We had a great stay in Berlin with Jelo Stay! The apartment and host were perfect! Thank you guys!

Appartement à l écart du centre mais tres facilement accessible en transport en commun. Quartier calme et appartement conforme au descriptif et photos. Très agréable séjour entre Noël et la nouvelle année.

Tolles, schickes appartement. Alles top!
Einziger Kritikpunkt: Eher Hellhörig (anderes Appartement gleich nebenan.
War eigentlich ganz ok aber es gab ein wenig Stockflecken und die Dusche war nicht ganz sauber. Preislich war es ein wenig zu viel.
Was ok because I got discout like 50 euros per night, but extra 50 euros for cleaning and fees. Anything more would not be ok for this tiny room. The house is nice, but inside you dont feel it.
Great location and very kind and responsive host. Pictures show exactly how the apartment looks like.
A beautiful,  airy apartment, much bigger than in the photos, with everything you need. Really felt at home in Berlin - thanks Elen for having us to stay!
入住方便，快速的回复。地理位置既方便又安静，房间也很干净。附近的好吃的饭店也很多。

This place is very well located and you can arrive different places just walking. There is a metro and bus station in the corner. The place is interesting since it is decorated with some pieces of art,  just be aware that one bedroom does not have a complete privacy, so far this is a very cozy place to stay in Berlin.

Veronika ist uns bei den Check-in und checkout Zeiten sehr entgegen gekommen und die Unterkunft ist wunderschön. Es ist noch deutlich größer im Vergleich dazu wie es auf den Fotos wirkt und richtig gemütlich!

Great apartment and very near to the s bahn so traveling in and out of the city was easy! Alex was a great host and let us add extra guests at a later date which was very helpful. Near two supermarkets and a lovely park with outdoor pool. As nine students we fit nicely, although the shower in the kitchen was slightly awkward there was still nothing to complain about! I would definitely come back!

our hosts were very helpful during our stay. the room is located in the heart of Berlin with a walking distance from many shops and restaurants which are open until late at night.
the coffee machine gave us a good start to the day and the room was clean with nice sheets and towels and many necessary things you may need.

Our stay was great. The location was perfect—right in the center of Berlin (Mitte), a nice neighborhood and very close to the main sightseeing spots. The apartment was super clean and the self check-in made everything really convenient. The only downside was that our room looked a little different from the pictures shown, but overall it was a very good stay and we’d recommend it.

Alles top 👍🏻…der Empfang durch Steffi war sehr nett, die Wohnung sauber und  mit liebevollen Details (Bücher, CDs) sehr gemütlich. Die Küche  war bestens ausgestattet, mit allem, was man so braucht. Ich habe mich mit meinen zwei Kindern sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Lage direkt am Helmholtzplatz geht sowieso nicht besser. Ich würde jederzeit sehr gern wieder kommen.

Die Lage der Wohung ist besonders erwähnenswert: ruhig gelegen, dennoch sehr zentral und mit toller Gastronomie in unmittelbarer Nähe. Wir konnten unser Auto auf einer verschlossenen Parkfläch abstellen. Die Wohnung ist großzügig geschnitten. Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen und mit allen nötigen Informationen versorgt.

We loved staying at Albert's Airbnb.
Albert was there to greet us and admit us to the apartment. He enthusiastically provided us with several ideas of places to eat and of things to see in and around Berlin. We followed many of his recommendations during our stay -- from local restaurant suggestions to a tour of Sanssouci Palace reachable by train in nearby Potsdam -- and were so happy we did.
Many of his suggestions turned out to be the highlights of our stay.
The apartment was clean, quiet, roomy for two and completely secure.
The location was perfect for us -- walkable to friendly cafés and restaurants, shops and U-bahn and S-bahn stations.
We whole-heartedly recommend this apartment and hope to return in the future.

Heval's apartment is simply superb. Very spacious and very clean and tidy. 3 bathrooms helped a lot when we stayed with  5 families, of about 9 adults and 4 kids. Big and bright living area perfect for the family breakfast and evening cool down. Finding parking was a bit tricky but other than that it's great. The owner also communicated very well and is very helpful. Highly recommended.
excelente ubicación

Mon séjour avec ma famille chez Martin était très agréable. L’appartement il était propre en conformité avec la description.
Super je vous conseil! Très bon doner dans le quartier et un restaurant vietnamien très sympa.
Würden wieder buchen wenn wir in Berlin sind.

Beautiful apartment with high ceilings and big windows overlooking a quiet courtyard in lovely Prenzlauer Berg, 3 minute walk from Senefelderplatz station. The apartment is beautifully decorated and very simple, with everything you need for a good stay. Comfortable beds as well (two twin size beds next to each other). I would highly recommend Henrik's apartment as a quiet place to recharge as you explore Berlin.

Nuestra estancia fue muy agradable, la ubicación es perfecta para moverte y fueron muy amables
Gracias!!
Great location and a beautiful apartment!

다른 유럽 중저가 호텔에 비해 매우 훌륭합니다. 깔끔한 것은 물론, 룸 인테리어와 건물 자체가 예뻐요.
지하철이 도보로 8-10분 거리에 있어 브란덴부르크 문이 미테 지구 등 방문하기 편했어요.
세탁기나 와이파이 등 편의 시설이 충분하고, 1층 리셉션에 친절한 직원분이 상주하여 도움을 받기 편리했습니다.
다만 숙소 가까이에 저녁 늦게 여는 식료품점이나 식당이 많이 없어 필요하시다면 미리 사서 들어가시는 걸 추천드려요!

El apartamento esta muy bien para la estancia. Es una bonita casa y reformada por dentro.
Tiene todo lo necesario y la ubicación es muy buena.

I enjoyed my stay at Phuong and Martin’s place because the bed was fairly comfortable and had a nice thick blanket to keep me warm at night. There was also a bathroom that was basically all to myself for the most part. The WiFi is fast and the water bottle in the room is a nice touch! The house was surprisingly very easy to find, if this was in central Berlin, this would make it even better, but nonetheless, the neighborhood is calm and tranquil. Nearby to the metro station which is 2 minutes by bus or a 12 minute walk, did both depending on how fast buses were running.

Der Mitarbeiter an der Rezeption war sehr unfreundlich. Er hat komische Witze gemacht, dass er nicht weiß was Airbnb ist.
Die Rezeption ist 24/7 und man muss bei der Buchung ankreuzen, wann man ungefähr kommt. Ich habe zwischen 22 und 24 angegeben und war gegen 23 Uhr da. Ich hatte den Gefühl, dass der Mitarbeiter sauer ist, dass ich nicht pünktlich um 22 Uhr da war.
Ich habe mich sehr unangenehm gefühlt.
Lovely and stylish place. It had everything we needed and was close to U-station for traveling. Would highly recommend!

Wir waren für vier Nächte mit unseren zwei Kindern (4 und 6) in der Wohnung und würden wiederkommen. Die Wohnung liegt gut und ist trotzdem recht ruhig. Das Schlafzimmer ist ein Durchgangszimmer zum großen Bad mit Badewanne. Das Wohnzimmer ist ebenfalls ein Durchgangszimmer mit Bett und Schlafsofa. Insgesamt wirkt die Wohnung mit ihren hohen Decken von der Bausubstanz recht hochwertig, leider sind die Möbel alle recht billig und fallen zeilenweise schon etwas auseinander. Der Außenbereich ist schön und praktisch, könnte aber etwas mehr Pflege vertragen. Es fehlen Kleinigkeiten wie Harken für Handtücher und hier und da müsste was repariert werden. Die Küche ist dafür aber recht gut ausgestattet. Es gibt eine Filter-Kaffeemaschine.
Das Parken an der Straße kostet ca 50 Euro pro Tag. Die Kommunikation und der Checkin war problemlos.
The building and apartment is amazing. It is a great location in Berlin that is surrounded by wonderful restaurants. I would definitely stay here again.

Tammy was a welcoming and friendly host.
Apartment was clean and in a quiet neighborhood.

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Die Wohnung war super, genau so wie auf den Bilder. Die Lage hat für uns sehr gut gepasst, wir konnten entweder zu Fuß gehen oder die nahegelegene U-Bahn nutzen. Vielen Dank, wir kommen gerne wieder!
Nice and clean place. Very comfortable.
Phuong and Martin provided a very comfortable space and were very responsive in the communication leading up to our arrival. They are very flexible and kind, would absolutely stay here again!

Sabine ist eine wunderbare und herzliche Gastgeberin. Die Kommunikation und Check-In waren tadellos. Das Zimmer ist wie auf den Fotos abgebildet sehr groß und hell. Alles war blitzsauber und mit Kaffeemaschine, Wasserkocher und Snacks gab es noch weitere Extras. Die Wohnung ist sehr zentral gelegen. Man braucht nur ein paar Minuten zu Fuß bis zur S-Bahn Haltestelle Berlin-Charlottenburg. In der näheren Umgebung sind viele Geschäfte, Restaurants, Supermärkte und weitere U-Bahn Stationen ebenfalls fußläufig erreichbar. Ich habe mich bei Sabine sehr wohl gefühlt und würde definitiv wiederkommen.
Great place. Optimal location to avoid the tourist traps. Loved it
The perfect place to use as a base for discovering Berlin! Gorgeous apartment and very stylish
Insgesamt drei von fünf Sternen

Our family of 5 enjoyed our stay at Rainer's apartment in Berlin. Rainer was a great host, and communication with him was easy. He met us at the apartment when we arrived to show us around. The apartment had everything we needed and was in a great location (all as described in the listing). We could walk to our choice of about 3 different U-bahn or S-bahn stations, which got us to anywhere we wanted in Berlin.
Tina是真的非常的友善，房间也很温馨，有阳台，有绿植还有很多书籍摆件，住在那里非常舒服🥰
Very nice location and clean room. The host was very kind all the time and gave me fast responses.

This place was perfect for our stay in Berlin. It's close to public transit and the neighborhood has tons of bars, restaurants, grocery stores, etc. The apartment itself is very nicely styled and had all the amenities we needed. Would def recommend to anyone coming to this part of Berlin!
Polecam, wszystko zgodnie z opisem.

Ruth’s place was clean, quiet, and had all the amenities for a comfortable stay. Less than 100 steps from the apartment, you can get on the tram and after a few stops you’ll be right in the middle of Berlin. Highly recommend Ruth’s place.

Ursulas Heim ist wunderbar in einem herrlichen Garten am Rande von Berlin gelegen. Sie ist eine sehr nette und hilfsbereite Gastgebererin, die am Abend bei einem Bier mit netten Geschichten und Tipps zu Berlin die Wartezeit zum Flug verkürzte.
Empfehlenswert bei Flugreisen ab Schönefeld. Das Auto kann vor Ort stehen gelassen werden.
Très bon séjour. Alex a été très disponible. Très bel appartement! Merci
De accomodatie ligt op een fijne plek!

Хорошие апартаменты, до которых довольно удобно добираться из центра города. Внутри все соответствует описанию. У нас возникли небольшие проблемы при заселении, но вместе с Аланом мы их решили. В целом, все хорошо, спасибо.

Absolutely beautiful place in a great neighbourhood with good connections to sites across Berlin. Very responsive hosts for any issues or recommendations. Will definitely stay again.
(Was definitely out of their control but we were kept up one night by neighbours playing loud music from 3am. Alles was top!
Der Aufenthalt bei Charlie eignet sich ideal für Personen, die viel unterwegs sind und einen gut angebundenden Ort zum Schlafen haben wollen.

Es war ein super Aufenthalt, mit allem was man benötigt hat! Sehr gute, schöne Lage :) alles sauber und super netter Empfang und generell eine sehr gute Kommunikation und Kontakt. Vielen, vielen Dank für den tollen Aufenthalt :)
Martina’s place was in an amazing location and gave us everything we needed to explore Berlin and rest!

Nos sentimos muy a gusto en este apartamento. Con un estilo exquisito, cálido y con muchas comodidades. Quedan pocos apartamentos en airbnb que dan una sensación de hogar y este definitivamente transmite calidez y sensación de estar en casa. Gracias por todo, nos ha encantado poder quedarnos aquí. La zona también nos ha gustado mucho.

Wonderful location, really cannot be beat. I stayed here with my partner and my younger brother (on his first trip to Europe!) and it was perfect for the 3 of us for a one week stay. We walked to the Prater Biergarten, Brunen DonerHouse, and Flying Monkey restaurant multiple times because they were all so good. There are also many other nice cafes, shops, and restaurants around that we went to and generally the neighborhood was just the best. Also within walking distance to the Kulturbrauerie which has a DDR museum as well as many clubs for the evenings.
Ranier's apartment was everything you need for your trip to berlin! Very cozy and located very close to the U-8 Metro. Highly Recommend staying here. :)

Prima  appartement. Vind het wel zeer ongemakkelijk dat als je met 6 personen bent er maar 1 badkamer is en 1 toilet, die zich ook nog in dezelfde ruimte bevinden. Nu weet ik niet hoe vaak het echt warm is in Berlijn, maar bij ons was het echt warm (30+ graden) en dan is het appartement niet af te koelen. Was echt warm ondanks de ventilatoren.

Nice flat, elevator to 4th floor, beautiful view on trees,
I had a good time there...thanks

Mein Freund und ich waren für ein Wochenende in der Wohnung von Andreas. Die Kommunikation war super und Andreas war für uns trotz dessen er sich auch im Kurzurlaub befunden hat stets ansprechbar. Die Schlüssel haben wir uns um die Ecke bei einem Laden abgeholt und alles lief reibungslos.
Die Wohnung war wirklich super gemütlich und wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt. Danke Andreas für die nette Gastfreundschaft wir kommen gern wieder :-)
Great location. Close walk to the train. Very clean inside and easy access to restaurants all around the AirBnB. I really enjoyed my stay!
Meget fin lejlighed med rigtig god beliggenhed tæt på ubahn. Dejligt med to separate soveværelser og det store badeværelse. Lækkert med automatisk kaffemaskine og opvaskemaskine.
ottimo soggiorno, casa molto carina luminosa e grande, comoda la posizione e ben collegata

La estadía fue bastante buena. Un lugar bastante cómodo y cerca de todo. Jens fue muy amable y atento a cualquier inquietud.

It was a nice stay for a group of girl-friends. Alex was very proactive providing all the necessary info. Finding food around was fairly easy. And we really appreciate that we could check out an hour later. Thank you.

Our stay was very nice. Sometimes hard to communicate but mostly fine with a mixture of languages! There is very good wifi in the room, and bathroom and kitchen were all available for us, and spotlessly clean. The sofa bed is a bit small for two people who aren't a couple, but overall very nice stay.
Bardzo klimatyczne miejsce, spokojna okolica. Gospodarz bardzo miły, jednak warto zaznaczyć, że nie mówi po angielsku, ale można dogadać się przez google tłumacz. Poza tym jak najbardziej polecam 😊

Wir waren sehr zufrieden.
Die Unterkunft ist angenehm eingerichtet und liegt sehr zentral. Zu Fuß war vieles erreichbar. Sehr empfehlenswert.

Ellen's apartment is better than on the pictures.
Very clean and furnished, we felt like "home".
It's well organized, kitchen, bathroom are very nice and every room is comfortable.
Schönhauser allee U and S Bahn is 5/10 mins walk.
I would really love to come back here again.

Dave is a very nice owner. I arrived earlier than normal check in time, he managed to store my luggage in advance and hand over key to me, so I can go free to visit Berlin.
Dave also gave me one helpful booklet, you can easily know many details around this area, how to go to train station/airport. Also provided both still and sparkling water.
Attached private bathroom is very comfortable. I highly recommend Dave’s room.
really great !! Comfortable, clean & Central, no complaints!
logement fonctionnel, propre accessible à toutes heures, quartier calme.

Even though the location was good, the apartment was super dirty (it even had cotton buds on the floor and smashed dirty towels in the cabinet). We booked this place for 3 persons (one is a baby, but still a person) and they didn’t leave sheets for the second bed. It also only had one bathing towel. On top of that, the host refused to answer and when he finally said something (after I contacted the airbnb support) he wasn’t helpful at all and dismissed everything that we asked, saying that the cleaning company they hired prepared the house for the guests. Which was a complete lie. This host is probably another house owner who makes the most profit out of a property’s without setting foot on it and with a huge lack of respect for the hospitality business and he’s guests.

Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt in Rainers Wohnung! Sie ist sehr gross, hat eine wunderschöne Terrasse und viel Licht, ist ruhig gelegen, sowie sauber und gemütlich :) Die Lage ist auch super, wenige Minuten Fussweg von der Tram entfernt, und auch zur U-Bahn ist es nicht weit. Es gibt süsse Cafes und Restaurants um die Ecke und einen Park!
Rainer war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit, und hat uns tolle Tipps gegeben, was wir unternehmen können :)
Wir würden die Wohnung jedem empfehlen der einen Urlaub in Berlin macht und wir würden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen!
nice neet clean quiet

The room was just as shown on the listing. The room was very clean and comfortable for the two of us. We loved the location. There's a great coffee shop just across the street, a little food mart almost next door, as well as a delicious kebab shop. There are many more stores and restaurants within walking distance too. A bus stop is just on the corner but we didn't need it because if you enjoy walking, you can get most places on foot.

Unser Aufenthalt für eine Nacht im Hotel Lindemann's hat uns sehr gefallen. Entspanntes Ankommen über handy key und entspanntes Landen in der Badewanne (wirklich große Wanne für zwei Personen). Zimmer tiptop und zu guter letzt die Terasse mit Platz und viel Sonne. Alles was wir brauchten.

We had a very active weekend in Berlin.  The flat is very well located for public transport (direct train to the airport and just a few minutes walk to at least two main stations) and there is also some good walking to do nearby although the area can be a bit chaotic.  We had excellent communications from the host with very clear and easy to follow instructions from the airport terminal right to the entrance of the flat!  It's a good spot for a short stay in Berlin.
I really enjoyed staying here. It was a great option for Berlin especially in a very lgbtq neighborhood!

phenomenal stay - one of the best airbnbs i've booked so far. modern, clean, tasteful/high quality furniture and decor - could be featured in Architecture Digest magazine. incredibly friendly host. area is perfect

This is a perfect place for a couple. The apartment is marvellous and close to shops and public transportation. The host is friendly and helpful. If I ever og back to Berlin this is where I would stay.

it was a blast!

Das Zimmer und die Waschräume waren zwar klein, aber sehr sauber und so für ein Wochenende super gut geeignet.
Small and compact house! Just enough place for 6 people. Quiet neighbourhood. Very easy to get in.

Die Remise ist inneneinrichtungstechnisch sehr gut durchdacht. Alles in allem ist es 1 Raum, genauso wie von Claudia beschrieben. Sie antwortet sehr schnell, ist auch sehr sofort Stelle, wenn was fehlt. Schlüsselübergabe u.-abgabe unkompliziert.
Very lovely place, located in a nice and quiet area. The hostess is very kind and always ready to help.
Stunning apartment with everything you could need and in a great location. Joseph provided clear communication on how to check-in and was always easy to get hold of when needed.
Klaus is an excellent host! His place is super clean and perfectly situated for all your city needs

We had a lovely time at Karsten's apartment. It's beautifully furnished in a mid-century style, clean and very well located, next to the metro station and very easily to get to the city center. Though we couldn't meet Karsten (he was on a trip) he gave all kind of facilities and tips to get to his apartment and he arranged everything, so a friend of him welcomed us and showed us everything. We fully recommend his place to anyone.

Man hat die ganze Etage für sich, es war sehr sauber und gemütlich, Bus und Bahn sind fußläufig und das Zimmer ist sehr günstig, vor allem dafür dass man das Schlafzimmer, Bad und Wintergarten für sich allein hat. Die kurze Unterhaltung mit der Gastgeberin war auch sehr freundlich und das Check In super einfach und unkompliziert
Great place to stay in a fun neighbourhood in Berlin, hosted by really nice people. 100% recommend!
Everything was great. The apartment and room were super clean, and I had a quiet, peaceful stay.

This place is fabulous!!!!very clean,very beautiful,very cozy, but i think is also the people living in there that make this house so warm!!!Paulo is the best possible host!thank you for everything and for making me feel sooo comfortable!!very nice neighborhood close to everything!!!ideal place to stay!
Hôte accueillant et sympathique, logement propre, fonctionnel et bien situé dans un quartier calme avec beaucoup de verdures et de bars/restaurants, pas très loin des arrêts de bus et de métro

Wohnung wie auf Bildern beschrieben, sehr schön alles neu und sauber. Ausgestattet mit allem nötigen das man braucht (Föhn, Wasserkocher, Milchschäumer, etc.)
Schöne ruhige Gegend gut erreichbar mit U Bahn oder Bus. Nicht zu weit entfernt von der Stadt und Nachtleben.

Wonderful place! Great location. Trying to figure when I can return!!

Alles in allem; für einen kurzen Aufenthalt gut geeignet.
Appartement propre et à proximité du métro. Bon séjour.
nice room ! practical and cosy

Amazing host and great location! I was able to walk to so many great spots!
Our stay went very well! The accommodation and location are great and the hosts are really friendly.
We had a great stay at Max's place. Was in a great location and easy to get to all main stops/metro etc. Max's place itself was cosy and well stocked. Felt like home!

Katja was super cool, generous and available for my questions. She mades me feel at home, the apartment is perfect, clean, the garden is beautiful and it was a pleasure to taking care of it. And the neighbors were super welcoming with me and Pankow ; what a nice district. Thank you so much for that experience.
Good, modern, clean apartment. No washing machine and iron. Nice and kind lanlord.

Great apartment in an excellent location surrounded by lovely restaurants & bars.  Host was brilliant answered all our questions and was really helpful.  I would definitely book this apartment next time I visit Berlin.

I had an extended stay at Nina's flat in Kreuzberg. You couldn't ask for a better location! So much to see, eat, drink and do just minutes from your door. You start to feel like you are a part of the neighborhood. Some well known, fantastic Berlin eateries, clubs and markets are all within an easy hike when you cross the beloved Admiralbrücke & walk along & beyond the Landwehrkanal. All the basics are covered too, with lots of small shops, larger markets and apothekes within minutes from the flat. It's also a six minute walk to a couple of large UBahnhofs. Nina is so incredibly helpful! She was quick and clear with communication and very kind in our dealings. If you feel like staying in, Nina has a galley kitchen to make a meal in and the washer is a life-saver if you're really on a trek. She describes her space as minimal & it is truly spartan. A comfortable chair or two and some warmer lighting would've been nice. I'm old, so the japanese sleeping mats where very hard on my back.

Wichtiger Hinweis: Lesen Sie bitte die Beschreibung von vorn bis hinten! Es ist (nahezu) genau so, wie beschrieben. Damit ist es keine klassische Airbnb-Unterkunft, aber eine gute Bleibe für Menschen, die viel unterwegs sein wollen, oder die genügsam sind. Da Übernachtungen in Berlin inzwischen recht teuer geworden sind, ist das für manche eine gute Alternative, aber keine klassische Touristen-Unterkunft.

Siamo rimasti soddisfatti di questo grazioso e accogliente alloggio. L'host sempre presente e ben disposta/o.
Consiglio caldamente questo alloggio e quando tornerò a Berlino, spero di poterlo riservare ancora.

Amine is very respectful and easy to talk to. I'd recommend staying there.
The flat is located at a S-Bahn train station.

Très bon séjour dans l’appartement de Bert! L’appartement est très bien placé : à côté d’une station de métro qui vous permet d’aller partout dans Berlin, des commerces à proximité pour faire des courses (donc un petit magasin au bout de la rue ouvert 24h/24!). Ils y a des bars et de bons restaurants dans le coin.
La cuisine est bien équipée et les lits hyper confortables, la rue très calme.
Je recommande à 100% !
Great place and even better host! Had an amazing stay at Ben’s. Feels very homey and cozy!
prima appartement, precies zoals de foto's. Lekker stil in de ruimte. Prima douche. Ook de matrassen van de slaapbank liggen prima.

Ich habe mich bei Brigitte besonders wohl und aufgehoben gefühlt. Wir hatten relativ schnell ein besonderes Vertrauensverhältnis. Das Haus liegt sehr ruhig und die Umgebung lädt zum spazieren gehen ein. Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und gemütlich.

Nous avons passé une excellente semaine en famille dans l’appartement d’Anna. Le logement était très propre, lumineux, équipé, parfaitement conforme aux photos de l’annonce. Sa localisation est parfaite pour visiter Berlin : le quartier est très agréable et calme, plusieurs restaurants et commerces de bouche à proximité, proche de plusieurs centres d’intérêt (à pied) et des transports en commun. Anna a été très agréable et réactive dans nos échanges de SMS, à notre arrivée notamment. Nous reviendrons avec plaisir chez Anna lors d’une prochaine venue à Berlin.
Une chose à avoir en tête (mais qui concerne probablement la majorité des logements disponibles sur AirBnB…) : il faut ajouter au montant payé sur le site une taxe de séjour d’un montant de 5% du montant total, non incluse dans le tarif indiqué (à payer sur place en espèces).
Great location and spotless flat. Communication was great, although I didn't get the chance to meet Ece, since I stayed just for a night. I can totally recommend staying here.
Wonderful host! We really loved staying at Sabine's place!

Really enjoyed staying in this beautiful small room located at a super trendy location in Berlin Friedrichshain! Bed was super compfy, so I had an excellent good night sleep! Checking in and getting in was a little logistically difficult (so many codes and PINs and instructions) as we had to upload heaps of covid vaccination certificates and IDs but I guess, that's the new normal in times of the pandemic. I don't think, that checking out by clicking on a link was really necessary - I usually forget things like that and would have preferred less admin to think about once on holidays. Anyway, if you take the time to read all information sent through Numa, I warmly recommend this place!

Alles gut, Fenster zum Innenhof und nicht zur Straße. Da haben in der Früh zwar ein paar Typen gequatscht, Aber mit geschlossenem Fenster ging es.
Zimmer sehr sauber. Nette Frau am Empfang. Hat alles gut geklappt. Ich würde es sofort wieder buchen.

keine Empfehlung

- Was uns gestört hat: das Bad liegt im offenen Schlafzimmer, was somit auch ein Durchgangszimmer ist - das fanden wir unpraktisch
Der Grund, warum wir früher ausgezogen sind: Schimmel überall am Silikon in der Dusche und in den Fugen an der Wand
Ich war schockiert, weshalb eine Wohnung in dem Zustand angeboten wird und fand es extrem ekelig!
Uns wurde angeboten das Silikon während des Aufenthaltes zu erneuern. Das wäre VORHER nötig gewesen PLUS die Beseitigung an den Fugen. Die Reinigung hat offenbar nicht viel gebracht.
Schade um das viele Geld...

Appartement ist neu eingerichtet und absolut ruhig. Trotzdem in zentraler Lage. Das Bad ist neu renoviert mit grosszügiger Dusche. Küche mit allem nötigen mit Espresso-Maschine und Wassersprudler. Wir haben nicht gekocht; ansonsten wäre das Töpfe-Sortiment etwas knapp gewesen. aber ansonsten alles tipptopp
Vielen Dank! Sehr schöne Unterkunft, super nett und der Kater ist zuckersüß 😍
Mycket bra boende. Nära till spårvagn. Första anblicken var att området såg ”ruffigt” ut men det va lugnt och tyst. Sköna sängar.

Serviced apartments, clean and comfortable. Kitchen was a little lacking in utensils. Beds very comfy and great shower in the en-suite. Staff were friendly and responsive. Good location close to bars, restaurants and the metro.
Un muy buen lugar! Muy cómodo, privado y limpio! Lo recomendamos

Das Apartment befindet sich in einer sehr schönen Gegend. Die Wohnung ist kleiner als erwartet und nicht zum längeren Aufenthalt geeignet, da es nur einen Stuhl gibt.
Die Fenster zum Innenhof sind vergittert und im Haus gibt es ( wie auch von Nachbarn bestätigt) lang anhaltendes lautes Geschrei und aggressives Verhalten, so dass es häufiger bereits zu Polizeieinsätzen kam wie auch bei unserem Aufenthalt.
Das Hochbett ist nicht gesichert,so dass der Abstieg für alle Personen äußerst schwierig war da es keine Haltegriffe gibt.

Cooles großes Loft an sehr guter Lage mitten in Kreuzberg 36. Trotzdem total ruhig in der Nacht. Geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Alles da, was man braucht. Küchenausstattung teilweise etwas veraltet. Würde gerne wieder buchen.
Eine sehr schöne Wohnung in zentraler Lage, die dennoch ruhig ist, könnt ihr erwarten. Die Wohnung ist mit allem, was  so gebrauch wird ausgestattet. Der Check-In klappt prima.
Gregory was an exceptional host. Excellent communication. Well located and clean. Fantastic stay. Thank you for the much needed rest.

I would have given 5 stars across the board but unfortunately we had no Wifi throughout our entire stay. Kirsten did attempt to fix the issue over multiple days, but we still left with having no Wifi the entire time which was unfortunate. Kirsten was responsive, the place was clean and in a nice location close to great restaurants and bars.

Fantastische nieuwe bungalow met een perfecte verbinding met de stad.
Alles erop en er aan.
Supermarkt en bakker op 5 min te voet.

I stayed here for 5 nights in April. Nice little apartment and good value for ~$100 a night (SGD). I’d recommend singles to stay here simply because the bathroom doesn’t have a ceiling so there’s no privacy. The apartment itself is like a little cottage behind a block of apartments—please note that it is located near a row of communal bins. Overall, it was a nice apartment.

Wir haben uns die Tage über sehr wohl gefühlt! Die Wohnung ist sehr schön eingerichtet und hat eine einladende Terrasse mit Ausblick. Auch die Kommunikation war super unkompliziert und wir haben uns durchgehend sehr wohl gefühlt. Immer wieder gerne!
Great price for a 3 bedroom, great location near transit, restaurants.  Very clean.

Fin, pæn og rummelig lejlighed med god beliggenhed. Mangler bedre/billigere parkeringsmuligheder taget udlejningspris i betragtning.

Ramfis was a great and friendly host. He gave clear instructions and the place was clean and tidy. The location was pretty good and was transit accessible.

Super Whg...ohne großen Aufwand mit der Bahn in Berlin- Mitte. Wenn man Freunde Vorort hat, iss man in Guten Händen, was schnelle und gute Verbindungen angeht 😂 Danke an unsere Freundinnen Karen & Maria aus Köpenick.

Marc war sehr sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Problemlose Abwicklung bei der Buchung und am Ankunftstag sowie am Tag der Abfahrt.
Leider war die Wohnung kleiner als wir gedacht haben, nachdem wir die Bilder gesehen hatten.
Sonst alles Super.
L’alloggio è stato fantastico. Le persone migliori che si possano incontrare. casa pulita, ospitale, profumata. tanto amore e tante gentilezza. bellissimo!
Parwana's house is really clean and lovely. It is also very near to the tram stations with supermarkets and bakeries nearby!

We had a great stay at Dietrich's. The apartment was lovely, well decorated and very easy to find. Very close to lots of public transport. Our only minor comment is that the apartment is on the ground floor of a block of flats (I had thought it was a loft apartment) so can be noisy at times with people coming and going. other than that it was great!
Great, thanks. Had everything we needed and close to the U-Bahn and S-Bahn stations

This home is lovely! Would definitely stay here again, very spacious and welcoming. Everything was very clear and set up perfectly.

Frank's place was a very comfortable apartment in a great location. The area was beautiful and lively - great places to go out at night. Great public transport around. The apartment was clean & tidy, and we were 5 and slept really comfortable there.

Andrea ist eine sehr nette, hilfsbereite und zugewandte Gastgeberin. Sie war immer ansprechbar. Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön und sauber. Ich habe mich sehr wohl und willkommen gefühlt und komme gerne wieder.

Dies ist ein Kleinod, um in Berlin ruhig und in freundlicher Atmosphäre zu wohnen! Die Wohnug von Bruni und Andreas ist  einladend und die Gastgeber bieten ein herzliches Willkommen. Man fühlt sich rundum wohl. Alles was man braucht, ist vorhanden.

Christina place's very nice and supper clean we love it. She's so kind and helpful for us and gave us a card for transports and guide us any question that we needed. Strongly recomend to stay in her place. If we have a chance to get back Berlin we will stay again.
😊😊😊
Great looking apartment,  we enjoyed our stay.

Check in went smoothly, and Mohammed was very communicative during our stay. Proximity to public transport was also a plus! We did have a few cons to the apartment though. There was a weird odor in the apartment that seemed like it was coming from the pipes. We left the windows opened which helped. There was some hair on the pillow cases as well, but the rest of the linens looked fine. Overall it was an okay stay in a safe area with a responsive host, but I’m not sure if I would book again.

Great location, mildly disappointed by shower as did not stay on hook and was slightly dangerous due to heaviness of shower head, WiFi was also not very reliable. Other than this apartment was very close to subway and comfortable :)

It is a very clean and lovely apartment. You can find  everything you need at the apartment. The location is fantastic! 1 minute  away from the subway! There are a lot of restaurants close by , and only takes 5mins to get to a super market. And Jörn is a very nice man , very thoughtful! It was a great trip ! I had great time in Berlin! Will definitely choose here if I ever visit again.

I had a lovely stay at Lina’s residence. The apartment was so clean and tidy. Lina and Mitchell were responsive whenever I had questions. They were able to accommodate my request for an earlier check in. The location is very convenient, close to the S and U lines as well as bus routes, shopping, pharmacy and food market. It was easy to get around town via public transportation. It was always nice to come back home to this space, it did feel like a home away from home. The big windows make the apartment bright even on a snowy day. I’m glad they have black out shades in the bedroom so I could sleep in as I was battling jet lag. Loved my stay here. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I will be back!
Very hospitable, wonderful breakfast, beautiful home!

Werner’s place is exactly as described—a comfortably spacious 3 bedroom in a quaint neighborhood with many fantastic restaurants and nearby attractions for whatever floats your boat. It’s very close to the city center with plenty of tourism and nightlife. You can easily walk, bike, Uber, or take the trains and busses. We were so very pleased with this as our first stay in Berlin and highly recommend this spot to everyone!
will recommend this place. the place is not far from Berlin hauptbahnhof/Alexanderplatz. the place is very clean. we felt right at home. book it and thk me later.   we will visit again.
Ben was friendly and helpful. Great location too! Totally recommended!

He has a very good understanding towards others. He is a very good host, easy to stay together.
Great location, looks exactly like in the pics. Great getaway for a girls weekend. Anna was very helpful. Great breakfast place across the street. Berlin Wall memorial 5 min walk.
Great flat in a lovely neighborhood. Franz was a very helpful host.

Jeanette was a wonderful host. Very clear communication, easy check in and out instructions. Provided a clearly marked private parking space which is amazing in a city. The space was super clean and stocked with everything necessary in the kitchen as well as some extras. Very professional host book with house instructions and recommendations. This spot is a 5 minute walk to a bus stop which run direct to a subway station with direct line into the city center (about 45/60 minutes) which is very accessible. The location is very quiet which is great for sleeping after the bustle of the city. Thanks so much for making our trip to Berlin so enjoyable and easy! Cheers!

Staying at Berke's place was great. We spent the weekend there for a concert on the Saturday in Zitadelle Spandau - which was great only 30mins by car til there. Also we got e-scooters from and til there easily and rides of 20-30min til the touristic area and with Cycling Lanes all the way!
We've had asked for the possibility of a late checkout on sunday and it was great that this was possible!
Would definitely recommend this place!
Stanza grande, pulita. Buona la posizione vicino la stazione metro. Ho dato 5 stelle!

Logement très bien situé, propre, fonctionnel et facile d’accès dans un immeuble calme.
Le contact avec Tanja a été bienveillant et nous la remercions pour ce séjour réussi !

Eine schöne, besondere Unterkunft. Ich habe ein paar Konzerte in Berlin gespielt- alles hat hier super funktioniert, ein Rossmann fast nebenan, schnell kommt man von A nach B, schöne Cafes in der Nähe! Die Kommunikation war fantastisch. Wenn ich nochmal alleine nach Berlin reise, würde ich gerne wieder hier unterkommen.
This flat is very spacious and in a great location close to transportation to the major Berlin sights.

Oriane's apartment is charming and spacious.
It is ideally located in Friedrichshain, close to many restaurants and bars but also to the Otskreutz station which makes it vbery practical.
Our stay was just perfect !
Das Zimmer war sehr sauber. Die Gastgeberin ist sehr nett, es war alles umkompliziert und sehr entspannt. Vielen Dank :)

L'appartamento è molto carino. È una stanza con letto matrimoniale, due armadi, una mensola e un tavolo con due sedie e cucina. La cucina è fornita con tutto il necessario. Poi c'è un bagno a parte anche quello con tutto il necessario (incluso phon). All'ingresso c'è un appoggia scarpe e si possono appendere le giacche. La posizione è ottima. L'appartamento è alla periferia di Berlino però a 5 min puoi prendere il bus (sempre in orario e molto comodo) e a 10 min a piedi raggiungi U-Bahn (U2 e U7) e la S Bahn. La comunicazione con la proprietaria era buona e ha semore risposto dopo poco. L'unica mia critica è la pulizia della casa. Non era proprio sporca ma neppure pulitissima. C'era molta polvere e prima di utilizzare gli armadi ho dovuto dare una pulita e spolverare quindi farei più attenzione alla pulizia in generale. Per il resto mi sono trovata molto bene e ringrazio la proprietaria

the place is great (as it can be seen on the pictures). Robert is a very nice host and is happy to give tips and support for his guests.
Close to puplic transport, close the Tiergarten area for those who love to go running, you will reach many interessting locations wirhin less time. Even being that cental you might wonder how silent the place is located.

Great location for commuting around Berlin to see the sights. Excellent local shops within minutes walk. Comfortable bed, brilliant shower & great kitchen facilities - crockery, pots & pans, etc for making your own meals. Extremely helpful local advice from Sandra, which greatly assisted with planning our trip. Already scheduling our next trip to Berlin, to see the parts we didn't get to - & will definitely book this apartment again.
Highly recommended.

My stay at Gili's apartment was ok. The bed was very comfortable and the comforter was nice and warm. Heating was effective, so it was great to turn on the heaters after a long day out in the cold and feel nice and toasty. I didn't use the kitchen during my short stay, and although it was very small, it seemed to have everything one would need to make some simple meals. The bathroom was very small as well, but it did have enough space for me to lay out my toiletries comfortably. The shower was not ideal because it was very small, but the water pressure was fantastic, so all was good there. The neighborhood was nice, and very close to public transit and plenty of places to eat, but I will say the building was unattractive and not the nicest thing to come home to. Also, there was a strong foul odor coming from the closet, and when I let Gili know about it, he did not want to come to clean it or remedy the situation. I therefore could not use the closet and I had to stay away from that side of the room because i could smell that odor whenever I was near. This made my stay less comfortable than it could have been, however because I spent most of my time outside of the apartment, it wasn't the worst thing. Overall, the space is a good size for one or two people, and the location is great for exploring all that Berlin has to offer, particularly at this particular price point.

Ein Zimmer in einer typischen Berliner Wohnung mitten im Prenzlauer Berg - Ausstattung war ausreichend, alles gut vorbereitet und blitzsauber. Zusammen wohnen mit dem Gastgeber und einem weiteren Gast sehr problemlos, alles in Ordnung.
excelente, tudo deu certo

Some of the dining chairs were a bit squeaky as if they were going to break soon and the floor wasn't very clean but everything else was super! Dietrich's hospitality was also very nice.
We had a lovely weekend in Simon’s flat. Great location, comfortable and spotlessly clean. Thank you!

Die Wohnung ist wie auf den Bildern ersichtlich ein absoluter Traum, leider hat es überwiegend geregnet und wir konnten die wunderbare Dachterrasse nicht nutzen. Wir kommen definitiv gerne wieder, wenn wir in Berlin sind! Vollste Empfehlung von meiner Seite!

Super appartement. Schoon en handig geregeld met inchecken. Prima voor een weekend Berlijn.
很好的位置！房间很干净！房间内没有咖啡和茶提供.

Die Unterkunft ist noch besser als auf den Fotos ersichtlich. Die beiden Schlafzimmer sind geräumig, das Bad mit Dusche und separater Badwanne gross. Der Balkon und das eine Schlafzimmer sind gegen einen sehr grünen und ruhigen Innenhof gerichtet. Richtig gemütlich, um ein bisschen draussen zu sitzen.
Das Apartment ist super gelegen. Die berühmte Oranienstrasse mit vielen Restaurants, Cafés, Bars und Kneipen ist zu Fuss erreichbar. Es hat aber auch direkt vor der Tür eine Bushaltestelle oder ebenfalls fussläufig erreichbar 2 U-Bahn-Stationen, um schnell in der ganzen Stadt rumzukommen. Direkt um die Ecke hats zwei Supermärkte, einen Späti und eine leckere Bäckerei. Es fehlt einem an nichts.
Alles in allem ein Top-Aufenthalt. Vielen Dank Sahin!
1층에 거주하시는 호스트분께서 직접 맞아주셔서 놀랐고 따뜻하게 맞아주셔서 감사했습니다. 숙소가 베를린 시내와는 많이 떨어져 있어서 이동하는 시간이 꽤 걸리긴 했지만, 그만큼 마을 분위기는 조용해서 좋았숩니다. 집 근처에 큰 마트도 있고, 작고 예쁜 레스토랑도 정말 맛있었어요.

Was greeted by Verda herself with free fresh cold beers!!! The apartment has everything you need, in an awesome spot for cafes, restaurants and entertainment and it was only a 20 min walk to the Berlin Cathedral, Berlin Wall Memorial and the Pergamon Museum!!!
Verda let us know about the bar that she owns (15 min walk away from the apartment) so we went there on our last night! And it was awesome!!
The apartment itself is stunning, clean and has beautiful views from the windows and the balcony. But ultimately, Verda was so nice and helpful throughout our entire stay and really helped make our Berlin experience a great one!!!
Easy to find, comfortable quiet place in the back block of apartments away from the street.  Checkin and out was convenient, the flat had everything we needed.
I had a great stay here. It’s a cute place that was convenient for my trip. Would stay here again for sure.

Eine Unterkunft, die alles bietet, was man braucht. Außerdem ruhig und zentral in der Nähe des Ku’damms gelegen.

Good bedroom, very clean, close to the metro station by 3 min walk. Burak was very friendly and helpful.
Would highly recommend great location, clean and safe.
Christoph’s place was amazing, so clean and modern, it made us feel at home. I especially liked the coffee machine. Beautiful location as well, it was perfect for our first trip to Berlin.
Das war mein zweites Mal in dieser Wohnung und es war wieder toll. Absolut zu empfehlen.
Great host, great loft both location and the loft itself!

I selected this apartment for a 5-day stay and had a pleasant experience.
The place has everything you need and is close to nice restaurants, a supermarket and an U-Bahn stop.
Great lighting and good bathroom. But the thing that stood out were the extremely comfy beds!
Simon gave me clear instructions to enter the flat and was available and friendly.
I would suggest this place to young people and I would definitely come back myself.

Le logement est situé dans une banlieue calme et verdoyante tout en permettant un accès rapide (30mn)au centre ville.
Le logement est confortable et chaleureux, les hôtes sont accueillants et réactifs. Nous recommandons cette adresse.
Ghislaine et Martine

As a visitor from the United States I was very happy with our accommodations and really glad that staying with Axel was very easy going. Check in was simple and Axel worked with us to accommodate earlier check in time. We enjoyed the small kitchen and amenities like tea pot. We also needed extra towels at one point and Axel helped bring them to us easily. The Airbnb is in a wonderful location near all the classic sights and monuments and there are always scooters/ bikes in are to get around. Starbucks is two blocks down and tons of restaurants in neighborhood as well as close supermarket and mall for all needs. The wifi is a bit slow, so if you need to do work for a job you will need to go to a cafe to find good wifi.
Great location, really nice studio and great host!
GREAT location in Berlin! The place is clean and also provides Netflix for your stay! Super easy and organized check in process.
Amazing stay and staff, would definitely recommend it :)
excellent space for a group to explore Berlin. walkable and close to public transport to get you anywhere you need to go.
Quiet and peaceful place. Had Berlin vibe.

My stay at Numa/Drift was great. The fully remote check-in/check-out worked fine. Help line internet messages sent to Numa were always answered promptly and they did what they could to help address any questions or issues. There were also periodically people in the lobby who could help with additional questions.
Just a heads up, for those traveling abroad with only data and no SMS/text ability, you’ll need to have a friend or relative who can receive SMS/text to register/check-in. This was the only hiccup in checking in.
The unit itself was like a very nice hotel. The property is in great condition and the rooms have nice amenities, including a microwave, small refrigerator, a few plates, utensils, etc. They even offer coffee pods and tea for free.
The one issue I had was with the reliability of the Wi-Fi. It was not strong in my room on the 8th floor and periodically disconnected. It was an issue since I had limited data while in Germany. I contacted the Numa help line, but they said they were not able to do anything about it during my stay. Just a heads up for those who may be working from the room or need to rely on the hotel’s Wi-Fi.
Otherwise everything else was great and I would recommend to other guests.

The apartment is OK. It suited my needs quite well, being central and spacious enough for two people. I find it very difficult to understand people who describe the place as clean because it was really filthy on my arrival. I spent 4 or 5 hours cleaning all the surfaces and the insides of most cupboards and the toilet which smelt like a public urinal. In addition to this I bought myself 2 pillows because the ones provided smelled of sweat. Also there is no way to provide sorely needed ventilation in the front room without opening the door to the street.... Would I recommend this place to someone?...Sure! If the bedding were cleaned or replaced, the window in the front room repaired, and the entire place given a proper spring clean, it would be fine. It's a pretty cool place actually, but it is in desperate need of a little TLC! I was given a refund of 25€ for my cleaning and shopping efforts which didn't really sweeten the deal nearly enough
Alles super, sauberes Airbnb, zentrale Lage.
Everything was nice and went smoothly.
great location, spacious rooms & lots to do

First, Richard is an amazing host. He responds so quickly, is very friendly, and speaks English well. He was able to help us get in when we had an issue once, and met us on arrival to welcome us in and show us the place.
Second, the place is great for families. There are 4 large bedrooms and 3 baths! The kitchen area made it easy to cook meals (and there are many nearby supermarkets). It is cool inside, even without A/C (and in 30°C heat!), and the wifi was awesome.
Third, the location with less than a 10 minute walk to the S-bahn makes this a great place. I worked in west Berlin, while my family was able to tour the city - all so conveniently.
I would stay here again if back in Berlin and recommend it highly to anyone else.

Great location, lovely balcony, apartment has two separated rooms.
Host is very attentive.
Very well located apartment offering good value for multiple guests

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The host was very responsive and helpful, offering great local recommendations. I’d highly recommend this spot to anyone visiting Berlin!

Kurz und Knapp: Überdurchschnittlich gut.

Overall we were satisfied with this place. Big plus is the excellent location. Big minus during our stay was that the heating did not work properly. This was eventually fixed but it disrupted our relaxation somewhat and caused two days of lowish temperatures inside the flat. This is technology and it can happen even though the boiler maintenance was overdue. Important was that Augustin dealt with the issue successfully as fast as it was possible. Thank you Augustin for an otherwise very pleasant stay. We would return anytime.

Liebe Mina
Vielen Dank für die tollen Tage in deinem Appartement. Für mich und meine Tochter war es sehr toll!

Really great apartment for our small family. Very helpfully equipped with high chair, cot and child bedding. We loved the local area too and very convenient for the tram and connections to central Berlin. Thank you for having us!
Alles einfach und unkompliziert, saubere und schöne Unterkunft. Insgesamt etwas hellhörig und in Zimmer 5 war die Lüftung zu hören.

Super séjour dans l'appartement de Martina : il est grand, calme, et placé proche des transports. Les chambres et le séjour sont confortables, le balcon donne sur une cour intérieure arborée. Je recommande !
God placering og fin kommunikation, fin plads i lejligheden, men lejlighedens møbler og køkken mangler opdatering og mere renhed kunne ønskes samt støj fra rør og udsugning generer for søvnen.
Our whole stay was great - location, communication, the condo itself, host recommendations and friendliness, all of it! We would highly recommend and stay here again in the future.

GREAT hosts. (The rental is basically a room of their apartment, but with a totally separate entrance. Total privacy, but also quick communication with Etienne and Judit, who are very nice.)
I was traveling alone with a grumpy 3-year-old, and Etienne and Judit shared kids' toys, which helped keep my child occupied.
Place itself is as described in ad. Quite small, but a nice location, quick to trams and right between Friedrichshain and Prenzlauer Berg.
Mis padres se hospedaron aquí y todos estuvimos muy contentos. Recomiendo el lugar.

Lovely stay in an awesome part of Berlin, but the house is right next to the trash bins, so crashing bottles & trash noise was loud as well as crows & doves in the early AM.
Bring ear plugs!
Julius is a great host but our biggest complaint was the bed was not a queen or double but two twins pushed together with separate comforters so either one of us was constantly falling into the divide & the duvets would separate. With the heat turned off this time of year, we were cold quite often.

It was amazing! The apartment is in a good location next to stop publish transport.
Martin gave us all the instructions to arrive easier
Das Hotel war sehr sauber und modern eingerichtet. Wir haben uns wirklich wohlgefühlt und würden jederzeit wiederkommen :)
Great location close to public transport

Good spot and easy check in!
A fan would of been nice since being in the middle of summer :)

Vi var 3 voksne og 2 børn på 8 og 13 år. Man sad lidt tæt sammen i køkkenet og der var kun 4 stole til 5 gæster. Vi valgte dog at leve med det, da vi kun brugte køkkenet til morgenmad. Om aften sad vi i vores senge på værelserne.
Har man brug for at sidde sammen om aften er lejligheden ikke optimal, men er man alligevel ude på tur det meste af dagen og primært bare skal bruge overnatning, så har lejligheden vores varmeste anbefalinger. Pænt og rent og gode senge. Vi har været meget glade for vores ophold!
Beautiful apartment

Great place! Very tasteful appartment. In short time, you reach the Prenzlauer Berg area so it’s a convenient spot to explore the city. We had very hot weather and enjoyed the very green and therefor cooler neighborhood. Would book next time again.
Muchas gracias por la estadía.
Ich habe mich wieder wunderbar wohl gefühlt in dieser kleinen Dschungel-Oase mitten in Berlin. Ich komme bestimmt noch öfter.
Great stay, extremely responsive and prime location. 10/10 recommend

Such a beautiful apartment. Amazing location in central Kreuzberg and the hosts provided a great extensive list of recommendations. They were also so communicative and friendly. Would definitely recommend and will hopefully return!
Wohnung ist gut zu erreichen. Schlüssel Übergabe war unkompliziert.

Unser Aufenthalt in der Wohnung war ausgezeichnet (Gruppe von 5 Personen). Aufteilung, Gestaltung und Ausstattung sind sehr gut, lediglich die Küche war etwas spärlich bestückt (Salz und Pfeffer fehlten beispielsweise). Es gibt zahlreiche Einkaufsmöglichkeiten (Edeka, DM, Apotheke, Bäckerei) in fußläufiger Umgebung ebenso wie nette Restaurants und Cafés. Auch die Haltestellen (U-Bahn und Tram sowie S-Bahn) sind in maximal 20 Minuten zu erreichen. Praktisch ist auch der Zugang mit Zahlencodes, sodass man auch in einer größeren Gruppe unabhängig und flexibel ist. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Perfect and tidy apartment with everything you could need for your holiday in Berlin. We have stayed there twice now and has been equally happy with both visits! Would highly recommend!
Alles super
Wir hatten einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt bei Luis. Alles war so wie beschrieben und Luis war wirklich sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Meget dejlig lejlighed og placeringen var helt perfekt. Rolig og hyggeligt kvarter.

Louis' Wohnung war super für meinen Kurztrip nach Berlin. Die Lage ist perfekt, die U-Bahn Haltestelle ist zu Fuß keine 5 Minuten entfernt und Louis war auch sehr flexibel sodass ich früher einchecken konnte. Das Bad hätte ein bisschen sauberer sein können aber alles in allem war ich sehr zufrieden und würde diese Unterkunft empfehlen!

I highly recommend Jana and Paul's place lovely location and same goes for the hosts.
Good informations about everything you need to know about the neighborhood and directions.

Perfect Berlin vibe! 
If you want to enjoy every minute of your Berlin holidays, this is the place you should choose. The location is perfect—very cozy and beautiful surroundings, with lots of cafes and restaurants. We really loved the garden inside the building. Apartments are even better than the pics here. Actually, you can find everything that you may need during your stay. 
Marwa is a very responsive and caring host! I highly recommend staying at her place. 
The only thing to complain about is the quality of cleaning.  We hope Marwa will manage it.
Alles wie beschrieben, sauber und ordentlich, haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt!
Wat een paradijsje, vlak bij het centrum van Berlijn! Heel fijn en schoon huisje! Vriendelijk ontvangst!
Very straightforward, easy check-in and the little treats were a wonderful extra touch! Very comfortable and safe space to stay.

Marius was very accommodating with our luggage drop off for an early arrival and even carried it upstairs for us! The listing is as described and Marius was quick to respond when needed. It’s an older home as stated but very spacious and we enjoyed our stay.
Definitely coming back!

Wir hatten einen angenehmen Aufenthalt im Appartement. Das Appartement sieht aus wie auf den Bildern und es war alles vorhanden, was man für einen Aufenthalt benötigt. Wir waren zu dritt (zwei Erwachsene und ein Kind) und dafür hat es die perfekte Größe. Man ist in wenigen Gehminuten im Treptower Park oder beim Einkaufsladen Netto. Die S- Bahn Station Plänterwald ist 10 Gehminuten und die S Bahn Station Treptower Park 20 Gehminuten entfernt. Die Kommunikation mit David und Inaam war super und der Check-in lief reibungslos.
Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Ich hatte einen großartigen Aufenthalt in der Unterkunft! Die Wohnung war genauso wie beschrieben, sehr sauber und gemütlich. Die Lage war super – ruhig, aber dennoch gut angebunden. Der Gastgeber war unglaublich freundlich und hat schnell auf Nachrichten geantwortet. Besonders gut gefallen hat mir die kleine persönliche Note in der Einrichtung. Ich habe mich direkt wie zuhause gefühlt! Ich würde definitiv wiederkommen und kann die Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen
SANA is a very comfortable, quiet place to stay in Berlin. Be aware that the sofa bed is designed for children rather than adults but other than that, I would recommend staying here!

Helia was great, meeting me at the apartment in the morning for an early check in. The apartment is in a very walkable area, with lots of restaurants and shops nearby, including grocery stores.

The only thing I wish I'd known before making my reservation is that it can get kind of noisy during the day. The apartment is behind a shop, and the bathroom and the shop's bathroom share a partial wall. The store room also appears to back up to the bedroom.

If you spend the day out of the apartment most of the time, it shouldn't be an issue, as the shop closes at 8pm. If you work from home, like I do, then it can be distracting.

It's a cute apartment in a great part of town, but I would say it's more for those looking to be out during business hours.
propre, bon emplacement dans lal ville, on a apprécié le café et le thé  disposition mais un peu froid dans l'ensemble.

The room is easily accessible, and while on the outskirts of Berlin, is close enough to the metro to make going to the center of Berlin easier than expected. Clean, inexpensive, and private, with a comfy bed.
The apartment was very nice with a really good localisation
Perfect place to stay, great location. A short walk to the trains and places for food and shopping. We had everythign we needed in the flat including a quiet washer/dryer. Great when you have a baby!

Wir müssen großen Dank und ein riesiges Lob an Heval aussprechen - das Apartment war in einem perfekten Zustand und ein idealer Ort, um den Aufenthalt in Berlin zu verbringen. Genauso lobenswert ist auch Heval als Gastgeber - aufmerksam, gut organisiert, außerordentlich hilfsbereit und zuvorkommend. Alles verlief reibungslos - vielen herzlichen Dank!

Wir waren zu viert für 2 Nächte in Berlin. Der Check-In und alle Anweisungen waren sehr gut organisiert, Personal sehr freundlich. Außer der Küchenzeile (aber auch nur die Oberflächen) machte die Wohnung allerdings einen wenig gereinigten Eindruck, fast so als wären die vorherigen Gäste gerade erst gegangen. Die Betten waren eher lieblos gerichtet, Kühlschrank und Besteck teilweise noch dreckig, Kaffeeflecken auf dem Nachttisch, Bad wirkte nicht gereinigt.
Die Lage ist aber recht gut, da man sofort in der U-Bahn ist und überall hinkommt.
Keine Angaben
Super schnelle Antwort immer sehr freundlich. Alles unkompliziert.

Original room that I booked did not have AC. NUMA handled the situation very well. They found me another room in the building with AC. Hotel was clean, centrally located. If in Berlin again would stay here

Die Wohnung ist wunderschön ruhig gelegen mitten im grünen Kalshorst. Sie ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet und wirklich mit allem ausgestattet, was man sich wünschen kann inkl. ein paar leckeren Sachen im Kühlschrank fürs erste Frühstück. Kerstin ist eine tolle Gastgeberin und man merkt, dass sie mit Herzblut bei der Ausstattung und Einrichtung der Wohnung dabei war. Es ist alles blitzsauber. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden jederzeit wieder kommen.
Great apartment, central location and the Zaza bar in front of the building is amazing, especially the employees!
Great mini apartment.

I enjoyed my stay at Andre's apartment. Andre was very friendly and helpful. The apartment was very nice and lovely which suited all my needs. The place is located near the subway and you can get anywhere easily. Perfect combination of reasonable price and great accommodation. Highly recommended!
Anca’s apartment was much larger than expected for the price. It was a very clean and unique space. Highly recommend!

Beyza è una persona molto gentile sempre pronta ad aiutare i suoi ospiti
La casa rispecchia le foto ed è molto pulita
La zona è il vero punto forte, in quanto facilmente raggiungibile con la metro è vicina alle principali attrazioni della città nonché ai miglior divertimenti
Excellent small and modern hotel in a great area
Great location, very friendly family. The bedroom is indeed small and separated from the bathroom but I would recommend this place 10/10!
Berat is a kind host. The apartment is brand new, or at least looks like it. A pleasant place to be.
Sehr tolles airbnb. Gerne wieder.
just a wow place, such a lovely hostess, best wishes for the new year!

Sehr freundlicher Kontakt,
Super schöne Wohnung in wirklich top Lage!

We stayed at Axels place for 2 nights. The apartment was very clean and we felt very comfortable.
The location, for us, was incredible! lots of shopping and restaurants all around but still not crowded makes the place perfect. subway is very close and with a 15 minute walk you arrive at mall of berlin.
communication with Axel was very easy. He replied fast and is very easy going. we will definitely come back to axels place and we can totally recommend the place.

Total nett, zuverlässig und unkompliziert.
Ansprechende unterkunft um Berlin wie zu Hause zu erleben.
The place is spacious and very nice, located in an lively area of Berlin with bars and cafes - but the yard is quiet so nobody will disturb you. much recommend, thank you for hosting us!
Lovely flat, easy location for public transport, in the centre of everything we wanted to visit. Free WiFi, clean bathroom and kitchen. Very comfortable double bed. Perfect

Numa is not worth your money!
We booked a room in Berlin Mitte for 3 days and payed €150 per night. For that amount of money you may expect good service and a quality room, but that was not the case.
Several things where off: the room was hot because the airconditioning was not working, the tv was not working, the bed was terrible (it was on wheels, it moved and made noise everytime you turned around) and you could hear your neighbours.
We contacted them immediately when we arrived on day one. The contact with Numa was terrible. You could only reach them via chat and the first answer was always from a robot. When we eventually could speak to a real person, they where not helpful at all and it took so much time to get a respond. They said they would fix the TV and that they would give us a discount of 25% with a refund, but they didn't do anything and up till now we haven't received any refund!
Don't book here, it is not worth your money!

Our stay was absolutely wonderful. The apartment was lovely and exactly as it looked in the photos - we especially enjoyed the beautiful balcony! It's perfectly located in Prenzlauer Berg, a great district full of shops and restaurants and a lovely park. We also found it within walking distance of all the main tourist attractions! The host, Verda, was exceptionally helpful, always there to answer messages and pick up the phone, as well as letting us check in early and check out late. All in all, I would thoroughly recommend staying in this lovely apartment.

L'appartement est conforme à la description, propre, agréable et situé dans un quartier très calme et proche des moyens de transport, avec une supérette et restaurants à proximité. Nous étions 5 adultes et avons passé un excellent séjour avec un accueil ponctuel, chaleureux et de bon conseil.
Excellent location in the heart of Berlin. Clean, cozy home.
Alles super, wie immer (sind zum dritten Mal da gewesen und kommen gerne wieder).
Great location next to restaurants and bars! Amazing communication with host! The loft was everything as expected and more
Nice, slightly noisy apartment in a great neighborhood. Stella’s a great communicator! We enjoyed Berlin.
Mooie BnB in een rauwe maar levendige omgeving!

Good Apartment with Some Issues
Pros: Excellent location; apartment in good condition.
Cons: Major heating problem as it's turned off from 1 AM to 7 AM, leading to cold nights. The kitchen, although equipped, lacks an oven, limiting cooking options.

Accurate pictures, amazing location, quick responses by host, and close to the subway and a few cafes. It's a "loft style" apartment so not a lot of privacy when you're in the bathroom and someone is in the bedroom, but we knew that going in and didn't mind at all. Will be back!

Toaster was broken and not replaced. Co host dropped one off. Pillows and towels terrible quality for an expensive apartment. Bed saggy in the middle below average comfort. Water stopped running on last day and we had to relocate. The easy entry was anything but easy. The lock box didn’t work and location is 1.1 km from property. The address on Airbnb is incorrect. For the price we paid per night it was a rip-off.

Lovely apartment! big like for the hottub! Everything was fantastic! Exept we had a lake in toilet paper..
I still not understand why we had to pay more money at our leaving so pay attention. Exept this all was amazing! 5 star! P. S mishel learned hebrew so the communication was very good
Very cozy place and perfect location.

Das Hostel/Zimmer von David ist sehr schön und auch sehr groß, was uns positiv überrascht hat. Es ist alles sauber und man hat alles was man braucht. Falls man einmal nicht weiter weiß hilft einem der Gastgeber sehr gut weiter. Die Betten waren angenehm und das WLAN war auch sehr schnell.
Nice, clean and spacious appartment. Metro stations and a supermarket (Lidle) just around the corner

Un bell' appartamento moderno situato in una zona verde e tranquilla vicino alla stazione, comoda per raggiungere il centro. Bella cucina, molto attrezzata per qualsiasi cosa si voglia cucinare. Il bagno é dotato di una doccia spaziosa.
Alles bestens

Die Unterkunft ist gut mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen und liegt in einer sehr schönen Gegend direkt beim Schloss Charlottenburg. Das Zimmer ist wie beschrieben klein, aber für einen kurzen Aufenthalt ausreichend.
Leider wurde unser Zimmer vor unserem Check-in nicht aufgeräumt.
Die Kommunikation mit Frank war schnell und es wurde eine Lösung gefunden.

Great apartment. Very quiet even though it's in the heart of a fantastic lively area! Wonderful place to stay, outfitted with everything you need. Communication was easy and key hand-off also no problem at all.
Comfortable and spacious apartment, nice and quiet in the area with local conveniences and decent transport links
Very friendly staff. Great location. There’s a small supermarket just downstairs and the train station a short walk away.

Amazing place, vary spacious, with excellent decoration. It is great for groups of friends or couples and it is located in a very quiet neighbour some kilometres outside the city centre and very near to the very lively area of Mitte. It is a little bit pricey but it is highly recommended.

Die Lage der Wohnung ist ziemlich gut und sehr nah von KaDeWe, dem größten Einkaufsviertel in Deutschland.
Ferry ist sehr hilfsbereit und freundlich und der Angestellte auf der Hotline bietet uns immer rechtzeitige Hilfe, was uns sehr freut.
Cute room with a minimalist style. Calm. Very good emplacement, I recommend.
Sehr netter Gastgeber , und sehr saubere Unterkunft 😊
Lovely appartment which offers an intriguing take on the use of space through its architecture - highly recommend it!

We were so happy to stay here. Tom went out of his way to make us feel at home. He was such a helpful and friendly host. The apartment is charming. The beds are comfortable. We will stay here again if we are ever in the area.

My friends and I enjoyed our stay in apartment. It was big enough for five people. The apartment was also clean and well equipped. I didn't meet Alex in person, but communication with him was very good. Flexible departure time and close location to the S-Bahn station were very useful for our onward journey.

Aaron’s artsy flat was wonderfully creative, comfortable, and friendly. It invited us to enjoy our space and feel at home in the neighborhood. We enjoyed walking to the canal and feeding the swans as much as getting mango cheesecake for breakfast at the cafe or pizza for dinner down the street. We got scooters and cruised all over the nearby neighborhoods. It was delightful and fun to explore Berlin from such a nice space. Aaron was infinitely helpful with all questions and issues. When I return to Berlin I will be touching base with Aaron, and hopefully staying in the same flat!

Mijn man en ik hadden een heel fijn verblijf bij Arne. Zijn appartement is stijlvol, netjes en gezellig en bevindt zich in een rustige straat in een bruisende wijk, met veel winkels, galeries, restaurants en uitgaansgelegenheden. Een ideale locatie om vandaaruit Berlijn te verkennen. Arne is de perfecte gastheer, relaxed, attent en sympathiek. We voelden ons meteen welkom. Onze kamer was prettig, schoon, en stijlvol ingericht, voorzien van handdoeken en zelfs van een fles mineraalwater en chocola, heel attent. De communicatie vooraf en tijdens ons verblijf verliep uitstekend. Wij komen graag terug!

Super Unterkunft!
Sehr netter, hilfsbereiter Vermieter.
Der Aufenthalt hat uns gut gefallen.
Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Excelente apartamento
Hat alles bestens geklappt 👍
Wie immer 🔝 und der Timothy ist wie immer mega freundlich und nett, schade dass ich mein Urlaub abkürzen musste aber komme immer wieder gerne! Bis bald!

Stephanie ist eine sehr liebenswürdige und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin.
Die Unterkunft liegt herrlich ruhig. Und doch kommt man mit der Schnellbusverbindung gut nach Berlin Zoologischer Garten.
Für mich war es perfekt!
Really nice experience！

A very pretty, quiet (with all the windows closed) and functional flat in a busy area of Berlin. Very close to the Underground so easy to get around.  Check in and out was easy.  Bed very comfortable.  Everything supplied in a tastefully decorated studio apartment.  Bathroom is lovely and lots of hot water.  Internet very patchy.  I spent a week there and was very comfortable.

Klein, tof 2 slaapkamer appartement. Alle voorzieningen zijn prima aanwezig en korte wandelafstand tot metro.
Op max 500 meter afstand zijn zowel Lidl als Aldi voor de nodige boodschappen voor ontbijt met dagelijks verse broodjes.
Enige ongemak was confrontatie met staking in openbaar vervoer wat ons een extra 150€ kostte aan Uber en verloren geld voor abonnement U bane. Natuurlijk is dat niet fout van host😀.
Voor een probleemloos bezoek zeker aan te bevelen.
Benjamin is prima host en ik hoop dat hij ons ook als prima gasten ziet.

Carola was very welcoming when we first arrived, everything was clean and looked just like the photos. The only downside for us is we thought wifi was free, and it wasn't, there wasn't a lot of airflow in the room and it's about a 25 min cab ride into the heart of downtown. But overall it was worth the price
Baustelle sehr direkt nebenan extrem laut und fängt früh morgens an, sonst insgesamt angenehm und sehr schöne Wohnung

Vi var veldig fornøyde med å bo i denne fantastiske rosa leiligheten. Vi var tre venninner på tur med to babyer, og det passet perfekt å bo her.
Eneste som kunne vært bedre, er tilgang på større feiebrett og kanskje en mopp til å vaske lett over gulv med, da vi bodde der fire netter.
war tiptop für einen Citytrip

Spacious and light apartment near Alexanderplatz, so really good situated.
Lots of restaurants in the neighbourhood.
Kitchen is not well suited for cooking and really dark.
There is no dishwasher.
Beds are unsuited for 1.90+ height. Almost no curtains in bedrooms.
Apartment has sleeping options for 9, but that will not be comfortable situation.
Some overdue maintenance.
But we (4 adults) had a great time. The house is a nice hub to return to after a day in Berlin.

We enjoyed staying in Claudia's nice apartment this winter. The street is lovely and quiet, we had no issues with noise. Claudia has been very quick to reply and always friendly. Recommended if you are looking for a more quiet place to stay outside of the city center, but still want to visit the city center regularly.

Communication was always prompt and the check-in procedure smooth. The room was very clean and the toiletries were stocked up. They even provided some complimentary snacks and ample amount of drinks. To top it off the room had a nice view and the location wasn't too far from the central station. Highly recommended.
bom hostel, limpo e sossegado

Die Unterkunft liegt in einer sehr ruhigen Gegend, gleichzeitig ist sie durch die nahe S-Bahn Station Messe Süd (zu Fuss in 7 Minuten erreichbar) ein hervorragender Ausgangspunkt, um Berlin zu erkunden. Die Wohnung bietet alles war Mann/Frau/Hund braucht, um sich wohlzufühlen und bei Fragen hat Michael schnell geholfen. Danke für die schönen 3 Tage und wir komme gerne wieder
Moni & Niko & Zuli (unser Mini-Aussie)
Urige Unterkunft..

We hebben een geweldig verblijf gehad bij Robert, onze persoonlijke gids vanaf het dakterras. Robert was erg gastvrij, we voelden ons welkom. De kamer was prachtig en van alles voorzien. De fietsverhuur zat aan het einde van de straat, want je ziet pas echt wat van de stad op de fiets!
Unkomplizierte und nette Übergabe der Wohnung, sehr zentral gelegen und trotzdem relativ ruhige Gegend. Wir würden die Unterkunft wieder mieten.

Un de nos meilleurs séjours Airbnb: logement authentique et agréable avec une très bonne localisation (rue calme à quelques mètres d’un parc, proximité des transports en commun, nombreux commerces et restaurants à distance de marche).
Boris était un hôte très disponible et attentif au bon déroulement de notre séjour. Ses conseils et recommandations nous ont été très utiles.
Nous y reviendrons avec beaucoup de plaisir si l’occasion se présente.
Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit, die Wohnung ist wirklich sehr schön und gemütlich! :)

Great location, really easy check in and very clean and comfortable.
Coffee shop over the road does the best coffee I’ve had in ages.
Well equipped and easy for convenience stores. Have already recommended and would stay again. Thanks Maik 😊
Tolle Lage, schnelle Kommunikation, der Wasserkocher war defekt und wurde super  schnell ausgetauscht. Ich bin immer wieder gerne vor Ort und komme sicherlich wieder.
Man muss bedenken nur ein Zimmer in einer Wohnung mit mehreren Personen zu haben

Zeer leuke kamer in een prachtige bruisend stukje berlijn. Keuken en badkamer waren zeer netjes en naar behoren te gebruiken. Host woont zelf ook in het appartement, maar we hebben hem tijdens ons 4 daagse verblijf niet gezien. Als je het trappenhuis binnenkomt ruikt het naar harira (Marokkaanse linzensoep). Een warm welkom dus als je daarvan houdt. Verder ligt het appartement op een uitstekend centrale locatie om de stad te ontdekken. Op loopafstand al veel leuke winkeltjes en restaurantjes. Kortom een hele leuke airbnb voor een zeer betaalbare prijs.
Mimi’s place is really great! Had a relaxing stay and communication prior and during the stay was excellent from Mimi! Apartment feels brand new and really spacious… highly recommend!
Petit appartement très bien centre à 7min à pied de Potsdamer Platz. Martin est très sympathique et à disposition pour chaque question que nous avions. On recommande !

From the moment we stepped in the door, Konrad made us feel right at home. The view from the room was great and everything matched the pictures. Would definitely stay here again if in the Berlin area!
Perfekte Unterkunft für eine Reise nach Berlin.
Nice appartment and good location. Gerit was just like a host should be; friendly and helpful, without being intrusive at the same time.

Nancy’s place is WONDERFUL!
It’s a gorgeous apartment, set over two floors and is so spacious and beautifully finished. The place really feels huge.
We were a family of 5, three generations, and we had plenty of space.
The kitchen has everything you need, the lounge is huge and comfy, the beds and bedding are great and the bathrooms and high spec.
The area is so peaceful and green, it has a lovely feel to it. It is not in the centre of Berlin but the transport links are very good and you can easily travel in every day.
Nancy also left a bike for me to use to cycle to the station which I really appreciated.
Nancy was also very communicative and gave responses very quickly to my questions.
For children the area is perfect, with brilliant playgrounds so close to the house and a fab tree house in the garden, which my daughter loved. The forest, minutes walk from the apartment, is beautiful.
I would highly highly recommend Nancy’s apartment and would not hesitate in going back
The place is very cozy and location is awesome! Def recommend it

We had spent an amazing time at Karsten’s during our stay in Berlin. Being in his apartment made our stay such an incredible experience!!!
The apartment is so well located. In less than 1 minute you can be at the metro station and from here you can arrive easily to every part of the city (you can also walk if you want to).His place is also very well equipped! You have everything you need! He provides you all the stuff for cooking or eating in the apartment. Everything works perfect! Really good shower (water pressure and temperature) also comfortable bed.
We would definitely come back here whenever we come back to Berlin :) Karsten is so kind and helpful, always responding fast and helping with all our queries. We recommend him to all Airbnb community Thanks a lot!!!!
Es war alles super sauber und wie angegeben. Schön war, dass Kleinigkeiten im Kühlschrank waren.
