Le dépôt de bagage est très pratique Et dans un café qui vaut le détour! Enfin nous tenons à remercier Caroline pr son accueil et sa réactivité en communication.
William is a great host, and super responsive! I enjoyed a lot staying in the flat :)

Wer ein in einer besonderen Location in Berlin verweilen mag, ist genau richtig hier!
Vielen lieben Dank!

Hemos estado muy cómodos en el departamento de Ivos. Fue muy amable, siempre respondió y flexible con los horarios. Está muy bien ubicado! Llegas a todos los sitios súper fácil. Y es tal cual las fotos. Si tenemos la suerte de volver a Berlín, sin duda nos alojaríamos allí! Gracias

Alisa and Dan's place is amazing, so clean and tidy, very nice feel to the flat and exactly as described. In fact, the instructions on how to find the flat were super helpful, made our travel from the airport a breeze. A&D were so lovely, very friendly and helpful. The weather was so hot, we mentioned that we were warm in our room and A&D gave us a fan which was a huge relief. The room is small but that's very clear on the listing so we knew what to expect  and to be honest, we didn't need any more space. The facilities were great,  it felt like we were staying in a luxury hotel.  I would highly recommend staying here and would very happily return in the future.
Centraal gelegen (t.o. Ubahn). Goed hotel, want zo ervaar je deze ruimte. Groot en fijn bed, mooi ingericht, lekkere douche. Welkomstdrankjes en de mogelijkheid om beneden te ontbijten.

Wir wurden sehr freundlich von David empfangen, der uns auch mit Tips zu Nahverkehr und Sehenswürdigkeiten versorgt hat.
Immer wieder gerne!

Departamento cómodo y espacioso, con todo lo necesario para una estadía placentera. La ubicación es muy practica y se puede acceder al trasporte publico de manera sencilla.  El entorno cuenta con tiendas, supermercados, farmacias, bares y restaurantes. Definitivamente volvería.

De woning is centraal gelegen waardoor de bezienswaardigheden van Berlijn makkelijk te bereiken zijn. De U Seestrasse is erg dichtbij met een supermarkt ernaast. De kamer is erg mooi, schoon en ruim. De waterkoker is een hele fijne toevoeging. Tip: ga ook eten in het Italiaans restaurant aan de voorzijde van het gebouw. Florent is een fantastische kok en zijn broer een super host.
Vanaf het begin voelden wij ons zeer gewaardeerd en thuis. We komen erg graag terug. Jan en Wendy Zaanstad.
Amazing place

La estancia en casa de Carmen fue muy agradable. La comunicación con ella ha sido muy fácil y fluida. El apartamento está muy limpio y cuenta con lo necesario pasa pasar unos días estupendos en Berlin. El apartamento se encuentra en una zona muy tranquila y a 10 minutos de la estación Ostkreuz Berlin, que  permite una buena comunicación con el resto de la ciudad.
Very nice host and great place.
Great little studio flat in a fabulous building. Well located and comfortable stay. Perfect for the three nights we spent in Berlin. Definitely recommend!
Es war sehr schön bei Katrin und Andreas. Sie sind sehr zugewandte. So konnte Wohligkeit aufkommen.
Wat een leuke plek! Fijne buurt, rustig, eettentjes in de straat (heerlijke sushi!!) bakker aan de overkant. Ruim appartement met alles wat we nodig hadden als gexin.
Super Hôte, je le recommande milles froid. Il a été à la hauteur de nos expériencez2s...

Die Unterkunft ist perfekt für einen Berlin Trip mit einer größeren Gruppe geeignet. Der Check-In hat problemlos funktioniert, und zwei Tramhaltestellen sind zu Fuß schnell zu erreichen. Die Wohnung selbst war sehr sauber, und die Ausstattung genauso gut wie angegeben. Die Gastgeber antworten sehr schnell bei Rückfragen.
Insgesamt hatten wir einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt und würden diese AirBnB auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen.

Appartement très agréable, spacieux, bien équipé et bien insonorisé.
Emplacement idéal dans l'hyper-centre de Berlin.
Gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis, sehr zentral und sauber war es auch. Hatten nichts dran auszusetzen

Jana and Paul are so helpful as hosts- both in suggesting pools and lakes when we came in a heat wave and in our check in. The place is so cozy and filled with character. Would recommend to anyone visiting Berlin- the neighborhood can’t be beat!
Everything was tidy and clean and Bárbara was really kind. The metro was close by so it was easy to travel.
Très bon séjour, belle appartement à proximité des transports !
El uso de las lavadoras de ropa es un poco complicado y no servia la única secadora.
Great location. Apartment is immaculate with everything you could possibly need. Highly recommended.

The flat is spacious and I understand it is of a very simple style. However, I would suggest three things and I am very willing to pay much more if the flat is equipped with:
1. a non-transparent curtain. People from the opposite buildings with a very short distance can easily see everything in the flat especially at night. If you value privacy, you might feel a little uncomfatable.
2. a hair drier. If you are staying for several days,
I think it is better to offer the very essential thing for ladies.
3. more chairs or a sofa. At the dinner table, only one chair is not enough to have breakfast or dinner. When we are very tired, it would be better if we can have a cozy sofa to sit in. It wont take much space as the room is so spacious.

Cons: The condition of the apartment is only so-so, the floor is in bad need of rennovation, the furniture is cheap (squeaky bed), it's hard to keep the bathroom from flooding, and it's more cluttered than the professional photos would make you think. Located in a silent residential area but walking distance to public transport, restaurants and supermarket. We highly recommend this place!

Ich war nur kurz auf der Durchreise da und habe auch Garrelt nur kurz getroffen aber mir hat die Unterkunft sehr gefallen und ich habe Garrelt als einen sehr sympathischen, hilfsbereiten, zuverlässigen Gastgeber kennengelernt, der viel über Berlin weiß und viele Tipps parat hat. Ich selber habe sehr lange in Berlin gelebt und kann auch die Lage sehr empfehlen. Die Wohnung ist in einer sehr ruhigen, begrünten Straße, wo man gut zur Ruhe kommen kann. Vom nächsten Bahnhof Südkreuz kommt man schnell in andere Ecken. Vielen Dank, Garrelt!
Schöne Wohnung mit Blick auf die Spree und schönem Außenbereich.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön. Sieht genauso aus, wie auf dem Bildern und ist auch sehr sauber. Leider war das digitale Türschloss kaputt. So dass ich am ersten Tag nicht mein airbnb abschließen konnte. Alessa hat sich am nächsten Tag erst darum gekümmert. Das scheint aber eine Ausnahme zu sein. Trotzdem hätte ich mir hier eine bessere Kommunikation gewünscht.

My girlfriend and I went to Berlin for four days and could not be happier with our choice of apartment, the location was perfect for us as we do like to shop aswell as see the sights and there is a greet shopping district right on your doorstep. The apartment was great and the sauna is a welcome sight after a cold day sightseeing. Would definitely recommend this apartment only criticism I would have that it is a little difficult to find at night, apart from that I loved it and will be back

This apartment is in a great location, walking distance to all major tourist sites, and also many good eateries nearby. We were there during summer and needed windows open. While there are amazing views it is also very noisy with trains running beneath constantly making sleeping difficult. It is a bit older than the photos look but overall a pretty good place to stay for 4 of us visiting for a few days.

This is a great place to stay, with Oz as an amazing host. It is clean, well-maintained, and incredibly convenient. The neighborhood is a bit sterile -- it is new and there's some construction noise around as the whole district seems to be re-building -- so it is not "old Berlin"; but a short walk or bus or tram or U-bahn will take you wherever you want to go, easily and conveniently.
The apartment itself is marvelous and if you want a quiet residential place to rest after a day out, it is really wonderful. Can't recommend more highly.
lovely room but ugly area around

We stayed for 3 days in BenSimon's apartment and really enjoyed. The apartment located in 4 floors building with some other apartments of this host.
There is one big kitchen and one sleeping room equipped with TV. Everything is in a good condition, very clean and stylish.
The location is perfect, in 25 minutes one can reach Alexanderplatz. The metro is also in 5-10 minutes away.
Also the safe parking in Kulturbrauerei Center costed 12 euro per day, that was very convenient.
We enjoyed our stay there and would like to come again.
Thank you BenSimon's 😊
Really good place.

Bonjour,
Nous étions deux personnes et avons passé 4 nuits dans l'appartement.
Le logement est vraiment très bien. Il est propre et très fonctionnel. Il possède tous ce qu'il faut notamment pour faire la cuisse.
Le logement n'est pas en centre-ville mais il est très bien desservi par les transports en commun, donc ce n'est vraiment pas un problème.
Jocelyne à toujours répondu très rapidement lors de nos échanges, en plus elle a pris soin de laisser des petits guides touristiques pour notre arriver.
Je recommande ce logement nous n'avons pas été déçus.
Amazing location and amazing host. Would def love to visit again!

Great location, close enough to the multiple tours and exhibitions I went to. This is my fourth trip to Berlin in recent years, third time partipating in a running event and my most enjoyable Berlin city stay so far. Great U-Bahn and bus links to all parts of the city, but importantly quiet enough for a great sleep every night. Washing facilities easy to use once you download the appropriate app.
Perfect for travelers on a short trip that need convenience. This place has everything you need with a comfortable accommodation and great vibes. Very close to big underground station. I recommend!

Очень удобное расположение в приятном районе полном кафе и магазинов. Легко добраться до центра на электричке, удобно гулять до достопримечательностей пешком. В квартире есть всё необходимое для проживания вдвоём: кухня с посудой и холодильником и плитой, чистая ванная и туалет, приятное освещение, довольно уютно.
Max’s apartment is very cosy and in a nice neighborhood close to subway stations and shops. Communication was not always easy but we had a nice stay :)

The room was clean, quiet, and spacious, if bare. The neighborhood is central and well connected. Knocking two stars off the review though, because when you book a double bedroom you expect a double bed, while we got two single beds pushed next to each other and slept uncomfortably.
They left a bottle of water, a single packet of crackers and a single chocolate bar by the beds, with a hefty price label sticker on it.
This is a hotel, and hotels in general should not be allowed on AirBnB. For the money they charged we could have slept anywhere in Berlin - and anywhere with a double bed and a slightly more human touch than "use our website to check yourself into your building, floor and room", or a ridiculous price tag on a small chocolate bar, would have been a much better experience.
Clean and new building, very clean studio fully equipped. 1 min to the train Stalin which was very convenient.

We loved our stay at this apartment. Everything you might ever need was there and the location was just fabulous with so many choices of restaurants and cafes right at the front door. Would totally recommend
Great place!

Perfect place for a medium group or family on a city trip.
Modern, clean, spacious and warm ground floor apartment in a quiet neighbourhood. A short busride away from Berlin action.
Closest must-do is the Vibali spa, which is a walk through the park from there.

un caldo e accogliente appartamento in stile industriale, dotato di tutti i comfort.
Pulizia degli ambienti, comodità e ampiezza della stanza sono stati i punti di forza.
Very good price for what you get. Close bus stations to get anywhere and a lot of bars and restaurants nearby.
Schnelle Antworten, sehr freundliche Gastgeber. Unterkunft war top und sehr zentral gelegen. Gerne wieder 😊👍🏼
Really nice place to stay, it’s comfortable and clean. It has everything you need
Alles war super sauber . Das Appartement ist ein reines Airbnb -Appartement.
Standard service
Rainer was very communicative and friendly. The apartment was a perfect, restful stay.

We stayed in this apartment for four nights during our stay in Berlin, and we enjoyed it very much! The location was a bit outside the main districts, but close to a supermarket and restaurants and a bike ride away from tourist attractions. The apartment was clean, modern, yet located in a older charming building, and had great special details such as a roof top balcony.
The apartment was on the top level, but the stairs did not bother us at least. Check in was easy and communication worked well with co-host Angelica.
We were four people but there was plenty of space for all of us, and the sofa turned into a nice-sized bed for two. This stylish apartment fulfilled all of our expectations and we enjoyed our stay very much! We would definately recommend this apartment for others.
War ein toller Urlaub. Gastgeber und Unterkunft toll. Straßenbahn kein fünf Minuten entfernt. Von Haus direkt in den See. Herrlich! Wenn Berlinbesuch hier erste Wahl.

This room is perfect for a city trip with friends. It is close to the center, while the neigbourhoud is very quiet. Martin is super friendly and will help you gladly if you ask him something. I would definitely recommend this place.
Dieses Apartment ist leider im ersten Stock über einem Restaurant zur Straße gerichtet, daher bei offenem Fenster laut
Empfehlenswert!
Totally recommendable!
Comfortable hotel for short stays

This is an amazing place, even better if you have kids with you. Well designed bunker bed would give every child a thrill. The apartment has everything you need, even conditioner for hair.  The beer and bottles of water in the fridge is a heart warming gesture from the host. I highly recommend this place!

Holger and Betinnas appartment was just perfect for our vacation in the big city of Berlin. It was in the heart of Friedrichshain with a lot of great vintage shops and delicious places to eat and a few stops from the East Side Gallery as well.

Nice big and very clean flat. Actually directly as in the pictures and even bigger than expected.
Equipped with all the essentials for a short or long stay.
Quick and easy communication in English from the beginning. Easy check in through key box and own entrance. Flat quiet and safe despite being on ground floor due to quiet side street and electronic blinds in front. I felt very comfortable.
The bedroom faces the backyard and is therefore very quiet.
I was asked in between if everything was ok and in the end Suites & More approached me and asked if I would like to check out later as the next day is not yet rented out. This was very convenient for me and I was able to check out at 14:30 without any problems.
Thank you very much.
Good experience
Die Kommunikation war immer top! Das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis ist unschlagbar. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Es war alles da, was wir brauchten. Liebevoll eingerichtet.
alles wie beschrieben, wir würden jederzeit wieder diese Unterkunft buchen ! Top!
A stylish space with a nice roof deck, and lots of light through the spacious apartment.
Great location and Martin was totally available whenever we needed him. Especially good because we arrived very late.
Gute Lage, tolles Zimmer. Alles sehr sauber und freundliche Nachbarn. Interessante Müllentsorgung und Alles gut erreichbar. Sdhr empfehlenswert. Gerne wieder.
Great location, nice apartment

The place was perfect for us (family of 5). The neighborhood is awesome. Great restaurants and close to public transit. We didn’t mind the basement apartment because we were so jet lagged that we slept late and it made for a nice and dark apartment. The host was generous with checkout time and also with coffee pods. Lovely apartment in a very charming neighborhood.
Great location, easy and flexible check-in and a very comfortable bed. Highly recommend staying here if you're visitng Berlin.
What a brilliant place and what a brilliant host! Thank you Birgit :)

Wir (2 Erwachsene und 1 Kind) wurden sehr freundlich empfangen, sogar vor unserer angegebenen Ankunftszeit. Die Wohnung liegt wie beschrieben in Bus- und U-Bahnnähe. Ausflugsziele sind somit super zu erreichen. In der Wohnung ist alles vorhanden, was man zum Wohlfühlen benötigt. Die Gastgeber sind bei Fragen und Sorgen vor Ort und haben gute Lösungen parat.
Rundum waren wir sehr zufrieden und kommen gerne wieder!!!

Everything with HP and the flat was perfect! He was so welcoming and proactive - gave me some local recommendations, explained to me how everything was working in the flat, was super proactive if i had any questions during my stay. He was super nice as a host and as a human being!
The flat itself was also perfect. Extremely clean, the room is huge with big windows, the kitchen is perfectly furnished and HP made sure i had everything i needed for my stay in Berlin (maps, guides, magazines for local events, slippers). Even if the flat is in a busy area, the room in itself has windows towards the inner garden. You don't hear the outside noise and it's super calm.
The flat is in a perfect location, i could walk to alot of the places I visited during my stay.
Thank you HP :)
Roberts Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet und durch die Raumaufteilung bekommt man sich so gut wie gar nicht mit. Uns hats gut gefallen!

Its an cosy great place to stay, near by city in the great area Kreuzberg
Many little shops and restaurants in the neighberhood.
Sophie is a good host and easy to communicate to!
Amazing place. It’s clear that Hanne has spent a lot of energy and effort to design and selecting the right furniture and accessories. I wish my home look like that.
Easy check in process and overall a clean room available.
It was really nice experience to talk with people coming from around the world and have a nice stay in Berlin
Die Lage der Wohnung ist ideal, Strassenbahnverbindung super. Im Hinterhaus lebt man in aller Ruhe. Der Tilman ist freundlich und hilfsbereit. Können wir jedezeit empfehlen.
Great stay and host

Kristina was a great host!
Very responsive and quick to anything we were worried about and she added little touches to the place and it felt very cosy and homey!
Certainly a place to consider staying :)
Very easy access to the public transports and an Aldi just around the corner. The beds were comfortable and the apartment was pristine.

Ich war sehr zufrieden mit der wohnung, man hat sich sehr wohlt gefühlt. Die kommunikation war auch sehr gut ! anfangs war es bisschen kalt in der wohnung aber das hat man auch schnell geklärt wieder ! :)
Da die Wohnung antike gestaltet ist, hat man sehr gute positive Energien empfunden. Vielen dank :)

Sohails place was really nice, all was very clean, U-Bahn as well as kebabs and supermarkets are just around the corner.
Hadn’t really had the chance to meet Sohail, as he was out of town during most of my stay, he did check in on me, if everything is alright though and the short time we did meet he also was very friendly.

I'd give it three stars primarily for the location and Rainer's responsiveness. However, the apartment's maintenance left much to be desired. The bathroom, kitchen, and bedroom seemed like they hadn't been cleaned thoroughly, so we had to do some quick cleaning ourselves. We did bring this up with Rainer, and he promptly refunded the cleaning fee. Additionally, we faced issues with plugs falling out when turning on lights, which caused a few minor blackouts.
Hopefully, the apartment receives the necessary maintenance for future guests.
Everything was great thanks
Great location and very nice apartments! Thomas is friendly and helpful as well
a lovely apartment perfect for a short stay! amazing and very responsive host too. thanks for having us!
Had a great time staying at Paulines place! It was the ideal location I was looking for and Pauline was very friendly! 😊
Amazing stay and really nice host. I highly recommend

It was a brilliant stay. Vanni was also easy to reach and the communication was so reliable. He is so easy going and and he has a great taste in furniture. The apartment was in the best area near all the little restaurants which were only about a 15 mins walk away. The tram is right outside the door to get to Alexander Platz etc...
The apartment itself made you feel like you wanted to be creative and write a book. It had an atmosphere of adventure. I was there with my family and there was so much space to spread ourselves out. We had free coffee and tea which is perfect before you get the chance to go to the supermarket. There was a bakery just around the corner. Vanni gave us good tips where all the supermarkets were and even prepared a map with the most important things around the area.
We got a parking space outside the door where we could unload the bags easily and then Vanni gave us a tip where we could park the car for free throughout our stay. We left the car there and did the rest by foot, tram and bus which is the best way to see Berlin.
I am planning to stay there again and was very sad to leave. We were there for 3 nights and even in the Corona time. Vanni disinfected everything and made me feel safer there than a hotel. Also there was disinfection there for your hands. I highly recommend Vanni place because you get a high class at a reasonable price and an all round Berlin experience.
Ursula's apartment was the perfect place to stay in Berlin! Comfortable, clean, stylish and excellent location. It could not have been better. Ursula was very friendly and helpful.

We liked the place as it exhumed an air of being lived in. That makes it distinct from many places in Airbnb nowadays. Also close to public transport and plenty of grocery stores and restaurants around.
What we truly appreciated the most is that Daniel let us in a few hours earlier than the official check in which saved us a lot of trouble.
Definitely recommended.

Très bel appartement, très bien équipé, très propre, très bien situé, très calme.
Nous avons passé un très beau séjour à Berlin.
Merci Stéphanie!
This apparment is a great place to stay while your in Berlin, it's roomy, clean and located perfectly.
Bülent ist ein sehr herzlicher Mensch. Wir haben uns super unterhalten. Die Unterkunft ist perfekt gelegen und war sehr sauber. Ich komme gern wieder.

Nice and cute apartment for 4 people. Very confortable and clean place. Perfect location (2 min. to the underground) and perfect reception. Shpresa and Ayse (the guests) were very kind with us, contacting us every time we needed. 100% recommendable.
Uns hat es seher gefallen bei Ihnen im hotel zu wohnen und werden öffters zu Ihnen kommen 🙂🙂😊😊
집이 조금 멀긴하지만 부담스러운 거리는 아니였어요. 집주인 부부가 너무 친절하고 사랑스러워서 묵는내내 행복했어요. 방에 화장실도 따로 있어서 편했고, 방도 정말 넓고 쾌적했어요. 행복한 집 이였어요

This was a great Airbnb for a solo traveler. I stayed here for nearly a week and found it perfect for my needs despite the compact size of the unit. It felt like a hotel room plus a small kitchen, and in a nice neighborhood surrounded by many cafes, bars, near transit, etc. Check in was very easy and Sebastian was quite proactive in the booking. I would stay here again, either solo, or with a partner.
Alles TOP!! Gastgeber,  Sauberkeit, Lage, zuvorkommend!

Ik ben dankbaar voor de vriendelijkheid van het personeel. Bij een probleem dachten ze met je mee en was alles binnen 1 minuut opgelost. Het was een mooie nette kamer, met een leuk uitzicht. Dichtbij de metro, dus je kan overal snel heen.

Caroline has a beautiful place! The pictures don’t do it justice with how big it is. Super close (as in, a 2min walk) to Friedrichstraße station, making it incredibly convenient to go to the airport, other areas in Berlin, etc.

Fiquei hospedado por 3 noites com minha esposa e filha. Gostamos muito do apartamento. Ótima localização, bem equipado e amplo. Kelly é uma ótima anfitriã, muito atenciosa. Recomendamos e ficaríamos no apartamento novamente.
Ich war sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft! alles war sauber und die Gastgeber äußerst höflich und nett. immer wieder gern.

Das helle, ruhige und geräumige Zimmer befindet sich in einer im 4. Stock gelegenen Wohnung eines Gebäudes im Jugendstil. Günter ist ein sehr freundlicher Gastgeber; ich habe mich bei ihm wohl gefühlt.
Gerne wieder !!!
This is an fantastic experience. I loved the place, something unique in Berlin. Great to take a boat to the house boat 🤩 Everything described was there and it has a huge chill out effect.

Wir haben es hier sehr genossen. Es war ein entspannter Aufenthalt mit schneller und liebevoller Kommunikation! Besonders der Balkon hat es uns angetan aber auch das moderne Badezimmer. Wifi klappte ohne Probleme. Das Hochbett knarzt und quietscht ein bisschen doll wenn die, die oben schlafen sich bewegen, das ist aber auch der einzige kleine Kritikpunkt!
Lage ist super, der mega leckere Kaffee vom Café 1 Minute zu Fuß hat uns als Liebhaber guten Kaffees morgens gerettet und wir haben einen schönen Abend in der Hotelbar am Wasser (5 min zu Fuß) verbracht.
Wir empfehlen euch herzlich gerne weiter!

Jens was very thoughtful and kind since the beginning. The house was just as announced, super spacious and very well located. The kitchen had everything and more. Would definitely book it again!

My first time ever doing an air bnb the whole vibe was perfect me and my wife loved the view and the space itself everything is close by train station right outside so very easy access to everything I would definitely book these apartments again overall an amazing experience

Had a great time! Perfect location with different public transit options only seconds away from

Hans war per Chat gut erreichbar, leider konnte ich das WLAN trotzdem nicht aktivieren, was das arbeiten vor Ort erschwert hat.

Super Lage, Alex antwortet immer sehr schnell auf Rückfragen. Unkomplizierter Check- in/out.

Unterkunft war sauber, entsprach unseren Erwartungen, Kontakt sehr nett.
War ein schönes Wochenende in Berlin!
Die Unterkunft ist in echt noch deutlich schöner als auf den Fotos! Die beiden Gastgeberinnen waren super nett und zuvorkommend. Die Lage ist etwas ab vom Schuss aber super idyllisch.

Absolutely loved my stay at this Airbnb! The host Al was incredibly welcoming and went above and beyond to ensure my comfort.
The apartment was stylish, impeccably clean, and had all the amenities we needed. The location was perfect, with easy access to local attractions and public transportation.
I especially enjoyed the stunning view from the balcony. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area
– can't wait to come back!
Great place, great location, well furnished, very spacious, great host, available for anything!

Perfect Airbnb apartment. Nice location on quiet street in a lively neighborhood in Prenzlauerberg. Close to public transport, and even better a good bike rental nearby . Apartment is very clean and good equipped. Enough space for two and a nice private terrace. Very friendly and quick contact with host. All in all a wonderful place to explore Berlin!
great location, very easy check in, very cool place to stay, Till is very nice,helpful person!

Tolle Wohnung, tolle Lage,
Gute Zeit!

Ben een weekje bij Karola verbleven om in de voormiddag te telewerken en in de namiddag/avond naar Wereldspelen Special Olympics te gaan.  Telewerken ging perfect,  perfecte wifi en er werd zelfs voor een extra beeldscherm gezorgd. Zeer rustige kamer, in het midden van de stad maar geen probleem om met open raam te slapen.  Niet direct een U- of S-bahn vlakbij, maar prima uitvalsbasis om Berlijn met de fiets te verkennen.  En Karola en Heiner zijn super toffe en behulpzame mensen, altijd een fijn contact met hen!!!
Amazing space. Would love to stay again next time in Berlin
Eine Oase der Ruhe und trotzdem nicht zu weit von Allem entfernt, Müggelsee und Restaurants direkt in der Nähe, sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtetes Häuschen, Urlaub und Erholung in der Großstadt pur...

Der Aufenthalt bei Cornelius war durchweg entspannt und perfekt organisiert. Es gibt einen Self Checkin, der einfacher nicht sein könnte, die Wohnung ist gemütlich und stilvoll eingerichtet und war perfekt vorbereitet.
Man merkt, dass Cornelius das nicht zum ersten Mal macht. Er antwortet auch bei Nachfragen sehr schnell und bietet gern zusätzliche Leistungen an. Insgesamt also absolut nichts auszusetzen.

Had a lovely stay at Max’s place - lovely neighbourhood, a spacious and well curated and designed apartment. The check in was easy, and the apartment had all the necessities for the stay. Would love to stay again!
Un lugar agradable, minimalista y moderno, con todas las amenidades necesarias para poder tener una estancia tranquila y muy cómoda
Great location, beautifully decorated room and Dietrich was very helpful and responsive. Amazing experience!

Nice, clean apartment with really comfy beds. We had a good stay. No issues at all!
Great place to stay in Berlin, everything was very clean and communication with the host was pleasant and precise. Location is great. I would definitely recommend it to everyone!
Alles wie beschrieben, sauber. Ruhige Umgebung.einziges Manko: eine Toilette im Bad integriert für 4 Doppelzimmer ist einfach zu wenig.
Stella's accommodation is just perfect to enjoy Berlin : clean, extremely well located, good and easy communication. I highly recommend it :)
Het appartement was erg fijn. Metro en bus zijn in de buurt, zodat je makkelijk Berlijn kan verkennen. Deze plek raad ik je zeker aan!

Super séjour chez Claudius et Barbara !
Quartier un peu bruyant lors du nouvel an et c'était super!
Klein 3 persoonsappartement. Voorzien van alle benodigdheden. Vlak bij de metro en binnen 10 min midden in het centrum.

Charlotte's apartment was absolutely wonderful. It was very thoughtfully furnished; for everything I needed during my stay, it seemed like I just needed to look into a few more drawers! :)
The location is pretty great, close to an S1 stop (Fridenau) - which goes through the city center- and a stop on the Ringbahn S41/42 (Innsbrucker Platz).

Would absolutely recommend this place, esp for a longer stay!
Nice appartment, spacious enough, nice area

We had an excellent stay at Dietrich's place. Instructions were clear, the studio was comfy, clean and conveniently located, and the host was kind and easy to reach. Looking forward to booking here again when going back to Berlin!!!

Amazing space, makes you feel comfy away from your home.

Even though the house is not in the center of Berlin, it is placed real near the sub-bahn and the u-bahn station and it has stores, supermarkets, coffeshops and restaurants near. Makes you experience a different kind of Berlin too.
Recommend it 100%!

Schöne, saubere Wohnung in praktischer Lage. Großes, helles Zimmer mit einem bequemen Bett. Herzliches Miteinander, hab mich wie in einer Familie aufgenommen gefühlt. Unkomplizierte, schnelle Kommunikation. Wenn ich mal wieder in Berlin bin, komme ich gerne wieder!
sehr zu empfehlen
Lucia’s place is a wonderful stay - charming and clean.  It is in a great Berlin neighborhood and she was a communicative and kind host.  Highly recommend!!
Das Zimmrt war sehr gemütlich und sauber. Die Kommunikation mit Sohail hat gut funktioniert. Kommen gerne wieder!
The house was nice and well spacious; the metro station is just in front of the door so is very easy to get on every part of the city.
Die Lage hat uns persönlich nicht überzeugt. An sich aber eine schöne Wohnung. Kommunikation war einfach.

Highly recommend - we loved our stay. Lovely apartment in peaceful location, and central for everything we wanted to do. Communication with Boian and Olga was excellent including great recommendations for local bars & restaurants.
Schöne kleine Unterkunft und sehr zentral gelegen!

We had a fantastic stay with Enrico! It was exactly as described. The apartment is located in a fantastic neighborhood, very close to restaurants, grocery stores, and multiple public transit options. Despite the very hot weather, the apartment stayed decently cool during the day. We had a small issue with the plumbing, and Enrico came by and fixed it the next day.
One small thing is the dishes were not entirely clean from the last occupants, and the shower lacked ventilation which caused the curtain to mold slightly after a week or so. Both of these were easily cleaned, but anyone intending to stay for more than a few days might want to be aware of the possibility.
Overall, I would definitely recommend this listing for one or two people looking to explore the city!
Eugen was friendly and flexible host. Everything went well.

We had an excellent stay at Sam’s apartment. Located in a great part of the city, we found our way around Berlin fairly easily with the near by transport links located near the apartment.
Sam’s communication with myself prior and during my stay was great, a truly welcoming host who took the time to inform us of all the details required to make our trip as seamless as possible.
A great property described accurately and filled all of our needs. I will for sure be looking out for Sam’s listing the next time I visit Berlin.

5 zasad jak Rosina mogłaby być lepszym gospodarzem:
1) O czystość w mieszkaniu mogłaby zadbać przed przyjazdem gości i zapewniłaby podstawy, takie jak komplet pościeli.
2) Zainstalowałaby zamek w drzwiach pokoju gości, aby móc w spokoju pozostawić swoje rzeczy, bez obawy o kradzież.
3) Udostępniłaby sprzęty i meble zdatne do normalnego użytkowania lub poinformowałaby gości o konieczności zapewnienia szczególnej ostrożności
4) Zapoznałaby się z różnicą między anulowaniem rezerwacji a częściowym zwrotem pieniędzy
5) Gdyby nie naciągała gości na pieniądze nie zapewniając podstawowego standardu.

We had a fantastic long weekend in Berlin and arriving home to this beautiful residential neighbourhood added an extra to our experience.
Everything as described by the listing and the other reviews.
The fireplace indeed is a great feature :)
Très propre et bien placé. Bonne adresse à garder.

The Berlin Surf Hostel was a great base for a few nights in Berlin. Easy to get into the centre on the local train or a short walk to the underground. The place was comfortable and clean. Volker was really helpful with his clear instructions on how to get there from the airport - it was very easy!
Ich war vollkommen zufrieden mit der Unterkunft! Einwandfreie Kommunikation, tolle Lage und eine sehr sympathische sowie angenehme Atmosphäre vor Ort. :) Ich komme gerne wieder.

Franziska was a fantastic host.  She had a lovely home and was very accommodating.  The area was nice as well, within walking distance of the Berlin mall memorial.  I would definitely stay here again.
A great place to stay if you are a bigger group. Clean, comfortable, nice host and close to public transportation.

Julien was an incredible host who went above and beyond my needs!! He was so well organized, prompt, thoughtful and easily accessible, that I’ve asked him about potentially renting a place from him in the future! Excellent location, next to metro. Charming block, really clean and neat apartment. Great wifi. No doubt recommend.

Perfect place for one or two people to explore Berlin from, small but cosy and well set out. Easy access to the U and S-Bahn for getting into Berlin or out to Brandenburg, including the airport. Tempelhof airfield round the corner was awesome for a bike ride or walk, and there’s lots of local shops, restaurants and bakeries too!

Everything was really flexible  and the apartment was stylish and in good location. It was really hot in Berlin, but the apartment was cool enough. And nice surprise was, that there was outdoor swimming pool at walking distance from the apartment.
Kjempeflott leilighet med god beliggenhet i et spennende område av Berlin

Très bien situé avec de très nombreux commerces et restaurants autour. Bien desservi par les transports.
La localisation au milieu d'une cour rend le logement extrêmement calme par rapport à la vie du quartier.
Super kind hostess, very nice apartment, two thumbs up!
Great communication with Josef, the place was fitting the description and pictures. The place is well situated and we enjoyed our short stay there.
Perfect for 4 people. Plenty of space and a 5 minute walk to the station that is 10 minutes from Berlin’s city centre
Eine top Loft-Wohnung mit ALLEM was das Herz begeht. Stephan hat alles top organisiert und ist ein hervorragender Host. Gerne jederzeit wieder. Vielen Dank!

Nice, very clean place. Got great pictures beforehand so finding it was easy, would have been impossible otherwise! Nice touches with lots of recommendations for different things. It was maybe a bit more "off" than we thought.
Sehr nette und zuvorkommende Gastgeber, gute Lage und eine saubere und gut ausgestattete Wohnung!
Nice place with direct connectivity to city center. local food easily accessible.great host always responsive. detailed, specific, and honest information shared.
Beautiful inside. Would come back!

We had a nice stay. The host was very responsive, which made everything easy. The location is great, accessible, with shops and transport nearby. The building is old, but that’s expected in the area and didn’t affect our experience. One thing to note is that the sofa bed wasn’t very comfortable, especially for longer stays and I have noticed that the other blanket smells not so good so we decided not to use it.
Overall, we’re thankful for the convenience of the place. Thank you again 🙏🏼

Het is een prima accommodatie om het centrum van Berlijn te kunnen bezoeken. Het huis heeft alles wat je nodig hebt. Het is fijn dat er al wat basis kookvoorzieningen zijn en shampoo en douchegel. Communicatie met de host was ook snel en prima.
Voor ons waren er 2 punten wat minder: de woning waarin je verblijft is erg gehorig, je hoort de bovenburen lopen en praten. Verder vonden wij de route die je loopt naar het metro station Botanische tuinen in de nacht niet zo prettig als 2 vrouwen alleen. Maar dit zijn subjectieve punten die voor ons minder waren maar voor een ander misschien helemaal niet erg zijn (wij zijn slechte slapers).

Great location just outside the station, it’s set back just a tiny bit so it’s nice and quiet but the Main Street and station is literally on your doorstep.
Good security, we felt very safe in this apartment and the place has a really nice, clean ( Probably one of the cleanest air bnbs we’ve ever stayed in. ) and minimalistic aesthetic.
I would absolutely recommend this apartment to anyone wanting to stay in Berlin and we’d 100% use the apartment again.
Frank was great, quick and clear communication, couldn’t fault our stay at all. Thanks!

Hi there! Don't hesitate, the flat is clean and well equipped. Ivo is happy to help and furnish any information you need. Access to city center is pretty easy and the area is quite enough for late sleepers. If you really want pure silence it won't work cause of a family with a running kiddo upstairs, but not sure you'll come to Berlin for that 😉
Alex is nice and very helpful. He provides you a lot of information to find the place. The flat is wonderful, cosy and confortable and well comunicated. Highly recommended.
Lots of charm, great location and very quiet!
Surprisingly easy check-in, good communication, helpful employees, neighborhood not so nice to walk around in at night in corona times.
Gut gelegen zum Ostkreuz oder Ostbahnhof, in einem quirligen Kiez, Wohnung in typischer Bauweise, etwas hellhörig, gut für 5 Personen

今まで世界中200軒以上のairbnbに泊まってきましたが、一番良かったかもしれません。ホストの方が丁寧で、何度もプレゼントをくださったり、嬉しかったです
お部屋も綺麗でした。ありがとうございました
Goede locatie voor een stedentrip Berlijn! Het appartement zelf was aan onderhoud toe en was vrij vies en stoffig

Eine schöne und empfehlenswerte kleine Wohnung in Kreuzberg.
Die Ausstattung ist sehr gut und umfangreich, die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern fix und einwandfrei, die Lage gut.
Einziger Negativpunkt während des Aufenthalts war die Hellhörigkeit des Hauses, was aber wohl auf temporäre Umbauarbeiten einerseits und andererseits im Falle von nächtlichem Trittschall in Teilen auch einfach nur persönliche Empfindlichkeit und Pech ist.

The apartment is nice, buwe left 3 stars mainly because there's no toilet paper, and neither plastic trush bag. And we are two, there are only one tower in the room. Then we contacted host by Airbnb message because we don't have German number to call the host, but we didn't get any response regarding our message. So we left 3 stars I think it's quite fair.

The appartment of Alan & Kaisa is located perfectly: near the S- and U-bahn which brings you in a couple of minutes anywhere you wanna go. There are a few supermarkets around the corner. The area, prenzlauer berg, is worth a visit. Lots of nice shops and restaurants. The appartment itself is big enough for a few days and has everything you need. The bed though isnt very comfortabel. The matras is very thin so you're lying on the buttom! Not ideal after a long day of walking. Also there was dust on the sealing and walls, we did vacuum ourselfs. So nice place but room for improvement!

The appartment ist very spacious and nice, good area and near to metro station. It is a quiet street and there are some interesting buildings around. The communication with the host was fluent and helpful. Totally recommended!
Amazing apartments with great design in heart of Berlin! Owner Karsten very kind and resposive person. We had perfect communication. Highly recommend!

Loistava sijainti lähellä julkista liikennettä sekä paljon baareja ja ravintoloita aivan kulman takana. Huone oli tilava sekä mukava, oma yksityinen sisäänkäynti oli loistava lisä. Ramona vastaanotti meidät saapuessamme ja oli todella ystävällinen isäntä koko majoittumisen ajan!

Excellent séjour dans cet appartement très bien situé. Le quartier est super pour des balades et manger à l’extérieur.
Le logement est pratique et le mobilier est de qualité.

Howy's apartment is a beautiful place. Very simple with just a bed and a couple of pieces of furniture but honestly you don't need much more. I had a great time there. Communication with howy was very easy. The apartment was clean. Also the location of the apartment cannot be better right at weinmeisterstraße in Berlin. Thanks for having me!
Sehr netter und unkomplizierter Gastgeber. Gute Infos und Tipps. Alles hat reibungslos geklappt!

Lovely studio! It looks quit new and well taken care of. Dietrich explained everything very well, the location was good and everything was clean and tidy. It was a little on the small side for 4 people, since 2 people sleep on the sleeping couch, but for a weekend it was fine. And other than that it was perfect!
really nice place! very clean and in a great location!
모든 것이 만족스러웠습니다. 호스트 분이 주위 상점, 식당 등 로컬 정보를 알려주셔서 큰 도움이 돠었습니다. 지하철 접근성도 좋은 편입니다.

Lieben Dank an STADT. LAND. BAD. für die Bereitstellung dieser tollen neuen Wohnung.
Die Anbindung zur City ist wunderbar und dass ein Supermarkt in der Nähe ist, war noch einmal die Krönung des Aufenthalts.
Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und kommen mit Sicherheit gerne wieder bzw. werden euch weiterempfehlen. Das Apartment war sehr sauber, top gepflegt und klasse ausgestattet.
Het was een fijn appartement. Mooi ingericht en dichtbij de tramhalte. Dichtbij een leuk plein en straat met leuke restaurants.

Nous avons apprécié cet appartement très central et calme, donnant sur une cour avec une jolie façade couverte de lierre. Il y a plusieurs restaurants dans les environs et une boulangerie française juste à côté qui propose un large choix de petits-déjeuners et de collations. Les transports publics sont proches (trams, bus métro et gare) et il est possible d’aller à pied à l’île aux musées, ce qui est bien pratique.

Thanks to Rebecca for meeting us at the house, we liked the area with all the Turkish restaurants and the supermarket on the corner was very convenient. The girls liked the local park/playground, we all thought the security shutters added a certain urban edge to the whole experience - very cool. The flat itself was super clean and fresh, we loved it. Next time we will come in the summer and go to Templehof.
Well-equipped Appartements right next to Hackescher Markt & Spree Riverfront. Instant communication with the hosts. Perfect stay for your city or business trip.
Todo excelente, volvería a elegirlo!

Wir waren für 2 Nächte bei Luisa. Es war alles sehr unkompliziert. Wir fanden einen Parkplatz direkt vor dem Haus und haben das Auto bis zur Abfahrt stehengelassen. Alles war zu Fuß gut zu erreichen. Wir haben in einem afrikanischen Restaurant sehr lecker gegessen. Das Zimmer war für unseren Aufenthalt ausreichend und gemütlich. Wegen der Jahreszeit konnten wir den Balkon als Kühlschrank nutzen. Es gibt einen Wasserkocher und ausreichend Geschirr um sich ein kleines Frühstück zu bereiten. Alles war sauber. Das Bad ist geräumig mit einer schönen Regendusche. Wir haben uns auch tagsüber im Zimmer sehr wohl gefühlt und konnten ungestört verweilen. Gerne kommen wir wieder. Weissensee hat uns als Stadtteil sehr gut gefallen.
Es gibt nicht viel zu sagen. Es war perfekt. Kommen in jedem Fall wieder.
Unterkunft entspricht den Fotos bzw. der Beschreibung und die Ansprechpartner waren schnell zu erreichen. Für den Preis sehr gut.

This place was AMAZING!! I’ve been staying in air bnbs for ages and this has definitely been my favorite. The location is amazing and we really felt safe there! Anytime we needed anything, it was taken care of. 10/10 time:)
Sehr toll gelegenes Apartment. Im Hinterhof sehr ruhig, eher dunkel, jedoch mit elektronischen Rollos. Super die guten Cafes direkt um die Ecke.

Mimi communicated with me really well and welcomed us at the apartment. She is very friendly & helpful. Nice clean apartment, which was lovely & warm (freezing outside!). Comfortable beds. Very close to Friedrichshain & right by Warschauer Strasse station. Recommended
Very friendly host
Angenehme Wohnung mit einem wunderschönen Boden :)

Flat was amazing - a beautifully designed interior with a wonderful collection of art books.  The location perfect, really quiet but close to public transport, cafes galleries and shops with a small local grocery shop open on a Sunday round the corner.

Fijn verblijf in een rustige straat. De bedden sliepen erg lekker en de geluidsisolatie naar buiten is behoorlijk goed. Alleen de vloer binnen kraakte behoorlijk, maar was geen probleem. In de buurt zit je bij leuke restaurants en bars, en dichtbij de U/S Bahn.

Great apartment in Prenzlauer Berg. Also a short tram ride to Mitte and its many museums. Very cozy apartment with great books and great furniture--a well-curated home and it was a pleasure to stay there. Great cafes and restaurants nearby, a farmer's market on Saturdays, a good super market also nearby.  My only quibble: that I had to pay taxes over and above the AirBnB price, but this seems to be something unique to Germany. It was 5% but now it's gone up to 7.5%. All in all, though, the apartment was charming and in a fabulous neighborhood and Camilla was a super communicative host.
Das Appartement war sehr sauber und wir hatten alles, was wir benötigten!
Ich bin zufrieden, die Wohnung ist echt schön.
Vielen Dank für die tolle Unterkunft in ruhiger, aber zentraler Lage. Ich komme gerne wieder!
Die Wohnung und das Zimmer war wie beschrieben ausgestattet und gut erreichbar. Markus war immer gut zu erreichen und hat schnell geantwortet.  Ich komme gerne wieder!

Wonderful, paradisiac place, near to everything. A home with a soul. Full equipped kitchen, WiFi, bathtub...and a garden!!!! We woke up with birds chirping, and green view on her private garden. We slept well, the neighborhood is quiet. This place is really a paradise in Berlin!!
Thank you Ina, for you kindness and for your kind attentions.
Very nice apartment, a little far from the center but in a very cute neighborhood with a lot of good restaurants and bars nearby. Thorsten was very kind and helpful.
very nice and friendly

Great place. My wife and I were very happy to stay at Michael's place. It is in a walkable distance from Nicholaiviertel and Alexander platz, there are also grocery shops, nice bars and cafes nearby. Michael was very friendly and gave us good tips regarding where to go. We would be happy to stay here next time!

Séjour très agréable chez benjamin. La communication était facile, les informations très détaillées (que ce soit pour l’appartement ou bien le quartier).
Appartement tout équipé et propre avec 2 grandes chambres et beaucoup de rangement. Quartier résidentiel calme a 10min à pied de la Alexanderplatz donc on peut faire difficilement plus central.
Nous avons apprécié les petites attentions comme le message d’accueil et les livrets touristiques sur Berlin.
Tres bon rapport qualité-prix !
Merci.

Einfacher Check-In außerhalb der Öffnungszeiten der Rezeption über eine App. Sauberes Zimmer, alles da was man braucht. Empfehlenswert, wenn man nur eine zuverlässige Möglichkeit zum übernachten sucht und übern Tag eigentlich unterwegs ist! 👍
The place was great for the price, and the location is perfect
Handy for u bahn station.  Lots of local restaurants.  Parks very near.

Das Zimmer war wie beschrieben. Ich hatte allerdings ein bisschen Probleme damit, dass der Gastgeber raucht. Ab dem zweiten Tag hat er draußen geraucht. Meine Berlinreise stand allerdings unter keinen guten Vorzeichen, so dass ich vorzeitig abreisen musste. Drei von fünf Tagen zu stornieren war kein Problem.

It is a really nice an adequate place for big groups. Everything was really good except thats there is not a own wifi and the one given was really really slow. Sometimes the water would also take a long time till it came hot.

Picked Oliver’s place last minute, and it was a perfect accommodation for 3 guests. Oliver and his colleague who met us at the house were very professional. The apartment was in a good location. Be prepared to arrive a little early because parking was a little difficult to find near the apartment.
It was great) thanks) David and his family were kind and we have a nice talk
Das Wochenende war super und wir haben uns sehr wohl bei unserem Aufenthalt gefühlt. Die Wohnung war sauber und man hatte alles, was man für einen Trip braucht. Kommen gerne wieder 😊
Great service
We had a very good stay in the appartment, very well equipped, close to the metro, quiet, with a lovely courtyard and greenery. Easy communication, and easy arrival and departure.
Great location, lovely host! The room was just as described, clean, easy to find etc. Highly recommend!

Insgesamt war das Airbnb ganz nett und entsprach auch den Fotos. Nachdem der Code für die Schlüsselbox da war, und wir diese öffnen konnten, war kein Schlüssel da! Damit kamen wir nicht ins Haus (bei kalten Temperaruren im November). Wir mussten mehrmals hin und her telefonieren und mehrere Stunden warten bis endlich ein Schlüssel vorhanden war. Ein Nachbar hat uns dann wenigstens im Haus gelassen, aber eigentlich inakzeptabel sowas!
Stylish apartment overlooking a large atrium which is both private and make you feel part of community.

L’appartement est parfait, tout est bien pensé. Literie confortable et linge de maison propre.
Johannes est accueillant et donne toutes les informations nécessaires pour le séjour.
Wifi accessible très facilement et rapidement.
Rien à redire je conseille vivement pour un séjour à Berlin !

Ce logement est situé dans un quartier très calme et agréable au bord de la Sprée. Il est proche du centre-ville et les transports en commun sont à proximité.
Le logement est bien équipé et propre. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Berlin :-)
un petit logement bien situé  pour visiter Berlin dans un chouette quartier.  impeccable pour un couple.
Für ein paar Tage wirklich eine gute Unterkunft. Wer länger bleibt, sollte Möglichkeiten zum durchsaugen oder Müll entsorgen mit dem Vermieter absprechen.

Wir waren mit fünf Personen in der Unterkunft von Gelfo und waren einfach begeistert. Die Wohnung bietet sehr viel Platz und man fühlt sich direkt wie zu Hause.
Gelfo hat uns persönlich begrüßt und war total nett (hat uns sogar beimTragen des Gepäcks geholfen). Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen.
Communication very slow & lots of tasks for the check out (e.g. removing bed sheets). I expect more comfort for this price. Location very good & apartment has a cool style

Das Apartment war wirklich sehr schön. Die hervorragende Lage, 2 Minuten vom KaDeWe entfernt und damit direkt an der Shoppingmeile. Sehr einfache Verbindung zu den großen Sehenswürdigkeiten von Berlin.
Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Stéphanie is a fantastic host, and the apartment is in a great location.
Such a lovely place near the train station! Lots to do and sightseeing is in walking distance.

We loved our time in Stefan's place. The location could not have been better for walking and public transport. The area is one you want to be in as a visitor to Berlin - surrounded by locals, cafes, restaurants, but not loud, and the street is quiet and suburban. The apartment was perfect for a couple and had all the amenities we needed. Would stay there again.

We had a really nice stay. We couldn't believe we would get such a nice apartment for that price. The location was great too, really close to a supermarket and surrounded by cute cafes and bars. If I'm back in Berlin, I would definitely stay in the same apartment. Thanks!
Felt right at home! Everything is very clean and the apartment is spacious and well equipped. Would love to come again!
Very great location. Easy access to UBahn and Tram and with this go everywhere effortlessly. Wonderful restaurants and markets. Family neighborhood and very comfortable there.
Notre séjour chez Katrin a été très agréable. Le logement est petit mais très propre et bien agencé, il est également bien placé dans un endroit calme mais reste proche des rues animées de Berlin.
Alles super. Steffen hat uns sehr herzlich in Empfang genommen.

Un super séjour dans un appart très sympas, bien situé et fidèle à la description.
Martin est disponible tout au long du séjour!
A essayer sans hésiter!

For a family visit, the location was perfect. Also, not too far from public transit, Edeka (market), cafe, park, and other places. The three beds were ideal for us but the space is small. It gets crowded once the luggage and items are laid out. The key is to be efficient and organized.. Alex has done a good job providing hangers and bars in the right places. We would have liked more air circulation. The windows are on one side of the unit so there's no cross breeze. A small fan would have helped to circulate the air. I liked that it was on ground level. No climbing stairs!
Alles hat super geklappt! Wirklich eine tolle Unterkunft und wahrscheinlich der coolste Kiez in der Hauptstadt. Sehr zu empfehlen!!
Great place and host!
Wohnung mit sehr schöner Atmosphäre
It was a good experience staying at Betty’s home. She is really helpful. Location is also good.
We enjoyed staying at this place! Very clean and comfortable. Looked just like the photos. Good communication with host.
Super locatie. Vriendelijke host. Centraal gelegen. Leuke Restaurants in de omgeving. Appartement schoon en gezellig.

Marcel is an amazing host—really kind and responsive. It didn’t feel like a shared apartment since the rooms were well separated, and he gave us plenty of privacy. The room was even bigger than it looked in the photos! The fully equipped kitchen was a big bonus. The apartment is in a great location, with Prenzlauer Berg within walking distance and excellent public transport connections. It was really easy to get anywhere in Berlin.

Etienne and Judit's place was a great base for a couple days in Berlin experiencing Christmas markets. It is cozy and very well laid out for such a small space, with a nice view from the bed. Transit connections are quick, despite being a little ways out from the center with cool restaurants and bars a short ride away (or a nice walk were it not winter).
The walk up the stairs was useful for burning off Christmas market calories, but might be a bit challenging for an older traveler. There was a bit of noise from the flat next door as they got out ready in the mornings, but nothing unreasonable.
For the prices, exceeded my expectations

Karins hjem må være den hyggeligste lejlighed i hele Berlin. Efter travle dage var det skønt at kunne hvile ud og føle sig hjemme lige fra starten. Lejligheden er indrettet utroligt hyggeligt med masser af finurligheder og flot kunst, og er meget veludstyret med alle fornødenheder. Stort kastanjetræ i gården, skøn altan. Jeg siger mange tak 🙏
Tolle Lage und tolles Design des Apartments. Sauberkeit speziell auf dem Boden, Decken und den Fenstern kann verbessert werden. Preis-Leistungsverhältnis sehr gut.
Awesome host! super helpful and communicative.
Apartamento muy bien situado! bien equipado con todo lo necesario! Sitio tranquilo y poco ruidoso! Muy limpio y confortable! Muy recomendable!
Alles super

Excellent séjour chez Till. L’emplacement est idéal, à la fois au calme mais près de restaurants, cafés et sites touristiques.
La chambre est grande, propre et lumineuse. Le lit est confortable. La salle de bain est propre et bien équipée.
Till est très accessible et flexible sur les heures d’arrivée et de départ.
Je recommande vraiment cette adresse.
I had a great time at Melissa's place. It was super comfortable in a quiet and convenient location. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Berlin!

Wir haben das Zweinihaus für 5 Nächte gebucht.
Maria ist eine sehr nette Person die auf Nachrichten und Fragen immer sehr schnell beantwortet hat.
Dass wir zu spät am ersten Tag angekommen sind, war es auch kein Problem.
Das Haus an sich, war sehr angenehm und wunderschön.
P.S. Falls ihr im Garten sitzen wollte(auch wenn das 10 Minuten sind), holt euch Mückenspray ;)

Tia has a beautiful apartment that I benefited from staying in for nearly six months so experienced at very different times of the year - I liked it so much that I just kept extending. The place is very attractively styled, spacious, calm, and everything from the kitchen to the bathrooms work very smoothly: I had not a single problem or issue across the whole period of my stay. The location is one of the nicest in Kreuzberg, with the apartment looking out on the most open section of the canal, and a great selection of restaurants, bars and shops are very close by, as well as good public transport connections (Tia has identified many of the best options on a google map collection she provides).
The apartment is comfortably warm in winter and cool in even the peak summer heat. Openness to the street (it has its own separate entrance too) is a real asset - easy to step out, watch the world go by or have friends drop by to say hi but can easily be closed up for privacy. It can work very well in multiple guises - as a work-space, entertainment space, or fantastic base for exploring the city. It was equally great in the most extreme phase of the lockdown and the super-open, summer-by-the-canal phase. Friendly neighbors in the other apartments. Bedroom to the back is very quiet and although I didn't sleep in the front bedroom, the street outside is really not very busy (most of the foot traffic is a few steps further away at the canal). Tia is very nice, communicates well, lives nearby if there are any issues.
Probably the best Airbnb I've stayed at (I have already planned my return...)
We had a great stay and the host the whole way through
Zona tranquilla ubicata vicino alla stazione di Nollendorfplatz. Vicino  a ristoranti e bar. Ottima pulizia e Jen  è una persona veramente disponibile. Lo consiglio
Tolle Wohnung, sehr gemütlich eingerichtet und vom Hbf sogar zu Fuß zu erreichen. Man findet alles in der Nähe was man braucht.
Exelente Dpto. Zona tranquila y a pocos minutos de varios sitios importantes. También tiene muy buena conexión con transporte público.

Urs’ Airbnb was the perfect home base for our short visit to Berlin. Kitchen was stocked with basics (coffee, tea, sugar, laundry detergent) and the large living room was the perfect home office. Neighbourhood was close to high street and was very peaceful. Great hosts who were flexible with late check-out. Would recommend!
Tolle Lage, faire Preise, sauber und unkompliziert

Die Wohnung liegt super zentral und ist geräumig und sauber, allerdings etwas dunkel. Die Angabe "kostenloser Parkplatz auf dem Grundstück" ist etwas irreführend, man muss einen Parkplatz auf dem Seitenstreifen der Straße suchen. Ansonsten entsprach alles den Angaben und Bildern.

The accommodation was very good: Clean, good space and functional, and close to public transportation and easy to find a parking lot. (Pls. note the postal code - there are several locations with the same street address in Berlin)

Our time at the Gran Hostel Berlin was fabulous! The staff was very nice and accommodating. The place was located in a great area, close to the train station, restaurants, and a short ride to Berlin city center. The place was very clean and exactly as described on the listing!
