Es un apartament molt ben equipat i prou ampli com per anar una família. Te forces estances i permet privacitat. El barri es tranquil i de fàcil comunicació
Très bon séjour dans ce logement propre, pratique et confortable. David très accueillant, échanges faciles.
Mitten im Kiez, uriger Kreuzberger Charme.

Logement parfait pour 3 personnes voir 4. Bien équipé, propre, lumineux. Metro à côté. Des très bons restaurants à proximité. Environnement calme. Hôte toujours disponible. Excellente qualité/prix. Je recommande.

Der Aufenthalt bei Conny war einfach super. Alles was man braucht. Ich war sehr zufrieden und Conny ist ein wunderbarer Gastgeber und immer für fragen da und super erreichbar 😊 hab mich sehr wohlgefühlt 😊

We had a fabulous time in Berlin and staying at this apartment was a big piece of that. Everything was close and there’s tons of public transportation. Along with that Alice was sweet enough to give us kinds of recommendations and they were fabulous! I would recommend staying here most definitely!
Excellent apartment.  We had a very pleasant stay and highly recommend this place.
Great space, really proactive and helpful communication, very centrally located.
The quality of Ben and Simon's apartment and service is extremely high. Our trip couldn't have been easier and was great value.
Nur zu empfehlen, sehr sauber und schön eingerichtet. Der eigene Eingang ein absolutes Plus!
Gute Lage, netter Host.

Brilliant location with most sights walkable, and the metro just a few minutes away. Great bakery and restaurants nearby. Funky, clean apartment but we had a few issues with a broken window, confusing instructions for using the laundry and a not-very-smart TV. Matthew was mostly very helpful, but a delayed response occasionally.
Very good apartment in quiet neighborhoods and with an amazing courtyard ! The reception is well organised, and we highly recommend it for a nice trip.
Everything was as written in the advertisement. The place was very clean and quiet. There are also very good traffic connections and shopping possibilities just around the corner.
The only thing is parking is a bit of a challenge, other than that a nice place to stay.

Bei Ute ist es sehr gemütlich und sauber. Der Check-in war völlig unkompliziert und die Gegend hat mir auch gut gefallen - es ist ziemlich grün und trotzdem ist man recht schnell in der Stadt oder im nahegelegenen Ortskern von Hermsdorf mit Geschäften, Supermärkten und Restaurants. Ich kann Utes Unterkunft wärmstens weiterempfehlen.
En dejligt sted, meget centralt. Rent og pænt. Værten er imødekommende og venlig.
Super nice area. Room is located in the backyard, hence very silent area.

Ich war beruflich in Wedding und konnte von dort aus schnell und flexibel mit den Öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln meine Termine wahr nehmen.
Die Wohnung ist zweckmässig und sehr sauber. Auf der kleinem Terasse kann man super den Abend ausklingen lassen und abschalten.
Auf meine zusätzlichen Wünsche während den zwei Wochen wurde sehr flexibel und zeitnah eingegangen.
Ich komme sehr gern wieder.
This is a really cool place to stay for any trip to Berlin. Good facilities, great breakfast, and ideal location for any sightseeing. Had a great night playing pool in the bar. Highly recommended!

Very privat and quiet 🤫 Tall travellers be aware the place has quite low seeling (I'm 188cm). Travellers with bad back might not be very comfortable the bed is super soft and I had a back pain after sleeping. Otherwise all good.

We stayed on the 2nd floor for a room of five. And here is our experience.
Positives
- Central, easy to move around.
- Parking house near by costed 25 Euros a day(btw: does no accept foreign Credit card. only cash)
Negatives
- The room wasnt clean at all.
- Bad hygine
- Beds were very uncomfortable, springs were totally bad and beds were dirty, stained.
- All the power plugs were hidden behind furniture.
- There was no cross ventilation in the room. Due to the rainy weather it was hard to keep the windows open at all times.
- Dirty Carpets
- Towels seemed totally used up. somewhat clean but hard to tell.
- Extremely small toilet for a room of five.
- Noisy during the nights
- There was parking in the hotel itself, but it was very small and limited space.. hard to get into and hard to manouver if you have a big car.
The hotel staff at check-in was very weird. e.g. I asked for parking the car. So they held my room key incase I would run away.. but I have the room prep
Praktisk leilighet, greit utstyrt. Bilder stemte med virkeligheten. Verten svarte raskt, innsjekking var smidig. Hyggelig nabolag, men dette var ikke Prentlauer Berg.

Es ist alles so, wie beschrieben und Stephan ist ein hilfsbereiter, super freundlicher Host: Die lage der ehemaligen Schmiede mit dem schönen Loft-Charakter ist ruhig im Hinterhof, dennoch sind die Bushaltestelle und alle Einkaufsmöglichkeiten oder Restaurants in der Nähe, man ist so schnell in der Stadt. Besonders gefallen uns, dass man bei lauen Nächten schön auf der Terrasse sitzen kann und Wohnung bzw. das Haus gleich 2 Bäder hat. Gerne hätten wir mehr Zeit in der der ehemaligen Schmiede verbracht und können den Aufenthalt dort jedem sehr empfehlen.
Ok Hermannplatz ist hermannplatz… aber die Appartements kann man rundherum empfehlen!!
I enjoy my stay with Chris, was also kind enough to leave my luggage with her while my other place was ready.
Just as described. Very nice location and easy to get to major places in and out of the city center.

Top appartement. Gelegen bij de uitgang van een station, van waaruit er verschillenden S-bahnen vertrekken. Binnen korte tijd zijn alle plekken in de stad makkelijk te bereiken.
Het appartement bevat een mooi, klein keukentje en een koelkast. De supermarkt ligt ook op 5 minuten lopen! Al met al een top appartement!
Super sauber, recht zentral und nettes Personal!

We stayed for a month! Great location in the heart of Mitte, with shops, restaurants and transportation close by. Very walkable to some of Berlin's must-see & do spots. More than ideal for 2 people or small family, who can manage with one bathroom. Safe apartment & location.

We really enjoyed our stay. The location was perfect and we loved sitting on the balcony and enjoyed watching the sun setting over the rooftops. Couldn't believe how peaceful and quiet it was despite its central location. The cozy lighting stood out as well.
Great communication with Gini! Amazing flat

My husband and I were satisfied with the apartment and the neighbourhood
and are delighted to recommend it.

Жилье комфортное для компании людей, хорошие кровати и большой общий стол, где мы могли заседать часами. Из минусов - нигде нет ростовых зеркал, а два маленьких зеркала в душевых не очень спасали, когда 6 девушек должны утром собраться и накраситься для конференции. Ну и нельзя было оценить полный лук без большого зеркала, приходилось смотреть в отражение в телевизоре, а также в витринах на улицах
Enjoyable stay, everything was as pictured. Great location. The shower does have a privacy screen.

Apartment looks even better than I expected, it’s a magical place with cute little garden what allows you enjoy silence and nature in the middle of one of the most  busy areas. Gundula is great host and really nice lady, my stay in there couldn’t be better, thank you ❤️
Ein schönes, helles Jugendstil-Appartement in verkehrsgünstiger und trotzdem ruhiger Lage. Kommunikation und Orga war bestens. Alles in allem eine perfekte Woche in Berlin.
Nice place, nice lady.

Clean, but really,really small apartment and definitely not working for 5 persons.
No space to eat together and very limited possibilities in the kitchen, which has a size of max. 5sq m. Opening hours of the reception are only from 2-9pm and there is no possibility to check in earlier. Overpriced apartment from my point of view.
Great location close to a beautiful park and delicious restaurants. Very bright and large room. Till was very responsive and kind. The area felt safe and local.
We had a very nice and pleasant stay with Klaus. Our own space, everything was there and it was very clean. Nice people, close to the S Bahn and an overall great experience. Definitely recommend!

I wish we could have stayed longer in her house. It is really so beautiful and clean and comfy. There's nothing bad you can say about her house. When we arrived at her place, she was there to happily assist us. Probably the reason why we right away felt at home.
Her house, I very highly recommend. Thanks so much!

Sehr gemütliche, zentral gelegene und geschmackvoll eingerichtete Wohnung. Man hat da alles was man braucht. Die Wohnung war vor allem richtig sauber und ordentlich!
Obwohl die zentrale Lage, war im Haus trotzdem sehr ruhig, was wir toll fanden!
Auch die Schlüsselabgabe lief reibungslos.
Der Ingo ist ein sehr freundlicher und flexibler Mensch.
Wir waren sehr begeistert!
Gerne wieder.
Danke:)
Great place and really enjoyed our stay in Berlin. Andre was a great host.

We loved our stay in Berlin. We enjoyed our stay in the apartment. Everything was there. The location is perfect. Sometimes a little bit noisy but the location in relation to all facilities is great.
The owner is very hospitable and everything was well arranged for a good stay in Berlin.
una zona y habitación muy acogedoras.

We had a wonderful stay in Berlin in this beautiful appartment. The communication beforehand was great, Dori and Kai are very kind and they helped us get to the appartment easily. The appartment is very clean and cozy with a lot of light. We had everything we needed in the kitchen. The terrace is also a big plus when the weather is nice. The neighboorhood is quiet yet there are a lot of restaurants, bars and beautiful parks nearby. There's an U-bahn and busstop close to the appartment so you can easily get to the center. We will definitely recommend this to our friends and family if they want to visit Berlin.
Comfortable stay. Felt right at home.
Communication was simple and Brit made everything seamless. Would stay here and recommend this place in a heartbeat.
El lugar es muy agradable y excelente ubicación, el único inconveniente es que la persona encargada del aseo ingresa a la habitación sin tocar o avisar, invadiendo la privacidad.

Die Wohnung ist sehr schön,neu, sauber sowie sehr gut gelegen. Die Kommunikation mit Silke war sehr unkompliziert. Obwohl sie nicht da war,war die Schlüsselübergabe bei Frau Krüger kein Problem.Gerne wieder, ich kann die Wohnung sehr empfehlen.

Very functional and clean.
Communication with Stayery was strenuous – the bot sent messages offering human support. We reached out asking for a late checkout but needed to send follow-up messages since twice there was no response for >10 days. During the stay, they offer you communication via text messages, which worked somewhat better, but was still patchy. Overall, we got very mixed messages for the simple question 'Is a late checkout possible?' ranging from everything between should-be-possible and no-can-do. Eventually, they said it wasn't possible 15 minutes prior to the actual checkout time.
Apart from that, the location is great if you want to be in downtown Friedrichshain, rooms are clean and all the necessities one might need are available. There's also a co-working-space-style lobby where you can work, have a coffee, and buy snacks.

Hyvien liikenneyhteyksien päässä. Helppo sisäänkirjautuminen.
Suhteellisen rauhallinen.
Unkomplizierter Kontakt, alles so, wie beschrieben, haben uns gleich wohl gefühlt, wie zuhause.
Un très bon séjour, l'appartement est situé proche des transports et des restaurants, le lieu est calme.
Super angebunden, nur wenige Gehminuten zur S-Bahn. Schöne Einrichtung. Ruhige Gegend. Nette, aufmerksame Gastgeberin.
Good spot for short stays! Clean, super easy self check-in and good location
What a great apartment! Light, airy, GREAT location. Clean, well equipped, comfortable bed, sunny balcony (in the morning). I had the perfect stay. Would definitively recommend it!
Great place and location !
We loved our stay! Amazing thanks.

Was a great place, happy to
come back.
Lovely big flat, great for our family. Nice coffee shops next door and good to have the park just opposite.

The place was perfect for me. I stayed there for over a month and felt like home. Simon and his family are extremely friendly and accommodating. The place is super quiet and cozy and you can’t be better located than that in Berlin. Would book it again anytime!
Really nice host and the house is like really new.

The apartment is in an interesting, socioeconomically and culturally diverse neighborhood, packed with small cafes and restaurants, and quite accessible by underground and many bus lines to major Berlin sights and neighborhoods.  The apartment is light and pleasant.  However, it is minimally furnished, for example, no TV, bureau for guests, etc.  Unfortunately, it is located in a quite shabby, dirty, and smelly building (not the fault of Guillaume and Ana, of course).  And the apartment lacks an Internet connection, with the nearest wi fi cafe about 10 blocks away.

Nos alojamos con mi familia. Fuimos 5 adultos y estuvimos cómodos. Al llegar, faltaba una cama pero el anfitrión fue súper expeditivo y nos brindó una rápida solución. Tal vez eso fue lo único negativo. Sin embargo, Frank fue amable y muy servicial, atento siempre a nuestra estadía.
El alojamiento bien equipado y la ubicación muy cómoda y tranquila. En general, una buena experiencia.
Kiva paikka.
Had a great stay at Franz’s place. He responded quickly to any questions we had. The apartment is close to public transport and lots of places to eat. The main bed is comfortable.
Unterkunft mit allem was man braucht. U-Bahn Station schnell zu Fuß erreichbar.
Très bon rapport qualité-prix. Les chambres sont spacieuses et bien aménager. Aussi le quartier est très bien desservis. Merci beaucoup !!

We had a very good experience with Rita's apartment. It was tidy and accurate and had everything we needed. Rita was a very nice host, was on time and even waited for us, when we were a little bit late. Recommended!
very good location, clean, helpful, totally recommended

Der Aufenthalt bei Karen war perfekt! Die Gastgeberin war sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und flexibel. Das Zimmer bietet ausreichend Platz, ist sehr sauber und gemütlich. Die Wohnung ist außerdem sehr ruhig und zeichnet sich durch eine zentrale Lage aus - in 4 Minuten zu Fuß ist man bei der U-Bahn-Station Bernauer Straße. In weiteren 4 Minuten befindet man sich bereits beim Alexander Platz - für mich der Ausgangspunkt für alle weiteren Aktivitäten am Tag und in der Nacht!
Liebe Karen, noch einmal vielen Dank für den schönen Aufenthalt - sicherlich bis bald!
everything was perfect apart from the smell in the bathroom.

We had a lovely stay at Bert's apartment. The room is very convenient for reaching the town centre and was super warm and inviting in Winter. Bert was an excellent communicator, giving us useful advice and recommendations.
Casa muy bien ubicada, limpia y cómoda.
Great stay in a great flat in a great location. Rolf has been very flexible and reactive, friendly and helpful. Really recommand the place. We'll probably visit again :)

it's excellent the only problem than I found is quite hard go to the center of Berlin from that area but you don't need too because the area you can find a lot of good restaurants, bars and nights clubs are always open so I really like the location

What a lovely place to stay, thanks to Katrin I felt very welcome.

I had a event at the University which is literally at five minutes walk away. I've also took the Ubahn to get to the centre of the city.

Would definitely book this again if I have to go to the University.
Ich hatte eine wunderbare Zeit in Hildas Studio und würde jederzeit wiederkommen!
Quartier in sehr guter Lage, ruhig, äußerst nette Gastgeberin , man fühlt sich wie zu Hause...
Matthias was a great host and was quick to respond with any questions I had. The apartment was spacious and sunny as described. We would certainly stay again!
We where very pleased with the apartment. It was exactly as described when booking. It’s a quiet courtyard and feels safe. Many great little restaurants close to the apartment. We will book again.
Einfach und unkompliziert

We had a great time staying in Emanuela's apartment. The layout is fantastic with a big living room, nice high ceilings and comfy beds. The location was perfect, minutes away from the s-bahn, shops and lots of clubs, giving you a real sense of living in the heart of Berlin. Communication with the host was easy. Great place to stay.

Die Familie hat uns willkommen geheißen und uns zum wunderschönen Apartment geführt. Die Wohnung war super, schön hell, freundlich, warm und sauber. Eine super Aussicht- egal wo man rausgeguckt hat, überall war Wasser zu sehen. Wer in Berlin was unternehmen möchte und trotzdem ruhig wohnen will (es war sehr ruhig, überhaupt kein Autoverkehr) ist hier genau richtig. Man muss bis in die Innenstadt aber etwas Zeit einplanen. Die Anbindung ist gut mit Straßenbahn und S-Bahn.
Wir sind viel Rad gefahren, z. B. um den Müggelsee mit anschließendem Essen auf der Arche. Auch der Mauerradweg ist gut zu erreichen, Theaterbesuch am Kurfürstendamm; Karten gibt es in der Bölschestraße in Friedrichshagen.

The apartment was nice and a bit better than what the pictures look like. Bed was clean and sheets were fine, just a bit tiny. Kitchen was a bit old and required lighting with matches. The bathroom was well-equipped but a bit dark as the one of the two lamps was broken. The location of the apartment is fair.
The best thing was Henrik was super nice to us and even helped my mom to carry her large and heavy luggage up to the second floor. Big thanks to him!!
Nice place. Cool location. Comfy bed
Fantastic apartment in a great location.  Everything you’ll need for a brilliant stay in Berlin.
Dirk's place was great. He is a warm & accommodating person. I recommend his place to anyone who needs a place to stay in Berlin.
Ich war zum zweiten Mal dort. Gute Anbindung zur U-Bahn. Allerdings recht laut, wenn man bei geöffnetem Fenster schläft.
very clean and spacious

I stayed in Anat's lovely apartment for a number of months and can highly recommend it! The apartment is really spacious with incredibly high ceilings and large bright windows. The kitchen is well stocked and the separate pantry and utility room were really convenient. The bedroom is comfortable with plenty of storage space and the balcony looks directly into a mature tree which is lovely in summer. The sitting room is really spacious with beautiful large bay windows. The area around the apartment is very convenient and despite the popular Kreuzkölln area being on its doorstep, the street is nice and peaceful, so you have the best of both worlds! Anat was a lovely and gracious host and communication with her was swift and uncomplicated. The entire stay was extremely positive and I would highly recommend Anat's lovely apartment.
Natalie war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Wohnung war sauber und S-und U-Bahnhof leicht zu erreichen. Wir hatten einen angenehmen Aufenthalt.

Great spot for us attending the IFA Berlin show for work - a quick scooter ride so we could ditch the traffic! Nice park around the corner for running, a gym 2 blocks out and great breakfast at Zeit for Brot made the visit complete.
we had a great stay. the kitchen was excellent!
Super AirBnb très bien agencé et agréable à vivre
Einfach schön und immer wieder gerne :)
ci siamo trovate molto bene :) grazie mille

Vincent was very friendly, helpful and proactive as host. His apartment is elegant, spacious and comfortable, we felt immediately at home. Very comfortable bed, enormous sofa to relax on with a neat little balcony to enjoy a morning coffee. We loved being so high up for the light and views.
Tram stop outside, going west connecting to the S-bahn heading into Mitte. Great bars, cafés and restaurants right by the apartment. We loved our stay here and would love to come back again!

The apartment was in a great location and clean and tidy when we arrived. Alex was very nice and helpful, and responded quickly to any queries. We only stayed for one night but would definitely stay there again.

Ein "Zuhause"Gefühl, vielleicht kann man es so am besten beschreiben. Ich habe mich vom ersten Moment an sehr wohl gefühlt. Sabrina ist eine tolle Gastgeberin, sie empfängt Dich mit einem herzlichen Lächeln. Ihr Haus hat viel Charm, großzügige Räumlichkeiten. Alles sehr gut organisiert, sauber, ruhig, gute Lage, nahe an der S-Bahn, am Park, Einkaufen um die Ecke. Danke Sabrina für die schöne Zeit.

Location was good for me as my cousin lives close and easy for us to meet and take transportation to city center.  Apartment is back off the street and quiet making it easy to sleep with no street noise.  Apartment is a 5 story “walk up” so pace yourself as it’s a healthy climb up.  Overall, I liked the apartment and being next to Mercantino and across the street from United; both restaurants worth exploring!
Gutes Zimmer für ne einfache Übernachtung, Anbindung an Olympiastadion und Hauptbahnhof gut. Atziger Host, check in war sehr easy. Empfehle
Wij zijn fantastisch ontvangen. Er stond een flesje wijn klaar en alles werd in een rondleiding uitstekend uitgelegd.

The apartment is really lovely and close to lots of nice places to eat/drink as well as a large supermarket and a train station within a 10minute walk. There is also a very handy bus link (which stops just up the street from the apartment) which takes you from the airport.

Great stylish place, sparking clean.
Super comfy bed.
Great location.
Delicious restaurant with magic breakfasts on the ground floor.
Highly recommended!
What a lovely apartment. It’s very comfortable and check-in instructions very good. Philipp gave many tips; we had dinner at the Goldenen Hahn, just perfect.

The location is perfect - walking distance to a great selection of local restaurants, bars, grocery stores and very close to the subway and other public transit! Alex was also extremely welcoming, responsive and accommodating. 10/10 would recommend!!
The room was nice and it was a 25 minutes walk from the city centre.
Really nice place to stay in Berlin! Great amenities.
Stella ist eine wunderbar zuvorkommende Gastgeberin, die auf Anfragen superschnell reagiert und bei Bedarf handelt. Die Unterkunft hat alles erfüllt, was sie sollte. Tipptopp!
My stay at this place was wonderful, there where no issues at all, quick responses and easy check-in and out . Additionally the location is perfect.  Would come again 100%

The place is in the city center and near U Bahn and restaurants, quite convenient. Jan is also quick to response. Only two drawbacks - it is in the basement and close to the street; therefore even close the windows you could still hear the street noise while sleeping. Also might due to the basement, the wifi is unstable, so we will need to use our phone internet instead. It is ok for a short stay.

Die Unterkunft ist top. So sieht die Unterkunft eines Super-Host einfach aus. Es mangelt an nichts und man fühlt sich sofort wie zu Hause. Die Wohnung ist mit liebe zum Detail renoviert worden und es ist alles vorhanden. Sehr gute Aufteilung für uns mit 3 Kindern. In der Nähe gibt es zwar nicht viel, aber wir sind ja wegen Berlin und Potsdam gekommen. In Kladow selbst kann man runter zur Havel laufen und zum Wannsee fahren. Super fanden wir auch die Parkmöglichkeiten direkt auf dem Grundstück und der Bus direkt vor dem Haus. Einzig die Dauer nach Berlin zoologischer Garten ist mit knappen 50 Minuten schon sehr lange. Aber besser als mit dem eigenem Pkw reinzufahren. Die Berlin Welcome Card beinhaltet die Fahrt mit dem Bus ins Zentrum. Das ist der einzig kleine Kritikpunkt. Ansonsten war alles super gut und wir empfehlen den Host und die Wohnung bedenkenlos weiter. Top! So macht Airbnb Spaß 🤩
Weiter so. 👍🏻

Der Gastgeber war ausgesprochen freundlich und hat uns persönlich in Empfang genommen.
Das Zimmer war wie beschrieben und ist vollkommen ausreichend für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in Berlin.
Die Wohnung war sauber, aber leider riecht es im Bad nicht so gut. Aber wenn man die Badetür geschlossen hält, lässt es sich aushalten!
Hinter der Wand befindet sich die Küche des Restaurants und es kann bis Mitternacht ziemlich laut werden. War für uns kein Problem! Wäre aber super, wenn man es vorher wüsste.
Die Wohnung ist ganz in der Nähe einer U-Bahn Station und somit sehr gut angebunden. Innerhalb von 15 Minuten ist man in Mitte.

Séjour mitigé dans l'ensemble

El piso es pequeño y con muy poca luz.

Está en una buena zona y la comunidad muy tranquila.
Great location.

The apartment is spacious, well equipped, comfortable, and beautiful. Despite its location (within easy walking distance of many places of interest), it is very quiet indeed at night. Highly recommended.

Great low hassle place to stay. Quiet and really convenient for exploring the area and for catching public transportation. Thoughtful touches made it feel like home. My teenage daughter & I felt comfortable.

Optimales Zimmer und sehr gute Lage.

Hasan war unglaublich nett, und der Wohnung liegt super Zentral. würde gerne wieder kommen!

Der Aufenthalt und die Wohnung waren super. Schön eingerichtet und gemütlich. Kommunikation mit Ruth war genauso gut, schnelle Antwort und Hilfsbereitschaft. Danke 😀.
Kommen gern wieder.
Super Anbindung zur Innenstadt.

Ein gutes Hostel, für alle, die nicht zu hohe Ansprüche an die Einhaltung von Ruhezeiten und die Sauberkeit in Gemeinschaftsräumen haben. Elegant and clean

Die Kommunikation konnte nicht über die App erfolgen , den Schlüssel ist erst von einem Restaurant in der nahe (etwa 250 meter) abholbar , kein Parkplatz vorhanden, man gelingt nicht über den Haupteingang. Die Wohnung ist sauber , die Küche ist gut ausgestattet, die Betten sind klein , die Bettwäsche haben mehrere Locher :( .
Die gesamte Erfahrung war ok ,konnte aber besser sein.

Daniela and Alex are such lovely, calm people.
I stayed for 4 days from Belgium to visit some friends and would really recommend to stay in this lovely room.
The room was big, clean and bright, lot of sunlight.
I arrived earlier than check in and Daniela was happy to meet me earlier and let me take a shower.
Theyre appartment is also beautifull to stay in, nice neigbourhood and the public transport is couple minutes (2-3) walk.
I would say, see you next time!
They were amazing and the location was great! Would go back in a heartbeat

The flat is situated at a quiet neighborhood, next to a park and with good connections to the local transportation infrastructure. The nearby park is excellent for jogging and many other sport alternatives. A small disadvantage is the lack of an elevator in the building, which makes the carrying of big luggage for more than a week a bit uncomfortable.
The flat on its own is very well sound insulated and warm and provides a good possibility for cooking your own food. We were three of us in the flat, each of us with his/her own room, but for more than 4 people it will be too tight.
Our host Fai was very easy to reach and contact and there were no problems during our stay. I can only recommend the flat for people, who would like to visit Berlin and have a nice relaxed flat for their stay.

Bon rapport qualité prix, un peu loin du centre mais en 15/20 min de métro sans changement on le rejoint facilement !
Chambre très confortable !!

Dodi war ein sehr netter und zuvorkommender Mensch. Er hat uns oft eine Vielzahl von Tipps für Berlin gegeben, da er sich sehr gut auskannte. Besonders mit der Kunstszene, in diese wir auch sehr interessiert waren. Insgesamt war es also ein sehr schönes Wochenende bei Dodi in Berlin.

Sehr angenehme Unterkunft, freundliche Gastgeberin.
Alles sauber und ohne Komplikationen. Kann ich sehr empfehlen.

super Gastgeberin und Unterkunft. man erreicht alles super zu fuß und mit der Bahn

Great place to stay for a short break.  Brilliant communication with Torsten.  Easy access to public transportation all over Berlin.  Apartment very clean and comfortable.  would stay again.

Nice and clean Airbnb. Would go there again!
Alexandre was a very kind and communicative host.
Ana Maria is a wonderful, friendly, open person! I would highly recommend to stay at her nice,cosy, art and spiritual place! It was a pleasure-to get to know her as a person! Thank you!

Logez chez Bruno et Ulrike, c’est vivre le vrai Berlin. Une “WG” où l’on se sent bien. Je reviendrai avec beaucoup beaucoup de plaisir. @Bruno&Ulrike: Passez un bel automne berlinois et merci encore de votre accueil chaleureux!

Beautiful, modern, spotless clean and spacious studio at a great area of Berlin, just a few steps from the U-bahn station. The shower is amazing and the kitchen very well equipped. There were booklets with tons of information about Berlin. Checking in and out was very easy, Andreas was very attentive and answered all of my questions. The studio is on a third floor of a building with no elevator, but a place full of character, with old photos of the city and a lovely courtyard. The only drawbacks for me: the mattress was way too soft, but it might be a matter of taste; the towels could be bigger and softer and the heater seemed a bit weak for Berlin winter… Despite these few issues, I definitely recommend this place and would stay there again!
Top! Sehr zu empfehlen. Ich komme gerne wieder. Wer vor hat einen Parkplatz zu buchen, muss wissen dass die Einfahrt relativ schmal ist. Mit einem PKW kein Problem.

Beautiful apartment with a nice location. Easy to access only downside would be uploading your ID to their portal as they should have access to my data through Airbnb.
Exactly as described and perfect for one night before flying. Central location and great amenities.

Ilias's place was amazing! Cool custom interior in spacious apartment with high ceilings and artsy wibe in the heart of creative Kreuzberg. Enjoy :-)

Very nice room

This place was conveniently located in Berlin Mitte, close to public transportation. I liked staying here very much, Arne was very kind and easy-going, communication was good as well. The apartment is located in a great neighborhood, with easy access and transit to the rest of the city. Kitchen and linens were well-stocked for longer stays, and apartment was spacious and clean. Would definitely stay again!

Oliver is a very pleasant, trustworthy and friendly host and we felt welcome in his appartment. Although it seems a bit far out of the centrum of Berlin, in just a 3/5min walk to the S-Bahn and a drive of another 5min you are as centred as you'll ever be.

A peaceful and cozy accommodation near a tram station (10m walk) connected to the center of Berlin. Ugur was super kind and the place was really clean and neat :)

Paula hat mich sehr nett begrüßt und mir Alles wichtige in der Wohnung gezeigt. Das Zimmer ist toll eingerichtet und es war sehr sauber - ich habe mich sofort wohl gefühlt. Für mich war es die perfekte Unterkunft für die dreitägig Dienstreise.

Would definitely recommend staying here, small apartment in the middle of Berlin. Very close to multiple metro stations which makes it easy to get to the city centre.

ASPETTI POSITIVI: Ralf é sempre stato reattivo nel rispondere a qualsiasi domanda. L’appartamento é grande e spazioso e generalmente pulito.
ASPETTI NEGATIVI: L’appartamento si trova in una via secondaria del quartiere turco. Io e la mia amica non ci siamo sentite al sicuro né di giorno né di sera in quanto abbiamo spesso subito catcalling. Per questo siamo state costrette a prendere il taxi per tornare a casa in modo sicuro. Le pentole antiaderenti erano tutte tagliate, oltre che sporche e quindi impossibili da usare perché nocive per la salute. Le posate, i bicchieri e le tazze erano sporche e le abbiamo dovute rilavare. L’olio presente in casa é per friggere e non per cucinare, la macchina per il caffe invece é per fare il caffe americano e non l’espresso. Gli asciugamani sono sottili e non asciugano, oltre che lasciano dei peletti verdi quando si asciugano le stoviglie, abbiamo dovuto usare lo scottex in quanto più igienico.

Great price/quality deal with an amazingly central location in the bussling metropole that is Berlin. Enough space with everything you could possibly need facilitated in the apartment.

This apartment is a great place to stay to explore Berlin. Das Personal, welches wir getroffen haben, war sehr nett.
Alles in allem hat uns das kleine Hotel sehr gut gefallen.

A great location, with easy access to the subway, trains and buses from the airport and around Berlin. The apartment is on the first floor of the building so easy access with no lift/elevator needed.
It is very nicely furnished, with amazing period features. The freezer, and hanging space are very high, so anyone under 5.5 will need a stepstool.The sides of the bath/shower are also very high with no grab rail so a bit scary to get and out of unless you have very long legs. As others have commented, the shower gets hot then cold then hot, so let it run for a few mins before showering.
The kitchen is nice, although the only condiments are salt, sugar and oil - we assume leftover spices, flour, pasta etc from previous guests are removed by the cleaner. It felt a bit spartan compared to most other places in this price range that we have stayed in, but it was pretty clean and reasonably well-equipped. The floors at the entrance to the kitchen and bathroom are slightly raised so beware.
The host is nice! The place needs some cleaning! The apartment is spacey.
Tolles Appartment!  Super ausgestattete Küche. Sehr ruhig im offenen, großzügigem Innenhof.
Langfristig Urlaub würden wir dort nicht machen! Aber für unser Anliegen (Eventbesuch) war es genau das richtige!!

Súper clean and confortable apartment!
Very good location to the main attractions. I really recomend Lena’s place. Thank you Lena!
Alles super, haben uns wohl gefühlt.
Good location, just outside of the main location. Food shop right outside. Such a friendly couple with a lovely air bnb

Ein kleines, praktisches und sehr sauberes Apartment mit allem, was man braucht und zusätzlich einem Balkon :-). Zudem liegt es zentral – mit vielen Lokalen in der Nähe und einer guten Anbindung an S-/U-Bahn und Busse. Ein gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis. (Bei hohen Außentemperaturen war es sehr heiß, aber das gilt für viele Wohnungen.)

Amazing time I had in Berlin. The house is beatiful, warm and cosy and it is perfectly spotted; 2min from the bus ; 7 mins from the train and 5 mins from a supermarket.

Totally recomended
非常安静的小房子，很温馨！门口有个大湖，景色很漂亮！

Super Lage & Unterkunft.. alles in der Wohnung was man braucht.

The apartment was very big and well design it’s I believe 130 square meters with everything you need for short or long term staying.
The location was also very good .
For large group this is very good solution!
Nice and comfortable place!

I stayed at Mike’s place for two nights, and it exceeded my expectations. Mike gave me a warm welcome and provided a clear introduction to all the amenities in the room and neighborhood, including public transportation, shopping centers, and parks. He also shared useful tips for my short trip in Berlin, which made my experience much smoother. The place was quiet at night, and the bed was cozy—perfect for a good night’s sleep. The location is close to the U8 metro line, making it easy to explore the city. It’s worth mentioning that Mike’s place was exceptionally clean, one of my favorite aspects. Overall, Mike is a thoughtful host, and this was my best Airbnb experience yet!
Die Lage der Wohnung ist perfekt. Mitten im Kiez und doch sehr ruhig. Claudia war immer erreichbar. Tolle Berlin Lektüre ist in der Wohnung vorhanden. Gerne wieder.
Excellent and perfect!

The apartment is within walking distance of subway, as well as close to a shopping street with many restaurant choices. We were visiting with our 1-year old twins, and Doerthe was very accommodating by providing two high chairs, and two cribs with blankets, and even toys. One plus if you're visiting in the summer: the apartment is half-way below ground which makes it nice and cool even during a heat-wave we had (very few apartments in Germany have AC). Overall highly recommended.

Caroline est une hôte très réactive.
Son logement correspond bien aux photos, on s'y sent très bien !
Des transports publics sont disponibles facilement vers le logement.
Amazing hotel, friendly staff and great location. You could walk to all the main landscapes. Great place for great value. Highly recommended.
Rien à redire sur cet appart, vraiment très sympa, fonctionnel et bien placé ; il est même beaucoup plus grand que ce que laissait penser les photos. Vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés

Very nice location, extremely central and still quiet*, and funky in a very Berlin style.

* quiet on the one day where there was no building work. The other 4 days noise started at 7:30 am every day with workers right in front of the windows.

This place is perfect! Amazing value, less than 1 minute from the train and it is a beautiful new apartment with vintage and classy decor! I highly recommend this place and the communication from the host is great. A+, 10/10!!
Great place to near the Center of Berlin

De Airbnb is meer n hotel. Veel kleiner dan verwacht. De code deed t op een gegeven moment niet meer. Beddengoed voor de slaapbank was er niet, en na t gevraagd te hebben is t ook nooit gekomen. Slaapbank is extreem oncomfortabel…

The apartment was incredible, very clean and comfortable and well located, and Lena was a fantastic host! She was very flexible with our check in and check out, and very kind and responsive. The neighborhood is great, and the apartment was a lovely home away from home for a few days. No A/C, but because it's in a basement it stayed comfortably cool the entire time, even though we were there in July.
Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Berlin und haben uns in dem Apartment sehr wohlgefühlt. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

We had a great stay at Daniel’s place, the apartment was great value, clean and comfortable with everything that we needed for 5 people. Communication was great and very friendly and the basement luggage storage round the corner was very helpful. we took a couple of Dan’s suggestions for cafes and restaurants that he helpfully left in the guide book and all were great, we had a great time in the city - a little out of the centre but so accessible by subway. Tempelhofer park is also right round the corner and a must see.
This is our second stay (5years apart), and our stay was just as welcoming and the whole apartment is just so perfect.

Pobyt jsme si užili. Byt je celkem velký. Jedná velká centrální místnost jako kuchyň, obývací pokoj a při 6 lidech i jako ložnice (rozkládací gauč). Pak 1 větší a 1 menší ložnice. Everything great and according to the description, great location, great communication with the host, highly recommend the place!

Great place and location

We stayed at Tuncays for the Euros. The accomodation was very nice. Clean and modern fittings and washing a great size for the 3 of us. Easy self check in and out. Didn't look like there was many bars/ restaurants close by but with how easy the SBAN and UBANs are in Berlin this wasn't an issue as could easily explore else where. Would definitely recommend if looking for a short stay trip in Berlin

L’appartement est très bien situé; métro, supérette, bars et street food à proximité immédiate qui en fait un endroit très pratique et au calme à la fois. Spacieux et confortable, il faut juste se faire au fonctionnement de la salle de bain qui est peu commun !
Les hôtes sont disponibles et réactifs, que du positif de ce AirBnB !
bel appartement, hôte réactif, attentif, agréable et bienveillant.
Great stay. A shower curtain and towel rack or place to put your clothes without them getting wet would have been good but overall nice stay

It is close to public transportation.  It is a very silent neighbourhood and safe. As a family, we found the apartment really clean and convenient. The host was very helpful. The furniture was sufficient and comfortable.
Nice. Warm. Welcoming. Excellent location. Recommended.
Einfachste Unterkunft für geringste Ansprüche.
appartement décoré avec goût, rien ne manque; de nombreux livres et jeux disponibles et un accueil chaleureux; accès au centre ville facilité avec le S-bahn et le U-bahn
Het verblijf was oke. Alleen de bedden/matrassen waren niet allemaal goed.

An absolutely beautiful apartment, stylish, fun and as camp as can be which is apt, given the building's history.  The owner, Norbert, could not have been more welcoming or  helpful. The area itself is a beautiful part of Schoneberg, a little way away from Nollendorfplatz, but filled with lovely cafes and bars. I can't recommend this place highly enough.

Scher schönes Apartment, sehr sauber, tolle Lage
War eine sehr schöne Zeit in Berlin.

Excellent location only about 3 minutes walk from Alexanderplatz. All transport options available from Alexanderplatz. Approx 30 min walk down Unter den Linden to Brandenburg Gate. Well appointed apartment.

Highly recommend staying here! We arrived in Berlin in the morning, but were able to store our luggage in lockers which was so helpful. The location of this apartment is amazing. We most enjoyed walking around the neighborhood exploring places with street art. The apartment itself was very roomy and clean and allowed us to have a nice comfortable stay during our extensive euro trip. Stella answered messages quickly and was so helpful with recommendations. Highly recommend staying in her apartment!
Atto's place is in a beautiful neighborhood with lots to do. The studio is very well equipped and cozy. Everything was great and Atto is very very kind.

Nous sommes venue pour 9 jours a Berlin.

The hostess was friendly and considerable. The place had all the essentials for cooking. The balcony was amazing! It was really nice to start my morning there with coffee, book and cozy warm weather and sunshine.
Nearby were lots of choises for takeout and all public transport varietes were also ~ 10 minutes walk away.
Excellent location, and nice modern clean apartment. Would definitely stay here again!
Appartement très agréable et vraiment bien situé.
This is a great apartment grom shock you can discover Berlin. Lots of great bars and restaurants in je neighborhood!

Sparkling clean, stylish, modern. Very helpful staff.
A bit further out of the city than I expected but was not a problem for me, I cycled all over Berlin. Great stay, I recommend.

Had a great time staying in this apartment! Everything was there that we needed, and any queires were responded to quickly.
Highly recommend!!
Great stay, loved the location and great communication with the host. Thank you!

We had a good stay at Eugen's place.  The location was very good (2 minutes walk to subway station).  The property was clean, functional and practical and our requests (like requesting for a fan) were attended to promptly.  Would love to stay at Eugen's place again if and when we revisit Berlin.

Sven's apartment was great! The furniture was very modern, the kitchen was beautiful, and the place was spotless. Sven was very communicative and made check-in and check-out easy. It's very easy to walk places from the apartment as well.
The apartment was great, perfect communication! Thanks!

Simone was so kind and thoughtful from day one of booking the apartment. Offering us loads of advice, allowing us to check in early after a 6am flight and messaging throughout our trip too! The apartment itself is stunning, spotless and modern and in the perfect area for seeing everything Berlin has to offer. The street is nice and quiet but just a few minutes walk from a large supermarket, metro stops and a lovely big park.

Prima appartement. Appartement ligt aan straatkant op begane grond. Daardoor wel veel geluid van verkeer op straat. Desondanks hebben we goed geslapen. Upon arrival, Martins place was exactly like the listing. A nice size apartment with a cozy balcony.

Very Nice appartment, close To the Center, Thank you for the Nice stay

Great apartment, cosy but enough space even for a bigger family. Apartment even had some toys and kids loved having their own room. Anahita ist ein sehr liebenswerter, herzlicher Mensch! Ich wünsche ihr das Allerbeste 🌹

Very conveniently located and pristinely kept place, with great public transport links to airport and the city centre (West Berlin/Zoo/KuDamm). Frau Neumann was a very kind host and the bed was very comfy.

Very clean and organised room exactly as pictures.

Pablo warmly welcomed us and gave some well-tailored advice. We would go back anytime!

Welcome to Berlin! This was my first visit to the city and I have 3 words, Location, Location, Location! This flat is located in the Mitte section of the city and is about a 5 minute walk to Alexanderplatz and the Berlin TV Tower! There is a U-bahn station and tram stop steps from the front door. Stephanie was great to allow us to check in a little early, and the flat was clean and accurate to the pictures. The heated floor in the bathroom is a bonus too! If I were to visit Berlin again I would stay here again for sure!

In dieser netten Unterkunft zentral in Charlottenburg gelegen in einer ruhigen Straße, in guter Erreichbarkeit multipelste gastronomischer Angebote sowie öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel in alle Richtungen haben wir als Familie vier äußerst entspannte und schöne Tage verbracht. Very nice and comfy beds!

Michael's apartment is absolutely amazing - spacious with very high ceilings and well decorated. It is located in a great part of Kreuzberg with easy access to multiple U-bahn stops as well as buses. Michael was very helpful in providing maps and information regarding attractions and local transportation. I had a great time in Berlin and having a great home-base with Michael's apartment made it that much better. Would definitely stay here again given the opportunity to come back!

Daniele and Patrizia’s house is a really nice place to stay in Berlin. It has everything you need. The house is very cozy, well organized and very beautiful.
It has a good localization. You can go to the town easily by bus.
We’ve loved spending our time there.

We really enjoyed our week in Berlin and the apartment. We appreciated the fast communication and that our hosts took good care and gave us tips about Berlin. Nice apartment, perfect location, clean and well equipped. Couldn't be better! Danke!

Super für den Preis. Viel Platz, ruhig und gut ausgestattet. Wir waren uns vorher unsicher, ob es an der Straße oder in einer Parkanlage liegt, das war etwas irritierend. Wir haben es so verstanden, dass man bei geschlossenen Fenstern schlafen muss. Dafür gibt es Klimaanlage und Luftreiniger - was wir nicht so gerne mögen. Alles in allem empfehlenswert.

Beschreibung trifft voll zu, Preis - Leistung stimmt, Gastgeberin geht auf alle Wünsche ein, gute Anbindung an die Innenstadt, Discounter in der Nähe.
Sehr ruhige Lage.

Very happy to have spent the last nights of our vacation here!

It was nice place to stay in Berlin, very comfortable and cozy, everything you need:) Marcello is amazing host. Thank you!

Awesome room on a tremendous location. Friendly and Nice host.
Fantastic apartment, very clean!
Very nice flat in good location

A perfect place for two! We experienced the very best of Berlin in this centrally located apartment. The area is very safe and located near trendy restaurants, bars, and shopping. The apartment itself boats a well-equipped kitchen, beautiful spacious bathroom, and perfect bedroom. We couldn't have been happier with the stay; everything you need and close to anything you could want to experience in Berlin.

Place was great, just keep in mind there is no AC so need to keep the window open. Also the pillow is not very comfortable, felt cheap. Other than that, excellent location, communication and comfortable bed

We really liked Ahmed's place, it's exactly as announced! Well located, right in front a beautifull park, walk distance from the most famous sightseeing and it is also near from train station and bus stop.

Perfectly located and quiet apartment. Dominik is also a friendly host! We definitely recommend.
Great location and convenient accommodations.

Herzliche, unkomplizierte, weltoffene Eigentümerin die in der einen Wohnungshälfte Zimmer mit eigenem Bad vermietet. Die Küche in der Mitte ist der Begegnungsort. Gute Mischung zwischen Privatsphäre und netten Zufallsgesprächen.
The room is quite small, but the apartment is nice (if she lets you walk around it). She might not have the wifi password (you should ask beforehand).

Doerthe met us at the given time at the apartment. As our train was running late, she waited for us to arrive. She was extremely kind and helpful. She got a translator along with her as she understood very little English and we did not understand German. The apartment was beautiful and the same and better than the pictures and the description. The 2 big bedrooms were very well kept and while there was only 1 washroom, it did not hurt us as it was big and beautiful. She showed us around the place and helped us with all that we needed to know.
The neighborhood was great too. It was a 4-5 min walk to the nearest metro and 2 mins walk to lots of nice cafes, restaurants, stores, supermarket etc.
very nice and clean spot. the place got everything that you need. the location is super and you got free parking spots.
Great place to stay to check out Berlin: close to city centre but also pleasant and quiet surroundings. Apartment was very tidy and has great kitchen and bathroom.

Hans place is recently renovated. It is cosy, comfortable and stylish. We had a very nice couple of days there. The terrace is a great place to relax. Hans was very helpful and friendly. He shared some very good experiences with us.
Et fantastisk dejligt grønt get-away tæt på centrum

Super Lage, gut mit ÖV angebunden. Die Wohnung ist schön, gross und ruhig. Küche top eingerichtet u das Bad war modern. Auch das Bett war wunderbar. Tom war sehr freundlich! Ich würde wieder hier buchen.

Atto’s place was the best! Check in was super easy and he was very communicative and friendly. The place was very clean and cozy, we loved sitting out on the balcony and reading. The location is hard to beat. It’s on a great street with lots of shops, restaurants and cafes while still being really quiet. It’s also a short walk from the tram and U Bahn. We would definitely stay here again.

Wir waren bestens zufrieden! Sehr cooles Appartement und ein sehr aufmerksamer Gastgeber. Es verlief alles absolut reibungslos ohne dass man hätte meckern können.

Eine sehr gute Gastgeberin. Die Wohnunh ist super die Lage. Nur das Internet ist nicht für Digital Nomade geeignet sonst alles super!

We had a lovely stay at Mia's flat! It's in a great neighborhood of Berlin with lots of bars and restaurants nearby. It is also very well connected and easy to explore the city from. Mia was also very helpful and friendly. We would definitely recommend! :)
Logement humide, pas de rideau dans le salon, couette pas assez chaude cependant logement propre et bien situé
