Appartement proche des commerces et du métro.
Seul gros inconvénient, la qualité des matelas qui est absolument à revoir pour les deux lits.

The apartment is as described. Ulf was a great host. The location is convenient - a 15 minute walk to Pankow train station, several bars and restaurants very close by, as well as having a grocery store nearby.

Marie war eine gute Gastgeberin. Schöne Wohnung, gute Lage. Alles prima, immer wieder gerne. Einzig der Fön, in der Ausstattung als vorhanden, hat gefehlt.  Naja, man muss auch mal improvisieren können. :)
Appartement spacieux et confortable, conforme à la description. Non loin des transports en commun. Accueil très sympathique . Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Berlin. Je recommande!

Nice apartment in a neighbourhood that is at the same time quiet and has all the shops and food places in walking distance. The underground is also just around the corner.
The apartment is pretty much as described. Just be aware that all beds are in a common space separated just by a doorway and hence with no door or other phonic isolation. Beds are excelent. Bath is on the smaller side, but quite sufficient.
Lots of power plugs / USB plugs. WiFi is workable, but sometimes on the slower side.
Highly recommended, we would gladly stay again.
Die Unterkunft war sehr schön und sauber. Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt in der Wohnung sehr genossen. Die Wohnung liegt in einem schönen und ruhigen Quartier.

Great spacious apartment in a cool location not far from famous hip restaurant areas in the city, an artists' hub & a Soviet memorial & park. It has something for everyone. Libor was very easy-going in communication and quick to respond as well.
We enjoyed our stay!

My girlfriend and myself had a great time at Marius place. The place is well furnished in a good spot. It has an easy access to both UBahn (U2) and SBahn - AlexanderPlatz and Jannowitzbrücke. It's also close to the Mercedes Benz Arena (only two stops). Lidl store is located just by the Jannowitzbrücke, which is about 4mins to walk.
Unusual is a location of a toilet (outside of the apartment), it's a medieval house. Stralauer Straße can be noisy for a light sleeper and the wifi connection was really slow so I'd not recommend for a business trip.
A great place for a short stay in Berlin. In a great area, easily walkable from Berlin and well served by public transport. Highly recommended

Cool design, located in a nice area!
We particularly liked the communication with the host and the heated floor in the bathroom.
Also the kitchen had everything we needed, the bed is comfortable as well.
If I were to change soemthing, would be the floor in the appartment. It gets quite cold during winter. I would also change the windows to make it possible to open it without fearing somebody will get inside.
I would not be so picky about these things if we weren't travelling with a crawling baby 🙈
Other than that, I recommend this place! ☺️

Wir sind echt gerne gast im Apartment No. 1 gewesen!
Das Apartment ist solide ausgestattet, die Lage könnte etwas besser sein.
Die Kommunikation vorher war sehr informativ, vollumfänglich und nett.
Wirkliche Probleme hatten wir nicht, daher kann ich eigentlich nur die normale Kommunikation bewerten.
Kann man echt gut machen!

Ich selbst war nicht Gast, sondern mein Sohn mit Freunden. Die Jungs berichteten sehr positiv von von Singer Hostel Berlin, insofern möchte ich diese Unterkunft im Namen meines Sohnes gerne weiterempfehlen.
Very spacious and nice apartment, quite by night, recommended to all travellers!
alles wunderbar!
It was the first time we rented a room, not the whole apartment , and I can say that it was unique in every way. I suggest

My boyfriend and I stayed at Linda’s place just for Valentine’s Day/ weekend. When we arrived Linda had left us a little gift in the fridge, which was very thoughtful. The apartment is really impressive, such a great use of space and we enjoyed people watching. Linda is super easy to communicate with and we had no issues at all. Wish we could have stayed longer!

Great location to get to and from the airport very easy on public transport (one stop on frequent X7 and X71 buses). You can also walk from accommodation to U-Bahn to get into Berlin.
Room and bathroom immaculately clean. Also nice space outside to sit at the end of the day sightseeing. I sat outside reading and my host saw me and very kindly brought a blanket in case i wanted to stay out as it got cooler.
Dejlig altan med fin udsigt 👍
Konumu harika olmasının yanısıra her şeyiyle mükemmeldi .
Super sympathischer Typ! War alles wie beschrieben ohne Probleme.
Top, nette Vermieter, zentral gelegen und eine sehr schöne Wohnung.
Alles easy & ok!
Incredible place, hugely spacious, well kitted out with piano, trampoline, games, garden. Wonderful!
supermysigt och trevligt boende och ett tryggt område!

Julians studio was spacious, very clean and tidy, very modern and stylish. Had all the amenities I needed and was in a great location. Communication was incredibly easy. I highly suggest this property and Julian as a host :) Thank you!

very friendly & responsive. would advise anybody wanting to stay in a home away from home to book this apartment.
She communicated everything perfectly.
Only thing to take into consideration is that, just like many apartments in Germany, you will need to walk up multiple flights of stairs. So pack light or make sure you have someone along who can haul your luggage upstairs
We had a great stay at Anca's apartment in Berlin. Clean, cozy, and easily accessible to the rest of Kreuzburg and beyond. It was the perfect launch pad for our trip.

The little apartment is in a quiet neighborhood. I enjoyed the terrace towards the courtyard. The apartment is functional and everything worked well. Jakob was very responsive when I had questions.
It’s furnishing is rather plain and a few additional details could make if feel more homey but it works well for a short-term stay.
Lovely place, great location, all you could ask for. Only concern was the steep stairs but we managed fine.
Wunderschönes zentral gelegenes Appartment
Reception desk was very helpful.
Es war insgesamt ein toller Aufenthalt. Die Lage ist super!!

Chris ist ein bemühter und freundlicher Gastgeber.
Die Unterkunft ist klein, aber gut geteilt und sauber.
Kochen sollte man sich zwar nicht vornehmen, eine Basisausstattung zum Essen wärmen ist jedoch vorhanden.
Das haus ist sehr hellhörig und umtriebig in der Nacht.
Aber für einen geschäftlichen Aufenthalt würde ich auf jeden Fall wieder hier wohnen.
el departamento es muy lindo, tal cual se  ve en las fotos. muy bien ubicado.
War alles top

This apartment was absolutely perfect for my stay in Berlin. To be honest, it exceeded my expectations. It was incredibly clean and exactly as described in the listing. The location is perfect for exploring the area and the rest of Berlin and the neighborhood is beautiful. Marcus is super helpful and very responsive. Check-in was a breeze. I’m very sad that I had to leave a little earlier than expected but I hope to return someday!
Lovely apartment, close to lots of places we wanted to go.
Gut geschnittene Wohnung.

Perfect for a long weekend in Berlin ! The flat is perfect according to the description
Close to city center, nearby tramway subway and buses ! Communication with Sharon was super clear ! I recommand, thanks :)
Beau logement. Très belle maison avec un beau jardin de fleurs. Ursula a été une hôte très gentille et attentionnée. Tout était propre !
Perfectly fine!
Netter Kontakt & schönes Zimmer, gerne wieder :)
Appartement agréable et bien situé.

Sehr zentral und schön eingerichtetes Apartment. Wir haben 3 Tage zu viert im Apartment übernachtet und haben uns rundum wohl gefühlt. Nächstes Jahr kommen wir definitiv wieder. Besten Dank für die tolle vorab Kommunikation, der unkomplizierte Check-in als auch die Sauberkeit des Apartments.
Schönes kleines Appartment! Wir werden es im Bedarfsfalle gern wieder buchen! Kommunikation verlief zügig und unkompliziert!
Modern apartment, great location. Host was well prepared. We had a great stay, thank you!

Très belle expérience. Appartement superbe, accueillant, élégant et calme. Et spacieux, mon fils a d'ailleurs pu s'amuser est profiter de l'espace qu'offre cet appartement. Nous sommes surtout ravi d'avoir fait la rencontre d'Alex, une personne vraiment sympathique.
Werner is such a great host, and the place is clean and comfortable.

Aufenthalt bei Carolin ist vom Gefühl wie eignen WG (wo im Vergangenheit haben die Künstler-innen einiges erlebt)
Das war echt angenehm zwischen City Tour Vormittags und Konzerten am Abends dazwischen Möglichkeit zu haben Kochen, Chillen, Kaffe trinken und Buch Lesen und immer wieder mit jemandem Smalltalk zu haben.
Ich kann mir vorstellen nächste mal den ort wieder zu besuchen.
Liebe Grüße

L’alloggio rispetta perfettamente la descrizione e le foto. Pulito ed ordinato. Consigliato per persone in forma e sportive visto che per raggiungere l’appartamento ci sono da fare 4 rampe di scale molto ripide con i bagagli a seguito.

Man kam Abends/Nachts nicht mehr ins Gebäude, die servicenummer, die angeblich 24/7 besetzt sein sollte, war nicht zu erreichen. Nur durch den Zufall, dass ein Bewohner des Hauses eben jenes im selben Moment verlassen wollte als wir rein wollten (3 Uhr nachts), mussten wir nicht auf der Straße schlafen. No go.
Buen anfitrión, el lugar es agradable, solo el edificio tiene un olor raro en los pasillos, dentro del departamento todo ok!

Mona und ihre Familie sind unglaublich gastfreundlich und sehr hilfsbereit. Wir wurden mit den weltbesten selbstgebackenen Keksen empfangen und haben und in dem orientalisch eingerichteten Zimmer direkt wohl gefühlt. Die Familie ist warmherzig und sympathisch. Wir haben gerne im schönem Garten gefrühstückt und die grüne Umgebung sehr genossen.
Wir würden den Aufenthalt sofort wieder buchen! Vielen Dank für die Gastfreundschaft!

Die Unterkunft war klein aber fein. Wir hatten aber mit 2 Erwachsenen und 2 Kindern genügend Platz dort und haben die Gegend an der Havel sehr genossen. Zudem sind wir täglich nach Berlin mit dem Schnellbus gefahren, was etwa 25 Minuten dauerte. Die Gastgeber waren super nett & unkompliziert und waren bei Fragen stets ansprechbar. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und hatte alles, was man braucht. Auch Einkaufsmöglichkeiten waren schnell erreichbar. Wir können die Wohnung nur weiter empfehlen!!!
It was great, just what we needed. Well placed with a lot of thing todo close by

We have spent a very pleasant long week-end at Claudia&Steffen's. We haven't seen them in person but everything was well organized.
The apartment is situated in a very nice neighborhood full of bars, restaurants, shops and metro stations. It is equipped and nicely designed.

Miriam est très réactive et précise dans ses messages. L’arrivée se fait sans problème, l’appartement est petit, agréable, tout à fait suffisant pour une découverte de Berlin pour une personne. Il est très bien équipé et bien placé. A recommander !

The location could not be better.  The apartment is near all the tourist sites and there are fabulous restaurants within walking distance.  The apartment is large and sunny.  Anna and Peter were responded to us quickly and they were very helpful.  The bakery downstairs topped off a wonderful travel experience.
Cozy place. Great location.

Sehr nette kleine Kellerwohnung im Herzen des Bergmannkietzes.
Super angebunden und direkt neben der belebten Bergmannstraße.
Die Vermieterin Uta ist ebenfalls sehr freundlich und für Fragen immer gut erreichbar.
Würde hier auf jeden Fall nochmal residieren :)

What a great place to stay in Berlin! The location is amazing and literally across the street from a Christmas Market. Easy to navigate and get around and great restaurants and a grocery store within walking distance. Louisa and Casper were super responsive and helpful. Great place for kids too!
The place was nice and clean, the location was good and Nicola was super nice and welcoming!
Very nice and welcoming environment!
Gute Basis für einen tollen Berlin Aufenthalt
Very comfortable place with aircon and central location

Lamentablemente no tengo los idiomas Aleman e Inglés solo Español, pero nos ayudamos un montón con el traductor para hacer todo mucho mas fácil, Monika es una gran persona y anfitriona esta atenta ayudar en todo desde mi llegada hasta mis últimos minutos fue la mejor en su segunda profesión de anfitriona.
Gracias mil Gracias Monika y si vuelvo a Berlín no dudaré en hospedarme contigo de nuevo.
Great Hostel! Super central right Next to Alexanderplatz and very tidy with beautiful interior! Highly recommended!!

Beautiful days in Peter's apartment. Comfortable, quiet neighbour, friendly communication, spacious, private , good internet.
Same as photos.
Happy to come back , totally recommend
Top Wohnung in ruhiger Lage mit guter Anbindung. Kann ich weiterempfehlen :)
Wunderbar im Südwesten der Stadt ruhig gelegen. Zur U-Bahn und den Geschäften muss man allerdings ein paar Minuten laufen. Mehrere Museen und der Grunewald sind gut zu erreichen.
Excellent spot not far from the city center! Quite, cozy and clean. Vietnamese restaurant downstairs!  Highly recommended
Chris ist ein sehr guter Gastgeber und die Wohnung ist eine der schönsten Airbnb Unterkünfte, in der ich bisjetzt war :)
A great property in an excellent location.  We were able to walk to a lot of areas with some local restaurants and shops in easy walking distance
sehr gute Lage, bequeme Wohnung mit guter Ausstattung.
We had a lovely stay at this house, it was very clean and they were kind and welcoming. We loved the layout of the room and the facilities were great!
Reibungsloser, flexibler Check-In, schöne geräumige Wohnung in bester Lage! Sauber und gepflegt. Komme gerne wieder.

Our stay was really nice. The kitchen is fully equipped with all the cooking utensils, there is a coffee machine and orange juice maker, toaster and gas cooker.
Living room is large: has furniture and music player, and downstairs in the basement there is a spacious bedroom.
All was good, place is lived in, real and authentic with a selection of paintings on the walls.
The only comment is about the Internet. We were looking for a flat in Berlin and doing general research for our stay. It was very slow. It kept going on and off and it took us way longer to do something that could take a few minutes because of interruptions. But if you get an extension from Aldi that is down the road - you could be ok.
The place is conveniently placed near Mitte with easy access to all parts of Berlin.
All food and convenience stores are around. Claudia was very quick to respond and communicate with.
I would recommend Claudia's place for stay, it is a great size for a price, just the internet needs a bit of an upgrade.
Lovely apartment, local to the station & access to the city & to local bars and restaurants.
Uma das melhores hospedagens do AIRBNB. O apartamento tem de tudo, inclusive azeite, café, especiarias. Muito completo e pertinho do metrô !
A wonderful and considerate host and a beautiful apartment!

I used to live in this area of Berlin une I was glad to come back for a week. The appartement has a really good location and is brand new renovated. Martin is a trustful person ! I recommend this flat.
Beautiful place in my fave area of Berlin. It’s clean and super quiet. Also the bed is really comfortable. Couldn’t think of a better place to stay tbh. Thank you Kevin!

Wir haben Ursulas Zimmer als Basis für verschiedene Radtouren in Berlin genommen. Der Empfang war sehr warmherzig und hilfsbereit. Ursula hatte bereits Pläne vorbereitet, in denen die nächsten Haltestellen für die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel markiert waren. Es war ein rundum gelungener Aufenthalt, den wir gerne noch einmal wiederholen.

Die Unterkunft war sauber, gut gelegen und entsprach in weiten Teilen der Beschreibung. Der Gastgeberin war freundlich und gut erreichbar, der Check-in unkompliziert. Besonders positiv hervorzuheben sind die ruhige Lage und das gemütliche Ambiente der Wohnung.
Allerdings war der Preis für die Reinigung für eine Nacht Aufenthalt (50 €) etwas hoch.
Insgesamt hatten wir dennoch einen angenehmen Aufenthalt und können die Unterkunft weiterempfehlen.
Hat alles super geklappt :)

Ivos Wohnung ist der Knaller.
Perfekte Lage, alles da was man benötigt und blitzsauber.
Die Kommunikation läuft schnell und unkompliziert.
Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und werde bei meinem nächsten Berlin Besuch sicher wieder hier übernachten.
Vielen Dank, Ivos!

Oliver's place is awesome. Easy location and relaxed a host: the perfect combination. We had a great time learning about baseball and the life of a sports editor. We felt very much at home, with great facilities, close to shops and restaurants and an easy walk to the Sbahn with connections to the centre of Berlin in 10 minutes. We couldn't have asked/wished for more. Would not hesitate to recommend!

Wir waren zu sechst bei Anna und haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt. Die zentrale Lage ist toll, um viele Sightseeing Highlights zu Fuss zu erkunden. Die Wohnung ist gross und hell und schön eingerichtet.
Vielen Dank für die schöne Zeit in Berlin!
Bien situé, facile d'arrivée même tardivement (boite à clé). Confort correct, pas très cosy.

The apartment is great, big comfortable rooms and perfectly equipped, in a quiet building and very good location, a lively area plenty of restaurants and shops. We stayed for 2 weeks and felt like at home. Michael was very helpful and easy to contact.

Very nice place, comfortable. Neighbourhood very exciting. Cleanliness ok, dust coming in from construction not their fault.. Kitchen needed some additions like frying pen for example. Logistics with key, check in and check out worked fine. When we moved in a neighbour shouted at us it is not legal to sublet etc. We suggest the host ans AirBnB make sure things like that don't happen .

The location is historic, the Berlin Wall was located in this street. Very tidy and clean / much space (I experienced the space to be larger than it seemed in the photos), quiet area with lovely bird sounds in the morning and during the day. Communication with Bettina was very easy. All gear in kitchen was present. Would love to visit again.
Superb spot. No complaints. Will almost certainly stay here again in the future.

The location couldn't have been better, whether you're travelling for business or for sight seeing. Room was comfy (the bed, especially!) and the check-in seamless – contactless check-in done right! Best part was that the coffee, tea and snacks were all thoughtfully sourced and really high-end. I'll be back! Thank you

Room was okay. Depends on what you’re after. If your traveling to Berlin to go sightseeing the flat is too far away from anything. Additionally the flat is on the bottom floor and when opening the window it felt like we were in a display room. Wasn’t our ideal stay but could be good for anyone looking to stay in that specific area but would not suggest more than 2 people as there’s not enough space once the other bed is rolled out. Host was accommodating and responded promptly.
A great stay with Katja, would recommend
Lovely topfloor apartment in a really nice neighborhood. Robin was very helpful and easy to contact!

Highly overpriced, noisy, you can hear every whisper from the hallway. Walls are dirty, the bed is hard the blankets are so thin they seem not to exist. The communication is rather stressful, you get texts and notifications non stop e.g. for the time you have to leave the apartment. Also it's non of their buisness what train or flight you will be taking. Cannot recomend.

Mein Mann und ich haben eine Woche in dieser liebevoll eingerichteten Laube mit einem wunderschönen Garten bei bestem Wetter mit unserem Vizsla-Rüden den Urlaub genossen. Mit der in Fußweite erreichbaren Fähre sind wir häufig auf die andere Seite der Spree gewechselt und haben am Ufer entlang verschiedene Biergärten ausprobiert. Es hat uns sehr gut gefallen und wir kommen gerne wieder!

Denise & Jürgen's place is just as described. Really well located, clean and cozy. Communication with Denise was easy and she was very kind to offer up a few tips for restaurants and was very flexible with our check-in/check-out.
Thanks again!
Nadia

Location of the apartment was quite convenient with a lot of cafes and restaurants around. The description of the place matches what we experienced and wasn't a disappointment in any way. Though it would be nice to have some ventilation in the apartment through a fan or an air conditioning system as it does tend to get really claustrophobic and hot during summers and in the day. The entire building had a positive vibe to it though. Enjoyed our stay there.

A lovely space, well located and well described - very quiet building, and plenty of great space. Was immaculate on arrival and hosts provided great suggestions for the neighborhood and check in was easy and convenient. Highly recommended!

Great stay at the house, which was clean and airy. Super easy connection with different public transport… bus, U bahn and S bahn. Big bathroom and very good water pressure. So definitely a good option if you plan on staying in Berlin.

We had an excellent stay at the apartment! It was exactly as described. Extremely clean and Douglas was very responsive and helpful. The area can be a bit loud at night (like most places in Berlin) but we brought earplugs for sleeping which helps if you’re a light sleeper! The wifi didn’t work very well except on the patio but other than that we really enjoyed the apartment and it is in an awesome location. Would definitely recommend it!
Super schön eingerichtet und sehr zentral in Friedrichshain:)

Sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit beim Check-in.
Gute Erreichbarkeit durch 2 Handynummern.
Gute Grundausstattung in der Küche vorhanden (inkl. Kaffee und Spülmaschinentabs)
Location is close to the Metro which is nice! Clean apartment, communication could have been better.
It’s a nice location to explore Berlin! There was some construction work outside, at our side of the building. So there was noise from 7am onwards.

Thanks Siggi, we enjoyed our time in Berlin and your place was comfortable for our 3 day stay.
Jacqui n Phil🌻
Wonder location and very accommodating hosts. Would deffinitly recommend 🙌
Sehr nette Gastgeber.  Habe mich sehr willkommen gefühlt. Man ist schnell in der City und hat gleichzeitig eine sehr ruhige Unterkunft.

I had a great stay at Penelope's while I was in town to run the marathon - it's an interesting neighbourhood and very well connected to easily access all the tourist areas. Plenty of shops and restaurants right on the doorstep and overall a very comfortable stay. Thanks Penelope!
Very good location, responsive host, easy to check in and find the flat.

L'appartement de Rainer a un charme fou, celui d'un lieu de vie où on sent toute l'attention qu'a son propriétaire pour les meubles, la déco, l'ambiance design. Un magnifique espace qui se mérite tout en haut de l'immeuble, mais avec en récompense, une terrasse superbe, au calme pour prendre un verre tout en profitant des couchers de soleil. De grandes pièces lumineuses et des équipements et linges de maison de qualité.
Le métro et le tram sont accessibles très facilement pour se déplacer dans cette immense ville et les alentours. Dommage pour les vélos que Rainer vient de se faire voler, mais qu'on peut louer un peu partout dans la ville. Un lieu d'exception.
Klein aber fein - für ein paar Tage für ein Paar ideal. Die Lage ist wirklich super!
Good location, clean and tidy apartment! The best thing - balcony with a nice view

Josephine's place was absolutely lovely and she was a pleasure to coordinate with. It had everything we needed, and was a peaceful, comfortable place to end long days of exploring the city. Highly recommended!

ursula’s studio apartment is the perfect place to stay while traveling in berlin. it is presented so beautifully and really feels like a home away from home.
the location is perfect with a u-bahn station 2/3 minute walk around the corner and so many places to visit locally.
communication couldn’t have been easier and checkin/out was a breeze.

Esperienza ottima Appartamento in zona residenziale ed elegante di Berlino. Metropolitana a 7 minuti a piedi per raggiungere il Mitte in 20 minuti. Al nostro arrivo abbiamo trovato fette biscottate, latte marmellata, caffè, the cereali,così da avere già tutto pronto per la colazione. Inoltre la cucina grande è attrezzata ci ha consentito di cucinare. Se dovessi tornare a Berlino tornerei qui. Ci siamo sentiti a casa
Lovely place. Ella was a responsive host and clear communicator. Her home felt cozy with Berlin charm and homey comforts.

PLUSES:stylishly decorated apartment with huge bedrooms . beautiful wooden flooring,plenty of storage space for clothes. Washing machine a great bonus. excellent external metal electric blinds blocks out light when needed. open plan kitchen/ living area spacious and tasteful
In a nice, family neighbourhood with lots of cool bars, cafes and restaurants nearby.
MINUSES: bedrooms at front, ground floor on busy road- noisy at night due to trams, beds not v comfy. No oven but has microwave, 2 rimged hob and big fridge-freezer

Чистая квартира

Единственное я бы добавила кондиционер, нам повезло с погодой в дни нашего прибывания, и было жарковато в квартире, вентилятор не сильно спасал! А вообщем для путешествий, квартира отлично, все равно там не живешь, а только ночуешь! Хозяин дал четкие инструкции проблем по заселению вообще не возникло! Очень благодарны

Жильё расположено в отличном месте, удобно добираться из аэропорта (без пересадок) и близко к центру. Само жильё меньше чем ожидалось и не новое. Очень сильная слышимость от соседей, смыв унитаза работает крайне громко, будил ребёнка. Для младенца нет кроватки и детского стула.

The apartment is lovely, spacious and bright with a fantastic balcony. Located in a quiet residential road and very close to many bars, restaurants and transport links. Was welcomed by Mimi and told about the area and also given some good restaurant tips. The Vietnamese restaurant just over the road is superb. Would definitely return to the apartment on future trips.

Wunderschöne EG Wohnung, sehr sauber und hell, top Lage, schöne Einrichtung, bequeme Betten, viel Platz, gute Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin Nina - immer schnell erreichbar, einfacher Check-in. Haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt

Had such a lovely stay at Nadine & Gabriel's place. We loved how peaceful and open it was and the big table was super helpful for co-working. The apartment has everything you need and more. We really appreciated the flowers and the welcome gestures. The hosts have been super friendly and accomodating. 10/10 recommend!
Danke für den tollen Aufenthalt! Es war wirklich schön bei euch und wir werden euch weiterempfehlen! :) LG Nele, Ayla, Nadine, Marleen und Jennie
Just as described. Really beautiful, spacious apartment and very clean on arrival. 10 minute walk from Ostkreuz station. Would definitely come back!

It was amazing. It felt like a home to me. Garelt is super nice and I can strongly recommend staying here!
Tolle Lage, super Wohnung, alles was man braucht!

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung von Patrick sehr wohl gefühlt! Die Wohnung ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet und die Lage ist perfekt. Wir würden auf jeden Fall wieder die Wohnung mieten und nächstes mal hoffentlich für mehrere Tage:)
Nette gut gelegene Wohnung

Het verblijf was zoals verwacht. Een update van de badkamer zou wenselijk zijn. Het is een beetje primitief om zo onder de douche te gaan met een plastic rolgordijn dat je moet laten zakken om niet alles nat te maken.

Wij hebben zelden zo'n schone accommodatie getroffen. Alles was aanwezig in deze ruime studio. Isra was heel vriendelijk en behulpzaam. Zij stelde ons op ons gemak bij onze aankomst. Wij hebben echt heel leuk gehad in haar verblijf.
Flat was even better than pictures show, Prasad was extremely helpful and communicative, coffering advice about the local area and being patient with our booking. Would certainly recommend.
Marcus fue muy amable y el lugar era muy lindo
Nice small well furnished apartment.  Only disadvantage is tram passing right under the window.
Great place in good location

He estado en la casa de Susanna 1 mes completo en Berlín. Mi estancia ha ido a  la perfeccion, incluso mejor de lo que cabía esperar. Buscaba una estancia tranquila, algo alejado del centro pero bien comunicada y la he encontrado. Susanna es una host que te da el servicio que ofrece y además te ayuda a que tu estancia en Berlín sea mejor. Muchas gracias Susanna por tu hospitalidad el buen trato. Espero volver por Berlín y visitarte!!!

Katja was a great host, waiting up late for my arrival and extending my checkout time on the day I left as nobody was staying in the room the following night. Also, a lovely room and an amazing location, right on the canal. Definitely would recommend for anyone checking out Berlin!

Sadly, I was here for only a little bit of time before having to leave due to the coronavirus lockdown. I was supposed to stay a month but it didn’t turn out that way😢. The location is perfect. It was just a couple of minutes walk to multiple grocery stores and bio markets. The restaurant selection is so numerous. I loved how diverse the food options were and I took advantage of it before they started to close down! Parking is all along the neighborhood and it’s about one euro an hour (you can probably find a parking garage if staying longer), but free on Sundays. The tram is literally across the street with access to the S-bahn, and if you need a taxi, the taxi stand is just outside the door. The location is also perfectly safe and comfortable at night. As a woman who planned to stay there a month alone, I felt that the neighborhood was a place I could walk freely into the late evening with no issues.
I didn’t want to end the review without saying anything about the host. Even though I didn’t see Verde face-to-face, she was easy to contact and very kind about things happening due to the COVID circumstances. She also left some beer in the fridge and had a lot of great recommendations on her chalk wall for restaurants. She included little touches throughout the apartment I did not expect such as books about Berlin, a sewing kit, shampoo, cleaning supplies, coffee, teas, and haribo gummy bears on the bed. If there are any days available to book this place and you intend to experience Berlin in comfort, I would not hesitate to book this apartment.

I can’t say enough good things about our stay here! I’ll try not to ramble.
BOOKING/RESERVATION: We ended up booking this apartment on the day of arrival because our other airbnb reservation fell through at the last moment due to some extenuating circumstances (Air bnb staff were also very helpful in this process). Needless to say, however, it was a pretty stressful morning trying to figure everything out but as soon as we found this apartment it all fell into place perfectly. It is operated by a staff that is readily available and very welcoming. One of our only hesitations in booking the place was the 3pm check-in time since we were arriving by car and didn’t want to leave all of our luggage in the car for hours, but they quickly reassured us that we could drop our luggage off early. It turned out that our apartment was ready 2 hours early and they immediately let us know so we could check in then.
CHECKING IN/INITIAL IMPRESSION: A very smooth process. They message you the code (it is the same to access the building and the apartment) and you just go in! Upon arrival, the extra pull-out bed in the kitchen was all set up since there were three of us. There were some complimentary chocolates and drinks awaiting us.
APARTMENT: The apartment was sparkling clean and very nicely decorated. We really enjoyed the balcony. The pull-out bed was one of the most comfortable pull-outs I’ve slept on (it’s still a pull-out bed, but as these things go it was nice). Everything really is just as described!
PARKING/LOCATION: We were able to find street parking right across the street. It is 1€/hr, BUT free on Sundays, so it ended up being cheaper (not to mention more convenient) for us to park there versus the parking lot that a lot of other reviews mention. In the midst of trying to figure parking out, we went into a couple of the nearby shops to ask for help and all of the owners/workers were super helpful as well (one even came out to the parking meter with us). The street itself is beautiful and the area around it has a lot to offer and is worth exploring. It’s about a 5-10 minute walk to public transportation, depending on what you’re taking.
COMMUNICATION: Someone from the rental company greeted us in person shortly after our arrival to make sure everything was going okay and someone followed up via message the next day as well to see if we needed anything. They were always prompt in replying.
EXTRAS: They provide shampoo, conditioner and shower gel (they’re vegan, if that’s important to you!). There was also coffee, tea, some powdered creamer available, dishwashing soap and brushes, extra toilet paper and towels.
Overall, a fantastic stay and I would definitely recommend it to anyone traveling to Berlin!

Vi njöt av vår tid i det mysiga och livfulla Friedrichshain. Ivo var en bra värd, allt man kan önska sig. Vi uppskattade särskilt hans trevliga bemötande och de lokala rekommendationer han gav oss.
Recommended, good value for money

Pokój był bardzo ładny i czysty, tak samo łazienka. Lokalizacja fantastyczna- Kreuzberg to wspaniała dzielnica, a airbnb położone było w spokojnej okolicy. Komunikacja z Esther przebiegała bez żadnych problemów. Polecam serdecznie!
Super emplacement tout proche du métro

Es war alles sehr sauber und funktionstüchtig! Emilia ist eine sehr freundliche Gastgeberin und es hat uns an nichts gefehlt! Die Lage ihres Hauses ist in einer sehr schönen und ruhigen Gegend. Miejsce świetne, położone w bardzo spokojnej i malowniczej dzielnicy. Dostęp był bardzo łatwy a instrukcje czytelne. Mieszkanie było bardzo czyste i w pełni wyposażone. Internet szybki i bez problemu można było znaleźć hasło dostępowe. Ogólna ocena 6 :)

Esperienza molto confortevole e unica. L’alloggio è spazioso e nuovo così come descritto, la posizione è perfetta sia per un soggiorno culturale e rilassato che per dedicarsi alla vita notturna berlinese. Mimi è gentile e disponibile.
Liegt sehr zentral und war alles top sauber, gut ausgestattet und gepflegt. Nur zu empfehlen.
It feels like a home away from home! Beds are amazing, decoration is super stylish. Would come back to stay here again without a doubt!
Great location and beautiful room!

Отличный хостел, чистый, с хорошим ремонтом, отличным месторасположением и ценой!
It's really nice place with good location for good price!
Die Unterkunft war genau wie beschrieben. Die Fotos entsprechen der Realität. Mike ist sehr, sehr freundlich und kümmert sich in jeder Hinsicht um seine Gäste. Auf jeden Fall zu empfehlen.

Great apartment with a high service level e.g. coffee pads, soap and even a mobile phone for maps etc, so you feel you are very welcome.  The absolute best location. Louis is the best host - very informative, proactive and helpful. Can very much recommend this place and host.

Great location with some good cafes, bars and restaurants nearby (there is one bar somewhere which plays loud music late, I’m sure it would’ve been ok with the window shut but it was very warm) Check in and out extremely smooth, it’s a very well equipped apartment and very clean. A very good price so close to the city centre.
Nice flat, and a very practical situation. Katarina is very kind and adapt herself to your needs. Don't hesitate to Book this place!

Beautiful room in an even more beautiful apartment. The flat is shared with the host which was not a problem for us at all since we were home quite rarely. The location was also perfect for us in a very cool neighborhood in Kreuzberg.
Would definitely recommend this place and love to come back there 🫶🏻

Bianka was a wonderful host and her place was so lovely. The bed was comfortable, location was walkable to many public transportation options, beautiful location close to the river, and super hospitable host. She provided local recommendations and was always responsive.
Beautifully appointed condo on the 1st floor.   Right in the middle of everything in Berlin.  Enjoyed my stay.

A casa de Phuong e Martín é aconchegante, o quarto é exatamente como o anúncio. O primeiro dia foi para o centro andando (andei por 2 horas) mas a paisagem compensou muito, porém, tem uma estação de metrô bem pertinho. Adorei! Muitas felicidades! Amei Berlim !
Great location, away from the city centre but close to a metro station. A secluded oasis of comfort in the otherwise busy Berlin

Very stylish place with many architectural details in flat located in block on third level. Very quiet and easy in the nearest. Nicole is very friendly and nice. Please note that to Nicole's flat is necessary to go on foot on third level without lift.
Beautiful apartment. Fantastic location with a tram stop at the end of the street.

Great place to stay when you are in Berlin. The flat is wonderfully decorated, the location is by the canal and you have easy access to amazing food places. The communication with the host was friendly and easy. Highly recommend.
Great flat in a great location. Was the perfect home for a weekend in Berlin.

The house suited us (two friends) perfectly. It was nice to return "home" and listen to the blackbird in early evening after exploring Berlin and its surroundings all day long.

Would absolutely recommend this place to anyone going through Berlin. The area was a bit far but still manageable to get around the city from. Andreas was very friendly, responsive, and made sure all the necessities were ready to go in the room! There’s even a kettle and tea. Also the bakery downstairs is a great added bonus. Thanks Andreas!
Erg genoten in Berlijn! Het huis van Markus en Ewa was erg schoon en op een goede locatie. Contact is goed verlopen.
Alles super!

Enough cannot be said about how fantastic Andre's place is AND how fantastic Andre himself is at communicating and catering to every guest need that arises. The light-filled airiness of a Berlin "Dachgeschoss" apartment, i.e., under the roof, with all the skylights, is unsurpassable, as are the great views that come along with it and the superb location close to the city-centre in ever-cool Prenzlauer Berg. Andre was always ready to help out, give advice, even buy new things more than once, to help make our three week stay more comfortable. I cannot wait to come back. Thank you so much again Andre.

When we stay with airbnb first thing we search is the location. So Maja’s flat is in the best location in Berlin we think!:) it is close to where ever you want to go in the center. There are lots of cafes and restaurants .
Flat is very sweet and artistic. We really enjoyed our stay and recommend it to everyone.

Stylish, comfortable apartment in a suburbs where real Berliners live but right next to the Schloss. Buses to tourist centre about 45 mins all in but we enjoyed seeing the city on our way in. Very easy for Tegel (? Spelling Airport). Nice local Russian restaurant. Would recommend it
Thanks! Very unique experience

Wir waren als Single - Familie unterwegs und haben alles so vorgefunden wie beschrieben. Es ist schon besonders direkt in einem Haus der ehemaligen Grenze zu wohnen, Fluchttunnel unter einem.
Die Lage ist super und der Balkon wirklich viel Wert im Sommer. Auch bei sehr hohen Temperaturen war es nachts in der Wohnung gut auszuhalten.
Das Bad ist riesig für die Wohnung, die Küche ist für einfache Mahlzeiten ausreichend ausgestattet.

Great flat in a great location nd t to the mauerpark.  Communications w david throughout were quick and easy and the flat was much nicer Than I originally thought, the pics don't do it justice.  It made the perfect base for our jaunt to Berlin.  Loved Berlin and the flat!
Merci pour cette bonne chambre très calme et personnel très agréable personne sérieuse
Mooi gebouw en erg netjes. Goeie service en ook een goeie locatie. Jammer genoeg alleen geen airco.

Wir haben ein schönes Wochenende zu viert in Berlin verbracht.
In der Wohnung war alles was wir gebraucht haben.
Die Betten waren sehr gut.
Es gibt einen schönen Innenhof den man von außen so nicht erwartet.

Für den nächsten Aufenthalt in Berlin definitiv auf der Liste.
Von uns eine klare Empfehlung.
Danke Mina
Everything was perfect. Everything we needed was available. Close to underground and good transport links to the city
alles super. gerne immer wieder

Perfekt für Paare, gut gelegen (angenehmer Bezirk und perfekte U-bahnanbindung), gute Tipps von André für den Aufenthalt (zb. Bar tausend, spionagemuseum, berliner unterwelten), im Ganzen also absolut empfehlenswert!!!

We had a great time at Marcus' flat! It's close to lots of transport options and in a residential area. The flat felt spacious and was quiet, the kitchen had everything we needed. It was ideal for our needs and we felt very comfortable!

We stayed at the Natalia’s apartment over the weekend... everything went perfect.
The apartment is very clean and cozy and Natalia provided us with all the infos we need.

So conveniently close to the hbf. Thiago also let me drop off my luggage earlier at a moment’s notice. Very easy going but clear with house rules so it’s well laid out for all guests. His recommendations were also ace. Would highly recommend this place for those wanting affordable accomm close to the train station with friendly and helpful host!

Ich war mit meinen beiden Töchtern in der Unterkunft, und es hat alles wirklich super gepasst! Die Wohnung ist toll eingerichtet, super sauber und mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht, um sich wie zu Hause zu fühlen. Besonders beeindruckend war die Liebe zum Detail bei der Einrichtung – man merkt, dass hier jemand mit Herz bei der Sache ist. Ein echtes Highlight ist der Späti direkt nebenan, der nicht nur alles Notwendige bietet, sondern auch eine richtig gute Siebträgermaschine hat! Der Cappuccino für nur 2 EUR ist genial und hat uns den Start in den Tag versüßt.
Einzig im Sommer könnte die Belüftung etwas herausfordernd sein, da die Wohnung nur ein aufklappbares Oberlicht hat. Das ist aber wirklich der einzige kleine Punkt, den ich anmerken würde. Ansonsten ist die Unterkunft wirklich klasse, und ich kann sie nur weiterempfehlen. Wir haben uns hier sehr wohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder!
Gutes Hotel, sauber, gemütlich

I was with a friend and we stay for one night in a 6 beds dormitory. Everything was clean. The only bad point is that toilets and showers are in the same room and there is no individual box for showers so we had to close the whole room, so nobody can go to the toilets while you are taking a shower, really bad point!! Especially when it is a 6 beds dormitory, which means 6 person who needs a shower...
The breakfast for 5€ is really good, there is choice, for the price you have everything for a complete breakfast (salted and sweet)!
The building is in a quiet area and well designed, I really recommend but the dormitory only for short stay.

The home was conveniently located, clean and stylish. It was very easy to walk and find public transportation. Everything was as described and there was lots of space. I really enjoyed the large shower. If you’re a light sleeper you should know that it can be quite loud because of the trolly that runs right outside the bedroom door. I loved how dark the bedroom got at night and I also enjoyed the ease of connecting to Netflix on the television. The cafe next door was delightful as well. Great home and very kind hosts.

Die Möbel sind in die Jahre gekommen aber funktionell und in Ordnung. Zwei Sachen könnten sauberer sein. Die Fugen in der Dusche und Backofen.
Ansonsten war es sauber und für den Preis in Ordnung
Kommunikation war super. Lage auch sehr gut.
Un appartement génial..une hôte réactive et très agréable...un emplacement au top.. on se sent bien chez Fadeih ....bref allez y les yeux fermés.

Logement très bien placé, au bord du canal, dans une rue très agréable avec de bons restaurants et bars. Plusieurs bouches de métro non loin. A 35 min environ de l'aéroport en transport en commun.
Logement bien décoré, propre et calme.
Logeuse très sympathique, et facilement joignable par email.
Favorite place I’ve ever stayed.
Je recommande ce logement très bien situé dans Kreuzberg
Nice place, would come back

Very good location and quiet, comfortable and clean house in Berlin. Very easy to find, and very close to the Underground. The host is kind, and the check-in / check out was very fast, with good communication. I'll back again when I'll returin in Berlin.
Sophia is a magnificent host. The apartment is nicely located, very well decorated and offers everything one could wish for during a city trip to Berlin.

Schönes Zimmer, zentral, hellhörig und gut gepflegt. Die anderen Zimmer waren ebenfalls vermittelt, sodass nette Unterhaltungen in der Küche stattfanden. Leider hatte ich nicht die Gelegenheit die Vermieter persönlich kennenzulernen, aber die Kommunikation zwischen uns klappte blendend
We loved our stay here.

Tout simplement parfait. Le logement est encore mieux que sur les photos : plus grand, parfaitement propre. Frank fait attention à tous les détails : café, thé, chocolat... machine à laver avec lessive etc etc. Il y a même des jeux pour enfants. Vous êtes comme chez vous. Cela a grandement contribué à un superbe voyage à Berlin. Nous reviendrons, et dan sexy appartement !

Fantastic apartment in a great multi cultural area with great restaurants and cafes nearby. The apartment is beautiful and has some lovely details. It’s on the first floor and overlooks some beautiful trees which gives the apartment a great feel. Bathroom was amazing and the bed was super comfortable.

Robin's apartment is truly wondeful. Everything was in its place. The balcony is fantastic and the place very stylish, with furniture, deco, etc etc. We really enjoyed it and would always seek to come back anytime we're in Berlin.
Good location.  Great metro connections.  Great value!
Nice ground floor flat in Kreuzberg. A sieve to make pasta would have been good.
Eine außergewöhnliche Wohnung das alten Charme und moderne verbindet.

Great location, lots of restaurants and shops nearby. The area is walkable and easy to get around. We felt like locals.
Note: the shower is tiny

This is the best airbnb we have ever stayed in! The place is exactly like the pictures, only more beautiful.  The bedroom is situated on a peaceful courtyard, so the windows can stay open at night and it's still quiet. The apartment is directly across from a supermarket, with cute cafés and restaurants and parks all around you. The neighborhood is extremely safe, calm, and welcoming, while still being right in the middle of everything. It's centrally located, but doesn't feel hectic. It's definitely in the best part of Berlin. Katja is an amazing host - responsive, kind, and considerate. I was so sad to leave this place- wish I could live here forever! If you're looking for somewhere to stay in Berlin, this is the spot!
Lovely apartment in peaceful neighbourhood.  Great public transport links too.  Had a very enjoyable stay thank you!
Super entspannter Aufenthalt, vom Check-In bis Check-Out. Außerdem ist die Lage super, mit vielen Restaurants und Bars - gerne wieder!
Realistic pictures and value, easy communication, flexible management, great location. I would definitely come back.

Von der Ausstattung her ist alles notwendige vorhanden. Die Lage ist super direkt in U-Bahn nähe und 5 min zu Fuß vom Potsdamer Platz entfernt. Der Gastgeber ist sehr freundlich und bei der nächsten Berlin reise würden wir wieder diese Unterkunft buchen.
Excelent place and excelent hosts

Einfach toll!
Mein Aufenthalt bei Limehome war ausgezeichnet. Die Lage ist mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel gut erreichbar. Außerdem ist es nicht sehr weit von der Stadtmitte entfernt. Das Zimmer war ordentlich, sauber und die Küche gut ausgestattet. Erhlich Klasse. Komme auf jeden Fall wieder! :)
Alles super, wie erwartet
Der Bungalow hatte alles was man braucht, die Gastgeber sind sehr nett und entgegenkommen, schnelle und unkomplizierte Kommunikation. Wir kommen gerne wieder um den Pool auszuprobieren.

We had a great two-night stay at Sven's place. It was centrally located and perfect for our stay. It was easy to reach from the airport and Check-in was very easy. The appartment was clean and had everything we needed. The host is very friendly and communication was proactive. Very much recommended.
Nice location. Spacious and light appartment. Washer was broken and we would like to have an extra set of keys (with 4 people that’s easier).
Sehr gute Lage, sehr netter und verlässlicher Gastgeber, sehr nette Wohnung zum Wohlfühlen.

Everything is perfect. The place is a very near to the public transportation, very clean and good equipped. I really enjoyed the time in Iliana's apartment. She is a great host, always available to answer any doubt. Definitely, I recommend it. Thank you, Iliana!

I really had a good Airbnb experience at Hardy’s place. His apartment is simply PERFECT, was VERY functional and well furnished. There was everything I need for my stay. EVERYTHING! Kreuzberg is a very nice area and near of all what you need.
I want to mention that Hardy is an incredible host and human being! He really care about his guest’s comfort, he’s proactive and maintain during all the stay a good communication. I never saw a host involved like him. His kindness and sensibility makes my stay better.
Hardy, thanks for everything, it was a blessing to meet you and I wish you the best!
Marc-André

Claudia's apartment is simply perfect.
When I saw it in the photos, so elegant, minimal and tastefully furnished, instinct told me it would be the ideal place to spend my vacation in Berlin. And so it was.
Well divided and organized in terms of spaces and environments, it is equipped with everything necessary for a comfortable stay. Thanks to a properly stiff mattress, the bed is really very comfortable and, thanks to the silence enjoyed by the apartment, you can sleep very well.
It is located in the heart of Friedrichshain, near Boxhagener Platz, in a quiet residential area and from which you can easily reach any part of the city at any time, thanks to the excellent network of connections that Berlin enjoys.
The price is average, and although I was alone and could not share the expense with another person, I think that never money was better spent.
Claudia was able to provide all the information I needed in a timely and precise manner and communication was always smooth. I didn't meet her personally, but I felt good with her and I felt her somehow complicit.
I could not have made a better choice and the wonderful memory I will keep of Berlin will also be thanks to Claudia's apartment.
I would go back again.

Had a wonderful time! The place is ideal for a short stay while exploring Berlin, as it is quite small and cosy but still has a kitchen to prepare dinner after a long day out. Bakery, supermarket and train/subway station are within walking distance. The hosts were super nice and even stayed up late for us to be able to check in. Would recommend!

This is a very quiet apartment in the middle of a lively and walkable neighborhood very close to various public transportation options. We enjoyed the bakery, restaurants, parks and shopping all nearby.
We had a great time at Wibke's apartment, she is very kind and the place is perfectly located to visit Berlin!

Jürgen ist ein sehr guter und zuvorkommender Gastgeber. Die Wohnung war wie erwartet. Es war sehr sauber und wir haben uns schnell wohl gefühlt. Großer Pluspunkt für uns waren die großen bodentiefen Fenster, die wir auf den Bildern gar nicht bemerkt hatten. Wir würden wiederkommen.

Yana is a truly wonderful host who made me feel right at home. Communication with Yana was just perfect, she’s very nice, respectful, and I really enjoyed talking with her. The house is fully equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay, and the room has direct access to a lovely garden, surrounded by nature. The neighborhood is calm and peaceful, yet still conveniently close to the city (just a 30-minute ride by Bahn), followed by a short walk along a pleasant, well-lit road. I really enjoyed my time here, and if I return to Berlin, I would definitely choose Yana’s place again!
Es war alles so wie erwartet und in den positiven vorangegangenen Kommentaren beschrieben.
Very accommodating with check in. Nice and spacious apartment

Eine schöne kleine und vor allem saubere Wohnung zum Wohlfühlen.

Cleaning lady friendly and welcoming and we were allowed to drop our luggage off early which was very helpful. It is a warm apartment so the fans were a bonus as no air conditioning

Other points:
For a 5 star review I would've expected a small welcome pack with a few essentials (as have experienced at other air bnb's) and nicer towels as a they were very thin and and thready, plus bedroom 2 had paint peeling off the wall - (this did not affect us but didn't look great.)
Despite amenities showing there is a cooker it is in fact a hob and a separate microwave so there is no oven/grill so if you are planning on cooking bear this in mind.

Es war ein großartiges Wochenende. Alles wie beschrieben. Tolle Ausstattung, gemütlich mit Liebe zum Detail. auch die Küche ist richtig gut bestückt. Wir hatten nun auch perfektes Wetter. Es stehen 2 Sub's  zur Verfügung wie auch ein 2 er Kanu. Wir haben alles genutzt. Ein Bootsverleih gab es auch direkt am gleichen Anlieger auch den nutzten wir. Es war Hammer. Die Lage ist so lala. Mitten im Industriegebiet. Man kann aber laufen oder mit den Öffi's alles erreichen. Immer wieder gern. Nur zu empfehlen 🥰👍
Good host, good location…

Der Aufenthalt war super bequem, die Zimmer waren groß, wie beschrieben. Jedoch hätte das Bad etwas sauberer sein können. Die Lage das Hotels ist hervorragend (5 Minuten zu Fuß zum Ku’damm). Alles in allem bin ich super zufrieden und würde das Hotel wieder buchen!

Le logement situé dans ce qui semble être un ancien bâtiment industriel est remarquablement bien aménagé et particulièrement paisible.
À quelques minutes à pied d’un arrêt du bus qui vous mène en quelques stations à la gare de Spandau point de départ vers tout Berlin en train, métro … tout est possible.
Birgit est une hôte bienveillante qui nous a donné de multiples informations et conseils.

Wera was great - met us - showed us how everything works - the place was spotless and a great location to get to know Berlin - sitting on the balcony after 20 thousand steps each day and watching the sun go down was spectacular

Schönes Zimmer, gut gelegen an der M4 Tram. Damit kann man ohne Probleme in's Zentrum von Berlin fahren.
Die M4 fährt auch nachts im 20 Minuten Tackt. Was enorme Flexibilität ermöglicht.
Alle geteilten Wohnungsbereiche wurden sauber gehalten.
Great Location!

Alles is zeker in orde en zou de plek aanraden aan anderen. We vonden het wel jammer dat er niet beschreven stond dat de “king size matras” eigenlijk twee matrassen langs elkaar zijn. We werden vaak wakker met een gat tussen de matrassen. Ook is 1 handdoek voor vier nachten een beetje weinig. We zouden ze natuurlijk kunnen wassen in de wasmachine die aanwezig is, maar om de machine te laten draaien voor enkel twee handdoeken is wat jammer. Voor de rest was de communicatie en de plaats zeker in orde, en hebben we een fijn verblijf gehad in Berlijn.
beautiful, clean space. Close to cafes, restaurants and night clubs.
Matthias’s apartment is terrific and he is the most obliging and responsive host.
Zentrale Lage, guter Ausgangspunkt um Berlin zu entdecken. Nette Restaurants in nächster Nähe.

Peter was an amazing host and he communicated with us before and during our stay there. He recommended us very nice places and they were all worth visiting and trying. He is such a polite gentleman 🌿
The location is super, walking distance to Alexandraplatz. The room was cute and cozy.
Michael is really kind, his appartement is really what we were looking for, nice, well located and clean. Thanks !
Schönes großes und sauberes Zimmer. Nette und hilfsbereite Mitarbeiter.
It was a nice stay for our long weekend trip to explore Berlin. Fun! :)
Great and affordable

Clara’s place is roomy and light especially in the afternoons when the sun streams in through the windows in the main room. There are also good blinds in case the sun is too strong.
The apartment is conveniently located, being only a 10 minute walk from the main train station, 5 minutes from a large supermarket, and a 20 minute walk north of the Brandenburg Gate. The tip of Museum Island is also about a 20 minute walk away.
Clara communicates very well, and was very flexible with the check-in process when my train ran an hour late.
The apartment is quiet and easily accessible via a lift. A minor annoyance for a non-smoker was that, on occasion in the evenings, cigarette smoke from the balcony of the unit immediately below drifted up and in through the open windows.
However there are so many good things to like about Clara’s place, and I would happily stay there again the next time I’m in Berlin.
Excelente ubicación y tanto la habitación como las zonas sociales estaban en perfecto estado. adicionalmente la comunicación siempre fue clara y oportuna
We had a pleasant stay at the apartement of Alan & Kasia. Good location near the s-bahn. We could check out later without any problem. Minus: there was definitely smoked in the apartment.

We had a nice stay. The flat is clean and fully equipped (sleeping on the couch is surprisingly comfortable and the bed is also good) check in is easy, and communication with Johann was effective. The price is fair for the location and for what the flat offers.
Empfehlenswert, Gastgeber ist freundlich, Zimmer ist sauber und die Atmosphäre ist ruhig

This was a great apartment. Exactly as described and seen on the photos. Typical and beautiful Berliner Altbau. Julia was a very helpful host. The apartment is located in a multilingual, young & interesting area of Berlin. Oderberger Straße has a lot of restaurants and stores. The restaurants are busy (and good) and stay open into the night. But the apartment on the fourth floor remains undisturbed by street noise. Very quite.   I would take it again.

Nette Unterkunft, gute Anbindung in die Innenstadt.
Unterkunft empfehlenswert.
Nur mit dem heissen Wasser in der Dusche hatten wir ab und zu mal etwas Probleme trotz des Tipps der Durchflussmengenreduzierung. Es war manchmal dann nicht besonders warm bzw. Temperatur schwankte dann. War aber nicht immer so.
Ansonsten aber schoene Unterkunft.

Unkompliziert, sympathisch, gut. Danke! 😊

Logement très bien équipé, fonctionnel, propre et très bien chauffé..

Although my stay was short, Paulo was a friendly and welcoming host!

Barbara was waiting for us when we arrived, she made us very welcome and explained how everything in the apartment worked and showed us where everything was. We loved the area as well, a short stroll in one direction took us to the Volkspark with a very nice lakeside beer garden. There were several small supermarkets nearby and some very reasonably priced restaurants and breakfast/cafes all within a couple of hundred metres, yet the road the apartment was in was very peaceful. We felt very safe walking around the area and it was only a 10 minute tram ride from the more lively areas around Alexanderplatz. I would recommend Barbara and her apartment to anyone.
Great locaties, spacious apartment and a friendly  host.
Beautiful location, thoroughly enjoyed the stay.
Great communication and beautifully decorated apartment.  Highly recommended.
Great place - recommended.

Die Lage der Wohnung ist sehr gut: schön Umgebung mit Cafés, sicher, recht ruhig, gute Parkmöglichkeiten. Von hier aus kann man Berlin gut erkunden. In den Ecken, im Bad, in der Küchenzeile waren Schmutz, Staub und Haare.
Flo’s place is straightforward, perfect for 1 or 2 nights.

Tijdens ons verblijf van een week in een prachtig appartement in Berlijn werden we aangenaam verrast door de indrukwekkende inrichting en de heerlijke sfeer. Het appartement is met veel smaak ingericht.
De bedden waren absoluut een hoogtepunt. Na een dag vol sightseeing was het een genot om in zo'n zacht en luxe bed te kruipen. We hebben iedere nacht fantastisch geslapen en voelden ons elke ochtend volledig uitgerust en klaar voor een nieuwe dag.
De ligging van het appartement was ideaal, op loopafstand van enkele van de meest iconische bezienswaardigheden van Berlijn. We konden gemakkelijk te voet of met het openbaar vervoer de stad verkennen, wat ons verblijf zeer ontspannen maakte.
Tot slot mogen we het uitzicht niet vergeten. Het appartement bood een panoramisch uitzicht over de stad, wat vooral ’s avonds, met de lichten van Berlijn die oplichten, een magisch schouwspel was.
Kortom: een heerlijk verblijf gehad.

Os quartos são limpos e com casa de banho privada e com espaço para guardar as tuas malas, além da cama ser bastante confortável e ter tomadas e entradas USB para que possas carregar o telemóvel sem problemas.
O único que correu mal foi a forma como a recepção lidou com o seu próprio erro de me atribuir um quarto de uma categoria diferente à que tinha reservado.
Depois de uma noite a dormir no quarto, eles verificaram que me atribuíram o quarto errado e sem proceder a qualquer tipo de contacto para me informar do sucedido decidem arrombar o meu cacifo para retirar os meus perteneces pessoais porque tinham que dar o quarto a outras pessoas.
Nunca me fizeram tal coisa noutros hotéis e hostels em que fiquei no passado, e como trabalhador na área da hotelaria fiquei completamente chocado com a forma como lidaram com a situação.
Simplesmente pedem desculpa e dão o pequeno almoço como complimentary e uma toalha de banho (a qual já tinha pago 3€).
É um hostel no qual voltaria a ficar pelo excelente ambiente que tem e pela sua localização super central.
