The location of the apartment is nice and central - very easy as a base to get around Berlin. There is a S Bahn station 2 minutes away, a big supermarket 2 minutes the other way and loads of restaurants from as close as across the road to 10 minute’s walk.
We would highly recommend staying here - really great experience!

the unit is so awesome, super clean, cozy, has all the basics needed for a short stay for single or couple traveller. Lin as a host is very good in communication and accomodating for my needs during my stay at her unit. The unit located 100m from nearest bus stop and around 400m to the subway.
Schöne Studiowohnung für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in Berlin.
Cute apartment in quiet neighborhood with many restaurants, walkable to tourist sights. Would recommend!
Good location, close to trains and buses.  Quiet neighborhood with bakeries, restaurants and grocery stores nearby.  Eclectic apartment with lots of space!

Outstanding location in a lovely street next to Kastanienallee. Lots of restaurants and bars in the area. 12 minutes to Hauptbahnhof by tram. Very well kept apartment with friendly, helpful owners. We were three in the apartment, with an extra fold-out bed in the living-room, that was of excellent quality. Just a great experience, highly recommended!

Ulli's house is located in a quiet neighborhood in East Berlin. Although it's located outside the city center, traveling to Alexanderplatz, the Museum Island and other attractions is relatively easy. Check-in instructions were easy to follow and the description is accurate.
Ulli's house is spacious and lovingly decorated, with a large and well-equipped open-plan kitchen and living room. There is also a nice backyard, which must be a big plus in the summer. The rooms are large and comfortable.
The only issue we faced was with heating - the first two days it was rather cold in the house, even though the heating was turned on. Luckily there were enough duvets and blankets in the house to stay warm at night.
Overall my family enjoyed their stay, despite the heating problems.

Birgit is an amazing host. She was very courteous, kind and helped us with questions. Her apartment was very clean, neat and had all the amenities required for cooking.
I will definitely stay here during my next trip. Awesome host and amazing stay.
Es war genau das passende für uns, ruhiges Zimmer, sehr netter und zuverlässiger Gastgeber und netter Kiez
Die Lage der Wohnung ist hervorragend. Wenige Minuten zu Fuß bis zur nächsten U-Bahn. Wir werden gerne wieder einmal kommen.

I was very happy in a great place:)
I’m highly recommend it!
Great place in a beautiful location. We especially enjoyed the flowering trees in the courtyard downstairs.
Great value for money, beautifully decorated apartment and you feel right at home. Nazanin was responsive if I had any questions. I would recommend this apartment.

Nena Apartments Metropolpark Berlin was a very nice place to stay at. The appartement was very close to the metrostation and there was 24/7 security so you could even get in at 4 am. The rooms were very nice and clean and the staff was very helpful.
However if you’d like to party this is not the place for you. You have to be considerate to the residents that live upstairs and thats why outside of your room you have to talk with a whisper. Inside of your room you cant be too loud either. The room itself was very hot and warm, it would have been nice if there was airconditioning of some kind.

We hebben genoten van ons verblijf in dit prachtige appartement in Friedrichshain. Alles faciliteiten waren aanwezig. Het huis was meer dan ruim genoeg voor 4 personen. Alles was enorm schoon.
De auto konden we gemakkelijk met easy park om de hoek parkeren en was niet duur voor 4 dagen.
We zouden zeker nog een keer terugkomen!

Nous avons passé un séjour incroyable dans cet Airbnb à Berlin ! Le quartier de Charlottenburg est parfait pour explorer la ville, avec des cafés et des boutiques charmantes à chaque coin de rue. L’appartement était propre, confortable, et doté de toutes les commodités nécessaires… L’hôte était accueillant et réactif, toujours disponible pour répondre à nos questions. Nous avons adoré l’ambiance du lieu et nous y reviendrons sans hésiter lors de notre prochain séjour à Berlin. Merci pour cette expérience inoubliable !

Si le quartier est sale et sans intérêt, on est proche de 3 stations de métro et d'un arret de bus au pied de l' immeuble.
Notre appartement conforme à la description était très propre, bien équipé et objet d'une rénovation récente.
Très agréable à vivre .
L' isolation acoustique est toutefois un problème.
Il ne faut pas de voisins bruyants ou noctambules.
A nice flat, great for students. Good location. The communication with the host was great. I can only recommend.

Das Apartment von Heinrich Glasser war sehr schön und sauber. Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen, es war perfekt für zwei Leute. Es lief alles unproblematisch ab, wir waren sehr zufrieden und würden es jeder zeit wieder buchen!
Responsive host, clean, recommended.
Great apartment in a nice and peaceful place. The apartment were clean and in good shape. We felt safe and had a great stay here in Berlin.

Das Appartement ist sehr gemütlich eingerichtet. Der Check-In verlief reibungslos - ganz easy mit einem individuellen Code 😊 Wir haben uns in dem Appartement sehr wohl gefühlt. Küche & Bad waren sehr sauber und alles Utensilien waren verfügbar. Die Kommunikation lief reibungslos, bei Fragen standen Stella & Laura immer zur Verfügung!
Wir kommen gerne wieder 😊
Good place, comfortable, clean and close to the subway.

Le logement est hyper bien situé dans Berlin. Cependant, nous avons eu la mauvaise surprise de voir notre facture explosée. En effet Jorn facture de nombreux frais supplémentaires non inclus lors du paiement à la réservation. Bien que Jorn mentionne ces frais dans son annonce, on passe très facilement à côté (soyez vigilant concernant le jour et l'heure de votre check-in et check out). Par ailleurs, le lit de la chambre donnant sur la cour est vraiment de très mauvaise facture. En effet, il grince à chaque mouvement ce qui réveille votre partenaire qui lui même vous réveillera à chaque mouvement de sa part. Ce n'est pas très reposant lors des vacances.
Super Wohnung- super Lage

Carsten, I just finished my trip to Europe. I want to thank you for hosting me and my wife in your beautiful apartment. Your apartment is beautiful; in addition it has a fantastic view. We enjoyed the evenings sitting at the terrace watching the sunset. You were very kind when we arrived and gave us needed information about the city. I happily recommend your place with 5 stars. Thank you again!

Der Wohnung ist ruhig und großzügig. Ich habe es genossen. Es ist ein EG Wohnung. Tür Öffnung mit dem Elektronik schlüssel kann etwas knifflig sein, also am besten leicht gegen der Tür drucken und dann drehen.
The apartment is comfortable and roomy. It is on the ground floor in an inner courtyard that makes it quiet, but the views are not spectacular. It is a great neighbourhood and very convenient. To open the doors it helps to push lightly so that it is easier to turn the lock.

We really enjoyed our stay at Ebru’s place. The apartment was immaculate clean, really well equipped and very stylish and organized. It had all the amenities we needed. The bed was really comfortable and Ebru was always really nice and attentive. It was really easy to go anywhere as it’s next to an Ubahn station and also close to the Sbahn. Getting to know Shila was a big plus 🐱. Thanks again for hosting us!
sehr freundlicher Host, hilfsbereit und gut erreichbar!
Great hosts, very welcoming and helpful. The place was clean and very comfortable. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to stay in Berlin!

Appartamento bello, pulito, riscaldato e fornito del necessario. A pochi minuti da una fermata della linea U7. Tutte le informazioni per la gestione vengono fornite dal proprietario, senza necessità di incontrarlo! Nella strada tra la fermata della metro e l'appartamento ci sono 2 supermercati, ma consiglio di cercarne altri per avere prodotti di maggior qualità. Di sera la via per raggiungere l'appartamento è un po' buia. Nel complesso molto soddisfatto!

Our stay at Christoph place was lovely, we spent one entire month and he helped us a lot, he gave to us a lot of recommendations, we are very grateful for that! The place is very well located near supermarkets and public transportation. The room was very neat and clean.
The place is very cool and useful. They have a washer machine and something’s for cooking. Bed and heater very great!
Excellent location and plenty of space for our small group. I absolutely recommend this place!
Nice and clean mini apartment in a good position close to metro station and supermarkets. It's been easy to find it following Simon's instructions. I would come back!

Michaela is a great host. The room was just like in the photos. She is friendly and chatty, but she also knows when to give space. We had interesting conversations about work and life.
It was a nice stay, I felt comfortable in her apartment

Eine idyllische Wohnung am Waldrand! Ich habe die Zeit genossen und nichts vermisst!
Der nächste Berlin/Brandenburg Besuch wird erneut hier stattfinden 😃
Michele’s place was bigger than expeacted. It was perfect for 3 couples. The best thing is Michele’s hospitality. He is a really nice host
Esta súper bien ubicado, es igual que en las fotos, muy luminoso y limpio, volvería sin dudarlo.
Nice place! Very clean and modern. Large rooms with big windows! Easy to go wherever you want with a lot of busses and trams near the hostel.
Andre and Su are top notch hosts and I would highly recommend a stay at their place.  Thanks a lot for the great experience 👍🤩

Heinz is very friendly and very reactive. Our contact before our arrival was perfect. the apartment is very nice and clean.
Great location for few days in Berlin !

Jen's home was a cozy loft in the middle of a cool gated community. Key handoff was a little strange but it wasn't his fault and it worked out good. The location was great, close to all public transportation and resided in a calm area with lively parts just a 10-15 minute walk away.
There were some parts I wasn't necessarily expecting, like the beds were all on the floor and the bathroom door didn't shut properly. But for a few Americans on a budget, this place has great value and were able to overlook these quirks pretty easily. Thanks Jens for the lovely stay!
Enrique was an amazing host with great communication.  The location of his place was perfect- so close to public transportation.  He went above and beyond to make sure our stay was comfortable.
Great ! Clean and nice !

Excelente departamento, hice una reserva el mismo día de llegada por urgencia, Douglas respondió al instante, el departamento es exactamente lo que publicó, muy bien ubicado, muy limpio.
Muy recomendable, volvería a alquilar el mismo departamento la próxima vez.
Excelente anfitrión

Die Wohnung sah genau so aus wie wir sie und vorgestellt hatten, es waren 4 sehr schöne Tage in Berlin. Die Zusatändige Hausverwaltung war sehr freundlich und hat sofort geholfen, als der Safe sich nicht mehr öffnen lassen wollte. Der Check-In wie auch der Check-Out verliefen sehr einfach per Handy und ohne Probleme.

Superbe appartement dans une rue calme mais néanmoins bien fournie en restauration et boutiques.
L’appartement est très spacieux et bien équipé.

Kristina is an amazing host, she gives you recommendations, answers quickly and has an amazing place. She also left us some snacks and food totally free that helped us a lot. Totally returning with her when I'll visit Berlin in the future.
War ein guter Aufenthalt aber das Zimmer hat obwohl es ein nicht Raucher Zimmer war sehr nach Zigaretten Rauch gestunken
spacious apartment, excellent location

Would highly recommend this apartment. The room is spacious and has a lovely terrace. The host is very friendly and hospital. Kitchen is very nice and good for cooking. Ideal location close to lots of public transport links and a park. Thank you Thomas!

The accommodation was good for what we paid. The room was clean and nice. Only thing that wasn’t great according to our standard was the bathroom- we didn’t find it very clean or nice but nothing crazy. Overall I would recommend to stay at this Airbnb, we had a positive experience. The host is very responsive and helpful:)
سكن نظيف ومرتب وواسع وكانت erzsebet ودوده وحنونه لقت احضرت لي وجبة العشاء ترحيباً لي ،، فعلاً انه مكان رائع ،، المكان يستحق العودة اليه
Sehr unkomplizierte Unterkunft, ist super ausgestattet und man bekommt immer sofort eine Antwort, wenn man eine Frage hat!
Kleines aber feines Appartement in unmittelbarer Nähe des Kollwitzkiezes, idealer Ausgangspunkt um Mitte zu erkunden...
Very nice apartment in an excellent location, close to the station. The apartment was clean and the host provided helpful information. Would highly recommend.
heel prettig contact, goede ruimte
Had a great stay for five nights around New Year.   Apartment ideal for us,  spacious.   Area good,  with easy access to food and drink, and quick to get to rest of city.
Alles gut, gekauft wie gesehen!
Clean space, great location, best price. Very happy with our 3 day stay in Berlin.

Schönes, geräumiges Apartment. Super Lage in direkter Nähe zu S-, U-Bahn und Bus. Sauber und gut ausgestattet. Den Verkehrslärm der großen Straße haben wir zwar hören können, konnten aber dennoch gut schlafen.
Big room in a great location. Sharon took good care and made sure I was comfortable.
Super Wohnung, gerne wieder!
Muy cómodo y accesible, el lugar y la ubicación
Nice place. Would recommend

Dan and Robert’s place is fabulous- it is a peaceful, very nicely decorated, and light filled oasis in a busy city. The rooms were spotless and after having rented quite a few places in Berlin we were super happy with the find. It is very centrally located. Restaurants and supermarkets are all within easy walking distance.  A washer and dryer make life easier if you stay a little longer like us. We will definitely be back. Thank you so much.
Appartement très propre et pratique. Bonne expérience à Berlin

está todo bien , el único problema y que siento que es un abuso es que el check-in sea hasta las 4 pm !! y si quieres entrar antes tienes que pagar ! además no ofrecen la comodidad que muchos otros huéspedes que te permiten dejar tu equipaje.
Fantastic room to stay in if you need a bed for a few days. Hosts are super lovely and accommodating into their home. Room is private and you don’t feel like you are intruding.

Alan & Kasia sind super Gastgeber (mit einem guten unterstützenden Netzwerk). Das Airbnb liegt super in Friedrichshain, sodass man durch Fußweg fast alles erreichen kann. Für meinen Geschmack war der Check in etwas kompliziert (Infos über Infos), allerdings hat es super funktioniert und war nach etwas Mühe sehr einfach. Ganz liebe Grüße :)

The place is large and perfect for a group of people. It’s close to a train or scooters to easily access downtown, but had a lot going on around it as well. I think it states in other reviews, but the bedroom walls for 3 of the bedrooms are half walls, so if you have someone staying up with lights on, it’ll light up the other room too. I’m not sensitive to light so it didn’t bug me, but just something to be aware of!
Easy communication and easy to check in and out. One of the only places I could find in the area that actually had 4 bedrooms!

Piccola e graziosa casetta indipendente come da foto, facilmente raggiungibile con i mezzi, in un quartiere tranquillo e con tutti i negozi necessari (supermarket, panetteria, bazar...)
Non funzionavano la wifi e la tv ma Constantin ha subito rimediato
Purtroppo mancava il piatto del microonde e anche se l'abbiamo segnalato il primo giorno, non l'abbiamo potuto utilizzare x tutto il soggiorno
Avendo una cucina piccola, sarebbe stato utile per scaldare i cibi
Constantin è un host molto gentile, la casa ha molti optional presenti nell'appartamento, con piccole manutenzioni e dettagli, potrebbe ulteriormente migliorare
A very simple process, good location and clean.

Nuestra estancia en Berlin fue muy buena, lástima que 2 días son muy pocos. Con respecto a los anfitriones, estamos muy agradecidos por lo bien que nos hicieron sentir, nos sacaron cualquier tipo de duda que hemos tenido y hasta el último día nos regalaron el desayuno, el cual compartimos. Además, el departamento está en una buena ubicación, no en pleno centro pero muy cerca. Así que recomiendo esta habitación para hospedarse en Berlin.

Stayed for the weekend to run the half marathon. Great location, we were able to walk to the start line easily. Lovely and quiet apartment. Our only feedback is the pillows are dreadful otherwise we had a great stay thanks

Jan's place was great! The location is really nice, close to a lot of great spots in Kreuzberg. The room and bathroom were clean and the bed was extremely comfortable. Also the coffee and tea were a nice addition. A next trip to Berlin would definitely be at Jan's place again!

Wir hatten eine sehr gute Zeit in Berlin und der gemütlichen Wohnung . Trotz Großstadt fühlte es sich im Wohnungsviertel wie Kleinstadt an. Sehr günstig ist die Lage, die Straßenbahn ist direkt vor der Haustür und führt bis zur Stadtmitte, ohne Umsteigen. Man kann wider Erwarten wunderbar mit dem Fahrrad ganz Berlin erkunden. Der Mauerweg liegt in der Nähe.
Geschäfte, Restaurants findet man auch genügend in der Nähe. Wir können die Wohnung sehr empfehlen und würden sie auch wieder buchen.
Antonia hat immer sehr schnell und freundlich geantwortet. Der Wohnungsbereich war sehr schön und sauber. Hat alles gepasst

Warm and quiet apartment close to Berlin downtown, excellent comunicated to underground, tram and buses. With new furnitures, a lovely bathroom and a comfortable big bed, we could rest perfectly after our Berlín long days. And not only the apartment rules, Julian is a really SuperHost! Very helpful info on a blue file! Don't forget reading it carefully!

We have been Airbnb Superhosts for many years and Carolina's property was a great stay for us in Berlin. Centrally located in Prinzlauer Allee, neighborhood shopping and great restaurants are all close by. Highly recommended!
This place is really awesome. Stylish, and in a cool neighborhood. Me and my girlfriend really loved out stay here.
Beautiful clean apartment in a nice are, not far away from the city center. Markus is a friendly and responsive host.
Alles war wie beschrieben… perfekt…

Außerordentlich nette Unterkunft mit Charme und willkommen heißendet Gastgeberin. Hab mich sofort wie zu Hause gefüllt- wie bei guten Freunden. Bett ist super bequem- mit Flügeltür zur Terrasse- man darf dort rauchen. Das Zimmer ist sehr ruhig. Immer wieder gern und sehr zu empfehlen!!

Claudia ist eine sehr freundliche, zuvorkommende und immer hilfsbereite Gastgeberin. Die Unterkunft ist liebevoll, sehr persönlich und gemütlich eingerichtet und umfassend ausgestattet. Uneingeschränkt zu empfehlen. Vielen Dank!

Ruhige Lage und etwas abseits der Hektik der Großstadt Berlin. Alles Wichtige wie Supermarkt und Straßenbahn fussläufig erreichbar. Gemütliches nettes Zimmer und persönlicher Empfang… rundum empfehlenswert! Sehr nette Gastgeberin
Clean place with a nice location. Helpful hosts

nous avons passé un très bon séjour et avons apprécié de dormir dans un quartier calme. c'était bien équipé et nous avons apprécié trouver quelques produits de base
bonus: il y a une aire de jeux pour enfants immense et vraiment géniale à 10 min à pieds !

Excellent séjour à Lekkerurlaub. Kathrin a été particulièrement agréable, serviable et nous a beaucoup aidé lors d'un problème que nous avons rencontré. La chambre était très propre et cosy, les espaces communs très agréables, tout est pensé pour vous arranger. C'est l'endroit idéal pour séjourner à Berlin ! Nous vous le recommandons chaleureusement.
Encore merci Kathrin, Auf Wiedersehen !
Awesome place in the heart of neukölln. The person responsible for this is sweet and loving
Alloggio fantastico, intimo, silenzioso in una zona molto piacevole di Berlino non tanto distante dalla S Bahn e U Bahn
We had a wonderful 4 days staying here. Lovely apartment with very comfortable beds and stylish decor. Great location close to everything. Highly recommended
The plane was great and the host is very nice. I highly recommend Marcus apartment. The best location, everything is near, quite and nice neighborhood.

Wir haben uns in einer sehr sauberen, modernen, liebevoll eingerichteten Wohnung mehr als wohl gefühlt. Uns hat an nichts gefehlt. Geschlafen haben wir wie auf Wolken. Sehr, sehr nette Vermieter,alles problemlos.
Jederzeit wieder, vielen lieben Dank.

Don't hesitate to book Wibke's place. It is in the perfect location and ended up being one of the highlight cities of our trip. The room is large, clean, and has a very comfy bed. Wibke and her boyfriend were very friendly and helpful at providing us suggestions to fill our days. We would definitely return!

This apartment is highly recommended. The location is amazing (right next to alexanderplatz) with tons of restaurants close by. When we first came to the apt someone was waiting for us there, greeting us and making sure all is ok.
On our last day we asked Nadia if we could check out at a later hour (as our flight was late at night) and she replied within 10 min saying it won't be a problem at all.
The apartment is awesome. The living room is big and comfortable, the bedrooms are cozy and the whole vibe is just great.
I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Berlin.

Elisabeth was very responsive to any questions or concerns. I enjoyed my 2 week stay in her Friedrichshain apartment, a great location surrounded by weekend markets, great transport links and cool finds. For the majority of my stay, I had the apartment to myself. The listing very much matched the description.
very close to subway station, which takes you to all the main tourist attractions. 2 stops away from the zoo. peaceful quiet neighborhood,  with good restaurants in walking distance .
È stato un soggiorno veloce ma ottimo per le nostre necessità

When you go to berlin and you want to stay in a clean, neat, calm and relax apartment. You've to book this one. It's close to all the facilities like an supermarket, all kinds of restaurants and café or bars.

We had a lovely 1-night stay! The room was cozy and welcoming with all the listed amenities and more! We had a rental car and easily saw a lot of sights on our itinerary. Paid street parking was available! Reception was friendly and communication was great! Will definitely stay here again!
Lovely house and really kind host!

Ich habe mich in dem Appartement sofort wohlgefühlt. Sehr gute und freundliche Kommunikation. Das Appartement war mit allem ausgestattet was man braucht, sehr sauber und sehr bequemes Bett. Sehr gute Lage in der Nähe der U8.
Hat alles gut geklappt vielen Dank.
Great location, nice apartment!
Great place and Stella and Lara always respond quickly. Would stay here again

Çok güzel bir oda ve deneyimdi her yere yakındı. Havlu eksikti ve airbnb fotoğraflarında bulunan teras kulanımı dahil değildi onun dışında her şey anlatıldığı gibiydi. Valiz bırakma odası olması büyük bi ayrıcalık. Her şey için teşekkürler.

De accommodatie maakt onderdeel uit van een groot complex, aan de rand van het stadcentrum in een redelijk, rustige wijk. De accommodatie is heel ruim, schoon en ruimschoots van alle gemakken voorzien. Ben en Simon hebben aandacht voor details, zoals een kleine attentie bij aankomst en iedere ochtend. Kortom, eeb bijzonder prettig verblijf en zeer aan te bevelen.
She is a very warm-hearted woman. And the room is clean and comfortable. The location is very good, it takes 15 minutes to the center.
wunderschön gebautes und eingerichtetes Hausboot. Tolle, ruhige Location mitten in der Natur mit guter öV-Anbindung ins Zentrum. Boot schaukelt nur wenig, für alle See-sensitiven Menschen.

I didn’t get the room I paid for. Was offered an “upgrade” which I declined because it looked worse than the room I did book but was still placed in it anyway. Good location though, clean and staff are communicative

Das Appartement ist sehr gut mit der U-Bahn erreichbar und es gibt viele Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in unmittelbarer Nähe. Die Ausstattung ist einfach, aber funktional. Für eine Person reicht die Anzahl der Teller, ist man zu Zweit ist improvisieren angesagt. Alles in allem eine empfehlenswerte Unterkunft für einen Städtetrip.

We had a great experience staying in this very well located airbnb in the heart of Berlin. Surrounded by great cafes, bars and restaurants our hosts took the time to share their personal recommendations. Both Jay & Inna were lovely and made us feel at home in their apartment.  Highly recommend this lovely place and thank you to our hosts for making our trip to Berlin so memorable!
War sehr nett und der Preis war überschaubar, gerne nochmal :)
Absolutely loved it! Charlie and Chris were so helpful and responsive! Definitely going back for my next trip!
My mom and her friend stay here and they had a great time. They said it was very comfortable to stay here and want to stay here again for the next time. Also Duc was very kind. Thank you very much!
Chambre spacieuse! Maria est réactive en cas de besoin et discrète par ailleurs! j'ai passé un bon séjour chez elle! de plus le quartier est sympa!

Super central. Plenty of good food around. Walking distance to Berlin Wall and Checkpoint Charlie. Had a great time there.
Apartment was spacious and clean. Well appointed.

Appartement agréable, fonctionnel et impeccable.
Situé non loin du centre et des transports.
Conforme à la description.

Thomas and Susanne were great hosts. Always ready to help with a smile.
The place is perfect getaway especially with the sauna and pool.
Sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt, schöne, gemütliche Einrichtung, alles sehr sauber und den Bildern entsprechend.
Posizione buona, facile accesso e alloggio che rispecchia quanto presente sul sito

Place was clean and clutter free. Close to tram, which connects to train easily and Close to Alexa Shopping mall. If you sleep in the front bedroom/living room, and you are a light sleeper, you may have a hard time sleeping in because of the noise of tram, traffic, and people walking. Bakery, cafe, restaurants, and grocery store nearby. Great location and comfortable.

1 Nacht dort verbracht, alles gut gelaufen und keine Einwände. Check-In war sehr einfach und unkompliziert.
Unterkunft war absolut sauber.

The apartment was even better than it looks in the pictures. Really great views, bright, and quiet as well. Great to have creative insights if you need to get work done. Everything was perfect. I could even do my laundry there. Neighborhood has plenty of stores within walking distance, some even open until midnight.
Lovely stay, well equipped apartment, short walk to train station, nice & safe suburb

Die Unterkunft war generell sehr gut, mit einer angenehmen Lage in einem ruhigeren Viertel und einer Nähe zu verschiedenen Supermärkten und Anbindungen an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel.
Wir konnten zur vereinbarten Zeit jedoch noch nicht einchecken, da dann noch geputzt wurde, weshalb wir dies erst rund 1 1/2 Stunden später tun konnten. Auch war bei unserer Ankunft das Geschirr nicht wirklich sauber im Schrank und die Pfanne war noch voll mit angebrannten Essensresten - das war nicht so toll, jedoch schnell durch eigenarbeit zu beheben.
Des Weiteren gab es von den „Essentials“ nur Salz, also sonst keine Gewürze oder Öl für die Pfanne/Topf etc.; muss man also im Vorraus selber mitbringen.
Sonst war die Wohnung praktisch eingerichtet, konnte von uns gut genutzt werden und hat uns gefallen.
Excellent séjour dans l'appartement de Jan ! Idéalement situé pour découvrir les différents quartiers de Berlin !
Todo muy bien, la habitación es amplia y cómoda, hay limpieza. Está cerca de un par de estaciones, Esteban respondió todas nuestras dudas oportunamente.

Perfect place.
Detailed instructions beforehand. Great location, everything provided and sorted .
Good location for quietness but then easy access to the tube .

Très bon appartement, bien situé et calme. Restaurants et bars à proximité, transport en commun au coin de la rue.
Très bien pour visiter Berlin
Martina est arrangeante et accueillante.
todo muy bien, cómodo para pasar la noche.

The place was great and exactly like it was described. The kitchen had everything needed to cook. The host was very responsive and nice. She helped with everything, we needed help with. The surrounding area was beautiful. The way to the center of berlin was short, but it was far enough that the area was very peaceful and quiet. We liked our stay and would recommend it.
Saubere und gut ausgestattete Wohnung. Große Schlafzimmer und super Location! Checkin und Checkout sind sehr einfach. Hier gibt es nichts zu meckern.

The place was very clean and the shared areas were very spacious which made for a comfortable place for 4 adults to be together. Messages were responded to very quickly. The location was great for our plans and had access to many public transport lines.
However there were a few things we were not expecting based on the add. The front door opens directly onto the street, there is only one toilet (although there are two showers) and there is no oven. The place only had space heaters so showering was cold and the nights were chilly. One of the bedroom doors couldn’t be closed all the way and also had a window into the hallway that couldn’t be covered so was a problem if the hallway light was turned on at night. Lastly, several of the screws in many of the door handles came loose and made it impossible to close the doors and exposed the sharp screws.
Overall the place was nice enough and if several of these small things were addressed it would be a very pleasant stay.
confortable, agradable, limpio y cerca de las estaciones, recomendado!

Mein Zimmer ging zur Straße, was bedeutete, dass ich nachts das Fenster nicht öffnen konnte, aber es schläft sich auf den angenehmen Matratzen auch mit geschlossenem Fenster wirklich gut.

I was in town for the Berlin Marathon, and I'm glad I picked this place because it provided the right setting for me to be able to relax before the race. The location is great, too. A plus is that you can park your car for free by the loft.
We recommended the loft of Birgit!
The apartment was clean, well furnished and close to the U Bahn stop. Check in was very efficient, they sent a code to the building and our apartment. Nice neighborhood too

Die Wohnung ist ganz genau wie auf den Bildern und der Gastgeber kaum mit Worten zu beschreiben. Appartement très bien placé et hôte flexible et réactif! Super!

Wirklich eine sehr schöne moderne und grosszügige Wohnung an dieser lebendigen und berlintypischen Ecke. Wir haben die Tage hier sehr genossen und fühlten uns sofort wie zu hause. Tolle Gastgeber und sehr persönliche und aufmerksame Kommunikation.
Wir würden sofort wieder buchen!

This is a great, cozy and spacious place in a very good location - it is peaceful, in a safe neighbourhood, and very close to U-bahn station. There are also some very good places around to have good brunch and coffee. Also, make sure to visit Tempelhof Field which is a very nice place very close to the flat. There is also a great and very cheap bicycle rental place one street away - 4eur bicycle for a whole day! Apart from that - Louis is an awesome host. We did not get a chance to meet him in person as he was doing a trip of his own, but he arranged everything for us, and checking in and out was a seamless experience. The place was clean and tidy, and Louis was messaging us from time to time to give us advices about moving around the city, which was great from his side. We would definitely rexommend this place to anyone coming to Berlin for a few days or even longer - great host, great location, and a very good flat.  Next time we are in Berling - this is the place we will look for first.
Much better than expected! Very clean, free breakfast, beds were very comfortable.

Prettige buurt om te verblijven, niet in de laatste plaats omdat Berlijn een perfect openbaarvervoersnet heeft.
Het appartement is ruim bemeten met goede slaapplekken voor vier personen. Echter, als je zoals wij ’s avonds thuis wilt verblijven, biedt de (slaap)bank en één luie stoel slechts schamel zitcomfort, zet er nog een makkelijke stoel bij, is ons advies.
Om nog maar te zwijgen over de absoluut onvoldoende keukenuitrusting: een elektrische vierpitter aus dem Jahre null, die zich amper liet regelen met daarboven een afzuigkap die helemaal niet functioneert. Perfect little place in a great location, with super responsive and accommodating host :)

Phillip is a great host, super friendly and helpful, very responsive. His place is clean, super spacious and also well located, totally worth the price and I will definitely be coming back possibly for longer stays.
Die Schlüsselübergabe hat reibungslos geklappt. Ingesamt ist die Wohnung echt top. Die Ausstattung, Größe und Lage ist perfekt für ein Besuch in Berlin. Meine Freundinnen und ich kommen gerne wieder.

Sehr gut Wohnung. Great Location. Great Hosts.

L'appartement de Bob est nickel, propre, silencieux, bien situé et très fonctionnel. Se rapproche beaucoup d'une chambre d'hôtel avec un coté cuisine.

It's rare for me to stay in a shared accommodation, but this time I'm happy I did - Thor is both welcoming but also lets you have privacy when you need it. On my first day, he took the time to show me around the house and the neighborhood as well as made sure that the fridge was stocked with things I wanted. I felt at ease at his place and welcomed in the common areas. The neighborhood might have become one of my favorite locations in Berlin :). I recommend staying with Thor.

Vriendelijke en behulpzame ontvangst.
Wer einen Kurzurlaub in Berlin plant und Abends "aus der Hektik" der Innenstadt fliehen möchte, ist hier sehr gut aufgehoben.
Great place to stay. Accurately described.
Super Host. Sehr gastfreundlich mit einem Starterpaket Kaffe, Wasser, Schampo, Handtücher.
Very nice. Would come back.

Wolfram was really helpful, welcomed us and showed us around. He very kindly allowed us an early check-in & late check-out. Fantastic location, we walked nearly everywhere & just got a couple of Ubers, but near public transport too. Comfortable beds. Quiet even though on the road. Exactly as described. Not a really modern, luxury apartment but priced accordingly and as we expected. Very well equipped. Yes, you walk past the toilet & shower to the kitchen & exit but there is a dark shower curtain & toilet screen. There is a proper door from the bedroom/living area so when our modest teenage daughter was in shower or toilet we just closed it & didn't walk through. It did not smell of damp as I had read in a previous review. Very clean. Overall, great apartment, great location, great price. Thank you Wolfram.

This flat is exactly as the description says. It keeps cool in the summer, and was immaculately clean. Kerstin is super communicative and clear in her instructions and dialogue, both written and verbal. The location is wonderful - walkable to probably 100 cafes, bars, restaurants, and shops. A good deal $$-wise too! I cannot speak highly enough of this spot. : )
I had a comfortable and pleasant stay.
Walking distance from restaurants and the U-Bahn, so very easy to get around. Also, the room was nice and clean. The only things we were missing were a chopping board and a dishcloth/kitchen towel.

Andreas is a wonderful host, very helpful and friendly. The apartment is basically one room, ideal for two traveling friends who are exploring the city the whole day. It is located in a very nice and safe neighborhood, close to public transportation and offers plenty of shops and restaurants. Would definitely recommend to stay with Andreas!

We were at the appartement for three weeks. It was a great base from which to explore Berlin. The wifi was very good, which was great because we were working from the appertment. Very nice, clean and cozy apartment, well located just 3 minutes away from the subway station. The host responded promptly, providing all needes details.

Perfect place to stay for two persons while visiting Berlin. Connections great.  Couple minutes to trainstation from which straight to the BER airport. Apartment was as it was described.
Departamento hermoso y re bien ubicado. Moe siempre estuvo disponible para cualquier duda que tuve. Súper recomendable
Sehr empfehlenswert – eine sehr schöne und gemütliche Unterkunft und gute Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern!

This place was more than the pictures. The whole space was designed so thoughtfully and efficiently. Anna was also cool, helpful and quick to respond. I didn’t get to leave a note in their guestbook because I was rushing to the airport - I spent every second I could enjoying Berlin. When I come back, I’ll definitely try to book here again.

The airbnb is a little in the outskirts of berlin, in a residential area but there is good connections with public transportation (buses, subway). Thanks for all :)
Simon was great host. Professional and always inntouch. Apartment was clean and cozy. I recommand staying at Simon's apartment.

Die Wohnung ist sehr ruhig und es ist alles vorhanden, was man braucht. Die Kommunikation mit Alec/Zlata hat hervorragend funktioniert und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Really enjoyed our stay. Stylish, comfortable space in a great location and certainly met our expectations. Martina was excellent on communication and we had a brief (mainly as we knew the area), but helpful introduction.

Alexanderplatz is just 10-12min walk away and tram stops at both ends of the street just 3 minutes walk away and the Penzlauer Berg area is very inspiring with lots of nice cafés and friendly pubs. The area is also very safe.

Het was verrassend hoeveel ruimte en comfort we hadden in jullie apartement. Ook zijn we heel goed opgevangen omdat het Pinksteren was en Daniela en haar man Andre voor ons boodschappen hebben gedaan, Daniela en Andre waren bijzonder vriendelijk en attent.

Unterkunft war super ausreichend für einen Citytrip für zwei Personen. Es war alles vorhanden, genug Handtücher und alles an Geschirr/Küchenausstattung, was man benötigt. Super empfehlenswert!

I would recommend the apartment if you're coming to town to party and enjoy the international cuisine.

Nice place for a short stay in Berlin. You will need to follow Michael's  exact directions to reach his place - the Google map address may not work, and he offers a flexible check-in and is very responsive & friendly.

Sabine was an excellent hostess, hospitable and accommodating . Her place is located in a very cozy area, surrounded with lots of restaurants. Whenever we go back to Berlin we don't want to stay in any other place han Sabine's.
Alles wunderbar, sauber und wie beschrieben.

Nice looking place and comfy beds! However it was extremely cold, it took about three days to warm up with the radiators. We had to buy our own electric heater and left it there for the next guest to stay warm. Also the WiFi was terrible, I had to use my phone data the whole time. These things would have been more excusable, but the final straw was the lack of response when seeking to solve these issues. No reply at all until AirBnB support got involved, and even then not a good response.
So, all in all it's a nice place, but please communicate with your guests, fix the WiFi, and maybe buy another electric space heater to add to the one we left.

I really enjoyed the place. The hosts were a bit nitpicky about certain things, like having guests over and keeping a camera on the door to monitor this- I get this but it felt a little invasive. I also was only provided with 1/3 of a roll of toilet paper for a 6 day stay and when I asked about extra I was told to buy it myself… I would have been happy to but 1/3 of a roll for 6 days is a little ridiculous.
I was also questioned heavily about the use of blankets and towels. Die Unterkunft war absolut top. Sehr sauber, wie in der Beschreibung, geräumig und stilvoll eingerichtet. Sehr netter Host und perfekte Lage mit vielen Restaurants, wir kommen gerne wieder.

Dafür, dass die Buchung relativ kurzfristig stattgefunden hat, habe ich mich sehr gut und freundlich vom Gastgeber aufgenommen gefühlt.

Vorgefunden haben wir eine saubere und geräumige Wohnung mit schöner Einrichtung und allen Möglichkeiten der Selbstversorgung.

I used to live in Prenzlauer Berg and will never tire of its charm. The apartment matches the area to perfection and it is nestled away on the top floor of a lovely apartment complex. The hosts were very quick to respond with queries and were generously able to let me check in slightly early to accommodate my early flight, which is very easy to do<3 It is very well equipped with amenities, the only suggestion I could give was that there was no kitchen roll - otherwise there was an abundance of toilet paper, towels and basic cooking ingredients. It was just such lovely experience and the building and street are extremely safe like the bulk of Prenzlauer Berg and it’s somewhere I do hope to return to again soon! If you are coming in the spring and summer it is worth it alone for the patio and balcony to soak up the sun. Just lovely and beautiful, thank you! ❤️❤️
A well sized apartment in a great location. Florian was easy to communicate with. Also very helpful having a coffee machine.

Ein absoluter Traum! So kann Urlaub in einer Großstadt zum wahren Ruhegenuss werden!

Mieszkanie było chyba wcześniej sklepem i można by je lepiej dostosować do wynajmu pod nocleg. Nie ma korytarza, więc pokój dzielą od ulicy tylko cienkie drzwi. Do tego okno prosto na chodnik na poziomie wzroku przechodniów, kiepsko zasłonięte i nie zabezpieczone żaluzjami antywłamaniowymi. Nie czuliśmy się przez to do końca prywatnie/komfortowo/bezpiecznie.
Na pierwszy rzut oka było posprzątane, ale w trakcie pobytu odkrywaliśmy, że nie do końca dokładnie. Na przykład gniazdka są bardzo brudne, w niektórych miejscach był kurz, w łazience był specyficzny zapach rozcieńczonej chemii lub niepłukanej szmatki do sprzątania.
Komunikacja z gospodarzem była bardzo dobra, zameldowanie bezproblemowe, cena była dobra -- oferta ma sporo zalet nawet pomimo powyższych problemów.
Alles super. Sehr stimmig, angenehm und unfassbar ruhig in dem Apartment.

What an amazing space and neighborhood!  Our hosts were so kind and lovely and so accommodating as we checked in and had questions about the city.  Thank you, thank you.  So awesome.

Merci à Nicole pour son accueil et sa gentillesse. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour dans son appart qui est très bien situé à trois minutes à pied d’une station de metro.

Great rooms and great value. Clean and in a location quite reasonably close to the main areas of the city. Very close to a beautiful park

Every single aspect of Erik’s apartment is worthy of 8 stars.

I really enjoyed staying here! It's really nice to get a place that's nice and secluded from the rest of town (though luckily it's a stone's throw away from a tram stop).
The place itself was beautiful. It is newly remodeled and has a clean, modern look. The kitchen was handy for making breakfast and I was a big fan of the motorized window shades in the bedroom (which Germans seem to really love).
The home included some other nice modern touches too, like lights that can change color with the touch of a remote and a nice Bluetooth speaker for listening to some music.
Christoph was great to work with as well. He was very flexible with his check in and check out times, and overall was quite helpful.
If you want to be right in the city center where the action is this probably isn't for you, but if you want to really feel like a local for a few days this is just perfect.

The hosts were very attentive and welcoming. Location is very good. The area is full of restaurants and bars and the apartment is easyly accessible by public means. The house is very spacious, for one o two people, with a small full kitchen available. Things to improve: the place was clean, but not sparkling clean, there were some cleaning issues in the kitchen and bathroom. The hosts have left only two small towels, for a 6 day stay. That's not enough, probably. There was not shampoo, either. And finally, there was also a small water leakage from the WC. Overall it was good value for money, in my opinion. But they need to pay more attention to details, and improve cleanliness. Also the apartment needs a little restructuring, at least.

Das war hier nicht der Fall und für uns zwei große Pluspunkte!
Und dazu noch: Die gute Lage. Fußläufig erwischt man zu jeder Zeit zügig eine Straßenbahn (Bersarinplatz) oder eine U-Bahn (Frankfurter Tor).
Direkt um die Ecke ist der Kiezmarkt zum einkaufen und ein reichhaltiges Angebot an Restaurants.
Absoluter Favorit für uns: nur 5 min zu Fuß: Café Tasso (biozertifiziertes Café und Antiquariat mit endloser Auswahl an gebrauchten Büchern für jeweils 2,50 Euro). Staying like a local, not just a tourist. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

The stairs were merely an annoyance during my comings and goings throughout he 4-day stay but I could handle them. Das Zimmer ist an und für sich sehr schön und vollkommen ausreichend für Reisende, die den ganzen Tag unterwegs sind und nur Abends in die Unterkunft zurück kehren. Allerdings war unser Zimmer nicht sauber. Die Fußleisten waren dick mit Staub belegt, ebenso das obere Regal im Badezimmer. Die Kaffeemaschine war eingestaubt, auch auf den vorhandenen Kapseln waren Flecken. Die schwarze Leiste, welche sichtbar wird, wenn man Geschirrspüler und co. öffnet war voll mit Krümel und Staub. Die Schranktür wies dunkle Handabdrücke vor. Gläser waren dreckig. Auf der Ablage am Bett und auf dem Waschbecken lagen fremde Haare. Wir haben nach dem Check In deshalb um eine erneute Reinigung gebeten. Darauf wurde schnell reagiert und eine Lösung angeboten. Am nächsten Tag war auch nochmal jemand im Zimmer, die Betten waren gemacht und Handtücher wurden getauscht, der Schmutz inklusive Haare war aber immer noch da. Ich habe daraufhin noch einmal das Gespräch gesucht. Daraufhin kam ein junger Mann in unser Zimmer, welcher gegenüber meinem Mann sehr unfreundlich wurde. Er wischte an besagten Stellen noch einmal lustlos drüber. Richtig sauber gemacht habe ich im Anschluss selbst. Das sollte so nicht sein und hat dazu geführt,dass wir uns nicht richtig wohl fühlen konnten. Zudem sind die Zimmer zum Flur hin sehr hellhörig. Die Türen knallen extrem laut ins Schloss. Davon wird man nachts sogar wach. Für zukunftige Gäste wäre es diesbezüglich hilfreich, wenn das Personal etwas Rücksicht nehmen -und die Türklinken in die Hand nehmen würde. Gerade am Morgen, wenn das Personal vermutlich gerade die Zimmer reinigt, knall es am laufenden Band. Das könnte man ganz einfach vermeiden. Alles in allem waren wir etwas enttäuscht und hoffen, dass die mangelnde Sauberkeit nur ein Einzelfall war, denn die Unterkunft hat wirklich Potential.

Ich reiste mit dem Auto an und konnte glücklicherweise direkt vor dem Haus parken. Reccomended!

We ate lots of lovely meals in nearby restaurants, but really loved the bakery directly below the apartment. Perfect for teenagers.
The ‘stumbling stone’ memorials at the doorway are poignant and give you pause.
You can see the TV tower from the window. The park outside is lovely for kids. Bring your ping pong set for teenagers.
Overall, a lovely stay. We felt honoured to stay and I’d definitely return if life allows.

Logement propre, grand et bien placé

Lovely place to enjoy Berlin.

Wir waren für 12 Tage während der Fußball EM in Alexanders Unterkunft und es war alles super! Die Wohnung ist gut mit dem Bus erreichbar oder mit den U-Bahnen die am Kottbusser Tor bzw. Südstern halten (ca. 10 Minuten Fußweg).

Wir waren in Alexanders Unterkunft sehr gerne und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Because of an accidentally double booking Birgit cleaned up her whole own apartment to let us stay in there. The next day she moved our luggage to the apartment which is described above. It is a lovely, spacious, light and clean apartment. We stayed with 8 friends and we had enough space. The communication with Birgit was easily, we had enough keys and because of the hassle of the double booking we didn't have to pay for one person extra.
Prenzlauer Berg is a nice neighbourhood with cosy bars and restaurants close by. The U-bahn and tram are also close to the apartment from where you can easily get to the rest of the city. I would recommend this apartment when you are visiting Berlin!

Situated in a perfect area with so much to do in both directions, the apartment has pristine vibes and character. That window seat is iconic. Franz is a dedicated and patient host. Book this masterpiece flat TODAY!

Her şey için çok teşekkürler ❤️

Honestly this place was literally perfect for my first trip to Berlin. The home was very clean and in this lovely pre-war building with high ceilings. There’s a quite convenient corner store for snacks, breakfast, wine, etc. And a great Chinese restaurant within steps as well. Lovely neighborhood, I felt very safe. I highly recommend this place. I will be re-booking for my next stay here. Host was very responsive and had great recommendations as far as food, shopping and local things to do.

The location was next to transport links which made travelling to the tourist sites easy. The location was quiet and away from the hustle and business of the city. Perfect for resting in between touring. Nice little bakery nearby and supermarkets a short walk away. The apartment was very clean and comfortable. Would definitely stay again if visiting Berlin.
Excellent location, apartment, and very friendly and attentive host.
Great stylish place in a perfect neighborhood with everything you need.

This was the perfect location for our Berlin adventures. We were close to U-bahn and S-bahn stops, we could easily walk to restaurants and points of interest. The room and facilities were clean and easy for us to access with the keypad, and our room faced an interior park so our nights were quiet. We would definitely stay here again!

Thomas und Alexandra waren perfekte Gastgeber. Schon im Vorfeld war die Kommunikation schnell, unkompliziert und einfach. Gerne wieder und sehr empfehlenswert.

Excellent apartment for a stay in Berlin, very well located and clean. Highly recommend.
Hat alles gepasst. War sauber. Bei heißen Tagen war die Klimaanlage meine Rettung!

Staying with Louisa was so nice - she is extremely accomodating and her place is perfectly set up and clean. It's in a very central area close to public transport but in a quiet neighborhood. The building has an elevator and a nice courtyard garden.
Perfect for the solo traveler!

Eine außergewöhnlich tolle Wohnmöglichkeit. Sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Die Gastgeber Paulo und Guido sind sehr nett und zuvorkommend. Sie sind sehr um das Wohl ihrer Gäste bemüht. Auf jeden Fall sehr empfehlenswert!

The place was in an awesome location. S Bahn nearby. Cafes and bars all around with a market easily accessible. It was perfect. Except for 3 things. Having to buzz a door to an Airbnb you are staying at and not have a front door key is really weird and made us very uneasy anytime we came back to get in.
There is no light in the foyer of the building so entering the code on the smart lock was very tough to see even in day. The code also changed a number of times while we were there.
And finally one of the bedrooms really is the dining room and is also meant to be the living room or lounge. I would never recommend that 5 people stay there. 2-4
I know that you don’t spent much time in your flat when you travel but still having a living area/lounge would have been nice. I must have missed this detail
The owner was very kind and responsive. And I am not putting the flat down at all. It was lovely. And we had a an awesome stay. I always like to keep it real when I review places.

The apartment was a good base for us for a couple of nights, close to the people we were visiting, in a nice area. Lots of transport links close by, supermarkets, and plenty of bars and restaurants. Anyway there are chairs and tables in the bedrooms to sit at if one wanted to cook and eat in the apartment. The beds are comfortable. It is a quiet building, just the normal road noises in a big city. We enjoyed sitting on the balcony!

Sehr schöne Wohnung in ruhiger Lage. Highlight ist der Balkon mit Liegen. Arne ist sehr freundlich. Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt genossen. Das einzige, was wir in den Sommertagen vermisst haben, ist ein besserer Kühlschrank mit Kühlabteilung.

Eine Insel der Ruhe in mitten von Berlin.

Sandra was very wonderful. She made sure I felt comfortable and right at home. The room is spacious and comfortable and so is the bathroom. Thank you for a lovely stay!

Clean and comfortable, about 5 min. walk to the U-Bahn. The builiding is old but the appartment is recently renovated.

Beyond our expectations ! Everything about our trip to Berlin was exceptional thanks to Felix’s hospitality and care. Zimmer war sauber, Technik hat funktioniert, nette Leute am Empfang und Auffülstationen für Wasser im Gang.
Top lage.

Everything went smoothly from the check-in to living in the apartment. Kerstin is super friendly, kind, and always ready to help — thank for that!

The apartment was spacious and the neighborhood was nice and quiet. There was good and free parking in the yard for a car. The nearest metro stacion is about 1,5km away and the bus stop across the street. This is good place to stay for its price.
Hannes ist ein sehr angenehmer Mensch und seine Wohnung ist sehr sauber, ordentlich und schön. Es war eine gute Zeit dort.

perfekt for sightseeing.

Dort fehlte es an nichts, auch in der Küche und im Bad war alles vorzufinden, was man benötigt. Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt mit 3 Generationen gehabt!
Schöne Wohnung die für 6 Personen nicht zu klein und nicht zu groß ist. Sehr entspannt am Treptower Park gelegen. Check-In und Check-Out waren sehr simpel und entspannt ✌️

Merci Carmen pour ce séjour si doux et à bientôt, car c'est sûr, nous reviendrons !

Safe, nice, clean, affordable. I never ONCE felt unsafe. Walking distance to shops, restaurants, beer, and tourist attractions. More like a hotel without a front desk than local apartment. Would stay again!

Better place than you expect, perfect position, everything clean and no disturbs of any kind!

Amazing location and a beautiful flat! Had such a lovely stay!

Host's communication was great. Apartment was clean, spaceous, great location with park and small store nearby.

Superschnuckelige Unterkunft. Sehr zentral und dennoch ruhig.

Amazing neighborhood, restaurants, bars and close to the metro. Not sure if this is standard in Germany but the shades outside the door were also great for noise/added security. Very clean and very easy check-in/check-out.

Maravillados con el trato de Ugur, habitación cómoda, estancia como que estuvieras en casa, agradecidos por su amabilidad y su trato! Quizás lo único que para el tiempo que nosotros íbamos a pasar en Berlín, perdimos mucho tiempo en transporte público! Pero por lo demás todo genial ☺️

Die Unterkunft hat eine gute Lage, um Berlin zu besichtigen. Die Straßenbahn-Haltestelle befindet sich in der Straße, sowie ein Netto.
Die Unterkunft war sauber und gut ausgestattet.
Nur nach einer Toilettenspülung dauerte es sehr lange, bis man diese wieder betätigen konnte. Bei vier Personen ist dies ein unangenehmes Problem.
Wir entschieden uns für die Unterkunft, da in der Beschreibung steht, dass ein kostenloser Parkplatz auf dem Grundstück sei, da wir mit PKW anreisen. Nachdem der Anreisetag gekommen war und der Infoaustausch mit der Schlüsselbox einwandfrei funktionierte, fragten wir nach, wo wir genau den Parkplatz finden, leider bekamen wir bis heute keine Antwort darauf.
Wahrscheinlich auch wegen der Baustelle, war es schwierig einen Parkplatz in der Nähe der Unterkunft zu finden.
Alles Top, kann ich nur weiter empfehlen.
Tolle Ausstattung, super Lage und unkomplizierter Check in. Kann ich nur weiter empfehlen

We spent 5 very enjoyable days in Berlin.  Louis's apartment was just as advertised and Louis was a wonderful host.  The apartment is very comfortable and located in a very pleasant and interesting neighborhood that has easy access to the rest of the city.  Louis was thoughtful and very responsive to any needs and was very solicitous in making our stay comfortable and hassle free.  He  made us feel very welcome but also was totally not intrusive. I highly recommend Louis and his apartment.

Le logement de Tracy est super. Très bien placé, à deux pas du métro, de nombreux restaurants et commerces.

Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit in der Unterkunft und kommen gerne wieder! Die Lage ist super und  auch mit (Klein)Kindern eine Empfehlung. Wahid war sehr freundlich & hilfsbereit. Vielen Dank!

I would stay there again.
Apartamento cómodo, muy limpio y tranquilo, mucha naturaleza alrededor. Flora es una gran anfitriona, siempre estuvo  pendiente y sus indicaciones acerca del alojamiento fueron más que precisas.
Es la segunda vez que nos alojamos y todo fue genial...como siempre

Onze zoons voelden zich er helemaal thuis. Vooraf had ik twijfels of de hoogslaper ruim genoeg zou zijn voor onze lange tienerzoons, maar onze 17-jarige kon er gewoon rechtop zitten.

Marcus reageert snel en vriendelijk. Al met al een topverblijf!

Mohammad is a one of a kind Airbnb host. For the price my boyfriend and I paid, we were not expecting such wonderful hospitality. From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with open arms and positive vibes. We felt safe and able to relax with Muhammad, but still have some privacy when it was appropriate. The area surrounding the place is one of the cheapest in Berlin, with some places offering pizza for as cheap as €2! The area is always busy and the nightlife is bustling, so it always feels safe no matter the time of day. Most shopkeepers speak English, so don’t worry if your German isn’t up to scratch hahah. If it wasn’t for Muhammad’s helpful tips, our time in Berlin wouldn’t have been the same at all! We highly recommend staying here!
很好，房间很舒适，很干净，房东也很细心，详细介绍了很多事项给我们，人很Nice。交通也比较方便，不远就有电车，唯一美中不足的就是没有电梯。。但是也没办法的

Clean cute apartment. But it’s the ground floor so sometime it was uncomfortable. Location is far from the center, but it’s fine that the stores, bars and restaurant were really close to apartment. So it’s good:)

Very helpful and friendly host family.  The location was perfect for our stay,to be close to Schoennenfeld Airport. The apartment was as expected. Very clean, modern accomodations.

Sehr schöne Wohnung, cooler Balkon, mega Lage - perfekt für eine Städtereise!
