In der Küche findet man alles, was man braucht. Die Gäste gehen freundlich und besonnen miteinander um. Die Einrichtung ist einfach aber ausreichend und warm. Ich hatte einen kleinen Buddha auf dem Balkon. :)
Ich hätte mir einen telefonischen Direktkontakt bzw. eine telefonische Ansprechmöglichkeit außerhalb der Rezeptionszeit gewünscht, gerade weil mein Check-in nur spät möglich war und wir auch nie vor 18 Uhr zurück sein konnten. (Internet ging initial nicht und war wichtig für die Weiterbildung, Schlüsselschloss-Problemchen, öffnete sich nur schwer) Es hat am Ende alles aber funktioniert. Insgesamt bin ich dankbar, dieses Örtchen gefunden gehabt zu haben. Perfekt für uns.
Really nice host and definitely worth your money!

Bruno is nice host and the place is very nice , better than on the photos. It was really quiet and good for sleeping. Nice location close to Berlin wall leftovers , walking distance to alex platz and further to museums...if you are tired to walk, metro is 2 min from the building.

Great value for money! On a fairly busy street with a bus and tram stop less than 1 minute away. Lots of restaurants and bars in the area, but a 20 minute travel if you want to get to city-centre. Overall, a good stay.
Very clean apartment , spacious and cozy !
Cozy and comfortable

We loved our stay at the Berlin house. The house is located in a lovely neighborhood with lots of coffee shops, bars and restaurants to enjoy. The place is unique and nicely decorated and the bed is very comfortable. Would definitely stay here again!
Very quiet and peaceful neighborhood right outside of the central city.

Samuel ist ein freundlicher und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber. Das Apartment entsprach der Beschreibung. Es war alles sauber, der Balkon war toll mit Blick ins Grüne. Wir haben uns für einen kurzen Aufenthalt sehr wohl gefühlt. Danke Samuel! :-)
Everything was very good!
Alles perfekt, klare Empfehlung.
A kind a professional host.

Alles was tot in de puntjes geregeld voor onze ontvangst.
Alles is aanwezig of kan gevraagd worden. Een echte aanrader als je Berlijn wil bezoeken. Heel rustige buurt. Winkel vlakbij ook (je moet wel eventjes vragen waar hij is).
Great place to stay and an interesting area. Would stay here again.
Tolles Apartment. Wir habe uns sehr wohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder.

V inzerátu chybí pár informací. Jako to, že se ubytování nachází v rozestavěné budově, což vede k nepořádku. Dále nám nebylo komfortní, že se v pokoji nachází průchozí dveře do bytu, které nešly zamknout. Jinak bylo vše v pořádku, hostitel byl milý. Ubytování pěkně zařízené.

Appartement très bien situé, à 2 pas du métro et d'un supermarché. Tout est très propre et bien entretenu, le lit est parfait pour se remettre d'une journée de marche, et comme précisé dans l'annonce, il y a tout ce qu'il faut.
Chaude recommandation !
I had a wonderful stay at Nihat’s apartment in Berlin! The place was spacious, cozy, and very clean—exactly what I was looking for. The location was perfect, in a great neighborhood!

We had a lovely time at Marie‘s home. Besides being located so close to the lake, the home makes a great place to rest and unwind. Definitely comfortable and relaxing. It is well-connected to the main city with its‘ public transportation. And Marie is a warm host - kind, lovely and understanding. Thank you for having us! We certainly hope to visit again.
het verblijf bij Numa in Berlijn was erg goed bevallen. Werkelijks niks aan te merken op de ruimte, locatie in de stad en de communicatie. Wij willen in het najaar weer een keer komen.
Fantastic place
Muy limpio. Ubicación extraordinaria. Muy cerquita del metro. Trato exquisito del casero, que domina el español y en inglés.
the house was nice and clean, comfortable . the bathroom was big.
es war ein wunderschöneraugenthslt in Berlin, schöne Unterkunft.
il nostro soggiorno da Olga è stato molto piacevole, l'appartamento è in una posizione comodissima per raggiungere i principali luoghi d'interesse ed è molto pulito. Super consigliato!

I have nothing but praise for our host Patrick and the accommodation in Berlin - the apartment was spacious, spotless and had the feel of a cool artist’s loft. My friend Anna and I really enjoyed the vibe! The neighborhood was also great for us, offering lots of nearby options for restaurants and fun bars. We were pleasantly surprised by how large the apartment is, and how quiet the building was during our stay. We liked the place so much that we would probably choose to live in a place just like if we ever decide to buy a property in Berlin! So, from our perspective, the flat was a fantastic find and we would not hesitate to book it again!

Krisztina was a super great host. We really felt at home in her apartment. The place is cool, clean, safe and cosy, the room is spacious and comfortable. We've meet personally and got in touch by messages as well and she was always a very kind and warm person even since our very first contact, by the site. She gave us many tips about the city and was at our disposal to solve any question. The neighborhood was a great surprise and made our stay in this lovely city became even better. We highly recommend her place and we'd surely stay at her apartment again. Thanks, Kitty :)
El apartamento es muy comodo que cuenta con buen menaje de cocina y todo lo necesario para una estancia comoda.
Me gustó bastante

I stayed for a weekend with my girlfriend. Stefan's apartment is very nice and in a pleasant neighborhood. All practicalities worked very smooth, and Stefan was helpful and quick to respond. We especially appreciated his tips for breakfast and dinner in the nearby area.
Amazing place and super central

Prachtig appartement. Zo schoon en zo strak als op de foto’s!
Dicht bij tempelhof, heerlijk om te fietsen.
Wij kunnen niet tegen kinderen en boven dit appartement woont een gezin met een kind van 3/4 jaar oud. Die rent en schreeuwt tot 0:30. Echt vreselijk voor je vakantie. Wij wonen zelf in een flat en ontsnappen daar juist graag van. Helaas is dit appartement niet voor onze rust weggelegd.
Hele aardige eigenaren om ons meteen uit te kunnen checken zodat wij naar een goed geluidsdichte geïsoleerde Holiday In hotel konden vluchten. Airbnb appartementen gaan wij nooit meer doen.
Mocht je tegen rennende, dreunende, gillende en krijsende kinderen kunnen tot diep in de nacht dan is dit appartement perfect voor jou, want het is brandschoon en voorzien van alles wat je nodig hebt voor een heerlijk verblijf in Berlijn.
The beds were incredibly comfortable and the location was perfect
Very nice Host. Everything Fine. Thank you!
A lovely studio for a short visit to Berlin!
Wonderful location and perfect room for my week's stay. Christian and Vemo were communicative, thoughtful, and kind. Would stay again for sure. Lovely little kitten, too!

Der Aufenthalt bei Helena war einfach nur schön. In einer ruhigen Lage wo man direkt vor der Tür parken kann. Die Kommunikation war unkompliziert. Jedes Schlafzimmer verfügt über ein eigenes schönes Bad. Ein eigener Eingang von der Terrasse führt in die Wohnung. Ich kann Helenas Unterkunft bedenkenlos empfehlen. Beim nächsten Besuch komme ich gerne wieder

Gostamos muito da estadia por 30 dias no flat do Olli. Muito limpo e organizado. Tem mercado aí lado e duas estações do metrô bem perto. Prédio antigo mas limpo e seguro. Recomendamos principalmente pelo atendimento. Inté e Axé .

Alles in allem war die Unterkunft in einem guten Zustand und grundsätzlich alles inordnung.
Schade fande ich nur, dass es mir praktisch unmöglich war zu Duschen, da das Wasser ständig zwischen Kalt und Heiss pendelte.
Good room and welcoming host!

We, 6 girls, arrived to the most amazing flat in the middle of the night!
Easy to find. Close to the U-bahn Birkenstasse. Close to a large shop. Close to resturants, ATM, some döner places and walking distance to Hautbanhof.
We spend more evenings in the flat than in town!
Der Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm und lief reibungslos ab. Die Gastgeber waren sehr hilfsbereit und konnten flexibel auf unsere Rückfragen reagieren.
It was very pleasure time in Berlin. House was beautiful and host Christine was very kind.

If someone visiting Berlin I would highly recommend to stay at Ilia's and Olga's apartment. It is absolutely amazing. If you are one, who is really into arts, you would really love it. The whole place has Berlin's unique atmosphere. The walls are decorated with paintings, and pictures and the flat has a wonderful catchy vibe. It will tune you to the city. Location-wise, it is not in the "inner-inner" city, but that is what makes it the best. You can sleep well, without disturbed by noises, and when you wake up you find yourself in Tiergarten, with full of trees and fresh air. There are a couple of really good places to grab a beer, or a refreshing breakfast. If you consider always staying close to the inner city, hop on a bike, maximum 10 minutes.
Dejligt ophold

This was an amazing stay.
Place is well located (walkable, close to tram and subway, nearby to supermarket, restaurants, etc.).
The host was great - communicating proactively to ensure the best configuration ahead of our stay. Also very helpful and flexible around check in and check out.
The house is spacious and functional, great for a family of 5.

Großzügige Anlage, hoher Raum, große Fenster, sehr modern. Großer Schreibtisch was für Geschäftsreisen ein Vorteil ist. Zentrale Lage gut erreichbar, trotzdem wegen Seitengasse relativ ruhig. Einziges Manko: das stete Blinklicht der COs Messanlage an der Tür stört, wenn man Lichtempfindlich ist, da kann man sich eine bessere Lösung überlegen. Alles in allem was man braucht um zwischen 3 und 6 Tagen hier zu verweilen.

We had a fantastic stay! The room is small but has everything you need. Ideal for a couple or a solo traveller. The location is excellent and just a few minutes walk from the station. Miriam was also very helpful and responsive to messages.
Beautiful space and very convenient access to public transit. Some difficulty with check in but beyond this perfectly nice lodging to explore Berlin. Overall would recommend.
it was awesome. best place for making friends, aspasialy for New Year :)

The apartment is located in a very nice and quiet area. Walking distance to two different U-bahn stops and the tram, as well as a lot of different restaurants and cafes around. Is not very sound proof, but as the are is relatively quiet, we found that to be of no issue. The apartment is small, but we were two people who could easily stay there for almost a week. The mattress was very comfortable, the pillows not so much. Everything you need is within close distance. We enjoyed our stay, it is a nice place to have as a base for exploring Berlin!
War sehr sauber und liebevoll eingerichtet
Für uns hat die Unterkunft in allen Bereichen gepasst!

Die Kommunikation sowie der Check-In liefen sehr reibungslos ab. Etienne hat schnell geantwortet und sich drum gekümmert, dass wir ohne Probleme in die Unterkunft kommen. Die Wohnung ist geräumig und sehr schön. Die Lage ist perfekt. Nachts ist es etwas laut mit offenen Fenstern, aber das geht bei der Lage nicht anders.
Ich denke die Wohnung ist wirklich toll für kälteres Wetter. Wir waren im Juni dort und ich muss sagen, wenn es meine Wohnung gewesen wäre, hätte ich sie niemals vermietet. Es hatte dort oben durch das Glasdach sicher um die 40 Grad. Es war unerträglich heiss und wir waren quasi gezwungen den ganzen Tag unterwegs zu sein. Tagsüber ist einem der Schweiss dauerhaft runtergelaufen, weil es so unfassbar heiss war. Leider konnten wir den Aufenthalt daher nicht wirklich genießen. Ich hatte das Glasdach gesehen, aber ging davon aus, dass wenn man 300/€ Nacht zahlt, dafür gesorgt ist, dass man sich auch darin aufhalten kann, leider war das nicht der Fall.
I loved it!
Сказочный домик💐
Katja's place had everything we expected and more. Clean, cozy, great location and nice hosts. :-)
Danke für den schönen Aufenthalt. Sehr schönes Zimmer mit Bad und allen Dingen die man benötigt.
Modern eingerichtet sehr gute Lage und sehr sauber.

Ute was flexible with us leaving our luggage in the apartment before check -in and gave good recommendations around the neighborhood. She also responded to all of our questions (how to rent cheap bikes.) The apartment was perfect for a short stay.

Apple City is perfect for a few night stay. My girlfriend and I stayed in a small room with a double bed. It was good enough for us, but if you’re staying 3 or more days, it might become a bit squishy (the rooms are quite small). In saying that, the room itself was nice, the bathroom was good, and everything required (i.e., soaps etc) is provided. It is also quite central, with a train station and tram stop just metres from the door. Would definitely stay here again.

L’alloggio di Ambra è in una zona residenziale ma collegata in modo eccellente al centro città. Casa spaziosa, camera luminosa, bagno dotato di ogni comfort. Consiglio a tutti di alloggiare qui se siete a Berlino
We can really recommend this place.

Appartement très joli, lumineux et fonctionnel, situé à proximité des transports et de restaurants.
Natalia a été très accueillante, je recommande vivement cet appartement
Excelente lugar, con clase y detalles. Muy bien ubicado y seguro. Llegamos muy cansados y todo estaba listo. Sin duda lo recomiendo ampliamente.

We really enjoyed our staying. The studio is very neat and beautiful, we really enjoyed living in such a colourful and comfortable apartment!
I think we also had good luck being at the Weser street, I think it’s a wonderful neighbourhood.
Es war ein angenehmer Aufenthalt.

Buen apartamento, con buena comunicación. Parada de metro en la puerta con líneas de metro al centro. Muy buena acogida y todo como se indica en las fotos y en las referencias. Si volvemos repetiremos.
Alles wunderbar.

The location is just perfect, in the heart of Berlin, most of the stuff is walkable or just a few metro stops away. Interestingly it is very calm and silent! The flat was clean and just as described.
Zirkada was extremely responsive and friendly.
Definitely would recommend and come back!

The Location is really near the station that you can easy to get City Center.And in 10mins Walk have 3 different supermarkets.
The breakfast JUST means tea and coffee offer.
You only use the Waschmaschine with host once a week(or more).
And actually she don't want you use kitchen too much.
Cange bed sheet and towel once a week.

i stay here for a month.sometime i felt that be keep a close watch over anything...and actually i just know little about deutsch,so it will be hard to understood all that meaning.so maybe sometime i got wrong.

It's a very nice PLACE.but make sure if you know what will Happen if you live with landlord....
Todo lo ofrecido en este departamento es veridico, mi pareja, hija y yo tuvimos una estancia muy confortable y sin dudarlo volveremos en el futuro, recomiendo este alojamiento en berlin.

the very friendly owner , just arrived he gave us all the information to reggiungere the center, the location of the house is in a very quiet neighborhood in total relaxation , near the tram stop and bus to reach the cemntro Mitte , the house is well maintained clean , modern , very bright , spacious bathroom with all the comforts , it was a pleasant stay , Berlin is wonderful to see how the Germans very helpful and smiling , thanks for everything !

Fadeih is a great host, very helpfull, friendly and welcoming. Her appartment is very nice, well decorated, clean and well located. The neighbourhood is great, lovely restaurants, bars, trendy but not loud. I highly recommend!
Really comfortable, clean und private place to stay in Charlottenburg. Can 100% recommend!
Loved our stay. Central location yet very calm. Also very convenient with a baby as it’s on the ground floor with only few stairs. Would stay again!

Sehr nette, unklomplizierte und freundliche Vermieter.
Haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Great place to stay in a nice safe neighborhood with lots of good food and drink walking distance away, as well as close public transit.
Apartment rooms were spacious and beds were comfortable. Perfect for our group of 5, would stay here again

The apartment is in a perfect location in Friedrichshain, close to nice bars and restaurants, second-hand shops, etc. It is calm and quiet, bright and spacious, very clean and with all the necessary commodities. I can only recommend it!

A really cozy and warm apartment! We (a group of 6) widely take advantage of the number of bathrooms and the kitchen for an intense trip to Berlin. Oliver was very patient since our flight got delayed, and he was waiting for us with a great smile. Highly recommended.

Stefan's apartment in East Berlin was ideal. I stayed with my boyfriend and dad for four nights to check out the sights & the apartment was in a great location - literally a few minutes walk to a u-bahn station & great supermarket. The king size bed & bunks beds were very comfortable. Quiet & clean. We ate out every night but the apartment has everything you need to cook etc. Would be perfect for families too. Can't fault anything. Would stay again!
Very nice apartment with good facilities. However, some hooks would be nice for coats when you step In.

Al bij de ontvangst door Ronald voelden we ons op ons gemak. Via gsm stonden we in contact met hem, Ronald reageerde zeer vlug op onze vragen. Alle tips qua bezoeken en restaurants waren prima ! De air bnb is gelegen in een rustige buurt. De voorstelling op air bnb is volledig zoals in de realiteit. Zeker een aanrader ! Groeten Peter, Sonja, Annick & Frank uit West-Vlaanderen België.
Bardzo fajny lokal i miła obsługa polecam
Alles super - grad auch Kommunikation etc. einwandfrei.
Super nette Kommunikation. Gute Lage,  die Tram ist nur wenige Meter entfernt. Alles sehr sauber. Einziges Manko war das sehr laute Bett, es hat bei jeder Bewegung geknackt.
Just know that you need 4 keys to get through 4 doors and climb 4 flights of large stairs to get to the unit.  Place is cool though!
Sehr tolles sauberes Zimmer
Die Wohnung war super – sauber, gut ausgestattet und gut gelegen. Der Gastgeber war gut erreichbar und der Check-in verlief dank der klaren Beschreibung unkompliziert.
Decent place to stay in Berlin !

Amazing location, incredibly private apartment, has everything you need for a great stay in a central neighborhood in Berlin. Carsten and his wife were incredibly helpful, with quick responses and a hospitable attitude.

Wir waren zum zweiten Mal für einen Kurzaufenthalt bei Masuda & Klemens und es war wieder eine ganz schöne Zeit für unsere Kinder und uns! Unsere 4jährige Tochter fragte schon auf der Hinfahrt, ob wir wieder in die schöne Wohnung fahren würden :)...
Es war ein perfekter Teelöffel Urlaub!
A nice room with a private bathroom. You can go to the center in 20 minutes by public transport. It is a good place if you want to stay in Berlin.
Ei mitään ikäviä yllätyksiä, vaan kaikki toimi, kuten pitikin. Huone oli siisti ja sijaitsi hyvällä paikalla Mittessä. Wifi oli hidas, mutta oikein muuta negatiivista ei pysty sanomaan.

Wir hatten drei wundervolle Tage in Berlin, was nicht zuletzt an der wunderschönen Wohnung bei Familie Nass lag. Wir, (2 Erwachsene, 1 Kind (6) ), waren von der Ferienwohnung mehr als begeistert. So schön und liebevoll eingerichtet, dass man sich wie zu Hause gefühlt hat. Der Empfang von Virginie und Sebastian war sehr herzlich und alles verlief total unkompliziert. Wenn wir etwas gebraucht hätten, wären sie jederzeit da gewesen aber wir waren wunschlos glücklich. Unser Sohn plant schon die nächste Berlinreise und wir wissen schon jetzt, wo wir unterkommen werden. :) Danke euch beiden!
La casa está en un barrio tranquilo y muy cerca del centro. El apartamento es cómodo y la anfitriona súper atenta y detallista. Muy recomendable!

It was great to meet Ben, legend of a bloke and superb host!
I felt very comfortable in his space as he was very welcoming, calm and considerate.
The place was clean and felt like home.
He gave me lots of tips for the area as well as some good conversation.

El lugar es de muy facil acceso. Hay transporte público cerca. Heidi puso a disposición varios espacios de la casa y nos dio independencia con las llaves. Sin embargo, encontramos incomodo el fuerte olor a cigarro. Nosotras no fumamos y nos incomodó. Estamos agradecidas por la hospalidad y los detalles que ella tiene con los huespedes.
host molto molto disponibile e  gentile,appartamento molto ben curato e comodo per tutto

I stayed with Andrea for 3 months and loved it. I would definitely recommend it to anyone. The space is even more beautiful than the pictures. Andrea was really a lovely and thoughtful host. It's in a beautiful, quiet area with a park nearby, but it's also very close to public transportation and within walking distance of lots of grocery stores, restaurants and cafes, museums, the Deutsche Oper, etc. I feel really lucky to have stayed there!
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Alles top.

It’s important to note that we never made it to this location. A specific city sticker was required to enter this location, which was not mentioned in the location’s profile.
Positive: the team tried to help us trouble shot, but it was too late for that. Team agreed to provide a refund, but didn’t respond to Airbnb Support when they reached out about the refund.

Rachele's place was great. The apartment is well organized and spacious. It's very well connected to public transport and there's a Rewe right around the corner. The kitchen has great pans and utensils, and Rachele was kind enough to share the kitchen essentials with me. If there's something to be wary of, it's that there's no elevator, which means you'll need to climb quite a few stairs to get to the apartment.

The apartment was clean and well located with easy access to trains. A little more noise because of the busy construction activity around but not a problem.
We are a family of four with two teenagers and this apartment was perfect for us. I recommend this to anyone visiting Berlin. Catherine was a good responsive host. 👍👍
Das Häuschen ist eine wunderbar, schön designte Unterkunft mit urigen Innenhof, zentral in Berlin-Köpenick gelegen, sehr nette und aufmerksame Gastgeber, wir haben schöne Tage dort verbracht
Nice view and the place is quiet.

Ich hatte bei Monika mein erstes Airbnb-Erlebnis und bin begeistert. Die Wohnung ist wunderbar sauber und ich habe mich sofort wohlgefühlt. Monika ist ein sehr herzlicher Mensch. Da ich öfter zum Studium in Berlin bin, werde ich auf jeden Fall wieder versuchen, bei Monika unterzukommen.
So ein zuckersüßes kleines Studio in top Lage der Rummelsburger Bucht. Genau der richtige Kontrast zur lauten und lebendigen City. Es hat uns sehr gut gefallen.

My wife, dog and I spent the month at Clara’s place in the heart of Berlin. The complex was lovely, the location was in the middle of everything (shops, restaurants, public tran, and grocery shopping) and we felt right at home and our dog loved the courtyard.
Clara was always very helpful and responsive. The doormen were also great to provide that extra bit of service.
The only issues was the refrigerator was a mini fridge in a closet, which took some adjusting for a long stay. Also, several of the complex washing machines were not working and were not fixed during the month.
All in all, this was a great base to call home for our month in Berlin.
This is a good place to stay, close to everything, very quiet, clean, very cozy yet spacious space, comfy beds. Will look if it's free if returning to Berlin.

Very nice apartment close to Alexanderplatz in a quiet and nice area, but still close to everything and public transport. Clear instructions from the host. Nothing negative to say, would definitely recommend.
We really liked this hostel. Very convenient location and friendly staff. I advise you to visit this place.

We had a wonderful stay at Hanno, Zaki and Suraya’s beautiful and spacious apartment. They make you feel at home and are such kind hosts. The neighbourhood is lovely, it’s away from the traffic, with cafes and boutique shops, and lots of greenery. The room itself is tastefully decorated, spotless and very calming—felt very good to retreat to at the end of each day. Couldn’t have picked a better place in Berlin! Thank you for having us.

Schamiram était un excellent hôte et l’appartement était très propre et décoré avec soin!
On s’y sent comme à la maison.
Les autres filles sont très accueillante.
La chambre était grande et lumineuse.
Ma seule problématique était le rideau qui laissait passer la lumière au matin mais rien de grave.
J’ai apprécié mon séjour chez Schamiram et je n’hésiterai pas y revenir.
Clean and spacious place. Recommend it to everyone.

This is a very interesting part of Berlin that is named "New Venice" for all the canals that crisscross the area. It is a favorite spot for Berliners to spend summer vacations near the lakes east of Berlin. The cottage is new and spotless and Ekki and Johannes are terrific hosts and we have become fast friends. The public transportation is great. I never drove a car during my 35 day stay relying on bicycle travel and trams and trains. I highly recommend this place to other Americans that want to experience laid-back German culture.

Steffi’s place is as described - the neighbourhood is safe full of young people with young children - tram and rail are less than 15 minute walk
Steffi responded to all our correspondence quickly and allowed us early checkin
Really happy we booked
Dank der Flexibilität von Willi konnte ich mich ganz auf meine Termine in der Nähe konzentrieren

We had a fantastic stay with Irina! She is the loveliest host and her place is beautiful. The bedroom and bathroom are huge and extremely clean. Great location as well, M10 takes you right to the central station. Only downside is I wish we’d stayed longer than one night!

Maik was very communicative and happy for us to check in a bit earlier for our convenience.
Great location. Lots of great bars and restaurants. Close to public transport.
The apartment was a bit cold but we were able to control the climate independently which was really good.
The TV in the main room did not work at all and one of the beds was broken. No pillows as such Just blankets stuffed in pillow cases, which worked OK.
There were no facilities for breakfast. No toaster to toast the bread we brought with us.
There was a small amount of what seemed like old, left over coffee. No milk.
clean towels were provided but there was no soap or shower gel.
Our stay was pleasant enough. We enjoyed Berlin
super stylish. good taste. very happy to live here. thanks for Daniel's advice.

War vom Preis-Leistungsverhältnis etwas enttäuscht, da die Wohnung einige kleine Mängel aufwies und sie für unseren Aufenhalt (4 Personen, 5 Tage) etwas zu klein war.
Lage war äußerst ruhig mit super Öffi-Anbindung. Check-In unkompliziert!

In der Unterkunft passt alles: gut angebunden, sehr gut ausgestattet, sauber, ruhig, man kann den Raum wundervoll Abdunkeln und hat seine Privatsphäre, da auch Miriam sehr respektvoll und gleichzeitig zugewandt und hilfsbereit ist. Sie hat mir alles genau gezeigt, präzise Anweisungen gegeben und mich mit Kuchen, frischen Blumen und lieben Notizen durch meinen Aufenthalt begleitet.
Die Matratze ist recht dünn, wer also Rückenprobleme hat könnte da Schwierigkeiten haben. Das war für mich aber das einzige Manko.
Mit hat es super gefallen und ich würde jederzeit wieder hier übernachten. Das ist außerdem noch ein AirBnb wie es im ursprünglichen Sinne gedacht war. Danke Miriam!
Excellent stay;
Such an amazing apartment! The loft was perfect for our trip- lots of space and light and really comfy beds. Also in a great area. Carolyn was super helpful during our stay- thank you very much!

El departamento es como se ve en las fotos. Está súper bien ubicado, en una zona tranquila y segura. Está muy conectado con el transporte público y a distancia caminable de Alexanderplatz. Volvería a alojarme en la casa de Max sin dudarlo :)

Oliver ist ein unglaublicher Gastgeber - offen, natürlich, lustig. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Das Zimmer ist geräumig, hell, das Bett groß und man schläft gut - oft habe ich Rückenschmerzen in anderen Betten, die Matratze hier ist super gut.
Man kann gut mit Oliver reden und die Wohnung ist genau so wie auf den Fotos.
Die Lage ist zentral, kostenloser Sport inbegriffen mit der Wohnung im.4. Stock, das haben andere auch schon gesagt. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Sehr zu empfehlen!
Thanks very much for the quick replys and the flexibility with the check-in. The neighborhood was peaceful and the metro station nearby. Very friendly hosts
Todo correcto, tal cual el anuncio
Great location, spacious and well appointed place, excellent communication with Louis. Many thanks!
Уютная квартира, идеальная для семьи с детьми, т.к. в квартире много игрушек! Расположение очень удобное, в 20 минутах на метро до центра, а метро сосем рядом в домом. Но шум не мешает.
Very responsive! The place is very nice and clean, and very well equiped! I recommend this host and this place!
Super nice location and spacious apartment with a nice view!

Die Wohnung entsprach genau den Bildern. Die Schlüsselübergabe war unkompliziert und die Wohnung war sauber und gemütlich. In der Nähe der Wohnung befinden sich viele gemütliche Restaurants. Das Tram ist direkt vor der Wohnung und auch die U-Bahn und S-Bahn ist in der Nähe.
We had a great night in apartment

Wir waren nur für eine Nacht da und dafür ist das Zimmer absolut in Ordnung. Nur war der Boden recht schmutzig. Sowohl im Zimmer unten als auch oben auf der Bettplattform. Barfuß nach dem Duschen aus dem (blitzblanken! ) Bad ins Zimmer laufen, war keine gute Idee.
Ansonsten aber nichts zu meckern. Checkin war super easy und für 1,70m Menschen ist die Plattform auch hoch genug, dass man sich nicht den Kopf an der Decke stößt.

Good place to stay, place felt like a cozy home. Elena did a good job of communicating.
Close to public transit, and very walkable. Would definitely stay there again.

Wir waren zu viert in Berlin zu einem Konzert. Die Wohnung war perfekt für uns und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Wir konnten schnell überall hingelangen. Es war alles sauber und ordentlich und die Betten waren sehr sehr gemütlich! Wenn wir wieder nach Berlin kommen, dann definitiv wieder zu Mina! :)
Everything was wonderful!!!!
Robert's place is located 3 mins away from the nearest metro and 10mins away from the famous East Side Gallery. Really hip area to be in and great value for money!

Wir haben uns bei Thorsten sehr wohl gefühlt! Check-in/-out war super flexibel. Wir waren viel unterwegs und haben uns deshalb leider die meiste Zeit verpasst,  dennoch hatten wir tolle Gespräche und haben uns sehr gut mit Thorsten verstanden. Mina ist eine liebe Gastgeberin, sie antwortet schnell, gibt hilfreiche Tipps.
Es hat alles super geklappt. wir kommen gern wieder.
Liebe Grüße

Vi fick ett mycket bra välkomnande! Värden skickade en beskrivning till mig hur vi skulle ta oss till lägenheten från flygplatsen. Han skickade också tips på bra restauranger i närhten. Absolutely loved this place! Couldn’t have been any better. Thank you.
Christine è un' host molto attenta e discreta. Appartamento accogliente,  piccolo ma Christine garantisce privacy e indipendenza ai propri ospiti.

Feines Quartier im Herzen Charlottenburgs. Da werde ich wohl nicht das letzte Mal gewesen sein.  Hat Hostel-Vibes, aber mit 7 Zimmern auf einem Flur und Gemeinschaftsküche so klein und fein, dass alles echt entspannt ist. Nous avons apprécié notre séjour dans le logement spacieux et confortable de René que nous avons rencontré  à notre arrivée, car son magasin est juste à côté. Bien adapté pour une famille de 5 personnes et facile d'entretien. Boîte à clefs pratique.  Commerces et transports à proximité. Nous vous recommandons ce logement sans hésiter!

Alles super und ohne Probleme!
Gute Lage.
Fornøyd med vert og leilighet, ikke så fornøyd med beliggenhet
loved the loft bed and great location!

Apartment is very clean! The bedding was very comfortable! We loved the added treat on our pillows and all the local suggestions! There is a lot of stairs but we managed with our luggage. Just something to keep in mind! The view was amazing though and for New Years it couldn’t be beat! We watched all of Berlin light up with fireworks!!! Would definitely recommend.

Sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft. Die komplette Wohnung war perfekt sauber und es war auch sehr ruhig. Axel ist ein toller Gastgeber, mit dem es sehr einfach ist, alles zu organisieren und für Ihren Urlaub zu vorbereiten.

I have stayed in many airbnbs over the years and Hardy's place is one of the best yet! He was so thoughtful when stocking the place with everything I might need and more! I like to cook and there was everything I needed. Sharp knives (!!), an air fryer, lots of pots and pans, glass containers for left overs, a britta, 3 different ways to make coffee...and the list goes on. He had windbreakers and umbrellas, slippers, lots of blankets, a yoga mat, and more. Honestly, I've never stayed in such a well equipped airbnb. I felt very much at home.
Besides all of that, the location is great, the bed is very comfortable, and Hardy is SO kind! He is a gem!

Awesome place, exactly as described and better.  It felt right at home, squeaky clean and everything there to make it a most enjoyable stay.  Denise and Juergen were super responsive and accommodating checking in to make sure we made it in ok and that we have everything that we needed.  I would stay there any time again, perfect spot and a beautiful apartment.  I can highly recommend it!!!!

Vielen lieben Dank an Ulla, wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt. Das Häuschen und der Garten ist eine Wohlfühloase. Und dann die Überraschung am morgen. Vielen lieben Dank. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder 🫶🫶☀️😊
We enjoyed it. Thanks!

We had a really great time at Gunnar's place. It was easy to reach from Schoenfeld Airport and a stone's throw from the park and some nice cafes. The room was spacious and quiet at night, the bed was really comfortable! We felt at home straight away.
It was easy to get around the city too, with a tram at the end of the road and buses nearby. The nearest U-Bahn was a bit of a walk, but a pleasant one (and it might have been possible to get a bus or something instead, but we enjoyed the walk!)
Gunnar was the perfect host, friendly and with lots of information about the local area.
The only thing worth mentioning is that there are quite a few steps to the flat, so if you're not great on stairs that might be an issue.
We'd recommend this place without any hesitation at all!

Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und liegt nicht weit entfernt von ÖPNV.

Für lärmempdindliche weniger geeignet.

War sehr zufrieden, jedem weiter zu empfehlen.

Die Wohnung von Waltraud in Berlin war schlichtweg perfekt. Angefangen von der Schlüsselübergabe, über den ausgezeichneten Zustand der Wohnung und dessen Sauberkeit, bis hin zum schönen Balkon und der ruhigen Lage. Für mich ist Waltrauds Wohnung die erste Wahl, wenn ich wieder eine Ferienwohnung in Berlin buchen möchte. Vielen Dank, dass wir ihre Gäste sein durften!
Lovely home, super responsive host, clean and tidy too

Very nice place to stay!
Arne is a great host and provides you with many information about Berlin.
We loved his place again;)

Madlen ist super freundlich und zuvorkommend und gibt tolle Essenstipps für die Gegend.
Die Wohnung ist sehr minimalistisch, aber toll eingerichtet und sehr zentral gelegen. Das Bad mein Favorit und das Bett war echt bequem. Absolut zu empfehlen!
Great place in a very convenient location. My family of four had a wonderful stay here.
Great loft! Wonderful location on a peaceful part of the canal. Helpful and easy hosts. Highly recommended.

Gute Bahnverbindung, Top Wohnung für einen guten Preis.

Matratze für meinen Geschmack zu weich, aber ist ja Geschmackssache

Went to Berlin to visit its musea and other cultural spots, after a whole day of walking around and getting many impressions the house is great quiet spot to come back to. Loved the artistic input, the space is beautiful and roomy.
The appartment and the location are very nice.

Great location, access to public transit just outside the door, and lots of space! The washing machine didn’t work and Ronald was very responsive and even did my laundry himself. I would definitely recommend this place.

Sehr saubere Unterkunft mit zusätzlichen Ausstattungen (Kaffee, mehrere Handtücher, etc.). Schöne Lage (Hinterhof, super zentral), schnelle und freundliche Kommunikation, kommen gerne wieder!

Nice and very Berlinish surrounding. Clean shared Airbnb :)

Das Apartment ist absolut perfekt: schöne Lage, ruhig und mit allem ausgestattet was man braucht. The apartment is very comfortable and convenient. there are two supermarkets close to there. One is DM ,another is Aldi. The underground stations is not very far. The host is enthusiastic. My friends all love there.

Sehr freundliche und hilfreiche Gastgeber. wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt

Beau et spacieux appartement, convient pour 4 personnes. Localisation centrale, proche des transports. Si vous êtes sensibles aux bruits la nuit, il vaut mieux prévoir des boules quies, car le tram passe juste en dessous de l'appartement.
Hôte réactif et flexible concernant les horaires d'arrivée et de départ.

The flat was in a great location and communication was fast and easy.

Had a great time at Jonas & JD’s cozy apartment. Easy to get to by public transport and well located between Kreuzberg and Neukölln. Both our hosts were very friendly and sympathetic. Sehr nahe von der U-Bahn station und ein toller Falafelladen in der Nähe! Ausserdem gibt es weitere Restaurants und Läden in der Gegend.

Super séjour à Berlin ! Logement agréable, cosy et facile d’accès, 2 minutes à pied du tramway.

beautiful spacious apartment with great light and a very comfy bed. the host was very communicative and there was an excellent coffee shop right across the street. thank you for a great stay!

We would definitely stay here again should we travel to Berlin, and would highly recommend.
I would like to thank Werner for allowing us to stay in his lovely apartment a bit longer (late checkout) much appreciated.

Great location, very pretty area with many restaurants and cafes, and public transport. Apartment is clean, comfortable and warm. It is well equipped with  everything I needed.  Communication with Verda is very easy and helpful. Lovely experience.

Everything was perfect. The apartment was really clean, comfortable and swetty. The location is very good. (Public transport and supermarkets only 50mt.)
Thank you so much Alan&Kasia..
Good communication. Easy check-in.

In der Umgebung gibt es viel zu sehen, die Wohnung selber ist im Hinterhaus und somit sehr ruhig gelegen. Die Wohnung ist mit allem ausgestattet was man benötigt, man fühlt sich direkt zuhause!

Wow, this place is a dream! Julie’s home is so lovely. Lots of space and even a bathtub (which I feel is rarer in Europe?). Really easy to get to the more bustling parts of the city by train but the neighborhood itself is quiet and was full of great restaurants and cafes (highly recommend Yummy Mummy!). We would definitely re-book this spot on future trips to Berlin!
The accommodation had everything we needed for a few nights in Berlin. We had our own privacy, the location was good.

Great option for small families. I travelled with my dad and son, and we found the flat superb. It's very well located, near the centre and with a tram station right in front. Very cleam, and equipped with everything you might need. Ramfis is an excelent host.

I had an amazing stay! The place was spotless and very comfortable—the beds were cozy, and the temperature was just perfect for May, not cold at all and it warmed up nicely at night. The location is super convenient with plenty of stores and coffee shops nearby, and the best part was the train station just a 5-minute walk away! The host was incredibly responsive and always answered my messages quickly, even when I had lots of questions. Highly recommend!

Awesome stay! The room was clean, staff are very weloming, it's very central close to
many please in center of Berlin.

have an early train!

Schöne Wohnung in guter Lage, es hat alles gepasst und war ein angenehmer Aufenthalt.

Great apparement! Pictures are displaying the appartement as it is. Lively neighborhood with loads of entertainment, don't look any further!
Der Aufenthalt war absolut großartig und sehr zu empfehlen! Die Flat ist ruhig gelegen mit tollen Betten ! Man schläft wie auf Wolken !

The place was wonderful and located near plenty of restaurants, bars and public transportation that could get you anywhere in the city. The apartment was clean, the bed was comfy and we had everything we needed. Would recommend and stay here again the next time we are in Berlin.

A great place to stay ! Everything is nearby And te appartment is Amazing ! I liked it Very much ! The owner is Very Nice And you can ask him everyrhing ! He is Very helpfull !

Dimitris’s place is perfect! The location is amazing, we stayed in one of the best areas in Berlin. The apartment itself is great - bed is very comfortable and the kitchen is very well equipped. Thank you for everything :)

This air b and b was a great find, in a really nice area and a bus stop right outside.

Thank you for our stay I would definitely recommend!

Ich habe mich Sabine wie zu Hause gefühlt. Es war alles so wie beschrieben. Auch Sabine als Gastgeberin war sehr freundlich und offen.
Auch der kleine Garten war sehr gemütlich.
Ich komme gerne wieder.

Die Unterkunft von Michele ist super schön und sauber - genauso wie auf den Fotos!
Der Check-In war völlig problemlos unabhängig möglich. Die Wohnung ist gut gelegen und ruhig.
Tolle Räumlichkeiten. Super Lage. 5*
Hyvällä paikalla hotelli.
Alles super.
We really enjoyed our stay at Parwana's appartement. Ist was super clean and comfortable. Check in-and out was also very simple and not complicated at all. We would always love to come back! :-)

Vi hadde et fint opphold hos Stefan. Han og hans familie var imøtekommende og lett å kommunisere med. Leiligheten var ren og ryddig. Det passet fint for oss at stedet ligger litt utfor de mest travle områdene av Berlin, stille og rolig, samtidig som det er lett å komme seg rundt. ¡El mejor hostal en el que he estado! Limpio, ordenado y distribuido perfectamente para tener intimidad. Casi que se te olvida que estás compartiendo habitación con 5 personas más. Susanne was friendly and helpful. Even though she is just beginning hosting through Airbnb, she already knows a great deal about how to be the perfect host. Suzanne is very communicative and you will not regret booking the room she has to offer.

Eine Altbauwohnung, die einem das richtige Berlin-Feeling vermittelt. Nach vielen Besichtigungen, Eindrücken und Großstadtrummel genau der richtige Rückzugsort.

This is a very nicely decorated, clean and well-located apartment. We happened to stay when it was 33 degrees and the apartment was very hot (no air conditioning) and with the windows open there was a lot of noise from the courtyard downstairs and other apartments. Reception had extra fans which helped. All positives for the apartment and the people running it.... just a bit uncomfortable if you're unlucky enough to be there in a heatwave.

Well located near the tram and close to several charming restaurants and cafes!  The apartment contains everything you need for a longer stay, both for professional purposes and for holidays!  I recommend it without hesitation.

Lovely home away from home. It was the perfect place for our family for a short vacation in Berlin. Nassa was quick to respond and very service minded.
The studio was small bat very cozy. The stairs were a little steep for our kids, and the bunk bed a bit difficult to climb. But it worked okay. Nice area. Lots of restaurants in the neighbourhood. Would come back another time. Thanks!
Lovely apartment

The acommodation looked in reality exactly as nice as in the pictures and we could do an early-check-in which was very kind of Claudia. Also the communication and check-in and-out went really smoothe. I would definitely recommend a stay in this appartment/house :-)

Ich bin super zufrieden, gerne wieder!
Klare Empfehlung.
Wir waren mit Heike sehr zufrieden und hatten eine schöne erholsame Zeit
Good stay with an accomodating host. Excellent location. Good short term stay option in Berlin.

Die Unferkunft ist gut gelegen, schnell erreichbar und der Check-In geht schnell und einfach. Die Unterkunft ist groß und bietet alles was man braucht. Toller Gasgeber, tolle Unterkunft!
Wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder
The hotel is easy to get

Alles prima + wie beschrieben. Ulrike ist sehr nett, offen und schnell erreichbar.
Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt, man hat viel Privatsphäre und An- und Abreise waren sehr unkompliziert! Danke!

Stanza molto piccola, ma tenuta molto bene. Le asciugamani pulite vengono rifornite ogni giorno, le coperte no, ma se si sta pochi giorni non è un problema. Check in e out molto comodi e smart. Ottima posizione per spostarsi con i mezzi. In generale è stata una bella esperienza.
Great flat in awesome neighborhood. You should stay there!
Very good house and very nice host!

Logement partagé avec l’hôte, vous n’êtes donc pas seul dans le logement.
Je n’avait pas vu, je n’ai donc pas pensé utile de préciser que nous étions 2 et pas tout seul étant donné que c’était une chambre de deux.

Sehr geschmackvolle Wohnung mit Stil! Top Lage! Die Gastgeber waren sehr zuvorkommend und Gastfreundlich. Wir waren geschäftlich dort und können beides-, Wohnung und Gastgeber vollstens empfehlen. Wir werden wiederkommen. Danke Ronald für den freundlichen Empfang und die Fürsorge!

Michael è un host attento e disponibile . Casa funzionale e in ottima posizione .
Consigliato
Had great time great host I’ll recommend

Die Einrichtung ist sicherlich Geschmackssache ;-)
Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter total problemlos und alles andere hat auch gut funktioniert!
Einwandfrei, super Kommunikation & sehr schöne Wohnung :)
Sehr zufrieden,  komme gerne wieder!
Fantastic stay in lovely small apartment with everything we needed. Ewa gave us invaluable advise on how to reach apartment easily from airport.

We had a great time in Josef's apartment. Very close to the city center and a few stops from the train central station. The apartment is very spacious and functional. We couldn't meet Josef but communication worked good, the person who received us was kind and easy going as well.
We recommend Josef's apartment 100%

Sehr empfehlenswert. Wir wurden zur abgesprochenen Zeit quasi freundschaftlich empfangen und in die Wohnung und Umgebung eingewiesen. Ohne groß textlich auszuholen war als sauber, top eingerichtet und vorgesorgt und insgesamt sehr schön.
