Beim nächsten Berlinausflug kommen wir gern wieder
A fabulous apartment in a lively and popular neighbourhood. Being with five we enjoyed three fantastic days in Berlin. The apartment is spacious, clean en well equiped. A perfect spot to stay.

We had a wonderful stay at Stefan's apartment. It's a beautiful, clean, cosy apartment in a great location near plenty of shops, restaurants and public transport stops - a perfect place to stay if you want to explore Berlin. Stefan was very friendly and helpful, and left lots of recommendations and guides for exploring the area. Overall we highly recommend staying here.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft, sehr sauber, Lage war auch gut

The apartment was ideal for a four-day stay in Berlin with my wife and adult child. The apartment was much bigger than what you see in the photos and we had plenty of room to relax and for each of us to have privacy. With the S-Bahn a short walk, it was easy to get just about anywhere in Berlin. Highly recommended!
Die Unterkunft war einfach genial, ein wahrer Diamant! Ich komme sehr gerne wieder.

Die Unterkunft ist wirklich klasse. Sie ist sehr geräumig und es gibt genügend Schlafmöglichkeiten.
Von Decken über Kissen und Handtücher war alles vorhanden.
Auch die sonstige Ausstattung ist perfekt. Wir hatten von Toilettenpapier, Fön, Kaffeemaschine und sogar Zucker , Salz und Pfeffer wirklich alles da. Am Ende unseres Aufenthaltes hatten wir zudem noch die Option unser Gepäck zu deponieren bevor es am Nachmittag zum Flughafen ging.
Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war so wie man es sich wünscht: schnell, freundlich, unkompliziert, präzise.
Einziges Manko war, dass sich die Heizungen noch nicht anschalten ließen und es dadurch in der Wohnung sehr kalt war. Zum Schlafen optimal, aber insbesondere das Duschen war sehr unangenehm, da sowohl der Boden als auch der Raum (Badezimmer) sehr kalt waren.
Ich würde für die kältere Jahrezeit auf jeden Fall Hausschuhe oder dicke Wintersocken empfehlen, damit man durch den kalten Fußboden nicht friert.
Very beautiful apartment. Sonja is very friendly and hospitable. Would come back again.
Had a great stay!
We had an excellent stay, thank you very much. The apartment was perfect for us and we really loved the location. We would not hesitate to come back.

Because of a few problems some basic necessities weren't in the apartment, but Andreas was a very flexible host who adapted to the situation and offered quick solutions. Checkin and checkout were very easy and without problems, all in all it was good stay!
A lovely home to stay when visiting Berlin. We really felt at home staying here and we were very excited to return to this lovely place after each busy day in the city.

Mein Mann und ich haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen. Die ganze Familie hat uns herzlich aufgenommen. Ein Besuch im Restaurant ist auf jeden Fall auch empfehlenswert:)
Das nächste Mal werden wir auf jeden Fall auch wieder bei Florent und seiner Familie buchen.
La casa es preciosa y está impecable. Un lugar muy cómodo y silencioso para descansar. Está muy bien comunicado con el centro de Berlín pero se tarda mucho en llegar con el transporte público.
Everything was fantastic, we had public transport very closed to the apartment, the heating worked great. We only had one inconvenient and it was that the sofa-bed were really uncomfortable.

Very nice place to stay
Chi is very nice and helpful
Good transportation

My group of 8 stayed for New Years, we found the room to be clean & spacious. The location was easily walkable to a nearby train station & a handful of decent restaurants. Front desk was friendly & inviting.
Alles soweit in Ordnung, das Zimmer könnte etwas sauberer sein. Lage top.
Doporučuji! Malý, útulný a světlý apartmán s výhledem na vysoký strom v jedné z nejlepší čtvrti Berlína. Vše je kousek! Navíc maximálně pohodlná postel a také super komunikace. Určitě se vrátíme!
alles gut, das self-login ist lustig und macht es unkompliziert. Kein Schlüssel kann vergessen werden :-)
Super appartement vraiment bien placé !

I truly enjoyed my stay at Bianca’s. It was even better than the pictures!
The location is fantastic super walkable to the train station, supermarket, and restaurants. I highly recommend touring around the area. And I HIGHLY recommend staying here during your Berlin visit. It’s close enough to the main part of the city but calm and welcoming environment.
I look forward to staying here the next time I visit!
Good appartment with very good location. Two metro lines (U6 and U7) very close. Warm appartment and two double beds. Host is very nice and very easy communication.  I hilghly recommend it.
Der Aufenthalt in Toms Wohnung war rundum super, alles war wie beschrieben, blitzsauber und super unkompliziert - genauso wie man es sich wünscht. Ich würde immer wieder kommen!

Location of the apartment was perfect.  Close to restaurants and grocery.  Apartment was much nicer than I expected - the hallway outside the apartment was dingy and a bit run down looking.  But inside it was very clean, modern, and had big windows.  We were able to walk to nearly all the sites we wanted to see.  Highly recommend it.  Only problem was that when we cut our visit short by one day (within the required timeframe), the host didn’t respond to the message and we had to go through Airbnb for a refund of one night.

Muy buen apartamento para visitar Berlin. Es fácil de encontrar, y está bien comunicado (hay una parada de metro a 2 min). La zona es tranquila, y dispones de diferentes servicios cerca (cafeterías, supermerdados, farmacias, etc.). Baharbin nos facilitó la llegada, y siempre que surgió alguna duda no tardó en responder. Un 10. Volveremos.

Had a great time staying with Stella. The flat is in a great area with good connections and lots of options for food and drinks. Stella was very helpful in terms of check in and highly responsive to any questions/issues. Would recommend!
Perfect location, nice and clean apartment! Very friendly welcome by Apostolos. We would definitely recommend staying here.
Suitable for a weekend trip
地理位置很方便，床睡得很舒服，暖气也很足。
Der Aufenthalt war sehr schön! Die Unterkunft hat eine top Lage, man kommt immer gut überall hin. Ist wirklich weiter zu empfehlen!

Malgré un logement conforme aux photos et descriptifs, un logement propre et bien équipé nous n'avons pas bien dormi du tout en raison du bruit incessant des voitures. Il faut noter que cet appartement est en rez de chaussée et donne dans la rue. De plus il ne possède pas de fenêtre,juste une porte d'entrée et une fenêtre dans la salle de bain donnant dans la cour, d'où un manque d'air. Nous sommes partis avant la fin du séjour.
It is a really good place to stay. Super clean, good location, quick responses. Nothing to complain.
As described, nice and easy to find.
Cute place in a good area but a bit loud
Mükemmel konumda bir daire. Her yer elinizin altında. Ev temiz ve düzenliydi her şey anlatıldığı gibiydi teşekkür ederiz Ferry tekrar görüşmek üzere 😊
The perfect stay if you love gorgeous Berlin houses. It made us feel right at home

I really enjoyed my stay at Stefan's and would recommend the apartment to anyone coming to Berlin, both couples and lone travellers. I was there by myself for a conference and felt right at home at Stefan's. Him and his girlfriend were very welcoming and helpful when I arrived, and very laid back during the week. The room was lovely and I slept very well. The apartment is perfectly located for Berlin, and also felt safe walking back alone at night. I'd stay here again.

Easy to get to location, very close to the S Bahn.  The flat was spacious and comfortable.  Fritz had a friend meet us at the Metro and escort us to the flat.  Plenty of brochures were made available as well as a recent copy of Lonely Planet.  I would stay there again!

Really nice and peaceful appartment, just between Mitte and Prenzlauer Berg. The appartment is located in a very nice neighbourhood with loads of restaurants around, grocery store close by and a nice little café just in front. The hot water system was down when we arrived so, although it took a few days to get fixed, Stefan and his partner were kind enough to inform us of what were the issues that was causing the delay. The rest of our stay was very smooth and we really enjoyed spending our evenings there. The courtyard is really nice and felt completely private!
sehr empfehlenswert
That was perfect !
War perfekt für unser Wochenende in Berlin!
War alles okay

A neat, streetlevel apartment with some architectural oddities in a quiet zone of Kreuzberg. All the furnitures are Ikea, in fact, everything in the place is bought in Ikea, from the cutlery to the wall decoration. Michael was very friendly and showed us the interesting spots in the neighbourhood on a map. We had to pay 28 euros extra for city-taxes. The Ikea-oven gave a lot of smoke when we tried to use it. The kitchen window looks out on a courtyard with many sigarette butts and some wastebins. Nice but slightly overpriced.
the place was just as described and fitted our needs for this trip perfectly. close to public transportation, and very easy to get to the center. it was a lovely stay!
Svært fornøyd med oppholdet vårt i leiligheten. Den hadde alt vi trengte og sto absolutt til forventningene.
War super, gerne wieder. Danke!

Wir hatten einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt in Mircos Appartement. Perfekt für zwei Personen, hochwertig ausgestattet und eingerichtet, dazu ein sehr freundlicher Empfang durch Mirco mit Erklärungen zu allem Wissenswerten. Höchst empfehlenswert!
Great location, light filled room with balcony, accommodating and friendly host. Recommended!
I really enjoy my stay at Jan’s, perfect location, clean and quiet. I highly recommend this place.
Alles einwandfrei, Lage ist super, direkte Bahnanbindung
Nice and clean, good communication 👍

The apartment was great, in a great location - clean and
neatly furnished.

Chris and his brother were very helpful from beginning to end, offering transit help for arrival/departure and tech support when the wifi went dodgy.

I had a great time there, you would too.

jens was very responsive and fast when our sink leaked and our power went out. all problems were solved swiftly. however, there was only one fan in the entire apartment and the wifi was choppy most of the time. it was hard to make calls solely using wifi. nevertheless, jens was a very hospitable host who gave us recommendations on places to eat near the apartment and directions to get to school.
All was well, despite some problems at check-in (we couldn't find which door was our apartment) bur apart from that it was great!!!!

Era la prima esperienza con Airbnb..Appartamento davvero bello in zona centrale e ben servita dai mezzi che permettono di raggiungere tutti i punti di maggior interesse cittadini,oltre ad entrambi gli aeroporti raggiungibili in poco tempo a qualsiasi ora..Birgit,davvero disponibile per qualsiasi aiuto e consiglio..massima soddisfazione..

Wunderschöne, gut aufgeteilte und saubere Altbauwohnung.
Joseph war super hilfsbereit und kam auch dem Wunsch nach einer extra Matratze nach. Immer wieder gerne! :)
Beautiful, well placed and clean Flat.
Joseph was super friendly and helpful. We even got an extra matress.
It was a real pleasure! :)
Local muito bom e próximo ao metrô. Restaurantes funcionando até mais tarde.por perto. Wi-fi rápido e espaço bem grande e confortável.
very quiet and clean place. We even had a balcony with our room. We will definitely stay again next time we are visiting.
The apartment is a lot more spacious and bright than expected.
Hat alles super funktioniert. Das treffen vor der Wohnung. Der Check In. Me Hien und seine Frau waren sehr nett und höflich. Viele Grüße aus Bremen.

El airBnB de Gunnar es hermoso. El departamento está decorado con mucho detalle y es muy acogedor. El cuarto es espacioso y la cama muy cómoda. El baño es privado y tiene todo lo necesario. El departamento está en una zona tranquila pero aún así cerca de muchos restaurantes y bares, igual que de la East side gallery y el metro/transporte público.
A pesar de compartir el departamento, nos sentimos muy cómodas y lo recomendamos 100%
Very convenient, well organised room, good location, excellent value.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl bei Sybil gefühlt - blitzsauber und sehr gemütlich! Bei Fragen war sie sofort für uns da! Wir kommen gewiss wieder!
Bien situé dans le quartier de Kreuzberg, l’appartement est parfait pour y dormir et la mise à disposition des vélos est un véritable atout !

Es un alojamiento muy original, nos sentimos muy cómodos. Esta muy bien ubicado y tiene estacionamiento propio.
Se puede descansar bien, ya que es silencioso. Recomiendo este alojamiento :)

Herzlichen Dank für die Unterkunft in der letzten Woche.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und haben eine gute Zeit im Appartement verbracht.
Nicht hat uns gefehlt, und wir waren ausgesprochen zufrieden!

Super semaine dans cette maison spacieuse et chaleureuse. Très joli kiosque dans le jardin. Les lieux disent beaucoup de la gentillesse de Fred et son épouse. C’est un air bnb dans lequel on peut vraiment cuisiner et vivre, ce qui n’est plus si courant. Il y a un peu de marche pour aller à la station de S Bahn, mais cela se fait très bien et un bus avance bien vers la maison si besoin.

Alles genau wie beschrieben.
Kleine und feine Unterkunft- direkt an der Straße und trotzdem ruhig.
Alles hat reibungslos funktioniert- Tamara antwortet in Lichtgeschwindigkeit.
Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Je recommande totalement cet appartement. Joli studio en ré de chaussée, idéal pour 4 personnes, très bien équipé, en bon état et propre !Le quartier est très calme en face d’un parc et le métro est à moins de 5 min à pied ce qui est très pratique mais outre le métro le logement est très central est permet de faire la majorité du centre de Berlin à pied. Martin est un hôte très agréable et très arrangeant, il nous à reçu bien avant l’horaire prévu pour l’arrivée et nous donne des bonnes adresses pour découvrir Berlin. Vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés !

Eine schöne saubere Wohnung, sehr gepflegt und schön eingerichtet. Alles lief problemlos, unsere Mitarbeiter haben sich sehr wohl gefühlt und konnten ihren Feierabend genießen. Danke, wir kommen sehr gern wieder.
Nice place! good location! Thank you Martin, for all. good luck!
Super entspannt und zuvorkommend!

Great apartment in vibrant yet quiet neighbourhood. Responsive hosts.
Everything as advertised or better. Spotlessly clean, comfy beds, powerful shower, nicely furnished.
A good find. Thoroughly recommended.

Das Apartment befindet sich in einer, meiner Ansicht nach, ehemaligen Gewerbeeinheit und es wurden in Eigenregie mehrere Mini-Apartments im Erdgeschoss eingebaut. Die handwerklichen Fähigkeiten lassen zum Teil zu wünschen übrig und es ist alles etwas zusammengezimmert. Das Apartment befindet sich im Erdgeschoss zu einem dunklen Innenhof hin.
Für 124€/ Nacht eindeutig zu teuer. Max. 85€-90€ wären angebracht.

I loved Katrin's place. The flat is very cozy and stylish. I found the bed very comfortable. The location is great, that part of Kreuzberg is very pretty, full of Altbau buildings. Also, the communication with the host was flawless, Katrin was also willing to accommodate a late check-in. I can only recommend this place.
Well situated for city centre and local shops. Clean , well organised accommodation. Value for money
a very pleasant and peaceful stay!
A wonderful place to stay in Mitte!  Hosts are gracious and helpful.  The apartment has good light and is comfortable.  The location is hard to top; close to Museum Insel and U-Bahn.

Torsten is a great host. He is always prompt in answering any questions we had by mail before and during our stay. He is knowledgable and gave us tips to get the most out of our stay. The apartment is a perfect one-bedroom flat for a couple. A nice well equipped little kitchen and bathroom. We did not miss anything in our two week stay. There is also a small veranda where you can have your breakfast (in summer). A great start of the day. The only thing there is that there is a busy street just below it and it can get quite noisy sometimes, but it is a big city so what else can you expect.
We would love to stay in Torsten's flat again and would highly recommend it to friends and family.
Lars and Hanne

Nossa estadia no espaço de Mike foi ótima. O apartamento é mais espaçoso do que nas fotos, com camas confortáveis e uma mini cozinha funcional. Perto do local há muitos restaurantes e comércio, alem de transporte público. Tivemos um problema pessoal e eles foram muito atenciosos conosco.
Super Lage und sehr ruhig.

Ich hatte eine großartige Zeit in diesem Apartment! Die Lage ist einfach unschlagbar – zentral, aber trotzdem ruhig und angenehm. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber, stilvoll eingerichtet und bietet alles, was man für einen komfortablen Aufenthalt braucht. Besonders gefallen hat mir die moderne Küche und der gemütliche Wohnbereich. Der Check-in war unkompliziert, und der Gastgeber war super freundlich und hilfsbereit. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen und kann diese Unterkunft absolut weiterempfehlen!
Sehr nette Gastgeberin, schönes Zimmer in Top Lage und ein reibungsloser Ablauf! Nur zu empfehlen.

Geweldig appartement van alle gemakken voorzien. Centraal gelegen ten opzichte van de highlights van Berlijn. Jessy (verhuurder) heeft een grote hoeveelheid insider tips om je verblijf in Berlijn compleet te maken. Voor ieder wat wils.
Mooi, schoon, fijne bedden, krachtige douchestraal, vaatwasser, nespresso apparaat, koelkast, smart tv. Ik zou dit appartement aan iedereen aanraden.
Zentral und super zweckmäßig. Sehr freundlicher Vermieter.
Wir waren mit der Unterkunft sehr zufrieden.  Besonders da sie zwar zentral gelegen, aber dennoch sehr leise ist und ausserdem blitzsauber!
Great place to stay in Berlin! Hosts were very nice and the apartment is cosy and beautiful.

Apartment very handy for moving around, overall with everything needed for our stay.
There were a few negative points: you can hear the noise from the neighbors, we found dead insects in the kitchen and towels had stains.
We requested an early check in, to this day I am still waiting for an answer…
Overall for the price it was good.
Great communication and tips. A fun area to stay.

A acomodação é exatamente como anunciada. O bairro é tranquilo e silencioso. Local próximo ao transporte público, fácil de se deslocar para os principais pontos turísticos. Mona e sua família são amáveis. Ela foi muito atenciosa no check-in, quando sofremos com imprevistos que nos atrasaram. O biscoito que ela faz é delicioso!

Never ever again!
I had an interview and chose the hotel because it was nearby. The location is great, but there are a thousand better options in the immediate vicinity. Honestly, just any hotel is a better option.
Broken windows, missing lightbulbs, dirty shelfs, loud ventilation...
The wifi-signal was so bad, I had to start the same movie over and over again.
Service staff unhelpful and quite rude - even talking bad about other guests.
Just a quick reminder for me to read the reviews better in the future.

Das Loft entsprach zwar objektiv den Beschreibungen und Bildern in der Anzeige, doch ein Wohgefühl stellte sich bei uns nicht ein: Zu wenig Lich fällt selbst bei Sonnenschein durch das eine Fenster, an der Badezimmerdecke viele Schimmelflecken, zu sehr zusammengesucht war das abgestossene Mobiliar, das Bett durchgelegen und das Sofa abgeranzt, sodass es Überwindung kostete, es zu nutzen.
Die nahe Umgebung (z. B. Dresdener Straße und Oranienstraße) bietet interessante und nette Orte. Doch rund um das nahe Kottbusser Tor haben wir uns schlicht nicht sicher gefühlt, von wohlfühlen ganz zu schweigen.
Great apartment, great host!

Host molto attenta, veloce e gentile nelle comunicazioni.
L'alloggio è in una posizione strategica per poter visitare la città avendo molti mezzi pubblici a disposizione.
L'appartamento è effettivamente giusto per 4 persone. Noi, con 2 figli + un neonato lo abbiamo trovato forse un po' piccolo nella gestione degli spazi: l'utilizzo del divano come secondo letto non permette grandi movimenti.
Ottima la presenza della lavatrice e abbiamo trovato il bagno con tutto quello che poteva essere necessario.
Mancano forse alcune cose essenziali in cucina, ma nulla che non sia migliorabile.
Consigliamo comunque questo appartamento soprattutto per la posizione e per l'host.

This was a great location for sightseeing.  Located in East Berlin, it is easy walking to the U and S and many historic sights.  The apt was clean and accurately represented with a grocery store and many restaurants close by.
Lovely apartment. Cool interior. Great amenities. Easy checkin. Close to the metro. Stores close by. Would visit again👍

Very spacious apartment. The room is large with a tv and has a nice balcony. I wasn’t able to meet Süheyla unfortunately but she was very communicative when I needed something. Close to the metro stations.

Toll ausgestattetes Apartment mit bester Lage  in der Mitte von Berlin. Die Klärung meiner Fragen zur Anreise und Schlüsselübergabe etc. lief problemlos und der Empfang war herzlich. Eine "kleine" Oase in der trubeligen Großstadt. Vielen Dank.

The location was very near Ubahn station.The rooms were perfectly comfortable but minimal, not exactly cosy. But one was getting what one paid for, so  as long as ones expectations are not otherwise, I can recommend it. Breakfast cost 12 euros extra-
Dieter is very kind and helpful. The apartment is at a very nice location you can take tram within 5 minutes walk. Generally I enjoyed my stay

Mooie accommodatie op de begane grond waar alles aanwezig is wat je nodig hebt voor een week Berlijn.
Jammer dat er geen toegang is tot de Spree. Rustige omgeving.
Top place - amazing location. Would recommend
We had a lovely stay at Stefan’s flat! It was really clean, comfy and warm. The flat is a short walk from the city centre and had everything we needed for our trip to Berlin!

Appartement bien situé et propre.
L'accueil est chaleureux.
Super hyggelig lejlighed i et hyggeligt område. Anke er en super god og imødekommende vært, og jeg vil klart anbefale hendes lejlighed, hvis man skal til Berlin.

Paolo and Petra were wonderful hosts with a stunning apartment in a beautiful part of the city. The flat was clean and well equipped with everything you could need, it made it difficult to leave! Charlottenburg is a lovely area with lots of cafes and restaurants to explore, as well as a huge park. It is very quiet and near a train station making it easy to get into the busyness of Berlin centre. Thank you Paolo and Petra for such a great visit to Berlin, we will definitely be back!

Great apartment. Nice wood floors, spacious kitchen, washing machine worked well, bed was large, windows were the old style and beautiful. Super easy check in and a very responsive host. Within easy walking distance of Weinbergs park and lots of great cafes as well as the more central of Mitte. Courtyard side, where bedroom is, was very quiet. Torstraße can be a little loud but you can close the windows on that side.

Die Unterkunft an sich, war ganz toll für eine Familie. Mit Küche und Waschmaschine. Auch der Zimmerservice war sehr gut. Leider waren die Angestellten im Restaurant, der Bar und der Rezeption sehr unmotiviert, sprachen teils kein Deutsch und waren wenig zuvorkommend für ein 4* Hotel. Essen war preis-Leistung nicht wert. Dafür gibt es tolle Restaurants in der Umgebung.

Die Wohnung ist groß, hell und gemütlich. Ich war allein mit meinem kleinen Sohn dort und habe mich schon beim Betreten wohlgefühlt. Ein Hochstuhl und ein Reisebett waren auch vorhanden. Die Umgebung ist ruhig, alles was man braucht ist vor der Tür und die Anbindung mit der Tram ist super. Oft waren wir auch zu Fuß unterwegs… in den Volkspark auf einen der Spielplätze und dann weiter bis zum Alexanderplatz. Danke und bis bald:)

Sauber, unkompliziert, gute Ausstattung
Kann ich nur empfehlen!

Eine schöne, geräumige und gut ausgestattete Wohnung, in der wir mit unserem Sohn ein erlebnisreiches Pfingst-WE verbracht haben.
Trotz später Anreise hat uns Tom freundlich empfangen und uns alles erklärt. Vorher haben wir auch schon umfangreiche Hinweise und Tipps per Mail erhalten. Unser Auto konnten wir kostenlos direkt vor der Haustür parken und ansonsten die nahgelegene U-Bahn nutzen. Nach einem langen Besichtigungstag konnten wir den Tag entspannt ausklingen lassen oder noch kurz den gegenüberliegenden Spielplatz aufsuchen. Wir kommen gerne wieder und können die Wohnung vor allem für einen Städtetrip mit Kindern sehr empfehlen..

We didn't get to meet Lorenzo, but he did check in with us to make sure we were comfortable throughout our stay and Katharina was there when we arrived to meet and show us the apartment.  A friendly neighbor also provided us with tons of great recommendations and tips for navigating Kreuzberg and beyond as well.  Perfect base of operations for us, great location, easy to walk to tons of interesting sites and museums and very close to public transportation should your feet finally give up at the end of a long day like ours did.  Great spot, highly recommend!

Ich habe diese Unterkunft für 2 Wochen geblieben. Es ist sehr sauber, ruhig und angenehm. Es gibt Supermarkt, Park, Tempelhofer Feld und 2 Bushaltestellen in der Nähe. Es dauert auch U6 Bahnhof und S Bahnhof Südkreutz 10min zu Fuß. Das Zimmer ist weit und alles möbiliert. Das Badezimmer, die Küche ist auch sehr ordentlich.
Anja ist die beste Gastgeber, sehr freundlich. Buchen Sie diese Unterkunft!
Cosy and welcoming apartment. We had a lovely stay, Thankyou :)
10/10 bis auf die Check in Zeiten war alles perfekt
Tout s'est bien passé, logement abordable pour un séjour à Berlin, je recommande

Great location, clean rooms, friendly reception staff, reception is meant to be manned 10 to 6 but we had to wait 30 minutes before someone arrived with no nite to say when they would be back and it was often closed well before 6 and no welcome pack with appliance instructions and local areas of interest

nice room, but the wifi is horrible, you're better off using your mobile data. The TV is also to small. The area itself way to sensitive to noise, you can literally hear everything from the other rooms.

Sehr zum empfehlen, das Häuschen von Ulla, die Herzlichkeit der Gastgeberin, die Ruhe, ja die kleine Abgeschiedenheit, die man dort genießen kann, das Schwimmen im angrenzenden See … . Wir kommen gern wieder - auf ein paar Tage.

Apartment was so much better than we were expecting. All the facilities were clean and worked really well. Very warm and comfortable. Not much to do in the area however easy to get to the centre. Overall a brilliant host!

L’appartement de Duc est paisible, grand, mais attention car 3 chambres sont annoncées or 2 lits sont dans le salon et 2 sont dans la salle à manger. Cela ne nous a cependant pas dérangé. Le quartier est très chouette, très accessible (Tramway devant la porte de l’immeuble), facilement à portée de tous les centres d’intérêt de Berlin.
Perfect apartment for a short stay

Es war ein perfekter Aufenthalt in Berlin - durch die genauen Angaben von Jonas und eine gute und schnelle Kommunikation hat alles super geklappt. Die Wohnung befindet sich in ruhiger Lage, ist gute angebunden, ist sehr schön eingerichtet und super sauber - sehr zu empfehlen!
Place was great and host was super responsive including coming to meet us to drop off a second set of keys
Beautiful gardens and comfortable accommodations. Mini kitchen is well appointed and comfortable for a several day stay.
Sehr netter Empfang, unkomplizierte und schnelle Kommunikation. Ein kleines Studio mit Grundausstattung und einem für mich etwas zu harten Bett.

Max foi super atencioso e sempre respondia as mensagens com rapidez. Nos recepcionou muito bem e o local é bem limpo e confortável. Próximo de estação de tram onde consegue se locomover para os principais pontos da cidade.
Easy access by public transport. Coean and nice house. Would recommend!
Es war ein nettes Zimmer und hat alles gepasst. Ich kann Me Hien nur wärmstens weiterempfehlen.
Iljana hat gut für ons gesorgt. Sie war sehr nett und hat uns tips gegeben für activitäten in de nähe. Das zimmer war sauber. Wir sind sehr zufrieden
I had a very nice stay. The place was quiet and had everything I needed. It was well connected to the center of Berlin thanks to the tram. The host was always available and nice.

Clean, quiet and well located two bedroom apartment with a large living space and separate kitchen.
Furniture more on the essential side, but everything we needed was there.
Good public transport connections and easy to rent bikes in the neighbourhood
Cool area, plenty of restaurants and cafes.
Great spot - very clean and uncluttered apartment, stayed warm for us on two very cold days. Near the train stop. Neighborhood has great food options. And the hosts were detailed and responsive!

It wasn't a surprise because we read the reviews of other guests but still surprise the place.
Everything was neat, clean and enough for our needs, towels new,bathroom big and heated ,hot water at the instant.
Bed huge and confy.
Kitchen with all utensils.
Location perfect with a bus half block away and U-bahn 3 blocks we were connected everywhere.
Excellent place and Franz, always reachable and with great disposition.

A great place to stay, relax and enjoy after a busy day in the city. Very well equipped, nice, quiet and clean apartment. The sauna was awesome! Communication as well as checking in and out was super easy and smooth! Thanks a lot Roi! We highly recommend your place!

Die Location ist groß, ruhig, gut gelegen für Ausflüge in Berlin. Die Einrichtung ist toll und vollständig.
Ein netter Mensch steht für Fragen immer zur Verfügung. Alles in allem sehr, sehr gut.

Kinga and her boyfriend are lovely hosts! I only could stay one night, but they were very warm and took the time to answer any questions I had about Berlin and even helped me call a taxi to the airport! Great location in Mitte, I highly recommend staying here.

It was a really nice place to live! Jenny not only welcomed us personally home, and was always responsive to our messages, she gave us suggestions on where to go, what to see and recommendations for the area. The place was really nice, a small room, with nice furniture. We had access to the kitchen and the bathroom was clean and quiet big!
We had access to the house at any time and always felt like home!
We didn't see Jenny so much during our stay but we knew we could reach out to her at any point.
Definitely recommend 😉
Wohnung war Sauber, Gastgeberin pünktlich, Schlüsselübergabe ohne Probleme

The apartment is located in a quiet area close to the center (around 10 minutes away) and it has a great view. It is very cosy and clean. It is great for a company  and the visitors feel very comfortable. I suggest it for anyone who is gonna visit Germany.

Für uns war es der perfekte Aufenthalt. Ulla's Unterkunft liegt im Grünen mit perfekten Möglichkeiten zum Laufen, Schwimmen und Radfahren. Man kommt mit dem Rad auch sehr gut in die Stadtmitte von Berlin. Die Angaben sind alle korrekt, die Kommunikation perfekt. Ulla kümmert sich sehr darum, dass man sich wohl fühlt und alles passt. Wir planen wieder zu kommen - was das beste Kompliment ist!

We really enjoyed our time here! Andreas is a great host who is always ready to help or advice. The location and neighbourhood of the appartement are great. Checking out the local cafe’s and bars is really worth while. The appartment is located on a quiet courtyard that must look really inviting in the spring or summer. All things considered a great experience!

Very welcoming
Absolutely lovely apartment
I would recommend this stay anyone and everybody
Hope to stay again
Biggest compliment for a hostel: the beds were sturdy and quiet.

Andrea was very helpful and flexible in the organization of my stay at his place. The overall communication run very smooth and he replied each mail within minutes. I didn't get the chance to meet him personally but he arranged for the cleaning lady to way for me at the apartment at the time that suited me better.
The apartment is simply amazing: furnished with taste, it has a big living room, a completely furnished kitchen, two toilets and a very spacious bedroom. The area in which it is located is one of the most lively in Berlin with plenty of bars, restaurants and nice spots. I really felt like a real Berliner while staying at Andrea's place! I definitely recommend everybody to stay there!

Julien is very responsive gave us good instructions about the check-in. The apartment is very nice, sunny big with a great location. The interior design looks super nice, but unfortunately the wooden floor was creaking with every step, the wooden walls don’t isolate so you can hear every sound from the other rooms and the furniture might be nice to look at, but not really comfy to sit/lay on. Great place for a short stay, for people who are not light sleepers.

Torkjell's unique gallery-front apartment was exactly what I needed after a challenging travel day from Prague. After struggling with train platforms and ATM hunting, his warm welcome and genuine smile instantly made me feel at home in Berlin.
The space itself had character and charm befitting its artistic setting. What truly stood out was Torkjell's attentiveness - he took time to understand my interests and provided spot-on recommendations after seeing how much I enjoyed Holzmarkt. His follow-up the next day showed he genuinely cared about my experience.
I especially appreciated the laid-back approach to the space. Despite being in an older building with character, Torkjell wasn't overly precious about it, which allowed me to truly relax. Checkout was effortless - simply leaving the key behind.
If you're looking for an authentic Berlin stay with a host who embodies the city's welcoming creative spirit, I can't recommend Torkjell's place enough.
Anna and Sebastian have been very kind. In the end I couldn't actually stay with them due to a series of complications but they were always very kind and quick to respond.
Great location, great customer service by the receptionist, nice room but the owner was rude.

Really great location, and the room is seriously huge. Simone was communicative and helpful at check in - she helped me with my luggage since there is no elevator. The house is like a hostel with lots of little quirks and charms to be discovered. Beautiful big windows in the room, be sure to bring an eye mask to be able to sleep in. Really good people and location

Sehr schöne und praktische Gästewohnung, die alles hatte was wir brauchten. Sie ist ruhig gelegen, aber mit guter Straßenbahnanbindung in die Innenstadt, die ca alle 15 Minuten fährt. Wir würden diese Unterkunft jederzeit wieder buchen
Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit. Das Ambiente war sehr entspannt und die Umgebung toll!
A very especial and elegant flat to stay in Berlin.
The apartment was just as described. Very nicely decorated and clean. Beds were comfortable. Parking was no problem.

Would definitely a 100% recommend this place. It’s clean, cozy, staff is very very friendly, they provide everything going from towels to shampoo, a blow dryer, lockers for your stuff etc
The place is also very well located, literally near the water, really cute hostel !
Sehr zu empfehlen. Sehr nette Gastgeberin

Check in war sehr einfach und klar. parkplatz direkt auf dem Grundstück war nicht möglich, es gibt aber genügend Platz entlang der Straße zum parken. Zimmer sahen gebraucht aus aber sehr gepflegt und sauber. Etwas störend war der Geruch in der Wohnung. Der vorhandene zigarettengeruch wurde mit Raumduft übertönt was für unseren Geschmack zuviel war. Was fehlt ist tatsächlich ein Platz zum gemütlichen zusammensetzen- aber das stand auch in der Beschreibung.
Fazit: Für die Durchreise und wenn man nicht viel Zeit in der Wohnung verbringt Perfekt.
Schönes Zimmer und sauberes Bad in ruhiger Top Lage. Klare Empfehlung.

Die Wohnung ist sehr ruhig gelegen aber hat gleichzeitig eine sehr gute Lage. Die Wohnung ist in einem sehr guten Zustand, gerade das Badezimmer ist top!
Der Gastgeber antwortet sehr schnell und ist verlässlich.
Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit und kommen sicherlich nochmal wieder :)

Carola hat uns sehr herzlich in Empfang genommen und war auch vor dem Aufenthalt sehr gut erreichbar. Die Unterkunft ist wie beschrieben - gemütlich und sauber, uns hat es an nichts gefehlt - wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!
Jeff was so accommodating and kind, the place is great value!

I can’t recommend Matthias’s place enough! We truly loved staying in this beautiful home. The apartment was immaculate, very spacious, and the interior design was fantastic. Matthias had catered to our every need with so many personal touches including a book full of excellent recommendations and a collection of records which we really enjoyed. It really did feel like a home away from home. The beds were all super comfy including the sofa bed. It’s location is excellent with great access to public transport, shops and bakeries as well as lovely cafes, bars and restaurants nearby.
Matthias is a wonderful host; excellent communication and was very accommodating of our needs with late check in and allowing us to store our bags.
We really didn’t want to leave and I’ll definitely stay here again next time I’m in Berlin. Thank you so much!

In der Wohnung befinden sich zwei Zimmer, die gebucht werden können. Bad wird geteilt, Wohnzimmer mit Fernseher kann nicht genutzt werden.  Da wir nur ein Zimmer gebucht hatten, war dies okay. Zweiter Mieter haben wir kaum zu Gesicht bekommen.  Zimmertür ist mit Milchglasscheibe versehen durch die Licht vom Flur fällt, wenn es nachts angemacht wird.  Sonst alles okay. Besonders schön war die Aussicht vom 15. Stock auf Berlin.

Anthony war ein sehr zuvorkommender und hilfsbereiter Host.
Wir würden definitiv wiederkommen!!
Ist direkt an der Messe, Super nette Frau.

Place is easy to find and get to if you‘re in Berlin using the bus, u-bahn, etc.
Check-In and Check-Out was super easy.
Place was pretty clean. The shower didn‘t have warm water constantly tho (kept switching from warm to cold and back)
Very Nice👍🏻
Destaca la limpieza completa de la casa. La amabilidad y comunicación de Daniel conmigo. Habitación amplia y gran comodidad en todas las habitaciones.
Fantastic location, Barbara was very helpful and flexible upon checkin.

Simon’s apartment is fantastic and in a great location. Subway station in close proximity which will take you directly into the heart of town making it easy for a day of sight seeing.
Also plenty of restaurants and cafes within walking distance from the apartment.
The apartment itself was very clean and well presented. One of the best features was the balcony which catches the evening sun.
Simon was a great host, providing all necessary information ahead of our arrival and was more than willing to answer any questions or queries we had during our stay.
We loved our time in Berlin and would highly recommend this property to anyone visiting.

Spazio bello e ben curato il tutto situato in uno dei miei quartieri preferiti di berlino.
Consiglio vivamente.
accettano cani ✨
Super freundlich und immer erreichbar

This place is fantastic. The private patio bursting with plants, handmade ceramic dishes, wonderful collection of art books, and joyful sounds from the neighboring playground made it probably the most special AirBnB I've stayed in. Nice location near a large park and proximate to U bahn, restaurants, and art galleries. Overall a very comfortable place to stay in Berlin.

Hallo Jan,
es war ein cooles Apartment im Innenhof gelegen. Daher sehr ruhig. Hab mich auch sicher
gefühlt als Alleinreisende.
Mit U-Bahn und Bus waren alle Ziele schnell zu erreichen. Also zentrale Lage.
Restaurants, Bars und auch der Späti sind um die Ecke.
Ein super Weinladen ist in der Straße mit sehr freundlichen Inhabern.😉👍
Jan ist ein sehr freundlicher Gastgeber und hat alle Fragen schnell beantwortet.
Kann man auf jeden Fall empfehlen.
Vielen Dank für eine tolle Woche in Berlin. 🙏
Ich würde wieder da buchen
Liebe Grüße aus dem Allgäu Doris😉

Das Zimmer war sehr schön, viel Platz und in einer ruhigen Ecke in Berlin. Der Gastgeber war freundlich und hatte sich bereits im Vorhinein sehr darum bemüht, die Lage des Hauses und die Wohnsituation genau zu beschreiben, sodass die Anreise und der Aufenthalt reibungslos funktionieren konnte. 😊
convenient location

Gemütliche Einliegerwohnung mit ausreichend Platz für kleine Reisegruppen mit sehr freundlichen und zuvorkommende Gastgebern.
Die Wohnung liegt etwas außerhalb vom Zentrum, was aber ideal ist, wenn man abends noch etwas Ruhe genießen möchte. Der ÖPNV ins Zentrum hinein ist aber gut ausgebaut - Bus und S-Bahn fahren etwa alle zehn bis 15 Minuten, auch später abends.
Great apartment! 10 points!

Wir waren jetzt das zweite Mal in Barbaras Wohnung und es war genauso schön wie beim ersten Mal❤️ hatten wieder tolle Tage und eine erholsame Zeit. Die Wohnung ist perfekt angebunden und liegt in einer tollen Gegend - hier gibt es immer neues zu entdecken! (:
Peggy’s place was beautifully decorated with some great art and had all the amenities we could’ve needed. Location was perfect and communication was fantastic. Would stay there again.
Good place, esay to find and good communication with the hosts.
Skøn gammel Berliner-lejlighed med perfekt placering. Fuld af charme og kreativt indrettet. Alt gik som det skulle og vi vil meget gerne komme igen.

Very responsive host, easy check in and lovely quiet neighbourhood. Was very convenient for attending a concert at the Waldbühne, within east walking distance. Also, lovely hike up to Teufelsberg which was really interesting.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr gemütlich, geräumig und ein echter Geheimtipp. In unmittelbarer Nähe befinden sich zahlreiche Cafés, Restaurants und Haltestellen. Birte ist sehr offen und herzlich und bei Fragen sofort erreichbar. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen ☺️ 🔆

Sehr gute Lage aber
Leider laut da Erdgeschoss in einer belebten Straße und sehr alte Fenster.
Es ist nicht möglich in dieser Gegend wegen Anwohnerparken zu parken.

El hospedaje es lo que mencionan en la descripción, muy limpio, cómodo y con excelente ubicación. Todo queda cerca caminando o en transporte público, además nos dieron oportunidad de dejar maletas antes y sacarlas después lo que fue de gran ayuda, en todo momento estuvimos en comunicación, todo fue bueno
Great place to stay and nice surrounding area.
Great place to stay. Clean and comfortable with the best shower I could imagine. Everything worked out perfectly and I would love to come back the next time I visit the city! :)
The rooms had everything we needed. Also, they let us store our luggage for the day, after we checked out, which was extremely helpful.
Great location! Many things are open around.
Keine Stornierungsrückzahlungen

Mir und meine Mutter hat es bei Maria sehr gut gefallen! Alles war super,die Laage,Kommunikation, Wohnung,Vermieterin :) Eine sehr süße Katze hat und begrüßt🐱
Gerne wieder
The accomodation is really easy to reach by public transportation and also well connected to other parts of Berlin. Jonas was friendly and gave clear instructions. The place was clean and  pretty.
Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Obwohl sich die Wohnung in einer sehr lebhaften Umgebung mit vielen Restaurants und Kneipen befindet, ist es in der Wohnung sehr ruhig.

Samen met mijn schoonbroertje (17), schoonzus (20), mijn partner (28) en ik (26) een weekendje Berlijn geweest. In de CURT suite hebben we ons prima kunnen redden en ook qua ligging is het super praktisch! Alles was goed geregeld en de kamer was super netjes en schoon 😊
Het verblijf is zeker aan te raden ! ⭐️

Nice quiet place and very friendly people. We felt like home.
The room and the bathroom were very clean and big enough.
We could also use the kitchen, BBQ and the nice swimmingpool.
The centre of Berlin is about 20 min drive. The supermarket is on the corner. We recommend this place when you want to sleep in a quiet area.
Robert, Monique, Aaron, Puck from Amersfoort (Holland)

Totalmente recomendable en todos los aspectos.
Super recomendable.
Bra utgångspunkt för turistande!
Great apartment, great location. only thing to consider is that the apartment is in the third floor and there is no elavator

Buona permanenza, consigliato soprattutto per la posizione (in 2 minuti a piedi la metro per raggiungere i punti più interessanti di Berlino), la tranquillità della zona e la vicinanza di buoni punti spesa
Sehr gute Lage, gute Preis Leistung
Tolles Zimmer im Herzen von Berlin-Kreuzberg. Judith ist eine super Gastgeberin!
Everything was great!

I had a perfect stay in the apartment! First of all Sabine was very welcoming and helpful, everything was provided for and there's even a ring binder with useful information and tips on the living room desk! The apartment was very clean and indeed spacious & light as said. Since I was there for work for two weeks it was important to me that I would feel comfortable and 'home', and yes I totally did. By the way, I have to say I loved the shower!
The location was very suitable for me since it was just a 10 minute walk to the office and with the Warschauer Straße station very nearby you're quickly everywhere in the city.
I would stay there again for sure and would definitely recommend the apartment to everyone!

Lea's home is nothing short of perfect. It's located across the street from a grocery store and in a quaint neighborhood with lots of delicious restaurants, bars and coffee shops. With two bedrooms and a living room with a large comfy couch, both my children were able to have their own space. There was also an adorable outdoor patio where we drank cocktails in the evenings. Overall we loved our stay and highly recommend Lea's home.

Wonderful, cozy location and exactly what we needed for our stay. Quiet, tranquil, and accessible to a wide range of locations. The host, Linda, was very responsive, helpful, and courteous. Highly recommended!
Thanks for everything!
Alles prima! Schönes kleines Apartment mit allem was man braucht, perfekt für einen kleinen Städtetrip! :)
Près des transports en communs, gare à 5mn à pied bien pour une visite de quelques jours à Berlin
Perfect apartment for a family vacation in Berlin. Nice and clean apartment, not far away from the next train station.

Nothing but nice things to say, the house is lovely and Werner the host is fantastic.
I was a concerned that it might be a bit to far out of Berlin when I booked, but it really isn't a problem. The public transport is close by, cheap and efficient, and the area feels really safe when walking late at night.
Highly recommend.

Rainer was very helpful. We had a bit of an electrical problem and Rainer did everything he could to get us what we needed (primarily WiFi access). The apartment is very nice and has more than everything you might need. The space was perfect for 3 or 4 adults, or 2-3 adults with children. We enjoyed our stay and it was relatively easy to get around the city from the apartment.
Uns war schon alles vertraut von einem früheren Aufenthalt und alles war wieder bestens. Wir kommen sicher wieder. Danke
estaba bien.  limpio y comodo. parking e internet.

We stayed at Maria and Dani's place for five days. Maria is a super host, she gave us a loads of nice tips where to eat in the area and not only.
The apartment is really as you can see from the pictures.
It is very cosy and warm. The kitchen is brand new and the bedroom is amazing...you have the windows on the ceiling so you can check the famous beliner sky all the time!!
In the bathroom there is a nice bath tub, very comfortable, and you have a speaker with the radio connected with the stereo...that was absolutely brilliant.
The connection with the airport is super easy, there is only one train to catch and it takes only 20 min.
From that station there is the S-Bahn thet brings you to the center of the city in 20 min.
The view from the windows is really astonishing cause you can see all the preatty gardens.
We would definitely reccomend Maria and Dani's place.

Die Wohnung von Max ist optimal gelegen, man kommt schnell irgendwo hin. Die Straßenbahn ist direkt um die Ecke. In der Wohnung war alles vorhanden, was man für einen Kurztrip braucht. Wir hatten uns bewusst für eine Wohnung ohne Küche entschieden, da wir diese bei unseren letzen Berlin Reisen kaum genutzt haben.
Problemloser Check in/Check out.
Wir kommen gerne wieder…
Great apartment!
Wir waren zu dritt dort, Zimmer völlig ausreichend und einwandfrei zum schlafen und Berlin besuchen.

Alles super gewesen! Check in war etwas schwierig. Aber das ist nicht micheles schuld, da uns ein falscher Schlüssel ausgegeben wurde.
Abfluss in der kleinen dusche lief etwas langsam ab, aber michele hat sich sofort drum gekümmert!
Paar Kleinigkeiten hätten besser laufen können, aber das hat der reise in Summe keinen abruch getan.
Wohnung ist sauber, modern und mit Charme. Umgebung ist Stadtteil typisch authentisch. Ich würde wiederkommen!
Die Lage der Wohnung ist einfach top und der Preis ist dementsprechend gut. Die Wohnung ist größer als es auf den Bilder zu sein scheint.

Daniel's flat is very nice. The room look exactly like on the pictures. I had a great time in this place I will never forget it :D Daniel is a very nice host, always here to help. I would definitely recommend this place for a perfect stay in Berlin !

A wonderful apartment within a short walk to transit, a supermarket, wine shops and some a range of eateries. It was the perfect spot for us to base ourselves for a true Berliner experience. The
two decks afforded us both river views and sunset views - what a treat! Communication from start to finish was flawless. We would love to return to this special property.
We came without any problems, Andrew is very nice and organized. The place is good for max. 4 people and it's comfortable. We will join his flat again when we come to Berlin again !

Kim was a kind and welcoming host who made my friend’s and my stay in Berlin so comfortable! The apartment is in a great neighborhood, easy walk toward lots of sights, plenty of restaurants and cafe’s around, and very cozy. It was the perfect place to return to after a day out in the city!

The apartment is in a fantastic location, a very quiet neighbourhood but still plenty of cool bars and restaurants around, and only a 20min walk to Alexanderplatz, or a few tram stops.
The apartment does have everything you’d need; a decent kitchen, full bathroom, washing machine etc.
The one problem we had, though, was that the Airbnb listing states on the floor plan and bedding arrangements that there is a king bed in the bedroom. There certainly isn’t, instead 2 single beds pushed together, both with a single mattress. The mattresses too were extremely low quality foam and very spongy, more than 3-4 nights I wouldn’t have been able to sleep on it.
Communication and checkin were very easy and fast.

The best airbnb that I ever had. Everything was perfect and clean. The host was super kind and friendly. There is a nice cat in the accommodation which is super cute. I really enjoyed the stay. It couldn't be better.

Mike's been great. Always kind and available for any needs.
Flat very nice, comfortable and clean and close to metro station.
Really no negative points.
5 stars
Everything was ok. Thanks. Very good location.
Ich kann nicht meckern!

Das Hausboot ist jedenfalls eine coole Erfahrung und Abwechslung zu "normalen" Airbnbs.
Wir haben den Tag davor ein check-in PDF bekommen, wo alles im Detail sehr gut erklärt wird.
Leider haben wir das Hausboot nicht auf Anhieb gefunden, da die Koordinaten nicht ganz übereingestimmt haben. Bei Dunkelheit unbedingt mit Licht am Tretboot fahren! Martin und Tobias haben sich im Nachhinein sofort drum gekümmert. Sonst kann es sein, dass man ne Strafe zahlen muss.
Das Boot ist super gemütlich. Wir haben fast alle Holzbriketts verheizt weil es im November sehr frisch werden kann. In der früh mussten wir auch heizen, das kann dazu führen, dass man bisschen stickige Luft an Board hat.
In Bad und Küche hat alles super funktioniert und auch das Bett und die Sofas sind gemütlich.
Auf jeden Fall empfehlenswert, auch die Kommunikation mit den Hosts war ohne Probleme.

Max's apartment was so beautiful - the furnishings, the sunlight streaming through the balcony window, the lovely garden below. The entire building is modern and clean, and the neighbors are all so friendly and welcoming. Max was super responsive and friendly - he made us feel completely at home. I would highly recommend this place!

You have in effect full use of a sweet duplex: bedroom, generous common areas, a very well appointed bathroom — plus a lovely little garden! Even better than we expected from the pictures. And in the house all the little things were just right, in the way that makes daily life a pleasure. Yes, the location is on the edge of Berlin, you need to be clear. But you will not have this garden — where we relaxed often, where we could eat, could read on the terrace — this kind of space (perfect for a couple doing professional work) near the center, nor this quiet (let alone for this price) — and the public transportation into town is excellent. As for our host, checking boxes in the AirBnB form does not capture Angelika's consideration, her kindness, her concern with every detail. As a bonus, the couple in the other half of the duplex is warm, generous — we became friends.
Staying for six weeks, my partner and I considered ourselves fortunate.

If you're the type of person who likes peace and quiet after a long day/night of exploring, then this is the place for you. This is situated just a few stops from all the major markets and tourist attractions, and about 45 mins from the good techno clubs (but don't worry, the metro runs all night on the weekends in Berlin so no need to worry about pricey cabs/uber). There's a supermarket around the corner, plenty of restaurants, and a hookah lounge all within walking distance. But the best part is the private courtyard where you can meet other travelers or just enjoy a quiet drink outside as the sun goes down. Would highly recommend for anyone who enjoys cooking their own meals too, there's a flat top and other appliances which are perfect for an easy breakfast before sightseeing!

This place is...just okay. Accurate pictures, good location next to the transit station, and clean facilities.
However, the host said at time of booking that he would send check-in instructions "shortly before" the reservation. He did not send them 3 days prior as is standard. Instead, I messaged him 2 days before, then 3 more times every 12 hours, requesting the check-in information. He did not respond until I got Airbnb customer service involved less than 24 hours before check-in. It was stressful wondering if he was not going to respond at all, and asking Airbnb for their help in order to get the check-in info.
Then when we arrived at the check-in time of 12:00pm (which I had mentioned to the host at time of booking 2 months ago), the cleaners were in the apartment cleaning and seemed annoyed that we were there. Cleaning after our agreed-upon check-in time was frustrating, doubly so since they seemed annoyed by my presence.
The host makes guests take out their own trash and wash and put away their own dishes, under threat of keeping your deposit if you don't (per the check-in information provided with the keys). This is inappropriate since guests already pay a cleaning fee.

This place is great, perfect if you are looking for somewhere more quite and out of the city. It has what you need in close proximity and the public transport links are easily used, however be aware the distance does involve a 45 minute to 1 hour travel into the city.
This is easily overlooked by the comfort of the place, which is clean and a good size for two. With a heated underfloor in the bathroom even coming out of a warm shower in winter is welcoming in this place. The hosts are welcoming and full of information of the local area, public transports and they do truly try for their guests stay to be the best. For example the beds are photographed apart, i messaged if they would be comfortable with me pushing them together and as a surprise on our arrival they already had been.
I would highly recommend this accommodation!

Several services such as coffee maker, linens, hair dryer, and iron were not available. Had to call Air B&B service about all this, and only after did the host come to “clean” and provide one extra towel and a camping coffee maker. Last, THE 5% TAX IS THE HOSTS RESPONSIBILITY DO NOT PAY ADDITIONAL MONEY. Unless you are in an emergency situation, do not book.

This place is excellent for a stay in Berlin! I arrived to a completely spotless apartment with a well-stocked kitchen and a very comfortable bed. Everything worked pretty well, though the WiFi had connectivity issues based on the where you were in the apartment and if the induction stove was on or not. The shower, washer, and dryer all worked great, and the hosts were very responsive with the questions I had.
I will say as part of the review that this is decidedly not a handicap-friendly apartment to get to or move around in, and I would consider packing as light as you reasonably can as there is no elevator either. I wouldn't count the design of the apartment as a negative, but the bedroom is on the upper level of a split-level floor plan with most of the storage.
Overall I'd recommend it if you're in Berlin for a few days!

It was great! Check in was easy and flexible, especially as we arrived late at 11PM. We had our bikes and there was a spot to park them inside the building rather than leave them outside on the street. The studio is spacious and uncluttered, clean, and charmingly furnished. It is located in the heart of hipster Berlin, close to many cozy and delicious restaurants and cafes. Most amenities you would need on a short-medium stay are there. Only downside is the heater seemed weak, which was only a problem in a few instances. For a very well furnished apartment, we were also surprised that there was no hanger for the toilet paper roll, but that’s the only thing I can complain about. The kitchen is well equipped for basic cooking. The studio overlooks a courtyard to other buildings, which makes it generally very calm, except if the neighbors are loud. Jessica is indeed a Super Host! She went above and beyond for us. This apartment and location were better than described. It is a very nice flat. We had a great time. Thank you!

Fantastic apartment - would highly recommend.

Super süsse Wohnung... Marius ist sehr gastfreundlich... tolle Typs... Wohnung ist zentral und direkt an der S-Bahn... Sehr flexibel für Check-in und Check-out... Danke Marius für den tollen Aufenthalt...
