Stunning old apartment in a beautiful neighbourhood! The photos don’t do the place justice. Amazing restaurants and grocery stores within walking distance. Jörg was a very responsive and kind host that provided us with everything we needed! Will definitely look to book here again!
Emplacement parfait, chambre très propre et conforme aux photos et description. Parfait pour visiter Berlin !

Our family of five stayed for a week in Berlin. We loved the city and really enjoyed the flat and the neighbourhood. Located just in front of a park and not far from the subway and the tram the location is ideal. Shops, cafés and grocery stores are just a few steps away.
The flat is large, bright and well equipped and the beds are good which after walking as much as we did everyday is important!
I had an amazing time here, the house was super clean and the location was amazing, i would definitely come back

Eins der besten AirBnBs in denen ich bisher war!
Super modernes Apartment, sauber und eine tolle Kommunikation mit dem Host.
Auch kleine Sonderwünsche wurden umgehend erfüllt.
Wir kommen super gerne wieder!
very cozy apartement, excellent location. we had a great time over there!

We had a very nice stay in Robin's apartment. It was nice, cosy and decent. It's also situated in a very nice neighbourhood next to Mauerpark and close to Mitte. Robin and his colleague Gerlinde were very helpful and easy to contact. We would recommend everybody to stay in Robin's apartment.
Very peaceful & calm place and a very nice couple! Have been responsive and helpful during my whole stay. Absolutely recommend!
Daniela was a fantastic hostess! The apartment was amazing and the neighborhood was just as great. I highly recommend!

El apartamento es genial. Está en un barrio no masificado por el turismo y lleno de gente joven y tiendas locales alternativas muy chulas.... de arte, ropa, música, mercadillos. ¡Justo lo que vamos buscando cuando viajamos! Enfrente también hay dos supermercados donde compramos todo lo que necesitamos para pasar unos días en el apartamento. A 5 minutos del apartamento está la estación de trenes, desde donde pudimos movernos por todos los barrios de la ciudad y a muy buen precio ya que sacamos el ticket de transporte público de 5 días. El apartamento es muy bonito, acogedor y luminoso. Nos gustó que tuviese muchos electrodomésticos como tostadora, microondas, secador, cafetera italiana etc... aunque echamos en falta jabón y champú, que no llevamos ya que creíamos que habría como se anuncia en la descripción. Pero sin problema. También tuvimos un pequeño malentendido con la recepcionista, que se impacientó con nuestra llegada. No sabíamos que nos estaba esperando porque no se nos comunicó, y nos llamó muy impaciente preguntándonos que donde estábamos que no podría recibirnos si no llegábamos en una hora, lo que nos hizo sentirnos bastante presionados por llegar pronto pese al retraso de nuestro avión. Después nos recibió bien, por lo que le quitamos importancia al asunto.
Gracias a este apartamento pudimos disfrutar de unas vacaciones increíbles en Berlín y visitar todos los sitios que teníamos previstos sin problema. Volvería sin duda a Berlín en el mismo apartamento. 100% recomendado!!

This place is perfect for what we needed for our two night stay in Berlin. As we arrived late, being able to use a code to get in worked perfectly. The room was lovely and clean and had all the amenities we could need. The location was also perfect and very near the underground which was easy to navigate. Would recommend!
Ein tolles Boot mit einem wundervollen Blick und toller Ausstattung!
Perfect communication, nice apartment, no complaints!
Wir hatten einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt in der Wohnung. Es war alles da und man fühlte sich wie Zuhause :) Kommunikation klappte ebenfalls super.
Комната выглядит по-другому (лучше!). Хозяин отзывчивый и сделал всё, чтобы было удобно поселиться и выехать.
A nice host which is so friendly to answer enquiries and provide help. The room is comfortable and perfect for two persons. The apartment is clean and cosy. Just few minutes to the metro and tram.
Tolle Unterkunft - gut gelegen - sehr gutes Preis/Leistungsverhaeltnis.

The best part about the room is the light!  The view is also breathtaking and the apartment is situated in one of Berlin's best neighborhoods. But the real joy of staying there is being able to spend some time with Meggie.  She an extremely kind person and always made me feel like I was at home.

The apartment is as advertised and photos are accurate.  Easy walking distance (10 minutes) to Alexanderplatz.  Closest transit is the S Bahn at Janowitz Brucke or the U Bahn at Strausberger Platz, each 10 to 15 minutes walk.  We found taxis very reasonably priced.  Thanks for accommodating early checkin.
Lovely apartment in a nice neighbourhood.
Highly recommend and very nice and friendly person

We spent amazing week at Ursula’s place. It was so stylish and cozy. The location is very comparable and the view from the terrace is fantastic.
Ursula was very helpful and friendly!

Admed's apartment is next to a beautiful park in a quiet area, but is conveniently located for public transport. He was really helpful with my early check-in, and keeps the apartment very clean. Had a great stay :)
Ein super tolle Wohnung, zentral gelegen die U-Bahn liegt nur 5 Minuten entfernt. Die Vermietung/Kommunikation lief sehr gut. Immer wieder!
Very nice place, great check-in, check-out process.
Buena atencion y bien ubicado

Tiny but terrific: The Studio is perfectly equipped place, we have never before experienced such a complete collection of household stuff in combination with a tasteful interieure, e.g you will find cutlery from Villeroy & Boch as well as an Apple TV box....
The Studio is southwestbound, therefore bright and sunny, even in these short and dark days..
Apart from that, it is situated in the middle of an vibrant, exciting multiculti Distrikt,full of delicious Vietnamese and French/Cambodian Restaurants, polish vintage clothing stores, art boutiques and a bike's ride of 20 Minuten brings you right into the center of Berlin. Communications and cooperation with Maren was always prompt and reliable.
To cut a long story short: a perfect place for a perfect trip, if you find always the Adlon meanwhile a little boring ..
We had a really nice stay with Daniela. The apartment is spacious and in a great location. Daniela was welcoming and helpful with local recommendations.

Michael was a fantastic host. He was very easy to get in touch with and very approachable. The apartment is exactly as it appears in photos (perhaps even nicer!) an absolutely beautiful space. The neighborhood is full of bars and restaurants and the apartment is very close to 2 subway stops. I would absolutely recommend this flat! Thank you Michael for a wonderful stay!
Had a perfect stay here.
Beatiful place

Wir fanden die Wohnung super, sie war viel größer als erwartet, was wir super fanden. Die Gegend war ruhig. Das Airbnb war auch super mit dem Bus zu erreichen. Alles war super sauber und die Betten gemütlich.
Thanks for the stay!
Great location, clean. comfortable beds

The location of this Airbnb is good and it was clean enough, with some small issues. The bathroom is small and dark, which can be typical for Europe, but I would caution the step down from the shower to the floor is pretty steep and anyone who has clumsiness or mobility issues might not want to risk it or just be aware you will need to be very careful.

Die Seelodge hat unsere Erwartungen übertroffen.
Anstelle von Dorit hat uns Marion begrüßt und uns einen ganz herzlichen Empfang bereitet. Es hat uns an nichts gefehlt und die Lodge ist in allen Belangen toll ausgestattet.
Unvergleichlich war der Blick auf den Stößensee - vom Bett aus 😀
Buß- & Bahnverbindungen sind mit einem kleinen Fußweg gut zu erreichen.
3 Nächte waren irgendwie zu wenig und wir vermissen die Seelodge schon jetzt sehr, sehr, seeeeehr! 😊
Wir kommen wieder. 🤘👌

- lässiger Check-In
- gute Lage (nicht zu viel, nicht zu wenig los)
- Sehr saubere Wohnung, hat Spaß gemacht!🙏🏽
Nice place, peaceful neighbourhood. Jan was great as a host, explained everything petfectly and was always responsive with good suggestions about the city.
sehr gut für Jugendliche, nicht so toll für Familien. Die Matrazen sind weich und dünn.

The apartment is well located in Berlin. Shops and transport are nearby. The rooms are spacious and the accommodation is perfect for a family of 4. Beyond that, you have to sleep in a sofa whose mattress is very hard!
Two big weaknesses though:
- the reception procedure: you have to fill out forms, sign documents, contracts... It's a long way from the Airbnb spirit. We didn't even have a visit to the apartment and explanations (selective sorting, ...)
- The accommodation is not very clean: beard hair of the former tenants in the bathroom, stained tablecloth... overall impression of dirt.
The owner is there to make a profit on his home without sentimentalism...
Der Aufenthalt in Louisa's Wohnung war sehr angenehm, die Wohnung und die Umgebung ist sehr familienfreundlich. Man ist sehr gut mit allen öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln verbunden.
Had a great stay. The place was very organized, clean, and had everything I needed. Thekla was very friendly and helpful.

The apartment is in a great area. A short walk from some lovely cafes and restaurants, but very quiet and peaceful building. It was very clean, and bright with big windows, fresh towels, sheets, tea, coffee and even a couple of little bottles of wine.  Martin was very kind when we arrived. Our flight was delayed and we didn't arrive until 2am, but he was on the end of the phone to give us directions and stayed up to let us in. He even took the time to talk us through the apartment and surrounding area which was very nice of him considering it was pretty much the middle of the night by the time we arrived! It was a great stay and i'd happily go back.

The night and day staff at the front desk were very friendly, helpful and professional.  We found the continental breakfast provided to be standard fare but with plenty enough variety that we chose to eat in the hotel most days for convenience.  If you haven't included breakfast with your booking, you need to inform the front desk staff the night before (or when you check in) if you'll be having breakfast the next morning so that they have a proper head count.  There was always plenty of food whether we ate early or later.  The hotel reception and dining rooms were nicely appointed with a modern design.  The only downside was that our room had an oversized bath tub that is positioned oddly in the room -- it takes up way too much of your usable space and makes the room feel cramped for two people.  The bath tub could be removed to a corner, or the space used to expand the size of the small bathroom with the shower and toilet.

My boyfriend and I stayed in Holgers and Eike's apartment who welcomed us and made us feel at home. The apartment is super cozy, impeccably clean and equipped with lots of amenities.
Communication with our hosts was fast, accurate and timely and we really appreciated the flexibility in check-in and check-out.
Holger went out of his way to make us feel comfortable and welcome.
We look forward to returning soon! ✨

My friend and I stayed at Remy's place for 10 days.  We absolutely loved it.  The place was very clean and quiet and looked just like the photos.  The check-in was really easy.  We arrived hours before check-in, and they were flexible to let us leave our bags while they finished preparing the place for us.  The neighborhood was really lovely - lots of cafes, restaurants, bars, and shops within walking distance.  It was really easy to get to different forms of public transportation and we were able to get all around Berlin.  The street was quiet and the whole area felt very safe.  Remy left really helpful instructions, including QR codes to help understand how all appliances worked, and really nice suggestions for places to go around the neighborhood.  I would highly recommend Remy's place to anyone going to Berlin and would happily stay there again if/when I return to Berlin.
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans l'appartement. Celui-ci est très fonctionnel et très propre. Bon rapport qualité-prix.
Right in the middle of the City. Easy to find. Very nice Place. Worth coming back to it and time.
Estupenda estancia en el apartamento de Eugen!!

Wkd en couple à Berlin
Logement très récent avec mobilier de qualité
Hôte réactif et flexible
Idéalement situé au cœur de Mitte
Appartement situé au 7ETG sans ascenseur pour admirer les toits de Berlin
Easy and fast communication! Thank you David!

Heerlijk en rustig plekje , en goed bereikbaar met het OV. Het is prima uitgerust, heel fijn dat er basiszaken als koffie en thee aanwezig waren.
Contact met Alain was prima, en in het appartement liggen allemaal tips voor Berlijn.
Volgende keer Berlijn zal ik zeker weer dit appartement boeken.

Kathrin welcomed me personally to her beautiful apartment. She is really sweet, kind and helpful. I felt welcomed. Her place is literally spotless. Cleanest place I've ever been too on my trips. I stayed only for two nights because of concert I was attending. The location of the apartment is convenient, close to the city by public transportation or you can just walk and enjoy the city. There are lots of restaurants, cafes and grocery stores in the area. Shoping mall also close by. I would definitely choose Kathrin's place again in the future. Thank you for having me.
Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Heidi et nous avons passé un très bon weekend à Berlin.

Apartment was centrally located, clean, and as advertised here.
Su and Andre were great hosts whose recommendations for nightlife and the city in general helped me effectively plan my short stay.
We got along well and it gave the stay another layer of human connection.
Thanks both!
The studio itself was very cozy and very nice. Just everything you need and a nice, quiet place in a very busy city.
Alles waren in Ordnung. Die Wohnung war wirklich hell und sauber. Immer wieder 👌
El barrio donde se encuentra la habitación es muy genial, tienes bares y restaurantes cerca. La habitación también estaba bien y tenía una buena vista.
very nice apartment, in a quite zone of Berlin. damur is very nice and responsive, and waited for me since i was very late due to my previous appointment. thank you again

Me and my friends had an amazing time at Cordula’s place. The house if very beautiful, it feels like home. Everything looks like a fairytale. Cordula is an amazing host, she made sure we were very welcomed. The place is very clean and looks even better in person. The cat will give you lovely company with her cuddles. I would definitely come back next time I’m in Berlin.

Thiago was an excellent host. Very friendly and helpful. He made sure I got in and settled nicely. Thiago have me great recommendations and instructions on exploring the city.
His place was tidy and clean. I really loved the lighting and disco ball in the bathroom. It’s a cute touch. The bed was comfy.
I always felt safe at Thiago’s too. Which is important as a solo female travelling.
Would stay again if I visit Berlin.

Apartamento bien ubicado y bien equipado.
Las camas muy cómodas y bastante limpio.
Bien comunicado con el centro de la ciudad en un barrio sin ruidos y tranquilo.
Nice, clean, comfy and in a great location. Highly recommended.

Daniela and Juan Pablo live here, and this was my first time sharing with the hosts. There were no problems at all. We felt welcome right from the start.
Daniela was able to offer good advice about local places to visit.
This is stunning flat with a lovely balcony in a great location. Nearby parks and waterfront - we hired a canoe and paddled past the apartment.
Daniela and J-P made this a fantastic stay by being exceptional hosts.

This place is a beautiful and stylish space ideal for staying with a group of travelling friends or family. A great base for exploring Berlin and really nice parks and shops nearby. Felix and Phillip were so accommodating. Loved it

Wir haben 4 wundervolle Tage in Berlin verbracht. Die Wohnung war einfach zu erreichen, sehr nette Wohngegend mit vielen schönen Altbauten. Matthias hat uns sogar schon vor der eigentlichen Check-in-Zeit in die Wohnung gelassen und war sehr freundlich.
Die Wohnung ist wirklich schön, allerdings ein bisschen „abgewohnt“ (Esstisch, Wände könnten einen Anstrich brauchen), wobei ich mir vorstellen kann, dass auch manche Gäste nicht unbedingt pfleglich vor Ort vorgehen. Das allergrößte Manko ist allerdings der sehr laute Nachbar über der Wohnung, der bis um 3 Uhr morgens die Nacht zum Tag machte, und zwar jede Nacht! Ich würde die Wohnung nochmals buchen, allerdings nicht, wenn der Nachbar noch oben wohnt.
Das Badezimmer war sehr sauber und auch die Handtücher und Bettwäsche waren in einem sehr guten und angenehmen Zustand. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt, bis auf die Nächte.

Nina ist eine tolle Gastgeberin. Von der Kommunikation bis Check-In und Vorort Rückfragen war alles super und freundlich.
Das Appartement ist groß und schön eingerichtet.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Gerade wenn nach der Pandemie wieder alles Restaurants und Bars und Cafés geöffnet haben, kann man sich dort nur noch wohlfühlen.

Loved it!
Everything was extremely smooth and well thought through - check in, directions and transport info, luggage storage, everything. The place is sparkling clean and comfortable for 4. Kitchen is well equipped with even a vegetable grater. The neighbourhood is nice and easy connections to the main sights. Very strong wifi. The decor is both interesting in a design sense but also very functional.
the neighbour is quite nice actually. Though there's train nearby, it did not interrupt my sleep
Suited us perfectly! Right next to the U-Bahn to get into the centre of Berlin and all functional and clean.
Стильная квартира, все чисто. Расположение неплохое.

Great location and a comfortable space. Communication was fast and check-in/check-out was a breeze. There are lots of fun things going on right in the neighborhood and there is easy access to public transport to head to other parts of the city as well. The whole thing was seamless, highly recommended!
The neighborhood it's very funny, the room confortable and bright, the host friendly and available, not at all invasive.  We were there for and interrail so for us was an incredible place!

Fairytale 🦉 ~ this apartment is stylish and serene, a getaway just off-road from the East Berlin city neighborhoods which all have much to offer. If you are the type to venture and enjoy the juxtaposition of city and nature and would like to see what East Berlin is like, I highly recommend Carmen’s place. There are a number of different neighborhoods within 15, 20, 30 minutes walking (also great public transportation and bicycle-friendly), so you can explore all the different scenes or find the one you are looking for. Carmen is a kind and positive host with good communication and a very nice selection of books and color palette.

oldukça kolay ulaşımı var, merkezi ve etrafta cafe,bar, restorantlar market var. ayrıca metro ulaşımı çok rahat, yürüyerek de merkezi yerlere ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Eugune'in  giris talimatları oldukça net ve kolay anlasilir. Ancak giriş ve çıkış saatleri konusunda esnek degil. apartman tam fotoğraflardaki gibi. temiz, kullanışlı. ev sahibi her türlü  sorumuza hızlı yanıt verdi ve sorunlarımızın çözümü konusunda yapiciydi. tekrar tercih ederiz. eğer merdiven çıkma sorununuz varsa 5.katta ve asansorsuz bir daire olduğuna dikkat edebilirsiniz.

one of my favorite air bnb’s i’ve stayed in in germany! it was in a great location in close walking distance to transportation. there were tons of lime scooters that we used a lot too. stefan welcomed us right when we got there and showed us around the apartment. it’s a gorgeous and spacious loft, and we were able to do some laundry for the midway point of our trip which was great. also, an amazing price for the space! highly recommend for couples and two people.

Great apartment, very clean and comfortable, plenty of space for 4. Easy walk to several train stations. Plenty of restaurants nearby and close to Lidl. Loved the massive TV and drawing on the whiteboard. Thanks for a great stay!
Sehr herzliche Begrüssung und Betreung, echte Gastfreundschaft
Amazing place to stay beautiful rooms perfect for long term stays
Alles wie erwartet.
Sehr schöne und ruhige Lage. Als Gast hat man seine eigene Toilette, was mir sehr gefällt. Die Gastgeber waren sehr nett und zuvorkommend!
Great accommodation and perfect location :)
So much nicer than a fancy hotel! Loved Michael's place.

This place is great! Small but perfectly formed, and in a really nice part of town with lots of nice cafes and restaurants near by.

Annette was fantastic. Everything was taken care of, and Nele the neighbour was very welcoming and friendly.

Wish we could have stayed longer!
The apartment is in an excellent location with amenities and monuments within walking distance for us. The apartment was clean, spacious, inviting and comfortable.
It’s a good place to stay while exploring Berlin. At an affordable price, has everything you need. The hosts were very friendly and helpful. Would recommend for a few days in Berlin.

It’s great staying at this airbnb, the interior looks exactly like the pictures. It’s clean, really big, comfy beds and everything you need to be comfortable. The host are also incredibly fast in awnsering any messages which is great! I defenitly recommend this place!

The location is great. The loft was very comfortable, spacious and with plenty of light, with all the necessary amenities and elevator access to the floor. The communication with the hosts is easy and instructions for check-in clear and smooth. I will definitely come back!

Laura was a very kind host who communicated instructions very clearly and promptly about my stay.
The room was nice and very well located, however I would say that it could get quite noisy due to the location so keep this in mind if you’re an early sleeper.
Very nice place at a great location!

El apartamento está ubicado cerca de la estación de metro, museos y supermercados, por lo que es perfecto para realizar actividades en la ciudad. El apartamento está muy bien equipado y cuenta con todas las comodidades para una buena estadía. Recomiendo completamente el alojamiento.
Waren für eine Woche dort. Wohnung und Lage sind wirklich mehr als ideal! Kommunikation mit Katja war auch total einfach. Wirklich sehr empfehlenswert :)

🚩-離中央車站只需15-20分鐘的車程直達不用轉車，距離最近的車站只要10分鐘的步行，同時有U-BAHN 可以轉乘，附近離alexanderplazts 和博物館島很近，附近則是有非常多年輕人夜店和techno可以去玩玩，晚上富附近都也非常安全且寧靜，不過前往bnb的路上路面有些非柏油路面，稍微一些些行李箱不友善，其餘無可挑剔。
🏠-處處充滿房東gunnar的巧思與佈置天份，公寓內部各項用具齊全且十分時髦，廚房冰箱都是名貴品牌，餐桌陽台都十分寬敞，若想自己下廚十分方便，廁所非常的乾淨除濕能力一級棒，房間很溫馨舒適，但不適合置放太多大行李，但整體空間都很令人開心愉悅。
👥-房東和他的伴侶同住，兩人都非常友好，也都會主動提供協助，建議喜歡交朋友的人可以選週末入住，能與他們能有更深刻的交流與互動。

Incredible value for money. The location was great, near public transport in a hip
and lively neighbourhood.
Philipp and Caroline were prompt to respond to our queries and their instructions were clear and timely.
The place is spacious and exactly as described.
Highly recommended!

Kleine aber feine Wohnung.
Eine Riesen Dusche ist auch dabei.
U-Bahn direkt vor der Tür.
Alles da was mach braucht Supermarkt, Sekt guter Bäcker und Bank direkt um die Ecke.
Für einen Trip nach Berlin ideal.

Die Unterkunt ist sehr sauber und hat eine gute Lage wenn man schnell zum Flughafen kommen will. (zu Fuß selbst mit Gepäck nur ca, 15min entfernt.)
Einrichtung ist zweckmäßig, als Bett stehe leider nur ein Schlafsofa zur Verfügung. Für eine Nacht ok, für länger etwas ungemütlich.
Gastgeber sind sehr nett und helfen gerne weiter. (Danke für den Tipp mit den Restaurants).
Die An/Abreise von oder nach Berlin dauert zwischen 50min und über 1 Stunde - vorher die beste Verbindung checken lohnt sich!

Stor og rummelig lejligheden med gode faciliteter. Lejligheden var pæn og ren. Den ligger i gåafstand til indkøb, restauranter og offentlig transport. Min familien og jeg havde et rigtigt godt ophold i lejligheden, og vi vil gerne booke den igen en anden gang.
War alles super, nette Gastgeberin, super Unterkunft, sehr zu empfehlen!
Very nice flat. Clean and comfy. I can highly recommend staying at Alan and kasia's place!!

Great place for a short stay in Berlin, the area is very calm and looks safe, there are a supermarket very near, also tram stops and bus stop not far away. The host is nice and keeps everything clear with the check in, it is super easy to check out too. Studio was nice with everything needed. Thanks for the stay!
The apartment is really cool! The view is amazing and the location is perfect. I was really satisfied staying there. The communication with the host was also super! Amazing apartment!

I hate to give bad reviews but they leave me absolutely no other choice. The matras was very old, smelly, itchy and there was a whole in it which resulted in basically laying on the floor. It hurt like hell and I can’t remember having a worst night than this. The blanket was very thin, way too cold for the winter. At 7am they were working outside very very loudly with glass or something. It looks nice but the reality is that everything is so old and dirty. I also did not get any money back for the second night I didn’t sleep there. I couldn’t possibly stay there another night and they didn’t give me a the money back. What a poor corporation.. :(
Perfect position, spotlessy clean, cosy and very easy check-in and check-outt. Thanks a lot for everything, hope to be back!
Sehr netter Gastgeber, hat sich um mich gekümmert, auch wenn ich nicht viel Zeit hatte. Ich freu mich auf nächste Mal.

Nous avons séjourné 4 nuits chez Sedat avec nos 2 filles de 10 et 8 ans.
L'appartement est parfaitement équipé et spacieux. Le canapé-lit est très confortable (comme un vrai lit !)
L’appartement est très bien situé, au calme, à peine à 200 mètres du "métro".
Quartier très calme et paisible au bord de la rivière.
Sedat est un hôte parfait : il nous a beaucoup aidé dans la préparation de notre voyage, et il a été toujours disponible. L'accueil sur place a été parfait.
Nous vous le recommandons chaudement.

We totally enjoyed our one month stay at Amelie, Christiane, and Ebru's apartment in alt Tempelhof. The apartment is well organized, with lots of useful information for guests including a large map of the Berlin U and S bahn routes. It has lots of storage spaces, a large comfortable bed, outstanding WIFI and a nice kitchen. The U6 provides easy access to the Ringbahn and therefore all of Berlin. Down the main street Tempelhofer Damm is a 'sea-coast' harbor, believe it or not! The neighborhood in which the apartment is located is charming with picturesque tree-lined, shady cobble-stone streets, churches and lovely buildings. Tempelhofer Feld is nearby if one wants to ride bikes or jog. All in all, our stay was perfect and the hosts are too.

This apartment was right in the heart of Berlin. Many things walkable and public transport only a few minutes walk. Felt very safe staying there as a solo traveler and it was very easy to find and get in, there are clear pictures for check in. Honestly, never needed to talk to the hosts about anything, it all ran very smoothly.  Would definitely stay here again if I'm ever back on Berlin!

Love love loved Roi’s  place.  The sauna was a wonderful way to end the day and relieve stress.  The apartment was fun and tastefully furnished.  Location was great. nice to have the beer and wine in the refrigerator when we arrived.  We will recommend to our friends.

Andrea’s apartment was beautiful and very well-priced for Berlin. We really enjoyed our stay and it was super easy to get to the S-Bahn (10 min walk), trams or buses, and from there, only 15-20 min into the centre of Berlin.

Cozy, beautiful, lots of character. The staff was very lovely and proactive as well as speaking different languages; available 24/7. Very cute library/ bar, affordable and super delicious all-you-can-eat breakfast buffet right next door. We stayed on the third floor which took us 69 steps to get to, that might be challenging to some. The breakfast buffet requires walking down stairs as well which limits the accessibility. The bathroom was nice and spacious, the beds comfy and furniture wise everything we needed (and more). Lots of options for public transportation close by as well as restaurants and other things. We very much enjoyed our stay and will be coming back! 10/10

He was also concerned if everything is going smoothly during the stay which we found very heartwarming.

The household appliances at the premise are by German manufacturers, The laundry washer and dryer let us stayed in style from being weary travellers, the dishwasher had not made any noise during operation and clean items like new, the light system are also well designed; so fancy yet practical.
In short, everything is literally perfect whether for a short stay or live forever for us. Thank you Stefan!

I have visited many capital Cities, especially in Europe.  Until recently I had never even visted Germany and Berlin was a City that I really wanted to visit. I can say now that Berlin does not even come in my top 10 Cities. It is very difficult to describe in one word, but Berlin in my opinion was 'drab' and slightly depressing, with many areas covered in graffiti. There are some areas that are modern and up to date, especially in and around the Brandenburg gate area, but I won't be re visiting Berlin, in the near future. I would still say to people to visit the City, but only if you had already visited the many wonderful places that exist in Europe.

The house was very clean with a full-function kitchen and spacious dining room. Everything looked exactly like in the photos.
We had a pleasant stay in Sabrina's place and would highly recommend to anyone that looking for a homie place to stay in Berlin at the perfect location.

Francamente es uno de esos caso en los que uno se plantea que hubiera sido mejor ir a un hotel. Las sabanas olían fatal, cuando llega la hora de ir a dormir lo último que apetece es oler como si no se hubiesen cambiado las sábanas de la persona anterior. Olían a sudado y había pelos y estaba manchado. Me quejé y llegó la mujer de la limpieza a cambiarlas a las 8.45 de la mañana del mi segundo día. Dándome excusas sobre el tipo de jabón con el que se pueden lavar o no. De buena mañana también es lo último que apetece. Luego cosas tal vez no criticables pero que molestan, en la ducha no había champú, solo una pastilla usada y en la cocina, a pesar de tener de todo, no había ni un triste sobre de café instantáneo. Encima también tienes que pagar igualmente un tasa turística añadida de 7,65 €. La conclusión es que más vale un hotel normalito pero donde todo esté limpio, tengas de todo en el baño y tengas el desayuno incluido. Sigo siendo fan de airbnb, pero estas experiencias hay que mejorarlas.

We loved the place! It is in a great neighborhood, with lot's of delicious food and cool things to do. The apartment is very tastefully furnished and decorated, it was a real pleasure to stay there. The secluded garden is a great bonus! It waa quiet and cosy, we recommend it to anyone!

Great place to stay in Berlin. Very clean. Ingrid and her adult children were very helpful and made sure everything was perfect. Anyone who wants to be close to Berlin but still have ample space should look here.

Wir waren drei Nächte bei Nils und seiner Freundin und haben und vom ersten Kontakt an wohl und gut aufgehoben gefühlt. Super Kommunikation, sehr sympatisch und unkompliziert. Die Wohnung top gemütlich und sauber. Das Zimmer klein aber ausreichend und auch sehr gemütlich. Sehr gut zu erreichen, zu Fuß oder mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Äußerste Empfehlung!

This apartment was a lovely place to enjoy our Berlin stay. The character of the building was gorgeous, we loved it here, great neighbourhood, lovely safe streets to walk around, close to many restaurants and a bio supermarket. Also the Wall Museum was within walking distance. But if you have had a busy day on your feet the underground was very close by. Henrik was great, lots of info provided and one of his recommended local Italian restaurants Osterio Fiorello was a definite winner for us, ate their on two out of three nights. Highly recommend this apartment.
Great apartments in great location of Prenzlauer Berg. Clean, cozy, sunny and have absolutely what you need. And  very friendly host! Good luck!

A lovely flat, exactly like the pictures. Really great location, in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg with all the restaurants bars and easy transport access, despite this a very quiet and calm apartment. I would recommend staying here very much.

Minor points which shouldn't spoil your stay: the flat is managed by an agency, do ask for full arrangements to the flat for arrival and departure, the address on its own won't suffice, as there are many buzzers and once in the flat block it's not at all obvious where to go. Ask for full access details to save yourself the cost of a few international phone calls to the agents. There are no lifts, not a problem once you've lugged your bags upstairs once though! Otherwise a lovely place to stay.

Katrin’s place is better that what it looks like in the pictures. I’m a designer and in terms of interior design the place is beautifully curated with vintage posters and furniture, cool mirrors and lamps! Definitely reflective of Berlin’s style. I would return there any time plus it is easy to get there by metro.
Alles war super, gerne wieder .
Das Zimmer war okay , allerdings leider in nicht besten Zustand . Für eine Übernachtung hat es allerdings gereicht.
Sehr schönes Airbnb! Sehr sauber und schön eingerichtet☺️

Wonderful room at a wonderful location, just a straight train from central station. Although, when I stayed, the host were not home, but they were always available online and ready to help with your needs. The check-in process was super smooth and didn't have any problems. Highly recommended!
In diese Wohnung wären wir am liebsten gleich eingezogen! Alles da, was man benötigt und sehr gemütlich.

We had an amazing stay with Micheal and Milkana. Their hospitality was super and they made us feel very much at home! The area is really quite, the city centre was easy to reach and variois facilities (restaurants, supermarkets) are close by. Thank you for making our stay so great. We would love to come back :)!
Really top class location at an affordable price. Great base from which to see the city. Very clean and warm. Small but has everything you need. Cleverly designed. Would highly recommend
Buena, anfitriona atenta y al pendiente. Las fotos coinciden con la publicación y hay metro a 100 mts, lo cual es muy bueno aunq el rumbo no me gustó. Todo lo demás muy bien.
Beautiful, big apartment next to a ton of really great, cheap restaurants! Very good kitchen with alot of supplies to cook with and super nice hosts :)

Je huurt bij Ella geen anonieme of luxe hotelkamer. Je komt er wel in een echt Berlijnse woning, tweehoog via het trappenhuis van een achterwoning. Ella is een heel plezierige en gastvrije host die je alle info en hulp geeft die je nodig hebt. Het geboden comfort is eenvoudig maar er is een prima bed van 1.40 breed en de kamer kijkt uit op de binnenplaats. Je hoort dus geen verkeer. Je kunt verder gebruikmaken van Ella’s badkamer en keuken. Locatie is helemaal goed, middenin Prenzlauerberg.
Most awesome location. Close to all and even though very close to a rai station it was very quiet inside. Awesome spot.
Marina is a very nice an helpful person. Great location in Berlin Mitte. It was a pleasure to stay at her place.
Yaz war sehr freundlich und die Wohnung ist sehr zentral zu allem
Gute Lage und saubere Zimmer

Wir haben uns super wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön in einer interessanten Gegend.

Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder :)
Ideal location near to restaurants,shops and local amenities. Would recommend it.

La maison d’Axel est un petit coin de paradis. Un véritable havre de paix avec un magnifique jardin où les enfants pevent s’en dînent à cœur joie ! La maison esy située dans le quartier de Pankow, un quartier résidentiel et borde de petites maisons. C’est un endroit où il fait bon vivre, calme et loin du tumulte du centre de Berlin. Il est facile de se déplacer depuis la maison d’Alex (M1 puis le métro) pour rejoindre rapidement les différents sites touristiques.
Si vous passez par Berlin, je vous recommande vivement de vous arrêter dans la maison d’Axel et sa famille, un grand merci à eux 💙

This lovely apartment is exactly like on the pictures: lots of space, lots of natural light and tastefully decorated. There is a nice café right next to it, and it's really close to the M2 and M10 tram lines. The room is quiet and practical, and the bed very comfortable. The neighborhood is safe and peaceful, with children and young families everywhere. The cats are adorable and super friendly. But more importantly, Katja is a wonderfully amazing host! Always kind, very helpful and generous! I highly recommend this place if you want to have a good time in Prenzlauerberg!

Very clean and the best location in Berlin!
Just you should have in mind that for 4 people if you are not family or close friends it will be hard to stay. Especially bed near the entrance is not as big as expected for 2 people.
Logement très sympathique, décoré avec goût et avec juste ce qu'il faut pour passer un bon moment ! En plus, il est super bien situé, en face de la KulturBrauerei ! Merci Lena
Sehr freundlicher Empfang und zuvorkommende sowie unkomplizierte Behandlung.

J'ai passé 6 nuits dans le logement pour un séjour professionnel :

le point négatif : il y avait comme une odeur de cigarette qui venait de l'appartement du dessus ou dessous, c'est pour cela que je mets 4 étoiles

Fantastic location, nice rooftop terrace, the apartment is even nicer than it looks in the pictures. Hosts were extremely nice and helpful.
Nettes kleines Appartemant in Neukölln mit allen Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Nähe. Wir waren sehr zufireden

We absolutely enjoyed our stay at Bernds home, there was enough space for all guests, the house was clean and in a beautiful building. The neighbors are friendly and the hosts are very helpful. You can easily get to nollendorf Platz or wittenberg Platz via a 5 minute walk. Lots of amazing food, shops and cafes nearby which made the neighborhood feel like home with our one month stay. The area gets bustling during the day and at night the bars are lively but never to loud so you never have to worry about late night noise. All I can say is I absolutely love Berlin and I’m 100% satisfied with my choice in Bernds apartment for the month of august!
wir sind von Sabine total nett empfangen worden, leider konnten wir nur für eine Nacht bleiben. Sehr, sehr gerne wieder beim nächsten Mal in Berlin.
Beatrice is fantastic and her apartment is adorable and welcoming!!

Super Airbnb Host! Schnelle Kommunikation und immer erreichbar. Peter ist sehr flexibel und die Wohnung war nicht mal eine Minute von der U-Bahn entfernt! Für Kaffee am Morgen wurde gesorgt und reichliche Handtücher von klein bis ganz groß. Die Wohnung ist in einer guten Lage und man findet sie sehr leicht.

La camera è piccola, ma pulitissima e gli spazi bene organizzati. Die sehr gut ausgestattete Fewo war gemütlich und ruhig gelegen. Es war ein gelungener Aufenthalt, gerne wieder!
Great place to stay

A very nice place and location, just 2 min from the train station.
The appartement is same as photos!
Very clean, and you find everything you need when you come , and specially Bio & Vegan Products (Wash gel, hand gel, body lotion, shampoo, etc) even chocolate and snack’ thank you!
Very good communication, numa team is so helpful!

Sehr geräumiges und sauberes Apartment. Gute Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel. Gastgeber leicht erreichbar. Lediglich etwas Probleme mit dem Internet.
everything was perfect - location, accessibility, and a cute apartment!

Le logement était conforme à la description voire mieux que dans nos attentes. Très propre. L’hôte Natalia est réactif et accueillant. I enjoyed staying at Yvonne's place. It was a neat and clean place, everything we needed was there. The place was cosy, had nice art and was on a perfect location for us. Thanks Yvonne!

Ruim appartement, in de zomer waarschijnlijk wel behoorlijk warm. Heel fijn dat we dichtbij een U-bahn halte zaten (Mohrenstrasse) en bij een heel goede supermarkt.

Our stay was awesome really nice place as described and on photos. Beds nice and comfy the kitchen bathroom had everything we needed nice and clean too.

Der Ludwigkirchplatz direkt in der Nähe mit all den Restaurants und Cafes lädt einen ein, direkt Zeit vor der Haustüre zu verbringen. Immer wieder.

Great location close to so many cafes and bars.  Short walk to Mauerpark for the Sunday market.  Apartment itself is a cool open top floor loft, a small balcony for some fresh air.  Comfortable home for our long weekend visit.

Die Wohnung ist super zentral in Moabit gelegen.

Leider ist der Aufzug ziemlich laut.
Vielen Dank Katerina! Es hat mir sehr gut bei dir gefallen. Tolles Zimmer und super sauber!
Der Besuch bei Frau Neumann war toll. Gute Lage, sauberes Zuhause und nette Bekanntschaft. Gerne wieder!

Absolutely clean place. Lots of space. Friendly host. Very close to multiple transport links. 3 mins walk to bus, 10 minute walk to tram.
Quiet and peaceful neighbourhood.

Stayed in this beautiful place for a month. Felt it like home. The best neighborhood in whole city, a lot of galleries and restaurants nearby. All furniture and technic were in perfect stay. Totally recommend

Appartement vraiment propre. Lit de bonne Qualité. Bon emplacement - déplacement en tram (proximité 5 à 10 minutes selon le tram nécesaire). Système de check in / check out top. Viajamos a Berlín mi pareja y yo. Thuy nos ayudó en todo momento para poder llegar a su alojamiento. Además, estaba en perfecto estado. La habitación es muy bonita y cómoda. Thuy fue muy amable. Recomendable 100%
A superb Airbnb apartment. Clean, warm, cosy and comfortable. Very close to metro to get around the city. Felt right at home. Kind and fast responsiveness.

Great place to stay to explore Berlin. Right at the train station, plenty of coffee shops and food places just accross the other side of the train station. Laundry was also a plus. Three supermarkets right there at the door. Train from Birlin airport to Zoologischer, then one stop to Nollendorfplatz or of your keen an easy 20 min walk to the accommodation from Zoologischer. would definitely stay again.

We had a wonderful time at Guy's place! The apartment is spacious and beautifully designed, with an amazing view. It features two large bedrooms and a generous terrace. Guy was the perfect host – warm, friendly, and incredibly thoughtful. Highly recommended!
florian answered us quickly and check in was very easy.  the apartment was exactly as in the pictures, we were very satisfied with our stay.
Great stay! Definitely recommend this loft for anyone visiting Berlin.

Easy check in and check out. Very good location (supermarket just across the street). Helpful host
Birgit ist eine offene und herzliche Person, sehr angenehm. In der Unterkunft habe ich mich gleich wohl gefühlt.
Easy access, comfy beds, nice neighborhood and a little dark interior.
Es war entspannt, wie beschrieben, sauber und schön. Beim nächsten Besuch in Berlin wird das wieder unsere Unterkunft.
Very nice place to stay. Big and bright room with good vibes, good communication, Leo and Gareth are great hosts. I definitely recommend the place.
Beautiful and cozy place.  Super clean, fully equipped.  As a bonus, a beautiful view of the city. It's a shame we had such a short stay.

Along with 2 other friends I stayed at Robert's place when we visited Berlin for a conference. The place was calm and peaceful and a 10 min walk to the nearest rail station (Heerstrasse). The place was sparkling clean with all the amenities of a fully furnished home. Good for a family of 4 with kids or even babies. I would definitely want to stay at this place if I visit Berlin again.
Das Zimmer war sehr ruhig, wir haben sehr gut geschlafen. Die Matratze war auch sehr bequem. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Logement très agréables, aucun problème. Tout était super, rien à dire !
Beautiful and unique home. The secluded courtyard made the home very special.

As advertised, this is a bedroom in a shared home with the host. The bathroom is shared with host and other guests. Alessia was very helpful and flexible with my need to drop bags off my prior to check-in. I wish I would have had more time to hang out with her:
The home is very close to the U line, making it easy to get around Berlin without the need for a car.
Priced just above hostel rates and well below private rental rates, the place offers everything that you’d expect for the advertised rate. It is perfect for a budget-minded person traveling alone who intends to spend most of their time outside exploring Berlin.
The building is older and could use some updates to the common spaces; however, my room was neat and clean when I arrived. There was a lingering smell of cigarette smoke which I found a bit disappointing. Also, you will be going up several flights of stairs to access the unit so be prepared for that.
Overall staying in Alessia’s home was an enjoyable experience.

Die Wohnung ist blitzeblank und noch schöner als auf den Fotos. Überrascht waren wir von liebevollen Details wie Schokohasen und Eiern auf jedem Bett (Wir kamen am Ostermontag). Toll ist auch, das alle Basics in der Küche und für die Kaffeemaschine Kapseln satt vorhanden sind.
Wenn ihr Kinder dabeihabt, packt alles mit ein was Räder hat: Skate-/Longboards, Rollerblades, Roller, .... das Tempelhofareal ist großartig!
Bei Problemen hilft Werner sofort weiter und seine Tipps z. B. für Restaurants im Kiez sind klasse. Wenn wir wieder nach Berlin fahren, kommen wir wieder.

Très chouette séjour dans cet appartement très bien situé. Michele est très réactif et aidant dans nos besoins. Nous vous recommandons ce logement et avons passé un excellent séjour à Berlin. Merci Michele
Fantastic place to enjoy Berlin. Clean, easy and in the best area. Laura Is lovely and helpful.

Appartement dans résidence ne résidence calme mais dans un quartier animé avec supérettes, restaurants et transports à proximité.
L'appartement était parfaitement propre et conforme à la description. Les 90 marches pour atteindre l'appartement ne sont pas vraiment un problème sauf le jour de l'arrivée avec une valise de plus de 20Kg 🤣(séance de cardio gratuite !)
Un seul petit reproche, il manque un peu de quoi cuisiner rapidement le soir par contre il y a tout le nécessaire pour le petit déjeuné (cafetière, bouilloire et grille pain).
Bonne communication de l'hôte.
This is a great little spot in a really great area! Lots of little bars and cafes nearby, as well as the canal and easy cycling routes.

Die Wohnung hat zwei schöne Balkone. Auf den Bildern sieht es so aus, als wären es zwei Zimmer, tatsächlich ist es aber nur eines. Wir haben dort genächtigt, weil wir die Nähe zum Flughafen gesucht haben. Ein Taxi zu Flughafen kostet ca. 20 - 25 Euro. Frau Ezsebet hat uns Tee und Kuchen auf den Tisch gestellt, was wir sehr nett fanden. Es ist eine ruhige Wohngegend. Preis Leistung war in Ordnung.
Great stay!
Die Unterkunft war für unseren kurzen Aufenthalt in Berlin perfekt. Die Lage der Unterkunft war gut. Alles war wie angegeben. Hatten eine schöne Zeit! Wir würden wieder kommen.

We spent some time at Ena's place for a work meeting and it served us well for this purpose. There is a park and forest across the street, it's quiet and still it's not far from the city center. Plus Ena and her mother Ana live in the same building, so communication is super easy.
Muy lindo departamento, cómodo, bien ubicado y la atención de Askan fue excelente, volvería a ir!
muy bueno muy limpio todo.
They canceled three hours in advance.
主人很友善，及时回答问题，Wi-Fi 很好，有煮热水水壶，还提供茶包/咖啡伴侣。

Wij (gezin met 2 ouders, 3 tieners en 3 jong volwassenen) hebben een fijn verblijf gehad. Met een groter gezelschap zijn 2 badkamers erg fijn.
Locatie ligt perfect om Berlijn te verkennen, loopafstand tot de S-bahn waarmee je makkelijk alle bezienswaardigheden van Berlijn kunt bezoeken.

Fabulous stay - sleek kitchen equipped with everything you need, with lots of thoughtful touches. Very comfortable bed and lovely check-in. Glorious patio, and a lovely neighborhood close to public transit. Would stay here again and again when in Berlin!
Alan is very friendly and explained his appartement in every detail. I can recommend Alan and his flat!

Euch erwartet eine gut ausgestattet, schön eingerichtete Wohnung. Die große Wohnküche ist einfach fantastisch !
Die verkehrsgünstige Lage hilft bei Fahrten mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln ins Zentrum oder zB auch mit schneller Verbindung nach Wannsee / Potsdam.
Die Gastgeber wohnen im gleichen Gebäude und sind sehr hilfsbereit - das macht sich bei Kleinigkeiten bemerkbar, die das Leben erleichtern (weitere Tabs für die Geschirrspülmaschine oder Küchentücher etc.).
Abends ist die Drakestrasse wenig befahren und man kann im Vorgarten ungestört laue Sommerabende genießen, Stühle und ein Tisch sind vorhanden.
Enrique is the perfect host. Thank you so much for the reactivity ! We hope to stop by really soon :)
Apartment was excellent (clean, convenient, comfy). Ideal for 3-4 people. Great location for going in and out of Berlin. Shops very near by, only downside no welcome package

Christian is a friendly, knowledgable, and accommodating host and made us both feel very welcome. The apartment is in West Berlin, about a 30 min drive from the airport (or 50 min bus) and 20 min bus ride (line 109) from the city center. A bus stop is a two minute walk from the building (so excellent!). The 4th floor room was very big with a lovely view of the river, big windows, plenty of storage, and full of interesting books. The bed is definitely firm but good for the travel-weary in need of sleep. The bathroom was a quirky experience as it is full of storage if you glance upward above the shower (books, an entire Xerox machine, etc.). The bathroom could use some updating, but it's fine for an intrepid traveler on a budget. The apartment has two other rooms that he also rents out, but we barely saw or heard any other guests. You cannot lock your own room, but there is a lockable wardrobe. We did not use the kitchen, only because we ate our meals out every day. Overall we had a lovely experience. The internet did not work consistently during our stay, which was mildly frustrating. Perhaps we would stay somewhere more centrally located next time, but we would not rule out staying with Christian again!

Stayed for two nights and it was wonderful. Maria is very quick to reply and welcoming. The room was nice, clean and bright, with the bathroom just across the hall. I rented a bike nearby and the location is great. The apartment has a lovely and green backyard. Will definitely consider staying here for my next visit to Berlin.
Perfekte Lage der Unterkunft. Ruhig gelegen, da Hinterhofhaus, aber trotzdem zentral. Wir haben unser Wochenende in Berlin sehr genossen.
A pleasant stay.
A great place! Lovely and clean and close to the train station.
the house was really good in a very convenient location

Schon kurz nach der Ankunft wurde ich zu einem Kaffee und einem netten Gespräch eingeladen. Das Zimmer ist schön und funktionell eingerichtet, sodass auch längere Aufenthalte möglich sind. Ich war einen Monat da und konnte sehr gut von hier aus arbeiten.
Das Haus liegt in einer ruhigen Umgebung. Durch die U - Bahnstation in der Nähe jedoch sehr gut angebunden.
Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen!

We had a great stay! The flat is well-equipped and quiet.
There are lots of nice restaurants and bars around. Great stay!
Nazanin was a really nice host and we would love to come back.

Hallo,
die Kommunikation verlief immer sehr rasch und freundlich. Zudem wurde uns die Wohnung persönlich gezeigt, was uns sehr gefiel. Ubahn ist direkt um die Ecke, in 3 Stationen ist man bereits am Kudamm und der Alexanderplatz, Brandenburger Tor ist auch alles nahe bei.
Wir waren zu Dritt in Jörns Wohnung. Jeder hatte sein eigenes Zimmer. Zwei Schlafzimmer und ein Wohnzimmer mit Ausziehbahre Couch.
Ich hatte das Schlafzimmer nach hinten raus, hier war es wirklich erstaunlich ruhig, was ich nicht so toll fand war die sehr dünne Ikea Matratze. Auf Dauer nicht so bequem.

Lovely place, as pictured, in a very convenient location near the S-bahn. Alan was very helpful in providing information about the area and Berlin more generally. Highly recommended!

Peter ist ein super Gastgeber, freundlich, großzügig, unkompliziert, und immer gut erreichbar. Seine Wohnung ist ausgesprochen geschmackvoll und individuell eingerichtet und perfekt ausgestattet. Tolle Küche, super Bad, alles gepflegt. Sauberkeit war top, nur auf der Terrasse waren die Sitzmöbel voller Spinnweben. Tolle Wohnung, super Host!!
Schönes Yoga Studio. Alles war Sauber. Tolle Atmosphäre. Wir würden wieder kommen.

This place is situated in the perfect location for walking or taking public transportation to restaurants, stores, museums, cultural spots etc.

My girlfriend and I spent 5 nights in Apostolos’ gorgeous apartment in Berlin. We had a fantastic experience!

It was great for sleeping at night; the bed was very comfortable, and shutting the outside window shutters meant the room was immersed in total darkness! The apartment is situated in a lovely area of Berlin, that is about a 5 minute walk to Samariterstrasse train station, which is only a few stops from Alexanderplatz. There are plenty of lovely cafes, bars and shops in the Friedrichshain area. If we wanted to get to another part of Berlin, we either walked or used the efficient and easy to follow train network.
I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone wishing to stay in the beautiful city of Berlin and experience the gorgeous area of Friedrichshain! Thank you to Apostolos for being such a great host!

Very good place to stay. The location couldn't be better. The appartment was clean and very quiet for somewhere so central. We spent five nights with our two children and had a fantastic time. There are also many very good reasonably priced places to eat and drink just round the corner.

Overall I’m very pleased with this experience. I would definitely stay here again.
Pros
- location: walkable, in a safe area close to big Berlin attractions, lots to do nearby, countless restaurants and shops within walking distance
- spacious: large flat stocked with everything needed for my stay. Good wifi, fully stocked kitchen, big bathtub, I had more than I needed.
- communicative host: Stefan was proactive and helpful, always checking in to ensure I was comfortable and everything was going well, without being overbearing.
- private: I felt at home and didn’t feel like I was intruding on someone’s home, it felt like my home away from home.
- great value: I’m thrilled with the price I paid for this space.
Cons
- cleanliness: it’s an old building and some surfaces were a bit dusty. To me this wasn’t a big deal.
- somewhat noisy: being in a city apartment building naturally will produce some noise transfer from other units. Earplugs were helpful.

Die Entscheidung, in Grünau bei Maximilian zu wohnen war goldrichtig. Nach der trubeligen Stadt war die ruhige Lage im Wald und am See sehr wohltuend. Man kommt mit der Straßenbahn direkt dort hin. Die Wohnung liegt hinter dem Haus im Garten und hat alles was man braucht, sogar eine Möglichkeit, draußen zu frühstücken. Maximilian und seine ganze Familie waren sehr freundlich, zuvorkommend und überaus hilfsbereit. Es hat uns allen sehr gut gefallen.

We loved the hoop hung in the living room.
Really nice and friendly apartment
Great site!! with brunch places, restaurants and bars

I’d say it is a cyber flat as most of the furnitures are linked to a smart home system. Unfortunately I’m not very into the smart devices so I just can’t enjoy that part.
The flat is clean, the furnitures are great, it has a fan with some special function, I guess it is something about cooling, I didn’t try it, but just use it as a fan.
The place is close to several S/U Bahn and bus stations, and also a mid size mall in walkable distance. I’d say the location is perfect for visitors with no vehicles.
One thing to remind that the flat is literally “by” the street. If you open the front door, it is the street. If you want to open some windows for fresh air, they are all facing the same street.

Muy buena estancia y atención.
La zona tiene mucha vida y está bien comunicada.
Highly recommend!!!! Even better than those pictures!!! Awesome host & best location!!! This place made my trip
Perfect apartment with big rooms and a nice kitchen. Close to the tram and lovely neighborhood. I would recommend!
Sehr schön sauber und gepflegt, tolle Lage!
Das Zimmer war super, alles einfach und sauber, gerne wieder! :)
Ich habe mich rundum wohl gefühlt in der schönen und stilvoll eingerichteten Wohnung! Die Lage ist optimal für Messe-Besucher.

Nice appartement naar stations.
Very good bed. Couch way to hard
daniel ottimo host

Excelente localização no centro de Berlim. Pertinho da U Bahn Stadtmitte. Perto da Konzerthaus Berlin. Bons restaurantes e para o café da manhã também muito perto além de um mercadinho ao lado.
A acomodação inclue um banheiro com chuveiro exclusivo para o hóspede. A cama é grande conforme as fotos. Uma pequena geladeira dentro quarto muito silencioso. Toni sempre a disposição me deu muitos conselhos e indicações.
É uma excelente opção. Eu voltarei com certeza.

Our host made us feel very welcome, they left us a bottle of bubbles and two champagne glassed to welcome us.

The apartment was just as lovely as pics.

It was very central to tour Berlin from.

Lovely and clean.

Schnelle, freundliche und proaktive Kommunikation. Sehr sauberes und liebevoll eingerichtetes Appartment mit unkomplizierten Self-Check-In und Out. Alles Notwendige und so manches darüber hinaus vorhanden. Ruhige Gegend, schöne Landschaft, toller See. Zum Einkaufen bzw. abends ist Autoanreise / Uber zu empfehlen. Whirlpool war leider defekt, was uns aber nicht störte....

Einfache, aber sehr saubere Unterkunft. Für ein Hostel wirklich sehr gut. Alle sehr freundlich. Uns hat es an nichts gefehlt. Prima für ein Wochenende, für Personen mit wenig Anspruch ggf auch für länger. Danke!

Klaus Hilfsbereitschaft vor und während des Aufenthaltes sind großartig gewesen. Er ist auf alle Wünsche eingegangen. Die Kommunikation war sehr freundlich. Seine Rückmeldungen erfolgten sehr rasch und mit kaum Wartezeit. Besten Dank.😊

The host was super friendly and helpful and gave clear instructions about finding the place and house rules etc. The public transportation connections were good as well, both a bus stop and U-train stop around 300m away from the location. The apartment was clean and cozy, very nice place to stay for a couple of days. :)

Great location for short term stay . Easy to explore the nearby attractions by walking .
Amazing breakfast !
Garrelt hat superschnell geantwortet, mir eine sehr konkrete Wegbeschreibung gegeben und war total nett. Ich kann ihn als Gastgeber wärmstens empfehlen.
Appartement parfait, dans un quartier très agréable de Berlin ! Bien aménagé, pratique et donnant le sentiment de réellement vivre sur place.
O espaço era ótimo!

Super angenehme Wohnung: große, freundliche Zimmer, alles ebenerdig, ansprechend eingerichtet und mit allem Nützlichen ausgestattet - an alle Kleinigkeiten ist gedacht! Dazu ein bezaubernder eigener kleiner Garten mit sonnigem Sitzplatz und Blick auf die Hühner. Total ruhig war’s auch, da am Ende der Sackgasse, nur die Züge auf der anderen Seite konnte man ein bisschen hören. Und ganz liebe Vermieter! 😊
Der einzige Nachteil, dass der nächste Bäcker 1,6 km weg ist, war zu verkraften…

Really nice layout, nicely furnished, and well equipped. And very close to the subway, grocery store, and restaurants.
I’m very glad that I stayed here, and would do so again on future trips to Berlin.

Anita hat uns freundlich empfangen und alles erklärt. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und gemütlich. Alles nötige ist vorhanden. Keine 100m entfernt ist ein Lebensmittelgeschäft und eine Tankstelle. U-Bahn fährt auch keine 100m entfernt. Sehr ruhig gelegen. Parkplätze direkt vor der Tür. Mit dem Auto sind es 10 Minuten bis zum Alexanderplatz
Very good place to stay

Our stay at Mona's place was very pleasant. We enjoyed the cosy bed in the colourful bedroom with a nice view of blossoming trees and peaceful surroundings. Bathroom is right next to the guest bedroom which was nice. Public transport station is just few minutes away, it's very easy to reach the center of the city. Mona was very friendly, gave us clear instructions and some recommendations for exploring.

Отличная квартира! Потрясающее расположение! Самый центр и в то же время тихо, спокойно и красиво. Кругом   зелень, по лужайкам скачут кролики, на деревьях белки. Поют птицы. Квартира идеально чистая и просторная. Для 4х человек подходит замечательно. Есть все: посуда, бытовая техника, столовые приборы, постельное белье и полотенца. Бесплатная парковка во всем районе, что нас, путешественников на авто, очень порадовало. Серпил ждала нас в квартире до 22:30. Несмотря на наше опоздание, она встретила нас радушно и все показала и рассказала. В 5 минутах от дома супермаркет Rewe и 2 станции метро. До Тиргартена и Золотой Эльзы минут 7. До Бранденбургских ворот 30 минут пешком. До Александр Плац 10 минут на общественном транспорте. Рекомендуем эту квартиру всем! С удовольствием приедем туда снова!
Great host. Seamless check-in, very clean apartment. Overall an awesome experience.

Starting out with that the place itself was as described and as nice as it is in the pictures.. I am sure I just got the short end of the stick so note that in this review. When I arrived the entire place was not cleaned from the previous person that stayed there. Including the bed being a mess/dirty sheets, empty beer and liquor bottles, used towels on the floor of the bathroom. They had refunded me the first night, which is the minimal expected. That being because I had to make other sleeping arrangement the first night after this encounter. This whole situation ruined the following day of plans set and arranged in Berlin that were surrounding the recent proposal (now fiancé) and the  celebration of that with my family that lives in Berlin (this is something I can never get back). Like I said, probably got the short end of the stick, but have never encountered something like this with another Airbnb, which I use Airbnb a couple of times each year.
Perfect place! Very nice flat, great neighborhood and hospitable hosts. Thank you for your warm welcome and useful advices! We will be happy to return again :)
Alles gut, gerne wieder
son personas muy amables. me quedaría de nuevo. y se puede agarrar el transporte facil. y hasta muy noche

Fantastic place steps away from Boxhagener Platz. The place is exactly as it looks and described on the photos. The balcony is also nice addition. I loved the interior and the lighting at night is very pleasing. In my opinion the place better cleaning. There was  lots of dust flying in the house which I didn’t enjoy for the money we spent. Denise was very nice and helpful and we really enjoyed the amazing coffee experience every morning. If u love coffee this is your place.

Super friendly
Will definitely come back
Hat alles sehr gut geklappt.

Conny war eine wunderbare Gastgeberin – sehr freundlich und herzlich. Man merkt sofort, dass ihr das Wohl ihrer Gäste wirklich am Herzen liegt. Ich kann sie nur weiterempfehlen. Vielen Dank für die schöne Zeit!
Schön, Sauber & die Location ist super !!

Best host ever!
Cancelled her meeting to let me in.
Amazing Apartment BTW!
Apartamento limpo e bem organizado. Ótimo custo-benefício. O anfitrião responde rápido aos questionamentos. Fácil check-in/out.
Everything was absolutely great. Looking forward to staying again!
Sehr sehr schöne Unterkunft mit einer perfekten Lage. Gerne wieder !
Eugen was great and the accomodation was very central to great bars and restaurants.
Great location. Good communication. Clean. Non decadent but goos place to stay for large groups
This was a fantastic place to stay. The location was great and it had all the utilities it promised.

The apartment is big and tidy. We stayed there with the four of us, two babies and two adults.  When we arrived the place was nice and clean, plenty of bedsheets and towels. There is some basic supply in the kitchen, such as tea, coffee, salt, etc... Parking is not the super easy in the neighbourhood but manageable. But on the positive side, the streets near by offer many many nice supermarkets, restaurants, bars. I would suggest Ellen's apartment for a weekend of sightseeing in Berlin.
cute and comfortable

This spot it perfect! Amazing coffee shops and restaurants near by and if you're staying for a long visit theres a massive market around the corner from this location, lovely fresh fruit, meat & cheeses. Was blown away with this area. To public transport it's like a 3min walk, got around very easy sure weather was so good me and my friend walked a lot back and forth. Lovely place for a stroll. Vincent's directions from airport to his place were simple, clear and you couldn't go wrong. :) I'll defs be staying here again for sure. The AirBnB it's self was prettttyy cool! Art everywhere, interesting place for sure, really loved it.

The stay at ElPilar’s apartment was great, we were on the top (6th) floor. The couches are a little uncomfortable to sleep on, but still ok. Otherwise, everything was as expected. And the neighborhood is not at all poor or creepy.
Everything ok. Easy Checkin and the host is very fun with us! The apartment is clean and very close to subway station
Alles wurde von Mathias gut geplant. Der Man ist respektvoll und freundlich. Lokalisation ist super. Nachtes Mal wieder bei Mathias :)
Pretty nice spot that's central and close to two U bahn lines as well as walking distance from many key areas. Place is clean and easy to get to.

Thank you Michael!  What a lovely pad you have!  We had a great time.  It was warm and clean and spacious, even better than the photos suggest.  Fun neighbourhood with lots going on and easy to get to two different tube lines, even in the snow! And thank you so much for the chocolates and wine, that was very generous and extremely welcome!  We'll come again in the summer.
it was good
Perfectly located for where we were working and easy to get into Berlin centre. Adler was very accommodating.
Everything was great! Rainer was very responsive, and the house itself was exactly as described. The location is excellent, as it is very close to both the S-Bahn and U-Bahn
Die Wohnung war sauber und hatte alles was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt braucht. Katharina ist eine nette Gastgeberin und sehr zuvorkommend.
As described

The place was just as described. Perfect for two couples flying in from different locations. Parking very easy. Everything you might need to get full use of kitchen space. Quiet location and good local stores. Beds were super comfortable with lots of towels. Thanks for a great stay.
Tolle Wohnung an super Lage. Alles vorhanden und sauber. Perfekte Kommunikation und Abwicklung. Wenn in Berlin, jederzeit wieder!

Good location, the host set up the pull-out for us in advance, and it was very clean upon our arrival.
However, the host seemed to work with a network of people to rent out the place, so it was confusing and somewhat disconcerting to try and communicate as we would receive messages/be asked to contact several people who were not the host or listed in the flat description.
Other than that, the host was helpful, responsive, and gave us a lovely welcome gift as well.

Great place to stay in a great location! The apartment was very clean and tidy. Klaus was really responsive and we were able to check in early which was really helpful. I would recommend staying here.
Die Unterkunft war sauber, ordentlich und der Check In war super einfach durch die Lock Box
Overall a great place!
Great place!
Location is perfect - in a very calm neighborhood, with easy access to transportation and city centre. The apartment is very spacious and well-equipped. Martin is a very friendly and welcoming host

I had a great stay! The apartment is spacious and lovely and had everything I needed. I love the neighborhood. Also had very easy communication with Maximilian, which I appreciated. Wifi was fast for working from the apartment. Would stay again!

The apartment was great Dietrich was really helpful. Everything was lovely and clean and there was everything you need. There are loads of great bars and restaurants and public transport links really close As others have said, there is a bit of noise with people entering and leaving the building but that didn't disturb our sleep. Really easy to find and check in/out was super easy. Dietrich is very helpful. We had a great time.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön, hat eine gute Raumaufteilung und sie war wirklich sehr sauber - wir haben uns rundum wohl gefühlt & für die eine Nacht war es auch absolut okay.
Das Badezimmer war sauber, Handtücher etc. vorhanden & die Wohnung ist schön, clean und nicht zu voll eingerichtet. Optisch wirklich sehr schön & ansprechend.
Für mich jedoch ein Aber: die Wohnung ist wirklich sehr hellhörig. Wenn man im großen Schlafzimmer schläft, hört man trotz geschlossenen Fenstern jedes Gespräch, dass draußen stattfindet & man denkt, dass die Personen im Raum stehen. Zudem hat man ab 6 Uhr morgens Kinder von der Wohnung oben drüber gehört (nicht nur leise, sondern so laut, dass man dachte die Decke bricht gleich durch).
Wenn man also einen leichten Schlaf hat, sollte man eher woanders hingehen :)

Pros: nice quiet location with good connections. Comfortable beds and sheets. Street parking available which is free Saturday evening till Monday morning. Basement apartment meant it was cooler temperature during the hot days we had in Berlin.
Cons: the bathroom plumbing has problems causing the shower to back up from the sink and flood the bathroom. There were some exposed wires and some broken glass shards from the front door which would be especially dangerous for children. Basement and lack of windows means less air ventilation.
Nice place. Good communication.

Endroit propre, agréable et sympathique pour séjourner afin de visiter Berlin. L'hôtel est proche des transports, facile d'accès et les hôtes sont très agréables. Il est proche des attractions touristiques.
bon rapport qualité/ prix. Je recommande.
Merci à Ester pour son accueil et à Jakob dans les communications. Et merci pour l’arrivée flexible avec la possibilité de déposer notre valise. Cela nous a beaucoup aidé.
Es war alles so wie beschrieben. Kontakt war super. Frank hat sich um alles gekümmert
The stay here was great the host had great breakfast spot recommendation, also it was super easy to go in as i had to check fairly late at around 20:00 O’clock. 10/10 would stay there again.

Even if Sylvia was away, her lovely friend Elena took us to the beautiful apartment. The flat was perfectly located, concerning the night life, as everything was at a walking distance from the house. The S and U bahn stations were also really close, so our life was easier.
Everything in the flat was as described. Very cosy apartment and really quiet, although located in a vivid neighborhood.
We would recommend the place for anyone who would like to visit Berlin!
Loved it 100% will come back

Great value for money.
Apartment has everything you need.
Location is great, the metro is 3 min. away and the apartment is very quiet.

Depto está en un cuarto piso muy alto, pesado para acarrear maletas. No hay ayuda para eso. Es un lugar cómodo sobretodo cocina y habitación. Sin embargo no es un lugar donde te sientas bien recibido o que puedes contar con alguien en caso de necesitarlo. Demasiado auto servicio
This is an excellent place to stay, central and quiet, super clean and an option to store luggage after check out! Ramfis and his wife were super responsive when we had a plumbing problem!
Great location and nice deco.  I have challenges getting in one evening but Alessa responded immediately and sorted things out
Ruhig, trotzdem gut zu erreichen

Von dort aus ist alles gut erreichbar. Zimmer waren sauber und gemütlich. Der Check in war sehr flexibel und wir wurden herzlich empfangen. Das Frühstück was man dazukaufen kann ist super. Für das Geld lohnt es sich auf jeden Fall, da die Auswahl echt groß war am Buffet.
Gerne wieder :)

Comfy bed, great location, welcoming and responsive hosts! The loft bed was a little scary for me at first but then I got used to it! Would highly recommend for a quick stay in a beautiful neighborhood!!

Accurate listing, very near public transportation, supermarket, restaurants, bakeries! Very clean and hip place. I like the interior design and the tools and appliances. Felt really secure staying here!

Alles entsprach den Angaben, super Unterkunft. Alles unkompliziert, ordentlich, gemütlich.
Sauna als Highlight bei schlechtem Wetter, wie wir es hatten, auch super.
Würden wieder kommen.

Excelente ubicación, cerca a todo! Fácil acceso al transporte público y cerca de la parada del bus turístico. El departamento es luminoso, con buena distribución, funcional y súper limpio. Karak es un excelente anfitrión, prever lo que puedas necesitar, tendrás una muy buena estadía.
This a great studio suite with all new fixtures.  Oli's Dad helped check us in and out and provided us with lots of local information.
super friendly, overall great experience. highly recommended

Peter and Vera’s were amazing hosts, very nice and good to chat to. Their apartment was beautiful, and was in a great, very cool location with lots to do and a really good vibe. 10/10, if youre coming to Berlin this is the place to stay!

Wir können die Unterkunft nur empfehlen! Alessandro war super nett und flexibel und die Wohnung ist sehr sauber, gemütlich eingerichtet und es ist alles da, was man braucht. In fünf Minuten kann man die nächste U-Bahn- Station erreichen und ein Supermarkt ist auch direkt nebenan.
Wir würden jederzeit wieder kommen!
La habitación grande y acogedora. La cama era muy cómoda y el lugar muy silencioso. La acogida también fue buena. 100% recomendable

Wolfram war ein sehr guter Gastgeber und hat uns herzlich aufgenommen. Das Apartment war wie erwartet zufriedenstellend und bietet alles, was man braucht. Bei 3 Personen ist es auch durchaus groß genug, jedoch hat die Toilette keine richtige Tür und im Bad sammelte sich etwas Duschwasser neben der Kabine. Ansonsten waren wir recht glücklich damit, v.a. die Lage ist wunderbar zentral. Auch ist die Wohnung recht ruhig, trotz der Straße und man schläft gut in den Betten. Wolfram hat immer schnell und hilfreich geantwortet und ich bin froh, bei ihm gebucht zu haben. Wir hatten eine sehr gute Zeit in Berlin und können die Wohnung weiterempfehlen :)
Rooms are spacious and well equipped. The automated systems all work well until there is an issue.
gute Lage , alles notwendige in der Nähe. Bei geschlossenem Fenster ruhig.Zimmer enthält alles was man benötigen könnte
Bianka was the most perfect host, super good communication, she was very helpful and nice ! The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. Highly recommended ;)

a very nice place, always responsive and offering help.
liked it.

P e r f e c t
Everything you need and more.
Great and kind hosts. Excellent location (Very close to Alexander platz) .
Thank you Simone and Guy !
Defiantly would recommend it!
Great Experience, recommended

We stayed when it was 38 degrees and the apartment still remained cool and comfortable during the days and nights. The location is the best, lots of cafes & restaurants close by and very well connected to public transport links.
lovely apartment
A lovely space and a perfectly located for visiting Berlin.
Concept original et bonne expérience
Nice room, clean place

Boendet var bra och följde beskrivningarna och incheckningengick smidigt. Området var ganska lungt men inte så mycket att göra just där. Det var dock 10 minuters promenad från U-Bahn så att man enkelt kunde ta sig in närmare centrum.

Super convenient location! lots of food and cafes within walking distance. several transit options to get to major areas of the city and to/from the airport. noise level was minimal.
apartment was incredibly tidy and felt a lot bigger than the pictures suggested. not used to the bunk bed but it wasn't a major issue for me. having the laundry machine turned out to be quite useful too!
The lock on the door was a bit finicky and took a bit of time to figure out how to unlock.

This is actually no Appartment because we were not aware that there is absolutely no kitchen … there is stuff from the owner all over the place to there is no room for clothes or your own stuff
This is no Appartement and I will inform the Berlin authorities on that … the location is excellent

Very comfortable apartment, very warm during winter and near to the metro station. Monica is a very friendly person, she always helped us when we needed something. We definitely recommend this apartment
Best view you'll get for your Euro in Berlin.
Excellent location: many cute shops and restaurants near by. Short walk to public transit.
Eine schöne helle und freundliche Wohnung in einem ruhigen Umfeld am Prenzlauer Berg. Übergabe war völlig problemlos. Die Nähe zu Cafes, tollen Läden und U-bahn einfach wunderbar.
Clean, quiet flat in a fantastic location. Highly recommended!
Sehr angenehme Location im grünen Gürtel von Berlin. Gemütlich und wohnlich.
I had a great time in Berlin and Mina’s place was excellent for everything I wanted! Supper recommend!
Beautiful stay, gorgeous bathtub, and we had booked the sauna one morning and felt so relaxed. 10/10
Nice host, good communications.

Die Wohnung von Barbara ist mit sehr viel Liebe ausgestattet und bietet dem Gast ein besonderes Ambiente. Es ist ein einmaliges Erlebnis, in so einer charmanten Berliner Wohnung zu wohnen. Auch die Lage im schönen Charlottenburg mit idealer Verkehrsanbindung ans Zentrum hat uns super gefallen.
