Vielen Dank, Beate und Georg
Gal’s place was exactly as advertised. I love the district. Check in was through a lock box and the instructions were perfect, no problems at all. I would stay again.
Very clean and very comfortable. Recommend if you want to be in a relatively safe and quiet neighbourhood at the heart of Berlin.
Zimmer praktisch eingerichtet, helle Ikea Möbel. Praktische Aufteilung des Raumes. Bad recht neu und modern. Aber viel zu teuer!

A great location and apartment - one of the best value for its size. Also, the host was very communicative and gave clear instructons, followed up regularly and checked in with us mid stay. I would definitely stay here again.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft, sehr sauber und super nette Gastgeber!
Clean and cozy room. It’s even quite big. Jonas is nice and there is almost everything you need. Strongly recommend if you look for transportation-convenient house.
매우 훌륭한 시설! 친절한 호스트, 쾌적한 방. 엘레베이터가 편리합니다. 편리한 교통 접근성. 추천합니다.

The apartment is great, location is perfect (2 min to metro) and you have everything you need nearby. Unfortunately some kitchen utensils were a bit dusty and dirty, but otherwise it was perfect. I would totally recommend this place, especially for mid-term stays.

Maria's apartment is an excellent choice to explore Berlin. Four of us stayed there for a few nights and were happy with the stay. The apartment is very spacious and comfortable. The wifi is not good as the signal comes from another apartment, and we had a problem with Maria's friend who checked us in telling us to be quiet one night when we weren't at the apartment and hadn't been for hours.
Apart from this I would definitely recommend this place
Das waren zwei super Tage.Die Lage der Wohnung ist perfekt,mit cafes und Restaurants direkt vor der Tür. Ich komme gerne wieder.
great location, easy and smart check in. Sebastian communication was flawless! highly recommended!!!

Es war ein schöner und ruhiger Aufenthalt. Die Lage war super, gleich neben der sbahn. Der Check in und check out war auch sehr leicht und bequem. Richard hat uns bei fragen schnell geantwortet und weitergeholfen
Alojamiento muy amplio y cómodo para grupos,aunque en verano hace calor por las noches.
Fin leilighet. Rent og pent.

Beautiful apartment in prime location, walking distance to Spittelmarkt subway station, Lidl grocery supermarket and close to many attractions.
The place is very well maintained, clean and bright. Two bedrooms, with separate washroom facilities was a big plus - for 2 couples and one child.
Ronald was waiting for us to greet us and welcomed us with a nice bottle of sparkling. Super fast response to all our email.
We walked a couple of minutes to a taxi stand opposite a hotel to take a cab back to the airport.
Definitely recommend this place.

Very clean and modern cosy apartment, Markus was a very responsive and helpful host when we needed something. Some instructions on how to get in would’ve been helpful but other than that it was a great stay. Quiet area, good surrounding restaurants. Would recommend to others, thanks Markus!
Great communication in a great house in a calm and beautiful location.
L'appartement est conforme à l'annonce. Spacieux et agréable. Les transports en commun très proches et pratiques.

Preis-Leistungs-Technisch nicht zu schlagen. Das Bett knarrt zwar etwas und die Seife war nicht meins,  aber wer etwas günstiges im "hippen" Herzen der Hauptstadt sucht und eigentlich nur Party und schlafen will sollte zugreifen.

Tolle verkehrsgünstige Lage direkt am S-Bahnhof Botanischer Garten, eingerichtet und ausgestattet wie auf den Fotos und in der Beschreibung, einfacher Zugang per Schlüsselapp, sauber - also alles bestens. Das einzige Manko ist, dass es an warmen Tagen wirklich heiß wird in der Wohnung und man nicht gut durchlüften kann (ehemaliges Ladengeschäft im Erdgeschoss). Es war natürlich Pech, dass wir gerade an den heißesten Tagen des Jahres gebucht hatten, zu anderer Jahreszeit wäre das kein Problem. Die Wohnung würde von einer Klimaanlage sehr profitieren. Ventilatoren standen bereit, kamen gegen die Hitze aber leider nicht an.

Great cosy apartment. Clean, comfortable and close to everything you will need. Bernardo is a great host and arranged easy check in and check out times to fit with our schedule.

Perfect for a couple travelling together.
Oli was a great host. The apartment was easy to find and it looked fantastic from the inside.
Preis-Leistung top, belebte Umgebung - etwas laut aber lebendig. Wir haben uns sehr wohl und willkommen gefühlt. Danke ☺️
Un petit studio très pratique, avec de nombreuses activités à proximité. L'immeuble est calme et facile d'accès. Merci à Stephan qui est très amical

Beautiful house close to the commodities !
Good location to visit Berlin !

- La machine à laver avait une fuite et de l'eau s'écoulait à chaque fois dans la salle de bains.

Die Unterkunft war wie beschrieben und für unseren Zweck des Aufenthalts optimal.
Für uns war die Nähe zum Klinikum wichtig.
Lg an Martina und vielen Dank für deine Gastfreundschaft
Das Apartment war für 14 Tage super, alles da was man braucht, Ubahn um die Ecke, alles super!
je recommande le logement d'Anita pour la propreté, tout était nickel, le linge de lit propre et très bien rangé. les instructions à l'arrivée étaient claires. nous avons passé un bon séjour.

Exactly as described, a fabulously characterful 'art' apartment, in one of Berlin's most creative districts.  Great facilities, a fabulous host team, perfect for accessing central Berlin's many attractions. Throughly recommended.
Great place to stay, would stay again and would recommend to friends and family
Great. Stay. Would recommend.

I loved my stay at this loft in Berlin. Thomas and Alexandra gave me very warm welcome. Communication before was always immediate and kind. The place is huge and has an amazing unique atmosphere. It feels very much like Berlin. Luckily Thomas and Alexandra saved the beautiful old wooden floor. The loft is completely silent, a miracle as it is situated right in the center of Berlin. You can easily walk from there, or take the trams and s-bahn and buses down the street. I recommend taking a hot bath in the large sleeping room.
Thank you Thomas and Alexandra for this beautiful place in Berlin!
Very nice place in a nice location.
Nice place to stay.

Staff members at the reception were super nice and friendly. They were always ready to help you out.
Clean apartment and the size of the apartment was also appropriate.
Nice 😊 place to stay !

Comfortable, stylish and warm. The place was clean the same that the pictures.  Definitely recommended for couples. Great location convinient for the center. The host was very helpful and very kind.  Highly recommended.
La posizione è ottimale, la U5 è a 2 minuti da casa. La casa è comodissima e facendo la spesa abbiamo anche potuto cucinare. La zona è tranquilla, senza confusione ma a pochi minuti dalla "movida".
주방이 잘 갖춰져 있어서 좋았어요. 방은 두명이서 사용하기에는 조금 좁은 감이 있었지만, 공용공간이 잘 되어 있어서 편하게 묵다 가요.
Klein maar fijn app op de begane grond op loopafstand van Potsdamer Platz. Genoten van Berlijn.

I booked Sonja's flat for my family. They had a good stay there; the flat is based in a good location with very nice surroundings. Everything was as promised in the listing. Key exchange was very smooth and quick. I won't hesitate to recommend Sonja's flat to anyone who wants to stay in Berlin.

Ho alloggiato nell'appartamento di Sophia per qualche giorno con la mia migliore amica. Sophia è stata molto disponibile ad accoglierci, nonostante i nostri voli arrivassero la sera tardi. La camera è spaziosa, confortevole e perfettamente pulita.
Abbiamo potuto chiacchierare con Sophia che ci ha dato anche diversi consigli su cosa fare durante la giornata del 1 Maggio e abbiamo conosciuto la sua splendida cagnolina Vilda!
Consigliamo assolutamente il suo alloggio! :)

excelente aparmatento y muy bien ubicado con 2 cosas tal vez a mejorar. Una la conexión de internet que practicamente no pudimos usar y en menor grado las almohadas que podrian ser un poquito mejores. son detalles que para nosotros eran importantes pero que igualmente no perjudicaron totalmente nuestra estadia. muchas gracias Anna

Really beautiful apartment, very close to the U-Bahn and S-Bahn stations in a nice area with cafes, bars and a Lidl within 8 minute walk. David Bowie’s apartment is just around the corner. Really nice finish to the apartment and super quiet. Loved the toiletries. Thanks both for a lovely stay in Berlin, can’t wait to get back.

An excellent stay.
The apartment is very well appointed and had everything I could possibly need making it perfect for short or long stays.
The area is close to many amenities such as supermarkets and restaurants, as well as gyms and the shopping district.
Oli is friendly, timely and knowledgeable.

I had a very pleasant time at Giulia's and Martino's place!
The apartment is great and stylishly decorated; you have a wonderful view on Prenzlauer Berg; there are loads of cafés, bars, and restaurants nearby - and it is easy to explore all of Berlin from that place.
Both Giulia and Martino are lovely hosts, open-minded and caring. They help out, whenever you need something.
Definitely recommended !!!
Everything was good. Thank you for your help
Martin's place was exactly as advertised, spacious, clean, and perfectly located steps from the Graefekiez. Martin was very friendly and responsive, a fantastic host. Would definitely recommend!
I really liked the place, it is cozy and you have all you need.

Great place to relax with family. Large apartment, kitchen has everything you need, good beds. There are shops nearby and easy access to transport.
Hosts are great with a quick response ♥️
Overall it was clean, but there are sticky spots on the floor and a little dust in some places. Also missing hangers in the shower and floor for shower gel and shampoo (have to put them on the floor and bend over), some sockets don't work. There is one more nuance with the neighbors upstairs, they started walking very loudly from 10:00 PM to 4:00 AM, so the light went out and creaked and this continued for all 4 nights. Also most likely they smoked and the smell of cigarettes penetrated the bathroom very strongly (but I'm not sure if this can be considered a minus of the apartment, maybe they also rented an apartment upstairs and got bad tenants).
Overall a great place to stay in Berlin for a few days.

To stay at Gundula’s is like to be at home but in Berlin.
The flat was clean, warm, beautiful and perfect for my 9yo daughter, my wife and me.
We could find anything we needed.
The bed and the sofa bed were very comfortable, the WiFi was fast and reliable.
The kitchen was full of stuff.
The location is very quiet with the U5 Frankfurter Tor stop and the 240 bus stop at few minutes walking distance:
we could easily go to the city center.
We did not have enough time to explore the surroundings but Gundula was always kind and prompt to suggest activities: she also informed us about a possibly dangerous political demonstration in the area. We really appreciated that!
To summarize, I strongly recommend you to book at Gundula’s which will be our choice for the next stay in Berlin (maybe in the spring/summer time to enjoy other aspects of this very nice city).
Thank you very much Gundula!
All the best for Christmas and the new year. 😘😘😘
Great location and all right value for the price.

Schöner Aufenthalt in Berlin - Moabit ist wunderbar, multikulturell, lebendig. Die Nähe zu den Arminius Hallen ein großer Vorteil dieser Wohnung. Alles ist sehr gut erreichbar: U- Bahn, Straßenbahn, Hauptbahnhof, Cafés, Restaurants, Bars - Alles in der Nähe.
Wohnung, etwas teuer, aber sehr zu empfehlen.
Einfach Traumhaft... Wir werden wieder kommen!
Beautiful, clean safe apartment close to supermarket and transport links.  Ruth is a fantastic host and exceeded our expectations.
Everything was perfect!

Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft. Die Lage ist zentral, check-in klappte problemlos und wir bekamen gute Tipps zu Parkmöglichkeiten und Anbindung an den Nahverkehr.
Ulf ist ein sehr netter Gastgeber, der stets erreichbar ist.
Zusammenfassend empfehlenswerte Unterkunft mit gutem Preis-Leistungsverhältnis.

Wir waren zu fünft in der Unterkunft und super zufrieden. Die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern hat sehr gut funktioniert. Die Unterkunft war gut zu finden. Wir wurden vor Ort von einer freundlichen Mitarbeitern der Berlin Lofts UG empfangen, die uns die Wohnung zeigte. In der Wohnung liegt ein Lageplan, auf dem die umgebenden Supermärkte, Restaurants, U-Bahn-Stationen etc. eingezeichnet sind. Die Wohnung liegt in einer ruhigen Gegend. Trotzdem ist Berlin Mitte mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln schnell zu erreichen. Wir sind auch einige Male zu Fuß in die Innenstadt gelaufen. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und sehr gut ausgestattet. Die Einrichtung ist auch sehr schön und stimmig mit Liebe zum Detail - vor allem die tollen Wandmalereien - genau wie auf den Fotos. Die Lage im obersten Stockwerk mit Blick in den Himmel vom Schlafzimmer in der oberen Etage der Wohnung ist schon etwas Besonderes. Auf jeden Fall zu empfehlen!

Süße kleine Wohnung in toller Lage mit allem, was man für einen komfortablen Aufenthalt braucht. Dazu noch eine sehr nette Gastgeberin, mit der die Abstimmung und die Schlüsselübergabe prima geklappt hat. Jederzeit gern wieder!
Alles super, eher modern, für jüngere Gäste, das Bad ist zeitgemäß aber keinesfalls Luxus
Easy check-in and super responsive. Great location for families given space and parks/playgrounds in the area. Clean apartment and everything important in walking distance. Definitely recommend it!

Nice place. Good communication from the hosts. Good location in a nice neighbourhood which is fun to explore + not too far from central Berlin for the more touristy stuff. We used the bicycles to travel everywhere, they were a really good addition.
Excelente localização. Perto de transportes para vários locais. Check in prático e fácil. Espaço cómodo e útil para alguns dias de viagem.

I really enjoyed my stay with Erich. From the minute I booked he was very helpful, great at communicating and sent me loads of good recommendations. Sadly due to a cancelled flight I was a day late in arriving. Erich was flexible and accommodating to this change.
The place is cool. Loads of random bits of furniture which I loved, albeit not for everyone.
It was peaceful despite being right in the centre of Berlin. Loads to see, do, eat and drink on the door step. You cannot get a better location than this.
Overall. I really liked my stay here. I found the shower difficult, given I am so tall. But I was reassured that it was being changed before my stay next year.
I’d happily stay here again. And looking forward to booking with Erich in the future!

Andrea ist eine sehr freundliche, angenehme Gastgeberin. Die von ihr angebotene Unterkunft ist unheimlich gemütlich, hat eine exzellente Lage für Messebesucher (5 Min. zu Fuss bis Messe Süd!) und es ist sehr ruhig. Ich habe keinen "Mucks" gehört :)
Ganz sicher werde ich Andrea wieder um eine Unterkunft bitten, wenn ich wieder einmal Messegast bin...
Vielen Dank für alles, liebe Andrea!
Quick, efficient, friendly, clean.

A beautiful apartment with vintage decor style and modern equipment. Eleni is so kind and helpful. The neighborhood is great, got lots of things to do (cafes, restaurants, malls, shops, etc) & its quiet at night. Would recommend!
Zum Zeitpunkt der BCB die beste Wahl und es gab noch ein kleines Amenity Kit
Beautiful flat with tall ceilings & wonderful location! Was a dream to call this place home for three months!

Overall I had a good stay. This place is in a great location and ideal as a base. My greatest pains were the noise - both from the street which I expected, but more so from the other half of this apartment (it is part of a bigger place, but separated) it can feel like people are in your place and a couple of the nights there was loud music and many guests in the other side of the place. The wifi is also shared with the other apartment, and did not function at times forcing me to tether or go into the office. Aside from these things, the place is really lovely and has everything needed for a short (or longer) stay. Ivo was available by message and responded quickly throughout. Despite the pains I listed, I would be happy to stay here again - it was overall pretty comfortable.

Apparemment spacieux et agréable, très propre et bien agencé, parfait pour un we à Berlin. L’hôte est réactif et les indications données sont clairs (accès au logement, arrivée, départ). Merci à Derek pour cet agréable séjour.

Great base to explore the city. U-bahn literally around the corner so very easy to get around. Very cute cafe for breakfast and lunch opposite the apartment and a cheese restaurant a couple of doors down (didn't have time so will go there next time). The apartment is super spacious, everything was very clean and there was even some coffee for the first morning!
The keysafe check-in was great as we arrived late. The host responded to a message about this straight away.
Extremely good value for money! We'll certainly be back.

Das Nena Appartment überzeugt definitiv mit dem Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Das Zimmer ist modern eingerichtet, das Bett ist bequem und die kleine Küchenzeile bietet alles, was man benötigt. Wenn wir eine Unterkunft in Kreuzberg suchen, würden wir sicher wiederkommen!
Gezellige wijk en leuk appartement. Berlijn is een heerlijke stad en dit appartement een fijne uitvalsbasis. I.v.m. een feestdag was het wel erg rumoerig tot in de nacht (oordoppen gewenst)

War alles wirklich super, sehr groß, sauber und Lage war auch top. Schnell am Alexander Platz und super zu erreichen.
Sehr gerne wieder! 🥰

Sehr nette Gastgeber
Super Apartment
Top Lage
Gerne wieder

This place is incredible. The artwork and decor were so amazing and almost as comfortable as the beds. Martina and Charlotte have provided everything you could possibly desire to make your stay perfect. Note that Google maps takes you around about from the station and there’s a shortcut for walking to the apartment.

Beautiful apartment, location and comfortable bed! Nice and quiet too. However the host isn’t very friendly or welcoming and has a long list of super specific rules to follow, which didn’t make me feel very comfortable.

Wir waren nur wegen paar Terminen in Berlin und haben deshalb viel Zeit in der Unterkunft verbracht. Die Wohnung ist sehr geräumig und sauber, alles war angenehm und entspannt. Alle Oberflächen wurden desinfiziert, der Spa-Bereich war nur für uns zugänglich. Durch die anderen Bewertungen wussten wir bereits, dass man zwischendurch durch den Wohnbereich der Gastgeber*innen laufen muss und waren am Anfang auch verunsichert, ob wir stören würden... Aber Mathis hat uns sofort zu verstehen gegeben, dass Gäste willkommen sind und nicht stören. Den Pool haben wir erst spät abends benutzt, und das war auch kein Problem :)

El estudio de Jot es perfecto para una pareja. Estuvimos 5 días pero nos podríamos haber quedado a vivir! La distribución perfecta y los servicios necesarios.
Una cosa que sí podría mejorar es el espacio de almacenaje. Faltaba un armario o estantería vacía donde dejar las cosas.
Por el resto, genial. Jot es encantadora :)

Schönes Zimmer, einfach mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen.
Super Kommunikation.
Späteres Check-In war überhaupt kein Problem.

El lugar esta muy bien ubicado y limpio. No me gusto que me pidiera que no saliera en la noche y también me acusaba de haber fumado dentro del departamento y no fue así. Aún así el lugar está muy bien

an oasis of green and peacefulness just outside Berlin ! all just as described and in the photos as well
Rainer and Bianca were super helpful and friendly hosts as well .
a great base to explore Berlin from
many thanks
keith and lamphoon
Nice good looking apartment with spacious bedrooms. Quick walk to the city and Ute always reacted quick to our questions. All in all a great stay!
Really nice place. Andreas was super helpful. Highly recommended.
Perfect place in the very center of Berlin. If you want a cosy and calm place don’t hesitate !

Die Wohnung von Jörg ist sensationell, etwas ganz Besonderes. Man wohnt in dem Kuppelhaus eines historischen Palais. Es ist alles so authentisch, wie eben ein Künstler lebt. Die Wohnung ist top sauber, gut ausgestattet und liegt in der wohl sichersten Gegend von Berlin.
Die Kommunikation war sehr gut, Franziska hat uns gute Tipps gegeben. Danke

Die Wohnung sieht genauso aus wie auf den Bildern. Das meiste ist in die Jahre gekommen, aber WLAN, Warmwasser, Herd, Waschmaschine, Kühlschrank und in unserem Fall auch Heizung haben einwandfrei funktioniert.
Die Nähe zur U- und S- Bahn ist gut, daher ist alles gut zu erreichen. Die Stadtautobahn war mir zu laut, aber meine Freundinnen hat sie gar nicht gestört. Die Kommunikation hat sehr gut geklappt. Wir empfehlen sie auf jeden Fall gerne weiter!
Appartement spacieux et joli dans un quartier calme. Bien desservi par les transports en commun. Un peu loin du centre à pied. L'appartement était totalement adapté à notre séjour. C'était parfait !!

Werner is a great host. Very friendly, reliable and caring. Also have a look at his awesome recommendations about Berlin on his very cute Blog. The apartment is perfect for a stay, very clean and equipped with everything you need. If you need to stay in this area of Berlin, it's q perfect match.
The apartment is lovely and clean and even better than in the pictures. It was very easy to communicate with Josef and his cleaning lady Veronika. I highly recommend this apartment.

appartement très lumineux, bien situé par rapport aux transports en commun, belles baies vitrée avec vue sur Berlin. Extrêmement calme. commerces à proximité. tout le confort et les ustensiles nécessaires dans l'appartement et la cuisine. nous recommandons. séjour très apprécié.
Great apartment! Spacious and clean. Everything we needed for a great weekend in Berlin!
Everything about V & her house is simply amazing to say the least... definitely again next time in Berlin... Much Love XxXxXx

We had a nice stay at Nena apartments. It’s spacious and tidy and you’ll find everything you need. We were there only 3 days and didn’t make use of the kitchen unfortunately. Would recommend if you’re looking for a tidy place and don’t mind the anonymity and a bit of sterility ;)
Excellent location as just around the corner from tresor and Kit Kat club. Perfect for short stays.
very good stay! location was great with lots to see, eat and drink!

The apartment was in a good location where we were able to walk around to places or take the metro elsewhere. We had some difficulty and inflexibility with check in where our ETA was off by an hour due to unforeseen circumstances which made it confusing with check in where we had to coordinate with a friend of the owner. Otherwise we enjoyed our stay.
nous avons passé un super séjour à Berlin. Le logement était super et notre hôte l'était tout autant. Très réactif et arrangeante ! je recommande ! merci pour tout !

Katja is extremely friendly and an incredible host, her place is spotless, minimal and close to everything while being removed from major street traffic. The neighbourhood is very friendly and clean.
Her home is filled with small thoughtful touches that give the home so much character. I wish I booked it for longer and I will definitely return.

This is our 3rd time using airbnb during our holiday in Europe this year. Since the beginning of interaction, Arzu has been very responsive. She responded to my request promptly and accommodated our needs fully. She & Tom, her husband have been so helpful with all of our question. We were so happy and satisfied staying at her & Tom's place, despite of the location is on 4th floor, the apartment was clean, functional and as shown in the photos at airbnb website. I would recommend this place, as it is easy to find and near to public transportation. Oh ya, Arzu has given us the 3 pages how to get to her apartment and other info regarding Berlin. Those info were so helpful. I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again next time.

we loved our stay! the recommendations were great. it’s a little out of the center of things, which makes it very peaceful, but still accessible. very good value and beautiful place. will definitely come back if i ever return to berlin.
Mieszkanie u  Joshua było dla nas świetnym przeżyciem. Mieszkanie było czyste, bardzo ładnie urządzone i w świetnym miejscu. Z samym gospodarzem zero problemu z komunikacją.
Nice and calm stay :)
Un séjour parfait et un bon emplacement
Excellent place. Thé appartement is very confortable and in a beautiful neighborhood. It is a perfect place to stay in berlin

We had a great stay at Elisa's apartment (two adults and two children). We found everything as described in the listing and very well functioning. The Bergmannstraße area is great with many charming shops and restaurants.

It is a really nice and small apartment with garden next to river where you can actually swim. We travelled with a small baby, so it was perfect for her to sleep in the stroller in the garden - no city feeling at all! It is very close to lots of nice caffees and restaurants, tram station and grocery store. I forgot that I was in Berlin :)

Séjour très agréable dans un logement propre et fidèle aux photos.
Je recommande

Wilken is a very responsive, fair, and proactive host. An issue upon arrival (out of his control) required swift action to resolve, and Wilken was in touch very quickly and engaged actively to help come up with a solution. The solution also worked out great and meant that the rest of the trip proceeded without a hitch!
Sehr netter Kontakt, unkompliziert, Carol hat sich gut gekümmert. Die Wohnung ist sauber und gut gelegen. Kann ich empfehlen.
Für einen Berlin Urlaub sehr schöne Unterkunft. Schöne Gegend
Danke für die schöne Unterkunft!

En super fin lille lejlighed, som var rigtig hyggeligt at være i, med god plads og en hyggeligt altan. Det er et dejligt, roligt og smukt område og vi nød meget vores ophold og kunne helt sikkert finde på at komme tilbage:)
La casa è piccola ma molto funzionale, non ci é mancato nulla. La collocazione é ottima: molto vicina a bus e metro. Uta é stata molto gentile e disponibile.
Schönes kleines Appartement, sehr gute zentrale Lage, schnelle Kommunikation
Praktisch (einfaches Check-in, nützliche Ausstattung, gute Bäckerei ums Eck), schön (Holzboden, grosse Dusche) und bequem (Bett, gut mit ÖV erreichbar)

Eine urige, gemütliche Altbauwohnung mit optimaler Lage, um Berlin zu erkunden (Haltestelle der touristischen Buslinie 100 ist ganz in der Nähe). Wir haben uns  dort sehr wohl gefühlt, auch wenn einige Möbelstücke schon ein paar Jahre auf dem Buckel haben, sind Küche und Bad gut ausgestattet mit den wichtigsten Utensilien, die man so braucht z.B. Essig, Öl, Gewürze, Kaffee, Zucker, Shampoo, Duschgel usw., so dass man eigentlich nur mit seinem Koffer anreisen kann.  Fehlt etwas ist,  EDEKA und ROSSMANN nur 5 min Fußweg weit weg.  👍🏼😊
Waren sehr zufrieden mit dem Hotel. Es war sauber und die Dusche und Toilette im recht modernen Zustand. Frühstück ist vollkommen ok für den Preis. würde ich nochmal reservieren.
Had an amazing stay! Isabella is the nicest person in the world and was very attentive throughout the whole stay. Had an amazing time getting to know Berlin and the people living there :D
Nice, modern, and the location was convenient for public transportation.

Очень хорошо квартира. Хороший ремонт и интересный интерьер. Все нужное для проживания ( посуда, постельное белье, и.т.д). Один минус не смогли подключится к 🛜 это нужно учитывать если нужно работать по сети!

Logement parfaitement conforme à la description. Grand et fonctionnel. Très bonne literie. Bien situé (nous avons découvert toute la ville à pied, sachant que nous sommes de bon marcheurs). Comme indiqué dans l'annonce, un chantier de construction est en cours devant l'immeuble. Les ouvriers commencent tôt l'été (avant 7h), donc pas de grasse matinée. Un grand supermarché se trouve à proximité, parfait pour les courses (ouvert tous les jours de 8h à 22h, sauf le dimanche). Merci à Daphne pour tous les conseils de visite, que nous avons suivi au mieux!

Thanks to Gundula for her unique hospitality andher touch of attention ! Her appartement is really nice and well decorated. Metro and Tramway are very close to the flat which is very convinient to visit.
We had a very nice trip in Berlin !
This place is huge and comfy and close to most anything you could want or need and Stefanie was an amazing host.

I had a wonderful experience here. Claudia is a great host who is very helpful as well. The place is right next to a bus stop that will take you downtown. My room was very spacious as well. 10/10 would recommend.

Small but comfortable room. We had access to everything we needed.
The neighborhood is very calm and charming.
It is easy to reach with the tram, however it is quite far from the city center.
Judith and her husband were very nice and helpful.

Beautiful views over the canal
Arty multicultural neighbourhood with great cafes delis and bars
The apartment is fun very spacious and great for entertaining….excellent kitchen
Two well appointed bathrooms.
Great value for money

Richards Wohnung hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Er selbst war über das Wochenende nicht da, deshalb hatten wir die Wohnung für uns alleine. Wen wir etwas brauchten war er aber sofort ereichbar und Check-In/Check-Out war auch überhaupt kein Problem und war alles gut erklärt. Die Wohnung ist nur wenige Minuten von der U-Bahn entfernt, dass man sehr schnell in Berlin-Mitte ist. Nur zum empfehlen :)

Just like the pictures, an excellent place!!!
Definitely staying here again if coming back to Berlin.
Very nice room ,the host is very kind.

Filippo is een geweldige host, zeer vriendelijk, attend (aanbevelen van restaurants) en is erg flexibel (konden later uitchecken). Verder is het appartement erg stijlvol ingericht, mooie ruime kamer en te delen woonkamer, keuken en badkamer zijn ook van alle gemakken voorzien. Locatie is top, midden in het hippe Friedrichshain, omringd door lekkere restaurants en cafes en 1 minuut lopen vanaf de metro. Al met al een dikke aanrader!

La nostra permanenza da Paulo e Guido è stata fantastica! Alloggio pulitissimo e la zona è stata facile da raggiungere con i mezzi. Ci siamo sentiti a casa da subito, gli host sono stati gentilissimi e disponibili. :)
The flat was in an excellent location for bars and for public transport. Alan gave really thorough advice/recommendations about the area and left lots of helpful brochures etc with us on our arrival.

Ich habe mich in der großen Wohnung von Caroline sehr wohlgefühlt. Die Atmosphäre war locker, aufgeschlossen und unkompliziert.
Das Zimmer war angenehm groß, hell und die Schlafqualität super.
Super Aufenthalt. Alles wie beschrieben, ruhig, sauber und unkompliziert. Gute Lage zur U-Bahn. Selbst meine verspätete Ankunft beim Checkin war kein Problem. Gerne wieder.

Ein super tolle Hostel ganz zentral und sehr billig... Die Gebaüde ist sehr schön und konserviert und die Leute sind auch sehr nett.
Frühstück war auch ganz gut.

Wunderschöne, ruhige Lage. Ich war mit meinem Sohn (9) und unserem Welpen dort. Der umzäunte Garten ist toll, es gibt viele Spielmöglichkeiten für Kinder. Wir durften Fahrräder, Boote und das SUP kostenlos nutzen. Die Gastgeber waren sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend und hatten viele tolle Tips. Es gibt viele schöne Ausflugsziele in der Nähe. Wir haben die Ruhe im Garten und das Paddeln auf dem Wasser genossen. Einfach traumhaft.  Wir kommen gerne wieder!
everything is good.

The location was great, as well as Heidi who was always very nice to us. One thing that wasn't so great was the cleannes of the apartment. It wasn't just that it was messy, we had to clean everything before using it because it wasn't clean at all. Also, after leaving the apartment, all of our clothes smelled like the place, which wasn't really nice. Nevertheless, the place was okey for the price and Heidi was a wonderful host
Preis okay, ziemlich laut und wenns warm ist ohne Klimaanlage auch ziemlich heiß aber sonst gut 👍🏼
Lejligheden var som forventet - dog var lejligheden lidt slidt. Pænt område og tæt på centrum ved Alexanderplatz

Good location!
Do not go there is you want to make noise after 10pm, quiet place

We (group of 5) enjoyed our stay very much. Place is exactly as described, the well-equipped kitchen/living room area and the two bathrooms were the two highlights for us. Frank is a great host: he provided very clear instructions, good recommendations and was flexible with our request for a later check-out. Would definitely recommend this place to friends and I would definitely consider staying here again for my next visit in Berlin.

Ich habe zwei Nächte in der schönen, ruhig gelegenen und gut ausgestatteten Wohnung verbracht. Auch ich wurde sehr freundlich von Olga begrüßt, besonders toll war, dass sie sich bezüglich meiner An- und Abreise sehr flexibel zeigte.

Wunderbarer Aufenthalt direkt an der Spree. Christian ist ein stets aufmerksamer Gastgeber, liebenswert und  immer erreichbar. Sehr schöne Umgebung mit zwei Parks, Cafés und Restaurants fussläufig erreichbar. U 7 , Bus 109, M 45 sind ebenfalls wenige Minuten entfernt. Ich komme gerne wieder.

Limpieza y localización buena y bien comunicado.
Las almohadas son incómodas, la cama está bien y la calefacción es buena.

Check in is at 3 pm but I asked if it was possible to leave the bags around 1 pm and they told me that the Manager was from 10 am to 6 pm.

Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt in der Wohnung! Genau wie auf den Bilder, wunderschön eingerichtet. Thomas ist auch ein sehr netter Gastgeber und war bei Fragen schnell zu erreichen. Wir kommen gerne wieder und können die Unterkunft wärmstens empfehlen! :)

Lovely, cosy place in a great neighbourhood of Berlin. Lively area, lots of cafes and choices. I hope we can come back! :)

Das Apartment war super schön und mit viel Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet. Wir würden es auf jeden Fall nochmal buchen!

The room was really nice with lots of storage and comfy couch. i liked the quick communication and the access to the keys. Great location so nothing else to say!

PROS:
-Well lit apartment with plenty of space & two queen beds
-Great decorations, cool place and concept. There were many little design ideas i’d love in my own home
-Clean place
-Pretty views
-Nice little courtyard with bike parking
-Good location depending on what you’re into (posh, gentrified, next to many tourist spots)
CONS:
-Wifi was not great
-Bathrooms are not very functional—both are quite dark, the one in the main bedroom has poor water pressure and the one in the main living area has poor drainage
-Other than toilet paper, not much for amenities (barely found a replacement trash bag)
-Despite paying a higher nightly rate than other airbnbs in Berlin, felt nickel and dimed—advertised as having a washer and dryer but it is locked and you must pay €7.50 per wash, days before checking in was asked to pay a 5%/day tax that was not advertised in the listing (other Airbnbs I stayed at in Berlin didn’t pass on this cost)
Overall impression:
It’s a cute spot and I appreciate that it’s well decorated and spacious, but wasn’t worth the $$$ in my opinion. Overall just felt the place was a little run down and not well maintained for what it was attempting to market itself as (Example: couch had stains and was covered up with two curtains). If a place is going to charge like a boutique hotel, the place should feel and be maintained like a boutique hotel.

Excellent location if you are looking to explore all the Berlin has to offer. Alexanderplatz is a short walk away whilst it's also easy to get around on the subway.

Ein toller Aufenthalt bei Karina ist zu Ende, ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und würde die Unterkunft wieder buchen. Danke!
Ganz lieben Dank für den tollen Aufenthalt und die flüssige Kommunikation. Wir haben unsere Zeit vor Ort sehe genossen! :)
Moritz og hans kone var nemme at få kontakt med

I am writing this feedback to share my dreadful experience during my attempted stay at Grand Hostel Berlin. My experience was nothing short of a nightmare. I found myself waiting all night at the reception, trying to resolve a situation that had arisen, without any assistance from staff.
The root of this issue began when I requested to change my reservation to one day later due to travel complications, a request that was promptly refused. When I finally arrived at Grand Hostel Berlin on the following day around 8 PM, hoping to check in, I was informed that my reservation was no longer valid because I had not arrived on the initially booked date, and thus, the remaining two days of my reservation were also invalidated. I was advised to wait for the manager, but after more than 4 hours of waiting, the manager stated they could not assist me as it is their policy to cancel the booking if the guest does not arrive on the first day of reservation.

That was really the best airbnb i ever been to.
Cousy apartment
They thought about the tiny things that wil make your staying perfect.

This appartment is an excellent place for a city trip to Berlin. The appartment is located within close distance to all highlights and great places Berlin has to offer.
The appartment is just what airbnb is all about. A space with the personal touch that no hotel can offer. Thérèse was a wonderful host. She even offered us help and tips during the weekend. We won't look further when visiting Berlin again
It’s certainly not a large apartment, but it was private and clean and perfect for a week-long stay
Excellent place
Andreas' apartment is super cosy, the Sauna is obviously a great extra! The surrounding area is very nice also with many cafés and restaurants 👍

Very nice place. Conveniently located next to bus stops and underground stations. This is a great spot for exploring Berlin. Despite the neighborhood itself not having many destinations, you’re conveniently positioned to get anywhere in the city with ease.

appartement bien situé, calme, propre, proche du métro et du centre de Berlin. Accueil sympa.  Nous avons pu laisser nos valises le dernier jour pour nous promener tout l'après midi. Nous avons pris notre petit déjeuner mais n'avons jamais cuisiné...mais la vaisselle est calculé au plus juste. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour sauf pour le départ à l'aéroport . La ligne S9 en panne sans aucun personnel ni de point d'information pour nous renseigner à la gare.
Alles war perfekt
Die Rolladen der Zimmer sind teilweise defekt. Die Küche ist für die Anzahl der angegebenen Gäste zu klein. Der Kontakt vor Ort war sehr nett und bemüht.

Ugur ist ein absolut empfehlenswerter Host! Mega freundlich und super hilfsbereit! Wir haben uns so gut verstanden und verquatscht, dass ich gleich zu spät zu meinem Abendessen kam 😂 das nächste Mal plane ich etwas Zeit zum reden und Kaffee ein!

Wir haben uns bei Fai wirklich sehr wohl gefühlt. Sie war super freundlich, aufmerksam und hat sich immer wieder erkundigt, ob wir etwas brauchen – das haben wir sehr geschätzt. Die Wohnung war sauber, die Betten bequem und alles genau wie beschrieben. Auch die Lage ist super: Supermarkt, U-Bahn (nur 5 Minuten zu Fuß) und ein großer Spielplatz für Kinder sind ganz in der Nähe, was für uns als Familie sehr praktisch war. Wir würden jederzeit gerne wiederkommen!

Didn’t really have any communication with the host at all, since it’s a hotel and not an actual airbnb! But I would definitely recommend the place! The receptionist was the sweetest man ever and made literally my whole day! Everyone is extremely positive and always there to help if you need anything. They clean your room every single day and provide you with clean towels and bedsheets. One of the best hotels I stayed at so far. It’s in a really good and expensive area of Berlin. I would love to visit and stay there again! ❤️

Fantastico, concuerda la descripción y las fotos con la realidad. Muy bien comunicado con el centro, apenas 10 minutos a Alexanderplatz y a 50 minutos en transporte público a Schönefeld. Muy limpio y ordenado. Ideal para familias con dos hijos. Barrio muy tranquilo con servicios muy cerca de la casa. Repetiria de nuevo en la casa de Natalia.

We (a family with three children) stayed here for 3 nights. Everything was great, even better than we expected. We had all the facilities we needed to feel good. The bus station was very close, aslo the U-bahn station was a small walk away and the kids didn't mind to race it with us. Also used S-bahn station that was 15 min away to leave for the airport. David was kind and friendly, comunication fast. Great place to stay and we definetly would  stay here on our next trip to Berlin.
The apartment is very well located, perfect for visiting Berlin!!!
Hat sehr spaß gemacht

I really enjoyed my stay here, the unit is spacious, comfortable bed, very clean in a secure building with a cute little balcony. It’s located in the middle of a large Asian market so there were so many shops and delicious food right outside the door and public transit comes right to the front of the building.  The host Thang was very friendly and accommodating would absolutely recommend this place to anyone staying in Berlin!

It’s amazing stay with my wife and 3 month old kid.
Recommended
Nice and clean place, highly recommended!
Great apartment and Stephan was very responsive. Lovely courtyard, lots of space & good location. Would recommend!
Super great. Bed not super comfortable and lighting in the room not very balanced. A great place though! Worth it.
Nice room in a good location, easy transport links and plenty of restaurants and bars. Check in was a breeze, and I’d definitely stay again.

Super Lage, ordentlich und sauber, leider etwas schlecht zu belüften (gerade das kleine Zimmer im Sommer). Es war ein Reisebett fürs Baby vorhanden. Ausstattung auch ok. Kontaktlose Schlüsselübergabe super einfach. Schön wäre noch ein zweiter Schlüssel, gerade wenn man mit zwei Familien vor Ort ist.

Amazing place! Recommend for sure. Close to everything and as described. Berlin was a blast and coming home to this apartment was perfect.

Danke, Danke, Danke!!!
Tolle Wohnung, Gastfreundschaft...hach ja - alles toll (sonst wird die Liste zu lang)
Gerne wieder
Localización perfecta a media hora del centro y el aeropuerto. Dueños muy amables y accesibles. Recomendable

Espaço limpo, próximo ao Tiergarten e a estação de trem. A comunicação com Rosário foi simples e direta, além disso ele foi bem compreensivo ao me recepcionar tarde da noite devido a um atraso no meu voo.
Lage optimal um Berlin zu erkunden. Das Zimmer hat alles, was man braucht, fühlt sich aber sehr wie ein Hotelzimmer an, unpersönlich und klein.

We enjoyed this apartment, location is nice - in walkable distance to Graefe- and Bergmannkiez. The host shared a great list of restaurants and cafes. Apartment was very clean and well furnished. The building as such (and the entrance) isn't the nicest I think, but this didn't bother us. Would stay there again!

What an amazing place! It far exceeded my expectations for a hostel. It's only a very small place, but it's exactly like the pictures -- clean, beautifully decorated and has a lovely atmosphere. The surrounding neighbourhood is also great for cafes, restaurants, bars and other amenities.
I had a bit of trouble getting in when I arrived, but Anne was incredibly helpful and responsive over the phone.
A couple of minor things that could be improved:
- The beds are very squeaky so you can hear every time someone turns over
- The shower doors are quite translucent so you can see people through them, which made me feel uncomfortable every time I showered.
Even despite those things, it's a gorgeous place, great value and I highly recommend it.
Für ein kurzen Trip als Einzelperson oder Paar ideal! Wir waren wegen der EURO2024 für 2 Nächte da. Alles gut.

Very well located nice to Kreuzberg Canal and close to many nice places and activities.
Nice flat slightly ground level but enjoying sunshine thru many windows we did enjoy our stay
Alles Top 👌🏽

Sven was great.  He met us when we arrived, showed us how everything worked, and gave us some great tips and pointed out where things were.  The unit was just as listed, and we really enjoyed staying there.
Great and efficient stay with Nena apartments as always. Second time booking with them, did not even look at any other providers in Berlin

We had a lovely time in Amelie’s place. It is what we expected, matched the description and was very clean. It made a great base from which to explore Berlin.
The area is very nice indeed: a calm suburb with excellent bars and restaurants.
Overall, I can warmly recommend this place.

The wifi is practically unusable and James will tell you to go buy a wifi yourself and he will only compensate 10 euros a month. Everyone has been complaining in their reviews about the wifi since 2021 and he did nothing so it is very hard to believe him that they will change it since he always avoided answering the question of when. Shower leaks water that will go all the way to the living room if you do not use your towels on the floor. The toilet is quite small so you might have to squeeze through the door to get out. It took 21 days to fix dead ceiling bulbs and the lighting on top of the table is poor. In general very over priced in rent and cleaning services for what you get. The living room is big with decent furniture but the bed is two singles connected together not a double bed. The kitchen is in the same room as the bed so you will here a constant buzzing sound from the fridge all the time. The location is good. James is responsive only for simple matters but will not go the extra mile to change important things such as the aforementioned problems about the leaking shower and the wifi. Overall for the price of the place I was not satisfied.

Für unseren kurzen Aufenthalt war die Unterkunft wirklich super. Sehr gut mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen, in einem ruhigen Stadtteil und ein echt fairer Preis. Wir kommen gerne wieder :)

We loved staying at Numa Potsdamer Platz! The apartment was very clean. The bathroom and shower were great, and the bed was very comfy! I would definitely stay at Numa again and would recommend it to friends.
Nice location! 10-15min from alexanderplatz! Check in instructions were clear and the staff were really helpful! Room is clean and so are the toilets and showers. Would recommend to others!
Die Wohnung ist sehr modern und schön eingerichtet und sehr ruhig. In der Umgebung gibt es tolle Cafe und Restaurants und eine gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr.
Lovely place in a lovely hood. The Brooklyn of Berlin: indie cafés, vegan restaurants - all very urban. Nice, secure atmosphere.
房东很好，天气冷没有衣服还给我了他的衣服穿，还帮我们做咖啡煮饭，人很好，品味很好，下次还会来
The host responded very fast when we were in urgent need of a new place to stay. We basically had all the amenities needed for a short stay do we were satisifed.

Appartement très confortable et tres bien agencé. Accès très facile au centre ville.
Nous avons passés un très bon séjour chez Natalia et nous recommandons son logement.

Before I wrote about the place let me tell you about Ivos. Ivos agreed to check us in very early and ensured the apartment was spotless and clean before we got in. He met us at the apartment and guided us with the basic grocery shoppling that we needed for the 3 days stay. Now about the apartment - it is very well located just about a 3 minutes walk from the S-bahn and right next to the bus stop and the metro. Lot of places of attraction are walkable. Alexanderplatz is only a short walk which is full of eateriesand restaurants. Ivos deserves 10 stars for his apartment, his responsiveness and his willingness to help is unmatched. I highly recommend this apartment. And thanks to Ivos for making our stay great and comfortable.

This apartment is in a great location with transport links to all the main attractions of Berlin, you can take a cycling tour from the KulturBrauerei or visit the Mauer Park within a short walk.
The hosts responded promptly to any questions and the apartment was spotless when we arrived

First, the window of the hostel is open, but the blinds are broken and no light comes in at all. It is said to be a single bathroom, but it is a shared bathroom. You have to ask for a message because you can not see the hair dryer or the items that it is equipped with. The refrigerator is small and there is no space, so it is inconvenient to use. This condition is not inexpensive.

If you’re looking for a cool and unique place that’s close to the heart of Berlin - this is it! Staying here for our first time in the city, we felt like we got the real Berlin experience. Frank was very responsive to messages and was there to meet us and show us around when we first arrived. He had great recommendations for local eateries and how to get around using public transportation - his directions were spot on! It was an easy walk to the local train station, and from there a quick hop to any spot in the city. The apartment itself was well supplied, clean, stylish, and surprisingly peaceful despite being in the heart of the city. The unique decor added to our enjoyment. We really fell in love with Berlin will absolutely stay here next time we’re visiting!

Felix’s apartment is amazing! It surprised us all because it looks even bigger and brighter than in the pictures and description. The bedrooms are cozy and the rooms facing the street are spacious.
The kitchen is super well equipped for cooking, besides offering a pleasant atmosphere.
The flat is nicely located, surrounded by peaceful streets and at the same time well connected with the U7 (subway) and the Sbahn (train).
Felix is a great host, available for any questions before arrival and also during the stay at his flat, answering quick with thoughtful and straightforward words, making the experience very smooth.
Definitely to be recommended :)

Sabine was a great host! We didn't interact with her much, aside from messages (she was always responsive to communication) and giving us the key. Sabine accommodated us with a slightly earlier check-in due to our arrival time. The apartment is as pictured: nothing overly fancy, but functional, clean, and just what we wanted. The location couldn't be better. Sabine's place is right by a main subway station and she lives in a very trendy area that we loved exploring. Thanks for a great stay!
Kommunikation mit Maddalena lief unkompliziert und sehr herzlich. Perfekte Ausgangslage für Berlin. Moderne Wohnung Wohnung mit Charakter.. Etwas laut dafür aber super zentral.
Overall the place was good! Public transportation was near by, it was peaceful. I give it a 4/5. It was the little things that didn’t allow a 5/5 for this place.

The loft was a perfect place to stay during our visit to Berlin. Heaps of natural light, spacious and all the amenities as listed. The area was super cool and we wish we had more time to further explore it! Also walkable to mitto area. MaCha were great hosts, with very responsive communication
Perfekte Lage, sehr nahe Verkehrsmittel, die Wohnung ist wunderschön, alles sehr organisiert und sehr sauber. Supermarkt und andere Geschäfte auch ganz in der Nähe. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation

Super hote il sont tout les deux vraiment gentil et present en cas de soucis

whoever cleaned the apartment didn’t do a good job - there were a lot of hair strands left on the wall in the shower cabin :(

Awesome spot! Great location, great host!
Helen was very helpful and communicative. Her apartment is amazing. The neighborhood is of course wonderful:-) Good transport connections, restaurants, cool shops. We'd be happy to come back!

Tolles modernes Apartment in guter Lage, sehr sauber und mit allem ausgestattet. Der Check-In war denkbar einfach und die Kommunikation ohne Probleme. Wir haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen und würden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen!
Studio parfait, très bien équipé, bien situé dans un quartier très agréable et très bon accueil de la part d’Atto.
I really like it.
Es hat uns sehr gefallen. Alles funktionierte wie beschrieben. Schöne Lage. Nette Gastgeber. Gerne wieder.

Sehr gute Lage, super einfacher Check-In und das Apartment sieht genau so aus wie auf den Bildern. Dazu gibt es noch ein Handbuch mit allerhand Tipps für einen tollen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Auf jeden Fall weiterzuempfehlen. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Wonderful location, close to many restaurants and shops.  Short walk to mass transit connecting easily to all parts of the city.  The apartment was spotlessly clean, and quite spacious for two people.  One slight quirk -- bathroom door is somewhat see-through.  Some traveling companions might find that awkward.  We had a wonderful time in Berlin and would definitely recommend this apartment.

il wifii non funzionava per niente, il bagno si è allagato perchè lo scarico della doccia non funzionava e nessuno ha potuto aiutarmi se non dandomi le indicazioni per delle asciugamani in modo da rimediare (asciugamani che poi si sono rivelati insesistenti). assistenza telefonica molto lenta, gentile ma purtroppo inefficace.
dato il prezzo mi aspettavo meglio
Great stay! Has everything you need with some extremely comfy beds.
Sehr nette Gastgeberin, äussert ruhige und geschmackvolle Unterkunft, gerne immer wieder .

I love the concrete cabin in the sky! Very central location, little supermarket less than 100m away, close to hackescher markt train station, heaps of food offerings close by. Apartment was clean, fully stocked with coffee makers, cutlery, crockery. Claudia and Steffen accommodated my late check in, and organised a super late check out. Cannot fault - a great place to stay in Berlin!!!

Stayed for three nights in Brittas apartment! Although we had difficulties finding the apartment (building unmarked and very unclear to find) after a while with no phone (as true travellers) we were able to make contact with Britta who then made contact with the people managing the place whilst she was away. We later had problems with the door and how to unlock it but after making contact with the managers at Berlin Cribs we easily solved the issue and found out how to open the door (stressful but quickly solved situation). After the initial difficulties of the first night we had a great stay and really enjoyed it. The tram is really close by and from there really easy connections can be made all over Berlin. The location of the apartment is very central and there is a cute strip of restaurants literally outside the door step (we recommend the restaurant on the corner opposite the apartment block (really good food)! Overall really good stay and loved Berlin and the apartment, good beds, nice location and lovely host!

we were a family of 6 adults ( parents and 4 siblings). the apartment was perfect. plenty of space , big rooms . The location could not be better , lots of local cafes bars and places to eat. I would defiantly stay there again.
Sehr schöne Wohnung. Ruhig, im Hinterhof gelegen. Dennoch sehr zentral und sehr gute Anbindung an den ÖPNV. Jederzeit gerne wieder!

We had a wonderful stay! The place was spotless (which I really appreciate as a bit of a clean freak) and very comfortable for me and my daughter. The bathroom was beautiful, the bed cozy, and the location couldn’t have been more central—easy walks or quick transit rides to everything, and we always felt safe. Our host, Berat, was incredibly responsive, friendly, and helpful—he replied within minutes and gave us perfect directions when we needed them. Be sure to check out Felix Austria just a couple blocks away for delicious schnitzel & apple strudel, and the Marheineke Markthalle across from it. Highly recommended!

Interesting area, close to shopping and restaurants.  Also close to transportation and part of the"wall".  Cute apartment/room with own bedroom/kitchen area and own door to come in and out.  Some steps. Great host,speaks English and has many good "tips" about the city.  The room is small but holds some fun in a tiny place, all packed in quite well.  Enjoyed our stay.

Es war wirklich alles super. Würde es immer wieder buchen.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl Gefühl und die Gegend war schön ruhig und dennoch ein relativ kurzer Weg zum Kudamm.
Great place to stay right near the center of Berlin.
Very nice apartment in one of the nicest areas in Berlin! Everything totally lived up to our expectations!! Highly recommended :)
Fabulous location - so close to transportation!

Klausさんのアパートは、私たちがヨーロッパで宿泊したアパートの中で、間違いなく1番良い部屋でした。
清潔さは、日本人の私たちからしても120%満足出来るレベルでした。

Nils was a very responsive host. He communicated well and described everything well. The area has really great places to eat and drink. Connectivity to the tram is extremely good.
Super nice appartment, we had a wonderful time. It's really clean, well designed and comfortable. Would recommend this place for a big group of people who want to stay in Berlin for the weekend.
Sehr gutes Zimmer mit sehr netter Gastgeberin

We had a great long weekend in Paul & Jana’s lovely cosy basement studio apartment in Kreuzberg. It was very cosy and easy to find and close to lots of cool restaurants and shops. The upstairs neighbours were a bit noisy one morning but other than that it was very quiet and private. Paul & Jana were lovely, always responsive and helpful and we would definitely stay again.
Very friendly, very  proactive Hosts! Thank you for making my stay so easy!

Marc est un hôte prévenant et attentionné. Son appartement est parfait: bien situé, bien agencé et sa petite terrasse est très agréable. Allez y les yeux fermés (mais pas à nos dates svp, on voudrait y retourner😉)
Nice BnB. Spacious and felt comfortable with everything you need inside

Eine richtig ordentliche und saubere Unterkunft.

Renate und Manni 😘

A great place to stay, as it's a great base for getting around Berlin. East Side Gallery? 20 min walk. Potsdamer Platz? The underground is right outside. Excellent location and a lovely place to stay.
Einfach eine ganz besondere Wohnung! Sehr geschmackvoll (für mein Empfinden) eingerichtet, hat alles was man braucht, in super Lage.
Sehr nette Wohnung in super Lage mit tollen Bars und Restaurants. Durch die Lage zum Innenhof bekommt man davon allerdings nichts mit. Sehr sauber, Check-In unkompliziert. Sehr weiterzuempfehlen!
Oli was great host, the room and bathroom are nice and the location was perfect for us.

Superschöne Wohnung. Man kommt rein und fühlt sich sofort wohl! Das riesige Wohnzimmer ist gemütlich und der Balkon läd zu einem gemütlichen Frühstück ein. Einchecken total easy und zuverlässig. Lage super... und sogar einen Parkplatz direkt vor der Tür bekommen. Wenn wir wieder nach Berlin kommen, dann gerne jederzeit wieder! Alles Super!!!

Beautiful home with lots to explore around the area, even in the winter without a car or bike. Very warm as well! Maarten was a great host, he was available yet also discreet during the stay. We used the hot tub which was an amazing experience, highly recommend :)

Alexander’s place was very nice overall
The bed was very comfortable and the apartment had a lot of character / nicely decorated which I liked. He was also very responsive and helpful when we had requests
The location is also very nice-
There’s a really good breakfast spot directly under the apartment which we went to every morning. You can walk to many nice places from the apartment and it’s centrally located, which is great but also means there is some noise at night.
We enjoyed our stay here, and would recommend!
Really responsive and kind host. Very understanding to changes in plans. The accom was great. Quite loud, but to be expected when living in a busy area. Two big comfy beds.

The location is great but unfortunately not much else positive to say.
The gentleman working that day was rushed and impolite. The Wi-Fi did not work in at least half of the building. I was told it would work again after restarting the router but did not.
I spoke with another guest who was using the internet in the courtyard (the only place it did work) and was told the internet had been out all week and that they also had troubles communicating with the staff. Having IT issues - fine, but I wish they would have been honest so I could have planned accordingly.
The bedroom was as advertised but the bathroom had some mold growth in the shower and the vanity sink didn't drain.
Overall, not a pleasant experience. I won't stay here again.
It was a great stay, nice and clean place and great location. I got the ground floor apartment with a sweet green garden, very quiet.
This was a lovely place for a group of friends to stay at. It was very convenient. Felt more spacious than the impression we had gotten from the pictures. So very lovely place to stay at.

Plus: staff is helpful and friendly, location is great, price is great. There's a café where you can grab breakfast on your way out in the morning, the coffee was excellent. They also serve lunch and dinner but we didn't try those.
Minus: on the last night there was a strange sound from the bathroom followed by sewage stench that woke us all up. It was also annoying that it's not clear that you need to pay extra for towels (i.e. "towels" is listed under included essentials with no mention of a fee, at least not when we booked the room) and luggage dropoff. It's not too pricey, but it irked us a bit.
Also, be aware that there's a bar playing loud music in the yard, but they turn down the bass after 11 PM.

Absolutely gorgeous apartment looking out onto Görlitzer Park. The space and light are stunning, better than indicated by the photos. Check-in was easy and Elisabeth & Johannes were very responsive. I hope to stay again soon.
Alles tadellos

Great place, clean, cozy, convenient to grocery and train stations, a lot of fun things to do around. Host Anke is a really nice person. She offered a lot of help and kept me feeling welcomed during the entire stay. Highly recommended.
Very recommended. Well located and spacious place.
Nettes Hotel in der Nähe vom Checkpoint Charlie in Berlin, sehr sauber und modern. Nur schade das es kein Frühstück Raum gibt.
Sehr netter Vermieter, sehr zentrale aber ruhige Lage, super als Ausgangspunkt für Erkundungen der Innenstadt
Spacious accommodation, nicely decorated. I had a great stay !

It was really a good experience and the flat was so good and location was close to shopping street Wilmasdorf.  Brit and her husband were so kind and helpful.  I am sure will stay during my next trip in Brits flat.  Thanks again
Super nice apartment, lots of sunlight and very nice host.

Fantastic apartment in a brilliant location! We were first-timers in Berlin and Josephine’s flat was the perfect base. Super-comfortable and light and spacious it was a great place to come back to after a day exploring Kreuzberg and Neukölln and central Berlin. Plenty of cool local cafés and bars and just a great neighbourhood to wander round, with the canal a five minute walk away. Josephine was very responsive and had some great recommendations for cafes etc (Ofra Café just across the park was a real highlight). Thanks for everything Josephine!

Arne ist ein sehr freundlicher, offener und unkomplizierter Gastgeber und die Wohnung etwas ganz besonderes. Ich habe mich sofort wie zu Hause gefühlt. Das Bett war himmlisch bequem. Wenn man Katzen mag, wird man seine Freude mit den beiden haben.

Die Wohnung ist behaglich, hell und hat alles, was man braucht. Die ruhige Hinterhof-Lage in der quirligen Umgebung Neuköllns ist eine perfekte Kombination. Auch die Anbindung an den öffentlichen Personennahverkehr ist sehr gut. Gerne wieder!

Wir konnten nach einer langen und anstrengenden Zugfahrt schon sehr viel früher einchecken und wurden mit einem Kaffee begrüßt. Sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Die Lage ist super praktisch und ruhig.
War ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt in Berlin. Kommen gerne wieder.
I had a wonderful stay in a very clean and modren apartment. Everything was as described. I would recommend this lovely space to anyone visiting Berlin.

Оливер отличный и гостеприимный хозяин, я останавливалась в квартире более чем на три недели, меня встретил отец Оливера, Убертус, и несмотря на то, что было уже поздновато он не только рассказал про район но и сделал маленькую экскурсию (автобусные остановки, рестораны, магазины). Приятно было увидеть будет цветов в день заезда, также есть кофе машина уже с капсулами отличного кофе, квартира очень чистая, отличный интернет, район очень тихий, до центра города каждые 20 мин ходят автобусы (поездка 20 мин до центра).  Оливер быстро отвечает на любые вопросы и всегда готов помочь советом. В квартире есть все что нужно для комфортного проживания как на долгий период так и для короткой поездки!

The apartment itself is spacious and so convenient it’s well equipped with everything that you need, unfortunately no microwave, but you can still use the electric oven which was a pleasant addition.
They didn’t miss out anything, I would highly recommend this apartment to groups, not close to main attractions but you can have a peaceful night of sleep for sure.
The apartment is quite large and situated in a nice position in Berlin.
super süßes Hotel, mit freundlichen Personal und einer guten Lage. Ich komme gerne wieder.
Thomas était prévenant. L'appartement correspondait aux photos. L'environnement permettait de s'alimenter facilement et nous avons aimé les parcs à proximité. Merci
Schönes Appartement und ein freundlicher Vermieter, der immer gut zu erreichen war. Vielen Dank👍
Gute Wohnung, gute Lage, problemlose Kommunikation.
Nice place :)

Astrid's place is well furnished and fits 6 people in a comfortable way. The apartment is on the 1st floor of a residential building, it has two bedrooms with comfortable beds, a living room with two couchs (where two other people can accommodate). The decor is very nice, lots of books and vinyls to be entertained if you are curious. The kitchen is equipped if you want to eat there. It is located in a quiet street, the entrance leads to a common area with lots of greenery and the sounds of birds singing. The location is very good in Mitte, close to bakeries, kiosks and bus stops that allow quick travel to various places of Berlin.
The only point of attention goes to the shower that is not properly fixed and the water flow ends up falling more on the wall than on those who bathe, we adjusted using a string that we found in the apartment itself and everything went well after that.
I recommend it also for medium to long stays, as it has plenty of storage space for clothes and even a balcony to enjoy the evening chatting.
Tolle Wohnung, super Lage, sehr sauber!!!
The apartment has a wow-factor. It is stunning, the photos do not convey the airiness, light, views. I would give six stars.
Alles spitze! Highly recommended

Le logement de Vincent est parfait pour quelques jours. A côté d un métro qui ment directement au centre ville et à 20 min à pied du check point Charlie.
Salle de bain très petite mais mentionnée suffisant pour une douche. Lit très confortable et quartier très calme et reposant.
Manque juste une carte de la ville et du métro à disposition mais cela est facilement trouvable.
Ina notre contact a été très gentille et disponible malgré nos 2h de retard de vol !
Elle est disponible par WH et réactive tout comme Vincent.
Stéphanie was very quick to respond to queries and made sure everything was ready for our stay with a baby.
Todo bien excepto que había solo elementos básicos para cocinar y de limpieza

Ermal’s apartment is homely, sparkling clean and furnished super nicely. Having a balcony is also a huge plus to relax and chill in the mornings/evenings with a drink or coffee! The self check-in is very smooth and Ermal’s level of communication is great. He’s very responsive and detailed, which makes you comfortable. Highly recommend this apartment for someone looking to have a good and relaxing time in Berlin.
Great location! Very close to the train, lots to do nearby.
alles bestens!
Great stay with a bear by local things
perfect location
Was a nice place to stay would recommend

Good value for money and exactly as described.
An earlier check in would have been nice but it was clean, comfy and in a good location to explore the city from.
The place was really nice and clean. The location is great, right at the subway station.

5/5
Die Lage in der Nähe der S-Bahnstation ist ideal.
Nette Nachbarschaft mit Bar und Restaurant.
Die Unterkunft ist ruhig und komfortabel und das WLAN gut.
I had a wonderful stay! Everything you need for a citytrip and close to many cool bars and restaurants in Friedrichshain. I would visit again☺️

Die Wohnung ist groß, hell, sauber. Der Check-In ist durch eine Schlüsselbox vollkommen easy. Es ist alles vorhanden, was man sich wünschen kann. Andreas ist ein großartiger Gastgeber: meldet sich sofort, wenn es eine Frage gibt, hat uns Milch, Kaffee usw. bereitgestellt, hat uns sogar eine Abo-Karte für den ÖPNV hingelegt.
Das einzige, was vielleicht stören könnte: in den beiden Zimmern, die zur Straße hin liegen, kann man nicht bei geöffneten Fenstern schlafen, weil durch die kopfsteingepflasterte Straße der Verkehr sehr laut ist. Aber wenn man die Fenster schließt, ist es ruhig. Und ich bin durch meine Wohnlage zu Hause - da ist es vollkommen still - sehr verwöhnt. Kann man für Berlin wohl einfach nicht erwarten! 😊
Vielen Dank, Andreas, wir empfehlen deine Wohnung unbedingt weiter!

Lägenheten i sig var helt ok men den låg vägg i vägg med en bar och det visade sig vara otroligt lyhört. Vårt sovrum låg vägg i vägg med barens kök = högljutt slammer inklusive en diskmaskin från kl 15-23. Om du vill somna under det tidsspannet gör du bäst i att välja en annan bostad.
Bra bageri med trevlig personal i hörnan bredvid och nära till kommunal transport.

Charming, comfortable and quirky. Everything and more is offered: the comfiest bed we have EVER slept on, coffee, laptop, lovely shower, large windows letting in loads of light. Perfect for getaways where you only really want a base and a place to sleep. Only downside is that we found it just a touch to far out to be super accessible to the city centre, just a touch. Thanks team Berlin Lofts!
Todo muy acogedor🥰 muchas gracias por la estadía y por la buena comunicación ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Nhu was such a lovely host! She’s very friendly and helpful and has a beautiful home. I highly recommend staying with her and Jan!

We spent three nights in this apartment, it is really nice, clean and stylish, located in a great area with lots of bar and restaurants. However a big minus for me was the management of the access to the rooms. The building is a sort of a labyrinth where you need to unlock multiple doors with a code that is provided in order to get to your room. The indications are not perfectly clear but one can manage. I had a scary moment where one of the padlocks at the exit of the elevator didn't work (empty battery?). I decided to take the stairs and got locked out at the staircase with no way of getting back to the main building. There were already two other guests locked out there, totally freaked out... They didn't have access to the internet and had no way to ask for help. Worth mentioning that it was on January 1 at 4 am... Luckily I could find the email with the number to call, they responded quickly and guided us to a way out through and inner yard (would've never found it ourselves...)

David’s place was great, the location was a bit far from the famous monuments but it was a great stay nonetheless. David also informed us very well on how to check-in and check-out so there were no misunderstandings. Overall, it was a great stay and we would 100% recommend!
Very good stay. No other comment needed.
Mooi appartement in een rustige wijk. Goed te bereiken met het OV. Alles schoon en netjes, en ook smaakvol ingericht.
Super apartament for Citybreak or business travel!

The place is near zoo with excellent connections from city centre. Apartment is very clean and with a very useful kitchen and coffee machine. Early checkin and payment of fees only on the link is a issue as the payment page is cumbersome with payment failures. The host is very responsive and helpful.

-Wifi is not working well
-The bathroom sink was stuck with dirty and hair.
-The window in the bedroom was broken and could not close so we could hear everything in the street.
-The host give me an appointment but never came it.
AND SOMEBODY From the Host team entered in the apparment at 01:30 at night right in the main room where the 2nd bed is.
First really bad experience with airbnb
Be carefull

Studio fonctionnel et très sympa, accueil de Jens excellent, qui viendra à votre rencontre en quelques minutes. Très bien situé, proche des transports, commerces et restos. Parfois un peu bruyant jusqu'à tard dans la nuit avec les tables du bar situé en face. Le plus rapide pour y aller depuis l'aéroport : train S-Bahn S45 jusqu'à Südkreuz, puis changer sur le même quai pour le S41 jusqu'à Innsbrucker Platz. De là, prendre le U-Bahn, ligne U4 et parcourir toute la ligne jusqu'à Nollendorfplatz (rassurez-vous, c'est la plus petite ligne de métro qui ne fait que cinq stations en tout, et la plus pittoresque).
È andato tutto molto bene! Il quartiere è bellissimo 🤟

We booked this place the evening we needed it when the accommodation we had originally booked fell through. The hosts went out of their way to accomodate us at such short notice. The place was just what we needed, spacious, comfortable and in a handy location.
It was good.
The room is very big, everything was clean and the house was comfortable and quiet and had everything we needed. A nice place to stay!

This place is insanely amazing!!! I felt so super comfortable. The flat is so big and has everything you need.
Every person that came visiting me was really impressed by this flat, looks really like some superstar is living in there hehe.
Armin does a really good job! I had absolutely no problems in the whole time I stayed there :)
Die Unterkunft hatte alles was man braucht, die Lage war auch super und der Check in sehr unkompliziert. Definitiv weiterzuempfehlen!
It was nice at Lindemann’s. Unfortunately the bed was not comfortable. Both my boyfriend and I couldn’t sleep well. We had backache after two nights sleeping there

Es war alles perfekt, super nette Konversationen gehabt. Das Bett war super bequem, der Check in und check out problemlos. Die Unterkunft war super sauber, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt! Immer gern wieder.

Lovely place, location and incredible host!
If you see this place as available then you are lucky... do not hesitate and just book it...
I promise you will be happy about it :)
Thank you ever so much for having us Maria :)

The rooms were clean and everything was as described.
Claudia was very proactive and quick to reply.
We would definitively consider her place again if we come to Berlin again.

We loved our stay at Kathrin’s hostel. The front shared space was always lit and very welcoming. Bedroom was very clean and comfortable and there were several bathrooms nearby. Great space to stay on the eastern side of the city!
Es muy buen lugar. Divertido y servicio de bar increíble.

Overall, this place was wonderful to stay in for our visit to berlin. Very stylish and cosy. Excellent location - 5 min walk from the underground.
Great communication from the hosts with a lovely warm welcome. Plenty of information provided and leaflets ready in the studio.
Couldnt have asked for better, great value for money! Everything you could ever need. Would love to stay again.
Many thanks!
Ashleigh

This place was great !  We had four people and the beds, and couch were a good fit for us all.  There is a huge kitchen / living-room area to hang out.  A nice TV is available if needed, along with easy to use bluetooth connections to the Bose speakers in the living-room and bathroom.  When we needed an electrical adapter, it was in the drawer.  When we needed an HDMI cable to connect a laptop to the TV, it was in the drawer.  Washer and Dryer are available and easy to figure out how to use.  The neighborhood is great.  There is a good variety of restaurants very close by of all food types.  There is also a huge supermarket about 5 mins walk as well.   Transportation is also very close by.  This was a great stay and I would recommend it to anyone looking to explore Berlin from a central location.
Хостел очень удобно расположен на пересечении двух веток метро. Матрасы новые, не скрипят, в номере все свежее. Из минусов шум на улице.
房源描述基本到位，总的来说住着挺好的。出了带行李箱离车站稍远，别的挺好。
Wirklich schöne Unterkunft für einige Tage. Sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung. Mina konnte man jederzeit gut erreichen und der Check-In war sehr einfach.

Anfitriã muito prestativa. Respondia com rapidez. Discrição exata do local. Foi deixado bastante utensílios úteis como cafeteira, pó, coador papel, material limpeza.
Boa localização, com metro a 1 mim. Bairro com muitos comércios e restaurantes próximos. Tem mercados também.
Gezellig huisje in de tuin met eigen terrasje.

2년 만에 Anna의 숙소에 다시 묵었네요.
