공원 옆이라서 여름에 꼭 다시 가고싶은 숙소입니다.
Actually is nicer than the photos! Very clean, quiet, well located and comfortable. Would definitely stay here again.

It was a pleasant stay. The location was nice, the host communicated very good and it was clean. It was no problem to add another person to the booking.
The only downside was the delayed check-in (about 30mins later) because the cleaning was still in progress.
Everything was ok

Super appartement, confortable, lumineux, propre, bien situé et bien équipé.
Good vibes!
Hôte très disponible et très accueillant - n'hésitez pas à demander à Tom les bonnes adresses.
Pas mal de guides et magazines sur Berlin dans la bibliothèque.
La literie était très confortable. Nous n'avons manqué de rien.
Nous recommandons vivement cet hôte.
Das Konzept hat uns sehr gut gefallen, wir kommen gerne wieder
beautiful place. Thank you Matthew

The room is very bright, spacious, quiet and clean. To my mind, it is a perfect location for a short Berlin visit. Also, there are many nice cafés and bars around the Richardplatz and public transport is nearby. Check-in and check out were super easy and Etienne was welcoming and uncomplicated, so I can definetly recommend.
Die Unterkunft von Andrey war super! Der Kontakt war wunderbar. Sehr zu empfehlen.
Geweldige studio in kreuzberg. dichtbij de mooiste clubs. Lekker rustig gelegen. Zeker een aanrader.
Nicht nur Berlin ist eine Reise wert, sondern auch die sympathische Barbara mit ihrer besonderen Unterkunft!
Tom ist ein sehr freundlicher und zuverlässiger Gastgeber! Zusätzlich ist die Wohnung immer super sauber, hier kann man sich richtig wohlfühlen!
Great spot near a lot of tasty Asian restaurants. The place was clean and a great place to rest after a day of sightseeing.
Gute Unterkunft für angemessenes Geld

We had a fantastic stay! Helen was so helpful from start to finish. The place is so unique and full of character. The area is filled with lots of great places to eat and drink. Thanks for a great stay
Séjour parfait dans l'appartement. Il est parfaitement placé, près des lignes de transports en commun et le quartier est tout à fait charmant. résidence très calme et appartement très mignon :)

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Berlin! Die Schlüsselübergabe hat prima geklappt, Doerthe war total nett, sie hat uns alles gezeigt und erklärt. Die Wohnung war sauber und sah genauso aus wie auf den Fotos.
Die Lage ist super - gleich um die Ecke gibt es jede Menge Cafés, Restaurants und Einkaufmöglichkeiten. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Kommunikation und Abwicklung mit Mina war professionell, hilfreich und freundlich. Wohnung war top und ruhig durch die Lage in einem Innenhof. Wegen eines vorhandenen Oberlichts in der Decke ist es ab Sonnenaufgang hell im Zimmer. Schlafmaske empfehlenswert. Die Lage fand ich super durch die Nähe zur U-Bahn. Als Alleinreisender hätte ich mir mehr Fernsehprogramme gewünscht (Empfang lediglich öffentlich-rechtlicher Sender) bzw. evtl. habe ich es auch nur nicht verstanden, wie man andere Programme aufruft.
Und als Essenstipp: In fußläufiger Entfernung war ich zum Frühstücken im Cafè am Schäfersee und abends bei einem Asia-Imbiss mit großem Angebot zu günstigen Preisen in der Passage zum Edeka Residenzstrasse.

베를린 중심가에서 꽤 멀고 북쪽이기 때문에 좀 나가려면 한시간은 잡아야 합니다. 가격 대비 방 자체는 나쁘지 않지만, 대신 2층이고 엘레베이터는 없기 때문에 짐이 무겁다면 참고하세요. 호스트가 부엌 사용에 대해 엄청나게 까다롭기 때문에 요리하실 생각이라면 정말 정말 비추... 냄비에 물 한 방울 안 말랐다고 살모넬라 균이 생긴다며 엄청 소리지르고 몇 번이나 뭐라고 해서 정말 어이 없었어요. 처음 며칠은 호스트가 있어서 이 점 때문에 굉장히 불편했습니다. 또 같은 이름의 길이 차로 십분 거리 정도에 하나 더 있기 때문에 우편 번호를 꼭 참조하시고 가야 합니다.
You really can't beat the price and the house is okay, but there are few things you need to know.
1. Obviously it's quite far away from Mitte so if you're planning to go out at night I would NOT recommend it. Takes more than an hour even within the city.
2. There's no lift or elevator in the building which is quite common in Germany but if you luggage is heavy you might have hard time carrying it.
3. There's another Trekowstrasse 10min away so you MUST check the postcode.
4. Most importantly, host was extremely fussy and difficult about kitchen use, yelled at me about how ONE drop of water was left in the pot(It was clean otherwise) and that causing salmonella poisoning...she was home for first couple of days or our stay which made us very uncomfortable and that's what made me write this review. I'd say if she's not home the house is a good place to stay, but if you're planning to use the kitchen or cook I would NOT recommend it.
I felt like she was really meticulous about her kitchen which isn't necessarily a bad thing, but if you're hosting people you'd expect different life styles and few changes...We were really dumbfounded by how she behaved towards us.

Die Unterkunft war sauber, gemütlich und perfekt ausgestattet. Die Lage ist ruhig, aber dennoch zentral, und die Gastgeberin war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Ich habe mich rundum wohlgefühlt – absolut empfehlenswert!
Nous avons passé un agréable séjour chez Alex. Nous n'avons pas eu l'occasion de le voir mais il était réactif par message.
Fantastic, friendly host and great place. Good location close to good public transport links.
Fantastic apartment. Magnificent stay. Thanks

Ralph's Görlitzer Park apartment is exactly how it is described and pictured on the listing - we were very happy during our stay there and the location is fantastic, with everything you need on your doorstep. The apartment is cosy but also spacious and includes washing machine, dishwasher, coffee machine etc. which were added bonuses.
We were initially worried about being on the ground floor for noise/light pollution but this wasn't an issue - we slept amazingly every night. Ralph was on hand at all times whenever we needed him and was a fantastic host - we can't wait to come back!

Ein schönes Zimmer - im Herzen von Kreuzberg!
Für Hüftgeschädigte: das Bett ist seehr niedrig!
Der Platz vor dem Haus atmet schon fast einen surrealen Frieden und Ruhe aus... alle Gäste sitzen alleine oder paarweise unter ihren Sonnenschirmen und genießen das Leben, als gäbe es kein Morgen...
Das quirlige Neukölln ist nur wenige Fahrminuten entfernt - wer in eine komplett andere, orientalische Welt abtauchen will!
Vor dem Haus oder in der Umgebung finden sich immer E-Tretroller oder E-Vespas zum unkomplizierten Ausleihen per App und die weitere Umgebung zu erkunden.
Mein Geheimtipp: das „Engelbecken“ und die St. Michaelkirche (unbekannt, aber stimmungsvoll)
Such a lovely apartment with a beautiful balcony and everything you could possibly need for a comfortable city getaway. Patrick was a gentleman, a great experience!

I stayed here for 2 days, and the experience is amazing, I will definitely come back when I visit Berlin again. I booked the 6 bedroom, and there are only me and another guy. The room is very quiet and clean. The breakfast is awesome, don't miss it!
Very nice and clean place. Good host. Easy check-in process.

We loved Hadi’s place. It’s bigger than it appears in the photos but otherwise as shown. Location couldn’t be much better if you’re looking to get away from the main tourist bubble and see ‘real’ Berlin - chilled out but with plenty of quirky little shops, bars, restaurants etc. (and walking distance from a lot of good clubs).  Hadi was super responsive and helpful from start to finish. Would definitely recommend.
위치도 좋고, 청결도 좋고 리셉션도 다 좋아요~!!
Gute Lage, U-Bahn direkt vor der Tür. Markthalle mit vielen Restaurants nur 600 Meter entfernt. Ruhige Und geräumige Wohnung.

Perfect location! Underground at the end of the road, a coffee shop opposite the building, a small independent bar below the flat, and well known shops and stones throw away! We came to Berlin for a couples city break and it was exactly what we wanted! 5*
Waltraud's apartment is just as displayed.  It is in an attractive and quiet neighbourhood with good access to public transport.  Lovely to step out onto the verandah for breakfast!
Sehr schöne Wohnung in der man sich wirklich zu Hause fühlt. Sehr gute und ruhige Lage. Übernahme und Abreise unkompliziert. Wirklich sehr zu empfehlen.

Thomas' place was great value for money. The best part of this airbnb was Thomas and how responsive/proactive he was, by giving his contact details should we be of need of anything. There were plenty of towels, bed-linen, blankets and crockery provided for a week-long stay. Everything was as described. Can recommend!

Fuimos un grupo de cinco amigos y estuvimos muy bien. El anfitrión muy simpático y comprensible. La única pega sería lo lejos que queda de las discotecas y lo pequeñas que eran las ollas, tardamos bastante en cocinar. Muy recomendable

Vom Bett direkt auf's Wasser schauen- so lässt es sich gut in den Tag starten.
Die Ferienwohnung liegt im Hinterhof sehr ruhig gelegen direkt am Wasser- im Sommer mit dem Steg ein Traum.
Wir haben uns hier sehr wohl gefühlt- eine gute Ausgangsbasis, um Köpenick, die Umgebung oder auch Berlin zu erkunden. Gerne kommen wir wieder hierher.

Tai was oh so wonderful and was always friendly and quick to respond.  The listing is close to perfect about the place. I'd say the master bedroom isn't that private due to the type of doors but it is still very big and lovely. Master bed is nice, sofa bed was surprisingly comfortable, and the one in the kid's room is OK.  The neighborhood is in the perfect spot because the street is quiet but only one block away from all the restaurants and shops (VOO STORE!). I would love to stay at Tai's place again!

Nice and clean place. It was a bit of a surprise that the apartment is situated on the ground floor. You step from the busy road in de room and there is no view. But the place was clean and comfortable and located in a nice neighbourhood.

Excelente anfitrión. Dominic responde rápido. Se nos dificultó encontrar el edificio, pero de inmediato nos vino a buscar. Todo estuvo perfecto! Todo estaba muy limpio, ordenado y con todo lo necesario para una buena estadía. Café, té, sal, aceite, azúcar, esos pequeños detalles se valoran mucho. Muy bien comunicado con el transporte público y también se puede llegar caminando a muchos  sitios de interés. Recomendamos ampliamente este alojamiento para disfrutar de Berlín. Muchas gracias Dominic y Karak.
weak wifi signal
The house and host are perfect. The location is great.

Lovely flat with so much space. Outdoor table & chairs a bonus, tho' opening the curtains to see cars a meter away maybe less so.
Having both coffee pods and filter coffee was a thoughtful touch.
Very quiet neighbourhood. Woke up hearing birdsong.

Je recommande ce logement si vous voulez visiter Berlin ! Il est facilement accessible en transport en commun.
Les conseils donnés sont très utiles, la chambre est comme la description et l'on s'y sent bien ! Tout est fonctionnel
The response time was amazing. And they are happy to check us in early because we arrived earlier than planned

Thanks for the great stay, Martin. Martin is very helpful, and his house is clean and quiet. The neighborhood is close to many tourist attractions and safe.
I am tall and a side-sleeper, but he has a comfortable bed that provides a good night’s sleep.
Nice place to stay at! Especially with quick access to the ubahn, sbahn and bus lines. Some nice places around to have dinner or brunch!

Alles super, super Lage, super Personal.
Gerne wieder! :)
Everything as expected, nice and clean, easy checkin, good location
Beautiful apartment exactly as described - highly recommended! Christiane is an amazing host.
Great location and perfect for what we needed

Jo and Fran's place is in a great location  for access to everywhere in Berlin city. It took 20 mins from the Hauptbahnhof. I could walk everywhere in central Mitte at all hours of the night,  The bedroom is very large and absolutely comfortable, and also private. Lovely bathroom and everything is spotlessly clean. The check in was smooth and easy.  Fran and Jo are travelers themselves  were friendly and welcoming . At the same time they were extremely discreet - but there if I needed them. I would highly recommend Fran and Jo's place. I wanted to stay longer but it was booked out! So be quick if their place is available for you.
Kathrin's place is - as others point out - a really lovely spot to stay in Berlin! Conveniently located, quiet, nicely decorated, and with soul. I would definitely like to come again!
Everything was incredibly easy and simple. We enjoyed our stay 🤞🏼

Ursula's apartment is lovely in a great location, close to everything that you may need. Communication was always easy and direct with Ursula. The apartment was decorated well and felt calm, peaceful and private. Check-in and out was easy and simple. Would recommend, thank you for having us Ursula!
Nice, clean and central

Karen was a lovely host. Her welcoming smile made really the difference during my stay, I am really happy that I chose her accommodation to spend a few days in Berlin. Both the room and the bathroom are very clean, and they are equipped with anything you might need. The surroundings are quiet and nice to have a walk. The area is full of restaurants, cafés, and bakeries, and the metro station is less than 10 minutes away by foot. I really recommend Karen's place for your stay in Berlin. Thank you so much, Karen!
Great hostel 😁

Fin och ren lägenhet i ett intressant område nära bra kommunikationer. Vi var aldrig ute också åt på kvällen men vad vi förstod fanns det flera populära restauranger i området. Mycket bra värd som snabbt svarade på frågor och som skickade värdefull info innan vi anlände. Kan varmt rekommendera Philipps lägenhet!
Dans la salle de bain très sale baignoire, problème de évacuation de l'eau,.très lente. Pas de micronde. Le reste est à point.
For my 3-day trip, this accommodation was perfect. Everything was easy to find, clean, and convenient. I am completely satisfied with my choice.
Perfect location and Ivos was a great host who was very attentive and responsive to any questions I had.

Nous avons été fort bien accueillis par Jana qui nous attendait et qui a fait preuve de beaucoup de disponibilité pour nous mettre à l'aise, répondre à nos questions et faciliter nos premières découvertes du quartier et de la ville.
War alles super

Die Unterkunft ist ein Traum und die Kommunikation mit Norbert problemlos. Eine der besten Airbnb-Erfahrungen, die ich je hatte. Die Wohnung ist wunderschön, sehr mit Kunst angereichert und das Treppensteigen hält fit :)
It was very cozy and a short walking distance from the grocery store. Charlotte was very helpful and responded to messages relatively quickly.

Natasya’s apartment was really nice and beautiful. She also gave a list of cafes and things do do in the neighbourhood, which was really nice. Sadly we didn’t meet Natasya but she was really nice in communication. We would definitely come back here!

Ashraf hat mich sehr aufmerksm telefonisch vom HBF in die Unterkunft gelost und dort sehr unkompliziert die Schlüsselübergabe gestaltet. Ich habe mich sehr wohl und sicher in dem sehr wohnlichen Appartement gefühlt, aber auch in der Gegend. Es war ein gelungener Aufenthalt!
Etwas außerhalb gelegen, aber perfekt für ein Wochenende in Berlin.

C est la deuxième fois que nous résidons chez Simon, nous adorons cet appartement, spacieux, calme, très bien équipé, propre et très bien situé!
Simon est un hôte sympathique, réactif et arrangeant! Nous reviendrons l année prochaine sans hésitation!
Nous vous recommandons ce logement!

Ich hatte einen sehr tollen auf bei Eleni. Sie ist super lieb und hilfsbereich, leider haben wir uns immer ein wenig verpasst.
Das Airbnb ist super sauber und man hat alles was man braucht. Die Lage ist ebenfalls top, da man eigentlich alles in der Nähe hatte und U Bahn und S Bahn Stationen in unter 10 min zu erreichen sind.
Es war ein rund um perfekter Aufenthalt bei Eleni.
그들의 숙소는 청결하고, 베를린을 여행하기 좋은 위치입니다. 주방과 세탁기, 그리고 건조기를 무료로 쓸 수 있어서 좋았습니다. 다만 방이 조금 작아서 캐리어가 크다면 공간이 모자랄 수 있습니다.

Myself and three friends had a wonderful stay in Bhavna's flat – it is beautiful, clean and relaxing, full of light, in a beautiful area and even with a balcony! I cannot recommend this flat enough, and Bhavna was a very responsive host who was nothing but friendly and helpful. Very much looking to staying here again in the future :)

The apartment is very beautiful (expecially the terrace during the summer), clean and comfortable. It's very close to subway und busses but you can reach very nice places to eat, drink or for a walk even on foot. I can only recommend it if you want to visit the city and enjoy kreuzberg!
Very nice appartment in the middle of one of the most vibrant neighbourhoods in Berlin. Large rooms with good facilities and easy access to public transport.
Die Wohnung war gut, sauber, alles nötige vorhanden für 4 Personen. Leider eine weiche Matratze. Aber insgesamt wars unkompliziert und gut angebunden. Passend für einen kurzen Aufenthalt.
Good apartment, great host, super fast comunication
Great stay! Very close to the parks and both S + U bahns. Would recommend.
Alles super !!!

Mostly loved the private terrace and the clean linen.
Thank you

This was our third stay in one of Marcus’s properties. The apartment is clean, tastefully furnished, quiet, and located in a fantastic neighborhood in the heart of Mitte. Everything works properly, and Marcus is a kind and helpful host. We had a great time!
Great place to stay, fully recommend to anyone wanting to stay central Berlin for a few days
Alles war gut!
请务必做好被额外收取住宿费的准备；
Es gab eine sehr nette Begrüßung und Einweisung für die Wohnung. Wir haben uns gleich sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Kommunkation vor der Reise war sehr gut. Gerne immer wieder!
Very clean, hotel style place! Perfect for a visit to Friedrichshain.
Good appartment very well located near an S-bahn station and several convinience stores. Very recomendable

The apartment is in a neighborhood full of restaurants and bars. A Markt is established every Wednesday and Saturday right in front of the building. The public transport connection is very good. The apartment is exactly how it is seen in the pictures. Check in and out was very easy. I did home office in the apartment so I spend lots of time in it. Bed sheets towels were very clean and a lot to use and change. A bit of smell from the toilet was unpleasant. But warm water was perfect. Windows were dirty but you might not find it disturbing if you don’t spend much time at home. Tableware was not very clean, but that might not bother you if you don’t eat at home.
We had a very nice trip in Berlin, we enjoyed our stay in this well equipped appartement and perfectly located in a calm yet animated neighborhood ! Thank you Nena apartments 🙂
Perfect place close to the UBahn!

Ich hatte eine gute Zeit bei Laura. Die Sauberkeit hängt natürlich immer von den anderen Mitbewohnern ab, aber es wurde täglich alles geputzt und daher war das auch kein Problem mehr.
Gute Lage, sieht so aus wie auf den Bildern.

C'est un bel appartement, très spacieux.
Comme de nombreux logements berlinois, il n'y a pas de volets aux fenêtres.
Toutefois, il y a des rideaux occultants. Tout est bien équipé et confortable.
Hae-Ok est disponible et soucieuse du bien être de ses locataires.
Nous gardons l'adresse pour notre prochain séjour à Berlin !

Hatten einen super Aufenthalt in Berlin. Die Lage hätte gar nicht besser sein können und alles was wir sehen wollten war dadurch auch schnell zu erreichen. Direkt gegenüber von der Unterkunft ist ein Lidl was auch sehr praktisch war. Insgesamt eine top Unterkunft!

Ik kon me geen betere plaats voorstellen in Berlijn! Dichtbij de gezelligste plekjes om te eten, op wandelafstand van het bruisende Mitte, en toch heel rustig gelegen met een leuke tuin. Ook de accommodatie zelf was perfect: alles was aanwezig en mooi verzorgd,  ook heel stijlvol en gezellig ingericht.  Renny is heel aangenaam en reageert meteen. Ik kom zeker terug!!

Unterkunft entspricht der Beschreibung. Check In und Out erfolgt unkompliziert. Mina war aufmerksam und um das Wohl meines Aufenthaltes bemüht.
Danke dir

Carmen is a very nice host and reacts to every wish. The apartment is small but cozy and the necessary things are provided. On the downside: no shampoo in the shower, a bit loud in the nights because of the trains, 900mtrs to any „trainstation“ // on the positive side: really cozy spot, easy communication, no pollution, fair price
Muy lindo igual que en las fotos , limpio, seguro y confortable absolutamente todo, definitivamente volvería aquí
It was super quite place enjoying my staying here… I enjoyed very much. Thank you kind Frank
Perfect accommodation for a short trip in Berlin. Easy to find and good well served with public transportation
Perfect hospitality and accommodation ! I will come back

I had a lovely stay at René and Anja’s Tiny House! The breakfast they served me every morning was delicious. Their little garden was beautiful. I loved the cozy and elegant set up of the Tiny House. Really felt like home. Checking in and out was a seamless process. I also really appreciated the tips and recommendations Anja and René shared with me. Their Airbnb was only a tram ride away from Alexanderplatz and was minutes away by foot from the beautiful Weißensee Park.
Looking forward to future stays in Berlin. Will definitely plan on reaching out next time I plan a trip :))

Ilias was a great host. I arrived into Berlin quite late but he stayed up to welcome me. The apartment is amazing - very spacious and airy. There were so many places to just sit and relax. The location was perfect for me and there are great bars and restaurants nearby.
Alles super
Ci siamo trovati benissimo, l'appartamento è spazioso e pulito, comodissima la posizione vicino a s-bahn S3 e tram, è una base ideale per girare facilmente tutta la città.
Vielen Dank für das herzliche Wilkommen in Berlin, eine ganz ganz außergewöhnliche und herzliche Wohnung nette Umgebung, ganz ganz spezielles Flair
Great place. Extremely well located, easy to access. There was a heat wave so not having an AC is a minus, but with ventilators and all of windows open you can make it.

Ljus, stilren och elegant lägenhet, högt i tak. Fräscht kök och badrum. Akustiskt piano i toppskick. Bra läge, lite utanför centrum men nära tunnelbana. Gott om restauranger och barer i närområdet. Trevlig värd, bra kommunikation och service, smidig in- och utcheckning. Rekommenderas varmt!
This was the perfect place for (3) men.  we all had our own space, coffee, and more importantly, it's was within walking distance from the city center.

Souterrainwohnung in sehr gute Lage, gute Anbindung an die Öffis für Sightseeing, sauber, bequeme Betten, WiFi   gut, TV nicht, schnelle und nette Kommunikation mit Yaz. Falls mehrere Personen: Schlafzimmer ist Durchgangszimmer. Wir würden wiederkommen!

Een brands hoon huisje op een top locatie met zeer gast vrije mensen!
Je komt niks te kort in dit huisje alles is aanwezig.
Well located and well priced airbnb in Prenzlauer Berg 👍 would stay again
Thank you Alina! My family had a beautiful stay in your apartment. They were super happy with everything. Thank you also for being flexible when my cousin ran out of time and a great host in general.

Mimi’s place is wonderful. Very clean & spacious with all the amenities that you need. It is in a lovely leafy location within a 5 minute walk to the station. Mimi is a brilliant host, very easy to contact and very welcoming. We recommend her place.
Muy buen departamente, amplio y limpio. El wifi no era tan beno, pero todo lo demas OK. Buena ubicacion !

This apartment is conveniently located in a wonderful area. The space is spotlessly clean and the kitchen was very clean. The bed was very comfy (and we slept really well - really dark and quiet which made for a good night's sleep)! ideal for a couple, would definitely recommend.

Nice and big apartment with 5 comfortable bedrooms. There’s a kitchen and a big table. Doesn’t have a common area with couches for bigger groups. Apartment is clean and in a convenient location in Prenzlauer Berg.

Que lugar incrível. Lindo, bem decorado, calmo e limpo.
Um verdadeiro paraíso para casais. Becky é Anthony foram ótimos anfitriões, e solicitei um serviço extra e eles foram impecáveis. Não dá vontade de voltar pra casa. Eu recomendo e com certeza voltarei!

Katrin's place is a perfect choice for a couple days long stay in Berlin. It's perfectly located and quite calm. The instructions were very clear and Katrin communicated very kindly. I definitely recommend this place to stay.

I feel that this place is dusty and smelly. It is not very clean as shown in the picture. The smell even stuck on my pyjamas. When he checked me in and before I left, he did not wear an appropriate outfit. Just underwear boxer which I think it is very disrespectful. The place is 8-9 mins walk from the nearest U bahn station.

Barbara was a fantastic host and has truly thought of everything. The apartment is beautiful, as advertised. Would love to stay again!
Thank you so much Barbara!

We loved our stay here! The apartment is spacious, light and nicely decorated. All the necessary facilities are there and it’s conveniently located in the city to visit places. The hosts always responded quickly. We’ll definitely be back!
Gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis.
All queries answered instantly, perfect location just out of the city

Martina was nice, the location is great, the kitchen had lots of sticky surfaces though and unclean dishes in the cupboards. One of the beds was really uncomfortable, the other one was ok, but the pillows should be exchanged, they are really really old and used and not good to sleep on. It’s a nice apartment but in my opinion the prize is a bit too high. The bathroom is nice and big.

Very clean appartment and very easy to access. Do think about bringing you own shower gel and shampoo though. Dirk was very friendly and responded quickly to messages. Thank you again for the stay, it was amazing 😊

We had a wonderful time in a very clean and nicely decorated place with all the amenities you would ever need. It was very quiet and peaceful in the beautiful courtyard and we really enjoyed the rooftop patio.
Great place!
Great stay in a historic building. Very convenient location. Would stay again and recommend to others.
Nice and neat appartment on a good location in Berlin.

Wir haben bei Yannik 1 Wochenende zu 6. verbracht und hatten dort eine tolle Zeit. Die Unterkunft hat unsere Erwartungen übertroffen. Es war sehr gemütlich und sauber. der Pool hat dem ganzen noch die Krone aufgesetzt. Wir würden jederzeit gerne wieder Gäste bei Yannik sein. Perfekt für ein entspanntes Mädelswochenende, um den stressigen Alltag zu entfliehen.
LG Luisa & Mädels 🤗
The house is amazing, clean and with a pretty decoration. It's not far from the city, take just one metro and you'll get there. And of couse Irene is a great person, really kind and polite.
Had a comfortable stay at Julia's lovely apartment. She was traveling at the time and I did not get to meet her. The neighborhood is lovely and Julia was proactive in making sure the stay went well!
Great place to stay. Close to S-bahn and bus stop, shops, bakery, cafes and restaurants. Thank you Rudi!

Ruhige und schnell erreichbare Unterkunft in einer sehr angenehmen Umgebung.
Susanne ist eine wunderbare Gastgeberin.
Es wäre schön, wenn das Badezimmer komfortabler wäre.

El departamento está muy bien ubicado. La zona es céntrica, segura, silenciosa. El departamento esta muy bien equipado y tiene todo lo necesario para pasar grandes momentos. Rainer es encantador y se preocupa por el bienestar de sus huéspedes.
Todo funciona bien y es de calidad. El supermercado más cerca no es tan cerca por lo tanto está bueno planificar las compras. Toooooodo lo demás excelente incluso las tiendas de la zona son de super diseño y muy interesantes. Se puede caminar a todos lados aunque Berlín es grande y también el subte y los colectivos están cerca.
Absolutely loved staying in Mohammad’s home in Neukölln. Mohammad had loads of recommendations, was very friendly and also provided us with lots of privacy. Highly recommend!!!

Jan wait for us in the apartment and gave us a friendly welcome, He left us a chocolate box and wine in every room. The apartment is big,  equipped and clean. There's a nice coffee shops and restaurants around the corner and some nice parks to chill in a sunny day. Easy public transportation in a few minutes walk. nice and quiet neighborhood. We are very recommend to stay at Jan.

surprisingly good
very good for sleeping on the great location

My only advice would be to revamp the bed and the beddings
We seemed to sink in the middle of the bed as the bed base separated into 2 sections below the topper.
A good firm bed base would make the bed more comfortable for a couple.
Very clean and good location, thank you for the stay.
Great space in Berlin! Definitely worth every penny!
ottima esperienza. tutto benissimo.

Accommodation was just what we needed for a busy few days of sightseeing. Great location, plenty of restaurants and a late night ‘bottle shop’ near by. Comfy beds, kitchen good for basic needs. We only used it to make toast and coffee and reheat croissants from the local bakery (recommended).
It’s described accurately, although not sure if the description mentions the shutters which we found on the second night and slept in late the next morning as so dark! Ideal for a short break of sightseeing.

Das Apartment war super sauber und genauso wie auf den Fotos. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und werden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen. Simon war ein sehr angenehmer Gastgeber und hat uns bei allen Fragen sofort geholfen. Die Sbahn Haltestelle ist nur 200m entfernt und man ist schnell in der Stadt. Sehr empfehlenswert!

Was great location, but got different room than expected. Was some stains on the walls and the balcony need some cleaning , was very dusty, also would need some basics like sugar tea and salt pepper , but in general great location and comfortable bed, suggest to everyone. 👌

Superbe appartement très bien décoré. Situé dans un quartier vivant et facile d’accès avec plusieurs station de métro à proximité.
On s’y sent bien.
I had a great stay at Jo's apartment. Very neat and practical. Jo was very kind, easygoing and helpful.

This apartment is perfect! No complaints at all except that I wish I could bring it to any place I travel! The room darkening shades, the pool, the spaciousness, and the cleanliness were particularly wonderful. Our family of five had more than enough space to be comfortable.

The space was like described, nothing special. My friend has an allergy to dust and she was really allergic during our stay but the place looked clean. The shower is terrible as it throws water everywhere and the bathroom floor was soaked.  Apart from this everything was fine. Lars was a great host, communication was perfect. No other issues with our stay.

Die Kommunikation im Voraus lief einwandfrei, der Check-In war seitens Silke flexibel möglich. Die Unterkunft war sauber, bestens vorbereitet und entsprach allen Vorstellungen.
Sehr gerne wieder!

Everything went as planned. Location is as described, amenities near by. Even though we did not meet the host, she responded to every message and was more than willing to help us. I recommend the location.

Karin ist eine unkomplizierte und sehr freundliche Gastgeberin, welche sich flexibel auf die Bedürfnisse einstellt.
Die Unterkunft ist gemütlich, sauber und gut mit ÖPV zu erreichen und trotzdem sehr ruhig gelegen.
Great situation in an interesting neighbourhood. Clean and spacious.
Great stay!
Dusche war nicht ganz sauber, sonst top für den Preis in der Lage
unkompliziert, Reinigung kam sofort wenn etwas schmutzig geworden ist. Für einen kurzen Aufenthalt ist es perfekt.

The property is exactly as described; well equipped small kitchen, lovely clean bathroom with a great shower, comfy double bed and a very nice small living area with a TV! A unique, and interesting place to stay in beautiful gardens, and a great location - very close to transport and the supermarket! Fantastic host, very accommodating in terms of arrival and departure, and easy to get in touch with, really quick replies! Lovely friendly cats as well! Thank you for a fantastic stay!
Zaki+Hanno were so patient to answer each of my questions before arrival. We also had great conversations! The room looks even better than the photos, it was huge.
Sehr unkomplizierter Aufenthalt, hat alles reibungslos geklappt. Vielen Dank!
Astrid is very welcoming! The studio is beautiful, peaceful, and I had a very pleasant stay. Unfortunately, I could only stay for one night but would definitely recommend to stay a  few days!

Canan's apartment is in one of the most fun restaurant and bar-dense neighborhoods in Berlin, right in the middle of X-berg on Görlitzer Park.
The apartment is spacious and has a super comfy living room and the best shower and tub set up I've ever seen in Berlin. The bedroom looks onto a leafy courtyard and is very quiet and has great light.
I spent most of my time during this stay working at the table in the living room, looking out from its beautiful bay window onto the leaves of the trees and the park across the street.
I've stayed in four different apartments in Berlin over the last three years, and this is by far my favorite.

Birte ist eine sehr zuvorkommende, aufgeschlossene, unkomplizierte und sympathische Gastgeberin. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden jederzeit gerne wieder bei Birte wohnen.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist absolut perfekt. Überall schöne hippe Restaurants und Cafés. Birte hatte auch ein paar tolle Tipps.
Das Zimmer ist sehr gemütlich und liebevoll eingerichtet. Es war wirklich ein rundum gelungener Aufenthalt.

It is a great airbnb in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg. The room is very spacious and comfortable. The apartment is relaxed and Katharina is friendly and pleasant to chat to.
I would definitely stay again and would recommend to anyone looking for a room in Berlin.
Die Wohnung war super schön in angenehm ruhiger Lage. Bei Anliegen und Fragen wurde immer sofort geantwortet. Alles top! Kann diese Wohnung nur empfehlen!
Decent Hotel. The bathrooms are  extremely compact. There is almost no privacy. Bathroom's door for rooms 216-218 can't be closed.
Очень мило, чисто и хорошо. Рекомендуем.
Alex ist ein sehr guter Gastgeber, der sich um seine Gäste kümmert.
Todo ok, muy buen alojamiento, con mucha luz y limpio.

Robert was a fantastic host! Superb location; balcony has a beautiful view and the place is very close to tram station. The room and bathroom were both excellent; way more spacious than I initially imagined!
This was my first time in Berlin, and Robert provided me with so many tips to make my experience seamless. Would come back!

Charming place near the city center. Helen's place is a perfect stay for families or groups. If you looking for something special just a few minutes to U-bahn, this is really great. We also find a parking spot nearby. Highly recommended.
Welcoming and helpful host. Spacious flat for two people and good location. Would definitely stay here again.

Wir haben mit Kindern eine schöne Woche in der Wohnung verbracht. Die Lage ist sehr gut und in einem lebendigen Quartier. Rundum hat es gute Läden und Restaurants und auch der Park mit seinen zwei schönen Märkten. Die Wohnung ist sehr gut ausgestattet und die Räume gross. Alles blitzsauber und sogar Tabs für Abwasch- und Waschmaschine stellte uns Monika zur Verfügung. Auch Babybett, genügend Decken und was man so braucht, selber aber nicht mitnehmen kann per Flugzeug. Einzige leise Kritik: Wenn man eher früh zu Bett geht, so ist die Musik von unten (2 Bars) halt schon auch gut zu hören. Rundum ein schöner Aufenthalt!

Highly recommended! Marlene and Gilles are very sweet hosts - they gave great tips about local places to eat and things to do. Very artsy and cozy place - felt like home and I would definitely stay again. Also great location near lots of transport.

+ Great location and very cozy room, although calling it a studio is a stretch. Check-in instructions were clear and everything was easy to find.
- We stayed for two nights and the room wasn't cleaned in between. There was only a pair of blackout curtains on the (huge) windows, so you basically have a choice between the room being completely dark or the neighbours seeing everything.
Excellent apartment in a nice neighbourhood. Highly recommended.
Amazing place!!! very nice style in furniture and lighting. FIVE STARS!!!!
Super appartement, propre et fonctionnel. Bien placé. Convient parfaitement pour 2 à 3 personnes. Hôtes attentionnés.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft mit allem was man braucht und sehr netter Atmosphäre. Alles top 👍

Auch beim zweiten Aufenthalt (als Basislager für Messe) hat alles Bestens geklappt; Fragen wurden prompt beantwortet, die Wohnung easy zugänglich mit Code, Schlafbereich sehr ruhig, und auch flexibler Gastgeber - es war vorab nicht klar ob wir zu zweit oder zu dritt kommen, das ging komplett unbürokratisch! Danke!
Emilia and her son are very nice people. They greeted us and helped us with whatever we needed. The location is pretty far away from Central Berlin. About 50 min. by metro (S/U Bahn).

Saido sorgt dafür, dass man sich in seiner modernen, freundlichen und sehr zentral gelegenen Wohnung von erster Stunde an zuhause fühlt. Er tut alles dafür, seinen Gästen einen unvergesslichen Aufenthalt in seiner Wohnung zu ermöglichen. Professionalität, Perfektion und Menschlichkeit- eine exzellente Kombination. Die Wohnung ist sehr gepflegt und mit liebevollen Details ausgestattet. Immer wieder gerne!
Daniele çok cana yakın biriydi. Ev tertemiz ve sıcacıktı. Konum olarak merkeze uzaktı. Konumdan yana sorununuz yoksa rahatlıkla seçebilirsiniz.

Erg mooi en super centraal gelegen. Schoon en zelfs ruimer dan ik had verwacht. Aardige host. Zeker een aanrader. Hou wel rekening met het traplopen, dus niet geschikt voor mensen die slecht te been zijn.
It’s such a cool place on a very good location. The art and the design make this place special. Big recommendation for anyone interested in atmospheric airbnb stays in Berlin.
Great place, always happy to find a proper airbnb experience. Claudia is great and so is the place. Highly recommend

Small but really practical flat close to the tram station. The flat comes without a kitchen but is still perfect if you search an affordable but clean place to stay in Berlin. We enjoyed our stay and would love to return in the future!
El alojamiento está muy bien ubicado. La habitación es espaciosa, limpia, y estética.
Tolles Appartement mit super Ausstattung!
fantastic location, spacious bedroom, friendly hosts!
Ivo was a great host and the location was great!  Very price worthy
Exactly what we were looking for. Easy communication!

Die Wohnung ist eine Mischung aus Büro und Wohnraum, was aber durchaus seinen Reiz hat und besonders für Leute geeignet ist, die auch froh um einen Arbeitsplatz während ihres Aufenthaltes sind. Die Lage ist super, zentral und doch sehr ruhig. Gleich gegenüber ist ein nette Café zum Frühstücken oder Mittagessen. Einziger kleiner Minuspunkt: Das Bad ist sehr eng, bin aber gut damit zurecht gekommen. Daniela war eine super Gastgeberin, sie war jederzeit erreichbar und hat sich zwischendurch erkundigt, wie es so läuft. Auch ein Rad stand zur Verfügung.

Clean and comfortable place to stay. Dennis was very polite and respectful; Hardly knew we were sharing the space!
The location provides convenient access to train and bus. Would absolutely recommend!

Todo perfecto. Lamentablemente no funcionaba el ascensor. En nuestro caso fue problemático porque viajamos con un bebé y una persona mayor de 84 años. El resto muy bueno, con juguetes, pero sólo con un aire acondicionado. En el resto ventiladores. Muy bien equipado y linda zona
Prima Lage in Lichtenberg mit Anbindung an U- und S-Bahn

Séjour très agréable. Appartement bien situé dans un quartier calme mais avec toutes les commodités à proximité (bars, restaurants, marché couvert, magasins). Accès au métro et au bus très facile pour visiter les différentes parties de la ville.

Meine beste Freundin und ich haben einen Städtetrip in Berlin gemacht. Wir haben nach einer günstigen, ruhigen und netten Unterkunft gesucht. Die Unterkunft von Kathrin ist nicht zu weit von einer Tram-Haltestelle entfernt und für 7€ Tagesticket war die Anbindung in die Stadt sehr gut.
Es hat uns gut gefallen, die Wohnung war mit Tee ausgestattet und mit ein paar Küchenutensilien für einen Snack. Richtig kochen wäre jedoch nicht möglich. Die restliche Ausstattung war gut und 3 Handtücher zum Duschen waren genau richtig. Des weiteren gab es kein WLAN, was für zwei junge Damen ein kleines Problem darstellte. Man konnte individuell die Heizung regulieren, da es uns anfangs zu kalt im Studio war. Alles im allem war die Unterkunft ruhig und man konnte sehr gut schlafen.
Liebe Grüße,
Jule :)
Super nah am Hauptbahnhof gelegen und somit war alles gut zu erreichen, die Wohnung war etwas hellhörig aber hat alles was man braucht🤩
Bel appartement, spacieux, à 3 min de la station Jannowitchbrücke ( direct gare ou aeroport). A proximité des sites touristiques et de certaines discothèque bien connues
Spotless beautiful studio. Had some WiFi problems, but messaged them and it was resolved.

Great apartment! Very beautiful and comfortable!
Better than we expected:)
Everything was greatl! The location was perfect — close to everything we needed. The room was clean, nicely decorated, and very comfortable. We’d definitely love to stay here again
숙소 자체는 좋았어요. 내부도 청결했구요. 근데 카운터 분들이 너무 불친절하시더라구요..체크인,아웃 시간도 너무 애매해서 애먹었네요,,

Great modern, clean and spacious space. They upgraded us with no charge. There was a deck and huge yard space where our kid could play. Also, a park right across the street. Very quiet, safe and hip neighborhood with great restaurants and close to public buses and trains. We would definitely stay here again.
Super emplacement, appartement très propre et calme

Situation combines easy access to the centre of the city whilst also being in an attractive residential area. The apartment is spacious and is located in an older building with lots of traditional character.
The kitchen is well equipped but there are some lovely restaurants and cafes close by.
A fabulous apartment, just out of the city but about 100 meters from the bus stop which runs you into the bustling city and surrounding areas.. lots of choice for bars, shops and restaurants

Perfekt base for at udforske Berlin. Lejligheden er lys, cosy og godt indrettet.
Der er et soveværelse, mens de to sidste senge er i den store stue, hvilket fungerer godt. (Hvis man blot er indstillet på det)
Jeg kan anbefale stedet på det varmeste, og kommer jeg til Berlin med familie og venner igen vil jeg helt klart overveje at booke stedet. 😃👍

Super schön gelegen und sehr ruhig; ein toller Ausgleich zur hektischen und lauten Großstadt…die Ferienwohnung ist sehr liebevoll und individuell eingerichtet und man fühlt sich ein bisschen wie in einer anderen Zeit…toll auch für Familien mit Kindern, da es einiges auch draußen zum Spielen gibt…

Great apartment for a short stay in Berlin.  Central location in Kreuzberg close to public transit.  The apartment itself is functional and has all you need for a short stay.  Jan communicated very well and made the check in and out easy.

Hemos estado muy bien en el apartamento con mi padre, ubicación muy buena y bien conectada.
El apartamento es confortable, lo unico que csmbiaria es la vitro, iba un poco lenta. Un microondas tambien hubiera sido interesante tener.
El resto nos hemos sentido como en casa.
Gracias Ivos por ponerlo tan fácil.

Our stay in Berlin was exceptional start to finish. From getting a neat and clean room to every possible welcoming to use anything in the kitchen, wash clothes, and so on. Burak is a very nice person, I’m sure you will enjoy your stay in his cosy place, right next to the subway and super close to Alexanderplatz:)
Excellent host
一切都非常好！整洁 设施齐全的公寓，友好 乐于助人 非常细心的房东。很高兴可以有机会再来这里。谢谢！

Ein schönes Zimmer in einer hippen Umgebung. Super für Katzenliebhaber.
Der Checkin und die Kommunikation mit Tatjana waren problemlos und ich kann die Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen.

The apartment looked like the pictures.  It was well stocked, and the two of us had plenty of room in the apartment.  We were not cold in the apartment even when it was snowing outside.  The building must be well insulated because we are back in San Diego and cold in our house even though it is warmer than Berlin.  The hot water gets VERY hot, so be careful to not scald yourself.  Our water heater at home is set to 120 degrees fahrenheit (49 degrees celsius) to prevent scalding, but it is set much higher in the apartment.  Julian answered right away when we had questions, and he was very nice.  The apartment is close to the transit station and several restaurants.  We were easily able to walk to the grocery store REWE.
The localisation is incredible, the balcony is in a very animated but quite street. You will truly feel the beautiful spirit of Kreuzberg !
Top Unterkunft mit Stil und viel Platz zum Wohlfühlen.

Jostys apartment exceeded expectations, Fantastic Host , Fantastic Location. The apartment was very clean, all needed amenities included and with spares. We had a fantastic time and could not recommend any higher.

Die Wohnung von Silke liegt wirklich wunderschön, nah am See.
Das gemietete Zimmer sind eigentlich 2 Zimmer.
Alles ist wirklich super sauber und nett eingerichtet.
Das Frühstück war war mehr als perfekt und Silke eine tolle Gastgeberin.
Für uns der einzige Wermutstropfen war das Bett.
Es war uns viel zu weich und wenn einer sich umdrehte wackelte der andere.
Aber Matratzen sind natürlich Geschmackssache.
Миленькие апартаменты для уютного проживания, куда хотелось возвращаться каждый день! Рита и ее муж приветливые и доброжелательные люди, которые всегда рады принять гостей.

Sehr schönes Airbnb direkt bei der U-Bahnstation Berlin Stadtmitte. Es gibt in der nähe gute Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und wer zu faul ist zum Kochen gibts tolle Restaurants in der unmittelbaren nähe.
Kann es nur weiterempfehlen.

well located and convenient spot in lovely part of Neukölln, easy to get around and lots of food options nearby. Room was clean, comfortable and spacious, we didn't use the kitchen or other areas. Barbora and Kai were friendly and welcoming.

Nous sommes restés 4 nuits chez Mike. Il n'y a pas grand chose a faire dans le quartier mais il est très bien desservi en transports. La chambre est assez grande, tout est extrêmement propre. L'absence de volets aux fenêtres nous a vraiment gêné, nous avons été réveillés tous les matins à 6h par la lumière du jour. Mike s'en est excusé et nous avait donné des masques mais ça n'a pas suffit car la chambre est très lumineuse.
Alles bestens
Easy, convenient and clean

Definitely worth the stay and definitely as described.
I was overall happy with everything, but I think it's important that everyone knows what they are getting themselves into.
This space worked exactly as described and I would have stayed longer if permitted... But again, read before you stay as I have AIRBNB'd quite a lot and I know AIRBNB guests don't often read the full description.
The space is big for what you'll find in Berlin (nowhere near the same price), the expectation is to clean after yourself before checking out (helps keeps costs down), and shut the heater off before you go (keep costs down).
All in all, I enjoyed my stay and would stay again.
sehr empfehlenswert!

This was not a good experience on many levels. First off, the apartment was used by other people throughout my parent's stay, including the kitchen and bathroom. Several times they returned to find things had move or dishes/ other messes left behind. This meant they were not comfortable the entire time. And, in the last two days there was no hot water. If you stay here, know that it is not really an 'entire apartment' but in fact a shared space.

We were looking forward to our stay in this apartment and this neighborhood and we were certainly not disappointed with the experience. The apartment is artsy and tastefully decorated .. spacious, comfortable and sparkling clean; the bed is great! We could have not been happier with our choice to stay in kreuzberg.. there’s so much diversity, art, world cuisine (restaurants) and truly cool bars just walking distance (including the metro station ~350 meters)
Our favorite places to eat and drink were definitely in this neighborhood and all recommended by Caroline who was an excellent and thoughtful host. Her list of places to eat and drink are a must ..! Don’t think twice and stay here.. Only piece of advice is that if u bring big/heavy suitcases you’re in for a monumental effort to bring those up the stairs to the last floor where the apartment is ... otherwise it was truly great staying here and would return again ..
The real Berlin experience away from the cliche touristy areas.

Прекрасное место в одной из главных локаций Берлина. Прекрасный доступ к общественному транспорту.
Для тех, кто привык питаться сам эта гостиница не подойдет. Кухонного уголка нет. Вы можете делать чай, кофе, завтракать и ужинать готовой едой, но не более. Для меня лично это не было проблемой, моей жене это-бы не подошло.
Второе замечание - я готов предоставить свой паспорт для процедуры вселения. Но я не был готов к тому, что снимок моего паспорта и мой домашний адрес останется в какой-то базе данных. Я считаю это излишним.
В остальном рекомендую эту гостиницу. Прекрасное место, чисто, уютно, прямо в одной из интереснейших локаций "Западного Берлина". Европа Центер, зоопарк, несколько тематических магазинов сладостей - Харибо, M&M's.. Необычная церковь с историей.
Schöne kleine Wohnung. Alles da, was man braucht. Sehr zu empfehlen!

Jan’s place was great. Cool design, close to great restaurants. There was also a guidebook included that recommended the best local restaurants, which was a great touch! Very happy with the apartment and will definitely return!
War alles super: Schöne Unterkunft wie auf den Bildern gezeigt, gute Lage, unkomplizierte Kommunikation, unkomplizierter und einfacher Check-in und -out. Würde wieder hier buchen.

Such a wonderful room with a lovely family. Very clean and comfortable.
We would definitely recommend and if the family were to have us, we would stay again if we happen to be in the area.
Schöne Wohung in toller Lage!
Everything was beautiful. I met new friends. Thank you.
Facile pour communiquer avec Daniel via WhatsApp

If Gunnar’s home is available during your travels to Berlin BOOK IMMEDIATELY! Do not hesitate one bit! Gunnar was traveling when I arrived but his amazing partner welcomed me and made me feel right at home truly he is a diamond in the rough. The apartment is MASSIVE (and I’m not just saying that because I’m a New Yorker used to small,tiny spaces)and the pictures really do it no justice. It’s far more beautiful,chic & homey! The location can’t be beat total walking distance to all your transportation needs the SBahn will take you to the main train station & a ton of sights. Not to mention there is soooooo much to do right outside the apartment within like a 20 min walk, which as a single traveler I felt completely at ease walking back at late hours. Berlin is magical as is but to stay at Gunnar’s just adds even more to the whole experience. I literally can not WAIT to plan my next visit to Berlin & will book my trip around when the Airbnb is available.
Also to note the bed is INSANELY comfortable you may sleep a little extra I mean vacation is sometimes all about the snooze button & there is plenty of hot water in the private bathroom for showering
You won’t regret staying with them!

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in der Wohnung! Für 8 Personen war es perfekt. Jeder hatte einen bequemen Schlafbereich und mit zwei Bädern hatten wir immer ausreichend Möglichkeiten zum fertig machen!
Der große Esstisch bietet Platz um gemeinsam zu Frühstücken und den Abend zu genießen! Die Lage der Wohnung und der Kontakt mit Fadeih war sehr gut - wir würden immer gerne wieder kommen!
Absolut empfehlenswert. Gern wieder.
Berndt is a very accommodating host and was quite quick in responding to my questions related to the stay
Bescheiden, aber sauber , sehr kleines Badezimmer, keine Geschirrtücher, Steckdosen in der Küche fehlen

Alexander’s place is perfect for 2 people! The location is amazing with tons of great restaurants and bars in walkable distance. The u-bahn is also within a 10 min walk. The house is equipped with some basic cooking tools, although it would be difficult to make a more elaborate meal. Alexander was very responsive and kind. I would definitely recommend this place and stay again next time we’re in Berlin.

This apartment was great. Very spacious and clean. With good transport links to get anywhere in the city. Very close to supermarkets, restaurants and bars.  Ralph was very friendly and communicative and responded timely to any queries I had.

Wunderschöne Wohnung mit tollem Flair. Fühlte sich nach zu Hause an :)
Immer wieder gerne!

The apartment was a great place to stay with lots of character, clean and well supplied. Karsten got in touch as soon as we booked with clear details about how to find it, and when we arrived he spent time giving us lots of good local recommendations. Highly recommended!

Markus's place is such a great place like as the pictures he shared, so clean, very big and peacefull place. He is so responsible host, so friendly, so polite and he is available on mail all the time. We were 5 people and rent there, it is totally worthfull based on our all ideas and we hope if we want to visit Berlin again, we could book there.
well located apartment with restaurants, shops and metro nearby. it was very easy to communicate with Alison and Marcus
Absolutely perfect Airbnb in a great location, peaceful flat with the most fantastic host one could ask for!
Sehr freundlicher Gastgeber und saubere Unterkunft. Leider war das Zentrum durch Bauarbeiten schwer erreichbar.
Sebastian was kind, we enjoyed staying. just recommending:)

Unterkunft entspricht den Fotos. Die "Schlafbox" ist eine platzsparende Lösung, um 4 Personen auf kleinem Raum unterzubringen. Für die wärmere Jahreszeit würde ich wahrscheinlich eher etwas mit Balkon/Terasse bevorzugen. Das einzige Fenster ist ein Schaufenster zur Strasse hin. Belüftung nur über ein Kippfenster oberhalb der Tür möglich.

A clean, spacious ground floor appartment in a very pleasant area. The street is a dead end so no through traffic and it's near a park. Generally well equipped, although there is neither a microwave nor an oven, which made reheating take away food difficult. Tiny but well designed bathroom. Dedicated outside space on quiet courtyard, accessible from bedroom.
Michaela is a proactive host.  The room is located in an exceptional environment, very quiet, yet well connected to the city.  All recommendations!

We spent 5 nights in this apartment. it was spotlessly clean, warm and all anticipated amenities. It's a 5 min walk from Messe Sud in a lovely neighborhood. Very quiet and felt very safe. Is located very close to Grunewald which has a  lovely village atmosphere, street bars and restaurants. We walked through the forest and up the mountain (created from the rubble from WWII)  Teufelsberg which (for an art fan) was a massive highlight of the trip. Such a fantastic place with a fascinating history!   Apartment is ideal location for a break experiencing Germany as well as the highlights of Berlin. We didn't meet our hosts but communication was excellent so if we needed help, we knew it would be there quickly! Highly recommended.
Great location and friendly people working there
Really enjoyed my stay.  Loved the balcony.   Fairly central location to many hip areas.   Abdullah was friendly and great with communication.   Thank you!
Louis well deserves his Superhost status. He's very helpful and available when you need him.

Absolutely loved it, just far enough out of the city so that you get away from the noise but close enough so that it's easy to get there. Loved the kitchen, the house is so fun and well-decorates, felt really homey!

Ich hatte einen kurzen aber angenehmen Aufenthalt! Top Unterkunft die genauso wie beschrieben war.
Gerne wieder!

Great flat, exactly as per the listing and very conveniently located for public transport access. Moe met us upon arrival, went through everything we wanted to know and beyond about the apartment, the area, things to do in Berlin ... A thoroughly nice, easy going guy and a pleasure to deal with.

Bien placé pour les visites mais cela reste une chambre et pas un logement
Quasi impossible d envisager d y manger
Coin cuisine plus que réduit
Pas de table et chaises
Super schöne und moderne Zimmer in Verbindung mit einer super Lage, perfekte ÖPNV Anbindung - äußerst empfehlenswert. Die unkomplizierte und schnelle Kommunikation war super.

Pierre's place was really lovely and he even accomodated us last minute, which was very gracious of him! We had a group of 4 and there was more than enough space. It's an old building though quite modern inside and has lots of charm. Thanks Pierre!
A really beautiful apartment in a fun area of Berlin, everything we were looking for.  Our host provided a great welcome and had taken care of all our needs.  We felt right at home.
Leider war unsere Wohnung dreckig und verschmutzt. PRoblem wurde nur mühsam bis garnicht behoben. Kommunikation schwierig.
This place had a great location near good places to eat and public transportation. Fairly quiet neighborhood and building was quiet as well

Isabelle et Bernd ont été des hôtes très accueillants ! Je me suis presque sentie comme à la maison :) Ce sont des hôtes avec qui il est très agréable de discuter car ils sont de très bons conseils sur la vie à Berlin.
La chambre est comme sur les photos. Elle est très calme et les stores permettent de ne pas avoir une trop grande luminosité le matin.
Le reste de la maison est spacieux et libre d’accès, ce qui est très appréciable.
De plus, il est facile d’accéder au centre ville depuis le logement avec le U6.
Je reviendrai avec grand plaisir chez eux !

Was a great stay for me and my brother as we were out at clubs in the heart of the city centre can walk anywhere you need and there is also e scooters every where out side to get you around would definitely recommend if you’re planing on a weekend stay in Berlin.
Mooi appartement. Eigenlijk een hotelkamer. Allemaal supernetjes. Enige minpunt is dat het buiten nogal stinkt vanwege de markt. Sommigen zullen daar beter tegen kunnen dan anderen.

Gorgeous, comfortable and stylish space! Alex and Danielle are exceptionally kind, responsive and welcoming. I couldn't find a single thing to fault about this place. 100% recommended to anyone looking for a memorable and chill place to stay in Berlin!
Great host, nice and clean apartment in a nice location. Would visit again.
Es un departamento muy confortable y bien ubicado. Muy recomendable.

L'appartamento di Dirk e' l'ideale per visitare Berlino, molto vicino ad ogni mezzo di trasporto, a ristoranti e supermercati. Inoltre e' riscaldato molto bene considerando le temperature rigide della citta'.
Assolutamente consigliato.

Rien a dire, le logement est idéalement placé et parfait pour un séjour de quelques jours !
Un grand merci à Alex pour sa sympathie et la propreté du logement !
Tolle Bewirtung, sauber , liebevoller Umgang , Parkplatz , sehr ruhig ,kann ich empfehlen
Great, stylish space, and in a great location. Not a single thing I’d change.
We loved our stay. Spacious and clean appartment with everything we needed. Would stay again! :)
Good stay and great area
logement dans un quartier agréable, a quelques encablures des lignes de métro permettant de rejoindre l'hyper centre en quelques stations.
Excellent hosts, very convenient smooth check-in/check-out, nice apartments, the train station is very close - easy access to all attractions - five stars in total!

Ottima posizione , mezzi di trasporto molto comodi, zona tranquilla e molto carina vicino al parco, l'unico inconveniente è che un paio di sere nel bar del parco adiacente all'appartamento hanno fatto baldoria fino a tardi...
per il resto tutto bene, spero di ritornarci, un giorno.
Stefan sempre disponibile e gentile.
Renato

Apparemment spacieux et très propre. L’emplacement est très pratique avec plusieurs lignes de métro à proximité.
On peut aisément se rendre à pied à Alexanderplatz.
Hote réactif.

Oliver is very quick to communicate and is extremely accommodating. This location is ideal - it is steps from the train station! There are quite a few things nearby that are reasonably within walking distance: the Berlin Wall memorial (one of them), little cafe, ice cream, bars, restaurants, corner store and more! One downside was the bathroom shower - it is very leaky. Additionally, the bunk beds were a bit noisy and uncomfortable. The living room is bright and large, and the apartment has just about everything you need. Wifi is a bit temperamental, but works for the most part. Thanks, Oliver!
Amazing place to stay :)
자상하고 친절한 Timothy 덕분에 베를린 보다 더 즐겁게 다닐 수 있었습니다.
Van was a really good host. His communication was clear and accurate. The place is just as described. Squeaky clean. The location is great - 5 minute walk to the Sbahn. Would recommend.

Vi havde nogle gode oplevelsesrige dage med udgangspunkt fra Stephans behagelige og godt indrettede lejlighed. Med en fin altan ikke at forglemme. Der var alt vi skulle bruge i en god, pæn og ren lejlighed. Vi kan på det varmeste anbefale den. Meget centralt for transport, butikker, caféer og restauranter. Vi kommer gerne igen.
The apartment was cozy and met my expectations. Although I experienced some delays and issues when trying to connect with the host initially, everything else about the stay was great.

Sonja and her husband are the kindest hosts and very helpful with all my questions. Sonja has prepared a super clean room and the private bathroom is a plus. The place has shown her unique taste and high-quality living style. I‘ll definitely come back!
Die Straßenbahn ist etwas laut. Die Tür sollte man mal reparieren. Ansonsten alles gut. 👍🏼
Andrea ist eine tolle Gastgeberin und die Location ist für einen Messebesuch ideal.
Logement à 2 pas des transports en commun, avec de belles chambres, appartement fonctionnel. L’hôte a été réactif et très sympa, je recommande !

René’s apartment was nice and clean with a cosy and spacious bedroom/lounge. He was an amazing host, and kindly allowed us to check out a little later. Located in a nice area, which was complimented by nice cafes and restaurants. (Apartment is first door on the left when you enter the building - we were unsure about where the apartment was on arrival!) overall would definitely  recommend xD

It was our pleasure to spend an extended weekend here - clean and spacious place, straightforward instructions, quiet neighborhood. We arrived a bit before check-in time and were allowed in once the place was cleaned up, Stephan also offered to store our luggage after/before the stay so we can check the city while we are waiting for our flights. Can't recommend this place enough!
Good location. Close to many bus and train lines. Walking distance to many places as well.

Super Zimmer mitten im Geschehen👍
Total unkomplizierte Abwicklung, sowohl check in als auch check out...
Wir waren sehr zufrieden....

Check-In und Check-Out absolut unproblematisch. Das Zimmer ist etwas kleiner als es auf den Fotos erscheint aber trotzdem sehr angenehm. Die Lage in der Stadt ist fantastisch. Jederzeit wieder.

Rent og ryddig, lett å komme seg til fra flyplassen. Var passende størrelse for vi to som var der, hadde vært mulig å være to til om ønskelig. Ligger i mitte, så det meste man ønsker å se er i gangavstand.
Matthias hadde kommet med en rekke anbefalinger for spisesteder i nærheten, som vi prøvde to av og var godt fornøyde med.

Él dueño nos echo de la casa sin hablar con nosotras por poner música y nos dio 15 minutos para salir de la casa, le dio igual que no tuviéramos donde dormir, fue muy desagradable.
No nos dejo darle explicaciones, nos amenazó con llamar a la policía y bloquearnos.
pretty clean place! nice for a few days stay :)
Apartments was awesome, the flat was cozy and clean. Instructions for check in and leaving are easy to understand

Berlin ist eine Reise wert. Wer bei Louis wohnt, ist zentral und ruhig untergebracht. Die Kommunikation mit ihm kann man nicht besser machen. Das Zimmer ist ein einfaches Zimmer in einer Altbauwohnung zum Innenhof.

If you looking for a flat in Friedrichshain- look no further. This is a gorgeous, very large apartment in a great part of town. Easy access to all the great restaurants and bars in town as well close to U stop and nice walk to Kruezberg. The apartment was professionally designed/remodeled and it shows. Michael was an exceptional host and met us at the apartment and spent sometime with us offering recommendations for Berlin. I highly recommend this place and would stay there again in a heartbeat.
Cool place, felt very Berlin. Worked well for three colleagues travelling together. Simple and quick communication. Close to shops and restaurants.
Alles hervorragend. Gerne wieder.
It was a great place to stay. Its absolutely spotless. I would recommend this to anyone. Though, I wasn't the best guest ever for her. she responded to my texts asap.
Das Appartement war wirklich hervorragend – sauber und in toller Lage mit allem, was man in der Nähe braucht. Ich würde bei meinem nächsten Berlin-Besuch gerne wieder hier übernachten. Vielen Dank 😊

Vielen Dank für Alles. Wunderschöne Wohnung in toller Lage.
Besonders die unkomplizierte Abwicklung hat uns sehr gut gefallen.
Wir waren gern deine Gäste!

I’m very happy we decided to stay at Mia’s apartment on our holiday. The apartment was exactly like in the pictures and the description. It was spacious, beautifully furnished and clean. The location is also practical with good public transportation options. I would definitely recommend Mia’s apartment for anyone travelling to Berlin.
All good and as described.

Un apartamento moderno, bonito y amplio con todo lo necesario para sentirte como en casa. La ubicación es muy buena - hay cafeterías, supermercados y transporte público muy cerca. Amit es un anfitrión estupendo, siempre dispuesto a ayudar, responde muy rápido a los mensajes. Hemos disfrutado muchísimo de nuestra estancia!!! 100% recomendable!!
Danke schön, Amit & Leo!

Le logement est très bien pour visiter Berlin. Il est bien placé, bien desservi par les transports et au calme.
Francesco et sa femme sont très accueillants et ils donnent, et, mettent beaucoup d'informations à disposition pour visiter Berlin.
Je recommande vivement cet appartement.
Alloggio ottimo, in una buona posizione di Berlino 👍🏻
Perfect location, easy check in, clean apartment. Unfortunately, there was not a microwave to warm up the food, but in was ok.

We had a wonderful stay in this new, modern and comfortable studio!
The commutation with the host went smooth, flexible and friendly
Nice clean flat in a good location
Good location and nice place to stay with a small group. Has all the necessities. Would recommend!
Un pied à terre très appréciable pour aller visiter la ville de Berlin. A 50 mètres de l'immeuble d'Andrezj un café très sympa permet de petit déjeuner.
Such a fabulous stay! Great transport connections and a really easy transfer from airport, we also loved how quiet the place was, downstairs bakery was also a bonus!
Clean, nice interior and uncomplicated process. Would defenitly recommend
We had very nice stay and time in Berlin 👍

Nice, in general quite (except renovation works on one of the mornings)

Alles ist sehr sauber, die Küche ist komplett und gut organisiert.
Meine Frau und ich haben es sehr genossen.
Großer Wert für Geld!
Fue una agradable experiencia con una atención amable. 🙏🏼

Martin's apartment was truly the best place for us to spend a week in Berlin. We absolutely loved the location. It's located in a quiet, beautiful courtyard in one of the best neighborhoods, Kreuzberg. There's beautiful streets and plenty of coffee shops and bars surrounding the apartment building. (Checkout Admiralbrücke and Klunkerkranich for sunset!) Easy walk to the subway and a couple supermarkets nearby. I worked remotely from the airbnb for a few days and had a great wifi connection. Although there isn't AC, we didn't need any in mid-June as the apartment stays very cool, even with days in the 80s!
Martin provided brochures and maps with local recommendations, and he met us at our check-in time to give us a quick explanation of everything. He provided plenty of extra towels in case we needed them, and the kitchen had a few spices ready for us to use for cooking.
When I return to Berlin next, I'll be back! Highly recommend.
