Zoek niet verder, dit appartement heeft het allemaal: ruimte, fijne bedden en een balkon en zeer centraal gelegen, bijna aan het Hackense Markt s-bahn-station. Supermarkt vlakbij en allemaal fijne restaurants in de buurt! Supergenoten, we komen graag nog eens terug

Caroline's place is in a great location, very walkable to two nearby 'metro' stations, and the cool bohemian vibes of the shop front and interior add to the overall charm. The kitchen is small, but why cook when you've great doner kebabs and currywurst virtually at your doorstep? All bedding was impeccably clean, and the shower had great pressure. The rooms are in fact much bigger than the photos can represent. The front (i.e., at the shop window / entrance) dual curtains are good at blocking out light and noise -- but really, the street is very quiet during normal sleeping hours. I wholeheartedly recommend a stay at Caroline's place!

Stephan and his wife were lovely hosts, quickly to reply to help with directions and went above and beyond to help our needs of check-out times, so we could leave our bags and carry out our morning seeing the last bit of Berlin. Maps and books were available to read and use during our stay and the whole flat is stylishly decorated and has a great feel! A lovely couple with a beautiful flat!! Well worth the money if you are in Berlin.
Heel goed appartement, ruim en schoon. De buurt was ook super, bereikbaar en veel te doen.

We had a wonderful stay and it was perfect for a weekend in Berlin. Having two beds with two separate bathrooms was a luxury. The stairs to the down stairs bedroom are not for the faint hearted but still sufficient to get up and down 😃
The highlight were the many coffee options and how much there was of it 🙌🏼
The place is a perfect walking distance to Eberswalderstr. which was perfect and made it easy to go do things 😊
Nassa was very responsive and he gave us some local recommendations, which was nice 🤩

Logement très pratique et agréable, hôtes très arrangeants, quartier sympa alentour ( Bergmanstrasse avec au bout bon caviste :très bons vins allemands ), l'excellent "mustafa gemuse kebab", le curry 36, un tas de choses qu'on n'a pas expérimenté.

Tout est idéalement organisé, de façon très compacte mais efficace. Tout est sur place. Le contact avec Numa reste "virtuel" mais très direct. C'est un lieu très pratique, avec une prestation très professionnelle.
房间和床铺干净整洁，卫生间也十分干净，接待处工作人员态度友好，会向朋友推荐这个地方
What an amazing deal. Sparkling Clean, friendly and courteous hosts, great (and SAFE) neighborhood.  So glad I stayed here. You'll be glad too ;)

Staying at Mike’s place throughout my trip to Berlin was just wonderful! Though the stairs are certainly a doozy, the pictures don’t do the space justice. It’s gorgeous, and being able to have coffee on the little balcony each morning was a lovely way to start my day.
The next time i’m in Berlin, i’d love to spend it at Mike’s again! Thanks for the great time!

It's a very good flat with everything you need in a perfect location, very close to nice shops, galleries, museums, flea markets, and etc. Izabela was a super nice host, she was friendly and very flexible about the checking in hours. I'd totally recommend this place to anyone who comes to see Berlin for the first time!

Lovely apartment in a great location. There are many good breakfast and lunch options nearby. A garage is available at the other end of the building around the corner, and it is well connected to the apartments via a long passage to the elevator. You just need to inquire about availability and pricing in advance.
Guillaume and Lena are great hosts and we would love to come back if we visit Berlin again.

Where do we even start! Never have I had a host like Hardi! He was so friendly and welcoming and made us feel at home. We had lots of privacy but we loved nothing more than a chat with him! The accommodation was much better than photos and it’s fair to say Hardi showed us the true spirit of Berlin.
We definitely will use his services again when returning to Berlin.
Had loveliest time staying at Ellen’s apt as it had everything we needed and more!
Great place, Great Host!

We enjoyed our stay at Serhat’s very much. The house has modern kitchen, bathroom, beddings, washing machine, dishwasher and wifi, there’re also free car park spaces outside the house.
Serhat and the family live very close by, so was very easy for us to communicate our needs.
There’s a supermarket 5 mins walk away.
Danke again for welcoming us.

Both the apartment and location are ideal -- I can't imagine a better place. The space is roomy, airy, quiet, and very clean. The shower and mattress are both excellent -- I find that these two things often make all the difference between an ok and excellent stay.
One caveat: do not book if you mind walking up four flights.

Ich hatte einen superschönen Aufenthalt in Bertas stylish-gemütlicher Wohnung. An- und Abreise haben optimal geklappt. Ich fand es sehr nett, dass Berta mir extra noch angeboten hat, den ganzen Abreisetag die Wohnung zu nutzen. Das Zimmer hat ein großes, sehr bequemes Bett und einen Balkon. Die Lage ist ideal, wenn man eine Veranstaltung im zu Fuß 5 Minuten entfernten Estrel-Hotel besuchen möchte. Die Wohnung ist auch nur eine Minute zu Fuß von der S-Bahn Station Sonnenallee entfernt. In der Nähe gibt es ein paar sehr nette Restaurants, Kneipen und Cafe´s und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.
Berta ist eine tolle und inspirierende Gastgeberin. Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und werde, wenn ich wieder nach Berlin kommen, auf jeden Fall versuchen, wieder bei ihr wohnen zu können.

L'appartement de Natalie est très très bien situé. Tout est parfait, nous avons passé un excellent séjour. Natalie est disponible pour répondre à nos demandes. Tout est parfait. Nous reviendrons bientôt !
Birgit ist eine sehr nette Gastgeberin und stets erreichbar. Wir hatten einen guten Aufenthalt in dem niedlichen kleinen Appartement, welches so war, wie beschrieben und auf den Bildern zu sehen

The place was just ok. It was clean, easy check in, but felt it’s a bit expensive relatively to what we got.  The pillows are not suitable for sleeping - maybe it’s just us.. either way it’s a good flat but the host needs to improve small things like: better pillows, softer sheets and towels. Again, maybe we have high standard.. don’t know…

A localização era ótima, próximo da estação de trem. Conseguimos estacionar na rua do apartamento. O apartamento era aconchegante e muito bonito, porém, não muito cômodo para três pessoas, considerando que o sofá cama não formava uma cama. Sentimos que falta um pouco de manutenção no apartamento, pois a roupa de cama estava furada.

Wir habe für 4 Nächte in der Unterkunft übernachtet. Die Wohnung liegt ruhig mit einer sehr guten Anbindung an den Öffentlichen Verkehr.
In der Nähe gibt es außerdem viele Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.
Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und das Zimmer groß.
Es hat uns sehr gut bei Thorsten gefallen und wir können die Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen!
Gerne wieder.
second time in this apartment - both times was every perfect :)
Always Super!
Fantastic apartment in a great location. Would definitely stay there again if I'm back in Berlin.
Such a great stay and a great host!
wird sehr empfohlen
Alles super, tolle Lage und sehr gemütlich.
Nice place
This was the perfect place to explore Berlin. The kitchen and laundry and private access elevator only made it better.

Een super fijne plek om te verblijven. Mooi schoon met alles aanwezig wat wij nodig hadden. De locatie was ook perfect; een rustigere, maar gezellige buurt, wat erg makkelijk te bereiken is. Seb was erg aardig en heeft ons meerdere tips gegeven voor leuke eetgelegenheden in de buurt. Wij waren met 4 vrienden en zouden hier zeker nog een keer terug willen komen!

Hat alles wunderbar gepasst 😊 Die Wohnung ist sehr groß und gut gelegen.
Leider war es sehr kalt in der Wohnung, aber es stehen mobile Heizungen dafür bereit.

Die Unterkunft liegt sehr verkehrsgünstig. Die Haltestellen (U-Bahn, S-Bahn, Tram) "Warschauer Straße" liegen in unmittelbarer Nähe. Des Weiteren kann man auch in der East Side Mall sein Auto sehr günstig (10,- EUR/Tag) und sicher abstellen. Die Kommunikation mit Tamara ist extrem positiv, hilfreich und freundlich. In der Nacht findet man, auch unter Woche, wirklich Ruhe. Nur startet der Tag um einen herum täglich sehr früh (nichts für Langschläfer). Ich könnte mir vorstellen die Unterkunft erneut zu buchen.

Beautiful place, just right for us both. We we’re within walking distance to shops, landmarks and the U-bahn, found a really nice vegan/veggie restaurant close by also which was perfect for us. We had an amazing stay and we will be returning and would recommend...

Benjamin’s flat is ideally situated only a few minutes walk to the U-Bahn station. The food suggestions from the host were fantastic and the flat has everything you would need for a short city stay. Benjamin is a very accommodating host and we have no problem fully recommending to anyone looking for a cosy Neukölln flat.
Ben and Julia.
房子的位置很好，离查理检查站很近，同时能够方便地到达地铁站。我们还在屋子里发现了一本这栋老房子的小册子。有一天晚上热水没有了，经过房东的沟通协调第二天热水供应恢复正常了。我们在此度过了愉快的柏林之旅。
Great hotel!

Un peu cher par rapport à la prestation.
Bien situé dans quartier calme
Alles war perfekt 😉
GREAT location! walking distance to a ton of bars and restaurants.
Fantastic location and very spacious apartment. Minimalist decor but well equipped & easy to walk to multiple tourist locations.

Die Wohnung ist zwar architektonisch sehr schön und bietet einen tollen Rundblick über Berlin, leider lassen aber Sauberkeit und Zustand der Einrichtung sehr zu wünschen übrig. Hier bräuchte es dringend eine Generalrenovierung und eine Grundreinigung, anders wird man auch der Ameisenplage in der Küche nicht Herr werden. Wo man hinsah und hingriff war - mit Ausnahme des Bettes - alles schmutzig und klebrig.
Besonders ärgerlich war, dass erst unmittelbar vor Schlüsselübernahme kommuniziert wurde, dass der Lift (immerhin 6. Stock!) nur mit Fingerabdruck funktioniert und daher von Gästen nicht benutzt werden kann. Vor Ort stellte sich heraus, dass dies schon seit Monaten so ist, das hätte also schon viel früher kommuniziert werden müssen. Noch ärgerlicher dann, dass eine freundliche Person uns den Zahlencode für den Lift verriet- vom Vermieter bekamen wir den nicht!

Flora ist eine super liebe und herzliche Gastgeberin. Die Wohnung ist sehr gemütlich eingerichtet und es ist alles vorhanden. Gerade die Küche und das Bad sind super ausgestattet.
Die Lage ist super. Zum Schlafen und Entspannen ist es sehr ruhig und man ist sehr schnell mitten in Berlin. Entweder fährt man zwei Minuten mit dem Bus zur nächsten S-Bahn-Station oder man läuft einfach die 5-6 Minuten. Von da aus ist man in nicht mal 30 Minuten mit der S-Bahn am Brandenburger Tor.

The apartment and location were really good, was great value for money. The location was fantastic, with underground and bus stations really close by. The only thing we had a slight issue with was that the shower drain smelt quite a bit, but we let reception know and they said they would look into it.
the place was very clean and the reception guy very gentle, everything was perfect
Good place for short stay, friendly staff, nice bar lounge area.
Philip always responded quickly to any inquirement I had, the place was lovely and i had a great time- would highly reccomend it!

We recently had the pleasure of staying at Johannes’and Hannah’s magnificent apartment, and can't recommend it highly enough! From the moment we arrived, we were captivated by the modern and stylish decor that perfectly combined comfort and luxury. The apartment was impeccably clean and well-maintained, which made us feel right at home.
The location is unbeatable—situated in charming Neukölln with easy access to local attractions, shops, and restaurants. Despite being centrally located, the apartment was wonderfully quiet, providing a peaceful retreat after a day of exploring the city.
One of the highlights was the stunning view from the balcony, which offered a perfect morning breakfast spot. Johannes was incredibly attentive and responsive, ensuring that all our needs were met and offering excellent recommendations for things to do and places to eat.
If you’re looking for a place that exceeds expectations in every way, this is it!
Thanks so much for your hospitality :)
Clement fue de lo más servicial. Su apartamento está muy bien conectado. La habitación es muy luminosa y acogedora. Un placer alojarse con el! Repetiremos 🤙

Die Wohnung war sauber und mit allem ausgestattet, was man für einen Kurztrip braucht.
Die Lage der Wohnung war super. Die U Bahn lag direkt um die Ecke.

Check in und check out liefen problemlos. Nils war bei Rückfragen über die App meistens erreichbar. Die Unterkunft liegt eine kurze Straßenbahnfahrt vom Alexanderplatz entfernt und bietet dennoch eine vergleichsweise ruhige Lage, auch an Silvester. Die Wohnung war sympathisch eingerichtet und hatte fast alles war wir brauchten. Nur das Wohnzimmer war zwischenzeitlich bewohnt, weswegen wir uns dort nicht aufhalten konnten, was wir schade fanden. Ansonsten top, können wir nur weiterempfehlen!
In der Küche gibt es nur eine begrenzte Ausstattung , um sich etwas zu kochen. Ansonsten sollte man kein Problem mit Fluglärm haben.

Julia's place is absolutely amazing and in a great location if you are looking to explore or work in Berlin. Very clean and modern apartment with everything you need for your time in Berlin.
Julia is also an incredible host who is very responsive and helpful and I would highly recommend staying at her place when ever in Berlin. I know I will be back for sure.
Barbara was very helpful, she responded very quickly and was very welcoming. The apartment was very clean and in a perfect location!

Mega kreative Unterkunft, da kann ich mich den Vorrednern nur anschließen, Frank ist außerdem extrem hilfsbereit und kann tolle Empfehlungen für die Umgebung geben.
Die Wohnung ist extrem „echt berlinerisch“ mitten im Kiez gelegen, kein Tourismus-BlingBling. Sondern authentisch.
Was mich am meisten begeistert hat… Stille… die Wohnung liegt im Hinterhaus und in der nacht haben wir mit offenen Fenstern geschlafen. Ich dachte zwischendurch wir sind aufm Dorf 😂
Lieber Frank: weiter so!
Hotel confortable très bien situé et très calme et l'accueil est sympa.

Fantastisches Appartement in Mitte. Wir waren mit unseren beiden kleinen Kindern dort und haben die Zeit sehr genossen. Parken kann man direkt vor der Haustür (kostenpflichtig), in der Nähe gibt es genug Grünflächen und Spielplätze (die zwar immer einen gewissen Berliner Flair haben, aber für die man natürlich dankbar ist). Wir würden die Unterkunft immer wieder buchen und haben unsere Zeit in Berlin und bei Carolin sehr genossen.

Wir sind super happy :) Flexibler Check-in (das Zimmer war schon ready um 10:00) und Check-out um 15:30 kostenlos
Die Zimmer super und die Betten bequem. Die Lage auch top. Wir kommen zurück! :)

Très joli appartement, fonctionnel et bien placé. Simon s'est montré clair et réactif, proposant un départ flexible.
Je recommande vivement cette adresse !

Très grande chambre, cuisine et salle de bain très pratique. Et emplacement idéal pour accéder à tout Berlin.
Katharina est adorable et nous a donné de bons conseils pour Berlin.

Our stay was perfect! The apartment is beautifully decorated, super comfortable and had everything we needed. The location was wonderful, just a short walk to the shops and public transport. The neighbourhood felt very safe also. The hosts were incredibly helpful and responded to any questions we had almost immediately as well as providing local recommendations which was very appreciated. I cannot recommend this apartment more, we will definitely stay again!
The room is quite nice! And the facility is very good! I’m so happy to stay here. If there are slippers, that will be better! Btw, the cat is sooooooo cute!

Ich hatte einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt im Apartment der Josty-Brauerei und kann jedem nur empfehlen bei einem Berlin-Aufenthalt dorthin zu gehen! Die Lage ist sehr zentral und dennoch ruhig und schön zu erkunden. Im Umkreis befinden sich jede Menge Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und die Verkehrsanbindung ist zu jeder Tages- und Nachtzeit sehr gut.  Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber, groß und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Ich war sehr begeistert und würde immer wieder dorthin zurück kommen!
Super ausgestattete, gemütliche Wohnung. Kommunikation und Check-In haben super geklappt. Wenn ich mal wieder in Berlin eine Unterkunft brauche, werde ich sicher wieder versuchen hier zu buchen.
Had such a great stay at christoph's place. Met me with the keys to check in and was very responsive when I needed him! Would recommend!

Oliver's apartment is beautifully decorated and quality furnished, and perfect for a couple. The apartment is a loft type, with kitchen, dining table, sofas, TV and bed are all in the same space....but it is really really very spacious. Everything was new, great bathroom, and big and supercomfortable bed. The kitchen is really well equipped, and Oliver and Olga were so nice to leave milk, bread, coffee, tea, butter, ... Also communication with Oliver and Olga was great and friendly making everything easy for us. You can tell that they truly want you to enjoy and be happy there.
Being our first time in Berlin, we though that maybe we were not close enough to the city centre, but this is only an advantage, because in Berlin you are always going to need to get the train or underground -or use one of the handy city-bikes- and we liked the non-big-city feeling of the area, and it also has a very nice vibe. The apartment is in a quiet place, but 5 minutes walk from lots of restaurants, bars, etc..
We would repeat at Oliver's apartment next time in Berlin, eyes closed!
We really recommend Oliver's apartment for anyone's stay in Berlin
Very clean. Has everything u need

This place was perfect for us. Lovely neighbourhood with cafes, restaurants etc. Great location close to all main sights by bike or transport.
Hosts were super friendly and helpful and always gave quick responses.
Would definitely return here! Thank you for a lovely stay.
Excelentes anfitrion fue Fyno y hospedaje impecable. Muchas gracias!!

Beautiful place with THE BEST PILLOWS în the world.
Just one thing, please put a table to eat! We ate on the floor.
Wir sind in Carolas Appartement mehrfache Wiederholungstäter und kommen sehr gerne immer wieder! Alles top und sehr nett, wie immer!
Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt. Besonders die Kommunikation zum Anbieter lief reibungslos und schnell! Wir kommen gerne wieder
Perfect stay, highly recommended 😊
Clean place, as described and shown on the pictures. Good connection to the city centre. Walking distance to the S bahn and grocery store.

This is such a great apartment - comfortable and well thought out. The bedroom and bathroom space felt generous. We had a family of four staying and it was fine for space - we even had family members round and managed to get six of us around the table. Comfy beds, great shower - everything you need! Communication with Volker was also fab, friendly and helpful with easy check in.

Plain excellent and troublefree experience! Lisa answered to any questions I had prior to arriving in Berlin, so I never doubted that things didn't work out. The appartment was minimalistic and clean, bright and convenient, it was pure joy to walk/bike back home just minutes from 'Mitte'. Close to the central station as well, so it was a bliss to get back to the airport Tegel. My wife and I had a great weekend, thanks for the hospitality, Lisa :-)

Tolle Wohnung mit einem super Blick über Berlin. Die Dachterrasse lädt einfach zum Verweilen mit einem Gläschen Wein ein. Wir haben uns von der ersten Minute an sehr wohl gefühlt.
Die Wohnung war sauber mit klaren Anweisungen.
Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder.

The apartment is as described. It has all the necessary things to spend a couple of days. Check-in was very easy and the neighborhood is really nice. Metro station is around 6-7 minutes' walk from the apartment. It has a supermarket just 2-3 minutes walking distance as well.  I would recommend it for 1 or max 2 people.

Me and my girlfriend spent 4 nights in Berlin at Sabines place. She made us feel at home and comfy. The location is great as well, with various cafes and restaurants, parks and bike rentals just around the corner.. Thank you for the pleasant stay :)

Everything about this place was wonderful. The apartment was clean, cozy, and the host was easy to reach and responsive.
Because the weather was warm, I opened the window each night for some fresh air. During weekdays this worked beautifully, cool and comfortable. However, on Friday and Saturday nights, noise from people talking and shouting in the street and the nearby restaurant came through and made it difficult to get a full night’s sleep.
Still, it was a lovely stay overall and I’d recommend it to others who enjoy city energy and don’t mind some ambient weekend sounds.
Thanks for being a wonderful host!
Spazi ampi, bagni e docce top. Oltre ad ogni migliore aspettativa. Luogo tranquillo e accogliente.

Great place, go there!
Nice and very comfortable apartment.
Near the subway, to shops, to pubs.
Friendly neighborhood.
Everything as expected. The place is clean, bed is comfortable  and room is nice and dark. its very close to the airport and to the U-bahn.  The host is very friendly and easy going.
숙소 근처 음식점도 다양하고 베를린 중앙역과 가까워 교통도 편리합니다
L appartement est tres propre et tres bien placé .

Un petit appartement de pratique accès dans un quartier calme et sécurisé. Le métro U8 est à proximité pour rejoindre les attractions principales de Berlin.
L’appartement peut être brouillant le matin quand on prélève les poubelles. Nous sommes ravies de notre séjour.
Villa Hühnchen ist eine kleine Oase. Liebevolle Details, ein toller Garten, ruhig und nah am Wasser. Für alle, die Entspannung suchen - genau das Richtige. Katrin ist eine tolle Gastgeberin!
Beautiful, modern flat on a quiet street in Prenzlauer Berg. Safe location and close to the park. The flat is small, but very clean and has everything you need.
Logement super propre, super beau et dans un quartier génial.
Nice place in a very lovely neighbourhood, would go again! Very equipped kitchen, overall very cozy place!
Alles spitze!
We hebben het fijn gehad in het mooie schattige Zweedse huisje. Gezellig, schoon, klein maar fijn.  Gunstig gelegen om Berlijn te bezoeken.

I loved our stay at Mia‘s place. The location of the accommodation is great. The apartment is cozy. And it was super clean, I wish all Airbnb apartments were like that. I really recommend this place to stay.
It might get a bit hot in the upper part of the loft in summer. But there’s a small fan that helps a lot, so we did not suffer even during the extreme heat in Berlin 🫶🏻
Nice location. Basic ground floor unit. Quiet.

This flat is in our favourite area of Berlin and you can walk around to lovely shops, coffees, restaurants and parks. The hosts were really nice and accommodated our check in and check out and helped us storing our luggages after checking out. The flat is really airy and there is a lot of natural light, the building is quiet and lovely. The flat is pretty basic - there is just the necessary to stay, I personally would have liked a little more furniture like a small bed table to put water and phones during the night, or some chairs or table in the living area to hang our clothes bags and jackets, but my boyfriend really liked it plain and simple as it is so I guess it's just personal taste! The beds are really comfy and the shower works well. Overall good stay!v
Gut geschnittener, ruhiger Fabriketagenteil im Hinterhaus, unweit vom Kottbusser Tor, mit allem was man braucht. Eingang durchs Vorderhaus ist etwas grottig aber ok.
Recomiendo este hermoso Apartamento amplio, buena iluminación, y muy completo, sin duda alguna volveremos, tuvimos unas hermosashermosas vacaciones en Berlín

Excelente! Muito melhor do que nas fotos. Apartamento espaçoso, localização central, muito limpo, bem equipado, perto do metrô. Lisa é uma ótima anfitriã, sempre disponível a responder qualquer dúvida.
Andrea est très accueillante et généreuse. Le logement est proche de la gare Messe Süd
War alles super. Komme gerne wieder.
Apartment was clean and has everything you need for short or long stay, host was very welcoming. I’ll be happy to come again

Excellent location right by the U-bahn and tram, walking distance to many places and some good food in the area! Julie was extremely helpful and responsive throughout our stay, and we loved the charm and homely feeling to her place. Would love to stay here again when we return to Berlin!
Very good apartment in a great location, host was prompt with replies to queries.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft, einfacher Check in. Wir würden jedes Mal wieder hier her fahren.
thank you for everything, we had a really wonderful stay.
Great apartment, nicely decorated and furnished. In a quiet building and laidback area but close to good cafes, restaurants and transport around Berlin. Recommended.

I lived in Constantin's apartment for three months. The apartment is very well located in the heart of Kreuzberg, with great restaurants and cafes. There are also supermarkets nearby, and the subway is a four-minute walk away. Despite being in bustling Kreuzberg, the area surrounding the apartment is quiet. The room is spacious and comfortable, as are the common areas, and the apartment has its own charm thanks to Constantin. It was also nice sharing the apartment with Constantin; he respects your space and is always available if you have any questions about the city. Therefore, I highly recommend Constantin's apartment, especially if you're staying in Berlin for a few months, as I did.
Das Apartment ist genau wie beschrieben. Lage, Sauberkeit, Ausstattung und Kontakt alles Super. Dort werden wir auch in Zukunft gerne unsere Gäste einquartieren.

Super logement ! Très bien situé, très propre avec tout ce qu’il faut !
Nous étions un groupe de 14 personnes et tout le monde était ravi de séjourner dans ce logement.

We had the best week in Berlin! Martina was so so nice and helpful during check in. The location is incredible - so close to the lively Mauerpark (best spot for sunsets), and only a short distance to the centre of town. Coffee shops and restaurants literally right outside the door. (But the apartment itself is set back from the road so it’s very quiet) A bookstore across the street!! The apartment was beautiful and has everything you might need. Grocery stores very close so cooking is a great option! Main tram line also very close. Only thing to keep in mind if you have mobility issues is the 7 or so flights of stairs. But otherwise, truly, if you want the best time in Berlin, you must stay here! :D

Very professional and helpful when we checked in especially with our luggage since it is on the 2nd floor. Augustin shared some information regarding the city. The location is perfect and the apartment is exceptionally cozy. Everything is great except the lamp in the dining table is not lighting up enough as one of them is not working , pls repair immediately, thanksp

Wir waren im November 2023 zu viert in der Unterkunft von Fabian. Auf den ersten Blick scheint die Unterkunft soweit ok. Auf den zweiten Blick entdeckten wir im Untergeschoss im Schlafbereich auf gesamter Länge der Außenwand im unteren Drittel Schimmel.
Leider gab es zusätzlich kein warmes Wasser in dem gesamten Apartment, was wir dem Host natürlich auch mitgeteilt haben, damit dies verbessert werden kann.
Beim Betreten der Wohnung wurden wir außerdem von einem unangenehmen Geruch überrascht.
Der Kontakt mit dem Host war dennoch freundlich, aber es gab leider keine Aktion bzgl. der Mängel.
Wir persönlich würden das Apartment nicht mehr buchen. Wenn die Mängel beseitigt sind, würde unsere Bewertung anders ausfallen.

Overall a well situated place in East Berlin. Not too far from Potsdamer Platz and a few museums to the South East. Clean and well provisioned.
Only let down was the lack of assistance from the staff when we faced a problem with the room.
If you want a clean and decent space for a few nights I would recommend.
Easy checkin easy to find nice to park and good apartment - just like described and the AC was really nice to have. Bathroom looks amazing rest is a little small but definitly alllll you need :) 5/5
Excelente localização. O Thiago ainda teve a amabilidade de me deixar sair depois da hora do check-out
Joerg was very welcoming and responsive, staying here is a must, a unique experience and an accommodating host!
Very nice, enjoyed my stay!

Ich habe eine schöne Zeit in Minas Appartement verbracht. Es ist alles da was man braucht. Das Appartement verfügt über eine kleine Terrasse und hat einen eigenen Eingang! Die U-Bahn ist fußläufig erreichbar. Ich würde meinem besten Freund diese Unterkunft empfehlen!
Tolle Location direkt in Friedrichshain. Modern eingerichtet, sauber, in der Küche alles was man braucht. Einfacher Zugang direkt von der Straße - trotzdem ruhig. Gerne wieder!

Sehr sauber und schön gemütlich eingerichtet. Martin antwortet immer innerhalb von ein paar Minuten, wodurch der Check-in/-out um einiges leichter war. Vor Ort gab er uns mithilfe von Broschüren und Fahrplänen noch Tipps und Tricks, um unseren Aufenthalt noch besser zu gestalten! 👍🏼

Das Zimmer befindet im Dachgeschoss des Hauses und hat nebenan eine kleine Küche und ein neues hochwertiges  Bad. Der Kontakt mit Hellen war sehr herzlich. Eine kleine gemütliche Unterkunft um Berlin zu erkunden.
El lugar es muy amplio y lindo para quedarse, está cerca del aeropuerto pero es un poco difícil acceder a él como tourista. En general muy buen lugar para descansar

Martin ha sido un gran anfitrión. Todas las indicaciones y recomendaciones nos vinieron muy bien. El apartamento estaba muy ordenado y se correspondía con las imágenes. La zona es céntrica, con mucha vida, restaurantes, supermercados, parques y bien ubicada para moverse por la ciudad. El vecindario es tranquilo y silencioso. ¡Sin duda volveremos!

Perfect location ideal for exploring different neighbourhoods and sites in Berlin. We had a lovely big room and a very generously sized bathroom. The fittings and furnishings very tastefully decorated to a high standard and a very attractive feature was the  natural exposed brickwork in the room. We had a great terrace which we couldn’t enjoy unfortunately due to the freezing cold weather but would be fabulous in summer. We’d definitely stay there again.
Ramfis was super responsive and helpful
Had a great stay! The place was very nice, clean, and stylish. The  hosts were very helpful.
Good, clean home in heart of Berlin

Stella was really lovely and communicative. The area is so fun and interesting and there's something to do on every corner. Would definitely recommend staying here with friends as the property has a very fun atmosphere!

Ich hab mich sehr wohl gefühlt! Als lärmempfindliche Person habe ich vor allem die Ruhe geschätzt. Zwar liegt die Unterkunft an einer sehr befahrenen Strasse, aber die Fenster isolieren sehr gut und das Zimmer ist auf der Innenhofseite. Auch keine Geräusche von Nachbarn!
Great apartment in a lovely part of Berlin, close to everything you could want!

Das geschmackvoll und modern eingerichtete Appartement im Souterrain, mit großer Fensterfront, befindet sich in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße mit wenig Verkehr in gehobener Wohngegend. Eine kleine, gemütliche Terrasse lädt zum Verweilen ein.
Carola ist eine freundliche, aufmerksame Gastgeberin. Ihr Frühstück ist großartig, abwechslungsreich und liebevoll hergerichtet. Wir haben uns dort außerordentlich wohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder!
Die Lage ist ideal zum Erkunden der schönen Gegend um den Schlachtensee. Der Wannsee und Potsdam sind nicht weit entfernt und einen Besuch wert.

Leo and Gareth are super cool, helpful, and very laid back. They made us feel at home, and gave great recommendations. We got everywhere we wanted to in the city quickly from the apartment, which was spacious and comfortable.
The room was a little noisy but fine for medium-heavy sleepers.
We’d definitely book again.

Good:
- much space (for 4p at least)
- nice beds
- huge bathroom
- nice neighbourhood
Not so good:
- noise from neighbours and outside
- not much diningware
- very nice shower but not fully functioning
- just one key; you can’t lock the door while someone is still inside

The pictures don't do it justice. it's so bright and is well planned. It's small but works great for 2 guests.
Great to have a decent
hairdryer as we were backpacking and I didn't want to be packing a hairdryer.
The bathroom works but curvaceous bodies may struggle with the size.
It's on the ground floor, not far from the main entrance door which you can hear everytime residents enter.
It can be quite noisy with other apartments above. This was the main downside to our stay but overall we were very happy here and location was perfect. we loved Kruezberg, the many restaurants and cafes especially the food market.
Victoria Park is beautiful and a nice walk.
The underground is a short walk from the apartment.
we would return.
I loved the place, 30 mins by tram to the city centre. Felt at home. Would recommend and repeat. Kristina is the best! Hugs x
Unterkunft ist sehr unkompliziert. Gastgeberin sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Unterkunft liegt etwas außerhalb. Mit dem Bus 142 sind vom Hbhf. aus ca. 4 Stationen und dann 3 Minuten zur Unterkunft.

We cannot rate this apartment highly enough! The apartment is beautiful, clean, and quiet.  It is very close to multiple modes of public transportation, grocery stores, and a major Berlin shopping area. The host was kind and responsive.  We come to Berlin often and would love to stay here in the future.
Tolle Wohnung, super Ausstattung, total einfache Abwicklung! Gerne wieder!
Everything went smoothly.

appartement bien placé
et fonctionnel
l'ajout de rideaux pour augmenter l'obscurité la nuit serait plus confortable
Perfect location in the heart of Kreutzberg

Wat een geweldige ervaring in het huis van Pablo en Sven. Het huis is ontzettend sfeervol ingericht met veel aandacht voor detail. Ook heel compleet ingericht, van alle voorzieningen in de badkamer, de schone slaapkamers, tot de zeer uitgebreid uitgeruste keuken, aan niets ontbrak het. Ook zeer veel drinkwater aanwezig, we kwamen niets tekort. En dan heb ik het nog niet eens gehad over de geweldige tuin, wat een groene oase! Heerlijke plek en absoluut een aanrader als je eens in Berlijn bent.

Pobyt jsme si užili. Byt byl čistý, útulný a v dobré lokalitě. Hostitel byl milý a komunikace probíhala bez problémů. Jediné, co nás trochu překvapilo, bylo to, že se jedná o sdílený byt. Z popisu to nebylo úplně zřejmé. Postel také trochu vrzala, ale nebylo to nic zásadního. I tak byl pobyt v pořádku a děkujeme za ubytování

Der Aufenthalt bei Luisa war für ein verlängertes Wochenende genau richtig. Ein längerer Aufenthalt wäre für uns ohne Küche und dem kleinen Zimmer eher ungemütlich.
Zum Bad kommt man nur durch Ihr Wohnzimmer, war aber unkompliziert.
Luisa war sehr freundlich und hat uns auf Nachfrage auch weiteres Geschirr gegeben.
Alles war sehr sauber und gepflegt.
Sehr praktisch ist auch der eigene Eingang in das Zimmer.

Wunderschöne, liebevoll eingerichtete und gemütliche Ein-Zimmer-Wohnung. Ausgestattet mit allem, was man braucht. Sehr ruhig gelegen, man war aber auch schnell zu Fuß oder mit sehr guter öffentlicher Verkehrsanbindung Mitten im Trubel. Die Gastgeber waren sehr freundlich und gut erreichbar. Wir würden bei unserem nächsten Berlin-Aufenthalt gerne wiederkommen.

Für 2 Personen mit Hund gute Unterkunft, mit Kaminofen. Ich hatte nur nicht bedacht, daß ich zum Schlafzimmer eine Stiege hoch musste und mit meiner Hüfte hatte ich etwas Probleme. Das war aber meine eigene Dummheit, das Bett und unter dem Dach war das Schlafzimmer super.
Great spot. Quiet and peaceful
Great place to be! Clean, good beds, good shower. Nice environment. East-Berlin is so amazing. Full of creativity. Carmens bikes are very good. We cycled a lot.

Prima Unterkunft, direkt am Wasser und mit einem schönen Blick auf die Müggelspree, um Berlin zu erkunden.
Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Nähe und gute Anbindung mit der S-Bahn zur Stadtmitte.
Die Wohnung ist sehr großzügig ausgestattet und bietet viel Platz. Sehr nette Gastgeberfamilie.
Clean, good location, laid back.
An excellent place to stay!

Edi’s place felt like our very own Berlin apartment. It is fabulously located , an easy walk or train ride most anywhere in the city. The apartment is very large and our family of 4 had plenty of room. The building is very new and has very nice underfloor heating so is very cosy. There is a small terrace for warmer weather. The bed is huge and very comfortable. We enjoyed our stay there very much.

Kommunikation und Check-In haben wunderbar problemlos geklappt! Für die Sauberkeit haben wir ein paar Punkte abgezogen. Angebunden war die Wohnung ganz gut soweit. Man hat Nachts seine Ruhe und ist trotzdem in 45 Minuten vom Haus bis in die Berliner Innenstadt mit Bus und Bahn gekommen. Insgesamt hatten wir einen guten Aufenthalt!

Es ist alles so, wie beschrieben und Angela ist sehr flexibel und freundlich. Die Lage ist für Berlin zentral und durch Verkehrsmittel gut erreichbar. Dennoch habe ich persönlich die Zeiten für Wege , vor allem während der "rush-hour",  unterschätzt. Das hat aber nichts mit der Bleibe an sich zu tun. Einfach mehr Zeit als auf Apps angegeben einrechen, du bist in BERLIN!

Die Unterkunft von Chi hat uns gut gefallen. Es handelt sich um ein Büro mit einer kleinen angeschlossenenen Wohnung. Trotz der zentralen Lage war es sehr ruhig. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und kommen gerne wieder. In der Küche ist alles vorhanden, was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt von einigen Tagen braucht. Für die Dusche sollte man allerdings einigermaßen schlank sein, sie ist recht eng. Das Bett bzw die Schlafcouch steht in einem separaten Raum und ist absolut traumhaft.
Die Wohnung ist für 4 Personen perfekt. Wir waren viel zu Fuss unterwegs und fanden die Nähe der Potsdamerstrasse fabelhaft. Bushaltestelle U-Bahn - alles ganz in der Nähe. Was will man mehr!

Good apartment in a nice neighborhood, you have tram, u-bahn and s-bahn just a few blocks away, so you can reach any point of Berlin easily. Supermarket just in front and lots of restaurants near by. The kitchen is a little small but we managed to cook something. We had a nice stay in Berlin!

What a gorgeous apartment! My partner and I LOVED our stay. There were so many thoughtful details such as a welcome video explaining exactly how to access the building, lovely breakfast items and Netflix etc with a big TV and a comfy sofa. Also really close to public transport and easy to explore! I would definitely stay here again.

Es war sehr bequem und sehr schön.
Preis Leistung aufjedenfall gegeben
Everything was perfect. Definitely next time I will stay here again.

We were very happy with the Airbnb in particular the bedrooms were all of good size and the beds comfortable. The kitchen was very well equipped and the lounge area nicely furnished. We would happily reccommend the apartment to our friends.
We were a bit disappointed there was a late check in charge as we were very limited to flights. Our recommendation would be to install a key safe.
Sehr gute Unterkunft, die man gerne empfehlen kann!
Wonderful flat in a great location. Alexandra was a great host!
Geweldig verblijf gehad in hartje Berlijn! De kamer was keurig en van alle gemakken voorzien! Wij zullen Numa zeker als plek aanbevelen en onthouden voor onze volgende vakanties.
Great and peaceful place
Die Wohnung und die Lage sind einfach nur mehr als top. Die Wohnung ist schön ruhig, auch wenn sie mitten im Kiez liegt.

Ik en mijn vriend hebben genoten van het verblijf. Je zit wel wat meer in een buitenwijk, maar dat is juist niet erg. Op de korte sirene geluiden van ambulances na was het heel rustig. Twee supermarkten en een metrostation zo om de hoek. Super handig!
Sehr sauber, aber deutlich kleiner, als es auf de Bildern gewirkt hat.
The apartment is fantastic, very spacious, bright, tidy, clean and well decorated. Communication with Canan has been perfect and the stay was unbeatable, highly recommended! :)
Super Unterkunft. Sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung. Supermarkt gleich neben an. Zentral gelegen. Sauber und ordentlich.
The apartment felt really spacious and very stylish. Great feature are the blinds that create pitch black bedrooms.

Kristina and Felix are some of the most authentic and warm people I've ever met. My friend and I were visiting Berlin for the first time and they were great guides and provided helpful advice at every step. They responded quickly when we had questions about the place and the amenities. The room is very cozy and clean and the rest of the apartment was very welcoming. Lastly, the cats made our stay extra sweet with their cuddles 😻 Would love to stay here again when I'm in Berlin next!
Florian ist ein außerordentlich aufmerksamer Gastgeber mit einer einzigartig besonderen Wohnung mit viel Geschmack fürs Detail. Zudem war es sauber und ruhig, die Lage top direkt an der M2

We had a lovely stay at Amir’s house. It provided everything we needed for a (short) stay in Berlin. Communication with Amir was quick and easy and he was obliviously very willing to help if needed. We weren’t much around in the house, because the city kept us busy, but it was always a welcoming place to come back to.

The men's restroom in the basement is heavily defaced with graffiti (the cubicles), and the urinal buttons are also heavily soiled.
The mirrors there are broken, and the
electrical outlets are broken.
The room itself was perfectly fine for the price. The attached bathroom (without a shower) was simple but acceptably clean.

Die Unterkunft war gut. Sehr sauber,frische Handtücher und frische Bettwäsche. Anweisungen waren klar. Die Kommunikation war auch gut. Das Bad ist auch sauber und hat eine schöne Dusche. Parkplatz ist auch dabei!
Eine schöne Unterkunft, die ich mit gutem Gewissen weiterempfehlen kann.
Sie ist etwas weiter weg von Berlin-Mitte, aber in Berlin-Marzahn kann man auch einiges erkunden. Wie das Schloss in Berlin-Biesdorf und den Park Gärten der Welt,mit Seilbahn. :)
Wir hatten ein sehr entspanntes Wochenende in Berlin.
LG Shazeeb Hussain

Beste Airbnb Wohnung die wir bis jetzt hatten!
Die Ausstattung ist neu, hochwertig und sauber. Die gesamte Unterkunft ist mit RGB LED ausgestattet und eignet sich sehr gut zum Relaxen. Eine sehr brauchbare Bluetooth Box steht für den Musikgenuss zur Verfügung und die mehr als vollständig ausgestattete Wohnküche lädt zum Essen kochen ein. Die zwei Schlafzimmer können vollständig verdunkelt werden, um so nach einer längere Partynacht entspannt ausschlafen zu können. Die Wohnung liegt in einem ruhigen Wohnviertel und die nächste S-Bahn ist 2-3min zu Fuß entfernt, Taxis zu den Clubs der Stadt kosten um die 20 Euro, was völlig im Rahmen ist. Christoph ist ein toller Gastgeber der immer für seine Gäste da ist und sehr gerne behilflich ist. Wir kommen wieder!

Very well situated, just a block or two from small town center with grocery store, cafes, bakeries.  Basement room with separate bathroom, which you have to access by walking through a non-private space (bathroom is not attached to the bedroom).  Bed is adequate, and there is a basic setup with coffee machine and espresso pods.  No fridge.  Tina was very responsive for getting access.

Très agréables si on veut être à proximité de tout !
Si on souhaite être seule et tranquille ce n’est pas la bonne solution mais pour nous deux qui sortions beaucoup et n’étions pas à l’appartement c’était parfait

La calidez de Katarina nos encantó, muy amable y dispuesta a resolver nuestras dudas, nos dejaron unas galletas y unos refrescos alemanes para recibirnos que nos encantaron, la limpieza del lugar fue excepcional, abajo habia cafeterias y en frente una tienda de abarrotes que tenia de todo, puedes llegar caminando al East side gallery.
Debido a que es una calle muy concurrida el ruido de los coches se escucha hacia las habitaciones pero es muy tolerable.
Gracias Katarina fue un placer conocerte y hospedarnos en tu propiedad :)
Nice and responsive host.

This is a great place to stay when passing through Berlin. Great neighborhood and easy access to public transportation to take you to different parts of the city. The place was comfortable and check in was a breeze. Would recommend, thanks Julius!

klein ,aberKlein, aber für zwei Personen einigermaßen akzeptabel, und das Wichtigste ist, dass es in jeder Hinsicht brauchbar ist. Es gibt nur eine Anmerkung: Die Straße, in der sich das Haus befindet, ist vollständig mit gebührenpflichtigen Parkplätzen bedeckt.

Kirsten’s flat was spectacular! The hard wood floors, high ceilings, chandeliers, and balcony overlooking a street full of character. The location is perfect and within walking distance of so many restaurants, bars, and shops (Kirsten has great suggestions)! A fully equipped kitchen met all of our needs during our stay! We couldn’t say more good things about it. ❤️
The apartment was really nice. Everything was super clean. Due to the fact that the apartment is in the back there is no noise from the street. It was really great!
A basic yet big room, with everything you need for a short stay. Great neighborhood, between Gorlitzer Park and Landwehrkanal.

Nena Apartments is situated in a really good location, close to Kreuzberg main streets and just a five minute walk away from lots of shops and restaurants, as well as the Ubahn and bus stops. The bedding was light which suited the hot weather, and our double room provided us with two duvet covers each, both very clean and comfortable, which the bed also was too.
The apartment is small but all you need for a short city break to Berlin. The kitchen is well equipped with everything you might need to cook yourself a meal. The bathroom had a nice large working shower, but the room did have a lingering ‘bad smell’. This can easily be ignored, especially if you don’t spend a lot of time in the apartment like us.
I would recommend staying here for two people and i really enjoyed my trip!
Good place to stay in Berlin with amazing location and cleanliness
Carmen is very friendly. We had a quiet, peaceful visit. It felt like a little oasis in Berlin. Thanks, Carmen!
greaat stay, great communication when we haad problems,  coumfy beds
Nice appartment, good location
A good stay for a city break to Berlin, we loved the location of the apartment and found the whole check in/ out process really smooth.
L’appartement était incroyable et la vue juste magnifique !

Meine beiden Teenager-Töchter und ich haben ein paar Tage bei Marion gewohnt und uns hat es dort rundum gut gefallen. Wir waren mit Öffis unterwegs und haben von Marion dazu detaillierte Tipps bekommen, sodass die Orientierung einfach war. Besonders gefallen hat mir der Blick ins Grüne. So konnten wir uns abends gut von der Berlin-Mitte-Hektik erholen.

отличная однокомнатная квартирка на территории частного дома. отдельный вход, перед входом столик со стульями, где можно приятно провести время за чашкой кофе утром или бокалом вина вечером. квартира чистая, в кухне есть всё необходимое, в ванной - мыло, гели для душа, фен, полотенца. в комнате для сна одна большая двухместная кровать и раскладное кресло. есть диванчик, обеденный стол, всё отлично. но было прохладно. отопление есть, но в тот момент было слабым. возможно, если бы мы об этом сообщили хозяйке, она б сделала потеплее, но мы не стали её тревожить. нас почти не было дома. в остальном очень рекомендую. очень тихий район, ничто не мешало. спасибо за уют.
Wunderschöne ruhige Lage, nette Gastgeber, schöne Einrichtung - was will man mehr…
Logement agréable, propre, bien chauffé, calme et bien équipé, situé devant la station de métro . Adapté pour nos deux familles ( 9 personnes en tout) .
Excellent apartment
Hello thanks for your reception. We had past good moments in Berlin.
Espectacular piso, su ubicación y su equipamiento. Estuve por trabajo y fue realmente cómodo para atender reuniones y para trabajar desde allí. Muy recomendable!
Very lovely stay, as described. Great offer with parking option in central Berlin location. Only negative would be the early check out time.

Airbnb was nice and clean. The place was clean and neat. Beds were fine and we enjoyed our stay.
Only thing was that everything was quite far away. So you can’t easily walk to places.
Public transport was close by.
Great stay, highly recommended

Cosy and central place. Agustin and Holger are very reactives and easy-going communicant !
I recommend !

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt bei Julian. Er selbst war im Urlaub. Das Einchecken hat dennoch reibungslos geklappt.
Die Wohnung ist sehr hell, gemütlich und großzügig. Das Bett ist sehr bequem und die Lage der Wohnung ist relativ ruhig besonders unter der Woche. Die belebte Bergmannstraße mit ihrem reichen Angebot an Restaurants, Cafés und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten ist nur einen Block weiter. Klare Empfehlung!
It is a wonderful sparkling clean apartment    And the great experience .  We really loved it and the host was really nice
Great place, nice host!

This is a great airbnb and Henrik is a great host! The location is amazing - close to all shops, grocery stores, drug stores, attractions, cafes, restaurants, and even the u-bahn station. The neighborhood is my favorite in Berlin and it’s beautiful during the day and quiet at night. The apartment is on the first floor so there are just a few steps to walk up if you have luggage. The apartment is perfect for solo travelers and two people, just enough space. We didn’t use the kitchen too much but it also has everything you might need. Henrik is very responsive as a host, he helped solve two problems we had during our stay and was very kind and understanding. The apartment itself, of course, is also very beautiful. Highly recommended!

Had a wonderful time staying here. Very spacious room with your own personal balcony and a personal bathroom to use. Regina and Alexander are both very friendly and were accommodating to all my needs. The place is also in a beautiful neighborhood and right next to a metro station that’s central to Berlin. Would definitely recommend !
Tranquilo y bien comunicado
meine freundin und ich haben uns sehr willkommen gefühlt bei andrea. der check in war sehr persönlich und freundlich. das zimmer war angenehm ruhig, frühstück im garten war super!
Neta's place was very comfortable for us for the weekend, in a great location. Neta was available and helpful whenever we had any kind of question/request. Thanks a million!
Fantastic flat in a area well suited for families with kids. Highly recommended.
Very comfortable cute flat! Perfect place to stay if you are either relaxing or sight seeing around Berlin. Would definitely stay here again!
Excelente ubicación, buenas amenidades, bonito lugar

The Space is little than I’m the picture
There’s a red alert light That does not turn off at night
We enjoyed our stay, thanks!

Very weird. Loud music coming from all side of the unit. The bathroom has a see through door so the neighbours and everyone outside can see right in to the shower. Had to put a sheet over the bathroom door to get privacy. No TV. I could never get the dryer to actually work and the shower would flood all over the bathroom so I was constantly cleaning that up.
However the location is great. Transit that time you right down time is directly out front.
This place definitely needs some updating and just general fixing.
Отличное жилье, по хорошей цене. Очень удобная локация и комфортные условия. Большое спасибо!

Pani Erika to bardzo przyjemna gospodyni. Mieszkanie znajduje się w podpiwniczeniu. Dostępny jest  cichy ogród z żółwiem oraz innymi mieszkańcami (np. jeże🙂). Spokojna i cicha okolica. Fajne miejsce, szczególnie jeśli ma się samochód. Gospodyni była bardzo pomocna. Szczerze polecam.

Obwohl die Wohung ein bisschen entfert liegt, kann man immer noch mit Tram, S-Bahn und U-Bahn innerhalb einer Stunde das Stadtzentrum erreichen. Sehr angenehme Zimmer, geeignet für 2 Personen. Der Preis ist auch ganz günstig. Der Vermieter ist sehr nett und freundlich. Empfelenswertes Angebot für diejenigen, die Berlin erkunden wollen.

Wirklich eines der besten Airbnbs in denen ich je war. Das Bad ist ein Traum mit der großen Badewanne und moderner Einrichtung. Zu zweit ist es definitiv die perfekte Wohnung. Im Hinterhof hat man seine Ruhe und ist trotzdem mit Bus und U-Bahn schnell im Zentrum. Wir werden bestimmt wieder kommen!
Было приятно встретить русских хозяев жилья в Берлине :) комната сделана с душой, очень приятный и интересный интерьер !
Great place - clean and cozy. Excellent localization. Everything was just perfect.

We had a great stay at Stefen place , except that one day someone opened the lock of main door and walked in thankfully I was inside the house and then the lady quickly walked away apologising. But it raised questions on the security and safety . Other than that we had a great stay at apartment . Would love to stay there again.
Easy links to the metro and lots of food places around! Spot on for a big group going on a city break, would definitely recommend for the price!
Eine erstklassige Wohnung und Gastgeberin. Unkomplizierte, schnelle Kommunikation, exzellente Ausstattung und Lage. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Alles bestens, nochmals danke.
Very nice host and was actually great to meet him and have a little chat at the place which made us feel more welcome. Overall a great stay, the place looks and feels great, danke Hans!

Albert is a very responsive and accommodating host who lives in the neighborhood. He was a delight to work with. The apartment is centrally located, a few steps away from a bus stop from which one can easily get to the subway and connect to other buses. If one prefers, the walk to subway stations are very close. The neighborhood is in the West, so it is quiet -- very close to Viktoria-Luiza Platz. The balcony is lovely, and the kitchen comes fully equipped (including fresh fruit waiting for us). There is a a big bed (for 2) in the bedroom, and then a couch that pulls out to become a double bed in the living room for another 2. Bathroom is very clean. I liked that the windows open so there is a lovely breeze. I would definitely stay again.

This was a great place to stay for me and a friend while we completed a workshop nearby.  Everything was new and I particularly appreciated the hot shower and new hob and oven, which were both exceptional. The location couldn't be better with lots of restaurants nearby, and the train station - Ostkreuz - a pleasant 10 minutes walk away. You are also located well for Uber trips to the rest of Berlin. Nicolette was very responsive and helpful.
The experience was excellent, far beyond expectations! Very spacious and elegant areas. Everything was extraordinary.
Logement atypique , belle localisation au calme. Lits confortables. Grande surface. Nous avons apprécié notre voyage.
Our stay on Lucas’s house was really great. Everything was perfect and we could work remotely with no problems. The home was comfortable too, definitely we will came back any time

I couldn‘t recommend Norbert‘s place more! I had the pleasure to stay here for a month after I moved to Berlin. I couldn‘t have hoped for a warmer welcome to the city.
Norbert is an extremely helpful and thoughful host, and his place is full of beautiful details (my favorites were the extremely well curated DVD collection and the books laying around).
Norbert‘s place is filled with gorgeous art and everything you need, made me feel right at home.
The appartment‘s location is perfect, and the neighbourhood is very quiet and full of things to see.
I can‘t thank Norbert enough for such a wonderful stay.
El alojamiento esta muy bueno!
Tolle Wohnung,  nahe Olympiastadion. Sehr sympathischer Kontakt. Wohnung top eingerichtet. Gerne wieder!!
Wunderbar angenehme Gastgeber,  ruhiges und gemütliches Zimmer, alles super fein. Komme gerne wieder.
Very comfortable bed, not too far from the train. It is a cool place behind the building so no people walking around. Comfortable, only stayed two nights. I would stay here again :)

Wonderful, spacious and comfortable appartement and a warm welcome by Lucia herself. Nice location in an area that I hadn't explored that much before. Parking in front of the door and easy to head back home via the main roads, instead of crossing the whole city. I would definitely recommend this place to people!

Nice apartment located close to the subway.
It's perfect for people who enjoy walking in Berlin.
There are a few supermarket around the corner and a traditional German restaurant close by.
Very nice for a weekend.
The appartment was exactly as described and equipped with everything we needed.
velmi vhodné pro můj pracovní pobyt, rád jej znovu využiji a jiným doporučim.
Lovely place on an excellent location. Mario is great host and it was pleasure to stay in his place.
fantastic location near u-bahn station, very cleanly and the hosts were very communicative. A bit pricy but very worth it!
Great place, quiet area while still under 20 minutes from Berlin's centre in Tram. Would definitely recommend to anyone travelling to Berlin.

The apartment was really nice and looked exactly as described. Wonderful neighborhood. The only downside was the internet - the "Dongle" was completely useless. If you don't need internet this is the perfect apartment.

nice place to stay.
bit expensive
lacks parking
but good place to stay.
highly recommend

Super relaxed and comfortable, homey appartment! It's located in a surpsingly fun and interesting part of the city, just outside the more touristy part of Friedrichshain. We stayed with five people and used both bedrooms as well as the sofa bed in the living room and all had pretty comfortable nights. The room in the back is the most quiet one, the ones in the front are ok as long as you keep the windows closed (very thick glass) but if you like to keep the windows open you might find it a bit noisy. Also, you can faintly notice the smell of cigarettes in the living room so if you are sensitive to that you want to be aware of this if you plan to also use this room for sleeping. Facilities are great and there are lots of nice shops close by and if you don't mind walking a bit an infinite number of good and interesting restaurants and other places to go. Public transport is closeby as it says in the description but you will need to negotiate a few crossings and/or traffic lights so if you plan to use the appartment as a hub throughout the day this might get be something to consider. Overall really good value and would definitely book again. Thanks Yves!
Wir hatten zu dritt ein schönes langes Wochenende in der Wohnung. War alles tip top.
Alles super. Sehr empfehlenswert.
Great location, nice place for a family stay!

Excellent apartment. it’s 20 minutes from the city center with a metro.
Clean a beautiful rooms and bathrooms.

Lovely apartment. Spacious and furnished quite well
Noisy at night with people hanging out

I had never stayed in this area of Berlin before (I have usually stayed in or around Prenzlauer Berg on previous visits) but the location in Reinickendorf was perfect, easy to access public transport (U-Bahn & bus) to Mitte, Prenzlauer Berg and Hauptbahnhof and beyond. The apartment was spotlessly clean. It is an attic apartment so it got extremely warm during the recent heatwave, there is no air conditioning apart from an electric fan but that’s a minor issue in my opinion. You may need to wear ear plugs (there are some on the bedside locker) as the apartment overlooks a busy street. I did wear my own silicon ear plugs and managed to sleep like a baby. The bed is very comfortable. The kitchen and living area overlooks a lovely courtyard. Mina was very pleasant, helpful and gave me plenty of good local recommendations. Nearby district of Wedding has plenty of good restaurants and it’s worth having a drink at the Café am See Schäfersee. I would be happy to stay at Mina’s place again.
Our stay was excellent. Host was responsive when we had questions and everything went well. Can’t beat it for the price
Tolle Unterkunft, um Berlin zu erkunden. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt. Daniel war sehr hilfsbereit und bemüht. Wir hatten eine super Zeit!
很棒的公寓，的有電梯、浴缸、洗衣機、烹飪用具，所有日常生活所需的用品，公寓裡都有。還很貼心的準備紅茶包和咖啡粉，環境乾淨又安静，通風、明亮，車站、超市就在附近，Sven的回應又即時，推薦給所有想去柏林體驗生活的旅客。

We had the best time in Berlin staying at Stéphanie's apartment. Mitte is the place to be while traveling in Berlin. She was so helpful and met us on our arrival. We had everything and more than we needed accessible at the apartment. Thank you so much!

Zum 2.mal vor Ort und alles TOP :)
gerne wieder!
Absolutely no issues.  The stay went perfectly.  Thanks!
Tágas, nagy lakás! 12-en kényelmesen elfértünk! Serhát nagyon jó házigazda! Jó környéken van! Közel van a buszmegálló S-bahn, U-bahn! És közel van az Aldi, Lidl! Csak ajánlani tudom!
Sonja ist eine tolle Gastgeberin,  die mich sofort wie zu Hause hat fühlen lassen! Sehr gerne wieder.
It was a good place to rest after exploring the city for a few days. Thank you :)

Perfect base for our long weekend stay to celebrate NYE in Berlin. It was clean, peaceful and cosy, with lots of natural light, and Etienne’s beautiful art hung up all around the apartment. Etienne was very friendly for check-in and very responsive via message, and other than that, it felt like we had the place to ourselves the whole time. Within easy walking distance of convenient public transport and local shops/restaurants.
Gutes und schönes Airbnb im Sommer ein bisschen warm im Schlafzimmer
귀여운 고양이 두마리를 볼 수 있어서 행복했습니다 ㅎㅎ 저희의 사생활을 잘 보장해주셨어요. 필요한 것들을 친절히 설명해주셨고 무엇보다 출입문이 따로 되어있어서 편했습니다.  안에 화장실이 따로있는 것도 그렇구요! 멋집 집과 친절하신 부부덕에 잘 머물다 갑니다:)

Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und ruhig gelegen. Trotzdem waren diverse Restaurants und die s-bahn fußläufig in maximal 15 Minuten zu erreichen. Dadurch ist man auch ohne Auto schnell in die Innenstadt gelangt. Parkplätze sind in der Straße auch gut zu finden.
Die Gastgeber sind sehr nett gewesen, der check-in hat reibungslos funktioniert, es wurde immer nach wenigen Minuten auf Nachrichten geantwortet.
Also ist alles stressfrei abgelaufen.
Really good borough and flat!

Mina's hostel is a good place for a mid-long stay in Berlin. The studio is large, has a nice equipped kitchen and it's near the U8 metro station; in 15 minutes of metro you can arrive in Alexsanderplatz easly. Unfortunatly during my stay there was serial problems with the Wi-fi connection, nowdays is a big problem for foreigners with no german telephone card. Mina tried to solve the problem but she doesn't succed during my stay. Overall I would recommend this hostel, the price-quality ratio is very good.

Wir waren zu viert in der Wohnung für ein paar Tage und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Sehr sauber und alles soweit vorhanden für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt.
Wir waren mit dem Auto vor Ort und das Parkplatz suchen war etwas schwierig. Aber so Zentral in Berlin gelegen ja auch normal... ;)

Tolle Unterkunft in super Lage!
Die Wohnung ist schön geschnitten, gemütlich und geschmackvoll eingerichtet – man fühlt sich sofort wohl. Die Lage ist ideal: In der Nähe gibt es einen Park, Restaurants, Eisdielen und viele gemütliche Cafés – perfekt, um Berlin zu erkunden. Der Kontakt mit dem Gastgeber war sehr nett und unkompliziert. Klare Empfehlung für einen Aufenthalt in Berlin – wir würden sehr gerne wiederkommen!

Toni is excellent host. Very helpful. I was along lots of questions before we came and she was so good in her answers.
She is very helpful. Flat is great. Good location. Plenty of things in the kitchen. Highly recommend
Good value for the price of the flat. But the Air bb service charges generally are becoming more and more difficult to accept which is NOT a reflection on Toni and the flat
Excellent flat
Perfect little place for a Berlin getaway with everything I needed. Lots of good cafes and restaurants in walking distance as well as different train stations close by.

Muito espaçoso, camas confortáveis, cozinha bem equipada e lindos tapetes orientais na decoração. O apartamento no fica no térreo, uns poucos degraus abaixo do nível da rua, mas é possível abrir as janelas.
A localização é excelente, estação de metro com três linhas e vários ônibus disponíveis bem próximo.
el apartamento está en una zona céntrica con buenísima conexión a transporte público. el apartamento está nuevo y limpio y los anfitriones fueron muy amables
New and modern apartments, fully support when i have any requested
Great stay for an entire week. The appartment is spacious and very well located. I would recommand for sure
A very nice place in Weissensee. Good breakfast. Talkative host who could tell stories about what it used to be in the old times before the wall was torn down.
Lovely space.  Very good location (very close to all useful transport links) and clean and comfortable studio.
Great Stay with Thomas!
Eine superschöne Wohnung, die hervorragend angebunden ist.  Ich habe mich außerordentlich wohl gefühlt und komme sehr gerne wieder!

Feras's apartment is nice and clean. The room is very basic, but considering the price this is ok.
The location is very good as it's super close to the SBahn, the airport and the Humboldt university.
My only note is that by the listing it looked like the living room was supposed to be a shared space.
Instead, there was always someone sleeping on the couch there. While I didn't mind, as I wouldn't have used it anyway, I just found it a bit misleading.
But in general, everything went fine!

The apartment is super cozy, clean and beautiful. The train station is very close and you only need a couple minutes to the city center. Barbara and Alessandro are so nice and friendly and their Bistro has awesome vegetarian Italian food, coffee and wine. The next time I'm in Berlin I will definitely stay there again and highly recommend this place to everyone.
Very friendly host. Beautiful apartment

Looking for a stylish yet affordable place? Then come here at Mike’s place. It has complete amenities, clean, has good food shops below and 20 to 30 minutes near Central. Mike is accommodating and makes sure the guests get the stay they deserve.

My first ever airbnb experience and I have to say it was over my expectations! The place was very neat and cleaned, but most importantly Stefanie was all around amazing in every single way possible and ALWAYS helped with any questions which felt very reassuring! Not only did she help me but she was also very fast at responding :) Very kind host that I would love to book from again in the future! The area which the hotel is located felt very safe and had lots of places to go and visit! I didn't use the train but it's very close as well!
The place even had a mini refridgerator with freezer which I absolutely loved because there's no kitchen available! So you can still buy food from stores or refridgerate bought food! The only downside was no microwave or kettle (I'm a tea lover) - but I managed to stay without my tea for a week because everything else was amazing! :) My experience was 10/10 and it would without a doubt be 15/10 if a microwave and a kettle existed! Thank you Stefanie!!
Steckdose im Bad funktioniert nicht
Un appartement agréable dans un quartier vivant. Très bien adapté à une famille pour découvrir Berlin car proche des transports en commun.  Hôte très réactif.

Für heisse Tage ist diese Wohnung im Keller eine günstige Wahl .Sie hat leider nur ein Fenster. Der Preis ist  okay und es gibt Park Möglichkeiten vor dem Haus. Busstationen sind gleich in der Nähe, eine Bäckerei auch.
Danke. War sehr gut! Gerne wieder

The house was great! Even bigger than I expected. Perfect location in the neighborhood - next to cafes, bars and two grocery stores. I thought at first that it was a little closer to the city center than it was, but it was an easy way over by train which isn’t far from the house. It’s a nice quiet neighborhood.
Sören was very friendly and easy to deal with, accommodating and helpful. We had a great stay 😊

A great central location with old Berlin traditional large rooms and high ceilings.  Great restaurants in the area, including in the ground floor of the building! We were a family of 5 and enjoyed staying at this place.  It suited our needs perfectly
Sauber und ordentlich. Ich werde wiederkommen

Chris was responsive and accommodating. I was able to check in early and get some rest after traveling all night. Breakfast was also amazing! The “cave” room is small, but if you just need a spot to crash it’s perfect and very cozy.

We had a great time at Robin's place ! Next to tram and subway, it is easy to travel in the city ! The appartement was super clean thanks to Gerlinde's work, and perfectly
equipped !
Thanks for everything 👍

It is a beautiful apartment in the very nice district of Berlin. And the vibe is very Berlin-ish if you're looking for it. Rooms are spacious, everything is very clean and convenient. We also appreciated a peaceful neighborhood, an own entry to the apartment and the park just in front of the house. The description and photos totally match what we saw. The hosts are very nice, responsive and helpful. Highly recommended.

The room was spacious and clean with huge windows and lots of natural light. The bathroom was clean and comfortable. But most importantly, Betty is a lovely host and made me feel at home immediately. She was flexible with check in times, and was very friendly throughout my stay.
The location is great, only a couple of minutes walk away from a u-bahn station, which provides good access to the rest of the city. The apartment is also only a short walk away from a tree lined canal, which in the summer is lined with people enjoying the evening.
Overall, great accommodation, a great location and a lovely host.

A lovely apartment. Excellent for a stay in Berlin. The only downside is that the wifi is very spotty, so if you're looking to research places to go or booking the apartment for work, you'll need to use your data allowance, especially in the living area, but that's the only downside.
The place was nice, spacy and next to the subway. Communication with the host was good!
gute Kommunikation, Wohnung entspricht der Beschreibung, gute Ausstattung, jeder Zeit wieder

We were surprised that many of the items mentioned as “ available “ in the apartment weren’t actually, as the salt and pepper , and oil to allow basic cooking. It was also mentioned that some shampoo would be available to, but still not.
During the day everything seemed fine, but once the sun down, and curtains closed, street lights were very disturbing and annoying, the curtains didn’t cover the lateral windows, the pharmacy light would enter and reflect straight on the wall in front of the bed.
Also the apartment had barely any sound proofing, we could hear every single noise from the outside and the neighbours. The fact that we had only a door separating us from the next “ flat “, made it extremely annoying by night.
Also very important to mention that our last night was spent very stressfully, as our room neighbours ( 3 or 4 men we guess ) were laughing and speaking very loud, the seemed drunk , and at some point they started trying to open the closed door, the one between the 2 apartments even though we told them to stop. It was very hard to sleep by night and not to think about our safety.
We really expected this stay to be much more comfortable than what it was. We choose to rent a whole apartment on purpose to avoid al the problems we mentioned above. But still we faced them all.
War alles wie besprochen. Zuverlässig und für uns perfekte Lage zum Veranstaltungsort.
Unschlagbare Lage. Ausgefallene und hochwertige Wohnung. Sehr serviceorientierter Host. Alles prima und mehr als empfehlenswert!

There are full of amazing paintings painted by the host. The room and living room are really cute and nice. The room is at the first floor which might be harder for girls went alone with big heavy luggage to carry upstairs in case for people couldn’t read German or translate all descriptions. The bathroom looks amazing beautiful as picture, but might be harder to take shower due to the hypotenuse space beside of shower bath for especially tall people. The host asked how’s our day there and really nice that recommended me nice places to go and eat, also send me an detail of a day schedule path. Very recommended to travelers especially who love arts.
Danke shön:)
Hanyu was a great host, and I loved staying in the flat, which was cozy and clean. Thanks for hosting me, would love to come back sometime :)

Eu, meu marido, meu filho e esposa nos hospedamos no apartamento da Ruth por 11 dias. O apartamento é ótimo! Muito silencioso e iluminado, acomodou muito bem nós quatro e tem tudo o que se precisa. A vizinhança é muito boa e bonita, muito próximo tem parques, supermercados, restaurantes, lojas. Ir ao centro e as pontos turísticos é muito fácil, pois o transporte é bem próximo também. Realmente adoramos! Eu recomendo muito e pretendemos voltar!

My cousins and I stayed at Martin's place for three nights. From the beginning, communication with Martin was excellent. Upon check-in, he provided us with several great recommendations for food, nightlife, and tourist spots. He really does know Berlin! We took his advice and had an amazing time! The apartment itself is very spacious with three really comfortable beds. Overall the apartment was very clean and really well taken care of. For a studio apartment it is quite open and airy and has plenty of space for everyone. The train stop is around the corner from the apartment and all the major tourist spots are within walking distance. You cant beat the location, the quality, and the price. We will most certainly be visiting and staying here again. Many thanks !
accommodated a last minute booking. apartment was perfect and clean. communication was super easy as well. neighborhood a bit too quiet, but nice parks around

Sabine ist eine herzliche und zuvorkommenden Gastgeberin. Die Unterkunft ist in einer ruhigen Wohngegend mit guter Verkehrsanbindung,  was wir besonders angenehm fanden. Das wunderbare Badezimmer ist so schön wie beschrieben. Gerne wieder! Vielen Dank!

I had a really wonderful stay in this little flat. Carsten and Jessica are super lovely and helpful. Wonderful location, amazingly well thought and organized. Just don't be too much afraid of insects hehe I would say, it's perfect for a short stay (just because there is no cooking plate. (:

Oda çok temiz ve özenli döşenmişti. Çok güvenilir bir bölge ve bina. Lokasyon çok iyi bir muhit olması dolayısıyla bir aile olarak bizi mutlu etti.
