Bir daha Berlin’e gelsek yine tercih ederiz. Tüm ulaşım ağlarına 3-5 dakika mesafede. Her yere kolayca ulaşım sağlayabiliyorsun.

Die Unterkunft ist nagelneu, sehr gepflegt und die Matratzen sehr bequem. Die Mitarbeiter handelten immer sehr kundenorientiert und hatten auf alle meine Fragen immer eine Antwort oder Lösung parat. Die Aussicht vom Apartment auf den Herrmannplatz ist einzigartig und in der Gegend findet man wirklich alles. Ein Park zum Joggen ist auch gleich nebenan.
Die Zimmer Reinigung ist sehr steril und gründlich. Gerade in dieser Zeit halte ich das für besonders vorbildlich. Ich kann die Unterkuft uneingeschränkt weiterempfelen.

Anna's place is a good choice if you are looking for something close to the city center, but perhaps the appartment was not as charming as in the photos. Anyway, it covered our needs and she attended our doubts in a kind way.

Stay was alright - not the apartment pictured which was disappointing, fairly poor communication and directions (slow to respond, only had one pillow and towel for our first two days, concierge QR scan errored out so we couldn’t use it, etc). It was very clean and had the basic amenities but overall pretty disappointed for the price. I think we’re owed a partial refund…

Grosses, sauberes Apartment im Erdgeschoss. Ruhig, doch ohne jegliche Aussicht, da Fenster mit Folien verklebt sind. Das ist gut als Blickschutz, aber man sieht halt auch nicht raus. Einlass einfach und ohne Probleme, flexibel möglich, fand ich gut und klappte auch gut. Ist ein Business Apartment, für meinen persönlichen Geschmack fast zu professionell. Die Lage fand ich sehr gut.
Vi boede i en dejlig lejlighed med mange faciliteter. Thomas var hurtig til at respondere og hjælpsom.
Tres bon séjour sur berlin, super emplacement
Alles top !
Very clean and spacious property with beautiful high ceilings. Annett was very quick to reply on messages :)
The place is exactly as it‘s described. The host is very friendly and helpful. Also, the location is perfect because there is a U-Bahn station only a block away.
Super recomendado, todo el personal muy amable, puedes dejar tu equipaje antes de la hora de check in y después. Fácil de encontrar. Bonito lugar, silencioso. Sin duda lo recomiendo!

Stella was a very nice host and responded quickly to our questions and requests. The house was cozy and had everything that is said on the description. Everything was properly clean. Very nice experience!

Jerome war ein erstklassiger Gastgeber. Vom CheckIn bis zur Verabschiedung verlief alles den Erwartungen entsprechend. Außerdem ist der Kollwitzkiez eine wunderbare Ecke, um Berlin von einer seiner besten Seiten zu entdecken. Immer wieder gern!
Lindemann’s is a nice and quiet place as advertised. We received good service service and I would recommend it to anyone who is looking for a convenient place to stay while touring Berlin.

Good location in the heart of Friedrichshain, 5-6 mins walking distance to the S-Bahn at Ostkruez and 1 min walk to the bus/tram stop Neue Bahnhofstr.
Lots & lots of restaurants and bars around.
Alex and Neli kept good communication throughout, even if we did not see them.
They have a very well looked after clean, functional apartment.
The coffee machine and sparkling water on tap was a good touch.
This is a good apartment to stay at if you want to visit Berlin for a few days.

Einfach Klasse.
Ein netter Empfang, eine gemütliche Behausung, leckeres Frühstück.
Dazu Ruhe und Entschleunigung, trotz dessen man eigentlich Mitten in der Hauptstadt ist.
Es hat uns richtig gut gefallen bei René.

Super, bon rapport qualité prix, idéalement situé à côté de restos et bars
Très bonne expérience, je recommande !!

Die Wohnung war genau wie beschrieben und mit der Dachterasse ein einziger Traum. Die Kommunikation lief reibungslos und der Check-In/Check-Out war maximal flexibel. Ich kann dieses Appartment daher sehr empfehlen :)
Tolle Unterkunft, perfekt für ein paar Tage!

Saubere Zimmer, alles wie vorher gebucht, schöner Innenhof
Alles wirklich top gepflegt.
On Top: Service - es gibt eine freundliche Dame die mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht!
In Summe ein sehr guter Gesamteindruck!!!
Stefanie is a great person. I would recommend her accommodation for staying in Berlin.
Very nice appartment. Wonderful neigbourhood, safe and nice to walk around at anytime. Neu Westend subway station close. Highly recommended.

I stayed a week at Heidi’s apartment in Berlin and it was great. Located within walking distance to Potsdamer Platz so you can check out everything there and get to wherever you want in the city easily by public transportation. There are other U, S and bus stations located nearby as well. Heidi kindly greeted me for check in and gave me an overview of the apartment. I am  glad I made the choice to stay here and would recommend to others who are looking to spend a few days in Berlin.

Зручна локація, чудові апартаменти. Чисто, нічого зайвого, місця достатньо, все нове. Є абсолютно все необхідне, крім кондиціонеру. Але персонал дуже привітний та знайшов нам вентилятор за нашим проханням.

Great place to see Berlin! Close to public transport and  to the great sights! Very eclectic space! Great little Balcony As advertised!
Great Place for a Great Price

Beautiful apartment in a lovely location- easy access to all the city attractions via public transport and in walking distance to the river, a perfect spot for a picnic or walk.
Stefan was an excellent host, quick with replies and answered all our questions. Thank you for a lovely time in Berlin! Danke!!
Sehr praktische Unterkunft, sowohl was die Lage als die Ausstattung angeht. Für Kurzaufenthalte sehr zu empfehlen.
A very comfortable place to stay, with great ammenities and a nice, greetenig host. 100% would recommend and will definitely return at some point.
Très bel appartement, grand et lumineux. Susanne est accueillante et très réactive au moindre problème. L'appartement est très bien situé, juste à côté du Mauerpark. Je recommande
War alles bestens, ganz lieben Dank!

Great place to stay - a short walk to the underground or a short scoot to the city centre. Lovely space and very easy to check-in. Very quiet apartment. Would definitely stay here again if I come back to Berlin.
Stor og ren lejlighed - super fint
Location was perfect and it’s a very big room! I definitely recommend it!

Overall the property os good and easy for getting transportation.  Although,  I won't prefer it for families due to its location and surrounding area of ahirt distance.  We were 7 Men adults and used it for good night sleep, and most of the time out of the property so for that reason we were OK  without any issue and property has all basic facilities that would be required.
Authentic Berlin experience. Private, clean apartment in great location!
Prima verblijf en een fijne host!
Tolle Wohnung und sehr netter Aufenthalt, habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt
Very nice place, highly recommended. Slightly noisy if sleeping on sofa bed room but otherwise great! Bathroom and shower very good

The stay was good.  I tried to rebook an extra night and was met with a totally confusing website which the chat staff were completely unable to explain and kept on giving me conflicting explanations about the initially advertised price next to the extra night in question of 145 Euro and the finally confirmed price on the last page after all the details - name, passport, etc etc were put in of 175 Euro.  Comes across as bait and switch but it’s actually due to the website’s use of a two night average rather than the price for that night - but who does that?? The booking assistance staff had a standard dismissive patter regarding this peculiar setup - they said it was due to tax, or changing pricing from one minute to the next and a variety of other nonsense explanations.  Also, I kept my luggage in the lockers provided free of charge after I checked out.  But my door code stopped working when I came to pick up my luggage and I had to plead with the on site maintenance guy to let me in

My recent stay at CALMA Berlin Mitte was delightful. The staff was incredibly friendly and went above and beyond to ensure a pleasant experience throughout my visit. One of the highlights of the location was the abundance of local restaurants and cafes. Additionally, the proximity to the public transportation system was a major advantage. Overall,  this Hotel provided an enjoyable and convenient stay that met my expectations.

Wir fanden eine den Erwartungen entsprechende Wohnung vor; sie war gut gewärmt, machte einen freundlichen Eindruck, wir fühlten uns sehr wohl.
Die Nachricht von Fabian am Samstag Nachmittag - er habe erfahren, mit dem Bett sei etwas nicht in Ordnung (ein Bein war abgebrochen) - wirkte irritierend. Wir schauten nach, das Bein war wirklich abgebrochen und konnte auch auf die Schnelle nicht repariert werden. Fabian bot sich an sofort zu kommen, was wir dankend ablehnten, weil das Bett trotz des abgebrochenen Beines benutzbar war. Es ist auch kein weiterer Schaden entstanden.
Ansonsten waren wir voll auf zufrieden; der Straßenlärm hat uns nicht weiter gestört aber für empfindlichere Menschen könnte er ein Problem sein (am Wochenende ok. aber ab Montag Morgen 6.30 Uhr rollt der Verkehr).
Liebe Grüße
Susanne Korfmann

Hans is a very nice and kind host. He introduced us all in very detailed information before we stayed in the house.
He is the best host and old friend I have ever met.
The house is very nice with quite and beautiful environment.
We did really enjoy the stay here.
I will definitely come back again if I will be in Berlin next time.
Good communication with the owner. Pleasant welcome. Liked the neighbourhood, very easy access to Berlin. Some lovely restaurants in the neighbourhood as well.
Ruhiges Zimmer mit guten Betten - in dem man sich gut von der Großstadt erholen kann  :)

Ingo ist ein sehr freundlicher und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber. Er hat immer schnell auf Anfragen reagiert und die Kommunikation war insgesamt gut und unkompliziert. Auch der Check-in und der Check-out waren super unkompliziert.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist top! Mitten im Berliner Leben und doch erstaunlich ruhig, weil ein Hinterhaus. Ich würde jederzeit wieder kommen.
Great place to stay in Berlin close to cute restaurants and the tram line. Thomas was very responsive and helpful during our stay.

I stayed at Henrik's apartment for five nights, and was completely happy with my experience there.  The space was perfect for one person or a couple, with a good-sized bedroom, a bathroom with a tub,  and a well-equipped little kitchen.  It has high-ceilings, big windows, good water pressure, and was very clean.  There are other nice little touches that make it homey.  It's also in a great location...right between the Prenzlauer Berg/Mitte neighbourhoods, and within walking distance to good restaurants, bars and shops, as well as a U-Bahn stop.  Henrik was also extremely easy to deal with...he responded to my booking request and a few other questions throughout my visit right away and was always helpful and friendly.  I ended up extending my stay from three to five nights because I was enjoying myself too much to leave.
El departamento es bonito. La limpieza del lugar y el orden fue agradable. Mucho espacio para descansar y pasar una estancia tranquila.
Lugar agradável, bem licalizado, charmoso, exatamente como nas fotos

The room was super – located right in the heart of Kreuzberg, within a charming, vintage building that really added to the atmosphere. Sophia was incredibly helpful and welcoming, making us feel right at home. We truly enjoyed our stay. If you're a dog lover, Vilda is an absolute gem of a dog - we didn’t even feel her presence, she’s well-behaved and calm.

A great room in a top floor apartment with a terrace. Tatjana was very easy to communicate with and she was very relaxed about me being there. The two funny cats sometimes like to hang out in the room so I would be comfortable with cats if you stay there.
Great place to stay.
Saubere Wohnung. Cooler Gegend. Gut zu empfehlen

Perfect location for exploring Berlin. Centrally located within walking distance to many sights, restaurants and bars. Sonja was great with communication and the flat was very neat and ideal for our short stay. Highly recommended.

Fantastic location and a really cute apartment.  Very close proximity to metro, shops and restaurants. Lena was extremely accommodating. We truly enjoyed our stay in Berlin. Would love to visit again!

I’ve stayed in this flat for more than 2 weeks and everything just perfect and can’t complain. The location is super good that within 5 mins walk you can reach S/U bahn, just few stops you will be at Mitte, nearby has supermarkets, parks and all you might need. The neighborhood also quite nice, even is close to Kreuzberg is not noisy or chaotic at all. Is also very close to Schöneberg which is probably my favorite district in Berlin.
The host response my message very fast and always helpful, friendly.
I can recommend all people who’s coming to Berlin for either vacation or business stay at this flat :)
Todo muy bien muchas gracias!

Loved our stay here!  We were met on arrival, introduced to the flat and given some top tips for Berlin.  Tom & Arzu responded to our queries promptly whilst we were there, too.  The flat was exactly as described, felt like home, and had everything we needed.  The balcony was the icing on the cake - we enjoyed breakfast and a coffee out there every morning!  Would highly recommend this place.

David’s flat had all the trappings of a classic European space. The layout was unique, with tall ceilings, original moldings and arched doorways. These details added to an authentic experience of being in Berlin.  Everything was lovely despite 6 of us sharing only one bathroom. Wonderful value for an off season visit and would definitely come back again.

-The location is good, close to KUDAM, very quiet to sleep.  It has basic requirements, even a balcony. It was warm, no problem with heating, water,etc. The kitchen and living room are lightsome. The bed is comfortable. It was clean, no problem in getting the key. We were happy to stay there.

Perfect spot for bigger group / family as for example our group of 8 friends. Katrin was a great hostess, quick reaction for any concerns or questions we had during our stay there. Location was perfect for us and you'll get anywhere you want quick, since tram stops and s-bahn stops just a corner away.  Tranquil neighborhood, did not hear anything during nights and super comfy beds! Can warmly recommend, and we will definitely stay here again if ever given a chance to visit Berlin with a group.
Wohnung sieht genau so aus, wie auf den Bildern. Hat alles wunderbar geklappt - wir kommen sicher wieder.
El alojamiento cumple con todas las expectativas, es lindo y organizado. Monika fue una muy buena anfitriona y en todo momento nos hizo sentir cómodas.
We really enjoyed our stay in Berlin here. Nils with his girlfriend were very nice to us and the accommodation was perfect for us.

Apartment was big, but other than the floor, nothing really spectacular.
It’s clean, but would need some renovation (doors/wall) and the interior is low standard. Pictures definitely better than reality.
Great location, super central and short walking distance to public transport.
Excelente anfitriòn, buena ubicaciòn lugar muy comodo y acogedor
The spacious, comfortable flat, and especially the wonderful Frank, made our first time in Berlin so sweet and ever so memorable.

Vi är toppennöjda med boendet, så trevlig och rymlig lägenhet! Lite ljud från trafiken gatan, men inget som störde särskilt. Vi hade lite otur med ombyggnation av huset, så det blev inga sovmorgnar. Men i övrigt var allt toppen! Trevlig värd och fräsch och prisvärd lägenhet.
Amazing hotel, great service and friendly staff
This apartment was great. It had all the amenities needed and a lovely common garden. Mina was a great host and was always responsive to any questions we had. I would definitely stay here again!

Very spacious loft with a terrace, better than the pics.
Warm and efficient welcome.
Very happy with our choice, we had a great time.
Sehr zufrieden mit dem Aufenthalt.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr gut gelegen zwischen Schönhauser Allee und Gesundbrunnen. Man kann aus er der Tür raus und halt viele kleine Bäcker und Coffeeshops sowie zwei Supermärkte in der Nähe. Auch zum Mauerpark braucht man keine 5 Minuten.

Thank you so much for having us. Everything was perfect... location, apartment, communication 💯 only thing Google maps takes you to the wrong apartment number but if you read her description it even says it on there 😅🙈

Vielen Dank Erez!
Wir hatten eine super Zeit bei dir :)

I stayed at Dominik’s Airbnb for a week and had a great experience. He was very helpful and offered great recommendations for local cafés. The location is excellent, most tourist attractions are within walking distance, even if you’re not using public transport. There are plenty of great restaurants and cafés just around the corner, and the neighborhood itself is very pleasant. I had a wonderful time and would highly recommend staying here!

What a lovely experience staying in Marko’s apartment! He greeted us upon arrival, showed us around the apartment, and also gave us local tips on where to go and how to avoid crowds. He is incredibly thoughtful with this very clean space and we would happily return to stay here in the future.

Great location, comfortable apartment, and pleasantly decorated. Cloths closet only in main bedroom. Apartment is 2nd floor (3rd floor US) walk up. Bathtub/shower is raised from bathroom floor posing an awkward and some what difficult entry.
Great location and very comfortable apartment

amazing stay, so clean and the beds are so comfortable! right next to a lidl for shopping anf close to everything we needed. Simon has been so helpful I even changed the guest number the night before as I made a mistake and this was so quick and easy. thank you for the stay!
Very accommodating and helpful host. The area is extremely nice, situated near a church, parks and many restaurants. The apartment is very modern and has great amenities. Would love to stay again.
Vi njöt av dagarna i Berlin och rekommenderar lägenheten då den är trevlig och det är nära till tunnelbanan.

Njce spot in the heart of Kreuzberg close to public transportation.  Huge apartment with plenty of room to spread out and nice courtyard in the back. Ground floor access made getting in and out super easy. Recommend!

Exzellente Gastgeberin!
Die Lage ist perfekt und es hat an nichts gefehlt. Hoffe bei meinem nächsten Trip nach Berlin hier wieder unterkommen zu dürfen!
We stayed with our two kids and we loved the apartment. It was very clean and fresh. We woul definately recommend Andreas place!
Neat and clean with all amenities nearby.

The place was spacious, the beds were comfortable, and it was close to the U-Bahn. My only warning is that it may not be the best place for tall or clumsy people because the ceiling is low in some areas and the rooms have steps up/down that are easy to miss.
Perfect location

The apartment was perfect for our stay and had everything we needed! The information Alan and Kasia gave us about getting to the apartment was extremely helpful and the booklets in the apartment about Berlin (things to do etc) were very useful and made our stay a lot easier! It’s in a great location and close by to the tram stop, so everywhere is easily accessible.
We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again!

Das Hotel ist super schön und perfekt im Prenzlauer Berg gelegen.
Die über AirBnB vertriebenen Zimmer sind - im Vergleich zu den normalen Zimmern- etwas anders. Die Treppe/Leiter zum Bett oben ist sehr steil, darauf muss man eingestellt sein.
Aber sonst alles super! :-) Schönes Bad. Das Zimmer war sauber und alles wie auf den Bildern.
nice little place close to station and convenient facilities
Very nice hostel! It was clean, the staff is very nice and the rooms are comfy. I had a great stay!
thank you Alexander, great hospitality and a beautiful, comfortable room in a cool neighborhood. Loved coffee and conversation too. Aribnb at its best :)
Great host and place that is well decorated and conveniently located . Thank you Peggy!

Great place, Fabian was great and his instructions very clear. One tiny detail, due to the fact I was with two females, a second mirror would be beneficial :)
Thanks again.

No frills apartment. The location is good, there are lots of coffee shops, restaurants in walking distance. Public transport links are nearby too so easy to travel around the city.
The apartment is on the 3rd floor with no lift. The shower was very tight, which wasn't a problem for us but I imagine could be for some people.
It would be great to have some additional extras like coffee/tea/sugar as well as body wash. I haven't stayed many places where there were not available.
The apartment itself wasn't as clean as it could be, there was some dirt behind the bathroom door and cobwebs above the shower. There was a white ring on the coffee table which I assumed was a stain but it came off with a wet wipe so seems the coffee table was not wiped down. My partner also spilled some water on the floor near the bed and we wiped it up with a towel, the towel was covered in brown marks afterwards and so it would also seem the floors are not cleaned. There was lots of dust under the bed.
Best location for Berlin and a very nice view.

Petra is an awesome host! She prepares a tremendous breakfast to start the day, takes an interest in guests ability to access the city, and  genuinely cares. Highly recommend Petra! A Super Host indeed! Thanks Petra! Cheers/best, Douglas

Die Woche bei Rosario war super, die Wohnung war schön und blitzsauber, Rosario selbst war sehr sehr freundlich und sowohl Check in als auch Check gut waren absolut unkompliziert. Sollte ich mal wieder nach Berlin kommen ist Rosario unter Garantie meine erste Anlaufstelle.

Een heel erg fijn verblijf gehad met mijn vriendinnen bij Katja. Het huis is heel licht en ruim. De energie van het huis was ook zeer prettig en we voelden ons meteen thuis. Communicatie was zeer goed want Katja dacht altijd met ons mee naar oplossingen. Mijn vriendinnen en ik hebben allemaal gezegd dat we nog eens terug willen komen naar deze airbnb. 🌞
Lin war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit in der Kommunikation und alles hat gut geklappt! Gerne wieder
Had a great stay! Would recommend to anyone

This is a brilliant apartment in central Berlin. I stayed there for 4 nights with my boyfriend and we were so surprised at the homey touches: slippers, toiletries, maps, bandaids, etc. Marius has really thought of everything! Definitely recommend it!

Dies ist das zweite Mal, dass ich in Lauras Airbnb übernachtet habe und wieder war es eine wunderbare Erfahrung! Ich schlafe dort besser als in meinem eigenen Haus. Die beste Matratze, auf der ich je geschlafen habe. Ihre Wohnung ist wunderschön, sie erfüllt mich mit Frieden, sie ist immer sehr sauber, die Anweisungen sind sehr klar und einfach zu folgen. Laura ist sehr nett, eine ausgezeichnete Gastgeberin! 100% empfehlenswert!

He is nice, friendly and comunicative. always responsive, on time, and the place was as discribe in the platform. so, if you plan for short stay its a good recomended place specially cause it is close to bahn. So, i was comfortable🙂🙂🙂🙂🙂 five smily for him as five stars
This is a charming place with the best welcome . I spent here a really good time.  I was like at home.

El barrio y ubicación están muy bien, a pasos del metro y de restaurantes y bars. El departamento es muy lindo y amplio, todo nuevo y muy limpio. La calefacción y la cama excelentes! No daban ganas de salir cuando hacía frío :) Lena es muy amable, nos permitió un late check out y accedió a recibirnos a las 10pm de un Domingo, así que muy buena onda. Gracias Lena por todo!

Andreas' Berliner Bed&Breakfast is situated in the very charming part of Schöneberg, with old historical houses and good food around the corner. Akazienstrasse nearby is super for eating and shopping.
The room was very charming with many details, historical and antique decor. Clean and nice. Andreas is very serviceminded, answers fast when you write messages. We can highly recommend.

Wir wurden sehr herzlich empfangen und fühlten uns in der wirklich schönen und liebevoll eingerichteten Wohnung super wohl und willkommen, wenn wir mal nicht unterwegs waren. Unser Zimmer war gemütlich, wir hatten einen eigenen Eingang und direkten Zugang zum ebenfalls sehr schönen Badezimmer. Die Wohnung befindet sich in einem tollen alten Haus. Die Umgebung bietet viel, man ist aber auch in fünf Minuten bei der U-Bahn oder an der Bushaltestelle mit super Verbindungen in alle Richtungen.

A PERFECT EXPERIENCE!!
I can not recommend this place higher!!!!!!!
If you are looking to stay in Berlin, Roi’s apartment is PERFECT. Not only was it absolutely stunning (EXACTLY like the pictures) but it was sparking clean. Roi went above and beyond to make sure we had absolutely everything we needed for our stay, we had cute little extras and gifts provided which just added to the pleasurable experience.
Roi is the perfect host, his communication was unbelievable every time I messaged no matter what time of day or evening he responded immediately, he even went above and beyond to recommend restaurants, travel, English speaking taxi services and bars.
The apartment itself is located in the centre of Berlin right next to a square of yummy restaurants and a huge shopping centre. The U-Bahn (like the tube) is also only a 3 minute walk away and you can easily and very cheaply get the U-Bahn to everywhere you would possibly need to be. It was very close only a couple of stops to places like Check point Charlie, museum island, the Berlin Wall and many other tourist attractions and interests.
We did not go to any clubs near where we were as the places that were recommended to us were about a 30 min journey on the U-Bahn in east side which stops running after 1:30 however a taxi back to our apartment was only €20!!
The stay was comfortable, stylish, very very very good value for money and if we are ever in Berlin again we shall definitely be staying here again!! Thank you Roi :)))

positivas : ubicación, estado del piso, trato del anfitrión. Nos nos permitieron dejar las maletas hasta medio dia, lo cual nos vino muy bien. Muchas gracias
a mejorar: No aparecía en ningún sitio la clave de entrada al apartamento y el anfitrión no contestaba. Tuvimos que hablar con Airbnb. Luego se solucionó todo. La wifi era muy mala. No éramos capaces de descargar o ver nada. Posiblemente porque el dispositivo de la casa obtenía la red a través de móvil y no de cable.
Great stay, lovely and clean plus easy access to everything we needed ☺️

El apartamento correspondía perfectamente a la descripción. Es amplio, limpio y funcional. Está en una zona perfecta para pasear por el barrio de Kreuzberg. Tal vez lo único que echamos en falta fue que dispusiera de internet.
Genau, was wir gesucht hatten.
Cozy place in a good location and a very responsive host. Highly recommended!

I wanted to love this place but where it was great in most areas, it fell short in a few important areas.
The location was amazing - super close to everything, beautiful courtyard with bamboo, super quiet and peaceful, but also close to great bars and food. The room was big so we felt like we had a lot of room and storage.
However, the shower curtain wasn’t big enough for the shower so water would get everywhere. The king bed had a queen size blanket on it and the additional blankets provided were stained so we were too grossed out to use them. The washer would leave our clothes soaking wet regardless of the setting we used (he did come to check it though which was nice, I guess it’s just not a great washer) so I had to hand wring everything out and then pack wet clothes to come home.
Overall we still had a pleasant stay, but just expected better. If I were in college and didn’t care, then this place would be amazing, but I’m not in college and expected a higher quality.

Wir sind sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft.
Es wäre besser mit einem Küchenhandschuh, einem Gericht für den Backofen, einer Nachttischlampe.

We had a great stay. Apostolos was extremely helpful and accommodating, and was nearby to help us in case we needed anything. The flat is a stylish studio--just as it's portrayed in the photos--and the location couldn't be better.
Totally recommendable.
Schoon en makkelijk bereikbaar vanuit het centrum met de OV.
great stay, lovely room and easy to get in. Katarzyna was very responsive, perfect host!
Alles wie beschrieben, Sauna ein tolles Highlight, für Familie mit Kindern als Citytriplocation empfehlenswert.
Great value for the money. Location was perfect for ease of public transportation.  A shared shower can create timing issues.
Notre nuit c’est super bien passé. L’hôte nous a bien informé sur la localisation et était super réactif.
schick, gerne wieder

4 of us were staying in Berlin to run (and spectate) the Berlin Marathon. Host was extremely helpful and even periodically massaged during our stay to check all was ok. This is probably one of nicest AirBnbs I’ve stayed in.
You are outside of the centre on Berlin but I see this as a positive as the local restaurants and bakery’s are much better than what’s on offer in the city. Public transport to the centre is externally easy and reliable
Thanks for an amazing stay, if we return to Berlin we will definitely book again

Die Wohnung ist schick eingerichtet und ruhig gelegen. Die Kommunikation verläuft erfreulich schnell.
Hier und da sieht alles nach Marke Eigenbau aus, aber das soll nicht stören. Werner was such a great host!host! We loved our stay, the private entrance, the decor,  the host’s thoughtfulness and picking us up at the airport. We had an amazing stay!
L appartement est très bien situé  et très agréable
Eine sehr saubere und moderbe Wohnung mit sehr guter Verbindung zu den Öff. Verhehrsmittel!  Die Gastgeber sind wirklich sehr nett und qechte profis!
As usually, a great stay! I recommend

Traumhafte Berliner Altbauwohnung mit viel Charme! Super sauber und zentral gelegen inmitten des schönsten Kreuzberg. Viel Platz für viele Leute und eine großzügige Küche und ein großer Esstisch für schöne Abende. Wir kommen bestimmt wieder!

Todo perfecto. Moe me dió indicaciones de cómo llegar al piso y sobre el transporte público. Durante mi estancia Julian me ayudó con cualquier cosa que pudiese necesitar, dándome indicaciones y ayudándome con asuntos que tenía que hacer allí.

La foto coincide con la habitación, con la salvedad de que no hay televisor, nada importante.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Ein großzügiges Quartier für zwei, mit weiterer Schlafmögllichkeit auf der Empore/Gallerie. Schöne, saubere und moderne Ausstattung. Modernes Bad. Kochmöglichkeit ist aber eher ein Notbehelf.

Firstly, let me say that the property is placed in such an incredible area. Along the water with a garden and a forest made this a wonderful retreat for us and the dog. The amenities are clean, great furniture and fully equipped kitchen. Great bathroom. The only issues were as follows: There were two houseboats mentioned in the description but what was not mentioned was that the residents of those two houseboats were to use a toilet that was attached to our accomodation. Also, wifi connection was non-existent or very faint most of the time. There was a misunderstanding between the host so we were locked out of the property and had to climb over the gate.
Regardless of all this Dorit was kind, responsive and very helpful. Highly recommended. I would consider staying here again if the wifi was sorted out.

I loved the nice interior and cosy environment. Thank you for this time.
By the way, the kebab recommended were the best food on this trip to Europe 🥙!!
All increíble
The house is clean, spacious and very centrally located. The check in process is really smooth and the hosts are very welcoming. I highly recommend this place for a stay in Berlin.
Great place, nice and quiet but nevertheless in the centre of Berlin. Very accesible!!!
clean, well-equipped and beautiful apartment. we enjoyed our stay!
The apartment was great, we had a great time there. The bathroom is not for tall people, but for few nights it is okay. The location is super.
Cool and cheap place, I recommend! Good location. I got room 004. Room on the ground floor, clean, close to the bathroom.  Very good beers at the hostel bar.
Einfach nur zu empfehlen, tolle Unterkunft mit einem sehr freundlichen Gastgeber. Vielen Dank!
Wie immer top!
Great stay, very easy to check in. Great location very easy to get around. Lots to do.
Very nice apartment; clean and central. Timo is a great Owner!

Location was a 18 min walk to the bus stops were using so a little inconvenient . No services a short walk away, more like 7/10 min. Minimal furniture in the apt. Pictures well represent the space. Nice balcony space.

Le logement est proche des sites touristiques et accessible en transport. Logement propre, rangé et bien équipé, assez spacieux pour 10 personnes et il y’a même des jeux de société . L’isolation (son) est plutôt bonne et les voisins sont tolérants. Phil est très communicatif. Le Check-in et le Check-out se sont faits très simplement, les consignes étaient claires et précises. J’y reviendrai sûrement et je recommande fortement !
Krásné ubytování v příjemné části Berlína. Všude blízko.

As far as hostels go, The Generator Berlin Mitte is awesome. The rooms and common areas are kept very clean and the staff I encountered were friendly. I personally felt comfortable with the other guests I shared a room with but if I were in a position where I felt unsafe, I would have no issues approaching the front desk staff. There is also a good balance of shared spaces that are more lively and ones that are more laid back and quiet.
The location is also amazing in general, but especially for the price. If you enjoy walking, then you can definitely get to a lot of attractions and things to do on foot. I seldom used public transportation in my 6 days and I was never bored.
With this all being said, it is still a hostel so it's not a 5-star hotel experience. As other reviews have said, it is generally quite a young crowd (seemingly late teens/early 20s) which can require some patience at times if you're out of that stage. But overall a great place to stay in Berlin on a budget.
Central and clean place, lovely host.
Great! Super clean and well-equipped flat :) Thank you Yves and Andreas!

Wenn man rechtzeitig den Code für das Türschloss aktiviert ist alles kein Problem. Hierfür gab es eine klare Hilfestellung. Frühere Kritiken diesbezüglich kann ich daher nicht bestätigen. Die Wohnung ist über den Innenhof zu erreichen. Nachdem gleich nach dem Eingang  noch ein weiteres Apartment vermietet wird, könnten die Wegbeschreibung zum gewählten Apartment etwas eindeutiger sein. Der Fernseher ist ein modernes Smart Gerät. Wofür steckt dann aber ein altes Antennenkabel drin und man ärgert sich zunächst, dass es kein Fernsehprogramm gibt? Aber auch das hat sich schnell geklärt. Insgesamt ist die Wohnung aber deutlich dunkler als sie auf den Bildern erscheint. Alles in allem aber war der Aufenthalt sehr gut.

This apartment is a beautiful and light filled place, with plenty of room for two. The little kitchen is totally perfect for cooking meals, the bed is comfortable, and the windows look out onto a lovely scene. Also, this neighborhood is fantastic, so many great shops, everything is close, including the subway station which is 1 block away. I absolutely recommend this place, what a fantastic option to those who wish to be self-sufficient during their stay in Berlin.
The pictures do not do this sweet little apartment justice! It is so pretty.
Gute Unterkunft

Great place for peace in the city. We loved it. A real home that is full of real character. Not like those other Airbnbs that are just filled with cheap rental fittings. Thanks for sharing your lovely and peaceful home. Hope we can return again one day

El departamento de Dagmar es muy bueno, la limpieza impecable y tiene un supermercado justo abajo cosa que es muy cómoda. Además ella contesta por whatsapp cualquier duda que uno tenga. Es muy recomendable.
Für eine Nacht ganz okay
Vous pouvez vous rendre dans les Airbnb de Kristina les yeux fermés. Elle est très attentionnée pour ses hôtes. Nous reviendrons avec plaisir

Great place to stay to explore multiple areas of Berlin. The apartment was in walking distance to a main train station to the airport, and to many food places and attractions. Ik heb heerlijk verbleven 14 dagen. Voelde me helemaal thuis. Vriendelijke host. Ik kom hier graag terug!
Kleine ruimte, maar alles wat je nodig hebt voor een kort verblijf is aanwezig. Alles is ook proper. Goede ligging aan de tramhalte. Vergeet geen handdoeken om af te drogen 😉

Appartamento luminoso e spazioso ideale per una famiglia di 4 persone.

Bardzo dobry kontakt z gospodarzem. Na miejscu okazało się, że pralka nie działa, niedogodności zostały wyjaśnione i gospodarz zaproponował rekompensatę w postaci vouchera na następny pobyt, co było bardzo uprzejme.

Beautiful location for public transport, perfect host. Dagmar was awesome host though we met only during the last day prior to our departure. I will be coming again next year. 👌. Thank you once again for hosting us.

Es war eine tolle - wie man es sich vorstellt - Berliner Altbauwohnung. Im herrlichen Kreuzberg. Unkomplizierter Check in. Im Vorfeld klare Anweisungen. Schnelle Reaktion im Austausch. Es ist eine private, große Wohnung, was super ist bei den ganzen lieblosen Apartments und in der man sich schnell wohlfühlt. Von der Wohnung aus ist man sofort im Kiez mit tollen Läden, Restaurants, Kneipen. Öffis ebenso  schnell erreichbar. Insofern empfehlen wir diese gern weiter.
L’appartement est situé dans un quartier animé, sa décoration originale lui donne un véritable cachet
Brilliant place
Really nice and clean apartment, very close a central U station and east side gallery. Spacy rooms and Martin was very helpful.
We loved your place. Super stylish and design. Close to the center, very quite and clean place ,with kindly hospitality.

Annette and Cecile were both very responsive and made the stay much easier for us. The apartment is very comfy and central but also in a quiet street. So commuting was very easy to figure out. I'd reccommend wandering in the area, specifically by the river, and across it to Treptower Park, it makes for a really nice walk and there's a little strip with a bunch of food stalls.
Overall, this flat is a great find! It is on the smaller side, but it has everything you need for a few days. Also, I noticed a reviewer mentioning not being able to find the cutlery, it's in a little drawer within the bigger one where the crockery is. A very clever design feature, that also took us a bit to figure out, but is mentioned in the very handy guide that Agnes had left us. Would definitely reccommend, and would certainly stay there again!
