Blöd war: das Internet funktionierte während unseres Aufenthalts nicht, auch nicht direkt über das LAN Kabel.
Davon abgesehen eine super tolle Unterkunft, sauber und in top Lage. Wir haben nicht gekocht, aber die Küche schien gut ausgestattet.
Wenn man zu dritt dort ist und hintereinander duschen möchte, muss man zwischendurch neues Wasser aufheizen - wenn man das einplant, ist das aber kein Problem.

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt und hatten dadurch ein wunderschönes Wochenende in Berlin. Hendrik ist sehr freundlich und gut erreichbar. Die Wohnung ist genau wie beschrieben und in perfekter Lage. Die Restaurants in unmittelbarer Nähe sind sehr zu empfehlen. Wer gerne ausschläft, sollte Ohropax mitnehmen.
Insgesamt hat es uns sehr gut gefallen, ich würde die Wohnung auf jeden Fall weiter empfehlen.
Absolut netter Gastgeber! Wohnung wie beschrieben - was will man mehr! Absolut Empfehlenswert!
Es war alles entspannt  perfekt zum abschalten😊
Tons of space in a great area - couldn’t have asked for more!
Very clean & comfortable apartment with kind and welcoming hosts! Also very close to public transit and restaurants/shops. Would definitely recommend this listing!!
Everything was very good, easy, nice place !

Great place to stay in Prenzlauer district
Tor was v friendly and met me on arrival. Enjoyed my stay.

Overall, very nice stay at Numa Berlin. Check in and PIN code was very easy and convenient, room was clean & location was excellent.
My only complaint was the lack of ironing board available (despite being on the listing) and when I raised this with support I was told that other guests must have took them - but then they didn’t resolve this issue for me, leaving me with creased clothes during my stay.

Jay and Inna welcomed enthusiastically me to their place and their room had a private entrance and bathroom. Nice warm welcome! Although you have access to their kitchen and living room too. The bathroom shower was a little tricky but Jay was great to help and made a few adjustments. A stand up shower would be a great addition to the place.
Mich für dieses Airbnb entscheiden zu haben, war ein Volltreffer.  Man begibt sich hierbei nicht nur auf eine architektonische Reise, sondern trifft auch auf überaus freundliche Gastgeber.

기욤은 굉장히 친절했습니다.
방은 깨끗하고 아름다웠습니다.
예쁜 조명과 편안한 침구가 방을 더욱 아름답게 만들었습니다.
욕실은 넓고 깨끗했습니다.
Exactly as described. Very nice place, and bedroom was very spacious. Incredibly nice hosts. Absolutely loved the location too.

Es ist ein Platz zum Wohlfühlen. Monika und Uwe sorgen sehr dafür dass es einem an nichts fehlt. Es gab Kaffeepads, im Kühlschrank waren Getränke und wirklich ausreichend Handtücher. Ausserdem eine liebevoll gestaltete Terasse. Ich kann die Unterkunft auf jeden Fall empfehlen.

We greatly enjoyed our week-long stay in Ted's apartment. It was ideal as a base for exploring many corners of the city as it's very well placed near public transport connections (frequent trams and overground trains) and bicycle networks. Just as important, it was a lovely space to return to each day as it offered solitude from busy city life.
The apartment is just as described, with high ceilings and generous amounts of natural light allowing us to work on creative projects or to simply relax.
We appreciated Ted's friendly welcome and his tips for places to visit locally.
The apartment was amazing and huge! Super new, super stylish. We loved it! Will be glad to stay again in this apartment one day. We loved the balcony!!!

We really enjoyed our stay at Caroline's. Spacious, clean and we felt right at home. The neighborhood is lively and safe. Caroline was responsive every time we reached out. Do yourself a favor and try the restaurant down the street- Marienkafer. Make sure to order the Bruce Lee pizza.
I liked the small studio with attached bathrom. It suited me well for the week I spent in Berlin. It’s a popular place and I would like to return to both Wedding and the studio.

From the moment I made the reservation, Gerhard was very attentive and gave me warm welcome.
On arrival I was welcomed in a very friendly manner. Gerhard sent me messages now and then to see how I was and also to give me some advice what to do in Berlin.
I stayed 11 nights to attend a course in Berlin and the flat was very comfortable and also to study. I would highly recommend this flat for your stay in Berlin for leisure and business.
All in all I left very happy and at all times felt at home.
Soggiorno perfetto, gentilissimo e disponibile host, comodo e spazioso appartamento

La casa esta genial. Tal y como está descrita en el anuncio, Alex la persona q nos entregó las llaves muy atentó en todo momento. Por poner algún pero es q solo hay 1 baño y con la luz d la cocina no se ve muy bien al estar los techos muy altos, por lo demás genial!! Supermercado a 150 metros!! Y quizás un poco ruidoso al estar cerca d la autopista y no se podían abrir las ventanas por el ruido

Alles bestens. Gemütliches Häuschen auf gepflegtem Grundstück, bestens ausgestattet und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Es gibt sogar eine kleine Terrasse. Uns hat es an nichts gefehlt (außer an Shampoo, was in der Beschreibung stand, aber nicht da war 😉). Es ist recht weit zu laufen bis zum Bus oder zur S-Bahn, von daher besser für Anreise mit dem Auto geeignet. Anke war sehr freundlich und unkompliziert. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

The apartment was large, and met most of our requirements - with huge ceilings, and a large kitchen, lounge and bathroom.  The area was good for accessing public transport.  We were made to feel welcome by Frederic and Frida.
Rent og pænt. Tæt ved offentlig transport.

We are so happy with the apartment! Spacious and very clean! The kitchen has a cool design and a big table where we all (8people) could fit to sit and chat. We all slept very well in the beds. The entrance/living room area is spacious and has a radio/cd-player so we could play our own music via Bluetooth. Good contact with Homaris, always answered quick and happy to help. The area is filled with cafès, pubs, restaurants and many shops for pretty much anything nearby. Close to Boxhagner park where you can sit and have a picnic or  just bring your book. Amazing accommodation, I recommend!
Apartment is exactly as advertised. Location is good too, less than 5 mins walk for bus station and grocery store, and 10-15 mins walk to Ostkreuz station.
The area and the house are both amazing, i’ve enjoyed my stay at Pigi’s very much! Thank you for the recommendations, hope to see you again! ☺️

Ena’s flat was really perfect, well located, in a super quiet street facing the nice Pankow Bürgerpark. Everything you need is nearby, connection to Berlin center is very convenient - would highly recommend!

Spacious, clean Apartment. Quite central to bakeries, small grocery stores, park, public transit, Pubs etc. Werner was a great Host with thougjhtful touches, eg. maps, books about Germany and various attractions etc totally recommend him.

とても素敵なハウスでした!
一部屋だけドアがないこと、掃除がチェックイン時間を過ぎていたことがよくありませんでした。
ハウスの周りは良いカフェが多いし、アクセスも良くてすごく良いです。
どうもありがとうございました!

Kleine Unterkunft; sehr zentral gelegen, daher nicht ganz so ruhig, aber auch nicht störend laut;   kostenlose Parkplätze auf der Straße; Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Nähe, Flexibler Check-In und Check-Out auf Anfrage; Kommunikation sehr gut; alles vorhanden, was nötig ist; Wohnung empfehlenswert.
Kleine, aber sehr schöne Wohnung in einem wunderschönen Berliner Altbau. Tolle Lage.

Die Wohnung ist top, sehr sauber, gut ausgestattet, sehr gut an die U-Bahn angebunden. Antworten kamen immer sehr schnell und Check-in und Check-Out hat super geklappt. Alles in allem eine TOP Unterkunft und ich kann sie absolut weiterempfehlen!
Echt super :)

Квартира хорошая, недалеко от метро и супермаркетов.
Спасибо Бену за быстрые ответы.
Die Unterkunft war genau wie beschrieben, sie gehörte am Buchungstag zu den günstigsten Angeboten.
Great place, great host!

War ok, die Empfangsdame war wirklich nett und hilfsbereit.
Es war soweit auch sauber und alles vor Ort, was man benötigt. Dennoch müsste man hier und da mal noch ein paar Euro in die Wohnung investieren.
Vor allem abdunkelnde Vorhänge, die Wohnung ist ab 5 Uhr taghell gewesen. Die Dusche ist leider ein Desaster, kaum Druck, das Wasser läuft an den Seiten der Brausen raus…
Was aber unbedingt einmal neu muss, ordentliche Matratze und Kissen (diese vor allem), es sind keine Kissen mehr, sondern nur noch Stofffetzen…
Für einmal zu 4. vollkommen ok, wieder buchen würde ich sie nicht.

This place is great! It was very clean & peaceful. The kitchen is well stocked & everything works as it should. The view of Berlin Lofts is pretty through the windows & the loft is charming.
The host was very kind & helpful whenever I had a question. We were also quite close to major attractions in Berlin. I would highly recommend this AirBnB to anyone staying in Berlin!

Ich hab mich super wohl gefühlt. Sabrina ist eine fürsorgliche Gastgeberin, die sich für alle Fragen Zeit nimmt und für alle Probleme Lösungen findet. Dabei kommt das Lachen und persönliche Gespräche nicht zu kurz. Das Zimmer war super, genug Platz, um alle meine Sachen bequem zu deponieren. Hab gut geschlafen, das Bett war sehr bequem.
Kann das Zimmer nur weiterempfehlen - danke liebe Sabrina !

Great room in a quiet and clean apartment.
you have the balcony to yourself which is a big advantage. located near the tram which leads to Alexanderplatz in 12 minutes. neighborhood is quiet and has restaurants and supermarkets in 3-8 min walking time. the only downside is that there is no actual dining table, I used to have my breakfasts in the balcony which is fine for warmer days but less relevant for winter.
host was super cooperative and helpful beyond expectations - always responding promptly. he even helped me out, being home and accepting a delivery of my lost luggage.

This place was perfect for my stay in Berlin. Really close to the Ubahn which was 10 minutes to central. Comfortable bed, beautiful cosy space. Shops close by to get food supplies. I recommend staying here if you want a lovely quiet space close enough to the city centre. Found a beautiful cafe called mirage with great breakfast a 5 minutes walk away. Thank you! I would definitely stay again x

Wir haben 2 Nächte in Olgas Wohnung übernachtet um unsere Kinder zu Weihnachten in Berlin zu besuchen. Alles hat völlig problemlos geklappt, Check-in war prima mit Schlüsselbox, die Wohnung ist sauber, das Haus und Grundstück sehr schön, wir waren sehr zufrieden!

Abbiamo alloggiato per 5 giorni, posizione molto comoda per tutto, mezzi pubblici, ristoranti, bar e servizi.
Franziska è stata disponibile e non abbiamo avuto nessun problema di comunicazione.
Dall'appartamento è facilissimo raggiungere Alexanderplatz, circa 15 minuti a piedi e nemmeno 5 minuti in metro!!!

The apartment is beautiful. Perfect place to stay. Björn was a very welcoming host, friendly and polite. Everything worked as it should. The area is lovely, lots of life, restaurants and little shops. Highly recommended!
Super unkomplizierter Aufenthalt. Tolle Unterkunft, ruhige Lage, kurzfristige Buchung möglich gewesen, sowieso abweichender Check-out nach Absprache.
Top notch, everything is as per description. View was bad but otherwise satisfied
Did what is said it would, ideal
Espaço perfeito para grupos grandes, para quem gosta de fazer refeições em casa e com pontos turísticos a menos de 20 minutos a pé.
Wir wurden sehr freundlich in der Wohnung empfangen und uns die Regeln erklärt. Die Wohnung ist hell und sehr ruhig. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.  Vielen Dank
everything was fine for few nights
sehr schöne Unterkunft

Die Unterkunft von Moni und Uve ist zusammen gefasst wirklich empfehlenswert.
Lage: Ruhig gelegen in einem Wohngebiet mit großem Park in der Nähe. Fußweg 5 Minuten zur S Bahn, wo man alles schnell erreichen kann.
Wohnung: Sehr sauber und liebevoll eingerichtet. Die Küche und Bad sind sehr gut ausgestattet.
Gastgeber: Uns wurden alle Wünsche erfüllt und darüber hinaus noch einiges mehr, an was wir gar nicht gedacht haben. Es war rund um perfekt!

Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und die Absprache bezüglich des Check-Ins war flexibel und unkompliziert. Lisa hat sich ebenfalls bei uns erkundigt, ob alles in Ordnung sei und auch bei Fragen hat sie diese schnell beantwortet.
Stylish, great location and friendly staff
This was the perfect sanctuary to come back to in the evenings. Very functional and very clean. Communication with host was easy. Highly recommend.

Great house in an excellent location, near to Bus and S-Bahn stations. Neukölln itself is a such lovely neighborhood, worthy of a walking tour. Heidi is a very lovely and friendly person, to talk with her is a real pleasure. In resume: excellent place to stay and rest in Berlin! Thanks for all, Heidi, you're a must!!!
Lovely place: friendly quiet neighborhood, perfect for sleeping, but also very close to U-bahn, Deutsche Oper, running routes by the river, the Schloss.  great value.

I absolutely loved the apartment! The location is perfect with a beautiful view. Comfortable, safe and in a great neighborhood. It had everything I needed. Ivos was a great host. I truly felt wonderful in this apartment.
Highly recommended!
A fantastic location -- buses and trains are a short walk away, and you can walk to a lot of the big attractions in Berlin. Martin was really helpful and responsive with the check-in.
Alles super! Wir kommen gerne wieder!

The very best thing of staying over at Dagmar's, was been treated like family. This was my first time using airbnb and I couldn't be happier with the results. From my host, to the many friends of her that I was introduced to; every single one of them were friendly and genuinely pleased to meet and help their clueless visitor. My room was comfty; the s-bahn station was less than a 10 minute walk from Dagmar's home. She even prepared breakfast and gave me directions on how to go about the city. The only regret I have was not been able to spend more time with her due to her work schedule and me visiting during the week. All in all, every thing was absolutely wonderful and I felt at home. Can't recomend her enough!

Oliver set up a WhatsApp group before the trip with directions for getting to the unit and to organise check-in, plus any further questions during the stay. Oliver's father was waiting at the unit on my arrival and showed me the unit and how everything works plus gave city maps including transport directions. Olivers father was there again to assist with check-out. Bus into the city centre is ~5-10 minutes walk away. The extra assistance makes it a very easy place to stay!

Hi Carolin/Philipp,
es war wie immer einfach perfekt !
Besten Gruß und schönen Abend
Rainer

Timothy war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit, unkompliziert. Wir waren zwar nur 2 Nächte dort, jedoch stimmt das Preis/Leistungsverhältnis was über die Lage (Erdgeschoss und das Zimmer ist sehr dunkel) hinwegsehen lässt. Unterkunft kann mit ruhigen Gewissen empfohlen werden.

היתה אחלה שהות, בהתחלה הייתי בקומה ראשונה, לאחר שהעבירו אותי לקומה 3 היה מעולה.
קיבלתי מענה מיידי ופתרון מיידי.

Alexandra is a really great host. She received us with the greatest enthusiasm and kindness. The apartment is nice. It was quite warm, but Alexandra provided us with fans, which was a lifesaver. The beds are hard; too hard for us. The area is great; close to lots of wonderful places to eat, and wonder around. The S-bahn is literally around the corner.

Ganz schönes kleines Zimmer mit eigenem Bad mitten in Berlin! Franziska ist super lieb, lässt einen aber auch in Ruhe, was wir sehr angenehme fanden.
Die Wohnung ist direkt an einer S-Bahn Haltestelle und es sind total viele Ressourcen, Läden, usw. fußläufig erreichbar.
Danke für die tolle Zeit!!
El piso es inmejorable. La comunicacion con los anfitriones y la entrega de llaves tambien estupenda. Repetiria sin duda.
Max was extremely kind and accommodating. I really enjoyed my stay and will look to book again when I return to Berlin.

A wonderful, sunny and comfortable appartment with a cozy, modern and homely feel. Very clean and has everything one might need for a short or long stay. The host is very friendly, welcoming and communicative, making sure the guests have everything they need and that they feel good. The place is located in a quieter quarter, but in walking distance from sights, train station, restaurants, cafes, and more busy streets. I would definitely recommend and return there in the future.
Great little place! Check in was super easy, and the location was really convenient.
Sehr ruhige Lage, sauber, alles gut

Sven and Eliza are excellent hosts! Sven’s home is clean and convenient for seeing all of Berlin by foot or public transport. There is also a lot in the immediate neighborhood (groceries, coffee, beer garden, restaurants, and an exceptional martial arts gym called Fenriz for any fitness enthusiasts!). Sven is communicative and helpful with any questions. A welcoming place to stay!

Die Wohnung ist schön gelegen, im guten Wedding 😉 Das Haus ist sehr gepflegt. Die Wohnung befindet sich im Hinterhaus Erdgeschoss. Dadurch ist es sehr ruhig trotz zentraler Lage, aber dementsprechend ist die Wohnung auch etwas dunkel. In der Wohnung ist alles neu (Küche, Bad) und alles war sauber. Die Kommunikation mit Ivo war sehr schnell und gut.

Excelente ubicación que te permite conocer Berlin excéntrico y poco tradicional! J’ai adoré 🤗.
A 8/10 minutos hay Dos estaciones que utilice mucho para ir hacia la parte turística de Berlín y también al aeropuerto.

This place is very well located! In the middle of Prenzlauer Berg, well connected to public transport. Taking the M10 brings you from train to flat in only about half an hour!
It is located in the ground floor of a relatively small courtyard. You do almost not hear any street sounds, but in the morning there’s is a lot of movement and quite some rumble in the courtyard itself (from the other tenants passing by and discarding garbage sacs). If you don’t want to sleep late, this doesn’t matter. The place itself is spacious, very clean and well equipped. You can cook in the comfortable kitchen (if you don’t want to try the numerous and varying restaurants close-by) and the dishwasher is an asset. Think about bringing or buying capsules for the Nespresso machine. Some tea bags and powder coffee from former users was there, but at our arrival there were no coffee caps.
Berlin — and this part of town especially — has so much to offer, that you don’t miss the TV. The living- & bedroom is a bit dark, which could be an issue, if you want to spent time “at home” to work or read. On the other hand, it is a help to sleep well in the very comfortable bed.
The check-in and -out are very uncomplicated, their was a prompt response on mails or messages. We didn’t require much of tips or ideas to spent time, since I am very familiar with the area. Information is however present.
Good quality-price balance.

Een zeer fijne locatie. Openbaar vervoer vlakbij, biowinkel aan de overkant, vegan restaurants, fantastische buurt, Friedrichshain. Ook snel naar Mitte en alle toeristische attracties, als je dat wilt. De accommodatie wat netjes en schoon, op een beetje stof na. Zeer praktisch georganiseerd en volautomatisch.
Un super logement, propre, avec salle de jeux, c’est vraiment top je reviendrai
Nice apartment next to Schlosspark. There are big living room and bedroom,  kitchen is small, but you can find almost everything to cook. I liked my staying there.

Susana gave us a warm welcome on our arrival to her apartment, which is only 15 minutes walk into the centre of Berlin. The bedroom is quite big and very airy,  the bed was so comfortable and there was no night noise from the street.  The shower room is small but very manageable and there were no problems in sharing with S and her lovely son.  The bedrooms are separated by a long corridor and it feels as though you are in a private apartment.  We sat out on the small balcony very often which overlooked the pretty tree filled street.   We look forward to returning for another relaxed stay.
Excellent séjour ! Logement parfait pour un couple ! 😊
Kleine, grüne Oase mit guter Öffi Anbindungen. Das Zimmer ist genau wie auf den Fotos. Alles ist sauber und unkompliziert. Wir würden wiederkommen :)
Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft. 👍
Mooi appartement in een zeer rustige lokatie
Place was great I have only issue with the check in
The location was superb! Max and Sophie really know how to make you feel right at home!

Great, convenient apartment if you are travelling for weekend and short stays. Area is hip with lot of great restaurants and cafes around. Very vibrant neighbourhood! Fully recommend for traveling quick and on the budget.

Perfect location, very close to everything you need and want during your stay. But still feels very peaceful and relaxing when you’re in the apartment or garden area!
The home itself feels very unique and creative! Everywhere you look there’s something interesting to look at! Loved our stay!
exquisite, spacious, minimalistic but even ironing board included
Eine großzügige Wohnung in einer der schönsten Gegenden in Berlin.  Die Wohnung war sauber, die Betten bequem und die Küche gut ausgestattet, sodass man alles hat, was man benötigt vor Ort.

El alojamiento es tal y como figura en el anuncio, esta muy cerca del metro y a pocas paradas del centro de Berlin, una ciudad que nos ha encantado, tanto por su historia como por la vida y cultura que transmite.
Great location and a nice spacious room
Matthias and Michele were lovely hosts, and we highly recommend staying at their flat. It is clean and in a great neighborhood!
Sehr schöne Wohnung mitten in der Stadt. Würden jederzeit wiederkommen.
A few steps away from KaDeWe and a perfect area in general!! We really liked the apartment. It is perfect for a short trip to Berlin.
Super gelegen, Parkplatz gleich nebenan, tolle grosszügige Wohnung

Es hat uns super gut gefallen. Die Lage ist schön zentral aber trotzdem ist es schön ruhig! Das Apartment war sehr sauber und gemütlich eingerichtet. Badezimmer und Küche waren top ausgestattet!
Immer wieder gerne in dieses Apartment :)

Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben und man kam mit der U-Bahn überall hin.
Wünsche dem Team um Marcel alles Gute!
Eine wirklich sehr schöne Wohnung. Ich kann dieses Airbnb nur weiterempfehlen.

Lydia and Chris are the most kind and sincere person I have ever met. They are not only my landlords, but also truly friends for me. The house is very beautiful and tidy. I love the perfect atmosphere of Lydia’s family, which made this period become my best time spent in Europe. I won’t forget how much help they have given to me. I feel so lucky to be a guest in Lydia’s house. Best experience ever!
Gemütlich & zentral :)

ci siamo trovati molto bene.
il posto è abbastanza centrale e ben collegato alla metro U6 e ai vari bus.
per quanto riguarda il pernottamento, entra molta luce la mattina quindi abbiamo faticato un po’ a dormire.
pulizia discreta: era presente qualche ragnatela.
l’host è stato super disponibile e ci siamo trovati benissimo.
abbiamo chiesto di allungare il soggiorno per qualche ora visto che avevamo trovato un volo di notte e ci è stato dato.
grazie
Super schöne Wohnung in bester und schönster Lage. Die Gastgeber sind super nett, schnell und hilfsbereit. Zum Abschied gab es sogar eine Tüte mit Proviant für die Heimfahrt. Sofort wieder

We stayed a week in Elisabeth’s place. Everything was as expected. They area is quiet with young families and suitable for our needs. Connections to other parts of the city are good though we mostly walked to things we wanted to visit, which was also easy. I recommend this place for couples who wants a nice and quiet holiday in Berlin a little outside the more vibrant neighborhoods.

Goed hostel/appartement op goed bereikbare locatie met U-Bahn Station om de hoek.
Fijne rustige afgesloten tuin waar kinderen rustig kunnen spelen zonder dat ze de straat op kunnen rennen.

Excellent, clean, comfortable studio. A bit out from the centre but fast and frequent train service a short walk away. Choice of two nearby supermarkets and a good doner kebab stall by the station. A very friendly and attentive host. What more could you want?

I would highly recommend staying here when you are in Berlin. Everything was exactly as advertised. The entire place was spotless.
Getting around is easy, no matter how you want to move around. There is parking nearby if you are with a car; a bus and metro station just a few minutes walk.
My whole family loved the apartment, especially my mom who is obsessed with cleanliness.
We know exactly where we are staying if we are ever in Berlin again

My stay at Zana’s was pleasant. He was flexible with the arrival and waited me.
The house is clean and what you see in the photos is what you get.
My stay was very short, so I cant speak of the zone, but seemed a peaceful place.

Sophia was extremely clear, available & generous in her hospitality. Not only did I find the place so supportive & comforting as I navigated a pivotal moment in my life, I feel I made a new friend. Thank you Sophia 🙏❤️

It’s a great hostel : bed are confortable, rooms are spacious, lights are well designed and powerfull. The sharing areas (bar, tables of living-room, sofas in the courtyard are really apreciated and clean. But one thing that has to be improved are the douches. My private douch was not very easy to use and couldn’t control effectively the debit of water : too violent !

I had a fantastic stay at Mathias Airbnb! The space was clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything I needed. The location was perfect—close to [mention nearby attractions] but still quiet and peaceful.
Mathias was very responsive and provided great local tips. I highly recommend this place and would definitely stay again!

Ha sido muy hospitalario, amable y atento tanto antes de la llegada como al estar en Berlin con él. Como única posible mejora, intentaria dar alguna facilidad para dejar las maletas en caso de pasar todo el dia. Pero por lo general muy bien y muy agusto con Axel.
For my wife and I this was our first trip to Europe and Germany; lives the local feel of the neighborhood, close to a lot of great shopping and cafes. Would definitely stay here again!
Kleine , aber feine Unterkunft in Berlin -Zehlendorf ; 5Min. zur U-Bahn. Gastgeber sehr nett und unkompliziert .Kommen gerne wieder .

Nice location, being on the top floor with no elevator sucks but we knew that going in. Appliances like dishwasher and washing machine are rather cheap and the buttons feel like they're about to break, but they didn't. New portable air conditioners were installed the day we arrived. They worked perfectly during the 100 degree days we had. A tram stop right across the intersection connects to Alexanderplatz.
The place was modern, clean, everything you need for a weekend stay in Berlin. Also, close to metro station so it’s easy to get to your desired places very fast.

Petra behandelt ihre Gäste wie gute Freunde, ohne aufdringlich sein. Die sehr guten Bewertungen, die sie bisher erhalten hat, stimmen alle. Die Altbauwohnung ist sehr geschmackvoll und originell eingerichtet, das große Gästezimmer auch. Die Lage ist ruhig, der Autoverkehr sehr gering. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind nahebei, der Weg nach Mitte und zum Bahnhof Zoo unkompliziert und schnell. Petra ist eine Superhost im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes. Immer wieder, wenn ich in Berlin bin!
The place was nice and clean and I received timely responses from Katharina.
Good hostel

We wanted to feel like we had our own Berlin apartment for a week, and that's what we got.  Great neighborhood -- lively with people walking around living their daily lives during the day but not at all noisy.  Very quiet at night.  Close to all kinds of good things to explore.   Apartment was as exactly as described.  Communications were exceptionally clear.
This was a perfect place to stay!
Right in front of the Wedding S-Bahn station. Clean room and washroom. Kitchen was well equipped.

L'appartamento era pulito, ordinato e accogliente. La zona era centrale e ben collegata e poi la vista sulla Torre della televisione: impagabile! Douglas si è mostrato e reattivo, anche flessibile nell'orario di check out. Da ritornarci!

The apartment is amazing. Big and spacious, very comfortable, everything was clean and well equipped.
It's also very quiet, despite the fact that building is on a very busy street, and next to a bar. The apartment is located way in the far back of the entrance, through a couple of inner yards, and it's very peaceful and quiet.
The location could not be more perfect. A cool lively neighborhood with lots of bars, cafés, restaurants, shops, and immediate access to public transport that reaches anywhere in Berlin, very easily.
Björn was attentive and helpful. My flight was delayed and I arrived close to midnight, but this was handled beautifully and efficiently, checking in and out was a breeze and very comfortable.
I highly recommend this place.

Well-appointed rooms/apartments (blurs the line) in a central location. Well-stocked kitchen with nice touches like coffee, sugar, olive oil, and a French press.
You may need to put up with street noise if you're on a low floor and want ventilation at night, but this is otherwise fantastic.
Deep bathtub, no noise from other tenants, recycling and composting facilities out back (a nice option to have), and responsive service.
buona posizione, centrale, pulito e servizi tutti vicinissimi
Svarer helt til beskrivelse; pænt og velfungerende, men med lidt larm fra gaden / ligger direkte i gadeplan (det er en gammel butik, som er lavet om).

The place is just like described. Great location to almost everywhere. Noisy because of the train and the surroundings. But if the windows are closed, then no annoying noise. The place needs some maintenance, I communicated the host about a problem and he said he was working to solve the problem. He was very responsive and helpful.
Great apartment , warmly recommended

Wir waren erneut bei Kerstin zu Gast und haben uns wieder sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist absolut gemütlich und komfortabel und mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht. Ein absolutes Kleinod in Berlin, das durch die ruhige Lage in Karlshorst und die schöne Einrichtung total zum entspannen einlädt. Trotzdem ist man schnell mit der S-Bahn in der Stadt und hat mit der Wuhlheide auch direkt einen großen Park in der Nähe.
Kerstin hat auch unserer Tochter mit Babywanne usw. den Aufenthalt versüßt und uns zusätzliches Gepäck erspart - man fühlt sich hier einfach willkommen und wie bei Freunden. Für uns definitiv the place to stay in Berlin.;-)

Freundliche und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin, die sich um ihre Gäste sorgt. Hat uns sogar einen Fahrdienst angeboten. Ruhige Lage und doch ziemlich nah an S-Bahn bzw. Bus zum ZOB und dem Olympiastadion. Danke an die Gastgeberin.

Wir hatten eine super Zeit in Berlin. Unser Reisegrund war famiIiärer Natur. Die Wohnung ist super schön mit liebevollen details eingerichtet. Vol funktionsfähige Küche gute Betten und insbesondere die Fensterbanklounge mit der hineinscheinenden Sonne - ein Highlight für unsere 2 Wochen alte Enkeltochter. Wir kommen gerne wieder und können für Kulturevents auch die Superlage nutzen. Top

Der Aufenthalt in der Wohnung war sehr gut. Wir waren zu viert in der Wohnung, diese war von der Größe her perfekt. Die Lage der Wohnung ist durch die Anbindung an Bus und Ringbahn für uns ideal gewesen. Die Kommunikation mit Thomas hat gut geklappt und wir hatten dort eine schöne Zeit.
Séjour très agréable, appartement très propre et bien situé. A recommander
Fantastic building, lovely stay

Lovely clean central space. Exactly as we expected. Very fast communication and accommodating when we requested a late check out. Would stay here again the next time we visit. A full length mirror in the bedroom would be a convenient addition. But overall we were very comfortable and pleased with our stay.
Angenehm ruhige Lage und nicht so weit weg von der Ubahn. Die Küche war kleiner als erwartet aber vollkommen ausreichend. Insgesamt eine schöne Unterkunft.
Tolles Designjuwel in guter ruhiger Lage. Restaurants, Bars ein großer Supermarkt  und alles was man braucht in der Nähe. Gerne wieder 🙂

We had a nice stay in this apartment for our Berlin trip and the communication with Martin was easy.
There are many transports available at a 5 to 15 min walk distance to go around the city, a supermarket (Lidl) around the block and the neighbourhood is quiet so it was perfect for us.
On a side note, regarding the sleeping arrangement, especially if you are more then two, please note that the bed mattress is extremely soft while the convertible sofa in the living room was too hard for our friend to sleep on. She prefered to sleep in the other convertible sofa in the bedroom. In the end it worked well for us but it might matters to some.
Stets gerne wieder. Erste klasse!

Bereits das zweite Mal Gast.
Ich wurde wieder sehr freundlich von Barbara in Empfang genommen und habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Top Lage mit schönen Restaurants in der Nähe.
Danke und bis bald :)

Ich war für einen kurztrip in Berlin und sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft
Hat alles super geklappt :)
Für Berlin preislich vermutlich total in Ordnung

A nice clean tidy apartment , great shower, all amenities I needed . The location is a bit away from the Center but the connections into the Town and TXL via bus excellent. Great value for money, good communications and very clean. The front road a little noisy and I’ve suggested a fan in case it’s really hot but I was fine.
Would stay again , thanks to Mina and her team

Wunderschöne, außergewöhnliche, moderne Wohnung in top Lage am Prenzlauer Berg! Stadtzentrum mit der Bahn in 10 Minuten zu erreichen..Angelika ist für Fragen immer zu erreichen.
Wir kommen gerne wieder!

We loved our stay in Victoria’s apartment! Check in and out were easy, the apartment was clean, cozy, and very quiet. Great area with plenty of fantastic cafes, bars and restaurants in walking distance, but still peaceful and low key. We have already recommended this apartment to friends and look forward to our next visit!
excellent choice

L'appartement d'Arno correspond en tout point au descriptif, il est idéalement situé dans Berlin  à la fois par sa proximité de la station de métro très centrale dans le réseau de transports urbains mais aussi par son implantation dans le quartier de Kreuzberg. Il faut souligner que la proximité d'un marché de producteurs est très agréable.

Danke Veronica und Jochen,
Leider haben wir Veronica nicht kennengelernt aber Der Jochen war jederzeit da für uns.
Wir gehen gerne wieder.
Es ist viel mehr vorhanden als geschrieben ist.
Also sehr großzügig
Grüße Ali
Personal sehr freundlich und nett, kann es nur weiter empfehlen.

Zimmer modern und gemütlich und sauber. Zum Einchecken mussten wir zur Rezeption links neben dem Eingang, das wurde uns leider vorher nicht gesagt. Auf Nachrichten bekamen wir keine Antworten. Der Rezeptionist war aber sehr freundlich. Nach dem Check in haben wir uns dann aber sehr wohl gefühlt
Nice cosy room in a well connected area of Berlin. Everything was as described in the ad and  Marielle was responsive and attentive all the time
super tolle Lage, besonders gute Kommunikation, schick eingerichtet, sehr zu empfehlen

Allotjar-se a Numa Stays Novela a Berlín és garantia de tenir: intimitat, una habitació amb bany propi i un confort bo. L’habitació és moderna, l’edifici net, molt a prop dels llocs més emblemàtics i amb un detall de benvinguda. Seria com una habitació d’hotel sense recepció presencial però amb facilitat d’accés lliure, serveis extres i amb normes i informació clares. Potser li faltaria un armari per guardar la roba, que nosaltres no hem aconseguit veure. Però en general, el meu marit i jo en general no tenim gaires comentaris negatius. Ans el contrari és perfecte si es vol anar per lliure.
Ara bé, hem trobat a faltar una comunicació més propera per whats app amb Numa. Els dubtes que vam comentar per aquesta via es van resoldre mitjançant un assistent virtual i feia que la informació fos curta i poc detallada. Això és la única cosa que comentaríem com a punt a millora en aquesta estada.
Però, de manera global, hem tingut una estada agradable i recomanem Numa Novela Berlín als demés.

Barbara's place was lovely, just like the pictures. Even though it's a pull down bed there was plenty of room. The bathroom was amazing, I'm fussy about bathrooms abroad but Barbara's was super clean, modern and beautiful! Her place is 2/3 minute walk to the nearest tram stop so getting around was easy and only 2 stops to Alexanderplatz where most lines go from. Also round the corner there is a massive supermarket to fill all your needs! Barbara was amazing with communication prior to the trip and during. The wifi had problems on our first day but Barbara kept communication and was even offering to come round the next morning to fix it completley however it quickly starting working again. Could not recommend this Airbnb enough, the apartment and Barbara herself are lovely !

Die Lage war traumhaft. Direkt in der City und trotzdem ruhig im Hinterhaus gelegen. Klasse Kommunikation. Modern eingerichtet mit Altbau Charme. Kleiner Garten zum chillen (könnte gepflegter sein, aber ist ja ein Gemeinschaftsgarten). Entspannte Gastgeberin. Gern wieder. Vielen Dank
Buongiorno host super retrivo gentile e preciso l’appartamento è come da descrizione. La posizione è prima vicino a tutti i servizi sia per spostarsi che per i supermercati
Stay was great, no issues. Done exactly what it said on the tin

Amazing place to stay! Mina was super nice and allowed us to early check in since we had to work. Check in and check out are super easy and apartament is super nice and has everything needed! We will certainly be back!
this place is fantastic, large, spacious and central to Berlins kreuzberg district!  Denitsa was a wonderful host and made sure check in was easy with no fuss.  Highly recommended!
Great stay with such a helpful host!!
I had an amazing stay at Elisa’s airbnb! I was in town (traveling alone) to run the Berlin Marathon. One of the best Airbnb’s I’ve stayed at.
Super Lage, unkomplizierter Check-In, saubere Unterkunft und eine sehr freundliche und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin - ideal für einen kurzen Aufenthalt.

Wonderful location near the kottbusser tor and space was designed beautifully. Self check-in was easy and comfortable. I thank Philipp for his communication and recommendations, would definitely stay here again.
Super Unterkunft, alles vorhanden und super einfache Kommunikation. Hat alles so geklappt wie ich es mir vorgestellt habe.

We had a lovely stay in Berlin at this air b and b. Very tidy and clean, and excellent communication. We were also able to store our bags after check out which was very east and smooth! Thanks so much!

Alles Super, sehr sympathischer Gastgeber, gern wieder! Die Unterkunft ist gemütlich, in einem Topzustand, sehr sauber.
A very friendly host, very helpful. The room is in a very good condition, comfortable and like the bathroom perfectly clean.
Very nice room with a great cafe downstairs. It is a shared space but Denise and Jürgen are great. Only complaint would be there is no lock on the door.
Great place, wow that bathroom! great shower :) cozy outside too :) we were 5 people, in my opinion would be a but small for 6people
Great location, nice fixtures and a layout most suited for close friends or a family. It is a true rental property.
Good apartments, hospitality and communication. Convenient place but a bit noisy environment.
Fantastic location, brilliant apartment, cool industrial modern decor, had a fab time with wife and older kids. Would definitely book to stay here again.

I arrived at 14:00 hoping to leave my luggage, officially check in wasn’t until 17:00. The receptionist checked and found a vacant room in order to check me in early at no extra cost which was very kind. Everything else was as advertised, really clean and comfortable, great location.
alles super

Christoph's place is excellent!! Well located (the tram was just under 5 mins walk which takes you directly to the city centre), warmly furnished with everything you need. The unit was spacious and the kitchen was well equipped. We had a wonderful and comfortable stay and Christoph was friendly, hospitable, helpful and gave us all the tips of what to do, places to visit etc. and even helped up get around in Berlin!
Our only regret was that we didn't stay longer - so will have to make another trip again!
Thanks Christoph for a really great stay!
The flat was clean and had everything I needed for a comfy stay:)) The instructions were super clear, so everything was easy. Would happily stay again 🤍

An amazing place hosted by Nicole, with a beautiful surrounding area, not far from the city center (Kaiserdamm station is less than a 5 min walk), nor far from the main attractions.
The apartment is tidy, cozy, with plenty of options inside, she has ever a massage seat.
I strongly recommend this place, worthy of every cent.
Great location & everything you need

Bei Anreise mit Auto: Parken in der Boxhagener Straße und somit auch vor dem Haus ist verboten, das Ordnungsamt kontrolliert 2x täglich, das kostet dann 55 €.
Zu empfehlen ist das Parkhaus im Victoria Center, 12€× pro Tag

Birgit was very kind to us!
She was always helpful if we had any questions. She treated us with goodies.
Her apartment looked amazing! Very clean and cozy!
This apartment and the owners were one of the main experiences in Berlin!
We were happy that we’d chosen this option.
Walking around the area, coming home was a pleasure.
We were full of emotions.
Thank you for everything, Birgit! ❤️

Stefan and Suzan have a beautiful home, the perfect base to explore Berlin! The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. Stefan and Suzan were excellent communicators, very proactive and responsive. We very much enjoyed our stay, thank you for having us!
Schöne Wohnung in super Lage!

El apartamento era muy grande por lo que para nuestro grupo de 8 personas fue perfecto. Aunque no se encuentra muy cerca del centro, se podía ir en transporte público hasta cualquier parte de la ciudad, había una parada de autobús a 5 minutos de la casa y otra de tren a 15 minutos.
Fueron muy amables teniendo listo el apartamento antes de la hora prevista de checkin por lo que pudimos ir antes al apartamento a dejar las maletas y así aprovechar la tarde visitando Berlín.
Volvería a reservar este apartamento en futuras visitas a Berlín.
Все прошло отлично, отдельно хочу отметить отличную работу Suresh на рисепшене.

Value, style, space, convenience; this place has it all!
Once you get a hold of the few nuances of this location (parking, air conditioning, and the extra 200€ deposit required via external website provided in your checking instructions) you’ll quickly be relieved and extremely happy with this beautiful space! Definitely a favorite of mine! Thank you so much! Would definitely stay again. :)
Great Airbnb in kreuzberg!

The place was very comfy! A bit small but okay for two people. Bus stops were about a 6-10 minute walk which was easy and there were heaps of food places nearby. Overall a great place to stay for a few days

Chambre dans un appartement situé au 1er étage, spacieux, lumineux et propre ; grande cuisine équipée et jolie salle de bain que le hôte partage avec vous.
L'appartement se trouve dans un quartier calme, à environ 15 min à pieds d'Alexanderplatz ; vous avez tramway et bus à proximité, un grand supermarché, des restaurants et bars sympas de le quartier.
La ville est charmante, l'hôte est réactif (elle vous donne pas mal d'informations et vous pouvez échanger sur plein de sujets) ; je recommande pour une visite découverte de Berlin.
Good localisation! Transports and supermarkets are very near. I recommend this apartment.

The studio was great. Well equipped and clean. Hosts were really friendly and helpful. This is a block of apartments so the room you get might not look like the picture but the room was still great and the building is beautiful. Location was the absolute best - so good for accessing all the different parts of Berlin. Great stay! Thank you
Charmant petit logement dans un quartier très calme mais un peu loin du centre. Le studio était propre et Carola est vite réceptive à  vos questions.

Bianca ist eine hervorragende Gastgeberin. Hilfsbereit, liebenswert und sie geht gerne auf deine Wünsche ein.
Das Zimmer ist spartanisch, aber absolut ausreichend.
Muy buena la atención y hospitalidad de Helen
It was a beautiful place very clean all the instructions were very clear. Loved it:)

We had a lovely stay at Daniel’s apartment. The check in was easy and it was great for each guest to be able to have their own access with the electronic system. Daniel sent lots of instructions but it still took us some time to understand the first time coming in.
The apartment itself is lovely and spacious, and in an excellent location. Would definitely recommend!
Top Lage - ruhig und trotzdem sehr gut angebunden. Die Gastgeber waren jederzeit für uns erreichbar und sehr freundlich. Wohnung ist top ausgestattet - wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!
Great communication from Jette made our stay very enjoyable. She went above and beyond when we made a last minute error checking out on a Sunday morning. We are so very appreciative.

Mona ist eine sehr nette und aufgeachlossene Gastgeberin, die einem mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht.
Die Wohnung war sehr sauber, Zimmer ist trotz Nähe zum Flughafen ruhig und gemütlich eingerichtet. Ich würde sie auf jeden Fall weiter empfehlen und bei weiteren Aufenthalten in Berlin gerne nochmal auf sie als Gastgeberin zurück kommen!
Mona is a wunderful host with important tipps and experience.
I would always recommend her to my friends and come back for my next stay in berlin.
The flat and room is very clean and in face of the closeness to the airport very quiet.
Monas husband and son are also very friendly and nice.

Zeer vriendelijke host, goed bereikbaar en erg behulpzaam.
Aangenaam, met smaak ingericht en rustig gelegen appartement met gemeenschappelijke binnentuin. De aanwezige kunst en interessante boeken hebben we erg gewaardeerd.
Ligging appartement zeer goed, oa Museuminsel te voet bereikbaar. Op wandelafstand alle nodige openbaar vervoer om overal te geraken. Tip: bus 100 nemen tot terminus en terug met bus 200 geeft een 1e beeld van de stad. Alle nodige winkels in de omgeving alsook eetgelegenheden als je niet zelf wil koken.
Berlijn heeft veel facetten en heeft veel te bieden, een boeiende stad! Wij gaan nog terug!
Great location to explore Berlin
really nice apartment.
very good place
Endroit idéal pour un citytrip à Berlin. A proximité de tous les transports et situé au calme.
Great place, would recommend
Few things to improve. In high season the price is too expensive. I wouldn’t pay more than 50 euros per night.

Stefan was a great host!  There were some complications with my arrival dates, but he did an excellent job of sorting them out and making sure I was well accommodated.  The room is very large, quiet and clean. It completely met my expectations.  I would recommend Stefan's place to anyone looking for a place in the area.
Ich war jetzt schon mehrfach bei Jan und werde auch künftig dort wohnen wollen. Das sagt eigentlich alles...
Sehr herzliche Gastgeber!
Perfect location to visit the city center of Berlin!
Ein sehr schönes Hostel. Gute Lage, sauber und ansprechend eingerichtet. Gute Kommunikation, gerne wieder! Berlin ist immer wieder ein Reise wert, es gibt so viel interessantes zu entdecken!

Es un departamento en pleno centro de Berlín, a un par de cuadras de Alexanderplatz, en el antiguo Berlín oriental. Perfecto para ir a pie a casi todas las atracciones. Está en un piso 15 (con ascensor), lo que da una vista panorámica de la ciudad fabulosa. Andy es muy ordenada y da buenos datos de lugares interesantes para visitar o comprar.
Muy recomendable.

2 of us stayed in the Penthouse, our 2nd AirBnB of the trip, so I had good grounds for comparison. Overall:
Pro's:
1. Looks great inside, just like the photos.
2. Big balcony which overlooks the entrance.
3. All 3 beds were a good, large size.
4. Large TV's in every room.
5. The Internet was fast.
6. Its mainly a commercial building, so the lower floors are businesses, which means evening/weekend its completely empty except you.
7. Ali very kindly let us check in earlier.
Cons:
1. If you don't have a car, it is quite far away from the centre of Berlin. (30min Drive)
2. Nothing really in the area to do in walking distance.
3. Construction in front of the building, which has been there for months.
Loved the seclusion of the place. Very peaceful and idyllic. Felt like I was out in the country. Ulla was a fantastic hostess and made me feel welcome and wanted from the beginning.

Very responsive and helpful hosts! They set up our apartment to be very family friendly, and the location was fantastic for public transport, walkable destinations, and safety.  It is on a busy street, so noisy if one is a light sleeper.  We did not have any problems.

We can mirror what others have said.  Nice apartment in a nice neighborhood.  We arrived much later than expected due to a missed connection at Heathrow, but Heinrich provided easy instructions about where we would find the lockbox for the keys.  We actually met Heinrich later and he was very friendly.  The apartment is not huge but fine for two adults and it is easy to go to the bus stop or walk to the closest S-Bahn station.  Wi-fi can be a bit iffy/slow but we were always able to reconnect and finish our tasks.  We would definitely return again.
Es war eine sehr angenehme Aufenthalt bei Ingeborg. Alles hat gepasst.

I appreciate the welcome and the nice flat of Michael. The room is bright and sunny, the view of the trees and the birds singing are very pleasant. The bathroom and kitchen are perfect. The area is very lively and at night no noise. Easy access to the Ubahn and buses. Plenty restaurants, markets and shops to eat and close to the center of Berlin. I did really enjoy my 2 weeks at Schoneberg.
The apartment was lovely and well connected by public transportation.  Jette who helped us check in was great and very quick to assist us when we have any issues. Highly recommend it!

El apartamento de Claudio es muy acogedor. Típico piso de Berlín con un balcón hacia el patio interior. Los muebles reformados le dan un encanto especial. La cama y almohadas me parecieron muy cómodas. Es un apartamento espacioso y muy cuidado al detalle.
Me sentí como en casa.
Claudio me recibió al llegar, me explicó de un modo muy amable todo lo necesario para que mi estancia fuese perfecta.
Sin duda repetiría!
We've enjoyed our stay!
Super Leute, sehr freundlich und nice Location.
The beds were okay, room was clean. WiFi was pretty much useless, a simple Instagram scroll wasn't possible. The use of the mopads in the city made the location no problem.

Clean, good location, quiet neiborhood, friendly host. We just got a little confused as not all listed photos are from the apartment where we stayed - few photos are from similar apartment (or apartments). Not a big deal, but still confusing. The big deal was to get running hot water at constant temperature (nearly impossible) as it changed from too hot to too cold by unknown forces. Still we enjoyed our stay at Punkti's apartment.

Jörg ist ein völlig unkomplizierter, angenehmer Gastgeber.Entspannt und freundlich wird man begrüßt, die Wohnung ist fix gezeigt und nach einigen örtlichen Empfehlungen für Unternehmungen, kann man seinen Aufenthalt einfach genießen.
Danke für alles.
Thanks you Nick and Ashely it was such a nice vacation!
Matthieu’s place was fantastic! Very spacious, comfortable, and exactly as described. He was very responsive and provided clear, easy to follow check-in instructions. I’d happily stay here again.

Un bel appartement tout neuf, conforme aux photos, dans un quartier typique, bien placé, avec codes d’accès permettant une arrivée à n’importe quelle heure, et des hôtes très réactives en cas de besoin.

Lina’s apartment is beautiful and in a good location. Very comfortable and complete. Lina was very helpful.
Free parking on the street is possible with a bit of luck.

Bel appartement, très spacieux, propre et lumineux, tout à fait en correspondance avec l'annonce. La touche très creative et personnelle de la décoration rend le lieu très acceuillant. Le logement est calme et très bien situé pour découvrir Berlin mais le quartier propose aussi beaucoup de restaurants et l'on trouve une belle ambiance le long du canal juste au bout de la rue ainsi que dans l'oranienstrasse toute proche.  Nous recommandons!

Martin ist ein perfekter Gastgeber! Die Unterkunft liegt super für Unternehmungen in der ganzen Stadt. Die U-Bahn ist ganz nah! Das Zimmer ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet und schön groß! Martin ist sehr hilfsbereit und kümmert sich wirklich prima um seine Gäste! Ich komme gerne wieder!

Wir haben uns gleich sehr wohl gefühlt. Es ist sehr sauber, toll, dass der Empfang 24 Stunden 7 Tage lang geöffnet hat.
Für eine Übernachtung sehr zu empfehlen.

Pascal is a great host. Everything is organized to make it easy.
the apartment is good for one or two nights if, like me, you are with kids as there is only one room with three beds.
it was our last day and we enjoyed it.
Wir haben uns bei Leo superwohl gefühlt und werden jederzeit gerne wiederkommen - tolle Unterkunft und tolle Gastgeber!
Excelente ubicación, fácil acceso al metro, cómodo, amplio, buena decoración.

Jay’s place truly felt like home. The apartment was clean, cozy, and had everything I needed. The neighborhood was quiet and safe, and being just a few minutes from trams 10 and 2 made it super convenient to get around the city.
Jay herself was an amazing host — warm, kind, and always supportive. She really made me feel welcome from day one.
The only (tiny!) downside for me was that the flat is on the 5th floor with no elevator — but honestly, that probably just says more about my laziness 😄. The view from the top totally made it worth it.
Would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommended.

Michael's place is fantastic: it's very homey, comfortable, and we loved the spacious rooms. The apartment offers everything one needs, the kitchen is better equipped than our own, and it is very quiet. The location is really great, too, because there are two train stations nearby which make it easy to use public transportation. All in all, we enjoyed our stay enormously and would definitely stay in Michael's apartment again.

Mert and his girlfriend were lovely and made me feel very welcome.
The place was absolutely spotless. Although I only needed it for a couple of hours to take a shower and sleep before attending a work event in Berlin, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay.
The bed was very comfy and wide, ensuring a perfect 10/10 sleep haha
The room is small, but it perfectly matched my expectations from the listings, making it ideal for a solo traveler seeking a safe place to rest.

Sehr schöne Unterkunft, die super gut ausgestattet ist. Vincent ist ein sehr lieber und freundlicher Gastgeber und hat sich persönlich Zeit genommen, uns die Wohnung zu zeigen. Wir haben uns wie Zuhause gefühlt, es hat an nichts gefehlt! :)

The place is central, very close to the subway U5, very accessible. Imad and his girlfriend really tried to make our stay as easy and confortable as possible, the communication with them was very smooth and they were very discreet during the stay. We didn't get to stay too much at home , but the room is clean, spacious and confortable. Thank you for hosting us!

Eine wirklich schöne Unterkunft. Wir waren mit 11 Personen da und standen uns nicht im Weg. Alles ist künstlerisch und mit der Liebe zu Details eingerichtet. Wir haben uns direkt wohl gefühlt und die Wohnung hat einen ganz eigenen, schönen Charme.
Wir würden diese Unterkunft für viele Personen auf jeden Fall wieder buchen.
Great location to the main sights in Berlin. Easy to find with easy instructions for self check in. A technical issue with the booking was sorted quickly with good communication between all parties.

We loved staying at Anke's place - the flat is beautiful and very spacious, and is in a wonderful location with great transport connections. The host was very responsive when we had questions, and provided really thoughtful touches to make our stay even nicer. Our son loved the local play areas and the nearby cafe also has a kids corner.

Beyond our expectations great! The space is huge and comfortable. Lots of extras and unexpected amenities. Loved this place! Apostolos was super helpful and kind! We would stay here again for sure! Very fun part of the city and great restaurants nearby! This is well worth the money! One of the best places we have stayed at in our 12 years of travel staying in Airbnb’s.
Mohu jen a pouze doporučit!!!

Die sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtete Wohnung liegt im Souterrain eines modernen Hauses mit eigenem Eingang, hat ein bequemes 140x200 Bett, eine gut ausgestattete Küche und eine große bodengleiche Dusche. Στον δρόμο δίπλα από το διαμέρισμα και σε απόσταση 200 μέτρων υπάρχει super market, επιλογές για φαγητό και ακριβώς απέναντι από τον δρόμο βρίσκεται και το δεύτερο μεγαλύτερο πάρκο του Βερολίνου.
Το διαμέρισμα είναι πρακτικά διαμορφωμένο. Έχει μια πλήρως εξοπλισμένη κουζίνα, με όλες τις απαραίτητες ηλεκτρικές συσκευές, τον χώρο διαμονής καθώς και ένα ευρύχωρο μπάνιο.
Η πολυκατοικία εκτός από τον ήχο στο δάπεδο και στις σκάλες, λόγω παλεοτητας, είναι ήσυχο και η γειτονιά επίσης.
Τα σεντονια και οι πετσέτες μοσχοβολουσαν και γενικά φαινόταν καθαρό.
Σίγουρα υπάρχει δυνατότητα βελτίωσης στην κουζίνα και στο μπάνιο.
Αυτό που χρειάζεται άμεσα αλλαγή είναι το στρώμα του κρεβατιού, το οποίο ήταν πολύ λεπτό με αποτελεμμα να νιώθω τις σανίδες του κρεβατιού.
Κατά τα άλλα ειχα μια πολύ ευχάριστη διαμονή!

Auf den Fotos sieht man bereits eine sehr ansprechende Wohnung. In Natura hat mich meine Erwartung noch übertroffen. Eine absolut sauber, und gemütlich eingerichtete Ferienwohnung. Und eine besonders liebevolle und herzliche Gastfreundschaft. Jederzeit gern wieder.

Vladimirs Appartement is the perfect base for a visit of Berlin.

Excellent location with great hosts and easy communication. We loved this place!

Very comfortable with one of the best equipped kitchens I have seen in a rental. Easy walk to check point charlie and the U Bahn.

Nice place easy to find
super séjour chez Peter et Vera qui sont des hôtes gentils, attentionnés et de très bonne compagnie.

Die Ausstattung ließ auch kaum zu wünschen übrig und der Balkon Anbau war auch sehr Putzig. Ich empfehle es weiter, hier kann man einfach eine tolle Zeit haben!
Nice and clean appartment
Place is cute and very convenient. Bed is comfortable; bathroom well equipped. Generally clean. Easy to get in and out. Only 1 flight of stairs. Thoughtful gestures. Warm and helpful at welcome.
Totally nice department, placed in the very heart of Berlin. Tastefull decorated and everything nice snd clean. Lovely host.

Well located, very close to a U-Bahn station. The bedroom is big and you have access to the kitchen, where Michael was kind enough to give me some storage possibilities. He was also always very polite and helpful, often answering my questions about anything I could ask.

We had such a wonderful time in this cosy yet spacious apartment. Denislav was extremely helpful and kind and gave us brilliant suggestions for activities around the city. Loved our stay. The studio was the perfect size and a great base to explore the city from. Clean, comfortable, and well-located. We’ll definitely be visiting again soon!

Meine Freundin und ich waren für zwei Nächte dort. Es sieht wirklich wunderschön aus, ist in einer sehr guten Gegend direkt am Mauerpark und es ist sehr sauber. giancarlo ist super sympathisch und hat uns sehr nett entgegengenommen, wir kommen definitiv wieder!

The place was clean and modern, the receptionist in the building was rude.
My second stay here. Very convenient location for whatever you may want to do in the city and Anna was a very genial host.

Appartement calme, lumineux et bien équipé, dans un quartier résidentiel avec bus et métro à proximité. Supermarché et biergarden sympathique tout proches. Nous remercions particulièrement le mari de Katja qui nous a attendu jusqu’à 2h du matin (retard d’avion)! Nous reviendrons avec plaisir

Great large apartment, very cosy and stylish furniture, big tv
René was a great host and supplied us with all that we needed including a baby bed. We stayed there for 4 weeks and had a great time. Also the Location is very convenient as close to 2 metro stations and lots of restaurants close by. Would always come back.
Nice place for my short stay in Berlin. Location was good, with access to two tram lines. Place was very small but comfortable and had everything I needed.
Ruime locatie met 5 slaapkamers voor 6 personen gelegen in een rustige omgeving, bereikbaar met openbaar vervoer. 2 badkamers. Een fijne plek om Berlijn te verkennen.

Everything was as described.

un apartamento muy bonito, limpio y moderno.

Beautiful place and calm place just some minutes from the central station.

Alles super, echt empfehlenswert. Sehr nette Gastgeber.

Great host and great place!

I would definitely ask to stay here again when I next visit Berlin. :)
Fantastic host with a great apartment that is perfect for getting around in Berlin!

We had a great stay in Ben&Simon’s apartment. It is very clean and comfortable and the location is perfect. Check in and out was super easy and communication with the hosts was excellent. Will definitely stay again when in Berlin!

The accomodation was perfect and Arzu and Tom were just lovely. There wasnt a microwave but we could manage well without it. Also have in mind that you have to take some extra money to pay a city fee.
Wonderful apartment and hosts! Would definitely return!

appartement propre, propriétaire sympa et emplacement idéal. pour un séjour de courte durée c'est parfait

Recommended. As described. Good value for money. Clean with efficient communication. Reception staff were friendly and helpful.
