Great apartment, excellent location and a flexible host.
Fabelhaft..ich hatte einen super Aufenthalt bei Ute.Die Wohnung ist ein Ruhepol mitten in Berlin.  Die kleine Terasse ist eine Oase in der Stadt... gerne jederzeit wieder.

Geweldige week gehad in Berlijn met de kinderen. Appartement ligt dichtbij het stadscentrum, vlakbij zowel de U-bahn als de S-bahn. Ook vanuit de Hauptbahnhof makkelijk te bereiken. Verder een supermarkt dichtbij.
Apartments were perfectly ready to host 4 guests!
房源位置極佳，房間內做烹飪設備齊全！

Great clean apartment, comfortable bed, excellent location for our needs. Kevin very communicative and fortunately we had no need of any extra help from him during our stay. We would happily stay here on our next trip to Berlin.
Great unit with all amenities. Excellent location with the train and tram next door and shops close buy.

Joe’s place was perfect for our time in Berlin. Location was great, and even though it’s ground floor the apartment was quiet! Joe’s communication was great and everything went smoothly for our entire stay. Highly recommend :)
Nette unterkunft aber es gibt leider kein Wlan
The apartment had everything we needed and a perfect location right next to the subway station.
Super clean, convenient and everything you need. Reasonable price for what you get. Thanks Lena for a great stay and for welcoming us! :-)
definitely worth the stay if you're in Berlin! Nassa was very good with communication

This is a fantastic apartment located in a very peaceful and beautiful area of Berlin among the trees. Robert was a superb host, responding quickly to our correspondence and providing us with information about the local area.
The apartment is extremely well equipped and spotlessly clean. The bed is big and very comfortable and we had everything we needed for a fabulous stay. It was particularly generous of Robert to leave us some bread, wine and beer for our arrival.
Nearby are some lovely forest walks and a little cafe and tut also have the choice of two train stations for the U bahn or S bahn. We would definitely stay here again and recommend this apartment wholeheartedly - thank you Robert!

Nice and quiet appartment in a lovely part of Kreuzberg. Situated nearby shops, cafes and restaurants. Easy to reach with the public transports. We had a very good time staying there during four days.
Host was responsible; apartment was centrally located, and great apartment for a family. We enjoyed.
Nice apartment in a calm and quiet location, Yumi explained everything in detail and made me feel at ease.
Ralf is nice and helpful! The apartment is comfortable and convenient.
Wie immer ein herzlicher Empfang durch die Gastgeber. Die Wohnung bietet alles für einen perfekten Berlin Trip. Wir kommen immer wieder gerne!

As someone who travels often ( work& holiday)
I must say that this has been my favorite place to stay in years.
Location, apartment,hosts have all been immaculate
Klemens and Masuda have a lovely garden apartment in a historic Berlin neighborhood that's convenient by S-bahn to all that Berlin has to offer.

Удобное расположение квартиры, т к.
общественный транспорт пару дней не ездил, можно было пешком дойти до центра (неспеша около часа), чтобы увидеть достопримечательности .

The apartment is located very near bus stops which makes it convenient to go to places. It is located within a walkable distance of tourist attractions like the East Side Gallery. The neighbourhood is quiet and peaceful.
Thomas was responsive and friendly during our stay and communicated with us effectively. He was very flexible and gave us local recommendations which was very helpful! 😊
We enjoyed our stay and would recommend it to anyone visiting Berlin!
The place was nice for a short term stay, it’s very convenience from the bus stop, which is just on some steps. Although I didn’t met Nikolas but he was super responsive. I recommend this place!

Le studio de Julian est atypique. C'est à la fois un logement et un lieu de travail. Très bien aménagé et décoré, il est situé dans une zone d'activité récemment rénovée au nord de Berlin. Aucun problème pour garer sa voiture sur le grand parking et un silence total la nuit puisque vous serez le seul dans les bâtiments ! Le centre de Berlin est situé à 10 kms environ. Une gare ainsi que des commerces sont à 10 minutes à pied. L'accueil a été très sympathique et la communication avec Julian a été parfaite avant et pendant le séjour. Il a trouvé une solution à la panne d'internet et est revenu pour remplacer le matériel. C'est surement un des meilleurs AirBnb de mes vacances et si je reviens à Berlin, j'espère pouvoir y séjourner à nouveau !
zeer vriendelijk en hulpzaam, zeker aan te raden!
Super location, sehr sauber, ruhiger Ort. Wurde ich empfehlen 😊
Super Zimmer! Kann ich nur empfehlen.

Thank you for this stay. We really appreciated the appartment and the neighbourhood. The appartment us very well located. Jürgen is very welcoming and available for all our questions. We fully recommend Jurgen's appartement !
Rien a dire , logement propre, spacieux et très bien situé (3km Alexanderplatz ) , communication parfaite
El apartamento fantástico y sobre todo la atención de los anfitriones .

Es war ein tolle Wohnung und genau wie in der Beschreibung dargestellt. Die Lage ist perfekt um Berlin mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erkundigen. Die Kommunikation mit Frank war jeder Zeit möglich und es wurde sofort hilfsbereit geantwortet. Ich kann es nur weiterempfehlen.

Freundliche und hilfsbereite Gastgeber.
Unterkunft wie beschrieben, hat alles gepasst.

Kristina’s place was great, located in a quite and nice area. Kristina as a host is really friendly and helpful. We were greeted with sweets and the flat had everything we needed, including something for breakfast, tea and coffee in the shelves. Each room was clean and the bed was comfy. Awesome stay, would recommend highly.
Gut für etwas Privatsphäre, ordentliche und gemütliche Einrichtung.

Our work-trip stay in Mia´s flat was truly perfect and great. The apartment is super spacious, with two toilets etc., so we all had our privacy. There is beautiful light and very good atmosphere, so we even fopund inspiration there to writ and work on our film scripts. It made our stay at Berlinale very pleasent. ;) Thank you very much for this.
Dachappartement mit herrlicher Aussicht in guter Wohnlage . Nicht geeignet für Menschen mit Gehbehinderung (4. Etage und offene Schlafempore  und Raumspartreppe)

Die Wohnung ist wunderschön und sehr gut eingerichtet. Katarina war sehr hilfsbereit und gab sehr wertvolle Tipps wie man sich in Berlin gut bewegen kann. Gleich vor der Haustüre fährt ein Bus. Auf jeden Fall werde ich beim nächsten Besuch wieder hier her kommen! Alles perfekt!
We enjoyed our stay at this appartment. Lively neighbourhood from which it is easy to explore Berlin. Tempelhof Parc just around the corner, perfect. Breakfast tip: Selig (3 minutes by foot).

We had a very nice time in Berlin at Anton’s place. The appartment is perfectly located in the right center of the town. The flat is really clean. The kitchen and bathroom are shared, but it gave us a real immersion into local Berlin life :)
Such a great location! So much to see In walkable distances— and amazing restaurants all around. Mia is a wonderful host, very clean and comfortable space- we had a terrific visit!

Die Wohnung von Bensimon Apartments war sehr schön, super sauber, tolle Ausstattung (Tablett in der Küche zum Check-Out und mit Informationen allgemein über die Wohnung/Nachbarschaft) und ruhig gelegen. Alles war sauber. Der Check-In lief über einen externen Link, über den man einen Code für die Tür erhalten hatte. Der einzige negative Punkt ist die Parkplatzsituation. Die Wohnung liegt in einer Fahrradstraße welche den ganzen Tag voll zugeparkt ist. Safür kann die Wohnung an sich natürlich nichts, aber so viel sei zur Lage gesagt.
Wir kommen gerne wieder.
It’s a small place, not suited best for someone my height (I’m only 6ft), I had to lean over a lot. But the location was great and suited what I needed for the short stay
Schöne und zentrale Wohnung!

If you are vegan (or not) this is a fantastic place to stay. There is a vegan grocery store, cafe and restaurant on the corner and the neighborhood is loaded with delightful vegan restaurants like the renowned 1990 Vegan Living. The apartment is sparking clean, very comfortable and convenient to the local train station, trams and such. It’s also just a few blocks from the Berlin Wall and starting places for hop on hop off buses and boats. Highly recommend!

Semras Eltern waren sehr gastfreundlich, unglaublich nett und unkompliziert. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und ordentlich. In der Küche und im Badezimmer hatte man alles, was man braucht. Ich wurde super in Empfang genommen und herzlich verabschiedet. Nächstes Jahr komme ich gerne wieder!
We had a great time at this appartment and would recommend other families to stay in this clean, well appointed space.

We spent a very great time in Berlin. Thankful to the information given by Volker, we have arrived to the flat really easily. Everything was perfect. The flat was very clean and exactly as it was described. There were even surprises in the fridge to welcome us. It is also very well located just 10 mins walk to the subway which is well deserved so that you can get to the city center in 10 mins. If we come back to Berlin we will surely stay at this place again if it is available. Don't hesitate to book, you will not regret it.
Felt like stayed at friend’s, or even better, house is so clean and well maintained — Ugur is the best host you can expect on AirBnb and he made our stay a wonderful experience.
Sehr zufrieden mit allem, super Wohnung und sehr nette Gastgeberin :)

Well-located apartment near a very trendy area. Katrin was quick to respond to questions, the flat was incredibly spacious, and the flamingo theme throughout was a nice touch. Only issues were temperature-related: the shower was very hit-and-miss, and we were quite chilly at times whilst inside. That said, for a big group getaway, this did the job brilliantly.
Alles bestens aber für ein Hostel doch recht hoher Preis.

La habitación es tal cual las imágenes. Limpio, con todo lo necesario para una estancia en Berlín. Y un diseño hermoso! Yvonne fue una muy buena anfitriona. Nos dejo un mapa para poder ubicaros. Parada de metro a dos cuadras, a pocos minutos del centro.
Ideal para una estancia en Berlín.

The accommodation is very good, in a very lively area of ​​Berlin and all necessary shops and bars are nearby. The apartment is clean and quiet although impersonal. Unfortunately, the reception was very quick and limited to essentials. We would have prefered to meet Bernardo in order to discuss on places to visit and places to go out at night.
Beautiful appartment on 5 star location
Super modernes Apartment, stilvoll eingerichtet. Alles super.

Genefer was very pleasant at check-in but we didn't meet Stephan.  We should have done more homework ahead of time about the area.  Apartment seemed clean the short amount of time we were there but the area was not at all what we expected or wanted.  Not much seemed close and we did not stay here, we ended up forfeiting our money we paid for the apartment and left within an hour and went and stayed in a hotel in a different part of town.
Gostei muito do espaço , realmente me sentir em casa ! Limpo e silencioso  como eu gosto .

Comfortable, well furnished and quiet apartment, perfectly situated at the intersection of S and U Bahns to explore Berlin.  Neighborhood has a great variety of restaurants, cafes and grocery stores to suit every appetite. Hope to visit again.
Great apartment, perfect for everything we needed.

Everything was as described.
Fast to respond, and clear instructions.
A very polite host. Would recommend
Such a great airbnb! I totally recommend it!
Everything was good!The room is exactly like the photos and the location is one minute by foot near the metro station!
Great stay: convenient airport access, friendly host, and a quiet location. The flat had everything I needed, and a mall is just a 15-minute walk away 😌

Very nice flat. Confirm to the description. Very clean and well equipped, renewed. Self checkin so maybe missing human contact. Location is so nice, close to public transport and a lot of good restaurants. Quiet street.
Just be aware that the isolation is poor, with the other apartment on the same floor but also above (we hear a lot the steps). I really recommend.

The flat is lovely - it is stylish and comfortable. It is in a great location with shops and restaurants very close. There is an underground station just outside and walkable to places like the Tiergarten .
War genauso wie beschrieben. Zu empfehlen.
A fantastic place, in a fantastic location. (Well, i thought so). "Minimalistically" ideal. :)

Kein Schnickschnack. Die Wohnung hat eine tolle Lage und für eine Übernachtung war alles supi. Mit schön großen Fenstern mit Aussicht auf den Hof = Für Erdgeschoss sehr hell. Allerdings auch sehr hellhörig mit der Wohnung darüber. Gestört hat mich das nicht, aber für Geräuschsensible vielleicht anstrengend. Die Raumaufteilung hat mir gefallen.
Anca war sehr freundlich und flexibel.

Absolutely lovely apartment, very well located for the U Bahn. There is a lot of stairs but well worth it, very beautiful and clean.
Philipp was very helpful, allowed us to check in early and gave us some recommendations nearby.

Das Singer Hostel ist vor Ort genau wie beschrieben.
Unkonplizierter Check-In und Check-Out
Sehr freundliches Personal
Zimmer waren ordentlich und entsprechend der Beschreibung ausgestattet.
Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Lovely apartment for a couple!
En meget smilende og behjølpelig vært og en super løkker lejlighed
It’s the first time I’ve tried this kind of hotel, I recommend it — everything is super clean and really nice. I’ll come back if I pass through Berlin again👍👍

Klein, aber fein! Etienne's Apartment ist die perfekte Unterkunft für einen Kurztrip nach Berlin. Zentral gelegen ist man schnell in der Innenstadt sowie in den Viertel Prenzlauer Berg und Friedrichshain. Empfehlenswert!
El apartamento tenía lo necesario para pasar unos días y conocer Berlín

Kathrin was very friendly and helped me and my friends with everything.
Besides that, the Hostel is well located and very clean.
Was a nice stay, would recommend. The key system makes it quite easy to coordinate if you are a large group.

Claudia nous a parfaitement reçu ! Avec quelques petites attentions des plus agréables ! L'appart est dans un quartier dynamique et calme prêt des transports en commun donc facile d'accès ! Très propre ! Seul point négatif la literie (canapé lit) un peu dure pour 3 nuits de suite à mon goût ..

Henrik and Sven’s apartment is lovely and perfect for exploring Berlin. The apartment is located very close to the U2 line and just minutes by train to Alexanderplatz. The surrounding neighborhood is generally quiet with nice shops and restaurants. The apartment was beautiful in the winter but I imagine in the summer it would be absolutely gorgeous. Hope to stay again in the future!
War alles Top.

Michael’s place is really spacious, more than the pictures look.We were met by Serpil who showed us everything the apartment had. The location is fantastic, in a quiet leafy area a few minutes walk from Bellevue S Bahn and right by the Tiergarten. You can walk through the Tiergarten to the Brandenburg Gate and everything that’s around it. There is a supermarket a couple of minutes walk away at U Hansaplatz. Serpil & Michael responded quickly to a problem we had. Serpil gave up her Friday evening to help us get sorted. We’d definitely stay again if we get the chance to visit Berlin again.
super et très bien situé. très belle vue sur la rivière
We were a group of friends and colleagues that came in for a conference and wanted to stay together, the place was perfect for us, both the location and what was offered, all great!

Wir sind für 2 Tage im Generator Hostel in Berlin untergekommen und waren sehr zufrieden. Die Lage ist super zentral. Man ist schnell am Hauptbahnhof und bei den Sehenswürdigkeiten. Außerdem gibt es in der Nähe viele Bars und Cafés.
Nachts war es recht ruhig und das Personal war sehr freundlich. Aufgrund der heißen Wetters stand uns ein Ventilator zur Verfügung.
Lediglich das Licht ließ sich im Badezimmer nicht ausschalten, was uns aber nicht gestört hat.
Wir würden jederzeit wieder kommen! :)
Der Aufenthalt bei Etienne war perfekt. Vielen Dank!
Super Lage und netter Gastgeber! Alles war echt unkompliziert und wir hatten ein paar wunderschöne Tage. Absolut zu empfehlen!
Alles top, süße Wohnung, haben uns wohlgefühlt - auch eine schöne Gegend und Andrej war bemüht, dass wir uns wohlfühlen.
Very clean, modern apartment with all the facilities.
Buena experiencia. apesar de que había más gente la estancia fue muy agradable. Muy limpio y lindo el lugar
Sehr schöne Wohnung und sehr gute Kommunikation mit Enrico. Kann ich nur weiterempfehlen.
Un bon séjour, bien placé, bien équipé et propre !

Martin’s place was a great little gem in a quiet part of Berlin. It was spacious, comfortable and convenient for our last minute stay. It was close to the S-Bahn, which made it easy to zip around the city and to the airport. Martin and his assistant Geraldine were really responsive and helpful. Thanks for the great stay!
A great apartment that’s quiet and had all the basic amenities you’d need, easy check in and close to S and U bahn stations

Es hat perfekt gepasst, sehr erholsam und ruhige Nächte👌🏻 Da wir tagsüber immer unterwegs waren und nicht groß gekocht haben haben wir nichts vermisst. Es gibt keine Tür innerhalb der Wohnung aber für uns war's fein! Schöne, einfache und sehr saubere pragmatische Einrichtung. Das Gärtchen klein aber schön fürs Zigarettchen und nen Apertivo.

Alles hat perfekt funktioniert, und ich bin total zufrieden. Die Strecke, die Organisation und die gesamte Atmosphäre waren top. Es hat richtig Spaß gemacht, und ich würde es jederzeit wieder machen. Ein großartiges Erlebnis in Berlin!

We had a great time in Berlin! Stayed as a couple and had heaps of room. Karsten's place was very clean and had everything we needed. It was very close to a metro station which made it really easy to get around. He also gave us a map of the local area and metro which was really helpful. He was flexible and able to accommodate changes to arrival/leaving times. I would recommend Karsten's place to friends.

Die Unterkunft bestand aus zwei Zimmern innerhalb der sehr großen Wohnung. Küche und Bad wurden gemeinsam genutzt. Alles war blitzsauber und höchst geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Die Kommunikation mit Silke war einfach und schnell, wir haben uns sehr willkommen gefühlt. Von der Lage her ist der Müggelsee zu Fuß erreichbar. Ich empfehle diese Unterkunft ohne Einschränkungen.
Freundliches Personal, angenehme Gäste, schön eingerichtet und sehr gepflegt.

great spot in an equally great neighborhood. for those travelling with a lot of luggage note there are no elevators and this place is a storey walk up. can't complain though as the place is stunning and so roomy and so functional.
Der Aufenthalt war total schön. Die Kommunikation war sehr einfach und angenehm. Gerne wieder!
Sehr gute Erreichbarkeit mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln und trotzdem ruhige Lage.
This place is as described. It is in a safe neighborhood that is close to public transport. The host if very helpful. I enjoyed my stay.
subway (u-bahn) is a quick walk with so many good choices for food and a couple shops right on the adjacent streets. Mike does an amazing job to make you feel right at home!
Ottima posizione, quartiere tranquillo. Host disponibile e ottimi consigli sulla zona
What a great stay and the vintage furniture was very cool!
Super schöne Wohnung,sehr gute Lage. Daniel war sehr hilfsbereit und freundlich. Wir kommen gern wieder!

Super Lage, paar Minuten zur s und u Bahn, schnell überall in Berlin und gleichzeitig ist die Autobahn nur 1 Minute entfernt ! Zimmer war wie beschrieben, alles war einfach und hat super geklappt! Absolut zu empfehlen :)
It was the best air bnb that I’ve ever stayed in hands down! Cannot wait to come back

Andre’s house was great! Nice and warm, beautiful large living space, the best shower I’ve ever come across in a hotel/holiday apartment, but most of all was equipped with all the little things you want... extra towels, heaps of tea and coffee, salt pepper and spices etc
Would definitely recommend this apartment!!

We had a really good stay with a very friendly host! Some of the house rule sounded a little strict, but we figured it all out and life was good. It’s an awesome area, well connected to the S-Bahn. The apartment has a great size and we had everything we needed.

Ein kleines, sehr feines und ruhiges Zimmer mit erfrischend natürlicher Einrichtung. Auch das Badezimmer ist top! Sehr gute Anbindung an Berlin-Mitte. Die Gastgeber sind super herzlich und hilfsbereit! Vielen lieben Dank für den schönen Aufenthalt bei Euch!
Easy, friendly and helpful. Also thank you for accepting my booking last minute. Highly recommend!

We can only hope that Bernd continues to list his flat on Airbnb for years to come. It is truly a magical place. The art, furniture, and amenities are all fantastic. The location is in a picturesque neighborhood and is walkable to many cafes, restaurants, bars, and transportation. It was a peaceful escape and we found it to be a fantastic place to recover from Berlins vibrant nightlife scene.
Bernd himself was incredibly friendly, proactive with instructions, and responsive to all communication before and during our visit.
We will attempt to stay with Bernd again every time we visit Berlin in the future.
This place was fantastic. Easy instructions to check in. I would just say that it would’ve been amazing if they put modern smart TVs with Netflix. But apart from that, it was a great place to stay.

Enrique fue un excelente anfitrión, dio excelentes instrucciones y datos sobre Berlín, asimismo demostró empatía cuando perdimos nuestro vuelo a la ciudad, algo que agradecemos. El lugar estaba realmente impecable y equipado; la cama muy cómoda y abrigada, contaba con calefacción, lavadora, útiles de aseo SOS, cocina 10/10, etc. El baño muy limpio y la ducha funcionaba muy bien. Ubicación muy buena, al lado del transporte público. Check in y check out fácil. Volvería y lo recomendaré. Gracias Enrique!

War toll, absolut empfehlenswert, freundlich, sauber, coole Wohnung und gut ausgestattet. Bad ohne Schlüssel, als Familie kein Problem, kann mir aber vorstellen, es gibt Konstellationen in denen das nicht so gut funktioniert.

The inside of the apartment is just lovely and matches the description and photos.  The outside graffiti and the inner hall downstairs is a little off putting.  The apartment had everything needed for our week stay and was in an ideal location for using local transport and had lovely eateries in close proximity.

Ulf and Caroline's studio is an absolute dream. It's spacious, cozy, in the best location, easily accessible, with a comfy bed and an amazing shower! There's a coffee shop just across the street with friendly people and great coffee and a supermarket just on the corner for anything you might need during your stay. Will definitely be staying here again on future trips to Berlin!
Wir waren sehr zufrieden!
Nice place to stay Berlin. We will use again. I highly recommend.
Claudio's place is nice. Perfect location. Hosts are very helpful , they answer all the questions as soon as possible. Check in was very easy. Thank you Claudio.
Problemloser einfacher Aufenthalt
We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was clean and the bed was so comfortable. It’s a great location. I would more than happily stay here again. Thank you!

Had a lovely stay here for a long weekend sightseeing.  Jeff is a great host and always quick to respond to queries.  Good location close to public transport for easy sightseeing.   Erbil Restaurant and Bedda’s Sicilia were decent restaurants within walking distance if you wanted to stay local.
The accommodation was everything you can ask for. Clean, lovely and well equipped. The staff was helpful and very nice.
Lovely stay close to city center. Easy check in and check out process. Comfortable beds and clean upon arrival!
Très bel appartement et bien placé à Kreuzberg. Hôtes très réactifs lorsque nous avons eu besoin d'eux !
Excelente ubicación muy cerca de todo y un barrio tranquilo. El departamento es muy grande y cómodo. Douglas un excelente anfitrión

Renovated, spacious and stylish appartment with very high ceilings in Kreuzberg. Although the neiggborhood looks quite rough the closer you get to Kottbusser Tor, the appartment is in a very quiet backyard. It was well temperatured despite the 30 degrees outside and had everything we needed. The bedding and bathroom had a few stains but other than that it seemed very clean and tidy. Communication was also good.
Cosy place to work from, close to boxi and u5 - would recommend

One of the best AirBnb owner i've met, my flights has been delayed and I ended up reaching the airport past midnight. Christian personally drove over to pick me up as he's kind of concern that it's not too safe to walk and to take the train over so late at night.

Nöjd undantaget att receptionen inte var öppen under angivna timmar vilket gjorde att vi fick vänta på incheckning.
En del damm på rummet.
Everything was great! Would recommend Dans Appartement to everyone!

Tolle Lage - direkt an einem Kanal mit vielen Restaurants, (kleinen) Läden etc
Host war freundlich, hat meistens schnell geantwortet und hat sich gekümmert, wenn es Probleme gab
Viel Platz und viele Schränke, aber nicht überfordernd riesig
Ein Manko, das es gab war, dass die Türen manchmal etwas schwer zu öffnen / schließen waren, aber mit ein bisschen Stärke und Geduld ging es

Vollkommen wirklich zufrieden, es ist das perfekte Hotel für ein Wochenendtrip nach Berlin, um die Stadt zu erkunden.
Bad rundum sauber, Bett genügt den Ansprüchen. Feedback vom Hotel war immer schnell da.
Einziges kleines Manko: Unser Zimmer hatte einen relativ spürbar starken Geruch von Tier(-haaren) gehabt, was mich persönlich aber nur leicht gestört hat, sodass ich keinen Wechsel angefragt habe.
Hier hätte aber die Rezeption sicherlich auch ausgeholfen.
Alles in allem wirklich top.

Great apartment, sparkling clean et very well located! Free parking nearby (5-10 min walk) and grocery store right in front. At 4th floor (no elevator), but a little exercise is good. Agnieszka was always available for us.
Lovely host!

I’ve enjoyed my stay here. Federico is the most friendly and helpful. Great place and convenient location are impressive. Highly recommended if you are visiting Berlin. I will come back again without hesitation.

Ein Sehr empfehlenswertes RBNB Zimmer mit super freundlichem Support alle meine Fragen und Anliegen wurden direkt gelöst einfach klasse
Danke für eure Arbeit 🙏
Thank you for let’s us stay here. We enjoyed our stay.

Claus’s place is located in a great neighborhood, only a few minutes walk to lots of transit, cute cafes, parks, but on a quiet street. Big windows bring in air and light. The flat is spacious and very comfortable. Claus is a fantastic host, great communication and quick yo respond to any queries. Loves this stay!
Nydelig leilighet. Masse rom og lys. Alt på kjøkkenet virker godt. Alt du trenger til alle måltider. Flott bakhage og matbutikken ligger rett over gaten. Vi hadde et fantastisk opphold!
This place is perfect for someone minimalist and on a budget when traveling to Berlin. Places can get pricey but this falls well within a decent budget. Super clean and very well located!

Staying here was an absolute pleasure! Birgit is wonderful and was so warm welcoming me into her home. One of the best experiences I've had on Airbnb and would not have preferred to stay in any other place in Berlin. Would recommend to anyone.
The space itself is very clean, spacious and gets lots of natural light, and the location is very convenient to get around the city.
This place is lovely. Very big and spacious with great amenities. Check-in was super easy. I would have loved to stay here longer. Thanks for having me.
Super nette Gastgeberin, die immer erreichbar war. Schlüsselübergabe einige Strassen weiter, Wohnung sauber und wie beschrieben. Empfehlen wir gerne weiter.
Für ein oder mehrere Nächte absolut ausreichend! Super nette Atmosphäre und cooler Vibe im Eingangsbereich mit Bar und Tischen etc. 🌞

Wir hatten eine gute Zeit in Georgys Apartment. Es war sauber und wie auf den Fotos. Uns war nicht klar, dass das zweite Schlafzimmer auch gleichzeitig das Esszimmer/Wohnzimmer ist. Das Selbst-Check-in hat nicht so toll geklappt, aber das kann ja mal passieren.

I really love Bee’s apt! I was renting with one friend and it was one of the bigger Airbnb places I’d seen in the area. It was wonderful for just the two of us but could easily fit more people. I only met/saw Bee at the start of our bit-over-a-week visit, but her place was exactly what we were looking for and exactly as you described. The location was ideal for us as we were visiting friends in a nearby area, and it was usually a simple train or bus ride to all the great restaurants and bars in Friedelstraße. Also easy to get to Berlin proper and travel around Germany. We loved the small touches with simple decorating and linens. The beds were super comfortable and the coffee and teas she left were so helpful on some of our earliest mornings.  A supermarket was one block away. It felt like we had our own place the entire time, but I was sure if we were around more we could have had more interactions. Very sweet find!
交通便利，環境安靜，衛浴乾淨，備料充足，房東很好，溝通無礙。可惜地毯有三手煙的味道，是美中不足的地方。

We stayed for 12 nights. The apartment is great, especially the balcony fronting the beautiful back yard. The neighborhood is fantastic and trendy. A large supermarket is right in front of the house and the tram is 4 minutes away.
Highly recommended 🙂

We had such an amazing stay at Jessy’s place in Berlin!
Jessy was there to meet us when we checked in, and provided so many amazing tips for restaurants and things to do that we wouldn’t have known about otherwise.
She also provided so many extra touches, like water, coffee, tea and chocolates that were really appreciated.
The place itself was clean, comfortable, and well decorated and the perfect place to come back to after a busy day.
Would definitely recommend this place to anyone coming to stay in Berlin.
Danke und gerne wieder.

This stay was great for a solo traveler! Also great if you like to go out to nightclubs, Kit Kat nightclub is a block away and still located on a quiet street! Great coffee and restaurants walking distance. Also two metro stations are within a 5 minute walk from the building. I would definitely recommend.

Am Ankunftstag regnete es heftig und wir hatten die Nummer für die Schlüsselbox nicht sofort griffbereit. Zum Glück öffnete der sehr freundliche Ulrich uns die Tür.
Die Wohnung ist superschön und hochwertig eingerichtet, wir fühlten uns direkt wohl. Das Haus liegt in einer schicken Villengegend, man läuft 10 min zur Straßenbahn und ist dann in 30 bis 40 min im Zentrum.
Da wir viel unterwegs waren, blieben wir mit Ulrich per Mail in Kontakt, Fragen wurden so schnell beantwortet.
Empfehlen können wir die Wohnung auf jeden Fall.

Marion est une hôte réactive et très prévenante pour répondre aux demandes et aux questions ainsi que son mari .
Le logement est magnifique 😍 quartier très calme et bien desservis pour les transport en commun .
Excellent accueil très à l’écoute .
Super hôte je recommande 👍👍👍
El alojamiento estuvo muy bien. David nos ayudó a desplazarnos por la ciudad de Berlín y nos recomendó varios lugares.

optimale Bedingungen für einen kurzfristigen Aufenthalt in der Stadt (z.b. Sightseeing, FoBis usw.), verkehrsgünstige Lage, gute Essensmöglichkeiten in der Umgebung, viele Cafés, Dönerläden usw., freundliches Personal, saubere Zimmer und Bad, kann nur sehr weiterempfehlen

Pleasant stay and a very good cafe just downstairs.
A minute away from the Turkish market

Flexible check-in was super useful. Marius's place was so homely and very chic!
He was a wonderful host and showed us places to visit around Berlin. Would love to come back for another stay sometime soon!
Logement très bien passé pour visiter Berlin. La communication avec Chi a été très facile et arrangeante ! Merci

Die Wohnung ist groß und sehr schön eingerichtet, so dass wir uns eine Woche sehr wohl gefühlt haben (Familie mit 3 Kindern). Der Esstisch in der Küche war groß genug für uns. Der Superpluspunkt ist die Lage: Vom Bahnhof Friedrichstraße nur wenige Meter entfernt, erreicht man die gesamte Mitte Berlins zu Fuß!! Einen Stern Abzug gibt es für die fehlende Angabe der "City-Tax" und für eine Baustelle im (sehr schönen) Innenhof, die uns jeden morgen pünktlich um 7 Uhr geweckt hat. Ohne die Bauarbeiten ist die Wohnung sehr ruhig! Insgesamt eine klare Empfehlung! Danke!
Flexible check in, room was clean and place was same as per description.
We have a lovely stay and had in the end a great little apartment facing the river spree.  Brand new, modern and clean. Easy access to Berlin if you dont mind the bus. We loved it.

We spent 5 days in Tina's appartment (we are a family of 5: 2 adults, 2 kids and a baby) and we really enjoyed our stay: the appartment is very calm (whereas the Simon Dach Strasse is very lively), it is more spacious than the impression given by photos and also very well located (nice street and neighbourhood and not far from the main interesting places in Berlin). Communication with Tina and Gosia (who was here at the arrival and departure) went also smoothly. We recommend this appartment for a short stay in Berlin !
Ubicación aceptable. Comunicada con el centro.
Location is perfect. Apartment is great with two different bedrooms and it has everything that you need

Great location, Kreuzberg has so many nice restaurants, also good record shops. Lots of walkable options. Quick to get to other districts. Quiet even though a basement level flat. Check in very easy with auto check/key box, which helped as we were returning from a festival at 1am.

Nossa estadia no apartamento do Stefan foi excelente.
A localização é ótima, cheio de bares e restaurantes por peito.
Bom para caminhar e próximo à estação de metrô.

Super schönes, kleines Apartment. Der Blick auf die Spree war toll! Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel waren schnell erreicht, Parkplätze in der Nähe. Der Mitarbeiter an der Rezeption war bei unseren Anliegen freundlich und zuvorkommend. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Alles Gut. Bei Bedarf kann man Frühstück hinzubuchen
alles ok  wel wat warm

If your looking for a nice appartment with a slightly bigger group I do recommend this appartment. City center is on walking distance but the building is also right next to the metro.  Several clubs are close by.  All Sven decribed about the appartment is correct. It was clean, comfortable beds, well equipped kitchen.  A big plus is the complimentary coffee and tea.

The entry process was very straightforward, and I liked the flat. B&K dropped by to say hello but actually all the details are nicely documented.
The neighborhood is great, the flat is centrally located with lots of restaurants and coffee shops around. Especially if it's not your first time in Berlin I recommend to try it out.
Hat alles super gepasst. Betten war sehr bequem
Great apartment - clean, comfortable and with a lovely balcony - in a nice part of Berlin. Excellent service from Anders. We very much enjoyed our stay.
Sascha was a great host and went above and beyond to provide us with everything we needed and more. His place was great as well. Would definitely recommend and stay here again!

Wir haben eine gemütliche Ferienwohnung vorgefunden, bei der alles stimmte. Mit Bus und Bahn sehr gut zu erreichen und trotzdem sehr ruhig in einem Wohngebiet gelegen, haben wir die Ferienwohnung als Ausgangspunkt für unsere Aktivitäten optimal nutzen können.
Wir vergeben fünf Sterne und empfehlen diese!
Sehr schöne Apartments, super Check in auch bei später Ankunft. Hatten alles was wir brauchen.

La estadia fue muy buenas, gracias a la amabilidad de Douglas.
el departamento esta muy bien ubicado, es amplio y limpio.
Douglas es un excelente anfitrion.
Lo recomiendo.

Die Wohnung ist schön eingerichtet, hat gut Platz für 2-3 Personen und befindet sich super nahe bei der Metro. Man kann in der Umgebung vieles zu Fuss erreichen.
Leider ist das Bett mit 140 cm Breite sehr klein für zwei Personen aber leider passt kein grösseres Bett in dieses schmale Schlafzimmer. Die Couch ist eine einfache Eckcouche aber bequem drauf zu schlafen für eine Person. Das Badezimmer ist etwas kahl und könnte erneuert werden. Es nimmt etwas den Charme der Wohnung weg.
Für einen Städte Trip völlig ausreichend. Wir haben uns trotz Verbesserungspotenzial wohl gefühlt.

Michele was super helpful and responded very quickly to any messages or queries.  The flat was well located with easy public transport links into the centre of Berlin which made it a good base for exploring the city.  The flat is deceptively spacious with 3 double bedrooms and 2 nice sized bathrooms.
Yaz was extremely helpful and the location of the apartment is amazing!

Wir haben sehr spontan gebucht
hat aber trotzdem alles gut geklappt.
In der Küche war alles da was man braucht.
Bad war alles da und auch ordentlich.
Nur hats nicht so gut geklappt mit dem Baby Bett.
Und Flecken an dem Kissen.
Einige Kissen sollte man austauschen.
Preis finde ich in Ordnung.
Great Location, lots to do in surrounding. Easy to access the city with the tour buses.

Super Airbnb, zentral, ruhig und gut ausgestattet.
Hardy ist zudem sehr zuvorkommend, zuverlässig und kümmert sich sehr gut um seine Gäste.

We had a very nice stay at Yael’s apartment. The neighborhood is quiet. The apartment is smal but exactly big enough for two. To get the key you have to follow the instructions exactly. Then you’ll get there.
For visiting Berlin this an excellent base with a couple of nice restaurants in the proximity.

Tanja's place was a beautiful, sunny flat in Schöneberg, next to Kreuzberg - a youthful area with loads of cafes, bars and restaurants. The flat was perfect for four people (two on the double suspended bed and two on single beds underneath). There was a kitchen that seemed to have all the essentials, though we did not use it. Tanja was an efficient and well organized host. We did not meet her, but she arranged for the cleaner to give us the keys. Also she was very flexible when we were unsure till the last minute if we were going to be three or four people. I would strongly recommend Tanja as a host and the flat is perfect for anyone who wants to explore the less touristy parts of Berlin.

Die Lage ist super, in unmittelbarer Nähe vom Schloss. Es gibt einen Bioladen und eine Discounter direkt in der Nähe. Auch die Anbindung mit den Öffentlichen funktioniert super. Es ist einfach ausgestattet, aber alles da was man benötigt. Das Bett ist sehr bequem und das Bettzeug auch. Es war auch wirklich sehr ruhig in der Unterkunft, trotz mehrerer Mitbewohner. Preis-Leistung wirklich gut. Gerne wieder.
great location, very nice appartment, for a good price.
Excellent host. Very pleasant accommodation.  Well equipped.
Einfach empfehlenswert !

Top Adresse in jeder Hinsicht!
Neben der guten Lage, schönen Umgebung und blitzsauberer toller Wohnung mit Balkon usw. Hervorragende Gastgeber, freundlich, herzlich, hilfsbereit, zuvorkommend, kinderfreundlich- perfekt!
Vielen Dank!

The apartment was great, exactly how it was described. The location is very good, right next to one of the main metro stations. You can easily get to the most famous spots in the city center by walking as well. Amazing restaurants nearby, the REWE grocery store is 7 min by foot. The place is very well equipped, modern and clean. Tara is a lovely host, really helpful and friendly. We had a wonderful stay. We totally recommend!

O melhor anfitrião do Airbnb! Nunca vi alguém tão bom em receber pessoas. O local é de um bom gosto impressionante. Muito bem localizado, super limpo e luxuoso. Você se sente em casa! Ah... e ainda tem o Jack! Muito obrigado por tudo Robert!
saubere Unterkunft, aber kaputter Klodeckel und Türgriff, sonst super
Danke! Der Aufenthalt bei euch hat die Berlin-Erfahrung rund gemacht :)
Great place :)
really enjoyed our stay!
Adorei o apartamento e o meu quarto! Muito bem localizado. Perto de Potsdamer Platz, Brandenburg Gate e grandes estações.

오래되었지만 관리가 잘 된 아파트같아요.
주방은 협소하지만 와이파이가 잘되고 베를린 시내를 구경하기에는 좋은 위치입니다.
Reasonable value for money. Regarding the car parking, if you are late after 10.30pm it is difficult to impossible to find a close car parking.

L'appartement à pleinement satisfait nos attentes. Idéalement situé et possédant un énorme cachet, parfait pour profite des attraits de la vie berlinoise.
Les hôtes sont charmants et réactifs, il est fortement probable que nous y reviendrons

Apartamento bien equipado y de buena ocupación. La comunicación con Marcella siempre ágil e inmediata.
Un detalle a mejorar es la reparación de las ventanas para que circule aire en días de calor.
Bien placé, bel hôtel, chambre agréable et propre

Wir waren mit unserer 5-köpfigen Familie eine Woche in dieser Wohnung im Urlaub. Die Wohnung war sehr schön und sauber und geräumig. Super ist die Umgebung, gerade neben der U-Bahnstation und in Spazierdistanz von unzähligen Bars und Restaurants.
When we arrived at 11 PM, Anne and her kids welcommed us with bread (pistolets), fruit (apples, grapes) and fresh water. That was a nice and welcome surprise!
Cozy location, nice apartment and everything went smooth. I recommend :)

Dan has been a fantastic host, super friedly, accommodating and always willing to help out and give advice/recommendations. The flat was was great! Really clean, with tasteful decor and plenty of space. The room itself was lovely and light, with an enormous comfy bed. The flat is in a chill residential area with a few good places to eat out. It is about a 7-10 minute walk to 3 different subway stations, so easy to get around. Would definetely recommend.

Andreas was extremely friendly and made me feel right at home. The property was clean and very quiet. Room was also quite big which was nice. Wonderful stay, hope to stay again when I’m in Berlin next.
Mittendrin, zugleich ein weiter Blick, hell und freundlich und ein Gastgeber, der für alle Situationen eine praktische Lösung findet. Wir haben uns sehr, sehr wohl gefühlt! Vielen Dank!

Lo bueno: Moriam fue amorosa al pedirle que venga a darnos espacio para guardar nuestra ropa, aunque no fue lo suficiente.
La zona es muy buena y con muchas cosas para hacer.
Nos acercó un ventilador dadas las altas temperaturas.👍🏼
El departamento es precioso!!!❤️
Lo no tan bueno: El pasillo de entrada olía muy mal por los tachos llenos de basura del condominio en general.
Tardaron una semana en sacarlos.
Nos dejaron un solo juego de sábanas viejas y con los cierres para el plumón rotos.
Las almohadas no cumplían la función.
Los elementos personales de la anfitriona estaban a la vista y la verdad, no resultava agradable verlos todo el tiempo.
Parece que en la casa había algo que me picó y por 15 días no pude salir.
Creo que no fue mala intención de Moriam, sino que tal vez alquila el departamento a gente muy joven que no tienen tantos reparos. Yo tengo 59 y soy muy prolija y bastante hincha con la limpieza.
Moriam nos trajo un juego más de sábanas , viejas. Un toallón estaba roto

Modern and cozy room for my family.
I loved common spaces and neighborhood.
Nice place. Feels like a co-op home. Would stay again.

The stay was overall great. Great location and cool-designed apartment made our stay really enjoyable. Alex is really friendly and responsive, he took a good care of all our needs prior to our arrival. The only tricky thing was the shower water. It was very cold despite using all of the host's tips. I understand it might not be an easy thing to fix in an old building like this one, but it should definitely be mentioned in the apartment description.

Very nice family :)
Sabrina and Jens are great hosts and the room is very comfortable. I had a perfect stay !
Außergewöhnliche, schöne Unterkunft. Leider ist die Auslegware sehr fleckig und schmälert den sonst sehr positiven Eindruck.
War alles in Ordnung. Das Zimmer sieht aus wie auf den Fotos. Es dürfte jedoch bereits von Beginn an, noch etwas mehr auf die Sauberkeit geachtet werden. Die Unterkunft ist gut gelegen.
My comments shouldnt be considered a problem. We love the apartment and its in a pleasant area. Also very close to the S-Bahn, a few stops to the centre.

Der Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm, die Übergabe problemlos und die Verwalterin sehr nett.
Das Apartment liegt über einem indischen Restaurant, was durch den Geruch und den Lärm Punktabzug gibt. Ein Pluspunkt ist auf jeden Fall die schöne Wohnung und die kurze Distanz zum Charlottenburger Schloss.
Wünschen würde ich mir, dass das Geschirr besser kontrolliert wird, es war nicht wirklich sauber.
Ansonsten war es ein toller Aufenthalt, in Relation zu den genannten Punkten aber etwas zu teuer.

Well located, the place meets the description.
Thiago was really friendly

Thank you! We loved our stay, the only downfall is not having staff around all the time and we struggled using the bluetooth key for our door. Otherwise perfect location and a really modern and clean room!

Super host et super accueil.
Merci Sascha. Cela fait du bien de se sentir à la maison en voyage ! :)

Loved loved the location! So easy to stroll to great restaurants and shops. We also loved the personality and charm of this space. Susanne went the extra mile in making the studio feel nice and welcoming. Cooking was easy and the backyard space was cozy!
Der Aufenthalt bei Ashley und Niklas war sehr angenehm. Der Check-In hat ohne Probleme geklappt, das Zimmer war sauber und die Beiden waren sehr hilfsbereit.

Enjoyed a lovely and comfortable stay at Meg's place! Very cute apartment with easy access to public transport to take you around Berlin. In a nice, residential neighborhood with grocery stores in walking distance, as well as many places for takeaway food. I was mostly out and about during the days, but this was a great and cozy place to return to in the evenings!
Beatrice was a wonderful host. We felt right at home in a beautiful space, which was in an excellent location. We would absolutely love to return to Beatrice's place next time we're in Berlin!
A great-location place and I definitely had a great stay there. Spotless house, lovely kittens, and talkative host Katrin 😄
Lovely place within walking distance of train station and many Berlin attractions and restaurants. Easy check in and a lovely cosy room and bed.
Everything was ok. It was pleasure to meet Garelt.

Fabulous apartment in a great trendy and safe neighborhood close to everything. Bigger than the pics suggest. Three of us comfortably shared the place for a weekend and we would go back for sure. Highly recommend for anyone wanting to enjoy Berlin in style. Distrikt Coffee close by is the best for brunch.

Hier lief alles optimal. Von der Kommunikation vor der Anreise, über die Übergabe des Schlüssels sowie die Einweisung war alles sehr reibungslos. Fragen wurden schnellstens beantwortet. Vielen Dank für alles, wir kommen gerne wieder.
Great studio, very confortable, bright large windows facing a courtyard on a very convinient neighborhood. Restaurants, shops, transportation right  just steps away. We will be back!

Apartamento muy bien comunicado y situado .
Mención especial a Marlon que nos facilito las cosas muchísimo .
MUY RECOMENDABLE SI VAS POCO TIEMPO A BERLIN
Super nette Altbauwohnung mit schöner personalisierten Deco und super Standort!
Bon logement fonctionnel pour des petites vacances à Berlin

I loved my stay at Casa D Oro, very quiet and comfy place. Would love to spend some time in the summer to enjoy the outdoor space. Check was perfect, and clear, lots of locations that are walkable from the home. The host were very kind, proactive, and responsive. Also having laundry in home after spending weeks in Berlin was amazing. Thank you ♥️

Die Unterkunft überzeugt mit der schönen Einrichtung im modernen James Bond Stil und sehr guten Aussstattung.
Vorallem hat uns die ruhige Lage in einer Wohngegend und die Nähe der S-Bahn gefallen.
Wir würden sehr gerne wiederkommen !

The apartment was great, sparkling clean, easy location and lots of useful services nearby such as supermarkets, restaurants and bars! Alec was responsive, kind, and treated us really well! Can't say anything but definitely recommend his place!

Es hat alles gut geklappt. Wir haben die Wohnung gut finden können, Dank der Erklärungen von Holger. Die Anbindung ist sehr gut und wir sind relativ schnell überallhin angekommen. Holger und Bettina waren sehr hilfsbereit udn haben sich auf meine Fragen sofort zurück gemeldet. Meine Tochter und ich haben uns wohl gefühlt.

Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der tollen Unterkunft und der netten Kommunikation mit Natasha.
Um einmal die Seele baumeln zu lassen der perfekte Ort um dies in aller Ruhe zu tun oder einfach mal ein paar Tage aus dem Stadtstress entliehen.
Man sollte nur beachten, dass ca. 5-10min rudern mit dem Beiboot nötig ist um wieder an Festland zu kommen. (Je nachdem, wie geübt man darin ist)
Also von mir eine klare Empfehlung und ich bin mir sicher mich dort noch ein weiteres Mal aufzuhalten!
Liebe Grüße!

Der Weissensee ist zu Fuß gut zu erreichen. Unser Zimmer lag auf der ruhigen Seite der Wohnung. Die Küchenzeile ist überschaubar ausgestattet. Leider hingen freie Elektroleitungen ungesichert unter dem einen Küchenschrank raus. Da sollte wohl mal eine Lampe angebracht werden. Und im Badezimmer fiel bei dem Versuch ein Handtuch anzuhängen gleich die Handtuchstange ab. Sviatlana hat sofort auf diese Mängel per SMS reagiert und es sollte ein Hausmeister zur Behebung der Mängel kommen. Was leider nicht geschehen ist.
Da bekommt man was man braucht. Es ist wie eigene Unkel besuchen. Großartig
Gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis

Дверь в подезд и дверь в комнату не закрывалась, что очень удивительно. Полотенца пропахли сыростью. Кухна общая с хозяевами в плочевном состоянии. На фото все выглядит иначе. Хозяйка гостеприимна, все обяснила помогла с вопросами.  Очень мало кафорта.

Rummelig og moderne lejlighed i hyggeligt område. Smuk udsigt over Spree! Relativt lang, men overskuelig afstand til centrum med offentlig transport.
Bianca er en god vært og kommunikationen var upåklagelig.
Det kan bestemt anbefales at leje denne lejlighed!
Marcello is a great host, very responsive and helpful. The location is easily accessible via public transportation but not in the city center.

Excellent appartement
Proche des transports (tram), promenades agréables dans le quartier, de nombreux restaurants de tout types aux alentours
Le logement était très fonctionnel pour deux : une salle de bain propre avec des serviettes gel douche et shampooing fournis, deux lits individuels avec draps plutôt confortables, de grandes fenêtres qui donnent sur une cour donc peu de bruit.
Nous n'avons pas utilisé la cuisine
Il y a un ascenseur que l'on peut utiliser avec une clef, néanmoins il ne fonctionnait pas constamment. l'appartement étant au deuxième étage, cela ne nous a pas posé de problème.
Toutes les indications données étaient très claires avant l'arrivé dans l'appartement

I wish we had been able to stay longer in Berlin.  Kelly's place was so cute and it was very suitable for four people. It was quiet and had a wonderful little patio to sit on and enjoy a glass of wine at the end of the day.  Kelly also thoughtfully provided chilled wine and beer for us in the fridge as well as candy and coffee. The apartment was very clean and things like shampoo and even nail polish remover were left for us to use! The location was great as it was close to great eating places and very close to public transit that led directly to the rail station.  Kelly answered my questions quickly and it never seemed to be a bother.  Kelly's husband met us as the door even though we were later than we expected to be due to us getting lost.  This is a five star place to stay and the only downside to our whole experience was that we did not actually get to meet her.  Thank you Kelly for all you did.

Great apartment, large rooms and all you need. Didn't hear any noise from the neighbours. Close to ubahn, so easy to get to and from.
Great instructions from Maximillian.

La estancia en Berlín fue genial y Bee y su piso estuvieron muy bien, ella muy maja.
It was perfect, the flat and we're very cool and the place is very well located.
Great place, Laura and Eli was very helpful with the the whole check-in check out process. Location is nice and very close to the tram but you need to walk a bit if you like to use S-bahn.
Chris was great. Very responsive and helpful. Was always around to answer my questions and very flexible with my check out. Would stay here again
A lovely place and a very friendly host. When in need of some peace and quiet - and comfort, look no further
Aun que está un poco legos del centro, está muy bien! Lo recomendamos:)
Een heerlijke plek voor een verblijf op historische bodem. Alles aanwezig.
Reply of owner was fast. Apartment located near U-Bahn and S-Bahn. Bit expensive, but good for the money.
Thank you Gihad. Amazing
It’s one of the most beautiful apartments I’ve ever been to
Franziska ist sehr offen, gute Lage, jederzeit gerne wieder.
Great Stay! nearby Columbia Theater for concert night 🌙

This is a little gem! The location is perfect with very easy access to public transport. The flat is surrounded by shops, restaurants, cafes: more than we could try. The flat is quiet, spacious and very well recently decorated. Extremely clean and cosy. It was very nice to stay on the balcony after a full day in this exciting city. We met Katja when we arrived and she was very welcoming, taking the time to show us around and exchanging with us some tips and facts about the city. Highly recommended, thank you Katja and Bernd, you are super hosts! :-)
A very convenient and spacious flat, with all the amenities required for a city break. Secure and quiet location.

Great little place and beautifully appointed (just like in the pics). Centrally located with public transport, as well as many restaurants/shops/groceries nearby. Sascha was a great host with fast and kind communications.  We loved having early morning coffee on one of the two balconies, overlooking Berlin. Note that this apartment is on the sixth floor with no elevator, so we were able to work off all those Doeners we ate...

Wir waren für 3 Nächte im Mai Gäste während des DFB- Pokalfinales SC Freiburg gegen die andere Mannschaft. Absolute Klasse war der flexible Check-In. Dem Wunsch eines zweiten Schlüssel kam man sofort nach, nochmals Dankeschön. Die Sauberkeit war sofort zu spüren und zu sehen, das ist uns grundsätzlich wichtig. Der funktionelle Charme aus Schweden spiegelt sich in der Einrichtung wider, was völlig in Ordnung ist. Die großzügige Dachgeschosswohnung war für uns Schlaf- und Duschmöglichkeit, deshalb können wir kaum was zur Küchenausstattung sagen, sah aber komplett aus. Ein Tipp an Peter, bitte eine Duschabtrennung anbringen, kein Duschvorhang. Ohne alles droht eine Überschwemmung. :)
Die Lage ist klasse. Man nimmt Geräusche von der S-Bahn wahr, kein Problem. Dafür ist man in wenigen Minuten über zwei Haltestellen „Unter den Linden“! Und genau so schnell ist man zu Fuß in der Prinzenstraße in Kreuzberg.
Fazit: Zu Empfehlen!
It was very good and host is really nice

とても素敵な方でした。
自分が辛い状態でも親身になってサポートしてくれました。

Great location, only 10 minutes walk from the nearby train station, bus station and Ubahn station.
Accessible accommodation with elevator. All facilities are provided, including our much needed washing machine, drying machine and all kinds of kitchenwares.
We would recommend you this accommodation if you still don’t make your decision.
Äußerst freundlich und zuvorkommend! Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und sauber. Uneingeschränkte Empfehlung

Mina non abbiamo mai visto, ma via mail era sempre e velocemente disponibile a risolvere piccoli problemi. L'alloggio si trova in una zona non molto pulita ma in compenso molto vicino c'è un grande parco con un laghetto molto ben curato. Il collegamento con il centro è ottimo.
Tolle Lage und schönes Zimmer. Würde ich erneut buchen! Tipp: Ggfs. Ohrstöpsel mitbringen, da der alte Boden einige Geräusche von sich gibt und man Mitbewohner im Flur hören könnte.

Place was awesome. Five of us were away for a long weekend and there was plenty of room for us. We booked for seven and two dropped out but easily enough space for 7 normal sized guys. Recommended and would stay again. Thanks.
Clean apartment in a great location, a great stay, fantastic communication! Would certainly recommend...

Sehr schönes, gut gelegenes Apartment mit süssem Innenhof und stylisher Einrichtung. Die Küche ist grossartig und verfügt über alle notwendigen Untensilien inkl. einer Spülmaschine. Es hat alles tiptop funktioniert.
The host Martina was both friendly and helpful.  The location and security are good and the accommodation is mostly comfortable.

We loved this apartment! It was so clean and had everything we could possibly need. We really appreciated the amenities like garbage bags and paper towels and hand soap. This makes it so easy to just walk in with your suitcases and begin your vacation! Berlin is a fascinating city with a lot to do and this apartment made it easy to relax after long days. The internet was fantastic, the kitchen had everything we needed to cook our meals and the parking spot was also really helpful. The kids absolutely loved the car elevator. They've never seen anything like it and won't forget it! It is also close to anything you might need. Walking distance to restaurants, transit and grocery stores. This really was one of our favorite apartments from the many - hundreds - that we've stayed in.
Hervorragende Übernachtungsmöglichkeit in einer außergewöhnlichen Loft-Wohnung! Robert ist sehr gastfreundlich und das angebotene Zimmer groß und wunderbar ausgestattet!

Stayed 4 nights.  Easy, flexible check in. We appreciated that as room was ready, flexible about checking in early.  All very polite, helpful staff.  Apartment clean, just like photos.  Great Shower, comfortable beds. Blackout  curtains.  If you put out sign, cleaning staff top up coffee etc daily.  My son liked gym & sauna. He regularly goes to gym at home and said it was fine.  Straight across road FROM FRONT DOOR is a supermarket (not Europa one further down - not so good).  Closed Sundays -  between great Lebanese restaurant (we had a delicious lunch) and bar (which we liked, friendly staff).  Several Metro stops within easy walk.  Not as central to sights as we would have liked but all easy to get to - just meant time-consuming to come back to rest before heading out again for evening. Glad we bought Berlin Welcome Pass for transport as used metro a lot.  Area safe. Cafes etc within walking distance but we preferred other areas for evening - too quiet for us for eve entertainment.
Clean & they. Exactly as the picture show.  A lovely appartment close to amenities.

Het appartement van Jurriaan is heel fijn. Het is rustig, licht, ruim, heeft alles wat je nodig hebt, en ligt in een leuke buurt. Jurriaan is vriendelijk en behulpzaam, contact ging heel soepel. Ik zou hier zeker terugkomen!

Estoy al 99,99% seguro que Rosita es una de las mejoras hosts en todo Berlín. Por la amabilidad, la claridad en las instrucciones del piso, y por la completa de predisposición a ayudar ante cualquier inconveniente. Además, el piso está en muy buen estado y bien conectado.
Gihad es una muy excelente persona, me quedaría donde el nuevamente. La zona es de muy fácil acceso, es muy limpio y ordenado.

We loved this apartment! It was probably our favorite place that we have stayed. The location was very close to a metro stop, but the noise was not an issue. We loved all the skylights. We tried Cornelius's recommendations for the best bakery and ice cream and enjoyed both of those.

Eine wunderschöne, wirklich große Wohnung. Wir waren zu fünft und haben uns sofort wohlgefühlt.

Very nice and cool apartment. Clean, incredibly QUIET at night (did not sleep so well in ages!), close to everything you might wish for. Excellent service, highly recommended.

Ein ruhige Wohnung mit schönem Ambiente das zum verweilen einlädt.

Gerlinde antwortet schnell, unkompliziert und hat mich spontan und wunderbar nett beherbergt. Die Lage ist (für mich) perfekt. Vielen Dank!
Alles wunderbar. Sehr schöne Wohnung. Nette, hilfsbereite Gastgeber. Alles war so, wie beschrieben und auf den Bildern zu sehen. Unbedingt weiterzuempfehlen.
Apartment was cool and comfortable during some really hot days in Berlin. Great location, kitchen had everything you’d need—very clean! We loved it.

Die Wohnung ist wirklich liebevoll und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Man fühlt sich wie ein „echter“ Berliner. Alles war super sauber und es war alles da was man braucht.
Die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel sind schnell zu erreichen und in ein paar Minuten sind viele verschiedene Restaurants zu erreichen.

Apartment has been further upgraded since booking and now includes additional en-suite bedroom in basement. A fantastic space, Nassa and Nour are great hosts and proactive in communication. Great location for the district and with excellent transport links to city centre.

Sehr netter Kontakt, wir hatten leider eine Kleinigkeit bei Abreise liegen lassen, nach kurzem Kontakt wurde es sofort zu uns nach Hause geschickt. Good room, good host, good communication, the location was a bit far from the sites we wanted to see, but it was well connected to transit.

Vera hat mich sehr freundlich empfangen. Die Unterkunft liegt in einer sehr ruhigen Gegend, man erreicht aber schnell die S-Bahn oder U-Bahn, um ins Zentrum zu fahren. Alles in allem eine klare Empfehlung!

Für unsere Zwecke (Gruppenübernachtung während Konferenz) war die Unterkunft sehr gut. Super Kommunikation, detaillierte Wegbeschreibung inkl Fotos. Zugang via Codes, so hatten alle 5 Personen von uns Zugang.
Sehr ruhige Lage im Hinterhof, sonst ist am Görli und im Kiez schon was los. Exzellente Restaurants in direkter Laufweite, sehr viel sehr gutes vegane Essen.
Die Wohnung war nett, wie auf den Fotos, etwas kleiner (Fotos sind vermutlich weitwinklig). Räume eher dunkel. 2 Schlafzimmer (bzw. 1x Wohnraum mit Mini Küchenzeile und einem 3er-Hochbett + 1x 4er Zimmer), 2 Bäder (je Dusche, Waschbecken, WC, Pissoir). Die kleine Küche reicht fürs Frühstück.
Sauberkeit ist ok, leider ist die Couch extrem fleckig (woher auch immer...), so dass niemand drauf sitzen wollte. Die Stockbettleiter im Wohnzimmer ist vll. falsch eingebaut, ist schmerzhaft hinaufzusteigen. Matratzen recht hart/dünn. Es gibt sehr viele Steckdosen, von denen ca die Hälfte nicht funktioniert. Handtuchablage wäre toll.
Wir waren mit zwei Freunden in Berlin und waren sehr glücklich mit der Wohnung - gut ausgestattet (z.B im Bad und der Küche), sauber, sehr gute Kommunikation und in guter Lage. Gerne wieder!
Great location and cozy apartment!

Obwohl wir nur eine Nacht da waren, haben wir uns in der kurzen Zeit sehr gastfreundlich aufgenommen gefühlt.

Anyone staying here should know that the room itself is private but it is in the hosts home where she and her son also live. So you do NOT have the place to yourself. The bathroom and shower is shared among all of you for example. If you like sharing spaces with others who may invite guests and do all their normal life stuff while you are there  (the host invited over 6 guests for a party one evening during which we felt like we couldn’t use the kitchen/living room) then this is a good value AirBnB. The room is nice and well decorated suitable for one person or a couple. It is a five minute scooter/bike ride to Rudow bahn station, but in general pretty far from Berlin center. The host is nice and did try to make us welcome in the shared spaces which we appreciated.
I really enjoyed the place and stay. Super friendly staff and really great apartment with a nice view on spree. Very clean and comfortable

I was so upset by this visit.
First of all, thank goodness I took a screenshot of their wifi name and password because I was traveling with no cell service and they provided the wrong code to get in. (“It changed,” they told me later. “Sometimes apps don’t work.”) They had listed an emergency number, so I messaged that person. I didn’t get a response for two hours (they provided another wrong code anyways). Fortunately I did get a repose sooner on AirBnb messaging, which I tried when the phone number wasn’t helping.
The key that they provided was very difficult to use. They left directions on how to press the button but the handles were extremely hard to get open, both for the unit and the outdoor area with the washing machine.
The host had a picture indicating that the washing machine was also a dryer (part of why I chose this place because I had to do my laundry). I started my load and then saw a note “no dryer” (but it was clearly the same machine from the Airbnb picture). The host then told me via messaging they deactivated the dryer which meant I’d be airdrying my laundry the night before my flight in the cold. I knew that my clothes would still be damp but what I didn’t expect was for my brand new $150 jeans to get stolen off the drying rack, which was in a private area in the center of the complex. I messaged Jan about it and received no response.
This was easily the worst customer service of any Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. It really sucks to have my stuff stolen on top of the other issues. I try to be careful with money, so I’m really sad.
