Great Flat. Great Location. Great Host. Great Trip.
Gabriele’s place was spotless. Felt very homey. And Gabriele was very responsive and gave clear directions.

This Airbnb was like a home away from home in beautiful Berlin. Excellent location, super spacious and pristinely clean. Plus, Martin’s attention to detail is second to none - from a video showing you how to access the Airbnb to the homely touches inside, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. I’ll definitely be back and will be recommending to all of my friends.

Wir waren für ein Wochenende zu Besuch in Berlin und uns hat die Wohnung sehr gut gefallen. Die Wohnung hat eine gute Lage ist sehr sauber und es fehlt an nichts.
Die Kommunikation mit Fatos war zu jeder Zeit sehr einfach und hilfreich.
Wir werden definitiv wieder kommen.
We had a great time here - the apartment is a great size (massive!), well equipped and well connected to public transport. Would highly recommend. Thank you Ulla!
Very friendly and nice staff. Clean room and uncomplicated communication.
Bernd war ein sehr toller Gastgeber. Kommunikation mit ihm war super und wir konnten uns jederzeit bei Fragen bei ihm melden. Wir würden sofort wieder kommen!!
Zentrale Lage und trotzdem ruhig, in wenigen Metern alles was das Hetz begehrt; Cafés, Restaurants und die Markthalle. Unkomplizierter check/ in und out - Fazit; gerne wieder

The apartment is as advertised. Larger then looks in pics. Location close to subway, supermarkets, and restaurants. Air conditioning is nice plus. A laundromat is close by too for longer stays. Beware though that apartment is on ground floor and directly on street, so be ready for steady city noise if sleeping on pullout couch in front room. Main bedroom and loft are very quiet however. Would have appreciated a few more kitchen cleaning supplies (sponge, dish towels), but kitchen is otherwise nicely stocked. All in all, highly recommend.
Very nice and quiet place with a beautiful garden at the backyard. Owners are friendly and helpful👍

El alojamiento esta en muy buena ubicación con la estacion de tren de bus y de metro cerca. El piso estaba impecable, ordenado y es muy bonito, nos sentimos muy comodos. El barrio nos encanto, es tranquilo, bonito y tiene buenos restaurantes cerca. Tobias vive al lado y para cualquier cosa lo tenemos ahi, y es una persona atenta y muy amable. El ultimo dia de la estancia, Tobias nos guardo la maleta en su apartamento sin problema para que pudieramos aprovechar el ultimo dia por Berlin.
Sehr schöne lage und super gemütliche betten .

We loved our stay at Numa | Sketch. It was in a very nice location with loads of bars and restaurants nearby and also had very cool rooms. It is self check-in which made it very easy to check in and they reply to Whatsapp messages quickly.
Die Wohnung ist super schön und war in perfektem Zustand. Der Kontakt mit Tobias war sehr angenehm und alles hat reibungslos funktioniert. Ich freue mich auf meinen nächsten Aufenthalt.
The place is very clean and cozy as well. there were no problems with communication at all. Jan even gave us some tips for cafés in the area.

Notre hôte a été très aimable et rapide pour répondre aux questions. Le quartier est plutôt sympathique et l'appartement aussi. Le balcon est très confortable ! Par contre l'appartement était très sale.

The appartment of Ivos was great! It's very clean and has everything you need. The location is also really nice. The communication on arrival was not perfect, but the host made up for that extensively so we were very happy about that. Would definitely recommend.

Fai's place is wonderful--gorgeous natural light, simple and comfortable furnishings, a peaceful Berlin balcony perfect for a quiet coffee or drink with a bit of stargazing on a clear night, and convenient proximity to U- and S-Bahn lines. Fai arranged everything for a very smooth arrival, and was lightning fast with her responsiveness to questions during our stay. Great value. Would definitely recommend her place. Thanks again, Fai!

Appartamento molto spazioso ed accogliente,vicinissimo ai mezzi pubblici e veramente comodo.
Lo consiglio vivamente!

Ein kurzer aber intensiver Aufenthalt.
Die Wohnung war genau richtig für 3 Personen. Alles vorhanden zum Selbstversorgung.
Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder.

Linda is super sweet, polite and kind, a no doubt amazing host! one thing to notice, there's no lift at the place and it's located on a 4th floor. other than that 100/10 would definitely come back at her place
Excellent place to stay, Lars was fantastic and helpful throughout. Highly recommend.
Super Airbnb!

Angela is an incredible host - so friendly and welcoming. She was proactive about communicating with us regarding checkin and made sure we understood how to get to her place which was easy enough to do. The room and bathroom were excellent and very clean. It was also quite private from her living space. The bed was high up so those who have a fear if heights or mobility issues this could be a challenge. Lots of restaurants close by. Angela gave us some great advice on what to see in Berlin and she went out of our way to help us with specific requests. A great stay.

Essa acomodação superou todas as minhas expectativas. O apartamento é perfeito, tudo limpo, tem privacidade, check in simples e uma ótima localização: tem supermercados, farmácias, restaurantes e shopping perto. Da pra fazer tudo com facilidade.
toll wie immer
appartement spacieux et très calme.  Situation idéale. Le top !

Le séjour chez Ellen à Berlin s'est très bien passé !
Hôte à l'écoute.
Endroit calme, très bien situé avec transport en commun, restaurant, bar.
Tout est facile d'accès
Je recommande !
Tasteful furnished room, very clean and quiet.

The place is far from most of the sights to see. About 40-60 min to walk to Alexandtplatz. But you can buy day pass for public transportation. Host doesn't speak English, but it wasn't a problem. Pillows were too skinn. Regarding noise, there a bar behind the wall. Sometimes it gets really noisy, depends how sensitive you are. In general I can recommend staying at Malik's place. Reasonable price for reasonable apartment. Double bed is okay now. Idk how it was before.
Excelente servicio y excelentes instalaciones. Muchas gracias por todo
we had a lovely stay. the apartment was fully equipped and spacious. the owners are very friendly.
Everything perfect

This is the third time I have stayed at Andy's apartment over the past 18 months, and all the positives I and others have mentioned hold true: the flat is clean, well-equipped and well-located and Andy is pleasant and easy to deal with.
However, the one negative point to mention is that on every occasion I have stayed, there has been renovation work on the floor above resulting in banging and drilling which starts at 8.30 each weekday. For those who rise early and spend most of the day outside the apartment, this is unlikely to be an issue though for those who like to sleep late this can be problematic.
While I realise that such work is not in the control of the host, I was disappointed to find this going on once again after having specifically enquired if any was planned.
5 minute walk from the train station. This place is super clean!!! Had a very pleasant stay there.

Stella and her team were super friendly and responsive. However, the shower wasn't working when we arrived which was super annoying as a group of 5. They took care of it while we out in the city. The whole apartment - but especially kitchen and furnishing - is quite worn already and you can hear every sound your neighbours make. However, as the location is quite central it's a good place if you're looking for a place to sleep in Berlin.

The flat was a good size for what we were looking for. Clara was friendly and helpful.  A few cleanliness issues here and there but didn’t detract from the stay overall. The bed is large and comfy but nearly on the ground as well as the ‘sofa’ in the room - which made it a bit uncomfortable. Kitchen has everything you’d need. Thanks Clara!

Franziksa was very accommodating to us dropping our luggage off before check-in time and the flat is very convenient for the tram stop right outside. The room is very small however, which is fine for one person, but there was not enough space to have two suitcases open at the same time. They have a new puppy that they’re training not to go in the bedrooms, so we were instructed to keep the bedroom door closed, which made the room quite hot, meaning we needed the window open, and the courtyard outside was loud late at night and early morning. The room is advertised as check-out being at 2pm, but Franziska’s daughter knocked on the door at 11.45am, asking when we were leaving as they had other guests checking in (check in is at 5pm).

Audrey was a wonderful and friendly host. The room was clean and comfortable, communication and check-in were all fast and easy. I loved the charm of the old building and it’s in a great neighborhood with access to parks and several subways. I would not hesitate to recommend this room. Thanks for everything!

Had an amazing stay here. Thoroughly recommend. Apartment spotless, secure, comfortable with lots of kitchen items. Bath AND shower. Lovely. Lots of shops, bars and amenities. Public transport frequent and easy to use. Get the BVG app. Would definitely come again. Thank you Remy, Waldo and Ignacio!

Für einen Kurzurlaub perfekt. Lage und Ausstattung top. Miniküchenausstattung (Geschirr, Wasserkocher, Kaffeemaschine, Kühlschrank, Tee und Kaffee) ermöglicht sogar ein Frühstück auf dem Zimmer. Mehr geht allerdings nicht. Wir haben uns wohlgefühlt -  allerdings sollte man keinen klassischen Hotelservice erwarten.

Hôte très accueillant et chaleureux , qui est la quoiqu on ait besoin
Appartement agréable et original
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour

It was absolutely great to stay at Johanna’s place. I can only recommend her place for any visitors to Berlin.
I liked everything about my stay, and will certainly be back soon.
Thanks for everything dear Johanna!
Komunikation war auf hoch level und alles andere sachen war auch gut ....👍👍👍

Apartment was ok. The problem was the people living in the other apartments, nerighbors. They were all the time shouting in the corridors and loudly opening and closing doors, at night. Common areas like elevator and corridors were all the time with trash left behind.
But the worst was the shower place/bathroom. The water accumulated easily and the dirty water stayed blocked in the box. If I had been alerted, before renting, I would thought twice and maybe I had decided for another place. Strangely in the apartment there were alerts about the possibilty of flooding in the shower box.
I suggest to fix the place or leave cristal clear in AirBnB ad about the problems in the bathroom.

Wij hebben een super leuke tijd gehad in de Airbnb van Julius. Het huisje was brandschoon, en alle spullen zo goed als nieuw. Het is heel ruimtelijk. Overdag en snachts is het muisstil, ondanks je midden in de stad zit. Dit komt omdat het huisje op een binnenplaats staat. Echt een hele bijzondere ervaring. Tram zit om de hoek. Julius is heel behulpzaam en reageert snel. Wij zullen zeker terugkomen wanneer we weer in Berlijn zijn.
Alles war perfekt.

We enjoyed our stay in Berlin and this accommodation is in a great location as long as you don't mind using transportation to get to downtown Berlin.  We did find the 2 apartments as 1 rental a bit awkward for our group (2 couples and a single) but would likely work well for families or a "younger" group.  Overall, this is a good place to stay.

Wir waren mega zufrieden, haben uns gleich absolut wohlgefühlt.
Danke nochmals für alles liebe Wibke, wir kommen gerne wieder!

Had a nice stay at Tamara’s place. Tamara is a friendly and responsive host. The place has a great location; it’s close to public transport and various supermarkets, and is located in a hip neighborhood (Friedrichshain) with various restaurants, bars and tourist destinations nearby. As others have mentioned, the corridor can be a bit noisy as there’s a general practitioner located in the same building, but it didn’t bother us too much. Would recommend to stay here!

Gunilla is a charming lady with a delightful apartment. It’s close to underground stations and is super easy to get to from the airport. (Shoenfeld)
The beds are very comfortable the bathroom is huge. The kitchen is basic but it’s all you need as there are so many cafes and bars close by. We had a great stay. Thankyou Gunilla!

A perfectly formed studio with a great layout. We loved the powerful shower, the bed is very comfortable & the whole place is spotlessly clean. Antonio was great at communicating with us before and during our stay with very clear instructions for getting into the studio as we arrived late. We struggled to work the TV (though that might have just been us) and the wifi signal wasn't very strong but this didn't affect our stay. Good location & close to the transport connections.

War wirklich ein entspanntes Wochenende, von der Lage her auch sehr praktisch weil man in nur 4 min zu Fuß zur S-Bahn Station gelangen konnte und innerhalb von 30-40 min Gesamtzeit haben wir alles erreicht wo wir hin wollten.
Wenn wir irgendwas gebraucht haben mussten wir nur danach fragen und dann wurde uns weiter geholfen, da könnte man möglicherweise gleich Sachen (z.B. Handtücher) bereitlegen.
Die beiden Hunde sind wirklich lieb und zur Zeit sind auch noch 2 Kätzchen da. Dementsprechend sind in der Wohnung Tierhaare und ein paar Sachen liegen rum aber im großen und ganzen wars von der Sauberkeit her wirklich in Ordnung.
Zwischenmenschlich gesehen war Filip (Lara war selbst an diesem Wochenende verreist) entspannt drauf und man konnte sich gut mit ihm unterhalten. Wir haben uns an den Tagen abgesprochen zwecks Unternehmungen und beim Check-Out war es auch nicht schlimm dass wir erst eine Stunde später gefahren sind als angegeben.
Im großen und Ganzen für den Preis wirklich gut. :)
L'appartement correspond bien aux photos du site et il est très fonctionnel.

호스트가 체크인 안내는 쉽게 해줘서 좋았어요. 입구는 통유리창이라 로비가 훤히 보여서 지나가는 사람들이 계속 쳐다보고 앞에서 구경하고 그랬어요! 중간문을 닫지 않으면 직선구조로 방 안까지 훤히 보여서 중간문 꼭 닫고 다녔습니다. 혼숙이고 공용욕실인데 욕실 잠금장치는 못본 것 같아요(?) 저는 2층 침대인데 캐리어도 그렇고 좀 불편했어요. 꼭 1층으로 원한다고 미리 말씀하세요!!! 위치는 힙한 곳이라고 하더군요. 저는 대문자 B추천 합니다!! ㅎㅎ
A decent, lovely and kind family! Such a great experience with this host! Really recommend it! Thanks to all of them.

Jeg havde sammen med min nevø fra Sydkorea et fantastisk ophold i Tinas lejlighed. Alt var nydeligt, pænt og rent, og Tina er en virkelig en sød og rar dame, som har styr på det hele i forhold til at gøre ens ophold i hendes lejlighed til en super god oplevelse. Hvad angår Tinas lejlighed, så har den en perfekt lokation - blot et stenkast fra metrolinjen, KaDeWe og Kurfürstendamm. Det eneste minus er, at supermarkederne i Berlin har lukket om søndagen (men det er jo ikke Tinas skyld). Jeg kan virkelig varmt anbefale at leje sig ind hos Tina, hvis man skal til Berlin :) Mange, mange tak Tina!!!

Très belle chambre dans un quartier Chic, calme et bien desservi.
Je recommande beaucoup !
Alex's place is closer to Hauptbahnhof, easy to access by any type of transportation. It is located in a quiet place. I would highly recommend it for anyone visiting Berlin.

Sehr angenehme Wohung. Alle räume super ausgestattet.
Das einzige: die Garderobe war sehr lose :-) evtl. ab und zu an der einen und anderen Stelle was erneuern.
Ansonsten sehr zu empfehlen

Definitely worth it, Tammy was so easy going & friendly, was very flexible with times, her place was very simple and homie for me, comfortable, no noise and perfect for my event across the road really, but would come back even if I'd be visiting city centre.
Tammy also supplied me kindly with the cake decoration paints she randomly had & I couldn't get before my event. So yes, very happy, thank you 🫶

A wonderful quiet retreat away from the busyness of the Berlin streets. It was a no fuss, charming little place that I'd happily recommend to anyone travelling solo or as a couple. I found walking through the Kulturbrauerei to the Rewe shops pleasant and convenient. Plus access to trains and trams was very easy but didnt hear any of the noise. 3 nights was a good amount for me to enjoy the area, the only thing that caught me out were the nearby businesses often required cash for payment, particularly the restaurants. Thanks for the lovely stay!
Great location, very comfortable nice place!

Immer wieder gerne. Tolle Lage, tolle Unterkunft. Wird nicht das letzte mal gewesen sein. Rundum perfekt.
Vielen Dank!

Really convenient, great location
Cute for a friends trip in a nice neighbourhood
Lovely stay at Audrey's place, conveniently located close to transport, clean, comfortable and personal touches by Audrey

Our first trip to Berlin
And it definitely won’t be our last, this apartment was like being at home in another city.
From the moment we booked until the moment we left our host was available and responded quickly to questions.
Nothing seemed too much trouble.
The space was very clean, well laid out and had everything we needed.
Thought has been put into things, from maps of the area to recommendations of local services to the equipment provided (washing machine, coffee maker, additional blankets etc)
Big thanks to our host Sven.
Appartement très grand et très agréable, au calme ( les fenêtres donnent sur une cour)

Lovely apartment,  good amount of space. Close to tube station and supermarket. Comfortable beds, good to have 2 bathrooms,  great coffee machine. Weather was very mild and heating was on so felt a bit hot at times (couldn't work out how to turn it off).  All in all, I would highly recommend this as a good place to stay.

Wunderschöner Ort am Rande Berlins um abzuschalten...das Häuschen liegt direkt am Feld/Waldrand zudem man auch direkten Zugang hat.Es hat alles was man so braucht- der Stil ist wie in der alten Zeit, rustikal und urig, einfach super gemütlich. Die Gastgeber sind sehr nett und immer zur Stelle, wenn es eine Frage gab. Meine Tochter liebte die Hühner und Kaninchen über alles... DANKE... gerne wieder
First time in Berlin and it was a very quiet, well located, cozy and clean place to stay. :)

Room: was as expected but a bit bigger than the pictures make it out to be. It may have been a little too small for a family of 6 full grown adults but if you have younger children it's not a problem.
Location: In a very hip neighborhood close to Alexanderplatz. It was easy to operate out of this area for a few days. Lots of things in walking distance as well.
Communication: We did have an issue with the wrong passcode when we initially got to the unit it took about 30 minutes to resolve so it was no problem. THey even let us check-in earlier the day of our arrival.
Overall I am happy with my stay and enjoyed our time at this unit. Would recommend.
todo muy bien, las toallas muy pequeñas y viejas
Dejlig lejlighed, stille område, tæt på transport.
Limpio, seguro y cómodo.
Super emplacement,logement très bien situé au calme et proche de vraiment tout.  rien à redire avec juste un petit mieux nécessaire  pour la propreté de la cuisine
Bellissimo soggiorno. Consigliato
This place was perfect for a quick stay in Berlin - the apartment had everything you could imagine with plenty of storage, a cosy bed, and a nice hot shower!
Ich wurde sehr herzlich empfangen und konnte mich in der Wohnung wie zu Hause bewegen.

We enjoyed our stay, the apartment was very close to tram stops so we could easily get around and some nice restaurants nearby. The apartment was clean and heaps of room for the 4 of us. Definitely recommend!

We loved staying in Birgit's apartment. Birgit is a super host and was very helpful whenever needed, the apartment is in a great location with cafes and restaurants close to public transport, and we had everything we needed in the apartment. Extra plus for the character of the apartment, overall we had a great stay and can only recommend.
immer wieder

Great hosts, friendly and always available for any needs.
Recommended!
The flat couldn't be in a better position. The surroundings are lively and safe. It's clean and provides you with everything you might need during a short visit in Berlin.
Was a very good place to stay. Nice host.

Very nice apartment with a great location. Short walk to the S and U bahn, several grocery stores close. Very quiet location and easy parking, and free parking close by. The apartment was well equipped, nice beds and great bathroom. Highly recommendable.

The apartment was clean, beautiful and conveniently located very close to an S bahn station. The Prenzlauer Berg neighbourhood was our favorite part of the city with nice cafes and restaurants. Hope to come back some time!

Het appartement zag er goed uit en ligt mooi gelegen dicht bij het centrum. Met de fiets kun je mooi alles in 2 dagen bekijken en op de looproute terug zijn genoeg restaurants om even lekker uit eten te gaan. De host reageerd snel op vragen.
Foi muito agradável a estadia ! Tudo nota 10!

Wir waren für einen Kurzurlaub mit unseren 2 Jungs in dem Haus. Das Haus ist sehr stylisch und schön eingerichtet, hat uns total gut gefallen.
Die Kommunikation war super nett und schnell. Alles war total unkompliziert und entspannt.
Wir haben wirklich tolle Tage dort verbracht!! TOP
fue justo como dice su publicación. Olaf y su esposa son muy amables

Die Wohnung ist wie beschrieben und Oli ist ein angenehmer Gastgeber.
Das Zimmer hat ein riesiges bequemes Bett und gleich nebenan das eigene Badezimmer mit Toilette , kleinem Waschbecken und Dusche.
Die Wohnung liegt in einem belebten Viertel von Berlin. In der Strasse sind viele Restaurants und Cafes angesiedelt.
Leider mußte ich meinen Aufenthalt wegen Krankheit abbrechen, würde aber gerne wieder bei Oli übernachten
Smidigt, allt vi behövde och på perfekt läge i Friedrichshein!
Great location. Spacious apartment. Good neighbourhood.
War ein sehr guter Aufenthalt. Man hat Supermärkte Drogerie sehr schnell erreicht, als auch eine Bahn Station in der Nähe. Anna hat immer sehr schnell und total freundlich geschrieben.

Wir waren zusammen mit unserem 12-jährigen Sohn in der Wohnung. Ein toller Ausgangsort für die Erkundung Berlins. Wir lieben das bunte, alternative Leben rund um den Kotti. Die Verkehrsanbindung ist ideal, die Möglichkeiten zur Verpflegung unendlich. Die Wohnung war für uns genau passend…

Alles in der Wohnung war, wie beschrieben. Wir haben uns perfekt wohl gefühlt!
Die Wohnung liegt zentral und in der Nähe des Mauerparks, wo wir einen wunderschönen Sonntag verbracht haben.
Die Wohnung sehr gut, schön und mit genügendem Platz für vier Personen.
Rosario ist ein sehr lieber Gastgeber! Alles war super :)
Ernest's place was beautiful, spacious and wonderfully convenient. communication was great, and the neighborhood is beautiful! would love to coe back there
Irish was wonderful, flexible,  understanding, and helpful! I appreciate her kindness!

Fantastic stay! The flat is clean, incredibly comfortable, and has a very nice aesthetic. Super close to everything you could need, including an organic grocery store. Flawless check-in process and entire stay. Thank you, Ulf!
We had a lovely stay. The apartment was very clean and unfussy and the neighborhood is great.

Das Airbnb liegt wirklich super zentral und direkt am Mauerpark. Vom HBF sind es ca. 15 Minuten, zu Restaurants und Bars ca. 5-10 Minuten Fußweg.
Das Airbnb sieht aus wie auf den Bildern, bei 6 Personen schlafen 2 im Wohnzimmer auf der ausziehbaren Couch, was vollkommen OK war.
Bis auf das dunkle Bad (Lampe wurde repariert) und die Missverständnisse ums WiFi hatten wir einen tollen Aufenthalt in Berlin.
Hôte réactive. Apparemment fonctionnel proche des transports et petits commerces. Je recommande 👍
Great place
Superschöne Wohnung  an bester Lage. Tolle Terrasse, ruhig und sehr sauber. Aufmerksame Gastgeberin, sehr gut erreichbar. Danke.

This place is a GEM on Airbnb. Even for a classic "Drei-Raum Wohnung" in Prenzlauer Berg it feels pretty special: spacious, well lit, and comfortable.
We have both lived a long time in Berlin (though many years ago) and know the area pretty well. But we had forgotten how peaceful, green, and inviting Prenzlauer Berg can be. Even if one is traveling to the capital to "see all the sights," it's great to have a nice place for lunch or coffee or ice cream right around the corner. This apartment is in the middle of it all. Or if one happens to be traveling with small kids like we were, there are great playgrounds nearby where they can get some energy out.
Nassa was a great host – very proactive with details about the apartment, and was flexible with logistic, both for checkin and checkout. We'd love to stay again the next time we're in Berlin.
Oh – and our daughter wanted to add to the review: "I loved how the rooms were so big, and my little brother really loved the toys!"

Quiet neighborhood. Quiet host but he answers questions. Quiet adorable cat. Clean and tidy apartment on fifth floor of a building. One supermarket a few steps away.  Short walk to S/U-bahn station – a ride to central train station takes 15 to 20 minutes. It was a good stay.
Perfectly located, an hour on foot from a lot of super things tu see, private parking is a huge plus. Dirk is a good person, and speak perfectly english. Everything was perfect.

Highly recommended! Andreas is a great host and an amazingly kind person !
Nice to meet you Andreas
A great stay!

Holger and Susan were wonderful hosts—very generous and warm. The room is tucked away in their incredibly stylish apartment, behind the kitchen, with its own outdoor access and plumbing, making it incredibly private and cozy. The location is top-notch, with easy access to great restaurants and supermarkets. They also have two sweet cats, Tymy and Lulu, who will surely inspect your belongings.
Great apartment, very spacious and clean.
Wunderhübsche, mit viel Liebe eingerichtete Wohnung, beste Lage der Welt, super sauber und eine fantastische Gastgeberin. Sehr, sehr, sehr zu empfehlen!
Very helpful host. Nice cozy room. Totally recommended

Blinds were not working, hence the second bedroom (just separated via a curtain and not a proper door) was very bright and difficult to sleep in the morning. After asking Arthur, he came and built a dark curtain, which was appreciated.
Second bathroom had still very wet towels and hair in the bathtub when we arrived. Also, no shampoo provided.
Overall, not worth a €400/night stay in Berlin.
Beautiful apartment in a great location ! 10/10

Oli und seine Familie sind super organisiert und dadurch die perfekten Gastgeber. Die Kommunikation erfolgte stehts super zeitnah und zuverlässig, was heutzutage keine Selbstverständlichkeit mehr ist. Ich habe mich in der Wohnung von Oli sehr, sehr wohlgefühlt, und es bereut, dass ich nur zwei Nächte bleiben konnte... eine Unterkunft, in der man sich für kurze, aber auch für lange Aufenthalte total wohlfühlt. Die Wohnung ist super funktional und modern eingerichtet, das habe ich selten so erlebt. Zur Begrüßung standen Blumen auf dem Tisch, alles war super sauber. Frische Handtücher, Klopapier, Bademäntel, Waschmittel, Duschzeug usw... es ist wirklich an alles gedacht worden. Besser kann man es als Gastgeber wirklich nicht machen.
Sehr zentral, und dennoch ruhig gelegen. Nah am Bahnhof Zoo.
Vielen Dank Oli, und vorallem auch an deine Eltern, für den tollen Empfang und den flexiblen Check-out.
Ich kann die Unterkunft nur empfehlen, und würde sie jederzeit gerne wieder buchen wollen.
Viele liebe Grüße
Rebekka

El apartamento es como en las fotos. Amplio, luminoso, totalmente equipado, muy cerca de la Alexander Platz así que cerca de todo en Berlín. Marius ha sido muy amable, comunicativo y detallista. Volvería sin dudar.
Schöne Wohnung und freundlicher Kontakt!
Eine schöne kleine Wohnung im EG, sehr schön eingerichtet.

I stayed at Frau’s apartment for 4 nights and very much enjoyed my stay. Her place was clean, tidy and comfortable. The location is perfect, supermarkets, pharmacy’s and restaurants are all in walking distance and the metro station is  about a 5 minutes walk. Overall I had a great time, and would definitely recommend staying!

Helpful host, nice area, all was well.
Tip: Should trains not be running to Grunewald for some reason, you can take the M19 bus from the S-Bahn station which runs east as far as the junction with Yorckstrasse and Mehringdamn. There is an underground station just north of here, or you can get off a little before at Yorckstrasse station. You can take a train to the city centre from both stations. If returning on the M19 late in the evening, make sure to get on one that is going to Grunewald station and not the one terminating somewhere else in Grunewald, although it's a short walk back to a bus stop on the route you should be on. Note: buses may suddenly terminate enroute but don't worry, there'll another along very soon

Beautiful little loft in an amazing location! Quick walk to train station which you can easily get into the main parts of Berlin - like Alexanderplatz.

Serkan hat sofort auf alle Fragen geantwortet und war extrem gastfreundlich. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und es war genau das richtige für unsere Übernachtung in Berlin. Es hat an nichts gefehlt und die Wohnung war überaus sauber. Jederzeit weiter zu empfehlen und wieder zu buchen!
Herzlichen Dank an Ariane & Henning für ein wirklich gemütliches, sauberes Wohlfühlappartement.
Habe mich in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. W-Lan war nicht das Schnellste, aber ansonsten alles bestens.

We had a great time in Carmen's studio apartment. Cosy, well equipped and well connected into Central Berlin, it had everything we needed. Carmen was really helpful too: good communication, advice on getting from the airport and around, bikes to rent, offers of a warm fire in the evening.
The trains do run quite close to the apartment, so if you're a really light sleeper this might not be for you. It's a 20 minute walk from Friedrichshain's main eating/drinking area, which suited us well but does involve a bit of an extra walk.
And don't be put off by the arrival through an old bit of industrial East Berlin - all car workshops and warehouses - once you're at Carmen's place it's an oasis of plants, hammocks and log fires.

Esta estancia es maravillosa !
El lugar está muy limpio y los detalles que tiene son fantásticos !
Esta estancia ofrece todo lo que se necesita.

amazing journey, thank you!

Mijn broertje en ik hebben erg genoten van het verblijf. Het is een mooi, appartement met een ruime, lichte kamer. Alles is schoon. Het zit op een erg goede locatie in een leuke wijk. Absoluut een aanrader!
Great stay at this Airbnb. Amazing decor and location. So many cool places to eat and drink nearby. Not too touristy but still quiet and relaxing.

Stella’s cozy abode makes for a great
stay in Berlin. It was a brisk walk away from the East Side Gallery and right next door was the Kali Cafe, which had a great vibe and friendly workers. Stella herself was quick at responding to messages and left helpful notes around the studio. It was an ideal fit for my friend and I, but I could see it being a bit snug for more than two people. Would definitely recommend Stella’s home, and would love to stay here again for a future trip to Berlin.

Vincent and Ina were incredibly helpful and responsive! The apartment location was great with a lot of restaurants within walking distance.
The art in the apartment was also really unique and I enjoyed reading the meanings behind the pieces.
I definitely recommend this to anyone looking to stay in Berlin and have a unique experience in a great location!

Super Tolle Lage Nähe des Parks und der U-Bahn, zu Fuß einkaufen sehr gut möglich! Zudem war es ein recht Ruhiger Ort um uns herum. Die Kommunikation zum Airbnb - Vermieter war super angenehm und schnell!
Leider konnten wir durch die Bilder nicht ganz wahrnehmen, wie das Airbnb aufgebaut wurde. Wir waren dennoch von der Größe positiv überrascht.
Leider mangelte es etwas an der Hygiene außerhalb des Bad bereichs, was uns für den Gesamtpreis den wir für 6 Tage zahlten, schon sehr schade fanden.
Zusammenfassend war es ein schönes Airbnb, nur müssten einige Punkte noch überarbeitet werden.

Ich habe dieses Apartment sehr kurzfristig gebucht, da unsere andere Unterkunft storniert wurde. Direkt nach der Buchung hatten wir automatisch alle Infos, bzgl. Check in und Schlüssel Tresor. Nicht nur frisch saniert, sondern auch super schön, gemütlich & praktisch eingerichtet und es war sehr sehr sauber. Malte hat sich direkt über air B n B gemeldet ob alles geklappt hat.
Da wir mit Kleinkindern da waren (4 & 3) hat uns der eigene Eingang im Erdgeschoss sehr gut gefallen. Das Apartment ist auch direkt an der U-Bahn. Wir sind mehr als glücklich gewesen und wissen schon jetzt: bei unserem nächsten Berlinbesuch kommen wir wieder in dieses Apartment.
Herzlichen Dank!
Anke foi muito atenciosa e o espaço estava perfeito, aconselho a 100%
Ganz herzliche Gastgeber, die mir sogar beim Bestellen vom Taxi geholfen haben. Wir bekamen sogar Kaffee und haben den Aufenthalt in der grünen Oase sehr genossen. Gerne wieder!

We had a great time in Berlin, partly because of this beautiful apartment. It was more than spacious enough for the two of us, fully equipped, very clean and in a nice neighbourhood. We would definitely recommend it to others!

Ich wäre gerne länger geblieben und werde definitiv wiederkommen!

Very nice place to stay for a city trip or business trip in Berlin. The apartment is cosy, has all necessary equipment and is cleaned up every day by very kind staff. Close to public transport. 100% recommend.

The house was fantastic, great design and view. The hosts were very friendly and accommodating. The only thing is if you're a light sleeper there is a lot of sound from the streets as its a busy area. Would recommend

Me and my sister had a great time at this hotel. The rooms were tidy and the location is great. You can walk to Alexanderplatz in 15-20 minutes.
We heard people talking in the room next to ours but it was pretty quiet, and all the people on our floor respected the quiet hours. There were only shared bathrooms and no kitchen, electric kettle or cutlery. However, all this is either mentioned on the Airbnb page or shown in the pictures, so we knew to expect it.
Overall, I think it's a good place to stay for a day or two. We have no complaints.
An amazing sophisticated apartment very centrally located and with an amazing host. Would happily stay here again!

Praktische , ordentliche und saubere Wohnung für zwei Personen mit liebevollen Details. Küche ist voll ausgestattet (sogar mit Waschmaschine), im SZ ein bequemes und breites 2er-Bett, TV an der Wand davor, ein Sofa, ein kleiner Schreibtisch, große Schränke und in der ganzen Wohnung stabiles W-LAN. Es gibt sogar einen Balkon mit Grill und im Keller 2 Fahrräder! Die Dusche (nicht separat sondern über der Wanne im Bad) ist für große Leute bisschen niedrig, aber ok.
S-Bahn und U-Bahn sind nur wenige Min. entfernt, Fahrzeit bis Mitte ca. 20-30 Min., zum Ku’damm oder Bhf. Zoo kürzer. Außerdem sind ein Späti, ein kleiner Lebensmittelladen und mehrere einfache Restaurants an der Ecke (Döner, asiatisch…). Ein größerer Edeka ist nicht weit.
Achtung, die Wohnung befindet sich im 4. Stock, das Haus hat keinen Aufzug.
Die Gastgeberin war uns gegenüber völlig unkompliziert.

I can only recommend this room. Anton is very nice host, the room is big, the flat has really great atmosphere. It is very close to the U-Bahn (I mean very very close, just a few meters from the flat) so it is a perfect place if you planning to spend a few days in Berlin.

Fantastic flat with many beautiful details and a wonderful sense of space. Excellent location and kept in immaculate condition. Very friendly communication with the owner, organisation very smooth and efficient. Thank you very much Nicolay - we could not have enjoyed it any more :-)

Séjour incroyable à Berlin, Johannes est l'hôte idéal, gentil et réactif. I had a great time at Yumi’s place! She was a fantastic hostess. The place was exactly as described. The garden was lovely, and it was really good located! I will definitely come back!
Ich habe mich sehr willkommen gefühlt bei Sabrina! Ein wunderschönes Haus mit allen, was man sich als Gast wünscht! 😊

Great apartment near all amenities.

Die Wohnung liegt mitten in einem ruhigen Wohngebiet, ist sehr sauber und bietet alles was man von der Unterkunft erwarten würde. Bei schönen Wetter kann man gemütlich auf der Terrasse zum Garten sitzen. In der Nähe befindet sich ein REWE und ein Penny-Markt.

乾淨衛生，離機場不遠打車10min，房東留有方便食品和水，能夠應急。有任何問題回覆也非常快速。

If you’re looking for a real Berlin living experience this is it. A trendy minimalist loft apartment close to shops and restaurants and within easy reach of a local bus stop S and U bahn. Perfect for that city break to explore Berlin. Nathalie is a fabulous host, clear instructions, flexible when she can be and really helpful with local recommendations. Would definitely come back again!

Jana is very kind and friendly. She told us a lot of useful information and gave us a lot of helps. Her response is perfect and very quick. She allowed us to store our luggage before check in and even let us early check in. The location is very good, near the city center， U/S train， and bus stations.
Jana 非常友好热心。她给了我们许多帮助和有用的信息。她的回复很快很有帮助。她允许我们提前放行李， 还让我们中午就入住。她家地点很好，靠近市中心，游览区，U/S 轨道和许多共交车站。
everything nice, big apartment, well connected
Die Unterkunft hat alles was man für kurze oder lange Aufenthalte braucht. Super Lage und gute Umgebung!

Es war alles top, vom Buchen übers Ein- und Auschecken, Kommunikation, Unterkunft, Sauberkeit und Sicherheit.  Alles nur zu empfehlen! Lage ist auch super gut, ÖPNV alles super erreichbar. Gerne wieder!

This is the apartment to rent in Berlin!It’s big and well equipped,it has everything you need and more.I was traveling with my son and my dad and we all loved to come back at night after spending the day visiting Berlin.It’s totally children safe and there are also some toys and books to spend the time.A home away from home.
Great location in Prenzlauer Berg. Easy to get to many areas from here in Berlin. Would definitely stay here again.
Very lovely stay. Highly recommend.

Sehr moderne und super saubere Wohnung in bester Lage. Alles in Laufweite ob REWE, Bäckereien ä, Restaurants und Bars.

Die Kommunikation mit Gihad war angenehm und unkompliziert. Habe mir die Wohnung ein wenig gemütlicher vorgestellt, aber sehr von den Bildern wich sie nicht ab. Ich gebe Gihad vier von fünf Sternen, weil mensch das Zimmer, entgegen der Beschreibung, nicht abschliessen konnte.

What an amazing week we had at this lovely place. It was hot (7 days heatwave) but at night it was ok with the big windows open and comfortable at the beautiful balcony. Natalia is very quick with communication and has really thought of every little detail in the apartment. And spotless clean! Maybe our best Airbnb experience so far. We have already recommended this little gem to friends. And we hope to go back some day with a lighter temperatures. Also in winter this would be a very cosy place!

My brother and I absolutely adored our stay with Kathrin this weekend! From the moment she greeted us at the door we felt right at home. The apartment is a beautifully decorated penthouse with breathtaking private outdoor space. The bedroom we stayed in was spacious and comfortable, perfect for one or two travelers. The area around the apartment has so many great restaurants, shops, and parks, and has convenient transit access to both the airport and rest of the city. And most importantly, Kathrin is one of the most hospitable Airbnb hosts I have ever stayed with and truly went above and beyond to make our stay great, including printing off directions for getting to the airport after checking out. I can’t recommend Kathrin’s apartment more highly!

We (a group of 5) stayed at Michele's flat for a weekend in May 2012 and will not hesitate to recommend it to anyone visting Berlin. The Prenzlauerberg area is lively, full of cafés, restaurants, boutiques. Quite a few recommended places were within short distance from the apartment.

The apartment itself is just as pictured. We can attest that the bed and 2 sofa beds are comfortable. The kitchen is fully equipped if you'd like to do some cooking. There is even a barbecue grill on the terrace. And of course, the jacuzzi tub is a treat.

Since there were several of us who arrived at separate times, I didn't have the pleasure of meeting Michele. However, he was friendly, quick and reliable with our reservations. (He's fluent in English, German, French and Italian... so he's got most communication needs covered). He gave us thorough instructions on how to arrive from the airport and sort ourselves out at the flat. He left a 3 page list of restaurants to try and his nightlife recommendation was spot on, an underground party we would never have found on our own.

Large, comfortable flat, best area in Berlin, excellent host, don't hesitate booking this place.

Peter hat mich und meinen Hund wunderbar aufgenommen. Er ist ein sehr zuvorkommender Gastgeber und ein ausgesprochen freundlicher und netter Mensch. Wir haben uns rundum wohl gefühlt und wären gerne länger geblieben!
We really enjoyed the stay, Rudi is very responsive and friendly. The place is great!
Top Lage, Kommunikation war super, alles Wichtige wurde kommuniziert. Gut zu wissen das es im Haus noch eine 2. Wohnung gibt falls man mal mit mehreren Freunden verreisen möchte.

Wonderful flat, whit a lot of space.

A spacious loft in a great spot near some great bars and restaurants!

Pareceria que el lugar todavia no está completo para poder hospedarse. Las duchas no tenian ni cortinas ni nada que pueda contener el agua lo que hacia que se moje todo el baño. This flat is a perfect location to go sightseeing, if you’re here for the marathon it is so easy to get to the start and return when you’re finished, a market next door, and a beautiful view. Gospodyni była bardzo miła, pokój zgadzał się z tym, co widać na zdjęciach. Okolica jest faktycznie malownicza, blisko przepięknego jeziora.
Is a big thumbs up for everyone who first time in Berlin. Mona and Ahmed really a great host.

Lisa and her husband met us outside just as the taxi dropped us off. They were lovely and charming and made us feel very welcome. The apartment was warm and cosy with a lovely and well equipped kitchen and balcony. Lisa very kindly bought us milk and cookies and gave us lots of information about the area.  We were also allowed to stay a bit later on checkout as our flight home was in the evening. Overall very pleased with our 1st air B&B experience. Thanks Lisa!

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in dem Appartement. Es war alles wie beschrieben und gemütlich eingerichtet.

The staff were quick to respond and friendly when we met in person. The only thing is that I asked if the wifi was stable because I would be in an important zoom meeting and I was assured that it’d be. Unfortunately, my internet got disconnected a few times. Otherwise, all was good.
The U is 3 min walk so easy to access to Wedding area. Might be a bit of work with a big suitcase as it is on the 3rd floor.

Muy bien! El apartamento es un poco más pequeño de lo que parece en las fotos, pero está super limpio, ordenado y bien equipado. Super Unterkunft für einen kurzen Trip nach Berlin.

Im Großen und Ganzen haben wir uns wohlgefühlt.
Habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt. Vielen Dank dafür
Eine schöne Ferienwohnung,  ruhig gelegen und dennoch zentral.

Kevin and Caroline were very kind and responsive hosts. They made our group feel welcome and made the check-in and check-out process really easy!

Nice place in the center of Berlin and the owners of the house are very friendly people!

Chic apartment in an old brick building. Easy to get to and many restaurants around. However it is relatively close to where some less tourist-friendly areas of the city start.

Singer hostel was a really good choice, perfect location, good amenities, friendly staff and normal price!
Top Lage und perfekt für einen Wochenendtripp in Berlin!

Ein rundum gelungener Aufenthalt! Ich war für ein paar Tage in Berlin und war bei Jo und Fran um mir bei der Gelegenheit die Stadt anzuschauen. In 5 Min zu Fuß am Rosenthaler Platz, wo die U8 alle 5 Minuten kommt und man in 2 Stationen am Alex ist. Viele süße Restaurants und Caffes in der Nähe, das Saramat kann ich wärmstens empfehlen. Wenn ich nochmal in Berlin bin, frage ich gerne wieder an :)
Well equipped and clean flat in a central location next to a railway station. Easy check in and well organised.

LO RECOMIENDO COMPLETAMENTE.

La limpieza del lugar es muy buena. Algo que me encantó es qué hay crema de cuerpo en el baño.

The location is perfect and the apartment has everything you need for a short stay. Till was very friendly and helpful.

This was our first time to Berlin and we picked the perfect place to stay. Thanks so much Henrik for hosting us. It is a very big apartment. Nice and spacious. Completely as the description and photos. The address is easy to find, but it is difficult to find the front door of the apartment. The area is Berlin specific (considering the multinational environment), but the proximity of the metro makes it very easy to get everywhere. Overall very recommendable. All in all, a good choice for a group of friends who are open to new experiences.

Hier gäbe es, falls möglich, Besserungsbedarf. Ansonsten alles tipitopi und wir würden auch wieder buchen. Danke und liebe Grüße
Great place to stay located in a neighbourhood with a lot of bars and restaurants. Liked the appartment!

Clean, newly renovated, impersonal rooms with kitchenette. There would be at least 30-40 rooms here. Free coffee, a beer in the fridge, free wifi, lounge access and bag storage after check out are great. Ren handwash, moisturiser, shampoo & conditioner are a nice touch too.

Super angenehmes Bett, gut ausgestattete Küche, ein riesiges Wohnzimmer mit super Chill-Sofas und die Lage ist mehr als optimal. 2 Minuten zur UBahn, 5 Minuten zu den Shoppingarkaden, knapp 20 Minuten mit der UBahn zum Potsdamer Platz. Emir war herzhaft, begrüßte uns mit einem Lächeln und war immer für uns da wenn wir Fragen hatten. Sofort hieß es: "Ihr lebt hier, fühlt euch wie zuhause". Was will man mehr?
Alles super, vor allem hat es so spontan geklappt. Danke fürs Möglich machen.
A very cheap, clean and tidy flat on the ground floor in Neukölln, me and my friends appreciated it very much.

The apartment was extremely clean and exactly as described. Our hosts were very helpful with local recommendations and quick to respond to questions. Check-in and check-out was easy. The apartment was very central and close to train stations for easy transport around the city. The Wi-Fi signal was excellent. The local bio-markt next door was fantastic and perfect place for morning pastries.
The only slight issue is that the surrounding area near Kottbusser Tor is a little bit dodgy at night. However, this is not a serious problem and we appreciate this is nothing to do with the apartment or the hosts, both of which were fantastic.
We really enjoyed our trip and thank you very much to Philipp and Caroline.
Die Wohnung war sehr gut, ich habe mich dort sehr wohl gefühlt.

Roi’s place was just perfect!!! It’s in an excellent location with plenty of bus and train stations to get you anywhere in Berlin. The apartment is beautifully stylized and sparkling clean. The bed is sooooo comfy and perfect after a long night of travel. Wonderful host with very fast responses. I’d absolutely stay here again if I’m ever back in Berlin!
Really nice and clean

My boyfriend and I had a great stay at Apostolos place. Apostolos was very helpful and responded quickly to our questions. The flat is located in a very nice area and we would definitely recommend it.
Besides there not being wifi and a few house flies i really enjoyed my stay
War eine gute Unterkunft und der Kontakt hat perfekt funktionierz :)
Beautiful apartment in great localization. Vincent was always helpful and communicative. 100% will recommend to anyone visiting berlin.

Je recommande le logement d'Alan et Kasia qui est parfait pour quelques jours en amoureux. Il est situé près d'une station de transport en commun dans un quartier calme de Berlin.

I really enjoyed my stay here ☺️

Perfect spot for a family trip. The neighborhood is full of nice restaurants, kids stores and parks. The apartment is on ground floor (no stairs!!) but is super silent. Near many transport hubs. I went with wife, mother in law and baby so everyone had their room, but we could comfortably have a much larger family in it. Even had a crib!

Alloggio ampio, curato e comodissimo sia alla fermata del treno che alla Fiera.

Fantastic! Would stay here again, right in the middle of where the cool bars and restaurants were too……the hosts were easy and very helpful. X

Súper cómodo, hermoso y limpio el acceso al centro muy fácil una estación de bus en frente de la casa, súper rápido para llegar a cualquier lugar, el apto súper amplio tan como sale en las fotos, súper recomendado todo muy bien, un 10 de 10 mejor que un hotel !!!!!

Marion ist zurecht ein Super-Host! Durch die guten Absprachen im Vorfeld konnten wir einfach und unkompliziert unsere Pläne umsetzen. Wir waren mit einem Auto unterwegs und konnten problemlos einen Parkplatz finden - die schöne Wohngegend bietet ausreichend Möglichkeiten. Auf den Bildern wirkt die Unterkunft kleiner als in der Realität - man hat ausreichend Platz zu dritt und auch eine räumliche Trennung zwischen Doppelbett und Schlafsofa. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!

Un appartement coquet et très bien agencé, avec une situation exceptionnelle à proximité de tous les transports en commun, en plein centre du Berlin historique. De nombreux commerces de proximité permettent toutes les courses.
Les photos sont conformes à la réalité, la propreté et le confort sont irréprochables. Grace aux instruction de Daphné nous sommes arrivés à l'appartement sans problème.
Nous le conseillons chaleureusement à tous ceux qui désirent visiter Berlin.

Verda was very welcoming and kind. She helped us with our luggages as well. The flat was clean and chic and there are many good restaurants and cozy cafes around. Most of all, we loved the sunny balcony. We enjoyed our breakfasts there!

The place was fine, and the supermarket and public transport were super close. Besides this, the place was quite dirty. The sheets and blankets provided had stains and random hairs, so we had to wash everything before using it. The dishes in the cupboard were dirty so we had to wash before using. There were only 2 coffee pods for 2 people for 3 nights, and the coffee pods were not easily found in the supermarket.
Die Kommunikation war super! Auch die Wohnung war hervorragend und ist sehr gut gelegen. Wir hatten eine sehr gute Zeit im AirBnB!
Nice place, clean and great location.

todo perfecto nada que no fuese acorde con la descripción , volvería a escoger este alojamiento.

I would come back in a heartbeat.

Danke und wir kommen gerne wieder!

Bellissimo appartamento, una location perfetta per vivere al meglio l’esperienza di Berlino.

Nice and cozy place, close to almost all of the interesting places in Berlin. Mohammad gave a lot of useful information about Berlin and where to go.

Max and Sophie are amazing hosts! The communication was super quick and efficient. Their home is absolutely gorgeous. The photos you see do not show the real beauty of the space! It is so cozy and homey-I could live there forever. Big beautiful windows allow so much light and the peek at the TV tower. I enjoyed my morning meditation and then an awesome coffee made with their great coffee machine. The location is superb! It is a quiet neighborhood with wide alleys and streets. There are 2 public transport stations nearby, or you could easily walk to Axanderplatz and take S or Ubahn or Buses. The supermarket is 2 min walk away; great organic grocery store 7 min up the street, bakeries, cute coffee spots and more. When you arrive at an Airbnb, you hope for a quiet, clean, peaceful place to rest your head and body after a long day of exploring. Christiane’s home offers exactly that sanctuary. It’s calm, comfortable, and thoughtfully prepared. I was delighted to discover she even has a Tempur-Pedic mattress on a twin bed—truly sleep heaven for me.
But what makes the stay unforgettable isn’t just the comfort of the mattress or the quietness of the space. It’s the deep, immediate connection I felt with Christiane herself. From the moment we met, there was a rare and beautiful feeling of familiarity, as if we were old friends reunited. Her warmth, generosity, and kindness shine through in everything she does, and she goes above and beyond to make sure her guests feel cared for.
I wholeheartedly commend Christiane and feel grateful to have met her. The best part of my stay wasn’t just the restful nights—it was the gift of her presence.

The totally new loft is simply breathtaking. For our stay we were looking for a central accommodation in Berlin Mitte and found a gem. A 10-minute walk to Museum Island, just perfect for those who'd like to discover most beautiful Berlin Mitte by walking, but all public transport also very near. Nothing to compare with any other flat I've seen in Berlin so far. Really great furnishings, perfectly coordinated. You walk up the stairs of this beautiful historic building and are rewarded with a view that is unrivalled from two rooftops. The spacious terrace going to the backyard in absolute tranquillity with Mediterranean plants and sun loungers made us feel like we were in Tuscany - perfect for relaxing after a day of sightseeing. Extremely luxurious box-spring bed, perfectly equipped kitchen and high end bathroom. All in all, an absolute insider tip. There is no better place to stay in Berlin and we will definitely be back - if I could do so, I would give more than 5 stars.
