Tolle Unterkunft, schön eingerichtet, total ruhig und ich konnte sehr gut schlafen. Nette Vermieterin.
Super mit dem Bus zu erreichen.
Vielen Dank für die Möglichkeit.
Sehr empfehlenswert! Man ist mitten in einer sehr sympathischen Familie :)
Stylish flat, large and nice place to hang out in a quiet but central part of Berlin, we had a great visit!
Modern eingerichtete und saubere Unterkunft. Wir kommen gerne wieder 👍

Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt in dem Zimmer von Philip. Die Einrichtung ist geschmackvoll und hochwertig. Auch das Badezimmer ist modern und ansprechend gestaltet. Für uns perfekt um eine Nacht in Berlin Buch zu verbringen.
Flat is as advertised. Felt welcome and comfortable throughout my stay, a cozy spacious room in East Berlin.

Cozy house,  clean, all commodities included and well located (15min tram to city center). The hosts were kind and welcoming. They also let us keep our luggage in the house after the check out, while we visited the town one last time.

We very much enjoyed our stay at Matthias's place as we used it for a home base during the Euros. He was very accommodative as our plans changed and allowed us to check in at a different time than originally planned.
The unit was spacious and we always appreciate having a washer as it makes packing so much easier. With the grocery store steps away, it was easy to buy food for meals or a snack, and not have to eat out for every meal.
Berlin was rather warm when we were there, so it did take a while for the flat to cool down in the evening's. Public transportation was very close which made it easy to hop on the tram and connect to the broad network of trains.
We always felt safe and would recommend Matthias's place should your travels take you to Berlin

Carmen‘s Urban Mojo is a special place in the former East Berlin surrounded by car repair shops and the classic berlin block of flats. The Mojo is indeed quiet an d public transport is nearby.
Our kids loved it and the bed was comfortable 😄 A good place for a city holiday.
Very central and a super stay.

Communication with the host was great, the flat had everything we needed and the location was really lovely. Amazing brunch can be found just 2 minutes walk away. The flat is in a courtyard and was really quiet but it's also well within walking distance of lots of great bars and restaurants (genuinely a couple of minutes).
Lovely spot, really nice room and really nice hosts
El alojamiento estaba impecable, tenía todo lo necesario para cocinar con. supermercados cerca. Puede que parezca lejos pero tiene una estación a 100 m. Sin lugar a dudas lo recomiendo y volvería.

A wonderful apartment in a quiet area of the city, it is truly a gateway. There is everything one need for a perfect vacation. Christoph and Aileen are great hosts and have helped us a lot with advice on city attractions and transportation. We truly recommend it ..

Modern, spacious apartment in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, super well connected to public transport and lots of restaurants and shops around. Björn was always responsive, helpful and friendly. Our entire family had a great time.

It is a lovely apartment, and it got everything you need to feel at home,
the neighborhood is also very lovely. The communication with Andrea was good and fast!
Very nice and large room in one of the coolest neighborhoods in Berlin. Would stay here again!
Tolle Lage , schönes großes Zimmer

The room is as adverted and even more. What the advert and reviews don't tell you is how amazing the hosts are. Monica's apartment is centrally located, just a mere 3 minute walk from Alexanderplatz station. From the apartment, it is a short walk to the Berliner Dom, and the Museum Island. There is a bus stop in front of the apartment. I took Bus 100 to go to the Victory Column, Reichstag Building, Brandenburg Tor, etc. And if you need to go to the opposite direction, the tram station is a few minutes walk (it is near Alexanderplatz).
The room is clean, streamlined and tastefully decorated. You can tell it was done by an art person. Monica works for a film company and Yvonne is an architect. I stayed a total of 3 nights, and I slept very well. The bed and pillows were comfortable. You have your own private entrance and your own bathroom. I felt as if I am home because of these 2 things.
This is a 5-star rated accommodation as far as I am concerned and the hosts are more than awesome.

We loved this airbnb. The listing is spacious and sparkling clean--very nice bathroom. The space faces a courtyard, which helped block out street noise. We really enjoyed exploring the Kreuzberg neighborhood and found that the rest of the city was also easily accessible. We had a small difficulty checking in but once we were checked in everything was fine.
Todo perfecto
Thibault's place was really chic and cozy, enjoyed staying there a lot!
Ótimo espaço, ao lado uma estação de trem, supermercado e farmácia. Quartos bem espaçosos e bem decorados. Check-in e check-out muito simples de fazer. O banheiro poderia ser melhor.
The location was perfect, next to great food, public transportation, malls, and lots of history. Check in could have been a little more clear, but would stay here again!

for those looking to be close to mitte but in a quiet neighborhood, this is an ideal place to stay. The space is ample, and laundry was very helpful and worked well. Do be aware that the apt is directly off the street in a former store space. As a woman traveling alone, this was not ideal for me, but for couples or families this space would work very well!

Your home experience is next door to one of the best fish tacos I’ve had in a long time.
You’re in a beautiful, native Berlin neighborhood where people live and work and enjoy regular routines everyday, which I love. Even for 2 days it’s immersive. Aldona and Bartek are wonderful hosts. Warm, kind, accommodating, respectful, and generous with their home, space, and welcoming nature. The room is absolutely beautiful, simple, elegant, cozy, and the perfect space for work, relaxing, nesting, and resting. It’s such a joy to become part of someone else’s world for a short time, and longer if there’s time. With a mixture of warm, low, and bright lighting, a balcony, and a place to wash clothes, this is a special place.
Arriving hungry in the evening? Also not a problem—there’s an answer. W downstairs makes great fish tacos. Visit Curry61, and stop through the market down the road.

Drie ruime slaapkamers, goede keuken en kleine woonkamer. De bedden zijn prima. Handdoeken, zeep, koffie en thee zijn aanwezig, evenals verschillende eetgelegenheden voor ontbijt, lunch en diner. Dicht bij de ubahn en zeer dicht bij Tempelhof. Goed te bereiken met de auto.

Die Unterkunft (eine Art Hostel) war leider nicht sauber und sehr ungepflegt. In unserem Zimmer miefte die Bettwäsche, im Bad, lagen Haare herum & es gab viele eklige Kalkrückstände. Die (schmutzige?) Bettwäsche von anderen Gästen (?) lag in den 4 Tagen in einem Einkaufswagen rum. Es schien sich niemand um die Grundordnung im Apartment zu kümmern. Ich sah jedenfalls niemanden. Auch feuchte Wäsche wurde übereinander gestapelt. Das mieft dann nur noch.
Die Gegend (fast direkt am Kottbusser Tor) empfehle ich nicht, vor allem alleinreisenden Frauen, da die Kriminalität sehr hoch ist & die harte Drogenszene. Der Innenhof ist auch ziemlich ranzig und die Tür zum Hof wurde oft offen gelassen. Auch nachts! So dass manchmal Jugendliche oder Obdachlose reinkamen, u.a. um zu "konsumieren". Wir waren enttäuscht und kommen definitiv nicht wieder.

Burada kaldığımız bir hafta boyunca çok rahat ettik, ev tertemizdi ve ihtiyacımız olabilecek her şeye sahipti. Ev sahipleri çok anlayışlı ve sıcakkanlıydı, Arzu hanıma ilgisi için çok teşekkür ederiz. Evin konumu da oldukça güzeldi, toplu taşıma araçlarına çok yakın olması sayesinde gezerken hiç zorluk yaşamadık. Berlin’e tekrar gelecek olursak kesinlikle yine burada kalmak isteriz.

Das Appartement von Sören ist sehr sauber und ordentlich und die Kommunikation mit Sören war sehr gut. Telefonieren / Sprechen hat Sören abgelehnt. Außerdem ist die Lage zentral und die Ausstattung für einen kurztrip gut
Es gab ein paar Punkte, die für uns beim wohnen sehr wichtig sind und nicht gepasst haben - was zu einer Stornierung geführt hat:
- das appartment ist unter 30m2 groß, und alles ist seeeehr eng - auf den Fotos wirkt es deutlich größer
- beim türöffnen steht man aufgrund der kleinen Größe mitten im appartment vor dem TV; Kinderwagen/Koffer/Schuhe etc. muss man also ins appartment stellen - das nimmt vom wenigen Platz nochmal platz weg
- das Haupt Bett ist sehr weich, nicht für große Menschen geeignet
- ist das zweite Bett (Schlafcouch) geöffnet - kann man die haustüre nicht öffnen
- der Kühlschrank steht weniger als 1m neben dem Bett; man hört die Geräusche also recht laut
- durch die ebenerdige Ausrichtung zum Fußweg, kann jeder ins appartment großflächig rein schauen, wenn man das nicht mag, führt es dazu dass man die Rollos immer hochzieht, da man sonst im Schaufenster sitzt (ist wohl mal als Gewerbe Räumlichkeit geplant gewesen)
Was bei uns also am Ende zu enttäuschten Gesichtern geführt hat, dass die wohnung auf den Bildern schöner rüber kommt als in Realität
What a wonderful apartment. Exactly as shown on the pictures. Worth everything I paid, was really greate and had a unique feel to it.
Un lugar cómodo para alojar, el check in bastante rápido, se encuentra cerca de metro y tranvía, bastante bien relación precio-calidad, recomendado si tienes una estancia no muy larga por Berlín

Die Wohnung ist super gut zu erreichen, mit der U-Bahn U5 ist man wirklich gut angebunden. Supermarkt ist 1 Minute entfernt. Ich hab mich sehr wohl gefühlt, es ist eben ein echtes Zuhause. Klaus ist sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit, offen für Kontakt aber auch zurückhaltend. Er hat sich sogar zwischendrin mal erkundigt, ob alles in Ordnung ist. Ich würde jederzeit wieder kommen!
Great space, super clean and great location. Host was really helpful and had lots of great tips. Would def stay here again.
Alles bestens

Merci infiniment, Andrea !
Notre séjour chez vous a été très agréable. Un appartement charmant au calme dans un joli quartier à proximité du S-Bahn.
🌺🌷🎈
Amazing, expected the place to be nice but was taken a back when we we arrived. Easy check-in, and great location, thanks Stella!
Prima Wohnung, moderne Einrichtung, chic und trendy, alles vorhanden, was nötig ist für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt in Berlin.
Check-in war leider sehr spät aufgrund der Putzhilfen jedoch trotzdem nicht 100% sauber.
we enjoyed our stay with our 6 months old. 100% recommendation

Beautiful apartment that made for a great stay in Berlin !
Location was great with lots of good food and coffee shops within walking distance and transit just 1 street away
Great location, very cool area, lots of great restaurants like baraka and fifth elemental! The house was lovely and clean, and Till was very helpful.
We vonden het een super leuke locatie, de kunst was mooi en leuk zo in het appartement. Aglaja en haar man Ronald zijn heel behulpzaam en reageren snel. Dank jullie wel, tot een volgende keer
Great place and good communication. Recommended!!
חוויה נהדרת, בדירה לא חסר דבר, נקיה מאוד ואסטתית. קרובה לתחבורה ציבורית. מייק בקבלה קיבל את פנינו ועזר לנו בכל מה שהיינו צריכות.
het huis van Katrin is prachtig!! zo mooi en gezellig en stijlvol. heel erg schoon enfunctioneel. het voelde als een traktatie om er te verblijven.

Idealne miejsce na weekendowy city break. W pokojach bardzo czysto, łazienki codziennie sprzątane. Cicho, i spokojnie. Bardzo miła obsługa. Na plus przyjazny lounge room z możliwością zamówienia drinków na barze. Super opcją jest również przechowanie bagażu przed zameldowaniem lub po wymeldowaniu. Metro łączące miasto dosłownie 3 minuty na nogach. Oferta w 100% warta swojej ceny!

Super Unterkunft!
Großzügig geschnitten, mit zwei Bädern.
Ich finde, dass die Wohnung in echt sogar noch schöner als auf den Fotos ist!
Ich will nochmal da unterkommen und habe sie schon an Freund:innen weiterempfohlen.
<3
Great apartment, s-bahn and u-bahn so close by . Perfect for a city break

Wir haben mit unserem Baby 4 Nächte bei Nhu übernachtet. Der Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm und Nhu ist eine tolle Gastgeberin. Das Zimmer ist für eine Familie ein Tick zu klein, aber wir konnten uns, auch dank der Unterstützung von Nhu, gut arrangieren. Die Wohnung ist groß und wir haben uns wohl gefühlt und hatten unseren Freiraum. Die Gegend ist schön und es gibt viele Restaurants und Cafes in der Nähe. Parken auf der Strasse war, nach etwas suchen, kostenlos möglich.
Lovely apartment and great location! We really enjoyed the nearby parks and restaurants. Carolin was super easy to communicate with throughout our stay.

Micheal was so kind and careful and the location of the flat was good. easy to get everywhere from the flat and also nice vibes of neighbourhood.
If there’s any chance to visit to Berlin, I’d like to stay again at Micheal’s place !

Es war wirklich schön. Schöne Lage und Sabine ist eine tolle Gastgeber!
Fue una agradable visita. Está ubicado en una buena zona y Sabine es una gran anfitriona.
The flat is very pleasant, clean, it has everything one needs for a short or long stay, very central. We had an awesome experience! Thank you for hosting us! Hope to be back soon!
Wonderful apartment centrally located. It is on a busy street but it's quiet at night. Close to everything. Peggy was very responsive! Recommend.
Helen was a brilliant host. Always responsive and extremely helpful. Beautiful apartment in a lovely area, close to everything! Will be staying here again.
Wir hatten einen schönen Wochenend-Aufenthalt in der Wohnung. Alles so, wie in der Beschreibung angegeben, das WLAN war gut und der Check-In einfach. Eine sehr gute Preis-Leistungs-Option!

The owner contacted me and send some pictures so it was easy to find the place .  We arrived a bit in front of shedule but this was for her no problem as she welcomed me and showed me around the apartment . The apartment is within walking distance to the supermarket and public transport . We enjoyed our stay .

The apartment is beautiful, amazingly decorated, spacious and bright. It’s even better in reality than in the photos. The light control created a very cozy atmosphere at night; the neighborhood is calm and safe. Great location. Luca is responsive and friendly. We will be back for sure :))

This was a wonderful stay in Berlin! Bernd and Katja are super friendly and responsive to all matters. Katja messaged me prior to the arrival, checked our flights, and assisted us in finding transit during a train strike. The metro/train stop is just around the corner and there are several grocery stores and restaurants nearby. The wifi also works great so it's a perfect place for anyone working remotely. The kitchen is very well stocked and a haven for someone that likes to cook on vacation. The place is warm and inviting and feels bigger than is shown in the photos. Do not hesitate to book this!
Wolfram ist ein sehr netter Gastgeber. Wir wurden persönlich von ihm empfangen.  Die Wohnung ist sehr zentral und es ist alles da was man braucht.

حقت اعجز عن التعبير عن مدى سعادتي في هذا الاختيار
الاعظم من كل هذا السيد هوجو اللذي جعل من المكان خيالي
Sehr gute Wohnung mit mega netter Gastgeberin.
Danke Ellen, alles fein.
Great unit for a few days in Berlin. Location was very good. Thankyou.
Die Lage & das Preisleistungsverhältnis sind sehr gut. Lediglich an der Sauberkeit könnte man noch arbeiten.

Jana was flexible with the check-in and check-out which was of great help to us. Very friendly and responsive, she also had good recommendations for restaurants in the area.
The flat is really clean, nicely decorated, and it's conveniently located - 1 min walk from U2 and M1 tram stop.
The only downside was a neighbor who showed up at 8.30 pm complaining about the noise we were allegedly making. Strange enough, we were as quiet as we could be - just returned home, have a feeling she was just blowing off steam.

Adrian's home was perfect for us. Fabulous location close to cafes, local markets, lovely neighborhood walks and public transport. Top floor with great balcony view and elevator if you're not feeling up to taking the stairs. Comfortable couch and well stocked kitchen. Would definitely stay here again.
Great location . Had a great time

The apartment is on the top floor, offering a great view of Berlin. Supermarkets, restaurants, and bars are conveniently located either on the ground floor of the building or along the same street. The interior boasts a beautiful blue design and a spacious living room. The apartment is well-equipped, and Hilda is very responsive and patient, answering questions quickly via text. I had a great stay here & I would recommend this place for young people and friends. Thank you!

Very nice place, you have everything you need for a short citytrip. Public transportation around the corner, which takes you to all of Berlin. Even do we didn’t see the hosts in person, the communication went very smoothly!

Het was een zeer fijn en gezellig appartement. De keuken en badkamer waren goed voorzien van alle benodigdheden. Zeer comfortabele bedden. Erg vlotte communicatie met de host, alles werd erg goed uitgelegd in verband met inchecken, uitchecken en de huisregels. Zeker voor herhaling vatbaar!
Everything was as advertised. I really liked the apartment. Maybe it's not the best for older people because of the steep steps but overall a great place to stay! Highly recommended.

The apartment was lovely and comfortable. It was a lot bigger than we expected and had everything we needed. Close to the center and in a pretty nice neighborhood. Only bad thing I could say is the sheets on our bed were pretty dirty when we arrived but except for that I really can’t complain. Would definitely recommend this apartment :)

A great apartment in a fabulous location to explore Berlin. Close to public transport or a half hour walk. The appaerment is great and the family are lovely hosts who can answer any key questions you have plus local recommendations. Will be back!
Empfehlenswert!!!!!

The room and bathroom are big are very clean. The location is a bit far from the center and touristic attractions, however, there is a tram and s bahn line close by. The host is very friendly and made us feel at home.
Sehr unfreundlicher und ignoranter Empfang! Nicht zu empfehlen.
Netter Gastgeber und ein ruhiges Zimmer in toller Umgebung.
Friendly and helpful hosts, clean room and peaceful, quiet area

Nette Gegend.
Gute Anbindung an den ÖPNV für Unternehmungen.
Supermarkt und Café's ect. in direkter Umgebung.
Great place and great host, wouls recommend

Grandios! Speziell! Einmalig!
Und den Host mit seiner soliden Ortskenntnis zu treffen war noch zusätzlich ein besonderes Vergnügen. Danke

This is a huge apartment in the middle of a hip neighbourhood.  Perfect for families - we had an infant with us and Monika not only supplied a playpen and a bunch of toys, but went out and bought a stroller when we asked if she had one.  There are tons of restaurants (including lots of vegan places), pubs and stores all around and the balcony is literally looking over a weekend market in the park.  It was better than we expected.
Clean and quiet for its location. Would recommend.
Schöner Aufenthalt:)
Ein kleines aber sehr feines Hotel welches zentral gelegen ist. Die Zimmer sind sehr sauber, der Service ist topp und das Frühstück reichhaltig. Ich komme bestimmt wieder.
Very nice place with lot's of public transport and grocery stores nearby

I had an excellent stay at Nicole’s place in Berlin! Even though we didn’t get to meet as she was out of the city for work, she was always available and quick to help whenever needed. The instructions to arrive at the apartment and access the room were spot on, making everything seamless. The place itself was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I truly appreciated her thoughtful communication and effort to ensure my stay was perfect. Highly recommended!
Super fint lejlighed, og rigtig god kommunikation med Ferdinand.
its a good stay located in central Berlin.
Totally matches to the description. Nice location! Timothy was very supportive.
Ottima posizione, camera bella e pulita. Apprezzatissimi le bevande e gli snack offerti. Da consigliare sicuramente.

Thomas's space is just as described, maybe even better than the pics. The best part was the instructions given even before travel on how to get in and other details. Thomas was responsive on phone for any queries. Apartment is far from the center, but it's reachable by public transport. Has many good quick eats like kebabs, Vietnamese, pizzas and super markets (Aldi, Penny). especially liked the pizza place that's right around the corner.
Throughout the apartment, there were useful instructions. There were some rules to follow like leaving the apartment clean, clearing the dishes etc on checkout that might be painful for some people, but they worked for us as we ourselves follow this protocol anyway.
There's no washing machine inside, but we fund a laundromat about 5 mins walk,
Charlottenburg palace & grounds are around 15 min walk from the apartment.
Overall, a very well managed place and I highly recommended.

Das Haus ist Klasse. Sehr geräumig und gemütlich. Im Sommer lädt der Garten zum Verweilen ein.
Man fühlt sofort heimisch und der Urlaub kann beginnen. Kein Parkproblem.
Das Haus ist geschmackvoll eingerichtet.
Gaby ist diskret immer im stand by, um behilflich zu sein.
Wir kommen gern wieder.

Caesar is the friendliest host ever! I felt comfortable at his place. The best thing about it is probably the location, very central and just a couple of minutes walk from a busy U-bahn station giving access to all other areas of Berlin.
Such great guys. Always willing to help in anyway with lots of good tips and directions
Alles super unkompliziert konzipiert, und die Wohnung ist wirklich toll! Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind nicht weit entfernt und ein Späti ist quasi in der selben Straße.
The location is great, with a U station close by, where trains run 24hrs. The room, although simple, is clean and tidy.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft mit toller Lage! Perfekt für einen kurzen Aufenthalt :)
Un apartamento pequeño pero con encanto. Acceso fácil a la red de transporte.
super Unterkunft. werde sicher wiederkommen. tolle Gegend man hat alles in der Nähe
Apartment close to subway and some supermarkets. Courteous and helpful host.
整個旅房跟家一樣，設備也很齊全，床很舒服，旅主也提供適當的幫助

Sven was a great host. The apartment is located in a very convenient area. Super close to grocery stores, transit and many clubs.
Highly recommend staying here!

We really enjoyed our stay at Dan’s place. Great location, we rented bikes to explore the neighbourhood. The place is super nice, clean, great beds, lots of warm water, and a beamer (!), public transport, night shop etc, around the corner. We definitely recommend this place!
Beautiful flat, lovely hosts, perfect location, comfy bed in very quite room with sunny balcony in lively neighbourhood - a perfect base fro anyone wanting to enjoy and explore Berlin.

Birgit ist eine erfahrene und zuvorkommende Gastgeberin. Sie beantwortet Fragen schon bevor ich sie überhaupt gestellt hatte.
Das Loft ist geschmackvoll eingerichtet, sehr sauber und gepflegt, so dass ich mich schnell wie zu Hause gefühlt habe. Dazu hat auch beigetragen, dass alles was man im Alltag benötigt, vorhanden war. Die Lage ist wunderbar ruhig in der Natur. Trotzdem ist man mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln schnell im Zentrum von Berlin.
Zusammenfassend: Es war einfach ein perfekter Ausgangspunkt für Exkursionen und parallel ein tolles Homeoffice.
Great location
Wilken is a friendly and helpful host! His place is clean and comfy and in a great location.
Aunque hubo un fallo en la reserva y la primera noche no pudimos dormir en la habitación que nos correspondía, se han hecho cargo desde un primer momento. El resto de la estancia ha sido favorable.

Lovely room in a great location. The flat is very cute and private, I enjoyed my stay very much. I didn’t get a chance to meet Yvonne as she was on holiday but the check in process was very smooth and communication was excellent. Great having a coffee machine :)
Highly recommend this to anyone wanting to stay in Mitte!
Sehr angenehmer und unkomplizierter Kontakt mit Fritz und die Unterkunft ist sehr ordentlich, sauber und geräumig.

The flat was just as described. Very nice and comfortable for two couples. easy to get around on foot to nearby sights and by public transportation from Jannowitzbrücke, just a few min walk from the appartment.
Clean and convenient

We absolutely loved our stay at Enrique’s! He was great communicating before we arrived and with directions from the airport, as well as super accommodating with our late arrival and flight delays. He provided great local tips and walking maps, as well as everything we could need for our long weekend stay. It was ultimately the perfect air bnb, and we couldn’t recommend it enough

Ulf and Caroline were excellent hosts. Check-in was a breeze thanks to clear instructions, and both of them were very responsive to my questions. The apartment was very comfortable, stylish and clean. Great neighborhood too, with a bustling nightlife. Wish we could have stayed more than one night. What a great way to experience Berlin like the Berliners do. Vielen Dank!!
Die Wohnung hat uns sehr gut gefallen,  eine sehr schöne & charmante Wohnung und ein sehr herzlichen Empfang

Such a fantastic host, she got involved with me as a guest took me out for dinner and beer and to watch the soccer I really couldn’t have asked for anything more she was actually perfect. Hilarious might I add 😂

Die Unterkunft war ideal für meinen kurzen Aufenthalt, die U-Bahn ist nicht weit entfernt wodurch man eine gute Verbindung hat. Die Ankunft und das Check-In waren sehr einfach und flexibel, genau wie beschrieben. Für eine Lage mit Bars und Restaurants in der Nähe, war es angenehm und ruhig. Es wurde Kaffee, Tee, und mehr bereitgestellt, die komplette Unterkunft war sehr sauber und modern, das Badezimmer hatte einen schönen großen Spiegel.
Das einzige Manko war, dass der Müll nicht geleert war, und der Wasserkocher gereinigt/entkalkt werden könnte, ansonsten war alles wirklich sauber. Für den vergleichsweise niedrigen Preis hat sich die Unterkunft jedoch auf jeden Fall gelohnt.

The place is everything we need for our 2 days in Berlin. The shops are on a walkable distance. Safe place for staying with a baby.
Thank you Ramona and Family.
Cozy place and excellent location, right by the U-Bhan station. Frank is nice and easy to communicate with. He was always available to answer any questions.

Wonderful place and hosts! Alan was super helpful with the apartment and many local places to eat, shop, enjoy nightlife and sightsee. The place was very clean, and quite spacious for a studio. Great location in Prezlauerberg, 3 min from tube and trains, and plenty of shopping of all kinds nearby. Would definitely highly recommended theirs as a fantastic place to stay.

This was perfect for what we were looking for - fast connections to Tegel Airport and the main central areas, but very suburban in feel. The place is just what you'd expect from the photos. Everything that you'd need for a longer or shorter stay. Kelly and co very helpful and easy to deal with. Recommended.
Had a great stay,beautiful location, all amenities nearby, place has a great vibe,Host is awesome

Had such a lovely stay in this apartment. There is a lot of space (perfect for a bigger group), it was very clean, and the location was perfect. The hosts were also super kind and understanding. I definitely want to stay there again :)
Good location, comfortable bed.
O apartamento é muito bom, estava limpo e é bem próximo do metrô e da Alexanderplatz. O atendimento do anfitrião foi muito bom. A experiência foi ótima. Sem dúvidas que recomendo.
Great place to stay, proximity of nice parks, trains, several nice restaurants (Chinese, Italian), friendly neighborhood.
Great location. On bus routes. Easy access, no stairs.

Die Wohnung ist gut zu erreichen. Die Gegend hat viele Cafés und Kneipen - die Versorgung war also gesichert. Die Ausstattung der Wohnung war ok. Luxus haben wir nicht erwartet. Die Wohnungstür klemmt manchmal etwas, aber mit Geduld klappt es. Sauberkeit in den Zimmern ging so. Leider gab es in der Dusche fies Schimmel  und die Duschtür schließt nicht - schade.
The apartment was pretty nice. It was comfortable and peaceful. There were enough spaces to fit 6 persons and landlord prepared various kinds of tea and a bottle of wine. I very much recommend it.
The flat was wonderful. Very clean once we arrived, and close to metro station. Supermarket nearby which was super convenient.
Had a lovely stay at Alexandra's place. Very comfortable, lots of space and a great location.
Made to feel welcome from the start. I enjoyed my stay and felt at home. Beautiful apartment.
Alles prima. Der Gastgeber ist super nett. wir durften auch einen Late Check In ohne Problem vom Gastgeber.

Franz is an amazing host, I can't recommend him enough. He met us at his apartment to show around and answer our questions, although we had a late flight and arrived after 11pm. Initially, we wanted to stay in another part of the city, but were turned down by multiply hosts because of the late check in. I am glad we stayed at Franz' apartment in Charlottenburg as you have a great variety of restaurants and cafes there, and the apartment is impressive. It looks like an art gallery, spacious and atmospheric with all the amenities you need. Special thanks for those cold fizzy drinks in the fridge!
Great communication and great apartment!

Accommodatie voldoet aan de beschrijving en verwachtingen. Olivier en zijn moeder zijn zeer vriendelijk en helpen je direct als er iets is. We hebben een zeer prettig verblijf gehad die wij iedereen kunnen aanbevelen.

We had a great stay in this centrally located, nice and quiet apartment! The hosts were very proactive and helpful, the apartment was nice and really met our needs and expectations. The bed was amazing! Would absolutely stay here again, highly recommended.
Nette kleine Wohnung und sehr ruhig.

Juttas Wohnung ist etwas Besonderes. Man merkt, dass eine Architektin am Werk war. Geschmackvoll, puristischer Einrichtungsstil mit Design-Klassikern. 6.Stock (ohne Aufzug, für körperlich nicht fitte Menschen ungeeignet), große Fenster, viel Licht, schöner Balkon. Der puristische Stil lässt eher an eine „Männer-Wohnung“ denken. Wer’s gemütlich, warm und kuschelig haben möchte, sucht sich besser eine andere Wohnung. Moderne Küche, top ausgestattet. Die Kommunikation mit Jutta gestaltete sich einfach. Dieses Mal lief bei der Anreise von unserer Seite aus einiges schief. Jutta reagierte darauf gelassen, freundlich, verständnisvoll und blieb hilfreich für uns. Die Lage der Wohnung ist ruhig, ca 15 Min entfernt zur nächsten U Bahn Station. Gute Restaurants in nächster Nähe. Es gab nichts, was uns gefehlt hat. Sehr zu empfehlen für Menschen, die in Berlin Charlottenburg wohnen möchten und auf Design und Stil Wert legen.

Toll, toll, toll!
Die Wohnung ist perfekt für einen kürzeren oder längeren Aufenthalt. Die Kommunikation verlief reibungslos, Claudio ließ mich sogar schon am Mittag hinein - großartig! Der Wrangelkiez am "Görli" ist jetzt nicht gerade das Schmuckkästchen Berlins, aber Claudios Wohnung ist herrlich, um graue Berlin-Tage zu überstehen. Fette Empfehlung!

Even that We didn't meet with Rainer personally, he was really nice. The communication fast easy going and an answer was always quick.
An apartment was bigger than we thought and everything was same as at the pictures. We were in love with a terrase and BBQ- just awesome evenings!!
Only minus is for few dirty plates in the kitchen, but the kitchen is well equipped, so we washed it be ouselves. Would absolutely recommend. Thanks for evething Rainer!!
Super Lage, sehr geräumige und schöne Wohnung. Die Ausstattung ist definitiv ausreichend und es ist ruhig im Haus. Gerne wieder!

We hadden een prima verblijf in Kreuzberg en de locatie wat verder uit het centrum is echt top. Fijne sfeervolle plek met restaurantjes en Ubahn vlakbij.  De communicatie was fijn. Lothar gaf duidelijk aan niet direct te kunnen reageren soms en als er vragen zouden zijn geweest konden we die kwijt bij een vriendelijke buurvrouw die ook de sleutel regelde. We zouden graag terugkomen.
Great place with very well thought of details!

Really loved staying with Ella! Completely beautiful apartment, everything you need in terms of equipment in the kitchen, and Ella was incredibly helpful with clear instructions about how things work. Also a completely lovely street and area with lots of great markets almost basically at your doorstep! Overall great experience and would totally stay with Ella again!
Gut gelegenes (direkt an der U-Bahn-Station), sauberes, recht einfaches Hotel. Schmale Betten.

This was my second time staying with Antje. The first time was in winter, and this time the stay in summer was just wonderful.
Antje has created a true home from home, and I already regard this space as my "Berlin home".

We strongly recommend Ursula's apartment, charming, very cosy and so calm.
Ver well located in a residential area, surrounded by many sops, café and restaurant. Near from tramway 4 which takes you to the center (mitte area).
Ursula gave all information needed to check in and check out.
we recommend.
A great apartment and very attentive hosts! Would absolutely stay again.
Very nice host. The location is also nice with u Bahn station at the doorstep with connections to the centre. Slightly overpriced.
We had a great stay in Charlottenburg and Julia's apartment. the U2 into the city centre is close by and there are restaurants and shops nearby.

War ein insgesamt schöner Aufenthalt, bis auf ein kleine Sache
Und zwar war unser Zimmer aufgrund eines Missverständnis unter dem Personal um 14:00 Uhr noch nicht gereinigt.
Wir wurden nett darum gebeten, uns eine halbe Stunde in die Lounge zu setzen während die Reinigungskraft derweil das Zimmer auf Fordermann brachte.
Netterweise konnten wir unsere Koffer oben lassen, mussten sie nicht nochmal mit runter nehmen.
Das WLAN war in unserem Zimmer leider nicht so ideal.
Really good place to stay. Host is very friendly.

The apartment is well located in a great area of Berlin, super accessible to all modes of transport. Lots of restaurants and shopping within walking distance. Close to Mauerpark and all the activities that go on there.
Entrance was a bit off putting with garbage in the entryway, and stairwell needs some cleaning and upkeep, but once inside apartment it was OK.

Ein schöne kleine Unterkunft mit sehr guter Lage um die Berliner Innenstadt zu erkunden. Dominik ist ein sehr freundlicher und zuvorkommender Host und kümmert sich aktiv um das Wohl seiner Gäste. Ich komme gerne wieder.

Квартира в хорошем состоянии, сам хозяин отвечал очень быстро на вопросы,очень чисто,рядом,в минуте ходьбы есть супермаркет,с очень хорошими ценами,метро,трамвай,автобус в 2 минутах пешком. Советую всем.

We loved staying in the apartment. Tatyana was very friendly and helpful and answered messages quickly.
The area js quiet and it was easy to quickly get anywhere
lovely stay at numa berlin arc! 100%
Tolle Wohnung mit einem sehr schönen Wintergarten
This place was lovely - really cool interior whilst comfy to stay in. Beds super comfy. Nice and quiet neighbourhood. We really enjoyed our stay here and would definitely stay again. Thanks Carolin!
Tolles apartment!! Gerne wieder :)
Eine schöne Unterkunft, mittendrin und doch so ruhig. Nette Vermieter und wir durften das Airbnb bereits um 11 Uhr am Ankunftstag beziehen. Wir kommen wieder! 😊
was top, goede communicatie prima accommodatie. Er ware alleen geen basis dingen zoals zout en peper aanwezig. Verder niks op aan te merken.
Our stay was pleasant and comfortable.

Elegant, ruhig und in einer Toplage, dieses charmante Apartment ist einfach sensationell. Das Apartment besticht durch seine Ausstattung, dem Komfort und dem tollen Blick über Berlin. Man spürt, dass hier ein Kosmopolit zu Hause ist. Es hat alles hervorragend funktioniert, von der Schlüsselübergabe bis zu den Essenstipps.
Alles Top, gelaufen und Essen ist auch lecker.
Alles war super, die Kommunikation bestens. Immer gerne wieder!
Beautiful apartment with all the amenities we needed. Perfect position, close to public transport, restaurants and supermarket. Had a fantastic time in Berlin.

What an amazing apartment!
It was much bigger than we expected. So warm an cozy.
It’s located very close the the S-Bahn and lots of cool cafes bar and restaurants within a few mins walk.
Will definitely be booking again next time we visit Berlin.

Nous partons ravis de notre séjour.
Nous avons loué une chambre de 3 pour 3 nuits et tout était parfait: chambre spacieuse et très propre, lits confortables, sanitaires impeccable (et jamais d'attente), cuisine très bien équipée, nuits calmes. La déco est très sympa, simple et de bon goût. L'accueil fut parfait, ainsi que le départ.
Et pour ne rien gâcher, le quartier (Pankow) nous a beaucoup plu et est super bien desservi en resto, bars et transports en commun.
Nous recommandons et reviendrons!

Great location, clean apartment and easy to access. However, we had booked a stay for 4 persons but there was only a bed for two and a sleeping couch but no bed linen. The host was difficult to contact and we only received automatic communication.
Great place for two and would not recommend for four.

Wir haben einen Wochenendausflug mit meiner Familie gemacht es war sehr schön die Wohnung hat alles was man für ein Wochenende benötigt. Die U-Bahn ist direkt in der Nähe von da aus konnte man in Berlin alles gut erreichen. Wir haben uns wohlgefühlt und können es weiterempfehlen.

Fantastisch! Het appartement bevat alles wat je nodig hebt. Wij hadden dit appartement gekozen op basis van de recensies, en niks was minder waar. Schoon, netjes en niks kwamen wij te kort. Op de foto's is het niet goed te zien, maar het uitzicht was geweldig!

Place was beautiful! Heaps of natural light
and in a really convenient spot.
Make sure you have the strength and stamina if you have large suitcases, but we loved our stay so much, would definitely stay again!

Cooles Gartenhaus sehr liebevoll eingerichtet und jetzt kommt mein persönliches Highlight Fußbodenheizung.
Host Anke ist typisch Berlinerisch hat das Herz auf der Zunge
I truly believe is one of the best values out in berlin, great place!!
We had a great time at this air bnb - thank you!!! the host was incredibly kind and responsive and I would definitely recommend this place to others :)

Het appartement was erg fijn en ruim. Het ligt net buiten het ‘touristische’ deel van Prenzlauerberg in een rustige straat. Een fijne plek om Berlijn te ontdekken. Annette was heel vriendelijk en antwoordde snel op onze vragen.

Most beautiful Airbnb in a fancy neighborhood in Berlin. Sabine is the best hostess I've stayed with over many years traveling. Her large penthouse apartment is gorgeous and impeccably clean with a completely quiet private bedroom. Sabine clearly loves hosting and thinks about every detail that makes guests feel welcome and at home (if you live in a five star hotel). There's a high-end fully automatic cappuccino machine, sparkling water by the bed, a rooftop terrace with rose bushes, and all around windows with views of the city. The street and area are very nice and safe with shops and restaurants just outside the door and great access to public transportation, allowing you to travel everywhere in Berlin. (Street parking is also easy with a car.) But the most special perk was Sabine's kindness and laid-back hosting style. A local who lived abroad, she offers tourist guidance, fashion advice for a wedding I attended, her washing machine, or complete privacy. Can't wait to return.

Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis war top mit perfekter Lage. Alles in Berlin war super schnell zu erreichen, die Wohnung war sauber und hatte alles was man braucht :) Karak war sehr freundlich und das ein- und auschecken lief problemlos. Kommen gerne wieder :)

We had a wonderful stay at Kim’s apartment - the location is perfect - so many places to eat and drink around, and it’s very well connected to other places too. The apartment was lovely - very clean decor, with high ceilings and it was so warm, which was great because outside was very cold.
Check-in was brilliant - Kim’s partner greeted us on time, even though we arrived into Berlin quite late, and he also told us about the bar they own downstairs, which we then visited - it’s a must. Absolutely amazing drinks and great atmosphere.
Overall the stay was fantastic - we hope to return!
很方便、最重要有禮貌和地方清潔！我會再回來！謝謝

Sehr gastfreundlich und unkompliziert, schön und stilvoll eingerichtet, angenehme, ruhige
Wohngegend, alles da vom Shampoo über reichlich Bücher bis zum Tesafilm.

In general, we liked our stay with Stella. She was a great host, and I would rent from her again. She was very helpful and fast in fixing anything we had a problem with.
The apartment is very small, and sleeping in the loft was not as comfortable as we thought. Being three people in the apartment was a bit cramped. This should not have surprised us, as what we booked was very clear in the listing: it is a loft and a small apartment.
The toilette lamp was broken throughout our stay, which got annoying. They sent someone over fast to fix this, but it never got solved.
The apartment became kinda stuffy during the night, so we wanted to open the window often, but people sit and smoke outside the window quite often. You can hear the people outside and in the corridor getting into the apartment. Not very quiet.
Overall, it was a good stay, with minor irritations.

I really enjoyed staying in Andreas’s place.  It’s in the middle of my favorite part of town, but in the courtyard, and very private and quiet.  The bed was comfortable, which is very important to me. Andreas and his partner were very quick to get back to me whenever I needed help with anything. I would definitely stay here again.
Alt er meget fit  og svarer til beskrivelsen
Great Place, Thanks Nadine!

Booked this apartment on behalf of my client, Michael was very prompt in responding and was very helpful.

I've had no complaints from my client, he was very happy with his stay.

Wir waren als vierköpfige Familie für einige Tage in Berlin und sehr happy mit dem "Bärengehege". Der Schlafraum war riesig und mein Sohn empfand das gemeinsame Schlafen in einem Zimmer als "Klassenfahrt-Feeling" :-) Uns hat es nicht gestört und zur Not hätte auch jemand auf dem Sofa im Wohnbereich schlafen können. Dort wäre es allerdings sehr hell gewesen, da der Eingangsbereich komplett aus Glas ist. Das Ganze war wohl früher mal ein Geschäft.
Es war alles da was wir für ein paar Tage benötigten (Handtücher, Betten frisch bezogen, WLAN für die Kids, genug Kleiderbügel und Stauraum fürs Gepäck) und wir haben uns absolut wohl gefühlt. Gegessen haben wir ausschließlich auswärts und hier ein kleiner Tipp: Das "Kaffee Karamell" in der Voigtstraße 35 war unser Highlight! Hier kann man toll frühstücken, Kuchen genießen oder auch richtig essen..., yummi <3
Wenn ihr aus der Wohnung kommt, zweimal links gehen, dann könnt ihr es schon sehen.
Viel Spaß in Berlin!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. The apartment is very large and has everything we needed.
The apartment is very central and very close to the U-bahn, however it is possible to walk to all the big attractions.
Would highly recommend!
Very good location, very clean and calm. We would definitely recommend.
War alles supi

La estadía en lo de Janet fue excelente. El dormitorio es muy cómodo y con una cama confortable. Además de que tiene un escritorio para trabajar con excelente wifi y amplios muebles para dejar o colgar la ropa. Toda la casa muy limpia y agradable.
El barrio es muy tranquilo. Caminando o en metro se puede llegar fácilmente al centro y a otros lugares de interés. Además de que a pocas cuadras tienes el parque Tiertgarten, uno de los más bellos de la ciudad. Janet es una excelente anfitriona.
Tolle Wohnung in der Nähe von alles

I stayed at Frederic's appartment for 3 nights with my mother and sister. We arrived early morning on our first day and left late on our last day and Frederic was very flexible stretching the check in and check out hour. The appartment is very spacious. The living room is big with a lot of light. Since the app is on a main road, one of the rooms and the living room are a bit noisy (didnt distureb my sleep. The second room is in the back and is quite.
The app was clean and pleasent. It was Equipped with every thing we needed. Frederic answered quickly every question we had and was very helpful and solved any issue that arose.

The app is well located - a walking distance from a lot of coffee shops and restaurants in the mitte area. It is also a 3 minute walk from the U2 line that arrives to a lot of the main tourist places.

We had a very pleasant stay.
Sehr ordentlich und sauber gehalten, man hat alles was man Braucht.
War sehr sauber, leise und toll dekoriert! Würde ich jeder Zeit empfehlen
great location, great automatic check in system, overall far above my expectations for that price. great work!
It was perfect !

Ich habe mich in der der individuell gestalteten Unterkunft sehr wohl gefühlt.
Die Lage ist für Bahnreisende ideal,die Infrastruktur klalsse.
Und Irmgard eine aufgeschlossene ,freundliche Gastgeberin mit der man sich stundenlang unterhalten könnte.
Vielen Dank auch für deine guten Unternehmungstipps , Irmgard.
Host respond quickly and has convenient transportation, but the washing machines have to share with others.
superschönes Loft, sehr ruhig. Haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt:)
The location when ordering taxi or Uber can be tricky. Make sure you use the zip code , otherwise can take you somewhere else.

We loved this place and the hosts were so friendly and helpful! Our kids are older but it was very kid friendly even if they had been small. The area felt very safe and close to transit. I would stay here again for sure.

Great Hostel to stay in central Berlin.
I arrived around 10pm, the check in time I arranged. I turned and came back later as there was a queue. I was given a drinks voucher as the team saw this.
Very kind people.
Cecilia was a great host. Good recommendations and helpful with finding local services. The flat is lovely as well. Highly recommended!!
Eine angenehme ruhige Wohnung in einer urbanen Gegend. Alle Verkehrsmittel sind gut zu erreichen.
Cozy, small room - perfect for a lone traveler or a couple. All of Berlin’s main attractions were within walking distance and hence ideal for us who enjoy being active. Check-in was super easy.
Spotless apartment in a nice neighborhood. Well equipped. Everything was professional in a good manner. Definitely would come back.

Notre séjour à Berlin s’est très bien déroulé.
Le logement est conforme aux photos et descriptions. Aussi, celui-ci est idéalement situé (tramway devant le logement, et bus à deux pas).
La personne en charge de notre arrivée, de notre départ, est très accueillante, arrangeante, un grand merci à elle !
Le seul point négatif du logement est relatif à l’ambiance, nous avons ressenti l’établissement comme un lieu de travail, de réflexion, où les gens y venaient pour travailler. Ainsi, nous n’avons pas profiter de l’espace commun à tout le monde.
Alles war perfekt. An Sylvester hatte ich das Zimmer genommen. Es war perfekt für mich. Keine Beanstandung!

The location is great, really close to a train station. The shower head was broken during our stay so you had to hold it in stead of hang it, but we managed ;). You share the apartment with Ahmed and you are allowed to use all his kitchen stuff which is very handy.

Fantastic apartment in a really cool Berlin spot! Great interior design. Really good location with a nice connection to a City Center via Tram. We definitely would like to come back when we are next time in Berlin :)
great location, great communication, just as advertised
The flat was as descripte . The host was very helpful and nice . The kitchen is well equipped . Prime location .
Perfect location, prefect host.
Really cozy place, just like the pictures, excellent communication, and very good central location! We enjoyed it very much😊!!
Saubere, kleine Wohnung in super Lage in Prentzberg!

Die Lage der Wohnung ist super, tolle Aussicht von der Terrasse. Auch wenn Mischo dort wohnt war es schwierig für uns genügend Platz für unsere Sachen zu haben (bei 10 Tagen Aufenthalt zu wenig). Die Wohnung ist toll, aber bedarf einer Reinigung. Wir mussten erst unser Handtücher aufhängen aus der Waschmaschine. Auch waren wir überrascht, dass das Rauchen verboten ist und wir auf der Terrasse unzählige Zigarettenstummel vorfanden. Für den Preis kann ich leider die Wohnung nicht weiterempfehlen.

Wir haben drei Nächte in der Unterkunft verbracht. Insgesamt waren wir mit dem Aufenthalt zufrieden. Doch zum Zeitpunkt unserer Übernachtung dort war die Wohnung noch recht sparsam eingerichtet. Es gab viele weiße Wände, jedoch keinen Fernseher, wenig Stauraum und keine dunklen Vorhänge. Dadurch konnten wir leider nicht sehr gut schlafen, weil das Licht der Straßenlaternen in die Wohnung leuchteten und es früh hell wurde. Die Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter allerdings war stets sehr freundlich und wir haben uns Willkommen gefühlt.
Servicios y alojamiento inmejorable, atentas y cuidando cada detalle. Un gusto alojarse en su apartamento!

Ich war mit meiner 5 köpfige Familie in diesem angenehmen Hotel. Es ist wirklich sehr zu empfehlen. einziges was gestört hat sind die zu wenigen Parkplätze. Man hat wirklich lange gesucht. Ansonsten war alles super.
Good location in a quiet neighbourhood, still not that far from the city centre. Check in quick and simple, very well described by Ben.

Wir haben uns bei Anke sehr wohl gefühlt. Trotz etwas verspäteter Ankunft abends, hat uns Anke sehr herzlich empfangen und uns in alles eingewiesen. Vielen Dank für die Ruhe, die wir genießen konnten und den schönen, unkomplizierten Aufenthalt.
Ein schönes Quartier! Sehr angenehme Atmosphäre, schlicht & edel, sehr ruhig, viel Vogelgesang im Hof, Katja ist freundliche unkomplizierte Gastgeberin - vielen Dank, ich komm gerne wieder!
La casa está a una parada de tram a la estación central, y cerca del Tiergarden. Rosario es muy simpático y atento!
The accommodation was in a good area and within walking distance to the major places of interest and transport links.  Communication was good.
Ideale Unterkunft für zwei bis drei Personen. Gute verkehrstechnische Anbindung viele Lokale in der Umgebung.

Tim is an amazing host! He communicated with us as our arrival approached with very detailed and helpful directions to the apartment, as well as instructions once we arrived. Check-in was super easy. And once we arrived we were more than pleased with the apartment itself. It is SUPER clean, comfortable (particularly the bed!), and has everything one could need (shampoo/shower gel, shaving and dental kits, plenty of towels, a well stocked kitchen, books/pamphlets on touring  Berlin, and Netflix in a cozy living room area). The location is great too as it is close to the tram and walking distance to some really good restaurants (Xigon has great sushi and we really enjoyed the pizza at Pomodorino’s). In every way, I highly recommend both this apartment and Tim as a host!
Great place, clean, minimalist and roomy. Great restaurant within 50 meter distance: authentic Italian, Thai, Chinese, several pubs etc.
Die Villa Nordlicht ist sauber, geräumig und top ausgestattet.
This place is a jewel! Incredible location and neighborhood; cool layout and design and Julius is attentive to everything.

Das Limehouse bieter eine tolle Gelegnheit für einen Trip nach Berlin. Die Wohnung hat alles was sie verspricht und ist ideal für ein paar Tage Aufenthalt. Wer mit offenen Fenster schläft könnte sich etwas durch den Lärm der großen Straße gestört fühlen, bei geschlossenen Fenster hört man davon überhaupt nichts.
Alles wunderbar und unkompliziert
it was okay

Sehr schöne und saubere Wohnung, die ruhig gelegen ist. Gut eingerichtete und benutzbare Küche. Kommunikation mit Nadja ist sehr herzlich und zugewandt!
Heerlijk verbleven.. dit is een aanrader als je in een levendige buurt van berlijn wil verblijven!

Flexible An und Abreisezeit durch einen Schlüsseltresor, die Wohnung ist in einem guten Zustand. Die Anbindung in die Innenstadt ist etwas mühsam aber ok. Internet war leider ungenügend. Die Lage ist relativ ruhig gelegen. Insgesamt ok und wir hatten eine gute Zeit.
Had everything we needed. Parking in back was perfect and easily accessible (book in advance). Location was perfect and staff was very respectful. Definitely recommend 100%!
Sehr ruhige und saubere Wohnung im Stadtzentrum.

I think the service for this place really let it down, everything was automated chats, whenever I had an issue - and there were multiple issues with the wi-fi - it was actually awful - if you're thinking about working remotely forget it! Otherwise for a 2 day short stay it's fine. I was here way too long and it wasn't great
Beste Zeit am besten Ort

What can I say? Frederic is a fantastic host. His apartment, right in the heart of Mitte, Berlin was gorgeous. The pictures don't even do the flat justice. Soaring ceilings, historic crown moldings, and wide plank floors give this flat the comforts of a perfect Berlin home. You will instantly feel at home in this wonderful place.
Frederic and his sister were an absolute pleasure to deal with. Frederic was quick to respond to my requests. Booking, check in, and check out were totally seamless. And the attention to subtle details made a big difference... complimentary chocolates, wine, and fresh flowers... Best Airbnb I have had.
If you are looking for the perfect home away from home, this is your place in Mitte, Berlin.
Steps from public transportation, as well as awesome bars and restaurants.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Daphné, le logement est conforme à la description et surtout extrêmement bien situé, au centre de Berlin , très proche des transports en commun, dans un quartier vivant et animé le soir

Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable dans l’appartement de Jens. L’ambiance y est chaleureuse et calme car l’appartement ne donne pas directement sur la rue passante.
Jens a été très arrangeant à notre arrivée malgré nos 4h de retard de vol et notre arrivée tardive. L’appartement est très bien situé à moins de 15 mn à pied de la Postdamer Platz ! Super pratique ! Sinon il y a un arrêt de U-bahn tout près et un arrêt de bus encore plus près ! Il y a aussi tout ce qu’il faut à proximité pour faire ses courses du quotidien.
all fine, nothing special.

Very nice apartment, well situated. 2min from the subway station.
Many equipments in it. Sven answered to all our questions very quickly.
Thanks again!!

Great location and well equipped apartment.  Generally our stay was very good. we walked to most places we wanted to visit with a few trips by u-bahn which was close by. Communications with Michael were very good. We had to wait 30-45 mins to check-in partly as we were a little early but also as the person Michael arranged to let us in was late for the time agreed.  Larger towels would have been appreciated.
Pænt stort værelse, som er en del af udlejers lejlighed. Vil ikke anbefale værelset om vinteren, da lejligheden var meget kold. Ligger i pænt område tæt på offentlig transport
enjoyed our stay. was very clean, and had a huge bed which was nice
Very clean and a nice home. The surraunding area is very cool and has lots of very good restaurants. The host was very polite and helpfull.
ubytování bylo v pořádku, vše jak je popsáno

The apartment is absolutely lovely – very clean, new appliances, and just the perfect size for two people! It's a few minutes' walk to the lake and about 10 minutes to town through beautiful leafy streets. Despite some rain while we were there, we had a wonderful time, and would definitely come back.

Andrzej was an excellent and friendly host. He accepted our check-in earlier than supposed to and everything went smoothly. For the price, the room is great being spacious enough for two people, and in a really good location being close to public transportation. The only minus might be the bed which is in fact an extended sofa but personally, I didn't mind that.
If needed will clearly book Andrzej again for a stay in Berlin.

Sohail's place was easy to get to, and it was easy to navigate around Berlin from his location. Sohail was a gracious host who made me feel like a guest. He speaks four languages, so his communication was excellent. Sohail was very helpful when it came to helping me use apps for bike rentals. I highly recommend Sohail.

The house was very cozy and organized. There was already a lot of equipment (like bedding, kitchen stuff and towels) so we didnt have to bring any. Also, the house was kids proof so no worries if you're coming here with your children. The neighborhood was very nice and quiet, a bit far from the center but there is public transport nearby. The host was very nice and helpfull and responded very fast if we contacted her. Very much recommended!

GReat place ! The place was so spacious and welcoming and incredibly efficient and had all of the amenities that you needed.   I LOVED it.  So well designed. The bed was super comfortable as well.  The block building and apartment were welcoming and peaceful.  I would stay again in a second and was sad to leave.
Great host, very friendly, supportive and perfect location.

Amazing!
The location couldn’t be better, walking distance from museum island and cute shops and restaurants, the room is so cute, also well connected to public transport so you can go anywhere from there.
I absolutely loved it :)
Korter oli puhas ja korralik, asukoht väga hea.
Ingoさんのお家はとてもロケーションが良かったです！お部屋も写真通りでした。空港からサポートしてくださりチェックインもスムーズでした。疲れていたのでお風呂に浸かれたのが有り難かったです！お家の周りの情報も教えてくれました。

I enjoyed my stay in this comfortable apartment. Alan & Kasia gave very clear instructions about many things and provided a neighbourhood guide as well. This apartment is in a vibrant neighbourhood close to restaurants, grocery stores, shopping, and transportation. My experience of the place during my 5 day winter stay was that it was extremely quiet as well. I found the bed comfortable and the kitchen and washing machine easy to use. I'm glad I chose this place for my first time in Berlin!
Nice and quiet room, with a great aesthetic outlook. Far from the city center but near the airport and the transportation is convenient - the description of the Airbnb is accurate. Thanks!

Bei Erez angekommen, hat man sich gleich wohlgefühlt. Hilfsbereit und kommunikativ. Die Wohnung von Erez ist was ganz Besonderes.. Es ist, als ob man in einem
kleinen Museum wohnt. Mit viel Liebe und einem ganz eigenen Style eingerichtet.
Vielen Dank!

Super nette Gastgeber. Tolle Lage ruhig und trotzdem zentral gelegen. Guter Ausgangspunkt für Radtouren. Super gemütliches Häuschen,  herrlich zum ausruhen und entspannen auf der Terrasse. Wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder.

The apartment had everything we needed for our six day stay. It was quite clean and well decorated which feels like its my own place. Neighborhood was also very nice, you can find supermarkets, shopping center, ubahn, sbahn and several bars nearby. Georgy answered all the questions right away. Only thing that could be better was pillows actually they have different size than i used to sleep with but its ok too. Don’t hesitate to stay there, totally worth it!!
Location wasn't that bad if u enjoy walk in the snow

Sehr freundliche und gut erreichbare Gastgeber.
Vielen Dank für den angenehmen Aufenthalt.
Absolut empfehlenswert.

Die Wohnung war schön und lichtvoll, genauso wie auf den Bildern. Mina war eine tolle Host, sie war immer erreichbar. Als ich mit dem Schlüssel Probleme hatte, kam sie in 10 Minuten um mir zu helfen. Ich bin mit der Wohnung sehr zufrieden, leider war der Flughafen näher, als ich dachte, und deswegen war es ein bisschen lärmig.

Wir haben uns bei Moe sehr wohl gefühlt. Mit eigener Toilette, Kühlschrank und Eingang war man recht unabhängig, was uns gefallen hat. Das obere Bett knarrt etwas. Uns hat das allerdings nicht gestört.

Great stay. Room was fantastic and loved the coffee machine and gift of beer in the fridge. Only concern was lift didn’t work - and it’s quite a big place so if mobility is an issue might not be ideal

Le logement est très propre et Audrey a le souci de vraiment bien accueillir les gens. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour et profité de la ville autrement que si nous avions eu juste notre guide papier: les conseils d'Audrey nous ont permis de découvrir des sites intéressants et de profiter de la vie berlinoise. On y retournerait les yeux fermés.

-: La description et les photos ne sont pas très claires, il n’y a pas de chambre, c’est un loft (pas de rideau, pas de cloison, pas d’intimité), déçue.
+: appartement propre et hôte réactif.
Great spot in the heart of Berlin. Lots of space and a lot of beds.

This home was perfect for our weekend get away, the place is very secure and in a good neighborhood, felt safe to walk around at night. the bathroom was clean. and there’s even a coffee machine for the mornings.
Easy check in, great flat in exactly the right area for us. Had a great weekend.
Andreas ist ein sehr netter und hilfsbereiter Vermieter. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und ruhig gelegen. Vielen Dank!

Byliśmy w Berlinie 3 noce. Nocowaliśmy w pokoju u Pauliny i Fernando wraz z dwiema nastoletnimi córkami. Było w sam raz, komfortowo. Swobodny dostęp do kuchni i łazienki. Z tyłu budynku jest dość spore podwórko z trawą i ławką. Wieczorem po męczącym dniu można odpocząć i zrelaksować się. W okolicy jest Lidl oraz restauracje z bardzo smacznym jedzeniem (Tacuza).  Na miejscu można zaparkować samochód bez dodatkowych opłat. Głównie dlatego, że przyjechaliśmy autem zatrzymaliśmy się dalej od centrum i wybraliśmy ten nocleg. Doskonała komunikacja z centrum miasta - niedaleko znajduje się metro. W kilka minut byliśmy w centrum Berlina. W odległości dwóch stacji metra znajduje się okolica, gdzie jest bardzo dużo restauracji z różnych stron świata. Naprawdę bardzo smaczne miejsce! Komunikacja z Pauliną była bardzo dobra - szybko odpisywała, dała nam jasne instrukcje jak dostać się mieszkania. Bardzo dobry stosunek jakości do ceny. Polecam!
Die Unterkunft ist direkt an eine Strassen- und U-Bahn Station gebunden. Alles andere liegt auch sehr zentral. Für den Preis war es sehr gut. Die Betten waren gemütlich.
Die Kommunikation war super schnell und sehr nett - das Zimmer war für unseren Aufenthalt in Berlin genau richtig - das Bad (Dusche und Toilette) hätte sauberer sein können. Sonst Top!
Unterkunft wie beschrieben, problemloser Check in. Simon immer erreichbar und hilfsbereit. Gute Lage, nahe Öffis.
Nassa was a wonderful host. Check in was easy and the flat was great.
Diese Wohnung ist zu empfehlen! Die Lage ist top und auch mit dem Parken hatten wir hier keine Probleme. Wir kommen sicher noch einmal wieder!!
Tolle Gastgeber! Saubere Wohnung! Nähe zur U-Bahn ist super!
Super Lage und nette Wohnung!

Frank was an exceptional host! Perfect location. He was very helpful as to what sights to see and how to get there. The only complaint I would have would be the comfort of the bed. Otherwise everything was perfect.

Dejlig lejlighed som matchede beskrivelsen fuldstændigt. Sophia var fleksibel til indtjekning og hjalp med tips til Berlin, når vi behøvede. God seng at sove i med rent sengetøj. Hunden Vilda var meget sød og sky, og vi så eller hørte ikke meget til hende. Eneste minus ved lejligheden er, at den ligger ud til en ok trafikeret gade, så når vinduet er åbent, kan man høre trafikken. Vi anbefaler på det kraftigste at bo hos Sophia.

Very nice, modern apartment at a great location. What I liked most was the convenience store next door and the only 7 min walk to KuDamm.
Oli and his dad were very kind and helpful.
I definitely recommend staying here when you visit Berlin.

Ein sehr nettes und modernes Apartment in grossartiger Lage. Besonders gut war der Edeka neben an und der kurze Marsch zum KuDamm.
Oli und sein Vater waren sehr nett und hilfsbereit.
Eine klare Emfpehlung fuer Berlin!
Appartement très propre, donnant sur une arriere cour très calme. Proche de nombreux commerces et du métro. Se trouve dans le quartier "créatif" de Berlin. Rien à redire
Charmante, freundliche, hilfsbereite Gastgeberin! Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt in der stilvoll renovierten Dachwohnung.

Wunderbare Unterkunft in sehr ruhiger aber guter Lage. Es war außerordentlich sauber und der Gastgeber ausgesprochen freundlich und unkompliziert. Wir waren mit einem Kleinkind da und waren sehr froh über das Kinderbett und den Kinderhochstuhl. Sehr empfehlenswert. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Really great experience, rooms were very clean, area was quiet and secure, and all instructions were simple and clear.
Highly recommend!
Tolle Lage zwischen Potsdam und Berlin. Ein wunderbarer Platz, um nah an der Stadt zur Ruhe zu kommen.
Schöne ruhige Wohnung mit fantastischem Ausblick! Alles vorhanden was man so benötigt.

Good location but The apartment was dirty when we arrived. The trash can was full, the bed was messy and someone even left an empty pizza box..
it was ok for low budget apartment
Good choice to stay. Thanks.

Die Unterkunft von Sabine liegt zwar etwas außerhalb in einer ruhigen Gegend, ist aber gut zu erreichen. Einkaufen und essen gehen erfordern etwas Fußweg.
Zimmer und eigenes Bad sehr großzügig und super sauber.
Das Gastgeberpaar ist sehr kommunikativ und gibt tolle Empfehlungen.

Appartamento molto carino, senza pretese, la posizione è ottima perché situato in centro, su una strada piena di ristoranti supermercato, bar e soprattutto fermata della metropolitana a 300 metri, l’host eugen è molto carina è disponibile a consigliare e rendere il soggiorno a Berlino migliore

We had a great time at Joshua and Yuqing's place. We only met Yuqing during our stay and she was super nice and very helpful. Also the communication beforehand was really well! The appartment is very nice and has everything you need. We totally fell in love with the two cats -they where adorable. We would love to come back another time.
Todo muy bien.

Airbnb is a true gem, thanks to the exceptional hospitality provided by the hosts, quick responses and friendliness made me feel instantly at home. The apartment itself has everything you could possibly need while also being cozy and comfortable, ideal for both short and extended stays. The location is beautiful and full of history I couldn’t think of a better place to be for sight seeing.
Overall, the seamless communication, homey interior and the added touch of the location make Konrad and Sven’s place a standout choice for a delightful and stress-free stay. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable experience in Berlin.
alles tip top
Very nice and spacious loft appartement, with a cosy terrace. Centrally placed on walking distance from Brandenburger and Hackesches Tor but still surprisingly quiet at night. Perfect for city visit!
Me and my family would like to thank Patrick for a pleasant place. Apartment was nice, modern and clean. Very beautiful place and friendly people.

Ein sehr schnuckliges, kleines Studio mit sehr gutem Preis-Leistungsverhältnis.
Für ein paar Nächte Berlin entdecken völlig ausreichend. Die Lage ist super, da man mit der Straßenbahn schnell zu den wichtigen Orten kommt. In der Umgebung ist alles, was man für den täglichen Bedarf benötigt. (Lidl, Rewe, dm uvm.)
Den genannten Verbesserungsvorschlägen in den Kommentaren würde ich mich anschliessen. Aber das sind Kleinigkeiten, die man schnell erledigen kann.
Im Grossen und Ganzen waren wir sehr zufrieden!!!
Kristina ist eine nette Gastgeberin, Check in und Check Out erfolgen völlig selbständig.
Sehr zu empfehlen, wir kommen gerne wieder!!

I had a really lovely stay at Oli’s place. It’s modern and comfortable, the bedroom is large and the private bathroom and toilet was great!
Anouk was there to check me in as Oli was away for most of my stay, she was so lovely and helpful during my time there and was nice to meet Oli before I left.
The location is super close to public transport (a short walk), restaurants and bars (both right outside the front door)!
As a solo female traveler I felt pretty safe in the area and coming home late at night. There are locals who do loiter at the train station and on some corners but I found they don’t hassle you and weren’t a worry for me.
Was a great stay in Kreuzberg, wish Oli and Anouk all the best! Would definitely come back again! :)

5 jours exceptionnels! L'appartement est vraiment aussi joli que sur les photos et très propre, la douché est très agreable, et la terrasse avec barbecue bien utile pour se faire une petite grillade le soir avec des enfants fatigués de leur journée qui profitent du hamac. Boulangerie très sympa juste au pied de l'immeuble ou nous avons vite pris nos habitudes.  Tres bonne reactivite de Jeep et mention spéciale à Tom pour son accueil efficace et discret, et sa disponibilité pour résoudre les petits problèmes quotidiens.  Adresse très recommandable et déjà recommandée!

Das Apartment war wie beschrieben, super stylische eingerichtet und super sauber.
Es liegt super zentral mit guter Anbindungen an den ÖPNV. Alle notwendigen Geschäften (wie Supermarkt, Bäckerei, Drogerie) sind nur 5 Minuten entfernt. Ebenso gibt es in der Umgebung viele tolle Cafés und Restaurants.
Die Kommunikation mit Karsten war sehr gut und er war sehr flexibel was die Check- in bzw. Check-out Zeit anging.

This apartment is perfect for a quick stay, as it is a minimal apartment in a great location. The apartment is clean, bright, and airy, at the top of a 4 floor building. The bed was comfortable and the living room spacious. A few things to be aware of - there are no toiletries at all, so be sure to bring shower gel/shampoo/etc.  The door to the balcony was broken (unable to use the balcony, which I was super excited about!) and the washing machine was broken, and communication with the host was tough as it took her a long time to respond, and sometimes there was no response at all. All in all, a decent value for that district in Berlin.
Great base for families with a small child! Nice location x

Comunication with Oliver and his father was excellent, quick efficient and very friendly. The reception was welcoming. The apartment ist fantastic, incredibly well organized space and very thoughtfully decorated and equipped. It is located in a nice and very quiet neighbourhood with buses in walking distance. I would definitely recommend this place and also come back for further stays.
An amazing comfy place and looks like photos for real, thank you for the host
Phillip and Caroline were amazing and attentive hosts and the apartment was just as described and perfect for our stay.
Appartement idéalement situé pour visiter la ville, à proximité des transports et des commerces. Logement neuf, propre et spacieux. Hôte très réactif. Je recommande !
Eine super liebe Gastgeberin und eine tolle Unterkunft. Sehr zu empfehlen
Perfect for quick one night stay. Only problem isn't even with the hostel, but the loud environment. Or i just had bad luck and the night was louder than usuak

Eine super Unterkunft und ein toller Gastgeber. Das Appartement ist sehr gut eingerichtet. Die Kommunikation war sehr angenehm und hat Spaß gemacht.
Der Check in war leicht. Die Umgebung ist toll.

me encantó!! 100% recomendado
Friendly environment, very well located.

We had a lovely 4 days staying here. An excellent location for exploring Berlin with a shopping center with a supermarket just 5 minutes walk away right by the S-Bahn, tram and bus services. Very easy access into Berlin center, about 30-40 minutes on the S-Bahn depending on which stop you want. It continues on to Potsdam (30 minutes again) which is well worth a visit.
Rüdiger has equipped the apartment with all the necessary items to cook meals easily. The local supermarket closes at 8pm (closed Sun).
The apartment is cool, light and airy with plenty of space. It is super clean with the added bonus of a washing machine and dishwasher. There is also a rack for drying clothes.
Rüdiger welcomed us on arrival and showed us everything we needed in the apartment. He lives in the next house, so is on hand should there be any issues.
We had an amazing four day break and would very much recommend this accommodation to others.
Amazing host, flat and location! We absolutely loved the area which was so close to everything. Would very highly recommend Verda and her flat to anyone visiting Berlin :)
Nice apartment, very clean, nice location.
Very nice appartement, located near to S and U- bahn and busses as well. Great park at a few hundred meters. Basic, but all you need to have a good startingpoint to discover Berlin!
I highly recommend Vlad's place. The room was cozy and communication was simple.

This apartment is not the same from the pics  ! Very cold , there are no blankets , very strong smell of cigarettes, dirty and not cozy ! I can’t imagine that someone can write gut review for this misery place , is a deception !

Das Loft hat unsere Erwartungen übertroffen. Wir waren begeistert vom Charme und Ambiente und der Historie des Ortes. Die Ausstattung ließ keine Wünsche offen und es war alles sehr sauber. Die Räumlichkeiten sind hell und groß. Besonders gefallen hat uns der Mix aus Retro-Stil und Modernem. Wir können das Loft und den Gastgeber sehr empfehlen.

Had a great stay at this Airbnb! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was super convenient, making it easy to get around. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a nice, hassle-free experience.
Excellent location and lovely flat!

Neli und Alex haben eine sehr gemütliche Wohnung und waren sehr gastfreundlich und fürsorglich. Wegen des großen Kinderzimmers gerade für Familien mit Kindern bestens geeignet. Dabei ist die Lage wirklich super, direkt mitten im Viertel mit einer riesigen Auswahl Restaurants nebenan.

Overall the apartment is great. It is located in the heart of the trendy area and it has a great interior. It also is equipped with eveything you need to feel at home (cooking appliancies, towels, shower gels, etc.).However our impression was spoiled by some issues with the check in. The official check in time was at 14:00 and we agreed with the host that we will come at this time. However when we arrived it turned out that the cleaning was not finished yet. We had to wait for 1.5 hours, however the host did not communicate how much time it would take before we could check in. The morning of our check out we were asked if it was possible for the cleaning person to come 30 min before the official check out time. Considering that this apartment is rather expensive and the cleaning and service fees were rather high we did not expect to run into such issues.

Great place, nice and quiet, good shower and nice area to go out and about in kreuzberg/neukoln/friedrichshain.
Only thing is that the place is an appartment máde for airbnbing, and not a place that you share with the owner. So its not that authentic as staying in someones house. Which i think is what Airbnb should be about.

Nettes, kleines Apartment, gut gelegen, etwas kleines Bad, sehr netter Gastgeber.
A perfect place! Well located, 4 people per room with a private bathroom, great breakfast, storage room for free and besides the building is so beautiful and cosy. Just loved it❤️

Great location with endless restaurants and bars in close walking distance. Close to a U bahn station and tram stop making it easy to use as a base to explore Berlin. Lovely apartment with all that you need for a short stay.

Great location, perfect flat, easy and convenient check in.

Rehana’s apartment is charming—very stylishly appointed. As a former interior decorator, I enjoyed being in such a chic environment. The bed was extremely comfortable. Excellent shower. My one issue, which really wasn’t Rehana’s fault, was it was very hot when I was visiting Berlin—in the 90s in early June—and it didn’t cool down until the wee hours of the morning. It was thus necessary to open all the windows. While they did a very good job keeping the room quiet when closed, Karl Marx Straße is a busy street and it was very noisy when they were open. I would recommend ear plugs if you are a light sleeper visiting during hot weather. Rehana was very responsive and helpful with directions.

The apartment was as in the description and provides all that one could need. Communicating with Sophia was always kind and easy per chat as well as in person. We had a very nice stay and would absolutely come again!

Stefania's penthouse is an exceptional accommodation that will make your stay unforgettable. ottima posizione, ottimo alloggio,  consigliatissimo! se dovessi tornare a Berlino sceglierei di nuovo di soggiornare qua!

Schönes geräumiges Appartement, funktional und einfach, aber mit allem, was ich brauchte, und alles sauber und ordentlich. Vor allem die Kommunikation und die Anweisungen waren exzellent, und das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis optimal. Ich empfehle Mandel gerne weiter!
Wonderful location, safe quiet neighborhood.  Everything was as described and the host was super responsive.  I liked it so much I extended  my trip!

Really nice warm apartment! Jörg was not at home during my stay but he had an assistant that was very helpfull! There was no problem and he let me stay a bit longer since my airplane departed during night. I would recomend anyone to rent this place in a very nice and fun area

Loved our stay in Simones place! Very clean and tidy everything you need. Can watch Netflix on the tv. Good communication and we got given flowers picked from their garden! Beautiful lake at the end of the street. Would stay again
Schöne Unterkunft, leider etwas dreckig (staubiger Boden, dreckiges Besteck), in einer unheimlichen Gegend (würde Nachts nicht alleine durchlaufen), mit freundlichem Personal an der Rezeption.

Great place

Jürgen’s place is awesome, very comfy room and your own bathroom! Jürgen is super responsive and a friendly host, and gives you privacy too. The neighborhood is beautiful and really well connected. I recommend it!

Eine tolle ruhig gelegene modern eingerichtete Wohnung

Highly recommend

very nice place, warmly recommended!

Dorothea was an amazing host, beautiful property in good location. We were pleasantly surprised by the lovely flat and would recommend to all!

Such a wonderful time in Berlin because of this home away from home. Totally equipped and lots of food and drink options close by. There’s even a sweet park to sit and read just a couple of blocks away. Nice neighborhood and super clean and cozy apartment.
