Eine gute Adresse für das Kennenlernen von Berlin.
All good :-)
Abgesehen das wir paar Haare gefunden haben und uns gesagt wurde das man einen Schwamm im Putzmittelraum findet, war das Apartment super.

L’appartement est idéalement situé pour un séjour touristique à Berlin. Dans une rue calme, proche de commerces, restaurants et transports en commun.

Auch etwas Schokolade auf dem Bettlaken!!! wurde vorhin noch bemängelt, bei 60 Euro Reinigungskosten .... Wirklich peinlich hierfür eine WhatsApp mit Fotos zu erhalten...  Ansonsten: Wohnung recht dunkel wegen fehlender Fenster im Wohnzimmer... seeeehr langer dunkler Flur... insgesamt ist die Wohnung etwas verschnitten, was man nicht sehen kann bei den Fotos. Camilla is an excellent host with great communication. Her apartment was also excellent - spotless, quiet and safe, located in a fantastic neighbourhood where you can walk to almost anything you'd want, or catch trams to farther locations.

Der Check-in verlief abends mit zwei müden Kindern etwas holprig, da wir zwar den Kasten für den Schlüssel problemlos gefunden und geöffnet haben, direkt darüber aber ebenfalls ein Bedienfeld  angebracht war und wir dort erfolglos den Code eingegeben haben. Nach Rücksprache mit dem sehr netten und hilfsbereiten Vermieter haben wir aber die richtige Wohnung (ein Eingang weiter) gefunden. Leider war die ursprüngliche Wohnung durch die Mieter vor uns so furchtbar stark verraucht worden, dass selbst den ganzen Tag lüften vorher nicht gebracht hatte. Der Vermieter bot uns daraufhin gleich an, in die zum Glück freie und direkt daneben liegende Wohnung umzuziehen. Ich hätte wirklich ungern mit den kleinen Kindern dort geschlafen. Vielen lieben Dank für die schnelle Lösung. Mir ist wirklich ein Rätsel, wie man mit fremdem Eigentum so umgehen kann. Ich hoffe sehr, Sie bekommen die schöne Wohnung wieder hergerichtet. Die Wohnung an sich war sauber und schick eingerichtet. Genau wie auf den Bildern. Die Wohnung nebenan liegt direkt an der Straße, was nachts und besonders am sehr frühen Morgen durch das große Hotel nebenan sehr laut war, aber wenn man einen tiefen Schlaf hat, stört das sicher nicht. Parken war abends dann leider etwas schwierig, das ist sicher einfacher, wenn man tagsüber anreist. Alles in allem aber ein zum Glück doch noch gelungener Aufenthalt. Vielen Dank dafür.
Ein schönes Apartment mit perfekter Lage! Nur zu empfehlen!:)

주요 관광지와는 조금 애매한 거리지만, 대중교통과 가깝고, 자전거 이용 시 딱 좋은 거리.

Bon, j'arrête, vous l'aurez compris : on adore Kreuzberg , village cosmopolite où le respect de l'autre est roi!
Very nice place. Great location and the place has such nice facilities ans rooms especially compared to the price!

Very clean home full of rooms to airbnb. The self check in is great, plus Parwana and Frank even let me keep my bag there all day. Would absolutely recommend! Esp for someone traveling alone!

Die Wohnung von Mikel war sehr sauber und angenehm. Die Kommunikation sehr schnell und einfach. Einen Babybett wurde zu Verfügung gestellt. Sehr praktisch und zentral, da in der Nahe von Alexander Platz. Vielen Dank an Mikel für die Gelegenheit! Gerne wieder.

My first airbnb experience was fantastic! So easy and hassle-free. The apartment was just like the photos, if not even more spacious and airy! The beds were very comfortable, good hot water at all times and great heating. It was a very cosy place, good neighbourhood location and building. Highly recommend.

Thank you very much, everything was super!
Love the area. Friendly restaurants and caffes, very green and well connected.
Carlos.
Fantastic location and an excellent place for a temporary office. Armin's place is very spacious and has a lot of light.

Wonderful hosts and overall a great stay!
Reasons to stay there:
- fast wifi
- 10 minute walk to train station
- 10 minute walk to great restaurants (check out Umami)
- 5 minute walk to Lidl
- very clean and pretty bedroom and private bathroom
- can use the kitchen
- hosts are very friendly and give you your space
Other considerations:
- neighborhood is quiet and you will have to walk and take a train to get to more central nightlife

The Airbnb was impeccably clean and perfectly located. However, the true highlight of my stay was the exceptional kindness of one of the staff members. A cleaner in the lobby, despite the significant language barrier—my German is practically non-existent—went out of her way to help me with an early check-in. Her friendly and helpful demeanor made a huge difference, and I am so grateful for her assistance.
Julian is a great host, always caring about the doubts and requests of the guests. He cook delicious. If we go back to Berlin definetely we will try to book again with him.

Het was een ruime nette kamer waarbij alle voorzieningen aanwezig zijn. We hadden een auto bij ons die we voor de deur konden parkeren. We werden gastvrij ontvangen en in het huis was alles brandschoon. De schoenen moeten uit bij binnenkomst en we hadden een heerlijk balkon om buiten te zitten. Badkamer en keuken waren ook super schoon, zeker voor herhaling vatbaar! De bus en treinhalte zijn praktisch voor de deur, je bent met 20 min. in het centrum van Berlijn!
Tijmen en Annika

Wonderful stay in Benjamin’s apartment! It was very comfortable, with a fully equipped kitchen and convenient to great restaurants and supermarkets nearby. The bedroom was quite and bed comfortable. We really enjoyed our stay! Will be back!
Vielen Dank nochmal für die tolle Zeit in Berlin, wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!
Tip top. Appartement propre et bien équipé.  Proche des commerces et du metro.

Zweites Mal hier genau so zufrieden wie beim
Ersten Mal meine Freundin ebenso 👍🏽

Malena (9 ans) et moi, nous avons vraiment passé un excellent séjour chez Hanno et Zaki. Ce sont des hôtes prévenants, très attentionnés et chaleureux mais discrets également. L'échange était simple et amicale. Malena, qui ne parle pas encore l'anglais couramment et encore moins l'allemand, a pourtant réussi à échanger avec toute la famille à son plus grand contentement. Par ailleurs, Hanno et Zaki sont de bons conseils si vous avez des interrogations sur la ville et vos visites. Leur appartement est très agréable à vivre et apaisant. Une certaine quiétude s'en dégage. Il est également idéalement situé dans un quartier calme de Berlin et à proximité des différents transports en commun. Facile d'accès depuis l'aéroport de Tegel.  Nous gardons un très bon souvenir de notre séjour chez Hanno, Zaki et leur fille Suraya, ainsi que de la ville de Berlin.
We loved the accommodation! Seb provided us with plenty of supplies and it was just as described. We will definitely stay here again!

Die Woche bei Klaus in der Wohnung ist super verlaufen! Das Zimmer war geräumig und die Küche wirklich super ausgestattet! Zudem ist die Lage super, so dass man überall schnell hinkommt. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Nice apartment. Everything was good.
Great location, very clean, comfortable beds! We enjoyed our stay here very much and were especially thankful that we could check in and out a bit later!

Hardi’s appartment is located very well. You can reach everything in a short time. The appartment itself is clean and Hardi is a nice host who takes care of his guests. All in all I can recommend a stay at the appartment.
War wieder sehr zufrieden mit Unterkunft selbst sowie der Lage mitten in Kreuzberg. Wiederholter Besucher und komme gern wieder im weiteren Verlauf von 2020.
Worth the money
Alle(s) sehr okay und freundlich 😀
It was a great Peace.... confortable, clean and very nice located..
The stay was good.
Duidelijke instructies en een nette kamer. de ligging is centraal,  goed te bereiken met openbaar vervoer en in de buurt zijn er gratis parkeergelegenheden. goede prijs/kwaliteit verhouding!

very nice choice for stay in Berlin for couple of days, very closed to S1 so it is convenient to get to center of Berlin in just 4 stations, place is also very quiet at night, and parking alone the road is easy too, you could always wait a few minutes then find a parking spot, we had a great time there, strongly recommend
Alina was extremely responsive, although I booked this place same-day. I am so grateful! The place worked great for my family of four. The curtains separating the bed from the living room was nice.
Todo muy bien.

Florian et Gaston sont des hôtes très accueillants et très sympathiques.
Appartement très bien situé dans un quartier calme.
Je recommande

Logement impeccable, mignon et fonctionnel. Le quartier n'est pas parmi les plus charmants, mais nous y avons trouvé sur la recommandation de Daniel un loueur de vélos aux tarifs imbattables. Dommage qu'il n'y ait pas de rideaux occultants dans la chambre, le réveil avec la lumière du jour était un peu dur !

Such a wonderful stay at David’s apartment. A beautiful place that was super central with amazing restaurants on the doorstep.
David’s communication was fabulous, and I ask so many questions! Very welcome and I would love to stay again next time I’m in Berlin.

Location was great. Trouble with checking in. Received no reminder of how to get inside. Limited conversation with us in the property made us feel uncomfortable. Good bed but terrible pillows. Worst thing was that the host would sit in the kitchen with his laptop or radio playing loudly and then proceed to fall asleep until after 1am.

Very happy with our stay. Location was peaceful and residential with direct access to city center using tram. Many local cafes to choose from as well as a convenient supermarket. Ingrid was extremely flexible and understanding and helped us even with a language barrier!
Alles super! Gerne wieder ☺️

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb apartment in Berlin. The place was spotless and beautifully maintained, exactly as shown in the pictures. Our host was exceptionally friendly and made us feel warmly welcomed, offering great local tips and ensuring we had everything we needed. The apartment is located in a peaceful and quiet neighborhood, perfect for relaxing after exploring the city. Highly recommended—we’d gladly stay here again!
We liked the place. Leon is easy to communicate!
Enjoyed my stay - the vibe was strong

Excelente lugar para descansar
Nuestro nuevo amigo nos trató como un alemán más nos sentimos súper bien
Volveríamos sin duda
Todas las comodidades
Luisa was very nice and made us enjoy our staying.

A acomodação da Erzsebet é excelente, espaçosa e bem equipada. A paisagem é bonita e o local bastante silencioso. Há paradas de ônibus que conectam aos trens a 300 e 550 metros da acomodação. Cheguei de madrugada e há linha noturna a partir do aeroporto com parada a 550 metros. Supermercados Rewe e Netto ficam a 500 metros.

El apartamento de Rolf es bastante cómodo y cuenta con todo lo necesario. Además, está cerca de una estación de bus, y, caminando un poco, hay una estación del subterráneo. Veronique y Rolf son muy amables y serviciales. Definitivamente recomiendo el apartamento de ellos para hospedarse.
excelente alojamiento

Nous venons de passer 5 jours à Berlin avec nos 2 filles de 12 et 14 ans. C'est une très bonne adresse pour visiter Berlin. accès rapide au centre ville avec un bus toutes les 10 minutes. Quelques commerces aux alentours qui permettent de se ravitailler. La maison est très calme et permet de se reposer après les journées de visite de Berlin. Le grenier est aménagé avec beaucoup de goût et est très confortable. Dörte et son mari sont très gentils et attentionnés, ils rendent le séjour encore plus agréable.
Good place!

Das Appartement ist stilvoll eingerichtet, gepflegt, bietet ausreichend Platz und liegt zentral im Herzen Westberlins in einem ruhigen Hinterhaus. Der Wohn-\Essbereich war aufgrund der baulichen Situation dunkler als erwartet, was in unserem Fall, da wir die Wohnung nur als Ausgangspunkt für unsere Tagestouren genutzt haben, zu vernachlässigen war. Um Gegenzug lässt das unmittelbare Umfeld keine Wünsche offen. Die Anbindung mit Bus & Bahn und das Angebot an Gastro, Shopping, Kultur und Sightseeing lassen keine Wünsche offen.
Cool Cosy place located in a great and peaceful area of Berlin.
Very nice place! Kind service

Une grande chambre, décorée avec goût dans un très joli appartement. Le quartier est pratique, joli, vivant et calme.
Sophia a été très flexible pour mon arrivée. Elle est de très bon conseil pour tout ce qui concerne Berlin qu'elle connaît parfaitement. Elle m'a raconté un peu d'histoire du quartier. Elle m'a aussi prêté un vélo et emmené faire un tour.
Et la cohabitation avec elle est très facile, je me suis sentie tout à fait à l'aise. Sophia est à la fois discrète, respectueuse et ouverte au contact.

Daniele war ein sehr proaktiver und netter Gastgeber. Die Kommunikation war super.  Ich habe mich in der Unterkunft sehr wohl gefühlt und die Lage war in einer ruhigen und gut angebundenen Gegend. Es war ein super Aufenthalt und ich kann Daniele sehr weiterempfehlen!
Sehr freundliche Gastgeber, ruhige Lage, alles wie beschrieben. Hab mich sehr wohl gefühlt 😊

Das Air BnB hatte ein super Preis-Leistungsverhältnis und eine gute Lage! Allerdings entsprach das Air BnB nicht den Fotos. Es waren trotzdem alle Ausstattungen da.
Ich würde hier nochmal übernachten.
Всё было замечательно, спасибо!

I've spent one night in Parwana's apartment which is very nice and cosy, situated 5 min from U-Bahn station and ca. 30 min from the central railstation. Unfortuntely I didn't have the chance to meet Parwana personally, she is very helpfull and nice though, available every time you need her. All in all we had a great time in Berlin. Thank you!
Alles bestens, einfacher Check in und Check out.
Alles bestens! Super Lage, entspannter Gastgeber und schönes Zimmer!

Super nice place to see the better side of Berlin.
Great and flexible host and no issues at all. We had a lovely stay. 5 stars👍
A great apartment with beautiful space and everything you need to enjoy Berlin
Alles wie beschrieben
Highly recommend this place surrounding with great cafe and restaurants. Easy to commute. Well maintained stay and a great host to provide all instructions clearly.

Krásný byt v krásné lokalitě. Bohužel v bytě je vše velmi slyšet, takže pokud narazíte na bezohledné spolubydlící, tak se moc nevyspíte. 2noci byly akorát k tomu, co jsme potřebovali, další už bych zde být nechtěla, protože z jiného pokoje v 1h ráno někdo třískal nádobím v kuchyni, poměrně dlouho a dost hlasitě, v 6h ráno to jede nanovo, protože vchodové dneře zvenčí nejdou zavřít jinak, než boucháním, někdy stačilo lehce přibouchnout, jindy bylo nutné dveřmi několikrát více třísknout, aby se zavřeli, což samozřejmě vzbudí úplně všechny.
The apartment is perfect, near many of Berlin attractions and eve a train station (Friedrich Strasse). The host is kind and helpful. Hope one day return. I'm very happy and glad.
Super friendly and great value in Prenzlaurberg. Tram outside for easy connection to Alex, a gateway to the rest of the city.
Die Wohnung war so wie in der Anzeige angegeben, super gemütlich und nur ~5 Minuten vom Adenauerplatz entfernt. Die Kommunikation lief reibungslos.

I had a great stay at Kate's home. Kate was very welcoming, thoughtful, and always ready to help — they gave clear instructions and useful tips about the local area, which made everything smooth and easy. The hause is very close to the subway and several bus stops, so getting around was no problem at all. The surroundings are peaceful and full of nature, perfect for relaxing walks. It’s a wonderful spot for anyone looking for a quiet and well-connected stay. Highly recommended!

Schöne Wohnung in der wir uns zu Viert sehr wohl gefühlt haben. Olympiastadion ist in Gehweite. Dafür ist Stadtmitte etwas weiter weg. Allerdings mit der U-Bahn in ca. 20-30 Min. erreichbar. Schiffrundfahrt auf der Spree mit Bus innerhalb 10. Min. erreichbar.
Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin war unkompliziert und schnell.
Very kind and approachable host. Room is very spacious and has a lot of light. Would recommend!

This is a beautiful room and adjacent bathroom, both with skylights, in a very tastefully decorated house. The atmosphere in the house is most pleasant and peaceful, I met Rudolf and his son, who were very friendly and easygoing. This place is a gem, I hope to be staying there again.

Logement très conforme à la description sur le site de Airbnb. Très bien équipé et au calme. Facile d'accès,  bénéficie de tout le confort et de tous les équipements nécessaires pour un agréable séjour.
El apartamento de Dima es tal cual lo muestran las fotos publicadas. Muy cómodo y confortable. Dima es un gran anfitrión, ameno y muy amable.
Energetic and friendly house host with a positive aura. Hope to come back for my next time traveling to Berlin.
if you can ever stay at rudi’s rest i would totally recommend it. he is so kind and has the most beautiful history filled home i have ever seen. i cannot wait to come back.
It was a really pleasant experience to stay with Rafael. Thanks for sharing your home with me.
Yury ist ganz freundlich und hilfsbereit. Checkin ganz schnell und reibungslos geklappt. Gerne wieder

Wir haben uns bei Susanne und ihrer Familie sehr wohlgefühlt! Sie waren sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit, es war alles sehr sauber und ordentlich! Durch die Lage war es ruhig und über die Öffentlichen erreicht man schnell das Zentrum bzw. andere Gebiete in der Umgebung. 100% Empfehlung!

Stefanie's place in Berlin was great! Its location was ideal, providing easy access to the city's vibrant sights, sounds, and tastes. The place was clean and decorated with a stylish, homely touch. Stefanie herself was an exceptional host, making check-in seamless. I'd recommend her place to anyone seeking a Berlin experience!

Spacious, well-furnished apartment with plenty reading material and original lights. Stylish in a traditional manner. High ceilings allow for cool temperature even in hot weather. Very close to supermarket and public transport. A homely place to feel the heart of Berlin.

We had a great time! The hosts were very helpful and responsive. There was some noise from construction work and from a piano placed outside, but nothing that would impair working remotely. The internet is very good and worked perfectly for both of us. The location is great, at Sony Center and right next to Tiergarten and Potsdamer Platz station. The bed is a little narrow and the apartment is small, but it's convenient. We would definitely recommend this apartment.
Everything was great, the flat is fun and has a lot of great amenities such as coffee machine
Quiet apartment in Berlin neighborhood close to lots of places to eat.  Great space with lots of room and nicely decorated.
Great place. Great location. Really easy to walk places and get transportation. A fun place to stay while visiting Berlin.
L'appartement très propre et équipé de tout ce dont on peut avoir besoin, est bien situé (proche supérette et métro). Location conforme aux photos. Merci Paul pour l'accueil.
All good en este sitio.
Top Wohnung in super Lage! Sehr sauber und Nathan ist ein super Host :)
Heel vriendelijk, accurate host.  Heel behulpzaam en kamer zeer in orde.

Die Wohnung war gut ausgestattet, sauber und zentral gelegen. Es hat uns an nichts gefehlt. Der Check-in verlief unkompliziert. Vor der Haustür war allerdings recht viel los, da sich die Wohnung an einer belebten Straße befindet. Morgens beim Rauchen wurde man dort auch mal von einem Obdachlosen angesprochen, der gegenüber auf dem Klavier gespielt hat – insgesamt eine besondere, aber freundliche Erfahrung 😅 Ein etwas privaterer Bereich zum Rauchen wäre wünschenswert gewesen. Trotzdem eine gute Unterkunft, die ich weiterempfehlen kann :)
Perfect and recommendable stay: convenient location, very good communication, well equipped apartment with everything you need. Thank you!
Alles super, gute Anbindung in die Stadt und sehr sauber.
Alles Perfekt, wie kommen gerne wieder.

Felix is a humble,  welcoming and social host, he created a cozy and friendly atmosphere at the place, making it also have a social dimension, there is a great common kitchen/lobby area that connects with a nice shared terrace and a cute garden, it quickly felt like home, the cheryy on the cake is the other guests were very welcoming as well.

Our stay at Ulf’s place was very pleasant. Communication with Caroline went smoothly and she was kind and flexible towards us.
Though the place is spacious, there is just one bedroom. We were 2 couples, so one room is pretty private, but the other bed is the sofa in the living room (which turns into a bed).
The location is one of the best in my opinion, with many nice options of restaurants, cafes and nice bars around.
Nette Gastgeber,sauber,tolles Zimmer und Bad,Pool darf mitgenutzt werden,gerne wieder !
Really nice apartment, a lot of nice restaurants and cafes close, Jörg is very helpful and friendly, recommend!
Très bonne adresse, bien située à proximité des arrêts de tram et de métro. Équipe chaleureuse. Équipements et services de l'hôtel très appréciables, je recommande!
Very nice hostel that are cozy and also very central. It was very clean and the staff are excellent!

Yaz è un host veramente eccezionale, gentile, prodigo di consigli utili e molto disponibile. La strada è molto tranquilla e a soli due isolato dalla metro. Avendo due passeggini è stato molto facile introdurli in casa perché ci sono solo 4/5 gradini in basso.
Se dovessi tornare a Berlino sicuramente sceglierei di nuovo l’appartamento di Yaz.
Stay was good

Good place to stay, big room, with kitchen and bathroom. The beds are ok for just some days, but no for more than that (they are not bad, but they are not very confortable either).
Very close to the subway, 30 minutes from city center.
Very nice apartment! The rooms are spacious and the location is central and close to public transport.
Danke für den Aufenthalt.

Die Unterkunft war einfach fantastisch! Wunderschön eingerichtet und perfekt gelegen. Wir haben ein Wochenende in Berlin mit Freunden verbracht und hätten uns keine bessere Wohnung vorstellen können. Alles war sauber, modern und komfortabel. Wir kommen definitiv wieder – absolut empfehlenswert!

An excellent modern apartment with very friendly and helpful reception staff and every amenity you need in a bustling young neighbourhood in Berlin! Lots of great food and bar options and great communication and loads of helpful tips from the Downtown Apartments staff!
Very close to Wedding station with access to the U-Bahn and S-Bahn to get you anywhere in Berlin quickly.
Great place to stay. Location perfect and hos, Peter, is great

We really enjoyed our stay at Simon’s boat house. Simon was very responsive during our trip when somebody stole our paddle. The surroundings are beautiful and if you search for a step when at the shore you are in the nicest part of Berlin within 10 minutes!

Aliaa’s place in Bergmannkiez is wonderful - and even nicer than the pics make it seem! Incredibly high ceilings, beautiful floorboards and a designer’s eye for detail - we couldn’t have been happier! Very comfortable bed, beautiful sofa - nice kitchen, supermarket literally just across the street - and peaceful and quiet!
Bergmannkiez is a lovely area to be in too; super close to rest of Kreuzberg and Neukölln etc, but with a very genteel atmos - feels a bit like a Paris-Berlin love child?! Easy to get a anywhere with several UBahn stations nearby, and loads of great restaurants and coffee shops right on your doorstep. make sure to hang out in nearby Tempelhof and we would recommend a visit to the beautiful lake Krumme Lanke too! Thanks Aliaa!

Fantastic location at the heart of Berlin.  4 minutes from Brandenburg gate and Tiergarten. Historic locations all around.  Midway between Brandenburg Tor and Mohernstrasse underground. 13 minute walk from Friedrichstrasse train station. So many things to do in easy reach!! The apartment was also well appointed and very functionally equipped. Very spacious and very convenient. Our hosts were extremely professional and well organized with great instructions to reach the place and check in. We had a great visit to Berlin and could not have been happier with this location!
I think the price performance hostel but this hostel can definitely be better, there is potential

It was great to stay with Franziska, in her wonderful apartment. Communication was very good. Check-in was flexible, very much appreciated because we arrived earlier than expected. The room and shower in the corridor were as advertised. Bed was good, we slept very well. Obviously, and clearly communicated, use of the living room is not included. Still it feeds the idea of having more space than just your room. Same goes for the kitchen. Off course we went out for meals, but it's great to be able to use the kitchen for making coffee or tap some water. Thank you so much for having us Franziska!

We had an amazing stay at Fadeih's place. It was clean, comfortable and in a great location. Fadeih was really helpful at all stages and was prompt and clear with all of her replies. When I come back to Berlin I will definitely stay here again.
Günter was very friendly and always available. We thank him for our stay!

Die Unterkunft von Jeannette ist sehr gepflegt und schön eingerichtet, sauber, ruhig und es ist alles da, was man benötigt. Die Gastgeber sind freundlich und sehr kommunikativ. Jedoch benötigt man um die City zu kommen zwischen 50 - 70 Minuten mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Geschäfte des täglichen Bedarfs und Restaurants sind für uns nicht fußläufig erreichbar, da sie mindestens 1 km entfernt sind. Wir können uns vorstellen, wieder bei Jeannette zu nächtigen, so lange die Gesundheit mitmacht und wir die weiten Wege schaffen.

The house was spotlessly clean and had everything we could need. It has character as it is a very old building, prepared with care, to provide what one needs. The area is quiet and close to Alexander Platz, just a 15 minute walk. But you can use the metro. Just a few meters from the house, there is the red subway line U2, at Senefelderplatz. There are various restaurants and bars nearby. The supermarket is very close and closes at 22.00. Henrik respond immediately at any question and he was very helpful.
All convenient and nice!!

Die Lage ist super, in wenigen Minuten ist man bei der U-bahn. Die Wohnung ist geräumig und funktional eingerichtet. Es gibt zwar 12 Schlafplätze, da es aber nur ein Bad gibt, würde ich sie maximal für 6 Personen empfehlen. Aber ansonsten war alles super.
Headed here for the Berlin Half - fantastic location and had everything you needed. Would recommend

Cosy place in a quiet neighbourhood, close to U-bahn and tram. Andrzej was hospitable and extremely helpful. We could pick up the keys at a time that was convenient for us and leave our luggage in the flat after the check-out. We highly recommend him as a host!
Great stay. Like the descriptions. Warm. Easy. I’d totally recommend it and book there myself again.
This was basically a really nice hotel without a front desk. Super easy and comfortable and a great value. Close to public transit and in a lively part of Charlottenburg.
We were very pleased! Could definitely consider staying there again:)

Nous avons passé une super semaine dans un appartement agréable et dans un quartier très sympa.
Merci !

Kristina’s place is beautiful, cozy and always spotless. The best part for me was that it felt like home. There were cookies and little treats everywhere. The kitchen was stocked, always clean and open to use. She was easy to reach out to and always replied promptly. It was a great experience overall!

Lugar limpo e muito organizado, com ótima localização, perto de pontos turisticos e facil de chegar em qualquer lugar.
Hanna e Paolo foram muito prestativos e gentis.
Super recomendo!

My family and I enjoyed a lot this apartament. It was clean and had all supllies that we needed in the kitchen, in the bathroom and in the room. The shower is strong and the temperature was too nice.
The internet is fast. It's really near the underground and there are some interestings places to go walking.
We feel very confortable at night because we could control the heating as we wanted, even the floor was warm!
Martin gave us all attention and we certainly would like to come back here again.

A great place to stay in Berlin. Super convenient, close to shops, trains, buses. The room is actually nicer than it looks in the photos. The staff are friendly n got back to me even with some silly questions. Thank you.

Christine was a lovely host. I arrived in Berlin early in the morning and she was able to accommodate me. Her apartment truly is cozy and is perfect for a person who is traveling light and it is very close to the metro station.  Christine was even nice enough to leave out breakfast for me, which was a great way to start the day.

Bernd and Katja's place was lovely. It was clean and well laid out. We enjoyed sitting on the balcony after a great day in Berlin. The apartment is located close to transit. Bernd was very helpful when we were leaving.

Bardzo czyste i praktycznie urządzone mieszkanie. Wygodne duże łóżko i kanapa. Dobre wifi, bez problemu pracowałam zdalnie. Bardzo sympatyczni gospodarze. Łazienka ze sporą wanną. Kuchnia malutka, ale dobrze wyposażona. Ok 5-10 min. na piechotę do stacji metra Seestr. W pobliżu supermarket, drogeria i wiele innych sklepów i knajp. Polecam na krótki i dłuższy pobyt w Berlinie.
we loved our stay in the apartment, great location and a nice space! check in was super easy and communication was great. it is cosy but we had everything we needed. would definitely recommend
La comunicación siempre fue muy rápida y positiva. Es un buen apartamento para ir con amigos. Muy tranquilo.

Imad es súper agradable, nos proporcionó información útil para pasar bien nuestra estancia en Berlín, el alojamiento muy limpio y espacioso en un barrio tranquilo y sobre todo al lado del transporte público, lo recomiendo mucho. Volvería sin pensarlo.

Marcus reageert bijna altijd snel. Toevallig even niet snel om de deur op afstand te openen toen we met rugzakken hem hadden laten weten dat we voor de deur stonden te wachten.
Het appartement is licht, groot genoeg voor 2 personen met een balkonnetje waar de zon ‘s middags schijnt. Alles is aanwezig wat je nodig hebt. Het is rustig al hoor je wel geluiden uit de binnenplaats maar dat hoort bij een wereldstad. De buurt is erg gezellig en volop keuze aan restaurantjes, cafeetjes en winkeltjes. De Lidl is op loopafstand.
Alles van de foto’s klopt met de werkelijkheid. We hebben een heerlijke week gehad en toevallig waren de weergoden ons gunstig gezind.
très bel appartement

We had a wonderful stay at Wibke’s place. It was really nice to spend our mornings reading and drinking coffee on the balcony. Everything was rather close to the apartment and we enjoyed walking everywhere. Wibke was super friendly and kind to us 😊
This place is great I loved the view, nice clean and spacious! Would definitely stay again!

We had a nice stay in this apartment, which is comfortably located. The street is busy, but the apartment is located at the back so the street noise only penetrates a little bit. In the nights the
courtyard can be a bit noisy at times.
While it is indicated in the add that towels are provided, the default amount provided is not really enough. One can ask for clean towels and these are then provided though. The kitchen is rather small (one can sit there with max 2-3 people), and it is a bit difficult to clean the dishes because there is not much space. Most kitchen furniture is present but some things that everyone needs for cooking are not there. Some small repairs are needed in the apartment, and it was not super-clean on arrival. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und sehr schön eingerichtet. Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und mir hat es an nichts gefehlt. Nur manchmal war es etwas schwierig einen Parkplatz zu finden. Trotzdem kann ich sie nur weiterempfehlen.
Nice, clean apartment in a good location close to the Ubahn and walking distance to many interesting Berlin sights.

En general, la estancia fué aceptable. Estuve 10 días y la mayor parte del tiempo lo pasé fuera.

Me colocaron un apartamento ridículo respecto al resto. La plancha de la ropa desapareció el segundo día.
A tener en cuenta la amabilidad del dueño y su rapidez en contestar.
Daniel è stato molto accogliente e gentile anche nelle indicazioni! Zona super centrale e alloggio nel complesso veramente ottimo!

Beyond my expectations, it was perfect for my stay working for a week alone in Berlin. I felt safe there in a family friendly neighbourhood...Petra was a great host, there if I needed help but otherwise discreet. I loved it!

We felt very welcome at Annas place! They were extremely nice and welcoming when we checked in, and gave us some recommendations for the neighbourhood! The quality of the place was not luxery, fx the kitchen was a bit smelly (which probaly was caused by the other people staying there) and the toilet got clogged one morning! It was a bit kaos because the day it got clogged it started to run on too the floor, but we wrote to Anna, and she responded so quickly and came and cleaned it all up very throughly! All in al it was a pleasant stay at Anna!:):)

Das Apartment ist perfekt! Es ist sehr sauber und sehr gut ausgestattet. Auch super für Kinder, mit Babybett, Kinderstuhl und etwas Spielzeug in der Wohnung. Die Nachbarschaft hat uns sehr gut gefallen, sie ist sehr kinderfreundlich und es hat viele kleine und nette Restaurants. Michele war immer sehr freundlich und super erreichbar. Er hat zuvorkommend nachgefragt, ob alles i  Ordnung ist.

Myself and six friends stayed here and it was very comfortable. Everything was spotless. The beds were all very comfortable. Communication with the host was excellent. Quick and helpful responses. Only thing I feel that should be noted is that the hot water tank for the shower is small. We had a large group so we had to take some really fast showers. I would definitely stay here again!
everything was good

System was so great. After complete the check-in(they send you a link) you get a pin for room and enterance door. All transport lines were close. So clean and you can find little surprise in the fridge.

I really liked the place! Room was very clean and Anne is friendly and helpful. Location is in calm neighborhood, next to it is a park, market, public transportation. :) all good!

Nice and comfortable apartment, very quiet! Benjamin is very welcoming and provides good addresses.

Die Lage der Wohnung ist einfach top man hat direkt vor der Türe die Tram und viele Restaurants da die Wohnung aber im Hinterhaus liegt kann man nachts mit geöffneten Fenstern schlafen und hat seine Ruhe. Нас было 3 подруги в апартаментах. Было чисто и уютно. Полы с подогревом и было очень тепло. Кофе и чай есть в номере, посудомойка. В доме есть лифт.

Mieszkanie i pokój bardzo czyste. Kontakt z gospodarzem wzorowy.
I stayed with Joe for 2 nights and everything was perfectly fine! :) nice and easygoing host, bright room with balcony, very beautiful area in Kreuzberg. I would stay here again!
Super. Wäre gerne länger da geblieben
Comfortable room in a central place.
Un appartement idéalement situé, avec un accès facile et un très remarquable effort pour bien nous recevoir. Merci Elisa pour ces bons moments

Expérience exceptionnelle ! Nous avons passé un week-end de trois jours à Berlin en groupe de 10 adultes. Disposer de trois jeux de clés a grandement facilité notre séjour. Le logement, spacieux, propre et idéalement situé, est à proximité du métro, du célèbre döner “Rüyam” ainsi que de nombreux commerces, bars et brunchs. La communication avec Werner a été excellente. Un grand merci pour la flexibilité concernant le check-in anticipé et le check-out tardif. Nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir !
Anatol was very nice and helpful. The flat location is easy to get to attractions and has supermarket around as well. Highly recommended!
Thuy is very cosy and friendly owner. The room is very clean and nice. House is very useful and very comfertable. Thank you for everything 😊

Lovely lady checked the 3 of us in with helpful instructions on where things were. She was available for questions whenever required and the room was spectacular. Everything was kept clean and stocked with crockery, cutlery and other household items. Plenty of space for luggage, shoes and to sleep. The room was as described and as in the pictures. If I was to go again to Berlin, I will surely stay here again! Thank you for a wonderful time!

Unser Aufenthalt bei Thekla war wunderbar. Die Wohnung ist liebevoll und durchdacht eingerichtet, sie hatte alles was wir brauchten. Die Lage ist nah an an allen Sehenswürdigkeiten und gleichzeitig nah an der Natur. Thekla ist eine sehr aufmerksame Gastgeberin. Sehr zu empfehlen!
Apartment was beautiful and equipped with everything I needed!. Ramfis was very helpful and the location was amazing.
La hospitalidad de Judith inmejorable. El alojamiento muy limpio y con todo lo necesario. La única pega que esta algo alejado del centro pero con buena comunicación

our train came in very late but Ella was still so accommodating and got us in with no hassle! she is such a sweet host and offered us great tips on public transport, restaurants, and sightseeing. location is perfect - plenty of restaurants and shops within walking distance, and only a short trip to central berlin. highly recommend!

Ruth's apartment is excellent, the location is great with lots of wonderful cafes and restaurants close by. The kitchen was perfectly equipped for us since we had to cook a lot for our baby. Communication with Ruth and Leda went very smoothly and I can warmly recommend the apartment to everyone!

Nonostante fossimo arrivati con largo anticipo ci è stata subito data la chiave della camera 😊
Stanza bella, luminosa e pulita!
Ottima posizione, ben servita da pullman e da metropolitana!

Complimenti ancora per la professionalità!
The perfect AirBnb experience! Best area in Berlin, clean and lovely apartment and nice hosts. Thank you again!
Appartamento molto luminoso al quarto piano. Arredamento nuovo e moderno. Ampi spazi. Bella vista sulla torre della televisione dal balcone. Zona tranquilla vicina ai mezzi pubblici.

Doerthe was a great host, she met us on time as agreed. The apartment was lovely and clean and in a fantastic location. The four poster bed was extremely comfortable! The apartment was very close to two underground stations. There were some lovely restaurants and bars very close by. I would certainly recommend to all my friends visiting Berlin.
Alles bestens.

Von Anfang an hat alles reibungslos funktioniert. Ich habe immer schnell eine Antwort auf meine Fragen bekommen und der Check in lief unkompliziert. Die Gastgeber haben mich gut über die Umgebung informiert. Das Zimmer war sehr schön und sauber. Die Betten sehr bequem. Ich würde wieder bei Ute ein Zimmer buchen.
Im gesamten Ergebnis war ich zufrieden.
Vielen lieben Dank für die Gastfreundschaft.
eine neu uns stylish eingerichtete, empfehlenswerte Unterkunft.

Die Wohnung ist klein aber sehr schön. Mit der U-Bahn ist man in 10 Minuten am Alexanderplatz und auch sonst gut mit den meisten Stadtteilen verbunden. Check-in und Check-out verlief reibungslos und alles war ganz einfach. Ich würde definitv wieder dort wohnen.

Overall it was a fine place, but the area didn’t have much to it, and it was quite empty. The large price is not worth it with it being 800 for 2 nights. I believe you can get better locations and places for a lot cheaper if you look around. I recommend being in West Berlin or more near the nightlife area to the east.

Wir fanden bei Christian eine supersaubere,perfekt eingerichtete Ferienwohnung in ruhiger Lage. Der gesamte Aufenthalt war vollkommen unkompliziert,die Gastgeber sehr hilfsbereit und aufmerksam, irgendwie so, als kannte man sich. ich habe nur eine Nacht in der Unterkunft verbracht, wäre aber gerne noch länger geblieben. Ich habe mich willkommen und gut umsorgt gefühlt. Andreas, seine Tochter und auch seine Partnerin waren sehr freundlich und offen mir gegenüber. ich würde auf jeden Fall wieder kommen!

Già all'arrivo abbiamo avuto difficoltà a prendere le chiavi, perché le indicazioni non erano precise. L'appartamento è diviso con il proprietario, non c'è bagno privato e neanche chiave in camera.  La cucina di uso comune ha le stoviglie poco pulite, per essere buoni ...il letto è ad una piazza e mezza e da un lato sta attaccato al muro. Non c'è un posto da mettere un vestito appeso. Non c'è TV aria condizionata. L'unica cosa positiva da dire sarebbe la posizione, vicino alla metro.
Henrik was very helpful with directions from the airport and responsive, if I needed anything. The place was spotless and I had a great time there. Very nice for a short stay.
we had a good time in Berlin

Unser erster Eindruck von der Wohnung war sehr gut und als wir dann den ersten Abend dort verbracht haben, waren wir begeistert! Schöne Wohnung, super Lage, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel in der Nähe. Einkauf auch. Nette Restaurants dazu überall. Wohnung liegt ruhig, sehr angenehm. Sauber, freundlich. Das separate Schlafzimmer ist äußerst angenehm gewesen. Alles sauber. Kommunikation schnell und zuverlässig. Ohne Probleme. Alles bestens.

Wir haben uns während unseres Aufenthalts sehr wohl und gut aufgehoben gefühlt. Sabine und ihr Mann waren super nett, und das Haus sehr sauber. Höchste Empfehlung!

Omkar's apartment is located in a quiet residential area. It offers convenience with nearby amenities and easy U-Bahn access. For car-sharing there are usually many parked around the neighbourhood. To mention some peculiarities: The entrance is very unconventional; you don't access through the building's main door but through a sort of ancillary entrance that initially looks like heading to a cellar. In the night is not well-lit and feels a bit eerie. The apartment access is through the kitchen. The shower and the toilet are in different rooms, which I found a bit unusual. As mentioned in the description, the apartment connects to the yoga studio through a door. What is not mentioned is that this door is sort of the emergency exit of the studio, thus it needs to be open all the time.

I stayed at Martin's cabin for a couple of days to escape the city heat. The cabin is as advertised, really cozy and with a nice yard to chill under the trees. It has everything you need, and it is not even 5 min walk to the beautiful beach at the lake. Ideal for an early morning or late evening swim (if you want to avoid the crowds). There are also several other swimming spots and trails for hiking or biking. Martin is very nice, he even stopped by to see if everything was ok. Overall I highly recommend it if you wanna spend a few days in the forest/lake away from the city noise.  I will be coming back!
I had a very nice stay and would come again when visiting Berlin:)

Great place, in a really good area.

we have been informed he will correct this issue.

We had a great weekend at Andreas' appartement. It has a great location near Osloer Strasse U-bahn which is great to visit the center of Berlin. We really liked the place. Communication was easy and the place and location very good.

Ich habe Daniele nur kurz beim einchecken gesehen. Er war sehr freundlich und alles hat unkompliziert geklappt! Er war über AirBnb jederzeit erreichbar.

A great place to stay in the heart of Berlin - our room was clean, bed was really comfortable and we loved the modern touches such as the dynamic lighting. It was easy enough to check in following the links and steps. Really good value for the price! Highly recommend for your stay in Berlin.

We zijn super tevreden. De host reageerde meteen als we vragen hadden en was heel vriendelijk. Verder was alles heel schoon en was onze kamer heel comfortabel.

I’d really recommend you stayed at Katja’s if you want to get to know the city with your couple and feel really safe but near to public transportation (tram and metro).
A really nice cozy apartment close to the city centre, very kind and helpful host :)

My parents, baby and I used this as a base for our exploration of Berlin over 3 nights. Overall our stay was good, the location allowed for multiple public transport options and the kitchen/bathroom had everything you'd expect, as well as a few bits and bobs left over from previous tenants (particularly useful in terms of toiletries if you can't bring your own!).
My only complaint is with the quality of the bed/s. The main bed mattress is very soft and squeaky (a problem in a lot of airbnbs) and the sofa bed has a head incline on it which made sleeping rather awkward, and I woke up with a sore neck every morning. The duvets and blankets were all lovely so it's really only the sleep surfaces which are at fault here. Unless they were changed we probably wouldn't stay here again. As with (almost)all German properties, they use the giant soft square pillows with no neck support so bring your own if that's important to you!

We kwamen met de auto en hebben tijdens ons verblijf gebruik gemaakt van de tram en metro. Dit was heel goed beloopbaar. Flora is een vriendelijke ruimhartige host. Alles was goed voor elkaar.

Logement très agréable, calme, avec terrasses et vue sur le parc. Prestations conforment à la description du logement. Les 5 étages à pied se font facilement ^^ À 5min d'une station de métro sur le ring donc très bien situé. Arne est très réactif dès qu'on lui écrit, la réponse est rapide. Si je reviens un jour à Berlin, je pense y revenir et je le conseille fortement.
Top Unterkunft in top Lage.

Tom was really quick to respond and provided all the information we could need. Was a very easy trip to plan. Was about 20 mins from everywhere we wanted to go. Area is very quiet and felt safe too. Rooms were really nice and airy. Great host and listing!
Was a great host with a really good personality, with a great place to stay the night

Fantastic spot on the best street in Kreuzberg. Close to the U-Bahn and the canal. Just perfect. The apartment itself is pristine. First floor, easy in/out. Highly recommend this good deal to anyone looking to get to know this amazing neighborhood better.
lovely flat with amazing views

The place is absolutely perfect : the location is great, walking distance from multiple markets and restaurants; the design of the apartment is cool and fresh and cozy, you had everything you needed. There is nothing i disliked and i would definetely choose it again for my next trip to Berlin.
Sehr schöne Wohnung mit top Lage im Crelle-Kiez in Schöneberg. Hat alles was es braucht, für einen gediegenen Aufenthalt in Berlin.
Sandra es sencilla, amable y colaboradora. Su apartamento es bonito, organizado y limpio. Fue una buena estadía.

We have just finished a wonderful week in Berlin, in no small part because we stayed here. The apartment is strategically located next to the U-2 station, which can whisk you to the sights of the city. Also, there are numerous restaurants and a great grocery store just a short walk away. The apartment itself is large, well-equipped and maintained, and has everything you need. The apartment is located in a very nice, fashionable building, with a wonderful garden and top notch security. It was a highlight of every day to make a cup of coffee, sit on the terrace, and enjoy the carillon bells of the nearby church. Great communication and fabulous place!

Todo bien, muy ordenado, la cocina equipada, lavandería activa (me cobraron 5 euros por lavar algunas prendas) ubicación no tan céntrica, está a 20 minutos en bus del centro de la ciudad. es justa el pago que se realiza. satisfecho!
Me recebeu muito bem

Great place, just one U-Bahn Station from Alexanderplatz, or a few hundred meters walk. Outstanding view from window, everything like described. I even had a Netflix (not in airbnb description ), so more than I hoped for.
Check in was flawless, and easy to follow, and Ivos was just great - responsible,respondable, and overall great guy. Highly recommended Thanks Ivos, I hope I visit you again.
Lovely quiet poison and ideally placed for connections to the City. Bed was super comfortable and everything easy to find on the linked guest information. Many Thanks Benjamin great place!
Sehr guter und netter Gastgeber. Die Wohnung und Lage ist Top. Kann man nichts falsch machen.

Place was exactly as advertised. Even more spacious than apparent from the photos. Felt even a bit too big for 2 people!
Super clean and stylish decor but still felt like a (fancy) home and not a hotel.
Very convenient location in the coolest area of the city. Nearest subway half a block away and two other lines less than 10 minutes away.
Apartment has high ceilings and is on the 4th floor so expect lots of climbing (8 flights of stairs)!
The shower was very nice and worked well. It can get a bit hot in the summer and there was no A/C, but a modern floor fan was provided. There are windows on both sides of the apartment so it was easy to air out and we didn't need the fan even with day temperatures around 30 °C.
Communication with host was easy, prompt and informative. Host was very flexible with check in and was at the apartment early to meet us, and let us check out ourselves.
Comfortable and well equipped flat. Nearby metro stations, restaurants nearby. We enjoyed our stay.

FUBIS에서 하는 여름학교때문에 집을 찾고 있었는데 학교에서 도보 10분거리라서 Carola집을 골랐습니다. Carola랑 올리는 친절했습니다.
집은 아기자기하게 꾸며져있고 방 인테리어도 예뻤습니다.

숙소에서 한 30분걷거나 버스타고 10분정도 가면 큰 Reve슈퍼가 있는데 24시까지 해서 편리했습니다.
Clean and nice place with a responsive host: all you can ask for in a good AirBnB stay! The place is really nicely located and helped us have a great time in Berlin!
Sonja’s place located at very convenient area which is a lot to explore about, walkable to the public transport and quiet at the same time. Overall it’s a great stay in Berlin!

I decided to stay here since it is close to the airport! Also just a 30 minute car ride from downtown Berlin. Perfect location, and very lovely hosts. They greeted us at the door and recommended restaurants in the area. Very flexible check out time as well. Super satisfied with this Airbnb. again, lovely hosts.

Communication was great, I ran into a little hiccup with the reservation (my fault), and the host managed to sort out the problem in no time.
Apartment super clean. Connections to transportation around the corner. Many possibilities for food, groceries, restaurants and breakfast around. Safe area for families.
Wer keine Katzenallergie hat für den ist es perfekt. Super freundlich und sehr sauberes Zimmer mit eigenem Bad. Ich hatte gutes erwartet aber war trotzdem positiv überrascht!

Nice apartment, the fact that there is an attached bathroom to each room is great.
the location is quiet close to the great restaurants of Kant strassa. Public transportation is not far. However, if you wish to be close to Berlin's main attractions this is not the best place.
The furniture and amenities were at a basic level, the soap and shampoo are of a very basic quality, filled in a dispenser and there was only soap or only one dispenser in each shower (???), we bought our own to use.
The apartment has access to a common nice yard. It's on the street level and the access is right from the street using a glass door, you can hear every step somone makes out there!
There is one TV on the living room but it has only German channels and no access to anything else.
The apartment is managed remotely, the access was with a code, we didn't see the host, however the host was very responsive and also allowed us an early check in which was very helpful and appreciated.

Prima appartement met 5 zeer ruime slaapkamers.
Communicatie met Jan via app ging eenvoudig.
Matthew’s miniloft was literally perfect for us! Highly walkable, super clean and nice space. Highly recommend!!

I only had a brief one night stay at Mike’s place, but it was perfect. Clean, had everything I needed (and more) and with Mike being a friendly and accommodating host, with clear self-check in instructions, I can highly recommend this place for a short (or even longer) stay.

We loved our stay at Toni’s apartment! The apartment is on the ground floor in a peaceful and well located neighborhood (it’s near the U-Bahn and some great restaurants that Toni kindly recommended). It was also well equipped for our weeklong stay. One window has to stay open on top of the door, but there is good heating so we were not cold, and the neighborhood is peaceful, so we never had trouble sleeping. Thanks very much to Toni! We would happily stay here again.
Very kind guy. His place is perfect!
Great location - right in amongst it - 5 mins walk to S7 - Ubahn just around corner. Clean tidy room with AC! perfect!
Great stay and very friendly reception. Already planning my next visit😁.

This is a great place to stay when visiting Berlin. The apartment is clean, spacious and exactly as described. The location is excellent, with some great places to eat within easy walking distance. It is only a few minutes walk from the apartment to the tram and U-bahn which makes this a great base for getting around Berlin quickly and easily.

We were 9 girls for the Bachelorette Party of my sister and we stayed in Berlin for one night. The maisonette was as described super nice and with good space.
Alex was really responsive and the exchange of keys went well.
Definitely would recommend it :-)

Very good location, near public transportation and many shops/supermarkets/cafés
The places was clean and comfortable.

It was an amazing stay in a beautiful, quite part of Berlin. Everything is easily reachable by public transport and Hani is great and welcoming (sadly I didn't get to meet Soli who I am sure is equally amazing). Would absolutely recommend!

Everything was great... The place was exactly like the pictures. The neighborhood was really quite with a michelin starred restaurant-bakery-cafe just outside and a metro station in a five minute walk. Anna was very helpful and friendly... Berlin is a great place to be and Anna is the right choice... Thank you for evething!!! CU soon

Alexander’s place is fantastic! The location is very good, easily accessible by public transportation and close to all tourist attractions. Within walking distance you can reach the Berlin Wall. There are many small cafes in the neighborhood and Alexander’s place is located in a quiet backyard. Alexander has a good taste in interior design, and hangs many interesting photos taken by himself on the wall, making the space very unique and unforgettable. Overall our experience is perfect! The only thing that I would suggest is having a hairdryer or making it more accessible (perhaps there is one somewhere in the house already, but I didn’t want to interrupt the host late at night). Thank you very much for having us!
הדירה נהדרת, נקייה, מרווחת והכי חשוב במיקום נהדר על תחנת המטרו. סוון היה אדיב וסבלני לכל שאלה ובקשה. מומלץ בחום!
Awesome experience!  The flat is so well designed!!! Dream loft with a really good price! We are definitely coming back!!!
We were very happy with the place. Helpful instructions and clear communication made check in easy, good location, everything was clean and neat inside.

Ich kann dieses Airbnb nur weiterempfehlen. Die Lage ist top - sehr zentral gelegen und man erreicht den Potsdamer Platz in wenigen Minuten Fussmarsch. Die Unterkunft war sauber und grosszügig. Perfekt für einen Städetrip mit Freunden. Martin war ein super Gastgeber und hat uns vorab bereits mit allen Infos zur Wohnung und Anfahrt versorgt. Es gibt sogar Videos die zeigen wo man den Eingang und die Schlüsselbox findet . Dies finde ich sehr professionell gelöst. Wir kommen gerne wieder :-)
Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Berlin und Franks Apartment. Super ruhig, mit einem Parkplatz vor der Türe!
Alojamiento correcto y en una zona tranquila.

Lovely and stylish appartment which accommodated our need very well as family with two teenagers. Spacious and comfortable with a well decked out kitchen. Interesting area with a good variety of restaurants and a great market twice a week with lots of fresh fruit and veg and all very cheap. Good access to U ban and S ban stations near by. Overall a great stay- we’ll be back to Berlin!
Stylische und gemütliche Unterkunft genauso wie sehr nette Gastgeber, die uns sehr willkommen fühlen ließen. Genau wie beschriebe und noch besser.
Das Appartemend von Stèphanie ist blitzsauber, es ist mit sehr viel Liebe eingerichtet und die Dusche ist der absolute hammer! Vielen Dank für den tollen Aufenthalt. :-)

Alles super unkompliziert. Lage schön und ruhig. Bushaltestelle in der Nähe. Bäder und Gemeinschaftsräume sauber, Schlafzimmer staubig und der Boden war ungekehrt, aber auch nicht tragisch. Alles in allem guter Aufenthalt!

It was a pleasure staying at Can's place, you arrive at the accommodation with simple instructions, the surroundings are quiet, the place is clean and tidy with comfortable space, the area is well situated, which is less than 5 minutes walk to the U-Bahn Station "Neu Westend" and also has bus station which brings you to the city center, there are coffee shops, restaurants as well as Edeka within the same walking distance.
The experience was brilliant and we enjoyed our stay in Berlin.
I will definitely recommend Can's Airbnb and his efforts to make the accommodation comfortable, reasonable and affordable.
Really cute furnished appartement in a trendy neighbourhood.
Excelente ubicación ! Todo super impecable
Mooi en schoon appartement op een geweldige locatie in Berlijn. Ideaal voor een stedentrip met het gezin.

The AI chat is not working well and can be frustrating.

Wilkens space was comfortable and located in a beautiful and accessible part of the city!

The flat was very clean and the host was always understanding. Communication was quick and efficient, and they were always helpful.

Appartement magnifiquement situé. Proche metro, commerces et podzdammer platz. Dans un immeuble en briques rouges, calme absolu. Tres propre et tres bien equipé. Quartier residenciel. Je le recommande vivement!

Vi havde et rigtig fint ophold hos Thomas. Der var meget rent i lejligheden, og det var nemt at kommunikere med Thomas. Sovesofaen larmer meget, når man bevæger sig i den, hvilket var ærgerligt, fordi hele gruppen vågnede af det. Ellers var alt, som det skulle være.

perfect location in the heart of friedrichshain, Apostolos is delightful and helpful. The appartement is just as expected, clean, spacious, and has everything you need to feel like home. Thumbs up for the bed and pillows, beyond comfort. Definitely recommended.
Very calm place to live:)
Lovely house. Close to bus stops to head either into the centre or to local bars and restaurants

Clean place, located in a peaceful neighbourhood 10min walk from the nearest train station. Only bad thing was we were not informed about the €35 tourist tax until check in as it was not stated in the booking.
Großes sauberes Zimmer, Gastgeber freundlich und entspannt, obwohl wir bloß zur Ankunft und zur Abfahrt Kontakt hatten, alles in allem empfehlenswert.

Fantastic flat !! Beautiful furniture, good lighting and excellent location.

Very clean, pretty, and comfortable! Dave was very helpful and all the directions/communication was clear. There’s a river nearby that’s great for walks. Good vietnamese food too!!
Great quality and place for the price. Nearby both U-bahn and Bahnhof. Personally I think it was worth it.
Great location and large room for the price.

Sehr schöne Unterkunft und tolle Gastgeber.
Haben den Spa Bereich genossen und hätten gerne beruflich mehr in Berlin zu tun gehabt um länger bleiben zu können.

ich habe mich wohl gefühlt, gerne wieder.

Muy lindo y cómodo  departamento

We absolutely loved this Airbnb and felt very comfortable there. It was really quiet even though the house is located in the middle of Kreuzberg.

An amazing place such a great time and would definitely come back again!
Cleanliness is perfect. Transportation is accessible. Check-in time is very flexible.
A beautiful apartment with large balcony in great location. Very cool 😎

Nice bed and clean room.

U can make reservation without any doubt. We could not have any kind of problem when we were staying. Cleanliness, fast check-in, details in the room made us very pleasant.

I had a great stay at Numa! It was perfect for a solo traveler, the space may be on the smaller side, but it’s very well thought out and has everything you need.
The work desk was super convenient, and the small kitchenette (with fridge, stove top, microwave, and sink) made it easy to feel at home.
The area itself is really nice, with plenty of spots nearby to explore, grab food, or just enjoy a walk. Overall, it was exactly what I was looking for and I’d definitely stay here again!
Great place! Clean and accurately described, easily accessible by U and S bahn. Welcome treats were a super nice touch! Would stay with them again.
Wir hatten ein paar schöne Tage in der Unterkunft. Die Wohnung ist super schön und gut gelegen mit mehreren Cafés, Bars und Restaurants im direkten Umkreis.

Problemfreier self-checkin, sehr schnelle Reaktion bei Nachrichten - auch Abends.
Super Service.
The flat was great :)

The place is amazing - even better than in the pictures. You have everything you need for a stay - all necessary things in the kitchen to cook, coffee capsules, shower gel in the bathroom. The bed was perfect, very comfortable. And also the neighborhood is great, only 10 mins by tram to Alexandarplatz. I strongly recommend this place to everyone!
Perfect stay for when coming to Berlin for work. Right next to the s-Bahn, making it so easy to get anywhere in Berlin. Everything was great!
ottima esperienza, appartamento accogliente e ben tenuto

I have a great experience with my 7 nights stay in Ben's apartment. He was very friendly and fast to reply. He arranged for a cleaning after previous guest left and let me do early checking even before noon. This apartment located very close to transports and numbers of restaurants also a few big supermarkets in less than 5 min walk for groceries shopping. with A train from airport to Berlin central, bus 245 stop is just 5 min walk to Ben's house. even it is in ground floor and beside a road but very quite and safe place. Good air circulation and enough facilities for simple cooking. the apartment is nicer than what photos are showing. Overall,very pleasant experience
cozy apartment in a nice neighborhood.

I was extremely pleased to stay with my son at Cornelius’ condo. The host couldn’t have been more helpful, and the place was impressively clean, quiet, and very practical. It’s close proximity to transit and many cozy restaurants and taverns made for a perfect stay. I highly recommend the apartment and the neighborhood. I can’t wait to come back!

Unser Aufenthalt bei Alex war wunderbar! Ein sehr zuvorkommender Gastgeber und eine grandiose Stadt. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt in seiner Wohnung voller Charm.

The apartment was generally as described—clean and functional, with all the basics you need. The location was convenient, and check-in was smooth. Overall it was a comfortable stay and good value for the price.
Sarah was very nice and welcoming, the apartment was clean and exactly like  in pictures..

Durch die zentrale Lage in einem Innenhof sind sowohl eine gute Anbindung, aber auch ein ruhiger und angenehmer Aufenthalt gegeben.
Gabriel hat uns nett und sogar fünf Stunden früher als geplant empfangen und im Loft rumgeführt - dieses machte einen sehr sauberen und wohnlichen Eindruck.
Die Unterkunft liegt wie gesagt sehr zentral, sodass jegliche Bahnstationen wie auch einige Restaurants oder Einkaufsmöglichkeiten innerhalb weniger Minuten erreicht werden können.
Meine Begleitungen und ich haben die fünf Tage in Berlin sehr genossen und würden auch jederzeit gerne wiederkommen.

Es war alles wunderbar wie beschrieben.

Det er en fin stor lejlighed med altan. Alt er godt bortset fra toget der kører forbi hvert 10 minut. Det larmer så meget at man ikke kan tale sammen og man er nødt til at lukke alle vinduer og altandør om natten.

Katerina was quick to reply. There is a bus to the airport a 5 minute walk from her place; meaning there are other buses and thus the ability to catch trains. I came in late (well after dark), and the place was easy to find (including the doorbell). I left while it was dark, felt safe. The bed was comfortable, as well as the blanket and pillow. There is a bed light and a few (European) outlets in the room. The room is small, but very doable for one person. There is also a window, which would be nice for the day. This is a shared bathroom room, and I think there were 3-4 adults sharing it. It was ok; I was there for 6 night hours and the proximity to the bus and airport, which was ideal, but if I was staying for a longer visit (or to tour the area), I might hesitate with this. There is a bench near the door to sit to take off /put on shoes, and the bedroom is a good flight up the stairs. There is also a friendly small dog who is not bothersome.
Très bon accueil. Appartement très agréable et calme dans un quartier vivant. Je recommande vivement

Conor was a great host and had a good spot to stay for some days. Super responsive and easy check in, was able to answer any questions and suggestions. Very laid back and good host, thanks again.

Susanne e Leonardo sono stati super disponibili e amichevoli.
