Die Wohnung ist sehr gemütlich und sauber, hat alles, was man braucht und mehr). In der Nähe U-Bahn, S-Bahnen, Busse, Supermärkte.
Die Gastgeberin Flora ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Hat uns mit Ratschlägen geholfen, welche Verkehrsmittel besser zu benutzen sind.
Uns hat alles sehr gut gefallen, wir würden gerne wiederkommen.
For anyone looking for a neat little room which is sensibly furnished and has a big comfy bed, this is it. Incredibly good value and Heidi is a warm, genuine host. Highly recommended.

Eine sehr niedliche, kleine, gut gelegene Unterkunft mit angenehmer Kommunikation und leichtem Check-In und Check-out!
Leider schimmeln die Wände, was dann doch ein unangenehmes Gefühl hinterlassen hat. Für eine Nacht aber in Ordnung.

Excellent location, walking distance to s-bahn, buses, and taxis. Communication with host was easy and helpful. Well appointed apartment. Walking distance to grocery stores and restaurants. Loved our stay there

We were pretty rattled when we arrived due to the grim look of the door but when we past through the first door we were pleasantly surprised by the spacious courtyard and large apartment. Ralph was very cheerful and gave us some decent assistance with moving and looking around Berlin. The apartment was spacious, good for a large group but it should be known that the apartment is in the basement level of the building and light is some what hard to come by. Location was okay but we were a little disappointed with the surrounding suburb, mind you there is a nearby station that can aid you in your movement around Berlin.
Great location and lovely flat. Definitely worth it!
we had a great stay! Elke was very welcoming and the location nice :)

Flat looks just like in pictures, good location, far away from airport if you arrive late in the evening. Quiet, secure and clean. I was however expecting a minimum of coffee to be available at the property, but this was not provided. The host however has provided filters upon request for the coffee machine.
Appartamento in una posizione fantastica, facile da raggiungere e centralissimo. Moderno e spazioso. Host gentilissimo, ci ha fornito un seggiolone ed un letto per bambini! Top!
The apartment is in a good location near a series of bars and restaurants. Mia was great to deal with.

Wonderful apartment with excelent location nearby underground station.
Many thanks for your hospitality- we will remember about this apartment in case of future trip to Berlin:)
Jeannette was really responsive and helpful, and the place was great!

Eine nette kleine Wohnung mit viel Platz im Schlafzimmer und hervorragender Anbindung. Mohammad ist auch ein sehr freundlicher, toleranter und kommunikativer Herr, welcher alles über die schönsten Plätze Berlins weiß :)
Lovely flat, great hosts!
Verda's place had all the comforts of home and was modern, spacious and bright. We would love to stay again!

We loved staying here. Very convenient and the flat has all the amenities you could need. We didn’t use the balcony much but that was the weather’s fault. Excellent coffee shop downstairs and it’s always nice to be met at at the apartment. Tom and George did a nice job of showing us round.
L'appartement est conforme à sa description, très bien situé, nous y avons passé un séjour agréable, je recommande !
increíble todo nos encanto una excelente hospedadora siempre estuvo al pendiente y nos ayudo mucho, hermoso lugar bien ubicado
Wir hatten eine gute Zeit in Berlin und würden die Unterkunft jederzeit wieder wählen!

Truly a unique space.  It is clearly a very used and appreciated space that is well taken care of. The organization of the art/interior is different then the photos - as expected from a space that is actually used and not cookie cutter always AirBNB space.  But, I would say that the reorg. Makes it better.
Schön und Sauber. Gern wieder.
Schöne Wohnung in lebhafter Gegend von Berlin. Viele Restaurants und Bars in unmittelbarer Umgebung. Straßenbahn-Haltestelle direkt vor der Tür. Check-in war problemlos. Insgesamt ok.
Good place to stay in Berlin. Good location with easy access to public transportation
Too expansive for what you get. 2 bedrooms, but one bedroom is also the living room. kitchen minimally equipped. right next to big street. Nice and helpful hosts.

Andrea’s penthouse is in a perfect location - a few meters away from the U bahn and the tram, close to bio supermarkets and Boxhagenerplatz which has great fresh produce market. The penthouse is very comfortable, with great underfloor heating, amazing bathroom and comfortable leather sofa. We unfortunately had no wifi as the router broke before we arrived but Andreas did his very best to help all the way from Indonesia which we appreciated. The balcony view is amazing and light fills the main room constantly which is beautiful. I would recommend this house to anyone looking for a very comfortable central accomodation in Berlin.
The apartment was great: comfortable and conveniently located. Birte was very helpful and responsive. Easy check in and check out.

Alles war super, ich hatte einen Kurs in der Nähe vom Flughafen gehabt und die Lage war super für mich.
Die Wohnung ist richtig cozy , ruhig und gut ausgestattet.
Bis nächsten mal 😊

Martina & Charlotte's loft apartment was the perfect spot for me as it was centrally located in most spots in Berlin, with easy access to public transportation. I questioned the chili pepper tile design in the bathroom, but it's a choice, and I admire that. All in all, it was a lovely stay. Definitely a great find in a great neighborhood! I'd stay there again!

Martina's apartment is in a great location. Easy walking distance to a lot of the major sights in Berlin. It was plenty of space for 3 people. It was cozy and comfortable. There is a 30 euro city tax that we were told to pay and unaware of, so just be prepared to provide that on arrival.
Incredible place and location, could not recommend it enough!
Danke für die Gastfreundschaft
Vielen Dank für alles. Wir hatten eine gute Zeit in Berlin.

Our stay at Carmen was a very enjoyable experience and beyond our expectations. We especially emphasize the welcome of Carmen, his kindness and his advice. She gave us time to introduce her city and focused on advising us on our centers of interest. The accommodation is very clean, very comfortable mattresses, a small haven close to the center
Nice apartment, good located & fast/friendly communication

I really enjoyed staying at Anca’s place! It had everything I needed for my time in Berlin, the location was great, lots of restaurants and cafes very close. The communication with the host was very easy, and the place was clean. The only downside to this apartment was the smell of cigarettes. It was attempted to cover it up with various scented items in the apartment, but definitely still noticeable.

It was really great to stay at Yvonne and Vincent's place. The room was well decorated and cozy. You can find everything that you need in the room. The location was also good to explore Berlin, especially Mitte and Kreuzberg. You can reach many places with M10 and U8. The best thing that I liked was my host, Yvonne and Vincent. They were super kind. They tried to their best to keep the guest comfortable. Thanks Yvonne and Vincent :). I wish you all the best.
한국어 후기가 없는 것 같아 작성하면 좋을 것 같아 남겨봅니다. 중앙역에서 멀지 않으면서도 베를린의 주요 지역과 잘 연결되는 위치에 있습니다. 방은 1층에 독립적으로 구성되어있어, 매우 지내기 편했습니다. 공간은 사진과 똑같습니다. 호스트 역시 친절하고 최대한 도와주려고 하는 좋은 분들 이세요. 베를린에 오시는 분들께 추천합니다!.
Helga was great from start to finish and the apartment was clean and comfortable!

Anton was great at answering any questions I had online, and once arriving at the stay you’re welcomed. Anna is happy to answer any questions you have, and goes out of her way to get the correct information for you.
The location is great with the U-Bahn (Underground) 20m from you, which has easy access to great locations. You’re also just off Potsdamer Straße which has great shops and restaurants with a REWE (Supermarket) just 2 minutes from the house. I’d really recommend to stay here, this was my first trip alone and I honestly loved the stay.

Very nice place in the center of Berlin.
No issues whatsoever.

Wonderful location. Lots to do, easy to get around, felt very safe and fun. The apartment is so spacious. Everything needed inside the apartment was provided. Arno was helpful and responsive. The only thing was the Airbnb amenities listed laundry, but there was no laundry. But luckily we didn't need it too much. I would very much recommend.

Susanne, Maurice and their family were amazing hosts. They were very helpful and we really enjoyed our stay in there. The house is only a five-minute-walk from a Tram station and it is well connected with all the areas in the city. The place is also extremely clean, organized and you have everything you need in the room, which was actually way bigger than it looked in the photos. The hosts were there at every moment when we needed them. We’ll surely come back, thanks!

Daniel was very friendly and responded to messages quickly. His instructions for contactless check-in were very clear and the space had many amenities, such as table tennis rackets, a projector, etc. Several adapters were provided which were very useful and a sufficient number of pots and pans for cooking. Would definitely recommend this space!

A lovely, clean apartment. Very close (20 minute walk) to Alexanderplatz from where you can find trams or trains to all over the city. We used the 'Hop-on, Hop-off bus tour to give us a good view of the city and then made our own way after that.
The apartment is almost next door to a supermarket and within walking distance of a wide range of restaurants.
Very nice flat with a flexible host.
appartement propre et spacieux, bien équipé et les chambres donnent sur une coure calme.
The apartment is lovely, perfectly located! We enjoyed our stay!
Voll gut, sehr empfehlenswert
Everything goo
highly recommended, Werner is friendly and easygoing!
Artistic Apartment🌱

We really enjoyed staying at Wibke’s place. When she found out her hot water heater was being replaced during our stay, she let us know well in advance, and offered us a large discount among many other options. We are so glad we stayed at Wibkes, even if we have no hot water for a couple days! Her flat is adorable and well equipped as well as comfortable. Wibke is very cool and a great host. Thank you so much
Everything was good, great check in, perfect communication!
Mia was really friendly and the apartment was incredible, fully recommend!
Fin och ljus lägenhet
Susanna was a great host, the area is beautiful and very well connected to the city center by public transport. Would surely book again!

Had a lovely stay whilst visiting a friend in Berlin. Daniel was super helpful from the start, with clear instructions for check in and a big list of recommendations. Whilst the lounge is a studio sort of layout, it's very spacious with a large dining table. Full kitchen facilities and a big shower. A short walk from multiple transport links it was very easy to get around. Would 100% stay again, highly recommend.
Eleni is very kind and nice woman. She was really helpful. flat location is perfect, few hundert meter to metro line and all supermarkets. Flat is a bit small but it is stylish
Gorgeous space!
Alles gut, danke.
Wij hebben erg genoten van Berlijn. De kamer was ontzettend ruim, schoon, netjes en de verhuurders waren gastvrij en vriendelijk. Dit maakte ons verblijf heel aangenaam! Bedankt!

15 Minuten nach Spandau, ruhige Straße mit freie Parkplätze
4 Etagen Haus mit 4 Schlafzimmer und 2 Bäder
Alles in Ordnung

L'appartement est particulièrement charmant et situé dans un quartier agréable à proximité des transports et de nombreux restaurants.
On passé un très bon séjour !
The place was wonderful - peaceful, clean and calm with a great location. Highly recommend :)

Liebevoll eingerichtete Unterkunft mit freundlichem unkompliziertem Gastgeber in guter Lage. Schnelle Anbindung an den ÖPNV und auch Fußläufig sind einige Orte gut zu erreichen. Im Gesamten ein unproblematischer Aufenthalt mit vielen Vorzügen wie Mitbenutzung von Küche und Bad.

I was in Berlin for work + weekend, and Sebastian's place was excellent - great little neighborhood, lovely places to eat nearby, opportunities to walk and run, and a quiet apartment to relax in!
The flat is at the top of the stairs, which is both wonderful (great views, great air) and, shall we say, an opportunity for a little bit of exercise 😂. It never caused me trouble but is worth mentioning!
I had to watch a youtube video to figure out how to operate the stove :). But it was quite easy!

Great place! Right off the train and next to a big supermarket called Edeka. It’s right next to a train station that takes you to Alexanderplatz. The area itself is very relaxing and safe. Everything that’s described is in the place. Great stay! Thank you
Roomy basement apartment to stay in the Kreuzberg area of Berlin. It was a comfortable place where we had a chance to explore the neighborhood and rest of Berlin.
Good location, staff are nice but rooms are a bit small.

Die Unterkunft hat uns super gefallen, es gab wirklich keinen Punkt den wir irgendwie zu beanstanden hatten. Im Gegenteil, Alles war sauber und liebevoll für uns hergerichtet. wir werden wieder gern kommen ☺️

Hannes ist ein sehr netter Gastgeber, der hilfsbereit und sehr freundlich ist.
Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Die Wohnung ist bestens für 4 Personen geeignet und gut ausgestattet.
Der großzügige Balkon lädt zum Sonnen ein, was wir selbst im Februar schon genießen konnten.
Im Sommer kann mir herrlich die warmen Nächte verbringen.
Loved our stay at Leonora’s place in Alt-Treptow. Felt right at home in the neighbourhood.
Great location, very clean and quiet. Would visit again!

Abbiamo Soggiornato da Paulo per un weekend lungo e siamo stati benissimo, l’appartamento è bellissimo e in un ottima posizione!
Paulo e Guido sono molto gentili, simpatici e molto disponibili!
Consiglio a tutti di soggiornare presso il loro alloggio!
The bungalow was great. A private accomodation with plenty space and ammenities, certainly worth the price. The location is only a few minutes walk from tram stops and is peaceful.

Very prompt responses to questions and proactivness in setting up WhatsApp group to correspond with me prior to check-in and check-out is to be commended! 👏
Apartment is exactly how pictures illustrated, which is not often the case with other Airbnb. So Thank You for the honestly.
Location wise, it's close to nearby charming cafe and resturants in the Charlottenburg / Wilmersdorft neighborhood.
좋은 집을 공유해주셔서 감사합니다. 아이들과 가족들이 행복한 시간을 보냈습니다~~^^

was in Berlin only for 2 days. Everything went smoothly. So checkin was easy and there are hosts which will aid you if you are in need for help or have questions. The room was clean and had everything I needed. It's also very quiet. Will consider stayery again!

Beautiful space in an incredible location!  Stéphanie and Tina were very helpful with arranging our check-in and out. We fell in love with Berlin on this trip and hope to return soon. When we do, I would definitely book Stephanie’s place again.
Great location in a ground floor apartment. Grocery store around the corner, many trains and access right into the city 10 minutes away. Nice apartment

The apartment was stylish, spacious and full of natural light. It is positioned in a lovely neighbourhood with surrounding parks and great cafes. Only a short 10 minute walk to the public transport hubs so well connected. Anna was amazing, really friendly with lovely energy. Highly recommend.
Molto comodo l appartamento è molto gentile e disponibile host . Tornerò di sicuro grazie mille
Eine sehr schöne Wohnung und eine super nette Gastgeberin!
Great little modern apartments, very central, staff were helpful.

Fantastischer Ausblick. Absolut ruhige Lage. Und ein freundlicher und zuverlässiger Check- in. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Ulf
Quiet, clean place outside of main tourist area
We had an absolute great time! Absolutly recommend the appartment, especially for small families.

Fin stuelejlighed i roligt område. Tæt på offentlig transport og indkøb. Lille fin park tæt på med legeplads og boldbaner. Vi fandt betalingsparkering på Oderstrasse. Lejligheden var pænt rengjort og redt op ved ankomst.

Alles war unkompliziert und hat super geklappt. Die Leute sind sehr nett und der Hof ist eine Oase in der Großstadt. Die Gegend ist sehr interessant und es gibt kaum Touristen hier, was seinen eigenen Reiz hat. Wir würden eventuell wiederkommen.
Tolle Wohnung in guter erreichbarer Lage mitten in Berlin 👍🏻
Great hosts and a perfect place to stay in Berlin! Loved all the plants in this urban style, clean & comfy apartment! Would definitely recommend! Cheers to fun traveling!

The apartment is fantastic, clean and directly in the centre.
Boian and Olga are such nice and helpful people!
Definitely a recommendation!
Excelente departamento, amplios espacios, cómodo, linda terraza y por sobre todo excelente cocina, tiene absolutamente de todo. Definitivamente volvería a ir.
Thank you Heidi for the gorgeous hosting, the experience was quite nice and felt so comfortable. The place is very accessible and nearby so many restaurants and cafes.
Great space, great outlook and great access to public transport. Next time we are in Berlin we are going straight back to Anton's in Charlottenburg
Casa molto pulita...la stanza è esattamente come si vede in foto,grande,luminosa e pulita...un punto in più per il terrazzino,molto pratico e comodo x i fumatori!

Die Wohnung ist mit allem eingerichtet was man braucht. Der Kontakt und Empfang war sehr nett, hilfsbereit und herzlich. Das Viertel in dem die Wohnung liegt ist super! Es gibt viele gute und günstige Restaurant und Bars. Man kann von dort aus  zu Fuß andere Stadtviertel erkunden, ansonsten ist auch die U-Bahn fußläufig gut zu erreichen.
Great location, close to U-Bahn station which gave access to all major tourist sites and easy travel to/from airport. Apartment was very clean.

L' appartement est neuf, spacieux, confortable et lumineux. Très agréable. Il est parfaitement situé, dans une petite rue calme en face d'un parc, dans un quartier animé et commerçant. A proximité des transports et de la Spree, c'est le point de départ idéal pour découvrir Berlin, même à pied, en bateau ou à vélo... Je reviendrai.
Beskrivningen av boendet var korrekt. Området bra med närhet till det mesta även om det var aningen långt till centralt belägna museer, restauranger etc.
It was a pleasant stay. The place was cozy & quiet. Phoung & Martin were easy to communicate with, very hospitable, flexible and open.
Sehr gute und ruhige Wohnung. Wir kommen immer wieder zurück!
Thanks for the great stay!
Ich hab mich sehr wohl gefühlt und war rundum zufrieden!
Perfect pad for group of friends. Easy access to public transport and plenty of nearby supermarkets and restaurants. Clean & tidy with lots of storage and super comfy beds!

Masuda und Klemens sind wunderbare Hosts.
Fragen werden sehr schnell beantwortet.
Die Wohnung ist wunderschön und hat eine tolle, ruhige Lage.
Mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln kommt man schnell in die Schlossstrasse, zum Ku’damm oder auch nach Berlin Mitte.
Geschäfte sind zu Fuß schnell zu erreichen.

All the week was really comfortable in Klaus’ house. He was really nice, respectful and really trying to help in everything he could as it was my first time living in Berlin. I recommend it really much to everyone. The location is really good, the room really clean and with all the necessary. I definitely recommend it 100%

For some reason, this hotel has decided that the concept of "keys" or even "keycards" is outdated, so they decided to replace these with an app to unlock your door. I was dreading the moment this would go wrong, and it finally did on my last day of staying there. Just tried to use the app and it was all greyed out even though everything else was in order.
Now, for such a hip place, it should come as no surprise that the concept of a "receptionist" is also a bit old-fashioned, so I could do nothing about it - I just waited at the lounge and messaged them. The only problem was that no one was replying as the minutes were passing, 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 45 minutes - still locked out of my room and kinda needing to use the loo by now.
By pure chance, a hotel employee appeared out of nowhere (there's no office or anywhere I could find them) & she helped me get in & gave me a keycard. I don't know how long I would have waited otherwise - my message got an (unhelpful) reply after an hour.
Ganz tolle Unterkunft, alles neu und super sauber. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Great value, good location and easy communication with the host. Thank you!

The Airbnb is clean and in a great location. Martin was always quick to respond and even let my cousin check in ahead of the official check in time. We would recommend this Airbnb to others.
Cheers!
great location (5 mins walk from train station), quiet neighborhood. Clear and prompt response from the host.

La habitación por dentro es limpia y espaciosa, ubicada no tan lejos del centro en transporte público. Tiene varios bares y negocios cerca.
El wifi no nos funcionó y tuvimos problemas para entrar al alojamiento la última noche, la cerradura digital estaba dañada y otro huésped se había llevado la llave de emergencia, estuvimos más de 30 minutos fuera del alojamiento esperando que llegara el huésped con la llave para entrar.
Unsere Aufenthalt bei Erik war perfekt: schöne Wohnung, mit einem sehr hilfsbereiten Empfang von Erik. Vielen Dank noch!
Die Gastgeberin ist sehr freundlich. Es hat uns an nichts gefehlt. Die Unterkunft ist wie beschrieben und fußläufig zum kleinen Müggelsee. Wir empfehlen es uneingeschränkt weiter! 👍
Great place, great host, wonderful location. Every moment we spent in his place, felt like home. Hope to be back soon and enjoy this amazing studio once more ❤️🔥🎉
Everything was great! The flat is very specious and has impressive interior design. The location is ideal for a weekend Berlin visit. Thank you for having us, Jenn and Anja.

Die Wohnung liegt verkehrstechnisch super. Gegenüber gibt es ein tolles Frühstück. Abends kann man im benachbarten Lokal einen Absacker trinken.
Die Einrichtung ist modern und sehr geschmackvoll. Das Bad ist totschick. Die Schlafzimmer sind sehr eng. Für eine 4-köpfige Familie ist die Wohnung genau richtig. Für sehr gut befreundete Paare auch.

Optimale Unterkunft für einen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Wir hatten keinerlei Probleme. Die Wohung war sehr sauber und ordentlich, Check-in / -Out lief unkompliziert ab. Die Lage ist auch gut, eine S-Bahn Station ist gleich in der Nähe.
Man muss damit klar kommen, dass das Bad mit den anderen Gästen geteilt werden muss, aber das stellte für uns kein Problem dar.

The apartment was perfect for a two week stay.  A&H we’re excellent hosts and very responsive to any questions, concerns.  Their recommendation list was great.  The location is in a great location for exploring many exceptional restaurants, coffee shops, bakeries, bookstores.  A crosstown bus stops at the end of the street and the Ubahn (metro) is a few blocks walk.  At the end of a day visiting the tourist sites of Berlin, we were so happy to return to the neighborhood which has a special charm .  The apartment building is set back and the apartment overlooks a little garden and is very quiet.  The kitchen was well equipped and there are three grocery stores a couple blocks away.

The apartment looks very nice, just like in the pictures, and is well located. Check-in was smooth. However, it's clear when opening some drawers in the kitchen for example that the cutlery, dishes, pans, etc. are not really clean, we never used any of them as we didn't feel comfortable doing so.

Einfach toll!
Top Lage, Zentral und dennoch ruhig.
Alles lief komplikationslos und es war sehr sauber.
Gerne empfehlen wir Franziska weiter!

The studio is in a great location in Berlin: very, very close to the center of things to see, such as museum island, but also near a couple good grocery stores and a street full of restaurants. A few minutes walk to a subway stop. The apartment is clean, with a large and complete kitchen and bathroom, and is pretty spacious for a studio. The downside in the summer is that, since one wall is entirely windows, it gets very hot on sunny days. Also, there wasn't any storage space, such as a dresser or hangers, where we could put our things, so we had to use tabletops or the floor.
Still, it's a great place in an excellent location, and Boris is really on top of answering questions, and provided us with a detailed guide to using everything in the studio (like the washing machine-- in Europe that can sometimes be tricky).
The flat is clean and quiet and the neighborhood is very safe and centrally located. One thing to warn if you need to get the key from the doorman is that the doorman could only speak German.
This place is in a perfect area if you want good nightlife and amazing food!
Vi nød virkelig et par dage i Minas lejlighed. Perfekt kommunikation og alt spillede bare. Vi vil klart komme igen!
Very nice room in a very nice residential area. I was in a short term need to find a place to stay in Berlin and Ayako confirmed quickly. Thanks a lot.
Vi havde nogle dejlige dage i julen. Karens bolig var perfekt til vores lille familie. Dejligt roligt kvarter - dog tæt på det hele. Skønt med privat p plads :-)
Wonderful apartment in a great neighbourhood! We loved our stay here and everything about renting the place went very smoothly! Would definitly stay here again next time I visit Berlin.

Der online Check- in war sehr einfach und sehr gut zu verstehen, man kann sogar per whats app schreiben, wenn man fragen hat und es wird sofort beantwortet.
Das Hotel hat leider kein Parkplatz aber da wird auch geholfen und 300M entfernte gibt es ein Parkhaus für 17€ für 24 std, was für Berlin sehr gut ist.
Die Lage vom Hotel ist perfekt, 100-200 Meter zur U-Bahn, wo man mit der U6 sehr leicht fast überall hinkommt ohne umzusteigen.
In der nähe vom Hotel sind viele Restaurants und Bars, das man auch nicht so weit weg muss, um was zu essen.
Die Zimmer waren sehr sauber, Bad war sehr gut
Das Bett war sehr sehr bequem zum schlafen.
Vielen Dank für alles und wenn wir das nächste mal in Berlin sind, kommen wir sehr sehr gerne wieder.
Very cosy clean quiet small apartment - great for overnight in Berlin

everything from the arrival till the end was great.
the apartment is big and cozy with lots of arty details. the location is wonderful and you can go walking to any point of interest or either rent a bike which Berlin has plenty.
also, it is close to FriedrichStrasse Station, which helps a lot when going to the airport.
definitely recommend it and will go back on our next trip to Berlin!
Normal hotel, everything was good. Clean and well designed rooms.
The place is really nice, near supermarkets as well as some restaurants. The Westend S bahn station is a few minutes away on foot.   Very comfortable.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt, die Unterkunft ist wie auf den Bildern beschrieben sauber, ordentlich und sehr gut ausgestattet. Die Kommunikation war stets freundlich und zuvorkommend. Mit dem Auto angereist haben wir im relativ teuren Parkhaus parken müssen. Die Anreise mit den Öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln sind in unseren Augen am sinnvollsten, da die Unterkunft eh sehr zentral liegt. Wir können die Unterkunft auf jeden Fall nur weiterempfehlen.
I was in Berlin for a few days and this place was amazing
Besonders hervorzuheben ist die unkomplizierte Übergabe der Schlüssel. Das lief super.

Best host I have ever met, understanding and very sweet. The place was nat too far from the city, and it’s sooo easy to get there. The room was clean and amazing, the zone is quiet and relaxing and the house was so cozy. I highly recommend it! 😁

L'appartement correspond bien au descriptif. Il est très fonctionnel et en parfait état, dans un immeuble très calme. Sa situation excentrée n'est pas gênante en raison de la station de métro située à 10 mn à pied.

It’s been very helpful for Sven and his team, since it’s a business trip, due to work purpose, we had a late check in and out during the stay, they’ve been extremely helpful and understanding. Apartment is very tidy and stylish, with a very good location, just 2 stations away from alexanderplatz, where we can find most of everything there. The closest metro exit is next to the building, would definitely 1st choice if we come back to Berlin next year again.
Seb was very nice and his place was clean and at a good location.
Very good recommended!

Eine schöne saubere Unterkunft in toller Lage in einer alten Stadtvilla, unweit der U-Bahn.  Das Beste ist aber die wunderbare Terrasse zum relaxen in einem Teil des Gartens mit alten Baumbestand. Wir lieben diesen Platz. Gruß J.W.
Das Apartment war sehr gut nur hatten ich letztendlich ein anderes Als ich gebucht hatte was aber kein Problem war da dieses auch sehr gut war wie das welches ich eigentlich gebucht hatte.

Lägenheten är precis lika fin som i annonsen. Lugnt läge högst upp på en en innergård. Lägenheten ligger i ett ganska vanlig del ac Prenslauer Berg men med gångavstånd till mer kafé- och turisttäta områden, vilket jag tyckte var ganska skönt.

We had a fab stay here over New Year’s Eve. A really well-located apartment in a cool neighbourhood. It was equipped with everything we needed, and very warm and cosy inside. Martin was super helpful and easy to contact, with lots of local tips. Leaving our bags in the office at check out was great too. Would love to visit again soon!

Tout était parfait !
L’emplacement de l’hôtel est proche de tout, on a été très bien accueillis et l’hôtel est calme :)
Excellent, looking forward to visit again

We enjoyed a fantastic four nights in Berlin! The area of Prenzlauer Berg is vibrant, cool and stylish.
The apartment is very close to transport that takes you straight to central Berlin and all the awesome sights to see and do.
Alan and Kasia’s guide to Berlin was super helpful with great places to eat, visit and how to get there.
The apartment was clean, comfortable and had everything we needed for our break away.
Thank you, we hope to visit again!
The best thing about this flat is the location - close to the center with many good restaurants nearby. There is not a lot of space inside, but more than enough to sleep and do the basics
Good stay at Susana's place. Very kind person and super nice environment. If I ever went to Berlin again I would probably book again at Susana's. Definitely recommended.
Heide's place is in a great location, very close to the S-Bahn and at the edge of the neighborhood Prenzlauer Berg with a lot to do. The apartment is comfortable and safe.
We felt very comfortable here, the room was spacious, and everything was great:) would recommend

The Airbnb is located in a nice locality, walkable from the U and S bahn Stations. Good facilities to check in and out. The host is responsive and was very proactive with the directions and advise. Room was OK. Shared kitchen was fine. Bathroom was clean but the shower wasnt well placed. Bathroom could be much better with a shower door to keep the water aside. Worth wise was OK. Overall, was a good stay.

Firstly, Claudia is the perfect host! She was very attentive to me and any requests and in very good time too. I’m very grateful for that as it made all the difference to our stay. Her property is beautiful; attention to details and home comforts make the stay very welcoming and has a good energy. The location was ideal for me, away from the hustle and bustle but close to transport links and good amenities close by. I’ll be returning on my next trip to Berlin! One of my favourite Airbnb stays yet. Thank you!

Daniele foi um anfitrião muito atencioso, sempre pronto para ajudar e preocupado com a qualidade da estadia. O local do alojamento é ótimo, próximo da estação de trem/metro, próximo do rio e próximo do supermercado Lidl. O apartamento é limpo e organizado. Eu recomendo este local para quem está a procura de um lugar para ficar em Berlim!

A great place to stay. The space was huge and very comfortable. Only downside was the apartment was mostly underground which made access a little hard and it was cold due to no windows (only vent slots) out. Pros outweigh the cons for sure!
Wir waren sehr zufrieden. Alles war tipptopp.
Tolle Lage, leider sehr teuer und beim Check-In nicht gut erreichbar.
The small guest house was nice and  comfy. The wifi was weak but available, and strongest in the kitchen. It was good for a layover and had easy access to the city.
Obrigada por nos receber em sua casa :)

Thanks for the place! We were a party of 4 and we all loved it. Very beautiful spacious apartment with fantastic light, artwork, and amenities. The kitchen is a great space to hang out, and if you have a guest staying in the living room it has its own door so functions as a third bedroom. I would definitely choose to stay here again, it is in a nice neighborhood, very quiet at night, with a lot of restaurants and transportation nearby.
Fantastic location and beautiful property. Sofa bed leaves much to be desired, though, to the extent that the “2” bed description is pretty inaccurate imo.

We had a very nice stay in Lindas apartment. Linda was very accomodating, helpful and sweet.
The apartment had everything we needed for our stay. The street was quite - and restaurants and shops were in walking distance.
The apartment could use some new paint here and there.
Ruhige und private Umgebung, Hygienentechnisch kann es besser werden. (Haare auf dem Boden, staubig)
We loved Ralph’s place. Central location, beautiful apartment and an incredibly peaceful shared backyard space. Cannot recommend enough. The perfect Berlin Airbnb

Arne is a brilliant host, very helpful with places nearby to eat (there is great choice- both traditional German through to Asian cuisine) and also things to do. His apartment is very close to a lot of attractions- 30mins walk along to the Reichstag and Brandenburg Gate. Would very much recommend this place to stay!

Lena's place is very comfortable, clean and quite. It's a great place to stay. It's well located; there is also a U-bahn in five minutes walking.
Lena is very nice and helpful in providing information about the city.
Recommended!

Ich habe Hilda nie selbst getroffen, was Mich aber auch nicht störte, da unsere Kommunikation per Airbnb ausgezeichnet war. Durch ihre Beschreibungen, in die Wohnung zu gelangen, war dies ganz einfach möglich.
Alles war wie im Inserat beschrieben.
Ich war mit meinem Aufenthalt bei Hilda sehr zufrieden und empfehle sie gerne weiter!
Kathrin’s property was in a great location with restaurants and transportation options close buy. The building was secure and felt safe.
Camera perfetta, bagno comodo, privacy adeguata e posizione eccellente. Ci tornerei sicuramente

Chambre sympathique près du tramway dans un quartier tres calme.
Merci

Clear and precise pre-arrival commununication. Easy to find and close to public transport. Beautiful mansion house in greenery setting. Calm and secure. Great bed and sleep. Full kitchen with amenities, simply, felt like being at home!

Sehr ruhige Lage direkt am Tempelhofer Feld. Gastronomie und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind in unmittelbarer Nähe. Die Wohnung war gut beschrieben und hatte uns einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt ermöglicht. Gerne wieder!
Excellent stay thank you for everything!
Super für ein aktives WE in Friedrichshain !!😉
Beautiful & spacious room with lots of natural light. Close to lots of restaurants, bars, and public transportation, and Betty is a lovely and gracious host. Absolutely recommend!
Great value. Serkan was easy to communicate with and place was small but comfy and clean! Very cute location and close to buses. Recommend for couples and solo travelers!
Super nette, unkomplizierte Gastgeber und eine sehr sehr schöne, stilvolle und saubere Wohnung. Schenja hat uns immer sehr schnell geantwortet. Vielen Dank, es war ein wunderbares Wochenende für uns.
War alles gut
Great place. Everything was perfect.

Johannes' place is decorated with style and taste, and is located close to lots of nice small restaurants. The third bed was not ideal, although still comfortable, but we had been warned. Thank you for trusting us to stay at your place !
It was a great experience to stay with Meggie. She is such a thoughtful and hospitable host, and in addition to that we had great food, thoughtful discussions and an awesome view.
Everything you need good location with ubahn stations within 5 minutes walk to get you to the centre.

Daniel hat immer schnell geantwortet und war sehr freundlich. Die Wohnung liegt wenige Minuten vom Ostbahnhof entfernt und liegt super zwischen sehr belebten Gegenden. Die Wohnung ist modern und hat alles was man braucht. Auch der Balkon ist groß und mit Blick auf die Spree.

I stayed one week at Robert's. Robert was very attentive from the beginning. In spite of him having a work travel before my arrival, he trusted me the keys of his full apartment for five days. Also, he allowed me to have an extended check-out, considering that there was no customer expected at that time. The area is very close to public transportation. I would recommend staying at Robert's
Great location for stay and amazing view from the balcony.

Ich war schon öfters hier und immer verlief der Check in sehr unkompliziert, auch wenn man erst sehr spät Abends ankommt.
Wenn ich in Berlin Adlershof bin, ist es meine erste Wahl zum Übernachten.

Stylish, very well equipped and clean apartment, as described. Trudy is very responsive and helpful. Centrally located steps away from U-Bahn station Hermannplatz, close to supermarkets and everything Neukölln has to offer. Only downside is that apartment is on ground floor and 2 of the bedrooms go out to Hermannstrasse (see pictures) which makes for a lot of noise.  We knew about the 10am check-out and no luggage storage but it's still not very convenient, especially when travelling with a big group of people.

This apartment has everything you need and is a home away from home.  It's within walking distance to tourist attractions and the city centre is only a few stops away on the underground. Aglaja and her husband were great hosts.  They helped us plan our travel from the airport (what train to get from which platform and what ticket to buy) and we were really grateful for that.  If your visiting Berlin I'd recommend this accommodation.  It's attached to an art gallery and the sliding walls add to it's quirkiness.  I've already recommended it to friends😍

Un lugar increíble, calidad precio garantizados.
Buena ubicación, con muchas ventajas.
Volvería sin dudarlo.

Die Wohnung ist super gelegen und sehr praktisch für einen Städtetrip mit kleiner Gruppe (Küche zum Frühstücken, 2 Bäder …), toller Ausblick, fußläufig bzw. gute Bahnanbindung zu alle. Sehenswürdigkeiten. Der Lärm durch die S-Bahn war hörbar, hat uns aber nicht beim Schlafen gestört.
Grandiose Wohnung, Mega stylisch und mehr als zu empfehlen. Die Lage ist perfekt. Auch das parken ist sehr gut möglich vorm Haus.

Very good and helpful host! All questions were answered quickly, the place is very beautiful and comfortable, the city center is in 7 minutes by tram, which is very good:)
Highly recommend!

It is just as nice as the pictures, a calm and lovingly designed oasis in a bustling neighbourhood! The apartment has everything you need and public transport is just around the corner. Johannes is a very friendly and helpful host :)
The place is located in a nice area with many cool restaurants and bars. Would stay here again 🙌
베를린에서 이 곳에 머물 수 있었던건 큰 행운이였어요. 실제로 보면 사진보다도 훨씬 아름답고 좋아요. 응대가 빠르고 친절하고 머무르는동안 너무나 행복했습니다.주변에 맛집도 많고 지하철 바로 앞이라 교통도 편해서 다음에도 꼭 머무르고 싶습니다♡

Wow, was für eine schöne Wohnung!!! Wir haben uns gleich wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung war sauber, gut ausgestattet und gemütlich. Sie wirkt größer als auf den Bildern. Die Kommunikation mit Johannes war unkompliziert und herzlich, die beiden sind tolle Gastgeber:innen:) wir kommen gerne wieder!
Great place, price and location! Host was very helpful and the apartment was beautiful
Bel appartement spacieux, propre situé dans un quartier calme a deux pas du tram. Restaurants et supermarché a proximité.
Muy bien localizado y la comunicación excelente! El departamento es muy cómodo y es específicamente cómo en las imágenes

L'alloggio si trova in una posizione ottima: il quartiere è ricco di locali, ma molto tranquillo ed è ben collegato a tutta la zona della Ring di Berlino. La camera rispecchia le foto pubblicate da Katarzyna.

Franz was helpful and relaxed. She let us do our thing and that was very relaxed. She has a great dog, he is so cute. The room was very clean and was equipped with everything we needed (closet, tv, closet etc.) and the bed was VERY comfortable. The apartment was clean and spacious and we were allowed to use the coffee machine which produced very nice, strong coffee. The apartment is very well located, nearby public transport, supermarket, eateries etc. We would definitely recommend this place! Thank you :).

Appartamento favoloso, in ottima zona, pulito e luminosissimo. La zona è centrale e si raggiunge qualsiasi luogo facilmente. La strada è bella, colorata e silenziosa. Host gentilissimi, reattivi e molto disponibili. Ci dispiace averlo lasciato, ma torneremo presto!

Spacious place
comfortable bed.
Close to the airport
Washroom a little bit small...
But has everything inside
Neat place, great location, nice hosts.
Everything is good, near the city and clean house!

Ralph and Maria were easy to contact and very responsive. It was a nice apartment that had all the essentials and close by to eateries including the Famous Burgermeister. It's also quite close to metros which makes it easy to get around. Some people might find the stairs a bit much but I used then to work off all the currywurst etc.
Tolle Wohnung mit einem grandiosen Blick auf die Spree. Die Lage in Kreuzberg ist zentral und man ist von Restaurants und Bars umgeben. Wir als Familie mit Kindern würden definitiv wieder kommen.

L'appartement est parfait et Oli est un hôte très sympathique. Il y a tout ce qu'il faut dans la cuisine et la salle de bain,  le canapé-lit est très confortable, et en plus il y a un petit supermarché juste en bas pour les courses du quotidien. C'est aussi très calme. L'appartement est à 10 minutes à pied de KuDamm et 5 min de Viktoria-Luise Platz, un très jolie quartier avec de bons restaurants. Je reviendrai sans hésiter.

Thankyou for the wonderful hospitality. From bringing us from the station, to providing us with dinner at a odd time in late night, we will remember it for a long time. We couldn't have asked for anything more. You have been the best Airbnb host, I have ever stayed with. Thanks a lot.
Great space.
Chic, sauber, alles voll funktionsfähig, sehr gut ausgestattet und super nett.
Super séjour , appartement proche de la gare
Great location, and space. definitely coming back

l appartement est très bien situé pour visiter la ville
il est bien aménagé et d'une très grande propreté
Sven a été un hôte très attentif et réactif à nos questions et besoins
nous avons ainsi pu passer un excellent séjour à Berlin
Tutto perfetto!
lovely place, great location, excellent value for money

Room was nice and big and not a tight hotel room you might find somewhere else. Bed was comfy.
A short walk from u-bahn and the hotel was located in a calm area. Although I did wake up on Monday morning to some loud construcrion outside, but that is not the hotel’s fault and will surely be done sometime soon.
Key to both entrance and hotel room were on my phone. Which made me anxious towards the evening as throughout the day the battery on my phone would get low. What if I ran out of battery and couldn’t then use the key to get into the hotel and my room? Luckily that didn’t happen because I knew I had to limit the usage my phone to make it back to my room.

Das Zimmer bei Michaela ist sauber und in einer sehr persönlichen vor Kreativität sprudelnden, schönen Altbauwohnung. Ich habe mich gleich wie Zuhause gefühlt und erholsamen Schlaf gefunden.
Der Kontakt mit Michaela war freundlich und angenehm.
Die Wohnung ist von der Freien Universität gut zu Fuß zu erreichen.
Great! Very close to the airport

Leuke plek in charlotteburg
Met leuke restaurantjes in de omgeving
Ruim opgezet loft
Was een prettig verblijf
Die Wohnung ist super ruhig gelegen und ein guter Startpunkt, um Kreuzberg zu erkunden. Es stimmt alles mit der Beschreibung überein. Sehr zu empfehle!
all good, it's a charm to be so central and at the same time have a calm place to return to. Nice furniture and golden elements

Andrea is a very pleasant and agreeable host. She made a meaty breakfast every morning with coffee or tea. Her house is an oasis of calm next to a beautiful forest. There is a train station nearby to access the city center quickly and easily. The room I rent was clean and well equipped. I will definitely come back next time I am in Berlin !

Alles super! Das Loft ist genau wie beschrieben, sogar etwas größer, als auf den Fotos rüberkommt. Super Lage zwischen Kotti, Görli & Maybachufer, mit einer Vielzahl an Restaurants, Cafés etc. in unmittelbarer Nähe. Durch die Lage im Hinterhof ist es trotzdem ruhig. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Stay weekend in this place.. really nice area.. everything close by.. for the place like that really cheap price..

Situado en un excelente lugar, en el corazón de Mitte. Hemos disfrutado de un apartamento amplio, limpio y agradable. Bien comunicado, con supermercados cercanos y zona de ambiente muy próxima.  Doug, el anfitrión, aunque no lo vimos, ha estado muy atento. Recomiendo el alojamiento, sin lujos, pero muy cómodo para desplazarsepor la ciudad y para descansar al final del día.
War sehr schön, jederzeit gerne wieder!
Amazing place, i loved the atmosphere
peter人很细心热情，为我们提供了非常好的就餐和游览线路，使我们能多维度的了解和体验柏林，公寓很完美，下次一定会再来的，非常感谢peter
Majoittuminen sujui hyvin ja Cornelius antoi kaiken tarvittavan tiedon miellyttävään majoittumiseen. Asunnon sijainti on loistava, koska julkisilla kulkuvälineillä pääsee helposti paikasta toiseen.

Logement bien situé et calme, avec un aménagement agréable. Un problème cependant (pour un séjour long) : l'appartement (situé en souplex) est assez humide, ce qui se fait ressentir, à la longue, sur les draps et les serviettes.

Super, Janik est très sympa et réactif
Le quartier est bien placé, calme et bonne literie
Merci Janik pour ton accueil
Nathalie
Super ruhig in schöner Lage; freundlicher, persönlicher Empfang und Check-out. Kleines nettes Zimmer mit bequemem Bett. Ausstattung wie beschrieben!

Wir waren jetzt das zweite Mal in Veronicas Wohnung und genauso begeistert wie das erste Mal.
Wohnung und Umgebung sind einfach toll. Die Kommunikation mit Veronica war nett und unkompliziert.
Wir waren bestimmt nicht das letzte Mal hier.
We had a lovely stay at Kerstin's place. It takes about an hour to get anywhere in the city but the apartment itself is cozy and has everything you need. Kerstin was friendly and helpful.
ruhige Wohnnung, zentral, Geschäfte in der Nähe, U-Bahn und Bus in der Nähe

The appartment was every bit as expected. It was very tidy and well set. The communication with the owner was great, he was very helpful. The surrounding is quiet, there's a lovely park right across the street. Trully recommend!
ort liegt super, sehr schöne umgebung und sehr zentrale lage.

We stayed in Thomas‘s apartment for 2 nights with a family of 4. The apartment is located in a quiet residential area - and with good S-Train connection to explore also other parts of Berlin. The apartment is modern & well-stocked - it has everything you need. During our stay 1-2 questions came up. Thomas always reacted in a swift and helpful way and tried to find solutions.

The room is at showed on the pictures! Alessandro was really nice and waited for us earlier than the check-in time so we could leave our bags in the room.
Even though we were late for the out, Alessandro was stil smiling.

The place was incredibly quirky and charming, adding a unique touch to my experience. I absolutely loved the location, which offered convenient access to various attractions and great food spots.
However, given my height of 6ft 3, I must admit that using the shower in the Airbnb was quite a challenge. The bathroom/shower space is quite tiny, which made it a bit uncomfortable for me to manoeuvre. Despite this, I appreciated the overall charm of the accommodation and the unique experience it offered during my stay in Berlin.

Louis è un ragazzo tranquillo e rilassato, abbiamo fatto il check-in a tarda notte e non ha fatto alcun problema. La posizione è abbastanza buona, la casa non è particolarmente ordinata e abbastanza polverosa, ma per noi (due ventenni a Berlino principalmente per la night life) andava bene, considerando anche il prezzo. Meno consigliato per famiglie o per viaggiatori più adulti

Wir waren über das Wochenende in Berlin. Der Check-In und Check-Out lief reibungslos ab. Ausstattung und Zustand entspricht den Bildern. Inserat in Kombination mit Spree-Nähe ist unschlagbar, vor allem im Sommer. Es war insgesamt wirklich sehr schön.

Lana made us feel welcome prior to arrival with excellent communication, which made us feel very relaxed. The apartment wasn't much to look at from the outside, but more than exceeded our expectations from the inside. All details in the booking were accurate and the apartment was spotless. It is in an ideal location, with the subway just a few minutes walk away. Local supermarkets, bars and restaurants also within a 5 minute walk which was perfect. Great accommodation for our group which ticked all boxes.

Dit is een super leuke airbnb in een leuke buurt! Het openbaar vervoer is dichtbij en ook zijn er veel leuke cafes en winkeltjes in de buurt. Stephan zorgt ervoor dat alles goed in orde is en de communicatie is ook top.  De airbnb zag er perfect uit toen wij aankwamen. Kan het alleen maar aanraden!
Excelente lugar!

Had a great stay at Simons apartment in Berlin. It was very close to the Hbf and with the U-bahn you were in the city within an short amount of time.
The apartment was clean and like shown in the pictures.
Would recommend!
Sauber und viel Platz. Lage war für uns super!

The apartment was nice and clean. In a central but still quiet location.
The host was very responsive and provided all the needed information timely.
Very recommended.
Sehr gut und gemütlich
Besser geht's nicht. Ich will das hier eig gar nicht empfehlen, wenn sichd aß rumspricht, dann ist Marion immer ausgebucht und wir kriegen das Zimmer dann ggf nie wieder😬😬

Extremely cozy place few steps away from both metro and busses. The house itself is spacious and clean, it feels like your own home! The host was very kind and accommodating, especially with check-in and check-out times. Looking forward to staying here again!

Best Airbnb experience ever! Robert is an amazing host and incredibly helpful. He sent a ton of information about Berlin before my boyfriend and I had even arrived and then sat down with us when we did arrive to show us maps of different places to check out in Berlin. The loft is absolutely beautiful and super comfortable. We loved every minute of our stay. Don't pass up staying here!

Ambiente confortevole e spazioso. Letti comodi. Bene accessoriata di tutto.
Ottima pulizia ambienti e stoviglie.
Zona molto tranquilla.
Vicina alla stazione della metro, ben servita anche dai bus.
Giudizio finale ottimo!

Bettina is splendid host .
I can’t speak English and German.
However, she talked slowly kindly.
When I didn’t understand how to open key, she came home immediately.
And she carried my food and souvenir ( many noodle ) .
The beautiful clean big house and beautiful garden.
Anyway, it’s stillness.
The station ( S line ) , it’s 15-20 minuets on foot.
A side immediate in the promenade and the Park.
I recommend it !

Boligen ligger i et central område med 5 -7 min gang til nærmest U bahn.
Lejligheden ligger i kælder plan og er fint renoveret. Fungere til en familien med 2 børn. Sovesofaen er af god kvalitet.
Wunderbare Unterkunft für Familien, ruhige Lage, zu Fuße in direkter Umgebung viele Restaurant und ÖPNV. Wir kommen wieder.

Great location full of locals -- quiet, but surrounded by restaurants, shops, grocery stores, etc. The apartment felt huge and open. Louis provided a lot of thoughtful information prior to my arrival. Highly recommend!
Great stay, thanks!

Vores airbnb var blevet annulleret så vi fik booket denne i sidste øjeblik. Det er et rigtig fint sted at være, vi holdt jul med vores datter. Gode senge og faciliteter. Vi fik late check ud hvilket var dejligt. Rigtig fint sted.
geweldige tijd gehad in Berlijn, ons ruime appartement was heel fijn, van alle gemakken voorzien en schoon, de buurt is gezellig en toch rustig, restaurants voldoende in de directe omgeving

Upon booking the apartment and throughout the process to arrival me and my friend received responsive and pleasant communication. Self check in was easily done upon arrival and we were impressed the decor of the apartment as well as how much surrounding businesses were closely accessible. We were very happy therefore with the accommodating nature provided by Stella and can confirm a pleasant Airbnb stay is available at this apartment
Apartamento bien comunicado en transporte público, barrio tranquilo, apartamento muy bien equipado.
Apartment war sauber. Die Antwort war blitzschnell von Stella. Für einen schmalen Taler sehr zu empfehlen. :)
Toll wie immer

Terrific spot, very classic old style Berlin apartment in a great location. Very stylishly decorated and a comfortable stay. Lots of great bars and restaurants in the area, very helpful hosts. Thanks!

Beautiful house and spacious apartment.
The sofa bed is the cheapest ikea one and unfortunately not very comfortable.
It‘s was ok for a business stay.

Highly responsive and friendly host. Fantastic apartment and location. Absurd value for money! Don't think twice, this is the place to be in Berlin!
Thanks a lot Tanya and Moritz. Hope to meet you soon again! :)

Nos alojamos durante tres noches en la cabaña de María, y puedo decir que fue una experiencia inmejorable. Desde el primer momento, María nos hizo sentir como en casa. Al llegar, nos recibió con una cálida bienvenida y todo estaba perfectamente preparado: el lugar estaba impecablemente limpio, ordenado y con todos los detalles necesarios para garantizar una estadía cómoda y relajante.
La cabaña en sí es encantadora, llena de detalles que demuestran el cuidado y la dedicación de María. Además de ser un lugar acogedor y bien equipado, la ubicación es ideal para desconectar y disfrutar de la tranquilidad del entorno.
María fue una anfitriona excepcional, siempre dispuesta a ayudarnos con cualquier consulta o necesidad que tuviéramos durante nuestra estadía. Su amabilidad y calidez realmente marcaron la diferencia, haciendo que nuestra experiencia fuera aún más especial. Sin duda, recomendamos la cabaña de María a cualquier persona que busque una estancia perfecta. ¡Volveremos!

Cozy apartment, great for couples or a small group of friends.
The area is surrounded by brunch places and cafes, close to supermarkets, 7/11 and a lot of parks.
Would 10/10 recommend.

Bienvenue chez Tony
Appartement coloré et coquet disposant du nécessaire pour un cours séjour
Proche du métro et des commerces utiles
Parfait 👍🏻
Thank you Susanne for a great stay! The room was lovely with a beautiful view into the garden. Clean room, central, and helpful host! Would recommend.

We had a lovely stay and everything was as we expected. Would definitely recommend staying here as there are loads of good restaurants within walking distance.
The place was very clean and tidy and allowed us to have a small yet intimate stay. Also the station is very close and travel is accessible from a lot of different areas.
Schöne Wohnung. Wenn ihr das erste mal in Berlin seid, lest den Bildband der in der Wohnung bereit liegt. Es lohnt sich, dann geht man an einigen Stellen nochmal mit anderen Augen durch Berlin.

Our stay at smarments was ok, the place is clean and convenient however we arrived late at night for our check in and we weren't able to access the building luckily there was a person who scan his card to let us in, the room was a bit hot at nights too. Everything else was fine.

Nous avons passé 4 nuits chez Louis et avons trouvé l'accueil, l'appartement et les accommodations parfaites, rien à redire. Il avait mis des serviettes à notre disposition, était d'accord avec le fait qu'on mette quelques trucs dans le frigo, le lit était confortable, bref super !

La zona tiene varios supermercados cercanos y una parada de autobús casi en la puerta (M11). Con este autobús se puede llegar al metro en 5 minutos y de ahí al centro en unos 40 minutos más.
