Ļoti laipna uzņemšana, jebkuros jautājumos palīdzēja. Ieraugot, ka esam ar mazo, piedāvāja citu dzīvoklīti, kam iekšpagalms ir ar bērnu laukumiņu. Tīrs un kārtīgs, atbilstoši bildēm. Kluss. Tikām iekšā pirms oficiàlā laika, kas mums bija ļoti svarīgi.

Insgesamt guter Aufenthalt, Quartier nachts etwas unheimlich. Gute Lage mit Anbindung an öffentlichen Verkehr. Sehr freundliche Hosts! Am Check-Out-Tag war ich zu spät dran, die Gastgeberin war aber absolut kulant. Daumen hoch!

Doro hat uns ganz spontan aufgenommen, nachdem wir in einer anderen air bnb Wohnung nicht bleiben wollten/konnten, wofür wir sehr dankbar sind, da sie uns damit unseren Aufenthalt gerettet hat. Doro ist eine sehr nette und warmherzige Gastgeberin, bei der wir uns sehr wohl gefühlt haben. Die Wohnung befindet sich am Rande Berlins, ist ruhig und idyllisch gelegen und durch Bus und Bahn super angebunden, in knapp 30min ist man in der Innenstadt. Alles für den täglichen Gebrauch ist vorhanden, die Wohnung ist sauber, schön und ganz persönlich eingerichtet, sodass wir uns absolut wohl und fast wie zuhause gefühlt haben. Wir kommen gerne wieder. Herzlichen Dank für alles!
Everything was great! Apartment is nice and spacious, and very clean, perfect location! The Host was very friendly and helpful! Thank you!

En sí el departamento es muy hermoso. Linda decoración y muy amplio. La ubicación es muy buena, ya que hay conexiones con el BUS y línea de U-Bahn muy a la mano. Sin embargo tuvimos una serie de problemas con el anfitrión, quien, a pesar de saber de los siguientes problemas, nunca apareció. El wifi nunca funcionó; tanto el sofá cama, como las sábanas y almohada para el mismo, estaban sucias; ambos televisores no funcionaban; faltaban toallas para el tercer húesped.
Sin bien contestaba a la brevedad, nunca nos ofreció ninguna solución a ninguno de los problemas.
Julian's apartment is very pleasant, quiet and perfectly located.  I recommend !
Pobyt była na prawdę udany. Okolica jest spokojna i dobrze skomunikowana. Sklepy i restauracje są w okolicy. Mieszkanie było czyste i przyjemne.

Even my way to use the accommodation was far beyond the intended purpose of the hosts. I needed just a bed for two nights close by our construction site. But, Carola organized perfectly the room for a business travelers. She manages very well arrival and departure of her guests. Next time i hope to enjoy a cup of tea with them.
Nice, clean and quiet apartment. With the subway only a short walk away, it was really easy to explore Berlin.

Perfekte Unterkunft für 1 - 2 Personen - klein aber fein. Serkan ist sehr nett 👍 Lage ist leider nicht so zentral, aber es gibt gute Anbindungen! Preis-Leistung Top. Es war auch alles sehr sauber und ordentlich.
It was a cozy and clean place. Host were kind. Very close to the airport!

Bernd and Isabelita were wonderful hosts, my room was clean and I got all I needed from local recommendations to lovely talks. The house is in the heart of Berlin, extremely easy to get to all the famous places by public transport.

Stark überteuerte Miete und mangelhaftes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis - unzureichende Sauberkeit, Pflege und Instandhaltung der Unterkunft und Einrichtungsgegenstände sowie deren teils mindere Qualität.
Fotos ansprechender als Realität, spiegeln z. T. nicht aktuelle Einrichtung wider:
- stabile Tische wurden durch wackelige mit unebener Platte ersetzt
- Mischbatterie auf Waschbecken fehlpositioniert - Becken kann nicht optimal genutzt werden, es fällt viel Wasser auf den Boden.
Direkter Körperkontakt mit Vorhängen beim Duschen unvermeidbar. Handtücher von schlechter Qualität. Stühle mehrheitlich unbequem mit wenig bis gar keiner Polsterung (Sitzauflagen - teils schmutzig und mit Geruch – nicht ausreichend) und teils instabil.
Kühlschrank klein. Küchen- und Haushaltsgeräte länger nicht gereinigt. Manches Geschirr, Besteck und Kochutensilien verschmutzt. Wohnung ziemlich hellhörig. Türen quietschen laut. Waschmaschine bietet keine zufriedenstellende Waschleistung. Viele Spinnentiere.

Alojamiento tal y como sale en las fotos, la zona muy tranquila con una entrada metro muy cerca.
Las instrucciones claras para llegar sin dificultad..
Todo muy limpio, caliente y comodo, con todo aquello que puedes necesitar para una estancia cómoda

High-end flat in a great location off leipziger strasse. Stefan and his assistant were kind enough to meet us at his place of business and drive us to the flat giving us suggestions of what to see and do. We had a great time in Berlin as it is a beautiful city with an amazing history while being safe and accessible using public transport. The only real issue we had was with the internet as it cut out intermittently, but as this was a minor issue, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Would definitely recommend Stefan's place and would stay there again.
Thanks.
Eine sehr schöne Unterkunft & ein sehr freundlicher Gastgeber!
Het appartement is erg comfortabel met 4 personen. De ligging is perfect voor openbaar vervoer en de prachtige Weissensee is op loopafstand.

Alex is very friendly and commutative.
Very good flat and easily accessible (10 min from the city center which is very good).
I really recommend this flat.

Great hotel in the city center! Despite the central location, the room was very quiet and comfortable thanks to the windows facing the inner courtyard. This allowed me to relax peacefully after a busy day. Major attractions are within walking distance, making the hotel even more appealing for travelers. I recommend it for those who value convenience and coziness.

Such a beautifully curated apartment, very well priced. I was pleasantly surprised with how spacious it was in real life for the four of us to hang out and relax in during our chill out time over the trip. Location is fabulous, central but not too central or hectic, loads of places to see and eat right on our doorstep, and only a 10 minute walk to a popular train station. Ia was so helpful and accommodating during our stay, it was a pleasure to communicate with her. I can't think of anything negative to say, it was just a really great experience.
Thank you Ia!
Wonderful basement property, easy access to the public transport system, great access to amenities

Waren 5 Mädels und haben die
Unterkunft für 4 Nächte gebucht. Alles top von Lage bis Sauberkeit war alles tadellos. Wir haben uns im Apartment sehr wohlgefühlt und können es nur weiterempfehlen. Anschlüsse zu U Bahn
Perfekt. Danke für den spitze Aufenthalt! :)
We enjoyed our stay. The apartment was very comfortable and convenient to our family. Also very close to the canal, which is a beautiful place to walk. And lots of restaurants nearby.
Super gelegen, problemlos  gefunden und eingecheckt. Habe uns sehr wohl gefühlt besonders praktisch das Code System.  Genau was wir brauchten. Danke und gerne wieder.
It is an ok hostel. We have been to cleaner ones.

Sehr einfacher Check-in und die Kommunikation war auch perfekt.
Die Anbindung an die Ringbahn ist in unmittelbarer Nähe, ebenso wie Einkaufsgeschäfte wie Aldi, Kaufland und Co.
Preis-Leistung ist super!

Fantastisk ophold. Smuk udsigt og rigtig god service af værten, som selv rettede henvendelse om alt var som det skulle være. Lejligheden ligger tæt på en masse smukke oplevelser i byen, lige når du træder ud af døren. Kan varmt anbefales.

We stayed 2 nights and barely 1 day due to our flight schedule, so we did the best we could. We arrived late and forced to take a taxi from the airport, so ended up paying 73 Euro to get there. However, Chris helped us on our way out and by using a bus, tram and train got back to the airport for only 12 Euro. (3 people)

A comfortable, small apartment in a nice, quiet area close to the city and the river.
Ahmed sent some very helpful instructions for getting to his home and was there to greet me and show me the facilities. He is a pleasant, cheerful guy willing to chat. He happily printed me a map showing how to get to where I needed to be.
I thoroughly recommend this accommodation.

Hi,
Michele is the best airbnb host. We did not meet him personally, but the instructions how to get there and how to get in were excellent and very clear. The place is exactly how it looks like on the pictures. The art on the wall is also my cup of tea. The location of the appartment is very close to a metro station and there are several nice breakfast places in the neighbourhood. It is very quite at night so you will definately have a good night rest. All rooms are very clean and tidy. If you go to Berlin, take this appartment, you won't regret it. We were there with 7 girlfriends which makes it very cosy and that was exactly how we wanted it to be. We felt as if we were on a schooltrip. We felt immediately at home in this flat.
My and my friends would like to go back. Due to the terror attacks in Brussels we had some problems to get back, but Michele showed us his generosity and went out of his way to help us. We won't forget this and made it even a more remarkable trip for us.
Small, functional room, quiet clean and all you need for a few nights. All of the three people of the Hotel we interacted with very friendly and polite. Good breakfast, prepared with love.
Amazing housing near public transports and in a quiet building. Dietrich could not be more reachable and helpful. Thank you so much !
Perfect place to stay in Berlin. Close to the centre but away from the hustle and bustle.

Julia was a helpful and friendly host. She speaks english fluently and gave us some great tips in Berlin.

The apt is nice and spacious, has all the stuff you need to feel at home and is clean and comfortable.

The apt is located in one of Berlins nicest streets, Oderbergerstrasse. We enjoyed our stay at Julia and would definitely recommend it others.

The sunset views truly are spectacular!! We organised our evenings around ensuring we were home to watch the sunsets and enjoy the amazing view. The apartment is very well equipped and very comfortable. We loved being right in the thick of the action in Alexanderplatz, including the absolute ease of transport with the station 2 minute walk away.

Everything was great. I'd stay there again!
The apartment is spacious, convenient, conveniently situated, and quite interesting with all the books and art pieces. The host made sure everything ran smoothly. Thank you!
Easy Check In and clean Appartement. Unfortunately the door of the toilet is not lockable.

Die Wohnung ist wirklich sehr bequem und völlig ausreichend für 4 Leute. Schnelles Self Check-In und Check Out ohne Probleme mit einfacher und ausreichender Erklärung. Angenehme Lage, nicht gleich im Zentrum aber trotzdem dafür einfach und schnell zu erreichen. Komme gerne wieder!
Helt ok ställe till bra pris.

Absolutely fantastic place to stay! The unbeatable location offers an array of nearby restaurants and shops. Moreover, the accommodation was impeccably clean, incredibly comfortable, delightfully cozy, and well-aired. Tori's self check-in instructions were exceptionally clear and beneficial.

Super schönes Appartement, tolles Ambiente herrliche Lage zwischen Schillerkiez und Reiterkiez im Herzen von Neukölln.
Die U-Bahnstation Boddinstraße in unmittelbarer Nähe ermöglicht es, schnell überall hinzukommen.
Komme gerne wieder
It was just like being at home, really! Stefanie is a very kind person, very easygoing and lovely to talk with about anything. Always there for anything you may need! Bis bald Stefanie :)
Sehr nette Gastgeberin, die Unterkunft war gut zu erreichen.

The flat was spacious and well appointed, tidy and modern. Access was very easy, being on the lower level. Nice big windows for air flow. The kitchen had everything to prepare food and it was lovely to have coffee available.
Tad bit noisy being on the lower level (and having windows open) but nothing too bothersome. About a 12 minute walk to a subway!
Un emplacement idéal pour rayonner dans tout Berlin au coeur d'un quartier habité et agréable!
Przestronny znakomicie urządzony apartament. Wszystko było znakomite. Blisko do metra, blisko do sklepów, restauracji. Dziękujemy
Everything was perfect. Apartment is beautiful and really spacious, location is walkable and near everything, Doug was responsive, proactive and friendly. Totally recommended!
Echt schöne Wohnung und sehr ruhig. Für Kinder auch super, da direkt hinter dem Haus ein Spielplatz ist.
Great place with nice personal touch (scented candles, little bottle of sekt :) ). Quiet and comfortable spot!
Mia’s place was in a great location and perfect for getting around to different sites and places to eat!
We stayed for one night and it was real nice place for the price. Easy tram accessible for transport and Serguo was provided clear instructions with flexible checkin
Tiene todas las comodidades de un hotel y eso es espectacular, repetiría.
Wonderful gem of a place! I would definitely recommend this place and will be back to enjoy it again. The communication and instructions were great and we had a fantastic stay.

Logement parfait, idéal pour découvrir Berlin à pieds et ses environs (station de métro 2min à pieds) !
Kitchenette parfaitement équipée
Nous reviendrons avec plaisir
Ci siamo divertiti tantissimo!
My one-night stay was pleasant, nice room, easy to get to the airport by bus from here
Archibald’s place was exactly as advertised. Great location and comfortable space. Would stay again.
Domenic and his wife are so nice and friendly, always help me to solve my questions , thanks for sharing your space!..

Ich bin froh, dass ich bei Yumi kurzfristig unterkommen durfte, nachdem meine eigentliche Unterkunft storniert wurde. Yumi war sehr flexibel, was meine Ankunftszeit angeht. Auch sonst war die Kommunikation sehr nett und ich konnte Fragen schnell klären. Die Unterkunft ist sehr gut angebunden, aber dennoch sehr ruhig. Es ist alles da, was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt braucht. Dankeschön!
Von der Wohnung aus sind wir gut zu Fuß zur Messe gekommen, wo wir gearbeitet haben. Die Wohnung ist super. Kommen gern wieder.
Wie immer alles großartig. ☺️
Sehr schöne Wohnung in guter Lage!
Anna's apartment is 5 star+. The place is in a nice location, very clean and well equipped. Communication with her is also very smooth. Definitely recommended.

We loved this space it was so cozy. As people who live in a tiny home it was really cool to see how someone else has made the most of a small space. The host was very helpful and the space provided everything we need!! such a cool vibe.

This place is awesome - loved the bedroom and back patio especially. The neighborhood is ideal, so many great bars/restaurants nearby and central enough to other areas of the city. Also next to a beautiful park. The hosts were extremely responsive and helpful as well!
Mike was super kind and friendly. The room was lovely and very close to public transportation. Highly recommend!
Sehr schöne Zimmer, leider schon sichtbare Abnutzungsspuren an Möbeln und im Bad.

Es ist wirklich super in dem Hotel von Michael! Sehr freundliches und hilfsbereites Personal, sehr sehr saubere Zimmer, moderne Einrichtung,  ruhige Gegend und sehr Nah an den U/S Bahn Stationen, womit man in nur 10-15 Minuten direkt im Zentrum von Berlin ist. Toll ist auch, dass ein Kühlschrank sowie eine kleine Küchenzeile mit Kochfeld und Spüle vorhanden ist.
Zona un po' distante dal centro ma facile raggiungerlo coi mezzi, casa piccola ma molto carina e ordinata.
Wir haben ein Zimmer für eine Nacht gesucht und bei Parwana ein gutes gefunden. Es gab zwei Badezimmer, so dass man nicht lange warten musste.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Verbindung in die Stadt war sehr gut. Rick und Katja sind sehr nett und haben immer schnell auf unsere Nachrichten reagiert. Wir haben unsere Zeit in Berlin sehr genossen. Muchas gracias por todo!

Nice and interesting place to explore berlin. Very good connection with the center and the most important monuments. Apartment nice and clean. The only downside is the proximity of the tram tracks. The contact with the host was very good. I recommend this place to stay in Berlin.

Arzu and Tom were fantastic hosts. The apartment had everything that we required and more and was very spacious. The neighbourhood is nice and is close to the metro. I would recommend staying here while visiting Berlin
A lovely apartment! I definitely recommend it.

Fabulous apartment. Everything you need in a really arty location near some great restaurants. The flat is comfortable, cosy, safe, quiet and has been decorated thoughtfully and functionally. Martin was a really friendly and flexible host who went above and beyond to make check in & out easy and stress-free. Highly recommend!!
Maravilhoso só poderia cancelar o uso da chave pra o elevador
We loved our stay here. A great apartment in a good location close enough to public transport to go anywhere you would like. Very  clean!

Everything was excellent, the apartment was clean and we felt right at home.
Gini was really kind and helpful and we definitely can recommend that one!

The appartment is great. It is spacious, clean and in a great neughbourhood! We were with 8 girls and had all the space we needed. It was close to a metro, so easy to go around Berlin.
What could have been better is the communication. I did send several messages in the weeks before arrival with no response. It made me worry a bit. Only in the week of arrival we did get reponses. The check-in in the end went good, we arrived after midnight at that was no problem. Checking out was a bit strange. 10 minutes before the set check out time (11.00) a lady already shower up starting to clean while we were still in the appartment. Outside the next group was already waiting..
So communication and check out could have been better, but for the rest the appartment was very good!
Es war alles super! Sehr kinderfreundlich eingerichtet :)

Schöne Unterkunft, ruhige Lage.
Kurzer Weg zum Bus.
Wohnung ist ganz oben im Mehrfamilienhaus (kein Aufzug).
Der Preis ist meiner Meinung ein bisschen hoch, aber für das Wochenende ging es mal.

This is a great space. Very comfortable. The kitchen is well equipped so cooking is easy, but with the location being so good I wanted to try out the local eateries instead! Howy is a responsive host, but the set up was easy to navigate and I didn’t have much need to contact him.

Ein sehr schönes Appartement, das genügend Platz bietet. Es ist sauber und zweckmäßig eingerichtet. Die Lage neben dem Cafe unweit vom Mauerpark ist super. Zur U und S Bahn unterschiedlicher Linien ist es nur eine knappe Viertelstunde und Supermärkte etc. sind direkt in der Nähe.
Wir hatten einen schnellen, unkomplizierten Kontakt und kommen gern wieder.
alles super
Alles super! Vielen Dank!
謝謝房東貼心準備的咖啡，還有洗衣粉，我們在這裡住得很愉快。門外轉角的十字路口有電車可以做非常方便
Really enjoyed my stay here it’s a great location and very modern clean apartment to stay in I would recommend to couples or families or friends
We enjoyed our stay in Simon's place.

This studio apartment was perfect for me and my girlfriend's stay in Berlin. Clean, and convenient to the U-Bahn, right down the street from a great coffee shop.
If you don't intend to cook at the apartment, and you are okay in small spaces, I would say this is a fabulous option, and I would surely stay at Jan's again.
Great host and great place to stay!

Great apartment, exactly as advertised in what appears to be a new complex, the room was spotless and more than adequate for what we needed. Complex is located about a 5 minute walk from a train station and there are local bakeries and shops close by if needed. Would happily stay again.

Tolle und sehr ruhige Lage, zu der man abends gerne wiederkam. Wunderschön eingerichtete Ferienwohnung mit 3 Balkonen. Danke für die unkomplizierte Hilfe als wir ein Nähset brauchten. Beim nächsten Mal Berlin kommen wir auf jeden Fall wieder
Beste strasse in Berlin, super schöne wohnung und sehr liebe hosts. Vielen dank!!
We had a lovely time in Berlin - the Airbnb was a beautiful apartment, clean, modern, and great location. Simon was also a great host, very friendly and responsive! Would recommend to anyone.

This was a great place to stay for our trip to Berlin. We found car parking nearby and Martin was waiting for us with the key and lot's of information  to add to our holiday. The location is central and walkable to key tourist sites and the apartment had more than sufficient amenities for a very comfortable time. It is well and comfortably furnished. We highly recommend Martin's apartment!
Ich bin sehr glücklich, dass ich knapp vier Wochen in Rositas Wohnung sein durfte. Alles wunderbar -- es gibt nicht das Geringste zu bemängeln.

Ein sehr angenehmes Hotel. Wir wurden freundlichst vom Personal empfangen und toll bedient. Es wurde immer nachgefragt ob die Zufriedenheit ansteht. Der Empfang und Eingangsbereich ist sehr modern, witzig und mutig eingerichtet. Für mich persönlich habe ich Gestaltungs- und Einrichtungsideen mitgenommen.
Das Familienzimmer ist übersichtlich und nach den Bedürfnissen eingerichtet. Die Räume sind hell, freundlich mit einer kleine Pantry (ohne Herd) einschl. Teller, Tassen, Gläser, Besteck eingerichtet und zu unser vollsten Zufriedenheit sauber übergeben worden.
Einzig ist, das Duschbad ist klein für große kräftige Menschen aber dies ist dem Planer des Grundrisses geschuldet und nicht dem Hotel !
Das Frühstück (leider nur einmal besucht) hat uns alle sehr beeindruckt. Nicht zu üppig, gezielt wurde frisch nachgelegt. Es war sehr lecker und wirklich zu empfehlen.
Wir hatten tolle und erholsame Tage in einen ruhig gelegenen Hotel. Bei einen weiteren Berlinbesuch kommen wir gerne wieder. Vielen Dank dem Team und dem Betreiber 😉

바로 앞에 트램이 다녀서 위치는 정말 좋았습니다. 그리고 정류장에 rewe도 있어서 장보기도 편했고요. 실내도 바닥 난방이 잘 작동돼서 따뜻하게 잘 지냈습니다. 다만, 아파트 층수가 1층이고 아파트 입주민들이 다니는 쪽으로 거실과 방 통유리가 나있어서 그대로 집 안 생활이 노출됩니다. 물론 블라인드가 있기는 하지만 쳐놓으면 답답하죠. 저희는 추운 겨울이라 문 닫고 지내서 상관이 없었는데... 봄, 여름, 가을에 이용하실 분들은 감안하셔야 할 것 같습니다.
Très pratique, très sympa !

La casa de Andreas, es perfecta para ir con familia o amigos. Cerca del metro, del super y con muy buenas comunicaciones al centro de la ciudad.
El señor Schroder, fue el encargado de atendernos ya que Andreas estaba de viaje. Estuvo muy atento y nos ayudo en todo.
Verdaderamente es un buen sitio para pasar unos días conociendo la ciudad.
Mi familia y yo lo pasamos muy bien y nos sentimos como en casa.

Fin leilighet. Stilig og enkelt møblert.
Stille område med butikker og restauranter i nærheten. Passer fint for en større gruppe
Alles prima. Gerne wieder
Calme, proche du métro et simple pour louer des vélos.

Das Apartment ist sehr gemütlich eingerichtet und in einen top Zustand. Beim Check-In haben wir die Wohnung sehr sauber vorgefunden und haben vom Gastgeber eine kurze Einweisung bekommen. Die Lage der Wohnung war so gut wie perfekt! Die U-Bahn ist Wortwörtlich zwei Schritte  von der Wohnung entfernt. Wer mit dem Auto anreist, hat die Möglichkeit direkt vor der Haustüre auf einem Gebührenpflichtigen Parkplatz zu parken(Sonntag kostenlos). Die Wohnung hat eine kleine Dachterrasse mit einer großartigen Aussicht auf die Skyline von Berlin. Hélène war sehr Hilfsbereit und war ständig abrufbereit falls wir Fragen hatten. Ich kann das Apartment wärmstens weiterempfehlen! Es ist perfekt für eine kleine Gruppe von Freunden, Paare oder Einzelpersonen.  Ich bin mir sicher, dass ich bald wieder das Apartment von Hélène besuchen werde :) Wir waren Absolut zufrieden! 10/10!!
Čisté a klidné ubytování 💓
In hipster location, we amaze by little attention and local vegan restaurant. 100% recommend
Prima appartement in een leuke buurt. Ook fijn dat je geen sleutel nodig hebt om het appartement binnen te komen. Aanrader!
Lovely place to stay, even nicer than the photos. Was lovely to get a full apartment and kitchen to ourselves. A bit outside of Berlin but public transport was smooth and regular. Would recommend.

Uns musste bei der Ankunft eine Dame helfen, die nur russisch sprechen konnte, die wir nur durch Zufall angetroffen hatten. Sie rief dann wiederum eine andere Dame, die ebenfalls nur russisch sprach an um uns weiterzuhelfen. Zum Glück sprach eine unserer Mitreisenden die Sprache. Anders hätten wir nicht gewusst, wie wir in die Unterkunft gelangen. Ob eine der Damen nun "Mia" war, kann ich nicht sagen. Merkwürdig...

Great sized flat in a quiet area. The kitchen is very small so eating out is a must but there’s plenty of places in walking distance.
The building is full of families and kids so you need to keep the noise to a minimum! The flat above has kids and even talking travels through the old floor very easily.
Overall the place was clean and tidy but the back room smelt of damp although we couldn’t see any visible signs.
We voelden ons zeer welkom in de gezellige woning van Rosa!

The flat is very nice and well located, in a quiet area surrounded by squares, bars and shops. The kitchen is very well equipped. The beds are a bit small but the overall space is spacious and bright. I recommend it!

J'avais loué un autre appartement dans la même structure et le même complexe d'immeubles par Booking qui , celui-là était lamentable.
le personnel fait ce qu'il peut et tout retombe sur eux mais l'esprit du loueur est pitoyable.
Les photos correspondant aux logements sont loués regroupent plusieurs appartements offrant le même nombre de couchages.
En fait, c'est juste du business sans respect des clients et je le répète, cela n'est pas dû au personnel
Das Appartement war super. Die Kommunikation bei der An- und Abfahrt leider eher unfreundlich. Wir haben uns dennoch sehr wohl gefühlt. Es war stets sehr ruhig.
Die Lage für den Preis ist top.

Kaikki oli kuten pitikin. Asunto on yksinkertainen, mutta siellä oli kaikki mitä tarvitsi ja se vastasi annettua kuvausta. Timo oli todella ystävällinen ja avulias. Hänen antamansa ohjeet olivat selkeät ja tarkat. Yhteydenpito sujui helposti ja nopeasti. Sisään- ja uloskirjautuminen oli joustavaa. Alue on rauhallinen, mutta kulkuyhteydet ovat kuitenkin hyvät.

Place was ok, clean, but not exiting. Just a place. Noisy area, but convenient location for grocery shopping and restaurants. TV didn’t work and when I contacted the ElPilar they just said it didn’t work for a long time and just needs to be removed. Not the response I requested. The soap dispenser in the shower area didn’t work either, but I was afraid to tell them at this point…😅 The coffee machine (Nespresso) is a nice touch. 👍
Very comfortable stay

Wonderful place in a central Berlin location, the place was well equipped and convenient to public transport. It was warm when we visited so some cooling fans would have been a nice option but overall it was a wonderful stay

We thought the flat was great, it was perfect for our stay. The neighbourhood was really interesting too.
Tessa is a great host, quick to respond to messages and very helpful.
Sehr gute Lage.
Conforme à nos attentes

I had a great stay at Sohails. Even though the room wasnt from the advertising Sohail made that very clear and explained everything in detail. Amazing stay!

Geweldige plek om Berlijn te ontdekken. Stadsdeel Mitte, loopafstand van centrum en toch rustige straat. Fijn appartement van alle gemakken voorzien. Leuke tip: loopafstand start/finish halve marathon.
Stylish room, comfortable bed, quiet at night and clean.  Check in procedure is straightforward.  Highly recommended!

Eine absolut empfehlenswerte Unterkunft! Sehr geschmackvoll und gemütlich, mit allem was man für sich und seine Familie braucht. Der Kontakt mit Fadeih verlief schnell und reibungslos!
Auch die Lage der Unterkunft ist prima! Alles was man braucht ist um die Ecke. Wir kommen definitiv wieder!

Für einen Kurztrip nach Berlin mit vier Personen top!
Super Lage.

Großartige Lage! Ein sehr gemütliches Bett! Ein wunderbarer Schreibtisch mit bequemem Schreibtischstuhl! Alles war für mich super! Gerne wieder! Und bestimmt auch sehr leise, wenn im Innenhof keine Bauarbeiten mehr sind ;-)!

Minden rendben ment :)
Szállás tiszta,könnyen megtalálható.
Tömegközlekedéshez közel.
This place was great nice house. Closed to everything. Restaurants , train. The host was super nice and very helpful. The house was super clean and very organized.

Sehr schönes Zimmer mit allem was man benötigt. Das Haus ist in einer sehr schönen Bauhaus Siedlung. Es ist sehr ruhig, so dass man durchgängig die Vögel zwitschern hören kann. Die Gegend lädt zum spazieren ein und für ein Termin im US Konsulat super gelegen. Check-In/-Out sehr unkompliziert.

Das ist ein ganz besonderes, tolles Appartement. Besonders beeindruckt war ich von dem sensationellen Beleuchtungskonzept. Auch das gemütliche Bett trägt sehr zum Wohlfühlen bei, genauso wie die Tatsache, dass Sebastian sehr aufmerksam und schnell antwortet. Alles in allem sehr empfehlenswert!

Unser Apartment war sehr sauber, die Lage ist super, alles wirlich sehr zentral sei es Kreuzberg oder Mitte, in der Umgebung gibt es mehrere Restaurants, Cafes und Bars und die Straßen sind vor allem an Wochenenden sehr beliebt.
Immer wieder gerne.

Super Unterkunft mit 4 Personen für ein paar Tage Berlin. In den Seitenstraßen hat man die Möglichkeit kostenfrei zu parken und kann desweiteren die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel nutzen. Perfekte Lage.  Ellen ist eine sehr aufmerksame Gastgeberin.
Sehr nette Gegend

Our stay at Stellas place was excellent! The interior is super stylish, the flat was very clean and the Stella was always super fast to respond. I also have to say that we appreciated the flat being already warm when we arrived as we were staying in October where it was already very cold in Berlin!
I can definitely recommend the comfy flat to everyone

We had two couples staying at Apartmenthouse Berlin for a long weekend. It was an ideal location for sight-seeing as only a short bus ride away from the city centre. Clean and comfortable and great value for money.
He was a great host! The place was very neat and clean. He was very quick to respond to all my questions. We had a great stay!
Good location and super handy having a supermarket right next door.
Very kind and communicative. Great apartment and location.

The apartment is gorgeous - spacious, full of natural light, and very stylish. The kitchen is also well-equipped and the flat generally just feels luxurious. Mimi was a great host, quick to respond to any messages as well as warm and welcoming. Would highly recommend!

The location of the apartment was great! The neighborhood is super cozy and fun. It’s just a walking distance to a lot of great restaurants, and the tram is also close by. The apartment resembles the pictures, so no surprises!
Bis auf den staubigen Fußboden war alles optimal
Sehr freundlich und fair im Preis. wir würden uns wieder bei ihm einquartieren ;)
The place is great! Especially we loved the location. Not too far from the centre, a lot of shops and restaurants.

Saido's apartment is located in a very convinient place, close to a U line station. The apartment was very clean and comfortable, big enough for 2 persons. And he was very nice and gave me many useful advices according to my interest. I enjoyed my stay in Berlin at Saido's apartment. Denifitely recommend it to everyone!
Hosts are super nice and helpful. Apartment has been recently renovated, it’s super user friendly and functional. You will have everything you need in the apartment ready!
Alles bestens.
War ein super Aufenthalt in einer sehr schönen und sauberen Wohnung. Sehr zu empfehlen!

Karma ist ein herzlicher Gastgeber, ich habe mich gleich sehr wohl gefühlt.
Er hat mir hilfreiche Tipps für die Gegend gegeben. Ich kann die Unterkunft nur empfehlen.
Sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt, tolle Unterkunft in zentraler Lage.
Die Unterkunft war genau wie beschrieben und sauber. Direkt in der Nähe gab es eine S-Bahn Haltestelle mit der man schnell überall hinkam. Können die Unterkunft nur empfehlen!
Great stay, Jana is a lovely host. Also, great location.
This is an absolutely gorgeous space in the best area in the city. Beautiful view and vibe. They were extremely accommodating and made me easily feel at home. Highly recommend!

Vielen herzlichen Dank! Wir hatten eine super Woche in Berlin, trotz Regen, die Wohnung ist ideal gelegen und prefekt für eine Familie, alles was man braucht um.auch mal zu Hause zu essen, und sonst nette Cafés und Restaurants un der Nähe, ebenso wie Geschäfte, Bus/UBahn. Gerne wieder!
Convenient place to stay.

Eine traummhafte Lage direkt an der Dahme. Der Kontakt zur Vermieterin war reibungslos. Die super geschnittene Altbauwohnung wird gerade etwas renoviert( Lichtschalter, Fußleisten usw.) und bietet ausrechen Räume und Schlafplätze. Auch Geschirr und Besteck ist ausreichend vorhanden
Das Badezimmer war wie erwartet etwas klein, aber die Regendusche hat das wieder wett gemacht. Die Angabe Whirlpool in der Beschreibung ist etwas fehl am Platz, da dieser ein kleiner Metallpool im Garten ist, der nicht befüllt war. Auch das der Garten nicht direkt von der wohnung zugänglich ist sondern durchs Treppenhaus könnte man mit in die Beschreibung aufnehmen.
Es ist allerdings ein Jammern auf hohem Niveau und konnte ein tolles Wochenende nicht verhindern 😉. Beim
Nächsten mal Berlin kommen wir wieder.

Tolle Möglichkeit sehr privat und ungestört in einer schönen Umgebung ein paar Tage zu verbringen.
Man braucht sich nicht mit anderen Gästen arrangieren, oder Rücksicht zu nehmen. Wohnen wie in den eigenen vier Wänden.
Die Lage zu den Öffis, in´s Grüne und zu attraktiven Freizeitmöglichkeiten ist super !
Haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt! Das von Benedikt empfohlene Cafe war auch super!

My stay at Villa Annabelle was fantastic, Elke has a beautiful home with lots of space and plenty of natural light. The garden is so serene and well looked after, I could’ve just stayed there all day! The communication was perfect, no trouble or issues with my stay at all.
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a short or long stay in Berlin.
Thanks Elke!
Tolle Lage, einfach zu erreichen. Perfekte Kommunikation, alles wurde bestens erklärt. Die Wohnung war ordentlich und sauber, immer wieder gern!
A little difficult to reach initially when checking-in, but otherwise provided a very clean and hospitable apartment that is ideally located.
Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen  gemütliche, saubere und funktionale Wohnung, tolle Umgebung mit vielen fußläufigen Restaurants, optimale Lage für einen Aufenthalt mit Familie in Berlin.

It’s a perfect choice for solo travel.
Although the apartment is in a old building, it’s very clean and comfortable.
It’s a little far from central, but close to the station.

Fantastic roof-top flat in a beautiful part of Berlin - highly recommended for anyone looking to spend some time in the city. Great hosting too. A warm welcome with lots of advice and support on what to do and see.

Es ist eine gute und ruhige Lage, wenn man den ganzen Tag unterwegs war und sich noch ein bisschen Erholung gönnen möchte. Es gibt einen schönen Park, Cafés und Spätis vor der Haustür. Eine Veranstaltungshalle ist auch nur 5 Minuten entfernt und 10 Minuten zu den Öffis.
Der check in ist unkompliziert und leicht zu verstehen. Wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder.

The apartment is well located, an easy 15 min walk from central station, and walkable to the main sights - Bundestag etc. A quiet residential area. The description and photos are accurate, and communication from Thomas (or his associates) was good. As well as the local cafe, the German restaurant across the road (Esszimmer) is very good, and there is a good Vietnamese restaurant nearby on Habersaathstraße.
We did have a couple of niggles, but otherwise it was an enjoyable stay.
For anyone planning to visit Berlin this year, you may wish to be aware that there is a lot of construction work in the centre which does spoil some of the main sights.

The place was very clean and super stylish. The bathroom is modern and also furniture and everything as in the pictures. You have everything you need in the kitchen and also bathroom products. The beds ( room for 3 persons) were comfortable and big. The check-in and out times were superflexible and everything was uncomplicated. In generell the contact with Vanni was quick and easy and uncomplicated. We would definitely recommend this place.
Casa carina comoda

It’s a beautiful flat, clean, spacious and bright. Communication and check-in / check-out was super easy and fast. Nevertheless if you are traveling with a lot of luggage it would be helpful to consider that you have to climb 111 steps to get to the flat (I counted them :P)
Übertraf die Beschreibung

Wir hatten einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt bei Nena Apartments. Die Apartments sind ganz neu und sauber. Der Check in war sehr unkompliziert und das Personal sehr hilfsbereit. Die Lage ist super in Kreuzberg, viele Restaurants und Bars in der Umgebung. Mit der Ubahn ist man überall schnell in Berlin.
Einziges Manko: vor der Tür/im Innenhof war während unserem Aufenthalt noch eine Baustelle. Dank der guten Fenster hat uns das dann aber auch nicht so gestört.
Nice, beaty, calm, ..satisfaction. I very recommend.
Great location at Nollendorfplatz with access to public transportation, great restaurants and bars around. Room is comfy with everything you could ask for.

Alles genauso wie beschrieben.
Sehr freundliches Personal.

Great location, easy to get to from main station on tram and very bright and clean apartment.
Everything is at a walking distance. Great cafe ( Cafe Distrikt ) and restaurant (Kat Orange) at doorstep

This is a brilliant place to stay in Berlin.
The apartment is very well located close to checkpoint Charlie and you can get all over town by public transport or simply walking.
The apartment is extremely secure and the brand-new Wi-Fi works like a charm
We were able to enjoy Berlin as we expected
Every morning we would walk to Brandenburg gate, find a coffee shop, wander back and get ready for the day ahead.
We highly recommend this Airbnb and thank the owners for their attention to detail.
Although we stayed in summer, the double glazing and hydronic heating will make it as warm as toast, I have no doubt.

super séjour dans cet appartement bien placé.
petit bémol sur la luminosité qui pourrait être améliorée par plus d´éclairage
Empfehlenswert! Gerne wieder!

Notre séjour s’est très bien passé.

Endroit parfait pour un petit séjour, quartier calme.

Il réponds à toutes les questions et vous aide en cas de nécessité.
Je recommande à 100% 🙏🏻

This apartment was an absolute dream! The flat was very cozy and I wished we could have stayed longer. It’s located in a cool neighborhood, with great restaurants and boutiques nearby. I highly recommend this Airbnb—it was even better than the photos!

I had business meetings in that area of Berlin and for that purpose it was great to stay with Janet. Everything is quite new and well kept in the apartment. You get a nice room with comfy bed. WiFi is not very fast but ok. You can use the large open kitchen and the modern, clean bathroom. Everything fine except for her dog who will not get used to you even after a few days, and the cat who pretends to be kind.
Top Unterkunft . 10/10

Emplacement proche de la gare, très pratique. Il faut son téléphone pour ouvrir la porte de l'hotel, de la chambre, du locker extérieur et pour fermer le placard de la chambre, donc hotel assez connecté. Mais sinon, très calme, propre (pas de fenêtre mais cela ne nous a pas dérangé car nous n'y allions que pour dormir).

Top Apartment- immer wieder gern.
Sehr sauber und ordentlich. Lage ist perfekt und man erreicht alles in wenigen Minuten.

Wir waren für 2 Nächte zu dritt hier.
Eine sehr angenehme Wohnung, auch die Nachbarn sind freundlich.
Die Unterkunft liegt nicht weit von der S-Bahn Station und fußläufig sind sehr gute Frühstücksrestaurants erreichbar

We had a great time in Frank’s home. The apartment large, cozy, clean and it is fully equipped with everything you could need. Frank has been a wonderful host! Next time we will stay here again for sure! Thanks
God beliggenhed i forhold til Ubahn og Kurfürstendamm. Gadeparkering lige udenfor lejligheden. Rummelig lejlighed med tre gode værelser. God kommunikation med værterne.

Superschönes kleines Häuschen am See mit direktem Wasserzugang. Die Lounge auf dem Steg ist perfekt.
Der Blick auf den See beim Aufwachen unvergleichlich.

Apartment was really nice. Good rooms in style of authentic Berlin. Excellent area - the centre of city's life. And the main thing - Alex is really great and pretty man who help you in everything you need

Best place we’ve stayed to date. Exceptional place, super decor & comfort, location, neighborhood super!
Stefanie was an excellent communicator. Thanks for offering a much better experience than being trapped in a hotel! Prima / wunderbar!

Really cool concept and space for a hotel. The location really is excellent for young people with so many bars and restaurants nearby. We loved the flexibility of the whole experience.
We really fell in love with our cosy room and didnt want to check-out!
Marion was so helpful and friendly

Sehr hilfsbereiter Gastgeber, gute Lage. Aber bei dem Preis sollte der Lattenrost unbedingt repariert werden. Ansonsten gerne wieder.
Great apartment in a convenient location. We loved the neighborhood and the apartment has everything you need for your stay. Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here on our next trip to Berlin.

Wir waren ein grosse Familie und die gesamte Wohnung hat uns sehr gut gefallen!
Die Räume waren alle hell und sehr schön eingerichtet. Die Betten waren sehr bequem und insgesamt war alles sehr gepflegt.
Das ein und aus Checken hat hervorragend geklappt.
Vielen Dank das wir diese schöne Wohnung 4 Tage in Anspruch nehmen konnten!!! :-)
bring a towel.  they have them but they cost 2 euros.

Firstly, Duran was very friendly at check-in. He gave us the run-through of the property and gave us tips to places of interest. there are plenty if restaurants and a bar right next door. Great location. Only a 15 minute walk to Alexander Plaz and from there you can find what ever you like. for groceries, there is a lidle just 6 minutes walk opposite side from the flat.
very happy with the flat and our host!!

A fantastic, clean apartment. Just as in the pictures.
Key pick up was easy, even in spite of the fact that I arrived very late.
Simply left the keys in the apartment afterwards.
Very recommendable!
Die Kommunikation war von Anfang sehr gut, Karl war super flexibel und man hat sich direkt wohl gefühlt.
Alles war genauso wie beschrieben. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!

The apartment was sunny, clean, quiet and pleasantly laid out.  Just right for our family of three.  The location is great, plenty of shops, restaurants and groceries nearby and it's close to lots of trams and buses, and a short walk to the Ubahn.  It's easy to walk to Prenzlauerberg or Mitte.  The kitchen is very well appointed if you like to cook. It had everything we needed. Lastly, Lea was very communicative and made our stay easy!

An absolutely wonderful apartment. Located right in the centre of Berlin very close to the Brandenburg Gate and easy accessibility to all City Highlights. Neat and clean. Friendly and helpful staff.
Only thing which I missed was perhaps a Microwave oven and maybe some salt and oil for cooking.
Overall an amazing experience. Will definitely come again.

el apartamento es  perfecto.  Muy centrico , cama muy comoda y muy luminoso. Cocina basica pero bien para 1 persona. Metro y supermercados justo abajo. Todo muy bien. Como para repetir.  La única pega es que es imposible tenerlo a oscuras con la cortina por lo que el sol te termina despertando si o si a primerisima hora de la mañana (si sale el sol).

The apartment was superb! :)
Easy to sign in and find. Everything was clean and tidy. Lots of space and calm vibes. Easy to connect with Jun. Me and my friend stayed 4 nights and would recommend it 100 % !
Henna ja Paula all the way from Finland

Hvis man kommer fra Schönefeld-lufthavnen er det lidt bøvlet at finde den bedste forbindelse med tog og bus, men brug Berlins version af "Rejseplanen": fahrinfo.bvg.de. Bus M41 stopper lige uden for døren.
Die Gastgeber waren sehr hilfreich und die Wohnung und die Lage waren toll! Gerne wieder!

o espaço e bom mas, a nao existencia de um aparador que devide a area do chuveiro torna o banho extremamente desconfortavel, pois cada banho molha todo o banheiro. não entendo porque não existe essa divisoria

Una departamento hermoso con todas las comodidades, en un barrio con muchas opciones para salir y cerca de una de las principales estaciones de trenes. Por ahora una de las mejores experiencia en Airbnb
It was clean and not too bad a location. It’s a pretty safe neighborhood and relatively near the tourist attractions

Kerstin is a wonderful host and she extended hospitality that warmed our hearts in the cold weather. She is responsive, attentive and helpful and that made our stay in Berlin very pleasant and memorable.
Her coach house is spacious and cosy with comfortable beds, and equipped with adequate amenities. It is 1 minute walk to the U-Bahn station and several minutes walk to restaurants, convenience stores, etc.
I highly recommend staying with Kerstin.
Andrea wasn't in Berlin, but he was always available and made sure my stay flows smoothly. The location is fantastic and the apartment really cosy.
Gute Lage, direkt am M-Station. Die Wohnung ist wie auf den Bildern, sehr gut für ein paar Tage in Berlin :)
Super Lage am SüdKreuz
great location - close to transportation, cafes, restaurants, and parks/memorials. easy to find and secure, would stay here again.
The apartment was just like the description and perfect for a few night stay. It is easy to get to the trains and by local coffee.
Lovely clean appartment and great neighbourhood! Dan gave us a lot of clear instructions!  We also loved the poster in the toilet:)
Matthew's apartment was perfect for me. It was in a perfect location, clean, convenient, roomy  and had everything I needed.

The Hostel was really great! The position is awesome because in 15 minutes you can reach Alexander Platz on foot or you can take the near metro station at Strausberger Platz and reach the rest of the city. The staff was kind and gentle with us! The breakfast was awesome: for 5 euros you can eat a lot, from sweety to salty food. I definitely recommend the SInger 109 hostel to everybody!

Wir waren super happy mit diesem Airbnb. Die Kommunikation mit Maddalena war sehr gut und die Wohnung ebenfalls. Uns haben besonders die zentrale Lage und die umfangreiche Ausstattung der Wohnung sowie die großzügige Raumaufteilung der Wohnung gut gefallen, sodass wir uns dort für ein Wochenende sehr wohl gefühlt haben.
Nur die Parksituation war manchmal etwas schwierig, doch nach ein bisschen Suchen findet man auch da einen Parkplatz.
Vielen Dank von uns, liebe Madda!
Great place to stay in Berlin, near the U8. Room spacious, bed very comfortable. 10/10

Tom, our host, was awesome with communication in regards to getting to the AirBnb, and gave us all the information we needed to know about living in Berlin. The house was tidy and in a great position (right next to a 24 hour convenience store and 1min walk from station). Tom made us feel very welcome and the stay was great! 10/10

Very nice place to stay, clean and looks exactly like the photos. Host responds very well and was extremely helpful.
It is on the ground level of a street that can get quite noisy though.

We *loved* this place. In the cold grey winter of Berlin it was a wonderfully homely splash of colour and comfort.
The space is super cool, and the BerlinLofts team have appointed it very generously with amenities and kitchen implements. There was also lots of maps, a really helpful guestbook and great recommendations.
The area is nice, and the Birkenstrasse subway system is a three block walk. There's also supermarkets and restaurants nearby.
We think this is one of the snuggest, most beautiful and most characterful airBNBs that we have ever stayed in, and as long as you're OK with walking up the stairs (we needed the exercise after the Christmas markets) we would absolutely recommend you stay here. We'd be back again if we return to Berlin.

Absolutely incredible apartment in a very peaceful yet central location. No complaints at all from any of our party. Will be recommending to anyone looking to visit the city. Spotlessly clean and very easy to find & check in. A massive thank you from all four of us!
Lugar agradable y cómodo.  Muy recomendable

A truly beautiful, hospitable and completely equipped/functional flat.  The flat (and building) is also very kid-friendly, a priority for us travelling  w/ a toddler.  As the photos show, Frank's place is very spacious, yet cozy, and has all the quality amenities we needed as a family.  The flat was a wonderful place to call home for 8 days w/ transportation, groceries, restaurants, shopping and much more just steps away.  Frank and Ingrid are very kind and communicative hosts.  Highly recommend staying here!

Very nice, quite, and peaceful place in Steglitz area. The room is as described with an unexpected lovely high ceiling. Comfortable bed and the opposite park is nice with bicycle trail. Bus stop is so next to the building and the closest grocery shop is less than 3 min walk (Lidl). The place is on the 2nd floor without elevator and the room is clean. The house is equipped with a workable kitchen and utensils. Washer works really great. Sebastian is friendly, responsive, and able to help you when in needs.
Alles wunderbar, Angela hat uns mit offenen Armen empfangen und uns gute Tips für den Abend gegeben!
Alla was very quick to respond to messages and very helpful. Apartment was close to public transport so it was easy to get around.
Great stylish apartment with a central location perfect for exploring Berlin. Host was very helpful and accommodating, would definitely stay again.
Dorothea ist eine liebe Person, gerne wieder.

David fue muy amable y atento.
El apartamento tiene todo lo necesario y una cocina compartida. Está bien conectado con el bus 200 y las líneas de tram M5 y M10 a menos de 5 min caminando
Nuestra estancia fue muy buena, lo recomendamos mucho!

We stayed for six nights at this lovely modern appartment in Kreuzberg. We absolutely LOVED the neighbourhood. Even in front of the appartment there was a very nice spot (Tzom) to have a drink.

The appartment was clean, nicely decorated and spacious enough to have a very comfortable stay. It was easy to acces by public transport.

The contact with Alex was easy, he answered quick if we had a question (we didn't have many).

One small downside for us was there was very few towels since there was no possibility to do laundry. (Just one kitchen towel for a 6 night stay, for example).

Overall, a very good experience at this apartment and well equipped. Host was very responsive.
An excellent location at 300 meters from subway.
Paid street parking is very expensive. Matteo’s suggestion to free parking at 20 minutes walk was appreciated. Also found out that parking available at Kaufland for 9 euros a day.
We would come back at anytime.
Alles gut! Sehr zu empfehlen!

Depto ubicado a 5 cuadras de una esracion de subte q queda actres paradas de Alexander Platz q es lo mas centrico.
Departamento muy bien provisto , limpio y muy calido, amplio y luminodo.

Cozy and cute apartment in an excellent and vibrant neighborhood with lots of bars, shops, cafes, close to subway and bus options. Very comfortable bed and bright and clean room. Ella was a lovely host who was very responsive and accessible. I would def recommend...

Mycket trevligt och centralt läge. En perfekt liten välutrustad lägenhet för ett stadsbesök. Lägenheten ligger högt så man störs inte av stadsljuden om kvällen. Det är nära till både mataffärer och restauranger. Karak var mycket hjälpsam och tillmötesgående och lät oss stanna ytterligare då vårt flyg gick sent. Det underlättade oerhört för oss.
the host was friendly and quick in communicating asked for help with accomodation.

Thérèse was the perfect host. She was very accommodating to our arrival time, quickly communicated and made sure we felt right at home. Her place is lovely, very clean and centrally located. Thérèse offered lots of suggestions and we really enjoyed staying with her. Next time we come back to Berlin we will certainly try to stay with her again.
Gute Lage und nette Gastgeber

location in Prenzlauer Berg is a big PLUS.
lack of kitchen facilities is a bit negative (but this was communicated through the host beforehands). all in all a recommendation :)
Excellent location close to Neukölln and Kreuzberg. Very clean and bright. Betty and Stefan are very communicative and helpful. Highly recommend.

The place was great. The apartment was clean and well put-together. The host was extremely kind and very helpful throughout the entire checkin/ out process. There was even a bottle of sparkling wine waiting for us when we arrived. The WiFi worked well and I would recommend this place for 2-4 people.

I had an awesome time staying at Petra's place. Felt right at home and the surroundng areas were very nice and peaceful.

Would definitely recommend this place as a good spot to base yourself in Berlin
Petra is an amazing host and takes a lot of pride in her space, and goes above and beyond to provide instructions and recommendations for your Berlin stay.
The lodging and the kind host Jessica including her cat have been a very posirive experience and made my stay in Berlin a true joy. Thanks.
Great location, easy check-in 24/7, clean and modern room, no fridge

Werner ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Wohnung war sehr sauber und hatte alles, was man braucht (auch Kaffee, Gewürze o.Ä.). Sie liegt jetzt nicht besonders schön, aber gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr.
Für unseren Kurz-Besuch in der Hauptstadt perfekt!
Vielen Dank!
Very chill , Host always responds very quickly and helps with any questions or needs you might have.

the apartment was clean and as shown in photos, the host was very helpful and responded quickly to all messages. what was very helpful was that they let us know as soon as the place was cleaned so we could get in early! a little far from the centre but very close to train/underground station so travel was incredibly easy
Very nice place! Convenient location, nice layout of the apartment, friendly host, all in all, recommend to spend time here!
Ausreichend grosses Zimmer mit Hochbett, Küchenzeile und Duschbad für 2Personen in super Lage. Check in problemlos, Out auch. Wir waren sehr gerne bei Kristina
Thank you! We really loved this unique and beautifully styled space. We felt right at home. Hope to return again soon!

Ich habe 3 Wochen in Jörns Apartment gewohnt und mich dort sehr wohl gefühlt! Die Wohnung liegt in einer tollen Gegend: Bayrisches Viertel, Akazienkiez und Ku'Damm, Wittenbergplatz und Nollendorfplatz sind gut zu Fuß oder mit dem ÖPNV zu erreichen. Die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet, hat eine tolle Größe und Aufteilung - alles so wie beschrieben und in den Bildern zu sehen. Ich habe im hinteren Schlafzimmer übernachtet, dort war es sehr ruhig. Jörn und Zahid waren super freundlich, immer gut erreichbar und haben mir nützliche Tips gegeben. Ich kann das Apartment absolut empfehlen und komme gerne wieder!
Amazing Location! Good Host!

Refiner's place is great! It's a lovely space in a vibrant and fun neighbourhood. Lots of amazing bars and restaurants hidden away in the back streets.
Very close to public transport, S and U trains to get you anywhere you need to be very quickly including a direct line to the airport, it couldn't be easier to get there.
I'd definitely recommend this property to anyone who likes a vibrant up and coming area with lots of hidden gems to discover and doesn't mind climbing the stairs! Although lots of stairs seems to be a running theme in Berlin
Sehr schöne Wohnung. Noch schöner eingerichtet als auf den Bildern. Perfekt für einen Städtetrip
Really charming flat. Pavel and Rick are welcoming and helpful. 10 of 10!
sweet, sehr freundlich

We had a really wonderful stay at Louis’ place. Location was perfect, close to public transport and in the middle of the Prenzlauer berg area. Beautiful church close by. Great apartment, comfortable beds and bathrooms. Enough privacy (we were traveling with 1 child 10 yr old). Nice interior, authentic building, we immediately felt at home. Louis is a perfect host, and is pro actively sharing tips, which are super useful. We didn’t want to go back home!! Thank you for a lovely stay Louis!
Comfortable and clean, great location.

Très bel appartement,
il y a 3 chambres et une seule salle de bain dans laquelle sont les WC, mais cela s'est très bien passé
ma chambre était voisine de celle d'une autre personne, et nous nous "entendions" un peu
l'emplacement est parfait pour visiter la ville.

I really liked the space. Slept like a baby. Everything was fine. Five stars.
If you don’t know Berlin, rest assured it’s easy to reach, easy to get around the city on the U-Bahn or S-Bahn, and it’s a great area to enjoy life in.
It was cold in December. It even snowed. But I had a great time; and the apartment was warm and welcoming. It only felt chilly when I stepped out of the super hot shower.

Great location on outskirts of the city. Apartment as described. Very lovely and friendly host. Only couple of small issues, it was very hot and no AC but was a particularly hot weekend and the water from the shower ran all over the bathroom. Other than that, great stay
The place is well located, with many restaurants and coffee shops nearby. The room doesn’t get much natural light, but it’s fine. The kitchen is fully equipped with all the necessary items.
Ganz großartig :) Sehr schöne Ferienwohnung und sehr freundliche und zuvorkommende Gastgeber :) Dankeschön :)

Christianes hat eine nette 2-Zimmer Wohnung, mit allem ausgestattet was man braucht.
Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt.
A very nice apartment with friendly and professional service situated in a charming part of Berlin. We would certainly like to stay here again!
Great location close to most amenities. All ordered and furnished in fine metropolitan style. Very calm area, large spaces and comfortable rooms. Host just available and super easy going
Godt tilrettelagt leilighet for 3 par. Kort avstand til kollektivtransport. Restauranter og butikker i nærområdet.
Nice flat, really quiet in Prenzlauer Berg. We stayed 2 nights. We enjoyed it!
Schöne, funktionale Wohnung, alle Basics vorhanden, super Kommunikation. Hat alles gepasst.
Werner war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Das Zimmer hält was es verspricht. Alles sauber und einwandfrei
A terrific location and an exceptional apartment. I Cannot recommend it enough.
Very clean and comfy flat. Close to amenities and super nice host. Would highly recommend.

100% recomendable el lugar es cerca de todo y es hermoso.
Great experience. Clean easy

Nice place. Highly recommended!
Appartement und Lage Top. Wir kommen gerne wieder

Nice place, worth price. Easy to get around!
Very easy to check in and room was fantastic.
Great place great host!

Die Lage der Unterkunft ist perfekt, weil man durch die nahe Haltestelle schnell überall hinkommt. Der Check-In war unkompliziert und auch das Zimmer ist sauber gewesen. David ist ein hervorragender Gastgeber!  :)

Great location, easy to get to restaurants, bars, cafes and touristic locations. Not close to club/nightlife though if that is what you are coming for. The apartment itself is beautiful and well decorated. The room is quite small and I would say good enough for one person only. Franziska was accommodating for our late check-in due to flight cancellations and let us keep our luggage in the unit for a late departure. Overall pleasant stay.
We had a great time with the airbnb and especially the beautiful garden. Everything was exactly as on the fotos. Thanks for the comfortable stay

Very nice location, surrounded by nice cafees and restaurants. A nice room with lots of privacy. There were a few cons, such as the windows not being able to close properly, which the hosts tried to fix with tape. Furthermore the toilet was running and the bed consisted of two seperate mattresses that kept sliding apart. Its not big issues, but it impacts the overall impression. With that being said we had a very nice stay and we were definitely pleased with the room!
Great little place, would highly recommend - we had a lovely stay.

We had a lovely week at Amélie‘s! The apartment is huge - there was so much space for the two of us, we could have stayed with one or two more people. The area is not really ‚Kiez‘, like the typical Berlin style with old buildings and charmy cafés, but we still appreciated the location very much. It‘s so central that you can get everywhere very fast.
We would defenitely book her place again!
Honestly we’ll worth the price and location was great very clean and accurate to pictures!

What a wonderful place and enjoyable stay! Liza really created a little oasis with her accommodation. We felt right at home, the room and bath were modern and lovely, and the sheer abundance of coffee shops, restaurants, attractions as well as the subway and other public transportation near Liza's place is just perfect for a stay in Berlin. Thanks again!
Eine wunderbare Wohnung in der nähe eines lebendigen Viertels. Trotzdem ruhig und für erholsamen Schlaf geeignet.
Fragen wurden sofort beantwortet. Flexibler Check in. U-Bahn war in knapp fünf Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar. Viele Kneipen und Restaurants fußläufig erreichbar.
Good value.
La estadía en casa de Jürgen estuvo muy bien. El lugar limpio y cómodo para dos personas. Jürgen muy servicial y atento. gracias por todo!
It was nice and very clean.
Lage ist top, um in die City zu fahren. Unterkunft sauber und pünktlich bekommen. Wir würden wieder buchen.
Unterkunft war top, wenn man eine günstige Übernachtungsmöglichkeit im Zentrum Berlins haben möchte.
Good stay, clean and exactly as described
Amazing location, stunning flat and lovely hosts! Really was the perfect place to stay in Berlin. Thanks again!

really good location easy to walk around and use local transports.
the apartment is large and clean.
the host was really friendly and helped me with some requests!
strongly suggested

Unser Aufenthalt in dieser Unterkunft hätte besser nicht sein können! Mit Bus und Bahn ist man sehr gut angebunden, der Check-in war super nett und die kleine Wohnung ist an Charme nicht zu überbieten. Alles war absolut sauber und die Betten waren sehr gemütlich. Ganz klare Weiterempfehlung!

Lovely place to stay! Very clean and neat. Ece and family are very warm and friendly. I interacted mostly with her mom, and she was very kind and took really good care of me. Made it really feel like returning to a home away from home! Ece is superb on communication, and has been very kind with my changes.
The place is literally a stone's throw away from the U8 station, and 5min from a S bahn station. Location is exactly as described.
House rules are easy to follow, and there is a really good orientation to introduce them.
Perfect for single travellers looking for a quiet place, and still close enough to the hustle and bustle.
Nette Gastgeberin, überraschendes Abholangebot wegen Zugsverspätung und äusserst unkomplizierten Fahrradverleih. Sehr gutes Preis-Leistungsangebot. Ich komme gerne wieder!

Top Lage und sehr ansprechende Unterkunft.
Maja ist freundlich und sehr entgegenkommend.
Empfehlenswerte Wohnung für einige Tage im Herzen von Prenzlauer Berg.
Beautiful apartment in a great location.  Easy to walk to various restaurants.  Definitely worth the stay.

Sehr angenehm.

Jun’s place was extremely clean, lovely and in a great location. He and his wife Wicky were great hosts!
War alles super , empfehlenswert
Beautiful apartment in a great location
Beautiful apartment in nice quiet location. Louisa was fabulous and helpful
Gute Lage, sehr sauber

From start to finish Timo was great and very helpful! The apartment looks just like the photos. Has everything we needed. The location is great and is walking distance from Spittelmarkt U-Bahn station. The bakery across the road is so good, and the supermarkets are 2-3 minutes away. As we arrived early (10:30am), Timo offered to keep our bags til check in and suggested we go and check out Berliner Dom which is walking distance away. He also offered to let us keep our bags in a safe place after check-out til our flight.
Thanks Timo for the lovely stay! The apartment is beautiful, wifi was great and the smart TV was a good touch :) would definitely stay again!

Five star ⭐️ stay at Frank’s. Nice place, great base for my work trip, transportation is a breeze, and Frank was flexible in allowing an early check in which made a big difference as I had to get straight from the airport to the apartment to drop off bags, shower, and get to where I needed to be. The place is tastefully and minimally decorated. Everything is clean and in perfect condition. I look forward to staying there again. Thanks, Frank!
Great location! The apartment was very simple but had everything that was needed. Easy and flexible check-in.

The place was very good, the location was great a quiet neighborhood near the center and very easy access to different transport to all areas in the city.
The communication with the owner was very fast.
The only think that was a little bit annoying were the 6 doors that you have to open and unlock in the building before entering home.
Dave war ein toller Gastgeber und die Unterkunft entsprach vollkommen der Beschreibung. Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und kann es nur empfehlen :)

Meine Frau und ich sind mit unserer Tochter dort gewesen. Das Studio war sehr gut für drei Personen geeignet. Es gibt ein kleines Schwimmbad, eine Sauna und einen Fitnessbereich, die wir genutzt haben. Die U-Bahn ist nur drei Minuten entfernt und für das Auto gab es eine Tiefgarage im Haus. Für einen Kurzurlaub in Berlin sehr zu empfehlen.
Nice clean place. Good to work in. Convenient for S-Bahn or U-Bahn.  Saturday market in square 200m down the road was an absolute delight!

L'esperienza nell'alloggio di Tori è stata ottima. L'appartamento è molto bello, comodo e tranquillo, totalmente aderente alla descrizione. La zona è perfetta, centrale e molto comoda per visitare la citta, spostandosi a piedi o con i mezzi pubblici. Anche se non ci siamo incontrate personalmente Tori è stata sempre molto gentile, disponibile e presente. Tutto perfetto! Sicuramente un luogo dove tornerei  avendo l'occasione di trascorrere ancora alcuni giorni a Berlino.
Der Check-In hat reibungslos geklappt und das Zimmer bietet alles wie erwartet. Ich komme wieder :)
Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Sehr gute Kommunikation. 2 Minuten bis zur U Bahn Station, 5 Minuten bis zum Alexanderplatz. Ich kann das Zimmer gerne weiterempfehlen.

the apartment is in a great neighborhood. very quite at night and yet has lots of cool places to hang out, eat and drink.
it does require to go up to the fifth floor, but it has a small and nice balcony and nice views from the living room . it has all facilities as mentioned and was comfortable during our stay there. we recommend
Sehr nette Wohnung! Lage top und trotzdem ganz ruhig im Innenhof!

The pictures don’t do it justice! This is a lovely place to stay. We were here for a couple of weeks during which time I “worked from home”, and everything ran smoothly. Florian was quick to respond to any query, and his helpful neighbour was on hand to help out too. Be warned, there are lots of steps on your way to the top floor. But don’t worry, as long as you’re not at death’s door, you’ll make it up just fine 😉
Thank you, Florian
eine sehr ruhige urige Unterkunft und das in Kreuzberg....erstaunlich...
Beautiful apartment lovely and clean and cosy would definitely stay again

Had a lovely stay at Beatrice’s cozy home! It was in a great location near lots of cute cafes and the Tempelhoffer park, and yet still nice and quiet for a good nights sleep. Haelan was the best! We loved the place, the environment, the style and Fatty the cat. Haelan was very kind and welcoming but also give us our space. It felt like home.

Great location in Prenzlauer berg and the photos don't do the apartment justice, it's nicer and bigger than it looks! Perfect for our family of 3. Our baby loved the toys and and the baby bed and chair made things easier. We would stay there again and can recommend to others too!

The apartment is lovely and cosy, with beautiful plants that lend a tropical jungle feel. Peaceful bedroom with an extremely comfy bed, well-equipped kitchen where you can cook and eat, extremely pretty bathroom. The living room is full of natural light and perfect for relaxing and working out. The biggest surprise was a gorgeous writing desk that wasn't shown in the photos. I really liked the location, as you are right next to Sonnenallee station with many supermarkets, shops, restaurants and cafes within walking distance. The neighborhood is lively in the daytime and quiet at night. I had a perfect stay and felt completely at home.

Séjour très plaisant grâce à la conjonction d'un hôte particulièrement accueillant et bienveillant, d'un appartement plein de charme et d'une localisation dans un quartier vivant et bien relié aux transports en commun.
Hautement recommendable.

Hat alles super geklappt. Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben und die Kommunikation mit Jeannine super unkompliziert. Wir hatten die Wohnung für uns allein, die Lage ist ruhig und trotzdem ist man schnell mitten im Geschehen. Durchaus zu empfehlen :)

Ursula's place is so incredibly comfortable - spacious, quiet, and relaxing, exactly what you'd like while on vacation. We were traveling to Berlin on holiday and experienced a bit of cold and rain during our stay. Ursula's place was always the perfect refuge. Excellent location - walkable to shopping, food and clubs and very close to public transit for everything else. Truly enjoyable.
Ótima experiência. Anfitriões muito simpáticos e prestáveis

It was a great decision to stay there , dear Maciej was so helpful and kind. 🙂 The building's location was just amazing and very close to the main area, the room and the flat was very clean and tidy. I truly suggest it to who wants to experience Berlin. 👍
Auberge de jeunesse très bien située, avec cuisine et salles de bain parfaitement équipées, équipe très disponible et à l'écoute.
Fantastic place to stay!  A new hotel, very clean and in a perfect location.

We loved our stay at Jodi's house! Because she was on holiday as well, we had the house for ourselves, but she left us a clear list of tips and house rules. Last but not least, the bathroom was perfect!
Eine wunderschön eingerichtete kleine Wohnung mit Park gegenüber, sehr ruhig und trotzdem super gut per S-Bahn erreichbar. Komme gerne wieder.

Ansonsten war alles zu unserer Zufriedenheit.

Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und komme gerne immer wieder.

Tina’s place Is really fantastic: great location, great space and a very nice and helpful proprietress. Tina helped us with all issues and was a great source of information. Her place is very clean, quiet (despite the unusual surroundings which didn’t bother us at all), really great value for the money spent, and only about 5 minutes from Wittenbergplatz, from where everything can be reached in no time. We definitely come back! Thanks a lot, Tina!

Met Marcus zeer goed gecommuniceerd over in- en uitchecken. Alles zeer schoon en conform foto’s en beschrijving. Goede rolluiken om kamers te verduisteren. We hadden in de vroege ochtend wat last van verplaatsen van vuil containers, kan Marcus niets aan doen, oordoppen wel gelukkig. Zeer tevreden! We komen graag terug. Communicatie met Marcus zeer goed en vriendelijk.
Appartement très bien agencé, agréable à vivre, nôtre séjour c’est bien passé !

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt und konnten uns auch bei schlechtem Wetter eine gemütliche Zeit dort machen. Es war sauber und es gab insgesamt eine gute Ausstattung. Ein- und Auschecken ist unkompliziert.

Sebastian war ein guter Gastgeber. Uns wurde alles super verständlich erklärt.
Alles sehr sauber und hohwertig. Die Lage ist zentral, viele Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und Restaurants in der Nähe. Bis zur U-Bahn musste man nur 5 Minuten zu Fuß gehen und die Bushaltestelle ist direkt vor der Tür.
Es ist wirkliche eine tolle Wohnung.
Kann man nur empfehlen.

Host was excellent but the accommodation didn’t really live up to my expectations. Very small, bathroom needs a better shower curtain as 1 shower floods the bathroom. Host was great though
Very clean apartment in a nice area with access to public transport. Excellent communication. I would stay here again.
a lovely stay. super easy and cozy

La habitación es tal cual se ve en las fotos, muy linda, amplia y cómoda. Tiene acceso privado para no molestarlos y está buenisimo. El barrio es muy tranquilo y muy lindo. Volvería a elegirlos!
This place is a beautiful penthouse with full amenities and fantastic location!

Fantastic apartment, spacious and well lit. 2 minutes walk from the U Bahn. Very suitable for longer stays with fully equiped kitchen, dishwasher and a washing machine (bring your own detergents though..).
Cot and high chair were waiting for us as discussed.
Contact with email prior to arrival as we didnt get a response with airbnb messeages.
Mind that city taxes have to be paid directly to the hotel when you check-out.
Very good stay for a family

I can only echo all the superb reviews of Audrey's place and her excellent hosting.  "5 stars," all around, and I simply hope that I'll be lucky enough to find it's available for a return visit to Berlin.
un apartamento super bien ubicado, prácticamente nuevo, una estancia super agradable! recomendado 100%
Olga’s place has everything you need for a great stay. It is close to the train station, and Olga is very helpful with her instructions and will guide you to the place. The cat is super friendly too!
Tobias was a wonderful host! Always available and had a very nice, clean place with great facilities. Would definitely recommend staying at his place!

Very welcoming greeting. The property had everything we needed and was very clean. Anybody wishing to stay close to the centre but wishing to see a bit more of the outskirts it is perfect. A short drive from the airport.

Julia’s place is so gorgeous! Impeccably decorated, gorgeous natural light, cozy and comfortable. My favorite part was the giant bathtub.  It is in a fantastic location right across the street from a train station with lots of cafes and restaurants nearby! Walking distance from the Berlinische Gallery, Jewish Museum, and the König Gallerie. Get ready for a workout- the place is on the 5th floor with no elevator! It’s worth the climb, I promise!! Julia is a sweetie and a great host

Апартаменты маленькие, но очень уютные. Были приятно удивлены оставленным вкусняшкам. Единственный минус этих апартаментов - это отсутсвие шумоизоляции. Очень слышно все, о чем говорят в других комнатах, соседей сверху, шаги. В остальном очень понравилось, апартаменты советую!

Franziska hat ein sehr gemütliches, kleines Zimmer welches sie vermietet. Wir hatten alles aufgefunden wie angeben. Bin 25/30 Minuten läuft man entspannt zum Alexanderplatz auch der Rest der Stadt lässt sich von dort aus gut erlaufen.
Wir empfehlen das Zimmer gern weiter und würden auch wiederkommen! =)
Todo ha ido bien.

Süße Unterkunft in perfekter Lage. Die Kommunikation war sehr einfach und immer äußerst freundlich.

En ljuvlig lägenhet med en stor härlig balkong mitt på Hackescher Markt. Vi trivdes mycket bra. Rekommenderas verkligen om man vill bo centralt.

very good location, a lot of shops,restaurants and metro stations are nearby.
Place is ok, bed can be more comfortable.

Gut aufgeteilte Wohnung in einem sehr ruhigen Hinterhof. Habe mich gleich wohlgefühlt. Unbedingt zu empfehlen.

This apartment was very centrally located and perfect for exploring Berlin.Mayaan welcomed us and was very helpful. As was Roi who communicated with us via email a few times over our stay. The only negatives we had were the 2 beds and pillows, both were too soft for our liking but that is a personal preference and the noise from,what I can only assume,is the stone deaf next door who listened to her TV late into the night at a very high volume.Not great if you're a light sleeper like me!

I was here with my brother nine(9) nights in december 2023.
Sleeping
It is a quiet neighbourhood. Only one of the rooms had blackout curtains, but especially this time of year it was not a problem. (Beds are far away from the windows and there are semi-opaque curtains that do provide sufficiënt privacy.)nine
Facilities
I missed nothing. Some of the mugs were a bit greasy; probably a previous guest just didn't use enough dishwashing detergent.
Location
Public transport is nearby. We found that Görlitzer park is locally infamous for drug users doing their thing there at night. But I visited it few times during the day and we crossed a part of it at night without feeling unsafe. So it's really not that bad. And the roads leading you around the park are normal/safe.
Communication
I only had contact with the co-host (Sophie). All went flawless and she responded reasonably fast on all our inquiries.
All in all a great stay at affordable cost. I would definitely recommend / visit again!
Gut und freundlich

Beliggenhed dejligt centralt, men helt ugenert og roligt. Spøjst og hyggeligt kvarter. Indkøb (både dagligvarer og shopping), caféer/restauranter og offentlig transport i gå-afstand. Parkering tæt på (men uden kortbetaling og maks. 20 Euro-sedler!). Køkkenudstyr og service i rigelige mængder til 6 personer. Toiletpapir, skraldeposer, håndsæbe, opvaskemiddel, køkkenrulle mv. var en del af pakken. Kæmpebonus. Og vi var meget glade for opvaskemaskinen!
Vi var seks voksne personer af sted, og man skal være obs på, at der ikke er meget privatliv. Var fint til familie (to voksne med søn på 18 med kammerat og datter på 23 med kæreste). Anbefaler at læse beskrivelsen grundigt - det står der, men kan være svært at se for sig.
To minusser:
1) Vi savnede et sted at samles alle seks ud over spisebordet.
2) Udeområdet er benævnt "enclosed courtyard with a garden". Det er reelt en asfalteret baggård med grøn bevoksning op ad hegnet, og ingen sol når derind.

Daniel's place in Berlin is simply terrific. It is located in a new trendy part of the city full of restaurants and other amenities at every price level, and with some of the best connected public transportation lines literally at the front door. The room is newly refurbished with exquisite taste and attention to detail--Daniel is a prominent Berlin architect--down to the best shower stall I've ever experienced. Daniel lives next door, so it makes the check in and out very easy. He is a delightful host, charming and knowledgeable, happy to chat if you want or leave you alone if you don't.

Zentrale aber sehr ruhige Lage im Innenhof.
Alles ordentlich, sauber und neu.
Netter und unkomplizierter Kontakt!
Klare Empfehlung.

Die Gastgeber sind total freundlich, und nachkommend.
