The place looks really nice, just like in the pictures, very spacious and stylish. The service was good and the communication was easy. The location is good, not the closest to the city but near a train stop where you can hop on and get into the city.
Sehr schönes und sauberes Apartment. Sehr liebe und gastfreundliche Hosts!
Clean, great staff. Little bit noisey, we enjoyed our stay here.

Pobyt spędziliśmy bardzo przyjemnie oraz produktywnie, bardzo dobra lokalizacja, miejsce parkingowe za opłatą, spacerkiem około 5 minut do przystanku, jeżeli zdecyduje się na pobyt w Berlinie bardzo chętnie wrócę do Citylight
Good place to stay for a night or two!

i had a wonderful stay at petra's. the apartment is very clean and well maintained and the room is spacious and light and has everything you'd need. petra is very generous and helpful and full of information. she left me little notes outside my door each morning telling me if she was out and asking if i needed anything :-) i would highly recommend staying here !
The flat is comfortable and functional and the balcony is a nice bonus. Our favorite part is the neighborhood which is incredibly diverse, has a multitude of meal options, and feels very safe.

Die Wohnung war sehr leicht zu finden und da sie sich im Erdgeschoss befindet, sehr gut erreichbar. Viele Restaurants finden sich in der Nähe und das Tempelhofer Feld ist ideal für einen Spaziergang. Die Umgebung ist sehr ruhig und man findet Parkplätze direkt vor dem Haus.

Loved the personnel, great for a quick stay. The area is full of shady characters , druggies, bums, but its a general feeling of those gentrified Berlin areas these days. It is only good for a single person and i would expect-it to be cheaper , but i guess it is a market price nowadays
Konum çok güzeldi. Alexanplatza 2 durak mesafesi. Kaldığımız yer çok temiz ve moderndi. Tuvaletler çok temizdi
Da geh ich wieder hin.

Tia's apartment was amazing! We had a great stay and as her place is in such a good location, we were perfectly placed to access all the cool areas that Berlin has to offer. The apartment was clean and super cool with really big rooms and separate (both big) bath and shower rooms. It was really comfortable including the beds and Tia was really helpful leading up to and during our stay, being on hand to answer any queries we had.
We can't wait to come again! Thanks for a great stay Tia. :-)
Great location, very clean and spacious. Amazing hospitality!

I stayed in this apartment for a month on business and it was everything I needed and more. Very easy access to the local train station and local grocery stores within walkable distance. The hosts and managers are very responsible and wonderful And I will definitely be staying here again on my continuing travels in Berlin!

A great place to be!!
Warm room and clean hostel! Always warm water and the reception team was very helpful in everything we asked for. I recommend it for everyone! Great option for all type of travelers!

Lugar hermoso , limpio y bien ubicado. Me encantó que realmente tienes todo lo necesario en la habitación desde shampoo hasta espuma para rasurarte . Tori fue súper amable y cordial . Recomendado ampliamente

Dietrich’s place is perfect for visiting Berlin. The apartment is just one block from public transport so you will find easy to go everywhere.
Despite the super authentic decor you will find all amenities you need for a confortável stay including coffee machine and an amazing shower.
I will leniently recomendo Dietrich’s place for anyone coming to Berlin.

Lo pasamos muy bien en el departamento de Birgit, es ta cual lo que esperábamos. El espacio es muy acogedor, sobre todo para estar con chicos. La ubicación, si bien es un poco lejos de las zonas turísticas, esta muy bien comunicado con el transporte publico.
This was a comfortable and well located apartment, no bells and whistles, but perfect for a short stay in Berlin.  Arrangements were easily made and we had no problems.
Wirklich schönes Airbnb, hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Tolle Gastgeberin, gerne wieder :)

Abbiamo soggiornato per quasi due mesi in questo alloggio e devo dire che è stata una delle esperienze migliori mai fatte a livello di soggiorni Airbnb. La proprietaria è stata gentilissima e ha sempre risposto in tempo rapidissimo e la casa è davvero comoda, fornita e in una posizione strategica. Ci mancherà molto, speriamo di tornarci un giorno!
Cozy apartment, great location! And very friendly hosts :) would recommend!

Henrik was a great host. He was there for us if we needed him, but also gave us our private space. The rooms were clean and warm during winter time. The apartment is very central and in a safe area, metro and tram stops are in close walking distance, as well as several cafés and restaurants. Would definitely stay here next time! :)
My stay was amazing! I recommend that place and region

We had such a nice stay at Maja's place! The neighborhood is amazing, with lots of restaurants and bars in the street and Mauer Park is just around te corner.
It was also very easy to reach by public transport.
Furthermore, the apartment felt very homy and cozy and had a great vibe!

Nina's flat is very unique. It is not far from the city center (Brandenburger Tor) by tram, but it is located in a quiet area. You can find a big Rewe close to it, and there are good restaurants in the neighborhood (including a vegan café which is very nice). In addition, there is a beautiful park in 5-10 minutes distance, where you can do your running workout if you want to.
The communication with Nina was perfect, she was friendly, asked me if it is OK with me and did everything to make me feel myself at home. I am very happy that I could stay there. Highly recommended!
Place ok. But be aware: lot of stairs and no elevator.

Fantastic location which made exploring Berlin really easy. Andre's place is beautifully renovated and was very comfortable and clean. We loved being so close to delicious vegan restaurants and cafes. I would definitely stay here again.

Fabian and his family are absolutely wonderful! We had a few hiccups in our trip planning and Fabian came to our rescue more than once. The apartment is fantastic and has everything you need. A short walk to the subway station and then you're in the heart of Berlin. All of our expectations were exceeded.
Très bon séjour, Alex répond rapidement à mes demandes et l'appartement correspond à l'annonce.

Everything was great, I liked the room, the staff was friendly and always helped us when we had certain requests. The place is convenient, right next to the metro, not far from the park and there is a Bio Company nearby
Dankeschön, bis in Zukunft nochmal

This is an absolute gem of a space in Mitte. It is adjacent to several lovely cafes and restaurants as well as the park, pond and bier garten, and is within easy walking distances of several transit options and attractions. The neighborhood is picturesque and tidy, bustling with locals and featuring several quirky shops that our party spent several afternoons happily exploring. The apartment itself is quiet, clean and modern, with comfortable beds and a lovely patio and courtyard area just outside, all with substantial security from the street.
Stephanie was a perfect host, happily accommodating our party's different arrival times as well as last-minute schedule adjustments. She was always easily reachable and happy to provide guidance when asked.
Travelers could not ask for a better place to stay when traveling in Berlin. It was wonderful and I would recommend it it highly.

Ich habe in einem Zimmer im obersten Stock gewohnt, das sehr gepflegt war und mit einer kleinen Bibliothek ausgestattet und mit einigen Bildern dekoriert war.
Die eigentliche Gastgeberin ist die Mutter von "Clearwater", eine äußerst nette und zuvorkommende ältere Dame.
Kurzum: War alles wunderbar! Wenn ich wieder in Berlin ein Airbnb bräuchte, würde ich wiederkommen.

Very nice apartment with lots of space, everything you need close by and easy to get to other parts of the city with public transportation just a few minutes away. The host was super helpful and quick to answer any questions we had.
This is the amabasy of backpackers in Berlin. I met a lot of people and had a wonderful time. Strongly recommended

I have had a wonderful and comfortable stay! I'll be definitely coming back
The staff is so so friendly and considerate, and they take great care of the place to the slightest detail, enough to make one feel like home.

Heel leuke en ruime kamer. Er waren wel geen gordijnen waardoor we mee opstonden met de zon, in de winter is dit niet zo erg maar in de zomer kan dit wel eens wat tegen steken. De accommodatie was op het bovenste verdiep, waardoor je wel heel erg veel trappen moest doen, als je wat minder te been bent raad ik dit minder aan. Voor de rest kon je alles gebruiken binnen het appartement en was alles zeer proper.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und Lorenz war immer freundlich, hilfsbereit und schnell erreichbar. Die Wohnung war sehr ruhig und von dort gut alles zu erreichen.

We loved staying at Ina’s apartment in Kreuzberg. We were traveling with our 16 month old baby and Ina provided a travel crib, which was all set up for us, plus a high chair. She also let us check in to the apartment early, which helped immensely so we could get our travel weary toddler down for a nap quickly on arrival. The apartment is well located, walking distance to shops and restaurants. It is quiet and the bed is very comfortable. We could definitely stay here again if we come back to Berlin.
Merci à Sergue pour les bagages déposés en avance à l aller et repris après au retour : très pratique !

Eine großartige Unterkunft mit vielen liebevollen Details etwas außerhalb vom trubeligen Großstadleben.Wir haben Berlin von seiner wunderschönen, naturbelassenen Seite kennenlernen dürfen!
Das Häuschen ist gut ausgestattet und den wunderschönen Garten durften wir mitnutzen. Die nächste Bademöglichkeit ist nur wenige Meter vom Haus entfernt.
Als Familienunterkunft geeignet, allerdings sind Wohn-und Schlafbereich zusammen und die Treppen sehr steil, auch wenn sie oben durch ein Gitter gesichert sind.
Eine super Unterkunft für alle, die neben dem Sightseeing auch Berlins Natur und Umgebung kennenlernen wollen!
Katrin und ihre Familie waren großartige Gastgeber und haben uns jederzeit tolle Tipps gegeben!
Wir kommen gerne wieder!

L'appartement est très bien situé, facile d'accès pour des arrivées tardives (digicode), très confortable pour un couple mais pour une famille de 4, le couchage dans le salon est un peu spartiate. Peu d'éléments pour cuisiner.
Buona posizione, centro raggiungibile a piedi o con la metro. Pulizia e ambiente ottimi. Facile ma sicuro il check-in/check-out a orari scomodi.

Wir haben uns in der Unterkunft von Ulf und Caroline sehr wohl gefühlt. Es war blitzsauber, gemütlich, ein sehr bequemes Bett und wunderschön weiche Badetücher. Wir haben auch sehr tolle Tipps für die Gegend erhalten. Wir werden sehr bald wieder kommen!
Logement top! Malgré la communication compliquée au debut Amit est un très bon hôte!

Beautiful space in the perfect neighborhood to use as a home base from which to explore Berlin. We did a ton of walking in all directions but were always happy to come back to this neighborhood for dinner and drinks in the evening. The space was airy and open, very comfortable beds, everything we needed.
Schöne grüne Oase in Reinickendorf. Apartment ist schön hell und freundlich. Alles war sauber und ordentlich. Richtig gute Kommunikation. Hat uns richtig gut gefallen.

Die Wohnung ist geräumig, ruhig und sehr gut gelegen. Die Sonne scheint auf der Straßenseite morgens in die Zimmer. Die Tramanschlüsse sowie die relative Nähe zur Ringbahn lassen einen sowohl die Gemäldegalerie als auch Charlottenburg in einer knappen halben Stunde erreichen. Unsere späte Anreise war für Duc Son kein Problem, und das war eine große Erleichterung. Dafür möchte ich noch ganz spezifisch danken. Die Kommunikation war insgesamt unkompliziert und lief wunderbar. Es war ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt in Berlin.
sehr unkompliziert, ruhige Wohnung, alles bestens

We had a fantastic stay at the flat. It’s perfect for a group stay. 10 min bus from the central train station and some good places nearby too. The flat was so clean, spacious and had everything you need.
Easy to communicate and the place was very clean and in a great area. Looks just like the pictures.

C'est Erich, un ami de Patrick qui nous a accueillis et il était très disponible, très serviable !
Le logement est de grande qualité pour passer un séjour super confortable ! Nous étions deux couples d'amis et l'appartement est parfaitement agencé pour que tout le monde ait de l'espace et de l'intimité.
Le quartier est calme tout en étant proche de toutes commodités : il y a un arrêt de S-Bahn juste à côté qui mène directement dans le centre ville.
On ne pouvait pas espérer mieux pour notre semaine à Berlin !
great apartment, nice location Jeff help us with a guest guide that was very helpful overall
Good location of apartment

Marius is one of the best hosts I have ever met, just as his apartment. It's super clean and offers even more than you could expect: we forgot our toothbrushes, but they were there already. In case you need something else - from shampoo to juice, there's a possibility to buy it just in the main corridor outside your apartment door. Marius himself lives in the same house, so he's always there to help, to recommend anything you should need: from transportation to cultural events or restaurants. As you can see in the pictures the apartment itself is actually one space, conveniently divided into separate zones for sleeping, working, eating. I absolutely loved it.  Due to historical house requirements the toilet is actually next door outside the apartment, but this makes no problem at all - no one else is using it. The double bed is combined of two separate sections, so there is a small gap between mattresses - but even if you prefer one-piece bed, this inconvenience is not substantial comparing to all other advantages.
Ruhiges kleines Zimmer, nett eingerichtet. Ayako ist freundlich und hilfsbereit. Das Kopfkissen war etwas klein als ich da war, es wurde aber ein weiteres angeboten.

Die Lage des Apartments war recht zentral in Berlin Kreuzberg. Die nächste U-Bahn Station ca. 5 Gehminuten entfernt und alle Sehenswürdigkeiten, Stadtmitte uvm. in kürze zu erreichen.
Der Check-In verlief reibungslos und die Anweisungen vorab waren detailliert und hilfreich.
Die Wohnung war grundsätzlich wie auf den Fotos dargestellt und die Ausstattung wie im Inserat beschrieben. Wir fanden einen bereits gedeckten Tisch vor. Dadurch wurde allerdings auch sehr schnell deutlich, dass dieser schon länger gedeckt war. Die Wohnung war zum Teil sehr staubig, das Geschirr auf dem Tisch ebenso. Ich habe das große Schlafzimmer im Souterrain bezogen. Auf dem Kopfteil war eine sehr sehr dicke Staubschicht. Zudem floss das Wasser in der Dusche kaum und sehr langsam ab. Sollte zukünftig mehr darauf geachtet werden, kann ich das ich das Apartment dennoch problemlos weiterempfehlen.
Great location, nice neighborhood, and the apartment it's perfect.
Very nice apartment

Beautifully appointed, modern unit in a safe and quiet neighborhood just a hundred yards from public transit (and half a mile from the Sportforum!). The host is as friendly and hospitable as could be -- I'd give Jan six stars if I could!
A very good experience! The apartment was exactly as what the photos showed and was near to all public transports: very convenient!

Sympathische Gastgeber, unkompliziertes Prozedere, gemütliche, ruhige, schöne Stadtwohnung - (über die Enge des Bades sieht man gerne hinweg) - zu jeder Zeit wieder! Danke nochmal an Arzu & Tom!
Margit und Matthias
Cozy room in a lovely apartment that is well connected to central Berlin. Madlen is very friendly and you have everything you need. Highly recommend!

Ik ben Maenhout Denis, en had 2 Nachten in kamer met 1 bed, was voor mij op alle fronten een goede scoore...overal vlak bij, en met 1 dagpas van 7 euro kun vlakbij het trein station, overal in mum van tijd naartoe...geweldig....groeten Denis.

Sehr schöne und gut gelegene Unterkunft. Der check-in ist easy. An der Unterkunft liegt direkt die Tram mit der man überall hin kommt. Das Apartment ist sehr schön und hat alles was man braucht. Beim nächsten Berlin-Trip gerne wieder 😉
Alloggiò molto carino e accogliente, dotato di tutti i comfort e in posizione centrale in quartiere molto bello, servito, ideale per visitare la città! Consigliamo vivamente

Doerthe’s place was incredibly big and in an area where public transport, amazing restaurants and supermarkets/drugstores can be easily reached within under 5 minutes by feet.
The place itself provides anything you could ever ask for! We were impressed and enjoyed our stay a lot! Doerthe was always available and gave us a quick tour explaining how everything works. I would be happy to stay there again when coming back to Berlin.

Hardi is so kind, nice and well organised. The room was clean and just like on photos. At the begging he gave us clear instructions about the space and everything. Perfect host, great location, it’s just 10/10

Es hat alles super geklappt. Die Wohnung war wie abgebildet, nett eingerichtet, ordentlich und sauber.
Kommunikation und Übergabe hat alles gut geklappt.
Gerne wieder.
Tolle Ladenwohnung mit Hochbett zum Kraxeln und allem was man braucht. Schönes lebhaftes Viertel mit vielen Cafes..

Nice, clean, central flat. Maybe a bit overpriced. However, I can still recommend staying here. On the downside wifi did not work and Max was unavailable and did not answer emails. Check-in went alright, though we never met Max or Marlen in person during our stay.
convenient apartment in a charming neighborhood. bigger than the photos indicate. overall good experience
Florian’s place is beautiful and the location is amazing! He was really helpful with accommodating my bags and offered suggestions for things to do when I asked! I would absolutely stay here again!

Top locatie & Fijne bedden! Er zouden wat grotere pannen en ketels aanwezig mogen zijn, zodat makkelijker ontbijtje gemaakt kan worden voor een grotere groep. Verder is dit appartement zeker een aanrader.

Le logement est vraiment bien situé, il est dans quartier vivant de jour comme de nuit. Il se trouve à moins de 10 min à pied du U5 qui fait la ville de gauche à droite, et du M10 qui vous emmène facilement vers plusieurs point d'intérêt. Le logement est vraiment top pour 1 à 2 personnes mais le prix est assez conséquent (peut-être étais-je dans une période pleine ?)

Mike and I just wanted to thank you for our amazing stay in your lovely home.  You went above and beyond your duties with making sure we were having a good time, getting the synthetic pillows for me and our lovely bottle of sparkling wine on arrival - (unfortunately, we didn't have time to drink that as we were out exploring the city too much, something for you to enjoy!) I am sorry if the leak was our fault!  Thanks again, it was such a special trip for us and made even better by your hospitality.
Very minimalistic and cozy. Great location to discover Berlin. Will definitely stay at this place again!
Great location, good place & host !  The appartement was perfect for a few days in Berlin.Recommended!
hat alles problemlos geklappt und war alles genau so wie beschrieben. gerne wieder !:)

Die Unterkunft ist total super, gemütlich und einladend 😊 auch die Anbindungen an Tram etc sind sehr nahegelegen. Die Kommunikation mit Berlina war unkompliziert, einfach und zuvorkommend. Immer wieder gerne und sehr zu empfehlen!
Die Wohnung war okay und gut gelegen. Leider war der Abfluss verstopft, was das Duschen nicht angenehm machte. Eine Lösung wurde mir nicht angeboten.

wir hatten zwei super Nächte, die Unterkunft ist wie beschrieben, wir konnten unser Gepäck vorm Check-In abstellen und waren deshalb auch vorher schon ganz flexibel. Die Lage ist prima, man kann überall in Mitte und Prenzlauer Berg gut hinlaufen, kulinarisch eh top. gerne wieder!
Overall, everything was good me and my friends. We had a good time in Berlin at Martin’s Airbnb. It’s really clean inside and very spacious.
Francesco and Elisa were excellent hosts and cannot thank them enough for making our stay in Berlin so great!

The apartment is exactelly what you see in the pictures. And it was wonderfull, because you are in the center of Berlin, just beside the big buildings, then you enter this one and gets surprised but the beautiful and welcoming garden. The location couldn't be better, just in front of a subway station (naturkunder museum), what made our locomotion pretty easy. It was also great for our arrival, since we just walked from the main city station (haupbahnhof). The apartment is very cosy, clean, and have all the appliances that you need. Ruth is a very nice, easy going and welcoming person (hope to see you again soon!).  I would definetely stay at this apartment again, if I have the chance of coming back to Berlin some day!
Perfect location, spacious and quiet apartment. A good selection of restaurants and cafes nearby, tram lines as well.

Berta is a fantastic host! The apartment is clean and spacious and B makes you feel at home instantly with everything you need. She has a comprehensive guide of things to do around Berlin and is always available to give advice to those new in town.
Lots going on in and around Neukolln but also a good place if you want somewhere a bit more chilled. It's a short bike/taxi/ubahn to all the nightlife of Kreuzberg and Friedriechsein.
5/5 definitely recommend.

Super schönes Hostel und super Kommunikation mit der
lieben Anne :)
Great place excellent on all levels .  Loved the location.
Tolles Appartement. Sehr zentral und trotzdem ruhig gelegen. Erik war sehr flexibel und super freundlich. Jeder zeit wieder

Wit waren mit der Wohnung sehr zufrieden. Wirklich schön und großzügig und die Lage ist für einen Berlinbesuc ideal, da die Anbindung an die Öffentlichen sehr gut ist. Für Familien bestens geeignet.  Gerne wieder!

Eine schöne Wohnung in super Lage! Die Wohnung liegt aber direkt neben der Ring Bahn - daher super Anbindung - aber bei leichtem Schlaf etwas laut, auch die Baustelle direkt vor der Tür war etwas Morgens etwa laut.
Man sollte auch die Wohnungbeschreibung ganz genau lesen, es wird eine City Tax erhoben die nicht im Preis von Airbnb inbegriffen ist, die Wohnung ist also etwas teurer als gedacht.
Ansonsten war Alan sehr freundlich und die Schlüsselübergabe hat sehr gut geklappt.

I read many reviews and anything positive is accurate, location was most important for me being close to museum island, just a block from the river with a scenic walkway in either direction with restaurants and coffee shops along the way, very close to public transport in any direction. Hot showers and very clean rooms. If you have any questions even regarding covid, or tests, just ask, very very helpful, thank you for hosting me.

Andre's apartment is beautiful and in a superb location. Communication with Andre was very easy and he answered any queries very quickly. We will definitely be checking if Andre's place is free next time we are in Berlin.
todo perfecto! muy limpio y muy atentos!
Gran ubicación y muy buen anfitrión
很棒的住处，周围的餐厅和超市也很多

We had a very pleasant stay at this flat. Everything was very clean and as described. The communication with the host was just perfect - he always replied very fast if we had any questions. We especially liked the location of the flat - the train station and main sightseeings are reachable quite fast with the trams that go regularly. We would be happy to rent this flat again for a stay in Berlin :)

Das AirBnB von Jan ist super schön eingerichtet und sehr zentral! Ich konnte auch problemlos früher einchecken, was sehr angenehm war. Noch dazu hat Jan immer sehr schnell geantwortet, falls ich irgendwelche Fragen hatte.

Ottimo appartamento nel cuore di Kreuzberg; grande, spazioso e pulito.
Kevin è un host fantastico e sempre disponible e ci ha consigliato moltissimi ristoranti, caffè, e locali.
Alloggio perfetto per chi vuole vivere a pieno "da vero berlinese".

The flat was perfect! We were right next to the underground so could access everything we wanted. It was very clean and a map on the wall showed us the nearest amenities. Extremely helpful when we had some questions and very responsive. Thank you so much!

The apartment was very clean and easy to find. The neighborhood was nice, with convenient stores nearby. Transportation was also easy from this location in Berlin. However, it was expensive compared to hotels and other Airbnbs.

Great stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout, making everything smooth and stress-free. Would definitely stay here again!
The Airbnb was lovely, with great nearby transport links. Alan and Guenther were really responsive and very helpful 10/10
Sehr nette, entspannte und unkomplizierte Gastgeber Familie. Komme gerne wieder! Schönes, großes Zimmer gute verkehrsanbindung.
Really nice place, big and well located.
Great location. 10 minutes walk to the Berlin Wall memorial. A few minutes from a great REWE supermarket which super convenient. Great restaurants locally and good connections at the Nordbahnhof.
Nice apartment, very well located, few meters from the subway. Amazing host, I forgot my computer and they helped me get it back really quick.

Wat een fijn appartement! Ligt super centraal en op een paar minuten lopen van openbaar vervoer. Douglas reageert snel en is altijd attent en behulpzaam. Ook de parkeergelegenheid is veilig en handig voor als je met de auto komt!
Het enige nadeel is dat er veel geluid vanaf de straat hoorbaar is, maar met oordoppen of de ramen dicht merk je hier niks van!
Wij zullen zeker dit appartement aanbevelen!

Jens house is great. The conditions of the room, kitchen and bathroom are excellent. And the location is spectacular. The house is located only 5 minutes from Berlin Friedrichstraße station and from there is actually really easy to move to any part of Berlin. Some of the most centric places in the city are in walking distance (10-20 minutes)
Also Jens and Astrid made a great check-in. They are very friendly people and it was a great pleasure for me to meet them.
I fully recommend this place to anyone going to Berlin, and next time I visit the city again I will book Jens place if it is still available.
Best regards,
Alejandro
Arne is a friendly host and his place very cozy!
Sehr freundlich und bemüht den Gästen gegenüber
Nice and calm apartment😊
Erik could improve the wifi .

Wir haben kurzfristig für ein Konzert eine günstige Übernachtungsmöglichkeit gebraucht.
Das Zimmer war sehr sauber, wie auch das Gemeinschaftsbad. Ruhige Lage, die Zimmernachbarn waren auch alle sehr leise. Der Check-In war problemlos und wie beschrieben zu jeder Zeit möglich. Die Lage ist super. ÖPNV direkt in der Nähe sowie zwei Supermärkte, die bis 23 Uhr geöffnet haben. Preis-Leistung stimmt hier. Vielen Dank für den angenehmen Aufenthalt!
We had a great stay, even if we only went back to the apartment to sleep.
Tolle Lage direkt an der Rummelsburger Bucht, Ostkreuz, schönes Zimmer, sehr hell, sehr sauber, sehr zu empfehlen
Great location and host. Very clean and comfortable for sleeping. Good for couples as well :) thank you very much lucio

Es war ein toller Aufenthalt. Alles Blitzeblank sauber; auch im Bad. Jens hat alles erklärt (man könnte z.b. auch in der Küche kochen) und war sehr freundlich, und gleichermaßen zurückhaltend, so dass ich mich auch wohl gefühlt habe, obwohl man ja bei einem Fremden in der Wohnung schläft. Ich hoffe sehr mal wieder einen freien Slot im dem Reservierungskalender für dieses Zimmer zu finden für meinen nächsten Berlin Besuch.
Beautiful, private garden room. Quirky and enjoyable aesthetic. Super comfy bed! Amazing location - couldn’t have asked for better! ☺️
Great place to stay, nicely located. Very quiet area.

We had a great time at Hardy's place. The bed was super comfortable, the apartment had absolutely everything we needed and Hardy made us feel very welcome. The location is especially great, in one of the coolest parts of the neighbourhood.

Nice house. Warm. Well decorated. The bed is in the lounge area which we weren’t expecting.
Nice kitchen and bathroom. Shower is very powerful
Het is een mooi ruim appartement en alle voorzieningen zijn aanwezig.

Byłam z przyjaciółką na weekendowy wypad do Berlina. Pokój naprawdę ładny przestronny i bardzo dobrze wyposażony. Kuchnia też w pełni wyposażona. Trochę mała łazienka ale posiada wszystko co jest potrzebne. Lokalizacja też dobra blisko przystanku tramwajowego i niedaleko wejścia do metra więc szybko można się dostać do centrum. Okolica naprawdę spokojna. Niedaleko jest nawet świetny punkt z kawą i wypiekami na szybkie ale pyszne śniadanie. Jeśli ktoś planuje zwiedzać Berlin na kilka dni to naprawdę polecam.

Overall it was an excellent stay. First impressions of the apartment were good. Clean white linens, however during the stay I became aware of small areas that could have been cleaner e.g. bathroom ledges, door ledges etc.. these things should be improved, but didn’t spoil a terrific stay.
I personally found the entry instructions inadequate for two reasons. There is no indication that there are two entrances to no 67., so when I tried to get in it was the wrong door! It should stipulate the left hand main entrance door. Secondly the instructions should mention going through the white door ahead of you in the second courtyard. Again not major but inconvenient and stressful after a long journey.
There was another issue but that was cleared up very quickly.
All communication was excellent and I would not hesitate to recommend the apartment.
Lots of supermarkets. Rewe is by far the best opposite Deutsche Oper.
Small apartment with everything you need! We had a great time staying here! would highly recommend
Great place, modern and with stylish decoration. I would definitely recommend it!

We had a fantastic time in this gorgeous apartment in the heart of Berlin. It was so close to public transport and grocery shops and made our trip extremely convienient and enjoyable. Ronald was extremely generous and accommodating. Would definitely recommend, an amazing experience
Schönes, sehr gut gelegenes Appartement mit allem was man braucht. Der Check-in war easy und der Gastgeber freundlich und gut zu erreichen.
lovely apartment in a great location

Check-in hat sehr gut geklappt nach vereinbarter Zeit. Kommunikation war nett und einfach. Wohnung liegt im EG, 2 Schlafzimmer, sowie ein Durchgangsbereich mit grossem Esstisch, den wir gut zu fünft nutzen konnten. Sehr sauberes Bad.  Alles in allem hat uns der Aufenthalt sehr gut gefallen, vor allem die gute Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln.

We had a great time at the little loft of Jessica and Carsten. It was cozy and there was everything we need. The location is great and we so much enjoyed reading the book on living with elephants :) Thank you very much for a great stay!

We loved our stay at Thorsten's apartment.
The place was very clean, nice and enough big. It's in a very nice position to take the tram/metro and go everywhere you want.
Thorsten was a lovely host, always kind, available and positive. He has a lot of spices, and we loved that!!😂
Amazing stay, reccomended for everyone!
Zwar etwas teurer aber sehr gute Lage, gute Kommunikation und sehr saubere und ruhige wohnung
Super lækker lejlighed i et dejligt område med masser af gode restauranter og rekreative områder. Lejligheden ligger også på offentlige transport. Super gode og professionelle værter.
Das Zimmer war ein Hotelzimmer, und als solches völlig in Ordnung. Alles drin, in gutem Zustand, angenehmes Bett.
Logement situé proche d’un tram, parfait pour un séjour seul ou à deux
Die Wohnung ist super gelegen, ruhig, sauber, die Zimmer lassen sich vollständig verdunkeln und Stéphanie ist sehr hilfsbereit und nett.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt in Brittas Wohnung. Nochmals vielen lieben Dank!
Das Check-In und Check-Out hat problemlos geklappt. Die Wohnung ist sehr charmant und die Lage/Quartier war perfekt für uns, kommen gerne wieder.
Tolle Lage und sehr ruhiges Haus. Habe gut geschlafen.

The apartment is located near the Opera Haus in Berlin, 200 mt. from the U2 U bahn, from there you can travel everywhere in Berlin.
The check in very easy, Alessa gave you all the infos and help, in case. We spent three days in the flat, it is very silent and with all the confort, very clean. Only if I can suggest to the owner to use cotton sheets for the bed and the sofa bed, and please change the pillows. They are not very comfortable. All the rest is perfect, I really suggest this place for a short holiday in Berlin!!!
Paolo and family

Unser Aufenthalt war großartig. Die Unterkunft war leicht zu finden, verkehrstechnisch sehr gut ans Stadtzentrum angebunden und lag in einer ruhigen, angenehmen Umgebung. Judith und ihr Mann waren sehr freundlich und jederzeit ansprechbar, was den Aufenthalt noch angenehmer gemacht hat. Die Kommunikation war hervorragend und wir haben uns rundum wohl gefühlt. Gerne wieder!
Hotel sehr modern und freundliches Personal, einzig das Zimmer war etwas verstaubt. Ansonsten alles top!!

Come lo scorso anno, sono stata nuovamente da Andrea. Persona super disponibile, molto gentile e soddisfa ogni richiesta. La posizione della sua casa è comodissima per chi deve recarsi in fiera e lo stesso a prendere la metropolitana. Consiglio Andrea al 100%.

Appartamento in posizione ottima e ben collegato grazie ai mezzi. Molto accogliente, luminoso e fornito di tutto il necessario per soggiornare. Nonostante la zona giorno si trovi su una delle vie principali, non si percepisce alcun rumore dalla strada - la camera da letto affaccia sul cortile interno, super silenzioso. Tomas estremamente gentile e puntuale nel fornire tutte le indicazioni utili, sia per raggiungere l’alloggio sia per spostamenti in zone di interesse. Super ospitalità e accoglienza al nostro arrivo! Si è preoccupato di farci trovare già il necessario per la colazione e il primo pasto, con un extra annesso (molto gradito). Consiglio vivamente!
Expect a beautiful apartment, with a big bathroom and a very stylish comfortable space. It was wonderful!
Auf laute Baustelle direkt vor dem Fenster im Innenhof müsste man bei der Buchung hinweisen. Sonst alles super.

Das war schöne Unterkunft. Ziemlich sauber. Kostenlose Parkplatz, kostenlose Kaffee und Tee in Zimmer finden wir prima.
Man muss Zusätzlich 6 Euro etwa bezahlen. Und Kaution entweder 150 Euro oder Kredit Karte Informationen
Super zum Unterkommen. Gute Lage für die Stadt. Bette bequem. Super Küche. Viel Platz

L’emplacement est top, je n’ai presque pas eu à prendre les transports ou les taxis.
J’aurais aimé que le bar soit ouvert un peu plus tard mais c’est quand même très sympa. Je suis parfois timide et grâce à l’ambiance et aux lieux communs je me suis fait des connaissances en 2 minutes. Je recommande totalement !
We got what we expected from this place. Never ran into the host or others staying. Nice view and great access to public transportation. Only complaint is that it smelled of smoke in our room
Sehr schöne, helle Wohnung. Große Fenster. Lebhafte Umgebung.
Great place to stay for a group, plenty of space. Exactly as described. Good transport links.
Gerne wieder alles super!

Arnes lovely apartment was the perfect place to stay on my trip to Berlin. The nieghborhood is great to hang out in, lot's of cafes, shops and art. Also close to all the sights.
Arne is a friendly, helpful host. I had a really fun and relaxing time.

A great luxurious place. With lots of room for a larger group. On two levels with three bedrooms. You can create more sleeping room by using the walk-in closet or the dinning room. Two bathrooms will make sure all can have a shower in the morning.
Located in a second höfe from the street you will have to get up stairs op three levels.
Besides all the space for us the location is perfect. We have a focus on public transportation. The appartement is located directly beside the city ring S bahn and the U2 which connects you to more public transport. The tram M1 line will bring you to the central station in 10 minutes.
Great connections everywhere. A night shop is directly located at the entrance to the appartement.
So if you are with a larger group and are moving around with public transportation? Do you like luxury? This is it!
Eine kleine, simple Wohnung, für Übernachtungsgäste perfekt. Thomas war sehr freundlich und es hat alles wunderbar geklappt. Gerne wieder einmal!

Heerlijke vakantie gehad in Berlijn. Het appartement van Heiko ligt op een hele goede locatie, op loopafstand van Berlin Hauptbahnhof en dichtbij de Brandenburger Tor en de Rijksdag. Het is een heel groot appartement met verschillende kamers, wat het verblijf extra prettig maakt, doordat je altijd ergens een rustig plekje hebt en je de ruimte hebt. Het contact met Heiko is heel prettig en hij denkt graag met je mee. Ook een late check-out was geen enkel probleem. Een heel fijn verblijf in een geweldig appartement. We hadden er gemakkelijk nog een week extra kunnen blijven.

This is a great place to stay for a budget traveller. It is a bit far from the city centre, but really close to train station, so the connection is good. It's a quiet and lovely area with a great park nearby.
Es war schön und leicht und die kurzen Gespräch zum Kaffee am Morgen, waren sehr gemütlich. Die Mietzekatzen fetzen.
ist eine sehr gute Lage in Berlin man kommt überall hin mit der u Bahn
Sehr schön und ruhig und angenehm. Die Unterkunft hat alles was man braucht.
Loved our stay great location

Bonne communication,
Et appartement conforme à la description.
Merci

What a beautiful elegant European apartment! Alex’s place sits in a tranquil, classic European block around a courtyard – so quiet, yet minutes away from some of the best bars and nightlife in Berlin.
Very comfortable apartment, felt very much at home as if I was living like a local. Alex was very flexible in accommodating in my friend’s arrival before me (with early check in) – and even helped me to carry my bags down the stairs at checkout. Highly recommended … discerning guests only!
Leider war es (in der Unterkunft) sehr warm - da die Fenster nicht geöffnet werden durften.
Es súper recomendable! La ubicación es ideal. La casa es sumamente espaciosa y cuenta con todas las comodidades.

El lugar es muy cómodo y acogedor. Excelente para descansar luego de un día de caminar. tiene tiendas baratas cerca, y está justo en frente al parque Tempelhof Feld. Esta muy cerca de una estación de S bahn/ U bahn, lo cual lo hace muy conveniente para moverse por la ciudad.
great location in Berlin, within walking distance of almost all the major historical buildings and musuems

L'appartamento è ben posizionato rispetto alla città ma seppure sia rimodernato è ubicato in un palazzo fatiscente con affacci su cortile interno rumoroso e puzzolente.
L'appartamento è al terzo piano con scale molto ripide e con finestre con vetri rotti.
Le informazioni non sono state sufficienti per capire che la cucina è pochissimo utilizzabile: posizionata nell'antibagno non ha aspirazione e ha solamente due piastre elettriche troppo vicine al lavabo.
Le finestre non sono in sicurezza per chi ha bambini in quanto l'apertura è troppo bassi e pericolosa.
La pulizia non era adeguata per una situazione normale tantomeno per la situazione attuale di covid. lenzuoli SPORCHI stracci sudici sotto l'acquaio lanuggine sotto i letti con residui di spazzature (pacchetti vuoti di sigarette e gomme da masticare sotto ai letti).
Positiva la presenza di aspirapolvere che ci ha consentito di fare da soli le pulizie (è incredibile poichè le regole di pulizia Airbnb sono chiare ed oggi incrementate dal Covid).
E' poco attrezzato per l'accoglienza di ospiti in vacanza sia per quanto riguarda gli accessori della cucina che per il bagno .

Michel and Anne have a beautiful and thoughtfully appointed apartment in a wonderful street in a wonderful neighborhood. Clean, with bright light, big windows for fresh air, an excellent kitchen and bath - all excellent. Communication about arrival logistics was informal but worked out without any problems. We loved our four-day stay and would very gladly come again. Highly recommended.
war alles wunderbar und tadellos, sehr gern wieder mal!

me and my 20 years old son loved the flat, its beautiful, spacious, super clean and comfortable.
the neighborhood is lovely, getting around was easy, after a long day it was so nice to come back to this welcoming place.

Tidy, easy, great futon beds (if you like hard mattresses). I was advised to bring earplugs, which was great because the building is old and not particularly soundproof although the neighbourhood was quiet.
Perfect for a few days to njoy the city.

Nice spot, clean and with nice facilities. Watch out when you book. We did it through Airbnb and paid 80€ more than it was advertised in Booking. We showed that to them, but the hotel didn't compensate us at all.
Anne was extremely helpful and easy to communicate with, she was truly wondeful. The hostel is amazing, faithful to the description, very clean and cozy, it has absolutely everything you might need.

Hi Katharina,
Thank you for worm and plesant stay in Berlin.
Petras

This place was amazing. I got lucky finding this place. It’s basically like a hotel but without a receptionist. It is super close to downtown so you can just walk to the main attractions, or get into public transportation. Definitely recommend it.
Wir waren sehr zufrieden und haben ims sehr wohl gefühlt. Super für größere Gruppen.

Emilia’s home is truly a gem — beautifully decorated with such unique and thoughtful touches that make you feel instantly at ease. Every corner reflects great taste and warmth. It was a wonderful stay, and I would love to return soon! She’s also very helpful and sweet. I had no troubles at all.

We had a fantastic stay at Doerthe's apartment!  The apartment and the neighborhood far exceeded our expectations.  There was more than enough room for the three of us to spread out and the kitchen was well appointed for making meals. Great restaurants and a very affordable bike rental shop are just a few minutes away.  We would not consider staying anywhere else on our next trip to Berlin.
Super close to many shops and the U Bahn, including a super cute cafe right next to the air bnb for morning coffee! Very clean and safe. Great place to stay in Kreuzberg! Thank you Stella!
Perfekte Lage, solide Zimmer, harte & bequeme Matratze, sehr ruhig!

Stayed for a week in Verda’s flat in Prenzlauer Berg. Great place, modern and well-equipped, with a super-cute balcony. The vibrant neighborhood is an absolute plus here. I highly recommend staying at Verda’s.
Just know that the flat is on the 5th floor with no elevator, so get ready to climb some stairs.
Vi hade en trevlig vistelse  hos Etienne!
Logement propre et bien situé, tout proche de l’île aux musées, très bonne organisation et possibilité de laisser ses bagages la journée après le check-out si besoin.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Es war sehr warm und wir waren nicht auf eine Heizung angewiesen. Toller Altbau mit Aufzug, der dem Alter entsprechend gut genutzt wird. Kaffee/Tee auf dem Flur. Sehr ruhig. Bad gut in Schuß. Kostenlose Parkplätze ab Ende des städtischen Parkbereichs ausreichend vorhanden (2 Min. Fußweg) Wir kommen gerne wieder hierher.

Mohammed is really kind and he will explain you every main aspect of the city. However, the place was not clean. The bathroom and kitchen look dirty. The towels were not big enough for an adult and the fridge smells terrible. Although Mohammed is a really friendly and kind host, I feel it wasn’t a really good place to stay!

Wir haben in der Wohnung Weihnachten gefeiert - und es war eine schöne Atmosphäre.
Wir haben gut geschlafen- die Matratze im Schlafzimmer ist super.
Die Wohnung ist etwas in die Jahre gekommen. Einige Möbel sind abgenutzt (Schrank im Wohnzimmer) . Der Abfluss im Bad riecht etwas. Wir haben einen Besen oder Staubsauger vermisst. Die Lüftungsanlage ist laut und nervt etwas.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist klasse, alles gut erreichbar und es war sehr ruhig. Wir würden die Wohnung in jedem Fall noch einmal buchen!

We were welcomed warmly by Angelika and settled into this lovely, very bright and clean flat. Wi-fi and tv were great. The apartment is a block from the tram , good restaurants, and grocery stores. Whoever stays here should be prepared to climb stairs and be aware that the bed, loft area is up a fairly steep staircase. We didn't mind however, and would happily stay here on our next visit to Berlin.
Great host - Nice apartment - Good location - what else do you need ?
Super geniale Wohnung, super Lage und geniales Wohnfeeling.

Super schöne Lage, kleine aber saubere Wohnung. Seltsam ist der aufwändige Check in und der zusätzlich nötige Check out. Zu viele Erinnerungen das man das machen soll. Eher wie in einem Hotel als beim klassischen Airbnb. Aber freundlich!
Freundlich und sehr unkompliziert.
tor perfecte

I stayed in cozy box number 7 and it was a unique and lovely experience! I enjoyed the modern design and the coziness of the place. It is so small that it seemed like a warm hug inside the German winter.
Florian, my host, was very organized and very responsive. All in all, I highly recommend this place to anyone who would like to find a small nest and feel cuddly :)
Great place. Stayed three nights. Was perfect. Only (tiny) drawback is the location. A bit far from the nearest u-bahn

Sofa bed in main bedroom was remarkably comfortable for a single adult.
Good access to tram stops, supermarkets, bakery, etc.
Lots of kitchen equipment with a dishwasher.
Shower was hot with good pressure.
The only thing we would have liked was a comfortable lounge area, rather than just a huge table and a sofa that was difficult to use. No TV either, but that didn’t bother us.
We had a pleasant stay at Benjamin's apartment. It has great location. Check-in and check-out were very easy and comfortable thanks to Benjamin.

Die haben unser Gepäck nicht vor Check-in angenommen (was vorher abgemacht war)
Sonst eine sehr schöne und gepflegte Unterkunft :)

Timo is a very nice guy.
The only negative point about the apartment is that is a little far away from the center, although is good communicated.
Ich fühlte mich sehr willkommen. Es war alles da, was ich brauchte. Ich wurde sogar mit einer persönlichen Karte verabschiedet. Sabine, tut sehr viel, dass man sich als Gast wohl tut.

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohlgefühlt und konnten von dort aus mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln die Innenstadt schnell erreichen (ca. 10 Minuten). Sehr empfehlenswert, wir kommen gerne wieder!

The stay was very good. The location is great with a lot of locals around, great food options. It was not loud at all. Perfect size to stay for a couple of days and to even manage cook something on the spot.

Logement excellent, literie confortable , bien situé et paisible avec vue sur un parc. Proche du métro et des restaurants, mais aussi du parc Monbijou et de l’île aux Musées.
Idéal pour un séjour à Berlin.

The apartment was really nice, very clean and well organized. The host was always available for information and clarifications. The pictures show what the apartment really looks like and the host treated us super well. I thank him for his hospitality and availability and I suggest this apartment to all the people who want to visit Berlin. Near it there are bus stops, S-Bahn and also U-Bahn stops so that you can move quite easily around the city.
Great apartment and perfect location - the toilet broke and it was an instant response and fix from the Sakine. Would highly recommend
Marc was kind, gracious, communicative, and helpful. The apartment is spacious, comfortable, and in a great location. The speaker system and washer/dryer in unit were an added comfort!
Nette Mitarbeiter, zentral, alles verlief sehr einfach und reibungslos

This is a beautifully finished apartment.  Very thoughtfully decorated and extremely clean. The small space was very functional and felt quite large.  Good hearing which was nice in cold November. A good shower with good water pressure and a comfortable bed.  I stayed with my partner and we felt the space fit two well.  It is literally right across the street from the train station.  Berlin is quite spread out and we found we needed to take the trains a lot so this was really, really convenient. Frank was really accommodating when we unfortunately got in very late and overall just really easy to communicate with.  I would definitely stay again.
Urs place was amazing value for money! We had a great stay, very tidy and spacious apartment. Extremely responsive host and clear instructions! Thank you for the hospitality !
This is a great place to stay! Very good location, super clean and super friendly. Would stay again!

Wir waren sehr zufrieden. Ein sehr nettes Ehepaar was höchst zuvorkommend und hilfsbereit war. Die Betten waren sehr bequem und man konnte hervorragend auf ihnen schlafen. Wir würden diese Unterkunft jederzeit weiterempfehlen und freuen uns auf den nächsten Besuch.

Very close to Metro station and the apartment was clean and spacious the room we stayed in was quite noisy a lot of sirens this may not have been as much of an issue in the other rooms as we were in the front one.

Lovely bright and clean apartment in a very quiet and friendly neighbourhood. We loved our stay, it’s close to local shops and the train takes less than 10 minutes to get into Berlins centre!  Would definitely recommend.

Das Appartement ist zwar klein, aber alles notwendige ist vorhanden. Es ist sehr modern eingerichtet. Es gibt außerdem ein sehr nettes Café mit Garten im Haus. Die Lage ist sehr zentral und trotzdem ruhig. Wir waren sehr zufrieden und können das Apartment sehr empfehlen.
Great apartment, great location!
Really nice place in a great location

Excelente alojamiento! Cercanía con los medios de transporte hacia lugares turisticos, bares y supermercados.
La habitacion es cómoda y grande y luminosa.
Los compañeros de apartamento fueron super agradables y la frutilla de la torta: Lupe, una perrita muy hermosa y simpática.
Todo el alojamiento está interesantemente decorado.
Volveríamos a ir!

Sabrina ist eine sehr freundliche und aufgeschlossene Gastgeberin, bei der wir uns sehr wohl gefühlt haben. Unseren Hund hat sie ebenso herzlich empfangen wie uns und kam uns auch sofort zur Hilfe als sich unser Hund bei der Rückkehr von einem Ausflug verletzt hatte. Das Zimmer war sehr gemütlich und die Lage ist einfach top. Wir hatten daher insgesamt einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt und würden jederzeit wiederkommen.

Really enjoyed our stay here. The location is very good with busses and many nice spots nearby. The house was very complete en very very clean! The contact with Gerhard made our trip even better. He is really nice, fast replies and even during our trip he was ready to give tips for things to do.  Our stay was perfect with many many thanks to Gerhard!

Brice war sehr hilfsbereit, freundlich und super flexibel uns gegenüber. Die Wohnung war schön eingerichtet, komfortabel, hell und sehr ruhig im Hinterhof gelegen. Die Lage in coolen Friedrichshain war für uns praktisch. Es  gab nichts zu beanstanden. Sehr zu empfehlen!
Really well located apartment, nicely done and with everything you need. Steffan was very helpful.
Im Sommer eine schöne kühle Unterkunft mit hilfsbereitem Vermieter, die sehr schön zentral liegt!
A wonderful place to stay in one of the most finest Kiez of Berlin!!!
Perfect cozy apartment. Great stay, thanks!

The apartment is very clean and well equipped and has a nice quirky decor. All communication was clear and sufficient. The neighbourhood is quite shabby, but there are many good and reasonable priced cafes and restaurants close by. The subway is only 10 minutes from the apartment.

I've stayed at this beautiful place for about 2 months, and it was such a great experience. Katja is really nice and she's the host who makes guests feel comfortable. I could get responses easily when I had questions. I especially loved the inspiring atmosphere of this place. The kitchen and bathroom are large enough. Also, the neighborhood is cool. There are various restaurants, cafes, shops, supermarkets and parks...! I would definitely recommend Katja's place to others. :)
It was very largem nice, clean and well maintaned. but being in basement may be a problem of steep stairs and small windows

Alojarte aquí es toda una experiencia, la caravana está súper equipada, acogedora y limpia, Sussan siempre estuvo pendiente, muy amable todo el tiempo.
Recomendadisimo si quieres vivir otra experiencia a los alojamientos habituales.

It was a nice place, everything as described on the site.
The only remark was the situation of the bathroom, a little awkward if not staying with family.
Moderne, fin og ryddig leilighet 😊
Sehr schöne Unterkunft.
alles super vielen Dank
This was an amazing apartment, very comfortable and well situated. I had a wonderful time and would highly recommend a stay here.

NUMA once again didn’t disappoint, the listing was phenomenal, exactly matched the description and pictures, the location was super central, right next to Checkpoint Charlie and various other landmarks, just made our stay many folds better. The rooms were impeccable, extremely clean, and ticked all our requirements. Would highly recommend.

Thor's apartment is in a great lively neighbourhood in Berlin, close to lots of good restaurants and bars. You can get to all the close tourist sites quite easily as well from his place. Would definitely recommend it!
Süßen kleines Apartment in sehr zentraler Lage. Gerne wieder!
Logement rénové, intime et très propre. Un peu loin du centre mais transport en commun très efficace.

Het is echt een bijzonder huis. Prachtige spullen en prachtige foto’s aan de muur. Het is alleen een beetje onpraktisch. De woonkamer is mooi maar er is geen bank om lekker te zitten en het werd ook moeilijk warm (verwarming stond maximaal open). We hebben dus 5 dagen in de kleine (wél gezellige) keuken gezeten. Dat is wel jammer natuurlijk.

Die freundliche und sehr vorkommende Art der Gastgeberin hat uns sehr überzeugt!
Wir kommen bestimmt mal wieder.
Sehr sauber, ruhig und zentral gelegen.
Herzlichst Catharina

Nice sunny apartment with a great location. Lots of things that can be explored on foot, e.g. Winterfeldplatz Market on a Saturday, Urban Nation, etc. Easy access to public transport. Quiet street and off-street building ideal if you are noise sensitive. Definitely great value for money.
Wunderschöne Unterkunft mit guter Lage und einfachem Check-In etc.

Nous avons adorés notre séjour à Berlin dans l’appartement de Barbara, l’appartement est situé à quelques minutes en transport en commun d’Alexanderplatz. Il y a un grand choix de restaurant aux alentours et un magasin alimentaires à 3 minutes à pied. L’appartement est d’une propreté irréprochable, conforme aux photos et très bien décoré. Si nous devions revenir à Berlin, nous choisirions sûrement cet endroit.
Nice apartment for this price. Clean, warm. Close to S-bahn . I recommend
We had an amazing stay with Mona and her family and we wholeheartedly recommend their airbnb! They are great hosts and we felt like at home. Everything was top notch and we will visit again.
I had a great time here. The location is very convenient and the apartment was very comfortable.

Great apartment, the beds are comfortable, plenty of hot water, and one of the best equipped kitchens I've come across.
I would imagine the apartment could get very warm in summer (we were there at the end of April and had the windows open most of the time) but there are some large almost industrial looking fans for hot days
TOP Lage! Nettes Personal und sauber.

Sehr einfacher und schneller Check-In
Sauberes Zimmer für ein guten Preis!
Had a great stay, felt like home. Transportation in walking distance. Quick connections to a lot of places in Berlin, thus providing great flexibility for organizing your stay. Room is spacious.

Host was very kind, responsive, and really friendly. We even recived printed information what to visit and where to go.
Accomodation is perfect, cozy, and really comfortable.
Steaming sauna was a surprise, and was really enjoyable after long walks.
Will return to this place, our full recomandation for this host and appartment.
Very good location. Small one bedroom studio room. Heidi was fantastic with communication and very helpful.
It’s a great place and close to the station.

I had a very comfortable stay at Flora's house. The check-in/out was flexible and easy. It has everything you need and the kitchen has so many cooking utensils. The location is a bit far, but it's not a problem because it has good connections to public transport. I highly recommend this place!
This is probably one of the best Airbnb accommodations that I have experienced so far. Everything perfect, not one single thing to complain about. Simply great.

Gerne immer wieder. Wir waren in einem Zimmer der günstigsten Kategorie und waren wirklich sehr zu frieden. Im Gegensatz zu der Beschreibung in dem Inserat, ist das Zimmer voll ausgestattet und beinhaltet alles was man braucht und dazu hat das Hotel auch noch Joshua….
Joshua ist der junge Mann an der Rezeption, er ist äußerst freundlich, hilfsbereit, beantwortet jede Frage und hat immer ein Lächeln für einen übrig.

Eine saubere, durchdachte, ruhige Unterkunft. Ideal für ein bis zwei Personen.
Fußläufige Busanbindung und vieles mehr. Und wer gern etwas mehr im "Grünen" die Sonne genießen möchte nimmt den Garten des Hauses oder bewegt sich einige Minuten in die richtige Richtung... Mir hat der Aufenthalt zu netten Kontakten verholfen ;-)). Ich habe mich in nur kurzer Zeit "zuhause" gefühlt. Das hat mir besonders gefallen...

Fantastic spot and would stay again!
Easy check in/out
Great location close to transit
Host was very responsive and shared recommendations for the area

Logement parfaitement propre et décoré avec beaucoup de soin.
Tout était prêt pour que nous puissions nous sentir bien et détendus dès notre arrivée.
Jun avait fait beaucoup d'effort pour que notre séjour soit le plus agréable possible : présentation du quartier, où déjeuner, dépliants sur les lieux de visite incontournables etc.

We had a great time staying at Maja's place which was a fantastic base for exploring the busy area of Prenzlauer Berg as well as Berlin in general. We appreciated the flexible arrangements for collecting the key as we were checking in relatively late. The flat itself is charming and has everything you need for a comfortable stay with a well equipped little kitchen and a spacious bedroom and bathroom. There is also a little table and seating area in the kitchen which were nice for sitting over a leisurely breakfast or late night glass of wine. A big highlight for us was a very comfortable bath (we live in an apartment with only a shower, so this is a real treat!)We also appreciated being able to do a load of laundry during our stay.
Much as we loved the apartment, the best thing about it was probably the location, situated near the crossroads of two long streets which are thriving with cafes, bars, and restaurants (not to mention an amazing English language bookshop which basically made my holiday!). Maja provided some tips after booking which helped us navigate the wealth of food options on offer. There is also a REWE supermarket about 10 minutes walk away for picking up your own food supplies. There are several metro and tram connections in easy walking distance, and we found it quick and easy to get to both the central station and other areas. You are also about 12-15 minutes walk or a short tram ride from Bernaeur Street which is a must visit if you are interested in the history of Berlin during the time of the Berlin Wall.
The only negative I have to say is that the stairs up to the apartment (which doesn't have a lift) are not to be underestimated! There are a full 4 and a half floors to get up which definitely felt like a work out every time. This wasn't a problem for us personally but definitely one to be aware of if mobility is a problem for you. Otherwise I can't recommend this highly enough, definitely amongst the best AirBnbs I have used.

- The heating didn't work the entire time, without any other heating appliances available, and as the temperatures went lower and lower - staying and sleeping in the apartment became harder.
- The washing machine that was old (As the owner later called out) wasn't working most of them times.
- The internet wasn't working fluently, needed constant turning on and off (at least once an hour) which made Zoom meetings and phone calls impossible for most of the times, so I went out for close-by Cafes with a stable WiFi.
