Sehr sauberes und schönes kleines Apartment nahe der Ubahn Richtung Mitte.  Die Kommunikation mit Dominique war sehr nett, schnell und unkompliziert.

İnnotrans fuarı için gittiğimiz Berlin'de, bu yoğun haftada fiyat/fayda olarak mükemmeldi. Genel olarak evin bulunduğu konum Berlin'in en güzel yeri diyebilirim. Ev çok rahattı, kendi evimizde gibi hissettik. Oldukça geniş, modern dizayn edilmiş çok güzel bi evdi. Henning Und Ariane'ye dostça tavırlarından dolayı teşekkür ediyoruz.
Fijne en ruime bnb. Voorzieningen zijn zoals op de foto!

Frank nous a extrêmement bien reçu.
L appartement est spacieux et tres propre.
L appartement est parfaitement situe pour balade à pied ou velo en plein centre ville !
À recommander pour un prochain séjour

Before I booked the place the host said that I could check in early. Then the morning I came in they said they needed to send me the check in instructions but couldn’t find my number but would jump on at 10am when I landed. I waited for 3 hours to hear back from here and then the location was wrong. Once I complained and ask for a discount she threatened me to say be happy that you have a place otherwise you don’t have to stay there. There was a strong lack of empathy and care about broken promises. The room itself was good but the common areas were dirty. I had come from a long trip so I had no energy to go back and forth and try to find a new spot. So I stayed.
I'm happy in one hundred percent :)
Une chambre propre et très bien placée

This is a great apartment in a very nice neighborhood. This place has everything you might need and is very well designed and clean.
It’s a walking distance to a public transit, supermarkets, museums, etc. I stayed in a couple of places during my visit, and this was my favorite.
Great location , clean and comfortable.

Tia made us feel most welcome and was there there meet us when we arrived. The flat was everything we had hoped for - and more. It was large and beautiful and very stylishly furnished , yet warm and comfortable too . It was very well equipped; the bathrooms were state of the art and the beds were large and very comfy. The main sitting room had plenty of sitting space - unlike many Berlin apartments - and the kitchen area was spacious with lots of counter space.

Ich habe schon häufiger in Berliner Airbnbs ein paar Tage verbracht und würde jederzeit wieder zu Oliver in die Wohnung kommen. Die Lage ist super zentral und gleichzeitig absolut ruhig. Die Wohnung ist perfekt geeignet für einen oder zwei Reisende. Es war alles in gutem und sauberen Zustand. Oliver war freundlich, hilfsbereit und proaktiv in der Kommunikation. Was braucht ein Airbnb mehr?

My husband and I stayed at Robin's place for 3 nights. Aside from some minor issues with the Nuki app at the beginning, which Robin was very quick to resolve, it was fairly easy to use the app to lock and unlock the doors during our stay.
The apartment was very clean. It has an odd layout, but it seems to work well. The kitchen had all the basics we needed, including cooking oils, sugar, and filters for the coffee maker. The bed was very comfortable for us, as were the couches in the living room.
I did find it a little uncomfortable to sit at the counter for eating meals, with the high chairs, but that's probably not an issue for younger folks. ;-)

Wir waren für 1 Woche im Haus von Matthias und Nadja zu Gast. Wir haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen.
Das Haus befindet sich in einer ruhigen Lage im Osten von Berlin. Es gibt einige Buslinien, die einen zu den nächstliegenden Bahnstationen bringen. In Laufdistanz gibt es einen Rewe und bald einen Lidl, ansonsten nicht sehr viel an Infrastruktur.
Das Haus selber ist sehr hochwertig gebaut und stilvoll eingerichtet. Es ist in ein Waldgrundstück eingebettet mit eigener Zufahrt.
Wir haben nichts vermisst und den Aufenthalt genossen.
Die Kommunikation mit Matthias war unkompliziert und zuverlässig.
Einfach Spitze! Wir können das Haus absolut empfehlen.

Hae-Ok was easy to contact in advance of our visit and very welcoming. She wasn't available for our visit but her friend met us instead (as arranged in advance) and stayed in contact through our visit.

We took the Airport Jet Bus (just 2.70 euros) from Tegel Airport to Alexander Platz and the apartment is very close by, just 5 minutes walk, and easy to find.

The apartment is just as described and was clean and well equipped. It is comfortable and good value rather than luxurious - like my own home! It is very light due to having windows on two aspects and glass doors to let the light flow through the apartment. The beds are firm and very comfortable with good quality linen and towels. Good Wi-Fi service. It is on the 8th floor with a 2 elevators serving it. We travelled as 2 couples and there was plenty of space for us.

We loved the location of the apartment. Lots of restaurants within a few minutes walk and a supermarket. The hop on/hop off buses stop at Alexander Platz and we got a 3-day pass and used it for transport around the city.

We really enjoyed our visit to Berlin and would happily stay at this apartment again. We felt we were part of the city for a few days rather than just visiting.
ready to find, free parking on the street, there is a lot of automation in the place with heating windows etc. overall nice place, would go again.

Die Unterkunft liegt an einer größeren Straße und ist einfach zu finden. Außerdem erreicht man den Alexanderplatz in einigen Minuten mit der Bahn. Schwieriger ist die Anreise mit dem Auto, da dass Parkangebot sehr gering ist. Der Check-In war selbsterklärend und das Zimmer was sehr sauber. Es gibt kein Personal, was bei Fragen eventuell zu Problemen führen kann, aber durch die Schlüsselbox ist ein Check-In 24/7 möglich was einfach nur genial ist. Für einen kurz Trip in Berlin ist das Hotel perfekt.
Berlin has definitely become expensive. That said, this studio is in a great location, and Izabela is a very helpful host. The studio is well designed and convenient.

Arzu and Tom were fantastic hosts. Tom welcomed us to our apartment and showed us how everything worked, gave local tips on transport and food recommendations and even booked us a taxi to get to a conference early the next morning. The apartment is spacious, clean, and in a great location.
Very nice area.

Einfache Kommunikation und Wohnung in einer guten Lage und sie war sauber.
Der kleine Balkon ist auch sehr angenehm.
Kann ich weiterempfehlen!

Very nice apartment in a nice neighborhood, it was very clean, fully equipped and had a lot of space for the 3. The apartment was exactly as described and Gert was a great host. We would stay here again without hesitation.
We loved our stay at this place, it’s a beautiful location and very comfortable apartment
Hade det supertrevligt hos Hanyu! Hon var väldigt trevlig och enkel att kommunicera med. Smidig in- och utcheckning. Jättefint rum, precis som på bilderna. Rekommenderar!

Apartamento muito bom.
Muito bem limpo (acima dos outros imóveis alugados por mim), muito bem decorado e com muitos utensílios domésticos. Exatamente como no anuncio.
Katja é uma pessoa muita atenciosa e comunicativa. Nos sentimos em casa.
Wonderfully stylish and in a great location- a stone's throw away from some fantastic restaurants.  An excellent place to stay, and a great base for exploring the city!

Fantastic apartment in an amazing location! Very comfortable and well equipped - much roomier than it looks in the photos! Atto was very responsive and gave us lots of tips for the local area. Would highly recommend!
Perfect location, very nice place to stay.
Safe and quiet area, we had a good experience with Thuy, she was lovely and respectful of our spaces and privacy. The flat was clean and cosy.
Great location, private space, very ideal for all your basic needs in Berlin!

localización cercana al centro y a varias líneas de metro.
Todo limpio y ordenado, buena comunicación y trato, instrucciones precisas para entrar de modo independiente. Todo muy bien, la verdad
Place is easy access the public transportation

La chambre était fonctionnelle et dans un espace calme. Le lit manque un peu de confort. Les transports sont facilement accessibles. Le séjour c’est globalement bien passé, mais nous aurions aimé plus de communication avec l’hôte. Nous devions arriver à une heure précise pour prendre les clés, ce qui n’est pas toujours évident lorsqu’on travail avant et qu’on doit prendre les transports…!

Philipp's place is very stylish, clean and very cozy. Caroline was easy to get hold of on Airbnb messages. the flat is 5mins walk away from U Kottbusser Tor, there are loads coffee shop, restaurant, bar and supermarkets within walking distances that opens till later on the night, which is was very handy.
The only thing i want to mention is, we were instructed to leave keys on the table of the flat or leave it in the Masterlock... we left it on the table...but when we got down to the front door of the building it was locked!!! We had a taxi waiting outside and a flight to catch, it was not a very good experiences! After many many attempts... somebody on the top floor answered our door knocking at 7am to come and unlock the front door for us.... very thankful for this person and word of advise for anybody else stay in this flat in the future, leave the keys at Masterlock when you leave just in case...
All in all still enjoyed staying at this place very much and would definitely recommend this place to others.
Fueron muy amables.
That was nice experience staying with friendly roommates, also Zinger hostel had great breakfast area in hall. local staff give really nice recommendation for see around places. thank you
Thank you. A great apartment with everything we needed, a super comfortable bed and ideal location with easy public transport access and excellent choice of eating out options. Great value for money.
Very comfortable and spacious, with all the details you need for a pleasent stay in Berlim. We do recommend.
Ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt und unkomplizierter Check-in.
genau das richtige für mich.

Es war ein schöner Aufenthalt bei Klaus. Obwohl es ein Zimmer in einer Privatwohnung ist, gab es bezüglich der Badezimmer- und Küchennutzung ( heißes Wasser für Tee oder Kaffee) keine Probleme.
Klaus hilft und berät immer, wenn man Hilfe oder Rat bezüglich des Aufenthaltes benötigt. Auch Check- in und Check-out waren äußerst einfach.
Die Lage ist sehr gut. Vier S-/U-Bahnen fahren ganz in der Nähe der Wohnung ab, und man ist schnell in der Innenstadt.
Nettes kleines Appartement, alles da, was man braucht, sehr sauber, Küche gut ausgestattet, verkehrsgünstig Lage, Vermieter freundlich und hilfsbereit
Great location, very clean, the room looks exactly like in the pictures, we got free towels and bedding and check in was very easy even though we arrived 2 hours later than expected, great stay!

Ich habe die Unterkunft für mich und 2 weitere Personen über‘s wochenende gebucht und bin überaus zufrieden. :)
Sie liegt super ruhig aber nur ein paar minuten von der u-bahn entfernt mit der man direkt zu allen bekannten Spots der stadt fahren kann.
10/10 würde ich jederzeit wieder buchen :)

Смело бронируйте это жилье. Моника замечательная! Очень приятно было остановиться у неё у гостях. Когда приеду в Берлин ещё раз - обязательно остановлюсь у неё! Квартира очень удобно расположена, если добираться до аэропорта Тегель. В общем, от проживания остались только положительные эмоции. Всем советую!

Wir waren für eine Nacht dort, hat alles gepasst und es war super zu erreichen.
In der Lobby haben wir abends noch was getrunken.
Für einen kurzen Berlin Aufenthalt super und gut gelegen.
2nd time staying here and as usual a good place and convenient location at a reasonable price. happy to come back again in the future

Wir wurden super freundlich von Martin begrüßt und mit vielen hilfreichen Tipps für die Umgebung versorgt. Wir haben uns in der Wohnung wohl gefühlt und hatten eine super Basis für unser Wochenende in Berlin. Einem sollte bewusst sein, dass die Wohnung recht hellhörig ist und eins der Betten über der offenen Küche und dem Zugang zum Bad ist und nicht in einem abgeschlossenen Raum.
Nette Berliner Altbauwohnung, sehr ruhig und mit schöner Morgensonne. Die Wohnung war sauber und die Kommunikation super. Gerne wieder.
Great accommodation. Very clean and new.  Everything you need. Hosts were very helpful and friendly. Would recommend this accommodation
Ein schöner Platz, gut zu erreichen von der U-Bahn, alles Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Nähe. Ich habe bestens geschlafen, es ist ruhig. Der direkte Zugang von der Straße gefiel mir gut.

We had a nice stay at Laurie's place :)
The apartment is beautiful and Laurie was quite helpful.
Boris have great flat! thanx

Einzimmerapartment mit kleinem Duschbad und Küchennische (wurde von uns nicht benutzt). Betten (Sofas) waren z.T. nicht so bequem. Für eine Nacht aber eine günstige zentral gelegene Unterkunft für max. 5 Personen. Kommunikation und Check-in problemlos. Gerne wieder!
Sehr schöne und geräumige Unterkunft 👍🏽
Really comfy place, a really friendly host, really close to infrastructure, what more to wish for! Thanks for hosting me :)

The room is very clean and spacious, right in front there is a lidl shop and very close to the building there is a penny shop.  The check in process is very easy as is the check out process.  The kitchen equipment is very complete and everything can be used and functions well.  close to public transportation such as U-bahn and others.

I stayed 2 months at Gudrun's flat and I found it very cozy. To my surprise the roof top terrace was much larger than expected, makes it in summertime or sunny dry weather a great place to stay. Gudrun is a great host - a super host! Thanks a lot!

Klein aber fein. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral, nah zu U Bahn. Museumsinsel zu Fuss erreichbar. Sehr ruhig gelegen, praktisch ausgestattet, ordentlich. Kleines Detail: das gute frische Geruch der Bettwäsche ;-)) Sonja antwortete unsere Fragen sofort und unkompliziert entgegenkommend. Die Angaben, die sie kurz vor die Reise gesendet hat, waren bewundernswert ausführlich (sogar mit Zone der Bahnkarte)
Mooi licht appartement met alle nodige voorzieningen. Comfortabel bed en badkamer. Heel rustige buurt, weinig lawaai.
Recomendado, buena ubicación, cómodo.
Bonne réactivité aux messages: rapide et efficace. Nous n’avons pas eu de soucis! Je recommande
Carola 와 Uli 는 매우 친절하고 숙소는 집처럼 편안했습니다. 추운 날씨였지만 따뜻한 이불과 난로가 있어 전혀 춥지 않았고 아늑하고 따뜻한 숙소입니다. 공용욕실도 청결했고 필요한 모든 게 있었습니다. 조용한 동네에 현지인처럼 살고 싶은 곳을 찾는다면 이 숙소를 추천드립니다.
Had a great stay! would definitely recommend !
Die Wohnung ist schön geschnitten und hat alles, was man braucht. Für uns lag sie optimal zu unserem Fortbildungsort. Die Kommunikation mit Thalia war schnell und unkompliziert.
Great place for one night stay. Very friendly host.

Awesome apartment and more important awesome Michele!
We came to the apartment which was exactly as described, in a great location, great atmosphere and very easy access. The house was clean and everything was waiting for us as expected.
Michele came to visit and it was very nice meeting him, he is very friendly and cool guy.
We had the best time in Berlin and we highly recommend this apartment or any other apartment hosted by Michele.
Will sure come back again!
Cheers,
Tali & Roy

Ruhige Lage, sehr altes Gebäude, rustikal-schick vor einiger Zeit renoviert, bequeme Betten, Vorhang machte es dunkel genug zum Ausschlafen, Fenster zur Strasse sind hälftig mit Milchglasfolie abgeklebt, macht es aus meiner Sicht dunkler als nötig. Schöne große Dusche, bequemes Sofa (Gelegenheit zum Abstellen von Gläsern dort wäre schön), Küchenausstattung dürftig (mehr von Allem wäre wünschenswert plus Kochgeschirr in nicht verkratzt/alten Zustand.

Dennis was a great host, super responsive to our questions and kindly allowed us to store our bags at the property before check in time.
The apartment is like a tardis and so much bigger than the photos suggest!! Lovely place with everything you need
It is a little out of the centre but only takes 10mins or so to walk to the nearest attractions
Great place and would recommend!
Alles gut und gerne wieder
Der Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm, alles ok und wie von Fai beschrieben, schnelle Antwort bei Fragen. Empfehle ich gerne weiter.
Es war ein großes Appartment zweckmäßig eingerichtet. Den Duschvorhang könnte man überdenken.. Ganz netter Hinterhof zum Sitzen!

Прекрасная комната в доме в живописном районе Берлина! Есть все удобства, доброжелательные хозяева! В шаговой доступности остановка городского транспорта и супермаркет.
A wonderful room in a house in a picturesque area of ​​Berlin! There are all amenities, friendly hosts! Walking distance to public transport and a supermarket.
Ein wunderschönes Zimmer in einem Haus in einer malerischen Gegend von Berlin! Es gibt alle Annehmlichkeiten, freundliche Besitzer! Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel und ein Supermarkt sind zu Fuß erreichbar.
Danke schön, Sabine!!!

Wir hatten eine schöne Zeit in Berlin und Severine ist ein tolle Gastgeberin. Sie hatten uns neben vielen hilfreichen Tipps rund um Berlin auch mit Kaffee und und Milch ausgestattet, was nicht selbstverständlich ist. Nochmals Vielen Dank für alles! 😊

A wonderful stay in a big, spacious appartement. The host was very kind, available, ready to meet our every need. The place was clean. It was fully equipped : dishes, hairdryer with even a diffuser attachement! The place is very close to many public transport which made it easy to go out and explore Berlin. There’s a big supermarket at proximity as well. We loved our stay. Thank you Angie

The hostel was very clean and I felt secure. They clean the room everyday! Also, the kitchen in the room was well equipped and convenient. Great location, walking distance to the central area (Alexander Platz). I met some good people and enjoyed staying at the Singer 109.
Clean, exactly as described, friendly helpful people, good value for money
eine super nette Frau. Kann ich nur weiter empfehlen.
Very good location to visit Berlin, close to Alexanderplatz with the tram ! Duc Son is very present for any question
Amazing place, second time that I visited, and will come back!
Nice place in trendy area.
Perfectly close to everything!

We had a lovely stay at Seb’a apartment. He sent helpful photos so we were able to find the location easily and he was always responsive to messages. The apartment was spacious and as described and had everything we needed for our trip! Seb provided a quick tour of the apartment on arrival to explain how everything worked and the places nearby. It was very close to supermarkets and a shop for toiletries which was also helpful for us. I would definitely book a stay at Seb’s apartment again if in Berlin.

A lovely place in the East side of Berlin. Christoff and Irene were lovely hosts and helped a lot with directions around the city. My room was cosy, warm, and quiet and I had a good stay. I would easily stay here again when I come back to Berlin.

Ich bin nun das 2. Mal bei Nook gewesen. Wieder einmal ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt. Unkomplizierter Check-In. Die Sauberkeit empfinde ich als wirklich gut. Die Ausstattung lässt eigentlich keine Wünsche übrig, es gibt eine große Dusche, sogar eine kleine Küche mit Mikrowelle und Herdplatten, jedoch waren keine Töpfe oder Ähnliches vorhanden um diese auch nutzen zu können. Das Bett ist super bequem und es gibt gutes funktionierendes WLAN vor Ort.
Die Lage ist super zentral und man kann die notwendigsten Geschäfte schnell erreichen. Ein größerer Mülleimer wäre auch sehr vorteilhaft. Bei einem Aufenthalt von 2 Nächten ist der vorhandene bereits deutlich zu klein.
Es war ein gemütliches und modernes AirBnb. Es hat alles geboten für einen kurzen, wie auch längeren Aufenthalt und liegt an einen guten Spot. Hier kann man nichts falsch machen!
convenient location in the city

Barbara & Alessandro were amazing and so welcoming! I stayed for 2 nights there and I felt like at home. The room was just like in the pictures. It's simple, clean, and comfortable; totally loved it! It's also quite cold in the room, so no worries in the summer. The area also has a number of restaurants and minimarkets nearby, as well as the UBahn station, so it's really convenient. I'll definitely stay here again next time I come back to Berlin!
top Wohnung, 1a Lage, super Gastgeber und total unkompliziert!
excellent séjour, tout était parfait. je recommande vivement!

Andre was a great host from the first exchange of messages to the check out. He was friendly and really helpful, offering dozens of great tips! The flat is spacious, clean and well equipped with everything one would need. I have stayed there for one week with my sister and a friend, and we had a great time. The flat was very close to public transport, markets and restaurants, which made our lives even easier. I would definitely stay there again, and would highly recommend the place to anyone visiting.
Zöhre war sehr zuvorkommend und freundlich. Das Zimmer ist groß, das Bett gemütlich. Es war alles sauber und die nächste Bus-Station ist 3 min zu Fuß entfernt. Weiterempfehlung!

Mona und ihre Familie sind sehr nett. Der Aufenthalt war okay.  Die Lage der Wohnung war sehr gut. Man hatte einen kurze Strecke zur U-Bahn und zum Bus man kam schnell in die Stadt. Das einzig Negative war das  die Küche wurde mehrere Stunden in Anspruch genommen (ca. 3 Stunden). Zum Teil konnten wir erst um 20:30 Uhr anfangen das Abendessen zu kochen.
Had a great stay at Johannes’ place - the flat was just as described and had everything you could need. Johannes was always available and very friendly and accommodating.

We absolutely loved our stay at Lena's apartment. Beautifully decorated, with an airy feel, quiet, and equipped with everything we needed <3 If you want to stay in a local quiet neighborhood, it is perfect. Communication was smooth and easy, and Lena was very helpful. She even allowed us to check in and out a little earlier and later, as no one else was arriving that day. Cannot recommend it enough – though a part of me wanted to keep this gem to ourself :) Thanks Lena

Die Unterkunft liegt unweit der S-Bahn, schön ruhig und einen Steinwurf vom See entfernt. Das Zimmer ist geräumig und hat alles, was es braucht, um auch länger zu bleiben. Ich konnte mich zurückziehen und hatte durch einen separaten Eingang ein Reich ganz für sich. Die Küche ist so ausgestattet, dass ich mich bestens mit Kaffee und Frühstück selber versorgen konnte. Mehr habe ich nicht ausprobiert. Das Bad ist sehr geräumig, mit reichlich Ablageflächen, sodass ich gut Platz hatte, mich auf Berlin vorzubereiten. Ich war sehr gut untergebracht und kann die Unterkunft weiterempfehlen.

Eve s’est montrer très arrangeante car je n’avais pas vu que c’était pour une personne, elle a accepté que nous soyons deux et a meme fournis un matelas
Eve est souriante et attentive à nos demandes quand nous la croisons
Eve a su nous recommander des activités

Eve n’a pas été réactive par message
Pas de problème pour entrer dans l’appartement mais après il faut deviner où est la chambre
Les espaces partagés ne sont pas neutre

Eve et sa colocataire ont un petit amis et ils sont bruyant ensemble …
Le logement est bruyant comme indiqué dans les autres commentaires
Ève n’a pas de problème avec la nudité

My stay at Numa Drift was perfect. The  communication was easy and fast, the room very clean and beautiful and there is a lot of love for details and little surprises that made the stay extra pleasant. Highly recommend!

Detlef's apartment is very cute and is a great space to relax after being out around Berlin. The kitchen is well equipped. The living room has a nice large tv. The bed is comfortable. There is lots of storage space and plenty of hangers for your clothing.
The location is great and the neighborhood it's quiet and safe. There are convenient connections to several transit options are less than 10 minutes away. The nearby Rewe grocery store is large and has anything you might want. For fitness it's a beautiful walk or run down along the Spree it through the grounds of Charlottenburg Schloss.
The building is nice and cool on hot summer days, which was wonderful since there was a heat wave while we were there. While the building is generally very quiet, one neighbor does keep late hours, coming home and cooking dinner past midnight. Another neighbor has a newborn baby which you might hear faintly at night. Neither is a problem with earplugs, but could be a bother if you're a light sleeper who dislikes earplugs.
Check-in was easy and Detlef was very quick at responding to any questions or issues.
The internet connection is DSL with speeds of 10–13 Mbps down, 0.4–1.0 Mbps up with 802.11g wifi LAN. Fast enough for browsing the internet and video, but with an occasional buffering hiccups while streaming HD. However, uploads are quite slow.
Great place, location and hosts! Highly recommended.

Bothe the place and Jan were professional and great as hosts. We made a mistake in dates while booking which caused some turmoil and a need for us to check out a day early, but Jan was accommodating given the circumstances.

Lovely apartment, clean, comfortable and quiet. The bus and train service into town, regular and on time. You feel you are really escaping the city when you come back here. Make sure you have cash, as there isn't an ATM nearby to get money for the buses or trains.
Value for your money, practical, near the train, grocery and food outlet.

Communication with the host was great, check-in was easy and there was a lot of nice bars and cafes in the neighborhood.
However, the place needs some maintenance. The street was sketchy, wouldn’t recommend to girls walking there alone at night.

tolle Aufenthalt und alles war vorhanden, sogar kalt gestelltes Bier im Kühlschrank .
5 Minuten zum Lidl, 10 Minuten zum Ostkreuz .

Super séjour chez Will, l'appart est immense, les enfants ont adoré la partie en souplex qui est grande et qui fait cabane avec ses escaliers (par contre cette chambre est ouverte sur le salon, ce qui est un peu problématique quand ils dorment  pour le bruit, les adultes étant juste au dessus). La deuxième chambre est très grande : on a été un peu inquiets quand on a vu qu'elle donnait sur la rue (avec possibilité pour les passants de s'assoir juste devant), mais en fait on a bien dormi, sans être dérangé. On se sent très bien accueilli (fruits, vins, boule quiès etc...) et la copine de Will est tout aussi prompte à répondre que lui en cas de pb ! Il y a une des consignes à valise dans le supermarché juste à côté si on arrive avant 15h, c'est très pratique.  Seuls bémols : le canapé lit n'est pas confortable, et la cuisine pas hyper équipée (on a pu se faire à manger quand même hein!).  Bref, un coup de coeur !

L'appartement d'Annette correspond totalement aux photographies. Il est lumineux et calme. Cette partie du quartier de Kreuzberg est très agréable et typique de Berlin. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Annette. Nous reviendrons sûrement.
Great place hosted by an amazing person. Thanks and I will stay again for sure ;)
Great location & beautiful apartment

Wir hatten eine großartige Zeit in diesem gemütlichen Airbnb im Herzen von Schöneberg! Die Lage ist absolut ideal, nur wenige Minuten zu Fuß von der U-Bahn entfernt, was es super einfach macht, die Stadt zu erkunden. Trotz der zentralen Lage war es sehr ruhig und erholsam.

I traveled to Berlin to get a multi-day tattoo at Der Grimm tattoo studio and this place was a 4 minute walk away. So convenient! The apartment was clean and quiet and a relieving space to crash after being tattooed all day. Heads up though, the neighborhood is pretty sleepy. I arrived on a Sunday and everything was closed, so I had to travel into the city center (about a 20 min cab ride or an hour long commute via public transport) to get groceries/supplies/money exchange/etc... During the week when things are open, amenities in the neighborhood are still pretty limited. A few grocery stores a 10-15 min walking distance away, a Vietnamese joint, a bakery, and that's about it. If I was to do my whole trip over, I still think Maxim and Anica's spot would have best suited my needs. But if I was only getting tattooed one day or traveling to Berlin for more cultural tourism, I might choose something in a more exciting neighborhood.
Overall though, this spot was perfect for my needs.

Boian’s guest apartment was a lovely stay for my mom and I. Very close to a metro station and relaxing place to come home to at the bed of a busy day in Berlin. Would highly recommend for first time visitors in Berlin.

We went running around the nearby channels and park during the morning which is also great way to exercise and get to know the neighborhood. The loft has its little challenge to get inside, but following Ulfs instructions carefully you should not have any problem. The loft was very clean, neat, cozzy and everything worked perfect.

The flat was very comfortable and warm. The flat is trendy and the location suited us very well since the tram stop was a minute walk away. The hosts were great at communicating and replied quickly to solve any issues. There is also an Aldi at the end of the street which is great if you want to cook at home. The flat is also great value for what we paid.
There are a few downsides to the flat. Firstly, it is a ground floor flat. You can hear people going up and down the stairs and the door banging shut - so I wouldn't recommend this place if you are a light sleeper. The back room curtains do not cover the window and are transparent - which would be fine if it wasn't a ground floor flat. The back room windows lead out to the courtyard where people will come and collect there bike, they can easily look in. Secondly, the host will send you generic robotic emails which are fine but they did ask us to strip the beds and take the rubbish out - which came across as a bit blunt given that we paid a cleaning fee. They even emailed us after we have left to not publicly write any downsides to the flat which I do think is a bit cheeky of them. Reviews are written for honesty and telling others about the experience you had. Lastly, the flat stank of smoke even though there are house rules to not smoke in the flat. It was obvious that the previous guests or cleaner would have been smoking in the flat since the smoke odour went away after a day.
Fantastic apartment with all the modern amenities. Being welcomed at the apartment and shown around is great.
A really good place. Next to a tram to the city, Lidl a block away. Roomy, and well stocked. Only complaint no TV or washing machine
Geräumiges Apartment in sehr guter Lage um sowohl mit dem Auto zu parken als auch U/S-Bahn oder Bus zu nutzen. Wir konnten flexibel ein- und auschecken und waren rundum zufrieden.
Very nice place. Beautiful and modern apartment. Great and lively district, perfect to hang out at night.
Great location, close to supermarkets, cafes and restaurants. Clean and well-equipped/furnished, lovely decor. We would thoroughly recommend.

Good apartment to visit Berlin. Not in City Center, but easy access to public transportation. You don't get to see the owners of the place, so that's a pity. Pickup of keys is in a nearby shop. The beds are comfortable and it is nice to have two bathrooms. The apartment is basic but clean, with basic kitchen utensils and cookware. The neighbors are quite loud in the stairway and you can hear them inside.
Oliver was a great host. Showed me a lot of things to do around city and very responsive. All around a great stay.

Great location near Alexanderplatz! Right near the Subway system for easy access to the city. Met at arrival and provided with instructions and a guide to the area. Lots of restaurants of all types nearby. Walking distance from Museum Island. Great amenities for a stay in a stylish apartment. Was part of a party of 8 and there was lots of space for all of us. Enjoyed the stay.
Sehr großes Zimmer, angenehm angebunden und schön. Insgesamt ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt, gerne wieder :)
Nice apartment, easy check in. Very good communication with host.

This is a conveniently located and very, very comfortable flat in Kreuzberg, a stones throw from the snaking queues at mustafas infamous kebab stand, and only a short cycle ride from other trend-setting areas like neukoln. All mod cons are on offer, from vintage coffee maker and accompanying retro stove, to TV, wifi and stereo, along with two impressive treehouse-styled bunk beds (double size) with sofa beds below. The home made collage pieces that adorn the walls and Berliner decor are a delight. For a couples trip, or a pair of old pals looking to kick back for the weekend, it's a stylish and well priced option, run by a kind and gracious host. We only met Arno as we were leaving as we found everything we needed in the apartment and didn't need to contact him during our stay! Would definitely stay again. Also, it was very cool inside on the hottest day of the year (37c outside) and has some seats in the shared shadey garden.

Sehr saubere und schöne Wohnung. Perfekt für zwei. Es gibt eine ordentlich ausgestattete Küche und auch alles andere was man Benötigt. Sehr erfreulich ist das es Kaffee, Tee, S/P, Öl, Duschgel und Shampoo vor Ort gibt. Sowas kaufen wir sonst oft und müssen es dann wieder mit nehmen. Sehr Praktisch wenn man nur ein paar Tage bleibt. Wir können das Apartment nur empfehlen.
Für ein Wochenendtrip nach Berlin war es eine super Unterkunft.

Karsten was a really welcoming and helpful host. The flat was MUCH better than what you see on the pictures: wider, well located, with a fridge, clean and everything you need!
We definitely recommend this flat for your stay in Berlin, for a week-end or a month!
the apartment was clean and very very very big. we love it.

Hat gut geklappt, neue Wohnung.
Grosser TV mit Netflix und PlayStation.
Wurde an alles gedacht.
Hoffe bald wieder

Fatto il checkin alle ore 17.00, l'appartamento era completamente sporco, non erano state fatte le pulizie. L'agenzia che gestisce l'appartamento ha cercato un addetto alle pulizie, che è arrivato alle 18.45. Siamo potuti entrare nell'appartamento solo alle 20.30.
Dalla doccia esce un forte odore di fogna che si diffonde per tutta la casa. Abbiamo quindi dovuto tenere sempre aperta la finestra del bagno.
L'appartamento è al quinto piano, ma non c'è l'ascensore, per cui bisogna fare 5 piani di scale ogni volta che si esce e rientra a casa.
I had a comfortable stay. The location is a great mix of private and peaceful in the middle of Berlin. Yvonne was responsive when I needed a clarification.
Was very good
The place is awesome and Daniel was really helpful, would come back here again
Cerca a todo, en una zona tranquila
Loved our time here! It definitely is small, and my 6’3” boyfriend didn’t quite fit in the shower, but overall great stay
Tres belle chambre, immense hauteur sous plafond. Il n’y a pas vraiment de réception mais c’est assez pratique de se retrouver avec les infos via WhatsApp

Apartment was beautifully furnished and exactly as it appears on the site. Transport links were nearby as well as shops etc. Generous supply of items such as teas and coffees also which were a nice touch! Beds were very comfortable and overall the property was airy and spacious. Would highly recommend.

I highly recommend staying here. The rooms are fairly priced, modern and comfortable with lots of nice touches.
The place is very clean and accessible with a train station across the road - ideal for exploring the city. There are plenty cafes and restaurants nearby with excellent quality food. The coffee shop next door provides great coffee.
Virkelig god beliggenhed og fed lejlighed til at dele, familie eller venner.

Regina was an amazing host. The room is so nice with a sectional couch and comfortable bed. And even a private balcony from the bedroom. The flat is located on Admirals Bridge which was so cool. And the neighborhood is fun and convenient. There are many cafes and restaurants steps away. And also close to Metro. I highly recommend staying with Regina.
Diese Wohnung ist wunderschön! Man hat Platz, ein Ausblick, eine schicke Einrichtung und eine tolle Location.

A very nice place to stay. We have been there with 2x adults and 1x 8-year old child and the flat was perfect for it. All amenities are within reach and one of our favourite playgrounds in Berlin (i.e. the 'Jim Knopf & Lukas der Lokomotivfuehrer' Spieplatz) is right on the doorstep! We would LOVE to come back!

Sehr nette Familie,
immer hilfsbereit und aufmerksam.
Das Gegend ist eher ein Familienfreundliches Ort, wo man eher durch den Wald spazieren geht, aber schwierig, wenn man was unternehmen möchte. Das haben Phuong & Martin in ihrer Beschreibung stehen, dass das Ort nicht besonders zentral liegt.
Alles anderes war perfekt.
Vielen Dank für die Gastfreundschaft, immer wieder gerne😊👍

Unglaublich gute Lage und eine sehr gute Ausstattung sodas man Kleinigkeiten wir Geschirrspültaps nicht extra kaufen muss.
Sehr gute Kommunikation
Total schönes Apartment. Alles ist da, um den Aufenthalt gemütlich zu gestalten. Sogar Kaffee steht zur Verfügung. Echt schön. Auch Anna ist sehr sehr hilfsbereit!

We really liked the apartament - modern, clean, spacious, and 2(!) big bathrooms. We were 5 persons share and evarybody loved the apartament. The surroundings where quiet, but If you need anything like a foodstore or an restaurant you Will find it in 500 mtrs. We also got a nice welcome from Carmen.
Louis was extremely helpful and communicative during our stay. The listing is in the cutest little neighborhood!
Nice location, metro directly outside. Great surroundings - coffee shop, supermarket, food places. Large space, comfy bed, ideal for large groups 3+

Das Appartement war für unser Aufenthalt absolut perfekt! Die Unterkunft war genauso wie beschrieben – sauber, gemütlich und sehr gut ausgestattet. Der Check-in verlief reibungslos. Der Gastgeber war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Klare Weiterempfehlung, jederzeit gerne wieder!

Martin's apartment is a practical and cozy apartment (on the ground floor) equipped with all our basic needs. Beds are good, but be aware that you need to climb into them. The neigbourhoud is pleasant, with good coffee across the road, nice pubs and restaurants around  the corner and a supermarket also across the road. We felt very safe and secure in this neighbourhood. There is a busstop nearby that brings you right into the city center.  We surely recommend this place.

Gili is the most welcoming guest you can dream of. He was extremely helpful and the apartment is nice and clean. Moreover, it is easy to go everywhere from his place and the restaurants around are great. Last but not least, for those who like to have a little jog in the morning, Stylish X-berg is just in front of a wonderful park.

The only slight disappointment was that one of the main reasons I chose this place was the large windows which suggested there was a view. However, the photos of the windows all showed curtains, not the view, which was, in fact, into a courtyard, not a city view.
That said, the entire experience was very good and the staff was exceptional.
Great place to discover Berlin ! Apartment hip and clean. Area offers plenty of options for food and booze. Did not meet Gal but communicating with her was clear and rapid. Thumbs up !

Jorg has a very  well situated property. it is close to a major station and a very convenient store next to the station.  Parking is a bit of a problem, but if using public transport which I would recommend you could get from the airport to the house without any hassles.  everything you need for a pleasant stay is there.  From the station everything is within a 30min train ride.
Mega super, mega Freundlich🥰
Die Wohnung ist mit viel Geschmack zum Wohlfühlen eingerichtet und die Gastgeber sind top!
The place was very cozy and clean, but eventually with kids around. The hosts absolutely kind and friendly. Really appreciated the flexibility with the check-out. Thank you very much!
Had a Great stay here, it’s a great location and perfect for me. Highly recommend

Beautiful interior finish with a modern artistic touch and perfect attention to details.
Prime location in the most family-friendly neighbourhood of Berlin.
Easy access. TV and Internet speed could be a bit better.
But a unique flat overall to mark a memorable stay.
Always responsive and very helpful with everything. Also very nice location and surroundings
관광지까지 걸어다닐수 있을만큼 숙소 위치가  매우 좋습니다. 역 앞에 있어서 다른 곳 이동도 쉬웠고 숙소에서 바라보는 텔레비전 타워도 좋았으며 방음이 잘돼있어 시끄럽지 않았어요. 숙소는 매우 깨끗했고 조리도구도 다양해서 좋았어요. 신발을 벗고 생활할 수 있어서 편했습니다.

일주일정도 머물렀습니다. 소파베드라고 해서 약간 걱정했지만 걱정 할 필요가 없었습니다. 침대는 생각보다 훨씬 편안했습니다. 내부는 정말 청결했고 특히 침구류가 깨끗해서 좋았습니다. 또 주방 이용도 너무 좋았습니다. 거의 모든 식기도구가 다 있고 마트가 바로 옆에 있어 직접 조리해먹기 편했습니다. 호스트는 정말 친절했고 설명도 잘해줬어요. 투숙하는데 아주 행복했습니다!
Great spot! So easy to get to everywhere we wanted. Room was super comfy and quiet for sleeping. Great communication and easy good vibes with julian and his housemate.

The flat is realy nice and clean. The location is nice, but you need to expect that it's somehow a place for a shop, you live behind the showcase and inspite of the windows we still heard all the noise from the street.
We also were surprised that the soap was missing, buy I think it's just a small mistake and didn't make a big trouble for us.
I want to notice that the hosts were super nice and the communication was perfect.
So if you don't mind living "in the shop" and not in the standard flat the place is very good and pleasant.
David est un hôte  réactif et plein de conseils ! Le logement est fonctionnel et est proche  de plusieurs lieux d'intérêt.  Il est à noter que l'environnement aux alentours sont assez bruyants.
Super Lage. Alles tiptop sauber. Vermieter ist sehr freundlich und hat uns gute Tips für unseren Aufenthalt in Berlin gegeben. Gerne wieder!
...einfach, gepflegt und sauber..mitten im Kiez, zentrale Lage, zuverlässiger Vermieter, Termine eingehalten bzw. gute Kommunikation...
The spaces and beds are much bigger than expected. Very clean, and very good value
Ich hatte einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Die Wohnung war top und ich habe mich dort sehr wohl gefühlt. Birte war eine nette und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin.

One of the cleanest Airbnbs I have stayed in. Immaculate condition. Kitchen and bathroom superb. Comfortable bed, lots of living space including balcony overlooking street.
Grace was very thorough in her welcoming messages, directions, how to access building and even uploading videos created herself on how to use the coffee machine. ☕️🙂
Very easy to get to from airport via train / subway. Supermarkets, bars, eateries all in the immediate area. During your stay the nearby (5 min walk) Kino independent cinema is worth visiting.
Recommended strongly.
Thanks again Grace.👍
Hôtesse Super gentille, accessible en transport et quartier sympa!
great accommodation
Great location, friendly service

I enjoyed my stay very much. I would come back any time. Everyone was very nice and helpful :)
Stefan's  place was wonderful! We loved that we were so close to a really active area and yet the place was surprisingly quiet. The apartment was clean and perfect for our 5 day visit to Berlin.

Ruhige, saubere und stilvoll eingerichtete Wohnung in super Lage.

We had a great stay in Gabriel and Nadine's loft. The loft is very spacious and modern. The neighbourhood is very cosy and public transport is nearby. Gabriel and Nadine are super hosts.

Very good value room in Berlin.
The flat itself is well located near a subway station which brings you to the main Berlin attractions in 25 minutes.
Two big supermarkets at around 7 minutes walk from the flat.
Nice attention and responses from Parwana on queries and to help on any check-in issues as she lives close by.
Shower in bathroom is good with plenty of power and hot water. Nice supply of travel size shower gel and lotion.
Kitchen is practical with good kitchenware. Nice supply of tea, coffee and biscuits.
Bedroom is good with its own desk and shelves and a flat screen TV.
Bed linen is washed at every stay for sure as there are two laundry machines used by Parwana regularly.
Thanks again Parwana.
Great location, great accomodation and great host!
tolle Wohnung und sehr freundlicher Gastgeber

Een fantastisch en zeer ruim appartement op loopafstand van supermarkt, busverbinding en begin van de Kurfürstendam. Van alle gemakken voorzien. Mark reageerde erg snel om wat kleine probleempjes op te lossen (lege batterijen afstandsbediening) en hij is zeer vriendelijk en hulpvaardig.

Great place. The house is located in a private residential area and is very cozily furnished. We slept like babies. The hosts are very kind and do everything they can to make your stay smooth and comfortable.

Nice place to stay in, a bit far from mitte Berlin, but with its very close proximity to Bus stop and Tram station, every corner of Berlin can be reached with no hassle.
The flat is clean, bright, and warm. I stay there for a month and never found anything to be complained of.
Very recommended for those whose looking a small place to stay and be productive as the neighborhood is not that busy and very quiet.
Kudos to Diana and Marko for the warm welcome, easy to contact and to communicate with.
jerome is super nice and accommodating and the room is so nice and big and clean. I’d definitely reccomend!

Fantastic spot, very easy to travel to and from. Stayed with a group of 6, still felt like we had a lot of space.
Great restaurants nearby, the area is lovely but had no trouble with noise at night.
Doug was very responsive and helpful, and I’m grateful for the flexibility with the check in time!
Melinee è una gentilissima ospite, anche spontanea e divertente, molto loquace! Disponibile, ci ha dato ottime indicazioni e lo scambio è stato super!

I had a very good time staying at Klaus’s place. He is a very polite, considerate and hospitable host. I’m a night owl so we didn’t see each other a lot during my stay, but I could feel from every detail the effort he puts into hosting to make sure guests can have a comfortable and delightful stay here. His apartment is well-equipped and he always has everything organized. In fact long before you come he would contact you, give you useful advice and tell you everything worth paying attention to. I’m very impressed by that, cuz by far he’s the most thoughtful host I’ve ever met. I know it’s silly, but it does fit my impression of German stereotypes, lol.

Nikolas did his best with the limited space (although it is bigger than the photo would suggest) arranging the kitchen station in the hall to suit basic needs. For more space and privacy I recommend Nikolas' other independent flat.

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit dort. Die Wohnung ist riesig, ziemlich in die Jahre gekommen aber sehr stylisch eingerichtet, in einer super Lage und dafür trotzdem sehr ruhig. Der Check-in war leider erst 1 h später möglich als geplant, aber die Gastgeberinnen waren sehr freundlich, verständnisvoll & hilfsbereit. Vielen Dank dafür!
I had a nice stay and really glad it's in a quite neighborhood. The backyars is a nice touch.

Mona is an amazing host! She was very welcoming, kind and helpful. She made us home made cookies and gave us some good tips for restaurants in the city. The room is big and the bed was really good. The bathroom and kitchen are shared but we had a lot of privacy, so it wasn't a problem for us. Although the room is not in the city centre, it was easy to reach by U-bahn and the neighbourhood was really nice, quiet and green. We had a really pleasant stay and we would definitely recommend Mona as a host in Berlin.
Supernetter Gastgeber. Besser kann man einen Aufenthalt in Berlin nicht verbringen. Tolle Dachterrasse. Tolle Wohnung. Insgesamt für uns ein perfekter Aufenthalt! Vielen Dank!

WAUW, wat is dit een geweldig appartement. We zijn hier samen met ons zoontje van 1 jaar verbleven. Er stond een babybedje klaar waar hij heerlijk in heeft geslapen. Ons bed was ook echt heerlijk, zo zacht! Alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig in het appartement. We konden zelfs Netflix kijken, voor ons heel fijn omdat we in de avond niet weg konden vanwege ons zoontje.
Het appartement ligt achter het eerste gebouw waar je aankomt, maar het is super goed te vinden vanwege de instructies die al geschreven zijn! Caroline reageert ook echt super snel als je vragen hebt. Op tafel ligt een boek geschreven door hun met allemaal tips, zeker de moeite waard om te lezen. Hier staan echt leuke tips in!
Wij zijn bij de Markthalle 9 geweest, hier zijn hele leuke tentjes waar je allemaal verschillende soorten eten kan halen, echte aanrader! Voor pizza’s Zola is echt super lekker en niet duur! Echte authentieke Italiaanse pizza’s.
Bij Brammibals hebben ze donuts allemaal vegan, maar ook echt heerlijke koffie! Alle koffie is met havermelk, als je koffie met melk erin besteld.
Plancafe heeft heerlijke sapjes fruit en fruit / groente. Allemaal versgeperst.
Bij Die Brötstatte wat er naast zit hebben ze super lekker brood maar echt GEWELDIG lekkere brownies! Ze hebben ook eigen gemaakte hummus ook erg lekker!
Wat ook leuk is, is om te fietsen in Berlijn! Dit hebben wij gedaan met onze zoon. Fiets zitjes voor kindjes kan je er gewoon bij huren.
De supermarkt zit op de hoek! Het is een biologische supermarkt en ze hebben een groot assortiment.
Je hebt geen lift in het appartementencomplex, maar voor ons was dit geen probleem!
Als je naar Berlijn gaat, ga dan naar dit appartement. Het is echt een heerlijk appartement voorzien van alle gemakken.
Super location, calme and green. Beautiful place to stay and enjoy Berlin. Very nice neighbourhood, excellent communication! Thank you! Wish we could stay there longer.

Very nice, clean and central hostel to stay in Berlin. The staff here and very helpful and welcoming! They also have very good Wifi here at the hostel! I had a very Comfortable stay here :) my only issue was they are not very communicative when the S bahns were on strike i tried to call them on the number provided but my call wasn't going through other than that my stay was perfect in every way

There were many accomadayions in the room
The place is easy to get to.
There is a supermarket nearby which was very conveniant.
My friends and I enjoyed staying there!
The apartment was close to public transport and it was very easy to get to the main attractions. There were lots of affordable restaurants nearby.
Tolle Unterkunft immer wieder gerne 5*

a great place to stay but if you have mobility problems there are lots of steep stairs. comfortable bed and private bathroom . a quiet and peaceful location with perfect hosts. close to the U-bahn station and supermarket. a little out of town but frequent trains to city centre.
Just amazing!
Hat alles einwandfrei funktioniert, wir kommen gerne wieder…😉
Airbnb was erg dichtbij het metrostation, kamer was mooi schoon en host was vriendelijk. Er was ook een uitgebreide collectie boeken en muziek in de woonkamer te vinden.
Sehr saubere Wohnung mitten in Neukölln in Berlin, ruhig, sehr gute Anbindung an den ÖPNV mit Bussen, U- und S-Bahn.
Alles wie beschrieben, ich bin zufrieden.
Sehr cool und schön 🥰 super 👍
The apartment was very clean and nice. The location was great and we found it easy to get anywhere in the city. Our host was very helpful and communicated quickly.

My boyfriend and I stayed for around a week and we both LOVED it!
I absolutely recommend it to everyone!
The house was very clean, extremly well equipped, modern, very cozy and located in a beautiful part of Berlin. It has an indoor fireplace that warmed up the whole house, the bathtub is huge and comfortable for two, everywhere were flatscreen TV's with internet connection, the garden is beautiful (we even picked some tasty apples right from the apple tree), the kitchen is big and well equipped, there is a free parking space on the property...everything was great!
Gino was also super welcoming and responsive and even cut us plenty of firewood. 10/5 Stars. Thank you Gino!
Sehr ordentlich und sauber, Nähe Brandenburger Tor, relativ ruhig und ein freundlicher Gastgeber!
Very nice Airbnb in a very nice area! Close to the metro with good connection. The house was clean and comfy!
I really enjoyed my stay. I will definitely come back!
The pictures  do not do this place justice - it is massive! Lovely apartment, great location. Perfect
Arne was a great host and very welcoming, even had chocolates and a towel left for me. Lovely flat, great location and was made to feel very welcome and relaxed. Would defiantly stay here again.

Les hôtes étaient accueillant,
Je recommande et reviendrai si un jour je dois visiter Berlin,
Merci

A spacious, well-equipped, clean and comfortable apartment in a beautiful 19th century building not far from the Jewish Museum and Checkpoint Charlie. This end of Friedrichstrasse is very quiet and the apartment is at the back of the building, which makes it even quieter. Highly recommended.
We had a great stay at Jun's apartment, quiet area, close to shops restaurants and trams to access greater Berlin. Recommend this apartment for a stay in Berlin

The location was perfect, room clean and as described. Check in was easy. This is a hotel.
Just be mindful that in summer there is no air conditioner. We requested a fan on our first day through the app but I’m not sure if it was received as we didn’t get one. The room was 28 degrees most days and due to the noise we couldn’t leave the door open overnight. We had curtains closed throughout the day and would open doors when we got back to prevent heat My suggestion is for a permanent fan be placed in the rooms to at least alleviate the heat a little.
Otherwise our trip was good.
The coolest apartment in the coolest part of the coolest city in the world. Cooooooooool!
Very nice stay!
todo muy bien. buena ubicación. y súper cómoda la habitación.
Nice apartment with good access to public transport. Timothy was a kind host.

L’appartement de Stefan nous a bien plu et bien convenu. Il est spacieux et très bien aménagé. Il est également très bien situé. C’est aussi grâce à tout cela que nous avons passé un super séjour à Berlin.
Karine et Jeff

Genial apartamento! Ideal para una persona como para dos. El barrio es muy tranquilo y muy bien comunicado. El apartamento tiene lo que necesitas aunque no tiene cocina, pero para nosotros no fue un problema. La cama es muy cómoda y se descansa muy bien los dias de caminata de turismo. Repetiríamos!

Der Aufenthalt war im Großen und Ganzen gut.
Jedoch waren die Fotos vom Apartment irreführend und nicht zutreffend. Wir erhielten ein Apartment, welches deutlich kleiner war als auf den Fotos gezeigt und eher eng war für 8 Personen.
Weiterhin wurden wir anfangs mit einer Kaution von 1000€ konfrontiert, die nirgends erwähnt wurde.
Positiv war die Sauberkeit und die moderne Einrichtung - es hat an nichts gefehlt.
Die Wohnung ist gut gelegen und Supermärkte und Bars sind mit wenigen Gehminuten erreichbar.
Das Personal ist sehr nett, zuvorkommend und hilfsbereit.

Pablo und Sven haben mit ihrem Haus und Garten einen außergewöhnlichen Ort geschaffen. Die Möbel und Ausstattung sind liebevoll und sehr geschmackvoll ausgesucht. Bei Fragen waren Pablo und Sven umgehend zu erreichen. Gerne kommen wir mal wieder.

Amazing stay in this apartment !

The place is located in a nice neighbourhood, close to a U-bahn station, the communication  with Parwana was excellent and the instructions for the check-in and check-out are simple and clear. Recommended!

Das kleine Häuschen von Heiko war gemütlich. Schöne Lage fast direkt am Wasser. Ich war zwei Nächte für „ausgelagertes Homeoffice“ dort. Das WLAN ist schnell genug und stabil für Videokonferenzen. Weiterhin gab es im Haus, alles was benötigt wurde. Das große Bett oben ist bequem und es gibt Möglichkeiten praktisch alle Fenster zu verdunkeln. Ich empfehle die Unterkunft gern weiter.
przyjemny pobyt, trafilismy na super ludzi. troszke cienkie sciany przez co slychac wspolkokatorow.

This a lovely very well appointed apartment in a really nice apartment block right next to the U-Bahn (U2). I particularly appreciated the splendid rain head shower! The apartment is very central and in a good residential area about a 5 minute walk to Alexanderplatz. All in all a 5 star apartment.

We had a great stay at the Storchennest. The Moabit area is nice and there are trams and metro's in +/- 10 minutes walking distance. The appartement is compact and therefor perfect for singles or couples. It requires - as the name suggests - climbing some stairs. The communication was on point and professional.

Mein Aufenthalt bei Werner war einfach nur spitze.
Sehr kurzfristig gebucht, unglaublich schnell reagiert, alles super geklappt. Werner war freundlich und hilfsbereit das Zimmer perfekt in Schuss und sauber.
Mein Aufenthalt war genau so wie ich es mir gewünscht hatte, gerne wieder.
Very nice, clean spacious apartment with new furniture. The only downside there was a construction at the entrance of the building with some noise

Sehr nette Gastgeber, saubere, angenehm kühle Unterkunft. Ausstattung und Preis-Leistung super. Habe das Appartment für die ILA 2022 in Berlin genutzt.
Gerne wieder!
VG
Torsten
Great host. Charming spacious place with good location 👍🏻. Very much worth the money.
Great apartment, easy to access from the metro and close to Berlin centre. Close to grocery store, cafes and pubs. Henrik was quick to communicate and had good local knowledge. Many thanks.

Erwin was very friendly and welcoming! Even though he didn't speak english, communication wasn't a problem. If you want a place that's peaceful + easy on the pocket and don't mind +40minute public transportation to the city center, Erwin is definitely your choice.

Lovely and comfortable place in a great area. Simple and clean apartment, perfect for a couples trip to Berlin. Near some great clubs and restaurants and right next to a nice bar for pre (or post!) going out. Only issue was with the door, it slammed shut behind us and we had to pay for a locksmith to come out so be careful you take the key with you. Great communication from hosts throughout

The checkin was easy. The rooms were spacious and enough for our group. She filled the refrigerator with food which could last for several days :)  She proactively took care of all the things so that we dont have to worry about the dinner even if we arrive late when all the restaurants are closed. They have a large TV and games, but we didnt have time to explore that. We had a wonderful stay.

Sehr große Wohnung mit vielen Schlafmöglichkeiten.
Das Bad war gerade neu renoviert, die Küche war perfekt ausgestattet: Kühlschrank, Eisfach, Waschmaschine mit Trockner und Geschirrspüler.
Die Wohnung liegt im Souterrain und war daher bei den heißen Tage angenehm kühl. Im Hinterhof ist ein schöner kleiner Garten auf den man blickt.
Wir waren zu viert und jeder hatte sein eigenes Zimmer, das kam uns bei unseren doch sehr stark unterschiedlichen Schlaf- und Aufstehgewohnheiten sehr entgegen.
Die Lage ist perfekt, man kann zu Fuß überall hin, die U-Bahn ist auch vor der Tür

I loved everything about our stay at Arne’s place. Arne and the cats made us feel right at home. The area has great access to public transport and is central to shops and restaurants. Berlin was an amazing experience. Thanks Arne 💜
Mooie loft studio op een perfecte locatie!

This was an incredible stay! The apartment was cozy and clean. The location was perfect and very walkable to many really great restaurants as well as fun shopping. Ufuk was a wonderful and responsive host. Could not have asked for more and would stay here again.
Great location for a Berlin Weekend! ✨👌🏾

Respuesta inmediata de las dudas, muy bien explicado todo para llegar al alojamiento, la foto que nos mandó fue imprescindible para no equivacarnos de casa porque el barrio tiene las casas muy similares. Limpieza y veracidad 100% a las fotos. Ducha de agua caliente que sienta fenomenal en el frío berlines!! Además la cama muy cómoda, ideal para turismo de día y poder descansar en sitio tranquilo, con acceso a 10 min a pie del metro (S5 y S7 para ir casi a cualquier sitio)
非常整洁干净，房东很好。注意周日no shopping no malls no supermarket no no no, 一切都关门Sunday.
Very nice place, clean and tidy, with nice free snacks and drinks.

Sehr tolle Whg in lebhaftem Quartier aber dennoch ruhig gelegen. Da unsere Bleibe beim diesmaligen Besuch der tollsten Hauptstadt Westeuropas besetzt war, haben wir uns für diese Unterkunft entschieden, uns aber nicht weniger daheim gefühlt. Die Kommunikation war sehr einfach und unkompliziert. In der Whg war alles vorhanden was man braucht, die Küche ist hervorragend ausgestattet und bietet mehr als man im Urlaub brauchen würde. Für die Fahrräder gibts im Innenhof prima Abstellmöglichkeiten. Wir würden uns auf alle Fälle erneut für dieses sehr nette Temporärzuhause entscheiden, falls sich dies in Zukunft mal wieder ergibt. Vielen Dank und Liebe Grüsse

Diese Wohnung ist sehr schön und sehr stilvoll sowie liebevoll eingerichtet. Genauso stellt man sich eine Altbauwohnung vor! Wir haben uns besonders über den Kaffee gefreut (eine Sektflasche wie in der Anzeige haben wir leider nicht gefunden ;-)
Die Gegend ist toll zum Ausgehen, alle Sehenswürdigkeiten sind außerdem gut erreichbar. Trotzdem ist es nachts sehr ruhig.
Wir kommen bestimmt nochmal wieder (dann ohne Baustelle).
Es war eine tolle Woche.
İmmer weiter so
Perfect apartment in crbt Kreuzberg. Big rooms, great heating and very well set up. Very close to some great bars and restaurants.

Nicky hat alles genau beschrieben. So war es für mich klar, dass ich "ins" Hotel gehen musste; 2.Stock, Code an der Box an der Zimmertür eingeben, dann kann man das Kästchen öffen und den Schlüssel rausholen. Schon ist man im Zimmer.
Auch sehr schön, dass man Kleinigkeiten wie Snaks, Getränke, Suppenterrine für 1 Euro bekommt! Der Kaffee ist sogar umsonst. Und auf Fragen und Anregungen wurde immer super schnell eingegangen.
Der Aufenthalt war super! Ebenso die Bus-/Tram-Verbindung, der Bäcker am Eck und der Grieche am Platz neben der Tram. Alles schnell zu erreichen. Gern wieder, wenn ich nach Berlin komme.
Alles Gute, Evelyn

We were very impressed with this apartment which is accurately shown in the photos. The space is comfortable, warm and homely with many useful items provided (such as charging points in bedrooms). The kitchen is well equipped with a useful pantry of essential items. The bathroom is functional and clean. The washing machine and dryer are very handy. My young adult children were very comfortable in the ‘bunk’ bed room. The apartment’s location is excellent, being both quiet and private but also close to train/tram and excellent shops and grocery stores. Many interesting sites are within walking distance through parks and local streets. Our host Marcus was fantastic with his prompt responses and support (we found the front door keys tricky but Marcus went out of his way to help).  I definitely recommend this apartment for families with children or couples looking for a bit more room to enjoy while traveling.
Incredible location, lovely view! Klaus was a lovely host! The room was very clean, loved staying here!
Ruim en net appartement met alles wat nodig is. Vriendelijke host, die snel reageert en goede tips had qua restaurants. Metro op 1 minuut afstand en bushalte voor de deur.

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung von Lothar sehr wohl gefühlt. Der Balkon und der Innenhof sind ruhig und grün, perfekt zum Entspannen nach einem Tag in der Stadt, die superschnell mit der UBahn zu erreichen ist. Der Bergmannkiez mit den vielen Kaffees, Restaurants und Läden ist an sich auch  eine schöne und lebendige Gegend.
Excelente departamento ! Hans siempre fue muy amable y atento, sin duda volveríamos!!!!

Sehr schöne Altbauwohnung in sehr guter Lage. Guter Bäcker unten im Haus. Die Kommunikation mit Anna verlief reibungslos. Leider kommt auf die ohnehin nicht gerade günstige Miete noch 7,5% Übernachtugssteuer on top. Insgesamt waren wir mit unserem Aufenthalt aber sehr zufrieden.
Josef is a wonderful host. I would definitely recommend this place to you if you are planning to stay in Berlin.

Es war ein super Aufenthalt, es hat an nichts gefehlt. Die Lage ist super und die Wohnung sehr schön.
Der Gastgeber ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Gerne wieder.
Very good host, friendly and attentive.  The apartment is well connected, just 3 minutes from the underground.  Clean, nice and well equipped house.  Thanks Erkan.
El airbnb es muy lindo, y está muy bien ubicado. Muy cerca de la estación de metro, sin dudas en mi próximo viaje vuelvo!!
Satisfactory
Alloggio tranquillo, pulito, facile da raggiungere. Host comunicativo e cordiale. In una parola: perfetto. Grazie

We had a great stay at Alan & Kasia’s apartment. The location was ideal for train links and also for walking into the centre, or to nearby restaurants and bars.
The property was very quiet, with plenty space and a comfortable bed.
The information for check in and getting to the apartment was very clear and detailed, which made everything very easy.
We would certainly stay here again,
Det var veldig rent og leiligheten var kjempeflott. Flott å ha hele etasjen for seg selv, med et funksjonelt bad og en herlig vinterhage. Jeg gjentar gjerne besøket ved neste opphold i Berlin!

Also es war ein schönes und renoviertes Hostel mit allem was man braucht. Es war nur Recht Laut mit der Straßenbahn direkt daneben und die wände waren auch dünn, sodass man die Nachbarn deutlich hören konnte. Auch die Fenster konnten nur mit einem Vorgang verdunkelt werden wo an den Seiten doch noch Recht viel Licht durchkam. Sonst war aber alles sauber und auch die Küche gut ausgestattet und organisiert. Es war auch ein Geschirrspüler vorhanden wodurch man nicht spülen musste. Die Lage war auch super angebunden. Alles in allem war es gut
Appartement très bien situé, spacieux, idéal pour un séjour pour 2. Seul petit bémol, appartement pas très bien insonorisé.
Tolle Wohnung in perfekter Lage, sehr schöner Aufenthalt!
Eine Insel der Ruhe in Berlin, trotzdem eine gute Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel.

Alles Top !!
Bis auf das Geräuschpegelmessgerät.
Lovely apartment in a cool area, great public transport connections. Check in and out was smooth!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Berlin et dans l'appartement de Djorje: un appartement lumineux et chaleureux, l'emplacement est dans un quartier dans une périphérie calme mais avec le bus, le tram tout à côté. Djorje est un hôte attentif et réactif.
Je recommande!

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb during our time in Berlin. Great location - within walking distance of many bars and restaurants, and close to trains for exploring the rest of the city. The apartment itself was clean, spacious, and perfectly suited for our group of four. Stella was a fantastic host, very accommodating and kind, offering us both early check-in and late check-out options. The on-site luggage lockers were also a really helpful feature. Thanks for a great trip!
음.... 주변이 너무 볼게 없음 트램을 끊어야 함..
Just as pictured...the airbnb is located in a very convenient location! Fast communication and flexible check-in/out was great!

Een fijne, praktische overnachtingsplek! Dichtbij een metrostation waarmee je met 20-30 min overal in Berlijn kon komen.
De foto’s komen ook goed overeen met de plek en was het inchecken gemakkelijk.
Lovely cosy spot well connected to transport for whatever you want to do. Knew Ilona was there to help if needed.
Eine richtig gute Unterkunft! Sie liegt total zentral, tolle Cafés, tolles indisches Restaurant und auch die Nähe zur S-Bahn. Auch zu viert haben wir uns sofort wohl gefühlt.
Die Wohnung von Axel und Anne ist sehr schön eingerichtet und sehr gut gelegen. Anne und Axel waren sehr nett und in der Wohnung hat es an nichts gefehlt. Vielen Dank!
Very nice room, good location, hotel-like.

We spent an amazing time visiting Berlin and knowing we had such a welcoming place to stay in the evening.
JC was very welcoming, he even invited us at diner with his lovely family !
The room was perfect and the bathroom too, if you're in Berlin, I vividly recommend you to make a stop in JC's house !!
Ansprechende Einrichtung, Küche super sortiert, hatte alles was wir zum Kochen benötigten.
War sehr gut
Es war super! Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit!! Sunny ist super lieb.

une vraie expérience chez l habitant
dans le plus beau quartier de Berlin
je me suis sentie à l aise Chez Dieter et Félix le chat qui ont été très accueillants
Cozy small apartment with a nice location near all needed public transport. Host was friendly and the apartment met all expectations! We had a great stay. Would definitely recommend.  :)
it was a very nice stay! the appartement has everything you need and is really nice located
short stay. Nice small apartment, very good and easy communication.
logement agréable, hôte accueillant
Lovely apartment, good position, helpful host
Wir hatten hier zwei sehr schöne Tage in diesem kleinen Luxusappartement . Zwar etwas ausserhalb , aber schön in Wassernähe , mit der Strassenbahn alles total schnell erreichbar . Danke an Thekla !
Top Unterkunft  mitten in Berlin würden es wieder buchen

Les + :
Appartement bien situé et spacieux, deux grandes chambres avec lits doubles. Salle de bain et cuisine fonctionnelles. Très calme, fenêtres efficaces.
Les - :
Gros problème électrique : le fusible des plafonniers de l'appartement faisait disjoncter le différentiel, donc pas de lumière salle de bain et coupure du frigo. C'est soit l'un, soit l'autre... L'électricien de l'agence (oui, il ne s'agit pas d'un app de particulier...) semble découvrir le problème... On s'est donc éclairé à la lampe de chevet déplacée dans le salon et à la lumière de la hotte !
Réveillé dès 5h du matin par la lumière du jour, les rideaux étant inefficaces
Chaleur étouffante, appartement chauffé par les tuyaux collectifs qui traversent les étages, malgré les radiateurs fermés.
Aucun charme, très peu de déco, vaisselle minimaliste obligeant à un lave-vaisselle par jour ou à la main. Et pas de sel / poivre / huile, juste le minimum
Pas d'infos pour mise en route du wifi (box débranchée)
Ampoules grillées

Amazing stay, with all the required services and facilities. All required items are already present, just move in and enjoy your stay.
I recommend choosing this stay for your friends and family.
The host was friendly and helped me with all my doubts and queries.
Great location. Would visit again.

Berlin was amazing and the stay was just as described!
Thanks
Alles super, vor allem die vorbildliche Kommunikation und das fürsorgliche Agieren.
Host molto gentile e accogliente. Bellissimo appartamento, pulito, camere grandi, luminose con vista mozzafiato. Ottima posizione a due passi dal Berlin Hackescher Markt e le vie dello shopping.

First holiday together for our group of 7 friends and couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. Easy to work out where we were going after we got their as they have binders and print outs of all the things to do in Berlin

This apartment is in an excellent location, near Checkpoint Charlie, metro and all kinds of shop. Axel is a wonderful host and he was very helpful with the local tips and suggestions.
Do note that this apartment is small and is meant for 2 adults and 2 small kids at the best, certainly very tight for 4 adults. Not much space for luggage and wifi is bit slow. If you don't mind close quarters then this is a good place to stay.

Wir hatten einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt bei Audrey! Die Lage war super - man kann bequem durch einen Park zur Haltestelle Schöneberg der Ringbahn S-Bahn gelangen. Auf dem Weg liegt auch ein guter Bäcker. Audrey war äußerst freundlich und hilfsbereit. Wir haben die eine Nacht genossen, prima geschlafen und würden jederzeit wiederkommen :)

Estadia tranquila e o anfitrião sempre respondeu rapidamente. Apartamento aconchegante. Mercados e lanchonetes próximos. Por não ficar tão perto do centro de Berlim, de transporte público pode levar algum tempo até chegar a alguns pontos turísticos (40 a 50 minutos), mas o transporte é bastante eficiente e algumas linhas de ônibus passam bem próximas.
we hebben heerlijk genoten. Fijne kamer goed bed fijne douche kortom helemaal top.

Eine wirklich schöne Unterkunft für ein paar Tage in Berlin mit der Familie.
Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber, es fehlt wirklich an nichts. Zudem ist sie sehr gut mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen.
Timo ist ein angenehmer, sehr flexibler Gastgeber, der immer schnell auf Nachrichten reagiert hat. Danke, Timo!

Wir waren dort, für ein paar Tage und alles war perfekt.
Danke nochmal für die Vertrauen und wir kommen wieder!

We really enjoyed our stay in Ricardo and Patrick's apartment, the place was just as described in the pictures and they were always very kind to us!
We can definitely recommend it.

Really beautiful accommodation, perfect for two travellers who are happy to stay a bit out of the central area of the city. Everything was clean, modern and functional. It would be great if the room featured an iron and ironing board, however.

Wir waren jetzt zum zweiten Mal in den Appartement und haben uns auch diesmal sehr wohl gefühlt. Es ist alles da, was man benötigt. Die Lage ist auch ziemlich perfekt, um Berlin zu erkunden. Die Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin ist sehr unkompliziert und schnell.

A really great apartment!  The balcony is nice especially in the breakfast time sitting with your friends and little chatting. The apartment is clean and tidy and with good visual design. Very close to the station and the area is quiet and peaceful. Oksana is a very nice host. I have called her that I and my friends will be late and we saw her waiting for us in front of the building.  it is a highly recommended place if you wanna stay in Berlin with nice view and relaxing time.

The stay at Johanna and Michael was special.
The apartment is well located (as advertised) and they were very helpful in giving local tips and seeing we had everything we might need.
I recommend it.
Prachtige kamer, met alles op loopafstand

El apartamento es como descrito: muy pequeño. Sólo caben dos personas apretaditas. Por lo demás, tiene todo lo básico. La situación es excelente y es muy silencioso, la ventana da al jardincito de atrás.

Unser Aufenthalt war sehr kurz aber dennoch hat Michael uns freundlich und höflich empfangen. Das Zimmer hielt auf alle Fälle was es verspricht. Es war alles sauber und wohnlich. Kann die Unterkunft nur empfehlen
Alles wie beschrieben.sehr sauber und unkompliziert

El alojamiento de Frank fue una maravilla. Estaba ubicado en una zona tranquila con muchos restaurantes y bien conectado con transporte para llegar a los demás lugares. Frank fue un increíble guía porque nos dio muchos tips, sin duda un lugar en donde me hospedaría nuevamente.
sehr sauber, unkompliziertes ein - und auschecken, 2 u-bahn-stationen in kurzer gehdistanz erreichbar

Sybil's cozy apartment is absolutely perfect if you are looking for a nice and calm base while experiencing Berlin. The location right at Schlachtensee and close to Wannsee made it possible for us to both go road cycling, enjoy quiet walks and be in Berlin Mitte in 20 min with the S-Bahn less than a 10 min walk away, as well as being able to work and take meetings from home in the nicely equipped apartment. Sybil and her husband were always very helpful and considered and made our stay both pleasant and trouble free.
Really cool apartment in a great location. The hosts are helpful and friendly.

Nous n'avons pas vu la propriétaire qui a été néanmoins très réactive à nos questions. Équipement très succinct, pas de tasses à café, pas de cafetière électrique, pas de base genre huile ,pas de penderie, pas de télévision vinaigre ou sucre ,table et fauteuils dans le salon très peu pratiques pour les repas, bref le strict minimum . Rien pour suspendre ses affaires dans la salle de bain . Les fenêtres de la chambre donnent sur les poubelles de l'immeuble . Pas du tout chaleureux mais très propre.
bons restaurants alentours mais nous ne retournerons pas dans cet appartement

Nice neighborhood. Tram lines immediatly outside. Lots of parks and shops nearby. Kitchen clean, equipped, and has the basics covered.
Bonus, friendly neighbor cat, who wants in, but let's you pet him even if you keep him outside.

This apartment was a wonderful option for my friend and I to spend a long weekend in Berlin. Very walkable to the public transportation options, it’s a great base for a trip of exploring. The host was responsive and even sent some restaurant suggestions. The apartment felt brand new and spotless!

Excellent rapport qualité prix .
L arrivée a été facilité , tout était simple et Uschi a toujours communiqué avec moi.
L appartement est situé devant de nombreuses stations de bus , il est très facile de se déplacer en transport en commun.
Les lits sont cool, la cuisine simple mais on arrive bien a y faire a manger.
C est un petit espace sympa ! Je recommande ce logement 🙃🙂🤩

Juwel am Müggelsee mit großartiger Ausstattung, sehr gutem Komfort und sehr netten Gastgebern.
Ich kann die Unterkunft unbedingt empfehlen und komme sehr gerne wieder.
convenient place in nice Grunewald. quick foot walk to the train station. Easy access to the trade fair (against traffic). Room is as described, everything in order, nice and spacious.

Die Unterkunft war gut gelegen, sehr ruhig und der Gastgeber gut erreichbar
Die Wohnung ist eine Altbauwohnung und daher recht kalt, Heizungen sind nachts reguliert und es war etwas dreckig (Haare im Bad, tote Spinnen am Boden)
Ansonsten hat aber alles gut gepasst
Danke für alles

We were extremely happy to stay at Uwe’s house. There are really nice restaurantsand bars nearby. The location was quite and peaceful as well. If we come to Berlin again, we definitely stay at Uwe’s place. Really warm and cosy as in photos.
I would highly recommend.
Great location,amazing apartment and  Meg  is an lovely host. She makes sure that you are very welcome and you feel comfortable. I wouldn definitely recommend this apartment!
We had a lovely time in Sophia’s apartment! Great host and neighbourhood. Would definitely recommend! 🙌
Die Wohnung ist sehr schön eingerichtet, gut mit dem Öpnv zu erreichen und sehr sauber. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Chambre très agréable, appartement spacieux avec une grande hauteur de plafond, ce qui rajoute à l'originalité du lieu.
Alex et Daniela sont à la fois très discrets et disponibles .
Je recommande vivement cette adresse.
Christine
Sehr gute Lage, das Appartment war sehr schön ausgerichtet und sauber, der Anbieter sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit: 100% zu Empfehlen!

Ce fut un super séjour dans un très bel appartement peu commun. Pas trop loin du centre et facilement accessible en métro. Magasin à proximité plutôt pratique. L’hôte est très réactif. Je recommande ce logement.

Jan war super freundlich, flexibel und sehr hilfsbereit. Alles hat sehr gut geklappt, die Wohnung war genau wie beschrieben. Super Lage und extrem ruhig! Wir haben nix gehört dank Lage in den Innenhof. Gerne wieder!
Nice location, great for staying a few days in Berlin

We’re thrilled with the apartment and the district
