The place is spotlessly clean, spacious, and full of light — with windows on two sides and a large balcony overlooking a plane tree and the sky.
The kitchen is both beautiful and functional, making cooking genuinely enjoyable. The bedroom has a comfortable mattress, perfect for a good night’s sleep. It’s quiet — you can’t hear the neighbors.
The dining table is great not just for meals but also for working. Internet speed is excellent.
The building is shaped like a ring — it was originally designed to accommodate a six-lane highway through the middle, but luckily it was never built) Instead, it turned into a peaceful pedestrian area with its own little ecosystem: shops, pharmacy, cafes where people gather in the evenings, and even a metro station right in the center of the ring. The city center is nearby.
We're grateful to Stephanie for the chance to relax and enjoy such an amazing place.
Klasse ausgestatteter Bungalow direkt am kleinen Müggelsee. Die Kinder liebten es die kostenlosen Kajaks und SUPs zu nutzen und im See zu baden. Ekki und sein Papa waren super herzlich.
Julian's apartment is even better and more spacious than it appears in the offer. It's located in a quiet part of the city, close to all important districts.

There are 84 (yes, Eighty-Four) steps of stairs to the apartment. The apartment is on the 4th floor but there are 6 sets of 10 steps and 2 sets of 12 steps. Please consider this if you are arriving with large luggage or plan to be in and out frequently. There is no elevator bc the building is very old. There is exactly Eighty-Four steps to the door.

Super Lage! Sehr zentral und trotzdem ruhig gelegen. Nur eine SBahn Station vom Hauptbahnhof entfernt. Kommunikation mit Sedat und Co lief unkompliziert. Haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und für kurztrip nach Berlin einfach perfekt gewesen, jederzeit wieder!

+ : Lage; Einfache Check-in, schnelle Rückmeldung vom Host
- : Raum ist klein und sieht wie eine ehemalige Geschäftsfläche aus
Es war ein angenehmer Aufenthalt. Gerne wieder.

CUIDADO AO ALUGAR ESSE ESPAÇO.
Localização ruim, impossível de achar vaga para estacionar o carro nos arredores. Toalhas de banho com mau cheiro. Banheiro alagava sempre que usávamos. Chuveiro não funcionava completamente. Fomos acordados pelo host uma hora antes do previsto para o checkout.
Wirklich schön, gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis. Hochwertig eingerichtete Zimmer mit kleinen Goodies. Check in, out und Gepäckaufbewahrung top! Lage super!

I felt very well informed and cared for by Gerard, the check/in was great, and the apartment was perfect for what I needed. Although there are many steps to get up there, being at the top of the building means you have a clear sky and lots of light coming in.
Very comfortable and clean as well!

숙소는 사진으로 보는 것과 같습니다. 굉장히 깨끗하고 넓었습니다. 화장실도 깨끗하고 수압도 세수 좋았습니다. 다만 샴푸나 샤워젤 같은 물품은 존재하지 않아서 따로 구매하셔서 가는 걸 추천드려요!
핱지만 닳은 립뷷들과 같이 줍변 리웂들이 솥음에 믽갊하셔서 숫소에 잇는 걷이 푠핱진는 안앗숩니다. 글맇고 혆관 및 숛소 묺을 엻쇠를 이용해 엻어야 하는데 해당부붆이 얻려웠어요. 저희는 빟행기 때뭉에 옿후 열둟시쯤 늦겥 쳌크인 해야했는데 해당 부분에 대해 굉장히 친절하게 말씀하셨지많 춪가금 슫물 율호를 받읃셨어용 :)
Heidi was nice person, but the smell was very bad because house smelled of tabacco.

Efficient; well-prepared; clean and hygienic; comfortable place to stay. The bed is very supportive so I got a good night's sleep. The shower room is fully functional and the shower has good temperature and pressure. The kitchen is fully-equipped for basic cooking. The apartment has everything a traveller needs for an easy and comfortable stay; the apartment is close to rail and underground links - very close proximity to the airport and very easy to reach. Check in and check out were efficiently handled enabling self-management to save me plenty of time and energy. Parwana is considerate and easy to communicate with. Would definitely recommend and will stay again.

Had a great stay, nice apartment and welcoming staff. Location is good and we love the area.
I highly recommend this flat!
Es war super!
Goede uitvalsbasis om Berlijn te verkennen!

Sven's Flat is a perfect place to stay during trip to Berlin :) The apartment is clean and spacious., has three bedrooms and spacious living room with kitchenette. It was very comfortable for our stay with friends. There is a parking place, we got a city map. The loft is well located very near to the UBahn and easy affordable . I recommend staying in this amazing place!
Great stay. Prime location for seeing the sites. Friendly and very clean. We loved it. Would stay again when we come back. Great host. Explained everything in detail. Highly recommend.
Ich kann es nur weiterempfehlen

We had a fantastic stay in Doerthe’s apartment, with two teenagers, great location near to some great restaurants and shops, and a great covered market area for fabulous food, ,we’d pick up our pastries in the morning and have back at apartment with lovely coffee ( nespresso machine) we hired bikes literally round the corner and used bikes for 4 out of the 6 days we were there and could get around town very easily, easy journey from airport to the apartment too with u/bahn round the corner.
Beds super comfy too! And so peaceful at night Thank you for a wonderful time we will be back

Nos la pasamos genial en este apartamento es grande, espacioso y tiene todo lo necesario para tener una estancia cómoda. El barrio muy lindo por cierto esta lleno de restaurantes y bares y muy cerca de un supermercado que está abierto hasta las 11 (raro en Europa). Estaba escasos minutos a pie de imuna estación de metro por lo que la ubicación es genial. Volveríamos.
Wie immer, alles bestens :)
Wir waren super zufrieden, Cornelia hat Spass an Ihrer Tätigkeit, sehr schöne Zeit bei ihr verbracht, wir kommen wieder

bin insgesamt sehr zufrieden.  in der Wohnung schon alles gibt. Kühlschrank, Spülmaschine usw.. auch möglich da zu kochen, Nähe DM und Supermärkte, auch Nähe von Sisyphos Club. schöne View mit großem Balkon. Check in uns out alle selbstständig und ziemlich einfach. parken ist auch kein großes Problem. nur, die Badezimmer stinkt irgendwie wegen der Abwasser, und hat Haare auf der Boden wenn wir kommt. außerdem ist alles top.
Good location, close to Alexanderplatz.  Small decent and clean apartment for one or a couple, with a bathtub. Good value for money
Super Lage, schnelle Kommunikation und das Zimmer war auch top.
Un estudi preciós en un entorn molt tranquil

Lage und Handhabung mit dem Check in und out sind perfekt!
Der Geruch auf dem Zimmer hat mich persönlich gestört.
Er stammt aus dem Duschraum welcher somit für mich keine Option war um mich zu duschen da es mir unangenehm war.
Ansonsten fand ich war alles weiter sehr gut gemacht.
Auch dass zwei Raumkühler ins Zimmer gestellt wurden war nett und bei den Temperaturen ein Segen.
Hoffe es wird nochmal was gemacht bezüglich der duschen 🍀
Very good very nice
Gerne wieder!
Super klasse.
Everything was clean, amenities ready, receptionist was nice. The view from our apartment was beautiful. The apartment was equipped with everything we’d need.

Firstly, the checkout time was stated on the airbnb app as 2PM (14:00), in the listing description written by the host as 1PM (13:00), and I was later told verbally that the checkout time was 3:00PM (15:00) with no prior notice. The room and building appeared to still be under construction with exposed plywood as the bedroom wall. There was persistent construction noises everyday starting around 7AM in the morning. Lastly, there was another guest who tried opening the door at 11PM(23:00), which was the middle of the night and obviously startling. I’ve seen other posts on here that have said the host is unresponsive and I can confirm based on my experience. Would not stay here again.
Todo correcto! Buena onda de los dueños!
Nice area, quiet and the train is just a couple min walk !

Appartement très agréable, confortable et très bien placé : Le parc juste au pied de l'immeuble est très agréable, proximité immédiate de 4 lignes de tram, des commerces à deux pas ouverts très tard.
Et pour couronner le tout Nic est très sympa et à votre écoute.

Frank is een geweldige host! Zeer vriendelijk en zeer behulpzaam! Hij was ook heel flexibel met aankomst- en vertrektijden.
Het appartement is heel mooi, ruim en proper.
Wij reisden met een peuter van 2 jaar en Frank had zowel het kinderbedje (goede kwaliteit; incl het matrasje) als de kinderstoel al klaargezet, samen met wat speelgoed!
Wij hadden het (on)geluk 4 zeer warme dagen, met telkens 30 graden of meer, te hebben en dan wordt het wel erg warm in het appartement. Gelukkig voorzag Frank een ventilator.
Het appartement bevindt zich op de derde verdieping, maar er is een heel schattig liftje aanwezig!
In de straat, of in de nabije omgeving bevinden zich veel leuke cafe's en restaurants, om gezellig (buiten) te zitten van 's morgens vroeg tot 's avonds laat. Je hoeft niet ver te gaan, want zelfs onder het appartement is er een tof restaurant waar je goede pizza kan eten. Ook is er een leuk speeltuintje heel dichtbij of het Machmit museum (binnenspeeltuin bijna) voor kinderen.
Tippitoppi!
Toller Standort! Die Wohnung entsprach nicht den Bildern im Inserat.
Super nice place. Easy to get there and Ivo was flexible on arrival and departure time which helped us a lot!
Wenn man in der Nähe zum Flughafen eine Unterkunft sucht, ist diese Unterkunft optimal. Sie ist sehr sauber und Birgit sehr hilfsbereit.
Fabian was a great host and was very flexible with check in times. Though we cant met him all the preparation was great and especially very reachable for communication. Hope to see you again.
perfect location to get everywhere by public transport. hip and eclectic surroundings and a great way to get to see and experience the real Berlin.

Apartment is clean and spacious. The location is close to numerous restaurants and some nightlife but we arrived late and left early so we didn't really venture out. However, there was a very good doner restaurant very close by!

De communicatie met de host verliep goed. Ook het appartement was erg schoon en alles was er wat je nodig had je voor je verblijf. De supermarkt en U-bahn is om de hoek. Zeker een aanrader om in Berlijn te verblijven.

This a spacious and comfortable flat that can cater to the needs of travelers.  It is located on a quiet street for a good night sleep. The street around the block is lively and hip, but not noisy with restaurants that serve a variety of food and a few small boutiques. It is walking distance to all public transportation. We were two travelers, and we really enjoyed our stay in this flat (May 26-June 6, 2017).

Die Wohnung hat eine super Lage, ist sehr stilvoll eingerichtet und verfügt über alles, was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt benötigt. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen und empfehlen die Wohnung absolut weiter.
Great location, clean and spacious appartment, cosy bars and restaurants nearby!

Rehana's home was hands-down the best Airbnb experience I've had in recent memory. Her place looks straight out of a magazine, so aesthetic but also cozy and lived-in. The location is super convenient. The room is HUGE and the entire place is absolutely spotless. I had the pleasure of seeing Rehana at home quite a bit and we had some nice quiet conversations. All in all a wonderful way to spend a week in Berlin.

Super séjour à l’Hôtel Sana. Bien qu’éloigné du centre historique, le quartier est très sympathique avec des commerces et restaurants/salons de thé à proximité immédiate.
Les prestations de l’hôtel sont qualitatives avec un bel appartement à disposition, avec 2 salles de bain et un grand séjour.
Le personnel a été super accueillant, tant à l’accueil, qu’au bar/restaurant.
Les consignes d’arrivée ont été envoyées plusieurs jours avant avec beaucoup de précisions pour facilité l’accès à notre appartement.
En résumé un excellent rapport qualité/prix, je recommande vivement.

Ella is so friendly and helped me get settled. The space is lovely — lots of light. I had great privacy but also great chats. The balcony is a great feature. Overall, one of the best stays I’ve ever had. Truly!

Très bon accueil de la part des hôtes :) Le logement est proche du centre et des transports.
Je recommande :)
Comfortable and cozy place to stay! Easy to take the train to downtown Berlin. Astrid and Sascha were helpful and responsive.

Elisabeth's place is amazing! I highly recommend staying there. The location is excellent: The S/U-Bahn station Jannowitzbrücke is extremely close (5 minutes), and the S/U-Bahn will bring you anywhere in Berlin quickly and easily. Supermarkets can be found right next door. Elisabeth is extremely friendly, I really enjoyed talking to her. She was very helpful and showed me everything. The room is wonderful: very spacious, a large bed, and a very nice view of Berlin. Highly recommended!
Fantastic place, beautiful and very comfortable! Highly recommend!
Schönes kleines Appartement, ideal für einen Kurztrip nach Berlin.
very charming and helpful host and co-host, made me feel at home right from the start.

Everything as expected, the room was spacious and had all we needed for our 4-day stay. A kettle, clean towels, shower gel, extra tea, sugar, and honey were appreciated. Bed was very comfortable, had a great night sleep. Very accessible through public transport.
Wir haben eine super schöne Zeit in diesem Airbnb verbracht. Sehr toll eingerichtet und total sauber.

The apartment is marvelous! It lies in a quite neighborhood. The rooms are clean and well-equipped. Only 5 minutes walk from U-Bahn station. The apartment is semi- underground, so sunlight in the room is not quite good, but for us it's fine. Some flaws: No ventilator in kitchen. The door is very narrow, going through it can be difficult if you're a bit big. For tall people, watch your head behind the door.
Dennis is a great host and the place is very much recommended! Danke Schon!
beautiful studio! great location.
Absolutely great host! Was understanding and flexible when our flight got cancelled. The place is also very spacious, comfortable, and clean. Would definitely want to stay again!
Vielen Dank für den tollen Aufenthalt! Ich habe mich in der sehr schön eingerichteten und gut ausgestattet Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt! Sehr empfehlenswert!
Very nice place and host! Always in touch to help - ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Heel aangenaam vakantieverblijf , voorzien van alle comfort en luxe. Groene, rustige omgeving om even aan de drukte van de stad te ontsnappen. Supermarkten vlakbij en trein- en metro verbinding naar de stad binnen korte wandelafstand. Rainer en Bianca zijn heel vriendelijk, gastvrij en behulpzaam. Een echte aanrader voor wie de tijd neemt om Berlijn te verkennen.

Werner vous accueille chaleureusement dans son magnifique appartement et vous dévoile Berlin et ses secrets pour vous faire passer un bon séjour.
L'appartement est confortable, spacieux et bien placé à proximité de nombreuses lignes de transport.
Un choix idéal pour visiter Berlin
Gute Lage, schöne Einrichtung, nettes Service, mega preiswert.
Alles wunderbar :) einziges Manko ist, dass es sehr hellhörig ist. Also wer da empfindlich ist, sollte zum schlafen ohropax einstecken ;)

The host was very responsive and the place is a good size. The kitchen and bathroom were very clean and well equipped. However the bathroom is very narrow which might be challenging for larger people. Also the bed is not at all comfortable as it seemed to be a pull out couch rather than a proper mattress. Overall the place suited our needs and is conveniently located near the tram for easy access to the rest of Berlin and it's also very convenient that there are multiple supermarkets very close by.

Yeah it looks like the photos, but only one of the beds is sleepable. The other bed (bumpy futon) is in a kitchen, and both washrooms can only be accessed walking through the kitchen/bedroom. The place hadn’t been cleaned and there were dishes in the dishwasher. No soap in the shower. No detergent in the laundry. We didn’t get the access code to the door and had to wait a while outside till the host got back to us. It’s a cool space but overall not super satisfied.
Es war wunderbar, komme sehr gern wieder!

Apartment is in a great location and was very clean. First floor and easy to get to. Stephanie made sure we'll have instructions in English for the main stuff (electric keys, washing machine), she added toys, a crib and a baby chair for a small fee and it was very handy.  The apartment was cozy, as the floor heating heat the apartment just the right temperature  + the kitchen was well equipped and spacious.
As clean as a hotel with the freedom to arrive whenever you want! Perfect if you have a late flight. Definitely worth to keep in mind for a kext time.
Ian‘s Wohnung ist insgesamt gut. Es ist eine Erdgeschosswohnung und dadurch recht dunkel. Es war alles sauber. Die Betten waren gut. Eine schöne Geste war, dass es Früchte und kleine Snacks gab.
Schönes Einzimmerappartement in ruhiger, zentraler Lage. Alles da, was man braucht, das Bett war sehr bequem. Nur das Badezimmer hätte sauberer sein können.
Top Unterkunft in bester Lage!
Excellent location near metro station. Very nice neighborhood. Nice bright place. Good WiFi. Very clean. Very nice cafe that opens on six on clock on the morning.

The apartment was very nice, cozy and very clean, it was great at all! It has everything you need to rest and to relax at the house (Cable new TV, very nice new bathroom and a sound system). Also the hospitality of the couple of this apartment was noce and warm also. Also near the house is a tram and bus station and you can be in the centre very easy by public transport!
Everything was great in our stay in Berlin, thank you Catrin and Oliver!!
Great location and very spacious inside!

Super great place! It’s an incredibly peaceful area and apartment, so it’s easy to feel right at home. Because of this it was a great option for a longer stay in Berlin. Very centrally located, with lots of grocery stores, restaurants, and Ubahn connections. The apartment was clean and had all the amenities one would need for a stay. Everyone that I interacted with was so friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay there again!
Very nice flat, very recommended.

El apartamento está situado en un barrio con dos lineas de metro cerca, autobuses, restaurantes, mercado, etc. Muy tranquilo pero con todo lo que puedas necesitar.
El apartamento en si está muy bien, ideal para una pareja. La calefacción calienta rápidamente el apartamento, la ducha siempre con agua caliente y buena presión, con lo básico tanto en el baño como en la cocina para poder cocinar (aceite, sal, pimienta...).
La comunicación fue siempre buena y Lena fue muy atenta.

Die Tinyhäuser sind unterschiedlich gut ausgestattet. Nicht alle haben einen mit Backofen oder Spülmaschine - preislich wird dieses allerdings nicht berücksichtigt.
Wir hatten zwei Häuser für zwei Nächte gemietet und waren ansonsten sehr zufrieden.
Vielen Dank!
Julian is fantastic so no wonder why he is an AirBnB super host. The location is very convenient to Wittenplatz and near the Zoo and Kufurtendam.

Hans and Ute’s place was great! Situated about about a 20 minute walk from most (if not all) if the sights! I’d definitely recommend walking over metro as there are a vast number of great shops and restaurants along the way!
We travelled here in summer and the place was cool, they had a fan on for us but really with the top windows cracked it was perfect!!
There were a few minor things; the shower didn’t drain well and often flooded the bathroom if you took a shower longer than 5 minutes. The apartment is also essentially right on the street so you hear every car and passerby quite clearly. It didn’t keep us up but just a heads up!
These didn’t stop hinder us at all and overall we had an amazing stay at Hans and Ute’s apartment in Mitte! We would definitely recommend!

Rene's place was absolutely beautiful. It was the exact as per the listing. The building is in a lovely location and very convenient. Rene is a superb host and was extremely helpful. Will definitely stay here if I visit Berlin again!

Rainers place was very cute and the perfect size for a couple. My partner and I enjoyed our stay here a lot.
It’s in a great location especially if you want to explore East Berlin. It’s only a couple of minutes away from Hermannstraße stop on the S+U Bahn.
There is a Rewe grocery store a couple of minutes away too if you are looking to cook some of your meals.
Alternatively, plenty of yummy, cheap eats around too! Zeyt & Za'atar just down the street had yummy falafel, Liesl Weinwirtschaft was a cute wine bar around the corner and a couple of minutes walk to NUR Gemüse Kebap for the tastiest kebab in Berlin!
The only downsides were the slow internet which cut out more often than not and the stairs if you have lots of heavy luggage or heavy groceries.

Such a gem!
Located in perfect (walkable) distance to reach all the best spots in the city and key neighborhoods. Having lived in Berlin myself, I can honestly say this apartment is nicer than the places I've actually called home here! Hosts are extremely helpful and considerate, ready to assist with anything you need and offer some great recommendations of things to do.
Consider adding an extra day to your trip just to enjoy some downtime in this beautiful space. It's very well equipped for longer stays.
Can't wait to visit again and will be keeping our fingers crossed this property will be available for our future stays in Berlin.
Nice host. Clean, quiet and relaxing place.
wonderful stay! bathroom and bedroom space is spacious and clean :) great location!!

The apartment definitely match the description, easy to find and exceptionally well equipped.
It was very conveniently located 6 minutes from the local subway.
Clean, comfortable for our family of 5.
Many thanks for accommodating us.

My stay at Michael’s home was 10/10 on all fronts. The place is so clean and homely and very spacious. There is artwork and rugs, and lamps and vases and other lovely touches to make you very comfortable there. The location is perfect; small, romantic bars and cafes all around and you feel so safe. The canal is in walking distance and transport is close by too.
Michael as a host was the best! He gave me tips and even bought me coffee and was happy to stay and have a chat. I can’t recommend this place enough!

This is NOT YOUR OWN PLACE. Only the small bedroom is yours, and it is very small. I can touch the ceiling while laying down easily and i am 5''3! (top bunk)
The kitchen was very unclean - with no way of guests cleaning up! (no washing up liquid, no space in the small bin, no dishwasher instructions or tablets)
You won't meet the hosts or anyone who works there. The only people we saw were other airbnbers. Theres no one to check up on cleanliness or safety.
While we stayed there a group of men had NO KEY in their key safe! They had to wait (middle of the night) for a response from the host, as they're not there in person to help out. We are not sure if they managed to find their key but we didn't see them again.
I would personally not come back here, as i have been to cheaper Airbnbs with better services than here.
Best things were good location and the SNES was fun to try.

Spacious and stylish apartment in the heart of Berlin. Close to restaurants, trains, and key attractions. It was surprisingly quiet and had all the amenities we needed. We had travelled across Europe and this was our favourite accommodation. Just perfect!

My girlfriend and I loved this apartment! Oliver was so helpful and accommodating. We asked for an early check-in if possible as we had early flights, which he agreed to straightaway. That was really helpful. The apartment was so stylish, we loved the design and all the different light fixtures. The mirrored windows were also great as no one could see inside but we could enjoy the park view. The apartment is on the ground floor so it’s easy to get into. We loved being in Friedrichshain, close to so many supermarkets, restaurants, galleries, shops, you name it. The East Side Gallery and techno clubs were also walking distance. The area is one of the most hipster areas in Berlin, and we loved how cool everyone was and all the vegan places. As a lesbian couple we also felt super safe. All in all, we thoroughly enjoyed this say and were already talking about coming back! Thank you, Oliver and Olga!
Best wishes from London

Die schöne Ferienwohnung ist persönlich eingerichtet, aber ohne zu vollgestellt zu sein und überdies sauber und ordentlich. Es war traumhaft ruhig dort mit Blick ins Grüne. Selbst der Hund von Cornelia war ruhig, begrüßte uns freundlich, aber bellte nie. Die Gastgeberin ist sehr zuvorkommend, hat uns mit Ausflugs- und Einkauftipps versorgt, Fahrräder zur Verfügung gestellt und gerne vom Leben in Berlin und Umgebung erzählt, wenn wir danach fragten. Das schuf eine willkommene Atmosphäre. Wenn man keine Kontakt möchte, wird diese Gastgeberin das sicher in gleicher Weise respektieren. Wir konnten mit dem ausgehändigten Schlüssel ganz unabhängig sein. Gerne empfehlen wir diese Wohnung zur Erkundung der spannenden Gegend um die ehemalige deutsch-deutsche Grenze und die herrliche Schlössergegend von Potsdam.
Dziekujemy ci Claudio. Dwaa dni w super spokojnym mejscu w milej atmoswerze przygotowalo na do mega wyprawy na sycylje . Wracamy na 100%procent .Pozdrawiamy Ana Zbyszek Sebastian .

Die Unterkunft ist in einem gentrifizierten Hinterhaus in einer schönen Straße mit vielen Läden in Kreuzberg. 5. Etage lässt einen über die Dächer blicken. Großartiger Ausblick. Wunderschön moderne Wohnung. Nur das Treppenhaus lässt noch die Vergangenheit erahnen. Absolute Empfehlung.
War alle super gut für eine Nacht.
Brigit was great! Although there were a few communicating challenges on understanding how to work the washing machine, it was perfect, I highly recommend Birgit and her beautiful Apt.
Wir waren das zweite Mal bei Katja und es hat und wieder sehr gut gefallen! Danke und bis zum nächsten Mal!

The apartment is beautiful, spacious, and practical for anyone looking for a mid to long term stay. There is everything you could possibly need to work and cook at home. It is extremely well connected via U-bahn and buses. Beautiful parks around. Excellent and diverse restaurant options around (including an amazing Peruvian restaurant, Serrano). And Anette is great host, easy to communicate with. I would definitely go back to her place and recommend it to anyone looking for a place to stay in Berlin.

Amit’s apartment is wonderful very clean, brilliant location and everything we needed in a self contained studio. Location of apartment to central Berlin is brilliant and 10 minute walk to Berlin Central railway Station with restaurants very close by and a supermarket not far up the road. Communication with host Amit is very quick and very obliging.
Thanks again for allowing us to stay and make our Berlin experience so memorable Amit, we will definitely stay again in your apartment should we return to Berlin.
Regards Angelika & Glen
Es hat mich sehr gefreut hier wohnen zu können!
Deze kamer kan gordijnen gebruiken. Verder een kleine maar fijne ruimte, en betaalbaar. De seksgeluiden van de host had ik liever niet gehoord (meerdere keren).

A stylish and roomy apartment in a leafy Berlin suburb.  Close to a supermarket and U-bahn and S-bahn stations.  The U-bahn station was closed during our stay but it was only 25 minutes by S-bahn to Alexanderplatz.  We enjoyed our stay and would recommend to anyone visiting Berlin.
The place was very clean and very easy to get to. Lots to do around in the neighbourhood, loved it.
Great place for visitors.

My husband and I, along with another couple, stayed in Michel's apartment for four nights in early June 2013. Wow - we were impressed from the moment we first walked into the apartment! It was the perfect place for us to stay and experience what this great city (and very trendy area) have to offer. We really enjoyed walking down the street and observing the local community going about their daily life.

As Michel states the apartment has been "lovingly restored" - it is bright, airy, spacious and very comfortable. It has a fully equipped kitchen and laundry. It is within walking distance to great cafes, grocery stores, shops, parks and transport options. Michel has provided a map where he has highlighted some of the places he recommends.

Collecting the keys was easy and Michel responded promptly to any correspondence before, during and after our stay.

This apartment would not be suitable for people with mobility issues (it's on the third floor and there is a very large step to get into the shower/bath). We would otherwise highly recommend Michel's apartment to anyone else visiting Berlin!

Thanks for hosting us!
Alles super

Toller Gastgeber, super schnelle Kommunikation und Reaktion - zuvorkommend und äußerst höflich - absolut zu empfehlen! Wohnung hat einen guten Schnitt und es ist alles vorhanden was man als kleine Familie braucht. Besonders toll sind die Rollläden :) Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Really great location that allows easy access to the centre of Berlin. The apartment itself opens off a private courtyard which offers peace and privacy.
great to spend some time off by the water and with a cool fireplace

Meine Kollegin und ich waren für ein Event in Berlin und die Unterkunft war nur 15 Min. zu Fuß von der Location entfernt. Es war wie beschrieben und wir haben uns wohl gefühlt. Das Bad könnte ggf. mal etwas neu gemacht werden, da unten an der Dusche es schon etwas abbröckelt. Wir waren sonst aber sehr zufrieden. LG, Vivi von Meerordnung.
Guter Standort und genug Platz für sechs Personen.
Nice apartment, clean, comfy, good office chair for working, good bathroom, very helpful host

Goeie locatie met leuke ontbijt tentjes en restaurants op loopafstand. Appartement is fijne plek voor gezin van 4. Alles goed en makkelijk geregeld. De hoofdfoto met de plantenkas hoort bij de binnentuin, niet bij het appartement.
Nice enough place , adequate for a short stay , nice area and very short walk to S-bahn and U-bahn , would stay again , Nicholas was very helpful
Amazing place and amazing host with outstanding communication and helpfullnesss.
There are two other apartments in the building. Both were having extremely loud parties while we were there.
War alles super

Amazingly spacious and comfortable apartment. Clean, quiet   and well equipped. Communication was very easy, as were arrival and departure. And the lift was much appreciated. Highly recommend to future Airbnb travellers
Great, spacious apartment overlooking the park

Tout était très bien préparé, l'accueil d 'Eileen chaleureux et l'appartement impeccable et très agréable. Je recommande! Quartier animé avec restaurants internationaux. Juste une petite réserve sur la qualité du matelas (moyenne) et l'absence de store ou rideau au vasistas au-dessus du lit.
Great location. Big and comfortable apartment. Great price. Little bit hot inside but there are fans to deal with it. Strongly recommend!

We really enjoyed our stay at Andreas' quirky altbau. The apartment is located steps away from a tram line and within walking distance of a lot of restaurants and shops. Andreas was excellent about keeping in touch with us and was very helpful. He seemed to really care about us having a good experience staying in Berlin.

Schöne, nett eingerichtete Wohnung. Die Wohnung ist groß genug für 4 Gäste. Besonders toll fanden wir auch den sehr großzügig bemessenen Stauraum, so viel Platz hat man selten.
Der Pool Ist schön und kann sehr gut zum morgendlichen wachwerden oder bei schlechten Wetter verwendet werden. Hat uns sehr gut gefallen!
It was a very nice stay at the Airbnb from Peter and Denis! The flat is big and has a very good location in Berlin!
bon logement, Lev répond assez rapidement

A fabulous location and unit. Incredibly spacious, all the amenities you need and everything super close. Was the perfect spot to land and base myself as I learned about Berlin and conducted my research. The unit managers were quick in responding and answering any questions I had.
Marion ist eine großartige Gastgeberin und ein wunderbarer Mensch. Alles ist schön sauber und ordentlich. Vielen Dank!

This is a perfect apartment for a week in Berlin. You are in a neighborhood that still breathes a little bit of the old and rough Berlin, while having the comfort of new Berlin just around the corner and in your apartment. The place of the apartment, in a courtyard, makes it nice an tranquil, but within a few minutes walking you are at a S-Bahn to take a train to the center in just under 10 minutes. You can walk to the vibrant neighborhoods Kreuzberg or Friedrichshain.
Steffen is a pleasure to communicate with. His response is fast and friendly. Al in al highly recommendable.

Ich war 6 Tage in Sirees wunderschöner Altbauwohnung in einer sehr schönen und ruhigen Gegend. Mit der S-Bahn oder dem Bus konnte man leicht überall hinkommen, etwas gebraucht hat es allerdings schon aber darauf war ich eingestellt. Alles war wie beschrieben und schöner. Morgens hatte man Sonne in der Küche und im Schlafzimmer was einen sehr schön hat in den Tag starten lassen. Siree hat mir immer direkt geantwortet und frühzeitig alle wichtigen Informationen zukommen lassen. Das einchecken war auch super easy und sehr flexibel. Ich kann die Unterkunft also wärmstens empfehlen. Danke Siree, es war ein toller Aufenthalt für mich <3
Es un lugar agradable, con mercado y trasporte cerca!
El hotel está muy bien ubicado a unos pasos de una estación del metro, en una zona segura y cercana a muchos lugares de internet
Clean, comfortable , Sonny and breit room, easy to reach transport.
A great comfy place to stay! Thank you!
Peaceful place with a lot of beautiful things to see. I felt welcome and had a good time. Renate was a kind host. Highly recommended!

The stay in this hotel was correct for the price. It is a bit old but clean and comfortable. All you need if you are couple of nights visiting Berlin.
It is located near bus and underground stations. You can easily reach a big famous mall and lot of shopping shops well know in Berlin, by foot (15 min walk).
The staff are nice and welcoming.

Logo ao entrar no apartamento, eu quis voltar, pois havia um mau cheiro muito forte por toda a casa,  tive muita dor de cabeça, não estou segura se era infiltração, já que havia algumas manchas nas paredes do quarto e o prédio é muito antigo, a primeira vez que usei descarga achei que estava entupida, porém enviei mensagem o Yomi que me falou, que por ser uma encanação antiga, demora descer os dejetos, isso foi muito desconfortável, pois tinha que ficar apertando a descarga alguns minutos para poder funcionar e além disso é muito barulhenta. Enquanto o Yomi ele foi muito gentil, sempre respondeu rápido todas as mensagens, deu sugestões do que fazer, ele é muito acolhedor, sempre querendo saber se estava tudo bem.
Great experience.

Jan's place was clean and tidy. We were suspicious if there was a kitchen because there was no photos of it, but there is indeed a small kitchen with full equipment. Also there were coffee and tea ready to use. The place was in a nice, safe location close to metro stop, restaurants, shops etc. We liked that the host prepare a small guide with recommendations about the neighborhood :) Flat was warm. Beside the nice things, few things can be improved in this flat. One of the them is that  the sound of the ventilation in the bathroom. Once you turned on the light it was being activated and there was no button to turn it off. It was working for a long time quite loudly and we weren't able to control when it stops.. Another thing was the fridge which was also loud, just next to bed. The last thing was about the hot water in the shower. Maybe it was because of electric heater, hot water run out during the shower.. In general we liked the place and recommend to stay..

There is nothing much to complain as such. One very important thing though, there is some problem with the flooring in one of the bedroom. Because of which when you walk there is a lot of vibration and sound. The guy in the floor beneath often comes and requests to walk very softly to avoid sound being overheard in his apartment. I hope Sandra gets it fixed soon.

Wir waren ein Wochenende in Franks Apartment. Es hat absolut reibungslos geklappt, die Einrichtung lässt keine Wünsche offen, perfekte Lage. Auch meine Kinder 4 und 6, haben sich sehr wohl gefühlt.
Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Sehr schönes Zimmer und Haus in reizvoller Lage. Innerhalb von fünf Fussminuten ist man am See oder in der Ortsmitte, wo es neben einem Edeka auch eine kleine Buchhandlung gibt. Mit dem Bus (zu den Stoßzeiten alle zehn Minuten) ist man in neun (!) Minuten im quirligen Tegel.
Danke für eine erholsame Woche, Silvia, in der ich nebenbei auch gearbeitet habe :-)

I had the pleasure of staying at Christiane's place for an entire week on March. The place has many advantages - a warm cozy living room, cool kitchen (which is fully equipped), and a small but very handy (and quiet) balcony.
You can find anything within 100 meters distance from the apartment, whether it is a supermarket, pharmacy, and some restaurants which are actually open until the small hours. Communicating with Christiane was easy and went without any problems. In addition, although I ended up landing a bit earlier than I expected, the apartment was ready and I got the keys plus full instructions on the electric utilities. Bottom line - the best place in Wilmersdorf that airbnb has to offer, and a truly kind host.

Très bon séjour à l'appartement proposé par Lorenzo, situé à 10 min à pied du métro U-Bahn Kochstrasse (chekpoint charlie).
L'appartement est en parfait état, il est juste à noter qu'il n'y a PAS de cuisine.
A recommander!
Quite basic. Very central however.

The apartment is clean, close to two train stations, bus lines, and a market, and it has everything you need for a great stay in Berlin.
Communication with the owners is very smooth, and they are very proactive in helping with any issues.
I will definitely return! Highly recommend! Thank you, everyone, for the stay! See you next time!
Wonderful place, comfy and equipped with all needs. Great location for travelling anywhere in Berlin. Super kind hosts. 5/5.
Buena ubicación, con metro y supermercados al lado del portal. Zona tranquila y a 15-20 minutos en bici o metro de las zonas de influencia.
We had the best time! unbelievable stay and affordable price! would 100% recommend 🫶🏻
It was a good experience. He answered every question quickly. Thank you very much.

Sehr große und saubere Altbau-Wohnung. Schön eingerichtet. Kinderfreundlich (viel Spielzeug, Hochbett). Gute Ausstattung. Fast direkt am Bahnhof (5 Min. Fußweg), also gute Verkehrsanbindung. Viele Restaurants, Kneipen und Geschäfte in fußläufiger Reichweite. Freundliche Gastgeber. Smart-Home mit Kaffee-Vollautomat. Haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Für Leute mit leichtem Schlaf eventuell etwas unruhig, da die Wohnung vorne zur Straße heraus liegt. Das war für uns allerdings kein Problem.
Très belle endroit avec une jolie terrasse. Les hôtes étaient très gentil et serviable.
Clean, quiet, modern, and private. A lovely garden apartment that suited me perfectly for a short stay. Will def stay here again!

We had a very pleasant stay. The decor was modern and nice, as on the photos. The kitchen and bathrooms were excellent, and the kids enjoyed the upstairs open bedroom. There is a park around the corner with all kinds of sport facilities.

Sehr schönes und sauberes Apartment.
Wir waren sehr zufrieden und können es jedem weiterempfehlen.
Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern verlief schnell und einfach.
Danke nochmals
Marc is very nice to us, place are clean and located in a good spot

Angelika’s apartment is very well equipped. It’s clean, bright, and comfortable. The location is great to visit Charlottenburg Palace. The neighborhood is very quiet at night. Public transportation is within 5 minutes. There are coffee shops and grocery stores nearby. Previous guests were kind enough to leave bathroom supplies and tea/coffee there. We contributed our shares too. Talk to Sabine before you need to use the washer. Give the recyclable bottles to the waiter in the ground floor beer garden.
房源整潔 位置便利 而且在G樓 不需要爬樓梯 扛行李！ 值得推薦

it was a great stay at this beaultifull and special airbnb! Very private and luxurious with TWO complete bathrooms!! 😍 also perfectly clean and complete with towels and soap available for the guests. Powerfull showers and cosy beds. Also the living area and total ambiance was very cosy  and felt like being 'at home'. the green courtyard and entrance was a pleasant extra surprise making it feel like an  special little hidden treasure. Very affordable as well, we had a great stay with many thanks to the very friendly hosts!
A bit small for 3 people but for 2 perfect
Tina und ihre Familie bieten ein sehr schönes, geräumiges und perfekt gepflegtes Zimmer mit einem sehr angenehmen Bett an. Empfehlenswert!
A comfortable, clean room in a quiet neighbourhood, yet within easy walking distance from everything you need, including public transport directly into central Berlin.
Alina's place was perfect for us. It is central to so many locations, but quiet in its placement, and the room itself was spotless and all the bedding smelled clean! What more can you ask for?

Great located, just few steps to metro station, close to Kreuzberg night life and canale. Great place for quick city break.
I haven't problem to left a car at the street.
The apartment was spacious, clean and in a fantastic location. Communication with the host was seamless. We would definitely recommend staying at the apartment for an urban experience of Berlin!

La casa, il palazzo e la vista sono bellissimi. Questo appartamento è un vero gioiellino!Location tranquilla e silenziosa, ma vicinissima alla metro.
Assolutamente consigliato per entrare in sintonia con Berlin!
Es hat mir sehr gut gefallen bei Hans-Peter, mein Zimmer war groß und ruhig. Hans-Peter war sehr hilfsbereit und großzügig, ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt, alles sehr sauber, einfach top.

Dies ist eine sehr schöne Unterkunft, sauber und sehr gemütlich eingerichtet. Astrid ist sehr freundlich, war sehr leicht zu erreichen und hat alle unsere Fragen schnell beantwortet; die perfekte Gastgeberin. Die Wohnung ist sehr zu empfehlen und hat einen tollen Garten.

Great location and great facilities. Very friendly communication and super flexible check in (I was a bit late)! The place is much bigger than it seems, the main bedroom is huge. Very cosy and quiet, with excellent high speed internet! Fantastic spot for this part of Berlin! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Rainer es un excelente anfitrión, nos permitió dejar nuestras maletas antes del horario del check in. Fue muy amable en darnos recomendaciones locales.
El departamento es muy bonito, mejor que en las fotografías. Muy limpio, ordenado y con muchas amenidades. Sin duda una gran elección, volveríamos sin duda

Sehr tolle Wohnung, wirklich sauber und es ist ein direkter S-Bahn Anschluss nach Berlin Mitte gleich in der Nähe!
Sehr Empfehlenswert

Es war ein wunderbarer Aufenthalt und ein wunderschönes Haus mit Terrasse. Ein sauberes Haus. Alles ist vorhanden und alles ist in der Nähe des Wohnortes. Sie können alles ein paar Meter von Ihnen entfernt kaufen

Excellent flat
Well located
I would recommend

Wonderful place to stay to explore the city for an extended period of time. Close to lovely cafes, bars, and the canal. Also great for public transport. Martin was extremely kind and helpful. Will definitely stay again :) Es war wunderbar

L’appartamento di Raffaela, si distingue tra le molte offerte, per lo stile, il gusto e la ricchezza di arredi e complementi di cui è dotato. Una volta entrati, per prima cosa, ci si mostrano le pareti e le porte, di un bel bianco nitido. I pavimenti rivestiti di legno, suggeriscono un tepore inatteso, mentre il passo che li percorre, produce un suono familiare e accogliente. Poi, se lo sguardo va ai soffitti, li trova alti e vasti. Il bagno spazioso è dotato di una doccia fantastica: in pochissimi secondi avete acqua calda a piacere! Elementi dell’arredo vi sorprendono: lampadari, sedie, statuine e immagini alle pareti, un’ampia scrivania, numerosi giochi per i bambini, libri per ragazzi…
In particolare, si fa apprezzare la vasta e varia biblioteca che lo impreziosisce, con i più importanti scrittori. Insomma… non manca proprio nulla. Infine : venuta a sapere che suono un po’ la chitarra, Raffaela me ne ha fatto trovare una, di ottima fattura. Questo, è il mio appartamento a Berlino

Thank you for a wonderful stay. Will definitely be back. Everything was perfect and location is amazing. Everything was easy and everything was spotless and clean. Used the Luardi Italian restaurant near by which was great also. Loads of shopping and restaurants nearby.
Thanks again.
Sehr schöne neue Unterkunft, beim Don Xuan Center!

Wir hatten echt tolle 4 Tage bei Wibke, es war sauber, gab WLAN und die Küche durfte mitgenutzt werden.
Das Zimmer war für 2 Personen ausreichend und die Gastgeberin sehr zuvorkommend und freundlich 😊 wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und waren heute morgen etwas traurig wieder zu fahren 😊 jeder Zeit wieder

The location of the accommodation is generally suitable for sightseeing in Berlin. Mr. Agustin is friendly and provides a lot of information about the accommodation and the city. Our family of four used the accommodation and we were satisfied.
Great stay and lovely host! Will definitely go back there next time I visit Berlin again :)
J'ai passé un superbe petit séjour dans cet appartement confort et à la déco vintage et rétro. Je recommande.
Très belle chambre, propre et bien située, tout était parfait et facile à organiser.

It was a perfect place not only because of location but also because of a great, caring and hospitable host. We spend some time together but too little. I met wonderful people thanks to him and i hope we'll meet again.
The flat was quiet and perfect for relax❤️ Spacious room and a charming backyard to chill. For me personally the flat was sometimes too cold and the heater was usually off but i could turn it on whenever i needed. I am definitely for saving and not wasting the heat:)
So all in all i would come back again many times:)
Wir waren für ein Wochenende in Berlin und haben uns in Madlens Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Sauber, ordentlich, gemütlich, alles da, was wir brauchten. Wir würden wiederkommen!

This B&B is truly charming in all aspects. The neighborhood, the house, the rooms and last, but not least, the host family. Small details like adding fresh strawberries for breakfast and herbs from the garden for an evening tea. Highly recommended for a relaxing stay and a taste of history in green Berlin.

Perfektes Appartement mit einer tollen Gastgeberin. Nicht nur die Lage ist toll - um die Ecke ist die Marheineke Markthalle - auch gibt es schöne kleine Läden und Restaurants. Dörthe ist eine klasse Gastgeberin. Besonders schön fand ich den Empfang mit Blumen, Wein und Knabberzeug. Ich komme bestimmt wieder!

Einchecken erst ab 15.00 ist zu spät! Wir wollten ohne Gepäck Berlin entdecken. Nach einem kurzen Telefonat wurde uns schon am Vormittag geöffnet, um die Koffer abzustellen. Der Empfang freundlich und zuvorkommend. Das Zimmer war eine positive Überraschung: Sehr sauber, mit Ziegelwand stylish und ruhig neben Innhof. Das Badezimmer groß und mit Fenster. Da kommen wir gerne wieder zurück! Danke 🤩 C & B
The house was perfect, located in a central area of the city with a subway station right around the corner, ideal for my stay!

L'appartamento di Klaus è stato perfetto per il nostro soggiorno. Pulito, ordinato, luminoso e tranquillo. La posizione è ben servita dai tram e bus e in poco tempo si raggiunge l'isola dei musei o le principali stazioni. La location è suggestiva e tranquilla. È presente un ristorante nella corte interna, ma la sua presenza non ci ha recato alcun disturbo. Raccomandiamo assolutamente l'alloggio!
Great suite in a hotel. Has a nice pool and sauna area. Also has a nice workout area. Not too far from the subway so easy to get downtown. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend!

The house was confortable, and everything went very well when communicating with Jürgen.
Definitely can stay there again when in the area and recommended for other travellers.
Absolut empfehlenswert. Wir haben die Zeit in Berlin sehr genossen. Danke Annett!
Responsive host, great location!
The tall ceiling makes the space look bigger than it is. It has big windows that allow enter the light. Very near to the Subway, just 3 minutes. Very confortable for just one person

Nice stay in a clean apt. in a central location with a very comfortable bed and linens. A few things to note, however: up four flights of stairs, in the amenities section it says there would be towels, but in the descriptions, it said to bring your own towels. There are no towels provided. There are very limited kitchen tools (example: no drinking glasses) and there were only 2 rolls of toilet paper provided for a 6 night stay. There was no AC (as listed) and it got pretty hot. The photos make the place look a little nicer than it was in person, but over all it was a decent comfortable stay.
El piso de Laura es increible, la zona en la que esta ubicado es perfecta, muchos bares, restaurantes, etc

Leider hat es uns nicht gefallen. Die Wohnung ist eigentlich super schön, aber leider total dreckig. Es wurde so gut wie nichts geputzt, nicht mal durchgesaugt wurde!
Im Bad waren die Armaturen völlig unangetastet von einem Putzlappen, ebenso das Klo wo noch Urinreste unter der Klobrille zu finden waren. Am Duschkopf hingen lange schwarze Haare runter, diese waren übrigens in der ganzen Wohnung verteilt zu finden.
Ganz zu schweigen das ewig nicht Staub gewischt wurde!
Wir haben der Gastgeberin bescheid gesagt und haben die Wohnung dann wieder verlassen um sie alles in Ordnung bringen zu lassen!
Als wir abends wieder kamen, hat sie lediglich durchgesaugt und die Haare vom Duschkopf genommen ins Klo geschmissen nicht mal abgespült und das war's!
Von zwei Nächten sind wir nur eine geblieben, sind morgens wieder gefahren!
Schade!
Molt ben situat per visitar Berlin.

Het appartement van Vincent is, zoals de advertentie het ook heel duidelijk vermeldt, niet heel groot maar perfect om enkele dagen een goed onderkomen te hebben. Ikzelf verbleef er 5 nachten. Openbaar vervoer (tram, U- en S-Bahn) is op slechts enkele minuutjes stappen.

Danke für den Aufenthalt. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral und ist schön und stylisch eingerichtet. Das Highlight war für uns die Regendusche im Bad. Leider war es in der Küche etwas unsauber in den Schränken und unter der Bank.

Enjoyed my stay. The place had everything I needed and the location was great. Sebastian answered all my questions right away & was super helpful (especially for this American tourist). I recommend for the solo traveler to Berlin.

A perfect place to stay to watch the stars on the terrace! It is easy to walk to, even if it takes 15 minutes on foot from the s-bahn. The apartment is fully yours, the furniture is modern, the beds are comfortable, the bathroom is great. Hans offered to meet us at the station and then to drive us there by car not to carry heavy luggage, thank you! I will definitely come back again :)

Wij hebben 5 nachten verbleven in het appartement van Claudia. Het was winter en toen we aankwamen was het appartement lekker warm. Alles is schoon en netjes en heel sfeervol ingericht. Bedden slapen lekker, keuken is volodende om een goed maaltijd te koken.
Het appartment is zeer rustig, je hoort 's avonds vrijwel niets. Toch vlakbij metro, horeca, winkels en supermarkt in de leuke wijk Penzlauerberg.
We hebben 4 heerijke dagen in erlijn gehad. Aanrader is om fietsen te huren; de afstanden zijn best groot en zo ervaar je de stad al fietsend. Er zit een fietsverhuur vlabij, die was helaas dicht, maar er is er ook een in de Kulturbrauerei. Prima fiesten!
Wij kwamen met de auto: parkeren kan in de straat maar is door de week betaald. Vlakbij aan de Schonhauserallee is een parkeergargage waar je voor 5 euro per dag kunt staan.
It was a lovely stay, thank you! Very clean, lots of space, great neighborhood. It is quite a hike to go up 5 floors but besides that very well worth the price.
Sehr unkompliziert, einfacher check in alles sauber, kleines Zimmer, aber völlig ausreichend

Gili was the perfect host, replied to everything superfast, very friendly and helped me with my case which was very much appreciated! The apartment was very nice, very clean and had everything I needed for my stay, also in a great location. Thank you, Gili! I would for sure stay here again and am very happy with what was my first airbnb experience. Jo

Hagie verwelkomde me persoonlijk, hij is heel communicatief en geïnteresseerd dus we hadden gelijk een leuk gesprek. De slaapkamer was schoon, er stond een goed bed en had een klein balkon. De gedeelde badkamer was ruim en schoon. Het appartement ligt in een gezellige straat in Prenzlauer Berg, Hagie heeft me restauranttips gegeven voor ontbijt en diner in de buurt waar ik heerlijk heb gegeten. Communicatie verliep soepel, als ik een vraag had beantwoordde hij die vlot en vriendelijk.
Bij een langer verblijf zou ik wel een accommodatie kiezen waar ik zelf ook ontbijt kan maken, maar voor een kort verblijf vind ik Hagie absoluut een aanbeveling waard!
Vi var meget tilfredse med opholdet.

Die Unterkunft war super gelegen. Sehr nahe an der U-Bahn und zu Fuss viele Bars und Restaurants zu erreichen. Es hat bei uns im Zimmer leider etwas übel gerochen von Anfang an und es hatte noch Haare am Boden und im Kühlschrank.
Wir konnten dafür etwas früher einchecken.
moderno, acogedor, bien dotado.......
Super séjour ! Très propre
Perfect location in Berlin and perfect size of apartments for a couple day/nights away!
Perfect location, very nice staff, recommend for a trip with friends
Eine kleine und schön gelegene Unterkunft für ein oder zwei kleine Personen:)
Sehr schöne Lage und sehr gute S-Bahn Verbringung nach Berlin, Potsdam, Wannsee. Sehr sauber und gastfreundlich. Hier kommt man gerne wieder.
Ganz toller Gastgeber und ein sehr schönes Appartement. Super Kommunikation !
Nice clean apartment,  I recommend

The room was exactly what we needed for one night's stay. The hosts were very helpful, allowing us to drop our bags prior to check in so that we could freely explore the city. The room was simple but comfortable, clean and warm. We didn't get a chance to try the breakfast, but did sample their delicious welcome drink - thank you!
Very nice and clean place. Fantastic and very good to be with your friends/family. A little bit far away from the center but Berlin is very well communicated that there’s no issue with this.
Très bien situé près des transports en commun, quartier touristique proche même à pied. Appartement calme et hôte agréable. Merci beaucoup !

This apartment was such a big surprise for us! It is super spacious, cozy and very uniquely decorated. The balcony is amazing and has a nice view of the Weserstrasse. This street is super nice and has a mix of different shops and cafes. Also Leo and Agnieszka are very nice and helpful. They put an extra mattress in the bedroom to accomodate all guests.
All in all 10/10! 🌞

Nice location! We walked everywhere. Small kitchen is nice.
Very loud noise from the street, hear people passing by, screaming kids, garbage trucks, plus that bench that is located near the entrance people sat and smoke and talked loud, no way to close upper windows so you hear everything what is happening on the street since early morning till late at night. WiFi never worked so if you are relying on WiFi better have a backup plan. Maybe they will fix it soon. And no A/C.
Overall good place.
Hat von A bis Z gepasst, alles gut funktioniert, reibungslos und unterstützend, in einer attraktiven Gegend, an der Ringbahn ideal gelegen, perfekte Kommunikation mit Gastgeber
We have had a nice stay at Emirs flat. He was very kind and helpful in all matters. When we come back to berlin we want to stay at his flat once again.
Eine herzliche Gastgeberin im coolen Stadtteil. Gerne kommen wir  wieder.

L'accueil était tres bien. Le logement est situé a quelques stations en métro du centre Berlin.
Il y avait tous les supermarchés et les magasins à coté pour faire les courses.
Toilette à partager, mais propre.
Machine à café gratuitement le matin.
Endroit à visiter
Dietrich's place in Berlin was great. Top location. very easy to access and Dietrich was always on hand to help out.

Martina's place is super spacious and is situated in a great neighbourhood. We really enjoyed our stay here and would certainly book again.
Martina is also very easy to communicate with; she gave us many useful tips and was flexible with early bag drops etc - it was very much appreciated!

El hospedaje fue tal cual se describe, con todo lo necesario para un par de días en Berlín. Fácil de llegar en transporte público y con excelentes lugares por visitar. El anfitrión es por completo una persona excelente!! Nos recomendó lugares por visitar y para comer y nos trató muy amablemente

Eine schöne, gemütliche Wohnung, die eine gute Anbindung mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln hat, so dass man sehr schnell ins Zentrum kommt. Ruhige Lage, dennoch in der Nähe von Cafés und Restaurants. Ich komme gerne wieder.

Top Wohnung in sehr schöner, sehr ruhiger Lage.
Alles großzügig und super gepflegt. Besser kann man nicht wohnen.
Jürgen ist ein sehr netter Gastgeber, auch wenn wir uns nur kurz gesehen haben, da wir auf einer Messe gearbeitet haben.
Leider keine badewanne wie auf dem bild zu sehen war, ebenso ein anderes zimmer als auf den bildern ansonsten alles top
Great flat, great location. Can only recommend it!
Jedyna wada to brak workow na smieci

Het was echt top, goede verbindingen met onder andere het vliegveld, maar ook met het centrum. Naar het centrum kun je ook gerust lopend gaan. De omgeving van het appartement was gezellig, met Kitkat in dezelfde straat en leuke tentjes om een koffietje te drinken. Het appartement was perfect, je had alles wat je nodig had. Vaatwasser, televisie, shampoo en conditioner, strijktafel. Zelfs een polaroid waarmee je een foto kon maken en ophangen aan de muur. Alleen olie moest je zelf halen, dus een tip voor toekomstige boekers. Het binnenkomen was ook heel makkelijk via de site van Bob W en het was erg duidelijk beschreven. Wij hebben heel comfortabel verbleven bij Bob W, en ik zou dit zeker aan iedereen aanraden!

great place! good communication, easy access & flexibility with my reservation needs. i walked to the spanish tapas, or across the street excellent vietnamese restaurant mama cook & a delicious steak house- all nearby! A kiosk near for water & snacks. walking distance to check point charlie tourist area with more food, a tech store for any power/ computer needs. comfortable bed & bedding, clean, nice large bathroom. its great place
Michael was an excellent host and the rental unit was just as described, very helpful host and great spot in Berlin! Underground and shuttle train was close by :)
Es war alles zu meiner Zufriedenheit. Sehr gut gelegen und die Kommunikation hat sehr gut und unkompliziert funktioniert.

Einfaches, aber schickes Hotel.
Sehr sauber, netter Check- in und Check-out.
Würde ich jederzeit wieder übernachten.
Vielen Dank!

Fantastic location, fantastic apartment and fantastic service! Couldn’t recommend more highly, it’s everything you need for a city break.
Tip - the Nextbike service is so simple to use and there is a lockup for them on the road right outside this apartment, makes getting around Berlin so so easy!
Die Wohnung war super, alles wie beschrieben

sehr schön und abgelegen, sehr freundlich Empfängen und verabschiedet worden.
alles zur besten Zufriedenheit
Confortable et super emplacement, merci !
Exactly as advertised. Clean hostel with a relaxing atmosphere. Would recommend
The apartment was clean and cozy. Jörn is very friendly and helpful host!
What a fantastic apartment! In the heart of the best area of Berlin and tons of good food/cafes around. Merlin was absolutely fantastic and responsive as well.
Kevin was very communicative ~ would recommend

Wir können die Unterkunft nur empfehlen! Die Kommunikation mit Hans und Ute war super unkompliziert und die beiden haben meine Schwiegererltern sehr freundlich in Empfang genommen! Die Lage ist zentral und trotzdem sehr ruhig. Alles was man für eine gute Zeit in Berlin braucht :)

Stefan was a great host -- the apartment is in the perfect neighborhood: it's young, diverse, lots of places for daytime & nighttime exploration.  The bedroom and apartment as a whole are great and I was made to feel at home the whole time.  Stefan is open & shared the apartment as though I was a regular old roommate.  I would stay here again in a second and would recommend it to anyone.
Merci à Firat pour l’accueil
Een heel fijn verblijf gehad. De ligging van het appartement was top. De host is zeer behulpzaam en de bedden liggen heerlijk. Een aanrader!
Das Prunkstück der Wohnung ist das Wohnzimmer, der Rest ist durchschnittlich aber gepflegt
Tolle Wohnung und tolle Gastgeber. Wir kommen wieder.
Familienzimmer war barrierefrei und ruhig. Hat alles gepasst.

Hallo,
Wir waren zufrieden mit der Unterkunft. War sauber und ruhig.
Sehr zentral für unsere Bedürfnisse.
Vielen Dank für die 2 Tage.

Great stay!! Close to many restaurants! Lots to do!! Aceto Lokanta is an amazing Kebab place! Get the chicken teller!! You won’t regret it!!
Numa was very responsive and always responded to us right away! Definitely would stay here again!

Der Unterkunft war sehr sauber und sah in der Realität besser und schöner als auf die Bilder aus . Wir werden immer wieder hier buchen :)
Roman ist einen sehr netten Gastgeber und war immer erreichbar. Der check in sowie auch Check out war sehr leicht und reibungslos .
Danke Ramon :)
Cozy apartment in a great location. The landlord is always available and ready to help.

Cozy rooftop apartment in a great location! Close to transport, restaurants, and a supermarket. Etienne and Judit were welcoming and helpful. The view of the TV tower was lovely. Note: 5th floor, no elevator. Would recommend! :)
it was great experience

Ich war mit meiner Familie zum Berlin-Marathon in Rainers Ferienwohnung und wir haben uns superwohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist so wie beschrieben tip-top und die Lage exzellent. Einziger kleiner Nachteil ist, dass die Schlafzimmer zur Straßenseite gelegen sind. Zwar handelt es sich um eine verkehrsarme, ruhige Seitenstraße. Doch wenn man mit offenem Fenster schläft, wird man nachts gelegentlich von grölenden Partyheimkehrern geweckt, die vor der Wohnung vorbeilaufen - also besser die Fenster geschlossen lassen. Rainer konnten wir diesmal leider nicht persönlich kennenlernen, weil er über das Wochenende verreist war. Seine Vertretung hat sich aber ebenfalls prima um uns gekümmert und die späte Anreise klappte perfekt. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!

The flat is very cozy and well isolated from the weather (summer and winter), ideally located on a ground floor behind a nice inner garden. Also, the location of the building is really convenient, since it's a few metres away from a supermarket, pharmacy and metro station. The host Amit is very friendly and the communication with him was great.

Besser geht‘s nicht. Perfekte Unterkunft für einen Trip nach Berlin. Wer die Kombi aus ländlicher Idylle und den Trubel der Großstadt
möchte, ist hier perfekt aufgehoben.
Chris was super lovely and the room is absolutely beautiful!

Apostolos's place was perfect for a day Business trip to Berlin, and would have enjoyed staying there longer. He was patient and helped a lot in locating the apartment. Everything was very clean, and in a great location - loads of great restaurants and bars in the area!

Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt, alles war sauber, es gibt genug Platz und zwei Badezimmer, wenn auch beide ohne Fenster. Es gab genügend Handtücher.
Die Lage ist super, 7 min zu Fuß von U Gneisenaustraße, 5 min zum Bus. Es gibt kleine Supermärkte und Bäckereien in der Nähe. Direkt nebenan ist eine kleine Bar.
Checkin und checkout gingen unkompliziert über eine Schlüsselbox.

We had a great stay at Gili's lovely apartment and Gili is a fantastic host. The apartment was spotless and exactly like the photos. The living room is spacious and comfortable and really warm. The kitchen, although very small, is really well equipped and the shower is hot-very important in cold cold Berlin! Gili met us on our first evening and very kindly left us a bottle of bubbly to drink for new year :) He was one text away if there were any problems and answered promptly. He was really flexible and allowed us a late check out and to leave our luggage until 4pm which was greatly appreciated. The apartment is near some lovely restaurants, bars and shops including an Aldi.  Staying here is highly recommended and we will certainly tell our friends when visiting us in Berlin. Thanks again Gili!

Jan and Sally were lovely hosts. Their apartment was beautiful, spacious, and in a lovely, area with grocery stores, and public transportation just around the corner. I would absolutely return to the apartment next time I'm in Berlin.

Lena's apartment is great, spacious with a beautiful bathroom and cozy living room (even a fireplace!). Only downside is slightly thin walls and ceilings, and so you could hear almost every noise from the outside and upstairs neighbours talking. Lovely stay in all

This place not only had everything as described, but so much more!
From an amazing sound system to an automatic cleaner, everything was taken care of and led to an amazing break in Berlin for my colleagues and I.
The view from the Balcony is beautiful on a summers day, and the rooms are spacious. I would definitely return, especially as the host (Fabian) is incredibly flexible with accomadation and needs.

Philipp and Caroline’s apartment was beautiful and great for our stay in Berlin. There were lots of large windows for good natural light. The bed was EXTREMELY comfortable and the bathroom was nice and spacious. The check-in instructions are essential for finding the place- it wasn’t obvious at first where we needed to go but the instructions made it very clear! The building does not have an elevator so be prepared to carry luggage up a few flights of stairs. Also, if you are arriving at night, you’ll want to have a flashlight ready as it was very dark in the hallways and stairwells. Otherwise a lovely place within walking distance of a few bars and transit stations. Thank you so much to Philipp and Caroline for hosting us!

Rochus was an absolutely superb host! He was always accessible when needed and ensured that we were as comfortable as possible. The house was superbly clean, located in a peaceful neighbourhood close to public transport. I am definately looking forward to returning in the summer. If you are looking for accomodation in Berlin look no further! This is the place to be.

ottima ubicazione e buona la dotazione
4 piani a piedi non sono comodissimi
compact place!
Sauber, gemütlich, ruhig und unkompliziert!

Kann die Unterkunft von Kathrin weiterempfehlen. Gute Lage, sehr sauber und gemütlich. Allgemein eine sehr schöne Einrichtung mit liebe zum Detail.
Kathrin ist sehr nett und immer gut zu erreichen. Ich komme gerne wieder.

Es hat alles top funktioniert und ich habe mich sehr willkommen gefühlt. Super sauber und komfortabel. Die Kommunikation per SMS war total einfach und unkompliziert. Die Reaktionszeiten bei Fragen war außergewöhnlich schnell. Sehr gerne wieder

Ece’s mother was a fantastic host. As she told me at the beginning, she lovely treat you like a mom that cannot speak with you (if you don’t know either German or Turkish). Her gestures are enough to explain you the basics of the co-living in the apartment.
For any kind of accidents, you can always text to the daughter Ece, that was always available and fast responsive.
The area is incredible comfortable even if it seems empty, thanks to the very close train station that brings you directly to the station. A supermarket might be useful to save some money for a easy going lunch and a kebab place is ready to serve you an emergency meal.
A general information about Berlin, if you are there for a week, take a one week train ticket “abc” possibly at the airport. you can use it for all the public transportations and will bring you also from the Airport directly to the Mitte (and this apartment).
If you are alone and you want to visit Berlin or having a solid base to travel around Germany, this apartment is a comfortable and cheap choice. Even if you’ll not be at home, you’ll feel like it.
Hope to come back here again.
Tschus.
Thomas

Ein sehr schönes Zimmer mit Küche und Bad.Busanbindung
direkt vor der Haustür die wir jeden Tag genutzt haben um nach Tegel und Heiligensee zu fahren.Küche und Bad sind top.Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt während unseres Aufenthaltes.

适合两人出行入住，体验很好，房东人很好，热情爱交流。
优点:位置非常好，到达地铁站仅3分钟，房东人热情，爱交流，房间够大，干净整洁，容易找到。

推荐携带东西较少的人入住，其他都非常好。
The area is walkable and well connected to public transport. The room was bright and the view from the balcony was lovely.
Preis - Leistung TOP!!!
The stay was great! The hostel is well located and the staff so nice! I recommend!!
great home base for exploring Berlin! the loft was very comfortable.

The place definitely exceeded our expectations. The check-in process was flawless, and the explanation was clear. Additionally, the host was always reachable and helpful. The center of Berlin is very easy to get to. We took bus 194 from the "Kröver Str." bus stop and got off at U Friedrichsfelde to then take the U5 to Alexanderplatz. We could also walk around the area at night without any problems as it is a safe neighborhood.
Thank you Kathrin we enjoyed the apartment. We felt welcomed and loved the location.
The apartment is in a great location and exactly as described. I stayed for a week and would stay here again if I was looking for a place.

Merlin's apartment is in a really great location, with many shopping and eating options within a 10 minute walk. It is also conveniently located near a train station. The space was clean and spacious, with enough amenities to cook should you desire.
Tolle Unterkunft mit allen notwendigen Utensilien, sogar für längere Aufenthalte. Alles ist wie auf den Bildern und in der Darstellung beschrieben.
The place was great, clean, full of kitchen equipment, esay communication with the host.

All good, the only thing I didn't like is that I wanted to ask to extend the checkout time and there was no one to ask that in the front desk and they didn't respond via the app.
The room has obviously not going to be used that day since there was no cleanning staff in the whole place (sunday)... So it would have been useful to know it beforehand so we could have stayed a bit more or even store our luggage and save some money. Or at least the option to leave the luggage in the property for a few more hours.

The appartment was very nice. Easy entrance and a nice location. We had the feeling some utilities were lacking, mainly equipment foor cooking etc (eg. A spoon for accuralty dosing the coffee). However, these were onlyminor problems. Very fast and clear communication was a big positive.

excellent and rare catch!! Perfect location, nice bar (LAMM) next door XD, wonderful cafe P-Berg, and the whole atmosphere of Schönhauser Allee. The room with balcony is very calm (courtyard) and has everything you need, as well as the kitchen and the bathroom. The apt is suitable for those, who have to work within the days in Berlin (!).
Check-in and checkout are flexible, so you don't have to worry about it.
And Damur was very kind and supportive, that made the stay wonderful.
Es war sehr schön! Tolles Haus, herzliche Begrüßung, super Lage! Wir kommen gerne wieder.
everything was wonderful 10/10 would recommend.
Sehr saubere und geschmackvoll eingerichtete Suite, gute ÖPNV-Anbindung und unkomplizierter Check-In.

Die Wohnung ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet und wir haben uns immer seh wohl gefüllt. Sie übertrifft die Erwartungen bei weitem. Die Kommunikation ist sehr gut. Einzig die Übernahme der Schlüssel bei Key Net ist etwas kompliziert, ich konnte jedoch bei Abreise die Schlüssel in der Wohnung deponieren. Die Lage im Helmhkiez ist auch interessant.
It was a great stay there, everything was good and like promised and it was very cozy and clean there - the location is also very central in Berlin :)

Persönlicher Check-in, liebevoll eingerichtet, eigenes Bad, Kühlschrank etc. vorhanden,
Ich habe mich bei Ugur sehr wohl gefühlt und werde ganz sicher wiederkommen. Herzlichen Dank, das ich dein Gast sein durfte. Kordula

Sophia was a lovely person who was very easy to communicate with and very understanding despite a mistake I had made regarding my arrival time and check in. The home is lovely, cozy, spacious and the bed was very comfortable. The apartment is in a great location close to many restaurants, convenience stores and multiple metro stations.
Danke für den schönen Aufenthalt. War super gemütlich und genau das, was wir uns vorgestellt hatten!☺️
This was a perfect location. All of the neighboring stores and restaurants were easy to get to the house was clean and the host was very responsive.
War toll und nah am Zentrum.
Enjoyed our stay in this flat
Das Zimmer war richtig geil. Bett schön gemütlich und Optik richtig nice. Aber verwirrende Gangstruktur. Wenn man nicht bei der Führung aufpasst kann man sich verirren. Aber sonst top.
Alles prima! Wir kommen gerne wieder:-)
The place was great, easy connections into the city and well equipped with everything you could need. Wifi really only works in the kitchen.
Perfect location for our 3 night stay in Berlin! Loved the balcony and the restaurant suggestions.

시간에 맞춰 숙소앞에 도착했는데 호스트가 답이 없어서 추운데 두 아이와 걱정하면서 밖에서 기다렸습니다. 우리는 10분 넘게 기다렸고 호스트는 집에서 천천히 내려왔습니다.

Our group had a comfortable stay at Ruth's place. It has lots of space, comfy beds and is in a quiet building close to a tram stop. Thanks!
Beautiful apartment in a great location. Highly recommend!

Ben’s space is one of a kind. The style and ambiance of his space is truly immaculate. Everything was incredibly well thought out from the well stocked fridge to the hand soap in the bathroom. I truly couldn’t have asked for a better stay. The location is unmatched, super close to many cafes, public transportation, and bars + restaurants.

Beautiful apartment in perfect location. We liked that there were two bathrooms and the big windows throughout the apartment are amazing overlooking Mauerpark! There is also a grocery store in the same house 👍🏽.
Comfortable, clean, and spacious apartment in a fantastic location! We'd gladly return to Doc Sun's place :)

The property is located in a very good location. Near city center and metro. The room is neat and comfortable. There are a lot of places for things. The bathroom has a hairdryer and everything you need for a comfortable stay. The staff speaks good English and will always answer all questions.
in the center, close everywhere. I recomend.

Although the apartment isn't brand new, it's a pleasant and quiet place. The kitchen is well-equipped, making it easy to prepare meals, and the bathroom is convenient. Overall, the apartment is clean and well-maintained.
Mike, the host, was kind and welcoming. He was very flexible with my arrival time, allowing me to check in much earlier than the time listed on the site. He was available to help if needed but respected my privacy, which I appreciated.
One aspect I felt a bit concerned about was the bed. I would have slept more soundly if the railing were a bit higher, as I have a past experience of falling from a loft bed. However, this is just my personal thought; the bed is as safe as any other loft bed.
The location is also great— just about 5 minutes walk to the tram, which takes about 15 minutes to Alexanderplatz.
Lastly, the price is very reasonable. For anyone who isn’t specifically looking for a brand-new or recently renovated place, this flat will not disappoint.

Hotel Ambiente was really a nice hotel during my short stay in Berlin!
The location just a pretty street during autumn and just perfect for a super introverted person like me🥹
It’s walkable to almost everything you need! And the receptionists. Oh my good, they’re really nicest persons on earth! They’re very helpful, informative and kind! Thank you for Theo even help me to search for another stay/hotel nearby since I need to extended. Really meant in, I’ll definitely will stay here again.

Apartment is incredibly close to public transport links so perfect for getting in and around Berlin. Apartment is exactly as described, with all the amenities you could need. More than enough space for two people and a generous sized bed.
Unfortunately when we arrived there had been a miscommunication and the apartment had not been cleaned after the previous occupant, which at 11pm was far from ideal. That being said, several measures were made to apologise for the inconvenience so our stay wasn’t dramatically affected.
Would definitely stay again
very nice place

Wir haben zwei Nächte in Heikes & Heinrichs Wohnung verbracht. Obwohl die Wohnung nicht zentral liegt, ist sie gut angebunden und wichtige Orte wie der Hauptbahnhof sind schnell zu erreichen. Der Check-In (mit Nachbarin im Haus) war schnell und unkompliziert Wir haben alles sauber & wie beschrieben vorgefunden. Insbesondere aufgrund des Preis-Leistung-Verhältnisses absolut zu empfehlen.

Brilliant stay. Jonas was super helpful with local recommendations. Would definitely recommend! Thanks Jonas! :)
Great apartment in a great location. Great bars and restaurants within immediate proximity and Berlin landmarks within walking distance. The apartment was spacious and clean.

mooi appartement, super douche erbij. vlakbij een tram station wat het navigeren door de stad heel makkelijk maakt.

Ferry’s place was absolutely perfect for our stay in Berlin. He is very prompt with replying to messages and makes check in and check out very easy. His place is a perfect place to stay in Berlin - clean, quiet, and in a perfect location. We loved our stay here and would highly recommend Ferry’s place.

Host was very flexible and allowed early check in.
