Was also incredibly noisy - neighbouring apartment had a party on first night of our stay which went on until next morning. Next night was as bad with outside street noise.
We left apartment one day early as no one was able to get any sleep.
Beautiful place, nicely placed, beautiful art, very nice host! Overall very satisfied with our stay! 🤗
You get what you pay for - a hostel in an incredible location. They do a great job building community and providing community amenities - breakfast, bar, events.

Die Wohnung befindet sich in einer tollen Lage und man erreicht sehr gut den Hauptbahnhof von dort aus, da ganz in der Nähe Bushaltestellen sind. Es ist super sauber gewesen und es gab für meine Kommilitoninen und mich sogar genug Platz am Tisch, um zu dritt an Laptops zu arbeiten. Antworten vom Gastgeber kamen immer schnell und waren hilfreich! Wir würden die Wohnung auf jeden Fall noch mal buchen :) sehr empfehlenswert

Katja and Bernd were the perfect hosts and incredibly helpful. They went out of their way to make sure I could access the accommodation and to check I was enjoying my stay. They sent over lots of information before arrival about how to get to the apartment, local shops, and all their personal recommendations. The apartment is really spacious and the balcony was a lovely space to sit out on. It was so peaceful, I never heard any noise from the street or other residents. The kitchen is beautiful and well stocked for those who want to cook. It's a very short walk from the U Bahn and only a couple more minutes from the S Bahn. Even at night it felt safe walking back to the apartment. There are plenty of restaurants and shops along the main road to stock up on anything you need. I can't thank Katja and Bernd enough for such an enjoyable stay, and I hope to visit again.
Very nice apartment and excellent hosting. Greifswalderstraße is a bit busy, but in the surrounding streets you find cosy restaurants, cafés and small shops.

Die Unterkunft ist ideal für einen Kurzaufenthalt in Berlin. Sie ist sehr zentral gelegen und trotzdem absolut ruhig!!! Check-In war unkompliziert und die Kommunikation schnell, freundlich und hilfsbereit. Wir haben uns dort 3 Tage sehr wohl gefühlt.

Sehr schöne Wohnung in bester Lage, wenn man authentisches Berlin erleben möchte, so wie es heute von den jungen und reifen, kreativen Leuten in dieser Stadt gelebt wird. Lohnt sich auf alle Fälle. Dazu kommt ein toller Gastgeber.

La casa è molto bella e comoda, anche per prendere treno e metro.

Good location, public transportation stops are very close by. Communication with Josef was great and he responded super quickly. Checkin went smoothly too. As the apartment is on the first floor and it’s not very soundproof, it got a little noisy at times. Cleanliness could be a bit improved. All in all we enjoyed our stay and the accommodation is very affordable!😊
Famille avec deux ados, spacieux, lumineux et très agréable. Location de vélos est très utile pour visiter Berlin. Nous recommandons.

We came for the first time in Berlin for 4 days, and we enjoyed the district with nice bars and small shops. If you like to enjoy simple things in life, you will love this soul of creativity in the air.
Only recommended :)
Das Airbnb war sehr schön,gut zu erreichen und Parkplatzmäßig sehr entspannt. Es hatte alles was drin geschrieben wurde, und die Inhaber sind sehr lieb und antworten schnell.

The appartment was confortable and big enough considering the usual small sizes in Europe.
The location was interesting with many small restaurants and cafes around. Also, it is walking distance to the subway allowing us to visit all places we wanted.
The check-in was very easy. Erik joined us at the location. What’s app exchange were easy and clear with him.
The only drawback for us were the beds. We were 3 guys looking to sleep in 3 different beds.
One room was spatious and ok for one. The other 2 beds were very small and mattresses were very thin.

The place was really nice , within walking distance from a lot of really nice restaurants and right beside a tram station so it was super convenient.
The hosts were amazing they were super friendly and helpful and made us feel at home !
Definitely would stay here again !!

Urlaub auf einer Insel ist immer was Besonderes, zudem wenn man sich in einer ehemaligen Munitionsfabrik niederlässt. In "unserem" sehr gepflegten und großzügigen "Loft" haben wir uns sehr wohlgefühlt. Die Vormittagssonne, die durch die riesengroßen Fenster schien, hat uns das Frühstück gleich doppelt so gut schmecken lassen und uns mit viel Energie für den bevorstehenden Tag "aufgeladen". Unsere Gastgeberin versorgte uns zudem mit dem besten "rundum Wohlfühlprogramm" und gab uns sehr gerne Tipp's und Info's zu Kulinarischem, Kulturellem, möglichen Freizeitaktivitäten auf und um "Eiswerder" herum, zu Historie der Insel und zu sonst noch Wichtigem und Aktuellem, was man wissen müsste, oder sollte, wenn man seine Tagesausflüge in und um Berlin plant. Wir bedanken uns bei Birgit für Ihre nette Gastfreundschaft und freuen uns auf ein Wiedersehen. Birgit & George

Decidimos quedarnos en este apartamento por los comentarios de otros viajeros y por la ubicación. Merece mucho la pena. Está ubicado a unos 15 minutos en metro dl centro de Berlín y justo en la calle de al lado hay un aldi.
Frank nos dejó preparada información y mapas sobre Berlín.
Es un apartamento muy cómodo y limpio.

We had a lovely time here - spacious apartment in a great location with many thoughtful touches. We particularly liked the wireless chargers and the coffee machine! The apartment was also really accommodating of our 2 year old who had plenty of room to roam. Would definitely stay again if back in Berlin :-)
A cozy room in a great location. It is on the smaller side, but a great price so that makes sense. The host was super friendly and quick to respond.
Perfekt für Berlinbesucher die in all dem Stadtwirbel eine ruhige und doch zentrale Bleibe suchen. Gemütlich eingerichtet und total nette Gastgeber. Empfehlenswert!
Great location to transit. Spacious rooms. Responsive to questions.

The apartment is as described - it’s a great location and is as quirky as described. It really is in the basement so it is damp-ish. Having the windows open helps but we had some ants marching in so had to close the windows. A couple of oscillating fans would make it really comfortable. The apartment was short on paper products (not enough toilet paper and no paper napkins or paper towels in the kitchen and only one small kitchen towel) so while it’s adequately equipped for cooking, plan to buy paper towels or napkins to be able to function well in the kitchen even if you’re just bringing food in or making coffee. It is weird to have the shower essentially in the kitchen, but having a separate toilet and sink in the other bathroom made it feel like having 2 bathrooms which was nice. It’s a fine apartment for a couple of adults for a couple of nights and you can’t beat the location! If there were a couple of fans for air movement it would be more comfortable for sleeping and drying bath towels. I do recommend staying here if the floor plan and apartment style makes sense for you and you don’t plan to be there much except to sleep and get ready.
Super sauber, super nett, super Lage, gerne wieder, Danke

good located，good for rest very quite. The apartment at sixth floor, the elevator only up to 5th floor. The apartment was big enough for two . Some furniture need to be taken carefully. The mostly difficult thing for me was the apartment entry door hard to open . Pls fix or change it.
Excellent location around the corner from the train to everywhere and a super cute, clean and stylish little apartment! Perfectly suitable for our needs, would definitely consider coming again:).

Eine Unterkunft, die sehr zu empfehlen ist, mit einem sehr netten und zuvorkommenden Gastgeber! Komme gerne wieder.

Cozy bedroom with nice balcony. Tina is very friendly, and the place is easy to find.

Logement en semi sous-sol au calme très bien situé dans le quartier de Kreuzberg. Communication très facile avec le propriétaire. Peut être un peu juste pour une famille de 5 notamment en raison de la taille de la cuisine, raiment rikiki mais cela aura peu d'importance pour la plupart.

Sehr nette und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin und sehr saubere Wohnung mit allem was man so braucht!

Super séjour. Proche du centre, bien desservi par les transports en commun. Très pratique pour rejoindre les différents endroits de la ville. La cuisine est fonctionnelle et bien équipée. Le quartier est calme et tranquille.
Ahmed est un hôte très chaleureux, très accueillant et a répondu avec gentillesse à toutes mes questions. Je me suis sentie vite très à l'aise et comme à la maison. Je recommande et je reviendrai avec plaisir. Merci encore :-)
auch dieses Mal war alles perfekt. vom Zimmer, bis zur Kommunikation, bis zur Umgebung

Am besten nach der Hausnummer 74 suchen. Der Eingang zum Airbnb ist das Tor neben der Haustür 74.
Beim Verlassen muss man das Tor stark ziehen damit es aufgeht.
Das Airbnb hält was es verspricht und ist tip top.
Alles in allem top! 👍🏻
Eine einfache und saubere Unterkunft in ruhiger und gut angebundener Lage. Danke

Das Hostel ist modern und sauber. Die Umgebung nicht unbedingt die beste, aber das Hostel ist abgeschieben von der Straße mit einem schönen Innenhof. Die U-Bahn ist direkt um die Ecke, sodass man sehr gut überall hin kommt. Kann es weiter empfehlen!
Espace agréable, neuf et bien situé près des transports publics quartier top
Ottima sistemazione, vicino ai mezzi pubblici, per visitare la città. Alloggio pulito e in ordine corrispondente alle foto.

Really moderna and nice hotel, easy check in and entrance during all hours of the day. Also loved how it had AC during a heat wave! Great location as well as it's right next to a train station, nightlife and food! Will book again if back in Berlin.

Das Apartment ist Teil eines sehr gepflegten Anwesen in zentraler und dennoch ruhiger  Lage mit einer U-Bahn-Station direkt gegenüber. Die Wohnung ist sehr freundlich und schön eingerichtet; ich habe mich sofort wie zu Hause gefühlt.
Excellent stay. Exactly as advertised. Host was also extremely helpful and clear with the instructions. Parking was right outside and it was clean and quiet. Exactly what I wanted.

Great apartment, nice and warm afterbirth outside all day! The apartment was near the UBahn, supermarkets and great bars. Gal supplied really easy check information and there were guide books in the flat. Comfy bed, great shower, couldn't want any more!

We enjoyed our stay, despite the fact that one of the showers didn't have warm water and there was a lack of communication in advance of our arrival, which meant that we had to wait to be let into the apartment. In addition, maintenance work had to be carried out when we arrived. There was a lack of sufficient pillows and bedlinen and the double beds had single duvets on them. We couldn't find any instructions for getting rid of our recycling and waste, so we had to leave everything in the apartment, and there were no instructions about what to do with the towels and bedlinen. The apartment is in a great place for the U-Bahn, so very convenient for where we wanted to be and visit, and there were supermarkets very close by, which was handy. The apartment is very spacious and stylish. However, it is in a building site, so the workmen started working at 7am on the Monday. If you are staying during the week I don't think you would be able to get a lie in!

Moayad ist ein super Gastgeber, Infos und klare Anweisungen zum Check-In erhielt ich am Tag vor meiner Ankunft. Ich habe mich in dem Apartment sehr wohl gefühlt, alles entsprach der Beschreibung und war sauber. Immer wieder gerne, vielen Dank!

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement lumineux. Les photos sont fidèles, la propreté impeccable , les hôtes attentifs et arrangeants pour la consigne des bagages. L'appartement possède une bibliothèque bien documentée sur la ville. Le quartier est très coloré avec ses façades bleues et vertes typiques de Wedding, et bien desservi (ligne 9) par un réseau de transports, il est vrai, un peu plus kafkaïen. Rien ne manque donc ici pour un passage réussi à Berlin.

Die Unterkunft ist gut gelegen und hat bereits in der Nähe die sehr belebte Akazienstrasse im Angebot. Alle anderen Sehenswürdigkeiten sind mit U- und S-Bahn bestens zu erreichen.
Das Ambiente der Wohnung ist grosszügig und hell. Die Ausstattung ist optimal für ein paar erholsame Tage in Berlin. Wenn etwas fehlt, sind die Besitzerin und ihr Team schnell zur Stelle. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und können die Wohnung sehr empfehlen.

Wunderschöne Wohnung, blitzsauber. Einziger Nachteil ist die Zugänglichkeit bloß über die steile, enge und dazu gewendelte Treppe ins 3. OG. Aber das weiß man vorher. Ärgerlich ist es, wenn man bei derart hoher Endreinigungsgebühr auch noch selbst den Müll runterbringen soll. Aber geschenkt.
Wir waren sehr zufrieden, vielen Dank!
Lovely stay, highly recommend
Byli jsme spokojeni - hezké místo, dobrá komunikace, dále od centra Berlína, ale dobré spojení. Vhodné pro děti. Děkujeme.
It was nice but the studio we had didn’t ressemble the pictures, what was a bit disappointing.
Nice cosy apartment. We have enjoyed our stay. We got good instructions on how to get to the city by bus 265. Very friendly host, apartment clean and nice and cold in the summer heat.
Schöne und gut ausgestattete Wohnung, gut angebunden und direkt am Park. Perfekt :)

We rented Fai apartment as we were exhibitors in Messe Berlin. Even if the apartment seems to need a little update, it is exactely as described, and is provided with everything we may need. The position is very good and the apartment is really calm. The park nearby and the fact that on request she provides a parking spot are certainly a plus. Even though she was in another country, Fai was always proactive, very thoughtful and answered promptly to every questions we had. We recommend this location.
The place is great and in a perfect location. Host was super helpful and always responsive. Nice kitchen and bathroom. Will be back and recommend for sure.

Thomas was very nice and welcoming, he wasn’t home alot but wanted us to feel at home. Everything was perfect and well described too! The terras is a big plus, especially because it’s next to the room.
Had a great time!
Thank you, Thomas! :-)

Oliver's place was clean and in a good location. The neighbours could be noisy upstairs. The public transport links are near the accommodation and easy to navigate. There is also a great Italian restaurant on the next street (called Sapori di Casa), which we highly recommend! Supermarkets are nearby.
The showers were great and the beds were comfortable, the pillows were a bit uncomfortable though. The kitchen is well equipped. It's worth noting the flat is a slightly strange layout as one of the bedrooms is only accessible by going through another bedroom.
Oliver showed us around the place when we arrived, however, it would've been helpful to have a welcome book with local recommendations and general information about the property.
Overall a good base for seeing Berlin.
Great Space

Staying at Gunilla's flat was a great experience. The flat was very comfortable and we had everything we needed. Gunilla left us some welcome treats, which made our arrival even more special. The flat is on the ground floor, very nicely decorated, and has a small kitchen area with a fridge, microwave oven, coffee machine and french press (which we used every morning), a large bedroom and a very spacious bathroom. Gunilla is a fabulous host. She sent us directions to her place before we left and was very quick at responding to my queries, which were actually sent quite late at night. The flat is located in a very charming part of town and access to public transport is very easy. We couldn't have asked for a better place!

Doerthe's place is really nice. We love Berlin and this apartment in Kreuzberg is in a great location for walking into town (20 minutes to Mitte) and in a good neighbourhood for dining out too. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed including a high chair and cot for the baby. As 6 adults and baby, we though we might be quite cramped in there but we weren't... it was a good size. Thanks again!
Nice apartment. Very close to public transportation. Easy to communicate with owner. Would stay there again.

Es hat uns sehr gut gefallen! Die Ecke ist wunderbar gelegen. Ruhig, aber dennoch nicht zu weit weg vom Trubel. Till war sehr nett und zuvorkommend, sowie immer erreichbar. Würden wir jedem empfehlen, der Berlin erkunden möchte!

Natalia's place was wonderful! She was quick to respond and set us up with a friend to meet us upon arrival. The place is spacious, clean, and has an amazing terrace. Location is great, quiet neighborhood but an easy walk to some restaurants and transportation. Would definitely recommend and stay here again!
Very easy-going, nice industrial loft-style with vintage and wooden elements, good books on shelves in the upper floors, nice view over berlin on the roof... no problems with check-in or check-out.

There was a Problem with my original room as something got damaged, anyway i got Support from the Team, they were Nice and friendly, and everything worked amazing. It was a very nice Service and a Nice room.
excellent location in the city

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Moderne Ausstattung und alles scheinbar ganz neu. Das Haus und auch die Straße sind ruhig. Wir konnten immer gut schlafen. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind gut zu erreichen. Parkplätze waren knapp aber wir konnten einen finden.
the flat is amazing! super clean, the self check in makes everything super easy and the location is awesome. a great finding!

Wir waren zu sechst in der Unterkunft und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung liegt im Erdgeschoss und ist sehr geräumig. Die Betten fanden wir sehr bequem, auch auf dem Schlafsofa konnte man gut schlafen. Die Küchenausstattung ist auf 6 Personen ausgelegt. Spülmaschine mit Tabs und Kaffeekapseln für den ersten Tag waren vorhanden. Der Rewe ist in wenigen Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar.
Zur nächste Bushaltestelle läuft man ca 5 Minuten, zur S-Bahn Beusselstraße ca. 10 Minuten.
Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber verlief reibungslos. Die Informationen zum Check-in /-out waren detailliert und gut verständlich. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

This was a very large airy 2br apartment in a fantastic location. Right near S1 line with dozens of amazing cafes / restaurants/ everything you need within a few blocks. The neighborhood is quiet at night. A little noise from the train but it is not bad and slept right through it with the windows open. Temperature of the unit was great ( had temps under / around 80 F each day / 60 at night).
No problem for us but the steps were a bit of a hike so might be difficult for less mobile folks. Only wish would be to have a freezer.
It was the perfect location for exploring our first time in Berlin. Highly recommend. Be sure to stop into the 24/7 cafe downstairs and say hi to the friendliest locals ever.
房间很漂亮，Ece妈妈也很好，交通便利，值得推荐

MaCha's penthouse loft is perfect. It is very spacious, and filled with light. The location is fantastic. There are many excellent restaurants and bars all around the neighborhood. Since the loft is set back from the street overlooking an apartment square, it is very quiet and peaceful. We would love to stay here again.
Wspaniała Turecka kuchnia w okolicy.

Being close to the station (Jannowitzbrucke) is great for backpackers looking to drop bags off and begin exploring the city. We were an hour early and reception was happy to check us in; checking out by dropping keys into a safe box takes the stress out of getting to the station on time!
The beds are a little rigid and pillows a bit flat, but after a day of walking around the city it didn’t matter a whole lot. There are enough facilities to make sandwiches, toast, etc. (some butter in the fridge would be a nice touch by the hosts).
The price was very fair considering the quality, location, ease of access and facilities.

Alles wie beschrieben – sauber, ordentlich und gut ausgestattet. Es war alles da, was man braucht. Die Lage in Neukölln ist bunt und lebendig – wer das mag, ist hier genau richtig. Durch die nahegelegene S- und U-Bahn ist man bestens angebunden. Die Anweisungen von Volker waren sehr genau und hilfreich. Wir kommen gerne wieder, wenn wir in Berlin sind!
This spacious appartment was a great place to stay during the Lollapalooza Festival. We were eight persons and would definitely come back.
TOP-Lage, direkt neben einem Späti, mehreren Imbissen und 10m von der U-Bahn.

Tutto perfetto! Hanyu è super amichevole accogliente e disponibile, la camera è grande e luminosa con letto molto comodo, inoltre provvista di Wi-Fi.
nel complesso anche cucina e bagno ok, tutto pulitissimo.
la posizione è ottima, collegata bene oltre al fatto che sono presenti vari supermercati nei dintorni.

Hat alles reibungslos funktioniert. Thomas kam nach unserer Ankunft kurz vorbei und hat uns begrüßt.

Die Wohnung verfügt über alles an Ausstattung, was man für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt braucht.
Wir waren zu viert in Berlin und das Sofa war zum schlafen auch bequem.
Lage is praktisch und durch den Tegel Pendelbus, der total regelmäßig fährt, kommt man sehr schnell Richtung Hauptbahnhof und Sehenswürdigkeiten.

We enjoyed staying at Nina and Soren's place near Victoria park.  The location is very good, especially if you're not wanting to stay in the more crowded touristy places.  There are a few U-bahn stations that are easy to use and can get you to where you want to go in a short amount of time.  There's a nice cafe next door and also the beer garden Golgotha within Victoria park both good places to start your day.  The furnishings and amenities of the apartment were really nice, very clean and modern.  The space is quite large, making it comfortable for groups of 6-8.  Everyone slept well whether in the back of the apartment or towards the front, fortunately, the street in front is not too busy with traffic.  Overall a very lovely apartment to stay in.
This apartment was perfect for our stay in Berlin!  The location was very convenient in a great neighborhood.  Barbara was very responsive and accommodating.  I would highly recommend to anyone.

Zentrale Lage, gute Wegbeschreibung des Gastgebers.  U-Bahn ca 10min Fußweg, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten gleich um die Ecke. Freie Parkplätze sind zwar überall vorhanden, aber es ist super schwer einen zu bekommen. Zimmer ruhig, Sauberkeit naja. .( Haare im Bett, Staub in den Ecken, Dreckige Fensterbänke) . Da von aussen gerade die ganze Hausfassade saniert wird/wurde, konnte man keine Fenster öffnen, bzw frische Luft reinlassen- in dem kleinen Zimmer suboptimal. Toiletten super sauber, aber Gemeinschaftsnutzung auf den Flur mit den anderen Gästen.  Manchmal waren beide Badezimmer ewig lange besetzt und dann kann man gar nicht auf Toilette.  Küche sauber und nutzbar,  leider viel zu wenig Besteck für so viele Gäste. Abwasch war schwer da kein Stöpsel vorhanden.  Kochen geht auch ( 2 Töpfe, 1 allerdings kaputt) Braten geht nicht,  keine Pfanne vorhanden . Rauchmelder schlägt zudem Alarm wenn man etwas zubereitet, lüften geht nicht wie gesagt. Gastgeber haben wir gar nicht persönlich kennengelernt,  Check-In / Out über Türcode und Schlüssel für das Zimmer liegt auf dem Tisch. Insgesamt war es ok, man ist ja eh den ganzen Tag unterwegs :)

Berlin ist eine Reise wert. Ich würde auch jedem empfehlen bei Fabian zu  buchen. Die Wohnung ist genauso wie in den Bildern. Wir wurden sehr herzlich empfangen und hatten eine tolle Zeit bei Fabian und seiner Familie. War auch kein Problem das wir sehr spät angekommen sind.

It's been really a pleasure staying at Agnes's House, position is great, bed is cozy, and hosts are nothing but kind and thoughtful, I really spent a wonderful time in Berlin with this nice apartment, if I were coming back to Berlin again, I would definitely choose her house again

My wife and I stayed here for a week in Berlin to run the marathon. Michaela is a wonderful hostess and person. The apartment is beautiful and the bed is very high quality. The location is in a great neighborhood with all kinds of good restaurants just a block or 2 away. The S-bahn is 2 streets away and there are buses that can take you anywhere as well. The only slight imperfection is the lack of WiFi at the apartment but short of that it was a special place to stay
Great location, really quiet and peaceful. The place is tidy,  comfortable and really close to the metro.

Hanoch's apartment is just perfect for a short or long term stay in Berlin. We stayed in his apartment for almost 5 months and felt very at home there. I would highly recommend Hanoch's apartment.

Very nice spot to spend a couple of days in Berlin. Nice location and well equipped rooms. We enjoyed our stay

There’s a sports field right outside of the building so morning exercises are not a problem. Can also easily get to most main tourist attractions in half an hour by public transport. Axel is very friendly and responsive, provided clear instructions throughout the whole process, and was very accommodating to our occasional requests. Recommend!
Eine wunderschöne Unterkunft. Die Lage ist großartig! Katarina ist eine tolle Gastgeberin, sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und antwortet sehr schnell. Einfach herrlich 🥰.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und der Standort ist für Berlin super. Man ist so schnell am Alex und von dort konnten wir super unser vorgenommene Touri-Programm starten.

A perfect little corner of Berlin!

Although it's a self check-in and check-out system (which was very straightforward and painless), you're still made to feel hosted and welcome - from the sweet notes around the flat to help you use the facilities, to Dan's helpful advice in exploring Neuköln and its incredible bars and restaurants.
The best part is that it feels so much more authentically 'Berlin' than anything else you might encounter of its kind, and really helps you feel like a part this outstanding city, if only for a short time. An easy five stars.
Lovely stay in a great neighborhood. loved all the shops and restaurants. The apartment was clean and comfortable.

Diese Wohnung haben wir zu dritt genutzt und uns darin sehr wohl gefühlt - die Ausstattung ist so wie beschrieben. Albert ist wirklich freundlich, hat uns persönlich empfangen und uns eine tolle Eisdiele empfohlen! Das Viertel ist ruhig und schön, bietet aber viele nette Bars und Restaurants.

El alojamiento estaba bien ubicado para el propósito que teníamos en la ciudad. En cuanto a la limpieza un repaso al piso no le vendría mal, las alfombras del baño y el salón  no estaban muy limpias, por otro lado encontramos envoltorios de chocolatinas debajo del sofá. Teniendo en cuenta que es un sótano no tenía buena ventilación y olía a cerrado.

Wir wurden wahnsinnig herzlich von Stefan begrüßt und er hat uns alles gezeigt. Das Haus und der Garten sind wunderschön und eher größer als erwartet. Es ist wie eine kleine Oase - man merkt gar nicht, dass man in der Großstadt ist. Die Einrichtung ist nicht nur geschmackvoll, sondern auch wahnsinnig hochwertig. In der Küche durften wir Tee, Kaffee, Gewürze, Mineralwasser und sogar auf dem eigenen Grundstück hergestellten Honig mit benutzen. Übrigens haben wir ganz problemlos auf der Straße direkt vor dem Haus parken können.
Wir möchten unbedingt wiederkommen und nächstes Mal länger bleiben als nur zwei Nächte!

Lena is a great host. She is welcomed and she gave us some tips to enjoy the city.
The appartment is at 5min by walk from the subway station (if you walk slowly). Clean, warm, perfect !
We really enjoyed our stay !
good location, easy access to good vibes in Kreuzberg. quiet, need some climbing.

Stephanie's place was great - perfect location, great neighbourhood, and a very spacious living room which was very well stocked. Stephanie was very accommodating even when we got delayed. On one of the nights, our kiwi electronic keys stopped working for the main entrance (or there was an issue with the main gate) and we had to call Stephanie late at night; she was accommodating enough to help us out. Beyond that, it was a great place to stay and we had a great time.

Séjour, parfait
L'appartement est parfait, commerce, café et transport à proximité
communication impeccable
Je recommande vivement
Very enjoyable stay would recommend
Sauber, chic, freundlich, modern, perfekte Lage, keine Wünsche bleiben offen in dieser fantastischen Unterkunft. Vielen Dank
Tolles Hause, tolle Gastgeber. danke!
Really central and beautiful place to stay. Katharina is a wonderful host. Highly recommended!
This is a great apartment with great facilities. Andreas is a wonderfully warm and communicative host.  We had a fantastic time. I highly recommend you consider staying here.
Beate could not have been more welcoming and friendly. The accommodation was excellent and the location perfect.
Perfect location, nice host, highly recommended
outstanding. wouldn't want to stay anywhere else.

El apartamento era precioso, muy acogedor, amplio, luminoso,confortable y muy limpio.
La ubicación muy buena, con parada de tren y metro a 3 minutos del apartamento, e importante línea directa de tren desde el aeropuerto de Schönefeld. Además a tan sólo 8-10 minutos paseando tenemos varias calles com amplia oferta de bares, restaurantes y tiendas.
En cuanto a Bernd+katja son encantadores y nos hicieron sentir como en casa en todo momento. Su predisposición para ayudarnos y orientarnos, darnos ideas de visita, tiendas... la tuvimos siempre. Incluso llegamos un poco con retraso del aeropuerto y vinieron a buscarnos a la parada de tren.
En conclusión: magnífica estancia en Berlín.
Riktigt schyst inredd lägenhet, med en fin konstnärlig touch. Plus för att det fanns kapselkaffe redo när jag kom, dessutom små förnödenheter i skåpen och en flaska mineralvatten i kylen.

Arne's apartment is the perfect place to stay in Berlin! It's a very cosy flat with its uniquely eclectic decor that makes it a pleasure to come back to every day. It stays cool during the summer heat, yet has a pleasant south-facing balcony on which you can enjoy the sun if you wish so. I stayed at the apartment for one month and were fully satisfied with my time there. Arne is an extremely friendly and helpful host; he is easy-going and never intruding. He is a great person to talk to, though if you need some quiet time he will respect your privacy. And of course, his cute cats are an added bonus! All in all, I highly recommend his place.
Christian is a kind and helpful host. Glad we booked his place for our stay.

Carola ist eine sehr nette Gastgeberin. Wenn wir etwas benötigt haben, war sie steht's zur Stelle. Die Kommunikation lief unkompliziert und reibungslos. Wir haben uns im Apartment sehr wohl gefühlt und es hat uns an nichts gefehlt. Die Lage ist herrlich, in ein paar Minuten ist man direkt am See. Wer also etwas weniger Trubel in der Hauptstadt sucht, ist hier genau richtig. Wir würden auf jeden Fall gerne wieder kommen!
It was ok. it's a big place if you plan on staying with a group.

We had a wonderful stay in Alessandro's flat, there is tons of natural light inside and beautiful views of the city through every single window. The flat itself felt very homely and clean. We were able to check-in easily due to the help of Alessandro's kind neighbor. Finally, they were both easy and fast to communicate with over WhatsApp. We will definitely be returning on our next trip to Berlin. Tschuss!

Claudia was a great host, responding almost immediately to any questions we had. We liked the layout of the apartment, including a spacious bedroom/dining area and a separate kitchen.  The area is quiet and relaxed but within easy reach of central Berlin via a short walk or bus ride to the railway station.

Wir waren zu viert in Emina Helenas Gästezimmer und es ist wirklich klein, man sollte sich also sehr mögen :-) Für uns als Familie war es toll. Ein gemütliches Bett, eine kleine Küche für einen morgendlichen Kaffee und trotz der Lage an einer großen Hauptstraße, war es recht ruhig, da das Haus im Hinterhof steht. Parken ist nur mit Geld möglich (wir haben uns für ein Parkhaus in der Nähe entschieden). In der direkten Umgebung gibt es Spätis und einen großen Lidl. Emina Helena war jederzeit zu erreichen und sehr zuvorkommend. Für einen Städtetrip nach Berlin absolut zu empfehlen.
Best place in Berlin...will definitely come back! Thanks Rosa!!!

Wir hatten eine schöne Zeit in Berlin und in der Wohnung von Oliver. Wir haben uns sehr über das Schlafzimmer gefreut. Wir dachten man müsse auf dem Schlafsofa schlafen. Auf den Bildern war es nicht zu sehen. Wie schon aus anderen Bewertungen hervorgegangen, sind die Matratzen etwas weich und durchgelegen. Und bei Nacht ist es etwas laut wenn man das Fenster offen lässt, eben ne Großstadt.
Ansonsten ist die Wohnung sehr gemütlich! Sauber war es auch. Der Check-in war völlig unproblematisch und der vierte Stock hat uns auch überhaupt nicht gestört. Wir würden wieder kommen!
Liebe Grüße
Would stay here again!
very easy comunication, very kind person, nice room, what else?
Die Unterkunft war gut gelegen.
Es war sehr nett, sie 2 Betten waren sehr angenehm und die lieben Lichter haben mir gut gefallen 😊👏🏻😊
Great location and fantastic host. Roi was very accommodating and the apartment was perfect looks exactly the same as the pictures! Would definitely stay here again and recommend!

We had a fantastic stay at Anna's place. A lovely, well equipped flat with plenty of space for 2, great location very near to both the tram and U-bahn, and the heating kept us nice and warm during the very cold weather! Would thoroughly recommend!

Все было очень хорошо, все понравилось.
Больше всего понравилось месторасположение, близко к центру и метро рядом.
Чуть меньше понравилась чистота, в общем все было чисто и аккуратно, но некоторые недочеты бросались в глаза (углы в ванной, кухонная посуда).
Great location, very clean and great communication. Would recommend!

Ljubomira was so kind and helpful! The place was great as well. There were more than enough beds, the kitchen and bathroom were good. Overall, an excellent experience.
Take note: if you're commuting, take the M2 and 158. Nearest S is way too far.
Great spacious apartment.. really really good bed and a nice spacious living room... Perfect for 2 people

Wunderschöne Altbauwohnung mit dem Flair der Kaiserzeit und einem interessanten Mix aus modernem und klassischen Interieur. Bereits das faszinierende Treppenhaus hat uns wie eine Zeitmaschine ins 19. Jh. versetzt. Großer Wohlfühlfaktor: Blick ins Grüne, ruhige Wohnstraße, keine Parkplatzprobleme, fußläufig zu Tram und S-Bahn: Perfekte Ausgangslage für die Erkundung von Berlin!
Sehr schöne Unterkunft in ruhiger Lage. Es hat uns an nichts gefehlt.

Très bel appartement calme et lumineux, dans un charmant quartier de Berlin. Literie très confortable. Je remercie Alex pour nos échanges, sa disponibilité et son accueil.
Je recommande! Merci.
Very authentic and nice place 👍🏻
Hat alles reibungslos funktioniert, vielen Dank.

Accomodation as described. Alae was responsive and engaging upon arrival. Location walkable to my daily venue. Within  a quiet area. Comfortable bed and the plants a bonus. Recommend for all potential guests.

The flat was very clean and fully equipped. It was also nice and cosy, which was good given how cold Berlin was when we visited!!
I would definitely recommend the flat to my friends and family as it is a great place to stay.

Alles war super! Eine tolle, ruhige Wohnung, super sauber, geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Zwar keine Küche, aber Sarah hat mir einen Wasserkocher, ein bisschen Geschirr und Besteck und Hafermilch und Instant-Koffee hingestellt -top! Gute und schnelle Kommunikation. Danke für alles, ich komme sehr gerne wieder!
Alles wie beschrieben,  ein recht guter Ausgangspunkt,  um mit den Kindern die Stadt zu entdecken.  Die Nähe zum Tempelhofer Feld hat uns gut gefallen.  Hier ist es super mit den Kindern zu radeln!
Went above and beyond to answer all my questions and provided more towels and cleaning daily

Eine sehr schöne Unterkunft mit einer super Lage.
Annabell war sehr hilfsbereit und gut erreichbar.
Alles in allem eine Empfehlung wert.
Top location,toller smart tv, gerne wieder
Sehr gute Unterkunft, nahe Trammstation!
Very nice, modern and solid apartment that meets all requirements. Very close to U8, so in no time in the centers of Kreuzberg or Mitte!

Peter was an excellent host, very friendly, clear, helpful and responsive.  The home was comfortable and clean, and I immediately felt welcome and comfortable utilizing the kitchen and living room area, in addition to my private spaces.  I felt safe and secure as a sole traveler, and the bedroom and bathroom were clean, spacious and comfortable.  The location was very convenient, and the Mitte area is very walkable, and has many fun shopping, restaurant and cultural options, and it is near all forms of public transporation.  I highly recommend Peter's AirBNB as a place for anyone to stay, and hope to return there if I visit Berlin again in the future.
everything was good, clean and fast check in check out

I enjoyed the stay at Ashraf’s flat. The flat is located in a nice and central area in Schöneberg. Public Transport is nearby. It provides everything that is needed and is comfortable.
Communication and checkin was very easy. Ashraf is a very friendly host, happy to help any time.
I can highly recommend staying at Ashraf’s flat.
A wonderful spacious apartment - would definitely stay again!
Vivement conseillé

While the apartment matched the pictures and the linens were clean, it wasn’t a home I could relax in. I’ll admit, I like a clean home.
In the kitchen, there are broken tiles and a lot of missing grout. This makes it feel unclean, when food gets trapped in the grout line. The kitchen is small, making it impossible to pull the table out and sit four people for dinner or to socialize. It appears the living room has been taken out to put in another bed to be able to sleep 5, but only 4 kitchen chairs.
It was my oversight to not catch that there was not a living room, which made it hard to connect as a family with such a small kitchen.
The towels appeared clean, but once they became wet after showering, they smelled like mildew, causing me to have to wash them. The dishes were not clean, but wiped off and put back in the cabinet. There was coffee stains in the mugs.
It is disappointing that the previous tenant would do that to the next tenant.
The cleaners left dust & a dirty sock.

The apartment is large and well equipped in a quiet and safe neighbourhood with plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. Franz greeted us and made sure everything we needed was working as expected and answered any questions. It was a great base for visiting Berlin with friends!

Все было хорошо, чисто, удобно, тихо. НО, я была с коляской и нужно было на руках таскать коляску т к много ступеней без лифта и в коридорах тоже ступеньки. Т е с колясками или чем то похожим очень сложно. Но само жилье очень хорошее! Если вы без коляски то очень советую.

We had a great stay here, had a lovely welcome and check in and it’s a very well situated place with lots of nice bars and well connected to public transport. Very spacious flat and would stay here again!

Christoph has an absolutely fabulous house and it is truly 5 star. Very chique and modern and done to a very high standard , in a very nice area of Berlin, everything you need is close at hand , Parks , Tram stop and Aldi round the corner !  We were greeted by Christophs mother who was very welcoming and helpful , I would definitely rate this one a 5 Star stay . Well done Christoph , Ellen and Sybile .

This was a great location. We could walk to all sorts of restaurants, stores, and train stations. There is a great little bar next door with live music and beer!  What a treat to experience local talent and culture.

El lugar es céntrico, tenemos todo cerca.

Buen sitio para alojarse

Cool place. Check in worked well and Mia replied fast to all my messages. Can recommend :)

The apartment was lovely, bright and very clean. It was very close to the tube station, shops and restaurants & also a park. The hosts Arzu & Tom were absolutely lovely and were very welcoming and extremely helpful. I would definitely recommend this apartment to all. Thank you again for everything.

We had a great time in Claudia’s apartment ! The place is very clean, well decorated and very spacious. Prezlauerberg neighbourhood is full of lovely restaurants and coffee shops. The communication with Claudia was perfect, thank you again for all your recommandations !

Great stylish apartment, very comfortable, bright and airy. Nice area, quiet but with good restaurants nearby. We haven't met Dan and Robert who were abroad, but communication was very easy before and during our stay, and everything was very well organized. Thanks to both of you, we truly appreciated our stay and recommend your place without hesitation!

This is a great and comfortable place for a family, very nice and cosy, has a unique atmosphere. I would visit this place any time in the future, Carsten did an excellent job, we are very happy that we found this apartment!

It is a great journey in Berlin. Thanks for Angela's kind help. She is so patient and friendly. The room is so clean and comfortable. There are a lot of delicious restaurants around there. And the traffic is convenient. Thanks a lot. Best wishes.

Superb hassle free stay in a stylish comfortable apartment.
Check in was a doddle, pictures provided full instructions of where the flat was and how to get in via two keycodes, no keys or cards to lose or share out.
The flat was delightfully decorated, looked newly refurbished or at least very well maintained. Full array of cultery and crockery, lovely fittings. The shower was phenomenal! Both the bed and sofabed were very comfortable to sleep in. Great curtains, often couldnt tell what time in the morning it was. Lovely and warm too.
Absolutely no regrets staying here, will return in future if it's available!
Idyllic location, yet very well connected to downtown Berlin and Potsdam. Jürgen and Christine are super nice and very responsive. I stayed there already twice and will book it again
Nice place, everything was very clean and new. I highly recommend this place!
Hat alles super geklappt. Schöne moderne und saubere Wohnung mit schneller Anbindung zu den Öffis.

We stayed at Mina's apartment for 5 nights.   Perfect location close to the lake where you can have lovely walks and something to eat in the little restaurants on the way around, and close to the train station.   This apartment is spotless and very comfortable with everything you need.   Very private and secure, always someone around to help if needed.

Very cool little place, very smart use of the space, AWESOME shower! Host was brilliant at setting out the info and always available. Close to the station to get to all the points of interest. Absolutely loved the place & it made Berlin a great city to visit. THANK YOU
We had a great stay, in a big home very well located close to public transport. The host was also very nice and easy to reach.
Apartment was just like in the pictures. Good location, smooth communication and everything went as expected. I recommend!
This apartment is amazing!! Fadeih was really friendly and chilled which made staging in her place so enjoyable. Great location, lots of places to eat nearby. I’ll definitely be coming back to stay!

Firstly, a wonderful apartment in a great part of Berlin.
Close to so many good restaurants and bakeries and coffee nearby.
Easy access to all other parts of the city by bike/cab.
Joseph is a great host, quick to reply and easy to communicate with.
Would return in a heartbeat.

Die Unterkunft ist gut gelegen und mit den öffentlichen sowohl vom Flughafen, als auch vom Bahnhof gut (30-45min) zu erreichen.
Der Check-In ist problemlos mit Schlüsselbox vor der Türe. Somit ist auch ein nächtlicher Check-In unproblematisch.
Der Anbieter reagiert schnell auf nachfragen.
Die Wohnung roch leicht nach Rauch als ich ankam. Mit Lüften war das aber nach drei Tagen weg.
Leider war die Wohnung echt nicht sauber. Staub und Krümel in den Küchenablagen, Geschirr offenbar vom Vormieter nicht ganz sauber. Müll in den Hängebehältern, Flecken auf Bettlaken und Handtüchern (Disclaimer: Die waren schon frisch gewaschen, aber halt mir hartnäckigen Flecken). Das ist für mich ein No-Go.
Die Ausstattung ist sehr einfach, aber zweckmäßig. Das Internet ist nicht schnell, aber für Teams Meetings ausreichend. Fernseher nur zum streamen.
Alles in allem ist die Unterkunft okay, habe aber bei den Preisen zumindest wirkliche Sauberkeit erwartet. Aber es ist ein leichtes das zu verbessern.

The photos don't quite do the apartment justice. It's got lovely high ceilings and feels so spacious, is really stylish, comfy beds, well equipped. The terrace was a wonderful addition - really enjoyed drinking our fresh coffee there in the sun in the morning. I'd like to return, couldn't recommend it enough
Great location literally right next to the train station, with heaps of eating options and bars nearby.
Great location and phenomenal response to questions and messages.

Een gezellig en schoon appartement.
In een perfecte buurt vlak bij de metro.

De tiny house van Sabine heeft alles wat je nodig hebt. Dit is een van de beste tiny houses waar ik heb gelogeerd. Het is er rustig, je bevindt je in een groene oase op een klein stuk prachtig land. Om de hoek is een supermarkt. Alles is op loopafstand. En als de zon schijnt dan kan je de hele dag in de tuin zitten tot ‘s avonds 20:00 uur. Ik kom graag nog een keer terug.
Die Wohnung ist sehr gut ausgestattet und sehr schön, lediglich eigene Handtücher mussten wir mitbringen. In der Umgebung gibt es alles Wichtige und aus touristischer Sicht Relevante. U-Bahn ist nah.
Gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis

Oli's Wohnung ist toll. Ausstattung, Lage, Kommunikation und Sauberkeit sind hervorragend. Ein Riesen Plus für mich ist auch der Parkplatz im Innenhof. Ich habe meinen Aufenthalt sehr genossen und komme gerne wieder.
Gruss
Elke
Una estancia muy agradable, lástima que el viaje fuera corto y no poder disfrutar más de su hospitalidad. 100% recomendable

Schöne saubere Wohnung, perfekt  geeignet für einen Kurztrip nach Berlin. Hervorzuheben ist die tolle Lage am Prenzlauer Berg mit vielen kleinen Cafés, Läden und Restaurants. Die Wohnung ist zur Straße hin im Erdgeschoss gelegen, dafür aber relativ ruhig. Die Fenster lassen sich durch Rolläden komplett abdunkeln, was wir als großen Vorteil empfunden haben. Ein Manko hingegen ist, dass nur die obere Fensterpartie geöffnet werden kann. Die Kommunikation mit Franz und Amelie war sehr gut. Kleinere Probleme beim Check-In wuden umgehend und unkompliziert gelöst. Absolut empfehlenswert!
Nice place perfect for couple!
Clean, comfortable apartment, perfect for a few nights stay. there were three of us, all comfortable. Great service , helpful, accommodating. Would stay there again.
Wir haben uns bei Birgit sehr wohl gefühlt. Sie war sehr freundlich und nett. Beim nächsten mal bleiben wir gerne länger….😉
Hat Alles prima geklappt . Wir kommen gerne wieder
Thank you Kathryn for a wonderful stay!

The apartment was a great choice for my few days in Berlin,  close to town and public transport.  Ivos and his son Alec also offered several great tips on getting oriented in Berlin and making the most of my trip.  Would recommend

Parfait! Très bien situé: métro et tram à 2 minutes et quartier animé et sympa
La chambre n’est pas très grande mais propre et assez moderne
Nhu and Jann are outstanding hosts, super friendly. Sakura is a good dog, 10/10
Ótimo quarto, grande e quentinho, dormi muito bem, fácil de chegar, tive muita privacidade, adorei estar neste lugar, super seguro e calmo

Wir haben uns gleich sehr wohl gefühlt. Großes Zimmer, bequemes Bett, gut geschnittenes Bad, Fenster zum Hof mit Aussicht auf den Fernsehturm. Konrad ist ein sympathischer, hilfsbereiter Gastgeber, der uns bei Ankunft gleich Kaffee und Tee angeboten hat. Danke auch für die netten Gespräche.
Un des meilleurs airbnb dans lequel j’ai séjourné. Rarement vu un hôte aussi flexible, disponible et sympathique. Je recommande.
Alles super. Sehr netter Kontakt, super sauber, perfekt gelegen, sehr schönes, gemütliches Zimmer und ich hatte genügend Privatsphäre. Ich komme sehr gerne wieder :)

Tolle Lage, tolle Umgebung - wir haben uns im Viertel sehr wohl gefühlt. Im Allgemeinen war es in der Unterkunft sehr ruhig. Das Haus bzw. auf dem Stock selbst war es sehr hellhörig, was uns aber nicht weiter gestört hat.
Im Zimmer war es sehr staubig (Tisch, Stuhl, weitere Ablagen) und der einzige kleine Spiegel wurde wohl auch schon lange nicht mehr gereinigt. Die Gemeinschaftstoiletten waren zum Teil sauber, zum Teil sehr dreckig. Je nach Uhrzeit. Für den Preis sollten/könnten sie durchaus öfter gereinigt werden. Es ist eben ein Hostel und es gibt auch Mehrbettzimmer. Daraus resultierend möglicherweise die Überraschung des Erbrochenen im Treppenhaus. Die Reinigungskraft welche schon 1 Stunde früher im 2ten Stock war, hat dies wohl “übersehen”. Alles in allem würde ich diese Unterkunft für den Preis (knappe 100€/Nacht) nicht nochmal buchen.
Am Tag der Abreise haben wir noch einen Blick in die Gemeinschaftsräume geworfen, diese sahen sehr ansprechend, ordentlich und sauber aus.
Nice location and okay apartment.

The apartment was exactly the way it was described. And more. Beautiful fixtures, crockeries, Cutlery, appliances. Very tasteful and upscale.
The underground garage offered spacious parking and just across the road. Very convenient.
The location made it possible to walk to the center and main attractions without a problem.
A small note. The apartment is on the 5th floor. And has no elevator. So lugging up baggage and frequent climbing may be difficult for aged or people with respiratory issues.
Having said that, Simon made that a small issue. He was extremely responsive with quick replies to my queries. A super host with a generous heart.
Totally recommend the apartment for any visitor to Berlin.
Ottima base per vivere Berlino
Idealer Ausgangspunkt für Kreuzkölln!

Everything was great: convenient location, clean, clear instructions and an amazing host! The only drawback was the stuffy air in the room, but it's something we expected looking at the pictures. Overall very good! Thank you Philipp.

Louis was a great host. Thanks!

Great huge space.  Good area.  Great communication from Heiko.  He even let us check out late on the last day.  Only thing that could improve is the bedding, wish the pillows were normal comfortable pillows.  Otherwise great Airbnb!

Franziska was gracious upon meeting me, gave me an appropriate overview of the unit and the neighborhood, and I didn't have any communication with her after that (due to our being gone from the flat at different times).  The neighborhood was nice, close to many of the attractions, extremely close to the tram, which was very convenient to get to the train station.  Best of all, it was a very short walk to the Berlin Wall Memorial, which I feel everyone should visit while in Berlin.  The flat met my basic needs:  a place to sleep and leave my things, some German language TV channels, decent toilet and shower.

A cosy, bright roof space with lovely views over the neighbourhood.  Innes made sure the place was warm for us during our stay last week (28.11.19-1.12.19).  Easy access to keys to get into the building.  Leafy suburban area about 5 km from Mitte Berlin. Very close to tram line and supermarket.  Beautiful park 5 minute walk away.

Spacious and cosy room in a quiet are. Very convenient to reach all the sites, a lot of things are walkable and we had a great night sleep there! We haven’t met the hosts but they gave very well written instructions and recommendations 🙏
God bolig med alt man skal bruge, nem indtjekning og ok roligt og hyggeligt område.

Все было просто восхитительно, я не смогла приехать, но жил мой друг. Он в полном восторге)

Sehr nette Gastgeberin und sehr liebe Hunde.

Einziger winziger Kritikpunkt: das Bett gibt in der mitte recht stark nach wenn man darauf liegt. Das war aber halb so wild.
Organised and well equipped. Perfect for  both short and long stay.
Schöne, einfache Unterkunft in toller Gegend. Gute Anbindung, viele Restaurants. Genau das Richtige, um Berlin zu erkunden. Vielen Dank!

Great location, but the room is really small. But it’s clean and quiet. In my opinion it is bit to expensive.
7/10 points

The room is massive and super clean and tidy.

Es war alles in Ordnung waehrend unserer Aufenthaltzeit bei Stella's Wohnung. Tolle Umgebung und Bezirksleben, ganz empfehlenswert. Besten Dank!

for this price, it feels very luxorious. would book again
La estadía con Jeannine y Alexander fue excelente, ambos son muy amables e interesados en ayudar y conversar. Muchas gracias por recibirnos :)
