Very nice apartment
Very clean
We appreciated that there was coffee and Tea availible as We arrived late and shops where closed
Great apartment in Berlin! This is my second time staying at this place because it has everything you need and in a great location and very responsive, welcoming host. Highly recommend.

Wir haben uns bei Frank sehr wohl gefühlt. Vor allem das ungewöhnliche Ambiente machte den Aufenthalt zu etwas ganz besonderem. Frank erwies sich als sehr netter Gastgeber, der sehr flexibel auf unsere Sonderwünsche reagierte.
Lovely little studio apartment, very close to U8 line. Easily able to explore Kreuzberg from here but also the rest of the city. Really enjoyed our stay here
Sonja was a wonderful host. The room was just as expected. Quiet, comfy and a with good links to public transport

Annalisa ist eine sehr liebe und nette Gastgeberin. Sie hat uns toll empfangen und uns auch Tips gegeben wo wir hin gehen könnten. Der Aufenthalt war angenehm und schön ruhig. Nach Berlin Mitte waren es immer nur 20-25 min also voll im Rahmen.
Ingesamt war es ein toller Aufenthalt.
Können wir weiter empfehlen.🫶

Everything was great at Alex's place. The neighborhood is pretty quite. The house is clean with a cute garden.  The room has a big bed, the private bathroom is on a different floor. It is worth the price, recommended!

Everything was perfect, Daphne and Jorge even agreed to let us stay a couple of extra hours since our flight was delayed.
Location is central with an Edeka and pharmacy within walking distance, and S Bahn / U Bahn station right outside the apartment.

Eins zu Eins wie auf dem Foto, außer kleiner Dinge habe ich nichts zu bemeckern. Super Lage, mehrere Bahnverbindungen unmittelbar in der Nähe. Außerdem schön ruhiges und leicht zu findendes Apartment. Immer wieder gerne :)
Appartement très pratique, et surtout très propre ! Au plaisir de séjourner de nouveau chez Duc Son. Freues Neues Jahr !

I stayed here for a long weekend with my partner, and we loved coming home to such a comfy, stylish flat each night. It's in a great location, very easy to get to and not far from nice restaurants and bars.
The bed was amazingly comfortable, we didn't want to get out in the mornings!
Celly was a great host, who was more than willing to go out of his way to help us check out in the middle of the night.
Definitely recommend.
Very lovely and romantic stay. Garden is super zen and smells amazing! 🌸We loved it! Thank you Carmen! ❤️
Alles war gut. Super Lage. Gute Betten, gepflegte Wohnung. Sehr gute Gastgeberin.

Eine wirklich wundervolle Wohnung in absolut bester Lage. Es hat unsere Erwartungen noch übertroffen. Restaurants in unmittelbarer Nähe ebenso wie die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel. Alles war blitzsauber. Die Einrichtung sehr modern aber alles aufeinander abgestimmt. Die Balkone laden zum relaxen ein. Wirklich ein Traum, der sein Preis wert ist. Für 4 Personen perfekt!
That was a nice stay. The hostel is located near most important spots in the city center.

Great place for family or just friend! Apartment has everything you need and it was really comfortable for four of us. Nearly to public transport, supermarket, and really nice little restaurants. We enjoyed in shawarma and Thai food :) and I hope that we will come back sometimes ;)
Super schön eingerichtet. Alles hat super geklappt, gerne wieder :)
Nice apartment, well located. martina was very helpful and communicative. we enjoyed our stay, quite easy  with a little child.
Werner was so lovely and helpful and I had fun learning how to use some of his smart home tech!

L’appartement est très propre proche de toutes commodités ( supermarché. Cafés . Restaurants bus et métro ) il est très mignon …merci à barbara de mettre à notre disposition des masques de nuit pour les français habitués aux volets ! Super accueil

The room is beautiful and equipped with all you need for your stay. The flat is in a great location, and Sophia is a very friendly, discreet and accommodating host. I recommend this room for your stay in Berlin.

I had a very enjoyable stay in Berlin, Arne is very friendly, easy-going and reliable, and making arrangements for picking up the keys etc. were straightforward. The flat is lovely, and its central location very convenient - there were plenty of things to do and see within walking distance. I would stay there again!

Jacob ist ein hervorragender Gastgeber, antwortet jederzeit superschnell und ist dabei schwer sympathisch. Seine Unterkunft ist stilvoll, charmant und gemütlich mit hohem Wohlfühlfaktor und gehobenem Anspruch, die Lage sensationell für die fußläufige Entdeckung von Kreuzberg und Umgebung. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Andrea is a wonderful person and host, I’m very happy I stayed at his place and would 💯 recommend it and book it again when I’m in berlin again.
It was a lovely place, it took some time to find at first but once we knew how everything worked we were very happy with our stay
Peter was incredibly helpful and welcoming. The apartment is spacious, bright and very beautifully designed. We had a truly wonderful experience
Loved it!. Great location. Close to everything in the heart of Berlin. Even closer to the train station.

The location in perfect, you can reach all the main ip of the city by foot and metro station is very close. In the neighbourhood there are lots of reasturants and shops, Alexander Platz is a 3mins of walk. The apartment has a breathtaking view and has lot of space. Recomended

Quarto super confortável, limpo e muito acolhedor. Banheiro super espaçoso e equipado. Opção de chá, café e água. Acesso fácil, comunicação eficiente.
Me senti em casa, a cama é simplesmente perfeita e super confortável, não dá vontade de sair. Lençóis limpos, edredom de boa qualidade e travesseiros maravilhosos. No geral muito bom para estadias curtas. No saguão do prédio onde fica os lockers tem um armário com essenciais( chás, toalhas, protetor de ouvido, etc) que acabei descobrindo somente no último dia, então fica a dica. A acomodação está bem localizada, perto de pontos de ônibus e metrô. Gostei muito e recomendo :) Thanks Numa, it was perfect :)

We had a wonderful stay!
Lana is a fantastic host: friendly, attentive, and easy to reach.
The apartment is spacious, clean, and very tidy.
The location is perfect: within walking distance of the city center, shops, and cozy restaurants where you can enjoy breakfast.
There's also a parking garage just a 10-minute walk away.
Everything you need is provided, and the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. Highly recommended!
Thanks so much Brigit! Very peaceful and easy stay and everything ran smoothly - I actually think the room is even nicer than it looks on the pics!

Enkel ren og lys lejlighed. Den er lidt lille og har ikke spiseplads og køkken til at lave mad. Til gengæld skøn for dem, der vil ud i byen og komme hjem til en lejlighed, der ligger fredfyldt i en lys baggård med fuglekvidder.

The "Copper Loft" is a perfect experience: the information in the description matches 100% with reality and Gunnar and István are very nice hosts and can be recommended without reservation. The apartment is perfectly located for trips in any direction. An all-round successful Berlin trip in style!
The apartment is great! Location is perfect when traveling with kids lots of parks and restaurants near! The patio is perfect for breakfast time!
Great place for a great price!
sehr schöne ruhige und komfortable wohnung  (auch für 4 Personen) - gute  u-bahn verbindungen in der nähe-  wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt

Appartement conforme à l'annonce.

Stephanie is a great host! This is a wonderful location, close to all transportation, restaurants, bars and shops. It's beautiful, private, clean and spacious. We found ourselves at home very quickly and would stay again!

I strongly recommend staying at this Airbnb. The room was private and clean and Susanne with her family are very kind. Apart from staying in your room, you are able to use the kitchen and enjoy the garden. To sum up, thanks for being such a great host and hopefully see you again :)
Wir hatten einen sehr guten Aufenthalt bei Jo&Fran. Die Wohnung hat eine super Lage und die Hosts sind sehr angenehm und freundlich. Wir würden wieder hier übernachten!

Super eingerichtete Unterkunft in toller Lage zu Tram, Ubahn und zum Hauptbahnhof mit Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und leckeren Restaurants in direkter Nähe. Ich habe meinen einwöchigen Aufenthalt sehr genossen. Super unkomplizierter netter Kontakt. Vielen Dank!

The perfect place to stay in Berlin! Very convenient location near a train station and you can be at the central station in 10 minutes. Would love to stay here again when I return to Berlin!

Das Zimmer in der Familienwohnung ist okay. Ordentlich und sauber war das Zimmer aufjedenfall. Nur beim Bad musste man einige Abstriche machen wie leere Seife, kein Handtuch für die Hände, einige Unsauberkeiten (Haare) etc. Da kann man nachbessern aber an sich war es okay.
Die Lage ist wirklich nicht nah an Berlin und auf schnelle Welle mal nach Berlin rein ist leider nicht..

My sister and I came to Berlin for a short vacation. The apartment was everything we  had hoped for. It much more beautiful than the pictures. Ursula had decorated so nice and cozy that we felt like home. It’s got everything U need, near to a central train, cool restaurants and  the best burger in Berlin!
Große und gut ausgestattete Wohnung. Gut mit U/S-Bahn erreichbar. Umgebung ziemlich lebhaft.
Alles bestens, immer wieder gerne!

Angela hat es mir sehr leicht gemacht, mich bei ihr wie zuhause zu fühlen. Mehr als ich tatsächlich brauchte stand großzügig zur Verfügung. Gespräche waren genauso möglich, wie Zeit für mich allein nach anstrengenden Tagen.
Ich kann Angelas Unterkunft gerne weiter empfehlen.
Great location, good bed, fast communication & a relaxed host
We stayed for a weekend there and it was amazing! Very comfy, not loud, pretty easy to access, i recommend !
Für unseren Kurzurlaub mit 7 Personen war es eine geeignete Unterkunft mit einigen Gebrauchsspuren. Der Gastgeber war sehr gut erreichbar und hat sich um unser Anliegen gekümmert.
Große saubere Wohnung in guter Lage. Das Gebäude und manche Möbel sind etwas stärker abgenutzt als auf den Fotos erkennbar.

Alexandra's home is absolutely beautiful. She's a gracious communicative and friendly host who makes herself available for any questions you might have.
The home is bright, spacious and comfortable. It's quiet while also being blocks from the busy heart of Schöneberg. It's also super easy and quick to get to the airport from Alexandra's house.
I hope to stay there again!
Supper netter Kontakt. Schöne große Wohnung. Kommen jederzeit gern wieder.
Mooi schoon ruim appartement. Vlakbij metro station.

The apartment was well equipped with kitchenware in comparation with other apartments i have been during my trip. It was well located due to the neraness of a subway entrance . That is a good point to add because the public transport in germany is perfect. The only thing that my partners and i found strange was  that the shower was in the kitchen . In view of above arguments, i would truely recommend it.
Sehr schöne, große und saubere Wohnung. Die Betten waren wirklich super gemütlich. Man ist zwar nicht direkt im Zentrum, sondern etwas außerhalb, aber dafür ist die Bahn- und Busverbindung super.
Nice and Cody apartment 👌🏼
El alojamiento  es súper moderno e impecable. Cómodo y espacioso.

Ich habe mich super wohl gefuehlt und es hat auch alles bestens geklappt.
Sabrina ist ein toller Gastgeber, und Sie konnte mir auch jede Menge Tips zur Umgebung und zum Laufen geben.
Mein Zimmmer war sehr gross mit eigenem Bad direkt gegenueber, alles ist tip top sauber.
Ich war sehr froh in der schwierigen Zeit im Maerz, als in Berlin alles geschlossen war, bei Sabrina zu wohnen. Ich konnte den Garten geniessen, Tischtennis spielen und grillen.
Vielen Dank nochmal an Sabrina.

Zimmer mit Bad, klein aber fein. Renovierung ist nicht ganz abgeschlossen, allerdings liegt es nicht an Timothy, sondern an der aktuellen Situation.
Soweit ansonsten alles in Ordnung.
Timothy ist ein netter, freundlicher und offener Gastgeber.
Goede lokatie dichtbij metro om Berlijn te bezoeken.
Excelent location, the apartment is very comfortable, hot water always available. Lot of restaurants around and near to the tourist points. Highly recommend!
Very location for walking and very close by a park to go run. It's an 8 minute walk to the bus. They are very friendly and would stay again.

Our stay at Alex’s was very pleasant and everything went really well.
The location was perfect for us as it was next to U and S station. The studio was very comfort and there was everything what you need for a short stay. The building was quiet, but you could hear the traffic noise from outside.
Comminication with Alex was very easy and he was very quick with his answers. He gave us very good advices how to come to our meeting point and he gave also good tips what to do in Berlin.
We would totally recommendate this place! :)
Nette und hilfsbereite Gastgeber! Schnelle Antworten. Anbindung zu S-Bahn super! Gegend ist ruhig und sicher, auch nachts!

Wir hatten eine ganz wunderbare Zeit hier. Ganz besonders toll war das Spielzeug für Kinder. Außerdem war alles sehr gemütlich und schön eingerichtet. Die Anbindung an die Öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel ist super. Tolle Lage. Super Kommunikation.
Wir würden jederzeit wieder gerne hierher kommen.
Great place, great location, unfortunately tv would not connect to wifi and hairdryer didnt work
The place is in a super central location. You can walk or take public transport. It was 4 of us so it was a bit cozy but for 2 nights it was great. Jeff is super responsive and helpful!

Valeu demais ter conhecido. Local muito agradável, super completo, cama excelente, muito silencioso. Indico a quem quer praticidade, conforto e economia, pois a relação custo benefício é muito favorável ao hóspede.

Nuestra estancia en apartmenthouse Berlín ha sido muy agradable. La habitación era cómoda y limpia, equipada con todo lo necesario. La localización también está bien, se llega fácilmente a lugares céntricos de la ciudad. Muy recomendable!

A beautiful room for three people with comfort, clean and ready to get inside with everything. It was like in description and in the photos. Self check-in is a great idea if someone arrives late to the place for getting the keys. The price is really good for the position of apartments ( in centre of Berlin) and for what we get. I recommend Nena Apartments in Berlin.
Beautiful house that looks bigger than the pictures. Decor was so pretty
Perfect location for a city trip, everything was easily reachable either by feet or by public transportation! Very clean und cosy, would come again. Thank you Maria!

We had a long road trip, stayed in more than 10 different places, and this apartment was probably the best airbnb of the entire trip. It has everything you need to feel at home. I could write about the comfortable mattresses, clean kitchen, the bathroom with bathtub, etc. But it's not only that. The apartment has an amazing feeling with great books, pictures, and little decorations that make it very cosy. I will definitely check if this place is available, next time I'm in Berlin.

Wer hier übernachtet,findet zwei hübsche Räume vor,
integriert in einer tollen ,stilvollen Wohnung.
Silke und Carsten sind tolle Gastgeber.
Einen kurzen Café auf dem Balkon macht den Aufenthalt perfekt.
Immer wieder!!!!

Selten waren wir in so einer tollen Unterkunft!! Für uns 5 Erwachsene + 2 Kleinkinder war ausreichend Platz im dem sehr geräumigen Haus, das toll ausgestattet ist, eine Sauna und einen großen Garten hat. Mit der Bahn, die zu Fuß in 8 Min zu erreichen ist, kommt leicht ins Zentrum. Bianca und Rainer sind tolle Gastgeber, die alles möglich gemacht haben. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Wunderschönes, sauberes Zimmer, sehr freundliches Personal, also alles perfekt
ich komme gerne nochmal wieder :)

Perfect stay for our girls trip to Berlin from Glasgow! Plenty of room for 7 of us, fab location with lots of good restaurants close by and the tram is around the corner. Would 100% stay again, thank you so much Werner!!
*Clean bedding
*Comfy beds
*Plenty of room and storage
*Lots of mirrors!! So helpful when 7 girls are getting ready at the same time!
* Dishwasher, washing machine, tumble dryer- so useful.

From the first moment to the end, Claudia was great, gave us all the details we needed, even we came very late her housekeeper waited for us and welcome us very nicely.
The studio is beautiful with all what you need to have a perfect stay. The location is great, close everywhere.

We had a great stay in Berlin at Nancy’s apartment. It was very spacious and clean - much bigger than I was expecting. Nancy provided everything we needed for a comfortable stay including a fully equipped kitchen. We were met by Nancy’s father-in-law who was a friendly host and took the time to show us around the apartment. Additionally as it was a hot summer week, when we requested a second fan, it was delivered immediately the next day. Nancy ensured that we had a comfortable stay and we will certainly book again when we return to Berlin. Parking was also very easy at the property.

Das Loft von Gabriel ist sehr stilvoll und liegt perfekt, trotzdem ruhig. Die Kommunikation war sehr freundlich und unproblematisch. Sehr pünktlicher und netter Empfang mit Blumen und Wein. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Wir hatten nur wenig persönlichen Kontakt aber über die E- Mail konnte ich immer die Rebecca erreichen und habe sehr schnell eine Antwort bekommen mit der ich voll zufrieden war. Wir sind somit wunschlos glücklich gewesen.

Sehr nette Kommunikation, gute Anweisungen und sehr hilfreich. Für den Preis ist das Zimmer okay. Das Badezimmer hätte für mich sauberer sein können.
Zimmer aber sehr schön und gross - alles sauber und da was man braucht.
Fabulous clean apartment,  close to public transport. Lovely restaurants and coffee shops near by.
Sohail ist ein lieber und unkomplizierter Typ und das Zimmer in der perfekten Ecke, um die Stadt mit dem ÖPNV zu erobern.
Alojamiento recomendable, muy fácil llegar a toda la ciudad gracias a su cercanía con el tranvía. Susanne y su familia fueron muy amigables. Gracias!
Beeindruckende Professionalität ohne dabei den für Airbnb typischen Stil und Charme zu verlieren. Stets zeitnahe Reaktion auf Wünsche und Fragen. Lage und Ausstattung des Appartments sind top.

Das Airbnb ist totall schön. Es liegt in einer etwas lebendigeren Straße mit viele Restaurants. Für einen Städtetrip war der Urlaub perfekt. Der Gastgeber war super lieb und sehr Hilfsbereit. Nur weiter zu empfehlen!
Angelika ist eine tolle Gastgeberin. Ihre Unterkunft ist blitz blank, ruhig und zentral gelegen. Ich habe die Zeit bei ihr genossen und würde jederzeit wieder bei ihr buchen.
Very nice place to stay and very helpful owner. Highly recomended!
Apartment ist 25 Minuten mit der Tram vom Zentrum entfernt
Nicely and proactive staff, excellent location cans clean room, a lot of things to do over there, definitely I’ll back
Enrique's place has good access to the U-bahn, Tram and not that far from the Hauptbanhof. It is very near Bernauer Straße station.

Der Aufenthalt bei Emilia war echt super. Sie ist eine sehr freundliche Gastgeberin und macht alles dafür, dass es einem gut geht! :)
Eine tolle ruhige Lage, wenn man nicht direkt in die Großstadt möchte.

Handy location to underground train line. Lots of good food and coffee nearby. Very spacious and comfortable apartment with all the amenities you could want for a few days. Host was also very good with instructions and assistance during our stay.
Ich habe eine sehr gepflegte Umgebung vorgefunden, die vom Gastgeber bis ins Detail gut durchdacht ist. Gleichzeitig ist Eckehard ein exzellenter Gastgeber, bei dem ich mich sehr wohl gefühlt habe.

Ich habe mich bei Ingrid sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Unterkunft war genau wie beschrieben – sauber, stilvoll eingerichtet und perfekt gelegen. Besonders gefallen haben mir die ruhige Atmosphäre und die durchdachten Details in der Ausstattung. Ingrid war jederzeit erreichbar, freundlich und hilfsbereit. Ich kann die Unterkunft absolut weiterempfehlen und komme gerne wieder, wenn ich in Berlin bin.
Die Lage von Birthes Wohnung ist perfekt.
簡單舒適的空間，洗衣機、冰箱與廚具等俱全，周遭機能方便，有很多不錯的餐廳。

Artem’s place is very well located. The area is full of restaurants and public transport connections. The apartment is just like the pictures, very clean and equipped as per the description. Definitely will stay again in the future if the place is available.
Super leichter und flexibler Check-In und Check Out. Gern wieder.
Prima verblijf. Redelijk dichtbij Olympia stadion, 6 minuten met de taxi. Rustige buurt, genoeg eetgelegenheden dichtbij. Comfortabele bedden. Niets op aan te merken.

WORST EXPERIENCE, DO NOT RECOMMEND.
The place has a really good location, and the place is nice, however there’s no elevator so getting all the luggage up through3 floors is exhausting.
Eugene was and incredibly rude person, the very first text we received from him was a question asking when were we checking out, even before we made the check in, then we couldn’t find the place because the address is not accurate and we didn’t know which building was, and he was rude and told us “read the instructions” even when we sent pictures asking which building was it he said again “aren’t you reading the instructions?” , we find this really disrespectful, considering we don’t know the country, er had to go building by building checking to see if that was the airbnb and he didn’t even ask if we get inside or if we get there properly, after checking out he asked for us to leave 5 stars despite the awful treatment we received and asked not to leave comments here.
Alles genau vorher abgesprochen und beschrieben.  Ben ist ein guter Host.
Good place to spend a few nights! Everything was clean and as described. check in and out was super easy!

Agnes and Lorenc were very friendly and helpful during my weekend in Berlin. They explained options to use public transportation and let me borrow their maps as well. Their listing was very accurate and there were no surprises with the room, which was very comfortable. The apartment's location is great... just a short walk from U-Bahn stops or Bus stops right across their building. I definitely recommend their place and hospitality.

Denise & Jürgen provided us a cozy, warm place to stay for our weekend in Berlin. The house is set-up so the room is separated from the rest of the house, with easy access to the bathroom and the AirBnB being easy to navigate.
Would recommend for anyone wanting a weekend trip to Berlin!
Vielen Dank für Deine Gastfreundschaft!

Check In war einfach. Zimmer war sehr sauber und Anbindung war auch mit ÖPNV super. Zugang zum Großmarkt war angenehm!
Das einzige was unschön war, dass direkt an der Haltestelle zum Appartement viele aufdringlich Verkäufer einem was andrehen wollten.

Spacious apartment with wonderful views over Berlin! The location is also excellent as you can go everywhere by foot. It's also worth mentioning that Edeka (supermarket) is right around the corner. Martin was a very friendly and understating host!
very nice place and quite clean. the bed in Saigon is a legend.

Lovely apartment with everything we needed. Heidi also came with a lot of tip from where we could buy breakfast, rent bikes, etc. The apartment lied in a quit street and close to the train station. If you visit Berlin this apartment is a good spot! Clean, good space for two people and heating in the ground.

Fantastically cozy, clean and comfortable room, with private access to bathroom and kitchen. All located in one of the more beautiful parts of old west Berlin. This all with a very kind host, makes it a quite great place to stay.
Much recommended, have stayed here over a handful of times on business trips to Berlin.
A nice and safe place to stay

We loved our staying at this apartament in the heart of Berlin. It was super convenient for getting almost anywhere, very spacious, tidy and comfortable. The only notable thing missing is any kind of AC, as it probably could prove problematic in the summer due to the fact the apartament is on the top floor. Which also takes quite a lot of effort to get to, due to lack of elevators. But overall, really good place and would come back again.

Wonderful apartment with so much character! Alke was also a great host, very responsive and met all of our needs. Wifi was a little weak if youre looking to remote work, but we weren't really, so not much of an issue! Also they were very aware of this and are working on a solution (the wifi extender wasn't working at the time).

The apartment is perfect for a couple, for a short break in Berlin. In the apartment there is also a sofa on which two people can sleep. Great location, close to the tram and metro.
Due to the fact that the apartment is located right on the street, on the first floor, it is a bit noisy.

Perfect location in the centre of the vibrant Kreuzberg
Nice flat, very clean and very comfortable beds
We were 6 friends, all girls and it was perfect! Just one bathroom/toilet to share
Ideal place for a family of four. Good supermarket close by which will give you money for empty plastic bottles - very cool!

Etwas außerhalb aber trotzdem nicht weit ab vom Schuss: 10 Min. Fußweg + 15 Min. S-Bahn und man ist am Alexanderplatz. Passt 👍🏼. Das Zimmer ist sehr sauber, Bett super bequem und netter Kontakt zum Vermieter. Ruhige Wohnlage - kein Verkehr. Gerne wieder!
Nice location, Very clean, Nice interior  and so easy to enter. Pleasure to stay here.

El alojamiento está al lado de las paradas de metro, bus y tranvía. Ubicado muy cerca del centro y a tan solo 15 minutos en transporte de la puerta de Brandeburgo.
El alojamiento estaba muy limpio y es bastante amplio.
The room is very cozy and has everything you need despite its small size. The host is friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay again if I need a place in Berlin :)
Die fehrnbedinung war leider kaputt. Aber ich denke das dies bis zu den nächsten Gästen behoben ist.

Excellent accueil d’Andréa et Jessica. Chambre très vaste, confortable avec cabinet de toilette individuel. Quartier bien fréquenté et très bien situé à proximité des stations du U-bahn et du S-Bahn. Très bon restaurants pas chers à proximité.
Location is decent with public transportation nearby. The Airbnb itself was huge with vaulted ceilings!
The flat is amazing, it has all de utilities and even more. Very clean and tidy and felt like home. It is very close to local supermarkets and entertainment. Thanks Sven

Our stay at Linda’s was great. The property is very close to public transport, restaurants, shops etc. The street is also quiet so we slept really well. The property is beautiful, great bathroom, kitchen and comfy bed. Lots of place to store your clothes and other items. Linda was communicative and flexible with our check in time. Would definitely stay here again if we came back to Berlin.
Alles wie beschrieben, sehr schön und urig, für einen ruhigen Urlaub mit Möglichkeit eine Großstadt zu besuchen sehr zu empfehlen.

We loved our stay at Vincent’s place. Very homey, tall ceilings & comfy furniture.
Lovely records & record player also.
It can be a bit noisy in summer at night on the Main Street but the location is perfect & check in / out and contact with Vincent was very easy.
We would recommend.

Convenient location, spacious area. Easy to communicate with hosts. Restaurants are within walking distance. Minor but the shower tap and temperature was difficult to adjust due to the way it was installed.

Super verblijf gehad in een heel prettig appartement! Super plek in de stad. Parkeren was uiteindelijk prima te doen (wel betaald). Super plek om de stad te verkennen. Appartement is erg stil als alle ramen dicht zitten waardoor we toch goed konden slapen ondanks het drukke plein. Het is van alle gemakken voorzien wat heel erg fijn is. Ook de grote badkamer is een groot pluspunt. Enige minpunt was het kleine bed. Die was erg krap voor iemand van 1,90m. Verder een aanrader om te verblijven!
Super unkompliziert und sehr freundliches Team die Unterkunft war wunderschön und super ausgestattet öffentlich auch super erreichbar. Ich würde sie auf jeden fall noch einmal buchen

Tobias’ apartment is very comfortable and has everything you need. It was very clean and Tobias has been very communicative and friendly. The neighborhood is very nice, there are shops and nice restaurants nearby.
We totally recommend Tobias place and would like to come back some day.

Great location and experience at a very reasonable price.
Doerthe is just the definition of a perfect Airbnb host.

Great location.. Ivos is super host.
Our recommendations!!
We really enjoyed our stay in Franks apartment. It was one of the best airbnb's we've ever been! Simple, clean and stylish! The location is just perfect and the price is just right!

The apartment is very well located. Everything is clean, tidy and comfortable for a good time in Berlin, and know the city.
Frank is very friendly and takes care of every detail, always available to help.
It is an excellent variant to stay and to know in depth the beauty of that historic city.
We recommend.
Super Lage und super schnelle Kommunikation. Sehr einfach eingerichtet.
Good location for access to public transport, quiet area just outside of the main areas of Berlin - would definitely stay again if back in Berlin

Max was a great host! He was very responsive on airbnb, gave clear instructions for accessing the property and was flexible with the checkin time. The place was very clean and spacious and was in a great central location.
Alles Tip Top! Mir wurden sogar vergessene Sachen nach dem Aufenthalt zugeschickt! Vielen Dank dafür!
Alles hat super geklappt,  sehr unkompliziert und angenehm.  Zimmer sauber und alles da. Kann ich gut empfehlen.
Jan is a great host! His place is beautiful and definitely worth visiting :) Totally recommend, I hope we will have a chance to come back.

Die Eule liegt bestens! Nur 25min S-Bahn vom Berliner Zentrum entfernt ist man dort direkt zwischen Wasser und Wäldern. Wir haben die 1,5 Tage sehr genossen und würden gern noch einmal wiederkommen, um auch die Kanus zu probieren.
Отличный хостел. Гостеприимный персонал и просто вкуснейший завтрак.
Fantastic place to stay for my month in Berlin. A wonderful neighborhood not far from the U-Bahn. Easy to get into the city.

Wir waren ein langes Wochenende in  Antje's Wohnung in Berlin. Die Lage ist super. Wohnung sauber und ordentlich, wie beschrieben. Kommunikation lief super. Ruhige Gegend...zu Fuss alles gut erreichbar. Gerne wieder!
Really lovely place
Ayako ist eine sehr entgegenkommende und freundliche Gastgeberin und ich würde auf jeden Fall wieder bei ihr buchen. Absolute Empfehlung!
Really nice place for 4 persons. Lots of restaurants and bars nearby. Stella always answers my questions in time. Strongly recommend this aprartment. :)

This little gem was a treat with lots of shopping, restaurants and nightlife if you choose. When retrieving the key make sure to go to the gate across the street and there may be 2 lock boxes there. We tried for a solid 10 minutes before realizing there was another on the same gate several steps away. Also, the shower is a bit to contend with if you have broad shoulders Iike my husband. He barely fit (but he's muscular and not average size) so that's to be considered.
The cute little courtyard with birdsongs everyday is amazing!!! They begin to sing in chorus and just as suddenly stop.
Gunter is very responsive and will answer your queries quickly. We highly recommend this lovely little place.
Sören’s place is spectacular, both in comfort and convenience. They all run a tight ship and it’s visible in the quality of facilities and experience.  Will stay here again when in town.

Beautiful spot in the heart of the city.
Exactly what you are looking for
you will enjoy the solitude in this place. the house is beautiful and is situated in a very practical location. plus the hosts - Phuong and Martin are really kind and easy to communicate with.

Superbe logement - Il ne manquait rien, Nous avions tout à disposition,
c‘est comme nous l’espérions.
Merci beaucoup.

We had a great time at Michael's place in Berlin. A perfect spot for your trip in Berlin. Close to a U-bahn station, you'll be in the city centre within 10 minutes. Reuterkiez is also a nice place to just walk around, lots of restaurants, bars and all sorts of fun things to visit. Can highly recommend this appartment!

Da es meine zweite Buchung auf dem Portal war und die erste aufgrund einer späten unbegründete Absage des Hosts nicht gut lief, war ich erst ein wenig vorsichtig. Aber das konnte Ina wieder gutmachen. Sie war pünktlich für die Übergabe vor Ort, ich leider 15 Minuten zu spät...
Aber dann ging alles sehr gut und die sehr günstige Lage der Wohnung hat. r ebenso gefallen wie die schnelle und schnörkellos Übergabe.
Ich war sehr zufrieden und komme gerne wieder.
Sehr zu empfehlen! Sehr netter Vermieter! Gute Kommunikation!
Roligt område med gode parkeringsforhold
Helt supert opphold i et veldig fint hus.
Buena habitación y se puede llegar rápido a todos lados desde la estación de Metro cercana

Very nice clean, spacious place. 10 min walk to the s-bahn which connects you to the main stations in Berlin.
Well equiped, quiet in the evening and night. Friendly hostst, and lost of privacy. We recommend it!

Nice place and nice people.
It is clean and nice and the owners/manager is so nice
Serdecznie polecam,super gospodarz!

Es war alles super. Karsten hat mich noch um 22 Uhr empfangen und die Wohnung gezeigt. Super Lage, trotz Mitte ungewöhnlich ruhig und direkt an der U-bahn. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und es ist an alles gedacht, ich habe nichts vermisst und mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Vielen Dank!
War super, danke dir Jan!

Fabulous accommodation, near the tram stop but also a walkable distance to the city centre. Supermarket a couple of doors down which was handy.
We ate at Preeda, a Thai restaurant nearby one night. The best Thai food we've ever had.
Wir waren sehr zufrieden! Kann die Wohnung auf jeden Fall weiter empfehlen.

Hotel Gat Point Charlie was well positioned to explore some of Berlin's Historical Sights by foot.
The room is simple but perfect for a short stay.
However, I would have loved a kettle and mugs in the room.

This is a fabulous place, well described. It's on the ground floor in a quiet residential area just off Karl-Marx Allee. There are shops and restaurants within easy reach, and it's very easy to get into central Berlin and the airport via U-Bahn.
Sparkling clean with everything we needed. Check in was great even though we arrived quite late - thanks to Hans for spotting us looking for the right apartment number and passing on lots of useful info.
Thanks very much!
Świetna lokalizacja w samym centrum Berlina, czyste lokum, świetny kontakt z miłym gospodarzem. Polecam 😁
ich war sehr zufrieden, empfehlenswert

Robert’s place is really one straight out of a dream. It’s more than we expected and we felt like kings staying at Robert’s.
His attention to details in the house, as well as the story of the house itself and Robert’s hospitality; all absolutely perfect. I’d recommended making a trip to Berlin just for this house ;)

Good things:
-House is very clean
-Location is close to u-bahn & s-bahn
-Ralf explained how you will access to house and answered our each questions clearly
-house is cozy and comfortable
-there are coffee machine and kettle
Not good things:
-blankets width and length were too short
-there was no bath towel, there were only hand towels. Don forget to put your bath towel in your bag.
-when the weather is cold (below 5 degrees) house is cold especially in night and early morning. (Approximately 18 ° )
Even we informed Ralf about situation he did not help for the heating.
If you don’t like cold weather and if you cold easily, you cannot feel good at night.

Wir hatten einen schönen, angenehmen Aufenthalt in Fais Wohnung: Die Fotos entsprechen exakt der Ausstattung und der Raumaufteilung – für uns war es ein idealer Ort, um uns als Redaktionskollektiv schöne, inspirierende (Arbeits)Tage in Berlin zu machen. Die Wohnung war herrlich warm und liegt sehr gut öffentlich angebunden: von Berlin Südkreuz (wir sind von Wien mit der Bahn angereist) nur 5 Minuten mit der S-Bahn, Fußweg ebenfalls ca. 5 Minuten zu S-Bahn und U-Bahn. Die Kommunikation war – trotz Komplikationen wegen Verspätungen und Zug-Ausfällen – einwandfrei, freundlich und zuverlässig. Vielen Dank für den Aufenthalt!
Schöne Atmosphäre, alles sehr easy. Man fühlt sich sehr wohl.

The apartment itself is exactly as we expected and is in a very central location. Clean and plenty of space for one to three people.  The bus stop is right outside and the subway is a short walk.  There is a grocery store next door and another one a block away. Plenty of coffee shops and cafe's nearby.  Transportation in Berlin is very easy.  Confirm details with the host and it may be a good idea to message him when you are on your way as a reminder to meet for check-in.  Unfortunately, our check-in time changed and our host was accommodating but ultimately forgot. We were waiting on a cold, wet day for quite some time after a very long flight. Original directions from the airport to the apartment were incorrect so make sure you confirm using google maps.

Nena Apartments wurde kurz vor meinem Aufenthalt dort gehackt und Betrüger haben die Website nachgebaut und mich über WA gedrängt, dort meine Kreditkartendaten anzugeben um die Buchung zu verifizieren.
Zum Glück hab ich es nicht gemacht sondern erstmal dort angerufen - da hieß es dann von Nena, AirBnb wurde gehackt, was natürlich kompletter BS ist. Dann wurde mir später noch als Entschuldigung ein Zimmerupgrade versprochen, dass es dann nicht gab - stattdessen war das Zimmer super ekelhaft und der im Inserat versprochene Balkon war abgeschlossen und nicht nutzbar.
Am Ende des Tages hat Nena Apartments dann noch eine rundmail verschickt, dass man nicht auf betrügerische Nachrichten antworten soll - aber kein Wort davon, dass alle Buchungsdaten und Kundeninfos bereits in den Händen Dritter sind.
Ich kriege seitdem täglich scamanrufe und -nachrichten.
Eine schreckliche Nacht bei Nena Apartments, wegen der ich jetzt meine Handynummer wechseln muss! Danke für nichts
I’m really recommend this place to stay in Berlin. Everything was ok.
Great place to stay in Berlin and Bert is a very nice host!
Thanh is very friendly and supportive 😊 the area is amazing you go do Asian shopping if you wish 😇 clean and beautiful accommodation!
Super Lage.

We loved this appartment. It was spacious, stylish, comfortable and very clean. As we arrived it was 30 c so the balcony was also lovely to sit out on. The location was gorgeous with tree lined streets and an abundance of cafes and restaurants and interesting shops. Also small supermarkets at each end of the street. All very easy with u bann and trams less than 10 mins away. We walked to some of the central sites within half an hour. The appartment was just perfect ! We were sad to leave! Thanks for hosting us Frank!

Ein wahre Trouvaille in einem historischen Hinterhof von Berlin. Das sehr grosszügige bis in jedes Detail stilvoll und liebevoll geschaffene und eingerichtete Bijou war wie geschaffen für uns als Design-orientiertes Paar, welches auch das romantischen Bad im eigenen Schlafzimmer sehr zu schätzen wusste. Die super Einkaufsmöglichkeiten gleich um die Ecke und die tolle Kommunikation mit Thomas rundeteten unser Erlebnis wunderbar ab. Fazit: Wir würden nur schon dieser Wohnung wegen wieder nach Berlin kommen…

This is a very nice, clean, and excelently equipped apartment. It is located in a beautiful and calm neighborhood, with lots of green spaces. The location is also convenient as it is  at walking distance from S-Bahn stations (Suddende, Priesterweg; about 20 min. to Berlin Mitte), buses, and stores. Olga and Rainer are the most hospitable hosts you can have. They borrowed me their public transport card and left some food in my fridge, as I arrived on Sunday when stores in Berlin are closed. I will certainly stay again in their place if I have the opportunity to visit Berlin again. Summing up, I fully recommend this apartment and its hosts.
Escepcional

This is our second visit to Seb's apartment. Seb is a great host and met us for the checkin. He is very responsive to messages and advises on local suggestions for places to vist and eat.
The apartment is five minute walk to the Frankfurter Alle underground which has great connections for exploring Berlin. The apartment is very well furnished and clean, has many bars and restaurants within walking distance and the local mini market is a few minutes walk.
Would recommend staying here if you are visiting Berlin.
Everything was wonderful! The apartment, the location and the host. Will definitely be back and really recommend staying here.
good place! a few stairs to climb but everything you need is included. would happily return
Good communication, flexible to changes on booking & fantastic to my needs

My stay at Louisa's place has been excellent.
She is a very nice, welcoming and easy person to deal with.
The aparment is quiet, bright and clean; the room spacious.
It is located in a very vibrant neighborhood with many bars, restaurants, shops and supermarkets in case you need to buy something.
Easy access to the public transportation: U Bahn and Tramway 5 minutes walk - S Bahn 10 mins approx.
I do recommend
Great location. Cute little studio flat. Perfect for a weekend getaway.
We enjoyed our stay on Oderberger Straße. Perfect location for eating out with an ice cream shop at the entrance of the building and great coffee a sniff away!
Perfekt wie immer - jederzeit wieder !

Gisella and Jens  place was great! Jens was super friendly and shared a lot of places to eat / things to do in the city . The apartment was clean and very cute! We were in a great area and had a nice stay.
Stayed here for two weeks following my relocation to Berlin. Great location, simple check-in, and the host is extremely helpful.
Great location!

Très bel endroit original, situé près de tout à pied , café, restos, épicerie, prévoyez quand même 20 minutes de marche pour les principales attractions ce qui est en fait une bonne chose car le secteur est calme.
Dietrich répond rapidement,
un petit resto sympa se situe à quelques minutes
BALANCE WEIN BAR
nouveau et tenu par un très gentil
jeune couple .
Adresse: Petersburger Platz 1 Berlin

Really nice experience, the flat is very clean and comfortable, and it's a great area too. The subway is only 5 mins walk away, and then about 20 minutes into the city centre.
There's also a nice supermarket, and plenty of good places to eat in Schoneberg, which is only 10 mins walk away.
I never met Moe, but he was very helpful before I arrived, as was his son, who met me at the flat. He recommended me a kebab shop, which was probably the best kebab I've ever had.

Great value, and would fully recommend if you're ever in Berlin.
Zona strategica a due passi da due stazioni Ostkreuz e Treptower. Vicina ai luoghi di svago più famosi di Berlino. Stanza pulitissima e comodissima , balcone super !  Ci ritorneremo volentieri!
Great place if your looking for a charming apartment near the centers of  Berlin. Clean apartment with many great amenities! Barbara is a great host! Hugely recommend!

Excellent location and very comfortable! Michael kindly met us at the front door when we arrived to give us the keys and show us the apartment. It’s small but is an excellent home base for a trip if you are out exploring most of the day. It’s up a few flights of stairs so be prepared to haul your suitcase up. The kitchen was very well equipped, had everything we needed. Would recommend.
Great spot all round, would stay there again!

L'appartement est bien situé à Berlin. Il est calme (excepté le tram juste à côté qui fait vibrer relativement fort l'appartement) et facilement accessible en transport.
Les hôtes sont disponibles.
L'internet de l'appartement est assez lent donc il est difficile d'y travailler.
Dans l'ensemble mon séjour s'est bien passé (excepté la soiré où les hôtes ont oublié la clef sur la porte et ont donc rendu l'accès à l'appartement impossible pour moi qui venait de l'extérieur...)

Great little flat in a cute, safe neighborhood. I stayed here a week and enjoyed it very much. Stylish apartment with lots of natural light. Close to several subway stations which made traveling to and from other parts of the city easy. I highly recommend this listing.
Alloggio  comodo ed è super facile spostarsi,accanto all’Uber Arena.Perfetto!!

Everything was just perfect and smooth.
Frank is a very attentive host and the place is very pleasant, comfortable and equipped with everything you need. Thanks again.
strongly recommend, you would be happy too

We stayed at Anton's apartment for three nights with 2 kids aged 3 and 4. The area is very quiet and the apartment is clean, nice and fully equipped (I only missed a washing machine, when you are traveling with kids is a must, but for all the rest was perfect). In conclusion, our stay was very pleasant. I would recommend it to everyone.
would recommend
sehr schöner ort
Excelente, super completo. Lo recomiendo.
The location is great and it was nice being below street level when it was hot out. The only real negative point is that the internet is rather slow.

Increible alojamiento. Un lujo poder quedarme 2 veces seguidas en este apartamento. Es realmente lujoso y muy céntrico.
Tiene todo lo que necesitas.
Helga le doy nuevamente 5*
Muchas gracias. Hasta la próxima!!!

This is a fantastic apartment in a terrific location in Berlin. The views from the balcony (complete with cherry tomato plants!) are great, and tons of places of interest are within walking distance. There is also a train station across the street, which was really convinient (a little bit noisy when you sit in the kitchen/dining area, but not too bad).

Alexander and Cristina were very available, and responded quickly when we needed assistance. They even went out and bought a baby cot when, before we booked, we told them we were travellng with a young child. All in all we felt at home and had a great stay.

As people who cook a lot, the only minus for us was that the kitchen was not so well stocked with the basics. We had to go out and buy things like oil and spices for cooking. The other thing was that although Cristina and Alexander had bought a cot, there was no proper matress; instead there were a couple of sheep skin/wool cushions which were way too soft (which could be a safety issue for younger babies).

Beautiful and huge flat, perfect for 8 persons !
Great location and Anna was really helpful !
Wunderschöne Wohnung in tollem Gebäude, extrem zentral mit allem was man braucht. Die Kommunikation lief sehr gut, freue mich bald wieder zu kommen.

Apartamento limpio y con estilo, muy buena ubicación (transporte, supermercado, zona de restauración).
Ines es un encanto, atenta y amable!
Nice apartments, allowed earlier check in without problems.

Sehr schöne Wohnung in der es an nichts mangelt, liegt in einem tollen Stadtteil, top Ausgangspunkt und nicht weit zu den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln und Natalie ist total nett und mit ihr ist super zu kommunizieren! Wir komm wieder !!!

Wayne and I had a wonderful time at Ute's place for a month. We loved the abundant light everyday, balcony views, and peacefulness. 3 grocery stores were close by and we were right on the U7 Richard Wagner Platz so were quickly getting around town. 30 mintues to get to Kreuzberg. Close to Halensee for swimming and the Deutsche Oper. We'd definitely stay again!
Wir haben uns in der Wohnung wohl gefühlt

This is a large well furnished room in a 4th floor apartment. It is in a well maintained older building with some nice period touches. Alexandre is very pleasant, helpful. The neighbourhood is very lively with a mix of ethnic and hip businesses. 5 minute walk to subway. This stay is highly recommended.
Nice flat, clean and in a great location! Lovely little cafes and restaurants and the parks nearby are great too!
We had a great stay. The flat is beautifully decorated and spacious. Great contact with the hosts. Not far from shops and metro. We would come back again!
The Apartment was great. Clean, cosy and the great location! Henrik was really kind and answered on everything we needed to know. We will definitly book this apartment again next time in Berlin!

Wunderbare Unterkunft (genau wie auf Airbnb beschrieben)! Die Lage ist perfekt (zu Fuss ca. 20min vom Hbf), zudem war alles sehr sauber und modern eingerichtet! Für zwei Personen ist die Grösse des Apartments ideal!
Obwohl wir wenig Kontakt hatten, waren die Hosts äusserst freundlich und die Kommunikation klappte tiptop!
Wir kommen definitiv wieder!

Lage, Komfort, Ausstattung und Sauberkeit der Appartements sind 1A und entsprechen dem etwas höheren Preis. Der Kontakt war sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Der Zugang zum Appartement, sowie Check-in und -out verliefen reibungslos.
Nettes Hotel im Altbau mit sehr geräumigen, altmodischen aber renovierten und geschmackvoll aufgehübschten Zimmern.
The place is great, in the heart of Berlin.  Stairs to the unit not for the faint of heart.  We'll appointed unit and we'll kept.

Denitsa's place was terrific and exactly as described. Fantastic location, comfortable beds, great apartment, great local amenities, shops, cafes and restaurants. Awesome neighbourhood. It's a must stay in Berlin.

The location of the apartment is perfect! It is not far way from 2 S-Bahn stations. It is really easy to go there from the airport and really close to the city center.
The sleeping room is cozy and well-designed, as well as bathroom.
Good place to stay in Berlin :)

Marisa provides a wonderful home away from home. The location is excellent. Although on a busy street, the double glazing is effective. Cafes and restaurants are everywhere and only a few steps away. Marisa provided us with great recommendations. We only had time to try one of the restaurants she suggested, and it was superb. The layout of the apartment is ideal and everything you could possibly need is provided.
We hope to return to her home when we are next in Berlin!

Heerlijk appartement, we hebben prima kunnen koken in de ruime en mooie keuken waarin alles aanwezig is!
De badkamer is in verhouding wel erg krap met een piepkleine wastafel…
Maar evengoed een hele fijne plek en een enthousiaste en behulpzame host.
We kunnen het aan iedereen aanbevelen!

Wir hatten einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt bei Stépahnie! Die Wohnung ist wunderschön, genau wie auf den Bildern, sehr sauber und hat eine tolle Lage. Für vier Personen ist sie etwas eng, mit drei Personen war es jedoch kein Problem. Ein späteres Auschecken war auch problemlos möglich! Stéphanie ist wirklich eine tolle Gastgeberin! :)

Definitiv weiter zu empfehlen!
Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit. Für unser kurzes Wochenende war es perfekt. Die Lage, sowie die Kommunikation war super. Wir würden wiederkommen.
Friendly and responsive, trusted us in the gallery alone whilst he was away- we had no problems at all

Es war alles super, die Gastgeber waren sehr nett, hatten alles da, was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt braucht. Ich habe mich dort sehr wohlgefühlt. Handtücher und Bettwäsche waren vorhanden. Ein separates Bad war ebenfalls da.

This is a large and confortable apartment in a great location. The area is nice and safe. A supermarket is about 5 minutes walk and there are several places to eat nearby. The tram is few meters away from the apartment providing quick and easy transport to the rest of Berlin. It is a very good value for the price.
Four floors by stairs is a little hard with big luggage but Tilman helped to carry it so this was no problem.
Tilman is a great host, always available and helpful. He dedicated enough time for doing checkin with complete explanations about the apartment and its surroundings and to answer our questions. He was also helpful for checkout.
We fully recommend it.

Der Aufenthalt bei Yvonne hat bestens geklappt! Ein sehr schönes und sehr gut gepflegtes Apartment. Die Lage ist auch sehr gut. Bei nächster Gelegenheit werde ich sicherlich nochmals bei Yvonne nach Unterkunft anfragen. Kann ich nur empfehlen!
The appartement was charming, nothing to complain. Very attentive host, Matthieu is so kind and communicatif host. I can not expect more than this. He was the best host ever :)

Apostolos is very nice & welcoming, greeted me when arriving, also letting me put my luggage at his place for free for few hours.
everything was perfect and exactly as described.
thank you Apostolos:)

Great place to stay for a 360 Berlin experience! The flat is spacious and equipped with more than just the basics. The area is ideal to dine out, go for drinks and has good access to transportation to all sights in town. Lastly, Michele pays great attention to accomodate and communicate with his guests.

Deze plek is perfect voor een geweldig verblijf in Berlijn. De locatie is centraal, niet te toeristisch en heerlijke restaurants in de buurt, restaurant Mausi en Zeitouna waren geweldig! De communicatie met Markus was erg goed en relaxed… Het appartement nog mooier en groter dan de foto’s laten zien, wij hebben een hele fijne tijd gehad en daar heeft dit appartement alles aan bijgedragen. Tot de volgende keer!
Lovely apartment with high ceiling and balcony in a lively neighborhood.  The host is very kind and interesting to speak with. Highly recommend
Clean place, convenient location with bus stop right outside
Great stay! check in was flexiable and the host was very responsive

Eine saubere, zutreffend beschriebene Unterkunft in einer schönen Gegend.
Ausser Kleinigkeiten war nichts zu bemängeln.
Es war sehr heiß in meinem Reisezeitraum, ein Ventilator hätte ggfs. etwas Abhilfe schaffen können.
Ansonsten, wie gesagt, alles sehr in Ordnung.
Würde die Wohnen auf jeden Fall wieder anmieten, wenn es passen sollte.

Great App. at a very good location in the middle of the city and close to a metro station. The App. is well furnished and has everything you need. Also the host is friendly and uncomplicated. Would definitely recommend it to others!

We are a regular Airbnb travelers and would rate Helena’s place as one of the nicest, best located, and real value of all the places we have stayed. The place was very clean, modern, had everything we needed to feel at home, specially with our 2 kids. and was an easy ride to all the sites we wanted to see. Communication was great too. We would highly recommend this wonderful apartment.
Eine sehr schöne Wohnung in ruhiger Lage. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Jörgs Apartment liegt etwas außerhalb aber man ist mit dem Fahrrad schnell im Politik-Viertel und im Kollwitzkiez. Die Wohnung ist für eine Familie mit 4 Personen geräumig. Die Küche ist eher mit dem nötigsten ausgestattet. Jörgs Antworten sind schnell und hilfreich.
i
Great place to stay, very clean and good location. Stefan is a great host and was very helpful.
that was a really good hostel, I recommend everyone

Jan und Sally sind hervorragende Gastgeber. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Unterkunft übertrifft die Erwartungen und unsere Tochter war im Spieleparadies. Die Wohnung ist modern, super gelegen und fantastisch ausgestattet. Es hat uns an nichts gefehlt und unsere Erwartungen wurden übertroffen. Jederzeit wieder!

Petra's apartment is spotlessly clean and the room is spacious and beautifully furnished......the bed is also perfect for a good night's sleep.  Public transport is nearby so it is a good base to get around Berlin.  Petra is a very friendly and genuinely helpful host , as well as being very knowledgeable and fun to talk to.  She made every effort to make my stay as memorable as possible.  (This included letting me check in early and check out late, and even offering me breakfast when I arrived). I highly recommend staying here, and can honestly say that this is my best airbnb experience to date.
Alles super.
Veldig fint opphold! Rene rom, god service og sentral beliggenhet😊
Great location and easily able to walk to many of the tourist attractions. Clean space and Patrick was always available to respond!
Amazing location, very clean and well-equipped apartment, super friendly hosts/staff

The location is nice. However, it just suits it's necessity. The interior and building looks fancy but it's rather cheaply made. There is no real functional heating therefore the room was really cold! Also the kitchen has no basic equipment like salt, pepper, tea or coffee.. it is ok for a few nights but also quite pricey for what you get.
Very lovely place and the kitchen is large and fully equipped
I really felt at home, and the host was excellent!
Die Kommunikation mit Carolina und Ramfis war gut. Die Unterkunft wie beschrieben. Wenn wir mal wieder in Berlin sein sollten, werden wir wieder versuchen bei Ramfis und Carolina zu buchen.

Our stay at Uwe’s place was everything we needed. The house is light and spacious and has all the equipment you need. The area is super green and quiet and still has lots to offer. Would definitely reccomend.

Buena ubicación, coincide con las fotos y la descripción.
La bañera junta mucha agua al usarla, es muy incómodo ya que hay que largar el agua y cortarla, porque si no, corre peligro de rebalse.
La ropa de cama debería ser del porte de la cama, no nos gustó que hubieran un cobertor para cada uno (como si fuera cama individual)
Solucionando ese detalle, todo ok.

Nice place close to S-Bahn station and a supermarket. 15 minuites by S Bahn to the airport and 10 minutes by car. Place has everything you would need. Combine this with an awesome host and if you have a nice stay!

It's a great pleasure to stay and it feels like home.
wonderful experience and always recommend.

Durant notre séjour, Philipp a su se montrer cordial et respectueux.
La propreté des lieux était correcte.
Les échanges avec Philipp fut constructif quant aux problèmes rencontrées lorsque nous obtenions des réponses.
L’annonce n’était pas fidèle à la réalité, (équipements manquants ou endommagés).
Schönes großes Zimmer in super Lage. Sophia ist eine tolle Gastgeberin, zuvorkommend und hat auch tolle Tipps parat! Wir waren super zufrieden! 😊

Schöne saubere und grosse Wohnung in angenehmer Lage. Reibungsloser Checkin/ Checkout und generell eine einfache Organisation des Aufenthalts. Wir hatten alles was wir brauchten und es war ein toller Aufenthalt in Berlin. Einzig der Komfort der Betten (inkl. dem kostenpflichtigen Babybett) könnte verbessert werden.

Excelente alojamiento! Está ubicado en un barrio tranquilo pero a la vez con muchas cosas para hacer, más típico de Berlín que el centro de la ciudad, todo muy accesible en el transporte público rápidamente. El alojamiento muy lindo con todo lo necesario, cómodo y contaba con café para desayunar, accesorios para baño, todo lo necesario. Muy recomendado!
war super !

L'hôte accueillante mais ne respecte pas les regles de calme qu'elle demande 23h-7h. Discute dans sa chambre jusqu'à minuit, se lève à 6 h sans discrétion donc si vous voulez vous reposer, ce n'est pas du tout l'endroit. Canapé dur pour le dos. Donc dos fragile s'abstenir. Le drap demandé pour mettre dessus était taché. Pas de rideau, de store, de volet donc réveillé très tôt et pas d'intimité. Salle de bain sale, poubelle pleine. Dernière nuit, peu dormi car l'alarme du détecteur de fumée émettait un bruit strident toutes les 10 mn. Elle a mis du temps à réagir pour enlever les piles et a laissé la lumière allumée ! Je n'ai pas utilisé la cuisine car ma famille n'était pas loin (seul coté positif). Très déçue de ce airb&b

Mr. Lorenzo offered a charming apartment located near bus and tram station. The apartment was clean, with free Wifi and everything needed for a short stay.

The listing description was accurate, and Lorenzo was a helpful host and flexible with the check-in and check-out times.

Had a very comfortable stay and enjoyed the apartment.

I picked Alex’s place because it was a much better price than many of the other places in Berlin and it was close to public transportation. The space was clean and comfortable. Alex gave us some tips on places to go eat and check out. He gave great instructions on how to get to the key since we had a pretty flexible schedule. It is right off a main road that’s super close to both the S and U lines. It has huge windows that let in a lot of light and allow you to look out over Berlin. Great place!

C'est toujours un plaisir de loger chez Cecilia.
L'appartement est super et très agréable à vivre. Vivement le prochain séjour ! ;)
Encore merci pour tout :)

Die Beschreibungen, um in die Wohnung zu kommen, waren super ausführlich und einfach zu folgen. Die Wohnung selbst liegt in einer wunderschönen Gegend umgeben von tollen Restaurants. Katarzyna war sehr zuvorkommend und hat alle wichtigen Infos direkt kommuniziert. Vielen Dank!
Vom check-in bis zum Shampoo im Bad: alles sehr sympathisch, bestens organisiert, sehr sauber und super leise ... Ellen antwortet sofort und sehr nett auf Fragen - wir kommen gerne wieder!

Exellent place for this money. Very clean and comfortable. The location was very good. A lot of shops and restaurants nearby, public transport as U and S - bahn are right there. I would recommend BerlinSurfHostel for short time stay.
Appartement parfaitement équipé et situé, dans un quartier vivant de Berlin. Nous recommandons.

Michael und Milkana waren sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Das Zimmer war sehr sauber und komfortabel, mit Trinkwasser, Kühlschrank und Backofen. Die Umgebung war schön und ruhig, und auch die Verkehrsanbindung war sehr gut. Wir kamen nach Berlin, um am Marathon teilzunehmen, und haben jeden Tag gut geschlafen.
Wir hatten einen sehr schönen und angenehmen Aufenthalt in dieser Wohnung.
Gastfreundliches Personal für denn Preis sehr angenehm sauber Zimmer hätte für 2 Person vllt bisschen größer sein können aber war alles perfekt.
Lovely apartment, in a great location with extremely responsive hosts. Book for a hassle free stay!
The location is superb, sparkling clean, very spacious. Anna was very friendly and helpful. We had a perfect stay in Berlin for two families in Anna's big apartment. Totally recommend.

Regina and her apartment were lovely. I wasn't able to request until the night before and she was very prompt with her reply, which was so nice! Her apartment is absolutely lovely and we had a nice private space and a beautiful balcony. It was a very comfortable stay!

If you have the chance to come to Sigbert, expect a friendly welcome, a clean and very inviting flat, a cosy bed: a home.
Wenn du zu Sigbert kommen kannst erwartet dich ein freundliches Willkommen, eine saubere und einladende Wohnung, ein bequemes Bett: ein Zuhause.
Schöne, geräumige Unterkunft mit Terrasse und hübsch angelegter Gartenanlage. Sehr gute Lage, gern wieder.
Vincent ist ein sehr freundlicher Gastgeber und wenn man die Wohnung gefunden hat, ist alles sehr sauber und schön eingerichtet und die Lage sehr leise.
Beautiful, spacious apartment in a great location. Would definitely stay again!
Daniel es un profesional amable y cercano. Todo salió perfecto! Volveré!!
great place to stay. would absolutely recommend.
Wibke has a beautiful apartment in a very easy to reach location. The communication was great and as a first timer traveling to Berlin, she was very helpful. I would love to stay there again!

Great place to stay in Berlin and easy to reach other parts from Ostkreuz, including the airport.
Kitchen had everything we need to cook in on some nights.
Room was always a good temperature and quiet.
My only complaint is the pillows. They felt like they were made of mashed potatoes that had been beaten by a heavyweight boxer.
Sehr schöner Urlaub in einer sauberen und gut ausgestatteten Wohnung. Danke!

我們在柏林的住宿體驗非常好！這裡的房子就像圖片一樣舒適。到達和離開時可以儲放行李，真是方便。
我們想煮晚餐，但不太會使用爐具，聯絡屋主後，他立刻過來教我們，讓我們很感激。他和他的團隊都非常友善，讓整個住宿過程更加愉快。
推薦這個地方，期待下次再來！
Wir waren rund um zufrieden und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Sehr sauber und super zentral. Man kann auch vor Check in seine Taschen abstellen. Wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder.

We had a great stay at Donjas place. Ideal location to the metro (less than 5 minute walk), plenty of shops and restaurants near by. Cleanest Airbnb I have ever been to - it was spotless when we arrived and very comfortable. Well equipped and had all of the necessities we needed that not all Airbnbs provide (such as paper towels 😊). A nice bonus was the waterfall shower head in the bathroom! Donja was quick to respond to any inquiries. Would absolutely recommend and stay again. Thanks Donja!

Great host and a lovely room for short term rentals. Great neighborhood and proximity to everything needed. As a newcomer to Berlin, I can only be grateful to the host for all his support during my stay :)

The room is definitely clean and neighborhood is quiet. Martin shows up at the scheduled time and gives suggestions for sightseeing places and delicious local food restaurant. 5 minutes walk to the nearest subway station and 10 minutes walk to Mall of Berlin. Location is quite convenient if sightseeing in the city.
Easy and convenient place to stay, close to public transport and some easy food options

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour dans votre logement, le quartier était très calme et proche d’une station de métro
Les chambres étaient très correctes
Cependant pour un groupe de 9 personnes, l’espace repas était un peu étriqué et l’unique salle de bain avec les WC as l’intérieur
Bahnstation direkt um die Ecke. Saubere Zimmer mit komplett getrennten Betten und eine kleine Küche wenn man möchte. Waren top zu Frieden und können es nur empfehlen.

We had a blast at Numa‘s. We were spontaneously allowed to check in a little earlier, which was very nice of them. The area is awesome. You have supermarkets nearby, delicious bakeries and you can walk to the city center. I would definitely book it again :) Thank you!
The owner is kind and friendly.  The location is quiet.
dusche in der küche, sonst in ordnung

This charming flat made for the most comfortable home base while we explored Berlin! Transit just across the street gets you anywhere you want to go. The host was great, proactive and friendly in communicating, and flexible in arranging check-in, as we experienced unforeseen delays at the airport with no cell phone service. Loved the youthful energy of the building and of Berlin! So much character and a creative vibe, yet peaceful. Loved cooking breakfast each morning in the bright, smartly outfitted kitchen…great decor  :) Felt as though we got a true Berliner experience and it now tops our list of favorite cities! Can’t wait to return!♥️
Гарне помешкання, люб'язний господар:)

Sehr schön eingerichtete Wohnung, Lage direkt neben dem S Bahnhof Botanischer Garten super.
Einziges Manko der Wohnung ist dass sie relativ laut ist, liegt direkt an der Straße und ohne geöffnete Fenster kann man nachts kaum schlafen..
Im Sommer auch ziemlich heiß in der Wohnung, weil nur kleine Fenster gekippt werden können.
Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt, vielen Dank! Kommunikation mit Urs war hervorragend!

Good location, clean modern, Just had a small issue with gaining access to the laundry. No access code was given then through a slow process the number supplied never worked. Couldnt gain access in the end and had to use a laundromat. Possibly an issue with the door lock. A bit of a worry if the room lock was too stop operating.  Having a centralised property manager caused a long delay with different people trying to resolve the issue but not reading the email chain to see i had been given the code .

This flat was spacious, very comfortable, great shower and bath (piping hot water). It has a really lovely cafe on one side and opposite with a great Vietnamese restaurant on the other - beautiful food and both cater for coeliac.  The beds have new mattress toppers so well cosy. It has a key pad entrance so no need to worry about losing your key or sharing with others. Really we couldn’t fault it and we had a wonderful holiday there.

Schitterend appartement! Buurt is niet bijzonder, wel een fijne verbinding naar centrum. Op straat is het in de nacht erg gehorig. Je hoort dat wel in het appartement. Toch is het Appartement zelf heel fijn! Schoon, nieuw
Herzliche und äußerst unkomplizierte Gastgeber.

The apartment was in a good area. It is easy to find from the Ostbahnhof. The room looked friendly and nice.

We left our apartment as good as it was possible to clean. Later back at home I received a message from the renter. He will debit me EUR 50 for cleaning services, which I can't accept. She also told me that she lost clients because it took to long time to clean the apartment. This is not in my responsibility.

At all we had a nice week.
Sehr nette Unterkunft mit einer sehr liebevollen Gastgeberin. Nächstes Mal komme ich mit Familie.
Great location, few minutes walk to; shops, cafes, public transports etc.
No notes! A perfect stay. Thoughtful details throughout - would return :-)
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour, l'appartement est agréable dans un quartier tout aussi agréable, attention cependant l'appartement est totalement vitré sans store il peut y faire très chaud
Alles bestens. Gutes Preis-Leistung-Verhältnis. Netter und freundlicher Kontakt.
Super Gastgeber, alles sehr reibungslos und kurzfristig geklappt - Danke hierfür und die gute Kommunikation!

Great overall stay. Top marks for location and access.
Bedding (pillows and duvets) could use a bit of sprucing up and were insufficient. But it's not something that can't be easily fixed.
Alles bestens. Gern wieder.

Wir waren dort mit 1 Erwachsenem und 3 kleinen Kindern und es hat sehr gut gepasst. Die Kinder fühlten sich wohl, alles war praktisch, schön und robust genug. Ganz in der Nähe sind sehr viele Restaurants. Ein sehr vielfältiges Viertel.
We had a comfortable and nice stay !

Wir hatten das Vergnügen, bei Peter für zwei Tage zu bleiben und es war absolut fantastisch. Peter war äußerst gastfreundlich und gab uns wertvolle Tipps zu Orten, die wir sonst vielleicht verpasst hätten. Seine Freundlichkeit und Hilfsbereitschaft machten unseren Aufenthalt besonders angenehm. Die Unterkunft selbst war makellos sauber und bot alles, was wir für einen komfortablen Aufenthalt benötigten. Die Lage war auch ideal, in der Nähe von Sehenswürdigkeiten und leicht erreichbar. Insgesamt kann ich Peter's Unterkunft nur wärmstens empfehlen und würde jederzeit wiederkommen.
This was a great place to stay and Martin was an excellent host!
Fint ophold til prisen

Very nice apartment, great location. Clean and nicely furnished.
Extremely unfriendly check-in. After a 12,000 km journey we arrived around 50 minutes after our estimated (!) time of arrival, due to 3 major traffic jams on the last 250 km. We called from the road to inform the guy who checked us in, but that opened the gates to hell.
Unacceptable.

We really liked the 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment at the SANA Hotel. Great location, walkable and only 1/2 block to the subway. Berlin has so much to see.
We had a great stay - the staff were always pleasant and helpful.
Wunderschöne Wohnung in bester Lage.
Andrej was super nice, the location of his flat is ideal and the flat itself is very stylish and comfortable. Will go there again !
unkompliziert, sauber, schnell und in guter lage

My family had a nice stay at Ferhat's place. I think the photos don't do it justice -- it is much brighter and roomier in person.
As others have noted, it is on the third floor, so keep that in mind if you have heavy luggage. Also the street is rather loud at night, so bring earplugs if that might bother you.
Otherwise, the location is great and convenient to the U bahn and some great spots for food and drinks.

Apartment is very close to transports that go to the city center (15 minutes). 2 minute walk to the supermarket (LIDL).
The apartment didn't have a good way to block sunlight. We are used to have blinds that don't let light enter.
Alex is very nice and, even though we arrived a little bit later than expected, we were able to check in. Recommended!
Fantastic location, ideal for jumping between Prenzlauer Berg, Friedrichshain and Mitte. Check in/out was very quick and easy. The rooms are also very clean and quiet. Highly recommended
Easy check in. Simple, clean room, with plenty of space, and nice light from the windows. Great Location.

謝謝Peter的招待，非常享受他美麗的房間。雖然剛開始入住時有點小插曲（我相信是Peter年紀大沒有馬上即時回覆，但他的家人有馬上幫忙解決問題）
房間在四樓，但是有電梯可以使用，浴室跟廚房需要跟Peter共用，但這沒有困擾我們。房間裡沒有空調及電扇，但是晚上窗戶打開就蠻涼爽舒適，床比較適合一個人睡，若有第二位要入住，可以麻煩他幫我們加另一個床在另一側。
可惜我不懂德語，否則就可以天天跟Peter聊天了⋯⋯
太謝謝Peter的款待

Ralf e Viola ci hanno accolto calorosamente e sono stati premurosi con noi in ogni momento, persino facendoci trovare degli ombrelli in un giorno di pioggia. L'appartamento è molto bello e in una zona deliziosa e estremamente tranquilla, è collegato abbastanza bene con i primi negozi utili ed è facile spostarsi anche verso il centro di Berlino. Comunicare è stato facilissimo e comunque abbiamo avuto tutto ciò che serviva per il nostro soggiorno. Decisamente consigliato!
Super Aufenthalt in gemütlicher Unterkunft und schöner Lage!
Appartement joli, confortable, parfait pour séjourner quelques jours à Berlin. Un peu excentré mais proximité immédiate des transports en commun.

Probably my favourite Airbnb ever (and I've stayed in a lot). Beautiful, stylish, spacious, clean apartment in a great location. I will definitely stay here again on my next trip - highly recommended!

Robin’s flat is exactly as expected. It has everything needed for a city break. The living space has open views from large window & a balcony. The kitchen has everything & more. Shower room is perfect.
Robin has left information & local recommendations about eating out etc- this was very helpful.
Short walk to transport infrastructure. Would book again.

Die Unterkunft war sehr ordentlich, sauber sowie gut ausgestattet und gemütlich. Die Kommunikation und der Service waren perfekt.  Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt und waren rundherum zufrieden.

Eine sehr schicke, bestens ausgestattete Wohnung in traumhafter Lage! Nahe am Schloss Chalottenburg, am U- und S- Bahn Netz und trotzdem ruhig! Absolut geeignet auch mit zwei Kindern. An- und Abreise dank super Gastgeber total unkompliziert. Parkmöglichkeit direkt vor der Haustür! Wenn wir wieder nach Berlin kommen, dann auf jeden Fall zu Heiko!!!

War schon ziemlich enttäuscht .
Sah nicht aus wie auf den Bildern!
Überhaupt nicht geeinigt wenn man Kinder hat!
Müssten Kinderwagen ständig hoch und runter tragen( Treppen)
Weil euer Aufzug nicht bis ganz unten fährt , wegen Altbau.( mehr Informationen wäre besser gewesen sonst hätten wir niemals gebucht )
Badezimmer in Ecken und Kanten nicht richtig geputzt .
Von den Wänden wollen wir garnicht reden überall schwarze Flecken .
Rezeption kein Stück Verständnis das man ein Baby hat. Mussten lange warten etc .
Schade ..
Gute Kommunikation. Internet teilweise sehr langsam. Wohnung ist schick, aber klein. Duschwasser war sehr warm. Gute Lage.

I had a fantastic stay at Sharon’s place. The room was large, the bed was very comfortable, the house was clean, the room was quiet, very secure and location was great.
Sharon & her partner Thomas were also incredibly friendly and great to chat with. Really enjoyed my time there and would happily book again next time I’m in Berlin. Highly recommend 10/10!
Very well located flat, very easy to leave in, very warm welcome.
Tolle Unterkunft indented Kontakt. Wir (6 Personen) haben uns gleich wie zuhause gefühlt!

Super chickes loft im Herzen Kreuzbergs. Großzügig bemessen, äußerst stilvoll eingerichtet. Alles vorhanden was man braucht, sogar Waschmaschine. Kaffeepads lagen bereit. Bestes AirBnB seit langem. Jeden Cent wert.
Sehr schöne Wohnung, gut gelegen
Wonderful place worth to stay with car access. Highly Recommended.
Easy and good price!
we really enjoyed our stay at nena apartments! our apartment was super stylish, clean and cozy. it didn't feel like we are at the hotel, but in really cool place.. thanks! totally recommend.

Nous avons passé un super séjour chez Till !! La chambre était très propre, et la literie confort. L’emplacement de l’appartement est idéal car il y a les transports en commun juste à côté et seulement à 3 km du centre de la ville. Il y a de quoi se restaurer aux alentours et un super marché aux saveurs à côté avec toutes les cuisines du monde. Till a été très réactif, et nous a donné de bon conseils. N’hésitez pas :)
Very comfortable, Beautiful home in a really nice area of Berlin. Would definitely stay again
It was best choice
Die Ausstattung ist sehr gut, Kristina tut alles um den Aufenthalt  so gut wie möglich zumachen. Da die Zimmer sehr klein sind, muss man Abstriche machen. Haben uns trotzdem wohl gefühlt

Our first time staying in a shared Airbnb. It was an amazing experience!! We felt that there was amazing hospitality, heaps of space, extremely clean and the doors were soundproof for when people went between the rooms and kitchen. Johnny the dog was very well behaved and cute. We would definitely stay here again! Close to nice restaurants and cafes too.
Der Aufenthalt war perfekt! Die Wohnung war sauber, gemütlich und bestens ausgestattet. Der Gastgeber war super freundlich und stets erreichbar. Absolut empfehlenswert!
So wonderful place! Quite small but it was great time during stay. Near the station so comfortable to go anywhere!
Wir hatten eine wunderbare Zeit in dieser schönen Unterkunft. Alles war wie beschrieben und sehr sauber. Die Lage ist zudem perfekt!
Martin was kind, flexible, and offered good tips. The space was big, clean, and bright. Terrific!

exelente lugar!
limpo organizado e próximo de estações.
o, bairro é calmo e tranquilo com supermercados próximos.

Nice and clean apartment, easy to get in to Berlin city. We arrived after midnight in central station but still bus available to get into the house . Flora give instructions but We use mobile map to locate the house as darkness .
Enjoyed our stay. I recommend this flat very highly
Thank you Flora

Excellent location, friendly staff, but beds on mezzanine level (reached by very steep ladder) very close to wall and ceiling so absolutely no air flow - fans just created noise and moved hot air around had to sleep on the floor on lower level, even that was too hot. Asked to pay for first night and move hotel which was denied.

Günter ist ein sehr freundlicher Gastgeber und verfügt über ein sehr schönes Zimmer an super tollen Lage in einem wunderschönen alten Haus, aber trotzdem ruhig.  Wir haben unsere Zeit in Berlin genossen!

El lugar es genial, se puede descansar de buena manera, el barrio es muy tranquilo y se cuenta con gran privacidad, Nikolas es un anfitrión 10/10 siempre atento y dispuesto a ayudar cuando uno lo requería, espero volver algún día =)
Do not hesitate. Just come and stay here. Absolulately best for you
Great place - recommend to all
Sehr zentral und dennoch ruhig gelegene Wohnung. Sehr schnelle Kommunikation und problemloser Checkin - vielen Dank!
