My partner and I had a great stay at Roberts place. Robert was very welcoming  when we arrived and even though there were 4 flights of stairs, the climb was definitely worth it! The communication wasn’t great, in fact there were two cases of firealarms during the night in one week. The hotel service didn’t even reach out afterward besides all of the hotel guests had to stay outside of the hotel for 1hour in heavy rain during the night (4am) some of them barefoot and half clothed. I missed one meeting because of that and my first nights weren’t exactly a paradise. As you can imagine.
I messaged them for the main room light and got no answer - it was broken after 5days. Then the Internet didn’t work. I called twice and there was a friendly service voice wondering why nothing happened and they didn’t get the message alert on Airbnb. It was super friendly but nothing happened afterwards. Room light stayed broken during the whole stay. Rooms look way bigger in the images.
All in all the hotel is very pricey for the service, but most of the guests are very young or in groups. So it was quite noisy during the night. I’m used to noise, but 17year olds smoking in the rooms partying isn’t exactly what I signed up for.
The washing machine, especially the dryer, was broken and nobody could help. The reception is hiding in another room, and you can only call them. It’s ridiculous when you know that they are 2m away but let you wait forever and hesitate to answer even during office hours.
The service staff though, the cleaning ladies and men, were absolutely impeccable and helped out whenever they could.
I wouldn’t stay here again. There are too many alternatives, larger rooms, better communication and less expensive.

Our plane was delayed by 3hrs and  the check in time was kindly changed without any hassle, communication was friendly and flawless. Top marks for comfy beds and an amazing shower. We will be back!
Nice location.

Lucias apartment is so beautiful! It’s in a good location with the main bustling part of the area just a street away. We really enjoyed our stay here, the apartment had everything we needed and more. Lucia was such a lovely host and was super understanding. She gave us a list of recommendations for the area and the communication between us was great. You must come here to enjoy this beautiful apartment!
Plus, Lucia’s dog is super cute.
Thanks again Lucia for a great stay! :)
Great place to discover Berlin. Very cosy and functional. Nina the host really takes care of her guests !

Die Wohnung war sehr schön, mit einem sehr großen Wohnzimmer und einer Küche mit viel Platz. Durch die vielen Pflanzen war der Balkon ein super Ort um sich abends aufzuhalten. Die Straßenbahn war nicht weit entfernt und auch ein Edeka war direkt gegenüber der Wohnung. Top Lage!
Very nice room. Easy check in. Great service. Nice neighborhood near by.

Nice apartment.

Leiligheten til Mina var helt topp! Rent og pent, og alt du trenger for noen dager i Berlin. Svarer raskt, og det var null problem med innsjekk selv om jeg selv ikke hadde helt kontroll på når jeg ville ankomme nøyaktig. Mina og kollegaen fikset det, og gjorde mitt opphold supert. Takk!

Thank you Brit! We loved the flat and would recommend it to anyone that is interested in staying in Berlin. Charlottenburg is a fantastic area and we enjoyed being in the heart of it all. We walked to the Charlottenburg Palace from the flat for our first ever visit to a German Christmas market. It could not have been better. Whether you need to do a big supermarket shop or grab a quick cup of coffee, the flat is close to it all. It was super easy to get to public transportation as well. The flat was clean, well appointed, and incredibly comfortable for our family of four. All of this begins and ends with our host. Brit took the time to check in with us on our first evening to make sure things were going smoothly and was super flexible when our travel plans went a little sideways. She's an excellent communicator with a personal touch and we would stay there again without question.

Torkjell was extremely kind and welcomed me in person, occasion in which he detailed the functioning of the apartment and gave me local recommendations. The apartment itself is conveniently located close to a subway (U-Bahn) station (Eberswald, line 2), and a train (S-Bahn) station (Schönhauser Allee), as well as multiple tram and bus connections. The room is spacious and contains a desk, a chair, hangers. The kitchen is fully equipped and the neighborhood is safe and full of shops, restaurants, diners. Berlin is amazing and can be explored on foot, by bike or using the excellent transport system.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden noch einmal wieder kommen. Sabine ist eine total liebe und freundliche Person. Beim Check in ist Sie uns sehr entgegengekommen, vielen Dank!

Super netter Kontakt.
Netter Empfang, trotz nicht persönlicher Schlüsselübergabe.
Stylisches Appartement.
Gut ausgestattete Küche.
Top Lage mit guter ÖPNV Anbindung.
Das Appartement liegt im Hinterhof, dadurch ist es sehr ruhig, so dass man bei geöffnetemFenster schlafen kann. Morgens ein wenig laut, aber bei geschlossenem Fenster kein Problem.
Alles rundum schön und sehr gut weiterzuempfehlen.

Wir waren zu dritt in der tollen Altbauwohnung und hatten einen fantastischen Aufenthalt!
Die Wohnung war genauso wie auf den Bildern und wirklich gut ausgestattet. Alles war sehr sauber und gut gepflegt. Besonders gefallen hat uns die ruhige Lage, von der aus man das Zentrum etc. sowohl zu Fuß als auch mit Bus/Bahn gut und schnell erreichen konnte. Die Gastgeberin, Julia, war super freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Die Kommunikation war einfach und schnell.
Wir würden definitiv wiederkommen und können diese Unterkunft jedem empfehlen, der einen entspannten und komfortablen Aufenthalt in Berlin sucht! :)
Schönes Apartment & Zimmer, gut ausgestattet und nette Lage. Zu empfehlen :)
Fantastische Unterkunft, tolle Gastgeber, das Wochenende war perfekt! Wir kommen gerne wieder,

Sehr charmantes Apartment, hohe Qualität in der Ausstattung und liebevoll vorbereitet!
Top Kommunikation!

I had a great time in EL's flat. Even though I was late a lot, her assistant, john was very kind. The flat was clean and very comfortable. Its location was also good.
Parking a car was not easy for me but i think it doesnot matter to others.
Appartement très viable, à deux pas du métro parfait à Berlin
Alles prima und wie beschrieben. Schöne Altbauwohnung in guter Lage. Kontakt und Schlüsselübergabe mit Henrik waren problemlos.

Хорошая квартира прямо рядом с метро (вход в метро буквально в 10 метрах от подъезда), недалеко от центра города. Квартира не новая, но все в хорошем состоянии. Очень удобно, что есть селф-чекин. Думаю, что если будем в Берлине ещё раз, то остановимся здесь же.

The newly refurbished flat has got everything you need for a lovely stay - comfy mattresses, wifi, cleanliness. Derek is nice and very responsive. The flat is a five-minute walk away from Lichtenberg station and the area is very quiet. (Don't forget to keep the key with you at all times, to avoid being locked outside as we were :) but again, Derek was very responsive.) I recommend!

Prima verblijf hoor. Ik zou alleen iets meer aandacht schenken aan de schoonmaak/interieur verzorging: spinnenwebben aan plafond, stoffig (vooral op planken aan muur), vlekken in gordijnen en dode plant in de hoek.. dit vond ik wat minder. Voor de rest was het prima!
Schöne Wohnung, gute Lage, sauber!  Die gefühlt 100 Spatzen und ihr Pfeifen vor dem Fenster nervt etwas...  schlafe mit gekippten Fenster fast unmöglich!
Excelente lugar, muy bien ubicado a pasos del checkpoint. En recepción nos recibieron muy bien y la recepcionista hablaba español. Volveria en mi próxima visita a berlin
Great location, beautiful apartment. We'll definitely stay there again!
This is excellent, also for families! Super nice staff.. Thanks, Walid!
Nice and clean apartment. Easy communication. Recommendable.

Jeannette’s house is a very cosy and beautiful place. This is a perfect stopover Incase someone is traveling from/to the airport. Also, Jeannette is a very kind and accommodative host. She was flexible with my checkins and explained everything in details. Definitely recommend it to other travellers.

Great apartment, close to U bahn at Wedding,( the area the apartment is located)
Good food close by.
Lidl near too, can be a little noisy at night due to location next door to restaurants but worth every penny.
The host was amazing, very responsive to questions and always patient.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft. Bad war super sauber und groß. Reagiert mega schnell auf Nachricht🤍 würde definitiv weiterempfehlen 🥰
Very clean and spacious area! Great place to relax after a long day in Berlin.
Great little apartment, has everything you need for a week long trip! Clean, tidy and nice. Right next to an S-bahn, great location!

Carlos ist ein vorzüglicher Gastgeber. Er ist sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Carlos versteht es aber auch den Gästen eine angenehme Privatsphäre zu gönnen. Ich denke, besser kann airbnb nicht sein. Sicher unsere Wahl beim nächsten Berlinbesuch und auch die erste Wahl, wenn wir Freunden eine Unterkunft in Berlin empfehlen wollen.
This is the best apartment you can find in central Berlin. Brand new, sparkling clean, luxurious amenities, close to U2 Bahn. We wish we can stay longer to enjoy more. Definitely will come back...
Amazing host. Everything went perfect.

Staying at Joshua and Yuqing's place was a joy.  My hosts were extremely helpful and accommodating, with lots of nice recommendations about the area.  Their apartment in the altbau is charming, and very spacious and clean.  The water is hot, the internet is super fast, and the location is excellent, with all kinds of great restaurants and bars nearby.  I can't recommend their place highly enough!

Simon is a perfect host and was of great help when we had to deal with lost luggage and a little sick 1 yr old. He is very responsive and quickly takes care of any needs.
In case you’re not familiar with Berlin, this is the perfect location to explore Prenzlauer Berg and Mitte to get a taste of why everyone flocked here after the wall came down. Best ice cream in town right next door, as well as a great breakfast place.
Highly recommended, this is an absolute standout Airbnb in this area!
Everything worked out well with no problems. Beautiful apartment, close to everything and good connection to the city centre. Highly recommended!
Bis auf eine Spinne 🕷️ für die das Hotel nichts kann, war es top :)

We had the best time at Ben & Martha’s apartment! It such a beautiful and light space. Everything was clean and the beds were super comfortable. Everything was even more beautiful in real life. The location is great too, many good restaurants and cafes closeby. And very good and easy communication with the hosts. Thanks a lot, Ben & Martha! We highly recommend this place to everyone.
Great host! Responds very fast with good information. Place was very clean and comfortable.

Klein und etwas altmodisch, aber gemütlich und sauber.
Anica und Maxim waren sehr nett und hilfsbereit

Verda wasn't able to meet us but her lovely friend Anna welcomed us warmly. Verda kept in contact and was able to organise things for us as our German was non existent!! There was a lot of great information about the area as well as maps and brochures about Berlin. Immaculate and stylishly presented apartment in a great area. Lots of cafes, restaurants and bars close by this quiet urban street.  Bells on Sunday from the church up the road and trams and U Bahn within 5 minutes walking distance. Perfect location to enjoy all the pleasures of Berlin. We even got used to walking up to the fourth floor.
nette plek waar u met veel plezier en comfort  u verblijft in Berlijn brengen. wij zullen Sabine b&b gebruiken bij ons volgende bezoek in Berlijn

Amazing location. Great restaurants. Bakery. Health food store. Buses and Metro very close by. The listing stated “full service” but we learned after being there for several days that it was more like self service. We were there for over a week and on the seventh day the room was cleaned by housekeeping. You could get towels, bathmats and tea on the third floor yourself. And you had to take the garbage up to the third floor as well. Washer and dryer were on the third floor and were Internet operated. It was slightly confusing to figure out. The air conditioner was set at 26C. We had some very hot days and it wasn’t very cool in the room. Bed was comfortable but pillows were gigantic.

Spent about a week and a half here with a guest total of 3. Ina was excellent with communication and even though our arrival was delayed, she was still able to make sure we can find the apartment and get the keys with no hassle. She had also recommended an amazing restaurant to us, which we enjoyed very much. Should I return to Berlin in the future, I would be glad to stay here again.

Great Apartment!
From the first minute on, Sören was the perfect host! A lovely stay, I can highly recommend!
Thanks for the great days!
Es war ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt! Die Ausstattung des Zimmers war perfekt und besonders die Lage überzeugend.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft in toller Umgebung!

El departamento de Andre es fantástico y esta muy bien ubicado.
Es muy recomendable.

Aan de ene kant is er weinig pivacy: keuken, baskamer en dakterras zijn gedeeld ruimtes, aan de andere kant is het een mooie ruime kamer, in het hartje van Kreuzberg - cafe’s en eethuizen om de hoek - en is gastvrouw Birgit bekwaam, hupvaardig, vriendelijk, en met een goed gevoel voor humor.

Mega Lage, Mega freundliche Gastgeberin!
Vom Check in bis out war alles super 👍🏼 kommen bald wieder 😊
Es ist ein großes und sehr gut ausgestattetes Appartement. Check in verlief reibungslos. Lage ist zentral, grün, typische städtische Geräuschekulisse.
Beautiful apartment plenty of amenities and Daniel was so pleasant !

great location close to U and S Bahn station. comfortable walking distance to alexanderplatz and area attractions.
large clean appartment, very comfortable for our group.
Kitchen fully stocked with everything we needed

Great location!  Close to the train station / underground.  Quick access to all of Berlin.  Coffee shop a couple of doors down. Enjoyed the place! Small (mini-frig) refrigerator so if looking for longer stay with lots of cooking, it may not work well.  We made breakfast each day and sandwiches for lunch to go and it worked perfectly for our family of four.
Had a lovely stay at Hille's place. Very close to public transport, super close to museum island and checkpoint Charlie and very walkable to lots of other places. Good value stay.

Caroline's apartment was a delight. The place is much larger than it shows in the pictures, very centrally located with good transport links and last but not least, contains everything you need to make you feel at home away from home! Caroline's replies were prompt, she is helpful and kind and definitely a superhost. Thanks again, Caroline!

This stay was exactly what we needed it to be. Well located and easily accessible to the rest of the city, clean and spacious and full of amenities in the kitchen that most Airbnb’s don’t have.
The team was so helpful and so easy to contact for anything we needed-would highly recommend for your next trip to Berlin!!

Wow! We absolutely loved our stay at Kiki’s accommodation. Everything was perfect and clean. The apartment and our room were beautiful – it truly felt like home. Kiki was also kind enough to let us check in early since our flight arrived in the morning. Overall, a very friendly and welcoming host. We totally recommend staying here!
Great stay! Was perfect for a small group and easy to access transportation.
Alles bestens und zu empfehlen.

Sehr schönes und ruhiges Zimmer, habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Ein absolutes Highlight ist der Balkon und die vielen selbstgemalten Bilder. Sehr verkehrsgünstig gelegen, man ist super schnell in der Innenstadt, Supermarkt ist fussläufig und es gibt einige nette Lokale direkt um die Ecke. Angela selbst war sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und offen. Dazu ein wirklich sehr gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis. Absolute Empfehlung!
Very nice appartment with nice location not far from anyting in center of Berlin, would book it again.

Очень удобное расположение: в тихом районе, но при этом до центра на электричке без пересадок всего 20 минут. Жилье чистое и уютное, было всё необходимое для проживания и питания. Сауна и бассейн - приятный бонус. Владельцы общительные и доброжелательные. Отдыхать было комфортно.

Our family had a wonderful stay in Susanna & Ingo’s beautiful home. The flat is very comfortable, well equipped (amazing coffee set-up!) and tastefully decorated. Our hosts were super friendly and accommodating. Thanks again for making our Berlin visit so special!
The place was very big and had a cool vibe. Had a small issue with plumbing but it was fixed very quickly! The location was very ideal.

The apartment itself was lovely. The bath was great. It had everything a self contained apartment needed. It was on the fourth floor with no elevator. The wifi was great. A little bit out of the way to the main attractions but otherwise good.

It was really great and cozy place to stay. Karen was very friendly host and she tried to help me staying well.  Also the place where the room located was quite and charming. Really want to visit again!
Excellent apartment in a lively area of Berlin. We enjoyed the experience so much.
Great host!
The flat was very clean and the overall space was organized well to accommodate 4 people.

Werner war sehr freundlich. Er hat uns in der Wohnung empfangen und uns alles erklärt. Man kann sich jederzeit bei ihm melden wenn man etwas benötigt wie zum Beispiel neue Bettwäsche.
In der Wohnung ist alles, was man braucht, enthalten. Auch ideal mit Kindern. Es befinden sich viele Spielplätze in der Nähe. Wir würden diese Wohnung jederzeit wieder nehmen.
Bra beliggenhet i stille og trivelig nabolag. Kort vei til offentlige kommunikasjoner. God seng. Lite kjøkken med begrenset med utstyr.

Angela's place (room & bathroom) is absolutely fantastic for two people looking to explore Berlin. The area is charming and quiet but Angela's place is right near the u6 and you can get to the centre in about 20 minutes. Angela is a lovely host and extremely willing to offer any suggestions and help. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay!
Pulito, comodo, ampio, tutto bene!

This place is fantastic! The location is perfect for exploring Berlin and there is a great supermarket very close by. We got directions and tips and check in and out were very easy. This was a treat for my husband’s 40th and the apartment was really impressive. Thank you Adrian.

Idéalement situé à deux pas de Alexanderplatz, au 3 éme sans ascenseur, appartement plutôt calme .
Conforme au descriptif, accueil sympathique et communication aisée.
Très bon séjour à Berlin, merci pour cette location😊
Sabrina ist eine sehr nette, offene und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin. Alles war sehr sauber und unkompliziert von der Buchung bis Tipps vorort. Gerne immer wieder bei Sabrina dem Sonnenschein Berlins

It was very pleasant to stay in Jenny's apartment during my weekend in Berlin! Everything was very clean, it was close to the S-bahn station and the neighborhood was full of cute coffee shops. I would definitely recommend staying here!

Eine nette kleine Wohnung in Berlin,welche gut gepflegt ist und eine super anbindung zu den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln hat.
Die Gastgeberin war nett und hat schnell geholfen wenn man eine Frage hatte.
Da die Wohnung an einer zentralen Kreuzung lag sollte man allerdings keine großen Probleme mit Lärm haben oder nachts mit geschlossenen Fenstern Schlafen.

Vi nød nogle virkelig skønne dage i Franks bolig. Lejligheden er lille, men hyggelig. Desuden ligger lejligheden i gåafstand fra både stationer. Restauranter og caféer. Kommunikationen var let og præcis. Tal for et skønt ophold!
Wir hatten ein tolles WE auf dem Hausboot. Alles was man benötigt ist vorhanden. Die Gegend um Berlin ist super schön. Wenn dann auch das Wetter mitspielt ist es perfekt. Wir kommen gern wieder!

Ein sehr schön eingerichtetes Ferienhaus im Garten des Vermieters. Der Vermieter war immer schnell erreichbar und der Check-In war easy flexibel möglich. Ein Parkplatz direkt vor dem Haus ist vorhanden. Wir waren sehr zufrieden und empfehlen es weiter!

Unser Hotelzimmer hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Es bot viel Platz und war in jeder Hinsicht äußerst funktionell. Sehr vorteilhaft fanden wir auch die Kochnische. Das Hotel liegt - trotz der Nähe zum Stadtzentrum- in einem für Berliner Verhältnisse ziemlich ruhigen Umfeld. Die U-Bahn-Anbindung ist durch die nahegelegene Station Gleisdreieck sehr günstig. Gut gefallen hat uns auch das kleine französische Frühstück (mit Croissants), das von Montag bis Freitag für 5 Euro pro Person angeboten wurde. Wir waren mit unserem Aufenthalt absolut zufrieden und können das Hotel auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen.
Super kleine Wohnung in perfekter Lage in die Innenstadt und schöne Gegend zum Essen. Die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet und sauber. Gerne wieder!

War meine erste Hostel-Erfahrung und ich bin positiv überrascht. Hatte ein 3-Bett-Zimmer...ist dort gemischt, was ich persönlich angenehmer empfinde, als reine Frauen oder Männerzimmer. Da wird mehr aufeinander acht gegeben. Entspanntes, junges Personal. Frühstück für 6 Euro mit dem nötigsten - dennoch ausreichend. Bar bis 5 Uhr geöffnet - nur für Gäste, d.h. kaum Lärm, man schläft ruhig. 2,70 Euro für ein Bier 👍. Preis Leistungsverhältnis generell top.

Jessy was an excellent host; clear communication and extensive research into local attractions and activities, all methodically laid out and presented in a welcoming brief. She's a lovely person and I would look to stay with her again should I re-visit Berlin.

A beautiful flat, perfect location and amazing for a family. Our kids didn't want to leave! And last but not least, Alex is a brilliant host, reactive and that has been very flexible with our changed schedule. Strongly recommended.

So very quiet!!!  Great location if you want to spend time around West Berlin. Really close to The Schloss Charlottenburg, with some fantastic local restaurants and space to breathe and walk. Public transport links are fantastic, meaning you can easily get into the Mitte or the forests and lakes. The flat itself was perfect for us and our two teenage daughters. The only downside is that it is on the ground floor and is does lack a bit of natural light.

Ubytování bylo v pohodě. Pouze první dojem byl ten, že jsme vstoupili do suterénu domu. Byli jsme tři. Dvě ženy spaly v zadní části bytu (mohly si pootevřít okno), muž spal u okna do hlavní ulice (okno si otevřít nemohl). Jinak vybavení bytu bylo standartní, žádný luxus, uvařili jsme si čaj, kávu, udělali snídani, vysprchovali teplou vodou. Blízko byl autobus č.248 do centra. Pouze bych chtěla  návštěvníkům Berlína připomenout, že parkování bylo na ulici (pokud najdete místo) zdarma, ale musíte mít zelenou známku (549 korun českých), která platí ve větších německých městech a jes neomemezenou platností, což my jsme si předem nezjistili a ani nás na to hostitel neupozornil (asi si myslel, že to víme) a nyní jsme ve správním řízení a zaplatíme pokutu ve výši 105 euro. Jinak na přespání je byt v letním období dostačující.

Being a first time visitor to Berlin, it was hard to know exactly what area of town to stay in.
Katja’s place itself, and the location within the city was excellent.
Everything is so easy to get to from here with three Tram Lines within short, easy walking distance.
The apartment itself was quiet (I’m a light sleeper), comfortable and very clean.
Katja responded to all our questions (minor) promptly before and during our visit.
Prenzlauer Berg is a quaint neighborhood, feels very safe and welcoming.
I would highly recommend this apartment and this location.
Thanks again Katja!

Very cosy and stylish apartment for 2, quiet in a typical Berlin backyard and an amazing neighbourhood if you step outside, with a sweet market close by. I enjoyed the stay very much. The host was very friendly and professional.
Super Host👍🏾
Esta bien comunicado con el transporte público, la gente en la recepción fue muy amable.

Vielen lieben Dank für den sehr angenehmen und unkomplizierten Aufenthalt!
Wir waren besonders happy mit der wirklich besonders schönen und idyllischen Lage. Es war auch alles super sauber und heimelig eingerichtet. Super Anbindung in die Innenstadt. Einziges Manko war für uns tatsächlich das Bett, das war uns zu hart und wir sind immer recht verrostet aufgewacht. Das ist aber wie immer recht subjektiv. Insgesamt ein toller Aufenthalt!

Die Wohnung ist super schön, ruhig und sehr zentral gelegen.
Fadeih ist sehr nett und antwortet schnell.
Immer wieder gern kommen wir zurück!
Marta

Best place so far! I stayed at Andreas for a month and I had a great time :)  Comfortable bed and cool architectural solutions in the apartment made a memorable stay. Thank you Andreas & Nom, the cakes and homemade bread were amazing!

War wie ausgeschrieben, mit guter Nahverkehrsbindung in die Berliner Innenstadt. Ingeborg war jederzeit zu erreichen und immer freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in Berlin kann ich diese AirBnb jederzeit weiterempfehlen.
Sehr schönes Airbnb mit Top Lage. Gastgeber bei Problemen immer schnell erreichbar über den Chat. Problemlose Check in alles online. Sehr zu empfehlen!!

Wir waren beruflich in Berlin und hatten fünf angenehme Nächte in diesem Appartement. Die Ausstattung ist sehr gepflegt, hochwertig und ansprechend. Prima ist, dass es zwei Badezimmer gibt und die Betten richtig gemütlich und gar nicht ausgelegen sind. Fußläufig gibt es eine gute Auswahl verschiedenster Restaurants und Cafés.

It was a very nice apartment in a nice and quiet area. Easy access to public transportation and Cornelius was very helpful with all of our questions. A very good experience. He even send a watch to us that we forgot in the apartment.
Lovely place! Right next to everything that you need. Easy to find and check in/out. Responded quickly to all of our enquiries😄room was clean and the bed was so comfy! We will definitely be back

Vores første, men absolut ikke sidste ophold på skibet!
Venligt personale, rar atmosfære og en formidabel udsigt til Muren(Eastside Gallery) og Oberbaumbrūcke.

The Emilio Vedova villa was an amazing place for couples and group of friends who come to visit Berlin. As we didn't have car the city center is little further away but the connection with train is good and it takes only 25 min to reach the city center, and train station is only 10 min by foot. The house was clean and host were welcoming and friendly. We really enjoyed our stay and I will surely recommend it to all my friends as a wonderful resort. :)
Thank you Wolfram for your hospitality.
Fantastic Place Great Host a lovely stay.

Easy and super flexible check-in. Place was as described. Cool neighborhood and very clear details for the place. It’s like staying in a small, low cost, cozy hostel with your own private room. Would definitely stay there again.

Wir sind dort mit 2 Familien und 2 Babys für ein Wochenende eingekehrt und hatten eine schöne Zeit. Der Schnitt der Wohnung macht das sogar für Familien mit Kleinkindern sehr attraktiv, da die beiden Schlafzimmer weit auseinander liegen und die Kleinen sich so nicht gegenseitig wecken. Es war schön warm und es wurde an nichts gespart. Ob extra Decken oder Handtücher.
Abschließend muss man die Lage hervorheben. Man ist in wenigen Minuten bei der SBahn und kann überall hin. Und natürlich die super freundlichen Hosts!
Immer wieder gerne!
Everything is  wonderfull: home, garden and over all the host Ursula!

Suzana hat mich sehr herzlich empfangen und mir gleich Infos zu den Möglichkeiten in der näheren Umgebung gegeben. Das große Altbauzimmer mit Stuck und einem tollen Dielenboden haben mir gutgetan. Ich kann Suzana‘s Unterkunft sehr empfehlen.

Stefanさんのアパートは公園の中にあり、すごく美しい環境でした。昼には子供の遊ぶ声が聞こえた、ベランダから見下ろすと犬を散歩する人たちや、芝生でくつろぐ人たちが見え、とにかくピースフルな立地で、とても居心地が良かったです。お部屋の広さもちょうどよく、キッチンも整っていて、バスタブで疲れを癒せるところも本当によかったです。アーリーチェックインや、追加のタオルもすぐに用意してくださり、Stefanさんには親切にしていただいてとても感謝しています。
ショッピングには歩いて行くことができました。かわいいカフェも沢山ありました。私のベルリン滞在がより良いものになりました。またここに滞在したいです！

Our group really enjoyed our extended stay at the loft. We stayed for a week, and it had all the amenities we needed for a longer visit. The kitchen was very well stocked! It’s located in a quiet neighborhood, which was a nice hideaway too. With a short tram ride to Hbf, it made getting around the city too. Spacious, clean, and well-taken care of. High-quality living. I highly recommend you to pick Felix's flat if you're visiting Berlin for longer stays.
Pros:
- Felix's hospitality is exceptional.
- Great natural light and open space.
- Safe neighborhood. Friendly neighbors.
- You've got to love the sound system and iMac.
- Small touches like the remote control for speakers and light.
- Fully equipped. No problem cleaning (vacuum machine), doing laundry, or cooking (oven) in the kitchen.
- There's a guitar! A bit broken but still playable.
- Well decorated with green plants and artworks.
- What I appreciate a lot is the complete living necessities (e.g. laundry detergent, soap, tissue, rechargeable battery, oil, wine-opener, drying rack, full-body mirror, etc). It makes it really convenient.
Cons:
- Not the most convenient to commute (e.g. It takes 45min for me to go to my office in Mitte).
- Not so much entertainment or restaurants around the area.
- There's no hanging wardrobe, only drawers. So you can't hang your clothes. Not so convenient if you have suits or jackets.
- Because it's so big, it actually takes some time to clean yourself in a longer stay.
- The mirror in the bathroom is weirdly placed above the toilet.
Overall, it's a convenient, comfortable, and high-quality experience for me. I stayed for 2 months and I would select Felix next time.

I unfortunately was surprised that I was very disappointed with my stay at Alan and Kasia's apartment. I had read so many amazing reviews that perhaps I had built it up in my head, but it was not like any of my usual airbnb experiences or stays. I understand that a lot of my complaints are personal preferences, so some less particular travellers may love the apartment and disagree with my criticisms, but I want to leave an honest review in case any future traveller have similar preferences when chosing a place to stay. Firstly, I missed in reading the reviews that this is a ground floor apartment, and not just ground floor with a few windows looking out to the street, but actually on the street. The front door opens to the busy sidewalk which is a block from a Video store , a market, and a transit hub. As a female traveling alone, I prefer more private spaces. I was in Berlin to do work and wanted a space where I could feel comfortable leaving the blinds open and looking out at the view. When I did that in this apartment I had a lot of people walking by and looking into the space. So if you want more privacy this is not the space for you. Also, I was awoken at night by ambulance sirens. The street is busy and must be near a hospital or ambulance hub and the shades do not block the light completely. Light sleepers beware! Secondly, the apartment itself. It is clear this is an apartment just for travelers and not one that the hosts actually use. It is not well maintained or cared for (i.e. the scratches on the walls and the dirty furniture fabric and overused kitchenware) and has very little personal touches. I have stayed in Airbnbs before that are all Ikea products, but at least they are well cared for. The blankets did not looked changed from the previous tenant. Again, some people are just looking for a bed to sleep in, but I was here to work and enjoy the apartment, so I was displeased with the lack of care. I chose to stay in Airbnbs over a hostel or a pension because I want to feel like I am in a well cared for home, with a clean kitchen, bed and living space. This apartment lacked care and because of my preferences I think I would have been better off somewhere else. Transit The apartment is close to an S train and two trams M4 (closest) and M10 (you can walk about 15 minutes or connect). The previous apartment I had stayed in was close to the Schonehauser Allee transit hub. I found this station (only two away from Alan and Kasia's) apartment to be a much better hub for sight seeing, finding great restaurants, and entertainment. So after the first Prenzlauer Berg airbnb this apartment felt like it was in the outskirts. Perhaps if I...

Had a lovely stay at Alexanderplatz, everything is walkable and comfortable airbnb. Everything was clean. Everything was nearby and fun so can’t wait to visit again!

The view is great. Many good places to eat nearby. Very close to public transportation. It’s a high rise building and the people I met on the elevator were friendly. Karak likes to know specific times of check in and check out. The place was very clean. The bed is a firm futon which I liked.
Perfect place for a quick stay in Berlin. Great communication.
Super hôte, toujours très réactif !
Tolle Unterkunft in sehr schöner Lage. Traumhafte Dachterrasse und Wohnung. Übergabe und Kommunikation waren perfekt. Ein großartiger Ort um schöne Tage in Berlin zu verleben!!

Three of us stayed here for three nights. The place was spotless and very well situated near stations and buses. The neighbourhood has hidden gems behind the main road on either side… the host was helpful getting the apartment clean for an early checkin! We love Berlin and this was a new area for us to stay in… thank you Volker.

We had a great time in Berlin and would stay here again! There were some miscommunications (they were resolved at a timely manner!!!) and the place (location and design/layout) was set up more for groups than travel with children. We enjoyed the location as it was close to restaurants, bars, canal, museums, parks etc. However, the entry way directly of the sidewalk was at times very loud at night.
I recommend this place especially for groups (vs. families)! Kreuzberg is a great area in Berlin!
Wir waren zu viert und das Apartment war groß genug für das Wochenende. Das Apartment hat alles was man für ein Wochenend-Trip braucht.

Sehr tolle und blitzsaubere Wohnung, mit schöner kleiner Küche und schönem Bad. Gastfreundlichkeit war Top. Es gab viele schöne Extras wie kostenloses Tee oder Kaffee, aber auch Instant Noodles für einen kleinen Heißhunger Nachts, aber auch reichlich Badutensilien. Die Wohnung liegt perfekt, gleich neben dem Bahnhof, und es kommt jede 4 bis 6 Minuten eine S-bahn Richtung Stadtmitte, die fahrt dauert ca. 25 Minuten. Neben der Wohnung gibt es auch zwei Supermärkte die bis 22:00 offen haben, also es kann an nichts fehlen. Danke Me Hien !!
Tolle Unterkunft … Alles was man braucht

David fue muy amable. Nos enseñó mediante a un mapa los lugares turísticos. Pudimos dejar las maletas antes del check in. Además nos guardó las maletas después del check out. Al final del día nos regaló recuerdos de Berlín. Con respecto a la habitación, estaba ordenada y limpia, teníamos la habitación privada y era bastante amplia. El hostal está ubicado a 20 minutos en transporte público de los centros turísticos. Recomendado.

Adorable and warm apartment in quiet area near the center with  fully equipped kitchen. Both of bathrooms has a lot of towels and very hot water. I also liked pictures on the walls) Andre is always in touch! Highly recommend!

The image of the room and space doesn’t really capture how nice this place was. Super roomy and central to town, restaurants, bars and train station. Cool living space and kitchen as well! Would probably advise that the location isn’t the safest ( particularly at night ) but with caution there’s not really all that much to worry about. Highly recommend!
Really good location and very well maintained apartment in a great location. Ivo was really great host and quick in responding
Alles bestens!
Jederzeit wieder!
Logement très confortable et bien situé, facile d'accès grâce à l'application et personnel très réactif et sympathique au moment du check-out. Merci et à bientôt!
Stilvoll schlichte Wohnung in ruhiger Lage .
Die Unterkunft war wie beschrieben. Der Host ist sehr hilfsbereit

I really enjoyed my stay. The appartment was very nice and I really felt at home. It has everything you need and all was clean and nicely decorated.
I also loved the area: there are so many restaurants, coffee bars and shops around, there was no need to use the kitchen;)
Definitly a olace I‘d love to come back to.
Very nice and cute place. The room was very spacious and the house lovely.  All was clean and communication with Sandra was very easy and nice!

Guest room is spacious and clean in great location. Very accurately described except that the family is surprisingly quiet. I was prepared for lots of kids noise but I could barely hear anything. The bathroom is shared with family and a bit crammed, but I never had to wait when I need to take a shower. Also Marcel and Sasha could be a little slow to respond, which I didn’t mind as it’s expected with working parents with 2 kids.
Really nice stay! Would totally repeat :)
Next to Berliner Dom, and other famous locations. A lot of food around.

Wonderful apartment. Great character  and design. Amazingly bright and very very well appointed. Supermarkets and restaurants in less than 5 mins. We loved staying here. Its quiet ( the neighbourhood) so if you want lively go elsewhere!
Great place and great for interrailing with my friends but may need extra facilities 👍
Such a pretty place!!!!  Had everything we needed, comfortable and close to transit!  Loved staying here!

Had a smooth stay at Frank’s place in Berlin. The location was excellent and the apartment was clean and well-equipped. Frank was very responsive and helpful throughout. Everything worked as expected, and I’d gladly stay again

Great apartment, this is probably the smallest room out of the whole apartment. There are 4 rooms and they are all rented out as Airbnb, so often times other guests can be rather loud. Since the wall is rather thin as well it's easy to hear everything that's happening outside, and also people like to slam the door so that doesn't help much.
The apartment itself is kept very clean, there's a kitchen available to use, a box with an assortment of tea bags which is great. The host come over to clean up every morning.
The toilet is kept very clean as well, however on my 3rd night the pipe got blocked after all the other guests have used it and I was probably the last to use, and I couldn't shower that night. The host came right away after I message them about the issue, they were trying to sort out the issue for a few hours well into midnight however without any luck. The 2nd day they told me the building management will send plumbers to fix however before it got fixed other guests weren't being careful and cause a flood on the toilet which turns into a big mess and I didn't get to use the toilet for the next 4 hours until I could find a public toilet outside. The plumbers finally came late noon and got it fixed at 1930, and I could finally take a shower after 2 days.
I asked the host whether I can check out early and get a refund for that last night since I have an early flight to catch and I really need a shower, plus the plumbers were supposed to turn up at noon to fix it but there was no sign of them, but I was turned down and got told it would be fixed. Even though it is not their fault, I think some flexibility and the inconvenience caused should allow some flexibility and let the guests check out early without penalty.
Apart from that, it is right opposite a discount supermarket, also the bus stop for the S Bahn replacement service is right next to the supermarket. It's about 40 minutes to get into town, which is not too bad. There's also tram line a minute walk away from the bus stop which takes you to other areas. Ikea is about 15 minutes away by tram.

This was overall a really great stay. We experienced great hospitality, a nice neighbourhood, a really compact, clean and a cozy place to stay with many options for stores and transportation. Definitely would recommend!
We stayed here for only 3 days, but we have nothing bad to say. We enjoyed also the cafe/bar where the host works, and had amazing glasses of sangria! :D

We had a very nice time in the apartment, which is small but cosy and has everything that's needed. The immediate neighborhood is a bit non-descript (still safe!) and the location is a bit out of the way, but it's ideal as a base to explore Berlin.

Very welcoming, clean and cozy apartment. Owners met us on initial check in & gave us a rundown of the apartment & getting around Berlin.
Easy walk to city centre & main tourist areas.
Die Wohnung sieht live viel besser aus als auf den Fotos. Die Einrichtung ist wirklich schön und die Küche top ausgestattet. Alles sauber und ordentlich.  Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Zu Empfehlen
Ade was a wonderful host - very responsive and welcoming. The place is clean, quiet and I woke up to birds singing in the morning. I highly recommend staying here!

Die Wohnung war sehr schön, sauber und ordentlich und wir haben uns dort sehr wohl gefühlt. Auch die Lage ist perfekt, nicht weit von Haltestellen, Cafes, etc. Die Katze war auch immer wieder bei uns, war sehr zutraulich und neugierig. Das einzige was uns gefehlt hatte waren ein paar Sachen in der Küche (nicht viel Besteck...). Alles in allem aber eine top Unterkunft und immer gute Kommunikation.

I had a wonderful stay in Camilla apartment. Location is great it's really close to city center and also has a good connection to public transport (U-Bahn or tram). Around the apartment is plenty of great restaurants and location is safe and really silent. Camilla was really fast in answering questions and help me a lot also when I needed something about the apartment. So I can only recommend this place !
Amazing host, amazing location, we had an  amazing stay! I highly recommend staying here, I would come back!

Alexandra's place was perfect for a chilled base for exploring the city.
Lots of bedrooms and large communal table makes it perfect for large groups with a fully functioning kitchen should you want to cook although lots of affordable restaurants close by.
The basement area is great for after hours activities as the building is residential and noise after a certain time isn't welcomed.

Andreas is a really nice guy (let me use his washing machine too)
he has a nice place, cozy with helpful things inside it (small umbrellas etc).
the lower bed is kinda nice but the curtains behind are not good since light comes in in the morning.
the stairs outside my door smelled from cigarettes.
the sink in my room was really small and the floor got wet.
the location was worse then i thought which bumped me ( 40-50 min to get to city center).
i recommend this place for people who want to chill, while having a nice host too in a nice neighborhood .
thx Andreas :)

I really enjoyed being a guest in Audrey’s apartment. It has a lovely neighborhood with great cafes and it’s easy to get to the city center from there. The room is nice and cozy, perfect for one or two persons. Thank you, Audrey and till next time!

Het appartement is op een super locatie in Berlijn. Heel centraal, dichtbij ov, leuke wijk met restaurantjes. Om de hoek kun je geweldig ontbijten. Het appartement zelf is heel authentiek en van alle gemakken voorzien. We voelden ons thuis.
Enige minpunt wat ik kan noemen is de cv ketel naast het bed, die lawaai maakt.

Tolle Wohnung & eine außerordentlich gute Lage!
Handtücher vorhanden
Location suitedmy needs, clean and functional, however street noise an issue.

L'appartement de Arzu et Tom est clair, calme et bien situé près du centre de Berlin. Il bénéficie d'un très bon confort. Les explications fournies par Arzu et Tom sont extrêmement claires et précises. Tout pour passer un agréable séjour.

Clean and spacious apartment close to  restaurants, clubs and subway. Host gave excellent recommendations for restaurants and things to do in the area. There is no couch in the livingroom, only a padded bench.
Great host, great apartment
Lieu bien situé

Besser geht's nicht: wunderschön eingerichtete Berliner Altbauwohnung, das Zimmer ist ruhig und geräumig; die Lage ist perfekt. Alles ist super sauber und Sigbert ist hilfsbereit, unkompliziert und absolut liebenswert. Ich komme auf jeden Fall wieder.

The apartment was perfect for a couple of days in the city. Located close to both the tram and train station. Three of us staying and we had plenty of room. Felt extremely safe even with the bedroom being street level. Only improvement would be new towels and bedding they did smell of damp. But overall great value for money.

The Airbnb was clean, spacious, and was in a pretty good location. There was lots of forms of transports close by which were walkable to. There were also lots of food shops and restaurants just outside the Airbnb and markets and second hand shops which we really enjoyed.
The beds were very comfortable and the bathroom were great. Communication with the host was good and the checking in and checking out was very easy. There was a very sensitive noise detector.

Wir hatten ein paar sehr schöne Tage in der Ferienwohnung von Tim. Die Lage ist sehr ruhig, trotzdem ist man mit der S-Bahn von der nächsten Station aus ganz schnell in der Innenstadt. Es gibt keine separate Eingangstür, die die Ferienwohnung vom Treppenhaus trennt, das hat uns persönlich aber nicht gestört. Die Ausstattung ist prima (sogar Kaffee war da) und alles war blitzsauber!
Netter und zuverlässiger Host, tolle Lage, super Wohnung mit bequemen Betten
Alles top, gerne wieder.
Wir waren zufrieden und haben uns in Friedrichshain sehr wohl gefühlt.

This place was such a peaceful retreat in Berlin. I stayed here for 11 days and it was a bliss. The room gets amazing light and looks out onto a quiet little garden — super calming and green. Perfect for work as well if you're a remote worker. Mostly just birdsong and total quiet. Loved coming back here after a day in the city. Would 100% stay again!
Parwana was very kind and helpful. The room was nice and quite. Apartment is very nice.
Alles hat super geklappt.
Endroit que je recommande les yeux fermés !
Clean, in a vibrant part of town. Only a couple stops from the Hbf. Flexible check-in and check-out

Tolle Unterkunft in guter Lage, EG-Wohnung aber durch Plissees und Rolladen gut abdunkelbar.
Sehr nette Gastgeberin, die sehr gut zu erreichen war. Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt und würden wieder kommen!
Appartamento in zona strategica, design nuovo e particolare, ottimo per brevi soggiorni per due persone.

We enjoyed staying at Mina’s place. It’s perfect for 2, not big or fancy but very clean and super close to the next U-Bahn station. It was easy to communicate with Mina and she came back to use quickly with some helpful information. She also checked on us during our stay. We enjoyed it.

the room is really cozy, and the apartment is located in a very nice area with many cafes, pubs, and shops. you can reach everything easily since the S-Bahn station is really close. Really enjoyed my stay.

Alles bestens !
Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Wohnung.
Lage, Anbindung und Erreichbarkeit der Gastgeber war ideal.
Wir kommen definitiv wieder.
Vielen Dank nochmal.
Das Zimmer war sehr sauber und ruhig, da es zum Innenhof gelegen ist. Hardi ist sehr hilfsbereit und nett. Die Bushaltestelle ist sehr nah bei.

Das Zimmer ist in einem dreistöckigen Haus  in einer ruhigen Wohnsiedlung und hat Blick auf eine Schrebergartensiedlung. Es gibt zwei Bäder für 3-4 Personen und ich hatte den Luxus, dass ich mir das Bad mit niemandem teilen musste. Auch eine kleine Küche mit Kühlschrank etc. ist vorhanden.

Klaus has been super kind and friendly. The house is very comfortable, clean and it's in a very nice part of Berlin. All kind of services are all around there. Very indicated for a super Berlin holiday.
Nichts auszusetzen! Einen besseren Standort kann ich mir nicht vorstellen.
Great stay, place larger than pictures suggest

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Berlin grâce notamment à la qualité du logement de Seif et Yasmine: bel environnement, beaucoup d'espace, idéalement situé, des commerces autour et un appartement à la fois élégant et fonctionnel. Communication avec Yasmine parfaite. Nous reviendrons !

C'était bien, ça vaut le coup ! L'appartement est accessible facilement à pied à partir de la gare. Thiago vous indiquera les règles à respecter, ce qui est normal vu qu'on vit chez un habitant. Vous n'allez pas beaucoup le croiser pendant votre séjour, mais il est sympa et réactif en cas de problème. Il m'a aussi dit qu'il y avait une fête le lendemain de mon arrivée à Berlin, ce que je ne savais pas et je le remercie pour m'avoir donné l'info ! L'appartement est propre et vos affaires sont en sécurité.
Le dernier soir, un colocataire est arrivé dans ma chambre, c'était cool pour discuter en tant que voyageur solo ! Je le précise pour que vous soyez au courant que dans cette chambre vous ne serez pas forcément seul, si vous n'êtes pas à l'aise avec ça.
En résumé, c'est une bonne option pas cher pour séjourner à Berlin !

Good apartment in an cool location with a lot of bars and nice areas for walks. The apartment has everything you might need. Robert is an awesome host, he was helpful and we had a nice conversation. As a bonus, you might hear him play music, which was great :)
Can definitely recommend!

We stayed here for a few nights and I would definitely recommend this place. The host was communicative and friendly, the flat looked exactly like in the pictures. The place had pretty good public transport, good for discovering the city.
All in all, I’m happy I stumbled upon this gem.

Hervorragende Lage, super Check-In-System. Die Einrichtung ist äußerst schlicht gehalten, aber erfüllt ihren Zweck und hat persönlich gerade deswegen gut gefallen. Man merkt der Räumlichkeit an, dass diese auf die Vermietung zugeschnitten ist - es wird geboten was beworben und notwendigerweise gebraucht wird. Der Preis ist - zumindest für ein Studentenbudget - leider relativ hoch. Alles in allem hat die Unterkunft ihren Zweck mehr als erfüllt; man kommt gerne wieder.

Toms place was great. Much better than anticipated. Very clean and even great location. Nadine was very helpful with the check in. Quick access  to the train and a lot of great places to go just walking distance. Highly recommend for anyone interest in staying in Charlottenburg.
Schöne Wohnung, wie beschrieben, alles gut, netter Kontakt zum Gastgeber.
Thank you for the nice stay.
100% pleased with my stay
Excellent séjour. L'appartement est très beau, très agréable, il donne intégralement sur la spree. Le métro est plutôt proche. Quartier agréable. Je recommande

The flat itself is really nice and definitely suitable for a longer stay. Martin is also very responsive and kind - whenever I had a question he instantly got back to me and helped me with whatever I needed (thanks for that)!
The location itself is also extremely good as it is central (close to Potsdamer Platz). However, I must admit that I was a little bit surprised by the building and the street (was pretty dirty) when I arrived.
All in all: Good place and I’d come back!
Seht netter Empfang, gute Atmosphäre
We had a great weekend stay here. The breakfast was great and well worth the extra money. Location was super convenient and accessible, because the tram is right there.
Perfect location, easy check-in, would stay here again!
Lovely nice place to stay while exploring Berlin. very clean and tidy. everyhting you need is close by. The host Frank is very friendly and helpful with whatever is needed! <3
All good. Nice, cosy apartment. Quiet area, park with a playground nearby. Easy commute to city centre.Worth noting that apartment is on street level and is not very bright. Besides all was fine.

This is truly a gem in Berlin! The place is extremely clean and well laid out.  It's truly a minimalist design with thoughtful touches across  each space.  This will be my first choice whenever we stay in Berlin again!
Great location, comfortable and clean room

Excelente AIRBNB, autenticidad, limpieza y privacidad 100%. Check-in y check-out muy ágil y rápido. Había de todo en el apartamento y además está ubicado en un barrio muy tranquilo. Muy buena comunicación con el centro y con el aeropuerto de Tegel  (Cuando vuelva a Berlín, sin duda volveré a alojarme otra vez en él)

Klasse Zimmer für einen Berlin-Trip! Ich kann mich den Vorrednern mit 5 Sternen nur anschließen! Es war gemütlich, sauber, freundlich und zentral. Sabine und ihr überaus freundlicher Sohn haben uns als offene, herzliche Menschen empfangen, die uns unsere Privatsphäre ließen (sogar eigenes kleines WC mit Waschbecken!) und die stets hilfsbereit und mit allem zugegen waren, was man brauchte. Sabine ist ganz ohne Zweifel zurecht ein Superhost. Wir können das Zimmer in zentraler Lage und doch angenehmer Nachtruhe uneingeschränkt empfehlen und kommen bei Bedarf gerne wieder!!!

The apartment is really nice, clean, comfortable, and very quiet. There is a supermarket and a cafeteria literally right round the corner. The subway station is right in front of the building, so it is really easy to move around the city, which has excellent public transport, by the way.
We had a couple of practical questions to ask and we got answers pretty quickly.
Highly recommendable. We have enjoyed our stay in Berlin.

Es war sehr schön und für unsere Gruppe war es perfekt! Wir dachten uns, dass wir von der Straße in der Nacht gestört werden aber wenn die Fenster zu waren, hat man nichts gehört. Die Wohnung war groß und sehr gut ausgestattet. Wir kommen gerne nochmal!
Stefanie’s place is a gem. Close to transit, very stylish and comfortable for two couples. Thank you for hosting us!

Great area to stay & visit Berlin.
When we came back friday at 1:00am there was a big party going on in room 17.
In the end we didn’t really hear it in the appartement.
Lot’s of youngsters, it feels like a Hostel, which is fine.
A few times bathrooms were out of toilet paper a few times and the bathrooms I visited didn’t all have shampoo & stuff.
No big deal in the end.
Unfortunately it really was too warm in the cube...although it was only 18 degrees outside, not really comfortable, although the beds were (a bit narrow), but good.
Preperation information/commucation was really great, we did enjoy Berlin from the location.
For the price I would still recommend to youngsters/students and adventurers.
Merijn
Easy to communicate with, perfect location (my favourite) in Prenzlauerberg. Flat is comfortable with great beds and everything you need. Second time I stayed here, will be back next month :-).
Wonderful place to stay in Berlin. Easy to access another places. Beautiful and clean. and kind hosts!
Great room in a great place, communication was brilliant and overall an amazing stay!
El apartamento estaba muy bien, cabría destacar la limpieza y comodidad además de ser un apartamento muy moderno. Lo único es que es pequeño para 5 personas porque las camas están muy pegadas.
Sehr nett, sehr sauber, war alles super!
Tout s'est tres bien passé bon emplacement passation des clefs facile avec la boite a clefs tres propre et agreable

The location of this Airbnb is fantastic, with easy walking access to most attractions and a U-Bahn station right outside. Nearby, you’ll find excellent food and bars, as well as a lovely park. The place is very clean, and Tara was incredibly easy to reach, proactive with check-in instructions, and responsive to messages. I would stay here again when back in Berlin.
Très bon séjour à Berlin, notamment grâce à ce logement qui était idéalement placé, propre, et très fonctionnel.
El piso esta ubicado cerca de todo por lo que resulta muy facil recorrer los sitios de interes. Frank estuvo al pendiente de la llegada y no tuvimos ningun inconveniente en la estadia
cosy flat and friendly host. Good location.  Will come back.

I had a great stay at Katharina's place. Location was perfect to explore the city. Katharina gave a lot of usefull tips and everything you need (and more) was there in the very clean apartment. Communication was good, she arranged everything very well. It is really nice to have a place where you feel at home and can relax. Highly recommended!
The place was as described and as others have mentioned be sure to bring ear plugs for city noise. Nico was responsive and friendly. The location was convenient and I loved the food in the area.

Kleine Einzimmerwohnung mit Küche, Bad und Flur in einem Wohnblock. Daher recht dünne Wände und teils Geräusche der Nachbarn. Lage ist zentral mit Lebensmittelgeschäft, Apotheke und Essensmöglichkeiten in naher Umgebung.

Had a wonderful stay at Kent’s place in Kreuzberg. The location is at the center of attractions, public transit, and great food. Kent was super responsive and helpful. This is one of my best Airbnb stays and hope to visit again!
Thanks for the nice stay and the early check in. We had a great time, lovely neighborhood with plenty of good cafes and restaurants close by. Cozy atmosphere and spacious apartment.

Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt in der zentral gelegenen Unterkunft von Mikel insgesamt positiv erlebt. Unser Interesse galt der Lage und dem authentischen Ambiente. Die Co-Hosts Mikel & Bery waren stets offen im Austausch und bemühten sich um individuelle Lösungen. Zwar gab es kleinere Herausforderungen, jedoch wurden diese in einem fairen Dialog gelöst. Diese Unterkunft ist eine gute Wahl für Gäste, die ein authentisches und etwas unkonventionelles Erlebnis suchen.

Got a bargain deal, good location, clean, felt very safe, great shower.
As others have mentioned, the beds are very creaky/noisy.
They make you pay 10euro deposit for towels and sheets which I found inconvenient, especially when you have already paid for the room.
Tuvo muy buen detalle al tener café en el alojamiento
Wonderful stay
Nous sommes restées en tout 3 semaines chez Helena et franchement c'était comme à la maison. Tout est parfait. Lors de notre prochain séjour à Berlin, c'est clair nous revenons chez Helena.

Peter's place was a self contained spacious apartment attached to hosts residence with a private entry. Its very quiet (ground floor facing internal courtyard), but very close to subway (U Bahn) and eateries/supermarkets . Its a high end property with everything you need - except I had no WIFI for the 5 nights stay. Which, was very inconvenient. I would have given this property 5 stars except for this issue.
But very recommended.

Excellent emplacement, nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Numa Bloc Francfort peu avant Noël. L’hôtel est très propre et très confortable, la kitchenette dans la chambre, la très bonne literie, les attentions aux détails et les lieux communs spacieux, calmes et très bien entretenus rendent l’expérience relaxante. Nous recommandons sans hésiter cet hôtel pour un séjour à Frankfurt !
Lovely flat for a group of friends!

Sven was incredibly responsive before, and during our stay. His place comfortably fit our group of 4. Unfortunately during our stay the washer wasn’t working, but other than that the amenities were great.
His place is situated in close proximity to a train station which is nice, but is close enough that you could walk towards most attractions. We were there for the Marathon and his place is located right on the route which was nice.

very nice and a clean place in a quiet and family-friendly area with a perfect location for first-time Berlin visitors.
highly recommend 👌

Open, accommodating, and kind, Guillaume and Iliana are the type of hosts you dream of. Their thoughtfully designed space is in one of the best neighborhoods of Berlin, home
to the best bars and restaurants. We especially loved the French-inspired restaurant Beuster below the apartment and the coffee shop dots, which is just around the corner. We would stay there again in a heartbeat.

Perfect place to stay if you don’t mind a buss or subway ride. Most things was 10-20 minutes away, either by subway or Uber. Lots to do near by as well. The place was clean, and the interior was cool and old school. Would highly recommend!
Die Unterkunft von Heike & Heinrich war genauso wie beschrieben. Die beiden waren auch super lieb und haben mir bei allen Fragen die ich hatte weitergeholfen.
It was a very comfortable stay and very quiet and private

Sehr schöne Wohnung in zentraler Lage.
Die Gastgeberin unkompliziert und freundlich. Jederzeit wieder. Danke
Sehr nette Familie, die keinen Kontakt scheut, sondern aufgeschlossen den Gesten gegenüber ist. Die Wohnung ist stilvoll eingerichtet. Insgesamt ein authentisches Erlebnis in Berlin.

Great location and very spacious. The host was very flexible when we checked in and in letting us check out late.
The only negatives are that the apartment is a bit rundown and the bathroom is very small
The place is beautiful and in a top location. We used it to work from there, however, and limehome didn’t manage to fix the internet over three days.
Eine wirklich tolle Unterkunft!

Essa foi a segunda vez que me hospedei com a Apart..Tudo tranquilo , só tenho uma solicitação, que seja colocado no Box uma pequena prateleira, ou um suporte onde possamos colocar o shampoo, sabonete, objetos que usamos normalmente no banho.
As demais condições excelentes. Não ha do que reclamar.
Na próxima viagem a Berlin certamente, farei contato.
Obrigada.
Bon rapport qualité prix
Ines's place is so clean and neat that you can stay comfortable!

Pros: Great location! Walking distance to most major attractions and close to public transport. Lots of great restaurants nearby. Apartment was easy to find with clear instructions on how to get in. Communication from the hosts was also clear.
Cons: It would have been great if there were basic condiments in the kitchen such as salt and pepper, cooking oil and ketchup. The blinds were also not ‘blackout blinds’ as described in the listing - the rooms were extremely light through the curtains.

Appartement au top très bien équipé et aménagé avec goût. Un petit cocon! L appartement est dans un quartier calme et agréable : on entend les petits oiseaux! Tramway au bout de la rue qui vous amène directement en plein centre.
Très bon séjour à Berlin . Merci Stéphan pour ton accueil et ton sourire!
Au plaisir

Laut, laut, laut. Einen Stock unter dem kleinen Appartement war eine Party Location. Bass bis 7 Uhr morgens. Ohne Ohropax geht nichts.
Zimmer war abgewohnt. Nicht gut geputzt. Als erstes Flipflops gekauft- da der Boden schmuddelig war. Badezimmer winzig und der Duschvorhang- igitt. Nur nicht anstossen.
Lage aber im Kiez aber cool.
We stayed here for 3 days while visiting Berlin for the weekend and had a great time. The apartment was well equipped, clean, and in a good location.
Nice room, apartment is close to subway so great connection to city centre. Sohail communicated well and quickly
lovely place, great location, quick replies ✨👌🏾
Great location, super friendly host, very responsive! Really enjoyed my stay:)

Die Wohnung ist in einer ruhigen, schönen Nachbarschaft. Nachts ist es zum Schlafen sehr leise. Die Wohnung liegt im obersten Geschoss (mit Fahrstuhl) und ist deshalb sehr schön hell. Es ist alles da was man für einen Aufenthalt braucht. Das Bett war bequem. Adrian war sehr flexibel mit den An- und Abreisezeiten, was wir sehr geschätzt haben. Der persönliche Empfang in der Wohnung durch einen Freund von Adrian hat sehr gut geklappt und war sehr freundlich.
Perfect home base while visiting my daughter nearby.  Lovely, light-filled space in a quiet neighborhood. Sybille was a great host! Thank you!
Great stay and location! Recommend!
clean apartment with lots of space, and really close to a train station + grocery stores
The place was great and clean. I would recommend the appartment.
Good staying in Berlin. My hosts were  helpful during my arrival

This was a fun apartment that I shared with a work colleague. It's very spacious and open-plan. The front two rooms are both bedrooms (also living rooms/dining areas). They are separated by curtains that go across the doorways. You walk through the front two rooms to reach the kitchen, the bathroom, and the WC. As long as you don't mind sharing the space this way, it's a great apartment! We loved that there were basic supplies of all sorts: pantry staples, toiletries, laundry soap, etc. It makes settling in much quicker.
The neighborhood is very quiet with tree-lined streets and lots of restaurants nearby. There is also a big selection of grocery stores very close by on foot (Aldi, Lidl, etc).

I stayed in the 8-bed dorm room for 3 nights and the value for money was great. Perfectly central location, very friendly, laid back atmosphere, a very cool aesthetic, and equipped with everything you may need. I'd recommend it to anyone traveling on a budget. The hostel as a whole was beyond expectation (except for the breakfast, which I was disappointed in and wished I had something to eat in their cafe instead again). Also, don't forget to bring your own lock if you're staying in the shared room.
Sehr ordentlich, ruhig und angenehm
Stanza pulita, posizione comoda per i mezzi pubblici! Claudius risponde velocemente in caso di bisogno!
Sehr schönes und modernes Appartement. Leider etwas wenig Stauraum, besonders im Bad.
Garrelt was a very helpful host. Check-in was super smooth, and his apartment is amazing — very clean and comfortable. I would definitely look for his place again if I return to Berlin!
Great place to stay
Very nice clean appartment with everything you need. Very quiet and calm location.
Der Aufenthalt bei Jules war super. Klare Kommunikation, schöne Gegend und ein super tolles Zimmer. Ich wäre gerne länger geblieben. :)
Everything was as advertised! It was small but lovely for a small group. I would stay there again. Nothing was wrong with the place.

Great place in excellent location, great owner, very glad to met.
Got great rest and comfort conditions, owner gave us best service!
Nice location with very easy access. The surroundings have nice restaurants, bars and playgrounds. The apartment is very comfortable with huge rooms.
Tolle Lage, unkomplizierte, freundliche Kommunikation und die Wohnung ist sauber und sehr gut eingereichtet.

Tia's apartment is fantastic. A truly lovely flat, well equipped with plenty of space within a five minute walk of the U Bahn and right on the river front.
Tia herself was flexible to our check in/out times, and very communicative providing lots of guides and tips.
I would 100% stay here again if coming back to Berlin!
Super Lage, top Wohnung, gerne wieder! 🖤

This was a very comfortable flat in a great location. The wi-if connection was a bit spotty, but otherwise everything was fantastic. My husband and I stayed for four days and couldn't have been happier. It's a great neighborhood with easy access to other parts of the city via public transportation.
Ich war schon zum zweiten Mal da, und komme sicher wieder. Lage ist super, das gesamte Ensemble des Landgutes einmalig. Kommunikation ist problemlos, Einrichtung ist einfach aber sehr geschmackvoll.
War sehr schön! Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Unkompliziert, sauber, idyllisch & ruhig. Man kann dort zum einen super abschalten und kann zum anderen, mit meiner Meinung nach kurzen Fußwegen, sehr gut den ÖPNV Berlins nutzen.
Zudem kommt man auch mit dem Auto von dort aus schnell ins Zentrum von Berlin.
Alles in allem, war der Aufenthalt einfach top!

Robert is a great host; highly knowledgable about the city and very willing to help with any questions or queries we had prior to and during our stay. He also gave us some great recommendations for places to eat, drink and visit. The apartment is beautiful, very clean, stylish and spacious. Thank you Robert for a great stay!
Zeer prettig appartement op de begane grond op een prima locatie

L'auberge est sympa et bien placée. Propre et bien équipée. Malheureusement selon sur qui vous tombez dans votre chambre cela peut tout changer.. pour moi mauvaise expérience.. avec des jeunes irrespectueux.

Thank you, Simon. We absolutely loved our stay in your apartment and your hospitality. This was by far the best Airbnb experience in Berlin and we will definitely book again. An extra plus for the washing machine and dryer and that everything was so spotless.
Wir haben uns bei Helena sehr wohl gefühlt. Alle Angaben waren so wie vorbeschieben und die Wohnung hat uns gut gefallen. Sehr zu empfehlen, wir kommen gerne wieder.
Unkomplizierter Check-In und großzügige Appartements, kann man machen!

We had a great stay at Madlen's place. The house was clean and the location was great. We never actually met her, although a couple of time we heard that the TV was on in her room. Anyway, she was responsive via message and flexible about check in and check out.

Nossa experiência de hospedagem com Ben e Simon foi simplesmente excelente! Desde o primeiro contato, fomos recebidos com muita cordialidade e atenção. O espaço é encantador, de muito bom gosto e extremamente confortável. A localização nos surpreendeu positivamente, tornando nossa estadia ainda mais especial. Cada detalhe foi pensado para proporcionar uma experiência agradável, e saímos felizes e gratos por essa vivência. Mal podemos esperar para voltar!

Christiane’s apartment is just wonderful and the best place I have stayed in Berlin. The apartment is large, well equipped with cooking utensils, dishwasher and washing machine. and very stylish. The lounge area is lovely  and looks out onto a quiet leafy street. The bedroom is large and very quiet. It’s away from the main tourist areas, so you get the feel of “real” Berlin. However it is right next to a bus stop with easy access to Tegel, and after a short walk to U-Blissestrabe you can be at Wittenberg in less than 10 minutes. Supermarket just around the corner as well as plenty of restaurants. Great sports facilities nearby, skate track, swimming pool and athletics track. Christiane was very prompt and helpful replying to messages, and check in was easy and well organised. Highly recommended.

Die Unterkunft ist super sauber, schön eingerichtet und man fühlt sich direkt wohl. Ursula ist eine tolle Gastgeberin, die sich um ihre Gäste kümmert. Von der Unterkunft braucht man zwar etwas länger nach Berlin Mitte (ca. 40 min) jedoch, sind die Anbindungen echt gut. :)
Nice stay, helpful host!
Nice place. Great location
Absolut empfehlenswerte Unterkunft und der Gastgeber ist Top! Tolle Lage und sehr unkomplizierte Organisation, netter Kontakt. Besser geht nicht!

Thanks for a great stay in your lovely home. It was exactly as advertised - exciting neighbourhood with great places to eat, supermarket and art gallery right nearby. Walks to the local parks. Comfortable and clean - recommended.
war alles super!

Ulf hat eine ruhig gelegene Unterkunft in Berlin Mitte. Man erreicht die Unterkunft sehr bequem vom Hauptbahnhof.
Ulf ist ein sehr angenehmer Host, bei dem man sich wohl fühlt.
Danke für die Gastlichkeit.
Sehr empfehlenswert.

Ich war das erste mal in einem Hostel und war sehr zufrieden. Die Mitarbeiter waren sehr freundlich und es gab immer einen Ansprechpartner. Das Zimmer war sehr sauber und man hatte ausreichend Unterstellmöglichkeiten für sein Gepäck. Immer wieder gerne :)
8 nuits sans histoire. Discrétion. Egards. Et le hasard de quelques discussions mémorables

The check-in staff were very responsive and helpful, the rooms were clean and spacious, the only thing was the creaky beds, but everything else was great! Totally recommend if you're coming to Berlin for multiple nights and want to make new friends!
Great stay!

Zimmer war schön groß und gemütlich, alles war sauber und die Reservierung ging super schnell. Die Lage ist top und die nächste U-Bahn Station ist direkt um die Ecke. Werde meinen nächsten Trip aufjedenfall wieder dort verbringen.
Schicke Wohnung, schick und sehr zweckmäßig eingerichtet, sehr sauber, eine sehr freundliche Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber. Besser geht es nicht.

We really enjoyed our stay with Mike, the room was exactly as described and was immaculate. The check in instructions were simple and perfectly explained. We had a request and Mike helped us within 5 minutes and got us what we needed. We would 100% recommend staying here and if we come back to Berlin we would like to stay here again.

The Juttas place is magic, in a beautiful place with green surrounding, the terrace outside the house is great for have the breakfast. the Underground is very near and it brings you to the center, also we could park the car without a problem, I recommend it
Adrian's aparment is beautiful and spacious, with a great balcony and cosy atmosphere. Super location. Communication with Adrian was easy. Highly recommended!
Great stay - great location close to U-Bahn. Nice and friendly host!

Very practical flat, ideally situated with great view. Tram and shops less than 2 minutes away and alexanderplatz only 15 minute walk away. Excellent place if you want to visit berlin city centre and surroundings. Great communication as well and over all excellent experience!
Alles prima!
Très bonne hôtel

Got the place last minute because of a cancellation and we're really pleasantly surprised. This room is nice, clean, and has everything you need. They were super friendly, and it was easy to get in. It's in a very touristy area but this room is in the courtyard and is really quiet, you even hear birds in the morning. Near everything. All in all an amazing deal, and easiest check in ever. Would stay again!

It was a pleasure to stay at Michaels. We were 5 people, and we had plenty of space. The apartment seems bigger in real life.
Michael was a great host, he welcomed us in the apartment even though we arrived past midnight, and he kindly told us everything worth knowing.
The area is close to the underground (5 min) and there is a lot of caffe's and kiosks around.
Michael and the apartment in Kreuzberg have my warmest recommendations!
Die Unterkunft von Frau Neumann ist super, man hat alles was man braucht! Die Kommunikation war auch reibungslos. Ich würde wieder dort übernachten 😊

Wir wurden von Ivo und Ramona total herzlich empfangenen und sie waren für Fragen und Tipps stets offen. Schönes, sehr sauberes und ruhiges Zimmer. Der separate Eingang ist wirklich ein Highlight. In der Umgebung findet man, was das Herz begehrt. Von tollen Restaurants, Cafés und Bars bis Flohmarkt wirklich alles... Wir kommen gerne wieder. Vielen lieben Dank!

Very good stay at Calvinstrasse.  Our hosts are realy concerned by our well-being and respond quickly to our questions. The place,  near Tiergarten and the central station is well situated. The flat is wide enough for 2 or 3 persons.   I will recommend it warmly. I will come back.
Excellent location in a quiet neighborhood and close to the metro. We had easy access to the entire city of Berlin and very much enjoyed our stay in Marie-Christine’s apartment!

La vivienda está muy céntrica y bien ubicada. Hay restaurantes, comercios, y tiendas al lado. En el mismo barrio puedes encontrar sitios muy interesantes que ver, como la Iglesia que está justo detrás de la casa. Si viajas con niños tienes varios parques cerca, pero te recomiendo el que está en la plaza de la Torre del Agua. Nos atendió Dieter, de parte de Ramfis y fue muy cortés en todo momento. Nos estuvo enseñando el mapa y cosas interesantes que ver en la ciudad. Recomiendo totalmente este alojamiento.

The room is located in a nice neighbourhood. Lidl 2 min walk. I used a bicycle to get to the centre. It's not far away, because you will enjoy you ride😁
In the room you have your private shower and toilets which makes the stay comfy.
The mattress is legendary. You will have the best night there!
So I can highly recommend this room!

This place is big!! We stayed here as a family of 7 (5 small children) and they loved this space. Toys for them to play with and lots of space to explore. Really wonderful location. Easy access to bus and metro, playground and market right out the front door. would absolutely stay here again.
Trotz kurzer "Turbulenzen " war der Aufenthalt super und die Kommunikation mit Joascha sehr gut.

Rudi est un hôte discret, très sympathique avec qui nous avons apprécié discuté. L’appartement est fidèle aux photos et est le reflet de son hôte, très chaleureux et rempli d’histoire. L’appartement est à 2mn d’un train qui dessert très rapidement le centre de Berlin ainsi que des bus déposant quasiment au pied du logement. Un logement légèrement excentré mais qui dessert très bien la globalité de Berlin.

We had the best mini trip ever, Berlin truly rocks! And the apartment was even better than expected, nothing to complain about. We felt like true berliner, when living in the middle of everything cool! The neighbourhood was perfect and Britta's tips were very useful. We will surely come back soon, already missing Berlin!

very nice location where just 10min walking checkpoint and museum.
room and toilet, bathroom is very clean so no stress.
she help you as soon as possible if something problem!

When I arrived I received a warm welcome: coffee with a good conversation at the kitchen table.
The location is great, the apartment is chill, exactly as I expected, very chill Berlin vibes, and basically you get the apartment for yourself at night 👌🏻
Alexander is a great host, very responsive with text messages when you need it. And overal a kind person.
Definitely would recommend!
Very nice and clean apartment

Eine Top Lage, direkt in der Nähe vom Potsdamer Platz. Die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel sind auch in unmittelbarer Nähe, so dass man problemlos überall hin kann. Die Unterkunft ist sehr sauber und man ist ungestört von Lärm etc. Der Gastgeber ist immer zu erreichen.
Wonderful space, everything you need. Exactly as pictures. Caren is a great host. I will book her listing again in future.
이 가격에 이정도 되는 숙소 흔치 않을거 같네요 일행이 3명이라면 강추합니다
Beautiful, clean and pleasant apartment. A great base for visiting Berlin. Highly recommended !
Great flat, central location, helpful host
Very clean place, comfortable. Easy train access to downtown.

Wir waren zwar nur eine Nacht bei euch, aber ganz ganz hoffentlich nicht zum letzten Mal. Zu einem wirklich schmalen Taler bekommt man hier nun wirklich alles geboten, was man sich von einem AirBNB nur wünschen kann.
Das Haus selber liegt sehr ruhig und abgeschieden in dennoch unmittelbarer Nähe zur S-Bahn.
Man wird sofort überrascht, davon, dass man tatsächlich eine ganze Etage für sich hat. Inklusive Wintergarten für die gemütliche Tasse Tee am morgen.
Wer Reisgepäck sparen will, freut sich über Handtücher, Dusch- und Zähneputzequipment, zusätzliche Decken und mehr.
Wer gern bei offenem Fenster schläft, wird sich außerdem unter dem Schrägdach und der wirklich beeindruckenden Ruhe sehr wohl fühlen.
Grade für längere BerlinAufenthalte eine dringende Empfehlung. Wir denken, dass man hier jeden Abend gerne nach dem Großstadtabenteuer zur Ruhe kommt.
Lg Julia und Lucas
We had a great stay here. Very clean, comfortable, great city views, great location. Two thumbs up!

U-Bahn ganz in der Nähe
