Ruhige und freundliche Gegend

Интересный, стильный дизайн квартиры. Много спальных мест- может поместиться 7-8 человек. Нас было 5 человек. Кровати, одеяла, подушки были удобными.
Довольно легко добираться до центра города.
Из минусов-было немного пыльно, бокалы были со следами использования.
Несмотря на это, вернулись бы в эти апартаменты.
Netter Kontakt, freundliche Gastgeberin, Wohnung soweit sauber, leider an vielen Stellen Reparaturen notwendig, daher nur 3 Sterne.
The apartment was great. Beautiful, great natural light, awesome views.

Michael ist ein sehr freundlicher und aufgeschlossener Gastgeber, der sich sehr bemüht, seinen Gästen einen schönen & angenehmen Aufenthalt zu ermöglichen. Wir waren vor und während unserer Reise in sehr netten Kontakt und können einen Aufenthalt in Michaels Unterkunft nur nachdrücklich empfehlen. Vielen Dank und alles Gute!

Juste parfait ! Au vu du mauvais temps et de la raison du voyage, j'ai beaucoup profité du logement de Lennard. Appartement ultra-lumineux, spacieux, calme. Petit regret de ne pas avoir pu profiter du petit balcon avec canapé à cause du temps pluvieux. Le système Alexa m'a séduite ;-)). Bref, un excellent séjour. Merci !

Aglaja and her husband Ronald were fantastic hosts. Ronald was there to welcome us into their beautiful apartment. He provided us with lots of information on what to do and where to eat close by. The apartment itself is great. Spacious rooms, very clean and the art is beautiful.  Location was also great - only 10 minute walk to the restaurants and bars. Would definitely recommend Aglajas apartment if you are travelling to Berlin!!
Nice place in a top location. Valeska was a very responsive and nice host. I recommend it! :)

Mario’s place was fantastic and he was a great host.  The place was perfect and we felt so at home there.  Mario was a kind and considerate host always willing to help and even left us champagne.  The area was very walkable and there were so many great restaurants close by and public transit was also very accessible.  We will definitely be back next time we are in Berlin!!
The apartment was exactly as advertised, and it has plenty of amenities. The location is very good,  and Thomas was extremely responsive to any questions I had. Definitely recommend it.
Schöne Unterkunft am Heidelberger Platz. Gute Ausstattung. Nahe U- und S-Bahn.

Jan’s place was exactly as described spotlessly clean and situated and a lovely well planted courtyard, location is within a 2-3 minutes walk from the underground and great restaurants on your door step - I liked the information booklet Jan had left in the room I checked out a few of the eating places and all first glass . Jan’s place  is also walking distance from places such as the Jewish museum and also CheckPoint Charlie . Berlin is a great cool city - I’m planning on coming back next year with my wife and will definitely be checking the availability on Jan’s place first, perfect spot for a couple or solo
Bez problému! Ubytko v super lokalitě, a i když je sdílené, všichni mají své soukromí:)
A very smooth stay - nice room and great with the private entrance and your own bathroom (except shower), plus the neighborhood is very cozy with many restaurants and cafees.

Super für einen Kurztripp! Das Hotel ist auf dem neusten Stand der Technik und modern eingerichtet. Die Badewanne im Zimmer und der Balkon machen es perfekt! Der Potsdamerplatz ist in 5 min mit dem Bus zu erreichen und die Haltestelle direkt vor der Tür. Ich komme gerne wieder!

I stayed in the Studio near Kastanienalle for 5 weeks and absolutely recommend it. I felt at home from day one. The apartment is beautifully decorated with modern design furniture (just like you can see in the photos). It is fully equipped with a small fridge, oven, electric kettle, toaster (no microwave), wifi, cable TV, etc. The place is super clean and the bed is large and comfortable. The bathroom includes a washing machine (very convenient for long stays). The only thing to keep in mind if you have mobility problems is that it's located on the third floor and there's no elevator in the building (like in most buildings in Berlin). It is also very quiet, one can't here anything when the windows are shut.
It's located in the neighborhood of Prenzlauer Berg, which is very hip and has plenty of restaurants, shops and cafes. The apartment is just 5 minutes away from the U-Bahn stations of Rosenthaler Platz (U8) and Senefelderplatz (U2) and 3 minutes from trams M1 and 12.

Arne was very responsive when I had some health issues on my flight getting to Germany.  He gave me helpful advice about how to get around Berlin and the neighborhood.  Although I visited in the depth of Berlin Winter I found the balconies very useable and enjoyed them and the apartment immensely.
체크인을 정해진 시간보다 빨리 해주셔서 여행 시간을 더 많이 확보할 수 있었어요. 관광지보다는 떨어져 있었지만. 지하철 및 교통이 편리했기 때문에 불편함이 없었습니다.

Sehr schöne, geräumige Wohnung in einem Hinterhof. Kein Straßenlärm, dafür allerdings Nachbarn im Stock darüber, die scheinbar ab 23 uhr erst so richtig wach werden 🙈 Ohropax-Alarm! Unsere  2jährige Tochter hat das allerdings nicht gestört. Tolle, tolle Lage mit kleinem Kind, direkt ggü. ein schöner Spielplatz mit Café und schönen Einkaufs und Restaurantmöglichkeiten, TOP!!! Wohnung ist toll ausgestattet, vor allem das Bad, mit tiefer Badewanne, einem Spiegelschrank voll mit allerlei Kosmetik und sogar Kerzen an der Wanne. Sehr süß 😊 jederzeit wieder!!

Pascal was a great guy. The apartment is well located, easy to find and check in was really smooth. Althought, sleeping were not a really good experience, pillows and bed need to be updated. Rest was good! Value for money! Recommended
Frank’s place is a great: location superbe, very clean and modern
Confermo le recensioni degli altri utenti. Tanja host top.
Sehr angenehme Person; hat mir viel Tips gegeben; sehr erreichbar; Super tolle Erfahrung; Jedem zu empfehlen!
Sehr gute Lage und Ausgangspunkt für Sightseeing. Sehr ruhig. Gute kostenlose Parkmöglichkeit
Super Wohnung für einen Wochenendtrip. Problemlose Kommunikation, sehr freundlich und schnell.
Alles war super!

Albert’s apartment was perfect! He took the time to make sure we had everything we would need or want. It was bright, clean, modern, all the amenities anyone would need and more....coffee, tea, juice, cream for coffee! Shampoo, other toiletries. Albert was spot on!
The beds were comfy. The air conditioning was amazing. Wi-Fi was fast. He was quick to respond to any question. And if there is anything you need to know about Berlin, he has the answer! The area was nice, and lots of little restaurants and grocery stores in the vicinity. There is a laundromat two doors down and a dry cleaners across the street if needed but the washing machine in the apartment was perfect! Busses and trains were very convenient to the location and there was lots of history in the area too. We felt very safe in the building and in the area! I would definitely stay here again and I would recommend this place in a heartbeat! Thank you for a wonderful stay Albert!
Great location. Very nice apt. and awesome and proactive communication from Hannah. Was a great experience.
very nice and welcoming people. I stayed there one night and breakfast was included. they had also taken into consideration that im on a plant based diet.
Tolle Wohnung 👍🏻
Mooi en rustig gelegen appartement op een hippe locatie met veel restaurants in de buurt.

Excellent location and seamless check-in! Don’t let the lack of reviews sway you from this stay.
Thanks!
Logement très agréable, propre et bien rangé. Proche des arrêts de bus et du métro. Facile d'accès.

Kerem's place was perfect for we exploring the parts of Berlin I was most interested in. It's near the heart of Friedrichshain, close to tons of restaurants and nightlife, and minutes' walk away from multiple transit options. The place was tidy and had everything you'd need for a short stay. The room was impressively large and bright with natural light. Thank you, Kerem!
Wir hatten eine schöne Zeit in der sehr geräumigen Wohnung, wo man abends mit dem Blick auf die Spree gut entspannen konnte.
Отличная квартира, в отличном районе!
Great location near public transportation. the outside of the place was covered in graffiti which was concerning at first but the inside was lovely and the neighborhood was great!
Perfect staying, I strongly recommend it! And Alexander is a very nice host :)

Parwana was incredibly helpful, whenever I needed help or had any questions she would be there, and she was always very detailed when describing the procedures of checking in, checking out, getting from the airport etc, etc...
The room itself was nicely designed, perfectly clean, with lots of space, and the building itself was very beautiful.
I would recommend the room to anyone who wants to stay in a good location on a small budget.

Es war wirklich super bei Amine. Er ist ein sehr aufgeschlossener Mensch, ganz flexibel, und kommuniziert klar mit uns. Ich werde hier unbedingt wieder kommon und buchen. Der beste Air BnB in Berlin. Er hat mit uns wie Freundu geredetet, und ich habe mich nie bevor so sicher in einen Air BnB gefühlt. Ich würde sagen, dass Amine einen neuen Freund von mir ist.
Great host, clean, spacious appartment, great location. Would definitely consider to stay here again!

This was 100% the best AirBnB experience I ever had. The apt was very modern, perfectly clean, spacious with lots of windows. The apt is near major bus lines and subways making it super easy to get around the city. Many cute eateries nearby to grab a bite and people watch.

Martin was an amazing host, he helped me with all my transportation needs and was even kind enough to pick me up from the train station when I arrived from Amsterdam. It was my first time in Berlin but surly won't be my last. Martin helped me book a few tours and guided to see some of the best areas and landmarks in this beautiful city. When I mentioned I liked drinking tea, he had 3 sorts waiting for me in the kitchen the next morning. He is a wonderful host and anyone that books with him will be surly have an excellent experience. I have already recommended this space to my friends in NYC and personally I can't wait to get back. Thank you for everything, Martin!
I had a wonderful stay, the place is nice and clean, location is peaceful and easily accessible and the hosts are very helpful and always nice. Would recommend 👍

Lust auf Bilderbuchberlin? Mitten in Kreuzberg!
Schöner Altbau in lokalem Stil ausgestattet ... sehr gemütlich und sehr zentral ohne laut zu sein. Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter absolut problemlos.
Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Alles wie beschrieben, sauber ordentlich und zuverlässig! Gerne Wieder!!

Really nice, clean and spacious apartment. A cosy neigbourhood, easy to reach public transport to the centre of Berlin.
Vanni is kind and helpful we will definitely recommend this place.
Schöne ruhige Lage. Parkplatz hinter dem Haus ist perfekt. Schnelle Reaktion bei Rückfragen.
Jessy had a beautiful apartment in a great location in Berlin. It was very thoughtfully set up with everything you could need or want for a short stay. Would definitely recommend!

Voor ons jaarlijkse trip naar Berlijn wilden we vlakbij onze vrienden verblijven en dat was mogelijk door bij dit appartement te verblijven. Het appartement zit aan een rustige binnenplaats, zo hoor je de vogels fluiten wat heel fijn was. Fijne keuken, badkamer en slaapkamer. Alleen jammer van de vloer. De vloer bestaat alleen uit planken waar je de spijkers nog van inziet. Niet heel handig met een kindje erbij. Hierdoor kraakt het veel in huis. Verder hadden we een prima verblijf!

Het is allemaal wat gedateerd (meubilair, serviesgoed, gordijnen) en niet helemaal schoon, dat is jammer.
De ruimte is namelijk prima voor 2 personen, aan een rustige straat terwijl het ov en de drukte allemaal op loopafstand is. locatie vonden we heel goed.

Ich war mit mir einschließlich insgesamt 4 Personen in der Unterkunft + Hund und jeder hatte ausreichend Platz zum schlafen. Du hast alles was du brauchst in der Unterkunft, sei es Fernseher, Küche oder Dusche. Leider war das Sofa sehr dreckig, so dass niemand darauf saß und der Boden war in vielen Bereichen (nicht nur die Ecken) zum Teil sehr staubig. Im Großen und Ganzen überwiegen die positiven Sachen. Und wir haben uns dennoch in den Betten SEHR WOHL gefühlt.

A beautiful apartment high above the city, great terrace looking over the courtyard for a evening glass of wine. Accessible to all transport links to the centre of Berlin yet felt like a friendly neighbourhood. The many stairs to the apartment good training for walking around Berlin. Really safe parking spot beneath the building too. Simon both helpful and communicative as well as a lover of contemporary style. Definitely recommend on all levels.

Sehr schönes Aparment mit Liebe zum Detail.
Bei kleineren Problemen ist der Gastgeber sofort zur Stelle, also Top Service.
Wohnung in einer super Lage mit vielen Cafés um die Ecke. Auf der kleinen Dachterrasse hat man einen schönen Überblick über Berlin. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

We loved this spacious apartment perfectly situated for doing sightseeing in historical Berlin. The trees around the balcony made us feel close to nature even being in a big European city. I will recommend this apartment to families going to Berlin

Vincent is a wonderful and caring host. The room and the whole apartment is bright, spacious, airy and exactly as seen in the photos. Beautifully decorated and impeccably clean. The location in the neighborhood is perfect -- close to the metro/subway stop and yet very quiet, with a few nice restaurants and cafes nearby. I can highly recommend staying with Vincent and would come back any time.

Vincent ist ein wunderbarer Gastgeber, das Zimmer und die Wohnung sind groß, hell, luftig und sehr sauber, genau wie auf den Fotos. Tolle Lage mit super Nahverkehrsanbindung. Sehr zu empfehlen und ich würde jederzeit wieder kommen!

This space is excellent. It is lighter and more spacious than the photos convey. The bed is comfortable, the kitchen has everything you need, and the location is incredible for enjoying restaurants and bars. Also close to a laundromat and multiple grocery stores, if you are looking for a more at home stay.

Our stay at Tina's Artists's apartment in Friedrichshein could not have been a better start to our holiday. The apartment is located a short walk from all forms of public transport and situated in a neighbourhood filled with good, inexpensive restaurants, bakeries, bottleshops and a few bars/clubs. The apartment is on the second floor in a gorgeous block which is a lovely and quiet place to relax or catch up on some zzzs after a hard day's walking.

The apartment itself is truly a unique place with Tina's artistic touch evident in everything from the walls to the furniture. We had all the comforts of home (big bed, beautiful shower, washing machine, wifi etc). Tina has put together an extensive book which lists things to do, places to eat and a few tips which we found extremely useful.

The apartment manager (Marcus) met us on our arrival and was also extremely helpful with his suggestions for the area.

This was our first ever Airbnb experience and we are officially converts! We would highly recommend Tina's place to anyone looking for a truly unique stay in Berlin. You won't be disappointed.
First visit to Berlin,  with the help of my niece I found the location ideal for my stay.  I would like to stay in the same place when I come again.
Eine tolle Wohnung, sehr groß und mit schönem Boden. Die Einrichtung ist gelungen, clean im Stil und doch sehr gemütlich. Komme gerne wieder.

Sehr sauberes Appartement, gute Lage, abgestimmtes Einrichtungskonzept und unkomplizierte Abwicklung.
Gerne wieder!

I've stayed at a lot of airbnbs and this is one of the nicest ones. If you are in Berlin this is a fantastic option. Right next to Kreuzberg but in a quiet courtyard so you'll sleep well as well. Having a large balcony and 2 bathrooms is a bonus.

Die Lage der Unterkunft ist super! Der Bergmannkiez mit seinen Restaurants und Bars ist eine tolle Umgebung, um sich gleich wohl zu fühlen! Es war schon etwas Besonderes, direkt dort wohnen zu können. :-)

Berlin Mon Amour! is a great option if you want to visit Berlin either for a short period or for a longer one, which was my case. Very well located, 5 minutes walk to a metro stop and a bus stop. Good restaurants and supermarkets in the area. The apartment is clean, well-equipped, and has everything you might need to have a really pleasant stay. And last but not least (and the best of all) Francesco and Elisa are very helpful and gentle and respectful, and you do get a lot of privacy but also the chance to knock at their door in any case. A great place to saty.
Good place and good location for the cost
Friendly, honest, caring host!
Zweckmäßig, gemütliches Bett, sauberes Bad :-)
Beautiful space and amazing location
Thank you! We had a great time

Ein tolles Haus mit einem traumhaften Garten! Wir haben uns sofort wohl gefühlt. Petra hatte überall Zettel hingelegt, sodass wir uns gut zurecht gefunden haben. Nach Berlin rein mit Öffis hat gut geklappt und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind auch in der Nähe. Wir hatten ein rundum gelungenes 3 Generationen-Wochenende.

Die Unterkunft war wie beschrieben und sehr gut erreichbar. Die Kommunikation mit Claudius verlief schnell und unkompliziert, er war jederzeit gut erreichbar. Leider war die Sauberkeit nicht ganz zufriedenstellend (Haare und ein etwas schmutziger Boden, sodass man schnell schwarze Fußsohlen bekam). Abgesehen davon war das Zimmer so wie angegeben und für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in Ordnung.
The app. is ok for couple days if you  are on vacation. Very close to metro. Wi fi is very week.
Good place!

Tolle Unterkunft für einen Kurztrip nach Berlin. Wunderbare Lage im Grünen mit Parkmöglichkeiten vor der Tür. Restaurants, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und ÖPNV ist trotzdem in wenigen Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar. Katharina ist außerdem super lieb, eine tolle Gastgeberin! :)
Great apartment in Berlin, near public transportation, nice neighborhood with good restaurant in the area. Selçuk is without a doubt the best host you could have in Berlin!
Très bel appartement. Très agréable, Très propre. Très bien situé.

Alles super, danke!
Immer wieder gerne.
Es war ein sehr entspannter Aufenthalt. unkompliziert, gemütlich und sauber.  nur zu empfehlen

Gerhard is an excellent host who is most concerned about his guests' comforts. He went to great lengths to ensure we enjoyed our stay, communicating regularly through WhatsApp. He offered tips on local amenities and advised us about the use of public transport. The apartment was clean and warm and provided a comfortable place to stay. We had access to WiFi and TV and radio. The cooking facilities were fine for our needs. We would recommend Gerhard as a host and the location has easy access to the city by bus and train.
great location

A great little ground floor apartment. Well located a few minutes walk from U-Bahn, S-Bahn, Tram and Bus stops. Walk for three minutes to see the Berlin Wall Documentation centre and a section of the wall still standing. Only a few U-Bahn stops to Checkpoint Charlie from where you can walk to the “Topography of Terror” exhibition, Potsdamer Platz, Brandenburg Gate and Bunestag. If you plan to visit the glass dome of the Reichstag building, make sure you register for the visit well in advance. Also only few stops to Alexander Platz and the tower, but we found it better to walk as there is much to see along the way.
The apartment consists of one room with Kitchen, living, dining and queen bed, but it is a large space and we didn’t feel cramped at all. The sofa converts to a double bed if you need it. (We didn’t)
Hans and Ute were great communicators and their advice and instructions were precise and accurate. We were lucky and allowed to move in early. Checking in was straightforward and easy.
We had a fine time and would definitely return.

Très bon séjour , bien situé par rapport au centre de Berlin et l east side gallery. Par contre , Je suis arrivée le soir et le quartier n etait pas très rassurant , quelques dealers sous le pont menant à l hôtel ..
Chambre et parties communes parfaites .

A beautiful apartment in a fantastic location - with lots of lovely place to eat/drink just around the corner. Wi-Fi is available which is really handy and the kitchen is fully equipped. The hosts were really quick at responding and made the whole experience very easy. I would stay here again and was really impressed. Can't wait to come back to Berlin.
War wirklich sehr klein und die küchenausstattung war leider nicht ganz wie beschrieben- es gab nocht genug Teller und Besteck und nur 1 Topf. Bei 3 vermieteten Zimmern sehr dürftig.
Love the little apartments, very good location

Hosts were very helpful and friendly!
Privacy was a little of an issue given the nature of the apartment. Room was Very Hot! No AC.
There are grocery stores and trains just a few mins walking. Can easily access other parts of the city.
Overall a good stay

wir waren zwei Nächte zum Halbmarathon Berlin da. die Unterkunft ist super zentral (fußläufig 15 min vom Hauptbahnhof entfernt.) sehr ruhige Wohnung. alles da , Küche gut ausgestattet. zu empfehlen! 👍
Good overall
Die Unterkunft war geräumig und es hat einem an nichts gefehlt. Wenn ich wieder in Berlin bin werde ich auf diese Unterkunft auf jeden Fall zurückgreifen.
Eine Wohnung um sich in der Fremde zuhause zu fühlen. Und sie liegt in einem familiären Wohnquartier und doch nicht weit weg von der Stadt-einfach genial

The appartment we stayed in was beautiful and spacious.  It had all the mod cons you rwequired. Both Stephan and his mother were very welcoming. There was a small issue which was resolved immediately.  The only small criticism is that the wi-fi was not great. But that said we would return to the apartment in a heartbeat.
Muy cercano a Messe Berlín, fui caminando.  Muy limpio y tranquilo.  Muy cerca de comercios y parada del metro

Toller Service, sehr freundliches Team! Die Lobby sieht auch sehr schön aus und alles war sehr sauber und hat funktioniert. Kleines Manko, unsere Fenster waren kaputt (ließen sich nicht richtig schließen), aber im warmen Sommer störte es nicht. Gerne wieder!
Zentrale Wohnung mit schöner Einrichtung

Absolut schöne sweete Wohnung, die alles hat, was man braucht. Helle Zimmer, voll ausgestattete Küche, einen Schreibtisch (für uns wichtig zum Arbeiten), Sessel zum Chillen und eine sehr gute Matratze :-) Und der Garten ist natürlich spitze, leider wars Winter, aber im Frühjahr und Sommer sicher ein Highlight. Die Lage ist sehr ruhig, und die Anbindung zu den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln gut und unproblematisch. Jana, die Gastgeberin, ist super sympathisch und sehr zuvorkommend. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Had a wonderful stay here over Christmas! Good location in very close proximity to public transportation, grocery stores, small restaurants, cafes, and a shopping mall - all within a minute’s walk. Flat was spacious, immaculate, and very stylish. Loved the decor, even better than the pictures :) My family was very impressed! There were 9 of us. Having 2 small children, the space felt clean, safe, and came stocked with a crib, high chair, stroller and toys - very thoughtful touches. We used the kitchen to prepare Christmas dinner and found this to be a wonderful place to have holidays away from home. Plenty of linens and towels, dishes and a fully stocked kitchen. Of note, there are 4 keys to contend with (with several spares provided - which was great for multiple guests with different agendas) and several flights of stairs. Though both the kids and elderly grandparents who accompanied us seemed to manage just fine! Recommend for large groups and families, for sure! You’re in for a treat.

I absolutely loved my stay at Natalie's apartment. The location is perfect, close to the canal and great cafes in the most charming corner of Kreuzberg. Natalie is an excellent host, very responsive and easygoing. The apartment was full of thoughtful touches, like fresh flowers when I arrived and even a complimentary pastry. Natalie has mastered the art of good lighting, a rare gift in the world of harsh overheads! I found the apartment had such a wonderful vibe, I just never wanted to leave. I cannot recommend this place enough. I can't wait to return on my next visit to Berlin.

I really enjoyed my stay at Laura´s. Laura was very friendly and made me feel right at home. Everything was very clean and well organized. Laura was super attentive and was always available if I had a question. The room is very spacious and comfortable. The apartment is in the courtyard. I particularly enjoyed the balcony and the calm atmosphere at Laura´s place which was perfect for winding down after a long day out.
Foi maravilhosa. Os hosts são super hipertenso mega queridos e simpáticos! A vizinhança é muito verde e bonita. Passamos dias incríveis em Berlin. O local é bem residencial e tinha mercados próximos!
Alles wie beschrieben, sauberes Zimmer und die Familie war sehr nett.

Fantastic apartment location wise with a great restaurant next to it and breakfast place opposite on the street outside. Good space and very clean with a good shower. Only issue was noise outside and it was too hot (couldn’t turn the heating down anymore), very minor issues though.

Birgit es la mejor anfitriona que hemos tenido en nuestro viaje. Nos recibió fuera de hora y además con comida! También nos asistió con indicaciones y consejos. Y nos despidió con regalos. excelente anfitriona
Alles sehr gut, gerne wieder.
Schlaf und Badezimmer waren sauber, Brigitte ist unkompliziert.  Immer wieder gerne
Awesome and very cute, cosy apartment in the Schillerkiez. Bea is an amazing host and made us feel at home from the first moment. 120% recommendable!!
Efficient and great location in ku dam
Alles war so sauber!!! der Gastgeber sehr nett. Gute Lage et ruhiges Zimmer.  ich war wirklich damit sehr zufrieden.
Good stay, had everything we needed and in a good location
Alles ist gut. Großartig für einen kurzen Aufenthalt bei einem Besuch in Berlin

Just wrapped up an awesome stay at this Airbnb in Turmstraße, Berlin, and it was absolutely top-notch! The place was super clean and had a really cool, laid-back vibe that made me feel right at home from the get-go.
The location is spot-on. Turmstraße is buzzing with life, full of great cafes, shops, and restaurants. Plus, getting around Berlin was a breeze with public transport just a stone’s throw away.
The host was a legend – super friendly and always quick to help out with any questions. They gave me some killer recommendations for local spots, which made my trip even better.
The apartment had everything I needed. The kitchen was fully decked out, perfect for whipping up a meal or two. The bed was comfy as, and I loved chilling in the cozy living room after a day of exploring.
All in all, I had a ripper time staying here and would definitely recommend it to anyone heading to Berlin. Can’t wait to come back on my next trip!

Es una de las mejores experiencia que he tenido con Airbnb. Alexandros es una persona maravillosa, siempre atenta a cualquier inquietud desde el mismo momento en que realice la reserva. Siempre respondió con celeridad a mis inquietudes y me dio todas las indicaciones posibles para llegar de la manera mas fácil a su casa.
La ubicación de la casa es perfecta, muy cerca a una linea de metro y con un sin fin de posibilidades gastronómicas y de diversión cerca a la casa. Estando allí, uno se puede desplazar a cualquier lugar de Berlin en pocos minutos, lo que hace que la estadía sea mas placentera.
Alex, siempre estuvo muy pendiente de mi, era como llegar a casa y encontrar un amigo para hablar de las experiencias del día y sus tips siempre fueron los mejores. Me ofreció toda su casa como si fuera mía y hasta me brindo de su comida una vez que ya la tenia preparada.
Recomiendo a Alex 100% y a su casa.
Definitivamente una experiencia maravillosa, allí volveré.
Gracias por todo Alex

If you are looking for a very comfortable stay in Friedrichshain, look no further. It will be your oasis in chaotic Berlin.
The host is very accommodating and hospitable. He will give you loads of tips on what to do in the neighborhood and share a beer or two.
Your room is spacious and very homy. You're very welcome to use the rest of the house as well. Your own personal bathroom is beautiful and spotless (just like the rest of the house)
If you're looking for a garbage bin in your room, ask Francesco about his ideology ;)
I've stayed in several apartments and hostels in Berlin but this was by far my best stay. Enjoy!

Was listed as a quiet place to rest and settle and it definitely lived up to the expectations. If you’re looking for a quiet oasis this is definitely the place for you. I’m used to a more lively atmosphere at home so personally was very different for me. Only about a 5 minute walk from the transit in Berlin so I was able to reach anywhere in the city which I found quite easily accessible.
Marcus made my stay very comfortable and the apartment is in a great location in Berlin Mitte. The communication was easy and very prompt making check in very easy. Thanks!
We had a wonderful stay, the apartment is a very homely place and Faesal is a great host! :)
Wonderful place in the center

Very nice appartement for 4.
Communication was good.

Very convenient location, very nice landlord. December 31, me and my friends because of train delays in the arrival time of late a lot, but the landlord has been waiting for us. The rooms are very comfortable and very warm.

Vermieter ist uneingeschränkt zu empfehlen, tolle Kommunikation und immer erreichbar. Wohnung ist gut an S- und U-Bahn Netz angeschlossen und liegt sehr ruhig obwohl Supermärkte, Einkaufszentrum und Restaurants direkt um die Ecke sind.
Die Küche ist aufgrund des aussergewöhlichen Designs der Wohnung nur eingeschränkt nutzbar aber das war uns anhand der Bilder schon vorher klar.
Wir waren sehr zufrieden und kommen bestimmt wieder.
Super Unterkunft, sehr sauber und gute Lage. Freundlicher Kontakt.
A very cozy place to stay!  Easy to find and  has good access to the rest of the city and it's establishments.

Emir was a great host, he accommodated our late request and had the room ready within the same day of request.
Emir helped us find some great local restaurants and joined us for one night to one of the great clubs.
The room itself was clean but had no storage which made us have to keep everything within our suitcase.
We had access to the full flat and got to enjoy using the kitchen to make our own meals.
Overall I would come back and stay with Emir again.

Die Unterkunft war sauber und entsprach den Bildern. Der Check-In war einfach.
Es ist ruhig dort, von dem anderen Zimmer, mit den man sich, wie in der Anzeige beschrieben, Küche und Bad teilt, habe ich so gut wie nichts mitbekommen.
Good to stay!!
The communication and friendliness of the team was awesome. I would make reservations with Art in the future with no hesitation.

Le séjour chez Numa Nook s'est extrêmement bien passé. L'hébergement de type appart-hôtel est situé dans une zone très centrale de Berlin (Mitte), à proximité immédiate de l'île des musées et de l'Alexander Platz. Il y a beaucoup de restaurants à proximité. Le S-Bahn est à deux pas. Le logement en lui-même était très confortable, très calme et très propre. Les équipes de Numa Nook sont très réactives à la moindre demande. J'y reviendrai sans hésiter.
Goede locatie, schoon en snelle communicatie. Het historische gebouw waar het appartement in gevestigd is is een mooie verrassing op de rustige binnenplaats van het appartementencomplex.
Luisa gives very quick responses on our questions. The room is simple and very clean. We could use the amazing bathroom. .
Amabilidad y buena ubicación.
Było bardzo czysto, gospodarz pomocny i miły. Lokalizacja ok, obok tramwaju i blisko restauracji azjatyckich.

Very interesting and clean apartment close to the underground station.  Ideal for a couple on a short stay.  Ronald met us on arrival and was very helpful with recommendations and booking a taxi for us.  Would recommend to others.
Es war alles rundum perfekt!

You couldn't expect a better host than Petra. She's genuinely willing to make you feel as if you were home. Her place is not only quiet, well-located and tidy, but also somehow transmit really good vibes. If I ever go back to Berlin, I have no doubt that that's where I'm staying. Safe travels!
Great space for what we needed. We loved the simplicity and ease of it all, with everything we wanted at our doorstep.
흠이 없는 숙소이였습니다. 주변에 숲과 호수가 많아서 공기가 신선하고 한적하면서 주변 교통수단과 마트, 식당등을 도보로 이용할수 있고, 그리고 호스트의 친절한 안내와 적극적인 소통으로 베를린과 인근도시들을 잘여행할수 있었다. 다시 가보고 싶은 숙소입니다. 데니스와 헬렌, 꼬맹이신사 밀란에게 대단히 감사드리고 항상 건강하시길 기도드립니다. 감사합니다.

Das Häuschen ist sehr gemütlich und hochwertig ausgestattet. Von der Küchenausstattung bis zum sehr bequemen Bett hat alles gepasst.  Die Gestaltung folgt nach einem konsequent durchgezogenen Farbkonzept. Tassen und andere Gegenstände haben den gleichen schönen Grünton wie z.B. Fensterrahmen und Treppengeländer. Das freut das Designerherz! Die Lage ist sehr ruhig und direkt am Wasser. Eine ideale Oase. Wir sind begeistert.
Good location for go to center by tram. And easy to find car parking slot.
Logement de qualité, bien placé au cœur de Berlin, avec un rapport qualité-prix correct. Je recommande.

Perfect location, a few steps away from S + U bahn station, with shops, restaurants and cafés nearby. Central yet very safe, clean and quiet, the place is ideal for a lone traveler or a couple. The renovated and functionnal apartment is an absolute gem. Check in and check out procedures are very easy. Frank gives detailed directions and instructions and always answers any questions promptly.
I had a wonderful stay in Berlin, in great part due to the flat and neighbourhood I discovered. I very highly recommand Frank’s Prenzlauer Berg’s apartment.

Gut gelegen ruhig und mit guter ÖPNV Anbindung.

Minha estadia no apartamento do Eugen foi incrível. O apartamento além de aconchegante e completo está em uma localização perfeita. A comunicação com o anfitrião foi fácil e ele se mostrou muito solícito. Obrigado.

Ann-Cathrins Unterkunft war einwandfrei. Nicht nur entsprach sie 1:1 der Beschreibung und den Bildern, sie war sogar noch besser und so detailreich eingerichtet, dass ich mich sofort wie Zuhause fühlte. Vor allem über die Yogamatten und Badezusätze habe ich mich gefreut, sowas findet man selbst in gut eingerichteten AirBnBs eher selten. Die Wohnung ist auch für Menschen, die es beim Schlafen sehr dunkel brauchen, perfekt, da man das Schlafzimmer hervorragend abdunkeln kann (fast blackout). Zwischen Haltestellen der U-Bahnen U1/U3 und U2 gelegen und mit dem Bus M29 direkt vor der Haustür, kann man sofort in alle Ecken Berlins und der Potsdamer Platz ist auch nur einen Katzensprung entfernt.

Great place with friendly staff and very easy location. Fab coffee. Would recommend.

Robin’s flat is located in a hip neighbourhood, and has a rooftop terrace with an amazing view on the Zionskirche. He let us check in earlier than the stated time, which was very convient as our plane arrived early in the morning. We definitely enjoyed our weekend in Berlin, and it’d be a pleasure to stay at Robin’s place again.
Absolutely great host. Great apartment, highly recommended if you have business in the area.
It was a chill place. Centrally located which is very helpful.
Julián's SMARTments were very nice, clean and cosy! 10/10 would stay again.

Prepare your legs for walking stairs as the apartment was forth floor without elevator 😁. Sure is mentioned in the description but something we noticed first when checking in.
היינו 3 מבוגרים. דירה מתוכננת היטב, יש מקום לכולם וספייס מושלם. נוח נקי עם קבלת פנים טובה. במזג אויר מתאים יש אפשרות לשבת בחצר הפנימית ובדשא
Appartamento delizioso e pulito, in un quartiere tranquillo ed è facile spostarsi a piedi. La metropolitana è molto vicina, quindi anche con i mezzi è semplice muoversi.
Veronika's flat was very comfortable ~ conveniently located near coffee places, markets, restaurants, shops, train station and trams.  I would stay again for sure.

Die Unterkunft von Martina und Charlotte in Berlin hat uns sehr gefallen. Das Loft ist grossflächig, sauber und gemütlich. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. An der Strasse zu der Unterkunft gibt es mehrere Bars. Trotz dessen war es abends und nachts im Apartment immer sehr ruhig und auch im Sommer herrschte eine angenehme Temperatur. Check-In und Check-Out waren äusserst unkompliziert und funktionierten einwandfrei.
It's been a really nice experience to stay at Raffaela's airbnb. I can recommend!

Marcel’s place was walking distance to S + U lines in Berlin and is close to good local restaurants and grocery store. Though we had zero problems, the bathroom is shared. The room was clean and is spacious, more than enough for the two of us. The apartment is renovated and the host is a really nice guy.

My friend and I stayed here for 3 nights and found it to be very pleasant - lots of good bars/cafes/ shops within walking distance. Supermarket round the corner. Friendly neighbours and the apartment was cozy and comfortable to come back to each day! Would definitely stay again
Die Unterkunft war wie auf den Bildern. Alles super sauber gewesen. Das Bett war schön groß und bequem.

La ubica inmejorable , cerca de todo

Sehr sauber, schnelle Kommunikation & günstiger Preis dazu! Wenn wir das nächste mal in Berlin sind, dann wird hier unsere Unterkunft sein.

Excelente departamento para estar unos días en Berlín, es muy completo, limpio y ordenado. Leider war die Sauberkeit im Badezimmer und in der Küche ungenügend und wir haben uns nicht wohlgefühlt. Die Loft ist wunderbar eingerichtet mit sehr tollen Bildern und einer wunderschönen Aussicht. Sie ist sehr geräumig und hat alles, was man benötigt. Great location. Not in the city but really peaceful & wonderful atmosphere

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Berlin, le quartier de Friedrischain est parfait concernant le logement tout était propre à l'annonce.

Nous n'avons pas manqué d'instruction concernant les codes et toute la procédure 3 jours avant (voir trop).Surtout lorsque rien ne marche.
Nous avons eu le malheur d'arriver 5 mins avant l'heure "digitale" et avons soit disant bloqué le code.

I definitely recommend this place to anyone interested to have a nice trip to berlin while staying at a spacious and welcoming place.

Ella ist eine wunderbare Gastgeberin und hat ein ausgezeichnetes Gespür für Design, wie an der perfekten, durchdachten und liebevoll minimalistischen Inneneinrichtung gut zu erkennen ist. We really enjoyed staying at the apartment. Perfect location near a lot of nice restaurants.

Eine kleine und nette Unterkunft, schlicht gehalten und sehr sauber. Die Gastgeber sind super freundlich und schnell zu erreichen.

Große Enttäuschung - Kein Zugang zur Unterkunft

Diese Unterkunft war einfach nur Top! Ein Edeka & DM sind direkt vor der Tür.

This airbnb was perfect for one person! Great location, the space itself was even better than the pictures! Jan communicated with me quickly when I had questions. Easy check in. Even laundry!

Stephanie was a wonderful host and was very responsive throughout our short trip. The apartment was exactly as described and had everything we needed (comfortable bed, nice bathroom, full kitchen). Lage war top. Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war auch super. Wir durften sogar früher einchecken und später auschecken.

It was pleasure to stay there. Room is nice and stylish. Would be good to have more light inside
Perfect host, always willing to help. Nice place, clean, and will return

Zentral gelegen und doch ruhig. Tolle und geschmackvolle Einrichtung

very recommended, central located, glad to be back

This is a very mixed review but it could have been so much better. Firstly the good bits: very good location as we walked all over Berlin from here. It was also very close to transport and had a very good supermarket only about 100m away. The apartment itself had plenty of space with big rooms and a very good bathroom. It was clean and had comfortable beds.
On the negative side: GETTING INSIDE WAS A NIGHTMARE - three different codes to get inside, the last of which is extremely difficult. FOR THIS REASON ALONE WE WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS APARTMENT. After a long day travelling it's not what you need. Inside, the apartment is very dark with deep colours requiring all lights (not strong enough) to be switched on. There were no instructions for any appliance, no microwave, no TV and no washing powder for the washing machine.
Simply by replacing the front door lock with something simpler, painting the inside a light colour and adding a microwave would improve this to 4.5 stars.

Great flat in Berlin. Only thing to note is it’s a 5th floor walk up so many stairs to go in and out every time. Other than that really enjoyed my stay at Ernesto’s flat - super quiet, well decorated, great for one person or a couple.

A very clean, peaceful and quiet stay just outside the hustle and bustle of Mitte and busier neighbourhoods.

Great place, great bed, great shower!

la casa di Martin si trova in una zona piena di vita di Berlino, a meno di 1 minuti a piedi dalla fermata della metropolitana "Leinestrasse" che ti collega a qualsiasi posto ai voglia visitare.
Una grande qualità è la grandezza, non è facile trovare case con così tante camere da letto a Berlino, inoltre si trova al piano terra, e per noi che abbiamo due bambini con passeggino è stato molto comodo entrare ed uscire da casa (a Berlino quasi nessun palazzo ha l'ascensore).
l'appartamento è dotato del giusto necessario, ho cucinato molto e ho trovato tutto tutto quello di cui avevo bisogno.
l'unica cosa che segnalo è che una stanza che si trova su piano strada è rumorosa, e la notte questo può diventare un problema. le altre stanze sono silenziose, ma quella no. in ogni caso consiglio a tutti di soggiornare presso questo alloggio perché confortevole e accogliente.

Lovely flat in a leafy quiet suburb of Berlin with good transport links. Hosts were rspectful of our space and very helpful .  The only downside was that the wifi barely works, we used a lot of our phone data!. It would be good to have a little folder to let you know about what is in the local area and some milk when arriving later on a sunday night! But over all, a lovely place to stay.

Ein grosszügiges, gemütliches und sauberes Haus inmitten einer Einfamilienhaus-Siedlung. Ruhig gelegen, kein Strassenlärm oder sonstige Lärmemissionen. Schicke Einrichtung und stimmige Auswahl der Möbel.
Alles was man für ein paar Tage in Berlin braucht ist vorhanden. Verbrauchsmaterial (Waschmaschinen-Tabs, Gewürze, Handtücher, WC-Papier, Abfallsäcke, usw.) ist ausreichend vorhanden. Keine Mängel – WLAN, TV, Heizung, Warmwasser funktionierte stets einwandfrei. Auto konnte am Strassenrand vor dem Haus parkiert werden.
Einziger klitzekleiner Kritikpunkt: Kühlschrank ohne Gefrierfach. (Natürlich kommt man problemlos ohne klar – man muss es einfach wissen :-) )
An- und Abreise war unkompliziert. Abklärungen im Vorfeld verliefen schnell und reibungslos. Für Familien oder Gruppen mit bis zu 4 Personen ideal!

With its one bedroom, this is a perfect apartment for a couple. Bathroom was small but with a good shower and plenty of warm water and good water pressure. It was a good home base for our Berlin stay.

Really nice place and very good communication with the host! Would definitely go back :)
Highly recommend this hotel, everything was good and convenient
Unkomplizierter Checkin und gute Anbindung über die U7 , die mit ca 10min Gehweg fußgängig erreichbar ist.

Die Wohnung liegt im schönen Charlottenburg und ist geschmackvoll ausgestattet. Sie ist sehr gut mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen. Es gibt alles was man braucht und die Couch ist super gemütlich ;) Der Zutritt zur Wohnung ist auch sehr modern und flexibel gestalten.
Leider reagiert die Gastgeberin sehr spät oder garnicht auf Nachrichten. So haben wir bereits am ersten Tag beanstandet, dass Handtücher fehlen. Diese haben wir bis zuletzt nicht bekommen.
Netterweise durften unsere Taschen auch nach der angegebenen Check Out Zeit noch in der Wohnung abstellen (auch wenn wir auch hier wieder sehr lange auf eine Antwort auf unsere mehrmalige Nachfrage warten mussten).
Insgesamt sind wir schon sehr zufrieden mit dem Aufenthalt. Lediglich die Kommunikation könnte besser sein.
J'ai passé un très agréable séjour. Patrick a été très disponible et l'appartement est bien agencé et bien placé. Je recommande !
Very transparent & clean :)
Wir waren zwei Nächte mit der Familie in Berlin um Freunde zu besuchen, dafür war die Unterkunft perfekt. Danke für den tollen Aufenthalt!

Micha ist ein hervorragender Gastgeber, ich habe mich sofort willkommen und sehr wohl gefühlt. Micha kennt sich bestens in Berlin aus und kann seine Gäste mit tollen Tipps zur Stadt und zum Viertel versorgen. Er ist sehr kommunikativ und reagiert sofort auf Anfragen - und er ist ein sehr interessanter Gesprächspartner. Die Wohnung ist schön und geschmackvoll eingerichtet, sehr sauber, es fehlt an nichts. Ich hatte einen rundum gelungenen Aufenthalt und komme sehr gern wieder. Herzlichen Dank, Micha! Matthias
Très bien conforme tout était excellent

The apartment is very well located, near of  everything. Besides, Ece's father is a spectacular man, a gentleman. Your mother is wonderful too. I just have a thank you to all of them. I'm still going to publish a book about my trip and these three enlightened beings to Berlin and it's certainly part of the story to be published. I highly recommend this apartment.

Nice apartment, relatively close to the nearest underground station. The city center is about 25 minutes commute. As Andreas was away, his friend and neighbour took care of us. He gave us tips where to go and told us if we need anything just knock on his door. The apartment is nice and spacious, got everything what needed. Worth the money.

Sonjas Wohnung ist ein Gesamtkunstwerk, das man fast ehrfürchtig betrachten und in dem man sich gleichzeitig sofort zuhause fühlen kann. Dazu passt der einzigartige Mix der Umgebung, des Prenzlauer Bergs.
Das Beste ist aber Sonja selbst, sie ist eine perfekte Gastgeberin !
Super nett Familie und man kann Toilette allein genießen. Es gibt eine für Gast, eine für Familie.

This was my second stay at Heidi’s and I already look forward to many more. The space is beautiful, with extra high ceilings, lovely artworks and sparkling clean. It was also nice to find how warm it was in freezing Berlin winter! (Last time I stayed was in sizzling hot July, and it was, on the contrary, nicely cool). It’s very safe, in a building with local creative businesses and residential flats alike, and the location couldn’t be better for me. Thanks again Heidi!

das Zimmer entsprach weitgehend den Fotos (das Fenster war ein Lichtschacht, das war auf den Fotos nicht erkennbar) und der Beschreibung und doch war es leider kein Zimmer in dem man sich gerne aufhält.

Sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt, die Unterkunft war nur 2 Minuten von der U Bahn Station entfernt.
Es war alles wie beschrieben. Sehr sauber. Sehr flexibler und einfacher Check-In.
Die Wohnung ist echt Klasse wir würden sie wieder buchen . Was alles super, nette Gastgeberin.

Mandy's place was amazing. When we arrived she was so kind giving us all the directions to get from the airport to the accommodation.
It was a wonderful experience to stay in her lovely apartment. All of the amenities were very clean and the location was ideal - a 5 minute walk to Frankfurter Allee station and close to several attractions. Great place, great host, super recommended!
No schower soap, but the rest was just incredible:) We really loved it

Family of 5 used appartment as the perfekt base for a long weekend in Berlin.
Very spacy, very clean and had All necesarry equipment. Will recmmend this place for families looking for a nice and calm place in a great friendly neighbourhood with great athmosphere.

Great location for viewing all of central Berlin. Easy to find from Alexanderplatz or Hackescher Markt stations. Apartment (middle) was slightly bigger than we expected, I was worried about room being very hot based on reviews, but we didn't think it was too bad. In summer this might be an issue though. Very quiet and peaceful, barely any sign that anyone else was staying there. Facilities are new, minimalist and spotlessly clean. Everything very thoughtful and considerate. We did have some small tech issues with the app but always resolved very quickly via messaging owner. 2 small issues, the bed being against the wall was a problem for us (we are both early-mid-50s) so hard to get in/out and maybe the room is geared more towards younger guests. Also, the self-serve beer/wine pump didn't work. This was also in a previous review so either repeat problem or never resolved. Either way, it's a great service we couldn't use. Overall, definitely recommend and would use again if in Berlin

Per chi vuole soggiornare nel cuore di Kreuzberg, quartiere vivace e multietnico di Berlino, questo posto è perfetto. Mini appartamenti piccoli ma confortevoli e funzionali in una struttura moderna e pulita. Incredibilmente silenzioso e tranquillo la notte, cucina attrezzata e bagno ampio. Receptionist disponibile e possibilità di garage a pagamento. Una bella terrazza comune a disposizione. Davvero consigliato!
Great host, great location, private and quiet.  Great access point to the subway.  I enjoyed my stay.

A great place to stay, this is probably the best deal you'll find in this area. This flat have everything you need to feel comfortable. Even WiFI is pretty decent which is rare for Airbnb in Berlin.
Five stars, would recommend.

Easy keyless entrance and check out.
Good big table in the main living room for playing cards and having nice meal.
Nice spot and nice host!
War sehr angenehm
sehr gut! Vielen Dank!
Beautiful space, felt very safe and clean.

- 车站步行十五分内可达，很好找。
- 房东服务周到。房间天花板很高，宽敞整洁。街区安静。
- 对面街有家印度餐厅，菜品美味。
推荐！

Vincent was incredibly available before, during and after the stay. Also very helpful about every recommendation and inquiry and the place was located just a short walk from multiple public transportation hubs!

Große Wohnung in ruhigerem Kiez in Kreuzberg. Fußläufig sind nette Cafés und Bars erreichbar.
Bei Hitze steht die Luft im Altbau, aber da kann man nichts machen :)
Rio war immer erreichbar und hilfsbereit!
Stay was great and worth paid.
What a great place, in a great location, for a great price! Jens was super responsive and helpful. We wished we could have stayed longer.  Highly recommend!
A nice single room flat which was perfect for my trip to Berlin. Easy to access via public transport and hassle free check in and check out.
Super saubere, angenehme Unterkunft und sehr gute Lage. Empfehlenswert👌
angenehm, schöne Umgebung. ❤️❤️❤️😍😍😍😍
Carsten was an incredible host, really nice and also comprehensive! I totally recommend staying here! Also the apartment is amazing, would totally stay there another time!

A very good apartment in a great location. Clean and tidy.
The only minor issue was the lack of lighting in the communal hall/lift areas which wasn’t ideal when returning in the Evening.
Other than that it was excellent.
War wunschlos glücklich. Tolle Unterkunft mit sehr nettem Gastgeber.

We had no problems coordinating our arrival with Bee, who was there to greet us with her husband Sam after a long train trip from Gdansk. The room was large and  contained a small table (not shown in the photo) and a little fridge which was not working at the time, however we were invited to us our hosts' fridge and kitchen. We had our own private bathroom, always nice when you're traveling. The bed in the upstairs lofts was comfy with nice sheets. There were a couple of couches in the room and couple of extra mattresses against the wall in case more people needed to be accommodated. The apartment used to be a nightclub and has been refurbished into one big living space by the owners, with a couple of extra rooms, like ours. It was homey. The apartment is located in the "Little Turkey" section of Berlin, a mixture of older and new buildings. We took a walk around after arriving, and felt absolutely safe. It wasn't far to the underground train stop, and a short journey into the heart of Berlin.
El alojamiento es incluso mejor que en las imágenes. Muy bien situado, cercano al metro, tren y buses para disfrutar de Berlin.  Destacaría la comodidad de tener separado el WC y la ducha.

Un soggiorno più breve del previsto dovuto alla cancellazione di un aereo.
Per il resto tutto ottimo, appartamento con tutto quello che serve , posizione perfetta con metro a due passi e ambiente silenzioso e tranquillo.
Peccato essersi fermati per così poco tempo.
Henrique risponde subito, è stato sempre disponibile e simpatico.
Molto consigliato!

Das Hotel ist super gelegen, die Mitarbeiter super freundlich. Ich habe echt nichts negatives zu berichten und würde dieses Hotel sehr empfehlen. Wir hatte zu dritt ein kleines Apartment gebucht. Da war alles drin was das Herzen wünscht. Top

Dave was a great host, always on hand to offer help and recommendations when I needed them. The space was clean and stocked with tea, coffee and water, which was a nice touch. The private bathroom was a plus too! Would definitely go back next time.

Es un sitio correcto y limpio pero algunos aspectos son claramente mejorables, como el olor de la habitación (a no ventilada), la ropa de cama (pequeña) o el mantenimiento de la limpieza del baño.
Anne es muy agradable y educada y estoy segura de que intentara mejorar estos aspectos.
Der Raum war sehr schlicht und schick, es gab sogar eine kleine Küche und kostenlose Getränke. Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt dort sehr genossen!

Great communication, easy check in with Gosia's help. The apartment is well situated with vibrant cafes and bars all around  and easy walks to get onto Berlin's excellent Public transport system. Small room was suitable for an adult (me) and my son used the sofa bed in the lounge. Two friends used the HUGE bedroom/sitting room . What you see is what you get - an eclectic, artistic apartment. Quiet, clean and with all mod cons including dishwasher and washing machine. 4 adults stayed and we never ran out of hot water. Tina's guide that she sends is the most comprehensive one I have ever seen ! No hesitation on rebooking if and when I come back to Berlin. Thank you Tina and Gosia.

Eine sehr schöne, freundlich eingerichtete Wohnung mit sehr netten Vermieter. Alles hat reibungslos geklappt und Gelfo war im Vorfeld, wie auch im Verlauf, sehr unterstützend und hilfsbereit. Wir können diese gut gelegene Wohnung nur empfehlen!
Ich durfte 2 Nächte Gast bei Sabine sein. Sehr gut erreichbar mit der S-Bahn und die Unterkunft war wie erwartet. Ein persönlicher Empfang machte das Ankommen leicht. Gerne wieder!
Thanks a lot to Rene and Anja. My wife encountered a disease at late night, and Rene helped take us to the hospital and care for us a lot. Thanks for the great help!

Ich habe die Unterkunft bewusst gewählt, weil ich ein dreitägiges Seminar in Berlin Mitte besucht habe und sie verkehrsgünstig gelegen ist. Rosario ist ein sehr angenehmer + höflicher Gastgeber. Das Zimmer erfüllte meine Erwartungen. Sehr lieb die Informationen über Berlin auf dem Schreibtisch in dem Zimmer. Obwohl das Zimmer nach hinten raus gelegen, hört man die S-Bahn und die Züge, jedoch fand ich auf dem Schreibtisch auch dafür eine Lösung. Es gab sehr weiche paarweise verpackte Ohrstöpsel. Dankeschön.
A fantastic apartment with all the facilities you need. A brilliant location and hardi is very welcoming and accommodating!

Clean apartment and good location when visiting Berlin. Check in was super easy and parking was easy to find.
David was really friendly and good at communication.

Wir haben uns in dieser Unterkunft super wohl gefühlt. Sie war nicht nur sauber sondern auch sehr modern. Von einer Regentusche bis hin zu sehr hohen Decken, welche meiner Meinung nach gerne gesehen werden. Vor der Unterkunft erreicht man direkt eine U-Bahnstation, Supermärkte, Kiosk, Sparkasse und vieles mehr. Ich hätte mir für den Aufenthalt in Berlin nichts besseres Vorstellen können. Handtücher und Bettwäsche sowie Toilettenpapier etc. konnte man sich ganz einfach in einem so genannten „Laundrey room“ selber beschaffen. Alles in einem ist diese Unterkunft nur weiter zu empfehlen!

Die Lage ist der Hammer! Die Öffis, den Mauerpark und vielfältige Gastro direkt vor der Tür. Das Zimmer ist sehr sauber und hat einen guten Standart. Es fehlt allerdings ein Kleiderschrank im Zimmer. Empfehlenswert!
Netter, aufgeschlossener und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber direkt nebenan. Der Ausblick ist einfach wunderschön. Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt.

Mein Aufenthalt war sehr schön, entspannt und ruhig. Die Wohnung ist gut gelegen und gemütlich. Wie beschrieben gibt es zwar keine Küche dafür aber eine Mikrowelle, Wasserkocher und einen Kühlschrank - für mich hat das so gepasst. In der Nähe gibt es auch einen Rewe der bis 23 Uhr geöffnet hat. Mit Karen habe ich mich zwar nur einmal kurz unterhalten aber sie war sehr freundlich und immer gut zu erreichen :)
the place is great, the kitchen and bathroom floors are heated so its nice, the bed are comfy and theres enough space to move around

Die Lage der Wohnung ist fantastisch – ruhig und dennoch zentral gelegen. Es gibt ausreichend Platz für 2 Erwachsene und 2 Kinder, was uns sehr gefallen hat.
Der Check-in und Check-out verliefen absolut reibungslos, ein großes Plus!
Einziger Kritikpunkt ist die Sauberkeit. Bei unserer Ankunft war die Wohnung nur oberflächlich gereinigt. Wir haben Daniel direkt kontaktiert, und das Problem wurde umgehend behoben, was wir sehr geschätzt haben. Leider scheint es laut anderen Bewertungen häufiger vorzukommen, dass dieser Punkt nicht ausreichend berücksichtigt wird.Daher vergeben wir auch nur 4 Sterne. Es wäre wünschenswert, wenn hier mehr Aufmerksamkeit vor Ankunft der Gäste investiert würde.
Insgesamt hatten wir aber einen schönen Aufenthalt.

Had a 4day getaway with friends in Berlin and were searching for an airbnb with 3 private rooms, this place had this but also a small gym, like a cinema room and 2 bathrooms with huge chill area, it was perfect to comeback after a long walk and lay down and rest. It was extremely clean, with lots of kitchen cutleries, different cups and glasses for different drinks etc. Only best recommendations !

It delivers on it’s description for the most part, i was overall content with the deal relative to what was available.  Bit smelly and noisy corridors. Fans were not included in the original price and needed to be asked for.

Alojamiento ideal para 2 personas. Las fotos son fieles a la realidad. El barrio multicultural y animado. Está lleno de restaurantes de todas clases.
Por poner una pega, el 5 piso sin ascensor. Por lo demas, una estancia muy satisfactoria.

Unterkunft war super.
Dor ist auch toll!
Lief alles gut ab!

Overall a brilliant place to stay. A very clean apartment that was much bigger in real life with high ceilings and a separate kitchen and big bedroom/living room. The bed was actually two twin beds pushed together, which was perfect for two friends travelling together. Karen provided towels and there were pots and pans so we could cook in the kitchen. The check in was very easy, just getting a key from a lockbox. There's not much going on locally but it didn't matter because it is about a 5 minute walk to the U-bahn and 10 minutes to the tram so it was easy for us to get everywhere.  Karen replied very quickly to any messages. The only small issue was the apartment has no wifi.
Perfetto e disponibile! Peccato per la presenza di un solo fornello e l’assenza di un lavandino.
Michaels place was very lovely, clean and the self-check in was simple. He was always there to reply quickly to messages when we needed him. Thanks again!
Top verblijf op 10 minuten van het centrum.
Alloggio molto luminoso, spazioso e pulito. In ottima posizione (la fermata della metro è di fronte all'appartamento) e silenzioso nonostante sia vicino alla strada.

Laura ist sehr freundlich und eine ausgezeichnete Gastgeberin, ihre Wohnung ist schön, geräumig und sehr sauber. Sie hat mich von dem Moment an, als ich ankam, wie zu Hause fühlen. Ich empfehle es auf jeden Fall und würde auf jeden Fall wieder zu diesem schönen Airbnb kommen!
Alles sehr modern, sauber, ruhig und zentral. Gerne wieder.
Nice hostel in a central part of town with good facilities.
Thank you Mona for sharing your appartment with us ! It was a great time in this very colourful and sweet place ;) I recommend it warmly !

The place is a great option if you're just traveling to Berlin or, if like me, you're moving to the city and struggling to find a long-term accommodation. The hostel is clean, the room I stayed had everything to make me feel super comfortable for over a week: good bed, table, space for clothes, etc. The atmosphere is calm, respectful and majority of people were professionals from different ages, which made me feel safe even to use the common areas to work when needed. I thought that shared toilets would be an issue, but quiet the opposite. Many bathrooms available in each floor, all super clean and tidy all the time! The kitchen was also clean and has good freezer storage space if you're staying longer. As it wasn't crowded, it was fine for myself to prepare and have a good breakfast and dinner at the tables. The location is also awesome, with lots of bars and restaurants (great kebabs on Dade Falafel just around the corner), cafes to work from and a nice park and supermarket by less than five minutes walking-distance. I also need to mention that the staff was beyond professional and helpful! I had a problem with internet, so needed to check-in through a phone call as I arrived late at night, and someone helped me through the whole process. Very thoughtful of him, also made me feel welcome and secure about the accommodation! I highly recommend it!

Lovely apartment! It's situated in a nice area with lots of bars and restaurants, so it's close to everything but still really quiet. The apartment is beautiful and fully equipped. It was light and clean and peaceful.

Sören was lovely and made check in so easy. However main bedroom did not have sheets on the bed and not enough towels for guests. Location was great and safe but a bit far away from the city centre. Would be ideal for a family. Internet didn’t work quite as well as we had hoped. Lots of sirens but other than that a quiet area. Again we felt really safe which was super important. The apartment was fine and did us well but didn’t have a super homey feel. Pillows are very flat however beds were very comfortable. The hosts are LOVELY the nicest people and very welcoming.

This is my second time staying at Klaus’s place and I think I’ll keep coming back in the future! The apartment is centrally located in a very walkable area, but still quiet because it’s located on an interior courtyard. In fact, it was so quiet that I was able to leave the windows cracked open at night (in the middle of the city!), which was amazing during a heat wave. The apartment itself is clean and modern but also a nice taste of “real Berlin”, unlike other places I’ve stayed. Klaus is super responsive—I booked at the last minute after encountering problems with other accommodations and I had access to the pristine unit within an hour.
Sehr schön eingerichtete Wohnung, tolle Ausstattung. Es hat an nichts gefehlt.

Ein sehr schönes, ruhiges Apartment. Tolle Lage direkt am Volkspark Friedrichshain. Die Wohnung liegt im Parterre des Hinterhauses und hat vor der Tür eine Bank, auf der wir sehr nett und ungestört in der Sonne mit Blick in den Garten sitzen konnten.

180 per night for this is way beyond reasonable. Surroundings are sketchy at night, with plenty of drunkards. the apartment was not clean: the toilet had some brown marks, the sink in the shower is clogged and water forms a consistent puddle as one showers. Noisy at night, a lot of young guests, pot smoke smell included. The couch has some white marks you do not want to know. no blinds just curtains that are not leak tight and, because you are up north, the sunrise is very early which disrupts sleep.
Outstanding penthouse apartment well situated. One of the more elegant air bnb homes in which we have stayed.

6 of us had a fantastic time staging at Ulla’s apartment. It was really spacious and comfortable and a perfect base to explore Berlin. The only thing I’d suggest for future stays is that they supply shampoo/conditioner/shower gel as there was none. We had a great stay - thank you so much!
Vielen Dank für die Unterkunft und das Eingehen auf unsere spontanen Bedürfnisse. Wir haben uns sehr wohl in der Unterkunft von Tim & Matteo gefühlt.
Super Aufenthalt nahe Berlin Mitte!!! Es hat sich mehr alsbgelohnt!
Super Lage! Schöne Wohnung

Grande chambre très joliment décorée.
Salle de bains super propre et chauffée.
Aucun bruits car situé en 3eme corps de bâtiment ce qui ajoute à l sécurité du lieu.
Parfait pour se reposer quand on a marché 15 km comme c’est la règle à Berlin

We had a great stay at Alan and Kasia's apartment. It was close to the train station, tram stop and supermarket and had everything we needed. The weather wasn't good enough to sit outside but it is nice to have the option of going into the courtyard in the summer. We would use the apartment again on another trip to Berlin.

Jun’s apartment was perfect for a trip to Berlin. It was easy to get all over the city from. The tram is just right down the street. The apartment was super clean and well thought out. If we ever come back to Berlin I wouldn’t hesitate about staying here again.

The apartment is really big, clean and nice decorated.
The rooms are light and everything you need is there.
The location is really perfect, in between Mitte and Prenzlauerberg.
We would love to come back soon again!
Hat alles prima gepasst.

Great view over Berlin! We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment - clean and exactly like the pictures. Being on the 5th floor means that you have to be prepaired for a stair climb :-), but the view, the fresh air and the beautiful apartment makes it all worth it. Easy checkin. We give our best recommendations
Great location, well thought out facilities, all you need for a family stay in Berlin.
Very easy communication with Sonja. The place has everything you need and is very well located. I would totally come again.

I spent 6 nights at Stefan's place. It's a calming, comfortable space with great amenities. Stefan really sets the benchmark for hosting - attentive but giving you your space intuitively. He even took me out to a local blues bar, which gave me a flavour for the Neukölln-Kreuzberg scene that I would never has experienced. Even if you don't get to see that, the place is well connected and the bed is *really* comfortable. Getting use of Stefan's bike let me appreciate the city in a way I would not otherwise have enjoyed.  Get on it, and head up to the local Volkspark Hasenheide or out west to Tiergareten. Thanks for a really restorative stay, Stefan.
I had a very nice time at Daniel‘s apartment. It is perfect even for a longer stay with everything you need. Communication with Daniel was easy and very pleasant.
Excellent stay we were very happy.
alles wie beschrieben mit herzlicher und unkomplizierter Aufnahme integriert im bewohnten Haus... Gerne wieder!

l'appartamento è comodo e molto ben collegato dalla metropolitana che dista pochi metri ma è in una posizione decentrata rispetto al centro di Berlino. A fianco della metropolitana c'è un cinema e un centro commerciale
great spot to have your lil cocoon in the best neighborhood in Berlin
We really enjoyed staying at Smartments, with simple check-in and check-out, near train station and tram station, also if you wants to cook simple meal this place is highly recomended.

Alles ist sehr gut gegangen. Nette Leute, alles so wie es sein sollte.
Gerne wieder!

What a great BNB - probably our most favorite in Europe so far. We spent 6 days in Berlin with 2 Grandparents, 2 kids (12 & 10), the wife and me. That was not even enough time to see everything - hint, buy a museum pass and a multi-day subway pass - you will use them.

Very surprised at how centrally located we were to everything in the area. Within a 2 block radius there are 2 grocery stores, 2 metro stations, 20+ restaurants, 2 pharmacies, multiple cafe's and bakeries, etc. The apartment itself was very well furnished and situated on a quiet, well lit block. Felt very safe the entire trip.

The Host met us at the apartment when we arrived from the airport and gave us a quick tour. 3 bedrooms / 1 bathroom. Kitchen was well stocked and washer / dryer worked perfectly.

HIGHLY Recommend this vacation apartment for your next vacation. If we come back to Berlin, we will stay here again!!!

The microapartment is in a fantastic location and very stylish and unique. It was super clean and the wifi is great.
Sebastian was extremely helpful during my stay and responded quickly to any questions I had. Definitely recommended!
What can we say? copy paste all other reviews: perfect location in Berlin s coolest neighbourhood, perfect communication, and a perfectly equipped apartment with garden!

Tolle Lage in Berlin (2 Min. von der U-Bahn Station, innert 15 Minuten an allen relevanten Hot-Spots der Stadt) und gutes Preis-/Leistungs-Verhältnis.
Sven kommuniziert proaktiv und hat auch während des Aufenthalts nachgefragt, ob alles i.o. Check-In und Check-Out funktionierten reibungslos.
Apartment ist gemütlich und funktional eingerichtet. Die zwei Schlafzimmer zum Innenhof sind sehr ruhig (wir haben super geschlafen), das eine Schlafzimmer Richtung Strasse passt dann eher zum guten Schläfer (Fahrzeuglärm) ;-) Das mindert den Eindruck jedoch nicht, vorbehaltlose Empfehlung!
I had a fantastic time staying at Tatjana’s place. Highly recommend it!!

The apartment is in a great part of Berlin for restaurants and bars. It is conveniently located two blocks from the U2 line which will take you to most of the main attractions in the city and also links with the major public transport hubs. The apartment is big, spacious, airy and quiet with very comfortable pillows and matresses. It also is exceptionally well appointed. If we come back to Berlin we would certainly like to see if this apartment is available

Nils and his girlfriend were very flexible to respond to my last minute booking. Nils even arranged for his work schedule to be changed so that he could accommodate my arrival time for check in. That was very much appreciated. The place was clean and comfortable. Nils and his partner definitely gave a lot of space - so I did not interact with them much - also since my stay was very short but appreciated the given privacy. There is a little friendly dog living there as well. :)

Lovely place to spend a few nights! Very clean and well kept and in a good location, just one tram to get into town.
Has everything you need and is in a quieter part of town so it isn’t loud at night. Would definitely recommend for short or longer stays in Berlin.

Practically next door to Markthalle Neun, and a stone's throw from quite a few nice restaurants, which made it easy to grab something to eat when we didn't want to do any cooking. First floor flat made it easy to come and go, and it was well-equipped for a short stay. Kirsten was very easy to communicate with.
Muy bien las instalaciones y el trato
Good location, proper room
Sven’s place is unique and very welcoming. It was warm and quiet despite the weather outside and its proximity to the main road. It had everything our small family could need.
I had a great ti.e in this spacious and well located apartment. Apostolos was more than a great host, readily available for questions of any kind

Günter's flat is in a beautiful neighbourhood, set in a quiet leafy road. The building itself is impressive as well. The room is really big, pretty and quiet. It was the perfect location to walk a lot of major sights we wanted to see such as Tempelhofer Aiport, Bergmann Kiez, Viktoria Park and the Jewish Museum. There's also a great Sicilian ice cream cafe on the same road. I'd definitely book again.
Nice place, nice kitchen, nice people and lots of tips to get to know Berlin beyond the tourist books. Rudi just makes you feel at home, so no tight up issues etc. You can feel free and flexible.

Very easy to speak to Sven who was very responsive and attentive as a host. Check in was easy with a colleague of Sven already at the apartment when we arrived who directed us to the secure parking space provided then took us to the apartment and showed us everything we needed for our stay. The apartment was very clean with all required amenities. Apartment location very central to the city with a subway station outside the apartment for easy access. Would recommend as a place to stay when visiting Berlin

Wir waren 5 Mädels für ein Wochenende in Berlin. Hierfür war die Wohnung perfekt. Zwei Toiletten, zwei Räume zum Schlafen (Wohnzimmer und Schlafzimmer) und eine super Umgebung. Viele Bars, das Maybachufer um die Ecke, alles zu Fuß erreichbar.

Die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet und die Betten waren bequem und die Fenster in den Schlafräumen können komplett verdunkelt werden. Durch die hohen Räume fühlt sich die Wohnung größer an als sie ist. Das Internet lief zuverlässig und schnell. Es hat nichts gefehlt und die Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter verlief einwandfrei und immer zeitnah. Die Lage der Wohnung war perfekt für uns - einerseits nah am Arbeitsort, andererseits mit guter Anbindung an die Öffis nach Mitte. Auch die Versorgung konnte fußläufig erledigt werden. Und da die Straße nachts zur 30er Zone wird war es auch recht ruhig. Wir können dieses Appartement empfehlen.
Alles in allem waren wir zufrieden.
Great place to stay when visiting Berlin. Lots of natural light. Rooftop and the kitchen area are a dream. Very close to high end shopping and TierGarden area.

Séjour inoubliable dans une ville inoubliable pleine de lumières et d'Histoire, et le soir, lorsque l'on revient de longues balades dans le froid de l'hiver, le plaisir de pouvoir se réchauffer dans un appartement sympathique et confortable, bien chauffé, géographiquement très bien situé. Thuy Trang is very nice and always there if you need anything. The place was very easy to find and close to public transport.

Another plus is the place itself, i loved the choice of furniture & the various amenities that it possesses, the bed was super comfy & the shower was outstanding! Loved taking showers in this place, bathroom was roomy & modern. the kitchen had everything i needed in order to cook whatever i wanted. Another thing i loved is the sound system in this apartment & the various classic vinyls that are in the apartment.
Damian was also such a sweet host & he always replied quickly to every question.
Overall, I highly recommend this apartment, it made my stay in Berlin much more enjoyable.

We just spent 9 days in Berlin at Holger’s apartment. The apartment exceeded our expectations.  It was comfortabe, roomy, beautifully designed, and in a perfect location. The apartment is a mix of contemporary and timeless, with high ceilings, tall windows,  wonderful light, warm, soft, muted wall coloring, wood floors, and with tasteful fabrics and furnishings throughout. The bathroom design is fabulous. The bed is really comfortable. The kitchen is functional and fully equipped, (with a state of the art nespresso maker),  and everything in the apartment works.  Prenzlauer Berg is a hip, trendy neighborhood with great stores and restaurants within walking distance, but the apartment itself is wonderfully quiet.  Holger is a great host, always available to answer questions and provide recommendations. His assistant Kerstin is the absolute best. So nice, pleasant, responsive… just a great person who made us feel very welcomed. We were sad to leave. Thank you both for a memorable trip.

Vi giver vores varmeste anbefalinger til Myriam og Mathis' lejlighed. Den er hyggelig, rummelig, med godt køkken, fantastisk badeværelse, ren og pæn og omgivelserne i bydelen er rolige og rare. Der ligger indkøbsmuligheder lige i nærheden, og det er ret let at finde hen til offentlige transportmidler - f.eks. kan du fra Alt Mariendorf-stoppestedet få kilometer fra lejligheden tage U-Bahn helt ind til centrum (Alexanderplatz, Friedrichstrasse osv.).
Vi havde tre børn med på turen, og de var især glade for muligheden for at kunne anvende familiens swimmingpool i kælderen.

We could not have been happier with our booking with Douglas. The sun room overlooking the iconic TV tower was the perfect place to relax with a glass of wine and a crossword after a busy day of sight-seeing. The double-glazed (noise-reducing) windows were very much appreciated, as the tram runs along the street directly below. Douglas’ communication was timely, helpful and accurate. We would definitely stay here again!!
insgesamt wars ok. die Straße hört man schon sehr stark und das Klo riecht ein bisschen aber an und für sich ne nette Unterkunft.
