Το διαμέρισμα είναι ακριβώς όπως φαίνεται στις φωτογραφίες. Ζεστός χώρος. Η γειτονιά ήσυχη και κοντά σε αρκετά εστιατόρια και μαγαζιά. Η πρόσβαση στα μέσα μαζικής μεταφοράς πολύ καλή και οι απόσταση για το κέντρο σχετικά μικρή ( περίπου 15 λεπτά με το μέτρο).  Ο οικοδεσπότης είναι πολύ ευγενικός και πολύ εξυπηρετικός.

Hell, freundlich, hat unseren Erwartungen entsprochen. Gegenüber ist ein kleiner Einkaufsladen, ein Eisgeschäft und eine leckere Bäckerei. Das war echt praktisch. Ein nettes Viertel mit vielen jungen Menschen, auch Kinder. Auf der anderen Straßenseite ist ein kleiner Park. Die Haltestelle der Tram (M10) ist gleich daneben, mit dieser kommt man direkt zum Hauptbahnhof. In unmittelbarer Nähe sind auch viele kleine, günstige Restaurants.
Alle Fenster blicken in den ruhigen Innenhof mit Bäumen, die Wohnung liegt im Erdgeschoss und hat einen schönen dunklen Holzboden und weiße Einrichtungsgegenstände, dadurch ist die Wohnung sehr harmonisch. Küchenzeile mit Induktionsherd, Waschmaschine - es hat alles gepaßt. Ich habe oft gekocht. Geschirrspüler gibt es keinen. Fön und Bügeleisen ist vorhanden.
Ein schönes, altes Entree bei der Eingangstür mit kleinem Innenhof, da kann man in Ruhe auf einer kleinen Bank eine Zigarette rauchen.
Die schwere Türe gleich nach der Eingangstüre in der Wohnung haben wir fixiert, damit sie offen blieb. Denn wenn man diese aufmacht und wieder zufallen lässt, wackelt die ganze Wohnung, so laut ist diese. Apropos Laut: Dünne Wände hat die Wohnung. Also man bekommt so ziemlich jeden Streit im Haus mit. Auch leider, dass die Nachbarn mit den Kindern frühmorgendlich durchs Stiegenhaus schreien.

Stefan's place was a great base for exploring Berlin. We had a family of five. Super quiet, with a U-Bahn stop within 5 min walk.(Schwartzkopffstraße, u-6).
Located on the second level of the building. The space had a fully equipped kitchen and we cooked daily. Super comfortable bed in the master bedroom. Combo washer and dryer in the kitchen, although the drier wasn't drying enough: had to do several rounds. No matter.
Edeka supermarket 5 min walking. Wall memorial: 10 min walk. North Side Gallery right around corner along with beach volleyball and ropes course.
Stefan was very accommodating, and he was able to find us a travel crib, even though it wasn't listed in the amenities. That was super helpful!
We would stay here again in a heartbeat.
Five flights of stairs. Our spouses brought heavy luggage to climb the stairs.

Apostolos was very helpful for my trip to Berlin. It was my first time visiting the city and he gave really detailed instructions on how to get there and met me to give me the keys and show me around.
The apartment is perfect for a single person or a couple (I was there 5 night on my own and then my boyfriend came for the weekend). It has nice high ceilings and is a good size. It is also in a great location, very near a lot of restaurants, bars and cafes. I would highly recommend.

The studio is indeed cozy and very clean. Chris was very helpful, specially since this listing was our first home in Berlin, so we had to deal with some bureaucracy. My husband, I and our cat stayed there for one month and were happy and satisfied overall.
The only problem we had was with the internet connection, which would be very slow and some times non-existent. Chris opened a protocol with the provider a few times, but unfortunately we just didn't get a stable reliable connection overall.
There are two supermarkets nearby and the polish restaurant under the apartments is quite good with a friendly staff, which was a plus :)

We stayed in the studio apartment. Decent size, but the kitchenette didn't have any counter space, so a bit difficult if you want to prepare your own food.
Wifi was a bit slow. we only got around 20-25mbps while we ere there. Could be fine for some, but we had work and many video calls.
The bed was very comfortable and we appreciated the keyless entry everywhere.
The outdoor window covers sometimes randomly open and shut while we were there.
Overall a good choice. Would have been a 5 star if those minor things were better.
Gut gelegene kleine Wohnung. Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt. An mancher Stelle etwas staubig. Umgebung sehr ruhig.

Sven's place is recommended if you are travelling to Berlin. Sven himself was a helpful host which provided us any support needed on different issues such as check-in, check-out and tips on travelling. The place was beautiful and cosy and was near to different stations too. Will definitely come back to this place if we will come back to Berlin.

Der Aufenthalt bei Nikolas war wirklich toll! Das Zimmer ist klein aber gemütlich eingerichtet, alles war sauber, ordentlich und wie beschrieben.
Vor der Tür gibt es einen Bereich mit Kühlschrank, Kaffeemaschine und Mikrowelle inkl. Geschirr, was zur einfachen Verpflegung echt praktisch ist.
Besonders gefallen hat mir das eigene Badezimmer, welches für diesen Preis keineswegs selbstverständlich ist.
Die Lage ist besser als man vermuten mag, man erreicht in 15-30 Minuten viele zentrale Orte Berlins und der Takt der Öffis ist zu jeder Tageszeit super.
Nikolas ist ein überaus freundlicher, unkomplizierter und proaktiver Gastgeber, der so einen schönen Aufenthalt ermöglicht.
Ich kann diese Unterkunft nur wärmstens empfehlen.

Great space kinda hard to get up in the stairs all the time but you get used to this. Any other thing was quiet perfect and the terrace is amazing!!! Carsten is a great host so you guys should really enjoy your stay!
Great Air BNB
Very cool apartment to have a stay in. Comes packaged with great hosts!

Kann ich nur weiter empfehlen!
Gute Unterkunft mit netter Gastgeberin in großartiger Lage - mit Öffis sehr gut verbunden und dennoch in schöner, grüner Lage. Gerade mit Kindern optimal.

The perfect base for exploring Berlin, with all the lively, fascinating gems of Kreuzberg all around this location. We loved the neighborhood, the fun and comfortable studio and Fritz was a responsive and extremely friendly and accommodating host. So glad we picked this spot.

Ein großes Appartement mit separatem Eingang und der Möglichkeit, bei gutem Wetter, draußen zu sitzen und zu essen.
Gut ausgestattet, mit allem was nötig ist.
Gute, ruhige Lage.

Very stylish space in a very desirable part of the City. Communication was easy and the apartment was perfect for a week’s stay. Less than ten minute walk to two different subway stations. In a wonderfully quiet neighborhood that’s still close to restaurants and shops and easy to get to different parts of the city. Would definitely stay again.
Very Nice house with welcoming hosts :-)

Fabulous stay in a spotless and stylish apartment which is full of character. Friendly neighbourhood, a supermarket next door and two tram lines in easy walking distance. Apartment has everything you need and the comfort gor relaxing after a long day sight seeing. Jun was very helpful with excellent communication before and during our stay. Highly recommended.
Great host, good organisation, everything went smoothly; we absolutely recommend hosts and apartment.

Great apartment! Very spacious with high ceilings and lots of light. Big comfy sofa, well equipped kitchen, spacious bedroom. Just a couple of minutes walk to several transport options, we thought the location was great. Very quiet so slept very well too!
Schöne Wohnung mit tollem Innenhof, sehr gemütlich eingerichtet, alles da was man benötigt und wie es beschrieben ist. Gerne wieder!
Nice and neat. Main attractions were accessible by foot. We walked everywhere. Nice dining options close by. We very much enjoyed our stay at Jun’s place
Beautiful, spacious apartment, centrally located. We had a great stay
Nice place, close to public transportation and stores.

Eine solide Wohnung mit allem drin, was wir benötigten für ein paar Tage. Der Ceck-in und die Kommunikation verlief einwandfrei.
Die Wohnung dürfte für mich mal etwas überholt werden da es meines Erachtens nach, ein paar Mängel gab (z.b durchgelegene Kissen) die leicht zu beheben sind. Ansonsten war die Lage auch in Ordnung und wir kamen überall gut hin.
Sehr herzlicher Empfang, sehr gemütlich und wunderbar zentral gelegen. Komme gerne mal wieder!

Excellent location. The buses were on strike one day and I was able to walk from the airport. Wonderful place to stay!  Host was supper communicative!  Beautiful flowers when we got there plus cold beverages. Very easy instructions from airport to flat via metro. Loved it and would stay again!
Amazing place! Clean, comfortable and large room. Location in the best neighborhood in Berlin! Very nice hosts and great communication. Would definitely recommend this place to everyone!

Vero handicap sono le molte scale per salire quasi al 5° piano, la palazzina è riservata, pulita e non si percepisce il traffico. Our stay at Jorge‘s apartment was fabulous! He was super friendly & clear with instructions and also extremely responsive whenever we had a question (or problem😅). Total sauber, sehr modern und tolle Lage. Nur zu empfehlen!

Thank you very much for hosting me. I had a great stay at Ellen’s! Easy check in, lovely place!

We had a wonderful stay at Madlen’s place. The place was sparkling clean, it has a lot of attention to details and we had all the amenties whe needed (cofee, shampoo, deodorant, toothpaste). The location is 15 minutes by tram to the city center. We highly recommend this place!

Als ich ankam, war die Rezi noch besetzt. Der Mitarbeiter war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Das Zimmer war groß und zweckmäßig eingerichtet und recht wohnlich. Fast alles was man in dem Appartement bedienen möchte, wird über ein Touchpanel an der Wand gesteuert, so z.B. die Lampen, Vorhänge und Temperatur. Für Menschen die mit Smarthomes noch keine Erfahrung haben, ist dies eine Herausforderung. Es gibt einen Erklärungsordner, der aber versteckt im Regal lag und den ich erst am zweiten Tag entdeckt habe. Außerdem gibt es eine smarte Toilette, die einem den Po duscht und fönt (wenn man es will). Habe mich nach anfänglichen Problemen darauf verlegt, alles spielerisch zu erkunden. Bei geschlossenen Fenstern ist sehr leise.

Das Apartment war mit allem ausgestattet, was man für eine größere Gruppe benötigt. Der Check-In sowieso der Check-Out verliefen sehr reibungslos. Mit der U-Bahn-Station um die Ecke ist man bestens an das BVG-Netz angebunden.
The flat is very nice and right near the park which is perfect for the kids! Communication with Boris was extra smooth.
Proper en net verblijf. Ideaal met 2
Nice apartment, great communication, would visit again!

Très bon séjour à berlin, l'appartement est conforme à l'annonce. Localisation légèrement excentré mais très bien relié avec metro et Sbahn. Zito est très arrangeant et joignable facilement si besoin.

Nice option to stay when visiting Berlin. Location is very good, close to U-bahn, supermarket and restaurants.
Nice place with a friendly host who always replies quickly. Would recommend.
Perfect stay, as always! Thank you so much Fulvia. See you soon!

Beautiful space in what appears to be a newly converted unit. The whole space is just lovely and a very good location. We would have no problem in recommending this appartment. The location was perfect for us as we like to walk. We were only 20-25 minutes fro Alexander Platz where there are plenty of shops, bars and restaurants. from there you can easily walk to Museum Island and on to Unter Den Linden. Most places are within 1 hour of the appartment although some you will have to take a tram or U Bahn.
We did have a few issues which we are sure Celly will sort out, nothing major which would stop us recommending the place. I will list them here just so you can see that they have improved. There was no hairdrier (you can tell this is a mans appartment), also no cups so we had to make coffee in glasses. The kettle did not work so we had to boil the water in a saucepan. A previous guest stole the TV controller so this was not usable.
We would suggest a shelf in the shower (which is great by the way) for shampoo and shower gel this is not so important but would be a nice touch. What really is lacking though is a guest reference book with recomendations for restaurants, good bars with or without music, palces of interest, map etc. I realise that even if this is supplied it may well be stolen! But a ring binder with paper slipped in could easily be replaced.
One last tip, do not rely on the R7 to get you back to the airport, we got this from the airport without a problem but the return today was a nightmare. Our early train was cancelled and the next one stopped at the next station. We then had to wait for the S9 but our ticket was not transferable. We go to the airport just in time, by the time we got through security and got to the gate we had 5 minutes and we boarded. No one in the sttaion knew why the R7 was not running!

Wir werden ganz sicher die Wohnung wieder buchen, wenn sie bei unserer nächsten Berlinreise frei ist.

Great place! very clean. Stylish. And BIG!

The apartment was really big, clean and we had everything we could need. A really great place to stay, we were made to feel really welcome and I would highly recommend staying here in the future.

Clean and quiet place. Feels like home. I am very happy about stay. Beautiful and friendly caffe shop witn nice meal very close. Fantastic coffe!
I am planning to come back to this apartment for my next stay I Berlin.

Clean, comfortable and an all round great stay. Francesco told us everything we needed to know and was very helpful throughout.

Neukolln is perfect mix of lively, cheap, well-connected, close to great cafes and nightlife, and as far as possible from the crowds of Alexanderplatz/Mitte.
11/10 would stay again.
La casa de Jonas está en una excelente ubicación. Es tal cual como se ve y cercano a metro y supermercados. Sector tranquilo y Jonas un excelente anfitrión.

Super toll eingerichtete Wohnung, super zentrale Lage, alles vor Ort wqs man braucht und die Nachbarschaft ist auch recht ruhig. Check-in und out verlief schnell und unkompliziert.
Excellent place to stay in Berlin! Clean, tidy and great if you value privacy and quiet.

Really nice Place in The Center of prenzelauer Berg!

Personal sehr freundlich. U-Bahn in der Nähe. Für 2-3 Nächte ok.

Clean, modernized apartment and comfortable place. This area has well-connected transportation for the most popular sights in Berlin.  Jörg is a Superhost truly. Everything was wonderful and effortless with regard to communication.
perfect staying at Erez's nice apartment

Die Wohnung ist wie beschrieben. Sehr liebevoll eingerichtet, sodass man sich direkt wohl fühlt. Die Lage der Wohnung ist einzigartig, sehr zentral und trotzdem sehr ruhig. Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt und einen guten Kontakt zu Carsten und Jessica!
Als ik zou ooit terug kom naar Berlijn dan kom in de zelfde adres weer terecht! Super bedankt!

Kristian’s place was the perfect spot from which to explore Christmas markets all over Berlin. It is conveniently located near public transport that took us all over the city. I had the BEST time in Schenjas apartment. Nice and clean facilities, privacy, garden space, nice building, spacious apartment, kind host, warm and welcoming place, great neighbourhood.

Much love ✌🏽✌🏽❤️
Prettig rustig appartement in een fijne wijk van Berlijn. Veel ruimte, een goed bed en alles netjes en schoon.

Tina var fantastisk, väldigt mysig lägenhet och toppen utsikt med solläge hela dagen på balkongen. Perfekt läge att bo i Berlin ansåg jag :)

Saubere schöne Wohnung in Berlin mit guter Lage und Versorgung in nächster Umgebung. Ein Toaster für das Frühstück wäre noch eine gute Ergänzung.

Great location and staff.
Good location for the single traveller with close transport links. Very clean room and bathroom. Very responsive hosts.

It's an easy stroll up the canal to Museum Island, and an easy 2-minute walk to a U-Bahn station. The gallery was great - perfect for my family of 5. Logement très bien situé dans Berlin, l'appartement est très lumineux et tout équipé ! Et les lits sont confortables
Das Airbnb war super. Ich und meine Freunde haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
We had a lovely stay in Simon's apartement! Very clean, spacious, great location (close to yummy restaurants and fun bars) :) I would 100% recommend!
Our stay was great. Moritz and Kinga are both very welcoming and generous hosts. The apartment is really spacious, comfortable and well located to explore Berlin. Highly recommended!
Great place to stay! Perfect location being right next to Checkpoint Charlie and within walking distance of a lot of great restaurants, bakeries, and coffee shops. Super clean and amazing staff!
Excelente todo,muchas gracias abrazo

Die Wohnung liegt perfekt in ruhiger zweiter Reihe zur Kantstraße. Die Ausstattung der Unterkunft lässt keine Wünsche offen - sauber, gepflegt, wie man es sich vorstellt. Eine wunderbare Location um Berlin zu erkunden und kulinarische Vielfalt (Kantstraße) zu genießen.
War ein super Aufenthalt bei Farid! Er war immer direkt für Fragen erreichbar und sehr hilfsbereit! Wir kommen gerne wieder:)
Very cool and comfortable space with unique artistic touches! Would definitely stay here again. Hosts leave very helpful information on the local area.

Carolina's apartment is lovely, very pleasant and clean, and located in a very cool neighborhood, the very trendy Prenzlauer Berg. Definitely recommended!

we stayed 4 nights there. rooms are very clean. walking distance from Alexanderplatz. there is an amazing bakery nearby as well, it's called "zeit für brot".
we are very happy with our stay.

Eine sehr schöne Wohnung, mit einer Top Lage! Einen Supermarkt direkt gegenüber der Wohnung - perfekt!

Great location in the former "East", perfect for 4 people. Lots of space, big kitchen. Many cool restaurants, cafés, shops in walking distance, close to Alexander Platz. Travel with public transport works perfectly as U-Bahn station just opposite the apartment.
Value for money! The perfect suite for us and the dogs.

Liebe Barbara.. Herzlichen Dank fuer dein hervorragendes Fruehstueck, deine Gastfreundschaft und die tolle Unterkunft, in der wir uns sehr wohl gefühlt haben... Kommen jederzeit gerne zurück... LG Frank

The apartment was in great location near Alexander Plaza. Two rooms, the second room had the kitchen table located. Beautiful high rooms with wide windowsills. Multiple mirrors were useful while we had two women make up at mornings.
sehr netter Gastgeber, es gab nichts zu bemängeln.

Jetty and her sister Katja were seriously the best hosts one could hope for! They were friendly, generous and incredibly helpful which made me feel immediately at home. Alles super

The room was small, but it got all you need. Even though it is a shared bathroom, you don’t bother each other. The location was perfect, lots of cute coffee spots and restaurants around the corner. Communication was perfect. Would recommend!
Great spot and fantastic host! Couldn’t have asked for more. He also held my luggage for me in his nearby shop after check out so I could walk around without it.

The apartment was nice, comfy, and clean. It was very safe and well located, very closed to bus and train stations. Oliver was very nice, made us feel very comfortable. I and my family recommend this room, and will stayif we go again to Berlin.

Très chouette séjour dans cet appartement cosy dans un quartier animé, où les restaurants et les bars sont accessibles à pied. La station de métro la plus proche est à 3 minutes et permet d’accéder a l’Alexanderplatz en 15 minutes
Mohammad et sa partenaire ont été très accueillants et ont su nous donner les meilleurs conseils pour trouver des choses à faire tout en étant très discrets et en laissant une parfaite intimité

Nice apt in the center of Berlin.

Martin’ house is much better than I expected.  Thank Tim for the warm reception and clear description.  We will come back again if a chance to Berlin again.

everything was fine. I'll recommend.

Very friendly hosts. The recommendations for restaurant and bars are fantastic.

You can see the amount of love and care that’s been put in Lana’s and Paul get-away in Berlin.
Situated in bustling Kreuzberg, with it’s grungy café’s, inspiring shops and people from all walks of life - you do feel like you in the 90s New York of Europe.
Berlin has something that I can only describe as freedom.
And you can explore all of that from this little hide-out, hidden behind this little red door you’ll find a place catered to your needs. The original woodwork is beautifuly renovated, actually, there is so much attention to detail, that you might think that an interior architect did the place for Lana & Paul.
The only downside i can mention is that the hot-water runs out quick, but since we are in Berlin, and everyone is an activist, they might did that on purpose, we are the environment, and we need to cherish it, so no long showers.
Thank you Lana & Paul, we really enjoyed our stay.
nice and kind host. the room is also nice.

We liked some things about this flat; it was very clean, had all kitchen utensils, a nice bathtub, and a great location. But it was all ruined because of the lock in the door. It was just impossible to open with our keys! We tried both the keys, a hundred times, and eventually a bar keeper had to open it for us. And when we tried to talk to the host about it, we couldn't reach them. And they were not very helpful. As a result, one of us always had to stay in the flat to open for the other. This is just not acceptable. That's why we decided to move after two days. Also, the bed was very uncomfortable, and there's a bar just outside that is open all night. So no sleep. If we visit Berlin for the next time, we would love to stay with them again.
Location is good, and the place is nice. Etienne was not very communicative.
Sehr zentral, um das  Viertel live und hautnah zu erkunden und erleben! 👍

Goede locatie om Berlijn te beleven buiten het toeristengebied en nieuwe plekken te ontdekken. Goed toegankelijk met het openbaar vervoer, op 20-30 minuten van het Hbf. Ruime keuze horeca, supermarkten en winkels in de omgeving.
Appartement ligt rustig tussen 2 binnentuinen in het achterhuis, functioneel ingedeeld en goed uitgerust. Vriendelijke buren. Openen en sluiten van de deuren met onze telefoons was een nieuwe ervaring voor ons - het werkte goed met de Nukiapp.
Communicatie met Robin was vlot en duidelijk.
Kortom, een fijne plek in een leuke wijk.

The place is very nice. And we really enjoyed . We will come back again.

El apartamento es muy lindo, está bien ubicado y equipado, se encuentra cerca de muchos lugares interesantes y en una zona tranquila de noche. Es limpio, organizado y acogedor. Ein ganz liebevoll eingerichtetes Zimmer, an alles wurde gedacht. Der Checkin unkompliziert, unabhängig von festen Zeiten. Wir kommen ganz sicher gerne wieder!

Overall great place and Michael and Mail’s were great hosts!

Really good location and easy to reach. Lots of great groceries and resto near to the apartment. Don’t miss the chance to try some ice cream at the Eispatisserie Hokey Pokey Boutique. We love it.
The host is a really nice person and willing to help with all needed. Everything was just perfect.
Schönes großes Zimmer, Christiane war sehr klar in ihre Kommunikation und es war im allgemeinen sehr angenehm. Tolle Lage, gerne wieder!
Unterkunft ist sehr gut. Einloggen einfach. Gute Lage

This unit is clean, neat, and in a great neighborhood. Loads of cafes, restaurants, and bars nearby. Unit has a good kitchen, so you can take advantage of the grocery stores. Diarmaid’s place was a really lovely base, with great communication from the host and lots of lovely touches they made us feel really welcome, check in was easy and the location was great. There was also a super useful map on the fridge with loads of hints and tips of areas to visit that we might never had known about, that really helped to shape our stay.
Muchas gracias por su hospitalidad y amabilidad. Recomiendo al 100%

Well located apartment and very clean. Kevin and Caroline were very helpful and we had a great time in Berlin thanks to their recommendations.
If you are looking for a nice weekend in Berlin, this apartment is ideal for that.

Het is een ruim appartement, geschikt voor meerdere personen. Leuk ingericht en een goede inventaris. Heel fijn dat er meerdere badkamers zijn. De ontvangst en het afscheid waren prettig en persoonlijk. Het contact met Olivier via de app was altijd snel.

The room was just a two minute walk from the station which was really useful and made it very easy to find! Our roommates were very kind and respectful, and so was our host! It was a nice spacious room and I'd highly recommend!!

Beautifully decorated apartment in the heart of Kreuzberg, with lots of cafes and attractions within walking distance. The large beds were super comfortable for our group of four, with room for more. Amazing wow beautiful

First of all, checking in was very simple, Calin was responsive whenever I texted. The apartment easy to find and all. Location is also nice, very easy to access the metro, or just walk 10 minutes and end up on the east side. Eventhough the apartment was decorated well, and it felt like home, we realised that it was a bit too expensive for the that time of the year (May) and considering there's a room that's always closed but we get an air mattress for a third person, not even a sofa bed or something relaxing, made the homey experience vanish. the water heater does not keep the water hot for long, and definitely not enough for 3 people staying there.
since we pay so much for cleaning fees on airbnb now, we decided to leave the dishes and didn't take out the garbage, hope that didn't upset our hosts much.
I really believe this apartment could be a gem in Berlin if the Calin fixed these issues for a 3 person stay.

Daniela was great, very flexible, allowed a very early check in due to my early flight. She met me and gave great explanations for appliances. Accommodated request for additional pillow case and towel, brought them the same day. Checked in during the stay, answered questions as they came up. Gave suggestions for local eateries, shops, points of interest. The location is central and many sights are within walking distance or a quick ride by train. Great stay!
A nice clean room, just like in the pictures and description. The host was very friendly and responsive, giving clear instructions on how to get to the apartment. Overall a lovely stay.
Beautiful and cozy place, balcony with a really nice view! Climbing the stairs five floors was a bit rough but totally worth it.
Eine schöne Wohnung am Rande Berlins. Man ist in kurzer Zeit im Zentrum  Berlin genauso wie zum baden am Müggelsee oder anderen Seen.
L'appartement est lumineux, la terrasse est appréciée, le bain aussi. Super quartier avec les meilleurs beignes en bas. Josephine a ete super !
Beate ist eine wunderbare Gastgeberin. Herzlich, hilfsbereit und freundlich. Ich habe mich außerordentlich wohl gefühlt bei ihr und ihrer Familie. Vielen Dank für alles!

Till war sehr zuvorkommend und freundlich. Die Wohnung ist sehr hell und sauber und wir hatten es durch die zentrale Lage sehr einfach die Stadt besichtigen.
Die Ausstattung ist wie auf den Bildern und wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt.

Das Singer Hostel wirkt wirklich eher wie ein Hotel, es ist super schön eingerichtet und das Zimmer ist ziemlich gross und hat sogar eine kleine Küche. Alles war sauber und gemütlich. Das Personal ist auch sehr freundlich und hilfreich. Wir haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen und kommen beim nächsten Berlin-Besuch auf jeden Fall wieder!

Modernized apartment in an charming old building. Very clean with a good amount of space. The location is great. Very close to the tram and U. Prenzlauer Berg is a great neighborhood to hang out, plenty of cafe and restaurants.

Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt am Müggelsee.
Die Wohnung ist sehr groß, modern und direkt am See! Viele Badestellen sowie Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind zu Fuß erreichbar.
Silke war eine tolle Gastgeberin!

El alojamiento es muy amplio y moderno. Está muy bien comunicado, con paradas próximas de bus, metro y S. El barrio es tranquilo y hay varios supermercados y restaurantes. Echamos de menos algún canal internacional de televisión pero es un alojamiento recomendable para disfrutar de unos días en Berlín.

Andrea ist eine wunderbare Gastgeberin. Ich wurde sehr herzlich empfangen und fühlte mich wie Zuhause. Sie ist sehr offen, hilfsbereit und der Service ist einmalig.  Das Zimmer ist gemütlich, mitten im Grünen, ruhig gelegen, gepflegt und dennoch gut mit der S-Bahn zu erreichen. Wenn man möchte, gibt es sogar ein Frühstück im Garten :) . Ich bin völlig begeistert und kann diese Unterkunft nur wärmstens empfehlen. Vielen lieben Dank Andrea.
Muy cómoda y bien localizada. Si vuelvo repetiré.
Great value in a fantastic location. Thank you so much Alan and Kasia!

Rigtig god beliggenhed midt i byen.
Beliggenhed giver naturligt noget støj. Desværre var vinduerne ikke støjtætte.
Seng og sofa var meget behagelig.
Lejligheden var ekstremt varm. Selv på overskyede dage og om natten var det ulideligt varmt, og man var nødt til at have åbne vinduer, hvilket lukkede støj og lys ind.
Wifi forbindelsen var dårlig.
Værten var meget venlig og hjælpsom.
Desværre var lejligheden støvet, særligt badeværelset, da vi ankom.

Brilliant apartment. Had everything we needed & the perfect location for us as we have family nearby.
Check in was easy & we had plenty of towels and linen.
The kitchen had everything needed.
A comfortable stay and a great flexible contactable host. Thank you
Wir kommen wieder:-)
nice place, close to trams, had a blast!
Great hostel to crash at if you're exploring Berlin. Bathrooms were clean and the rooms were also kept clean by the house keeping regularly.
Just as adverticed. Thumbs up

For one night / a stopover this would be fine, however for longer than that I would suggest finding a budget hotel or something similar, due to problems with the doors in the shared bathrooms. At one point, both toilet doors were broken, making it quite uncomfortable when you’re sharing the space with strangers. It was cleaned everyday but unfortunately there are issues that need to be fixed by a maintenance person, everything could do with a repaint etc. The location is good for exploring Berlin. There is noise from the street and people staying in the other rooms but that can’t be helped. Host was responsive and helpful.
Not the safest location to stay in. Apartment was okay.

We really enjoyed our weekend at Laurie's place. Everything went as expected and completely without a hitch. The location is really good, close to different hotspots of Charlottenburg (central West Berlin), lots of transportation options, and a nice park with a lake nearby. Close to the autobahn and an SBahn stop and yet very quiet and green. The host was very nice. The place is very homey and had everything we could have needed. We could rest very well.  The cats very friendly and a welcome feature. We would definitely recommend the place for a stay with the locals.

Till is very nice, alright area, everything was clean and easy. A bit expensive for what you get, but nothing too bad. The bedsheets, pillows and duvet was very weird and not very comfortable. So the sleeping experience isn't amazing, which is what drags it down to 3 stars

The room was very nice and clean when we arrived, it was very comfortable.  The apartment was in a perfect location, a great neighborhood with lots to do and explore.  We were unaware of the extra cost for bedding and the Berlin tax, so it would have been easier to have that simply included in our initial charge.  Other than that, it was a good place to stay in Berlin!

Die Wohnung war groß und sehr hell (vor allem am frühen Morgen). Die Lage ist gut. Man braucht ca fünf Minuten zur nächsten U-Bahnstation. Der Spätkauf vor Ort hat auch noch ein Bierchen zur späten Abendstunde parat. Die beiden Bäder (Badewanne und WC) waren einigermaßen sauber. Eine große Küche ist ebenfalls vorhanden, die wir aber als gute Touristen nicht genutzt haben :)
Der Balkon ist klein aber fein. So wie er aussah, wird er aber selten benutzt.
Im großen und ganzen eine solide Wohnung, die alles zu bieten hat, was man für einen Kurztripp braucht.

Lola’s place is unique, stylish and perfectly located. My partner and I were able to access all areas of the city easily and quickly. It was so nice to stay in an apartment where so much effort has been put into giving it character and individuality. Highly recommend!
I thought it was new, it isn’t. There were stains, cigarette smell, room wasn’t like the photos. Apart of that it was ok, great location, good  and friendly communication.
Wir hatte eine gute Zeit in dem Appartement. Vor allem der flexible Check-in und die Lage waren super. Wir können Numa weiterempfehlen :)
Great place with nice location and easy access to the city. Maybe it lacks a bit of natural light but it's a wonderful place to stay in Berlin

Wir haben in dem Haus ein unglaublich tolles Wochenende verbracht (7 Personen) und uns Dank Terrasse, Sommer-Wetter und Einrichtung/Deko gefühlt wie im Kurzurlaub in Italien! Wunderbar und empfehlenswert! 😊
Super Kommunikation, Wohnung ist sehr sauber und ordentlich. Außerdem eine gute Anbindung an Bus und Bahn.
Leuk appartementje.  Prima plek

Guillaume was very welcoming and his place is super cozy! We loved staying there and had no problems. We had control of heat which was nice too. He gave us some indoor slippers to use and allowed us to use his washing machine and even cleared a space and turned the heat up so we could dry our clothes overnight. I have no complaints at all and wish we had stayed longer in Berlin! The UBahn is very close and there is a bus stop that is nearby as well.

Ivos was an incredible responsive and helpful host. We were able to leave our bags before our check in time which we really appreciated. He also gave us local recommendations which were really helpful. The space was clean and in a great location. I highly recommend staying here
Es war mal wieder super bei Hannes. Kann die Wohnung nur empfehlen, wie auf den Fotos sehr schön eingerichtet und großzügig. Lage ist top und Hannes ein sehr guter Host.
Easy check in, great location and clean apartment! Thank you for a great stay!

stylish apartment in a reasonsbly central location. managed by a company not an owner so lacking some of the personal touches. the entry doorlock is very difficult to operate, requires two hands plus a flashlight to see the tumbler numbers since there is no light above the door. however, we would stay there again so our experience overall was positive.

Nadim was an excellent host! He was able to accommodate my early arrival last minute, and has even helped ship me a personal item I accidentally left in his apartment. I felt very comfortable communicating with him. His place itself was also tidy and provided all I needed for my stay in Berlin.
The room is very clean and Andrea is very friendly and nice. The location is close to Olympic stadium.
Ben was a great host! He was so accommodating to me and my needs. The apartment is in a great neighborhood, felt very safe and close to many good shops and restaurants!
its a good accommodation in Berlin, near to the underground station, and it easy to find by Uber. The owner provide food for us. It’s a good experience in Berlin

Sehr freundliche Gastgeberinnen und top Lage. Man kennt's am Kotti: kulinarisch super, Leute nett, aber auch entsprechend laut. Ist eben nicht außerhalb.
Insgesamt merkt man, dass sich im Gebäude und der Wohnung in den letzten Jahren nicht so viel getan hat, alles etwas alt und abgewohnt. Preis/Leistung trotzdem schwer zu schlagen.
Immer wieder gern👍
Tolle Unterkunft, super Lage. Alles sauber. Super ausgestattet.
Me and my friends had an amazing stay! The experience was fantastic. The staff were incredibly friendly and the space was clean and well-maintained. Highly recommend!

Super schönes saubers Ferienhaus mit Terrasse und ruhigen idyllischem Innenhof, Einkaufen fürs gemeinsame Kochen und Bäcker direkt fußläufig erreichbar, nächste Straßenbahnhaltestelle auch gleich ums Eck. Kommunikation und Kontakt mit den Gastgebern super! Sehr zu empfehlen!

Fantastic, quirky, stylish apartment. Short walk to the U-bahn, with short trip to get into central Berlin. Martin is a great host, very welcoming and touches like milk for tea and coffee were very much appriciated. We would certainly stay again.
To be recommended. Very nice apartment.

Great deal and great location. Had a change to meet lots of new people, and the vibe is also nice. But it's not the perfect place for privacy of course. Highly recommend if you're looking for a cheap place to stay in Berlin.

My stay at Mike’s was amazing, everything is clean, the appartement is so beautiful, the room is spacious, and Mike was so Flexible with Time of check-in, even when i got there so late…
I recommend it so much ✨
Komme sehr gerne wieder 🫶

Alex's place does give a very chill homely Berlin vibe. It's very close to public transportation and a LOT of very good cafes and restaurants at walking distance. He was a really chill host, welcoming and guided me on the hot spots of berlin. I highly recommend his place!

Mein bf und ich haben bei Rebecca eingecheckt, uns hat alles gefallen, alle Annehmlichkeiten sind vorhanden, es ist natürlich schade, dass YouTube nicht funktioniert hat, das WLAN war etwas schlecht, aber alles war in Ordnung, die Gastgeberin war freundlich, sie begrüßte uns und zeigte uns alles🤗

If you want privacy, it's a "bed-sit" but a very very nice, spotless, spacious, fresh-as-a-bright-new-pin apartment with all mod cons you could wish for. It is super-convenient in terms of location (subway, shops, cafes, pubs)  and being only on the first floor. The host is extremely helpful and prompt in responding to any requests. It could comfortably sleep four family members or good friends if required.  The living room/bedroom,  bathroom, bedroom and utilities room are all large, bright and contemporary.  For tourists only staying a few days, it wouldn't hurt to give a short list of the very good local cafes/ restaurants: the Turkish one on the corner, the Thai one around the corner, the excellent bakery / cafe chain near the subway. Birgit is a great, thoughtful and responsive host.
Koht oli puhas, voodid mugavad, kõik masinad töötasid ja omanik vastas vajadusel kiiresti.

Very nice flat, comfortable, good light, nice balcony outside with plants. Had everything I needed. Peggy communicated well, everything worked and was a pretty and inviting space beautiful space. There are restaurants , bars, and convenience stores right downstairs,  it can be a tad loud late night/early morning, just be careful coming in/out as it’s Berlin right outside, but a good place to stay and very much enjoyed while I was here the flat is very nice.

Michael's apartment is great! Is really well located close to many important places of Berlin. The flat comfortable, was clean and has a beautiful view!
We didn't meet Michael but he was in contact with us all the time and answered every question we made. I completely recommend Michael´s flat.
Thank you for everything Michael and good luck on sunday in the world cup! ;)

Für ein Wochenende in Berlin ist es ein gutes und günstiges Apartment, bei dem das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis stimmt. Jeder hat seine eigene Toilette und Dusche, was sich in unserem Fall als schwierig rausstellte, da unsere Toilettenspülung nicht richtig funktioniert hat und es keine alternative Toilette gab. Auch ist dieses Apartment sehr hellhörig.

Elisa's apartment was perfect for our Berlin stay! The space is bigger than it looks in the photos and has everything we needed. The neighborhood is great and offers great food, drink, and access to transit. We'd love to visit again!
Хорошая чистая квартира. Тихий район. хороший интернет. Магазин близко.  Но надо рассчитывать что до центра Берлина очень далеко.  В данном районе очень много жителей других государств

Die Wohnung besticht durch ihre gute zentrale Lage und die Nähe zur U- Bahn. Trotz der vielen Kneipen und Gaststätten in der Umgebung ist es ruhig. Die Wohnung ist geräumig und bietet ausreichend Platz für vier bis fünf Personen. Der Wohn/Schlafraum ist als drittes Schlafzimmer gut nutzbar. Die Dusche hat einen perfekten Wasserdruck. Das Waschbecken ist etwas klein, sieht aber schaut hübsch nostalgisch aus. Ich habe Pflegeprodukte im Bad vermisst. Die Küche ist gut ausgestattet mit ausreichend Geschirr für mehrere Personen.
Die Einrichtung ist zweckmäßig, entspricht aber nicht mehr ganz der auf den Fotos (weniger heimelig). Sofas und Sessel im Wohnzimmer waren fleckig. Der Boden war sauber, aber etwas abgewohnt. Insgesamt eine gute und empfehlenswerte Unterkunft. Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt.
Super Hotel mittendrin in der Stadt. Ist auf jeden Fall zu empfehlen.
Im großen und ganzen alles super, sehr einfaches check-in.
Alles so wie beschrieben. Perfekte Absprache beim Anreisen sodass alles reibungslos verlaufen ist.

Tolle Location die bis auf die direkten Airbnb Nachbarn auch sehr leise ist. Die Lage in Kreuzberg ist auch prima.
Bei Sauberkeit und Beleuchtung ist noch Luft nach oben und ehrlicherweise sollten mal ein paar aktuelle Fotos eingestellt werden.
it was all good. it is what it says it is. Simon welcomed us in and was so kind to allow us to stay a couple of hours axtra as there was no extra booking.
Werner was great! Our stay was wonderful!
Emilia est l'hôte la plus gentille qui soit. Elle m'a accueilli avec un café et une agréable conversation. Le logement est parfait, propre, il ne manque de rien. Vous ne trouverez pas mieux à Berlin!
Perfect home away from home. Would come back again!
Ho trovato minimal hostel molto pulito e accogliente, ottima ospitalità nel quartiere a mio avviso migliore di Berlino, consigliato vivamente
Merkeze yakın, ulaşımı kolay, restoranlara ve marketlere yakın bir yerdeydi. Daire temiz ve kullanıma hazırdı. Jan bütün sorularımıza en kısa sürede cevap verdi. Her şey için teşekkürler Jan.
Schickes, sauberes Appartement mit allem was man für ein Wochenende in Berlin braucht. Exzellente Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr.

We were very pleased with the stay at Antje's home during our 2 week workation in Berlin. Antje was a wonderful host. The place was clean, spacious and very comfortable for two people for remote working (separate work rooms).
Very calm, safe and peaceful neighbourhood (slept without any disturbances). The district is extremely beautiful, green, so we felt harmony and peace there. Lots of nearby restaurants, grocery shops, which can be reached on foot/bicycle/car. The city centre can be reached by car or by train (the station is 5min away from apartment; takes approx. 45min to get to city centre).
Overall - felt like home. Recommend.

Sehr schöne Wohnung, genau wie auf den Bildern zu sehen. Wir haben ein langes Wochenende dort verbracht und würden jederzeit wieder kommen.
Coole Lage, unzählige Cafes und Restaurants in der Nähe und Haltestelle direkt vor der Tür.

Liebe Berlinbesucherin, lieber Berlinbesucher, falls ihr die Stadt entdecken wollt, so könnt ihr euch auf eine zentral gelegene Wohnung freuen, Nähe Alex und der U- Bahnstation😊Es gibt in unmittelbarer Nähe diverse Lokals, wo man sich auch wunderbar verpflegen kann. Und trotz der zentralen Lage ist es super ruhig in der Wohnung, perfekt für einen guten Schlaf 😊Die Wohnung ist zudem wunderbar ausgestattet, du kannst selbst Tee machen, eine Kaffeemaschine nutzen, eine Mikrowelle und, und und 😊Stéphanie hat uns sehr lieb willkommen geheissen und hat uns während dem Aufenthalt unsere Fragen rasch beantwortet und sogar Tickets ausgedruckt. Die Wohnung war für zwei Personen gut geeignet. Viel Spass beim Aufenthalt😊
Une auberge de jeunesse très agréable. On peut cuisiner dans un grand confort. Les lespaces sont cosy
great location and beautiful air b and b. tracy was very kind and responsive. checking in and out was easy; and she made our time in berlin very pleasant. thank you.
Ich hatte einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und ordentlich. :) Anthony ist super freundlich und hat immer schnell geantwortet.

Great place to stay. Lots to do.  Near the buses and subway which Google maps will help you with.  The apt is beautiful.  Don’t hesitate because of the no air conditioning.  Open the windows and it cools off nicely.  Especially at night. My only caution about this place is the stairs.  If you have a preexisting medical condition, it may not be right for you.  It is on the 6th floor.  The elevator is secured with a thumb print device.  You cannot use it.  Fortunately someone will greet you day one and let you know up with your luggage.  The rest of the time you have to climb the stairs.  Other than that, the place is great.  Highly recommended.
Super unkomplizierter Check-In und ein sehr schönes Appartment mit genügend Platz und Stauraum. Wir würden wieder kommen! 😊

The location was quite central. The host was very communicative, there was a little issue with the app during the check in, host helped me quickly. One thing to consider is that, there is no elevator, when you have heavy baggage it can be a quite the exercise. Around there are lots of restaurants and markets.

We didn't had the opportunity to meet Nassa, but his dad helped in with the smooth check in. The location was near the trams so it was easy to get around.
We stayed for 3 nights, 3 persons. The picture in Airbnb was exactly the same as the place. We liked the room concept - high ceiling, nicely furnished. Towels were provided. The kitchen was perfect for cooking light meals as the basics were provided - salt, pepper, etc.. However, the flooring was quite dusty even after we wiped it. We wished it was vacuumed/mopped as we prefer having bare footed at home to respect the apartment. The couch was a bit dusty too. All in all, it was a pleasant stay :)

Die Unterkunft liegt direkt am Ostkreuz, sehr gut erreichbar mit vielen Restaurants direkt in der Straße.
Die Wohnung ist liebevoll eingerichtet, alles wie beschrieben, sauber und gemütlich. Durch die Nähe zum Ostkreuz hört man abends/nachts und ab morgens die Züge & Durchsagen recht laut, wer hier empfindlich ist sollte Oropax mitnehmen.
Helena war sehr freundlich, hat uns alle Infos vorab mitgeteilt und war bei Rückfragen zeitnah erreichbar. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und würden jederzeit wiederkommen.

셀프체크인 방법을 정확하고 자세하게 안내해주었습니다. 베를린의 카페 및 식사장소, 즐길거리 등 리스트를 공유해주었습니당. 들어가는 입구가 많이 어두웠지만 잘 적응 되었고, 자전거 보관소 옆이라 아침 저녁으로 사람이 다니니 커튼을 잘 치면 좋아요. 이웃들도 친절하고 좋았습니당
위치도 좋아요!
Very nice and spacious appartment in a calm neighborhood. Everything was ready and clean when we arrived. Definitely recommanding this place for families or group of friends.

Tolle Wohnung mit zwei Schlafzimmern (eins davon ein Kinderzimmer) und einem riesigen Wohnzimmer. Bad ist klein, aber ausreichend. Die Lage ist super und die Besitzerin sehr nett. Die Wohnung sieht inzwischen anders aus als auf den Fotos, ich würde Esther empfehlen, mal neue zu machen. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Perfect location, I rebooked my stay with my mum immediately. The apartment has everything you need and even more. And the view is just amazing! Within minutes you are at the main sightseeing in Berlin :)
Excelente anfitrión. Totalmente recomendable.
sehr schöne Unterkunft. gerne wieder wenn ich in Berlin bin.
Rent och städat, enkelt att checka in och ut. Vänligt bemötande och tydliga instruktioner.

The apartment looked better on the photos than in reality, the heating at this ground floor apartment wasn’t really good enough for a comfortable stay during the winter. Otherwise the apartment is big and clean and has a functional kitchen.

I really enjoyed staying in Karsten apartment! I loved all the details on decoration. I liked how you can see the neighborhood through the windows and the option to close the windows for privacy. I had some problems with wifi, it was very slow but maybe was a momentaneous problem, the host was available to go there and fix it but I was hurrying during my day plan and  preferred let it that way. I loved the blue walls on the toilet! Just one thing that I would suggest is to change is the curtain on the box (I don't like curtains on shower) and maybe add some light above the shower, a little too dark but this is just a suggestion, for sure a perfect apartment to stay in Berlin and I hope comeback in a near future. :)
Denise and Jürgen were wonderful hosts! They made you feel right at home. 10/10 recommend!
It is fine of you don’t plan on spending a lot of time in the hostel. It looks a bit strange, but it is fine - and close to the metro

Die Unterkunft war leider ein Reinfall. Die Wohnung war auf dem Boden fast überall (bis auf das Bad) klebrig oder dreckig. Das nasse Papiertuch zum Test zeigte nach dem wischen kein weiß mehr...
- dreckiger Boden
- kaputte/alte Badematte
- Kellerassel auf Badematte
Alles in allem ein Reinfall. Bin einen Tag früher abgereist. Wollte eigentlich noch einen Tag dort verbringen, aber habe mich umentschieden.
Vermieter war danach nicht sehr kommunikativ und wollte nicht erstatten Frechheit! Und das bezeichnet sich dann als gewerblich und berlin apartments. Wohl eher Berlin Abzocke...

베를린 관광하기 딱 좋은 숙소.
위치가 멀어보이지만 트램과 s반 사용하면 30분 안에 중심지까지 이동가능합니다.
제일 좋았던건 숙소에서 걸어서 1분 거리에 마트가 있었던것.
호스트 역시 친절하십니다.
호스트가 친절하고 숙소가 깨끗했어요!

Hem tingut una estada genial. La localització de l’apartament és ideal (recomanem menjar vietnamita pel barri), però vam trobar alguna millora a fer (els llençols no arribavem per tot el llit, eren individuals), els coixins no eren gaire còmodes, i vam trobar algun paper pel terra. Tot i això, molt recomanable
Lejligheden var dejlig ren og lækker ved ankomst. Den har en perfekt beliggenhed, hvis man vil udforkse Berlin. Der har været god kommunikation med Heidi, så alt i alt en stor anbefaling herfra.
Kjempefin leilighet med mange gode spisesteder i nærheten. Lett å finne fram og lett finne nøkkel.

Johann war ein klasse Gastgeber. Die Kommunikation war immer hilfsbereit und nett.
Die Wohnung war wunderschön, super gut ausgestattet und sowohl das Bett als auch die Couch waren unheimlich bequem. Eine sehr gut ausgestattete Küche und tolles Bad.
Jederzeit wieder!
Everything was 👌
Top Unterkunft, vielen Dank!
Villiam hat sehr flexibel auf die Änderungen unserer Ankunftszeit reagiert und hat uns trotz Verspätung sehr freundlich empfangen.

Grundsätzlich war der Aufenthalt in dem Apartment ganz OK. Es gibt jedoch ein paar Punkte die wir nicht so toll gefunden haben
- lieblos eingerichtet/ungemütlich/keine einzige Farbe (grau und weiß)
- wenig Küchenutensilien vorhanden
- keine Sitzgelegenheiten am Balkon
- Rauchverbot am Balkon, wenn man erwischt wird, drohen sie mit 500Euro Strafe.
- Müll muss man selbst entsorgen, wenn nicht, 200Euro Strafe.
- keine weiteren Müllsäcke vorhanden
- nur 1 Rolle Klopapier
- kein Salz, Pfeffer und Öl in der Küche (obwohl in Anzeige beschrieben)
Für andere Besucher*innen vermutlich ganz gut weil sauber, zentral und geräumig, aber für uns keine Airbnb Wohnung wie wir sie uns vorstellen, da zu unpersönlich und kommerziell.
Great base for exploring the exciting neighborhood and further afield as the U-bahn is just on your doorstep. We stayed on the top floor that had a balcony too!
Nice, warm, clean, close to tram lines, in a quiet, residential area of Berlin.

Absolutely loved the loft - everything described and more. A real great location for the train and really handy for the local shops too for supplies
The loft was well equipped and very comfortable and very good base to explore Berlin

Our stay was everything we had hoped for. The location is great with plenty of transport links and also lots of parks and quiet streets to go for walks. Fatos, the host, was also very responsive and gave easy instructions for the self check-in. 10/10 would stay again.

I spent 5 nights in Jan‘s apartmemt.
The site is very well located in Kreuzberg next to a subwaystation and the Bergmannstrasse with a lot of very good restaurants.
Jan was very responsive and the self check-in worked perfectly. The place is ideal for one, max two ppl as the bedroom and bathroom are very small.
Will be back, for sure!

Comfortable and clean place and Kay is a nice and welcoming  person. She was also helpful with recommendations of what to see around the city. The place is exactly as in the description and has a good location close to a metro station. Recommended.

Easy Check-in not stressy at all.
Good location to reach public transport.

Everything was as expected
Really great !
Everything is super. Great host!

Hele mooie locatie met leuke restaurants and cafes in de buurt. Ook makkelijk om met openbaar vervoer te komen en naar andere buurten te gaan. Simpele kamer waar je de badkamer met de bewoners deelt, maar alles heel goed en schoon.
Good location and clean place
Ich hatte einen angenehmen Aufenthalt. Helen ist eine nette Gastgeberin, ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und würde jederzeit gern wiederkommen.

We were very happy with this apartment.  We liked having 2 separate spaces. The bedroom/living room had a nice space for hanging out. We were glad to have the dining room/kitchen with a good dining table which we used for working and eating.  We were both working so if one of us had to take a call, we could do it in private. Fantastic location with lots of little cafes/restaurants all around. The cafe just downstairs was very good for breakfast and lunch.  Close to shopping.  Great grocery store just down the street.  Our local friends all said that it was their preferred neighborhood. We would definitely come back. The hosts were readily available to us. Thank you again!

Daphne hat immer schnell und zuverlässig geantwortet.
Der Check-In via Schlüsselbox funktioniert tadellos..
Die Wohnung selbst ist wie in den Bildern dargestellt und war genau das, was wir für 2 Erwachsene und 2 Kinder gesucht haben. Wobei auch sicher 4 Erwachsene komfortabel Platz finden.
Die Einrichtung ist zweckmäßig und an der Grundausstattung ist alles vorhanden was man sich wünscht: Viele Handtücher, Geschirrtuch, Salz, Seife, Spüli, sogar Spülmaschinentabs, Toilettenpapier.... das ist schon super wenn man davon nichts im Koffer mitbringen muss oder erst einkaufen gehen muss (was auch nur 3 Gehminuten entfernt möglich ist).
Zur Lage muss man nichts sagen: zentraler geht fast nicht mehr.
Wir können sowohl die Wohnung als auch die Gastgeberin rundum empfehlen. Wenn wir nochmal nach Berlin reisen dann nach Möglichkeit wieder dort ;-)

I’ve stayed in tons of places across the city and this is one of my favorites. Amazing, central location, it felt safe and private, and the amenities were thoughtfully chosen. I think cleaning could’ve been a bit more thorough (it was quite dusty and the door was a bit sticky) and the AC setup was a bit weird (at least there was AC in the Berlin summer) but I’d absolutely stay here again. ❤️
I would highly recommend Britta's place! She and Nicholas are amazing people. Very kind! Their place is in the perfect area!

The apartment is very nice and spacious. Located in the centre close to Alexanderplatz. Stephanie was available for smooth check in. The apartment is equipped with all the necessary things including umbrella and fan. The apartment was sparkling clean. It has good living room attached to kitchen. Stephanie was always available on call to help us in case of emergency.  Our stay was very comfortable and we enjoyed out Berlin visit for 5 days.  The communication was very clear from the beginning. We need to buy wifi, towels and bed linens which is clearly mentioned in the description of the listing.

Nous avons séjourné deux jours chez Svenja afin de visiter Berlin. Très bon environnement a 1 km de la gare pour aller visiter. Svenja est très agréable, discrète. Flexible pour les horaires. je recommande le lieu
Very nice apartment in berlin! Can recommend this place to everyone who wants to have a trip to berlin with a nice apartment where you can chill after a long day in the city.

Die Wohnung ist eine klare 10/10.
Schön eingerichtet, mit einem super Ausblick und in top Lage.

Die Unterkunft war genauso, wie wir sie uns vorgestellt haben. Axel und Anne waren sehr gastfreundlich, haben uns gar spät abends empfangen und dafür gesorgt, dass wir uns in der Wohnung richtig wohlfühlen konnten. Ein grosses Dankeschön!! Berlin und die Wohnung waren für uns einsame Spitze.

Axel und Anne sind supertolle Gastgeber und wir können sie und die Wohnung nur wärmstens weiterempfehlen.

This apartment is incredible. The light is magnificent. It is not cluttered or overly stuffed with stuff. The couch is comfortable & the bed is nice. The neighborhood is so happening there was always something to eat or drink. Highly recommend this apartment.
Great links to transport, lovely bars and restaurants nearby and lots of amenities near by
Excellent communication from Ben and his team

très bien. aucun soucis
merci pour ce séjour

estancia genial.
la persona amable al 100% y siempre pendiente
Sehr schöne Wohnung und professionelles Management! Werden wieder kommen.
Good location, easy, fast and cheap to arrive from the Tegel airport by taxi. Everything was as described. Good spot to stay in Berlin and easy to move around the city with public transportation.

Hannelore was an impeccable host! I certainly recommend this place to anyone looking for a nice and well connected appartment in Berlin. We stayed for a month, and it was very refreshing to know we could just chill at home for a while due to its location and space at any given moment. That's the appartment's greatest asset: its dimensions and luminosity.
Hannelore, though we didn't meet in person, was keen at communicating me any incidences and questions about our comfortability. Super attentive!
Little tip: if you make up your mind and choose Hannelore's place, make sure to check out the Kulturbrauerei and the Mauerpark open air market on Sundays!
This place is worth every cent. Close to everything. Many amenities. The friendliest staff. So clean. We would stay here again anytime.

Kitty's place was lovely - beautifully laid out, fantastic bathroom, great location. Very helpful the little notes she left around the apartment explaining everything. Communication was a breeze. I had a fantastic time and would stay with Kitty again anytime.
Tolle Wohnung, perfekte Lage. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
I had a really great time at the Singer Hostel, the staff was just adorable, the place was super nice and well located to visit Berlin ! I will definitely come back 🧚🏻‍♂️
La ubicación está perfecta
Anja's place is brilliant. such a good location and SO much space. totally loved it and would definitely stay there again

The piano shed has a great atmosphere and I felt immediately at home in Berlin.
If you want to cook or prepare some food, the kitchen has everything you need.
Stephan already responded quickly and was accommodating regarding check-in and Check-out time.

Perfect place for a family or friends trip to Berlin. Location is full of interesting places to dine and relax in the evening and it makes it easy to travel anywhere else in Berlin.  Host is super nice and responds to all questions without delays. Will use again during our next trip.

Me sentí super cómoda en el departamento de Meg! :) Pude trabajar cómodamente desde mi cuarto y cocinarme sin inconvenientes. Ella fue muy amable en todo momento. Amé su heladera! El alojamiento está muy cerca del metro por lo que es muy sencillo llegar a cualquier parte de la ciudad.
Ich war eine Woche zu Gast bei Gee. Alles prima!
Convenient traffic
Nice and cozy studio in peaceful area, pleasantly quiet. Easy to reach Berlin’s sights and public transportation from.

Vanni was great and the apartment is a great shabby chic place of a good size. No real mod cons but that is no problem. The major flaw is the neighbours. One bedroom wall is paper thin and the neighbours just talking sound as if they are in the same room. The neighbours below the other bedroom smoke a variety of substances in great quantities and the smell comes through the unsealed wooden floor. Thus, even though everything was freshly cleaned, everything reeks of smoke. If that's not a deal breaker, then you have a great find. But for me, with a kid, it was not ideal.
Appartement simple mais fonctionnel qui a l'avantage d avoir deux chambres séparées. Emplacement pratique proche d une station de métro.  Quartier plutôt peu bruyant.
The room is large, well equipped and common areas are clean. The location is perfect, everything is within walking distance. We enjoyed our time here !

Excelente apartamento! Tal cual las imágenes. Muy cómodo y muy buena ubicación. Super tranquilo. Hay que tener paciencia con las puertas hasta ingreasar al apartamento porque las 3 tienen código de ingreso. Pero super bien!!

Moe was such a gracious host! My flight was delayed and I arrived far later than planned, but he gave me a very warm welcome. The room has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Very good location and value, and I would heartily recommend!

Ich habe mich sehr wohl bei Britta und Nicolas gefühlt. Bei höheren Temperaturen ist es schon recht warm im Zimmer, aber das kann man sich bei einer Dachgeschosswohnung ja denken ;) die Lage ist super in einer schönen Gegend und nah zu öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Es wird einem alles bereitgestellt, was man für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt braucht.
It’s a very beautiful and well located flat in Berlin, we enjoyed spend our trip in this place

Super tolles Apartment, das eine fantastische Lage hat. Es sind nur wenige Schritte zu Restaurants, Cafés und auch Parks und der ÖPNV sind quasi direkt vor der Türe. Ich habe mein Home Office für einige Tage hierhin verlegt, was sehr gut funktioniert hat, auch dank des stabilen WLANs. Die Einrichtung ist hochwertig, wurde mit viel Herzblut zusammengestellt und bietet Möglichkeiten zur Erkundung, um die ein oder anderen Sachen zu verstauen. Auch Sebastian ist der perfekte Gastgeber! Danke für diesen kurzen, aber schönen und sehr unkomplizierten Aufenthalt. Ich komme hoffentlich bald wieder :).
Very good place to stay, only improvement would be the WiFi connection. Other than that this penthouse studio loft is absolutely breathtaking.
Nice easy visit
Definitivamente un buen departamento para conocer Berlín, quisiera volver.

When visiting a city new to me I'm out and exploring 8-12 hours of the day.  I look for a place to stay that helps me feel grounded and part of the daily rhythm of a neighborhood.  Michel and Anne's place was perfect by my standards.  Their place is located in a great neighborhood with everything needed within a short walk from our door:  cafes, public transportation, small grocery.  The apartment is lovely, clean and full of natural light.  At the end of a busy day I always looked forward to returning "home".  Thank you Michel and Anne for providing a home-away-from-home that surpassed my expectations.
Thank you for a pleasant stay.
Great place to stay in Berlin. Great location and very clean and modern. Would recommend it to everybody!
Sehr gutes Appartment ! Habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt !

Bel appartement propre, bien situé et fonctionnel.
Les infos pour l'arrivée sont bien précises.
Je garde l'adresse pour un futur séjour sur Berlin.
Bardzo przyjemny pobyt, super atmosfera! Wszystko zgodnie z opisem, nie miałam problemów z zameldowaniem ani z transportem. Przyjemna okolica, bardzo dobre miejsce na spacer wzdłuż kanału
all staff polite and helpful. room was lovely. interior of hotel was really good. breakfast was nice. not much variety but ok. a really nice quaint small hotel. will def stay again
Kathrin is a great host - friendly and helpful, and Room 5 was super cute and cosy. Definitely recommend !
Séjour agréable
Stylish and airy apartment that was truly a home from home. Some lovely touches. Host provided quick responses and local Information. Highly recommend.

Gastgeber sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt! Bahnhof in der Nähe sodass man schnell in die Stadt kommt. Die Wohnung war sauber, es war auch sehr schön, nach dem Sightseeing gemütlich auf der Dachterrasse zu sitzen!
Great location with plenty of bars and restaurants around. Good place to base yourself in Berlin. Communication with Andre was excellent they were very responsive.
Great spot, plenty of space and lots of natural light. Would stay at Jana’s place again next time I’m in Berlin
Sven was very quick to respond to questions and help us out. He met us when we got to his place and was happy to offer us a drink and answer any questions we had. He is very hospitable!
Sehr gute Lage und tolles Apartment.
Alles super
Everything was marvellous!  Clean and bright appartement, good location, nice host!  Absolutely recommended! Thank you, Bettina!

Wir waren zu viert drei Nächte in Elisas Wohnung. Zwei Erwachsene und zwei Teenager. Es gab genug Platz. Bad und Küche waren makellos. Die Betten bequem und die Wohnung ruhig.
Um die Ecke sind viele Restaurants, Bars, Bäckereien und Spätis. Alles, was man braucht.
Die Kommunikation war lückenlos.
Ich würde die Unterkunft in jedem Fall empfehlen.
so wonderful place and great hosts！our flight arrives late and they really helped us.30mins drive to messe Berlin

De ontvangst was zeer goed. Het was mogelijk ons baggage wat vroeger af te zetten op het appartement van Klaus. Hij maakte ons meteen wegwijs en stelde ons helemaal gerust.
Alles in het appartement was zeer proper. Er was een grote keuken die we konden gebruiken en de slaapkamer was perfect voor 2 personen. (veel ruimte in de kasten, handdoeken, dekens,...)
Klaus was een goede host voor air bnb en zeker een aanrader voor iedereen die Berlijn wil bezoeken. Afstand met de metro tot Alexanderplatz (centrum) is slechts 10 minuten!
È andato tutto bene, host molto chiaro nelle spiegazioni e appartamento veramente bello. Divano comodo e ottima zona living.

We really enjoyed our stay at their place. Room was really spacious and a lot bigger than on the picture. The three of us felt really comfortable. We loved our separate entrance which gave us more freedom to come and go as we pleased without interrupting others.
A kettle in the room with tea was a lovely touch. Highly recommend!

Die Gastgeberin Viktoria war super nett und hilfsbereit.
Die Unterkunft entsprach der Beschreibung und war einfach zu finden.
Schöne Einrichtung war sehr ansprechend und schön hell, sodass man sich heimisch fühlt.
EMPFEHLENSWERT!!!!!
Comfort number top!

The location is great, close to a ring station (3 min walk) and several other stations that can be reached in 10-15 min.
The apartment is clean and spacious. The communication was easy. We enjoyed the stay (a family with kids) and Berlin.
Very lovely place quick train into city centre
Easy to find, very responsive friendly and helpful host!

The location of the apartment is a perfect and very useful espacially for whom visits for work. The apartment is quite near the metrostation and after just two stops you will be at the cuty center. Everything was very clean. There were neither noise, nor other things that could be disturb you. Thanks a lot to Franziska for such amazing accomadation

Wir haben eine Nacht in der Wohnung von Gini und Eric verbracht, weil wir für ein Konzert in der Uber Arena in Berlin waren, die in ca. 20 Minuten Fußweg zu erreichen ist.

Die Wohnung ist geschmackvoll eingerichtet und hat alles, was man für einen Städtetrip braucht.
It was great to stay at Andrej’s apartment. Everything was clean

Soggiorno splendido, Ulrike è una host simpatica, amichevole e poliglotta con cui é molto piacevole stare a chiaccherare.

10/10

loved this place. very spacious, beautifully designed. highly recommend for Berlin

Beautiful condo with great views of and access to the park. Modern and comfortable. Grocery store within 2 blocks and Restaurant Die Horn - great food with friendly service - just a block and a half away. Wonderful stay.

This was the perfect place for us during a family wedding. We had everything we needed, great beds, good shower and plenty of room to spread out. Werner was a fantastic host we highly recommend his apartment!
Cozy and stylish apartment in a great location with many shops nearby and good connection to public transport. Yael is a very friendly host and always available to help. Would recommend :)

An excellent apartment, conveniently situated. The apartment is bright and super clean. I particularly liked the well equipped kitchen. The hot water is really hot.
100 pc recommended

Peggy's apartment is great, friendly and well equipped. The room is absolutely spacious, luminous, with a view on a beautiful church belltower. Location is right near a metro station, with a convenient supermarket close by.
But what made my stay specially enjoyable is the friendliness and communicative energy of my hostess :
Dank sei Dir Peggy !
I'll be back with great pleasure...
thanks a lot! My stay was very  smooth, Parwana provides all useful info how to get to the appartment and how to check in and out.

Sehr ruhig :-) Orga + Kommunikation + persönlicher Kontakt super - Nicole hat ein ganz besonderes Talent. Sehr sauber, auch das kleine, effektiv gestaltete Badezimmer und das vom Hochbett geprägte Schlafzimmer. Wir haben prima geschlafen :-).

Das Apartment ist modern und die Aussicht spektakulär. Für mehr als zwei Personen ist es wichtig zu wissen, dass die Wohnung ein Raum ist und die Dusche teilweise einsehbar. Dafür kann man mit Blick auf Berlins Wahrzeichen duschen.
The place has everything you can wish for and although it’s a bit far, our host explained really well how to get around. Would totally go back

감각적인 인테리어가 돋보이는 곳이였습니다. 호스트분이 엄청 친절하시고 밤비행기라 늦게 밤 12시가 넘어 체크인을 하였는데 반갑게 맞이 해 주셨습니다.
호스트분이 주변 미술관도 많이 알고 계시고 정보도 많이 주셨어서 편안하게 여행할수 있었어요 :)

It was a nice place, enough to crash for few nights. The house is well equipped and has 2 bathrooms, despite having so many people in the house, we never clashed with anyone. Its close to metro and Charlottenburg station, makes it very accessible with city centre. There are many restaurant options and there's a shopping mall nearby too. The park near the house is nice for evening walks.
Top Lage, top Wohnung.
Nice stay! Will definitely come back when in Berlin!

Ferry place is in a good location either for business and sightseeing travel purposes, and Ferry is a good and very responsive host. Thanks Ferry for your warm welcome and kind assistance on our queries in Berlin!
Die Unterkunft ist super Zental gelegen, die S-Bahn ist nur 5 min enfernten und von da aus ist man schnell in der Innenstadt. Alles sehr sauber und ordentlich. Wir kommen bestimmt nochmal wieder....,
Genuinely cozy place. We stayed as a group of four and never found it wanting in terms of space. Perfect for exploring east Berlin
Beautiful location, loved walking along the canal, lots of space, peaceful and lovely garden. would go back!

This is a fantastic little apartment. Good location with access to public transport only a few minutes away. There are two markets in walking distance if you decide to cook in the kitchen. Heike showed us in and set us up with how to get around Berlin. When you get here pay attention to the numbers on the sides of the buildings. We thought we were at the right building but it was actually around the corner. Heike had to come find us.

Super nice apartment! You’ll have everything you need, including all the kitchen equipment. The location is convenient and you can easily access the U and S stations. One of the best places I’ve ever placed at. Danke!
Very nice apartment and everything modern and clean. Werner is a polite and cool host. I would definitely book again!
Recomendado un 100% .

Ankunftsprozedur ist eine Katastrophe: es müssen 3 online Formularen ausgefühlt, mit Pass, Bild, Foto, Impfungspass, alles elektronisch mit daten manuell erfasst, ohne dass man weiss, was mit den Daten passiert.
Dauer: für mich mehr als 30 min. und 3 mal probiert, weil nicht funktionniert hat. also katastrophe.
Die Boxen, sind echt kleine Boxen. das ist nicht zu gross, aber ganz neu uns super sauber.
Bett ist sehr bequem, Decken und Kissen genau so gut.
Sehr sehr lauf auf der Strasse, dafür ein super Internet.
Die Wände sind dünn wie Zigarettenpapier, also kann man nicht wirklich schlafen. Zimmer 2 auf jeden Fall vermeiden.
Super ruhig auf dem Innenhof, dafür Internet super schlecht (Zimmer 7)
dafür werdet ihr schnell telefonisch geholfen, wenn es klemmt. schon mal gut.

also nicht wirklich BnB Philosophie
also würde ich nur aus Not empfehlen.

Das Zimmer geht zur Straße raus an der Kreuzung der Ubahn Eberswalder Straße und der Straßenbahn M10. Es ist verkehrsmäßig super angebunden, aber sehr sehr laut. Schlafen bei offenem Fenster ist nicht möglich. Das Bad ist tiptop und sauber, der Empfang über das Restaurant im Erdgeschoss lief sehr gut. Das Zimmer als NEU zu bezeichnen ist aber nicht mehr darstellbar. Es gab einige merkwürdige Flecken an der Wand, das Fenster zur Straße ist sicher 20 Jahre alt und die Einrichtung hat den Status 'neu' auch hinter sich. Vom Preisleistungsverhältnis her dennoch sehr zu empfehlen.

Sehr sauber und schön ausgestattet 👍 Es fehlt vielleicht ein Backofen und eine Kaffeemaschine für längere Aufenthalte, auch war nicht wie beschrieben ein Parkplatz auf dem Grundstück vorhanden, es gab aber genug freie Parkplätze in der Straße. Die Gastgeber waren sehr freundlich und die Lage war top!!!

Beautiful place, the cleanest room I've ever been, bed clothes super clean and fresh. Checking in, communication and Sabine's hospitality was excellent. Even though the house is not close to tourists spots, you can get easy access to the train station and places to eat. We really enjoyed our time in Sabines house.
Super séjour

Ich konnte krankheitsbedingt leider nicht anreisen, habe aber einen sehr netten Kontakt gehabt. Wenn ich mal wieder zum Marathon oder Halbmarathon nach Berlin fahre, würde ich wieder Stella Wohnung auswählen.
Alles bestens! Linda ist sehr freundlich und unkompliziert in ihrer Art. Das Zimmer ist genau wie beschrieben. Wenn es mich das nächste Mal nach Berlin zieht, übernachte ich gerne hier.

Claudia è stata da subito disponibile alle mie richieste, mi è venuta incontro per le mie esigenze di check-in in anticipo rispetto all’orario indicato.
L’appartamento è pulitissimo e nuovissimo, in un’ottima posizione in zona tranquilla ed elegante e vicino a diversi punti attrattivi.
L’appartamento è confortevole e mi sono sentita come a casa.
Grazie di tutto.

Sebastian was extremely responsive, kind, and accommodating.  My family and I stayed at his apartment to run the Berlin Marathon and it was very well located, within walking distance of the start and finish line with the race running along the street just below.  Very comfortable, including the water bed, which I was nervous about, but it was firmer than I expected and I slept very well.  Pristine bathroom, great lighting.  Would recommend!  Thank you!
it was nice, but be aware that you are sharing the room with strangers, male and female

Frank’s place is immaculate and beautiful - he was clear and communicative following my booking and I felt welcomed at the place by his mother who lives in the apartment. Despite a language barrier we were able to understand each other and she was very kind and helpful, clearly explaining the dos and don’ts as well as providing guide texts for things to do in Berlin. Strongly recommended!

Logement de caractère dans un petit immeuble avec peu d'occupants, très aimables. Rue calme et verdoyante. Accès à un jardin en arrière cour, très agréable. Appartement spacieux, agréablement meublé et confortable. Mise à disposition de produits d'hygiène et de produits de base (cuisine) permettant de préparer un repas simple lorsque l'on arrive tard. On se sent rapidement chez soi chez Verena. Proximité de la station de métro de Wollankstrasse, et des quartiers du centre de Berlin. Lieu de séjour idéal pour une découverte de la ville dans les meilleures conditions. Corinne, Thibault et Basile.

This place is fantastic and in a great area of Berlin, located near to lots of lovely cafe's and shops, and is only a short walk or tram ride from Alexanderplatz. The flat was perfect - clean and tidy, and very comfortable.

The host made us feel very welcome by providing some recommendations of where to go, some restaurants and cafes, and even provided us with some milk and juice!

Many thanks and when we come back to Berlin we will definitely stay here again.

Tom & Anjali

I thought this place was great, especially the digital code instead of key system.  so much easier than trying to remember your room key every time you leave.  the apartment was small but had most everything I needed.  conveniently located right on Nollendorfplatz, was right across the street from the UBahn station as well as convenient to everything in that neighborhood like restaurants and Bio-Markt and cafes, bars etc.  great for single traveler.
Great location and clean little hotel rooms. Very good breakfast. Martin at the front desk was very helpful.

Sehr schönes und vor allem ruhiges Zimmer mit Hinterhoflage. Das Airbnb entsprach der Beschreibung und alles hat super geklappt. Alles in allem jedoch würde ich dieses Airbnb empfehlen und wieder kommen.

very quiet, warm and comfortable. you can live six without interfering with anyone. kitchen, boiler, toilet, terrace and the warmth of the wooden building. Metro and shops are not something that would be close, but it's trivia. to the center of Berlin 30 minutes. to stancion 10 walk. best on car. free parking. so, my bestrecomends
a nice apartment worth the price.

Good > 8 minute walk away from charlottenburg station. & nice mall nearby
Ok > Three different codes to get into the room
& the bedroom upstairs you can’t stand up, so if you’re over 5ft tall, bit of a challenge
wunderschöne Unterkunft in einem sehr schönen Teil Berlins. Sehr gerne wieder!

Je suis 100% satisfaite de mon expérience avec ce Airbnb. Philipp et sa sœur communiquent très rapidement et ils portent de belles attentions. Le logement correspondait exactement à mes attentes. Vraiment, merci infiniment pour cet incroyable séjour!!

C'était notre deuxième séjour dans ce studio confortable et calme. Nous y reviendrons certainement.
Proche du métro et des nombreux commerces du quartier.
Gilbert et Annie

it is rigth for two people.
if you love italian coffe take a coffe express machine. there is almost all.

The location is nice unfortunately there were works ongoing on the building in front of the apartment. Therefore it was very noisy and hard to get some good rest. There was a big stain on one side of the bed linen.
Nice place and nice people ! Well located
