Beautiful and clean with great beds and crisp fresh white bed linen. Had a lovely stay.
Didn’t have any interaction with Naomi during stay. I did message her on the last day to mention about a leaky shower and what to do about rubbish but never got a response which seemed strange as was always quick to respond prior.
Super Wohnung und total liebe Gastgeber, man hat immer schnell eine Antwort bekommen und auch Tipps was man sich in Berlin ansehen kann. Wir würden wieder kommen😊
Tout était parfait, l'appartement est bien agencé, propreté impeccable et un hôte très disponible et arrangeant. Merci pour tout !

Wir haben uns sofort wohl gefühlt in dem wunderschönen und makellos sauberen Apartment. die Lage war optimal ruhig und zentral in einer charmanten Straße mit sehr guten Anbindungsmöglichkeiten an die Öffis. Den Ausblick auf den hübschen Hof und die gehobene Ausstattung, sowie das äußerst bequeme Bett, das warme Parkett und die Loggia gefielen uns besonders gut!
Boian war sehr freundlich und gab uns wertvolle Restaurantempfehlungen. Sogar unsere Räder fanden einen sicheren Ort im Fahrradraum. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen und empfehlen Boians Unterkunft unbedingt weiter!
Tiny, tidy, warm place in a friendly neighbourhood! Great comminication! My recommendations!
Alles Top gewesen. Gerne wieder.
We felt very welcomed from day one. The Communication was great. Romina and Benjamin were very kind, sweet and understanding. It was just a very nice expierence.
El apartamento está muy bien ubicado,tiene todo lo necesario para una estancia de 5 días en Berlin.Frank muy amable y atento

I live in Berlin and rented Oliver's place for family members who were visiting, and we were all so happy with the apartment in every way. Oliver was a great host, always in contact, the instructions were easy to follow, and the apartment was as lovely as described. Highly recommend this cozy place!

Sebastian war ein super zuvorkommender und verständnisvoller Gastgeber mit viel Flexibilität und Engagement.
Ich hatte ein paar spezielle Anfragen und er hat alles gemacht, damit der Aufenthalt so stressfrei und unkompliziert wie möglich wird.
Super hilfsbereit und kommunikationsfreudig. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und können die schöne Unterkunft bei Sebastian nur weiter empfehlen :))
Все отлично спасибо
Great place, would definitely go back! Really good location and super easy to get anywhere else! Very clean. Fit my party of three very well!
Alles wie beschrieben. Tolle Lage mit super schönem Park/Grünzug am Kanal entlang Richtung Steglitz. Im Apartment haben wir uns sofort zuhause gefühlt. Vielen Dank und gerne wieder!
Nice and modern. we loved it. Also great bed. would def go back.
O Apt é exato como nas fotos. Bonito, moderno, janela imensa, entra muita luz. 5 min andando do metrô. Localização perfeita para jovens, está em um bairro descolado. Me senti bem lá.

Robert es un excelente anfitrión. Su hospitalidad y amabilidad me ayudaron a sentirme cómodo en la habitación. La ubicación es inmejorable, a unas cuadras del Bahn, y la vida nocturna es muy animada. Recomendado.
super Unterkunft, hat alles einwandfrei geklappt  danke noch mal ;)
Such a clean, friendly and homey place! I would recommend it to everyone who visit Berlin! Best hosts ever!

Host greeted us personally and explained everything including how to contact him easily.  Very nicely designed with many thoughtful touches. Plenty of towels and hot water. Electric shades, big comfortable bed, lots of hangers.  Convenient patio with fountain. We wanted a place closer to the sites, but they seem to be rare because Berlin makes it difficult for hosts to airbnb.  About 20-30 minutes to most locations in the city by public transit, which is very extensive.
Top organisiert, saubere Unterkunft
Sehr gut gelegene Apartment. Für alle, die gerne laufen, ist das Tempelhofer Feld in der Nähe. Alles bestens!!
Good apartments for a good price

Very spacious, clean and lovely apartment. Great location if you like it quiet, yet very central and plenty of great places to eat and drink close by. The (father of the) host communicates very promptly and kindly. Definitely deserves a super-host status!
Good place to stay. Very clean and kitchen with various sweets and snacks.
Stella’s place is great for a weekend stay and to have as a base as you explore Berlin. Beds are actually very comfy as well.
Heidi's Wohnung war großartig, sehr zentral und total sauber und bequem, ich hoffe ich kann nächstes Mal wenn ich Berlin bin zurückkommen!

Perfect!
Agustin is really cool and available !
The flat is huge, clean and really functional. Very good for big groups and big families!
It is very well located only at 300 meters from Alexanderplatz!
Keep in mind that it is at the third floor without lift!
Everything was great 👍

The flat was great for a group of 5+ sharing with lots of space and great location. The place was clean and bright and good arrangement for collecting keys. We arrived a bit earlier and Arno was flexible in allowing us to get into the flat a bit earlier which was very helpful.
Truly beautiful place at an amazing location! Communication was perfect and Robert was super helpful and provided us with many tips of cool places to visit. Would 10/10 recommend!!

This is a great place to stay and relax in Berlin. The apartment is warm and comfortable, and exactly as described by Tom & Arzu who were very helpful and welcoming hosts. The neighbourhood is quiet and safe, with a terrific Italian restaurant just around the corner (Don Pasquale) and many other good cafes and restaurants close by. We will definitely want to stay here again when we come back to Berlin (if they will have us!).

Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und offen gestaltet und die Lage unschlagbar.
Ein Zimmer, das ohne Tür an eins der Schlafzimmer grenzt, hat keinen Vorhang an der Tür, sodass morgens Tageslicht hereinfiel. Außerdem hätte die Küche noch besser ausgestattet sein können (Öl, Salz, Pfeffer etc.)

Thomas ist mega nett und entspannt.
Ich hab mich dort sehr wohl gefühlt.
Der Balkon ist mega:)
Immer wieder gern!
Alles war top. Die Gastgeber nett und hilfsbereit. Das Zimmer war riesig und sauber!
가성비 좋음 ! 방이 깔끔하고 침대도 푹신해요 ! 호스트 분이 친절하십니다:)

Great appartment in residential area. Not too large but has all you need. Small dining table, seating area, bathroom and shower and small kitchen. Parking is close by, bus or tram can be taken to city center. We enjoyed dropping by at Kaffee Bohne for a coffee to go when taking the bus. Also good to take your breakfast there or any other sandwiches.

I was mostly a solo traveler on my 10 night trip to Berlin. I felt safe and secure being alone, as this unit was off the street (I think all of MaCha's units are), and there were security codes to enter the buildings.
The apartment was comfortable and had a lot of character. I brought my web development work with me from California, and was able to be productive in the evenings. The internet was good, and the area was generally quiet. On Friday and Saturday nights, the restaurant downstairs tended to be a little bit noisy until about 1am, but nothing raucous.
So many cool museums, galleries, cafes, and shops were within walking distance! I was able to explore quite a bit during the day on foot. A grocery store was also available right across the square.
Hope to return!

Der Aufenthalt in Berlin und in Katjas Unterkunft war ganz wunderbar. Sehr schönes und sauberes Zimmer. Zudem ein super sauberes Bad, welches wir allein nutzen durften. Die Kommunikation lief reibungslos und Katja war immer sofort zur Stelle,falls was gefehlt hat oder man einen Tipp brauchte für ein Restaurant. Wie haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt. Und kommen gerne wieder.
Mario's place is a perfect located apartment in a beautiful and unique building. We enjoyed it a lot :)

Unfortunately I had a terrible stay. The electricity did not work for the first hour, the host did not respond to help, I rented for 5 people and there were only bedding, towels and places to sleep for 2, the pillows were not pillows; they were sacks with blankets stuffed inside, the listing was not the same listing as the pictures on the listing, there were clumps of black hair in the bathroom and living room, full of dust, the building door and the apartment door had no lock, stains of bodily fluids on the walls, overall the worst stay I’ve ever been to. I arrived at 23:00 at night with my family and I had no where else to go at this hour. The host was no proactive and unresponsive. This listing should not be on airbnb

Beautiful apartment in a nice neighbourhood. The bedroom and private bathroom are clean and comfortable. The metro station is just in the same street and brings you directly to the city centre. Gabriela and Peter were kind and experienced hosts, and Schatzi just added the extra coziness :)

Die Wohnung ist super! Sehr leise, in der Nähe von Bus, S-Bahn und U-Bahn. Viele Geschäfte in der Nähe und Kiosk gleich nebenan. Schlüsselübergabe hat alles super geklappt und Tanja ist wahnsinnig nett. Wir hatten eine tolle Woche in der Wohnung!
Wohnung war ok.
Wendy is a wonderful person! The place is very quiet and in a very comfortable area, totally recommend!
Great room, loved the atmosphere. The landlord is very friendly and proactively asks if there is anything I need help with.
great location and yhe apartment had plenty of room
Lugar exelente, a Caren nós recebeu muito bem ela é bastante receptiva e cordial, foi tudo mavilhoso. Nós recomendamos!
Would stay here again. Very accessible with the train right there on the block. Was nice to relax after a Long day.

El apartamento está bien equipado tiene todo lo que necesitas, únicamente nos faltó un microondas.
La ubicación está bien, 10 min andando de alexanderplatz y un super en frente con todo lo que puedes necesitar.
El anfitrión es muy rápido a la hora de contestar y amable.
Keine Wünsche offen. Wunderbares, top ausgestattetes Zimmer. Zuvorkommende Gastgeberin, sauer, ordentlich - beste Lage. Jederzeit wieder. Danke, Katharina.
Ha sido una estancia buena. La habitación está muy limpia y es acogedora. Sabine es buena anfitriona. Todo genial.
Recepcionistas muy amables en todo momento.

Sehr schöne kleine Unterkunft, direkt an der Spree gelegen mit allem was man braucht. Perfekt für kurze Aufenthalte und zudem sehr zentral gelegen. Hans Jörg hat sich immer sehr schnell bei uns gemeldet und hat uns proaktiv mit einer genauen Beschreibung vom Check in und allen Informationen, die es sonst noch braucht versorgt. Gerne wieder

Sehr gemütliches und gut ausgestattetes Ferienhäuschen. Die Lage war sehr ruhig und entspannt. Regine war eine sehr freundliche Gastgeberin. Wir würden auf jeden Fall nochmal wieder kommen. Alles in Allem eine Empfehlung wert!
Great place in Berlin .

Im Prinzip war alles i. O. und das Appartement zu empfehlen.
Was aber zu beachten ist: Wasser gibt es nur im Bad, Dusche und kleines Waschbecken.
Abwaschen und die Zubereitung von Warmgetränken usw. ist daher gewöhnungsbedürftig und umständlich.
Hier wäre ein Hinweis auf diesen Umstand in der Beschreibung angebracht.
Deshalb 4 Sterne

A fantastic Airbnb! Everything was very clean and the hosts have put a lot of thought into what guests need - even the washing machine instructions :) Markus was very responsive and flexible with our check-in/out times. The area was very walkable to bars, restaurants, the train station and a big grocery store. We would happily stay here again.
Great location and really appreciated the 25/7 front desk!

Martin's place is great! It's spacious, clean, close to the train and in a central neighborhood location as well. Martin was very accommodating with our late night check-in, as we arrived close to midnight.
Make sure your cab driver is familiar with the address, especially at night. The apartment is situated in a complex, and it was a little confusing for us to find the correct building.
But other than that, would definitely recommend!

Phuong & Martin sind sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit! Der Check in war flexibel und entgegengekommend!
Leider gab es zur Zeit keinen Schlüssel für das Gemeinschaftsbad sowie das Zimmer, während auch andere Gäste dort waren.
Wszystko zgodnie z opisem. Blisko centrum, wygodnie, kontakt z gospodarzem bezproblemowy. Polecam
Was a great stay, the host were very nice and the flat very well maintain and practical.

Meine Freundin und ich haben 2 Nächte im Alex Hotel übernachtet. Die Lage des Hotels ist sehr praktisch, es ist nur 10 Minuten zu Fuß vom Alexanderplatz oder man kann die M4 Straßenbahn nehmen. Das Zimmer war perfekt für eine kurze Übernachtung. Wir bemerkten nur eine kleine Abweichung von der Beschreibung des Zimmers: die Beschreibung sagte, dass die Handtücher nicht zur Verfügung gestellt wurden, sowie die Heizung. Das stimmt nicht! Zu unserer Überraschung fanden wir sowohl Handtücher als auch Heizung im Zimmer.
Die Kommunikation mit dem Host war super! Antworten waren schnell und klar, auch spät in der Nacht. Sie hatten uns auch ein etwas späteres Check-out des Zimmers erlaubt. Das Zimmer war ziemlich sauber. Ich empfehle es allen, ohne Zweifel!

Our family had a great stay at Apartment Rodenberg. Had just spent the previous week in hotel rooms, so really enjoyed the space of the apartment. Location excellent - close to public transport, shopping precinct, eating options etc. All communication was top notch & helpful, including assisting us when our DB train reservations were not clear to us. Great local recommendations for Berlin attractions that are outside the generic tourist stuff. Highly recommend 👍

Riesige und Traumhafte Altbauwohnung: Hohe Decken, große Fenster, Holzböden, sehr stilvoll eingerichtet.
Die Gastgeberin haben wir persönlich nicht kennengelernt weil sie verreist war, aber sie hat bei Fragen sehr zeitnah und hilfreich geantwortet.
Die Lage ist super, nur 3 Minuten zur Fuß zur U-Bahn.
Kommen sehr gerne wieder!

Die schönen Bilder im Netz entsprechen der Wahrheit, eine außergewöhnlich hübsche Wohnung in einem schönen Stadtteil mit guter Anbindung. Von dort aus macht das Radfahren durch Berlin richtig Spaß. Sehr nette, unkomplizierte Vermieter. Wir waren sehr zufrieden 😀

An immaculately clean, well-equipped and tastefully furnished flat in a delightful and lively part of Berlin. Uta went out of her way to greet me, offered valuable advice about public transport and touched base to see how I was going during my stay. I couldn't have been more satisfied with my choice. And a fine coffee shop right at the front door!

Overall a clean and neat Hostel, pretty good price for Berlin. The personel behind the desks were nice and had good recomendations.
However the beds were creacky and the pillows were not that comfortabel.
If you want a reasonably cheap stay for a couple of days in Berlin it's great.

Kasia's apartment was perfect!! The check in was very convenient, the apartment itself was exactly as described, location was very convenient (right next to a tram station and about 10 minute walk from a Ubahn station) and in a cool neighbourhood. Right outside the apartment you have a minimarket, bakery, pizza place etc. The beds were convenient enough. No noise from the neighbours whatsoever. We needed to extend the stay at the last minute and Kasia communicated back swiftly during the weekend. I don't have a single complaint for this place, will definitely stay again!
Peters place is perfect if you're staying in a large group, and the flat is also in a great location close to good restaurants and bars.

Had a great time in Berlin thanks to the hospitality and kind stay we had at Marko's place. Coming home to see the entry way was charming and pleasant. The area is rather quiet, despite some occasional bustle from the city. Would stay again.

Es hat alles super funktioniert und war wie beschrieben. Der Check-In/out war easy. Die Lage für einen 3-4 Tage Berlin Trip war perfekt, ruhig, Super Markt in der Nähe, gute Anbindung, nette und günstige Kneipen.
Die Unterkunft war einfach und sehr sauber. Zu empfehlen für einen Berlin Trip. :-)
Great option when staying in the area. Subway and buses are close by. Plenty of coffee shops to choose from in the morning to go for breakfast too. I would definitely stay there next time again.

La casa si trova a 10 minuti dalla stazione della S-bahn  ed è collegata soltanto alla linea  S1. Per raggiungere il centro sono necessari 30 minuti di metro. La stanza è ampia e in casa c'è tutto il necessario per la doccia e per i pasti.  Il letto è un po' scomodo (io soffro di mal di schiena e forse non faccio testo). Consigliato!

Great location in Kreuzberg to stay whilst in
Berlin. Have a fab holiday.

Sehr empfehlenswert!
Top Lage und eine total saubere und schöne Wohnung. Perfekt für einen Wochenendaufhalt.
Die beiden sind super spontan und konnten zum Glück noch eine Nacht früher anreisen als eigentlich gebucht.
Vielen Dank euch, wir werden gerne wieder kommen!
Eine schöne Wohnung, ideale Lage und eine Nette Gastgeberin. Uns hat der Aufenthalt gefallen!
Great place to stay, very clean and cosy.

The perfect location for us as my husband payed a show at Madame Claude’s one night and recorded at Patch Point another day, both in Kreuzberg. Can’t beat the convenience of close Lidl, Aldi, and the Markethalle Neun. With the fully equipped kitchen we made several amazing meals in the flat. If you don’t have the desire to cook there are so many fabulous restaurants near by. We had pizza and pasta from Cantucci on Lubbenerstraße, and tapas at Bar Raval. Laura was helpful and responsive - if you need assistance with the washer/dryer combo just send her a picture of the dial and she will talk you through it. Our room had direct access to the interior garden which we did not know ahead of time and were delighted to find. It’s not the most quiet place due to the apartment being in an active home with many others living above and in connected buildings but the soaring ceilings, beautiful art, and prime location make up for it. Bed, pillows, linens, and towels all very comfy.

Das Apartment ist sehr ruhig gelegen in einem Innenhof im  Erdgeschoss, deshalb leider etwas dunkel. Gunilla hat eine große Vielfalt an Dingen für das Frühstück bereit gestellt. Die Lage im Kiez von Charlottenburg ist toll. Gemütliche Restaurants machen den Aufenthalt sehr angenehm.

Nous avons eu un très bon contact avec Sigrid et sa fille.
Sigrid est formidable de générosité et empathique.
Nous garderons un bon souvenir de cette rencontre pour cette visite de Berlin

Eine Wohnung in der man sich fühlt, als würde man bei Freunden in Berlin übernachten. Niklas hat uns empfangen - er war super herzlich, hilfsbereit und äußerst gastfreundlich. Die Wohnung ist echte Empfehlung für alle die es mögen, sich eine Wohnung mit netten Menschen zu teilen - super gemütlich, sehr sauber und heimelig. Wir würden das nächste Mal, wenn wir wieder mal in Berlin sind, gerne wieder kommen! (:
Liebe Grüße auch an Ashley, die wir leider nicht getroffen haben!(:
Very nice place, clean and comfortable
eine sehr große und schöne Unterkunft in einer noch schöneren Umgebung ;)

logement très bien situé pour visiter Berlin

Cool place! We had a good stay and enjoyed the apartment. Quiet street and nice location :) It’s an uniqe and different kind of apartment with everything essential you need 👌🏼
Schönes Appartement in grüner und ruhiger Lage nahe am Wasser. Super Lokaltipps bekommen. Komme gerne wieder!
Entsprach unseren Erwartungen (außer Schimmel im Bad). Nettes Personal
Gute Lage, alles Sauber, Gerne wieder!
Sehr schöne Altbauwohnung in Friedrichshain. Super Viertel, sehr schön gelegen, sauber, ordentlich und sehr gut eingerichtet.

Estuvo bien !! Acorde a lo visto.

Caner was very communicative and a great host. Would stay at his place again.
I had a great stay at Michaels excellent apartment. I had everything I needed and even the neighbors were supercool. All over 5 stars. All the best and hopefully till soon, Fetsum

Pessoal simpático e prestativo. Na foto do anúncio, porém, havia quatro camas "normais" e, pra nossa surpresa, duas eram estilo beliche. Para driblar a situação, a partir da segunda noite colocamos os colchões no chão. Aí foi tranquilo.
Acomodação do David estava excelente! Chuveiro maravilhoso!!! Perto de estações de ônibus, trem, mercado e restaurantes. Recomendo!!
felt very welcome and enjoyed the apartments style

I had such a great time!
Manu and Rory were extremly nice, I felt right at home!

我非常喜欢Oliver的房间！这是一所非常干净的房子，特别是厨房和厕所，干净与整洁给我留下了很深的印象。Oliver的爸爸是一个非常友善的老人，他在我们入住的第一天亲自给我们介绍了房子和周围的环境，并且在我们遇到麻烦的时候总是能打电话找到。房子周围的环境非常安静，几乎听不到任何噪音，很适合休息。这样好的房子和好的房东，我很愿意推荐给大家，可以放心入住！这是一段难忘的住宿经历。

wir hatten einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt bei Katharina. Katharina ist super nett und freundlich, hilfsbereit, antwortet super schnell. die wohnung war wie beschrieben, echt süße kleine Berliner Altbauwohnung- sehr schön! gut gelegen, gute Verkehrsverbindung. Empfehlenswert.
Гарна квартира, все комфортно, зручна інфраструктура, приємні господарі!
Sauber, unkompliziert, super Host

Verda's apartment was beautiful, clean, and incredibly charming! I had lived in Berlin a couple of years prior and was really excited to return and visit my favorite places. This apartment was the perfect place to return to at the end of the day. Verda herself was welcoming - she made us a welcome sign on the wall chalkboard, gave us recommendations for good neighborhood restaurants and bars, left us breakfast items in the fridge, towels in the bathroom, and everything else we needed. I'd love to come back to Berlin and stay here again in the future.
Die Gegend ist wirklich wunderschön und ich habe mich direkt wohl gefühlt. Ich kann die Unterkunft sowohl für kurze, als auch für lange Aufenthalte nur empfehlen! Ich komme bestimmt mal wieder!

Wir sind zu 3. angereist und haben den Aufenthalt in Ava‘s Wohnung sehr genossen. Vom ersten Moment an, haben wir uns wie zu Hause gefühlt. Ava selber war nicht vor Ort, sie hat die Schlüsselübergabe mit ihrer Nachbarin organisiert, welche uns sehr nett empfangen hat. Die Kommunikation im Vorfeld mit Ava& auch ihrer Nachbarin war super unkompliziert und es hat alles bestens geklappt. Die Betten waren sehr bequem, wir haben geschlafen wie Engel.
В апартаментах есть все необходимое. Рекомендую всем, кто планирует поездку в Берлин.
Lovely space in an amazing location. The couch looked funky but could have been a bit more comfy! Still, loved staying at this appartment and would definitely come back.

Feras was nice and easy to communicate with.
The place itself is great for the price. It is a bit of a haul to get your suitcase up all the stairs, but that is to be expected. The kitchen is small but clean and tidy, eoth everything you need. The bathroom was also very clean. The bedroom is very spacious and the bed was very comfortable. There was easy access to wifi and a good little desk if you need to work.
I would highly recommend Feras for a short stay, but for a long stay I found him quite unreliable. He had to cancel the first week of my stay a month beforehand due to repairs, and then he had to cancel all but the first 4 days of my four-week stay only 3 days before it started because his daughter was coming to stay.
Bisher eines meiner Besten AirBnB-Erfahrungen! Wohnung, Sauberkeit, Lage Top. Aber die Gastfreundschaft von Johannes hat unseren Aufenthalt noch einmal auf eine andere Stufe gehoben.
Great place and really near the main train station.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden aufjedenfall nochmal kommen.

Very nice apartment. Good central placement. Close to U-Bahn and good options for food in area.
Really good apartment for holiday in Berlin

I enjoyed a six-night stay here, and I don't think the photos in Alex's listing do the place justice - the apartment has high ceilings and feels airy and roomy, with a pleasant minimalist decor. The apartment was very clean and Alex accommodated an early check-in, with clear instructions provided. He was friendly and respectful on arrival. I would highly recommend this place for individuals or couples.
It is amazing place to stay in Berlin, very kind people, very clean apartment and really practical location (very close to SBahn station).
The flat was super clean and the room was cosy. The host was chill. The flat was at convenient location. Should I return to Berlin I would book this place again.

Eine individuell eingerichtete Wohnung in einem schönen Hof. Der Check-in war problemlos und die Kommunikation schnell und freundlich. Kleine Abzüge für einen vergessenen schimmeligen Kaffeefilter in der Kaffeemaschine, Spuren in der Toilette und ein unangenehm riechendes Treppenhaus. Alles in allem aber empfehlenswert und gut angebunden.

Very nice apartment.  Two of the beds were not very comfortable the common space within the apartment was great with lots and lots of open area.  the bedrooms were pretty cramped, but that's what we expected.   The bathroom was spacious and we'll appointed, but having just one toilet for our group of 7 required a lot of coordination. We ran a couple of loads of laundry in the washing machine and it worked well.  no dryer, so we had to air dry on the towel racks.
Robin was very accommodating and v. quick at getting back to us. Would recommend! :)

Apartment light bright and airy but does need attention to detail. Appliances are working but need some repairs. Had to buy laundry detergent
Great advice from Christoph about which local resturants to visit. Very close to underground and KaDe We
Fint og rent sted. Mange værelser så lidt svært at finde rundt men lejligheden lå godt placeret ift restauranter, butikker osv.

Super! Es war alles sauber und ich habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt. 5 min vom Tempelhofer Feld entfernt für eine schöne Joggingrunde.
The only word we would like to pass on to Me Hien is a big thank you to her. She is an excellent ambassador of Air BnB organisation. Thank you for hoisting us.

Sehr schoene Wohnung in idealer Lage, auch ruhig, exzellente Kommunikation. Absolut empfehlenswert.
Very pretty apartment in an ideal location, quiet too, excellent communication. Highly recommended.
Peaceful location. I'm sure summer is much nicer. The place was clean and Werner is an experienced,polite and friendly host
Impeccable et l’équipe est super sympathique 👍

Really nice place, clean and close to the center by feet! Perfect choice!

Super netter Kontakt, alles wie beschrieben. Freuen uns aufs nächste mal!

10/10 ! This place was awesome and made my trip the cherry on top. I recommend this place if you’re planning a trip to Berlin! The host was fantastic and was very easy to communicate with him and ask questions. I definitely plan to vacation here again in the future.
Patrick helped us by being flexible with the check out time which was so nice of him and it really made our visit in Berlin perfect!

Schönes Apartment in einem Altbau mit netter kleiner Terasse zu einem Innenhof. Gute Anbindung an ÖPNV.
Kontakt mit Sören war unkompliziert und schnell.
I was made very welcome by the hotel team and the cleanliness was impeccable.  It was a pleasure to stay there
Wonderful stay, would highly recommend. Great location, great local restaurants, great host.
Un buen lugar para alojarse, tiene cerca el tren y restaurantes

Andreas' room is a cosy room with extra entrance and en-suite toilet. Only the shower you share. Andreas is a wonderful an friendly host, it was nice chatting to him and look at all the arty photos in the room. I'll definitely recommend! Ah, yes, location is great, too, lots of cafes and shops around!
Lina' s house is on the best location of Berlin.  Furthermore,  her house is neat and cozy.   It is perfect for small family member or group trip.
The apartment was very clean and a really nice space, close to the U-Bahn so getting around was pretty easy. Would recommend staying here.

L’alloggio serve di una posizione splendida, vicina ad Alexanderplatz e a circa 200 metri dalla fermata della metro. Nei dintorni sono presenti svariati ristoranti, cafe e supermercato.
L’appartamento risulta esser Fedele alle foto pubblicate dall’host, unica pecca: leggermente polveroso.
Per il resto è stato perfetto per i nostri giorni Berlino
Robin was a great host, super friendly and helpful. If we were to come back to Berlin we would look at staying again.
Gorgeous apartment in Friedrichshain- close to tram ect easy to get around. Jana and Maria were helpful, would definitely recommend staying here.

I had a lovely stay here. The house is large and accommodating and the hosts are very nice people. Everything was kept clean and neat and the house itself is beautiful. Would definitely recommend staying here!

We really enjoyed our stay in. The apartment is well designed and everything is new and fresh.  Self check in was easy (we arrived late at night) and communication was great with quick replies from Andre even in the evening. We were a group of 5 girls and felt safe in the apartment and general area. Good location for walking to tourist spots and there are also a few Metro stations nearby. Explore the area too if you want to get a taste of living like a local! We only had a few days and lots of plans but if you are looking for recommendations for restaurants and bars Andre recommends lots in their thoughtful house manual and tips guide. We went to restaurant Bastard 5 mins away and had a delicious brunch. All in all a great stay and I highly recommend!

Beautiful, cozy and stylish, great value for money. We loved its excellent location. Robert and Wibke went the extra mile to make sure we had a care-free and unforgettable stay in Berlin. Mission accomplished!
Fantastic place for a single or couple. Great location. Lovely little apartment with everything you need.

So muß Berlin: Eine schöne Altbauwohnung in ruhiger Lage und doch mitten im Kiez und dazu ein netter Vermieter! Alles sauber, ordentlich und sehr angenehm.
Ich habe mich wie zu Hause gefühlt und hatte etwas Anschluss/Ansprache, aber ohne dass man sich zu sehr auf die Pelle rückte.
Wenn es Airbnb noch nicht gäbe: Für Berlin müsste man es erfinden, wa?
Great apartment - clean, warm and decent location.
Logement très propre et literie parfaite, métro au pied de l’immeuble avec petits commerces non loin! Très bon séjour dans ma ville préférée

We stated at Claudia’s over a three days stay and the appartment is very pleasant and peaceful. The decoration and all the appliances were really nice and chosen with taste. You can tell Claudia took time to set up a nice atmosphere with an attention to details.
The location of the appartment is perfect to discover Prenzlauer Berg’s neighborhood (the city is so big, you can’t really be closed to everything).
We appreciated the fact that the appartment was in a quiet neighborhood yet closed (walking distance) to nice coffee shops and excellent restaurants. We appreciated Claudia’s reactivity to our messages and the fact that we were able to check in and out with a key lock (no stress to be on time for a meet up when coming from/ going to the airport with public transports). Nice addition: Claudia gave us her favorite adresses and we were able to try and enjoy a lot of them.
We definitely recommend this appartment to the Airbnb community.
Ute and Ben are wonderful hosts, we loved it there. The room is very big, cozy and clean. It has everything you need - including coffe and tea.
alles war wunderschön. Empfehlungswert. 10/10.
Great stay, very easy to check in and out.
excellent location and a beautiful, art deco building with original stained glass details. nearby river walk and great food market and restaurants.

Location cannot be topped!  Marcus and Kathleen were very helpful upon my arrival.  Very gracious hosts.  The apartment had everything I needed.  Clean and confortable.  Perfect for sightseeing and exploring Berlin.

Die Wohnung von Natalia ist wirklich sehr schön, alles ist neu und geschmackvoll gestaltet. Schön ruhig im Hinterhaus. Wir mussten nicht weit gehen, um gut zu essen. Fischplatte beim Portugiesen. französisch bei Chez Maurice...... die Strassenbahn ist um die Ecke und wie immer in Berlin sind die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel super organisiert. Ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt... ich kann Natalias Unterkunft sehr empfehlen. Sylvia
Excellent location. Stylish, clean space. Pictures are accurate. Hosts are friendly and communicative. High class.
Danke war sehr angenehm bei dir

Очень понравилось пребывание в этом доме. Я оставалась с 1го по 24ое декабря. Несмотря на холод на улице, дома было довольно тепло. Всё соответствует тому,  что было написано в описании. Есть все необходимое для прибывания на долгое время. Хозяева очень отзывчивые и прилагали все усилия, чтобы я чувствовала себя как дома. Было приятно получить от них подарки и открытку на Рождество. Спасибо огромное Микаэль и Майке.

The apartment is spacious and has a nice view of beautiful trees. The bad was comfortable. The place was very clean. Barbara was very nice and responded quickly. I had great time staying at your place, Thanks you!

Sowohl telefonisch als auch per Message nicht erreichbar. Eine Stunde nach Buchung dieser Unterkunft musste ich diese wieder stornieren. Der Herr ist zu fein um auf meine Nachricht zu antworten. Nachdem er die Nachricht gelesen hat war er plötzlich nicht mehr telefonisch erreichbar.
Ein einfaches Nein auf meine Nachricht hätte mir gereicht. Die Unterkunft an sich kann ich nicht bewerten. Deswegen überall 3 Punkte.
War alles gut, bis auf die Heizung, die schon auf Sommerzeit umgestellt war. Daher war es mir zu kalt in der Nacht und am Morgen.
Freundliche Rezeption, guter Kaffee, prima Lage. Alles wie beschrieben. Zimmer sauber und gut, wenn man an das WC grenzt, aber auch sehr laut.
Great location, cosy reception area and room! Would recommend to anyone going to stay in Berlin

Gut gelegen, wer mit dem Auto anreist, muss für eine gebührenfreie Parkzone aber einen Fußweg von 10-15 min in Kauf nehmen ;-) Die Bilder versprechen nicht zu viel - tolles Flair und sehr gemütlich! Und auch ruhig - Ausschlafen war kein Problem! Leider an manchen Stellen mehr Schein als Sein; vieles ist hier und da ein bisschen „zusammengefrickelt“; da gibt’s noch Luft nach oben. Super lief die Abstimmung mit Javier; er war auch gut erreichbar und hat schnell reagiert, als es ein Problem mit der Dusche gab. Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt.

War ein netter Aufenthalt in Berlin mit toller Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel um ins Zentrum zu gelangen. Konnten unsere zwei Hunde problemlos mitbringen - das ist keine Selbstverständlichkeit und verdient einen extra Pluspunkt.

Das Hotel ist neu und sehr clever eingerichtet. Die Zimmer sind nicht gross, haben aber alles was es braucht. Es gibt eine Kaffeemaschine und Kaffee und Tee gratis, sowie Kühlschrank, Minibar und eine kleine Küche. Das Bad ist auch tipptopp, nur etwas dunkel erleuchtet. Würde wieder kommen,

Eine liebevoll und geschmackvoll eingerichtete Wohnung mit eigener Terrasse, auf der man im Sommer super frühstücken kann. Besonderer Pluspunkt für mich war die sehr gute Matratze. Die Lage ist perfekt, sehr ruhig und grün, ein See mit Wald direkt vor der Haustür, ebenso wie Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. Dank Michaels Tipp fuhr ich mit dem Rad direkt an der Spree entlang bis zum Schloss Bellevue, wunderschön! Ich habe mich hier sehr wohl gefühlt und kann die Wohnung sehr empfehlen.

Nicely central location and a big, spacious apartment if slightly odd configuration.
We were a group of 7 blokes and it worked out well with a bit of room - but not bed - sharing.
Immediate location is a little bit seedy but only in a non threatening low key way. Supermarket very close by and a short walk to KDW and the high end shops plus Zoo etc. Very pleased with my choice.

We would happily stay again at Sven’s place. It covered all our needs comfortably: great location for getting around town quickly, well-stock modern kitchen for our cooking needs, excellent heat & plumbing, great internet, helpful information for 1st-time visitors to Berlin, bright and clean rooms and quiet nights for sleeping, easy and accomodating interactions with Sven before and during our stay.
100% pleased with our week at Sven’s.

Appartamento come dalle foto, molto pulito e fornito. Televisione, fornelli, luci e il resto funzionano tutti perfettamente!
Posizione comoda e vicina a locali, posti in cui mangiare e alla fermata del tram per spostarsi facilmente. Host molto gentile, disponibile e flessibile!

Denise e Jürgen foram incríveis!
O quarto é perfeito, com cama confortável, lençóis limpos e macios e uma vista linda pra rua! O quarto tinha tudo que precisávamos, inclusive frigobar, cafeteira e utensílios. O banheiro era grande e bem completo, com chuveiro quente e forte. A localização é ótima, com estações de trem bem perto, de uma avenida com muitos restaurantes ótimos em apenas 10min de caminhada.
Denise e Jurgen nos auxiliaram desde a chegada em Berlin até o dia a dia, com dicas sobre locais, restaurantes, locomoção etc.
Recomendo muito o local! E quando voltar a Berlin, com certeza será no apto deles! <3

Comfortable apartment with garden in quiet courtyard. Conveniently situated in vibrant area. Many things to do and see. Great choice in restaurants and shops around the corner. Near East side Gallery and RAW Gelande. Public transport in walking distance. Had a wonderful time!
La chambre individuelle était très propre et spacieuse. Les communs étaient ok et récents. L'emplacement et pratique mais la rue n'est pas forcément rassurante de nuit quand on est une fille solo.
Buen departamento ubicado en una zona céntrica y linda de Berlín. Las grandes atracciones quedan cerca en comparación a lo largas que son las distancias, ya de por si, dentro de Berlín.

A perfect stay. Stefan's apartment is even nicer than the photos: clean, tastefully decorated, and located inside a highly functional modern apartment building right next to Gleisdreieck park. We had an incredibly easy time checking in and out and felt right at home for the week that we were there.

Wir haben uns mitten in Berlin sehr sicher und geborgen gefühlt. Die Wohnung war großund gemütlich. Es war alles Wichtige vorhanden und es gab sogar einen Balkon, der war perfekt für laue Sommerabende. Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit! Danke für alles :)
Interior and host is good but entrance etc is not the best.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft in einer perfekten Lage und dazu noch ein sehr netter Kontakt. 👍🏻
Praktisch eingerichtete Zimmer. Sehr gute Organisation der Anreise Schöne Lage fußläufig zum Lietzensee. Ruhiges Zimmer zum Hinterhof.
Amazing place and service!

Perfect host, easy to contact and responds promptly. Could not have asked for a better place to stay during our stay in Berlin, the apartment is trendy, cosy and comfortable with everything we needed. A 10 minute walk to the station, very well situated and great transport links. Would definitely recommend to anyone wanting to stay in Berlin, great value for money and great host.

¡Un airbnb 100% recomendado! Hanna fue muy amable, estuvo al pendiente de mí y me dio recomendaciones por el barrio. Zona bien comunicada por metro y Uber, llena de restaurantes de varios países, zona segura y agradable. Me volvería a quedar con mucho gusto :)
Una sorpresa impresionante

Cristina was the perfect host for our visit. She arrived within 5 minutes of our call to provide the keys and a quick tour. She also took care of 2 weeks of accumulated laundry for us for a nominal fee and directed us to a grocery store. The apartment itself is spectacular. It is tripping distance from the train station and along the side of a bustling public square. There are plenty of restaurants, coffee shops, and stores within a block or two. Many of the mainstream tourist attractions (for example the Berlin Wall) are within a mile and make for an easy walk. We left on Friday but before going there was a huge outdoor market going on in the square right outside our door with lots of fresh fruits and such but also the expected tourist knick knacks which turned out to be a really convenient place to grab some gifts. To your right as you leave there is a beautiful park that overlooks the Spree river to the Berlin Dome. To your left, please bypass the square restaurants at least once and hit Revolver Burger (1 block away, may be slightly off on the name). As an American living abroad this place had a burger that reminded me of home and frankly could hold its’ own in my top 10 hamburgers. Great location and great hosts in a truly massive but completely connected (above/below/on ground trolleys to anywhere at crazy convenient intervals) city. Loved exploring the city from this central point.
Rigtig fin lejlighed

Unkompliziert und nett.
Laurie und ihre Tochter haben mich freundlich empfangen. Das Zimmer war sehr angenehm und eine großartige Dusche. Man muss wissen dass die Katze schnell durch die Eingangstür abhauen kann und man sich keine Sorgen machen muss.
Thanks, Ilan, we had a wonderful time in Berlin!

Es war wirklich sehr laut und die Zimmer waren für 4 Personen einfach viel zu klein. Wir haben es kaum ausgehalten so warm war es aber durch den Lärm war auch nicht an Fenster öffnen zu denken. Es ist eine gute Gegend nette Menschen aber wirklich um dort schlafen zu wollen zu laut

Very cute and clean apartment in great area. Graefekiez is fun with lots of shops and restaurants. The apartment itself is located in an apartment complex that has been transformed from an old hospital into a bunch of flats. It is beautiful and a rare find. Very quiet. Great connection to Main Train station, short walk to metro and bus. Alexander was a friendly and helpful host. I’d definitely stay here again.
Great stay! Staff was very helpful and friendly. Wonderful pool and sauna

Propere / nette kamer met voorzieningen volgens de omschrijving. Goede communicatie met de host. Mooie ligging naast een park, op 20min. van het centrum. Enkel jammer dat de verwarming op een hoge temperatuur moest blijven staan. Verder alles tip top in orde!

Our family of 5 stayed at Nina's house for a week. Nina was an all-around great host. We really enjoyed her spacious house, beautiful backyard and clean amenities. The kids loved the tree house outside and the loft play area in the house. The neighborhood is safe and has easy access to Berlin city center and surroundings. Would definitely book again!

Stayed at Andrea's place four nights in July 2015. Everything worked perfectly, Andrea was very helpful and gave lots of good tips for the local area, and the apartment is in a great neighborhood. Great experience!

This was a fantastic apt! Clean, cozy, and Verda's place had everything I needed (even plug converters and hair dryer). She kindly had breakfast, coffee/tea, and snacks ready in true bed and breakfast manner. The location was perfect with easy transportation right outside the door. For those who prefer a taxi, there was always one immediately outside (literally could see from the window). There are tons of good eats and bars around, but Verda also had great places written out on her cool chalkboard wall. Verda is a great communicator and always responded quickly. I would absolutely return to Verda's. It would be my first choice in Berlin and I would highly recommend it to anyone.

Sven’s place in Berlin was great. He communicated very well. The property was well stocked with things to make our stay wonderful. I would definitely recommend this location for anyone going to Berlin.
Problemlose Buchung und Aufenthalt.
Logement parfait! Ambiance tres sympa!

Ich war nun schon zum zweiten Mal in Franziskas schöner Wohnung und habe mich wieder rundum wohlgefühlt. Die Lage im Prenzlauer Berg ist ideal – ruhig, aber trotzdem mitten im Geschehen. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber, liebevoll eingerichtet und bestens ausgestattet. Franziska ist eine tolle Gastgeberin: freundlich, hilfsbereit und immer gut erreichbar. Ich komme auf jeden Fall gerne wieder – vielen Dank, Franziska!

Very nice appartments
good location
we had a hreat stay! A wonderful flat at a nice location.

We loved our stay at Vanni’s place. From our initial conversations to check-in, everything was so easy. Vanni’s friend Lennart checked us in, providing a great guide to the area and the property and even offered to do a laundry for us !!
The apartment was just as advertised, in a lovely safe area, with lots of local places to eat and drink, with great transport links just across the street.
We really enjoyed our time and would stay there again when we next come to Berlin.
Danke !!
This apartment is in a great location and it's very adorable and cozy. It's everything you need for a delightful stay in a very creative city.
muy bien hostal cerca del centro de Berlín.

The location was perfect for us because our family lives very nearby. It was an easy walk to the train station or bus stop. We were able to get everywhere we need to go by train or bus. Our room was clean and exactly as we expected. I would definitely stay again.

This was the perfect location for our week in Berlin. The space was super quiet and cozy and near tons of lovely shops, restaurants, cafés, etc. The bed was so comfortable and when we wanted to have a night in we had all the things we needed to make a simple dinner. Great shower too! Would definitely recommend.
Ça a été un séjour incroyable et un très bel accueil. Je conseille vivement !!!
Small quiet and very comfortable apartment with modern decoration. Trendy neighborhood. Many bars and restaurants nearby. Easy access to other districts. I highly recommend!

Nice place with everything you need and walking distance from restaurants and bars, I can definitely recommend.
The room is oriented towards a road so you can’t have the window open during the night but we didn’t mind that much, even during the hot days it was livable there.

Die Wohnung ist sehr gut gelegen, so dass man schnell zu den verschiedenen Sehenswürdigkeiten in Berlin kommt. Betten und Bettwäsche waren gut und sauver. Leider roch es in der Wohnung nach kaltem Rauch.

Dit was een prima adres. Zeer schoon en alles is er, zelfs een radio wat ik wel fijn vond. Parkeerplaats op eigen terrein. Supermarken genoeg in de buurt. Wel iets buiten het centrum gelegen. Maar de bus stopt op 5 min, (lijn 179) van de Airbnb. 6 Haltes en je bent bij metrostation Alt-Mariendorf. Met deze lijn kom je in hartje centrum van Berlijn.

Das kleine Appartement entspricht voll und ganz der Beschreibung im Internet. Ich wurde sehr freundlich vom Hauswart Friedrich empfangen. Er erklärte alle wichtigen Dinge zur Wohnung und entpuppte sich als interessanter Gesprächspartner. Die Wohnung ist zweckmässig eingerichtet und war sehr sauber. Die Lage ist sehr gut und ruhig. Die verschiedenen Wochenmärkte am Maibachufer haben mir ebenfalls gefallen. Die Woche in Berlin hat mir sehr gut gefallen und ich würde diese Wohnung wieder buchen.
Nils and his girlfriend were so sweet, took great care of the room and were really flexible about the check-in and check-out:) would definitely recommend staying there!

Die Kommunikation war super einfach. Die Lage ist ideal. Wenn man viel in Berlin ist ist das super. Das Frühstück war reichhaltig. Leider war das W-Lan nicht stark genug das ich das in meinem Zimmer empfangen konnte. Das Zimmer war klein aber für alles ausreichend.
The apartment is well located and is a functional whole.
Thanks for the clean, comfortable and safe accommodations.

Very good location: 20 minutes away from the city center. The neighborhood is quiet, we even did not need earplugs. Very cozy and clean apartment, had everything what we(4 ppl) needed. Tom and Arzu are very friendly, one of the nicest hosts that we have met on Airbnb.
Great quality/price ratio.

The apartment was honestly beautiful and practical. Anything needed is included and it was really convenient for my 4day stay in Berlin. In addition, with the host's instructions the self check in process was really easy. Last but not least, the apartment is well located, only 1 minute away from the train stop.
This apartment was so great, such a good location and it was so cute! Great food around the apartment as well, the metro stop is literally at the apartments doorstep as well!

Beauriful appartment.  Very well presented with enough space to do everything you need.  Great location with easy access to transport as well as fantastic food places.  Highly recommended, though please don"t book it up as we want to stay there again!
Es un excelente anfitrión, habla muy bn el español, es amable, atento y muy buena persona, gracias Rosario por todo,  gracias, gracias, gracias atte. tus amiguitos mexicanos.
Departamento muy bien ubicado, a 8 minutos de un centro comercial con restaurantes y supermercado. También conectado ahi mismo al transporte público, es muy rápido llegar a las zonas turísticas.

Markus und Ewa sind sehr freundliche Gastgeber, ihre Wohnung ist super gelegen und sehr schön eingerichtet.
Danke für den tollen Aufenthalt.
Gorgeous apartment in a very handy location
Great place
Nice place with easy acsess to public communication and a really serviceminded host😀

Will has a great, beautiful apartment! He even left some delicious fruits and a bottle of champagne! We did have some problems with the bathroom, but this was quickly solves trough some smooth communication. Overall great stay, would definitely recommend and probably come back next year!
A beautiful and very clean apartment. We really enjoyed our stay.
Tout était super de A à Z. L’appartement est génial, assez bien situé. Je recommande fortement !

Dan & Robert foram incríveis anfitriões desde o momento em que fizemos a reserva, só temos a elogiar o lindo apartamento e todo cuidado que tiveram comigo e minha irmã! O apartamento estava extremamente limpo e bem cuidado, além do ótimo bom gosto. Também adoramos a localização.
Com certeza voltaremos! Obrigado!

The pictures don’t do the place justice! The location is near public transport if you want to visit Berlin city. The house was clean and had everything we needed and more. Very spacious home with a warm interieur. If I ever go to Berlin again I will check if this house is available.
Thank you Mia for letting us stay a your wonderful apartment. It was absolutely wonderful in every way and made the visit to Berlin perfect. Highly recommend.
Tolle Lage, schöne Wohnung, sehr sauber und sehr nette Kommunikation. Kann die Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen!
Exactly as advertised! Perfect stay for first time visitors to Berlin, within walking distance to all major landmarks. Highly suggest and will be back!

Die Wohnung entspricht voll und ganz der Beschreibung und den Bildern. Sie liegt im Hinterhaus im 3. OG (viele Stufen, da hohe Räume) und ist sehr ruhig, hell und luftig. Die Lage zur U-Bahn-Station Birkenstrasse ist ideal, man kommt von dort überall gut hin. In der nahen Umgebung gibt es diverse nette Bars, Cafes und Restaurants und einen sehr guten Bäcker. Wir würden sofort wieder dort wohnen.

Le logement correspond bien à sa description et est très agréable. Il est parfait pour passer quelques jours à visiter Berlin seul ou en couple. Je l'ai trouvé très calme. Il est proche de nombreux magasins et restaurants. Pour visiter les principaux monuments de berlin, le métro est à une dizaine de minutes à pied et les arrêts de bus sont encore plus proches.
Julius est un hôte sympathique et très réactif. La procèdure d'accès au logement est très rapide et très simple.
Great place
Very nice place to be. 🙋🏻‍♂️
lovely apartment very clean, excellent hosts
War alles super, gerne wieder:-)!
A bright and cozy place to stay. Big room, space to work if you need it, bed is soft. The  cat is cute :-)
Phillip is a really lovely guy. Very accommodating and friendly. The place was very clean and had everything we needed.
Good location, right next to the station.
Lovely place and definitely will stay again if it is available when we come to Berlin

An sich war alles ok. Nur sah die wng deutlich schöner und vor allem größer aus auf den Bildern und die Lage war definitiv nicht in der Näher von irgendetwas grünen wie man irreführenderweise auf manchen Bildern der anzeige gezeigt bekommt. Es gab jeden Morgen Kindergeschrei im Hof zu hören (Kindergarten im haus) und das erste was ich beim Check in machen musste war fast 100€ zu zahlen. Die Unterkunft hat mich 167€ pro Tag gekostet und das war sie definitiv nicht wert. Maximal 80€ die Nacht. Leider nicht zu empfehlen.
Zeer nette studio. Alles is goed geregeld en er stond zelfs een verse bos bloemen. Smaakvol en gezellig ingericht. Het voelt als een warm welkom.
Perfekt beliggenheten når du skal besøke Berlin. Gangavstand til det meste. Gode restauranter og barer i umiddelbar nærhet, men det er en fordel å bestill bord når du er en større gruppe.
Kiki and Christian are very friendly hosts, we had a wonderful 2-night stay at their cosy apartment in the lovely and multicultural neighbourhood of Kreutzberg
Great location,  and has got a few lovely bakeries and coffee shops around. Just be mindful that it is a sofa bed in the living room, FYI.

We had a good stay! We arrived late but everything was prepared for us and we could check in ourselves which was nice! The room looked clean and was spacious, the only thing was the fact that the 3th bed was located in the kitchen and a bit small, but beside that it looked good. The location was nice as well. The metro station is in front so you can easy travel to the city centre or other places
The room was perfectly clean and comfortable and the hotel is well located. I would recommend it.
Alles wie immer bestens

Everything was perfect with Kitty's place, the only detail I could point is that the courtins are translucent and there is to much light very early in the morning, specially in summer, but just that, for the rest it was all very good.

Charlotte was very available and very kind.
Overall, the flat was outstanding, beautiful and very well situated. Many bars and restaurants are close and the metro is just a few minutes by foot.

Rene’s apartment is located in a great area close to lots of food venues and some good spaces for a drink/nightlife. The train links into town were quick and you can be straight in Alexanderplatz in around 15 minutes. Tickets for the train are around €9 for 4 trips. The beds in the apartment were very comfortable and the bathroom and living spacious were immaculate and lovely in terms of facilities and style.
Rene was a wonderful host, quick to respond, helpful with advice and friendly and accommodating throughout.
If we were to visit Berlin again Rene would be top of our list!

Lage, Ausstattung, Kommunikation, Sauberkeit, Apartment an sich - alles top!
Kann die Wohnung von Julian und Lisa auf jeden Fall Sehr weiterempfehlen! :)
شقه نظيفه اقامه ممتعه ومريحه جدا توجد نقطه صغيره الدخول في الساعه 16:00 والخروج في الساعة 10:00 عدا ذالك كل شي مثالي مؤكد سوف نعود مره اخرى

This was a last minute trip and thankfully we found this studio apartment. Asli was so kind and accommodating. We ended up arriving earlier than planned and she was able to adjust to those changes. The place itself was so clean and aesthetically pleasing. The bed was very comfortable, I slept like a baby! Extra points for having a full body mirror, it came in handy since this was a new years trip. Location is perfect, very close to the tram and near by are a lot of shops and restaurants. Great place, even better host. 10/10 recommend!

Wir waren zu dritt unterwegs und Marcus’ Wohnung war perfekt für ein verlängertes Wochenende. Sehr gemütlich und komfortabel! Die Gegend um das AirBnB war sehr angenehm - gute Anbindung, tolle Cafés und Restaurants nur wenige Gehminuten entfernt. Gerne wieder!
nette ruhig gelegene FeWo mit allem, was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in der Stadt braucht.
Eine ganz tolle Unterkunft, mit einer super Lage und einer tollen Gastgeberin :)

Onestamente l’alloggio va bene per pernottare qualche notte, non come ho fatto sia adatto per un lungo periodo di un mese come nel mio caso. La cucina non è ben equipaggiata, le padelle sono vecchie e rovinate, dal rubinetto non esce acqua calda, per cui è difficile lavare le stoviglie. My wife and I spent 6 nights in this apartment. Here are the positives and negatives of the place.
Good points :
Auto check-in works great. Also, we were arriving early in Berlin and Sören agreed to let us check in early. Thanks Soren.
The apartment itself is in a very nice area. There are many restaurants within walking distance, grocery stores, bars, etc.
If you like to walk, in about 45 minutes you can walk to the centre. Anyway, the metro station is very close, so it's very easy to go anywhere in Berlin.
In other words, the location of the apartment is perfect.
The apartment is well equipped for cooking, washing your clothes, etc.
Negative points :
The apartment is smaller than it looks from the pictures.
There is no closed room, everything is open.
The wall directly adjacent to the street is a window. The curtains must therefore be closed all the time otherwise people can see you from the street.
There are no other windows in the apartment and the air conditioning is stand-alone (no heat exhaust outside) so ventilation can be a problem. The week we spent in Berlin was not too hot, so we did not suffer from the heat.
There was no soap, no shampoo, no coffee available when we arrived. I always appreciate when these are available for a day or two.
Would I go there again? Probably, surely, if a few of these issues would be resolved.
