Everything was fine!

After all, it is a hostel, so the cleanliness of the common rooms depends on the other guests. We were not as lucky, there was hair in the bathrooms and unflushed toilets sometimes. The kitchen had only a few spoons and forks for the amount of guests, and there was no microwave. The bath towels were clean, but an addition of hand towel would be appreciated.
We had a great time in Neta’s apartment. Bright, spacious, clean, well furnished, conveniently located, etc. Highly recommended!
Super friendly people! Great speedy communication, we cannot fault the apartment or the location. Great value!

Ellen's apartment is very nice and spacious and we found it clean, it is located in Prenzlauer Berg a peaceful neighborhood near a main road full of shops, pubs and etnic restaurants. The subway for downtown is five-minute walk away.

Christoph's place was awesome and we had great stay. As a host was very flexible, helpful, and kind. Location of the apartment near supermarkets, restaurants, and different public transportation options was great. Thank you!
Es war alles super. Anfängliche Probleme mit dem Zimmer wurden schnell und freundlich zum Vorteil der Gäste gelöst.
Groot appartement met veel voorzieningen. Vlakbij supermarkten en andere winkeltje. U-bahn vlakbij.

Wir hatten einen großartigen Aufenthalt in diesem Apartment in Berlin! Alles war komplett neu, modern eingerichtet und sehr sauber. Die Lage ist perfekt – sowohl mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln als auch zu Fuß sind viele Sehenswürdigkeiten und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten schnell erreichbar. Besonders hervorheben möchten wir die tolle Kommunikation: von der Buchung bis zum Check-out verlief alles reibungslos, schnell und sehr freundlich. Man merkt sofort, dass hier auf jedes Detail geachtet wurde, um den Gästen einen angenehmen Aufenthalt zu ermöglichen. Wir haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt und würden jederzeit wiederkommen. Absolute Empfehlung!

Ein tolles Apartment das für 4 bis 6 Personen, bestens geeignet ist.
Tolle Ausstattung, gute Lage, super sauber.
Man kann sich hier schnell wohl fühlen!
Exactly as pictured. Bar downstairs was highly convenient. Great location with easy access to public transit. Many good places within walking distance. Would recommend!
Das Zimmer ist gross und sauber. Hat alles was man für eine Übernachtung baraucht. Kommunikation war freundlich und einwandfrei. Ich würde das Zimmer noch mal nehmen.

was disappointed in the "beds" there was truly 1 bed that slept 2 people but the other "beds" should of been described more as cots. they were single chairs that had hideaway beds but the legs to hold the bottom of the"beds" had been broken before our arrival. when I emailed her about it she said she was aware and would have it looked at on Monday. we left on Monday. while we told her we were okay with it it was because we had appointments and could change them.

The interior of the apartment is basic, but everything is really neat and there is even coffee, tea and cubes for the dishwasher. The apartment has a fantastic location. We were lucky that it was beautiful autumn weather and we could use the lovely balcony. So highly recommended.

We had the best time in Henning & Arianes appartment. Its easy to get to the center of Berlin from there and it is definitely also worth taking a walk in the neighbourhood.
The appartment is clean and cosy and nothing is missing. Grocery shopping nearby.
Henning & Ariane are so kind and welcoming and we will absolutely recommend everyone to stay at their place.

Apostolos is an amazing host and from the service received I am not surprised that he is a Superhost! I noticed and appreciated his commitment towards the guests from any small particular. Indeed, the house provides you with everything and you are so happily surprised to notice all the useful things that you can find in the house. You will appreciate all the efforts that Apostolos makes to help and make his guests happy! I totally recommend him as a host! The listing is wonderful, in a great location and very cozy!

7/5 Punkten.
Das Wc/Badezimmer ist sehr sauber und top Modernisiert. Das Bett war sehr bequem. Die Kommunikation mit Frank war einwandfrei und empfehlenswert.
Die Lage ist sehr gut, es gibt tolle Möglichkeiten was zu essen und zu parken.

Marco war ein sehr guter Gastgeber! Die Wohnung ist super sauber und schlicht, aber stilvoll eingerichtet. Das Bett ist ein Traum, es hat alles sehr frisch gerochen. Wer gern etwas außerhalb von Berlin unterkommt und in einer schönen, ruhigen Gegend unterkommen möchte, ist hier genau richtig!
Eine typische Berliner Altbau-Wohnung mit knarrenden Dielenboden. Gute zentrale Lage.

Alex has an easy-going and fun personality. He answered all my questions fast and precisely. I really enjoyed staying in his place. House was close to city center either walking or taking metro or bus :) The house has high ceilings and a balcony which makes the experience much more enjoyable. The apartment was clean and had everything I needed. It was really easy to access to the kitchen and bathroom. Thanks for everything, I would definitely recommend him. Hope to be back!

Great safe and friendly neighborhood with lots of bars and food options. Public transportation was a breeze with the station being a 5 min walk from the apartment. Myself and 3 friends were able to sleep comfortably with each of us having our own bed which were really comfortable. Many stores and restaurants close early during the week and the street can get a bit loud in the morning which is something to keep in mind. This apartment is ideal for getting around the city, I would stay here again next time I’m in Berlin.

Rosita was a very good host and provided us with everything we needed for our stay in Berlin. The appartment offers every comfort one needs. It is well located to reach many parts of Berlin within a short time. We truly enjoyed our stay.
Typische Berliner Wohnung, sauber, alles da was man braucht, gute Lage und super Anbindung an den Nahverkehr. Auch parken ist kein Problem. Passt alles

We had a great time here! Super clean and comfortable space and Seb was a really responsive host and communicated well! Convenient location also (only a ten minute walk to the tube/train station) and a short trip to Alexander Platz.

Bianka a été une hôte parfaite, à l'écoute, disponible et très chaleureuse.
L'appartement est super, calme et extrêmement confortable (mention spéciale pour le lit).
Encore merci pour tout Bianka ! Tchüsssss
Det er en meget hyggelig og afslappet lejlighed. Den er ren og godt indrettet. Et stille og lokalt kvarter tæt på togstation og indkøb. Pina er nem at kommunikere med.
Alles super durchdacht und vorbereitet. Der perfekte Airbnb Aufenthalt!

Kolejny pobyt w Hotelu Comenius i kolejne maksymalne zadowolenie.
Od ostatniego pobytu w marcu zmienił się wystrój pokoju - zdecydowanie na plus.
No i pracownik hotelu (Pablo), gdyby kiedyś szukał pracy w polskim hotelu to z chęcią zatrudnię go u siebie :)

El apartamento de Na es posiblemente una de las mejores opciones para todos aquellos que están buscando un hogar bueno, bonito y a buen precio en Berlín. Queda en un muy buen lugar, cerca tanto de la estación de metro como de tranvía. Hay restaurantes muy buenos por la zona que hacen descuentos al mediodía.
El apartamento es absolutamente cómodo, los sofás son tan buenos que con mi compañero de cuarto a veces simplemente nos quedábamos dormidos ahí y no salíamos a ninguna parte jajaja. Tiene todo lo necesario: lavadora, nevera e implementos de cocina.
Por último, Na es un host increíble. No solo responde rápido y a todas las dudas, sino que nos ayudó incluso con cosas que no tenía nada que ver con nuestra estadía. Nos recomendó los mejores lugares, nos ayudó con varios problemas y en todo momento estuvo muy pendiente de cómo nos sentíamos.
110% recomendado!

No hot water, slow communication from hosts. Listed for 4 people but the sofa couch was unstable. Found another guests socks in the sheets. Pillows were deflated and towels were tiny and old. Location was good. All the construction did not bother me bc there were other things to be concerned about.
Super schöne, gemütliche Wohnung! Der Kontakt zur Rafal und Aga war sehr nett und unkompliziert. Eine klare Empfehlung
Nice family, was happy about the room and the friendliness. Would recommend.

Bee hat uns freundlich empfangen und uns das Zimmer gezeigt. Der Aufenthalt hat reibungslos funktioniert. Die Familie hat einen wunderschönen Kater ☺️. Das einzige störende waren die vielen Schnaken im Zimmer, sonst hat es uns super dort gefallen. Vielen Dank für die Unterkunft!

This boat is an adventure. Pedal boat, self build island on lake in middle of Berlin. Small living room with fireplace, nice bedroom. Place for a grill.
Very open and nice host. We dropped into a lake pedal boat lock, but host was very nice and did not charge any costs.
It's not a place for everybody. We don't recommend it for parents with small children, but if you like adventures, houseboats or caravans - you will love it.
Danke für die Übernachtungsmöglichkeit. Für einen weiteren Kurs, komme ich gern wieder.

Ich habe mich sehr wohl in der ordentlichen und sauberen Unterkunft gefühlt!
Vielen Dank :) bis zum nächsten mal

Katja was a great host, she accommodated me last minute, was very welcoming and kind, gave me great recommendations for the city, and the place was stunning. I would recommend this stay to anyone and would be happy to come back some day :)

Dieses gemütliche Studio war die perfekte Unterkunft für meinen kurzen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Es war ausgestattet mit allem was man braucht und mehr. Ich fühlte mich gleich wie daheim. Danke Jonathan & Raissa!
Hat alles gepasst, gerne wieder.

Numa team was very helpful and check in was easy although the room was not easily accessible. The room was very small but clean (it looked better online than in reality). The location was okay and relatively easy to reach from the BE Hbf and the BER airport. The local transport was also decent although it was relatively far from my conference location. I would not recommend this accommodation to the people who travel for work because it is more a student hostel type of place. The sound isolation was very poor so I could hear unpleasant noise from other rooms at various floors. Anyway, thank you Numa for your service.

Jens was a great host. Very helpful, kind and sociable. He always made us feel at home and helped us get to the house from the airport as well as showed us around town. I am very grateful to him!
The house had everything we needed and public transit to center Berlin was close and easy to use.
I definitely reccomend anyone who is considering staying at Jens to do so!

It was so nice to "live" in Berlin for around 2 weeks! Amazing Gemüsedöner across the street, and when I thought I could get the stove to start (It was my own fault, I unplugged it earlier haha) I got super quick and nice replies! Thank you for the stay! :)
Frank is very polite and kind. Thank you to let me stay at your place !
Ruhige Lage in einem Innenhof, trotzdem ist man schnell bei Kneipen und Restaurants am Schlesischen Tor.
Leuk appartement en echt een toplocatie!
A good quality hotel without the reception. Clean, calm, simple, good bed, perfect location ....I definitely recommend !

Nicht so fresh und stylisch wie auf den Bildern, aber es wurde sich um alles sofort gekümmert. Es war warm, ruhig und angenehm. Wenn mal wieder frisch gestrichen wird, entspricht es auch wieder der Beschreibung.
Wibke is a wonderful person and host. Enjoyed our stay at her place.
Super Unterkunft, Beste Lage, relativ ruhig. Gerne wieder.

Mega freundliches Service Team, die dir helfen wo sie können.
Gute Anbindung mit öV.
Preis- Leistung top!!!

Martin is a fantastic host!!  He was very helpful in explaining where attractions are in the city, and answered all of our questions. Martin's apt is in a good location and fit my group of 4 perfectly. I highly recommend staying with Martin
Sehr schönes, gepflegtes Apartment in zentraler Lage. Kann ich nur empfehlen!
Andrew was very friendly, responsive and flexible even though we arrived outside of the "official" check-in time window.
had a wonderful time! host was super helpful and Ruby is such a sweetheart 🙏
Wunderschöne Altbauwohnung  in tollen und aufregendem Viertel. Haben die kurze Zeit extrem genossen und schätzten die gute Kommunikation mit Benjamin. Sehr zu empfehlen.
Es war alles super bis auf ich durfte nicht vor 15 uhr ein Check in ansonsten war alles gut
Great place thats a but far from centre hence the fair price. Nice room with cupboards, desk, couch, table and a fan for hot nights.
房间设备很齐全，周围买东西也很方便，但是WIFI信号不是很好

We really enjoyed our stay at Dimitris' flat, which is cozy and well equipped. The flat is located on a quiet street with convenient transportation, laundry, supermarket, restaurant and stylish stores nearby. We didn't meet Dimitris but hosted by Alena, she explained everything we needed detailedly, and gave us lots of suggestions. I do recommend this flat and hope that I'll have a chance to stay here next time when traveling in Berlin.

It was great to stay somewhere so well equipped, especially in the kitchen. Good local transport links but we also walked into town from hereba couplebof times. We also really appreciated that when we went to leave our luggage after getting off the sleeper train, they let us move in early as the flat was alredy cleaned. So nice to get showered before we headed out to explore (not many hosts would have been that helpful). Thanks for a great stay.
A very nice place to stay, and a lovely host, very welcoming. We really enjoyed our stay in Berlin, and we definitely recommend Jenny's place !
Enkel lejlighed, god placering i Berlin, moderne indrettet, godt lys

Great place to stay for a few days in Berlin.
Swift check-in. Quick responses. Clean and well maintained room and facilities

Eckehard's home is a little gem of a place:  a lovely spacious house teeming with charm, light and positive energy; a quiet road in a pretty neighborhood with good public transportation; a bedroom with a comfortable mattress, top-notch bedlinen and a desk that comes in handy when you need to work; the privacy of your own -and incredibly well-equipped- bathroom. Eckehard has paid attention to all details. Getting to the center of town is easy: you walk two blocks to catch the bus that takes you within minutes to the subway stop - and then it's only a twenty-minute ride to downtown. But, most importantly: Eckehard is a pleasant, gracious and thoughtful host who welcomes you personally and makes sure you feel at home every step of the way.  And you do - within minutes of getting there! Eckehard's place is a true find.
Jay has a beautiful designed home. The room is private and Jay is a great help and very friendly and private. 10/10!!

This apartment is located in a very convenient part of Berlin. Plenty of things to do and see. All major attractions can be easily accessed by the public transit system. Having this apartment as our home base made our trip to Berlin that much more enjoyable.
Great communication good location

Check in went very smoothly even with the language barrier and the instructions received for how to get to the apartment were very clear. The room was very nice and clean and the amenitites were perfect. We had flights that were earlier than the check out time and Daniel was extremely accomodating for this. The neighborhood is very quiet and easily accessible to the metro line. A wonderful experiences overall.
着いてから部屋の紹介など何もなく鍵を渡され、自分の部屋に入れてくれただけでした。部屋はとても雰囲気の良いかんじでした。
Very central location in Berlin with easy check in.

Also diese Unterkunft ist eine Frechheit. Diese positiven Bewertungen kann ich NICHT verstehen! Sowas unverschämtes habe ich in meinem ganzen Leben noch nicht erlebt.
Wir kamen an und hatten von dem innengebäude eigentlich einen guten Eindruck. Es sah gut eingerichtet aus und war eigentlich ganz in Ordnung.
Als wir an die Rezeption kamen, haben wir die Buchung hin gezeigt und haben unsere Karte für den Bereich bekommen. Als wir aufs Zimmer kamen, sahen wir das bis auf 2 Betten schon alles voll war. Es waren keine schränke zum abschließen da, hieß wir mussten unten ein Schloss kaufen für einen Preis von 3,90€. Frechheit.
Als wir hoch kamen sahen wir das eine Person in das Zimmer ging, zu unserem Entsetzen es war ein Mann. Wir waren geschockt. Männer und Frauen in einem Zimmer? Was soll sowas? Wir haben uns dann ein neues Hotel gebucht. Zum Glück eins gefunden. Wir werden auf jedenfall das Hostel NIEMANDEN weiterempfehlen sondern eher von abraten!
ruhige, zentral gelegenes Zimmer mit Wohlfühl-Atmosphäre - jederzeit wieder :-)

Drei Wochen haben wir in der Wohnung von Robin gewohnt. Wunderbar! Ruhe und perfekte Lage..... viele nette Restaurants ganz in der Nähe, die Tram und Ubahn ebenso..... alles in allem ein wunderbarer Ort um Berlin zu erkunden! Wir kommen gerne wieder! Danke Robin! Hans und Claudia

Schön gelegenes Hostel, preislich okay. Einen Punkt Abzug gibt es für die kaputte Dusche und den sehr lauten Boden im Gang. Der Empfang von den Herren an der Rezeption war super und wir haben gleich eine kleine Stadtführung auf der Karte erhalten und ein paar Tipps bekommen.

Wir hatten zu viert schöne Tage in der toll ausgestatteten Wohnung, super zentrale Lage mit guten Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Nähe und tolle Tipps von Sven wie das Cafe am Engelbecken. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
lively and clean. very specious. helpful advice given by host

Great location for exploring Berlin. Handy for subway, great restaurants/coffee very nearby.
Apartment, quiet , spacious, it suited our needs perfectly.
We would recommend staying here.
Alison
位置很好，去看博物馆方便，房间便利设施都有，希望提高的是wifi网速，很多时候太慢了，我用的自己的5G流量。还是给出全满分评价，推荐
Great apartment great vibe and energy. The design and furniture was very inspiring. Location is central couldn’t have asked for more

Sehr schöne Wohnung in einer tollen Villa mit wunderschönem Garten.
Antje hat alles getan, um uns den Aufenthalt noch angenehmer zu machen. Wir freuen uns schon auf den nächsten Besuch!

Karsten's flat is fantastic, right around the corner from shops, groceries, and restaurants, and a tube station. The flat is bright, comfortable and clean, we really enjoyed it. Kartsten was a great host, everything was really easy!
Die Wohnung war super schön und hatte für uns die perfekte Lager! Vielen Dank, dass alles so gut und schnell geklappt hat.

Appartement très agréable, c'était parfait, la literie est de bonne qualité et c'est très bien équipé, emplacement ++. Seul bémol l appartement est assez sombre mais il y a un petit balcon très agreable

We enjoy staying in places that are a little bit unique and this was certainly one of them! Wonderful central location and Aglaja was a fantastic host throughout. Would highly recommend this to anyone staying in Berlin

Bei unserem Aufenthalt in Berlin hat sich unsere ganze Familie (6 Personen) in dem schönen Appartement sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Mitarbeiter an der Rezeption waren immer sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Das Appartement wurde jeden Tag zu unserer Zufriedenheit gereinigt. An Geschirr und Einrichtung war alles vorhanden, was wir brauchten. Die Anbindung mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln war super. In der unmittelbaren Umgebung gibt es jede Menge schöne Geschäfte und Restaurants.

The place is very Nice and in a excellent neighbourhood. The room is Nice and she even left us Some drinks and snacks! Thank you for that.
The area is super Nice and there a loats of places for diner and drinks.
The only thing that was less pleasent is that it is very noisey in the appartement. You can really here the neighboors talk and have conversations and the children run next door. Also the upper living people you can here. For us it was not bad because we dont party and wake up early. But if you want to sleep till 11.00 you need to be a good sleeper haha. Overall it is a Nice place and the communication is super easy with ulla.
alles gut, leider ein wenig laut mit dem Bahnhof, aber dafür mit Ohropax und gut zu erreichen. Der Kontakt war super freundlich, unkompliziert und schnell.
Es war einfach super vielen Dank

Natalie's place was great!! Super friendly welcome with fresh fruit, some wine and also very clean apartment! We were there for business so didn't spend much time there but the comfortable beds ensured we got a good nights rest :)
excellent klean appartmen and kind hosts I advise this Wohnung great
Was a very nice  and cossy flat located in a quiet area. Michael is a very kindly person.

Sehr gemütliches Haus, entspannte Atmosphäre, sehr freundliche Gastgeberin.
Danke Sophie

Nous avons choisi cette chambre pour son rapport qualité/prix et son emplacement' géographique et la chambre est correcte pour ce tarif!
Les points positifs:
- à proximité des transports en commun (bus et métro)
- Les hôtes sont flexibles sur les horaires d'arrivée et de depart
- la chambre est minimaliste, mais propre
- une salle d'eau privative
Les points négatifs:
- il y a une autre chambre Airbnb juste à côté, dans le même couloir
- on entend tout ! Les murs sont très mal isolés
- pas de volet ou store roulant
Das Zimmer ist korrekt für den Preis und gut gelegen.
In der Nähe gibt es Busse und u-Bahn Stationen.
Das Viertel ist nicht das sehenswürdigste, aber gut verbunden.
Das Zimmer ist recht klein aber mit privater Dusche.
Allerdings befindet sich im gleichen Flur ein zweites Airbnb Zimmer.
Leider ist am Fenster kein Rollladen und es ist relativ laut - man hört bei den Nachbarn alles !
Alles in einem für den Preis korrekt.

I had a thoroughly enjoyable stay two weeks at Sven’s apartment in Berlin. Sven is a gracious and attentive host, who was both kind and genuinely interested in ensuring my comfort throughout the visit.
The apartment is ideally situated on Plaenzauer Allee, right in the heart of Berlin, with easy access to charming streets, excellent cafés, and a variety of restaurants. The location offers both convenience and a true sense of the city’s vibrant atmosphere.
The flat itself is beautifully decorated, with thoughtful details that create a warm and inviting environment. The kitchen is well-equipped, making it easy and enjoyable to prepare meals at home. Overall, this accommodation provided both comfort and style, and I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Berlin.

I had a great weekend stay at Jan’s air bnb. The accommodation was clean and spacious for one person. Most importantly, I felt safe as a solo woman in both the neighborhood and building. I especially loved the blue bathroom tiles. The location was just a few blocks between two subway stations which made traveling a breeze. The neighborhood is filled with great restaurants and an abundance of local shops. Jan’s instructions for traveling from the airport and getting into the apartment were clear and accurate. The building was quiet and I safely left my luggage in the entry hall for several hours after check out without issue.
I’d only note that there are quite a few doors with different entry methods that can be tricky figuring out the first time, but Jan provides photos for instruction. The kitchen facilities are also very simple so I wouldn’t recommend for someone looking to cook a lot- not an issue for my short stay.
Overall I’d recommend to others and would gladly return.

My boyfriend and I booked an apartment from Nena Apartments and it really felt amazing. The location was perfect to move around using public transports (within 10 minutes by foot) but it was very close by foot too (in 20 minutes we arrived in Alexander Platz, one of the most popular places for tourism). The apartment was clean and comfy, we truly felt at home coming back at the end of the day.
Would really recommend it!

Die Wohnung liegt im EG und hat bis auf ein kleines Fenster im Bad keine Fenster, die man öffnen kann.
Vor mir hatte jmd in der Wohnung geraucht und ich konnte nicht lüften.
Der Bett steht Richtung Strasse auf einem einer Empore. Dementsprechend laut ist es.
Ich habe mich nicht wohlgefühlt.

Le séjour fut très agréable, Béatrice fut très aimable avec nous, et l’appartement est très charmant, et très calme :) à deux minutes des transports, on arrive au centre de Berlin très facilement ! on reviendra avec plaisir ! Encore merci !

A wonderful, unique experience!  Very clean, peaceful, beautiful atmosphere. Sparkling clean with great light and air and many little treasures to delight the eyes;  wonderful assortment of herbal teas.  Several excellent, inexpensive dining options close by; pleasant neighborhood walking;  good, frequent tram service.  Kathrin was a gracious and helpful host.  Thank you for the great little weekend stay!

The apartment was very cute. As other reviews mention, the apartment can be accessed from the main road so that meant it was a little noisy at times, but it was really comfortable once I got used to the street ambience. Snacks, tea, coffee and washing supplies were provided which meant I could make myself at home easily.

We had a great time here....the apartment is cool and spacious in a really lively part of Kreuzberg with a great bar next-door and very good restaurants all within working distance. The underground and buses were also excellent and easy to work out. Many main attractions were easily accessible and we managed to travel all over Berlin easily and cheaply and were really impressed by the city. It was lovely to hear so much birdsong outside our windows and to see three red squirrels playing in the trees.  It was mostly really and surprisingly quiet in the apartment  - well, with an exceptional noisy night one weekend from an upstairs neighbour who I think was only there for two nights....but, hey,  this is Kreuzberg and it is a fun place to stay.  We felt that we really saw the real Berlin here and were impressed by how friendly and helpful everyone was.

The apartment is located in a calm area, away from the city center but well communicated by bus and subway. The kitchen and bathroom are very well equipped.
The only slight negative was the floors being a bit dusty. However, in all other aspects the apartment was a great place to stay and we were very comfortable there.

A perfect spot for our week in the city. Right next to the underground so we were able to enjoy Berlin to it's fullest. The apartment itself is very pretty, the kitchen is small but had all the amenities for cooking.
Comfy beds with a nice view through the kitchen window.
Would stay again!
Thanks for your hospitality and your help I would like to recommend this place for anyone with small family want to spend View days in Berlin

Ganz hervorragend zentral und doch ruhig gelegen, wunderbarer Dielenboden, alles sehr liebevoll, sauber und gemütlich.
Sehr schöne Wohnung, auch für 4 Personen genug Platz.
Everything was perfect
Everything was perfect - very clean, great interior design, perfect location, so easy to go in and out thanks to the padlocks.
Perfect location to go out and have dinner and drinks in Friedrichshain in walking distance, lots of space in the apartment itself and very clean! Would book again immediately.
Great place📍great stuff 🫰
It was an amazing apartment, great value and very modern, in an amazing location so close to the best pubs and clubs in Berlin. Highly recommend
It was great!!
very spacious. has everything you need and in a good location

Hébergement parfait !
Charlotte est très réactive et arrangeante.
Le logement est agréable on s’y sent vraiment très bien. Mention spéciale au soleil le matin dans la pièce principale qui fait du bien. Tout est très propre. Il y a des petites attention partout, on ne manque de rien ! Le quartier est sympa pour se promener et proximité des transports.

Sehr schöne Lage, ruhig, aber trotzdem in der Nähe von vielen Restaurants, Kneipen, einem Park. Nächste U-Bahn und Tram Haltestelle etwa 5-10 Minuten Laufweg. Schöne Wohnung, schnelle und unkomplizierte Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber.

Check in war absolut unproblematisch.
Wir waren nur zum Schlafen da. Und das haben wir super!
Das Bad ist sehr klein, aber das hat uns nicht gestört.
Alles super gewesen gerne wieder!
War zum zweiten Mal da und auch diesmal vollauf zufrieden. Die Einschätzung beim Preis – Leistung (vier von fünf Punkten) war daher, dass ich die großzügige Wohnung alleine nutzte.
Alles hat gepasst!

Le logement était super et bien situé par rapport à la ville. Nous avons eu quelques problèmes avec des couvertures et oreillers manquantes et pas d’eau chaude dans la douche. Malgré tout le logement est très bien pour un séjour à Berlin.
Very comfortable space at a well-connected area. Having the metro station just in front was very helpful to mobilize everywhere.
Leider war im Badezimmer ein sehr unangenehmer Geruch. Ansonsten war aber alles gut.
David was a great host, warm and nice apartment, the location is nice and safe, free parking area nearby.
Wonderful little room in Berlin! Hagie was very nice and gave a fantastic list of restaurant recommendations. Would absolutely stay here again

My mum and I stayed at Franziska's apartment for three nights and found it perfect for what we were looking for. Close to subways, comfortable living, kitchen available, many restaurants/sites close by. Franziska was a lovely host and her daughter Zoe was very fun, and the dog Leon was always around :D
I would highly recommend this apartment.
Everything was great, nice apartment, close to the u-bahn and loads of restaurants, bars and cafes.  Bernardo was also very helpful.

Lovely apartment
Great place, location. Very quiet.  Perfect!

Die Wohnung ist blitzsauber und wirklich sehr schön eingerichtet. Die Qualität der Einrichtung ist außerdem sehr hochwertig und auch die Lage, sowie die Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel lässt keine Wünsche offen.

Nice host, nice room, convenient location for visiting museums and other major attractions in Berlin.
Very friendly host and super easy check-in. Not far away from the subway to get into town. Recommended for sure.

René is a great host, super welcoming and friendly. This was my second stay at his place and would always stay here again if it's available. The apartment is beautiful and in a great location. Very clean chic modern apartment, with easy walking access to groceries, bakeries, the river and the tram. Quiet family neighborhood, and a good base for exploring Berlin.

Ich hatte einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt in Charlottenburg. Der Gastgeber war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit, das Zimmer gemütlich und sauber. Jederzeit würde ich wiederkommen :)

Michael was an excellent host. He was there waiting for us when we arrived. He gave us maps and tips on the area. The apartment was clean, spacious and secure. He even left us some basic bathroom and kitchen items. We would highly recommend staying here.

Very Happy - Friendly, Happy to Help, Relaxing Stay.

Das Airbnb war gut für einen Kurztrip geeignet und gut zu finden. Die Kommunikation war super unkompliziert. Der Preis stimmt auch. Die Matratzen sind lediglich sehr unbequem und sollten getauscht werden. Sonst kommen wir gern auf einen zweiten Besuch.

Great room, lovely hotel, friendly and helpful staff. Would definitely stay here again.
Wir hatten einen schönen, angenehmen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Die Lage der Unterkunft ist super, man erreicht alle interessanten Orte in nur wenigen Minuten mit der S- oder U-Bahn.

We had a lovely stay , the apartment is clean and in a great location. The hosts were very responsive and helpful. We would definitely stay here again.

Very cozy and warm apartment. Nina took care of every detal to make your stay comfortable and feel like home.

Die Unterkunft war nach der Beschreibung nicht schwer zu finden. An sich muss man sagen, dass die Lage der Unterkunft einfach nicht optimal ist, wobei Neukölln was zu bieten hat.
Grundsätzlich muss man den zwischen Flur von Eingang zur Unterkunftstür kritisieren, da dieser einladender gestaltet werden könnte. Unterkunft ähnelt einer Fabrik, laut Gastgeberangabe korrekt, jedoch muss sie nicht so aussehen, wenn man diese als Unterkunft anbietet. Der Boden hatte einige Flecken. Wir haben uns keine Hausschuhe mitgenommen, da laut Angabe welche da sein sollten. War am Anfang ziemlich kalt. In der Küche fehlt es an genügend Gläsern und Tellern.
Ich bin ein Fan von minimalistischem Design, aber ein wenig mehr kann man aus der Unterkunft machen.
Das Bad sah sehr schön aus und die Sauna war auch echt super.
Im ganzen keine schlechte Unterkunft!
Ein wenig Bedarf zur Verbesserung besteht, dann wäre es echt schön.

The apartment is very cozy and clean. It looks just like in pictures. The location is amazing! So close to all the restaurants and public transportation. I will definitely stay again.
Tolle Lage, sehr schöne lichtdurchflutete Wohnung. Perfekt für einen gelungenen Berlin-Aufenthalt.

Sabrina's place and hospitality can never be justified through words alone. The place is superbly located, very well maintained and replete with all facilities to make a comfortable and enjoyable stay. Sabrina as a host is a wonderful person to interact with. She provides all the help and suggestions. Had a great time staying at her place and wish I would have spend few more days. Definitely a must recommend place if you are looking for one in Berlin. Will definitely recommend and stay at her place whenever I am in Berlin again.

Berlin’in nasıl bir yer olduğunu bilmediğimiz için ilk başta konum açısından tereddüt etmiştik ama gittğimizde farkettik konum açısından şanslı hissettik. Tren 4 dakika mesafede ve merkezi yerlere 3-4 durak. Rudolf’ un iletişimi çok güzel her şeye hemen cevap veriyor ve talimalatları açıkça anlatıyor. Tekrar gittiğimde tercih edeceğim her şey için teşekkürler :)

We had a really great time in Yves' appartment! It was really comfortable, in arguably the best area of Berlin, namely Friedrichshain. We were welcomed and shown around the appartment, and shortly after that we could do as we pleased. We had Yves' phone number for questions, but didn't need it as he left behind all the info about the neighbourhood. The street was really quiet, yet still very lively. Convenience stores (spätkauf) were within a 100 meters and a large supermarket  was only a 5 min walk away. Best of all, you really sensed you were in a residential area where you were surrounded by residents and not tourists, yet we always felt very welcome!
Rosario ist sehr nett und hilfsbereit und ich habe sehr gut geschlafen, die Matratze ist klasse :).
Clean and modern

Soli and Hani’s place is located in a beautiful neighborhood (Grunewald).  It has a quiet and clean feel and is a nice area to come home to after a busy day in Berlin.  The apartment is a 2 minute walk from Grunewald S-Bahn train station from where you can easily reach anywhere in Berlin.  Also near the train station are grocery stores, several restaurants, and a forest with hiking paths.  The apartment itself was very clean and the host was extremely hospitable and kind!  Highly recommend and would go back in a heartbeat!

We stayed in Alex' appartment with a group of six. The  appartment is excellent for a group this size. If you like fireworks Alex neighbourhood is the place to be on new years eve.  S bahn and shops (Penny and aldi) are nearby. Alex was  hospitable and  responded quickly to our questions though we never met him in person.

Tolle Erfahrung im Hinterhof in der zum Apartment umgebauten alten Schmiede wohnen zu dürfen! Mitten in Berlin, aber doch ruhig und für sich abgeschlossen. Die Schmiede ist Teil eines Komplexes, so dass man auch gut und gerne mit mehreren Paaren bzw. Gruppen dort eine wunderschöne Zeit verbringen kann. Man kommt an und fühlt sich sofort wohl. Mehr als empfehlenswert!!!
Sehr modernes, schönes Zimmer
Superrruim appartement voor 6 in het centrum van Berlijn. Metro vlakbij, en leuke buurt om iets te gaan eten.

Een schoon appartement op een top locatie. Op loopafstand van vele bezienswaardigheden.
Alle benodigdheden waren in het appartement aanwezig en sven was goed bereikbaar, behulpzaam en vriendelijk.
Enige nadeel was dat het slaprn wel lastigerwas; de gordijnen verduisteren vrijwel niet en de bedden waren erg hard.
Desondanks een toptijd gehad in Berlijn!
Great location. The hotel wasn't too busy and it was easy to relax there.
Good place to stay in a central location

Highly recommend this apartment. It was perfect for our family of four. We loved the special touches, like sweets for our children on our last day and local recommendations. The hosts were responsive and helpful. While the apartment is not super close to the main sites, the proximity to Beusselstraße train station was very convenient. Thank you Simon for a great stay!

Die Wohnung ist in einer sehr guten und ruhigen Lage von Charlottenburg mit gut Verkehrsverbindungen und hat alles was man braucht. Zwar ist kein Waschbecken in der Küche vorhanden aber man kann die paar Tasse und Teller vom Frühstück im Bad problemlos abspülen. Das Bad ist sehr groß und hat ein großes Fenster, was sehr angenehm ist. Gunilla hat für uns Wasser, Milch, Brot, Butter, Müsli, Expresso Tabs eingekauft. Im Bad stand auch Shampoo, Conditioner, Body cream, Parfüm zur Verfügung. Gunilla war immer bereit, wenn man sie braucht. Wir haben die Tage in Berlin sehr genossen. Wir kommen wieder.

We loved our stay here. The apartment was bigger than we expected, had all the essentials we needed and was very well heated in the colder weather. Ralph was very welcoming and communicative and the check-in and out process was easy. This was my second time staying in Kreuzberg and I would definitely stay in this apartment again! Thanks Ralph.
Very close to the trains. Good restaurants and coffee just around the block
Die Wohnung ist wie beschrieben sauber und gut gelegen. Trotz das sie Verkehrsgünstig ist war es sehr ruhig.

Daphne's apartment matched our expectations. It's well located. Less than 10 minutes by walk from Alexanderplatz. And 2 minutes from the metro station Jannowitzbrücke.
The apartment was clean. You will find anything you'll need to have a great stay. The kitchen is furnished and you'll find most tools needed to cook or prepare something quickly.
The Wifi and TV work fine.
Everything was clean and the beds are comfortable.
We had a great stay in Daphne's apartment and we would for sure come back again.
Beautiful apartment and a great location. Bert was an excellent host. The birds were a little bit unexpected, just to be aware if you are a light sleeper.

Super location, right next to the underground and tram and easy to find.  We arrived from the train station and the trip there on the tram was quick and easy. The area that it is in is close to the main tourist sites and it is easy to get to those on the underground.  The flat itself is comfortable, with a good use of space.  It was very clean and everything was easy to use.  There are two separate main sleeping areas, which are only separated by a frosted glass wall so the light from one lights the other which may be an issue if people have different bed times (or get up in the night) and the fans from the bathrooms are very loud and persist for a long time.  It was not a problem for us but may be a consideration for others.  The kitchen is well equipped and functions well.  Overall a great appartment in a great location.  Thanks!
Really nice place with a beautiful visual ! Also really well located with sweet host , thank you

It was my second time staying here and I really enjoyed the peace and quiet in a nice neighborhood with organic health food store close by. Angelika was as nice and welcoming as always with clear communication.

Appartement correspondant au descriptif. Propre. Bien situé (face au tram) pour arriver rapidement au centre.
Les consignes pour l'arrivée étaient claires.
Nous n'hésiterons pas à relouer lors d'un autre voyage à Berlin
Einfacher Check-In und coole Wohnung 👍🏻

Bianka's place is great, everything we needed, giant place. Great location, especially for the summer. Quiet and sweet neighborhood. All the amenities you could want or need. If it's available, book it!
Lovely space,wonderful hosts & an ideal place to explore Berlin from.
Чистая простая квартира для путешествий, метро в двух шагах, ничего лишнего. Для семьи отличный вариант, как и для пары путешественников.

Es ist eine saubere, gut gelegene Unterkunft.
Der Aufenthalt hat uns sehr gefallen
Wunderbare Wohnung direkt am Wasser in bester Kreuzberger Lage. Jederzeit wieder!
Ein sehr schönes, super ausgestattetes Airbnb in vorzüglicher Lage - sehr zu empfehlen! Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und bedanken uns für die herzliche Gastfreundschaft :)

Das kleine aber feine Zimmerchen bietet perfekt Platz für einen Kurzaufenthalt in Berlin mit perfekter Lage! Mit der S-Bahn kommt man super schnell überall hin und auch zu Fuß ist vieles zu erreichen. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt :)

L'appartement de Art est très propre et très bien équipé. Il nous a très bien reçu. La literie est vraiment confortable. Les pièces sont grandes. La terrasse doit être très agréable en été ou au printemps. Je recommande vivement cet appartement. Je reviendrai lors de mon prochain séjour à Berlin.
The apartment has a nice and quite location. The kitchen has a limited assortment of utillities so do not expect to cook a grant meal. All in all a good apartment with a central location.

This place was great! I was traveling with 3 friends, so it was a bit cozy but definitely worked out! It was walking distance to a lot of great restaurants and the park. Stella was an amazing host! She was extremely responsive and the directions for entry were amazingly detailed. I'd definitely recommend!

We had a great stay at Florian’s place. Cami, who we corresponded with, was quick to reply and very helpful with details about check in and directions from the train station to the flat.
Very nice location, great balcony and comfortable bed.
非常舒適的空間和友善的屋主，他除了耐心地向我們介紹附近的小區和柏林的景點外，還仔細地教導我們當地的交通，令我們有很舒服的旅程。

This place was really great, excellent location you can get to the center by walk if you want to see a little bit more or the public transport its close. Martin was really friendly and kind, unfortunately we only could be there for 1 night but he even recommend what to do and where to eat something. Really good!
Great place great people definitely would recommend 10/10
10 out of 10

We had such a great stay at Jan’s apartment. It was bigger than expected, with a really nice separate living room. The ground-floor location on a quiet courtyard worked great for us with loads of baggage. Comfy bed, decent shower/bath, all very clean and Jan was super welcoming and responsive. Also Schillerkiez is a great neighbourhood to be in, with loads of nice cafés and restaurants, and Tempelhof and Hasenheide parks right next door. Definitely recommend and we hope we’ll be back.
Nicole ist eine sehr freundliche zugewandte Person und gerne bereit zu helfen wenn was fehlt
Great location, clean appartement and a kind host.
Apartment is cozy, clean and Howy is hospitable host! Recommended.
房间好看，有小点心，自助入住很方便，喜欢

This place is in a great location, close to many restaurants etc.   A very vibrant district and easy to get to where we wanted to visit.   The host was very, very helpful.   I would definitely recommend this place to others.
Alles super, gerne wieder!

Haben uns bei Angela sehr wohlgefühlt.
Sehr ruhige und schöne Lage.
Vielen Dank!
Good location and perfect to pass a week
Great location and good value for money. Would stay again.
Mooi interieur

This place as kooky as it looks and has everything you need for a pleasant stay. I would say that the other inhabitants of the surrounding courtyard spend about five hours every night chatting and drinking beer so if you're a light sleep it might be too noisy for you.
Clean, modern space with everything you need (towels, hairdryer, microwave...). Very close to three U-stations.

leuk hostel, prettig personeel. Makkelijk te vinden wel was het vinden van een parkeer plek in de buurt vrij lastig te vinden (Dus houd hier rekening mee als je met de auto komt). bij aan komst werd er meteen een aankomst drankje aangeboden. Ik had helaas iemand op de kamer slapen die enorm snurkte maar ja dat kan je hebben in een hostel. De bar is 24/7 open en wij hebben hier veel langer gezeten dan de bedoeling was door de fijne sfeer. Overall als jij in Berlijn een slaap plaats zoekt waar je ook mensen kan ontmoeten en van een praatje houd is dit zeker een aanrader.

Günther was a great host. He was a great communicator, helpful and gave very clear instructions for check in.
The flat itself was well equipped and clean. Everything I needed was available.
The location was also good. There were supermarkets and shops 5 mins walk away. The local train station (also 5 mins walk away) had connections to tourist spots as well as the other train lines.
I can’t think of a single negative thing, so I definitely recommend this flat for a stay in Berlin!
Martin's place very close to an u-bahn station which makes it easy to go anywhere! The place was clean and we had no problems communicating whatsoever. Thank you, Martin. We had a great stay.
He charged with the bad tax

I really liked the apartment. It is a two bedroom apartment, with a nice living room, a complete kitchen, washing machine and dryer, and WC separated from the shower area.
The windows are big and there is a lot of light entering the apartment. The views are nice too. In the back, you can see the Sony Centre and also the balloon (Die Welt) when it is up. There are a lot of shops around and if you prefer to walk instead of taking the subway (there are two stations nearby), it is completely doable.
It is located on the top floor, so always expect some stairs even when using the lift.
I would highly recommend this place!

I was only there for one night but I found the apartment charming! Check-in and check-out were super easy, and its only a short walk from the U-Bahn. It was the perfect apartment to come back to after a long day of sight-seeing.

Alojamiento perfecto para disfrutar del barrio con más vida de Berlín. Bien comunicado. Para dos parejas está muy bien. Instrucciones de los propietarios correctas. Si volvemos a Berlín repetiriamos sin duda.
It was a very nice stay, we would definitely come back!
Very nice place and amazing hospitality from Paul and Jana. Location is very great to travel to city centre, área is very calm. We have enjoyed every day spending in this apartment.
Flat was in a really great location and matched expectations.

Jo is great! The space is quite spacious and the bed is really comfy. It has a prime location that is very easy to get to. Also, there’s an elevator, which was particularly great as we had large suitcases!

erg fijne lokatie in Prenzlauerberg. Het appartement is zeer schoon en netjes en met een fijn dakterras. Hou er wel rekening mee dat je niet zoveel privacy hebt op het dakterras, maar dat mag de pret niet drukken. Hier verblijven is echt een aanrader. Ik had wel geluk dat ik last minute dit appartement kreeg tegen een schappelijke prijs vergelijkbaar met andere appartementen in de regio. Tegen de normale prijs vind ik het wat aan de dure kant, maar als geld minder een rol speelt zou ik hier zeker voor gaan en vanuit de lokatie is gezien de enorm hoge prijzen van vastgoed de prijs wel weer realistisch.
Alles wie beschrieben. Top Lage, sehr sauber und unkompliziert. Können wir nur weiterempfehlen!
Very nice hostel. Super friendly staff and the room was very clean 👍🏻

Der Aufenthalt bei Rochus war super! Die Unterkunft ist genau so wie auf den Bildern zu erkennen. Alles war sauber und super vorbereitet. Rochus selbst ist ein sehr sehr angenehmer Gastgeber, mit dem wir uns gut unterhalten konnten, der uns aber in seinem Haus auch genügend Freiraum gab. Im Sommer werden wir definitiv wieder kommen!

L'auberge de jeunesse Singer est idéale pour un séjour à Berlin entre amis, les chambres sont propres et rangées, avec possibilité de louer des serviettes. Il y a toujours quelqu'un à la réception, la communication avec l'hôte est facile. Le logement est à proximité des transports en commun, ce qui est très utile à Berlin. Merci !
Gutes Hotel zu fairen Preisen. Ich komme gerne wieder.

The flat is very good, everything perfectly equipped, Albert's care that we are well has been a plus, he has received us and said goodbye, and that we left the flat at an unusual time and with the taxi to the airport at the door, all a detail.
Very good host!.
The area, although it is not Berlin centre, is a very nice residential neighbourhood, quiet, with a supermarket in front and many bars and restaurants nearby.
There is also a shopping area about a kilometre away.

Wolf sent me a few helpful e-mails in preparation for our arrival.  We let him know when we planned to arrive and he met us at the apartment.  We were thrilled about the size, layout, and location.  We were even more excited to have a full kitchen and washing machine.  Wolf explained everything we needed to know and gave us helpful tips about the neighborhood.  The grocery store is right around the corner.  There are many restaurants on the block.  And the subway and tram stop is only a block away.  The apartment was very clean and it had everything we needed for our brief stay in Berlin.  Muffled noise from the local bars and clubs did carry on past 11:00 PM on the weekend, but I guess that's just part of living in the city.  We felt very safe in the neighborhood and, if we ever visit Berlin again, we would absolutely try to rent the apartment again.
Great flat, great area, amazing local food tips. Wunderbar

We have recently returned from a 1 month stay in Berlin. Matthias's beautiful apartment was a truly a home away from home. Everything was as portrayed in the photos and all of the previous comments are true. The apt. building is very quiet and at times we wondered if we were alone in the building!  We preferred to walk most of the time but it was nice to know that we were so close to the U-Bahn. Having the grocery store on the ground floor is an added bonus. I have no qualms in recommending this apt. to anyone and actually have already given the information to German friends wanting to visit Berlin.

This was an amazing and electric two level apartment on a beautiful street in Berlin. Easy access to tram to downtown but quiet enough to enjoy some downtime. I loved exploring local restaurants in the area and even caught a rainbow outside of the apartment our first night there. All in all great find and we had a wonderful experience!
Absolutely  great apartment, very stylish and more spacious, than expected.Everything worked well and we (4 people) enjoyed it very much.
Exciting journey! Nice location and furniture

Eine sehr zu empfehlende Unterkunft. Ein grosses, ruhiges, sauber und - zu dieser Jahreszeit nicht genügend zu schätzendes - warmes Zimmer mit einem großen, bequemen Bett. Alles war unkompliziert, obwohl Johanna aus beruflichen Gründen nicht anwesend war. Die Umgebung ist ruhig. Es gibt einen Späti in der Nähe und 5‘ zu Fuss ein Kaufland. Zur U-Bahn-/S-Bahn-Station Tempelhof sind es rund 7‘ zu Fuß. Dort findet man auch ein valables italienisches Restaurant. Ein Abstecher auf den ehemaligen Flugplatz Tempelhof bietet sich an. Danke, Johanna, für Deine Gastfreundschaft!
great time in Berlin. I really recommend to stay there

We absolutely loved staying at Elisa’s Airbnb. We could not have wished for more. We loved the artwork, the really comfortable, sheek,  relaxed style of the apartment. We felt like we were truly in Berlin. The Market and all of the fantastic restaurants, the residents of the neighbourhood all made our stay very special. Also we were able to walk to all of the historic sights, and memorials of Berlin.
Good place clean and clear to arrive is good option for sleep and calm and safe for tourists
Enjoyed our stay!

Das Apartment hat meine Erwartungen nicht erfüllt und somit kann ich es niemandem empfehlen.
Die Schlüsselübergabe war unproblematisch, der Gastgeber hat den Schlüssel in der Gaststätte hinterlassen wo ich ihn einfach abholen konnte.
Das Apartment ist zwar wie in der Beschreibung angegeben, groß und bietet viel Platz an, ist aber sehr heruntergekommen. Die Dusche war völlig verkalkt, Das ganze Badezimmer roch sehr unangenehm nach Kanalisation. Toiletten Papier: Fehlanzeige!!.
WLAN funktionierte nicht.
Backofen in der Küche defekt!!
Fernseher über DVB-T. Nur wenige Programme konnte man empfangen. Die üblichen wie ARD ZDF Sat eins konnten nicht empfangen werden.
Gleich nach meiner Ankunft habe ich den Gastgeber angeschrieben und ihn gebeten die Mängel zu beseitigen. Eine Antwort auf meine Anfrage habe ich nicht bekommen. Außer E-Mail Adresse hatte eher keine Kontaktmöglichkeiten angegeben. Eine Telefonnummer wo man ihn erreichen konnte war nicht vorhanden.
Somit habe ich viel Geld für ein schlechtes Apartment und an einen schlechten Gastgeber bezahlt. Ich bedaure dieses sehr und schreibe das hier so ausführlich damit er entweder das Angebot verbessert, das Apartment raus nimmt und wenn nicht damit keine anderen Gäste darauf reinfallen!!
Great place to stay in
Calma was a calm and tidy small hotel. The service was extremely friendly, and everything (hotel keys and communication) worked conveniently through your own mobile phone.
Tolles appartement. Gute Lage. Sehr gute Küchenausstattung. Herzlichen Dank für die wunderbare Gastfreundschaft!

Wir waren sehr zufrieden! Der Kontakt war sehr nett und hat uns noch einen guten Tipp für Parkplätze gegeben. Die Unterkunft hatte einige richtig coole Vorteile, wie gefiltertes Wasser aus der Osmoseanlage und Beschilderung an so ziemlich allem, sodass man sich gut zurechtfinden konnte. Die Lage ist natürlich super zentral, was für uns wichtig war, wenn man das Fenster aufhat ist es halt relativ laut und riecht nach Döner, aber da muss man einfach wissen worauf es einem ankommt. Auch wenn es offensichtlich eine Wohnung ist, die regelmäßig für Airbnb genutzt wird, war sie gleichzeitig auch individuell eingerichtet und man konnte sich wohlfühlen. Das einizige winzige Manko war der fehlende Duschvorhang, die überall stehenden Alexas, und die Sauberkeit der Kaffeemaschine, aber es war trotzdem top, dass man sie überhaupt so mitbenutzen durfte! Wir würden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen, wenn wir ein Wochenende in Berlin verbringen möchten und eine zentrale Unterkunft brauchen!

The perfect air bnb in Berlin does exist!
This air bnb was perfection all around. Fantastic location. Very close to public transportation, shops, restaurants etc.
As a solo female traveler I felt very safe.
The space itself was a dream!
The room is massive. The bed is very comfortable. Everything is so stylishly decorated. The black out curtains were amazing. 3 layers of curtains, no light was getting in at all. For this night owl, that was the best thing ever.
Dierk was extremely friendly and accommodating.
I had issues with getting the door open and he went out of his way to help me and explain it properly.
All spaces were modern and incredibly clean.
Five stars all around!
I will definitely stay here again the next time I am in Berlin.

L'appartement était très bien, un peu vide et froid au début. Il est parfait pour un séjour pour 3 personnes mais le quartier autour n'est pas typiquement berlinois. Il aurait été plus pratique qu'il y ait au moins les aliments de base dans la cuisine, comme du sel par exemple. Sinon, nous avons tout de même passé un très bon séjour dans cette appartement. Il est pratique pour sortir faire la fête.
Alex was very nice and communicative.  The apartment had a great location and I definitely recommend it.

1a gelegen, Marcus ist sehr nett und antwortet sofort bei Fragen. Schöne, ruhige Wohnung. Die Betten sind voneinander getrennt, wenn man sie zusammenschiebt, dann liegt man in der Mitte auf den Bettkästen, das ist nicht so bequem, wenn man eine große Matratze gewohnt ist.

Georgy’s place was nice, clean and in a good location. He also allowed us to check in an hour early as one of our party members became suddenly unwell on the day of arrival, which we really appreciated.
However, there was no dryer or drying rack which was inconvenient given we booked this place in part because there was a washing machine, but we then had no way to dry our clothes.

Nena Apartemnts was the perfect location.
It’s not far from the center, it’s in the right place where it’s peaceful, yet alive.
The apartment was great, Berlin is freezing at this time of the year, but the apartment wormed us good, the towel heater in the shower saved my life.
The hosts were friendly and nice, I never needed much from them but I never felt worried incase I would need, always felt as if there’s someone to talk to.
The YADA YADA breakfast club next to it(100m from the apartments) is top tier by the way, highly recommended when you choose Nena Apartments.
Hope to visit again soon. 🙏🫶
Alles einwandfrei! Gerne wieder!

Dani, el anfitrión, nos recibió muy amablemente. Nos dio un montón de consejos sobre qué hacer y qué ver en Berlín. También agradecemos mucho sus recomendaciones sobre restaurantes (nos gustó mucho el vietnamita).

Además, nos dedicó un buen rato para darnos algunas pinceladas la historia de la ciudad y sus habitantes, que nos sirvieron para entender un poco mejor lo que vimos luego.

El apartamento es pequeño pero cómodo. Tiene todo lo necesario para sentirse como en casa. Está amueblado con gusto y hay algunos detalles muy curiosos, objetos antiguos, que combina con mobiliario más moderno. ¡La radio es una reliquia que todavía funciona!

El metro y el tren están a unos 10-15 minutos andando, pero hay un bus en la esquina que lleva directo al aeropuerto. Una vez en el tren/metro, se tarda muy poco en llegar al centro.

We really appreciated our stay in Michele apartment. It was exactly on the announce. The place was clean and with everything we needed. It was really easy to exchange with Michele to prepare our stay. I recommand it.
Wonderful flat in Neukolln, full of taste and very welcoming
The apartment is beutiful with a really good atmospere. The kitcken is very well equipped.  The balcony is nice. And in the neigbourhood there are lots of places to eat and drink.

booked this place with my partner and we were both amazed by it.
Great location, lots of things to do in the area and approximately 25 minutes away from the city center.
Kitchen and bathroom were shared but still clean. We may come back to this airbnb for a round 2 🫡
Great place to stay, we were a group of 3. Beds were comfortable bathrooms were nice too.  The lounge area was great with food and drinks at good prices. Definitely recommend this place.
zeer meelevende hostes. aanbevelenswaardig.

Bernd was a fantastic host. Replied message very quickly. The flat was very clean and includes everything you need. Great location, convenient U-bahn, and close to great bars and restaurants!
Hope to come back again!
I can’t fault this apartment, it was beautiful and perfectly located! Would definitely book again.
War ganz gut, besonders der Service. Hätte es gut gefunden wenn die Tür zu gewesen wäre wenn wir ankamen.
Außer der in paar Missverständnissen habe ich alles so vorgefunden wie es beschrieben war. Parwana war bei Fragen oder Problemen immer erreichbar. Danke dafür!

Un apartamento muy lindo, limpio y cómodo, acorde a lo publicado. Queda en una zona a metros del transporte público y tiene restaurantes cerca. Está a unos 20 minutos de Alexander Platz, una de las estaciones principales de Berlin.
Annalisa es una estupenda anfitriona. Siempre estuvo pendiente de cada detalle durante nuestra estancia, muy atenta y simpática, siempre atenta a que la estuviésemos pasando bien.
Volveríamos 100% a quedarnos.

Snelle en duidelijke communicatie. Nog mooier, completer en ruimer dan op de foto's. Perfecte uitvalsbasis voor Berlijn (eigen parkeerplek, S-Bahn zeer dichtbij en gemakkelijke verbinding met centrum - 5 haltes, geen overstap!) en ook Potsdam (goede uitvalswegen). Geweldig om steeds weer thuis te komen na de activiteiten, zeker voor gezinnen, met onder andere veel speelgoed en een prachtige tuin met schommel, skippy-bal en trampoline. Handige voorzieningen ook zeer dichtbij (Lidl, bakker, pizzeria's, speeltuin, wandeling door mooie en groene wijk). Geweldig mooi, ruime en sfeervolle kinderkamer.  Al met al zeer compleet, echt een aanrader voor een zeer comfortabel bezoek aan Berlijn!
The place is nice and the transportation is really near
Man erhält ein super hübsches Zimmer bei Michael in einer tollen Lage in Berlin!
good communication, nice and clean place
Amazing place and such a convenient location! Highly recommend this Airbnb
Everything was good. Great place to stay.
Everything was alright!

Our stay in Berlin was great. I was slightly worried the apartment was in a neighborhood that was too far out, or wouldn’t have any good restaurants or bars but I was wrong - there’s lots in the area and it’s very easy to get to other areas of the city. Excellent communication and very helpful, would definitely recommend, especially for larger groups!
Sauberes, großes, helles Zimmer. Sehr freundliche Gastgebering. Immer wieder gern!
Appartement répondant aux besoins de base, facile d’accès et bien situé.

We booked Adryan's place as our previous booking cancelled 2 days before our arrival to Berlin. Adryan was extremely quick to respond to any queries we had. We chose the self check in option and it was so easy. The apartment is located pretty much right outside a tram and underground which we used everyday and took us to wherever we needed. The apartment itself is beautifully decorated, the kitchen is perfect for making breakfasts and lunches and a simple dinner as there is a stove but no oven. We didn't use it but the washing machine is great if staying for a long period of time. The sitting room is very stylish but being honest the sofa is not something you could relax on but it does look beautiful. There is Netflix on the TV and the WIFI was excellent. The bathroom has everything you need and there is actually a small bath/shower (from the pics it just looked like a shower to me). The water pressure is very strong. The bed is super comfy and there is enough wardrobe space to put your belongings. The only big issue some people may have is that the apartment complex can be very noisy (there is pretty much no noise cancellation), however this is not the hosts fault and it wasn't something that bothered me too much. Overall I would definitely stay here again, the location is perfectly located near all forms of transport, the only reason it doesn't get 5 stars is because of the lack of noise cancelation and the uncomfortable sofa and the slightly more expensive price tag. Adryan is a great host and very helpful.

The place is a professionally managed apartment complex, but there were some issues:
- I didn’t receive an email or SMS that would allow me to check in - I had to call them and ended up with someone in Munich, and it took 20 min to sort everything out as far as possible
- the apartment was in a rear building (Hinterhaus), and there was no buzzer for the entire rear building at the door on the Main Street
- the doors have electronic locks, and they required a 9 digit code 🤪to get into the apartment, while at the same time, the door to our staircase was locked open because the keypad to that door was broken
- there were no instructions available how to enter the building complex - which was an array of 3 possible entrances and an additional 2 exits. We couldn’t decide if this was Alcatraz or Fort Knox - entering as well as leaving was an adventure!

Spülmaschine und Waschmaschine sind zwar vorhanden aber letztendlich musste man alles selber spülen und die Wäsche kam nicht sauber raus. Das mit der Sauberkeit war eine reinste Katastrophe, das ist total respektlos 60 Euro für eine sehr dreckige Wohnung zu zahlen der Staub der da war war bestimmt Monate alt und man musste Reinigungsutensilien selber kaufen da keine richtige Reinigungsmittel vorhanden war. this is my 5th time in Berlin and first for my boyfriend. we stayed at Mara's in Friedrichshain which is perfect if you want to go to the clubs. all the great clubs are less than 10 minutes away. the apartment itself is a converted studio/shop so the layout is a little funky but you have everything you need. everything is clean and the hosts are easy to reach. we loved our stay!

Monica offered a map and explained where I would find all the things and places I wanted to see. Yes, she even offered to warm up a bottle of beer (something the German's do, in order to fight the flu (I declined with thanks ;))
The apartment is perfectly located in Berlin Mitte, right next to the Alexander Platz. The bus to the airport literally stops in front of the door, which is super convenient. The room is cozy and spacious with a stunning view over Berlin, there's a private bath room with a tub and even a washing machine and a separate entrance to the apartment. great place to stay!

Would highly recommend to others visiting Berlin.

This little flat is very comfortable. The location is very handy, lots to do in the neighbourhood. Matthias is very nice and accomodating. I recommend staying there to visit Berlin.

This Airbnb is undoubtedly one of the best I’ve experienced in all of Europe. The moment you walk in, it feels like home, with a perfect blend of smart design and spaciousness. The room is cozy and beautifully furnished, and the shower is impressively large, rivaling even U.S. standards.
The hosts are highly professional—accessible and attentive when needed but never intrusive. I especially loved the space during the Christmas season; it was ideal for cooking and staying cozy during inclement weather. While the 86 stairs are challenging at times, the comfort of the space once you're inside makes it well worth it.
A small note about the neighborhood: it's the "arts district" of Berlin - the immediate streets feel safe, but closer to the train station, there’s more activity—groups of youths, loitering, drinking, trash, etc. If you’re from cities like NYC or SF, it’s nothing shocking, but worth noting for personal travel preferences. Overall, this space is a gem & an exceptional stay!

I stayed for two weeks in the flat — it was exactly as described, very clean, and small. For one person it was perfect, but two people might feel a bit too “cozy” after a few days! I appreciated the kitchen and washing machine, which made my stay much more convenient and easy. The location is ideal in Prenzlauer Berg, surrounded by very popular bars, cafes, restaurants, as well as lots of boutiques selling fancy knickknacks. A REWE grocery store and bakeries are also close by. Transportation links are excellent with the tram, U2, and S-Bahn all within 10 minutes. The sofa bed, as others have noted, is not the most comfortable and it is definitely on the shorter and smaller side, so again, for one person it was OK but two people might start to get a bit restless after a few nights. The flat itself is on the ground level and faces the inner courtyard so it is fairly quiet both day and night; the back door/window is right next to door to the garbage & recycling room, but residents were generally very quiet and courteous about going in and out. The courtyard is very pretty and well maintained, although there isn’t a dedicated space or chairs for the flat itself so it felt a bit awkward sitting in the middle of it next to the children’s play area. But these are small quibbles — for the price, the location and the fact that the flat is completely outfitted for cooking, laundry etc., it is excellent.

Some things were nice, including the beautiful courtyard, the location not too far from the water, and the room was spacious. Other things were, quite frankly, terrible. We paid more than $550 for three nights, so we expected a smooth, nice and relaxing visit. We are both working professionals who need a reliable wifi to do work. If that’s you too, we would not recommend that you book here. The internet was unreliable. We had to try to use our own data from Canada, work from coffee shops, etc. to do meetings when the internet just completely failed. We were told that it would be fixed in five minutes; it wasn’t. It was a very stressful situation and we felt a bit helpless. Staff didn’t seem to know how to help. In addition, the fan in our room was broken and extremely loud in a hot room, making it hard to sleep (along with the loud noises from the courtyard into the early morning). The elevator was broken, so we had to carry our luggage up and down multiple days. All in all, it was a disappointing visit and, while it has the potential to be a nice spot, it was not nearly worth what we paid to stay. If you want a smooth and relaxing stay, I would look elsewhere, especially for the cost.

I originally booked this place for a month but appealed to move out early for the following reasons:

To resolve this issue, the host sent me a 5-10mbps hotspot and a 5 euro note.
- apartment was extremely bare. Uncomfortable dining chairs were the only chairs outside of the sofa. No seating on the balcony. Only one mirror, in the bathroom.
- kitchen was the absolute bare minimum. Only bowls were soup bowls, only cups were small cups.
All in all, for a few days in Berlin this would be a fine place. Central, spacious, 2bd. But for a month, this was not sufficient.
