Der Aufenthalt im Numa Berlin Boxer war rundum angenehm. Das Zimmer war modern, sauber und gut ausgestattet. Besonders gefallen hat mir der einfache Check-in per App und die zentrale Lage – perfekt, um Berlin zu erkunden. Auch die Kommunikation mit dem Team lief reibungslos. Gerne wieder!

Trevlig, uppmärksam värd och stor, ljus lägenhet alldeles intill en park med fina marknader både lördag och söndag. Dock - mitt i ett livligt bar/resturangområde med (åtminstone på helgerna och särskilt från ena sovrummet)  ljudet av fest långt inpå småtimmarna, ta med öronproppar:)

Gut gelegen, schöne Zimmer und unkomplizierte check-in/Check-out. Das Personallose Hotel ist aber nichts für Leute, die nicht sehr digital sind. Wir haben ein älterer Herr helfen müssen, der mit der Prozedur völlig überfordert war.

Tamara was a brilliant host, gave us a welcome beer and sweets when we checked in. always checking on us making sure we were having a pleasant stay. The location was only a couple minutes walk to the train station and the city was very accessible from there. Thanks Tamara for all your help.

Nadia's place is fantastic. We had a very warm and kind check in by her friend Natasa even in a late Friday night after a 12 hours delay of our flight! The fully equipped kitchen is great, and really bigger than appears in the pictures, the same for the huge living room. Is a big cosy pad in the real Heart of Berlin. a lovely flat in a wonderful building!
Hope to get back soon..!

All in all, a good stay! The kitchen was lacking some basics, but Ljubomira brought the things we needed to us immediately! I think it’s best not to think of this as exactly “private,” more like an old-school BnB experience… the flat is technically separate, but the hosts will enter unannounced, as happened once while I was breastfeeding my baby in the bedroom! Luckily I’m not modest about such things but there are some who might find this off-putting. The area was very quiet and the hosts kind and accommodating!
Sehr nette Vermieterin.
A great apartment in a brilliant location and the perfect base for a weekend in Berlin. Leonie was really responsive and helpful before and during our stay. It made for a fantastic weekend away!

דירה מקסימה במיקום מושלם.
איזור מקסים מלא בבתי קפה ומסעדות וגישה לתחבורה ציבורית.
הדירה מרווחת, בייתית, נקייה מאוד, ומושלמת לשהות בעיר.
אשמח לחזור לשם בביקורי הבא בעיר.

Thank you very much for a great stay in Your nice big apartment.
Just an idea, a dining table would have been really nice:0) And a showerhead, that nok was broken.
Would stay here again.
Really nice location next to Karl Marx alle and very close to Alexandreplatz.

If you’re looking for a quiet, peaceful stay in a buzzing city; Numa is the place. Great public transport connections nearby, no noise and a wonderful, clean room.
By the end of the week I’d recommended the place to two friends who were looking for a safe place to stay.
I might just come back next year!

En mycket stor och rymlig lägenhet! Ett mer stillsamt område vilket vi gillade och kände oss trygga då vi bara var tjejer! Lite längre att ta sig till allt men annars en mycket fint boende och bra värd!
Great apartment, lovely host! Really helpful and communicative :)

Above expectation : ) !
We would love to return...
Guenter ist erfrischend unkompliziert; die Unterkunft ultra-sauber und gut gelegen fusslauefig zum Bergmannkiez.
Perfect place for family with kids. Spacious and comfortable apartment.Good location and near to public transportation. Highly recommended.

Alles super. David ist ein herzlicher und proaktiver Mensch. Hat mich sehr nett empfangen und einmal die Wohnung gezeigt. Meinen Ankunftszeitpunkt konnten wir flexibel abstimmen.
Die Wohnung an sich war super, bietet viel Platz und durch eine größere Fensterfront gutes Licht.
Hatte zudem alles, was gebraucht wurde, sogar Kaffee und Tee waren inklusive. :)
Sehr gerne wieder!

Julian’s apartment was the perfect spot for my family to explore Berlin. Very close to everything - good food, good coffee, easy transit to all the sites. The apartment itself was stylish, very clean, functional and comfortable. To top it all off, we had train problems getting to Berlin and Julian was totally accommodating with our schedule.
I fully recommend Julian and this apartment!!
Very clean and modern apartment in central location. Three bathrooms are really helpful for getting ready in the morning :-)
Good location. Good price. Good service. Breakfast is a bit of a disappointment, though.

My husband and I travelled with our 2 teenage kids. I must say we had a wonderful stay and this is the perfect location . Check in was a breeze... Tia was out of town but she had her friend Eugenia check us in with no problems . We had everything we needed to accommodate us with all kitchen utensils, appliances, and washer.. Everything is within walking distance and easy access to the train. The neighborhood is beautiful where you can walk around the river, many shops restaurants and groceries with in walking distance and all reasonably priced. Would stay here again .

Berlin is such a big city, it's hard to know where to stay for your first time there! But Rainer's place is perfectly located. It was so easy to get to everything we needed walking, or the bus or train or tram. There were great restaurants and shops nearby even if we didn't want to go exploring. Berlin can be very grey, so the light that came into the apartment was much appreciated. The beds were comfy and everything easy to use. The washing machine could use some instructions attached (had to do some Googling!), but everything else is very self-explanatory. Overall we had a great trip!
Alles sehr gut geklappt, netter Kontakt, gerne wieder.

Marisol war eine sehr aufmerksame Gastgeberin und hat dafür gesorgt, dass ich mich sehr wohl gefühlt habe. Das Loft ist toll ausgestattet, sauber und lässt keine Wünsche offen (z.B. Fußbodenheizung). Es sieht in Realität noch schöner aus als auf den Fotos. Die Gegend ist wohl eine der coolsten in Berlin. Ich kann es nur wärmstens empfehlen!

Das Zimmer war relativ klein, jedoch ausreichend wenn man die Unterkunft nur als Schlafmöglichkeit nutzt, wofür sie bestimmt auch gedacht ist. Alles war wie beschrieben und somit absolut in Ordnung. Das Zimmer war Sauber, mehr Steckdosen wären super, aber man kommt auf jeden Fall auch so zurecht.

도심지외 달리 평화롭고 조용한 곳에 위치해 있어 좋았습니다
잘 쉬다 갑니다
친절한 설명과 안내 감사했어요
Great studio location and space. It is a very efficient use of a studio. The pull out bed is comfortable and the kitchen was well stocked with essentials.
Great location, nice host and clean decent apartment
A Nicole pratica preço justo para Berlin. Ela é hospitaleira e uma excelente cantora!

Everything was great!
Affordable and in a nice area.
If I had to be picky I'd say the bathroom needs updating but overall it's a very comfortable apartment!

The place was very nice! Would recommend the space.
Only issue was with check in - was confused by instructions given / website used for check in and ended up not being given check in info until 5pm (check In was supposed to be at 3pm). Operating the website was not easy, especially as a traveler without phone data or reliable WiFi.
The space is 5 stars for sure, but my stressful experience with check in brings my rating down to a 3.
Netter Aufenthalt. Freundlicher und schneller Kontakt zur Gastgeberin. Gute Anbindung an den Nahverkehr. Alle notwendigen Ausstattungen waren in der Unterkunft vorhanden.
great location, great host! i recommend!

Gihad was a very friendly and responsive host. The room is exactly how it appears in the photos, with a nice big window and bed. There’s a bus stop right outside the building, and though Schönefeld is a little outside the main city, public transport was easy to use from there. I had a long stay and didn’t encounter any issues at all.
Liten enkel leilighet med bad. Enkelt innsjekking og med gode installasjoner for å finne fram.
5 out of 5 stars! would definitely recommend to everyone staying in Berlin. Kasia was the best hostess, and it couldn't be better!
Beautiful home in the perfect location in the super desirable neighborhood of Mitte. Plenty of space for our family of four. Would definitely return!

Moritz has a beautiful apartment with striking views of the city. His decor is cool and the furniture in the room is comfortable. The location worked well for our exploration of Berlin. Moritz and Kinga were friendly and welcoming. As it turned out, they left town on a vacation shortly after our arrival, leaving us the apartment to ourselves. That was really nice. We would highly recommend this Airbnb.

We had a lovely stay in Arne's place! Arne was very tentative throughout our stay making check in and check out easy. The location was perfect right opposite a large park and close to many transport links to get into central Berlin. The flat had everything we could ask for for our short stay in Berlin with lots of homely touches.
Conforme à la description
It was a wonderful stay, felt like home, private, close to everything. If I go back to Berlin I will stay there :)
Was self checkin, local to tourist spots, easy transport links. Great base for exploring Berlin.

Perfect place to stay to see Berlin.  Plamena met us at the door and provided a thorough orientation as well as suggestions for site seeing. The location is very close to the train stations and lots of good restaurants. It is a short walk to museum island. The apartment was clean and well equipped for our needs. The new mattress was very comfortable. Would definitely stay again!
Near to city center and cute apartmant
Die Unterkunft ist ideal für Gruppen mit Freunden, die sich gut kennen. Roll eingerichtet, super gelegen. Gemütliche Betten. Nette Kommunikation
It was so nice location to go everywhere in Berlin. And, there are many restaurants, coffee shops, vintage shops and galleries around. i really enjoyed the area n had good time while i stayed.
Great host, an apparment well located love it

We had a great week in the apartment. Everything was perfect for our needs - traveling with our one year old boy. The building has a nice communal yard where all the kids meet and play (nice neighbors too), living room was spacey and comfortable, the kitchen was well equipped and the hot water in the shower were a nice bonus.. Maybe not the ultimate location in Berlin but subway is 4 minute walk, there's good pizza just a building away and a nice park around the corner so all in all it's highly recommended. Communication was also easy and all our needs were taken care of.

We had a great stay in Berlin. The apartment was spotless. Clean, well equipped, comfortable and with good location. We've been received very well, also we were given helpful tips about the neighborhood and the city and the host was available to help us if needed.
Very nice apartment in the perfect area. Really enjoyed the two balconies and the Simons communication. Would love to stay here again!

Super sympathische und zuvorkommende Gastgeber, als ich angekommen bin wurde mir kurz die Wohnung gezeigt und auf Nachfrage leckere Essensempfehlungen gegeben.  Ich konnte flexibel einchecken und allgemein war der Aufenthalt sehr angenehm, kann ich nur empfehlen.
Rien à dire, tout est parfait, je recommande !

Exactly what it says on the tin, but I would consider the impact of not having AC as the weather gets much warmer – the adjacent road was so, so loud, so it was choosing whether to sleep with really high noise levels and have a bad sleep, or roast! With it being around 30 degrees in Berlin at this time and no fan either to compensate, that made it quite an uncomfortable stay. Despite that, clean, good size, kitchen was really well stocked and shower was great.
Ramfis was the best host with a true will to make it easy for us. He’s very flexible and thoughtful. The location is great with public transport just outside the door.
Very nice apartment in the perfect location!

Alex was very friendly and accommodating. He helped us get to his apt from the airport and offering many delicious local restaurant suggestions. His apt is very clean and comfortable with plenty of amenities. It's also very quiet and peaceful at night. The neighborhood is very easily accessible by tram or train nearby. The restaurant strip with many delicious options is within walking distance. I highly recommend staying at his apt in Berlin.

sehr ruhige Lage zum Hinterhof, schön warm, hell, ein wunderbares Bett und viel Grün
und und und....
Absolutes Wohlfühlwochenende gewesen! Ein Ort, um mal die Seele baumeln zu lassen und sich zu entspannen!

Die Wohnung hat eine sehr zentrale Lage, ist super zu erreichen.
Man hat alles fußläufig in der Umgebung
(Supermarkt, Drogerie, Restaurants , Bars, Apotheke, Bank).
Abends sollte man auf jeden Fall die Gegend erkunden, es lohnt sich!
Der Check -in lief super und Tamara war jederzeit erreichbar.
Begrüßt wurden wir mit einem kalten Bier im Kühlschrank.
Im Badezimmer standen Duschgel, Zahnpasta und Waschmittel bereit.
Die Umgebung ist sehr belebt, dennoch ist die Unterkunft Verhältnismäßig ruhig gelegen.
Wir können diese Unterkunft weiterempfehlen.

The Kastanienallee where the appartment is located is TOP location: right in the middle of the nicest (trendy) neigbourhood of Berlin (Prenzlauer Berg), near wonderful shops & cafes & the famous Kulturbrauerei. The check in was really easy because we could pick up the keys at a nightshop accross from the appartment so we didn't have to hurry. The access to the appartment was no problem (elevator!) The appartment itself was just fine: not very big but definately enough for the two of us. Good kitchen, great bath/shower, washing machine, wonderful bed. My boyfriend missed being able to look outside (there is a terrace but you can't see the street) but that didn't bother me at all. There is a window facing outside in the bedroom and a low to the ground window in the kitchen. The appartment was comfortable, warm & cozy. We had a great time in Berlin and will definitely rent again from Michele.

Kleines modern eingerichtetes Appartment, was alle Anforderungen erfüllt. Perfekt geeignet für Ruhesuchende. Check-In und Check-Out sehr unkompliziert,  flexibel und selbst durchführbar. Leider kein WLAN mehr ab zweitem Tag. Da wir viel unterwegs waren, für uns persönlich aber zweitrangig.

Hannes is a great host!  He is really friendly and made us feel very welcome. The house is fantastic with updated features in a very quiet neighborhood and we especially liked the balcony. It is an easy walk of less than a mile from the Blankenburg subway station with quick access to the rest of the city. We would definitely choose to stay there again on our next trip to Berlin.

Great stay at Martina’s place! The apartment is beautiful, ideally located, and very comfortable. Martina is a wonderful host—warm, welcoming, and a pleasure to talk with. Special mention to the two adorable cats who made the experience even more delightful. Highly recommended!

Excellent rapport qualité-prix !
La chambre est vraiment cosy, elle est même spacieuse car tout est bien agencé ! Vous ne manquerez de rien ! Etienne est très réactif par message et vous donne de très bonnes recommandations pour passer un agréable séjour.

The best neighbourhood in Berlin! The location was ideal. So many quaint shops, restaurants, cafes, and bars. I loved coming home to Natalie’s place after a long day of sightseeing. She was a great host: easy to contact, always available. I recommend her place highly.
Alles ist super gelaufen. Vielen Dank Andreas

Also diese kleine süße Wohnung hat alles was man benötigt und man fühlt sich sehr wohl. Gestört hat mich persönlich nichts und ich war begeistert von der Ausstattung.  Viel mehr sollte man auch von einer Unterkunft auf Zeit nicht erwarten und dafür war sie schon echt top.
Clean hotel and reasonably priced. Comfortable bed but pillows were bit thin but didn’t ruin my sleep. I also didn’t ask to see if there were any alternatives so can’t complain
Clean and tidy place in a very quite area. Close to public transportation and many restaurants and shops. The place had everything to have a great stay and an amazing vacation.

The apartment is ideally located in the heart of Kreuzberg, with great access to nearby bars and the U-bahn. Laura communicated everything we needed to know in advance of our visit and gave some excellent local recommendations! The apartment is nicely furnished and well decorated, with some cool art on the wall. The bedrooms are very spacious, with comfy and clean beds. The check-in progress was smooth and easy.

Maria has been the best hostess I’ve had with Airbnb! Quick to respond and have great food recommendations, as well as things to do. The flat was clean and felt right at home, lots of walkable beer gardens and transport stations. Could not have asked for a better place and host for the week, we would definitely stay again! :)
I loved staying at Mia's! The space felt like home right away. It was quiet but near excitement, quaint but with everything I needed. The rooftop was incredible! I would absolutely stay again.
It is great place with great location. Clean and nice flat.
Appartement bien équipé et idéalement placé pour visiter Berlin, tout est réuni pour un séjour réussi
Thomas is a good communicator and the apartment is overall nice, but we had some trouble with a noicy ventilator, very soft beds and a bathroomwater-problem.

We stayed at Ben’s place during the Lollapalooza weekend in Berlin. The apartment was very easy to reach, good connectivity with public transport, and located in a quiet neighbourhood. The studio itself was cozy and well suited for a couple. Ben is a nice person and very communicative. He also offered some drinks and chocolate, small gestures but felt very nice. Would definitely recommend his place!
Nette, praktische appartementen. Dichtbij supermarkt en openbaar vervoer.

Was in town with family for the Marathon! A perfect location with train stops very close. The codes weren’t working for the entries, but someone was there within 60 seconds to fix it! Thanks for a great stay!!
Worked well for our family!

A beautiful flat and an interesting host.
@People: Google „the Ocean“ that’s his band 🤟🏽
Jag kan verkligen rekommendera detta boende med ett värdskap som har allt.

I had a wonderful stay at Veronika’s place. She was a great host - very friendly, welcoming, and always helpful whenever I had a question. The apartment itself was very nice, spotlessly clean, and full of charm with its classic German style and beautiful high ceilings. I would happily stay here again and can highly recommend it!

Great place. Very nice rooms with the possibility to cook a small dinner/lunch.
Great service and very clean. The location is in a quiet neighbourhood with about 45 minutes to centrum by foot and U-bahn.
A great place if you don't want to be in the busy Berlin after your day out. Would definitely recommend it.

Sigbert is an incredible host who has made my first ever stay in Berlin the one to remember. Anything from the location to amenities and warm conversations was flawless. It's just two minutes by foot to the u-bahn and about 50 min from the Shoenefeld airport, with lots of little cafes nearby. The area itself is vibrant yet quiet. The flat is filled with little touches that tell you more about Sigbert's personality and make the space arty and cozy. Overall, I couldn't hope for a better experience. Thanks again Sigbert!

Stayed in Alex's place for 3 nights and had a great time. Only a 5 minute walk from the train station and plenty of shops nearby to keep you occupied. Instructions on how to get there and pick up the key was very clear and convenient.

WOW! What a wonderful group of people! Right away when we got to the apartment, they welcomed us in with warm conversations and wine! Jens made us maps with general info about the different districts and important transportation stops and interesting things to do and see. Sara cooked us a delicious fresh Italian pizza our last night, and even set out homemade muffins, croissants and smoothies for us for breakfast. Their friend was also so incredibly nice and helpful, and we felt right at home in his presence! Everyone was so genuine and helpful, and the place was unique and in a great and safe location. I would highly recommend to anyone traveling to Berlin! We had 4 of us--there was room, but it's a bit tight, so make sure you're comfortable being very close to one another :-)
Alles super!!

La pasamos muy bien en departamento de Sven, cómodo para 5 personas (aunque en Europa difícil encontrar apartamento con más de un baño), impecable, el acceso al edificio un poco oscuro, pero hay una estación de metro al frente ahí mismo.

Perfect for my family of three. Clean, easy to walk to eat or catch transportation around the city. It was quiet and in an interesting neighbourhood of homes and work spaces. I'd recommend it for couples mostly but the big couch makes it easy for a kid too!
Love the simple design aesthetic. No fuss, just what you need to be comfortable.

Spree studio was a beautiful little apartment tucked away in Berlins best neighbourhood. So many great bars and restaurants nearby. The apartment itself was so adorable and had everything we needed for a short stay. Bed was super comfy. Hans was very friendly and open to responding to our influx of questions. Will definitely stay here again.

Agréablement surpris
Spacieux et lumineux le l’appartement de Maximilian a était plus que convenable.
Je vous le recommande les yeux fermer.
Tolles Apartment. Toll eingerichtet. Alles super.

Lage, Sauberkeit und Kommunikation bezüglich An- und Abreise waren top. leider war, wie in der Bewertung zuvor beschrieben wurde, die Matratze sehr durchgelegen, wofür wir dann eine Teilerstattung bekommen haben.
Mit einer besseren Matratze hätten wir 5 Sterne gegeben.

Daniel‘s place is probably the most nicest Airbnb I’ve stayed at, and I’ve stayed in many Airbnbs. The place is absolutely stunning. I loved my stay there. Daniel’s place is clean, nicely furnished and I absolutely love that the bathroom has heated floors!! I also loved the low lights he has around the entryway. I would leave them on as purple when I’d go to bed. I felt at home but this apartment is nicer than my condo and I live in a luxury condo!
Very easy to get around, the train station and bus stops are short walks with lots of shops and grocery stores within short walking distance.
Very friendly host, Daniel replies as soon as he is able to. I was very happy with my stay that I had a couple of nights in because I was so comfortable and felt like home.
Just a FYI.. there is no elevator in this building, you have to climb seven short flights of stairs to get up to the penthouse but I guarantee the place is well worth the effort!!

We loved our stay at Thomas's home. It was a beautiful, spacious apartment with all of the things you'd need for a trip to Berlin. It felt homey but also was beautifully decorated and extremely clean. It was also in a very central location but it was also a quiet neighborhood. We couldn't have really asked for anything more. I would certainly stay here again and recommend that you do too!

Wir waren super zufrieden!
Hae-Ok ist eine tolle Gastgeberin und es hat alles reibungslos geklappt – vom Check-in, über Sauberkeit der Wohnung, Check-Out, die Ausstattung – einfach alles super! Wir konnten sogar eine halbe Stunde früher in die Wohnung – das war sehr zuvorkommend. Die Lage ist natürlich ebenfalls der Knaller!
Alles in allem sehr empfehlenswert und wenn wir nochmal mit 6 Leuten nach Berlin reisen, würden wir die Wohnung wieder buchen :-)

Had a great stay at Iris’s charming and comfortable apartment. Well located in a fun but not too wild part of the city with super easy access to public transportation as well as bike shops that rent bikes by the day or week. The apartment itself was quiet and comfortable, filled with plants and lovely objects and art. I highly recommend Iris’s place and would stay here again upon returning to Berlin.
Great location. Bit lacking on sound insulation, otherwise everything for a short stop is covered.
Very good prize/quality, everything was very clean, new, comfortable, location next to a metro station, interesting neighborhood. Highly recommended!
Very good location. Excellent hosts

The contact with Björn about the arrival was good. His parents (they live next to the bungalow) received us at the bungalow and were very hospital. They gave us good tips what we could see in the centre of Berlin.
The public transport in Berlin is well organized. We never had to wait long for any bus, S-bahn or U-bahn (the underground).
The bungalow was very complete and clean. Everything what you need was there. The garden, the table tennis table, the barbecue and the swimming pool were a nice extra.
The bungalow is located in a quit suburb of Berlin, not far from three big supermarkets.
We had an amazing time here!
This studio was perfect! Everything you need in an apartment for a short stay. Very central and close to nearby stations. Very modern, clean and great value for money. Would highly recommend
Superb decoration and stylish apartment

Hat alles super geklappt!
Vielen Dank!
Super host!
Schöne Wohnung, toll eingerichtet, sehr ordentlich und eine super tolle Lage. Wir haben den kurzen Aufenthalt zu viert genossen. Andreas

Die Lage dieser Wohnung in diesem Viertel ist hervorragend. Auf dem Weg zur S-Bahn Olympiastadion kann man tolle Architektur sehen. Schöner Spaziergang runter zur Havel und Essen in der Alten Liebe, einem Restaurantschiff - lohnend. In der Wohnung gibt es normale Ausstattung und tolle Blicke nach draußen.
Great location, sweet staff and nice rooms!
Alles war super gut und unkompliziert. Sehr sauber und super bequem. Immer  gerne wieder ☺️

Wir haben zwei Nächte in Kaddis Wohnung verbracht, das Zimmer ist groß und sauber, das Bett ist für zwei Personen absolut ausreichend. Kaddi hat uns sehr lieb empfangen, hatte uns zwei Bier bereitgestellt und war immer ansprechbar. Absolut empfehlenswerte Unterkunft für ein paar Tage in Berlin.

Great place to stay! Nice location in Prenzlauerberg with lots of Cafés and Restaurants. Place is super clean and quiet. Tobias and Enis are very friendly and super responsive, even when we arrived late for check-in. Would definitely recommend. Thanks a lot!

Stella was a great host - very responsive and communicative, enthusiastic and quick to help with any questions or issues we had. The place was also great, looked just like the photos and we had a great stay! Five stars.
Prima verblijf gehad. Op loopafstand naar de metro. Parkeergarage in de buurt.

A estadia foi muito boa e tranquila, o lugar estava limpo e organizado. Hendrik sempre mostrou proatividade e disponibilidade para tirar nossas dúvidas e ajudar no que fosse necessário. A localização é boa, perto de trem, metro e ônibus, o único problema que tivemos foi com a água quente para banho que acabava muito rápido, não sendo possível tomar dois banhos quentes em seguida do outro. Apesar disso, recomendo essa estadia fortemente.

Wij hebben (2 volwassenen en 2 kinderen) 2 nachten gelogeerd in de woning van Helena. Het is ons zeer goed bevallen! We zijn vriendelijk ontvangen! Dat we eerder gearriveerd waren dan afgesproken, was geen probleem. Het appartement is volledig uitgerust, zeer schoon, nieuw en netjes. De badkamers zijn top! Het ontbreken van een TV was voor ons geen probleem. Na een hele dag Berlijn ben je moe en kun je goed slapen. Wij zijn 2 dagen met de fiets op pad geweest. In het begin moesten we erg wennen aan het fietsen op de busbaan, maar na een halve dag ging dat prima. Met de fiets zie je ontzettend veel. We zijn ook 1 dag met de trein en metro gereisd, dit is een geweldige manier om grotere afstanden af te leggen. Wij zijn zeer tevreden, vonden het jammer dat onze tijd erop zat. We komen zeker nog eens terug! Dankjewel voor de fijne ontvangst en het aangename verblijf in een uitstekende buurt!!
Eine total tolle Wohnung! Große Empfehlung! Perfekte Lage, schöner Stil, recht leise und alles da, was man braucht. Komme gerne wieder!

Three of my friends and I stayed at MaCha's space for a week. We couldn't have been happier with our stay, much due in part to MaCha's apartment. The space exceeded expectation, the pictures do not do it justice. All amenities were taken care of and and the wifi was strong. The street/block turned out to have some of the best restaurants and bars that we went to during our whole trip. ORA and Luzia were two of our favorites and are a stones throw away. More so, the apartment is situated in a part of Kreuzberg where everything seems to be a 20 minute walk away in either direction- super convenient! On our last day, we were running a bit behind schedule, and MaCha was able to accomidate a slightly later check out time on short notice, which was incredibly helpful. All in all, we couldn't recommend this apartment more and will be recommending to friends who are traveling to Berlin in the future.

L'appartamento è ampio e molto pulito, coerente con la descrizione.
Si trova a circa 8 min a piedi dalla S-Bahn, con cui è possibile arrivare in molte zone di Berlino.

Excellently designed apartment with lots of living space. Quiet area with lots of international restaurants on your doorstep step. Close to transport. Hosts description and photos perfectly described. Really helpful and friendly hosts . We would highly recommend staying here.
Well located, excellent neighborhood.  The apt. Is uglier than the pictures.
Rigtig dejligt sted at bo, jeg vil klart anbefale det. Både området og hostel var meget charmerende.

Ursula is very kind person and I'm grateful for the opportunity to live in very comfortable room.
Public transport, restaurants and parks are close to the apartment.
I spend calm and happy two weeks.
Located in a lovely area with ease of access into central Berlin - would happily stay here again.
Nice location, very clean and nearby supermarkets :)

Jan und seine Mutter waren sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Die Wohnung entspricht meiner Ansicht nach jedoch nicht ganz den veröffentlichten Bildern: die Dusche hat zum Beispiel gelbe/braune Verfärbungen und vor den Fenstern des Apartments wird Baumaterial gelagert. Die Wohnung ist nicht sehr gut renoviert worden. Letztlich war das alles ok für mich, aber dafür war der Preis meiner Ansicht nach etwas zu hoch.
Un pis perfecte per passar uns dies a Berlin! En Max és molt atent, i al barri hi ha de tot. Molt recomanable!

Excellent flat right in front of East Gallery. Couldn’t recommend this place enough. Absolutely everything you’ll need, in a great location and also with a beautiful terrace to enjoy!
Kathrin was responsive and extremely helpful, she was kind and went out of her way to make sure we had everything we needed for a perfect stay. Thank you! 🙏🏽

stanze ampie e accoglienti. location a 20min dal centro con la metropolitana. personale cordiale e gentile.
4/5 stelle come servizio.

Bett in Ordnung, warme Dusche, Sauber! Große Kühlschrank, TV, Tisch, Stuhl.
Keine Spiegel!
Keine Badehandtuch!
Keine Licht am Bett!
It was perfect !
Very convenient spot near metro/bus.
Very clean and good location. Very secure. Great hospitality.
Super Lage. Zimmer sauber. Check-In unkompliziert. Kommunikation mit Host war sehr gut.
Erg fijne plek. Het was stil en rustig. De communicatie met de host was ook zeer prettig. Leuke restaurants om de hoek. We raden deze plek van harte aan!
Recomendado para una primera vez en Berlin
Wir hatten schöne Tage in dieser Unterkunft. Alles war super sauber und die Unterkunft ist fußläufig gut mit den Öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erreichbar.

Die Wohnung liegt mitten in Neukölln, nur wenig entfernt vom Tempelhofer Feld und vom Volkspark Hasenheide. Sie ist super sauber, schön modern eingerichtet, und wir hatten alles, was wir brauchten. Die Kommunikation war immer sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Der einzige Kritikpunkt ist, dass die Schlafgelegenheit auf der Klappcouch sehr unbequem ist. Ansonsten: gerne wieder, aber nur noch zu zweit, so dass die Couch als Schlafgelegenheit nicht mehr benutzt werden muss.

The location is in Kreuzberg, close to public transit stations (bus, U-Bahn, S-Bahn), which was nice. It also has some shops and restaurants in the area which are nice, we especially liked the Turkish breakfast place right on the corner, they served some amazing scrambled eggs with some hot bagel.
The apartment itself was on the smaller side, but clean. You have to get a bit creative if you want to be able to put 2 suitcases somewhere and search for clothes at the same time, but we managed.
The checkin was also ok, don't know about the alternative checkin, if you don't get there in the timeframe when the reception is empty though. Checkout is super easy, we just dropped the keys in the dedicated mailbox inside the building, near the exit.

Susanne and her family are kind, loving, and welcoming people. This was in a quiet and peaceful spot with a very good Pakistani restaurant nearby. It is quite far from the center of the city but the tram station is closeby.

Le séjour (de 1 mois) fut parfait. Tout est conforme (photos/descriptions). Endroit idéal à Berlin, et host extrêmement sympathique :) .
Merci pour l'accueil Olivier.
wonderful stay! would recommend!

I highly recommend staying at Tia’s home in Berlin. We had a little hitch getting into the apartment at first, but to be fair, we arrived earlier than the check in time. But Tia made it work and even arranged for her husband to come and open up the door for us!  The apartment is on the ground floor and is within walking distance to numerous restaurants and coffee shops, as well as the train station which takes you to all the main attractions. Tia’s apartment is in a great neighborhood, right across from a canal. In the evenings, people gather on the sides of the canal on their blankets, with bottles of wine or beer and just enjoy each other’s company and watch the swans (which are also very cool!).  The apartment has a washing machine, but like most places, there is no dryer so you have to plan for a day of clothes drying on a rack. The bedrooms and bathrooms are very spacious and there’s plenty of closet space. Thankfully, Tia has an umbrella available because we got caught in a thunderstorm one night!!  We will happily stay at Tia’s apartment when we return to Germany some day!!
Was a wonderful stay and a great little hideaway to explore the city centre

Avi fue muy amable con nosotros, a pesar que tuvimos inconvenientes con nuestra llegada , fue comprensivo y muy atento en todo momento. Desde el hogar de Avi , hay facilidad para desplazarse a los puntos de interés en Berlín a tan solo media hora en bus.
Super coole Wohnung in einem coolen viertel.
Olga is a wonderful and kind host. Her apartment is beautifully kept and the double beds in the guest bedroom are very comfortable. I felt very home there. Recommended if you are staying in Berlin!
A very good place to stay. They are friendly and willing to help you, plus they keep everything very clean and tidy.
Everything went great with the apartment, close to the Ubahn, clean and spacious.

Eine schöne, kleine AirBnB Wohnung mit allem, was man für einen City-Trip in Berlin benötigt. Die Wohnung ist in einem eher ruhigeren Wohngebiet gelegen. Man ist aber in 5-10 Minuten zu Fuß im Trubel vom Prenzlauer Berg mit vielen Bars und Restaurants. Bei unserer Ankunft war alles sauber und mit der Key Box ist man bei der Anreise sehr flexibel, da wir erst spät abends angekommen sind.
Alex's place was clean and in a great location. He also was very fast at replying to messages. Would highly recommend!
Nicole ist eine tolle Gastgeberin, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und für uns perfekt. Wir können sie wirklich weiter empfehlen! Lage der Wohnung ist auch top.

Die Wohnung war für uns (4 erwachsene + 3 Kinder) eine große Enttäuschung. Bei 740 € für 4 NächteN: eine dunkle Wohnung in der man kaum merkt welches Wetter draußen ist. Die Luft ist muffig feucht. Das Bad bei dem Preis eine einzige Zumutung: minimal ausgestattet. Keinerlei wohlfühlatmosphäre.
Die billige geschmacklose Einrichtung ist dabei fast schon Nebensache.
die zahlreichen positiven Kommentare sind uns ein Rätsel. Das Preis Leistungsverhältnis ist unverschämt.
Einzigen Pluspunkte: sauber und die gute Lage und gute Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter im Vorfeld.
Definitiv keine Empfehlung
Die Lage und Sauberkeit war sehr überzeugend.
Gute Lage in Berlin auch mit Hund.
Alles super,allerdings wurde der Pool extra berechnet und war nicht im Preis inbegriffen. Das stand leider nicht in der Beschreibung

Die Ferienwohnung von Norman und Stefanie hat wirklich eine perfekte Lage. In wenigen Minuten ist man am Müggelsee (Fährstation und Seebad) und auch die S-Bahn und somit die Anbindung an die Innenstadt und die Umgebung ist nicht weit. Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt in Friedrichshagen sehr genossen. Für zwei Personen ist die Ferienwohnung perfekt geeignet und gut ausgestattet. Auch die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern im Vorfeld und vor Ort verlief reibungslos. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Die Kommunikation mit dem Host hat ganz gut funktioniert. Wir konnten sogar etwas früher einchecken, das war super.
Leider ist die Wohnung stark renovierungsbedürftig, vor
allem das Badezimmer. Dort schimmelt die Decke über der Dusche und es riecht sehr unangenehm. Der gesamte Boden klebt beim drüberlaufen und ich habe mich wirklich geekelt.
Insgesamt ist die Wohnung billig ausgestattet, an sich ist das kein Problem, aber die Polster sehen schon ziemlich verschmutzt aus und die Schlafcouch scheint auch zerbrochen zu sein. Da würde es sich lohnen die Möbel auszutauschen.
In der Küche stand noch Geschirr der Vormieter, das dort trocknete. Wir haben leider auch nur 4 Gabeln gefunden, waren aber zu fünft eingecheckt. Geschirrtücher waren auch nicht zu finden.
Der Waschtrockner in der Küche lief als wir ankamen und die (Bett-)Wäsche muss dann 2 Tage dort im trockenen/halbtrockenen? Zustand verweilt haben.
Für den Preis waren wir leider enttäuscht.

Die Örtlichkeit des Zimmers lag sehr günstig zur Nutzung von öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Die Lage war für Berliner Verhältnisse sehr ruhig. Im großen und ganzen ist diese Unterkunft auf jeden Fall weiter zu empfehlen.

We had a nice time! The place had lovely decor just like in the pictures. Great shower. Hot and a little humid apartment, but the fan helped. Quiet neighbourhood. Dietrich was very friendly and answered quickly. We had a few issues at the beginning of our stay: wifi didn't work the first day, some dirty dishes and the sofabed wasn't prepared as promised. We couldn't find a proper sheet for it, only a single bed one. We were offered a compensation, so overall we were happy with our stay. Thank you!
A great place, clean and nice and the check in was easy and the host is very nice.
Fantastically cute place and great location! Super comfy and access to everything—including metro/tram, coffee and restaurants. Comfy but very soft bed and pillows.
Awesome introduction to berlin

Wir waren zu viert im Zimmer und hatten genügend Platz. Es war ruhig und das Personal war sehr freundlich. Die Bahnverbindung ist 2 Minuten entfernt und konnten alles mögliche besichtigen. Wir konnten unsere Koffer nach dem checkout im Hotel deponieren bis am Abend. Aufjedenfall sehr empfehlendswert...!!!!!
Great little place for a group. Access is direct to the street, and the metro is a short walk away.
I really enjoyed the stay. The location was in a very nice area and close to the tram. Easy transport to the city Center. The appartement was very spacious.

Anna is incredible. Easy check in. Gave some amazing recommendations for the local places to enjoy food, drinks and ambience. Clear communication through the entire stay, very kind. Even allowed me to rent a bicycle and this came in handy! The accommodation is spacious, plenty of amenities and it's a wonderful neighborhood. Highly recommend and I would absolutely stay here again and plan to do so next time I'm in the city.

Tip top.
Sehr sauber, sehr gemütlich und die Treppen halten auch fit ;)
Gerne wieder
Nice place in a lively area with loads of shops and restaurants.
Ein tolles Appartement mit perfekter Lage, einfacher In- und Checkout. Kommunikation läuft auch perfekt und Probleme werden schnell gelöst. Danke für den tollen Urlaub!

"I had an absolutely wonderful and relaxing stay at this hotel. The cleanliness, beautiful interior design, and welcoming receptionists all exceeded my expectations. The meal at the restaurant was also fantastic! The only thing that could have made my stay even better was if there were a store nearby to buy groceries, as I booked an apartment with a kitchen. Overall, a great experience!"
Very close to the Charlottenburg Palace. Small, but nice room. Shared bathroom, but good price for Berlin. I would book it again
Great location and really nice welcoming!
Great for short stays

Super Zimmer in einer Gegend in der ich mich auch sehr wohl gefühlt habe.
Mit Tanja hat man eine echt super liebe Gastgeberin mit der man, wenn man möchte super Gespräche führen kann.
Man kann sie alles Fragen, sie hilft einem immer gern weiter und weiß auch gute Tipps.
Danke Tanja für den tollen Aufenthalt:)

Very good location! You could have your own private room which is nice, bed is comfortable. I could rest well after a long day. The kitchen provides all necessary equipment and it's organized. The receptionists are very helpful and polite. Overall, it's a good deal! Highly recommended for backpackers!
Fijne plek. Het matras was een beetje hard, maar voor de rest was alles super!
Alles so geklappt wie erwartet!

Sabine’s place is truly a home away from home! I hope I get the chance to stay here again soon. Everything is perfect, from the communication and location to the cozy room. I felt completely comfortable. Sabine is incredibly attentive, considerate, and friendly. Highly recommended!
Sve super, sve savršeno, uredno i prijatno. Domaćin odličan i pristojan. Pohvale i preporuke.

El alojamiento está muy cerca de una estación de metro y a 1.5 kilómetros del Muro de Berlín, es decir muy cerca. El lugar estaba muy limpio y nos proporcionaron buena Cobija y acceso a cocina completa. Burak fue muy amable y comunicativo. Recomiendo este sitio
Annehmbares Preis-/Leistungsverhäktnis, könnte ich mir nochmal vorstellen
Nice place near central bus station. Great detailed instructions and easy check in. Thank you, Parwana,  for fast responses!
Alles bestens, sehr unterstützend und freundlich. Gerne wieder!

Francesca was the most lovely host you could ever ask for!
The house is super clean and the position is amazing.
I would reccomend this host 100%
Nice place. We had a few changes of plan and Patrick accommodated our requests.
I highly recommend Agnès’ flat!!  Well located to visit Berlin.
Awesome apartment! Stefan was very friendly and kind. We definitely recommend a stay!

Kay und Anne haben uns sehr nett empfangen. Der Check-in hat super geklappt und wir konnten sowohl am Anreise- als auch am Abreisetag unser Gepäck bei ihnen lagern. In der Wohnung war genug Platz für 2 Personen und die Küche war mit allen wichtigen Utensilien ausgestattet - gespült haben wir im Badezimmer. Trotz anderer Anwohner ist man ungestört und hat seine Privatsphäre. Die U-Bahn Station ist zu Fuß 3 Minuten von der Wohnung entfernt und es gibt Supermärkte, Drogerien und Restaurants in direkter Nähe. Auch Shopping-Läden sind schnell erreichbar. Es findet jede Woche ein Diary-Slam bei Kay und Anne statt, bei welchem aus den eigenen Tagebüchern vorgelesen werden kann. Alles in allem hat uns der Aufenthalt sehr gefallen!
Really great value for such an amazing location!
Very cool flat! Very clean! I recommand!

Had a fab few days staying in Sophie’s lovely apartment. It was super clean and comfortable, exactly as shown in the photos. It was a great location for quick access to explore the city with the tram right outside the front door and just a short walk or ride to Alexanderplantz Station. Would certainly stay again and definitely recommend this as a great place to stay when visiting Berlin. Thanks for a great stay :)

My partner and I had a wonderful stay for 8 days in Nathalie’s lovely apartment. The bed is super comfortable. Even the loft bed is very cozy. The duvets are fluffy and warm and made the stay feel like a 5 star hotel.
Nathalie went above and beyond She did our laundry for a very reasonable fee, and was always prompt in replying to our messages. She even rearranged the cleaning schedule in order to let us stay an extra night, even though she was expecting new guests later that day.
The apartment is an extremely quiet haven from the vibrant city, with great black out blinds that cover the two huge skylights.
We highly recommend Nathalie’s place and hope to stay again on our next trip to Berlin.

The place had a great location and all you need for a short stay. Marcella left very clear instructions on how to get to the apartment and she was really nice! Many bars and restaurants on a short walking distance, yet in a more quiet street. The home has a very comfortable and large bed, which was a big plus for us!
The apartment however did not match our standards in cleanliness and did not have many cleaning supplies available either.
We also could not get the gas oven to work and had some communication issues trying to get instructions.
For a short stay this is overall good value for what you are getting. 😊

Uta' s appartement ligt in de superhippe wijk Kreuzberg. Heel veel leuke restaurantjes, winkels en markthal op loopafstand.  Het appartement was superschoon, het bed uiterst comfortabel. Echt een aanrader!

This fit our needs very well.  It is difficult to find a place with no stairs for guests with limited mobility, and this one was perfect... right at street level.  And it is not a busy street, so it was quiet.  The place was very clean and good open space.  It was comfortable to sit and sleep, and the shower was good.  A good location for young families with playgrounds near by.  We will likely return as it was convenient near our young family.

Compact but cozy and super well-located flat, which packs everything you need for exploring Berlin.  It's located in a little self-contained outbuilding ("remise") in the backyard, reached through its own staircase, which adds a charming, cottage-style feeling to the place. The bathroom is large and also has its own washing machine & clothes rack, great if you plan to stay longer. Check-in and out was relaxed and glitch-free, and David was quick and accommodating in responding to any queries both before and during our trip. The location in the middle of Boetzow-Kiez is fantastic for exploring Prenzlauer Berg and Friedrichshain (including the beautiful park nearby, one of my personal Berlin favorites), and within easy reach of Alexanderplatz or Friedrichstrasse to connect with U/S-Bahn networks. Greatly recommended!
Tout s’est très bien passé, logement propre et agréable. Carola est très accueillante et réactive et a su répondre à tout nos besoins.
A perfect clean and comfortable place! It is not situated in a toeristic part of Berlin but therefore just perfect for a real nice time in Berlin!

Die Wohnung hat uns sehr gut gefallen, alles war ordentlich und sauber. Man ist relativ schnell bei der S-Bahn-Station und damit gut angebunden. Wer in der Gegend eine Unterkunft sucht, ist hier gut aufgehoben. :)

Bel appart contemporain, béton, 2 salles de bain pratiques. # chambres semi-fermées...
Pas bcp d'intimité, mais pratique si on est à l'aise avec le concept.
J'ai bcp aimé le design

Responsive host, cozy apartment, good location for exploring Berlin. A few of the electrical amenities had some small issues during our stay but will presumably be fixed rapidly as we made Doug aware of the issue. Without a doubt a very solid choice for a short visit to Berlin. Would recommend.
Gorgeous apartment, very clean, great hosts and great location!
Really nice flat in an excellent location. Perfect for our group of friends wanting to hang around in Kreutzberg. Close to the u, stores and restaurants.
Un ambiente hermoso para quedarse, habitaciones muy lindas y gente muy amable

Great stay in Jörgs apartment. Located on a quiet street in Schöneberg only a 5 minute walk from Nollendorfplatz Ubahn which had great connections. Apartment was spotless and really stylish and modern. Equipped with everything we needed.
We were very comfortable here and would stay again :)
Hôte, Nicholas, super sympathique. Accueillant et proactive.   Il a fait le tour avec moi.

My stay at Jan's place was effortless! There were no doubts or issues from check in to check out, which is such a relieve when traveling. The place itself is honestly one of my favorite Airbnbs yet, super cozy attic loft which i found to be quite roomy with tons of natural light from the skylights. Exactly as described and very well kept. Jan was polite, prompt replies, quite clear with instructions and offered everything you may need to feel at home. 10/10 recommend to anyone.

Tomasz’s Apartment is beautiful, even better than in pictures. Balcony is very nice and views are green and light.
We loved the Apartment and the neighbourhood and we will come back.
Thank you for everything!
Ulla

Service was very nice and professional. Room was clean and if you can get a padlock for the lockers in dorm rooms so you don't have to worry. It's a lovely building with good connections to public transport.

Location is fantastic and the place is really nice. It suffers from a lack of ventilation and no fans etc. which is a slight issue in summer. Three of the bedrooms have no individual door, leading to a distinct lack of privacy. Fine for a family. As a group of grown men, we found it a bit jarring.
Great communication and location. Good for short stays!

Judith was very helpful and very reactive with our demand.
About the appartement, we can say that it's a real airbnb (with real persons who live inside ;)
Good decoration, good place for us (not far of places we like in Friederishain and Kreuzberg > by bicycle or transports)!
Thanks for all !

Virkelig god lejelighed, sød og virkelig hyggelig - ren og velfungerende, der manglede ikke noget 👌 lækker lokation, perfekt afstand til offentlig transport og nem at finde med egen bil med gratis parkering lige nedenfor lejeligheden.
Kan kun anbefale denne lejelighed - kunne helt sikkert godt finde på at leje den igen. Berlin er en skøn by 🇩🇪💛

Waren zum Wochenendtrip in Berlin, durch den Berlin Marathon war natürlich alles ausgebucht.
Gute S-Bahn Anbindung, ruhige Lage

Beautiful neighborhood,  safe area, lots of amenities close by,very close to U bahn, S bahn. great apartment, comfortable beds.  Prompt response to any questions. Would totally recommend staying at Ellen's place.
Really nice room, easy to find and friendly staff. Would stay here again. Bit pricey but compared to some other places, worth it.

Apartament zgodny z opisem – czysto, dobrze wyposażony, idealny na krótki pobyt. Znajduje się w piwnicy, co chwilami czuć w powietrzu, ale nie przeszkadza to w komfortowym wypoczynku. Dużym plusem jest lokalizacja – bardzo blisko Waldbühne i Stadionu Olimpijskiego, świetna baza wypadowa na koncerty. Spokojna okolica, a jednocześnie dobry dostęp do komunikacji miejskiej, dobry kontakt z gospodarzem Peterem. Polecam!
Christine was a good host, kind and understanding. We even had a good conversation about different countries and life. The place to stay was nice and in a good location.

We loved staying with Ana - the location is amazing but also private. Travelling with our two kids, we also appreciated that the apartment was on the ground floor and that we didn't have to bring the stroller up any stairs.
The apartment itself is very cute and had everything we needed - with mice touches like extra deodorant or shaving cream in case we forgot something. I highly recommend staying here!
Alles war super, eine tolle Wohnung und tolle Lage. Jederzeit wieder
Michael was very helpful and accommodating of our plans! All went smoothly, and the apartment is in a perfect location for exploring the city. Vielen Dank!

Andre is a fantastic host. He made sure that we had everything we needed and that we had a great stay. The apartment is in a quiet area, and it's easy to reach the city center with public transportation. We plan on staying there again on our next trip to Berlin.
一切都非常棒，溫暖的居住環境，房東迅速回覆以及可愛的貓咪；唯一需注意就是因為無法使用廚房，清洗餐具會稍微不方便些。

Insgesamt toller Aufenthalt, gerne wieder.
Schönes und wohltuendes Zimmer.
Schmale Wendeltreppe, die zum Badezimmer führt.
Kaffee und Tee gab es auch in der Küche.
Wir haben uns rundum wohl gefühlt.
Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Alles war so wie beschrieben. Die Lage ist super es gibt eine Menge Cafés in der Nähe und trotzdem ist es ruhig. Andreas ist ein sehr netter Gastgeber.

Schöne, saubere, moderne Unterkunft in toller Lage.
Gerne jederzeit wieder!
top Host! Every time again!

If I could give this place 10 stars - I would! What a beautiful apartment and a lovely host! Incredibly attentive, quick to respond to questions and such lovely personal touches to make it feel like home! It’s a bit outside of Berlin, but the transit is easy. It’s easy to get to Berlin and the airport via transit, we had no problems! Can’t wait to come back to visit!

spacious, clean and well equipped room. Typical of a post war east Berlin accommodation building - conveys an authentic Berlin experience, with all the requisite comforts of the 21st century (the room has all modern appliances and technologies). Martin was responsive and knowledgeable, and helped make our time in Berlin stress free.
Spacious comfortable apartment which is located very well for public transport. Ruth and her husband are also very helpful.

En la llegada nos atendió Ainhoa y desde el principio nos ayudo en todo, nos enseño la casa y desde el primer día estuvimos como en muestra casa. Nos aconsejo sitios para ver, comer y hacer compras. Un 10 para Ainhoa, nos llevamos un muy buen recuerdo de Berlín...
Philip was a great host, the flat is very nice, easy to check in and has everything you can need. I can recommend.
Die Gastgeberin ist sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Die Wohnung ist sehr gut mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen. Das Zimmer war wie beschrieben, ruhig und bequem. Immer wieder gerne!
Gunnar was a great host and the place really felt like a home. Would definitely stay again if possible.
Super! Wir kommen bald wieder!

The apartment is exactly as described, which is great! It is very well located, close to the train station and with all the transport options. The neighborhood is central and you are close to several tourist sites and there are also good options of restaurants, markets and cafes nearby.
Wir waren nur eine Nacht dort – alles war sauber und gut organisiert. Das Zimmer hatte zwar keine Fenster, aber für eine kurze Übernachtung war es völlig in Ordnung.
Todo OK! REcomendable. Como limpio y bien ubicado.

I had to cancel on the same day as booking unfortunately as I got a renewed bout of sickness, which saddens me as I would have loved to spend my time in Berlin. In our communication, Thor has proven to be incredibly thorough, generous, understanding and I would have loved to extend my gratitude for his service in person. Just from our communication, Thor's abilities as a host were immaculate, so I would recommend inquiring with him about your next stay in Berlin.
Gutes Hostel im Herzen Berlins - wer möchte findet glaube ich noch günstigere, aber wir hatten eine schöne Zeit.
Clean apartments with beautiful interior, transport within 5 minutes walk, location in a quiet beautiful area.  A supermarket can be found nearby.  I recommend!

Elena was a very nice host. The apartment is great, in good location and super clean.
Thank you.

Me and my friend had a lovely stay at Anna and her husband’s. We absolutely have nothing bad to say about the apartment and the hospitality, the stay was pleasant from the very first to the last second 🤗

"Wir waren als Gruppe in der 'Bowie'-Wohnung und waren begeistert! Die Wohnung ist geräumig und bietet genügend Platz für alle. Die Schlafmöglichkeiten sind flexibel und die Verdunkelungsrolläden sorgen für einen erholsamen Schlaf. Die Lage ist gut, man ist schnell überall. Besonders toll fanden wir die Mischung aus Altbaucharme und modernem Komfort."
Nice apartment and friendly host. Great experience.
freundlich und unkompliziert, vielen lieben Dank

Appartement spacieux (il y aurait d ailleurs de l espca pour accueillir plus que 2 hôtes avec un canapé convertible), en souplex (mais suffisamment lumineux pour que ce ne soit pas étouffant). Très proche d une stationde métro. 2 mini bémols: déco assez minimaliste tout béton : quel confort en hiver quand il fait froid et humide ? Et lumiere sur minuterie assez longue dans la couloir
Alles top. Funktionales Zimmer, nette Service-Kräfte.

Andrew is a great host. He helped us with easy bookings and flexible timing since we encountered difficulties with our visa approval and need to post-poned for a few days. His place is lovely and we love the nollendorfplatz neighborhood, very near to U bahn station and bus station. Lots of cafes nearby and there is a 24hour supermarket nearby. Very recommended place to stay.
Absolutes Schnäppchen. Wer keinen kleinen Umweg scheut ist hier gut beraten.
war eine super Unterkunft und die Kommunikation war immer top hat alles geklappt wie ich es mir vorgestellt habe
Great place, very cool art. Location is fantastic with lots of amenities in the area and steps to the tram and subway. Quiet neighborhood too.

This apartment is in need of some serious TLC. It is tired and not well kept. The described sitting room is now an additional bedroom which this apartment doesn’t need and as a result you can’t comfortably sit anywhere (and watch tv). I messaged Sören as soon as we arrived about the state of the apartment and the messiness of the kitchen and we did get a discount. Much appreciated, but an uncomfortable stay anyway. Not cozy at all… I am sorry to be this negative, but by far the saddest AirBnb we stayed in.
Wir hatten wirklich schöne Tage in der Wohnung. Sie ist sehr gemütlich eingerichtet und hat alles was man braucht! Danke!

Sehr schöner Aufenthalt in Key 1 und ein idealer Ausgangspunkt für eine Besichtigung Berlins. Die Nähe zu einem Biosupermarkt und verschiedenen Lokalen war sehr günstig. Die nahe S-Bahnstation (etwa 5 Gehminuten) war auch sehr hilfreich. Gerne kommen wir wieder auf diese Wohnung zurück!

Muy buena localización, cerca de los sitios más interesantes y del transporte público. El hotel está muy cuidado, la habitación tenía todo lo que necesitamos y es muy tranquila. La cama muy cómoda. Buena elección.
Excelente localizaçao, Muito Confortavel e bem equipado. Recomendo!!
Great stay with Helen!!

Wir haben drei schöne Tage in Reinholds Hütte verbracht. Die Lage am See ist sehr besonders, mit  direktem Zugang zum Wasser und dem Sitzplatz auf dem Steg. Die Hütte steht auf einem langen, sehr schmalen Grundstück mit minimalem Abstand zu den Nachbargrundstücken und Stegen. Da zu unserem Aufenthaltszeitpunkt die Badesaison eigentlich schon zu Ende war, hatten wir das Glück, dass die Nachbarhütten und Stege fast unbewohnt waren und wir viel Privatsphäre genießen konnten. Die Kommunikation mit Reinhold war gut und problemlos. Das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis ist unseres Erachtens  eher schlecht. Die Ausstattung ist sehr einfach, was nicht schlecht ist, der Preis dafür ist allerdings deutlich zu hoch. Die Lage alleine rechtfertigt unserer Meinung nach nicht den teilweise sehr hohen Übernachtungspreis.
Erika ist eine sehr gute Gastgeberin und hat uns und unseren Hund herzlich aufgenommen. Die Ausstattung der Wohnung ist gut und der naheliegende schöne Park für einen Spaziergang mit Hund ideal.
We loved the house and our child loved the garden - an oasis where we could rest after long days of city exploration.
A stylish and brilliantly located apartment, very quiet and chilled but easy to travel from! An excellent choice for a travelling couple.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Franck, arrivée autonome très pratique grâce à la boîte à clefs, studio très propre, lit confortable, quartier très calme, très bien situé à proximité des moyens de transports. Nous recommandons vivement ! Merci encore pour cet accueil chaleureux et idéal :)

Dorit est une hôte sérieuse, aimable, attentionnée et à l'écoute.
La chambre est nickel et située ds un immeuble super calme mais dans un quartier qui foisonne de cafés, restaurants, petits commerces... Et à 3 arrêts de tram de Alexanderplatz. Parfait!
Check-In ging bis spät in die Nacht, Rezeption sehr freundlich, Zimmer größer als erwartet, Bett bequem, Bad super, Zimmerservice nett, alles super
It was great pleace and big enough room.
Super Zimmer, gute Kommunikation, total flexible Abstimmung bezüglich Check-In und Check-Out und im gesamten alles sehr unkompliziert. Danke, Theo !
Super hôte toujours présent dès que j’ai eu besoin
Everything was clean and comfortable. Very good choice for a 3 days trip in Berlin just the lift is missing to get to the room mostly if your booking is at the 3rd or 4th floor .

Wir waren schon in einigen Airbnb aber das war mit Abstand das tollste und die Kommunikation war sagenhaft. Jessica hat immer sofort reagiert und alles war total easy. Die Lage ist phänomenal, man fällt aus der Tür ins Berliner Leben und trotzdem ist die Wohnung total ruhig weil sie im Hinterhof liegt. Die kleine Terrasse im Garten ist total schön und die Wohnung mit super viel Geschmack eingerichtet. Wir würden gerne wiederkommen.
Everything was very good

The apartment was big and very clean and comfortable. Communication also worked fast via Airbnb messages (phone numbers were also given). Everything was better than expected - all the good reviews are well deserved!
Schöne, kunstvolle Wohnung. Nette Gastgeberin und gute, zentrale Lage.
Lovely cozy quiet little apartment in beautiful neighbourhood. Great responsive host. I can recommend.

Vielen Dank für den sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt in der Penthouse Wohnung. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und über die vielfältige Unterstützung von unserem Host Sebastian gefreut. Dadurch wurde auch unser Aufenthalt in Berlin zu einem schönen Erlebnis!
Vielen Dank,
Artur & Birgit
Natalia is an amazing host! The Air bnb was clean and spacious.

Das Apartment lag super zentral und trotzdem ruhig durch Hinterhof Lage. Es hat an nichts gefehlt, die Wohnung war top ausgestattet. Thomas ist ein toller Gastgeber, der stets zu erreichen war und immer sehr hilfsbereit war.

Ein schönes Appartement, zentral gelegen im Viertel Prenzlauer Berg. Sehr ruhig, die Fenster gehen auf einen wunderbar begrünten Innenhof. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt bei Carolina und Athena. Jederzeit wieder!

Sehr schöne Wohnung. Alles war sauber und schön eingerichtet. Man hat sich direkt wie zuhause gefühlt. Kommunikation war top. Man hat immer schneller und hilfreiche Antworten bekommen. Lage war super.
Immer wieder gerne die Wohnung buchen, wenn man in Berlin sein sollte.
5von5 Sternen.
Frank was a great host and his place was great!
Nous avons passé un super séjour. L'appartement est très agréable à vivre: spacieux, propre, convivial, bien équipé et dans un super quartier. Blaine est très réactif et disponible en cas de besoin.

Karsten was very helpful. The apartment was as we expected: clean, stylish, comfortable for a couple with modern decor in an older building. The location was very convenient to both transit and close enough to walk to sights in the Mitte. Generally quiet. I’m glad we were able to stay here, I’d be happy to return.
This is a fabulous apartment in a great location near the park and beer garden.  The inner courtyard is a lovely safe play space for small children
We had a very pleasant stay in this nice and friendly neighborhood of Berlin!

Amazing location. Alexander was super communicative, helpful and just wonderful as a host. Had great tips for our stay and the place is just amazing. Quiet, comfortable, clean, great sunlight, what more is there to ask for?
Everyone should stay here

Michele is a responsive and caring host. The apartment is spacious and comfortable, and has everything you need for an enjoyable stay. 5 min walk to Birkenstrasse station for onward connections and with a small supermarket 2 mins walk away. We criss crossed the city with ease and cheaply, so didn’t get the opportunity to sample bars etc nearby.
We had a very enjoyable stay and would definitely stay there again. Thanks Michele

Fadeih was a lovely host, we very much enjoyed our stay in the appartement.
I would definitely recommend this accomodation for people who like to enjoy culture, architecture, good food and cheap drinks. The neighbourhood is very vibrant and full of things to do. There are loads of restaurants, bars, stores,... in the area so you'll always have something to do.
The appartement has everything it needs, was exactly like the pictures and is very neat and clean. The communication with Fadei went very smoothly as well.
We'll definitely be coming again!
Thank you again Fadei.
It was very nice staying in the Airbnb! The room is great and everything was clean and organized. Hardi is also a very nice host, he was very helpful and kind. I totally recommend the Airbnb :)
Awesome host and place! Would recommend.

Für den flexiblen Check-In möchte ich mich bedanken.
Im Apartment habe ich mich sehr wohl gefühlt und bedanke mich für die herzliche sowie freundliche Gastfreundschaft.
Vielen Dank.
Отличная, красивая, чистая, удобная квартира.

Berta is so awesome and so is her space. She has a wonderful warm energy and is very communicative,  knowledgeable and really goes the extra mile to make sure you have the best stay possible. I kept saying “wow” when I first arrived because I was so impressed with her and the flat (which is one of the coolest decorated spaces I have ever seen). I would definitely stay with her again!

My friend and I loved staying at Sunny’s very much! It was clean, spacious, modern, and a perfect location for us. The only issue was the noise from the disco downstairs, but Sunny handled the situation very well.
Idéalement placé pour visiter Berlin. Spacieux et confortable. Très bon séjour chez Ralph.

The room is comfortable for a couple, big and with a lovely view for the trees. Ahmed is kind and polite. Complete kitchen, nice shower (shared bathroom). Very close to public transport and supermarkets. Half floor by stairs after the lift. Recommended!
Schöne Wohnung an ruhiger Lage.

nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Berlin dans l'appartement de PAtrick et Kate. un ptit plouf dans les lacs voisins quand la chaleur était trop forte, l'appartement est super bien situé et proche de commerces, restaurants cafés... le métro pas loin et nous sommes venus avec nos vélos (ce que nous recommandons) qui peuvent être abrités à la cave ! c'est top !

Tåmä huoneisto oli hieno ja käytännöllinen. Se oli siisti ja siellä oli kaikki tarpeellinen keittiövälineitä ja stioita myöten. Paikka ja talo oli erittäin hiljainen ja sijaitsee lähellä keskustaa. Isäntä oli miellyttävä,joustava ja avulias varausasioissa ja saimme hyviä vinkkejä nähtävyyksistä ja kaupungissa liikkumiseen. Kokonaisuutena voimme suositella tätä huoneistoa ja sen isäntää kaikille, jotka käyvät Berliinissä.

Wahnsinnig nett, die Kommunikation war extrem gut, schnell und freundlich. Ich hatte auch die Möglichkeit etwas später auszuchecken, dafür war ich sehr dankbar. Die Lage des Studios ist wirklich toll, man erreicht alles schnell und ist trotzdem durch die Seitenstraße relativ ruhig gelegen.
Danke, Dominik!

Great place! Fresh and new, very comfortable. What you see is what you get :D

Fritz was very nice and although we didn't meet in person he was always kind and friendly.

5 stars ++++++!!

Magnifique appartement, avec un très grand espace et un mobilier impeccable. Nous nous y sentons comme chez nous. La situation est très bien, proche des transports publics et dans une zone calme. L'arrivée et le checkout se font très facilement et Patrick est joignable en cas de demande.
Je conseille vivement cet endroit pour un séjour à Berlin.
The apartment was exactly as described, in a great location and the check in and check out process was very smooth with the onsite reception. I would definitely stay there again.

- logement très cher pour la taille, l’emplacement, le fait d’être au 1er étage, et de donner sur un métro aérien donc très bruyant. De plus le quartier n’était pas spécialement amical. Des gens fumais de la marijuana en bas et la fumée remontait dans l’appartement

Great Berlin studio! Styled with love, care and attention. No doubt about that! The bathroom with its colors... Amazing! The only thing is that the neighborhood didn't feel too safe. I went there with my 9 year old daughter, it was pretty intense for her. She totally loved the bed though!

Die Beschreibung passt exakt: Ein wirklich traumhaftes Loft, zentral in Kreuzberg gelegen und trotzdem sehr ruhig. Die Ausstattung ist sehr stilvoll und es ist alles vorhanden, was man barucht. Bei Fragen stehen Caroline & Philipp immer schnell und freundlich zur Seite. Ich kann diese Unterkunft nur absolut empfehlen :)
Kanon lejlighed. Plads til mange og tæt på U Bahn. Flinke værter. Super
Recht komfortabel

Jörn è stato davvero gentile ha risolto i miei dubbi sia sugli spostamenti dall'aeroporto (estremamente facile in taxi) sia sull'orario check in che è stato fatto in tarda serata per via del volo con un piccolo supplemento.
Al nostro arrivo ci ha accolti parlando un inglese davvero chiarissimo questo ci ha permesso di capirci senza difficoltà.
In generale la casa è pulitissima
Ambienti come da foto
Comodissima alla metro (in 25 minuti scarsi siete ad Alexander Platz e in generale ben collegata a tante altre linee che vi porteranno nei vari quartieri della città)

Zona tranquilla

Wer eine Unterkunft in Ost-Berlin sucht in der Nähe von Marzahn, ist bestens aufgehoben. Man kommt schnell zur S-Bahn und zum Einkaufszentrum. Das Zimmer ist groß genug und die Küche konnten wir gut nutzen. Die Lage ist ruhig. Angelika hat immer sofort auf unsere Fragen reagiert. Alles super!
Sehr zufrieden mit den Unterkunftsbedingungen. Wir werden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen.

Kristina’s studio was very nice and clean, the location was really close to many bars/restaurants as well as the airport which was very convenient. She provided us with food/beverages and lots of german sweets!
Heiko和他的太太很热情友好、交通指示明确，位置在柏林安静安全的街区，距离地铁站火车站都步行可达，打车到市中心也很快，这里富有历史感同时又很有生活气息～遇到的邻居也都很可爱善良～是非常具有性价比的房源！
A very beautiful house with a wonderful garden. The apartment is cozy, nice and calm. Christine is a warm and generous host, who made us feel very welcome. Thank you for letting us stay in your home!
Gute Ort und Preis. Alles war in Ordnung.
Sven had fabulous communication and flexibility with all our requests. We truly felt at home and can't wait to come back.  Place was close to walk to several sites and easy location for transit.

Melissa was kind thoughtful and welcoming host. The instructions to find the flat were very clear and helpful. The flat is beautiful and the room peaceful and spacious. The area is full of independent shops and places to eat and has a relaxed and friendly vibe. I had a lovely few days in Berlin and hope to come back soon.

The apartment is very cozy, spacious, clean and organized.
The neighbourhood is beautiful and safe, there are also many restaurants and cafes within walking distance. You can easily get to all parts of the city by bike or public transport.
Staying at Clarize and Nicholas's apartment was a great experience, I 100% recommend it!
Coole Unterkunft mit guter Lage. Alice selber war super Hilfsbereit und immer für einen da, falls man Fragen oder sonstiges hatte. Kann man nur weiter empfehlen

Hasan was a very friendly and accommodating host. His apartment on the top floor has a beautiful sunroom, great bathroom and nice kitchen. Hasan also generously prepared breakfast for me on both mornings. I'm looking forward to meeting Hasan again in the future.
lange Wartezeit bis zum Check In sonst super
Super lovely accommodation for our group doing college fieldwork, handy location, perfect kitchen and bathroom, and super helpful host :)

Having stayed at Camilla's place for a week we have nothing but positive things to say. The apartment is immaculate and stylish, with an excellent array of books/magazines and DVDs. The film projector is a big plus, perfect for a night in when you're all walked out. Prenzlauer Berg (great architecture, bars, boutique shops etc) is a fantastic base to get round Berlin and the apartment is situated on a cool street with some smart coffee shops and bars (the food at Muse was superb value). There are plenty of supermarkets nearby to stock up on any essentials too. As a host, Camilla could not have been more helpful and always replied straightaway to any enquiries. On our last visit to Berlin we stayed at Soho House and whilst we have nothing bad to say about it (it's fantastic too!) whatsoever, it's testament to how much we enjoyed our stay here that we'd return for a repeat visit on our next time in the capital.
We were given very helpful information during check in.
Maravillos lugar. Lo volvería a escoger:

La chambre de Sabine est parfaite. Très spacieuse et lumineuse, et aussi très confortable. Elle est située dans un quartier calme à 5 min à pieds d’arrêts de métro et S-Bahn qui vous mèneront partout dans la ville.
Sabine est très accueillante et attentive aux besoins de ses hôtes. Je recommande vivement pour un séjour à Berlin!

Sehr schönes Apartment in einer gepflegten Gegend. Es hat an nichts gefehlt. Hervorzuheben ist die komplette Küchenausstattung mit Herd, Backofen, Spülmaschine, Kaffeemaschine, Wasserkocher und vieles mehr!
Super Lage - super Ausstattung
Great place to stay in Berlin. Save and close to everything.

Appartamento molto bello con vista spettacolare! Host affidabile è disponibile ad esaudire ogni mia richiesta.
Consigliato
Cosy and cute apartment with all the amenities you need. Surrounded by plenty of restaurants. Would recommend to others visiting Berlin!
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Dietrich, qui a été réactif et disponible. Le logement correspond parfaitement à l'annonce, proche des transports, et est très agréable. Nous recommandons !
We hebben genoten van ons verblijf. Rustige locatie dichtbij alle highlights. Goed verzorgd, sfeervolle en luxe ruimte.  Volgende reis naar Berlijn gaan we weer.
