Den ligger nær T-banen,  elven, matbutikker, hyggelige kafeer og restauranter. Takk for oss! Enkel vert å kommunisere med, og gode romslige soverom og fellesareal. Leiligheten kan bli litt kald nå på høsten, så jeg anbefaler å ta med varme klær.
Lovely room - bigger than it looks in the pictures. Johanna responded quickly to messages and was flexible when I needed to change my check in time.

The location is superb. The neighborhood is lovely and vibrant and easy to get around. You’re in a short walking distance to so many great restaurants, bakers, butchers, art galleries, museums, markets, and shops. The S Bahn entrance is within 50 meters. You only need walk across the street or around the corner to find coffee, beer, baked goods, and more. Try Mogg for an amazing Reuben Sandwich (cash only).
As far as the super convenient ground floor apartment, count on all the creature comforts one wants for a short stay. It’s modern, sophisticated, and very stylish. I wouldn’t be surprised if Stephanie is an architect or interior designer.
Love the shower. I may have to have a similar unit installed in my own back home. I’m also going to purchase a DeLonghi coffeemaker. Having such delicious, freshly ground coffee, made my mornings. Sorry Nespresso.
The only drawback was the presence of loud music until midnight on Saturday night. But only on that evening.
Plamena, who opens and introduces the apartment, is so accommodating. Nothing is too much trouble for her. Because my friend was delayed a day, she made a special trip to let him into the apartment while I was in a tour. She is truly lovely. Much of the reason this Airbnb is so highly rated.
When I return to Berlin, I will make sure I book Stephanie’s place. It will be like returning to my own special home and neighborhood in Berlin.
Patrick was an excellent host and the apartment was very clean and comfortable. Highly recommend staying here!
Fantastisk lejlighed i hipt kvarter. Kommer helt sikkert igen. Eneste minus er en svag lugt af fugt, som egentligt kun er generende de første minutter man kommer ind i lejligheden udefra.

All in all it’s a nice place, good organisation, great location and staff.
Would’ve loved to have a mirror in our room tho. Also some of the other guests didn’t clean up after themselves in the kitchen…
staff had to clean everything the next day :/ i

Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und schön gestaltet. Die Gastgeberin ist sehr sehr freundlich und wir hatten eine super Kommunikation. Das einzige was ich zu bemängeln habe ist das Hochbett, da es sehr wackelig war und man deshalb schlecht drauf schlafen konnte. Wir waren aber trotzdem zufrieden :)
Hi, I must say that Sören was easy to work any problems out quickly, he was always freindly with any question I had, overall it's a great place highly recommended by myself to stay in.

Un excellent séjour grâce à un appartement chaleureux, très bien placé qui permet de visiter au mieux cette superbe ville.
Merci à Bernd and Katja pour leur accueil formidable.
Stephanie‘s place was absolutely stunning. It was as good as being at home. Beautiful accommodation with classy styling. The only problem we had was communicating with the host upon arrival.
Very nice person,  good location.

Im Schlafzimmer kann man nicht grade stehen ( höhe keine 185 cm ), was nicht in der Beschreibung steht.
Das Fernsehen ist leider nicht möglich gewesen da es entweder kein Signal durchgehend kam oder ein bunter Bildschirm, jedoch konnte man dafür wenigstens die Stimme hören vom Sender und das wars aber auch.
Badezimmer und Küche waren nicht wirklich sauber und waren leider voll mit Spinnweben und spinnen, was ich schade finde , weil man 30€ für Säubern zahlt und man dafür aber keine Sauberkeit kriegt.
Die Garten Türen hingen und man bekam diese zeitweise nicht ohne weiteres geöffnet.
Das Wlan funktionierte zeitweise nicht und der TV hat leider keine Internet Verbindung gehabt.

Wir haben drei entspannte Tage in dieser schönen Wohnung verbracht. Sie ist geräumig und hell, liegt in einem ruhigen, grünen Umfeld, die Matratzen sind bequem - alles super für einen guten Schlaf. Die Wohnung befindet sich in einem wunderschönen Haus der 20er Jahre und absolut klasse ist die große Dachterrasse. Hannes ist ein sehr sympathischer und kommunikativer Vermieter! Uns hat es sehr gut gefallen!
Timothy ist ein sehr freundlicher und flexibler Gastgeber. Ich bin unvorhergesehen sehr spät angereist und war sehr dankbar für Timothys unkomplizierte und entgegenkommende Art.

Katja y Rick son increíbles!!
Alojamiento super recomendable, la estancia es muy bonita y acogedora, todo estaba impecable y nos recibieron como en casa. Katja muy atenta a todo y siempre pendiente de nuestra comodidad, sin dudar, repetiremos si volvemos por Berlín.
Muchas gracias :)

Charlotte est très accueillante ! Le logement est très beau, et bien placé, à proximité de transports en commun dans un quartier cosmopolite. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour, la chambre est spacieuse et nous n'avons pas manqué d'intimité. Nous recommandons ce logement aux couples ou amis qui voudraient visiter Berlin. Merci Charlotte pour tout !
Tout était bien. Conforme à l'annonce. Appartement pratique, bien situé, facile d'accès et communication très agréable avec Jonas. Super séjour !
Monika is a great host! Highly recommended!
It’s a nice place to stay in with unique home vibes. While the streets are busy it’s very quite inside. There is transport nearby but it is possible to walk to centre too.

Fint och rent, bra med egen parkering.
Amir var bra att kommunicera med, kom med tips och hade svar på alla frågor och funderingar. Rekommenderas!

I had a really good time in Jürgen's lovely apartment - a hidden gem. The communication was clear and fast and the apartment clean and cosy. I immediatelly felt at home. Jürgen is an amazing host and an insightful and open-minded person to talk to. There is a nice view from balcony and the neighborhood is great: quiet but many nice restaurants, cafes and markets close by.
Beautiful room, everything clean and comfortable. Great location in Prenzlauer berg. Close to the Subway and Metro and some really nice restaurants right next door. Recommended.
Nice appartement in a good location near the train station. Everything was clean and the apartment was fully equipped.
It was a nice experience for 3 of us, we enjoyed the place and anything related to apartment can be found in the description. Beate was helpful and thoughtful that makes the staying enjoyable

La anfitriona estuvo siempre pendiente, amable, tuvo flexibilidad con el horario de entrada, dejó claras las instrucciones y nos hizo sentir en confianza. Nos gustó que tienen parqueo para los huéspedes incluido en el precio. La estancia en general fue agradable, solo estuve una noche y éramos 3 personas. El apartamento es grande y acogedor. Se sentía un poco de polvo en el colchón (soy alérgica y sensible con el olfato) y el colchón de la cama grande muy blando para mi espalda pero en general la ubicación y el apartamento me parece una excelente opción. Baño y cocina limpios y con todo lo necesario ❤️
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Berlin grâce à Susann qui nous a accueilli chaleureusement dans son appartement très confortable,  idéalement situé pour aller explorer la ville.
Outstandingly well-equipped and central AirBnB, with a truly authentic Kreuzberg twist!

Probably the loveliest host I've ever seen!
Diego is kind, smiling, and very flexible.
Wir waren sehr zufrieden und hatten eine tolle Zeit in Berlin!
Very good location and calm neighborhood. The room is clean and modern, perfect for a short stay. Would recommend!
We had a great stay in Berlin, its a little hidden jewel, Thank you Claudia
Beautiful typical berlin apartment. High roofs, creaky hardwood floors, just fantastic. I really anjoyed my time and can only recommend!

Berta is an absolutely wonderful host with a lovely room and apartment, do not miss this opportunity when you are visiting Berlin!
I could not have asked for more during my short stay; she provided me with information about the area including bars, restaurants and a map, and the room is large and comfortable with good light. Berta even kindly let me use her bicycle which was a huge bonus! Her apartment is right next to the station, and the area has great bars and restaurants, a perfect mix of quiet and lively. Oh and make sure to check out the cafe round the corner for great coffee and snacks!

I absolutely loved staying at Masha’s place. The location was perfect and it was very safe and easy to access property. Inside was very clean and it had everything you needed if you wanted to cook yourself. 5 stars thanks masha!!! Would 100% stay here again.

Ayoka ist eine sehr freundliche und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin. Ich habe mich dort sehr wohlgefühlt. Die Unterkunft ist sehr sauber und es ist ruhig dort. Es gibt sogar in der Nähe kostenlose Parkplätze. Ich kann die Unterkunft bei Ayako nur weiterempfehlen.

The apartment is clean and situated in a very nice place in Berlin. The host is very nice and comunicative.
I enjoyed the stay!
This place is exactly what I needed in accommodations. Very easy access to transportation and shops made my stay extremely comfortable.

Great location, wonderful decoration. Stella is a great host. She told everything before we get there, so there's no need to ask anything. Also entering was really easy. Thanks for everything. I hope to come back again :)

My boyfriend and I stayed in Joseph's place for a month and wanted to move in permanently on Day 1. It's wonderful. Joseph is one of the best hosts we've ever had - immediately responsive to all of our questions and needs. The wifi went spotty half way through our stay, and he made it top priority to get it fixed. He's incredibly friendly and really cares about his guests' experience. The apartment is on the 3rd or 4th floor and there's no elevator, so if accessibility is a concern, it won't be the most ideal place to stay. If you're fine with stairs, it's just enough to get a little workout but not enough to be sweaty when you get home. :) The bedroom is very small but once we were settled in, it made no difference at all since we spent most of our time in the living room, which is a really nice space. We were both working during our stay, and it was a little tricky when we had calls at the same time. I moved a desk in the bedroom, which became very cramped, but it wasn't a huge problem by any means (working while traveling is rarely ideal - you just figure it out). The bathtub was a huge treat - very clean and plenty of hot water. The neighborhood is quiet and cool and feels very safe. We were surprised it wasn't more lively, but there are a number of great restaurants and coffee shops walking distance. We were super happy here and would definitely recommend!

Best location to stay, in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg and the middle of everything the area has to offer. The U-bahn and tram stop around the corner, plenty of good restaurants and Mauerpark on 5 minutes walk.
The appartement itself is basic and simple, yet offers everything you need. Very good beds, practical kitchen and hot shower.
Downsides? Don’t expect the cleanest apartment ever. We have spend a good hour of cleaning bathroom and kitchen… the rest of the appartement could do a good hoover as well… 😬
Great location, very clean and well maintained Apartment  and Apostoles is very kind and friendly.
War alles gut. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Wakker worden met de zon in de prachtige kamer. Heel ruime slaapkamer en een praktische badkamer. Heel aangenaam verblijf gehad bij Mareike. Ze is heel vriendelijk en gaf ons enkele leuke tips!
Our stay with Dumar was splendid, home clean, easy to arrive. All in all a great host and person! Highly recommend!

We had a great time at Yulia’s place! Her apartment is very clean and also very stylish :) it is well equipped as well and her recommendations about what to do in her area were super nice.
We enjoyed our breakfast on her sunny balcony a lot.
Be aware that the location is more northwards than the Airbnb location says, but this was not a problem for us at all, since she told this before our arrival. Also: the neighborhood is great! So all in all, we would love to stay at her place again. Thanks Yulia!!
Wie immer sehr angenehm und nett!🤗
Can really recommend Peter's apartment!! It was nice, clean and in a great location. Would definitely stay there again!
The apartment was big and very well accommodated, in the center of Berlin, the host was great and the zone as well, wifi not that much.
Everything was great. From checking in to checking out. And the apartment was greatly situated in the middle of everything.
Die Unterkunft war genau wie beschrieben und sehr einfach zu finden. Der check in klappte durch den zuvor erhaltenen Code einwandfrei! kann ich nur weiterempfehlen
Great apartment, great communication and great area. We would definently consider renting this place again! :)
Truly exceptional place to stay! I cannot recommend it more highly! Nadeem went above and beyond in terms of responsiveness and help on this. I look forward to coming back to Berlin soon!

Wir haben zu viert ein Wochenende in Yves Wohnung verbracht und haben uns gleich wie zuhause gefühlt. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und ist sehr schön eingerichtet. Es ist alles was man braucht vorhanden. Sie liegt in einem belebten Stadtteil und es gibt eine Vielzahl an tollen Restaurants und Cafés in der Umgebung. Zur U-Bahn sind es auch nur ein paar Minuten zu Fuß. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Danke für die nette Begrüssung.
Uns hat es sehr gut gefallen.
Sehr sauber und gut eingerichtet.
Mir würden wieder kommen.
Liebe Grüsse
The apartment is amazing and is easy walking distance to train station. We loved breakfast at the Bondi Cafe 2 mins walk from the apartment! Enjoy!
great and beautiful space

The stay at Susanne’s place was wonderful! It is a great family: Susanne and her husband are friendly and hospitable, their daughters are lovely and confident. The room has a great location and is easy to access to from the central bus station and the train stations with public transportation.
You will have your own fridge in your room.
Anyway it would be a perfect choice to stay at Susanne’s in Berlin.

Die Unterkunft ist gut gelegen, das Zimmer vollkommen in Ordnung.
Das Bad ist neu, aber die Tür quietscht sehr - Ohrstöpsel mitnehmen.
Das Check in war hervorragend.

Vielen Dank für den angenehmen Aufenthalt:-)
Das Apartement hat wirklich alles, was man braucht (auch längerer Aufenthalt möglich).
Sogar Kühlschrank/ Mikrowelle und Geschirr sind vorhanden, womit ich nicht gerechnet hätte.
Great place

Très bon accueil de la part de Cyrus, il nous a donné pas mal d’informations sur les lieux à visiter et les différents moyens de transport.
Merci beaucoup!
Ideální lokalita na S-Ring vlaku.
Location was good for us and michael was in quick communication

The place was perfect!
Perfect location, 5 minutes from hackaser market and 5 minutes from Alexander platz. Its really the perfect place to stay in while in Berlin.
Stephanie was very helpful and extremely nice. The street which the apartment is located on is pretty quiet and the view from the window is to a joint garden. I would rate Stephanie's place as a 10 out of 10. Thank you Stephanie.
Krásné místo a krásné okolí…

Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable à 6 en famille chez Yosh :-)
Un séjour vraiment très original sur cette maison embarcation flottante, très bien équipée et au calme au milieu du lac !
(prévoir Aller / Retour en quelques minutes en barque jusqu'à la berge et un peu de logistique pour les courses)
Un endroit idéal pour visiter Berlin et se reposer le soir !
Nous vous recommandons vivement cette location :-)

Mit meiner Frau verbrachte ich zwei Nächte in der Wohnung. Sie ist außerordentlich schön gelegen, in einer sehr ruhigen Gegend mit viel Grün. Perfekt für Uni-Besucher, zur FU sind es weniger als 5 Minuten zu Fuß.
Leider entsprach die Ausstattung nicht den Erwartungen und meines Erachtens auch nicht dem verlangten Preis. Wir bezahlten für die beiden Nächte zu zweit insgesamt 205 Euro. Im nahegelegenen Seminaris CampusHotel hätten uns die 2 Nächte inklusive Frühstück 220 Euro gekostet. Leider hatten wir uns dagegen und für diese Wohnung entschieden.
Das Zimmer ist vollgestellt mit Möbeln, davon gibt das Hauptfoto einen falschen Eindruck. Das Doppelbett steht in einer Ecke direkt an der Wand, an seiner dritten Seite steht ein Sofa, so dass die zweite Person keinen eigenen Zugang zum Bett hat, sondern über den Partner hinwegsteigen muss.
Das Bad ist sehr klein, man kann sich darin kaum bewegen. Neben einer Waschmaschine steht ein billiges Regal. Der WC-Sitz ist abgenutzt und beschädigt, die Ablage unter dem Spiegel hat zwei dünne Risse, der darüber befindlichen Lampe fehlt die Abdeckung, so dass die bloße Birne zu sehen ist.
Die Küchenzeile ist abgenutzt und klapprig, die beiden Herdplatten zeigen Rost.
Im Treppenhaus liegt ein alter Teppichboden, der im ganzen Haus einen unangenehm muffigen Geruch verbreitet.
Als billige Studentenbude mag diese Einzimmerwohnung genügen. Unseren Ansprüchen an eine nette Unterkunft dagegen nicht, vor allem nicht bei diesem Preis.
Schöne Wohnung, gute Lage, unkomplizierter Kontakt. Ruhiger Hinterhof. Gerne wieder. Danke.

Francesco y su familia han sido muy amables, siempre pendientes de que no nos faltase nada.
Apartamento situado a 10 min del centro de Berlín en metro. Barrio muy tranquilo y con todos los servicios.
Apartamento ideal para pasar unos días en Berlín, recomendable.

The place was clean and organized. Duc, was responsive and provided on time instructions for check in and getting to the apartment.
The location was perfect for what I needed, 10 minutes walk to the nearest train station, and walkable distances to some of the nicest and busiest streets and bars.
Highly recommend it.

Fue muy agradable, espacioso y nos hicieron sentir cómodos en todo momento. La habitacion estaba cuidada y limpia, y el baño era muy grande. No nos faltó nada.
Está un poco lejos del centro, pero realmente no es un gran problema porque esta cercano al transporte público.

The house was impeccable in terms of cleanliness, extremely spacious and equipped with everything you need during the time you spend there. The host was very receptive to let us make a change related to the check-in and check-out time.
I recommend this accommodation! ⭐️⭐️⭐️

Großartige Wohnung. Einzige Kritikpunkte: das WLAN war langsam. Der tägliche Zugang über das Treppenhaus (5 Etagen kein Aufzug) ist kreislauffördernd.
Ansonsten eine fantastische Wohnung mit allem, was man braucht. Sauber, durchdacht in großartiger Lage mit sehr guter Ausstattung.

Top Unterkunft!
Die Wohnung punktet in jeder Hinsicht.
Die Lage ist unschlagbar, alles lässt sich problemlos von hier erreichen. Zusätzlich befinden sich viele Lebensmittel- und Bekleidungsgeschäfte in unmittelbarer Nähe.
Auf Sauberkeit und Ordnung wird hier sehr viel Wert gelegt, was besonders positiv aufgefallen ist.
Die umfangreiche Ausstattung hat mich am meisten begeistert! Hier ist wirklich alles vorhanden. Neben der vollausgestatteten Küche, der Waschmaschine mit integriertem Trockner gibt es z.B. auch Schuhcreme und neuverpackte Bodylotion. Somit ist die Unterkunft auch für längere Aufenthalte besonders gut geeignet.

sehr nett
sauber
empfehlen
Super Unterkunft mit guten Anbindungen an Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel
got what I wanted 😉

Die Lage ist sehr zentral und belebt, das Apartment sauber.
Leider ist das dritte Bett ein Klappbett. Das war aus der Anzeige nicht so direkt ersichtlich und etwas schade.
Bei Problemen war aber jemand zu erreichen und es wurde noch abends gelöst.
Alles in allem gut für einen Städtetrip.
Very peaceful and beautiful spot. No problem parking at Spandau station and then easy trip into Berlin. Perfect for a short stay.
very good place, we enjoyed it very much.
Nice clean appartment, great location.

Adoramos a estadia, Yvonne deixou várias informações sobre transporte, onde visitar e restaurantes! O espaço é fiel ao anunciado, ótima localização. Quarto muito bem decorado e uma ducha excelente! Com certeza voltaríamos a nos hospedar novamente.
Inderdaad mini-huisje op mooie locatie aan het water, ideaal bij mooi weer.
Kleines, sauberes Zimmer mit Küchenzeile. Sind sehr zufrieden und können es weiterempfehlen.
Terrific place, will definitely want to go there again.

Ambra is a very kind person. She rents out a room and the bathroom in her private appartment on 1st floor, the room is very comfortable , can be warmed up with 2 radiators, it's clean and tidy. The location is great, there are restaurants around , parking is also not an issue and the tram is in 2min walking distance and in 20min you can be at Alexanderplatz.

My friend and I had a great time staying at Jo's airbnb! He was quick with responses & easily accessible. Which was helpful when our plans got complicated.  He was also very helpful with tips about how to get around. He was very accomadating & we appreciate it! We would stay again at Jo's airbnb.:)

io e due mie amiche abbiamo soggiornato nell air bnb di david, per 5 notti. appena arrivate david ci ha accolto e ci ha spiegato nel dettaglio tutto quanto, ci ha anche consigliato dei posticini dove mangiare vicino a casa, lui davvero una persona gentile ed educata, e sempre super disponibile!
la casa, che dire, piccolina ma molto molto accogliente, super attrezzata e devo dire che abbiamo lasciato un pezzo di cuore oltre che a berlino anche nella casetta!
grazie mille ancora!!! se farò un altro viaggio a berlino cercherò di venire ad alloggiare da voi!!

Eric and Claudia were fantastic hosts. They were welcoming and flexible with the check-in, offering us drinks and a chat when we arrived with lots of recommendations for what to do during our stay. The room and the rest of the house were in excellent condition. The bed was very comfortable and the high tech design in the kitchen and bathrooms was fun to use. We enjoyed returning to the quiet and calm of the flat and the green streets of Friedenau after excursions into more hectic parts of the city.
When we crossed paths in the flat, we had some great chats about art. Otherwise we felt comfortable using the kitchen and other facilities while Eric and Claudia were out.
We would definitely recommend staying with Eric and Claudia for a holiday in the city or as a tranquil base for work.
Sehr zu empfehlen, hat wirklich alles super gepasst!😊
Alessio, fue muy amable y flexible con el check in. La casa es como en las fotos, apartamento bien comunicado con medios de transporte público. Muchas gracias Alessio

My stay here was great. The apartment is clean, spacious and comfortable. It is very quiet, despite being located in the middle of lively Neukölln. The neighbourhood can easily be explored on foot, for everything else there is an U-Bahn station around the corner and I highly recommend renting Anna's bike. Communication and check-in was very easy and Anna was happy to share some tips and recommendations with me when I arrived.

We had a great stay at Flo’s accomodation. The apartment is located directly on the street, is accessible via à keypad and is very well suited for city trips to Berlin. The accomodation is ideally located in one of the best neighborhoods in the city

Francesco is a terrific host, he is very friendly and responsive. He has set the space up so that it can fulfill all your needs, from just a one night stay to as long as a week or so. The studio was spacious and equipped with a kitchenette such that we were able to cook a few times without any trouble. The comfortable bed was also a highlight!
Thank you Francesco :)
Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt, gute Lage auch mit Hund.
Excelente ubicación y buena comunicación.

The flat was very nice, full of light, good size, absolutely spotless and as a bonus Alan and Kasia left a lot of info on Berlin and a personal guide plus two bottles of beer as a gift! Bed and sofa very comfortable. Nice kitchen. The flat is just out of the “nice” part of Prenzlauer Berg but there is an S Bahn one minute from the house so all good. Would definitely recommend.
Lovely stay in Berlin, the area has plenty of nice restaurants and bars and provided easy access to city centre. It was a large space and clean, perfect stay!
This really is a peaceful place to stay. I also enjoyed walking in the nearby forest. Very respectful hosts and great communication. Highly recommend.

Super Gastgeber und super Unterkunft!
Kann ich nur empfehlen!
Wonderful home in a beautiful neighborhood! Yvonne was cordial and very accommodating, such a great first time experience in Berlin thanks to there hospitality

Awesome stay! Great location and easy to walk everywhere.  Super clean room and bathroom!! Klaus is friendly and very helpful with information for anything you need to get around the city and many cultural areas of interest and fun!
The sociable host. I recommend him
Alexandras Wohnung ist klein aber fein. Wir hatten alles was wir für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in Berlin brauchten. Gerne wieder!
Nice location for daytrips in Berlin, everything you Need is there no more no less.

We spent 3 nights in this perfectly situated apartment. Carolina and Ramfiss answered all questions and were super helpful all the way. The place is in a great area of Berlin and with two teenage boys, we could walk to the cozy eating places or jump on the tram right outside the door to see more of the city.
The apartment had what we needed and on days with higher temperatures (we had 0-7 degrees 😉) we would have enjoyed the small garden as well.
L’appartamento di Nemala mi ha fatto passare dei giorni a Berlino stupendi, un luogo tranquillo dove rilassarsi tra un giro e l’altro e la zona comodissima
Elegant and clean apartments and very good location.
Alles super!

Die Unterkunft war wie beschrieben – sauber, gut ausgestattet und ideal für einen Kurzaufenthalt in Berlin. Die Lage ist top: Nur 3 Minuten zu Fuß zur U-Bahnstation Schlesisches Tor und etwa 15 Minuten bis zum Ostbahnhof. Das Viertel ist sehr lebendig mit vielen Cafés, Bars und Restaurants in der Nähe. Einziger Nachteil: Die Wohnung liegt im 5. Stock ohne Aufzug, was nach einem langen Tag in der Stadt etwas mühsam sein kann. Insgesamt aber eine empfehlenswerte Unterkunft für alle, die zentral und mitten im Berliner Leben wohnen möchten.
Anregende Wohnatmosphäre, freundlicher, der Musik zugetaner Gastgeber, ein gelungener Aufenthalt. Danke.
Miejsce było bardzo przyjemne. Dobry kontakt z gospodarzem, wszędzie blisko. Mieszkanie ładne i czyste. Polecam :)
Lovely apartment - beautiful space. Great neighbourhood. Public transport very accessible. All good - thank you Vanni!
Un raport calitate/pret foarte bun.

A perfect huge apartment for our family, it has everything you need plus board games the kids enjoyed. Location is great too - just a few stops on the tram from Alexander Platz  and easy enough to access all main attractions within 30 mins. We did have a problem with the check in so it’s the only reason I gave it 4 stars. Lexi though was immediately on the case and we got into the apartment an hour later. Still would recommend.

Great quiet clean apartment in the heart of the Checkpoint Charlie area. Good transport links or easy to walk to main sites. High quality apartment block..lovely green outlook.All you need for a short stay. Would stay again.
Thanks Marija 😊
Amazing design and beautiful apartment. We love it. Linda is a great host. We have enjoy Berlin in your lovely apartment. Thank you for all! Dylan and lucy
Svært velutstyrt kjøkken og faktisk større leilighet enn vist på bildene. Utrolig sentral plassering.

Die Lage war sehr gut aber auch sehr laut. An dem warmen Tagen war es sehr heiss im Apartment und wegen des Lärms war es nicht möglich die Fenster zu öffnen nachts. Eher lieblos eingerichtet aber funktional.

Bellissimo appartamento, perfettamente adatto per quattro persone. Consente di vivere il soggiorno a Berlino come se fossimo a casa nostra. Oltre ad ospitarci per la notte, l'alloggio ci ha permesso di rilassarci. La posizione è molto comoda, e facilmente raggiungibile con i mezzi pubblici.

Perfekter Aufenthalt – absolut empfehlenswert!
Ich hatte eine wunderbare Zeit in diesem Airbnb! Das Zimmer war genau wie beschrieben – sauber, gemütlich und geschmackvoll eingerichtet in einer tollen Lage: ruhig, aber dennoch nah an allen wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten und öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln.
Die Gastgeberin war super freundlich, immer erreichbar und hatte tolle Tipps für die Umgebung. Die Kommunikation war unkompliziert, und der Check-in verlief reibungslos. Ich habe mich rundum wohlgefühlt und würde jederzeit wiederkommen. Vielen Dank für die tolle Gastfreundschaft!
Loved this place. Attention is excellent and location is great!
Amazing stay! Great hosts
War eine super Erfahrung, sehr gern wieder.
Mein Bruder und ich wurden sehr freundlich empfangen. Das Apartment war super ausgestattet und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Wir fühlten uns sehr wohl.
Very nice and spacious apartment in a lovely area. Everything at hand, great for families, also with small children.
kleines, zweckmäßiges Appartment. sehr gut für 2 Personen. Fahrtzeit zum Alex und nach Mitte sowie Prenzlauer Berg per Tram ca 10 bis 20 Minuten

We really enjoyed our stay, the flat was perfect for us and the area is lovely. We were a three generation family having a holiday together and there was plenty for everyone to do within easy access of the flat despite the public transport strikes. Marcus shared some helpful recommendations and was very responsive. Thanks!

Hatten einen tollen 5-tägigen Aufenthalt in der Unterkunft.
Check-In sowie Check-Out haben mit den zuvor zugesandten Informationen reibungslos funktioniert.
Die Wohnung war blitzblank und sehr ansprechend eingerichtet, das es sich, wie in der Beschreibung erwähnt, für einen Monat dort gut aushalten lassen würde.
In der Küche war eine gute Grundausstattung fürs Kochen vorhanden.
Das Bad schließt sich den Wohnräumen in Sauberkeit an.
Das Bett war von den Matratzen her sehr angenehm, außer man schläft in der Regel auf harten Matratzen. Aber selbst in dem Fall hat man die Möglichkeit der Schlafcouch, die für solche Fälle optimal ist.
Great spot, huge room and close to all the action. Would stay again!

Jo and Fran’s place is exactly the same as the pics here! Very central located and a nice few mins walk to the U bahn station! The neighbourhood is posh, peaceful and clean, it gives you a huge sense of security even walking alone in dark! Jo and Fran they are both very welcoming, helpful and quick in response! Would definitely repeat and highly recommended!!

Alleen maar positieve woorden voor Susanne en haar studio! Alles was spik en span, en bovendien super gezellig. Je ziet dat er veel tijd en emotie in de studio is gestoken. Kortom; geweldig! Ik keer sowieso terug!
Good location, quiet area and safe location, I wish they had an iron in room but everything else was perfect!
Excellent location, lots of shops, restaurants and playgrounds around with amazing transport connections. My kids and I loved it

Prima ruimte zoals op de foto weergegeven. Een goede douche in een schone ruimte en ook de bedden waren prima. De locatie is in een prima buurt met diverse winkels om de hoek (inclusief metro). Enige punt was dat de advertentie beschreef dat er gratis parkeervoorziening voor de deur was dit was niet het geval meer dit is na wat berichten prima tegemoet gekomen. De reactie op vragen ed is ook erg snel.

Tolle Unterkunft mit viel Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet.
Manchmal und in diesem Fall ist wenig auch mehr.
Alles war da und unser Brunch zu meinem Geburtstag
war klasse.
Andreea&Stefan sind sehr liebe Menschen, die auch Ihre positive Lebenseinstellung weitergeben.
So wie wir auch...
Also buchen!!!

We loved Jessy's beautiful apartment. It is in a really convenient location in the very heart of Berlin with numerous, restaurants, cafes bars and shops right on the doorstep.
The apartment is very clean and decorated to a high standard with all the amenities required for a comfortable stay for our family of 4 adults.
Jessy was the perfect host, on our arrival Jessyshowed us around the apartment and then gave us a comprehensive guide to where we were situated in relation to all the main tourist spots of Berlin and also where the best restaurants, bars and shops within walking distance could be found.
We are giving both Jessy and the apartment a five star review and would highly recommend this apartment to family and friends.
Toller und sehr netter Gastgeber, sehr gute Matratze,sauber, direkt am S und Bahnhof Charlottenburg und ganz nah an vielen Bars und Restaurants am Stuttgarter Platz. Ich komme gerne wieder!

Nena apartments was a great and easy stay. The tool looked exactly as in the photos and everything was neat and tidy. The host responded quickly and accommodated a second bed for the room. Would stay again.
The apartment was very spacious, extremely clean and had some nice added touches.  It's also located in a great neighborhood with many things to do within walking distance.  Highly recommend!

Audrey was a great host, she accomated me despite my late arrival. Everything fitted her airbnb description.
Appartment is really well located close by plenty transportation.

L appartement de Berta est propre et clair. il dispose de 3 chambres un grand salon une salle de bains avec toilettes et une cuisine. Berta loue 2 chambres et en occupe une.
elle vous remet a votre arrivee un guide du quartier et de berlin.
L internet fonctionne bien. L appartement est a environ 30 mn du centre en transport .
j avais une chambre avec balcon.
Andres has great resources for getting acquainted with the city and has a beautiful clean place
Great location and value!

Meine Eltern haben hier über das Championsleague-Finale geschlafen. Es war wirklich alles top. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und sehr sehr ordentlich und sauber. Es gibt wirklich nichts auszusetzen. Vielen Dank für die tollen Tage.
Great flat perfectly located. Recommended!

Klaus es una persona extraordinariamente amable y simpática, y con una gran cultura, se puede hablar con él de cualquier cosa.
La única pena es mi bajo nivel de inglés que dificultaba mucho la comunicación, aún así hemos tenido largas y ricas conversaciones.
De sus recomendaciones a destacar la de la última tarde, Viktoria Park, muy cerca de su casa y al que se llega por un paseo bonito y con mucha zona verde.
Ni conocía la existencia de ese parque y sin su recomendación me hubiera pasado desapercibido.
The location is amazing. It may not be the cleanest and tidiest apartment you will ever see but honestly its much better than described. Overall it was a great stay.

This was the perfect place to stay for a Berlin break! Close to public transport, a 30min into the city if we wanted and in a beautiful location.
The flat itself had absolutely everything we needed and had such a cool, stylish interior decor.
Katrin and Adam were so responsive to all messages and were so incredibly kind to let us check in a bit earlier because of our early flight.
Ross and I are already planning when to come back to Berlin and we know that we’ll be booking with Katrin again!
Great apartment at a good and easy location for exploring Berlin

Es ist eine sehr schöne Wohnung in toller Lage. Viele Sehenswürdigkeiten sind zu Fuß erreichbar. Es gibt jede Menge Restaurant in der Nähe und einen guten Bäcker für die Frühstücksbrötchen gleich an der Ecke. Auch ein Supermarkt und eine Drogerie sind um die Ecke.
Die Wohnung liegt allerdings im 3. Stock ohne Lift!! Es gibt nur einen Schlüssel für die Wohnung. Wir waren zu dritt und da ist das manchmal schon ein Problem. Das Bett auf der Galerie ist zwar groß aber man kann auf der Galerie nicht aufrecht stehen.
Ein paar Dinge könnten erneuert werden aber im Großen und Ganzen wirklich schön mit der kleinen Dachterrasse.
Wir können die Wohnung in jedem Fall weiter empfehlen.
Excellent location, with everything we needed for a great stay.

Buena zona, tienes el tram cerca como a 5 min y hay varios restaurantes y kiosk por la zona. Un poquito caro para la habitación tan pequeña pero si vas por un finde está bien. El baño es espacioso. Recomiendo descargarse la app es más fácil para abrir las puertas.
Nice apartment, good location.
Great place and location in the cosy Prenzlauerberg. A lot of nice restaurants and cafes in the area

Daniel's appartment is perfect in every way, lots of light for breakfast, nice sunsets, a great balcony, quiet inner courtyard, top level with an elevator that makes it easily accessible. Modern yet convenient design as a whole. The Queen size bed was very comfortable and the electric shades ensured that we could sleep in. Internet was great. The area is bustling with young families, various restaurants and cool and artsy shops.
Public transportation is within walking distance to various lines, M, S and U-bahn, and makes visiting Berlin really easy. A grocery store is a few minutes away and a nice pastry shop is just next door. Contact with Daniel was very easy and most pleasant from beginning to end. We would totally recommend Daniel's place and would definitely come back.
Nice and clean place for a mini trip in Berlin. Mike was very helpful and discreet which was much appreciated.
L’appartamento è molto piccolo ma super accogliente, ideale anche per coppia per qualche giorno. Super silenzioso, posizione fantastica! check in eseguito in autonomia

Very clean and comfortable apartment in the center, close to the major attractions and subway. Communication with Stefanie was very easy, all instructions were promptly sent, no problems checking in. Would stay again.

We stayed in Berlin for 5 days with our two boys at 10 and 7. The flat is perfect for a family. Its nice and spacious and there is all you need for a good stay. Tom even provided us with internet so we could be online while we where on holiday. There is a little playground on the opposite side of the street, which was a treat for our boys. Tom and Arzu was very helpful with information and ideas of what to see and where to eat. Flat is close to both bus and U-Bahn. We can only recommend this flat and the helpful hosts

David ist ein sehr freundlicher Gastgeber, die Wohnung ist wie auf denn Fotos beschrieben sehr schön, das Bad ist auch toll! Die Wohneinheit liegt separat im Innenhof und die Lage ist gut, in der nahen Umgebung gibt es alles, was man braucht!

Das Hotel liegt in einem Hinterhof zu erreichen über eine etwas in die Jahre gekommene Zugangstür. Im Hotel wird man jedoch überrascht über die nette Gestaltung und den erhofften Berliner Charm. Die Zimmer sind einfach aber groß und nett eingerichtet. Das Bad war sehr sauber und funktionell. Auch das Frühstück war sehr gut. Die Nähe zum Alexanderplatz machte den Aufenthalt zu einem gelungenen Stadtaufenthalt.
The apartment is clean, in a great area and the host is very helpful . Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Berlin!

It’s exactly what they’re selling - very flexible stay you can tailor to your liking. The rooms are cute, uncluttered and have interesting features. My favorite had to be the different light switches for different moods, it really changes the energy of the room immediately. Alles war so wie beschrieben. Wenn man mit der Nähe zum Gastgeber wenig Probleme hat und die Gegend Berlins besonders interessant findet, ist man am richtigen Ort.

Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt in Marians Wohnung genossen. Innerhalb von 15-20 Minuten erreicht man eine Vielzahl an schönen Bars und Restaurants, die einen Besuch absolut wert sind. 100% recommend.

Tolle Möglichkeit in Berlin zu verweilen in einer ruhigen Umgebung und trotzdem nichts von Berlin zu verpassen. Die Haltestelle ist sehr nah und man ist sehr schnell in der Stadt. Ausstattung ließ nicht zu wünschen übrig und Kommunikation war super! Leider kam es wegen unseren kurzen Aufenthalts nicht dazu Caren persönlich kennenzulernen aber wir waren rundum zufrieden.
很好的房子 房东人也很好

Till is a great host! I had a little trouble during check in and he responded almost immediately even though it was pretty late. I loved the home and the area is perfect - close to 2 train stations and many good restaurants nearby. Highly recommend!

Malte it is an excellent host. Very helpful and responsive. The flat is a proper three bedroom, with very comfortable beds, and one and a half nice bathrooms. Clean and contemporary. The neighborhood is gritty and noisy, but it has excellent and plentiful casual restaurants and grocery stores. It's very lively! We had two cons: the photos are taken with a wide angle lens, so it's not quite as spacious as it looks. There is not good airflow and most Berlin apartments do not have air-conditioning. The front window is fogged and does not open. We did not get enough natural light. You can open the front door but it opens right onto the street like a shop door and that is awkward, as you can imagine. So I felt claustrophobic and hot. Especially because we were often working there during the day and we stayed for 12 days. So those last two factors were hard for us. If you're there for a short stay, and you'll be out a lot, it could be perfect.
Tolles Host, sehr gute Lage. Parkplätze zu finden. Dankeschön
Super Kommunikation und es gab sogar ein kleines Frühstück.

This place is a steal for what you get! Huge space, huge bed, huge coach. Listing and bathroom are spotless. Bus stop for bus M41 is 2 min walk away from the house. The bus comes frequently, about every 8 mins. Train station is about a 8 min walk from the listing.
While I didn't get a chance to meet Franz, I did meet his mom. While his mom only speaks German, she is a super lovely woman.
If you are on a budget, or don't want to spend a crazy amount on accommodations, you can't beat this place.
Smidig och flexibel in och utcheckning!
Tolle Lage und ein schönes Zimmer für ein paar Tage in Berlin! Wir werden gerne wieder kommen :)
Very enjoyable stay and nice host Janine did a wonderful job. out of the way of the city hustle but still close by for accessibility.
Andreas is a very kind person, he helped us and gave us recommendations for everything.  We enjoyed verling a lot and the place is in a nice place with many ways to get the centre. THANKS A LOT
Great host and fine place
Everything good!
L'appartement d'Alan et Kasia est conforme aux photographies. Agréable, bien situé, à 5 minutes des transports et d'un centre commercial. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour.  Nous le recommandons.
Its a very nice place to be. Its cosy and clean.  Alan and Kasia are nice people. The S-bahn in the neighbourhood  is very noisy.  There is a very sunny garden.
Had a lovely time staying here. Checking in was really smooth. Highly recommended.

Der Aufenthalt bei Garrelt war super und die Kommunikation in Vorfeld war schnell, freundlich und zuvorkommend. Das Zimmer ist liebevoll eingerichtet und ich kann es uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen. Ich komme auf jeden Fall wieder.
Tolle Lage! Sehr gut geeignet für ein paar Tage Cityurlaub!
Sehr zentraler Aufenthalt mit einem modernen Zimmer. Die Kommunikation war ebenfalls super!
Very friendly and responsive host, very uncomplicated and easy going. I arrived very late for check-in and the host waited for me. Great rooms.

Anna's place was perfect for us. It is very spacious and beautifully decorated. Good air conditioning and excellent hot water. Quiet. The kitchen is well-stocked for making basic meals.
The area is upscale and clean. The apartment is walking distance to many restaurants, cafes, and public transit.
Anna communicated clearly and promptly. Check-in and check-out were efficient. We had to cut our stay short due to a family emergency, and Anna handled the situation gracefully.
I highly recommend this apartment and would absolutely book it again in the future.
Alles super, vielen Dank! Gerne wieder.

Michael ist ein super Gastgeber!
Vielen Dank dafür, dass es kurzfristig geklappt hat. LG
Perfect place to visit Berlin! We had everything we needed to have a great time: Clean bathroom, well equiped kitchen and a cosy bedroom. Vielen dank! 😊
It was a great apartment with everything, what you need. Sandra answer always immediately. Public transport is so good and there are a lot of supermarkets nearby.

What a dream! A lovely and spacious open plan appartment, complete with a ping-pong table and trampoline! It's beautifully designed and our hosts were so accomodating with arrival/check out times. Couldn't have been more perfect. Would 100% recommend. Thank you for the best weekend. We will be back!
idéalement placé, pratique, très propre, pas cher.
Zie eerdere tekst
Heel fijn mooi appartement met supermarkt, metro en restaurants in de buurt!

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung liegt verkehrsgünstig in der Nähe der U-Bahn. Alle Sehenswürdigkeiten sind gut erreichbar. Direkt um die Ecke ist ein Lidl. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und zweckmäßig eingerichtet. Das Bett war bequem. Die Schlüsselübergabe war problemlos und freundlich.

Wir hatten einen wunderschönen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Das Appartement im 21. Stock hat einen atemberaubenden Ausblick. Die Wohnung ist hell, freundlich und sauber, allerdings ist das Haus und die Einrichtung schon sehr in die Jahre gekommen. Die Betten waren für unsere Rücken definitiv zu weich. Aber die Küche und die beiden Badezimmer bieten alles was man braucht. Die Lage der Wohnung ist unschlagbar; somit ist das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis völlig in Ordnung!
Alles war gut !
Ideal für 2 Personen (+1) und Städtetrip.
Muy bien ubicada, a pocas cuadras del metro. La casa estaba muy bien equipada. Muchas gracias por todo ❤️

Es wurde trotzdem wir die Reise vorher wegen Corona-Risikogebiet storniert haben kein Cent von Gastgeber erstattet. Das ist unverschämt und ich würde diesen Gastgeber nicht unterstützen und auf keinen Fall empfehlen.
Ein wunderschönes Haus mit sehr netten Gastgebern!

Die Wohnung ist super gelegen. Zentral in Schöneberg nur ein paar Gehminuten zur Akazienstr mit vielen tollen Cafes und Restaurants. Ein paar Minuten zu Fuss zur SBahn und man kommt überall hin.
Die Wohnung ist gross. Ideal auch für Familien. Ebenerdiger Zugang - keine Altbautteppen;-)
Sauber und ausgestattet wie beschrieben. Wir würden immer wiederkommen.

Fantastic apartment, much larger than the photos indicate. Very clean and spacious. Balcony definately a big plus. Easily accessible from almost everywhere and lots of cool restaurants/bars/breakfast places round the corner. Hadrian was an amazing host, very accomodating, flexible and easy to reach. He had lots of good tips to the area. We followed most and were not disappointed. Will for sure stay at Hadrian's next time we come to Berlin.
Habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt. Es gab insgesamt 3 Zimmer die waren auch belegt. Trotzdem gute Atmosphäre. Preis /Leistung fand ich absolut ok
A great place!
Everything was nice and cool!
Yaz was a great host. And the apartment was tidy,cosy and close walking to good food and hospitality.

Sehr schönes Zimmer in sehr gemütlicher, individueller Altbauwohnung im Schillerkiez. Madeleine und Herbert waren nicht nur perfekte Gastgebende und immer vor Ort zu erreichen, sondern auch ausgesprochen interessante Gesprächspartner*innen. Gerne wieder!
Great location and really kind host! Thanks!

I had an amazing stay at Numa Arc. The location is very convenient; the room was beautiful, clean, and quiet; the communication was very clear; great services such as free lockers. It feels like a great hotel and I would definitely book this place again. Only thing is that they don’t clean your room during your stay such as in a hotel - but that is clearly stated and was not a problem for me.
Excelente servicio, son muy amables y de mantuvieron en comunicación en todo momento, lo recomiendo

Frank is kind and considerate. However, this unit was not for me. It is a SHARED bathroom with at least 6 other guests, I never would have booked it had I known. The listing said "Dedicated". Frank discounted my fee, which was kind of him. There are definitely multiple markets and restaurants near by. I had to walk 10-15 minutes to get the subway or tram I needed. I didn't ride any buses so I can't speak to how close or far. It was a 20-25 euro taxi ride to Berlin central train station.
They did have someone come in every day to clean. My unit #7 was right next to the sidewalk and road. Only quiet time was midnight to 5 am.
Nice, clean, albeit tiny apartment. Great for a "home base" while you spend most of your time exploring.
Alles tipptopp- jederzeit wieder!
Hatten einen sehr angenehmen und entspannten Aufenthalt
Stylish appartement, quick response from hosts, quiet and lovely place to stay.
Perfect place for a Berlin getaway! Highly recommend!!! Easy to talk to and responsive to any questions we had, lovely view and comfy beds!

Everything was absolutely fine. The flat was very clean and the room was spacious. Also only a few steps from the tram and a few minutes from the metro station! Would defintely stay again at this place!
Fijn verblijf, voldeed aan de verwachtingen! Vriendelijke eigenaar

We had an absolutely perfect stay at Marc’s apartment! It was the ideal spot for me and my girlfriend—spacious, spotless, and incredibly comfortable. The shower was fantastic, and the apartment had everything we needed for a relaxed visit.
Kreuzberg itself is incredible—we spent hours exploring the neighborhood’s cafés, restaurants, and lively streets, and loved coming back to such a welcoming space each evening.
Marc was a wonderful host, taking the time to greet us personally and give us a thorough tour when we arrived. His warm welcome made us feel right at home from the start.
We couldn’t have asked for a better stay and would happily book again on our next trip to Berlin. Highly recommend!
The space was great for travel.

Mieszkanie bardzo fajne. z ciekawym rozmieszczeniem poszczególnych pokoi. Było wyjątkowo fascynujące dla naszych dzieci. Apartament całkiem przestronny, a byliśmy w nim w 8 osób - 4 osoby dorosłe i 4 dzieci. Wszystkie sprzęty w apartamencie działające. Dobrze wyposażone. Fajnie, że bardzo blisko od dworca głównego- ok 10 min autobusem i 10 min spacerem. W pobliżu apartamentu bardzo duży i fajny park.  Miejsce śmiało polecam. Gospodarz kontaktowy nie było najmniejszych problemów.
quartier calme, un peu plus animé en soirée. beaucoup de restaurant aux alentours! proche de beaucoup de monument (facilement accessible en u-bahn ou s-bahn)!

The apartment is really nice for the price!
Modern, new interiour with a nice old-house flair although a little minimalistic (which I personally really like).
Especially the room and bathroom were spotless and exceptionally clean.
The whole apartment is shared and seems to be rented to other parties as well. Rio is also living there.
There is only one small thing that bothered me a little: I could hear another person talking on the phone for an hour or so until 23 o'clock. Since it is an older flat with a small wall in between rooms, I could have eavesdropped (I did not :D )
But I am overly sensitive regarding sounds - and apart from that longer phone call, the flat was really nice and I got good sleep for the two days I stayed there.
Overall: the apartment is located in a lively neighbourhood with lots to see but really quiet and private overall! Recommended
Schönes Appartement! Tolle Betreuung !!
Danke für den unkomplizierten Aufenthalt!

Beautiful apartment , the pictures do not do it justice. Comfortable beds in all the bedrooms. Clear instructions on how to check in and check out. Close to the metro station. Great location with plenty of restaurants, bakeries and bars close by. There’s a lidl 5mins away from the apartment.

We were two couples and we had an excellent stay. The location was very good for us. The apartment is unique and had everything we needed. We had a nice welcome gift and the hosts were very nice and gave good advice. Thank you!
Very clean and comfortable, nice neighborhood. And it was always very easy to get in contact with Alexander.
Nice place, nice man.
lovely apartment with lots of graffiti books and posters. but you need to ask before if the shown bedroom is included.

Wir waren eine Woche lang in Davids Wohnung und haben uns sehr wohl dort gefühlt. Gute Kommunikation, schöne Wohnung, gut eingerichtete Küche, ruhig und dennoch ist man schnell bei der U- und S-Bahn. Gute Ausgangsposition, um den Mauerpark und den Prenzlauer Berg zu erleben.
Wir kommen gewiss wieder.
très bien situé, très confortable,  super accueil

Great place to stay if you’re doing solo travel (which I was). Looks exactly like the photo! Only note is that this is a staircase building so wouldn’t be good for those who need an elevator. Great location as well— a bit further from the city but easily walkable !
the place is clean and comfortable
ホストのJoseさんは丁寧な方で、チェックインからチェックアウトまで完璧なサポートをしてくださいました。また、私が滞在期間に起こしてしまったトラブルに関しても、大変親切に対応してくださいました。再度ベルリンを訪れる機会があれば、必ずまたこちらに滞在したいと思います。ありがとうございました！
Uns hat es sehr gut in der Wohnung gefallen. Sehr hochwertige Ausstattung. Sie war sehr sauber und wie beschrieben. Würden jederzeit wieder kommen.

Numa Drift is very close to the station.... so close you hear trains all day and night.
The room was clean, linen was clean and there was additional linen available from a shared laundry. However the only washing machine was broken during our entire stay.
In addition to Airbnb verification, we also had to provide photo uploads of ID directly to the hotel chain.
Only one of our windows opened and only a small amount. The room felt airless, however the aircon was a welcome relief.
We had an issue with the noisy bathroom fan not turning off and it was going to take over 36 hours for them to fix it.
We also had a fire alarm at 3:30am, which is apparently fairly common (according to other guests who had already had a few during their stay).
The online staff were responsive and friendly during our chat interactions, but I guess there is not much they could do about much of the above.
Our stay here wasn't terrible, but we would not stay here again.

Good place.
So clean!!
Not too far from city town.

Barbara und Alessandro have a nice little Bistro with organic vegetarian food (It´s delicious!) and marvellous coffee. The room is clean, cosy, and equipped with nice vintage furniture and with a private bathroom. Barbara made a list of places you should spend a visit when you are in Berlin and she also helped me out with questions about the public transport. I had a realy good time staying at their place in Berlin and i will definitely stay here again.
Schöne kleine Wohnung mit super Lage! Liebevoll eingerichtet, super ausgestattet und sauber. Alles in allem perfekt, ich komme gerne wieder!

This air bnb was amazing. The host, Marko, was easy to reach and was very polite and hospitable. The room itself was very nice, it had everything we could have hoped for and needed. Great sized room with the two of us, and the bathroom (which included a washer & hang dryer) was a great fit. Bigger in person than in pictures! Also in a perfect location of Berlin, even with a yummy pizza place a few doors down! 10/10, definitely would recommend staying while on your next Berlin trip!
Alles bestens! Einziges Manko ist das Gemeinschaftsbad, aber damit kann man leben.

This is a shared apartment where a varying number of the rooms are rented out to airbnb guests. I felt welcomed by the hosts who were all very kind and friendly. Mike's room is spacious and cozy, with a work desk, sofas, and lots of decorations. The location is very central in Prenzlauer Berg, at one of the big streets with a tram line. Since the room has windows facing the street, there is constant street noise throughout the day and night. Because of the noise and the curtains that don't really block light, I would not recommend this place for a light sleeper. It may also be useful to know that people smoke inside the flat. Apart from sleeping trouble, I enjoyed my stay and appreciated the kind and helpful hosts.
Really good hotel - it was just a bit warm :)
Ich habe mich sehr Wohlgefühl! Die Ruhe und der Blick auf den schönen Garten haben mich erfreut ! Komme gerne wieder .

Our stay at Benjamin's place was lovely! The flat was super clean and very pretty. We really enjoyed it! Also Benjamin sent us a list with restaurants around what was super helpful and very kind. One breakfast place in particular was amazing!
Grocery-stores are very close by and a nice park, as well as the stations, very central but nevertheless calm for the big city!
All in all a great stay!
We recommend to bring earplugs for the night/mornings because the house has very thin walls and it's not always quiet with many children in the house - lively!
We would definitely come again for the next Berlin stay!
It was perfect, wish i could have stayed longer ! Avi is a great host. Reactive, flexible and also a talented decorator 😇

If you love modern architecture, you will love Matthew’s place. It is concrete and glass with high ceilings, and carefully chosen clutter-free pieces to add natural texture.
Absolutely pristine, sunny and quiet. Comfortable bed with luxurious professionally laundered and ironed sheets and down pillows.
We enjoyed and took frequent advantage of the gluten-free Café on the ground floor .
Very responsive host .
We would love to return .
We enjoyed our 2 night stay. The place is clean and comfortable, close to transportation. Katherine was a lovely, communicative host :)

Es war eine äußerst gut ausgestattete Unterkunft; besonders in der Küche war wirklich alles vorhanden, was man für seinen Aufenthalt benötigt. Besonders aber die schnelle, freundliche und unkomplizierte Kommunikation der Gastgeberin war positiv. Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und komme gerne wieder.
Thomas and Angelika were great hosts. This was the best BNB I have stayed in yet. Location was very good for all the Berlin hotspots. Will definitely be back!
Klein, aber fein. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

L’accès était super facile. Tellement pratique de ne pas avoir de clefs. L’espace plus grand que j’imaginais. Super propre et j’adore le quartier où est situé l’appartement. Une seule chose qui m’a un peu dérangé c’est le parfum que la personne qui fait le ménage a laissé. J’aurai préféré avoir le choix du parfum car je pense que certaines personnes vont aimer mais moi pas spécialement mais c’est la seule chose

Un appartement agréable, un quartier extra, très bien situé, idéal pour visiter Berlin.
Et des hôtes très à l'écoute.
Petit bémol : salle de bains WC un peu étroite.

Very close to public transport, probably in the best district of the city. Quiet neighborhood.
Caren is awesome, and her cats too!
Fabulous appartement!

Really enjoyed my stay and would go back. I love the simplistic modern design of the apartment. I was on vacation, but I could have easily imagined working remotely from there. The hosts were super nice and did everything they could to make my stay perfect. They let me check in early as I was getting to Berlin earlier than originally planned, and a bottle of Champagne waited for me in the apartment because it was New Year’s. What a warm, amazing touch! 🤩

Die Wohnung bietet eine super Lage und verfügt über das Nötigste. Preis- Leistungs- Verhältnis stimmt. Der Vermieter ist super nett & die Kommunikation lief super.
Alles in allem haben wir eine gute bis sehr gute Erfahrung gemacht!
Great place, very comfortable beds :)
Es war alles perfekt. Sehr gemütlich ☺️  Eine große Energie für sie und ihr Zimmer.

My husband and I spent a few weeks in Berlin and this was one of the airbnbs we stayed in. It was a lovely apartment - so clean, comfortable and had everything we needed. Having a washer and a dryer was a treat. And while it’s not in the photos, there is an actual desk for a dedicated workspace which was so helpful. If you’re looking for a place that’s got a real Berlin neighborhood-vibe with lots of restaurants and cafes right out of your door, I’d suggest a different location, but if you’re looking for a spot close to a lot of tourist sites and museums and on the U-Bahn it’s a great spot.

Loved our stay! Stephanie's husband greeted us on arrival and he was very welcoming and suggestive of places we visited whilst on our short stay. The apartment is beautiful, very light and airy.
In particular, the shower was amazing being so powerful! This apartment is definitely worth staying in, with lovely hosts & a very short travel distance from the airport and centre of the city, loved it!
Nice place to stay, in the city center, for low budget holidays.

Mario's apartment was beautiful, clean, spacious and comfortable. He could not have been nicer or more accommodating. Check-in was simple. He was waiting in the apartment when we arrived and gave us a gracious tour. The pictures really do not do the place justice. Great little kitchen with nice appliances, especially the coffee maker. There are a lot of restaurants and bars within easy walking distance. Transportation was easy with the U close by and the S and tram within walking distance across the river. The balcony is a real plus. We would definitely stay there again.
Die Unterkunft hatte alles was man braucht. Empfehle ich weiter!
Had a great stay at Sören’s place - was clean and in a quiet neighborhood!

Actually, we didn't stay at the place. Our booking was cancelled in the very last moment due to water draining. Things like that happen and you cannot plan to avoid them. However, the host was very kind to call me immediatelly. They offered another place where we can stay or full refund of our payment. I think they handled the situation very professionally. Luckily, we managed to find abother place.

Alles bestens, kommen gerne wieder.
Maja und Mark waren perfekte GastgeberInnen!

Bel appartement avec salon aménagé et cuisine équipée. Le lit est très confortable et le quartier est calme.
Excellent stay. Clear instructions from Carsten and great location
Perfect. Location, Bike, Area and Stefan very kind and Helpfully :)

Tolle Wohnung für einen Aufenthalt zu zweit! Tolle zentrale Lage, aber trotzdem ruhig, da im Hinterhof.

Jederzeit wieder und unbedingt zu empfehlen für Paare oder Freunde, die zu zweit ein paar Tage Berlin erleben wollen.

Fantastic 6 night stay at Charlotte's.
The apartment is extremely well appointed with all you could need for a much longer stay.
Location is excellent , lively and interesting neighborhood with the transit a 5 minute walk away from where you can be in the City Center in 15 minutes.
Finally, Charlotte herself is a great Host. Wonderfully responsive, friendly and helpful throughout.
Great experience all-round !
Alles wie beschrieben vorgefunden. Gut ausgestattete Küche.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet, mit Handtüchern, frisch bezogener Bettwäsche und sogar Shampoo und Duschgel. Marko hat uns gut in Empfang genommen und war sehr gastfreundlich und hat uns sogar Snacks und eine Tee- und Kaffekanne zur Verfügung gestellt. Insgesamt kann ich sagen, dass die Unterkunft meine Erwartungen übertroffen hat und ich kann sie weiterempfehlen.
It's a wonderful place, very comfortable, restful and quiet although it's located on a busy street. Recommended.

I had a wonderful stay at Thiago’s place – everything was perfect! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Thiago was a fantastic host, always friendly and helpful. A special thank you for sharing some delicious Brazilian cuisine with me – it made the stay even more memorable. I would definitely recommend staying here to anyone visiting, and I hope to come back again someday!

Это потрясающие апартаменты. Рядом с S-bahn, район спокойный, тихий и уютный. До центра ехать минут 10. Апартаменты очень уютные и стильные, 2 террасы, кофемашина. Хозяин очень гостеприимный, всегда был на связи, и при этом совсем не беспокоил. С удовольствием бы остановились в этом месте ещё раз.
Thanks to Mohammad for guidance and support.

Arne was absolutely fantastic! He was super nice and accomodating and  even invited us to come to an exclusive fashion show with him. Not to mention the sweetest cats in the world who made the stay so much better! The apartment is also very nice and centrally located within walking distance of lots of museums and landmarks. I would definitely stay here again next time I'm in Berlin.
Superbe Auberge de Jeunesse! Proche du S-Bahn et peu cher

Studio agréable bien situé et propre avec la possibilité de faire sa cuisine.
Pour résumer en dehors des deux petits problèmes mineurs que je liste ci dessous je recommande vivement cette location.
La capacité d'eau chaude est limitée il faudra attendre 15 minutes entre chaque personne.Éviter de faire un thé ou café avec le réchauffeur d'eau de la cuisine celui ci étant entartré: il en sort de nombreuses particules noires.
The apartment is well situated and is close to local supermarkets, cafes and restaurants. Ideal for a couple and centre of Berlin easily accessible by train.

Rainer's place is exactly as demonstrated in the photos. It's immaculately clean and tidy, and quite well located for both the airport and the city centre. our only slight change would have been if it could have been slightly closer to the centre but Rainer's instructions were great at helping us navigate. we really enjoyed our stay in Berlin and would definitely stay here again if we were to return.
Recomendable. Cuidado con estacionar en la calle. me pusieron multa por 20 euros

Unser Urlaub im gemütlichen Häuschen mit Garten war wunderschön – wir wurden herzlich von Ulla empfangen, und konnten bei tollem Wetter im See um die Ecke baden. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder, vielen Dank!

Anna and Sebatian offered me a wonderful experience over my 1.5 months stay. I was given a warm welcome right from the beginning acommpanied by the cheerful smile of their two children. The friendliness of the hosts was ceaseless and we several times ended having long late-night conversations about all sorts of fascinating topics. Highly recommend to anyone as I sure will be back at some point!

Wir hatten einen super Aufenthalt. Die Lage ist ein Traum. und die Spree ist ein toller Ort zum Kajak fahren. in der Küche ist alles vorhanden, lecker zu kochen.
Wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder :-)

Leo quien nos atendió en la barra muy amable y nos dio muchos tips para salir de fiesta.
La gente que se hospeda en el hostel muy amigable e internacional, jóvenes.
La ubicación del hostel es perfecta está cerca de todo.
Cómodo y seguro.

Friendly and helpful host. I stayed one night during a road trip across Europe.
