The apartment is on the 4th floor without a lift; so if you have heavy items it may be challenging; the host did offer help to carry things for me. The hosts (a young couple) live there in the other bedroom and are very quiet. The building is older and the insulation on the windows is not great; it is a street where the busses run, so I had to resort to earplugs. For me it was practical enough for the one night I stayed.
The room was tidy and it came with a private bathroom. More than anything, she was always available for travelers to give us a hand when in need. I would recommend this place for sure:)
Sehr sauber. Einfaches Einchecken. Sehr nette Kommunikation. Gerne wieder.
Martin s place was easy to find and check in. He was responsive and quite helpful. recommended a lot
I really felt welcome and we'll accomodated. Great place to stay, can really recommend to people who like a flexible check-in and privacy.
Everything was perfect
Good value for money, spacious and clean. Convenient to get to and from airport and town center.
Perfect location

Een aanrader! Het appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien, is zeer stijlvol ingericht en ligt in een zeer bruisende buurt met veel leuke horeca.
Verder kregen we ook uitgebreid informatie toegezonden en werd er tussentijds gevraagd of alles naar wens was. Top!

Lekker ruim appartement van heel veel gemakken voorzien. Hartje Kreuzberg,lnmet om de hoek de heerlijkste eettentjes, Viktoria park op loopafstand evenals 2 metrostations. De studio zit nét iets buiten de drukte, dus rustige nachten.
Sehr schön gestaltete, saubere Wohnung zum Wohlfühlen in zentraler Lage

If you are looking for a place near the central station in Mitte, don't hesitate!
He is very kind and helps make the trip comfortable.

Tolle Kommunikation mit Richard - unkompliziert, klar und sehr freundlich.
Direkte Nähe zu U-Bahn-Station. Ziemlich zentral in Berlin, die Wohnung war super ruhig und sehr sauber.
Sie hat Charme und viele schöne Einzelstücke.
Ich komme gerne wieder.

What I can say other than this place is perfect!! It had everything we needed for 3 nights in Berlin. It really felt like a home away from home due to the nice touches by Frank, we especially enjoyed the coffee machine and balcony. Amazing views to the TV tower from the balcony which gets sun throughout the day. Bathroom is lovely and bed very comfy. Kitchen has everything you need. Two supermarkets, one of them vegan, are a 5 minute walk and there is a lovely coffee shop on the corner for banana bread or a brownie in the morning. The neighbourhood is very nice and the apartment is within walking distance of Gesundbrunnen and Schönhauser Allee, both with great connections. Finally, Mauerpark is nearby and great fun, make sure to go on a Sunday for the flea market and karaoke!
Loved everything about my stay, Ralph was an excellent host. Overall everything was clean but some areas required some dusting. Lots of great restaurants and transit is a short walk away.

Ina was absolutely amazing!
The apartment is very well located, clean and nice.
We were 3 adults and the apartment was perfect for us. Had a great time.
5 stars well earned!

It was my second time staying at Petra, so that says enough I think :-) This time around I was there for a week and got to experience more from the location and the space. It is very close to all the things you need (supermarket, U-Bahn station), super clean and cosy, and Petra is the sweetest host ever. Just a perfect place to stay when in Berlin! Thanks Petra!
Gemütlicher, ruhiger und freundlicher Aufenthalt bei Anne. Die Wohnung ist mitten in der Stadt und trotzdem ruhig. Es war sehr entspannend und wir haben und gefreut über den Aufenthalt :)
Lovely Staying, beautiful appartment, well located, and David is a super nice Host.
Es war super! Tolle Location. Vielleicht ein bisschen zu teuer, aber das gilt nur für den Ortsteil, nicht für die Location. Danke für alles!

perfect house for location, size, taste in furnishings and beauty. Old wood plank floors, leather sofas, large bathroom with walk in shower, huge windows and lot of light ... honestly I found no defects. Also the host, very kind and present. Not insignificant detail, perfectly connected to the center of Berlin and the airport. All this makes me say that I will definitely return.
This is a great accommodation with a lot of space for families planning to stay in Berlin. Jörn has been a great host. Definitely recommended.

Our stay at Helena's was fantastic. We were arriving a bit late on Christmas Eve, but she made great accommodations for us. She is not your average AirBnB host! She was very considerate of our needs and the place was comfortable and very tidy. We hope to stay again if we travel through Berlin again. Thank you, Helena!

Schönes, modern eingerichtetes Studio in sehr guter Lage nahe des Ku‘damms. Gut isolierte Fenster, bequeme Betten und Klimaanlage garantieren uns einen guten Schlaf. Das Studio war etwas kleiner als es auf den Bildern wirkte und es gab keine Spülmaschine, was für den gehobenen Standard etwas schade war. Der Self Check-in war einerseits komfortabel, andererseits fehlte mir ein wenig der persönliche Kontakt zum Gastgeber (der natürlich keine Privatperson, sondern eine Firma ist), aber das ist wohl auch Geschmacksache!

Die Wohnung ist wunderbar ruhig gelegen. Das ist für mich super, aber man braucht mit den Öffentlichen schon eine gute halbe Stunde zur Stadtmitte. Mir hat es gut gefallen und Flora ist sehr freundlich. Vielen Dank für den Aufenthalt

Perfekt!! Tolles, ruhiges Apartment in der allerbesten Lage und noch dazu super nette und flexible Gastgeber ❤️ Wir haben uns total wohl gefühlt und hatten alles was wir brauchten (und noch viel mehr)! Wir kommen wieder - ganz bestimmt!

Our stay at this apartment was wonderful. The UBahn station was right outside the apartment making it a convenient location to get around.  Sven was a great host checking into make sure we had everything we needed.
Excellent stay!  One of our favorite Airbnb’s on our holiday through Germany!
Wir hatten eine angenehme Zeit bei Dirk und Silke. Die Unterkunft ist sehr geräumig und schön eingerichtet. Die Umgebung ist total idyllisch und wir haben zwei tolle Tage dort verbracht.
Tony’s Airbnb was spacious, modern and stylish. There was ample room in the apartment. Tony was accomodating and a responsive host. I would recommend his Airbnb to others.
Great stay! Located 15 minute walk from  alexandrea platz - room was clean and had all amenities needed. Would stay again <3
Amazingly friendly and helpful hosts situated in a fantastic area. Everything inside was as expected and despite the nightlife the rooms were quiet throughout the night. Would recommend!

There are some things that deserve to be improved. The apartment is on the 4th floor and the light from the hall doesn't work so going up during the night can be dangerous. It only has shampoo despise advertised differently. The floor was dirty. The towels and the bed sheets are old and the pillows are not comfortable. The shower is broken so the water goes all over the bathroom while showering, you have to find a way to avoid this. The check-in is very easy but not flexible and I had the feeling that the host expected me to leave before the check-out time. However, the location is excellent.
A friendly place to stay in Berlin for low-budget travelers.Hosts are kind and helpful. Rooms are spacious. The apartment covers all needs.  Only downside is 1 bathroom per multiple occupants.
Sehr hilfsbereite und entspannte Gastgeber. Die Location ist, obwohl in Berlin, am AdW, und genau deshalb ist sie so großartig. Berlin mal aus einer völlig anderen Perspektive

We had a great stay at Marie's place. It is located centrally in Prenzlauerberg and is convenient to lots of transportation options. The apartment is quite large, very clean, comfortable and quiet. The apartment is well stocked with everything you will need, including a well stocked kitchen. Communication with Marie was great and the key hand off was straightforward with her friend. We would definitely recommend staying with Marie if you are going to Berlin.

leuk, mooi en schoon appartement in Berlijn.
super leuk lang weekend gehad!
zeker een aanrader!

Leuke en levendige buurt. Je zou hier anders niet snel terecht komen.
Erg groot en mooi park in de buurt.
Volop levendigheid.

This apartment was absolutely amazing, so stylish and in a great location. It also felt very safe and it was really quiet. It was so nice and the finishing touches were so lovely, they have a big wall map with loads of locations and its very interactive. It is a really cool place which is really clean. Lots of space too, i would 100% recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to visit Berlin, great location, great apartment!
Heike and Heinrich were great hosts that were thorough about explaining local public transportation. The room was everything we needed for our NYE stay in Berlin!
Quiet, spacious apartment, quaint, very walkable neighborhood with very good restaurant options, within easy walking distance of the Ku'damm, one of the main thoroughfares in Berlin.

Lejligheden var rigtig fin, masser af plads til 4 personer, og det reneste vi nogensinde har set, højt til loftet og nem ind-/udtjekning. Vi brugte ikke offentlig transport, så afstandene var lidt lange til seværdigheder, og selve nabolaget var ikke så hyggeligt, man skal gå et stykke vej hen til gode restauranter og butikker, men man kunne gå på 20-30 min.
Mia var super imødekommende, svarede på vores henvendelser hurtigt og hjalp med forespørgsler meget hurtigt.

Wir sind aus dem Staunen nicht mehr rausgekommen, unsere Erwartungen wurden übertroffen. Famos!!!
Trotz sehr später Anreise (Stau) wurden wir sehr herzlich empfangen und haben direkt eine Führung durch das Haus bekommen.
Wer gute Kunst und den Stil der 60er Jahre liebt, will hier eigentlich nicht mehr weg.
Unser Zimmer war sehr sauber, das beste die kleine Kaffeemaschine im Zimmer und der Blick in den Garten bzw. Wald.
Durch die tollen Tipps von Katharina & Raik waren wir bestens gerüstet. Die beiden haben uns nach Absprache noch Fahrräder geliehen mit denen wir das wunderschöne Stück Wald direkt um die Ecke und einen See erkundet haben.
Zudem waren wir angenehm überrascht, dass die beiden so herzlich und freundlich waren. Wir haben uns fast wie zuhause gefühlt.
Eins steht fest! Wir kommen wieder! Es war die perfekte kleine Auszeit zum Entspannen und Entschleunigen. Vielen Dank!!
Nice flat and very easy to reach from the airport! The position is strategic also to reach the city center since the subway (U8) is near! Overall, we were very happy about the accomodation!!

The apartment was perfect! Clean, lots of space, spare towels, linen, a washing machine and a good kitchen. The bed and couches were comfy too. It was exactly what we were looking for! Michele is very quick to answer emails and is super organized! He answered all of my questions before I even asked ie: key, wifi, check-in/out times etc. Good location a couple of blocks from the tram. Thanks Michele! I would definitely recommend you and your peaceful flat! Peta and Guy
Eine Freundin und ich habe zwei Nächte im Apartment von Raja verbracht und können es nur weiterempfehlen. Das Apartment liegt zentral, ist geräumig, sauber und nett eingerichtet.

Un logement facile d’accès en transport en commun.
Une arrivée très simple et bien expliqué par les propriétaires afin d’arriver de manière autonome.
Le logement était agréable et sympathique.
Je vous le recommande vivement.

logement idéalement situé dans un quartier calme et proche du centre,  en 30mn à pied vous êtes au cœur de Berlin. hôte prévenant avec de nombreux conseils sur les commerces du quartier.  je recommande grandement.  très agréable séjour.

Super séjour dans un logement bien aménagé et spacieux
Localisation idéale à deux pas de Mauerpark

Would recommend this place! Perfect location, walkable distance to many attractions, train station buses etc! So spacious and we liked that it was a private apartment without having to go through a reception (easy self check-in with clear instructions). Perfect for couples or families, we would stay again if we were back in the area!
Eine Super Unterkunft, Preis-Leistung war definitiv Top! Danke für den tollen Aufenthalt

Tutto adeguato, appartamento ben organizzato in una zona raggiunta da molti mezzi pubblici. Cucina comoda e completa di tutto, stanza da letto interna e silenziosa, letto super super super comodissimo. Unico difetto si potrebbe trovare nel bagno, andrebbe rimodernato ma alla fine ci si abitua. Marcella molto discreta ed efficacissima nel lasciare informazioni utili.
Ich schlafe in ein kleines Zimmer, für Geschäftsreise ist okay. Parkplatz ist vor dem Haus, ich bin zufrieden damit. Gastgeberin ist freundlich.
Nous avons vraiment apprécié notre séjour chez Irene et Christoff qui étaient très disponibles. L'appartement est joli, propre et bien placé. Je recommande ! Merci encore pour tout !
Simply perfect. Nice appartment, nice neighbourhood. Perfect accommodation.

My husband and I enjoyed our stay. The bathroom is amazing: very spacious with a big tub and a separate shower, huge mirrors, a laundry machine and 2 sinks! That’s really what sold me on the apartment in the first place! :)
The apartment is very clean, with all the necessary amenities, in a safe and quiet gated courtyard. Steffen was easy to communicate with and he helped us with calling a taxi for our early flight.
The only issues one might have is the bed mattress, in case you have a sensitive back, since it’s hard, futon-like; and there are really no windows to open and air the place, since it’s on the ground floor and you would sacrifice your privacy.

De woning is behoorlijk groot. Grote keuken met veel apparatuur waaronder ook een goed koffie-apparaat. Badkamer is groot en daarnaast zijn er nog 2 grote slaapkamers en een woonkamer. De woonkamer heeft een klein balkon. Het ouderbed is in een soort hoogslaper. Daar moet je wel inklimmen. De woning ligt in een levendige wijk. Daardoor wat gehorig, maar er liggen oorpluggen

The Airbnb was good for our needs. The location was excellent by the U-Bahn, grocery store, restaurants and bar. The people caring for the hostel were helpful with checking us in and directions. Thank you!
Way better apartment what the pictures suggest!

We had a wonderful time in Berlin which was made all the better by staying at such a fantastic apartment. Axels place is situated in a perfect location opposite parks and some great local cafes and restaurants. The apartment itself is extremely clean and comfortable to stay in. Axel proved to be a super host and offered advice on how to make our trip to Berlin one to remember. My partner and I highly recommend staying here.
Super hôte et super appartement !
Alles super, gerne wieder
Tudo excelente. Amamos. A casa atendeu todas nossas necessidades. O anfitrião é extremamente atencioso e está sempre disponível para o que precisar. Super recomendamos.
Very nice apartment and very nice people
Chambre propre. Appartement bien situé. Hôte tres réactive et serviable. Je recommande ce Airbnb.

Très bonne auberge, chambre propre, spacieuse. Cependant la salle de bain du 3e étage sentait mauvais et était sale. Les douches ne sont pas pratiques. Mis à part ce souci, les toilettes, lit, chambre étaient super, très contente d’y avoir séjourné.
Beate was wonderful. The apartment was wonderful. Just what I needed for an easy, quiet place to sleep while visiting Berlin.
Limpio, con atención 24/7, muy chulo el interior!
Near great transportation, clean, and aesthetically pleasing interior! Please note, there are many stairs but doable.
The beds were very comfortable. There was a great restaurant right down the road. Ilona was very friendly and helpful. Right near the bus station too.

Die Wohnung sieht aus wie auf den Fotos, Bad und Küche hätten aber sauberer sein können. Die Lage ist toll, viele gute Restaurants und Cafés, kleine Läden usw. in der Nähe. Direkt gegenüber ist ein kleiner Sport- und Spielplatz, nachts war es ruhig und trotzdem nicht abgelegen.
Great location, lots of space, functional appartment.
Teşekkür ederim
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und hatten nichts zu  beanstanden. Durch die Bushaltestelle in unmittelbarer Nähe war die verkehrsmässige Anbindung super.

Die Unterkunft ist unglaublich schön. Im Sommer kann man die große Terrasse bestimmt auch gut nutzen. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und die Anbindung und Restaurants in der Umgebung sind auch klasse.
Schöne Wohnung in guter Lage. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel direkt vor der Tür. Preis Leistung sehr gut.

Apartment was incredibly central. You could walk into centre. Takes about 25 minutes or get the underground which is only two stops.
Great supermarkets only 2 minutes away from the apartment.
Very cozy apartment. Lots of kitchen utensils for cooking if you didn’t want to go out.
Apartment secure in a safe area.
Thanks
Sven.
Absolutely amazing and great value for money!

약 2주정도 머물렀는데 숙소 너무 편하게 잘썼습니다! 완전한 중앙역은 아니지만 u반 엄청 가까운곳에 있어서 이동하기도 편했구요 슈퍼마켓도 길건너에 있어서 좋았어요 다만 u반이 가깝다보니 어쩔수없이 열차소음은 좀 있는편입니다! 많은 독일 건물들이 그렇듯 엘레베이터가 없다보니 캐리어 들고오시는분들은 주의하셔야 할것같아요 다시 베를린에 방문하면 또 여기서 머물고싶네요

Was in Berlin on my own and felt super safe at Ivo & Ramona’s place. You have your own entrance so you have a lot of privacy as well - definitely can recommend for solo female travellers! And of course everyone else:)

Meget imødekommende vært, som svarer hurtigt.
dørporten var defekt, men vi havde aftalt mødetidspunkt - så der var en da vi ankom.
Alt virkede og rigtig gode senge som man bare sov godt i.
vi kommer gerne igen - tak for et godt ophold
Such a wonderfull place to stay in Berlin ! Carolin is really nice and the apartment is lovely, and in a perfect location.

Perfect place to stay for a weekend.
The communication is easy with Numa | Nook, they give you all the information you need clearly and quickly.
The location in Mitte is ideal.
I recommend without a doubt.
Gute Unterkunft für einen Kurztripp, wenn man es gerne ruhig hat :) Sergej ist ebenfalls ein sehr netter Host. Gerne wieder !

The appartment is even more spacious then you think....it was great for our family to be able to have our own individual moments but also to be together and eat/play games. The location is great, super close to metro and supermarkets. Don't forget to bring your football so you can play a little on the corner-playground. The only thing which is not so handy is the sink to do your dishes, it's super low and not good for your back. Communication with Stefanie went smooth and good.

Très bon séjour chez Marcus.
La communication était simple et Marcus a été très arrangeant :)
Merci beaucoup !
Wir hatten einen fabelhaften Aufenthalt in Berlin! Sabine ist eine ausgezeichnete Gastgeberin, sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Ich kann jedem dieses Airbnb ans Herz legen.

Birgit has been the best host I've ever met. Shortly before I arrived, she dropped me a message (super kind), asking me whether I wanted to go to a biergarten with her and a couple of friends. Not only she was talkative and engaging, but paid me a beer - that was so nice!
The flat is a real gem. Really, really, really clean. The mattress was perfect, good pillows, spacious. The bathroom was REALLY clean - this matters a lot!
Above everything, Birgit is a fantastic human being. I can't wait to come back! We spent several hours talking about life, parenting, children, traveling, politics.
You're amazing, thank you!
Great location and nice amenities. Close to lots of restaurants and public transportation. The availability of a local cell phone was a very nice touch. Everything was clean and lovely
Toller Aufenthalt!
A great flat to base yourself in while in Berlin. Very spacious and easy to check in!
Great flat. Great host. Would recommend to anyone visiting Berlin
Wonderful place, amazing location and great host!

Great, spacious and clean apartment in a super nice neighbourhood. Lots of great cafes, restaurant, parks, shops and playgrounds nearby and close to tram and metro. We loved it here! Communication was quick and professional, could have been a little more personal.
Very pleasant experience interacting with the host. The apartment is conveniently located and exactly as described.
The place was very quiet and clean, however it's quite far from downtown or any restaurants or cultural centers (about an hour by public transportation)

My friend and I were here for a long weekend to explore Berlin’s landmark sights and the gay scene.
Christoph’s apartment is so beautiful, decorated to a high quality, with two balconies that offer lovely views. In terms of proximity, there are some lovely coffee shops close by (one opposite the apartment block) and for nightlife you are only 10-15 minutes in an uber from some amazing bars and clubs.
We definitely recommend Christoph’s place and would love to stay again in the near future!
Everything was just perfect and possibility for free parking is great. Sure thing to come back next time.
It was a nice place in the town and the management coordinated very well.
Very godd hostel. Very clean, good furniture and the kitchen is great. The location is a definite plus !
Respostas rapidas no chat. Bem localizado em ralação a estaçao de metrô. Lugar limpo e organizado!
Alles wie online dargestellt, guter Aufenthalt, nette Kommunikation.
Alles Bestens, ich komme gerne wieder!

Clean and spacious studio loft. Clean sheets and hot water available.
Very convenient location with supermarkets and a few restaurants nearby. The neighborhood is very quiet and peaceful.
It got pretty cold during our stay (end of Sept), however the central heating was only available starting Oct 1. So pack more warm clothes. Bigger and warmer blankets would be a plus too.
Typical response time is around 7 hours, which might be inconvenient when you have any quick questions.
Overall, I recommend this place!
Frank was a fantastic host. Everything was in order and ran smoothly from start to finish. Highly recommend 🫡, thanks again Frank.

Nettes, schön eingerichtetes und funktionales Appartment, das super zentral in einem angenehmen Viertel liegt.
Appartment ist im Erdgeschoss mit Fenstern zum Gehweg.

Martha’s place was great! It’s a spacious beautiful apartment that had both European charm with modern amenities. It was close to transportation that connected to key tourist sites in the city- most in under 20-30 minutes! Martha was also an amazing host. She welcomed us and gave us a tour of the apartment when we arrived and was very responsive throughout our stay. I would definitely stay there again on my next visit!

Superschöne, helle, modern und hochwertig eingerichtete Wohnung. Die Kommunikation mit Jörg verlief stets schnell und problemlos. Das Leihen eines Fahrrads war unkompliziert und hilfreich, sich in Berlin zu bewegen. Unter dem Dach unter den Fenstern zu schlafen, war ein einmaliges Erlebnis. Ich komme gerne wieder. :)
great location

O apartamento está próximo à estação de metrô, a supermercados, e se pode alcançar a Alexanderplatz em cerca de 15 minutos a pé. O imóvel está um pouco distante do portão de Brandemburgo e dos outros pontos turísticos mais procurados. O apartamento tem tudo o que se precisa para uma curta estada, mas não é aconchegante. A decoração é impessoal e fria, assim como a recepção da anfitriã. Na cozinha, havia café, chá e açúcar. Normalmente, nos apartamentos airbnb que temos alugamos há, pelo menos, sal, óleo e temperos. Em suma, faltou "tempero" (spice) na decoração, na recepção e na cozinha! ;-)

Lars' place was fantastic! The apartment was super tidy, clean, and decorated. The location was perfect, close to great restaurants, shops, and transportation. Lars was a wonderful host, very responsive and accommodating. Check-in was a breeze. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

Norbert's place was a lot of fun to stay in.  He has a real flair for design that shows in thoughtful details throughout the space.  You'll take ideas home!  Norbert warmly welcomed us.  The neighborhood is very quiet.  We were always happy to retreat to this lovely, airy apartment at the end of long days sightseeing.  Highly recommend.

Beautiful, clean and cozy room and apartment. The host, Beatrix, is kind and makes sure everything works out very well. This has been one of my better Berlin stays, and I was very happy to stay there.
Some more local details :
The house is a beautiful old art nuveau house, that's quite a joy to witness.
Likewise, the houses in the area are also old, beautiful and well maintained.
The area is center of old West Berlin, with a relaxed and friendly air.
sehr zentral gelegen, wie in der Beschreibung benannt, Support unkompliziert erreichbar, einfache und schnelle Kommunikation

Super freundlicher Empfang.
Top Lage.
Für den Sommer sollte man eine Klimaanlage nachrüsten.
Sonst war alles bestens.
Würde ich auch weiterempfehlen.
Heel fijn, ruim en schoon appartement vlak bij metrostation Wedding. Denny reageert snel en is vriendelijk.

Es war einfach genial. Es gibt nichts zu bemängeln. Jederzeit wieder.
Alles was man braucht war da. Super Einrichtung. Super sauber. Alles perfekt.
Fijn appartement op een top locatie! Raad het iedereen aan.

Great apartment and great location. The staff was super helpful--I needed to get instructions beforehand due to traveling and they were extremely accommodating. Will recommend and also keep in mind if come back to this neighborhood again.

Vi blev välkomnade av värdens pappa som visade oss runt i lägenheten. Lägenheten såg precis ut som på bilderna och var väldigt rymlig. Läget i Berlin kunde inte varit bättre. Vi hade närhet till mysiga restauranger, caféer samt kommunikationer.  Det fanns många bra restauranger med vegan alternativ eller hel vegan-koncept.
Absolutely lovely apartment, way bigger than the pictures make it seem. I was very comfortable there, and the neighborhood is nice too. I would love to stay here again
Great place, love the neighbourhood. Very comfy room and space . I really liked the view from the balcony so cozy and peaceful atmosphere …
die Unterkunft ist etwas für Leute, die etwas sehr günstiges suchen und auch bei einfachsten Dingen Abstriche machen können

Der Gastgeber is super freundlich gewesen und hat super schnell geantwortet.
Wohnung so wie auf den Fotos.
Alles super sauber gewesen.
Der Stadtpunkt der Unterkunft is perfekt gewesen man konnte alles erreichen mit der s & u Bahn in wenigen Minuten.

Good place for a weekend Berlin, strategic location close to one of the biggest public transport hubbs in Berlin (Lichtenberg station). Communication with Alex was really easy, and he was very friendly giving us many tips about Berlin. Had a good stay.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans l'hostel 199. Nous avons apprécié de pouvoir cuisiner. Les transports sont justes à côté. Niveau propreté impeccable. Le quartier est top et pas très loin du centre historique.
Merci beaucoup et peut être à bientôt !!

Iwona was so kind and helpful for us. She gave local tips, and also she and her friends helped us for the entrance to the clubs:) The flat was 5-10 min close to subway by walking. The room was so clean, and perfectly designed. We felt like at home. Thank you for everything:) I would absolutely recommend you to stay here:) ❤️
We had a great weekend at Kims place. Location was perfect, close to U-bahn and restaurants. She was very attentive to our needs and quick to answer all our questions.

Schmuckloses neues Hotel.
Positiv:
Wir hatten ein Zimmer im 4. Stock mit nettem Blick auf das Wasser / die Bote.
Für unseren Zweck war die Lage gut. Berlin Ostkreuz ist fußläufig in 10 Minuten erreichbar.
Negativ:
Keine Bilder an den Wänden, ungestrichene Betondecke, Südseite ohne Klimaanlage und ohne vollständigen Sonnenschutz, nur 1,40m breites Bett für 2 Personen, Bad ohne Fenster, für ein Appartment ist der Raum eigentlich zu klein, Haare auf Kissen und Bettdecke
Hotels in Berlin sind mitte September offensichtlich teuer, dieses Hotel auch: wir haben für eine Nacht 135 € ohne Frühstück gezahlt - 80 € hätte ich für den gebotenen Komfort für noch angemessen gehalten.
The apartment was lovely very clean and quiet and the area was very cool nice restaurants,bars etc.
Very good location for Berlin - it was perfect to walk around, grab a bite to eat and more

Gorgeous apartment in a good location - just a few stops on the S bahn to the main attractions in Berlin.
Stef was a great host, giving very quick responses, easy to follow directions to the apartment from the airport and when we checked-in she offered suggestions for places to eat and drink locally.
The apartment is huge with big and comfy beds and all the amenities you would need, including a powerful shower, hairdryer and hair straighteners! There's no a/c and we could have done with a couple of fans in the apartment as it was quite warm but I'm sure Stef would have supplied some if we had asked (we never got round to asking though!).
There was a bit of noise from the hostel and S bahn, which runs right past the building, but usually by about 11pm it got quiet so nothing unexpected (but possibly not the place for very light sleepers).
Overall a really great airbnb and would happily stay again and recommend to friends!
Great time. Great apartment. We loved the location.

Room smaller than shown in the pictures, sufficient for a short trip.
No possibility to store clothes, missing cupboard or wardrobe.
Service and communication proactive and friendly.
amazing place, we enjoyed immensely, alexander is an amazing host

Wir hatten bei Martinas Unterkunft eine sehr schöne Zeit. Wir waren zu Dritt (Papa mit 2 Kindern) und es hat uns in der Wohnung und auch in der Umgebung sehr gut gefallen. Martina ist eine sehr aufmerksame und freundliche Gastgeberin und war während der gesamten Zeit für unsere Anliegen erreichbar. Wir würden die Unterkunft beim nächsten Mal gerne wieder wählen.
Great unit!   Perfectly decorated with a comfortable bed.   Easy, short walk to public transportation, eateries, and shopping. Very responsive host!  Loved our stay!

The apartment is well located for most places you would want to visit in Berlin.  The accommodation is well equipped, clean and bright. The hosts are friendly and communicative. I would stay here again when visiting Berlin.
Angenehmer Aufenthalt in einem modernen Zimmer mit Fussweg zum Bahnhof. Nettes Personal, hilfsbereit
Absolutely lovely place, conveniently close to the airport. We had a great time at Horst's and would definitely come back!

Fantastic stay at a really well located flat. Great neighbourhood and easy to get to all parts of Berlin. Had a great few days and would happily return. Oliver very helpful before and during the stay.

Super séjour, notre hôte a été très accueillant et amical :)
Séjour au top
El departamento esta impecable y es mucho más amplio de lo que se ve en las fotos, hay estacionamiento gratis afuera lo recomiendo ampliamente y Mimi es una excelente anfitriona
Maravilhoso.
Удобное заселение, хорошее место, все соответствует описанию , при входе есть мини бар с чаем и кофе

Dankeschön für den tollen Aufenthalt. Wir waren zwar nur zwei Nächte da, haben uns aber sehr wohl gefühlt und hatten nichts zu beanstanden. Die Lage ist wirklich super gut und wir haben nirgendwo hin länger als 20 Minuten mit der Bahn gebraucht. Mega tolles Viertel!

Die Wohnung liegt nahe zu U Bahn und Bus so kann Berlin Mitte schnell erreicht werden.
Die Wohnung hat ein gutes Bett, das Bad ist schön und neu saniert. Die Küche mit dem allernötigsten eingerichtet.
Um Berlin zu besuchen empfehlenswert.

Die Wohnung vom Verda ist sehr gut gelegen. In der Gegend selbst hats viele gute Restaurants. ÖV ist zudem sehr nahe, man kann aber auch gut zu Fuss z.B. zum Alexanderplatz spazieren. Die Wohnung selbst ist einfach, aber sehr gut ausgestattet. Ich habe nichts vermisst und würde wieder buchen.

Ich bin bereits das dritte Mal in dieser Unterkunft. Es ist immer sauber, sehr unkompliziert und gemütlich, trotzdem alles neu ist.
Ich komme gerne her.

Einfach, aber modern eingerichtet, alles da was man braucht. Super Lage: ein paar Schritte zur U-Bahn und ein paar Minuten zu Fuß zum Boxhagener Platz/ Simon-Dach-Str.
Die Wohnung liegt im Erdgeschoss direkt am Gehweg, wo bis nachts Menschen unterwegs sind. Bei offenem Fenster hört man jedes Gespräch der Passanten mit.
Easy to Check-in an Check-out. Jonas answered quicky if We need more info. Very nice stay in Berlin.
Tolle Wohnung nahe am Alexanderplatz. U-Bahn Station sehr nahe. Einige Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. Wohnung sehr gut für 4 Personen, sehr geräumig und sehr sauber. Wir haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen.
Gut für diese Preis. Nicht alles war praktisch, aber für ein paar Nächte ist ok.

Oliver’s place looked even better in person than it did in the photos. The bathroom and kitchen were extremely clean. The mattress and bedding are very comfortable. The street is peaceful and we did not hear any noise from people walking past. If you’re worried about the street facing windows, the automated shutters are great at night time as they make you feel a bit safer and provide more privacy. Great location and close to the S and U stations, restaurants and supermarkets.
tutto perfetto! grazie
The place was amazing, my daughter really enjoyed it and had a great time. Katja was a fantastic host, many thanks!

Bis auf die Lage war alles nicht gut.
Zimmer war ein anderes als abgebildet und man hatte viel weniger Platz dadurch.
Die Fenster des Zimmers gingen nicht komplett zu, da es eine Art Kippfenster war …
Die Sauberkeit des Zimmers war mangelhaft, in der Dusche hingen noch Haare des Hotelgastes vor uns und auch der Seifenspender war leer (was in Corona Zeiten ein No go ist) und darauf Hinweist, dass das Bad nicht geputzt wurde.
Auf unsere Bitte zur nochmaligen Badreinigung kam man zwar nach, aber die Haare des Hotelgastes vor uns waren immer noch da…
Auch unter den Betten war es dreckig als wäre nicht gestaubsaugt worden…
Ja der Preis ist gering für ein Zimmer in Berlin Mitte, aber ein sauberes Zimmer und Bad ist eine wichtige Voraussetzung ..
bis auf die Lage ist, das Hotel nicht zu empfehlen !

Good (five-week) stay overall. The place is quite well-located (easy access to public transport and the vibrant Fhain neighborhood) and the host and their reps were always responsive. (There were some things missing when I arrive - broom and fan - but upon requesting, I had the both within a few hours.) The photos definitely use wide-angle and convey a larger space than is the case, but still, it's a comfortable flat with comfortable sofa, table, chairs, and bed. The front of the apartment faces the main ground-floor entrance area, so not very private (but thankfully there are good curtains). Shower leaks into main bathroom floor, but it's manageable. Minor issues aside, this place is a good deal and is comfortable for one person, well-located, and comes with a response and friendly host.

Ich habe mich bei Carola und Ulli wohl gefühlt. Die Unterkunft ist so, wie auf den Fotos abgebildet. Mein Zimmer im 1. Stock war nett eingerichtet, gemütlich, hell und freundlich. Besonders begeistert hat mich die Vielzahl an Steckdosen :-)). In dem großzügig angelegten offenen Küchenbereich ist alles vorhanden, um sich ein Frühstück schmecken zu lassen oder für einen Kaffee zwischendurch. Sehr schön ist der Garten, in dem es ausreichend Sitzmöglichkeiten gibt.
Der Check-in war problemlos, meine Anfragen wurden umgehend beantwortet. Carola und Ulli sind perfekte Gastgeber.
Recieved good information before departure, the host replied quic on all our questions.
The full-fledged Airbnb experience in the middle of the popular neighborhood of Kreuzberg. Everything included and very smoothly organized.

Buen piso. Éramos 6 y había solo 5 camas, pero el sofá de cama es cómodo.
Único inconveniente para nosotros es que íbamos con mi madre y la bañera estaba alta.
No hay gel ni champú para la ducha.
Por lo demás muy bien

We loved staying with them! Super friendly people with great knowledge of Berlin that really made an effort to make our stay as good as possible. We felt really at home and the cats made the experience even better. Coffee and tea in the mornings and beers and wine on the roof in the evenings, such a dream!
Perfekte Wohnung für einen kurzen Städtetrip, alles verlässlich und unkompliziert. Unbedingte Empfehlung!

Alles hat super geklappt!
Martin war beim Check-In sehr flexibel und hat uns einiges zur Umgebung der Unterkunft gezeigt.
In der Wohnung ist alles, was man braucht und sehr sauber. Nur die Schiebetüren, welche sich nicht abschließen lassen (auch im Badezimmer) waren etwas ungewöhnlich.
Bernd&Isabella sind sehr nett und die Wohnung+Zimmer war ganz sauber. Eine einladende Gastgeber ^^

Was a very good stay! We enjoyed our time in Berlin. Only downside was that the apartment was on the 4th floor without an elevator. But other than that, very nice accommodation for two people stay!! Would recommend
Perfect place for exploring Berlin! Nice to have a large kitchen and to have two beds. Very very responsive host
Very friendly and helpful people at the reception and clean rooms.
Nice apartment, enjoyed our stay.
Appartement is located in a vibrant neighborhood. Great as a starting location to discover Berlin. Appartement is clean and comfortable, away from city noise.

Wir hatten ein tolles Familienwochenende in einem top ausgestatteten Haus in direkter Nähe zu Berlin und trotzdem ruhiger Lage. Das Haus und die Sauna waren total gemütlich. Trotz niedriger Temperaturen war es durch einen Kamin schön warm. Vor dem Haus gibt es einen Garten mit Trampolin, Schaukeln und einer schönen Terrasse mit Grill. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Studio pratique et bien localisé pour un week end prolongé à Berlin. Le studio est dans un Quartier calme, très bien desservi par les transports en commun
Sehr süsses apartment, sauber und super lage ;) würde wieder kommen

Eine schöne und moderne Wohnung zum Wohlfühlen. Der Einzug war trotz der abwesenden Gastgeberin unkompliziert und gut organisiert. Tramstation und S-Bahn sowie Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind schnell zu Fuß erlaufbar.
Wir würden jederzeit gerne wiederkommen.
Alles prima

This Airbnb was exactly what we wanted in Berlin. Instruction to access the apartment was clear, the Airbnb was spotless and had all the necessary items you’d need. This Airbnb is also in a great location to all different types of restaurants, public transit and shopping.

Everything was perfect, however Wi-Fi sometimes didn't work :)
The kitchen is really splendid and the bed is very comfortable 😌

Diese Unterkunft war genau richtig für mich. Die S-Bahn war nah und die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und geräumig. Es gab wenig Kontakt zu Van Chien weil ich früher abreisen musste aber es war für diesen Preis wirklich sehr gut.
Incredible property, stayed for nearly week - very convenient, lots of restaurants, everything you can possibly need is in walking diatance.
Es hat uns sehr gefallen. Gastgeber sind sehr freundlich und aufmerksam, die Wohnung ist toll. Immer gern wieder!
Sehr schönes Appartement, sehr ruhig.

Простора квартира у тихому райні Берлина. Відповідає опису. Зручні кроваті з білою чистою білизною. Кухня обладнана всім необхідним, багато посуду, що немаловажно коли подорожуєш з дітьми. Господар чітко надає інструкції для поселення. Поряд магазин Лідл та Едека. До метро 3 хвилини.
Рекомендую!
Alex is a good host, the location is really great. We enjoyed our stay at Berlin !
It was a nice and comfortable place to stay for the night, though it is a bit distant from the city center.
El departamento es muy bonito. La zona tiene mucho movimiento y vida nocturna pero no se escucha ningún tipo de ruido en las habitaciones
The best place to stay in Berlin , beautiful,cozy ,elegant ! I’ll stay here again
Perfect place perfect host!

The host was responsive, friendly, & check-in was straightforward. The space is well-located, with easy access to most of Berlin within 30 min. by tram or bike, & it's across from a beautiful park. However, it's on the ground floor behind a Turkish restaurant, which emits strong odors nearly 24/7. The entrance path has overflowing garbage & compost bins, attracting rats that you see when you come or go. The daily noise from the restaurant dumping trash is disruptive. The sink is clogged, leaving a gunky residue, & the upper showerhead leaks, making the handheld one the only option. which works fine. The bed duvets had an unpleasant smell, & overall cleanliness was poor, with dusty corners & spider webs, suggesting more cosmetic than deep cleaning. The freezer door was broken as well. Although we did not use the bed sofa, it is not one I would sleep on. While sufficient for a party trip, the apartment does not meet expectations for a romantic getaway, especially at this price.
Todo genial, Martin muy majo y dispuesto ayudarte en todo lo que necesites, repetiría sin duda.

Aglaja was fantastic; she was so helpful especially regarding checking in and out as our flight times were early in the morning and late evening. The flat itself was even better than expected - I loved the modern décor, having two bathrooms is a real plus, and the artwork gives the place a very distinctive and enjoyable feel. Also having the fresh coffee machine in the kitchen to fuel my caffeine addiction was great! Location wise Spitelmarkt is excellent for exploring the city. My tip would be to visit the bike shop on the other side of the street from 'One Motel' and rent a bike for 24 hours (15 euros) to explore via (really helpful guys and the bikes are fantastic quality). Would not hesitate to book again. Thank you so much!
tout était parfait. seul bémol, la serviette de douche aurait pu être comprise dans le prix de la chambre.
We enjoyed our stay with Rudi - the apartment was nice and the room was large. Rudi was friendly, although we didn’t see him too much during our time at the apartment.

Such a lovely flat, very clean and in such a good spot.
Ksenija was so lovely and kind.
Highly recommend.
Thank you for having us ! X
tolle Unterkunft; dafür das es nur ein Gemeinschaftsbad gibt etwas zu teuer
Great place to stay. Recommend highly!!

We had a great stay with our young child. The neighborhood is great and definitely kid-friendly, and Louis's recommendations for restaurants and playgrounds were spot-on. The apartment was very clean and well-sized. Even though the primary bedroom faces the street, we did not have problems with street noise overnight. Loved our stay!

I stayed at Francesco's apartment for 2 weeks, and it was very good! He and Elisa were always very helpful, the room was very clean and comfortable.
I recommend it!
Muy buena ubicación, departamento limpio, ordenado y con todo lo necesario
Wonderful short stay - great communication and good location!

Bel appartement en rez de chaussée dans une rue et un quartier calme.
Appartement propre, linge de toilette fourni, RAS.
Je recommande aux internautes qui comme moi souhaite trouver une alternative à l’hôtel traditionnel. Propriétaire à l'écoute, disponible et sympathique.

Die Unterkunft liegt super zentral in Neukölln. Es sind viele Möglichkeiten für Essen in der Nähe. U- und S-Bahn Anbindung ist gut zu Fuß zu erreichen. Die Unterkunft liegt ruhig und ist liebevoll, aber ohne Schnickschnack eingerichtet, super. Wir haben uns extrem wohl gefühlt - danke dafür!! Ich fand es angenehm sauber, auch die Bettwäsche. Und die Vorhänge an der Fensterfront lassen auch Privatsphäre zu. Vielen Dank für den unkomplizierten und tollen Aufenthalt. Empfehlung!!

Super séjour ! Très bien placé, très propre très agréable, Accommodant en cas de problème
Je recommande

Mein Freund ich haben haben 2 Nächte im Zimmer Hive 3 verbracht. Das Zimmer war sehr sauber und gut eingerichtet. Es lagen Handtücher bereit und es gab einen Ventilator. Ein Spiegel wäre noch toll gewesen, um sich zum Beispiel zu schminken wenn mal jemand anderer im Bad ist. Das Zimmer hat bodentiefe Fenster direkt zur Straße raus (nachts etwas lauter), die sich leider nicht öffnen lassen. Auch der Wasserhahn im kleineren Bad klemmte ein bisschen. Das sind aber alles “Luxusprobleme”, die Unterkunft ist wirklich top. Auch die Lage ist relativ zentral allerdings sollte man nicht außer acht lassen dass sich die Wohnung in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Görlitzer Park befindet, diese Gegend würde ich vor allem als Frau alleine eher meiden.
Danke Laura für den angenehmen Aufenthalt!
The apartment is very nice, clean and tidy. It is located in a good position in the city, it is well connected to the center. I recommend it to everyone.
I love the neighborhood and the flat.

It was great staying at Günters apartment. Everything is clean, the bedroom is large, has nice light and its in a good location. Günter is very kind, respectful of ones own space and it was easy staying with him. Would happily stay again.
Thank you Günter :)

Logement très sympa avec tout ce qu'il faut. Bars, restaurants, commerces à proximité. Rue calme. Proche de tous les centres d'intérêt de Berlin. Métro à deux minutes. Ina était là pour nous accueillir et nous donner des explications.
Nous recommandons.

As described a very cozy room with a lot of lovely details. Also very near to the station.
Audrey is a really nice host - totally recommendable.
Sehr gute Kommunikation. Wohnung recht klein, aber sehr sauber. Immer wieder gerne. Danke Kristina

It’s a decent Airbnb for a short stay. It was clean, had a comfortable double-decker bed, nice bathroom with good shower/water heater. The check in process was smooth. It is also situated in a good location, right next to the Treptower park, a train station, 3 grocery stores (Lidl, Netto, EDEKA), and many bars and restaurants. There was a constantly buzzing night life on the streets.
Having said that please be aware that this apartment is facing the ground floor next to the building atrium where people come out to smoke. It doesn’t have a washer or dryer in the apartment. They are available in the common area via WeWash app for a fee: 4 euros for one wash and 4.80 to dry. There’s no available garbage area to throw out your garbage. Additionally all commission with the host in the Airbnb app goes through an AI chat bot.

Dimitris's place was great! It is a lovely little flat on Kastanienallee, one of the nicest streets of Berlin full of cafes, restaurants and shops. The flat is quiet and was clean and very easy to get to. The check-in and check-out process worked like a charm! I will definitely be staying at Dimitris's place again.
Lovely apartment and Ermal was very helpful and responsive. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay!

Claudia was very reactive when we had questions and the apartment is well located and functional.
The concerns I had was about our safety in the apartment: the gas stove had no leakage trigger, electricity cables are everywhere and plugs were getting out of the wall. There is also the shelf in the bathroom that is about to fall.
The apartment is in a great location with plenty of bars and cafes nearby. It is also just across the street from the U-Bahn so you can get across the city extremely easily.

Alexander's apartment was comfortable and convenient to public transport making the whole of Berlin accessible for exploration.  Good local amenities.  Nice space for a couple taking long weekend in the German capital.

Wir sind Universitätsstudentinnen in Deutschland. Die Vermieter waren sehr freundlich und alles über das Zimmer wurde auch gut erklärt! Liebte die Einrichtung des Hauses ~ viel Grün im Inneren! Wunderschön und sehr komfortabel! ☺️
Tamara hat es uns sehr leicht gemacht, uns wohl zu fühlen; unbedingt empfehlenswert

We began our Berlin adventure on the west side to run the Berlin Marathon, and ended our stay on the East side of Berlin at Istvan and Gunnar’s amazing home. While we didn’t chat with Istvan and Gunnar much, it was no issue getting in.
Impeccably clean, loved the modern & sophisticated decorating, with fun quirky accents. I especially enjoyed the love-seat in the foyer, modeled like a car with head lights! This made taking shoes on and off easy. The room was very comfortable, the laundry was a perk.
The location was close to great bars, shops, restaurants, with a convenient coffee and pastry shop close by for morning breakfast. I would love to visit/book again!
Location is a bit far away from center of Berlin but it is a nice, clean Airbnb
Sehr sehr schönes Appartement! Sehr nette Gastgeber! Gute Lage, nur 30 Sekunden Fußweg an die Tramstelle! Einfach Top!
Super clean and homely place :)

Appartamento molto bello, ordinato e pulito. La posizione è ottima per andare ovunque, che siano musei, parchi, ristoranti o locali notturni. La cucina è attrezzatissima, ha tutto e nelle quantità giuste. Letti comodi e di mattina non entra luce.
L’unica pecca è il fatto che l’host non risponda sempre ai messaggi, mandando tutte le informazioni predefinite e necessarie ma non rispondendo sempre alle domande che vengono poste.
Nel complesso comunque ottimo, soprattutto per dei ragazzi.

The apartment was beautiful, fully equipped. Everything matches the photos. There is a tram a short distance from the apartment and in about 20 minutes you are at Alexanderplaz. There is a shop within walking distance. The location is quiet. The host communicates, the instructions are clear and precise. The accommodation was great.
Schöne Wohnung, Übergabe lief problemlos.
Die Unterkunft ist eine gesamte Wohnung für den Gast ohne Teilen des Bades mit anderen. Sehr gute Parkmöglichkeit.

Lovely and super well equipped, modern flat. Very family friendly. If windows are open, there is noise from the railways behind the house.
Quiet area with easy access to public transport and very easy access to airport.
If by car, the parking situation is good.
Muy agradable el apartamento en una zona tranquila. Vale la pena

El alojamiento es cómodo para una o dos personas.
Es amplio y muy limpio.
Tuve una estancia agradable.
Tanto John como su padre respondieron rápido y se mostraron con iniciativa en que yo tuviera una estancia agradable. Gracias!
Nice place to explore the city from. Everything you need for your stay is avaliable. Strict housing rules where a shower arter 10pm was not alloud.

Check In war über die süße Szenebar im Erdgeschoss. Einfach Name nennen und schon bekommt man den Schlüssel ausgehändigt. Wohnung liegt eine Etage über der Bar. Also klar gab es auch lange Geräusche von unten aber erstens haben wir persönlich trotzdem gut geschlafen und zweitens steht das auch klar und deutlich im Inserat und drittens -hallo! Berlin Köpenick. Klar is da was los! Wer eine ruhige Unterkunft sucht sollte sich was anderes suchen.
Die Wohnung ist eher minimalistisch eingerichtet aber am Ende alles drin was man braucht. Die Umgebung ist ein Traum zum erkunden und Berliner Szeneluft schnuppern. Die Menschen sind einfach herrlich dort. Würden wir auf jeden Fall wieder buchen!

Our stay was GREAT.
Lars is very easy to communicate with.
In the middle of our stay we asked for some extra towels and he brought them with no delays.
Wifi works very good and place is cool and fresh during peak heat season.
Very calm neighbourhood and well connected to multiple restaurants and parks.
Definitely recommend lars and his apartment.
Michael was a great host and is very approachable. went far and beyond in accomdating us.
Alles hat Problemlos funktioniert und das Apartment war wie in der Annonce beschrieben. Die Lage ist hervorragend für einen Berlin-Besuch.
Super fin lejlighed. Alt var som det skulle være, sengene var dog hårde.
Great place.

Appartement parfaitement situé très proche du centre-ville de Berlin.
Equipements parfaits pour un séjour en famille.

The room was beautiful, with gorgeous afternoon lighting. The adorable balcony faces West so you can watch the sunset!  Everything was very clean, the shower was nice, the kitchen was beautiful. I found the building itself a tiny bit noisy-- just small things like hearing other doors shut-- so I would recommend taking some earplugs if you're also a light sleeper like me. The location is a little far from the nearest bus stop, but that bus is a great, frequent, reliable route that leads to the core, so it all works out!

Die Wohnung war sehr schön - sie war genau wie beschrieben und wir fühlten uns sehr wohl. Schöner Holzboden, bequemes und großes Bett sowie ein recht geräumiger Wohn-/Essbereich.
Die Kommunikation mit den Hosts war sehr gut, auch die Anweisungen für Check-In und Check-Out waren sehr klar. Wir würden die Wohnung auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen!
Todo perfecto!!

Would definitely suggest this apartment to anyone, very spacious with a really nice huge living room and 2 large bedrooms. Clean, bright, and very well-decorated. The location was great, close to the S-Bahn. Wifi was fast which was important as I had to work remotely. Would love to book the same apartment for my next visit to Berlin.
Functional place that provides the basics in good location.

I had an amazing stay at Ulrike's home. It's beautiful and a lot like what I would love for my future home to look like. Her cats are adorable and Ulrike herself is so so nice and friendly. The train line is quite close by but the noise at night wasn't so bad since there were double windows.
Only thing to note would be that like a lot of German homes, you will have to carry your luggage up the stairs but it's not that far up. And the bed is a little low, so it may not be good for older folks but it was perfect for someone in their 20s like me :)
Easy instructions, great location, clean.

Such a great experience!
My parents and their friends stayed at Seb‘s place during their few days visit in Berlin. The accommodation was exactly as described: super clean, spacious and practical. Simply perfect!
Seb is very friendly and caring host! My parents felt so welcomed from the very beginning on. I also met Seb personally and his hospitality was something extraordinary!
The location of the apartment is super good with the tram stop and grocery stores / restaurants nearby. It’s very easy to access all the ”hotspots“ in Berlin.
I highly recommend to stay in here!
Douglas’s place is perfectly located to visit Berlin with a big group. He replies fast and even let us in a bit earlier! Do recommend!
Great experience, fast and clear communication, everything working as expected. Five stars
Lovely stay, great location, great service. Just a couple of fire alarms but i guess at least they work!

Rainer var trevlig, snabb på att svara och enkelt att kommunicera med. Härlig lägenhet i trevliga Wedding. Gillade verkligen takterrassen och att lägenhetens var ett hem och inte en lägenhet som bara används för uthyrning. Rekommenderas!
Good stay! The place is pretty small but it was very clean, great location, and an easy check in so it was perfect for a short stay in Berlin

Frank's place is in a great location, close to most attractions and public transportation.  The space is large and well equipped.  Frank was very helpful with suggestions and greeting us when we checked in.  We would highly recommend this airbnb!

Conveniently located near the subway station in an interesting neighborhood that reflects an important part of Berlin's past. The room and spacious and well-decorated. Hosts are friendly, welcoming, and thoughtful. Highly recommend!

We had a wonderful time staying at Frank’s apartment, he was a great host who gave good recommendations for things to do around the airbnb, great communication throughout, and the place itself was really unique with cool designs. We felt at home throughout our stay and the flat is in an ideal location where you can get to the centre of Berlin quickly but can also explore more local neighbourhoods nearby.
perfect location, great apartment! we really enjoyed our stay. the area is surrounded by great cafes, restaurants and shops. it is easy for commute as well.

This place will WOW you! From the moment you enter the door, you're taken on this beautiful, breathtaking journey of style, space and comfort... These hosts personalise your visit and make you feel like a friend rather than a paying guest! Lol. The home is impeccably clean, warm and inviting. It's in a wonderful neighbourhood, minutes from delighful cafés and the train station. Highly recommended.

Wir hatten ein schönes Wochenende in Berlin und waren sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft. Die Lage ist super zentral und man kann sogar mit dem PKW im Innenhof parken.
Einziger Punkt: Man sollte sich Hausschuhe einpacken, weil die Treppe ins UG auf Socken oder Barfuß leider nicht so angenehm zu laufen ist.
Great for a short stay in Berlin! Very good location , many restaurants in the area, concert venue , bars and a shopping mall.  S-Bahn , Tram and U-Bahn very close by
Vitale e pulito, in una posizione perfetta per chi ama questa zona di Berlino e cerca un’esperienza di apertura e incontro in ostello.

The apartment was generally pretty nice, although a lot of the finishes and fixtures were fairly outdated. The pillows on the bed were the worst I’ve ever used, and under the pillow cases were covered in stains. The extra pillows in the cupboard suffered from the same issue. Other than that the place was nice, Stefan was helpful and met us in person to let us in. Location is great, with easy access to the Ubahn or tram.

Ich habe das Angebot für einen Kuraufenthalt von vier Tagen genutzt. Das Appartement war dafür perfekt geeignet. Alles war wie beschrieben und die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern perfekt. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen.
El mejor de los lugares de nuestro recorrido por Europa, una casa muy bonita, muy limpio todos los lugares de la casa, la alcoba muy cómoda y muy bonita. Excelente lugar , lo recomiendo.
Lovely peaceful area. Apartment was great. Lovely view. Just do need to be able to walk up the stairs.
Nice apartment for 2 people. Great location and check in was a breeze.

In der Nähe des Olympiastadions in ruhiger Lage gelegen war es über S-Bahn Heerstraße bzw. S-Bahn Olympiastadion sehr gut zu erreichen. Kostenlose Parkplätze gibt es an der Straße. Das Georg-Kolbe-Museum liegt in kurzer Entfernung, wo man die Bildhauerwerke besichtigen kann, aber auch ein gutes Frühstück im Café möglich ist. Fernsehen ist problemlos möglich. Die Küche ist ebenfalls sehr gut. Und gut geschlafen haben wir auch.
Grosszügige, schlichte und ruhige Wohnung - man hört die Strasse nicht. Trotzdem ideale Lage. Wir haben die nahe Tram und die "Essstrassen" im Quartier sehr geschätzt.
Beautiful, spacious, modern apartment just steps from subway. Couldn’t recommend it more. Great host who was quick with communication and very accommodating.

Der Aufenthalt war prima für uns. Die Lage ist sehr günstig zu U-bahn, Bus und auch SBahn ist gut zu erreichen. Alle Einkaufsmöglichkeiten direkt vor der Tür.
Sehr ruhig im Gartenhaus/Hinterhaus ist die Wohnung in einem angenehmen Altbauhaus.

I highly recommend staying at William’s place for a short or long stay. His place is well located in the Schoneberg area which is a beautiful neighborhood and is literally close to everything you could possibly need. The flat is impeccably clean and you could literally eat off the floors, it is stylistically decorated and I really felt like I was at home. William is a SUPER-host, he really has mastered hospitality. He is responsive and genuinely cares about the comfort of his guest. Even though it’s a shared flat, you will barely notice his presence, I felt like I had the whole flat to myself which makes the experience even more enjoyable, especially since this is the first time I’ve booked a private room in an Airbnb. Overall I will definitely be coming back the next time I’m in Berlin.
Great people working in the reception and they had a good breakfast in the morning. I would recommend this place

Awesome place to live in your private house in Berlin for optimal price. The house is clean, all amenities are included, the piano is awesome. Thanks for the brief review of local cafes and supermarkets. I recommend Stephan as a host!

very well placed!!
the apartment was excellent, cozy, clean, warm.
Everything was exceptional. since the check in until the check out.
definitely returning again!
Bra läge, fräsch lägenhet, bra kommunikation och väldigt hjälpsam värd!

L’alloggio è posizionato benissimo, ma purtroppo è quasi l’unica cosa positiva. Si tratta di un’appartamento con tre camere per affitti brevi, quindi un dormitorio. Pensavamo si trattasse di una camera in un appartamento vissuto da persone del posto, soluzione che di solito preferiamo. L’host non fornisce una chiave dell’appartamento (e non ci vorrebbe niente a farne una copia per camera) e la serratura elettronica era rotta, vi lascio solo immaginare la rogna ogni volta che dovevamo entrare. Il bagno era sporchissimo e la doccia intasata. Ho fatto presenti i problemi ma non sono stati risolti. È venuto pure qualcuno a pulire il penultimo giorno, ma il bagno è rimasto in condizioni abbastanza spiacevoli. La camera era molto grande ma poco accogliente. Mettere due sedie e un tavolino non costerebbe molto e la renderebbe sicuramente più piacevole.
Sehr gut gelegenes kleines, ebenerdiges Apartment in ruhiger Hinterhoflage mit netter Vermieterin. Sehr gut geeignet für einen Kurzaufenthalt in Berlin.

Das Haus besteht aus mehreren Appartements. Unser Appartement entsprach den Vorstellungen, wobei die Zimmer und das Bad wie erwartet klein waren, was für uns zu dritt aber absolut ok war. Es war sehr sauber und die Einrichtung neu. Die Fußbodenheizung im EG super angenehm, wahrnehmbarer Geruch, evtl. Abfluss, aber in Grenzen. Schönes Gesamterlebnis.
The apartment is beautiful and very well located. The place is clean and with all amenities and Bernd is as nice as a host than as a person :)

Cornelius war ein toller Host. Er hat uns viele hilfreichen Infos gegeben und antwortete sehr schnell auf Fragen. Die Wohnung war groß, hell und sehr gut ausgestattet. Eigentlich fanden wir sie noch schöner als in den Fotos. Die Lage ist auch top, auch wenn nicht so zentral wie manche Wohnungen und Hotels. Das war auch gut so, im Helmholtzkiez ist alles viel sicherer und ruhiger. Man hat dort alles was man braucht: Gute Verkehrsverbindungen mit Ringbahn, M2. Vielen Dank, Cornelius!
Nice and clean. Great location with helpful staff. Answered all my questions and gave me recomendations. Thank you and see you soon.

L’appartamento si trova in una casa d’epoca, nella periferia a sud est della città, in una zona popolare molto tranquilla e silenziosa. In meno di 5 minuti a piedi si raggiungono negozi, supermercati, la farmacia e i mezzi pubblici (bus e tram). In 40 minuti si raggiunge comodamente il centro. L’appartamento è di recente ristrutturazione, molto pulito, luminoso, arredato in modo semplice ed accogliente. La cucina ha l’essenziale, i letti sono molto comodi. L’appartamento si trova al secondo piano della casa e non c’è l’ascensore, per raggiungerlo bisogna fare 4 rampe di scale, ma per noi non è stato un problema. Nel complesso siamo stati bene.
Unique and beautiful home in a nice environment! We recommend this warmly!

Martina arranged for a friend to meet us and everything worked out very well. Her friend was able to answer all our questions concerning restaurants, public transport and many more. The apartment is lovely and  located in a wonderful part of this great city. We found everything we needed and had a relaxing and exciting time. Thanks so much.
Perfect, just perfect :)

Had a great time at Fabian's place. Good place to stay if you search for something close to the center.
the tram gets you to the center / Airbnb all around the clock.
There is also a späti and nice little bar right next door!
great location, looks better in person. good spacious apartment
Really peaceful and a nice park across the street. I just slept and slept. It was nice

J’ai passé un très bon séjour pendant 10 jours chez Birgit. Super localisation. Logement impeccable et chambre très spacieuse. Accueil attentionné. Je reviendrai lors de mon prochain séjour à Berlin et je recommande.

Lorenz und Arthur haben eine schöne kleine Wohnung in der man prima eine Woche zubringen kann. Hervorzuheben ist hier klar die Lage. Gleichzeitig stand Lorenz bei Fragen zu Restaurants und sonstigem super schnell mit Antworten parat. Wir können die Wohnung nur empfehlen!
Andres è stato un host cordiale ed amichevole, unica pecca il checkin tardivo ma per il resto nulla da dire se non in positivo.
Great apartment on quiet street in bustling neighbourhood. Would definitely stay again!

Great apartment and location. Accurate description of facilities, kitchen well equipped, everything was very clean and tidy.

Very bad internet connection, no reception at all in the bedrooms.

Sehr bemerkenswert ist der tolle Stil der Wohnung mit teils antiken Möbeln, ein wunderschöner, ruhiger Innenhof und die tolle Lage. Es ist an alles gedacht und es fehlt an nichts in der Wohnung. Kerstin ist eine sehr angenehme Gastgeberin, die Kommunikation ist schnell und problemlos. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Nous avons passé un séjour magnifique et ne pouvons  que recommander chaleureusement ce petit coin de paradis.

Schon zentral gelegen. Sehr ruhige Wohnung durch Innenhof Lage. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten fussläufig zu erreichen.

Damian’s apartment was perfect. Incredibly spacious, beautifully furnished and very well stocked. It’s in a great location for walking around Prenzlauer Berg and is also conveniently located near a tram stop so it’s easy to get around the city. Even though it’s close to a lot of action, the apartment itself is quiet since it faces inside a very large courtyard shared by the surrounding buildings. 10/10 would recommend and plan on staying here again when we come back!

Nous avons passé un super séjour ! L’hôte a été très réactif. L’appartement est très bien situé, accessible au métro au bout de la rue. Plusieurs restaurants se trouvent à proximité de l’appartement. Enfin, l’appartement est semblable aux photos.
local bom e limpo. mas anfitriã se limitava a responder o que já estava escrito no anúncio.

This apartment in Mitte, Berlin, is perfect.  There are two rooms, one which has a kitchen, and a table for eating and work. The other isa bedroom.  Both rooms look our on a courtyard filled with flowers, trees and bushes.  Bird abound.  It is easy to get to grocery shopping and nearby shops offer locally made bags, and objects.  Culture is nearby. Transportation convenient.  The apartment is meticulous and welcoming.

I had a very nice stay at Michaels place – everything worked super smooth.
The apartment has a great location. Large spacious room and the apartment has everything one needs, including a nice balcony. Michael was very friendly and the communication worked perfectly.
I will most certain come back and I can highly recommend Michael's place :-)

One of the best airbnb’s I’ve stayed in. Yes the place is really small but the space is just enough to make it comfortable and the location is absolutely great.
Really quiet at night and comfy bed!
Excellent communication from Marcus. Large and comfortable apartment in a good and quiet neighbourhood and just a short walk for access to trams and underground.

A great apartment that was very close to Kreuzberg where we spent most of our time. The busy road outside didn't bother us at all as the windows were well insulated. The rooms were very nice with the two bedrooms being a good size for the amount of beds and the living room large and comfortable. Having a separate shower and bathroom was very convenient!
All in all a great place to stay!

Very nice place to stay.
Fantastic view, nice bed and all in all a clean and comfortable place to stay.

The room was conveniently located from several train/subway stations, and supermarket, drugstore and so on was a few min. walk.
The surroundings are quiet and peaceful, so if you want to stay quietly and calmly in this capital city, here is one of the places you should consider.

This was a really great place to stay. I booked this for me and my four girlfriends. We all fit comfortably and appreciated being so close to so many restaurants, bars, transportation, and shops. The place could have been a little cleaner but overall, the flat was spacious and nice.
Alles super.
Sehr nette Gastgeberin, Unterkunft war top :) Gerne wieder!

Francesco’s home is beautiful, comfortable, and had everything we needed. It is close to so many great restaurants, bars, and parks, and has easy access to the tram and bus. Francesco and his son were on vacation during our stay so we didn’t get to meet them in person, but he was extremely kind and easy to communicate with. We would love to return the next time we visit Berlin.
The room is perfect 👌 very cosy, I had a great sleep to rest of my trip !  Paul is a great host and gives good advices 🙌 I fully recommend a stay at his place !

L’appartement est très bien situé, ce qui le rend pratique pour se déplacer et profiter des environs. La chambre est joliment décorée, avec un lit très confortable qui assure de bonnes nuits de sommeil. Tout l’appartement est impeccablement propre et parfaitement équipé avec tout le nécessaire pour un séjour agréable. De plus, la colocatrice est adorable, toujours disponible et très serviable, ce qui rend l’expérience encore plus agréable
We had the pleasure of staying with Simon's Stadt apartment. It is close by to everything, Simon is responsive and helpful.

We (3 persons) stayed in the apartment for 5 nights for a business trip. We were welcomed by Thomas' daughter who explained us how everything worked, and there were also some more written instructions. The apartment looked exactly like the pictures, and we felt very much at home. The living and kitchen are very spacious and comfortable, and also the bedrooms are huge (especially the two upstairs). For us it was also very convenient that there were two desks to work on in one of the bedrooms. The neighborhood is also great. Many great restaurants and shops nearby, and a big grocery store at the corner of the street. And if you would like to visit some other places, public transportation is very nearby. So all in all it is a very nice apartment which is located great and we would definitely come back when we visit Berlin again (either for a business trip, or for a private trip).
Alles top!!
Espacio muy acojedor y amplio

The apartment was extremely beautiful and and it had absolutely everything we needed. The check in and check out were extremely easy and efficient. Der Kontakt mit Katrin war immer schnell und sehr freundlich.

Sehr schöne Wohnung, ausgezeichnete Lage, alles hat geklappt. Gerne wieder.

Amazing time at Karsten's apartment in Berlin. Super close to the underground public-transit station. We had no trouble getting around in Berlin via this way, so it was nice having it close. He also is knowledgeable about the area and he helped us with where to get bikes, what good museums to go to, etc. I will definitely be staying here again.
Loved the apartment! Great central location. Amazing lovely restaurants.
Michael et Christian sont disponibles et accueillants, l'appartement est situé dans un quartier très calme à proximité de toutes commodités. Je recommande vivement.

Bed is not king-size, but could accomodate 2 medium-large size male.

I really enjoyed my stay in David’s apartment, the room was clean and very comfortable.

Eine sehr schöne und außergewöhnliche Unterkunft. Martin und Tobias haben alles gut und einfach organisiert. Wir hatten einen super gemütlichen Abend und eine schöne ruhige Nacht auf dem Wasser. Der Kamin sorgt für eine angenehme und gemütliche Atmosphäre. Wir kommen im Sommer wieder und besuchen die Kino und Musik Veranstaltungen der nebenan gelegenen Plattform. Allerbeste Grüße von Bea und Christian.

À notre arrivée sur Berlin l’appartement était libre à 12h au lieu de 15h ce qui est une bonne surprise quand nous arrivons le matin à 10h en avion. A 2 minutes à pied du U-Bahn et S-Bahn de Neukolnn le logement est dans un petite rue calme entrée par digicode (mieux que des clés quand vous ne rentrer pas tous a la même heure entre amis). Le logement est correct et propre manque juste un peu de luminosité. Peu de bruits, cuisine fonctionnelle, salle de douche parfaite avec eau chaude et pression. La chambre donne sur la cour calme mais un peu proche du local poubelle mais aucune odeur a déplorer. Le rapport qualité prix est très bon je recommande ce logement.

Nette kleine Unterkunft für kurzen Aufenthalt.  Nette Gastgeberin. Zentral gelegen um Berlin zu erkunden. 🛌
Un apartamento impecable y muy bien situado. Perfecto para pasar unos días en Berlín. Volveremos.

Das Penthouse ist wunderschön und sehr gemütlich, mit viel Geschmack und Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet. Man kann vom Sofa aus den Fernsehturm am Alexanderplatz sehen. Besonders Abends Atmosphäre pur! Auch wenn wir Adrian persönlich nicht kennen gelernt haben, sorgte er für eine perfekte Schlüsselübergabe und war für uns ansprechbar. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Sehr empfehlenswert!

Everything fits the description. Digital check-in & out very fluent and easy. Cozy, spacious room, very clean, nice bed. Balcony onto a beautiful street. Very good location, easy to get to everywhere amd the area itself is vibrant and beautiful.
Great apartment. View was amazing and Martin was very helpful.
great accommodation, nice host!  I will come back :)
Zentrale Lage in großem Hochhaus der Stadt.
Stiina and Alex’s apartment is gorgeous and very well equipped. We stayed with our two kids and we all loved it. Totally recommend!

Ich war für ein Trainings Wochenende in Berlin und dürfte zu Gast bei Nathalie sein. Da wir schon morgens ganz früh in Berlin gelandet sind, musste ich irgendwo mein Gepäck Zwischenlagern. Es war kein Problem gegen einen kleinen Aufpreis früher ein zu checken. Ich bin sehr dankbar für dieses Entgegenkommen!
Ansonsten ist das Apartment sehr zentral gelegen. Das Haus ist sehr ruhig und angenehm.

Very nice and clean accomodation, the hosts are very friendly and explained everything well. Would deffinitely come back!:)

Nice spacecy appartement. relay good location.

logement parfait, avec ce qu'il faut pour un petit sejour, dans une cour bien tranquille

Schönes Familienzimmer. The Kids loved it. Ideal für ein Wochenende.

Die traumhafte, zentral gelegene Wohnung. Genug Parkplätze vor dem Haus, Café, Restaurant und Geschäfte um die Ecke. Unglaubliche Gastfreundlichkeit! Ich habe mich super wohl gefühlt.

Appartement bien situé proche de commerces d alimentation,restaurants et métro. Nous avons passé un agréable ou nous avons pu visiter les principaux spots touristiques. Nous reviendrons !
Très bon séjour ! Appartement conforme à la description ! Le quartier est très sympa.

Die Wohnung war ruhig und angenehm, ideal für einen entspannten Aufenthalt. Ich würde definitiv wiederkommen!

This is a real nice place to stay. Private and has quick access to the underground and suburban trains. Also quite a few nice restaurants and bars just around the corner.  This is also an ideal spot if you are two people traveling together but you want a bit of your own space.

Die Unterkunft einfach mit dem öffentlichen Verkehr erreichbar. Son war sehr hilfsbereit und flexibel was den Check-in angeht. Die Wohnung ist etwas kühl eingerichtet und wirkt ein bisschen wie ein Rohbau, trotzdem ist sie gut mit allem notwendigem ausgestattet.

Le logement de Mariana est très bien : grand, ambiance sympa, près du tram, et à une vingtaine de minutes du centre ville. Absolutely loved this apartment. Spacious, full of character, great outside space, felt like home as soon as we walked in.
Would recommend to anyone and would definitely return.

Lugar amplio, calefacción buenísima, lugar muy bien ubicado en un barrio muy tranquilo, con buenos restoranes y supermercados cercanos. Los días sábados se instala una feria a pocas cuadras, imperdible. Gracias Jörg.

Schönes Appartement im Innenhof, das heisst SEHR ruhig. Die ÖV Anbindung ist top, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sehr gut und nah. Ein weiter Tip ist das Vietnamesische Restaurant Tinh Co in der Nähe.

El primer dia que llegue me perdi porque no soy buena leyendo mapas pero Gihad estuve pendiente de mi llegada, siempre preguntando cómo estaba o si estaba pérdida. Sehr angenehme und schnelle Abwicklung!
Perfekte Familienunterkunft für einen mega Berlin Citytrip!
Schön eingerichtete Wohnung an der East Side Galery. Super sauber und gut ausgestattet. Anbindung durch die nahe S-Bahnstation Warschauer Straße perfekt.

Highly recommend! Room is beautiful! Perfect location.
Marcus ist eine echt nette Person! Ich habe bei ihm tatsächlich spontan angefragt, aber hat er wirklich nett damit umgegangen. Der Airbnb ist total empfehlenswert:)

Hardi is a very thoughtful and helpful host with a great sense of humour. The apartment is well located to see Charlettenburg and beyond with easy bus access nearby and some nice eateries within a short walk.

Merci a Florian et Gaston. L'appartement est propre, calme, confortable et bien situé. Nous avons pu profiter pleinement de notre séjour avec a notre grande surprise de découvrir le carnaval des cultures qui se trouvait juste a côté de notre logement. Je recommande vivement.
Tolle, sehr coole Unterkunft - alles unkompliziert, Anne ist mega nett und hilfsbereit! Perfekter Ort!
Todo muy limpio y ordenado, Katherine fue muy amable!! Como consejo dejo que pongan cortinas en la ducha para que no se moje todo afuera :/  pero todo estuvo excelente
war okay, schneller check-in, spartanisch eingerichtet und viele Restaurants in der Gegend.
