This basement studio in Kreuzberg provided a great base of operations during our week in Berlin. It is close to public transport, and a great number of restaurants and food markets that can serve all your needs. Being close to the U7 line was a huge benefit, as it was easy to get to most major landmarks within half an hour. I had minimal contact with the host, as the apartment is managed by a neighbour who was quick to respond to our needs via online message, and generally very friendly and helpful. The bathroom is small, but manageable. Altogether, the shower, toilet and hand basin probably take up no more than 1.5 square metres. The space itself is very nice, with a lot of contemporary art on the walls. The bed was very comfortable, and it was pleasant to sleep in at night. Overall, I would definitely recommend this apartment, and would happily stay here again. Thank you for having us!
Would crash here again.

Apparemment très bien situé et parfait pour un couple avec 1-2 enfants. Eugénie est disponible pour informer ses hôtes et notre
séjour a été très agréable. Merci Eugénie!
Lovely place to stay in a baeautiful area. Nice to explore the city. Everything was clean and the bed was super comfy! Would recommend!

Unfortunately our host couldn't meet us to introduce us to the apartment. Her cleaner let us in and we had to improv a bit. Everything was relatively straight forward though! Massive living area with a comfortable bedroom and a beautiful bathroom.

There wasn't any grocery shops that we knew of in the area (I did find one about 5 min walk away eventually) but there was a few basics that we had to buy (soap, milk, toothpaste etc.) Would have been great to know where the shop was the first day. I had to do a bit of reconnaissance on the area and it took a while to find out where I could go to buy these things as they weren't in the apartment.

The apartment is beautiful and exactly as it appears in the photos but I think it's worth noting that it's not an actual Loft. It's on the ground floor with a door from the living room onto the street. The bedroom is also just above street level so you can hear people walking by but it's not very loud.

The location was perfect. An underground station just down the street and bars and restaurants within a few minutes walk. Museum Island is a 10 minute walk away.

I would definitely recommend this place as it's fantastic! But I would say that if you're not comfortable with being on the ground floor or with having windows and a porch/door onto the street this might not suit. It's certainly the best location for getting around and making the most of your time in Berlin though.

Leider hatten wir nicht so viel Glück wie die anderen Gäste mit der Kommunikation bei Check-in und Check-out
Lage ist wirklich toll. Schöner Balkon mit Blick ins Grüne. Ebenso toller Innenhof.

Incredible Stay! As a frequent traveler to Berlin this was my favorite Airbnb. Quiet, very comfortable, super clean, close to great food, galleries, shops. A perfect stay. Marcus was an gracious host and this spot felt like home.

Tomos is a wonderful, generous host, and his apartment is fantastic. I worked from home with a beautiful view of trees out of those large windows, and WiFi was great. The bed was comfortable, there was plenty of storage, the apartment was stylish without being cluttered, and Tomos was extremely responsive and helpful - he was flexible with check out which was greatly appreciated. Thank you, Tomos!!!
It was a nice stay but it was a bit dirty on the bed clothing.
Wonderful stay, great hosts!

Christian et son frère sont des hôtes adorables. Réactifs mais très discrets mais très sympathiques quand on se croisait. L'appartement est à 5 minutes à pied du S-Bahn ring donc, toute la ville est facilement accessible. C'était un super séjour et une super rencontre.
Nice, bright, clean room. Great area. 2 tram stops to metro. There is Edeka nearby. And next to the subway there are all the other shops. Everything was great. Thanks a lot

We had a great time at Claudia's appartment. It was well located, super clean, quiet and had all we needed for our stay. The design is incredible and we had a lot of space.
The only real issue we had was with a ladder leading to the mezzanine that was not fixed. An accident could have occurred! If this issue is fixed, I'd gladly go back to Claudia's appartment on my next stay in Berlin.

Apartamento pequeño pero con lo necesario para pasar unos pocos días en Berlín. Zona residencial tranquila, con supermercado y línea de tranvía cerca. Disponía de champú, sal, aceite y café. Recomendable para pasar pocos días y recorrer la ciudad.

my family of 3 had a wonderful stay in berlin, and in part because of staying here at lena's apartment. it is indeed in the perfect location and i think especially so for those visiting berlin for the first time, like ourselves. all sorts of public transportation just within a block or 2, good restaurants aplenty, and a little grocery one the corner. we found much within walking distance for us as well and did much walking being the weather was quite mild for winter.
the key drop off upon our arrival was a tad eventful. the key was not where it was said to be and it turned out it was forgotten about, to be dropped off and all. but lena was easy to get a hold of and worked quickly to get it all sorted out. gela, her housekeeper, arrived with a set and walked me through the first 2 doors and into the courtyard where she then tripped over a poorly placed bike (it was quite dark in the courtyard. hit the button for the light before you go out into it) and fell. she hurt knee bad enough she needed an ambulance. the kind neighbors quickly came to help and after awhile gela, with a smile, handed me the keys to the apartment and told me to go on. lena felt badly about our arrival, and reimbursed us one of our nights stay. i was not expecting such an offer, i found it very thoughtful and considerate. lena took good care of us, as she would you and yours. we'd happily stay here again.
Super Aufenthalt, auch für Familien mit Baby zu empfehlen. Sehr gute Kommunikation und Erreichbarkeit.
Muy bien ubicada, impecable, y Klaus es un súper anfitrión.

un espacio cómodo y bien ubicado para conocer Berlín. está a unos pasos de Checkpoint Charlie, de zonas de comercio y bien ubicado para el transporte público. Las instalaciones están en buen estado y hay servicio de locker incluidos en tu reserva. Siempre está disponible café, agua y té. La cama es deliciosa. Volvería sin dudar a quedarme con ellos.

Die Wohnung war leider sehr unhygienisch. So waren das Geschirr und Besteck klebrig, sodass wir alles erneut waschen mussten. Dabei war schwierig, dass wir keine Geschirrtücher hatten, bzw.. nur eins, was ebenfalls dreckig war. Insgesamt gab es viele klebrige Flächen, durch die deutlich wurde, dass nicht regelmäßig geputzt wird. Der Wasserkocher befand sich ebenfalls in ekligem Zustand, das Wasser war innen gelb mit sehr viel Chlor. Im Bad waren sehr dicke Chlorschichten auf der Armatur und die Möbel waren teilweise kaputt und sehr alt. Es müffelte in der Wohnung. Lediglich die Bettwäsche war frisch gewaschen. Leider also insgesamt für den Preis unzufriedenstellend.
very clean and nice loft in the quit area of Berlin

Check-In war spätabends problemlos möglich. Das Appartement liegt ruhig und ist verkehrtechnisch sehr gut angebunden (Busstation ca. 50 m, U-Bahn ca. 300 m).
Das Appartement war sehr sauber und ist für Selbstversorger ausreichend gut ausgestattet. Der kurze Kontakt zum Gastgeber war sehr angenehm. Das Appartement hat unseren Ansprüchen mehr als genügt und wir waren sehr zufrieden. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Wir haben zwei Allergiker, die auf Vogelfedern reagieren. Tim hat federfreie, allergikerfreundliche Bettwäsche organisiert.
Die Unterkunft sieht aus wie auf den Fotos, für 5 bis 6 Leute absolut ausreichend mit insgesamt 3 Doppelbetten, wovon eines im Wohnzimmer ist.
Die Unterkunft ist im Südosten von Berlin, bis ins Zentrum zu den klassischen Touristenorten ist man mit Öffis ca 45 Minuten unterwegs. Mit dem Auto geht es auch nicht schneller und Parken in der Innenstadt ist auch nicht günstiger als ein Gruppenticket des BVG.
Insgesamt hat es uns sehr gut gefallen. Jederzeit wieder.
Enjoyed our stay at Fabian’s place. Apartment has nice stylings and well equiped. Location feels safe and is right next to the tram into town and multiple supermarkets.
It was short stay but I felt like home
Great little patio for morning coffee and evening cocktails. Loft room was super sweet. Beds very comfortable. Kitchen well equipped.
Elisa is een super aardige host, reageert snel en geeft duidelijke instructies. Daarnaast was het een mooi appartement in een leuke buurt. Al met al een superervaring gehad!

Hallo, mir hat der Aufenthalt bei Alessandro gut gefallen. Ich hatte sehr kurzfristig gebucht und ich war froh, dass es so wunderbar geklappt hat. Ich habe prima geschlafen. Mir hat auch der kurze Weg zur S- und U-Bahn gefallen. Viele Grüße H. Otto
Loved the location, host very communicative and helpful, we had a great time in Berlin.
Mijn dochter en ik hebben een heerlijke tijd gehad in Berlijn en het appartement voelde echt als thuiskomen. Heerlijke plek!
Great space and service! The sofa bed was smaller than expected but everything else was perfect.
Everyone was as the description and the place was very cozy and could easily sleep the group.
We had a wonderful stay Maria's place. The Room was very nice and clean. Maria was lovely and helpful. :)

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in dem Domizil von Gino und kommen gerne wieder.
Kamin, Terasse und toller Garten mit Fuchs und Katze war inclusive.
Liebe Grüße und vielen Dank nochmal für Alles.
Manu und Martin

Appartment is nice, clean, simple but with everything one needs. Our host was friendly, he responded quickly and helped with everything we need. Parking is very useful. Location is great. We hope we will come again.
Schönes Atelier, sehr liebevoll eingerichtet, zentral und super leise. War ein toller Aufenthalt :)
Eine gemütliche Unterkunft mit einer tollen Gastgeberin. Die Wohnung ist ausgestattet mit allem was man braucht und hat dazu noch eine super Lage.
Great place for the price.

Great place to stay in Berlin, in the middle of the Boxi, which is a restaurant, bar and social quarter. Extremely well-connected with public transportation. The rooms are spacious and clean.
We will definitely stay here again

Das Zimmer ist sehr gemütlich und alles war sauber, hat alles was man braucht, es ist in der Nähe einer Bushaltestelle und ein Café.
Moritz ist eine sehr freundliche Person und hat immer auf Benachrichtigungen geantwortet, außerdem sind seine Kätzchen super süß 🥰
Appart impec, chaud, confortable, propre, agréable. Nickel
Wonderful host and room!
Overall, a great place to stay in Berlin! Absolutely loved the location and the apartment had everything we needed.
Stunning ! The appartment is perfect, everything we needed was available. Thanks you so much !
Wir haben uns bei Jutta sehr wohl gefühlt. Gastfreundschaft und leckeres Frühstück sind unschlagbar. Wir kommen jederzeit gern wieder.

Ninad Loft is a nice and quiet place in Neukölln Berlin, right in the center of an area, where culture, poverty and immigration clash heavily which is a very interesting sight. Easy Check-In, easy Check-out and Nina will always answer any Question.
However theres also one or two things we didnt expect but should have been aware off in my opinion. First, the Balconies view is heavily obstructed by a new construction site and the pictures are out of date. The entire building is very old, and also working on an old plumbing and heating system. Meaning its very hard to reach a not boiling but also not freezing water temperature to shower. Generally speaking everythings given in the Apartment as said, but keep in mind that ALL of it is old, except the dishwasher.
Also I had to clean the apartment on arrival bc a previous guest didnt clean properly, which isnt the first time this happens based on other reviews.
We definitely still enjoyed our stay, but it wasnt what we initially expected.

Thalia was great. Very friendly and quick to respond. Great location with grocery stores near by. There is a lake with a nice park a few minute walk with great restaurants and beer garden right on the water. The beds are very comfortable and the apartment felt right at home.

Klein? Ja, aber ausreichend. Etwas sauberer könnte es an einigen Stellen/Ablagen etc. sein. Dennoch, ich habe mich wohl gefühlt, war sogar überrascht, wie großzügig auch etwas so Kleines sich anfühlen kann und letztendlich ist alles drin in  der Wohnung und dran, was ich brauchte. Die Kommunikation lief rasch und freundlich, meine kleinen Bitten wurden prompt erfüllt. :)
Super Lage, schönes  Zimmer, alles Top!
Die Kommunikation war super. Sehr schnell und detailliert!:-) Die Wohnung war sehr schick eingerichtet und modern. Auch die Lage war gut. Gerne wieder! :-)

Ex ele te lugar, ubicación, limpieza.
Lo único que cambiaría es que la cocina se pudiera utilizar.
Sin embargo, el lugar es muy ameno, cerca de la estación del metro y tiendas.

Anca’s Airbnb in Berlin was fantastic! The space was spotless, stylish, and cozy, with thoughtful touches that made it feel like home. The location was perfect for exploring the city, and Anca was an incredibly welcoming and responsive host. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Berlin!

Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Wohnung und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Vielen Dank auch für euer Entgegenkommen trotz dem späten Einchecken, es hat alles wunderbar geklappt.
Die Wohnung ist sehr warm, heizt sich auf, was sehr wahrscheinlich der Bausubstanz des Gebäudes angelastet werden muss. Es kann aber gut gelüftet werden und Ventilatoren stehen in jedem Zimmer bereit.
Wir können diese Unterkunft jederzeit weiterempfehlen!
Vielen Dank!

The place was very cozy and comfortable. It was also a great space to work — the Wi-Fi worked perfectly, and Lina even offered to boost the signal with a special plug-in device, which was super thoughtful.
Lina was such a lovely host — it was really nice chatting with her about running! I especially appreciated her encouragement before my half marathon. It was also so sweet when she said she’d be out cheering as a spectator and would wave to me on the course — that really made my day!

Great location, transport and shopping close by.
Only negative is that the laundry requires the use of an app. As the Laundry is located in the basement, there is no phone or wifi signal preventing the use of the laundry.
Nice place. Great location. Tarek is very responsive and I loved the extras he allowed me to use.

Very communicative host. Easy check in but I prefer selfcheck.
I would say that this is low standard apartment but in adequate price.
I am satisfied.

The check-in process was easy and Marcus was very responsive. The location is great, there’s plenty to do in the area and still close enough to the city centre. The apartment was great and exactly as described.

Gracias por la buena acogida! Me encantó la casa de Sabrina. Es espaciosa, agradable, y encontré todo lo que necesitaba. Mi habitación, el baño y la cocina eran estupendas. La casa está en una calle tranquila, pero cerca de una estación de metro con conexiones muy prácticas para moverse por Berlín. muy recomendable!
We loved staying here. It was so close to so many beautiful places around the city, and Martin gave us many wonderful recs.
Good location, close to Bergmannkiez.
L’appartamento era davvero bello e spazioso. Restaurato di recente con tutti i confort. Posizione tranquilla, vicino alla metro. Jan è stato gentilissimo e super reattivo. Lo consiglio!
Easy and fast response with the host. The apartment was very spacious and beautiful in the centre of Berlin. Would definitely recommend!
Super appartement ! Proche du métro et de plusieurs restaurants.

Ich habe hier vier tolle Tage verbracht. Alles war sehr sauber und sehr ruhig für Berliner Verhältnisse. Sehr toller Innenhof in dem man gemütlich sitzen kann und seine Ruhe hat. Ich kann das Airbnb nur jedem empfehlen und werde selbst auch, wenn ich nochmal nach Berlin komme sollte, wieder hier einkehren!
Amazing location, easily accessible to everything. Very strong WiFi. Kitchenette totally wonderful and the building feels safe and secure for a solo female traveler! Absolutely loved it!

Ich hatte mich recht kurzfristig dazu entschlossen, zum Lollapalooza Festival nach Berlin zu fahren und bin froh, dass ich auf die Schnelle noch diese Unterkunft gefunden habe. Sandra und ihr Sohn waren sehr nett, sodass man sich direkt wie zu Hause gefühlt hat. Die Wohnung ist geschmackvoll eingerichtet, das Bett schön groß und gemütlich und dadurch, dass es im Hinterhof war,  gab es auch keine Probleme mit Lärm. An der Sauberkeit gab es absolut nichts zu meckern. Da Bus und Bahn in der Nähe waren, kam man auch gut zum Olympiastadion und wieder zurück - und auch sonst ist es recht zentral gelegen. Weil sie im Hinterhof war, habe ich die Wohnung nicht auf Anhieb gefunden, aber Sandra stand auf dem Balkon und hat mir Anweisungen zugerufen. Das Einzige, was ich gewöhnungsbedürftig fand, war die Tatsache, dass es keine Dusche, sondern nur eine Badewanne gab. Vermutlich hängt das damit zusammen, dass es ein Altbau ist. Insgesamt hat aber alles super geklappt, sodass ich das Festival und meinen Aufenthalt in Berlin in guter Erinnerung behalten werde.

Th apartment had I think everything you’d need to have for your stay. A lot of towels, shampoo and conditioner, shower gel, toothpaste, hair dryer,  washing machine, fridge, stove, a lot of dishes like plates, glasses and cups etc., we had coffee, cream, tea. The place was very quiet to stay, the bed was comfortable. If we were to stay there for more than for two nights I think we would even cook there and stuff. The host was also very welcoming and kind.

Alles super! :) Die Unterkunft war super gepflegt und sauber, das Zimmer hatte alles was wir brauchten, sogar einen kleinen Schreibtisch. Kommunikation war einwandfrei, Marcello hat uns freundlich begrüßt und wir haben uns gleich wohl gefühlt. Tram, S-Bahn und u-Bahn sind in unmittelbarer Umgebung und gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit, dankeschön!

very comfortable bed and pillows. large clean bathroom with big shower. modern and clean kitchette.
quiet at night made for great sleeping. Blaue Bonhe had a great coffee
Great location
Enjoyed my stay at Antonio's and he was a super host, very responsive and kind, and the place it self is in the middle of everything .. highly recommended

dejlig lejlighed, ren og pænt og hyggelig. Rigtig god kommunikation med udlejer, som var meget hjælpsom. Lejligheden ligger i et dejligt roligt og charmerende område med gode restauranter og hyggelige små butikker. Tæt på transport til Berlins Centrum og gåafstand til Alexanderplatz. Jeg kan varmt anbefale.
Alles super! :)

The listing was simple, clean and well located. We were only there one night, but communication with the host was easy, key exchange was simple, the listing was quiet and perfect for our needs. Would definitely recommend for a very simple place in a well located neighbourhood.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans le logement d'Ulrike. Le logement est propre, fonctionnel, bien équipé, confortable et bien situé (2 mn à pied d'une station de tram (M1) par laquelle on rejoint Berlin et le métro en 10-15 mn), dans une banlieue calme et verdoyante, tout proche des commerces.
Nice and tidy room, exactly as described.  Great location, we would stay here another time as well.

Great couple of days at Philipp and Caroline’s place.  Lovely studio off a quiet inner courtyard. Very comfortable bed. Interesting check-in process with some detailed instructions (worked perfectly). Good recommendations for local restaurants (there are lots in walking distance). Easy access to the city centre using the underground. Added dimension  to a memorable trip.

Das Airbnb war super sauber und das Zimmer ist riesig.
Das Wohngebiet ist ideal für kleine Restaurants und Kaffees zu besuchen. Die Umgebung ist grün und ruhig.
Marvi ist eine sehr liebe Gastgeberin und ihre Tipps sind wirklich Goldwert.
Sie hat uns sogar im Vorhinein über das ÖV System des Airbnbs informiert.
Wirklich augezeichnete Kommunikation!

Alles prima. Schöne Wohnung mit guter Ausstattung. ÖPNV nur wenige Minuten entfernt. Absolut ruhig gelegen, kleiner Park in der Nähe. Unkomplizierter und netter Kontakt mit Julian.
Diese Wohnung ist sehr zu empfehlen😊

Thank you for the apartment! Everything worked well. Location was good; it was easy to get downtown with U-bahn.
And special thanks for letting us to bring our luggage there before checking in!

Mein Aufenthalt war wie erhofft. Die Wohnung ist wunderschön und gemütlich, die Aussicht vom Balkon traumhaft. Binnen 3 Minuten ist man an Bus und UBahn Station. Es gibt nichts zu meckern. Bin total zufrieden

I loved the room- comfy bed, clean bathroom, quiet, private. Great host- Louis is really welcoming and kind.
Can only recommend it.

Top strukturiertes Konzept - Wir hatten ein fantastisches Wochenende in Ben&Simon Apartments. Die Wohnung war super sauber und sehr gut ausgestattet. Die Kommunikation lief zu jeder Zeit einwandfrei und schnell. Als ich einen Fehler der Kaffeemaschine gemeldet habe, war innerhalb weniger Minuten jemand aus dem Team vor Ort und konnte diesen beheben, sodass wir wieder frischen Kaffee genießen konnten, der übrigens ebenfalls zur Grundausstattung des Apartments gehört. Sehr gefreut haben wir uns auch über die Überraschung an der Türe am zweiten Tag unseres Aufenthaltes :) Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!
Her zaman tercih ederim
Der Aufenthalt bei Mayya war ganz wunderbar, ich komme gerne wieder! :)

Lo bueno:
* Buena comunicación con la anfitriona.
* Departamento cómodo, simple y básico en todo aspecto, pero tiene todo lo necesario para una estancia corta. (4 dias en mi caso)
* Utensilios de cocina mínimos pero esta bien (faltaban las tapas de las ollas), cama comoda, toalla + toalla de mano + toallon.
Lo malo:
* Lejos de todo, 2.5km que para hacerlo caminando puede ser mucho. Es casi inevitable usar transporte público, yo alquile una bicicleta.
* La cama se encuentra en un entrepiso, que se accede por escalera, la escalera no es para cualquiera, empinada, escalones altos, es un problema tener que ir al baño en la noche, no te podes parar, ni arrodillar en la cama porque te das la cabeza con el techo. Apenas sentado.
* Si el vecino de arriba pisa fuerte o se le cae algo, se escucha y en el silencio de la noche me despertaba. También el vecino de enfrente que no se si era venezolano, cubano o de que pais de centroamerica pero cuando se peleaban, se escuchaba. Y era molesto.
The place was cool.

Clean
Quiet
Charming
Kathrin Helpfull and fun
Felt Safe
A lot of nice foodplaces around
Food store, bakery etc next neighbour
Necessary with bikes, then central

A really great location with good public transport links and close to amenities. Also very easy to walk to the centre of Berlin. The apartment was perfectly equipped for 2. Everything that you could need; good bathroom, comfy bed, easy charging points, modern, light and clean. The kitchen was particularly well equipped which made it easy to be able to cook anything! The addition of herbs and oil/vinegar was great. Probably the best kitchen I've stayed in with Airbnb. Very quiet place, both outside and neighbours. Top apartment! Really well thought out layout and facilities for visitors.

La camera è più piccola di come sembra nelle foto. A parte questo, è tutto perfetto. Pulizia ineccepibile, host molto cortesi, posizione comodissima, subito sotto la fermata della metro e a due passi da mauer park. Ci torneremo sicuramente
Thank you for your kind Hosting..

Leuk appartement, midden in leuke gezellige wijk. koffie tentje bij voordeur. Met metro station vlakbij een goede plek om de stad te verkennen. Parkeren voor deur kon niet maar is gelukt vlakbij oude luchthaven Tempelhof. Redelijk te belopen.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr geschmackvoll saniert und die Remise von außen wirklich hübsch. Es ist kein Verkehrslärm zu hören und in dem Bett schläft es sich wunderbar bequem. Auch die Küche ist gut ausgestattet, die Lage der Wohnung top!
Nette, ruhige Wohnung im Bezirk Wedding. Ralf hat sich proaktiv gemeldet und war sehr flexibel beim Check In. wir waren sehr zufrieden.
Very nice place, good location, highly recommended

Gunilla ist eine sehr sympathische Gastgeberin, die mit vielen liebevollen und kreativen Details und Annehmlichkeiten aufwartet. Die Innenhoflage bedingt wirklich absolute Ruhe. Und etliche Restaurants und eine Bäckerei liegen gleich ums Eck, sodass es nicht weiter ins Gewicht fällt, dass die Küche in der Wohnung eigentlich eine Improvisation darstellt. Also wir können die Wohnung von Gunilla für Kurztrips wirklich wärmstens empfehlen! Danke für die feine Herberge!

Andrea a été une hôte généreuse, et très accueillante. Je me suis sentie comme à la maison pendant mon séjour. Ma chambre était très confortable. Le logement est bien placé, à 10 minutes à pied de la S-Bahn , ensuite il faut moins de 15 minutes de trajet pour être dans le centre-ville.
Je recommande !

Stanze pulite ed accoglienti.
Bagno privato non in camera, ma al piano inferiore (pulitissimo).
Lo consiglio vivamente.
This is a gorgeous apartment with unique details in an excellent location. A great place to explore Berlin from.
很棒的公寓，房间内的设施很齐全，可以洗衣做饭，还有免费赠送酒水饮料和咖啡。公寓周围有很多好吃的小吃和餐馆。

Robert was an amazing host, so warm and welcoming and we felt at home straight away. He has great knowledge of the city and provided us with maps and info to get us ready to explore Berlin.
The apartment is another level, we had our own area which was huge and the waterbed was so comfortable. Everything was clean and the design of the apartment was amazing.
We had a medical issue whilst we were there and without help from Robert I don’t know what we would have done.
As for Jack the dog, I fell in love instantly!!
Highly recommend this apartment and hope to return at some point to see more of Berlin, and Jack :)
The heat worked well and the tv and internet were good. The bed was clean, big, and comfortable

App nr 612 was echt helemaal geweldig! Schoon, ruim en heerlijk rustige plek om bij te komen van mooie maar drukke stad. Ventilatoren in elke kamer. Locatie is bij tram, bus en metro. TIP langparkeren bij East Side Mall €15 per 24uur, maar 10 minuten lopen.
3minpunten:
Kleine keuken. Tafeltje 3 pers in 8 pers app en verder geen eettafel, niet genoeg kookgerei en twee pitten
Communicatie. Chatrobot was dramatisch. Er is naderhand geen contact opgenomen . (melding kapotte stoel en missend kookgerei).
De entree en gangen van gebouw. Tussen drukke terrasjes met keiharde muziek is voordeur. Bij voordeur is het vies, binnen is het donker en ook heel erg vies en slechte wegwijzering. Terwijl het een prachtig gebouw is maar daar wordt niks aan gedaan. De binnenplaats ziet er op de foto's best leuk uit maar het is een verzamelplaats van vuilcontainers en fietsen. (Groot appartementen complex met bedrijven en horeca. Niemand voelt zich verantwoordelijk voor de algemene ruimtes blijkbaar.)
Miejsce jest po prostu przepiękne. Zachwycający i estetyczny wystrój.
Good apartment in good location. Close to everything and station just around the corner. Host very responsive with a replacement key and check in. Very Good Thank You.

At finde en oase som Lio & Ete ‘s lejlighed i Neukölln var alt vi drømte om. Og fyldt med Waldorf-inspirerende legetøj og indretning var det som at træde ind i vores eget hjem. Her er en atmosfære der ser ud til på fotos i opslaget. Og værterne var altid klar med svar på spørgsmål og gode tips. Tak. Vi glæder os til at komme på besøg igen ❤️

The apartment itself was clean (though a few kitchen utensils had stains) and in a good location near the bus stop. Unfortunately, several aspects of our stay were disappointing. Check-out was set very early at 10 a.m., and the host wouldn’t allow even a brief extension or let us leave luggage nearby—instead, we were told to store it quite far from the property. The flat was also quite noisy, both from the street and the upstairs neighbors.
What bothered me most was receiving a long email during my vacation with strict instructions to remove laundry, wash everything in the kitchen, and take out all rubbish. I would normally tidy up anyway, but the tone felt unnecessarily pressuring and not very welcoming. Overall, while the apartment is well-located and tidy, I didn’t experience the kind or friendly hospitality I expect from an Airbnb stay.
Amazing apartment, very friendly and helpful host. Would stay one more time once in Berlin!
Great location, great apartment. I’ll definitely book it again!
Great host!

This is a very stylish space. The hosts are incredibly accommodating and quick to respond. It is a very well-suited space for people who want separate bedrooms. The WiFi, however, is finicky in parts of the apartment and the location felt a bit secluded.
War alles super. Vielen Dank

Ich war sehr beeindruckt von dem Apartmenthaus. Der Loungebereich ist klar, alles funktioniert, super war auch das Vertrauen der Betreiber gegenüber dem Gast bei allen Produkten, die angeboten wurden…ich hoffe nur, dass es niemals missbraucht werden wird. Ich komme sicher wieder.

Ich hatte einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt in diesem Airbnb. Die Wohnung war extrem ruhig, was ich besonders geschätzt habe. Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war immer super schnell und hilfreich. Auch die Basics wie Shampoo, Seife, Salz und Spülmaschinentabs waren vorhanden – das hat den Aufenthalt noch komfortabler gemacht. Insgesamt eine tolle Erfahrung, ich kann es nur weiterempfehlen! Falls man mit Kinderwagen unterwegs ist, sollte einem bewusst sein, dass die Wohnung nur über sehr viele steile Treppen erreichbar ist und man das Bettlaken und die Bettwäsche für das Babybett selbst einpacken muss.

Die Unterkunft von Diego ist in einer tollen Lage - sehr gut zu erreichen, es gibt viele Restaurants und Geschäfte in der Umgebung.
Der Check In verlief einwandfrei über eine Schlüsselbox - die Anweisungen von Diego waren unmissverständlich.
Diegos Hilfe haben wir während des Aufenthaltes nicht benötigt und haben deshalb auch nicht viel von ihm mitbekommen, ich bin mir aber sicher dass er uns bei Fragen oder Problemen geholfen hätte.
Ich würde diese Unterkunft wieder buchen.
Mina was an accessible host, her place was spotless and super peaceful. It was perfect for a night of rest after lots of exploring. Great location, close to the train station.
Our stay was fantastic! Great location and very spacious apartment. Would highly recommend!
Tolle Unterkunft mitten im Geschehen und sehr netter unkomplizierter Gastgeber.
Vi havde et dejligt ophold i Gabriels lejlighed. Lejligheden er perfekt beliggende. Gabriel var venlig og imødekommende.  Kommunikationen var hurtig og præcis.

This may have been the best Airbnb I've ever stayed in. The space is so cool and full of personality. Robert is a super helpful host and gave us great food and activity recommendations. The location is convenient and feels like you're in a non-touristy part of Berlin. Would highly recommend!
Great location, wonderful hosts and a beautiful bug room, thank you ! xx

Good value for money! Cool artistic/ campy apartment in a very quiet neighbourhood. The cat is friendly, ambient temperature OK, and the bed comfy. I had access to kitchen utensils and a shelf in a fridge. Two supermarkets in a walking distance. A tram stop and S-bahn stop nearby. Make sure you get instructions in advance! Unfortunately, there was no building number given in the automatic booking confirmation + in Germany apartments don't have numbers, you need to know the surname on the door and doorbell.

Everything about my experience from check in to check out was a breeze. I it was incredibly helpful and quick to respond when it came to instructions and any questions I may have had during my stay. The place was amazing. Just like the photos, but better… The loft bed was extremely comfy. The location was perfect. All you could really ask for! Highly recommend
Perfect room for a short stay in Berlin. The space was clean and tidy, in a peaceful neighborhood with everything nearby. The host was friendly and flexible.
Es lief alles reibungslos ab, vom selbstständigen Check-In bis zum Check-Out. Auf jeden Fall eine Empfehlung wert.

This accommodation was absolutely fantastic! The host was incredibly gracious, making every effort to ensure our stay was comfortable and enjoyable. The room was spotless, and the establishment itself felt very secure. Without hesitation, I highly recommend this Airbnb.
The restaurant downstairs is a must-try! We ended up going there twice because we loved it so much.
There is also a bakery beside the restaurant which is another must try!
We had a great time in Berlin! Great location and neighborhood; very accessible to the rest of Berlin! Markus was very helpful and responsive to our questions.
Everything was fine and exactly as described! :)

Ich habe bei Beate zwei Woche übernachtet.
Beate ist eine sehr aufgeschlossene und freundliche Gastgeberin. Man fühlt sich wie zu Hause und kann man immer einige Wünsche mit Ihr besprechen.
Ich kann nur weiterempfehlen

Sehr schön wohnung
Sauber
Freundliche
Nice staying

The apartment is clean and very welcoming and has a little beautiful garden. Situated in a nice, quiet neighborhood opposite the Gleisdreieck park, with close walking distance to public transportation. The park offers a nice walking/bicycling path to a good supermarket and Yorckstrasse health studio.
In the apartment is all equipment you need for a stay, including dishwasher and a washing machine. It is furnished beautifully and practically.
Ann-Cathrine and Mario were quick to respond to my few questions.
I will for sure be back next time in Berlin.
Excellent location in Prenzlauer Berg! Quite cozy, with nice amenities and welcoming touches.

Mia's place was perfect for our trip to Berlin. Apartment is exactly as described on the listing and has everything you will need to enjoy a couple of days in Berlin. location is great with trains minutes walk away with easy access to any part of the city from there. we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and Mia's place was perfect 👌

Super tolle Unterkunft für Familien! Die Wohnung ist mit Liebe gestaltet und hat eine super Ausstattung.
100% Weiterempfehlung 🤍

It's nice to know there are still people like René in today's world. The welcoming nature of the "tiny house" could only be matched by the resounding kindness that is made apparent during your stay. I had a wonderful time visiting the city and seeing what it had to offer while being able to come back to the private oasis that is the "tiny house". I can confidently say this is well worth the price and few short blocks to the train station from where this Air BnB resides.

Evin konumu çok merkeziydi. Hem Kreuzberg’in karmaşasından uzak, sakin ve temiz bir muhitti hem de ulaşımı çok rahattı. Biz 3 kişi kaldık ve 3 kişi için idealdi. Yüksek tavanlı, çok ferah bir evdi. Perşembe gününden sonra sokak çok hareketli olmasına rağmen, evin ses yalıtımı çok iyiydi, hiç rahatsız olmadık.
Bir daha gitsek tercih edeceğimiz bir evdi. Tavsiye ederim.
Muy buena atención de Mohammad, al llegar nos dio muy buenos tips. Recomendable
I recommend it for who's planning to stay at berlin. Sparkling place to stay in with great location and helpful hosts.
Good location, amazing
Ważny dla mnie aspekt, to jasne instrukcje co do zameldowania, Carola świetnie wyjaśniła jak się zameldować, wysłała również zdjęcia wejścia. Wnętrze było bardzo czyste.
Walls are a little thin so could hear others in their rooms but overall it was great! Great location, easy to get in and it was really well kept and clean.

O espaço é simpático e corresponde à descrição, estando localizado num bairro com muita oferta de supermercados, cafés e restaurantes. O acesso de transportes também é fácil estando a 30m do centro de Berlim.
Quanto à comunicação com a Agnieszka foi muito boa, tendo estado sempre disponível para resolver pequenos contratempos.
Eine sehr schöne Unterkunft in der Nähe der S-Bahn-Station Friedrichsfelde Ost, von der man gut zur Innenstadt Anbindung hat.
Very kind host, nice place, I can recommend

Chris’ place is an oasis! Lovingly furnished, clean, and well-equipped. It’s located on one of the most beautiful and lively streets in one of the very best neighbourhoods in Berlin. The room is sunny and quiet and peaceful. Chris is a warm and relaxed host, and very quick to respond. The best thing about this room is also its one and only thing to look out for: bring your sleep mask because it’s flooded with bright sunlight in the morning.
Excellent accomodation...clean...roomy...and close to attractions!
Beste Lage, sehr sauber und unkomplizierter Check in.

Een geweldige locatie midden in de stad. Alles beloopbaar. Leuke omgeving met restaurants en bars en toch rustig.
Kan het koppels, families en vrienden aanbevelen.

We enjoyed 4 nights at the apartment using it as base to explore Berlin. The apartment was spacious for a family of 4 and comfortable. Treptower park was a nice location it’s a 10 min walk to the s bahn and well connected by buses to the centre of Berlin. Their is parking available opposite the apartment on the street. The neighbourhood is interesting and the park is amazing. The apartment is on the ground floor but felt safe, as expected it is a little dark and there is sometimes some noise from the street/road but nothing too bad.
Beautiful apartment and amazing location to really take in Berlin! Klaus is a great host and I could not have imagined a better stay. Try the Katz Orange in the courtyard, fantastic restaurant!
Schönes Hotel und super freundliches Personal! :)
It was a very nice stay at this apartment and i will book it again in the future. Just 2 small things: there wasn’t any water cooker and the cleaning was little too less.

Great apartment, clean and clutter free! Easy to access and cool building. Loved the inside! Quite a quiet area but 5 mins (max) walk to the bahnhoff. Quick responses to any questions prior to our stay too. Nice touch of an umbrella and tote bag on the apartment too! Walking distance to checkpoint Charlie, then places to grab food or drinks there during the day/early evening.
Thanks for a great stay!

Tuvimos que hacernos las camas al llegar. La habitación interior sin ventana estaba sin ventilar. El barrio es para estar todas las noches en la calle con mucha vida pero no lo que necesitábamos con dos adolescentes de 13, y 14 años. No ha sido nada acertado el lugar. Apartamento sin aire acondicionado. Mala ventilación calle ruidosa. Primer piso. Muebles inservibles antiguos. No volvería a este lugar. No me a gustado Berlin por su culpa.

Stayed here for an extended stay(40 days), while on a work trip. The location was perfect; right off the U3 metro line, and within walking distance of multiple bus routes, which afforded me the chance to commute around the city with ease. Additionally, within walking distance of the shopping heart of Berlin(KDW), and the Tiergarten/Aquarium, which my family enjoyed when they visited me here. The apartment itself is as described, filled with ample linens, blankets, etc. for a small family to stay if needed. Kitchen was well furnished, and much appreciated for the long stay, allowing me to home cook meals when desired. The apartment also comes with a washing Machine, and several drying racks. The balcony, during warmer periods, is fantastic, and provides a beautiful view of the neighborhood, good for drinking coffee in the morning, wine in the evening, etc. cannot recommend the location enough, and would book again if the need arose to work in Berlin for long term.

very informative host, superb location. great bars, cafes and restaurants in just 5 minute walk, and train station just outside that connects to the airport in just one transfer. very clean, comfortable bed but there is no hand soap!

The stay was suuuuuper nice, Thor was very friendly and caring and Perejil was sooo adorable! I had problems with the arriving time but he was very easy to talk with and didnt mind it at all. Also the room was really clean and you’ll have your own bathroom. He had basically everything you would need and there were food and drink at home all the time. If you’re a cat person, just book him for a stay in berlin with no hesitation, he’ll welcome you with big hugs and the clingy cat will just meow at you and come to you whenever he sees you!
I had a lovely stay at Natalia's place. Beautiful apartment, well located. Natalia is responsive and I had a good time overall. Recommend.

Ich hatte mit meinen Kindern (9/12 Jahre) eine super Zeit in Andreas‘ Wohnung. Die Unterkunft war sauber, gut ausgestattet, hell, ruhig und trotzdem sehr gut zentral gelegen mitten in einem sehr entspannt-bunten Viertel. Die Kommunikation war reibungslos und schnell. Vielen Dank für alles!

Hermoso depatamento, es mas lindo que las fotos de la publicacion!!.  Muy limpio y ordenado.  Muy comodo y muy cerca del metro lo que facilita el transporte en Berlin. Kai muy buen anfitrion, muy cordial en la comunicacion.
Alles super!
Alles sehr einfach und unkompliziert, schnelle Kommunikation und sauberes Airbnb. Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit unserem Aufenthalt ☺️

The apartment was really well located just a few minutes walking the station! It’s also at the same line from the main tourist attractions.
I really recommend this place, which also is beautiful and has all the amenities we need.

The listing was simple, clean and well located close to local transport. Large bathroom, and lots of hot water! Check-in was easy and communication beforehand was quick and smooth. The simplicity of the apartment meant it lacked the personal cosiness of a real home, but this certainly didn't distract from our short stay. Recommended for a functional stay.

Es war eine schöne Zeit auf dem Hausboot. Es war alles so wie beschrieben und Fragen wurden sehr schnell und klar beantwortet.
Die Tour mit dem Paddelboot am Anfang und am Ende runden das Erlebnis ab.
Gern wieder

Mon séjour à Berlin était vraiment agréable, l’appartement situé au rez de chaussé est très calme avec un petit espace extérieur. Grandes baie vitrée des deux côtés de l’appartement, très lumineux. Tout est très propre et le lit est très confortable - on se s’en chez soit rapidement.

Insgesamt waren wir mit der Unterkunft sehr zufrieden. Die Lage wenige Meter von U-Bahn und Busstation entfernt ist top, die Betten sind gut und es ist Nachts trotz der zentralen Lage ziemlich ruhig. Die Wohnung entsprach insgesamt bis auf eine Ausnahme den Erwartungen. Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber Jörn war jeweils schnell, freundlich und hilfreich.
Einziger Mangel: die Hygiene in der Küche war definitiv mangelhaft: Bratpfanne mit Essensresten, Toaster voller verkohlter Brotreste, Tomatensaucenreste in Mikrowelle, Küchenschränke und Kühlschrank mangelhaft gereinigt.

Die Airbnb ist sehr gut!
Buchen Sie sie, wenn Sie können!
Sie ist ziemlich modern, liegt in einer ruhigen Gegend und ist leicht zu finden. Die S-Bahn-Station ist etwa 5 Minuten zu Fuß entfernt und das Zentrum mit S-Bahn etwa 10-15 Minuten.
Das Einchecken war einfach und die Gastgeber waren leicht zu erreichen.
Die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet und bietet fast alles, was man braucht.
Man hört manchmal die S-Bahn, aber wir hatten kein Problem damit.
Alles in allem hatten wir einen wirklich guten Aufenthalt. :)
Great apartment, good exercise up stairs but well worth it.

Wir hatten einen spitzen Aufenthalt in Marcus´ wunderschöner Altbauwohnung. Von Anfang bis Ende war alles perfekt. Alles war wie beschrieben, die Wohnung ist ruhig, sauber und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!
Marcus war in der Kommunikation sehr proaktiv und bei Fragen schnell zu erreichen! Vielen Dank hierfür nochmal!
Die Lage der Wohnung ist ideal, um Berlin zu erkunden. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind sehr einfach fußläufig zu erreichen. Einen Parkplatz vor der Haustüre oder in unmittelbarer Nähe ist kein Problem. In der Umgebung gibt es zahlreiche Restaurants, Kneipen, einen Späti, Bäcker, Supermarkt etc.
Wir können diese Wohnung uneingeschränkt empfehlen und würden sie jederzeit wieder buchen.

I had a wonderful stay at Süheyla’s place! Before my arrival, she gave me clear directions from the airport, which made getting there very easy. The apartment was clean, cozy, and full of her beautiful art pieces. The bed was comfortable and I slept really well.
Süheyla was very kind and welcoming — she even treated me to coffee and shared great tips about the neighborhood. I enjoyed exploring Schöneberg with its cafés, restaurants, and bookshops, and loved the convenient access to public transport.
Highly recommend staying here!
Verblijf was ontzettend aangenaam. Fijne ruimte. Dichtbij het centrum, goed te doen met openbaar vervoer. Ook leuke restaurants in de buurt. Aankomst was duidelijk.

Where should I start:) We loved staying at Alessio’s place, it’s a super artsy and authentic place, highly recommended for openminded people. Location is great, walking distance to bergmanstr with lots of bars/restaurants and the host is extremely kind, flexible and very responsive. I’d definitely go again.
Very humble host ! Home was neat, clean and very cozy.
Great location, great room. Check-in and out was easy and fast. The room had everything you'd need.
Lovely apartment, 5min walk from nearest u bahn, Martin gave great advice on local attractions, restaurants etc.
体验感很差 有一个门是坏的
Very cute and cosy room ideally located in Kreuzberg. The little balcony is extremely nice and the room is quiet. I totally recommend this place, thank you Johannes!

Wir haben ein paar schöne Tage in der Ferienwohnung von Arzu und Tom verbracht. Trotz unserer zu frühen Ankunft konnten wir sofort in die Wohnung. Alles war sauber und ordentlich wie auf den Fotos. Zentral und trotzdem ruhig. Besonders gut hat uns die Bibliothek gefallen und die zahlreichen aktuellen Flyer und Infos über Berlin . Schon vor Reiseantritt erhielten wir per Mail gute Informationen für unsere Reisevorbereitung. Wir würden jederzeit die Wohnung wieder buchen und können sie uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.
Wolfgang und Annette, Januar/Februar 2013
Great hotel near the East Side Gallery. Had a brilliant room, with plenty of space and a very friendly front desk team. The restaurant/bar is lovely. Would recommend.
Die Einrichtung war sehr gut und die Schlüsselübergabe hat gut geklappt. Zuerst war es zwar etwas schwierig die Unterkunft zu finden aber das lag eher an der momentanen Baustelle... :)
Sehr schönes Hotel. Sauberes, fast voll ausgestattetes Zimmer gehabt und einfach, gut beschriebener Check- In.

Неплохой район - используйте автобус 19 (рядом с домом) и через 6 остановок вы рядом с КДВ и Ноллендорф. Автобусы ходят круглые сутки. В апартаментах есть все для жизни, кроме стиральной машины. Но рядом есть прачечная. Очень отзывчивый и гостеприимный хозяин. Если едете сюда зимой - возьмите теплые носки или тапки: апартаменты находятся на 0 этаже и пол зимой очень холодный ( хотя и деревянный)
God beliggenhed. I nærheden findes parkeringsplads hvor det kost 6 euro for 12 timer.

Robin's apartment is in a fantastic part of Berlin - plenty of vibe and easily accessibly by foot or tram. Plenty of local bars and restaurants which were amazing.
This apartment has a lovely view (5th floor), plenty of space and everything you need to stay comfortably. I stayed for 5 nights. I didn't use the balcony as I was out all day - but it is a winner on warmer days!
The fact that this is Robin's home means it has life in it - books, CD's, pictures, art, a comprehensive kitchen. So much more than an empty apartment or hotel room.
I cannot recommend it enough and would certainly be back on my next visit to Berlin.
PS Oh - the bed is so so comfy too!
Very good !

Claudia’s apartment is really lovely - very simple and stylish in an excellent location with lots of bars and restaurants nearby. The nightlife is great in Friedrichshain.
The apartment is great for a short stay but you might struggle for a longer stay as there is no washing machine/microwave/toaster etc. It was perfect for us though!
One thing to note would be that although it says that the check in is flexible, Claudia asks for a €20 fee if you check in late. Other than that, everything was perfect! Would definitely stay here again.

The girl that helped us with the check in was really kind and helpful! Love the hospitality and also is a place that's not to far from the principal attractions. Really like this hotel, even though the bathroom had a peculiar smell (not so good), but it was very clean and cute the room they gave us.

War letztes Jahr schon da
Bin dann gleich wieder gekommen. Alles super nächstes Jahr gerne wieder.

Horst and his wife welcomed us warmly despite our late arrival due to very heavy traffic.
The house is situated in a very rural-like residential area. The apartment has a separate entrance at the opposite end of the building.
The apartment itself is small but very functional and has all basic amenities for a comfortable one-night stay. Don't be discouraged by the photo of the bed standing next to the entrance - first, the house is being kept really warm (when we arrived the heating system was still on); second, there are thick curtains between the little entrance hall and the room.
There's an airport and a railroad nearby (well, that's Berlin after all) but the occasional noise of passing trains or planes didn't bother us much.

I had a wonderful stay at Maria’s apartment! The room is lovely and very comfortable, the entire building complex is super quiet and safe. The apartment is in a strategic position, 5’ walking from the U, in general very well connected to the rest of Berlin. Maria is a wonderful host, the communication was great and very precise. Thank you Maria!

Eine gute Unterkunft mit dem Parkplatz für eine kurze Reise nach Berlin.
Gute Lage, nicht weit von U-Bahn- Station.
Die Wohnung verfügt über das Nötigste.
Die Kommunikation mit Dirk war sehr gut.

Perfekt für Familienunterkunft! Sauber, ruhig-alles was mann braucht !
Wir sind sehr dankbar für alles und wünschen alles bestens für Anke und Ihre sehr nette Familie.
Great apartment in a perfect location! Absolutely recommended!

This is a super cozy little apartment which has everything you will need – and even more! Good connection to other parts of the city (U9 + S-Bahn are close), easy check-in, friendly and effective communication. 5/5!
l'appartement est très bien placé,  proche du Sbahn et du grand parc de Tiergarten
Очень хорошая гостиница. Идеальная чистота. Находится в центре
Ulf is fantastic and everything was easy and great. Also meeting him was part of the experience! ;)

The place is very nice and clean. Is 10min walking from 2 Metro stations. All of the staff is really nice and you can get an OK breakfast for 5Eur. I think is a great place for a budget trip, definitely recommended.

The apartment was very well situated, we could reach main landmarks by feet. We visited Berlin in February and it was quite cold outside, however that was no problem as inside was warm enough. The place was very clean and it provided everything necessary for our stay. Would come again.

Beautiful recently refurbished flat in a loft vibe; spacious, high-ceiling well furnished, quiet, clean and kept separate from the host.
The neighbourhood is full of delicious restaurants, the best vintage shops, in walking distance from the canal, parks and several U-Bahn stations. Perfect for us three girls’ tourist, shopping, partying needs.
Esther was welcoming and gave clear instructions.
Best Airbnb ever. The view over the park and the skyline was breathtaking. Despite really hot summer weather the apartment was airy and flowy and so comfortable. Can’t wait to come back

Lovely large spacious apartment in quiet Prenzlauer Berg neighbourhood. Great location as it was really easy to get around Berlin using the S/U-Bahn and plenty of restaurants nearby. My only criticisms are the floorboards in the bedroom are very squeaky when you walk over them and the pillows were too soft to provide any neck support.
Hemos estado muy a gusto durante la estancia. Recomendaríamos el lugar.
Rosa is super helpful and flexible. Apartment is spacious and well laid out. Sparingly furnished but it has what you need. Terrific location - love the neighborhood.

The apartment has everything needed to have a comfy stay even for remote work with  a dedicated space and fast wifi. The space was even bigger than the pictures, and Libor was really friendly and an excellent host, super recomended for any one that is hesitating in this place

Super modernes Apartment, mega Lage und auch klasse mit der Parkplatzsuche.
Würde jederzeit wieder herkommen!
Fijne, centrale plek voor een bezoek aan Berlijn!
Sehr nett und schöne Wohnung

The apartment was modern, clean, not too big but fine for a weekend.
The area is nice and not too far from the centre or from areas with restaurants.
The communication with the host via app was seamless and easy.
The cleaning staff in the building wasn’t super nice or available (hard to communicate when we needed help).
Reception hours could be more open.
eine gepflegte wohnung in ruhiger und geschichtsträchtiger lage! habe bestens geschlafen!

Absolut geniale Unterkunft mit vielen zusätzlichen Extras ( Räder, Boote, Grill, Spielplatz...) ohne Aufpreis! Wir haben uns super wohl gefühlt. Die Bungalows sind sehr schön, toll ausgestattet und von sehr umsichtigen und hilfsbereiten Vermietern angeboten, die immer erreichbar sind! Ein wahrer „Urlaubs-Schatz“ und hoffentlich nicht das letzte Mal für uns!
Es war ein wunderschöner Aufenthalt, vielen Dank 🙏 und ich komme gerne wieder.

Michael's communication was very good and I was able to get answers to all my questions in a short time. Also he is so sweet and friendly. The house was generally very clean and beautiful. It was easy to reach everywhere in terms of location and in a central location. I had a really good time and I said I'm glad I stayed here. Just not having the kitchen can be a problem for other people, but it wasn't necessary for me. Highly recommended!! 🫶🏽☺️
Appartement bien décoré, bien desservi par les transports en commun. Hôte très réactif. Seul le canapé n’est pas confortable, il faudrait le changer.

The room was spacious and comfortable, and the entire apartment was very clean. It’s located in a peaceful and calm neighborhood, with the added benefit of being super close to both the S-Bahn and U-Bahn, making travel around the city incredibly convenient and fast. The host was friendly and communicative.
However, there were some unusual rules regarding heating and ventilation. The host insisted on keeping the kitchen and bathroom windows open 24/7, even in November. While I closed them because it was too cold for me, she asked that I only do so temporarily, such as while using the bathroom, and then reopen them upon leaving. Additionally, the host required the heaters in the common areas to remain off, allowing me to turn them on only when I was actively using the bathroom or cooking in the kitchen. This is something I’ve never experienced before in my Airbnb stays. These rules made the common areas quite chilly, although my room was warm.
Aside from this, I enjoyed my stay overall.
Absolut nichts zu beanstanden! Alles top und empfehlenswert 😊

La ubicación es perfecta, puedes acceder a través del subway a todas partes, además hay un centro comercial a lado, lo que facilita todo. La comunicación muy buena. Frank siempre estuvo accesible. El lugar es exactamente como se ve en las fotos, y muy limpio. Excelente opción.
Hans' place had everything, from sewing repair kit to cooking utensils. Location and view was great. Hope to return soon.

Die Unterkunft ist super, alles zur vollsten Zufriedenheit. Top Lage für einen Berlinaufenthalt zum die City zu besuchen. U-Bahn in unmittelbarer Nähe, diverse gute Einkaufsmöglichkelten in unmittelbarar Umgebung.  Wir werden wiederkommen  :-)
Etienne and Judith were lovely hosts. The a apartment was as described and quite perfect for a brief 2-night stay in Berlin.
Super fint, meget centralt
like my previous review: thin walls and a little noisy but super clean and beautiful room
The apartment was great, and Stella was easy to communicate with.

A wonderful stay with some wonderful people!
Close to the subway/bus and close to some very nice public places.
Also not a far walk from some very beautiful clubs.
A public thanks to Reinhardt and his girlfriend!
Well appointed apartment in a great part of town.
Berlin'de vakit geçirmek için çok ideal. Yataklar rahat. Odalar geniş ve ferah. Bölge canlı ve güzel. Tavsiye ederim.

The TV had to be unplugged, or else it would just switch on after a few hours to show their "Welcome to Numa" screen. The fire alarm went off in the middle of the night and the whole building had to evacuate. Other than that it was good location, near u-bahn, clean rooms, good AC, looked like the pictures.
Great room in a nice quiet part of the city, close to the city center. My second stay here and would like to return some time
We had a great stay here. Lovely view of the area. Super resourceful amenities and very affordable. Would highly recommend you stay here!

Wunderschönes Zimmer mit fantastischer Dachterrasse in Köpenik. Stilvoll eingerichtet, sauber und ruhig. Gute Lage um mit dem Fahrrad Köpenik kennen zulernen.

hans peter a ete tres disponible et est tres serviable l'appartement est tres bien mais la situation à la sortie du metro avec drogues et sans abris est regrettable

Ich glaube am idealsten ist es für Leute, die alleine reisen, mit 2 Koffern und Taschen wurde es nämlich etwas eng. Das Bett war super.
Hosts und die Nachbarn sind überaus freundlich, zuvorkommend, hilfsbereit und immer erreichbar gewesen! Man ist auf jeden Fall gut aufgehoben.
Nothing to add.

Verblijf in dit appartement was absoluut fantastisch! . Het appartement was perfect schoon en had alles wat je nodig zou kunnen hebben voor een comfortabel verblijf. De inrichting was modern en stijlvol, met oog voor detail.
De locatie was ideaal!
De keuken was goed uitgerust en de woonkamer was heerlijk ruim en comfortabel

Nice place to stay for 1-2 days

Perfect base for a Berlin stay. The loft has character but the minimalist look and feel make it a calming bolthole after a day exploring. Beds were very comfortable and everything was as described. Communication was timely and clear. Would highly recommend.

Very Clean, great location for what we wanted to see/do. Great amenities!

Very comfortable space for two people or one. The bed was comfy and everything was very clean. Thank you!

Unterkunft gesucht für Event am Flughafen Tempelhof. Gefunden! Nur knapp 5 Minuten mit dem Auto entfernt. Ich kann nicht meckern. Alles da, was man braucht. In unmittelbarer Nähe auch Möglichkeit, sich etwas Essbares zu besorgen.

Villiam hat uns sehr freundlich in Empfang genommen und uns kurz die Wohnung gezeigt.
Auf den ersten Blick war sie ordentlich. Leider stellten wir fest, dass viele Küchenutensilien verkalkt waren (wie z.B. der Wasserkocher etc.) und sich überall Kalkflecken befanden. Zudem waren viele Töpfe unsauber. Einer davon war stark angebrannt. Ein Küchenbrett war ebenfalls stark verschmutzt und müsste aussortiert werden. Die Duschbrause war stark verkalkt und leckte, so das diese in ihrer Funktion stark eingeschränkt war. Auf den Badezimmerfliesen befanden sich ebenfalls starke Kalkflecken. Die Handtücher und Bettwäsche waren sauber. Leider war das Bett instabil, da es bei jeder kleinsten Bewegung knarrte, so das Ohropax notwendig waren. Am Ende ist es auseinander gebrochen. Vermutlich wurde vorher bereits versucht ein instabiles, "kaputtes" Bett auf Teufel komm raus nochmal zusammen "zu schustern". Wir waren sehr enttäuscht und haben den Gastgeber über alles informiert.

The location, however, was great, safe, and close to metro stations and markets right around the corner.

Ich war eine Woche lang zu Gast im individuell gemütlichen Haus von Jutta. Ruhig und sehr günstig gelegen, sei es zu Seen oder den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Das Doppelbett war leider ein Schlafsofa, das ist in meinem Alter nicht mehr so gut für den Rücken. Ansonsten alles sauber und problemlos.
Its a good place for low cost
Beautiful place in good central location.  The apartment was very nice, clean and open.  We enjoyed our stay and would stay again.
A really funky apartment with super- comfortable beds. Bathroom showers a bit tight for a tall person but we enjoyed the functions of Alexa
El departamento es espacioso, luminoso y confortable. El barrio tiene muy buenos restó y cafés.Muy recomendable. Un muy buen lugar para alojarse en Berlin.

Ich fand besonders gut, dass man nicht lange auf Mitarbeiter warten musste oder darauf dass sich jemand um einen kümmert. Ich habe vorab einen Code geschickt bekommen mit welchem ich ins Hotel und auch in mein Zimmer gekommen bin. Es war sehr sauber und alles exzellent beschrieben!

Sehr zu empfehlen!
Vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés! Le logement est top, très bien situé. Yaz est un hôte très sympa, de très bon conseils et disponible.

Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Wohnung. Sie hatte alles, was wir brauchten, sah wie auf den Bildern aus, Check-In klappte wie versprochen. Die ehemalige Bäckerei hat schon Charme. In der Nähe der Wohnung findet man alles, was man so braucht: einige Restaurants, Parks und Sehenswürdigkeiten, Supermärkte, diverse Anbindungen an die Öffis (Tram, S-Bahn, Bus...) und auch der Bahnhof befindet sich in Laufnähe (Dies war unser entscheidendes Auswahlkriterium: vom Bahnhof aus mit Gepäck ohne großes Ticketgeraffel zur Wohnung zu kommen und sich dann in Ruhe um das Wochenticket kümmern).  Die Gegend ist an und für sich relativ ruhig, was Verkehrslärm und/oder Menschenmassen etc. angeht. Man kann sich gut in der Wohnung aufhalten, auch wenn der Wohnraum direkt an die Straße geht. Dass wir zur Begrüßung auf dem Tisch schon mal einen Linienplan der U-/S-Bahnen und weitere Infos gefunden haben, hat uns den Start sehr erleichtert. Konnten uns sofort problemlos orientieren (selbst ich als Chaotin). In Namen meiner Reisebegleitung soll ich noch ausrichten, dass das Bett sehr bequem war und man gut darin schlafen konnte. Kommunikation und Schlüssel"übergabe" waren problemlos, flexibel und easy, worüber wir dankbar und erleichtert waren. Wir wussten einfach zu jeder Zeit, was uns erwartet und was zu tun war bzw. was von uns erwartet wurde.  Wir würden jederzeit wieder bei Alex wohnen.
Mycket fin lägenhet!

I stayed at Martin's house for a month and I really loved it! It's in the greatest location possible, near to the best coffee houses and bars, and the very beautiful Landwehrkanal. Public transportation is right next to the house, so you can get anywhere in the city very fast (most central places are 15 min away).
The room is spacious, nicely decorated and very comfortable. It has a lovely little balcony with a view to a beautiful yard. Even though in a very popular area, the street is actually quiet, so the house is quiet as well!
Martin is a very nice and cool person to live with, you will always hear nice stories from him and he can tell you a lot about Berlin and Germany (if you are a foreigner like me). He is extremely helpful and will try to accommodate you the best way possible during your stay.
It was amazing stay
Nice time was spent. I will definitely consider visiting again

Dorit’s place is super nice, 10min from the center, and if offers a complete different environment, in front of a beautiful lake. The fireplace helped to create a super cozy evening by the lake! Great apartment, very well located and equipped with everything one needs.
Phillip was a good host who allowed us to check in early which was appreciated. Also, the location of the apartment was great.
We really enjoyed the stay. The owner wwas really nice and he evn facilitate a late check out. I would 100% recommend it
Tolle Lage, gutes Frühstück, alles wie beschrieben!

Sauberes Zimmer und Handtücher. 👍

The room is soooo pretty, big and very nicely decorated. Hanyu was super arranging and fast to respond. The neighborhood is cool, cool stuff walking distance to do around. Really recommend!

Super Wohnung genial in Friedrichshain gelegen. Fotos und Beschreibung entsprechen absolut der Realität! The apartment is great, it’s located in the city center that helps to reach many places easily. The room was very cozy and pretty clear, with all necessary equipments for a short stay. We recommend this place and would be happy to get back here again :)

Die Kommunikation mit Alan&Kasia war sehr unkompliziert und schnell.

Great apt !! We were 8 people and stayed for 3 nights, big , clean and convenient! very nice neighborhood and super close to all transportation! Emma and Ben are very nice and the communication with them was great! We will definitely come back !!
wonderful stay in Berlin, great location and the apartment was wonderful. would highly recommend staying with Duc Son again!

Eine gemütliche, hübsche Dachwohnung eines Einfamilienhauses- in einem ruhigen, grünen Wohnquartier. Sehr bequem mit allem was man braucht. Sogar mit kleinem Balkon. Edeka in der Nähe für das wichtigste… Dorothea ist super hilfsbereit. Für mich ein perfektes Zuhause wenn wieder ILA Messe ist.

Thanks again for another great stay!

I cannot say enough about René’s wonderful tiny home!   René went above and beyond to make our experience comfortable and enjoyable.  His tiny home is spotless and built and designed with care.  He took the time to give us a tour of the home and all the features he’d added and was thinking of adding in the future as well.  We live in a tiny house in California and enjoyed hearing about Berlin’s solar power details and seeing René’s chickens and garden.  The value of the home and experience were more than expected on their own... but René also made us a fresh, home-made Breakfast with delicious bread and home-made jam before he left for work.  We would highly recommend this place to friends and love to come back ourselves in the future.

Great value for money and looks just like in the pics. Stella always responsive. Easy to get in.

Tolle Lage, super netter Empfang, sehr zuvorkommend und freundlich, Wohnung wunderschön...gerne wieder!

Good value for 3 people traveling together. It was in a convenient location 10 minutes walk from the nearest U Bahn station and very close to a great bagel shop which we frequented. Only complaint is the size of the shower which we could barely turn around in.

This is one of the best houses I've ever booked by Airbnb. It is exactly how it's showed in the pictures, maybe even better. A special mention must go to Simon and Ben, the owners. They've been very kind and always ready to answer all of our questions. From the day before our arrival, they gave us all of the informations we needed without even asking for them. Berlin is an amazing city, and the only bad thing is that I would have liked to spend more days in this apartment. Totally recommend it!

This spot is perfect for solo travelers who want to be near Potsdamer Platz.
Nice little apartment in a perfect location! Close to lots of restaurants and cafes, and a convenience store right on the block.

If you have a car, it is very easy and free to park. There is a shop near the place where you can find anything you need. Katharina is a very nice host and doesn't hesitate to give you some advice if you need. She is available when you need.

Highly recommend this place. Hosts are incredibly warm, kind, and good people. I felt very welcome and at home. The bed is so comfortable! The location is perfect with great public transportation. Don’t hesitate to book if looking for a comfortable and convenient stay in Berlin :)

Ute’s place was really comfortable and a short walk to the S-Bahn. The area and neighbourhood is nice and quiet. There’s a Lidl just across the road which was super handy too. All in all a good spot to come home to and relax after a day or night out. I’d happily stay here again.

We had a misunderstanding and he cancelled my reservation. I believe that’s European conduct in general. And he went ahead to state things I wouldn’t expect from a service provider. Again, misunderstanding doesn’t mean that it’s unresolvable. This man knew if he cancelled he could still get a portion of the reservation and he felt no need to have that conversation with me to find a solution to the problem we had.
I thought his place was nice and I would have enjoyed the weekend with my family and friends at his place. Unfortunately, money rules the world and not everyone gets the last word. Im sure he’s surely a good guy based on the reviews that made me want to come to his place.
Great place !

Das ist aber wegen des unmittelbar daneben liegenden Bades unproblematisch.
Juan Miguel ist ein sehr netter und professionell organisierter Gastgeber. Bei Problemen oder Fragen ist er gut erreichbar und antwortet schnell. Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Und komme gerne wieder.

Ein echt schönes Hotel. Das Zimmer war sehr geräumig und sehr nett eingerichtet. Es hatte alles was ich gebraucht habe. Die Lage ist auch ausgezeichnet mit der U-Bahn zu erreichen und man hat inder unmittelbaren Umgebung jede Menge Restaurants.
Steffen von Team war auch besonders hilfreich und ich komme gerne wieder.

Thank you Svitlana. We had a great time at your place. If you book this apartment then I recommend not only the place itself but the following restaurants. Turn right out of the door and try the Vietnamese. Turn left and cross the road for a marvellous kebab. The LIDL across the road is very handy.

the locks on the doors were a bit confusing but perhaps thats just me being english and its different locks but the place is lovely. a quiet small jewel-box of a place. the rooms were spotless plenty of amenities available to anyone one staying there. as well its relatively close to the train station as well as a beautiful park and plenty of places to grab food. had a brilliant stay!

Good place!!!

I've never stayed in a Berlin apartment as quiet as this one.  This studio-sized place at first struck me as being sterile -- However, I appreciated the interior design and aesthetics.  Other pros include: Good lamps, lighting and lighting options; agreeable colors (dark red kitchen cabinets, seafoam green closet and bedroom glass sliding doors); mechanically-operated exterior window shades.  Cons include: minimal kitchen cabinet space; shower could have used a glass door, instead of a curtain;  the main room was too small to accommodate the respective sizes of both the glass dining table and the two block-shaped armchairs; two small glass coffee tables that were "chained together" just took up space; and finally, I would have felt more comfortable with a coffee table & a dining table, with tabletops made out of something other than glass.  This place I chose for its location (close to Schöneberg).  Overall: the location is the main reason that I'd stay in this place again.

Vi var i denne lejlighed i 6 dage. Fordele:
- Lejligheden ligger 5 minutters gang fra Leopold Platz U-bahn hvor U6 og U9 kører.
- Lejligheden er nyrenoveret og møbler og inventar fremstår nyt.
- Der er flere indkøbsmuligheder i nærheden.
- Køkkenet er veludstyret.
- Jeg bad om en ekstra dyne og han kom samme dag med en. Tak for det.
Ulemper:
- Lejligheden ligger i stuen og har tidligere været en butik. Vinduerne er slørede og ikke lydisolerede og naboer mødes på gaden foran lejligheden hver aften. Det lyder derfor somom der er fest i soveværelset til kl. 2-3 om natten. Husk ørepropper.
Vi måtte have skodder for vinduerne hele tiden.
Derfor var lejligheden meget mørk.
Vinduerne til gaden kan ikke åbnes og vinduerne til gården går ud til skraldeområde.
- Fjernsynet i stuen er ikke sat til, men vi kunne alle sidde i sengen og se film.
Området er fint og der ligger restauranter og cafeer, men højlydte stemmer har gjort det svært at sove, og det var trist ikke at have en udsigt.
