Wir haben die Unterkunft zu viert für ein Wochenende in Berlin gebucht. Es lag gut zur U-Bahn und die Lage war recht ruhig für Berlin. Das Zimmer sieht aus wie auf den Fotos und sauber war es auch. Für unsere Zwecke war war es optimal.
Had a lovely stay at Karolinas! Very clean apartment and well equipped. She was very responsive and helpful. Would definitely stay again next time I’m in Berlin!

It was a nice place and nice area , the check in was fine. The flat is on the 4th floor though, it would have been nice if we had known it was so high up, with no lift. But we were given no instructions for check out and host wasn't contactable after many tries, so we left the key in the lock

Nice apartment close to the Berlin hbf and Alexanderplatz. Amazing view from a 21st floor. Comfortable for a group stay. Hae was always in communication to make sure we had no problems during our stay.

The Berlin Artist apartment is a great place with nice art and great amenities. It is a really comfortable space and is situated quite close to the ubahn/sbahn and tram which makes it really easy to get around. There are cool vintage stores and cafes surrounding the apartment, and Friedrichshain felt like a quiet and safe area in Berlin. Loved our stay there!
I can only recommend this place. We stayed here for three nights and loved it!  The details are amazing and we felt like queens in this apartment.  It was great!
Fabulous flat, very warm, modern appliances. Comfortable bed with a fabulous location. Quick response from Babett, a great stay I would recommend this place
Die Kommunikation mit Christina war super und über die Wohnung gibt es nichts negatives  zu sagen. Sauber, relativ ruhig und in absolut zentraler Lage im Wedding
Sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt. Bad war super sauber und sehr geräumige Wohnung.
A very spacious and comfortable place! Would recommend this space and stay again :) thank you so much
Es war alles super! Schöne, saubere Wohnung. Der Check-In und Check-Out verlief absolut problemlos.
It was a large room in a really beautiful flat with big windows and a lovely host.

Alles war gut. Der Vermieter war freundlich und mit der Check-Out Zeit entgegengekommend. Die Wohnung ist wie auf den Bildern. Durch das Kitty ist die Straße natürlich entsprechend belebt, aber die Fenster sind recht Schalldicht. Bass kann ein Fenster natürlich auch nicht abhalten, das war dann aber eher Musik aus vorbeifahrenden Autos.
Wir waren zufrieden :)

Good location, property was clean and tidy. Had a problem with the T.V but that's minor. This would be 5* but just finishing touches missing, which I think will be resolved as it really is brand new and lovely. Needs hooks for coats, maybe some in bedrooms. No coat hangers in any wardrobes, which was a shame as lots of space to hang if we had them. Bins needed in bedrooms. Tiny little things that can easily be added. Certainly wouldn't stop you from staying! Would also benefit from an info book in the main area for info/ T.V instructions etc but overall a great place to stay.
Thanx for the host.

Susanne was a great host. She greeted me in person, explained everything in the apartment and the city, and made the whole check in procedure feel more personal than other Airbnb locations. Her artist's studio was not only lovely to stay at, but also very unique through its design and history. It had everything you needed for your stay. This apartment is the perfect location to either explore Berlin further or stay at home on a rainy day and read or work on your projects. I would absolutely recommend this place to my friends and I would love to come back here next time I'm in the city. Thank you Susanne!!

top Lage, sehr nette Gastgeberinnen. Leider Federkissen, das ist blöd als Allergikerin. Das Wasser in der Dusche würde nicht warm und das Bad war eiskalt.
Das Klopapier war mehr Schmirgelpapier. Sonst alles top! :)

Très contentes de notre séjour à Berlin !
Mona est très gentille.
Le logement est proche du métro. La chambre est très propre.
Merci pour votre accueil :)

Super stylish top floor apartment in cool neighborhood!  We would definitely stay here again. Check-in was easy via keys in a lockbox, and landlords communicated through text.  Subway stations were an easy walk (10-15 min). The surrounding neighborhood is full of great restaurants and cool parks.  We bought groceries at the nearby aldi  supermarkets, and made meals in the wonderful kitchen.  Bear in mind, this is a fifth floor walk up, and the stairs will give you some exercise, but it’s so worth it to be in this space.

A perfect little apartment in the north end of Mauer Park, easy to walk to lots of places in a family-friendly neighborhood. Despite the small footprint, the apartment is spacious, and balcony is perfect for 2, and it was clean and orderly. Definitely recommend.

We had a great time at Simones apartment. It was bigger as expected and, very clean and well equiped. We rented some bikes at the flower store (100 metres) so all the things to see and do were within reach. The subway is also nearby so with a day-ticket you can also go everywhere you want. Thanks for your hospitality Simone!

My friend and I had a great time! The host was kind and it’s a good room for the price that you pay for it. However, if you are in need of an ergonomic bed or don’t like sleeping in close quarters with your travel partner, I do suggest a different room with a better bed.

Sven gave pre check in instructions to help us find the apartment, this was super easy. Laura met us at the apartment to check in and show us around. She was very accommodating with us being slightly delayed at the airport. The apartment was very clean with all amenities described. We had access to major transport links within a couple minutes walk.  Would recommend staying at this apartment for a visit to Berlin.

équipement et cuisine trop minimaliste pour y prévoir des repas. le reste de l'appartement correspondait au descriptif. nous avions une ampoule principale d'une chambre qui ne fonctionnait pas et n'avons pas eu de retour de notre hôte a ce sujet. l'emplacement était idéal ( opter pour le métro a droite en sortant et non à gauche moins bien fréquenté) et l'arrière cours agréable quoi que bruyante. site idéal pour de cours séjour, moins agréable pour des séjours de plus de 3 jours.
sehr gute erfahrung gehabt

The apartment is as described, basic but functional and a good value for the neighborhood. The neighborhood is convenient, close to the center city and museums.
The staff needs to up their game. This is the first Airbnb we have used where they neither met you at the property to answer questions nor had anything in writing to give information about restaurants or other amenities in the neighborhood. But we did text and ask for restaurants. The suggestions were dives though eventually we did find nice restaurants . We asked if the washer was a washer/dryer and how to use it and got an answer 2 days later while we were at the airport.

Absolutely loved my recent stay! Boris proactively reached out and was incredibly helpful with any questions I had. The kitchen was fully equipped and cozy with the plants, the bedroom was spacious, and the bathroom, though small, was perfect. Highly recommend and can't wait to come back! 🖤

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und die Großstadt Berlin einfach und schnell, aber eben auch von einer ruhigen und grünen Gegend aus erkundet. Die Ausstattung war genau, wie wir es brauchen. Stefan hat auch praktische Infos in einem Ordner bereitgelegt und in einem Bücherregal standen gefühlte 40 Berlin-Führer aller Couleurs, in denen wir tatsächlich gerne gestöbert haben. Schön war auch, dass wir uns gut in der Küche einfache Sachen zubereiten konnten - das machte uns noch unabhängiger.  Was für ein toller Aufenthalt! Danke!!

Had an extremely pleasant stay. Very cool spot surrounded by lots to do and not too far from the central city attractions. Would highly recommend! Buy an all day metro ticket using the metro app and go traveling all around Berlin!
beautiful and clean flat. Fabian is young and polite man.

The apartment is in a great location, very close to a main train station and supermarket. My parents stayed there and they were very comfortable (it was also very good that it had an elevator). The communications with the management were very easy and fast.

While the trappings of the location were fairly basic, it was very clean, and Daniel, the host, was very friendly and available to help or answer questions. He even carried my bags to the first room I booked, and when I saw it it didn’t have an additional bed, he carried the bags to another room! He also had good suggestions about places to see in the area.
Host was very kind and helpful. Had a pleasant stay here.
Worth the journey as my daughter lives furthest east of Berlin and great location
与房东沟通很好，房子位置很好，走路去柏林墙遗址公园大概5分钟不到，去勃兰登堡门骑车10多分钟。有毛巾费和床单费，毛巾费不用的话，可以不用给。
Great place

Petra is a superhost! If I go back to Berlin I would stay at her place. Highly recommended for travellers, apartment is very nice with so many little details, excelent bfst, very well located close to the airport and local transportation. I have had feeling like her old friend. Thank you Petra.

Great apartment overlooking the beautiful Berlin sites. This apartment has everything you could ever need including a spacious balcony, kitchen, bedroom, lounge and bathroom. Their were really useful maps and local guides including the home and even had cooking amenities if you want to create your very own currywurst. The building is modern, safe and secure with an elevator and is walkable to everywhere! Michael is also an incredibly patient host (I was stupid enough to try and get into the wrong apartment in a whole different building!)- you should do yourself a favour and book this if you get the chance😊

Amazing apartment in a very central location! The apartment is beautiful, beds were very comfortable and the shower is spectacular! Stephanie is an amazing host and we would definitely recommend this place to anyone staying in Berlin! X
Wonderful modern apartment in tree-lined neighborhood only a ten minute walk to S Bahn station. Great host and excellent amenities.
Appartment super well located in the center of Berlin. Ideal to go for a few days, having the most important things very close to the appartment at walking distance. Recommended!

Wir haben uns superwohl gefühlt. Megazentrale Lage. Bequeme Betten mit allerbestem Kissen. Viel Platz. Tageslichtbad. Fenster, mit denen super gelüftet werden kann. Astreines leckeres Frühstück im Café🥰
Den Schlüssel bekommt man bei Anreise direkt im Café. Der Hinweis hat mir persönlich gefehlt, daher war ich im Vorfeld etwas nervös ob alles klappt.
5 Sterne ⭐️

Schöne, gut ausgestattete Wohnung, mit Terrasse und Garten. Für einen Familieurlaub sicherlich perfekt.
Bus und S-Bahn gut erreichbar, dennoch dauert es etwas, bis man in der Mitte Berlins ist.
Daher für unseren Zweck (2 Freundinnen auf Kurztrip) etwas (zeit-)ungünstig gelegen. Dank Uber/Bolt konnten wir aber auch die Stecke zum Südkreuz mit Gepäck gut händeln.
CheckIn/Out sehr unkompliziert und Kommunikation fix.
Fazit: empfehlenswert!

Fijne plek, een nacht rustig, tweede nacht onrustig door gebruik badkamer in de vroege ochtend.
Alles aanwezig.
Alojamiento familiar en un entorno maravilloso. Es como sentirse en un paraíso a pesar de que se encuentra a las puertas de una metrópolis. Volveremos con toda seguridad.
Bel appartement fonctionnel
Die Wohnung ist wie beschrieben alles hat optimal funktioniert gerne kommen wir wieder

Am späten Vormittag gebucht und schon am frühen Nachmittag checkin möglich.
Das Hotel verfügt über kostengünstige Parkplätze. Frühstück ist zusätzlich buchbar. Checkin, Checkout und Aufenthalt sind unkompliziert. Ich war zufrieden.
The place is clean, spacious, well located, and offers great value. Hosts are effective and clear in their communication. 5 of 5 across the board!

Sehr sauberes und schön möbliertes Zimmer. Relativ zentral gelegen mit einer tollen Aussicht über der Stadt. Die Gastgeberin ist sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend, die Kommunikation hat super geklappt. Kann ich nur weiterempfehlen 👍

The apartment itself is very nice and in a great location but not really made for 4 people, there were shutters only in the bedroom. The living room was warm and bright, plus it wasn't a sofa bed but inflatable mattresses.
Also the air conditioning didn't work so it was extremely hot and difficult to sleep in the morning.
Die Unterkunft war genau wie beschrieben alles sauber und die Kommunikation hat super funktioniert.

Sehr freundlicher Gastgeber. Konnten unkompliziert länger im Zimmer bleiben. Frisch renoviert und eingerichtet. Ein eher schlichtes, sauberes Zimmer, zu einem guten Preis-Leistungsverhältnis. Zum Übernachten absolut okay. Gerne wieder.
Excelente ubicación! Excelente departamento, muy cerca de todo. Excelente. Lo recomiendo ampliamente
Bis auf den ewig dauernden Check in eine echt super Unterkunft mit genialer Lage! Viel los in der Gegend, vor allem am Abend, perfekt für junge Leute👍🏻
Very nice stay, just as described.
Perfect central location for our trip - beautiful views too! Ticked all the boxes. Ivos was lovely and always responsive too

조용하고 안전한 동네에 위치한 숙소였습니다. 치안이 좋아서 저녁에 돌아다녀도 무섭지 않았어요.
집 근처에 지하철, 버스정류장, 슈퍼, 약국이 있어서 유용하게 이용했습니다.
호스트도 정말 친절했고, 깨끗하고 아늑한 집을 제공해 주셨습니가. 덕분에 베를린에서 편안하고 좋은 시간 보내다 갑니다!
베를린에서 혼자 머무를 조용한 숙소를 찾으신다면 이 곳을 추천드리고 싶습니다!

Lo bueno fue que en la casa se estaba caliente y fueros muyamables para explicarnos la llegada. Aun así cabe mencionar que, durante la estancia hubo algunas cosas que nos resultaron un poco incómodas. Debido a que son “superanfitriones” (la categoría que establece Airbnb), esperábamos que fuese todo muy bien. Pero por ejemplo, no había champú ni acondicionador en el baño disponibles para nosotros. Sólo podíamos usar un gel, y sus productos de baño (champú y acondicionador) los ponían bajo un cartel que ponía “privado”. También cabe mencionar que un día que estábamos tratando de dormir por la tarde no pudimos, había mucho ruido en la cocina, y desde la habitación se oye mucho lo que sucede en la cocina. Podíamos escuchar su conversación muy alto. También invitaron a unos amigos mientras estábamos nosotros en la casa, lo cual dificultó la disponibilidad de usar el baño, y debido al ruido hubo una tarde que tampoco pudimos tomar la siesta. Por último, no nos explicaron nada de la ciudad.
excellent place
Super einfache Abwicklung und nette Kommunikation. Wohnung auch super sauber, alles top!
Great place!  Very easy communication and check in, clean and organized.  In a great location to walkable sites.

The beauty of Airbnb is that you end finding friends all around the world; just by sharing their/your long space. Carsten and his family's habitat, including their flat, their lovely neighbours and the neighbourhood are for me prime location in Berlin. He is a great guy and I can tell this without ever meeting him in person... Yet.
An Airbnb highly recommended. I will be back.
It's was fit for purpose. Everything is available but little bit far from the city center

Joseph is super host - very warm, always reachable and super helpful. The flat is located very well in the heart of kreuzberg, right opposite Golitzer park surrounded by bars, restaurants and pretty much anything you can think of. The vibe is super chill, and a very unique pocket of Berlin with its own personality. Loved our holiday, loved the apartment which itself is well lit and super cosy - doesn’t let you leave easily. All in all - one of our best stays yet. Will visit again for sure.
Tolle Lage. Sehr angenehm, schlicht, sauber und schön eingerichtet. Wunderbar flexibel beim Check-In, Check-Out, Zugang, Verlängerung etc. Gute Kommunikation. Habe mich sehr wohlgefühl.
wonderful place, very easy communication!
Super gelegen. Gutes Smart-Konzept.
great place!

Wij hebben een zeer prettig verblijf gehad bij Arzu & Tom! Ontvangst was erg gastvrij en vriendelijk. Een keurige en schone accommodatie van alle belangrijke gemakken voorzien, zoals een eigen keuken en sanitair, maar bv. ook een föhn. Fijn eigen balkonnetje. Iets buiten het dynamische centrum van Berlijn, maar daardoor wel lekker rustig en het centrum is makkelijk en snel te bereiken met het openbaar vervoer. Het is een wat ouder pand met houten vloeren; als je licht slaapt, zou je soms wat last van je bovenburen kunnen hebben. Dit was voor ons geen (groot) probleem.
Het is het geld meer dan waard geweest!
Mike 是我见过最友善最绅士的房东，他既会主动为你介绍附近的交通情况，为你提供帮助，又会严格保护好你的隐私，在这里的入住体验是安全、舒适且温暖的。房间和照片上一样，甚至更好，明亮且宽敞，还有一个自己的小阳台，Mike 在房间里准备了非常多可能用到的物品，非常贴心。另外，这里绝对是你在旅行时住过最干净的地方之一，这很重要。
Unkompliziertes Check Inn , super sauber .., direkt an der Straße gibt es Cafés sowie Drogeriemarkt - alles in einem Top ! Weiter so ... 🔝👌🏽
Logement pas très propre, lavabo bouché quand on est arrivé. Présence de cafards dans un lit...
Hat alles super gepasst! Klare Empfehlung! 🙏🏻
Sehr netter Kontakt. Klasse Unterkunft. Absolute Empfehlung. Gerne wieder.
Good and cheap hostel, nice to stay if your just flying by and spend your time in the city. hard to communicate with certain staff people but manageable

The problem is that Homaris (the company that owns the place listed here) has none integration with A&B, everything is mostly done at their page (which is not listed) or through e-mail (which, you guessed! is also not listed).
Checking in from the page is pretty easy but the fact that I had to spent 40 minutes in google trying to find some contact information really made it cumbersome to get in side.
Also, reserving from the page is cheaper than doing so at A&B.
The location is okay, a little far from downtown and the S-Bahn is literally less than 20 meters away from the window so is uncomfortably well connected and noisy.
Overall I would not recommend it, I think is expensive, not very well located, noisy, the communication is precarious and I am sure you can get a similar deal with better perks if you look somewhere else.

Wir hatten eine super Zeit in Stefan's Apartment. Die Kommunikation un Checkin/-out verliefen reibungslos, die Lage ist sehr zentral mit gutem ÖV-Anschluss und die Wohnung war sauber und mit allem Nötigen ausgestattet. Definitiv zu empfehlen!

Peter's place was perfect for our few days in Berlin. It's a large space so it's nice to hang out if you have a larger group. There's wifi in the cafe, but not in the apartment. You also have to climb  decent amount of steps. Would definitely stay again though!

It was a very nice stay. Exceptionally clean place. Very friendly host. Depisite shared kitchen the host behaved in a very appropriate way respecting our privacy.  I'm recommending the place quite honestly!

Its a quiet place. Restaurants, Bars, Shops and a Park are nearby.
Its not luxuary but its comfortable and the equipment fullfills all basic needs of living.
What i like the most, is that it is directly located in the nightlife area of Friedrichshain.
Good stay, ideal location
Mein Zimmer war etwas kleiner wie auf den Bildern aber alles in allem super. Würde ich wieder buchen.
A very quiet appartment with a nice atmosphere in a great part of Berlin.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Stefan. C'est la deuxième fois que nous venons à Berlin dans cet appartement, tout confort et super bien décoré ☺️. Nous adorons le quartier, emplacement idéal pour visiter Berlin tout en étant au calme. Nous reviendrons 😄

Die Wohnung ist wirklich sehr schön, super ausgestattet und ideal gelegen sowohl für Aktivitäten in Prenzlauer Berg wie auch Berlin allgemein. Schlüsselübergabe hat problemlos funktioniert, sehr nette  Betreuung vor Ort durch Ingrid. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und kommen gerne wieder :-)
Great location, spacious and stylish apartment, enjoyed staying here. Recommend!

Henrik’s flat is very comfortable and very well situated to visit Berlin. Less than 5m from the U-Bahn (Senefelder Platz) and from one of the best area in Berlin : Prenzlauer Berg ! Communication with Henrik was really fast and easy.
I highly recommend his flat to discover Berlin !

This apartment is great for a family to stay in. Our daughter felt right at home and slept very well. The host was friendly and responsive. It’s a nice area to stay in if you want a great visit to Berlin. The location is great.
Spacious house for a big group
Nice place 👌🤙👍
Very nice we loved it. It's cost for friends and especially couples as it's only one room with a bathroom attached. Location next to Reichstag and Brandenburger Tor

This is absolutely a great apartment in the perfekt spot in our opinion! Prenzlauer Berg is one of the most relaxed and cool neighbourhoods in Berlin, and you are never far away from anything, tram stops outside and the U-bahn is only a few minutes walk! Everything was clean, the beds were good, there was even a bathtub to take a bath after a long day in the city... We will surely come back and recommend it highly :)

Liebevoll eingerichtete Wohnung, sehr sauber.
Tolle Lage, viele Cafés & Restaurants in der Nähe. Lebensmittelgeschäfte und Bäckereien gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Gute Anbindung in die Innenstadt.
Barbara ist freundlich und reagiert immer schnell auf Nachrichten.
Ich habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt.
Klare Empfehlung!
Alles super !!!

A big room in an old nice appartment located in what may be the only quiet street in Friedrishchain. There are tram, U-bahn and S-bahn stations within a 5 minutes walk. Herrmann was kind and helpful and can give a lot of informations.

A lovely compact apartment that is perfectly for 1 or 2 persons. The apartment is very clean and comfortable. You may need to climb up a bit but it wont tire you out. Also Great location with a short walk to underground station. Awesome Bars and restaurants nearby too. Our host is also very kind, responsive and sincere. Everything you can ask for for a nice stay in Berlin
Beautiful quiet apartment with lots of space. Easy for visiting Berlin. Lovely and responsive host. We had a great stay!

The property is in a great part of Berlin with easy access to the subway and buses, Tegel Airport and to downtown Berlin. The neighborhood is very quit, there are little markets for groceries, local restaurants to eat, parks near by and lots of nice architecture. My room was clean and conformable and it was easy to check in as all the information I needed was send to me as soon as I booked. The property is undergoing some renovations and that is the reason I said my stay was good and not great as when the renovations are made, it will be even better. I would recommend staying here.
Schöne Unterkunft in einer schönen Gegend!
Habe so gut geschlafen wie zuhause- angenehm ruhig und süßes Vogelgezwitscher vom Garten

The place is amazing with High ceiling rooms with an elegant color pop of red. Andrew was very responsive and gave us great recommendations. With the subway stop nearby, it’s easy to get around the city! Also, the nespresso was on point.

Das Zimmer ist schön, die Wohnung toll eingerichtet. Alles ist sauber. Uns hat der Aufenthalt sehr gefallen, wobei ich nächstes Mal gerne länger bleiben würde. Darum waren wir viel unterwegs in dieser kurzen Zeit und waren leider nicht viel in der Wohnung. Ich würde aber jedem einen Aufenthalt bei Markus empfehlen.

Appartement très bien placé, très agréable, bien équipé... Rien à dire, Excellent !
Nous le conseillons.
Super séjour, cadre idéal et accueil aux petits oignons.
it was a great airbnb for 3 people.

Große, stylische Wohnung in toller Lage!
Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und ist modern eingerichtet. Check-in/Check-out und die Kommunikation mit dem Host haben einwandfrei funktioniert.
Keine 30m von der Ubahn-Station entfernt, ist diese Wohnung wunderbar gelegen. Mit dem Bahnhofszoo ist auch ein größerer Verkehrspunkt in unmittelbarer Nähe. Man erreicht alle Sehenswürdigkeiten und wichtigen Orte in der Stadt schnell und ohne Probleme.
Eine schöne Unterkunft, die wir jederzeit wieder buchen würden!
Super Unterkunft
Sehr praktisches Studio an guter Lage, um Berlin zu erkunden. Fulvia ist eine nette Gastgeberin und antwortet jeweils rasch auf Fragen.

Eine wirklich sehr schöne Unterkunft, die genau den Bildern entspricht. Sie ist sauber und mit allem ausgestattet, was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt brauchen könnte.
Eine Bushaltestelle ist fast direkt vor der Tür und auch die S-Bahn ist nicht weit entfernt.
Die Kommunikation war zudem immer schnell und sehr freundlich.
unvergessliche Erlebnisse! Vielen Dank!
Nette Kommunikation,  hat alles, was man braucht und war sehr sauber. Sollte man super geräuschempfindlich sein, sollte man sich bewusst sein, dass die Zimmer an einer Straße liegen..
Wir hatten eine schöne Zeit bei Jörn
sehr nett Mensch und schöne Wohnung
Spacious apartment on the ground floor, near public transport and  shops. Nice hosts.
great location, very clean linen and towels.

I wasn’t going to leave a review after
1. I arrived to find the apartment hadn’t been cleaned after the previous guests.
2. I returned from waiting for someone to clean the apartment to find my toiletries and groceries had all been thrown out.
What compelled me, however, was when I was blamed by the owner for my things being thrown out. “You should know to move your things if someone is coming to clean.” But firstly, my bags were already open, indicating I was using the space. Secondly, when I called/sent photos about the place being dirty, I was indicating the trash, used dishes, and lack of bedding. And thirdly, his condescension that I should have hidden my items before the cleaner arrived doesn’t make sense for the perishable items I was already storing in the fridge. I also had to buy my own toilet paper, the kitchen light didn’t work, and he told me the neighbors were reporting on me to him which made me uncomfortable as a young adult staying alone. The apartment itself was nice

Ben was more than welcoming, he also accomated a very late request for us to check in early.
The loft is awesome as per the photos and description.
The location is a great spot, a great view overlooking the park can keep you entertained from the outdoor terrace.

Großer Vorteil: Lage und Anbindung (Seen, Kultur, Innenstadt). Edeka fußläufig. Kleiner Nachteil: Toiletten-Sitzplatz etwas eng (liegt an der Bauweise des Bades). An heißen Tagen wird es ziemlich schnell warm in der Wohnung, es steht aber ein gut funktionierender Säulenventilator bereit. Sehr positiv: Waschmaschine mit integriertem Trockner. Alles in allem war es ein guter Aufenthalt.

Chris ist ein super Gastgeber. Sehr flexibel und hat immer schnell auf die Nachrichten reagiert.
Die Wohnung war auch super, sowie bei Airbnb beschrieben.
Gerne kommen wie wieder :)

die Lage ist sehr gut und Sven ist ein sehr netter Mensch. ich empfehle diesen Unterkunft mehrmals!
위치도 좋고 깔끔합니다~
Great stay! Would definitely recommend.

The apartment is at a very central location, close the Berlin central train station and is therefore very well connected.
Thiago is a very warm and welcoming host. A very jolly fellow and wonderful person.
There was a miscommunication from my side about my checkin time that caused inconvenience to Thiago but he was kind enough to let it go.
Everything went well throughout my stay.

Laura’s place was very well located and very clean. The mezzanine sleeping area is pretty hot in summer months and although the sleeping area was absolutely fine for us, it’s worth noting that it requires a level of agility to get up and down from due to the narrow staircase and low ceiling! We had a wonderful time in Berlin, and this apartment played a big role. The location is outstanding as it's so close to the two Bahn stops, but on a street that is very quite in a great neighborhood. The apartment worked well for our family of five, and we highly recommend it! Bernd was a great host.

A beautiful apartment in a fantastic location. Just a few hundred metres from bus lines and the subway, with lovely restaurants and bars in walking distance! Pia was also very helpful and always responded quickly to our messages.

Martin’s apartment is excellent, and Martin and is  a gracious and communicative host. The building itself is an old Soviet tower, and Martin’s apartment is on the top floor. The apartment faces south and has gorgeous views particularly at sunset. There is cool Soviet-era art in the lobby. Apartment looks exactly like the photos. Two great Italian restaurants are across the street, and you can walk to cafes, grocery store, etc. You’re also only a block from the subway or a quick Uber ride from just about anything in Berlin. I have stayed at over 100 airbnbs, and this is one of the best places I’ve ever stayed. I would live in Berlin and Martin’s place in a New York minute. Thanks, Martin!
Es war wieder alles wunderbar und ich habe mich super wohl gefühlt. Absolut angenehme Atmosphäre :) Freu mich auf das nächste Mal!
Der Aufenthalt war sehr positiv und hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Check in war einfach, Kommunikation sehr gut.
Perfect spacious place in a great area - very good value for price

Très joli studio bien agencé, décoré avec goût et bien équipé.
L’environnement est calme, donnant sur la cour d’un immeuble. Le logement est situé dans un quartier verdoyant tranquille mais avec plein d’activités a quelques minutes de marche (marché, restaurant, bar, promenade le long du canal…)
Le métro est à 6-7 minutes à pied.
Une amie d’Ina nous a accueillies et nous a donné plein de bonnes adresses toutes proches.
Bref, nous recommandons ce logement, pas tout à côté des monuments les plus connus mais installé dans un quartier vivant et agréable où l’on goûte la « vraie » vie berlinoise.
Alloggio molto bello in stile industrial, in zona molto tranquilla, si dorme molto bene, solo nella cucina non c’è sale e olio per cucinare ma per il resto tutto ottimo, ci tornerei volentieri

It was a great experience. The flat is in a very nice area with lots of cafes and restaurants and very close to the tram and metro station. Very easy to get from the airport. Everything was just like the pictures and all amenities work fine.
Really a excellent experience. Super nice and clean flat in a super area. Søren the host was very precise and quick to reply with helpfull and super good advice on the area. All was excellent!!!!
Very nice room !

Logement très propre et plus grand que sur les photos. Bien desservi malgré son emplacement un peu excentré de Berlin.
Nous avons trouvé de bons restaurants dans le quartier.
Coincide con la descripcion, recomendable.
Carsten’s place is great - it is a very convenient location, very clean and Carsten is a very quick communicator. We had a great stay and would stay here again if we return to Berlin.
Alles war super und die Wohnung wie beschrieben. Auch die Kommunikation und Check-In waren unkompliziert und professionell. Danke Carsten :)

Pour Berlin, ce logement est un bon rapport qualité/prix.
Globalement nous avons passe un séjour tres agreeable - nous avons apprécie le parc a cote, les commerces de proximité, la literie confortable et le quartier calme.
L'essentiel était au rendez vous. Toutefois, le lave linge était en panne, les finitions dans les salles d'eau (douche/WC) pourraient être plus soignée. On était content de trouver ce logement et on retournerait a l'avenir.
Man konnte sich an Kaffee und Tee bedienen, was mir sehr gut gefallen hat.

Wir haben einige schöne Tage in Berlin verbracht.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist fantastisch!
My friends and I spent 5 days in Berlin in this apartment and we really enjoyed our stay. It has supermarkets, a train station and lots of restaurants nearby. Totally recommend it!
Great little home to stay when visiting Berlin. Only downside is it is a 10 min walk to the nearest tram station.
Stefan und seine Frau sind super nette Gastgeber. Die Unterkunft ist sehr gut angebunden ans ÖV Netz.  Es gibt in der gegegend verschiedene Orte zum Einkaufen und Essen gehen.

This place is fantastic and offers an authentic, live like a local Berliner experience. A modern, renovated apartment in an older courtyard building - typical Berlin style. The neighborhood has several cafés, restaurants and shops right outside the door, and a U-Bahn (subway) stop is just up the street. Would definitely recommend this place and would stay here again.

Tolle Gastgeber, sauberes Zimmer mit einfacher Ausstattung.
Wen es nicht stört sich ein Bad mit dem Nachbarzimmer zu teilen ist hier gut aufgehoben. Die Unterkunft befindet sich in der Nähe des ZOB Berlin und das Schloss Charlottenburg sind fußläufig zu erreichen.
Wer buddistische Seminare besuchen möchte kann hier hervorragend dazulernen.

Location can’t be beat.
A street full of galleries. A grocery store around the corner. A bakery couple doors down, a wine store around the corner and an Italian deli on the next block. Go to hackescher market metro take the S9 train all the way to and from airport. Short walk to place. Was perfect for what I needed.
Absolut easy. Sauber, tolles Bett, totales Berlin Feeling!! Zentral alle coolen places to be in Laufdistanz

I enjoyed staying for a month, as it was cozy and comfortable place. Warm welcoming and quick response by the host, easily accessible to S/U-Bahn Station/grocery, in the midst of Tiergarten(I could concentrate well on my tasks in quite area), peaceful view, etc. I recommend this place! :)
Bon rapport qualité - prix.

Die Wohnung entspricht genau den Angaben und den Bildern der Anzeige.
Das Zimmer ist schön eingerichtet und für zwei Personen hat es eine gute Größe. Die Wohnung ist in einem Altbau, daher schön hohe Decken.
Mit Marlene und ihrem Mann wohnt noch eine kleine liebe Hündin in der Wohnung.
Wir hatten gute Gespräche mit den beiden Gastgebern und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Die Lage ist auch toll, nicht zu laut und trotzdem nah an allem dran.
Super easy Check-In, sehr sauberes und gut ausgestattetes Zimmer. Wurden mega nett empfangen und die Lage ist super.
Very nice and well-equiped appartment with great view!

It was a nice and comfortable stay. The place was well connected to central city and Tegel Airport.
However, we had to wait for sometime for the hot water in the bathroom, which unless you not in hurry, is not a huge problem.
She is quite helpful and nice to chat with.
super kommunikation und flexibler gastgeber! sehr freundlich
Das Hostel bietet einen tollen Service in einem historischen, schön modernisiertem Gebäude. Die Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sind sehr  freundlich und helfen gerne.
Asunnon esteettisyys ja sijainti, puhtaus ja sisäilmanlaatu tekivät asumisesta viihtyisää. Majoittajat vastasivat hyvin viesteihin ja asioiminen heidän kanssaan oli hyvää.

Agnes und ihr Mann sind tolle Gastgeber, sehr herzlich, unkompliziert, hilfsbereit. Hat alles super geklappt und ich hatte einen schönen Aufenthalt. Die Lage der Wohnung ist ebenfalls prima, man kann von dort aus sehr viel zu Fuß machen. Das Zimmer ist sauber, gemütlich und ruhig mit einem schönen Ausblick in den Garten.
Bei meinem nächsten Berlin-Aufenthalt gern wieder. :-)
Absolute Weiterempfehlung!
L’alloggio era pulitissimo e sono stati molto disponibili con l il check in anticipato sebbene il poco preavviso
War alles super!Nur zu empfehlen
Nice place, nice host

He was a great host, and very responsve to my messages. his flat was clean and very well equipped. It was also really close to the metro station so it is very convinient to travel, super market also around the corner.

Schicke kleine Unterkunft in Pankow. Durch die Lage im Hinterhof ist es auch sehr ruhig und angenehm.
In der Umgebung befinden sich viele kleine Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten des täglichen Bedarfs. Parken ist in den Parallelstraßen kostenfrei möglich.

Olivier's family flat is huge and stylish. We stayed when the weather wasn't great but the flat was very warm and comfortable; in the summer I'm sure the balcony would come into its own. It's very quiet as it overlooks courtyards, not the street. There are four bedrooms, and in three of them the beds are raised platforms, accessible via a ladder; in the fourth there are bunkbeds and a single bed. This wasn't a problem for us but worth bearing in mind if you don't like climbing up to bed! There's a big sofa, dining table and a well-equipped kitchen.
The area is fun - great local restaurants, plus on the Thursday night we went to Markthalle Neun for street food and a great atmosphere - only ten minutes away. It's close to Gorlizter Banhof U-bahn station so getting around was easy. Kreuzberg is gritty, urban, cool, full of vintage shops and great food, graffiti-covered, central and interesting.
We were lucky enough to meet Olivier to hand over the keys and he was charming, helpful and super-friendly. Personally, I really like staying in someone's actual flat, rather than a holiday-rental apartment; this one was a real gem. Highly recommended!

I stayed here 3 months and I never met any problem
The room is spacious, clean and the whole place, very quiet! The view from the window is perfect.
Christian is also very helpful! Thank you Christian!
Unterkunft ist sehr zu empfehlen. Gut zu erreichen, leichter Check-In, alles vorhanden wie beschrieben und sehr sauber!
Great apartment, very clean and well located! 👌🏼
Very cozy place, felt right at home. The neighbourhood is nice as well, lots to see around. Boris was very helpful too :)
Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber, Agnes und ihr Mann sind sehr freundlich und ich kann sie als Gastgeber nur weiterempfehlen! Danke!
Chill neighborhood.  Cool decor. Great kitchen for making dinners.  High ceilings.  Great available light any time of day.  Awesome host.
Lovely apartment in a great location. Communication was easy and helpful. Fully recommended host/apartment.

Samuel was a very responsive and friendly host and gave us lots of recommendations for activities and travel around Berlin. The space was lovely, it was great having two bedrooms and the bathroom was beautiful and clean. There was enough kitchen equipment to save money making breakfast and lunch at home if you wish. Easy to travel into central Berlin or to lakes etc nearby.

Fantastic location - a few steps away from the nicest parts of Prenzlauer and the local U-bahn, but tucked away in an inner courtyard so very peaceful and quiet.  The apartment was well equipped, and Kerstin was very welcoming.  Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
Frank is a really nice host. So proactive and responsive!! Best place for tourism in Berlin! Thanks Frank.
Clean, quiet, spacious room, lovely hosts! Will be happy to come back again :)

Yamen은 너무 친절한 호스트였습니다!
덕분에 베를린을 아주 잘 즐길 수 있었어요.

즐거운 숙박이었습니다😊
I had a lovely stay here. Bryn was proactive and communicative. The entire process was very smooth. The apartment was excellent and the neighborhood is lovely and walkable.

Wir waren rundum zufrieden. Die Wohnung hat eine super Lage (Supermarkt, Feinkostläden, Restaurants etc. gleich um die Ecke). Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und funktional ausgestattet. Die Kommunikation mlt dem Vermieter verlief reibungslos.

Wir waren für 2 Nächte bei Carola :)
Carola hat uns persönlich und super freundlich empfangen.
Es ist ein sehr schönes, sauberes, ruhig gelegenes Apartment. Alles vorhanden. Hatten kurz Probleme mit dem WLAN, wobei uns aber sofort geholfen und die Sache behoben wurde.
Die Lage ist schon recht weit außerhalb zur Innenstadt. Aber zur nächsten S-Bahn sind es max. 10 Minuten Fußweg. Und das S und U-Bahn Netz in Berlin sind ja super einfach und schnell zu verstehen, also alles kein Problem :)
Im Apartment selbst ist alles vorhanden was man braucht. Das Bett ist toll, die Einrichtung generell sehr hübsch und einen Parkplatz haben wir jederzeit direkt an der Straße gefunden. Sehr schöne, ruhige Wohngegend.
Uns hat es wirklich gut gefallen und wir würden auch auf jeden Fall wieder bei Carola buchen :)

Jens's apartment was absolutely fantastic. Very clean and comfortable! It was a very easy experience meeting with marco who was friendly and had some good local advice. Would definitely recommend staying here to anyone looking to stay in a centrally located apartment in Berlin.

Notre arrivée dans l appartement a été facile, et l'appartement correspondait à la description. L emplacement était très bien et les places de stationnements très appréciables. Après l appartement n est pas luxueux et pas très bien isolé au niveau phonique, mais le rapport qualité prix reste correcte.

Really lovely apartment and as you'd expect from the pictures. It's in a good location particularly for food - streetfood Thursdays in markthalle neun, burgermeister and Wu Kong all great and closeby. Fritz is a great host who was always quick to respond if we had queries. Flight was delayed but we kept in touch and he made arrangements for our arrival.

Zentrale Unterkunft in beliebter, belebter Lage. Sie Lage im Hinterhof reduziert den Lärm der Großstadt, die aber logischerweise dennoch zu hören ist.
Die Unterkunft ist sauber, groß und geräumig, sodass man sich auch dort wohlfühlen kann.
Wonderful apartment and a fantastic stay. I would recommend the apartment highly!
Beau séjour, appartement bien équipé et proche du métro, merci
heel fijn hostel!
Top locatie, lekker schoon, heerlijke douche, goeie communicatie, gewoonweg een prima prijs kwaliteit verhouding
Amazing apartment! Ursula is so so nice and welcoming.
Nice and pleasant stay at reasonable price

They should provide a common kitchen space where we can get some hot water and heat our own food. In the room, it would be good to have a few shelves in the bathroom to keep toiletries.
The average age of the guests is around 20-25. Maybe good to know for the older guests. :)
The apartment was very nice, super clean, in a cozy and quiet neighborhood. Jo was very kind and flexible.
Comfortable room, great location, communicative and friendly host. I stayed here for a month and felt right at home.

Overall good stay and good location. Checking in was a hassle as host not available and person with key ask us to pick it up 6 kms away, we refused and she was over an hour late. Place tastefully decorated. Kitchen set up nicely for continental breakfast but offers no cooking utensils, pans, pots, etc, so we had to buy our own as this was a 2 week stay. The kitchen photo a bit misleading as cooking was a top priority. Guest parking available on site on first-come-first-serve basis. Public transport easy to access and takes 1 hour to Berlin centre. Well stocked supermarket on same location.

Bebekli konaklama için ve uzun konaklama için uygun bir yer değil. Mutfak kullanışlı değil, mutfak malzemeleri yeterince temiz değildi. Örneğin ekmek kızartma makinesi. Zeminde ahşap döşeme olmadığından ve zemin beton olduğundan 2 yaşındaki oğlum evde zaman geçiremedi. Bu konuda uyarılmalıydık. Pozitif olarak merkezi konumda olduğunu ve sakin bir muhit olduğunu söylemeliyim. Kısa süreli ve çocuksuz konaklama için uygun olabilir sadece
Waren für ein Wochenende in Berlin. Völlig ausreichend und sauber

Highly recommend. Easily walkable to many restaurants and public transportation. Extremely clean. Comfortable bed. Easy to find. Katja responded quickly to my messages. Try the ice cream at Fräulein Frost, a great recommendation by Katja.

Arzu & Tom’s space is a very clean, welcoming and spacious. During the day the sun beautifully lights up the flat, ahh what a treat. All the informations you might need are provided by the hosts: public transport, info about the city, restaurant tips etc.
If you want to stay in a calm and quite environment while you live the hectic and stimulating Berlin, thats the place for you.
It was lovely to be there.
Will definitely come back!!!
Thanks a lot.

Mooie ruimte met een grote tuin. De ruimt is wat kleiner dan het op de foto's lijkt. Maar alles is er en alles ziet er netjes uit. Keukenvoorziening is aan de krappe kant voor 4 personen. Jessica is vriendelijk, pro-actief en reageert heel snel. Dichtbij metrostation, supermarkt en leuke restaurantjes.
Wij zouden zo weer boeken bij een verblijf in Berlijn.

Stylish airbnb in a great location that has heaps of cool bars and restaurants. It’s also well connected to public transport and easy to get to the airport & central station. Only drawback was the room wasn’t sound proof, so you could noticeably hear noise from the hallway and adjacent rooms.

Die Wohnung ist modern eingerichtet und sehr gemütlich mit einem schönen großes Bad. Außerdem schön ruhig im Hinterhof gelegen. Alles, was wir brauchten, war vorhanden, (sogar Tesa, um noch schnell ein Geschenk einzupacken😊). Wir haben uns wohlgefühlt.
Rebecca ist eine freundliche Gastgeberin und war gut erreichbar.
War unglaublich schön. Super einfach zu finden und Kommunikation war top! Empfehlenswert !
Very nice apartment in buzzing area. Host helpfull and friendly
Alles Super 💪🏻

Alles lief unkompliziert und sehr freundlich ab. Es gibt nichts zu beklagen. Toller Balkon, tolle Gegend und sehr geschmackvolle Wohnung für einen super Preis. Gute Anbindung an Öffis. Würde bei meinem nächsten Berlin-Trip wieder dort übernachten.

Wir sind total begeistert!
Irenes Wohnung befindet sich in einem sehr gepflegten , typischen Wohnhaus in Berlin-Charlottenburg. Schon der 1. Eindruck, wenn man das Treppenhaus betritt, ist toll! Sowohl in der Unterkunft als auch in der Umgebung befindet sich alles, was man sich für einen schönen Berlin-Aufenthalt wünschen kann. Auch die Verkehrsanbindung ist perfekt: man ist in wenigen Minuten an den Haltestellen mehrere U-Bahn-Linien und erreicht fast jedes Ziel innerhalb kürzester Zeit. In den Betten haben wir sehr gut geschlafen. Das Zimmer liegt nach hinten zu einem begrünten Innenhof, so dass wir morgens vom Vogelgezwitscher geweckt wurden : ) Der Kontakt mit Irene war freundschaftlich und völlig unkompliziert. Wir kommen gerne wieder!!!
Good apartment for value. Great location.

Wir waren mit dem Aufenthalt in Erikas gemütlichen Gartenhaus sehr zufrieden und haben uns rundum wohl gefühlt.
Wunderbar, die Möglichkeit auf der Terrasse vor dem Gartenhaus zu sitzen und gemütlich zu essen inmitten eines sehr gepflegten Gartens.
Die Verbindung per S-Bahn nach Berlin war super und die Umgebung konnten wir gut mit unseren ebikes erkunden.
Eine sehr gute Option, wenn man Stadt Besuch mit Ausflügen in die Natur verbinden will.
Excelente estadia. Anfitriã respondia rapido, deu varias dicas de turismo da cidade.  Apartamento funcional e bem cuidado, utensílios , máquina de lavar e demais comodidades.
Der Aufenthalt war unkompliziert und sehr freundlich. Danke für die Kommunikation. Schöne, saubere Wohnung!
Stéphanie's place was fantastic. It was in a great location, was very clean and just as she had described it.
Very nice location, close to the city centre and at the same time it feels like a country side. Perfect getaway.

Awesome friendly and helpful host. Accommodation and location excellent. Even after Finnair lost our suitcase for several days, Martin took phone calls and co-ordinated its return delivery for us. He offered tips on good cafes, restaurants and places to visit. Communication was always prompt and helpful and Martin even organised our taxi back to the airport. In all my travels, Martin has been by far the most helpful of hosts, even so far as providing tea, coffee and milk in the fridge. Thank you Martin for our great Berlin experience.

Joli appartement ou il fait bon de s'y poser apès une journée active dans la ville. Au calme et apaisant avec de belles lumières qui le traverse quand le soleil brille. Bien isolé donc pas de bruits parasites génants. Garde la fraicheur même en cas de fortes chaleurs.
Seul bémol : une douche ancienne mais en cours de rénovation.
Accès rapide à pied aux transports (métro, RER,Bus) et bars à proximité.

Hyggelig og tolerant vert. Liten men veldig funksjonell innredning. Noe støvete. Varmtvannet i dusjen varte veldig kort. Eller veldig komfortabelt, veldig deilig seng. Fin bakgård. Tolerante naboer. Alt i alt en god opplevelse.
Stilvolle und sauberes Appartment in sehr guter Lage.

Hervorragende, gepflegte und mit Liebe zum Detail eingerichtete, Wohnung. Die Gastgeber Silke und Carsten sind sehr freundlich und aufgeschlossen. Von der Küche aus hat man einen sehr schönen Blick auf den Müggelsee.
Wir werden jederzeit wiederkommen, wenn es uns mal wieder in die Gegend verschlägt.
The apartment matched the pics perfectly. Marcus was very responsive. The neighbourhood has everything you need, and isn’t too far from the centre.
Exactly as described:)

Rudi ist nicht nur eine der nettesten, sondern auch einer der interessantesten Gastgeber, die ich bisher auf Airbnb getroffen habe. Ich war nicht zum ersten Mal da und werde bestimmt wiederkommen. Herzlichen Dank für alles!

War einfach nur mega zufrieden.

Located very near to Berlin Mitte, Nordbahnhof, and not too far from Hauptbahnhof, this place is a hidden gem. The room is huge with all facilities in place. Alexander is a wonderful host and is even more wonderful person to talk to. I will look forward to staying at his place any time I visit Berlin. :)
Very cozy place to stay while in Berlin! And there's a bakery right beside it so when you're feeling lazy, you don't have to walk far for that perfect cup of kaffe and bread!

Please read before booking. This place has great potential but is lacking quite a bit. First off, we’re ok without aircon but we couldn’t leave the window open because of the noise. It’s in a very active area so people are out partying and just hanging out well into the night. Also, since everyone has the windows open you could here EVERY SINGLE THING from your neighbors. I listened to an entire episode of Seinfeld from the room next to us🙄 On top of that the blinds are not dark enough to keep the light out.
The door locks are crazy difficult to sort out. We had to have the staff open our door a few times and we, in turn helped others get into their room. So annoying.
Our room wasn’t ready until an hour after check in, the cafe doesn’t exist and the coffee room has a college dorm feel??
THE STAFF was amazing. I felt sorry for them because they had a lot to cope with. They did their best to help and assist us! Lots of great restaurants nearby and super convenient to the trains.
Alles super! Sie ist so nett und kümmert sich um alles, später Check In kein Problem und man fühlt sich sehr wohl! 🥰
Perfect customer service, place was clean and modern, no issues whatsoever

Jeannine était très disponible et très réactive pour répondre à toutes mes questions avec gentillesse!
Emplacement top!

Super convenient. There's supermarket within 1 minute walking distance. There're serveral parks within walking distance.
The room I stayed was also good equipped with a large bed and a desk with a large (24+ inch) display. I could work remotely efficiently thanx to that display.
Sehr schöne und günstig gelegene Unterkunft
Bei Ulla war es sehr entspannt und gemütlich.Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Saido hat uns völlig unkompliziert geholfen, weil in einer anderen Wohnung schrecklich laute Bauarbeiten waren, so dass wir dort einfach nur wegwollten. Und dann waren wir ganz glücklich über eine klasse aufgeräumte und saubere Wohnung, mit tollem Bett, schönem Bad und allem, was es einfach braucht, um sich wohlzufühlen. Jederzeit wieder gerne!

Суперсовременные аппартаменты, в которых есть все необходимое для комфортного проживания. Для нас были приготовлены маленькие подарочки, это было очень приятно!
Парковку можно легко найти на соседних улицах. Рядом есть пекарня, там можно купить вкусные булочки на завтрак.

Very central with good transport links . The place is small but fine for a short stay . It had everything we needed. You do need to be quite agile to negotiate the steps to the bed platform which is too low to stand up in.
Wholeheartedly recommend Martin as host and his apartment for staying! Great location, quiet place to relax and close to city center. With Martin you get more than you expect!
All perfect. Quiet, warm and cozy. All I needed in one place for a very good price.
Julius' place is a cosy, welcoming and quiet island in the middle of the lively area of Prenzlauer Berg. We enjoyed our stay very much.

Superbe appartement ! Lumineux et très beau on s’y sent vraiment bien. Des guides sur le quartier et même un parapluie à disposition dans l’appartement.
Très bon emplacement juste à côté du métro Check point Charlie et d’un quartier avec des musées / galeries
Gestion autonome de l’arrivée et du départ très pratique
(Seule petite remarque la douche n’est pas des plus optimales : Rideau de douche trop petit et savon/shampoing sommaire)

Great apartment for a group of up to 5 people with 2 bathrooms, which is very important. From the subway 7-10 minutes. Clean, neat. Next Cafe for every taste. Across the road market. Open until 23.00. We were very pleased! Thank!

Die Wohnung von Simone ist sehr schön eingerichtet und hat alles, was man braucht! Sie war wirklich super sauber, desinfiziert und unsere Fahrräder konnten wir im Hof abstellen! Mehr kann man wirklich nicht erwarten! Außerdem gab es viele gute Tipps für die Gegend.

Uns hat die Wohnung auch mit zwei Erwachsenen und drei Kindern sehr gut gefallen. Am Ende waren wir aber auch viel unterwegs und fast nur zum schlafen und frühstücken in der Wohnung. Die Lage ist super! Sehr schnell am S/U Bahnhof Gesundbrunnen und von dort alles gut zu erreichen. Wir empfehlen Ulf und seine Wohnung gerne weiter und kommen auch gerne nochmal wieder.
Alles zufriedenstellend und wie erwartet, das Zimmer etwas kleiner als gedacht, aber dennoch sehr komfortabel
Great location, really nice place to stay for a weekend and Arcan is a great host! :)
A very nice place to be in Berlin, with a very nice landlord!
Gastgeber waren freundlich, nett und die Unterkunft war auch sehr sauber. Gerne wieder wenn ich in Berlin sein sollte

房间整体来看比较干净但是房间的设施不是很完善，厨房和客厅都没有垃圾桶

Un premier séjour à Berlin parfait, Karina m’a conseillé sur les endroits à découvrir. Il se situe dans un quartier paisible mais très bien desservi par les transports pour rejoindre les différents points d’attractions.
L’appartement est spacieux et chaleureux, les chambres se trouvent sur des étages différents pour plus d’intimité.
C’était un plaisir de cohabiter pendant une semaine.
Fijne ruime kamer zonder overbodige luxe, maar met eigen douche en veel privacy middenin een hartstikke leuke levendige buurt.
Sehr freundliches Personal, tolles Frühstücksbüfet, sehr gute Lage.
Top Wohnung in top Lage. Alles perfekt. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
War alles super!
Sehr süßes Zimmer und super hilfsbereite Gastgeberin!
Allgemein guter Aufenthalt. Leider sehr hellhörig und kein Tageslicht.
The studio of Kristina was great and very clean! The public transportation are very close to the location!
Un buen apartamento, bien equipado y siempre hubo buena comunicación. Excelente ubicación. Para 4 personas es perfecto. Todo muy limpio.
Would definitely stay again!
Stelle ist super gastgeberin

el apartamento cumplio con las expectativas, muy equipado y centrico, zona tranquila y con muchos servicios alrededor.
the apartment met expectations, very equipped and central, quiet area with many services around.

Great apartment for in a great location.
Fast communication and service.
Will recommend staying
Wir waren 2 Nächte im Tiny House von Rene, uns hat es sehr gut gefallen, eine ruhige Oase in relativ zentraler Lage in Berlin. Sehr guter Ausgangsort um Berlin zu erkundigen.

Super Erfahrung gewesen bei Katja und Ihren Katzen ein temporäres zu Hause zu finden. All die Fotos stimmen 1 zu 1 überein, Check in und out super easy und die Wohnung liegt schön zentral. Via Haltestelle Winstrasse ist man schnell an all den Hotspots für Shopping, Kulinarik und feiern :)
10/10 kann man mit gutem Gewissen buchen!
Super tolles organisiertes Team. Hier klappt alles problemlos.
Great experience, easy to book and communicate with the host. Clean, comfortable place.
Sehr gastfreundlicher Host. Gut und ruhig gelegen. Nette Gegend. Alles top!
A great accommodation in a perfect location. I highly recommend it!
Questionable location but very clean and amazing host

Wir hatten ein paar sehr schöne Tage in Berlin und das Appartment hat einen großen Beitrag dazu geleistet. Es sind die sehr vielen kleinen Details, die dafür sorgen, dass man sich in Simons Unterkunft sehr wohlfühlt. Beim Ein- und Auszug bekommt man kleine Aufmerksamkeiten und die besondere Integration von Nachhaltigkeit hat uns sehr gefallen. Dank Dachfenster ist auch gegeben, dass trotz Sommertemperaturen nachts keine drückende Hitze vorherrscht.
Simons Unterkunft ist daher absolut zu empfehlen und wir freuen uns darauf, beim nächsten Berlin-Aufenthalt wieder vorbeizuschauen.
Der Aufenthalt sowie die Kommunikation mit Brigitte war sehr angenehm.

Die Wohnung ist im Prinzip wie beschrieben. Mir hat sie nicht gefallen. Nicht sehr sauber und nicht gemütlich (zugeklebte Fenster und ziemlich abgewohnt) außerdem recht weit zu U-/S- und Straßenbahn. Den Schlüssel muss man am anderen Ende der Straße abholen, 10 Min Fussweg. Kochplatte hat nicht funktioniert.

Simon was a helpful and friendly host. The flat was beautiful and in a perfect location! It had all the required amenities plus a lovely garden to enjoy the summer weather. It's set back from the street so it feels very private and doesn't get the street noise. It's a wonderful flat in a very cool city and I would highly recommend it to anyone travelling through Berlin!

Lucia greeted us on arrival, kindly meeting us at a check-in time that accommodated our arrival schedule. She gave us a quick tour and some recommendations. The apartment matched the photos and description, and, for us, was a convenient walk to meet with family we were visiting nearby. Overall, hit the spot. Thanks Lucia!
Das Zimmer bei Beate ist sehr gemütlich und die Dachterrasse ist im Frühling/ Sommer auf jeden Fall ein Highlight.

The apartment was very nice and they were very friendly! They checked in on us once we arrived to make sure we had everything we needed. Would definitely recommend renting from Ben and Simon. Thank you!
Great stay, responsive host and lovely apartment
Big, light-filled room. Nice people. Close to tram. Would recommend.

Very nice apartment and an amazing location! The apartment’s spacious with a lot of windows. The bed could use some improvement though (it’s a bit small and the matras is certainly not the best). Overall a nice apartment price-quality wise!
Great host that explained what to expect. We arrived in the middle of the night and he was very accomodating. Only stayed there for one night but it was definitely how it was advertised.
Great spot, easy access to transit options, solid amenities, was a great home base for our week in Berlin!

Sehr schön, nahe U-Bahn und perfekte Kommunikation. Empfehlenswert
Michael
Great place!

Michele has been really available and helpful. In fact, we had some last-minute changes that influenced our reservation and Michele took time to skype and understand our situation with a real desire to find the best solution for us, he seems to be a very nice guy. Everything was nice in the apartemnt and the location is perfect!

Sehr viel Platz, gemütliche und saubere Wohnung. Gut für kleine Gruppen geeignet und einfacher Check-In / -Out.
Allerdings ist die Hausnummer 61 und nicht 62.

Das Wasser aus der Leitung riecht einfach super ekelhaft nach Abfluss und ich finde fast 40€ pro Nacht viel, dafür dass man sich mit mehreren Fremden ein Zimmer teilt UND nichtmal ein Schloss für den Spind kostenlos bekommt. Dafür nochmal 4€ extra. Finde ich nicht ok. Aber für die Lage und generell für Vergleichspreise in Berlin wirds preislich wohl schon ok sein.
My room and photos did not match
Everything perfect! Thank you very much!
Great location and great host. Clean apartment with good transport links to all areas of Berlin. Nearby some great coffee shops too!

Beautiful flat in a very central location. S-Bahn very close by and shops and many restaurants around the corner. The flat is modern and stylish decorated, very clean and good supplies in the kitchen. Great place to stay in Berlin. Check in and check out very smoothly. Host answers immediately.
Fint sted midt i hjertet av Berlin! Tusen takk for oss!
Great location, comfortable and responsive hosts.
A beautiful room, very well located
Alles ist wie auf den Bildern. Das Apartment ist gut gelegen mit gute Anbindung. Bei uns war es nicht tip top sauber aber alles andere hat gepasst.
Hat unseren Erwartungen entsprochen und wir haben uns echt wohl gefühlt für die kurze Zeit :)
Eine sehr schöne Altbauwohnung mit hoch gebauten Räumen,  einer schönen Einrichtung und einer Sauna  machen schon was her. Die Buchung lief einwandfrei wir haben uns hier super zurecht gefunden
Great stay at Numa!

Heel tevreden over het verblijf. Rustige, mooi buurt. Zeer aangenaam appartement met ruime slaapkamers en badkamers. Alles was in orde.
Ideale plek om van daaruit Berlijn te ontdekken. Zeer dicht bij metro.
Wonderful place and perfect communication from Martina & Charlotte. We've very much enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it to other people!

Schöne Wohnung im Hochparterre eines Hinterhofes. Sehr zentral. Tolles Frühstück gleich nebenan und (auch veganer)  Vietnamese mit wirklich tollem Essen schräg gegenüber. Im Hinterhof des Appartements gibt es zahlreiche weitere Airbnb-Appartements. Trotzdem war es bei uns sehr ruhig, auch abends. Die Wohnung sah genauso aus wie auf den Bildern, war sauber und ausreichend eingerichtet. Es war etwas tricky,  die unterschiedlichen Öffnungsmechanismen der drei Türen zu verstehen. Alle haben zudem unterschiedliche Codes. Man hat darüber auch Zugang zur Dachterrasse, die wirklich groß ist. Zudem gibt es auf der Dachterrasse eine Outdoor-Badewanne,  die man mit dem danebenliegenden Wasserschlauch befüllen kann. Haben wir nicht getestet, aber sehr cool! Wir würden auf jeden Fall wieder kommen, wahrscheinlich aber eine andere Wohnung testen (werden alle von Mia, aber über 2-3 andere Accounts vermietet. Man findet die anderen Inserate über die Adresse/Suche über die Karte.)

Wir hatten einen wunderschönen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Das Apartment ist wunderschön eingerichtet, sehr sauber und liegt sehr zentral. Alle Ausflugsziele sind gut zu erreichen. Wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder.
The apartment and place matched the desciption. Easy to communicate with the host and not too far from good restaurants. Our daughter had a lot of fun with the playgrounds in the area.
Buen host, ningún problema!

The apartment was lovely, very clean and nicely decorated. Lots of flash touches like fancy dimmer switches, and all the equipment you'd need. The hosts also left some little treats which was cool.
The location was also great, only a couple of minutes from the Ubahn and a good supermarket.
Check-in and out was smooth. The keypad system works really well.
Only downside was that there was a little bit of noise on a couple of the mornings (drilling and banging). Not sure what that was, but not too serious, and presumably only a temporary thing.

This beautiful home was the perfect place for us to rest after busy days exploring Berlin; extremely comfortable and welcoming. We truly could not have asked for more. Everything was spotlessly clean, pretty freshly-picked  flowers were placed in vases, we had coffee and biscuits and fruit — water and tea — absolutely wonderful! The beautiful red house is nestled in a gorgeous garden in a quiet, pretty neighborhood. We thank Joanna and Christoph for providing such comfort and style! Absolutely perfect!

Apartment was great, clean and as described. I asked for a flat with a balcony and they willfully arranged that.
A great stay.
Very nice apartment, I'd definitely stay there next time I'm in Berlin. Keep it up.

Wir hatten dieses Wochenende eine sehr angenehme Zeit bei Angela Zuhause. Sie hat uns ganz toll empfangen, so haben wir uns auf Anhieb wohl gefühlt. Einen ganz besonderen Charme hatte ihre Wohnung. Das Zimmer in dem wir geschlafen haben war gemütlich und sauber. Die Gegend in der sich Angela's Wohnung befindet hat uns besonders gut gefallen, sie war ruhig, grün und unweit vom See entfernt... wie in einem Sommerurlaub :)  Wir danken dir herzlich für alles Angela!

Philipp and Caroline were great hosts! They were very helpful with local recommendations, and even brought extra supplies during our two week stay. The loft was spacious and accurate to the listing and the neighborhood (kiez) is truly incredible, very walkable/bikeable and close to public transit. So many things to do! Also everyone is quite English-friendly, which I did not expect. As mentioned in previous reviews, be prepared to walk up a lot of stairs to reach the apartment. The place is full of light, which was lovely, but it might help some people sleep if they bring earplugs and an eye mask given the late night / early morning culture in Berlin. Overall, it's a great place to stay!
We hebben heel hard genoten van ons verblijf. Heel schattig hond in huis. Heel vriendelijke familie.

Luisa is a wonderful welcoming lady, she was flexible to wait for us having arrived later than we were supposed to come due to flight delay.
A very clean and organised flat.
Thank you Luisa

El cuarto bastante cómodo, tal como se ve en las fotos. Cuenta con refrigerador y kettler, muy bien. La ubicación perfecta, justo enfrente del metro y del tranvía. Zimmer amable y nos dejó tomar el cuarto antes de tiempo. Sin embargo, la comunicación no es buena, tarda en contestar y considerar que no hay área de recepción y el restaurante donde se puede preguntar abre a las 3pm., por lo que es muy importante poder contactar a zimmer por llamada telefónica, que es la única forma en la que logré contactarlo. Limpieza bien, solo agregaría tener mayor cuidado en la limpieza del piso.
Libor was always responsive and really friendly. The location and the place was well equipped and clean! definitely will stay again. Thanks for the good time
very close to a U bahn station which is awesome, and just across the road from Tempelhof Park. Would recommend bringing your own pillow though as the one in the room isn't great

Eine mit viel Liebe gestaltete, ruhige Wohnung in schöner Lage direkt am Wald. Es ist alles da, was es so braucht, sogar solche Dinge wie Wärmflasche, Yogamatte, Milchaufschäumer usw. Ich war hier, um in Ruhe zu arbeiten, und dafür war es perfekt. Annett war immer gut zu erreichen und sehr freundlich. - Vielen Dank!
Nice room with everything you need including cool TV, bath and so on
Gemütliche und saubere Dachgeschosswohnung.

Appartement vraiment charmant, calme et très bien situé. 10mn à pieds de Alexander Platz. Ideal pour un couple si vous séjournez plusieurs jours. Si le séjour est de 2 à 3 jours, vous pouvez facilement être 4 pers.
L'arrivée à l'appartemen st vraiment pratique car vous receptionnez les clés juste à l'aide d'un code!! Pas besoins d'attendre sur quelqu'un. Je le recommande vivement..Merci Sonja

Very clean and well equipped cozy apartment, absolutely quiet. We loved the neighborhood, green spaces, streets full of shops and restaurants. Supermarket (5mins walk) and wonderful breakfasts in S-cafe at the nearest Fridenau S-bahn station!

Sehr schicke Unterkunft. Vor allem der Vorgarten schafft eine ruhige und entspannte Stimmung mitten in Berlin.
Würden auf jeden Fall wieder dort hin!
Perfectly located close to public transport. Some groceries close by as well. Ideal to have a nice and quiet place after being in the hustle and bustle of the city all day sightseeing.
I enjoyed my stay as Elekra was friendly and welcoming. I would recommend her to any travellers!
Hardi is een prima gastheer, met wie je, als je wilt, makkelijk op vriendschappelijke voet komt. Als ik weer eens naar Berlijn ga, weet ik al waar ik verblijven zal. Kan het iedereen aanbevelen!
Beautiful apartment. It was really nice to stay and its near shops and supermarkets.

This place has great potential. It's in a nice and quiet neighborhood and the facilities here are good enough if you're looking for a budget stay.
Interior and amenities are basic and simple (ie: IKEA furniture), not every room has a full-length mirror, and there's not much space in the bathroom where you can put your toiletries. So sometimes you might need to improvise a little.
During my stay, one of the bathrooms wasn't ready yet so sometimes it's 4+ people sharing one bathroom, so occasionally it was a bit inconvenient.
The soundproof isn't great. If someone is talking with a normal volume, whether it's in the room next to yours or in the kitchen/entrance area you will hear it. My room was No.4 and the wi-fi signal was pretty weak. But it shouldn't be a problem unless you get up as late as I did... :p
If you like a family-friendly and quiet environment, this is a good choice for a short stay. Nice scenery and plenty of supermarkets, shops, and restaurants nearby. The host Frank is also very helpful and warm-hearted, this airbnb tends to attract friendly people, too.

ideal location for a short stay in Berlin. Elisa's apartment is quite small but the space is laid out well so seems bigger, it was also very clean. Heating and shower both very good. Chocolates and wine were a nice touch. Would recommend.

The place was very clean and very well located and near grocery stores and public transportation as well.
I recommend booking this place for sure, especially for a few days in Berlin.
Dietrich was very nice and available at anytime for us.

We had a great stay at Dirk and Silke’s place. Everything we needed was available, the place was super clean and the couple responded super fast. And the best; we had a gorgeous view of the sea in the morning. Thanks for everything.
On the whole a good stay ...

We receive great hospitality before/during/after our stay in Berlin, and the room is bigger than what we expected. Two separate bathrooms are so convenience to accommodate two families! the location is perfect for tourists who wants to experience being the true Berlin residents. Numerous of "Good Tasty" restaurant at downstair and nearby street, and the supermarket and park is just across of the street! My husband and I will definitely choose this place when next time visiting Berlin! Thank you!

I had a great time staying in Jenny's room. She was so helpful with information and suggestions about directions to do everything. The room looks like the same in the picture, and the atmosphere is cozy and nice.
Thank you, Jenny! I had a great time for the two days that I stayed with you guys!
duidelijke communicatie
The flat is nice and well equipped. We enjoyed our stay!

I cannot reccomend this stay enough. By far one of the best places we have stayed in for travelling, numa is so so accommodating and replies quickly to any queries you might have. A completely stress free place to stay, with the added bonus of the best bed I have ever slept on, and luxury branded products at your disposal, (face/body wash, shampoo conditioner body lotion).
Perfect area of Berlin, full of character and diversity, definitely the most hip area to stay in with plenty of local businesses near by, shopping, food etc which numa reccomends in a leaflet left in your room, all within a five minute walk, the reccomedations were excellent.
The location is perfect, in a court yard style so away from the main road or any noise, you will sleep like a log!
Overall 10/10, cannot thank numa enough for such an excellent and hassle free stay.

Anna's place was absolutely amazing.
Beautiful, spacious, fantastic facilities and an amazingly well stocked kitchen.
10/10

Florian was very helpful to us! He is a great host and was in contact whenever we needed him.
The location of his apartment is very handy with a train station near by and his apartment was nice and cosy, we really loved the cute balcony with daybed on it!
Would stay again! :)
tolle Wohnung sieht genau so aus wie in den Fotos

Sara was very communicative and nice. She was also flexible with check-in and check-out times, which helped us a lot with our trip. The house is exactly was shown on pictures, really clean and convenient located in the heart of Kreuzberg. Would definitely go back!

It was a nice room and Judith's husband welcomed us when we arrived. Judith and her husband were really nice and helpful for all the queries that we had. The room was nice and spacious and the bathroom was clean and big as well. Approximately 20 mins to get to the city centre and the tram comes every 5-7 mins so location wise it was alright.

Le logement est très bien situé avec de nombreux restaurants autour, et les transports en communs tout près. Ce quartier est très agréable en août. Dans la maison, tout était propre et bien agencé.
La résidence était très calme aussi.
Julian s’est montré disponible donc nous en sortons très satisfaits de notre séjour.

Good place to stay for a weekend visit to Berlin! Only a short walk from the S-Bahn. Very peaceful and seemingly safe area. Bed was very comfortable. We were provided with two separate duvets which was nice as we were friends sharing the same bed. Very friendly and accommodating host, even kind enough to provide breakfast! A bit of a language barrier but easy to overcome through messaging and the fact my friend knew some basic Spanish. Dog does not take well to strangers but understandably so as he is a guard dog! Overall would recommend.
super und günstig. Gastgeber sehr zuvorkommend und freundlich. gerne wieder
Es war ein 100%ig gelungener Urlaub! Die Lage ist Top 100 Sterne, ein schöner Ort, wo man entspannen und die Natur genießen können! Wir empfehlen es sehr!

Dadurch, dass man das Tor abschließt und davon ausgeht, dass die Gäste in den anderen Wohnungen sich daran halten, fühlt man sich allein ebenfalls sicher. Die Lage ist völlig in Ordnung. Es befinden sich Cafés, ein kleiner See und die U-Bahn-Station ganz in der Nähe. Ich kann die Unterkunft empfehlen!

Really nice host, very communicative and accommodating. Is in a really central area so you can go wherever you need pretty easy. It’s near trams and a short walk to good train lines. Is close to a really nice park and other cool areas of Berlin. The place itself was nice, it was private and relaxed but fairly loud at night if the window is open.

I had a fantastic stay at Thomas’ Airbnb in Berlin. The space was clean, cozy, and beautifully decorated. His communication was prompt and friendly, making everything seamless. I felt right at home and would definitely stay again! Highly recommended!
The location of the flat is excellent! It's in the centre of Berlin and you can even walk to the central train station! Ilia and Olga were very nice and helpful! Their flat is artisitc and inspiring!
Great place and location with plenty to do around. Friendly and helpful staff. Very good for long stays.
I stayed for 1 night and it was fine. I was in a 4 person room and the floor was generally quiet.

An easy walk from Hauptbahnhof. Large, spacious apartment. Clean, everything worked, many restaurants in the area, supermarket around the corner. Wifi was slow: 5G phone connection was clearly faster.
Gustav’s place was perfect for us. It’s a beautiful and spacious apartment with great location. Also the beds were really comfortable :)

Ich habe mich wie zu Hause gefühlt! Judith war während meines Aufenthalts nicht da, aber sie hat alle meine Fragen beantwortet und war sehr reaktionsschnell!

Danke Judith, ich werde wiederkommen 🌸
Great location, nice apartment. Would recommend!
It's a great apartment. Has everything you need and is close to some lovely restaurants. Also very quiet at night.
Great place, nice vibe. All you need. Short train ride from BER airport, near public transport with easy access anywhere in Berlin. I'll be back — if I can get a good price.
Was very clean, easy to open lockbox. Very responsive. My fqv restraunt happens to be close by, so i liked that
super conveniently located, and a great base to explore the city!

Nous avons été très bien accueilli, et avons été très satisfait de notre séjour. L'appartement est très agréable, très calme, et parfaitement situé - beaucoup de restaurants à proximité. Un grand merci à Anne et Axel !

Die Unterkunft war sehr schön.
Ordentlich und Sauber. Der Gastgeber war immer erreichbar.

Super Unterkunft!! Gerne wieder.

Small but well organized apartment. Ivos is super kind and always nice. At the check in he gives some tips about transports and where to eat. Very well located. You can find u-bahn near the apartment and you can reach almost everywhere by feet. Surely recommended. Definitely will I book it again when in Berlin
Awesome Location. Would stay again

Wir waren mit unserem Aufenthalt in Berlin voll und ganz zufrieden. Wenn man erstmal die vielen Treppenstufen zur Wohnung erklommen hat, erwartet einen eine Lichtdurchflutete Altbau-Wohnung in der man sich sehr wohlfühlen kann. Der Check-In war super flexibel und wir bekamen direkt eine freundliche Einweisung in die Wohnung. Alles war super clean.
Direkt in der Nähe ist auch eine Tram-Station. Für einen kürzeren Aufenthalt in Berlin, bei dem man keine Küche braucht - eine 10/10!
Really great apartment in a fab location and perfect for 2. Might be a squash for 4 and beware 110 stairs to climb!! We quite enjoyed the climb though as it helps keep you fit!!
Thanks Gunther for the staying we enjoyed Berlin so much! Your place is clean and tidy and well located
Had a great time here! Would love to come back in the summer

A lovely place to stay. A really short walk to a train station and opposite a super market. The apartment was very clean. The beds were comfortable. The curtains were blackout curtains which was fantastic.

Our stay at Katharinas apartment was so wonderful. Everything was just right. Good communication with Katharina and when we arrived she even came down and helped us carrying the luggage. I can really say that my grandmother and I enjoyed our stay and we truly recommmend this place.

the apartment was fantastic, the position is great. the neighbourhood is full of nice restaurants, shops and bars. the metro station is less than a five minute walk from the apartment and with a ten minutes walk you arrive in alexanderplatz. we really enjoyed our time in berlin and in this apartment. would definitely recommend!
Rent MBE place, you son'y regret.

The place is exactly as described, the area is super top, cannot be closer to the vibe. The place is spotless and with anything you might need.

Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Jonas ist ein toller und bemühter Gastgeber. Die Unterkunft ist sehr sauber und gemütlich. Jonas will, dass es einem an nichts fehlt. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen!

Tolle, saubere Unterkunft in ￼ ruhiger Seitenstraße. Sehr gepflegt und stilvoll eingerichtet.
