Numa Boxer szálláshelyet nagyon szerettük, a reptérről nagyon jól megközeíthető tömegközlekedéssel. A hotel előtt áll meg a villamos, minden egy ugrásnyira van. A környék nagyon kellemes, barátságos, fiatalos. Boltok, kávézók, kocsmák pár lépérósnyire találhatóak. A belépés pinkóddal nagyon kényelmes, nem kell igazodnod senkihez. A szállás hangulatos, tiszta. Az ágy és az ágnyemű egy álom, életemben nem aludtam ilyen kényelmes ágyban. Víz, kévéfőző, kapszulák, vízforraló, teák, tejszín, chips, gumicukor bekészítve. Hűtő, tv. Nagyon jó kiegészítő szolgáltatás még a csomagmegőrzés, amivel a kijelentkezés napján még 20 óráig rendelkezésre áll automata csomagmegőrzés.
Összességében nagyon meg voltunk elégedve, mindenkinek ajánlom.
Everything went on well
Great location and more spacious than the pictures suggest.

Die Wohnung ist sicher gut geeignet für ein paar gute Tage in Berlin. Für längere aufenthalte ist die Wohnung nicht Ausgestattet. In der Küche gab es nur ein Brotmesser, außerdem fehlten Auflaufformen und ähnliches. Die Putzutensillien mit einem Handfeger und einem alten Staubsauger ließen ebenfalls zu wünschen übrig. Ein Besen und eine Wäscheleine wären wünschenswert gewesen.
Ansonsten gibt es nichts zu Beanstanden, der Vermieter war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit.

Martina and Charlotte were amazing hosts, never got to see them but everything was explained easily and well to us upon arrival. The apartment was in a good location, close to the underground and other restaurants. The loft was also much bigger in real life then in pictures which was a lovely surprise for me and my friend, everything had been cleaned to perfection and it felt like home which is always something I reach for when booking holidays! would definitley recommend to anyone going to Berlin especially for such a good price! thank you to the both of them! left a bottle of Prosecco to say thank you for our stay aswell
Great and stylish apartment. We had a very good time. The location is perfect to enjoy Kreuzberg, Neukolln and the surroundings. Perfect for two people.

Спасибо Флоре, очень гостепримная и позитивная хозяйка. Сама квартира полностью соответствует ожиданиям, все чисто и есть все необходимое. Очень красивый садик и вид из окна. Рядом есть парки, где мы гуляли каждый день. Магазины и станция электрички в пяти минутах хотьбы, все очень удобно. Нам очень понравилось.
Exceeded expectations. Very clean, quiet, perfect location, close to transport, good cafes and shops. Julius was a great host and always responded quickly. Would definitely come back again
Alles supi.

War alles super! Obwohl wir recht spät ankamen war der Check-In problemlos und schnell.
Tolle Lage und sehr gemütliche Einrichtung. Wir haben uns gut entspannen könne und haben den Aufenthalt genossen.
agréable apt tout confort.

This apartment was exactly as described! The hosts were very helpful and friendly and they have people on staff 24/7 in case you call. The apartment was spotlessly clean while also having everything we needed for our stay.
The only downside of this apartment is maybe the location, depending what you're looking for. It is rather far (by public transport) to some parts of the city as Berlin is huge and the apartment isn't on a major subway stop. That being said, we managed to get around fine as Berlin has great busses.

Ich habe mich direkt willkommen und sehr wohl gefühlt. René ist ein super Host, die Kommunikation unkompliziert und sehr freundlich. Tolle Umgebung, alles fußläufig erreichbar :)
Immer wieder gerne!

Superhost is an understatement! Alex was extremely accommodating to us during our stay, he gave recommendations of places to see in the city along with public transport advice and delicious places to eat. The flat itself was very spacious and clean and conveniently in the middle of all the places we wished to visit, so the location was ideal for us. Alex felt more like a friend to us than an Airbnb host, so I would recommend anyone to stay with him to ensure a relaxed, safe trip! We had absolutely no issues with our stay and would gladly return to the same Airbnb if given the opportunity!

This place is divine.
It is stylish & artistic, and perfectly located. But beyond that, Bernd truly invites you into an inspiring journey sharing his passion for photography and art. This is by far one of the most special places we stayed at. We felt at home and I would definitively recommend it to anyone - especially for gardener lovers ;)

Ruim appartement op een mooie plek in Berlijn .
Tram, bakker, supermarkt enz.op loopafstand.
Appartement voelt als prettig thuiskomen na een drukke dag. We hebben erg genoten.
Die Lage ist sehr gut und bietet viele Möglichkeiten die Stadt zu erkunden. Das Zimmer war großartig. Ich hatte insgesamt einen tollen Aufenthalt.

Katha u. Fabian waren stets offen und hilfsbereit. Wir waren frei zu kommen u. zu gehen. Schlafplatz ist eine Ausziehcouch, aber genauso bequem wie ein Bett. Das Zimmer ist größer als es am Foto aussieht. Ausstattung wie beschrieben, auch W-LAN.
Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!
Sehr nett alles war top :)
Schön renoviertes Zimmer,  ruhig gelegen, leckeres Früstück, sympathische Gastgeber. Wir waren nur eine Nacht da - wären dort aber gerne länger geblieben.
Allemaal goed en keurig netjes. Kan wel wat klein onderhoud gebruiken. Maar voor een weekend absoluut niet storend.

Ich war fasziniert von der im Detail eingerichteten Wohnung. In der Nähe alles was man braucht.
Habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt.

Yair made everything easy! He was available and quickly responded when messaged.
The location of the apartment is excellent - close to transportation, grocery, and restaurants.
Mauerpark's Flea Market on Sunday was so much fun and we enjoyed the feeling of safety everywhere in Berlin.
We would be happy to stay here again!
Zeer mooi appartement!  Gelegen op een paar honderd meter van het station dat je binnen het half uur overal in de binnenstad brengt.
Everything was perfect
Die Unterkunft ist passend eingerichtet und hat alles, was man für einen kurzen Städtetrip braucht. Die Mitarbeiter sind super freundlich und die Lage ist mehr als perfekt.
Schoon en goedkoop, dicht bij het station. Aanrader!

Andrej var meget proaktiv og nem at komme i kontakt med og lejligheden har en god placeringen.
Lejligheden er dog meget meget nedslidt, skabene i køkkenet var ved at falde fra hinanden, der var grundlæggende beskidt efter mangel på grundig rengøring og generelt trængte stedet til en kærlig hånd. Der var meget lyt i opgangen. Døren ud til opgangen lukker ikke tæt.
Все было супер! Общение, чистота, удобства! Выдались хорошие выходные :)

Excellently finished and spacious 2 bed apartment - was exactly as listed. 5 minutes walking distance from Charlottenburg Schloss and Mierendorffstraße U Bahn Station. Nice breakfast/lunch places within walking distance and a convenience store open late within 2 mins.
Hosts were proactive in communicating and very helpful. High recommend.

Wir haben das erste Mal über Airbnb gebucht und ich kann euch sagen, Sonja hat unsere Erwartungen übertroffen! *Traumhaft*
Die Unterkunft von Sonja ist sehr zu empfehlen! Sonja ist sehr sehr freundlich und gibt auch Tipps, mit welchem Bus man fahren kann etc. Wir sind zu unserem Ziel gelaufen ;-)
Sie war wie eine unsichtbare Zauberfee, das Bad war immer makellos sauber und man hat sie weder gesehen noch gehört.
Das Zimmer ist super ausgestattet und sehr schön gemütlich eingetrichtert.
Die Lage ist Geschmackssache... wer es ruhig mag, ist dort genau richtig. Wer big city live möchte, sollte sicherlich eher in diese Richtung schauen. Allerdings ist es Berlin, direkt vor der Haustür ist eine Bushaltestelle, wer die Öffis mag, kann auch so überallhin reisen. Es ist ein Wohngebiet mit einer sehr großen angrenzenden Gartenanlage. Restaurants und Bars um die Ecke eher wenig bis gar nicht.
Nichtsdestotrotz für uns war alles PERFEKT und wir kommen sehr sehr gerne wieder, Sonja! Liebe Grüße
Lovely stay, no thrills with accommodation but very clean and the staff were all lovely, slightly overpriced for what you get
Muy lindo el Departamento y con todo lo necesario !
Great apartment for short holiday in Berlin. Hosts were really helpful. Highly recommended. Rgds Maurice
David is great host. Location great the whole stay was great. Thank you for all
Wszystko było okej, pokoje czyste, łazienka również. W okolicy troche więcej "Turków".

Probably the nicest Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. Perfect location, beautiful house, friendly and communicative host, super spacious - and even a piano to play on in the room. Will be returning for sure

Das Airbnb ist wunderschön, bietet genug Platz für zwei Leute mit Koffer etc. und ist wunderbar gelegen mit Cafés und Restaurants in Laufnähe und in einer ruhigen Familiengegend sodass man sich auch abends als junge Frau mehr als sicher fühlt! Wir können das Airbnb nur jedem empfehlen, auch das Teilen des Wohnraums ist kein Problem, da das Zimmer so liegt, das man trotzdem noch das Gefühl von Privatsphäre hat.
The apartment is beautiful and in a great area of town.  I would highly recommend staying with Marius if you are spending time in Berlin.

Mina fue muy atenta en todo momento y su apartamento es igual que en las fotos. Es acogedor, cómodo y limpio
¡Hemos estado encantados!

Perfect host, good communication, location, top neighbourhood near many highlights. Perfect if you are with more than two people. We were with three and had our own bedrooms there were two bathrooms. Great few from the 21 floor. Loved it.

Mimi was very helpful throughout our stay and accommodated our late arrival at night.
The flat is spacious and very comfortable. It is well furnished and attractive.
The apartment is only a short walk from bars and restaurants, and is close to the river. It is well equipped and has plenty of storage. The weather was quite cold during our stay but the flat was a very agreeable temperature. We could adjust this as necessary.
We were able to visit many galleries and museums which we accessed via Uber.
The residential area is quiet and there was no traffic noise.
We loved staying here and we look forward to our next visit to Berlin and staying here again!

Eine einfache aber sehr schöne Unterkunft. Trotz zentraler Lage sehr ruhig gelegen. Alle dort sind sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Man kann zu Fuß und mit dem ÖPNV sehr gut ganz Berlin erkunden. Wir haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen.

Meine Tochter und ich haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt bei Laura! Wir können die Unterkunft zu 100% empfehlen, besser geht eigentlich nicht :-) Wir wünschen Dir alles Gute und freuen uns schon auf ein Wiedersehen!
Nette Mitarbeiter, angenehme Atmosphäre, schönes Appartement

Wir haben uns in dieser optimal eingerichteten, günstig gelegenen und blitzsauberen Wohnung sehr wohlgefühlt.
Auch für einen Aufenthalt mit Kindern ist gesorgt: Spielzeug, Kinderstuhl .. Becher, Teller... sind vorhanden.
Die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern Maya und Marc klappt vorzüglich, immer ein offenes Ohr und sehr hilfsbereit. Wir kommen gerne wieder und können die Wohnung nur bestens empfehlen
Maria
Loved the place so much, would love to stay there again 😍😍

Ich war zwei Tage wegen des Marathons in Berlin.
Da konnte ich mich glücklich schätzen, so kurzfristig eine so schöne Unterkunft zu finden.
Die Unterkunft entsprach den Bildern.
Die Kommunikation mit Birgit war stets freundlich und schnell.
Hier hat alles gepasst, gerne wieder.

We stayed there for the weekend. Egil was very responsive and flexible when we needed a last minute change with our booking. Place is great: very clean, spacious rooms, great kitchen and dining area. A big plus is an outside terrace. The only thing to be mindful about - it is a last floor (4th) and no elevator. So, be prepared to take a stairs. But it is really worth to pay this ‘price’ for the lovely place and a view from the terrace. Thank you, Egil for hosting us!

Check in was difficult and confusing. Flo and the corporate team that owns this property were very responsive but it was tough to have to stand outside in freezing weather trying to figure out where the key was.

Chris was an extraordinary host!
Apartment was clean and tidy. It is minimalistic, yet very well equipped for everyday life. One can notice that Chris cares about the details: I was welcomed with treats (chocolate, still water and tea/coffee) and other disposable higiene/personal items such as slippers, wipes, earplugs, etc. Everything to make you feel comfortable right away.
My room received a lot of natural light and had really good blackout curtains. It also faced the street, which is noisy during the day because of the trams, but windows were soundproof, so I never had troubles sleeping at night.
Bed was comfy, desk and chair where good for working with the computer and wardrobe had plenty of space for all of my belongings.

We had a very good stay at Andre's apartment. There is more than enough room for 4 people, but if you are with 6 or more it could be a little bit on the smaller side. The neighborhood is great and very quite, with a full service supermarket and a bakery that serves coffee and croissants within walking distance. Communications with Andre were perfect, we felt very welcome. So all in all, I would totally recommend this place! Five out of five stars *****

The location was fantastic with proximity to weekly Farmers Markets and a weekly Antique market. There were so many beautiful places to have a meal and a great supermarket around the corner. We enjoyed going to Mauer Park which is a short walk away. Also the public spaces with history of the Berlin Wall were close by.
The tram and U8 public transport was so easy to access.
Although there is a lift, there are 2 flights of stairs to navigate.
We rearranged the furniture to meet our needs as we stayed there just under 2 weeks - we love to sit at a table to eat and to play games. The style is very eclectic and the numbers of chairs, coffee tables over catered for 2 guests.
Thank you for a wonderful stay in Berlin!
Great host and fantastic property, very easy to get around and host super helpful

We stayed here for over a week and absolutely loved it! Peaceful location by the water, grocery store walking distance away, and a few quick transit stops away from more happening parts of town. Love the big windows and natural light. Would stay again!

This is a cosy and stylish apartment in a good location. Very homely. It’s high up with no lift so it’s good to be fit to climb the stairs! Also it’s very much someone’s home, so there’s quite a lot of stuff and not much space free for guests  - which was fine for us staying a few nights but worth being aware of for longer stays. Anni was helpful and quick to respond (though we didn’t meet in person).
Tolle Unterkunft mitten in Neukölln! Werner war super freundlich und hilfsbereit - sehr zu empfehlen:)
Wir waren zu dritt und hatten ausreichend Platz, easy check in, sauber und gut gelegen, schnelle Kommunikation, tolle Dusche

Het appartement is voordelig, dus ik mag niet te veel klagen. De kamer heeft sfeer. Maar het zou beter moeten. Een beter bed is een must, de oude slaapbank met een niet al te goed matras erop is verschrikkelijk. De matrassen op de vide zijn heel dun en oud, daar valt ook niet op te slapen. Ook missen er gordijnen. Iedere keer als de buitenlamp aangaat voor andere bewoners in het gebouw schijnt het felle licht naar binnen via de ramen op de binnenplaats.
Voor de prijs accepteer ik het afwassen in de wastafel, de douche die je niet kan ophangen, het niet al te warme water en het gebrek aan keuken benodigdheden.

The location is perfect. The hosts are very nice couple. They're friendly and responsive. Above all, the apartment is nice and clean. I really enjoy the stay and my trip to Berlin. Staying at the host's place made me love the city more.

Martin's place was amazing. It was super clean, spacious and very comfortable. The whole experience was smooth and enjoyable. Martin was sweet and extremely helpful and helping us in every step of the way during our trip :) I would definitely come back!

points positives:
logement plutot bien situé
lit confortable
environnement vert
points négatifs:
j'ai acceuilli un ami proche (pas un inconnu) 30min et ça n'as pas plu au hote!
trop de poussière dans la chambre et sous le lit!
ménage pas fait ni avant ni pendant mon sejour.

The loft apartment is lovely and clean. It is too far to walk in to the sightseeing places however we had a car and found it easy to park. Public transport is close and a Little grocery shop. We were there in December and it is a cosy space. Parking on site was great for our hire car.

This is a nice, spacious apartment in a quiet residential area that is well connected via public transport to other parts of Berlin. We really enjoyed our stay here, had good communication with the host and found the photos very accurate. Only improvement would be to provide WiFi in the apartment.
Eu me hospedei neste hostel no reveillon de 2023 e foi perfeito em tudo o que ele propunha como serviços. Dormia muito bem e recomendo muito este hostel. Maravilhoso!
Very cool tiny appartement. Great bed and great shower. Also very good location. A lot of restaurants and bars within walking distance and public transport (bus, tram and metro) nearby.

Smaakvol appartement aan een rustige patio/ binnentuin. Prima bedden. Een van de twee bedden bevindt zich in een loft achtig ruimte die gescheiden wordt met een wandje van de keuken. Daardoor hoor je de koelkast soms aanslaan. Oordopjes mee en t is opgelost. Daniel is een goede host en reageert snel.
Robert was an amazing host. The flat is stunning and in a great location and Robert's tips were spot on. Would really recommend to anyone thinking of coming to Berlin.
Enjoyed the space. Cozy and felt like home away from home.
Very friendly host, and a perfect apartment for a big group.

We had a great stay and the local area was lovely. Easy to get to using the underground. For us, there were only a couple of niggles about the apartment. One, there were only one pillow each, when I asked Max, if there was another pillow I could have, the answer was ‘No’. The second niggle was that there was very little room at the side of the bed to get out. So, you had to shuffle to the bottom of the bed. The bed itself was very comfortable.
The apartment had everything we needed for our stay. Despite the niggles, I would definitely go back. The host was kind enough to let us stay a little longer after check in as we had a late flight. The communication of Silke’s representative for checkin was responsive and helpful.
It would have been useful to have had some information in the apartment like a map or local restaurants with recommendations either from Silke or other guests.
Great location in Berlin for a great value. Highly recommend!
Very nice stay in one of the best Kiez in Berlin!
Great location! Easy to find. Good host!

The flat was as advertised. The location was excellent: a picturesque, quiet neighborhood with excellent public transport, large park and amenities right around the corner. The flat was a good size with a great bed and bathroom and a kitchen with a dishwasher! Frank was a very gracious host. I would stay here again if I return to Berlin.

Ottima soluzione per brevi soggiorni, nel quartiere Wedding a una decina di minuti a piedi dalla stazione metro Seestrasse. La camera è spaziosa ed anche il bagno privato con doccia è più che vivibile. Essendo al piano terra di un cortile interno, non si sente alcun rumore proveniente dalla strada. Barbara è stata un ottimo host, consigliandomi anche prima del mio arrivo a Berlino su mezzi di trasporto e luoghi da visitare. Consigliato! Grazie e a presto! Enrico Mikrokosmoskriti.com

Ho soggiornato qui solo una notte in un momento di assoluta necessità. Si è rivelato una scoperta. Lo staff è accogliente e amichevole. L'hotel è posizionato in un'ottima parte della città, vicino alle linee della metro e a molti luoghi d'interesse turistico. La camera era pulita e con gli essenziali a disposizione (come shampoo, crema per il corpo, salviette, asciugamani...)
Su due piani della struttura sono presenti delle macchinette per gli snacks ed è possibile lasciare il baglio in deposito dopo aver fatto il check-out dalla camera.
Esperienza positiva! Spero di poter tornare presto a soggiornare qui!
Super zufrieden und sehr freundliche Gastgeber 🙂
It’s a beautiful and very comfortable apartment!! We loved our stay! They were very helpful with any questions we had. And the marathon runners ran down our street! Thank you!

Wir haben ein paar schöne Berlin-Tage in Ralph’s Wohnung verbracht. Es hat alles gut geklappt beim Ein-und Auschecken und es gibt sehr nette Lokale zum Essen in 10-15 min Entfernung. Auch die öffentliche Verkehrsanbindung ist sehr gut. Ralph gab uns sehr genaue Informationen vorab, wie wir vom Flughafen zur Wohnung kommen (Dauer ca. 40min). Für Einkäufe sind zahlreiche Geschäfte (inkl. Karstadt) in nächster Nähe. In Ralph’s Wohnung ist alles Erforderliche vorhanden. Hervorzuheben ist die tolle Dusche. In der Nacht kann es durch Nachtschwärmer manchmal etwas lauter werden, aber unter Tags ist die Wohnung sehr ruhig.
Tolle Lage, tolles Kiez. Alles super zu erreichen. Tolle, helle Wohnung mit sehr viel Platz für 2 Personen.

I stayed at Olaf's home for three nights, Oct. 19-22, 2022.
The host is very welcoming and helpful. My accommodations were very nice and comfortable.
Olaf has stocked the rooms with everything you could possibly need.
I highly recommend this host if you are visiting Berlin.
Walt....from Canada

I have a deep rest in Rudolf house.
The comfy bed and private bathub are so perfect and wonderful!
I impressed by Rudolf and her wife welcomed me to the house in such a warm and respectful way. I feel like I am at home. :) They are the best host I've ever met in Airbnbs. Thank you so much🌸
The area is wonderful, one station to the lake and easy to connect to the city. so quiet and peaceful area.
I am in love with the living room which you can see big treees from the mirror room. It's so relaxed.
Clean, private, nothing to ask for more.
I will choose Rudolf place if I visit Berlin again.
Ottima posizione

Sehr freundlich, wir haben uns unterhalten als würden wir uns schon lange kennen
Zimmer waren sauber und in Ordnung wie sich das gehört.
Würde jeder Zeit wieder dort ein Zimmer nehmen
Extremely helpful and nice host, always prompt to reply and to help. Nice apartment, I enjoyed the location. Spacious room, clean. Everything was great. Highly recommended.

Monika, her husband and her son were very kind and welcoming. The apartment was very nice - the kitchen was comfortable, and also the bathroom, and the other places around the house. The wi-fi worked great, and the door-mans were really helpful. The location was great - only a walking distance from Alexanderplatz and also a fantastic transportation that helps to get anywhere in the city.

The apartment was lovely. It is centrally located in Mitte and access to public transport is very easy. The area is full of young people and is very vibrant. Stéphanie is a great host and very knowledgeable on Berlin. Stéphanie lives in the apartment next door and is very approachable and extremely helpful. We (2) stayed here for two nights and we will definitely be back to stay here

Perfect accommodation! One of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve had so far. Garrelt is extremely courteous and helpful and also funny. He creates a very pleasant atmosphere. A cozy room in a quiet neighborhood not far from the subway. Wifi is super fast. Highly recommended!

Myself and 2 friends very much enjoyed our stay here. The location in Neukölln is great - walkable to parks, coffee, restaurants, shopping, and the metro. You're on the ground floor, but even the rooms on the street were relatively quiet throughout our stay. The place was clean, bathroom and kitchen sufficiently nice for a few people, and we felt comfortable throughout. Keyless entry to the unit + lockbox for the building meant we could come and go as we pleased individually which was a nice bonus. Pierre was responsive throughout and all the instructions provided were easy to follow.

Der Aufenthalt war sehr gut, die Wohnung liegt im Prenzlauer Berg zur Schönhauser Straße sind es nur wenige Meter wo sich auch direkt eine Haltestelle befindet.
Dier Wohnung war sehr sauber und Immer gerne wieder
This was a great location and very easy walkable access to everywhere. The place itself was easily accessible, clean, and comfortable. We would definitely come back.
it was clean and what i expected

The apartment is spacious, clean and bright. The neighbourhood is quiet at night. Public transport is a walk away, as the apartment is located along a wide and long street (about a 850m walk/10 min to the nearest U-bahn; or a 500m walk/6 min to a nearby tram stop). We appreciated that there were lots of trees along the street. The beds were super comfy, and we had such good sleep every night. Zaki and Hano welcomed us with so much love. We also shared hearty conversations about food, books and cooking, which we learnt were their passion. Danke schön!
War das erste Mal bei Oli. Für 3 Nächte. Geräumiges Zimmer mit großem Bett. Eigenes Bad und WC. Tolle Lage. Prima Kommunikation. Alles wie im Profil beschrieben. Komme gerne wieder.

Hae-Ok’s lejlighed var et perfekt valg til vores ferie i Berlin. Mange af Berlin’s attraktioner og offentlig transport var indenfor gåafstand, så beliggenheden var helt perfekt. Udsynet over Berlin er også helt enestående fra denne lejlighed🤩 Jeg vil helt klart anbefalde denne lejlighed til andre og ville helt klart ville bo her igen, næste gang jeg kommer til Berlin😍

Rainer hat uns sehr nett empfangen +war auch bereit ,die Schlüssel -Übergabe etwas später zu machen als seine Lieblingszeit .Man muss seine Pfandflaschen nicht selber entsorgen + hat eine Auswahl an Tee,Kaffee usw.

Alle infos die man braucht hängen an einem schwarzen Brett in der Wohnung +es gibt genügend Infos über Berlin +sogar einige Kunstbände.

We had a great time at Holger's apartment! The space was clean and quiet. The Wifi worked great for remote work. The area was also very walkable with public transit options and restaurants/markets close by. I would stay here again!

Great location. Great apartment. Cozy and welcoming.
Will love to come again.
Easy from start to finish. David gave very clear intrusions. Lovely apartment with everything we needed. Would recommend to anyone!

Absolutely great location and nice apartment. There you'll have everything you need for a short term. A lot of cool places in the neighbourhood.
Communication with Agnieszka was easy, fast, friendly and very helpful.
I had a problem with nuki app to open the door, the key didn't work from my phone. But she created me another one quite fast.
Good price and comfortable apartment even for three people.

Het was een erg leuke plek met een fantastische host. Mooie locatie in een authentiek pand. Veel restaurants en gezelligheid in de buurt. En in je kamer is het weer lekker rustig. Koffie en thee aanwezig was erg prettig. Ik zou deze locatie zeker aanraden.
Xin is very kind, and his home has everything I need. He was a great help during check-in and check-out. I will definitely stay here again when I visit Berlin! Thanks
a very clean apartment and a friendly owner, highly recommend! :)
A lovely place and so very well connected. Could have been cleaner.
Very nice place. Has a coffee machine. Lol

Comfortable and convenient. A good kitchen to prepare your own meals, a washing machine/dyer to clean clothes, a good sized and quality bathroom and a comfy bed. Nice location close to the river and not too far from public transport. It was a 25min walk from the main train station which was nice before/after a long train ride. Other local options nearby.
Ulf ist sehr nett und freundlich und die Wohnung super schön und sehr zentral gelegen! Sehr empfehlenswert!

This is a quite and moody place with good transportation connection (U-Bahn). Good communication with immediate answers.
We missed the microwave. It is cold if not heated in advance.
Excellent location, very clean, comfortable, helpful staff, excellent breakfast. Highly recommended
Es un lugar muy bonito

The apartment's area is great!
There are numerous bars, restaurants, and charming small shops. It boasts beautiful architecture and is well-maintained. The transportation is very convenient, and you can reach the main attractions quickly.
The apartment is clean and has everything you need for a short stay. Even though it is a bit worn out, it is still ok. There are two toilets, which is nice if you are with a big group of people. Rooms are quite spacious. The only downside is that two rooms are above the night shop with a terrace. And people are partying there the whole night, the whole time we're there. So four out of six people were not sleeping well. If you are sensitive to loud noises, consider bringing earplugs along.
Really good customer service every time I had a problem it was solved quickly!! Perfect location right by Checkpoint Charlie. Room was clean and exactly like the pictures.

If you are contemplating renting this unit, don't hesitate - book it!
The view and sunsets are incredible. The location is exceptional (I walked everywhere). The apartment is lived in, so it feels personal with sweet touches (Lot's of items from Africa, which makes this doubly special!). I worked here for a week and had no problems with the wifi at all.
100% recommended.

Amazing location and great flat. Bernardo was very kind in letting us in earlier to leave our luggages. It was all clean and tidy when we got in and Bernardo was very clear in explaining all we needed for a great stay. Highly recommended!
Extremely nice loft in a nice part of Berlin. Good connections to the center of the city by public transport.

Andrea’s place was fantastic- really comfortable flat with lovely decor. The apartment is through a courtyard and up several flights of stairs so wouldn’t be ideal for someone with mobility issues. Overlooks a beautiful courtyard

I had a wonderful stay! Volker and Alexandra were incredibly responsive and helpful throughout my trip. The apartment was spotless and well-maintained, making it a very comfortable place to stay. The location was excellent—easily accessible by public transportation, with great amenities nearby. Volker and Alexandra went above and beyond to assist me, which made my time in Berlin smooth and enjoyable. Highly recommend!
Чудове помешкання. Наше перебування на 1 ніч пройшло чудово. Є все необхідне для комфортного перебування. Господар дуже ввічливий і готовий завжди допомогти.

Rainers apartment  is in a great central location close to public transport and the tourist points of interest. Rainer was an outstanding host and even left us a box of chocolates on arrival. We’d thoroughly recommend a stay at rainers apartment

This apartment is wonderful and is located in one of tne most beautiful neighborhoods in Berlin. My husband and I loved the apartment and were very sad when we had to leave. Everything was very comfortable and you could not ask for a better location. We made sure to see other areas as well (Charlottenberg, Kreuzberg, F'Schein, etc), and nothing compares to the lovliness of this section of Prenzlauer Berg. It is our hope that we can find an apartment just like Britta's so that we can spend more time in Berlin.
Great place. Slept well was calm outside. Marvi is great. Would recommend

The flat was great! The location was perfect and Michele was a great host. The fold-out beds were very comfortable and all the linens were clean and cosy for these and the other beds. It was even more spacious than we had expected!

A group of four of us had a lovely stay at Philipp's place! It felt very homely and much more spacious than we expected. The flat was spotless and very artfully decorated. Philipp's mother let us into the flat and was very kind and helpful. When there was a minor issue, Philipp was very proactive and sorted it out immediately. The surrounding area was filled with bars as well as Turkish restaurants and kebab shops. It had easy access to other areas across Berlin. Overall, we were very satisfied and would highly recommend this stay :)
Vše v pořádku,z ubytování kousek do centra. Mohu jen doporučit... 🙂
Lovely big, bright room in one of the best areas in Berlin, lovely hosts, would definitely recommend

Marcus' place is in such a great location, with a lot of wonderful bakeries, bars, restaurants and groceries within just a few steps of the front door. We like to walk, and found that we could get to just about anywhere in the Berlin core by walking, and for areas further out or if we were tired, access to public transport was nearby, reliable and easy to use. The unit is only accessible through three locked doors and looks out onto an inner courtyard that is extremely quiet and private. Amenities were as described, and the unit is very comfortable. Highly recommend.

Estupendo apartamento, muy tranquilo, cerca del centro, muy bien comunicado.
Me he sentido como en casa, contaba con todos los utensilios necesarios.
Totalmente recomendable, muy limpio y ordenado, el propietario se comunico conmigo antes de la llegada y me dio todo lujo de detalles de cómo acceder
Great space and green host! Would definitely stay here again!
比想像中很好多的房型！四個人一間非常舒服，廁所很乾淨，周圍步行都很方便
Dascha ist eine nette Ansprechpartnerin. Sauber u praktische Wohnung in belebter Lage und dennoch ruhig gelegen.
A great place in a great location. Loads of good restaurants in walking distance and easy to jump on the underground. We had a lovely stay!
Highly recommend – would definitely stay again! Great location and Florentine is a great host :)
Sehr saubere und stilvolle Unterkunft für einen fairen Preis.

Die tolle Wohnung liegt direkt im Bergmannkiez, sodass sowohl die umliegenden Lokalitäten als auch die nächste U-Bahnstation schnell erreicht sind. Die Wohnung an sich ist sehr geräumig, blitzsauber mit einem hervorragenden, modernen Bad und einer voll ausgestatteten Küche. Der Check-In mit Julian war sehr angenehm und unkompliziert. Eine perfekte AirBnb-Erfahrung!

Ein schönes Apartment in guter Lage in Friedrichshain.
Der Check-In verlief leider anders als gedacht. Wir wurden darauf hingewiesen den Schlüssel aus einem Restaurant abzuholen, zu welchem wir mit unserem gesamten Gepäck laufen mussten (etwas schade wenn man im Inserat angibt das ein persönlicher Check In bis 21 Uhr möglich wäre).
Nach unserem Aufenthalt wurde seitens der Gastgeberin die Kaution geltend gemacht. Die aufgelisteten Schäden konnten wir leider nicht nachvollziehen. Die Gastgeberin bestand dennoch auf ihre Kaution.
Wir würden empfehlen bei Ankunft zur Absicherung Fotos der Wohnung und vorhandener Schäden zu machen damit so etwas nicht passieren kann.
Insgesamt können wir die Wohnung aufgrund der schlechten Erfahrungen mit dem Host nicht weiterempfehlen.
Agradable estudio,  muy bien ubicado

This apartment is great for anyone who wants to be able to commute to the Mitte (Zoologischer Garten) but wants to be close to Olympiastadion and Grunewald. Great running paths nearby, a nice park with table tennis, decent restaurants but also great proximity to public transport (U-Bahn, S-Bahn and buses). The apartment has what you might need, is modern and clean, and is located off of the street so it is quiet at night. It was the perfect getaway for my family and I for a 3-week stay in Berlin!
Gepflegte und gemütlich Unterkunft in Top Lage und trotzdem ruhig gelegen

The apartment was clean and as it showed in the pictures! The kitchen is full equipped with all the appliances and an espresso machine! The 5th floor is a thing if you are out to see the sightseeing! You can’t find a coffee store or any other shops around the area, the closer is 10-15 min. In addition, the transportation isn’t good! If you want to go at the city center(35-40minutes) you need to change from bus to the underground or tram! The curtains definitely need to change to black out! The apartment loses from the location!

This is a top location for visiting Berlin. Katja is a Sweet perfect host. Clean, light and quite room. With own bathroom lots of privacy..
Close to a lot of breakfast and dinner place. Rent a bike in the Mariannestrasse nearby with good bikes.

I spent a wonderful time staying at Ben & Lena's place and I would like to highly recommend this central located place.
The room is just so lovely, beautiful, cozy, bright, comfortable, nice stylised, clean, the bed and pillows were so good :-) the flat is at really good location and good connected to the underground, trains and airport; Just around the corner you have an Open Gallery with the famous Berlin wall, I came for the concert and also the Mercedez-Benz arena is just behind the house, a great open space market in 10 min walking distance, you have a big shopping mall at the other corner and the tram and underground in front of the door, the city train in 5min walking distance that connect you to the city center in 15 min and directly to the Schönefeld Airport in 45min.
I was more than happy with this good located flat, I have got all what I need and I would like to say especially thank you to Ben for being so available on the phone and thank you Lena for making such a nice house spirit. Bojana O. (Austria)
Just a couple of minutes from the U-Bahn, nice private home. Louis is very hospitable!
Die Unterkunft ist in toller Lage, super modern ausgestattet und Jan ist wirklich sehr nett und kommunikativ.
Everything was very good. The owner is a nicest man who was friendly and available all the time. The apalocate's location is wonderful. Everything was good.

Hardy's place is  very comfortable, and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay of over three weeks. Hardy is a pleasant and very helpful host. The apartment is well appointed, the bathroom is well stocked and the kitchen has all the needed pots, pans, etc. to cook full meals; we had everything we needed. The neighborhood is wonderful with many restaurants (for takeout only at this time), as well as handy markets, and two fabulous bakeries (one French and one for bread) just next door. The lovely canal just across the street offers a great place for a stroll.

We had a fantastic stay. It was the perfect apartment for travelling with a young child.  Our 3 year old loved having the sandpit and toys to hand. Location was great and it was easy to get into the cente of Berlin. Kreuzberg itself was a lovely neighborhood to explore with lots of amazing restaurants. The apartment was exactly as described and was beautifully decorated with all essentials provided throughout. Would not hesitate to recommend.
L'appartement est spacieux, très propre et situé dans un quartier paisible de Berlin avec un immense parc très proche. Heiko est un hôte charmant et prévenant. Nous reviendrons !

Numa is super close to the u-bahn, so it is very easy to travel around the city via public transport. The location itself is not very central, which is a pro because it’s pretty private and quiet there, and con because all restaurants and attractions is 30+ mins walking from the hotel. There are a few cafes and fast food shops very close by.
All in all, we were extremely pleased with the value for the money! The room is very nice and clean, the bed is super-comfy and the instructions are clear and easy to understand. Would definitely recommend to stay at Numa!
Lovely place and great location :) Was woken up by birds singing every morning.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft, ACHTUNG Kaution übertrieben hoch und bei Ankunft direkt zu bezahlen.
Prachtig appartement op de begane grond in een levendige wijk. Vanuit hier hebben we heel goed Berlijn kunnen ontdekken. Contactloos ontvangst, maar alles was piekfijn in orde.
Highly recommended. Really lovely flat, extremely well equipped, very nice area. Great host. Great base for visiting Berlin.
Awsome place, awsome neighbourhood and supernice host! Thanx for everything!

Roomy apartment, comfortable and clean.
By the end of the week we were getting used to the stairs - they were good for us!
Excellent location, walking distance to many attractions.

Very nice and cozy apartment!
We were especially surprised with all the small things included. Like spices, some shampoo and shower gel, cleaning supplies, dish washer, towels…
The place is very well connected with public transport. Everything we wanted and needed was easily reachable.
Iris also responded very quickly to our messages and even let us check in early.
Great place to stay and we already miss it. Hopefully we can visit again soon😊
Thank you Iris!

Wir haben eine wirklich sehr schöne Zeit in dieser Wohnung von Katha & Bernd verbracht!
Alle Räume sind geschmackvoll eingerichtet, man fühlt sich gleich heimisch...Besonders herauszuheben sind der Innenhof-Balkon, das gemütliche Bett und die gut ausgestattete Küche. Die Wohnung liegt zudem sehr, sehr ruhig und eine Anbindung an U-Bahn und S-Bahn ist in unmittelbarer Nähe gegeben. Das Vermieter-Paar ist äußerst bemüht und nimmt sich auch gerne Zeit für Berlin-Insider-Tips. Jederzeit wieder!
Thank you Oli for an amazing stay. Best host with good communication, the place was lovely and so convenient & close to good food and public transport. Can’t recommend it more!

Helen hat uns freundlich empfangen, der Check-In und Check-Out konnte nach meiner/unseren Vorstellungen angepasst werden. Die Räumlichkeiten waren sauber und frisch renoviert. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!
Perfect spot, perfect communication. Super easy check-in and check-out. Could not have been better.
War alles super! Gerne wieder

Carolin met us at the apartment which was great as we got in really late a night.

The apartment was amazing!

It has excellent décor and the facilities are ample. We were a group of six adults and it was big enough for us. It was nice to have Tea/Coffee, herbs, milk, sugar etc available as meant we could have something on arrival as it was late and also make food on some of the other nights. The speaker in the lounge was also a great touch and the WiFi is excellent even with all of us using it.
The Lonely Planet's Berlin travel guide in the apartment was brilliant and we could not have got around without it.

I would certainly stay again and recommend for anyone looking to stay near the center of Berlin. It is only a 10-15 mins walk to Alexander Platz and there are other local bars and restaurants within walking distance.

L’emplacement est idéalement situé et nous avons reçu un accueil très chaleureux. Cependant la cour n’est pas vraiment accessible pour les locataires si vous êtes fumeur il faut sortir complètement du bâtiment. Des alaises sur les matelas et les oreillers auraient apprécié. Sinon très bien dans l’ensemble
Ich kann es nur weiterempfehlen.

Der Aufenthalt bei Christiane war optimal.
Sie ist eine sehr freundliche ,aufmerksame,kommunikative und fürsorgliche Gastgeberin.
Ich habe mich wie zu Hause gefühlt und möchte gerne wiederkommen.

Es gibt eines dazu zuschreiben.
Es war einer der besten Unterkünfte
ever.
Katjas Wohnung ist superschön, ihr Service unkompliziert, die Lage wunderbar - komme gerne wieder!
Fin lejlighed til 2 personer. Forholdsvis roligt område, og 7 min. til U-bahn. Kunne jeg godt vælge næste gang vi skal til Berlin.
Super-zentrale und erschwingliche moderne Unterkunft. Wir würden jederzeit wieder hier unterkommen.
Excellent place to stay in Charlottenburg! Great restaurants right around d the corner!
Nettes kleines Appartement. Sehr kompakt und sauber. Alles vorhanden.
Cozy little apartment on the ground floor with many transport options nearby, and Izabela is a very friendly and communicative host. Perfect for a short stay in Berlin.

Very nice flat! Perfekt location, lots of bara and restaurants nearby. Good communcations woth tram and s-bahn nearby. Grocery store across the street. One thing to note is that the beds are pretty hard so if your sensitive about that, that could be a good thing to know. All in all a very good place.
Alice's apartment is in a great location, close to public transit options.  The room is clean and spacious for a studio.  I would definitely choose to stay here again if I come back to Berlin!
Ina’s place was lovely and quiet, and perfectly situated. We had a great time wandering around Kreuzberg.
An amazing experience and a wonderful location. Thank you for your great hospitality, Micha! It was such a pleasure. Highly recommended!

My stay at Sanne Maria & Natalie's place was short but wonderful! The sheets and the towels smell and feel amazing- just like a hotel. The place is decorated nicely and there is a large balcony overlooking one of the prettier streets in Berlin. The location couldn't be better- you are in the center of the best part of Friedrichshain, steps away from Boxhagener Platz.  Sanne Marie and Natalie were very accommodating- they accepted my reservation request on short notice and made sure that I found my way inside the building with no trouble whatsoever. Any questions I had during my stay were also promptly answered. I truly have no complaints and can highly recommend this beautiful home to anyone!
Very nice and interesting host.

Convenient location to transportation by subway, bus or rail to all parts of the city. Alex is a gracious host and very responsive. Neighbors can be a bit noisy, but Alex has no control over this. Overall a good value.
Pierre’s appartment was very clean and situated in the best area of Berlin. Can totally recomend this flat for groups looking for a nice place in Neukölln! :)

Freundliche Vermieter, gute Lage, gute Anbindung mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, gute Matratze und die Unterkunft war sauber.
Die Suchkriterien der Unterkunft passen leider zum Teil nicht auf das, was wir gesehen haben: "ein privates Bad, das nur für uns bestimmt ist", gibt es nicht, es gibt ein privates WC. Wenn man duschen möchte, muss man Gemeinschaftsräume durchqueren und das Bad wurde gemeinschaftlich genutzt, was aus dem Text zur Unterkunft nicht klar hervorgeht.
Einen "kostenlosen Parkplatz auf dem Grundstück" gibt es nicht, sondern lediglich kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten auf der Straße vor dem Haus.
Unser Eindruck war, dass die Unterkunft noch nicht zuende renoviert worden ist.
Uns ist klar, dass es kein Hotel ist, welches zum ähnlichen Preis buchbar wäre, aber es ist eben auch kein CouchSurfing.
Insgesamt war die Unterkunft für uns ok.

The pincode given for opening the door did not work. We had o wait outside for sometime and for some misterious way the door opened by itself. It was not only for us that the code did not work. For others also that we encountered on the hall, the code apparently was not working.
Alles bestens :) wir waren rundum sehr zufrieden. Danke für das schöne Wochenende! Wir kommen gerne wieder!

The hosts were incredibly friendly, explaining how to get around the city and giving us recomendations for the best tourist destinations and restaurants. They even called us a cab on our way to the airport.
The owners also live next door and they were very open to our asking for help. The apartment itself was clean and exactly as shown on the website. wedding is conveniently located near a train station and metro but the area is still quite far from the central parts of the city. It took us about a half hour to get to any major tourist destinations. Other than that, we had a fantastic visit!
Caroline und ihre Mitbewohner:innen waren sehr nett und sie haben eine tolle, liebevoll eingerichtete Wohnung. Ich habe mich dort sehr wohlgefühlt.
Zeer plezierig smaakvol ingericht appartement. Prima bed. Een fijne plek om te verblijven op goede locatie.

Für meinen aktuellen Aufenthalt hat es gepasst und für die Wetterlage war es noch auszuhalten.
Kommt man jedoch in der kälteren Jahreszeit und möchte eventuell länger in Berlin verweilen, wird’s vermutlich grenzwertig. Denn die Heizung kann man nicht betätigen.
Braucht man nur was zum schlafen und nützt die Unterkunft sonst nicht, is es ok.
War ne Erfahrung - mochte ich aber so nicht mehr.
Malgré quelques petits soucis de maintenance tout s’est très bien passé

Good location and great place to sleep and shower - and not much more. Could use a little loving touch. Would be great with basics in the kitchen such as coffee/tea/sugar/salt/pebber etc. I think the place must be cleared of these items after most visits - surely someone has bought stuff like this and left them - we did. The place is dark since it's on the bottom floor and the windows are tinted but that also keeps the temperature down on warm summer days.
We had a great stay at MaCha’s place. It lived up to our hopes and, most impressively, was very spacious.
Close to main attractions, beautiful ground floor apartment with small outdoor terrace, great place to stay for visiting Berlin. Also Marc was a great host and everything went smooth.

Thomas hat mich auf eine witzige Art & Weise empfangen und ist ein herzenslieber Mensch! Habe mich direkt wohl gefühlt & ich habe alles nötige bekommen und das Bett ist super gemütlich. Konnte morgens entspannt mein Frühstück auf dem Balkon in Ruhe genießen. Würde die Unterkunft immer wieder gerne buchen!:)
Great place to stay. The location is very good. Hae-Ok was an excellent host

Unterkunft wie beschrieben. Einfach, aber sauber! Man sollte sich bei Buchung aber bewusst sein, in welchem Stadteil man sich befindet. Also vielleicht nicht unbedingt als Familienurlaub! Aber das muss jeder für sich selber wissen. Die Kommunikation war sehr gut...sehr freundlich,schnell und ausführlich! Wir kommen gerne nochmal wieder! Vielen Dank!
Great apartment in an interesting neighbourhood.
Merci pour ton acceuil, disponibilité et adaptabilité Johanna !

Great location next to an underground stop
Lots of good restaurants and bars is walking area
un lugar muy bello, para pasar la noche opara poder permanecer mas tiempo :D
Hôte extrêmement facile à rejoindre et s’assure que tout se passe bien pour nous. Très agréable séjour chez lui. A recommander sans hésitation. Transports faciles vers le centre .
schönes Zimmer mit Gemeinschaftsbad in einem buddhistischen Kulturzentrum.
Spacious, quiet and clean apartment close to public transport. Max. 10min ride to Alexanderplatz and other great sightseeing sites. All good, recommended for short and longer stay in Berlin.

Mona y su familia son muy simpáticos y muy agradables y la casa es perfecta.
Tranquila, limpia y bien ubicada
Sehr schöne Wohnung in ruhiger und privater Atmosphäre.

Exkluvise Wohnung in bester Lage im Prenzlauer Berg. Die Einrichtung lässt keine Wünsche offen, insbesondere die Küche ist mit allem ausgestattet, was man sich wünscht. Besonders schön war, dass Kleinigkeiten wie Salz, Zucker usw. vorrätig waren und man für eine paar Tage nicht riesige Vorräte anlegen musste. Die Kommunikation mit Marine war vollkommen unkompliziert und angenehm. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Zweckmäßig eingerichtet in einem ehemaligen Geschäftslokal im Erdgeschoss. Alles neu renoviert. Obwohl die Wohnung sehr hellhörig ist haben wir in den bequemen Boxspringbetten hervorragend geschlafen.
In der direkten Umgebung gibt es alles was man zum Leben braucht - Supermarkt, diverse Restaurants und Imbisse, Friseur uvm.
Verkehrsanbindung ist mit Bus vor der Haustüre und U- und S-Bahn 2 min entfernt top und trotzdem ruhig gelegen.
Kontakt mit dem Vermieter hat super funktioniert. Wir konnten sogar ganz kurzfristig früher einchecken.
Wir kommen gerne wieder.

I'd give 6 stars if I could. 5 for a great artistic apartment in a lovely neighborhood with a well laid out range of amenities. And another star for how responsive she was & how she kindly stayed up late to let me in after a late flight.
Excellent place to stay in the heart of Berlin & next time I'm back, I'll check first to see if this apartment is free.

A lovely, quiet apartment in a great location by the riverside. Easy access to Berlin’s main tourist spots via the local S-bahn station (and also a brilliant base for a Berlin Marathon stay). Well equipped kitchen ideal for cooking simple meals and a host of good cafes and restaurants within a 5 minute walk - we had a fantastic meal at the Ristorante Da Ponte. Sedat was pro-active getting in touch with check-in instructions before we arrived, provided plenty of recommendations and advice for making the most of our trip to the city, and was quick to respond to messages during our stay.

We had a very warm welcome. It was very comfortable right from the beginning. Everything was convenient. And best of all, Mona and Ahmed were very accessible and made us feel at home.
This was my first Airbnb experience and it was amazing.

Der Aufenthalt war wirklich großartig, Berlin ganz privat mitten im Wohngebiet, umgeben von Restaurants, kleinen Läden und schöne Spazierwege mit Parks gleich um die Ecke. Die Unterkunft bietet alles was man so braucht und wenn man es nicht eilig hat und sich einfach treiben lassen möchte, ist auch so ziemlich alles zu Fuß erreichbar.
My stay at Dietrich’s was stress-free. His place has everything needed for a comfortable stay and it was very clean. He was also proactive in communicating with me!

Der Check in war total problemlos habe ich noch nie erlebt so !
Die Wohnung war genau wie beschrieben und auch super sauber! Wir haben uns das Wochenende sehr wohl gefühlt und werden auf jedenfall wiederkommen!!
Alex ist ein sehr netter Mensch und super hilfsbereit!!
Wir danken das wir die Wohnung nutzen durften!
Lg
Alles perfekt!
The apartment is really great. Good size and location

הדירה נקייה , ומאובזרת
מספיק מיטות גם ל5 אנשים ( והספה לעוד אחד )
המיקום לא טוב אבל חוץ מזה הכל בסדר איתה , ואף מצויין .
8 דק הליכה לתחנת הרכבת / אוטובוס הקרובה
Alles in einem war es einfach TOP;)
Die Zimmer waren kleiner als erwartet.

wonderful spacious apartment in a fantastic location near restaurants and public transport. Agustin's recommendations were spot on and the time he spent with us giving suggestions we really appreciated.
Thank you.
Kelly, Darren and kids.
Australia

Perfect location to visit everything in Berlin. I was 20-30 minutes from every location I wanted to visit. Thomas was helpful and responsive, as well as, provided some excellent recommendations for places to eat.
Good place, confortable and clean, close to the metro.

Die Wohnung sieht aus wie auf den Fotos und trotz Straßenlage war nichts vom Verkehr zu hören.
Wir haben uns dort insgesamt sehr wohl gefühlt.
Ein kleines Manko war lediglich das WLAN, hier wäre eine zweite Option für Geschäftsreisende schön.

Die Unterkunft ist auf 3 Etagen aufgeteilt in einem Altbau. Im Bett konnte ich gut schlafen. In der kleinen Kochnische konnte ich gut Kaffee zubereiten. Die Wohnung hat mir gut gefallen, ist ordentlich und mit dem Wichtigen eingerichtet. Fußläufig von 5 Min ist eine Bushaltestelle und von ca. 10 Min eine U/S-Bahn Haltestelle, von denen man gut zu den bekannten Sehenswürdigkeiten kommt. Die Wohnung liegt ruhig im Hinterhaus. Ich komme gerne wieder.
Very nice apartment. Only here for one night but it was great!
Ich hatte eine schöne Zeit in der ruhigen und sehr gut gelegenen Unterkunft von Fritjof. Der Check-In war auch unkompliziert früher möglich, was mir sehr geholfen hat. Gerne wieder!

Good little cosy Berlin basement apartment.
A little noisy in the rooms but is as listed.
Excellent location. Close to heaps of great stuff. Quick communication from host .

Overall, a really lovely stay. The apartment is in an ideal location, close to many bars and restaurants, yet in a quiet area with considerate neighbours, which made for a very pleasant month-long visit.
The apartment had everything we needed for a longer stay, including a washing machine and plenty of spare bedding, which was great. Although we could have cooked, we chose to enjoy the wide range of nearby dining options instead.
As others have mentioned, the apartment is quite dark, but on the plus side, it stayed wonderfully cool and fresh even during a heatwave - a real bonus.
Overall, a great and friendly host and a very pleasant stay.
Very lovely! Awesome location
All good. Everything exactly as described in a great location.
the apartment is great and very clean but it's lacking a washing machine which was a bit of a hussle to do in the washing place near by

Good central location, key got stuck in top lock (it should have been made clear only to use the bottom lock on the door to the apartment) room needs a bit of cheering up - so bland & clinical, no colour. Needs a chopping board and bread knife. The bed is far too soft. But it was warm and the shower was good.
Mr. Christian was a very warm and helpful host, I really enjoyed Berlin. It’s very close to almost everything in Berlin.

Die Wohnung ist genau wie auf dem Bildern abgebildet sehr großzügig und stylisch modern eingerichtet und trotzdem gemütlich. Wir haben uns rund um wohl gefühlt. Die Ausstattung war absolut überdurchschnittlich mit Kinder Besteck/Geschirr und einem Kinderbett. Man schläft nach hinten, so dass es nachts ruhig war.
Annette war eine tolle und zuvorkommende Gastgeberin. Sie war bei Fragen und Tipps immer ansprechbar und erreichbar. Die Lage ist super, man ist schnell im Kiez und hat ein großes kulinarisches Angebot, Spielplätze und Anbindung (Ringbahn) sind ebenfalls direkt um die Ecke.
Wir würden hier jederzeit wieder hinkommen. Für einen Ausflug nach Berlin eine optimale Wohnung.
Amazing house and the best airbnb experience I've had. Close to central by bus. Really clean and affordable. Thank u!

Insgesamt können wir Helena und ihre hübschen Zimmer nur jedem empfehlen, der eine entspannte und qualitativ ansprechende Unterkunft sucht.
