Bardzo dobra lokalizacja, dobre wyposażenie,
własciciele bardzo pomocni
Polecam
Georgy‘s Appartement ist wirklich sehr schön und alles entspricht absolut den Angaben und Bildern. Preis - Leistung stimmen total. Wirklich eine Reise wert!

Merci à Cecil pour l’accueil exceptionnel qu’il nous a réservé lors de notre séjour à Berlin. L’appartement est magnifiquement décoré, très bien équipé et propre .. on se sent comme là dans la suite d’un palace 5 étoiles !
L’emplacement est parfait car à proximité direct de plusieurs métros et le quartier est certainement un des plus mignons de Berlin.
Cecil s’est montré attentionné et disponible tout au long de notre séjour et a tout fait pour que notre arrivée se passe dans les meilleures conditions.
Good location and airbnb

Ursula fue una excelente anfitriona. Nos recibio antes de previsto y nos explico todo lo que le consultamos. Muy atenta en todo, tiene mapas y guias de Berlin que te ayuda mucho en tu visita. El departamento es muy comodo y la habitacio muy amplia. Se puede descansar muy bien. La ducha es increible, la presion del agua termina siendo un masaje para la espalda. La cocina super completa. Esta muy cerca del subte y al lado del edificio hay un supermercado muy barato donde comprar. Es muy recomendable para cualquier tipo de viaje que hagas por Berlin

The apartment exceeded our expectations in every way. The location is ideal—the nicest part of Berlin filled with shops and amazing restaurants, many of which were happy to deliver food to the apartment. A great supermarket a couple of blocks away, friendly shop owners, and just a really cool neighborhood to explore when we went for walks in any direction.
The apartment itself was top-notch. Spacious, beautifully furnished, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we might need. The only very minor exception is that there is no freezer, but this did not interfere with our ability to enjoy all of our meals in the apartment. The photos on this site don’t do this place justice. It’s truly stunning.
We cannot imagine a better host than Yves. He responded within moments to every question we had both during the booking process and during our stay. His warmth and hospitality were second to none. Here’s an example: My husband realized a few days into our 3-week stay that he really missed playing video games, so he asked Yves for some help in renting an Xbox. (The rental company required that we have a German bank account, which we don’t.) Yves responded that he bought an Xbox for the apartment on Amazon, and it would arrive in two days.
We have stayed in Airbnbs all over the world, and this is far and away the nicest place in the best location with the most gracious host that we have ever experienced. We wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone who is visiting Berlin.
Gutes Hotel in zentraler Lage zum Ku’damm. Apartment war optimal für uns. Alles vorhanden wie beschrieben.
Die Wohnung ist optimaler Ausgangspunkt für Unternehmungen. Alles was man braucht ist fußläufig erreichbar.
Stylish, clean space in an excellent location! Host was communicative and helpful, making our stay easy and enjoyable. My wife and I will definitely stay here again while we’re in Berlin next!
Eine verkehrsmäßig prima gelegene Wohnung in der man sich wohlfühlen kann. Toller und freundlicher Service, von Ankunft bis zur Abfahrt klasse, dafür ein dickes DANKESCHÖN !!!

Die Wohnung war für ein Wochenende in Berlin genau richtig: Stylisch und dabei sehr gemütlich, gute Lage in Ku’dammnähe, Bäckereien, Supermärkte und diverse Restaurants in direkter Nachbarschaft. Die Kommunikation mit Jochen war problemlos. Wir würden wieder kommen.
The apartment is very central, 5 mins walk to the station, lots of restaurants close by. Very close to Museum Island, river cruises, local amenities - supermarket etc
Heel mooie en fijne kamer met een geweldige ligging: zeer dichtbij de Postdamer Platz. Janet was erg aardig en een prettige host. De WiFi werkte helaas niet, maar verder was het helemaal top.

Marcel was a fantastic host and provided an amazing space for me for a month and was very prompt with any of my questions.
The apartment is in a great location with many shops near by, and only a short walk to multiple public transport services. The apartment was warm, clean and cozy and fully equipped for my stay.

Unser Aufenthalt im Studio Lizzy war perfekt. Genau, wie beschrieben, sauber, angemehm, super ruhig, perfekt zu erreichen mit allen "Öffentlichen" und teotzdem quasi im Grünen. Besonderer Dank: trotzdem es eine "kontaktlose" Vermietung war, war es eine Spitzenkommunikation! Danke dafür! und allen anderen sei die Unterkunft gerne empfohlen!
Merci à Dave pour son accueil chaleureux. La chambre était impeccable, propre et pratique (thé café, eau à disposition).
Paul is a beautiful host, great stay.
Razem z moją rodziną spędziliśmy świetny tydzień w tym apartamencie. Wszystko działało tak jak powinno, a Pankow to świetna okolica. Polecam!

Helen ist eine wunderbare Gastgeberin. Sehr freundlich und nett, zuverlässig und hilfsbereit.
Die Unterkunft war sauber und schön eingerichtet.
Jederzeit wieder!!!
Sehr zu empfehlen, die Kommunikation mit David ist super und die Unterkunft für den Preis wirklich sehr gut!
Christina ist freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Prima verblijf gehad. Eenvoudig maar netjes!

Frank's apartment is in a great location and has everything you might need for a comfortable stay. Frank himself was lovely & communicative & did his best to accommodate wifi needs as I needed to work remotely during my stay. Thank you!

Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben. Aufgeräumt und sehr sauber. Besonders gefallen hat mir der Innenhof, der schön grün bepflanzt ist.
Eine U-Bahn Haltestelle gibt es in 2 Minuten Fußweg.
Besonders gefallen hat mir die Kommunikation . Superschnelle Antworten und immer freundlich. Klare Empfehlung!

Die Lage ist sehr zentral und die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel sind super fußläufig zu erreichen.
Die Umgebung ist ruhig und wir haben uns sehr sicher gefühlt. Alle erforderlichen Gegenstände inkl. Handtücher waren da.
Insgesamt waren wir zufrieden und würden wieder kommen.
Mitten in Berlin, viele Sehenswürdigkeiten sind zu Fuß zu erreichen, nah an der U-Bahn Station um zu anderen Plätzen zu gelangen. Alles topp

je recommande vivement la location de l'appartement d'Alex et cela pour plusieurs raisons : sa proximité avec les moyens de transport et les magasins, à pied, il est facile de rejoindre de nombreux points d'intérêt, comme par exemple le marché aux puces du dimanche. Mais ce que j'ai particulièrement apprécié, c'est le grand calme qu'offre l'appartement, ce qui permet de bien se reposer.
pour finir, Alex à su se montrer très amical et très pratique pour faciliter notre séjour.
si je reviens à Berlin il est évident que je reprendrai cet appartement.
although not the cheapest apartment, it is money well spend. Great rooms, beds, kitchen, 2 toilets. Absolutely worth the money.
Bon emplacement

Lovely apartment really close to s-Bahn and u-Bahn and shops and restaurants. Great area. Flat is fantastic with a well kitted out kitchen, very cosy and warm in winter it was -3 outside. Good hot shower. Marcus was a really helpful and responsive host and looked after us really well. I would highly recommend this to anyone looking to stay in Berlin and would definitely stay here again.
La atención en recepción es muy buena y el hostal estaba limpio y ordenado, 100% recomendable .

Susanne es súper linda! Siempre estuvo atenta a nosotros y la realidad es que fue un alivio llegar con ella! Después de haber perdido un vuelo para llegar a Berlín, tuvimos que tomar camión para llegar (hicimos 11 horas!) y obviamente llegamos muy tarde al departamento, no obstante, se mostro súper accesible! Fue un ángel para nosotros! Gracias por todo Susanne! <3
El cuarto está super limpio y es muy acogedor! La cama está deliciosa! Descansamos súper bien! 👌🏻 Nos hubiera gustado quedarnos más tiempo y si regresamos a Berlín, definitivamente nos volveríamos a hospedar con ella!
Cute apartment. There's a tram station nearby, a few restaurants, bakeries and cafés. The river "Spree" is also just a short walk away. Villiam was responsive and friendly. Would stay there again.
Nice flat with a good location. Kitchen well equipped.

Die Wohnung ist gemütlich und verfügt über alles, was man braucht. Sie liegt günstig in U-Bahn-Nähe. Auch für eine Erkundung zu Fuß gut gelegen.
Ashraf ist ein sehr sympathischer und zuvorkommender Gastgeber. Gerne wieder!

A great place, perfect location close to a nice park and all the public transport needed. Fai was always quick to respond to any questions we had. Lots of space in the perfectly clean apartment, comfortable beds and couches. Well equipped kitchen and enough places to eat outside close by. Neighbor downstairs is very sensitive to sound
Gracias por todo

Paulina´s Wohnung ist wirklich super "cosy", super clean, check in und out sehr, sehr easy!
Alles was man braucht, ist schnell erreichbar - ob U Bahn, frühstücken ( Hermann´s gleich um die Ecke auf der Brunnenstr. ) oder einkaufen. Sehr empfehlenswert und tolle Lage!
Die Lage war gut, direkt am Mauerpark und die Öffis waren ebenfalls gut zu erreichen. Wir hatten eine gute Zeit.
Alles super, immer wieder gerne!
The location is good and the place is clean
Was very accommodating to my unusual one night request. Five minutes away from the train and easy to find
Incredibly beautiful apartment and we had it to ourselves all weekend - it was amazing!
Cozy apartment, comfortable. Nice view from balcony

The apartment is pristine and Markus has put in a lot of thought into it. We felt right at home. Check-in was very easy with the instructions, as was washing or clearing trash. It is amply stocked with cutlery. It is situated in a very nice location with good restaurants around, and a 5min walk to two tram stations that can take you to the city center or any other connections. Markus was also very proactive in communication. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay there, and I would recommend this place strongly to anyone.

Kim’s home was so beautiful and cozy. It always smelled nice, and there was an adorable little dog named Yoshi ੯‧̀͡u). We enjoyed having coffee together and had great conversations. The location is excellent, with nice cafés, restaurants, a large supermarket, and a laundromat nearby. I highly recommend this room. Kim, come visit Korea!
Die Unterkunft war einwandfrei! Genau, wie beschrieben. Die Buchung ging in null Komma nichts vonstatten & wir konnten direkt in die Wohnung.
Martins Wohnung ist eine Altbauwohnung in Neukölln mit allem, was dazu gehört: knarrende Dielen, hohe Räume, internationale Nachbarn. Wunderbar! Willkommen in Berlin!

This place is so lovely, completely spotless, spacious and bright. The apartment had everything we needed and seemed very newly renovated. It was in quite a noisy block of appartments but wasn't too bad. The location is really good, 3 minutes​ walk from the train station and in a really lovely neighbourhood.

We enjoyed our stay here. The location is excellent. Very close to public transit and lots of restaurants, shops, cafes. The apartment itself is very quiet as faces a courtyard. Definitely recommend this air bnb to anyone travelling to Berlin.
The flat is quiet and really clean. Semra's parents are very hospitable and helpful. It's a perfect choice if you plan to use U8 line. I enjoyed my stay there.

the apartment is larger than it appears in photos. Very clean, the bed was exceptionally comfortable. Excellent location, 5 minutes subway, and busfront of the building. No noise, very safe building. Michael was very quick to respond. He gave me all the directions to the building. I highly recommend this apartment, where I felt at home.
Perfect location, perfect decoration. Ideal for a couple !

Die Wohnung ist sehr gemütlich, sauber und gut ausgestattet. Es ist an alles gedacht, insbesondere an Kochutensilien, Gewürze, etc. Auch Spül-und Putzmittel sind vorhanden, ebenso ausreichend Geschirr. Die Matratzen waren sehr bequem. Die ruhige Lage ist toll, man ist problemlos in 30 Minuten mit der S-Bahn am Brandenburger Tor. Guter Ausgangspunkt für Radtouren entlang der Havel.
Ingrid ist eine sehr freundliche, hilfsbereite Gastgeberin, mit der wir auch nette Gespräche geführt haben. Danke für das schöne Berlin-Zuhause!

Für uns eine gute Lage.
Sehr schönes Zimmer

Le logement est très bien situé dans un quartier agréable. Les hôtes sont très accueillants et flexibles et donnent de très bons conseils et adresses. Le logement est propre et le linge et la salle de bain sont régulièrement nettoyés.
Je recommande et je reviendrai

It was a pleasure living at Judith's and Lauritz's beautiful, cozy and peaceful house in the quiet and pretty neighborhood that was only 20 minutes away from Alexanderplatz by M4 tram running every five minutes!
But I am even happier knowing the hosts! Super friendly, nice and helpful people that I will try stay again with next time I am in Berlin.
Vi havde en rigtig godt weekend ophold i Dietrichs lejlighed. Skøn lokation, ren og pæn lejlighed og ingen problemer med praktikaliteter 😊 Vi ville klart anbefale denne lejlighed.

L'appartement est très bien équipée, calme et les pièces sont très grandes. Il se situe à proximité des transports en commun, d'un magasin d'alimentation et d'une boulangerie, ce qui est vraiment pratique. La propriétaire est très avenante. A recommander!
Sehr guter und zuvor kommende Gastgeber
Lovely host, high quality place, exceptional position in the centre of Berlin. Looking forward to visit again!

Zuerst mal zu den positiven Seiten
Super Lage, unkomplizierter Check in,
Ruhig.. Shampoo Conditioner Bodylotion vorhanden, bequemes Bett
Für mehr als 2 Personen nicht geeignet da zu klein. Das Sofa ist ausziehbar jedoch sehr unbequem und dann kann man sich wirklich nicht mehr im Raum bewegen.
Küche ist nicht zum kochen gedacht
(Ganz kleines Kochfeld das Fenster muss immer offen sein da sonst der Alarm losgeht.
Das Bad ist in einem schlechten Zustand und hätte echt ein wenig Liebe gebraucht.
Für ein Pärchen, dass Berlin erkunden will passt es perfekt. Nicht für Familien geeignet..( meiner Meinung nach)
Wenn die Wohnungen ein wenig makeover bekommen würden wäre das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis absolut ok aber nicht im jetzigen Zustand.

Waren nur eine Nacht da und mussten schon über eine Stunde auf unseren Check in warten. Der Check in war erst um 15 Uhr so mussten wir vor der Tür bis 16 Uhr warten. Auf der Airbnb Seite sind zwei Doppelbetten angegeben. Angekommen waren aber nur ein Doppelbett und zwei einzelbetten. Auf Anfrage konnte mir da aber auch keiner weiterhelfen. Ein wenig enttäuschend.
Très bonne localisation, beaucoup de cafés et restaurants à proximité. Logement propre et en bon état. Hôte réactif en cas de soucis
problém se sprchou
Ottimo appartamento vicino a stazione metropolitana, buono anche la disponibilità del posto auto gratuito in cortile chiuso adiacente.
Tolles, schön eingerichtetes Zimmer, super freundlicher Gastgeber und gutes Preis Leistungs Verhältnis
Lovely area!!

El sitio es como de película. Tiene una iluminación que hace del espacio algo mágico. Muy bien ubicado y en un barrio muy lindo. Lo único es tratar de solucionar el tema de la ducha que a veces formaba un charco afuera pero nada grave. Volvería sin pensarlo.

Nous nous sommes bien sentis chez Gihad, c'était comme chez nous. Il a été très amical avec nous et ses instructions étaient très claires. De plus le quartier n'est pas éloigné des principales attractions de la ville en transports en commun avec la gare de Shoneweide juste à quelques mètres. Merci beaucoup à toi Gihad.

We had a great stay! Everything, from the cosy tables outside the hotel where we could take a glass, to the location and facilities was super. Very nice host who helped us settle in and gave advice on what to do. Close to the S1 train which takes you directly to Brandenburger Gate, which is a great starting point for exploring Berlin. Thanks for having us!

We had a really good time at the apartment.
The apartment is baby friendly for the most part, so that was nice, and we were able to borrow a baby bed and a high chair.
The communication was easy and very good.
The Café next door offers very good coffee!
I would highly recommend the place!
Would highly recommend, a very warm welcome, easy to find and great location, will definitely be back!
Nice area, light apartment with high ceilings, we found it very comfortable 👌🏻
Lovely apartment for 2. Great location
Good hotel and great location near most Berlin important lanadmakrs and metro bus and train station. The service was quite good and their coffee buffet from 1 to 9pm was great.
Always fast response from Ben. Nice and clean apartment

Super logement pour un long séjour! Situé à proximité de cafés et épiceries. La station de métro est à 7 minutes de marche et le centre y est accessible très rapidement. Francesco nous a gentiment accommoder pour nous laisser arriver plus tôt dans le logement à notre arrivée. La petite cuisinette est pratique et a tout ce qu’il faut.
Great place, great communication, very comfy bed! :)
great stay and friendly people
Sehr saubere, gemütliche und schöne Wohnung. Unser Aufenthalt war sehr komfortabel! Meine Kinder wollten länger bleiben!))

Dominik's place is a true gem, conveniently located near the city center in a charming little suburb that is quiet and peaceful at night.
There are plenty of lovely cafes and restaurants to discover on a leisurely stroll. The apartment is incredibly charming, filled with natural light, great architectural finishes, and offers spacious living with excellent amenities.
I particularly enjoyed cooking and dining while gazing out the window. Dominik was very responsive and took the time to introduce himself, providing great recommendations. Overall, I had a fantastic stay and would definitely choose to stay here again on my next visit.
would stay there again if i get to visit berlin again. great location and clean
I have been here several times now and it’s always a really nice stay with no bad surprises. Everything is as described and they are very accommodating. 10/10 would recommend.
Amazingly easy to reach, super clean, and the most central possible. Was a dream to stay here!
Empfehlenswert

The location was great, the space was cool, and exactly what I was looking for for my stay.
My only complaint was that the WiFi network was not reliable, and I couldn’t work from the hostel. Zoom calls dropped, I would frequently lose connection while performing tasks, even scrolling social media on my phone barely worked.
Nice apartment well located
Really nice place to stay in Berlin!

Fine price and location. But the studio was a little bit dirty,also really bad smell. But there’s many things available inside the studio. Cutlery,kettle,toaster and many more. Looks the same as in the picture.

Freundlicher Empfang, Lage ist in Ordnung. Das Mehrbettzimmer war sauber und man hatte genug Platz für seine Sachen. Das Gemeinschaftsbad war sauber und man hat sich überall wohl gefühlt. Kann es jederzeit weiterempfehlen.

Omkars bolig ligger centralt til udflugter i Berlin, og ligger i et roligt kvarter tæt på U bahn. Der er mange nøgler til at låse mange døre op med, før end at man kommer til lejligheden. Let at finde fra lejligheden og til U bahn. Mange gode restauranter i nærheden. Den eneste lille ting, som kan forbedres er, hvis der kan findes ekstra sengetøj og lagen i skabet, så man selv kan skifte disse, og måske en mindre ikke så blød hovedpude. Ellers var alt godt. Pænt og rent.
Beautiful and clean home in good and safety place. Thank you for all 🙂
Molt bona experiència, però els nòrdics del llit eren una mica curts per una persona de 1,90
Sehr nette Unterkunft!

This place is great, located in a great area, close to everything. Verda is an excellent host. The only down side of this rental property is it’s a 5th floor walk up. Close to 90 stairs to climb to the front door. But it didn’t really bother me, or my wife and daughter. Also no air conditioning, but it was not needed because it was cool enough at night to just sleep with the windows open during our stay. We would totally rent this apartment again. Place is nice and clean and Verda is a great host

La casa si trova in un quartiere tranquillo di villette, a 10 minuti a piedi dalla penultima fermata della U7. il centro in metro dista quasi un'ora quindi l'alloggio è l'ideale se si pensa di uscire la mattina e tornare la sera, in quanto ha un ottimo prezzo paragonato ad altri in città, non se si ha necessità di passare da casa durante il giorno, trovandosi più o meno lontano da tutto.
Le stanze ed il bagno sono esattamente come da descrizione, pulite e confortevoli.
Non abbiamo incontrato Iljana, abbiamo comunicato via chat per il check in, che è risultato molto semplice.
Consigliato.

This was our third stay at this apartment and we have already booked for next summer - it is simply perfect for us. It's a perfect location with lots of public transportation right around the corner and most of the stores and services around the corner. The place is perfectly furnished and has everything you need. Yves is very responsive - prompt reply whatever the time. Thanks for a great stay!
Eine sehr schöne Unterkunft, hatte alles was man für einen Aufenthalt braucht. Die Lage war ebenfalls sehr gut gelegen, gerne wieder.
A warm and friendly place with a family atmosphere. I highly recommend it.

Charlotte ist die perfekte Gastgeberin. Ihre Wohnung ist wunderschön und mit Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet. Du findest ALLES was du brauchst, inkl. Verlängerungskabel (damit konnte ich auf dem süßen Balkon arbeiten). Das Schlafzimmer liegt direkt an der S-Bahn Linie und in der früh wird etwas hell, Ohropax und Schlafbrille können helfen. Vielen Dank Charlotte, ich habe mich wie Zuhause gefühlt.
Very nice flat, extremely close to very good dinning.

Logement conforme aux photos et description. Propre, accueillant, vue dégagée et confortable. Situation au centre de tout. Seul bémol, pas de café alors qu’il y a une superbe machine à disposition. Sinon extra !

Emir's place is quite conveient, easy access to S/B bahn to anywhere in the city. Emir is a quite nice guy, he even show me around the where i can eat, to shopping, to traffic & guidance me how to buy the local traffic ticket. When I arrived at the main entrance, he come downstairs and help me come in, which is quite helpful when you go there alone in the late night. Alaa is the one stay with us when i were in the town, he also help me a lot. I would definitely recommend any other guy come to the town try Emir's place. Not mention he speak different language, including English, Russia, Espana, German, Arbiac, this is really amazing.
Perfekte Lage, super schöne Gebäudekomplex und hier kann man sich richtig wohl fühlen. Bis zum nächsten besuch in Berlin.

Vi havde et rigtig dejligt ophold i Daniels lejlighed i Neukölln. Området var virkelig skønt – stille og grønt, men stadig tæt på masser af gode restauranter, hyggelige barer og små butikker. Der var også mulighed for at spille bordtennis i nærheden og tage på tur i den fantastiske Tempelhof Park, som vi klart kan anbefale!
Daniel var en super sød og hjælpsom vært, og han reagerede hurtigt, da vi havde lidt bøvl med den elektroniske nøgle ved indtjekning – han dukkede hurtigt op og fik styr på det hele. Lejligheden var pæn og ren, med alt det nødvendige. Hvis vi skal nævne én ting, så kunne madrasserne godt trænge til en opgradering – de var lidt slidte og hårde, især for os, der ikke er helt unge længere.
Alt i alt en god base for en tur til Berlin – vi ville bestemt komme igen!

Theo ist ein sehr netter und unkomplizierter Gastgeber mit einer sauber, großen, gut gelegenen und zudem frisch renovierte sehr schönen Altbauwohnung.
Thanks!
Vielen Dank! Wir waren rundherum mit allem super zufrieden!

Im grossen und ganzen war die Wohnung perfekt. Sie war so, wie beschrieben, gueter Service und sehr unkomplizierte Abgabe der Wohnung.
das einzige was mir aufgefallen war, während meines Aufenthaltes waren nur Kleinigkeiten.
z.B war bei uns der WC-Deckel verdreckt (leichte spuren und flecken).Die Türklinke fällt aus dem Türdorn sehr leicht raus. (im Badezimmer). der Linke Stuhl, welcher nach dem betretten der Wohnung links am Esstisch angelehnt war, fällt leicht raus. (Stuhlbein fällt raus) Man kann ihn zwar einfach wieder einschlagen aber das ist kein grosser Mangeln.
im grossen und ganzen war die Wohnung Perfekt und Sauber!
Jessy was a wonderful host. Her place was beautiful and central and so comfortable. She left us detailed notes for restaurants for every occasion. Highly recommended.

The host is fantastic and very quick to respond plus happy to help.

The location is perfect - a few steps away from grabbing shop supplies, relaxing in a cafe or having a beer. All this buzz but very quiet too - we slept fantastically! With a quick trip on the U-bahn you're right in the centre of town.

The appartment is gorgeous - uniquely decorated, clean and spacious. The kitchen is well-equipped and the shower is excellent. It stands out from other airbnb places I've stayed at before. I would definitely recommend!

Allen is a great host with very good communication skills. We felt right at home in her apartment and were happy to meet her son and partner. Apartment is located close to major tram intersection with direct link to the central station. Very nice experience!
je recommande sans hésiter ce logement. Il est propre, bien situé avec tout le nécessaire pour passer un bon séjour
Super Location, sehr stilvoll und in schönem Quartier gelegen. Gerne wieder einmal.
Nice place in an interesting area. I would be happy to come back.

Henrik made contact with us long before our arrival date to ensure someone was present when we arrived and also gave us lots of info on the local area. We really liked the flat, its perfect for a couple exploring Berlin. The flat was clean, well presented and warm and has an individual character. The street is quiet and mainly residential but there are shops, cafes, bars and restaurants a short walk away. Public transport is close and the WiFi is good. Many thanks. Highly recommended!

Karsten nous a attendu dans l'appartement malgré notre arrivée tardive (22:30) . Il a été très accueillant et coopératif. L'appartement est conforme aux photos, et est parfait pour deux personnes ( pas plus! ). Il est bien placé, dans un quartier hyper sympathique ! La cuisine est très sommaire, mais nous a amplement suffi pour notre séjour de 3 jours.
L'appartement était agréable et bien agencé. Il était tres propre et fonctionnel et Douglas a été très réactif à nos demandes. Je recommande.
Incredible location in Prenzlauer Berg. Close enough to everything, but still in a private, neighborhood-y spot.
Wie beim letzten Mal war alles top!

War alles sehr schön. Werden bestimmt wieder mal mit einem Hausboot Urlaub machen. Hier ist alles drauf was man für einen Woche  Urlaub braucht. Man kann baden, angeln, grillen, chillen … und die Natur und das Wasser genießen. Alle Details auf dem Boot sind gut durchdacht schön und zweckmäßig. Wenn es Fragen oder Probleme gab wurden diese schnell und unkompliziert gelöst.

Very nice appartement with everything you need! We chose this appartement also because of the parking space so it was a bit further from the center of Berlin then we would normally go, but with uber or metro/trams you can get everywhere pretty easy!

The studio was perfect, very clean and cosy. Kristina's little thoughtful touches like providing snacks and mini toiletries were much appreciated. The area was nice and had everything we needed. Great value for money too. Would recommend to anyone staying in Berlin!

L’hôtel est parfaitement bien situé !
Les transport sont à proximité.

very nice air bnb! exceeded all my expectations. BERLiN is a vegan heaven.
La casa di Christophe è stata perfetta per il nostro week end a Berlino. Molto bella e comodissima per raggiungere qualsiasi zona della città.

Had a really good experience on our first weekend in Berlin, location was easy to reach by bus and the host was very responsive and communicative. The check-in/check out was easy and everything was clean, including the shared bathrooms. No complaints, thank you to the host for being so friendly and helpful.

We thought we booked a double room but actually got an apartment on the top level, which was great. Photos didn’t match this particular listing but wasn’t worthy of complain at all. Great place, definitely recommend.

Tobias is a polite and courteous guest who has made himself available to every eventuality. The apartment is nice, warm, quiet in a great location. Some small renovation work would be necessary. The price is very cheap for Berlin considering the location. I advise.

Ich war sehr zufrieden mit dem Aufenthalt. Eine Gegend, in der ich auch auf dem Nachhauseweg bspw. nachts von der Oper mit meinen 3 Kindern keine Angst hatte! Die Unterkunft war exakt wie beschrieben, die Kommunikation schnell und hilfreich und sogar Salz, Pfeffer, Öl und Papiertücher wurden uns nachgeliefert, da sie zuerst nicht wie beschrieben vorhanden waren. Das fand ich wirklich toll!

Wir hatten einen wirklich schönen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Erheblich hierzu beigetragen hat auch dieses Apartment. Der Service war unkompliziert, schnell und freundlich und das Apartment war hervorragend ausgestattet. Ist definitiv eine Empfehlung für alle die einen Aufenthalt in Berlin planen.
Martin is great houst. Great location. I stongly recomend to anyone.

Great hotel for our short stay in Berlin, the location is great and only a stones throw away from checkpoint Charlie which is a must. We arrived on a sleeper train at 6am and the hotel were accommodating for us and allowed to freshen up in the hotel and offered us free tea and coffee. They held our bags for the day whilst we explored Berlin which was a very organised and trusting process. The room was small but did the job with an amazing aircon system and comfortable bed. Would 100% recommend.
Logement commun mais ça n'a pas été un problème, tout était niquel rien a signaler 👌🏼
Very well located place. Verda was very kind and we loved having the little balcony to be able to sit outside
Great place! Spacious, stylish and lovely and warm. Short walk to many bars and restaurants. And great clubs! Only downside is the restriction of short showers🙃
For the price was nice stay
Excelente piso para tu estancia en la capital alemana' En este barrio encantador donde te sientes seguro 24/7 . Mil gracias..!!
very nice and quiet place with great garden and friendly host. Absolutely recommendable.

Marko stocked up the place with lots of complimentary snacks, we felt very welcome. He provided clear and detailed self check in (and out) instructions that were easy to follow.
The flat itself is very spacious and well heated. Overall a very wonderful experience and I have no complaints whatsoever :)
Worth recommending!

The apartment is cosy but very spacious for two, and the balcony area is very nice. It was impeccably clean and there were all the standard cooking facilities you need for a short-medium stay. The location is really excellent, such a lovely area. We particularly enjoyed the apartments proximity to a great board game shop! Ellen was a great host and sent very detailed information about check-in and our stay. Would definitely recommend!

Really great location and close to the subway making getting around Berlin a breeze! The apartment is spacious and just what we needed, convenient for shops.
The little restaurant on the same street is well worth a visit too.
Thanks for a great stay!
alles super

Well placed appartment, spacious, luminous and clean.
Catharina is nice and easily accessible.
I recommend.

Das Zimmer inkl. Bad von Marcus und Jean ist sehr sauber und ordentlich. Es ist alles vorhanden, was man für einen Kurzaufenthalt benötigt. Auf Fragen bekamen wir jederzeit immer eine schnelle Antwort. Die Nähe zum BER ist unschlagbar, zur nächsten Bushaltestelle sind es wahlweise ca. 10-20 Minuten und dann kommt man mit Bus/Bahn/Tram in die Stadt. Gerne wieder. 🙂
I've stayed in this apartment for 2 months. It's very stylish and location is simply excellent. Lot's of restaurants nearby and everything is walkable. I liked it a lot.
An artistic, convenient location in the city of Berlin that allowed us to visit many important landmarks.
Love the place, stayed here last year, this time and will stay again if come to Berlin.
The place in good area and close to Uban and Sban
Martin nous à réservé un bel accueil. Ses conseils étaient bien avisés. nous remercions encore Martin de nous avoir loué ce beau logement !
Amazing apartment....very central to multiple locations. the house is well decorated and well equipped. I recommend it with my eyes closed and we shall be back
We were very impressed with this stunning appartment. Perfect location, very spacious with gorgeous big windows

Great place, even though it might seem that it is not that close to the center in terms of distance, it is really close to the S-Bahn station. With the S5 and S7, you can easily get around the city and it might take you less time compared to a place that is more central. The room where we stayed was really clean and the host is really nice, the service was similar to a hotel but for a much cheaper price. Highly recommend.
Ruhige Ecke in Berlin mit der U-Bahn Station direkt um die Ecke. Sauberes Bad und Zimmer!
Es gab ein paar Sachen wo nicht gepasst haben aber man konnte sich schließlich einigen. Die Immobilie Lage ist Top!

I stayed here for a few days in May. The apartment is the perfect size for 1-2 people and located close to shops, restaurants, and other neighborhood amenities. There was everything I needed for a short stay.

We had an amazing stay in Berlin! The flat is very nice and cosy, it's very well located, next to the supermarket, the Tram and the S-Bahn. If you take the M4 you are very fast to the Alexanderplatz. The next time we come to Berlin we will stay for sure at Alan&Kasia's place! We are already looking forward to come back.
This was a fantastic apartment in a great and lively neighborhood.  It was walkable to many restaurants as well as all forms of public transportation.  We would highly recommend this apartment.

Marc is a superb host.
During our staying he was not in Berlin but we had his presence every day.
The flat is PERFECT! Clean, well equipped and it’s in a superb zone.
I really recommend it !!!
6 STARS

Ideale uitvalsbasis om Berlijn te verkennen met een prachtig uitzicht. Een heel vriendelijke gastvrouw die je helpt met tips en ideeën.
Ideal base to explore Berlin with stunning view. A very friendly hostess who helps you with tips and ideas

This place has everything you need, very cozy and very homely, the area is lovely to spend a lot of time in and above all else hannes was extremely communicative and helpful with absolutely every question or curiosity I had, I could not have been happier to be staying here! Highly recommend

The place it's amazing. All spaces were super clean.  Bianca was so nice and helpful. We enjoyed so much our trip thanks to this reservation. Apparently it's far from the center but the station it's near and it's easy to arrive. If you are considering stay here don't think too much, it's perfect.
Frank was a great host! And the apartment is in such a great location-easy to get on the train, tons of shops and restaurants. It was the perfect place to stay while in Berlin!

As soon as we got to the apartment, Timo's lovely wife welcomed us and showed us everything we need to know about the apartment and area, the location is fantastic, the underground train station is about a minute from the apartment, there is a cafe across the street and two supermarkets about three minutes away by foot. The apartment is very neat, cosy and well equipped. The underground is 3 stops away form "Alexanderplatz". We had a great stay, and we absolutely recommend Timo's place!
Super Gastgeber. Keine Verbesserungsvorschläge.
Top, immer wieder gerne!

Ich empfehle nicht mit dem Auto anzureisen, denn parken vor Ort gestaltet sich sehr schwierig. Da brauch man mehr als „nur ein bisschen Glück“. Ansonsten war die Wohnung wie beschrieben und ziemlich sauber. An einigen Stellen könnten Erneuerungen vorgenommen werden, aber allem in allem war es top.

We loved the large windows and the 1890s architecture building. The apartment is on the fifth floor without elevator is quite an exercise with suitcases and without elevator.
The interior offers all you need and there are many great artifacts of Claus’ travels and some cool framed photographs. Enjoying the morning sun on the balcony is a bliss even in March the warmth radiates back from the walls.
The neighborhood is awesome with many cafés and restaurant.
Would be happy to come again and recommend to others as well.
Alles super, jederzeit gerne wieder. Vielen Dank!

We had a lovely stay, location was great and plenty of public transport close by. Hosts were quick to respond and helpful. the only negatives were the broken fan as it was really warm in the apartment, but host was very apologetic for this. Great space
Well located close to station and supermarket
For the price I think it is really nice. There was no problem and everything was clean.
Tuve problemas con la aplicación, pero la recepcionista me ayudó bastante para no tener que esperar. Es muy central y tienen actividades en el mismo lugar

Berlin, une totale découverte.

Location is perfect, 20min away by train from the center. Bus and train connections are amazing. Would love to come again!

Sehr gute Unterkunft.
Sauber. Schön gestaltet. Sehr gute Lage.

Beautiful, spacious apartment in a great neighborhood and central location to explore Berlin.  We spent five nights and felt very much at home, with many supermarkets and restaurants withing walking distance of the apartment.  We used bicycles rented in the neighborhood to access the tourist sites in Berlin.  Albert is an extra-super host and went out of his way to make sure we had a smooth check in and out, and met with us to provide many valuable recommendations for us to make the best of our stay.  We highly recommend Albert's apartment and hope we return to stay here again soon!

A simply perfect stay in Berlin. We have a 8 months old baby and we have in the apartment all that we need. I think it would be perfect also for a stay without babies. The district is full of shops and restaurant.
het was mooi weer, zelfs in de herfst. dus we konden buiten zitten en genieten van dit voortreffelijk appartement

Beautiful and large space, conveniently located for walking all over Berlin's center! Well-chosen furnishings and everything you need for a comfortable stay. Patrick was quick to answer and very clear in his instructions for seamless entry and exit.

Gute ruhige Gegend, U-Bahn und Tram sind schnell zu Fuß zu erreichen. Kommunikation mit Timothy ist unkompliziert und angenehm. Wer sehr empfindlich bei Sauberkeit ist, sollte das Single Studio aber nicht buchen.

We really enjoyed staying here. The space was comfortable, clean and spacious. Loved having an L-shape couch & nice sized dining table. We would definitely return!

hat alles perfekt gepasst! :)

Great stay in Berlin! Very clean, spacious, and nice outdoor area. It is not in the center of the city but in a residential neighborhood not too far away. Ein netter und freundlicher Gastgeber. Wir haben uns im Birkenwäldchen sehr wohl gefühlt, auch der Hund!

Nice guest, really friendly and helpful. The apartment is ok, But could be a bit more clean, and smell too much cigarettes

The flat is very nice and cozy, situated in a most vibrant quartier. Lots of reataurants and cafes nearby makes you feel comfortable. The flat has everything you need and Apostolos is an excelent host. Very helpful but very discreet! We loved staying here!

A fantastic apartment that I would thoroughly recommend if staying in Berlin. The location was central and perfect for bus, train and walking. Well stocked kitchen and bedrooms and bathrooms were just as described. If we are travelling to Berlin again, we will be back.

What a great place to stay! Not only for the beautiful appartement (a great plus for the bath- and bedroom with beautiful decor, the superdouche and the waterbed), but also Robert is a great host! We received lots of tips and explanations and maps + a good coffee in the morning :-).
We would recommand to rent some bikes to discover Berlin and get everywhere you want in no time. Much easier than taking the bus or the metro, because Berlin is really large and stretched, but very friendly for bikers. Robert arranged our bikes and reservation for a restaurant with some very good food. Great tip, Robert! We surely would recommand this place to all friends who wants to visit Berlin. Please keep in mind that you will have to take a few steps to get to your appartement (4th floor), but it's good for the condition and it is well worth it :-)
Glad we discovered this place!

Apartment is in a great location, between three train stations and around some major tourist attractions. Getting around was so easy!
We will definitely be coming back with our friends! Thanks Martin xx

Francesco and Elisa were really nice hosts. All messages was replied quickly. Flat is beautiful, colorful, clean and it was easy to find free parking places near the building. Our little son also loved the place and there were many useful things also for him. Our family warmly recommend this flat.
Nice and clean place, I loved it. Only issue for me was that there were not night and the tram/metro is a bit far so you need to take uber to come back/go to the city center after a certain hour.

Anna's place is perfectly situated and in a great neighbourhood with a fantastic selection of restaurants, bars and quirky shops. It is very stylish and comfortable and we thoroughly enjoyed our Berlin weekend in the apartment. Anna was very responsive and on hand to help with any queries. Would recommend to all.

Our host was a wonderful communicator and the place was lovely and as described except that it was not clean. sehr schöner Aufenthalt und Ubahn schnell zu erreichen!

nice to stay at Lea 's house, the house is very homey and nice surrounding
great stay!
Really good experience : The hosts are super nice and welcoming. The apartment was very clean and cozy. Everything was great. highly recommended!

Michael and Milkana are the ideal hosts. Felt right at home at their place. They are very friendly and responsive. Helped us out with local recommendations. The house is located in a lovely neighbourhood. Highly recommended!

Leonor was a lovely hostess. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay due to the clean and spacious apartment.
Communication was clear and easy with Leonor even though we didn't encounter any problems during our stay.
Quiet area, with easy access to transport just added to the enjoyment of our trip.
4 Adults, week long trip.

pasamos una noche en Berlín y estuvo todo genial! fuimos alojados en un departamento divino, luminoso y muy cómodo con todo lo necesario. En un barrio cercano a los mejores puntos turísticos. recomendamos 100% Nena apartaments Esperamos volver muy pronto
muchas gracias por su cordial atención!

Rio was a really great host, he provided clear instructions and was always contactable. The flexible check in was perfect for me because I arrived quite late at night. The place itself is very clean and in a perfect location with lots of bars, restaurants and cafes around. I will definitely look to book next time if it is available.

Quel fut la surprise de ma femme lorsqu'elle à su que l'on partait pour Berlin. L'appartement à un cachet exceptionnel. De très grandes chambres, très lumineuses, très calme, très confortable...
Tout est très propre et très bien entretenu.Ce bien est situé au centre de mite, à deux pas des restaurants, métro, musées, parc, etc...
Le propriétaire est très sympatique et très arrangant. Merci pour votre gentillesse et on sait dorénavant que nous avons une très bonne adresse !
Salutations de la famille Keizer

Francesco is a friendly and welcoming host. He and his family live next door to this unit, so any concern or question you may have can be addressed almost immediately.
The unit is small, but great for folks doing lots of exploring of Berlin or that need digital workspace friendly accommodations. The bed and couch are cozy, the bathroom is well-equipped and small meals can be prepared in the kitchen area.
The building is quiet, safe and secure. The only things you will hear are the occasional church bells or siren.
Wedding is a good neighborhood for eating and drinking. There are a few quiet locals’ bars within a block or two and there is ample delicious Turkish and Middle Eastern food in the area. Lidl, Rewe and a host of green markets are available in the locale as well.
Overall, a very good experience.

Wonderful! This adorable two bedroom flat was an ideal place to stay in Berlin. It’s homey and comfortable, and it’s located right in the center of everything: you can easily walk to shops and sights from the Berlin Wall Memorial to Museum Island. We would definitely book again.
Schönes Hostel in sehr guter Lage und top mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen

Mimi est une hôte accueillante, et sympathique. L'appartement est vraiment comme sur les photos, neuf, grand, très bien décoré et très propre.
Il est tres bien situé, surtout si vous aimez sortir, mais reste un vrai endroit de repos grâce au calme qui y règne.
Pour nous le séjour s'est parfaitement déroulé, jusqu'au dernier jour où nous avons malheureusement perdu un des deux trousseau de clés de l'appartement. En en envoyant un message a Mimi pour lui annoncer et trouver une solution, j'ai eu des réponses inappropriées, pour une situation pas "anormale" en AirBnb. Le prix à payer pour une clé? 350€! Ce qui est totalement excessif.
Mis à part ce problème qui peut arriver à tous, je vous conseille l'appartement de Mimi.
The place was much more than we expected
Although the cleaning was included it didn’t happen as often as it should (once a week at least), specially for long stays like mine (one month).

Mooi ruim appartement met fijne grote woonkamer waar je prima met 4 personen even lekker kan zitten en wat drinken. In het appartement is het heerlijk rustig, en hoor je niks van stadse geluiden en de straat, ook niet in het weekend.

Hallo erst einmal an alle Nutzer.

Alles perfect. Empfehlenswert.

If you’re driving 8 hours from Ámsterdam to Berlin for a romantic weekend in a rustic appartement with brick walls and wooden floor, you’ll be disappointed. If you’re looking for a spacious place to spend some time while visiting Berlin, you’re in luck. The room is spacious and has any facility that you need. Easy acces, free parking, perfect water pressure for showering, very warm heater.
It was a bit of a miss for us but only because we thought we booked something we saw on the pictures. The place itself is more than fine.
Felt great coming home here every night. It was very comfortable and exactly what I needed. It was really easy to walk around and grab the tram.
The house is a nice place, and Rainer is a nice person. He will help us to solve all of the problem. We have a pleasant time.
Absolutely fabulous apartment and location. Seriously, this place is awesome and gets my highest recommendation. Very much hope to stay there again in future!
An apartment with great aesthetic in a quiet neighbourhood. Responsive hosts and some very comfy beds!
Great little place for the light traveller or business visit in Berlin.
Consigliatissimo! Tornerò qui se mi ritroverò a Berlino in futuro!

Amazing house just a half hour away from the centre of Berlin. Host is amazing and picked us up and returned us to the airport! We has a brilliant stay in this beautiful house with so much personality and a lovely and vocal resident cat. People were so friendly and really made the stay in Berlin incredible, will definitely be back!

We were welcomed by Kasia and she told us about the neighbourhood and nice places to go. The studio is of good size and we could make use of the backyard.

There is a supermarket around the corner and also the metro and busses are close by. It is about a 10 minute walk to the centre of Prenzlauerberg, where all the bars and restaurants are.

Overall a nice experience

I wanted to stay for more days, but because of other reservations, i couldnt.

Très à l’étroit et pas très bien insonorisé, très peu d’intimité. La propreté n’était pas parfaite: cheveux, saletés sur le lit et derrière le lit… malgré tout Kristina est très gentille et réactive. Des petites attentions dans l’appartement (friandises, gâteaux). Un peu cher selon moi pour un logement type « tinny house ». Bien pour une nuit mais pas plus…

Immer freundlich,  check-in war etwas wild von beiden Seiten aus, hat aber gut geklappt! alles ist sehr sauber, es ist alles da was man braucht, sehr ruhige Lage aber trotzdem gut angebunden! Stayery is in a great location in East Berlin with nice bars and restaurants near Ostkreuz station and lovely independent shops and cafes around Boxhagener Platz (don't miss the Saturday food market). It is easy to get everywhere in the city from Ostkreuz which is a 10 min walk away. The airport express train from Schoenefeld takes under 20 mins to reach Ostkreuz. There is a supermarket around the corner.
Everything at Stayery is sparkling clean and very new still. Bed is firm but comfortable, windows are very well sound proofed (no street noise when closed) and the kitchen is well equipped (except there is nothing to wash dishes with). Staff are all friendly and approachable. They quickly resolved a technical problem with payment.
The rooms have a window into the bathroom, which is not ideal if you are staying with another person. You also have to remember to close the curtains to the main room before using the bathroom if you do not want people across the street to see you.
It is very good value compared to other places in the area so we would definitely be happy to stay there again.
All good, we found it a bit expensive.
Appartamento piccolo, ma molto confortevole! Super comodo per raggiungere il centro città in quanto ha due fermate dell'autobus sotto casa. Consigliato per pochi giorni!!
Comfy place with a lot of light inside 😍 super nice and eazy Check i .. thanks for the dry guys
Nice place, good location with loads of restaurants around.Also near tram line and couple stations

The perfect place to fall in love with Berlin! Honestly, the apartment is nicer than the photos show. The view is unmatched, it feels like you are the highest apartment in the city. Great shower, and having laundry is so nice on big trips!

At all it was a lovely stay and there was nothing wrong with it.

Centralt och nära tunnelbanan.

No issues, highly recommend. Great location and the host is really helpful.

Das Zimmer, das Waldemar anbietet ist geräumig und hell.

Zeer net en comfortabel appartement.
Ihana kodikas asunto. Lilly ja Balu olivat mahtavia. Hyvä sijainti. Tulisimme koska tahansa uudestaan.

Großzügige helle Wohnung mit allem ausgestattet was man braucht. Rundherum ist man gut versorgt mit Restaurants, Take aways, Bäcker etc. U- Bahn Station direkt um die Ecke. Arzu und Tom wohnen direkt nebenan in der Wohnung, waren sehr freundlich und haben uns Tipps gegeben. Vielen lieben Dank!
Der Aufenthalt war schön, die lage hat gepasst und das personal war sehr nett und zuvorkommend.

Die Ausstattung in der Küche war ein bissen wenig das könnte ein bissen mehr sein weil wenn man selber kocht ist es schwierig.

The apartment is central in Berlin, metro and train just around the corner. Shops and restaurants aswell. I truly Can recommend the apartment.
Very walkable area conveniently located near the tram and the subway station. Lovely home near so many great restaurants and a very popular flea market. Our hosts were so friendly and responsive.
This appartment is beautiful and cozy, the balcony has a great view and it feels great just sitting in it. Robin was very helpful and responds quickly.

This is a great, spacious and light studio apartment. It's clean and has everything you need. We loved to location too. Communication with Simon worked also really well and he even offered us a later checkout which was much appreciated. Thanks a lot for a great stay!

Ich konnte Martin nicht persönlich kennenlernen. Die Kommunikation hat aber hervorragend geklappt. Das Zimmer war schön hell und sehr sauber, wie auch das Bad.

Sehr schöne und saubere Unterkunft. Sehr netter Kontakt. Gute Anbindung. Alles in der Nähe, was man braucht: Supermarkt, Restaurant (Trungvan). Ich komme wieder ♥️

Stayed in two units in this building during this trip and I preferred the other one over this Beletage studio.
The studio is essentially converted from what was the hotel reception and breakfast hall. So it’s quite spacious but a little awkwardly laid out (for example, shower is open next to the bed, separate from the sink/toilet). One bonus for this unit versus others in the building is washing machine in your own unit.
It’s on the ground floor, so if you have the windows open, everyone walking by or enjoying the courtyard can see into the living/sleeping area. It also seemed like the open shower and ground floor combo maybe contributed to the room holding more moisture. There was a dampness in the air and furnishings when we arrived.
Overall cute design features and comfortable furniture but not quite worth the higher price tag over other units in the building, despite the larger space.
Rasheed was very flexible in accommodating and the place was as described. Had a pleasant stay :)
10/10! I would use Nena again.
The apartement was clean and very nice and the neighbourhood was very good! I recommend it to everyone!
Great stay, I recommend it 👍

A lovely apartment in a great location. Close to everything you could possibly need. Ricardo (Michele’s dad) was in contact with us throughout our stay and was very proactive in ensuring everything was perfect. Would highly recommend and would happily stay again.

Amiram's flat in Berlin is quiet, comfortable and in a vibrant kiez full of restaurants, bars and cool cafes, though none of the noise reaches the apartment as it's in the quiet back building.
Everything you need is nearby. Upon arrival, the host greeted us with a nice spread of bread, cake, and cheese.
Unfortunately, the flat wasn't as clean as possible, but a cleaner was promptly arranged to come. Amiram was easy to contact, and quick to respond.
The living room is dark - not much natural light gets into the place, so it's not really somewhere you'd want to chill for long periods of time. But there's so much to do around that you wouldn't want to anyway.
Some of the bedding and kitchen stuff could do with an update, and a deep clean would serve the place well, but otherwise, it was a good stay and the neighbourhood is a buzz!
Affordable and clean stay.

very nice place, the service was great. Only detail I would say was that my night light and power outlet weren't working.

Gerd ist ein super netter , origineller Mensch, der sich ganz viel Mühe gemacht hat, damit wir uns wohl fühlen ( was ihm auch gelungen ist ). Es war mehr, wie bei einem guten Freund übernachten, als bei einem Fremden. Wenn wir wieder in Berlin übernachten, dann bei Gerd.

Great value, lovely staff, great vibe, good location

Berlin ist immer eine Reise wert!

3.附近的餐廳、麵包店、咖啡館等有好幾家，還有冰淇淋店都很美味。

整體環境很棒，只是只用了一次洗衣機，第二次用時，就發生故障無法使用。
房東有即時回覆，也提供可以去附近自助洗衣店洗，再用收據退款給我們的選項，不過我們覺得麻煩，所以就自己手洗囉！算是這次稍微美中不足的地方。但整體住宿還是覺得值五顆星。

It was such a very happy time.  Will visit again next time.  It was nice to have coffee and food as well.  The surroundings were also very quiet which was nice.  She was really kind!  The room was spacious, and it was enough for me to stay alone!!  lovely house!

Liebenswerte VermieterInn; defekte Leuchte wurde umgehend repariert. Wohnung war sauber. Gutes Bett. Gerne wieder:-)
