Unsere Lieblingsplätze waren der Schaukelstuhl und der Hinterhof. Die grün-roten Lampen und die Girlanden waren definitiv ein Blickfang und haben den Hinterhof verzaubert.
Wir haben das Restaurant "Xi Gon" auf Empfehlung von Holger und Bettina besucht und wurden nicht enttäuscht. Es war sehr lecker!!!
Die Lage der Wohnung ist top, alles ist in Kürze erreichbar!
Wir hatten einen wundervollen Aufenthalt und kommen gerne wieder!
Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und würden das Hotel weiterempfehlen :)
It was very good
Uns hat es gut gefallen, die eigene Sauna war besonders für die kalten Tage jetzt ein Traum. Super Lage und Anbindung zur U Bahn. Küche hatte alles was wir brauchten. Bett sehr bequem :-)

We had to change our arrangements shortly before we were due to travel as my husband was diagnosed with a serious health condition. Fadeih was so helpful and did everything she could to ensure our friends were still able to go ahead and stay at her apartment as planned. They really enjoyed their stay and said everything was great - excellent location, very comfortable accommodation, clean and quiet.
Sehr sympathischer Vermieter mit schneller Kommunikation - wir kommen gerne wieder!

Firstly, I’d love to give a huge thank to
Markus and EWa who made my stay comfortable, safe and secure. They were so kind and helpful from the beginning to the end. They warmly welcomed me, although my arrival became in the middle of the night after some big delays. The hotel-like clean and tidy apartment is located in a calm and quiet residential area, 10 minutes walk from the busy central station. I felt so good during the entire stay with the friendly, lovely couple, although it was pity that I didn’t have much time to talk to them during the short stay fully packed with plannings. I would love to recommend their place for your next stay in Berlin and I myself would love to see them again at my next visit to the city.

Wir waren für ein Wochenende in Lindas Wohnung, wie schön häufiger. Hat wie immer alles super geklappt. Kontakt mit Vermietern sehr gut. Reagieren auf Anfragen in sehr kurzer Zeit.
Heizung im Schlafzimmer liess sich nicht gut regulieren. Vermieter hat aber sofort versucht Abhilfe zu schaffen.

We stayed here for 6 weeks with our 12 month old twins. We were nervous about staying in a new place with toddlers but this place exceeded our expectations in every way. Truly felt like a home away from home. Very well appointed, clean, excellent neighbourhood for families, and easy to communicate with Andre. We would definitely stay here again.
Robert is an amazing host, very grateful he took care of us upon our arrival to Berlin. Thank you much for everything!
Tom and Arzu were very kind. They welcomed us and were accommodating, inviting us to check in early. We loved our stay.

A bit far from the city center but good connected with bus and metro.
In general, all good.

Für ein Wochenende perfekt. Ich bin mit dem Zug angereist und war sehr schnell und unkompliziert an der Unterkunft angekommen. (Hbf -> U5 Samariterstr. -> ca. 3 Minuten laufen), der Code zum Öffnen der Türen wurde mir sobald das Zimmer fertig war (schon vor 15 Uhr) bereitgestellt und ich konnte ihn nutzen. Die Unterkunft an sich ist, wie man auf den Bildern auch sehen kann sehr unspektakulär. Das Bett war in Ordnung, der Schrank hatte einen Mülleimer, einen Safe und nen kleinen Kühlschrank und genug Platz für meine Tasche. Bad war sauber. In der Nähe gibt es auf jeden Fall genug Angebot und durch die gute Verbindung über die U- als auch Straßenbahn und Bus ist man eigentlich auch schnell wo anders. Ich bin über den Zeitraum des ganzen Aufenthalts keinem Personal begegnet. Wenn ihr den Luggage Room nutzen wollt, empfehle ich es euch so bald wie möglich zu machen. Ich habe am letzten Tag kein Fach mehr bekommen, da diese Begrenzt sind. Es wird aber auch von extern was angeboten.

Bell'appartamento, ampio e ben tenuto, con cucina ben attrezzata. La zona è tranquilla, gradevole e ben servita (ristoranti, negozi, ecc.). La posizione è buona sia per raggiungere i trasporti pubblici che per muoversi a piedi (in poco meno di mezz'ora a piedi si arriva all'isola dei musei). Cortesi e puntuali gli host.

The loft is very cool with great windows, especially in the barhroom. Very close to the U-bahn and S-bahn.
But the district a didn't really like. And the shared bathroom, wc and fridge because i was looking for the whole appartment and the very important info about the shared space were written in the text below the advertisement which i never ever read.

We enjoyed our stay at Numa Arc.  It was very centrally, particularly to Checkpoint Charlie, but there is a lot around there within a few minutes walk.  We loved that they had free lockers to leave our luggage, after we checked out.  They also offer the same thing if you get in earlier.  This is so wonderful!  Beds were comfy, snacks in room.  It was lovely!

Beautiful place, the room is nicely decorated and cozy. We were happy about the equipment proposed (towels, hair dryer). It is also very well located just 5min walking to the S-Bahn station. I highly recommend it. :)
Wir waren nur für eine Nacht dort. Dennoch war Stephanie sehr flexible beim Check-In. In der Wohnung war auch alles vorhanden und wir hatten eine super Zeit in Berlin.

L'appartement est très agréable, cosy et bien équipé. Et spacieux. Parfait pour 4 !
Le quartier est très sympa, accessible facilement en transports en commun. La proximité avec l'ancien aéroport rend le quartier original.
Bref, nous avons passé un agréable séjour à Berlin !
Immer wieder schön!
Great location & Henrik is a very fast and easy communicator. Recommended for a stay in Berlin!
Small but quite well appointed,  the apartment more than met our needs for a home base as we explored Berlin. I would stay there again!
Lite verdi for pengane
Unique large apartment which was perfect for our family of five. Clean, spacious, ground floor access. Easy to get to with food options close by. Thank you for having us!
heel mooie kamer en vriendelijke gastvrouw.
Všechno probíhalo na jedničku, doporučuji.
Perfect stay!

We could not have asked for a better place to stay in Berlin - the photos don’t do this wonderful loft justice! Simon was great and easy to communicate with and very accommodating. The location was perfect with tons of bars, restaurants and public transportation around. I would highly recommend Simons place and hope that we will be able to return soon!
Super netter Host, tolle Wohnung, gerne wieder :)
Recomendable

Detlef heeft een heel mooi appartement op een rustige locatie. We werden warm ontvangen waarbij Detlef alles goed uitlegde over het appartement. Het appartement ligt in een rustig complex en heeft alle gewenste voorzieningen. En voor ons handig: we konden voor de deur gratis parkeren, zoals overal in de directe omgeving. We kunnen dit appartement van harte aanbevelen voor andere gasten! Wij hebben genoten van ons verblijf. Bedank Detlef!

Wir haben ein sehr schönes Wochenende in Stellas Wohnung verbracht. Die Lage ist sehr gut, die Kommunikation war schnell und einfach, der Check-In hat problemlos geklappt und die Einrichtung ist sehr stilvoll. Einziger Kritikpunkt: das kleinere der beiden Schlafzimmer ist wirklich sehr klein, wirkt durch das kleine Fenster zum Wohnzimmer etwas beklemmend und ist nicht für große Menschen geeignet. Wir würden aber definitiv wiederkommen!
Хорошо, но очень шумно ночью от движения поездов прямо за окном. Но если ты устал очень за день, то это не мешает спать ночью.

Ce logement est magnifique avec son beau parquet, ses grandes fenêtres et ses jolies moulures au plafond. Il est également très spacieux. Nous avons aussi beaucoup aimé le quartier, dans lequel il était très agréable de se promener.  L'arrêt de bus situé devant la maison nous a permis de nous déplacer très facilement. Nous avons vraiment adoré notre séjour et nous prévoyons déjà de revenir.

Moritz is great and his cat is the cutes of all. During my stay he was really helpful and kind.
his place is close to the lakes and great for walks if you are interested :)
There is a bus right front so the transportation is easy if you follow the time table.
Don't hesitate to stay at his place,
Best regards,
Defne.

Alt var veldig bra og over forventningene. Rolig gate med nesten ingen biltrafikk, svært sentralt midt i smørøyet. To minutter til t-bane linje 8. Hyggelig og trygt område som har alt hva man kan ønske seg av cafeer, restauranter, barer, matbutikker 3-4 stykker i gangavstand (to økologiske), tyrkisk nøtte-godteributikk ved t-banen anbefales, apotek, helsekost, second hand, trær og grønt i gatene og sikkert mye mye mer. Nydelig turområdet langs kanalen.
Problemfri og fleksibel inn og utsjekk med god kommunikasjon. Alt var rent og ordentlig, og som på bildene, rommet innredet med stilige gjennomtenkte detaljer og farger. Sov godt og uforstyrret. Kommer gjerne igjen!

Very clean and beautiful apartment. The studio is small but well equipped and bright. I would suggest to put shampoo and shower gel. The location is perfect to visit Berlin city centre by foot. Watch out the stairs to climb the bed, they may not suit for everyone.
Schönes Apartment, super netter Service - alles top!
I think that's really good and highly recommend for a person, who wanna find a hotel for fews day and alone in Berlin. Although around of the hotel is a little bit complicate .
Super gelegene, gut ausgestattete kleine Wohnung im Prenzlauer Berg. Sehr nette Gastgeber!

Wir hatten einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt in Hannas Airbnb, angefangen bei der sehr freundlichen Kommunikation, über die schicke Einrichtung, die Kaffeemaschine, alle notwendigen Accessoires und die eine oder andere Überraschung, die ich nicht vorweg nehmen möchte. :)
Hatten ein schönes Wochenende in Berlin. Wohnung ideal angebunden. Geschäfte und Restaurants fußläufig erreichbar. Freundlicher und hilfsbereiten Gastgeber. Was will man mehr!!
Sehr schöne, saubere und gut ausgestattete Wohnung in einem tollen Teil von Friedrichshain! Sehr nette Kommunikation. Alles super!

Be Home was a excellent hostess, friendly and with good communication, advisable for everybody. The flat is nice, for a small family or small group of friends. The neighborhood is good, with stop underground near and a lot off goods turkish restaurants.
Jan was very kind and proactive host, really appreciated my stay at his place.
Simon place was amazing. It looks like everything is thought out even a small details. Thank you so much !
Departamento cómodo y eficientemente equipado. Bien conectado (al lado de una estación de metro/u-Bahn). Mucho ruido ambiental (no hay A/C, así que abrimos ventanas, en verano).
Thilbaut ist ein super Gastgeber und auch wenn ich nur kurz in Berlin war, habe ich mich  in seiner Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Gern wieder.
Magnifique appartement, très spacieux, très bien situé.

Sybil’s place was perfect for our time in Berlin. I was travelling with my husband and 3yr old, and Sybil made us feel right at home. It’s a beautiful apartment and garden, and an excellent location being by the lake. The S Bahn is easily accessible, so the city isn’t far at all. Sybil even supplied toys and a huge bag of Lego for our son to play with. Thanks so much Sybil!
Nous avons passé un bon séjour à Berlin.  Le logement de martin est en plein centre, nois avons pu découvrir la ville très facilement avec les transports en commun.
Excellent choice and location! Erik was really kind.
It was a great place and communication worked very well!
Eine sehr schöne Wohnung mit einer super Lage.
Alles ist super gelaufen und wir hatten schöne zwei Tage in dieser Unterkunft, auch Kochen ist möglich, was uns sehr wichtig war. Gerne wieder !
Die Unterkunft ist super ausgestattet, hat eine sehr gute Lage und die Kommunikation mit den Vermietern verläuft unproblematisch, freundlich und schnell. Wir würden wieder buchen!

Estuvimos con 2 amigas más en el departamento. Es tal cual las fotos. Mina respondió súper rápido siempre y fue muy agradable en su trato. El lugar tiene la parada del subte a una cuadra y media que conecta con todo Berlín, que por cierto es muy grande. El departamento es muy cómodo, el agua de la ducha es para destacar. Lo recomendamos !!!
Gute Lage, sauberes Bad und Zimmer, genug Platz aber ein wenig laut in der Nacht wegen der S-Bahn Station am Fenster.
the Singer 109 Hostel is a great place, clean and it has a good staff. very close to the main city area, quite and confortable.
Die Lage ist top und die Unterkunft war wie im Inserat beschrieben bzw wie auf den Fotos.  Kommunikation und Check in waren sehr unkompliziert.
Best place, we will come again !

Die Wohnung ist wunderschön, top ausgestattet, großzügig, liegt superruhig und
gleich um die Ecke von vielen hübschen Kneipen und Geschäften mit sehr urbanem
Flair. Die Terrasse ist im Sommer noch ein zusätzlicher Pluspunkt !
Wir würden jederzeit wieder hier einen Stadturlaub verbringen !
Lovely place and great location. Would recommend!

O apartamento é ótimo, muito melhor do que nas fotos. Muito limpo e organizado, bem equipado com tudo que é preciso para um estadia confortável. Detlef foi muito prestativo e um ótimo anfitrião. O apartamento também é perto de várias opções de transporte público, supermercado e tem fácil acesso ao centro de Berlim e ao aeroporto Tegel. Recomendo!

O anfitrião não nos recebeu, ele enviou um funcionário para que fossemos recepcionados. Infelizmente tivemos que contactar o anfitrião pois seu funcionário esqueceu de repor alguns itens básicos como detergente e papel higiênico. Tudo foi resolvido no mesmo dia.

O apto é bem simples, mas muito bem conservado. Apenas o chuveiro não é muito bom.

A região é muito boa com ótimos restaurantes a menos de 700m do apto. Transporte público também próximo (entre 500m à 700m dependendo se é tram ou metrô).
Mina ist sehr nett und die Kommunikation ist bestens. Viele Tips und alles sehr unkompliziert. Eine Tolle Wohnung für bis zu 4 Leuten alles da was man braucht!! Toll wir kommen gerne wieder!! Lg
Beautiful apartment in a great neighborhood - looks exactly like the photos. Manuel was friendly & easy to communicate with. I strongly recommend this place!

The apartament was a good choice. Everything was clean, the room and kitchen was good and the bathroom was also very nice. It's really close to the metro, so you can reach the city center in easily 20 min. Would recommend it!
A really nice apartment for one or two people! Had everything I needed and Kati was very responsive and friendly
Ben was a great host! I needed some flexibility with checking in, and he was great at accommodating. The apartment was clean, well- lit, and the neighborhood was quiet at night.
We had a great time!
Alles super!
Great place to stay to explore Berlin! A short walk from the station in a quiet neighborhood with a great space!

We stayed at Ulf’s apartment with our baby girl. Ulf was kind and warm and all was extremely cozy and comfortable. The neighborhood was super cool with lots of galleries, coffee houses and great restaurants.
Een superfijn appartement op een leuke locatie in de stad. Een perfecte uitvalsbasis!

Le séjour était parfait. L’appartement reflète parfaitement l’esprit de Berlin. Erez est adorable et très serviable. Son appartement est impeccable et très cozy ! Surtout très propre et ordonné malgré la quantité de décoration présente ;)

This is my second time staying with Ashraf. He’s a wonderful host who is so friendly and warm and welcoming - a real pleasure to stay with him whenever I’m in Berlin and I will be staying with him again! Also great accommodations that are always clean and well suited to my needs as a traveler!

El apartamento de Houssem es lindísimo, espacioso, luminoso y con buena aislación de sonido.
La zona del apartamento es muy linda y pintoresca.
Houssem como anfitrión es increíble: atento, flexible y responsable.
Recomendadísimo
Vist area and a beautiful view over the Chanel. Good restaurants nearby.

I was attending a conference and needed a place to stay that was safe and near public transport. Jans place was a perfect spot. Everything you need, the apartment has been smartly designed, really effective use of the space. Near restaurants and bars too. But it is Jans proactive communications that made my stay special. Very nice hosts and that makes all the difference.

Eine tolle Unterkunft im Herzen vom Prenzlauer Berg, die alles bietet, was man für einen entspannten Aufenthalt braucht. Die Lage könnte nicht besser sein: direkt neben dem Mauerpark und nur wenige U-Bahn-Stationen vom Alexanderplatz entfernt - wir haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt und kommen gerne wieder :)

Ótima estadia! O apartamento é confortável, bem localizado e tem tudo o que é necessário para uns dias em Berlim.
Recomendamos!

Very peaceful,quiet area next to  one of the best eating out options in Berlin....at walking distance from tram station and river front area. Host is super response with clear cut advice and instructions. Stayed for two days and found it excellent for relaxing and taking rest after physically exhausting city excursions.

Die Unterkunft ist ist einladend, blitzeblank sauber und gepflegt. Prima Matraze und das Zimmer ist ruhig. Frau Neumann ist äusserst hilfsbereit und nett. Die Nähe zu S- und U-Bahn absolut vorteilhaft. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten um's Eck.
Ich werde gerne wieder bei meinem nächsten Aufenthalt in Berlin zu Fr. Neumann kommen !
Danke für die gute Zeit bei Ihnen !
Very spacious and clean. Perfect for large groups with beds tucked in every corner.  A grocery store is located about 50 feet away in the metro station.
Very beautiful Apartment. If u dont take it, you are making a mistake.
Un lugar fantástico y ambiente agradable. Con todo lo que puedas necesitar, y del que se llega a cualquier sitio.
Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen und mit Tipps über Berlin versorgt. Eine ganz ganz liebe Familie, wir haben uns super wohl gefühlt!
Tolles Haus, perfekte Lage. Check-in unkompliziert. Würde ich auf jeden Fall wieder buchen, wenn ich in Berlin bin.
Arthur's place was very clean, stylish and generally a great place to stay. The location was excellent and Arthur was a very good host. Would highly recommend.

Die Wohnung war super für einen Kurztrip in die Hauptstadt Berlin. Besonders die ruhige Hinterhauslage im Großstadtgewirre ist gut für eine erholsame Nacht nach einem ereignisreichen Tag voller Sehenswürdigkeiten und herumlaufen… Alles was man braucht ist in der Wohnung vorhanden und Apostolos war sehr freundlich als Gastgeber😀

De atelier/woning van Claudia en Peter is een bijzonder verblijf. Het ligt ideaal om Berlijn te ontdekken. Heel bijzonder is de ligging, in een rustige wijk met een eigen binnenplaats op een steenworp afstand van o.a. Der Neue Nationalgalerie. Bus en U-Bahn zijn dichtbij zodat ook de rest van de stad goed bereikbaar is. Anders kan dit ook op een E-scooter, E-step of fiets. De supermarkt is op 5 min. afstand en is ruim gesorteerd. De atelier/woning ademt sfeer uit en bevat veel kunst. De 2 badkamers en 3 slaapkamers (de TV kamer met slaapbank in het atelier is een volwaardige kamer) maken dat het ideaal is voor wat grotere gezinnen (samengestelde gezinnen zoals bij ons) of groepen. Al met al een zeer aan te bevelen uitvalsbasis om Berlijn te verkennen. Het echte Art-Berlijn gevoel begint hier al.

Ausgezeichnete Unterkunft, sehr entspannt und nicht weit vom Hbf.
Sehr zentral, somit waren jegliche Sehenswürdigkeiten leicht zu Fuß, mit U-Bahn oder der Straßenbahn zu erreichen.
Wir empfehlen die Unterkunft unbedingt weiter, und freuen uns demnächst eventuell wieder hier zu übernachten!

Schmutzig, morgens immer laut da sich die Nachbarn ab 6 Uhr im Treppenhaus unterhalten, Ratten vor der Türe,
Kein sicherheitsgefühl durch die Türe, und leider ist die letzte reinigung auch schon etwas länger her.
Ubahn in der Nähe das ist absolut positiv und das Viertel ist auch in Ordnung

Wonderful Airbnb, light and spacious in a great location.  Private bathroom and coffee available in the cafe downstairs. We loved meeting Katja, so friendly and readily available to help and offer advice. Highly recommend Katja’s place. Loved it.
整体不错，位置好，就在U8旁边，还有Aldi超市。唯一缺点就是有两个小床是挂在屋顶的，不是很舒服。
Nice open-plan apartment
Tolles eingerichtetes Zimmer in ruhiger Lage. Die Wohnung ist so sauber dass ich bedenkenlos vom Boden essen würde. Absprache mit Ronny war schnell, unkompliziert und flexibel.

L’appartement est bien situé (proche des transports et à quelques minutes en voiture du centre ville) propre et en bon état. Nous avons rencontré un petit problème d’éclairage que nous avons constaté à notre arrivé avec la personne qui nous accueilli en l’absence de J+S, mais qui a été résolu assez vite.
Le logement manque peut être d’un peu de rangement dans les chambres mais à 2 personnes pour 2 chambres doubles, ça ne nous a pas posé de problème
Il y a des commerces à proximité.
Le stationnement est gratuit à proximité même si parfois il est difficile de trouver une place (le soir).
Je recommande ce logement

Super clean, warm, amazing and stylish apartment. Would definitely recommend staying here for anyone wanting to experience Berlin. Excellent communication and great location. Loved the hip and quirky atmosphere in the area.
Fadeih is a super super host!
Very ideal location and close to restaurants and public transport.
We really enjoyed our stay. Lots of places to eat nearby. Fantastic transport with local train station. Lots of reccommendations from the host. Easy check in. Very responsive host.
Milí ľudia 😊
Everything has been as expected and Thomas has been contacting with time enough in advance and with very clear instructions. I recommend Thomas as a host.
Berlin istbein Reise wert
apartment was great, communication perfect, hassle free enjoyable stay. would definitely recommend.

Appartement très propre , bien situé par rapport aux moyens de transport et lieux à visiter. Cependant, un peu juste pour y loger à 3 personnes pour une dizaine de jours. Une table et des chaises auraient été bien venues dans la cuisine ( même un mini bar ou tabouret pour un gain de place ).
Muy buen apartamento para visitar Berlin en familia. A cinco minutos del metro y el apartamento muy cómodo. Muy recomendable

Great, well-placed and harmonic design features, lots of plant, sculpture and light elements that make this location a perfectly balanced and made me feel home and safe!
Felt very respected and conformable with Andrea, such a pleasant host :)

*****
Just perfect! Karsten is the nicest person, very attentive and welcoming, and His beautiful apartment is such a great place to wake up and end your day in. The location was perfect, easy to get everywhere but also peaceful and quiet. The apartment is a clean, cozy, comfortable, beautiful (!!) big room. We definitely recommend :)

Breathtaking view over green trees, the park and the city skyline. So nice and comfortable. Our warmest recommendations.
We want to come back again soon!

Really good apartment with an awesome location. Was really clean and quiet. Also highlighting now the apartment has a bed instead of a sofa bed.
Lots of restaurants with different food options closeby.
Also really easy to reach other parts of the city from the appartment using public transport.
Claudia as a host was awesome giving us a wide variety of recommendations and was able to adjust check in/out times for our needs.
Ich habe mich wie zuhause gefühlt, alles war angenehm und ruhig sie ist so lieb und freundlich. Ich habe mich gefreut sie kennenlernen zu haben. Ich werde es jedem empfehlen.
Alles gut. Kommen gerne wieder

Die Unterkunft war toll. Gut angebunden an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel, aber trotzdem relativ Nah zum Grün.
Es war alles wie beschrieben/ auf den Bildern gezeigt. Sehr sauber und vollständig ausgestattet . Kristin war immer erreichbar und sehr freundlich.
Definitiv empfehlenswert

Alojamiento muy limpio. Totalmente equipado. Anfitriones muy amables.Ubicado en un vecindario muy tranquilo. Supermercado y tiendas cerca .Buena conexión con el centro de la ciudad y también con el aeropuerto.
Estancia totalmente recomendable.
very clean in a quiet neighborhood of Berlin situated in a lovely garden.

We just wanna Thank You for amazing accomodation in Berlin! It was such a wonderful stay. Room was clean and great condition.
See You again! 🍀🇩🇪
Regards Martin and whole family!🇨🇿

David was a great host, always very responsive and helpful! We loved the area a lot - at the edge of amazing Prenzlauer Berg!! We ate both breakfast and dinner in the area, and both the food and the people were just great! It is also only a short tram-ride from Alexanderplatz where you can easily explore the center.
The bathroom was very clean with lots of towels and all other ammenties you may need (enough toilet paper, handsoap, washing maschine, hairdryer etc.). The apartment itself was a little rustic and small, but it was perfectly fine for three adults (one slept in the upper bunk and 2 downstairs).

Ein wirklicher sehr schöner Aufenthalt in einem sehr gepflegten Apartment. Das Design komplett durchdacht und schön gemacht!:)
Wir hatten eine wunderbare Zeit🙈
Buena ubicación. La habitación es grande, está muy limpia y cuidada. La con Bert ha sido fácil y fluida. Alojamiento recomendable.

Great apartment for large groups. Located a bit out of the city center, in a very nice area. The apartment was a lot bigger than I originally thought! Me and my bookclub had a great time. Not only the beds, but also the couches were very comfortable.
Very convenient location,  loved it. thanks

Lage war sehr gut, Wohnung schön eingerichtet.
Der Küche fehlt es etwas an Ausstattung und das 5&6te Bett sind sonderlich bequem.

Lisa is a truly great host and while spending three weeks in her place I had a chance to see that she is getting all those positive reviews for a reason. The room she offers has all the space you need, everything is clean and tidy. I truly loved the location - from Lisa’s place you can easily walk to Prenzlauer Berg, Museum Insel or Friendrichshein/Kreuzberg. If walking is not for you, there are plenty of public transport connections located in the area of the flat. One of the highlights of this location was for me Volkspark Friedrichshain, which is located only 400m away from the flat. During summer it’s a perfect place to enjoy the weather, have a picnic or do sport. Lisa will provide you all the tips you need, regarding where to go and what to see. She is a very friendly person and I find myself lucky that I had a chance to stay at her place :)
War alles TipTop

We enjoyed our stay.  Apartment was as described; comfortable and modest. Seems like a working class neighborhood with not a lot to do in the immediate vicinity but very close to subway and therfore everything very accessible
Immer wieder gern 👍

Silke's accommodation is really beautiful.  lovely high ceilings and well preserved features. it is spotlessly clean. very close to the lake and the tram to get you in to Friedrischagen and Berlin. she is a great host.

We were visiting friends in the neighborhood for a weekend and this AirBnb was exactly what we needed. Quiet, clean and comfortable and in a great location to get around the city/neighborhood. Dietrich was a super communicative host and it was super easy to get in and out.

Annett’s place was lovely, clean, and conveniently located. The space, though it appeared small, had plenty of closet and cabinet space, and also provided lots of essential kitchen utilities, laundry amenities. The neighborhood was quiet and felt very safe and transit was easy to access. I would definitely recommend Annett’s apartment to anyone looking to visit Berlin!

Caesar is a great host, responsive, helpful, and the place is very clean and quiet, located in a nice neighbourhood; I had a good time staying there for the two nights I was in the city. Good place to recommend !
Good communication with host, great location, spacious!
Good downstairs area, rooms were clean. Like any hostel, roommates will determine a lot
De ruimte heeft best wel wat onderhoud nodig, maar de spullen die je nodig hebt zijn schoon. Voor zomaar een of een paar nachtjes om Berlijn te verkennen een prima onderkomen.
Buen apartamento, bien ubicado y facil comunicarse con la amfitriona.

Leuk appartement met handige indeling. Voldoende ruimte. Heel opgeruimd en redelijk schoon. Alleen een rioollucht in de badkamer, misschien vanwege missende sifon o.i.d. Klein misverstand over welk appartement door typfout in bericht, maar werd snel opgelost door vriendelijke dame. Dichtbij metro. Aanrader als je in Berlijn bent!

Peter è stato davvero ospitale e gentile. L appartamento ha tutto il necessario e il fatto di avere il bagno in camera un vero e proprio must! Posizione comodissima per scoprire Berlino, alloggio moderno e davvero pulito.
Super consigliato
Great stay: clean, quiet, perfect location!
Alojarme en el apartamento de Thuy mejoró mi experiencia y la de mi novia en Berlín, me brindó muchas facilidades y me sentí como en casa. Es muy amable y siempre estuvo dispuesta a ayudar.
war super - zu empfehlen
Der Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm. Wir hatten ausreichend Platz und konnten sogar früher als erwartet einchecken – das war völlig problemlos. Birgit war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Vielen Dank!
The appartment was as expected based om the pictures. Everything  was available. Good value for money. Good and quick communication with the host.

Flat exactly as in the description. Industrial chic. Front door entry took some getting used . Great location by park with fairy tale fountain, and 200 bus  to Berlin central around the corner. Lots of restaurants further up the street and next door! Enjoyed our stay.
Everything was fine ! very cute hotel and kind service

Die Lage ist der Hammer, wunderbare Gegend direkt am Park und am Wasser. Und man kann sogar noch Parkmöglichkeiten finden falls man mit dem Auto anreist. Anbindung an das Verkehsnetz sind gut. Wohnung ist genügend ausgestattet, sollte man etwas kochen wollen. Das haben wir nicht. Ansonsten ist die Beleuchtung etwas dunkel und das Schlafsofa ok für ein zwei Nächte. Hochbett ist sehr gut. Im Sommer ist die Wohnung sehr schattig, absolut genial.
Würde sie wieder buchen.
Super nice and great location
Sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt! Sylvia hat eine ruhig gelegene und saubere Wohnung mit Balkon in einem grünen Teil von Kreuzberg. Die Schlüsselübergabe war gut organisiert.

Convenient and comfortable. Just as advertised with plenty of room in a quiet safe neighborhood. We felt a bit like a local Berliner while we stayed. Public transportation was close and convenient with lovely local bars and shops in walking distance. Highly recommended.

The stay at Fritjof's house was unforgettable.  There have been problems since arrival, the bathroom and room were not clean, there was hair and dirt on the floor and sheets, and there was no work table in the room, unlike what was stated in the advertisement. Hygiene is important, maybe having someone professionally take care of it given the cost of a room, it's worth it. When I searched through Airbnb assistance to find a solution, the assistance gave to the host 24h to solve the problem, proof that they recognized some inconsistencies.  Fritjof eliminated the 5-month stay from evening to morning, due to "personality clash".  The truth is that you can have a nice house but if you are a host with whom dialogue and reasonableness can be difficult and you do not provide what you put in an ad, and you charge a room around 900 euros (cost of a one/two room apartment in Mitte or Friedrichshain..), here there is a problem.  But it was better that way.  I have limited myself to ascertaining reality with photos to Airbnb and they help me with a total refund, a coupon and a new accomodation. Many thanks to Airbnb assistance!!
Anna is very good person. excelent location. highly recommended :)

Super host

Very spacious, comfortable, quiet place in perfect location.
Vielen Dank 🌻 🌻 🌻
Nice, clean apartment in a great part of town. Martin’s communication was clear and fast. Would recommend!

I had a lovely stay at Hotel Intervarko. The location is great, about 15 minutes walk from Alexanderplatz (or about 5 minutes on a scooter). The room was clean and exactly what I expected. All the facilities were great. Communication was really clear. Recommended!

Für uns, als Familie mit 3 jährigem Kind, war das Zimmer völlig ausreichend. Wir haben 2 Nächte bei Sabine und Andreas verbracht, die super nett und gastfreundlich zu uns waren. Die Entfernung zur S-Bahn ist ein kleiner Wermutstropfen. Dafür hält der Bus aber unmittelbar vorm Haus, dass sehr schön ruhig gelegen ist.
Für Party und Halli Galli in Berlin ist's vielleicht ungeeignet aber für nen ruhigeren Berlinbesuch zu empfehlen.
Uns hat es gefallen und wir würden auch wieder bei Sabine und Andreas übernachten.
The place was so peaceful and had all the required amenities. Manfred was really helpful and responsive.
Es war eine sehr zentrale und gute Unterkunft. Es hat Spass gemacht dort zu übernachten!
Es wurde super auf Fragen und Wünsche reagiert.
Es hat freude gemacht, in dieser Unterkunft zu wohnen, !!!
We had a great time!

We were met by Jens, who was very friendly and gave us some good tips as this was our first visit to Berlin. The apartment was ideal - well-equipped, clean and comfortable. Would definitely recommend it - handy for the subway, shopping district walkable from the apartment and bars and restaurants close by to choose from. Fabulous cakes in Romeo & Romeo on the corner.

The location is good, the bedroom is ok. However, I don't like the sharing bathroom. There are 2 places for taking shower inside the bathroom, both of them with glass doors and one door is broken. The bathroom is used for girls and boys, thus it is not comfortable for girls to take a shower.

Your comfy renovated apartment was exactly what we were looking for :-)
Very warm and very close to the public transportation with a supermarkt just next door.
Our host Heide was very helpful, kind, giving us tips, advice and taking care of every wish and question we had.
It has really been a wonderful stay.
Thank you Heide!

Sauberes Airbnb, in ruhiger Gegend mit guter Anbindung zu einem fairen Preis.
Die Kommunikation verlief reibungslos und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Clean apartment, close to S-Bahn station. It was smaller than I thought

The location of the commodation was great. The mitte area is full of terass bars, restaurants and cafes. And there was short walk to the riverside witch is really beautiful part of Berlin.
The apartment owner Stephanie was super easy to communicate with and we had no problems with her.
The only negative thing about the apartment was that there were no air condition so the place was really hot to sleep and the air inside was little stuffy. But gladly the was the little terass so we could keep the terass door open so you were able to get some fresh air. And the apartment was so bright even with the curtains there were so much light coming in.
Overall the place was beautiful and there was everything you could need for your stay.
Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben, alles top, gerne wieder!
We enjoyed our time at Berlin Surf Hostel. Grateful to be hosted by Volker, and appreciated his efforts to make our stay and accommodation work the best for us

Fantastisk ophold i Chris og Lenes lejlighed. Beliggenheden er super og stemningen i kvarteret enestående.

Cool place.  Close to the metro

Nonostante l’appartamento fosse un po’ distante dal centro, ci siamo trovati benissimo e l’oste è stato gentile e disponibile e la descrizione rispettava la realtà
Bonito apartamento totalmente equipado, muy cerca del metro.
Great place!
Konum güzeldi fakat ev temiz değildi.
Super Wohnung in toller Lage. Wir hatten die Wohnung mit 8 Personen für ein Wochenende gemietet.

We had a wonderful time. The place is very central, you can walk to the city or take the metro.

2 mins from the famous flea market.
The apartment is quite although it’s on the ground floor.

We hope to come back soon and I suggest people to book this place if they come to visit Berlin.

Super gemütliche und ruhige Unterkunft mit guter Lage.
Great stay! absolutely loved the view!!

The room itself is lovely! Large and bright! It was also clean and the apartment is in a lovely part of Berlin. The only downside is that there is one bathroom between several guests. I was unlucky to be there at the same time as someone who wasn’t the best at cleaning up after themselves and left clumps of hair on the bathroom floor 🤢 But the location, the light of the room, and Rio’s hospitality more than made up for it.
If I hade known about this place earlier, I would have visited this place always. Nice location, service, coffee, breakfast, river! Especially in summer.

Andrea is by far the best host I have ever come across.. she is as extremely swift with her responses, accommodated to all our requests, going out of her way. Also the place is so well maintained, and it just felt like home with everything you might need available right there..
Andrea even left us some fruits and drinks, along with a cute welcome note..
Highly recommend this place for a stay near Berlin

Asunto oli oikein sopiva pariskunnalle ja sijainti mukavan lähellä juna-asemaa. Gerhard oli erittäin avulias ja joustava isäntä. Ympäristö oli rauhallinen ja kivoja ruokapaikkoja löytyi ihan läheltä. Es war sehr angenehm bei Jo & Fran. Die Lage war top und wir wurden sehr herzlich aufgenommen. Das Zimmer war sehr sauber und das Bett sehr gemütlich! Immer wieder gerne!
people talking in the morning

Spent a night before an early flight. It went perfectly.
Thank you for accepting my last minute request and accommodating my early check out. Clean, reliable, great communication and people!

Schönes Zimmer mit gemütlichem Bett in zentraler Lage, trotzdem sehr ruhig.
Die Gastgeber waren sehr freundlich und die Kommunikation unkompliziert.

Tobias's place was amazing. Beautiful and spacious in a quiet neighbourhood, near bus, metro. Tobias was extremely helpful and very welcoming. His place was perfect, and we never say that! Highly recommend it!

Удобное расположение, рядом метро и легко доехать до центра, недалеко много классных баров. Супер милая девушка на ресепшене,  которая предлагала заварить свежий кофе. I had a very comfortable stay in Katrin’s apartment. Beautifully styled, sparkling clean and very peaceful space. Well connected to public transit and in a great neighbourhood. Would love to stay again.
The location is okay but some utilities were missing like toilet paper, tissues, the wifi didn't work and the cleanliness of the apartment wasn't as expected.

This is a great spot and a great value that could not be more central. Peter, as a host, went out of his way to make my stay comfortable and was kind enough to do two loads of laundry; a big help for a traveler! Overall, I would say that you cannot go wrong here. Highly recommend.
Everything was great
We absolutely loved staying at Fritz's incredible apartment! So close to public transport and some incredible restaurants in the area! Had a fantastic time :)

Sabine's place is great, we had a great time. She was very understanding when we had complications with our check in time due to external reasons. Always in constant communication and very friendly. The room is beautiful, and very clean. The bathroom is huge and very comfortable. We could not have asked for anything else. Would love to stay here again.

Our stay was perfect…Andreas the key holder was very communicative responsive and ge recommend lots of local eateries and shops. Metro is just 100m away from the property. Thank you also for Thorsten the online reception whom very responsive and guide me from the day before checkin until after checkin.

La primera vez que me alojo en este tipo de alojamiento. Quizá exagere con mi opinión por que estoy comparando a un Ibis que suelo ir siempre

Good location, close to everything.
Andrei was nice and friendly during our stay.

Nice Apt on the north side of Prenzlauerberg with many cafés and restaurants close by, good transportation in the area. The Apt. Itself is not very personal (more like what you would expect from a hotel room), but functional and clean, good to relax and sleep after a long day in the city.
The check in with Ellen did not go smooth, since the address that we thought we needed to pick up the keys had already closed, and it was very late, so we had to book a hotel room the first night. Ellen changed the address, but this was easily missed in the very long e-mails that she wrote! So when you book, please make sure that you are on the same page to avoid a situation like this.

Ute’s flat was a great base for our stay in Berlin. It is well-located, being close to public transport links to the city centre and outlying Potsdam, but also provided a peaceful base outside the business of the city. Directions were clear and the key handover worked well.
The accommodation is clean and has everything you need for a comfortable stay, including hairdryer, washing machine and dishwasher. There were board games and lots of books too.
We would definitely stay again.

We loved our stay in this lovely apartment in Berlin. The location is great - surrounded by so many cafes, restaurants and local shops. There is a bakery opposite with delicious pretzels and we loved walking to the local ice cream shop in the evening with our children.
It is close to two U-bahn stations and we also used the buses to get about which were very convenient.
The apartment was perfect for our needs. Two bedrooms, ours with a comfortable bed and our two girls loved the bunk beds. Blackout curtains helped us sleep well, and it stayed cool in the heat. The bathroom was spacious and clean and the kitchen had everything we needed. It was well decorated and we enjoyed watching the world go by from the windows and balcony.
Our hosts were responsive and helpful, answering queries quickly and going the extra mile (early check in, extra bits for my small child). We will definitely stay here again if we return to Berlin.

Betty’s place is just delightful and in the perfect location. Betty and her roommate are both so welcoming, thoughtful and kind. They went out of their way to make sure I had everything I needed during my stay. I will absolutely be booking this spot next time I find myself in Berlin.
Nice quiet location, very welcoming hostess, good access to transportation and a very nice place to rest after a long day.

Had a great time at Pierre's. The apartment was as listed and the locations great, with some fantastic restaurants nearby. Would recommend.

The photos for this place are so good, but the place is even better in person! Very spacious with high ceilings and very clean. The flat is located on a very quiet street one street away from plenty of restaurants, bars, and shops. We are already hoping this flat is available for our next visit! So happy we found this one!
The staff is amazing. Very generous and helpful and fun!

If there were a way to give them 10 stars I would!  Tanya met me at checkin and was a delight.  Clean and safe place (was traveling solo so this was important!). Very nice stay in a very beautiful apartment.  The room was very comfortable and sunny.  Nassa was welcoming. Thanks a lot it was beautiful holidays  in a pleasant neighbourhood.

Second stay here, great as usual!

Such a great location. Very central and only a stones throw away from the U-Bahn and S-Bahn. Ivos was a great host and gave us great tips for what to do during our stay. I would recommend this place to anyone.

A very cozy spot & the perfect place to call home during our week-long vacation. Host was extremely welcoming the moment we stepped through the door! The apartment is in a very quiet & safe area, and it is a short & convenient walk from the train station which can easily take you all over the city! As two poc young female travelers, we couldn’t have asked for a better spot. This is truly a safe space where all are welcome & the host greets you with openness!
Bonus: if you come in winter, the room is so warm PLUS the bed is so comfortable and they provide a duck feather comforter which will not only keep you SO warm, but also give you the best sleeps of your life. Some of our favorite things in the area are cafe KALI, the farmers market at the park down the street, and Lon Men’s Noodle House!
Nytt og flott, veldig sentralt plassert i gangavstand fra Ostkreuz togstasjon, hyggelig og imøtekommende personale.

Das Zimmer war sehr sauber. Das Bett war sehr bequem. Die Lage war perfekt. Innerhalb wenuger Minuten erreichte man die S-Bahn, welche einen überall hinbringt. Zudem findet man in der Nähe einen schönen Park, sowie gute Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.

Such a very nice stay at Daniela and Alex's place ! They were very available if needed and pretty flexibel. Alex welcomed me the day i arrived and the communication about my arrival and during my stay was very fluid and friendly.
The room is bright but fresh in the summer and pretty big. The bathroom is shared with Alex and Daniela but always available.
I warmly recommend !

Great Place to stay. Airport is so close. Hosts are real nice people. 😊
Very cute apartment in a quiet neighborhood. Easy walk to the underground/subway and lots of restaurants and cafes.  Stella was very responsive and left great instructions.
Lugar incrível, ótima cozinha, perto do metrô, bons mercados e restaurantes nas proximidades. Recomendo.
Amazing flat and great location!

The appartment is very spacious and we felt quickly at home. The location is also perfect next to the mind boggling Tempelhof. We didn't meet Julia, but organising was easy and she seems very relaxed and easy going. It was hard to leave and hope to come back one day!

일단, 주변에 힙한 음식점/카페/바/편집샵 등 즐비합니다.
voo store도 걸어서 5~10분 정도면 가는 것 같아요.

Estancia perfecta. Apartamento muy limpio y cómodo, con todo tipo de facilidades. Trato excelente por parte de los anfitriones y ningún problema con la entrada y salida. Simplemente excelente.
Very well equipped appartement (has a bathtub!), great location. The sleeping couch was surprisingly comfortable. Frank responds quickly and friendly. We can really recommend this place.

Apartment is centrally located and in close proximity to many night clubs and the East Side Gallery. Robert is a laid-back, agreeable, and above all genuine person who has a host of stories to tell. Especially recommended for solo travelers who are willing to put themselves out there for different perspectives. Pleasant stay and would visit again!
Nice small flat in a great neighbourhood, great communication from Sebastian the owner for our arrival and we recommend Göttlich cafe round the corner :)

Great stay! Near public transport stations, nice communication with the owner, very clean room and modern apartment. I can’t think of any disadvantages :) (only if you’re by car, notice that there is a busy area and it’s hard to find a parking spot, but I managed to do it anyway).
It was good and exactly what you are paying for, friendly people working there (:
Beautiful, clean and convenient apartment near the central train station and Tiergarten park.
Loved our stay, Arcan was a very hospitable host. Would definitely recommend his place!

Fantastic location in Prenzlberg, very vibrant and lots of amenities.
Cute and comfy place.
Jan’s place was lovely, I would stay again and recommend my friends stay there as well!
Wonderful stay!

Die Wohnung von Arzu und Tom war super schön und auch sehr gepflegt, wir haben uns dort ausgesprochen wohl gefühlt – würde ich jederzeit wieder buchen und auch weiterempfehlen.
Unsere ziemlich späte Ankunft war ebenfalls kein Problem, die Kommunikation per AirBnb und Telefon war immer schnell und freundlich.

The apartment matched its description perfectly.  The best feature for me was the very quick access to the local U Bahn station.  I spent a week using Berlin's great rapid transit system, and having the stop less than a five minute walk away was excellent.  The apartment has all the features i needed:  good shower, comfortable bed, sufficient kitchen related things.
Muy buena comunicación con Ariane. El departamento muy limpio y bastante céntrico. Muy cerca de la isla de los museos.

Such a well decorated space!! Good location and transit. Bathroom got a little muggy / dirty because no ventilation, but maybe with less guests (we had 5) that’s less of an issue. For Berlin, one of the better priced options.

Wir wurden wegen eines Wasserschadens in die Wohnung im Alt Moabit 82 umplatziert. Eine einzige Katastrope! In der Küche waren Kakerlaken und ein Besucher hat nun Krätze! Unglaublich, dass diese Wohnung hier angeboten wird! Nach Rekla beim Anbieter haben wir eine absolut unzufriedenstellende Antwort erhalten, dass wir das melden hätten können und dass wir keinen Beweis hätten, dass die Krätze von der Wohnung kommt. Eine Frechheit! Nie wieder!!!
Nettes kleines Apartment mit allem, was man benötigt. Sauber und bequem.  Einziger Kritikpunkt ist die Hellhörigkeit und das dauerhaft aktive Lüftergeräusch.

Liebe Kirsten,
die Wohnung war einfach super!
We enjoyed the space and the warm welcome Suzanne gave us. Would 100% recommend!

The flat was great and in a great area. Carsten was also good up until our check-out day when he started sending me really angry messages because of a miscommunication. This arose because Carsten is not involved at all in the day-to-day preparation of the flat. He instead hires people to do the on-the-ground maintenance and welcome guests.
Though Carsten is responsive over the Airbnb chat, the people you are supposed to contact while you are there never check their phones. As a result, messages didn't get to them, there was a big palava, and I had to sprint across Berlin in extreme heat to stop him sending me angry messages.
The flat was lovely, but because of this experience I'll not be staying there again.

Wir haben unsere Zeit sehr genossen.
Die Unterkunft von Simone und Detlef ist wunderbar eingerichtet, mit viel Liebe zum Detail. Es hat uns nichts gefehlt.
Die fussläufige Erreichbarkeit zu den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln sowie zu einem komfortablen EDEKA ist sehr gut.
Wir wurden sehr herzlich empfangen, vorab und währenddessen mit wertvollen Tipps versorgt.
Die Kommunikation war stets gegeben und sehr gastfreundlich.

schönstes Zimmer, zentral gelegen, hat alles für einen Kurzaufenthalt.

I had a great and pleasant stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-located. The whole experience smooth and enjoyable. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others!

Agnes and her husband have a beautiful place in Berlin that is accessible to many of the best sites and neighborhoods of Berlin. I walked almost everywhere just from their apartment.  Agnes is so welcoming and helpful. Everything was clean and lovely and it was fun to speak with her about art and things happening in Berlin. Such a wonderful gem in the city.
ottimo Hotel e ottima posizione, la vista è davvero carina, le camere sono pulite e ordinate e il personale è cortese

What a awesome place to stay loved everything about it. The apartment is located very close to the train station making it very convenient to get around. The owners are very helpful with any questions you may have. If I was to come back I would defiantly stay here again. Perfect for a couple.

Es war ein angenehmer Aufenthalt bei Phillip. Die Wohnung ist sehr einfach zu erreichen und liegt mitten in Friedrichshain. Die U-Bahn ist nur wenige Meter zu Fuß entfernt.

Nichts desto trotz kann ich die Unterkunft für Kurzaufenthalte weiterempfehlen!
Nice and clean place. sometimes it's noisy because of other neighbors but location is good, 35min to center by public transport and very nice palace garden nearby + super cool cafe in next house
Ein schickes und blitzblankes Apartment in einem netten Kiez. Kommunikation und Check-in liefen super.

Wonderful location, very cosy, quiet, nice place with creative spirit. I admired the DIY pieces of furniture. I enjoyed the stay very much! :)

Susanne und ihre Familie sind sehr herzliche Gastgeber. Das Zimmer und Bad sind hell und sehr sauber. Die Umgebung sehr ruhig.
Ich kann Susannes Haus sehr empfehlen☀

The apartment is spacious and lovely. It is very central and easy to find.
The host was very responsive and friendly. The entire apartment was very clean.
I can recommend this place to anybody who wants to visit Berlin for a weekend.

Tolle Lage der Wohnung und ruhig.

I had a great stay and really enjoyed me week here. It's in a great location and very walkable. Hosts were super responsive and very friendly as well as helpful. I'd recommend staying here 100% and will be back next time I visit Berlin. Thank you!
great airbnb in a perfect location - literally next to the metro or walkable to all sorts of bars and shops. Easy check in and check out - Would recommend! Thank you
Good place. Good furniture. Great location. Very polite and helping hosts.
Unser Aufenthalt war super! Alles passt, nur einzig die erste Bedienung ohne Personal war verwirrend und hat zeit gebraucht. Ansonsten alles Perfekt. Vielen Dank!

I highly recommend Limehome for anyone visiting Berlin—great value, excellent amenities, and a smooth experience overall. Would definitely stay again!

Sehr schönes Apartment in top Lage. Kommunikation sehr schnell und freundlich!

Tim ist ein super Gastgeber, den ich nur wärmstens weiter empfehlen kann. Er war immer gut erreichbar und hatte ein Ohr für persönliche Bedürfnisse. Die Unterkunft bot alles, was man braucht. Werde hier in Zukunft bestimmt nochmal nächtigen.👍🏻

Gemütliches Zimmer, einfach zu erreichen mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und trotz zentraler Lage direkt an einem Park gelegen! Bad und Küche, auch wenn mit zwei anderen Zimmern genutzt, sauber und mit allem was man braucht! So macht airbnb Spaß! Gerne kommen wir wieder!

Mimi’s place is where you want to stay in Berlin. It’s very central and close to transportation. The apartment is very clean and stylish. The terrace is gorgeous. Bed and sofa bed were very comfortable, didn’t want to get out of bed. There are a couple of good food spots 10 minutes walking from the place. Hanna and Paolo welcomed us with no hesitation and showed us around the place while also giving us very useful information about Berlin. They were also very easy to talk to and if we needed anything they were more than willing to help

Great hosts - very communicative. Nice location, 3 mins walk to the river where you can sit on the back, 4 min walk to the train which is really well connected to the busier parts of the city. Would stay here again
Anita bescherte uns einen erholsamen Aufenthalt im großen, sehenswerten Berlin. Komfortable, gemütliche Wohnung, ausgestattet mit allem, was wir brauchen. Gute Lage mit guter Verkehrsanbindung.

Schönes bequemes Zimmer in optimaler Berliner Lage! Unkomplizierte sehr freundliche Kommunikation vor und während meines Aufenthaltes. Es hat an nichts gefehlt! Vielen Dank für den angenehmen Aufenthalt.

Zimmer exakt wie in der Beschreibung und auf den Fotos, unkomplizierte Kommunikation mit Adrien, Privatsphäre, viele Annehmlichkeiten auf dem Zimmer wie Mikrowelle, Geschirr, Besteck und Wasserkocher und eine angenehm ruhige Wohngegend. Dank der nach zwei Minuten fußläufig erreichbaren U-Bahn-Station ist man auch schnell im Stadtzentrum. Prima für einen Städtetrip!

This is a charming small apartment located in a great neighborhood where you can find coffee shops, grocery stores, public transport and restaurants nearby. It gets good sunlight. It’s on a higher floor so need to be prepared if bringing heavy luggage.

We had a wonderful time at Tatiana's apartment. It felt very homey, and the decor and apartment felt cosy and open. The check-in was flexible, which was appreciated due to our late flight. I would definitely recommend this apartment to other travellers.

Von Anfang an hat die Kommunikation mit Nassa super geklappt, obwohl wir uns nie gesehen haben. Sein sehr freundlicher Bruder Nader hat uns die Schlüssel übergeben und uns erste Tipps gegeben. Die Wohnung wirkt eigenwillig eingerichtet (kein 08/15), z.B. durch die Hängematte und die Bilder/ Plakate, und man fühlt sich dennoch sofort heimisch. Wir sind zu viert (Familie mit zwei Kindern, 3 u. 6 Jahre) mit dem Platz gut ausgekommen. Hilfreich war eine zweite Matratze unterhalb des Hochbetts. Für die einsetzenden kalten Tage war es schön, dass es drei Heizkörper gibt. Das Fußballländerspiel D-Irland konnten wir auf einem guten HD/ 3D-TV  sehen (ohne Ton, damit die Kids schlafen ;-)). Ansonsten stimmt alles, was die anderen über die Umgebung gesagt haben: Es gibt eine Vielzahl von günstigen, aber guten Restaurants (Hauptgerichte für 6-7 € sind üblich) auf der Straße selbst, die Verkehrsanbindung ist durch die Ring-S-Bahn und die U2 hervorragend. Zu Fuß ist der Mauerpark, aber auch andere Gebiete des Stadtteils Prenzlauer Berg gut erreichbar. Auch zum Einkaufen ist alles in unmittelbarer Nähe (mehrere Spätshops, Bäckereien, Supermärkte). Ein UCI-Kino befindet sich am Anfang der Straße. Gerne wieder!

If I go to Berlin again in the future I will go to his room again!

The stay was wonderful and I would love to stay here again.

Alles gut, danke!

A good place, we found everything to be close by.
A friendly host.
All was good.

❗️During my stay by Susann, we experienced some highs and lows.
Leaving out that time when the cat covered my bed with ✨piss✨ (that might happen with a cat), I really tried all my best to be as respectful and kind as possible, but probably it was not the point. Leaving out also the high price, there were in general days when everything was super good, and the atmosphere seemed to be a very pleasant one, but in other days…. the total opposite.
First, to anyone who intends to stay here, keep in mind that if you are used to make noise while pushing the light switch, this place is not for you.
This is to say that from a psychological point of view, my experience was frustrating because I constantly lived with anxiety and panic not doing the “right” thing (conform to Susann’s house rules) and consequently being immediately told over about it.
Moreover, I'm probably a very Kälteempfindlich person (sensible to cold) so much so that Susann came into my room when I wasn't home to turn down/turn off the heating 🤭 which if I’m not wrong is against privacy rules. And It has also already been mentioned in another review, so it was not the first time. It is also very dangerous to keep the heating off in winter, one might get sick.
Susann likes to stay in a calm envrironment, to share her private home with particular care for living in a comfortable atmosphere for both guest and host. Therefore, be careful with being loud or make ANY sort of disturbing noise, otherwise she will probably spend the following hours slamming doors more violently than you have done or anything else that makes noise, maybe to make you understand what not to do. At least that’s what happened to me.
Most of the times she herself was aware of this behaviour and misunderstandings between us, so she offered me some presents.
Yes of course it cannot be denied also that in general, the flat is well located, wide (especially the room) and illuminated.

The apartment is well located and was clean as if new. The kitchen is well equipped, nice furniture, very comfortable bed and clean, modern bathroom.
Gabriela communicated effectively and spared no effort to make our stay comfortable, really exceptional. I wish all AirBnB host were like her.

I spent about 4 months in Annika's apartment. I was in Berlin for business, and it was a great flat to live in. It is close to public transportation, Annika or Johannes always replied straight away if I had any questions or concerns and everything you could be needing when living long term in a flat was there. In my personal opinion, the flat is great for one person if you are staying long term, however is more than big enough for 2+ people when staying for shorter periods. I worked at Potsdammer Platz and walked to work every day. When walking through Tiergarten it takes about 25-30 minutes to walk to Potsdammer Platz and other locations around such as Brandenburger Tor. I had a great stay, thank you to both Annika and Johannes for all your help and support while I was there.

nice and agile contact, smart room concept

perfect communication with hosts! super friendly and patient. apart from a broken kitchen appliance everything else was as advertised. they were very forthcoming and offered compensation. also very beautiful yard. would definitely stay again :)

Frank was always quick to reply and gave us many excellent suggestions for restaurants and activities.  I would definitely stay here again, it is great for a long term (or shorter term stay). It is also an excellent value. If it is available when for your dates, you (almost certainly) will not find a better place in such a location.
Very nice and responsive host! Thank you! We had a wonderful stay. It’s a nice area compared to other parts of Berlin <3

10/10 experience staying here — best Airbnb in a long time.

Sehr schöne Wohnung; tolle Lage; Peter, Julia und Familie sind super nette Gastgeber; absolut zu empfehen!

I initially thought i would definitely stay here again, but in the end after i could not get the stove top to work, and Florian failed to respond to my requests for help, except for a cursory response that didn't solve the issue, i found the whole experience really disappointing. Florian was super responsive about everything else i messaged him about, and even agreed to a late checkout, which was very cool, but his lack of communication regarding the stove was really dissapointing, and to be honest, surprising... Leo’s place is amazing. Great location, cool neighborhood, stylish and cozy room. Leo and Gareth are so coooool. Thank u for everything!
Appartement spacieux, dans maison très agréable, silencieux et très bien placé pour les visites.

The place was great, very convenient location and lots of great cafes and restaurants within walking distance.

Wir fanden das Appartment sehr angenehm. WC/Dusche ist super.
In Summe: Ausstattung war sehr gut. Das Check-in war klar und einfach.
Es liegt im Hinterhof und ist sehr ruhig. Die Kommunikation mit dem Host war sehr einfach und sie haben super schnel reagiert. Was will man mehr. :-)

This was a great place to stay and I'd definitely return. The hotel is in a good spot in Kreuzberg next to tons of great bars and restaurants; there are plenty of museums and landmarks within walking or biking distance, and a few metro stations nearby.
My room was really big and clean, as was the bathroom; the big windows were helpful with the breeze and the fans kept the room from being too hot. The man at the front desk was incredibly friendly and helpful, making it easy to check in as well as arranging an early-morning taxi to the airport for me when I was leaving.
Muy recomendable! Anne es muy servicial y amable. El hostal está genial, todo muy limpio y cómodo
alles in Allem ein guter Aufenthalt mit guter Anbindung zum ÖPNV

I really liked the room, so beautifully decorated. I didn't realize it was a hotel so that was not what I was seeking but it was great regardless.

Logement très calme situé à deux pas du parc du château.
Communication avec l’hôte très réactive.
A recommander.
El lugar muy aseado, con una estación de metro muy cerca. Sin embargo el lugar muy pequeño para 3 personas y muy poca ventilación.

A very nice apartment in a very quiet but close to everything neighbourhood
Mimi was a great host
The house was super clean and cozy
Super schöne Bude zum Wohlfühlen. Alles da was man braucht. Julius ist super hilfsbereit bei jeglichen Fragen. Absolut zu empfehlen! Ich komme wieder!

Die Unterkunft ist sehr praktisch, man kann auch auf der Couch im Wohnzimmer schlafen. Es sind auch oft Parkplätze vorhanden, man muss nicht lange suchen. Alles super sauber und Bettwäsche aus Baumwolle, was für mich wichtig war.

I stayed for two nights at Chris’ apartment. Communication with him was easy and uncomplicated. He was very friendly and forthcoming with any needs. The apartment is very much like in the picture - with all that you need, but really most basic.
Super nice host! The apartment is equipper and really cozy especially with the balkony. Public transport, groceries and restaurants are super close too. ✨

My first time in Berlin after having loads of people recommending that I should come. This Air BnB makes me want to come back and visit this amazing city quite a few more times! Bed is one of the most comfortable I’ve ever slept in, shower is fantastic and was a warm place to go back to after a cold day out in Berlin.

Das Check in verlief sehr unkompliziert und zuvorkommend. Da sich das Hotel in einem Hinterhof befindet, war es recht ruhig. Vor der Tür ist auch eine Straßenbahn Station. Die Lage ist super Zentral. Ich würde wieder kommen.

Sebastian is really communicative, and helpful. The apartment is clean and charming!
We had a great time.

Super space in a great location! The apartment was incredibly well organized and Olga and Boian included some great touches such as breakfast provisions and adapters should you need them. The apartment was incredibly quiet in the back where the bedroom is and is very comfortable and spacious. I have been a longtime user of Airbnb and theirs ranks very high on my favourites.

Wir haben eine sehr gut gelegene Wohnung vorgefunden (sowohl in Bezug auf Innenstadt und Anbindung, als auch bezüglich nahe liegender Supermärkte/Bäckereien/Restaurants). Die Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter war einwandfrei und sehr unkompliziert, wir durften sogar früher einchecken um unser Gepäck abzustellen. Die Wohnung hat alles, was man zum Wohlfühlen braucht und Küche sowie Bad sind mehr als ausreichend ausgestattet (wir waren zu zweit). Weiterhin ist sie liebevoll eingerichtet und zeugt von vielen netten Details, die ein gewisses Luxus-Gefühl vermitteln. Unser einziger Kritik-Punkt ist, dass es für unseren Geschmack durchaus etwas sauberer hätte sein können in Küche und Bad (teilweise mussten wir Geschirr noch spülen, da es nicht ganz sauber war, bevor wir es nutzen konnten). Teilweise war es im Haus etwas laut, was man dann auch in der Wohnung zu hören bekommt, da sie direkt neben dem Eingang liegt. Alles in allem hatten wir aber einen sehr schönen und angenehmen Aufenthalt und das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis ist dementsprechend sehr zu loben!
Great apartment, location and host. We really appreciated being able to check out late and being able to enjoy our last day without carrying our bags with us.

Es ist eine Wohnung mit schon etwas älteren Möbeln. Alles jedoch sauber und gepflegt. In der Küche alles was man für einen Kurzaufenthalt benötigt. Die Lage ist wirklich sehr gut. Einerseits ruhig andererseits ein paar Strassen zu Fuß weiter gibt es Kneipen kleine Geschäfte usw. Man ist mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln schnell im Zentrum. In der Regel findet man in der Strasse einen freien, wenn auch kostenpflichtigen, Parkplatz. Zum Hinterhof ist das eine Schlafzimmer sehr ruhig. Wir konnten bei offenem Fenster sehr gut schlafen. Das andere Schlafzimmer liegt an einer wenig befahrenen Wohnstrasse. Da musste das Fenster zubleiben - aber war auch kein Problem. Besonders schön war auf dem kleinen Balkon in Ruhe zu frühstücken bzw. am Abend noch ein Glas Wein zu trinken.
Astrid hat auf jede Email schnell, freundlich, felxibel und hilfreich reagiert. Also wirklich zu empfehlen. Wir können uns gut vorstellen die Wohnung nochmal zu mieten.
Brigitte ist sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und zuverlässig und ich war sehr zufrieden.

Great apartment!  The location is right in the middle of everything. Lovely restaurants on the river nearby. If you arrive by train, you can store your luggage in the train station . It was a few euros and easy.  Thanks for the great stay!
Kerstin was friendly and a great host! Gave us recommendations for travel and things to do.  And coffee in the morning was delicious!

Meine Mädels und ich haben jetzt das 2. Mal in einem der Bensimon-Inserate übernachtet. Wie erwartet lief alles reibungslos. Wir kommen wieder und freuen uns schon auf den nächsten Aufenthalt in Berlin!

A very spacious and comfortable apartment with one of the best views you can get in the city. Perfectly located and easy check in and out

Nous avions choisi cet établissement pour y passer la nuit avant notre vol tot le matin. L'appartement était conforme aux photos, seul gros bémol pour la propreté de la salle de bain (cheveux et poils), et les odeurs très fortes même dans la chambre.
L'hôte était très réactif pour répondre aux messages.
An excellent apartment in a very nice neighborhood. We only wished there were some kitchen basics like salt and oil.

Wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder! Das Gästehaus des Dharma Mati liegt ruhig im Westend von Berlin. Es ist sowohl mit dem Auto als auch mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln bestens zu erreichen. Unser Late Check-In über die Schlüsselbox erfolgte aufgrund der hervorragenden Beschreibung völlig reibungslos. Am folgenden Tag wurden wir an der Rezeption sehr freundlich empfangen und erhielten interessante Informationen über das Angebot des Buddhistischen Zentrums. Das ruhig gelegene Zimmer war sehr sauber und zweckmäßig eingerichtet. Es verfügte über einen kleinen Kühlschrank und einen Wasserkocher/Tassen/Gläser. Den Gästen stehen zusätzlich verschiedene Gemeinschaftsküchen zur Verfügung, die sehr gut ausgestattet sind. Wir teilten uns das ebenfalls sehr saubere Bad unkompliziert mit einem weiteren Gast/Zimmer. Absolut empfehlenswert: Das vegetarische Restaurant Lotus Lounge im wunderbaren Gartenbereich und die Meditationen im beeindruckenden Schreinraum - auch für Anfänger.

La casa es increíble, tal cual aparece en la imagen. La atención de Rochus es increíble, desde el primer momento te hace sentir en casa.

Gut angebundene Unterkunft, die sich gut für Kurzaufenthalte mit vollem Tagesprogramm eignet. Solide Grundausstattung und schnelle Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber.

Very nice place on a great location in Berlin. Dorit is a very nice host who makes you feel really welcome. The studio has everything you need. Would for sure come back here on a next visit to Berlin!

Sharon was an incredible host throughout the entirety of my stay! As a host she was nothing but incredibly helpful and outstandingly responsive, and her apartment is just as incredible! Bardzo dobra lokalizacja - cisza, spokój, restauracje, kawiarnie i sklepy blisko mieszkania. Dobra komunikacja do centrum miasta. Sprawne i bezproblemowe zameldowanie. Czysta i nowoczesna łazienka (z ogrzewaniem podłogowym!). Bardzo atrakcyjna cena. Bardzo polecam!

Arzu and Tom were great hosts; from the menus from restaurants in the area on the cupboard and various sight-seeing pamphlets and books all available; which they send in the confirmation email too. The apartment is close to public transport and it does not take long to get into the city centre. The neighbourhood is safe and we loved the fact that there was a playground just across the street for our little. They supplied us with a camping bed for baby and a stroller, less things to lug around the airport. We enjoyed our time staying at this apartment while seeing Berlin. This is definitely a place I would recommend to a friend if they ever have to stay in Berlin. Thanks Arzu and Tom
haben uns wohlgefühlt,  süßes apartment, Ausstattung war wie angegeben und es sah alles so aus wie auf den Bildern :) Lage ist auch top. Können es nur weiterempfehlen! :)

everything was great. super stylish appartement with a very nice host. we'll definitely come back.
