Virkelig dejlig rummelig og lys lejlighed, som var er virkelig godt udgangspunkt, for vores lille familie på fire, til at udforske Berlin. Udsigt fra terrassen til baggård med træer, og der var ingen støj om natten, selv med åbne tagvinduer.
Området er rigtig hyggeligt med autentisk og god café, loppemarked og meget mere. Man går til U-bahn på 5 min, og er kunster stop væk fra Alexander Platz.
War sehr nett, gerne wieder !
Tout était parfait, je recommande.

Schöne Wohnung in super Lage, mitten in Kreuzberg mit vielen Cafés und Restaurants in der Umgebung. Gute Verkehrsanbindung. Alles genauso wie in der Beschreibung und auf den Bildern. Sehr netter und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber. Gerne wieder, vielen Dank!

Overall it was a really nice experience staying for a month at Daniel's flat. Daniel was super nice and very punctual. The flat comes with all necessary amenities you might expect from a fully equipped apartment. It is located in a more residential area so if you're looking for something quite this is the right pick for you. Nevertheless there are a bunch of restaurants and super markets within a few steps reach so I barely really cooked. In addition, there is the river Spree right around the corner and invites you to a peaceful walk every evening. In regards to public transport: only a few steps from the flat (less than 5 minutes) are two bus stops. And if you don't mind a few steps more (~10 min) you can hop the underground or tram. Last but not least the flat comes with a really fast internet connection, which was rather crucial for me since I also had to get some work done remotely during my stay.

Thanks a lot Daniel!
Martin hat total schnell geantwortet und war sehr entgegenkommend!  Die Betten sind bequem und man ist schnell in der Stadt mit der U-Bahn.
Tolles Airbnb an toller Lage. Passt super für Unternehmungen mit ÖV oder zu Fuss. Restaurants in der Nähe sind ebenfalls toll und sehr empfehlenswert.

Had a great stay in the flat, decoration a little tired in places but not enough to spoil our stay. Having a bedroom for everyone was a real bonus and a privilege in Berlin.
As some said kitchen equipment was a bit light however our request for additional mugs for our group was sorted within a couple of hours by a smiling and gracious Monica (who we had already met hen we dropped off our suitcases) So I don't see any problems, if you have a request just ask, the hosts a very proactive and helpful.
Area was great, quiet with lots of local restaurants a supermarket and several bakeries within a short walk. It suited us perfectly, Berlin's fantastic tram service meant we could get wherever we wanted quickly. Recommend
A great experience, a very friendly host & the higlight of a wooden hottub in the back. A great place to go as a couple or with friends in the summer.

This apartment felt like home right from the start. It is way bigger than it looks on the pictures and is tastefully decorated. In is located in a quiet area (but still very central!) and with all the good facilities it was a pleasure to stay there.
Esperienza STUPENDA! Host carinissimi, alloggio pulito e zona perfetta. Siamo stati benissimo!
Amazing place to stay. Carola is a very nice host with lots of local tips and her house is really comfy.
Tiene un encanto especial. Desayunar fuera da la sensación de estar desconectado del mundo.
Es war sehr schön und sauber.immer wieder buchen 😃👋

Dejlig rummelig lejlighed og lys lejlighed. Lækkert møbleret og med fin plads til 5 personer. Beliggenhed super god - tæt på seværdigheder og hyggeligt lokalområde med masser af liv og stemning. Dejligt roligt om natten. Kan helt klart anbefales.
I really appreciate the hospitality and great service at Lindemann´s. I will definitely recommend your hotel to others. Thank you for a great stay in Berlin!
A lakás kicsi de szép és kellemes

This flat was fantastic and I can really recommend it to others. The area is great with many good restaurants, shops and cafes. The host was also very helpful and flexible. Thanks a lot for everything, I will definitely come back!
Lage direkt an U-Bahn, wodurch man schnell überall hin kommt. Freundlich und unkompliziert empfangen worden. Preis-Leistung perfekt für Kurztrip nach Berlin geeignet.

from the get go he was likeable person, always responsive, corporative, professional and a good guy over all . the place was spotless the price is affordable and the best part is location wise was my favorite place to be in . I would suggest anyone to give it a try .

The apartment is in a very peacefull area at about 10 minutes from the Underground (U). It is a very cosy place and proper for a family with 2 kids. Fabian is a great host. He answered to us at any questions that we had and he gave us all the indications that we needed to get to the apartment. Thank you! Fabian&Family. D&G.

Very beautiful location, walking distance to several public transportation stations, in between two great supermarkets and many other restaurants. Room was cosy, the bed was good, had a tv and a desk and shelves. Everything was waiting for me.
The room may feel too crowded for two people but was great for one.
Parwana asked me immediately if I managed to check in and everything was OK.
immer wieder gerne!
Great location, good value for money and a nice place to stay for a few nights in Berlin.

Dit is een aanrader! Goede locatie en heerlijk bed. De kamer is perfect voor als je alleen bent, alleen als je met zijn tweeën verblijft dan is er wel te weinig kastruimte en te weinig hangers. Als je naar Berlijn gaat en niet van plan bent in je kamer te zijn behalve te slapen dan is dit perfect.
Great location, very helpful host and would definitely stay again.
Nice, small, cozy apartment in good location, very close to Tierpark (Zoo, Aquarium), KaDeWe and metro station.

We hebben een heel prettig verblijf gehad. Super leuke wijk met speeltuinen, winkeltjes en horeca en een metrohalte op 100 meter. Fijne wandelingen gemaakt. De accommodatie heeft 2 extreem grote slaapkamers. Bedden zijn prima.
Het woongedeelte vond ik wat minder qua aankleding: vervelend bankje waar je na een vermoeiende dag niet lekker op neer kunt ploffen, tv deed het niet, de gootsteen stonk enorm telkens als we de kraan opendraaiden en er zaten vlekken in de stoelen en de bank. Verder weinig servies (en er stond een kapot glas in de kast). Maar ondanks dat zou ik het zeker aanraden want de voordelen zijn veel groter dan die paar kleine nadelen. We waren er met 2 kinderen en hebben echt genoten.

The reason I gave four stars is not a reflection on Stefan as a host or the apartment. It was simply because the location was so LOUD.
And it’s a catch-22. The location was GREAT for walking around and the view of the park. But at night, the noise from the park made sleep impossible…and I can sleep anywhere.
The apartment is lovely and Stefan a great host. Perhaps you will have a quieter experience than we did.

Gabriele's place is a hidden gem. The appartment is in a beautifully renovated old warehouse. Very authentic, with huge windows over looking the leafy courtyard. The room is large and bright. The host is very helpful and knowledgeable of Berlin. The place is located on a quiet road near an area with loads of restaurants, bars and great cafes, and we found it to be quite central. I would recommend this place to my friends. I will be returning if I visit Berlin again.
Thank you. Very good.
Great location and a lovely stay right in the heart of Berlin

Ich war ca. 3 Monate zu Gast bei Sylvia und bin sehr zu frieden. Die Unterkunft hatte alles was man für einen Aufenthalt braucht.
Sehr gut war die günstige Anbindung an die Autobahn und der S Bahnhof Schichauweg. Von dort aus war man in ca. 25 min. am Brandenburger Tor. Auch der Privatparkplatz an der Wohnung ist sehr viel Wert. Ein Lidl ist zu Fuß in 5 min. zu erreichen und Kaufland mit dem Auto in 10 min.
Sylvia hat sich auch stets erkundigt ob alles Ok ist und ob ich etwas brauche. Ich kann Sylvias Unterkunft weiter empfehlen.
Appartamento molto accogliente

Wir hatten einen super schönen und gemütlichen Aufenthalt bei Hanna.
Die Wohnung ist liebevoll, aber dennoch sehr clean eingerichtet.
Wenn man nicht vor Ort kochen mag (was gut möglich ist), sind Restaurants fußläufig zu erreichen. Die Bahnanbindung ist auch top.
Der Check-In war unkompliziert und ging schnell.
Wir kommen hoffentlich bald wieder!

We travelled to Berlin with our two eldest children who are 17 and 14.
This apartment was the perfect location for us. The U bahn station is 2 mins walk and gets you to all the main tourist attractions. We like to have a full day then head back home and eat local. The restaurant reccomendations we got from Stephanie were great and we had 3 lovely meals locally. There is a Lidl 5 mins walk for any essentials you might need. Booking in was seamless and we were able to drop our luggage off prior to checking in which meant that we could have a full day on our first day and didn't ?en is well stocked and spotlessly clean as is the rest of the apartment! We loved the quirky touches about the apartment!. Thanks for your hospitality!
a good option for a short stay in Berlin, near to public transport, flat has everything you need

Die Unterkunft liegt in einer ruhigen Gegend und ist mit der S-Bahn M10 (15 Min. + 5 Min. Fußweg) oder auch zu Fuß (30 Min.) vom Hauptbahnhof aus zu erreichen.
Die Spree ist ca. 10 Min. zu Fuß entfernt, entlang deren Ufern man zum Regierungsviertel spazieren kann.
Direkt gegenüber ist ein nettes veganes Tagescafé (schmeckt alles wirklich lecker!), auf der anderen Ecke eine urige Stammkneipe, bei der U-Bahnstation Birkenstraße (Richtung Norden) weitere Cafés und Kneipen und in der Arminiusmarkthalle um die Ecke (Richtung Süden) gleich eine ganze Reihe von Läden, Restaurants, Cafés und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, ebenso an der S-/U-Bahnstation Turmstraße.
Die Wohnung ist geräumig, freundlich und funktional eingerichtet und
bietet alles, was man für einen Kurzaufenthalt braucht.
Nachts ist es sogar bei offenen Fenstern leise und die Betten sind gut, so dass man erholsam schläft.
Uns hat besonders gut gefallen, bei geöffneter Eingangstür quasi auf der Straße im Kiez zu sitzen ;o)
Gerne wieder!
Very nice apartment and host. Recommend!
Tolle und große saubere Wohnung. In guter Erreichbarkeit zum Olympiastadion. Ist super für eine große Gruppe 😊
Superbe appartement très bien.situé

Die Wohnung befindet sich mitten im schönen Bergmannkiez, wo man alle möglichen Restaurants, Cafés und Läden finden kann. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel erreicht man binnen 5 Minuten Fußweg, was sehr praktisch ist. Die Wohnung selbst ist sehr schön eingerichtet, es gibt alles, was man brauchen könnte, die Betten sind sehr bequem. Und die Gastgeberin ist super freundlich und gibt klare Anweisungen, das ist auf jeden Fall ein großer Pluspunkt! Tipp: wenn Wäsche gewaschen werden soll, am besten im Wäschetrockner trocknen, da die Wohnung etwas tiefer als Erdgeschoss liegt und deshalb recht feucht ist. Auf jeden Fall möchte ich mich noch einmal für den schönen Aufenthalt bedanken und komme gerne wieder! :)
Everything was perfect, very cozy stay, location was near Ubahn station, small market was near too. We had amazing time here
Wonderful, clean and spacious apartment that's really convenient to get to. Michael gave us very clear directions and he was very helpful in recommending places to go. Highly recommended!

Super Lage und fantastische Ausblicke über Berlin sowie zwei gleichwertige Schlafzimmer, ein Wohnraum, modernes Bad und eine tolle Küche - alles in einem Topzustand und blitzsauber! Bei unserem Aufenthalt hat uns nur ein wenig der Geruch in der Wohnung gestört, man kann aber in allen Zimmern sehr gut lüften. Kommunikation und Check-In mit Andy problemlos - vielen Dank!

Theresa und Aaron sind sehr nett, ihr Hund super süß und freundlich. Alles war sehr sauber und ordentlich, es gibt ein eigenes Kühlschrenkfach un die gemeinsam genutzten Räume sind ebenfalls in hervorragendem Zustand.
Abendessen konnten wir im kleinen Gärtchen vor dem Haus einnehmen.
Vielen Dank und gerne wieder!
Convenient location for travelling around the city.
Alles super! Komme gerne wieder.

Der Check-In hat super geklappt und die Zimmer waren ordentlich hergerichtet. Auch die Lage war Spitze, ruhig und gemütlich, trotzdem nicht zu weit weg vom Zentrum.
Kann ich nur weiterempfehlen!
Cute little place, host was very communicative. Great area to stay. Nice and cool during the heatwave when we stayed.
The location is great. Host is kind and nice. The price is reasonable too.
Schöne Wohnung, netter Kontakt, schöne Lage!
Alles prima, Bülent war super sympathisch und herzlich!

Located 10mins from Checkpoint Charlie and near the heart of Kreuzberg, we had a great time in the apartment. It was easy to get to and easy to communicate with the host.
The place was super clean and had everything we needed for our 5 day stay. There were 4 of us that comfortably fit and would recommend this place if you're traveling around and want to be near lots of things to see in Berlin.
There is an Italian restaurant across the street where we picked up the keys, that has fantastic food, too. And a beautiful patio.
We had a great stay here!

Die Wohnung ist zentral gelegen, modern eingerichtet und sehr sauber. Der Duschdruck war stark, was ich als sehr wertvoll erachte. Durch die kalten Tage konnten wir die Heizung manuell einstellen und es wurde rasch warm im Zimmer. Das Bett war bequem und die Wohnung hatte alles, was man brauchte. Das Check-in verlief reibungslos! Wir empfehlen die Unterkunft wärmstens weiter und würden auch immer wieder kommen.

This flat is located in one of the best places if you are looking to go out in the hip Berlin, situated in Kreuzberg and close to the best Sauna in Berlin (liquid rooms). It is very clean and it has very comfortable beds to sleep on and a cosy atmosphere. Getting in touch with landlord is super easy and the instructions for the flat are easy to follow. I recommend this flat 100%!

Der Aufenthalt hat uns grundsätzlich sehr gut gefallen. Das Appartement ist wie beschrieben gut ausgestattet, die Lage, Anbindung etc. waren sehr gut. Allerdings ist zu erwähnen, dass die Sauberkeit im gesamten Appartement nicht unseren Vorstellungen entsprach. Great place! We loved it
Jerome was very friendly and the room was cosy and comfortable. Very good value for the money. Really felt like a proper home. Lovely big kitchen. Good communication and nice bathroom with a bath.

really good hotel for a fantastic price!
Honestly, I don’t have anything about to say the only bad thing is if you’re sensitive to loud noises on a Saturday night they do have a place nearby that place pretty loud music for me. This isn’t a problem as I’m used to sleeping in loud noise but genuinely that was the only negative, the hotel itself was 100% worth the price and I would recommend

Das Studio hat eine gute Lage und man kommt super schnell zur U-Bahn,  Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und Restaurants. Desweiteren war der Kontakt mit der Gastgeberin sehr einfach, freundlich und hilfsbereit. Der Check in war ebenfalls unkompliziert und schnell. Mein Freund und ich haben uns in dem Studio von Anfang wohlgefühlt. Es sind alle essentiellen Sachen für einen Aufenthalt gegeben. Weiterhin war die Unterkunft sehr sauber und stimmig eingerichtet. Zusammenfassend lässt sich sagen, das das Studio ein Wohlfühlort, der gleichzeitig super für Erkundungen in Berlin geeignet ist.
Maciej is wonderful host. He not only recommended good place for site seeing, but share nice experience for us. It was my pleasure to live in Maciej's apartment.
L'hôte avait laissé plein de belles attentions à notre endroit

We felt at home from the moment we worked in the door. Everything is provided for a comfortable stay including so local treats upon arrival. The apartment is located in a lively little pocket of Berlin with lots of restaurants and a food market only a few minutes away.
Thanks for a great stay!
Great place. Perfect for small family.

Mooi verblijf in een rustige omgeving maar toch dicht bij alle openbaar vervoer die je nodig kan hebben.
Appartement is mooi ingericht en voldoet aan alle eisen om deftig te kunnen logeren.
Een aanrader!

I had a great stay at Andrej‘s space. The experience started with picking up the key at the nearest convenient store, a great occasion to shop for some snacks and drinks after the journey — really appreciated that, versus the usual key box self check ins.
The apartment is clutter free and super clean, so that was a positive surprise for the unique and very „Berlinesque“ courtyard setting of the apartment. Since it’s in the courtyard it‘s quiet and shielded well from the street noise, trams, emergency vehicles and the usual metropolitan nuisances. Big plus.
Also the neighborhood is a great pick for staying in Berlin. Friedrichshain is actually ranked „the coolest neighborhood of Berlin“ and proudly holds 18th place in „the worlds coolest neighborhoods“ by the renowned London travel magazine TimeOut.
I‘m a picky guest, but I felt I got my bang for the buck. Chapeau! 👏🤩
Small but cosy apartment. Nice neighborhood with a lot of cafes and restaurants.
Très bien placé

Exactly as advertised. Well appointed, roomy flat, well situated and supplied with many essentials. A haven in the busy centre of Berlin and triple glazing keeps the noise and cold out. Alexander and Cristina made every effort to make sure of my comfort.
Das Studio ist klein aber funktional (inkl. Waschmaschine und Geschirrspüler) - es beeinhaltet alles was man braucht :) Die Tipps von Marianne waren sehr hilfreich und sympathisch!

Great location, close to all transports and in a very lively and safe area. Communication was great and Mauro and Stefano are very responsive and easy going. The flat has everything - it's a bit dark but there's a very nice balcony.

Estadia ótima!
Localização muito boa para fazer tudo de transporte público.
it was a beautiful spacious room and had a cozy balcony.  Quiet and easy chdck in too. we enjoyed our stay

Olga was a great host and I had a smooth check in and check out. The apartment was clean and in good condition and I was happy to find a supermarket within walking distance.
Highly recommended.

Lovely accommodation with a really modern kitchen however the rest of the apartment needed modernisation.
The apartment was large and comfortable and close to amenities and train stations.
Bel endroit

Great apartment in an awesome neighborhood! Tanja and her husband were very accommodating and gracious for our party as our arrival time was quite late. The bedroom comfortably sleeps 4 and the living area was perfect for us! Checkout was as easy as leaving the key on the table. Thanks Tanja and Enrico! Hope to stay there again!
We had an amazing stay at Carolin's awesome apartment and can only recommend it if you want to have a great time in Berlin!

Agnieszka's place was really nice, exactly like the photos and the perfect place for 3 people. Agnieszka herself was very helpful and quickly replied to our messages. We had a late check-in and everything work out really well.
The house is situated on the 4th floor without elevator, but taking the stairs was a nice exercise! There is a supermarket right in front of the apartment, lots of nice shops and restaurants in the neighborhood and great connections with the rest of the city. The appartement is turned to an inner garden, so it is in general quite quiet, although on Friday and Saturday nights it can get a bit noisy outside.
All in all a great experience, would recommend when in Berlin!

Warm and spacious flat, I really enjoyed the stay in this flat.
There is both bathtub and shower. Nice location.

Schöne, nette, saubere Wohnung und supernette Gastgeber. Alles hat wunderbar funktioniert. Gute Verkehrsanbindung und ein Parkhaus für 2 Euro am Tag um die Ecke.
Gute Lage und ruhige Wohnung. Gemütliches Flair. Nette Kommunikation.

The studio is super cosy. It is nicely decorated with tastefully curated pieces of furnature and art.
It can be easily reached by public transport.
We slept well in the quiet room and enjoyed our stay. Thanks a lot.
Die Wohnung war top, alles wie beschrieben! Sabine war eine richtig tolle Gastgeberin - super lieb und zuvorkommend. Vielen Dank für den netten Aufenthalt ☺️

Die Unterkunft ist toll , sehr geräumig und liegt sehr zentral.

Eine sehr gute und freundliche Gastgeberin
Ideal couple days stay in Berlin

Very cosy flat. No direct sunlight but lighting is good in all the rooms. Very central and close to the u-bahn.
We enjoyed the lovely café just outside the building.

L'appartement de Fai est très confortable. Situé dans un beau quartier, un des rare qui n'a pas été complètement endommagé pendant la guerre, il est à deux pas des transports avec lesquels on peut visiter toute la ville. Propre et équipé de tout ce qui est nécessaire, il a été parfait pour nous et nos 2 adolescentes. Nous sommes restés 8 jours.
Le contact avec Fai été facile et très précis. Merci

La chambre était parfaite, le balcon fut très agréable, nous y avons déjeuné tous les jours. Le quartier est très beau, vous pourrez y faire de longues balades le long de l'eau. Les magasins et transports en commun sont accessibles à pieds.
Silvia est très sympathique, je recommande vivement de séjourner chez elle.

Perfect for 4 people, well located and super quiet. The outdoor courtyard definitely was a plus.

The location is a little further out from the main visitor areas of Berlin but well connected via U- & S-Bahn stations, so it was very easy to get around. There was a lively bar area nearby, close to Ostkreuz, meaning you didn't have to travel far if you wanted food and drinks. Having been to Berlin a few times, using the public transport system to get around is so easy, being further out is actually a good decision.
Apartment is clean, has a couple of bathrooms and three separate sleeping areas, so was perfectly sized for three friends. Again, the communal space was well-sized for three people.
This is a very good apartment at a reasonable price

Our hosts made us feel very welcome and met us on arrival. The apartment was exactly as described. It is very accessible to the town centre and was a haven to come home to with all the greenery and chirping birds after a day's sight seeing in the city. The swimming pool around the corner was a great way to start a day's sightseeing with our young son. Rainer and Olga gave us lots of other advice on what to see and where to eat. I would highly recommend their apartment and we will be back!

I would very much recommend Thomas’ apartment for a short stay in Berlin. The neighbourhood is great - lots of good local bars and restaurants, we ate locally every night - and easy to get to. The apartment is really well appointed (the listing says ‘no essentials’ but that’s an error, it has pretty much everything including tea, coffee, cooking things, plus wine and treats left out as a welcome). Its situation in a transitional Berlin courtyard means it is really quiet at night. It’s compact but doesn’t feel small because of the high ceilings. I stayed with my mum, with me sleeping on the platform and she on the sofa bed. We both slept really well. Thanks Thomas for a great stay!

Our stay at Bärbel's apartment was wonderful. It's located in a very quiet area (we fell in love with this neighborhood!) but with very easy access to the city center by bus or tram. The apartment is lovely, cozy and it has everything you need for a pleasant stay, including a fully equipped kitchen. The host is nice and friendly but also discreet, even though the apartment is upstairs from where she lives you always have your privacy. We really enjoyed staying here and would definitely come back! Danke schön, Bärbel!

Pænt og rent. Alt virkede som det skulle. Der var de fornødne ting i lejligheden.
Vil bestemt anbefale det til andre.

Sehr schöne, helle und wirklich grosszügige Wohnung. Wunderbarer Blick in die Baumkronen der Kollwitzstrasse. Eignet sich mit den zwei getrennten Schlafzimmer und dem Wohnraum genauso als Familienunterkunft wie zum Arbeiten. Lage und Ambiente sind absolut top und machen den Preis mehr als wett. Das Angebot ist ein Geheimtip und empfehle ich unbedingt weiter.
Excellent location, excellent host. Check-in was very easy.
tolles Zimmer mit tollen Gastgeberin. Alles klappt völlig problemlos. Sehr schöne und ruhige Gegend. Immer gerne wieder.

Numa Stays is my New fav place to stay.

Overall the location is a big plus since it is so close to the train station. This made it really easy to travel around Berlin. The washing machine was a bit hard to work with and the dishwasher you need to push hard for the door to click.
Aside from these things overall stay was okay.

Невероятно красивый дом. Много цветов, картин, интересных книг и мелких деталей интерьера. Очень уютно. Нам всё очень понравилось, спасибо!

This is a great stay in a fantastic part of Berlin. While Kreuzberg isn't central, it's a great location in a walkable neighborhood with tons of great bars and restaurants nearby.
Daniele wasn't around, but Carmen greeted me early and allowed me to check-in early to drop off my bags.
Overall, my family had a wonderful stay at the apartment!

Neta’s flat was clean and the beds were very comfortable! Simple cooking worked for us but we were not able to make an easy meal on the stove top or in the oven for a family  of five (limited pots and pans). Washer recently broke, but we weren’t informed of this. Neta was kind and offered to do our laundry for us. We used the bus down the street frequently and easily to get most of our destinations.
Sehr nette Gastgeberin, alles wie beschrieben, gerne jederzeit wieder. Hilft auch in etwas komplizierten Situationen. Sehr hilfsbereit.
Sehr schöne Loft in perfekter Lage. Terrasse hätte nur bisschen ausgebaut sein können.

Wunderschöne Altbauwohnung in toller Lage!

Das Viertel in Kreuzberg ist super – lebendig, authentisch und voller spannender Ecken zum Entdecken.
Anca war überfreundlich, immer erreichbar und hatte viele tolle Tipps für unseren Aufenthalt parat. Der Check-in war kinderleicht und dank ihrer ausführlichen Beschreibung völlig stressfrei.
Klare Empfehlung – wir kommen gerne wieder!

Pascal contesto siempre los mensajes y fue muy atento, el apartamento esta en el edificio 21 y al principio fue difícil localizarlo pero le mandamos mensaje y salió a ayudarnos a localizarlo, ya que no tiene número el apartamento, localizarlo fue complicado pero el fue muy eficiente. La zona se me un poco sola en unas partes pero está bien, su check-out es a las 10 y nosotros tuvimos una confusión h pensamos que era a las 11, asi que salimos tarde y el fue muy amable y comprensivo con eso, la verdad si lo RECOMIENDO.
Check point Charlie está a 15 minutos aprox caminando, en la dirección opuesta, pasando el canal está una tienda de despensa y encuentras de todo, y como a 10-12 min está una calle con mucha comida, “street food” un lugar de pizza llamada “Primo” está muy rica.

Thankyou so much for my stay! Very accommodating and attentive host. We had a very peaceful and easy stay and the property was clean and looked just like the photos. it was so lovely to get away for a week thankyou will definitely return !! xx
Great location, the room is quite big with good furniture. The bathroom and Kitchen are shared among other guests are clean and everybody respects each other, would definitely recommend this place

Très bien, à quelques pas de Alexanderplatz donc vraiment pratique, quartier calme mais pas très loin des quartiers animés, transport en commun à quelques minutes de marche donc rien à dire et le logement est vraiment propre et calme !
Sehr schnelle und gute Kommunikation. Alles prima. Gerne wieder.
The room was comfortable and clean, the bed was comfortable. Other reviews mentioned that it is on top of a bakery and noisy, but there was no bakery, and no noise!
Great location!
Die Unterkunft ist super zentral, sauber und trotzdem ruhig. Wir haben schnell und einfach alles gefunden. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

This was the most perfect stay in Berlin! Roi was quick to respond to all our queries and the pictures don't do this place justice (that's saying something!) it's stunning! Really clean, well equipped and just a little piece of luxury! We were there for my partners birthday and there was a little bottle of bubbly waiting for us on arrival (thanks Roi :) ) would not hesitate to recommend at all and would absolutely love to go back and stay here again!
Sauberes Zimmer, sehr nett Leute.  Gern wieder!

Ich war die ganze Woche in der Unterkunft von Stefan.
Es war alles so wie beschrieben und war für mich passend.
Komme gerne wieder.
Ich hatte eine sehr schöne Aufenthalt bei Rebecca und würde sehr gern rückkehren.  Sie ist besonders gastfreundlich, das Zimmer ist angenehm und ruhig.  Sehr empfehlenswert!

Top, komme aber wahrscheinlich nicht wieder! Alles gute… Beim nächsten mal sind für die Gäste Empathie und viel meeehr Ruhe wünschenswert!
Alles Gute Werner
Lucien Lamah

The flat was exactly as advertised and Klaus was more than happy to accommodate different check in and out times.
It was a very hot week in Berlin and the windows of the flat were permanently open, it didn’t cause any problem to us, but the noise from the restaurant courtyard could be an issue for some.
As an added bonus the flat was cleaned and all towels and sheets changed half way through our stay. I’ve never experienced this before with an AirBnB and it was very pleasant surprise.
The flat is very centrally located and you are not far from all points of interested, with good transport links.
We had a great stay, thank you Klaus.
Kirsten is a perfect host on a lovely flat near the beautiful place in Kreuzberg! I recommend this flat and come back here when I go back to Berlin. Thank you Kirsten!

에어비앤비의 정석 그리고 순기능이 이런걸까 생각하면서 지냈어요. 많은 에어비앤비를 지내봤지만 처음이었던 경험들이 많았네요.
유나와 귀여운 고양이 그리고 무엇보다 항상 편안하고 친절하게 절 맞이해준 다니엘라와 알렉스 부디 언젠가 다시 베를린에 온다면 이 숙소로 다시 오지않을까 싶네요.
교통은 오히려 위치가 애매한 도심 속 호텔보다 훨씬 나아요 트램 u반을 통해 왠만해선 어디든지 바로 갈 수 있구요. 추천합니다!
The place is perfect! Everything is as pictured, the only thing is that there were big distances to get to all main spots, nothing too bad though.

Martina hat es uns ermöglicht, die Wohnung schon vor Beginn der Eincheckzeit zu nutzen und am Abreisetag länger zu bleiben, bis unser Zug ging.
Sie empfing uns sehr freundlich, wir kamen sofort nett ins Gespräch, alles war komplett unkompliziert.
In der Wohnung haben wir uns sehr wohl gefühlt, sie ist ruhig, obwohl sie in einer belebten Gegend liegt, mit ganz viel kulinarischen Möglichkeiten ringsum, die man in kürzester Zeit aufsuchen kann. Der Standort ist super zu erreichen, vom Hauptbahnhof ein paar Stationen Tram und dann noch ein paar Schritte zu Fuß. U- Bahn 7 Minuten entfernt, Rewe 4 Minuten. Alles perfekt als Basis für Unternehmungen in ganz Berlin, zum Ausgehen oder Schlendern, Prenzlauer Berg hat viel Liebenswertes zu bieten.
Wir empfehlen die Unterkunft wirklich sehr.
Thomas und Margot
Sehr nette Familie, sehr gastfreundlich, sauber, ordentlich. Von den Nächten habe ich nicht viel mitbekommen - ich habe tief und fest geschlafen.
Everything was ok. great contact, very good check-in, good equipment, nice and warm, clean.  I highly recommend it

Really nice flat in the center of the city.
Short way to the subway.
A lot of small shops nearby.
Very clean and cozy.

Nous avons apprécié le logement de Volker, très bien situé dans un quartier très agréable, facilement accessible depuis la gare (Tram M10, puis métro U9 proche de l'appartement). Il est également très facile d'accéder à l'appartement. Par ailleurs, il est calme, joliment décoré, plutôt bien équipé. Le lit de la chambre est confortable. Le seul reproche concernant l'appartement est que nous avions réservé ce logement parce que l'annonce précisait qu'il y avait deux lits: un dans la chambre, l'autre dans le séjour - nous souhaitions des espaces-nuit séparés.  Or le canapé-lit du salon n'était pas utilisable. Et mon amie a dû dormir sur un matelas installé au sol, situation un peu inconfortable quand on commence à vieillir!Heureusement, comme elle est légère, elle a à peu près bien dormi. Mais elle était déçue de ces conditions, bien sûr...

Fin lejlighed til pengene, dog lidt slidt. Fedt område. Mystisk lugt.  Ret meget larm fra gaden og døralarmen, da det er på gadeplan. Ejerne opfordrer på skrift til at man ikke giver under 4.8 i anmeldelse, da det går ud over deres indtjening.
Trevligt ställe, bra läge och Annett är en toppen värd!
Alles top 👌🏽

Alles super! Extrem nett und hilfsbereit. Sehr sehr sauber und schön eingerichtet.
Sehr zu empfehlen !
Maria’s place was wonderful! Very peaceful, stylish and relaxing with a great balcony and convenient location. Highly recommend!

Wir haben eine angenehme und entspannte Woche im schönen Haus mit Garten von Peter und Monika genossen und werden schon in ein paar Tagen wieder kommen. Bei den beiden haben wir uns sofort zu Hause gefühlt und insbesondere die ruhige Wohnlage im Grünen sehr geschätzt. Bis in das Stadtzentrum von Berlin muss man zwar 50 Minuten Reisezeit einberechnen, das geht aber ganz gut, zumal Rudow gut erschlossen ist und gute Einkaufsmöglichkeiten bietet. Wir kommen gerne wieder, zumal wir uns bei Monika und Peter gut aufgehoben fühlen und die familiäre und zuvorkommende Art der Gastgeber schätzen.
Vielen Dank meine Eltern hatten eine angenehme Zeit.
cadre sympathique et accueil conviviale
Die Wohnung liegt sehr ruhig im Hinterhaus u. hat einen kleinen Balkon. Der Schillerkiez ist klasse und grenzt direkt an das Tempelhofer Feld.
Great Place!
Great place
Everything was as expected and better.

Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral, die (eigentlich gute) Ausstattung war aber schon deutlich abgenutzt. Nachrichten im Vorfeld wurden nicht beantwortet. Beim Checkin war die Wohnung noch nicht sauber gemacht (Handtücher und Laken noch dreckig) und erst nach telefonischer Nachfrage kam noch einmal der Cleaning Service, danach war es immer noch staubig.
Für diesen Preis empfehle ich eher ein komfortableres Hotel.

Top Unterkunft! Man geht eben direkt von der Straße hinein und das ist absolut angenehm. Top eingerichtet mit viele Utensilien in den Küchenladen.
Sehr schick.

Completely blown away is how I’d describe our stay at Denise’s apartment. The apartment has an incredible look and feel and has all the touches that help you feel at home as well. The artwork and the space have a great feel and the space is really large and spacious.
The location is amazing and their are some great food options nearby. Denise also gave us some all time great suggestions as well that we loved!! Her communication throughout was exceptional. Would love to go back one day. Thanks to Denise for her amazing house and hospitality as well.

Very happy with the apartment. Spacious, handy for all public transport and convenient for all the things we wanted to visit. Lots of bars and restaurants around but super quiet. Communication was easy and responsive.

We had a wonderful stay in Micheles spacious apartment. The apartment is situated in the calm area Moabit, close to Birkenstrasse U-bahn. There are many cafes and restaurants nearby. The apartment itself was nicely decorated with art and posters and we really enjoyed our stay. Michele was the helpfulness himself. He would do anything to help and guide us, and he always responded to our request within few minutes.
I would fully recommend a stay in Micheles apartment.
Would stay again.

Everything is perfect, I strongly recommend here when you visit Berlin!
立地も何もかも素晴らしいです。ベルリンに滞在する方にはお勧めします。
Alles bestens, immer wieder gerne 😊
ich hatte ein kleines schönes Wochenende in Berlin. die Wohnung ist toll. die Menschen die dort leben sind noch um so großartiger. Dankeschön

Great place to stay, Alexander was very kind and helpful. Everything was clean and bed was very comfortable. We could use the coffee machine as well, which is a nice little plus. The flat is a little further from the city center but the metro station is nearby and the neighborhood felt safe, definitely recommend staying here.
Very nice and clean apartment, with a lot of space. Located on a very quiet and secluded spot. 20-30 minute tram drive to the city center, so that’s perfect. Thanks Ruth

Fantastisch ruim en schoon appartement met eigen ingang in een mooie loft. Met fijn waterbed en een heerlijke regendouche.
Verschillende OV mogelijkheden op loopafstand. Van harte aanbevolen!
Tolle Wohnung! Das Airbnb liegt sehr zentral und dennoch hat man im Hinterhof seine Ruhe. Die Wohnung ist super ausgestattet und wir haben uns wie zu hause gefühlt. Sehr, sehr empfehlenswert!
great apartment, central location, very responsive host!

Excellent séjour à Berlin, l'appartement est très bien situé dans un quartier familial et animé. Louis laisse plein d'infos pratiques pour profiter au mieux de notre séjour. A recommander sans hésiter !

Fantastic location.  Excellent view.  Walkable to Alexanderplatz.  S-bahn and U-bahn trains are right next to you. Clean and comfortable. The flat was the perfect size for me and my friend.  Definitely recommend for 2 friends or a solo traveler.
Sehr schönes Zimmer! Super sauber!
Thalia’s apartment was absolutely lovely with easy access to the U and S-bahn. I would stay there again.

Sehr schönes Hausboot. Es hat einen Glamping- Ähnlichen Charakter. Witziges Erlebnis.
Wissen sollte man Vorab, dass man keine Trinkwasser hat und man sich extra Wasser kaufen muss.
Die Pumpe für das Abwasser ist laut, aber hört zum Glückschnell auf.
Alles in allem ist es eine coole Idee und für einen Wochenendtrip gut geeignet.

Big and spacious apartment in a calm and good neighbourhood. Very close to Mauerpark, nice cafés and cool restaurants around. Katharina was very friendly, was helpful with information and hints (the flea market was a very good recommendation) and made us feel welcome. Only down side was that we found that the apartment was a little bit dusty, beside that, was pretty accurate. The experience was great, we had a great time in Berlin!

The appartment was so arty and great! Located a little north from all the activities but we got to discover a really cute neighborhood that was quiet in the evenings and felt very safe. Would definitely recommend!

Our stay was perfect, the apartment is ideally located in Neukölln, close to great restaurants, bars and thrift shops. The apartment was beautiful, comfortable and very clean. Salah was a proactive and welcoming host. I would definitely come back. Thank you!
All good, thanks!

stanza molto bella, comoda ai servizi. a
poche fermate dal centro
Estancia perfecta. Cuidan mucho el detalle. Demasiado electrónico todo. Se nos fue la luz y no pudimos entrar al edificio durante 1 hora.

Die Wohnung ist schön und gut gelegen, guter Stil, sieht top aus, gute Küche, Klasse Sofa.
Leider kann ich die Wohnung dennoch nicht weiterempfehle..
Kurz die Story dazu: Wie schon von mehreren anderen in den Bewertungen erwähnt gibt es einen sehr unangenehmen Geruch im Schlafzimmer (ich denke Schimmel in der Matratze sowie in den Wänden) da ich mich auch etwas krank gefühlt habe, nach ein paar Nächten gehe ich von Schimmel aus (die Matratze riecht auch muffig daher bringt es nichts die Matraze ins Wohnzimmer zu packen, habe ich auch versucht). Ich habe mich dann entschieden auf den Boden im Wohnzimmer zu schlafen ohne Matraze für 4 Nächte. Also ich den Host auf den Geruch angesprochen habe sagte er dies sei ihm neu, totaler Unfug, da es schon viele schlechte Bewertungen bzgl des Geruchs gibt. Er versucht in den Bewertungen von seiner Schuld abzuweichen, aber er weiss durchaus genau was in den Wohnungen passiert also Vorsicht bei Buchungen.
Wir waren 5 Tage Gaste bei Birgit. Alles war perfekt. Birgit ist sehr nett und hilfreich. Die unterkunft ist top.
Ein gemütliches Zimmer, eine super Lage, gleich um die ecke gibt es ein Lidel und die U- Bahn. Dazu sehr gastfreundlich.

Ulf’s place was in a great neighbourhood, and his directions and instructions for access were easy to understand. The space is small but had everything we needed, including a good selection of kitchenware. For any extra things, be sure to have a look around the space. The mezzanine area worked well for sleeping with plenty of space, however as mentioned, access is by ladder and there is no standing room. Overall we had a lovely stay, and we would recommend. Great restaurants just around the corner near Mauerpark!

Eine so schöne Unterkunft in schönster Lage nahe Berlin!
Mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln ist man trotzdem schnell in der Stadt und hat sonst immer das Wasser vor der Nase!
Zudem ist die Familie super nett.
Wir kommen wieder :)

Ein gut und komplett eingerichtetes Appartement in prima Lage. Alles ist durchdacht und von passender Qualität. Außerordentlich ruhige Lage zum Innenhof und trotzdem alles in Reichweite. Gute und freundliche Organisation bei An- und Abreise.
Sonja‘s little place is well put together in a beautiful neighborhood with access to a private beach at the lake. I highly recommend it.

The flat was in a great location for exploring Kreuzberg and has good travel links to get into the centre of town. Katrin was very friendly and made me feel very welcome, and was really flexible with when I moved in/out. The room was clean and the flat had a lovely kitchen and bathroom. Thanks for a great stay!
Nothing to complain about👌🏻

Lovely house and location. The place is a bit away from the city centre but is very easily accessible via the tram. Judith and her husband are great hosts, they have maintained the place really well and very meticulous and detailed on providing instructions to guests. We hope to visit this place again sometime in the future. Thanks again for your hospitality Judith
Der Aufenthalt war sehr entspannt. Ich komme gerne wieder

My cousin and I stayed there for a month and found the apartment very nice and clean. there was everything there: towels, soap, ...
it is quite small but still nice and it is situated in a very nice place. the only con is transport: there is a bus which takes you to the metro station, but on weekends and at late times you have to walk for about 15-20 min to the station.
but carola was very nice with us and we enjoyed our stay there.

War zum zweiten Mal da, es war alles prima!
Danke Jonas!

There is one bed, big studio living room.
Can be a good apartment for a couple not for roomates.
Alles super geklappt!

Good sized flat with everything a traveler needs, and a nice "staying at your mates house" vibe. Ground floor which was great as I had very heavy luggage. The shower was especially good and powerful, which I appreciated. Lively neighborhood, great location near to shops, restaurants. Rob is a fun guy to be around, always on the go with music or something related! He was a good host and gave me recommendations for local food and places to visit. Thanks again dude!

Heel mooie kamer voor een goede prijs.
Zeer leuke gastheer (gezin).

Logement atypique très sympa ,très propre et surtout très bien situé à Berlin.
Attention une seule chambre et deux lits !
Carmyta est très aimable.L’arrivée dans les lieux très simple.
Notre seul regret a été de ne pas pouvoir laisser nos vélos dans la cour intérieure :résultat un de nos vélos pourtant attaché a été volé dans la rue devant la maison le dernier jour de notre séjour.
Ideale Unterkunft für Familien mit Kind(ern)
Nette appartement in goede locatie bereikbaar met OV en dichterbij supermarkt/etencafes. Bijzonder inrichting met de gallerij kunstwerken. Met uitgaan is de OV minder.
Sehr schönes Apartment mit sehr netten Mitarbeitenden

super Lage in Berlin Mitte; ruhig auf einem Hinterhof gelegen; man hört gar nichts im Haus; Bad leider nicht so sauber wie erwünscht; man kann gut abdunkeln; auch mit 2 kleinen Kindern für ein paar Tage zu empfehlen
Nassas appartement is beautiful. Three lovely, large rooms with a wonderful ambience, situated in a quiet street in charming Prenzlauer Berg. We would stay here again.

La ubicación es buenísima! Las fotos hacen parecer algunos muebles mejor conservados pero es más amplio de lo que parece, el área de la mesa se puede disfrutar bien y tiene una jardinera muy linda. Todo estaba limpio y el acceso muy cómodo.

This is really good location to commute to everywhere in Berlin as the subway station is just 2 mins. Especially, you can walk to Bonanza coffee by walk!
Also, they do professional cleaning service so it’s cozy and clean.
And thanks to Sven again for the quick responses.
Highly recommend to stay here.

Wij hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad in de caravan van Julia. Het contact was heel fijn en soepel en de caravan is heel knus. Fijn dat er ook gratis fietsen beschikbaar waren. Hierdoor fietsten we zo het centrum in. Aanrader!

Es mejor de lo que se ve en las fotos. Es amplio, limpio, bien decorado, con todos los implementos necesarios para una buena estadia, Philipp fue muy amable, nos ayudo mucho en todo lo que necesitamos. A dos cuadras de la estacion del Metro desde donde se puede llegar a cualquier lugar. Lo recomendamos 100%.
Wohnung wie auf den Bildern, klein aber komfortabel. Lage top, Kuhdamm 5 Gehminuten entfernt. Viele gute Restaurants und Einkaufsläden in der Nähe. Kann die Wohnung nur weiterempfehlen.
The perfect Berlin apartment for when you’re visiting with a family of friendgroup. Close to the U-bahn, supermarkt around the corner, safe entrance to the building and spacious rooms.

Tolle, gemütliche Unterkunft nur 20Min zu Fuss vom Hbf oder 5Min mit der Tram. Sehr zentral, alles in Berlin Mitte ist gut zu Fuss oder mit der Bahn/Tram zu erreichen. Das Eingangszahlenschloss zur Wohnung ist etwas gewöhnungsbedürftig. Aber wenn man den“Dreh“ raus hat, kein Problem mehr. Würden jederzeit wieder hier buchen!
For what we paid we could expect something more. Not big enough for a 4 members family. We missed a freezer, dish washer and a modern toilet. Location is OK. And cleanness was not perfect.

Très propre. J'ai bien apprécié tout les petites attentions dont fait preuve l'hôtel : gel douche, savon, shampooing, après-shampooing, café, boules quies.
Seul bémol, la clim qui ne marche pas. Mais pour pallier à ce problème, ils fournissent une clim portable qui fonctionne bien mais qui est bruillante.

Tolle und ausführliche Kommunikation und Info weitergäbe. Eine sehr schöne Wohnung mit ausgefallenen Extras, alles sauber und schön eingerichtet. Unsere Mitarbeiter hatten eine angenehme und schöne Zeit
Vielen Dank

Nous avons un retour plutôt mitigé sur le logement de Mia.
Elle nous a transmis des indications exhaustives nous permettant une arrivé et un départ paisibles. Le logement est également idéalement situé avec seulement 30min de transport de toute attraction touristique et est ressemblant aux photos. Globalement, vous pouvez y séjourner sans trop de soucis pour la vie courante.
Cependant, il était sale, rempli de poussières (particulièrement en-dessous du lavabo de la salle de bain où cela formait des boules de poussière énormes) et les draps ou le lit lui-même sentait l’urine au niveau de la tête. Nous aurions dû demander à ce que le ménage soit à nouveau fait, nous le regrettons. Nous avons dormi sur le canapé. C’est une partie de la prestation que nous payons sur AirBNB… De plus, il manque une passoire pour la cuisine, de l’huile et le congélateur ne ferme pas correctement.
Nous remercions Mia pour son service mais des points importants doivent être améliorés, surtout pour le prix.
Fijne plek, goede verbindingen met openbaar vervoer,. In het appartement waren wat zaken die aandacht behoeven. Verhuurder zou dit oppakken.
Absolutely loved my stay. Beautiful place with all the amenities I needed. Excellent location. I’d definitely stay there again.
Es war mal wieder toll bei euch. Besonders aufgefallen sind mir dieses mal eure dünnen und super Kuschel warmen Daunen Bettdecken- vielen Dank dafür
Beautiful house.
Communication with Michael went very smoothly. The flat is comfortable and nice to stay in - I particularly enjoyed the morning sun on the wall :)

Schlechtestes Apartment in dem ich war würde ich niemandem weiterempfehlen, vor allem für Raucher überhaupt nicht geeignet.
1. Fernseher hat nicht funktioniert
2. Bett total unbequem
3. man spürt das Gitter durch die Matratze 4. man darf auf dem ganzen Gelände nicht rauchen ( nicht mal vor dem Gebäude)
5. viel zu strenge Security, klopfen an unsere Tür um 18 Uhr und sagen wir sollen Musik leiser machen… gehts noch??!! Es ist nicht mal Nachtruhe!
6. man kann komplett vom Hof in die Apartments gucken
7. viel zu dünne Wände
super leuke airbnb, heel schoon, goede locatie en goede communicatie

I loved staying in Johannes' place. The location is amazing, the room super clean and comfortable, and Johannes was a helpful and friendly dude. Thanks, Johannes - I'll definitely look to stay with you again when I'm Berlin.
Appartement calme et bien situé

Frank‘s Apartment befindet sich in bester Lage mitten im Prenzlauer Berg; eine riesige Auswahl an Restaurants, gemütlichen Cafés und schönen Geschäften. Die Wohnung ist blitzsauber, geschmackvoll eingerichtet und sehr gut ausgestattet! Die Tram ist nur wenige Gehminuten entfernt. Wir haben uns hier sehr wohlgefühlt und können Frank‘s Wohnung nur weiterempfehlen!

Ich habe den Aufenthalt bei Martina sehr genossen. Sie hat mich sehr herzlich empfangen und war bei Fragen sehr kompetent und hilfsbereit.
Die Unterkunft ist komfortabel und gut ausgestattet.
Sollte ich wieder nach Berlin reisen, wäre das meine Wahl.

Philipp is a wonderful and well organised host. The apartment is located in a very quiet neighbourhood, I was very sick while I was in Berlin, the bed was absolutely amazing as I have low tolerance to noise, I had not problem falling asleep quickly after a long day at the Inno Trans exhibition. Phillip is very helpful for local tips and recommended many great places to go and visit, hopefully I will have more time in Berlin next time to explore them all. Definitely recommended!!
Absolutely amazing flat in the best location in Berlin. Great communication. U could not recommend more strongly.
Muchas Gracias Elizabeth por tu flexibilidad con nuestro check in y check out!!

Nook is a hotel chain that provides studios for travelers. This particular one was in a great location in Mitte, Berline. Though it's quite in the thick of things, it's actually on a quiet street. I was able to walk to all the major attractions and also found lots of places close by to either get a bite, coffee, or purchase food.
Though this was in some ways beyond the control of the host, I do want to note that the walls of the studios are paper-thin. There was an unruly family on my floor whose child kept screaming at the top of his lungs out of anger over something. The family also kept slamming doors and cabinetry quite early in the morning. I immediately wrote to Nook, and it turned out that none of their staff were actually on hand to deal with the matter.
With regard to another issue, while it was smoothed out eventually, Nook were slow to respond to my request to book an extra night. This involved a LOT of unnecessary back and forth that really could have just been taken care of with more diligent customer service.
All this said, I really did have a good stay at this facility and can recommend it to others. Just maybe bring earplugs!
Beautiful, spacious apartment near good restaurants and public transit.
Susanne is a great host, she was always available and give us some tips on what to do. Thank you Susanne I had a great time :)
Alles bestens
Lovely place in quiet courtyard with great transport links into town!

The apartment is very spacious, Bright and clean. It's in Mitte, in the center of Berlin, and very quiet at the same time. The apartment has 2 bathrooms and 2 spacious and comfortable bedrooms.
Views from the apartment are beautiful!. Besides, it has a nice terrace, that is impossible to use in November but in Spring time or summer, it must be a must for this apartment.
Highly recommend!
Excelente apoyo y tips por parte de Enrique, recomendado

Every thing was beautiful. location is very close to all public transportation and a lot of restaurants, super markets and even gardens. all attractions is 15 minutes driving or less. Thanks Elisa for welcome drink and your nice hosting.

Great place to stay.
Everything was a described. Me and my friend came to see IFA in Berlin and this place served us well. Located strategically next to the S-Bahn, you can get pretty much everywhere in less than 40 minutes and often times even without changing.
There are many local places around and a kebab shop just around the corner if you arrive late and feel hungry.
Netto grocery store is in the same building, so food is covered, unless you're looking for a wider selection in which case all other major shops are quite far away, so you'd have to take a scooter, bike or bus to get there.
In terms of the rooms/flats - they were cozy and comfortable. Even though the building is located next to the main road, we never had issues with noise. All the appliances and utensils are there, and although the kitchen is small, it's convenient for quick meal prep.
A thing for improvement - a place, where guests could leave non-expiring goods for others, like salt, sugar, pepper, herbs etc. Cause you cannot survive without these basics, but I cannot imagine having to take 0.5kg of sugar back into my country and throwing absolutely good food is unacceptable. Great place to stay, close to public transport, great recommendations from hosts.

This is a great apartment and Annette is a great host.  It is an easy entry, first floor apartment.  There are three floors with two nice, large bedrooms on the top floor, the kitchen is on the main floor and the bathroom on the bottom floor. There was also a huge container of gummies and fresh flowers.  We ate at restaurants and did not use the kitchen for much more than morning beverages.  The beds were very comfortable.  WiFi worked well.  The neighborhood is quiet but full of restaurants and shops within easy walking distance.  The tram stop is very close as well.  Our host, Annette, was very responsive.  We highly recommend this apartment and would love to stay again on our next visit to Berlin!

Der Aufenthalt im Apartment war großartig. Die Wohnung ist schön eingerichtet und gut ausgestattet. Die Kommunikation funktionierte einwandfrei. Und auch um meine liegen gelassenen Dinge wurde sich vorbildlich gekümmert.

The apartment was a perfect place for a short stay! The location was about two miles from the city center, so close enough for an uber, walk, ride a bike or scooter and far enough away from the loudness of a city. The apartment had many places near by to grab a drink or bite to eat and a market. The apartment was clean and adorable, Katrin made sure we had milk and coffee for our mornings which was perfect. She also worked with our arrival time which was important as we were delayed getting in. The place was close to the SBahn, walking distance as well! The apartment had three doors to walk through making us feel very safe and secluded with a cute back garden. Katrin gave great suggestions of local restaurants and cafes to ensure we had a good stay! A great place for your Berlin travels! I recommend renting a bike if you plan to explore the city!
Really good location for the price paid. Good attention at the reception and fast for solutions. Recommended!

Stefan is a great host. We were in touch via airbnb to arrange my arrival, and he was so open to my schedule. When I arrived we talk a little about me and he gave me tips about the city and how to reach it. Every time he saw me, he asked me if I wanted something to drink and asked me how was my day in Berlin. One night he and a friend invited me to have dinner with them, unfortunately I had to refuse it because I had already eaten. The room it is exactly as the picture. It is located 45 min walking to Brandenburg Tor, I did id walking, but there are a lot means of transportation from his house. Also, really close there is a big supermarket, and you can cook in his house. If I have to go to Berlin, I will definitely go to Stefan's house again.
Die Lage des kleinen Hotels ist super und das Zimmer war sehr sauber. Der Check In klappte ohne Probleme. Unser Doppelzimmer war nur etwas zu klein. Für zwei Nächte ging es gerade.
A very clean, conveniently located apartment! The history of the building is interesting, too. Alex is a communicative host and made sure everything was okay.

Perfectly located clean spacious appartment equiped with everything you possibly might need.
We could place our bikes safely in the backyard.

We had a lovely long weekend stay in this flat. The flat was lovely decorated and was so quiet. It was a relief to not have to walk lots of stairs to the apartment, as you can enter right off the street! Benjamin was incredibly responsive and very accommodating during our stay.  Would definitely recommend!

the room has lots of light and is a really lovely place to stay, lots to do in the area and feels very safe to walk around nearby
exactly as is described too! ekkehard was very good at replying to messges/answering questions and his daughter was super helpful when i arrived(:

I recently stayed at a Numa property and overall, it was a pleasant experience. The place is nice and located in a fantastic area, making it easy to explore the city. However, the common space is quite narrow, which might be a bit uncomfortable if you’re planning a longer stay, like a week or more. For shorter visits, though, it’s a good option with a great location.
Friendly host, good location

Wir hatten einen super Aufenthalt im Künstlerloft. Die Unterkunft ist wie beschrieben und ein absolutes Highlight. der Kiez ist fantastisch, zahlreiche Restaurants Cafés und Spielplätze bieten für jeden etwas. Wir können definitiv wieder!

Super séjour chez Arno ! Très bien placée pour visiter Berlin
Je recommande vivement

Un appartement cosy et calme au sein d’un immeuble artistique a 15 min d’Alexanderplatz.

La relación costo-calidad me pareció razonablemente bueno, lo único que recomiendo es mejorar el WiFi la calidad del Internet es muy mala, no sirve para trabajar o realizar transacciones por Internet como realizar pagos y comprar tickets de bus/tren o algo así.

Great location, great spot. The landlords were super helpful in helping me get a lost item back. Great place to stay for a trip in Berlin! There’s an amazing burrito place on Hasenheide too called El Burrito, its next to Cafe Raffine which is also amazing! Check it out!
Had a great stay at a great Airbnb

Kuanita ist eine sehr freundliche und tolle  Gastgeberin. Ihre Wohnung ist einfach perfekt: geräumig, bequem, sehr gut ausgestattet, sehr ruhig und  zentral gelegen. Von da aus kann man unkompliziert und schnell überall hinfahren. Viele Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Böcker, nette Cafés und Restaurants findet man gleich vor der Tür. Absolut empfehlenswert!!

Kitty’s place was perfectly located. Close to cafes, restaurants, organic shops, trams, weekend markets etc. The space was arty, clean and spacious for a studio. Kitty communicated promptly. Highly recommend.
Красивое, уютное жилье в зеленом районе. Квартире чистая, есть все необходимое. Рядом много небольших кафе и баров на любой вкус. Хозяин быстро выходит на связь. В целом рекомендую.
Gute Lage. Apartment ist klein, aber fein. Die Küche ist echt gut ausgestattet!
Great neighborhood, 5 minutes walk to U Bahn, clean and homely apartment
Hallo Torsten, alles hat toll geklappt. Vielen Dank nochmals, Mario

We spent 1 week at Anna’s apartment - perfect for 2 or 4 with 2 huge bedrooms. The apartment is exactly as on the pictures, Anna is very reactive and gives advice when you need.
The location could not be better, 5 minutes walk from nordbanhof buses / subway / tram and very close to some of the best places in former « East Berlin » with plenty of parcs, restaurants, bars and fashion.
Will come again !
롤라팔루자에 참여하기 위해 베를린에 머무르는 동안 이 숙소를 이용했는데 지하철도 가까이 있고 공원도 가까이 있어 좋았음. 공사중이라 아직 경관이 아쉬웠지만 공사가 완료되면 멋질것같음. 호스트와의 의사소통이 긴밀히 이루어져 큰불편없이 지냄. 다음에도 베를린에 갈 기회가 생기면 다시 예약하고자 함

Gillian is very nice and the place is quiet and convenient! We were visiting for a concert in Uber Arena and the apartment is very close to the arena. It is also close to the station. We had a very nice stay at this place.

Top Unterkunft!

Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber hat einwandfrei funktioniert.
Parkplätze sind genügend vorhanden.
Haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder.
Hilda she is a very nice person and helpful i enjoyed stay in her place its nice and clean place

Jose was an absolutely amazing host! He welcomed us to his home and gave us a tour so we knew how everything worked. He had amenities that were above and beyond and you can tell he took pride in his place.
The location was absolutely fantastic! It is right along the Spree River with a view of Molecule Man. Everything is easy to get to; we were close to all the tourist attractions but it was secluded enough to feel like we were at home. If we come back to Berlin, we will absolutely ask Jose to rent his place again.
Super accommodation, very convenient location, very clean and comfortable place . Bright sunlight and cozy atmosphere. Had a great week staying here .
This flat is a perfect location in the city- easy to get to driving or on the tram. It's in a neighborhood with so many cafes, bars, and bakeries. I would recommend this to all visiting Berlin!
Logement très propre. Salle de bain spacieuse est propre. Conforme à la description. Cependant on entend un peu le traffic de la nuit des véhicules qui passent dans la rue.

Sehr angenehm besser als erwartet.

Oli's place was clean and just as pictured. He goes out of his way to provide helpful information and orient you to the city. Around 20 to 30 mins on the ubahn to the contemporary art museums and galleries.
Ich war rundum zufrieden, vielen Dank!
Our stay was very pleasant, without any issues. The place is clean, we found it quickly and the check in and check out was quick and convenient.
Very nice room with a view on the beautiful foliage / forest. very pleasant stay - would absolutely book again. Thanks again Andrea!
Wir waren mit dem Appartement sehr zufrieden. Super zentral, sauber, gute Ausstattung, sehr gemütlich. Kann ich sehr empfehlen. Kommen gerne wieder!
Die Lage ist super für ein paar Tage Berlin. Zimmer und Bad waren sauber, die eingebaute Küche ausreichend bestückt. Eine Frage zur Kochplatte wurde sofort beantwortet.

Es war sehr angenehm bei Birte. Die Kommunikation war unkompliziert und das Zimmer war schön eingerichtet. Das einzige zu verbessern, ist die Dusche. Es war immer nötig das Bad zu trocknen, da das Wasser aufgrund der Position der Dusche gespritzt hat.

A fantastic experience to stay in this great location! The apartment is well equipped and planned for two persons. Due to the warm weather we (a friend and myself) enjoyed the pleasant balcony a lot. But despite the fact of temperatures above 30 degrees Celsius the apartment didn’t heat up uncomfortably since it is on the first floor and is impacted by the warming sun first in the early evening.
Moreover we loved Prenzlauer Berg as a homebase for the weekend: The calm but still exciting atmosphere and plenty of nice cafés, restaurants and bars.
Finally, Marcus was a great host with strong service level, always only one WhattsApp away to help.
We strongly recommend to stay here!

This is a pleasant, spacious and clean apartment. It's also very quiet. The location is brilliant, close to everything you could need and fabulous cafes and restaurants. We were traveling with small children and it was perfect for us but would be equally great for people without kids just wanting to soak up the local atmosphere.

Mia ist eine wundervolle und herzliche Gastgeberin. Der Austausch mit ihr war sehr inspirierend. Ich habe mich während meines Aufenthalts bei ihr und ihrer indischen Mitbewohnerin sehr wohl gefühlt.
Das Ambiente ihrer Wohnung hat mir sehr gut gefallen. Das Zimmer ist gemütlich und liegt ruhig zum Innenhof.
Mia hat mir tolle Tipps gegeben für sehenswerte Orte und Aktivitäten in der Stadt.
Wir waren 4 Tage in Berlin und haben uns bei Anca direkt wohlgefühlt. Die Wohnung war sehr zentral gelegen und man konnte vieles zu Fuß erreichen. Gerne immer wieder 😊
Uns hat es sehr gut gefallen. Die Wohnung ist super, das Auto steht sicher auf dem Hof, zweimal hinfallen bis zur Straßenbahn - Astrein!

シャワールームのみ少し清潔とは言い難い部分もありましたが、他はおしゃれで居心地良く文句なしです。

Tal y como se ve en las fotos, un departamento pequeño, bien equipado, en una buena zona. La decoración es hermosa, hay transporte público cerca de la zona y David fue muy amable y rápido para responder las preguntas que teníamos. Lo recomendaría y volvería a quedarme aquí ;)

Maria's place is spacious, tidy, and quiet. Her instructions for everything are very clear. The location was close to the Orienenburger Tor train station and the Friedrichstrasse Banhoff, and walking distance to many of Berlin's fine cultural offerings. Definitely a good launching point if you want to get around Berlin.

Wir hatten einen sehr angenehmen und unkomplizierten Aufenthalt bei Björn. Die Wohnung befindet sich in einer schönen Lage und ist gut angebunden. Very nice stay at Katja! The flat is perfect, very bright and in a super nice area!  Katja is very friendly and accommodating.  I recommend
Sehr schöne Wohnung in toller Umgebung :) Wir haben viele tolle Tipps für unsere Freizeitgestaltung bekommen und waren im Großen und Ganzen sehr zufrieden!

The apartment has a very good location: it is on a quiet street, u-bahn and bus stations are in 5 minutes, Tiergarten is also near. Room is very clean and has everything for comfort staying. Stefan is very friendly, responsible and welcoming host. I highly recommend to stay here

Die Wohnung hat unseren Erwartungen entsprochen. Check in and out war easy.  Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Berlin Aufenthalt. Kleine Anregung für die Gastgeber: es fehlte an nichts - bis auf ein paar Weingläser 😉

The room is minuscule and ok for one person.  The bed’s ok.  The noise from banging doors is loud till late.  Put a white noise app on your phone plus bring ear plugs.  The fridge cycles on and off all night.  It’ll wake you up unless you are a very heavy sleeper.   The metro is close.  The restaurant choice is ok.  The place is clean.

There were a few problems with hot water, but the hosts were on the issue quickly.
Great location. Loved the plants.

My stay in Berlin was very pleasant and very enjoyable, also thanks to the warm welcome from Birgit, a very friendly, spontaneous, relaxed and helpful hostess, in her beautiful, cozy and quiet apartment.
The location of Birgit's apartment is also ideal and practical, namely in the lively, vibrant and multicultural Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg District Berlin, unique and characteristic!
Birgit's apartment is also a stone's throw from excellent public transport such as the U-Bahn that takes you anywhere you want in Berlin and around the corner is a typical cozy beer garden, where everything and everyone comes together and meets.

Once again Birgit, thank you very much for your wonderful and easy going welcome, see you next time that's for sure! Diana

Just amazing and quiet place to rest. we were in Uğur's place just one night but it was enough for rest and reload battery to continue. Very nice guy.

Great, clean place. The check in instructions were very clear. Comfortable beds. Very spacious. Only negative was the shower was slow to drain so water got everywhere.

Sonst immer bei Freunden in Berlin übernachtet, dieses Mal zum ersten Mal "auswärts". Sehr zufrieden. Die Wahl fiel auf Grund der Nähe zur Waldbühne, ohne allzu weit von der Innenstadt entfernt zu sein. Gerne wieder :)

I had a fantastic stay at Frank's place in Friedrichshain! The apartment was cozy and well located and had everything I needed as a single traveler, making my stay easy. I would say the biggest highlights are:

2) The location - the apartment's location in the center of the Friedrichshain means that I was never more than 5 minutes walk from bars, restaurants, and grocery stores, and only 7 minutes walk from one of the major U-Bahn (underground) stations.
Overall, very solid choice for someone (or a couple) looking to visit east Berlin and wanting convenient access to a prime neighborhood.

It is a lovely, very spacey and light appartement on the fift Floor of a charming house. Quiet area at night, and lovely views over the city from the window. Very charming balcony with plants and coloured lampbulbs too. Very cosy place!

Top Hotel für den Preis. Gute Anbindung. Hat alles, was man braucht, wenn man viel in der Stadt unterwegs ist und nur übernachten möchte.

Das Studio von Tina ist großzügig eingerichtet, die kleine Küche lässt keine Wünsche offen. Einladend und hell begrüßte mich das geräumige Altstadtzimmer mit Blick in die Bäume draußen und einer tollen großen Zimmerpflanze (Glücksfeder). Das Bett ist sehr bequem und gut ausgestattet. Es ließ sich dort wunderbar schlafen. Die Nähe zu den „Öffentlichen“ unterstreicht die ohnehin zentrale Lage. Alles ist gut zu erreichen. Ich kann die Bleibe von Tina uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.

We had an excellent experience during our stay at this accommodation in Berlin. The communication with the host was exemplary—prompt, clear, and professional, ensuring a seamless check-in and overall stay.
The location is superb, situated right in the heart of the city, making it incredibly convenient to explore Berlin’s key attractions and amenities.
The apartment itself exceeded our expectations in terms of cleanliness, with every detail attended to immaculately. The size of the accommodation is perfect, offering ample space for a comfortable stay. Furthermore, the facilities and amenities provided are outstanding, covering everything one could need for a short or long stay.
If there is one minor improvement to suggest, it would be the addition of blackout curtains to enhance the comfort for light-sensitive guests. Additionally, it would be helpful if the lightbulbs in the kitchen were replaced to ensure optimal lighting.
Overall recomended and we would gladly return in future!
Great space for group travellers. Affordable and with easy access to the Berlin public transmit, it was well worth the stay.

Mein Aufenthalt war wirklich schön. Das Apartment war sauber und die kleine Küche war so schön. Der Chat mit dem Gästeservice war super einfach und praktisch. Daher empfehle ich diesen Gastgeber zu 100 %.

Wolfgang was a very welcoming and relaxed host. We felt very comfortable in his home it was very spacious and airy with a lots of light. The apartment is in a great local surrounded by shops, cafes and restaurants. The station is right across the street and easy to get to from Tegel airport.

This flat is in the best neighborhood in Berlin, located right above a cute bar. We were able to walk or take the U bahn anywhere we wanted to go from here. The space is huge and beautiful. We really loved ending our days by sitting on the little patio and playing cards while watching the street come alive. It’s a little noisy at night but if you have a set of earplugs for light sleepers you’ll be just fine.

Great apartment on the second floor, private side entrance, small kitchen with everything you need if you wish to cook something and Edeka is only 300m away😊 Peacefull location but good connection to city centre, 15min walk to S bahn station Kopenick or you can ride 2 tram stops to the station.
Very clear and easy instructions for self check in. Definitely recommended
Hat alles sehr gut geklappt, das Zimmer war sehr sauber und die Lage perfekt!!

A good value option near the centre (but not actually Alexanderplatz). Room in an iconic block on the boulevard - great if you like a cat in the house (which we do…). Comfy beds and an excellent Vietnamese restaurant nearby and a Book cafe for brunch!

This is a professionally but very nicely run house, in a classic building at Mitte. It is fully-equipped, well-decorated and located at the heart of the city. There are nice cafes/bakeries, restaurants and bars just around the corner, and it is walking distance to beautiful streets of Mitte. The host has always been very responsive and helpful. It is definitely a good value for money and I highly recommend staying at this place.

Excellent choice! Room is exactly as pictured, its spacious, nicely decorated with everything you may need. This is such a nice apartment in a very nice, quiet and green spot! There are busses and metro nearby and it’s just great to stay here!
Spacious, airey, bright apartment in good and peaceful location. Delightful balcony.

Good apartment, clean, well furnished, TV, wifi. Kitchen would be perfect if had a microwave.

As summary, Very good!

The location is a little far away from the action but we rented bikes which we were able to store securely in the yard which was super helpful. Très bon accueil,  charmant quartier,  métro proche

We stayed here 4 days and really enjoyed it. It was nicely decorated and had everything we needed.  The apartment was easy to find and close to many restaurants and little shops. Would definitely stay here again.

This is a stunningly beautiful apartment and Natalie has been the perfect Airbnb host, going beyond to make our stay wonderful. The apartment is perfect, has everything you could need and more. We have fallen in love with Berlin and will definitely return! Thank you Natalie! Yvonne and family x
An extremely comfortable, well-appointed studio. Really recommend Stefan’s place

helaas kraakt overal de vloer,dat is erg irritant. De bedbank is vooral voor mensen onder de 1.80 m anders is het echt te klein.

Mooi groot, fijn en stijlvol appartement. We waren met 8 volwassenen en 1 kind. Babybedje stond klaar. 2 keukens en 2 badkamers, incl wasmachines. Netjes en schoon.

Thor was very welcoming and the house itself is exactly how it was advertised. The bathroom is a separate one and it has all the necessities you need, towels included. Even before coming over, Thor had already prepared a list of places to check out near the house. My flight ETA was really late at night and I initially planned to stay at the airport until day breaks and head over to his place, but he asked me to head over directly instead of waiting for the following day which was supposed to be my check in day. What a nice guy! And me being Muslim, he was very hospitable and took the effort to find halal food to stock up in the fridge, as well as showing me halal places around the neighbourhood. The neighbourhood is a safe one with the house just next to a kindergarten. It's located near U Bahn Mehringdamm with the famous Mustafa's Gemuse Kebap (which I sadly never got to try as the queue was crazyyy longgg. That's how popular it is!!) nearby. Thor doesn't mind you using his kitchen and it's cool that he also sometimes cooks and invites you to eat with him. He's a great cook by the way, and you should really try the meals that he cooks with offals. Really good experience overall.

L’appartement de Werner est extrêmement bien situé, le quartier est très agréable. Les chambres sont spacieuses, bien équipées, les lits confortables, l’ensemble du logement très agréable. Il est bien adapté pour 3 couples, ce qui était notre cas. Nous retournerons avec plaisir dans cet appartement si nous revenons à Berlin.
Super emplacement ! Jan hyper reactif.
Perfekte Lage im schönen Friedrichshain, herzlichstes Personal, minimalistisch-chic, alles vorhanden!! Kommen gerne wieder :)))
Parwana is a great host. Very proactive, she regularly checked on us and made sure we did‘nt have any issues. Would definitely stay with her again.

Ich hatte eine wunderbare Zeit in diesem schönen, loftartigen Space, mitten in meiner alten Hood, dem schönsten Teil vom Prenzlauer Berg. Es fühlte sich an wie ein kleines Zurückkommen nach Hause.
Die Umgebung ist wirklich ein Traum. Es gibt unzählige Restaurants, Bars, Cafés, Vintage Stores und eine sehr gute Anbindung. Alles ist fußläufig erreichbar.
Das Studio ist wirklich besonders: hochwertige Möbel, ein stimmiges Farbkonzept und echte Kunst an den Wänden. Als Künstler bedeutet mir das viel. Überlege sogar eines der Werke zu erwerben.
Der eigene Eingang hat mir sehr gefallen. Obwohl es im Erdgeschoss liegt, habe ich mich jederzeit wohl und sicher gefühlt. Alles entsprach genau den Bildern. Sehr ästhetisch.
Vielen Dank an Katharina für die schnelle und herzliche Kommunikation. Der Self-Check-in lief absolut problemlos.
Ich freue mich schon auf meinen nächsten Aufenthalt. Ab jetzt definitiv mein Go-To in Berlin. :)
Le logement est fidèle à la description. L'espace est charmant et agréable. Par contre, il y faisait particulièrement froid.
Nice place, very clean
Super Wohnung in guter Lage. Sehr freundlicher Empfang und tolle Hilfe bei Parkplatzsuche. Gerne wieder.

Hanna is vriendelijk, proactief en bij vragen reageert ze snel. Dit was erg prettig! De accomodatie was bij aankomst uitermate schoon en netjes, huiselijk aangekleed en van alle gemakken voorzien. Het is gelegen in een gezellige, levendige maar ook wat rustigere omgeving net buiten de stad. Er liggen verschillende gezellige en heerlijke restaurants en ontbijt,- en lunchtentjes in de omliggende straatjes. Op zaterdag was er een sfeervolle markt op loopafstand waar we een ochtend op hebben gespendeerd.  We hebben enorm genoten in ons verblijf en zullen, wanneer we nog een keer terug naar Berlijn komen, zeker weer bij Hanna boeken!!
Der Kontakt war sehr nett und die Wohnung hat die Erwartungen übertroffen. Es war blitzsauber und gut zu erreichen!

Es war wie ein Nach-Hause-Kommen. Alles war liebevoll vorbereitet, bestens beschrieben und sofort zugänglich. Das große Bett war herrlich bequem, und alle wichtigen Informationen – wie der WLAN-Code – waren leicht zu finden. Der gemütliche Schreibtisch lud direkt zum Arbeiten ein, und auch in der Küche entstanden schöne, entspannte Begegnungen. Bei Laura ist alles außergewöhnlich sauber und gepflegt. Wir haben uns auf Anhieb gut verstanden und tolle Gespräche geführt. Ein Ort zum Wohlfühlen – ich komme gerne wieder.
Amazing sparkling clean beautiful place! Location is awesome, Stephan is very friendly. Definitely best value for money, recommend 10/10.

Hay dos supermercados muy cerca, y el centro de Berlín está también a unos 10-15 minutos andando, aunque se puede coger transporte público

Kitty is a great host and the apartment was very clean, spacious and very stylish. We loved the art everywhere!

Die Kommunikation mit Anna war sehr freundlich, der Check-In lief trotz ziemlicher Verspätung unsererseits super. Die Wohnung ist schön und direkt an der S-Bahn gelegen, so kommt man schnell überall hin!

Bellissima esperienza di alloggio a Berlino,   in compagnia di un gattone simpaticissimo. Ripeterò sicuramente l'esperienza nel mio prossimo viaggio a Berlino. Un caro saluto a Olga da parte di Marina e Tamara
Nette gut zu erreichende Gastgeber, ruhige Lage und gute Anbindung, familienfreundlich. Ideal für unseren Wochenendtrip. Gerne wieder!

Great location for access to local transit to get around Berlin, and near to two supermarkets, and a kebab place. The place was clean, and as advertised. I enjoyed my time in Berlin staying here.
