This is a great apartment for small groups of friends as a base for exploring the city. The location cannot be beaten, in the heart of the very cool district of Kreuzberg with great food and drink outlets on your doorstep. And yet, because of the courtyard, we noticed no noise from the streets outside. The apartment is well equipped with everything you need, and comes with all the basics that are sometimes missing from other airbnb apartments (i.e. soap, toilet paper, washing up liquid and utensils, etc.). It's also very stylish with a very comfortable sofa! We really enjoyed our stay there and would certainly recommend it to other groups.

Extremely comfortable and well organised studio apartment. Very comfortable bed. Nice kitchen corner very well equipped (two hot plates, microwave, toaster, Nespresso machine, fridge, dishwasher) with everything needed to make breakfast and simple meals. Fabulous spacious and luxurious bathroom with fantastic shower. First time for me to encounter the ingenious high tech system for quickly and easily making one's own key card on arrival. Large back yard with gate access operated by my key card providing secure, covered storage of my little folding Brompton bike. Looking forward to staying again in the future.

My family and I stayed in Ellen’s apartment for 2 nights. It could’ve used some more cleaning especially in the kitchen. The kitchen cabinets were quite disorganized and most of the silverware had dried on food. The  washing machine was definitely a plus. The location is a little outside of the city, but it’s easy to take public transportation to wherever you need to go.

Das Zimmer im Hostel war sehr Sauber und morgens wurden sogar die Mülleimer und der Duschvorleger gewechselt. Das Frühstück hat ein super Preis-Leistungsverhältnis! Lage sehr zentral mit nur einer S-Bahn Station Entfernung zum Ostbahnhof.

Pluspunkte: Die Lage der Wohnung in einem Innenhof ist wirklich super und vor allem sehr sehr ruhig. Schöneberg, Zoo etc., Museen, U-Bahnen alles gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Wie bereits von anderen Mietern geschrieben, sollte man sich gut kennen, wenn man mit mehreren Leuten dort übernachtet, da die Wohnung sehr offen gehalten ist, auch was die Schlafzimmer angeht.
Minuspunkte: Was wir (4 Personen) als nicht so gut empfunden haben ist, dass die Bäder aufgrund mangelnder Belüfungsmöglichkeiten ziemlich muffig riechen, die Matratzen/Schlafsofa mal erneuert werden könnten, Bleche im Backofen oder auch Pfannen nicht richtig gereinigt sind und viel zurückgelassene Nahrungsmittel (Müsli, Reis, Salz etc) im Küchenschrank stehen, die einfach mal entsogt werden könnten .... für über 1300 Euro für 6 Nächte könnte man das schon erwarten.

I would highly recommend Katjas apartment if you’re visiting Berlin. The apartment is very high quality and was clean and cosy. Katja was a great host and we look forward to staying in her place again when we next visit.
We loved the sparkling water addition!
amazing. super nice and apartment in beautiful location!

Thomas's Berlin loft is perfect. It's in a great location in the center of town yet quite and peaceful. It's very spacious, airy, clean, beautiful and well appointed.  We enjoyed our stay very much and if we return to Berlin hope to stay there again.

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in Werners Apartment und können es wärmsten für einen Trip nach Berlin empfehlen 😊 Zimmer waren sehr groß, das W-LAN hat gut funktioniert und es war alles sehr sauber 👍🏼
Alles was top. Fijne bedden, goede communicatie.

Great place, great location, very cute dog.

We enjoyed our stay in Berlin.  Ashley and Niklas were so kind.

Fab little studio which was perfect for our stay. Close to both the ubahn and sbahn, and near to local amenities. The key safe for check in was a great idea and made it a smooth handover (didnt have to worry about flight delays etc). It was absolutely spotless - v clean! Stylish with everything you could need for a city break. We cooked a couple of bits and bobs with plenty of ease. Only things to note are that the water pressure was terrible as its top floor, leaving us unable to have a proper shower at certain times. Also two of the blackout blinds seemed to be broken making it very light in the mornings. The owner lives through a connecting door and can get in and out which we weren’t aware of: not particularly an issue but just FYI for those preferring to be a bit more isolated. Overall would definitely recommend and had a lovely time - thanks!

Nice, clean and cosy studio at a great location. With a 10 minute walk to Alexanderplatz and a supermarket and some great coffee places around the corner, the apartment is at a great location.

Habe mich wie zuhause gefühlt! Tolle Wohnung, sehr gemütliche Matratze und gute Anbindung an die Öffis.

PLEASE BE CAREFUL It was very dusty and dirty. There was dust all over the room, on the counters and even on the shelves. If we placed something down in a matter of hours it would be ridden with dust. There was also no mop to clean the toilet with which wasn’t good. The bathroom door also doesn’t close and drags along the floor. The floor was also extremely dirty, anytime id wear socks it would get dirty almost immediately. They charge a cleaning fee but it seems as though they don’t get the room cleaned. The dust laying on the shelves looked like it had been there for weeks if not months, there was also clumps of dust under the beds and the windows had black dirt on them whenever they were touched.The walls are quite thin so you can hear anything happening outside or people in the front of the apartments talking if they’re coming home late as it’s on the ground floor. Great!

There was one fan that had limited functions and there were two windows. One window couldn’t open all the way and there were no screens to keep insects out. There were also no curtains which would have helped with the heat, light exposure for sleeping, and would have provided at least some amount of privacy. If you do not want to expose yourself to the neighborhood while dressing you have to change in the small bathroom. The stay wasn’t very comfortable for those reasons, but the area was active and packed with restaurants and everything was walkable. The check-in/out process was smooth, the hotel was quiet, and there was an elevator (saved us). If needing the basics and don’t care much about comfort this is decent.

I would recommend Birgit's home for a short stay in Berlin. Birgit and her daughter are very friendly and met me with thoughtful gifts upon check-in. It is a very beautiful designer apartment and would make an excellent tourist visit and is in a gorgeous area.
Please be aware that - at the time of writing - some of the pictures are not accurate as the decor has changed (including the children's room which is now a teenager's room and changed balcony). I think they are great changes but wanted to point out in case you're particularly attached to something. I also would have like to have known that the shower is hand-held, that the kitchen table is no longer there (I intended to use for work), and there are no bedroom curtains or blinds.
I ended my stay early and was refunded the remainder by AirBnB. While I would definitely recommend it for short, tourist visits - I would not recommend it for longer periods or for work trips. There is no comfortable desk space (the picnic type table from the photos is no longer there, the other tables are curved so not good for typing), the beds are not very comfortable, there are no shades or curtains in the bedrooms, and the owner initially wanted to come into the apartment to water plants and had planned to come back and forth to pick up things for her and her daughter. If you need privacy for work or need to isolate after travel, this is not ideal. The owner did agree to let me water the plants but my stay was cut short by the host's illness and my discomfort with the uncertainty around access to the apartment.
Additionally, this is the only apartment in Berlin that I have seen in over two years of work trips here that does not offer discounts for monthly rentals and, upon reflection, the price is definitely not worth it for a long stay. I initially considered staying longer to avoid the hassle of moving, but with the potential privacy issues and the cost versus the working situation, I relocated to a much more suitable apartment for a fraction of this price and am thankful to AirBnB for their assistance throughout my stay.
In sum: if you're going for a tourist, short trip and are looking for a magical instagram worthy spot, go for it! If you need a work space and a longer stay, I'd recommend somewhere else.

And almost completely quiet - a big plus in a large city as Berlin. The city area around the apartment is so charming and living, and there are cafés, bars and restaurants literally everywhere!
We walked a lot around in Berlin during our holiday, and we did not find a area as charming as this. With our start 50-years, we were mostly the oldest people on the street. The apartment and its surroundings can therefore be even more recommended if you are younger :-)

Very nice to stay for a few days
Like one or two
Everything you need for that price

Alles war so wie beschrieben. Die Lage ist super und es war auch alles sauber. Die Ruhe in der Nacht war herrlich, das hatte ich nicht ivon einer Großstadt erwartet. Vielen Dank   Wir hatten eine super Zeit.

A cozy flat in a nice neighbourhood. The old airfield is ideal for morning runs, there are several grocery shops and U/S banh very close to the flat. The flat is also very warm and has quite thick duvets so should be good for the everyone who loves to sleep warm. We also found 3 coffee makers(French press, filter, and table coffee makers) which was nice:)
Stylish, genuine loft apartment in a great location - very central but located at the back of the building so super quiet.

Logement très propre et fonctionnel. Celui-ci est localisé dans un quartier agréable et idéalement situé pour visiter Berlin (à proximité des stations de métro et de tramway). Werner est un hôte réactif et très organisé. Les informations et les précisions qu’il nous a communiqué avant notre voyage nous a permis de préparer sereinement notre arrivée et notre séjour à Berlin. Logement à recommander sans hésitation.
Perfect location in Berlin. Felt like I was living like a locale! Amazing restaurants, parks, and art as you step outside

Was een super fijn verblijf.
Mooie plek en goed appartement 🫶🏻
Everything was great!
We enjoyed our hotelroom .

Sven's flat is a great place from where you can discover all of Berlin. It is located really good, next to the U-Bahn and just between Mitte & Kreuzberg. A lot of touristic attractions are in walking distance. The flat itself is spacious, modern, cosy and well-equiped. During the weekends, the neighbourhood is somewhat noisy, but the weeknights are very quiet and calm. The construction work nearby doesn't hinder at all. The communication with Sven and his colleagues is impeccable! They are very friendly and always ready to answer and help wherever they can. Recommended!
Very nice apartment for a short stay in Berlin.
Amazing apartment and host! Definitely recommended! ☺️

Alex was very helpful, responding quickly and supplying us with everything we needed. The flat is close to the station and the centre. It was very cosy and clean, we enjoyed our time there a lot. The sink in the bathroom is so small that it’s hard to be used at all, but it was easy to use the kitchen sink instead.
The beds are comfortable as well!

Sehr helle und sehr saubere Unterkunft mit tollem Blick ins Grüne. Ideal für Honey Moon Paare.  Sehr zentral gelegen,  Restaurants und Supermarkt um die Ecke,  U-Bahn und Call-a-Bike Station direkt um die Ecke.   Kann man wirklich empfehlen.

Location is the best ever. If you are sensitive to upstairs neighbors noise - there's some. It's not horrible but it is there and more prevalent in the back bedroom.
Apartment is very large. Super spacious. Really inspiring having the canal literally as your front yard.
Super safe and comfortable area. Highly recommend!
They were wonderful hosts & the space was perfect!

This is one of the nicest places we have ever stayed through Airbnb. Everything was perfect and as described. We couldn't have asked for more. Adrian was super accommodating and checked up several times with us to make sure everything was ok. We can only recommend him and his apartment!
We received a very warm welcome and very clean room! Thank you so much:)!

Super clean and filled with natural light, the apartment is a cheery place to stay. It’s close to metro and great restaurants- all within a block or two walking distance through a lovely neighborhood. Because it’s not in a tourist area at all, the best thing to me about the location was that I felt like a local and not a tourist- and got a chance to speak German - or at least try to speak German along with charades to communicate.  It was an awesome time in Berlin and the apartment really made it special. Thanks Birgit! I highly recommend!

Slim and Kean are wonderful hosts. Always available for anything, and specially very helpful with whatever  we needed along our stay, even if they had to do any research on a special requirement.  Very lovely guys. The apartment is very well located, in a peaceful residential area but full of restaurants around the block, a small grocery right in front of it, a comercial area a few blocks away, and three blocks from the nearest station. Every morning they had coffee and some delicious croissants, which made our stay more enjoyable. We recomend staying with them because their tips made our visit in Berlín more interesting since they know special things about the citie’s history and its cultural movement
We enjoyed our staying at Moritz’s place, it was as he described, close to the historical sites

The apartment was in a fantastic location less than a five minute walk from the nearest subway station. The room was clean, spacious and good value for money. Staff were helpful and friendly. No complaints!

Great space and Louis got back to us asap and checked in on us regularly. They provided a phone with a European data/call plan loaded with Netflix if you needed it and instructions on how to use the washer and dryer combo which is great for those unfamiliar with Europe. Flat is in a great central location and there were no issues getting to Brandenburg Gate, Parliament, etc... Baby cot was provided and had an upgraded mattress which my son slept great in. Easy access to the apartment and was already heated when we entered which is a plus if you are visiting in the winter.
The apartment was perfect for my weekend stay. Central location, clean and great communication from Ivos!
I had a great stay there, the location was perfect and Thiago was really friendly! A slight negative is that the doors aren't very soundproof, but besides that it was a very smooth stay.

This was a perfect airbnb in the best location. You’re surrounded by coffee shops, bakeries and restaurants. The U Bahn is about a 10 minute walk and it can get you everywhere. It was a great place to unwind after along day of strolling through Berlin.
gute Unterkunft

Ein schönes, ruhiges Apartment in Prenzlauer Berg. Alles was man braucht ist da oder befindet sich in direkter Umgebung. S-Bahn-Station nur 5 Minuten Fußweg entfernt. Schlüsselübergabe lief problemlos ab, Alan hat uns noch viele nützliche Tipps und Empfehlungen für die Zeit in Berlin mitgegeben. Alles in allem würde ich das Apartment uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.

Nous avons séjourné 5 jours à 2 couples sans problèmes. Très bien placé pour les visites et les transports.
Super accueil. Encore merci.

The flat is very spacious and elegant. Really well equipped, comfortable beds, good WiFi, computer,etc. Close to U-S Bahn stations and bars, restaurants, etc. Area seems mainly occupied by young families. Louis was a great host with good communication. Thoroughly recommend.
Sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt, ich habe mich wohlgefühlt. Das Bett war sensationell, und den Cappuccino aus dem Hotel-Café kann ich auch sehr empfehlen.
Veel te veel geld voor voorzieningen en verblijf.
Birgit was such a lovely soul and hostess! Would definitely return to her cozy space :) Thank you! I will nail the pronunciation of your name next go round, for sure!

It was really a pleasure staying in Andrea's apartment! Really comfortable & cosy, great location not only with easy access from the airport but also a 3 minute walk from the train station and a 10-15 minute ride to the city center! Although we didn't get to meet Andrea, he was always at reach and our late check in was no problem at all. Even we stayed only for two days in Berlin and Andrea's apartment , we would love to stay there again in our next visit! Totally recommend it guys!
Beste große Wohnung für den Preis. Wir mussten kurzfristig für eine Nacht mehrere Gäste unterbringen und das hat super funktioniert trotz sehr später Buchung.

L'appartement est très bien situé d'un point de vu des transports en communs. Maik à été flexible sur notre heure d'arrivée malgré le retard de notre avion. Par contre nous avions pris se logement car nous avions négocié de pouvoir laisser le bagages le dernier jour mais à notre surprise cela n'était plus possible. Il a donc pu nous proposer de les laisser dans le bar d'à côté.

Judith excels at communication. She provides helpful tips for Berlin. The location is safe and convenient. The Hansa Center nearby offers a lot for good prices. I recommend Judith's place. The kitchen at the top is one of a kind -- pretty cool. Way to go, Judith.

Gorgeous apartment in a fabulous location!  We had a great stay.  However, for the price, the place could have been cleaner when we arrived (crumbs on the table and floor from previous guests), and we had trouble getting the key at first.  But once we got in, we loved it.
Gut zu finden, super Beschreibung, super sauber, gut ausgestattet, gute Lage, praktisch mit Kindern! Danke!

We enjoyed our stay here. The place felt spacious & clean with a very good location. Martin was a very responsive host who personally greeted us and made us feel comfortable. It might lack a few ‘lived in’ touches but that’s personal preference. Would definitely recommend.

Logement à proximité de plein de lieux à visiter à pied et en transport (U et S a proximité), beaucoup de restaurants, supermarché à 3min.
Situé dans une rue peu passante. Cependant, il y a eu des travaux tout au long de notre séjour et l'isolation des fenêtres n'est pas idéal en cas de travaux. Nous avons été réveillés à 7h tous les matins a cause du bruit, dommage pour des vacances où on espère se reposer.

Wir waren über das Wochenende für ein Seminar in Berlin. Marvin hat ein schönes, ruhiges und sehr sauberes Appartement in einem frisch renovierten Altbau. Wir waren sehr zufrieden. Marvin bzw. sein Bruder sind super nett und das Ein- und Auschecken war unkompliziert.

Das Ferienhaus ist sehr gut ausgestattet, sauber und absolut ruhig, Einkaufmöglichkeiten in nicht mehr als 10 min. zu Fuß, S-Bahn zu Fuß in 5 min. erreichbar. Auch abends kann man bis nach 24 Uhr mit S-Bahn zurückkommen. Große überdachte Terrasse. Betreuung ist unkompliziert und zuverlässig. Die
Gastgeber sind sehr nett und entgegenkommend.

We absolutely loved Babett’s place. It is stunning and so peaceful considering it is near a busy road. It was a great apartment to put your feet up at then end of the day and relax around the big dining table.
We would not hesitate to book this again and highly recommend.
Great location and spacious. We were 3 guys and this place was perfect. 5 minute walk to the train and so many cool spots within walking distance. Definitely recommend if you are more than 2 people.
Superbe appartement dans un quartier génial. Simple, efficace et communication optimale.
Matthias & Michelle are truly super-hosts. This was our second stay with them at this convenient and central apartment. We are looking forward to returning again next year. Highly recommended!

Friendly and attentive staff.  It is an aparthotel with a very spacious layout with a central location (close to local public transport and Christmas markets).  The apartment was clean and accessible.

Appartement très bien placé au pied du metro, avec la possibilité de faire beauxoup de choses à pied aussi. Très propre et fonctionnel. Sofia a été très réactive et nous a bien aidé. Nous recommandons très vivement ce logement.
Good place to lodge
Kevin war sehr freundlich und die Wohnung war liebevoll eingerichtet und sauber. man hat sich sofort wohl gefühlt. Gerne wieder :)
Nice big space, well located
Sehr schöne Wohnung und sehr nette Vermieter. Perfekt zum wohlfühlen

The room with view to the top of trees, very calm court, extra entrance to the room and very friendly attitude of Ivo with his family. All perfect :-). The apartment is in very nice part of Berlin and you can get the city center in few minutes. Thank you!
The place was as described
Toller Wochenendtrip mit schöner Unterkunft! Dusan hat uns lieb empfangen und war auch schnell bei Fragen zu erreichen. Zu sechst hatten wir genügend Platz.

We had a great stay at Numa. Very good communication and instructions from the host and super easy check in/out. They were very responsive to our requests and the location is great. Totally recommend it for people visiting Berlin.
Sehr zu empfehlen! S und U Bahn fussläufig zu erreichen, tolle Wohnung, sehr sauber!

We (three people) stayed for almost a week at Cornelius's apartment and loved our visit. The apartment looked as described and was easy to find. We especially appreciated that it is situated on a calmer, quiet street with many excellent restaurants, cafées and bars nearby. Also, there's an excellent supermarket, tram, and U-Bahn. Cornelius was very welcoming, and we especially appreciated the local tips; we got to experience several things we otherwise would have missed out on!

Fadeih's house is clean and cozy. The interior is unique and we could feel the taste of the host. All the equipments are very convenient, and placed exactly where I expected. The house is quiet around. There are several restaurants, bars and shops for looking around. Check-in process was seamless and convenient. Fadeih always answered quickly and it was very helpful. The house is on ground floor and located in the inner parts of the whole building, so it's not bright during daytime. I had a good stay there and strongly recommend Fadeih's house!
Great place for small groups to stay at.
Very nice apartment. Very clean. Well presented.

We had a great experience with Andreas, starting with him very kindly picking us up from the underground station. Andreas had plenty of tips about Berlin for us, and was generally very helpful with excellent communication. The apartment is large with everything you need, and has a lovely balcony that looks out over green trees. It was clean and the kitchen was well stocked with cooking equipment. The neighbourhood and building was nice and quiet, and was perfect for us.

Elisa is an amazing and friendly host.
Great location and amazing place to stay. Everything you need for a great citytrip!
appartement excellent, très bien équipé, beau et propres, nous avons passé un super séjour dans ce logement, je recommande fortement
Hanna had a lovely apartment and it was close to cool areas. The apartment had a lovely Berlin wibe. Plus for the fascinating books on display!

Great place to stay! Also very friendly host. All perfect, just the room is somewhat small and the bed is soft and small for 2P. Combined with the shared blanket it were not our best nights 😄 all in all we would recommend this place 👍👍

Hat alles reibungslos funktioniert.
Absprachen wurden eingehalten und kamen mir zugute. Blitzsauberes Zimmer und moderne Einrichtung. Habe mich direkt wie Zuhause gefühlt.
Ich würde jederzeit wieder beim Hotel AVAlex buchen.

Bardzo wygodne i zadbane mieszkanie w dobrej okolicy. Stacja metra tuż obok. Wokół także bardzo przyjemne tereny spacerowe, jedynie pół godzimy do dawnego lotniska Tempelhof, które jest obecnie terenem rekreacyjnym. Andre bardzo sympatyczny i pomocny. Polecam!
Tolle Unterkunft, wie beschrieben. Jederzeit gerne wieder!
Loved our stay in Prenzlauer Berg   And Berlin!! Place was clean and quiet.
Ich war sehr zufrieden in der Unterkunft,Zimmer ist klein aber sauber .

we requested a lot for early checkin due to our travel plans and only wanted to drop off luggage, but the cleaning team was there till 4PM also which is the official check-in time, could have been more considerate to allow checkin if requested with genuine concerns

Schöne simple Einrichtung der Zimmer. Schöne große Badezimmer und Aufhaltebereich. Der Check-In sowie Check-Out lief problemlos und unkompliziert und die Gegend ist super, gerade wenn man gerne essen geht! Würde immer wieder kommen.

The app. is exactly the way it looks on the pictures. It was clean, warm, hot water all the time. A friend of Christophe met us and waited for us although we were late because of the flight.
Location is the best.
Everything was explained to us in grate details on an email at list 2 weeks before our arrival which was grate
I recommend Christophe's app. a lot
Liat

Expect to be cussed out be her when something goes wrong and you have to wake her up in the middle of the night. Also, expect to feel like an inconvenience while there, slow responses, and have to figure out everything on your own, like how to access the wifi. This has by far been my worst experience with Airbnb.

Bilal is a very flexible host, who is friendly and interested but does not meddle in any sense. The location is good for the S bahn, that gets you everywhere. Overall my stay was good.
I've deducted a star for accuracy, because when I arrived the desk shown in the pictures was not in the room, but when I mentioned to Bilal that I need a desk for working he went out and bought another, smaller one.
So if I could give 6 stars for Bilal his attentiveness, I would! Thanks again

Great location and in the center of the city. The train station is a few minutes walk and you have lots of food options. Having the industrial fan was a big plus given that it was hot in Berlin. I do think the lockbox should be changed because it was difficult to check in and out of the apartment.
Très belle chambre et super emplacement dans le quartier de Mitte.
Eine tolles Apartment, tolle Lage. Wir haben uns super wohlgefühlt.
Alles 100% - von der Kommunikation bis zur Unterkunft, Umgebung ... Wir haben die Zeit in Berlin einfach toll genossen. Vielen Dank an Kamila! Einfach empfehlenswert :-)

Alloggio molto bello e pulito, in contesto tranquillo, se pur in un bel quartiere centrale con tutti i servizi necessari raggiungibili a piedi.
Purtroppo il divano letto era scomodissimo, e noi grandi abbiamo dormito molto male.
Accessori della cucina insufficienti. mancava pentola grande per bollire acqua, e pastiglie per lavastoviglie. Avrebbe fatto molto comodo qualche mobile in più per riporre valige ed oggetti.
Se cambiano divano letto, torniamo sicuramente

Diese Wohnung ist ein Traum. Es war hier alles vom Feinsten. Sehr große Wohnung mit viel Platz und vor allem sehr sehr still. Und das mitten in Berlin. Wunderbare klare Atmosphäre. Wir kommen gern wieder.
Leiligheten hadde perfekt beliggenhet midt i sentrum. Den var lys og fin, kommer gjerne tilbake hit

Ines and Ulrich were wonderful hosts       who were very responsive to all our questions and made sure we had everything we needed during our stay. Even though the property is outside the city centre, it is very close to public transport and is a lovely quiet neighbourhood. The apartment is beautifully clean and decorated. Our family loved our time here. I would highly recommend.
It was a nice stay in Berlin. Rosario is very accommodating!  Very clean and near a train stop. Heads up: there is no lock on bedroom or bathroom door.
Vom Willkommen bis zum Goodbye alles Super.
Jo elhelyezkedes, nagyon finom a reggeli es kedves szemelyzet.

Die Wohnung von Team Rockchair ist wirklich nur zu empfehlen. Sie ist riesen groß, liegt in sehr guter Anbindung zum Alexanderplatz und war sehr sauber. Der Check-In / -Out hat dank einem Türschloss mit Zahlencode unproblematisch geklappt. Auch die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern könnte nicht besser klappen.
Das einzige „Manko“ was man benennen könnte ist, dass es nur 1 Badezimmer inkl. Toilette gibt. Dies steht jedoch klar in der Beschreibung der Wohnung, wodurch wir uns darauf einstellen konnten.
Alles in allem hatten wir einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt in dieser Wohnung und werden diese bei einem kommenden Berlin Aufenthalt 100%ig wieder buchen! Vielen Dank nochmal an Team Rockchair dafür!

Everything was absolutely perfect
Highly recommended
Thanks
Perfect location, gemütliche Wohnung, easy access, easy comunication. Totally recommended. Vienen Dank Andre
Dilo's apartment is everything you could possibly need and more. Clean, spacious and comfortable. What you see is what you get. Dilo as a host and his apartment are 10/10

Alt i alt et godt ophold. Ligger meget tæt på stationen, så det var nemt at komme rundt omkring. Dog virkede aircondition ikke, så det var meget varmt og vandhanen var helt løs i køkkenet.  Vandhanen blev fikset, men det gjorde aircondition ikke - vi er glad for vi var her midt sommer.

Es war alles einwandfrei. Gerne wieder.
It was all very good. Any time again

Kristina’s place was beyond what I expected, much prettier in real than in pictures.
It’s super pretty and extremely clean and very well located.
It’s ideal for two people who are looking for a budget stay.
I would highly recommend this place.
Nice and clean apartment.

Sehr gute Lage, direkt vor der S-Bahn Haltestelle. Wenn die Fenster geschlossen sind auch sehr ruhig. Die Küche ist sehr praktisch wenn man nicht für jede Mahlzeit in ein Restaurant oder Café gehen will. Alles in allem waren wir sehr zufrieden

Das Appartement war sehr gemütlich eingerichtet und hatte alles was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in Berlin braucht.
Die Lage ist super zur U8 und man ist zu jeder Zeit mobil.
Excelente ubicación.Anfitriones impecables
Das Loft war absolut toll, wir hatten eine tolle Woche dort und können es absolut weiterempfehlen. Die Kommunikation verlief auch super und wir kommen gerne wieder!

The apartment in Nollendorf was very nice, spacious en well equipped. We were warmly welcomed by Andrew's mother. There is everything you need and even a little more like great coffee. It is a very quiet place and fine neighbourhood. We had a great time.
Bel appartement très cosy avec super vue dégagée et propriétaire très sympa
The flat was so beautiful and perfect for us. 10/10 would stay again!

I was really happy to stay with Reinhard and his girlfriend. They are both very nice, helpful and have a clean and nice home. There's a lot of cafés and restaurants in the area, and a few supermarkets are within walking distance. Nearby is also some nice walkways along the canal, with people hanging out playing boule, taking a bear, playing music in the evenings. A nice place in a nice neighbourhood! I'm planning to return to Berlin pretty soon, and really hope I'll be able to stay with them again.

1ère découverte de Berlin en logeant chez Annette.
Appartement très agréable et fonctionnel, à 2 pas des transports.
Un grand merci à Annette pour ses conseils et sa réactivité.
Great apartment!

My two nights at Elektra were wonderful! The price-performance ratio is extremely good. Not only do you get a very large and clean room in a safe accommodation with a really friendly hostess, but also access to the bathroom and a great kitchen. I would stay here anytime again. Thank you Elektra for being so flexible to my complicated journey with Deutsche Bahn.
Very nice apartment, very nice vibe
Beautiful place, clean, with beautiful finishes, large, close to shopping centers, restaurants, museums. I loved

Sehr schöne und kreativ eingerichtete große Wohnung Wohnung, perfekte, sehr ruhige Lage und trotzdem mitten im Leben. Perfekte Kommunikation, alles tip-top. Tia , ihre Wohnung und natürlich die Umgebung direkt am Spreekanal sind mehr als eine Reise wert. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder, Danke!!!
It was a great stay

Very big and light apartment. Everything was pretty fine, but we had some minor inconveniences:
- sometimes there was a strong smell in the bathroom
- construction every morning right outside of the biggest room, impossible to sleep every morning, except on Sundays :(
- location isn't too bad, but could be better
Overall, I'd say fair price.
Alles tip top, super nettes Personal, problemloser vorab check in/out. Zimmer wie beschrieben. Sehr gute Adresse, wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!

Absolutely loved staying at Numa. The room was very clean and it was actually bigger than what I thought it would be. The communication was great throughout the whole stay and the location is great with everything you need in the area (shops, restaurants, the U-Bahn and S-Bahn, etc.). I highly recommend and I will definitely come back here for my next stay.

Biggi ist sehr unkompliziert, flexibel. Weitere Bettwäsche und Handtücher im Schrank.
Ausstattung gut, alles da was man braucht.
Grundsätzlich war die Wohnung ordentlich, pingelig sollte der Mieter nicht sein.
Lage sehr gut, U6 um die Ecke, ebenso Supermärkte etc.
Die Wohnung liegt in einer total ruhigen Straße, sodass wir bei gekipptem Fenster wunderbar geschlafen haben.

Wir, 3 Studienfreundinnen und ich mit Kleinkind (1Jahr), hatten ein super Wochenende im November in Berlin und waren mit der Unterkunft super zufrieden.😃😊 Vor allem der große Wohn-/ Essbereich und die Sauna war toll! 😃👍🏻
Es wurde uns sogar ein Babyreisebett und ein Hochstuhl gestellt. Das war sehr angenehm, da wir mit dem Zug angereist sind. 🤗👍🏻
Ein kleines Manko war, dass kaum noch Zündhölzer auf Vorrat waren und wir den Kamin daher nicht nutzen konnten. 🙂

Parwana ist freundlich und der Check-in ist super leicht.
Für Wochenendtrips ist die Wohnung sehr gut geeignet, sauber und einwandfrei. :-)

Unangenehmer Geruch (kalter Qualm) im Appartement und Badezimmer
Das Bad war leider alles andere als sauber, genauso wie Teppich, Couch und decken.
Von der Benutzung des Fahrstuhls würden wir DRINGEND abraten!!!
Das WLAN ist sehr schlecht und weder für Anrufe noch Arbeit zu nutzen.
Das Appartement ist gut ausgestattet, und geräumig. Jedoch ist durch den schlechten Geruch und die Verunreinigungen ist ein Wohlfühlen nur schlecht möglich und dafür absolut zu teuer.
Es war alles super.
Muy cómodo, limpio y buen barrio!
Amazing Berlin experience :) Cozy and wonderful

Très satisfaits de notre séjour.
L'appartement est idéalement situé, dans un quartier charmant et à échelle humaine, remarquablement commensurable pour des parisiens.
L'appartement lui-même est parfaitement tenu et la décoration équilibrée participe d'une bonne appréhension de la ville.
Andrea est accueillant et tout à fait arrangeant.
Le chat extraordinairement sociable.

A nice apartment at busy area surrounded by grocery stores, restaurants, cafés and public transportation (subway). The street is very quiet and beds are comfortable so we slept well! All the equipment worked as promised and the place was very clean so we got totally value for the money - can warmly recommend this place!
Tolle Unterkunft. Super Lage! Hat alles einwandfrei geklappt.

Calma has a superb location and we were pleased with how close the hotel was to the city center! It is located in Mitte, one of the oldest neighborhoods in Berlin— using the pay-as-you-ride scooters and bikes are a great way to get around and see everything! Restaurants, shops, historic landmarks and more are located within the vicinity. The metro is right around the block, too. The staff at Calma are very kind, the check in is easy and the accessibility to hot spots in Berlin is flawless. Although you are located to so much, the hotel is pretty quiet and peaceful. No loud cars or people, you can go to sleep soundly. Highly recommend!
good location , easy check in and check out , good room
Ganz herzlichen Dank, für den Aufenthalt in eurem Haus. Es war alles wunderbar und ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt.

Kamer is ruim genoeg en schoon. Host Rosario is een rustige man. De rest van de woning is aan de kleine kant. Bijvoorbeeld: met zijn tweeën tegelijk even in de keuken staan, bijvoorbeeld om even thee te zetten, is wat lastig.

This place was perfect in every way. Spotlessly clean, newly renovated, nicely decorated, short walk to U Bahn. Wish we could have stayed longer! Next time we are in Berlin we will definitely stay here again!
The place is clean and close to Metro. It's good for 4 friends (not couples). The wifi is a bit slow but the rest is all good. The host is nice and helpful. Check in and out is easy
Wonderful stay! The place was spotless, cozy, and exactly as described. This place is close to city center. Highly recommend!
Súper bien ubicado, muy cerca de una estación del metro y muchos lugares cerca para comer. El precio es muy accesible, y Kerem es muy amable, 100% recomendado.
Frank provided a great place to stay and see the sights of Berlin.

Marcello's place was fantastic. Everything was exactly as it should be.
The only issue we had was that the listing stated the bedroom was lockable, this was not the case.
When we communicated with Marcello, he was polite and told us this was a mistake on the listing description and was going to be fixing it.
Overall, great place, highly recommend.

Wir kommen gerne wieder
wieder. Wurden herzlich empfangen und konnten die Empfehlungen für die Umgebung gleich in die Tat umsetzen. Alles war sehr ordentlich und unkompliziert. :)

The building is in a good neighborhood, close to a number of restaurants and close to public transportation.   Dorothee and her husband were gracious hosts who some tips about places to eat in the neighborhood.   The bedroom and bathroom were clean.   The bedroom window faces out to quiet courtyard.  Recommended.
Très bon séjour, hôte réactif et appartement bien situé.
Great place in a great neighbourhood. Everything was as described and Apostolos was a helpful and communicative host :)

Perfect place for my husband and grown up daughter . Warm even though snow outside! Convenient for public transport. Recommend to anyone

Very clean, private, quiet, located close to train station and trams. If ambiance isn’t something you care about, this place is great. Good for people who travel a lot for work or remote workers. Nice place and super location

The location was also perfect. The flat is a 2 minute walk from a main shopping street, public transportation, restaurants, and a 15-20 minute walk (or 7 minute bus) from the Zoologischer train station where many tours start. I have so many good things to say about this place, would recommend to anybody and would come back here in a heartbeat!

Wir haben uns bei Andrej schnell sehr wohl gefühlt :) Die Wohnung hat einen super Standort und ist auch cool minimalistisch/hygge eingerichtet :D

Their place is located in a classy and quiet suburb 10 min walk from metro and rail stations, supermarkets and shops.

Good modern kitchen and bathroom.

I can highly recommend this appartment for people who like their luxury and can appreciate a lively neighborhood.
Cheers Nico Willard

Un appartement très mignon et joliment décoré où nous nous sommes sentis comme chez nous durant 4 jours.  Nous avons trouvé tout ce dont nous avions besoin. L'emplacement est pratique et permet de rejoindre rapidement le centre de Berlin. Un AirBnb à fortement conseiller :D

Yomi es mucho más que un anfitrión, te hace sentir mucho más que bienvenido cuando compartes tu cultura con él. Yomi y su hija son una gran dupla de hosts, decisión de que no me arrepiento, porque más allá de “sentirte como en casa”, te invitan a salir a que explores Berlín, que es una fabulosa ciudad.

Just an overall Great experience and Stay at Tamara’s place ! Highly recommended to any Guests .

tolle Unterkunft im Herzen Moabits mit guter Anbindung nach ganz Berlin. Sauber, bequem und mit Balkon mit schöner Aussicht.

The good parts of the apartment outweighed any minor inconveniences for us!
The room was lovely and spaceous and the flat is lovely! Very easy to walk to shops and cafes. Would 100% recommend staying here!

Voll zufrieden mit der Unterkunft, war alles wie auf den Fotos und zu Fuß kam man schnell zur s Bahn und zum Bus. Man kann von hier aus alles erreichen und ist schnell beim Alexanderplatz. Gerne wieder das selbe Hotel wenn ich wieder in Berlin bin.

Unser Aufenthalt in Uwes Wohnung hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Er stand jederzeit für unsere Fragen bereit und hat geholfen sofern es möglich war. Außerdem war er sehr sympathisch und offen, was wir bei einer kurzen Begegnung feststellen konnten. Die Lage der Wohnung ist zwar recht weit vom Zentrum und den meisten Sehenswürdigkeiten entfernt, allerdings ist sie auch gut angebunden, sodass man das Zentrum mit unterschiedlichen öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erreichen kann. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön, ordentlich und liebevoll eingerichtet. Größtenteils wird von Uwe alles bereitgestellt, was man braucht. Ein paar Kleinigkeiten, beispielsweise ein zweites Küchenhandtuch, wären noch hilfreich gewesen.
Insgesamt waren wir sehr zufrieden und können uns vorstellen, diese Wohnung noch einmal zu besuchen.

Really nice apartment in a great location, there're two metro stations nearby, plenty of restaurants and cafes and if you're a beer enthusiast you must check out BrewBaker which is like two blocks away and offers great beer and foods plus there's a cool beer shop really close.
Kelly was also a great host, she provided us with a TONS of information regarding Berlin and the local area. If we return to Berlin we'll definitely choose this place again!

Die Unterkunft sah toll aus. Ein einzigartiger Stil und es war alles vorhanden, was wir brauchten. Lediglich die Dusche war leider schimmelig und die Lampen verstaubt. Abgesehen davon waren wir sehr zufrieden! Auch die Lage war für uns sehr angenehm. Danke auch an Jan für den freundlichen Empfang und die Empfehlungen!
Sehr freundlich und zuverlässig

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und auch wenn es nur ein kurzer Aufenthalt war, werden wir die Unterkunft weiter empfehlen und nochmal dort buchen wenn wir wieder in berlin sind
Super Wohnung, nette Kommunikation trotz Probleme 🤙🏼

Grand studio simple, propre et fonctionnel , près du métro et non loin du SBAHN pour l’aéroport . RDC donnant sur une cour intérieure. Quartier vivant et typiquement berlinois.

Great space for 8 people however there were stains in some towels and in the couch. The neighbourhood is very dangerous at night.

Leider gibt es in der Wohnung zwar heißes Wasser, aber ohne Druck. Das hat mich während meines Aufenthalts aber nicht gestört.
Die Kommunikation mit Amit war super! Er ist super freundlich und hilfsbereit - nicht nur gab er Tipps zur Wohnung und der Gegend, sondern stand mir auch bei Fragen zur Seite. Außerdem war er meinen ganzen Aufenthalt über super entspannt und unkompliziert, was zum Beispiel Check-in oder Check-out betraf.
Alles in allem, und gerade für längere Aufenthalte, sehr zu empfehlen. :)

l'alloggio si trova in una via molto tranquilla e silenziosa; in zona si trovano supermercati, negozi e ristoranti. Il centro è facilmente raggiungibile (fermata della metro a 5 minuti ).

Francesco è stato molto gentile e disponibile.

De buurt is een beetje armoedig. Veel vuilnis op straat. Goed bereikbaar met het OV en natuurlijk de fantastische stepjes die door heel Berlijn staan, super!

Jo's room was as advertised. It's perfectly located in the Mitte, so it's great if you want to walk around and get lost in the neighborhood. Lots of dining and shopping options within a walking distance. Jo's apartment is also close to several public transportation options, so take your pick.
We had a very lovely stay with Sabine. We stayed for two months and had a very good experience. Sabine and Horst were very helpful and great hosts!
the place looks big and very nice. it is really a super quiet area. I would totally recommend this place to others.
War alles sauber und super gute Lage mitten in Charlottenburg. Würden wir wieder buchen.
Everything was as described in the listing and we were surprised by the host’s attention to detail to make sure we had a good stay such as suggesting restaurants. We would definitely recommend
Die Unterkunft ist klein aber fein. Sie ist sauber und ruhig gelegen. Es fehlt nichts und wenn doch kümmern sich Jürgen und Christine gerne darum.

Shafaq was a great hostess - she met me personally to help me find the apartment & assisted me with checking in.
The apartment is centrally located but you need to navigate buses & the metro. Once you’ve sorted this out, the apartment is central & convenient to everything. No internet or TV available (but I’m happy with this as I don’t really watch TV. I had my own SIM card for Europe so this helped me with accessing the internet.

Outstanding host! Ursula is the nicest person. Her apartment is as described in a great location for food and bars. Had a late flight out and Ursula allowed us to check out late which made life so much easier. Bed is comfy and shower is great. Plenty of room for two. Would stay again. Highly recommend.

jürgen's house Is very comfy, cozy and clean. The  ambience Is warm and welcoming, as you can see from the photos. Jürgen is nice and helpful, he never disturbs and gived Is several al tips for restaurants. Recommended!

Fantastic. To start with, Ann-Katrin is very warm and welcoming, which is good because it allows you to feel comfortable and at home from the onset of your stay. The apartment was well furnished, what you see in the pics is exactly what you get. Also, it's a very good location, with a lovely view of the internal garden that's beautiful. Very balanced and enjoyable stay, and of course Berlin is just wow :)

Très bel appartement, grand et spacieux, conforme à la description. Il y a bien 4 chambres et 2 salle de bains, la cuisine est équipée, il y a une grande terrasse,  le wi-fi fonctionne. Serviettes et draps fournis. L’arrivée se fait avec des codes et nous avons pu ouvrir l’appartement un peu plus tôt le jour de notre arrivée en communiquant facilement avec l’hôte. Parfait !
Inmejorable anfitrión....muchas gracias Enrique! lugar limpio, bien ubicado y con todos los servicios!
Top ausgestatteter Wohnung mitten in Berlin. Schön eingerichtet, sehr sauber und Toplage mit tolle Geschäfte und Restaurants direkt in der Nähe.
Wonderful stay, great property, lovely host, very easy parking right out front. Only downside for me: very limited dining options nearby and no shops in walking distance.

Nice cosy place, well situated near Alexanderplaz, next to U and S Bahnn.
Despite what the title says, I found it easy to get to sleep in the night.

The room was very cozy and with a nice view. You have everything around to have a great time in Berlin. The hosts is super nice and gave us great recommendations for food and drinks.
Happy to be there again soon!
Michael's apartment was perfect for our short stay in Berlin. It's a great location with lots of cafes and bars nearby. Michael's communication was excellent too... Highly recommended.

Mooi appartement op een goede locatie. Restaurants, bar, bakker, supermarkt en OV erg dichtbij. Het appartement heeft fijne bedden en een mooie ruime badkamer. Voor 4 volwassenen is het jammer dat er maar een bank voor 2 personen is, de overige twee moeten dan op een eetkamerstoel zitten. Na een hele dag lopen om Berlijn te bekijken, zou het fijn zijn om even lekker te kunnen zitten. Ook qua keukeninrichting vonden wij het wat summier tenzij je uit eten gaat.
Voor het overige een heel fijn appartement en een fijne host!
Our stay was fantastic! The place was clean, comfortable, exactly as described and showed in photos . What really made it special was the host is so helpful and responsive. Highly recommend!"
Kristian and Peggy were fantastic hosts! Their apartment was beautifully furnished and located in a very convenient part of Berlin.

great cosy apartment, close to public transport.
very nice hosts!

A nossa estadia foi incrível! O espaço é super quente e aconchegante, com chão aquecido na casa de banho (um detalhe maravilhoso para os dias frios). A cama é extremamente confortável e toda a casa tem uma decoração linda e cuidada, o que torna o ambiente ainda mais agradável. Além disso, o bairro é ótimo, muito tranquilo e com fácil acesso de transportes para o centro. Tivemos alguma dificuldade no check-in, mas o host foi super rápido a responder e a resolver tudo. No geral, foi perfeito! Recomendamos muito e com certeza voltaríamos.

Es war ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt in Berlin und in der Wohnung am Gesundbrunnen. An der Wohnung gab es nichts zu bemängeln und insbesondere den Tag bei etwas Restsonne auf dem Balkon ausklingen zu lassen hat etwas. Danke Oliver für den schönen Aufenthalt!
Good location, very friendly owner. The apartment is very modern and clean.
Lovely apartment - clean and everything you need for a short break. Location is fine but not much around the spot but a short walk to the u-Bahn

This place is a great minimalist room in a colourful character building in a beautiful part of Kreuzberg. It is well connected by the U-Bahn and bus, so it makes for a fantastic central base for those wishing to explore Berlin. I was delighted, and I would happily stay there again!
Highly recommend this place if you are coming to Berlin…. Paolo and Manuel were beyond helpful and friendly. The place was so nice and had everything we needed and more. 10/10 would stay again

Die Unterkunft war super. Wie in der Beschreibung gelesen, war alles da. Wir sind mit Baby angereist, auch hier war alles verfügbar. Kommunikation lief sehr gut und super schnell. Wird nicht unser letzter Aufenthalt gewesen sein!
Great apartment to share with family, close to a lot of food places and well connected
Spotlessly clean spacious apartment. Highly recommend.
Appartamento molto confortevole, caldo e pulito. Non distante dalla stazione -Quindi potrete raggiungere il centro molto facilmente-. L’ideale per fare una visita di tre o più giorni della cittá.

Really unique experience & prestine apartment in Berlin .It reflects their owners good taste and the effort that they’ve put for everybody that is their guest to have a great experience and also will be guided to reach true spirit of Berlin with their help.
Would strongly recommend !!!

Das Upper Rooms Hotel ist sehr schön und rustikal aber dennoch auf eine moderne Art gestaltet. Das Zimmer und Bad ist sauber und schön. Der Check in verlief reibungslos und auch ein spontanes zu buchen des Frühstücks ist kein Problem.
In den ersten Stock kommt man nur mit Treppen. Ab den ersten Stock bis in den vierten Stock in der die Rezeption ist gibt es einen Fahrstuhl. Dies ist etwas hinderlich mit viel Gepäck oder einen Kinderwagen. Aber auch hier war eine Umbuchung vom vierten Stock auf den ersten Stock simple und ohne Probleme und längere warte Zeit.
Insgesamt ist das Upper Room Hotel zu empfehlen
Great location, clean and convenient. Modern apartment and clear communication

We stayed at Rolf's nice apartment , big enough for the two of us. Was much nicer then on the pictures; nice wooden floor, high ceilings en brand new bathroom situated in a quit courtyard. Bike rental at the end of the street. Rolf is a very helpful host.

Super fin lejlighed, hvor alt er nyt og pænt. Der var gode dyner, puder og håndklæder. Køkkenudstyr var i god stand og intet manglede. Det var rart at kunne rulle de udendørs gardiner ned for at skærme lys fra gaden. Lejligheden er tæt på metro, supermarkeder, park og caféer og restauranter. Alt hvad du har brug for. Der er dog lidt larm i gaden aften og nat.
Vi manglede intet - måske at kunne tænde lyset i køkkenet under skabene.
Loved our stay, we were 4 people and both beds were big enough for 2 for sure. Also Karolina and Phillipp we’re always very responsive and helpful.

The room was clean, spacious and central. It was unfortunately too warm to sleep well and opening the window made it too noisy to sleep. We could not adjust the temperature as it's a building controlled system. On top of all this we were not told the building was clad with scaffolding and mesh material so we couldn't even look out of the window. Finally we had to pay an extra 37€ tourist tax on departure which was not mentioned in our original booking
Simply super
Very good for large families

Two bed rooms big enough for our family.
Everything is ready there without any inconvenience.
Also there are many restaurants and cafe in the area.
Super schöne Wohnung,  sehr gute Infrastruktur, haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt, kommen wieder.

Ideal location very close to great restaurants and cafes and right on the canal. The apartment is not fancy and oddly smelled like mustard, but it had all the necessities for a 4 day stay. Beautiful view. Elevator was convenient for the bags.
Super gelegen, toll eingerichtet, leider lage alte socken beim einzug unter dem bett. Aber dass kann man ja mal übersehen. Ansonten top, kann ich nur empfehlen
Spotless, easy to get in/out and better than a hotel! Host was SUPER responsive. Would gladly stay again. Highly recommend.
Maria was friendly and responsive, and the place was clean and exactly how it looked in the pictures. Train station close by to get into the centre of Berlin. Thanks for a great stay!
We had a wonderful stay here! The room was very nice, the location is absolutely perfect. Great value for the price!
Super freundliche Host, sehr schönes Apartment. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und empfehlen das Airbnb weiter.
Appartement toujours aussi bien placé : idéal pour faire du tourisme.

La nevera y congelador no funcionaban, cuando avisamos nos dijeron que mandarían a alguien a arreglarla. En los días que estuvimos no fueron capaces de enviar a nadie a arreglarla, ni de traer otra nevera. Cuando lo reclamamos nos ignoraron. En Berlin hay servicios 24 horas de arreglos de electrodomésticos, no es excusa las fechas navideñas ni fines de semana.
Nos molestó el poco interés mostrado por esto la mala reseña. No tener nevera nos fastidió el viaje.
El apartamento está muy bien y cumple con todas las expectativas.
Le hubiéramos puesto la máxima puntuación si hubieran resuelto el problema que tuvimos o hubieran mostrado un mínimo interés por resolverlo.

Une heure de retard lors du Checkin. Pas de possibilité de déposer sa valise avant. J’ai perdu une journée à attendre le checkin. L’appartement laisse à désirer niveau propreté. L’appartement donne sur la rue la plus animée du quartier, les nuits sont bruyantes et la deuxième chambre n’a pas de fenêtre. Même si l’emplacement est idéal, il y a d’autres appartement qui sont plus au calme deux rues plus loin. Pour ma part, je ne  relouerai pas l’appartement. On doit mettre et enlever les draps soi-même, chose que je n’ai jamais dû faire avant dans d’autres AirB&B. La propreté de l’appartement laisse vraiment à désirer. C’est vraiment dommage.
The hostel is in a very beautiful place of Berlin, we stay there a night and everything was good.

Ralph was very prompt in responding and all went smoothly on arrival.  The flat is fine for a large group that all goes to bed and gets up at the same time.  We were a mixed group (teenagers and adults) and had looked long and hard for a 3-bedroom flat so the teenagers could sleep in and stay up late without disturbing others.  However one of the bedrooms had no window or door and was right next to the kitchen so could not be used.  So we ended up using the beds in the living room which would have been OK except that was what we'd been trying to avoid by renting a 3 bedroom flat in the first place.  Otherwise facilities were fine and location is very convenient for  U Bahn, shops, sightseeing etc.
Good location, affordable price, nice staff, clean room.

Das Belfort Apartment ist wunderschön. Die Lage ist super zentral und ruhig. Das Design des gesamten Gebäude ist einmalig. Man hat das Gefühl, man ist auf Bali. Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit im Apartment.
Sehr zu empfehlen. Wir kommen definitiv wieder!

Very welcome, met me at bus stop.  Lovely spacious apartment with view over garden.  Clean, comfortable, simple to operate. Studio room with nice dining area, balcony and clean, efficient bathroom.  Some nice bars and restaurants in Weser strasse.  U bahns are a level 20-25 minute walk away through nice streets.  Good supermarket and late night food store close by.
Lovely place! Perfectly equipped and clean. Highly recommended 👌

Nice stay, good location, pretty rooms
Unfortunately its really noisy, you can hear everything from the rooms nearby and from the hallway - sadly all those young people staying there dont really care abt you sleeping and will be really loud at for example 3am, 6am whatever
War alles super

We had a wonderful stay at Katja’s place.
The apartment is spacious, bright and light-flooded and beautiful designed.
Katja was on vacation so unfortunately we had no time for talking. Therefore the organization was very good.
Arrive and feel good.
Thank you!
Great location with plenty of space and a nice common area.
Very close to mass transit and the price was a big plus
Super Lage, toller Blick über die Stadt, ruhig. Wir hatten zwei wundervolle Tage und haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt.

Desværre kom Philip for sent, og skulle så først gøre rent og skifte sengetøj da vi var landet. Det var lidt ærgerligt, men Philip havde fortalt at han var forsinket og det kan ske for os alle.
Han var super flink, lejligheden lækker og den lå tæt på det meste.
Vi havde en dejlig tur, og kunne godt finde på at bo her en anden gang.
Vi anbefaler i hvert fald denne lejlighed :o)

Eine saubere, zentrale Unterkunft mit guten Parkmöglichkeiten, bequemen Betten und entspanntem Check-in / Check-out. Für ein Wochenende in Berlin war die Wohnung ideal. Lärm war für uns gar kein Problem, trotz der Nähe zur S-Bahn.

Björn was such a nice host, and his place was located in a beautiful part of Berlin. 😊
The place was very clean, well-designed, and cozy.
He recommended us where to go nearby, and provided help if we need any guidance further.
Overall, it was a nice experience. Thank you Björn!

Die Unterkunft war sehr gepflegt, die Kommunikation mit Benno war super bei Fragen war er direkt erreichbar, die Wohnung war recht zentral alles super erreichbar mit Bahnen. Im vollen und ganzen empfehlenswert
Vielen Dank für deine Gastfreundschaft Louisa! Es war sehr schön bei dir! Vielleicht bis bald mal wieder! :)
Alles bestens!

Es un muy lindo departamento. Natasya es una gran anfitriona, nos ha ayudado muchísimo.
Super recomendable!

Good location with easy access to Underground and tram. Very nice restaurants and bars just around the corner. Weihnachtsmarkt in “Kulturbrauerei” was recommended by Verda; excellent!
Flat very clean, stylish and comfortable. 4th floor without lift keeps you fit.
Poloha, apartmán, Berlín. Čo viac dodať. Vrelo odporúčam a hostiteľovi prajem veľa spokojných hostí.

This apt is very well designed, has great light (3 nice windows), and has a well equipped kitchen even if it’s compact in size. There is a cooker top, along with the microwave, which is great. Everything in the apt is nice, clean, and new. The building are is also great. Location is outstanding for transportation. Super comfortable bed and a really nice big bathroom. While the apt is small it doesn’t feel that way given the good design and light. Frank was super helpful and responsive.
It was amazing.  The apartment is wonderful and in a great location and the hosts are very kind.  Highly recommend :)
Quick and easy communication with the host. Good location, and street parking was easy to find. The apartment itself is very no-frills, but it is functional and good for a short stay.

Pase unos dias increibles en Berlin, gracias Ernst por ser tan amable. El apartamento esta bien ubicado, es comodo y muy lindo y bien decorado. Te hace sentir en casa! Despues de largos dias de caminar por berlin, podia descansar muy bien en el barrio. Sin dudas recomendaria este apartamento y volveria a reservarlo cuando vuelva a Berlin!
Paolo and Petra’s place was superb. It made our stay in Berlin feel most authentic. It’s close to several transit stations which made for easy access to the city. Would highly recommend!
Sehr netter Gastgeber.
Just as described, very clean and there’s always someone to answer your questions at the front desk.

Joseph and his girlfriend are really nice and very helpful. The location is perfect and only 15mins walking distance from Alexanderplatz and the tube is only 2mins from the building. The flat is stunning with typical 3m high ceilings. We felt like locals. By the way, we slept like babies because the mattresses are out of this world. Just amazing. Please share the name of the manufacturer of your mattress. :-))) Again many thanks for having us! Love & Light...
Great place does what it says on the tin. Helpful messages from the host and allowed us to increase number of guests last minute. Would recommend

I would recommend this place for all coming to Berlin, whether that be for the weekend or a month.
The apartment is found just as in the photos, and its setting makes it cosy and safe at night. You arrive in a beautiful area with lots of cafe’s, restaurants and stores nearby. There is a great flea market at the end of the street on Sunday’s which local people are very welcoming and happy to chat. Jan was very hospitable and allowed me to check in early, store my luggage after check out and responded promptly to any questions I had during my stay. I would gladly stay in any of their places for my next visits!!
¡Todo genial, recomendando!

Der Aufenthalt bei Denise und Jürgen hat unsere Reise sehr bereichert und war genau das Richtige für unseren Berlin-Trip. Von den leicht verständlichen Angaben über die schnelle + hilfreiche Kommunikation bis hin zu dem wunderschönen Zimmer haben wir uns pudelwohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder vorbei falls es uns mal in die Stadt verschlägt. :)
Wir können diese Unterkunft empfehlen und wünsche euch alles Liebe!

The apartment was perfect for a weekend stay in Berlin. Clean, modern, easy check-in and a central location.
Frank was available if we had any questions and always replied quickly. We would highly recommend.
sve ne bilo super , domačin je bio prva liga , vračamo se ponovno sigurno 😁

El departamento estaba muy bien. La zona es alejada de las atracciones turísticas. Pero hay metro cerca. El barrio es muy ecléctico. Hay zonas lindas y otras poco agradables y hasta parecen inseguras.  Lo único realmente negativo es que no nos contestaron cuando preguntamos donde podíamos dejar las maletas por unas horas luego del checkout. Pedíamos solamente consejo para dejar nuestro equipaje.

Great place to come and visit Berlin for a few days. Good location to get to the train station. A little tricky to get inside at first, but after the first time it was easy. Wi-Fi was a little spotty but other than that a great place to stay
Clean feel good space!
Nice place. Be aware that the host sleeps in the apartment
Hanspeter's place is in a quiet and safe neighborhood. I felt really welcome and he was always on hand to answer any questions. The room is clean and comfortable. Thank you for a lovely stay!

Frank was a wonderful host. The place was clean and in a great location. Frank met us at the apartment and showed us the place. He also provided fresh towels halfway through our stay! If you are looking for a great location in Prenzlauer Berg with a great host, definitely book Frank's place!

Contact was flawless and very accurate. Verda made sure we were welcomed by a friend of hers. The place is spacious and light, neatly decorated and has all the amenities. I stayed in many places in Berlin, but this one certainly is in my top-3, also because of the location.

Die Lage und Ausstattung der Unterkunft waren sehr gut, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Auch die Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin war schnell und unkompliziert. Einziges Manko war die Dusche: Die Armatur lässt sich (besonders mit seifigen Händen) schlecht bedienenen, die Wassertemperatur ist nur schwer zu regulieren, kaltes Wasser kommt garnicht.
Mo was very hospitable/flexible and had a great spot.
Overall happy with our stay.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würde wieder in das Hostel gehe. Die präzise Anweisungen zur Ankunft, einchecken und erleben hat uns gut auf den Besuch in unserer Hauptstadt vorbereitet. Auch die Möglichkeit sich bei jeglichen Fragen an den Besitzer zu wenden, fanden wir sehr zuvorkommend.
vielen lieben Dank für den netten Support und der tollen Unterkunft
Gerne wieder!
Nicd area, good person.

Alles wat we vooraf gelezen hadden, klopt ook.  Een rustige plaats, op twee metrohaltes van de Alexanderplatz en dus gemakkelijk om alle hoogtepunten van Berlijn te bezoeken. Koud weer, maar een warme kamer! Bakkerijen en supermarkt vlakbij. Zeker een aanrader voor een paar dagen Berlijn.
Ich kann das Hostel sehr empfehlen. Ich war zum zweiten Mal dort und esxwar wieder super. Nette Mitarbeiter und das Zimmer super.
muito bom! só wifi não funcionou, resto muito bom
Wir waren als Familie unterwegs und auch nur zum Schlafen dort. Dafür war es aber ausreichend.
Such a cute place! Very close to public transportation and lovely host.
Excellent stay and host! Great location in a quiet area within walking distance of nice restaurants and cafes.

Martin's place is as-advertised. More importantly, he is an amazingly-communicative and accommodating host. I give him my highest recommendation. It is my hope to be able to stay in his wonderful, and perfectly located, place very soon again. :)
Great apartment in Berlin! However the checkout is very early. I would recommend to stay here.
Très bien dans l'ensemble
Excellent stay, everything as described and close to the train station.
Все було добре. Зупинялись на день. Багато супермаркетів та магазинів поблизу.
Tolles Ambiente, sehr ruhige Lage. Extrem nette Gastgeberin.
Nice place and great neighborhood.

Maria is a pleasant and helpful host. The unit is spacious and very conveniently located. On the whole a good experience. However, we found that the bed was not very comfortable. The sofa-bed in the lounge room was uncomfortable.
Fantastic apartment by brilliant hosts. Always when responsive and allowed a lot of flexibility. Apartment was extremely large and was in a brilliant location. Thank you!!

Barnado's flat was clean, very conveniently located next to the U12 Ubahn on the Wassertorplatz (very close to Kottbusser Tor and all it's amemities)and had all the essentials for a weekend in the city. The balcony was a particular plus. Communication was easy and efficient.

my stay at this apartment was perfect! check in was flexible and uncomplicated, same with the check out. host always responded quickly and kindly. everything was clean and there were even some sweets and teas for me to use. the location was great! calm and safe area. i can definitely recommend this place and probably gonna come back! :)
Alles super, vielen Dank!
Very nice room. I had a great stay with Hanna. The neighborhood was really quiet. 5 min walk to the subway station :)

Markus is a wonderful host. He responded immediately to my inquiries, and always with kindness. The unit is very well located and has everything you need for a weekend getaway. There was a little construction noise on one of the days (I think from the next door neighbor) but it was extremely quiet in the evenings (and I’m pretty sensitive). Would recommend and stay again in the future. Thanks, Markus!
Really enjoyed my stay here! The location was super convenient, and everything was very clean and well-kept. Would definitely come back!
Perfect finding. Thank you!
Max war immer gut erreichbar und hat sich gut um uns gekümmert. Die Wohnung ist sehr groß und gut ausgestattet.

The forest within walking distance was a perfect opportunity for morning walks — peaceful, refreshing, and absolutely beautiful. We even spotted a squirrel and a fox nearby, which made the whole atmosphere feel very natural and special. We stayed here in June, and it was lovely, but I can imagine it would be just as stunning (if not more) in the fall. The house was exactly as shown in the photos and had everything we needed. Highly recommended!

Für einen kurzen Aufenthalt eine absolute Empfehlung! Sehr sauber und Preis-Leistung ist einfach unschlagbar!
Es gibt keinen Fernseher, sprich man muss sich mit seinem Gegenüber tatsächlich unterhalten. (-für die Humorbehinderten: bitte mit Humor nehmen-)

Nassa’s place was an iconic Berlin style loft,  well balanced in decor, space, age and cleanliness. I especially appreciated the generous amount of bedding and firm bed! The neighborhood was quaint yet so close to diverse places to eat. I felt right at home, had the best sleep in ages.

This is probably the most liveable, well layed out air bnb I have ever stayed in. The space was so well designed, with the layout of the stage that you could lounge on, the bed in the corner etc. The architecture in the apartment is gorgeous-high ceilings, large archway. The kitchen is so cute and also really easy to cook and find everything you needed. The building was in a safe quiet location, but close to fun activities like the Boxi flea market. This is definitely a neighborhood I would live in if I lived in Berlin. 10/10
Tolles Hostel! Sehr zentral gelegen.
Great apartment, great location! It was so chill!

Muy comodo apartamento, cerca de supermercados y del tram que te llevaba al centro. Cocina super equipada con todo lo que necesitas. No faltaba nada para cocinar. Nos sentimos muy a gusto.
Stefan respondio siempre de manera inmediata.
Wij hebben een fijn verblijf gehad! Er was van alles aanwezig in het appartement (Shampoo, wasmiddel, etc.). De accomodatie was schoon en ruim. Roman had goede tips en reageerde altijd!

Oase im Grünen, mitten in Berlin. Wunderschöner, grosser Garten, sehr ruhig und idyllisch, stilvoll eingerichtete sehr helle, schöne Wohnung, moderne Ausstattung, sehr freundliche und liebevolle Gastgeber. Top, uneingeschränkte Empfehlung!

Janet is very considerate and the room is clean and feels like a hotel room.:)
It was a short stay and Janet accommodated my very early morn check out. Good location:) Walking distance to the potsdamer platz
Expérience parfaite.
호스트가 매우 친절하고 깨끗했어요
Alles unkompliziert und passend zur Beschreibung

We had a fantastic stay at the loft! The space was thoughtfully decorated with unique, cool pieces, making it feel cozy and inviting. It was spacious and well-equipped, providing everything we needed.
The beds and pillows were super comfortable, and the living spaces were perfect for relaxing.
Alexandra was a wonderful host, meeting us at the loft, offering great local recommendations, and even accommodating an early check-in without hesitation. There was also a helpful binder with lots of useful information.
“We would definitely stay here again!”

Such a unique spot, especially for the area. Especially if you play piano! Very quant and charming. Good for someone who wants to get out and about the neighbourhood, when they're not at the piano! Close to interesting neighbourhood and grocery stores.

Thanks for providing such a nice base to explore Berlin. The accommodation is tidy, clean, quiet and right next door to an amazing vegan restaurant. It's a great place to rest and recharge between sightseeing and enjoying Berlin's nightlife.
Nice place, central location, clean rooms and also shared bathroom, very kind stuff on the reception.. Thank you AVAlex!

This place couldn’t be more perfect for a short break (or a long one) in Berlin. The location was perfect. Even on the street it was located were loads of lovely restaurant, coffee shops and bars. We had breakfast at Fraulein Wild opposite. And the cocktails in Wurgeengeil next door were heavenly. As was the candlelit atmosphere. The apartment itself was very stylish. Airy. Very comfy bed. And blissfully quiet (we live in London). Communication was easy and fast. And getting around was also easy due to the five minute walk to the station. Oh and check out the Turkish supermarket next to the station. Would count as a top deli in London with all its tasty wares. As you can tell we loved it

I had a really wonderful time at Kristian and Peggy's apartment and 100% recommend it. The apartment design is stunning and you really cannot find a better location in Berlin. If you're looking for somewhere central, this is an incredible place to be.
Peggy and Kristian were very easy to communicate with and very helpful with anything I needed. They live in the building and have a studio there so there's always someone to help if you need anything. Jutte at the studio was really wonderful and she even looked after my shipping when I was out.
WiFi was great for those wanting to work from the apartment and the kitchen is also great for those staying longer. They just renovated so the place is pristine.
Highly recommend!

The apartment is in a great location for access to local bars and restaurants and to many museums and attractions.  We loved the neighbourhood.  It feels relaxed, stylish and safe.  The apartment itself is stylish, comfortable and really well equipped.  Highly recommended.
As expected; well located
Der Check In und Out war einfach, auch mit dem Parkplatz hat alles funktioniert. Zimmer war in Ordnung uns hat es an nichts gefehlt
A beautiful apartment, we'll equipped and we'll located.
Great stay right by check point Charlie. There is a great steakhouse as well only 1 block away. Definitely recommend!

Sehr schöne Wohnung, geschmackvoll eingerichtet in ruhiger Lage mit vielen Restaurants in der Nähe und super Anbindung um in Berlin was zu unternehmen. Sehr netter Support. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden auf jeden Fall wieder kommen.

We had a lovely stay at the apartment. Everything went smoothly and communication was great. The neighborhood is calm and has many cozy cafes and restaurants. If we go to Berlin again, we would be happy to be hosted by Cornelius again.

An extremely cosy and functional flat, I enjoyed every day I spent there. Located on iconic Kastanienallee, but tucked away from any noise. Walking to nearby Mauerpark or even the Museum Island is super easy and comfortable, but you're also right next to public transport. Check-in/out was very straight-forward and communication with Greg always easy. The place itself felt like home: it had everything I needed to cook and enjoy great meals, flawless wifi to work, a super comfortable bed, great shower, nice temperature control (in Winter/Spring). The single thing I could imagine to improve the place is a balcony, but one cannot have it all. Be aware that you do have to go up several flights of stairs to get to the flat, which I did not mind. Also, it's worth mentioning that besides the hundreds of interesting vinyl records and a great soundsystem, there's clothes and shoes and boxes in the closets. To me, it's all part of the charm. But don't expect a completely empty apartment. Overall, I think you're pretty lucky if you get the chance to land there. I would recommend and stay again.

Lots of good eateries in the area and a beautiful park just along the road. Neighbourhood is upmarket and safe. It can be noisy at night especially as you have to open the windows to get ventilation.
Nice and very central.

Generally a great space and good value for the cost. Location is nice, size of apartment is pretty good, decor is lovely. Especially enjoyed the proximity to Tempelhofer Feld!

Der Empfang und die Kommunikation war sehr gut.
A wonderfull location and well linked to public transportation. I wish you to spend some times with Chirs and his wife.

The top attraction is the easy access to the city on the 200 bus, it runs from just round the corner, frequent and reliable, we could come back in the afternoon and get freshened up to go out.
Had a nice stay at Sunflower. Friendly staff, cool location. I’d recommend for short stays.
The apartment is a great base for a short tourist stay in Berlin.  It is clean, spacious and has everything thing you need.  Good local transport connections are an added plus.

wonderful clean space walking distance from restaurants, parks, and more. we had a lovely stay and recommend Barbara’s place! she was very communicative and kind
