Positiv ist der Fahrstuhl, der direkt in die Wohnung fährt. Auch die Terrasse ist wunderbar.

Die Wohnung wurde angeblich am Anreisetag um 11 Uhr gereinigt. Jedoch wurde offensichtlich weder Staub gesaugt, noch Staub gewischt. Auch die Flächen im Kühlschrank waren nicht gereinigt. Die vorhandenen Platzdeckchen waren ebenfalls verunreinigt. Da eine nicht unerhebliche Reinigungsgebühr verlangt wird, und die Bewertungen vorher eigentlich auf eine gute Sauberkeit schließen ließen, sind wir verwundert über den vorgefundenen Zustand.
Ansonsten war die Wohnung schön und die Terrasse hat überzeugt.
Alles prima
casa meravigliosa, fatta. con ottimo gusto, calda ed accogliente. La posizione e' ottimale in un quartiere estremamente vivo e colorato, allegro.
tolle Wohnung in Berlin-Steglitz in grüner Umgebung, interessante Stadtteile in der Nähe, gut mit dem Rad zu erkunden, Geschäfte in der Nähe

Staying in Berlin at Peggy's place was truly amazing! The apartment is filled with light, adorned with gorgeous art, beautifully decorated with high ceilings, and situated in an incredible neighborhood. Peggy, the host, was responsive. The space was spacious and comfortable for our group of four. It's evident that Peggy has poured love and attention into planning and furnishing the place. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely return and recommend it to friends!"

We had a wonderful time staying here! The house was very cozy and had all the charm of a true Airbnb home, which always makes us feel at home. The location was fantastic, close to everything we needed. Overall, a lovely experience. Highly recommended!

We had a wonderful time in Berlin and this flat was a perfect place to stay. We loved the local area and Sven sent over a very useful email of suggestions for places to eat and visit. Very close to the metro too. Thanks for having us!

I didn't see Leona and Gareth much, but they are cheerful, trusting people who welcomed me into their home. The room is spatious, and the location is well situated to explore Kreuzkölln; the nearest S-bahn is a two minute walk away. Communicating with the hosts couldn't have been easier. Remember you're renting a room with shared bathroom, kitchen and shower - wich to me perfectly fits the initial idea of Airbnb.
Sehr sauber und ordentlich. Alles hat reibungslos geklappt Kann ich nur empfehlen!
Super in allen Dimensionen!

Meine Gastgeber haben mich sehr freundlich begrüßt und erst mal zu einem Kaffee eingeladen. Die Ferienwohnung ist sehr großzügig geschnitten, modern, hell, freundlich und natürlich sehr sauber. Wundervoll im Grünen gelegen, was mich total überrascht hat. Eine sehr schöne Ecke von Berlin in der ich auch wohnen würde.
Todo perfecto.
Nice place! Everything was great, thanks!

wunderbar liebevolles Frühstück,
sehr herzliche Aufnahme,
familier und sehr freundlich

Perfect location which was quiet but still very central. Lots of cafes and a few shops around with under 15 minutes walk from Berlin central. Apartment was exactly like photos and had everything we needed. The only issue was the lack of curtains/blinds on the windows but only across the loft area. A really great place to stay, would definitely recommend!

Very very clean and lovely apartment. Beautiful kitchen with EVERYTHING one needs and a very nice bathroom. Parking can be a bit tricky but a car is anyway not really needed as the S-Bahn is 2 mins away on foot. Local shops are also very conveniently located just around the corner,  with a bakery next door and a small supermarket 2 mins away, again on foot. We really enjoyed our stay here and will be back:)!

Molto carino il contesto e la posizione.
Ideale per una coppia
Sehr schöne Wohnung, umsichtig eingerichtet, tolle Lage, sehr guter Preis. Nur Probleme mit Treppensteigen sollte man nicht haben, es ist im 5. Stock, aber darauf weist Patrick ja hin.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft.

We had an amazing stay, the apartments were perfect for me and my 8 guests, plenty of space and we are so thankful that we could leave our suitcases in the apartment and get straight out sightseeing this wonderful city. The amenities in the apartment were great for what we needed and we were all comfortable.
Neighbors upstairs were tad noisy in to early morning.
Apartment location was excellent, being so close to train station made getting around Berlin so easy. Would highly recommend this Airbnb

Katrin is a very nice host, she always answers the messages very fast and gives very clear indications to get to the place and for the check-in. The place was very clean and tidy, and it is also very near to the bus stop and the central train station. It was a very good stay!
Situation idéale pour ce logement qui peut accueillir une grande famille dans le confort. Communication fluide et disponibilité du propriétaire. Nous recommandons !

Location is great and quiet, within a short walkable distance of both bus and U-bahn station, and if you're going to Tempodrom it's close enough for a nice walk too. We visited during a heatwave (like, 35C high) so the room was quite stuffy, there was no AC but there is a desktop fan and it made sleep possible :)
Can recommend, the ladies at the desk were awesome too!

The place is very nice, modern and enjoyable. Very clean, everything needed, great location, and great host! Thank you!
Замечательное место! Очень приветливый хозяин, все очень чисто, современно, приятно, подсказал и рассказал что и где находиться, в квартире все необходимое для жизни! Остался очень доволен!
Incredible stay in Berlin. Ines' place is in a beautiful neighborhood off the path enough to be quiet, but in easy walking range of public transit or restaurants and grocery stores.
Fantastic hostel! Would stay again.
Werner was a super responsive, and friendly host with clear infos getting around the city. The apartment was nice, perfectly fitting our needs of 4 adults and 3 kids. Thanks.
The apartment is perfect, it has everything you need! Good location
Die Lage war für mich perfekt, aber da ich nur eine Nacht dort war kann ich nicht sehr viel sagen. Ich wurde auf jeden Fall sehr herzlich empfangen, das Zimmer ist schön hell und sauber.
Super leichtes Check-In und Check-Out, sehr positiv überrascht durch Kaffeemaschine, Wasserkocher und andere Ausstattungsdetails. Ich kann die Unterkunft sehr empfehlen!
The booking was confirmed, but later the host cancelled. Had to find a new place during my travel to Berlin, not very comfortable. Don’t list on Airbnb if you don’t have space for visitors!

Lage:
Super Lage in einem lebendigen Bezirk und trotzdem ruhig,
gute Verkehrsanbindung
Wohnung:
Bezauberndes helles Apartment mit tollem Balkon über den Dächern von Friedrichshain,
blitzsauber, stilvoll eingerichtet, und gut ausgestattet mit allem, was man sich vorstellen kann, so dass man sich sofort wohlfühlt.
Host:
Super nett, freundlich, umsichtig, hilfsbereit, sympathisch
Check-in:
unkomplizierte Schlüsselübergabe
Kommunikation: unkompliziert, schnell, freundlich, hilfsbereit
Wir würden jederzeit gerne wiederkommen.
Sehr empfehlenswert
Great location! Be sure to note the bathroom, fridge, and entrance are in a shared space. Attentive host and nice place.
Lovely, newly renovated apartment perfectly located only a few stops from Alexanderplatz. Timo as a host was very friendly and quick to answer any questions we had.

Ein wunderschönes Studio mit einer sehr ruhigen und wunderschönen Wohnanlage für eine Person.
Liebe Grüße
Mohamad Bakkour

A beautiful flat with great access to Neukölln and Kreuzberg (and only a 12 minute taxi to Sisyphos 😄) and even bigger than it looks in the photos. Very spacious, great amenities, and very smooth check in process and responsive host. Would love to stay here again.
το σπίτι είναι σε βολική περιοχή κοντά στα μέσα μεταφοράς. είναι άνετο και έχει όλες τις παροχές που περιλαμβάνονται στη.ν περιγραφή.
The nicest Airbnb apartment I have been to in Berlin. Very tidy place with nice furniture. Has everything you need even for a longer stay.
Superfriendly and helpful host! Very comfortable bed, nice linens, lovely showers, soft towels, charming ambiance, quiet street. Highly recommend! :)
Beautiful and comfortable!
Super beau logement, fonctionnel et très bien placé !

El piso está céntrico en el barrio de Mitte, está bien comunicado con metro, autobús, tranvía, yo utilizaba el metro que está a 3 minutos andando del piso, y en dos paradas estas en Alexanderplatz. También hay un supermercado bastante cerca (Rewe) con un horario bastante amplio de 7 a 23 horas.
El piso está muy limpio, es tal y como aparece en las fotografías y con una buena terraza para relajarte después de estar todo el día caminando.
Sehr sauber und ordentlich. Gastgeber ist sehr freundlich und steht immer zur Verfügung und ist sehr schnell erreichbar.

It is a tightly designed interior which is not bad but it’s unusual in the layout. The balcony/deck was wonderful to come home to
after a long day out to sit out and enjoy the city outline and tranquility. We would like to come back someday soon and do some
more exploring of the city.
Super verblijf gehad! Kamers zijn groot

Super gestyltes Apartment, genau wie auf den Fotos. Auch bei geöffnetem Fenster bot der Innenhof Ruhe. Check in, Aufzug, Kühlschrank, Kaffeemaschine- alles funktionierte problemlos und war angenehm.
Die Lage fanden wir gut, kurzer Fußweg zur Bahn. Und wer im Viertel bleiben möchte, findet eine schöne Auswahl an Restaurants und Cafés. Können wir absolut weiterempfehlen!
Eine tolle, helle Wohnung, die sehr zentral mit guter Ubahn, Tram und Busanbindung liegt. Einfache Schlüsselabholung, alles gut beschrieben. Madda hat sich gut gekümmert.
Lovely place, convenient location. Just a note that there are no elevators in the building and the apartment is on the third floor, so it’s a bit of a haul with luggage. Overall highly recommended!

bei diesem apartment nicht lange überlegen- einfach buchen.
sehr zuvorkommende gastgeber total nett, unkompliziertund freundlich - superschönes apartment in toller lage - kann ich auf jeden fall nur weiter empfehlen und wir kommen wieder :D

It’s a great place, everything was clean and you felt really comfy the second you walked in. The location of the apartment couldn’t been better, it’s near to the Alexanderplatz and really cute coffee shops, we also had bikes which we were able to use of course.
Over all it was the perfect place to stay in Berlin!!

One word: flee! Ola gave us 0 news even though we had arrived in the morning!
Once we had contacted AirBnb customer service, Ola finally wrote to us to tell us that the accommodation was unavailable... no words to describe this kind of host!
Super Location, super Appartement, ganz tolle und reibungslose Kommunikation. Sehr zufrieden!

Very positive experience! It was extremely clean and uncluttered which made it easy to begin our holiday. Delightful decor. We will use Sebastian's apartment again when we return to Berlin in the future.
A very nice apartment, beautifully decorated in a great neighborhood. Linda is a caring host. I highly recommend this place.

Very pleasant stay in this stylish, clean and well-appointed apartment. The coffee, tea and general cooking ingredients were a nice touch. Tia was easy to communicate with and gave nice suggestions. I would recommend Tia's apartment!

We hebben een geweldige tijd gehad in Berlijn, mede dankzij ons verblijf in het appartement van Johannes. Hij is een echte super host: flexibel, attent en vol met leuke tips voor de stad. Hij denkt mee en zorgt ervoor dat je je echt thuis voelt, iets wat we nog niet eerder zo hebben meegemaakt.
Het appartement zelf overtrof onze verwachtingen. Het is ruimer dan de foto's doen vermoeden, heerlijk rustig en beschikt over een fijn balkon. Alle voorzieningen die je nodig hebt zijn aanwezig, en we vonden het super dat er alleen biologische producten waren. De bio-winkel om de hoek was ook erg handig!
De locatie is vlakbij het metrostation, waardoor je makkelijk en snel andere wijken van de stad kunt verkennen. Alles bij elkaar was het een super fijn verblijf en we weten nu al waar we de volgende keer in Berlijn zullen verblijven. ;) Bedankt, Johannes!
Lovely place close to many attractions, restaurants and the train station. Appropriate for two people.

Gorgeous apartment with a really positive vibe, and excellent location - great selection of shops, bars and places to eat very close by. And Jorg was very accommodating. I would definitely recommend this as a place to stay.
Danke Simon, alles war wunderbar! Besste Grüsse, Pierre
Excellent apartment. Excellent location.

This place is so cute, as are the hosts! They did so many small things to make my stay smooth…let me store bag a few days before coming, placed the bag in my room before check in, helped me with laundry. The place itself has all the little amenities and thoughtful details to make my stay seamless, from the kitchen equipment to bathroom stuff.
Alles super gelaufen

We spent 6 days in the apartment with 2 other friends, in June. It's big enough for a small group of friends, it's sunny, clean and ideally situated (a very calm area with a good transportation connection).
Guillaume and Ana were very much reachable to answer our questions during our stay.
It's an apartment I would suggest !

Till war ein sehr netter Gastgeber und seine Unterkunft hat unsere Erwartungen in jeder Hinsicht erfüllt. Alles wichtige, wie Supermärkte, U-Bahn und Bushaltestellen, war in Fußnähe zu erreichen. Schöne Restaurants und Sehenswürdigkeiten waren auch nicht weit. Eine klare Empfehlung!
Super Ort alles lief einwandfrei

Mario’s place was easy to find and check into, and in a great location for us. The airbnb was clean, but still had character which made it feel cosy and homely.
As a host, Mario was lovely, helpful and very quick to respond. We asked to check out later than the agreed time and Mario was kind enough to let us stay a few hours longer, as there was no rush for a turnaround that day.
We would love to stay again! Thank you again Mario ❤️

Weißensee war früher für mich tiefster Osten.
Inzwischen ist es ein lebendiges Viertel geworden.
Für alle Jogger: von der Wohnung zum See und drumherum und zurück ist durch Grünstreifen und Parks ganz wunderbar zu laufen :-)
Birte ist eine sehr nette Gastgeberin und vor Ort hat man alles, was man braucht. Uns hat es sehr gut gefallen und wir würden immer wieder kommen. Danke!
I had a wonderful time and will come back again. Simply put: X studio is a gem.
Heel aangenaam verblijf! Vriendelijke host. Ideaal gelegen. Een aanrader. Zeker met kids ook.
Chambre très confortable et hôte très accueillant et réactif. Merci Gihad!
Excellent location.  Clean, basic apartment that is close to transportation and the city center.  Walking distance to many of the sights.  Ivos was super easy to work with and a great communicator.

Great stay for small to medium sized group, apartment was very clean and beds were comfy. It is also located 5 steps from a U7 platform making it extremely easy to travel the city. 100% recommend this apartment to anyone wanting to visit Berlin.

Appartement adapté pour un séjour de courte durée pour visiter Berlin. Tout le nécessaire est présent sur place.
Tout est conforme à la description présentée.
Very clean, with a lot of amenities and the host even get us a map with points of interest near us
Wunderschöne Wohnung über den Dächern von Berlin! Blitzsauber. Tolle Einrichtung mit Liebe zum Detail. Uneingeschränkt empfehlenswert!
Brilliant host, extremely responsive and catered to all our needs.
Great place to stay in Berlin, would stay again! Great hosts too!
Great spot in a good location for getting everywhere in the city. Extremely reasonably priced.
Séjour très agréable, conforme à la description
Sehr schön, sauber, gute Gegend in der Hinsicht Verkehrsmittel und Einkauf Markt. Rauchen verboten könnte man vielleicht noch ändern aber ansonsten  ales gut.
Everything was great! The place was exactly as described, clean, cosy and comfortable. Julianne was very friendly and communicated everything clearly.

Singer Hostel 109 is a nice hostel. I found it clean and warm, with a nice staff. I appreciated the dormitories with the private kitchen. The loung downstairs was also very cool. Thank you a lot, I will come back!
Max was a fantastic host. Very quick to respond and provided clear instructions. The apartment was very spacious and the area was pleasant. Would recommend.

The flat is amazing and obviously furnished with keen attention to detail. It has everything you could need - the kitchen (surprisingly for an Airbnb) is really well equipped. It is also perfectly clean!! The best Airbnb I have ever stayed in. Highly recommended !!
Logement impeccable pour deux voyageurs.  A 20 minutes d'Alexander Platz. Des cafés autour pour petit déjeuner,  un bon accueil et un tarif super doux.

i stayed at this apartment for 5 night. Max wasn't around when I was there. However the building manager Friedrich was really friendly. The apartment was just next to the canal which was nice..And had a lot of eating places around it. It was clean and proper. I was comfortable there. Train station is really close by and close to Berlin mitte. I will recommend this place if you are in Berlin! Thanks Max and Friedrich!

We wanted to rent another flat by Annika, but as we requested a late checkout, she kindly offered this one to grant us our wish. The flat was sparkling clean and had everything you may need to have breakfast and cook there. The bed is comfortable and the flat quite spacious. We thought that as Berlin is such a big city, we’d mostly use public transport, but given the flat’s proximity to some landmarks and the lovely surrounding neighbourhood, we walked a lot. Everything went just fine and communication with the host was very good. Thank you Annika!
Perfect place to stay for a long week-end in Berlin, as clean and cosy as it is in the pictures, very practical. We would definitely book with Numa again for another trip in Berlin.

Notre séjour dans l'appartement s'est très bien passé. Le logement est très bien situé, avec des transports à proximité (U-Bahn, S-Bahn, Tram), idéal pour un voyage d'affairel comme un séjour touristique. Le quartier est très bien, calme et avec supermarché, restaurants et pharmacie tout proches. L'appartement est agréable, propre et rénové. Nous recommandons !
Apartamento bien situado y bien comunicado con el centro. Pero faltaban detalles como gel y champu.

O local de Ivos é fantástico! Muito perto da alexanderplatz e de um ótimo mercado. O apartamento é bem espaçoso, ideal para uma casal. Estava tudo muito limpo e exatamente como na descrição. A vista é ótima e rendeu algumas boas fotos. Os eletrodomésticos e utensílios estavam em bom estado e funcionando perfeitamente. Tivemos uma ótima passagem por Berlim e o lugar do Ivos contribuiu muito para isso. Esperamos voltar algum dia.

The stay at Ute’s place was very pleasant. The house was nice, in a quiet zone. The self check in was easy. Ute was very nice and responsive.
Thank you for having us! :)

Matthias was very welcoming, his sister met us at the door and showed us around. She was very nice to us and was able to communicate perfectly. They both answered our questions right away and were easy to talk to. The flat is beautiful, and looks exactly how it does in the photos. The beds are very comfortable, and the kitchen is well-equipped. It would have been nice to have a microwave, but the oven works well. The neighborhood is nice, the flat is near a lot of good restaurants (and next door to a supermarket) and is a short drive away from many historical sites. Great to come back to after a long day sightseeing. Overall, it was a wonderful stay and I would definitely like to stay in Matthias' house again when I come back to Berlin.
Wszystko zgodne z opisem. Czysto, cicho i przytulnie. Polecam!

The flat is amazing, has everything you need. Very spacious and cool. We missed the trampoline though! Beds are really comfy, and the area is quiet but very close to lots of bars and restaurants as well as the U-Bahn. Communication with Floccus was really easy. Will definitely stay here again!

We hebben een fijne tijd gehad in Berlijn. Het appartement bevat alles wat je nodig hebt voor een comfortabel verblijf. OV verbinding richting het centrum was goed en vlakbij had je voldoende supermarkten. Een rustig en ruim appartement.

Everything was good. Room has all the needed stuff for short stay, smooth checkin and checkout.
Few small problems were that toilet shower was broken, Once the entry electronic keypad to enter building stopped working. They was a board to enter the building from backside in German. But, they clarified it pretty quickly when asked in Airbnb chat.
Es war alles wirklich sehr gut. Das Appartement ist geräumig und sauber. Wir (und unser Hund Smilla)) wurden perfekt in Empfang genommen. Die Lage ist bestens! Vielen Dank und gerne wieder!
Nice, modern, well located and clean appartment. Recommend
perfekte Unterkunft, insbesondere für junge Leute

Numa ist quasi ein großes Hotel mit kleinen Appartements, alles gut durchdacht, es gibt sogar die Möglichkeit sich Yogamatten auszuleihen. Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder.
Gut fanden wir, dass die Möglichkeit gab einen Checkout bis 13 Ihr dazu zu buchen und dann auch die Möglichkeit noch die Koffer in dem Hotel zu verwahren.

Perfect place for a trip to Berlin! Walking distance from Alexanderplatz, Museum Insel, and even the Tiergarten. Plenty of dining in the area, and easy to find good vegan options if you’re in need. Stephanie the host is very accommodating and friendly as well.

Wer gerne in der Nähe des Zentrums von Berlin im Grünen übernachten möchte, ist hier an der richtigen Adresse. Das Gartenhäuschen liegt sehr ruhig und trotzdem nah bei der nächsten Tramhaltestelle. Zwei grosse Einkaufsläden in 5 Minuten Laufentfernung runden das Bild ab. Die Gastgeber waren beide sehr aufmerksam und antworteten jeweils zeitnah. Wir können die Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.

Great communication and easy check in. We enjoyed our time in this Airbnb. However, pillows were a little uncomfortable. Public transport was easy to locate and use which was required to get to iconic landmarks. Overall great Airbnb and thanks for having us.
Eine ganz tolle Ferienwohnung mit einem ganz besonderen Flair! Wunderschön direkt am Wasser gelegen, sehr sauber und sehr nette Vermieter!

Die Unterkunft war sehr schön und für die Gegend ehr ruhig und gemütlich. Die Räume sind sehr schön, sauber und groß. Die Küche und das Wohnzimmer konnte wir mitnutzen.
Der Kontakt mit Rehana gestaltete sich sehr einfach und sie war jederzeit erreichbar für uns. Die Lage war perfekt für uns und die Anbindung an die Stadtmitte ist sehr gut.
Nachdem uns die Schlüssel ausgehändigt wurden , waren wir jederzeit unabhängig und konnten kommen und gehen wie es für uns passte.
Wir empfehlen die Unterkunft weiter und würden selbst wieder hier her kommen. Danke!!

Great place to stay in Berlin! Super clean and modern with helpful information via QR code all around the house.
And amazing hosts! Really nice touches with great suggestions and even surprise gifts :-)

Great for our needs, very comfortable, easy to access the surrounding area.
It was a very quick trip to run the Berlin marathon but was perfect.
Alison
Wir haben es wirklich genossen) Sauber, ruhig, sehr praktische Lage. Ugur ist ein freundlicher Gasrgeber.Vielen Dank 😁

Great place. High ceilings. Lots of light. Very confortable. Big bathroom for europe. And close to famous places. Try mama cook great Vietnamese restaurant.
Will stay here again. Lovely place

Für Personen, die ein sehr gut gelegenes Zimmer brauchen ist das Zimmer sehr gut gelegen. Leider wurden wir bei Ankunft darüber informiert, dass wir ein anderes Zimmer als gebucht bekommen. Wir hatten leider auch keine eigene Küche.
Kitty was the perfect host! Located right in the center of Prenzelberg, we felt super comfortable in her beautiful studio loft. We‘ll be back, thank you so much Kitty!
Great room at a very good location.

We found Babett’s flat more than met our expectations. It was spotlessly clean, spacious , equipped with every amenity and furnished with restrained and tasteful style.  Communication was excellent - I emailed Babett regarding an issue upon arrival and had it addressed within a few hours! Location on the Mitte/Kreuzberg “border” provided walkable access to many historic and cultural sites. I highly recommend this apartment to my fellow AirBnB travelers.
Total nett und ruhig und optimal organisiert. Wie haben wunderbar geschlafen. Es war total ruhig. Leider war das Wetter nicht so toll aber da kann weder Eric noch Kai etwas dafür...
Amazing place, very well located and incredibly kind hosts. Very recommended! Thanks for the chocolates!🍫

We had a great stay at Andre's place in the Friedrichshain neighborhood of Berlin. It's an artsy, eclectic neighborhood and Andre's apartment fits in well with that aesthetic!
Andre was very proactive and positive in his communication with us. He also put together a guide in his apartment for different restaurants, shopping and activities for his neighborhood. This was very handy for us and was a nice personal touch!
If we make it to Berlin again we'll definitely put Andre's apartment at the top of the list for accommodations. Thanks again!

Die Wohnung von Birgit und Axel war tatsächlich wunderschön... Man kommt hinein, und fühlt sich direkt zu Hause und wohl. Sowohl das Wohnzimmer, inklusive der Musikanlage als auch die Küche waren sehr geschmackvoll, aber auch zweckdienlich eingerichtet, sodass es an nichts gefehlt hatte. Die Fußbodenheizung ist sehr angenehm, und unterstützt die wohlige Atmosphäre sehr. Das Bad hat eine sehr großzügige ebenerdige Dusche.
Alles in Allem einer der schönsten Unterkünfte die ich in der letzten Zeit bewohnen durfte.... Die Verkehrsanbindung nach B-Mitte ist genauso, wie die der Supermarkt innerhalb von 5 Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar.
Liebe Dank noch mal an die beiden Gastgeber, Markus
Had a wonderful stay and the view of the sunset from the apartment was spectacular
Nice place in a great location with a very friendly and fun host.

Wij verbleven in een schone, heel mooi ingerichte studio, van alle gemakken voorzien. Goede locatie, prettige receptionisten, lekkere bedden. Enige nadeel was dat het erg warm was binnen, met alleen een ventilator lukte het niet om het veel kouder te krijgen.

Very spacious and tidy room with kitchenette and private bathroom in a great neighbourhood, very quiet inside the flat but walking distance to Kurfürstendamm. Basics (coffee, soap etc) are available, host is very friendly and informative.

Lovely, well equipped apartment in a nice neighbourhood. Right next to a bus stop, and lots of cafes and bars. Had everything we needed for a week’s stay ☺️ also perfect instructions for arriving and getting into the apartment- even in the dark!
Nice place and the description was very accurate
Schöne und saubere Unterkunft. Ich kann sie nur empfehlen. Immer wenn ich nach Berlin komme, werde ich dort buchen. Die Rezeptionistin ist sehr flexibel

Daniele was very friendly host.
Okay his place is good and you can go mostly wherever in 30mins by public transportations.
Host was really nice and a decent person, but still friendly.
Thanks for letting me in your place :)

Prachtige accommodatie. Je voelt je er snel thuis. Alles heel schoon. Prachtige centrale locatie maar heel rustig. We komen
graag terug. Charlotte en Marjolein
Great flat, great host
Alles top für einen Berlin Trip. Lage super Zentral

Der Aufenthalt war gut und die Lage des Airbnb‘s ist perfekt. Alles was man benötigt ist leicht zu erreichen. Es wurde klar und deutlich mit dem vermieter Kommuniziert und man wurde auf dem laufendem gehalten wenn es etwas gab das wir wissen mussten. Insgesammt war es einen super Aufenthalt!

For this stay the host was really helpful and responsive over messages making the check in go really smoothly allowing us to check in early even though dealing with our flight delays. The flat was really nice and was in a great location for exploring Berlin with easy access to public transport. Saw the bakery across the road was recommended in previous reviews and can definitely vouch for that! Would definitely recommend this as a stay for exploring Berlin!
Super logement, bien placé !
Great apartment, clean and in a great neighborhood. Responsive hosts, replied to all my questions pretty quick!
goede locatie. nette appartement en was schoon. vlakbij de trein en metro.
Very smooth check in/out. Close to Ubahn station.
Tolle Unterkunft, waren sehr zufrieden!
I like the hotel very much. This is second time I am here. And I will come again :)

Super schöne, ruhige und wunderschöne Lage sehr dicht nach Berlin und Potsdam.
Herrliche Gegend um entspannt Spazieren zugehen oder mit Blick aufs Wasser einfach zu chillen.

We had an amazing time with Sabine. The room was very nice and everything was really clean. Sabine is a kind person who gave good tips on things to do in the city and public transport. We would definitely stay here again if return to Berlin.

Couldn’t ask for a better accommodation for the price I paid. The amenities that were listed were pristine and spacious.
Excellent location. Multiple big chain grocery stores in walking distance as well as easy access to various public transportation.
The room was big and clean, comfortable bed, and the kitchen and bathrooms were so clean. 100% would recommend if you’re visiting Berlin!!!

Loved the altbau area. Felt right at home from Leipzig, everything just felt bigger scale. Gorgeous Wohnung felt like a retreat. Linda helped me get around the area, and super flexible with my schedule.
The place was amazing! Perfect for 4 for a few days in Berlin. Close to lots of things and right on the tram for easy travel around the city

Wonderful stay here. Allen was kind, warm and we felt instantly welcome! It was a pleasure to spend time with her and her family. We were provided a super comfy bed, in a room with a gorgeous view overlooking Berlin, and there was everything we needed to cook in the flat.
The location itself was residential and quiet, next to a large supermarket and 2 tram lines going into different parts of the city. There were very easy and frequent transport links into the city.
Thankyou Allen!
A clean and comfortable place to stay that’s close to city center!

Het appartement voldeed aan alle verwachtingen. Comfortabel, goed geoutilleerd, schoon en rustig.

Great AirBnb. The room is super spacious and well illuminated, and everything is clean as should be. Highly recommend this one, don’t hesitate for a second!!

Casa molto carina ed accogliente.Pur essendo nel piano interrato ha finestre in tutte le stanze.Cucina attrezzata,lavatrice,lavastoviglie tutto quanto serve per rendere accogliente un ambiente. Nicole è molto gentile, siamo arrivati con un'ora di anticipo e senza chiderle nulla ci ha immediatamente anticipato il check in portandoci le chiavi. Appartamento vicinissimo alla stazione sulla linea U2.Consigliato
Tutto come descritto, ottimo alloggio!

I had a wonderful stay at this cozy Airbnb in Berlin! The room, located in the host’s flat, offered a perfect balance of privacy and comfort. It was clean, spacious, and thoughtfully designed, making it feel like a home away from home. Having access to laundry service was incredibly convenient.
Laila was fantastic—very responsive, friendly, and accommodating, ensuring that everything went smoothly. The location was also ideal, with easy access to public transport and nearby amenities. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a relaxing and hassle-free stay in Berlin!

Chouette logement conforme à la description, petit mais suffisant pour un séjour court. Ann-Kristin a été réactive et compréhensive par rapport à notre retard et nous la remercions pour ça (nous sommes arrivés pendant la grève des transports) !
Preis-Leistungsverhältnis war super und die Gastgeber waren sehr freundlich. Die Unterkunft ist ein guter Rückzugsort, um Berlin zu entdecken.

Mein Mann und ich hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in der Unterkunft. Sie liegt ruhig in einem sehr schönen Berliner Hinterhof, ist aber trotzdem sehr hell. Die Einrichtung ist modern und gemütlich. Es gibt alles, was man benötigt. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen.

Lovely apartment in a wonderful neighborhood just above Berlin's city center. Will definitely return here when next in Berlin!

The apartment was absolutely clean and has a good location close to the metro (train) station, just 15-20 minutes to Alexanderplatz. There is a fully equipped kitchen and the rooms are nicely decorated. We really enjoyed our stay there. Cheers Me Hien and thank you for your hospitality!:)
Wohnung war toll. Gastgeber auch:)

Super chouette appartement, super accueil ! Très bon plan, situé tout près d'Alexandrrplatz, super propre, charmant, franchement rien a dire :)

Schöne und saubere Unterkunft. Hat uns gut gefallen 😊
für unseren zweck solide. kommunikation sehr gut. an ein paar Stellen kann noch etwas nachgebessert werden, zb das laute bett und die Abdichtung der dusche

spacious, nice flat in a good location, with room to put down your clothes. Timo is super friendly and responsive.
Tolles Appartement für ein paar Tage City-feeling. Gerne wieder!
Great place, minimalisticlly furnished apartment with everything we needed. The sauna was fantastic. The area was very quiet and calm but with many bars close by.
Jerome was great - really enjoyed staying at his place!

L'appartamento è stato perfetto per il nostro soggiorno. È pulito, confortevole e in una posizione ideale. La vicinanza alle fermate del tram ha reso gli spostamenti molto facili, e avere un supermercato a due passi è stato incredibilmente comodo. Consigliatissimo!

Really loved Philipp's apartment...super close to the metro and grocery store and in a very walkable neighborhood. The place was sparkling clean, had fast wifi, laundry, and the bed was super comfy. Great communication throughout and detailed instructions for self check in. Berlin is an amazing city, hope to stay there again.
Nicely designed appartement with good location. Very close to public transport and lively neighbourhood with relaxed vibe. Communication with host by mail only (our guess due to corona concerns).

This apartment is part of what appears to be a segmented larger apartment. There are multiple units behind the first door in a single hallway.
The checkin process was very simple and effective, and the video for how to check in was greatly appreciated. The space is clean and perfect for a few travelers. The loft bed is really nice (though the steps are a bit steep) and the couch is a perfect sleeper for a single person or a couple.
The kitchenette served its purpose for us (we really only needed the fridge) and the TV gave us a way to relax at the end of our day of sightseeing (though you need to bring your own cables!). Bathroom was sufficient and water pressure was great in the shower. Would definitely recommend and would stay again!

Una estada molt agradable amb un amfitrió molt atent que sempre ens ha posat facilitats. La llar molt neta i molt espaiosa. És destacable que, tot i que les zones comuns son compartides, la convivència ha estat molt positiva i realment no hem vist alterada la nostra privacitat.
Moltes gràcies Alexander per obrir-nos les portes de casa teva, tenim ganes de tornar a Berlín i repetir l'experiència :)

Die Wohnung entsprach unseren Erwartungen. Sehr zweckmäßig und alles da, was man für einen Familienaufenthalt braucht. Was uns sehr positiv aufgefallen ist: bei geschlossenen Fenstern ist es wirklich sehr ruhig - trotz der vielbefahrenen Hauptstraße vor dem Haus. Die Lage ist sehr zentral und perfekt für Ausflüge in alle Richtungen. Wir würden nochmal wieder kommen.

The apartment is located at the heart of Berlin where tourist attractions are nearby. It is near to supermarkets and public transport like buses and trains. If you are coming during winter season, the apartment is well equipped with adjustable heaters. Most importantly, the host, Vladimir, provide us with useful knowledge and responded timely whenever we have enquiries. Even when we reached the apartment around 9pm, they still wait for arrival and see through our check in. Overall, if you prefer a condominium style of AIRBNB with a nice environment, this apartment will suit your needs.
Really nice and cosy room. I enjoyed my short stay and can definitive recomment it. Peace!
Very clean pleace,pretty close to metro station,very nice service and very good quality at a low price.Five stars!
Super Innenhof, kurzer Weg zur U- Bahn Station, einige Restaurants und Supermärkte in unmittelbarer Nähe, für unsere Kurzwoche in Berlin perfekt !!
bon accueil,la personne était très agréable. le logement propre et calme , bien isolé. Je conseille vivement.
Really nice mini suite, clean and modern. just a microwave was missing to make it perfect
El apartamento es tal y como se ve en las fotos, la ubicación es perfecta, tienes todo a mano y muy bien comunicado. Sin duda repetiría otra vez, 100x100 recomendable
L’ostello si trova nel quartiere residenziale di Charlottenburg, è a 5 minuti dal castello e dal parco. Le stanze sono essenziali, ma comode. Host veloce nelle risposte è molto gentile. Grazie!
Everything fine and as described
Goede prijs-kwaliteit verhouding .  Net, schoon verblijf dat helemaal voldoet aan de verwachtingen. Goede ligging in het centrum .
Great location.
Good communication with host, great location, we had a really nice time in a place which was very clean and has everything we needed.

Nice location, great prices. Room wasn’t that amazing though. You can see into the bathroom from the living room so there’s little privacy. The lighting isn’t great either. Basically expect a nice clean convenient hostel room to come back to after exploring the city , but not a room for relaxing.
Eine sehr schöne Wohnung, einfacher und flexibler Check-in, die UBahn U2 und U7 sind 5 Minuten zu Fuß entfernt. Also alles super und wir kommen gerne wieder :)

Great apartment for a group of friends and the locations was also really good. Close to two metro-stations and also a lot of places to eat and shop nearby. A really big grocery store is right by the apartment.

L’emplacement est superbe c’est composés de deux grandes chambres lumineuses et la partie cuisine ouvert avec table à manger est dans une des chambres côtés rue. Idéal pour un groupe de 4 personnes. La salle de bain avec une douche et WC est assez grande. Proche de métro et de trame et très centrale. Tara a été très réactif à nos demandes. Merci pour tout.
Everything was very good. House is clean and cosy. Located not so far away from city centre.

Un appartement qui correspond en tout à la description: très propre, joliment décoré, fonctionnel et bien situé avec ce petit plus: très au calme. L'accueil est chaleureux.

Sehr nettes Apartment! Es is ein wenig nervig dass man so oft den Code eingeben muss und man muss die Heizung selber aufdrehen sonst erfriert man. Aber die Betten sind großartig!

Very very clean studio in a lively part of town. About a twenty minute walk to most of the main attractions. Directly by many metro stations for when  you don’t feel like walking. Excellent communication with hosts. The washer/dishwasher were greatly appreciated! There was no body soap or shampoo, so come prepared. Very nice stay, and highly recommended.
Easy check in, nice place with a fresh bathroom and a balcony!

Sehr nettes, kleines Studio in guter Lage. Check-in und übrige Abwicklung waren super unkompliziert. Gerne wieder!
Stella siempre estuvo atenta a nuestros pedidos! Cercano a los principales lugares turísticos (en bus local llegas en 10 minutos) Un lugar agradable y acogedor!

A beautiful bnb in the center of Berlin. The place is close to the U3 station and located in a peaceful but cultural district. Michael is very friendly and helpful. I’m very satisfied to stay in his house for 5 days.

Max's studio has everything you need for an excellent trip to Berlin. it is well located in a quiet street but very close to the centre, transport links and lots of local bars, restaurants and shops. Communication and check-in was seamless. Recommended
Alles bestens - so soll es sein!
Michael was a lovely host and we are grateful to have stayed at his apartment :)

Needing temporary housing during renovations while pregnant, David's flat was perfect. Conveniently located near home, it felt cozy yet spacious - a true home away from home. The flat had everything needed for a relaxing stay.

Perfect for a city escape, I highly recommend his outstanding rental in a great location. An ideal place for singles or couples with a fantastic host!

I had an excellent stay at this stylish, spacious, and well-furnished apartment. It’s larger than expected and could easily accommodate a bigger group. The bed and mattresses are exceptionally comfortable, ensuring a great night’s rest. The apartment had everything needed for a comfortable and enjoyable visit. The location is ideal, calm and quiet, yet very central. Just around the corner, there are plenty of cafes and bars, so there’s always something to do. The host was incredibly helpful and always responded quickly. I would definitely stay here again!
Sabine und Horst sind sehr Hilfsbereit und offen. Die Wohnungen sind gut ausgestattet,  sauber und gemütlich.  Wir haben uns wohl bei Euch gefühlt.

Our stay was lovely and there’s not really anything to complain about, everything exactly as advertised.

Die Unterkunft ist super ausgestattet und liegt sehr nah an der S-Bahn Station, gerne wieder!
Get what you sign up for, cleanly, good utilities, superb location. Would be nice if there was more autonomy. Would have loved to smoke a cigarette on the balcony but ultimately it wasn't an issue.

Todella siisti, rauhallinen ja hyvällä sijainnilla oleva majoituskohde. Toimiva kokonaisuus. Suosittelen!

Had an enjoyable stay.  The space was as shown in the listing and Matthew was responsive. Would recommend if you’re looking for a central location in Berlin and I would definitely stay here again if available. I felt safe walking around the neighborhood at all hours.

Schone en plezierige ruimte voor 4 personen. Goede bedden, ruime huisraad. Dicht bij openbaar vervoer. Fijne rustige wijk, maar niet bijzonder. Wel een paar eetgelegenheden en supermarkt in de buurt van het appartement! Wij hebben het fijn gehad!
War rundum zufrieden ☺️

Es war echt alles in Ordnung, nur in dem Zimmer hat leider ein Spiegel gefehlt. Für den täglichen Gebrauch, insbesondere zum Ankleiden oder Frisieren, wäre ein Spiegel sehr hilfreich gewesen.
Für einen Citytrip ist alles vorhanden, was man benötigt. Es war sauber und angenehm eingerichtet. Die Bahnstation, Cafés und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind in direkter Umgebung.
Très bon accueil, hôte sympathique ! Appartement cosy et spacieux, très propre et lumineux ! Proche de la station de métro et à 15-20min du centre ville !
This place is good for hipsters looking for somewhere a little more quirky to stay in Berlin. Right next to Templehof Airfield!
Prima plek als je Berlijn wilt verkennen. Je bent zo bij de metro. De bedden waren netjes opgemaakt en er lagen handdoeken voor ons klaar. We hebben het prima naar ons zin gehad!

The attention to detail in this space is incredible with lovely timber joinery and the colour palette is so refreshing compared to countless ikea and chrome and white plasterboard apartments! The bed is like a cosy little timber lined cave and really great perched high up in the space! This place was the Airbnb highlight of my trip!

We had a fantastic stay in this beautiful loft! The gym was impressive, and the view from the apartment was absolutely stunning. The location was perfect—central but peaceful—and we loved exploring all the great spots nearby. Highly recommended!

Amazing place to stay with walkable distance to many attractions of urban Berlin life. The neighbourhood is quite diverse and that gives the proper feeling of staying in Berlin. good location, nice place. breakfast is alright if you are in hurry.

The place is cozy, tastefully designed, and quiet. Bert and Mi Kyung are great hosts, and provided helpful advice about neighbourhood and Berlin in general. Would be happy to stay again!

L'appartement de Stephan est très agréable, décoré avec goût, très bien équipé et parfaitement propre. La cour intérieure où il se situe est pleine de caractère.
Stephan est attentif aux demandes, et chaleureux.
Nous avons tout fait à vélo : l'appartement est à trente minutes au plus des principaux quartiers de la ville, une ville tellement riche historiquement.

An excellent little home for a few days. My daughter loved the high-up bed and the noise people complained about on these reviews was minimal at most! It was plenty warm for our December stay too. A very cute little place for our small family to stay x
Place was great, very comfortable, definitely suited our needs. Very conveniently located.

Heel fijn verblijf gehad. Goede omgeving en prima te doen vanaf metro halte Hermannplatz. Authentiek Duitsland ervaren.

tido fantástico. buena zona y muy tranquilo, el apartamento es tal cual como en las fotos. sin duda volvería

Maurice’s place is perfectly located in an area near to local spots as well as more touristy destinations. The shower was finicky and which could have been a one time issue but worth noting.

I didn't travel to Berlin in the end as the trade fair I  wanted to attend was cancelled. However, Enrique was very kind and helpful with the cancellation of my booking. The communication with him in general was excellent.

Das war ein schöner Trip. Nette Menschen, zwei freundliche Kater.

we had a very nice weekend here. lovely flat, perfect location, very trustful hosts... definitely a recommendation. for the next get-away in berlin we´ll be staying here again for sure!
Wohnung wie im Inserat beschrieben. Sehr attraktive Lage, fußweit vom Alex, gute Verkehrsanbindung. Ideal für Sightseeing
Maximilian war zum Check-In vor Ort, was das Einchecken unkompliziert gestaltet hat, eine kurze Einweisung in die Unterkunft... immer wieder gern als Unterkunft in Zukunft.
Super zentrale Lage und alles wie beschrieben! Der Park in der Nähe sowie viele Restaurants und Museen runden den Besuch ideal ab! :)

This apartment is what you see on the pictures which is in itself a good start. Hosts were quick and forthcoming during preparation and in the arrangement of our arrival. They also left some good tips for local highlights.
This apartment is very well situated at the edge of the Kreuzberg area. Bus stop in 100m and metros within 750m to take you anywhere.
The apartment itself is spacious. Large kitchen & dining area, decent-sized sitting room, bedrooms (good beds!) with useful ventilators and two well equipped bathrooms (good showers!). A bit of traffic noise on the street side and sometimes a bit of neighbor noise on the backside. But still it’s a quiet spot after a day in the busy city.
The lack of a private garden or balcony is more than compensated by the park across the street (which also has the Golgatha beer garden which we much enjoyed).
I would strongly recommend both this location and these hosts.
I was a great experience. So much things to do in this area

Das Apartment liegt verkehrsgünstig, nahezu alles ist gut mit dem ÖPNV zu erreichen, ein Supermarkt befindet sich direkt neben der Haustür. Freundlicher und unkomplizierter Gastgeber mit einer spannenden Vita. Malteserhündin Ruby ist zuckersüß.
Great place! It was very clean and in a great location!
Margarete is a super nice host, everything was perfect during our stay :) liebe grüsse aus Frankreich!

Es war unglaublich schön! Marie war super lieb und die Wohnung ist wunderschön eingerichtet. Die Busverbindung war auch top und es gibt einen Spielplatz direkt daneben, sowie Zugang zur Spree. Also 10/10 für den Aufenthalt!
Quick but lovely stay!
It was a great stay :)!
Alles war super,komplikationsloser geht es nicht !:)

A great and practical stay for families and dog lovers. Great location and facility (access to the pool and sauna is a big plus), easy to walk to the next U-Bahn station/public transport, great restaurants around. The place has all you need for a pleasant and comfortable stay. We'll be back for sure.

Jan’s apt is very comfortable, cool, and convenient. It is located in a very walkable neighborhood with close proximity to cafes, parks, and transportation. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay again our next time in Berlin. Jan is a very accessible and accommodating host.
The location is very good, the building and street clean and quit. General impression of the flat and owner is pretty good. Much recommended!

Sehr empfehlenswerte Wohnung!
Sehr netter freundlicher Gastgeber, der uns ausführliche Informationen gegeben hat, sodass wir unseren Aufenthalt rundum genießen konnten. Wir können die Wohnung und den Gastgeber jederzeit empfehlen!
Spitzenmäßig!
Danke hat alles gepasst.
Happy with place

Stefan's place is perfect for single travelers or couples. Apartment has everything you need even for a longer stay. I had really nice time in Berlin when staying in Stefan's place.
We highly recommend this Airbnb. It’s beautifully decorated & super clean - located in a great area and the breakfast is just the cherry on top! 10/10
From the location, to the cleaning and the room by itself, everything was really good. The only thing is that there was not possible to communicate via Airbnb.

Appartamento molto comodo e vicino ai mezzi pubblici.

Very convenient location. Great value. A bit noisy if the window is open.

Aufenthalt in der Wohnung war nur auf Nacht- und Morgenzeiten beschränkt. Durch zentrale Lage unmittelbar an U-Bahn Station  Kurfürstenstraße war eine sehr gute Anbindung gegeben.

We would certainly recommend this cute apartment in Berlin. Only ten minutes walking from some major highlights of the city, like Museuminsel and Alexanderplatz, and with the benefits of an inclusive kitchen, we considered it an ideal accommodation for a city trip. Diego is a kind host who, when home, mostly stays in his own room, so that you as guests can feel free to use all other parts of the apartment. We had a lovely stay!
Die Wohnung ist hell, sauber, nett eingerichtet und man hat alles für ein schönes Wochenende. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Die Unterkunft war total sauber und ist sehr gut angebunden. Wir haben uns direkt total Wohlgefühlt! Sie ist mit allem ausgestattet, was man für einen (kurzen) Trip braucht, es gibt sogar eine Kochzeile. Auch die Kommunikation und der Check-In lief top. Sollten wir nochmal nach Berlin fahren, werden wir die Unterkunft definitiv wieder buchen :)

Lovely apartment with modern furnishings and in a nice location. Great neighborhood to walk around in, especially by the water, and lots of walkable transit nearby. Hosts were great with communicating both before and during the trip, would stay here again!

Great apartment, lots of natural light, comfortable furniture, well equipped kitchen, great wi-fi, and AMAZING location right across from a beautiful little park and seconds away from lots of little cafes and restaurants. Highly recommended.
alles war super

Buen lugar, cerca de la estación de metro, con minimarkets y tiendas para comprar víveres.

The apartment was very centrally located, which made it so easy to have a comfortable, quiet home base while exploring the city. what really stood out was Denny's responsiveness, we had some questions and encountered an issue with the main building door, and he responded to all my messages within minutes and was incredibly helpful and proactive. Thank you!
Guter Preis, muss man echt sagen. Die U Bahn war auch perfekt. Direkt am Hostel.
Really well located, near U-bahn station. Lots of bars and restaurants around. Big room clean and quiet.

Die Unterkunft von Chris war echt super. Check-In und Check-Out liefen sehr unkompliziert und schnell ab. Innen hat man alles, was man benötigt, selbst Geschirr und Besteck ist vorhanden. Die Wohnung an sich liegt zwar an einer größeren Straße, innen ist es jedoch sehr ruhig.
Alles in Allem empfehle ich sie gern weiter und komme gern ein weiteres mal. :D
Beautiful room with so many lovely touches, and Audrey is very kind. One of my favourite neighbourhoods in Berlin. The whole stay was a pleasure!

I had a really enjoyable stay at Emina and Jacob’s beautiful home. Very friendly and helpful hosts. Comfy room as described/ seen in photos. Convenient location but also quiet. Easy to find and great transport links. Plenty of bars and restaurants nearby too.
Lovely airy bedroom and sitting room. A bit noisy some nights. Beautiful courtyard and great location.
Rigtig godt besøg, og en god vært :-)

Wir hatten 5 wunderschöne Tage in Berlin. Man ist in der Stadt und trotzdem im Grünen… einfach schön. Die Erreichbarkeit der öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel ist perfekt. In der Wohnung fehlt es an nichts, man hat sich sofort wie zu Hause gefühlt. Die Kommunikation sowie der Empfang mit Familie Harsdorf war  sehr nett. Wie werden auf jeden Fall wieder kommen.

This flat is in a perfect location.  It was exactly what I was looking for.  The flat itself was absolutely perfect, having everything you possibly need to prep food and use of toiletries.  CLEAN. Shower pressure was the best I've ever experienced on any vacation/location.  Loved it. Would stay again and again!  Apostolos was very kind and helpful.

A nossa estadia com a Charlotte correspondeu largamente às expetativas! A habitação tinha todas as condições para passar uns dias num ambiente familiar e aconchegante. He was kind, the room was very clean.

Mariietta hat ein wunderschönes Zimmer, das geschmackvoll und gemütlich eingerichtet ist. Es liegt zentral an der Oranienstraße direkt neben vielen Cafés, Restaurants und Bars. Vielen Dank Mariietta! :-)

appartement bien équipé et bien placé !
super communication avec Agustin !
war alles top, gerne wieder

Schöne Unterkunft für kleine Familien!
zwei getrennte Schlafräume, eigenes modernes Bad und eigener Balkon;

Wir waren mit unseren beiden Kindern im Miniloft und hatten eine sehr gute Zeit. Das Loft hat eine sensationelle Lage, ist super modern und hat alles an Ausstattung, was man braucht. Was das Loft angeht: Die Bilder sprechen für sich.

Es lief alles wirklich reibungslos und unkompliziert bei Franziska! Die Wohnung und Lage ist toll und sie und ihre Familie nette Gastgeber.
Sehr schöne Wohnung.
Remi’s spot is amazing! Great place for a group stay! And great views!

Uta a été une hôte très réactive, gentille et accueillante. Elle a toujours répondu rapidement à nos messages et à toutes nos questions, nous conseillant des endroits chouettes où nous balader.

Thanks Ursula for the opportunity I had a blast in Berlin and the location of your department is perfect. Thanks for let me use your kitchen I hope I can come back with you soon. <3
The place was as in the photos. The communication was instant and really helpful.

le quartier est très paisible, et à seulement 10 min à pied de la station de metro.

à bientôt Audrey! 👋

Segnaliamo soltanto un paio di aspetti migliorabili: il parco pentole, in particolare le padelle che risultavano inutilizzabili, e la manopola della doccia, che perdeva un po’ d’acqua dal tubo. Con qualche piccolo intervento l’esperienza potrebbe davvero diventare perfetta.

It has great neighbours and vibes around the house. Also the house itself is cozy and nice. The host is calm and communicative as well.
Perfect stay, highly recommend!

Das Appartement war sehr stilvoll eingerichtet und sauber. Die Küche war gut ausgestattet; es gab ausreichend Koch- und Essgeschirr sowie Utensilien zum Spülen. Darüber hinaus gab es ausreichend Handtücher und die Bettwäsche war sauber.
Die Lage ist super gewesen; in 15 Minuten ist man am Alexanderplatz zu Fuß. In 10 Minuten mit dem Taxi an der Mercedes Benz Arena. Um die Ecke des Appartement gibt es einige Restaurants, welche gutes Essen für kleines Geld servieren.
Mein einziger Minuspunkt ist die Matratze. Sie ist sehr dünn und man liegt schnell auf dem Lattenrost.

Das AirBnb fühlt ich wie ein zweites Zuhause an. Es ist sehr sauber und die Lage war ebenfalls super. Unser Highlight war Hardi als Host mit seiner gastfreundlichen Art. Wir haben uns sehr willkommen gefühlt und er hatte immer einen Tipp für uns.

Semplicemente perfetto!
Stanza privata con accesso indipendente. Pulizia e ordine impeccabili.
Posizione comodissima: vicino a fermate autobus e stazione + vari ristoranti e supermercati.
Great stay. Clean and convenient.
Thanks for the stay!

Een prettig apartment in een rustiger deel van Berlijn. Met de U-Bahn voor de deur ben je binnen enkele minuten overal. Verdere plus: het park Charlottenburg, het balkon, de Spree en een goed Italiaans restaurant om de hoek.
Super kind host! Very cute and clean little corner that can incredibly offer everything in a perfect position.
Das schönste Zimmer, das ich je in Berlin gesehen habe. Alles war perfekt. Wenn ich zurückkomme, wird dies meine erste Wahl sein!

Amazing stay!! Very close to public transport and clubs which was perfect for us! We were 3 young people and it was perfect for us to rest and relax in between exploring Berlin. Loft is a little squeaky but very doable. Thanks for a great weekend!
Very nice flat in a peaceful area. Very clean and tidy. The beds were incredibly comfortable ! Have a wonderful stay at Sören’s

A hospedagem do Ivos tem um excelente custo / benefício . me senti em casa , próximo dos principais pontos de Berlim e com uma vista maravilhosa. Ótima hospedagem para explorar Berlim. A cidade é incrível,pretendo voltar mais vezes.  Obrigado Ivos
Tolle Lage, herrlicher Ausblick auf die Spree und wenn dann ein Frachtschiff bei Nacht vorbeifährt, ist dass eine herrliche Atmosphäre.
Nice, clean place right in the center of Berlin. Axel was friendly and accommodating.
Friendly staff at reception👍
It’s really clean,nice and convenient.Self check in and check out is also convenient.Next time when I travel to Berlin ,I will live there.
Apartment feels like a home far away from home :) Many places with food around the apartment, big bathtub and of course amazing host. Thank you Atto!
The apparent it was so nice, clean and the most important it was near the train station and it was so near with the most important place in berlin.

This apartment is located on the same block as the S1, with many U and S-Bahns also very, very close by. It is a scoop because of its location, but also Jürg was a tremendous professional, yet personal host who accomodated my move in- and out-plans accordingly to my flight schedules. This was highly appreciated, and everything all together was just perfect for the kind of vacation I was planning to have.
If you need snacks or a beer, theres a snack store next doors. If you need grocerys, to maybe fix your own breakfasts at home before your busy berlin vacation days, you can conveniently shop at Penny or Aldi less than 300m from the apt. Theres also a nice burger joint around the corner, and if you walk a little further in that direction, you get to the exciting part of Wedding. Which actually is a lovely neighboorhood.
Cant praise this place enough. Dont wait!

Le logement est idéalement placé à Charlottenburg, à 5-10 min soit du métro soit d'un bus rapprochant du centre. Il est bien équipé, agréable. Je recommande pour in séjour à Berlin sans être trop loin du centre !
Alles super unkompliziert geklappt. Sehr schöne Wohnung mit moderner Einrichtung! Gerne wieder!
Eine sehr schöne und saubere Wohnung! Die Lage war top! Immer wieder gerne
Great place to stay, has all the information that you'd need to get around anywhere. Highly recommend.

great location for those who want to have the opportunity to get some time in not only in the city of Berlin but also at the beautiful park next to the apartment with lots of wildlife. Despite there being water damage it's still a nice apartment!

We really enjoyed our short stay at Thomas's place. It was exactly what you expected when looking at the pictures and getting into the apartment was very easy with the access code. great apartment, I will choose it again next time I go to Berlin
Sehr komfortables Appartment, mit allem was man so braucht, schöne Küche, schickes Bad, stilvoll renoviert. Gute Lage in direkter Nähe zum rbb und zur Messe, U-Bahn, S-Bahn.

Все классно, ясно, понятно и четко. Вы молодцы!

So close to the transportation station. Convenient to get to anywhere. Generally quiet at night. Feel not that secure since the door can be directly opened with a just password while without any additional key to lock the door supplementarily for security at night and during sleeping.

Agnes and her husband Lorant are so friendly and welcoming, and gladly shared tips and suggestions about Berlin. The room was great for two people, and the location is excellent - I have stayed in less central parts of Friedrichshain, etc, and felt that I needed to spend twice the amount of time traveling between things. So if you are trying to do a lot in a short time in a sprawling city like Berlin, this is an excellent choice.
It was a nice tri0. Axel is a good man. Thanks for everything

Our host Ronald was great - he greeted us at the apartment to show us around and give us tips on the neighborhood. The location couldn't have been any better - in the middle of everything, yet on a quiet block and only a minute walk to the subway station. I'd stay here again if I was visiting Berlin.

Le quartier était super, plein de petites boutiques pour manger, quelques bars aussi. Le gros avantage : très proche du tramway , à moins de 3 min et proche du métro, à environ 10min.
L'appartement est super, très moderne, très design et très fonctionnel. Il est plus grand qu'il ne paraît sur les photo.
De plus à notre arrivé nous avons eu une bouteille de vin et des chocolats, c'était un très bel accueil. Enfin nous n'avons manqué de rien, il y avait tout ce qu'il nous fallait : liquide vaisselle, savon pour les mains, serviettes, draps, produits ménagers, et quelques aliments de base!
C'était une expérience génial, nous nous sommes beaucoup amusés et nous recommandons cet appartement! Nous reviendrons ! :)

Alles super! Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt - tolles Ambiente. Auch eine hervorragende Lage mit tollen Essensmöglichkeiten. Schon eine besondere Unterkunft, wenn auch nicht ganz günstig. Ich werde gerne wiederkommen!

Our stay in Berlin was amazing and a big part of it was because we stayed in Julian's apartment. We felt at home from the first moment and it was the perfect place for us, a small family of 3 people (1 child), who would work remotely and enjoy Berlin for a little over 3 weeks.
It's really more beautiful and spacious than it looks in the photos. Also quiet, something we always keep in mind, especially when it comes to sleeping. We had everything we needed to cook and keep the house clean and tidy. On the other hand, the apartment was always very well heated for the low temperatures in Berlin at this time of year.
Julian is very communicative and attentive; when we had any small questions, he always responded quickly and with clear instructions.
The neighborhood is super quiet, just a few minutes by U5 from the city center, and with nearby means of transport that will take you anywhere. There are many things to do and see nearby.
It was definitely everything we needed and more :)

I had a great time by Caroline. The flat is big, in a great neighbourhood, the room is huge. Caroline and flatmates are the kindest, nicest persons. I was really like home, on my own when I wished, and when we wished we also had very nice talks and interactions.
I recommend this place without any hesitation.

The location of Arne’s apartment is brilliant with both the S and U Bahn a few minutes walk away, and puts you very close to the heart of Berlin
The apartment itself is perfect for couples who are not wanting to cook and just use it as a base to get out into Berlin, with the added bonus of the terraces giving you sunshine at the start and end of the day.

Arne is a tremendous host with great communication and gave us some good hints in getting around
We changed our arrival time at short notice which Arne was very good to accommodate, especially when our flight was delayed as well.
So to summarise
1) Top bloke

3) Top area

Great value for what you pay, nothing bad to say about it.
Amazing stay.

The apartment is beautiful, very comfortable and close to transport. Philipp communicated well. Definitely recommended.

Germán was easy to communicate with and the apartment was very clean and bigger than it looked like in the pictures. I felt right at home and had a very comfortable stay. Thank you Germán!

Great stay! Amazing views and peaceful location. Getting upstairs to sleep is a bit uncomfortable, also single beds mattresses are not comfortable, we didn't have good rest. Improving this would make this apartment just perfect.
Thank you!

Marius was an exceptional host. As a fellow Airbnb host myself, I always look for the little things that make the stay special.
He held our luggage before our check-in time which was amazing! He greeted us in person and gave us a tour of the home and even told us a little history of the space. He was available for anything we needed and the home is stocked with everything one would need. It's tasteful, refined, clean,and super comfortable, not to mention in a great location near everything and Alexanderplatz. He even has a section where you can buy items instead of having to go out and buy them elsewhere which was a great touch.
Overall, it's obvious how much he cares about his home, the way the space looks and the service he provides for his guests. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this apartment and host which again are exceptional.

the toilet is an ancient relic from the soviet era it's an antique I could not take a proper dump because the surface was so close to my backside I'd end up making a mess.
I got given a children's towel to dry myself.
Great modern apartment with amazing view in convenient location. It was clean, checking in and out super easy, and owners were very helpful. I am happy to come again.

I loved staying in this cool, clean, spacious apartment; the sauna was so enjoyable. The flat is just as described, spotlessly clean with a minimalistic and cool vibe. Gal provided very detailed instructions on how to find the flat, so even though there were a few steps to take to get from the street to the flat, I had no issues checking in. The apartment's location, hidden in an inner yard, made it calm and quiet despite being in a lively neighborhood with bars, restaurants, and a grocery store just a few steps away. The only thing that would have made my stay even smoother would have been to receive quicker responses from Gal. Still, everything was sorted out eventually, and she was always very polite and helpful in her comms. I would definitely love to stay here again, thank you!
Very nice, clean and large apartment. Everything eorked perfectly, and the hosts were excellent at communicating.
Excelente lugar para conocer la ciudad y pasar un par de días.

Schönes kleines Zimmer. Sehr stilvoll und liebevoll eingerichtet mit Blick zum Detail. Nette Begrüssung durch den Gastgeber. Der Ort ist historisch und ich habe den Blick nach Aussen genossen. Alles gut erreichbar. Perfekt für einen Kurzurlaub in Berlin. Ich komme wieder dann mit meinem Fahrrad.

Wir kommen gerne wieder :-)
Perfect stay ! Would recommend to anyone. Ideal for babies : baby crib, High chair, plastic fork and plate, baby shampoo... Our 10 months old son spent a great week.

Schöne, saubere und ruhig gelegene Wohnung zum Innenhof mit gut ausgestatteter Küche. Perfekt mit Kids. Sören war sehr gut erreichbar und hat uns bei Ankunft gleich zum richtigen Eingang gelotst. Regionalbahn fährt ab Jungfernheide in 2 Stopps zum Hbf und  Potsdamer Platz. Parkplätze nur auf Straße und ggf. abends Mangelware.

Das Apartment ist wirklich sehr schön und gemütlich!
Wir haben uns total wohl gefühlt :-)
Very nice flat, good location and very clean. We recommend 👍

appartamento molto bello e confortevole, il riscaldamento funzionava benissimo, qualita delle lenzuola e cuscini impeccabile. unica cosa le luci della camera erano un po' troppo chiare e molto accese, consiglio una luce da notte piu' soffusa

Great flat, very large, with a big living room and 2 bedrooms. The flat was perfectly clean. Located at the first floor of a building with a lift, and just in the middle of a living and so funny district. The kitchen is perfectly well equipped with full of vessels to do the cooking and to eat, with microwave, coffee pot with filter, boiler,  oven, cooking plates, and so on. The bathroom is also nice with a large mirror, a washing-machine, a shower. Cold and hot water work perfectly in the bathroom. The WI-FI worked also without problem in all other the flat. No problem either with the heater; the special heater under the floor in the bathroom is really pleasant when you leave the shower in bare feet. The little bedroom (who gives on the kitchen) has no window and no radiator; so you don’t have to be claustrophobic to sleep in it (and not too much cold feet; but under the duvet, the temperature is ok); but consequently, this bedroom is very dark and very quiet. And you can find a double beds for young children in this bedroom. The other bedroom (who gives on the living room) is larger, has a large window who gives on a balcony (nice on summer…). All the windows are equipped with special shutters (who look like Venetian blinds) who make rooms enough dark to sleep without eyes mask. But as the flat is located in a living district, at the first floor and as the windows overlook the street, this main bedroom is not really quiet, mainly on the weekend when people eat, drink, speak when they smoke, laugh, cry outside, in the street (there’s a restaurant just under the flat; but the noise doesn’t come from the restaurant; we never heard its music for example). Beds were not made when we arrived, but sheets and towels have to be put down in a basket when you leave the flat. The slats of the bed base in the main bedroom must have to be adjusted if you don’t want to see the mattress sinks. The bed is not really good in this bedroom. The bed  is better in the little bedroom. Be careful with the warden: the welcome is organized by a society (Jörg P***); if you arrive late in the day, you have to pay an additional charge (who increases with the hour); as we arrived at the flat 30 minutes later than expected because of a delay of delivery of our belongings at the airport, Jörg was gone (I sent him a SMS when we get the train at the airport; and he replied me: « Hurry up »; next time, I’ll ask the conductor of the train to go faster), so Anders has to welcome us (fortunately he was there when we arrived).
