Dennoch kommen wir wieder, weil das das erste Mal war, an dem es eher nicht so gut war.
Great location, very clean & modern place. Awesome smart tv. After 4 days came and cleaned. Was an awesome surprise. A little bit pricey, but oversll totally worth it.

This place is a gem. It is in a really lovely neighbourhood with lots of cafe/ restaurants and shopping. It’s close to public transport as well which was great. The place is very comfortable. We have 4 small kids and it was very spacious
It was great! Very comfortable and homey!
sehr einfache Ausstattung, entsprach aber der Insertion.
Alles war gut.
Fire overnatninger med mine drenge. Det var et dejligt og roligt sted. Kort til indkøb og offentlig transport.

Samuel & Roland ont été très accueillants. Ils ont passé du temps pour s’assurer que tout était clair pour moi. L’appartement est idéalement placé sans avoir les nuisances et bruits de l’hypercentre. L’équipement fut à la hauteur de la description.
Todo fue increible. El departamento es muy lindo y fue entregado super limpio. Javier es un genio que nos ayudo con todo!!

Eine grosszügige Wohnung im Kern von Steglitz. Alles ganz nah, auch die U oder S-Bahn ins Zentrum Berlin. Perfekt!
Leonor ist eine freundliche, unkomplizierte und grosszügige Gastgeberin.
Wir haben uns in dieser sehr schönen Wohnung sehr wohlgefühlt. Herzlichen Dank Leonor!
Christian Schaub

Perfekte Unterkunft für 1-2 Personen mit guter Lage und Allem für eine gute Zeit in Berlin.
Gastgeber auch zuvorkommend und freundlich.
Gerne wieder :)
Tutto ottimo

I really liked staying at Elizabeth’s flat - wonderfully decorated and well stocked with essentials - I felt very at home!
The flat is convenient to public transportation and is walkable to a large variety of boutique shops and restaurants. It is located in one of Berlin’s loveliest neighborhoods in Prenzlauer Berg. Elisabeth was very pleasant and quick to respond whenever I had questions.

As a single traveler this is a great place to stay! Big room, big comfortable bed. Shared bathroom, but never any inconveniences during my stay. Location is perfect for Kreuz/Fried. Great swift communication with the host. Good price for what you get.
Das Zimmer war für den preis sehr gut, der Gastgeber sehr nett, die Gegend jedoch etwas zwielichtig.
really cute and cozy apartment. it was really warm und good connection to the public transportation.
Nice flat with OK space for two adults and to middle-sized-kids. Shower with good water pressure, and well equipped kitchen.

Ich kann mich dem positiven Feedback nur anschließen ;)
Sabine hat uns herzlich empfangen und man hat sich sofort wohl gefühlt.
Check-in war einfach und unkompliziert.
Parken war auf dem Grundstück oder davor möglich.
Und die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel sind schnell zu erreichen.
Macht weiter so!

Es war ein sehr angenehmer 3tägiger Aufenthalt anlässlich einer Kongressteilnahme im nahen CityCube. Sehr netter, persönlicher Kontakt mit Bea und Anton. Zimmer ist sauber, Bett bequem, ruhige Lage, S-Bahn und Kongresszentrum nicht weit weg, ein Frühstück war inclusive, Balkon ist auch dabei. Tadellos, was will man mehr. Wenn ich darf, komme ich nächstes Jahr gerne wieder!

Great stay in perfect location of Moabit! Lovely inner garden, when you open the 2 doors of the French balcony your forget you are in the inner city as you are surrounded by lush green, birds and squirrels! We stayed in this apartment for 3 months while moving to Berlin in Corona times. Perfect place to land, get to know the city, and we were able to do our first registration at this apartment. The hosts are super helpful with anything you need. Really quick communication and no hassle. The apartment is simple, with all the basics you need. Proximity to big food store (Edeka), great cafés (you must try out Tirrée) and in the same building you have a small food store (with the best hummus you*ve ever had) and a sweet restaurant. Only thing I can comment on is that it's not super sound-proof, with regards to neighbours and you can clearly hear sounds from the stairwell but we quickly got used to it.  Can recommend, enjoy!
De host was erg vriendelijk, sympathiek en behulpzaam. Duidelijke instructies en een excellente ligging van de accommodatie,  om Berlijn te verkennen.
Lovely modern apartment. Conveniently located with easy access to public transportation. Very attentive host. Highly recommend.

Overall it was okay.
The location is great, we really enjoyed the area. The backyard in which the flat is located on the ground floor makes it a little gloomy even though the sun is shining outside, but at the same time it's really quiet especially at night. We slept really well there. From the inside everything is just like on the pictures so really nothing is missing in the flat itself. Also the bed was really comfy and the bathroom was nice. Shower was mounted too low for people taller than 1,20.
In case you don't like it cold you may want to skip this flat entirely, no matter what season you travel as in Germany a rainy day can happen throughout the entire year. In that case the heating will be fixed to 18 degrees and for us that wasn't enough as the ground floor is really cold. In the house rules they write that you cannot change it, but we still asked twice whether they could kindly turn it warmer but the answer was no.
They have put little cards all over the flat where they call the place "Berlin Prestige Living", I found this ironic for a place that doesn't allow to increase the temperature and has a breakfast table with views to the community dump where constantly people pass by to drop their rubbish and watch you (a curtain could solve it). Also the shower wasn't mounted properly.
So overall okay but not really a stay we would want to repeat.

Cool, clean & cozy basement. Great location, great self check-in with easy communication.
The water-heater inside the room is a bit weird but we got used to it. Mattress could be better.
:)
Ivos was very helpful and friendly. Apartment was clean and quiet.

Great little apartment in a very convenient yet charming location. The hosts kindly let us arrive a bit early so we didn't have to hang out at the airport too long after our international arrival. The place was spotlessly clean, and the provided shampoo and toiletries were great. Older people might have trouble climbing in and out of the beds, so those with limited mobility might wish to avoid this one.
Sehr saubere, gut eingerichtete Wohnung und der Gastgeber ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Immer wieder zu empfehlen!
Great place in Neukölln, right near the U + S bahn. The neighborhood is great, if you want to stay right outside of the city center, with plenty of things to do!

Unser Aufenthalt in der Wohnung war angenehm.
Das Haus ist etwas in die Jahre gekommen, die Wohnung ist jedoch was die Ausstattung angeht in Ordnung.
Für kurze Übernachtungen sehr zu empfehlen. Der Check-in und die Kommunikation liefen absolut super!
LG David

Das Zimmer war sauber, wie beschrieben und hat uns einen ganz wunderbaren Aufenthalt in Berlin verschafft. Die Wohnung ist sehr zentral und trotzdem ruhig gelegen. Die öffentliche Anbindung ist gut und alle Sehenswürdigkeiten sind schnell zu erreichen.
Mike ist ein sehr zuvorkommender Gastgeber, stand immer mit guten Tipps zur Seite, war immer erreichbar und offen im Kontakt!! Vielen Dank für die Gastfreundschaft. Wir kommen gerne wieder
Outstanding accomodation and excellent host. The apartment is a great size! There are fans supplied which was needed on a warm day. Uta is wonderful to deal with.
Merci beaucoup, c'était un endroit incroyable ! Tout était parfait. Bonne journée :)
Un excellent séjour dans cet appartement très confortable, parfaitement propre et joliment décoré. Merci beaucoup pour votre accueil !

Hemos pasado una estancia estupenda en el apartamento de Inés.
Es muy confortable y bonito.
Está ubicado en un barrio residencial muy tranquilo, no muy lejos del metro.
Inés ha sido una buena anfitriona. Se ha preocupado en todo momento de que nuestra estancia fuera lo mejor posible.

Had a great time staying here.
It had everything we needed, is close to interesting spots to see, and to public transport.
Sehr schön gemacht!
Super clean and beautiful rooms:) also very quiet despite the road rights next to it.  I had a great stay.
Muy agradable el hogar y bien situado

Das Appartment war in einem sehr schmutzigen Zustand, vorallem das Badezimmer war sehr dreckig und wurde nicht geputzt. Als wir dies meldeten, meinte der Gastgeber er bringe uns eine Flasch Wein zur Wiedergutmachung, die Flasche kam nie bei uns an. Auch meinte der Gastgeber er erstatte uns 40 Euro zurück, das Geld wurde nie überwiesen. Hinter El Pilar stehen mehrere Kontaktpersonen, was sehr unübersichtlich ist. Die ganze Liegenschaft sind Airbnb-Wohnungen, es ist also mehr ein Business und nicht die Airbnb-Philosophie die der Gastgeber betreibt. Sehr schade..

4. Stock, der sich lohnt. Kleines charmantes Zimmer mit kleinem Balkon zum Hinterhof. Bett etwas härter, was ich sehr positiv bewerte.
Gerne wieder!

Michael’s place is very comfortable and the location is amazing - right next to the Ubahn.
The apartment has every amenity you would need, and Michael
Is very easy to get a hold of and resolve any issue I had very promptly.
I highly recommend this place and would stay here again.

Positive-- location is great, the room is cool, logistics were easy.
negative-- I found the room to be quite dark- there's no bedside lamp to read by-- and they only clean every 5 days, which is a problem if you have any garbage that collects in the tiny trash bins.

Wir waren 4 Personen und 3 Nächte gut untergebracht und haben uns wohl gefühlt. Eine wirklich kuschelige Wohnung mit Geschmack eingerichtet. Es ist allerdings SEHR hellhörig. Es ist wirklich jeder Schritt der Nachbarn drüber zu hören. Ansonsten alles vorhanden was für so einen Aufenthalt gebraucht wird.

La descrizione della casa è perfetta nei dettagli,nulla da aggiungere. Il quartiere va bene dato che è in una zona residenziale ma è veramente facile raggiungere il centro con i mezzi. Per l'accoglienza è stata "professionale". Nel senso che non ci sono stati problemi dato che, una volta arrivati, ha mostrato l'appartamento e aiutato a orientarci. Molto bello, lo raccomando :)
Ich habe die Unterkunft schon öfter gebucht für Familienangehörige und die waren immer sehr zufrieden. Danke Ursula

Muy buen lugar para estadía familiar. Amplios espacios, muy funcional. Si bien la cocina y el baño son pequeños, muy funcionales. Nosotros viajamos con una bebe de 2 años y el espacio funcionó perfecto. Volveríamos. Lo único que mejoraría sería la limpieza, pero en general todo super bien! Nos sentimos muy a gusto. Está a aprox 15 min caminando del S bahn, castillo bellevue a 5 min de supermercado (penny) y el bus a 2 minutos.

Die Kommunikation mit Tobias war sehr gut.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist sehr zentral zu den Bus/U-Bahn und S-Bahn Stationen.
WLAN funktionierte einwandfrei.
Die Wohnung ist genauso wie in der Annonce beschrieben.
Mir hat die Wohnung gut gefallen und ich würde jederzeit wieder mieten.

Thomas ist ein super netter und zuvorkommender Gastgeber. Ich konnte ohne Probleme nach 23 Uhr einchecken. Thomas hat mir sogar den Koffer getragen- Danke! Nach den X-Treppen vorher in Berlin, weil Rolltreppen defekt waren oder es einfach nur Treppen gab eine tolle Erholung. Der Weg von der S-Bahn ist kurz und einfach - nur etwas dunkel.
Die Wohnung ist so nah am Wannsee, ein Traum. Bäcker und Netto gibt's auch im der Nähe und im Zimmer von Thomas gibt's einen Kühlschrank, Wasserkocher und Besteck und Geschirr, um gut dort zu frühstücken.

Michele’s apartment is in an interesting, hip suburban neighbourhood a short walk from a tram and train that take you right into the centre of Berlin.
The apartment is clean and tidy, with some interesting character, and the blockout blinds were very helpful for a good night’s sleep!
When we arrived, there was unfortunately no toilet paper, washing powder or paper towel. Michele responded relatively promptly when I contacted him about this, and he explained that the normal cleaner was currently on leave, and set about trying to resolve this issue. I trust that this will not be a continuing issue for other guests.
The neighbourhood seemed quite cool, though it would have been nice to have a list of local recommendations provided on arrival. It’s these kind of personal recommendations that really ‘make’ an Airbnb stay for me, as they give you a real taste of the local area. This Airbnb felt more like a simple place to stay rather than part of the experience of our time in Berlin.

Die Wohnung ist genauso wie versprochen. Sie hat alles um sich wohlzufühlen und den Aufenthalt zu genießen und ist wirklich geschmackvoll und praktisch eingerichtet. Äusserst günstig ist die prima Anbindung an den Nahverkehr. Der Bäcker schräg gegenüber ist auch sehr zu empfehlen. Trotz zentraler Lage relativ ruhig mit herrlichem Vogelgezwitscher am Morgen. Wir würden wieder buchen und sie auch Freunden empfehlen. Heike & Heinrich haben wir nicht persönlich getroffen, aber alles war perfekt organisiert.
Alles super gewesen. Ruhige Lage, tolle Unterkunft, netter Kontakt. Gerne wieder :)

I got sick the day I arrived, and couldn't have picked a better location, because the nearest grocer was only 5 minutes walk away. The neighborhood was quiet and clean and private, but still only 15 minutes from the nearest mall and many food options. Maybe that's normal for this area. I don't know, but I was happy. The kitchen had everything I needed to prepare my meals for the week and instructions were provided in detail for foreigners who are not used to the recycling process, which I greatly appreciated. The specific room I booked with the two beds, I will say, is more private and more spacious than the single room, and stays cooler because it receives less sunshine. Honestly I have no complaints and hope I didn't keep anyone up late from my coughing.  Oops.
Joe was verry nice, we had a good stay
Very nice, clean, and cozy stay in the part of the city we needed it to be in.

Antonia has an amazing apartment in Berlin. Our stay was pleasant and the communication with the host was quick & smooth.
I would totally recommend this place for its sleek decoration, cleanliness, location and chill vibe.
Tamara was a good host, she answered quickly and helped us with all our questions. We could arrive earlier than in the description, and we got the whole apartment for our self.
Just perfect... the place is perfectly located and its totally nice. Martin was always willing to help with advices... such a nice host.
Easy check in...very comfortable , with all that we needed. easy to get everywhere and some great restaurants nearby

I recommand the house of Suzann.
She is very nice.
The house is very clean, bright, and with space room, close to many things, very practical. Foods, markets, and garden and S-bahn at 8mn.
Thanks again for everything and for your trust.
Larbi and Françoise

Eine schöne Wohnung in einer ruhigen Lage, ideal für einen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Ganz in der Nähe ist ein Penny, der bis 22 Uhr geöffnet hat.
Die Kommunikation mit Alex war sehr unkompliziert. Die Wohnung hat alles was man braucht. Auch ein kleiner Balkon ist vorhanden. Und wenn nicht - einfach Alex fragen.
Mit Bus, S-Bahn und U-Bahn erreicht man problemlos die Berliner Sehenswürdigkeiten.
Wir können die Wohnung sehr empfehlen!

Nice, basic appartment in the center of Berlin. A bit bare, but was everything we needed! Nice balcony and kitchen. Matrasses were good. Pillows were a bit cheap, but not that big of an issue. Location was superb, great starting point to explore the rest of the city!

You will find a carring and welcoming host in Danielle.
The room is functional and the matress comfortable.

Todo muy bien,  las instrucciones muy claras y la casa perfecta para nuestra estancia muy bien comunicada con la estación central de Berlín 17 min en autobus y a 30 min en metro, igual fácil de llegar a los puntos de interés. Muchas gracias!

Die Unterkunft ist sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet. Das Bett ist mittlerweile ein besseres, etwas größeres als das auf den Fotos. Handtücher, Seife, Spülung, Duschgel und ein vernünftiger Föhn waren bereits vor Ort. Die Lage ist schön.
Wir wurden freundlich empfangen und konnten auch am späten Abend noch einchecke.

We had wonderful time in Berlin in Katrin's apartment. It looks even more stylish, than in the photos. You keep noticing new details while staying there! And it feels "hommy" really fast. Thank you for the hospitality!
wide open space, with all the tools you need for a really nice stay

Here is the best place I have ever stayed in my life! The fireplace is especially perfect for upgrading your trip. And we enjoyed the terrace to look the skyline of Berlin. As we have one baby, washing machine and dryer are convenient during rainy days. Also other things such as bed, kitchen, sofa are vey nice. The host contacts quickly and clearly. If I come again to Berlin, I would like to stay here again. I highly recommend this house!
lovely apartment in a great location, highly recommend

I loved my stay at this beautiful, spacious rooftop apartment in Kreuzberg. Although the house and the entrance don't look inviting,  the apartment itself is amazing - modern, full of light, well equipped, and in a very central location. There is noisy construction work in front of the house at the moment, so this may not be the right place for someone who desires complete tranquility. But it worked great for me. Communication with Vlad was great and I loved the video projector in the living room - such a cool idea! Would definitely stay again.

We stayed in Anjas apartment for 6 weeks. It is very nice, very functional and well equiped - in the kitchen and elsewhere.
The area in Zehlendorf is very nice with less than 1 km to a good shopping area and Schlachtensee, where you can have a good 6,5 km walk or run around it - or a good swim in the summer time!
You can park everywhere in the area for free, and still get into the center in 15-30 minutes, so if you visit Berlin by car, this nice, quiet area is perfekt...
Susanna & Finn ,o))
from Denmark
Lovely, cosy studio apartment with everything you need, great home base from which to explore Berlin! Natalie was super helpful and flexibel, thanks again!!
Henrik is a very good host. Great stay
Yurys Unterkunft hat uns sehr gefallen. Ruhige Lage aber doch war man schnell überall. Alles war sauber und ordentlich.

My short stay in Berlin was fantastic in part for my time spent at the Loft.  Everything is exactly as advertised...but better in real life.  The most comfortable bed I experienced in three weeks spent across Europe.  The suite is chic and elegant and I appreciated their approach to zero-waste living.  Perfectly situated one minute across from the Tram, purchase your day pass to access the U and S trains with easily from home with the Transit App.  Grocery, restaurants and bistros are close by.  Grab a beer next door at Uebereck and say 'hello' to Marco their barman.  I would't hesitate for one second to "Highly Recommend" this listing for your stay.  Enjoy Berlin!

Die Wohnung hat eine sehr schöne Lage, in direkter Nähe zu Geschäften, Bars, Restaurants etc. Haltestellen sind auch in der Nähe. Die Wohnung ist klein, aber ordentlich und gut ausgestattet. Übergabe des Schlüssels problemlos. Gut organisiert.
Very spacious apartment, the pictures don’t do the size of the living room any justice. Doreen was super responsive and we had everything we needed for a group of 6; highly recommend.
The room is as presented in the offer and the hosts are both great and very communicative people, invested in having your stay as pleasant as possible. Would recommend!
a nice place to stay, very well connected to public transport. one will love.
We all loved the accommodation. It slept all guests well , and had enough facilities to cook in the evening for everyone. It was clean, and we would book again when we go back to Berlin.
Schnelle und unkomplizierte Kommunikation. Hilfreiche Hinweise um das Haus zu finden. Sehr nette Gastgeber.

Amazing hospitality, Lovely and kind couple with great recommendations and just a pleasure to be around. If i ever need a short term place to stay in Berlin, I would of course come back. Thanks again!

I have spent three days at Betty & Stefan's quiet yet conveniently located studio. Everything from check-in to check-out was well organized. The hosts are also very helpful in providing information regarding the area and things to do. I can definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for an authentic stay in the heart of Berlin.
Greta location! Very clean. Would stay again.

Die perfekte Wohnung, um mit mehreren Personen zusammenzukommen und Berlin zu erkunden! Wir waren zu neunt und hatten während unseres Familienausfluges eine grossartige Zeit! Toller Stil, gut geschnitten und im ruhigen Erdgeschoss liegend. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel befinden sich in der Nähe, so dass sich viele interessante Stadtteile in kurzer Zeit erreichen lassen.
Der Kontakt zu Ulla und Andreas war sehr freundlich, Anfragen wurden schnell beantwortet. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Le logement est très bien, bien équipé et très bien placé. Il y a des lignes de metro et tramway a proximité.
Les échanges avec Katrin étaient faciles et comme elle habite a coté elle est disponible en cas de besoin.
Le seul problème est que le logement se situe au niveau de la rue et qu'il y avait des travaux sur le batiment qui touchait le bâtiment juste a coté. Il y avait des bruits de chantier, des manipulations d'objets métalliques qui faisait énormément de bruits parfois dès 7h30/8h00 tous les matins de la semaine.

Die Lage ist super für Ausflüge in die Stadt. Die Wohnung ist für 2 Personen gut geeignet und mit allem ausgestattet, was man für
einen Kurzurlaub braucht. Wir hatten eine schöne Zeit
All well. Nice flat and good location!  Thanks Guillaume and Ana
Jörg was very respectful, responsive, and super kind! When I tell you the house was exactly like the pictures I mean EXACTLY lol, I will definitely be booking again😮‍💨

Steffi’s apartment is in a vibrant area with lots of quirky shops and excellent bars and restaurants.
We were late arriving due to the train problems & traffic from Amsterdam but check in was very easy.
We popped in to say hello to Steffi and she was very welcoming.
We had brunch in cafe tillda and cannot recommend it highly enough. The food was amazing and the coffee excellent.
The apartment is perfect for a couple with a studio layout. The kitchen has everything you will need and walk in closet is a lovely idea. It was too cold for us to use the outside space but in summer it would be perfect for breakfast or late evening drinks.
We walked into Mitte which took about 40 minutes. If you don’t want to walk the U2 line is 6 minutes walk and takes you into the central area.
If we return to Berlin we would definitely look to stay here again.
Nice room for one or two people to stay comfortably for a few says in Berlin. Location is good, there’s a tram stop nearby and some nice cafes and restaurants.
Beautiful flat, very clean and quiet. Great location for getting around.

We had a great stay at Stella's place. She is really friendly and answers real quick. It was a great communication and a beautiful apartment. Also the doorlock system is really nice, because you can't lose the key.
I would definetly recommend thuis place!
meget fin og ren lille studiebolig til 2 mand. Har alt hvad man skulle bruge til et kort eller længerevarende ophold i Berlin

The place is good for a hostel. But the beds don’t have a separation between beds as they do in the picture and the bedrooms are mixed. Some people were noisy and not considered of other guests.
The staff was very friendly though and the location is great. For a hostel it was quite clean and showers are warm. With 6 people, at least one will snore, arrive late or be inconsiderate. Therefore don’t count on sleep if you are a light sleeper.
Very responsive and flexible host. The house was also very clean and well maintained. A quick train ride from the city center as well. Very nice over all.

L'appartement de Jonas est idéalement placé, à 10' de marche d'une ligne de tramway, du parc de Tiergarten dans un quartier calme. Le logement est très grand et atypique dans sa décoration.
Merci Jonas pour votre accueil.

This was my second stay at Parwana's apartment and once again I really enjoyed myself! As always, it was impeccably clean and cozy.
Thanks again for a great stay! :-)
Die Kommunikation mit George war super unkompliziert und alles war sauber. Wir haben uns bei George sehr wohl gefühlt und würden jederzeit wieder kommen wenn der nächste Tripp nach Berlin geht!
Nice apartment right by Sonnenallee train station. There's a lift in the building which is handy. Lovely chilled neighbourhood, I enjoyed my stay!
I really enjoyed 3 weeks stay in his house. Both Berlib central station and Tiergarten are walking distance.
apartment was exactly as listed, modern and minimalistic. The condition was immaculate and the hosts very accommodating to our needs. recommended
War ganz ok. Zwar gab es zwei drei Kleinigkeiten aber sonst alles gut.
Perfect place and host.

Der Check In hat gut funktioniert. Als ich ankam, hat er mir gleich erzählt, ich solle bei der Küche aufpassen, es wäre Echtholz. Da ist mir schon aufgefallen, dass die Küche einen unangenehmen Geruch und viele Krümel hatte. Highlight war der Schneebesen, der mit weißen Flocken beim "sauberen" Geschirr lag. Ich hab mich echt geekelt. Töpfe und Pfannen waren noch dreckig.
Dusche war ebenfalls kaputt, es standen Shampoo Flaschen da, die bestimmt schon 4 Monate da waren und waren mit weißen Belägen versehen.

We loved staying at Florian and Gaston's apartment, the location is perfect and very quiet. Great amenities, everything you need and a nice comfortable bed. The place was also extremely clean. Both hosts were very good with communication. We will be back next time we visit Berlin! Thank you again for having us :)
Sweet, personable and always helpful !
Great flat in top location. Bjorn is very kind and no problems rise during our stay. Highly recommended!

She told me it was flexible check out over the internet and in person and then emailed me at 9:20 AM saying she expected me to be out at 10 AM. I didn’t get the message because I was jet lagged and still asleep and she tried to wake me up at 10 to get me out without a shower. I hadn’t yet showered because she had people over the evening before and I felt uncomfortable so I had to shower anyway and she kept checking on me to see when I would be out even though I was clearly rushing.

Die Unterkunft war zentral gelegen und sehr sauber. Der Check-In hat super geklappt, Stella war sehr nett und hat alles sehr gut erklärt. Die Wohnung war sehr gut ausgestattet. Leider wurde auf der Baustelle auch am Samstag gearbeitet, wobei Sven uns explizit auf diese hingewiesen hatte.

Apartment exactly as it says.  Clean and warm with easy heating and hot water.  Kitchen looked well equipped but didn’t use it.  Not easy if you have mobility issues - high step into bath/shower and low bed.  Would definitely recommend it to others who wanted to stay in that area.  Lovely coffee shop just across the street
Great place to rest and with a good location!

Sedat's place was comfortable for us (2 couples), it was nice and clean, the location of the flat is perfect (the s-bahn station is 2 minutes from the house, and the Brandenburg Gate was about 20 minutes on foot)!  Sedat provided  were very useful guides about the city, we would definitely go back again!
Great location. Very nice and clean place. Quiet and private. Very easy communication!

Vielen Dank, dass wir die letzten Tage auf deinem Hausboot verbringen durften. Tolles Boot, toller Ort. Danke auch an Kai, der uns alles gezeigt hat und einige fehlende Dinge uns zur Verfügung gestellt hat. Super freundlich! Wir erhielten eine super Einweisung in das Hausboot und hatten ein paar schöne entspannte Tage. Gerne wieder.
Viele Grüße Sabine

Ich habe mich von der ersten Minute an sehr wohl bei Tanja gefühlt. Ich wurde sehr freundlich empfangen und alles war super hergerichtet im Zimmer, und das, obwohl ich sehr kurzfristig gebucht hatte. Das Zimmer ist sehr geräumig, hell und geschmackvoll eingerichtet, mit Liebe zum Detail. Es ist sehr sauber im Zimmer, dem Badezimmer und der ganzen tollen Berliner Altbau Wohnung. Dies war meine erste airbnb Buchung und ich habe wirklich eine tolle Erfahrung gemacht. Ich kann einen Aufenthalt bei Tanja sehr empfehlen.

Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber, gemütlich und mit allem ausgestattet was man benötigt. Und Mirco sehr hilfsbereit und gastfreundlich.
In gehobener Wohnlage mit guter Anbindung zur Sbahn und Supermarkt.

Super Lage, Kommunikation :)
Sehr guter Spot um Berlin für ein paar Tage kennenzulernen!
Jürgen war sehr freundlich und entgegenkommend. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und man hat einen tollen Ausblick. Die Küche ließ keine Wünsche offen und das Wohnzimmer ebenso!
Nice spacious apartment. Perfect for the five of us. Denny was very helpful when we arrived early.

Despite my late arrival I was welcomed with a smile and understanding.  Nicolas is a very considerate host, helpful and available.  The place was exactly as described and is a little gem, immediately felt at home. I didn't have time to see as much of Berlin and so hope to return - will check Nicolas availability first. Thanks Nicolas.
Great for short-term stays. Excellent communication.
We really enjoyed our stay at Ina’s place! The apartment is really clean, nicely decorated, and close to everything we wanted to see. We would definitely return. Thank you Ina!
Everything was professionally organised and the location was perfect!

A estadia foi maravilhosa, o anfitrião sempre foi muito gentil.

Mooi appartement op een mooie locatie. Voor je het weet ben je in het centrum van Berlijn  (5min lopen naar u-bahn en vandaar weg kun je overal komen). Op 5 min lopen ook verschillende goeie eetgelegenheden. De kleine keuken was voor ons dan ook geen probleem.
The house is cosy and Ivo is really helpfull and easy to contact
Situación buena. Apartamento precioso. Atención del amfitrión pésima. No contesta a los mensajes.
Unser Aufenthalt als Familie war perfekt - für zwei Kleinkinder ist die Wohnung optimal ausgestattet. Die S-Bahn war für uns super zu Fuß zu erreichen. Check-in war auch spät abends kein Problem.
Everything was perfect Ambra is always there if you need anything and puts you directly at ease.

Very nice stay.
Raphael and Leo were very nice and they took care of averything.
Todo muy agradable,  sobre todo la hostidalidad

Hemos estado supercómodos en el piso, está muy céntrico, al lado de la isla de los museo y el pirulí de televisión, además hay un montón de restaurante por la zona y tiene la estación de metro en frente, es cruzar la calle y ya.
El piso muy bien aislado por lo que no escuchas los trenes pasar.
Comunicarnos con Ariane fue muy fácil.
En el piso encontramos de todo, incluso paraguas (que por cierto tuvimos que utilizar),
es totalmente fiel a las fotos y descripción, incluso diría que es mejor que lo que puedes percibir por el anuncio
Si volvemos a Berlín, nos volveríamos a alojar en su piso

The apartment is very well located, with a bus stop within 5 minutes walk.
There were plenty cafes, restaurants, etc in the neighbourhood.
A big plus is that you can park for free on the street, however it was not easy to find an available spot.
The host, Anca, was very attentive, she replied very fast and even gave some suggestions for restaurants. In the apartment there is also a notebook with recommendations and some instructions.
The apartment is mainly suited for a short stay and city trip (it’s just a studio), and served us perfectly.
La pasamos muy bien en el departamento de Douglas. Estaba muy bien ubicado y con muchas cosas para hacer. Tenía muchos negocios, restoranes y supermercados cerca. Lo recomendamos.

What a great place! Arrival was made very easy by Friedrich who explained everything in the apartment. Apartment was very well furnished and was nice and warm which was great during winter, bed was also comfy. There were markets outside on some days of the week where you could buy fresh fruit etc which was really nice. All in all a great place, great location and great hosts. Thank you!

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt auf Martins Hausboot. Es ist alles da, was man braucht um ein paar schöne Tage in Berlin zu verbringen.  Bei Fragen war Martin jederzeit erreichbar. Werden es auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen.
Perfekte Lage, Blitz sauber, freundliche Empfang und eine sehr gute Aufteilung der Wohnung, ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt, und würde es jeder empfehlen!

You have to make sure you have the lockbox in your hands for the self-check in. Otherwise, you will be in the street, in the cold, at night and no one will help you. Parwana did everything perfect, I just missed a smile.

Ein wunderbar grosszügiges Apartment direkt am Mauerpark und gut an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel angebunden. Die Betten waren herrlich, ich habe die ganzen Ferien nicht so gut geschlafen wie da.
Die Küche haben wir nicht benutzt, es schien aber alles da zu sein. Sehr gute Kommunikation mit der Vermieterin.

Although the apartment is on the ground floor, there was no noice from the street outside. The location of the apartment is great and the self checkin process was smooth and easy and was perfect for me because I arrived really late.
Tall people may not be able to fully stand in the bedroom/sleeping area but aside from that everything was great, really clean, nice and warm.
Would recommend!

Wonderful space and stay for a couple or individual in Berlin. I stayed for five nights for a work trip. The space is clean, modern, has everything you need and faces a tranquil courtyard. It is in a perfect location in a quiet area of the neighborhood, with easy access to groceries...But, it is also within a 5 minute walk to all the central restaurants, sightseeing and shopping one could dream on the famed Friedrichstraße. Stephan and the team were responsive to any questions I had.  Super highly recommended.
Φανταστική εμπειρία. Το σπίτι ήταν αυτό ακριβώς αυτό που περιμέναμε. Ο Apostolos μας βοήθησε σε ότι χρειαζόμασταν κατά την παραμονή μας. Η επικοινωνία μαζί του ήταν άψογη.

Virkelig hyggeligt hus der har alt, hvad man skal bruge under sit ophold i Berlin. Ved ankomst var alle senge opredt og håndklæder lå klar. Det var som at være på hotel. Olga er en super vært, der hurtigt besvarer alle spørgsmål. Huset er hyggeligt indrettet, så man føler sig hjemme og særligt haven er helt fantastisk, når man vender træt hjem fra ture i Berlin.   Virkelig gode rammer for et godt ophold som familie :-)
Great apartment!
Great apartment in a very good location. The bed was really comfortable and I slept so well. The flat is high up in the building, which was perfect but you better don't mind climbing some stairs.
Amazing place, amazing location!
Place is clean, quiet and perfect location for exploring the city! Loved the stay here.

Ulf was a great host. He is a very kind person and openminded. Ulf knows Spanish and English, which helped communicating. There is a really good German bakery nearby (be ready to practice some basic German when ordering). I enjoyed staying in this neighborhood since it was less touristic. The hosts were very helpful giving directions on how to use the train system to get to my destination.
Responsive host. Eclectic spot. Unique Airbnb. Thanks for the hospitality!
Everything was as show in the pictures. The department is a little far away from night life and tourists points, but is well communicated
Spatious apartment and good location

The views above the roofs and the evening light that hits the living room makes it well worth climbing up the stairs to the 5th floor! Klaus was active in communication and checked if we got in and out without any problems. Would recommend!

Die Unterkunft von Stella ist zwar sehr klein und nicht sehr günstig, dafür aber wirklich gemütlich und gut ausgestattet, außerdem sehr sauber. Die Lage war wirklich toll es gab sehr viele schöne Cafés und Restaurants in der Umgebung, die alle fußläufig zu erreichen waren. Wir haben uns für die vie Tage dort äußerst wohlgefühlt.
Hat alles super geklappt und war für unseren kurzen Aufenthalt genau das richtige!
the pillow here and bed is like heaven the best accomodation

Positive:

Eine gemütliche kleine Wohnung. Würde ich wieder nehmen.

Super Lage und tolle Wohnung! Würden immer wieder kommen :)

Bigger than it looks in the photos, clean, and the kitchen is pretty well stocked. Not the best location for sightseeing/ being in the city, but we doing a reunion with a big group of friends so it was perfect. Easy enough to get their with public transport. Thank you!

Could not recommend Downtown Apartments more, we had the best stay! Nothing was too much trouble for the amazing reception team, they gave us recommendations on where to go and explained the transport systems to us when we weren’t sure. Thank you for making my birthday week so special, we can’t wait to come back!❤️

Everything went well. The old building is beautiful . The room have a lot of space.Loved the location . Rio have responded messages very quickly.
One of the showroom will needed a bit work . Always find water on the floor after shower . Without it , very happy with my stay.
El lugar es genial para pasar unos días en Berlín.Sitio acogedor y con muy buena ubicación.

Virkelig et skønt sted! Lejligheden var både smuk, ren og rummelig - og Jan var en rigtig god vært :)

Arrived very late due to travel issues and found it difficult to sleep when I found hairs all over the bed and in the bathroom sink. Canceled my stay half way through 2 of 4 nights but they only refunded me one night and can see they’ve viewed my messages but won’t respond. Please do yourself a favor and spend the extra $20-30 per night to stay elsewhere.
Lovely area!
Wie waren letztes Jahr schon einmal in dieser Unterkunft von Steve und ich kann mich nur wiederholen: alles perfekt, immer wieder gerne !
Sehr sauber und sehr freundliche Gastgeber. Gerne wieder!
I very much enjoyed my stay at this location in Prenzlauer Berg district!
Great flat and location, super easy to check in
Really lovely space close to transportation and what I wanted to do in Berlin. So nice to be so close to the water, as well. Thekla was very kind!

L'appartement est conforme à la description. Proche du métro et dans un quartier très calme.
Sven est disponible et à l'écoute.
Il a tout fait pour que notre séjour soit agréable.
De plus Sven propose des produits écologiques et respectueux de l'environnement. C'est très appréciable.
Sehr idyllisch gelegene Unterkunft in einem kleinen Häuschen mit außerordentlich netter Vemieterin/Mietbewohnerin. Das Zimmer war sauber und gemütlich eingerichtet. Ich komme gerne wieder!
Recomendo para uma estadia curta na cidade

A superb place, in a fantastic location. Amazing views over the park. The appartement is bright and clean, just as photos shows. I had great benefit of the portable internet device which Stefan provided.
very nice apartment, in a great location
Der Aufenthalt war wunderbar. Die Unterkunft war sehr schön und modern eingerichtet. Gerne werde ich dort wieder übernachten.
Great place in the heart of friedrichshain. Vibrant area but very tranquil apartment. Thanks apostolos for having me! Would definitely recommend!
Was in an amazing location and was a great space
absolutely perfect location. really cool view at night. highly recommended. great host communication as well! would definitely come back again
Mike is a great host, very solicitous over the confort of his guests. The room is remarkably confortable and nice.

A very modern, designer, warm and well equipped apartment to base yourself from when visiting Berlin. The bathroom is amazing with under floor heating. Prenzlauerberg is quite an alternative area. Victoria has a very cool local restaurant guide she shares with guests and helped to make our winter stay in Berlin very smooth and enjoyable!

Gorgeous apartment, easy checking in and out, was in a fantastic area of east Berlin full of resturants as well as close to multiple stations. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would be happy to return again as the host was responsive and answered all burning questions about the city that we had! Thanks again for the stay, 100% recommend!

Schönes und sauberes Appartement. Es war leider nicht alles was in der Beschreibung war vorhanden, wurde aber auf Nachfrage gebracht (Fön, Wasserkocher…). Tolle Anlage und sehr sicher und modern. Netter Empfang.
I stayed for 3 months and really enjoyed this apartment. Michael and his team are very responsive. The location is excellent and very close to the S/U-Bahn and Tram.
Good and comfortable stay

Very nice and well located apartment at the foot of the tram.  Katarina was kind enough when we arrived by keeping a private parking space and something to have for breakfast.  it should be noted that the apartment has only a small window and that it is very dark.

Appartement parfait pour les groupes. Très propre, bien agencé avec tout le nécessaire (serviettes, drap mais aussi le fond de cusine) c’est appréciable.
La localisation bien qu’excentrée du Mitte nous a permis de découvrir un quartier très sympa et animé le soir. Je recommande

Well-located and comfortable - that sums up this place. My family and I had a great stay at Dietrich's place, with a bakery just steps out and a S-bahn and tram station meters away. Sehr nette Gastgeber in einer Toplage der  Stadt. Gerne wieder. Vielen Dank

Fin og ren leilighet, godt utstyrt og lett tilgjengelig. Lucas var hyggelig, hjelpsom og lett å kommunisere med. Det var litt støy i gaten utenfor, men leiligheten ligger jo sentralt og på gateplan. Vi koste oss. Anbefaler Trattoria Rocca pizza i nærheten, hyggelige og god mat.

Martin was a really good host. He was punctual in answering and gave very good descriptions to get to the apartment. The place is wonderful and cosy to work and stay at. Great advantage is the balcony. I will definitely stay there again.

Es war wirklich ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt in Gerhards Wohnung.
Sowohl die Kommunikation, als auch die Wohnung waren tadellos. Ein besseres Airbnb, auch was die Lage angeht, ist wahrscheinlich schwer zu finden.

Ein angenehmer Aufenthalt in einem ordentlichen Zimmer mit schönen und sauberen Bad. Noch besser wäre es mit hellerer Beleuchtung in den Zimmern gewesen.
Alles in allem, zu empfehlen.

Our stay was great!
The apartment is very spacious and clean. The location is also very good, it is a 20 minute walk from Checkpoint Charlie and about 40 minutes from the Reichstag. There is a great Greek restaurant a few minutes from the apartment.
Everything was great! Thank you.

A very nice apartment and a perfect spot for a weekend in Berlin. You are in the middle of Prenzlauer Berg and yet have your quiet spot overseeing the skyline of Berlin. The apartment doesn't leave any wishes open, is perfectly well equipped, clean and yet very cozy. Me and my little daughter loved staying there!

This was a wonderful place for our stay in Berlin! We really wanted to find a neighborhood vibe and this was totally it! Lots of local places to eat and drink at with such easy access to all parts of the city. The place was exactly as described and was perfect and spacious for a traveling couple.

A cozy and welcoming spot. Quite modern with electric blinds, large windows and a pleasant view of the museum and outdoors. Conveniently located (definitely try akkurat cafe) and Matthew was helpful and proactive. Only downside was the studio makes sounds thru the day, like some metal thing in the walls is moving. Maybe it's the heating. More hangers would be nice too.
The once a week cleaning is thorough and great to have. The locks are all contactless which is great when your hands are freezing in the berlin nights.

We had a great stay at Katjas place. Location is perfect, super central in the heart of Kreuzberg.  Lots of cafes and bars around but nothing will bother you as the apartment faces a quiet courtyard. Die Betten waren sehr weich und bequem. Das Zimmer mit drei Betten liegt direkt an der Soundbar, was dazu führt, dass es abends etwas lauter werden kann. Unter der Woche ist dies aber halb so wild und unproblematisch. Das andere Zimmer liegt zum Hof und ist sehr ruhig gelegen.
Das Bad war sehr sauber. Die Küche hatte soweit die Ausstattung, die angegeben wurde. Allerdings roch es aus dem Abfluss.
Die Lage ist perfekt, sodass alle Lokalitäten im Umkreis gut zu erreichen sind.

Bert e la sua famiglia sono fantastici, casa bellissima e vicina alla metro. Consigliato!
The room was Nice and very clean and the host was Nice. The neighborhood was ok but close to public transportation. Thanks :)

We had a great time at Alex’s apartment!
The public Lido is very nearby, so is an Aldi which was useful.
Our favourite local spots were Sotto (vegetarian pizza), Ouef & Mars (for brunch).
We felt safe in the area and it was easy to get public transport.
For 4 friends the apartment was perfect as we had a space each, although it is worth mentioning that one of the bedrooms is accessible through another one, which I hadn’t realised from the photos. This wasn’t a problem for us.
Earplugs recommended if you are a light sleeper - especially if you’re having daytime disco naps!
All in all a great place to stay :)

Beautiful spacious apartment just as described!
The host is very responsive! Lots of restaurants close by and very well located within walking distance to major attractions!
We loved our stay here!

Alles gut gelaufen, gerne wieder!

Vielen Dank Sebastian für die anschaulichen Videos zur Wohnung bzw. für die Tipps zur Gegend!

Fijn appartement dat rust geeft na een drukke dag. Locatie is prima, dichtbij de tram.  Prima bedden, fijne douche en thee en koffie voor handen. Very nice apartment and very good stay in it. A very nice communication with the host and a breathtaking comfort.

Zeer mooi, lichtrijk en ruim verblijf.  Perfecte uitvalsbasis voor enkele dagen Berlijn.  Zeer netjes.  Mooie eetruimte.  2 terrasjes.  En de fietsen kunnen veilig geparkeerd worden op de binnenplaats.  Absolute aanrader !
Sehr sauber.

Die Wohnung hat eine gute Lage. Es gibt viele Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und Restaurants in direkter Nähe. Bus und U-Bahn direkt um die Ecke. Trotzdem ist es sehr ruhig nachts. That was everything I wanted. Will plan to come back soon.

Schöne Unterkunft mit Terrasse und kleinem Garten. Sehr nette Vermieterin, immer ansprechbar und hilfsbereit. Gerne wieder.

Muy contenta con la estancia muy limpio e igual a la foto! Lo único que no hay ventana y la puerta está conectada directamente a la calle, pero es un barrio tranquilo, así que ningún problema. Espero repetir estancia algún dia!

Netter Aufenthalt, geräumiges sauberes Zimmer, gute Matratze. Nach hinten raus gelegen, war das Zimmer super ruhig. Das Fenster in das Bad, mit Blick auch auf die Toilette, ist aber recht gewöhnungsbedürftig. Insgesamt trotzdem sehr empfehlenswert.

Mooi authentiek appartement, leuke omgeving wijk en veel restaurant’s !

This is a gorgeous and unique apartment in a really beautiful area of Berlin. Very central and great local options also. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.

Highly recommended!! Esther's room was perfect for my needs. I stayed for 8 days and it was beyond my expectations! very spacious, all renovated and luminous!
Esther was super nice, available, flexible with my check in/ out times. We almost didn't see each other so I had a lot of privacy.
Excelente ubicación, limpio y bien distribuido el espacio.

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour chez Betty et Stefan. L'appartement est parfaitement conforme à la description et aux photos. Il est également très propre. Le quartier est très agréable, nous recommandons ce studio !

Ulf’s place was perfect for what we needed: a comfortable place to sleep close to public transit, with the ability to cook breakfast. Great communication - thank you!

The apartment looks exactly like the photos. It was clean and very easy to get to, close to train stations with shops and restaurants near by. Easy check in, super clean and spacious. Perfect for our trip to Berlin.
Excellent communication and check in, okay apartment next to a park. would come again.

Accurate description and pictures. Very clean and comfortable. Check in process was easy. Perfect location. Would recommend to anyone!! I would stay here again.

Easy check-in, safe neighbourhood, large and spotless apartment, responsive and accommodating host.  Perfect experience.

This was one of my favorite of all time airBnb stays, because of the apartment itself and the neighborhood. Fantastic apartment and location

Cos's place is a stylish, spacious one-bedroom apartment with a kitchen designed for serious cooks. When I travel, I'm obsessed with food (actually, when I'm home I'm obsessed with food also), so the kitchen was very important to me. I was delighted to find it was just as described, with even more amenities than I expected. Such as? A DeLonghi fully automatic espresso maker. Plenty of pantry staples, such as coffee beans, olive oil, sugar, salt and pepper. An electric sandwich griddle, which we never even had a chance to use. A chef's apron. What short-term rental apartment ever has an apron? I used both the ceramic cooktop and the oven and found them excellent.
With the twice-weekly Turkish market literally right outside your door, you can eat amazingly well at Cos's place without setting foot in a restaurant. But of course the local restaurants are great, from hole-in-the-wall Middle Eastern kebab places to gourmet establishments. Don't miss the Markthalle Neun, the food market nearby in Kreuzberg.
The beautiful living room overlooks a row of trees next to the Landwehr canal. The living room is a great place to hang out but I have to confess we spent almost no time sitting on the couch during our one week in Berlin. There was so much to do! We never even turned on the TV.

The apartment is located about equidistant from two U-Bahn stops, different lines, so it's super-convenient. We never took taxis, just traveled on the U- and S-Bahn.
I can't recommend Cos's place enough. I literally am planning another trip to Berlin and we wouldn't consider staying anyplace else.
