Kitty’s studio is located in a quiet neighbourhood full of character, with plenty of lovely restaurants and cafés nearby. The space is very spacious and clean, and the balcony is a wonderful touch that adds to its charm. We really enjoyed our stay there.

This was the first shared place my partner and I stayed in and it was amazing! Sebastian and Philip were great hosts and very welcoming. They also helped us with anything that we needed like washing/cooking. Their apartment had everything you needed and more compared to most full apartment listings in Berlin. The plus was that you had great company to share it with☺️ The room that we stayed in had a separate entrance through the living area and it was on the opposite end of the apartment (sound proofed) so we never had to worry about noise. It also had plenty of storage, a lovely bathroom and a cozy bedroom with air con. The location of the apartment is also very good. It has lots of restaurants and bars but it’s not as crazy as the inner city, which is great especially if you’re coming home late at night. The public transport is at your doorstep and there’s literally a cafe, pharmacy, drugstore and food store 1 minute away. I would really recommend staying here as we’ll be definitely returning ourselves!
Really easy to get around Berlin from this apartment. Although small with a basic bed, it had everything you need. Great value.
Wieder einmal eine pefekte Unterkunft. 100%ig zu empfehlen

Wir wurden herzlich willkommen geheissen und das kleine Appartement von Verda ist hübsch und geschmackvoll eingerichtet und hat alles was man braucht. Die Küche ist komplett und es hat Kaffee und Tee sowie einen Wasserkocher, French-Press Kaffee, Nescafé oder auch eine kleine Bialetti! Alles ist sehr sauber und man freut sich immer aufs nach Hause kommen! Man schläft sehr gut im bequemen Doppelbett; das Schlafzimmer ist zum Hinterhof gerichtet und deshalb sehr ruhig!
Das Tram Nr. M2 hält direkt vor der Türe was wunderbar ist!
Wir kommen gerne wieder!!
Nice location Caro was very cool and helpful
Die Wohnung ist gut gelegen und das Umfeld ist schön städtisch, das geräumige Zimmer verfügt über einen Schatz an Büchern.
Great location and great value. We stayed for 5 weeks and everything was as advertised. Close proximity to great restaurants, supermarkets, bakeries, and parks. We would definitely stay here again.

Lovely, bright flat stocked with many convenient amenities. The Weber grill on the balcony is very special. We grilled 3-4 times per week. 2 nearby supermarkets and dozens of interesting restaurants. Famous Museum Island is literally right around the corner.

Thor is incredibly thoughtful and considerate, and he makes your experience so personal! He offered to show me around the area, had a bike available, and even made a wonderful soup to share :) The space is lovely and in a convenient location. Perejil, the cat, is wonderful.

I had a great stay at Ella's! She was very helpful explaining everything I needed to make the best of my stay in Berlin, open and warm company to hang around. Her apartment is very nice with a cozy terrace and big rooms, very comfortable for a stay in this beautiful city!
Good location
Very clean and a great size. Neighbourhood good and close to supermarket. Also central so close to tourist spots

Super Aufenthalt!
Die Wohnung bietet eine ideale Lage, ist sehr sauber und der Gastgeber war äußerst hilfsbereit. Die Kommunikation verlief reibungslos. Insgesamt ein angenehmer Ort zum Übernachten.

The apartment was great. 4 bedrooms(comfortable beds), with living room(which can be used as another bedroom), 2 bathrooms and kitchenette. This made for a very comfortable stay for the 7 of us.
The washing machines were great and well used.
Location was good. 5 minutes walk from Frankfurter Allee station which is a transfer station allowing for multiple destinations. 12 minutes to Alexanderplatz.
Lots of food and shopping options close by.
Communication was great.
If coming back to Berlin with a small group will book here again.
Great stay.

Terrific apartment in a wonderful part of a lovely neighborhood.
Close to everything yet still peaceful.
Lea was a kind and responsive host.
You should definitely stay here if you are visiting Berlin.

Overall disappointing. Checkin was advertised as 14:00 but Simon said that cleaning would not be complete until 17:30. This was not a problem for us as our flight was delayed. The apartment was not as clean as we would have liked (dust on shelves, crumbs and dirt in the kitchen drawers, mould on the shower door, sticky kitchen table).

Susan and Florian’s place was a peaceful getaway within Prenzy, that is home to many of our favourite cafes and restaurants. It’s just near the U-Bahn and with great tram connectivity if you’re planning to head into Mitte or other districts. Prenzy is a relatively more peaceful area to explore Berlin from, and Susan and Florian’s home was the most comfortable place to rest after a day of exploration. Thanks for hosting us!

Nähe zum Zentrum von Berlin, bezahlbare Parkmöglichkeit, Wohnung entspricht voll den Erwartungen, als Stadtwohnung sehr ruhig. Pool- und Saunanutzung möglich. Für einen Berlinurlaub eine klare Empfehlung.

Alles in allem waren wir zufrieden.
Das Bad hat leider etwas komisch gebrochen. Es gibt leider keine Parkplätze für Autos. Wir mussten nun an der Straße Parken und haben für das Wochenende 45€ gezahlt.

El cuarto está muy cómodo, súper acogedor y limpio. El baño bien y el barrio con buena ubicación y bonito. La cocina no es ideal. En general la comunicación fue buena para llegar pero Julián nunca me respondió  después de que llegué. Tuve una buena experiencia en general.

Ich habe mich in Ursulas Appartement vom ersten Moment an wie zuhause gefühlt.  Alles was du brauchst ist vorhanden, und sollte etwas fehlen, Ursula wird bestimmt sofort Abhilfe schaffen. So ist sie. Der kombinierte Schlaf- und Wohnraum ist luftig, hell und hoch. Das Bett funktionierte sehr gut für mich. Die Illustrationen und Zeichnungen von Ursula sind sorgfältig ausgesucht und schön gerahmt. Es gibt einen geräumigen Flur und durch die kleine Pantry kommst du in ein ebenfals helles, grosses Bad, ausgetattet mit sowohl Badewanne, als auch Dusche mit ausreichend Power. Schmankerl ist Fussbodenheizung im ganzen Appartement. Komme sehr gerne wieder.

Wir hatten einen wunderschönen Aufenthalt im Tiny House. Trotz des eher kalten Wetters im November konnten wir es uns sehr gemütlich machen.
Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen.
Für jeden sehr zu empfehlen!

What a lovely place. I could live in this apartment. So nice to be greeted by someone who lived in the building and obviously took pride in their home. Fantastic abnb. Excellent area if you are looking for something slightly more upmarket and the urbane street wear shopping close by is world class.

Hanna en Paolo zijn een geweldige gastvrouw en gastheer. Ze communiceren altijd snel, ze stellen hun huis (en balkon) beschikbaar, ze geven veel handige tips en ze bieden 's avonds gezelligheid. Je voelt je bij hen meteen thuis. Privacy is ook goed mogelijk. Het appartement ligt centraal en vanaf daar zijn alle highlights lopend of met openbaar vervoer te bereiken. Kortom: een topplek in een topstad met tophosts!
J'ai été très bien accompagnée pour trouver l'endroit, puis l'accueil a été chaleureux. Je me suis sentie tout de suite "à la maison".

Bel appartement, belle décoration... conforme à l'annonce.
Enfin un Airbnb avec du matériel de cuisine et de la vaisselle :- )
Literie top.
Si on revient à Berlin on n'hésitera pas à reprendre ce logement !

Ivo was a great host! He was very welcoming and helped me with any questions I had about the city. The place was very tidy and had all the amenities you could possibly need. I really recommend staying here as the location was super close to the city centre. 5/5 in every way!!
Lovely location close to everything
Excellent place to stay. Well located and a responsive host. Highly recommended.
Nice location 、friendly service、good food and good place to meet new friends.The restroom in EG is really impressive，really nice price also.

We really enjoyed our stay. Katja is very nice and welcoming. The room  was confortable and we liked a lot the neighbourhood. You can enjoy peaceful walks along the river and you will find awesome and rather cheap restaurant all around !

Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable chez Jan.  L'appartement est comme sur les photos.  Une petite cour isole le batiment de la rue  et le garde au calme. Le tram est proche et pratique pour se rendre au centre de Berlin.  Une boulangerie est à 2 pas et on trouve facilement des commerces à proximité.
Very nice location! Very reactive hosts!
Sehr zufrieden,  würden wieder kommen 👍👍👍

Johanne's place is on the great location with great transportations(U8 & walking distances to a lot of top attractions). Moreover, Johanne is such a hospitable and helpful person, I enjoyed my week-long stay here very much
We loved our stay in this loft apartment. The place was clean and well equipped. The surrounding area also had lots of great bars and good transport links. Thank you to our hosts!
Geweldige accommodatie voor een grotere groep. Dichtbij het openbaar vervoer.

The receptionists were very kind, they helped us with some things. The apartment was good, comfortable, clean. And there are bus/metro stops near the apartment, a place to rent bikes, and a nice kaffe!
Chris is super welcoming and inviting and has a lovely place in a great location.
Easy access to U and trams. Very quiet. Vincenzo was a great communicator. We stayed for a month and it was a great base to explore Berlin.
Eine sehr schöne, saubere Wohnung mit vielen netten Bars und Cafes in der Nähe. Top organisierte und unkomplizierte Gastgeber. Jederzeit wieder!
Sandy was a wonderful, communicative host. His place was comfortable, secure and in a fantastic location. It has everything you need in a home base to explore Berlin from. Definitely recommend :)
It was a pleasant stay at Berlin. I'd recommend this place.
AMAZING space!! Would highly recommend to anyone staying in Berlin!
Solides Hotel mit angenehmen Preis Leistung Verhältnis und freundlichem Personal

Ein gemütliches und sauberes Zimmer für einen Aufenthalt in Berlin. In der  Zimmer ist alles vorhanden, was man braucht. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden jederzeit wieder hier übernachten. Ich kann es jedem wärmstens empfehlen.
This room is located in a beautiful part of Berlin, full of cafes and restaurants and accessible public transport. Check-in was easy and the room contained everything listed.
This apartment was clean, comfortable, and quiet. It was ideally located. It also had everything we needed. We appreciated having access to the  BBC and CNN in English to keep up with the news.

Great neighborhood. Quiet street, and the flat is on the back of the building so even less street noise. Alan and Kasia have a book of helpful info and recommendations so finding activities or restaurants is a breeze! This would definitely be my choice for my next trip to Berlin.
Good apartment studio for a great weekend stay. Apartment well located and very close to public transports! Coming back for sure

6 friends only came for one night.
it was great for us.
O apartamento é aconchegante limpo organizado está exatamente como na descrição das fotos a recepção foi boa

Out family of four had a great stay at Daphne's apartment. We loved the location - plenty within walking distance but easily connected by public transport too! Daphne also provided us with loads of great tips on what to do in the area etc that was really helpful!

Dagmar and Stefan provided us excellent accommodations to assure a comfortable and enjoyable stay while in Berlin. Stefan greeted us and assisted us on how to use of all the new and modern kitchen and entertainment appliances located within this luxury furnished two-bedroom apartment.  He introduced us to the neighborhood and the amenities of the condominium including the upscale market located at the ground floor of the building.  During our stay Stefan provided immediate response to all questions or concerns conveyed through our texting.   In addition, the building provided a most efficient and pleasant concierge, assisting with taxi and travel arrangements and providing information requested concerning Berlin.  I recommend anyone seeking an apartment in Berlin to consider uniquely styled condominium coupled by an attentive and professional host.

Pro 1-2 osoby je ubytování naprosto skvělé v poměru cena/výkon. Dobře dostupná lokalita blízko rušné části s plno obchody a podniky. Byt je ale ve vnitrobloku, takže uvnitř je naprostý klid. Jednoduše zařízený pokoj s balkónem i kuchyně, k dispozici vše potřebné. V bytě bylo velmi čisto. Damur byl přátelský, laskavý, ochotný. Citily jsme se u něj velmi dobře. Doporučujeme

Simone was the perfect host. Her instructions on getting to the apartment were really clear and helpful. We didn't arrive until 11pm but she was friendly and informative and we had a good chat.
The apartment was lovely and a great size for two people. Impeccably clean and modern, light and bright - exactly as it's shown in the photos.
It's about a 15 minute walk to Alexanderplatz and we walked almost everywhere but there's a train station at the end of the road if you want to use transport.
Thanks Simone!

Etienne made us feel right at home. He was very thorough and helpful and even greeted us when we arrived. The place was very clean, stylish, warm and in a convenient and quiet location. Easily accessible via the tram and was great to explore Prenzlauer Berg as well! Although the place in on the 5th floor it was a lovely view from the top. Definitely recommend staying here and hopefully we will come back again!

Die Tiefparterrewohnung hat einen schönen Schnitt und liegt trotz der zentralen Lage sehr Ruhig zum großen Innenhof. Für unseren Konferenzbesuch war es genau richtig zum Runterkommen. In der Umgebung auch spät noch einkaufen oder essen zu können ist großartig.
Praktisch waren die zwei Duschen. So konnten wir morgens Zeit sparen. Die Kommunikation lief optimal und es war kein Problem, dass wir erst nach 21 Uhr aufschlugen.
Wäre wieder eine Option, wenn ich in der Nähe bin. :)

Cozy and clean.
After a day of going out in cold, windy weather of Berlin, the apartment 22 Pappelallee provided the very much warmth. The heaters and the dehumidifier worked well to make the atmosphere comfortable. The upholstery also let us rest peacefully.
Helpful amenities.
We cooked food and could keep the room clean with the amenities. The cooking utensils are well-arranged enough for us to make delicious dish. Also, the cleaning products also worked well to eliminate dirt and odor. We also could wash and dry our laundry well. Helpful for a long stay.
Accessible.
The place is easy to find on Maps. The tram station is just across the street. The U-Bahn station is only a 10-min walk and Alexanderplatz is only a few stations away with this line. Ideal for exploring Berlin!
Reasonable price, great location. Surprisingly quiet so slept well.

Die hübsche Wohnung liegt ruhig und sehr schön in einem Hinterhaus im Prenzlauer Berg. Sie ist gut ausgestattet und ich habe mich in dem Monat meines Aufenthaltes dort sehr wohl gefühlt. Anne und Axel sind absolut zuverlässig und angenehm im Kontakt. Empfehlenswert!

La ubicación es buena, cerca del centro comercial de Kreuzberg. El edificio está descuidado. Hay que tener en cuenta, que el departamento está en un 5 piso por escalera (no hay ascensor).  La host nos cobró una tasa de 5% en efectivo, de la cual no estábamos informados.  El check-out era a las 10am, sin embargo la host empezó a limpiar nuestro cuarto a las  9 sin nuestra autorización mientras nosotros desayunábamos en  la cocina.

Una estancia muy agradable . La habitación es confortable y muy limpia y puedes hacerte café o té o calentar alguna cosa . Esta muy bien situado a pocas paradas en metro se la puerta de Branderburgo y estaréis rodeados de tiéndas y restaurantes . Agradecer también los
Detalles de bienvenida que siempre hacen la estancia más agradable .

Apartamento muy bonito, muy bien comunicado (transporte público para zona centro y aeropuerto).
Todo limpio y atención fantastica.
Como único punto negativo el colchon podría ser más comodo.

Wij zijn bekend, eerder deze locatie gehuurd van Claudia. Bed is heerlijk en snachts is het doodstil. PrenzlauerBerg vinden wij top! Goede restaurants, leuke winkels en perfect dicht bij metro, tram en U bahn.
We hebben Claudia nog nooit gezien maar zij reageert snel en accuraat. We komen graag nog eens.
Beautiful apartment in a quiet and excellent location. I really recommend this apartment!

Florian never replied to my messages.
Since I never got instructions on how to access the place, I had to spend the night at a cheap hostel.
But airbnb people were so helpful and refunded m fully and helped me to find a better place.
Florian apologized afterwards but it don’t matters much really, the damage was already done.
Esteban은 매우 친절하고 따뜻한 사람이였다 다음번에 베를린에 방문할때에도 무조건 이용하고 싶은 숙소!

Wonderful place to stay in Berlin! Good neighborhood, lots of choices for transportation- taxi, tram, subway right there. Delicious local restaurants. But best is the apartment itself. Clean, everything in its place, great amenities, several private indoor and outdoor spaces. We wish we stayed longer as it was such a nice urban home away from home.
Everything is great
bardzo dobra lokalizacja w centrum, blisko s-ban i u-ban, czysto, bardzo dobry kontakt z właścicielem.

We had a great stay at this Airbnb home. The location was convenient, and the check-in process was smooth. The home was nicely decorated and had all the amenities we needed for a comfortable stay (except for there is no hood in the kitchen, so when we cooked steak the fire alarm went off). While there were a few minor issues we encountered (such as a light that would turn off in the shower if we stayed in there for some time and a cold floor in the restroom), they did not significantly impact our experience. All in all, we had a good time at this Airbnb and would recommend it to others.
Todo limpio y correcto. Axel es amable pero la comunicación no es fácil porque no habla más que un poquito de inglés.

Wibke is the perfect host! She's verry nice !
Her appartement is beautiful and spacious, you would love it!
We loved our trip in Berlin thank's to her advices !
Don't hesitate anymore and trust Wibke!

The house was very cozy, and our room and bathroom were very clean. Our host was Rudolf, who was very hospitable and polite. The house is located in a peaceful area with tall pine trees, 7 minutes (on foot) from the U-Bahn station at Onkel Toms Hütte. We highly recommend it!

Sehr schöne und komfortable Unterkunft. Die Innenhof Lage ist besonders charmant. Wir waren mit Kleinkind unterwegs und konnten uns wirklich gut organisieren, da auch die Wohnung praktischerweise im Erdgeschoss ist.

My daughters & I felt comfortable and at home at Duc Son’s appartement. It is very spacious and is well maintained. We really appreciated being able to run a load of laundry with the washer provided. We live Berlin and this is a fantastic neighborhood to stay in. Highly recommend!!!
That is a super great apartment
Heike was a very nice hostess, the place was very unique and nested in a good location right next to the tram. Would highly recommend booking.
Really great stay ! Close to the station and spacious apartment. Definitely recommend.
Amazing place and service!! Well worth the visit... hospitality 100%! Don’t miss out
Marwa was a very friendly host and her warmth translated into her apartment space as well. It was very cosy, comfortable and spacious. We really loved our stay!!

Carolina and Athena chic apartment was exactly what needed for our week's stay in Berlin. Our daughter ran in the Berlin Marathon. The apartment was clean, tidy, well equipped and perfectly placed right next the M2 & M10 tram stops.
We flew into Schonefeld Airport and purchased our 7day passes at the station.
After that, travelling around Berlin was a piece of 'cake'.
There were plenty of cafes and restaurants within easy walking distance of the apartment, just minutes away.
Many thanks to Carolina and Athena.
Derek and Lyn.

Fijne kamer in gezellig huis van Conrad. Schoon. Goeie sfeer. Lekker bed.
Conrad is heel vriendelijk.
Hij maakte lekkere koffie voor ons in de ochtend en vertelde ons leuke dingen om te doen in Berlijn.
Je bent wel echt in zijn huis. Maar dat was in dit geval heel leuk.
Een aanrader.
Anna’s place is very nice! We loved the vintage vibe, the location is great, the place was clean.. just great:)

A great location & the apartment was a home away from home for us for a while. There was a sudden change to the entry process during our stay that created some challenges, and my wife and I were happy to leave the small second bedroom behind us, but overall a great stay. We appreciated the late checkout in particular.

Die Wohnung ist einfach grossartig! Sie ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet, viele liebevolle Details, sehr gemütlich. Die Lage der Wohnung ist perfekt (Lokale, Läden, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel), das Schlafzimmer Richtung Innenhof gelegen,  ruhig. Nur zu empfehlen und jederzeit wieder!
Die Unterkunft war sehr schön eingerichtet, wir haben uns dort sehr wohl gefühlt. Uwe und seine Frau waren auch sehr hilfsbereit und nett. Alles in allem sehr zu empfehlen.
Very nice place to stay. Good neighbourhood with nice places for coffee, breakfast/brunch and close to a nice park with a market. Had a very good experience. Would gladly repeat.

I had an amazing time staying at Ece's place.
Her mom was amazing and very friendly. Very thoughtful and always ready to help out.
The place was amazing and very clean and it was fully equipped with everything you have at home.
The location is amazing. Only 15min walk from the TV Station Tower and the city hall. Public transportation is right outside of the place and you can get to the centre of Berlin or the wall in just 10min or less.
There is a restaurant and 2 market stores right in front of the house.
Definitely recommend staying there if you want to be close to the centre but still enjoy the quite time at night.
Will book in the future when I go back to Berlin.

We loved Tanja’s apartment. The location was fantastic. The apartment is  very centrally located and on a main road but inside the apartment is very quiet as it faces away from the road and toward a park to the rear. There are some great restaurants nearby, we would recommend Pirouette! And very near to a few u bahn stations and tram stations for visiting other areas.
Super friendly host! Lovely location, and brilliant for 3 people!
Rundum sehr zufrieden. Johanna ist eine sehr zuvorkommende, hilfsbereite und unkomplizierte Gastgeberin, bei der wir uns durchweg wohlgefühlt haben. Einfach nur empfehlenswert :)
Great location, nice and quiet street. Host was very friendly and quick with his reply.

Top Wohnung, zwar sehr klein, aber das ist ja auch so beschrieben und auch zu zweit, kann man hier für ein paar Tage gut klarkommen. Die Wohnung ist in einem sehr guten Zustand, allerdings hellhörig.
Die Lage war für uns super, da es viele gute Restaurants, auch für Veganer*innen, in der Umgebung gibt und man kann auch zu Fuß einiges erreichen, wenn man bereit ist, auch ein wenig zu gehen. Zudem ist die Wohnung auch perfekt mit den Öffis erreichbar.
Die Kommunikation mit Frank ist auch top gewesen.
Had a great stay, everything was as promised. The apartment was spacious and clean, and Ralph was very welcoming. Would definitely stay here again!
Great location, lovely apartment, responsive host. Nothing to complain about, would stay here again.
Fantastic appartement and neighbourhood!

Anders' place was great. It was very comfortable and cozy. The communication was pleasant and easy to navigate. We stayed for a week and the location was well connected to get everywhere we needed to go. Given that the flat is located in the heart of Friedrichshain, it does make it susceptible to noise, particularly on the weekends. For us it was manageable with ear plugs, but it is good to keep in mind in case this is a main consideration for certain travelers. As other reviewers noted, you make your own beds, but none of us saw this as a cause for complaint or found it to be an issue whatsoever.
Overall, we had a great stay and would recommend the place to anyone looking for a comfortable and relaxed place to stay in a vibrant part of Berlin. We would definitely book here again in the future! Thank you Anders!

llegamos tarde y nos pareció todo muy oscuro, pero es verdad q la cuidad está poco iluminada, yo vengo de España q esta todo muy iluminado, nos costó entender el transporte, pero en general todo muy bien lo recomiendo, cerca hay tiendas, volveré! muchas gracias también al.anfitrion q nos respondió a unas horas avanzadas del dia
Alles top, nur doof war es dass sich die Rezeption und Zimmer in der 5/6 Etage befanden und der Fahrstuhl ging nicht…
It was an amazing apartament, not too far from ubahn so getting everywhere was super easy. Very cozy

We loved the Prenzlauer Berg neighborhood! Also the flat was pretty easy to find.

The apartment was tidy, stylish, cosy and comfortable. We also loved the terrace in the backyard. The appartment is suitable for a family travelling with the children.

Everything worked well except we didn't manage to use the TV despite the instructions.

Die Wohnung ist sehr geschmackvoll gestaltet und hat viel Charme.
Es war alles sehr sauber. Das Bett war super bequem.
Die Lage perfekt! Trotzdem sehr ruhig und alles gut erreichbar.
Digitaler Check-in & Check-out sehr einfach. Gerne komme ich wieder.

Nuestra estancia en Berlin no podría haber sido mejor. El departamento muy bien ubicado, en un barrio tranquilo, super limpio y excelentemente decorado. Eramos 4 personas y estábamos muy cómodos, esperamos poder volver.
We loved our stay in Berlin! Doug was a great host, and provided clear instructions and an accurate description of the property

Great place to stay! We were in Berlin for a wedding and it was a perfect location. Good, comfortable beds, nice common area space, easy check-in. There’s lots of grocery stores and shops around. There’s a bit of noise from the street, but that is to be expected in a big city!

Violeta is a very nice host. Communication was perfect. Quick respond. Prenzlauer Berg is one of the most beautiful districts in Berlin. It's just 10 min. to reach Alexaner Plaz. Transport is near by. It was very nice that Violeta was flexible with my check in and out time. We didn't meet, but I felt as she is responsible  and nice person. I had a very nice stay.

Super adresse: cette petite maison est bien située, lumineuse, très bien entretenue et équipée. L'environnement est très calme, et Simon est un hôte très attentif au bien être de ses locataires. Vraiment à recommander!

Lena's place is really wonderful - clean and comfortable and in an amazing location and nice neighborhood, and also very close to the trains to get to other parts of the city. I had a last minute change to my arrival time but Lena was very easy to get in touch with and was easily able to accommodate my changed schedule. Great experience, highly recommended!
Schöne Unterkunft in guter Lage

We were very happy staying in the studio, for a snug little apartment it was actually a little bigger than it looked in the listing , the bed's very comfortable, what I liked best was it felt as if we were staying in a good friend's place. Really great location, lovely area with lots of bars and restaurants, right beside the tram stop but mostly we used the bikes available, as even if you stay out, you can always take the bikes on the train. We loved the wood burning stove. The tiny Vegan place directly across the street does a very good dinner for €10. We loved the market nearby on Saturday morning.
Great flat directly on a quite street! Very clean etc, nothing bad to say about.
Regina was very welcoming and accommodating. She had great recommendations for restaurants, and she helped me get settled into the neighborhood.

Wonderful apartment! It was perfectly clean, warm, and comfortable. Honestly, the bed was like a cloud. The neighbourhood is quiet and calm, and there are coffee shops and cafes really close to the apartment.
Katharina was a brilliant host - responded super quickly to messages and was friendly and welcoming!
Cannot recommend this apartment highly enough!

The best neighbourhood ever! Lovely flat with all you need and a really comfy bed. We didn’t spend much time in the flat as we wanted to get the most out of our time in berlin. It’s such a good location with cute cafes and markets just around the corner. The host was easy to communicate with and very helpful. Thank you for the nice stay.
Perfekt leilighet til weekendtur

It was a pleasure to reside in your classic Prenzlauerberg flat, with high ceilings and an intellectual ambience enhanced by eclectic visual art and artifacts. Shelves of carefully curated books were a main feature and we sampled a few of them, as the quiet setting was conducive to reading. The spacious bath and shower, with good water pressure, were excellent. A Christmas tree decorated with real candles kept us in a holiday spirit!
Easy access to the M2 and M4 trams meant we could traverse Berlin at will, which we did, enjoying a couple jazz dens, some book stores, architectural wonders, Weihnachtmarkts, and a wide variety of good restaurants. Your generosity in providing us a home away from home during the holidays that transmitted clues and signs of everyday life was much appreciated. Best wishes!
Danke sehr!

Michael is kind, gracious, keeps a clean house and is very helpful. He lent me medicine when I felt ill and all the pharmacies were closed, for example. He communicates well and leaves you to do your own thing in peace while still being friendly. The flat is close to public transport and shops.
One issue is that the post doesn't emphasize how small the mezzanine is, nor how close to the other bedrooms and front door it is. If you are claustrophobic you could definitely encounter problems with the mezzanine's size (the ceiling is less than a meter from your nose when lying on the bed). There isn't much space to spend down-time, if you want to chill at home in the day. On the other hand, Michael was sure to supply the mezzanine with clean bedding, a bedside light and a small fan to keep us cool, as well as space to store our bags.
Fantastic apartment with plenty of room and a great patio space. Lots of windows made the space feel very open and gave plenty of breeze. Would stay here again.
Tolle Lage, sehr nette Gastgeber und ein zweckmäßiges, sauberes Zimmer für eine Person. Alles super. Würde ich beim nächsten Berlin Besuch gerne wieder buchen!
Hans Jörg war super angenehm und sehr sehr nett! Tolles Apartment in toller Lage und super sowohl zum entspannen  als auch zum entdecken von Berlin. Gerne wieder!
Nice apartment in a great location with a very helpful host

O apartamento de Hilda é um ótimo custo benefício para quem quer conhecer Berlim. Acomoda bem 5 pessoas e nos atendeu perfeitamente. O encontramos com uma limpeza impecavel e com tudo muito bem organizado
O bairro de Steglitz é bastante tranquilo e familiar, possui uma variedade de restaurantes com comidas de todos os lugares do mundo. A avenida acima possui uma grande variedade de lojas e shoppings. Também fica muito bem localizada em suas conexões com a região central e mais turística de Berlim, nos arredores você pode facilmente pegar um metrô, trem ou ônibus.
Hilda é uma hóspede super cortês e organizada em suas locações. Nos passou todas as instruções de check in, check out, e regras do apartamento com clareza. Também forneceu ótimas dicas de restaurantes em Berlim
Espero retornar um dia.
Sehr gemütlicher und ruhiger Innenhof, nicht allzu weit vom Bahnhof Ostkreuz entfernt.
We werden netjes ontvangen. De ruimtes waren spik en span. Het was voor ons een goede uitvalsbasis om Berlijn te verkennen.

Une paires de tongs et de onnes boules quies obligatoires pour pouvoir dormir du fait des allers-venues dans les couloirs. Couvre feux de 22h obligatoire niveau bruit hyper bien respectés.
Situation idéale. Personnel adorable, dispo et en nombre. Même des vigiles pour assurer le calme et la sécurité (eux aussi super sympas).
Moquette partout dans les halls et chambres = propreté limitées de fait. Ma chambre sentait la cigarette en arrivant (mais pas le lit, qui Etat propre). Travail des femmes de ménage parfait, juste la moquette + le très frand passage = nettoyage intensif et non stop obligatoire.
J‘y retournerai :-)
Gemütliches Unterkunft mit allem, was wir brauchten, und Vincent ist ein sehr netter Gastgeber. Nochmals vielen Dank!

Insgesamt ein schöner Aufenthalt.
Schön möbliert und gut eingerichtet, hat so gut wie garnichts gefehlt. Der ÖPNV ist auch gut zu erreichen, fußläufig ca 5 Minuten bis zu nächsten Tram-Station und innerhalb von 20 Minuten (ab Wohnung) ist man in der Innenstadt.
Kleines manko unsererseits, Geschirr (bzw Töpfe) mussten wir nochmal spülen, da es nicht ganz sauber war.
Backofen könnte mal wieder eine vernünftige Reinigung erhalten.
Einige Fliesen könnten ausgebessert oder ausgetauscht werden, aufgrund von Rissen und macken.
Und das Kabelmanagement kann man vielleicht nachbessern.
Sonst keine Probleme gehabt, Gastgeber war stets freundlich und fürsorglich.
Parkplätze waren ebenfalls genügend vorhanden und nah an der Unterkunft.

The flat is well placed for all the sights, it is clean and comfortable with everything needed.
The host's communication is excellent.

Wunderschönes Apartment. Kommunikation und Check in top! Sehr sauber und gemütlich.
Nur zu empfehlen!

Excelente el departamento y la atención de Douglas. Muy atento a lo que pudiéramos necesitar en todo momento. Además nos ayudó con las valijas después del check out, lo que nos permitió salir a dar una vuelta hasta nuestra partida.
Muy recomendable todo.

Die Unterkunft war sauber und ordentlich, vollkommen ausreichend für eine Nacht in Berlin schön zentral gelegen. Das Fenster geht zum Hof raus, dementsprechend konnten wir bei offenem Fenster schlafen. Ich hätte lieber das Zimmer mit 4 Einzelbetten gehabt, aber das Zimmer mit den 2 Stockbetten war auch gut. Das Bad war sehr sauber und neu gemacht. David ist ei netter Gastgeber, gibt Tipps für Restaurants und Parkplätze.Den Parkplatz gibt es nicht auf dem Grundstück aber es gab genügend gebührenfreie Parkplätze an der Straße. Sehr empfehlenswert.

Great place to stay - close to metro, walking distance to supermarket & tourist attractions.
Everything you could need in the apartment & spotless!
Host was helpful & friendly.
We loved our stay in Berlin!
Alles top und die perfekte Unterkunft für einen Wochenendtrip!

Super appartement, propre bien placé pour bouger dans Berlin , quartier super sympa, l appart est super propre et très bien équipé pour un long week-end ! Le principe du sans clé est top !! Et la possibilité de laisser ses bagages avant et après aussi ! Grand réactivité bref c était top ! Nous n hésiterons pas à recommander à des amis et à y séjourner de nouveau ! Merci

The apartment was absolutely perfect for our first 3 nights in Germany! The location was fantastic - very easy to walk the the central train station or to the tram stop and the accommodation felt very private and secure. We enjoyed using the staircase as it felt very traditional and grand but there was also a lift when we had our suitcases. The apartment was well equipped with everything we needed during our stay. The shower was excellent, the beds comfortable and it was great to have a table in the kitchen to eat breakfast before heading out for the day.
Downstairs there was a fantastic artisanal coffee shop and we found Mia's food recommendations to be extremely useful. The location couldn't be better for exploring the Berlin wall memorial and the Mauerpark flea market on a Sunday. If we are in Berlin again we will defiintely book this apartment!
* The city tax needed to be left in cash on the table of the apartment - there is a cash machine on the opposite side of the road*
Had a great time while staying here. Location is easy accessible by tram. The apartment itself was clean and decent.
jederzeit wieder!

We had a great experience staying here. The place was clean, spacious, and exactly as described. The location was perfect, close to everything we needed. It felt very comfortable and well-maintained throughout. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a quality stay in the area!

Perfekter Raum an der perfekten Lage! Ich liebe den Hinterhof, die Bar unten am Haus, die Gallerien und Restaurants in der Umgebung. Unkomplizierte Kommunikation mit dem Host. Habe Marcus auch kurz persönlich gesehen. Er war sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Ich komme wieder!
Alles perfekt gewesen, vor allem die Lage! Die U-Bahn ist auch in der Nähe. Kann ich weiter empfehlen!

Apartment is on the ground floor and is accessible via the main street- super convenient (still felt safe) and so happy I didn't have to lug my stuff up those crazy steep European stairs! This is a professional operation -definitely worth the money- and I'd recommend it to anyone visiting Berlin!

Oli's place is perfect; really clean, excellent appliances and he's a great communicator if you need Berlin advice. I was really impressed with the sofa bed - it's as comfortable as a really good normal bed and very easy to get out and put back. Highly recommended.
Great location. Stylish and clean apartment. Host was nice and responsive. I would recommend this place.

A really nice place in a pretty good location. Communication and checkin was very good. However, it is difficult to rate over 3 stars as there was significant issue with the shower/bathroom. This is a perfect place to stay whilst visiting Berlin. It had everything we needed and was in a great location near the wall. We requested a cot for our toddler and this was made available. We would definitely recommend.

Great place to stay! Very comfortable, clean, and exactly as described. The location was convenient with easy access to everything I needed. I had no issues during my stay and would definitely recommend it to others.

The location was nice right next to the park and decently connected to the rest of Berlin. David and Inaam were great hosts, it was clear it was important to them that we enjoyed our stay.
clean and modern, good internet connection and in the middle of friedrichshain, a very good area in Berlin to stay.

Follow his restaurant recommendations. We ate at 3 of them and every single one was incredibly delicious.
We surely come back for another stay.
My time in Berlin was great and memorable thanks to Francesco :) def recommend 100%

Lage, Ausstattung und Sauberkeit sind Klasse!

After we accidentally locked ourselves out, Mina was super helpful and understanding. Great service and wonderful apartment!
Super friendly and beautiful area.
Wirklich sehr schön und empfehlenswert. Sieht genau so aus wie auf den Bildern und liegt in einer tollen Gegend. Perfekt für einen Mädels Trip :)

Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt in der Wohnung!  Der Check-In verlief ohne Probleme kontaktlos und wir konnten flexibel einchecken. Famille française, parisienne du 6ème arrondissement, nous sommes partis à Berlin avec notre fille ado de 15 ans pour lui faire découvrir cette ville spectaculaire et son histoire extraordinaire dans les meilleures conditions possibles. Nous pouvons dire que Louis a formidablement contribué à faire de notre voyage une superbe expérience.
Louis a été très attentif à ce que tout se passe bien pour notre arrivée et pour notre départ.
Toujours joignable, Louis a été très réactif lorsque nous en avions besoin.
Louis avait par ailleurs veillé à quelques petites attentions que nous avons grandement appréciée (ne serait que pour l'intention).
Louis est vraiment un hôte de très grande qualité.
L'appartement de Louis est très agréable et correspondait parfaitement à notre souhait de séjourner dans un lieu berlinois pourvu de caractère, de design et de confort (la literie est très bonne notamment).
La décoration de l'appartement nous a beaucoup plu, elle reflète une personnalité ouverte sur le monde et la culture (tout ce que nous aimons donc).
L'appartement était par ailleurs impeccable de propreté et très fonctionnel (nous avons pris plusieurs petits déjeuners très agréables sur place).
Le quartier est parfait, très agréable à vivre : très arboré, propre, on y trouve une population bourgeoise bohème avec des enfants aussi. Le quartier est calme, avec peu de touristes (comme nous) mais pourvu de nombreux et très bons restaurants (deux superbes Italiens notamment), pas mal de restaurants veggie aussi ainsi que des cafés pour prendre de très bons "Frühstück" (petits déjeuners) en terrasse.
Cette ambiance berlinoise authentique, peu touristique mais animée malgré tout, c'est exactement ce que nous recherchions.
Enfin, l'appartement de Louis est situé non loin de deux stations de métro de la ligne U2 qui vous mèneront très vite (10-15 min) où vous le souhaitez dans les coeurs touristiques de Berlin.
Pour finir nous ne pouvons que vous recommander de séjourner chez Louis.
