Nous ne pouvons que recommander ce logement et nous y retournerons si nous revenons à Berlin ! Merci Marcello !

Eine kleine Wohnung etwas ausserhalb vom Zentrum. Nichts besonderes, aber es genügt definitiv für einen kurzen Aufenthalt mit 4 Personen. Eine gut ausgestattete und einigermassen geräumige Küche, dafür ist das Bad etwas klein.
Nice Room for a Weekend Trip :)
Amazing, cozy, quiet place.

Lio est une hote chaleureuse et accueillante. Les explications concernant le logement étaient très claires (nous avons reçu un document à notre arrivée). Le lit était confortable.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour et nous sommes ravis d'avoir pu faire la connaissance de Lio qui est une personne arrangeante et à l'écoute !
A bientôt peut être :)
Beautiful house, great location and nice host

El apartamento está nuevo, muy limpio y aunque es pequeñito, tiene todo lo necesario. El barrio es muy tranquilo y aunque no está en una zona muy animada, está muy bien comunicado con el centro, (con autobús y tranvía) y los barrios más animados. Recomendaría sin duda alguna este apartamento si se busca tranquilidad.
Nice place. It was  clean. In front of underground station. Quite noisy, but it has a lot of location advantages. Restaurants, supermarkets, park, bus stops.
Sehr gute Unterkunft. Gerne wieder.

So ein schönes und großzügig gehaltenes Apartment haben wir nicht erwartet, wir hatten es nur gehofft. Alles Notwendige ist vorhanden, was man für einen Städtetrip benötigt. Die Unterkunft ist sauber und ordentlich. Von der Buchung über die Schlüsselübergabe bis hin zum Check-out hat alles reibungslos geklappt. Vielen Dank für einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt.

Ein wundervoller Aufenthalt in einer wundervollen Wohnung! Karsten ist sehr nett und die Kommunikation verlief angenehm und unkompliziert. Das Bad ist neu und in dem Bett schläft es sich sehr gut. Die gesamte Wohnung ist gut durchdacht und sehr detailverliebt. Es gibt immer wieder etwas Neues zu entdecken, was Karstens Wohnung zu etwas besonderem macht.
Die nächste U-Bahnstation ist entspannte 5 Min. entfernt und zum Hbf sind es nur drei.
Insgesamt eine super Erfahrung!

we couldnt get in because the code was faulty. the phone number they provide in the app doesnt work. The number they provided in the check in site does work though. And when i reached them they were really helpful.
Then after midnight the fire alarm went out randomly so we had to spend an hour outside.
I have to say i was already tired and these things added a lot of stress on top of it. so two stars.
Super Lage, problemlose Kommunikation, geräumiges Apartment. Gerne wieder!

Jessy is a fabulous host. She has created a beautiful apartment that has everything you need to feel cosy and comfortable. We felt very much at home. Jessy has amazing insider tips of interesting places to visit and wonderful places to eat. She was very quick to respond when we had a question. The apartment is very well located and we walked everywhere. There are also excellent public transport options close to the apartment. You can’t go wrong staying at Jessy’s place.
100%recomendada, la casa es amplia, cómoda y limpia, tiene 2 baños, está muy bien ubicada, con seguridad  volveriamos.

We stayed at Robert's flat for 2 nights and we enjoyed it very much. It has all the equipment we needed, it was very clean and cosy. There is also a nice garden. Robert is a very nice person and very helpful. I would really recommend it!
Very nice place and a great location. Very nice and flexible host. Would definitelg stay there again
Nice big apartment. Located in a quiet area with easy access to U-bahnen.

Das Appartement entspricht der Beschreibung. Wir waren dort mit 3 Kindern und es war für uns als Familie hervorragend geeignet. Zumal wir uns dort ja nur zum Schlafen aufhielten uns tagsüber unterwegs waren.
+ Die spielenden Kinder stören keine Anwohner
+ Es gibt Küche, Dusche und Waschmaschine
+ kostenfreies WLAN und Parkplätze in der Nähe.
Wir kommen gerne wieder.
the rooms are small and very difficult to get to.  Little empathy in the return of money for cancellation.
Host disponibili e accoglienti, camera comoda come da annuncio, zona valida perché ricca di servizi e ben collegata.
Le logement est bien décrit, c'était comme cela que nous imaginions l'atelier de Carol. Un peu loin du centre ville, mais facilement accessible en métro.

There’s a grocery store within 3 mins walking, and a calisthenics gym within 2 mins walking. It’s close to two major train stations which can take you anywhere in Berlin, and it has a nice view of you go to the 18th floor.
只小住了一晚 房间很好很干净  离车站十分钟左右 Tammy人很好 会为你提供你需要的信息 推荐

Thanks Michael for a great, albeit short stay in Berlin! His apartment is very neat and clean, centrally located, and easy to locate. I had a great time staying at Michael's flat and will recommend it to other guests.
Lovely place that easily accomodates family of four. We were with the two of us. Great beds, lovely shower. Close to Mauerpark, cosey area, lovely easy going residents. Prenzlauer Berg favorite place
Wir waren 5 Mädels im Appartement und der Platz hat vollkommen ausgereicht. Das Appartement war wirklich super schön, modern und sauber. Alles hat reibungslos funktioniert. Gerne immer wieder

Total schöne Wohnung in mega Lage. Tram quasi vor der Tür und See auch nicht weit entfernt.
Die Ausstattung ist sehr gut und ich war insgesamt sehr zufrieden:)

Good location with easy access to public transport.  Good, local restaurants within a reasonable walking distance.  Apartment was ideal for two people- quiet with a lovely view of the park. Arne was a responsive host.

Ich war bereits zum zweiten Mal in der Stayery - und war genauso zufrieden wie beim ersten Mal. Gute Lage, gute Ausstattung (eine Küche, die als solche wirklich funktioniert), alles sehr sauber und neuwertig. Die Kommunikation im Vorfeld war sehr gut. Und am wichtigsten: Sehr nettes Personal, immer freundlich und hilfsbereit. Gerne wieder!

Peggy and Kristian are fantastic hosts! We arrived in Berlin on a Saturday night and realized the adapter plugs we’d been using in Italy didn’t work in Germany. I reached out to Peggy to see if she had any tips for buying a plug on Sunday when most shops are closed. Within an hour she’d hung a bag with two plugs on the front door of the apartment for us to use during our stay. Without her responsiveness and generosity, we’d have spent our first full day in the city scrambling to find an open electronics shop. Instead we were able to enjoy the sunshine and visiting our friends in Charlottenburg.
The apartment itself is so cozy and ideally located. We walked and took trains everywhere. The area around Rosenthaler Platz also has great restaurants in a variety of price ranges. We loved Curry Mitte, Standard Pizza, and Yarok. Couldn’t have asked for a more comfortable stay.

Well located apartment and Marcel is a helpful, friendly host. He gave us great recommendations of things to do, restaurants, etc.
Would recommend this to anyone looking for a place to stay while visiting Berlin

Bee's place is in a great location. The Berlin public transport system is easy and her place is convenient to this and to lots of Turkish cuisine. We enjoyed fresh Vietnamese nearby and well priced. We loved Pidgeon the cat too. Thanks Bee.

La ubicación del apartamento es muy buena, cerca de paradas de metro hacia los principales puntos de la ciudad. Hay restaurantes y supermercados y es una zona de Kreutzberg tranquila, con muchísimo arbolado y muy agradable. La comunicación con Martín fue rápida y efectiva.

We hired Werners apartment for four days to see the sights in Berlin. It is a very nice apartment, spacious and clean.  We could make use of all the facilities in the apartment which was very nice. Werner was a very good host. He gave us good tips on the sites in Berlin. On the day we would leave we could stay longer in the apartment.  The apartment is near the subway which brings you very quickly into the center of Berlin.

Wonderful wonderful stay and communication before and during our time there. The open flow of the loft, two large trash bins, water pressure, temperature control, very Berlin style mural outside, and not to mention the accommodation of an extra guest made our experience so nice. Would stay again.
Top gelegene Unterkunft

Eine grosse, helle Wohnung in zentraler Lage. Super-bequeme Betten. Wer Lust hat selbst zu kochen -in Berlin ausserhalb des Lockdowns eigentlich überflüssig- sollte sich seine Lieblingskochtools (z.B. Messer, Weingläser) mitbringen. Parken in den Seitenstrassen gut. Einkaufsmöglichkeit rund um den Prager Platz hervorragend. Bundesallee stark befahren, auch Nachts. Ruhiges Vielfamilienwohnhaus mit Aufzug.
Alles prima
Very comfy and clean apartment. I definitely will be back when I visit Berlin again. Ashraf was very nice and helpful. The location is also great!

This apartment was great, had everything we needed inside, even herbal teas and board games which was a nice surprise. Location was great, close to supermarket and the train line. Only downside was the cleaning team who entered the apartment at 10:02, so make sure you are out on time or be prepared for company. Overall happy with the stay!
Net appartement in een leuke wijk, 6 min lopen naar de metro
perfect location! i liked this artistic vibe in apartaments 🙂

Everybody at FABEL was incredibly helpful and responsive. The apartment is within a walking distance from the Berlin’s version of Champs-Elysees, slightly longer walk to Tiergarten but pretty much easy access to all the important places. Beautifully and unusually arranged apartment, very comfortable bed. Absolutely perfect for a weekend in Berlin. Highly recommend.

Very stylish, clean and tidy. Good size apartment and has everything you need for basic self catering. Great location and we were given good directions to get from the airport to the apartment. Definitely recommend!

El alojamiento es bonito, está limpio. Es igual a las fotos. Pude hacer el check in fácilmente e incluso cuando me quedé fuera de la habitación me ayudaron rápidamente a solucionarlo. No tuve problemas y volvería sin duda.

10 / 10 in every respect.
I would recommend this apartment to anyone considering a break in Berlin!

Le logement de Michel est très bien et conforme à la description. L'emplacement est très bien, proche de commerces, bars, et à 5min à peine du métro. Petit bémol, nous avons été déçu de n'être reçu par personne. Il manque un petit micro onde, et si vous êtes sensible à la lumière, prévoyez un petit masque pour les yeux pour éviter le réveil par la lumière à 7h (j'ai l'impression qu'il y a peu de volets sur berlin). En résumé l'appartement de Michel est très bien avec un bon rapport qualité prix !
Appartement très bien situé dans un quartier très agréable.
Fiquei 3 semanas em Berlim. O senhor Werner foi incrível comigo, me ajudou em tudo que precisei além de tudo estar sempre muito limpo e organizado.

Wir fanden es sehr nett, dass Hans Werner uns zurück zum Bahnhof gebracht hat .Er stand immer für Auskünfte, Informationen und Gespräche zur Verfügung. Die Wohnung war für meinen Aufenthalt mit zwei Kinder ideal. Sehr schön fanden wir auch, dass für unsere Einkäufe kostenlos Fahrräder zur Verfügung standen. Die Lage der Wohnung ist optimal um Berlin zu erkunden.
Super Wohnung, super Kommunikation! Danke

This place is great, clean, roomy, secure, and it has a nice balcony overlooking the Neues Promenade.
It is close to many restaurants, a Grocery Market, Museum Island, and the Hackescher Markt train stop which brings you to and from the Berlin Airport on the S9 line. Further it has a good kitchen, elevator, and a reliable WiFi.
I would recommend it to anyone without hesitation.
Decent place and if you’re okay hoping on the tram now and then I wouldn’t hesitate.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft

Horst was a fantastic host. They were really nice to let us check in later on in the evening.Despite our lack of German and his lack of English, we were able to communicate what was needed. What a cute little garden house. Very clean, well set up. Minimal wifi connection. Short walking distance from train into Berlin and really close to the airport.
Sehr zu empfehlen!
Keinerlei Handtücher
Espaço excelente, perto de supermercados e do metro.
We enjoyed the well decorated flat which is in an excellent Berlin location close to restaurants and a nice grocery store.
All very good. Can recommend if you want to stay in Berlin-Wedding.
Frank was a really good host! Really nice and clean apartment, 100% positive experience

Haitao’s place is fantastic! A lovely apartment for 4-5 people, very cosy and clean, the small kitchen is very good organized and perfect to enjoy your morning coffee/tea or just have a good time with your loved ones. After a long day of exploring the beauty of Berlin you just need a good rest and you can have it in those great and comfortable beds!
If you need anything, Lidl is in the building, but the entrance is from the street. There are also many restaurants and bakeries nearby.
Haitao is an amazing host, very friendly, lovely and supportive! I enjoyed communicating with her, so easy, fast and proactive :) The instructions with screen shots provided by Haitao made self check-in so easy in the late hours when we arrived. We felt like coming home! Thank you Haitao! :)
The apartment is near to the Alexanderplatz, just 5 mins by Tram 4. Tickets can be bought in every tram (2.80€), you just need to have coins! :) And tram station is just in a minute walking distance.
Berlin was so wonderful and so Christmassy with all the Weihnachtsmärkte :) I heard that the city is amazing during the other seasons as well, so Berlin wait for us! We are coming back! :) And will definitely choose Haitao’s place again!!! Highly recommend it!
Happy New Year 2019 to all of you and may it be a blessed and joyful one and full of new adventures!!!
Great Apartment in an awesome area. Very clean and quiet. Kai was a very responsive and friendly host. Will come again.
Auch bei einem weiteren Besuch gibts nichts zu beanstanden. Diese Unterkunft und die Gastgeber sind einfach was ganz besonderes!. Vielen Dank! Manu

Lägenheten ligger alldeles perfekt i ett levande område i Berlin. Gatan är vacker och har massor av restauranger och kaféer med bra priser och det är nära till allmänna kommunikationer. Lägenheten ligger i ett litet hus på en innergård vilket gör att det är väldigt lugnt och tyst.
Värden svarar snabbt på mail och en vän till honom var på plats när vi checkade in och tog väl emot oss och visade oss runt. Värden hade även lagt en flaska vin i kylskåpet vilket var väldigt gulligt. Lägenheten är stor och har allt man behöver.

We stayed here as a family of 4. Me, my wife and 2 young kids. We had a fantastic time.
Location: the Prenzlauerberg area is fantastic. It is simultaneously hip and kid friendly. There are great cafes restaurants and design shops and also a large number of playgrounds and kids activities. The area is also super well connected. The M2 tram is 2 mins away and M4 is very close as well. We went into central Berlin a bunch of times and it was easy and quick.
Home: Nassa's apt is fantastic. Spacious, well lit, high ceilings and tastefully decorated. We loved it.
Host: Nassa was amazing. He was there to greet us and also helped us with small and big things that made our stay great. He got us a plug adapter, an Amazon fire stick to watch Netflix and also helped us order takeout food! He was easy to reach and always quick to respond.
Overall: We loved our stay. It was perfect for what we were looking for. When we visit Berlin again we'd stay in Nassa's place for sure
Alles super. Gerne wieder wenn ich beruflich in Berlin bin.

Vielen lieben Dank für den schönen Aufenthalt. Wir haben uns wohlgefühlt und alles war vorhanden.
Gern wieder beim nächsten Aufenthalt in Berlin!
Prima verblijf gehad. Fijne communicatie met de host. Goede uitvalsbasis voor Berlijn, vlakbij de metro. Appartement van alle gemakken voorzien.

The frontdoor to the apartment was very tricky, and we had problems getting in. After some rehearsals it got a bit better, but we were always a bit anxious that we couldn’t get in. So we recommend it to be changed.
Alles wie erwartet. Praktisch und nette Gastgeber.

I loved staying at Marta’s place! The apartment fit the description and the pictures, it was super clean and quiet in the evening.
Location-wise it wasn’t difficult to get to the central area of the city.
Most of all, I enjoyed how responsive and helpful Marta was, she always checked in with me to make sure everything went ok and was super quick to reply my questions.
Thank you again, Marta!

Good comunication and hospitality. A little far from main attractions, but with a neighborhood to be discovered. The building seems to be under renovation, but it was a bad surprise when we arrived at night. The shower needs to be improved.
Een erg goede locatie, metro is dichtbij in de buurt, zodat je Berlijn makkelijk kunt verkennen. Airbnb is ook erg goed en schoon!
Great please to stay , very quiet and comfortable 🥰🥰 super clean too 🤩 highly recommend it 👌

Flat is in a great location, very central and easy to get everywhere by public transport. The apartment furnishing is quite minimalist but there is everything you need (espresso machine, washing machine etc) and the place was very clean. Being in a tower block on a busy road it is a bit loud, but Ivos had kindly left earplugs for us. Would recommend if you’re looking for a convenient place to stay in central Berlin.
Gorgeous flat in a fantastic location, couldn't have been better.

Staying with Christine was a treat. It's a quiet ground floor room in a family home on the courtyard of a typical Berlin apartment block. Christine was there to welcome me on arrival and got me settled in with everything pretty quickly. Breakfast was included for me which was a real treat. The room is spotless and it's exactly like it was pictured. It was a stay the way Airbnb used to be!

Hardys place is a real gem in a lively area with a huge number of restaurants, cafes and bars.
The apartment is equipped with everything you cold want for a pleasant stay. If you are planning to cook for yourself you will find anything you need.
Hardy himself is a really nice and helpful guy who was reacting immediately to any request we had. Checking in and out was flexible and he showed us around in the apartment to explain all the various devices.
There are several grocery stores and "spätis" close to the apartment, as well as two subway stations.
We had a really great time staying at Hardys place and would recommend it without hesitation!

Brilliant short stay in Berlin, couldn't have asked for a better apartment.
Located in THE quietest area, with the most polite neighbours and beautiful views.

Barbara was brilliant and even allowed myself and my partner to arrive at the apartment earlier than organised and stay longer because it was convenient for us.

Highly recommend using the lovely bubble bath too after a long day of walking the streets of Berlin.

Everyone must stay in Barbara's humble abode!
Dobra poloha, ubytovanie pekne a ciste

Angelika byla úžasnou hostitelkou. Bydlela jsem u ní 4 měsíce a cítila se tu jako doma. Na všem se s ní dalo domluvit, ubytování bylo čisté, mohla jsem využívat společné prostory i terasu, kdykoliv jsem chtěla. Další výhodou byla blízká dostupnost MHD a klidné místo. Děkuji moc za příjemný a přátelský pobyt! :)
Naomi’s place was wonderful. So chic and central. Exactly the haven you need in Berlin. Thank you

One of the best Airbnb's that I've stayed at so far, if not the greatest. Gunnar is avety easy going and one can be completely comfortable around his presence.
And their home, feels like a home. Not to mention the meticulous attention to details. Everything was perfectly prepared for my arrival.
Comfortable bed, great shower and utilities. Super fast WiFi.
Highly recommended!

Bonjour,
Nous étions quatre adultes pour un séjour d’une semaine à Berlin. Notre logement était parfait tant au niveau emplacement (quartier calme ), que de sa superficie et de son agencement. L’équipement était complet, il manquait juste un étendage pour faire sécher la lessive.
Attention quand même à une chose si vous choisissez cet appartement, il est au quatrième étage surélevé soit…..88 marches relativement raides. Une bonne semaine de « sport » avec la marche à pied touristique.
Très bonne adresse que nous recommanderons sans souci.
Laurence, Eric, Florence et Magali.

Die Wohnung von Mark und Maja war sehr gut situiert, um Berlin zu besichtigen, 50 Meter vom Südbahnhof entfernt.Die Albauwohnung ist sehr sauber und schön, allerdings im Erdgeschoss, so das man die Fenster nicht ganz geöffnet lassen kann.Maja ist sehr reaktiv und die Kommunication war sehr angenehm.Die Wohnung ist richtig angenehm, perfekt für 4 Personen., wir würden jederzeit wieder kommen.Der einzige Punkt, was uns gestôrt hat war die schlechte wlan Verbindung im Haus. Wir empfehlen diese wohnung auf jeden fall.
We had a great time staying in this very beautiful central apartment. Franziska was very helpful and the roof terrace is lovely !!
Exelente todo.
Von der ersten Anfrage bis zur Abreise - wir haben uns bei Tina wie zuhause gefühlt. Gerne wieder! Danke!

Die Unterkunft liegt zentral in Kreuzberg. Wir hatten überhaupt keinen Stress einen Parkplatz vor der Haustür zu finden. Die Unterkunft ist super um Kreuzberg und Umgebung kennen zu lernen. Das Team vor Ort ist total nett und hilfsbereit.
Beautiful apartment, very quiet, super clean, well equipped kitchen maybe a bit far from amenities but that can be a smart choice sometimes...

I had a wonderful stay at Flottwell. The location is perfect; less than 5 mins walk to Gleisdreieck station, less than 50 ft from a Nelly-sacks park that I went to for a run during my stay and communication with staff was great. I highly recommend and well worth the value for money. 👍🏾👍🏾
Gute Lage und insgesamt war alles sehr sauber und angenehm. Kann ich nur weiterempfehlen.
One of my favorite stats ever. Loved the art studio turned home. Unique vibe.

Perfect location to explore Berlin! Clean and spacious (even for 9 guests). Close to public transport but also in walking distance to all the main sites. Has everything you would need for a stay - hairdryer, towel, kitchen utensils etc. Douglas is very responsive and check in is easy. Would recommend staying here if visiting Berlin

Die Zeit bei und mit Yomi war prima. Er ist super freundlich und umgänglich. Ein guter Gesprächspartner, mit Themen rund um die ganze Welt.
Die Wohnung ist super ruhig in einem Hinterhof gelegen - ich habe lange nicht mehr so ruhig schlafen dürfen wie bei ihm.

Siamo stati benissimo da Elisa! Abbiamo scelto questo alloggio perché la posizione era vicina al luogo dove avevo un training, ma si è rivelato perfetto anche per visitare la città, grazie alla vicinanza alla metropolitana - in poche fermate si raggiunge il centro.
Il quartiere è molto vivace e pieno di ristoranti etnici (anche se quelli che noi abbiamo provato non erano gustosi come apparivano) e con un'ampia gamma di opzioni vegane.
L'appartamento è vicino anche a un supermercato, un discount, un mercato, una farmacia, un parco giochi... è tutto raggiungibile a piedi. E, nonostante sia un quartiere così vivace, il fatto che si trova in una via laterale lo rende tranquillo e silenzioso per dormire.
Elisa è stata gentilissima, molto reattiva e disponibile, sempre pronta ad aiutarci, chiarire i nostri dubbi e venirci incontro. La casa ha tutti i servizi indicati ed è molto comoda e pratica. L'unica cosa è meno luminosa di quanto appaia in foto, essendo seminterrato.

Alles wie in der Beschreibung. Verschiedene Tram und U-Bahn Stationen sind in 5-10 Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar. Damit kommt man überall hin. Größere Supermärkte sind 10 Minuten zu Fuß entfernt.
Ein Topf und zwei Herdplatten sind vorhanden, das Kochen im Zimmer ist aber unpraktikabel. Man sollte sich darauf einstellen wenig selbst zu kochen. Dafür gibt es viele Bäckereien und Restaurants in der Nähe. Too Good To Go bietet sich auch an.
Im unserem Zimmer (Doppelbett) gab es nur eine Decke. Die war zwar sehr groß, trotzdem mag es nicht jeder.
Die Kommunikation über einen Chat Bot hat sehr gut funktioniert.
Hat unseren Ansprüchen zur Gänze entsprochen.
L'appartement de Caroline est idéalement situé. Il est impeccable et idéal pour un séjour de plusieurs jours à Berlin.

Great apartment in a great location for exploring Berlin.
Nice and quiet but with lovely bars and restaurants nearby. Also loved being near the canal, great for a stroll.
Stylish space with everything you need. Stefan was flexible with check in and very easy to communicate with.
Highly recommend and would definitely stay again!

We had a great trip to Berlin and this small pad was a perfect place for us to rest after our days of exploring the city. Conveniently located near an underground train station it was easy getting in and out of the city centre. The apartment was simply but very well decorated and in an excellent condition. Thank you.
A lovely apartment in a really nice area but the cleaning can be better!

My friends came together in Berlin and needed a place to catch up and cosy up from the cold winter. Antonia's place was central with lots of food options around, and was fully equipped with amenities like coffee/tea, extra pillows etc to make for a jolly good time indoors 🫶
Antonia was also very generous with check-in/check-out times to accommodate our travel plans, thank you so much ✨

Het is een heel leuk ingericht appartement. De wijk is rustig maar met leuke restaurantjes in de buurt. Anja heeft ons persoonlijk ontvangen en welkom geheten. Ze reageerde snel en aardig op berichten. Het is een echte aanrader!
Had a great stay!

This is a great location with an amazing park out the back and easy access to great transportation (many lines at the nearest station).  The apartment is spacious and clean with the necessities all there, but minimal linens and towels.  People should know that this is a semi-basement with good light, but no actual windows looking out.  They are frosted.  So there are no views out.  Otherwise great and recommended!
Really nice place to stay. Very quiet neighbourhood. If you like dark bedrooms, bring an eye mask! Oliver was very responsive and helpful. Highly recommend his place. And his mum is lovely!

logement en adéquation avec les photos et la description ! L appartement est situé entre 2 stations de train qui vous permette de vous rendre au centre de Berlin en 15min.
Sabine est très réactif et gentil
Nous recommandons vivement cet appartement très propre, très design, au calme et près des transports. Robert est très attentionné et toujours disponible.
Sehr schöne und vor allem saubere Unterkunft mit einer freundlichen Vermieterin.

We had a great week-end in this flat.
Exactly what we were expecting.
Jan is reactive and friendly.

Katharina’s place was okay. Close to checkpoint Charlie, Jewish Museum & Berlin Art Gallery. Easy to find and navigate around the city with a few cool local spots too.
Wasn’t a fan of the bed, which was broken in parts and the fridge was not in a good state upon arrival. Katharina did remedy the problems as best she could with swift action and clear communication.
Not the best value for money.
Beautiful neighborhood, easy to access studio apartment.

Beautiful sunny apartment. I loved my stay at Antjes apartment. Very clean with everything you need for your stay. Great communication and easy check in/ out.
Close to the new u5 line with easy connection to main station

Fijn en groot appartement, met leuke boeken en posters, in een levendige buurt. We hebben een heerlijke week gehad.
Tip: Aziatisch restaurant RokuHachi, op loopafstand van het appartement.

I didn't meet Oli in person but his Father welcomed me and gave me an in-depth introduction.
Very welcoming.
The place is great. Really.
Spacious, bathroom and kitchen perfectly appointed.
Washing machine, dishwasher. Geat.
I am normally not a friend of a sofa - bed but this one is areally comfortable sofa-bed and I have absolutely no complaints whatsoever.
Internet is great and fast!

The area, environment looks rather conservative and quiet....but within a few steps, you have a great grocery, the best Iranian restaurant in Berlin, an unmistakably delicious and greatly affordable Berlin Döner Kebab take-away.
Even the Russians have their supermarket. Down the street an Italian Delicatessen. What do you want more?

ALL GOOD!

Our stay was absolutely lovely! Michael and Melani were incredibly kind and accommodating, even though we weren’t able to stick to the check-in time we had originally agreed on. In Germany, it often feels like you have to walk on eggshells because people can be quite grumpy — but Michael was endlessly understanding and warm, which made all the difference.
The photos match the place exactly, and it’s located in a very quiet neighborhood with endless restaurant options just a minute away. After long walks around the city, we really enjoyed relaxing as a family in front of the cinema-style TV — such a cozy touch! The bathrooms are stocked with soap in case you forget, and both check-in and check-out couldn’t have been easier.

PERFECT location (situation géographique). Short U Bahn trip to city centre East or West, brief walk from U station. Very near you will find a large supermarket (with a hair dresser), a good kebab kiosk, a bar, a small alcohol shop and a few shops.
The APARTMENT itself: Easy to keep FRESH in the heat as you can open windows on both sides to make a draft. Plenty of SPACE to put luggages, clothes, shoes. The DETAILS are practical like good lighting, a bin in every room (with plastic bag), croc shoes to wear indoors, umbrellas, plenty of tables/desks and chairs. QUERIES if you need anything the owner or manager provides it or answers questions. Very large BEDROOM because with 2 double beds, press, desk and chairs there was still space around. Extra large LIVING ROOM with balcony, tv/sofa area, dining table and also a sleeping corner with double bed and desk. Functional KITCHEN, not many utensils but of good quality, large fridge, many presses and worktops. The CLEANING is done but is perfunctory and examples of dirt are tiles near toilet seat and kitchen presses. BEDDING: clean nice sheets but mattress of medium quality.
Conclusion: overall perfect if you are not fussy about cleaning and don’t need a luxurious mattress. I recommend it.

Easy access to Potsdamerplatz, lovely and clean apartment, easy check-in, and great communication. A+
Alles top! Super Lage in Kreuzberg, sehr schön eingerichtete Altbau-Wohnung, gut ausgestattet, nette Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern. Wir kommen gerne wieder :)

Great place! The room is clean, cozy, and beautiful. Location-wise, it is very close to the subway stations, good restaurants, galleries, and museums. I will definitely stay here again when I visit Berlin next time.
Highly recommended!
Bello espacio, cálido y confortable. Todas las amenidades necesarias para disfrutarlo al máximo. Muy bien ubicado y de fácil acceso
Alles super! Auf jeden Fall absolut empfehlenswert!

Fabian’s place was great! It was clean, cosy, and full of amenities! Everything I needed, he had in this apartment. The location is good too, as it is not too far from the heart of Berlin. I enjoyed how clean the place was as well, and there were no issues checking in or anything of the sort. Would definitely recommend!
Super appartement pratique et fonctionnel !
Michael's apartment was very clean and very convenient to public transport. Michael was very responsive and helpful when I needed to contact him. Would highly recommend.
Very nice and clean house in a beautiful area. Valentine was a very kind host!

We didn't get the chance to meet Jocelyne, but we met her friend Marianne who took care of us and was really helpful. she gave us advices and even took us in her car to show us around and was always available for any question. The apartment was great, very clean and cozy and near the center. We had a great time at Jocelyne's definitely recommendable

Muchas gracias por todo,
Todo fue tal cual el anuncio!
Gute Lage, sehr sauber. Nette Empfangsfrau. Ich wollte bis 8:00 schlafen, aber man kriegt schon mit, wenn andere früher raus müssen. Ansonsten, sehr zufrieden, auch mit Preis Leistung Verhältnis.
Hôte très réactive et agréable. Logement super et très bien placé !
Nettes kleines Apartment und sehr zuvorkommender Host.

Dominique’s house really really good location and super clean and warm !
Super recommended, if you are trip alone !

Nach einem anstrengenden Arbeitstag bei 38 Grad Berliner Hitze empfing mich Natalie zur Übergabe mit zwei kalten Flaschen Wasser, einer gekühlten Schokolade und Obst in einer sehr sauberen, ansprechenden und kühlen Wohnung mit kleinem Garten im Innenhof. Besser geht´s nicht! Nathalie ist eine perfekte Gastgeberin.

Die Wohnung liegt im Erdgeschoss und bietet bzgl. Möbel, Geschirr und Technik alles, was erforderlich ist. Insgesamt ein rundum gelungenes Angebot, welches den Angaben entspricht und perfekt wäre, wenn die Wohnung einen kleinen Tick leiser wäre.
Sehr angenehmen und super gelegen ☺️ kann ich nur weiter empfehlen!

Lovely stay, clean and comfortable place, close to the metro and bus station.
Thank you for hosting us.

Wir waren nur eine Nacht in Berlin, dafür war die Unterkunft ausreichend. Die gute Lage und Anbindung an die Straßenbahn war uns wichtig.
Einige Dinge im Zimmer sind in die Jahre gekommen, das Bad roch sehr muffig und hatte keine Lüftung, es war aber soweit sauber. In der Nacht war es sehr laut von draußen , es ist auch sehr hellhörig in den Gängen und Zimmern.
Alles einfach gehalten und sehr klein . Für eine Übernachtung war es ok.

Süheyla war eine bezaubernde Gastgeberin. Sie war sehr freundlich und kommunikativ, hat aber auch akzeptiert wenn ich meine Ruhe haben wollte (Prinzip der geschlossenen Tür), kein Anklopfen oder Nachfragen. Aber eine ausgiebige und interessante Unterhaltung (mit einem Glas Wein) in der Küche war möglich. Ich habe eine tolle Gastgeberin gefunden.  Gerne komme ich wieder .

Eine originelle, geschmackvolle Unterkunft in bester Lage.
Wer offene Raumlösungen schätzen kann, wird diese Wohnung mögen.
Wie die Fotos schon deutlich machen, ist dies keine 0815-Bude.
Trotz der zentralen Lage ist es (vor allem nach hinten raus) sehr ruhig.
Kommunikation und Check-in haben bestens funktioniert: Sehr empfehlenswert.
Great place on a quiet street and close to public transport!

The instructions on AirBnb app about the address and the WiFi are wrong.
Moreover, the text message with the instructions we received with the address was misleading due to a wrong address.
Other than that, it was great and the host was very nice and responsive

Unser Aufenthalt bei Pigi war super!
Sie war immer sehr freundlich, hat uns essen angeboten und uns handtücher zur verfügung gestellt. Die Wohnung ist wirklich wunderschön und man von der Unterkunft aus alles gut zu fuß erreichen.

It was a lovely stay, felt like the whole house belonged to us. I definitely recommend it. The house is a bit far from center but really near to the public transport. I definitely suggest to stay here.

Great place to stay, good amount of space and very well equipped, although it's not good for nightlife and not very close to the centre but there are lots of public transport nearby so it wasn't a massive problem
Die Absprachen verliefen sehr flexibel und wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen. Insgesamt haben wir uns absolut wohl gefühlt! Absolut zu empfehlen!

Wir und die Kinder haben sich fast wie zuhause gefühlt. Eine tolle, konfortable Wohnungen mit charmanten Möbeln, einem tollen Grundriss (Küche und Esstisch!).
Die Lage geht natürlich kaum besser, mitten in einem tollen Quartier und umgeben von Trams, Bussen und Metro.
Das Haus mit dem Innenhof ist ruhig und sauber.
Danke, Kasia!

Das Apartment war genauso schön wie beschrieben und gepflegt. Gute Lage, gleich um die Ecke ist die Wilmersdorfer Straße mit Läden, Cafes und Restaurants. 5 Minuten bis zur U2, die praktischerweise einmal ganz Berlin durchquert.
Der Zugang mit Handynummer und Türcode klappte problemlos. Habe Herrn Lappe nicht persönlich getroffen, das war aber auch nicht notwendig.
The apartment was very clean and new. The location is easily reachable by tram. I would definitely go there again!

Kleine, gemütliche Ferienwohnung im Herzen Berlins. Wir haben uns sofort wohl gefühlt. Im Nachbarhaus war eine größere Baustelle, man hat die Geräusche aber kaum wahrgenommen. Mit etwas Mühe findet man einen Parkplatz in der Nähe. Von der Wohnung aus ist alles schnell erreichbar, ein Park ist auch in der Nähe.
Marcus war jederzeit erreichbar, alles top!

It was amazing the owner is super helpful and kind makes you feel right at home really close to the metro and restaurants the sauna is next level all around amazing if I go back to Berlin I wanna stay here
Super séjour ! Très bon accueil et appartement vraiment chouette !
Ich habe mich  in dem angebotenen Zoimmer wohl gefühlt und gut geschlafen. insgesamt etwas anonym, aber das hat auch seine Vorteile.

uno de los mejores hostales en los que he estado, muy amplio, renovado, limpieza, ascensor, personal muy amable, desayuno muy completo (se paga a parte)... Calidad precio inmejorable. Tiene los inconvenientes de cualquier hostal en el que compartes habitación con más personas, pero por lo demás todo fenomenal. Sin duda repetiré.

Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber. Die Betten sind prima und man schläft in Ihnen wirklich wie Gott in Frankreich, jedoch in Berlin. Die Anbindung an die Innenstadt ist sehr gut.
Alles genauso, wie es in der Beschreibung aufgeführt wird.
Die Unterkunft kann ich bedenkenlos empfehlen.
We had such a wonderful time staying at this property, it was perfectly located and Martin was a fantastic host. Would definitely recommend!
Très propre et confortable, l’espace partagé est très agréable. Le logement est bien situé et sécurisé.
Der Check-in war sehr unkompliziert und die Lage direkt an der U-Bahn ist auch super. Alles war sauber und so wie auf den Fotos! Auf jeden Fall eine Empfehlung :)
Kansellerte med engang vi så stedet

Nice clean quiet and confortable appartement. Good location. We defefinitly recomend this adress.
The communication was also very easy for the check in.
Hope to come back!
Caroline
Kerstin was very welcoming and responsive. The apartment is in a great location and perfect for two people.
The appartment was super clean and it has everything you need. The neighbourhood is great and its 2 minutes away from the ubahn. Lena ia a great host!
schönes hostel, gute lage
Sabines room was spacious and comfortable enough for two. She she was very welcoming and we had a lovely time. :)
es war nur eine Nacht in der tollen Wohnung. Aber direkt in Berlin mit Dachterrasse. einfach herrlich.
Foi mt perfeito. Hospitaleira. Café gostoso. Me senti mt a vontade. Casa Linda e Limpa. Extremamente simpática. Ano que vem voltarei e com a Madlen com toda certeza
Wir kommen für unser nächsten Berlinbesuch auf jeden Fall wieder in dieses Apartment.

Abbiamo soggiornato in questa casa in Germania per qualche giorno e ci siamo trovati molto bene. L’appartamento, anche se un po’ piccolo, è perfetto per due persone ed è dotato di tutti i comfort necessari. La zona è comoda per spostarsi e proprio di fronte c’è un supermercato molto utile.
La casa era pulitissima e ben tenuta. Il proprietario è stato davvero gentile, ci ha fornito tutte le informazioni utili prima dell’arrivo e ha sempre risposto subito ai nostri messaggi. Inoltre, ci ha gentilmente concesso un check-out posticipato rispetto all’orario previsto, cosa molto apprezzata.
Consigliamo sicuramente questo alloggio per un soggiorno comodo e senza pensieri!
Todo muy bien pero del baño salia mucho y muy fuerte olor a cloaca que inundaba todo el piso. Muy feo

I had a wonderful 4-night stay with Britta and Nicolas! Their top-floor apartment is clean and beautiful, with tall ceilings and beautiful art work all around. (One must climb many stairs—but I appreciated the exercise!) The bedroom has plenty of space, with a comfortable bed, sofa, and desk. It connects directly to a lovely terrace with potted plants and a table, from which there is beautiful view up and down the street. I spent  time out there reading and relaxing. Prenzlauer Berg is a picturesque area with many great shops, restaurants, and parks. Britta and Nicolas are kind and considerate hosts who were genuinely interested in making my stay enjoyable. They lent me an umbrella when it rained, encouraged me to use their piano when they learned that I was a musician, and gave me opportunities to practice my German. They know Berlin well and can recommend many sites and activities. I really enjoyed sitting and talking with them a bit on my final evening. Highly recommended!

Amazing location, so green and quiet. Nice host, overall very worth the money.
Thank you!

Le logement est bien situé pour visiter différents quartiers de Berlin. La ligne TXL qui permet d'aller et de venir à l'aéroport a une station toute proche de l'immeuble où se situe l'appartement.
Le contact avec la personne qui s'occupe des clés a été tout à fait cordial.
Yan was a very nice host and the apartment was also very nice !

We were a group of 8, staying for a week during a conference. The apartment was great, clean and specious. The two kitchens and bathrooms were very useful, as we were a lot of people. The location is fantastic, and public transportation was easily accessible. Food and groceries were found nearby as well.
Suprisingly stylish apartment in a quiet square. Great experience and pleasent communucation with Michael.
Ruhige Lage, gemütliches Bett und man fühlt sich super wohl und wie zu Hause:)
Hallo, es war ein kurzer, aber sehr schöner Aufenthalt. Absolute Weiterempfehlung
Very nice room and Mickael is very very nice!

Отличная квартира с центральным расположением.
Небольшая квартира идеально подойдет для недолгого пребывания в Берлине. Есть все необходимое для комфортного проживания (впечатлил мощный фен!).
Рядом есть метро, кофейни, рестораны. До центра 15-20 минут пешком.
Спасибо Jonas, за удобное заселение с инструкциями, гостеприимство и помощь!

This apartment is perfectly located for a chilled weekend break in Berlin. In a more residential area, there's no risk of being disturbed by party goers, and yet it's still just minutes on foot from some fantastic restaurants and a beer garden too.
It's well connected by S-bahn, and an amazing off-road walking and cycling route into the city centre through parks and quiet streets. It's in the dockless bike zone so we had great fun riding around most days, into the centre, and out to Templehofer Feld.
Communication with Gerhard was top notch, and he gave tailored tips for things to do, to make the most of our time in the city.
A really good break in a lovely apartment with a host who helps things go of without a hitch. Definitely recommend.

I have good time in this apartment, very nice, bright with all the furnitures, in a very nice position in Neukolln, very close to Hermannstrasse metro station ( U- bahn and S- bahn).
The owner, Inga, a very nice person,has always been reliable and available to help me any time.
I really recommend to stay at this place!
Gute Erreichbarkeit, sehr saubere Wohnung, Kommunikation lief reibungslos und schnell, gute Anbindung an die öffentl. Verkehrsmittel .

Ich war zum zweiten Mal da und komme gerne wieder. Der self check in ist sehr einfach, es ist alles super sauber und an Grundausstattung ist alles da. Etwas Abzug gibt es nur für die doch sehr kleine Küchenzeile. Das Haus ist zwar recht hellhörig, bisher waren die anderen Gäste aber alle sehr ruhig. Die U-Bahn ist in wenigen Minuten zu Fuß zu erreichen und es gibt ausreichend Supermärkte und Restaurants in der Nähe.
Sehr schönes sauberes Zimmer, gute Umgebung, schöne Küche mit Essplatz und sauberes Badezimmer, nette Gastgeberin
Everything was  cool, THANK YOU!

Great place for a short stay.
Max was very helpful and welcoming.
Muy buena anfitriona. Estudio muy limpio y acogedor. Con unos detalles muy lindos. Anfitrióna muy dispuesta a ayudar
Buen alojamiento y económico
Super freundliche Kommunikation, wunderschöne Unterkunft in ruhiger Lage aber trotzdem zu Fuß schnell überall.
Tolle Wohnung. Toller Host. Kann ich nur weiterempfehlen!

Really enjoyed my stay at Gee’s flat. Helpful from the start, kept communication throughout and super friendly! Everything was as described and nicely decorated (love all the plants in the bathroom). Was a really good location for travelling and direct to the airport. Thanks for the stay! :)

Nette Wohnung in sehr zentraler Lage. Von hier kann man bequem alle zentralen Sehenswürdigkeiten besuchen. Lidl, Bäcker und Rossman direkt vor der Tür.
Leider nur kostenpflichtige Parkmöglichkeiten. Also eher was für Leute die mit der Bahn anreisen. Ansonsten sehr empfehlenswert.
All in all serves the need. But i would prefer a hotel room for 10€ more next time.

I had a very nice stay here. The apartment was very unique and special and all worked well. I also valued good and friendly tips that Frank gave in terms of places to visit and a good breakfast coffee and dinner place.
The apartment was basically clean, but however, there was dust on various places - it can also be because we got a much earlier check in than expected, so maybe so much cleaning had not been done.
All in all, a very good and lovely stay!
Very nice, cosy, and clean flat in the heart of Friedrischain.

this is a clean comfortable place with a nice little balcony.
beds are soft and clean.
it's perfect for a group and the lockers downstairs make it easy if you are leaving on a flight or can't check into your next place.
Good place for staying a bit in Berlin, well located and connected, with good value for money and several amenities
easy communications, great check-in and really good flat for the price!

Lento para responder, nunca me enviaron las instrucciones de check in por lo tanto tuve que esperar desde las 7 am hasta las 14 hrs para saber qué hacer y dónde ir. El resto todo impecable, alojamiento limpio y muy bien ubicado.

It was a pleasure to stay at Ivos's apartment. He was very friendly and provided all of the information we needed to easily arrive from the airport and to check in.
The place is across the street from both S-Bahn and U-Bahn stations. It is so easy to get anywhere in Berlin from there. Take advantage of Alexanderplatz just one station away, which has everything you need for dining and entertainment. However, you also have a couple grocery stores just five minutes away from the apartment on foot. Very convenient!
Most important: It was a pleasure to meet and to have a nice conversation with Ivos. He has so much to say about local and German history in general. You will also find him to be well-versed in English to discuss just about any topic. I hope you have the chance to converse with Ivos as we did.
I would absolutely stay here again if I visit Berlin.
Well situated hostel, easy to find and good overall. The only bad thing is that the bunkbeds are quite noisy, so be sure to have earplugs!

This is one of the best AirBnBs I've stayed in. The piano is fantastic— if you're reading reviews to figure out whether the piano is good enough for you, you can stop: it is. It is very, very, good. The rest of the space is really pleasant and well-laid out. It puts a lot of functionality into the space. I wrote a ton of music in my week here!

My stay at Sem's was magical, restful, and beautiful. I totally felt at home. I did not want to leave!!! It is very quiet and safe. The apartment is immaculate and highly designed. There are many restaurants right on the same block, lots of shopping, if you should even want to leave the apartment. It's location was perfect for where I needed to be in Berlin. Highly recommend!!!!!!
Great place, excellent location for Berlin. Clean place & easy to check in & out. Helpful staff! Can recommend the place for an enjoyable stay in Berlin!
Wonderful place to stay with kids! Nice neighbourhood, beautiful apartment. Kids loved the bunkbeds and all the toys. Parents enjoyed the nice view and proximity of restaurants.
Amaizing place to stay in Berlin, super quiet and private. Went out at night and was able to find bars and restaurants opened very late. Totally recommended!!! :D

I absolutely loved staying at Tamara's flat for my first time visiting Berlin. It is a wonderful space that is decorate very well and is extremely well located. You have all the great restaurants and bars at your door step with easy transportation that can get you around Berlin safely.

The appartment is situated right in the middle of Friedrichshain with all the nice cafés and restaurants, but being located in the backyard it’s very quiet and calm all through the night.
The appartment itself is very cosy with all the necessities you need. Stylishly decorated and we felt very much at home.
Very conviniently theres a supermarket just across the street where you can also buy freshly baked bread in the morning.
We stayed as a family with two kids and enjoyed the closeness to Boxhagener Platz with the playground.
Will recommend a stay here for everyone.

We waren als gezin in Berlijn en het appartement is ons zeer goed bevallen. Simone is zeer een vriendelijke gastvrouw. Ze heeft goede tips voor de omgeving en reageert erg snel. Het appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien. Het ligt in een rustige straat en daarom is het ‘s avonds fijn thuiskomen!
Very friendly host, reservation had all the amenities one would expect. Great neighborhood; inner city abd outer city as well as nature all very easily reachable.

I absolutely loved staying at Wibke's place. The room was perfect — spacious, well-appointed, comfortable, and quiet. The whole apartment is artsy and colorful without being pretentious. I felt right at home. Wibke herself is an absolute delight, as are her partner and her son. I had a number of engaging, interesting, and thoughtful conversations with them, and was a bit sad that those wouldn't continue after I left. Overall, I cannot recommend this place enough. It was hands down one of my best AirBnB experiences. Don't hesitate to book it.
Nice stay in a modern flat Were there for business reason and perfectly matched my needs.

It was a great stay - location is very convenient with and U-bahn station just outside the building. The room was nice and clean and the instructions how to get in clear. Definitely will come back here next time I'm in Berlin :)

Florian was a great and responsive host! The apartment is sunny and comfortable; the deck is a huge bonus. Right in the middle of Kreuzberg, close to the train, but walkable to almost everywhere. We’d love to stay again.

Die Wohnung ist mega gemütlich und es ist alles da was man brauch. Toll eingerichtet und sehr, sehr viel Platz! Super Lage und man ist super schnell bei die Öffis. Umliegend sind viele Restaurants, Bars und Lokale, da kanns am Abend schon mal lauter sein, hat uns aber absolut nicht gestört. Alexander ist super lieb und antwortet sehr rasch und ist sehr bemüht. Ich kann euch die Wohnung von Alexander von Herzen empfehlen.

L'ospite è molto accogliente, disponibile e reattiva. Zona residenziale di piccole villette molto tranquilla. Disponibilità di parcheggio gratuito nella via. 15 minuti di passeggiata nel parco per raggiungere la metropolitana, i supermercati e i servizi del quartiere. Per chi volesse cucinare spesso lo spazio e le attrezzature sono un po' limitate come comunque si vede nelle foto. La signora era gentilissima e ogni giorno ci lavava le stoviglie utilizzate. Ci siamo trovati bene durante il nostro soggiorno.
We found the apartment easily with Boris instructions. It is in a very good location. Central to everything.

My stay was outstanding! Martin was so helpful and easy to get in touch with. The place was so clean and much bigger than it looks in the photos. I loved this Airbnb a lot and would suggest it to everyone!
Todo perfecto
Very nice place in a cosy location
Apartment is in a fantastic location with everything on your doorstep, yet very quiet in the bedroom at the back. We had a great time staying here

L’appartement proposé est, dans son ensemble, un bon logement. Cependant, il pourrait être d’encore meilleure qualité avec un nettoyage plus approfondi de la VMC de la salle de bain qui est encrassée, de faire la serpillière dans tout le logement. De plus, la literie est de mauvaise qualité (oreillers en plumes pas top pour les allergiques, couette 1 personne sur un lit double, pas de coussins…). Il y a aussi des travaux à faire. De plus, Gini et Marc nous ont bien fait comprendre être en Thaïlande lorsque nous échangions avec eux. Les voyageurs n’ont pas à être impactés par la vie des hôtes, on paie pour un service. Point. L’emplacement reste cependant intéressant et accessible (S42, métro…).
Großzügige Wohnung, tolle Lage, sehr freundlicher und unkomplizierter Kontakt. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
Die Wohnung war einladend zum Wohlfühlen. Sie liegt zentral, wenn man sich Berlin anschauen möchte.

Look, this is a good place for an ok price. The neighbouring tenants were incredibly noisy and kept us up on 4 nights, staying up late and waking early. The instructions to get to house were unclear. The team were relatively responsive but it was honestly a little disappointing to say the least.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr stilsicher eingerichtet, sauber und an einer sehr ruhigen Straße gelegen.
Die Kommunikation mit Gordon ist top, Fragen werden schnell und freundlich beantwortet.
Der Check in wird sehr verständlich erklärt und verläuft daher problemlos.
Wir waren sehr zufrieden, hatten eine gute Zeit und können uns gut vorstellen wieder zu kommen!

Der Aufenthalt bei John hat uns sehr gut gefallen, wir wurden von seinem Vater nett empfangen.
In der Wohnung selber war alles sauber und ordentlich und genau wie auf den Fotos/in der Beschreibung.
Gute Anbindung an den ÖPNV und trotzdem ruhig gelegen. Persönliche Tipps von John lagen auch in der Wohnung, so haben wir direkt ein Restaurant von seinen Empfehlungen ausprobiert. Das Bett ist äußerst bequem, wenn man es gern weich mag!
Auch beim Check-Out war John sehr flexibel und wir konnten kurzfristig noch länger bleiben.
Im Großen und Ganzen können wir die Wohnung und John nur empfehlen.
Vielen Dank! :)
Excelente anfitrión, atento a nuestras solicitudes. buena ubicacion .

Die Unterkunft ist perfekt für einen Kurzurlaub in Berlin. Der Standort ist sehr zentral, trotzdem befindet sich diese Wohnung in einer ruhigen Strasse.
Die Wohnung befindet sich im Untergeschoss eines Wohnhauses und bietet somit keinen "Ausblick", allerdings hat uns dies nicht gestört. Vielmehr möchte ich die Sauberkeit hervorheben und dass die Wohnung über zwei bequeme Doppelbetten und ein Schlafsofa verfügt, für insgesamt max. 5-6 Personen.
Absolutely fabulous apartment, great for our family, with nice large table.

This apartment was great. We found everything as expected and it was clean and comfortable.
Check-in was easy, following instructions that were sent to us in plenty of time before our arrival.
The area is bustling, with many restaurants and cafes and also has great public transport links across Berlin.
Again everything was fine and the communication is very easy to handle.
absolutely perfect. would definitely recommend.

This apartment was so stylish, beautiful, had everything you needed. The host Verda is fantastic and let us leave our bags at the apartment early due to us wanted to go and explore Berlin and also allowing us to stay a little later due to a late flight home. Great stay!!
Kayleigh & Tomas

Sui's place is a good stay in the fun Friedrichshain neighborhood. Within 30 minutes walking distance you can see the East Side Gallery, some museums(Stasi/Video Game), and many of Berlin's famous music clubs. As well there are a fair number of nearby metro stations once you figure out Berlin's metro system. I only stayed for two nights but for the time we interacted Sui was a great host. My only caveat to the location is that the vibe may not suit everyone, you should know whether you want to stay in East or West Berlin beforehand, assuming you're more interested in the East/Friedrichschain I'd certainly recommend this stay.
Very central location in Kreuzberg. Place is very clean. Johannes is very friendly.

I spent 3 fantastic months in this apartment.
it's extremely well located, very central.
The apartment itself is very pleasant, very well decorated, great balcony.
Lilia is a wonderful host, always reactive and with good advice.
I can only recommend this apartment.

Arne's place is the most artful and charming Airbnb's I've ever stayed in. Immediately when I walked in Arne was friendly and helpful and made me feel right at home. He placed a large bottle of water and glass in my room. I was thirsty from the traveling, and it hit the spot. The location was central and close to public transportation. I am thoroughly pleased.
Alles perfekt gelaufen, kann ich nur weiterempfehlen!!

I had a wonderful stay here - super convenient location. Close to the train to get you anywhere you need to go. The space was lovely, clean, bright and well stocked with everything I needed. I would definitely stay here again.

Unser Aufenthalt in Ingrids Chalet war perfekt. Das Haus ist komfortabel.
Es hat an nicht gefehlt. Nachts ist es total still. Wir haben so gut schlafen können und im Garten zu frühstücken war herrlich. Wir haben uns rundum willkommen und zuhause gefühlt. Ganz herzlichen Dank, liebe Ingrid.
Wir kommen wieder und freuen uns auf dich.

Our experience in your apartment was as good as we expected. The neighborhood was calm and, even though the building was old, we didn’t think it was a problem. The apartment was super functional, clean, warm, and provided all needed devices. Netflix and Amazon plus were a surprise for us!  What was missing for us were things like salt, sugar or non-stick baking paper for the oven and we had to buy them. However, our overall experience was really good and we would highly recommend your apartment
Sooo zentral uns super geführt!!
Great place near the airport. Clean and great for a good night's sleep. Would recommend for other travelers who want a nice place with an owner who gives great communication.
Super Unterkunft sehr netten Gastgeber und ein unglaublich schöner Blick auf die Spree. Ein Unschlagbares Preisleitungs-verhältnis gute Küchenausstattung schönes zwei Bett Zimmer und gutes WLAN.
Alright, good location, but bad communication, and a lot of things were missing in the apartment like hot water for dishes in the kitchen sink.
Excellent, top hospitality

The stay at Bernd's place was overall great! Stayed the for a week before fully moving into the city. Bernd's and Isabela made me few right at home, giving friendly advice. The house is well located and maintained.
would defined recommend to anyone visiting the city
Sehr nette Gastgeber, schnelle und unkomplizierte Kommunikation :) gern wieder.

따로 방을 내어주는 것이 아닌, 공용공간의 거실 소파에서 취침해야 합니다. 예약하기 전에 꼭 명십하십시오. 호스트의 배려가 있었으나 개인공간이라는 느낌은 전혀 받지 못했고, 불편했습니다.
호스트님이 많이 배려를 해주셔서 조용하게 사용할 수 있긴 했습니다. 체크인 시간이 늦고 체크아웃 시간이 굉장히 이릅니다. 저는 이 부분에서 많은 불편함을 느꼈습니다. 시간을 잘 확인하시기 바랍니다. 이전 여행과 다음 여행 일정에 차질이 생길 수 있습니다.
거실의 바닥과 주방, 욕실에는 먼지가 가득했습니다. 거실 바닥이 더러워서 제 물건을 두기가 찝찝했습니다. 주방에는 치우지 않은 그릇과 음식물들로 인해 약간의 악취가 났습니다. 욕실에는 잡동사니가 많았고 먼지가 많아 정리가 되지않은 느낌이었습니다.
숙소의 위치는 베를린 중심부로부터 약간 벗어나 있습니다.
호스트님이 굉장히 친절하시지만, 개인적으로 생각했을 때 호스트님은 자신의 집에 게스트를 받을 준비가 되지 않은 것 같습니다.

Pour finir, la localisation du logement est vraiment très bonne. Il y a des commerces
à proximité (y compris un petit supermarché bio, à 300m), le quartier est très sympa (notre préféré après avoir passé 6 jours à Berlin), avec plein de bars et restaurants, notamment autour de Boxhagener platz. Enfin, des stations de métro et de trams très proches permettent de se rendre facilement dans le lieux à visiter à Berlin.
En résumé, un super logement pour passer une petite semaine à Berlin (en utilisant
le logement uniquement pour se reposer et les petits déjeuners ; la cuisine est un
peu petite).
