Very central. Close to lots of restaurants, parks, & shopping.
Nice apartment with terrace in quiet neighborhood,close to tram and metro.

Wir hatten einen super Aufenthalt bei Petra. Das Frühstück und die Gastfreundschaft waren wirklich klasse. Auch die Anbindung an die Innenstadt und Sehenswürdigkeiten sind gut. Perfekt für ein Wochenende in Berlin.
Alles ok, nur das Hochbett bisschen schwer zu erklettern für ältere Leute😄
Had a fantastic stay, apartment just like the photos and they were both very warm and friendly. Very close to the metro so great location. Highly recommended!

Wir hatten ein tolles Wochenende in Berlin - nicht zuletzt aufgrund unserer großartigen Unterkunft!
Moe war ein sehr netter Gastgeber, hat uns freundlich empfangen und dafür gesorgt, dass es uns an nichts mangelt.
Dank der verkehrsgünstigen Lage ist man innerhalb weniger Minuten mitten im Zentrum.
Das Appartement ist sehr gemütlich und -was vor allem für uns sehr wichtig war- sehr ruhig gelegen.
Absolut empfehlenswert!
Easy to work with!

We arrived well before check in and asked to store our luggage for the day. The apt was cleaned and ready for us early instead. It is well located to 2 transport stations with shops and restaurants close by. Rents appeared to be raised due to the marathon. Clearly it is a lived in apt. There was food in the fridge/freezer and cabinets and a lot of personal items. The bathroom is not as pictured. It could really have used a deep cleaning. The balcony was lovely and we utilized the laundry. Your host meets you at the apt to go over everything and hand off the key. Our hosts were friendly and accommodating.

It was really nice stay in Tai and Carsten’s apartment. It’s a lovely apartment. It has been fully equipped with everything that we need. Really clean and calm building.
Also i can be thankful for her friend Annelie. She has gratefully welcomed us. Location is truly perfect. In the heart of Kreuzberg and so close to the center. I strongly recommend you guys to rent this apartment. I would really stay in it once i get back to Berlin someday.
Thanks Tai & Annelie and keep in touch:)
Extremely clean place, very humble receptionists, bright rooms. Totally satisfied with the service.
Sehr einfache Unterkunft ohne Schnörkel, sehr anonym, etwas dunkel, aber ruhig. Wenn die Renovierung abgeschlossen ist, dann ist der Preis angemessen. Jetzt fehlen noch ein paar Kleinigkeiten.

Alan and Kasia's apartment was perfect for me. Clean and organized with a very homely feel. Alan was there to greet me and give me advice on all the best places and local pubs to check out. Highly recommended!
Overall it was a great set up! Close walk to public transportation. A couple blocks away from a busy street with stores and restaurants. Felt safe. Clean and has everything you need.

Das Hostel ist sehr sauber und ordentlich. Die Mitarbeiter sind freundlich und hilfsbereit, wir durften uns sogar Löffel ausleihen. Insgesamt gibt es nichts zu beanstanden. Alles top, danke für den schönen Aufenthalt ;)

Really enjoyed our stay at Robert’s. The place mirrors the effort he has put in; highly recommend! If you are looking for a great and centrally located stay, with a friendly host and even better facilities, then Robert is the way to go :)

Tolle Wohnung, gute Gastgeber, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Die Unterkunft ist gross und hat 4 Schlafzimmer mit jeweils einem Doppelbett, zudem hat es 2 grosse Wohnzimmer und 2 Badezimmer. Wir waren nur 5 Personen und hatten so sehr viel Platz. In der Wohnung können gut 8 Personen übernachten. Falls die Wohnung nicht voll belegt werden kann, ist die Wohnung eher teuer.
Die Lage ist zentral im Hinterhaus und mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln sehr gut zu erreichen. Auch Restaurants und Lebensmittelläden sind in Gehdistanz. Uns störte ein Bisschen die Moschee im Erdgeschoss, die grosse Anzahl Besucher betete mehrmals im Innenhof und versperrten so den Zugang zum Haus, die Blicke der Moschee-Besucher empfand ich eher als abweisend. Des Weiteren ist direkt vor dem Haus ein Strassenstrich. Wir wurden jedes Mal auf der Strasse von den Damen angesprochen, nach 5 Tagen nervte uns das.
Sehr freundlicher Host und ein wirklich schönes Zimmer.
Amazing place! Super friendly host and supercute cat! It's around 7mins walk to Nöldnerplatz and 2 mins to the bus stop. I would definately recommend going here!
10/10 - tolles Airbnb, einfacher Check in, alles nötige war vorhanden, produktive Kommunikation, einfach super!
Goede locatie, ruim genoeg. Was alleen erg warm aangezien de airco niet werkte.

Super recommended!! Everything was great and the space is really nice for 2 people to stay for a while. We stayed there 3 months and Eleni was really helpful, responding really fast to anything we needed. The bed is comfortable and the apartment have everything you might need. There's a supermarket across the street and U-bahn and S-bahn stations really really close, 2-3min.

Cozy and clean place. Is easy to arrive from the airport and to go around Berlin walking or with public transport.
Jenny is nice and welcoming.
I will definitely go back next time I am in Berlin!

Nous avons beaucoup aimé notre séjour chez Andrew. Il répondait bien à nos attentes. Il est très bien équipé, très propre et très tranquille, car il donne sur une cour arrière paisible.
Nous avons beaucoup aimé le quartier, animé et vivant. Nous aimions profiter du quartier en fin de journée, après nos visites de Berlin. Tout se fait à pied et à vélo, si vous avez l’énergie pour le faire. Sinon, le métro est à la porte.
Le supermarché Edeka est vraiment très bien et très proche. Nous recommandons à 100%.
Henrik ist ein toller Gastgeber. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden immer gerne wiederkommen. Alles hat gepasst. Henrik war immer hilfsbereit und hatte uns im Blick.
Ottima posizione, appartamento confortevole e davvero bello. Arne un ottimo host
Friendly guests, round the clock help from reception, and clean bed sheets. U-Bahn/S-Bahn a 5-10 minute walk from here. All in all not a bad place to spend the night
Great house, within easy access to central berlin. Host was very hospitalable and ensured are stay went smoothly. Would definitely recommend stay here!

Our stay in apartment was just perfect. Kirsten is a great host, we didn't have any problem with communication at all.
Neighborhood is vary safe, residential but still full with shops, markets...
The main metro line U2 is 5 min walking from the apartment. To the center is about 20-30 min (Berlin is really big city).
Very, very clean, bright, warm and cosy apartment. Equipped with everything. We were four of us and it was comfortable. Its hard to find nice app in Berlin with two bedrooms, but still with good price.
I recommend Kirsten's place to everybody.
Hope see you again!

Barbara’s Place was extremely close to public transit which made it very easy to explore Berlin! If you don’t mind walking it is around a 20-25 minute walk from the town center! It’s around some cute shops as well! She has styled the place so perfectly and it is well equipped with a travel guide and tons of snacks! She was extremely thorough with her explanation of things! Would definitely recommend staying here to someone looking for a place in Berlin!
All good if you are a crowded group. Second floor is only suitable for sleeping. Ceiling is about 130mm on second floor

Ik heb een geweldig verblijf gehad bij Dominik, Dominik is heel vriendelijk en behulpzaam. Het appartement is geweldig! Mooie nette ruimtes en het is er ontzettend stil, wat ik heel fijn vond zo midden in de stad.  Het voelt ook heel privé, gewoon je eigen appartement. De locatie in de stad is ook geweldig, dichtbij tram, bus en ubahn haltes. Veel is ook goed te belopen, gezien de centrale ligging. Kortom een perfecte locatie en een perfect appartement om te verblijven en zeker met zo’n aardige gastheer als Dominik.
Spacious and the check-in instructions were spot on! Location was wonderful, so many delicious restaurants and cafes within walking distance
A lovely place for short stays and close to buses . Location overall good

Wir hatten eine angenehme Zeit in Frankfurt. Frank ist ein guter Gastgeber und die Unterkunft ist gemütlich und sauber.
Vielen Dank und auf ein anderes mal:)
Je recommande fidèle à la description et propre
Die wohnung war sauber und super gelegen. Wir würden wieder kommen

Wir waren zu fünft,, die Wohnung ist aber bestens geeignet auch für sieben Personen. Wir waren sehr zufrieden es ist alles hochwertig ausgestattet und sehr sauber. Lidl und Aldi sind schräg gegenüber und der Bus ist auch nicht weit, alles in allem sehr zu empfehlen.

What a great apartment in a wonderful neighborhood! It was clean, comfortable, and had a well equipped kitchen. The  grocery store, small shops to browse, and an amazing selection of restaurants were all in walking distance. Louis is a great host. He responded to any questions very quickly. We would give this host and his apartment a 10 star rating if Airbnb allowed it!
Habe für meinen Berlin Besuch gebucht. einfach toll! Gerne wieder
Es handelt sich um eine sehr klar organisierte Wohnung. Alles neu und sauber. Gute Atmosphere. Ich werde gerne wieder kommen.
Couldn't have asked for a better location or hosts. Incredibly welcoming and were patient and informative. Will definitely stay here again if I can
Eine geräumige Wohnung, ein Schlafzimmer zum Innenhof ist ruhig, zur Straße hin kann es morgens schon mal laut werden, aber in der Nacht war es okay.
Sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung. Perfekt um Berlin zu erkunden.
zu empfehlen

VOLVERÍAMOS SIN DUDARLO!
Es más, creo que vivir la experiencia es aún mejor que cualquier descripción, la habitación es sumamente amplia y confortable, la luz es maravillosa y el acceso es perfecto porque es por una escalera diferente a la de la entrada principal.
Gracias por compartir su departamento con nosotras, fue una maravillosa estadía.
Prima en mooi verblijf. Smaakvol ingericht en super verbinding met openbaar vervoer
Praktisch, sauber, Kühlschrank, gutes Bad. Sehr gut gelegen. Am Ende der Kastanienallee sozusagen. Also sehr zentral. Der Aufenthalt war sehr gut. Zu empfehlen. Ich werde wieder buchen.
Ivos appartement is een aanrader voor wie Berlijn te voet wil ontdekken. Dichtbij metro en bezienswaardigheden. Keurig appartement, goede communicatie, vriendelijke gastheer!

Numa is very well located without being noisy, ideal for frist time visitors, right next to many sightseeing locations. Also close to the metro, we walked everywhere. The room itself has everything you my need, a good bed and shower, mini kitchen, very nice shampoo, conditioner and lotion. We highly recommend it ! ☺️
Awesome accommodation, great communication, just perfect. Thank you for a perfect experience Babett. We highly recommend this place.

This hostel is very nice, it has a kitchen with is very convenient, plus a flexible check-in which was very helpful because our flight arrived quite late. The area is very peaceful and everybody was very helpful, the staff was nice and the location is perfect! Just a 5 minute walk from the train station and one stop away from Alexanderplatz and other tourist attractions. Would totally recommend.
Thanks for being a wonderful host!

Fanatastic central location, room at the back of a complex of flats so no noise and a very peaceful sleep. Lovely spacious and stylish apartment. Ella was away when I stayed but very quick to respond by text and her neighbour was also very helpful. Highly recommend staying here!

I had a great stay at Andres’s place! He was an extremely responsive host, giving us local recommendations and helping immediately when we had an issue with the WiFi. His apartment was just as advertised, and the surrounding neighborhood was so nice. Lots of fun restaurants and bars nearby, and close to busses and the train to access the rest of the city. I’d definitely stay here again!

good location and you will find everything you need for your stay.
the kitchen and toilets have everything you need for a short or medium stay

Ich habe eine zentral gelegene Unterkunft gesucht, die funktional und ruhig ist und primär der Übernachtung dient. Ich hätte auch dort mehr »wohnen« können mit selber kochen usw., habe das aber nicht genutzt. Das Zimmer ist sauber und ruhig, die Einrichtung definitiv zweckmäßig, man wird also nicht mit irgendeinem Stil konfrontiert, den man nicht mag. Ahmed war freundlich, hilfsbereit und zugewandt, ansonsten hatte man seine Ruhe. Die zentrale und gleichzeitig sehr ruhige Lage ist ideal als Start- und Endpunkt eines Berlin-Tages.
nice place with nice location
A very good place to stay a few days, with all the essentials to live with.
Exactly like the photos and worth the money.
Wir waren zu zweit für drei Nächte in dieser schönen Wohnung mit hervorragender ÖPNV-Anbindung. Die Unterkunft (ruhige Lage) war wie beschrieben, die Kommunikation gut und unkompliziert.

Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt bei Dennis und Dario sehr genossen. Die Wohnung liegt einerseits an einer ruhigen Straße, andererseits zu einem ebenso stillen Hinterhof, ideal als Rückzugsort nach vollgepackten Tagen in Berlin. Besonders positiv ist uns die Sauberkeit aufgefallen: Alles war sehr ordentlich und gepflegt.
Gegenüber der Wohnung ist ein schöner Park mit vielen Spielplätzen, Calisthenics Station direkt am Parkeingang und schönen Flächen zum Picknicken….
Die Kommunikation mit den beiden war jederzeit freundlich, schnell und unkompliziert, genau so, wie man es sich wünscht.
Kleine Anmerkung für große Menschen: Das Bett im Schlafzimmer ist eher für Personen bis höchstens 1,90 m geeignet.
Vielen Dank euch beiden für die schöne Unterkunft - wir empfehlen sie gerne weiter!

Es ist eine sehr schöne Wohnung in einer super Lage. Das Viertel ist nett und lebendig.
Die Kommunikation rund um Buchung und Check-in war schnell und unkompliziert. Auch während des Aufenthalts gibt es immer Ansprechpartner*innen, falls etwas fehlt. Ich hatte trotz beruflichem Aufenthalt das Gefühl, ich bin im Urlaub und würde jederzeit wiederkommen!

Julian ist sehr hilfsbereit und der Check-In war problemlos. Die Lage ist super, sehr nah zur S-Bahn und der Kuhdamm ist zu Fuß sehr gut erreichbar. Der Savignyplatz mit seinen nette  Restaurants und Bars ist direkt um die Ecke. Wir haben uns zu Dritt mit unserer kleinen Tochter sehr wohl gefühlt.

Wir sind mit zwei Erwachsenen und zwei Kindern angereist und waren mehr als zufrieden. Die Unterkunft ist hell, ruhig und geräumig. Es war alles sehr sauber und alles was man benötigt war vorhanden. Wir haben uns sehr sehr wohl gefühlt.
Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel und Supermärkte sind sehr gut erreichbar.
Alex ist ein sehr freundlicher und unkomplizierter Gastgeber.
Tha apartemen of Nouri is very fine. There's a nice little terras and the situation near the Tempelhof parc is super

The pictures do not do this place justice. It is a beautifully appointed flat, that is very spacious, with ample space to relax, make food, and enjoy a good nights rest. The flat situation is perfect, and the building stunning (the apartment is just a few minutes from the river, where there is a real buzz of people and places to eat and drink). Stefan was helpful, good with emails, and very accommodating with an early check in. The flat coupled with the hosts made this an airbnb I couldn't recommended higher, and it certainly would be a place I would come back too.

Ich habe mich in der Unterkunft sehr wohl gefühlt! Alles sehr sauber und schön!
Mein Zimmer war in einen Hinterhof und so konnte ich sehr gut schlafen. Das Bett ist bequem, das Bad sauber und insgesamt ist das kleine Apartment sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Ich würde wiederkommen! Vielen Dank!

Der Aufenthalt bei Carola und Uli war total super. Beide ganz liebe und offene Menschen. Das Haus ist wunderschön, das Zimmer 1 sehr schön eingerichtet und liebevoll gestaltet. Ich habe alles vorgefunden, was man benötigt. Die Anbindung an die S-Bahn ist grandios. Man ist schnell in der Stadt und die Haltestelle erreicht, man zu Fuß, in ca. 10 Minuten. Ich habe mich rundum wohlgefühlt!!!!
Ich möchte mich ganz, ganz herzlich bedanken, dass ich in ihrem Haus Gast sein durfte. Ich komme jederzeit sehr, sehr gerne wieder🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙋‍♂️
Nice cosy appartment! Very good located! The owner gave us great tipps where to eat! Good equipped, everything perfect!

This fantastic Wohnung is in a funky part of town: If you are looking for bougie Charlottenburg, this is not it.  If you are looking for a taste of the new Berlin, home to immigrants from all over the world, this is definitely it.  Want a quick Döner or Burger? It's a block away. Looking for Vietnamese,  Lebanese, Indian, Sushi or other world fare? Huttenstrasse is just three blocks away. Want to see the sights? The nearest S-Bahn station is an easy two blocks from your door. Want to relax with an evening swim? Freibad Plötzensee is within walking distance, but you can take a bus if you are burned out at the end of the day. We were surprised that the unit had no kitchen, but guess what, that was our bad. The description was very clear. We simply didn't read it. And in the end, we didn't need it. We bought cold snacks at a nearby Rewe and stocked the fridge. Plus, it is hard to beat two showers and three toilets!
Très bien, merci :)

Thanks for the stay! The host was very nice and met us at the flat late at night to check us in. Overall the flat had everything we needed: great internet, full kitchen with everything needed to cook a nice meal, great water pressure, good location, enough space for two. However, the garden is very overgrown and dirty with old cigarette butts left over from previous renters, the flat was a bit dusty and is older than the pictures show. Also the flat gets very little sun due to the location between tall buildings. It feels a bit like a basement flat. Our stay was sufficient for our needs.
Muchas gracias por recibirnos en su casa!!
Bright and spacious apartment. Helpful and communicative hosts. Great experience!

Die Wohnung liegt traumhaft, sie ist beides, ruhig und zentral. Perfekt ausgestattet von Küche bis Bad. Ich werde den Blick auf das bunte Laub amTeutoburger Platz vermissen.:-) Stefan ist ein sympathischer, aufmerksamer Gastgeber, der sich auch von unterwegs um alles perfekt gekümmert hat. Danke!
Stefan is a nice and thoughtful host and his flat is just beautiful, quiet and central in Prenzlauer Berg. And perfectly equipped, from kitchen to bathroom. I had a great time and would return for sure. Thank you!
Obwohl ich Robert leider nicht persönlich kennenlernen konnte, klappte die Kommunikation super. Sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit :)
Just perfect ❤️
Sehr gemütliche Wohnung in super Lage! Kann ich nur empfehlen für einen Berlin Trip

Nadia was lovely. She provided us with lots of information prior to our trip and there were maps waiting for us when we got there. There was also a bottle of sparkling wine as a gift, which was very thoughtful. The apartment looked exactly like the pictures and were beautiful, clean and central. We were impressed and very happy. Clean towels and sheets, great cooking equipment and really nice interior decorating. The location was perfect, close to transport, cool shops and restaurants. If ever going back to Berlin we would definitely stay again. Thanks Nadia, much appreciated.

Great place to sleep in for single or a couple. Comfort bathroom, the bad a bit soft for me but this is individual. Equipment kitchen (just one spoon, recommend to add some more, miss a pan).
It’s an apartment in front of the street but a quite one. So the privacy is not complete.

Amit’s apartment Is simply unbelievable!!! The location is perfect, super close to main transportation stations (both u-Bahn, Tram and buses), it is so tastefully designed and has lost of touches that made it feel like home. We stayed over a week and we definitely recommend anyone to stay in it too!
Great stay. Highly recommended

david’s place was a 1st level shop front, not that far from the city centre. the bus stop right around the corner brings you almost everywhere! one thing to note is that the front door and windows are glass and the privacy you get is from the curtains drawn!
this wasn’t an issue to us as we just consciously rmbr to draw the curtains before leaving the house. overall, a good stay in a good location. thank you!
I really enjoyed my busienss trip to Berlin. The apartment has everything. Localization is absolutely amazing. I will stay with Andrew again in upcoming months. Cheers!
Great stay in fantastic location!

Apartment is in a great location. Walkable & a good base for exploring. Well equipped apartment for groups. Host is very responsive and great instructions. Didn't bother us, but the apartment is on the 4th floor with no elevator.
Der Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm, sollte es wieder mal in diese Gegend gehen gerne wieder dort👍🏻
Great place. The location was very quiet and peaceful. Great for couples on a short trip to Berlin. Might be a bit small since it’s a studio sized apartment if you’re planning to stay long.

Es war wieder super in der schönen mit Liebe eingerichteten Wohnung von Henrik und Sven. Die Lage der Wohnung in Prenzlauer Berg ist sehr gut, sie ist in der Nähe von der U Bahn und nur 5 Gehminuten von der tollen Kollwitzstrasse.
Ich komme nächstes Jahr gerne wieder!
I had a clean and cozy stay. thank you!

la leipziger strasse n'est pas l'avenue la plus sexy du monde, loin s'en faut.
Mais le logement est à environ 10 minutes de check point Charlie et idem de Gendarmenmarkt Platz. la porte de brandebourg est à 30 minutes à pieds.

Host was super nice and communicative. Flat was just as in pictures, in a central location, and by a good selection of cafes/restaurants. Fair value of this flat would be a 4.5/5 stars - only deducting half a star because the bed was uncomfortable BUT being in a central location gives this place a good value for the price.
Monika fue una anfitriona muy amigable, comunicativa y genial. El lugar es muy lindo y tiene una hermosa vista a un parque además de estar muy bien ubicado. Definitivamente una excelente opción.
Danke Julia für die tollen Gespräche, das wundervolle, saubere Zimmer und für deine Hilfe bei allem was ich gebraucht habe <3
Sabine's place was great! Nice location near public transport and restaurants/bars. Sabine lives upstairs and was available to help when needed. Would definitely recommend!

Duuuuude. Hands down the BEST AirB&B experience I’ve ever had in my life. I’ll admit I was pretty reluctant to book a shared accommodation instead of an entire apartment, as it could’ve gone one of two ways; absolutely awful or absolutely amazing and fortunately I’m pleased to say the latter.
To start with, Alex is a wunderbar host; a wise man of quick wit, sarcasm and as a native Berliner he will quite frankly put any bullshit itinerary you make to shame - but bloody thank him for this! During the course of our stay we met a handful of his lovely mates, including his girlfriend, Yelina who was the sweetest ever. Everyday was filled with laughter, exploration and learning. Berlin is an amazing city and I’m truly greatful to have spent my 20th surrounded by the coolest most free spirited souls.
So to my dearest bestie Mersadi who accompanied me, Alex, Yelina, Friends & of course the lil baby; thank you for exceeding my expectations and giving me memories that I’ll never forget (hopefully). This is truly not a hotel, but a beautiful home with beautiful people. Congratulations on the kiddo and we will most certainly be back. If you’re looking for an experience of a lifetime look no further. This is the one!

Muchos Besos & Auf wiedersehen
Xxxx

Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Wohnung. Totz der Verspätung unsererseits hat das Check in gut geklappt da Rainer auf uns gewartet hat. Die Nächte waren sehr ruhig sodass wir uns gut von unseren Tagesaktivitäten erholen konnten.

Perfect stay in Berlin! The flat is comfortable and cozy, even bigger than on the pictures. The location is perfect, close to everything and in a great area.
Great communication with Peggy and Kristian, a perfect experience!
Would definitely come back again.

It's a pretty basic room but it has everything you need and it's really a good option if you want to stay in Berlin for a few days. Tram/Bus/Underground - everything is in 3-5 mins on foot.
Timothy was nice and helpful.

Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit in Berlin. Die Wohnung war genau wie auf den Bildern beschrieben, es gibt sehr gute Restaurants in der Umgebung und die Anbindung ist gut. Als wir ein Problem hatten, wurde uns vom Gastgeber sofort geholfen. Gerne wieder.

The apartment is well located, is comfortable and has all amenities, we could reach a lot of places just by walking and has a lot of cafes and restaurantes nearby. Sonja attention was amazing, always responsive and helped with all my concerns.
Beautiful stay!
Had an enjoyable stay at Hotel Cormenius! Location was fantastic with many great restaurants within walking distance.

We had a really great stay at Gilis apartment. The apartment was very clean and in a perfeft locatin , perfect for our 5 night stay in Berlin. The apartment had everything we needed and Gili was very fast to reply and helpful. i am recommending this apartment to anyone
Wohnung ist super für mehrere Gäste ausgelegt. Alles sauber und gute Kommunikation :)

Le logement d' Elena est trés bien situé. A une minute des stations Bus et Métro qui vous emmenent directement dans Berlin Centre. A également 10 minutes de la Gare qui rejoint directement l'aéroport. L'appartement est trés calme et permet de bien se reposer. Elena a été une hote parfaite, discréte et toujours á l'écoute. Elle m'a offert avec son fils quelques astuces de visites. Pour une premiere experience de booking room, j'ai été gaté. C'est certain je reviendrai chez Elena si je fais un nouveau séjour á Berlin.
Merci encore pour votre merveilleux et chaleureux accueil Elena.

Kousek od metra, do centra par stanic. Ac se hotel tvaril, ze nelze nikde v okoli parkovat i na dotaz, primo pred hotelem jsme nasli misto, sice je to v placene zone, ale v sobotu od 14 a nedele zdarma a jinak take zadne drama. Byla zde i mala hernicka. Veci na pripravu kavy a caje na chodbe. Byl slyset hluk z jinych pokoju, ale s tim se v techto starsich domech temer v centru musi pocitat. Za nas super. Synovi se moc libila palanda oblozena drevem jako takova pevnost...

Enjoyed my stay here and appreciated the accommodation for my last minute reservation. It is a nice quiet spot in Berlin to stay at but still not too far away from the city and the main touristy areas.
The guys are really cool and communication went super smoothly. The place itself is an absolute gem. Clean, comfortable, central and… a little quirky in the best possible way :) loved it.

It was a nicely designed apartment at a convenient place. Everything was new and clean. Kitchen was especially spacious and all the equipments were in perfect situation.
Tanja was very responsive and cooperative. With a few minutes from the tram, it was an excellent apartment choice in Berlin.
Een woning waar vanuit je Berlijn goed kan ontdekken. Het ligt centraal, dicht bij de metro en een grote supermarkt. Het huis is compleet, maar niet schoon.
Muy lindos apartamentos, cerca del transporte público que hacen muy fácil y rápido la llegada al centro de la ciudad y a los puntos de interés.
War alles super. Gerne wieder.
Amazing location - very easy to get around the city and nice size unit
It was a great experience in one of the best places in town to have some chill time and visit small bars. Thank you.
Amazing host!  Went above and beyond to help with my stay in Berlin!! The room was very cosy and he was very welcoming! Would highly recommend!!

Very nice apartment in a quiet and nice neighbourhood. The “little extra” include superior communication and flexibility from the host, a nice terrace and good kitchen utilities + also that the apartment is well shaded and airy + comfortable even on very hot summer days.
Convenient and peaceful neighbourhood, clean and tidy apartment, nice and helpful host 😊
Very beautiful and clean place in a historic building.
Phillip was an incredible host! We loved his apartment! It had everything we needed to make our trip to Berlin great! Comfortable, Spotless clean and in a perfect location. Would highly recommend!

Very nice stay at this beautiful area in berlin, close to the subway and cafe, restaurants. Thomas was very nice to let me stay in his apartment, felt like home, easy to answer any questions and welcomed me in when i checked in :)) Easily recommended!

Ivos is a great host. He was extremely responsive and helpful. We were greeted by Ivos outside the apartment building and he was very welcoming as he showed us to the apartment. The place is beautiful, spacious, airy and very comfortable. The views are amazing. The bed is one of the most comfortable beds I’ve ever slept in! Es wurde mit Fußbodenheizung geworben.. Meine Anreise bei Minus 3 Grad in eine eiskalte stinkende Keller-Wohnung, wo nur die Heizkörper in Schlaf- & Wohnzimmer angedreht waren. Auf eine Nachricht über die Message-Funktion, antwortete Katharina mir, ich solle einfach die Türen auflassen (es wurde also bewußt die Fußbodenheizung NICHT angeschaltet). Es zog überall, man ist fast mit dem Allerwertesten auf dem Toilettensitz festgefroren und trotz Schaffell-Socken stoch die Kälte über die Fliesen in die Füße. Ich habe nach einer Gassi-Runde mit meinem Hund erstmal Duft-Kerzen besorgt und hätte eigentlich noch einen Heizlüfter besorgen sollen, damit man es einigermaßen aushält. Ich sehe dieses rücksichtslose Verhalten inzwischen als mutwillige Körperverletzung an, da alle 3 Freundinnen eine Bronchitis plus Fieber hatten und mein Hund hat auch eine Lungenentzündung. Es ist eine absolute Unverschämtheit so zu vermieten und verachtender kann man einem zahlenden Gast nicht gegenüber treten.

Recepcja otwarta cały czas. Fajny taras na dworze ogólnodostępny. Pokój w którym byliśmy, był zwykłym pokojem, nic specjalnego ale wystarczający jako baza wypadowa na zwiedzanie miasta.

Appartement très bien placé et central. Des pièces spacieuses avec de grands volumes. La cuisine est bien équipée. Par contre, un des canapés lits dans le salon était dans une très mauvais état et il n’était pas possible de dormir dessus.

Удобно расположенная квартира. 900 метров до Александрплац. Два супермаркета рядом, один в 30 метрах, второй за углом. Две станции метро в 5 минутах ходьбы. Оборудованная и снабженная всем необходимым кухня (кроме масла для жарки), посудомойка, кофемашина, большой холодильник. Хорошее отопление. Немного тесновата душевая кабина. Нам понравилось здесь останавливаться.
Lucio is a great host. He offered me a great service.
Hervorragend und wirklich schöne Unterkunft!
This is a nice apartment in the middle of Mitte super close to multiple hip neighborhoods. The host is communicative and helpful with recommendations.

Oh my goodness what a perfect spot. Apartment was well appointed, great location very close to transit and two grocery shops, lots of space in the apt, and amazing beds.
Would absolutely stay here again.

Zee's place is in an incredible location for getting to any Berlin neighborhood by train, or walking to Mitte for coffee/shopping in the morning through the most beautiful part of museum island. The apartment is perfect for bare-necessities and very clean. I have food allergies and cook a lot of my meals so the kitchen was pretty sparse but definitely covers the basics and eating out in Berlin is so easy so this is probably something only I notice! Very lucky to been able to find and stay at Zee's.

Das Zimmer ist sehr schön gestaltet, sauber und sehr zentral gelegen. Essen ist in jeder Seitenstraße zu bekommen und egal ob zu Fuß oder mit der Bahn, man ist schnell an allen Sehenswürdigkeiten in Mitte.
Durch die Klimaanlage ist es übrigens auch an warmen Tagen, sehr gut in der Unterkunft auszuhalten
It was nice and cozy place. Location is also good positioned. Hope, one day i will come again.
Very nice little appartement with good location.

Oli and his roommate were the chilliest people I've met. Super cool to hangout with and very hospitable. And the place was everything it was advertised to be. Totally recommend it for business or pleasure travelers
Beautiful place, very clean and excellent value for money! 24/7 reception and €5 breakfast especially appreciated.
Very cozy apartment and great neighbourhood. Recommended!

On se sent rapidement chez soi dans cet environnement loft arty de Kreuzberg. Les pièces sont immenses et baignées de lumière. Nos adolescents ont adoré leurs chambres. Et les hôtes sont extrêmement sympathiques, accommodantes et flexibles. Difficile d’avoir une meilleure expérience. Nous reviendrons sans hésiter.

Very comfortable bed and nice welcoming touches.  Its worth noting that the apartment is up 68 steps so not suitable for anyone with mobility issues.  There isn’t a shower (other than a handheld hose) so bathing in the bath tub could also be problematic (which it is was for us as there was an issue with the hot water pressure for the duration of our stay).  It's in a quiet neighbourhood, has a couple of supermarkets within a 10 minute walk and the central train station can also be reached on foot within 30 minutes.
contact with Robert was great, the room was very beautiful, highly recommend 🥰
Christoph & Aileen's appartment is simply perfect ! With a very nice interior design, fully equipped, very comfortable. We are very grateful to them.

The flat was perfect for the five of us to stay for a week! The location was close to busses and trains and the windows faced the inner courtyard which was serene and quiet. We loved the location and David was extremely accommodating and responsive to all our questions and needs. We couldn’t imagine a better experience visiting Berlin! If I could give six stars and would! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Die Unterkunft war für uns einfach nur perfekt! Sie hat eine tolle Lage, mit kurzem Fußweg zur nächsten UBahn.
Die Angaben waren alle sehr detailliert und gut beschrieben und der Kontakt zum Host hat einwandfrei geklappt.
Ich würde diese Unterkunft immer wieder buchen!

Wir haben ein paar angenehme Tage in Berlin verbracht.
Die Wohnung in ruhiger Lage ist komfortabel, sehr sauber und elegant eingerichtet. Ein großes Plus: die Waschmaschine.
Im nahegelegenen Volkspark Friedrichshain bieten sich optimale Laufstrecken.
Vielen Dank an Jun für die hilfreichen Anreisetipps

Die Wohnung ist super zentral und ideal, um von hier aus Berlin zu entdecken.
Wir waren zu viert (zwei Erwachsene und zwei kleine Kinder) hier, und hatten genug Platz und außerdem hat Sven uns Babybett, Wanne und Kinderstuhl zur Verfügung gestellt, das war super!
Die Einrichtung ist zweckmäßig und sauber, die Matratzen sind super. Toll war für unseren längeren Aufenthalt, dass es eine Waschmaschine gibt.
Wer absolute Ruhe sucht, ist hier vielleicht nicht ganz am richtigen Ort, wer zentral und mit allen Einkaufsmöglichkeiten die Stadt erkunden will, auf jeden Fall! Wir würden die Wohnung auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen.

I wanted a good and clean room for 1 night, near my daughter's dorm. Andrea's offering was perfect : close, comfortable, and Andrea was very helpful and even arranged the night before for our taxi in the morning at 4.45am !

Lovely little flat in a residential area within easy bus route from Berlin central. 68 steps to get to the flat but easy enough if you are mobile (no elevator). Perfect for the two of us as we were always out and about and lack of kitchen not an issue at all.

El apartamento está bien ubicado y es completo, pero no tiene Wifi o conexión a Internet. El anfitrión me ofreció una adicional (paga), pero tampoco anduvo. Un vecino que lo ayuda fue muy amable en el proceso de check in. El departamento está muy bien, aunque no tiene una cama doble, sino dos individuales, un poco duras.
Great little apartment with character close to UBahn and not far from the centre of Berlin in an Uber. Organic supermarket just over the the main road very useful for supplies.

I can’t say enough good things about our stay. The flat was something out of Architecture Digest. Benjamin was super responsive and made sure we had everything we needed. It just felt like home. The location is also extremely convenient, close to great food, coffee, parks, and… parties. Already planning a trip back!
Fantastic apartment for groups of 5! Has everything you would require with a great location! Martina and Charlotte are easy to get hold of and were very helpful! Highly recommend
A very huge room with balcony in the banlieu of the Berlin. Really liked the quiet atmosphere in the locality. The host was really nice.
Everything was perfect, highly recommended
La ubicación es perfecta y el apartamento muy moderno y limpio. Nos gustó mucho. Por poner alguna pega, no disponen de cuna para bebé, por lo demás todo genial y repetiríamos sin dudar.
Nice and clean apartment, quick and easy response
Very clean place, quite, and have friendly staff. Would come back again for sure.

La verdad superó mis expectativas! Los chicos de la recepción súper amables y atentos, tuve que quedarme una noche más y rápidamente lo gestionaron. Antony el mejor!
La habitación super limpia y arreglada, baño y ducha impecable. Lo único malo que podría decir es que al ser tantos en la habitación para ducharnos, a veces te tocaba agua fría, pero es lógico siendo 6 personas!
La ubicación exelente, quizás un poco lejos de la parte histórica, pero con un bus en 20 minutos ya estabas ahí.
Es una muy buena opción a buen precio, lo recomiendo!

Séjour professionnel réussi dans l’appartement de Sven.
L’appartement est extrêmement propre, très lumineux (malgré le ciel Berlinois ☺️ Situé dans un quartier résidentiel constitué de grandes barres d’immeubles mais très calme. Au pied de l’immeuble un petit supermarché bio de quartier parfait pour faire ses courses, et à deux pas le fameux club le TRÉSOR, pour les amateurs de techno 🙃.

first trip to Berlin. place was well located, great sushi restaurant just up the road and 10 minute walk to some great bars. loads of transport links on doorstep. lovely accommodation not dissimilar to nice hotel room. one negative was the fan in the bathroom stayed on for an inordinate amount of time after turning off light and was very noisy. but other than that highly recommend
The apartment is really nice and communication with the host was great! Super easy check in and nice location. Only consider before to book that is the last floor without elevator.
Vielen Dank! Wir waren 6 Personen und haben 2 Übernachtungen hier verbracht. Alles super.

The studio is perfect to visit Berlin few days.
The tram passes very close, what it's a little disturbing.
The studio we got was so exposed to the street.
There were biscuits, sweeties, coffee and tea to have lunch, that was a great positive point
Location was very good.

Stylisch eingerichtete, schöne Wohnung mit unglaublich bequem und großen Bett. Liegt im Parterre und somit sehr ruhig, aber auch schattig  das ist im Sommer sicherlich ein Vorteil. Im Winter ist es etwas grau. Zu bemerken ist, dass die Wohnung ja keine Küche hat, und es somit auch kein Messer und Gabel gibt wohl aber zwei Korkenzieher und ein sehr schönen Wasserkocher sowie eine Espressomaschine. Die Kommunikation mit Hannah war die ganze Zeit sehr gut und hilfreich.
Nice apartment next to the centre of Berlin.
Hanna was extremely communicative and helpful. The apartment was in pristine condition and is in a great location, near the tram line and walking distance from so many great restaurants.

The apartment had everything we needed, and it was lovely inside. The quiet courtyard setting was nice as well, and it is a quick walk to the bus stop. Communication was excellent and check-in was easy.
Loved my stay at Ann’s place! Everything was perfect, can’t wait to come back!❤️

It’s was a lovely apartment and great choice for our quick weekend Berlin getaway.
The negative things I can say was probably the heater wasn’t heating well the whole apartment so we got cold.
Better sound proof window maybe and dark curtains for better sleep.
Thanks for having us in.
Ein wunderbares, blitzsauberes kleines Appartement. Die Lage ist perfekt! und der Gastgeber hat wirklich an alles gedacht. Wir kommen jederzeit gerne wieder.

Nous avons passé un excellent WE chez Sedat en famille.
Accueil impeccable de la part de Coskun.
L'appartement est très calme et proche du métro,idéal pour les visites.
Céline
Appartement propre, confortable et spacieux ! Notre séjour a 7 c’est merveilleusement bien passé !
Stilvolle Unterkunft! Genau mein Geschmack getroffen. Vielen Dank für die tolle Zeit. Ich hoffe bis bald 😍✨
Sehr lieb sehr sauber und sehr sicher

Tutto perfetto e oltre le aspettative. Unica criticità: le signore che si occupano delle pulizie non parlano inglese. Ecco perché è diventato un problema: sono le uniche persone che vedi durante il soggiorno, sulla piattaforma di Numa c’è scritto che puoi recuperare un oggetto dimenticato nella stanza senza problemi. In 4 ore in cui era stato segnalato in chat un oggetto dimenticato in stanza e due tentativi di contatto non ho più recuperato l’oggetto perché non ne sapevano nulla. Bellissimo l’automatismo del check-in, della chat con un robot, ma se c’è un problema a livello umano sei finito 😅
Beautifully designed and surprisingly spacious apartment, very close to all the delights of Kreuzberg and the canals. Martin was a charming and relaxed host. Would recommend.
Alles wie beschrieben- sehr schöne Ecke von Kreuzberg!
Had a great time, for an overnight visit. Still the same wonderful experience like some years before. Cool and sunny staff , great job. See you next time!
Really enjoyed my days at Ulrikes place! Easy to get around from there and also felt comfortable like at a second home :)
Nina war unkompliziert und freundlich. Es hat alles prima gepasst. Gerne wieder. 😁
The apartment was really nice and clean, the host and co-host were really kind and responsive

Ruhige Gegend am Gesundbrunnen, sehr schöne Wohnung und schöne Möglichkeiten dort was zu unternehmen. Gastgeberin sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend. Zimmer und Bad sauber und ordentlich. Flexibler und einfacher Check-in und -out.
Fijne en rustige uitvalbasis voor Berlijn.
Sehr gute Unterkunft für einen Städtetrip, U-Bahn Station gleich vor der Tür. Kommunikation per Handy 🔝
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt in dieser Wohnung und waren begeistert von der tollen Lage! Das Bett war super bequem und alles war sehr sauber. Wir würden auf jeden Fall wieder kommen. 😊
the staff were lovely, and I enjoyed my stay
Super stay at super location with a super host :)
The place is a great spot to stay. It‘s very well located, the apartment is modern and clean with all the amenities you need.

We searched for a five-person apartment (not a simple thing in Berlin) and found Steve's apartments, chose a three-room apartment and a living room. The communication with Steve and Patrick throughout the stay was great. The apartment is clean and tidy, had everything we needed and even more. Great location close to
public transport and supermarket nearby. And the area in general is very pleasant to stay. With everything we needed, Patrick was immediately available. We had a great experience and a lot thanks to them.Thank you Petrick and Stiv for the wonderful hospitality.

Sehr nette Gastgeber.
Ich hatte eine schöne Zeit in Berlin
Die Wohnung war Sauber und Ordentlich. Es gab ein Fach im Kühlschrank für uns und Handtücher bzw. Bettwäsche lag bereit.
We loved this apartment, and everything was perfect! Very nice neighborhood and we got recommendations about Berlin. The host is outstanding, and we will highly recommend the apartment!

그냥 넘 최고에요..
위치도 너무 좋아서 미떼까지 맨날 걸어갔구요
공간이 너무 멋지고 아늑하고 침대는 잠이 너무 잘옵니다... 그리고 고양이가 정말 귀여워요 제 친구는 고양이 알러지 있었는데도 너무 귀여워서 맨날 같이 놀았어요 무조건 가십쇼
Great apartment and easy check-in and checkout.
Great location!

진짜 정말 너무 좋았습니다! 공항에서는 거리가 있는 편이지만 숙소 바로 앞에 버스 정류장이 있고 근처에 지하철 역이 있으며 베를린의 주요 스팟과 멀지 않아서 베를린 관광하기에 정말 좋았습니다. 호스트 분도 정말 친절하시고 답장도 빠르셨습니다. 숙소 역시 따뜻하고 온수나 수압도 좋았어요!! 그리고 만약 여기서 묵으시는데 한식이 너무 그리우시다면 근처에 Gogi Boss라는 음식점을 추천드립니다!! 진짜 맛있었어요ㅠㅠㅠㅠ

Es ist ein sehr großzügiges Appartement. In der Küche waren alle Sachen vorhanden. Von Kühlschrank über Geschirrspüler, Wasserkocher, Kaffeemaschine und Induktionsherd bis hin zu sämtlichen Geschirr.
Im Bett konnten wir sehr gut schlafen.

Host is great, replied and was kind. Sadly the lack of cleanliness of the apartment caused us to leave our first night.
Bed is a futon style mattress with burn holes, hair, and white substance left on the cover. Shoes seemingly left by other tenants were found, and the hot water lasts around 4 minutes before running out.
Overall great location, but terribly dirty. Ladder is very uncomfortable, and old ladders and cabinets are stored in the apartment.
Mina has a wonderful apartment. The train is approx 5 mins walk away. The room and bathroom were spotless ans mina waa a great host. Highly recommend

Céntrico y el personal atento, por poner una nota negativa.
El aire acondicionado no funcionaba y había bastante calor en la habitación.
De resto todo bien

Agnes and Lorant were very kind and helpful hosts. Their apartment is perfectly situated for exploring the city - we walked to most places - and the room was very quiet and warm (it was cold outside). We were very comfortable there and I would recommend it to everyone.

Es war großartig. Ein toller Ort, um Berlin zu erkunden. Direkt neben dem Treptower Park eine gute Gelegenheit, um mit Hunden und Kindern spazieren zu gehen. Super einfacher Check-In und Check-Out, ohne unnötige Aufwände. Jederzeit wieder für unseren Berlin Aufenthalt.
We stayed in one of the rooms for two nights and the room&bath was great. We really liked the design of the apartments. Would love to come back again in the future!!

Staying at Hans Flat was great! The place is exactly like the photos, very clean and warm. We didn't have any issues with communication or otherwise. The area is also very good and quiet, couple of real good options to eating around and a short walk to the centre! Would definitely stay there again!

The technology part was a bit stressful and unclear but once you learned it it was fine.
I never used the QR code and still don’t know why you have to have it!
Once you have front door code, registering and getting card to enter the apartment door was simple. Nowhere did I read I would be creating a door key in the lobby!
My greatest fear was that we needed WIFI to complete this. We do not pay for international service so we can only do technical stuff once we are on WIFI!
Also paying the 5% tax was a total surprise to me so I didn’t realize if not paid we could not enter!
Also, arriving late Friday before Christmas we never met anyone until the following Wednesday after Christmas. Seemed weird to me. I was grateful 2 young people happened to come through the lobby while we were making the key and helped us!
The employee who came on Wednesday was extremely caring, helpful and friendly. We were so happy she was there!

We had a great time on Holger place.
The house is very comfortable, well equipped and beautifully organized. The location is perfect.
It is highly recommended for families that come to Berlin.
Schöne Wohnung in ruhiger Lage und die U-Bahnhaltestelle ist gleich in der Nähe. Das elektronische Türschloss hat gut funktioniert.

Moritz provided a gorgeously decorated space for my partner and I to stay in while we explored Berlin. Both Moritz and his partner were warm, friendly and accomodating during our stay.
The location is excellent, with the apartment being situated on a quiet and peaceful street that is still close to public transport and all the main attractions in Berlin.
I highly recommend staying here, this AirBnB is terrific value and Moritz provides and excellent experience.

très beau studio. transports à proximité qui permettent d'accéder facilement à tous les quartiers. propre et joli.Couchage agréable. Hôte amical, communication facile et réponses rapides. Très belle salle de bain, douche.
Sehr saubere und zentrale Wohnung in Berlin! Karsten war beim Einchecken vor Ort und hat uns noch tolle Tipps für den Aufenthalt gegeben! Gerne wieder!
The old stable is good for a family who likes to sleep in one large room. It isn't fancy but OK for a few days.
lovely place, perfect for what we needed. nice places to eat within walking distance
Amazing place to crash for a few days! Squeaky clean, private, and had laundry. It was great 😊

Barbara ist eine sehr herzliche und freundliche Gastgeberin.Das Zimmer ist gemütlich und süß,die ganze Wohnung wurde von Barbara wunderschöne eingerichtet.super Frühstück mit Barbara.Die andere Zimmer sind auch sehr zu empfehlen. Ich bedanke mich sehr für den schönen Aufenthalt. Würde ich gerne wieder kommen.
This was a very clean, quiet and convenient place and perfect for what we needed. Instructions were super clear. Neighborhood is very charming and close to the subway. Highly recommend!
Alles ist einfach super !
Nur zum empfehlen 👌

I had a really great stay. The appartment was beautiful, furnished with great taste. Jerome was very helpful and easygoing. I had a really great sleep because the neighbourhood is very calm. There's lots of great restaurants and café's at your doorstep. would recommend 1000%. Possibly my best Airbnb experience.

Locuința spatioasa, patul tip loft de deasupra bucătăriei s-a dovedit util pt copil. Baie utilată cu masina de spălat, presiune buna la dus, apa foarte fierbinte.Lenjerie curata la paturi, dar nu impecabila. Paturi confortabile. Proximitatea cu celelalte două apartamente ale complexului face ca gălăgia de pa vecini sa se audă destul de tare, dar nu a fost deranjant. Bucataria complet utilata. Nu am găsit însă nici un vas metalic pentru plita cu inducție.Pret rezonabil, acces facil din strada,locuinta e la parter.
Dobre miejsce aby się przespać i ruszyć na wycieczkę.
This is a lovely little unit in an excellent location. It has all the basics you need. And the bed is very comfortable and Jan makes it very smooth and simple to check in/out.

Beatrice was a great host, always there to chat and answer and questions I had. She’s an incredibly kind and friendly person. The house is super cute and cozy, the room is spacious and overall a great place to stay. Highly recommend :)

Ostello molto ben pulito, personale gentile e disponibile.
La postazione letto nelle camere multiple spaziosa. Ho viaggiato da sola e mi sono trovata molto bene.
La zona è piena di ristoranti etnici e molto frequentata con supermercato aperto fino a tardi nelle vicinanze.
Unico appunto se visitate la città per la prima volta a parte l’east side gallery le attrazioni principali sono a 30 minuti di mezzi dall’ostello quindi non proprio una posizione strategica se si hanno pochi giorni a disposizione.
This lovely place has a perfect location to walk anywhere in Berlin. Axel met us right on time and gave us some Restaurant ideas and grocery locations. We had just a wonderful time!
Amazing apartment, we enjoyed our stay so much. Great location and very clean. Julia was also very flexible with check in and out which really appreciated. Great Airbnb experience :)
Lovely apartment, easy to get anywhere within Berlin🙌🏼

Heval må være den beste vert :-)
Leiligheten lå kun 2 minutter fra u-bahn.
Flott, lys og romslig leilighet med alt man trengte.
Vi ble tatt for sniking på u-bahn fordi vi trodde at barn på 14 og 15 var barn. Det var feil. Fikk beskjed om å betale Euro 60 pr pers (totalt 8 stk) i bot, men Heval kom og hjalp oss etter at vi hadde forsøkt i ca 30 min. Vi slapp unna bot :-)
Kommer garantert tilbake neste gang vi er mange som skal på tur :-)

A great place to stay in Berlin, in the middle of a vibrant neighbourhood Kollwitzkiez with nice bars and restaurants just around a corner. Communication with Henrik was smooth and friendly. Apartment is spacious and has all necessities on offer. Some important details such a coffee and tea make the final touch to the experience. Highly recommended.
Very well located!
Elliott was an amazing host. He gave a small tour of the neighborhood and had plenty of recommendations.

Leiligheten er som beskrevet i annonsen.
Kort vei til offentlig transport, dagligvarer og gode restauranter.
Utleier er proaktiv og svært hjelpsom for å gjøre din ankomst og opphold så behagelig som mulig.
Man må regne med noe støy fra naboer og fra gateplan, men du verden for noen fantastisk gode senger.

Place is super clean and looks exactly the same as shown on the pictures, there are restaurants, markets, cafes etc around. It is also easy to get to the train station with several minutes walking. Would recommend!

We stayed one month in the apartment. It was the same as the pictures. Very clean, well located with lots of transportation around the apartment. The only thing would be that the internet connection is very low... Otherwise, I good stay that I recommend!
Cool hosts, great location! Highly recommended!

Excellent 2 bed contemporary apartment as part of an apartment hotel so has the convenience of check in etc. Apartment is spacious and clean and pretty quiet. Location is close to metro station for easy access to all downtown tourist locations.

Julia ist eine unglaublich freundliche Gastgeberin.
Die Unterkunft entspricht genau der Beschreibung und ist mit vielen kleinen Annehmlichkeiten versehen, sowie sehr liebevoll eingerichtet.
Die Kommunikation war perfekt.
Ich würde sofort wieder buchen.
Very kind host, place was close to the subway. Also great restaurants nearby.

We hadden een geweldige tijd bij Anja en Mario. Het oude, grote huis heeft veel karakter en de omgeving is groen en rustig. Aan het eind van de straat is een bos waar je kan wandelen. Anja en Mario zijn heel lieve mensen die altijd klaar staan als je iets nodig hebt. De kamer is goed verzorgd en netjes met een gedeelde badkamer en keuken. Ook is er een aangename tuin. Het was heerlijk rustig verblijven, net in een dorp en toch op slechts een half uurtje van centrum Berlijn, de Potsdamer Platz. Ook een aanrader is fietsen via de Berliner Mauerweg door het groen naar Potsdam. We komen met veel plezier nog eens terug! :)

We had a very easy check-in at 10 pm at night. The team had emailed us directions and instructions to get in beforehand, so that was made super smooth. Once we walked in, we noticed that all the beds were nicely made, the info book was left to us to see and there were a few colds in the fridge! Perfect welcome. We stayed for 5 nights in total and absolutely loved the location. As we attended the film festival we were mainly around Potsdamer Platz & Friedrichstrasse, which were easily accessible by the S-Bahns (we are talking 15 min door-to-door). If you want to see the 'real Berlin', the east-side is easily accessible as well.
The flat consists of a bedroom, a huge living space with TV, sofa table, dining table and of course a fold-up sofa. There is also a decent-sized bathroom and a little but efficient kitchen. Made our stay very homely :)
We left early in the morning, 7 am, and were happy how smooth the check-out was made already. Volkar kept in touch throughout the stay and there were absolutely no issues.
I will definitely be staying here again the next time I come to Berlin! Highly recommend this!
Beautiful flat, everything was perfect  and has everything you could possibly need. Would stay there again :) thank you

Awesome apartment, in a very stylish part of town. I can only say great things, about our stay at Max's place. From beginning to end, we throughly enjoyed ourselves. Your minutes on the metro, from anywhere in the city. The apartment was the perfect size for two of us, with all the amenities we needed. The superintendent Friedrich met us when we arrived, and made us feel welcomed. For anyone staying in Berlin Max's apartment is the place to be. Thank you Max, very much!
Adam & Renske

Un très joli appartement, idéalement situé à 15 minutes à pied de Check point Charlie.  10 minutes du musée juif .Facile d’accès de l’aéroport à aller comme au retour. Compter 45 minutes pour s’y rendre. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour chez Nena. La salle de bain tip top. La cuisine fonctionnelle. Propre agréable. Ich hatte einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt in Chris' privatem Zimmer. Die Lage ist ausgezeichnet – nur ein kurzer Spaziergang vom Alexanderplatz entfernt, was es einfach machte, sich fortzubewegen und das zentrale Berlin zu erkunden, einschließlich der Museumsinsel und Unter den Linden.
Das Zimmer war hell, gemütlich und durch den eigenen Schlüssel und das Schloss sehr sicher. Das Badezimmer habe ich mir mit Chris und einem weiteren Gast geteilt, was überhaupt kein Problem war – es war immer sauber.
Das WLAN war zuverlässig, und ich fand es praktisch, Zugang zur Waschmaschine und zu einfachen Küchengeräten wie Mikrowelle und Wasserkocher zu haben. Der Check-in war unkompliziert und flexibel, wie beschrieben.
Insgesamt war es ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt. Ich würde auf jeden Fall wieder hier übernachten und kann die Unterkunft allen empfehlen, die eine bequeme und gut gelegene Unterkunft in Berlin suchen.

Zudem sind Supermärkte in Laufnähe, was den Alltag erheblich erleichtert. Empfehlenswert ist das Cafe am Engelbecken, gutes Frühstück, nette Leute und super Musik. Insgesamt eine großartige Erfahrung!
The room was cozy, and light and we felt really nice. Both hosts were pleasant and communicative but we also had our privacy.
Alex's place is very spacious and very unique. It's close to public transportation and the check in was so easy. I highly recommend others to stay here.

Great place! The only thing to keep in mind is that it can get a bit warm in the summer, so you might need to open the windows. Since it’s on the ground floor, it can be a little noisy in the mornings.

Jag och min 13åriga son hade två bra nätter i lägenheten när vi besökte Berlin över en helg.
Lugnt läge med gångavstånd till restauranger, matbutiker och caféer. Nära till kollektivtrafik för att utforska mer av staden.
Lägenheten hade allt vi behövde och kändes hemtrevlig att vistas i. Snabb och trevlig kommunikation med värden och flexibilitet vid in och utcheckning som var till stor hjälp för oss. Skulle gärna hyra den igen!
Wir möchten sehr gerne nochmal kommen! Alles war gut!

Nice and calm apartment nearby Hasenheide park.
Everything you need for a enjoyable stay.
Great stay in your cosy and clean appartement. It was for our family the perfect basis to explore Berlin and we will highly recommand it to others.

The apartment was beautiful, really special, Ulrich was abroad so we didn't have the chance to meet him but he replied to our e-mails and contacted us promptly :)
the description he gave us of the apartment, the neighborhood and how to get to the center was accurate and really helpful as well.
It's close to the center by metro, but in a quiet lovely neighborhood - just what we were hoping for.
Great place to stay and enjoy the mood of Berlin
Werde auf jeden Fall wieder kommen :) sehr tolle Unterkunft!
Confortable place with usefull complements and well connected. Dawid is always available for any request or question.

Wir waren angenehm überrascht über diese Unterkunft. Die Gastgeber, die einem das Gefühl geben sehr willkommen zu sein, bieten den wunderbaren Service einem zum Flughafen zu fahren/abzuholen. (Wenn es möglich ist.) Trotz der Nähe zum Flughafen hat man trotzdem den Eindruck in einem friedlichen und ruhigen Teil von Berlin gelandet zu sein. Das Zimmer ist hell, komfortabel und sauber, die Betten sind bequem, man schaut ins Grüne - was will man mehr. Vielen Dank!

Wir hatten einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt in Sergios Airbnb. Die Wohnung ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet, gemütlich und sauber mit einem sehr gemütlichen Bett. Der Check in und Check out hat beides problemlos geklappt. Wir haben Sergio in der Zeit nicht gesehen, aber er war immer erreichbar, sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Auch sein Freund, der uns in die Wohnung gelassen hat, war super freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Das Airbnb ist in einer schönen Gegend in einer ruhigen Straße gelegen und trotzdem super zentral.
Auf jeden Fall zu empfehlen!

Heidi ist eine sehr herzliche, aufgeschlossene Gastgeberin! Wir haben uns bei ihr sehr wohl gefühlt, sowohl beim Check-in und Check-out war sie sehr flexibel und jederzeit, auch vor unserer Anreise, für uns zu erreichen. Das gemütliche Zimmer ist in einer schönen Altbauwohnung gelegen und wie auch Küche und Bad sehr sauber. Direkt vor der Tür fahren mehrere Buslinien, auch zu den nächsten U- und S-Bahn-Linien ist es nicht weit, was die Unterkunft zu einem perfekten Ausgangspunkt für die Erkundung Berlins macht. Wir würden jederzeit wieder bei Heidi buchen, vielen Dank für alles!
Christian & Annika

Apartamento fantástico, muy bien ubicado y economico...cerca de transportes y supermercados.
Repetiría sin pensarlo.
Great hospitality

Thank you for being a great host for my 1st Air BnB. They say 1st impression is everything and for sure your hospitality and neatness gave me an off the chart lasting impression of what air bnb host should be. Thank you so much.

Die Unterkunft von Dlauer hat mir und meinen Freunden sehr gefallen. Wir waren 9 Personen in der Wohnung und hatten keinerlei Probleme was die Größe des Apartments angeht. Das Golden Apartment ist sehr schön und gemütlich eingerichtet, sodass man sich wie zu Hause fühlt. Die Ausstattung hat auch gepasst, da das Essentiellste für Küche, Bad und Klo vorhanden war. Nicht weit von der Wohnung findet man etliche Geschäfte, in denen man auch spät am Abend Lebensmittel und anderes zu einem günstigen Preis bekommt. Gleich neben dem Apartment gibt es auch öffentliche Verbindungen, mit denen man fast überall hinkommt. Alles in Allem ist diese Unterkunft perfekt für größere Gruppen.
Great place to stay very fun area to stay
Maravilloso host y el hospedaje maravilloso. El estilo que tiene ds unico y maravilloso. Lugar muy bien ubicado y lleno de comercio local, lo recomiendo ampliamente

This place is amazing! The location is great, close to the tram station, walking distance to shops, restaurants and supermarkets. Close to Kino International where I watched a film and Karl Marx Alle, which has a nice view of Berlin particularly at dusk. The hosts are super friendly and responsive. They even provided me with a bike to cycle around, which is very convenient cuz central Berlin is great to explore by bike. I would definitely come back again if I visit Berlin again!
Very cosy room in the heart of Kreuzberg. Loft style hish ceiling and decoration is amazin. Very close to everything you may need. Next time!
Amazing accomodation!
Had a nice time here.

Nadim était un hôte amical et à l’écoute,
Il a pris le soin de nous donner les informations nécessaires avant l’arrivée.
L’appartement quant à lui est comme sur les photos, impeccable, bien rangé et propre.
Le Check-in et check-out étaient très simples, c’est presque comme si on habitait déjà dans cet appartement.
Si vous voulez profiter d’un bel appartement avec un bon rapport qualité prix non loin du centre de Berlin alors c’est le bon. Endroit très calme et un peu caché.
Prisen i Berlin er høj. Denne lejlighed er ok, men ikke et epi ar hjem. En lejlighed til udlejning. Ingen direkte lys. Lejligheden ligger i stuen og alle vinduer et matteret glas.
Great hosts, house was very nice . I enjoyed my stay very much
We all liked the very convenient location of the apartment and the convenient arrival, the apartment matches the description

The room big, bright and clean with a desk and trashcan.  I was given my own shelf in the fridge which was nice. The kitchen has the basics. Location is nice tranquil with cute cafes near, 15 min bike ride from the messe (trade show). The days I was there was a heatwave so I suggest a fan for next time and a mosquito zapper. The door of the room was hard to close. Wifi 80% stable. Host and her sister were friendly and helpful.
Alles super!

Hans ist ein sehr netter und freundlicher Gastgeber, seine Wohnung ist bestens ausgestattet und die Dachterrasse ist ein absoluter Traum. Wir kommen bestimmt wieder!!! 🤗
Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt! Vielen Dank :)
We enjoyed this lovely & convenient flat close to the S & U bahn. The surrounding is very nice & quiet with a supermarket pretty close. Very clean & nice. We strongly recommend.
nice place, as mentioned it's micro but very well designed!
So schöne Wohnung! Tolle Lage, hab mich wie zuhause gefühlt
War super, alles genau wie auf den Fotos.

Die Wohnung war super schön und war für mich von der Lage her ideal. Innerhalb von wenigen Bahnstationen ist man schon an der Gedächtniskirche/am Kufürstendamm. Alles war sehr sauber und auch wenn ich Brit nicht persönlich getroffen habe, hat mit der Schlüsselübergabe alles problemlos geklappt - gerne wieder!

Die Wohnung liegt in einem netten Viertel, zentral an den Öffentlichen Verkehr angebunden. Zum Frühstücken musste man einen etwas längeren Fußweg quer durch den Park in Kauf nehmen. Direkt vor Ort kann man jedoch für 21,00 EUR pro Person im NH Hotel Alexanderplatz frühstücken. Manche Cafés öffnen erst gegen 11:00 Uhr. Direkt vor Ort leider keine Möglichkeit, Brötchen einzukaufen. Ansonsten können wir die Wohnung sehr empfehlen.

Gianni‘s apartment is very cozy and clean. There is everything you need and Gianni is very helpful at all times! The kitchen is a bit small, but we went out for food the whole time. The apartment is bright and the beds are supercomfy. It is located in a really nice and calm area and you can get everywhere from the metro station nearby. Staying in Gianni‘s aparment was really a huge pleasure. We will definitely keep Gianni‘s place in mind for our next trip to Berlin. With Gianni you will do everything right!
Alles top, gute Anbindung und man kommt schnell überall hin!
Thomas was very kind and an amazing host. He was available and kind. Thank you again for having us!
Thank you so much for being a wonderful host! The place was nice, and your hospitality made my stay even better. I would definitely recommend your place to others :)

Ich habe im Zimmer bei Florent eine Nacht verbracht. Diese war wunderbar. Das Zimmer, das Bett und das Bad waren sauber. Der Ort ist super gut erreichbar. Mitten im Wedding eben. Die Pizza im benachbarten Restaurant war übrigens exzellent. Sehr zu empfehlen.
I had a great stay with Victoria; stylish interior, very quiet and dark at night. I slept like a baby!

I stayed at Johanna’s flat for 6 days, and it was absolutely wonderful! It was quiet, clean, and very comfortable. The location made it so easy to explore Berlin. Johanna was also very kind and attentive. Definitely a place I’d love to stay again!
Nice and big appartment, lots of room for bigger groups of families.
A really stylish and well-equipped apartment in a good location, communication with hosts worked flawlessly.
The apartment was great! Central location, very comfortable bed, clear instructions for checking in and out. Would happily stay here again!

Sehr schöne Wohnung - zentral und trotzdem ruhig. Sauber und ordentlich!. Ohne Bedenken zu empfehlen!
Excelente alojamiento y datos de Guillaume para tener una buena estadía en Berlín!
Buen alojamiento, en un buen barrio. Tranquilo, muy pocos ruidos, intimo. Transporte público muy cerca, zonas de esparcimiento, restaurantes y bares.
Such a cute place to stay when you are in Berlin! Birte was lovely and so fun to chat with, such a kind person and would highly recommend staying here!

Spent 4 nights at Numa Belforter Berlin as part of our honeymoon.
We originally were staying for 3 nights, but as we were camping around Europe, had flexible plans and wanted to spend more time in Berlin, we decided to extend our stay by one night which was made extremely easy by numa via their online portal.
The room we had was 203 and it was perfect. Very comfy and in a great location just 2 minutes walk from the tram line 2.
There is also a beautiful peaceful park around the corner with historic buildings and beautiful restaurants and bars in this area too.
There is a convenient grocery shop on the same road as well on the way to the tram.
The only critical feedback I have is the fridge.
Like most hotels or apartments we have been to in Europe, the mini fridges are never really cold.
Luckily we had our camping fridge so used this instead. I would recommend that numa upgrade the mini fridges but this is my only and very minor criticism.
Everything else was perfect!
We had such a lovely stay here! Such a cool and cozy place. Had everything we needed and was in an awesome location for going out. Would definitely recommend!

Absolutely lovely, cool flat, in the best area so close to the fabulous food market and lots of other interesting shops etc loved eating our breakfast at the little table looking out over the street. Thanks jo

Highly recommend to anyone looking for a beautiful, relaxing, and inspiring place to stay!

I have been staying at Stellas apartments several times as they are exactly as advertised, very clean and the communication is on point.

Bernd and Katja's apartment is really lovely and it was a pleasure to stay in such a beautiful place. We felt very lucky to have booked it! The apartment is clean, cosy and has a very nice feel to it. Our hosts were very friendly and amenable, allowing us to check in early and providing us with lots of helpful suggestions. The neighbourhood is great with lots of shops and places to eat, as well as lots of local transport links. We had a great time and wouldn't hesitate to book this apartment again!
A real nice and comfortable place in the center of Berlin for a very cheap price. If It wasnt for the size of the room, It would be a 4 stars hotel.
Mysigt område och lätt att ta sig. Vi trivdes bra i Darias boende.

It was great! I feel bad because I checked out after my friends and they didn’t clean up very well, but there were also no instructions about cleaning up. Either way, we should have done better and he was incredibly responsive.
Sehr liebevoll und hochwertig eingerichtete Ferienwohnung. Wir kommen gern wieder!

Great location, right where you want to be in Berlin.

Everything was great! The room was beautifully decorated and situated in a nice neighborhood. And Petra is a very friendly and welcoming host!
We really enjoyed our stay here! Claudia was super friendly and helpful, and the apartment was spacious, modern and clean. Nice location in a quiet neighborhood.
Decent sized apartment, I stayed here because my friend lives nearby. You must organize to meet the cleaner to get the keys

eine sehr ruhige und schöne Gegend, sehr idyllisch mit großen alten Bäumen. Die Gastfamilie ist sehr herzlich und freundlich. Die Unterkunft ist sehr sauber. Alles gut! Nur die Lage ist etwas außerhalb der Innenstadt, aber machbar. Durchaus zu empfehlen!

Hat alles Gepasst.
Nette Gastgeber.
Small but modern and spotless garden apartment. Mandy is a great host and made me feel welcome.

Die Unterkunft war super leicht zu finden und gut angebunden an den ÖPNV. Ubytování bylo ucházející, ale konkrétně můj pokoj (č.4) byl velmi malý a velmi tmavý, vybavený jako vězeňská cela... velmi malé okno s mříží... postel ale byla pohodlná. Kuchyně v pořádku. Koupelna v pořádku, ovšem sprchový kout velmi malý s příliš krátkým závěsem...

we were staying 7 days and enjoyed our time in there very much! Dirk was fridendly and we got a great instructions for getting in. Apartment was clean and kitchen was great for making breakfast! We would definitely come again!
Wir waren herzlich willkommen und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt! Vielen Dank!

A visszajelzéseket olvasva aggódva érkeztem néhány részletkérdés miatt, de pozitívan csalódtam, ezért leírom, hátha valaki emiatt nem tud dönteni:
- az utcafront nem volt hangos, bár jelenleg egy felújítás miatt zsákutca és nincs nagy forgalom, de nem volt zavaró az utca zaja, pedig mi csöndhöz szoktunk.
- az ajtó elég stabil, nem volt félelem érzetünk.
- éjjel valóban kicsit hűvösebb volt, de egyébként jól be lehetett fűteni (kint nem volt nagyon hideg) és a takarók nagyon melegek voltak.
- a szomszédokkal nem is találkoztunk, a szomszéd apartmanban ugyan kicsit hangosak voltak, de kibírható volt.
A kiadó kommunikációja valóban személytelen, ne is próbálkozzatok még fél órával korábban se early check-int kérni. Ezt személy szerint én nem értem, egy 20 hónapos gyerekkel álltunk az utcán várva a 3 órát, pici rugalmasság szerintem segítené a kommunikációt, de leírták előre, hogy nem lehet, végülis minek kérdeztem...
Összességében jól éreztük magunkat, ajánlom!
Hôtel très sympa, très propre, petit déjeuner pas trop cher

The location is unbeatable - really a great neighbourhood and a very nice building! The apartment itself is also very nice - completly as you see in the photos along with a really beautiful and large bathroom.
However, it's not your typical Airbnb experience. As others wrote before, a professional service firm takes care of handing over the key - and not much else. The women who met us there, didn't know anything about the neighbourhood and questions about how to get to the apartment from the central station went unanswered - also by Marc. Several light bulbs were not working and noone seems to notice that (Marc did say he would get it fixed though) It took me a whole day to find out the WIFI code (yellow tape on the fridge FYI :-) There are also two great balconies but strangely enough no table or chairs or even a plant there, which makes them hard to use.
A neighbour stopped me to tell me that it was illegal to rent out the apartment via AirBnB. I do believe Marc has a license but it's not so pleasant. Maybe neighbours should be informed.
Knowing all this I would still recommend the place for its great location and nice decor - but maybe not if you are planning to stay for weeks. The beds have very thin mattresses and are quite uncomfortable
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und für eine Nacht, war die Unterkunft für uns perfekt. :)

We had an absolutely awesome stay. The apartment is beautiful, well-equipped and very well situated - it was the perfect "base" to start the day and come home to in Berlin for the week that we stayed. I wholeheartedly recommend it to any groups who are thinking of renting it out.
Great host and always very responsive!
Ahmed is really chilled. The layout of the room is simple and spacious, that remind me the place I used to stay while I was in Berlin. Highly recommended.

Zweckmäßig für meinen beruflichen Aufenthalt. Sehr gute Kommunikation. Im Vergleich zu den Hotelpreisen im gebuchten Zeitraum preislich okay, einzeln betrachtet mit insgesamt 120€ für die Nacht etwas teuer (lag aber sicherlich an der spontanen Buchung und dem Zeitraum...)
Yhden majoittujan lakanat puuttuivat. Paljon hyttysiä. Hyvä paikka, suosittelen isolle porukalle.
Unfassbar schönes Ambiente und perfekte Lage.
Heikes "Atelier" ist ein kleines Schmuckstück, sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet in einer tollen Gegend.

Jot was a great host and the place was nice and tidy. It was previously a storefront but that’s in the description and other reviews so be considerate of that. Overall the stay was amazing and Jot was very accommodating. Would highly recommend for solo travelers as it’s very easy to come and go.

Wenn Mensch eine kleine Auszeit von der hektischen Großstadt braucht, ist dies der perfekte Ort dafür.
Super gemütlich eingerichtet und die Lage könnte, egal zu welcher Jahreszeit kaum schöner sein. Sehr empfehlenswert.

The flat is in a quite and friendly area  and our host was very accommodating. Perfectly situated for sightseeing with many of the major sights  in  walking distance and for those further away public transport was easy to get to. We enjoyed the local restaurants and the excellent cafe next door.
Sehr empfehlenswert, hat alle super geklappt!
the hostel is great value for the price for sure. check in to check out, things were easy.

Aber alles in einem würde ich den Aufenthalt bei Christine sehr empfehlen, sie ist eine tolle Gastgeberin und ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt ☺️
Apartment was as described and within good walking distance to nice restaurants, cafes, public transport. Can recommend staying here👍🏼

Had a great stay at Heidi's place. Safe and convenient location. Pictures and description were accurate. Would highly recommend!

Un grand merci à Phuong et Martin pour leur accueil et leur gentillesse !
The room and the apartment were great and Andrea was very kind.
nice, quiet, clean place, everything as described.
