Hat alles prima geklappt, sehr zu empfehlen

Die Unterkunft von Robert können wir jedem sehr empfehlen. Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber, stilvoll eingerichtet und auf der Dachterrasse kann man herrlich entspannen. Robert ist sehr hilfsbereit - die Kommunikation verlief bestens. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral und hat eine gute Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Was fine for the price. Bed not the most comfortable, but not too bad. Very clean and close to tram. It is perfectly fine. No frills. Perfect for what I needed it for.
Everything was great!

Der Aufenthalt in der Wohnung von Ïan und Julia hat uns keine Wünsche offen gelassen. Die Wohnung ist schön eingerichtet und ist mit allem ausgestattet, das man für einen gemütlichen Aufenthalt in Berlin benötigt.
Die verkehrstechnische Anbindung ist auch hervorragend.
Des weiteren ist der Kontakt zu Ïan und Julia sehr einfach und zuvorkommend. Zuvorkommend und individuell wird zudem auch auf die eigenen Bedürfnisse und Wünsche eingegangen.
Als Softwareentwickler mit entsprechend leichter Geek-Veranlagung kam ich nicht umher, als über den individuellen Türcode zu schmunzeln. Das kann kein Zufall gewesen sein 😉
Am Ende bleibt mir nichts anderes übrig als den Aufenthalt in der Wohnung von Ïan und Julia nur wärmstens weiterzuempfehlen. Vielen Dank!
Philipp’s a great host, even remotely! The house is just perfect and exactly like the pictures.
Excelente hospedaje Slim tu servicio de Airbnb es de los mejores en los que me he hospedado en Europa. Seguro volvería a contactarte al regresar a Berlín. Muy recomendado.
Wohnung sieht aus wie auf den Fotos, wir waren sehr zufrieden!

Fantastic. Everything was great in the apartment. However it was advertised as being on the second floor which was slightly confusing as it was on the third.
Overall an amazing experience and place to stay in Berlin. Would recommend highly to everyone!
Thankyou.
Tia was great to deal with. She answered all queries promptly and gave really useful advice in advance of our trip. She was waiting for us at the apartment when we arrived.
I had a wonderful 3 days... I'll be back again!
Gute Lage, Freundliche Gastgeberin, Zimmer mit viel Platz, Supermarkt bzw. Möglichkeiten zum Essen sind in der Nähe.

Ich war zum zweiten Mal in der Wohnung von Barbara. Und wäre sie nicht ständig ausgebucht, hätte ich sicher schon öfter dort übernachtet. Barbara ist eine fantastische Gastgeberin: Sie reagiert sehr schnell auf Fragen, ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Zur Begrüßung stellt Barbara Wein und Wasser hin. Kaffee und Tee sind ebenfalls vorhanden. Und auch die Küche ist perfekt ausgestattet. Wer kochen möchtet, findet dort alles. Generell ist die Wohnung toll ausgestattet, super geschmackvoll eingerichtet und sehr sauber. Höchstbewertung mit Sternchen!
The appartement was perfect, very big and clean

Sehr gute Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber. Unkompliziertes flexibles einchecken. Parkplätze direkt vor der Tür. Es ist wirklich ein sehr schönes und ruhig gelegenes Apartment, in dem man sich gleich wohl fühlt. Vor der Tür gibt es direkt ein paar Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.
Also unsererseits gab es nichts zu beanstanden, wir waren mehr als zufrieden und würden jederzeit wiederkommen.

Eine super Unterkunft. Sehr sauber und gepflegt und ausgestattet mit allem, was man braucht. Top Bad und Küche. Super angenehme Dusche!
Helen ist eine sehr freundliche und aufgeschlossene Gastgeberin. Alles war ganz unkompliziert und wir hatten eine schöne Zeit. Danke!
Easy location close to an U-Bahn Station, Restaurants and grocery store.  The street is also very quiet which means a good night sleep!  great shower and comfortable bed.
Nice Apartment!
Ev çok güzel. Metroya 5 dakika uzaklıktaydık. Evin olduğu mühit  biraz kötüydü fakat ev o ortamdan uzaktı.

We had the best time at Tina’s. It was clean and cozy and welcoming. It felt like being home. The neighborhood was definitely our favorite place in Berlin!
Many public transport options, good restaurants and wine bars. 10/10 experience
Alles bestens

We had a great stay at the loft- perfect location for exploring the area and nightlife, and the apartment is very spacious and comfortable. The bedroom facing the river can sometimes be quite noisy with party boats but the main bedroom and flat is peaceful.  Arthur was helpful and flexible about check out which was much appreciated :)

Appartamento bellissimo, estremamente curato e molto pulito.
Non potevamo trovare di meglio!
Geräumige Wohnung wie beschrieben und wie Fotos mit guter Anbindung an Bus und U-Bahn
Alles super!👌
Perfekt für unseren Besuch der Columbiahalle am Abend!

Super (très court) séjour !
Nous avons séjourné 2 nuits dans un quartier calme proche de divers modes de transports en communs.
Le logement était impeccable, bien décoré et comporté de nombreuses commodités : machine à café, gel douche à disposition, bureau, …
Notre hôte était très accueillant et nous à même fournis des guides de Berlin très utiles pour planifier notre visite !
Loved my stay at Nora’s place! Great part of Berlin and Nora was an excellent host :)
The stay was wonderful thank you!

Arzu and Tom were very professional in their correspondence. Checking in and out late was no problem and was greatly appreciated, it was easy as they had a friend assisting us. They had very clear instructions with regard to the house and gave us good tips about Berlin and the neighbourhood. The apartment was clean and spacious!
Would definitely come back as it is value for money as well!

Thanks guys!
I had a good time and we really enjoyed staying in the place, just the tv had no English and we couldnt understand and the electricity is bit unstable. But it didn’t bother us much.

A wonderful stay in a great flat. Well-decorated and furnished, so you can feel warmly at home. Spotless when picked up and images true to life.
The location is very convenient, and the communication with the host clear from beginning to end.
Fully recommended !
Great place to stay in Berlin. Would recommend to anyone!

Das AirBnb war genau das, was wir für unseren Aufenthalt gebraucht haben: Schön und geschmackvoll eingerichtet und wirklich sehr gut ausgestattet, uns hat es an nichts gefehlt! Die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern lief hervorragend und selbst bei kleineren Problemen (zB kaputter Wäscheständer) wurde uns direkt geholfen. Die Lage war auch super: Man konnte fußläufig alles erreichen, was man brauchte und die U-Bahn Station ist nur 2 Gehminuten entfernt. Vielen Dank für die schöne Zeit, können die Unterkunft wärmstens weiterempfehlen! :)

Ich habe ein Wochenlang Barbaras Gastfreundschaft genießen dürfen, zum ersten Mal, zurückkehren würde ich aber nun sehr gerne jeder Zeit. Ich habe mein Zimmer geliebt,  wie auch das wunderbare Frühstück in guter Gesellschaft mit ihr. Da die Wohnung sehr groß ist, ist es überraschend privat und ruhig für die Gäste da zu Wohnen. Das Badezimmer wird zwar mit den eventuellen anderen Gästen geteilt, bei mir waren es nur Bekannte von mir. Barbara war äußerst hilfreich und freundlich, alles ist sehr sauber, die Lage perfekt um die Messe Berlin schnell zu erreichen, oder die guten Restaurants in Charlottenburg. Vielen, vielen Dank nochmal und bis bald, hoffe ich. Liebe Grüße Anna

Everything was super ! The apart is lovely, tasteful, clean and well located. Stefano is great and available when/if we need.Just as a note - make sure you have a strong arms to carry luggages up the two floors - but when you do its a super cute and warm apart ! Highly recommend :)

Klein, aber fein! Alles war sauber, zweckmäßig eingerichtet und mit Liebe zum Detail (viele Tipps zum Aufenthalt in Berlin) dekoriert!
Ruhige Lage und sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung.
Wir empfehlen die Unterkunft weiter!
Berlina ist klasse ;)

Die Lage ist relativ zentral (1-2 Stationen vom Alex), man muss allerdings 10 Minuten bis zur S-Bahn laufen. Zimmer ist nett eingerichtet, Betten allerdings etwas geräuschvoll und Zimmer sehr hellhörig. :-(
So eine komische Dusche habe ich noch nicht erlebt - fixer "Duschkopf" und Temperaturregelung a la Lotterie.
Der Aufzug nervt mit seiner Langsamkeit. WLAN funktioniert stabil, allerdings auf 1-2 MBit/s gedrosselt. VPN funktioniert nicht!
Frühstück ist okay für den Preis.
Zimmerservice scheint nur Mülleimer zu leeren und Toilettenpapier nachzufüllen.

Werner is very quick and thorough in his communication.
The apartment looked exactly as depicted on the images. There was nespresso coffee already in the apartment which we loved. Werner gave us a lot of tips about the neighbourhood and within a 5 min walk we found ourselves in the tempelhof park which was great. The only thing we wished was better was a stronger wifi connection. Other than that we had a great stay!
Nice location, everything was fine :)

Sehr schön gelegene Wohnung in Berlin Mitte. U Bahn Station um die Ecke und auch die S Bahn war fußläufig gut zu erreichen.
Wir haben die Wohnung zu fünft genutzt. Haben uns als Familie darin wohl gefühlt.
Der Empfang und die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber hat einwandfrei funktioniert.
Tolle Lage zum erkunden von Berlin.
Wir können die Wohnung weiterempfehlen.
Jederzeit wieder, alles wie beschrieben. Mine ist sehr lieb und hilfsbereit.

Katharina's place was just the spot we were looking for. We had a pleasant and quite private stay, the studio is quiet, isolated and equipped with the essentials. The metro station/Checkpoint Charlie is just around the corner, there are also other lines and a train station within a 10 minutes walk.  We had a nice stay!

Piero es de los mejores anfritiones que eh tenido en Air BNB, 100% amigable, sociable y super instruido. Hemos charlado de arte, de sociedad, Piero sabe como recomendar y sobre todo la predisposicion para ayudar en todo. Volveria a su casa sin dudarlo, lamentamos dejar el apartamento, esta ubicado a 2 cuadras de alexander platz, nos llevamos un amigo con Piero y la ubicación super recomendable!!! 10 puntos todo!!

Heidi and her husband are wonderful hosts and were very helpful and are right next door if there's any issues. They even went out of their way to help us with an issue with the Wifi.
The location of the apartment is great. Most of the big attractions are within walking distance, and there is public transit and restaurants only a few blocks away, including a very cool brewery/restaurant.
The apartment itself is perfect if you plan on being out and about all day and just need somewhere to sleep and call home base. There's a coffee maker, mini fridge, and microwave, but that's it so it may be difficult if you're someone who likes to cook meals while traveling. The bathroom can get a little slippery as well as there's no raised edge to keep the water in the shower. We felt very safe there and the bed is nice and comfortable. If this is your first time traveling to Berlin and you want to be somewhere that is centrally located, I recommend this flat.

The couple was friendly but stayed very often locked in their room. The flat was clean. But the room was colder than the rest of the flat + they did not provide a real blanket, only some kinda decorative blanket and in winter it is not enough. The dog was cute and very quiet. Location was ok with transportations.

Wir waren 2 Nächte im Apple-City Hotel und waren an sich sehr zufrieden, nur als wir am ersten Tag ankamen glich das Zimmer einer Sauna, was sich bis zum nächsten Tag auch durch Ventilator oder Fenster öffnen nicht gebessert hat. Die Einrichtung des Zimmer ist klein aber fein, uns hatte nur ein kleiner Kühlschrank gefehlt, vor allem bei der Wärme. Die Lage fanden wir optimal, man läuft nur wenige Meter bis zur nächsten U-Bahn Station.
Wir hatten eine gute Zeit, für uns als Hundehalter war die Umgebung sehr schön durch das viele Grün.
Loft suficientemente habilitado y bien comunicado.Barrio tranquilo y interesante.

Very spacious flat in Berlin. Very large rooms with comfortable beds. The apartment is located in a very quiet side street but not very close to public transport stops. Construction work in the neighboring house woke us up very early in the morning during the week as the building is old and poorly soundproofed. Friendly and very accurate hosts.
Die Wohnung ist günstig gelegen, checkin war einfach. Alles war sehr sauber, die Küche gut eingerichtet. Hier würden wir gerne wieder bleiben.

Die Unterkunft war super sauber und wie beschrieben. Wir haben uns direkt wohlgefühlt und da die Wohnung im Innenhof liegt ist es auch sehr ruhig. Cool fanden wir auch die vielen unterschiedlichen "Siedler von Catan" Spiele und das Badezimmer ist richtig schön und groß! :-)
Die Lage ist ok in der direkten Umgebungen gibt es einige Kaffees und eine super leckere kleine Eismanufaktur, aber um etwas zu unternehmen und auch das "vegane Berlin" voll auszukosten, muss man schon eher nach Kreuzberg, Mitte oder Prenzlauer Berg. Um das zu tun ist aber eine U-Bahn nur wenige Minuten zu Fuß entfernt. Alles in allem hatten wir einen tollen Aufenthalt und kommen gerne wieder! :-)

Sven was great. Easy to get hold of, great communication. We had an issue with the apartment's washing machine & the machine was replaced the next day. We might have been responsible for destroying the machine??? (not sure) but Sven couldn't have been more understanding. An excellent place to stay in Berlin

Personable and accommodating host in clean, well-appointed apartment in a pleasant, unpretentious neighbourhood with great location right by trains and trams, food, and shopping. Ostkreuz station is fairly close too, putting most of the city a short transfer away. For those who want to check out Friedrichshain, it's across the street. Highly recommended!
Professionell, freundlich, top Lage, gute, klare Kommunikation. Gerne wieder!
Vse v poradku. Moc dekujeme:)

This hostel is very close to the city center, which makes it easier to move around de city. The hosts were great, very nice and always available to help with anything. The space was very cool, nicely decorated, and the rooms were spacious. One of the best hostels we’ve ever been to. Exactly how described, it was a great stay.

조용하고 미적감각이 좋은 숙소였습니다

다음 기회에 또 방문하고 싶습니다!

A beautiful apartment in a fantastic part of town. The apartment itself is in a quiet, peaceful street with a lovely little view. Within 5 minute walk there are great restaurants, shops, trams and trains. Strongly recommend.

Wonderful place to stay in Berlin. Loved my room (decor & size) the cleanliness of the whole house, and the how personable & available the host, Nico, was. The Airbnb is located in a popular area, for a reasonable price. The house is also really close to the train station, tattoo & coffee shops, boutique’s, restaurants, & parks. Kitchen is well equipped with cooking-ware and Nico will offer his espresso machine and coffee for any coffee lover out there. Highly recommend this place!

Laura ist wirklich ein Engel! Mein Aufenthalt war kurz aber toll. Lauras Wohnung ist wie ein wahres Zuhause, man fühlt sich direkt sehr wohl. Ich würde immer wieder kommen. Gerne dann auch länger ☺️
Die Gegend ist auch ein Traum. Super gut vernetzt mit der Tram. Große Empfehlung !!
Hat alles prima funktioniert. Die Gastgeberin sehr freundlich, das Zimmer absolut sauber, alles unkompliziert. Hier klopfe ich gerne wieder an, wenn ich nächstes Mal in Berlin bin.
Fantastic apartment, in a fantastic neighbourhood, with fabulous hosts.
We loved staying at Dietrich's place, Dietrich was very friendly and proactive in answering all of our questions and the flat was lovely, comfy and clean!
Max”s place was trendy and hip, & cosy warm in winter. It was easy walking to trains & trams, and not too far to the bars & cafes. I would stay here again.
Alles super, lieben Dank!!

Our stay was quite enjoyable. The apartment was very clean and close to a ton of shops and restaurants. I thought the price was excellent as well. The owner's response time was so quick and always pleasant. I definitely recommend this apartment!
Séjour au top ! Chambre très bien équipée et propres, emplacement parfait. Personnel adorable, je recommande !

This apartment at Mollstrasse 3a is perfect for a longer stay. It’s a 5 min walk to Alexanderplatz and from there you can take the U-Bahn, S-Bahn anywhere in the city. You’re right in Berlin Mitte but the residential location is quiet, so you’ll get a good rest. The layout of the apartment was great a separate kitchen/sitting area, nice sized bedroom with desk and the bathroom was tight, but sufficient. If I come to Berlin for a longer stay, I’ll definitely check availability here first. Strongly recommend!!!
Die Unterkunft war klasse! Alles ordentlich. Sehr freundliche Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin. Organisatorisch hat alles super funktioniert. Wir waren rundum zufrieden. Gerne wieder!

Clean, compact, convenient place to stay. Would recommend! The shower was the best we’ve ever had and the Ren products were gorg. We made use of the locker storage and fridge in the room. It was quiet during our stay and we weren’t disturbed. Great location for walking to cafes, restaurants, bars and public transport.

Regina is very welcoming and hospitable. Her home is perfect for either a short/long stay. The neighborhood Is amazing for someone   not looking be in the center of Berlin. Kreuzberg is accessible to all parts of the city and has a very large alternative scene. There are so many restaurants/ cafes/ bodegas within walking distance. I highly recommend this stay!

Ich hab Caroline nicht persönlich getroffen, aber Ihre Mitbewohnerin Simone. Mit Ihr habe ich mich gut verstanden und Sie konnte mir auch bei allem helfen. Daher hier auch an Simone hier ein großes Dankeschön!
Eine Sehr schöne Altbauwohnung in einer schönen Wohngegend. Gerne wieder.
An amazing stay. The photos don’t do the place justice. Wonderful ground floor apartment with a gorgeous patio. Really enjoyed my time here.
Vielen Dank Jan, es war hervorragend bei dir und ich danke dir erneut vielmals für deine schnelle Unterstützung und Hilfsbereitschaft.

One of the best value for money rooms I have stayed in! It is such a trendy apartment in a brilliant location (the bathroom in particular is amazing). The apartment is big, super clean and it takes no more than 20 minutes to get anywhere in the city due to the great public transport system. Chris is kind, respectful and a great host and the cats are adorable. I look forward to staying here again if I find myself in Berlin. I would recommend this apartment to anyone.

Super Wohnung, sauber, wenige Busstationen vom Hauptbahnhof. Die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern war perfekt, alle Infos vorab, Selbst-Check-In mittels Schlüsselbox, leicht zu finden.
Schnelles und stabiles WLAN, Wohnung entspricht exakt den Bildern, nachts ruhig trotz zentraler Lage.
Jederzeit gerne wieder!

I was very excited to stay in this place as it looked great but unfortunately I got disappointed. To start with the positive the location is good. Everything is so close with lots of cafes/restaurants etc. a few minutes walk away.
Unfortunately the apartment wasn’t clean, especially the bathroom. It felt like it hadn’t been deep cleaned in quite some time and there was a sewage smell when opening the bathroom door. I have been in communication with the host who unfortunately wasn’t able to get the apartment cleaned during our stay but initially offered some money back which was good. However, since leaving the place I haven’t received one single reply and had to get support from Air B n B management to sort this out. Such a shame as this could have easily been sorted between myself and the host.
Would not recommend unfortunately.

Bianca and Rainers place is the truest home from home you'll ever find! So light and spacious, incredibly peaceful... we felt like we really were on retreat! It's so well connected to central Berlin by train by day and see then we loved relaxing there in the early evening having a sauna and a cold plunge. :) The yard backs onto a reserve so it feels like you're truly surrounded by nature.
The place is incredibly well appointed with everything you could possibly need. Laundry room downstairs, a great kitchen, proper coffee machine with fresh beans etc. but the piece de resistance was the massive workspace upstairs with a desk chair, cable machine, yogamat and cardio machine :) my husband who works on the road was in heaven.
Bianca and Rainer are great hosts too so thoughtful even going so far as to pick us up some groceries to get us started (as we arrived on a Sunday and supermarkets are closed). Don't hesitate to book this place for a true feeling of living like a local in Berlin
Wonderful apartment in a perfect location. So easy to get anywhere in the city and close to great shopping. We would definitely look forward to staying here again.
Tabaro was very welcoming, even though I more or less just slept in the room, I felt like I was at home.

Für uns ideal gelegene wunderschöne Wohnung mit allem, was man zum Leben braucht und brauchen kann. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und danken den netten Vermietern. Wir empfehlen diese Wohnung vorbehaltlos.
Skøn lejlighed og dejlig central beliggenhed.
Bad place, we all got insects on our bodies that are not going away after visiting this basement,  dirty sheets and beds and alot of moisture since it's a basement.
Nice & clean!

L’appartement est très bien équipé et très propre. Il est situé dans un quartier sympa et facile d’accès. Parfait pour une famille avec 2 enfants ! Nous n’avons malheureusement pas pu profiter de la jolie petite terrasse car il faisait trop froid.
Andrea nous a conseillé des restaurants du quartier et les activités que nous avons pu tester et valider !
sov der 3 nætter. fint værelse og pladsen godt udnyttet til 4 personer. dejligt med et lille køkken. det var ret varmt på værelset også selvom der stod en blæser og kørte hele tiden.
Nice place.
Great stay! Everything was as expected and Victoria was a great and easy host. Would stay again!

Cristina was really nice and friendly, meeting us on arrival.
The place is nice and private, and is closely located to the metro line.
A couple of nice spots close by including a beer garden and coffee shop.

Eine wirklich toll gelegene Unterkunft mit allem was man in einer Ferienwohnung benötigen könnte! Zudem diverse Restaurants aller Geschmacksrichungen direkt vor Ort. Trotzdem in einer eher ruhigen Straße gelegen und super an den ÖPNV angebunden (2 U-Bahn-Linien und mehrere Bus-Linien). Insgesamt ein perfekter Ort für einen Berlin-Trip. Uns hat es sehr gut gefallen!

Sehr schöne, saubere und moderne Unterkunft mit allen was man braucht.
Das Personal war auch sehr hilfsbereit, gerne wieder.
Great stay as advertised. Would definitely repeat :)
vielen Dank an Brigitte für alles.

Wir waren zu 3. in der Unterkunft für 3 Nächte. Wir haben uns sofort wohl gefühlt. Die Einrichtung ist modern und sauber. Es ist alles da gewesen, was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt braucht sowohl in der Küche als auch im Bad. Da wir zu 3. waren, musste eine Person (1,78m groß) auf der Schlafcouch schlafen. Auch hier war alles super. Ohne Probleme auszuziehen und sowohl lang und breit genug um gut darauf zu schlafen.
Fußläufig ist schnell ein DM und Rewe zu erreichen für die kleineren Besorgungen zwischendrin sowie eine Apotheke.
Alles rund um spitze gewesen (:
Great host, great flat!

Das Appartement war sehr sehr sauber , liebevoll eingerichtet! Thekla ist eine sehr nette Gastgeberin, die uns mit vielen Tips den Aufenthalt sehr angenehm machte ! Wir kommen bestimmt wieder !!
Winter Petra

Thorsten's place is spacious and stylishly adorned. It is well-equipped for longer stays. The location is central and public transport is in the vicinity. Thorsten had let his neighbor Frank to pass us the key, Frank was indeed very kind and accommodating since we arrived at the night of Christmas Eve.
The balcony oversees a great view of Berlin. The whole apartment was surrounded by firework on New Year's Eve, it was unforgettable.

This is one of the best airbnbs I have stayed in. Perfect location, a wonderful Apartment and Great amenities. Boian was helpful and kind.
If I am allowed, this is where I'll always stay when in Berlin.

This place is beautiful and is exactly as advertised. The back gate literally faces the train station which is a 5-minute ride to Brandenburg Gate.  It is also on the same street as the west end of the Berlin Wall Memorial, and not to mention the abundance of food and drink nearby.  I would definitely recommend staying here, and if/when we go back to Berlin I'll check first to see if this place is available.

es tal y como se ve en las fotos . perfecto si llegas a Berlin con coche se puede dejar en la puerta sin problemas y t puedes acercar al metro en 5 minutos .
cerca de super y centro comercial
insisto en el vehículo sino queda alejado debes cojer bus y metro.
muy comodo y Jurgen t lo pone todo muy facil

Garrelt ist ein äußerst herzlicher Gastgeber. Ich habe mich sofort wohl gefühlt und sogar noch besser geschlafen als daheim ;-) Das Zimmer ist genau so wie auf den Fotos und es fehlt einem an nichts. Perfekte Location für einen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Kann ich jedem empfehlen und würde ich immer wieder buchen. Danke für alles, lieber Garrelt, auch für den Café am Morgen ;-) Bis hoffentlich ganz bald mal wieder.

The apartment is lovely and exactly how it looks in the photos. Check-in and check-out were incredibly easy. It is a cellar apartment, so be prepared to hear footsteps above, but the upstairs neighbor keeps sane hours, so it won't disturb your sleep. Within ten minutes of a couple of U-Bahn lines, but if you're tired like we were, you can get the M41 bus just up the street and take it to Hallesches Tor, where three U-Bahn lines intersect. A great location for exploring Kreuzberg.

This was an excellent place to stay. It was spacious for our needs and very comfortable. The kitchen was quite ample for our stay, although it did not have all utensils that one might need (e.g., I didn't see a peeler). Note that there is no microwave or freezer in the kitchen, which wasn't a problem for us but could matter for some people.
The access to transit was very good; many attractions were about 30 minutes away by transit. There were a number of restaurants, grocery stories, and bakeries in the neighborhood.
The temperature in the apartment was fine day and night, when highs in Berlin were in the mid-70s Fahrenheit and in the 60s at night. I don't know how it would've been during a heat wave.
We didn't really use the basement but I should note that the stairs down are extremely steep-- almost a ladder instead of stairs.

Everything matches the offer.
Smart, quick, easy and modern.
Patrick made everything straight forward, and the space was perfect for a short stay. A few minutes walk from Charlottenburg hbf.
Too expensive for what it is. Nice enough, but not worth an extra 70 euros in fees.
Schöne Altbauwohnung. Gute Lage, gute Anbindung an die U-Bahn. Gerne wieder.
Tolle Lage, netter Gastgeber, guter Ausgangspunkt für einen Berlin-Trip!

We had a lovely stay at Westhafen. Very attentive hosts with quick, helpful responses, even over the Christmas period.
The apartment was spotless and the bed was exceptionally comfortable, had the best 3 nights sleep ever! The kitchen and shower room, fully equipped with everything we needed for a short break away.
Location was superb, with no road noise, as secluded in quiet courtyard.
Highly recommend!

We stayed at Marko's apartment for a short stay in Berlin. We loved every day of it. The apartment was nicely located an we had a very warm welcome. The room was clean and included practical things as wifi, tea, cookies and showergel. We would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Berlin.
Great place. outstanding host.
Very happy with our stay.

Thor's apartment is exactly as described in the ad and even better looking than on the pictures: it is large, clean, with lots of natural light and even comes with a private bathroom (with a nice shower) for the guests! Sadly I didn't have the chance to meet Thor himself, as he was away in Norway, but I can nevertheless say that his housemate Johnny is definitely an awesome host! He is really accomodating and welcoming, pretty much always available (he works only a few steps away from the apartment) and very generous! The ‘en suite’ door to the adjacent room couldn’t be locked from my side - allowing easy access. Although the whole place seemed pretty safe regardless.
Overall, I had a wonderful stay, didn’t want to leave, and will definitely return!

Christina's place is outstanding.  I have stayed in many excellent AirBnB's through the years but none finer than this.  The apartment is bigger than it appears in the listing.   The large and comfy living  room sits at the corner of a lovely pre-war block, with a lovely view down onto the street.   The bedroom is large with french doors looking out onto a little balcony.  The kitchen is fully equipped with even a dishwasher and washer/drier.  The appliances appear very new.  The bath room includes a full sized enclosed shower.  The hot water was strong and never gave out on me.   The neighborhood was perfect for my needs which included exploring every corner of Berlin I could find.  It is a 7 minute walk to both the U-Bahn and S-Bahn stations.  Those two networks give you access to all of Berlin.   There is a great bakery just 3 minutes away and an excellent (and inexpensive) Italian restaurant just beyond that.   The flat was absolutely spotless and the building silent.  I never heard a single sound from any neighbor.  And Christiane was an excellent communicator.  Bottom line:  the is as good as it gets in Berlin.  I hope to be back in the spring.   Thank you Christiane!

The only thing that took the edge off for us was that the apartment was really very warm, and it was difficult to sleep without the windows open (and shutters mostly down); this then meant that some noise from neighbours kept us awake or woke us on a few occasions when we weren't still awake because of the heat. The boiler for the whole building is apparently below the apartment (and no fan or Aircon). I don't know if perhaps in the winter this would be a good selling point or if in summer the boiler isn't on, but at Easter (temp mid-teens to low 20s) it was very difficult to sleep.

Die Wohnung selbst ist gemütlich eingerichtet. Die Sauberkeit der gesamten Wohnung ließ keine Wünsche offen.
Der Gastgeber war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Schon vor der Anreise erhielten wir klare Anweisungen zur Schlüsselübergabe, und während unseres Aufenthalts gab es immer schnelle Antworten auf Fragen.
Insgesamt kann ich diese Ferienwohnung uneingeschränkt empfehlen. Wer eine gemütliche, gepflegte und ruhige Unterkunft in Berlin sucht, ist hier genau richtig!
Die Wohnung  ist sehr schön und gut gelegen. Vor allem der Check-In war super.

Beautiful apartment in a very cool and convenient location. It is even bigger than it seems on the photos, awesome interiors, beautifully decorated. You got everything you need, totally equipped, even a cool sound system. I rented a lot on Airbnb and this was by far the best value for price I got so far. 5 Stars indeed!

Die Wohnung ist okay für ein Wochenendtrip o.ä.
Allerdings ist sie definitiv weniger schön und sauber als auf den Fotos. Das Badezimmer ist klein, nicht besonders sauber und schimmelig.

TempelCasa is perfectly located in Kreuzberg, one block from the Landwehrkanal and a couple of blocks away from some of the main shopping streets. The street it is on is very quiet, with bus and U-Bahn stops close by. The apartment itself is immaculately clean and well-appointed. The mattress on the bed is great- I have seldom slept so soundly. The wifi worked perfectly and the tv reception was excellent.
Alexander was very responsive to any questions or problems we had. For example, the stovetop didn't work and he called an electrician right away. There are a couple of things to be aware of about TempelCasa: 1.) Hand soap is provided in the bathroom, but you should bring your own shampoo and bath soap, and 2.) Because the apartment is semi-subterranean, you won't get a lot of daylight coming into the apartment. The windows have translucent blinds on them, though, and privacy is no problem. Tipping the windows open provides plenty of fresh air.
In summary, we really enjoyed staying in this apartment and would do so again.

Tolle Unterkunft für einen guten Preis! Leider merkt man das die Unterkunft bereits älter ist…
Das Bad hat einen komischen Geruch und die Toiletten-Spülung hat nicht ganz zu 100% funktioniert.
Für 2 Nächte hat es aber gereicht zu 4. :)

The apartment is spacious and comfortable for 6pax. Practically all items are brand new such as beds, comforters, pillows and home appliances. Having 2 comfort rooms make our mobility faster. No line on taking the shower. Location is very close to supermarket and bus stop. Across the street is a very good Italian resto. Highly recommended!
Lovely apartment, you had your own private space. Walkable from the station to get into the centre. Easy going hosts that were extremely helpful, I would highly recommend!
Eine schöne kleine Wohnung, noch alles sehr neu eingerichtet und sauber, die S Bahn ist gleich in der Nähe und der Stadtteil Steglitz ist sehr schön,
Es war gut :)

The apartment is as it looks in the photos and is only a 5 min walk to Ostkreuz station. Plenty of places to eat and drink and there is also a supermarket across the road. The facilities were good with enough pans, cutlery, toaster etc to be able to cook fairly simple meals. Agnes was great at communicating and sent very clear instructions as to how to gain access to the apartment. She had very recently had a new Bluetooth lock installed, which was easy to use and meant that there was no need to take keys out with you when you left the apartment.
Would recommend.

Путешествовали вдвоём с женой. Заблаговременно забронировали жильё, связались с Кристиной уже непосредственно перед отъездом. Хозяйка отвечала быстро и на все вопросы. Инструкция по заселению полностью понятна и доступна для всех. В студии очень уютно, достаточно места для двух человек. В квартире очень чисто, присутствуют различные гели для душа, шампуни, бальзамы для волос, зубная паста разного вида и тд. На кухне приятный тёплый приём с различными сладостями, это очень кстати , когда позади долгий путь. В квартире имеется все, разная кухонная утварь, бытовые приборы и др.
Мы очень рады, что выбрали такое жилье и так сильно повезло с хозяйкой. Нисколько не жалеем и всем рекомендую Кристину. Спасибо за все!
Świetne miejsce – czysto, ładnie i przyjemnie. Apostolos to wspaniały gospodarz, zawsze pomocny i kontaktowy. Zdecydowanie polecam.
The host is very helpful and friendly. The room is just what you may need and the location is great. A very good option if travelling to Berlin

Was great to have a private apartment for a week. Felt very private, never bothered by anyone, and after a couple of days of letting myself in and out, it kinda felt like I lived in Berlin...kinda. Bad points were: (drumroll) it was insanely noisy due to it's location. Constant sirens night and day and beeping traffic. I didn't know this before booking but honestly, I got used to it eventually. The bed sheets weren't dirty but they didn't smell fresh either. As they don't operate like a hotel I had to take them to the laundry. Walls and parts of the bathroom were a bit grubby and the shower gel was almost empty. All combined it doesn't give you the impression that they could easily make this a 5-star-worthy spot if they put a bit more effort into the upkeep. The reception guy was friendly and accommodating letting me check in early. All in all I would probably stay somewhere else next time
Super Kommunikation, schnelle Rückmeldung, unkompliziert und angenehm.

Ich habe vier Nächte in der WG von Oli verbracht und mich gleich wohl gefühlt. Auch wenn Oli selbst nicht vor Ort war, wurde ich freundlich von den Mitbewohnern empfangen und hätte bei Fragen jederzeit einen Ansprechpartner gehabt. Das Zimmer ist ohne nötigen Schnick-Schnack und ich habe in einem großen, bequemen Bett geschlafen. Ich empfehle Ohropax einzupacken, da schon in den frühen Morgenstunden reger Anlieferverkehr vor dem Fenster zu hören ist. Mich hat es nicht weiter gestört. Der Görlitzer Park und viele Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind direkt vor der Tür. Optimal. Ich kann Olis WG sehr empfehlen und komme gerne wieder :)

We were two adults and three kids (14,15,18) staying for three nights. We found the place larger than anticipated, and the ceiling was up in the sky. I’d say you could stay 9-10 people there, so with a gang of five, it was really luxurious. Everyone was happy with the beds. Lots of cutlery (but only two tee spoons), pots and pans. Many small food places outside the gate, and a metro stop straight on your left hand side.
One the minus side:
* That you couldn’t cover the indoor windows between the rooms (not that you could ever reach that far, far, far up to look in from one room to the other, more of a lamp vs darkness matter in the evenings/mornings, as not only your own room shines up)
* No cupboard for your groceries
* The check-in process including having to sign a multi pages long contract, upload a copy of your ID/passport, late check in and early check out, and extremely short cancellation terms.
With all this said, we were very happy with our stay and would recommend it
Waldemar was a great host. he was very friendly and communicated very well. his flat was in a great location , would 100% stay again :)
Stefan was a friendly and welcoming host. I recommend fully!
Abdallah ist ein sehr netter Host Unterkunft ist sehr sauber und gepflegt. Ich komme gerne wieder. :)
Einfach , sauber , unkompliziert, gerne wieder :)

El alojamiento está perfectamente acondicionado. Es exactamente como se describe.
El barrio es muy tranquilo y está bien comunicado con el centro.
Todo genial

We hebben een fijn verblijf gehad. Net appartement, rustig. Het ligt in een wijk waar woongebouwen, grote winkelstraten en kleine eettentjes en cafeetjes elkaar afwisselen. Het is een rustige locatie. Fietsen worden een paar deuren verder verhuurd. U-en S-bahn zijn op loopafstand.

We absolutely loved this apartment and neighborhood. Gary and Andreas went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed, help us discover the hidden gems of Berlin, and ensure that we had everything we needed. This is one of the best AirBnB’s we’ve ever stayed in, and we’ll most certainly look to stay here again when we come back in the future.
Quartier génial, beau grand appartement, chambre spacieuse et bien aménagée.
Freundlicher Host und schöne Wohnung! Gerne mal wieder :)

Appstolos is a super nice guy, he explained everything upon arrival. The apartment is bigger than I thought based off of the pictures and included everything one could need while on vacation.
The location is perfect. Overall amazing.

We really enjoyed our stay. The communal lounge/dinning area had a great little play area that our 3 year old enjoyed.
Staff were friendly and helpful.
The location was perfect for getting the tram and trains around Berlin to see the sights.
Thomas fue muy atento y siempre contestó a mis mensajes rápidamente. El departamento es muy luminoso, es muy cómodo y está muy bien ubicado. Volvería sin dudas!

Aliaas apartment is beautifully decorated, very cosy and with a perfect location. I travelled with my family and the apartment was perfect for three people. Aliaa is very helpful and responds fast. I wish to come back for another stay.
Alles super, würde ich jederzeit wieder buchen! ☺️
Very spacious apartment in a nice location.

Vom Gehsteig geht es direkt (ohne Flur) in die 1-Zimmer-Wohnung. Scheint früher ein Ladengeschäft gewesen zu sein. Die Wohnung war sauber und nett eingerichtet. Bad sehr schön.
Die Küche ist klein und zweckmäßig. Auf dem Herd mit zwei Kochplatten lässt sich - auch wegen der beschränkten, aber ausreichenden Kochutensilien - wahrscheinlich kein 5-Gänge-Menü kochen. Waschmaschine in der Küchenzeile.
Die Gastgeber haben sich bei der Ausstattung Mühe gegeben. Neben einem Ordner mit Berlin-Tipps finden sich auch Spiele, etwas Lesestoff, ein Bügelbrett und Kleinkinderequipment.
Gute Lage: Tram Station 100 m (Alex ca. 15 min + x), Bäckerei gegenüber, Spätkauf 50 m (auch So.abend geöffnet), großer Edeka in wenigen Gehminuten
Wir haben uns wohlgefühlt und können die Unterkunft guten Gewissens weiterempfehlen.
Needed to give it a try ,, you will enjoy it
Ashraf ist ein sehr netter und unkomplizierter Gastgeber, der Check in war super, die Wohnung hat alles, was man braucht. Gerne wieder!

We had pleasure moments. Near to three markets and s-bahn. The place was nice, clean and safe.
The wash and dry machines worked well and helped us a lot.
When necessary, all responses were quick.

Eine schöne Wohnung, die alles bietet, was man für ein paar Tage in Berlin benötigt. Unkomplizierter Check-in und sauber.
Mit den Öffis ist man im Nu an allen wichtigen Orten, parken ist eben wie in jeder Großstadt von der Uhrzeit abhängig.
Es ist jedoch innerhalb der Wohnung etwas hellhörig, wenn man noch im "Wohnzimmer" quatscht und jemand versucht zu schlafen.
ansonsten war das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis stimmig und ich kann mir vorstellen noch einmal hier einzuchecken!

Tilman was an exceptional host. Really felt like a home away from home. His place is located less than a block away from the street car stop, which runs very efficiently in Berlin. He is also located in a neighborhood with a plethora of food options. My fiancee and I really were able to take full advantage of seeing the city because of these things. If you are planning to book his place, it is probably best to pack light as there are lots of stairs. Other than that, I had zero complaints

Pésimo servicio, nunca volvería acá, en primer lugar me cancelaron la reserva porque supuestamente “no llegué el día que correspondía “, (siendo que hice el check in online como ellos dicen) además, en su perfil aparece que se puede llegar después de la media noche y ellos “atenderían”. FALSO, llegue a las 01 de la madrugada y no me dejaron entrar, además me dicen que están sin disponibilidad.
Informé esta situación al equipo de Airbnb y aún no responden (EastSeven) para solucionar este problema. Además EastSeven indica que alguien con mi nombre ya se registró y estaba en la lista, sin embargo yo nunca entré a la habitación. En conclusión aparte de no respetar sus mismas reglas son mentirosos, por su inoperancia, ineficacia y poco compromiso, estuve en las calles de Berlín en la madrugada buscando un hostal con disponibilidad.

Denitsa’s apartment is very spacious and nicely equipped and clean. We stayed there with 3 people and it was well enough space. I slept in the double bed and it was very very comfortable. I also liked the location, it’s close to a lot of restaurants and cafés, but still the noise was not really loud inside. Thanks for hosting us, we enjoyed our stay!
Sehr empfehlenswerte und schöne Unterkunft. Total ruhig am Waldrand gelegen. Ideal, um dem stress des Alltags zu entkommen.

Lage und Tipps im Heft (vorallem Food-Tipps) waren optimal!
Check-in auch sehr einfach!
One of my favorite airbnb stays yet! such a lovely space. Comfortable and beautiful.  would definitely stay again.
Alles super!

fijne ruimte als uitvalsbasis en om in thuis te komen. In Rixdorf zelf zitten een paar fijne café's.
alles goed:)

Mein Mann und ich hatten einen sehr schoenen Aufenthalt in Berlin und wir haben uns in Kathys Wohnung sehr wohl gefuehlt. Die Wohnung ist geraeumig und es gibt alles, was man braucht. Das Haus mit der Wohnung befindet sich in einer ruhigen Strasse, die S-Bahn-Station sowie eine nette Einkaufsstrasse mit Geschaeften aller Art, Cafes und ein paar Restaurants sind beuem zu Fuss zu erreichen. Fuer uns war es ein guter Ausgangspunkt fuer unsere Aktivitaeten in Berlin. Die Kommunikation war sehr gut und die Gastgeber sind sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Sehr freundlich zuvorkommend und zuverlässig. Gerne jederzeit wieder!
The apartment was great, amazing space. Art was really welcoming and helpful, recommending some great local places to eat. Already looking forward to visiting again!
Great stay. Good communication and nice apartment.

Très bel appartement neuf et décoré avec style dans un quartier vivant (toutes commodités à proximité). Nous n'avons pas rencontré Karolina mais elle était très présente malgré tout et répondait rapidement à nos demandes.
Nous recommandons cet appartement
Everything was great.

Ina’s apartment was a very comfortable stay in a very good location, conveniently located between Kreuzberg and the centre of Berlin. The garden alone is worth it, as it catches the sun in the afternoon and is perfect for a Berlin summer. Recommended!

This is a lovely spacious and functional flat. The flat was very clean and well kept - with all the basics you would need. It is right by the metro so you can easily access central Berlin. Jorg was very accommodating when we arrived late.
Das Zimmer ist gross, hell und sehr sauber. Der Check in verlief reibungslos und Amir ist immer offen für Fragen und schreibt schnell zurück.

We had a great stay at Bernd’s place and would definitely stay there again if we ever go back to Berlin.
Great location with a 3 minute walk to public transport with a lot of awesome local cafes and restaurants minutes away. The place is nice and clean exactly as pictured and Bernd is a great host . We had a late check in and he was so kind and came up with a solution for us.
The large balcony was a plus and we enjoyed the nice weather and the beautiful views there.
I definitely recommend this place to whoever likes to stay at a comfortable and clean place, you won’t regret.

Was exact zoals omschreven, alles wat je nodig had was aanwezig. De communicatie met de host liep goed!
Veel plezier in Berlijn!

Entspricht den Beschreibungen und Bildern. Top Lage.
Allerdings ist es der Inbegriff der Hellhörigkeit, Ohrenstöpsel sind absolute Pflicht!

Location is top and worth considering if you want to be everywhere at the same time.
The place itself is pretty good for a short time, but if you need longer stay, consider not too convenient kitchen and bathroom. When it’s hot outside, inside is quite cool which is a big advantage. The host is nice and responsive, so can recommend it and will not hesitate to book again.

This Airbnb is in the perfect location! Lots of restaurants around and lots of trains that take you anywhere in Berlin! Apartment was good for a weekend trip! Was clean and had everything you need for a short period of time! Would recommend. Check in super easy.

Extremely happy with our stay. Lovely apartment that felt very safe. Beautiful, spacious and clean. Within walking distance of everything worth seeings. We had a great stay and would recommend this stay to anyone.
Great location. Basic accommodation but worth it for the view and the location was perfect
Michael is a charming host and really joyful and always helpful. I had a great stay, really convenient place.

Es ist eine super große Wohnung mit sehr guten Betten. Man kann toll mit 4 Erwachsenen dort übernachten und die Schlafzimmer sind auch nicht direkt nebeneinander. Sehr geschmackvolle Einrichtung, wo man sich gleich wohlfühlen kann. Es war extrem sauber. Die Lage ist top und sehr leise in einem tollen Hinterhof von einem alten restauriertem Haus, sehr schick.

Very nice apartment to stay in Berlin mitte with a group. It is much better that shown on pictures, in a residential new building and with a perfect location :) I would just upgrade the sofa beds, specially the one in the living room, it has a sort of division so uncomfortable to the back.
Vladimir was always in contact and answering my questions, we never see each other since it was self check-in. Thank you for everything.
Very easy check-in, stylish room, and impeccable structure made our stay great. Clear instructions and beautiful refurbishment created a very welcome experience. Highly recommend!

Etienne's place is very cozy and I would recommend it mostly to single travelers or couples. The apartment is put together very well both design and function wise. Even though it is located on the top floor, it wasn't very hot thanks to a big fan. Putting the blinds down also helps big time during a hot day. For some the lack of a kitchen might be an issue but we never found ourselves missing any appliances apart from maybe a microwave. The apartment is still equipped with an electric kettle and a nespresso machine. Despite having Etienne and Judit right next door, you have a lot of privacy and it doesn't hurt having the hosts close when you need something. Connection to public transport is perfect, with a tram stop right around the corner. Five different tram lines stop here so you can get anywhere you want quite easily. An S-bahn station is a short walk away.
Great and very original accommodation!

Optimale Lage, tolles Zimmer, gut ausgestattet. Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt.
Der Aufenthaltsbereich mit kleinem Späti ist auch klasse :)

Loved staying at this cute and bright sunlit apartment right opposite Tempelhof field. The light and windows are better than the photos! ☀️
The place is cosy and convenient and spacious. I will try and book it again when I come back to Berlin for a work trip.
Es ist eine super Lage und die Wohnung ist so groß und super eingerichtet. Ich komme auf jeden Fall wieder.
Gemütlich und perfekt

Очень хорошая и чистая квартира. Хороший хозяин, встретил и помог с заселением. В некоторых моментах пошёл на встречу. Прекрасный район. До метро 5-7 минут пешком. Кофейни, магазины прямо возле дома. До центра на метро минут 20.
Очень чисто и стильно. Спасибо:)

I would stay here again in a heart beat. Such a spacious room, in the most glorious part of town. So easy to get to, so quiet. Flore was a gorgeous host and so easy and generous. Such good value for money!
Super liebe Familie :) Gepflegtes Haus !
Super Wohnung, sehr sauber, groß mit Blick auf den Tiergarten und die Siegessäule. Super zentral. Sehr zu empfehlen.

The location was good about this place as it was only about a 30 minute walk from the city centre which was great. However place itself had issues from the beginning. There was no toilet paper, it was dirty and the bathroom bin had not been emptied. We sent the host a message about this and were refunded some money and he organised a cleaner however the house was still dirty.
Other issues we found with the place was that the shower was clogged with previous tenants hair and my partner had to unclog it himself. There was also no salt or oil as stated that there was, the kettle had mould inside it and the TV controller was not working so we couldn’t watch TV.
After our stay we tried messaging the host about these issues but were not met with a response which was extremely disappointing.
Gute Unterkunft im Zentrum

Great apartment and fully equipped with everything we needed. Great for families since it has 2 toilets. Internet Speed was very good and I was able to work from there with no problems.
The location is very central and there is a supermarket around the corner. The underground can take you anywhere in Berlin
We also used the parking and there is a nice gym in the building that you can use anytime.
The host is very nice and responsive . I extended my stay 2 times for personal reasons and the host was supportive.

ホストのClaraさんは、とても人の良いホストさんで、お休みにも拘らず、必要なことがあれば、直ぐに対応して下さいました。
ここのお家は、ベルリン中央駅から徒歩10分ととても便利なローケーションで、更には、経済環境省、フンボルト大学やCharité 医科大学のキャンパス、フンボルト博物館に囲まれた、アカデミックなエリアで、週末は毎週キャンパスで、4週間の滞在中のんびり散歩させて戴いました。
国家議事堂やブランデンブルク門まで徒歩20分足らずでドイツの中枢機関にも近いです。
お薦めは入場無料のFuturiumと言う未来を考えた博物館も徒歩10分、4週間の滞在中4回も訪問させて戴きました。日本の方には、森鴎外記念館博物館も徒歩10分、兎に角このアカデミックなエリアで二重ドアでとても静かなこのお家は私にとっては最高のお家でした。
また、ベルリンに来るならここのお家を選びますね。
The apartment is simply the best, all you need you can find in the apartment. Very modern nice decorated. I highly recommend.

Everything was perfect. This truly is the perfect place to stay while in Berlin. Close to public transport, large spacious space, unbelievably clean, extremely kind and courteous hosts. Everything you could need is provided. If this place is available, I will always consider this place first when traveling to Berlin.

Bea’s place is nice and clean. The room is really big and cozy. The area/location is really nice too. Bea is an amazing host; easy going, helpful, friendly, kind and i always felt comfortable. I highly recommend staying at Bea’s place :)!
Great place, exactly as described.
great location
Super schön
Casa pulita e accogliente. Johannes disponibile e cordiale.
Wir waren hier glücklich und zufrieden :), insbesondere die schöne Lage hat es für uns ausgemacht.

Pasamos unos días estupendos en el apartamento de Lina. Nos recibió a nuestra llegada aunque todavía no era la hora del check in.  Nos dio todas las instrucciones de funcionamiento del apartamento, los sitios de parada de buses y estaciones del metro cerca del apto., restaurantes y comercios. Quiero agradecer a Lina ya que mi esposa dejo el celular en el apto. y ya habíamos partido a otro país. Conversamos con ella y enviamos a un amigo a recoger el teléfono y muy amablemente se lo entrego. En conclusión recomendamos ampliamente a esta anfitriona con su apartamento.

I am happy that i choose that kind of place. As an woman i didn't had a problem to sleep in an room with 9 other men, but for other i guess it would be a problem. I wanna say its a really nice place and the price i cheap. 😊

Die Wohnung ist gut mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen. Sie ist geräumig und ruhig. Die Wohnung liegt im hinteren Gebäude und man muss einige Türen aufschließen. Kommunikation war sehr gut

i strongly recommend staying at pascal's apartment! it was cozy and clean, with every amenity you could need to have a nice stay in berlin. there are a few grocery stores within walking distance and is well connected to other parts of the city.
Tudo perfeito

We absolutely loved this apartment. It was really close to transport and 2 mins away from a super market for getting daily essentials ( including fresh croissants and rolls 😊)
Don’t worry about the graffiti all around - seems to be everywhere in Berlin!
I had some queries re housekeeping and Simon responded promptly each time.
There’s a tablet in the kitchen which has lots of useful information.
My husband was blown away by the number of power outlets everywhere (10 in our bedroom!)
The decor is minimal and elegant with marvellous high ceilings.
Lots of eco features re amenities, but it was still lovely and warm.
For transport to and from the airport, it was only 3,80euros on Ubahn & train and really easy to navigate. ( double decker trains, who knew!)
We wouldlove to stay here again in the future. ( Our apartment had an outside sitting area which would be lovely in the spring/summer )
Thank you BenSimon for making my husband’s 60th, and son’s 30th birthday trip so comfortable 😀

Notre séjour chez Maciej s'est très bien passé. Maciej a été gentil et réactif, il nous a fait de bonnes recommandations. il a été très amical et accueillant.
Le logement est très bien situé dans Berlin, dans un quartier sympathique et bien relié au reste de la ville en transport.
Nous recommandons chaudement ce logement !
Sehr freundliche Gastgeber! Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und wurde herzlich in der WG aufgenommen.

The apparent is awesome! It has enough space and everything that is needed for a comfy stay. Everything was clean and spotless.
The host is very friendly and supportive, helped us to check in and showed everything in and around the place.
Alles was netjes en de communicatie verliep buitengewoon snel

Ein super schönes Apartment direkt um die Ecke einer Ubahn-Station. Leider war das Apartment noch nicht geputzt, als wir eingecheckt haben und wir mussten dann noch eine Stunde auf die Putzfee warten, bevor wir tatsächlich einchecken konnten. Das war sehr schade. Ansonsten lief aber alles super und wir würden immer wieder gerne dieses Inserat buchen!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment! Everything was perfect — the place was clean, comfortable, and very welcoming. The check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow, which made the whole process smooth and stress-free. The apartment had everything we needed and was exactly as described. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay. Would definitely come back!

The apartment, large and well kept, is located in a cool area. Lots of restaurants and shops. The subway is one minute away by foot.  The only bad thing is the check-in and check out times: 4pm and 10pm respectively. Too late and too early. Guys it's roughly 6/7 hours pinched from our stay in total. Improve that and everybody will be happy

A very fun, eclectic, and enormous loft. Tom and Alex are lovely. Very hospitable and their restaurant recommendations are spot on.
We’d stay here again should we return.
casa pulita e in una posizione molto centrale, host molto disponibile

Die Unterkunft bei Jan war echt toll!
Eine kleine Oase im Trubel der Großstadt.
Wer nach einem aufregendem und hektischem Tag in der Hauptstadt etwas Ruhe und Entspannung sucht ist bei Jan genau richtig.
Das kleine Appartment im Hinterhof bittet Dir die Möglichkeit wieder ein bisschen "runterzufahren" und in den netten Cafes und Restaurants in der Nähe wieder neue Kräfte zu tanken.
Ich freue mich schon auf den nächsten Besuch.
Bra lägenhet med allt man behöver.

The apartment was really good and exactly as the pictures on the listing, located in a quiet part of te city and really close to public transport stops. The communication with Pascal was easy and with quick responses during my stay, definitely would recommend the place.

Stefanie's place is beautiful, comfortable and convenient to all transportation.

If you're hoping to be across the street from the Brandenburg Gate and other tourist attractions, you'll need to pony up and spend 50% more. As others have said, there are tons of darling shops and cafes within a 3-minute walk. My favorite part of the flat was the little balcony where I could have my evening wine.
