Excellent. Lovely house, and great communication, even though I arrived an hour earlier than anticipated. Would highly recommend
Great place in a great neighborhood ! Quiet, warm & cosy !

Great place for a short or longer stay. Everything you need is there, in the apartment. Perfect location to explore the whole city. Four supermarkets (!) within walking distance, including a biological supermarket. Communication with the host was smooth and easy

Die Unterkunft ist sehr geschmackvoll ausgestattet und wir waren sehr zufrieden.  Sehr netter Vermieter,  der Zugang zur Unterkunft völlig unkompliziert . Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und kommen gerne wieder.

I rented Michael's place for my mother, who was visiting me in Berlin, and it made her stay super enjoyable and comfortable. You feel instantly at home in this charming room, and spotless bathroom & kitchen.
Estuvo todo bien. Felicitaciones a la recepcionista brasilera, que fue encantadora con nosotros. El baño es muy chico pero todo funciona bien
Es war alles wie es für anspruchsvolle Menschen zu sein hatte!

You could not find a better place to stay in Berlin than Kinga's! Great neighborhood just about a 20minute walk to Museum Island....lots of nice personal touches, very quiet and an extremely comfortable bed!
Interesting place in a quite district of one-floor houses.
gute  Lage, gute Kommunikation, sehr empfehlenswert :)

Die Buchung lief, trotz dass wir sehr spontan gebucht haben, völlig ohne Probleme. Wir waren für eine Nacht in dem AirBnb und waren sehr zufrieden. Die Wohnung sah aus wie auf den Bilder beschrieben…Klein aber fein. Das Olympiastadion liegt nur 20 Gehminuten entfernt, eignet sich also für alle die dort ein Event besuchen.

Für uns in der perfekten Lage, easy check in und check out.
Ordentliche Wohnung, sauber und warm im Winter.
Very good apartment for the week-end
Very cute and clean apartment. Felt like a home away from home and in a very convenient area public transport wise. Great kitchen and heating !!

Such a peaceful stay in Templehof! Ania and Sebastian and their two kids are great hosts— so quiet I slept like a baby! Very comfortable bed and lovely private room. Close to a nice park, easy walking area, perfect for my stay. Will book again!

My teen daughters and I had a wonderful stay in Thomas' beautiful, very cool, and very well/generously appointed maisonette. It's close to markets, pharmacy, the tram, and the immediate neighborhood has interesting boutiques and many vegetarian restaurants! It's really a perfect location if you're visiting Berlin and want to be able to stay close but far enough away to get a good night's sleep from the hubub in the more touristy areas. I hope to be back in the not-to-distant future!
Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen, die Sauna ist großartig und man hat viel Privatsphäre. Thomas ist überaus freundlich und hilfsbereit, uns hat es an nichts gefehlt.

I stayed at Claudia's for two months.
It's in Moabit in a quiet and safe area. As a young woman travelling solo this was very important for me.
Conveniently located close to a bus stops and a tram which can take you all over Berlin.
Great café next door and a mall that's only a 10 minute walk away.
Everything I needed to live comfortably in Berlin for two months was available.
Claudia was extremely responsive and willing to help with any questions or concerns I had.
The apartment was a lot more spacious than I had expected which was a plus.
Overall, great value for the price!
An absolute pleasure to stay in, Felix and Lisa are very kind and helpful hosts.

Mein dreimonatiger Aufenthalt im grosszügigen Zimmer bei Constantin habe ich rundum genossen und ich würde ohne zu zögern sofort wieder bei ihm buchen.
Die Wohnung ist superzentral gelegen im lebendigen Kreuzberg und doch total ruhig. Bei den vielen Eindrücken dieser Grossstadt bot mir mein Zuhause bei Constantin immer den perfekten Rückzugsort.
Die liebevoll eingerichtete Wohnung und der grosse Innenhof, welcher direkt an die Spree grenzt und mitbenutzt werden darf, bieten eine wahre Wohlfühloase. In dem gemütlichen Zimmer habe ich mich von Beginn an wohl gefühlt. Auch die Küche und das Wohnzimmer, welche gemeinsam genutzt werden, bieten alles was man braucht.
Constantin ist ein super sympathischer, hilfsbereiter und unkomplizierter Mitbewohner. Grundsätzlich lebt und kocht jeder für sich und bei Gelegenheit besteht die Möglichkeit zu spannendem Austausch und interessanten Gesprächen.
Herzlichen Dank für den perfekten Aufenthalt, ich komme gerne wieder.
Mike's responses were very fast, there were many supermarkets and cleaning services nearby as well as good links to the centre on the train service.
Great, friendly and helpful host. Nice, bright, clean room. Would stay again with no hesitation.
Mariarosa muy amable. El lugar está muy bien comunicado.

Super comfy stay in a very quiet area in Berlin with lots of cafes and restaurant/take out places around.
Fully equipped kitchen with a very nice seating area and balcony.
The bed was super comfy and the bathroom had a great shower and was spotlessly clean!
All in all a Great experience for staying a few nights in Berlin!
Die Wohnung war sauber, gemütlich und ideal gelegen. Dagmar war freundlich und hilfsbereit.

L'appartement est très pratique, central et joliment décoré ! Henrik a été très disponible et l'accueil super chaleureux même si nous ne l'avons pas vu à cause de notre retard. Un grand merci, et vous êtes le bienvenue à Bordeaux !

Super schöne Unterkunft- perfekt für einen Städtetrip nach Berlin! Susanne war sehr lieb, aufgeschlossen und hat das Zimmer süß eingerichtet. Es war alles da, was man braucht. Ebenfalls eine tolle Umgebung, viele schöne Restaurants, Cafes, Bares und viele Lädchen zum Stöbern! Wir kommen gerne wieder. Eine absolute Herzensempfehlung von uns :)

Lola’s place is in the perfect location as it’s in a trendy area and it is easy to get to the centre. The apartment is as beautiful as it looks in the photos, and whenever we had any issues the host made sure it was quickly solved. All in all we had a great stay!
Een rustige locatie. Basisvoorzieningen. Dicht bij openbaar vervoer, dus snelle verbinding naar het centrum van de stad.

amazing stay - perfect location. quick and easy check in
communication was amazing and we had a lovely time

Nice place, as seen in photos, clean and tidy, well organised, would recomend.
Public transportation at convenient distance (max 10min walk)
Even if the host is in the house, your privacy is guarantied.
check in war sehr einfach und ging einwandfrei. leider gab es keine kostenlose parkplätze wie bescheieben aber sonst war der rest makellos
Nice location, very cosy and  well designed apartment. Clean and well equipped. Communication was easy. What more do you want? Perfect!
Très bel appartement, propre, bien équipé et bien situé. L'accueil est très sympathique, et Werner parle très bien le français, ce qui est très appréciable. Merci à lui.

Lucia is a great host and made us feel right at home. We arrived later than expected and she was still there to welcome us. The house has all you need in a nice neighborhood! The only little thing that woke us up earlier than we would’ve liked was constructions in and around the building. I’d love to stay here again and would recommend to anyone that wants to stay in Neukölln!
alles gut, gerne wieder
amazing place to stay!!

This is the place to stay while you are in Berlin! Enrique went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed for a good stay, including detailed instructions on how to get to his place and hand made walking maps for his suggested tours of the city. The area was safe and quiet and his place was absolutely wonderful. So many touches to make us comfortable and welcomed. Highly suggest!
the apartment is nice, the decor is very feminine and delicate. Clean and comfortable.  Good location.
Waren sehr zufrieden,  kann man weiter empfehlen

Nice hotel, good atmosphere, bar downstairs/ sometimes open as a restaurant. The bed “furniture” is interesting so fine for 1 person to get into bed but second person would have to kind of climb in as they cannot get in from the side. Great shower, separate toilet and a lot of counter space! Mini bar was good too and reasonably priced. I’d stay again :)
El departamento es muy lindo y estaba impecable!

Absolutely great location, handy to everything, the apartment is light and airy with good space and all requisite appliances and more.  It is in Berlin so there needs to be acceptance that it is on the 3rd floor and there are stairs to cope with.  Overall I highly commend the host Albert and his property.

El alojamiento de Jana es excelente, cumple con todo lo que dice la publicacion. Nos gusto mucho el barrio, que no es centrico pero esta bien conectado, y los vecinos son amigables, intentaron ayudarnos para ubicar al anfitrion al momento de la llegada, que no fue facil. Lo recomendamos y volveriamos a alojarnos aqui.
Will definetly come back to Numa!
The place is as advertised apart from the kitchen which I believe was under renovations. Close to public transport and supermarket. Parwana even allowed us to stay a little longer on check out day.
Nejlevnější ubytování v Berlíně,  hostel je  velice hezký, dobře vybavený, bar a recepce 24/7

L’appartement est conforme à l’annonce . Propre , bien situé et calme . Literie confortable.
Seul bémol : le volet roulant est tombé en panne le mardi matin et sommes restées sans lumière du jour pendant 2 jours jusqu’à notre départ .
Alessa a , à priori, fait le nécessaire mais personne n’est intervenu.
Je n’en tiens pas compte sur ma note globale.
Very nice and cosy apartment

Wow, Matthias’s place is one of the best airbnb experiences we’ve had! First of all, the apartment is stunning—high design combined with a relaxed vibe. We really loved spending time in the apartment. The bed and pillows were definitely the best we’ve had while traveling, and the bathroom was spotless. Matthias was always ready with answers to our questions and suggestions. Honestly, we felt very taken care of. The location is walkable to Museum Island and many other sights. And the Berlin Wall Memorial is just down the road. So much to see and absorb in this fascinating city! We will definitely stay at Matthias’s place when we return to Berlin. Highly recommend!

Rochus is a wonderful host. He is really helpful and kind. We loved our stay in his beautiful house.  We can definitely recommend a stay at Rochus. He was so nice to make breakfast for us, we felt at home. It's not the last time we visit Berlin and Rochus.
Great place and host - we’ll be back.

Appartement spacieux avec pièce principale agréable. Calme. Propre. Bien situé, central, proche des transports publics.
Note surprenante : la douche est dans la cuisine.
Cuisine limitée en équipements : pas assez de mug, de bols.
Nous n'avons pas rencontré Jonas mais son "amie" qui fait le ménage est très sympathique.
Stayed twice. Room was hot and loud on Saturday. Shower ridiculous. No interaction with host. Location excellent

Appartement wie beschrieben, sauber, modern schlicht eingerichtet, renoviertes Bad, neue flauschige Handtücher. Sehr unkompliziertes Ein- und Auschecken.
Einziges Manko leider die ziemlich durchgelegenen Matratzen und die stark befahrene, laute Straße, die ein Schlafen bei offenem Fenster unmöglich macht.
Parkplätze sind kein Problem und Frühstück gibt’s beim Bäcker nebenan.

Wir haben uns in der Unterkunft wohl gefühlt, allerdings wäre es schön gewesen, wenn in der Beschreibung gestanden hätte, dass die Wohnung im Erdgeschoss ist und ein sogenanntes großes Schaufenster hat. Das große Schaufenster war direkt zur Straße gerichtet und somit mussten wir die Vorhänge permanent geschlossen halten, damit keine fremde Leute in die Wohnung schauen und wir uns nicht beobachtet fühlen.
Außerdem fanden wir es schade, dass in zwei Schlafzimmern die Fenster nicht zu öffnen waren, somit bekam man keine frische Luft in die Räume. Es sollte außerdem erwähnt werden, dass ein Schlafzimmer ein Durchgangszimmer ist.
Insgesamt war es aber sehr sauber und ausreichend für unsere Reise. Die Gastgeberin war auch sehr freundlich.

This was a great location, close to the heart of Berlin and equipped with everything you need. Spotlessly clean, and a super responsive host. I asked to drop off my suitcase early, before check in; and they were happy to assist. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone.
This is great! Clean and fresh, plus very simple to check in to. Could not be more pleased.
Schöne Lage der Unterkunft im Grünen zwischen hohen Bäumen. Man kommt schnell fußläufig in den Grunewald und kann nach der Arbeit noch spazierengehen. Michaela war eine nette Gastgeberin.
Eine grosszügige Unterkunft in perfekter Lage!

We really loved how they communicate and answer all of the answers in the most possible way that could be helpful to us ✨
Also the room were very nice and clean as mentioned.
Sehr gute Kommunikation, klare Anweisungen für Check-in und Abreise. Gute Beschreibung der Unterkunft.

Great location, close to the centre and metro station. I loved the apartment, very stylish but nothing extra. Everything is clean but no kitchen which didn’t matter to us since we’ve been eating somewhere else to eat. Perfect for a short stay. Definitely would come back!

L’appartement était fidèle à l’annonce. Grande hauteur sous plafond et beaux volumes cuisine / salle à manger et salon. Très pratique d’accès depuis l’aéroport et proche du métro pourrait toutes nos visites. Kristina a été très réactif à nos messages. Nous le recommanderons.
Hatte eine sehr gemütliche Zeit in Berlin. Das Zimmer ist sehr praktikabel ausgestattet und im Bett hat man auch sehr gut geschlafen. Für einen Aufenthalt in Berlin auf jeden Fall empfehlendswert.
I dont have anything negative to say😊

Wir haben uns bei Felix und Lisa Superwohl gefühlt. Klasse Gastgeber, war für uns das erste mal über Airbnb, bei diesen Gastgebern würden wir zu Wiederholungstätern werden.
Nur Empfehlenswert und auch wenn mal eine Frage war, gab es auch schnell Antwort. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Alles hat super geklappt. Wir hatten eine angenehme Nacht.

Good location! Nice owner!
The only problem was that the description mentioned 5 bedrooms but one of them was the living room.

This is a nice clean apartment on the top floor with lots of light and all amenities needed. The apartment is close to the main U-Bahn no. 8 plus busses so it is fairly easy to get around Berlin and also back-and-forth to Tegel airport. We enjoyed our stay over the Easter vacation and the communication with Semra was very easy. Highly recommended.
Tolle Unterkunft - tolle Gastgeber! Vielen Dank!
A perfect place for a city break
Logement agréable, propre et bien situé. La communication avec Ben a été facile. Je recommande.

Sehr schöne, kleine Wohnung in Toplage mit allem, was es braucht, um sich wohl zu fühlen. Carola ist zudem sehr herzlich, offen und unkompliziert. Fußläufig gibt's etliche nette Lokale, wo es sich gut frühstücken oder zu Abend essen lässt. Ein großer Rewe erleichtert das Selbstversorgertum. Hinweis für alle Kaffeetrinker: In der Wohnung gibt es eine Bialetti - für uns genial, die wir daheim auch nur so Kaffee zubereiten. Wir kommen auf alke Fälle wieder!

Great apartment with a great location.
One of two double beds didnt work and it took ‘the professionel team’ a long time to work out the solution.
When I rent out from professionals like this place, I expect higher levels of service.
No problems besides this. Highly recommended apartment for exploring Prenzlauer Berg.
Unexpected visits by the neighbors. A cat came to greet us and a raccoon knocked our window at night. It was an interesting experience for us and we had a good time here.
Mina was wonderful at hosting once I had checked in.  The space was great and everything I needed.
Buen lugar, igual a las fotos.  Todas las.comodidades, la pasamos muy bien.
La casa cumple exactamente con lo descrito. Esteban es un muy buen anfitrión. La casa está a unos 30 minutos del centro en transporte público. Un buen alojamiento calidad precio.

Great location, close enough to popular sites but not close enough that it’s always loud/busy. Contactless check in and out was super easy and convenient. But when you do need help, they are very responsive and very helpful! I really recommend this place!

Had a great stay at flottwell and I wouldn’t definitely stay again, the room was fully equipped and super comfortable for me.
Thanks
Nur zu empfehlen!

Прекрасная чистая комната в мансарде частного дома, с садом. До метро или до остановки автобуса 4 минуты пешком. До аэропорта Тегель 8 минут на машине. В комнате есть все необходимое, и даже более того. Температуру в комнате вы можете регулировать на свое усмотрение. На первом этаже туалет, душ, кухня.  Хозяева очень дружелюбные люди. Мы были приятно удивлены комплиментом от хозяйки в виде чая, кофе и печенья, которые были в комнате к моменту нашего приезда. Очень рекомендую это место как для длительного пребывания, так и для остановки на один-два дня.
Very good place to stay, central location and Jonas was great with communication. I would recommend!
Perfect place for a weekend getaway to Berlin :-)
交通非常便利！安全，安静。
Very well equipped apartment with all necessities. Perfect for 1-2 persons

Anca was a great and very attentive host - the location is perfect, in a quiet street but a walking distance from bars and restaurants and my favourite neighbourhood in Berlin. The place is just as in the pictures and very comfortable for a short stay
Superbly located in a buzzing part of Berlin, everything was very clean and tidy. Perfect for a long weekend.
Fantastic place, calm, clean, great people
The apartment was in a great location. Less than a 5 minute walk to grocery store, bakeries, public transit, shopping, restaurants.

2nd time @Arthur’s place, perfect!
Can’t wait to come back soon.

Great apartment in a residential area but in good reach of the city center and public transport. The apartment is perfectly equipped and very tastefully decorated. All you need as a base for a citytrip. Super nice!
Eine sehr schöne Wohnung in einer tollen Lage. Für uns ( Familie mit 2 Kindern) war die Wohnung perfekt!

Huis staat in een prachtige, rustgevende en groene omgeving. Eekhoorntjes en een vosje gezien in de tuin.  Gezellig ingericht. Vlakbij de Wannsee. Bezienswaardigheden Berlijn prima met het openbaar vervoer te bereiken, met de auto trouwens. Wij komen zeker terug!

It was a lovely nice stay in a comfy and cozy home. There's a nice view from the porch to some other gardens and it's a very quiet place. It rained a lot when I was there but this was actually a nice setting to enjoy the pitter patter sounds. I mostly just wanted a quiet stay (and I got that) but the place is fully equipped with every amenity you could want. No complaints at all, very lovely place.
Es war sehr schön in Kirsten's Wohnung! Vielen Dank für den tollen Aufenthalt. Eine wunderschöne Wohnung, in die ich sehr gerne bei meiner nächsten Berlinreise wiederkommen würde.
Very artistic space with amazing hospitality and in a great location. I would definitely recommend this place 😊

This place was great. It is well situated on a quiet street with lots of diverse shops and restaurants within a 5 minute walk. It's also right next to a U-bahn station so it's very easy to connect to other neighborhoods in Berlin. The place itself was clean and spacious (the lovely high ceilings made it feel big). The place also has a balcony looking out onto the main road, which was a nice suprise as I wasn't expecting one.
Check in was easy and communicating with Birgit was always quick and helpful. I would absolutely stay here again.
Wir können nur danke sagen - tolle, geräumige Wohnung mit  Lage direkt am Südkreuz - Kreuzberg und Schöneberg direkt vor der Haustür!
Alles war super bequem, und bei Bedarf wurde sofort geholfen. Sehr zu empfehlen!
Super nette Betreuung und die Sauberkeit meines  Zimmer war mehr als beeindruckende. Alles blitzt und glänzt .  Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt

Auch wenn ich nur für eine Nacht einen Platz zum schlafen benötigte, hatte ich das Gefühl bei Garrelt zu Hause zu sein. Alles war leicht zu finden und das Zimmer inkl. Küche und Bad liefert allen nötigen Komfort! Ich würde jederzeit wieder hier einchecken 👍🏼

Simone was an excellent host. She communicated with us for all stages of our stay and even gave us lots of tips on the local area . Simone met us at the apartment and explained how everything worked which was thoughtful and helpful.
The apartment was a great space and very well equipped.
The area was very handy to public transport which is so efficient in Berlin.
I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Simone her apartment.
Excelente alojamiento e inmejorable ubicación. Marius muy puntual y buen comunicador, un placer. Repetiría sin duda.

The place will not disappoint the pictures do not do it justice . We have stayed at well over 60 airb&bs and this place is one of the best from start to finish Stefan’s care and service is the best. I cannot say enough about the whole experience. 5 stars is not enough I would give it a 10 star if I could. The location is great easy to get to everything and if you don’t want to go far. everything you need is steps away. We loved our stay.

I would recommend this recommendation to anyone staying in Berlin that is going with a larger friend group or family. The place was really nice and clean!
And going out into the city was so easy and only took 10 minutes.
I would stay here again if I were to come back to Berlin.
Wir hatten einen super Aufenthalt und sind begeistert von dem coolen Konzept. Eine Art Hotel voller AirBnB-Unterkünfte von Numa. Schöne Openwork-Spaces. Hier sind Profis am Werk.

great location and both Marcus and ewa are very polite and give your own space and if u need anything they directly help.
walking distance from Berlin Central station and bus and tram
perfect for me
Gezellig en net appartementje, goede uitvalsbasis om de stad te verkennen, dicht bij metro, Ivo geeft goede tips, veel eetgelegenheid in de buurt, kortom een aanrader!

You are in for a treat if you stay here.  Fabulous location, quiet and close to all the important areas of Berlin. The apartment is very comfortable and decorations cool. Nice and warm in the cooler months.  Communication with the team is super fast and I am certainly coming back!

I really enjoyed my stay in Ursula’s apartment. Perfect location in Prenzlauer Berg, and it’s conveniently located on the ground floor. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and quiet. Also check in and out process was very easy, and the host communicated quickly. I’d highly recommend!

Berlin Wedding is a rougher neighborhood than we expected. The apartment is well spaced (2 bedrooms and bathroom, good sized kitchen/ living room) and practical but similar to the neighborhood with noticeable issues (no warm water in the kitchen, noisy bedrooms). The hosts were welcoming and fast to respond but all in all rather a place for a party visit to Berlin rather than a family trip
Alles super
Frau Neumann was very friendly. The room was very clean and tidy. I felt comfortable. If I return to Berlín I would like to stay at her house again.

Very comfortable and clean place. Mo was very helpful and knows a lot about the area, even had some really good recommendations for food places around.
Would highly recommend a stay with him.
Everything went smooth as expected. Thanks.

Peter and Denis's place is a wonderful place located in the perfect spot in Berlin! It is right by the train station so you have quick access to the whole city. The place was thoughtfully decorated and very clean with essential amenities. Peter and Denis are wonderful hosts who go above and beyond to accommodate any needs or last minute changes. I highly recommend this place, and when I go back to Berlin, this is where I want to stay.

Splendido appartamento, ampio, bene attrezzato e pulito con cura, situato in una zona molto tranquilla di Berlino vicino alla via dello shopping di lusso.
Ottimo rapporto con l'host, sempre disponibile.
Consigliato

An excellent apartment in Berlin with easy access to public transport including buses and the S-bahn. The apartment itself was spotless and there are loads of supermarkets nearby as well which was really handy! Highly recommended.

4 of us stayed in Carolin’s apartment for one night. It was in a great location, and the apartment was comfortable, stylish and clean.
Communication with the host was very quick and easy.
Would definitely return! Thank you!

Good and kind commonication with Carolin.
Very clean and nice appartement.
Central and in a very friendly and cosy neighbourhood.
Easy to reach with U-bahn.
I warmly recommend this place.
Rapport qualité prix excellent mais un peu en dehors du centre Mitte Berlin.
We had a great stay here. Was very walkable and easy to get around. Very convenient and responsive host. We had no problems with easy check in and check out. Would highly recommend

Bárbara fue muy atenta y rápida para contestar.
Las fotos coinciden con la publicación; la ubicación está bien a 500 mt de la línea de metro. Es relativamente cerca a la puerta de brandenburgo estás a menos de 20 min; el sector tiene variedad de restaurantes y con supermercado cerca.
Gracias Bárbara.

We hebben een heel fijn verblijf gehad in de accommodatie van Geraldine. De buurt is rustig en groen, maar je bent met de S-Bahn snel in de stad. De inrichting is gezellig en netjes. Er stond ook een flesje wijn en nootjes klaar op tafel. We vonden het ‘s nachts wel te licht, omdat er voor de deur geen raambekleding hangt en de vouwgordijnen voor de ramen lichtdoorlatend.
We komen graag nog eens terug!

Britta and Nicholas are excellent hosts. Their place is located very near Berlin tower and the conference center BCC at Alexanderplatz. It is also in a quiet neighborhood with multiple options for breakfast and dining. I had a fabulous time here in Berlin thanks in great measure to the peace of mind provided by my hosts. Thanks, Britta and Nicholas and hope to come back soon.
One of the best place in Berlin, really quiet and close to supermarkt and also Bus station.
Super miejsce! Bardzo polecam na pobyt w Berlinie. Świetna lokalizacja, pokój czysty i zadbany. Cool :)

Notre séjour à Berlin s’est très bien déroulé.
Le logement est très bien placé, facilement accessible, les transports à 2 pas, et temps calme la nuit donc peu bruyant. Les commerces (pharmacie, magasins, restaurants, bars…) sont facilement accessibles à moins de 10 minutes à pieds.
Le logement était conforme aux photos et Alan & Kasia ont été réactifs pour chaque demandes ou questions !
Je recommande vivement ce logement !

Alessandro was súper chatty, friendly and patient with me.
The place is super clean, super cute, well located and near a lot of things to see.
Absolutely flawless experiencie
A kind host, a good location and a good room were all good thanks a lot

El departamento está en una zona de muchos restaurantes y supermercados. El muro de Berlín está relativamente cerca, fuimos caminando. También hay estaciones de metro muy cerca, así que puedes moverte por la ciudad fácilmente.  El departamento es bastante amplio, ordenado, limpio y con todas las amenidades.  Sin duda volvería.
Aufenthalt war super. Sehr zu empfehlen. Alles lief reibungslos und unkompliziert. Für unsere Geschäftsreise als grosse Gruppe, die auch einen Platz zum arbeiten brauchten perfekt. Gerne wieder!

Ich war nun zum zweiten mal Gast bei Thalia, es war wie immer super, alles sehr sauber, gemütlich Stil - wie auf den Bildern - so schön, dass ich nächstes Jahr gern wieder kommen möchte.
Herzlichen Dank
Christiane
Absolut empfehlenswert !

Un écrin de confort et de good vibes au cœur de kreuzberg. Bien que vous logiez chez Saskia, vous vous sentez directement chez vous. Un bon équilibre entre espace privé et espaces de partage comme ce que devrait être un vrai airbnb.
Et bien sûr, impossible de ne pas apprécier la gentillesse de Saskia.
Spacious double rooms, ideal for families
Man braucht nicht mehr! super für ein zwei nächte

Da wir mit der Bahn angereist sind und an diesem Tag Streiks im Nahverkehr angesagt waren, haben wir Informationen erhalten, wie wir am besten zur Unterkunft gelangen.
Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen und durch die Wohnung geführt. Ein sehr schönes Bad und die Zimmer waren wie auf den Bildern zu sehen ausgestattet. Eine Kleinigkeit hat uns allerdings gefehlt: für die Glastische Untersetzter für Gläser/Tassen bzw. Platzsets.
Sollten wir nochmal für einen längeren Trip nach Berlin kommen werden wir als erstes schauen ob wir hier wieder einchecken können.
Modernes, sauberes, ruhiges Hotel.
We had a wonderful stay. The space and building were beautifully and perfectly located in a wonderful neighborhood. We would definitely come back.
Die Unterkunft war super. Alles hat sehr gut geklappt. Vielen Dank nochmal.

The apartment is in the back through a couple gates which I really liked. Being a little bit secluded gave me a sense of security. Also Michaela is the most helpful and attentive Airbnb host I’ve ever had!

Es waren sehr schöne zwei Tage😊
Es war wirklich unkompliziert, dass Zimmer war sauber und ruhig, dass Bett war bequem.
Und es gab ein Frühstück morgens

Nous avons été fort bien accueillis par Ursula. Le logement est parfait, fidèle à la présentation et aux photos. Lumineux, propre, agréable, bien décoré, calme... le tout dans un quartier très sympathique, vivant et très bien desservi. Nous reviendrons avec un grand plaisir !
The flat and the bedroom are very well located, bright and very clean...Kinga & Moritz are very kind and caring about your needs...A place to go in Berlin, to see the city in the best conditions...
Tolle, kleine Wohnung mit allem was man für einen längeren oder kurzen Aufenthalt braucht. Süßer Balkon, perfekte Lage, hilfreicher Gastgeber. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen :)
Gutes Hostel. Komme gerne wieder

Very special, cozy room in a great hotel with a special ambience of the ancient baths in central Prenzlauer Berg. You should only be a bit heat-proof as the upper floor with bed can get quite warm in summer.
Top Lage! 3min bis zum Checkpont Charlie.
Both the hosts are welcoming and accommodating while being respectful of your privacy

Ideally located in the central Mitte district, Nook Numa Apartments are ideal for a short stay.
The apartements are very professionally managed and altogether good value for money.
For convenience ad location above charm.

Dharma Mati's place has great private rooms ,
will a well equipped kitchen and a spotless
bathroom. The staff are courteous and always ready to help. The building is well located in the heart of Charlottenburg, with bus stops
and supermarkets just steps away.
I would certainly recommend this place to anyone planning to visit Berlin.
Best place with evrythng a tourist would need...
Lovely apartment in a quiet street nearby Boxhagener Platz. The place is clean, fully furnished, and Sarah was always responsive and helpful!
Thank you so much for the great communication and great hospitality :D !!!

Es hat alles gut geklappt und ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und cosy !
Ich komme gerne wieder !

Had a lovely stay here - room has plenty of space with a TV and a fan (which is a godsend for me during European summers!)
William was lovely, super helpful and made me feel right at home. I would highly recommend staying here!
El lugar es muy lindo y acogedor. Muy recomendable!
An amazing flat with a lovely family in a great neighborhood! A great place to stay in Berlin!

Albert's apartment is amazing. We were privileged to rent it during one of the hottest months of June and we really enjoyed the air conditioner - to the best of my knowledge this is one of the only apartments that has an air conditioner in Berlin - a true advantage!! The apartment is immaculately clean. Equipped with everything you need for a long and short stay - we were there for three weeks. One of the most pleasant apartments I have ever been to. Great location - public transportation just below the house, very well connected to anywhere we wanted to go. Albert is kind and charming host and available for any question and request. Highly recommend!

Claudia is the perfect host—she’s warm, attentive and makes sure you have everything you need to have the most comfortable and memorable stay. She’s always reachable and communication with her has been effortless.
Her place is just perfect, a true gem. Location is great—just steps from public transportation, local cafes and restaurants, and very close to city’s main attractions.
Her place is the perfect little spot—very quiet, private, with its own entrance and more charming than what the pictures show. Extra towels and a Nespresso machine made my stay even more perfect☺️
I’m glad to call Claudia’s place my home in Berlin!
I highly recommend her place—you won’t regret it.
It’s a wonderful room with nice experience. Zoe is a good person to communicate and her room is clean and tidy indeed.
Great apartments in the center
Frank's place is very clean and central. Plenty to do and transport is excellent. Quite a small apartment but has the basics. Enjoyed our stay.
Our second stay was as good as our first!

Virkelig dårlig rengøring! Der var støv alle vegne, og gulvene var hverken blevet støvsuget eller vasket i meget lang tid. Vi var desuden blevet lovet en babyseng og en babystol, men det fik vi aldrig trods gentagne henvendelser. Larmen fra gaden er massiv, også hele natten. Det samme er larmen fra naboer samt over- og underboere. Gulvene knirker ekstremt meget! Når naboen ryger på sin balkon, lugter hele lejligheden af røg, fordi vinduerne er så utætte. Vi kommer aldrig igen.

We've spend a wonderful week in this flat. Well located, it was perfect for a couple and the flat had everything we needed. Communication was perfect and it was really easy to get the keys. We would definitly love to come again.

The apartment was very spacious with lots of light. The bedding was fluffy and comfy. The place is in a great location, close to the subway. There were enough dishes for a family of 5. Tourist information pamphlets were provided along with a very detailed guide of Berlin  from the landlord upon arrival. The only concern was the cleanliness. It was clean enough, but it was not exceptionally clean.
Dejlig lejlighed med go plads til to familier. Den ligger rigtig godt i forhold til togstation og hvis man er i bil, er der gratis parkering:-)

Majutuskoht oli kena väike korter Tempelhofis. Tempelhof on asukohana kindlasti väärtuslik, sealne miljöö on eripärane ja hubane. Korter oli kena tagasihoidlik väike peatumispaik kõige olulisemate mugavustega. Majutuskoha omanik oli väga külalislahke loomuga hea suhtleja ja hoolitses kõige eest.
Perfect place! Transport is close, there are many cafes near the house. Thanks Dirk!

Ich musste erstmal warten, da mein Code nicht funktionierte.
Dann wurde mir für ein Besuch eines Freundes 10€ extra angerechnet, da das Personal vor ort der Meinung war, man darf keine Gäste zu sich nehmen.
war super, danke!

Tolles, großes Apartment hoch oben mit Lift, Balkonen und tollem Ausblick, sehr ruhig. Super tolle Lage mit Tram vor dem Haus und U-Bahn in der Nähe, schönen Cafes, Restaurants und kleinen Läden. Ausstattung auch sehr gut. Für uns als Familie mit zwei kleinen Kindern sehr gut und würde ich auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen.

Ich habe 3 Wochen bei Gabriela und Peter und nicht zu vergessen, Schatzi verbracht. Gabriela und Peter sind super Gastgeber und Schatzi ist zuckersüß :-). Ich habe mich direkt sehr wohl und willkommen gefühlt. Das Zimmer mit eigenem Bad ist sehr komfortabel und sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet, wie die gesamte Wohnung. Auch der Balkon ist toll, mit einer super schönen Aussicht und man kann von dort einen phantastischen Sonnenuntergang genießen. Auch die Küche ist voll ausgestattet und es wäre kein Problem, sich die ein oder anderen Mahlzeit zuzubereiten, sofern man dies möchte. Die Wohnung, direkt am Friedensplatz, liegt super zentral zu U-Bahn und somit erreicht man von dort alle 'Hot Spots' der Stadt in sehr kurzer Zeit. In der direkten Umgebung findet man aber auch alles, was man so braucht, Supermärkte, Bäcker, Restaurants und nicht zu vergessen, der gemütliche, kleine Hafen, der abends zum Verweilen einlud. Ich würde die Unterkunft jederzeit wieder buchen.
Chouette appartement de vacances avec jardin intérieur et à 5' à de la ligne 8 de métro
Terrific appartment with a great balcony and awesome location. The check-in and check-out was painless.
Great location! Apartment was very clean.

Aufenthalt war für drei Tage angesetzt (zwei Personen) Lage Top ! Zimmer und Ausstattung Top ! Kann ich wirklich mit einem guten Gewissen weiterempfehlen……Bäckerei direkt unterhalb der Apartments und Restaurants + Shopping Möglichkeiten liegen alle nah beieinander….(wir sind nicht verhungert 😉)

I had a beautiful time at Gunnar’s home. It was our first time in Berlin, and thought their home was absolutely beautiful. I was able to have some of their fruit that was on the table. They were super kind and always available anytime we needed. Loved the bathroom and patio, thank you again for a cozy and warm stay :)
Très sympa pour un court séjour entre amis

charming and full of light Apartment. Excellent location, close to all the main places, cafes, restaurants.
Maddalena answered anytime any questions and gave us helpful tips.

The best AirBnb I have ever been. Really outstanding service from the host (super cool, thoughtfull, considerate, helpfull, worried about us, gave us a lot of tips and details).
About the place, wonderfull, super clean, nice, big, comfortable, full of details and also close to public transportation with everything you could possibly need.
I can just simply say it was a wonderfull experience. Highly recommended for short or long stays, for sure the best choice.
The host was super nice and looked for our best interest even before arriving to Berlin. Thanks Yaz!
Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit hier. Das Appartment ist super schön, geräumig und sehr zentral. Es hatte alles da, was man brauchte und die Kommunikation war extrem freundlich. Gerne wieder!
Top Lage im Berliner Osten mit grandioser Aussicht vom Balkon⭐️. Gerne komme ich wieder!
Really nice AirBnb- would totally book it again
Good location, but the mattress is quite stiff and worn out.

Très calme, confortable et peut être rendu suffisamment sombre pour dormir (ce que je cherchais pour ne pas être réveillée par la lumière) mais avec de grandes et belles fenêtres ce qui rend le logement lumineux en journée. Très frais pour l'été.
Recommended! Nice, informative and easy to deal with.  Beautiful flat in great location.

It was a simple place but good value for the money. There was enough public transport nearby and one could easily go to the train station Zoo or train station Charlottenburg from there. After that it was an easy ride to the central station. Frank sent me very clear instructions, so I didn't need any further help. The room was simple but clean, the bathroom was spotless. I took a nap there in the afternoon but left Berlin around 10:30pm, so I didn't spend the night in the room. It was a fairly quiet street and the neighborhood had some nice restaurants.
Beautiful and clean place as expected - Prime location, close to main attractions  Great host  who is quick to response - We highly recommend this place to anybody.
nice room, clean and easy find.
Good location, nice and sweet apartment

The location of this flat was perfect! Sven was such an attentive host and the flat was clean, airy, and comfortable. It had everything we needed for our stay including a great kitchen for cooking and socialising. There was even a map near the door that showed nearby supermarkets, attractions, and restraunts.
Great stay, responsive host and nice apartment
Estadia foi simplesmente maravilhosa! Acomodações muito limpas! Ambiente aconchegante e tem tudo o que precisa para uma excelente estadia! Voltarei com certeza!
Wir kommen definitv wieder☺
Host gentile e disponibile, appartamento carino e in una zona tranquilla.
Mirco war total freundlich, Wohnung hat uns sehr gut gefallen, wir haben wirklich wohl gefühlt, hochwertige Einrichtung
Super Unterkunft!

When a place instantly feels like home, then you know you’ve chosen the perfect Airbnb. The flat has personality, is bright, perfectly located and quiet. Actually, I was hesitant to write this review because - frankly - I’d like this place to remain a well-kept secret … so that I’m guaranteed to return :-) …
Thank you Marius & Jutta for being kind and responsive hosts!
We had a one night stay while we were sightseeing in Berlin. We were very satisfied with everything, we had a pleasant stay.

Un appartement très bien placé, dans un quartier animé, proche de toute commodité.
Les lits sont confortables et les chambres agréables.
La communication avec notre hôte était fluide et rapide. Merci pour ce séjour! =)

The apartment is lovely and comfortable and we had everything we needed, including somewhere to park our car! It's very close to a bus stop where you can get a bus to the U-Bahn. You can also get a tram from just outside too. It's very easy to get around from here. A lovely place in a nice suburb of Berlin. Would definitely stay here again.

Such a nice place, great beds, very nice kitchen, everything is there, you just need to look for it. Kitchen is well stocked and equipped. Lovely little patio, spacious rooms, two toilets, washing and drying.
Area is nice, easy to get into the centre, Lidl and aldi nearby.
Werner is a great host, very straightforward, good dry sense of humour. Will be coming back to stay here when we return for Berlin round 2!

Le logement est conforme à la description. Il est très calme, à proximité de tous les moyens de communication.
Bettina est charmante et disponible.

Wir waren 3 Nächte in der Ubterkunft, die Lage ist unschlagbar, mitten in Kreuzberg und doch sehr ruhig und friedlich. Die Unterkunft ist sauber, toll eingerichtet und super ausgestattet, sogar Kaffee und Tee ist vorhanden. Schlüsselübergabe hat bestens geklappt. Wir würden sofort wieder buchen!
Apartment was lovely and Ferhat was extremely helpful when there was some issues getting the key and returning it. Location was great and apartment was exactly as it looks on website.
Perfect for a short stay: basic but clean, and very quiet. Good location as well.

Alles hat super gepasst! Die Unterkunft liegt sehr zentral und ist trotzdem ruhig. Alles war so wie beschrieben und sehr sauber. Die Kommunikation mit Ute war angenehm und völlig unkompliziert. Gerne wieder!

Appartement très agréable à proximité de la gare Marienfeld et des bus. Restaurants à proximité. Ne pas prendre de taxi de l'aéroport à l'appartement car hors de prix, il convient de privilégier les transports en communs très faciles d'utilisation et qui amène avec un seul changement à la gare de Marienfeld. Nous avons rencontré un problème de clé qui a été très vite résolu par nos hôtes.

A beautiful little apartment in the heart of the city. Just around the corner from a train hub and allowed us to get where we were going with ease. Lots of lovely little cafes and not too far to travel for nice bars.

Super Haus
Super geeignet wenn man als Gruppe verreist.
Alles notwendige für einen Kurztrip vorhanden

The apartment is located in one of the nicest, family-friendly neighborhoods in Berlin.  The restaurants nearby are of the highest rated in Berlin.  The apartment and bed are comfortable and very quiet.  Thomas is quick to answer and so welcoming.  I would highly recommend staying here.
Suosittelen!

Nous avons particulièrement apprécié cet appartement, bien situé, propre, spacieux, lumineux... si nous avions l'occasion de revenir à Berlin, nous reprendrions sans hésiter ce logement. Les échanges avec Lina étaient en outre clairs, ses réponses rapides. Un appartement que je recommanderais sans hésiter.
Todo genial! El personal siempre muy amable y dispuesto. Todo limpio, excelente ubicación (a 5 min de metro y trenes). Recomendado
Amazing stay and thank you Katie for being such a gracious host! The next time I am back in Berlin, I will love to stay with you again! Great location and I felt welcomed and well taken care of!

O quarto é enorme, ensolarado e muito bem localizado, mas o ponto mais positivo foi o anfitrião. Oliver deixa os hóspedes muito à vontade e está sempre disposto a auxiliar com suas informaçoes, o que facilitou muito nossa estada em Berlin.
Ein wirklich süßes, kleines Appartement, die Gastgeberin ist wirklich sehr nett und die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und beinhaltet alles was man so brauch.

Alan managed the communication in an excellent manner.
The location is really good with an Edeka open until midnight and even during the weekend, the train/underground connections are really good for the airport and anywhere else in the city.
The apartment is unfortunately close to the train tracks, so if you are sensitive to noise bring some ear plugs for the night. The garden in front of the apartment is really cute and completes the experience nicely.

Vladimir’s apartment is very spacious and well located. He was super fast answering all our questions. The apartment was not very clean, but nothing that stands out (probably realized because we stayed for a week). Washing machine wasn’t cleaning all dishes properly as well.

We really enjoyed our stay in the apparent which is lovier than  it looks in the pictures. Lofty ceilings, clear comfortable furniture and great facilities made it a great place to base our family. There are lots of local eateries and a great kitchen if you choose to cook. It’s an easy walk to three local underground stations (all within 10mins of the apartment). Both Gelfo and his wife were quick to reply and gave lots of information before and on arrival. If we went back to Berlin, we’d absolutely hope to stay here again! Thank you!
Best Airbnb we have stayed in. The apartment was great, within walking distance of the trains and Tom was a fantastic host
Sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit

Sehr gute Kommunikation und sehr gute Lage.
Die kleine Wohnung war sauber und komfortabel; vielleicht wäre es gut gewesen ein paar mehr "basics" für die Küche zu finden - z.B. Salz, Pfeffer, Oel, einige Teebeutel, Zucker - vor allem für längere Aufenthalte (ich habe in der Wohnung 5 Nächte übernachtet).
Ansonsten alles prima, es hat mir sehr gefallen! Gerne wieder :)

Very spacious with plenty room for 5 adults. Loved staying in a neighborhood rather than tourist area. 10 minute walk to metro and 5-10 minute walk to lots of eating options and grocery store. Full kitchen too, had our stay been longer we would have used.

Doerthe's place is very well furnished and maintained. The bedrooms are spacious, and the bathroom is new, spacious and very comfortable. The location is near Ubahn, making it very well connected. Would stay again, recommended!

No wonder this is a rare find. David was an excellent host: he explained the instructions very kindly and patiently, even if we arrived half an hour before the end of the check in period.

Keep going! Great services:)

Thanks Andrea!

Deze ruimte is enorm aan te raden. Ligt in een levendige buurt maar het appartement zelf ligt in een hofje waar het heel rustig is. Er zijn goede voorzieningen in het huis, goede bedden, keuken en douche en bovenal is het een zeer sfeervol geheel met mooie details (druppellamp boven de tafel!)

Die Lage des Air BnB's ist super zentral in Kreuzberg und die Wohnung selber war absolut toll und schön eingerichtet. Aber ich würde sehr gerne wieder kommen und die Wohnung auch weiterempfehlen.
The apartments and Marco are great, the space is small but well set up and ideally located. Very clean and Marco even noticed it was my birthday and left some chocolates on my luggage - thank you!

Wir hatten einen wundervollen Aufenthalt in dieser Unterkunft! Die Wohnung ist absolut modern eingerichtet, sehr stilvoll und gleichzeitig unglaublich gemütlich – perfekt für Familien. Alles war blitzsauber, bis ins kleinste Detail gepflegt, was uns sofort ein gutes Gefühl gegeben hat.

Die Unterkunft ist nicht nur schön, sondern auch sehr familienfreundlich – unsere Kinder haben sich sofort wohlgefühlt. Wir haben uns rundum wohl und willkommen gefühlt und können diese Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen. Alles war wirklich bestens – wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!
Für meinen Anlass war es die perfekte Übernachtung
Gihad was very helpful and responsive. We were satisfied with the accomodation.
Pragmatisch. Macht man nichts falsch.

War alles perfekt ! Besser geht es nicht. Bestes Appartement was ich bis jetzt hatte. Sehr sauber. Alles war da was man so braucht. Selbst Waschmittel usw.
Nur parken kann man dort sehr schlecht. Aber dafür kann der Vermieter nichts.
Alles super!
Well decorated , good location flat!!
Wir hatten eine schöne und entspannte Zeit. Gut ausgestattete Wohnung. Würden wiederkommen.
Sehr freundliche Empfang durch Marius. Sauberes und baby-freundliches Appartment. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!
Mein bestes Quartier in Berlin bisher.
Great apartment, lots of restaurants in area. Easy to get from HBF
Very nice apartment in a very nice area.

This is a wonderful place in a great location on the Landwehrkanal. Great communication and assistance with any questions that came up. Would happily recommend to anyone else looking for a central stay in a clean and fully stocked place when visiting Berlin!

What can we say, staying at René’s place was far more than just a place to throw your bags and catch some sleep before exploring the city. Whether it’s taking advantage of the modern amenities, efficient use of space in the house or just sitting on the porch to admire the garden and it’s abundance of chickens and duck, even in the evening it offers a chance to enjoy the stars. the house itself has plenty to offer. By far the best part however was René’s outstanding hospitality which was worth the price alone, we were greeted every morning with a breakfast made with the fresh chicken and duck eggs with warm buns as well as a delicious latte macchiato each. All of this contributed to the best value experience we’ve had at an air bnb to date

One of the nicest Air BnB I've stayed in.  It is a delightfully renovated modern flat through a beautiful courtyard.  The location is great (be sure to walk along the canals).  Gal was a perfect host.   The bed is comfortable and the space is open and minimal in a lovely way.   And the sauna is private, just off the bathroom.  Stop searching and book this place.
Nice place, good location
Nice apartment, kitchen is a bit tiny, but there is everything what you need. Area is peaceful, and the hosts are really lovely and helpful.
great, easy stay!
Thanks so much for having us in your gorgeous flat!

Sehr schöne Ferienwohnung, die -einziger Minuspunkt- leider nicht viel Tageslicht hereinlässt.

Voor de rest: topkwaliteit.

A beautifully decorated bright apartment in a lovely quiet neighbourhood. Easy walking distance to cafes/ supermarkets and transport. Exactly as seen in photos . Very clean  and well appointed. Comfortable beds and furniture and great bathrooms. Excellent communication and very helpful host.  I would highly recommend Tim and Matteo’s place to everyone.

Appartement presque conforme à la description (pas de lave-vaisselle, équipement très sommaire) et propre. Belle salle de bain mais qui sent l'humidité au bout de quelques jours (les serviettes ne sèchent pas).
En revanche, il est situé en plein milieu d'une zone industrielle extrêmement bruyante (flot ininterrompu de camions et voie ferrée sur le trottoir d'en face). L'appartement étant en RDC, impossible d'ouvrir les fenêtres.

Dans l'appartement, aucune documentation fournie sur les commerces du quartier, le lieu où déposer les ordures…)
Gente extremadamente amable y preocupada. Volveria a ir 100%
Very nice little studio, in a very quiet neighborhood close to the S bahn. Enjoyed our stay!

We had such a lovely stay at Alan and Kasia's for our first time in Berlin! The location was incredible—a short walking distance to public transit, lots of bodegas, shops, cafes & restaurants. Alan and Kasia were so communicative and helpful, and the apartment is SO cute. I couldn't recommend this place more! I hope to stay here again next time I visit Berlin.
Rainer has a lovely apartment. It was exactly as described. He was a great host in communication and quick to respond when I reached out.
Kristina haben wir zwar nicht persönlich kennen gelernt, aber am Telefon war sie sehr freundlich. Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und wir haben uns wohl gefühlt.Gerne kommen wir wieder.

Perfect location and accommodation for our trip. Stayery is very streamlined and intuitive to allow for self service but also were quick to answer and questions.
Thank you for a lovely stay!
Schönes Hotel mit großem Angebot!

O anfitrião foi muito atencioso desde a reserva até o final da estadia. Apartamento muito limpo, agradável e com bom espaço interno.

An amazing property in an amazing city. Had a great experience in Berlin - the accommodation was located just 10 minutes on the Ubahn or a very easy 30 minute walk from Alexanderplatz. Very modern interior with clean amenities. Would recommend staying here to anybody who wants to visit Berlin - 10/10
Sehr freundlich und fair! Top Kommunikation

It is a beautiful apartment. I personally find the location very good. Everything is easy to reach by bicycle and the neighborhood is quiet. The check in and check out went smoothly. I recommend everyone to stay here if you do not want to be in the busy center but everything is easily and quickly accessible.

Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber klappt sehr schnell und gut. Die Wohnung an sich ist ein richtiger Hingucker. Man genießt vor allem die detailreiche und großflächige Einrichtung.
Insgesamt kann ich nur sagen das ich von der Wohnung und dem Gastgeber begeistert bin und jederzeit gerne wiederkomme
Great place, spacious living room, clean bathroom and nice balcony. WiFi was excellent and location was nice and quiet. Would recommend!

Joshua's place was perfect for our week in Berlin. It's just as described, in a great neighborhood and close to public transit. Joshua was extremely helpful during out stay, always responsive and helpful. I highly recommend!
Really good stay in a contemporary place. So cute.

Meine Eltern und eine Freundin haben eine knappe Woche in der Wohnung verbracht und haben sich rundum wohl gefühlt. Schnuckelige Wohnung mit viel Liebe zum Detail in top Lage zur Köpenicker Altstadt und Dahme. Die Wohnung ist sehr gut ausgestattet,  ist sauber und hat einen sehr schönen Innenhof. Es ist alles da, was man braucht. Der Kontakt zu Gordon war sehr angenehm. Ein super Gastgeber und die Wohnung definitiv zu empfehlen!
Verbrachten sehr schöne Tage in Berlin in Holgers wunderschönem zentral gelegenen Penthouse

Nice stay with a good sleeping couch and bed. Used the accommodation with my daughter and biked through the center. The apartment is fully equipped and clean. We enjoyed Penslauerberg and especially the restaurants nearby Helmholtzplatz!
Sehr zufrieden. Gerne mal wieder!

Very nice house with a lovely garden. Jeanette is a very good host, who did everything to make my stay confortable and easy.

Apartamento cómodo y limpio. Ubicación tranquila, a poco más de 5 minutos de la estación y muy bien conectado.
nice modern flat in the middle of Berlin, everything was wonderful

This was a very welcoming home in Berlin! It was very clean and organized and convenient to public transit. The neighborhood was very quiet and residential which was nice for us and much preferred to the more touristy areas. Massimo was very helpful and friendly and helped us settle in very easily. We would certainly stay here again and/or recommend it to anyone traveling to Berlin who is looking for a quiet place to stay off the beaten-path in a cool up and coming neighborhood. It is also VERY close to Tegel airport which was super convenient.
It was a decent location and very nice host.

Amazing apartment in a great location. Easy to walk to most landmarks but also public transport 4 minute walk away. Great restaurants in walking distance. Would highly recommend staying in this apartment, will definitely be arranging another visit.

Vi hade en trevlig vistelse här, beliggenheten och byggnaden är fantastisk. Nära till kollektivtrafik eller att bara utforska Mitte med omnejd till fots. Fotona stämmer bra med verkligheten och restaurangen i bakgården (Katz Orange) är väl värt ett besök, men kom ihåg att boka i förväg.

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in Lindas Apartment. Die Lage ist top. Von hier aus kann man alles gut sowohl zu Fuß als auch mithilfe des ÖPNV erreichen. Das Apartment ist recht klein, allerdings gut ausgestattet, gemütlich und vor allem sauber.
Die Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin und der Check-In lief problemlos und auch für kleinere Probleme wurden zeitnah Lösungen arrangiert. Wir würden definitiv wieder kommen!

Rochus ist ein zuvorkommender Gastgeber, der sich sehr viel Mühe gibt, damit seine Gäste sich wohlfühlen. Er ist hilfsbereit und dankbar für jede Anregung. Ich kann die Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen und wünsche Rochus angenehme freundliche Gäste!

Unsere erste Erfahrung mit Airbnb war ein Volltreffer! Die Unterkunft befindet sich in einem sehr hübschen Viertel mit gepflegten alten Villen, großen Gärten und Parks. Alleen mit uralten Lindenbäumen und Kopfsteinpflaster führen zum Haus. Genau wie beschrieben darf man in einem wunderschönen Gartenhaus inmitten eines liebevoll gestalteten und gepflegten Gartens wohnen. Man kann das Auto kostenfrei vor dem Haupthaus auf der Straße parken. Vor dem Gartenhaus gibt es eine Terrasse mit einer schönen Sitzecke, perfekt für ein Frühstück mit Vogelgezwitscher oder ein Glas Wein in der Abendsonne. Mitgebrachte Fahrräder finden da ebenfalls Platz. Die Inneneinrichtung ist sehr geschmackvoll mit viel Liebe fürs Detail gestaltet. Es ist alles da, was man braucht. Man schläft in unglaublicher Stille mit angenehmer frischer Luft, unfassbar, dass man in einer Großstadt ist! Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Restaurants und öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind nah gelegen.
Die Vermieter haben uns sehr herzlich empfangen, sogar zu einer Familiengrillfeier im Garten wurden wir eingeladen! Die Kommunikation im Vorfeld war stets schnell und freundlich. Vor Ort bekamen wir immer und zu jeder Frage hilfreiche Tipps. Wir haben uns sehr wilkommen gefühlt und würden das schöne Gartenhaus jederzeit empfehlen und wir kommen gerne wieder!
Die Unterkunft ist zentral gelegen und bietet alles was man im Rahmen eines Städtetrips braucht.Sehr netter Kontakt, problemloser check in !

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Sie liegt fantastisch zentral. Die Ausstattung ist für sechs Personen genau passend. Die Betten waren bei Ankunft bezogen. Dies, ebenso wie zwei Bäder und die Spülmaschine haben uns unseren Aufenthalt sehr genießen lassen. Lästige Wartezeiten und Aufgaben haben unsere kostbare Besuchszeit in Berlin nicht verkürzt.
Alles super! Danke!!
Sehr sauber, neutral und stimmig eingerichtete Zimmer und unkomplizierter Check In

ons 2e x verblijf bij Apostolos midden in Friedrichshein met de metro, kroegjes, winkeltjes en de Boxhagenerplatz op loopafstand.

We greatly enjoyed our stay, Fabian was very helpful and proactive with his local recommendations. The flat was clean, had everything we needed!
This room is lovely. Very spacious and separate to the rest of the house so it feels like a separate apartment. Lovely hosts too.
Séjour plaisant dans un logement original et agréable.

Nice, clean and cozy hotel. Staff was really friendly and the location is great. Walking distance to all you could need and also the public transport. Definitely recommend and I think I will book a room if I ever go to Berlin again:)
Die Unterkunft von Felicitas war super. Ruhig, nah an der Bahn, schöne Cafés und Restaurants in der Nähe und die Kommunikation hat auch toll geklappt. Lieben Dank, ich würde immer wieder kommen.
super wohl gefühlt. alles sauber. küche immer ordentlich. gerne wieder

Lokatie was prima, schoon en verzorgd. Het geluid van de straat viel enorm mee. Geen last van gehad. Zal wel anders zijn met geopende ramen. De latbodems van één van de bedden was niet goed gemonteerd of stuk waardoor je naar het  midden rolt. Dat was jammer.
Very beautiful and clean apartment in Berlin
Sehr nette kleine Unterkunft in der Nähe der Gärten der Welt. Äußerst ruhige Lage mit nettem Freisitz im Garten.
We had a great time staying at Robert's apartment. Nice location, stylish interior. Would definitely recommend.
Es war ein wunderschöner Aufenthalt in schönem Ambiente und guter Lage.

Great accomodation for our short stay in Berlin. Despite the sharing situation, this was very private. Chris was very responsive with communication and helpful.
the apartment was roomy, with lovely high ceilings and everything was clean and tidy. comfy beds, large bathroom, good facilities. This is well worth the price. Really good value. Thanks Chris.
Der Aufenthalt bei Jörg kann ich nur weiterempfehlen. Jörg ist ein zuvorkommender, freundlicher Gastgeber, die Wohnung ist sauber und geräumig. Und die Lage ausgezeichnet!

Tanja’s apartment was the perfect base for a few days in Berlin. It was easy to find and get around, and Tanja gave us very good instructions for our stay. The bed was comfy and it was a peaceful area.
War sehr schön. Gerne wieder. Danke

It was alright, not great ! The amenities were adequate, the staff were excellent, and the bar was nice. But, the room smelled strongly of cigarettes, cabinets were sticky, and tables were damaged. It was a mediocre location and you definitely need to leave the area to find nice things to do. I would not pay this amount to stay here again, but it does the job!

Well informed by Thomas before our arrival, he also came as soon as we arrived for some extra information about public transport, use of the apartment, restaurants in the neighborhood,... Very clean studio, with reasonably comfortable bed and good shower. Quiet place. 15 min travel with a direct bus to the centre (busstop at 2min walking).

Etienne's place was the perfect fit for our family of 5 (2 adults and 3 teenagers). Everyone had their own space and the 1.5 baths was super helpful when we were home. The location is great. The U-bahn, tram and bus were all right outside and we could get most places we wanted to go without many transfers. There were also tons of restaurant within walking distance and a nice park about 10 minutes walk so we could enjoy the nice weather we had.
There are 2 things to note about this property. First, it is a sixth floor walk up so keep that in mind. The space was worth it for us, but it might be a problem if you can't manage that many stairs multiple times a day. Second, there was no AC in the apartment and only one small fan. With the glass ceilings, it got extremely hot during the day so we planned to stay out all day and return after the sun was going down. Entienne did tell us that he was in the process of having an AC installed so that should solve the heat problem when complete.
met expectations. communication before check-in anticipated any problems at check-in
The perfect apartment for our big family. Very clean and stylish with everything we needed.

Zito war mir auf Anhieb sympatisch, die Kommunikation sehr unmittelbar und klar. Der Wohnraum  ist sehr  angenehm gestaltet und bot mir eine willkommenen Oase der Ruhe nach vielen Aktivitäten mit meinen Leuten in und um Berlin drumrum.

This is a gem of an apartment in a great location with its own unique history as a former wood factory. There's a lot of space, the sitting area/ dining area/ kitchen is perfect for a family or group. It has a nice energetic vibe and Shiva the cat is as cool as can be. We really felt at home and hope we might stay again in future. Thank you!
Tolles Appartment, besonders mit Kindern! Sehr netter Kontakt! Super gelegen: Spielplätze, Restaurants, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und die S-Bahn Station direkt in der Nähe

Hermoso departamento! Había una variedad de transportes públicos muy cerca. La zona es muy cómoda y tranquila, cerca del centro.

War eine super Unterkunft

We were a group of 3 adults and two children. So it got a bit crowded. Especially one bunker bed is actually placed in the dining room...the furnitures can be placed in a better way to fit larger group. The two bunker beds are quite comfortable.

I think it's quite a good option for a short stay.

tutto bene. appartamento pulito e in zona molto comodo. Amit disponibile e pronto alle NS. esigenze.
grazie
Excellent location, clean cozy convenient studio apartment. Ideal for short or extended stays. Very helpful, great host. I very highly recommend it.

Although I did not meet Katharina in person it was pleasant to communicate with her. She responded fast and to the point and had some good advice on places to eat. The room was nice an clean and the location is well connected to public transport.

Tolle Unterkunft am Rande des Tempelhofer Feldes - U-Bahn zwei Minuten entfernt, tolle Restaurants und Cafes in unmittelbarer Nähe - auch ein freundlicher Bäcker/Lebensmittelladen um die Ecke, so dass man jeden Tag Frühstück kaufen kann - Danke für die wunderbare Wohngelegenheit.
Well-presented and plenty of space for our group. Super friendly and helpful host.
Frank is a very nice host and his airbnb was cozy and modern. Nice bathroom and a great bedroom! Thank you so much for everything
Had a wonderful stay. Very spacious property.  Immaculately clean. Great location near to public transport and great restaurants and cafes.

Good location and fairly quiet despite a busy road. The bed and space were very comfortable.  A little clutter and smelly fridge were the only reason for one less star on cleanliness.  Daniel is super friendly.  We enjoyed the place and recommend it.

This apartment is located in a thriving neighbourhood and is in a perfect position for bars, dining, public transport and beautiful walks. The apartment was beautifully furnished and thoughtfully styled. Our stay here was amazing to say the least, as this cosy apartment really became home for our time in Berlin.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr gemütlich und gepflegt. Der ruhige Hinterhof ist eine grüne Oase. Wie schon einige hier geschrieben haben, lässt sich die Wohnung wegen des Oberlichts nicht vollständig verdunkeln. Ein Problem mit einer kaputten Jalousie löste Mina professionell und sehr entgegenkommend. Über die Nachrichtenfunktion kommen standardisierte Nachrichten, z.B. am Vorabend zum Checkout. Für schnellere oder individuelle Antworten ist es vermutlich besser, Mina direkt anzurufen. Die Kommunikation mit ihr hat trotzdem immer gut geklappt. Ich würde das Apartment wieder buchen.
We had a great time staying at this airbnb! The apartment is clean and stylish and Denny always replied super quickly.

Perfect for a short stay no longer than a 2-3 day -

Wat een heerlijk appartement. Leuk ingericht, schoon, heerlijk bed en lekkere douche. Super leuke buurt ook. En de communicatie met Gianni was top! Ik raad dit zeker aan.

We zijn een gezin van 4 met twee kinderen (9 en 13 jaar) en een kleine hond. We hebben echt van elk moment genoten in het schattige huisje. Het is zo creatief en smaakvol ingericht. Het geeft echt een heerlijk gevoel bij aankomst en telkens als je toekomt voel je je blij. Het huisje is gelegen in een rustige tuinwijk aan de Spree. Aan de overzijde van de Spree begint het stadsgewoel al en de S-bahn ligt op 1 km wandelen van het ferry aanmeer punt aan de andere kant van de Spree. De ligging is echt perfect. Aan het Spreepark zie je de locals genieten. Ook de tuin is een weelderig paradijsje, zeker voor onze kleine hond. We willen heel graag nig eens terugkomen, want we hadden te weinig tijd om alles te doen wat we wilden doen, en we houden gewoon van deze plek en van Berlijn. Sven heeft ons bij aankomst rondgeleid en is echt lief en sympathiek. Pablo heeft de communicatie vooraf en nadien gedaan, en die was altijd heel warm, en hij reageerde zeer snel. Het is kortom een echte aanrader

Simon’s apartment is fantastic. Incredibly well appointed, with everything you would need. Super comfortable, modern (in a heritage building) and stylish. Nice and quiet (essential for post-sightseeing rest!).
Lots of great options for dining and drinks close by. Fantastic neighbourhood feel.
Train very close by to get everywhere very easily.
Incredibly responsive and gracious hosts - nothing is too much trouble.
Would love to return some day!

Linda's little studio is the perfect haven for your trip to Berlin. Located in a local neighborhood with easily walkable access to bars, restaurants, and public transportation, it was such a treat to stay in a well considered and cozy space. Linda has fine-tuned every detail, from custom designed interior, great recommendations, maps, a record collection, and more. This is a wonderful place for anyone who wants a local experience in a quiet neighborhood, with a great design aesthetic. Thank you again Linda!

This is a beautiful apartment! I really enjoyed relaxing on the couch and on the balcony on sunny afternoons, and listening to music. A wonderful place to unwind after a weekend in Berlin. There are skylights in the apartment and an elevator (so you only have to climb up one short flight of stairs). Robin is accommodating and very responsive. I would recommend Robin’s place to anyone.
nice place to stay at when relaxing in Berlin
Very pleasant, quiet, clean, and centrally located. Was exactly what I was looking for.

Angela's description of her house and room does it a disservice. She undersells the room and get hospitality. A perfect host, who was extremely communicative prior to and during my stay. The room was vrightr, extremely clean, and airy. The location worked for me because of the conference I was attending. If you're flying into Schonefeld and want a great place to stay that's very accessible to the airport, stay at Angela's
Everything was great, thanks!

We had an amazing stay in Sören‘s flat! The apartment itself is very nice and has all necessary equipment for a short term stay, the Boxspring beds are super comfortable and the area is very quiet so a perfect time to relax after sightseeing!
Highly recommended for a stay in Berlin!

Tolle Unterkunft. Geschmackvoll eingerichtet und bietet alles was man braucht. gut erreichbar, 5 min bis zur M10.

everything was nice and great neighbourhood!!

Sehr unkomplizierte Kommunikation & hübsches Zimmer

Me and my partner stayed at OTA for about a month after leaving a shared flat. The chilean lady who gave us access to our room was extremely kind and welcoming and due to the nature of our situation offered us to store some of our stuff in their local storage to make it easier for us space wise. Also gave us the chance to switch to a much bigger room since our was tiny with all our stuff in it, which we didn't end up taking because we had everything moved already to the original room. The wifi acted a little weird sometimes, but even that counts as nothing if we see the  the big picture. We enjoyed the experience and in case we need a temporary stay again, OTA will be the first place we will think of. Thank you!
Great stay, location the room the facility. Clean and comfy. Only wish there is AC installed as the temperature was 28/29 degrees, a bit hard to fall into sleep at night when it’s warm.

This is a very stylish small flat with everything you need to be comfortable and a cosy sleeping loft. We really enjoyed our time here, it's so well located and comfortable. Really warm and cosy which was very nice in January. The description said the shower has limited hot water but we found it fine as long as you keep the pressure low. Overall a stylish, warm and comfortable space and close to many places to eat, bars and the U-Bahn. Perfect!

Janek was a great host. Very responsive, gave helpful recommendations and let us check in a bit earlier. The thing that was above and beyond alö expectations was the following: we needed a crip for our 2 year old daughter. We ordered it online and had it delivered ro Janek's place. He went and picked it up at the post office and even assembled the crip for us and had it ready upon our arrival! Extremely good and friendöy service and it made it easier for us to arrive there in the morning and put her down right away.
It was very nice and clean there, I would definitely recommend this airbnb

Prima uitvalsbasis voor Berlijn in de buurt van mijn familie. In de keuken kun je goed een maaltijd bereiden, de ruimte is functioneel ingedeeld. Wat mij betreft kan het wat gezelliger worden aangekleed maar dat is een kwestie van smaak. OV, winkels en restaurants op loopafstand. Niet al te levendige of gezellige buurt. Ook een beetje gehorig (buren, de gang, de straat) en al met al - ook door de bijkomende kosten van Airbnb-toch aan de prijzige kant voor wat je  krijgt. We had a great overnight stay! The location was perfect, just steps from the marathon route so we could cheer on our friend running. The space was very clean and the bed was comfortable. The only minor hiccup was that the shower head adjuster was broken, but we managed fine for a short stay.

Greg is an extremely welcoming host and it’s been great to stay at his flat. The apartment is spacious, nicely set up, and has everything you need including a pull up bar / yoga mat to work out, a good sound system in the living room, and a nice and well-furnished kitchen. There’s a desk you can work from and a terrace to enjoy the sunny days. The position couldn’t be better, right in the middle of the action between Kreuzberg and Neukolln. There are plenty of excellent cafés, brunch spots and restaurants nearby. This is his actual home, so don’t expect hotel standards, but it’s a very comfortable place to stay in.
NB: it’s on the fourth floor with no elevator. This was not an issue for me, but people with reduced mobility may find it a challenge.
Great host, very clear directions, apt just as in description. All good, no issues.
Everything was great!!!
Superbe expérience. Logement  propre. Axel très  sympathique.
Very good flat ! A light in the kitchen would be good :)
Il faut de bonnes cuisses pour monter les étages, mais l'appartement est près de tout (2 minutes d'un metro et d'une épicerie)

A great apartment in a very interesting and safe part of town. Spacious and clean, and very quiet. Kitchen facilities excellent, plus lovely hot shower. Plenty of towels. Very easy check-in. I will be re-booking.
5 stars. Great!
problem fri opphold.
Vielen Dank für die Unterkunft während einer Weiterbildung- gut erreichbar, wunderbares Haus und Menschen sowie angenehme Umgebung!

Me and my husband really enjoyed our stay! Gianni was very friendly and always kept in touch, responding to our messages very quickly. The kitchen was a bit small for us since we like to cook, but it was not a problem, we got used to it from the very first day. Grocery store and nice cafes are very close to the place. I really recommend this apartment, thank you Gianni!
We enjoyed our time there, the location was amazing and the installations succeeded our expectations.

Het hotel bevindt zich in een leuke wijk met verschillende koffietentjes en bakkerijen.

Very design and clean hotel apartment, with all quality equipment you need, and a nice view on a little park on one side. Just be careful if your sleep is fragile, the tram station is just under the bedroom's windows :(

The apartment was exactly as described in the listing and perfectly clean. Dlauar was responsive to all queries, and instructions for check-in and check-out were easy to follow. Near the apartment are supermarkets, shops and cafes making it a convenient place to stay. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend the apartment to groups - it was the perfect base for our trip to Berlin.

Chegamos as 11.p.m - e ela já estava esperando eu e meu irmão com todo paciência, nos mostrou todo apartamento, comentando que ainda poderia usar outras áreas da casa, sendo que só alugamos o quarto.

Tirando esse detalhe, otima localização, perto de metrô e ônibus, local limpo e seguro, não tive nenhum problema!
Tudo muito Bom.
Danke.

Between two bookings, I stayed for about two weeks at Camilla's flat. The neighborhood is top-notch, with the vibrant Kollwitzplatz just a short walk away. Ein Zimmer im Berlin Style, das mit viel Liebe zum Detail ausgestattet ist und in dem es an nichts fehlt. Wie auf den Fotos zu sehen schläft man in einem Hochbett. Wer nicht schwindelfrei ist, kann aber auf die Bettcouch ausweichen.

Had a very pleasant stay at Vlad’s place. Many transportation options around, the apartment is spacious, clean and minimalistic, the host was always helpful and responsive. Thank you!

This was our second time staying at Anna’s and everything met expectations once again.  Our visit was for family and Anna’s place is very convenient.  Anna met us for check-in and gave us some hints and tips for exploring more parts of Berlin.  The flat was spotless and tidy with clear instructions for how to use amenities etc.  Check-out was simple and easy.  I definitely home from home, thank you Anna.
Absolut empfehlenswert.

Apartamento muito bem localizado atendendo a que se trata de uma zona residencial tranquila mas muito bem servida por transportes públicos. Os autocarros 110 e 109 e o metro levam-nos a todos os principais pontos de referência e interfaces de transportes.
A casa é muito bonita, confortável, quente e limpa e tem todas as comodidades necessárias para uma viajem em família.
Para 8 pessoas uma só casa de banho pode ser pouco mas conseguimos gerir bem.
Recomendo vivamente.

Ich habe einige sehr entspannte Tage bei Sabrina verbracht und werde definitiv wiederkommen. Bei ihr fühlt man sich ab der ersten Minute prima aufgehoben. Das Zimmer ist groß und optimal ausgestattet und durch die ruhige Gegend sind die Nächte sehr ruhig. Lieben Dank für alles, Sabrina.

Emplacement idéal pour vadrouiller dans toute la ville. Très proche du métro. Restaurant, supermarché et boulangerie à proximité.
Carte de la ville dans l’appartement et conseils d’Axel à notre arrivée au top. Nous avons pu faire pratiquement tout à pied et ce n’est pas déplaisant malgré la petite pluie. Rien ne nous a arrêté :) on recommande et on reviendra sûrement.

Nik's apartment is exactly as pictured and described.  Comfortable for 2 people, it was very clean, well organized and quiet.
