Het is een fijne plek om naar toe te gaan, op de eerste etage. Er islekker veel licht, een goed bed, een klein koelkastje, een lekkere bank, een TV, veel video's. Stijlvol. Een gedeelde badkamer met bad en wc. Het huis is alleenstaand en rondom ligt tuin.

This is a nice apartment, in a nice building, in a great area. Central to everything. Safe. Convenient. Clean.
Americans will make the mistake that it is on the “first floor” - Europeans call the second floor, the first. There are 25 steps to get to this apartment. Good to know if you have heavy luggage, as you may need to ask Marcus for help.
I also had another experience that I didn’t read that anyone else has had, in the reviews. I did not sleep one minute more at night, than the lady upstairs did, as every single foot step, chair moving, water running, door closing, etc. can be heard clearly.
I’m also an Airbnb host and one of my properties was built in 1894, so I get it. It’s challenging. I warn People in the listing, that tenants also live upstairs, and its an old building.
This apartment is in a quiet neighborhood, and quiet courtyard and when the lady upstairs goes out, it is quiet upstairs.
She sleeps from about midnight to between 5:30am - 7:30am. I was woken From a deep jet-lagged sleep every morning when she got up.
Marcus was nice and offered to talk to her mid stay, and to bring me ear plugs. I had already tried ear plugs. By the last night I was using my own ear plugs, with old school Beat head phones over them, while playing music and was able to at least fall back asleep, eventually.
I can’t explain why no one else had an issue. Maybe if you are not jet lagged and exhausted by 9pm, and also just naturally want to sleep from 12pm-7am... then it’s fine? And also if you are used to apartment living or are a deeper sleeper. I don’t know. But I’m none of the above, and It was an issue for me.
The apartment is good, beyond that. And again, I can’t explain why I’m the only one to mention it.
Also, a woman knocked on my door one day asking for a pillow from my closet. I was taking a nap (from being up at 7am) and so I was probably out of it. I think she said she was the property manager from the art gallery. I was very confused as she wasn’t a guy (Marcus who I never met) and I had no idea there was an art gallery or why she’d need a pillow from me. Marcus later clarified she is his colleague. So, Just FYI, you may meet a woman or a man, they work together, apparently.
So if you are a good sleeper, it’s a good place.
Angenehmer Aufenthalt

wir haben den Aufenthalt bei Ellen und Thomas sehr genossen. Wir könnten früher einchecken, hatten netten Kontakt zu ihnen. Das Zimmer ist obwohl zur Straßenbahn raus sehr ruhig. Klare Empfehlung von uns!!!!
Thanks for your hosting, it’s very nice of you!
location was fantastic, so easy to get about and lots of shops restaurants near by. the host was very responsive and helpful. apartment was great, has everything you needed. thank you

Stefan's apartment has an excellent location on a quiet street a short distance from the Tiergarten, grocers, cafés, and public transit. Stefan was very welcoming, helpful, and responsive. I arrived early morning and dropped off my bags without issue. Wifi is great and apartment is clean. I would definitely recommend staying here!
Great and comfortable room in central Berlin! Would def recommend!

Cons:
1) Expensive for a hostel, I paid around SGD 50+ per night, which is more expensive than previous hostels I've stayed at before (all of them were <40 SGD). It is better to book through the official website of Singer hostel because cheaper.
2) I stayed in mixed dorm, and the shower had HORRIBLE privacy. showers had NO LOCKS on them, and anyone could just open the shower door! No privacy or security!
Also, there's absolutely nowhere near the shower area to hang our clothes and towels. There's a ledge by the sinks, but that would require me to walk out the shower fully naked if I wanted to retrieve my clothes.
3) Anyone can pick and choose their beds, but this posed an issue because some guy who checked in earlier than me took over my locker space. Also, the lockers suck because they're so heavy, and you have to drag them out fully from under the bed and then lift the heavy wooden cover. It's a back-breaking task.
Pros: Counter people were very nice and helpful and it was clean

Świetna lokalizacja doslownie sekunde od stacji metra, ogolem okolice jak to i cały berlin wieczorem trzeba uważać na siebie. Pokój mały, ale schludny zapewniał wszystko co potrzeba, w gorące dni moze byc natomiast ciepło. Zameldowanie 24/7

A beautiful outlook over the trees in the neighbouring park. Quiet and efficient layout . The access to public transport options is great. Overall a place of refuge in a bustling city.

Guido ist ein total netter Kerl! Wenn ich wieder nach Berlin muss, gerne wieder! Ich habe mich total wohl gefühlt und alles war perfekt 👍🏻

It is remarkably quiet(we were able to sleep without any disturbance, and I'm a light sleeper), and ideal for two friends who want to hang out in Berlin as there are two bedrooms.

Claudia’s place is awesome. We were in a group of 7 and we felt the space was comfortable for us all. The space itself is well designed and the art is a special touch. Close enough to public transport that we easily navigated the entire city. I would stay here again!

Really great place for a getaway with a large group of friends. Lots of space for the 8 people we had. Werner is very responsive and accommodating. He provides lots of things so you don’t need to worry about them - eg lots of cooking utensils and ingredients, shower products, lots of toilet paper and 3 hairdryers. Has a great little outside area and the flat is close to a lot of parks and cool cafes and bars in the NeuKolln area.

As a musician to have a piano and be able to practice in the space is a great advantage, and the host is very generous and understanding of musicians/artists and very accommodating,  I was able to sing opera in the space freely which was invaluable. There were nice touches such as a CD and beer put out on arrival. Stephan also provided great suggestions about local bakeries and eateries which were very handy and which were very enjoyable eg a great artisan bakery around the corner with great coffee. The bed is comfortable . The one suggestion I would make would be some better curtains and a blind on the kitchen window for privacy at night, so as not to have to strategically manoeuvre doors to provide this and perhaps no food left from other guests eg half a packet of crisps, milk in fridge and 99per cent used nutella etc but that may be something others would appreciate and would not be bothered by so it is not a strong criticism and the place was clean.  But the living space (a loft) is cosy and quite comfortable and great for artistic types and very very warm with the portable heater. The history of the building seems quite interesting too as regards the Berlin wall and all in all it was a great Berlin experience and I would recommend it to people who value having an easily accessible practice space.

Look no further, y’all — this is THE best AirBnb in the Berlin area.
First and foremost, Martina is just lovely. She is warm, welcoming, and incredibly thoughtful. She has thought of everything that might make a guest comfortable, and she goes above and beyond when it comes to making your stay relaxing and peaceful. Just one example: my luggage was lost the day I arrived in Berlin, and Martina, without hesitating, furnished me with all of the essentials, including pajamas!
Second, the location — you can’t beat it! You are a five-minute walk away from the S1, which gets you into the city in less than thirty minutes. But, there are lots of parks, running trails, and beautiful green spaces near Martina’s home, so you get the perfect balance of peacefulness from residential Lichterfelde with easy accessibility into Berlin Mitte. There is also a grocery store, bakery, and pharmacy — all just five minutes away on foot.
Finally, the home itself — a gorgeous Altbauwohnung that is stylishly decorated. The bed is comfortable, the balcony is lovely, and everything is very clean. There’s also a writing desk in the room, which makes this place great for anyone traveling on business.
And — as a bonus: Martina is a truly excellent Alexander Technique teacher. I am a professional opera singer, and I cannot tell you how much of a luxury it was to have access to Alexander Technique after two days of international travel. If you suffer from back or neck pain, want to improve your posture, or find more awareness in how you move your body, I highly recommend Martina as an Alexander Technique practitioner. I’m looking forward to continuing lessons with her in the winter!
Really, this is the best AirBnb experience I’ve ever had, and I would highly recommend Martina’s listing to anyone looking for a “home away from home” while visiting Berlin. Viel Spaß! :)

In Wohnung Beschreibung  steht „ für 5 Personen“, aber realistisch ist nur für 3 -4 Personen.  Das Kühlschrank ist so laut, das hat uns bei Schlafen sehr gestört . Wir können noch empfehlen Tee und Kaffee zu kaufen, vielleicht kleine Flasche Olivenöl in Salz und Pfeffer, Toilettenpapier auch besorgen.
Brilliant location. Friendly staff.
Great accommodation, in an easily accessible of area of Berlin. Everything inside the flat was pristine and lovely.
Excellent service.

Nice place with an essential kitchen, really close to the tram and Alexanderplatz. Beds are confortables, walls are really thin so you can hear neighbours during the day but at night everything is dead silent. Cool block, you feel safe walking by night, we also went to Berghain by feet.
The bathroom curtains were mouldy and the ground tends to get flooded after every shower. That's the only part that's. really lacking

Apparemment lumineux, très bien situé, à 5min à pied d’une station de métro
Idéal pour passer un agréable séjour à Berlin
Tout est conforme a la description, appartement parfait !

Mi sono adattata all'appartamento. Purtroppo le finestre danno sul marciapiede e non ci sono gli oscuranti dei vetri dappertutto, quindi bisogna tenere sempre le tende chiuse. Vorrei dare un consiglio, comprare delle piastre da cucina nuove e mettere un lavandino accanto al fornello perchè non è molto igienico lavare i piatti nel lavandino del bagno. Io mi sono adattata e se dovessse servirmi lo riaffitteró. Nel caso spero di trovare un lavandino in cucina ;)
La casa è molto calda, fornita di ogni tipo di prodotto per la casa. Tanta biancheria di ricambio.
La zona è molto tranquilla.
Mi sono trovata molto bene.
Overall a great place to stay

Ben ist ein wirklich toller, bemühter Gastgeber! Dank des sehr netten Empfangs (Ben hat sogar beim Koffertragen geholfen) habe ich mich direkt zuhause gefühlt und drei tolle Monate in Berlin verbracht! Komme gerne wieder! :)
The house is very nice, place is clean. Everything in kitchen is available for cooking. Dirk and his family are very kind.

The apartment was great! Great location and spotless when we arrived. We struggled slightly with the opening of the door but Klaus was super responsive and left a spare key for us in case. We would definitely recommend!
The location and the flat were good, the communication with Olivier was easy and our stay was smooth sailing. I can recommend the flat for your stay in Berlin.

Georgios no estaba en berlin durante mi viaje pero me dio el numero de su amigo chris que fue quien nos recibió en el apartamento y nos contó buenas zonas para salir por Berlín. Tanto él como el propio Georgios muy atentos por si había algún problema. El apartamento tal y como sale en las fotos,muy limpio y cómodo. Tiene parada de tranvía al lado y buenos restaurantes cerca. Creo que no hubieramos estado mejor en otro sitio, volvería a Berlín y a este apartamento sin dudarlo. 100% recomendable.
We had a good time at this Airbnb, it is very spacious, clean, and in a good location.
The place is exactly what is offered and it is really confortable. Kreuzberg is a great area and you will find nice bars and restaurants nearby
Franziska and her family were very accommodating. The space is private and clean, not to mention it has a very comfortable bed. Definitely a great place to rest between exploring and touring museums.

Fabian e il padre sono molto disponibili. Rispondo in poco tempo e sono pazienti, comprensivi e gentili. Il posto è piuttosto connesso con il centro, non abbiamo avuto difficoltà nel raggiungere velocemente anche a piedi le attrazioni turistiche. Pecca il senso unico ma non è niente. Non avendo ascensore è stato scomodo trasportare le valigie, ma un po’ di esercizio fa sempre bene. Servizi che offre sono ottimi, c’è un ottimo bollitore, aspirapolvere, phon, prodotti da bagno e persino profumi che si possono usare. Letto comodo, cuscini un po’ meno, c’è anche un ventilatore molto forte e comodo.

This is a gem apartment. It's super minimal and chic. The location is amazingly close to everything. It's a prime location near restaurants, shopping, cafes, and the supermarket. There's an awesome restaurant right downstairs that has the best food with a lovely interior. There's a mini fridge to put in groceries or drinks. The best part is the HEATED FLOORS and full ceilng to floor windows. Lots of natural sunlight in the morning as you wake up. I would stay here again if I ever came back to Berlin. Klaus was an amazing host who stayed in communication with us whenever we needed, even when he was on vacation!  Very caring and responsive. I definitely recommend this place.
Angenehmer Aufenthalt

Matthieu’s place is exactly as it looks on the pictures. The apartment is conveniently located and very close to public transport. It was fantastic to have a supermarket right under the apartment as well as several others close by. Matthieu is very friendly and responsive and we could not have asked for a better host or place to stay. The coffee machine is excellent too :-) Highly recommend this place to stay in Berlin!
Excelente hostal

Molto consigliato! Posizione comoda a 5 minuti a piedi dalla metro. Francesco e la sua famiglia sono stati molto disponibili fornendo consigli su cosa visitare e mostrandoci tutto ciò che era disponibile nell'appartamento. Ottima anche la comunicazione con loro prima e durante il soggiorno.
Ett ovanligt fint Airbnb, bekvämt, rent och spatiöst av hög klass vilket gör det hela väldigt bekvämt. En mycket charmig värdinna dessutom fullbordade det hela.
Absolut zentral gelegen. Für meinen Geschmack etwas zu dunkel gestrichen und abgewohnt - plus Interior sehr durcheinander - denke aber dies ist der gewollte Retro-Styl. Nettes Team vor Ort.
Sehr schöne Unterkunft. Alles vorhanden was man braucht, dazu sehr nette Gastgeber!

Wohnung sehr praktisch gelegen, U-Bahn wenige Minuten entfernt Richtung Zoo. Gutes Preis-Leistungsverhältnis, großzügig mit genug Platz für 3-4 Personen. Die Kommunikation mit Thomas war schnell und präzise. Nähe Wilmersdorfer Straße und doch ganz ruhig.

Julian is a great host, we spent time in his place in Christmas and could not ask for a better place. The market and tram just a walking distance away. The view of the park and all the great locations just a step away. When we wanted, we could feel at home resting at the flat and cooking for ourselves. And when we looked for more actions, we were but a few minutes away from the centre by tram or metro.
Good place to stay for interactions with other backpackers!
Sehr freundlicher, unkomplizierter Empfang. Sehr ruhige Lage und gleichzeitig gute ÖPNV-Anbindung. Komme gerne wieder.
Die Unterkunft sieht genau so aus wie auf den Bildern, sehr schön und sauber. Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und komme gerne wieder.
Heel fijne en ruime kamer met eigen badkamer in het smaakvolle huis van Julia. Ze gaf ons veel ruimte en alle vertrouwen. Leuke, levendige wijk.
War alles gut

Super gelegene, saubere und für zwei Personen großzügige Wohnung. Der Gastgeber ist sehr nett und zuvorkommend und alles war sauber und aufgeräumt.
Die Lage ist das Besondere, in direkter Nähe zur Berliner Fressmeile, durch die Fenster zum Innenhof trotzdem absolut ruhig. Sehr zu empfehlen.

excellent accueil et très bonne communication.
nous avons passé un excellent séjour.
Hâte de revenir !🫶
Wonderful apartment, stylish decor with plenty of space

Besondere Unterkunft in Guter Lage in Neukölln!
Trotz Hauptstraße ruhig genug zum Schlafen.
Checkin, Kommunikation und Abwicklung waren super easy, gerne wieder!
Everything was good and as expected, very Quick contact with Philip
Very helpful guy and great apartment. Some issues with the listing however as we were seeing different check in and check out times.
Unterkunft wie auf den Bildern und sehr schöne Lage. ☀️

It was really comforting and nice to stay at Sophia's place.
She takes care and is interested in her guests.
We felt home immediately.
I am a musician and was looking for a place to busk and than she gave me the great tip to play at the Admiralbrucke. That was a great experience.
I highly recommend Sophia's house for a stay in Berlin!

Eine außergewöhnliche und wunderschöne Unterkunft. Die Wohnung ist toll, die Villa und der Garten sind extrem beeindruckend.
Die Ausstattung ist sehr gut, es ist alles da, was man braucht. Heike und ihr Mann sind sehr nett. Wir kommen sicher wieder :-)
Angela ist eine super liebe Gastgeberin. Ich habe mich total gefreut bei ihr zu Gast sein zu dürfen!

Superbe séjour ! Le logement était impeccable, confortable et conforme à la description. Très bien situé, il nous a permis de profiter pleinement de notre voyage. L’hôte a été très réactif et accueillant, rendant notre expérience encore plus agréable. Nous recommandons sans hésitation et reviendrons avec plaisir !
Great stay,  nice space, easy access to the m1, responsive host.

Ruhig und privat, habs sehr geliebt!
Tolle Anbindung zu den öfis

Die Unterkunft eignet sich für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in der Stadt. Es ist alles da, was man braucht. Die Wohnung ist aber etwas dunkel, da sie im Erdgeschoss im Hof liegt und kein richtiges Fenster vorhanden ist, nur eine Glastür.
Die Wohnung war im großen und ganzen sauber, allerdings könnte die Sauberkeit der Küchenutensilien besser geprüft werden.
Tip Top jederzeit wieder, vielen Dank

I had an excellent stay. The place was spotless, and the location was convenient for work and several of the main bus routes.
Jurgen went above and beyond to make the stay seamless and welcoming.
I couldn’t recommend this Airbnb more highly and would happily stay here again.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Wat een geweldige accommodatie! Alles was tot in de puntjes verzorgd: schoon, stijlvol ingericht en van alle gemakken voorzien. De locatie was perfect — rustig maar toch dicht bij alles wat je nodig hebt. De host was ontzettend vriendelijk en behulpzaam, wat het verblijf nog aangenamer maakte. Echt een aanrader voor iedereen die op zoek is naar comfort en een vleugje luxe. Ik kom hier zeker terug!
Good location near public transportation
Excellent séjour à Berlin ! Logement très propre et identique aux photos ! Les hôtes sont très sympas et réactifs, je recommande !
Great location near many bars and restaurants. Host has great communication. Very nicely designed studio and a comfortable stay. Occasional lack of hot water. Would recommend.

Benjamin and Dascha were excellent hosts.  Even though a delayed flight meant we checked in late, they were still up and ready to welcome us to the apartment. The apartment itself looks great and is well appointed, and near lots of good restaurants.

Haider and Sabastian are very easy-going guys. We arrived quite late but that wasn‘t any issue for them. The location is great and very central. Next to that, there are lots of good coffees around where you can have breakfast…Haider and Sabastian were more than happy to give us suggestions👍🏻

Katja's place was wonderful! The apartment was very cool with quirky-urban furnishings and the balcony was an extra special treat. The neighborhood was fantastic - lots of cute and cozy bars, cafes and restaurants, but overall very clean and not loud. The only minor thing was that in the house the walls were a bit thin, so you might want to bring earplugs if you're a very light sleeper, but it didn't bother us. I would very much recommend Katja's place, if you're looking for a cool and cozy place in a superb neighborhood in Berlin.
Great place to stay away from the rat race and get amongst a local village, and great value for money
房間跟廁所都很乾淨，房東很和善
The location of the flat was very perfect four our trips in Berlin. Also the style of the flat was really nice. We had enough space for us 3. We defiently recommend this apartment!
Sauber, gute Lage, top Kommunikation, einfacher Check in and check out. 👍👍

A nice apartment in a area with great transport links. The apartment was very clean but as a previous reviewer said the decor is dated and could do with updating . The kitchen was a bit too small to cook in but lots of restaurants close by so not a problem. We initially had a problem with the wifi but Alla responded quickly to my messages and problem was sorted.
Tolle Gastgeber, kleine aber feine Unterkunft, super ruhig gelegen, Anbindung Bus/Bahn in unmittelbarer Nähe
Logement idéal pour un week-end ! Merci Alex pour l’accueil.

We were able to communicate with host easily and arranged to meet a contact upon our arrival. Check in/out went smoothly.
The unit itself was great and as advertised. It was large, bright, clean and had everything we needed. It was well located and just a few minutes from bus and subway in a very nice quiet neighborhood. There were nearby restaurants, grocery stores and coffee shops. We usually ate breakfast in and the kitchen was well equipped with a toaster, kettle, and all necessary dishes, etc.
We greatly enjoyed coming home after a long day of sightseeing to a quiet and comfortable spot to hang out, much appreciated the ability to plug in our music, connect to the internet without problem and either sit inside or on the balcony overlooking the inner courtyard.
Overall a fantastic spot with no surprises, we would definitely come back again the next time we are in Berlin. Thanks Anna.
Had a great stay in Berlin. Apartment was clean and in a great location. Outdoor patio was a good plus!
The apartment is great, just as shown in the pictures. The location is perfect to get almost everywhere on foot. We would highly recommend it!
A great spot. Close to a number of ubahn lines, grocery stores, coffee shops and great restaurants. A great value for a spot in the heart of Berlin.
Super Lage, entspannte Atmosphäre und sehr sauber. Wir hatten das Doppelzimmer mit eigenem Bad und waren sehr zufrieden. Besonders hervorzuheben sind die freundlichen und hilfsbereiten Mitarbeiter.

Separate entrance and own toilet was great. Very close to both bus and U Bann links to take you into Central Berlin, Whilst the area itself had a lovely feel to it.  Loads of places to eat, and some quirky shops.  Amazingly close to Schloss Charlottenburg quite literally minutes away, and well worth a visit.  The wonderful bakery below has great food, but occasionally makes a little noise early morning.  Not a real problem unless you are a really light sleeper.  Would recommend the 3 day Museum ticket if you are a culture vulture,  Do not hesitate to book here as Moe was a great host.  Would return.
Eine schicke, sehr gepflegte Altbauwohnung  im Erdgeschoss, ruhig und doch nah an öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln der Schönhauser Allee.  Die Gastgeberin ist sehr zuvorkommend.
Sehr schöne und geräumige Wohnung. Stilvolle Einrichtung in heller Umgebung. Waren mit 6 Personen vor Ort und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Clean space, helpful host, and superb location! Very walkable with great restaurants and cafes nearby.

The apartment is wonderful, well furbished, warm in winter, very comfortable and with everything you might need. The communication with Bianka was easy and quick. Also there is plenty of parking space nearby, no noises at night, an Aldi some meters away, and one big tram station around 15mins walking. I can very much recommend it.
This location was very convenient and ideal for those looking to explore Berlin. It is close to various transport links. It is also very comfortable and you most definitely feel safe.

My stay at Maria's apartment was pleasant and easy. Maria is very nice and the communication and coordination around the check-in were super easy. The private room is spacious and bright. I appreciated that I was welcomed in the room with a bottle of water and some cookies. The only thing I need to mention (and that I didn't see before my stay) is that smoking is allowed in Maria's apartment. I would not recommend this Airbnb to anyone who is not a smoker him/herself or is sensitive to cigaret smell.

Appartement is schoon en ruim en gelegen in een leuke buurt, dichtbij openbaar vervoer en leuke restaurants. Communicatie met de eigenaar is erg vlot en duidelijk. We waren met een groep van vier en hebben een heel fijn verblijf gehad in Berlijn!

We absolutely loved our stay at Arne’s place with his two beautiful cats Doris and Uwe. Arne made us feel right at home and his place had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The location is perfect with lots of restaurants, cafes and bars around and close to public transport. Would definitely recommend for a stay in Berlin.

Ursula's apartment is stunningly beautiful, elegant, and has everything you could need for a wonderful time in Berlin. We felt at home straight away.
Travel links are excellent, and the area of Kreuzberg has lots of bars, restaurants and bookshops. We couldn't recommend Ursula's apartment more highly!
Dejligt sted. Super velfungerende lejlighed.

Sehr unkomplizierte und direkte Kommunikation mit Wolfgang, für mich hat alles hat perfekt gepasst. Die Wohnung ist ein stilsicher eingerichteter Berliner Altbau mit hohen Decken, viel Licht und sehr guter Lage direkt am U-Bahnhof Eisenacher Straße. Gerne wieder!
Great location, nice host
Amazing place. Great location, comfy beds, everything works fine (the oven was a bit battered A little under equipped in terms of kitchen ware and no air con. Aside from that brilliant

Fantastisk husvert, vil anbefale å bo hos henne, nært til det man trenger. Når man har parkert bilen, som var gratis i sidegatene, så var det bare å benytte seg av offentlig transport. Veldig lettvint😊

Ein großes Zimmer mit gut isolierten Fenstern, sodass man absolute Ruhe hat. Karina ist super nett und offen. Die Küche kann mitbenutzt werden und man kann sich in den Garten setzen. Insgesamt ein super Aufenthalt, jederzeit gerne wieder.
You have to stay yourself and immediately understand, how good decision you made,  enjoy 🍷🍷!!

Wir hatten ein paar tolle Tage in Yurys Wohnung. Die Wohnung ist toll dekoriert und gibt einfach ein unglaublich gemütliches Feeling. Es ist gut gelegen und man kommt überall bequem hin.
ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen und hier ein Wochenende verbringen.
dicke Empfehlung ❤️

Carlos foi um anfitrião impecável. Gentil e solícito desde o primeiro momento permitindo check in antecipado. O apartamento é espaçoso e muito confortável com uma linda vista do lago. A localização é excelente próximo a transporte público, se retornar a Berlim me hospedaria lá novamente.

Die Lage des Apartments ist super! Wir hatten überall hin kurze Wege.
Der Check-in und der Check-out haben toll funktioniert. Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet.
Wir haben uns sehr darüber gefreut, dass sogar Handtücher, Duschsachen, Kaffee und Tee da waren.
Wir können die Unterkunft auf jeden Fall weiter empfehlen!
Immer gerne wieder .
serdecznie polecam wynajmującego

5 Sterne ⭐️ verdienst der Sven und alle Begleiter 🤩ES WAR ALLES PERFEKT 👌 DANKE DAFÜR
Der Blick aus dem Fenster in der 10.Etage auf den Alexanderturm war einmalig vor allen Abend und bliebt für immer in Erinnerung..wenn wir nochmal nach Berlin vereisen sollten kommen wieder 👋😀Lg MIRA

My stay at this apartment was great: the hosts were nice and accommodating. The place is modern, clean and equipped with everything that one may need. The location is perfect to explore Berlin and several supermarkets, cafes, etc. are also just some streets down and within walking distance.
We had a very pleasant and comfortable stay in this apartment.
Wir waren rundum zufrieden und würden die Unterkunft jederzeit wieder buchen. Danke!
Schöne Wohnung in einer ruhigen Lage, genau das, was wir gesucht haben. Vielen Dank!
A gorgeous apartment in a great location! Close to lots of bars and restaurants, and good transport links nearby. Perfect base to experience Berlin. Thank you for our stay!
Gemütliches Zimmer bei sehr sympathischer Familie, die Ihren Gästen großes Vertrauen entgegen bringt und super hilfsbereit ist. Sehr zu empfehlen.
This is a stylish and cozy place.  Made my first experience to Berlin the best.  Good food options around.  Nice locals around the neighborhood.
Très bel appartement dans un quartier très agréable et très bien desservi pour visiter Berlin!

Meine Erwartungen wurden übertroffen! Die Lage ist top, die Zimmer sind sauber und alles war da was benötigt wurde. Die Hosts waren sehr zuvorkommend und haben an alles gedacht.
Der Check-in & Check-out verliefen reibungslos dank der Nachricht die vor der Anreise an mich geschickt wurde. Besser hätte es nicht laufen können. Vielen Dank an die Hosts!
Schöne Wohnung, super Host. Gerne wieder

We zijn voor de tweede keer in het appartement van Steffen verbleven en opnieuw was dit een heel prettige ervaring. Voor ons is dit appartement perfect omdat dit zeer dicht is bij het werk wat wij in Berlijn hebben. De plek is rustig, achterin het tweede binnenhof. Het is ruim genoeg voor twee personen. De badkamer is enorm, de keuken heel praktisch en netjes en alles is aanwezig voor een prima verblijf. Met mooi weer kan je ook lekker op je vlonder voor het appartementje zitten, waarbij je de deur naar de keuken open zet. Kortom een prima plek om te verblijven als je Berlijn wil verkennen en als je rustig wil kunnen slapen.

Katrin and her family were very welcoming and made the stay enjoyable. I arrived very late at night, and was surprised and happy to see a bottle of water waiting for me on the nightstand. Overall the stay was quiet, and I had the floor largely to myself. They also offered to prepare me breakfast, which I thought was sweet.

Communication was great weeks before I arrived, and during my stay. Katrin and Fritjof were both very responsive and made sure I felt comfortable during my journey and during my stay.

It's around a 5 minute walk from the U3 Dahlem Dorf station, and a fairly easy walk (from the house, you walk straight until the first crossing, and then turn left until you reach the station). The neighbourhood was green, quiet, and the neighbors seemed friendly.

The only negative thing I could say is that the WiFi didn't seem to connect very well in the room, but it worked great in the kitchen area, which had a table where you can do your work.

Overall, I found the stay enjoyable and quiet.

Wir - meine Schwester und ich - hatten einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt bei Frau Liu.
Frau Liu ist sehr freundlich und jederzeit erreichbar, falls etwas gebraucht wird.
Das Haus ist sehr schön eingerichtet und liegt in einer angenehmen ruhigen Umgebung.
Die Britzer Gärten sind fußläufig erreichbar und bieten die Gelegenheit zu einem Spaziergang im Grünen.
Das Dachstudio ist schön und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Das Bett ist sehr bequem und hat eine gute Matratze. Wir haben wunderbar geschlafen. Es ist ausreichend groß für 2 Personen.
Für uns war es auch sehr vorteilhaft, dass wir jederzeit einen Parkplatz direkt vor der Türe hatten.
Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel - z.B. U7 - sind aber auch in unter 10 Minuten zu Fuß zu erreichen.
Kaffee gibt’s ständig dank modernem Kaffeevollautomaten. Die Milch dazu hat Frau Liu uns bereit gestellt.
Alles in allem eine tolle Unterkunft, die ich sehr empfehlen kann - v.a. wenn man nachts Ruhe haben möchte - und die ich jederzeit wieder buchen würde.
Everything was great! The place looked exactly like the photos. :) The instructions for the check in was clear.
Es war mega super bei Leona ! Das Zimmer war spitze! Das Bett war der Oberhammer bequem! Alles super. Kommunikation sehr easy, Beschreibungen super! Danke für die tolle Zeit!
Great place for a small group or two couples. The front door goes right out to the Berlin street life. Loads of good bars and cafés close.

Die Lage ist sehr gut. Ein Rewe ist fußläufig erreichbar, somit braucht man zum Einkaufen nicht unbedingt ein Auto, zumal die Parkplatzsituation recht bescheiden ist. Wir hatten Glück, direkt einen Parkplatz vor der Haustür bekommen zu haben. Daher blieb das Auto auch die ganze Zeit dort stehen, zumal die S-Bahnstation (Wollankstraße) 5 Gehminuten entfernt ist und man mit der Bahn in 10-15 Minuten in der Innenstadt von Berlin ist.
Die Wohnung an sich ist ein 1-Zimmer-Apartment mit Küche und Badezimmer. Schön eingerichtet und sauber. Bei einem erneuten Berlinbesuch würden wir diese Wohnung/Apartment wieder buchen.
Rien à dire c'était très bien.

Het verblijf was helaas niet heel prettig, omdat er in de nacht werd aangebeld om 5:00. We hebben hierdoor een enorm slechte nachtrust gehad. En de mensen die daar wonen waren aan het schreeuwen voor onze deur. Een van ons is naar buiten gegaan om deze mensen toe te spreken. De nacht ervoor was ook erg rumoerig en de douche bleef lekken waar we wakker van bleven.
Een aantal van ons waren erg onrustig geworden, omdat het vanaf het begin met de sleutel niet goed liep. Bij het openen van het kastje was de sleutel niet aanwezig, dit was erg vervelend na een lange rit. Dit probleem is nu opgelost voor volgende gasten, omdat er een extra sleutelkastje is neergezet.
Goede locatie, maar niet geschikt voor een fijne nachtrust.

Upsides:
- super smooth and simple checkin and booking communication
- well equipped room
- clean facilities
- great location
Downsides:
- air conditioning seemed to be broken: it was very warm and noisy, and even though we switched it off it did not change anything about the temperature; thus we had the choice between an open window and loud metro noises or very warm temperatures at night.
- TV did not work; we reported this to the hotline and were promised someone would come over and check the next day. We never got feedback on this and the TV remained broken.
Overall, we would like to come back as the place is nice and has potential. But taken into account the malfunctioning air conditioning/heating and the broken TV as well as not reacting to us reporting this, we would not like to spend another two almost sleepless nights there.
Polina is a gracious, accommodating and pleasant host.  She went above and beyond to meet my needs, which I a thankful for.  I would highly recommend this listing, the apartment was impeccable.
Kurzbesuch in Berlin. Spontan gebucht. Super Apartment mit allem was man sich wünscht. Sehr schick!

Wibke is super friendly and welcome. The house is cozy and private enough. We had a great time in Berlin, and key factor was the place and wibke’s availability for what we’ve request
Recommend!
Notre séjour à Berlin a été très agréable .L'appartement est très confortable et bien situé pour toutes les visites dans la ville. Et l'accueil a été très aimable et efficace.
Ruhige, helle, schön eingerichtete Wohnung mit guter Ausstattung. Sehr gut erreichbar mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Lebhafte urbane und vielfältige Umgebung.
Great location, actually even larger than it appears on the photos. Provides everything needed, communication and check-in went very smoothly. All together a great stay, thanks a lot!!

Rosario is a gracious host.
The place is comfortable and very well located.
Guys, just not forget the 100 euro deposit for the keys.
I overlooked that, so do not make the same mistake that I did! Fortunately, I had the money with me.
Bottomline: all good! I recommend it!
Todo bien. Alex nos recibió en la puerta y nos dejó las instrucciones claras para salir al día siguiente. Todo bien, muy buen anfitrión. Gracias!
Unforgetable

Our stay here was adequate. Feels more like a hostel than a hotel with the shared bathrooms and kitchen. Thoughts are as follows:
What we liked:
- able to use parking free of charge
- located close to Tempelhof airport and also transport links to the city centre
- comfy beds and fan provided
- shared kitchen and fridge available for use.
- private rooms
where they can improve:
- piping in shower partly broken and thus pressure not good. Water also doesn't get very hot in showers opposite room 3.
- staff smoking cigarettes down stairwell from kitchen so kitchen area smells of cigarette smoke.
- windowsills a bit dusty.
overall the place was a comfy stay, but there is room for improvement.

Everything was great! just maybe take care of fulfill the shampoo and soups on every cleaning day during the week.

The space matched the photos exactly. Both the bed and sofa bed were comfortable, with bedding provided.
Monique stayed in touch, gave clear check-in/out instructions, and kindly offered help with luggage after checking out.
Overall, we’d recommend and would happily stay again.

Great apartment in wonderful Prenzlauer Berg. Very spacious and nice with a great rooftop outdoor area. Highly recommended! Would absolutely visit again.

Lucia’s apartment is very spacious, tastefully furnished and well connected with public transport. Communication with Lucia was straightforward and everything went according to our expectations. Highly recommended for a stay in Neukölln.

This apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a great location that was quiet yet central. My friend and I had a wonderful time, and we could walk to the Tiergarten, cafes along the Spree, vintage shops, and famous döner kebab in different directions. I would stay here again.
Great accommodation in a very good area, and a great host - Very responsive and friendly. Recommended
Anna is very responsive, clean, and her place is stunning!

We enjoyed our time at Denise & Jürgen's place and wish we could've stayed longer. They were both friendly and helpful and provided great recommendations. We loved how easy it was to get around Berlin from their place; it's even easy to get to & from the airport. We recommend this beautiful room without hesitation.

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour dans l'appartement d'Anke qui se trouve dans un quartier résidentiel en périphérie du centre de Berlin. Le logement est à proximité de la ligne de Tram M4 permettant de rejoindre Alexanderplatz en 20 minutes.
Le concept de maison en bois est très sympathique notament en terme thermique. En revanche côté isolation phonique c'est pas génial. Nous entendions les voix et les aboiements du chien qui nous ont réveillés durant les deux dernières nuits.
Mis à part ces désagréments, Anke reste une hôte attentionnée et son logement bien adapté à un citybreak Berlinois.

We had a fabulous four days in David & Lillit’s place. They were great hosts, super flexible with check in and very responsive.
The apartment is very stylish, spacious and worked perfectly for our group of 6. It’s ideally placed for exploring Berlin and super close to lots of bars, restaurants and coffee
shops.
Would definitely recommend this as a place to stay and would love to come back! Thanks again.
Rachel & family, Sydney, Australia
alles war super !

La verdad nos gusto mucho, el lugar tiene un diseño contemporáneo, nuevo y agradable. Aunque parece que está lejos del área turística no se nos complicó para nada porque el transporte es muy eficiente y en la calle del edificio está la parada del bus. No funciono nuestro ventilador pero tienen un cuarto donde puedes cambiarlo. El cuarto se lavado muy practico. Lo recomiendo mucho! Hay café y te, asi como un snack de bienvenida que se agradece. Si volvería!
Lovely stay in Katha’a and Fabian’s cosy apartment. Felt like home and we loved it very much
Perfect Location!!
Good location and plenty of space.

Gezin met kinderen. Goede uitvalsbasis voor trips, ruim appartement. Tv met Amazon is handig, keuken is basic maar goed bruikbaar. Kinderen voelden zich snel thuis. Relatief rustig gelegen appartement vlakbij groot park en OV - wij zouden zo nog een keer boeken
Koselig hotell med bra beliggenhet

The house of the host is located in calm suburbs in a nice spot close to train station (just a couple minutes of walk). The room was inside house and based on the price I would say that all was very fine. The room itself was clean as well as bathroom. Arrival was easy because host speaks some English, so we were able to commuicate. As far as we liked the stay, unfortunately I have some complaints. We stayed just for a weeknd and on Saturday night there was a big noise and vibrations from next room comming from TV, so we were not able to go sleep earlier then midnight, when the TV stopped playing. Also some people were loud on the hall, but in the end, I would forgive this - it was Saturday, but what made me quite angry was that someone clearly was in our room when we were gone during the day, because we left sunblinds up, but when we came, it was down. I belive this was not necessary and host should not enter the room except of some legitimate reasons.

I really enjoyed my stay at Tanja's elegant apartment. It is located in a residential side-street but just one minute's walk from a supermarket and S-Bahn station, from which all of Berlin is accessible. The room itself was tastefully decorated and had everything you would need for a comfortable stay. Sharing the kitchen and bathroom with such a friendly and easy-going host such as Tanja was no problem at all. She was kind enough to put up with my poor German. I look forward to returning when it has hopefully improved!

Lovely apartment with lots of sunshine and a great balcony. Comfortable sofa that we pulled out so the two of us could have sweet dreams with plenty of space. Oksana was very communicative and helpful - she even met us at the U-bahn stop when we were unsure of where to go. Highly recommended!

The location is perfect in the middle of the city -east side-. Really well comunicated and close to grocery stores and good restaurants. It's small but fuctional and also it is clean. We had a good stay in this little flat! I totally recommend it
Stefan is a welcoming, attentive and responsive host. The room is quiet, peaceful with a huge and comfortable bed.

The place was clean and comfortable. Lots of restaurants and shops nearby. Close to tram stops, easy to get to from the main train station.
Apartments is on the fourth floor at least 70 steps.

Joe was a really lovely host. He made sure I was comfortable and was lovely to be around when we were both in.
The photos don’t do this room/space justice. It was really serene—like a little retreat. It had really great light and was thoughtfully put together/designed to make you feel super comfy.
This neighborhood is my favorite in Berlin too. I would definitely book here again.
Sieht ganz schick aus, etwas teuer und die Staubflocken sind nur so über den Boden geflogen als hätte man einen Monat lang nicht gesaugt. Küchenzeile ist super ausgestattet. Insgesamt OK.
The location is great and very close to the U-Bahn. Lovely space I would highly recommend to anyone traveling to Berlin. Karsten is a great host!
A really comfortable and spacious apartment with some lovely touches on arrival. A perfect place for a group of friends to share.
Really nice place, welcoming host and close to public transportation
Danke für den Aufenthalt

Highly recommendable place in Berlin. The neighbourhood is vibrant but the street itself is considerably quiet. There's a restaurant and a biergarten close-by, which adds a nice atmosphere to the street.
The place has got everything you would need for a few days. It's clean, spacious enough and it looks better than on the pictures. The kitchen is simple, so don't expect to cook any extensive dinners. But I'm 100% ok with that, because the basic facilities are there.
Also, I shouldn't forget to mention that Ashraf was super kind to me and very easy to communicate with. Would definitely book his place again!

Superbe localisation
Instructions claires
Bonne communication
Great location. Pleasant stay.
Nice place, great for the price.

Felt like I was visiting a life long friend.
He was super helpful with any questions I had and was very flexible with my check in.
I definitely would go back.
Also I was lucky enough to have him make some yummy snacks .
Sehr schön und ruhig in einem Innenhof gelegen, zwei richtige Doppelbetten und großem Bad.
Unkompliziert, gerne wieder.

Perfect spot for visiting Berlin, not far from any public transport spot and with lots of local shops and restaurants. It's on a quieter street as well which was really nice. Really lovely interior too, everything we needed to make a couple of meals during our stay plus so much more, 100% recommend staying here.
Good room in a nice apartment with everything needed for a comfortable stay. Very friendly and relaxed host.
Super unique space, well equipped - and extraordinarily gracious host.  Erich was helpful, kind and truly cares that his guests feel welcomed and comfortable.

Great apartment in good location. Neighborhood is lively  and was an eye opener to our teenage kids. Cafe next door is fantastic., great coffee, great food, great service with a smile and very well priced. Watch the supermarket though, charge tourists more. Overall we loved our accommodation and time in Berlin. Thank you Gregor
Fijne kamer , badruimte en faciliteiten, rustig huis. Prima om uit te rusten na bezoek aan de stad. Erg attent dat er wat snacks klaar lagen en een koud biertje.
Great place, room was perfect, only thing to complain about is no oven but overall amazing!!

The rooms were clean and as described. The place was right by the water and the view from the main balcony, when able to use it, was great. The rooftop is a great place to spend some time when the weather is nice and sunny.
As for Jose and Frank they were both very welcoming, extremely helpful and great people to live with. Would definitely recommend their place for a stay in Berlin.
Excellent stay ❤️
Top appartement
Wundervolle Unterkunft. 10/10

Wir hatten einen wunderschönen Aufenthalt bei Barbara. Das Ambiente und ihre Gastfreundschaft sind wirklich einzigartig. Die Räumlichkeiten sind großzügig und sehr sauber, das Frühstück lecker und die Begegnung dabei besonders herzlich und persönlich. Es hat perfekt zu unserem Aufenthalt in Berlin gepasst. Jederzeit gerne wieder – vielen Dank, liebe Barbara!
A nice apartment in the north end of Berlin. It's exactly as described in the pictures and was a very pleasant place to stay while touring the city.
Saubere Unterkunft. Sehr schöne Gegend. Kommunikation war sehr gut.

Ein schönes Hotel in guter Lage, mit freundlichem Personal und sauberen Zimmern. Mir hat besonders gut gefallen, dass in unserem Zimmer noch ein kleines Ecksofa integriert war. Der Platz im Raum wurde somit optimal ausgenutzt.

5 Jugendliche waren zu Gast und begeistert von der Wohnung und der Lage.
Unkomplizierte Kommunikation. Lage der Wohnung so, dass alles gut per Bahn
zu erreichen ist. Empfehlenswert.
Sehr guter Gastgeber!

Fed belligenhed i et meget “Berlin” område med gode restauranter og masser af street art. Lejligheden er ren og alt virker. Kan blive god varm og hyggelig altan. Lidt lille seng hvis man er to personer - men hvis man er et godt sted i sit forhold går det fint. :)
Sehr schöne, zentrale Lage, nette Betreuung und schöne Ferienwohnung

Sehr zentral und ruhig gelegen. U-Bahn und Tram nah.
Das Zimmer ist angenehm groß, hell und luftig. Sehr schön eingerichtet. Ich habe gut geschlafen. Über die frischen Blumen und etwas Wasser und Obst habe ich mich sehr gefreut. Schöner Stil und sehr bequem.
Katharina ist eine großartige Gastgeberin. Herzlichen Dank.

A notre arrivée à l'agence, on nous a proposé un logement plus grand que le studio prévu initialement car nous étions 4 (un couple avec deux enfants jeunes adultes) pour un séjour d'une semaine et un autre appartement était disponible. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié cette très délicate attention de la part de l'agence.  Cet appartement était confortable, agréable, lumineux, calme, bien équipé et très bien situé par rapport aux transports en commun (tram et métro). Le quartier est très agréable. Idéal pour découvrir cette belle ville qu'est Berlin. Je recommande donc vivement !

This place is very convenient, close to touristical sites yet the flat us very quiet in the evening and morning. The flat is very spacious with high ceilling, airy and good lighting. I would stay the next time I visit for sure.
Alles top. Top Lage
We really enjoyed this cosy apartment which was located close the public transport, grocery stores and restaurants. Highly recommended to others looking for a great apartment.
Very beautiful appartement, nice and fast communication and a perfect central location. Highly recommend !!
Great location & space to stay while exploring Berlin.

Camila, co host is very responsive. I traveled with my young daughter and we booked the place on very last minute and she help to arrange and give us the accommodation. She also allowed me to check out late. I would stay again.

Michaela is welcoming and respectful of guest's privacy.  Her apartment is beautiful and clean.  Her rabbit is super cute too.  She is definitely a host I would recommend.  Overall,  it was good experience.  Her airbnb room is very nice.  She works really hard to make her guests feel comfortable.
Sehr freundlich und hilfreich.  Alles war sehr sauber und ordentlich.
very well located place.

Un séjour à Berlin très agréable que nous recommandons. Appartement conforme à l'annonce, très agréable, calme, adapté avec un enfant de 2 ans.  Alan et Kasia fournissent pleins informations (restaurants, visites, bons plans).
Thanks a lot! Nice house to stay!!

Great place to stay! Cozy & with really cool vibes.
It’s also in one of my favorite quarters of the city. Would recommend to anyone :)
A good place, apart from being a bit far from city centre. Quiet, private, good condition. Helpful host.
very good location. The stuff are so friendly
Great place to stay if you travel alone for a cheap price
Communication facile avec l’hôte, dans un quartier calme

it was an amazing experience. Bernd did a great job at making me feel at home. He went above and beyond by offering me fruits and chocolate as well as complimentary coffee and/or tea. He provided tips and recommendations for the city. He and his family respected my privacy greatly. His location is a perfect distance from beer gardens as well as the subway system for easy transport. Would 100% recommend to anybody traveling to Berlin.

Excelente lugar.
Solo sugerir que vean cómo manejar la distribución de hombres y mujeres en las piezas. Nos tocaron de roomy 3 hombres que nos acosaron tanto, que tuvimos que pedir cambio de pieza. El resto, todo bien

for the price. it was good. a bit dusty and dirty but the bed linen and towels were fresh and clean. peetty good location. lofs of food options around. id you are looking for a simple place to stay on a budget this os a good choice. i would not recommend 6 people. we were a group of 5 and it was comfortable 6 would have been one too many.
Tolle und stylische Wohnung, super gelegen im quirligen Viertel! nicht super sauber, aber wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!

Saubere, gut ausgestattete Wohnung!
U-Bahn gut zu erreichen. Kleine gemütliche Lokale in der Umgebung!

Wir waren mit vier Erwachsenen und zwei Kindern da. Die Aufteilung mit drei Schlafzimmern und einem großen Wohn- und Essbereich war für uns super. Witzig: Ein Kicker im Keller. Die Gegend ist klasse - direkt nebenan bei Sullys gibt es ein tolles Frühstück. Gegenüber gibt es ein sehr gutes koreanisches Restaurant. Die Anbindung an die Stadtmitte ist super. In der Wohnung war soweit alles vorhanden, was wir gebraucht haben.  Der Preis ist schon eher hoch, aber noch okay. Die Kommunikation mit primeflats lief gut. Der Check-in war problemlos. Leider kann man kein Gepäck in der Wohnung lassen - Check out ist schon um 10h. Die Gepäckstationen am Hbf und einem privaten Anbieter waren am Abreisetag alle belegt. Das war etwas lästig, da wir die Koffer bis zum Nachmittag mitnehmen mussten bzw. an der Museumsgarderobe abgegeben haben. Da bieten Hotels natürlich mehr Möglichkeiten. Alles in allem aber ein schöner Aufenthalt. Wir können die Unterkunft empfehlen und würden sie wieder buchen.
Gemütliche Wohnung, unkomplizierte Kommunikation und nette Gespräche - gerne wieder :)

Lovely apartment in a good location. Atto was a great host. The video provided for check in made it really easy to get into the apartment even when we arrived late in the evening. The photos & description are accurate, we had everything we needed for our long weekend (including a Nespresso machine with pods).
The apartment is on a pretty, quiet street with restaurants, bars and an ice cream parlour next door. We would highly recommend Mauer Kebab just around the corner.
Only a 10 minute walk to the train station with regular trains to everywhere you'd want to visit in Berlin.

Kleines, feines Stübchen.
Mit allem Notwendigen ausgestattet, um einen schönen Aufenthalt zu haben.
Ich werde wieder kommen!
Great place to stay, can't wait to try Numa all over the world.
Good location, cozy and clean apartment and friendly host.

Estuvimos durante 2 semanas en el departamento, el cual está en una zona que siempre tiene mucho para hacer.
Eramos un matrimonio con 2 hijos. El departamento es espacioso y práctico. Tiene todo los electrodomésticos que puedes necesitar para estar en estadías prolongadas.
Valoramos especialmente la cocina super equipada con mucha vajilla y todo tipo de elementos. Está todo muy organizado y preparado para diversas situaciones. Nos encantó el amplio espacio que era práctico paraa poder recibir a algún amigo a familiar para desayunar sin inconveniente de tener los elementos justos.
El departamento da al patio interno en una planta baja. Es un edificio tranquilo y perfectamente conseravado.
La anfitriona siempre ha sido cordial y atenta, respondió siempre rápidamente y con cordialidad, como también iniciativa a resolver todo tipo de situaciones.
Einfache Unterkunft, gute Umgebung und Verkehrsanbindung, kostenlose Parkplätze in der Nähe, passender Preis, 2 Gemeinschaftsbäder, 6 weitere Zimmer.
Great place, easy to access and nearby stations
Sehr liebe Person und rasche Kommunikation. Kann ich nur weiter empfehlen
Wonderful appartment close to Alazienstraße (and David Bowies former appartment). We had a really nice stay. Everything was as described.
The place was nice, clean and everything ok. The host was excellent, she was really kind with us 😊. I recommend this place!
Nice stay and good area

Kerstin ist eine sehr nette und zuvorkommende Gastgeberin. Die Unterkunft ist gut ausgestattet und hat eine praktische Lage. Direkt neben den Gärten der Welt und mit verschiedenen Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. Gern wieder.
the place is easy to find and accessible location.
Stella‘s accomodation was perfekt for three people. We loved everything about it: the location, the fact that we didn‘t need keys and the apartment itself. We highly recommend this place!

We were two couples that each had 1 year olds staying in the apartment for an extended weekend. It was the perfect size for us and there were cribs and high chairs for both kids to use. The kitchen had everything we needed to cook simple meals for the kids and the apartment had enough space for us to all relax. Be aware that the elevator doesn’t go to the door of the apartment though so you need to walk up/down one flight. Was a bit difficult with our strollers but we made it work fine so wasn’t a problem. Great little playground right outside and also very close to the trains. Would definitely stay here again!
Really lovely place to stay! Phenomenal location - both transport wise and for local gems. The flat is lovely and relaxing :)
We stayed in this suite for a few nights. There were no problems at all. Very quiet. Highly recommend.
Fantastic house in a great location, lovely 10 minute walk to the train station along a pretty path. House was well equipped with everything we needed and Gerd was a very welcoming host.

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt-mitten drin in Kreuzberg. Schöne Möglichkeiten außerhalb zu essen und trinken vorhanden- doch wir haben die Abende auf der Terrasse genossen!
Dankeschön!
Everything was fine.  Only the refrigerator emits a bad smell when opened.
We had a great stay at Jonas place and would choose it again anytime. Thank you!

This is a lovely place. The location is great. Neighborhood feel and easy access to public transportation. The home was beautiful. We enjoyed sitting on the balcony in the evenings.  It has all the amenities and excellent coffee. The beds are comfortable. The shower has plenty of hot water.

The apartment looked cool even though it was a lot smaller than it looks on the photos. It was clean, it had all we needed and the service was great.
The biggest problem was that the building complex was still in the middle of construction, so there was a lot of noise every morning since around 7am.

Julie's flat is perfect for a couple, the area is just the place to be, quiet to rest but lively to go out. It's full of nice cafes, bars and shops and the center (Alexander Platz und Unter den Linden) are easy to walk to.
Julie was very helpful at replying questions and solving problems.
I recommend her flat!

Leider hatte ich, anders als andere Gäste, Probleme beim digitalen Türschloss, obwohl ich die Nutzung von Nuki gut kenne. Ich musste 30 Minuten warten (innerhalb der Wohnung), bis das Problem gelöst war. Auch wenn 30 Minuten nicht viel sind, störte es mich, auch weil gefragt wurde, ob das Problem am nächsten gelöst werden könne und ich somit nicht mehr hätte herausgehen können. Auf meine Bitte hin wurde das Problem jedoch am Abend gelöst.
Die Information zum check in ist umfangreich. Meiner Einschätzung nach zu viel. Die Wohnung war zum Teil nicht sauber (Haarbüschel lagen neben dem Bett, das Bad wurde, wenn überhaupt, nur kurz gereinigt).
Alles in allem kann ich einen Aufenthalt nicht empfehlen.
Great studio in the heart of Friedrichshain.
I enjoyed my short stay here. Great location with beautiful interior. Regina is a great host!
Amazing place, would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Berlin!

Unser Aufenthalt war super. Die Wohnung ist wie beschrieben und die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern war einfach und zuvorkommend. Sie haben immer sehr schnell auf unsere Anliegen reagiert. Sowohl zu Fuß als auch mit der Tram war die Wohnung gut zu erreichen.
Toller Aufenthalt. Vielen Dank.

Have been going to Berlin for a while now and this was hands down the best place I've stayed. In a part of Neukolln that still has an edge with a great mixture of old and new. Right next to Neukolln Station it has great connections to the airport and only 12mins into the popular places in Berlin via the U Bahn. The accommodation was excellent. lovely bathroom well equipped kitchen and comfy beds. Best kebab shop round the corner too. Couldn't ask for anything more.
Hana非常的热情房间条件非常好，性价比很高，再来柏林我应该还会选择这里
The host was very communicative a responsive to any requests. The apartment is in a great location and very comfortable.
Nice place, good location, friendly staff

Unser Aufenthalt bei Arzu und Tom war wirklich angenehm.
Wir hatten einen kurzen Weg zur Arbeit und konnten Abends noch etwas kochen.
Virkelig dejligt sted, midt i byen og alligevel roligt. Stefan var meget serviceminded og fleksibel <3

Очень чистая квартира, удобное расположение. Комната просторная с огромной кроватью и удобным матрасом. Из минусов: очереди в ванную, так как всего 1 санузел на 8 человек. В целом, нам очень все понравилось.

This place was incredibly cozy and magical, genuinely reflecting the spirit of Berlin in an incredible apartment. The location is perfect, and the flexible check in makes it the right place for people looking for privacy and homey experience. Definitely book!

I totally recomend Ursula's place. It is very comfortable, stylish and clean. The spacious apartment is close to the means of transport. The area is very quiet and peaceful. Ursula was very polite and helpful with some local tips.
Great place with very good transport options to move around Berlin. Very clean and as described in the listing. The host was a great communicator. Thanks!
Really beautiful apartment in a great location with east access to everything that you would need. Great hosts also that cater to all needs :)

This was our first time in Berlin and wanted somewhere comfortable for us to stay. We were all so thankful to have found Remi's place. It was very nice, clean, modern and had a beautiful view of the river and the Berlin wall across the way. It was also nice and centrally located so it was easy for us to ride the U-Bahn to wherever we were going. 10/10 loved this place.

Ece is a great host. She responds quickly and is always ready to help. The place is well located near Alexanderplatz. Public transport is few steps away. Ece's mother is very friendly. It's a great place for a single traveller. The nearby doner place is perfect for an inexpensive dinner after a day's hard walking.

Siamo stati benissimo nell'appartamento di Micheal. La cucina è molto attrezzata, il terrazzo è magnifico e il bagno ha una doccia idromassaggio. La posizione è ottima e vicino all'appartamento ci sono varie fermate di diversi mezzi pubblici. Perfetta anche per soggiorni più lunghi. Quella casa ci resterà nel cuore, grazie Micheal.

Friendly host and a nice apartment with a good bed.
Easy to reach by public transportation. I recommend!

The apartment was all it was advertised. Everything was spotless and worked well. The location was especially Good for us as we had family nearby but with Berlin's excellent public transport everywhere is reachable. The area is quiet and is very leafy with lots of trees either in the Ge We Sud across the road or the Marienhohe behind. Our only issue was in August air conditioning was badly missed as temperatures were close to 30C. However A/C might only be needed an odd  week.
Alles super, sehr gemütlich und schön!!!
Great stay ; very close to u bahn
Christiane is def a super host! She is kind, very helpful and attentive. The room is comfortable, and it offers a great view to a green patio. It is also very quiet. I highly recommend it!
Das Zimmer hat eine sehr gute Lage( 5min zu Fuß zum Alexanderplatz). Die Gastgeber sind sehr nett. Wir kommen gerne wieder😊
Excellent accommodation, price, location, communication- just about everything. wish I could have stayed longer!

Die Wohnung von Verda hatte eine absolute Toplage. Wir konnten alles zu Fuß oder mit der Bahn in sehr kurzer Zeit erreichen. Außerdem hat sie uns super Tipps gegeben und war wirklich nett. Man hat einfach gemerkt, dass es ihr wichtig war, dass es uns gut geht und wir uns wohlfühlen.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden gerne wiederkommen.
Kristian's place was very well kept and matched the description exactly. He made sure we got in to the apartment and everything was good with the stay!

Excellent location and a great place to return to each day. The space is a lot larger than the photographs and the beds were really comfortable. Having a large kitchen with all the necessary items was also a good addition (along with a number of very close supermarkets) so you could cook a few meals at home, if you wanted. Communication was excellent and the check-in very smooth. Would highly recommend this as a good base for Berlin.

had amazing time here, place for 5-6 people. amazing location close to subway and tram, with lots of bars and even shopping mall nearby. host was responsive even on the 1st of may(Labour Day) holiday.
Well located, clean, and quiet.

Well-equipped, clean and comfortable apartment which is close to public transport, restaurants and coffee shops. Easy to get to and from the airport. We were welcomed by Ody who was friendly and gave us some good recommendations for things to do.
There is a convenient, secure luggage storage in the basement if you have an early or late flight where you can lock your bags.

Great stay at Numa. Great location and lovely room - spacious and clean. We had some trouble with our check in code but the Numa team were very responsive in helping us get in quickly. Would recommend. Thank you!
Beautiful apartment and amazing neighbourhood! Didn’t have a chance to meet Robin, but everything was smooth.
Great place to stay. Also located in nice area close to everywhere you need. Recommend ❤️

Отличное расположение, рядом торговые центры и трамваи, 30 минут и в центре города. В апартаментах не хватает кухонных принадлежностей, и микроволновки, для самостоятельного завтрака

Al met al een goede, eerste ervaring !
Apartamento grande, comodo, fresco , con todo lo necesario para una estancia agradable y Martin como siempre excelente anfitrion
Great place!!!

Sehr praktische Unterkunft mit allem was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt braucht. Werner ist ein angenehmer und netter Gastgeber.

Samuel ist freundlich.

I spent nearly three months in this flat and absolutely loved my time there. It was a relief to discover that it was a first floor apartment — especially since I arrived with two massive suitcases. The flat is situated a brief walk from the Rosenthaler Platz U8 and the Zionskircheplatz Tram, and very close to two groceries and a bunch of spätis, making it an unbelievably convenient place to stay if you're planning to stay a while. The neighborhood itself is quiet and populated with families, so even at night, it feels very safe. There are restaurants all over the place if you're too lazy to cook, but if you want to get creative in the kitchen, you'll be quite happy to find an electric stove and oven. (Living in this flat turned me into a domestic goddess!) The kitchen doesn't have a toaster or a microwave, but it's easy enough to get by without. If you like coffee, it's well equipped, and I may have left a few more pans in the cabinet than there were when I arrived.
The flat itself is just the right size to comfortably house one or two people, and for some reason, the bedroom continued to remain at a cool temperature even at the height of summer. (I was there from the end of May to the third week of August.) If you're the kind of sleeper who can't stand sunlight, the room stays wonderfully dark with the curtains shut, and becomes nice and sunny when they are drawn.
Perhaps the only criticism I have is that the bathroom lights were almost never working while I was there, although there was a powerful lamp set up in the bathroom to sort of compensate. It was never really bright enough in there for me to do my makeup — I'm a makeup artist — but it was plenty bright enough in the dining area.
Overall though, I was beyond pleased with the flat, and can safely say that I spent the happiest months of my life living in it. Already looking forward to returning to Berlin long-term. Thank you for a wonderful summer!
