Een aanrader… je wordt vriendelijk te woord gestaan.. zijn behulpzaam bij de receptie. Schoon appartement.. er is aan alles gedacht.
Het park voelt niet veilig om door heen te lopen in de schemering of donker.

Un détecteur de bruit est présent dans l’appartement et s’active au moindre bruit. Nous avons eu l’impression d’être épiées durant toute la durée de notre séjour.
L’appartement est extrêmement mal isolé, la fenêtre de la chambre claque toute la nuit et est très bruyante. Les locataires des autres appartements étaient très bruyants et faisaient la fête jusqu’à 3h du matin.
L’hôte ne répondait pas lorsque nous lui écrivions mais était très réactif pour nous demander de faire moins de bruit (nous avions uniquement un fond de musique).
L’appartement était très très sale. Nous avons trouvé des poils, des cheveux, un rasoir usagé, de la poussière sous les lits. Le lavabo de la salle de bain était cassé et rafistolé et les sols étaient dégoûtants.

Great place to stay for several nights in Berlin. The apartment is perfectly located near Warschauer Str. station and with easy access to nearby U-Bahns direct into the city centre. The apartment itself is ground floor, but the street itself is peaceful and sleep was no issue. The kitchen was also great, and there are multiple supermarkets just down the street.
Ben was responsive and easy to reach out to when I had any questions. Definitely recommend. :)

Die Wohnung ist absolut empfehlenswert. Alles ist super sauber, jedes Detail stimmt und die Ausstattung lässt keine Wünsche offen. Der zusätzliche Rund-um-Service ist durchdacht, super und unkompliziert.

Appartement tres calme et agreable. Un peu excentré mais accès facile aux transports en commun.
Je recommanderais sans hesiter

Wir waren übers Wochenende in Berlin. Die Lage der Unterkunft ist sehr praktisch. Die Straßenbahn ist in 5 Minuten erreichbar und liegt in Zone B.
Anita war sehr nett und unkompliziert, schnelle Reaktionen auf Anfragen. Die Wohnung selbst war sehr sauber, alles Nötige vorhanden und sehr ruhig.
Es gibt gleich in der Nähe einen REWE und eine günstige Tankstelle.
Gerne wieder.

Ashraf ist super freundlich und hat sehr schnell auf Nachrichten reagiert. Der Check-In war unkompliziert. Die Wohnung entspricht genau der Beschreibung, alles Notwendige war vorhanden, alles sehr sauber. Ich komme bestimmt wieder.
Very nice atmosphere, clean, tidy. Working bar,  hotel was quiet.
Spacious and comfy loft, excellent communication with the host 5/5.

Habe sehr kurzfristig eine Unterkunft für meine Eltern gesucht und war mit Gerhards kleiner Wohnung sehr zufrieden. Sie liegt gut, ist ruhig und sauber und meine Eltern haben sich, nicht zuletzt wegen guten Restaurantempfehlungen, sehr wohl gefühlt.
清靜，整潔，旅客需要的東西齊全！與房東溝通容易！

En fin og rummelig lejlighed fuld af personlighed og sjæl. Alt var rent og ordentligt.
God beliggenhed i et fedt kvarter med gode restauranter og cafeer, tæt på offentlig transport og supermarkeder.

Unsere Unterkunft in Berlin war tip-top. Super location, S- und U-Bahn-Stationen in 10 bis 15 Gehminuten mit guter Anbindung an wichtigsten Sehenswürdigkeiten. Die Wohnung ist modern und bequem eingerichtet und sehr sauber.
Gerne wieder!
Tolle Unterkunft und Ariane & Serpil waren super Host. Wir haben uns sehr willkommen gefühlt und können  die Unterkunft sehr empfehlen.

Comfortable bed, good natural lighting in rooms with about 10 foot ceilings in a very centrally located neighborhood with Ubahn just a few feet away, all the stores you need in an popular neighborhood with lots of food options and great restaurants.  Great value and very nice hosts.  Jonathan

This was a really great spot for a first visit to Berlin! Quiet street and building— so close to transit and easy to get around. Good shops and restaurants nearby, too. I was surprised at how spacious and comfortable the space felt given that it’s a small apartment. the lofted bedroom area was lovely and the high ceilings and good light made it feel cozy but never cramped. I would definitely be interested in  staying here again when I return to Berlin.
Lovely apartment close to a fantastic area with good transport links. Check in and out was really easy and flexible. Dietrich was very quick to communicate and very helpful.
Vincent is a wonderful host, thoughtful and  very interesting person. His apartment is awesome, we had a great journey in Berlin. Thank you very much :)
Alles super.Schön gelegen so ganz nah am Müggelsee und alles , was man braucht, ist schnell zu bekommen.

Het appartement was fijn te bereiken met het OV. Toen we aankwamen bij het appartement kregen we te horen dat wij een badkamer en keuken moesten delen met andere gasten. Dat hadden wij helaas over het hoofd gezien, dus dat was wat minder. Het balkon deel je ook met een andere kamer helaas. Verder was het een fijne slaapplek om de stad te verkennen. Alles was schoon en de bedden lagen lekker! Voor twee dagen was dit helemaal prima.😄

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour dans le logement de Laura. C'est idéalement situé.(Tramway/Magasin alimentaire)
Je recommande !
Super Unterkunft, ruhig und gut gelegen, sehr unkomplizierte Kommunikation.

Wenn man generationenübergreifend (17 - 77 Jährige) mit 6 Personen ein paar Tage in Berlin verbringt und sogar die Teenies sagen "Wow, coole Wohnung" ist wohl alles perfekt! Wir waren begeistert, die Wohnung ist sehr grosszügig und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Anfragen via Mail und WhatsApp wurden stets umgehend beantwortet und die Einführung von Carmen vor Ort war ebenfalls ausgezeichnet.
Wenn wir wieder mal mit einer Gruppe nach Berlin verreisen, wissen wir, wo wir zuerst nachfragen. Vielen Dank den Gastgebern!
Very friendly hosts. Apartment has so much character and is beautiful at an affordable price.
Check in complicado, sugiro não seguir a localização do anúncio e sim a do restaurante. Mas é bom quarto, bem próximo ao metrô! e com bastante próxima!
Prima Unterkunft von netten Vermietern in schöner Lage

Great Airbnb for a short visit to Berlin. Amazing connection to the city center, regardless of the replacement bus that is in operation due to maintenance on the metro line. Mona is very thoughtful and always willing to help + we loved the cookies we got upon arrival. We'd recommend this place definitely if you're looking for a cozy stay in the German capital.

Tanja's apartment is well located in a pleasant suburb of Berlin. There are lots of restaurants, cafes & shops neaby. There is good public transport access to the centre of Berlin.
The apartment was very clean, spacious & well equipped. Tanja was helpful, responsive & flexible. A lovely stay.

I enjoyed staying in Natascia's quaint flat, and first and foremost, enjoyed staying in her neighborhood of Neukolln. It's a hip 'hood with lots of character- Turkish bakeries, dive bars, vintage boutiques, etc. And while distant from the center of Berlin, easily accessible by the U-bahn. Natascia was so pleasant and accommodating, and her place was clean, quiet, and felt safe as a solo traveler.
Great place in the heart with everything you need.  Excellent communication from hosts and really close to public transport
Martin’s place was great. Location is spot on and Martin’s communication was absolutely top notch. Highly recommend!

La casa estaba genial. Ubicada cerca de transportes públicos (metro, trenes, autobuses y tranvías).
En la zona algún restaurante cercano, cafetería y supermercados. La casa es un bajo pero no hay ruidos ya que la zona es tranquila y residencial. La casa limpia y ordenada. Salón/cocina amplio con utensilios para cocinar. Otro salón con sofá cama y cama supletoria y una habitación con una cama amplia y cómoda.
La comunicación con anfitrión muy buena (en alemán e ingles).
En general recomendable hasta
Todo genial!!!
Beautiful little apartment in a great neighborhood. Would definitely recommend and would stay again.

Really nice place. I had a short and comfortable stay. Very reasonably priced.
Staff were very helpful for me in the morning before checking out. Would highly recommend!
:)

Vriendelijke host, mooi appartement en goede locatie. Helaas waren er een aantal minpunten. In de badkamer zat schimmel op de muur en hing er een sterke, onaangename geur. Ook waren de matrassen vies en was het appartement stoffig. Schimmel werd gemeld, maar slechts oppervlakkig schoongemaakt en de geur bleef hangen. Jammer, want met beter onderhoud zou het een topverblijf zijn.
Very small for three people but great area
Everything perfect! I would come again at any time

El alojamiento es 100% recomendable. El lugar y casa donde se ubica este alojamiento es muy limpio, cómodo, grato ambiente familiar y tranquilo. Además, el anfitrión es muy respetuoso, agradable y habla español entre otros idiomas, lo cual nos facilita mucho las cosas a los latinos.
Gracias Rudolf.
I felt at home ! Thank you very much for everything Max

It is a very austere appartment, but considering the time you spend on it, for us was more than enough. The appartment was clean, heating was working perfectly, wifi was good, and personally I found the sofas very confortable to sleep :)

3 things will stand out when you visit this lovely home!
1. Katarina's fabulous and kind hosting skills
2. The tastefully decorated apartment
3. The cleanliness of the beautiful house
We requested a later check-in, and Katarina was very accommodating. Great place close to everything you need and a great way to explore Berlin!
You will not be Dissapointed!!
Thank you for letting us use your beautiful home xx

Wij verbleven hier met 5 in het prachtige appartement van Ben en Deborah. Het appartement is erg ruim en in een heel leuke buurt!
Communicatie was erg vlot en antwoordden snel op onze berichten.
Over de hele lijn een positieve ervaring
Prijemne ubytovani v dobre lokalite, dekuji :)

We had a fantastic stay at this Berlin apartment. There were 5 of us staying and we found it very spacious and well equipped. With its proximity to ostkreuz station it was the perfect base for us to explore Berlin. It was well located for Schoenfeld Airport, Union Berlin, the nightlife of friedrichshain and kreuzberg, and for a trip to see the main sites in the centre. The kitchen was well equipped and the showers very good. There are plenty of shops, cafes, restaurants, and bars in the area. Communication was good when we needed to extend our stay, and no problems checking in etc. We would not hesitate to come back.
Great apartment with all amenities needed. Good location for food, drink and transport.
还不错，有疑问房东会很快解决

Die Lage war super und die Unterkunft auch! Erik war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Hat alles perfekt gepasst, man muss nur beachten, dass die Unterkunft im obersten Stock ist und das Bett etwas quietscht. Sonst, wie gesagt, war wirklich alles spitze!
Logement vraiment très agréable, grand, très bien décoré, au pied des transports et dans un quartier vraiment agréable.

Martina's apartment is the perfect stay for anyone wanting to see the most of Berlin. It's located in the middle of the city with easy access to public transport and is a spacious, quiet and cute apartment.

Apostos has great communication and very friendly! I loved staying here. fantastic location within 5 mins of great restaurants and bars. also very closer to the underground train which takes you all over berlin.
comfortable bed. nice kitchen amenities. perfect for a solo traveler or a couple.
although the shower and washroom is small, it has very strong water pressure.
wifi was strong. next time I come to berlin I will be booking this place again.
Die Unterkunft war toll, check in hat bestens geklappt, alles war sauber und wie erhofft. Die Wohnung ist gut gelegen um die vielen Restaurants und Cafes in der Gegend besuchen zu können. Ganz toll!

Una experiencia increíble y maravillosa, la anfitriona super atenta y amable.
Recomendable 100% y ubicación inmejorable.
Should definitely stay here if visiting Berlin! Great location and very clean and cozy.
Michael war ein toller Gastgeber - hat alles wunderbar geklappt - wir waren sehr zufrieden - danke nochmals!
Amazing to stay so close to the east side of the wall and easy to get to central Berlin. A great home from home
Eine sehr schöne Unterkunft mit sehr herzlichen Gastgebenden. Vielen Dank 🌷
An absolutely beautiful apartment and a great host!
Emilia ist eine ausgezeichnete Gastgeberin. Das Zimmer und das eigene Duschbad sind super. Gerne buche ich wieder. Lieben Gruss
Neukölln ist eine Reise wert.

Worth every dollar. First floor access, huge space, central to Berlin (in the Mitte area), plenty of public transportation options nearby, and the homely amenities. And I have to give Ute some props here -- she has gone to the next level in making sure you are aware of the rules, some local tips, and prepped a homemade book. Useful for exploring some of Berlin's hidden gems.

Der Aufenthalt bei Tamara war sehr angenehm. Die Lage war super - gute Anbindungen, viele Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Nähe. Die Gegend ist sehr belebt. Die Wohnung hat eine solide Grundausstattung, sie ist sehr sauber und fühlt sich direkt wohl. Das Bett ist, anders als beschrieben/ auf Fotos dargestellt, eine Schlafcouch. Tamara gibt vor der Anreise super Tipps und Infos zur Anreise und für Unternehmungen & Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Nähe. Sie ist jederzeit sehr gut erreichbar. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Отличный вариант проживания. Окна выходят во двор, который очень тихий. Из-за первого этажа и расположения солнца было не видно. Постоянная тень. Хозяин квартиры очень озывчив, пошел навстречу с поздним выездом.

The apartment was perfect for our visit to Berlin with two adult couples. The location is excellent with plenty to do nearby and felt safe. Also close to grocery stores and the train. The apartment is comfortable and very peaceful with the windows on the courtyard. It is 87 steps from the ground to the apartment. It wasn’t a problem at all, but if you have trouble with steps it might be an issue. We stayed in July and the weather was warm but the windows opened for a nice breeze in the evenings. Overall it was a great stay and I would stay there again without hesitation.
Really charming flat in one of the best neighborhoods of Berlin... Can suit any couple or small group of friends easily. I definitely recommend this place !
Nette gemütliche Wohnung. Wir waren zu dritt da und es hat völlig ausgereicht.
Muy buena opción para conocer Berlín.
Super lækker og mega velbeliggende lejlighed - Alt var så fint, dejligt sted at bo i Berlin, stor og rummelig lejlighed, vi er meget tilfredse - absolut et sted vi gerne kommer igen
Das Zimmer war sehr sauber.
Es el piso perfecto para visitar Berlin!

Marius was very communicative and responsive. His friendliness was a great first impression of Germany and he made us feel very welcome.
We recommend his place for anyone visiting Berlin! :)
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour, merci !
This was great! My friend and I had a very pleasant stay in Berlin. Communication with Javier was excellent and he made sure everything was well taken care for us. Absolutely recommended.
Gutes Hotel, sauberes und schönes Gemeinschaftsbad
This is a great apartment in Berlin. The space is beautiful and in a perfect location. Max was very very kind and super easy to get in touch with. Super recommended!
Everything just perfect - stylish space, very clean, great neighbourhood, fantastic host. Highly recommend!

I had a great stay at SANA Berlin. The availability of the front desk/concierge, cleaning service and fitness facilities made the normal Airbnb stay into an elevated experience. I would definitely stay here again.
gutes system, alles was man braucht vorhanden !
Schnelle Kommunikation und super Preisleistungsverhältnis. :)

Tolle Wohnung. Sauber, zentral und stylisch.
Herzlichen Dank!

Wir haben uns direkt wohlgefühlt. Das Zimmer ist groß und die Wohnung war ordentlich. Gereth war sehr nett und angenehm.
insgesamt nur zu empfehlen, würde jederzeit wiederkommen. :)
Very good place to stay.
Alles was echt prima, doen!
The house is small but still doable for four people if you don't spend time at home except for sleeping. It's clean modern and comfortable. Also close to public transport.

Wir hatten so eine schöne Zeit in dieser wunderschönen Wohnung. Sie ist super gemütlich, es ist alles da, was man braucht. Die Ecke in Schöneberg ist klasse, es gibt viele nette Restaurants und Geschäfte ganz in der Nähe. Tanja ist sehr sympathisch und die Kommunikation war super. Für uns war das die perfekte Unterkunft in Berlin.

We enjoyed our stay at Nassa's place. Spacious, quiet apartment in a nice neighborhood. Close to S-Bahn train and many good restaurants. Apartment is  dedicated to vacation rentals (not a primary residence) which is a plus.
Good apartment,  very cozy, maybe a little to small but nice and clean
Sehr nettes Paar, bei dem man sich direkt wohlfühlt in ruhiger Wohngegend - nur zu empfehlen!
Very cute little appartment. A little bit small but perfect for a couple of days! So clean with a lot of supplies.
Lovely host, very kind and reasonable. The only downside would be the location, Im someone who likes to go to the city by walking. Other than that, it was really great!! 😊
Eine kleine, nette und saubere Whg. Leider war die Matratze auf dem Hochbett alt und durchgelegen.

La casa està molt ben situada, aprop del metro i de les principals atraccions. L’amfitrió va ser molt atent i les instruccions molt precises. Hem tengut una estada molt còmode i agradable. Molt recomenable!
L'accueil de Nassa et son père est très chaleureux. L'appartement est spacieux et très agréable. Le quartier est très vivant. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.

Ich habe für drei Nächte bei Sabrina gewohnt und war sehr zufrieden. Die Lage ist fußläufig zum U-Bhf Fehrbelliner Platz. Die Unterkunft ist großzügig und hell, Sabrina war sehr freundlich und immer erreichbar, und es gab auch andere Gäste, die offen und kommunikativ waren-und trotzdem habe ich mich natürlich jederzeit zurückziehen können, wenn ich Ruhe brauchte.
Der offene gemeinsame Wohnbereich ist phantastisch gestaltet und man konnte bei schönem Wetter quasi "mitten in der Stadt" im Garten sitzen.
Die Küchenmitbenutzung hat einen riesigen Spaß gemacht, toller Arbeitsbereich! :-)
Liebe Grüße an Sabrina und Danke nochmal für den angenehmen Aufenthalt!
toller Aufenthalt, gerne wieder !
Buena localización y buen trato, mejor de lo que nos esperábamos, contentas con el resultado.

This is a beautiful roomy apartment right on the U6 U-Bahn line.  It’s easy to get around, near a nice Bio Markt and a lovely canal park, great for running.  Hannah was wonderful, and made our Easter stay in Berlin easy and fun.
Place was exactly as shown. Sebastian was very easy to communicate with and looked after us well. It was the perfect flat for a city holiday!
Really great place exactly as described. Has everything needed and very close to the train station.
We had a fantastic stay. The apartment is lovely and the basement room with table football is brilliant. The location is ideal too, close to great cafes, restaurants, supermarkets and transport.

Stella’s apartment is a lovely place for anyone looking to visit Berlin and needs a place to stay with friends or family. Very affordable, clean, near a station and close to bars, I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a nice place to stay in the area!
La ubicación del departamento es muy buena y el departamento muy lindo
Eine für meine Zwecke gute Unterkunft mit einer sehr guten Anbindung. Ich würde wieder buchen, wenn es passt.

Coole Unterkunft mitten in Neuköln.

Ik ben samen met mijn vriendin een week in de studio verbleven voor onze vakantie. De studio ligt net op een rustige plek maar je bent binnen 5 minuten in een drukker gebied. Dichtbij de bus en metro. Ook heeft Phil ons de hele week geholpen door snelle reacties en tips voor bijvoorbeeld een ziekenhuis. De studio heeft alles wat je nodig hebt. Knus verblijf en ruim genoeg voor ons!

My girlfriend and I came back last week from a stay at Roi's and (as expected) the flat was incredible. We could not have asked for a cleaner, more luxurious apartment. Roi was kind enough to allow us to arrive a little early and drop our bags; we were met by his lovely cleaner who gave us all of the information we needed about the local area and public transport. She even walked us half way to an area of restaurants she recommended.
The area where the flat is located is perfect (3 minute walk to the Ubahn) and with plenty of shops.
The flat made our stay in Berlin 10 times better and we would highly recommend staying with Roi to anyone who asked.
Great location, clean and modern apartments

Mir hat der Aufenthalt sehr gut gefallen. Total netter Kontakt. Die Lage der Wohnung ist aus meiner Sicht super. Direkte Anbindung an U-Bahn und S-Bahn, machen die Wohnung zu einem guten Startpunkt, um Berlin vom Osten aus zu erkunden. Außerdem ist man nach einem kleinen Sparziergang auch direkt im Zentrum von Friedrichshain mit all den Annehmlichkeiten, die der Stadtteil so zu bieten hat.
Die Wohnung liegt in einer ruhigen Nebenstraßen, so dass man sich da auch von dem Gewusel erholen kann. Unweit davon entfernt gibt es auch eine schöne Cafe-Bar (Herman Schulz) in der man in entspannter Atmosphäre mit einem Frühstück in den Tag starten kann, bevor man sich in das Getümmel von Berlin stürzt.
Wenn ich mal wieder eine Unterkunft in Friedrichshain bräuchte, würde ich hier wieder übernachten.
Vielen Dank noch mal an dieser Stelle :)
Place was nice and in a good area. Only downside was the WiFi going in and out and the kitchen not having oil/salt and pepper.
War alles ok
All good overall, except for a mild odor in the house caused by the humid conditions.

We enjoyed our stay at Maria José's place! Communication with her and also her son was always very friendly, courteous and swift.

The apartment certainly had all the amenities we needed for a week-long work trip and it was great that our dog was welcome there too.
Thank you for an all-round pleasant stay and the friendly exchange!

Die Lage des Piano Shed ist gut, da im Gehabstand zu S-Bahn. Auch das Ein und Auschecken verlief kontakt und problemlos. Das Piano Shed hat einen Flügel mit Silentmode und Charme, aber es war leider sehr kalt bei Ankunft. Nachdem wir die Heizungen angemacht haben, wurde es warm nach einiger Zeit. Doch leider gibt es keine gleichmäßige Verteilung der Wärme und keine Luftzirkulation. Das heisst, dass die ganze Wärme nach oben steigt und es im Winter zu kalt ist um die untere Etage zu nutzen, wo das Piano steht, obwohl es oben schon fast zu warm ist.
Ansonsten ist Schimmel in der Duschkabine und in der Toilettenkabine riecht es auch muffig/schimmlig, da es keine Lüftung für beide gibt. Es gibt auch staubige und mit Spinnenweben behancene Ecken.
Alles top danke
Very lovely apartment in a great area of Berlin. I can highly recommend :)
Great place to stay, very easy and fun atmosphere.

Ich hätte es nicht besser treffen können. Was für ein wunderschönes Ambiente. Auch ich habe das leckere Frühstück genossen und vor allem den angenehmen Kontakt mit Barbara.
Ein idealer Ausgangspunkt, um die Stadt zu entdecken.
Alles lädt zu einer Wiederholung ein, wenn ich das nächste Mal in Berlin bin.
Great location about an hour walk from Central Berlin, close to a train station, and a well-kept building. Would recommend!
everything okay, good place for a few days.

Gili is an amazing hoste !!!!! He cares about everything and he is helpful if you need something. Whatever your questions or problems he'll help you ! Moreover if you want to discover berlin and if you look for some tips : museums, walks, bar and clubs he will give you all informations you need.

Jan is a very friendly host.
Daniel's apartment is very tidy and clean also easy to going everywhere in Berlin.
Nice apartment, nice neighbourhood. Would recommend!
Appartement spacieux, très propre, calme car situe sur cour. Emplacement idéal, très bien desservi par les transports en commun. Tout était parfait.

Dejlig ramme for vores tur til Berlin. Vi havde en god kontakt til værten som også gerne vil være behjælpelig både med gode råd, men tilbød også med at handle ind da butikkerne var lukket.
Området var dejligt, masser af Liv i nærområdet og tæt på offentligt trafik.
Le logement est super et Biggi est très communicative et flexible . Je le recommande !

Annalisa è stata super accogliente e ospitale.

Wir können die Unterkunft bei Robert nur empfehlen! Er ist ein sehr sympathischer, warmherziger und sehr hilfsbereiter Gastgeber! Die Kommunikation von Anfang bis Ende war super! Die Unterkunft ist genauso schön oder sogar noch schöner wie auf den Bildern. Auch Jack, der genau so entspannt wie Robert ist, haben wir sofort ins Herz geschlossen! Die die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral und ist verkehrstechnisch super angebunden – aber trotzdem absolut ruhig!
Apartments are new and excelent. The place were it is situated is convinient to use any public transport. A lot of shops and restaurants nearby. No noise in the night. Highly recommended.

Wie auf dem Bilder ! Schön und sauber.

Great value for money. Very clean. great place in a central location

Très pratique grâce à l’autonomie totale pour les accès, la chambre correspond aux photos et la literie d’excellente qualité.

Sehr bemühter Gastgeber. Optimale Lage zum Messegelände. Sehr ruhige Umgebung. Wohnung ist mit vielem ausgestattet. Gab nur Probleme mit dem Wlan. Ansonsten angenehmer Aufenthalt.
Nice apartment and location.

Great apartment, cozy and elegant

Sehr schöne Wohnung. Leider im EG, daher hat man die Leute draußen direkt vorm Schlafzimmer stehen.

Die U- Bahn direkt um die Ecke.
The loft is perfect. No more words needed. Will come back for sure!

One of the best Airbnb's I have stayed in. Very tidy and lovely Airbnb apartment equipped with everything you need. From bed to tidy bathroom, everything was in order and also had instructions in every room which helps to follow and respect guests and host.
Judith is a great host and will definitely stay there again!!!

Super schöne, kleine Altbauwohnung - sehr ruhig Richtung Innenhof gelegen. Vor allem das Bett war sehr bequem, habe hervorragend darin geschlafen. Apartment was so cosy and clean. Communication with Maria was very fast. We're enjoy it!!
The place is clean and good value for money. Though I would add that you can quite literally hear everything that’s going on in the rooms next to you.

Eine wunderbare Unterkunft, geführt von sehr sympathischen und bemühten Menschen. Wir haben uns sehr willkommen gefühlt und hatten einen richtig tollen Aufenthalt, bei dem uns an nichts gemangelt hat.
Eine dicke Buchungsempfehlung!!! Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder. :)

I stayed 4 days in the apartment. They respected my privacy. Slim gave me great advises where to go. In general I felt like I stayed at friend's place. They have a great collection of rubber ducks. So having this breakfast was was perfect, since in rainy weather you didn't want to go out right away. Nice and clean apartment I can come and go at any time.

A really simple and good place to stay!
He is a super host and the room was friendly like he is.
U Bahn and all supermarkets easy to find.
Simple and easy choice for accommodation

Cannot rave about this place enough. Spotless and relaxing apartment in a fantastic neighborhood that is walking distance to everything. The restaurants nearby were great and the street is very quiet at night. Would recommend to anyone.
Wir hatten wirklich schöne 3 Tage und haben uns von Anfang an sehr wohl gefühlt! 💌

Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt in
der Wohnung von Uwe.

Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und diverse Restaurants sind gut zu Fuß zu erreichen.
Wir würden jederzeit wieder bei Uwe buchen.
nette kleine Wohnung. Zu 2 völlig ausreichend aber für 4 Personen wirklich zu eng.

Der Aufenthalt bei Ayako ließ keine Wünsche offen und übertraf meine Erwartungen. Ihre Begrüßung war freundlich , das Zimmer sauber und gemütlich und es gab sogar einen Wasserkocher auf dem Zimmer. Ich würde jederzeit wieder bei Ayako übernachten. Absolut empfehlenswert!

Hannah's home is very cosy and comfy. It's on the top floor, but it totally worth it to climb on each day! The building is looks awesome (it's and Art Deco masterpiece) outside and inside too. The flat is spacious and friendly, the kitchen and the bathroom is clean as well. The room is looks better than on the pictures, the large windows make it super bright. In the flat you can find everything what you need for the daily routine.
It's not so far from the popular destinations in Berlin, and it's in a friendly area. There is a lot of good restaurants. The parking with car was easy on each day.
Picking up / leaving the key was super easy as well.

Wir haben 3 Nächte in der Wohnung verbracht. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt, alles war sehr sauber und die Lage ist auch sehr gut. Tram und Hbf sind gleich in der Nähe. Alles war wie beschrieben und können wir nur weiterempfehlen!
Great little place to stay. Cosy home away from home in Berlin with hospitable hosts :) Thank you

We needed a place from where we could easily travel to the centre of Berlin and also a peaceful place to rest after a busy day; Henry's appartment was the perfect fit for this!
If you come with public transport, it's about 15 minutes walking distance from the S-bahn, so that was perfect for us. When we arrived, we got a warm welcome and a clear tour of the house.
The only thing that wasn't totally clear to us was how private the appartment would be. You are directly next to the hosts house and although it was closer than we had expected, we never felt like we didn't have privacy. Because we were so close to the hosts house, it was very easy for us to ask questions when needed and everytime they helped us out with much kindness.
The only thing that missed was good wifi. There was actually wifi, but it wasn't strong enough for three people. But we still had a lovely time and explored a big part of Berlin in just a few days. We're defenitely thinking of returning!

Javier the co-host of Lola was really nice, the hold house looks just amazing, every single detail, the room is bigger than how looks in the pictures. He also give us maps and recommendations for spend the time in Berlin. Really happy and grateful for the hold experience

I had a great time here! Paolo and Manuel were super nice and made me feel right at home. Big comfortable room, desk and good wifi, great location near a fun neighborhood and close to tram/train lines. I would definitely come back. Thanks!
Marc was an excellent host. There was great communication and a lot of help provided. The location was fantastic and Marc was very easy to deal with. We would definitely return.

Die Unterkunft war wirklich schön, tolle Lage und sehr netter Vorgarten. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und gemütlich. Das w-lan hat einwandfrei funktioniert, ebenso die Schlüsselübergabe. Ich hatte keine Möglichkeit Kerstin persönlich kennenzulernen, aber die Kommunikation per Mail hat super geklappt. Würde jederzeit wieder gerne die Remise buchen.
Good location and many things to do close buy with easy access to multiple metros

Serkan es un anfitrión excelente.

Lovely place … I will book it again when I back to Berlin.
Sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt. Alles vorhanden, was man zum Leben braucht. Der Check-in verlief reibungslos und die Kommunikation war perfekt. Vielen Dank.

Жилье подходит для большой компании. Из минусов – квартира в не очень хорошем состоянии, пришлось подкрутить ручку в ванной чтоб она не отваливалась, держатель для душа болтается, столик в царапинах, окно плохо закрывается. Из плюсов – большой балкон.

Our family stayed four nights in Andreas apartment. The apartment is, as seen in the pictures, very nice. We especially loved the terasse where we could enjoy the sun in the afternoons and evenings.
We loved the surroundings in Prenzlaur Berg, with restsaurants and cafés.
Andrea is very friedly and helpfull, and she always replied fast to our questions.

Excellent place, the location is perfect as it's in Neukolln but still nice and quiet. Lots of space in the apartment, clean and functional. Great to communicate with, clear directions for check-in and host was very responsive and helpful to any questions I had. Definitely recommend :)
Really clear communication and nice location! We had a good time!

This was a very good experience. Roy welcomed us upon arrival. The appartement was perfect - almost "over-equipped"! We enjoyed the luxury. The appartement is placed in walking distance from KaDeWe, which is very convenient. Just around the corner is a fantastic bakery - easy to pick up breakfast. We have already recommended this appartement to a couple of friends who got quite interested. Many stars from our site!
The apartment was great and the location is very convenient.
Super stylish apartment, easy access and very clean. The stay was very pleasant and easy to find. Would defiantly come back

Very nice and clean flat with everything needed. The communication with the hosts was always easy and very friendly. The Airbnb is located very well and is a good starting point to discover the city of Berlin.

The flat was nice, clean, and in a central locality with several good restaurants within walking distance! At the same time, the neighbourhood was also peaceful and quiet during night. Elisa was always helpful and responded promptly to any queries or doubts. Highly recommend this flat to anyone going to Berlin!

Sehr freundlich, sauber und sehr zentral!

Very communicative and the place was very clean!

Eine tolle Gelegenheit für einen zentralen Aufenthalt in Berlin :) Da wir im Sommer da waren, hätte ich mir wenigstens einen Ventilator gewünscht, ich fand es sehr stickig im Zimmer.
Very bright and comfortable apartment. Very caring and detailed communication. Nice location with quick and efficient transportation to any part of the city. We enjoyed it very much. Thank you!

The apartment is full of design with pieces of art and a well equipped kitchen and bath room (rain shower!). The apartment has a natural balcony filled with plants and flowers for  having a coffee/tea in the morning. The apartment has great bus and subway (U-bahn) connections to all districts of Berlin. Highly recommended!
Very nice and clean place!

Dagmar is very nice. She drove me two times to the S Bahn station and offered me coffee in the morning. Excellent place, very central, and the host was very responsive. Loved staying here and the price was very reasonable!

Отличная квартира, отличные хозяева, лично познакомится не удалось, но проблем с получением ключей не возникло, идеальное место для остановки с маленькими детьми, квартира суперчистая, на кухне есть все необходимое, но учтите, между гостиной и спальней нет двери, а плотные шторы, вдруг кому-то это важно. Really great accomodation in a busy neighborhood. Loved the recommendations on the welcome pack and went to a few of the suggested locations! Really convenient for travel over the whole city too. Check in and check out was easy!
Lovely place, nice host :-)
Sehr saubere Wohnung und einwandfreie Kommunikation.

Der Aufenthalt war einfach nur gut. Die Unterkunft ist klein, aber fein, sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet und ich habe mich sofort wohl gefühlt. Die Umgebung bietet jede Menge Restaurants und Cafés, Anbindung an ÖPNV könnte nicht besser sein. Unbedingte Empfehlung!
Very good experience. Everything we needed was there and the apartment was also very clean and spacious.

Heel fijn appartement: ruim, gezellig en complete inrichting, voelt heel huiselijk aan. De Körnerkiez heeft veel te bieden en toch is de straat zelf rustig. Misbah en Rachel zijn tophosts: steeds supersnel en volledig reagerend, flexibel met aankomst en vertrek.

Cogimos este apartamento el mismo dia porque nos cancelaron el que teniamos de antemano. Douglas se mostro atento y servicial en todos los aspectos. Martin our host has been very welcoming and helpful from the beginning to the end of our visit to Berlin. The apartment was clean and the location convenient and calm. I highly recommend this airbnb! And I would like to thank Martin again

The host was friendly and welcoming! The place was clean, spacious, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Lovely place, sparely but nicely furnished, in a beautiful neighborhood - we were very comfortable.

Stefan’s apartment is absolutely wonderful – a beautiful, welcoming, and cozy place that instantly feels like home. It’s fully furnished and equipped, with great attention to detail throughout. The kitchen is exceptionally well-stocked – it’s rare to find a place where you have absolutely everything you need to cook.

The cleanliness was impeccable – everything was spotless and well-organized. Communication with Stefan was excellent: fast, efficient, and very friendly. He provided all the necessary information and made sure we felt comfortable throughout our stay.
I wholeheartedly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for an authentic, comfortable, and charming experience in Berlin. We would definitely come back!
Great stay!

Platz, überall die schönen Originalfenster, alles liebevoll restauriert. Herzlichen Dank und ein grosses Kompliment an das Gastgeberpaar.

sehr sauber, schöne Ausstattung und top lage. beim check in gab es ein wenig Probleme da mir die falsche Zimmernummer und ein falscher code zugeschickt wurden. konnte aber schnell gelöst werden.
The place was as described, very neat and clean and quiet in a beautiful neighborhood. The WIFI worked very nice as well!  I was very happy having stayed here. Highly recommend!

Rene's place is very comfortable, is in  very pleasant part of Berlin and both airport (Tegel) and centre of Berlin are easily accessible.

Ganz tolle Unterkunft in Köpenick. Wir waren in 30 min beim Tiergarten und 20 min beim Müggelsee. Lage ruhig, aber trotzdem gut angebunden. Parkplätze in den Nebenstraßen reichlich vorhanden.
Unten in der Unterkunft gibt es ein hervorragendes Café.
Das Personal ist herausragend freundlich und zuvorkommend gewesen.
Klare Empfehlung!

Die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet. Die Umgebung ist mit den vielen Restaurants und Shops ein super Einstieg auf den Weg zur belebten Berliner "Innenstadt".
Wohnung und vor allem dem Vermieter kann ich nur weiter empfehlen.
Sehr saubere Unterkunft. Die Location war perfekt um Berlin zu erkundigen.

Eine so schnelle Bestätigung der Buchung habe ich noch nie erhaltet. Ich habe reserviert und in weniger als 30 Sekunden habe ich ein Bestätigung bekommen. In 2 Minuten hatte ich eine Zimmer. About 5 min walk from a train station that takes you anywhere in the city. 5 min walk to East Side Gallery on the Berlin Wall. 15-20 min by train from all the tourist attractions you might want to visit.  The loft itself is large and well decorated and furnished. Two large beds (both very comfortable) and two couches. Plenty of room for two couples. Kitchen was great to prepare some meals. Washer and dryer was helpful to do laundry. Grocery store about 10 min away (just 5 min other direction from train). Tons of bars and restaurants in the neighborhoods nearby.  But also on a quiet street, so easy to sleep and get some rest.  Check in was easy. Great communication from our hosts. Would stay here again. We loved it. Thanks much! Cheers!
pequeño alojamiento recomendado para estadías más bien cortas. es cómodo y tiene una gran ventana
Ich empfehle nicht

Excellent location and great balcony! Great neighborhood and easy access to all of the sights.  Lovely little check in setup with much needed cold beverages. Clean and comfortable room.  We loved the liveliness of the area but people needing absolute silence should look elsewhere.

super Lage direkt an der U-Bahn-Haltestelle Bernauer Str., viele Restaurants, Cafes und Botiquen in direkter Nähe - abseits des Trubels.

Spotless, peaceful residential side street, just half a block away from so many restaurants, bars, shops, Marheineke Markt, a park, and app bikes and scooters! Bergmannkiez is a desirable neighborhood. Great water pressure! Great sleeping! Comfy, cozy, and perfect!

Top Gastgeberin, schöne ruhige Lage.

Great location

Decent little place. Nice bars and shops around. Easy to get into the city centre. For getting into town there’s a bike rental place next door which is decently priced. Or it’s a few stops on the tram, or grab one of the e-scooters.
L’appartement est nickel, conforme à la photo et vraiment très propre. Il est aussi bien équipé. J’ai passé un très bon séjour 🤗

I stayed a couple of days in Berlin with two frinds of mine. Unfortunately, I haven't met Andrea in person. But everything was well organised and there is nothing to complain about. Thank you so much!

It feels like home is a spacious space is nice and clean
Recommended 100%
Our stay was very comfortable. The apartment is modernly equipped (drip coffee maker appreciated ;) ) and feels really cozy.  Alan was always ready to help, so I can highly recommend him as a host.

シャワーも暖かく、バスタオルなども清潔で、
生活に必要なものはすべてそろっていた。
対応もよく、迷うところもなかったので
すごくよかったと思います。

Arthur is lovely and the location is fantastic. Beautiful view of the river and Berlin. Very spacious with lots of wonderful books to look at and comfortable beds. Well appointed and clean kitchen. Arthur was very helpful and gave us some great advice about the area and how to get around. We got held up, and Arthur was very nice about refunding some of our money. Overall, the value for price paid was pretty amazing. It’s a really big and spacious loft with beautiful views, and great access to the city. There’s also a great little convenience store right downstairs to get snacks and beverages after our journeys. We were definitely stay at Arthur’s place again if we go back to Berlin.

Kuschelige und direkt am Boxhagener Platz gelegene Unterkunft. Man ist mitten im  Szene Viertel Friedrichshain, auch ist man schnell im Stadtzentrum bei den großen Sehenswürdigkeiten. Ich kann die Unterkunft nur empfehlen.
Appartement très agreable au rez de chaussée, propre et bien chauffé. Proche des transports en commun, avec supermarchés et restaurants à proximité. Nous y avons passé à 4 une semaine parfaite.
Appartement très agréable, hôte très disponible... Parfait pour découvrir Berlin !
Berlin ist immer eine Reise wert - erst recht in dieser tollen Unterkunft!

Stephan is an amazing host- friendly, responsive, helpful. He reached out and gave us detailed directions before our trip. Check-in & check-out were super easy! His place is absolutely beautiful and cozy. Spotless clean and spacious. We fell in love with it as soon as we arrived. During our stay, we felt safe and felt like being home. The kitchen was well equipped and everything we needed was provided. The location is great- close to bus stops that can either take you to Berlin Main Train Station (10 mins ride) or anywhere you’d like to visit in Berlin. 100% recommended!!!
The neighbourhood is very peaceful. There is a supermarket across the apartment and the metro station is five minutes away which made it very convenient.
Great location and responsive host

Venues passer quelques jours à Berlin entre amies, nous sommes absolument ravies de notre séjour chez Kasia. L'appartement, idéalement situé (à deux pas de tout une série de super petits commerces et restaurants) est encore plus spacieux et charmant que sur les photos, le grand canapé dans le salon très convivial, les lits confortables. Ici vous ne trouverez pas un logement dépersonnalisé, mais vous sentez au contraire que vous êtes hébergés chez une famille, dans un logement vivant et plein de chaleur, mais aussi - c'est le gros avantage - parfaitement meublé et équipé ! Les jouets des enfants sont parfaitement intégrés dans le décor et pas du tout gênants. Dernier point, Kasia, qui n'a pas pu nous accueillir elle-même, nous a envoyé une vidéo très précise et utile pour trouver facilement l'appartement, et nous a mises en contact avec Charlotte pour la remise des clés. Tout a été très fluide. Nous recommandons à 100 % !

Very nice place to stay. Hosts are very friendly and easy going, always quick responds to our questiona. The house cant be more central and close to public tranaportation, that was amazing . The house was very clean, cozy and big. The view was amazing. I highly recommend to stay .

Berlin was absolutely worth for a
Visit. Jo’s place was really at good location , right in Mitte center. Recommended. Rent a bike in Berlin is a must try. Very interesting at Berlin Wall East Side
Sehr gemütliche und ruhige Unterkunft. Das Zimmer bzw. die Wohnung bietet alles, was man für einen Aufenthalt benötigt. Nur zu empfehlen! :)
Apparemment très bien situé pour visiter Berlin. Quartier sympa et très calme.  Je recommande.

Robert’s flat is ideally located if you want to visit Berlin, the neighborhood is living with plenty of restaurants and bar, and the Metro is 2 min
Robert welcomed me as a friend and it's very cool when you travel alone like I did 😄 thank you and se you soon!!

Alexander hat schnell auf Nachrichten reagiert und kann viel über die Umgebung und Berlins Geschichte erzählen. Ich habe den Weg zur Unterkunft dank der Beschreibung sehr einfach gefunden und konnte schon früher einchecken weil die vorherigen Gäste bereits abgereist waren. Das Zimmer ist in einem Innenhof sehr ruhig gelegen und das Bett war bequem.
Thank you Adrien.! We had a great time at your place.

Ben’s place was a great home base for our stay in Berlin. Clean, simple, everything you need for a comfortable few nights. Very quiet and peaceful.
Great location in the middle of a vibrant community.
Super séjour chez Mélinée, le logement est idéalement situé, fonctionnel, propre et très bien décoré. Mélinée est très réactive par message. Nous reviendrons sans hésiter !

Etienne’s place was absolutely ideal.
We particularly loved having his paintings in the room, and having the balcony was so nice, I imagine even better in summer.
The bathroom was also lovely, we both agreed that the shower was perfect.
The room was super clean with really nice lighting ☺️
We only saw each other a couple of times and it seemed we had the place to ourselves often which was nice, although we would have really liked to chat more too so either way was fine with us.
A peaceful home in a very peaceful area, thankyou!
Sehr zentrale Unterkunft in Berlin! Gut mit dem Bus zu erreichen! Gerne wieder!

The apartment worked out very well for our needs. This was our first trip to Berlin and there were many places to eat and drink in the neighborhood as well as easy access to public transit. The place was centrally located, but also a quiet respite at the end of the day. We had multiple sets of keys which was great for our individual schedules as well.
There’s a bit of a heat wave that was descending upon us and we requested a fan. Unfortunately our hosts we’re out of town, but within the hour we had housekeeping deliver a fan to us! All of our communication was timely and very accommodating And we appreciate it such a worry-free stay.
Spotlessly clean, very professional. I asked a stupid question and he sorted it out graciously. Great host and place.

Julius’s tiny house was perfect, in a great location close to lots of lovely bars, restaurants and tram stations which made it easy to get anywhere in the city. Had everything we needed and was beautifully decorated and very clean. It’s located in a quiet neighbourhood at the back of a beautiful building, the only thing it doesn’t mention is the outside area is right next to the bins but we didn’t seem to mind! Would definitely book again if I came back to Berlin, was the perfect base for our short stay.

Das Appartement war sehr schön. Zu dritt hatten wir genügend Platz gehabt. Die ausziehbare Couch war letztlich bequemer als das Beistellbett.
Die Küche mit Geschirrspüler ist ausreichend für kleine Gerichte. Geschirrhandtuch am Besten selber mitbringen. Die Problematik mit dem Wasserdruck ist weiterhin vorhanden gewesen. Deswegen nur 4*.
Great and clean place in awesome neighborhood!
Alles prima, gerne wieder!

We were greeted by our hosts upon arrival and shown the basics of the place. The apartment is very charming and quiet. It is very fitting for the neighborhood it is situated in.
We didn’t have any questions thanks to the plethora of guides and reading material provided. The apartment is a short walk to the U Bahn and you can reach out and touch all of the cafes and shops along the way. What’s more, there is a cab queue just up the block for easy access to the airport after your stay. I highly recommend this apartment for a visit in Berlin. 😊
Everything went perfectly well! Nice place, perfect area, easy communication. 100% recommandation :)
Sehr schickes Hausboot und trotz der relativen Nähe zur Großstadt absolut ruhig !
Very good value for money. Really easy to check in and out and very good instructions
Gute Lage, günstige Anbindung an die U-Bahn, sehr ruhig.
Alles da für einen längeren Aufenthalt. Habe mich dort sehr wohl gefühlt. Und dank der tollen Lage zur S-Bahn ist alles andere in Berlin gut erreichbar.

Eine schöne Unterkunft und eine sehr interessante Gegend.
Meine Freundin und ich sind uns einig, wir werden noch mal dahinfahren.

We loved Maria’s place and her sweet cat who greeted us upon arrival😊 Communication was easy and friendly and Maria was very understanding with any of our requests. We loved the Balcony space in particular. It was also well situated, only an 8 minute walk to local shops and the train station. Would highly recommend!
Katharina hat uns sehr nett empfangen. Alles sehr unkompliziert. Sehr geschmackvolle kleine Wohnung , die Kids liebten das Bett auf der Empore. Lage auch gut sehr schnell im Zentrum, gerne wieder

Die Unterkunft ist neu renoviert und in einem entsprechend sauberen, guten Zustand.
Die Lage istetwas abseits vom Zentrum, dafür aber ruhg gelegen und mit guter Parkmöglichkeit, wonach wir als Anreisende mit PKW gezielt gesucht haben.
Schöne Veranda die zum verweilen einlädt. Privatsphäre bleibt gewahrt.
Die Internetverbindung ist nicht ganz optimal, aber die Ursache liegt beim Telekommunikationsunternehmen und nicht bei den Vermietern.
Gerne wieder.

Great place to say in East Berlin. Really close to tons of restaurants and shops. Room is huge and you get your own private bathroom. The main door of apartment is shared for their office space. But really not a problem. Super nice and communicative people.
Lena’s Place was great. It is in a brilliant location with a fantastic food market and nice bar near by. The place is cosy and the fire was really appreciated.
large place, great location well equipped. host was great and available

The apartment was everything we expected and communication with the host was great. We really appreciated that we got the opportunity to drop our luggage in the apartment upon arrival, as we arrived before the standard check-in time. The neighborhood was cute and central, just a 5 minute walk away from Kastanienallee/Oderberger Str.

The only drawback was that the temperature reached 36 degrees (!) the day we arrived, and even with all windows open, the apartment was quite hot.. However, the host gave us a great tip to a pool by the river where we could cool off.

Would definitely return to this apartment, but probably in the spring or autumn!
clean, easy check-in, perfect location, Dor is friendly and helpful :)
Alles top, schöne Unterkunft und netter Kontakt :)

Natalie was easy to communicate with and we found the apartment nice and practical to stay in for our family of three.
The neighborhood was walkable and family friendly, with especially nice cafes and bars on the same street as the apartment.
The only couple of things to consider is that there is no AC which made it a bit hot during the heat wave (but shouldn’t be an issue at other times) and that the apt didn’t get a lot of sunlight as it is on the ground floor (which again, shouldn’t matter if you are out and about during the day). It got a bit street and train noise if the windows were open, which didn’t bother us much.
Sehr unkomplizierter Check-In, saubere Wohnung, super Location...es gibt nichts auszusetzen. Würde die Wohnung jedem anderen AirBnb'er empfehlen. 5 Sterne :)
Great location, lively bars and restaurants nearby so can be noisy at night. Beware it's 89 steps up to the apartment so some will not manage.
Flat was ok. Great advice for surrounding area, bars Abd stuff.
Clean apartment, nice location, friendly host, great recommendations!

Excelente ubicación para la estadía en Berlin, cerca de paradas de buses, cerca de estación de tren, (se escucha el ruido de tren pero para nada momesto), lugsres de comida cerca, y supermercado también, el departamento super limpio, cómodo, cálido y el gatito amoroso.
El anfitrión super amigable, nos proporciono buenas recomendaciones sobre Berlín!
nos gustó alojarnos allí! volveremos! 😁

Das Zimmer ist einfach, zum Übernachten völlig in Ordnung. Wie beschrieben, wird noch umgebaut. Mir war es im Bad zu kalt, es gibt (noch?) keine Heizung. Insgesamt für den Preis bei der Lage eine gute Möglichkeit, günstig zentral zu übernachten.

Localização privilegiada. Fica a 4 minutos andando da estação Schönhauser Allee, linha 2 do U-Bahn. Dali vc vai pra AlexanderPlatz e tem acesso aos melhores pontos de Berlim. Valeu cada centavo essa estadia e quando voltar a Berlim, irei procura-la novamente com certeza.

This apartment was as much as we could have hoped for. It was very well equipped, nicely decorated and had tons of space. The view from the deck was also fantastic, much better than the pictures showed. The neighborhood was also great. It was very quiet and in a super nice setting. Excellent value and a very nice rental.
Schöne Wohnung, Bettdecken sind bloß sehr kurz.

We had a great stay at Fundas Apartment! It was very spacious and very clean when we came in. The area is great to discover Berlin, you are very close to Ostkreuz station, where lots of restaurants and bars are, and yet the street the apartment is located is nice and peaceful. A supermarket is just 2 minutes away by foot. Funda was also very nice and answered quickly. Thank you for letting us stay! We would love to come back and will definitely recommend it! 😊
Great location.  Nice view from the 17th floor.  Walking distance (20 minutes) from Potsdamer Platz and Mall of Berlin.

The stay was good. I was greeted by Patrick, he helped me with the suitcase to the 4th floor. Gave great recommendations for nearby, supermarkets, restaurants and art galleries to check out. The room is lovely and spacious.
Alles bestens!
Wirklich sehr schöne Wohnung für Zwei. Für Vier vielleicht etwas eng. Leider keine Kaffeemaschine da, sonst alles top und Koffer in die 4. Etage muss man tragen wollen. ;-)
Beautiful space

Jorn's place is friendly, welcoming clean and very well furnished with everything you might need! Jorn is an excellent communicator and was helpful with us booking his apartment, transfers and helping us make the most of our stay in beautiful Berlin from the moment we hit the tarmac. Jorn was also very kind in his flexibility of our check in time which really started our break off well. I would not hesitate to recommend Jorn's place to anyone I knew was going to Berlin. Thank you Jorn!
Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und schön eingerichtet. Es hat alles was man braucht. Babett ist sehr nett und hat super schnell geantwortet.

The place was clean and quiet. Overall our stay was fine. One thing to note if your are three people: we were told there would be a bed prepared for a third person but there wasn’t. There was a camping type bed thing in the corner with no instructions, and there was no duvet or pillow for a third person prepared. We informed Raffaela twice before arriving that we will be three people and were assured the place would he prepared for three.
A great tinyhouse in Berlin!! You have kind hospitality, exceptional services and wonderful location!

The house is very beautiful, with a pleasant balcony on a calm park and the TV tower of Alexanderplatz on sight, illuminated by night.
It's also well situated between Mitte and Prenzlauerberg, both at walking distance.
We spent five great days.
Stefan is a kind host. Thanks!
Centrally located studio apartment, conveniently close to bars and restaurants. Perfect for a single traveler or a couple. Wouldn't mind staying there again the next time I visit Berlin.
Very nice place. Close to the centre, very clean. Positive was a working WiFi and I felt safe in the apartment.

My colleague and I stayed for a conference and the experience within our semi-serviced apartment was excellent along with a delicious full breakfast (extra charge) each morning. The location was excellent with plenty of restaurants nearby and the staff were all very attentive. Lastly, the price was attractive for two people with plenty of room within the apartment, one room had an ensuite which was helpful. Overall, I would definitely recommend it and intend to stay here again for the conference next year.
Am fost pentru a doua oară și ne-am simțit excepțional! Merită tot absolut totul inpecabil! Locația de top! Liniște, pădure,aer curat cântecul păsărelelor non stop! Îți mulțumim pentru tot! 💪
Kathrin was a great host. Very helpful and made my stay comfortable and enjoyable. Many Thanks.
Es war wieder alles genial! Phantastisches Loft! Arthur ist ein perfekter Gastgeber! Vielen lieben Dank!

Die Wohnung war super und genau wie beschrieben. Die Wohnung liegt in einem Mehrfamilienhaus, es war aber ruhig. Fußläufig sind U-Bahn, Tram sowie der Bahnhof Gesundbrunnen schnell erreichbar.
Der Hausflur war ziemlich dreckig und wurde während unseres Aufenthalts auch nicht sauberer. Da dies aber durch das Mehrfamilienhaus nicht unmittelbar mit der Wohnung zutun hat, blieb dies in meiner Bewertung unberücksichtigt.

I stayed at Chris + Oliver's place for 5.5 months - really beautiful neighborhood and nice building. I recommend if you're looking for a nice flat for 1 person. 2 people would be a bit of a squeeze.
Chris and Oliver were great hosts, communication was very easy!
Things you should know if you're considering a longer term rental:
- There is no oven! There's a stove with 2 burners, but no actual oven. This is something I didn't realize until my arrival, It made eating in a little hard, but I managed.
- The hot water for the shower doesn't stay hot longer than about 5-7 minutes, so your showers must be quick.
- The wifi isn't the strongest, mostly needs to be used in the main room, doesn't work so well in the kitchen
I'd recommend this place if you're looking for a place in Berlin for 1 person! Thanks Chris and Oliver!

Really cute apartment in a great, safe location that is close walking distance to public transit. If anything the apartment was larger than I expected. The kitchen has everything you might need for cooking!
Very nice host with a nice apartment which is around 15-20m from the city centre. The underground is a 3-4min walk with a bus stop and tram stop near.
L'appartement est conforme à la description, il est propre, agréable et offre toutes les commodités. Nous n'avons pas rencontré Tobias mais il s'était bien organisé pour nous accueillir.

Definitely recommend to stay in Mona’s house! It’s not in the center but it’s really easy to get to it in the public transport, de bedroom was really nice and clean exactly like in the photos!
The bed was really to sleep after a hole day walking in the center.
We really feel like home
Suitable for young people who travel in a group.
Muy bien en genes tal. Muy buen estado y limpio. Camas muy cómodas.
This was an excellent hostel! The Accommodations were great and the staff was helpful and welcoming. I would recommend here for your stay in Berlin!
Alle super!

Very nice and roomy appartment, with a wonderful sauna to get warm after long walks in the cold!
Gal is a very friendly and reactive host.
Die Unterkunft liegt super zentral und ist trotzdem ruhig. Wir hatten eine super Zeit! Ich würde die Unterkunft jederzeit wieder buchen!
Alles okay, wir kommen wieder
Clean and well situated, fine for a three day trip
Great place to stay with a large group. Nice open space for people to spread out

Wir sind Neufans von Berlin Tegel und unserer Super-Gastgeberin Angela! Durch ihre offene, herzliche und zugewandte Art haben wir uns wie zu Besuch bei einer Freundin gefühlt. Angelas Wohnung und das Gastzimmer mit eigenem Bad waren sehr gemütlich, schön eingerichtet/ dekoriert und makellos sauber. Angela hat wirklich an alle möglichen Bedürfnisse ihrer Gäste gedacht - von der Mehrfachsteckdose direkt am (Hoch)Bett über Infobroschüren zu guten eats, sights und activities in der Gegend bis hin zu einem Schränkchen mit allen erdenklichen Hygieneartikeln für den vergesslichen Gast ;-) Durch die direkte Nachbarschaft zum Tegeler See ist Angelas Wohnung ein idealer Ausgangspunkt für wunderschöne kürzere oder längere Fahrradtouren. Auch kulinarisch hat die Gegend einiges zu bieten und man muss nicht unbedingt in die Stadtmitte. Diese ist allerdings durch die großstadttypisch- hervorragende ÖPNV-Anbindung sehr einfach zu erreichen.
Wir hatten tolle Tage, danke Angela :-)

We had a lovely stay at Isabelle’s place. She had everything we could have needed and added some lovely extra touches that were really appreciated by us all!
The apartment was so convenient and easy to access, the area was okay too, it had anything we needed and was a short walk to the S Bahn.
The only inconvenience we had was the heat. We stayed during a few warm days and the apartment was really warm. There was a fan provided but we recommend sleeping with the windows open and shutters down just to allow some air in!
Overall our stay was perfect, Isabelle’s place was better than the pictures and we’d definitely stay again☺️
Andrea is a very nice lady. the place is quiet, but not far away from the center of Berlin. Very well served, and the veggie breakfast provided is a really big surprise.
Tolles Zimmer in toller Lage, habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und kann es nur weiter empfehlen.
This apartment is in a great location with easy access by tram to downtown Berlin. Quiet hours are strictly followed in the neighborhood at night. Good home base for exploring the city.
Everything as promised, fast responses.

Perfect place, clean and convenient.
I am from Berlin but live in the US. With Covid it took 3 long years before I was able to come home and see my family again. Since my parents house is only one train stop away and I know the area well and this was the perfect fit for my husband and I.
The place:
Super clean and has everything you need to make it a perfect little home away from home. It's bright and quiet despite the train stop nearby with a garden and trees in the back.
The location:
In my opinion it's in the prefect location. It's away from the hustle and bustle, but still super close to everything. The train stop to the S-Bahn is literally a stones throw away and as it is one of the main train lines it can take you to downtown Berlin and all the fun stuff in no time. There is a grocery store and bakery right across the street, several restaurants and 'food to go' options within walking distance. There is a park nearby for running and chilling and another set of great running and walking trails close by.
The hosts:
Michael and Kerstin were super nice and easy to communicate with. They greeted us when we arrived and made sure we hade everything we needed. They made us feel welcome and at home throughout our stay.
A lovely place and highly recommended. Hope to stay there again.
Thomas è stato gentilissimo e molto flessibile, super consigliato!

Great value for the money! It was close to the center, easy to reach, 2 grocery stores nearby and quite clean. And even if the bathroom was shared, we never stumbled across any of the other guests and could use the bathroom whenever we liked.
Top Lage und Top Hotel
Monika we una increíble host. Si lugar es cómodo y agradable, su atención se destaca por mucho. Sin dudas, volvería a alojarme en su lugar.

Der Aufenthalt in Hubertusstraße (Berlin Steglitz) war einfach super. Ich habe mich ab dem 1. Tag in der Wohnung rundum wohl gefühlt. Die Umgebung war auch sehr geschickt, da man wenige Meter vom Apartment entfernt eine Bushaltestelle, U-Bahn Zugang… hat. Dies hat es mir ermöglicht, schnell und einfach von A nach B zu kommen.
Ich kann sowohl Hilda als Gastgeberin, als auch das Apartment total empfehlen und komme gerne wieder nach Berlin 🌇

If you want to stay close to the train station and in the centre of Berlin close to everything, of you like  nice and warm hosts who make you feel at home, choose the Lemon Tree Room. The room is spacious and has everything you might wish: a king-size bed and a sofa, a table where you can have your breakfast, a kettle,  a coffee perculator and a fridge.  The hosts have prepared lots of Berlin booklets where you can find lots of things you can do in Berlin. Apart from that Denise and Jürgen are ready to help you with advice and recommendations.  I would describe them as caring hosts ( and I have seen many during my travels) who make your visit to Berlin unforgettable! ❤️

Great stay, looks even better in person.
couldn't be happier with the location and the great communication with the host!
Fantastic stay.
Very good option in Berlin!
Fijne kamer. Alles netjes en schoon. Makkelijk binnenkomen en vriendelijke host. Je zit aan het begin van het huis, dus prive genoeg.

Apartment was well located and very clean. Host was easy to communicate with.
Overall, a very pleasant trip and I would be happy to stay there again.

…wir haben an der Deutschen Drachenboot Meisterschaft in Grünau teilgenommen und durften bei Fabian über das Wochenende übernachten.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung hat all unsere Erwartungen übertroffen. Eine super ausgestattete Küche (da fehlt es an nichts), ein schönes Bad, bequeme Betten, sauber,…alles was man für einen entspannten Urlaub sich so wünscht.
Wir haben mit Fabian nur kurz nach unserer Ankunft sprechen können - ein sehr freundlicher und herzlicher Gastgeber. Die meiste Zeit haben wir dann an der Regattastrecke verbracht. Die Abreise war in den frühen Morgenstunden - leider konnten wir uns bei der Abreise nicht mehr persönlich von Fabian verabschieden und uns bei ihm bedanken. Es ist schade, dass uns die nötige Zeit für ein nettes Gespräch gefehlt hat. Das nächste Mal – und das wird es sicher geben – werden wir uns mehr Zeit nehmen (Urlaubsmodus) und die Gastfreundschaft von Fabian gerne wieder in Anspruch nehmen.

Grüße vom Bodensee
Location is about 7-10 mins walk, quite a good and quite area! Very near to centre of Berlin!
Das Bett war gemütlich und alles war sauber. Die Einrichtung ist etwas karg, aber für den Preis alles vollkommen in Ordnung. Würde wieder buchen

There was a large splatter stain on the ceiling and they had to shut the water off in the building to do work between 8-12noon one day which was an inconvenience. The place was small but sufficient for what we needed and the rest of the room was clean. However it was small for the price

Bülent ist super netter und interessanter Gastgeber. Ich habe bei ihm Thermoflasche bei ihm vergessen. Aber er hat eine Wochenlnag etwa für mich sie aufbewahrt und zu mir zurückgegeben. Herzlichen Dank.
Nur. Es ist für war das Zimmer an der Nacht ohne Heizung etwas kalt...Es war gar nicht so schlimm.

We really enjoyed the apartment not too big nor too small perfect for a couples getaway.
We loved the area and in particular loved Berlin.
Probably the best Airbnb experience I've had. Brilliant apartment, perfect location, easy, friendly and helpful host. All in all I can't recommend Carolin and her apartment enough.

We were visiting our son on his semester abroad in Berlin. This apartment was perfect for our stay! It was so close to everything! You could walk the neighborhood to the local markets and restaurants, or catch the train anywhere in Berlin--all a 2 minute walk.
Yaz stayed in touch since the day I booked. After a long night of travel, we got to the apartment a little early. Yaz was there to greet us and allowed us to store our luggage while he finished preparing for us. He was so personable and offered great insight on places to go. When we returned later, the cozy apartment was warm, clean and well-appointed. Perfect for the 5 of us! There was a small fridge, microwave, toaster, pans, plates, glasses/mugs and plug-in coffee and tea pots available in the kitchen. Yaz very generously supplied towels, cleaning supplies, a vacuum cleaner, toilet paper, paper towels, coffee, tea, etc. all available. Overall we had a great stay and I would highly recommend this place .

Wir hatten ein großartiges Wochenende in Toms Unterkunft im Prenzlauer Berg ! Die Lage ist perfekt, um Berlin zu erkunden – viele Cafés, Restaurants und die Tram ist in unmittelbarer Nähe. Tom war ein super Host, immer erreichbar und hilfsbereit. Klare Empfehlung, wir kommen gerne wieder! :)

The apartment was comfortable and in a great location, close to a shopping area where you can get all you need, and yet in a quiet and family-friendly neighborhood. The apartment has everything one might need for a short or long term stay. Our communication with the hosts was great, we could always count on their support with any questions or problems during our stay. I can only recommend Anja’s place to someone who is looking to spend some time in Berlin.

Ein großzügiges, Loft artiges und Licht durchflutetes Appartment. Wir wurden mit Sekt und Blumen empfangen und fühlten uns gleich wie zu Hause. Sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet und hochwertige Bettwäsche und Bettzeug. Auch die übrige, technische Ausstattung ist sehr gut. Wir haben uns in den zwei Wochen sehr wohl gefühlt und den Süd-Balkon auch viel genutzt. My goodness! What an experience! This was by far the best Airbnb we had. Kristina was very responsive to communicate. The freedom of self check in was really awesome. Die Kommunikation, Check-in und -out waren unkompliziert und vorab wurden alle notwendigen Informationen gesammelt übergeben. Das Apartment ist klein, aber sehr praktisch eingerichtet. Alles war sauber und ordentlich bei unserer Ankunft. Die Wohnung ist ebenerdig und strassenseitig - uns hat das zwar nicht gestört (die Gardinen und elektrische Rollos bieten 100%igen Sichtschutz), allerdings könnte ich mir vorstellen, dass es bei Sommerhitze nicht so angenehm ist, wenn man nachts nur die oberen Fenster kippen kann kann.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist gut - in Gehdistanz hat man zahlreiche nette Bars, Restaurants und ist mitten im Charme des Prenzlauer Berges. Die Strassenbahnstation ist gleich um die Ecke und in knapp 10 Minuten ist man am Alexanderplatz bzw. kann direkt zu den Hackeschen Märkten fahren.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und für unsere Bedürfnisse war die Unterkunft perfekt - vielen Dank und volle Empfehlung von uns! :)

Absolutely gorgeous space! You really feel the luxury here and the attention to details. Steps from the new(ish) Berlin Wall Memorial and literally across the street from the U-bahn for convenience. Getting to the airport took less than 30 minutes. Huge soaker bathtub for relaxing your aching muscles after so much walking in Berlin (seriously, the best workout). The bed was heavenly and it was easy to get a silent night's sleep - no noise from the neighbours or street at night. There was some daytime construction on the exterior facade while I stayed here so it would be good to bring earplugs if you like to sleep in late. Communication was great & Patrick's mum met us to explain keys and explain everything we needed to know about the apartment. There was also a detailed neighbourhood guide book put together by Patrick that had all the details one would need to to navigate Mitte and beyond. Would absolutely stay again!
Cosy apartment close to public transport!
Apartment is bigger than its looks on photos. Very close to most popular Berlin attractions.

Apartament znajduje się w spokojnej dzielnicy nieco oddalonej od Centrum gdzie można dojechać w około 30 minut z przystanku tramwajowego w odległości 3-4 minut spacerem. Blisko duży supermarket oraz punkty gastronomiczne.
Sypialnia na ostatnim 2 piętrze domu a prywatna łazienka w przyziemu (poziom -1). Przejście przez prywatną część gospodarzy zgodnie z opisem apartamentu. Do dyspozycji balkon ze stołem na świeżym powietrzu i suszarką na ręczniki.
Jest bardzo czysto, schludnie i zgodnie z tym co widać na zdjęciach. Do dyspozycji kuchnia gospodarzy w tym półka w lodówce, urządzenia kuchenne i ekspres ciśnieniowy do kawy.
Gospodarze są bardzo mili i pomocni, szybko reagują na zapytania i pozostawiają dużo przestrzeni na swobodny pobyt. Jest bezpiecznie i panuje przyjazna atmosfera.
Ostatniego dnia mogliśmy zostawić nasze bagaże do godzin popołudniowych przed wieczornym powrotem do domu. Dziękujemy Michaelowi i jego żonie za wszystko. Polecamy to miejsce.

Exceptionally comfortable flat. Thoughtfully set up kitchen with everything you need and no clutter. Supermarkets close by and several public transport options within easy walking distance. I turned off the heaters and was still comfortable. Sven is kind and very responsive to messages. Highly recommended.
I enjoyed my short stay with Ron, who welcomed me personally. Thanks again for having me!

very good place to stay

Sehr zu empfehlen!
Had a lovely stay. Tatjana is very friendly, helpful and hospitable. Cozy and cute bedroom and terrace. Cats were adorable!
Stylische Wohnung mit industrial Design in typischem Kreuzberg -Hinterhof.

It was great to stay for a few days in Berlin in one of Alan and Kasia's flat. The flat is nice and tidy, same as in the pictures.  It is also  a convenient location, close to public transport. Geweldig schoon en fijn appartement. Foto’s kloppen en de omgeving was ook heel fijn en rustig! Ik wil hier zeker een keer terug komen!
Good location and spacious
Great place - thank you!
Die Wohnung ist toll und super gut ausgestattet - Altbaucharme! Die Verkehrsanbindung nach Berlin Mitte ist gut und die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war toll und komplikationslos.

A lovely relaxing flat to unwind in after busy days exploring Berlin!
Linda was very helpful, giving us loads of good tips for things to do in the area and around the city.
Would highly recommend!!

Die Wohnung ist groß und angenehm kühl an warmen Sommertagen. Fußläufig sind tolle Restaurants zu erreichen und trotzdem ist es in der Wohnung recht ruhig. Die Kommunikation lief unkompliziert, wir waren absolut happy!

Mirco was a fantastic host — very friendly and helpful.
