The apartment itself is very well-equipped. The kitchen has everything you need to prepare a delicious meal during your stay. The neighborhood is quiet and peaceful — we truly felt at home!
I would definitely recommend Mirco’s place and hope to stay there again when I’m back in Berlin.
The apartment was great, super well designed and close to everything in one of Berlin’s coolest neighbourhood. Max was a great host. I highly recommend!

Tamara’s place is located in a very nice spot in the middle of action of Berlin. Perfect for two people, provided with everything, easy to access and very easyq on the communication side with the host. The place is clean and very near a supermarket and the warschauer station, which is big and with many lines stopping there. Nice place!

Innanzitutto Till è molto cordiale e ti mette a tuo agio fin da subito, generoso e rispettoso della privacy altrui! La posizione è perfetta: ben fornito sia di bar, supermercati e parchi che per raggiungere i vari mezzi. La stanza è spaziosa come il resto delle camere, ed è una casa accogliente. Sicuramente ci tornerò in futuro

Die Wohnung ist sehr gut mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen (Haltestelle ca. 200 m entfernt).
Check-in und Check-out waren sehr einfach und gut erklärt.
Die Wohnung war genauso wie auf den Bildern, sehr sauber und schön warm, trotz des kalten Wetters (nachts minus 10 Grad, tagsüber plus 3 Grad).
In der Küche und Bad war alles vorhanden, was man für einen Kurzurlaub braucht. Zum Kochen kamen wir allerdings nicht, da in der Nähe sehr viele Restaurants sind.
Der Eingang direkt an der Straße war für unseren Aufenthalt sehr praktisch, da mühsames Treppensteigen wegfiel. Nur diejenigen, die im oberen Bereich der Wohnung schliefen, mussten die steile Treppe oder Leiter hochsteigen. (Anmerkung: Nichts für große Menschen, da niedrige Decke.) Das Bett im Erdgeschoss hingegen ist nichts für kleine Menschen, da das Bett sehr hoch ist. Aber alle Betten sind bequem.
Florian und Gaston sind super freundliche Vermieter, die sehr schnell auf Fragen geantwortet haben.
Great apartment - good transport links to central Berlin and nice surrounding area

Very nice apartment, and good localisation! Nous étions 9 amis, l'accueil a été sympathique.
Thank you!

Great home to discover the city
Very spacious and authentic Berlin style.
It was a cute home with everything you need for a comfortable stay. It's far from the city though. A bit expensive but you get everything you need plus the study area to work.

I had a fantastic stay at Rio's Airbnb in Berlin! The flat was very spacious, so was the room, facing the canal and filled by sunlight all day. The location was beautiful and peaceful, with easy access to public transport and great local spots around. The space was spotless, well-furnished, and had everything I needed. Rio was a wonderful host, making check -in seamless and ensuring a great experience. Highly recommend and would love to stay again!

The spacious apartement with it's ideal location offered our group of 8 people a very pleasant stay in Berlin. Only thing we didn't appreciate was the scent of Tobacco. Apparently previous guests before us we're smoking inside against the rules.
We spent one night in Damur's appartment. It' perfectly nice, clean and well situated. Damur is definitely a great thoughtful host.
Great hospitality and warm greetings.
Alles in allem ein sauberes und gutes Hotel.
Sehr schön ausgestattetes Apartment unweit zur Haltestelle Hallesches Tor ☺️
A fantastic place situated in the perfect location. Some really nice touches by the landlord were very thoughtful and added to our amazing experience.
Einfach top! Herzlichen Dank Fried! Die Wohnung war super, die Lage perfekt und wir fühlten uns sehr wohl. Gerne kommen wir wieder.
Great location. Plenty of space in bedrooms and kitchen/living area.

Lovely flat, super clean, very very comfortable beds, so quiet at night, very safe. Pretty much perfect! Only downside was that fact there was no lift, 5 flights of stairs can be a lot! Supermarket just 2 minutes away as well which was super useful. Thank you Natalia

Check in instructions were very clear, place is easy to find and its a nice and comfortable place for a short stay in Berlin. There was a bit of delay in the response time from the host, but overall the experience was great.

Thank you Limehome for a great stay. The check-in process is pretty simple and the limehome website is easily understandable. Great communication from the team, really quick responses, which was nice.
The room was very clean, big, comfortable beds. Very modern. A nice kitchen too. Location of the place is good if you’re not looking for a generic berlin experience. Our main goal was to shop around, thrift and eat some nice food, the locations was ideal for that.
A few things that I should note : The lights were at first a little hard to understand, maybe just trying to be a little too modern.
And the water pressure in the shower could be better. Not the worst tho.
To sum it up, limehome provided us with a very pleasant stay and i would not only come back, but also recommend it to friends. Thank you.

Die Lage der Wohnung war echt super , die U-Bahn ist wirklich direkt nebenan. Parkmöglichkeiten auch super! Man hat sich sehr wohl gefühlt :)
Gerne wieder!
Súper ubicación y espacio
Зручний чекін, затишна та чиста квартира з усіма зручностями. Дякую за гостинність
Ha sido fantástico y estupendo. Un anfitrión genial! Ninguna queja en nada.

Uneingeschränkte Weiterempfehlung für die Wohnung. Alles war sehr sauber und schön, alles Wichtige war vorhanden. Auch das Bett war super gemütlich. Zu Fuß war ich schnell an der Messe und sonst fahren am Theodor-Heuss-Platz diverse Busse und U-Bahn, sodass man auch unkompliziert überall sonst hinkommt. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen!
Es war ein angenehmer Aufenthalt. Alles war sauber.

Alloggio come da descrizione, anche meglio. Facilmente raggiungibile con i mezzi e di facile accesso anche con le valigie, grazie alla presenza di ascensore.
Casa ordinata e spaziosa, con tutto il necessario in bagno e in cucina.
L’aspetto più sorprendente è stato l’estremo garbo e gentilezza con cui Martina ci ha accolti. Piacevolissimo chiacchierare con lei dopo cena, ci ha fatti sentire come a casa.
Troverete una proprietaria di casa gentile e sempre disponibile a darvi consigli utili.

Vincent offers a comfortable, very spacious, with a nice high ceiling. This place is super convenient: very central yet relatively quiet. During the day the friendly next door artist will be working. Would definitely stay again.
For cyclists: you can easily park your bicycle(s) inside.

We stayed in the room for one night. The location is excellent, right in the center. The apartment is large and has everything you need. But the bathroom needs to be renovated. The door to the shower did not close, there was a lot of black mold on the tiles.

The apartment is great, amazing and comfortable bathroom. The location is perfect. Not far from the highway and the nearby station Charlottenburg is very close and takes you to almost every hotspot in Berlin. The neighborhood is quiet and has a lot of nice restaurants.
Franz is a nice host and he will tell you everything you want to know in Berlin. Thanks for the hospitality!
This house was perfect and quiet neighbourhood and easily accessible especially in the ground  floor, where bags can be easily transported . Great House!
Really cozy space
We had a superstay and Birte was a great host.
A very spacious and stylish apartment in a vibrant location with excellent transport links nearby. Highly recommended!

Alina is a very communicative and helpful host.  She even leaves a map with the house rules that has recommended restaurants and sights marked within her neighborhood.  The apartment is easily accessible to public transportation as well as walkable to some historic sights.  The apartment is clean and organized and very welcoming. We had a great time in Berlin and this apartment was a big part of that experience! Thanks!
Everything went smoothly. Location's gre
Martin's place is located in a quiet location, yet not far from Postdamer Platz. The apartment is nicely decorated and was very clean and tidy. Moreover Martin was very friendly and a great host.

Das Apartment entsprach vollständig den Bildern auf der Plattform. Die Lage war ideal, um Clubs wie den KitKatClub und andere fußläufig zu erreichen. Besonders hervorzuheben ist die Freundlichkeit und Hilfsbereitschaft der Mitarbeiter, die den Aufenthalt sehr angenehm gestaltet haben.
Ulla's place is nice, friendly and comfortable, and Ulla is likewise an excellent host. I would neither hesitate to book with Ulla again nor hesitate to recommend it to others.
Bright, airy flat with a nice balcony for having coffee in the morning or to relax at night.  Very convenient for travel on foot or by S-Bahn through Berlin.
empfehlenswert 👌🏽
The apartment is in a perfect location for exploring Berlin, a short walk to a U bahn. The local area has many restaurants and cafes to enjoy, would highly recommend!
Nice room in a great location, very clean.
Very convenient location - very clean with good communications.. Very happy to use the flat next time I'm in Berlin !!
Clean and quiet!  Would stay again.
Great place in a great location !
Удобно приезжать на машине. Очень, очень приятная хозяйка. Хочется приехать еще! Спасибо Урсула!
Very nice, confortable apartment, in an extremely centric and easy-to-reach part of Berlin.

Robert was super helpful in terms of recommendations and being responsive.
I would recommend this place to people who are okay sharing a bathroom with a couple others. As for the room, it is minimal but clean.
I really liked the location because you are in the middle of city center and can walk to a bunch of restaurants. I didn’t mind the street noise though it was loud at night and thought it added to my experience.
We were also able to leave our bags on the day of our checkout which I thought was thoughtful. Would absolutely stay here again

L'appartement était propre, idéalement situé et les instructions très claires pour venir. Nous recommandons complétement! Nous avons fait une erreur de date et Nina a été très compréhensive et nous avons tout de suite trouvé une situation. Bref, beaucoup de réactivité. Merci!

The flat and its location in general was good nothing bad to say about the host and the flat.

Have in mind we had no almost no music on but were having conversations and laughter which apparently was not allowed by them at 9pm.

When telling that to the male neighbour he was disrespectful and showed his middle finger as response and walked upstairs. So nice flat and host but neighbours from hell.

Appartement bien situé, mais peu de luminosité car au sous-sol. Atmosphère moite, peu d’aération.
Bruit et vibrations à chaque passage du métro, de nuit comme de jour.
Literie à l’hygiène plus que douteuse et matelas inconfortable. De nombreuses araignées présentes à notre arrivée. A l’usage de l’aspirateur se dégage une odeur fort désagréable. Adapter un système de fixation pour la pomme de douche pour éviter de devoir la tenir quand on fait sa douche.

Eine kleine gemütliche Einzimmerwohnung mit Balkon und Blick in einen schönen grossen Innenhof mit riesiger Esche, klösterlich still und nach dem tollen Trubel im Kiez entlang der schlesischen Strasse oder der Wrangelstrasse eine wahre Erholung. Die Adresse ist perfekt als Ausgangspunkt für Wanderungen entlang des Landwehrkanals und dank naher Busthaltestelle für Besuche der diversen Stadtzentren und Sehenswürdikeiten sehr geeignet. Die Küchenausstattung ist O.K., wir haben praktisch keinen Gebrauch davon gemacht. Ein Fernseher fehlt, was wir als sehr positiv enmpfunden haben. Der Mietpreis scheint uns im Hinblick auf die Grösse des Apartments etwas überzogen.

Alexandra heeft een prachtig appartement met een minimalistisch en stijlvolle smaak waarin je geheel tot rust kunt komen in het actieve Berlijn. Het appartement is ook aan de rustige kant van het complex gelegen. We hebben het erg kunnen waarderen en is een goede keus voor een verblijf in Berlijn.
Cool location, perfect for two. :)
Alex was a wondeful host with good communication. The apartment was neat and tidy, with a nice, central location. I would definitely come back to this one.
Alles wie beschrieben.  Sehr schönes Zimmer mit Balkon. Hervorragende Lage. Sehr freundliche und schnelle Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin. Absolut empfehlenswert.
Das ist Zimmer ist gut, für einen kurzen Aufenthalt. Leider ist dort nur ein kleines Fenster, weshalb es dort wenig Tageslicht gibt und auch wenig frische Luft in das Zimmer kommt.

Place was awesome! Really comfortable and fun.

Great location, nice apartment that we enjoyed staying in.

Nice flat, nice location, nice host.

S반에서 매우 가깝고, 바로 앞에 물이나 과자 등을 사올 수 있는 마켓도 바로 앞에 있어서 사용하기 편했습니다.

Good location and apartment but very commercial approach.
nice hotel, convenient location and good price. nearby is Leo caffe that you can go for breakfast and it's very tasty

Glückskind nos salvó por completo, muy amables ! El lugar era tal cual a las fotos que están publicadas. El baño y la habitación totalmente impecables. La zona repleta de restaurantes y también de supermercados . Súper recomendable
Outstanding place!

Wieder einmal ein toller Aufenthalt, vielen Dank!

Everything was perfect for a long weekend in Berlin. The place was nice and clean only little thing  might be that you're on the groundfloor of a courtyard building and you don't get so much day light. We recommend staying here close to nice neighborhood of Prenzlauer berg.

Wir haben eine andere Unterkunft bekommen, als wir gebucht haben, da die gebuchte Unterkunft noch nicht geräumt wurde. Die Ersatzunterkunft war jedoch größer, hatte aber dafür keine Polstermöbel. War top sauber und sehr gut ausgestattet. Der Fußweg zum Alexanderplatz sind ca. 5 Minuten, zur U-Bahn 2 Minuten. Die Bahn kann man nachts zwar hören, aber hat uns nicht gestört. Handtücher, Bettwäsche waren sauber.
Schönes Ferienhaus am Rande von Berlin am Müggelsee. Moderne Einrichtung, alles vorhanden, sauber, Garten vorhanden. Sehr freundlicher Vermieter. Kommunikation schnell und einfach.
This place was absolutely beautiful and perfect for my trip. Great vibes and wonderful host!
The location is near to the city center and it is easy to find it. Sara is very friendly. Sara's home and neighborhood are peaceful. You can stay there in calm.
Sehr empfehlenswerte Adresse für ein paar Tage in Berlin.

Den er suveren. Den bedste lejlighed vi nogensinde har haft. 2 min fra station med direkte forbindelse til centrum. Dejlig bager og italiensk restaurant for enden af gaden. Ejeren var nærværende og vi fik rigtig meget hjælp!
Perfect location, and charming space. Highly recommended.

Jeg vil absolutt anbefale Bernds rom i Schöneberg. Han er en vennlig og imøtekommende vert. Rommet var også en oase og komme "hjem" til etter hektiske storbydager. Jeg er svært glad for at det var akkurat her jeg bodde, og håper virkelig at jeg får mulighet til å bo her en annen gang.
Katrin was an amazing host. She was very helpful and had very quick responses. The next time I’m in Berlin I will definitely be staying here again!
Das Zimmer ist ruhig, hell und freundlich; die Ausstattung gut. Man kann es gut erreichen und es gibt einen Aufzug, daher kann ich das Zimmer nur weiterempfehlen.
War super nice! Sehr freundlich, wir hatten einen angenehmen und entspannten Aufenthalt. Danke Kerem.
Sehr angenehm und unkompliziert, immer wieder gerne, Danke liebe Antonia wir haben uns bei dir sehr wohl gefühlt!

Vielen Dank für den Aufenthalt! Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und William ist ein sehr netter und entgegenkommender Gastgeber (Kaffee und Tee wurde zB angeboten) - würde ich auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen! Also hier buchen wenn ihr nach Berlin kommt!

Perfect location, clean, as described and shown on the pictures.
Axel was always available, answering our questions and providing good tips.
Definitely the place to be if you want to stay at Berlin !
Very nice, large and modern room. Friendly and helpful hosts. Super convenient to public transportation to the airport as well as the city center.
personas muy amables y gentiles. Muy serviciales. El apartamento es muy acogedor y está bien equipado.
Clean and cosy place in a lovely central neighbourhood. Tilman was easy to reach and helpful during our stay
Schönes und ruhiges Zimmer, gutes Bett, absolut Alles, was man braucht, ist vorhanden und Hanna ist eine unaufdringliche und gleichzeitig herzliche Gastgeberin. 5*

Even better than we expected!! We had two Airbnb bookings that were cancelled and so this was the third place we had booked in Berlin, and we were thankful every day that things worked out that way, since we had an awesome experience at Edi’s place! It was so centrally located, very spacious and pristinely clean and comfortable (even moreso than we expected from the photos), and best of all it was perfect for our family, or really any family. We were traveling with our 4 month-old baby, and there were so many baby amenities—but also plenty for an older child too. Plus a washing machine. Edi was very communicative too. We were sad to leave!
Great space. Each room felt private.
Fueron muy amables y sus instrucciones para llegar desde el aeropuerto muy útiles

We had a wonderful stay in Berlin. The location of this apartment is great as it is really near (or on top) of the metro (U9/U7). Within 10 minutes you are in the center. Also in the near area of the apartment there are supermarkets (Lidl, Edeka) a bakery and (good!) restaurants.
The apartment itself:
Albeit clean, the entire apartment smelled of cigarette smoke (al lot).
Also: The pictures make the apartment look better than it's actual state:
The apartment wasn't as modern as we expected. Overall it looked worn-out both on maintenance and equipment: The walls could need a paint job and on the window frames the paint was peeling off. More over the wasmachine didn't work (broken door, missing front), the light of the extractor hood wasn't working (switch is missing). In the fridge the freezer door handle was missing (which made it hard to close well). In short, overdue maintenance.
Finally the bed(s) felt hard partly because it had a very thin (Ikea) mattress. And something not mentioned in the advertisement, you can clearly hear the Metro (U-Bahn) from the bedroom.
On the positive:
The apartment was clean and we had clean sheets and towels also we had handsoap and soap for the dishwasher. The shower was hot and plenty. The kitchen had all utensils (pots and pans). We had a free WIFI connection. Finally, it was a very spacious apartment.

Die Unterkunft war sauber und modern eingerichtet. Das Bett war super bequem. Nach Mitte ist man tatsächlich ziemlich lange unterwegs, aber ich denke darauf ist man eingestellt, wenn man die Unterkunft bucht.

Ich kann jedem empfehlen in diesem wunderschönen kleinem Studio zu übernachten. Das Gebäude ist wunderschön und das Studio hat sehr hohe Decken. Es hat alles was man braucht (eine kleine Kochnische & Kühlschrank), die Lage ist sehr ruhig und war perfekt für eine Person. Es liegt im schönen Bergmannkiez mit tollen Restaurants und Shops, die in Reichweite zu Fuß zu erreichen sind. Auch alle Berliner Sehenswürdigkeiten lassen sich sehr gut erreichen, da U-Bahn als auch Busse in der Nähe abfahren. Ich würde jederzeit hier wieder übernachten!
Totally enjoyed my stay at Guido's place which is close to public transport. Guido is very discreet and helpful and the room was larger than expected. Will come again!
Ich war sehr zufrieden, ich komme auf jeden Fall wieder 💯
Alles voll easy und einfach super unkompliziert.  Herne wieder.
Logement aux volumes spacieux ultra clean et idéalement placé.
A gorgeous apartment in a quiet, safe neighbourhood. Extremely clean and we were well looked after by the hosts.

Por menor precio he conseguido mejores Airbnb, pero reservamos el mismo día y no había tanto. Sinceramente, nos quedamos porque no conseguíamos más alojamiento. Pero el apartamento no está en las mejores condiciones, una de las puertas tiene la cerradura dañada y no la pudimos abrir para que entrara aire, ya que hace calor en la noche. Y la puerta principal cuesta para cerrar. El baño se inunda fácilmente, se sale el agua de la ducha 😓 El piso es bastante rústico, y las escaleras son peligrosas pues tienen mucho filo en el borde si alguien se resbala. La lavadora de la vivienda no exprime bien la ropa. Mucho que desear, la verdad 🫣
Very convenient place to stay, if you want the anonymity of a hotel and the benifits of an appartement
Maria’s place is well located , particularly for public transport.It is a good size and very quite at night.

Andreas and Gary’s place was well designed, clean and convenient. Everything we could’ve wanted for our stay in Berlin. The apartment had lots of guides and tips on what to do and see. Close to cool bars and restaurants within walking distance too. We will definitely be staying there again on our next trip!

Sehr schöne Wohnung in guter Lage mit U-Bahn-Anschluss und vielen Cafés und Restaurants in der Nähe. Dazu sehr ruhig gelegen und Parkplatzmöglichkeiten in den Nebenstrassen. Die Ausstattung ist sehr gut, allerdings ist die Wohnung eher weniger für Familien mit Baby geeignet (Essecke in der Küche ist zu klein). Auf jeden Fall zu empfehlen!

The house was really big and 7 persons could perfectly fit there. The area was super nice with supermarkets nearby. The U-bahn was also near. The kitchen had everything we needed. Ralph told us all that we needed to know and overall it was an awesome experience and location!
niet zo toeristisch en rustig. Publiek transport is dichtbij en handig. Aangename badkamer, de keuken is wel wat te beperkt om echt te koken.
Beautiful, clean and great location. But this is a 2 bedroom + a couch, not 3 as listed. Also, the mattresses gave us back sores...

Great stay next to lots of amenities and public transport and near a grocery store.  The place was very clean and I booked it last minute so got a substantial discount it was worth it with the discount.  Would stay again!!

Karsten's apartment was VERY spacious and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. He has highlighted this in his posting but just to share that it's a level 1 unit with windows facing the streets and there's no aircon. Would have preferred the freedom to open the windows or have some ventilation in the room (either fan or aircon) since we visited in summer. Location is decent and it's two stops away from the main interchange station... we highly recommend tourists to get the AB DAY pass which only costs 7 euros and allows unlimited travel for the day until 3am the next day! A single trip already costs 2 euros and you definitely need to take the train from this apartment to the must-sees in Berlin. :)

We had such a pleasant stay! The apartment had everything we needed in a large and clean space. The neighborhood had two stations less than 5 mins away in either direction. The location is super well connected to other parts of the city. There were plenty of towels and sheets. The best part of the apartment are the HUGE windows and super high ceilings.

Appartamento pulito, molto vicina alla metro.
Per le attrazioni della città occorre spostarsi con i mezzi pubblici tempo di almeno 20 minuti
La sera non sono presenti attività per giovani occorre spostarsi

Lovely mom and adult son hosting a bright and comfortable private room within their home apartment. Terrific real neighborhood with restaurants and stores. Tram line runs right out front and easy connections to wherever you need to go. Stock den Himmel über Berlin! Sehr empfehlenswert.
Parfait, nous avons passé un agréable séjour. Rien ne manquait.

Der Aufenthalt bei Birte war genau das richtige für uns! Super Lage, mit vielen Lokalen vor der Tür, trotzdem war die Wohnung ruhig in einem Hof gelegen mit kleiner toller Terrasse.
Würde wieder bei Birte übernachten!
Ein guter Ausgangspunkt für Unternehmungen, sehr ruhig gelegen, ÖPNV in absolut akzeptabler Entfernung.
Schöne Wohnung in Kreuzberg, Gute Kommunikation
Very welcoming
Es hat alles gepasst. Profi-Vermietung

We just had the best time here. In a brilliant, bustling and lively part of the city full of restaurants and bars, but tucked away cosily behind the main road which makes it so incredibly peaceful and a perfect place to come back to.
The check-in experience was easy and so friendly with recommendations for the local area and the city available.
The room itself was lovely, and very clean. A huge bed and gorgeous bathroom as well.
Check-out was also so easy, and completely flexible.
Overall it was perfect for our weekend getaway and when we come back to the city I think we'll be coming back here!
Lief alles super. Wohnung war zentral angebunden und sehr ruhig.

Cornelius' place was spacious and beautiful. Cornelius was very communicative and thorough. We had to check in late but we were able to do that easily with his check in process. The Airbnb is in a nice location with restaurants and cafes around which made it an easy walk to breakfast before we got going for the day. I'd definitely stay here again on my next trip back!
Recomendo, espaço muito bonito e aconchegante, próximo ao metrô e muito próximo de restaurantes e cafés.
Schönes und geräumiges Zimmer mit guter Nahverkehrsanbindung von sehr netten und zuvorkommenden Gastgebern.

Sehr gute Lage und unkomplizierter und freundlicher Check-in.
Das Zimmer ist groß, das Wlan schnell und die Anbindung mega. Wie Ekki jetzt so als Gastgeber wäre, weiß ich leider nicht. Wir haben nicht gesehen 😊
Miejsce położone przy samym zoo, w okolicy dużo restauracji i sklepów, za rogiem stacja metra, mieszkanie wyglądało dokładnie tak jak na zdjęciach, bardzo czysto, polecam bardzo serdecznie:)
Wunderschönes Loft in ruhigem Innenhof

Eine coole Wohnung die alles bereit stellt was man braucht. Die Wohngegend ist gut , viele Restaurant in unmittelbarer Nähe.
Alles war sehr unkompliziert.

Die Unterkunft von Tilman ist toll - sehr gemütlich, sauber und liebevoll eingerichtet. Das Highlight ist der Balkon zum ruhigen Hinterhof, auf den Vormittags die Sonne scheint. Eine Ruhe-Oase in Berlin, in der man sich direkt wie Zuhause fühlt.

I had a great 4 night stay at Dave’s place. He was very accommodating, friendly and flexible. Very clean room and bathroom especially! Bed and pillows are comfortable. About 10 mins walk from tram M10 and subway schönhauser allee. Dave is also very responsive and polite. Thanks Dave!

This place is really good! If you want to stay in beautiful place and rest, besides of that you want to visit beautiful Berlin- this place is perfect.
The only thing that wi-fi is not so fast, but if have any questions- you always can ask to Jurgen's family and they will help you with very warm welcome.
I would recommended this place!
And say Hi to your beautiful and friendly dog from us. ;)
Kathrin war eine super nette Gastgeberin und war kommunikativ und zuvorkommend. Die Gegend war sehr gut gelegen mit vielen Restaurants und netten Cafés die fußläufig  zu erreichen sind.

Swetlana is a wonderful host and her place is perfect — without doubt the cleanest, best organized and equipped Airbnb we have had the pleasure of staying in over many years of travel. The neighborhood is perfect if you seek the quiet, less hectic parts of Berlin, or if you have friends and family in the area, as it is far from the city center. But for us that was a big part of the appeal. Highly recommended.

Our stay in Bianka’s place was great! It is exactly like the photos show.
Bianka is so friendly, welcoming and helpful, she was so quick to respond to any of our questions!
The bed is comfortable, having a garden space was lovely to relax in the sun, there’s space to work, a kitchen and washing machine if you’re staying for a while! Also an Aldi right across the road!
The Sbahn, tram and bus are all within a 5 minute walk, it was extremely easy to get around Berlin and home again in the evenings!
The area is lovely and calm, very quiet! There’s a nice bakery down the street, coffee places within 10 minute walk etc.
If you go one stop on the Sbahn to Ostkreuz there are loads of restaurants, bars, cafes etc.
Definitely recommend Bianka’s place for a stay in Berlin! Whether it be a for a weekend, or two weeks like us!
Great host & apartment

Die Unterkunft ist sauber und gut eingerichtet. Um die Ecke nach 2 Minuten Fußweg sind Tram und S-Bahn. Man kommt von hier schnell und mühelos überall hin. Zusammen mit Google-Maps ein richtiges Easy-going.
Rigtig sød og imødekommende vært. Lejligheden er indrettet virkelig hyggelig og indbydende. Virkelig skønt med tagterrassen. Rent og pænt, og har alt hvad man behøver til en en ferie i byen.
clean spacious rooms. Comfortable beds. A good location close to restaurants and parking. Easy to get to historic land marks.

Everything was good!!
Location is very central, Close to train station and metro station.
We asked for a earlier check in and it was done without any problem.
Would stay again!!!

Mein Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm. Sehr schönes kleines gemütliches Zimmer. Man fühlt sich sofort wohl. Keine 5 min entfernt ist ein Wald mit einem See. Ideal auch für meinen Hund und für Spaziergänge. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten ganz in der Nähe und Parkplätze direkt vor der Tür. Man kann es nicht besser haben. Ich würde es jedem mit gutem Gewissen empfehlen.
alles super, sauberes Zimmer. super nette Mitarbeiter.
Great location right in the middle of Berlin
Exactly as described. Quiet, well-designed studio apartment in a great location. Haven to retreat to from humming city.
Very clean and classic place. There is no parking problem. It is also very close to public transportation.
Our stay at Ben's has been perfect. Nice an clean apartment, easy to reach metro and bus stops. 100% reccomended!

The perfect place! Lucky for us, Roi was outside the apartment when we arrived. He showed us around his place and was very helpful (he has really nice stuff and he made the directions on how to use the appliances so easy!). His apartment is very clean and is even better in real life than the pictures. It was hot during our days in Berlin and we were more than grateful that Roi's apartment has air conditioning! The location was perfect too. It's very close to the U-bahn, shops, restaurants, and a grocery store. Roi's apartment is also great if you just want to relax. My boyfriend used the sauna once and loved it. I would definitely stay here again (hopefully for longer next time)! Thanks for everything Roi! =)
War alles klasse. Die Kommunikation verlief reibungslos. Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt in Berlin.
Great stay at Stella’s accommodation. Was well described and was a nice neighbourhood.
…ganz fein im Hostel bei Kathrin im bunten Berlin. Komme sehr gerne wieder und empfehle weiter!
Toller Service und sehr freundliches Personal.
War alles unproblematisch und gut
Sehr schmutzige Wohnung mit einem komischen Geruch. Auf Sauberkeit und Hygiene wurde nicht geachtet. Anbieter sehr unhilfreich.
Michael’s place have an amazing view from the balcony. There was a supermarket just around the corner. Communication was extremely quick.

We loved our stay with rooms of paradise! Super cozy apartment perfect for three. Our only complaint was lack of heating, which made it quite cold in the mornings. Apart for that we loved everything else!The host even let us check in early since we arrived in Berlin before check in😊

We had a very nice stay in this appartment. Very nicely furnished and plenty of space for 4 to 6 Person. Perfect location just 2 minutes walk from S-Bahn and Subway, Supermarket , Restaurant and Pub around the corner. Booking went on without any Problems. Highly recommendable!

Johnny's place is a peaceful oasis on the middle of the city. I enjoyed my breakfast on the sunny balcony surrounded by flowers and the apartment makes you feel right at home with it's automatic lights and great amenities. Everything is though out well and Johnny is both present and descrete as need me. Fantastic place, one of the best!
Great place. EXCELENT HOST!!

Hanna is a delightful lady, she was incredibly hospitable and helpful. The apartment is close to the U-Bahn and sits in a residential area so peaceful there are dozens of wild bunnies hopping around outside!? Good place for dog lovers,, perhaps not so much for anyone with allergies. Highly recommend, very grateful to Hannah for everything :-)
The place was exactly as described. Caroline and Ulf were super responsive and gave us amazing recommendations. Really enhanced our stay in Berlin.
Great location and comfortable beds
A very nice and friendly hostess,  I keep a very good impression.

Tanja is a wonderful host. She was quick to communicate and extremely helpful. The apartment is even more lovely in person than in the photos. It is in a wonderful neighborhood on a quiet street. It was perfect for our stay in Berlin.
Gute Unterkunft in sehr guter Lage

Great stay, nothing was to much trouble. Quick communication the only time it was needed.
Accommodation was exactly as described

Die Wohnung liegt in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Europapark (Schwimmzentrum).
Fußläufig ist eine sehr gute Bäckerei (Backfee), in der man früh morgens schon gute Brötchen kaufen kann.
Weitere Einkaufsmöglichkeiten (REWE / DM etc.) sind ebenfalls zu Fuß zu erreichen. Von dort aus kommt man super in die City von Berlin.
Die Parkplatzsituation war wie von Josef beschrieben: Kostenloses Parken und kein übermäßiges Suchen erforderlich. (Kaum zu glauben, aber wir hatten immer einen Parkplatz "vor der Tür".

Quite decent place, but rooms have no sufficient ventilation and there is no proper window in the room. Matresses/bed frames also make a lot of squeaking sounds very annoying while you sleep. Everything else was fine!

We stayed here for one week. Host lives next door so that is always helpful. She even helped me print some documents I needed. Apartment is really a big studio (there is no separate bedroom). Bed was comfortable and kitchen was really well equipped for cooking. No air conditioning, and we caught a really warm week. Very trendy neighborhood.  Enjoyed our time here.

Thank you for sharing your place with us.
It was very enjoyable.
Definitely will stay again.
I was enjoed my holiday in this apartment. is really nice. see you soon NUMA XXXX

Precioso apartamento con todas las comodidades , cerca de entrada de metro
Sin duda una muy buena opción

Alles wie beschrieben, tolle Lage und Aussicht, und super Kommunikation. Checkin und Checkout lief problemlos.
Die Wohnung war sauber und funktional, aber könnte an verschiedenen Stellen etwas Aufmerksamkeit vertragen.

Really loved the flat!  Much bigger than thought, lovely high ceilings! Would really recommend staying here- easy to get to from airport, walkable to places and transport easy! Gave us loads of recommendations. Was super friendly and helpful.
Really nice place close to the centrum. Enjoyed relaxing on the balcony. Highly recommend Lilia’s place if you are staying a bit longer in Berlin. She’s a wonderful host!

Die Unterkunft ist toll, sauber, super gelegen, großzügig geschnitten und trotzdem gemütlich. Wir haben toll geschlafen und am großen Esstisch gemütlich gefrühstückt. Wir können das Bärengehege wärmstens empfehlen!!! ;-)

Tolle Wohnung. Tolle Gastgeber. Sehr flexibel und hilfreich. Schnelle Kommunikation.
Immer wieder gern
Parfait ! Emplacements, équipement, communication ! Au calme
This is a very nice place close to lots of pubic transportation.  I highly recommend it.

Yvonne ist ein wunderbarer Host. Sie hat immer super schnell geantwortet.
Der Garden Room ist super gelegen, war sauber und gemütlich.
Ich kann den Aufenthalt wärmstens empfehlen!

Alles in allem ein schöner Aufenthalt. Moderne Zimmer! Die Wände waren ein wenig schmutzig, ein Glas zerbrochen und das eine Nachtlicht hat nicht funktioniert. Insgesamt waren wir dennoch happy! Der Besitzer war immer erreichbar und hat uns auch nach 18 Uhr problemlos einchecken lassen. Wir kommen das nächste Mal sicher wieder!

Muy buen apartamento. Contaba con todas las comodidades, estaba cerca de varios puntos de interés y de paradas de transporte. El apartamento fue tal cual las fotos y descripción, el anfitrión muy amable y atento, hubo muy buena comunicación. Esperamos volver. ¡100% recomendado!
Kein Klopapier...passier...sonst alles dufte

The Airbnb on Fontanepromenade is gorgeous! Not only super close to Sudstern station but quiet as can be. The street itself was beautifully blooming in spring and Sudstern is a really central and stylish area. The airbnb studio fit our needs perfectly. Everything was provided and the owners even allowed us to store our things just a little longer before our flight. Clean, easy to check in and out, friendly people, easy to get around - you cannot ask for a better accommodation. Betty and Stefan really have a gorgeous place to whoever needs a quiet headquarters before exploring Berlin. Be sure to check out the Italian place nearby and hire a bike!!
Thanks again Ian

Lovely place and lovely host. The apartment is very close to the metro line and bus stop. The fact that the apartment is on the third floor could be a bit of a problem for families with children. Other than that, everything was great. Thank you Amelie and Leo..
Een schattig huisje in een prachtige tuin. Sfeervol ingericht, gastvrije eigenaresse. Houd rekening met een vliegveld in de buurt.

Elliott was an excellent host. The flat and the room very well designed, bright, clean and inviting. He was kind and very helpful in answering any questions i had. The house is in a great part of Berlin for exploring, close to public transit and many nice bars and delicious restaurants around. I highly recommend this stay.

Angekommen und Massimo war direkt vor Ort. Sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit hat er uns die Wohnung gezeigt und die technischen Dinge wie Wlan/Heizung erklärt. Das Base Camp ist genauso schön, wie es auf den Fotos vermuten ließ. Wir haben uns vom ersten Augenblick an wohlgefühlt. Infomaterial über Berlin ist in der Wohnung vorzufinden. Von dem Base Camp sind SBahn und UBahn gleichermaßen gut zu erreichen (ca. 6 Min.). Es war ein schöner Aufenthalt. Wir würden uns jederzeit wieder bei Massimo&Lucia einmieten.

This apartment is in a great area lots of good bars and restaurants nearby the apartment itself was warm clean spacious with really comfortable beds and the kitchen was well equipped I would recommend this apartment if visiting Berlin.

Le séjour s’est magnifiquement bien passé, l’appartement est idéalement situé, quartier, calme, proche de transport
La chambre était propre , le personnel, gentil et efficace
Rien à dire de plus juste parfait

Met de familie 4 dagen Berlijn gedaan. Het was een prettig huis met grote slaapkamers in een fijne omgeving. Alle activiteiten waren prima te belopen en er waren goede restaurants in de buurt. Service was fantastisch!! Bij vragen snel antwoord. Aanrader!!

Ana Maria was just amazing. I had a sudden change of plans and needed a new place with same day check-in. I made my request at 6 pm with apologies and an explanation, but Ana Maria was super accommodating and made sure the place was spotless by the time of my check-in.
Even though it was very late, she greeted me graciously and warmly. I had a couple of questions about the apartment and she provided clear responses. The next day she even sent me some recommendations based on my interests.
The apartment is super cozy in a great location. It’s the perfect refuge for a person after long days and nights in the city. Ana Maria’s decor is impeccable too!
The kitchen is fully equipped and Ana Maria let me use everything as I desired. There’s a washing machine too! Absolute killer feature for light packers such as myself.
The location, value, and hospitality cannot be beat. This is an amazing Airbnb.
Cheers to you Ana Maria!

Bonito apartamento en una ubicación céntrica, cerca de la Kurfürstendamm. El metro es fácilmente accesible, lo que es ideal para explorar la ciudad. El apartamento es amplio y tranquilo, lo que hace que la estancia sea agradable. El baño estaba limpio, pero necesita una renovación. En general, la relación calidad-precio es buena. ¡Muy recomendable!

Sebastian, was really kind and always available, whenever I had a question.
The apartment was super clean and in perfect condition. Even though it’s in the heart of Berlin, the place was in a really quiet and secluded area. 5 stars and nothing less

Ok place. Good neighborhood. Clean. Not really a real Airbnb experience though because it’s a hotel. Also, when checking in, we suddenly had to pay a 5 percent city tax. We were not told about this extra fee when we booked through Airbnb.
Alles sauber und ordentlich, Gegend ruhig und etwas abgelegen aber nur 3 Min. von der nächsten Tram-Station entfernt. Sparkasse, Kiosk, Supermarkt und Restaurants/Bars nur wenige Minuten entfernt.
Viel mehr Platz als erwartet und ein großes Bad. Das Personal ist sehr zuvorkommend

Wer ein zentral gelegenes und ruhiges Apartment sucht, hat hier genau das Richtige! Die Ausstattung und Sauberkeit ist zufriedenstellend und die Angaben stimmen. Wenn man keinen Luxus sucht, sondern vor allem  ein preiswertes Zimmer, sowie einen sehr einfachen Check-In und Check-Out bevorzugt, macht man hier nichts falsch!

Super schöne suit.
Gerne Wieder
Great location and great host! Thank you for the hospitality!

Euch erwartet ein wunderschönes Haus, das liebevoll hergerichtet ist. Das Zimmer, in dem ich war, war schön hell mit Jalousien, gleich gegenüber ein kleines schönes Bad mit Dusche, die auch genügend Wasser hat. Ihr bekommt Platz im Kühlschrank und Schrank dürft die Küche benutzen. Was will an mehr?
Eigentlich wie in Frankreich im Urlaub. Sabrina ist nicht nur eine perfekte Gastgeberin. Meistert jede Situation. Einfach super!!

Mary and Eric are wonderful hosts. I enjoyed my time throughout because of their friendliness and accommodating nature. The apartment is very quiet and located in a great neighborhood. Hope to be able to return.
Beautiful apartment , very clean and comfortable.  Excellent location - central but quiet and cozy.  Was perfect for a family with two kids.  We had an great time!

Très bon emplacement, facile d'accès, proches parcs/restaurants/metro.
Appartement calme
Mir wurde vorab alles wichtige mitgeteilt, die Unterkunft war super und ich hab mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Habe absolut nichts zu merken.
Brilliant location and very close to transport links. Clean and tidy and with everything you could want, and very warm
Très bon appart.  Je recommande
Con mi madre y mi esposa, disfrutamos mucho hospedarnos allí, todo fue mejor de lo esperado, las fotos no haces justicia, nos sentimos muy cómodos. Sin duda volveríamos.
Une personne s’occupant du logement est rentré dans l’appartement avec son propre badge pendant que nous étions dans le logement.
Beautiful apartment

Everything was perfect, great location, clean and beatiful apartment in nice neighbourhood. Only minus for the unable to cook and use the kitchen. Nevertheless, i would highly reconmend this location and we would surely visit again :)
Fabelhafte Gastgeberin, schöne Unterkunft, alles wie angegeben und erwartet und noch ein bisschen besser, vielen Dank
Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm! Man hat alles was man braucht und Preis- Leistung stimmt. Perfekt für ein Wochenende oder Städtetrip :)

Die Unterkunft wird allen Ansprüchen gerecht. Schlafräume und Küche sind mit allem ausgestattet, was man benötigt. Reiseführer auf Deutsch und Englisch gestalten das Erkunden der Stadt einfacher. Der Gastgeber ist sehr freundlich, zuvorkommend und hilfsbereit. Vielen Dank Andreas!
Great place to stay. Clean and spacious, close to public transport and attractions.

Super coole Lage und alles gut zu erreichen mit Tram oder Bus.
Gastgeber super freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Gerne wieder.
Great check in process, place as described and has all the things you would need. Would stay again

Nathalie is one of the most communicative and helpful Airbnb hosts I’ve ever met. The best thing about this apartment is the light. The skylights and high ceilings are wonderful. I also enjoyed the garden access downstairs. I invited a friend over for tea and we had a very peaceful time in the garden by the flowers. The neighborhood feels a little remote in the south side of Berlin, but the nearby Bahn station has trains that can take you pretty much anywhere in 20-40 minutes. My only issue with the space was lack of storage. There isn’t a closet or enough shelves for more than one person, unless everyone is packing extremely light.

A very helpful neighbor greeted us when we arrived and helped us get settled.  Bikes were provided for us at a great price as well.  We really enjoyed riding around the city.  However, the amenities listed were not accurate at all.  No extra pillows, hairdryer, shampoo, or extra towels.  The apartment was located very close to the road which was very noisy and made it hard to sleep.  Not to mention the noise coming from the apartment above us very early in the mornings.  The kitchen area is very small with a mini fridge, portable set of burners (no oven), and three washers (which were all full of laundry (not sure if it was clean or dirty). The bathroom is also very small and the shower does not drain very well.

Ottimo monolocale situato di fro te al castello di Charlottenburg, l'host è stato molto preciso nella descrizione al fine di ottimizzare la pratica del check in. Quando tornerò a Berlino sarà ancora la mia meta.

Na het boeken via Airbnb moest ik toch nog via een link allerlei persoonlijke gegevens doorgeven. Gelukkig zag ik dat op tijd, voor we weer op de fiets zaten, ik weet niet hoe het gaat als je dat bericht niet op tijd leest.
Vragen werden wel via berichten in de Airbnb app beantwoord en die communicatie verliep soepel.
Kamer prima in orde, alleen twee koffiecupjes is wel erg weinig als je drie nachten geboekt hebt. Ook missen er keukendoeken.
Al met al prima tevreden over ons verblijf en de locatie.
Excellent emplacement et tout est conforme à la description

La habitación es amplia y cómoda, y aunque los espacios compartidos (cocina pequeña y baño) los debíamos compartir entre 4 nos fuimos organizando.
Si bien el.departamento esta a unos 20 minutos de centro de Berlin esta a 2 cuadras de varios medios de transporte y cerca del aeropuerto así que nos resultó muy cómodo.
Los anfitriones fueron muy amables en todo momento y nos ayudaron en todo.
Pasamos una muy buena estadía.
Schöne Wohnung, gut gelegen

Ein sehr schönes Haus mit vielen liebevollen Details und einer sehr guten Verkehsanbindung. Roumiana ist eine sehr nette Gastgeberin und hat Fragen sehr schnell beantwortet. Gerne kommen wir wieder! Liebe Grüße Doreen
Perfect, thank you 🙏
Rosario ist ein wirklich netter Gastgeber, der einem mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht. Die Lage ist sehr zentral, die Stadtmitte ist zu Fuß erreichbar. Gerne wieder!

Excelente ubicación, 1000% recomendado, limpieza total, super detallistas los dueños, me encantó el apartamento, es grande  y muy cómodo, cerca de la estación del metro, restaurantes y hasta pista de carrera cerca para los que corremos, los que quieran hacer el Maratón de Berlín está ubicación es muy buena!
Nassa's place has a great atmosphere - we particularly liked the plants. It's super spacious and everything just works. Highly recommended.

Das Inserat ist sehr akkurat, Fotos beschreiben auch gut. Das Bett war fantastisch!! Marko hat sich viel Mühe gegeben, hat Sektchen, Knabbereien, Tee und Kaffee bereit gestellt, es gibt einen kleinen Kühlschrank, Wasserkocher, Toaster, im Bad sind Waschmaschine, Bügelbrett und -Eisen, zwei Handtücher groß/klein für jeden. Achtung, drittes Obergeschoss! Ohne Aufzug wird man fit… 😁 Einchecken war völlig problemlos, genauso das Auschecken, Kommunikation lief zügig und gut. Wir würden wieder kommen!
Quite Small but absolutely fine for a few days in Berlin. Good cafes and restaurants around.

We came over for the Berlin Marathon. The Location was ideal for both running the marathon and supporting it. Close to the Trams/buses and the U-Banh. A short jog down to the Start of the Marathon ( about 2km, perfect warm up!) . There is a Lidl within walking distance.
The Apartment was ideal for us travelling as a family of 4. Two Adults, two children. Some playgrounds nearby also. Quiet area too.
Katrin was a great host, very nice, responsive and helpful.
10/10 ! Would happily stay again

This studio is in the middle of one of the best parts of Berlin for street culture, night life, amazing international cuisine and alternative clubbing.
The city centre is within easy reach with the Metro station being close and straight into town.
Studio was clean, well equipped and perfect for a couple. However, it would not suit people with impaired mobility as you have to climb four taller than average storeys.
The night life in the building was not disturbing at all. We could not hear any music from the night club in the basement. There was absolutely no noise from people coming or leaving the place. On the level below was a club as well. We had the pleasure of listening to beautiful swing and tango with our door left open. Once we closed the door the music did not disturb our sleep at all. The studio was facing large court yard and noise from the street was absent.
Instructions for check-in were very clear and plenty of written information about the area was left for us at the studio.
We were very pleased with our stay and would recommend it for a couple.

The room was exactly as described/depicted. The door could be locked as could the bathroom door. It was clean and tidy. The building was very old, built during the First World War which meant that the walls were very thin but this did not bother us too much. Irene and her partner were very nice and helped us with any queries with had. However, we did not see them at all for the majority of our stay at their apartment - only on the days we arrived and left, we began to wonder if they were even in the apartment at all. This was not an issue though. We can home very late 2 nights in a row but Irene did not mention this so we presume she was not bothered by this. The flat is about 35mins from the city centre but is quite easy to get into the city via public transport when you know what you are doing. She has two budgies that are kept in the kitchen - they are very cute!! We would stay here in the again, just wish it had been more central.
Excelente comunicación y preocupación por parte de Domenico. El departamento cumplió con todo

Staying at Jürgen’s was great, the check-in process went smoothly with the clear instructions he provided me before I arrived and the house was clean and tidy. The neighbourhood was also really quiet, which helped me feel at home.
Thank you Jürgen!
War alles top!

We had a great time at this beautifully curated flat! The location is excellent, right in front of a U-Bahn station, and within walking distance from many points of interest. The flat was super clean, and communication with the host was very easy.
We had a little scary moment, though, which made us feel a bit unsafe. We were mainly a group of young girls staying in the flat, and on Saturday evening, one of us stayed back in the flat to shower and relax. As soon as she got out of the shower, there was someone we didn't know in the living room. Apparently, there was a double booking, and the situation was resolved quickly. However, this made us feel very unsafe in the flat that night, knowing someone else had direct access to our belongings and to us.
Besides this, the stay was very pleasant.

Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft und würden sie definitiv weiterempfehlen! Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und mit allem Nötigen ausgestattet. Die Aussicht ist super und auf der anderen Seite des Gebäudes gibt es sogar einen Balkon mit Aussicht auf den Berliner Fernsehturm. Das Beste an der Wohnung war für uns, dass sie so zentral gelegen ist. Zum Alexanderplatz hat man nur 5 Minuten zu Fuss und auch alle öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel erreicht man super schnell. Ein Supermarkt gibt es direkt auf der anderen Strassenseite des Gebäudes. Ivos war sehr nett, hilfsbereit und immer zu erreichen. Wir sind sehr glücklich, dass wir diese Unterkunft gemietet haben! :)

O espaço é ok, num local muito bom com muito boas ligações, estamos em 20min no aeroporto e também em Berlim centro, se voltássemos a Berlim voltaríamos a ficar em Ostkreuz. Wunderschöne Wohnung, tolle Umgebung und sehr zuvorkommender Gastgeber!
very good location and good guy👍👍
Ruhig aber zentral gelegen, gute Anbindung für alle möglichen Unternehmungen. Würde ich jederzeit wieder buchen.

After unpacking and putting our toiletries in the bathroom, the door automatically locked itself...   we had to stay home from 08 until 15:00 waiting for help...  no response on our text and they did not return our calls.  AirBnb did not manage to reach them either.  this ruined our trip.
Todo estuvo perfecto, el lugar está super cerca de la estación de trenes principales de Berlín. Justo enfrente hay un mercado para comprar todo lo que se necesite. El lugar es cálido y super bonito.

The room is clean and well-equipped (with washing machine, fridge, microwave, kettle). Very comfortable. The bus station is near the house. And the neighborhood is quite. The bed is too soft for me, but that’s okay. Highly recommend.

Wir haben uns wirklich sehr, sehr wohlgefühlt. Es war alles super sauber und wirklich alles vorhanden was man braucht. Von Fön bis Glätteisen, Waschmaschine, Geschirrspüler(inkl. Cute appartement near the public transport. Instructions clear to get into the building. The hosts are super nice and easy to contact.
Sehr zu empfehlen

Phillip's place was exactly as pictured. It was extremely clean and check-in was a breeze with clear instructions that included photos shared by Phillip. As other reviews note, it is a five and a half story climb to the top floor. However, the apartment has a a couple skylights and feels very open and bright, making the climb worth it.

Petite maison au fond d’un jardin luxuriant habité par des écureuils peu farouches. Un petit bémol quant à la taille minuscule de la cuisine qui est l’unique pièce commune, sinon les deux chambres sont grandes et la salle de bain a été refaite récemment. L’accès au centre de Berlin est facile et quand il fait beau le jardin est très agréable.

Die Wohnung von Ashraf ist zentral gelegen, in einem lebendigen aber nicht lauten Quartier (Schöneberg). Es gibt - zu Fuss erreichbar - alles in der Nähe, um sich den Aufenthalt in Ashrafs-Wohnung angenehm zu gestalten.
Die Einrichtung ist zweckmässig, in Takt und die Sanitär- und Kücheneinrichtungen funktionieren bestens. Wenn man nach dem Treppenlaufen im 4. Stock ankommt, kann man sich auf einem kleinen Balkon kurz erholen.
Wir empfehlen Ashraf sehr gerne als hilfsbereiten, freundlichen, diskreten Gastgeber weiter!
Toni und Gerhard

This place was amazing !
The room is precisely the aesthetic and peaceful place you need, the house was super clean and all the house amenities were provided to us generously from our host.
The location was convenient and very close to the metro station, a quiet but beautiful neighborhood that you can go easily from calmer places to the more “loud” ones.
Nicola was an excellent host and super friendly that gave us detailed recommendations for Berlin regarding food, nightlife, coffee places and open markets so we can experience the Berlin life.
He responded to all of our messages within few minutes and was very kind and open to communication.
Definitely we will be back to this place in our next visit in Berlin!

Michele's apartment is very spacious, very clean and in a wonderful location in East Berlin. I stayed alone but this very nicely kept apartment would work for a small group or a family just as well. Michele was very responsive throughout.

Das Apartment ist wunderschön und modern eingerichtet und lässt keine Wünsche offen. Falls man doch welche habe ob sollte kann man sich unkompliziert via Tablet beim Gastgeber melden Oder sich einfach direkt an das Büro wenden das sich ebenfalls im gebäude befindet. Die S-Bahn ist Mitte etwa 2-3 Minuten vom Apartment entfernt und durch den direkten Anschluss an die Ringbahn lassen sich alle Ecken Berlins in kürzester Zeit erreichen.
Dazu kommt noch die perfekte Ausstattung zu der Bluetooth-Boxen, ein Internetfähiger Fernseher, Waschamschine und Spülmaschine gehören, was gerade bei einem Aufenthalt mit mehreren Personen sehr hilfreich ist.
Wir waren rundum zufrieden und würden jederzeit wieder einchecken!
Die Wohnung ist ideal gelegen, sehr sauber, nette Gastgeber und gut zu erreichen. Ich war voll zufrieden

Appartement très bien pour 4 personnes, fidèle à la description et très bien équipé. L'emplacement est très bien.
L'hôte est très réactif et compréhensif.
Je recommande

We hebben genoten van ons verblijf in dit stijlvolle appartement! Dichtbij was er lekker eten en verschillende winkels. Het is een rustige en goed bereikbare buurt wat ook heel handig was. Udemærket ophold.

Perfect place for a stay in Berlin.
Nice & easy as I like :)

skøn lille lejlighed, hos en vært der var imødekommende og hurtig til at besvare mine henvendelser.

Perfekt für einen kurztrip in Berlin. Perfekte Lage und sauberes Apartment. Alles top und 100% Empfehlung 👍

Utes unit is very easy to stay in. It has a lovely outdoor area , a good little kitchen and is quiet.
We enjoyed our time here.

L’appartamento era come da descrizione, accogliente e pulito. Si vede che l’host ha curato di sua mano il posto. L’host è stato amichevole e disponibile. Il quartiere è più adatto a ragazzi, non a famiglie, però comunque ben collegato a tutte le attrazioni principali.
Great hospitality, very clean and organised apartment, easy communication with the host. A pleasure to stay there! Thank you!
Die Kommunikation mit Maria ist extrem gut und der Checking funktioniert reibungslos. Die Wohnung muss allerdings renoviert werden, um dem Preis gerecht zu werden.

We had a good time.The place makes great use of the space.
Everything was very clean.

4x bei Ute gewesen und 4x wie zu Hause gefühlt!!! :-)

Great stay!!

It is all as described. Birgit is easy going and a great host. Thanks !

Appartamento centrale, ben ristrutturato e arredato. Cucina spaziosa e attrezzata, anche con alcuni beni di prima necessità. Camere ampie e luminose, ma con scarso isolamento acustico: nonostante le regole degli appartamenti vietassero le feste in casa, l’appartamento al piano di sopra ha tenuto per ore ed ore la musica a livelli inaccettabili.
Bagni polverosi e con scarico doccia otturato: nonostante la segnalazione fatta già al primo giorno nessuno è intervenuto per risolvere il problema.
Non si può proporre ad un turista presente in città per solo 3 gg di attendere un intervento alle 14 di pomeriggio, nel bel mezzo di una giornata! Tra l’altro l’intervento sarebbe stato effettuato dal personale di pulizia e non da un idraulico! Presente un unico phon ma non funzionante (sola aria fredda in uscita): inutile anche questa segnalazione, a nulla è servita! Consigliamo vivamente una migliore manutenzione della casa!

Unser Aufenthalt bei Ion hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Die Wohnung ist super angenehm gelegen und gut angebunden. Zudem ist es sauber und sehr geräumig. Die Kommunikation verläuft unkompliziert und flexibel. Sehr empfehlenswert für alle die dem wild wild Wedding einen Besuch abstatten möchten :)
Cómodo, amplio y céntrico. Marcel, muy amable y siempre atento. Hemos estado muy bien.

I'm glad that I picked Thor's place for my stay in Berlin. It made my first Berlin visit more memorable.
Thor's hospitality is truly exceptional. He goes above and beyond in order for you to feel truly welcomed and have pleasant experience during your stay. He offers to share what he cooks with you.
Thor's place is clean, functional and comfortable. As someone who loves cats, spending a few days with his adorable cats was truly great.
If you're a avid runner, Thor's place being close to Tempelhofer Feld (a former airfield) is a plus and Bergmannkiez neighborhood on your way to Tempelhofer Feld is lovely.

El apartamento es tal cual lo publican: cómodo, bien decorado y con todas las comodidades que se necesitan para disfrutar una visita a Berlín. Todo funciona perfectamente y tiene detalles (como la vajilla o restos de la vieja construcción) muy atractivos. Está en una ubicación excelente y en un barrio bellísimo que merece visitarse.
El anfitrión, Sven (por ausencia de Henrik) fue más que gentil y cordial: nos indicó supermercado, panadería y otros lugares útiles; nos sugirió hermosos lugares para visitar no tan conocidos y nos pidió el taxi el día en que nos íbamos.
Todo esto permite darle el máximo de puntuación al departamento y a los anfitriones, recomendarlo a quien quiera disfrutarlo y desear que podamos volver.
Pero si todo esto fuera poco hubo un PLUS: cuando llegamos a nuestro siguiente destino descubrimos que nos habíamos olvidado una cámara fotográfica y unos cables de conexión.
Al ir a abrir el correo para comunicarnos, ya SVEN nos advertía al respecto y se ofrecía a enviarlo donde le indicáramos. ¡Genial!
Gracias Sven por tanta atención, hospitalidad y cordialidad y esperamos volver a encontrarnos.

I rent this flat for my cousin and her husband when they came for visit, and they were as happy and satisfied with the flat as could be. High standard, comfortable,  good location, clean and well equipped. They would definitely want to stay there again next time thy come back.

Kerem was a lovely host, extremely relaxed and intent to make us feel at home during our stay. The apartment is gorgeous, has everything you need and is conveniently located both close to neighborhood restaurants and public transport - would stay here again in a heartbeat
Super séjour chez Fai ! Toutes les i dos étaient claires, le lieu était impeccable et calme. Merci beaucoup :)

And absolutely pleasant stay in a perfectly clean flat. The host is very friendly and eager to help out in any way you might think of.
Sehr sauber Zimmer. Alles sehr modern. Preis leistung TOP
We had a lovely stay in this apartment. It is clean, well decorated and is located in a very nice and central area which made exploring Berlin much easier.
Great place in Berlin center for its price

He has been extremely polite and helpful person. He even gave quick response and helped to get me the appartment. He also helped to obtain the unmeldung in very short time. Overall, it has been very nice experience to stay in his place.

The apartment has a really cool vibe and a "character", the room is spacious and feels private - it has a gallery bed to climb to but also a comfortable couch you can sleep on.unlimited towels. hot water all the time, plenty of room in the fridge, oven, stove, and whatever you need for cooking.
Advantages - amazing location, privacy, special atmosphere, fully equipped.

Wer eine „urige“ Unterkunft mag, ist hier genau richtig.

Danke für die ergebnisorientierte Kommunikation zum Check-In!

A great apartment in a nice suburb with streets lined with trees . An easy walk to shops, restaurants and the train station.
Pictures accurately show the apartment.

Fint og pænt sted at bo. Det var en god størrelse for prisen og nemt at komme med offentlig transport rundt i resten af byen.

Great location for exploring Berlin by foot. Very comfortable and warm.
Franz is one of the most hospitable and kind hosts we have ever met. The apartment was also very clean, stylish and pleasant. Very well equipped and at a super location.

L'appartement est situé dans un quartier très calme de Berlin, on se croirait dans un village. Mais le centre est facilement accessible en train. Nous avons passé quelques jours très agréables à Berlin dans cet appartement confortable et très bien équipé. Merci à Antonio et Judith de leur accueil.
Very nice host who helps you with any questions you have of the area, clean, good location. I would go back again!

Alles prima - kann nur wiederholen, was die Anderen schon geschrieben haben; Sabine ist super nett und zuvorkommend; das Zi ist sauber, gemütlich eingerichtet, ruhig, mit großem Hochbett und alles was man braucht ist da. Great host who’s friend met us at check in to explain everything.

Great place.
Great location and good value for money. Balcony was lovely. One thing I would say is that the place was incredibly warm at night time during the summer when we were there.

The room itself was relatively simple but had everything we needed, including a fairly large fridge, comfortable bed, good sized shower, desk, and balcony. While it wasn’t in perfect condition, for the price and with its location we were very very happy.

Ich war sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft! Da ich auf Geschäftsreise war, war ich zwar quasi nie da außer zum Schlafen, umso angenehmer war aber daher der unkomplizierte und flexible Check-In. Gerne wieder!

Super fin lejlighed centralt placeret i Berlin og i gåafstand fra Alexander Platz m.m.

Great value for money, nearby S bahn to central Berlin. Shared kitchen and bathroom were no problem for us. Professional intake and communication. Highly recommended in this price category.
It’s was a great place to stay in Berlin!

The apartment was fantastic and just what we needed. It was well supplied and the wee treat bag was a nice bonus.

Great location, the second room a bit awkward but not a big deal. Definitely recommend!

Susanne's home and family are very welcoming. We were in a comfortable private bedroom and we had our own bathroom as expected.

Appartement très bien situé, à deux pas du U-Bahn. Nombreux commerces de proximité. Logement spacieux, couchages confortables, pratique et bien équipé. Nous n'hésiterons pas à revenir à cette adresse lors d'une prochaine visite.
Amazing apartment in one of Berlin's nicest areas. Michele was more than helpful and allowed a very smooth check in and check out. Would recommend to anyone!

The flat is convenient to some of the many museums in Berlin. Cozy and atry place in Kreuzberg. Sometimes a bit noisy. Ana is very welcoming and nice person, it was easy to communicate with her.

Ambra is a really nice host I must say, she’s very responsive and willingly to help you if you have any problem. Also the place good and clean and look exactly like the picture you see plus the bathroom is super niceeeee!

6/5 Sterne! Super unkomplizierter Aufenthalt. Alles sauber und in bester Ordnung.

A very warm welcome, in an exquisite, artistic and personal home. The area offers restaurants, bakeries and supermarkets. The apartments are elegant, early 20th Century, with frequent and rapid links to the centre of Berlin. A perfect place to stay!
Es war sehr spontan, hat alles reibungslos geklappt, haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt, gerne wieder

Wir haben die wunderschöne Remise zu dritt mit Kleinkind bewohnt und uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Besonders toll war die Waschmaschine, auf die wir einen Wickelaufsatz gelegt haben und so unseren Kleinen direkt neben dem Waschbecken wickeln konnten. Die Wohnung ist der perfekte Ort für einen Familienurlaub mit Kleinkind in Berlin. Im Innenhof konnte sich unser Sohn frei bewegen. Wir waren jeden Tag im Bürgerpark spazieren und haben dort die Ziegen anschaut. Besonders gut hat es uns auf dem Eulenspielplatz in der Pradelstraße gefallen und auf dem Kinderbauernhof Pinke Pinke hinter dem Bürgerpark. In wenigen Gehminuten gelangt man außerdem zur Straßenbahnhaltestelle "Am Bürgerpark" von der aus man direkt zu vielen Sehenswürdigkeiten fahren kann. Rundrum gibt es viele preisgünstige Cafés und Restaurants, so dass man nicht jeden Tag kochen muss. Die Küche bietet jedoch alles, was man zum Kochen braucht.  Wir hatten ein paar Probleme mit der Heizung, die jedoch sofort behoben wurden. Dankeschön für die schnelle Hilfe.

Very clean and perfect space but the area is just super noisy 24/7 and we did not sleep well all week. Other than that its about 10 minutes walk to very busy kreuzberg area which was good and host very responsive and kind 👍
Sven et son épouse sont très sympathiques et très serviables. Nous avons eu un très bon accueil et le logement était totalement conforme à nos attentes. Nous y reviendrons avec plaisir à l'occasion.

Lovely apartment in a great location.

Claudia is a great host who always replies promptly and has some great places to explore.
