Beautiful apartment in the interesting area of Berlin, fully consistent with the description. Christophe and Patricia are great hosts, always ready to help. We hope that future guests will be as pleased as we are.

Alles nahezu perfekt (Lage, Ausstattung, Service), aber aufgrund extremer Hitze in dem Zimmer weder tagsüber noch nachts angenehmer Aufenthalt möglich! Aufgrund mangelnder oder nicht vorhandener Klimaanlage (!) heizt sich trotz aller Vorkehrungen das Zimmer auf ca. 30 Grad auf und geht nachts nicht unter 25 Grad - nicht zum Schlafen geeignet! Nachts kann auch die kleine Tür nicht zum Lüften genutzt werden aufgrund des Lärms draußen. Insgesamt also nicht zu empfehlen - schade, ansonsten tolles Konzept und tolle Ausstattung/Lage. Bei Temperaturen ab 20 Grad aber sollte jeder wissen, was er erwartet. Die Angabe "Klimaanlage" ist nicht wahrheitsgemäß.

Overall decent hostel. Amazing location. However, especially when compared to its counterpart in Alexanderplatz, it has various flaws. For example I had various problems with the check in. First of all, they assigned the same bed to me and another guest. I came back late in the evening to find all of my stuff on the floor. I switched bed but the day after, even though I was supposed to stay for 4 days, I found all of my stuff on the ground again. The en-suite toilet is not too bad but sharing one toilet in 6 people is inconvenient, especially in the morning. Laundry service is not working.

Très bon séjour chez Antonia qui, bien qu’absente cette semaine, s’est assurée que tout se passait bien pour nous.
Logement confortable et quartier très vivant, tout à fait typique.

very convenient stay, nice place and very well maintained property.
The host are super sweet and provide with everything to make very comfortable.
Extremely spacious, well-lighted, clean, and relaxing.  Marie is a kind and hospitable person.  Be respectful, you will have a wonderful stay!

Wera greeted us when we arrived, gave us great instructions and showed us the city from her balcony. The apt was clean and comfortable and had a beautiful view of the city. We loved our stay and highly recommend!

Sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtete Wohnung in bester Lage. U-Bahn- und Bushaltestelle fußläufig erreichbar. Viele nette Geschäfte, Bars und Restaurants in unmittelbarer Nähe. Schönes geräumiges Schlafzimmer mit bequemem Bett und Schrank sowie Regal. Kleines, sauberes Bad. Liebevolle Küche mit Kühlschrank, Waschmaschine, Herd. Ich würde hier gerne wieder übernachten.

Wir wurden super freundlich empfangen in der wunderschönen Wohnung und fühlten uns fast wie zu Hause. gemütlich und praktisch war es.
Perfekte Lage, nahe Team/Bus und vielen schönen Cafés und Restaurants.
It's a clean and bright room larger than I've expected. Clean and tidy, feeling like home after the travel in Berlin.
Sylvia ist eine tolle Gastgeberin. Es hat alles super geklappt. Jederzeit wieder, nur zu empfehlen.
We had a very good stay. Very comfortable, very good location and flexible check-in. I can recommend this place to everyone!

Super séjour sur Berlin, rapport qualité prix au top ! Proche du centre ville vraiment pratique !
je recommande

Gabriella was very friendly and would greet me warmly every day when I got back. The room was spacious, thoughtfully done up, and I especially loved the little desk by the window and the shelf of books. She even left me a chocolate as a welcome gift, which I thought was really sweet.

Ulf’s apartment was amazing. The high ceilings really makes it even more spacious. The neighbourhood was perfect; central and with all the nice bars/clubs nearby. I’m defenitely going to rent his apartment next time I’m visiting Berlin.

Moe's place was great for my stay in Berlin. It is central, only a short SBahn trip to the center and near many supermarkets if you want to purchase your own groceries. Check in was easy and Moe was quick to respond to my messages. The room was nice for relaxing after being out all day and I enjoyed my stay.
Berlin is a bit overpriced but this place was nice and just as described.

This place was so good. The area was really pretty when we visited in May, and it is close to Charlottenburg station. The home itself was really cozy and clean. Bernadette was really kind and let us bring our luggage before the check in, and she had good recommendations what to do locally. She was always really helpful and it was really nice to chat with her!

Great location! The place had everything we needed and the kitchen did as well however there was a strong smell of stale cigarette smoke and even as we traveled to our next destination it stayed with us in the clothes we kept at the apartment. We washed out clothes and the items that had to lay out and dry still smell like the apartment and it’s been a week since I was there.
It is a great place in the heart of Berlin. It is within walking distance to all the major attractions.
Es war gorßartig und genau so wie beschrieben und abgebildet. Wir kommen gern wieder!

Die Wohnung war wunderbar und wie beschrieben. Eine klassische Berliner Altbauwohnung mit kleinem sonnigen Balkon. Meine Freunde haben sich sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Schlüsselübergabe verlief problemlos. Gerne wieder.

Karsten is a great host and was very flexible and understanding with the check-in process!
Karsten's place is quirky but tasteful! It is spacious and is a good place to come back to after exploring Berlin (very close to the tube station). There are lots of great touches in the flat, the best one was the retro (working) radio! The place was really cosy and we really enjoyed staying there - highly recommended!

Jo was very friendly and helpful in how to get to his place with local transportation. There is a smoke smell, so if you’re sensitive to smells I would take this into consideration. Water strength and temperature was great! Location is close to public transportation and it’s pretty easy to get around!

Hier war alles tip-top.
Besten Dank lieber Werner.
Sehr schönes Zimmer, super Lage in Berlin. Sehr empfehlenswert. Auch die kurze Einweisung in die Zimmerausstattung war super.
good spot 👌

Super Nice Flat,
in one of the best parts in Kreuzberg.
Nice Host.
Highly recommend!
Gute Lage, schnelle und freundliche Kommunikation und saubere Wohnung mit allen Notwendigkeiten. Durch die Innenhofausrichtung ist die Wohnung auch sehr ruhig!
Sehr empfehlenswert, mehr muss man nicht sagen.
Elisabeth and Johannes's place is so well designed, spacious, well lit and organized. Moreover, it's super close to public transport. I'd recommend to anyone.
Great stay and great location
Nice place for groups or families and good communication with city centre.
All in all, a great place to stay in Berlin!

Diese wie eine Einliegerwohnung zu erreichende Unterkunft ist zu empfehlen. Ruhig gelegen, ÖPNV fußläufig erreichbar, Bäckereicafe und Supermarkt in der Nähe. Parkplätze sind zwar kostenfrei, jedoch meist belegt.
Excellent choice for a couple of days to discover the city!

A great stay. The room was far more comfortable than we imagined and Janik was a great host. We were surprised with the convenience of the location, it was easy to go out and eat or walk to the park with the tram station just a block away.
Very quiet at night and nice and sunny in the room during the day. What more do you need in Berlin?
We will look forward to staying again! Thanks Janik -- see you soon!
We really enjoyed our time at Thomas's place.  Everything was clean and we had everything we needed. The coffee shop/bakery across the street was amazing.
Alles top, super Kommunikation. Unterkunft sauber, Betten bequem.
Schöne und gemütliche Wohnung und ein netter Vermieter! Alles war perfekt, ich kann die Wohnung nur weiterempfehlen!
Caring, understanding and trustworthy hosts!

Great place however a bit far from the center of the city. Public transportation is nearby. Very residential and quiet at night. Not near any of the typical Berlin nightlife however it is a nice peaceful neighborhood!

A great place to stay in Berlin, well connected to many places and sites.
Very safe place to stay and room was clean and comfortable to stay in.
Mina is a great host and was very helpful in checking in and easy to communicate with.

Ubicado muy cerca del centro y a una cuadra de la estación de tren. Fuimos 3 personas y encontramos el lugar aún mejor que en fotos, el cuarto principal se ve mucho más angosto en fotos y en realidad fue bastante amplio. Madlen me ayudo mucho desde que llegue a ubicarme con los transportes y llegar bien al airbnb. Al llegar nos dieron indicaciones exactas de cómo usar cada cosa y no conforme con eso, tenían indicaciones de lugares recomendados cerca lo cual fue de suma utilidad. Cerca a la casa hay centros comerciales muy baratos, lugares para comer muy baratos también y es una zona muy muy tranquila. Recomendaría al 100% date airbnb para quienes busquen una estancia genial en Berlín. Todo nos quedó cerca y fue muy cómodo.
Plus: la cama principal es muy cómoda, te facilitan toallas y papel higiénico y la cocina es justo lo que necesita un viajero. GENIAL AIRBNB ❤️
Alles super

Great place and great host. Stephan made sure we had everything we needed for our four week stay and check in instructions were clear. Comfortable bed(s) and two double fold out couches, smaller fold out not as comfortable but fine for kids. Kitchen was well stocked and supermarkets five minute walk away. Good size rooms and nice high ceilings.

The place was clean. Contact with the host perfect:) Free parking. The tram stop was very close. It didn’t take long to get to the city centre.
There’s some noise because of the trams passing by. For me it wasn’t a problem. It wasn’t very loud and stopped in the night:)
It’s a nice place to stay while being in Berlin:)

Sedat is a great host and the appartment was perfect for the family (2 kids & parents). It´s a very quiet area around and the river is right in front of the house and all is only one stop away from the central station. Perfect location for a weekend in Berlin!!!
Amazing place near by all the public places in Berlin
Spacious and tastefully decorated apartment in a very convenient location.  The apartment is well organized and has everything for  a comfortable stay.  We highly recommend it
Big room in an area close too all the good nightlife spots. Good host, easy check-in, quiet & cozy room, decent bed, clean bathroom. Thanks!
a great stay in Berlin in a fantastic neighbourhood,  will come here if I come back to Berlin !!
Alles soweit wie erwartet.

Lovely little apartment, very close to a beautiful park. Susan was a lovely host, and was very helpful in all regards!
Definitely recommend this place if you want somewhere a little away from the city center, but close enough to grab a quick train.

Would highly recommend. The apartment was so spacious and spotless. Plenty of storage and was cleaned daily. The gym was the perfect hotel gym with bike, rower, treadmill and weights. The sauna and pool were great addition!
Solide Ferienwohnung. Hält was sie verspricht. Gerne wieder.

This was truly one of the best Airbnb apartments I've stayed in. A designer apartment in a very central location in Berlin, cosy and comfortable, high ceilings, light-filled and beautifully decorated. It's even better than all the pictures. Perfect location for a sejour in Berlin. Couldn't think of a better place to stay! Nora is a wonderful host. Thank you!
Top Location and room, easy and simple checking.

Die Wohnung befindet sich in einer guten Lage mit guter Anbindung. Sakine hat den Check in einfach gemacht und war gut erreichbar.  Leider haben wir die Wohnung unsauber aufgefunden obwohl uns gesagt wurde das der Check in nicht vor 15 uhr wegen reinigung stattfinden kann. Im Kühlschrank stand noch eine Milch die offenbar auch schon sehr veraltet war. Wir fanden kein Geschirr vor was wir später dann in der spülmaschine ungewaschen und schimmlig fanden. Auch das Bad und die Toilette waren offensichtlich nicht wirklich gereinigt und die Klobürste ist so stark verdreckt die müsste unbedingt ausgetauscht werden. Der Toaster war leider kaputt und fing an mit rauchen. Grundsätzlich ist die Wohnung sehr gemütlich und das Interieur liebevoll aufeinander abgestimmt..aber die Sauberkeit hat unseren wenn auch kurzen Aufenthalt ein wenig getrübt.

Wir hatten einen tollen , entspannten Aufenthalt. Die Betten waren mega bequem , die Lage auch supi , 10 Minuten mit dem Fahrrad zum Ku’damm. Wenn mal was gefehlt hat wurde sich gefühlt augenblicklich darum gekümmert. Selbst extra wünsche wurden so gut es geht umgesetzt worüber wir sehr froh und dankbar waren. Wir kommen gerne wieder , wärmstens zu empfehlen :)
Alles perfekt!
Kleines Zimmer mit allem was man braucht.
Great staying, location and host!

Great stay at Paulina’s apartment. She was great and easy to communicate with. I often stay in this neighborhood when I visit Berlin to see friends that live a few blocks away. The location was perfect and I was able to explore places I hadn’t seen before. The area is safe with lots of dining and grocery options within walking distance. Both the S and U Bahn’s are nearby as well to get you to museums and the rest of the city. I had to work this trip and the large dining table was perfect for that (good WiFi too). I would definitely stay again the next time I visit. The apartment is spacious and clean. I had everything I needed in the kitchen, inclusive of a washing machine which was great after weeks of travel. The bed was comfortable and the living room was nice and open. Important to note: like many apartments, this one is a walk-up (no elevator), which wasn’t a problem as a solo traveler, but just a callout for those traveling with others. Thanks, Paulina!
je recommande fortement !

Yury's place was great, cozy apartment in a great neighborhood. Very easy commute to the Mitte. Would highly recommend to friends and family.
Thank you for a great stay!!

Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Die Wohnung war sauber, ruhig und so wie beschrieben. Tanja ist sehr freundlich, hat uns alles notwendige kurz erklärt und wäre im Fall der Fälle auch telefonisch jederzeit erreichbar gewesen. Die Lage des Apartments ist absolut zentral. Kreuzberg ist ja ein lebendiges Viertel in dem man viel entdecken kann. Das Aparment liegt aber sehr ruhig - man hat also das beste aus beiden Welten. Parkplätze findet man auch ganz gut im Umkreis von 5 Laufminuten.
This is a fanatic apartment in a peaceful but well connected part of Berlin. Both tram and underground are close by and there is a supermarket (Edeka) just around the corner.
Hübsche, gemütliche und saubere Wohnung. Kommunikation ist super, denn bei Fragen bekommt man sehr schnell eine Antwort. Innerhalb von 5 Minuten laufen ist man  bei der U-Bahn und beim Supermarkt.

This appartment is located in a wonderful district, very close to alexanderplatz (walking distance). It is even better than in photos, clean, warm, quiet and colorful. Sun light is all over the place, really amazing and not what would one expect in berlin. It has a big rear balcony, if the weather is nice a great spot for breakfast and morning coffee.
Kitchen is fully equiped for those that opt for home made food.
And on top of all that Eleni is a great host. Everything was in place and arranged for before our arrival. The place is highly recommended!
Gute Lage, flexibles Check In und Check Out👍🏽
Amazing place. We had a fantastic two months here. Thanks Andreas!

Mooie schoone ruimte, basisbehoeftes worden goed voorzien. Supermarkt ligt op 5 min loop afstand, ideaal voor de boodschappen. Snelle communicatie met Vincent en eventuele problemen worden snel opgelost. Prima plek om te verblijven als je van plan bent de hele dag op pad te zijn. Aanrader
Die Wohnung hat alles was man braucht. Die ist super schon eingerichtet und war sehr sauber. Die Betten waren super bequem. Wir empfehlen Numa!
Silke is kind  and helpful, the apartment is nice and clean, in a nice spot. Everything was ok

Amazing flat, just as pictured. Good furniture, comfortable bed, all what you need for cooking food there is at the kitchen. I liked location as well - near running track, restaurants and subway stations. Axel was very cheerful. Without doubts it is in my top of visited apartments.
The place had everything we needed. The location is fantastic, we loved the area.
appartamento esattamente come descritto da Henrik in una posizione favolosa per visitare Berlino. Lo consiglio vivamente.

Appartement parfait,  propreté, accueil , petites attentions (café, confitures...) tout y est ! À 2 pas du métro très simple pour se déplacer. Il y a même une petite terrasse pour déjeuner dehors pas beau temps .

Wir (2 Kinder und ich) wurden vom Gastgeber super freundlich empfangen. Alles hat wunderbar geklappt. Der Kontakt im Vorfeld war unglaublich nett und unkompliziert! Die Wohnung ist genauso wie beschrieben: schön designed, geschmackvoll eingerichtet, modern und praktisch. Alles war sehr sauber und schön hergerichtet. Saubere Bettwäsche und saubere Handtücher, das Bad tippitoppi, alles was das Herz begehrt! Die Lage ist für einen Hauptstadt-Trip perfekt. Den Spielplatz gegenüber fanden die Kids auch toll ;-) Direkt über die Straße gibt es ein nettes FrühstücksCafe. Alles hat gepasst. Der Gastgeber hat für alles gesorgt und Schlüsselübergabe war am Anfang wie am Ende total stressfrei. Wir sind begeistert und sagen herzlichen Dank für soviel Gastfreundschaft. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt :)))

This flat was really cute, clean, comfortable and perfect for my vacation. The bed is soft and the whole place gets nice light. The garden is not as private as I expected, but adds a unique touch most airbnbs won't have. It's in a decent location (5 minute walk from the U Bahn and busses), very near grocery stores and restaurants. It seems to be only for rental and not a home, so some kitchen essentials are missing. Otherwise fully functional and great experience.

Vi havde lejligheden i 3 overnatninger. Til dette opfyldte den fint de behov vi havde.
Der var nemt til seværdigheder. lejligheden ligger i et afslappet nabolag og restauranten La Maison Bleu, som ligger lige ved siden er er fantastisk
Lugar bien ubicado y súper cómodo
Wir haben mit unserer kleinen Tochter Freunde in der Nähe besucht. Dafür war die Wohnung durch den Innenhof und der Nähe zum Schäfersee super.

Der Gastgeber war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Das Zimmer war sauber und gut ausgestattet. Allerdings hat ein Waschbecken gefehlt, was etwas unpraktisch war.
Ansonsten kann ich es gern weiter empfehlen.
위치가 도심이 아니라는 아쉬움도 있지만 공항에서 가까워서 매우 좋고 호스트분들이 너무 착하시고 잘챙겨주셔서 정말 좋았습니다

Great place.  Huge windows and balcony were top notch.  Everything new and plenty of space for the 4 of us.  Location is fantastic.  Many coffee shops and restaurants right outside door and only minutes walk to the subway which gets you EVERYWHERE.  No need for a car(was our personal mistake.  Didn’t need one).  Can’t recommend place enough.
My expectations weren’t high but they’ve to improve on basics as cleanliness but also the location is above a Bar/Pub so it’s super noisy.

L'alloggio ha soddisfatto appieno le nostre aspettative! Il bungalow era pulito ed accogliente e disponeva di tutto l'occorrente necessario. Gli spazi sono ben sfruttati, il bagno e la doccia comodi. Birgit si è dimostrata molto simpatica e disponibile e ci ha fatti sentire come a casa. Il bungalow si trova in zona tranquilla e silenziosa e ben servita dai mezzi pubblici (ogni 20 minuti c'è un tram che porta fino ad Alexanderplatz). Nei dintorni ci sono un supermercato ed alcuni ristoranti.
Consiglierei l'alloggio a chi si reca a Berlino da solo o in coppia.
Esperienza molto positiva!
I had a great stay as the communication with Michael was easy and the central location of the apartment enabled uncomplicated traveling.
Had a nice stay at Thomas

Great apartment in East Berlin. Communicative (via WhatsApp) and accommodating host.
Fully stocked kitchen (I don't cook much so take that with a grain of salt), washing machine, comfortable beds in HUGE bedrooms, and two great terraces. Internet TV was nice for relaxing with Netflix (I forgot to sign-out, you are welcome). Great care was put into the decorations to give the apartment a genuine feel and not a sterile professional rental. I would absolutely call this place cozy.
The area is super safe and the neighbors are friendly. Grocery store on the block with a couple other small markets and at least one coffee shop. Local restaurants and bars are 3-5 blocks. 1-2 blocks from a couple street car lines going into the city center. Subway is a bit more of a walk.
You pick-up the key at one of the local markets. It feels a little like a back alley trade but it was fun and different. Not sure if the store is open all night so ask if you are coming in after 11pm (23:00).
I stayed for 4 nights, I would absolutely stay here again. Elevator would have been nice being on the 4th floor (European 3rd), but the stairs are gradual and easy enough.

Accueilli par le voisin très sympathique, il m'a gentiment fait patienté et proposé une douche qui est magnifique...
L'endroit est très calme, la chambre un peu sombre, grande mais encombrée vraiment très éloignée du centre de Berlin 16 km environ.
Il y a le car tout près.
Super. Gerne wieder.
房东非常好。屋子干净整洁。周边有超市，和公交车站，生活便捷。竟然旁边还有个亚洲超市，惊喜。价格也非常便宜。
Ordentliches Appartement in zentraler  gut angebundener Lage

we really recommend this place, we spent 5 nights of our vacation in there and we had a great time.
The apartment is clean, stylish and the space is big and the hosts are really nice and helpful.

Linda ist eine super liebe und freundliche Gastgeberin! Mit ihr hat man sich direkt wohl gefühlt.
Die Wohnung war super angebunden und Linda war auch ab und zu da und hat mir dann paar Tipps für die Umgebung gegeben.
Den Aufenthalt bei ihr kann ich nur empfehlen!

I definitely need more stars to rate this apartment. Our stay was just great thanks to the well-organized spaces, the light filtering from the wide windows, the greatly-furbished kitchen and bathroom. The perfect Airbnb exists and it's in Berlin!
Super nice place, lovely location. Very modern and clean.

Wir hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt. Die Unterkunft ist super ruhig und somit perfekt für einen entspannten Städtetrip.
Die Gastgeber waren sehr nett und jederzeit ansprechbar. Ich würde jederzeit wieder in dieser Unterkunft wohnen.
Mona and Ahmed are very friendly. The room is beautiful- very comfortable, clean and cozy. Thanks for your hospitality!!
Herzlichen Dank für eine tolle Unterkunft, proaktive Kommunikation und was ich hervorheben möchte: absolute Flexiblilität bei der Ankunft (die Bahn…).

The place is tidy and spacious. The kitchen is well equipped. The shower and bed are not super, but the rest makes up for it! We did not meet Anna in person, but she was very kind and quickly to respond.
Die Unterkunft liegt sehr ruhig und ca. 10 Minuten vom S-Bahnhof entfernt. Es ist alles sehr ordentlich und sauber und hat mir gut gefallen. Ich komme definitiv gerne wieder.

Quartier très bruyant. Au dessus d'un snack.
Appartement chaud en été. Vitres cassées ou hors service.
Douche bouchée à l'arrivée.
Mal équipé pour cuisiner pour 5 personnes (pas un saladier). Il a fallu réclamer une passoire pour faire des pates.
Le ménage n'est pas bien fait.
Heureusement l'hôte est facile à joindre et réactive.
Cela reste cher pour les prestations.
Todo la estancia fue muy bien

Metroyla havaalanından nasıl ulaşırım sorusuna garip bi şekilde kendimin araştırarak bulmamı tavsiye ettiler. Oysa ki 2 cümle yazarak yakındaki durağı tarif edebilirlerdi. Ayrıca gece tek başıma geldiğimde lobide rahatsız edici tipler vardı ve sözleriyle taciz ettiler. Bu 2 kötü deneyim dışında konaklama iyiydi

Die Wohnung ist der Wahnsinn. Wunderschön und sehr praktisch gelegen. Der Hoste war sehr zuvorkommend und hat uns alle Wünsche erfüllt.
Einfach nur top!
Really good. They have a nice apartment. They recibed us very kindness. Its very near from the center in metro. We recommend it.

Our stay was amazing! The house was beautiful, the surrounding area was peaceful - so much wildlife in the garden.
The house was absolutely spotless and the host responded instantly when a question was asked.
I would absolutely recommend staying here if you get the chance ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

C’est le meilleur rapport qualité prix, le personnel est très accueillant et amical, l’ambiance est grave sympa et c’est vraiment propre !
Je n’ai malheureusement pas eu le temps de participer aux activités proposées et profiter de l’ambiance globale, mais si je devais revenir à Berlin avec le même budget j’y retournerai

A prime location with excellent accommodations, this listing was the perfect place for me and a friend to spend several days. It was comfortable, quiet, and clean, and the host Martin was extremely friendly and helpful. A worthwhile stay in Berlin!
Was all great for a short stay.
Convenient location, simple and clean
Great location (easy to get around from Moritzplatz station), safe, quiet and affordable!

Toll eingerichtete Wohnung im Zentrum von Berlin. Alle wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten in sehr kurze Zeit, teilweise auch fußläufig zu erreichen. Schöner Ausblick vom Balkon auf den nah-gelegenen Park. Alles bestens :)

Nicht gerade preiswert, aber sehr schöne, geschmackvoll eingerichtete Wohnung in ruhiger Lage.
Man fühlt sich wohl.

Vorab ein herzliches Dankeschön für die Informationen, welche wir bereits nach der Buchung erhalten haben. Sehr hilfreich. Die Wohnung ist geschmackvoll und zweckmässig eingerichtet, mit einem originellen Grundriss auf welchem der Platz geschickt ausgenutzt wurde. Auch hat uns die überdurchschnittlich gut eingerichtete Küche sehr gefallen.
Volker und Alexandra sind echte Profis welche sich vorbildlich um das Wohl ihrer Gäste kümmern. Volker hat uns auch spontan noch eine Zusatzstunde ermöglicht. Sehr geschätzt!
Wir kommen gerne zurück.
房子非常大，装修漂亮，整洁卫生，厨房设施一应俱全。
We had a great time at Bernardo's apartment! It is very comfortable and very well located. Communication was easy at all times. Thank you Bernardo!
Very nice stay. Everything fine and smooth.
cheap hostel for backpackers. The staff is friendly and always available. Room quality is good for the price. The bar is great for making new friends.
Alles top. ;)

Es ist eine besondere Unterkunft in einer schönen, ruhigen Gegend mit sehr netten und hilfsbereiten Vermietern. Die Wohnung ist gemütlich und mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht.
Wir kommen gern wieder!

first of all, this is really lovely and cozy place
and the host is soooooo nice.

Oliver is a very thorough, kind and precise guy, caring for every detail you can possibly imagine.

Especially, he made very clear on some points which every traveler may worry about. (which I like most on my staying)
You don't have to worry about most conflicts that may happen b/w host and guest in this studio.


I was there on a business trip, and the surrounding is perfectly quiet and relaxing.

It was 1st time using airbnb and in Germany,
and I got a really nice experience mostly because of this house and Oliver.

I would definitely stay here again if I go to Berlin again.

I had the best stay with Birgit and her husband, Hassan. They are such hospital, friendly people. I had a pretty long stay and I can honestly say I felt very much at home. I’m now leaving Berlin with not only great memories but also great new friendships.
Birgit’s apartment is in a great location. It’s a 5 minute walk to a central U-Bahn stop, to local restaurants, supermarkets, bars, and the river.
If you are looking for a walkable and enjoyable stay, I can’t recommend Birgit’s place enough!
Thanks so much Birgit, Hassan, & Ratwan! I’ll miss you guys so much & can’t wait to visit Berlin again.
Fantastic spot to stay…close to public transport. Felt safe in comparison to other parts of Berlin. The apartment met all our needs.

Rigtig fin lejlighed. Rent og pænt og alt hvad du har behov for - og beliggenheden perfekt i forhold til at komme ind til Berlin centrum: 10 minutters gang til S Bahn og 20 minutter med S Bahn til Berlin Mitte. Og lejligheden ligger tæt på shopping og spisesteder i et roligt kvarter - så det fungerede perfekt for os. Vi kommer gerne tilbage.

Piccolo appartamento dotato di tutto ciò che è necessario, arredato con gusto e con una luce naturale stupenda che entra dalle vetrate! Bello il terrazzino e menzione speciale per la vasca da bagno! Zona molto tranquilla ben servita dai mezzi. Supermercati e ristoranti appena sotto casa. Patrick cortese, attento e ospitale.
Le cinque rampe di scale sono assolutamente fattibili 🙃 e non possono concorrere alla non scelta di questa splendida casina.
Den hyggeligste lejlighed med perfekt beliggenhed! Alt var tip top i orden - ikke en finger at sætte på noget. Vi kommer helt sikkert igen.

Absolutely wonderful stay at Tim’s place! The pictures do not do this beautiful apartment justice! Great location, easy access to public transport and lots of cool little bars and restaurants within walking distance! Highly recommend!
Sweet spot on wonderful auguststrasse. Clean, comfortable. We enjoyed our stay.

Everything was great. Susanne sent all the necessary information in advance and we could even leave our luggage in the appartment before our check-in time which made the whole trip much more enjoyable for us.

We loved the unit and we ate at several places right downstairs. Every meal was fabulous and the people were super friendly. Also super close, are large and small markets, coffee shops/bakeries and a train station. It is a PERFECT location even though it seems sketchy when you first get there. We will definitely stay here again!

Heel erg fijn en rustig plekje om naar terug te komen. Zodra je de poort door bent vanaf de levendige straat, direct een oase van rust. Leuk ingericht. Schoon en opgeruimd. Voelt als een thuis tijdens een lang weekend Berlijn ontdekken. Enige minpuntje dat wij hebben ervaren is heel kort warm water. Dus een echt goede douche nemen zat er niet in. Ondanks dat zouden we zo weer terugkomen.

We enjoyed our stay!  The best is the nice balcony with a view to the spree/river!!  Really enjoyed eating out there and seeing the view.  The apartment is quiet and loved the location,  close to sbahn and to the park.  The place is cosy and as I said loved the location and the balcony,  therefore we recommend it!

Alles bestens — schnelle und klare Kommunikation, wenn auch ohne sichtbares Personal; gute Erreichbarkeit, nette Zimmer (meins war für den Preis etwas klein und mit Feuertreppe), gute Ausstattung, schöner Hof (teilweise noch im Entstehen). Wirklich gefehlt hat mir nur ein Kühlschrank (gerne auch gemeinsam), da ich meinen Tee gerne mit Milch trinke, auch im Hochsommer.
Btw kann ich «Suppengrün» für Frühstück und Lunch sehr empfehlen!
Marco has been an amazing host. We felt so comfortable from the beginning which made us extend our stay for a little longer. :)
Cozy apartment in a good location, perfect for getting to know berlin

This is a great apartment for 3-4 people, clean and incredibly conveniently located. The apartment has everything you need - comfortable beds, well-equipped kitchen. We would like to point out that the communication with Stefan and Christina was clear and accurate. It helped to make our trip very pleasant.

The location of the apartment is about 5 min from the subway, there are plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. We found a free parking spot right in front of the house. Apartment was clean and perfectly prepared.
Only negative thing is that the apartment is located on the 3rd floor without an elevator. And we were a bit surprised when we found a shower in the kitchen :)
Communication with the host was fine, the answers were immediate, we also got some tips for our trip around Berlin.
Great location and clean hotel.

Uns hat es auf dem Hausboot sehr gut gefallen. Es war ein Abenteuer, welches uns sicher noch lange in Erinnerung bleiben wird. Die Lage ist optimal für Leute, die dem Großstadttrubel entfliehen wollen. Trotzdem ist man in ca. 45 Min. im Zentrum. Die Haltestelle ist direkt vor der Unterkunft. Direkt in der Nähe befinden sich leider nicht viele Restaurants. Jedoch gibt es viele verschiedene Lieferdienste und falls man selbst kochen möchte, ist ein Netto ca. 10 Minuten fußläufig entfernt.
Parken kann man ebenfalls auf der Straße vor der Unterkunft.
Wir waren mit Hund da. In der Wuhlheide kann man stundenlang spazieren gehen. Auch für Kinder interessant, da es eine Parkeisenbahn, Spielplätze und ein Miniaturland gibt.
Wir waren insgesamt 3 Nächte da und konnten viel unternehmen. Ich empfehle die Unterkunft auf jeden Fall weiter.

The flat is really great. Located on the ground floor, a bit under the pavement, however it’s very quiet as the district. Rooms are really huge. WIFI works perfectly, as heater and warm & cold water. The amenities are new. There are 2 separated entries. A supermarket is just nearby. Just a negative point: the kitchen has no window, and the flat is not really brightness. But we will not hesitate to return.

Dies ist einfach eine wunderschöne Wohnung, sehr liebevoll eingerichtet und eine Vermieterin voller Freundlichkeit und Großzügigkeit. Die Wohnung hat zudem einen schönen kleinen Balkon mit einer herrlichen Blumenpracht.
Great host, quick response time, very friendly and a great airbnb for the price.

We stayed twice with a 3 week gap. Our first stay was very good. Our second stay was disappointing in part. This review covers both stays. Check in was easy. The apartment is large, airy, comfortable and spacious with lots of natural light. Although it faces on to a busy road, the sounds from the street did not disturb us. The kitchen is a little dark but we did not spend much time there. The location is walking distance to restaurants and close to public transport. The problem we had on our second visit was that the bedsheets had sand in them, some of the rubbish bins had not been emptied (including luggage tags from our first visit) and the bathmats had been washed the day we arrived and took a full day and night to dry. Nina, our host, was generally friendly and responsive.
I had a great stay, very well located and everything you need is close. I was staying for a year during my studies and I can not complain about anything. Recommendation!
Wonderful, modern, central! Absolutely stunning

Notre séjour chez Gaby était parfait ! La maison est très confortable, très agréable après une bonne journée de visite à Berlin. Gaby a été vraiment super, tant avant le séjour avec toutes les infos qu'elle peut donner, que pendant avec sa sollicitude discrète.
Quant à l'emplacement, la maison est un peu éloignée du centre, mais située à proximité d'une ligne de S-Bahn directe vers le centre ville. Et le calme du quartier est très appréciable après une journée passés à Berlin.
Et bien sur, Berlin est une ville super à découvrir; nous reviendrons !!
Great apartment and easy to check in.

Fantastic location, place, and host. Clean and peaceful room with a wonderful balcony.  Location is filled with restaurants, supermarkets, transportation, and more. A hidden gem! I hope to be back again.
War alles super! Gerne wieder!

Belle vue du balcon de ce studio situé au 8eme étage d’un immeuble d’une cité tranquille, avec même quelques écureuils et lapins dans les espaces verts. Logement lumineux .
Mais toujours les inconvénients de la douche ( bruit strident de tuyauterie dés augmentation du débit) et de la chasse d’eau du wc ( qui ne chasse pas..). Espérons que l’intervention d’un plombier solutionne ces problèmes de salle de bain .
Proximité des transports et bon emplacement pour visiter Berlin

Eitan was very nice and welcoming and even allowed for a slightly early check in. The home is clean, spacious and very well located with train stops nearby and a really nice pub literally next door. There is also an Aldi a five min walk away.
Unfortunately as it’s a ground floor flat in an older building there is a lot of noise coming from the flat above that travels through the ceiling. I can only assume it’s children upstairs running around continuously.
Place has lots of beds and is good for a larger group. If you’re looking for something inexpensive and cosy it does the job.
However if you’re wanting to cook and eat for a large group, it can be difficult as only two relatively small hobs and no oven.
Overall I would give it a 7.9/10

I had a great stay with Ulrike. The apartment is fantastic and you're right next to the subway, so getting around is a breeze. The area itself is very cool with lots of small shops and restaurants around. The room is very quiet and spacious. It's a bit separated from the rest of the apartment, so you can really retreat and have space for yourself. Ulrike is a great communicator and very easy to talk to and I very much enjoyed our conversations over some cups of tea. Highly recommended!
Sehr schönes Zimmer mit super bequemen Bett. Bin zufrieden!
Robert’s place was a wonder! Sparkling cleanliness accompanied with a warm welcome from both Robert and his dog best friend, Jack! I couldn’t have picked a better place to stay in! Thanks Robert!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5 Sterne, es war wieder alles wunderbar 😊👍🏻 Kommen gerne wieder 😊

very Nice stay in Betty and Stefan's appartement. Good location in a quite area and next to a metro station.
it can be difficult at the first time to open the door of the appartement.

We had an amazing time at Adrian’s place. It is extremely well located, in a central and lively neighborhood. The apartment is spacious, bright and very confortable. Definitely the best place we stayed in Berlin. Adrian was very reactive and flexible. Thank you!
Einfache Kommunikation und sauberes Apartment. Empfehlenswert!
Nice and clean apartment in nice neighborhood, but it's on the ground level in the inner courtyard of a house, so the apartment does not get much natural light

Very nice area, perfect apartments, helpful neighbors Thomas was out of Berlin, but he was online and we had no problems with settling. Great time in Berlin with family and friends. Strongly recommend :)
Great apartment!
A great little studio in a great location, and great value for money! There's everything you need!
everything good

Wir hatten zu sechst einen schönen Aufenthalt in Douglas Wohnung. Alles war wie angegeben, Betten bequem und alles sauber. Gute Lage, man ist in 10 Minuten auf der Museumsinsel. Parken zu angemessenem Preis

Appartement très calme, très bien placé. Tout est accessible soit à pieds si on aime marcher ou bien tous les transports en commun sont juste à côté (métro, bus, tramway, s.bahn). Supermarchés classique ou bio la rue à côté. Restaurants en bas dans la cour ou au bout de la rue pour les plus près.
Appartement très bien équipé et isolé. très agréable. Le lit est confortable. Tout petit bémol : le débit de la douche qui est faible.
Un très bon séjour de 9 jours.
Lisa a été très réactive à chacune de nos demandes et ponctuelle.
Intéressant d'avoir un plan des transport et un guide et des dépliants en arrivant.
Pour l’aéroport schonefeld le taxi est un peu onéreux, compter entre 45 ou 50 €. Donc le s.bahn est une bonne solution.

We had a wonderful time in Ullas appartment. We were six grown-ups and two children - and had all the Space we needed. The appartment was clean, big and clean. The Kitchen and the bathrooms had everything we needed. We celebrated my 60 th birthday - and the appartment was excellent for that. Nice and quiet neighbourhood - and we had very Nice weather, and did not mind walking a bit to th S-and U-Bahn.
Tolle Übernachtungsmöglichkeit, wenn man Berlin sehen möchte.
Je recommande si vous cherchez une chambre pour votre visite :)
By far my favorite airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. The place was lovely & Luke was both responsive & easy to communicate with.

Sehr nettes kleines Airbnb - für 2 Personen ideal mit allem was man braucht. Vor allem die Lage war super, um Berlin und Prenzlauer Berg zu erkunden. Es war alles sehr sauber und makellos, wir haben uns wohlgefühlt. Die Kommunikation & Check-In war auch sehr einfach und super erklärt.
Удобные апартаменты и паркинг, о котором вы не могли и мечтать, да и кровать супер, Ингмар и Том большое спасибо!
Stay was good. We had our privacy as no one was there at home during our stay. The location is very central, near to ostbahnof. It was a room solely given for us
Clean and comfortable place at a perfect location,  well designed easy access.

It was really nice! Top host, top location!
Highly recommend :)
Amazing location, new building, designed  light room, comfortable  bed! Recommended!

Very warm beautiful flat with lots of space and 4 different ways to make coffee! wow!
Good location little walk to the center but made sure it was quiet during the night. This was also helped by the enclosed courtyard the flat is in.
When back in Berlin will definitely be back :))
Toller Gastgeber, herausragende Wohnung in Top-Lage. Habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt und würde jederzeit wiederkommen wollen.

The place was perfect for our weekend in Berlin - great location and walking distance to historic city centre. Even though it’s located in centre of Kreuzberg it was super quiet inside. Everyone was super nice and freindly. Highly recommened!
War nun schon das zweite Mal dort und wer eine ruhige und dennoch zentral gelegene Unterkunft ohne sterilen Hotelcharme sucht, ist hier bestens bedient. Gerne wieder!
Would stay there again. Easy to get around. Right by a bus stop.

Ci siamo trovati molto bene, la casa è spaziosa con due bagni, la lavatrice e accessoriata, vicinissima alla metro, con vari supermercati in zona.
Ti consiglio questo appartamento se vuoi visitare la città perché è comodissimo secondo più punti di vista. Benedikt è molto disponibile per qualsiasi cosa.

Sehr schöne Wohnung. Genau wie beschrieben. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. In der Wohnung hat es an nichts gefehlt. Das Wohnviertel war sehr schön mit vielen Villen und Gärten, mit der U-Bahn ist man schnell in Berlin Mitte.  Nur zu empfehlen.

Andrea‘s Apartment was a peaceful oasis to return to after a busy day in Berlin and wonderful to wake up in.
I experienced a stunning sunrise over Berlin‘s skyline and the ever present view brings light and spaciousness to this place which is part of its peaceful vibe.
Public transport (S-Bahn) and free parking are right in front of the door and you can get into town quickly.
Corbusierhaus can feel quite intimidating as it‘s massive but it has a lovely community and is not as anonymous as you might think - I experienced people as friendly and helpful.
The apartment has everything you need and its original features from 1958 are charming albeit a little dog-eared. Andrea did a beautiful job with Bali-inspired furniture and decoration and as I travelled on my own it was plenty big enough - when it’s warmer and the balcony can be used I would even dare to bring my husband along.
I appreciated the closeness to the woods - the Grunewald is only 500m away and great for jogging and walking!
Tolle Lage, bestes Sushi gleich um die Ecke (musashi), gemütliche Wohnung, unkomplizierter Service - Danke!

Casa maravillosa, muy limpia y bonita. Un poco lejos del centro pero en una zona muy tranquila y bonita. Cerca de muchos supermercados. Muy bien comunicada. Al lado del tren y parada de bus delante de casa.

Das Zimmer ist praktisch ausgestattet (keine unnötige Deko o.ä.). In der Küche könnte es eine etwas größere Auswahl an Geschirr (z.B. Tiefe Teller, große Teller) und Besteck geben.
Positiv hervorzuheben ist die Sauberkeit. Dafür, dass immerhin 7 Zimmer zu der Wohnung gehören, waren die gemeinsam genutzten Bäder und die Küche wirklich top.

Great apartment with easy travel to the city centre and airport.
Everything was clean and fitted to a great standard. Beds were really comfortable and having two showers and toilets worked well for our visit.
Seb was easy to communicate with and gave some helpful tips for our stay.

The apartment is quite comfortable, with high ceilings and lots of space. The bed and sofas are also great. There are a few things missing in the kitchen to make it fully functional, but it gets the job done.
The highlight is definitely the host team: always super responsive and helped us sort out any issues. We will definitely be back!

Très belle maison de pêcheur pleine de charme, à quelques mètres de l eau et dans une cour très bucolique
Appartement meublé avec très bon goût
Très grande attention au détail (des ustensiles de cuisine rutilants aux savons délicats)
Gordon a été très réactif pour trouver un lit de bébé et nous permettre d arriver plus tôt et de repartir plus tard
Allez y les yeux fermés !!

Accueil très agréable dans un très bel appartement, bien situé et calme.
Vincent est un hôte très cordial.
j'espère pouvoir y séjourner de nouveau

Plenty of room to stay for a few nights, and in a nice, accessible area of the city. Very close to a lot of restaurants and two different grocery stores. Not necessarily ideal if you're looking to cook for yourself, and not ideal for a working vacation due to the slow wifi, but definitely a solid spot to book if you're passing through town for a few nights.
Cute, very accessible, convenient.  Would definitely stay again!
l'appartement est conforme à la description : confortable, bien situé (20mn de Alexanderplatz avec M2), agréable et hôte disponible.

Easy to get to with public transport on a nice quiet street. We were just here for one night so the flat was perfect for a stopover and not too far from trendy areas to go for food etc. The bed was sooo comfy and the room was cosy and clean. Excellent shower! Also nice to have a filter coffee machine. Thanks for having us!
Posizione facilmente raggiungibile al centro città con qualsiasi mezzo a disposizione e c’è ne sono molti. L’appartamento era perfetto, pulito come da descrizione
A nice apartment in a great neighborhood, convenient to everything. Bring earplugs if you’re a light sleeper, as foot/car traffic along the road can be loud at times. Would definitely stay again!
muy bien comunicado, limpio y acogedor.

We had a great time at Tara and Leo's stay. The apartment is very spacious and the lovely decoration made us feel welcome from the moment we stepped through the door. The check-in and overall communication with Tara and Leo went super smoothly and they were always happy to help if there were any questions and concerns. They even allowed for a later check-out, which saved us from big troubles with our luggage on the last day. Overall, a great place for a group of 8 people if you are looking for a stay in the east of Berlin.
My stay at Numa drift was just as I imagined: check-in and check-out super quick and easy (I could even check in earlier), nice room, very economic but comfy, and a great location
Klein aber stilvoll und vor allem sehr schön mit viel Holz. Wir waren sehr gerne dort.
Alles prima, jederzeit wieder.

The appartement is newly refurbished and quite fresh. It is also spacious.
The problem is that one out of two bedroom is towards a main road and therefore impossible to sleep in. One night my husband had to sleep in the bathroom to get some sleep.
Also the furnitures i the living room should have an upgrade. They do not look good and not in line with the appartements standard.
Wir haben uns als Familie sehr wohl gefühlt und hatten einen unkomplizierten Kontakt mit Jeremias. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet. Wir kommen bei Gelegenheit gerne wieder.
Nice and unique place for our long weekend in Berlin. Great communication with Sariko who was always quick to answer any of our questions before and during our stay. Would book again!
Ich habe vier Nächte in der Wohnung übernachtet, alles hat super geklappt. Die Wohnung war sauber und ist wirklich günstig gelegen. Zur U-Bahn und den Gropiuspassagen sind es nur ein paar Minuten.
Alles war super. Sehr netter Kontakt.

tolle und zentrale Wohnung mit freundlichen Gastgebern!
würden wieder kommen. : )

We’ve spent the bank holiday at Simon’s place and everything was perfect. The apartment felt so safe, very clean, spacious and the hosts were so kind giving us recommendations and some sweets for Easter.
100% recommended!
Perfect location for a very reasonable price.

Het is een mooi groot, proper goed uitgerust appartement met mooie hoge plafonds. Weinig tot geen burengeluiden. Het ligt vlakbij een bushalte die je naar Potsdammer Platz of centraal station kan brengen en van daaruit kan je veel overstappen maken, maar er zijn ook nog andere vervoersmogelijkheden op wandelafstand. Voor ons was het een ideale uitvalsbasis om Berlijn te verkennen.

Tatjana is a warm, thoughtful, caring, and professional host. She was very welcoming and greeted me in person upon arrival. She’s also an excellent cook! I enjoyed the delightful conversations with her as well.
The entire apartment is clean with plenty of sunlight. The bedroom is very spacious with closet space for my personal belongings and clothes. It was very comfortable and felt like home away from home.
The neighborhood has many accessible public transportation stations/stops. It was a breeze getting to the major train stations when I visited other cities outside of Berlin. It’s a very safe place to stay.
I highly recommend this apartment for solo traveling! I’d totally come back when I’m in Germany again.

it was just okay. the price is what made me book it because i only needed a quick one night but the space smelled bad, the sofas were stained, im not sure if they changed the sheets because there was a lot of someone else’s hair in it. My room also did not look like the photos. The photos were misleading.
The check in process should’ve been easy but they use a separate system that didn’t have clear instructions when they said it would so i had to keep reaching out to ask for specific links.
The pros: excellent location (1 min walk to the train station) & good prices, but you often get what you pay for

My husband and I loved staying at Ena's place. Ena was very accommodating to our check-in needs, and everything we needed was available at the apartment. The apartment itself is spacious and stylishly decorated. While the apartment is not close to many of Berlin's attractions, it was in the perfect location for us, and there are many transportation options close by. I would highly recommend Ena's apartment to anyone looking for a fantastic and peaceful home base while visiting Berlin!

Het was een heel mooi en groot appartement. Het had ook een leuk klein terrasje buiten.
Het appartement was niet gelegen in een buurt waar veel te zien was maar het treinstation is vlakbij (150m), dus je kan overal gemakkelijk geraken!

Eine TOP Unterkunft mit einer herzlichen Gastgeberin, die auch in Not aushilft.
Es ist sehr sehr sauber, ruhig und in sehr schöner Lage gelegen. Immer wieder gerne!

The stay was great, appartement is exactly what the description says, clean, fully equipped kitchen with a nice warm shower and a big bath tub also a nice balcony. Location wise it was a bit further from the centre than we expected but that’s on us ;)
in general a 9/10

Great place in a very green location of Berlin. I love the walks at the Gruenewald and very well located to get into the center of Berlin! The hosts were very nice people and I can only recommend this place !

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Berlin dans le logement de Mia.
Tout était clair pour notre arrivée et Mia a été très réactive pour nous répondre. L'appartement est confortable et bien situé.

Appartamento ottimo situato a pochi minuti dalla metro M4 e M10. Spazioso, pulito, confortevole e curato nei dettagli. Natalia molto cordiale e disponibile per farci depositare in anticipo le valigie e lasciarcele in appartamento fino nel pomeriggio (avevamo volo la sera). Veloce nel rispondere a richieste per informazioni e per esempio per un adattatore dimenticato in Italia.  Unico neo 5 piani senza ascensore. Ma superabilissimo per una sistemazione così ben accogliente. Consigliatissimo!

Dejlig, lækker og central lejlighed med masser af gode faciliteter. Super beliggenhed med adgang til restauranter, cafeer, indkøbsmuligheder og grønne områder. Tæt på offentlig transport. Altanen er et kæmpe plus, især med den smukke udsigt til Fernsehturm. Passede perfekt til vores forlængede weekendtur.

Sehr gemütliche, stilvoll eingerichtete, saubere und sehr sehr ruhige Wohnung in perfekter Lage und mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln super erreichbar!Hervorragende Gastgeberin!
Die Kommunikation mit Franziska war sehr angenehm und lief wirklich reibungslos! Ich habe alle nötigen Infos rechtzeitig bekommen. Mit ihren Beschreibungen und Tipps habe ich die Wohnung problemlos gefunden und auch das Einchecken lief perfekt!
Die Küche ist mit dem nötigsten eingerichtet (inkl. Kühlschrank und Spülmaschine). Da es in unmittelbarer Nähe aber zahlreiche sehr gute Cafés und Restaurants gibt, muss man die Küche eigentlich gar nicht nutzen.
Ich möchte außerdem noch betonen, dass ich mich als alleinreisende Frau immer sehr sicher und wohl gefühlt habe!
Absolute Empfehlung!
Zusammenfassung: Sauber, gastfreundlich, flexibler Check-in, guter Ort

Well appointed and spacious apartment. Great location and helpful / responsive hosts.
Although the apartment is on the top floor the area is pretty noisy when you have the bedroom windows open on a night in the summer. However, location is key and everything is on your doorstep. Would definitely visit again.

Franz's apartment was well equipped, in a great location and aesthetically brilliant. My client was very impressed with the property and hopes to stay again.
Franz was also very patient with us whilst we negotiated our check-in, we're very grateful that he was able to accommodate us!
A beautiful apartment on the 1st floor, comfortable, well equipped kitchen and close to all the tourist places to visit in Berlin

Wohnung war sehr schön und geräumig, alles war sauber und ordentlich.
Der Kontakt war sehr freundlich und reibungslos. Sehr empfehlenswert für Paare und große Familien die Berlin erkunden möchten
Was nice, very good location

Bel appartement, bien situé et disposant de tous les équipements nécessaires.
Instructions claires et hôte très réactif lors d’un souci de clé.
Wir waren rundum zufrieden 💕
La zona del alojamiento es excelente, con estaciones de metro muy cerca.  El apartamento está bien equipado. Cuando hice la reserva no me había quedado claro que era cuarto piso por escalera.
Nice stay - Angel / Toni were really nice to us and gave us great recommendations for the stay. Would visit again :)!

L’appartement est très jolie avec une superbe énergie , on si sens très vite chez soit , je recommande !
Tout est fait pour le confort optimal 😁 avec une communication réactive et plein de bon conseil de la part de Marie-Antonia
Merci beaucoup je reviendrai sans hésiter.

Schöne, gut und geschamackvoll eingerichtete Wohnung. Netter Gastgeber. Gute und ruhige Lage. Parkplatz vorhanden. ÖPNV gut erreichbar.
Fazit: Sehr zu empfehlen.
Kleines Manko: Leider ohne Kleiderschrank, in dem man Kleidung auch hängend aufbewahrt werden kann.

Tolles Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis, gute Lage und einfacher Check-in.
Alle Makel und Störfaktoren hängen eher mit den anderen Gästen zusammen, die z.B. die Gemeinschaftsbäder sehr dreckig hinterlassen und keine Rücksicht aufeinander nehmen.
Really pretty view of a little lake. Walking distance to cute cafes and thrift stores and bakeries. The apartment was really clean, and Michael was very friendly and kind!

Die Unterkunft war perfekt! Tolle Lage,eher ruhig, aber dennoch gut angebunden. Maria ist wirklich herzlich und super freundlich. Die Wohnung ist wunderschön eingerichtet, sauber und sehr gemütlich. Ich habe mich rundum wohlgefühlt und komme gerne wieder. Vielen Dank!
The stay at Nena Apartments Kreuzberg 61 was pleasant. The location was quite nice, lots of cool places and restaurants to see. All good!

Eve Uber’le gittiğimiz için rahat bulabildik. Binaya giriş kolaydı. Eve girmek için verilen şifre ise tam 15:00’te açıldı. Yani bizim gibi birkaç dakika erken giderseniz kapıda beklersiniz. Eve girdiğimizde ev çok soğuk ve kirliydi. Yorumlarda evde çok az eşya olduğu yazıyordu, ancak tuvalette en azından bir raf olmasını beklerdim. Yatak odasında başucundaki raflar sallanıyordu ve yamuk durduğu için üstüne bir telefon dahi koyulamıyordu. Evin her yeri toz içindeydi. Ancak asıl sorun ısınmaydı. Airbnb üstünden benimle iletişime geçilen hesaba yazdım, ancak otomatik cevaplar geldiği için doğru düzgün iletişim kuramadım. Airbnb şikayet hattına yazdım ve ev sahibinin beni aramasını bekledim. Ev sahibi son derece kaba ve ilgisizdi. Isıtma sistemi her gün bozuldu ve her gün ev sahibine tekrar tekrar yazmam gerekti, aradığım zaman da telefonu açmıyordu. Isınma sorunu ancak son gün çözülebildi. Bir daha Berlin’e gitsem asla burada kalmam.

We didn't have hot water for one day & night, but Calin responded as soon as he could with directions to the fuse box to fix it. I have dust allergies and was quite badly affected as soon as I was in the bedroom, and sure enough when I looked there was a lot of dust under the bed and in the corners. This probably wouldn't be an issue for people without allergies, but sadly affected my stay quite a bit. It seems like it had just been given a quick tidy-up rather than a deep cleaning.
Overall a good stay!

At first I was surprised at the lack of bugs flying in--no window screens--but by the end of the week we were greeted by wasps and mosquitos. Also, some noise from partying passersby late at night. There was construction noise in the courtyard, outside our bedroom windows, that started at 7 a.m. The exhaust filled the room my son was sleeping in, as he somehow slept through the jackhammer. Surely the construction is a temporary problem. But a good stay overall.

Wir könnne die Unterkunft nur empfehlen :)

Nicht zu empfehlen wenn man wirklich schlafen möchte.
Einfach nur laut.
8 Bettzimmer sehr klein und null Privatsphäre. Bin nachts ausgecheckt weil ich kein Auge zumachen konnte. Partyhostel. Nichts für mich.
Logement très agréable en plein coeur de Berlin. Très bien équipé et entretenu. La terrasse est un vrai plus par beau temps. Nelma est une hôte accueillante, je recommande complètement.
Great stay, perfect value for money

Een maand lang was ik te gast in het kleine, maar zeer fijne appartement van Thomas.

Alles is gemakkelijk bereikbaar. Thomas is een heel vriendelijke gastheer. Ik kan iedereen deze plek aanraden.
Perfect for a solo stay. Till’s communication is top tier. Thanks.
Great place and amazing location
Muy recomendable el alojamiento. Limpio, bien ubicado, y con check in programable. Cumplió con las expectativas al 100%
Amazingly beautiful place. very comfortable and in a good location with nice restaurants

Gute Lage, Mina war schnell zu erreichen, wenn es Fragen gab.
Appartement ist gut und funktional eingerichtet, ruhige Oase mit grünem Innenhof.
Sarah ist eine sehr nette und unkomplizierte Gastgeberin. Das Zimmer ist super gemütlich und ich habe mich sauwohl gefühlt. Komme bestimmt wieder
Sehr zu empfehlen
Tolle Unterkunft ✨
Propre, spacieux, dans un quartier calme et agréable. Appartement idéal pour un séjour berlinois.
Departamento muy cómodo y agradable, bien ubicado y limpio. Nicolas fue muy atento y preocupado por nuestra estancia.

nice and roomy appartment
well equiped
المكان اشبه بالفندق الشبابي ، لقد كتبت إلى المضيف اكثر من مرة ولم يقم بالرد نهائياً ، الموقع جيد جداً وسط العاصمة.
The place was very nice and we enjoyed our stay

Die Wohnung entspricht vollständig der Beschreibung und ist in gutem Zustand. Die Qualität der Betten ist sehr gut.  S- und U-Bahn-Stationen liegen sehr nah und uns hat auch die Nähe zur S-Bahn-Trasse nachts nicht gestört, wir haben sie kaum gehört. Sehr empfehlenswerte Wohnung!
logement tout à fait convenable et bien entretenu,  avec un hôte sympathique et professionnel. je recommande :)
Ubicacion exelente ... inmejorable el espacio ... de mis mejores experiencias en airb&b  recomendado 100%
Great location, clean and the bed very confortable.

Heerlijke plek om te verblijven in Berlijn. Wat mij betreft de leukste wijk. Appartement was netjes schoon. Balkon aan levendige straat. Op loopafstand van  historische binnenstad. Tramhalte voor de deur. Snelle reactie van de gastvrouw via airbnb communicatie tijdens ons verblijf.
good person, good stay, perfect for a young traveller, good local knowledge

Uns hat der Aufenthalt bei Pigi sehr gut gefallen, sie ist eine außergewöhnlich herzliche und gastfreundliche Person, das Zimmer war ruhig, sehr sauber und gemütlich, die Lage der Unterkunft sehr zentral und gut angebunden. Wir können es ganz klar empfehlen und kommen gerne  wieder!

Everything was great, very comfy beds, all amenities were good. The only thing that kept it from being perfect was that the shower didn’t drain well, so each time someone took a shower it overflowed into the rest of the bathroom.
Sakine was very responsive and we had no problems at all. Definitely recommend!
Es war alles super, genau wie in der Beschreibung und auf den Bildern. Florian ist super nett und stets erreichbar. Dankeschön :)
Très bon emplacement !

Het enige minpuntje was dat er geen kasten aanwezig waren om de kleding in op te ruimen.
Verder een prima appartement voor 2 personen en brandschoon.

The flat is well equipped and clean, the shower is strong and easy to use.  If you drive there, you can safely park the car outside the street. We highly recommend Fabian's Place to whom wanna have a good time in Berlin.
Quiet neighborhood. Amazing bakery nearby -- great for breakfast! (Don't go to the tapas place, though.) U-Bahn station near by. Good WIFI. Decent furnishing.
Habe mich wohl in der Wohnung gefühlt, der Check-In und Check-Out war flexibel und die Lage war ruhig aber gleichzeitig zentral in Berlin

Eine rundum zu empfehlende Unterkunft! Super schön eingerichtet, super ausgestattet,  super sauber und super gelegen (Tram hält fast direkt vor der Tür und Bürgerpark ist auch direkt um die Ecke)! Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Ich war mit meinem Bruder 3 Tage in dieser Unterkunft und kann nur sagen, dass es ein unglaubliches Erlebnis war.
Die Unterkunft ist sehr sauber und alles ist nahegelegen.
Wir haben uns wie zu Hause gefühlt und können sie euch nur empfehlen!

Gorgeous flat on the top floor in Kreuzberg! Perfect location — very close to shops and cafes. While it doesn’t have many amenities, it had just what we needed for a long weekend. Despite the listing saying there’s no hot water, there is! My biggest issue was that there wasn’t a single mirror outside of the bathroom. It would have been nice but obviously not totally necessary. Would def stay here again if I was on a quick trip.
Muy bien todo , gracias y hasta la próxima vez ☺️

La estadía ha sido excelente. El apartamento es bonito, y esta rodeado de árboles, lo que hace que la estadía sea muy agradable. La ubicación es muy buena, con el U-bahn en la esquina y a pocas cuadras del centro de Wilmersdorf. Christian es un gran anfitrión, siempre dispuesto a ayudar en todo lo que se necesita y siempre de la mejor manera. Recomiendo este apartamento!
Hôte très chaleureuse et prévenante. On se sent presque chez soi chez Andrea.
Great host, easily accessible - will definitely stay here again when next in Berlin!

The place is in a fantastic location, the reason I chose it. Staff were friendly. Had a good coffee in the morning. Rooms were okay, a little hot at night and I unfortunately had the loudest most inconsiderate hostel guests in my room which is not the Hostel’s fault but it obviously affected my sleep and experience there. Overall a good stay besides getting very little sleep.
Roomy and nice apartments, very responsive and always available host, we had everything we needed, thank you for the nice time we spent there
Very good location, spacious apartment, good shower.
It was a very nice stay at Calma Berlin, I enjoyed it, they have very nice rooms
Alles da was gebraucht war, tolle Unterkunft in einer super Gegend.
Todo perfecto

Location was great, bedroom is comfortable, and bathroom is excellent. Not to mention the recommendations for good restaurants, laundry, supermarket, and interesting places nearby was very helpful. We felt right at home!

Schöne Dachgeschosswohnung in alter Villa mit großem Garten. Für uns fünf Personen mehr als ausreichend. Grüner Bezirk mit einer Bushaltestelle fast direkt vor der Tür. Mit den öffentlichen ca. 30 Minuten bis zum Bahnhof Zoo. Neues Bad und Küche.
Alles super

Tanja er imødekommende, venlig, hjælpsom og altid parat til at svare på spørgsmål og give forslag til oplevelser. En super værtinde.
Værelset var superfint og svarede 100% til beskrivelsen.
Der er kort afstand til S-bane station og lidt længere til Südkreuz, men stadig gå afstand.
Jeg kan kun anbefale Tanjas bolig.

Karsten's apartment is clean and very cozy and we liked every single little thing he has chosen to decorate it.
Subway is very close and the neighborhood is quiet.
We would definetely stay there again.
Es war alles so wie erwartet und äußerst unkompliziert. Wir würden wieder kommen. :)
Really nice flat in a good location. I slept well and really enjoyed my stay.

Die Wohnung ist sehr stylisch und sauber! Würde sie jedes Mal wieder buchen :)
Der Gastgeber war immer erreichbar und hat schnell reagiert!
Vielen Dank für alles!

L'appartement de MArcel était parfait pour notre famille de 5.
L'accès au transport au commun est très facile.
Le quartier est calme.

Francesco was very accommodating, my flight was extremely delayed and I came in around 1AM and he was available to check me in and willing to give me information about Berlin and how to get to city center. The apartment is comfortable and easily accessible by public transport. I definitely recommend Francesco's place.
Todo perfecto, la zona está cerca de todo y nos dieron facilidades en todo. Perfecto para visitar Berlín. :)
Staying at Madda’s was perfect! Very accessible and in a good area. Her flat is great!
Everything was perfect! Apartment close to the station, very clean and spacious. I would recommend it to a friend.
Very German and decent place for a one night rest!
Der Aufenthalt bei Miriam war sehr angenehm. Die Wohnung ist klein, aber gemütlich und schön eingerichtet.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 – An Absolutely Beautiful Stay!
I had the most amazing experience at this Airbnb! From the moment I arrived, the hosts were incredibly kind, welcoming, and attentive — they truly went above and beyond to make me feel at home. Every detail of the space was beautiful — clean, thoughtfully decorated, and filled with a calming energy that made it hard to leave. It was the perfect balance of comfort and style. I couldn’t have asked for a better stay. Thank you for such a lovely and memorable experience — I’ll definitely be back!
Schöner Aufenthalt. Gutes Apartment.
Self service check in so very easy! Room was nice and clean and bed was comfy. Not much around but lots of lime bikes and scooters so things are still easy to get to just a short ride away
Lovely stay at Heinrich’s apartment. We really enjoyed the neighbourhood and close proximity to public transport.
Friendly and helpful. Very nice apartment, so clean. Location felt very safe. Would defo recommend :)
Great place !!

Beautiful apartment near good public transport. The flat was just like it seemd in the pictures and communication with Ralf & Gaby was fluent and very pleasant. Loved the modern kitchen and bathroom in that old, romantic apartment.
The flat is on the first floor and bedroom windows are to the street so it’s not that quiet during the day, but on nighttime the area was peaceful. Had a good sleep in that bed too!
I really would recommend this place!
Great stay. Sorry for the trouble with checkout.
Zentrale Lage, gute Verkehrsanbindung, nette und gut erreichbare Gastgeberin.
Ulla war sehr nett und hilfsbereit.
Very nice and cosy place to stay at! For sure would recommend to family and friends!

As a woman travelling alone, I found Uta's apartment very convenient and safe. Set in a quiet residential street, it was only a few minutes walk away from a Ubahn station connecting me with all parts of the city. In the other direction, again just a short stroll away, was a host of different food outlets: organic supermarket, bakeries, etc, and some great little restaurants and cafes.

Aangename ontvangst en heel vriendelijke host. Heeft ons goed rondgeleid in haar huis en hoe de sloten werkte…
Jammer dat er geen lavabo op de kamer was maar voor de rest een AANRADER!
Sophia en haar hond zijn zeer sympathiek…
Ik kom hier misschien nog eens terug 🌻🌻

My experience staying at Alexander's place exceeded my expectations. The location is superb - right next door to an S Bhan station - which took me directly to and from the airport. The apartment was immaculate and very secure- at no point did I feel unsafe. There is an abundance of hot water for the bath, shower, kitchen- at all times. Despite being immediately next door to an S Bhan station, it was a quiet place to sleep- as the bedrooms are to rear of building. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you need to cook, like we did (there are 2 supermarkets within a seven minute walk). The neighbours are also quiet - which is an absolute must for me when I chose to select an Airbnb property. Communication was excellent,  from arrival to departure- this was very reassuring for us. There is an excellent coffee/barista bar within a 3 min walk called '93' - serving top quality coffee. Turn right as you come out of main front door and follow right around. Enjoy this place, it's great!

Ubytování bylo ideální, v docházkové vzdálenosti od hlavního nádraží, skvělé spojení městskou hromadnou dopravou všude, kam jsme se chtěli podívat. Samotný byt byl dostatečně vybavený, byl čistý. Anton je velmi milý a sympatický pán, velmi rychle komunikoval. Můžu jenom doporučit, absolutní spokojenost.
perfect place to stay
Molt recomanable!! Aneu-hi!!

I totally recommend this airbnb, you have a beautiful and peaceful place to stay. Also, the building is very original. The host is great too, he is always up to help you if you have any question or problem, so in my case that I travelled alone, I didn’t feel worried being in another country because Özgür is a very attentive person.

Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war hervorragend, ebenso mit der Beauftragten für die Schlüsselübergabe. Die Wohnung war genau wie beschrieben. Es hat mir sehr gut gefallen. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen, wenn ich in Berlin bin.
Amazing place! Would love to stay again!

Die Unterkunft ist genau so wie beschrieben, eine perfekt ausgestattete Ferienwohnung in einer traumhaften Lage. Der Ausblick aus dem dritten Stock über Spree und Müggelsee ist perfekt, auch im Winter.
wir kommen gerne wieder.
the stay was wonderful, shame about the confusing access signs where I wasted time at the beginning, the overhead shower doesn't work, otherwise great stay
We had a pretty good three days here

very nice hotel, lokated super central in Berlin. The stairs/ladder up to the bedroom was very very steep, you should be aware of that when you book the room. It is not for all people ( children and old people ) to climb every time you are going to the toilet or going to bed.

Good apartment in an ideal location with lots of restaurants and bars nearby and public transport within close walking distance. The beds were comfortable and the bathroom was clean. This place did the job and was a great base from which to explore Berlin.
Appartement propre et bien équipé. Arrivée et départ sans aucun problème. Parfait, merci 👍🏻

Martin and his son are amazing, Martins place is better then any hotel in Berlin and cheaper. He makes sure you have towels, Tea, Coffee, water and milk when you arrive and leave multiple bottles of body wash etc in the bathroom.

Quick access to public transport (Ubahn, S, Tram); clean, quiet, discrete host.
We met only Marc, which didn't leave until he gave us all needed information (transportation, shops in the area, recommendations).

Wir haben die Wohnung vor allem wegen der Nähe zum Hauptbahnhof gebucht (10 Minuten zu Fuß). Darüber hinaus ist die Wohnung aber auch zweckmäßig und ansprechend eingerichtet. Alles Notwendige ist vorhanden. Schön ist auch der kleine Balkon. Die Wohnung liegt in einer weitgehend ruhigen Seitenstraße. Der Verkehr auf der mehrspurigen Hauptstraße (Autos, Busse und Straßenbahnen) ist zwar als Hintergrundgeräusch zu hören, hat uns aber nicht gestört (auch nicht nachts bei geöffneter Balkontür).
Schöne Wohnung mit sehr gut ausgestatteter Küche

Marius such a good guy , we enjoyed our stay in his apartment.
can advise for sure to friends to go there :)

房源與描述相符。
空間大，足夠打開三個大行李箱。
廚房設備齊全，附近有超市，可以買食物用焗爐加熱，省略不少金錢。
