Even though I didn't get to meet Kai, I was very happy with my stay. Keys and instructions was easily comprehensible. The apartment is beautiful, clean and fresh. A very nice welcoming was a couple of bottles of beer and water in the fridge. I loved the little balcony and found the location perfect for my desires. Internet was a bit slow at times but worked.

I would definitely recommend this place for a solo flyer or a couple. Good ambience and quiet.Also appreciated the flexibility in leaving the luggage behind even after check-out. The level of trust is an asset to Airbnb!

Das Airbnb an sich ist in Ordnung, aber viel zu klein für 4 Leute. Leider wird es auf den Bildern viel größer dargestellt als es tatsächlich ist. Es war schön eingerichtet aber leider garnicht wie eine Wohnung sondern eher wie ein Hotelzimmer mit Küche. Wichtige Dinge wie ein Lappen oder Geschirrtuch haben komplett gefehlt. Für 1-2 Tage mit 2-3 Personen ist es in Ordnung, für einen längeren Aufenthalt und mit 4 Personen kann ich es überhaupt nicht empfehlen, vor allem bei dem Preis. Da würde ich mir dann doch eher eine richtige Wohnung raussuchen. Ich finde es schade das man es als Apartment einstellt, wenn es eigentlich eher ein Hotel ist. Neben dem eigenen Zimmer sind auch noch einige andere Zimmer also hat mit einem Airbnb finde ich nichts zu tun. Kann’s nicht empfehlen.
Sehr zentrale Lage, super Preis-Leistung und überaus freundliches Personal. Sehr gerne wieder!
Bra och prisvärt!

Norbert was an excellent host from start to finish. From suggestions of where to go get coffee or bread, to making the apartment feel like a welcomed respite, I was made to feel at home in this wonderful city from the moment I arrived.
Super netter Gastgeber und die Lage ist top :) komme gerne wieder
Best place to stay in Berlin! I love Emir's flat! Recommend to all! Very comfortable, u can feel like home ;)
Location is walkable to bus lines (25 min walk to Checkpoint Charlie). Lots of bars and restaurants, good for the price.

Denislav is a super cool guy and really nice, had really good tips about bars/restaurants/nightlife! The apartment was clean and cozy, well equipped. The district is quiet and friendly, but many restaurants and bars within few hundred meters. Really good location, public transport within few minutes too.

Schöne moderne Wohnung in Top Lage. Das Haus in dem sich die Wohnung befindet, ist auch sehr schön. In wenigen Minuten ist man auf dem Kurfürstendamm, viele Lokale in der Umgebung. Vor dem Haus bekommt man relativ gut einen Parkplatz, der für die zentrale Lage auch noch sehr günstig ist.
We had a great time in Berlin at Kasia and Alan's apartment. Location is great, apartment is clean and facilities great. Would recommend.
The place was wonderful. Great neighborhood and clean quiet apartment. Will stay again.

Great stay and rooms
5 km from centre Berlin, but tram and station is nearby.
Appartment is downstairs and street can be little bit loud
Communication is top, you can ask them anything

Logement propre, bien placé et conforme aux attentes et Timothy a été arrangeant et réactif. Je pense que l'ajout de deux tasses serait un plus car il n'y a actuellement qu'une bouilloire et rien d'autre.
Werner ist ein super Typ, hilfsbereit und gut erreichbar, und die Unterkunft ist wie beschrieben. Alles, was man braucht und in einer tollen Lage.  Klare Weiterempfehlung.
It was pretty easy to get around the city from the flat and Laura provides more than enough information so it was very easy to get around as well as checking in.

Nos ha encantado poder pasar tiempo en esta casa, aunque fuera cortito. La casa era muy acogedora y limpia y Stella siempre ha querido ser la mejor anfitriona. Sin duda repetiremos si tenemos la oportunidad.
Loved this beautiful stay, so charming! Creative vibe, fun neighborhood with lots of restaurants and grocery stores. HeIen is delightful. I would definitely stay here again!

Great location for metro stations, Bergmannstrasse just around the corner was great for choice of bars and restaurants within just a few mins walk. Martin is a great host, replied straight away to all our questions, flexible with arrival and departure times and allowed us to leave our luggage on the last day which was brilliant for us. We were out early till late and this was the perfect base for us.
Lovely place in a perfect part of town with a responsive and helpful host. Would definitely stay again!
aceptable option just 10 min walk from the metro conncetions. quite neighborhood
Lovely, clean apartment, great location - very close to the U bahn that gets you to most sights quickly, also close to supermarket and bakery. Host's communication was timely and accurate
overall happy with our stay great location and very comfortable bed
Very well located, next to Alexanderplatz and very close to two Metro stations. Its a nice place to stay around 3/4 days.
it was all very smooth, we had a great time in berlin

Herausragende Unterkunft, in idealer Lage mit Altbauflair - für ein paar wundervolle Tage in Berlin. Arzu&Tom sind hervorrangende Gastgeber und Ihre Gastfreundschaft hat uns durch die Tage in Berlin begleitet. Sogar strahlender Sonnenschein hat auf uns gewartet :-) - wir kommen wieder. Vielen Dank und Euch wundervolle Ostertage!

Wonderful appartment. Very strategic position, perfect to explore the city.
the building is very nice and the host super-friendly. Reccomended!
Everything was great, Alina was great host!

Tolles Apartment, perfekt zum Entspannen, in Prenzlauer Berg, Supermarkt direkt um der Ecke, Cafés,Bars, Restaurant auch ganz nah und der Mauerpark auch nicht weit entfernt.
Würde ich immer wieder buchen! 😄

Es gab Probleme mit dem WLAN, da wir auch teilweise beruflich tätig waren wurde das etwas schwierig. Max arbeitet aber daran das zu verbessern. Unbedingt nachfragen ob das behoben ist, sollte es gebraucht werden.
Max ist ein sehr netter Typ und sehr hilfsbereit. Die Wohnung ist sehr großzügig- Loftcharakter.
Bra boende, dock väldigt varmt rum
Amazing warm apartment near the center. Very comfortable and quiet. We really enjoyed our stay at Imke's place!

The place was clean and in a nice part of town and close to the Ubonn. The unit had nice bathrooms and plenty of linens. However, there were no drapes in the bedrooms so the street lights shined into the room.   Two bedroom windows could not be opened at night since they opened to the street.  There were no screens on the windows so we had mosquitoes in the house when we opened The transom during the day.  We expected no air conditioning but they provided no fans in a summer that had record heat advisory.

Sentralt plassert leilighet, ideelt for oss som bruker hele byen. Alle fasiliteter tilgjengelig, enkelt å nå ubahn og annen kollektivtrafikk. Lett å finne kommunikasjon med utleier, og vi fikk god hjelp med alt vi lurte på.
Really nice flat. Great location in a cool part of the city. Sascha and Urike were very helpful.
Great stay. One can find near everything near by, access to public transportation is excellent and only a couple minutes with U2 to reach Alexander Platz.

I have to say Ivos is a mench. If more people were like him, the world would be a better place.
The flat was nice. Pretty view, good access to public transit. It was just the right size for me.
I stayed here on my birthday and Ivos made sure it started well.
When i come back to Berlin, i will be sure to try to stay here again.
I liked staying here. Basic but exactly what was needed for a weekend stay. For breakfast check out Cafe A.Horn,  really good food.
Premises matched the description. Very easy to find and a good location if you’re there to enjoy your time. Recommended.

Schönes Zimmer in ruhiger Wohnlage. In 3 Minuten zu Fuß bei der U-Bahn womit man alles gut erreichen kann. Sabrina ist eine sehr aufgeschlossene und tolle Gastgeberin, ich war zwar aufgrund einer Hochzeit nicht viel im Haus habe mich aber sehr wohl gefühlt. Danke!!!
Alles bestens. Ruhig, sauber, und alles wie beschrieben! Danke!

Diese schöne Wohnung überzeugt durch die ruhige Lage in einem Innenhof und das perfekte kulinarische Angebot in unmittelbarer Nähe:) den besten Kaffee und Kuchen könnt ihr bei dem Kaffeehaus Zazza ein paar Häuser weiter erhalten. Gary hat uns sehr freundlich begrüßt und die Kommunikation mit Andreas war jederzeit sehr gut. In dieser Wohnung kann man sich direkt wohlfühlen :) vielen Dank für die tolle Zeit!

Alles gut. Für uns hat es gut gepasst. Preis-Leistung ist gut. Die Lage hat uns auch sehr gut gefallen.
Falls man viel kocht, sollte man beachten, dass die Küche sehr klein ist

Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt bei Emilia sehr genossen, uns hat es an nichts gefehlt.
Sie war sehr gastfreundlich.

Bel appartement dans un quartier calme et agréable à deux pas des transports en communs. L’appartement a tout ce qu’il faut pour passer un très bon séjour 😊. Stefan est un super hôte, accueillant répondant rapidement si besoin. Si nous devions revenir à Berlin c’est ici que nous reposerions nos valises 🧳. On recommande à 100%

Ich hatte bei der Unterkunft etwas mehr erwartet.
Die Räume sind schön groß und es bietet auch genügend Schlafmöglichkeiten.
Leider war das WLAN nicht nutzbar (keine Bandbreite).
Die Sauberkeit könnte besser sein sah eher so aus als ob lange keiner da war.
Der TV und die Kaffeemaschine sind nicht die auf den Bildern.
Kontakt war sehr freundlich. Die Lage macht es wet.

We stayed at Andrea's house at the end of December. Andreas is the nicest, most helpful host. He always there to answer questions. We want to thank Andreas for his hospitality, kindness and information of this beautiful city. It was all perfect. The room is clean and comfortable and close to everything. I recommend this space and hope to stay here again in the future.  Thank you Andreas and Nam
Gerne wieder
It has a really good location, the hostel in itself is very cool and had a lot of common areas where you can meet other travelers. Would definitely come back here

Great Apartment in a very relaxed surrounding.
The communication with the host Laura is easy und uncomplicated.
Enjoyed our stay in Berlin to the fullest :)

Neue gut ausgestattete FeWo . Ruhige Lage in einer Remise im Hof.
Gut mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erreichbar und direkt am Park gelegen.Sehr nette und aufmerksame Vermieterin.
Für unsere Zwecke in Pankow perfekt.

Absolut empfehlenswert. Eine schöne, gemütliche Altbauwohnung in sehr guter Lage. Geräumig, blitzsauber und mit allem ausgestattet, was man brauchen könnte. Heiko ist ein toller Gastgeber, immer erreichbar und sehr entgegengekommend. Gerne wieder!

My stay at Mme apt was perfect, the room is large with two big windows, there is a comfortable wardrobe and a 5 drawer chest. The bathroom was perfect and clean with al the necessary. The position of the apt is very good, it's near to the U station and Tram stop and it's full of restaurant, shops and bars. I highly recommend it.
Paolo und Petra sind fantastische Gastgeber, wir haben uns wie bei Freunden zu Hause gefühlt. Aber um in den 4. Stock zu gelangen braucht man doch etwas Grundkondition ;-)
Great location and friendly host. Definitely recommend

fantastic, comfortable stay in a wonderful family-friendly neighborhood. Thomas was so kind and gave us a very thorough introduction to the apartment. Everything was very easy.
As a bonus, the building even has an elevator!
Great place
周围是环境安静漂亮的居民区，很多适合跑步的路线，但离大众景点不算近；在3楼，需要爬楼梯；房间干净、设施齐全；不是独立淋浴间，是架在在浴缸里的；studio的选项提供的是展开的沙发床，个人不挑床所以觉得没问题；没空调，有戴森无叶风扇，如果天气热又不想把窗户关死，周末早上会被附近教堂的钟声叫醒。

Gerhard met me at the house to hand over the keys and go over everything about the flat in person.  He was always available and ready to help throughout my stay as well, providing helpful tips about local businesses and things I should keep an eye out for while in Berlin!  The flat is great, right next to parks and a 10 min walk to access to Berlin's extensive S-Bahn train system.  10/10 would recommend to friends and stay there again.

Selcuk and Sabrina were simply amazing hosts! They were so friendly and welcoming that we really felt more like staying at friends'. They have beautiful home, stylish and clean, in a perfect location if you are looking for the feeling of the city of Berlin. There is lots to see and do nearby, we stayed for a week and hardly left the neighbourhood. Yet the building itself is very quiet and we could sleep tight windows open. Selcuk and Sabrina have also really nice recommendations for the area so it's feels easy to settle in. Our stay at their place was definitely one of the highlights of our more than 2 weeks journey through several countries!

We hadden een prima verblijf bij David en Katja. De ruimte was makkelijk te vinden en de instructies om binnen te komen duidelijk. De wijk Neuköln is niet super schoon en er zijn veel daklozen, maar dat is overal zo in de binnenstad van Berlijn. We hebben ons in elk geval wel veilig gevoeld, ook 's avonds als we de metro uit het centrum terug namen.
Ik raad deze ruimte aan. Als je niet de hoofdprijs wil betalen voor je bezoek aan Berlijn, dan is dit prima. Natuurlijk niet perfect, maar daar is de prijs ook naar.
Super Lage,  geräumig und hell. Schneller und unkomplizierter  Kontakt mit Gastgeber .

Avi has a very beautiful place. Lovely décor and the place has its own personality! Avi was kind enough to wait for us due to delays in check in and is very helpful. The place has all the necessities and is very clean. Highly recommended!

Bee's flat is incredibly beautiful - exactly as you see it in the photographs !!! The location is perfect and getting around Berlin extremely easy. Bee is a great host and she will do whatever possible to help you gaining the best from your trip to Berlin. Plus she's got a cat - Pigeon - who is the sweetest feline you will ever meet :D Highly recommended !!!!

Unique loft in a trendy neighbourhood with public transport connections at a 5 minute walk. Quiet and cool at the same time. One feels at home right away due to many details in styling and comfort. Highly recommended.
the host is very friendly,  and this place is really convenient.
Tolle Lage, super netter Host und rund um ein tolles AirBnB Angebot! Sehr gerne wieder ;-)

+ Location is perfect, getting there is easy. Everything is clean and well organized.
- The apartment is very small for 4 people, and using the codes to get in and out is inconvenient.

Ewa was a fabulous host, provided us with all relevant information, and the place is v nice, well equipped, very clean. We had a lovely stay, and we would love to come back to Ewa’s next time we’ll visit Berlin.
Bardzo przyjemne, obszerne i czyste mieszkanie

Die Wohnung von Laura & Vanja ist unbeschreiblich schön, stylisch, mega-sauber und war einfach perfekt für uns. Wir waren mit 4 Mädels anlässlich eines Konzerts in Berlin und haben 4 Nächte dort verbracht. Wir haben uns einfach vom ersten Moment an super wohlgefühlt. Bruder Yves war beim Check-in total unkompliziert und hat uns gleich das Gefühl gegeben, in Berlin willkommen zu sein und jederzeit behilflich sein zu können.
Die Aufteilung der Wohnung ist super, vor allem ist es auch schön, dass sie einen großen ruhigen Balkon hat und die Lage ist sowieso perfekt. Die Betten sind extrem bequem, es waren mehr als genügend Handtücher vorhanden, die Küche ist super ausgestattet und hat keine Wünsche offen gelassen.
Leider hatten wir eine Woche erwischt, wo es um die 35 Grad heiß war. In einem der Schlafzimmer war es daher nachts ziemlich warm und zum Fenster-Auflassen war es leider etwas zu laut von der Straße her. Aber das ist wirklich das Einzige. Ansonsten war es rund um perfekt und ich kann mir in Berlin zu diesem Preis wirklich keine schönere Wohnung vorstellen!
1000 x Danke an die lieben Gastgeber! Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder!
Fint boende i ett lugnt område!
War super Aufenthalt!
Tolle Unterkunft mit super Lage. Freundliches Personal und alles hat super geklappt. Wir waren zufrieden!

Alex's house was perfect for our vacation! Very clean and spacious! Suitable for large groups of people! Alex was always available through messages! Whatsmore the house was really close to transport means, so wandering around was very easy!

El espacio es suficiente para una pareja aunque es pequeño, el baño es compartido con otras habitaciones que es algo para tomar en cuenta. La zona es muy bonita, da una sensación de ser una zona poca turística.
El host es muy atento, sin duda volveríamos a quedarnos aquí!
Direkt beim Schloss Charlottenburg. Viele nette Restaurants in der Umgebung. Alles was man braucht vorhanden. 2 Bäder, grosse Küche.
Stijlvol appartement in een mooie en centraal gelegen wijk. Alles is netjes en schoon en we hadden genoeg ruimte om met 4 vrienden te verblijven.

Lugar limpio. Buena atención de Flora. El baño es muy pequeño para una persona grande o mayor. En general estuve a gusto y sin contratiempos, salvo a la llegada, pero sin algo malo que comentar. Quizás debería enviar un video de cómo llegar de la calle al departamento. Hay una escalera que subir, por lo que, en personas mayores es de pensarse. La zona tranquila, pero alejada del centro. Si me volvería a hospedar ahí.

Astrid is een enorm lieve en vlotte vrouw. De communicatie verliep goed, zowel vooraf als tijdens. Astrid kan slechts beperkt Engels, maar dit vormde geen probleem doordat ze zo enthousiast is en alles doet om dingen duidelijk te maken. De kamer was heel netjes, en alles was er eigenlijk dat je nodig hebt. Astrid heeft mij zelfs om 3u30 ‘s nachts naar de luchthaven gebracht. Ik zou het zeker aanraden!!
Great location, it’s possible to reach the city centre both by foot or by subway. Everything okay! :)
The stay was good. The location is good and the checkin was very easy!

I can highly recommend this room at the Living Hotel Berlin-Mitte. It is comfortable, private and has its own kitchen, bathroom and bathtub. The hotel staff was friendly, kind and always helpful. The hotel has its own laundry facilities, a gym and a sauna. There were no issues whatsoever. It was perfect.

Wunderbarer Aufenthalt
zentral in Bahnhofsnähe gelegen
Freundlich und zugewandt im Kontakt
Immer wieder gerne
Great place to stay for a few nights!

Had a great stay at the apartment. Good area with lots of nice bars and restaurants in walking distance and well connected to other areas in Berlin too.
Apartment is very spacious and perfect for working or a short holiday

We had a great stay here. The communication from the owner was swift and helpful. The welcome pack was also really helpful too. We loved the stylish decor and cleanliness. This was a quiet place to stay and had a great little courtyard. We'll definitely be coming back to stay here again.
Andy and Michelle

Die Wohnung bietet viel Platz. Wir haben uns zu sechst sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Lage ist perfekt, wenn man Zehlendorf und den Südwesten Berlins mit den Seen und Wäldern entdecken möchte. Außerdem ist die Anbindung mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln sehr gut, sodass man auch schnell in die Innenstadt gelangen kann. Wir würden die Wohnung jederzeit weiter empfehlen.
Comfortable, clean, well equipped flat, convenient for local restaurants and shops with tram stop right outside and s-bahn 10 mins walk away.  Would stay here again.

Caren is an excellent host we've ever met. On the first day, we arrived Berlin very late, but Caren still greeted us warmly and nicely. She quickly showed us the room and it is exactly the same as we saw in the pictures. The beds are cozy and the bathroom is also good.
Alles super, gerne wieder! :)
great Apartments!  great location 1 minute walk from metro.  the room is very clean!  I recommend!

Staying at Alexandra's place was absolutely wonderful. Her flat is very bright, with a south-facing balcony and has a nice layout. My husband, myself and our daughter stayed for six weeks in the apartment and loved every single day of it! The beds are comfortable and the kitchen is well-equiped. I would stay there again.

The hostel was easy to find and check into. My room was clean along with the bathrooms and showers. It was generally quiet at night, there wasn’t too much noise. I forgot to bring a towel so I rented one which was about 3 euros. They also let you store your luggage before check in if needed. Overall, my stay was excellent and I would come again.

Simone was such a great host to me and my three friends. All the information she gave us was so useful, the apartment was clean and had all the amenities we needed to make our own food. The apartment was also really nice and warm and quiet day/night.
The location itself was so ideal. 15 mins from Alexander Platz, we could also walk to Mitte. The U-Bahn is really nearby (5mins walk), and from there you can go most places.
We will definitely be back, thank you so much Simone x
The apartment looks like the photo, really nice and lots of light, also near the train and restaurants.

A very welcoming apartment in a family house in the outskirts of Berlin.
Hans is very friendly and take care of all the small details during the accommodation.
Highly recommend!
The house is new and clean. Host is very friendly. we had a good stay.
Nice, cosy and as described.
Great place and very conveniently located.
Gut ausgestattete zentrale Unterkunft mit sehr guter Anbindung an den ÖPNV.
Cute apartment in a handy location with great amenities!

We had a great weekend in this apartment, traveling with a toddler. We texted Alla when we arrived and she came to meet us within a few minutes. The location is amazing - short walk to U and S trains, with loads of stuff nearby. Cute cafes, great restaurants, bakeries, playgrounds, a grocery store, a shopping mall all within a few blocks.  The apartment is on the ground floor of a large apartment building full of families. There was quite a bit of street noise at night, so if you're a light sleeper you might want to steer clear. The furnishings were on the basic side but we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay (including a baby cot - thanks!), and with Berlin at our doorstep we didn't spend much time there anyway! Thanks again Alla!
We had a good stay. A beautiful apartment well decorated and very tidy. Book with confidence

Wir waren in der heißesten Woche des Jahres in Berlin und haben bei den 5 Stockwerken geschwitzt. Aber: es lohnt sich. Die Wohnung ist toll und hell und hat einen fantastischen Ausblick. Sie ist super eingerichtet Alles da, nichts zuviel. Wir kommen wieder.
Man geht raus und ist gleich im Leben. Durch den Innenhof ist die Wohnung ruhig und auch bei offenen Fenstern konnten wir gut schlafen.
Dankeschön!!

Wonderful apartment - whisper quiet. Perfect for one person or a couple. Great kitchen, small stovetop espresso, strong hot shower, can’t fault it - a perfect place to stay in Berlin, especially if you like being somewhere central and walkable, yet quiet. Karsten super responsive too.

Un buen lugar para quedarse, tenía acceso a mucho transporte y fácil de llegar, a pesar que para acceder a las habitaciones había que subir una escalera, esta no era compleja y tenía mucha facilidad de acceso.
Por otro lado, a pesar de estar rodeada de locales, en la noche se sentían muchos ruidos, al cerrar las ventanas, este se reducía, pero el aumentaba el calor dentro de la habitación.
A comfortable place to stay. Clean and pleasant. Thanks!
Great place to stay in Berlin- it is as described in listing and in a perfect location for exploring the city!

Sehr professionelle Abwicklung, schnelle Kommunikation, alle Angaben wie versprochen. Große Individualität in der Einrichtung/Ambiente darf man nicht erwarten, aber die Ausstattung ist verblüffend hochwertig und geschmackvoll. Die Lage der Wohnung ist praktisch für Ausflüge nach Ost und West, Anbindung an den ÖPNV gut. Der Preis während meines Aufenthalts eher an der Obergrenze, aber dennoch vertretbar.

L'appartement de Michael est dans un quartier vivant avec bars non loin et toutes les commodités. Super quartier entre Neukolh et Kreusberg. On a beaucoup aimé vivre là! La chambre est spacieuse et le lit super  bon. Très bonne communication avec Michael que nous n'avons pas eu le plaisirde rencontrer mais super arrangeant et précis. Je recommande!
Sauber, ruhig und eine sehr freundliche Vermieterin. Diese Unterkunft kann ich bedenkenlos weiterempfehlen!  Wir kommen gerne bald wieder! :-)

Katja und Bernd sind sehr nette Gastgeber. Leider hatten wir nach dem Check-in einen positiven Covidtest und mussten wieder abreisen. Kulanterweise haben uns die beiden einen Teil erstattet.
In der Wohnung ist alles zum Kochen und es gibt viele Tipps von den beiden. Schade, dass wir den Aufenthalt nicht entsprechend genießen konnten. Wir würden die Unterkunft auf jeden Fall nochmal buchen.

We had such an amazing stay at Michael's place and if we could give it 6 stars we would. The neighbourhood is super quiet, so we slept like babies. But it's very near public transport. The appartment is so spacious and Michael is very generous with all his things. The kitchen is super equipped and there is a big welcome bowl on the kitchen table with some essentials (including some bottles of wine). There are bakeries, supermarkets and great little restaurants around the corner in Leberstrasse. We particularly liked Nosh Deli. Michael has an informative manual and we also tried the coffee shops he had suggested. All great. Would definitely stay here again if ever in Berlin again. Thanks Michael, hope to see you in Australia one day.
Nur zu empfehlen!

Great room with storage, private bathroom super clean
Common parts are great too
Nice hostel and nice staff, would recommend
Alles prima!

We stayed at Camilla's apartment for four days in April. Camilla was a good host and communication was excellent before and during our stay. The apartment was ideal; very spacious, clean and comfortable, with many personal touches.  It is in an excellent location on a quiet street in a great neighbourhood but with many independent coffee shops and small restaurants within easy walking distance. It also has metro close by if needed with great transport links for anywhere in the city. It is our third time staying in this part of Berlin and we would happily return to this area and this apartment. Many thanks.

Martin was great, and he provided a lot of things that other hosts have not, such as, coffee and tea, milk, water bottles, shampoo, and conditioner. The flat was absolutely amazing! Very clean and spacious. There were three beds, two single and one double. It was perfect for us and we absolutely loved staying there. Martin is really great as well and was very helpful during our stay. The flat is in a nice location, only a 5 min walk from Potsdammer Platz and the Mall of Berlin.

This apartment has a stunning location, with a leafy view onto a very cute park in one of the most pleasant parts of Kreuzberg, a short walk from Hasenheide to the south and the canal to the north. The living room is bright and airy, and I spent many mornings and afternoons sitting at the table on the balcony drinking a coffee or a beer and taking in the neighborhood scene. The kitchen had everything I needed for a long stay. This is a fantastic spot to be based during a stay in Berlin.
We had a great stay here. The flat is really well equipped and in a great location. I would recommend it to anyone looking for somewhere to stay in Berlin.
Wir waren voll und ganz zufrieden:)

Helena est une personne très aimable et attentionnée qui n'hésite pas à rendre service. Le logement se trouve dans un quartier résidentiel, calme et près d'un petit lac. C'est très joli, très soigné, décoré avec beaucoup de goût. Idéal pour se rendre à City cube (à pied 25'). La station Grunewald n'est qu'à une dizaine de minutes à pied.

A wonderfully designed cozy apartment!
We had a blast and felt right at home. The place was clean and beautiful, and full of personality!
While not in the most central location in the city, the apartment is right next to a big U-Bahn station, making the whole city easily accessible. Additionally, there are many great shops and nice restaurants in the area! Best of all is being 5 min walk away from Tempelhof park, which is quiet and beautiful.
Mark was a great host, incredibly patient, and always available for every question we had.
Highly recommended for any young visitor to Berlin that wants to experience some of the local life over the main tourist attractions!
Nicely refurbished and spacious apartment in good location if you're up to explore Berlin. Communication with Martin was excellent. I would gladly visit again!
great location, helpful host, would stay here again

Julias Wohnung liegt mitten in Prenzlauer Berg umgeben von süßen Cafés und Restaurants. Genauso schön wie du Umgebung war auch die Wohnung.
Ich war habe hier vier Wochen gelebt und würde es jeder Zeit wieder tun.
Die Kommunikation mit Julia war auch immer proactive und sehr freundlich.

The kitchen is great: stylish and well stocked. There is plenty of herbal tea and coffee.

This is a residential area, half established Turkish half international youngsters and German couples in their 30s. We are in our 50s and 60s - a writer and photographer - so old enough to be the parents of the hipsters. But honestly we fitted in. We loved it.
Cafe Jacques is 200 metres down the street and was a highlight of our trip. Terrific food, great music, wonderful service. About 50 euros for two for dinner.
Opposite Cafe Jacques a pop up bar with no name but a terrific proprietor who was once a journalist and lovely bar staff on the corner of Maybachufer and Schinkestrasse.
Go and enjoy. It’s wonderful.

Gepflegtes Hotel im berliner Stil. Freundliche und gute Abwicklung. Gehobene Klientel. Sehr gute, zentrale Lage. Ruhiges Zimmer zum Innenhof.

Jan's place was very comfortable, with laundry, two spacious rooms for beds, a kitchen good for cooking, higher ceilings, a large desk with an extra screen for working, a little balcony. Excelente ubicación, un precio accesible, y proporciona descanso y seguridad

Albert is a gracious host who went out of his way to welcome us and provided a nice assortment of kitchen essentials, coffee, tea, milk, snacks, etc. He spent a generous amount of time with us describing favorite restaurants, food shops, etc. He even helped us drag suitcases up the stairs. He deserves his reputation as a “superhost.”
His building is undergoing extensive exterior remodeling - but he had warned us about that, and the workers did not work over the weekend, so it really did not impact us much at all.
The bedroom has nice, quiet air conditioning. Who would have thought that that would be welcomed in early June in Berlin? - but we saw some atypically hot weather, and the AC improved sleeping conditions.

We loved our week-long stay at Erez’s apartment. It’s super close to a bus station and to Boxi and other happening areas of East Berlin. As Erez stayed at his studio, we had all the privacy at the apartment tastefully styled by the host.
L'appartement est mieux qu'en photo.

Die Kommunikation lief lösungsorientiert und nett.Der Zimmer war modern und sauber.
Es war sehr zentral für Friedrichshain.

Der Aufenthalt in der Wohnung von Michel&Anne war klasse, unkompliziert und familienfreundlich. Ruhig und zentral, allerhand Restaurants in der Nähe, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Straßenbahn. Die Wohnung ist sehr gut ausgestattet und sauber.
Super Lage, gerne wieder!

Dorethe was extremely nice and accommodating, she gave us the key at the time we asked, left us some nice chocolate and wine in the apartment and it was a smooth transition all the way. The apartment is really great - comfortable, clean, with very good facilities, in a very nice area and close to the underground. I definitely recommend staying there.

The apartment is big & kitchen had everything we needed & more. The bus station is 3min walk, supermarket 1min & neighborhood is nice & quite. All & all, we managed but had problems. There was no toilet paper & when we asked we received one roll. There was a good washing machine but no place to hand the laundry to dry.
Sehr netter Host und super Unterkunft! Ich hatte zuerst den Zugang nicht gefunden aber Markus hat mir sofort geholfen. Ich hatte die Hinweisnachrichten nicht gesehen. ;-) Danke!

Joseph’s place is awesome. The bathroom is huge, the bed is comfy, and the natural light is inviting. Also, we had an issue upon arrival where we weren’t sure exactly which apartment was Joseph’s but he answered our questions to him immediately.

Der Aufenthalt bei Sophia hat uns sehr gut gefallen! Die Wohnung ist genauso wie beschrieben und in einer super Lage. In der Nähe gibt es viele Restaurants und Cafés. Wir haben uns hier wohl gefühlt und hatten eine schöne Zeit! 😊
Super schöne kleine Wohnung mit allem was es braucht, ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt.

Evelyn ist eine super Gastgeberin!

Susanne es una excelente anfitriona, muy considerada y amable. Su casa es súper cómoda, limpia y linda, además de estar bien ubicada. Recomiendo esta opción de hospedaje sin dudarlo!

Sehr gemütliche Wohnung, mitten in Kreuzberg, alles gut zu Erreichen.

Great address!

Exactly as described! Clean, comfortable, and convenient! Highly recommend!
Kinga and Stahu are great hosts and I would most definately stay at their place again!

Henrik was a wonderful host and his apartment was perfect for our needs! It's in a great location! I had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend it!

Uns hat die Wohnung sehr gut gefallen. Unsere Kinder , 9 und 11 Jahre, haben sofort die Zwischenebene mit Doppelbett zu ihrem "Königreich" erklärt. Für Kleinkinder wäre das allerdings nichts, da die Treppe sehr steil ist.

Die Kommunikation mit Simone hat sehr gut geklappt. Sie hat immer zügig geantwortet, uns sehr nett empfangen und mit vielen nützlichen Informationen versorgt.
convenient stay, easy check in and smart tv connectivity was a bonus!

Fai's place was very nice - it provided ample space for our family of four and it was an ideal location for us: it was quiet, but nice restaurants in walking distance and public transport to the centre as well as other locations was very convenient.
Fai was very welcoming, quick in answering any questions and everything worked out well with the key etc. Her written descriptions and recommendations were very good and accurate.

Nous avons passé une belle semaine dans ce logement calme et bien équipé. Nous avons apprécié la qualité de l’accueil et la proximité des transports en commun ainsi que l’espace cuisine, le balcon et le petit salon. Un pied-à-terre idéal pour un séjour de découverte à Berlin.
Great place centrally located perfect for 3/4 people.

L'appartamento è ben collocato, al quarto piano di un edificio nuovo con ascensore; in posizione moderatamente collinare, con vista dominante, da nord verso la Museumsinsel. Grande vetrata e balconcino che si affacciano su un giardino sottostante: la vista rimane così aperta sullo skyline di Berlino. L'appartamento è silenzioso, ben organizzato, fornito degli strumenti necessari a un c modo soggiorno. Gentilezza e disponibilità del proprietario che ci ha accolto personalmente. I messi di trasporto sono proprio sotto casa: Straßenbahn a due minuti, U-Bahn a cinque minuti a piedi. Grande supermercato a cinque minuti. Non manca niente per un bel soggiorno a Berlino.

Wir waren nur für eine Nacht bei Ben. Sowohl der Check-In als auch der Check-Out waren super unkompliziert, da Ben sehr flexibel war und uns zeitlich sehr entgegen gekommen ist.  In der Unterkunft haben wir uns auch direkt wohl gefühlt, da Ben super freundlich war. Das Zimmer und die Unterkunft waren genau wie angegeben. Am Morgen hat Ben uns sogar ein kleines Frühstück zubereitet und es gab frischen Kaffee. Zusammenfassend also keine Kritikpunkte und ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt :)
merkezi bi konumda, 1-2 gece konaklama için uygun. Odalar oldukça küçük.

Elisabeth ist sehr nett.
Es ist eine herrliche Berliner Altbauwohnung. So wie man sich das idealerweise vorstellt. Mitten im Kreuzberger Geschehen. Die Wohnung ist sehr liebevoll eingerichtet. Sie hat tolle große Fenster und große Türen. Es ist alles da, was man braucht.
Abends kann man den Balkon zur Straße nutzen, um noch was von der Kreuzberger Atmosphäre mit zu bekommen.
Kreuzberg lebt bei Tag und Nacht.
Zum Frühstücken, Essen gehen, einkaufen, Kiez-Atmosphäre schnuppern geht man einfach auf die Straße ein paar Häuser weiter. Es ist ein Erlebnis die Menschen auf der Straße zu beobachten.
Alles ist fussläufig erreichbar. Auch die U-Bahn.
Der Park vorm Haus bringt Abends ein bisschen Action mit sich, was hin und wieder für einen etwas gehobenen Geräuschpegel führt. Eben mittendrin statt nur dabei :)
Wir fanden es gut und würden sehr gerne wiederkommen.

Super appart, bien placé à proximité du métro, de restaurants et d’une supérette. Très pratique pour visiter les quartiers alentours. Nous avons été très bien accueillis, tout est fonctionnel dans l’appartement. C’était super ! Je conseil !

Wir hatten eine großartige Zeit in Berlin - und das nicht zuletzt Dank der tollen Unterkunft! Perfekte Lage, super Ausstattung, tipptopp sauber und alles in allem einfach wahnsinnig durchdacht und komfortabel. Ich hatte mit Elektra sehr nette Gespräche.

Dirk è stato gentile e disponibile. L'appartamento come da descrizione, pulito, bello e fornito di tutto il necessario. Comodissimo per spostarsi con i mezzi per visitare Berlino, vicino a supermercato, bar e ristoranti. Super consigliato!
Alles super! Gute Lage, sehr schöne und liebevoll eingerichtete Loft-Wohnung, gute Kommunikation mit Gastgeberin. Sehr empfehlenswert! Gerne wieder!
Quartier sympa. Bon accueil. Belle grande salle de bain. Joli chambre en dernier étage (4eme sans ascenseur) donnant sur une cour intérieure tranquille. Nous avons apprécié notre séjour chez Birte

The studio is exactly as described in the listing and as seen in the photos. It was clean when we arrived. The area is quiet at night. We did not see Katrin. As advertised, we arrived and left independently. This was convenient. Katrin messaged us to make sure everything was okay.

Martin is by far one of the best hosts I’ve ever had, and if you’re going to Berlin I could not recommend this spot more. Perfectly located. Great surroundings. And a great way to experience Berlin like a local. 100/100 stay.

Had a great time— this place is very centrally located and it’s easy to visit main attractions. There is construction going on, which could be a problem for others but we were up and out by the time they started.
A really nice apartment, in a nice area. We were the as a family of four, and had a really great time. The apartment was clean,  and we felt right at home.

Wir wurden pünktlich auf die Minute von einer freundlichen Mitarbeiterin empfangen, die uns die Wohnung zeigte. Im zweiten Hinterhaus eines alten Berliner Hauses liegt eine liebevoll renovierte, schicke Wohnung, in der man sich ausgesprochen wohl fühlen kann und in der es an nichts fehlt. In der näheren Umgebung gibt es viele hübsche Geschäfte und nette Lokale. Die Verkehrsanbindung ist ideal, um Berlin zu erkunden. In wenigen Minuten erreicht man die U-Bahn und ist schnell in der Stadtmitte. Die Kommunikation mit unserm Gastgeber hat ausgezeichnet geklappt, wir waren insgesamt sehr zufrieden und können die Wohnung nur weiter empfehlen.
Reallly nice apartment in peacefull neighbourhood, U-bahn station within few hundred meters. Great few days in Berlin, warmly recommended place to stay.

A wonderful apartment, very tastefully decorated, antique and modern combined, and beautiful high ceilings . The area is perfect too, public transport, rental bikes, supermarkets and restaurants/bars nearby. Contact with Dietrich was easy and fast, we were able to collect our key easily through a key safe. Dietrich texted us on arrival to see if we needed anything. All in all a great stay, and someplace we would like to return to when visiting Berlin again.
Beau séjour, espace dd vie agréable, quartier vivant
lieu d'hebergement parfait. trés propre et quasi neuf. vaste et paisible.

Wir haben uns total wohl gefühlt bei Kay und Anne. Man fühlt sich fast, als würde man mit der Familie wohnen, ist aber in der kleinen Dachgeschosswohnung ganz für sich. Das Haus, der Hof, die Lage, die Wohnung sind zauberhaft! Hier lebt noch ein kleines Stück altes Berlin, noch nicht tot-saniert, noch lebendig und menschlich. Die Lage seitlich der Karl-Marx-Straße ist super, man ist sofort im lebendigen Kiez, hat aber in der kleinen Wohnung seine ruhige Oase. Die Wohnung selbst ist liebevoll gestaltet. Für uns war es das perfekte Setting, wie wären gerne noch viiiiiiiel länger geblieben. Besonders dieser Mix aus dem wuseligen Teil Neuköllns und dieser kleinen Idylle bei Kay und Anne war besonders schön. Kay und Anne sind mega nett und immer für Fragen erreichbar. Ich hoffe, wir können bald wieder kommen!!! Danke für die schöne Zeit & liebe Grüße!!!!!

Très bon séjour chez Mia !
Cocon décoré avec goût et très bien équipé, bien chauffé.

I have seen hundreds of guest houses and can say that this is a real gem. Its personal, well-located, clean, renovated, overall value for the money and most importantly, super-friendly place to stay (for non-party people), thanks to Anne.

Top hosting. We had a very nice stay and Frank is very kind.
Ótimo lugar, perto dos pontos turísticos. O apartamento é super confortável e quente.

Nuestra estancia con Ugur estuvo increíble, de lejos ha sido el mejor air bnb en el que hemos estado. El es una excelente persona y un gran ser humano. Estuvo pendiente de nosotros todo el tiempo y nos dió recomendaciones de que visitar y como movernos. Muy buena experiencia lo recomiendo al 100%
The place was nice and spacious and in a great location, jan was also very attentive and easy to communicate with.

Ottima posizione, casa spaziosa e accessoriata. Proprietari disponibili  e cordiali unico problema la lingua in quanto parlano spagnolo ma per noi italiani è stato abbastanza facile farci comprendere.

Heinrich's place is stylish, clean and in a great location! The neighbourhood is buzzing by day, but quiet late at night, so no unwanted noise.

Danke und tschüss!

My stay was very pleasant, Daniele is very friendly and his apartment is well located and close to public transport.

Beautiful, big apartment, high ceilings and with U-bahn and tram just two blocks away. Easy to get there from airport or train station. Hannes had very good recommendations of small cafes and bars in this really nice and convenient neighborhood. The balcony is really lovely and quiet, and a rare find. Grocery around the corner. Also there is both a shower and bathtub, which is nice!
The apartment was lovely, the area was really nice. Felt very cosy and safe. Is quite far from the city centre but transport is great in the area!
Great place! Andi was very nice too

Die Wohnung, Gestalltung und Umgebung an der Frankfurter Allee 25 haben uns sehr gut gefallen. Tatsächlich sieht Alles gleich oder besser aus , als es in der Anzeige geschrieben wurde. Wir bewerten diese Wohnung als die richtige Auswahl.
The stay was everything we wanted. Great area and easy to get around. Lots of great restaurants and night life. So many recommendations which we loved. Thank you for having us.

just absolutely beautiful, charming, and cozy. Both hosts were so friendly and kind - I felt so extremely safe as a solo traveler. Yet so private and quiet. The area is the best area in Berlin in my opinion. After seeing it all I wouldn't have chosen another place!
Christine is lovely. Friendly and easy to talk with.

Sehr gut gelegene Wohnung. Sehr sauber, gut zu Fuß vom Hauptbahnhof zu erreichen. Es war sauber und ordentlich. Genügend Platz.

We especially loved the vibrant area and the many restaurants and playgardens in close distance. We would definitely recommend this place for a trip to Berlin (with or without children).

Eine sehr schöne, gemütliche Wohnung, in der ich mich sofort sehr wohl gefühlt habe. Unglaublich ruhig und mit einem romantischen Innenhof . Berlin mal von einer entspannten Seite. U Bahn um die Ecke, ebenso Lokale und kleine Läden. Ich wurde nett empfangen, alles hat problemlos geklappt und ich würde in dieser Wohnung  mit Charakter jederzeit gern wieder wohnen. Sylvia
Enjoyed this central stay, close to metro and had everything I needed
Really kind and understanding host, with a focus on problem solving, even when I had to cut my trip short.  All in all I really liked it there.

Lovely and warm and cosy for our January stay, well equipped and so close to many points of interest including the railway station.
Very spacious with generously proportioned rooms.

Not the best choice I'm afraid, especially if you're with more than three. The space is very limited, the kitchen is run-down. At least one of the four table chairs is unusable, since it's dangerous to sit on. The bedding is cheap/low quality and therefor not very comfortable. The appartment is only used for Airbnb and similar activities it seems, no one lives there permanently.
What we did like:

-shower with plenty of hot water pressure
-host met us when we arrived (no wait time) and reacted quickly to issue with window
great stay in peaceful surroundings, easy to access by s bahn and bus even late in to the night. great hosts, all amenities as listed, would definitely return.

I stayed there for four days and had no single problem. Whenever I needed him or asked him to help me, He helped me very kindly with exactly what I was looking for. When I was in the room, I felt that he was trying his best not to disturb me. Because of his efforts, I had a very cozy stay in his room.
Logement identique au descriptif, bon emplacement pour visiter Berlin , propre , le minimum pour cuisiner ! Parfait à deux pour passer quelques jours dans cette belle ville .
Good place to stay

Markus was away on holidays for most of my stay, but he was there to show me around the house when I arrived and we had a good chat for a while too. The room has a lot of a space and a balcony, plus it's a great location close to a number of restaurants and bars. Would stay again!
comfortable bed. suited us for our needs and appreciated the washer. he was very kind and prompt to communicate with. you could tell he wanted us to have a good stay.
Great stay, house is excellent. We loved the vibe and the decorations and cleanliness.

I liked that we were in a residential neighborhood, it made it feel like we were getting the true Berlin experience.
Nice if you want to be away from the touristy spots.
would recommend this place to a group just wanting to have a place to sleep and store luggage.
This apartment is right next door to a bar so it can get a bit noisy.
WiFi is very slow, which we only needed for looking up landmarks and making reservations so we had to use our own.
Very good vegan and sushi restaurant right across the street.

We enjoyed our stay in this beautiful and spacious apmt and I'd recommend it! Very tasteful interior, good heating, well connected to public transport, very friendly and reliable communication, very clean, quiet.
The only thing I wanna mention is the tap water: it tasted a bit funny and when I took a bath I saw why - it has a green-yellowish colour, so we didn't drink it anymore. Maybe the house has old pipes...

The apartment was brilliantly located and convenient yet in a quiet area. 5 minutes walk to the Kaisen-Augusta U-Baun stop, with a direct line to Brandenburg gate, Checkpoint Charlie… we also found that Bus M45 took us straight to the zoo (about 25 mins). Wi-Fi was a little unpredictable, but owners were very quick to sort.
The stay was very nice. There is a lot of cool people in rhe neigbourhood!
Comfortable, clean, safe, central. I would stay again.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön, wir hatten eine gute Zeit. Evelyn ist jeder Zeit erreichbar und sorgt sich, dass wir die beste Erfahrung bei ihr haben.

Comfortable apartment and very well situated. The reception was excellent, Rainer is a great guy.

Mooi, zeer ruim appartement met vintage inrichting. Bijzondere vintage items op een smaakvolle manier geplaatst.

Loved my stay at Neo's place in Berlin! Great location, very nice apartment on the fourth floor with everything you'd need to feel at home for a week or more.
Great stay, really nice.

Het was een mooi en ruim appartement in een zeer rustige straat en toch dichtbij restaurants, U en S-bahn, het Mauerpark enz... We hebben ook genoten van het terras met uitzicht op Prenzlauerberg. Luca was een zeer vriendelijke en communicatieve host. Topappartement op toplocatie!
apartamento genial, ubicaciones estupenda, es súper acogedor y la comunicación con Alex fue súper fluida! repetiría

I even stayed in the room quite long time rather than travel Berlin haha. Totally fell in love. Arne helped us to carry up our luggage, my check-in time was at night though, he gave many tips.
