A fantastic place and a lovely host. Would absolutely recommend and stay again. The rooftop is incredible!

Beautiful traditional Berlin apartment, accessed via the communal courtyard. Apartment was well stocked and beautifully clean. Easy walking distance to two UBahn stations and lovely restaurants just around the corner. I’d probably wait until our babies are a bit older to stay here again but we would definitely come back.

Heerlijk appartement in Prenzlauer Berg! Schoon, ruim genoeg en leuk ingericht. Alle voorzieningen zijn aanwezig en zelfs een bankje voor het huis waar je koffie kan drinken in de zon. Ook de twee fietsen die je mag gebruiken zijn top, je voelt je al snel echt thuis in Berlijn.
Clean and well equipped. Friendly staff. In a very convenient location.

René's Unterkunft hat einen eigenen Charme, ist gut gestaltet. Es ist urig und die offene Wand hat schon eine Wirkung. Auch die Bilder passen toll. Die Lage ist für Berlin schon gut, maximal 10min zu den Öffis, weitere 10min in die City. Es gibt auch ein paar Bars und Lokale in der Nähe.
Entsprach dem Preis-Leistungsverhältnis. Louis war nett und reagiert schnell auf Nachrichten.

Ellen's Wohnung ist sehr schön, sauber, gut ausgestattet und liegt in einer sehr zentralen aber gleichzeitig ruhigen Lage Berlins. Die Kommunikation mit Ellen und dem Team war vor und während des Aufenthalts hervorragend! Vielen lieben Dank für alles!

Karsten was welcoming and we very much enjoyed our stay in a thoroughly clean, stylish and central apartment. The bed is extremely comfortable, the shower a brilliant pressure. The price is affordable, too. I will definitely return for other stays in Berlin.

Martina's place is right at the heart of Kreuzberg. Is a spacious apartment and has a nice vibe in it. Martina is such a welcoming person.i had wonderful time. We enjoyed our time in vibrant and vivid kreuzberg. thank you!

Super toffe plek voor een weekend Berlijn. Dichtbij het hart van Prenzlauer Berg wat vol zit met hippe concept stores en restaurants. Supermarkt op 100m en ook een fietsverhuur. Met de fiets ben je binnen 10 min in het “toeristische deel”.
wir waren sehr zufrieden, es war alles super sauber und die Lage war perfekt!

Leuk appartement dat dichtbij openbaar vervoer voorzieningen ligt. Bij het appartement zijn 2 fietsen beschikbaar gesteld, daarmee hebben we Berlijn op een leuke en makkelijke manier kunnen ontdekken.
Sehr freundlicher Gastgeber. Kann weiterempfehlen

위치는 관광지 대부분이 모여있는 미테(Mitte) 지역에서 다소 떨어져 있지만, 차로는 20분 이내로 접근 가능하고 대중교통도 이용은 하지 않았지만 도보로 가까운 거리에 있음.
방이 4인 가족이 머물 수 있게 충분한 크기는 아니지만, 그래도 깨끗하고 같은 건물에 (유료이지만) 세탁기와 건조기가 있고 무엇보다 수건, 세제 등 많은 생활 도구들이 넉넉하게 구비되어 있어 매우 편했음.
자체 주차장이 없는 게 아쉽지만, 도보로 5분 이내 유료 주차장 (1일 24유로)이 있어 안전하게 주차할 수 있었음.

Simple but spacious apartment, with a little garden at a perfect location in Berlin. Duc Son is a very friendly and flexible host who lives in the same building. You can also rent bikes at the location, which I highly recommend as *the* method of transport in Berlin.

Muy sencillo, bien comunicado por transporte, algo lejos del centro. Alrededor tiene locales para comer y cenar, no hay supermercados cerca pero bueno.  Tienen un perrito que ha parecido que ni estuviera, menos por los pelos, todo el suelo estaba completamente lleno de pelos por toda la casa. Es lo único malo que diría. El resto bien, alomejor un ventilador en la habitación iría fenomenal.
It was a great stay in the appartement which was big, airy, cosy and well situated. In the street there are dozens of bars and restaurants.  And a lot of shops nearby.

Apartment in great location, close to several stations so easy to get around the city. Apartment was very clean, easy to find and I didn’t hear noise from other guests or the street. Nena apartments were really responsive on message and helpful when I informed them of my later check in due a delayed flight. Would recommend!

Unkomplizierter Check-in und ein schönes und sehr sauberes Zimmer. Auch im Sommer sehr angenehm durch die Klimaanlage. Verkehrsmittel sind fußläufig erreichbar, die Umgebung ist jedoch nicht so schön.

First of all Martin is super nice, funny and cool. The apartment is literally 5 minute walk from Potsdamer Platz. Walking distance from every attraction Berlin has to offer. The apartment is was clean, with milk, coffee, tea, some water, and 4 different types of soap to shower. Martin even came out of his way to the apartment when we had trouble locking the door (which was confusing at first). I would differently stay in Martin’s apartment again.
Very comfortable appartment in a safe, quiet and touristic area, a little far from the closest metro station.
Ev gerçekten çok rahat ve güzeldi.Her şey sorunsuz geçti.
Good Communication, great location, super cozy and nicely decorated, very clean! We had a great time and would for sure come by again :).
everything is super

De var ikke klar med værelserne da vi ankom, og havde ikke et tispunkt på hvornår de var klar. Så da sidste udmelding lød tidligst kl. 22.00 fandt vi et nyt hotel, så vi kunne komme igang med vores relativt korte storby tur.
Die Unterkunft war echt super. Sabine ist super freundlich und Absprachen waren alle sehr schnell. Die Unterkunft ist sehr sauber und sehr gut ausgestattet mit allem was man so brauchen könnte.
Perfect, thank you!

Eine wunderschöne, edle, saubere Wohnung in der man sich bei Ankunft gleich wie Zuhause fühlt und die mit der tollen zentralen Lage drum herum überzeugt. Supermarkt, Cafés, Restaurants alles in nächster Laufnähe.
Mit der U-Bahnlinie U2 in Wohnungsnähe ist man auch sehr schnell mit den öffentlichen Unterwegs und man ist innerhalb von 10 Minuten am ZOB Busbahnhof. .
Der Checkin lief freundlich Reibungslos und es konnte vorab der Kofferservice bei früherer Anreise genutzt werden.
Für kurze aber auch für längere Aufenthalte wirklich zu empfehlen.

I've been staying here already before and the experience made me come back! Staying at Jay's is my first choice when coming to Berlin. Thanks again - Had a great time and already look forward to another stay.
Der Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm; die Unterkunft sehr schön und auch praktisch gelegen; die Kommunkation mit Karen sehr unkompliziert und zuvorkommend. Komme sehr gerne wieder. Herzlichen Dank!

Très bon séjour chez Paul. L’appartement est très clean, le lit est très confortable. Nous avons pu utiliser la cuisine.  Il est idéalement situé et tres bien desservi. Paul est un hôte très amical et arrangeant pour les départs et arrivées. Je recommande fortement !
Great stay, they were considerate and flexible. Enjoyed our stay, close to the rail line so was easy to get around.

Very well located near the u bahn, and nice space for a great stay! We loved the proximity to restaurants ( the chungking noodle and ramen bar next door were excellent). Recommend for a fun stay in Berlin! Phillip and Caroline gave a lot of recommendations too which were appreciated
Ich würde definitiv wieder kommen
Alles tiptop!

We stayed for 5 nights and had a fantastic time! (It was just my husband and I).
What we loved the most:
- location! in the heart of Friedrichshain close to a ton of restaurants (vegan heaven by the way)
- modern, clean, spacious apartment
- the shower is amazing! Hot and strong water pressure
- ground floor apartment which stays nice and cool during hot summers
- big closet to hang and organize your clothes
- really big kitchen table that comfortably fits 6+ people
- organic grocery store right across the street (Denns Bio Markt)
Only thing I was missing personally was a Microwave to heat up leftovers and coffee, but that's really not a big deal if you look at how beautiful and amazing this place is!
We consider booking this place again in the future! :)

We loved our stay here! Everything was exactly as described and SUPER clean! Very comfy beds with everything you would need for a quiet weekend in Berlin :) Close to the tram stop too which was really helpful! I would come back for sure!
Stefan is an amazing host! So many local tips and even a bike! Nice touch. Will return on my next trip to Berlin! Thank you so much for everything and the super comfy bed!
Harika bir ev sahipliği için çok teşekkür ediyoruz. Keyifli bir deneyim oldu. Muhit çok iyiydi. Her yere yakındı.

Ich war während der IFA einige Tage in der Wohnung. Oli war sehr freundlich, zuvorkommend und zu jeder Tageszeit telefonisch erreichbar. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und hatte alles was es für einen geschäftlichen Aufenthalt braucht. Er hatte mir sogar Wasser und Schokolade in den Kühlschrank gestellt :) Vielen Dank Oli für den tollen Aufenthalt.
周辺観光地へのアクセスがしやすいロケーションで、アパートもとても静かで過ごしやすかったです！ベッドルームの電球が切れかかっていましたが、特に問題なく過ごせました。ベルリンに来たらまたこちらに泊まりたいです！どうもありがとうございました☻
El hostel es muy lindo, tal como se ve en más fotos. La ubicación es buena, muy cerca de Alexander platz. Muy limpio y el desayuno por 5 euros completo y rico
Serkan is a great host! The place is small but cozy and with everything you need. Serkan will make sure you have a good stay
Highly recommended! We liked this accommodation very much. The hosts were friendly. Everything was clean and nicely prepared for our arrival.

Im Großen und Ganzen okay für ein paar Tage. Wegen der Fotos hatten wir es uns schöner vorgestellt. Das Landgut ist sehr alt und die beiden versuchen es auch liebevoll einzurichten, aber nur auf den ersten Blick. Als wir ankamen haben wir erst einmal das Geschirr gespült weil die ersten beiden Tassen die wir aus dem Schrank nahmen klebten. Der Spüllappen und der Schwamm hatten auch schon bessere Zeiten gesehen. Die Besteckkästen waren schmuddelig und klebrig.
Bei unserem Aufenthalt war es recht kühl. (10 Grad Außentemperatur) und wir hatten zwei kleine Kinder dabei. Wollte man es warm im Bad haben musste man vorher den Ofen anschüren. Dieser beheizt die Wohnküche und das Bad. Mit nassem Holz geht das aber nicht so gut. Und wenn man von einem Ausflug nach Hause kommt und in einem kalten Bad duschen soll ist das nicht angenehm. Außerdem gab es im Bad an den Waschbecken nur eiskaltes Wasser.
Schwarze Spinnweben beweisen, dass die letze Grundreinigung schon etwas länger her ist.
Appartement parfait, spacieux et propre avec tout le confort nécessaire. Emplacement idéal, on reviendra !!

Logement est très spacieux dans très un très bel environnement, on oublierait presque qu'on est en ville. Nous avons particulièrement apprécié de pouvoir garer notre van dans la propriété et la proximité avec les transports en commun et les commerces.
Le logement est décoré avec goût avec tout le nécessaire. Rafael a été un hôte génial, extrêmement gentil et serviable. Nous ne pouvons que vous conseiller de séjourner là-bas !
Alles perfekt belaufen inkl. EM Sieg gegen Polen. Wir kommen bestimmt wieder.
easy to find, nice, clean
Everything was perfect, and clean.
Sehr sehr schön und Sauber Gerne Wieder
Nice place and good location, would stay here again!
Sabine est une hôte très accueillante et sympathique. Le logement est très calme et bien situé.
Schöne und gepflegte Wohnung im Erdgeschoss, welche gut ausgestattet ist und sehr zentral Mitte in Berlin liegt.

This was the worst hostel I stayed in.
In the private room what I rented, the carpet was extremely messy on the floor.
The bathroom is the dirtiest thing I've ever seen in my life.
I had a nicer bathroom in the army.
This accommodations should be banned.
Entering a hostel is like entering a labyrinth.
The main way out of the hostel is through the pub.
Only thing worth in this hostel is the metro line in front of the building.
The guy who works at the bar of the pub was so rude that he threatened me that next time I have to say "sugar please" instead with "sugar" as I said, because he didn't bring it with my coffee.
I strongly do not recommend this “hostel” to anyone
My stay at Klaus' place was a delight! Everything was clean, super easy to check in, and a really lovely place in a delightful part of Berlin

Fabian‘s apartment is situated very close to public transportation. The apartment is exactly as described in the pictures, very clean and spacious. Fabian was very responsive to all questions: check in and out was simple with no complications. Will highly recommend his apartment!
Sehr schöne Unterkunft, sehr gut gelegen. Würde jederzeit wiederkommen.
The apartment waa really spacious and cozy, and the location is great. We had great walks and found awsome spots nearby.

Der Aufenthalt bei Simon war für uns eine Freude. Was man bitte besser kommunizieren könnte, gratis Parkgelegenheiten sind praktisch ohne Anwohnerpass nicht vorhanden. Aber das ist Politisch gewollt wie in Wien auch. Fenster gehen auf die belebte Potsdamer Straße und das lieblingsgeräusch der Überaus freundlichen Berliner dürfte die Sirene sein. Und bitte bei einer Übernahme die Armaturen und Abläufe nachkontrollieren. Ansonsten werden wir sicher wieder bei Simon einziehen und auch das Quartier weiterempfehlen. Danke
Enjoyed my short stay. Everything I needed.
Stéphanie’s place is amazing -- great location (seriously fantastic), stylish apartment, really fast communication. If you're thinking about staying here, do yourself a favor and just book!
Clean and conveniently located very close to a subway station. The apartment has all you may need, even for longer stays. Jürgen was a great host and I would thouroughly recommend his apartment.

Exactly as pictured, amazing location - quick 5 minute walk to the UBahn which takes you all over the city! Great Turkish markets & restaurants in the area. As mentioned in other reviews there are lots of stairs so be prepared for a work-out! Wouldn’t recommend if you are travelling with lots of luggage. Kitchen was well equipped to make a quick breakfast/snack/coffee. Had a bit of trouble with the wifi first day but Rainer was quick to respond and fix it. We also found that the hot water was very limited especially after the morning. Overall a good stay in Berlin!
Anna war sehr freundlich gegenüber uns und ihr Airbnb war sehr gemütlich.
klein aber fein. Ein kleines schnuckliges Quartier in dem wir uns sehr wohl gefühlt haben. Die Lage war super ruhig. Anita war eine richtig gute Vermieterin. ... gern wieder.

My son and I had a fantastic stay at Ingos. It's central and you can walk everywhere. The apartment is charming and we enjoyed the two balconies. We'læ be back!!!
Contact with with Ingo was good and uncomplicated.

This place is really beautiful! The ceilings in the main living area are high and there is a lot of natural light filling the place. We enjoyed the balcony, especially when the apartment got warm on hot summer days. The bathtub was deep and luxurious, and there are beautiful plants everywhere without it feeling cluttered. Just be aware it’s a bit of a climb to the top, which could be a little daunting after a night out! We liked being close to a metro station. The kitchen was cute and pleasant to cook simple meals in.

My wife, young daughter, and I stayed in this lovely apartment for six nights while visiting Berlin for vacation.  The proprietor was very communicative leading up to our trip, as well as during our stay and upon departure.  The apartment is lovely, updated, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.  Several evenings we stayed in, taking our daughter to nearby parks and then cooking dinner while she played with the large selection of toys provided by Annett.  When we wanted to explore, the neighborhood is friendly and vibrant, and the residence is located near a train station.  Numerous stores, restaurants, and laundry are within walking distance.  Thank you very much for providing an atmosphere for a great holiday.
Marius was very helpful, responsive and welcoming. We had a fab stay and would definitely recommend!
Sehr guter Aufenthalt!
Could be so much better, but he has taken minimalist to far, there is a Ldil's supermarket round corner, close to transport

This was my first time renting an apartement on airbnb and Berta made it so easy and comfortable. She nor her roommate were home during the stay but the neighbors were very helpful and welcoming. Her home was clean, easy to use and SO cozy! We loved it. All in all a very pleasant stay with so much help from Berta. Now that the neighborhood is not the most charming, it is lucky it is soo easy to get to the city since there is a station very close to the appartement.

Genau wie beschrieben & gut organisiert. Der Unterkunft mangelt es an nichts und für eine Übernachtung bietet sie alles was man braucht.
Lebensmittel und Restaurants gibts ausreichend in der bubble der Unterkunft.
Check in und Check out sind top organisiert.
Ich gebe gerne 5 ⭐️
El departamento es genial y está en un lugar muy bonito de Berlin. Julián es un anfitrión muy amable. Lo recomendamos!
Sehr schönes und sauberes Apartment. Zentral aber doch sehr ruhig!

I spent a few days at this apartment and couldn't have been happier. I felt straight at home and enjoyed my stay greatly. It was quiet, location was good and internet was fantastic, which helped as I was working remotely. Babett even arranged the self check-in for me, which was super helpful after a long travel. 10/10!

Boligen var perfekt til os, vi var 7 fordelt på tre par og en single. Boligen var hyggeligere end på billederne. Kvarteret er perfekt med gåafstand til Kolwitz Platz og tæt mange gode restauranter. De to af dobbeltsengene var lidt smalle. Køkkenet godt udstyret. Vi vil helt klart bo hos Alexandre næste gang, vi skal løbe Berlin 1/2 maraton.
Maravilhoso, me hospedaria novamente

super unterkunft
alles wie beschrieben
super internet
fernseher mit netflix, youtube funktion
sehr sauber
Spent a nice weekend in Berlin and enjoyed the stay in Agnes' Apartment which was the perfect location for visiting the city. Agnes and her husband were helpful and kind hosts.
Great central location. Easiest check-in ever. Using one code for the front entrance and room is great and very convenient. The room is quiet and spacious.

Located in the Mitte on a lively street with every amenity you could need. Public transport literally outside the door, bars, restaurants supermarkets etc. all within a few minutes walk. The apartment is spotlessly clean, with everything you could need. Carolina was a perfect host providing tips and recommendations. A fantastic base from which to explore Berlin. Loved it.
正好赶上了最热的时候 不过好在屋里有风扇 厕所也很干净 酒店的位置也很安静 楼下走两步就到查理检查站
Esteban fue muy amable y amigable desde el principio, el departamento es muy amplio y cómodo, queda a dos cuadras de una estación de metro y hay muchas cafeterías, supermercados, plazas en la zona
Had a wonderful stay in Franziska’s apartment! Would warmly recommend

This apartment is in a great location for sight seeing around East Berlin. It is close to the train station (5 mins in a taxi). It had all the amenities required for a comfortable stay. Close by are many good quality bars and restaurants, as well as supermarkets. Hans and Ute are very helpful, as was Ilona who handled our check in.
A beuatiful place in a prime location ! Highly recommended !
Tolle Lage aber die Gläser waren sehr dreckig und im Bad hat es sehr Unangenehm gerochen.

La casa está un poco retirada del centro pero tiene buena comunicación con el centro en transporte público. El paseo de 15 minutos hasta la estación es agradable. La casa es muy luminosa, tranquila y con una pequeña terraza perfecta para tomar algo si hace bueno. La cocina está muy bien equipada, aunque no la usamos mucho. Todo estaba muy bien.

The location of the apartment is perfect. It is placed in a quiet area only a few minutes walk from the U-bahn or a 15-minute walk from Alexanderplatz. The apartment was clean when we arrived and the nice hosts had put beer and coffee for us to enjoy if we wanted.
Besides that the apartment also had everything we needed (maybe aside from a kitchen table) and we can absolutely recommend the apartment for anyone who, like us, wants a clean and nice apartment to live in while exploring Berlin.
Booked this place because the location wasn't so far from an event venue! The room was cozy enough for the few days we stayed in there.
El lugar estaba limpio y muy acogedor, la zona tiene muchos lugares para comer.
Super nette Gastgeber und eine sauberes und schönes zu Hause
Tolle Lage, sauber und schön eingerichtet. Wir hatten eine gute Zeit!

사진과 동일한 숙소입니다. 아름답고 안전하고 깨끗한 곳입니다. 와이파이도 잘 연결되고 세탁기도 있어서 좋았습니다.
제가 일찍 도착했는데 미리 예약시에 체크인 시간을 조절해 주셔서 감사했습니다.
집주변으로 강이흐르니 산책을 추천하고 집앞 나무와 새소리가 아주 좋습니다.
마트도 바로 근처에있어 장보기도 좋아요!
조용하고 안잔하고 깨끗한 곳에 위치해 있습니다~ 너무 잘 지내다 왔어요! ^^
Nice apartment and good contact with host.

Great location - you can easily access everything and most of the tourists attractionsare 10 - 30mins away. You can easily commute with buses & trains, and if you are a stay at home buddy there are local shops & a feesh market closeby.
Host was great. I was hardly at home & was jet lagged during my stay, so I might have been a little noisy going to the bathroom at night. My only thing is the weather was a little hot, no AC or fan, which is what you get in some homes around there. If it's a big deal, you might need to buy a fan or open up the windows like I did.

Nice and clean apartment with the basic amenities and a clean nice bathroom. Its a pension and not a private home and thus its cleaned from any personal charm. But you have the flat all to yourself with private entrance and two big bedrooms. The host is very welcoming and helpful with sight seeing tips. The flat is on the ground floor but in a quite street during night. Its placed in the business and shopping district and thus its very deserted in the evening. If you wish to stay close to sight seeing spots its perfect but if you are looking for more cosy hang outs in parks, cafes and markets then you might wanna look at prenzlauerberg / mitte mitte.

Very responsive host and a great little place to stay.
While it was further out than we expected but the public transport in Berlin is incredible, so it wasn't a disadvantage at all.
I would recommend this AirBnB and we hope to come back again soon, so much more to see and do.

정말 멋진 숙소입니다. 친구와 묵는내내
만족했어요. 주방도 멋지고 침실도 넓고 쾌적합니다. 욕실의 건조대가 정말 유용했어요. 수압도 세고 샤워실도 넓습니다. 찾아가는 길이 조금 특이하지만, 설명이 잘 되어있어서 금방 찾을 수 있습니다. 주변 관광 가기에도 좋은 위치입니다

We were very comfortable here. The place was lovely and spacious and clean. The host was friendly and helpful. Check in and check out was handy for us as we used a code and didn’t need to even meet the host. We could let ourselves in and out. It was in a great central location.

Beautifully decorated apartment with little extra touches such as coffee, bread, jam, candy, wine, and beer.  The kitchen was well stocked with enough plates, cups, and utensils.  Basically, anything you need to cook a meal.  Nice to have screens on the windows which was a rare find on our Europe trip.

El departamento más estético y completo que tuve la suerte de hospedarme.
Muchas gracias por todo Barbara.
Witziges Interieur, tolle Lage in Alt-Tegel.

Für uns war diese Ferienwohnung perfekt, weil unsere Familie, die wir in Berlin besucht haben, um die Ecke wohnt und weil sie auch für Kinder einiges zu bieten hat. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt - es ist alles vorhanden, sauber und gemütlich. Die Gastgeber sind sehr nett und immer ansprechbar. Danke und bis zum nächsten Mal!

We absolutely loved our stay with Daniel. The directions were very clear and at the end of the street were a lovely corner with restaurants, a playground and a bakery located. We would absolutely return here!

Nhu has a gorgeous place in a wonderful location. It’s a very modern apartment that’s spacious, stylish and comfy. Great bedroom with plenty of storage, and a modern & clean bathroom and shower. Nhu and her dog Sakura were wonderful company during my stay, I was travelling alone and Nhu was always up for a chat and had plenty of great recommendations for my time there. The location was great as well, close to an awesome park in Berlin (Treptower Park), some lovely walkways along the canals and close to an excellent supermarket. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay in Berlin!
Clean apartment in a great locaton, not far from the centre of Berlin with plenty of great food spots.

Hemos pasado 5 días en uno de los apartamentos y son tal como se ven en las fotos, amplios, cómodos y modernos. Todo funciona perfectamente y el cuarto de baño, aunque solo uno, es realmente cómodo. Por poner una pega, para mi gusto, falta un micro-ondas. El apartamento está justo al lado de las vías del tren pero está bien aislado y prácticamente no se escucha el tren. Está justo en el límite de Car2Go lo que nos permitió movernos por Berlín con mucha comodidad y bien de precio. En cuanto a la atención de Bensimon, fantástica, durante nuestra estancia tuvimos una huelga de personal de tierra del aeropuerto de Berlín y, en todo momento, contamos con la ayuda que necesitábamos por su parte.
Totalmente recomendable

Super tolle Wohnung. Wirklich toll eingerichtet. Die Lage ist sehr ruhig, aber dennoch zentral gelegen. Man hat alles was man braucht in naher Umgebung. Kurze Wege zu öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln und ein toller großer Park um die Ecke.
Wirklich nette, sympathische und schnelle Kommunikation. Gerne wieder.
Nice safe area, near supermarket and station. Friday food and wine market was amazing at the nearby park.

Super tolle Wohnung! Fantastisch gelegen und dafür relativ ruhig. Es war alles vorhanden was wir benötigten und das auf wirklich großem Raum! Alles war sauber. Und die Kommunikation hat auch hervorragend geklappt. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Alles super wie beschrieben! Barbara ist super nett und jederzeit hilfsbereit. Die Kommunikation lief absolut vorbildlich. Das Apartment ist liebevoll eingerichtet und in einer tollen Umgebung. Absolut empfehlenswert! Danke!
Wir hatten vier sehr schöne Tage in Berlin. Das Appartement war sehr schön und es gab alles was man benötigt hat. Alles war sehr sauber und schön hergerichtet und wir haben uns rundum wohl gefühlt!

The place is nice and cozy and well-appointed, not to mention a lovely terrace. The location is great - within walking distance of different train stops, and walking distance to main attraction in Mitte. There are nice cafés and plenty of restaurants around.
Alessandra and her team were responsive, accommodating, and all-around great folks.
I highly recommend this place for those looking to visit and explore Berlin.
Lovely space in a fantastic location. Recommended!
Beautiful spacious apartment! Great hosts!
Die Lage ist wirklich perfekt um Berlin zu entdecken. Es war sauber und gemütlich.
Petra's place was amazing. Everything was sparkling clean, the area around is amazing and the place is quite equipped.
sehr schöne, gemütliche unterkunft. hat alles super geklappt, haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. wir konnten fahrräder ausleihen und haben ein schönes frühstück gegen kleinen aufpreis bekommen.

Beim Check in ergab sich, dass der Schlüssel nur zu einer Abstellkammer passte und das zugesagte Zimmer mit anderen Gästen belegt war. Da keine Telefonnummer des Gastgebers verfügbar, wählten wir den absolut unkomplizierten Support von Airbnb zu kontaktieren und binnen kürzester Zeit war der Gastgeber vor Ort, entschuldigte sich für das Versehen und die Umstände und ermöglichte die Unterkunft in seinem größten Zimmer mit privatem Bad. Absolut professionell gelöste Situation und adäquate Reaktion! Herzlichen Dank 😁

Апартаменты хорошие, при заселении было очень чисто, отличное расположение, рядом много транспорта и легко добраться до любой точки Берлина. Очень не хватало кастрюли, просили ее и зарядку для телефона у хозяина, на что последовали обещания, что их нам занесут, в итоге ничего не принесли и не предупредили об этом. В качестве извинений позволили бесплатно выселиться позже, за что большое спасибо)

Great place to stay at! Yes, you have to walk through the front door to get to the space but it’s not a big deal. Mathis was very kind and welcoming! The place was big, neat, and clean. Would definitely stay here again! 😁
Sehr schöne Unterkunft mit guten und schnlöen öffentlichen Verbindungen in alle Richtungen. Eine gemütliche kleine Kochecke und viel Platz für alle unsere Sachen 👍🏻
Fantastic place  and hospitality to visit berlin.Thanks Robert.

The apartment is very clean and well equipped! The place is very spacious, lovely big bedrooms. They even provided earplugs because of the tramline that runs in front of the house. I really recommend this place.
very nice experience，and thanks a lot for your kindly help.

Io e il mio ragazzo siamo stati da Dor dal 7 al 10 dicembre. La stanza e il bagno privato si trovano all’interno di un appartamento in condivisione con il proprietario. Siamo stati subito accolti. La stanza è pulita e ordinata e abbiamo dormito serenamente. Dor ci ha subito fornito le chiavi per spostarci indipendentemente. La casa è molto pulita e super calda e rispetta l’intimità di tutti.
L’appartamento si trova su un punto strategico, ottima per visitare Berlino… infatti era possibile prendere metro, treno e altri mezzi per città e aeroporto. Inoltre, vi sono diversi pub, bar per fare colazione e market 24h.
Ringraziamo ancora Dor che è stato un perfetto Host!
Geräumige, stylische Wohnung in sehr schöner Lage.

cute little appartment, everything as described and shown on pictures.  Plenty of restaurants and shops around as well as public transport. Main train station only 10 minutes away by train.  Extra plus for being pet friendly.
Wer etwas Spannung beim Check-in braucht, ist hier richtig. Zimmer, Lage, Sauberkeit sind sehr gut.
Ubicación perfecta y anfitriona muy amable.

Die Kommunikation mit Sohail wir immer sehr zügig. Durch die eine Nacht vor Ort haben wir nur kurz mit ihm beim Check In gesprochen. Er war sehr nett und freundlich in seinem auftreten.
Die Wohnung war sehr ordentlich und machte einen guten Eindruck.
Er hatte sogar für uns Getränke zur Begrüßung hingestellt. Was wir sehr gut fanden :-)
Nice place and nice location. Top floor with elevator.

Super nice and sweet guy, he welcomed us so warmly and made us feel very comfortable at his place! We highly recommend his airbnb spot regarding every aspect: location, cleanliness, personality!!
Much love
Spacious Flat in the midst of Friedrichshain. You literally look at Boxi (Boxhagener Platz). Next U Bahn just around the corner. Perfect for us. Monika was very helpful! Thumbs up!

Adelina and Baris were super hosts, the room is in a perfect central location and very cheap compared to similar listings in the area, the apartment was super clean and the hosts were very helpful, definitely recommended and will book this again next time I am in Berlin.
A place that feels like home. Perfect location if you want to explore Prenzlauer Berg.

Apartamento perfecto, todo lo que ponía en el anuncio correspondía, grande, espacioso y con todo lo necesario. Las camas muy muy cómodas, en definitiva, uno de los mejores apartamentos en los que me he alojado. Por poner una pega, está bastante alejado del centro, aunque no es un problema porque desde la estación de Schöneweide puedes ir a cualquier zona de Berlín a cualquier hora.

A little bit smaller, than expected but still enough room to sleep, shower and cook. Also a nice cold temperature inside while we were melting in the sun. Overall a great place to stay for 2 friends or a couple
A good find!
Ideal für einen Städtetrip, sehr zentral und doch sehr ruhig.

Die geräumige Wohnung liegt sehr gut zentral in Berlin Mitte, man kommt gut ohne öffentliche Verkehrsmittel aus. Die Umgebung ist belebt und schön. Alles, was man benötigt, war in der Unterkunft bereitgestellt.

This was my second stay with Madflats, and the excellent experience was comparable in every respect to the delight of first Madflats stay a year earlier.
The location is convenient for visiting with my family very nearby in Friedenau, and convenient (easy walk) to the S-Bahn 1 line which connects you to other lines and thus to all the most treasured Berlin locations.
The apartment was immaculately clean, and all appliances new -- or almost new -- and in easy-to-use good working order. The apartment opens to a well-kept private courtyard which was especially helpful for when my grandchildren visited.
Although I spent most of my Berlin visit out and about with family, the apartment proved a restful space for morning and evening meals preparation and sleep.
Do not hesitate if you have opportunity to reserve with Madflats!

Wir hatten einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt – die Wohnung ist sauber, gut ausgestattet und ruhig gelegen. Der Gastgeber war super freundlich und hilfsbereit. Zwei kleine Dinge (langsamer Duschabfluss, automatische Jalousien) wurden direkt ans Wartungsteam weitergegeben – sehr professionell. Klare Empfehlung, wir kommen gern wieder!

Adelina’s home was a great space for getting some rest and doing a bit of work while experiencing the city. As well, Adelina had great recommendations and was very responsive and helpful as a host. :)
Parfait, le logement est propre et très  agréable. De plus, le propriétaire est particulièrement réactif et gentil !!

The apartment was a great place to stay, with a lovely forest less than ten minutes away. The apartment was clean and was exactly as described. Jürgen was a welcoming and kind host! Would definitely recommend!

Vielen Dank Prime Flats, wir waren sehr zufrieden!
Liebe Grüße
Simon

roi is a great host, the communication was uncomplicated, proactive and friendly. the apartment with all details is as shown in the pictures. all facilities are fully functional. i can recommend the accommodation for relaxed city trips.
Gianmarco ist ein toller Host. Sehr empfehlenswert. Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit :)
We loved the spacy room and the place itself. Birgit was helpful and check in was easy. The place is a bit far from the center, however, easily reachable by subway within 20 min.
Es war ein rundum wunderbarer Aufenthalt in Berlin! Das Studio war sehr komfortabel eingerichtet und sauber! Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt! Die Lage ist Top! Gute Bus und S/ U- Bahn Anbindung!
Extrem schönes Hotel!

I had a very pleasant stay! The landlord was friendly and welcoming, making the experience comfortable. The apartment was clean and well-maintained, and everything was organized nicely. I appreciated the peaceful atmosphere and the thoughtful attention to detail. Thank you for providing such a great place to stay!
Top host, top apartment
Sehr schönes Airbnb mit allem was man braucht… Check in und Check out haben wunderbar geklappt und wir waren sehr zufrieden! Wir würden definitiv wieder kommen :)

Schöne einfache Wohnung in bester Lage.
Wir können sie weiterempfehlen. Das Bett war wirklich bequem. Kommen gerne wieder.
Tout correspondait à nos attentes !
A lovely room in a lovely apartment with a welcoming host.
War alles top!

Die Lage sowie grösse und Ausstattung des Zimmers ist perfekt. Jedoch war zum Zeitpunkt unserer Reise die Rezeption nichz besetzt, worauf wir auch nie hingewiesen wurden. Das online check-in sowie die Schlüsselausgabe hat nicht geklappt da die Buchung online nicht gefunden wurde. Erst nach herumtelefonieren hat es geklappt. Die Zimmerreinigung fand (trotz vorab 3-maligen Nachfragen) nicht statt - ohne einen Grund zu nennen. Die Angaben die uns via Chat gegeben wurden bezgl. Supply Room waren falsch. Eine Entschuldigung gab es nie, eher ein Beschuldigen.

Loved Robert's loft. This beautiful place is a in a residential neighborhood yet within walking distance to public transport. It was easy to get around and explore during the day and relaxed and quiet in the evening. We enjoyed the rooftop terrace-fabulous! Robert is a friendly and personable host who showed us around the apartment and provided good tips for exploring Berlin and getting to teh airport.
Очень спокойное место, отличная ванная. Приветливая хозяйка
Vielen Dank für den freundlichen Kontakt!

Room is very nice as it looks in the pictures. Katrin was not there but arranged to give me the keys with a flatmate.

Katrin was very nice and left water and some fruits, thanks a lot for that extra detail!!!

Die Wohnung ist in super Lage und das elektronische Türschloss ist echt klasse, wenn man mit vielen Leuten unterwegs ist und alle zu anderen Zeiten heimkommen.
Es war alles sauber, das einzige Manko war das harte Bett oben und dass das Bad gerne mal uberläuft, wenn mehrere Personen hintereinander duschen.
Der Preis war im Vergleich auch gut, kann man also sehr empfehlen! 😄
Hele fijne en bijzondere ruimte. Fijne locatie. Goed contact met de hosts.

Dieses Hostel ist in einem wirklich wunderschönem Haus, die Lobby… fantastisch! Die Zimmer sind sauber, es gibt alles, was man braucht. Sehr ruhig und super angebunden, man kommt schnell überall hin und das Personal ist sehr freundlich!

Loved this space! Will definitely stay here again next time I'm in Berlin. One night there was loud music playing from somewhere nearby, which was kind of a bummer, but this place was so cute and such a great location it didn't even really affect how I felt. It was clean, cute, and in a great spot.
Amazing appartement, super clean, great neighbourhood, very smooth check-in, and also good tips from Laura to explore the area.
all 5 stars from me. lovely space as per pics. very clean. comfortable bed.

Charlottenburg can be a very nice place to live, and the apartment is really convenient to a lot of public transport. It is central to old West Berlin but pretty far from what would now be considered the center, and not at all hip, though there are many, many good restaurants and cafes and shopping opportunities nearby. The apartment has none of the classic Berlin charm (high ceilings and grand windows in beautiful buildings) but is instead a stylish and neat modern furnished unit. I don’t know if my experience was typical, but while I was there the owner had left the rental to a management company that was busy and not terribly responsive. If it is a good fit for you, though, you could be very happy with this apartment.

Selbst zu fünft ist in dieser äußert stylischen Wohnung ausreichend Platz, um gemütliche drei Wochen zu verbringen.
Die Einrichtung ist modern und angenehm. Die Küchen- und Badezimmerausstattungen sind so umfassend, dass man nichts vermisst.
Bei Extrawünschen oder bei Fragen ist der Gastgeber sofort für einen da, ohne jegliche Zusatzkosten zu verlangen.
Wir, Schüler aus Hamburg, waren sehr positiv überrascht und würden dieses Inserat JEDEM weiterempfehlen und kommen bestimmt noch einmal wieder.

Beau logement fidèle aux photos, endroit calme et gare accessible à pied. Très bonne communication et arrangeant pour l'heure d'arrivée. Bien équipé.
Nous étions 3 et nous avons passé 5 jours parfaits à Berlin

Tout a été parfait ! L’appartement est très bien situé (juste en face d’un métro). Il est également très bien équipé. La personne à l’accueil a été adorable avec nous et très arrangeant pour récupérer la chambre de plus tôt possible. Il y a un petit espace très sympathique à côté de la réception. Le rapport qualité prix me paraît imbattable. Je vous recommande fortement cet endroit pour votre séjour à Berlin.
Sehr angenehmen sehr schöne atmosphäre ! ich freue mich euch nochmal besuchen zu dürfen vielen dank für den super aufenthalt !
Kevin's place was great, we loved the location and the apartment and wish we could have stayed longer!
La verdad que súper las expectativas, piso muy cómodo y súper bien ubicado. Más que encantando

Einfach gut und preiswert.
Netter Host.
Gute Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel.
Mir hat die Unterkunft sehr gefallen:)

If you want a place very close to the airport and some great coffee shops and supermarkets in a non Central part of berlin, this might work for you. The beds will at best be comfortable for two tiny people....the noise from the street is an issue and the walls between rooms don't really block noises ....also the u and s bahn are atleast ten mins walk away and about half hour into mitte ...but then again it depends on what you are optimising for ....if you compare it to a hostel it's better , if I compare it to my previous Airbnb experiences, then it's not the best
Cosy and unusual bungalow, great design and perfect communication and check-in - thank you!

Der Aufenthalt bei Mike hat meine Erwartungen übertroffen! Er war stets per Handy erreichbar und das Zimmer war gemütlich und sehr sauber.
Danke Mike für Deine Gastfreundschaft!
Amazing place to stay. Would recommend it! Felt cosy and relaxed. Really lovely apartment.

Arzu and Tom's apartment is absolutely amazing and they are some of the most helpful we've encountered on our trip so far. We only met Tom, but he filled us in on everything in the area and recommended places to eat and shop as soon as we arrived. The day we left, we were taking a night train and they held onto our baggage for us long after the check in time so that we could have another day to explore Berlin unburdened by our heavy back packs.
I would definitely recommend staying with Arzu and Tom. The location is excellent, they were incredibly helpful and you will have an amazing time.

The Studio was really great, it was like living in a museum. All the small details in the studio were nice to see and everyday I discovered new things. Clean appartment. Warm welkom from Frank, he gave us some good advice about the new Ai WeiWei exposition. Just in the middle of Prenzlauerberg, but not to noisy. The two bicycles were great to explore the city, we took only one day the subway. I recommend everybody this appartment.
Perfect location :)

We (6adults+3kids) really enjoyed our time in the apartment! It's huge and has everything you need in there (including coffe,spices in the kitchen, earplugs-not needed as it's quiet there!, even toothbrushes,deo,shampoo, conditioner etc). It was clean everyone had was provided a towel, bedrooms were big and cosy. The common sitting area is not too big but for us it was enough,as we all had a place and it was also connected to the kitchen. Prenzlauer Berg at itself is a very vibrant area, lots of restaurants and bars,the street where the apartment is is very quiet. I definitely reccomend the place, it's great for bigger groups/families!
Communication with the co-hosts was great, thank you for that!

I stayed at Miniloft for just over 5 weeks. Check in was very easy and elevator was very useful for heavy luggage.
Matthew was very responsive when I had questions and the emergency phone number worked great when I locked myself out of the apartment.
I got free weekly cleaning services which were flexible with my times and were very efficient.
Miniloft is located in a very safe neighbourhood with everything that you need at walking. There is a police station nearby and police officers patrolling the Jewish museum during the day. As a young female, I felt extremely safe during the entirety of my stay.
The only critique is that the washing machine was out of service when I needed wash my clothes before I departed and was not given prior warning.

Josephine's place is beautiful, well-decorated, and in a great location in the trendiest neighborhood of Berlin. I biked or walked everywhere in the neighborhood. She left chocolates and a hand written note for me, so sweet! It's clean and even has a bathtub. The only downside is it's VERY expensive for Berlin, in my opinion, and I've been coming for years, and no A/C so in the summer it was very hot.

Private Reise
Gepflegtes Hotel, man bekommt von der Hauptstraße nichts mit

This is my second stay with Andreas and Gary. The studio was, once again, a great base for my stay in Berlin. The space is comfortable and cozy, clean, and stylish. The location is perfect for anyone wanting to enjoy everything from sight-seeing to nightlife. Andreas and Gary are friendly and responsive. Thank you for another lovely stay.
Location great!  Super close to one of my favorite Christmas Markets (Lucia). Friendly welcome. Comfortable bed. Warm and cozy. I only wish the shower was roomier. Everything else was great!
Very diligent communication about a lovely place in an exciting part of town. Would stay there again!
Lovely place, would happily recommend to others. Great communication from hosts. Wonderful time had.
Very nice place in a cool area of Berlin. Good price/quality ratio for this accomodation. Can recommend :)

The apartment is really great and comfortable, living room is super welcoming and spacious. Double room is very big and spare room is good enough for a couple days or for kids. Kitchen has all the necessary items for cooking, very handy. Bathroom is nice and clean.
Heater/ AC worked perfectly, plus window heaters and towel warmer on the bathroom. Apt is located on first floor, but there's a couple steps to get to the door (6 or 7 steps). Wifi was good, but not awesome, 40mb but unstable.
Neighborhood is as good as it can get. We loved! The Kaisers supermarket just across the street is very handy.
Katja was a nice host, very kind and helping.

Die Wohnung von Katrin ist rundrum empfehlenswert! Man konnte an heißen Tagen nachts das Fenster offen lassen und hatte ein bisschen Durchzug. Die Wohnung war ruhig gelegen und das Bett bequem. Mit der S- oder U-Bahn ist man schnell überall, das Viertel ist schön.

Fantastic flat for our family with everything we needed beautifully presented and no more ( parents of small children will understand this last bit reduces stress levels considerably). Berlin was freezing but the flat was toasty warm. The lift to the flat ( it's on the 5th floor) was s godsend. The local area was very family friendly and the children enjoyed the local playground, the toy shop and we enjoyed the coffee! Lots to do locally and definitely get the App for all the transport systems on your phone! Thank you Frank for letting us stay!
Superschöne Wohnung mit allem Zipp und Zapp. Genau so schön wie auf den Bildern. Zentrale Lage. Freundliche Gastgeber und reibungslose Kommunikation. Uneingeschränkt empfehlenswert.
Great place

The apartment was at a great location. Public transport stations, various stores and supermarkets, restaurants and bars were all within walking distance.
The apartment war spacious and comfortable. However, a few essential things were missing. For example, dish soap, washcloths, salt/pepper/oil, etc. A broom or something similar to clean the apartment was also missing, which was really inconvenient because there was ongoing construction work right in front of the building.
Costumer service was good and helpful when they were on sight. However, as soon as they left it seemed as if they didn't care (not picking up the phone).
Vielen Dank für den netten Aufenthalt bei euch und wir kommen gerne wieder 😃
Tolle Wohnung, schick und ruhig. Toller Gastgeber und tolle Lage in Berlin. Wenn die Wohnung wieder frei ist, würde ich sie wieder nehmen!

Das Apartment von Werner hat alles, was man für ein Wochenende mit Freunden braucht. Die Zimmer waren sehr sauber und die Küche war mit allem ausgerüstet! Die Kommunikation mit Werner sowie das ein-und Ausschecken war unkompliziert- alles in alles sehr zufrieden!

Excelente experiencia! El apartamento es muy cómodo y está muy bien ubicado.
El bueno de sotirios fue muy amable en dejarnos ingresar antes del horario previsto.
100% recomendable!
Todo estuvo bien.
Enjoyed my visit! Clean, large and a good location

Yair is a great no-fuss, positive host with an eye for detail and a fantastic place. We  arrived with two six-year-olds who wanted to move into the apartment at the end of out stay. A clean, nice apartment with everything we needed in a super nice area.

My stay at this place was great, primarily due to its location right near a subway station, making transportation incredibly convenient. The room was not only spacious but also very clean, providing a comfortable and relaxing environment after a day of exploring.
The location is good. Photocopier/printer services downstairs. The room and toilets were clean.

Johannes ist wirklich ein Super-Host. Von Beginn an war es eine sehr gute Kommunikation, eine super-Beschreibung, um in die Wohnung zu kommen, und auch während unseres Aufenthaltes blieb das so. Die Wohnung ist nur zu empfehlen, hat eine neue, sehr gut durchdachte Einrichtung und ist wirklich blitzsauber. Trotz der vielen anderen Wohnungen ist es eine sehr ruhige Lage. Wir waren mit 3 Erwachsenen dort. Das geht prima, auch auf dem Schlafsofa ließ es sich prima nächtigen. Der Willkommenswein war ebenfalls ein Volltreffer; wir haben uns sehr über dieses Extra gefreut. Alles in allem eine sehr gute Adresse für einen Berlin-Aufenthalt! Nur zu empfehlen! Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Die Wohnung liegt in der Nähe vom Alexanderplatz, direkt an einer Straßenbahn Haltestelle und somit sehr zentral.
In der Umgebung gibt es jede Menge interessante und gute Lokale und es ist auch sonst eine echt schöne Gegend.
Die Wohnung ist groß und man ist mit allem versorgt was man braucht.
Die Kommunikation mit Tomas verlief optimal, auch ein flexibler Check in war möglich.
Also eine echte Empfehlung wenn man Berlin erleben will.
Eine wunderschöne Wohnung nah am Hauptbahnhof. Freundliche Gastgeber und das Preis-/Leistungsverhältnis ist top.

Die Unterkunft ist genauso wie auf den Bildern gezeigt. Mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln ist alles super erreichbar.
Gute Tips/Manuals zu Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und den vorhandenen E-Geräten liegen aus.

Dejligt sted lige i centrum af Berlin. Nemt at finde og med tydelig guide fra værten. Rent og pænt, samt holdt i moderne stil. Hyggeligt lounge area. Mange muligheder for tilføje lidt ekstra til sit ophold. Der er blevet svaret på beskeder inden for ganske kort tid. Jeg følte mig tryg i mit ophold. Jeg manglede blot en børste/svamp til rengøring af opvask. Super nemt med koder til selvbetjening.

Overall was a decent stay at Bernardo's.  Apartment was clean but could use some new towels and linens.  Also a garbage can would have been nice.  Walkable to restaurants and nightlife but not too loud in apartment.
An oasis in the city with a really nice terrace. Super friendly landlords. Absolutely recommend this place
Andrea is really nice host. Breakfast is made when you want it and very friendly
Great apartment, really good location, would definitely recommend!
Todo perfecto
Breezy check in. Clean apartment. Had everything we needed and they responded very promptly. A delightful stay !

Milan's apartment is a real gem in Berlin. If you have lived in hotels or other Berlin apartments before, you will feel lost right from the threshold in this large space, among the modern equipment, beautiful bathroom, tip-top kitchen, and finally on the terrace... One would think that such apartments only exist in advertisements - but you can actually live in one :) And when you pick up your jaw from the floor and step out onto the city, you will discover that you are a step/bus/metro/tram (all nearby!) away from the center of Berlin, among restaurants from all over the world, next to a park, one intersection from a well-equipped supermarket. Parking on the street or in nearby parking spaces - I recommend the Ampido app, thanks to which the car remains cheap and safe throughout your stay. Milan responds quickly, is extremely friendly and if he is not a Superhost in the first year, I will personally protest to the company headquarters :) Thanks for staying, we will be back ;)

Arzu and Tom were great hosts and responded very quickly to all of our questions and communications. The flat was clean, quiet, comfortable and convenient for public transportation, both in relation to Tegel as well as all the main sights in town. They made some great recommendations for things to do and local places to eat. For a few days in Berlin, this was a great base for our family.

El apartamento impecable y apto para niños, muy cerca del tranvía y U-Banh que permite trasladarse fácilmente en Berlín. Anna respondió muy rápido a nuestras consultas y nos facilitó la llegada al apartamento para dejar nuestro equipaje

I had a great stay at Alexander's apartment. It's very spacious, both horizontally as well as vertically: the ceiling is very high which is pretty cool. It's kind of a giant cube split around in multiple sections. It's filled with thoughtful art (that you can seemingly buy — at least many pieces had prices listed).
The kitchen was nice and there was a washing machine too. There was a second set of keys which I found nice (though personally I didn't need them as I was traveling alone).
The apartment is located in a very nice area with lots of restaurants where I particularly liked getting breakfasts.
Alexander himself is a friendly host who was quick to respond to my questions. He wasn't there for my check in but he sent detailed instructions with photos so the flat was easy to find.
Great place and location. Uta was super helpful and friendly. Ideal for a weekend trip in Berlin
Gorgeous apartment and very private. I would definitely stay again. Thank you for a lovely holiday in Berlin

For starters, the communication was easy with quick responses from the host! The apartment itself is situated just a block from a tram, it’s stylish, clean, bright and tidy with our favourite part being the rooftop terrace which is just spectacular to sit on either day or night. You must come to Berlin and I have no hesitation in recommending this apartment to stay in!

Die Unterkunft von Stefan ist einfach perfekt für einen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Die Lage ist sehr gut, um schnell in den Prenzlberg zu kommen oder zum Erkunden der Innenstadt. Fußläufig erreicht man schnell verschiedene Restaurants und Kneipen. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber gewesen und entsprach in jeder Hinsicht den Bildern und der Beschreibung. Die große Dachterrasse mit Blick auf den Berliner Fernsehturm ist das Highlight der Wohnung. Stefan ist sehr freundlich, flexibel und war  jederzeit gut zu erreichen. Wir kommen bei unserem nächsten Berlin Besuch auf jedenfall wieder.

Everything was perfect. The location is great, a lot of bars and restaurant around thé appartment.
The appartment was very beautiful, we would totally book this one again for a week-end in Berlin !

Eine nette Unterkunft, etwas außerhalb vom Berlin Zentrum. Die Anbindung ins Zentrum ist durch die nahegelegene Bahn und Straßenbahn super. Der Check-in war sehr unkompliziert und die Gastgeber sind sehr freundlich.
Auf das geteilte Bad im Erdgeschoss muss man sich entsprechend einstellen, ist aber alles kein Problem.
Insgesamt ist die Unterkunft sehr zu empfehlen.
great size and nice amenities

Perfekt!
Dankeschön. 🙂
Great location et great flat, with all the cumfort. Thanks to Yair, we enjoyed our trip on Berlin !

Alice was a great host. She was very friendly and made sure we enjoyed our New Years. We enjoyed the apartment a great deal and definitely would stay there again. Would recommend for your stay in Berlin.

Super Unterkunft!
Unkomplizierte Gastgeber, mit super Kommunikation.
Gerne wieder! :)

Dejlig lejlighed. Alt fungerer. God kommunikation med værten.
Fed beliggenhed. Fedt og hyggeligt lokalmiljø og tog direkte mod centrum rundt om hjørnet.
Kan anbefales. 👍
Alles super. Die Lage ist schön ruhig! Die Wohnung top!

if you want to sleep in a soft and comfortable bed, and waking up in the morning to prepare the most delicious breakfast in the kitchen with all the conditions, and have breakfast in a lovely courtyard, then you should be here.
It was the most comfortable, clean and pleasant house we found in Berlin. This house made my trip.
P.s. Very hospitable hosts. Everything was very clearly explained, told and even conducted a tour of the house.
Es hat alles nach Absprache geklappt
Jess' place was very nice and cozy with a wonderful backyard. The location was probably one of the best in the city! She's super responsive, I'd recommend this place to anyone.

Wir haben eine knappe Woche bei Nana verbracht. Leider ist die Unterkunft nur in den Ferien und am Wochenende ruhig, ab 7:30 Uhr hört man nämlich auch bei geschlossenen Fenstern die Grundschüler, die auf den direkt unter der Wohnung liegenden Pausenhof stürmen. Außerdem ist in dem Inserat von 3 Räumen die Rede. Diese Räume sind eigentlich ein großer Raum, der durch nicht abschließbare und sehr dünne Schiebetüren getrennt ist. Die Lage ist super & die Wohnung ist sauber, die Küche ein wenig in die Jahre gekommen.

Einfach nur eine Herzensempfehlung. Die Wohnung ist so liebevoll eingerichtet, dass man sich sofort heimelig fühlt. Kerstin und Michael sind liebe, freundliche und zuvorkommende Gastgeber, die einem mit Rat und Tat zur Seite stehen. Wir haben uns von der ersten Sekunde an wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung entspricht zu 100% den Bildern und lässt keine Wünsche offen. Wir waren begeistert und kommen mit Sicherheit nochmal wieder, wenn wir in Berlin sind.
Very nice apartment with a great location. Service and communication with Simon was superb 5/5.

Мы отлично провели время в апартаментах у Гуннара и Иштвана. Квартира в идеальном состоянии, прекрасный современный дизайн, очень милый балкон с видом на зеленый двор. Местоположение просто отличное, рядом большой выбор транспорта и много интересных мест. Гуннар был очень отзывчив и гостериимен. Все рекоммендуем данное жилье и хозяев.

Wir haben einen super netten Gastgeber kennengelernt! Und ein sehr schönes Appartement vorgefunden,genau wie auf den Fotos gezeigt. Für 2 Personen optimal. Jeanette und Henry reagierten flexibel auf unsere geänderte Ankunftszeit ,waren jederzeit ansprechbereit und hatten Tipps für diese Superstadt! Gerade Radfahrbegeisterte sind bei ihnen gut aufgehoben ! Zu Fuß läuft man ~10-15 Minuten zur nächsten Bushaltestelle;war für uns okay. Wir würden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen! Vielen Dank für diese schöne Zeit bei euch :)
Great space, just as advertised and 10 minutes away from the center. great value for the price

Ein sehr empfehlenswertes Objekt!  Nicht nur wegen der Superausstattung und der gastfreundlichen Aufnahme, sondern auch wegen der verkehrstechnisch günstigen Lage. Durch die optimale Anreisemöglichkeit und durch die Nähe zur S-Bahn, die ohne  umzusteigen die direkte Fahrt zum Brandenburger Tor, Potsdamer Platz , etc. ermöglicht verkehrstechnisch sehr günstig gelegen.  Das  Haus befindet sich in einer sehr ruhigen, naturnahen Lage, sodass man sich abends, insbesondere im Pool entspannen kann.

Eine schöne, für unsere Zwecke gut gelegene Wohnung. Parkplätze sind Mangelware, vor allem, wenn man abends oder nachts einen sucht. Die Kommunikation mit Franziska war sehr freundlich und unproblematisch.
Lovely modern apartment with everything we needed. Great location for jumping on the underground and exploring the city. Douglas was very helpful in letting us check in early as the flat was ready.
Great stay. Right in the heart of the city to see all of Berlin's attractions. Very quiet building. Perfect place to take breaks whils exploring the city for a couple of days.

This was my first Airbnb experience and communicating with Ellen was easy and welcoming. Her space is bigger than I expected and very clean and comfortable. The terrace is great to enjoy a morning coffee. There is a washing machine as well with clear instructions. The location is right near a ubahn stop and in a fun area. With three of us total, it fit us perfectly and comfortably. Our only disappointment was our busy days did not allow us to enjoy the space more. If we are ever back in Berlin, would definitely stay here again. Danke ellen!

Ben’s place was one of the cleanest I’ve ever been since I started using Airbnb. It was really comfortable, well located and decorated.
I recommend this place to all my friends and family and if I will ever be in Berlin again, ai will definitely choose to stay at Ben’s again.
Wunderschöne, zentrale Unterkunft :) sehr freundliche Gastgeber!

Super Unterkunft
Liegt zentrale an allen öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel
Viele Restaurants in der Nähe
非常不错的住处，房东很亲切和蔼，卫生各方面也都很好，房东都已经消过毒了。卧室也非常不错。下次有机会的话，我还会来这里住。

Appartement très grand.m, conforme à la description
Tous les équipements sont de qualité et fonctionnent très bien

I had a really nice stay for one night at Tatjanas place - she was super friendly and the bed was really comfy! There’s a lovely balcony in front of the room too which was great to get some sun and the view over Berlin is awesome :)

Zentral gelegen, sauber und schön.
Hätte fast sogar nochmal verlängert. Auch der Gastgeber ist sehr aufmerksam und kümmert sich. Gerne wieder
Very much a classic Kreuzberg studio in a great location. Appreciated the security and space of this studio. Would stay here again!

Such an amazing find! My boyfriend and I stayed here for just under a week and absolutely LOVED it— it was well-located right next to trains & buses so it was easy to get around, it was on a quiet street but walking distance to bustling areas, and the apartment had everything we needed. We especially loved how cozy the place felt. Dirk was an incredible host with great communication. Should we find ourselves back in Berlin, we know where we’d want to stay!
Anita empfing uns zu später Stunde sehr freundlich, die Kommunikation gut, wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Wohnung.
Nice place and close to public transport.
Had such a wonderful stay! The apartment was spacious and clean, perfectly situated, and the hosts were absolutely outstanding! Enjoyed my stay very much :)
I had a wonderful stay at Stella‘s place. The beds were nice and beautiful bedrooms. I really enjoyed the place well done Stella keep it up.
super séjour dans un appartement impeccable avec plein de bons restaurants à proximité et proche des transports
Sehr schön eingerichtete Wohnung. Die Bushaltestelle vor der Haustür ist ein großer Pluspunkt. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Die Lage war echt super, man konnte von hier aus schnell zu öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln aber auch viel zu Fuß erkunden. Es war alles sehr sauber und sah aus wie auf den Fotos!
Check-in war super erklärt und es hat alles geklappt :)
駅から近く、人気のケバブショップがあります。

Wibke is a very good landlady,she is very nice! She answered all the questions in time,the house location is also very good,with many restaurants and bars nearby. My sister and I like her and her house very well.
Mia's place is amazing! Just like the pictures, and in an amazing location. Definitely recommended if you are visiting Berlin!
Ein wunderbarer Ort zum Entspannen und Berlin entdecken. Alles sehr funktional und praktisch. Tolle Homebase im ruhigen Umfeld für den Ausflug in die Hauptstadt.

This apartment is easily accessible by public transportation, has a grocery store across the street, and is quiet location despite the central location. But the best part is the lovingly decorated space and all the amenities: washer/dryer, dishwasher, stove/oven, toaster, water boiler, TV, stereo, not to mention the beautiful balcony - it's all there and will make your stay super comfortable. Ina made sure that someone was there to give us the keys and she was very helpful with all questions I had. Highly, highly recommended!

Great Hostel smack in the middle of berlin! Room was great and the staff were super helpfull and super nice! The shower is a bit lacking but this place goes out of their way to ensure you have a good stay and time!

We had a lovely week in Lothar's big and spacious apartment. It is located in a nice neighborhood very close to many excellent restaurants. Everything was perfect about our stay and we definitely recommend it for anyone visiting Berlin!

Es hat alles prima geklappt. Vor der Tür fahren unmittelbar Straßenbahnen und 70 Meter entfernt befindet sich der Nordbahnhof. Die tolle Anbindung wirkt sich natürlich auf die „Ruhe“ aus. Die Fenster sind aber gut isoliert. Bei rechtzeitiger Anmeldung steht ggf auch ein Parkplatz zur Verfügung.

The house was incredible. It was really well situated, near a great S-Bahn station and some Bus stations that allow you to get to many places in Berlin really easily. It was really big, even more than we expected from the pictures for the place, and very comfortable. It was clean and had everything (except a microwave, but that's something stated in the listing and I'm just too used to have). When we come back to Berlin, we'll definitely try to stay here as well, it was a great experience!
Super bien todo!!

Beautifully designed, tiny studio in a great location. As others have said, it’s a little small for two but if you’re traveling solo or are fine with sharing the small space I highly recommend this rental. Just round the corner from Kulturbraurerei and a ton of cafes, bars, restaurants and parks.

The apartment is spacious, clean and looking great. The beds are comfortable and bedrooms are nice and quiet. Contact with Will was really easy and he responded quickly on any questions.
Definitely worth it!

The space and location isn’t justified until seen in person.
Outstanding and highly recommended to anyone willing to visit Berlin in comfort for a short stay or an extended one.
Conveniently located outside the centre but more than enough access to local transport and necessary amenities to thoroughly enjoy.
Would recommend to anybody to stay here and highly consider staying here again my self.
Super Unterkunft alles top!
넓고, 깨끗하고, 가성비 좋아요! 수건도 넉넉하게 있습니다. 주차도 할 수 있고, 근처에 아시아 및 현지 마트도 다 있고, 저희는 사용하지 않았지만 부엌에 식기류도 충분히 구비되어 있어 음식 해먹기도 좋을 것 같아요. 딱 한 가지 단점은 지하로 내려가는 계단이 지압판처럼 아파서 맨발로는 다니기 힘들었어요ㅎㅎ 그래도 좋은 숙소였습니다 추천해요~

A wonderful place to stay! The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and had all the amenities you could want. David’s instructions for accessing the place were also great and very helpful. The neighborhood is wonderful with lots of restaurants, cafes, and easy access to the tram. Would definitely stay again!

Die Unterkunft war wie erwartet mega Süß eingerichtet, mit ganz viel Liebe zum Detail.
Das kleine Wohnung war sehr sauber und nah an den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln angebunden.
Wir würden jedes mal wieder deine kleine Unterkunft buchen! Vielen lieben Dank das wir deine Gäste sein durften 😊☝🏻
my mum stayed at Ulriks while we visited Berlin. she had a lovely stay and enjoyed Ulrikes hospitality and great hosting. Warm recommendations from us!

Karen was absolutely wonderful; she immediately made me feel at home, answered any questions I had about the neighborhood, and even let me keep my bag with her until I could move it to the next spot. The neighborhood was very nice: quiet, but close to the more vibrant parts of Mitte and within walking distance of downtown.  Great place!
Lovely home, very nice family neighborhood.  Nice personal service from host. I’d highly recommend it.
Zentrale Lage
Mega schönes Hotel in einer alten Schokoladenfabrik.

Appartement très agreable, propre, spacieux, bien équipé.
Tout a fait conforme aux photos. Quartier idéal pour séjourner à Berlin. Communication très facile et efficace avec Berat. Je recommande vivement !

Limehome Berlin is quite nice airbnb, walkable from city center.
The place is suitable for a weekend stay. However the price paid is too expensive for the standing proposed.

Die Wohnung war super! Perfekte Größe für 3 Leute, sauber und schön eingerichtet.
Leider liegt die Wohnung etwas abgelegen in der Ecke Neukölln/Sonnenallee, was nachts alleine als Frau nicht so empfehlenswert ist.
Sonst aber top!

Michael ist ein wahnsinnig toller Gastgeber! Mega freundlich, antwortet schnell, steht mit Rat und Tat zur Seite und die Wohnung ist unglaublich gut ausgestattet. Wir haben uns in den knapp zwei Wochen unfassbar wohl gefühlt und würden sofort jederzeit wieder diese Wohnung nehmen. Auch die Mappe mit allen Hinweisen und Tipps war großartig! Wir können wirklich nur schwärmen.

Die Lage am S-Bahn-Ring ist super, aber für einen warmen Sommer kann ich die Wohnung nicht empfehlen. Die Hitze staut sich insbesondere auf der Galerie, wo die Schlafplätze sind. Die aufgestellten Ventilatoren schaffen leider kaum Abhilfe. Es gibt keine Möglichkeit zum Durchlüften und sobald man den schmalen Fensterschlitz öffnet, ist es gleich sehr laut von der Straße und dem Spielplatz gegenüber. Denn der Spielplatz wird am späten Abend auch von zahlreichen Erwachsenen gerne genutzt.

Spacious and very beautiful apartment on two floors with a great view. The apartment is clean, cares for ecology and extremely comfortable. We found a special welcome packet at the arrival that we appreciated a lot. Quiet and pleasant zone close to the main center, 20 min walk from Alexander Platz; we could avoid using bus or subway that are close indeed. Family friendly house and area. We liked this place very much!!
Wir hatten ein tollen Aufenthalt in einer ruhigen, gepflegten Unterkunft. Die Kommunikation war gut. Vielen Dank!
Good location! Blinds were very see through but apart from that great apartment
Amazing place, levan was very helpful and quick and responsive to anything I needed he is so much appreciated!
Sehr gut erreichbar, sauber und modern.
Excellent location and apartment!
all and all, very nice place. Just a shame that it isn't possible to use the outside area.

Where shall I start or finish . Really felt like Im at home. Such a hospitality and modern treatment. And anything needed anytime the host were available in way that I’m just extending and extending. Thanks , huge thanks to Andrew and his lovely Mother

Birgit es la mejor host que te podría tocar! Me presento a gente, me saco a tomar algo, era súper atenta con todo y divertida.
Gran estadía y el departamento era hermoso, amplio y limpio.

Had a nice three night/four day stay in Berlin. For us the location was excellent as we gladly walk everywhere. I believe there are transport links nearby but we chose to go on foot which is about 30-40 mins to the most popular attractions. Quiet building, nice environment, hostess approachable and available as required. Helpful that we could leave our bags after checkout and before our flight.
Communication from booking/check in instructions all excellent and efficient. No complaints from us and would gladly stay again. Only feedback would be, despite the nicely furnished and decorated apartment, whoever installed the shower in the centre of the bath wasn’t thinking clearly - if you’re over 6ft, it’s awkward but not impossible.
Recommended place to stay. Thanks :)

Was mich am traurigsten und unbehaglichsten machte, war, eine Kamera zu Hause zu haben. Das ist sehr schlecht. Ich konnte mich wirklich nicht wohl fühlen, weil es im Haus eine Kamera gab. Abgesehen von diesem Problem ist die Wohnung wunderschön.
Everything really as it seems in the announcement. Area is super nice and well connected. Recommended
Martha's cosy and stylish appartement has a unique atmosphere. My family and I spent some  wonderful time there and we are very thankful to Martha, who is such an amazing host!

Die Buchung und Kommunikation über die App ging sehr schnell und zuverlässig. Bei Fragen oder wenn Hilfe benötigt wurde, konnte man sich stets auf die Gastgeberin verlassen, welche sehr zuvorkommend und freundlich war. Das Zimmer war sehr schön hergerichtet und das Bett war extrem gemütlich. Tolle Atmosphäre. Alles hat dem Inserat entsprochen. Zweifellos weiterzuempfehlen und beim nächsten Berlinbesuch, werde ich definitiv wieder das Zimmer buchen.
Had an awesome visit. Thank you so much.
Ottima esperienza, unica pecca l’aria condizionata. Comunque consigliatissimo, posizione comoda per girare la città.
small cozy room in great location. Axel is a good host. highly recommend!
The location was very easy to find, very centrally located. The price was very good. It was easy to check in and to find the place. Marc was very friend, helpful and informative.
Wir waren jetzt zum wiederholten Male in dem Appartement und sind gleichbleibend sehr zufrieden.
Prima prijs kwaliteit verhouding. De studio is voorzien van alle comfort. Heel dicht bij winkels en restaurants. Metro heel dichtbij om naar het centrum van Berlijn te gaan.
Alles bestens, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und kommen gern wieder!
Wow! What a beautiful apartment at a great location. Well decorated & super clean. Going to Berlin? Go sleep here.
Great place, thank you!
Tolle Location, moderne Einrichtung, sauber, gute Küchenausstattung. Die Wohnung ist zu empfehlen und enttäuscht nicht. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
We had some issues with the key box so we couldn’t access the appartement. Katerina was really helpful and friendly. She find us an hotel at 1am and we stayed there until the end of our vacation.

The Central Atelier is really tastefully decorated and well equipped.
Because of big family, the only things we missed were dishwasher and and microwave owen.
Great value for a cosy place in a good location with excellent transport links into the city centre

Spacious apartment in a great location with a charming balcony and all necessary amenities. The host has a casual, informal communication style. Though not shown in the listing photos, there is one bedroom that remains locked and inaccessible during your stay. Also, the apartment gets very bright at night from street lighting, and only has light curtains, which may be problematic for light sleepers. Even though there are stairs to reach the apartment, I would recommend for the location and amenities.

Ivos was good host and very communicative. The apartment was nice and it was in a centrally located area with great access to public transportation. The only downside was that we came during a minor heat wave and had to keep the windows open at night which was very noisy because of the street traffic.

A beautiful home with friendly hosts and a calm, but ever-so-slightly bohemian environment. The perfect place to rest & reset after a long day buzzing about town. Would highly recommend! Thank you G & I!
Amazing Flat so relaxing place  top top top book

We were so thankful to stay in Victor's place for the last few months. It was very comfortable and very well organized and spacious.  It was the perfect place to be with our family and to enjoy life. We found Victor very helpful with whatever we needed.  He is positive, helpful and responsive. Really just a wonderful experience and because of Victor we were able to enjoy this place for so long.
everything was great! will be happy to come back again

spacious bathroom with washing machine and dryer which are very useful for us. very close to amenities, shopping centre and U +S bahn. Marcus gave a great introduction to his apartment during our check-in and was ready to reply our queries.

Unterkunft war sehr sauber, ruhig. Vom Komfort her das bare minimum, im Zimmer nur Bett & Tisch mit Sessel. Nur 2 Steckdosen. Sanitärräume sehr sauber, wobei die Dusche leider ziemlich gestunken hat und schwer abgeflossen ist. Der Check-In war okay, wobei die Rezeptionistin leider etwas unfreundlich war. Easy Checkout.
I recommend this place to everyone. We were 5, feeling spr comfortable and at home. Close to subway, clean and beautiful.

Super Lage, super Gastgeber*in!
Eine schöne, ruhige Umgebung, von der man trotzdem flott in das Zentrum Berlin gelangen kann. Die Unterkunft selbst war sauber und gemütlich und hielt alle Versprechen.
Die Gastgeber*innen waren äußerst zuvorkommend und hilfsbereit, insgesamt herrschte eine total entspannte Stimmung!
Gerne wieder :)

Wir waren vor einer Woche in Berlin und ich habe mich super wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung war super sauber und alles wichtige war vorhanden. Ebenfalls ist die Lage echt top. Sie sind beide super nette Gastgeber und haben unsere Fragen super schnell beantwortet. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Great apartment and super friendly host

The apartment is in a perfect location.

Philipp’s house is very convenient and a lovely space. The garden is also delightful we enjoyed all of it.
Takk for ett fint opphold ✨
Très bon logement, agréable et situé à proximité des lignes de bus pour rejoindre le centre de Berlin. Je recommande !

Victorias Wohnung ist ein Traum! Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt, die Kommunikation war unkompliziert und super zuvorkommend. Ideale Lage direkt an der M10 (ohne Umstieg direkt zum HBF. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Pascale is a great host - very helpful and responsive to questions. We had a problem with one of the bathrooms when we were there and she got it sorted very quickly. Good location. Nice and peaceful. Easy transport into town and walkable shops and eateries etc. The apartment is her family home and it was nice to stay in a place that was a home rather than just somewhere that is only used as an AirBnB. Lots of charachter. Lovely balcony looking onto really nice communal gardens. Nice place to have breakfast (we were lucky with the weather!). Would stay there again and would recommend to others.
Nice space, young crowd. Staff asks for an ID number at check in, which isnt usual
Miejsce godne polecenia.
Esther ist eine sehr herzliche Gastgeberin. Ich habe mich bei ihr sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist sauber und zentral gelegen.

Fue todo bien, único problema fue la llegada. Pero dado que llegamos el día 1 de enero a mediodía se podía entender.
Très bon séjour
Muy agradable el departamento y los anfitriones, muy buena ubicación y comunicación, feliz en quedarnos nuevamente
Es war ein toller Aufenthalt. Besonders das Bad war toll. Das Zimmer entspricht nicht ganz den hochgeladenen Bildern, aber das war kein Problem. Ich würde wieder herkommen.
Really enjoyed my stay. Had everything I needed and was nice and clean. Definitely recommended.

Der Aufenthalt verlief reibungslos, die Kommunikation war sehr gut und die Wohnung wie beschrieben :) Für einen Wochenendausflug nach Berlin gut geeignet. Mit der Tram ist man auch sehr schnell in Friedrichshain, am Hbf und weiteren Vierteln.
Wir kommen gern wieder, es war perfekt für unseren Trip zu viert 👍🏽

Esperienza fantastica. Ho usufruito della camera per 2 notti, abbiamo trovato una camera e un bagno super puliti e comodi.

L'host super disponibile e amichevole

Proactive, friendly and helpful people on site helped with check-in process.
Es war richtig schön. Sauber stilvoll und alles was man brauchte war vorhanden. Immer wieder gerne.

We had a wonderful one-week stay at Nathalie's studio apartment. She also provided a very early check in for us after our overnight flight from New York. Everything was exactly as shown and clean. Our recommendations would be for a loveseat or couch in the apartment. Currently there isn't one and we really could not relax there in the afternoon. A toaster and possibly a television would also be great. Lots of steps (5th floor walk-up) so if you have mobility issues this is not the place for you. Thank you Nathalie for your hospitality.

Vielen Dank Brigitte für die Unterkunft. Brigitte war sehr flexibel mit dem Check In. Alles sauber und freundlich. War ein guter Stay für eine Nacht, um von dort am nächsten Morgen zum Flughafen zu kommen.
Das Bett war sogar neuer und gemütlicher als es auf den Fotos aussieht.
heerlijke uitvalsbasis om berlijn te bezoeken
Sehr sauberes und aufgeräumtes Apartment mit freundlichem und hilfsbereiten Personal im Büro. Gerne wieder!

Die Lage der Wohnung ist ein Traum!!! Man ist super schnell am Tempelhofer Feld und in Kreuzberg drin, sehr gut Richtung Alexanderplatz angebunden. Das Zimmer ist richtig schön hell und Jo super unkompliziert und nett. Er raucht, was man im Flur auch sehr riecht. Aber im Zimmer, im Bad und in der Küche ist das unproblematisch :)

The space is a gorgeous loft that FEELS like a place you make art.
