The space has most everything you need there for you, and the neighborhood truly was fantastic.
If you want to get some peace while you’re in Berlin, this place is a great get away
A well kept , quiet place to stay. Thank you for hosting us!
Highly recommend a stay at Arno’s house. Charming property with everything you need and close to bars and restaurants.

La habitación es enorme! Muy bien equipada, tiene todo lo necesario para estar tranquilo. Dawid mantiene todo con extrema limpieza y orden. Si volvemos nos hospedaremos sin dudar en este lugar.

appartement petit mais très bien agencé, cosy, moderne et très propre, idéal pour 2 mais à 3 avec le canapé c'est très bien aussi, nous avons pu arriver vers midi et profiter de suite de Berlin, bien situé pour visiter avec le métro pas loin, une bouteille de vin et des chocolats étaient en cadeau de bienvenue, dans une arrière cours très tranquille et sécurisée, je reviendrais volontiers.

Muy agusto, agradable, buena limpieza y todo muy bien. Un gusto poder alojarnos en su alojamiento. Un saludo

Was a nice experience, clean and friendly receptionist, everybody helpful, just they book me wrong, and one night I didn’t have place to sleep, that was a problem, and the price was different To the airbnb, 27.00 was here and there was 38.00, but in all the other things was good, confortable and nice location.

Wir wurden (trotz starker Verspätung durch die DB) super freundlich mit Tee und Kaffee empfangen. Uta hat uns gerne gute Spots in Berlin empfohlen, proaktiv sowie auf Nachfrage. Wir haben uns jederzeit Willkommen gefühlt und hatten nicht das Gefühl in jemandes Privatsphäre einzudringen. Uta ist außerdem eine sehr gute Gesprächspartnerin. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
great location, cute and cosy apartment, lovely host

Wir hatten einen super Aufenthalt hier! Die Kommunikation mit den Hosts war sehr klar und sie haben schnell auf Fragen geantwortet. Die Wohnung ist klein, aber schön eingerichtet und hat alles, was man braucht. Vielen Dank!
Saubere sehr ruhige Wohnung in zentraler Lage. Die Kommunikation war einfach und effizient.

Hôte très accueillante et souriante (ainsi que ces deux chiens très mignons). Le logement proposé correspond parfaitement à l'annonce. Proche d'un arrêt de bus et de tram, nous avons pu accéder facilement au centre ville de Berlin. Logement très agréable à vivre avec tout les équipements nécessaires pour un bon séjour. Nous n'hésiterons pas à reprendre ce logement pour notre prochain séjour à Berlin :)
Nice place to stay

Das Zimmerwar großzügig und geräumig. Es ist schon etwas in die Jahre gekommen, hat aber Charme.

Very central and clean, this hostel provides room to socialize. Only negative point being, thin walls get shaken by door slams in the night, which can interrupt your sleep.
It was really easy to check in, really close to public transport , Restaurants and shops, a good Environment i will book it again

A clean and warm house. The location is very convenient, there are many bus, underground station nearby and so do many good restaurants and supermarkets. The sofa in the house is really comfortable. There are many chairs and a large table in the house, so my roommate and I could comfortably sit and eat dinner and do things at it. You can find almost everything you need in the house!
Die Unterkunft hat ein sehr bequemes Bett und eine wunderbare Lage. Es hat alles was man braucht, um ein paar entspannte Tage in Berlin zu haben.
Love the place and the neighborhood ! Great place to stay

Un alojamiento muy bien comunicado, en una zona donde abundan los servicios, como bares, restaurantes y supermercados.
El apartamento es amplio y está bien equipado.

Evin büyüklüğü , metro hattına yakınlığı , çevresindeki rest, market vs olarak çok iyi , ev ile ilgili tek sıkıntı internet sorunuydu , internet sorunluydu , ev sahibine bildirdik ancak çözüm bulamadı . Ama genel olarak konaklamadan memnun kaldık .

The stay was great and we loved the typical Berlin apartment. The Check-in was easy and comfortable and we received perfect instructions. We were in the apartment over Christmas and it was even decorated and we got some chocolates and sweets. So nice!
I am sure we will stay here again.

Hannes war ein super Gastgeber,  man hat sich direkt fast wie zu Hause gefühlt. Er teilte mit uns Essen aus seinem Kühlschrank und er hat exzellenten Kaffee =) Ansonsten ist die Wohnung super gelegen, nahe dem Boxhagener Platz, da das Zimmer zum Innenhof liegt ist es aber auch ruhig genug, dass man gut schlafen kann. Einziger kleiner Minuspunkt ist, dass Hannes zwar auf dem Balkon raucht, der Rauch aber bei offener Balkontür bis ins Zimmer zieht. Da uns der Rauch nicht so sehr gestört hat, haben wir es nicht angesprochen. Ich bin mir sicher, dass man das mit Hannes hätte klären können. Alles in allem super Aufenthalt, ich würde wieder kommen!

גרנו בבית של קטרינה יותר משבוע. נהננו מהבית עצמו שבמציאות נראה אפילו יותר יפה מאשר בתמונות, מהסביבה הירוקה, מהשקט. היינו עם ילדים קטנים, הם בילו זמן רב בגינה - בארגז חול, טרמפולינה, בריכה קטנה, נדנדה, בית בעץ גבוהה. בתוך הבית גם היה הכל לילדים - ספרים, צעצועים, דפי יצירה ועוד. בית עצמו מאובזר בהכל כולל מדיח כלים שזה היה תענוג. אפשר לגור שם ולא להצטרך כלום. קטרינה ובעלה היו מאוד נדיבים - נתנו מענה לכל שאלה ובקשה שלנו. צ'ק אין וצ'ק אוט מאוד פשוטים. עזבנו את מקום בלילה ולא הייתה שום בעיה.
נסיעה ממרכז ברלין קצת ארוכה - בערך שעה אבל מי שמחפש מקום ירוק, שקט ויפה, יתאים לו מאוד.
אם לחזור לברלין - לחזור לבית של קטרינה.
Easy access to local transportion and restaurants. Good to work with.  Thanks
Great location and very good host
War sehr gut. Gerne wieder

My husband & I stayed at this location for the Berlin Marathon & found it easily accessible to everything we needed using public transportation. There were good food options within walking distance along with a grocery & drugstore so I could stock up & eat in. I loved having a bathtub & found the bed to be very comfortable. I did not use the loft upstairs, but the stairs leading to it are very narrow & the space is small. It’s not suitable for small children or adults. Maybe kids between 9-13. One of the perks is that there is a lot of natural light, but if you’re sensitive to that in the morning, bring an eye mask. The U train was right down the street & from it & you can get anywhere you need to go. The area wasn’t crowded either. Keep in mind, you do have to walk up 4 flights of stairs to get there. It didn’t bother us though & I would absolutely stay again.

We are so grateful about everything about this apartment, the location is perfect, very close to a metro station well comunicated with the center of Berlin.Also, Sebastian was a perfect host, the apartment looks the same as it seems on the photos.

Nous avons passé un super séjour chez Susann. Elle a été très accueillante et de bons conseils. L’appartement est impeccable et la chambre confortable.
Le lieu est bien placé, ce qui nous a permis de facilement explorer Berlin. Merci encore !
Andreas was a very welcoming host! The room is great, clean, and it has pretty much anything you might need for a short stay. The location is great as well and the neighbourhood is beautiful.
It’s a private room in a pension with shared kitchen and bathroom. Location is amazing, really well connected and with a lot places to eat nearby
Laurie’s place was very nice in a lovely part of town…we enjoyed our stay very much!
Had a fantastic stay here, a really cosy and comfortable apartment that is easy to get to and close to plenty of great places to eat and drink
Really lovely and clean apartment with all of the amenities you need if you’re visiting Berlin or in between locations.

Wir hatten einen fantastischen Aufenthalt. Wir waren zu früh und haben ein wunderbares Brunch im Restaurant genossen. Die Kommunikation mit Daniel war hervorragend und war immer erreichbar. Absolute Empfehlung. Tolle Gegend, wunderbare und liebevolle Wohnung.

Ich hatte für eine Nacht gebucht und war sehr zufrieden. Die Lage der Wohnung ist super, die Unterkunft war wie beschrieben und es gab ausreichend Platz für die persönlichen Dinge.
Hannes war sehr gut erreichbar, der Check-in war unkompliziert und flexibel.
Ich komme gerne wieder und kann diese Unterkunft definitiv empfehlen!

Jurgen and his son was super friendly.  We really enjoyed talking to him.His place was exactly like the pics. Everything look modern.  We feel really welcome and comfortable at his place .  His place is close to a lot of the attractions.  We would love to stay at his place again.

Ein sehr nettes Zimmer in angenehmer Umgebung; Von der Wohnung aus blickt man auf die Spree mit East Side Gallery. Tritt man aus dem Haus, ist es nicht weit zu den Cafés & Kneipen von Kreuzberg. Auch die U-Bahn ist zu Fuß in 2 Minuten erreichbar. Also alles wunderbar!
Amazing spacious arty loft in direct city location. Love the black bathroom! Easy communication, everything in perfect condition super clean felt like in a hotel suit. Highly recommended

El departamento es recomendable, se encuentra en una buena ubicación, muy cerca de los subtes, es muy cómodo y con todo lo necesario para una estadía agradable. El trato de la anfitriona fue el esperado. Recomendamos tener las precauciones necesarias al transportarse en el subte, sufrimos el hurto del teléfono celular, hecho que nos generó muchos inconvenientes. Por lo demás todo muy bien.

Pia’s appartement is very clean and complete. It is a very nice place to come back to after a long day sightseeing Berlin. The area is very friendly and close to the s- bahn. We are surely coming back
Sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtete kleine Wohnung!
Hält, was es verspricht
Clean and cosy apartment in a great location. All necessary amenities for a short stay. Thanks!
Appartement très spacieux et situé près des transports en commun pour rejoindre le centre et les divers lieux à visiter. Jorn et Zahid très réactifs et de bons conseils.

Zimmer war gut, das Bett auch.
Leider scheinte das Licht Nachts vom Flur ins Zimmer, die anderen Gäste habe leider die Tür dolle geknallt! Die Badezimmer waren leider auch nicht so!

Simon is a very great host. He welcomed us when check in, and explain important things about the city. The apt is so neat and clean and modern and big and amazing.. we love it! Simon provide us the baby cot as requested, very nice :)
The big supermarket is only 1km away, and the bus/train station is only about 250m walk.. Overall, we had a good time here..
Thanks Simon!

It was great meeting Birgit and stay in her rooom. I had great talks with her, and she gave me good local advice, and we talked great drinking coffe together on a local cafe. Her room and she is just great. Thanks :-)

The stay exceeded all of our expectations - the room and bathroom were neat, tidy, all amenities were available, everything was thought out by the homeowners. The place is easy to reach by public transport. There are no grocery stores in walking distance, but they can be easily reached with public transport, which is situated just 3 minutes away from the house. There is a lot of greenery around the area, with a big park just outside the house. The area in general is nice, clean and quiet.
The homeowners (the entire family) deserves a special mention - they are one of the most friendliest people we have ever met, they are incredibly warm, welcoming, accommodating, very cultured and very well behaved, very social and talkative but give all the privacy and space you need for yourself.
Highest recommendations for anyone looking for an amazing place to stay in Berlin! We came looking for copper, but found gold :)
Eine sehr schöne Unterkunft . Gute Unterkunft und freundlicher Vermieter

We werden netjes opgevangen door Alan. Hij gaf ons goed uitleg over de mogelijkheden in Berlijn. Er lag al een toeristenkaartje klaar, handig! Het appartement is precies goed en van alle gemakken voorzien. En alles was redelijk nieuw, dat was fijn. We konden onze auto prima kwijt voor de deur. Aanrader!
Alles super und empfehlenswert - immer wieder gerne.
Es war richtig toll, genau, wie beschrieben: Ruhig, eine Oase inmitten der Großstadt. Völlig problemlose An- und Abreise. Gerne wieder.

Place was gorgeous. Neighbourhood was great, just as advertised. Entrance to the apartment was long and dark but that's part of the charm and definitely the standard in Berlin. I would definitely stay again and recommend to anyone. Host also gave great reviews for restaurants and area. Only thing is it would've been nice to have a full length mirror in the airbnb but that's on me as it was not advertised.
Alles top !

Ich habe knapp 4 Wochen bei Christoph und Katharina verbracht. Ich habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt, die Wohnung ist gemütlich und sehr gut ausgestattet. Die Kommunikation lief immer gut und reibungslos und alle Fragen und Probleme haben die beiden beantwortet bzw. gelöst.
Klare Empfehlung!
The house is close to the metro and the park, the surroundings are quiet and communication with the owner is smooth

My room had the street view which gave it a nice airy feel but a little traffic noise came with it,the bedroom itself was spacious and the bed very comfortable.
A great place for a short stay as long as guests in all 4 rooms respect each other ,are as quiet as possible and use the amenities for the minimum time required.

Staying at Christoff's & Irene's was perfect! The location was lovely itself and only a short train ride from the centre. The room was perfect and the kitchen had everything needed to cook ourselves. Would definitely stay again! Thank you

Really enjoyed the stay! The only note I would make would be to bring eye masks because a lot of light gets through the curtains when the sun is up. Otherwise, the area was lovely and super accessible, and we really enjoyed meeting the cleaner and chatting with him. Would definitely recommend this stay.

We enjoyed our stay at Simone's lovely apartment in Berlin. It was exactly as described in the photographs, was quiet and contained everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Simone was a very responsive, kind and friendly host and it was a pleasure dealing with her. We would definitely consider staying at Simone's apartment again.

Tanja war eine tolle Gastgeberin und es hat uns an nichts gefehlt. Besonders gut hat mir die Ausstattung der Küche inklusive einiger Lebensmittel gefallen. Die Wohnung befindet sich in einer top Lage in Schöneberg und wir haben es genossen, dass sich außerdem direkt um die Ecke zwei Spielplätze befunden haben. Sehr weiterzuempfehlen. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
I had an amazing stay at Max's place! Would highly recommend it. The apartment was very nice for our needs and everything worked as it should. Looking forward to staying here again. 10/10!

Die Wohnung ist schön und wie auf den Bildern. Durch die Lage im Hinterhaus ist es relativ ruhig, obwohl man sehr zentral ist. Die Küche ist sehr rar mit Kochutensilien ausgestattet, aber es geht irgendwie. Zum Einkaufen ist der Rewe direkt gegenüber super; parken ist eher schwierig. Die Kommunikation mit den Vermietern war leider nicht gut, weil teilweise keine Antwort kam. Der Check-In war dementsprechend etwas schwierig. Aber sobald das geschafft war, war alles gut mit der Wohnung.

Florentine’s place was perfect as a first-time visitor in Berlin who didn’t want to be in the middle of a metropolitan craze. Her flat is in a beautiful neighborhood in Kreuzberg and extremely convenient for venturing outwards with good food and markets nearby within walking distance  Florentine is a lovely host and makes you feel safe and welcome. The room is also spacious with a comfortable large bed. She has lovely and respectful children who come by now and again.
we liked the stay, the host was kind,  responsive and hospitable. can recommend and would stay again
Amazing, thanks for being such an amazing host

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour. Le logement est super, propre et bien desservi par les transports.
Très bonne communication avec Mina aussi, qui a été soucieuse que tout se passe bien à notre arrivée. Merci pour ça ! Nous avons aussi pu profiter de la cours extérieure, avec le beau temps, qui est bien agréable !
Le seul petit bémol si il faut en noter un est peut être la proximité avec les autres logements en location. Certains voisins ne sont pas toujours soucieux des autres et parlent très forts au téléphone (en haut parleur) tôt le matin et tard le soir à l’extérieur.

Martin is a super host. He was very flexible and helpful both before and during our stay. The apartment was clean, warm and had everything we needed.  The location is good and there are nice restaurants and shops nearby. The nearest tube station is 10 minutes away, which isn't too far if you don't mind walking -- I'd have preferred it to be a bit closer, to be honest. All in all, we had a great experience!

Ich habe die Gastfreundschaft von Kim sehr genossen. Das Zimmer war genau so, wie es beschrieben war und der Checkin hat problemlos funktioniert. Es war alles sauber und für Neukölln erstaunlich ruhig gelegen. Ich werde gerne wieder bei Kim übernachten.

The apartment is lovely. Everything you need is there.Iliana worked around us and was very helpful. The location was not as central to the hub of Berlin as I had hoped. but other than this we were very happy.
Danke für den super Aufenthalt. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder zu Euch!

I really had an awesome stay at Ernst's apartment! It is centrally located in the best area in Berlin, close by supermarkets, public transportation, as well as affordable bars and restaurants. Ernst prepared a map that makes it easy to find everything nearby, which was really helpful to get to know the surroundings. The area is lively and dynamic and close to the canal, where you can go for a relaxing walk at night. Communication with Ernst was always good and he is always there if you need some tips and recommendations on what to do. The apartment was clean and the room is quite big, so you feel comfortable. If you're planning a trip to Berlin, you should definitely consider staying at Ernst's place!

Die Wohnung liegt in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße im Prenzlauer Berg. In wenigen Gehminuten sind die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel sowie allerlei Einkaufsmöglickheiten erreichbar. Die Unterkunfst selbst ist super gemütlich und es fehlt wirklich an nichts. Katja und Bernd haben uns sehr freundlich empfangen und uns noch mit einigen Tipps versorgt. Alles in allem eine sehr empfehlenswerte Unterkunft.

Single room STUDIO apartment. We missed that on the description when booking this place. Though it is a very spacious single room, when staying with our young boy, we were missing a separate room. We made do, as there was still plenty of living space. For more than 1 or 2 people for over a week of time, I think we may have fair bettered somewhere else. The futon and bed were “alright” for comfort, and the pillows need an upgrade. We also just weren’t accustom to the more european sleeping arrangements.
That said, everything else about the space was absolutely perfect. The kitchen is well stocked enough to handle leftovers and the basics. The bathtub is a really welcome retreat.
And the biggest positive to give this place, the location is perfect for those wishing to explore all the excitement Berlin has to offer.

Wir hatten eine gute Zeit im Apartment von Alan & Kasia. Die Lage war sehr gut und zum parken ist die Straße auch sehr gut. Nur nachts ist es direkt neben der Straße evtl etwas laut. Kommunikation ging problemlos. Wir können das Apartment sehr weiterempfehlen!
Great place to stay in Berlin. 👍🏻
Logement impeccable, bien équipé et qui correspondait à la description et aux photos.

Wir hatten ein paar großartige Tage in der superschönen Unterkunft und konnten Berlin richtig genießen. Wir haben uns sofort zuhause und willkommen gefühlt. Alles lief reibungslos und auch die Kommunikation war klasse. Danke für eine tolle Zeit!
alles bestens danke

Das Zimmer war ganz geschmackvoll eingerichtet und das Bett sehr bequem!!

Ich hatte einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt in dieser Unterkunft. Die Wohnung war sauber, ruhig und gut ausgestattet. Insgesamt alles gut.
Alles super! Gerne wieder!
Would highly recommend Robert’s place! It’s very stylish and clean and Robert gives great tips of the city and always goes above and beyond to accommodate you!

Pleasant stay in a spacious, well-situated apartement. Rough outside only adds charm to the modern inside. Björn friendly and punctual. We couldn't find a corkscrew but the bartender at Zaza came to assistance and saved our evening;) Perfectly calm and quiet at night.

Good accommodation. The place is located next to 2 U-Bahn stations, therefore allowing east access to the entire city. Another positive of its location: safety. It is located across the street from the Deutsche Opera on a well lit street. The neighborhood is nice and quite in the morning hours of the weekend, and there is little noise in the night, as it isn’t located above or near to any loud nightclubs. The room is comfortable and spacious. Despite its small size, it can accommodate 2 people comfortably. The apartment is equipped with everything you need: Dishes, silverware, towels, internet. A nice addition is a private bathroom. For those looking for an entire place for yourself without overspending your budget, this is a great find. For the price, I can highly recommend it.

Eine tolle Unterkunft in Oasenflair und das in Berlin. Nette Gastfreundschaft und super Tips.
Sehr zu empfehlen!!

Très bon accueil chaleureux.
Logement et environnement très agréable.
Je recommande vivement.

Great place to stay in Berlin with lots of restaurants and things to do nearby, very walkable with easy connections to Ubahn. Hotel was clean and had a nice private terrace area and lobby. Staff was responsive and offered great price for late check out.

Andreas' old, very beautiful and carefully decorated apartment is not only huge, it makes you feel at home in a way only few houses do; you do not want to leave there! The bedrooms are bright and open, the kitchen and bathroom have everything you could wish for (including a great caffee-machine!), and the apartment is so big that you feel free and unrestrained - even if you are with five, such as we were. The apartment is located in the midst of Schönebergs Akazien-Kiez, where the atmosphere is very friendly and cosy. You get everything you want (bio food, nice book/clothing/otherwise shops, restaurants), just around the corner and U/S-Bahn connections are plenty. Andreas himself is very much like his apartment; an old soul, very warm and friendly! When we arrived all rooms were decorated with little bottles with flowers, there was wine in the fridge and he made sure that we would use his oils, coffee and other basic stuff so that we wouldn't have to buy any and then throw it away again. He is very kind and generous and makes you feel comfortable, taken care off and at home. I have nothing but good words for Andreas and his apartment, and would warmly recommend it to anyone who would want to enjoy a wonderful stay in Berlin city!
Alles war wie beschrieben und sehr ordentlich:) die Lage war auch sehr gut ☺️

Perfect stay. The appartment is actually great, I would live there.
Everything was super clean and there were actually some brand new utensils in the kitchen.
The appartment is bigger than what it looks in the photos for me. It's a big open space with a lot of natural light.
The personal in the hostel is helpful and cheerful all the time, and Mina is always very responsive to help you online.
I liked the zone, because you have all what you need nearby, with supermarkets, restaurants of all kinds, a park, the metro station and buses, but it is also true that it's not the most beautiful zone of the city for me.
Very nice location. More spacious than we thought :-)

Mi estancia ha sido estupenda. El apartamento está muy bien diseñado para mantener la privacidad del anfitrión y del huésped. El lugar de encuentro, la cocina, resulta muy agradable.
Peter se ha esforzado por hacerme fácil la estancia, con amabilidad y respeto. Todo ha ido sobre ruedas.
La situación del apartamento es óptima. Está en una zona tranquila y muy agradable para pasear, y al mismo tiempo a 10-12 minutos andando para acceder a la red pública de transporte (bus o metro).
Hatte erst übersehen, dass die Küche und das Bad „shared“ sind. War aber  lustig und haben nur nette Menschen dort getroffen, es war alles top!

Die Unterkunft ist ideal für den Berlinreisenden. U-Bahn und S-Bahn vor dem Haus, zum Alex ein Katzensprung.
Und dann gut und komfortabel untergebracht, was will man mehr? Meine klare Empfehlung!

Best Place to stay in Town!

Alles super geklappt.
Das Zimmer ist sauber, Bett sehr bequem. Check-In hat ohne Probleme geklappt. Nicky war sehr freundlich und ein sehr guter Gastgeber.

Roumianas Haus ist perfekt und liegt wenige Gehminuten vom S-Bahnhof entfernt. Wir haben 5 Tage dort verbracht und wirklich jeder in unserer 5-koepfigen Gruppe war aeusserst zufrienden. Roumiana hat stets umgehend auf Fragen geantwortet und war sehr hilfsbereit. Das Haus hat alles (und noch viel mehr) was man braucht. Die Ausstattung ist top und der Garten eine wahre Oase. Notre séjour dans l'appartement de Dietrich a été excellent l'appartement est très agréable proche de nombreuses lignes de tramway et un métro. Tout a fait conforme aux photos.

Dietrich est super agréable et reactif et nous avons bien communiqué.
Merci pour tout
Perfect place to visit and enjoy Berlin, the area is full of bars and restaurants and perfectly connected to the transportation system. A great choice for a short stay

The location was ideal - a short walk from U-Mehringdamm and even shorter walk to all the bars and restaurants on Bergmannstr. The room was simply but comfortably equipped, with nice large windows that overlooked the courtyard allowing both fresh air and privacy; the bathroom was clean and spacious, with good water pressure in the shower, which got hot right away. The shower head started spraying water on the floor at some point, which they couldn't address during our stay but was not a problem once they brought extra towels. Ella was very friendly and responsive through the app whenever we needed anything like extra towels or pillows. We would definitely stay here again!
Perfect location close everywhere and very nice neighbourhood

Bel appartement proche de tout ce que l’on peut voir à Berlin.

einfache, aber völlig ausreichende und saubere wohnung in sehr guter lage (bus direkt vor der tür) und mit sehr bequemen betten. alles wunderbar. danke!

Great location and place!
Very clean and eaay to access place, within easy access of all public transport across berlin. A comfortable and effortless stay
Nice area and cool apartment. Julia is really helpfull

Perfect spot for Kreutzberg and good bus and metro connections to Berlin Hbf. Very kind and welcoming host. The flat has everything you need and is fully equiped. It is also arty, like the host says, and is something else and extraordinary. So in all, a great experience and stay! Thank you Aaron!
Tolle Wohnung + Toller Gastgeber

Had an amazing stay with Giulia! Fantastic host - so friendly and helpful, and offered us lots of recommendations for our stay. Great location of flat- only a 10 minute walk into the centre. Would 10/10 recommend!!

Das Zimmer war sehr schön. Die Lage ist wunderbar (mit Bus und Bahn ca. 20-30 Minuten ins Stadtzentrum).
Das Zimmer ist sehr schön eingerichtet und in der Küche findet man alles was man zu kochen braucht.

Sehr saubere Unterkunft in Berlin, ziemlich zentral und man könnte innerhalb von 20-30min zu jedem zentralen Ort gehen.
Joao war sehr hilfreich und hat den check-in und check-out sehr sehr einfach gemacht.
Ich würde seine Apartments definitiv weiterempfehlen.

zeer net appartement, wat verder gelegen van het centrum, maar dat is op te lossen middels openbaar vervoer.

Sehr gute Unterkunft zum Top-Preis.

Britta und Axel sind die perfekten Gastgeber - unheimlich nett, fürsorglich ohne aufdringlich zu sein, herzlich und rundum freundlich. Wir haben uns wie bei guten Freunden gefühlt und kommen auf jeden Fall wieder.
Das Boot ist ein absoluter Knaller! Schon nach dem ersten Tag haben wir angefangen zu überlegen, ob wir uns nicht selbst ein Hausboot zulegen wollen ;-). Die Ruhe, der Ausblick, die Einrichtung, das sanfte Schaukeln - es war Urlaub pur! Ein Sprung in die Spree hat das Sommerfeeling vollendet. If you need some snacks or quick food items, there's a Rewe a few perpendicular streets up (the intersection of Wrangelstraße and Falckensteinstraße), which is a market that sells food and other basic needs. When I was having a hard time pressing in my code to get into the building for the first time, Stella (the proprietor) magically appeared behind me and righted me - turns out I couldn't read/follow the directions that were plainly posted right above the keypad (that's my bad :D). The overhead shower felt palatial and the heated bedroom floor!!!! SO COMFY.

Jan’s apartment was very cute! Check in was very easy and straightforward. The Location is very central and close to lots of food, shopping and a close walk to public transport. The room was very clean and spacious. We felt very safe and comfortable. Definitely a great place to stay when visiting Berlin or surrounding areas. Public transport to main destinations around Berlin was super easy and the neighborhood itself was clean, safe and cute!
The apartment was exactly as expected. Very clean and fresh. Marion and Wolfgang were very friendly and helpful 💕

I loved staying here! Super affordable, easy check in and somewhat central to everything. There is lots to do in Berlin so it’s hard to pinpoint one place to stay. This spot was really close to all the public transport and my Uber was no more than 10€! The place itself was very clean and homey

Very spacious with three separate bedrooms - very rare . It was recently updated and everything worked and was very clean. Our only wish was a clothes washer as we were traveling lighter using trains for transportation. Good communication . Thanks !

alles ganz wunderbar und unkompliziert

The place was really great, clean and ideal for my stay. Michaela was very responsive and helpful. I had a great stay. I would definitely recommend the place to everyone, especially if you have an appointment for US Visa. US Consulate is at a walking distance.

Hotel tres bien situé, proche du metro dans un quartier très vivant, bar, resto, fripes, boutiques.

Super Lage, perfekt, wenn man Carsharing nutzen möchte. Man findet immer ein Fahrzeug in der Nähe und auch immer einen Platz, um anschließend zu parken. Great stay!

Tolle, kleine Wohnung zentral im Westen von Berlin in einer guten Gegend. Check-in war einfach, WLAN war super. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber. Die Ausstattung war auch ok.

We were a group of 4 and all loved our stay. The apartment is clean, well appointed, lovely & spacious, and the location is great. Cafes & bars & supermarket all on the doorstep, trams directly outside, the underground train station 1min walk, and an easy pleasant walk to Alexanderplatz.
Merlin is a great host too. Highly recommended.

cozy, well located, newly renovated apartment. Comfortable beds, well equipped kitchen and nice bathroom.

Die Unterkunft bei Joanna und Christoph ist wunderschön grün gelegen (mitten auf dem Grundstück der Beiden), dabei ruhig und mit viel geschaffener Privatsphäre. Die Unterkunft war super sauber und in unseren Augen geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Die Küche lies auch in puncto Ausstattung keine Wünsche offen. Wir kommen sehr gern wieder!
Appartement

What an amazing experience this was! This apartment has it all! We were greeted by their amazing housemaid who was cleaning the place as we
arranged an early bag drop arrival beforehand. We came back then at the appointed time for full handover and the place was spotless.
The bed is so comfortable, shower is amazing! Lots of foodstuffs were provided and what we didn't have we purchased easily in the
Alexa store nearby. Netflix and Prime are available which was great! The balcony is fantastic just to chill and read. Also it is very secure.
The owners were very communicative and had all the information we needed ready for us.
The area itself is so central, a short walk from Alexanderplatz and TV Tower. We actually walked to Checkpoint Charlie, Hitlerbunker,
Brandenburg Gate and Tiergarten and back again in one of our days!
A really special place, which I would highly recommend!

Sanja is very welcoming - she is responsive, the communication is easy, she made sure I have my own space in the kitchen, in the fridge and in the bathroom. She even shared the cake she made with me. The whole apartment has been exceptionally clean and had remained so during my 9-day stay. While she is at home, she is very quiet and respects your private time and space.
The room is spacious, there's sufficient space for luggage and a hanger, and the bed is reasonably comfortable.
The tram stops in front of the building are great when you need to catch a ride, but otherwise quite noisy, even with the windows closed. The trams run the whole night and cross the tram tracks of the other lines, which gets very loud. But if you are fine with the city traffic noise, you will feel at home :)
P.S: There's a construction site in the inner courtyard - I did not hear any noise coming from this side during my stay, and I did not mind it.
Me gustó mucho Grand Hostal , buena ubicación,  el personal muy excelente,  todo limpio , regresaría nuevamente

Marcel's apartment is in the perfect location, between Kreuzberg and Neuköln, steps away from a metro station and surrounded by great restaurants, cafés, shops.

Great apartment and ideal for maximum 04 persons. Would definitely recommend this apartment. Thanks Bernardo...all the best.

My friend and I had a lovely stay at this cute & sunny apartment in Berlin! The space is gorgeous- it was clean, comfortable, stylish, and well-appointed with everything we needed and more. Sehr schönes und geräumiges Zimmer und eigenes Bad in privatem Wohnhaus. Gut ausgestattet und ruhig. Sehr nette Gastgeberin!

Annette was an excellent host and helped us with a number of things as we were new to the city. She was very responsive and keen to ensure our stay went smoothly. Would recommend!

Christoph's place is a dream - just as wonderful as the photos suggest.  Bright and sunny with fantastic views of the city, well equipped, and stylish yet also exceedingly comfortable.  The only problem was that the apartment was so lovely I did not want to leave each day.  There is an extensive music and book library to enjoy if you have the time, not to mention all the great art.  The bed was wonderful - a very comfortable mattress, delightful sheets and a down comforter soft and light as a cloud.  I did not try the shower but the bathtub was perfect.  I was able to do all my laundry the first day using Christoph's very nice washer and dryer.  The apartment is close to restaurants, cafes and grocery stores and yet it is also very quiet at night even on the weekend.  I had an evening flight and Christoph allowed me to stay in the apartment until it was time to go.  Instead of telling me where I could buy the book I was reading from his library, he gifted it to me.  I can't wait to return!

Die Lage der Unterkunft ist super!

I have much to say, but will try to be brief.
First, the apartment is just as advertised. It is a typical Berlin floor plan with main hallway, kitchen, bedroom, and living room (pull out couch) coming off of the hallway. It is not a fully lived-in apartment and appears to be used for (only) rentals. No worries, it feels very cosy and well maintained (there are little touches, most furniture is from IKEA and that is OK because this is typical of all Berlin apartments!). (One note, pay attention to the final price, because adding people more than 2 adds to the price significantly)
The apartment is SUPER quiet; you hear nothing from the street or from neighbors.
The apartment is on a dead-end street so there is little street traffic and you are on the inside of the courtyard space, so it is very very quiet.
That said, it is not in the center of the city, so you are not in the crazy active area of things. This was good for us. There is just enough activity at night that you feel at home (Gleimstr. has some nice restaurants with outdoor seating, keeping it lively). The Mauerpark is a bit rough, it is both a pace that is good for families (the farm in the park is fantastic for kids who love animals) and at the same time a place that feels a little peculiar. But this is also the feeling of Berlin and of East Berlin in particular. In short, we stayed here for 3 weeks in August as a family of 4, and had a wonderful time!
Todo perfecto, ningún problema.

The reason I'm not giving it five stars is because the experience felt more like house-sitting a nice home than a vacation rental for our pleasure (the latter is what I expected at this price point). This is in comparison to other higher-end airbnb rentals, including one in this same neighborhood I made a couple years ago.
There is a very extensive list of requirements and instructions for the apartment that you'll receive a couple weeks before arrival. This list reflects the care that the owners have put into their home but also reflects a certain paranoia they have in renting it out.
This place would be a great rental for a couple or small family over a short stay. It's not ideal for a group of friends or for longer stays.

We were meet promptly by a friend of Cornelius who took the time to show us around the apartment and demonstrate how things worked. This is a beautiful relatively large apartment with an amazing view over the rooftops of Berlin - you can see the TV tower very well from the gorgeous balcony. The apartment caters well for travelers requiring two separate, private sleeping areas as the pull-out sofa can be partitioned off from the main lounge area very well and still leaves plenty of room to dine at the table, entertain and relax after a long day. Each room has excellent ventilation and natural light and the automated window shutters are fantastic, they block out the sun very well for sleeping. The bathroom has a full very long and deep bath (we are both quite tall women and we could stretch right out) and heated floor (if needed). There is plenty of room for storage and the beds were both large and comfortable. The kitchen has everything you would need and is very functional for cooking meals. Full dishwasher and excellent gas stove and oven more than adequate cutlery and crockery and really useful provisions like storage containers for food, vases for flowers (which was much appreciated as we made the most of the very well priced flowers available in September in Berlin). We were there for a week and it was extremely nice to come home and relax at the end of a very long day in such a well appointed apartment. It is in a great location with many local eateries and bars close-by. It has two supermarkets at the end of the street, one of which is an organic/bio store. The train station and tram are also at the end of the street. It is very easy to get to main tourist attractions from this location. The only thing that might be of concern to some is the noise from the building (perhaps pipes) that you can hear at night in the bedroom. If you are a light sleeper this might disturb. Not something the owners would have much control over though..
This was our first visit to Berlin and this apartment exceeded our expectation contributing toward a perfect stay. We would definitely recommend this to others (particularly for longer stays) and hope to
come back! Thank you Cornelius for providing and maintaining such a beautiful Berlin 'home away from home' for us to enjoy.

Alles perfekt, bis darauf dass unser Fenster undicht war. Lage war super alles gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Sauber und schön eingerichtet
Amazing location and staff Highly recommended :)

Ich habe das Airbnb vorzeitig verlassen da es mit der Baustelle vor der Tür kaum auszuhalten war, natürlich wusste ich vorab nicht das vor der Tür eine Baustelle ist! Abgesehen davon gibt es in dieser gegend so gut wie keine Parkplätze. Das Apartment war etwas staubig ansonsten eigentlich ein nettes Apartment.

Pascale’s place is a beautiful family home in the heart of Berlin. The location is top, with easy access to public transport (we used the U6 daily) and bars, shops, restaurants and cafes round the corner - all in walking distance.
We were a family of 3 adults and 1 kids and felt very comfortable in the apartment. It’s spacious, with a balcony and views to the enormous garden which was a highlight for our 6 year old! The kids from the other apartments were super welcoming and they ended up playing big soccer matches every night!
The apartment has a well equipped kitchen (it’s a family home and we had access to everything we needed including kids plates and lunch boxes.
Pascale communicated promptly and provided clear instructions and guidance - we felt well looked after!
Καλή τοποθεσία το σπίτι είναι όπως της φωτογραφίες….
Amazing place, in a great location. Everything was as described. Host is super helpful and responds fast. Will be staying here again next time I’m in Berlin.
Spectacular location and a fabulous apartment!!! All was perfect.
Příjemný a originální design. S radostí bych se vracela.

Our stay at this airbnb in Berlin was comfortable and convenient. Walking distance to the Friedrichstadt Palast, Friedrichstraße, Reichstag and many other tourist attractions along with shopping. Great access to public transportation (3 min walk to Oranienburger Tor subway) The place can definitely fit a group of 4 people comfortably with ample spaces. The kitchen was well equipped, washer is available on site and comfortable bed to sleep in. If you have a car street parking is available but can be costly. We ended up parking our car at a P+R for free for several days and only used public transportation.
Overall, we definitely recommend this to anybody looking for a place to stay in Berlin.
Sehr nettes Apartment mitten im Kiez, aber trotzdem ruhig. Schöner Frühstücksbalkon mit Morgensonne. Sehr entspannter Check-In mit Code.

A experiência no apartamento do David foi extraordinária!! David sempre foi muito atencioso, respondendo a todos as minhas dúvidas de forma rápida e precisa. Ele nos recebeu no check-in e deu todas as instruções necessárias. O apartamento é incrível! Super moderno, com linda decoração e ótimos utensílios domésticos. O chuveiro é excelente e a cama muito confortável. Fica localizado num bairro residencial, ao lado de um grande shopping, com ótimo supermercado, cinema e locação de bicicletas. Também fica ao lado de uma rua com ponto de metro, o que permite fácil e rápida locomoção pela cidade de Berlin. Enfim, a hospedagem no apartamento do David tornou nossa lua-de-mel em Berlin ainda mais especial!! Obrigado por tudo!!
Wow. What a space. Location on point. Local tips very handy. Will be back.
Had a great stay and the host was very accommodating, flexible and responsive. Can fully recommend :)

The apartment was in a perfect location in a quaint little square. The host was very nice and extra communicative.
There were some problems with slow wifi and some basic necessities missing - this is just an apartment for renting, no one typically lives there. But overall, I really had a pleasant stay and was happy with my experience!

Great price and location! Easy access to the metro! The only thing was that the shower in the bathroom spilled water in all of the floor, it could have a little higher step or a glass to close, but amazing experience

All like at the photo. Robert has all that you need for the first time. Appartment is situated near the Underground station and East side gallery wall. So it's very comfortable to take a pause during a day for a cup of tea and continue to travel though the city. Thank you, Robert!
Too dirty, people snoring while sleeping, I couldn’t sleep there

Staying at Klaus’s house was really good. Good location, in front of house really cool cafe where you can order coffee and breakfast. Clean, good looking space, nice and really responsive owner. One thing that was annoying its really slowly internet((( I highly recommend this apartment for staying in Berlin
Eine sehr schöne, saubere Wohnung, empfehlenswert
Todo perfecto, muy céntrico!
Sylvia ist eine sehr freundlich Gastgeberin. Alles hat super geklappt und war genau wie beschreiben. Mein Aufenthalt war kurz, aber ich würde jederzeit wieder hier übernachten.

Beautiful apartment which is really well situated in an excellent location in the city.
Check in and out was really easy and the support team was really helpful with my questions. The included baggage storage as also a great idea as we had a late flight. I would definitely go back!
Great place

Mario was kind with our late train and sent us a picture of the door to his building. Check-In was easy. The bathroom was big and lovely. The deck was a nice breakfast location. Unfortunately, the bed had two sides against the wall which is not convenient for some folks. Also, neither the kitchen counter nor the deck had four chairs to make it easy to have a meal in with our family. Overall, it was a great place to stay and very clean.

Die Unterkunft ist leicht zu finden und gut erreichbar. Sie liegt zwar direkt an einer viel befahrenen Hauptstraße, doch obwohl wir sehr lärmempfindlich sind, habe wir erstaunlich wenig davon gehört, vor allem Abends. Wie auch schon andere geschrieben haben, liegt die Wohnung in einer Art Geschäftsgebäude wodurch es Deckenhohe Fenster gibt, die mit zwei Vorhängen zugezogen werden können. Dies sollte man vorher in Erwägung ziehen. Die Wand unter den Fenstern war sehr dreckig und die Küche war okay sauber. Ansonsten war es jedoch sehr sauber und sah genauso aus wie auf den Fotos!
Es ist zwar angegeben, dass Shampoo und Duschgel vorhanden sei, aber da es in der Dusche keine Beschriftung des einen Spenders gab, konnte man sich nicht so genau sicher sein, ob sich darin nur eins von beidem oder beides befindet.
Die Kissen sind sehr wenig gefüllt, aber das ist auch ein persönliches Empfinden.
Dietrich als Gastgeber kann ich nur empfehlen! Es lief alles unkompliziert und ohne Probleme ab.

Natürlich kann man für den Preis nicht die Welt erwarten und man muss auch damit klar kommen mit fremden Menschen in einem Zimmer zu schlafen (ist halt ein hostel).
Frühstück ist sehr zu empfehlen und kann auch nachgebucht werden für knapp 9€. Dabei gib’s eine recht große Auswahl, auch was milchalternativen angeht.
Das Badezimmer hätte sauberer sein können, Betten waren allerdings total in Ordnung
Kleiner Tipp: nehmt kleine Schlösser für euer Schließfach mit ☝🏻
The apartment is beautiful and very cosy, perfectly located, communication was really easy. We definitely recommend it !
Me Hien hat mich sehr nett empfangen und mir alles notwendige erklärt. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber weil sie auch täglich gereinigt wird. Sie entsprach den Beschreibungen perfekt. Gerne wieder!
Alles top! :)
Mathias was very friendly and the apartment is spacious enough for 1-2 people. Clean and perfect location - quiet and plenty of restaurants close by. Thanks for hosting me! :)) till the next time!
Appartement unique, décoration très originale ! Hôte sympathique et accueillant. Voisinage très calme, lit confortable. Merci beaucoup 🌈😁
We enjoyed our stay - apartment was comfortable and had everything we needed. Host was easy to communicate with. Thank you!

Très bon séjour chez Katerina, la chambre était agréable, calme et bien rangée. Les parties communes ainsi que le jardin sont également très agréables. Katerina était également très accueillante et chaleureuse !

Das Apartment ist sauber & geräumig. Man kann sich hier wirklich für ein paar Tage lang wohl fühlen. Die U-Bahn-Station Tempelhof ist direkt um die Ecke. Werner (Vermieter) hat sich super um unsere Anfragen & (Extra-)Wünsche gekümmert. Immer wieder
Gut ausgestattete Wohnung in S-Bahn-Nähe. Der Vermieter war sehr nett und die Kommunikation mit ihm super einfach.
Mias Airbnb war ganz perfekt.
Wir waren mit allem super zufrieden. Besonders mochten wir die traumhafte Lage und die schönen Gespräche mit dem Vermieter.
Lovely location
We loved Dan's place so much that we decided to extend our stay for couple of months. This place is very central. The interior is super stylish, clean and well equipped. Totally recommend!!

Hitao is a wonderful host. Her response was quick and accurate. She was helpful in many ways: specially early check-in. The check out process was very convenient. My family (kids) like the separate rooms. Beds are all clean. Also, the apartment is very convenient. Tram is right in front of the apartment. Great location. We put bunch of useful informations on the wall.
The courtyard area was a little bit rough but her apartment was on the top floor, bright and clean. Worth it!
Very nice, clean accommodation. Good facilities. Very easy to find and access. Thank you.
Great location. Few hiccups with checking in but there was a quick response and everything was resolved quickly.
Tolle Lage, freundliches Personal, gutes Preis Leistungsverhältnis
Anna’s place is great! The location is close to tons of good restaurants, bars, and cafes. In addition, Anna is super kind and her place is lovely! Definitely recommend to anyone solo traveling!
Horst's place is so convenient. It's a few minutes walk to the train station.

I stayed in this apartment for three months and really enjoyed the time there.
The neighborhood is perfect and I loved sitting outside in the evenings.
Gilt is very kind and communication with him went easy and friendly all the time. He reacts extremely fast, if you need him and helps directly.
You should know, that it is not perfectly quiet in the apartment because Hasenheide is pretty busy but it’s perfect to enjoy Berlin night life.
Thank you Gili

Du möchtest bei Peter übernachten? Herzlichen Glückwunsch, gute Wahl. Das Appartement ist sehr schön und geschmackvoll eingerichtet; alles ist bestens gepflegt und super sauber. Die Bettcouch ist definitiv kein „Notbett“ sondern von einer hochwertigen Marke, auf dieser Matratze lässt es sich sehr gut schlafen. Schon beim Kommunizieren wirst du feststellen „hier bist du willkommen“.
Die U-Bahnstation ist nur einen Steinwurf weit weg, die City West ruckzuck erreicht. Durch die Lage im „Hinterhaus“ mit schön begrüntem Innenhof kann man auch in der Stadt die Ruhe genießen.
Ich würde hier jederzeit gerne wieder buchen und übernachten.
Schöne große Wohnung mit vier Badezimmern. Schick eingerichtet, bequeme Betten und Klimaanlage.

Super Lage, tolle Unterkunft. Die Zimmer sind top ausgestattet. In der Tiefgarage gibt es Fahrradabstellplätze, wo wir unsere E-Bikes sicher abstellen konnten. Wir können die Unterkunft bestens weiterempfehlen.
Good place, good value!
sehr gute, kleine,  aber feine Unterkunft
Friendly and generous host.
Très bel appartement, bien situé, arrivée et départ en toute autonomie

Our stay at Frank's place was perfect for what we needed! It was close to public transit and a few great little cafes that had great coffee and breakfast. There was always a lot of activity outside due to the restaurants and other apartments but inside the apartment was quiet and no issues with outside noise. Our biggest issues were that our allergies were definitely bad while we were in Germany and seemed a little worse when we were inside the apartment - however it was spring and the height of allergy season so not convinced it was the apartment. Also some nights it was difficult to open the windows in the bedrooms due to the smell from the trash cans behind the apartment - but it was not a problem most nights! Overall we got a safe, spacious apartment that was a great jump off point to our time in Berlin!

I had a fantastic time at this Airbnb! The place was impeccably clean and had such a cozy vibe. The host was really friendly and accommodating. The neighborhood was pleasantly quiet, yet there were plenty of activities around. It was super convenient with laundry, subway access, and grocery stores just minutes away. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would absolutely recommend it to others.
Beau logement, endroit calme... lit plus ou moins confortable mais pour le reste, tb :)
Carolin was extremely friendly and provided some great recommendations. We did think it was meant to be a private bathroom but it wasn’t an issue at all. Would definitely stay here again
Es war wieder alles super wie beim m letzten Mal😉👍😊

A great place to stay in Berlin in a quiet part of the neighbourhood. Rainer is a great host and is very attentive. The black-out blinds in the flat make this a great place to rest after you've explored the Berlin nightlife! I would stay here again for sure
Easy access to public transport. Nice breakfast.
Very very good to stay in this house. Nice experience, hope to come back again.

Sehr helle Wohnung in zentraler Lage, direkt an der U-Bahn und Busstationen gelegen. Minka sollte man anfangs nicht direkt streicheln, sonst beißt sie leicht zu, aber danach gewöhnt sie sich sehr schnell an Fremde und wir haben sie in unser Herz eingeschlossen.
Es musste jemand anderes für die Schlüsselübergabe kommen, demjenigen hat es lieber erst 1 Std später gepasst als wir eigentlich an kommen wollten und zudem kam er noch 30 min zusätzlich am Tag später an. Das war leider etwas enttäuschend. Das Schlafsofa war sehr klapprig und alt aus Holz, war schon beim aufklappen kaputt. Die Gästematratze, die im Wohnzimmer angeboten wurde
, war steinhart auf dem Holzparkett, da hätte man nicht schlafen können. Wir mussten uns also das Schlafbett teilen, die Matratze war total eingesessen und abgenutzt. Alleine wäre dies wahrscheinlich eher auszuhalten. Wir empfehlen dafür dringend Erneuerung.
Ansonsten Dusche funktioniert super, genügend Handtücher zum auswechseln, über einen längeren Zeitraum die Katze schön gefüttert und von uns aus das Katzenklo gesäubert, weil der Geruch durchs Wohnzimmer zieht, da das Katzenklo keinen Deckel hat, was auch eine Empfehlung wäre.
Kommunikation lief mit Deborah sehr gut, sie hat extra ein Gästebuch wo all ihre Hausregeln stehen. Es war kein richtiger Mülleimer für die Graue Tonne in der Küche, eher nur eine kleine Tupperwarenbox und ein kleiner Mülleimer im Badezimmer war auch nicht vorhanden. Für drei Nächte ist es aber dennoch für den Preis in Ordnung, man darf halt nicht zu viel erwarten. Die Lage war wie gesagt nicht zu toppen, man kommt überall schnell hin.
Schöne Wohnung, hell und gut gelegen,die Kommunikation war schnell und problemlos absolut empfehlenswert
Great experience! Looked just like the photos the place is very cozy and perfect for a solo trip.

A perfect place to come back to after a long day of sightseeing.  Jun's place is very clean, the kitchen is well stocked with all the necessary dishes and an espresso maker, and it is very quiet and comfortable.  There's a ton of restaurants just steps away and a grocery store next door.  The neighborhood is family friendly and transportation is easily accessible.  Overall great place to stay.

Già al momento della prenotazione ho sentito subito di aver trovato un angolino molto particolare. Ed è stato così realmente. Incastonato nella parte interna della corte di un palazzo in posizione veramente strategica, questo bijou è diventato in solo due giorni un vero nido per me. Tornare a casa come se ci fosse qualcuno ad aspettarti, in una grande città come Berlino, è un bene inestimabile.
Ottima pulizia, disegnato e arredato con buon gusto, ogni cosa trasmette calore e serenità. Un ampio bagno con vasca. Angolo cucina pronto con ogni attrezzo. Camera da letto (comodissimo) raggiungibile con scala a chiocciola come nei sogni di tutte noi ragazze ☺️. Ben areata, molto silenziosa e anticipata da un piccolo patio dove ritrovarsi con i propri pensieri quando torni da una intensa giornata fuori.
Grazie Niels e Kathi per avermi dato la possibilità di soggiornarvi!
Very nice r hostel in a beautiful old building in a convenient location. Comfortable table beds, free luggage  storage. No privacy in the dorm rooms.
parfais pour un groupe d'amis, proche des transports et commerces.
The hosts are extremely welcoming and kind. The room was very clean and spacious. Stayed for a week and had no issues whatsoever.

The flat was very charismatic and cozy and we felt immediately at home. Everything was very clean and we especially liked the bathroom, which was surprisingly large. Even though the flat is located a bit far from the city center, it was easy to get there by using the s-Bahn, which was close by and took about 30 min to get to Alexanderplatz. Overall we had a great stay and would definitely recommend Ralf’s place if you are planning to stay in Berlin!
hotel in a quiet spot. beds were comfy and staff very kind and helpful.

the appt is beautiful and cozy. we loved it. Rhys was very nice and helpful. the appt is right next to the canal and some great cafes, bars and restaurants.
We came on relatively hot days and it lacked a fan or an AC. the balcony fronts the inner part of the building and it is on the first floor so it lacks privacy.
Es war alles sehr nett und entspannt, wir kommen gerne mal wieder :-)

Wij hebben genoten van ons verblijf hier. Het zelfstandig in en uitchecken was erg makkelijk en de kamer voldeed aan verwachting.
Wij waren er op dagen dat het warm buiten was, daardoor was het in de kamer ook erg warm. Het raam kon alleen op een kiepstand en de airconditioning deed weinig. Dit was dus echt wel minder.
good location, clean and spacious room

Andrzej et sa compagne nous ont très bien accueilli. Cet appartement était parfaitement propre et situé dans un quartier à la fois calme et entouré de restaurants. Le lit et le matelas gonflable étaient très confortables et nous étions comme chez nous. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Berlin grâce à Andrzej qui nous a recommandé plein d'endroits à visiter ainsi que des restaurants et bars. Je recommande cet Airbnb 5 étoiles!!
Clean. Comfortable bed. Good location. Clear instructions. Would recommend.
Wonderful place to stay, perfect location made things easy to get around, the room was spotless and lovely, and had everything we could have needed!

Schneller, unkomplizierter und freundlicher Kontakt.
Wohnung ,super Lage, sauber und bestens ausgestattet.
Herzlicher Empfang und reibungslose Abwicklung.
100% zu empfehlen !

Ich war das zweite Mal in der Unterkunft. Mir hat Folgendes gut gefallen: sehr angenehmes Zimmer in für mich guter Lage ( meine Weiterbildung war in Lichtenberg, 30 Minuten mit der Straba), Straßenbahnhaltestelle nur 3 Gehminuten entfernt, trotzdem kein Straßenlärm im Zimmer da Nebenstraße, funktionierende Heizung ( das ist auch nicht immer so), sehr bequeme Matratze auf der ich gut geschlafen habe und das Wichtigste: sehr sympathische, hilfsbereite, nachsichtige und freundliche Gastgeberin.
Outstanding location. Super cute place. Having laundry is an awesome bonus. Can’t recommend it highly enough!
Lovely hostel
Good neighborhood, friendly staff, and clean with a  fan in every room, which was great
The accommodation was perfect! Nothing to complain about.

Ev sahipleri oldukça ilgiliydi. Gezilecek yerler, çevre ve restaurantlar konusunda bize önerilerde bulundular. Evi ayrıntılı olarak gezdirdiler. Evin yakınında kahvaltı ve akşam yemeği için güzel mekanlar vardı. Hatta gezi rehberi sitelerinde önerilen mekanlardan çok daha kaliteli mekanlardı. Metro, gross marketler ve müzeler adası gibi gezilecek yerlere yakınlık açısından evin konumu mükemmeldi. Evin bir sanat galerisi olması nedeniyle iç aydınlatmasının iyi olmasına rağmen caddeye bakan penceresinden ışık alımı kısıtlıydı. Tüm havlu ve çarşaflar temiz olmasına rağmen duvarlar kirliydi. Duşakabin yoktu. Perde kullanılmıştı. Kapıdaki kilit sistemi şifre ile çalışıyordu. İçeri girmek için kart yada anahtar olmadığı için güvenlik sorunu vardı.
Genel olarak güzel bir tatildi. Ev sahiplerine teşekkür ederiz.

Die Bilder und die Beschreibung haben nicht zu viel versprochen!
Die Unterkunft war wirklich wunderschön und wir haben gerne und viel Zeit dort verbracht.
Auch bei allem hausmeisterlichen gab es nichts zu beanstanden: die Kommunikation war super freundlich, schnell und zuvorkommend genau wie der persönliche Check-In (auch eine nette Abwechslung zu den üblichen Schlüsselboxen).
Ich kann es nu absolut empfehlen wenn man auch etwas entspannen will und nicht nur unterwegs ist.
nice place for a short stay!
Perfect room for me and my friends. The most comfortable beds and pillows I’ve ever had. Kitchen area and bathroom very clean. Great location. Would definitely stay here again.

The apt was great in a fantastic location close to fun bars, coffee places and restaurants. Sure its even better in the summer. Marius was a perfect host. Super helpful with cool suggestions on what to do and see. Easy and fast to communicate with. Awesome stay!

Gerhard was at the apartment to greet us when we arrived. With most Airbnb entries you self-checkin which is convenient but not very personable. It was lovely to meet with him in person.
Gerhard helped with daily what’s app messages suggesting places we could visit locally and provided us with taxi contacts, train schedules and eatery places.
When our luggage was lost temporarily by the airline, he even offered us a suit for my partner to wear to a wedding we had to attend in Potsdam.( We got the luggage)
A great place to stay in Berlin because the ground floor apartment is between two train stations…both about a ten minute walk.
As a “ veteran” Airbnb client, I highly recommend this property.

Vår vistelse hos Arcan var helt fantastisk. Lägenheten var verkligen perfekt och vi kände oss direkt som hemma. Arcans välkomnande var mycket trevligt och man fick direkt ett trevligt intryck och ett varmt välkomnande till staden och lägenheten. Därutöver var lägenheten i mycket bra skicka samt var mycket ren. Dessutom var området lägenheten låg i mycket trevligt och centralt. Jag kan verkligen varmt rekommendera Arcans lägenhet, och jag kommer definitivt bo här igen när jag återvänder till Berlin!
Martin ist ein sehr freundlicher Gastgeber. Schnelle Antwort. Tolle  eingerichtete Wohnung. Ausgezeichneter Ausgangspunkt für Ausflüge in und außerhalb der Stadt.
Great location
Gut gelegene Unterkunft, gut zu erreichen, angenehme Umgebung, ruhig, einfache Kommunikation mit schneller Hilfe.
El piso está bien. Tiene una cama poco confortable que podría ser un problema para largas estancias

Die Lage der Unterkunft ist herausragend und sicher der Pluspunkt dieser Unterkunft. Alle Basisfaktoren sind in Ordnung: die Küche ist vollständig ausgestattet, es gibt eine Waschmaschine und das Bad ist nett eingerichtet. Die Kommunikation lief reibungslos ab und Alex ist freundlich und proaktiv. Nur das Geschirr in der Küche war etwas schmutzig und wir haben alles vor Verwendung gespült.
Dadurch, dass die Unterkunft im Keller liegt hat sie Schwächen, die so eine Unterkunft aber mit sich bringt. Es sind umgebaute Kellerräume und deshalb nicht so gemütlich, einfach architektonisch bedingt. Die Abwasser-Situation ist nicht besonders angenehm: lässt man in der Küche Spülwasser ablaufen so kommt es in der Dusche hoch. Man darf kein Toilettenpapier in die Toilette werfen, was natürlich ein erheblicher Komfortverlust ist (und bei uns dazu geführt hat, dass wir die Toilette gemieden haben). Dicke Kellerwände sorgen für eine schlechte WLAN-Abdeckung und es gibt kein Mobilfunksignal.

Brilliant spacious apartment and really good value. The host was super helpful recommending places to eat (we’re vegan so love a good local recommendation of nearby  restaurants). The shower is fantastic and the rooms very quiet. The beds are very comfortable. Would definitely stay again if we visit Berlin in the future.

Die Wohnung ist Teil eines Hostels und bietet Platz für bis zu fünf Personen. Die Küche ist gut ausgestattet, und auch der Rest der Wohnung ist praktisch eingerichtet. Mina war jederzeit erreichbar, Check-in und Check-out verliefen reibungslos. Die Wohnung selber liegt gut eine halbe Stunde entfernt von der Innenstadt, die mit der U8 oder der Buslinie 120 gut erreichbar ist. In der Nähe der Wohnung befinden sich Einkaufsmöglichkeiten (Netto, Penny), eine Pizzeria und sogar ein Waschsalon. Um den Großstadttrubel zu entkommen bietet sich ein Spaziergang um den Schäfersee an, der drei Minuten von der Wohnung entfernt liegt oder eine Partie Minigolf, die man dort spielen kann.
Alles in einem ist die Wohnung eine gute Unterkunft für ein Wochenendtrip nach Berlin.
Room is small for 2 people
Irina war total nett und das Zimmer geräumig und sauber. Die Lage ist top und für unseren kurzen Aufenthalt perfekt. Vielen Dank!
Die Unterkunft war wie beschrieben. Gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis, super Lage innerhalb Berlins und die Kommunikation mit Florian war immer sehr schnell und gut. Merci!

Fantastic place to stay!!!! It was clean and had everything we needed. We will definitely stay again.

Sehr schöne Wohnung,
sehr gut ausgestattet und geschmackvoll eingerichtet.
Sehr gute Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter.

Es war ein schöner Kurzurlaub. Das Anwesen ist super und es hat Spass gemacht. Unser Hund war willkommen und wir haben uns alle sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Gegend ist sehr schön, viel Wald und Wasser in der Nähe
Great space! Excellent location. Would stay here again while visiting the city.

Alexander was a lovely host and happy to help with anything I might have needed. His place is absolutely lovely, and the location is very good too!
I felt at home right away and would certainly recommend this property to anyone!
alles super danke für die Unterkunft
Good experience overall, nice people, nice location and very easy to find :)
Appartement parfait pour 2 personnes. Bien situé dans un quartier calme

Lina's place is Great! It is in a very quiet street in Moabit. We had a small balcony surrounded by trees. There was a goshawk in the area and we saw it twice from quite close. Amazing to see that in the city. The flat is in easy walking distance from interesting local shops and transport to anywhere in the city is very easy. The accomodation was exceptionally clean and contained everything that we needed. We were very much home from home. If you want to be quiet and comfortable in Berlin, Lina's place is great!

This studio is easily accessible to both Mitte and Tegel airport. The room was very clean and artistic. And the host was so helpful upon my arrival at the airport. I woud like to stay here again when I visit Berlin!

La estancia fue excelente!! Sin lugar a dudas una opción recomendable  para quien quiere conocer Berlín.  Se puede ir a pie perfectamente y sino tienes vías rápidas de comunicación.  En caso de regresar a Berlín no me planteo otra opción que volver a contactar con Martín.

Wonderful location.
Kitchen, bathroom, parking were good.
We needed 2 bedrooms and it was confirmed that there are 2 bedrooms, but not that room 2 had to go through room 1 to get to the toilet during the night!!
Highly inconvenient and unacceptable.

Pros:

Een heel leuk en knus appartement met eigenlijk alles wat je nodig hebt om even helemaal tot rust te komen. De omgeving was opvallend rustig terwijl het een levendige wijk is. Het openbaar vervoer is makkelijk te voet te bereiken en de winkels liggen op een paar minuten lopen van het appartement. Mochten wij in de toekomst weer eens naar Berlijn gaan, dan kijken wij zeker of dit appartement beschikbaar is. Zeer vriendelijke host ook. Reageert snel en is er echt voor de gasten. Wij bevelen deze plek zeker aan!

Denny was really helpful and responsive. Place is clean and tidy. Beds were comfortable. Bathrooms were quite new. There was even a small garden with table for 6. It was a pleasure to be in the apartment.

Bernhard's place has several benefits: close to subway stations (Märkisches museum and Jannowitzbrücke), nice and easy communication, it was warm and clean in my appartment. Some disadvantages: scary window view, that could be avoid with thin curtains - but they were missing. I also missed a table or working surface in the kitchen sector.

Die Unterkunft war sauber, der Check-In war unkompliziert und freundlich. Die Fenster zur großen Straße haben den Lärm nicht so gut abgeschirmt. Straßenlärm war auch in der Nacht zu hören. Würde wieder das Hostel buchen!

The staying with Sophia was great. She is a very calm and peaceful host. The apartment was very cosy and relaxing. There was no noise heard from the streets which was very nice. I highly recommend booking here if you like experience the artistic side of Berlin and the night life!
A good place

Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit am Hafenplatz in Berlin. Die Wohnung befindet sich in Top Lage in direkter Nähe zum U-Bahnhof.
Der Check In war schnell erledigt durch unmissverständliche Anweisungen für die Schlüsselbox. Die Wohnung ist mit allem ausgestattet, was man benötigt. Alles in allem waren wir sehr zufrieden. Vielen Dank Martin.
It was great. 2 minutes walk to subway. It was a turkish neighbourhood but there was no problem with communication. I would definitely recommend.

Serkan ist ein sehr aufmerksamer Gastgeber. Selbst aufhä kurzfristige Anfragen/Bitten hat er verständnisvoll und hilfsbereit reagiert.
Die Unterkunft ist in jedem Fall für alle geeignet, die viel in der Stadt entdecken wollen. Man kommt gut zu den ÖPNV und auch zu Fuß kann man nahe gelegenes entdecken.

Sehr nett und zuvorkommend, es würde für alles gesorgt.

Great stay, the apartment was very convenient for a week-end in Berlin
Super Wohnung in ruhiger doch zentraler Lage! Echt empfehlenswert und mit allem drum und dran ausgestattet.

Die Unterkunft hat die perfekte Lage um den hippen Ortsteil Friedrichshain kennenzulernen. Die öffentliche Anbindung ist super, unzählige Restaurants, Bars und Späties sind direkt vor der Haustür. Die Einrichtung ist liebevoll und läd zum verweilen ein. Von dem Balkon kann man perfekt das City Life Berlins beobachten.
Die Schlüsselübergabe und alle anderen organisatorischen Dinge haben reibungslos funktioniert. Ich würde immer wieder in die Unterkunft zurückkommen.

We really enjoyed our stay at the Stayery. We chose this AirBNB as a place to stay with our friends for separate rooms. What really stood out was the common areas where we could reconvene and catch up over a hot drink or a beer from the fridges on site (paywall). The hosts on site were extremely helpful and flexible when it came to looking after our luggage on the last day of our stay and providing helpful recommendations in terms of what we should prioritise in terms of food spots/sights etc. Overall, a very enjoyable stay - would highly recommend!

Die Wohung liegt super zentral. Bus und U-Bahn in der Nähe. Tolle Restaurants ebenso - und trotzdem total ruhig. Kommunikation mit dem Vermieter war perfekt. Die Wohnung ist ein Klein-Od. Sehr zu empfehlen. 😊
Great apartament in a very good location.

A great place in a great location. Lots happening around the local area. A great local tips book and everything about the apartment was fitting to the local area. Very accessible, we got to the airport on public transport with two small children. Andre sorted out very small issues immediately after being called.

Loved the apartment! Fantastic location - highly recommend walking the 10 mins to Bergmannstrausse for a great selection of restaurants! We stayed here partly due to its proximity for the Columbiahalle venue - a 20 minute walk! Fantastic.
Well equipped kitchen, a minute to the local supermarket, loads of space, kept very cool temperatures, comfy bed. What more could you ask for.

Wir haben uns wohlgefühlt. Es hat uns an nichts gefehlt. Die Lage war für uns sehr praktisch. Friedenau mit Bioladen und netten Restaurants hat uns auch gefallen. Die Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin war sehr angenehm.
Amazing location very close to Alexanderplatz. It takes just a 15 min walk. The room was very clean as well as the whole building.
Mooie rustige ruimte. Maar er is onderhoud nodig. Nauwelijks borden of glazen aanwezig. Ingewikkeld bereikbaar.

Martins apartment was perfect for us with regard to location, house facilities (ample towels, wifi, kitchen ware, fans, cleaning products, coat angers, umbrella etc) cleanliness and communication with Martin, who was extra generous on our leaving day enabling a later checkout which assisted us tremendously. We loved the area around Kruetzberg and the proximity to our family in Neukolln. The cafes, bars, parks and Karstadt nearby made our stay heaps of fun. Our granddaughters stayed one night in the “top bed” and loved it altho the stairs may be a bit treacherous for some. Thanks Martin. We will return.

Roberts Loft is incredible. We met with Robert upon arrival and he gave us keys, tips about the area and a quick tour of the entire, spacious loft. The waterbed is quite comfortable and the AC unit in room was great given the heat in Berlin at that time. There is also a nice tv, two large windows along with power outlets and light switches by the bed. There was ample privacy in the form of a curtain that covered the glass door and the private bathroom a few steps outside the room is just as full of grandeur as the room itself. The shower is massive with both a rainfall shower head and a handheld option. After a long day of travel and exploration in Berlin, it was a comfortable spot to return to (also, quite easy given the private entrance for this particular room).  Unfortunately we didn't get to check out the terrace for long, but when Robert showed us it, we were blown away. When you arrive, make sure to check out the journey book Robert has created for the loft that details how it has come together and the incredible work he has put into it. Next time we are in Berlin we will definitely be staying with Robert.

If you are considering booking a stay in Berlin, you ought to look no further. Meggie is the most incredible host, and person, and cuddles from Marie, her beautiful dog, made the stay even better.
Meggie provided us with countless recommendations for the local area (everything is also very walkable from the flat) and we were not disappointed by any of them.
Meggie introduced us to some local German food and also provided fresh herbal tea- it was truly an amazing first trip in Germany.
I could not recommend anymore if I tried- you would be very lucky to get yourself a reservation in Meggie’s home!

La estancia ha sido agradable, el apartamento está dotado suficientemente de los servicios necesarios para dormir y poder comer allí sin ningún problema
La entrada fácil con las claves y muy cómoda

Really beautiful, brand-new space. Lovely location. Loved my stay!!!
Lovely home, charming decor, great location, and feels like your home away from home. Boxhagener Platz is a wonderful area to hang out in.
Raphael was zeer behulpzaam en een fantastische host. Het appartement voldeed precies aan de verwachtingen en was erg schoon.  We komen zeker een keertje terug!

L'appartement de Jessy est superbe, très fonctionnel et très bien placé. Il y a beaucoup de restaurants et de bars accessibles à pied. Le tramway est en bas de la rue. Le lieu est calme, peu de bruit dans l'immeuble.
Jessy nous a accueillis, elle a pris du temps pour nous expliquer les lieux à visiter, restaurants, sorties, supermarchés... et ses adresses sont parfaites! Nous avons presque tout essayé !
Elle nous a contactés dans la semaine pour savoir si tout allait bien.
L'appartement est fourni en thé, café, epices, ce qui est très appreciable.
Nous avons passé une excellente semaine.
Rien à redire, tout était parfait!
Merci Jessy

One room had plenty of space for your own clothes, this them was not carried over into the other room with some unexpected personal items left in bedside draws and on display on shelves also. Kitchen was good and new like described in the description however we couldn’t operate the dishwasher and there was a lot of opened food on the counter and in the fridge including  short life items such as bananas and milk. Bathroom was as described, beds were also good, good location. Do not recommend to families.
Excellent hosts, very happy.

Yena's apartment was a lovely base for exploring Berlin. The location is perfect in a very safe and peaceful area with easy access to explore the rest of Berlin. I was there for a month to write a book and do illustration projects with local artists. The apartment was the perfect creative space for writing and drawing. This place quickly felt like home and would definitely come back again.
Awsome place!! Hans was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. The location is great, the place is cozy and very clean. I definitely recommend this flat.
The apartment is in a very nice neighborhood with lots of great restaurants and shops. The apartment was clean and  checking in and out was easy.

Located near to Leopaldpkatz station for an easy ride into the city centre. Meanwhile great coffee shops & bakeries nearby and a fabulous take away kebab/pizza shop 5 minutes walk away when we were too exhausted to go out for dinner.
I'd happily book this accommodation again.

Super Typ, hat alles problemlos geklappt. Checkin war flexibel, Bett war sehr bequem. Kann ich vollstens empfehlen.

Die Gastgeber haben uns persönlich empfangen und waren sehr nett. Wir waren mit vier Personen in der Wohnung, es ist eng, aber funktionell. Ein Pluspunkt sind die beiden Bäder! Friedrichshain ist ein interessantes Viertel und ein guter Ausgangspunkt, um Berlin zu entdecken.

Great place and location for the price. Near city center, public transport and commercial. Simple but effective interior. Because it is an ice cream store (only in summer) there are no extra windows to open, except for the front door. But we knew that beforehand , so that was no problem for us.
Appartement is clean and the host Mirwais responds very quickly.

Le logement était parfaitement conforme à ce qui est présenté sur le site. Notre hôte a été charmante et toujours disponible. I couldn't fault my stay, the flat is perfect and beautifully decorated with all the amenities I could have needed. Frank is a great communicator and always happy to help. I would gladly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a cosy and comfortable spot to stay in a fantastically well connnected area.

Sehr stylisches Hostel mit Humor, cooler Bar (mit eigener Micro-Brewery)und grandiosem David Hasselhoff Museum im Keller.
