We enjoyed our five night stay at Stephanie’s. We found her and her partner to be friendly and responsive. It is ideally located in walking distance to many attractions as well as lots of public transit. The place was clean and we appreciated the well stocked kitchen. Would definitely recommend. Thank you Stephanie!
Along with the great communication with Xenia, Matija was a very welcoming host to their place, which is a pretty spacious and comfortable space to stay in.

an absolutely delightful apartment and a fantastic location! Wonderfully appointed, gracious high ceilings and wonderful lighting, surprisingly contemporary and well done Flate! Lovely amenities with the most amazing coffee maker ever, and a very seamless check in process! if you’re a light sleeper like I am, it will be helpful if you bring really good earplugs as there is a subway that runs beneath the building, otherwise I highly recommend the flat!
Great location, comfortable and clean apartment- a great hospitality and welcoming owner. We enjoyed every minute. Thank you!

Cornelius' place is a beautiful, large, very tastefully furnished apartment, even better than what the great photos show, and the neighbourhood (Prenzlauer Berg) is fantastic: very walkable, with lots of great restaurants and cafés, parks, and very close to all forms of public transport. Very simply put, it's an amazing apartment in an amazing location.
Cornelius was also a wonderful host, super communicative, helpful and went above and beyond: I forgot some items at the apartment, and Cornelius very helpfully went through all the trouble of mailing them back to me, always staying in touch and friendly. Basically, every time I'll be in Berlin in the future, I hope to be able to come back here!
What can I add….. just perfect, responded 100% to what we expected

Susanne und ihre Familie sind sehr freundliche und aufmerksame Gastgeber. Das Zimmer sowie das zugehörige Bad waren zeitgemäß und ansprechend eingerichtet und sehr sauber. Fußläufig gibt es keine nennenswerten Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, aber mit dem ÖPNV sind diese in etwa 15 min erreichbar. Insgesamt hatten wir einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt.
Best place of Berlin! A lot of Bars and Restaurants, Supermarkts. The Apartment is very comfortable and perfect for couples for long stay.

The flat is extraordinary... truly. Confi, elegant and so well located if you want to visit the city, or party, or whatever, and come back like a king. And the little details, like the coffe... it-was-great.

Sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt, alles war unkompliziert. Die Wohnung ist perfekt : groß, ruhig, viel Licht, in einer schönen grünen Umgebung. Perfect location, what a gem in Berlin. We loved sitting on the jetty each morning drinking coffee with a view of the Spree.

Super schön eingerichtetes 1 Zimmer Apartment mit großen Bad und voll ausgestatteter Küche. Daneben sind außerdem öffentliche Parkplätze also perfekt wenn man mit dem Auto kommt.

Super Lage und fairer Preis insgesamt

ik raad deze plek aan!

Es war ein schöner Aufenthalt in Monikas Wohnung. Die Absprache mit der Schlüsselübergabe hat Super geklappt. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und ist sicher in einem abgetrennten Bereich gelegen.
Ich würde jeder zeit dort wieder wohnen wollen !!

Nora's apartment is very stylish, spacious and clean with lovely high ceilings. Very modern kitchen with everything you need plus lots of handy extras like oil, washing powder etc. Loved the Japanese bath! Excellent  location close to buses and rail to take you to the centre of town about 10 minutes away. Quiet and safe location with many restaurants and supermarkets nearby. Nora was easy to communicate with and was very welcoming. I would really recommend this lovely apartment for long or short stays in Berlin.

The place was a bit dirty upon arrival. There were a lot of things left from the previous guests around the apartment and especially in the kitchen like opened food. Great location, great apartment and the concierge was extremely nice & helpful. The host was responsive and communicated everything beforehand, however there were instances where the communication could have been friendlier and more helpful. Overall the area was terrific as well.

I stayed at Ece’s place for 3 nights! Her place is so much more cozy and clean than the picture looks (which is great of course haha) She was very lovely, making sure I was comfortable and shared some tips. Clean as well, enjoyed my stay and would recommend to everyone as it was very walkable to places. I didn’t even use the metro.. as I love walking. Ein wirklich tolles Apartment!

lovely apartment situated very close to many main transit lines. easy to get to anywhere

Really nice stay! The house is lovely, and Anna was really helpful throughout my stay. Thanks!

Ich war nun zum 4.Mal bei Mina und bin einfach sehr zufrieden.  Gerne komme ich wieder um die Zeit zu genießen. Der Garten ist wunderbar zum Entspannen und gemütlich zusammen zu sitzen. Das Apartment war wieder wunderbar,  super freundliche Mitarbeiter und ebenso Mina als Gastgeberin.

Sehr freundlicher und flexibler Gastgeber, sehr gute und zentrale Lage, alles war wie beschrieben. Können wir sehr empfehlen!

Wir haben die Wohnung mit insgesamt 9 Erwachsenen gemietet. Sie ist hell und freundlich, sehr sauber und sehr gut ausgestattet. Sie liegt sehr ruhig in einem schönen Wohngebiet und nah am Bahnhof Schöneberg. Alles ist gut mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen. In der Nähe ist ein Bäcker und 2 Supermärkte. Um die Ecke befindet sich ein sehr leckeres italienisches Restaurant. Der Check in mit Sören war unproblematisch und wir haben viele Tipps von ihm bekommen. Alles in allem ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt trotz der vielen Besucher in Berlin, die anlässlich von Kirchentag und DFB Pokalspiel Berlin bevölkerten. Wir kommen gerne wieder....

Location is great and Marc is a fantastic and responsive host! Very accomodating and we really appreciated the late check out - thank you so much!

Annas lejlighed er fantastisk. Den er charmerende og meget smagfuldt indrettet. Den ligger i et dejligt område med mange restauranter, men samtidig er kvarteret roligt. El apartamento era espacioso para dos personas, con mucha luz y vistas algradables a un patio. La zona es tranquila, con supermercados cerca y comunicada con la parada de metro de Franz-Neumann-Platz. Pudimos hacer el check-in autónomo sin problemas.

Das Hotel war brandneu. Alles, was in den Zimmern verwendet wird, wurde sorgfältig ausgewählt und sorgfältig gereinigt. Es wurde eine sehr ruhige und friedliche Umgebung geschaffen. Es war sehr einfach, den Mitarbeiter zu erreichen, wann immer Sie ihn brauchten.

We had a great stay in Amit's apartment - it is a great location if you like peace and quiet in an otherwise busy city. The greatest thing is the location, though - a 30-minute stroll to the city center just made it super convenient for us

Da wir zu viert meinen Bruder in Berlin Pankow über das Wochenende besuchen wollten, benötigten wir eine Wohnung, die in der Nähe von Pankow ist und zudem auch eine gute Verkehrsanbindung zum Prenzlauer Berg und in die Innenstadt aufweist. Ich kann diese tolle Wohnung vollstens weiter empfehlen -
Vieleln Dank Uwe für diese tolle Wohnung!!!

This place was perfect for our family of four. Natalia was there to meet us when we arrived, and she was clearly a warm and kind person. Her place was located near great parks and restaurants and shops (all a 10 minute walk, at most), and was a peaceful and quiet home base for our trips around the city. We would absolutely stay here again if we returned to Berlin. Thank you, Natalia!

Martin was very helpful prior to our arrival and all the way until we left. Constantly answered any questions we had and offered suggestions for local food. The apartment was very clean and close to the mall of Berlin and other tourist areas. I would definitely stay here again if ever visiting Berlin area again.
Excellent emplacement, en plein centre et très calme.
This apartment is in a fantastic location and is very comfortable, feels like home!  Marisa is responsive and the best host. recommend 100%!

Pas dans le centre mais proche métro , 15 min en uber du centre (20 euros environs). Une fois la première grille passée il faut aller tout au donc à gauche des escaliers descendent.
L’appli n’a aucun intérêt pour ouvrir la porte. Logement propre et agréable !
Thank you for having us - it was a great stay :)

Sehr süße Unterkunft, mit kleinen Extras, wie Tee und Kaffeemaschine, eigenes Bad. Sehr schöner Garten, den wir leider nicht genutzt haben, auf Grund von Zeitmangel! Wir haben uns auf Anhieb wohl gefühlt.
En veldig praktisk leilighet med god plass til en familie. Rent og godt utstyrt for alle behov.

habe es für freunde von mir gebucht, war selber nicht drinn.
sie waren begeistert
Alles super und wie beschrieben. Gerne wieder.
The home is as described; two turns from the train stop. Very clean with all you need. Seriously squeaky floors though.
Anfitrião gentil e apartamento muito bem equipado. Próximo a estação de metrô, mercado e restaurantes
Excellent location and spacious apartment furnished with style. Also thanks to Simon & Franca we felt at home and enjoyed our stay.

Everything was fine! Marcel and Max were very helpful and accommodating to our arrival. Plenty of bed and sofas, very quiet neighborhood so perfect for resting.
3 minutes away from Metro station and very close walking - distance to many bars and restaurants.
kitchen is a bit small and basic but we were out most of the day so no big problem.
we enjoyed our stay.
Schöne, saubere Wohnung, wo man nicht nur schlafen kann, sondern wohnen.
Je recommande, l'appartement, le quartier. Séjour parfait

Wibke has a stylish house with a great location, nice, quiet living around, surrounded by cafes and restaurant. It was amazing to talk to them, they are super fun and friendly, definitely makes my Berlin trip brighter than it is!!  Great recommendation, thank you!

Amazingly well located apartment with plenty of restaurants and cafes around. Excellent spot for transport as U & S Bahn stations nearby as well as Tram stops nearby. Museum Island is within walking distance as is Brandenburg Gate (20 mins).
Clean, well equipped, modern and stylish apartment, comfortably furnished for 4 people. Enjoyed our stay very much.
Es war mein zweites Mal bei Parwana. Immer super. Kann nur empfehlen.

We had a lovely time at our accomodation. Our host was very lovely and the staff downstairs at the restaurant were very kind too. The room was beautiful and exactly like the photos. It was a 35 min commute to the city but transport was very easy and on time. It was nice staying out of the chaos and busy life of the city. We would definitely recommend to any staying in Berlin.

I really loved staying at Beatrix apartment. It's charming, beautiful and like a calm oasis, although it's in the middle of everything. Also, Beatrix is a very welcoming host, really the best! I can definitely recommend her place. Hope to be back!

A wonderful place to stay when visiting Berlin. Located perfectly, a lot of places to eat or have a drink nearby. Also, it’s quiet, cozy and really lovely. Enjoyed the terrace, loved the interior and convenience, would gladly recommend 😍

Geweldige locatie nabij Alexanderplatz, van waaruit je gemakkelijk met OV, fiets of te voet de stad kunt ontdekken. Monica is een erg vriendelijke host. De kamer is klein maar fijn, met een mooi uitzicht. Je hebt er je eigen badkamer.

The flat is very well located, even though it's not placed at the city center. It's also very comfortable and Marcus was always available.
Great place, I totally recommend it.
We had a lovely stay at Jurriaan's. It is wonderfully quiet and peaceful with all the amenities one could need and a very comfy bed.

Nena Apartments Metropolpark is a great alternative to an equivalently priced hotel room. My unit in this imposing structure was a nicely designed, studio apartment. It would be appropriate for short to medium stays. It’s ideal for one or two, but could accommodate three. The space is comfortable enough that you might be tempted to stay inside.
The neighborhood is a little lackluster, comparatively. There is a Bio market nearby, nightclubs, and a few restaurants. There is U and S Bahn close by.
The arrival and check-in process may appear confusing on first read, but every proceeded as described.
Lovely neighbourhood. Nice clean apartment. Check in and out worked smoothly.

Place was clean, easy check in and out. Staffs were friendly. distance wise bus stop and metro just right downstairs but still around 20-30mins travel to city centre.
Just a little bit expensive when I booked probably because of the events and 75th Germany anniversary. Also I thought I book 4 beds room but ended up in 8 beds room, but was fine and pretty good overall. Would recommend if was cheaper.
Todo excelente. Además, Jürgen es un excelente anfitrión!!

Lovely apartment on a beautiful street next to the canal and some wonderful vintage markets, shops, cafes and a supermarket. Was a very handy location close to our friends during our stay in Berlin. Although we did not meet Poca she checked in to ensure everything was running smoothly, the communication and key exchange was very easy! This cute little apartment is ideal if you are a couple or visiting on your own. It is very tidy and has all the bare essentials, the mezzanine bed was also comfy. Would recommend!

Sehr schöne Wohne Wohnung in toller Lage in Pankow, in der Nähe eines Parks und ca.15 Minmit Öffis ins Zentrum.
Bei einer Belegung mit vielen Personen ist zu bedenken, dass es nur ein WC in der Wohnung gibt.
Unterm Strich hat es uns sehr gut gefalllen.
Jonas was a great host! He provided us with a lot of great food and nightlife recommendations in the area.

Meine Freundin und ich hatten einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Leider hatten wir ein kleines Problem mit der Schlüsselkarte, weshalb wir auf unseren Handy-Akku achten mussten. Trotzdem würden wir uns immer wieder für dieses Hotel entscheiden.

Nettes Hotel in sehr guter Lage. Es gibt in unmittelbarer Nähe Schnellimbisse, Drogerie- und Supermarkt, ein schönes Einkaufszentrum, Markthalle und die U-Bahn. Der Empfang war sehr nett und unkompliziert. Das Zimmer ist klein, aber ich fand es gemütlich und praktisch eingerichtet. Das Bad könnte für große Menschen eng sein, aber es war sauber und bietet viel Ablagefläche. Von den anderen Gästen habe ich nicht viel gehört, ebenso war die Straße ziemlich ruhig trotz der lebhaften Lage. Für den Preis bekommt man für mein Empfinden eine sehr gute Unterkunft.
Elisabete非常親切，房間乾淨舒適，還有小點心，十分推薦！

This was our first ever booking through airbnb and our expectations in respect of the process, apartment and Aglaja as our host were exceeded in every element. Despite Aglaja having been a little unwell when we arrived she made us feel very welcome both throughout the lead in to our visit with informative emails and during our stay in Berlin. It really is a unique property and quite innovative to have art displayed in room settings which comprise the apartment (and a gallery at other times). We felt completely at ease and extremely comfortable. The apartment is a matter of 100 mts or so from the U2 underground which connects many of the Berlin attractions and the   central Gendarmenmarkt is within an easy 10 minute stroll. We highly recommend this apartment in Mitte

Das Hostel ist nur ein paar Gehminuten von der U-Bahn entfernt und ist ruhig gelegen. Auch der Bahnhof, ein Rewe to Go und Kleinigkeiten zum Essen findet man in der Nähe. Das Zimmer war wie auf den Fotos. Sauber und schön geräumig. Leider aber auch sehr hellhörig und unsere Fenster waren zum „Innenhof“ dadurch hat uns die „frische Luft“ gefehlt. Alle waren sehr nett und der Kaffee sehr gut :)
Very friendly host. Clear and accurate advices. Comfortable and chic apartment. We highly recommend it
We had a great stay at Elisabeth and James’ apartment. It was small but had everything we needed as a couple.

This was an excellent and very comfortable stay in the great city of Berlin.  The apartment is in a fantastic neighborhood in Mitte with some lovely cafes and shops and easy access to transport and major attractions. It is a stylish and cool place. I would go back for sure.

Es ist ein super schönes Appartement, perfekt an Öffis gelegen und mit allem ausgestattet, was das Touri-Herz begehrt. Es ist einfach jedem zu empfehlen. Die Gastgeber sind denkbar unkompliziert, super gut organisiert und total zuvorkommend. Herzlichen Dank für die schönen Tage
Freundliche und zuverlässiger Vermieter, schöne Wohnung. Alles gut.
Wir haben uns uns wohl gefühlt und hatten ein gute Zeit. Die Kommunikation mit Michael verlief sehr gut. Sehr empfehlenswert.

Wir waren mit der Unterkunft sehr zufrieden, das Bad und das Schlafzimmer sind ziemlich sehr groß und gut ausgestattet. Im Schlafzimmer gibt es viele Ablagemöglichkeiten und einen großen Kleiderschrank.
Das Zimmer ist sehr gemütlich eingerichtet, man fühlt sich sehr wohl, etwas Tee und Kaffee wurde zur Verfügung gestellt mit ein bisschen Süßem, so fühlt man sich gleich willkommen. Man hat zur Verfügung ein Teil der Wohnung, dazu gehört ein eigener kleiner Flur, ein Bad und das Schlafzimmer, was zur alleinigen Nutzung gedacht ist. Das Schlafzimmer kann man abschließen, wenn man möchte. Im Innenhof kann man parken. die Kommunikation mit Laila weil problemlos und unkompliziert. Sie ist sehr nett, aufgeschlossen und hilfsbereit. Wir würden gerne wiederkommen und Laila weiterempfehlen!
This place is just as described!  Wonderful place and close to everything!  You can walk to all sites and cute places to eat around.

Kleines, feines, sauberes und arg gemütliches Studio in ruhiger Umgebung, der Rummelsberger See liegt quasi vor der Haustür und lädt zum entspannen ein. Die S-Bahn erreicht man in ca. 5 Minuten und man ist dann in ca. 10 Minuten am Alex, Friedrichstraße und Co.
Wir kommen gerne wieder! 🙂
Waren sehr happy :)

Monika and Uve are perfect hosts. They are very kind, friendly and always helpful, making you feel right at home. The cottage we stay in is charming, cosy, very clean, well equipped and well located. We had a great time in Berlin and certainly Monika and Uve deserve much credit for it. Many thanks to them.

This is a great location to enjoy Berlin, you’re very close to the Mauerpark and right in the middle of Prenzlauer Berg.
Everything is very new in the apartment, the host was super friendly and we felt at home. Recommended for anyone wanting to explore Berlin.
Joli appartement, bien situé à proximité d'un métro et de plusieurs restaurants sympas.

Convenient location. 5mins walk from the station. The apartment is right on the street, only few stairs to the apartment. No need to climb up and down. Very clean and comfy! The only thing is the neighbour on the upper floor will start to run around at around 7am so if you are sensitive to sound, please bring a earplugs with you. Will definitely stay at Doerthe again if I come back to Berlin!
emplacement idéal pour la restauration, pour les supermarchés et l'accès au transports en commun, on n'a besoin de rien de mieux pour découvrir Berlin.

Great place if you can climb six floors a few times a day. There was deck paint odor on arrival making it hard to get fresh air on a hot and humid day, likely not typical. The owners are next door if there is an issue. Not their issue, had to figure how to use european showers knob :) - place is large and sort of psychedelic built decorated.

We had a phenomenal stay at Franz’s place! The apartment is beautiful with plenty of amenities. Franz left a packet full of great suggestions of nearby restaurants/bars. The location is absolutely perfect it’s close to everything including a grocery store. Would definitely stay again when in Berlin, we loved every minute of it!

We were first draw to this seeing how cheap it was, but weren't expecting such a large spacious space with THE comfiest bed and a balcony! Such a great location, Nastasya and her Grandmother were so helpful and kind! BOOK IT x

Very nice apartment, clean, look like new and big!
In the center of Berlin, in a very cute street.

The apartment is very spacious and cozy. It is certainly a lovely home. However, since the house is on the ground floor and the bedrooms are situated near the street, there can occasionally be some noise from passersby at night when sleeping. One more thing to mention is about the network. The WIFI connection in the house seems to be quite poor, with a weak signal and limited mobile service. We have reached out to the host about this issue and some other questions, but have not received a response yet.
Despite these, I would still recommend the house due to its pleasant environment. It is truly a comfortable place to live.
Wir hatten eine großartige Zeit in Berlin

Excellent location and the foldout bed is surprisingly more comfortable than you think. As it’s on a main road consider the noise before you book, but we were ok with it.
Would stay again
Una muy buena opción para la relación precio calidad. Todo muy limpio y la habitación tal cual como en la fotografía.

Ich kann mich den vielen positiven Bewertungen, die bereits geschrieben wurden nur anschließen. Björn ist ein sehr freundlicher Vermieter. Dem kurzfristigen Wunsch, mit 1 Person mehr anzureisen, wurde ganz unkompliziert entsprochen. Die Wohnung ist wunderbar. Ausstattung top! Ruhig durch die Lage im hintersten Bereich des Häuserblocks. Einzig der sehr spezielle Weg durch den Innenhof sollte erwähnt werden. Ich selbst fand es interessant, meine Familie allerdings war davon nicht begeistert, meine Tochter sogar eher erschrocken. Allerdings bestätigte sich die Aussage Björns über ein friedliches Miteinander sehr schnell. Daher war es ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt. Ich würde jederzeit zurückkommen!

Really nice little space for two people. The flat has everything you would need and in a great location. Would say if you're a light sleeper to bring some ear plugs as there is a bar on the floor below which is open some nights but didn't take us long to get off to sleep. Certainly wouldn't put me off coming back. Also if you do stay here definitely look at the recommendations sheet as there's some good tips on here: especially the Thai place! Thanks for a great stay.
Gute Lage, sauber, schöner Balkon
交通方便 位置很好 房間乾淨整潔 房東人也很好👍推薦！
Nous avons passé un agréable séjour dans cet hôtel calme et très bien situé au coeur de Berlin. Sans clim, il fait quand même très chaud dans la chambre, dommage !
Très propre et bien agencé, parfait pour une visite à Berlin!
Would definitely come back
The apartment is really nice and recommended for small groups.
Nice place to stay
Wie immer sehr gut, nächste Reise schon gebucht.

Stayed for 5 nights. The apartment is quite comfortable and met my needs well.  The area is great with a wonderful pub right next door.  Also 2 grocery stores within 5 minutes walk and restaurants whichever direction you walk. The kitchen is tiny but works well. I cooked 3 dinners there during my 5 night stay.

Maravilloso apartamento, bien comunicado con transporte público. Zona muy tranquila para descansar. Heiko muy hospitalario, nos recomendó lugares para comer y visitar. Sin duda, repetiría la estancia.

Ich hatte ein herzliches Willkommen durch Eces Mutter Elif.
Die Unterkunft war picobello sauber. Ein weiterer Pluspunkt: nur 5 Minuten zum Alex.
Sehr nett !!

It is conveniently located nearby an U-Bahn Station, as many reviewers have pointed out, though it's on the third floor, which may be a problem for those carrying heavy luggage (not a problem for me though as I just carried a backpack). The room itself is very clean and tidy. Sandra speaks good English (and of course excellent German) so communication should not be a problem. Her son is very nice and sweet :) And I would like to especially thank Sandra for preparing the room on such short notice from me.

Recently renovated so everything is very neat and complete. Check-in is flawless and if you need anything you can use WhatsApp, the team is pretty quick in helping out.
We really liked the bed, the location, the fact there is a Chromecast, the option to cook something if you want (small stuff of course). It was very hot at the time we were there so we were also very happy with the airco.
We did had an issue with the hot water but they actually fixed it very well.
In short we loved our stay in the Numa Hotel and the team.
Great place, good location. To be recommended.

Sehr nette Gastgeber, einfacher und flexibler Check-in, blitzblanke und sehr zentral gelegene Wohnung. Ein paar Grundausstattungsdinge haben leider gefehlt, aber alles in allem war es ein super Aufenthalt in Berlin! Gerne wieder :)
Appartement très sympa, dans un quartier calme. Idéalement placé pour les visites ou pour sortir le soir. Nous avons passé un excellent week-end.
Sehr schönes Zimmer. Super Lage direkt an der U-Bahn Haltestelle.

It was a very pleasant stay at Parwana. In her profile everything was described in the most accurate way, so it was very easy to find the house and stay there. Although not far from the city centre thehouse is situated in a calm area near to the park with a natural lake.
Tolle und superfreundliche Gastgeberin. Habe mich direkt zu Hause gefühlt. Und ich habe so gut geschlafen. Herzlichen Dank, Nadja!

Norm and his wife are perfect hosts. The location, historical Friedrichshagen, although a bit away from the center of the city of Berlin, is a wonderful and interesting community full of cafes, restaurants, shops and markets. For those that love to be surrounded by tranquility and nature, a two-block walk can take you to the shore of the Müggelsee Lake where a stroll and a beer will detox you from a crazy busy day in the city.
Nestled in this neighborhood, Norm’s place faces their back courtyard with a private entrance. The apartment is spacious and very comfortable. You will have everything you need and more for a relaxing stay. Make sure to peek into their back yard; full of wonderful surprises!
THE spot to stay in Berlin. Great area, walking distance, cute coffee shops around. Super quiet to get a lovely night sleep. Clean & much bigger than the photos lead on. Perfect

Wohnung ist gut gelegen, nahe an einer Tram Station, aber auch direkt neben einer Döner Bude.
Es war, denk ich, früher einmal ein Ladengeschäft, weil eine Seite auf die Straße komplett verglast ist. Dadurch ist es leider sehr laut. Unbedingt an Ohropax denken!
Bei Ankunft war leider wegen einem neuen Reinigungsdienst das Appartement nicht geputzt. Das wurde zwar nachgeholt, aber auch dann waren noch dreckige Handtücher des Vorgängers vorzufinden, dafür keine frischen für uns. Auf erneute Nachfrage, wurde das auf den Putzstress geschoben.
Ich denke gerade in diesen Zeiten ist Sauberkeit/Gründlichkeit äußerst wichtig.
Die Kommunikation mit Dietrich war anfangs super. Erst als es um die Bewertung des Aufenthalts ging versuchte er mit Geldrückerstattung eine 5 Sterne Bewertung zu erkaufen.
Menschlich für mich nicht in Ordnung.
Alles hat sehr gut gepasst. Das apartment ist sehr geräumig und schön! Schlüsselübergabe war problemlos & Bettina war immer schnell zu erreichen und sehr zuvorkommend :)!
L'appartement de Ben est bien situé en ce qui concerne les transports publics et les magasins. Ils est propre, fonctionnel et clair. Je le recommande.
Great big space with lots of beds. Had a great stay in Berlin at Duc Son’s after having to walk away from our booked hotel because it was filthy.
Schöne Unterkunft im Norden Berlins 😊
Very nice stay!

It was very easy to communicate with Stephan who left us guidance as to how to find the keys. 2 beers were waiting for us inside which is always a very welcomed touch.
The flat was exactly like the pictures and rather well located with a massive shopping center 10min away and bar areas in Neukolln and in Kreuzberg 20min away or clubs at walking distance or short cab drive away.
I highly recommend this flat for anyone who's looking to stay a week end in Berlin !

Instructions to get inside are very detailed yet we managed to miss a step and got very nervous. Both beds were comfortable and i liked having our own space in the apartment. The little extras...spices and oil for cooking were appreciated.
Responses were quick to our questions as were suggestions for eating out for my vegetarian daughter.

Mina’s place was as described, very clean and well located with close proximity to the Ubahn.  The garden is very nice and I am sure would be a great place to relax in good weather.  Mina responded promptly to my questions and requests. Overall a very good stay in Berlin.

A great place to stay. We’ve been there for 3 days and we really enjoyed their company and how friendly they were. Even we arrived 1 hour earlier but the room already been ready and they let us to go in. Wonderful hospitality I can say.
Zahid made us feel very welcome when we arrived. The place was very clean and looked really nice. Responsive hosts. Would strongly recommend Jörn and Zahid and this apartment!

Specious comfortable apartment.
Especially convenient for the remote work.
Very quiet and green area.
Easy access to the city center by public transport.
Nice restaurants around.
I’ll be happy to stay here again.

Alles wie beschrieben: Kleines Zimmer, günstig und in guter Lage. Auf Nachfrage wurden auch Wasserkocher und Tassen zur Verfügung gestellt. Leider war die Internetverbindung etwas instabil und langsam. Ansonsten alles ok.
perfect place, spacious and clean. Monika gave great instructions and was a very good host.
Een aanrader!! Toffe locatie en mooie, aangename en comfortabele kamer.
Danke war sehr angenehm
Sehr kinderfreundlich. Sehr ruhig. Wir würden nochmal buchen.
房東很熱情，簡介了一些柏林景點，民宿地點超棒！
väldigt trevligt ställe. Bra kommunikationer och bra värd
I had a lovely stay at this place. Everything was completely up to my high standards and I felt more at home than any other listing.

ottima posizione, proprio sopra la metro U3, collegatissima con altre metro per le zone centrali. quartiere tranquillo ma pieno di locali dove poter mangiare qualsiasi tipo di cucina. in due minuti a piedi si arriva allo zoo e alle vie limitrofe piene di negozi. Appartamento molto comodo, ottima qualità del letto, cucina attrezzata e ottima pulizia generale. Ottimo sia per soste brevi che lunghe.
Mi piacerebbe tornarci
Eine sehr gute Erfahrung! Nur zu empfehlen!
The best location for tourism in Berlin. Very spacious place. Host provides very useful information and is super nice. The check-in instruction is the clearest I've seen.
Beautiful home! Amazing location.
Ruhiges Zimmer, bequemes Bett und super nette und zuvorkommende Gastgeberin. Danke Cecilia! Wir kommen gerne wieder!

Данальд - очень гостеприимный, дружелюбный и общительный парень. В апартаментах есть ванна, стиральная машина, быстрый интернет. На кухне есть всё, что нужно для хранения и приготовления пищи. Можно использовать всё, что найдёте на кухне (специи, крупы, макароны, водку, пиво, мороженое). Отличное место за такие деньги.

Die angebotene Wohnung war blitzsauber und entsprach der Beschreibung.
Check In und Out unkompliziert und schnelle und freundliche Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber. Alles Top!
Alt var som beskrevet, rigtig fint sted.
Es war alles problemlos ,sehr gut !

Geräumiges Zimmer mit großem Bad und recht neu eingebauter Küche. Vor allem ist es ruhig gelegen! Es gab weder Tags noch Nachts Lärm. Die Heizung funktioniert gut. Zum Bus Richtung Hauptbahnhof sind es drei Minuten.

Eine sehr individuell gestaltete Unterkunft mit allem, was man braucht! Super Lage, mitten im Geschehen-dennoch absolut ruhig. Apostolos ist ein außergewöhnlich liebeswerter Gastgeber. Ich habe mich wahnsinnig wohl gefühlt und komme gewiss wieder. Sehr empfehlenswert!
Wir waren total begeistert. Das ist ein wunderschönes Hausboot in toller Lage, dem man die Liebe mit der es restauriert wurde, ansieht. Wir empfehlen es auf jeden Fall weiter!
everything was great

Das hier angebotene Apartment ist relativ lieblos eingerichtet. Die Möbel sind von sehr geringer Qualität und erfüllen, wenn überhaupt nur ihre Funktion. Allerdings sind auch bei den Stühlen schon teilweise die Stuhlbeine locker. Das Apartment ist nur oberflächlich gesäubert.
Wie in anderen Rezensionen zu lesen läuft die Dusche leider weiterhin über und die Fugen sind teilweise schimmelig. Auch ist der Halter der Duschbrause defekt. Am Abreisetag war zudem auch das Wasser komplett kalt und wurde nicht warm.
Auch sind die Ratten im Hinterhof beim Müll weiterhin ein Problem und begrüßen einen zu jeder Tag- und Nachtzeit.
Positiv festzuhalten ist die gute Lage und Anbindung an den ÖPNV.
Alles in allem ist das Apartment für den aufgerufenen Preis zu teuer, insbesondere wenn man für das gleiche Geld bereits ein günstiges Hotel buchen kann.

Dagmar was very responsive. It’s a new building in a very convenient location. We loved having the gym and the grocery in the building. There are a lot of restaurants and cafe’s nearby. The apartment has all the amenities we needed.
Cornelius was a wonderful host. He was responsive but otherwise left us alone. The apt. was exactly as described and immaculately clean. We had a wonderful stay.
Sehr schöne Wohnung in Berlin, nur die Gegend hat mir nicht so gut gefallen.
Sehr freundliche Atmosphäre, jederzeit wieder =)
Es war sehr gut

Good base for exploring Berlin as father & son, opposite bus and short walk to U Bahn. Basic accommodation and compact, but just as described, secure, and really clean with good communications. Handy supermarket over road. Felt quite pricey for what it was, but more affordable than others we looked at. Didn’t end up using hobs but fridge and equipment good for breakfast and making packed lunches. Would stay again and recommend if the description meets your needs.

Hier ist der Gast König - man wird ins Zentrum gestellt und richtig gut umsorgt. Angefangen bei einem personalisierten Schreiben, Wifi per QR-Code, Willkommensbier (Wie wärs mit was lokalem? ;) ), Nachfrage nach Befinden, Überraschung für die Heimreise - einfach nur WOW!
Die Wohnung liegt ideal: nahe zum Kollwitzplatz, rasch bei Ubahn und Tram. Für Kinder hat es in Laufdistanz mehrere tolle Spielplätze. Eingerichtet ist die Wohnung hübsch und es halt alles, was man so benötigt. Auch hier merkt man den Kundenfokus. So hat es nicht einfach Duschmittel, welche Gäste vergesse haben, sondern eigene in guter Qualität.
Kleine Manko: Die Wohnung liegt direkt über einer Pizzeria. Die Abluft des Pizzaofen wird direkt unter dem Balkon zur Frontseite hinausgeführt. Der Pizzageruch war Anfangs witzig, mit der Zeit aber eher stören und die Fenster konnten nicht geöffnet werden bis zum Ladenschluss. Lärmemissionen waren auch vorhanden, mit dem muss man aber rechnen, wenn man Städteferien bucht. Für Reisende welche eher früh zu Bett gehen (zB wegen Kindern) empfiehlt sich eher eine Wohnung in den oberen Etagen oder hinten heraus.
Unser Reiseerlebnis hat dies aber nicht getrübt - so toll war die Wohnung und der Service!
Danke euch, gerne wieder
Zum Schluss noch eine Anregung:
Obwohl via Airbnb gebucht musste noch zusätzliche Regeln akzeptiert und via Kredikarte ein Depot hinterlegt werden. Dies wurde in der Wohnungsbeschreibung zwar erwähnt, nicht jedoch der Betrag . Ich empfehle dies transparenter zu handhaben
Thank you so much! Easy to get in, great location and comfortable space.

Really lovely flat to stay in for my time in Berlin. Everything you could need in the kitchen, and super close to the U-Bahn so was easy to get into town and the airport. Met Birgit briefly when checked in, extremly flexible on checking in and out times which helped a lot! Definitely recommend.

Ich war für ein paar Tage bei Frau Katrin in Berlin und war sehr zufrieden mit dem Zimmer im alten Haus, das gemütlich und kreativ war ☺️🙌🏻
Frau Katrin hat auch zwei Katzen und zwischen den Museumsbesuchen habe ich Zeit mit ihnen verbracht 😇❤️
Frau Katrin ist auch sehr aufgeschlossen und aufrichtig, wir konnten viele Themen besprechen 🙏🏻😉

Shiny apartment conform to the description.
Not far from transport.
3 real bedrooms.
Large bathroom and living room
Perfect for discovering Berlin with friends.

I have used airbnb for many years, but I had never looked for a longer-term stay before. Stefan's garden house is, without a doubt, one of the most special places I ever stayed at.
I am a writer and was visiting Berlin for a month, and this place was exactly what I needed, and so much more. This very private garden house is well-equipped and thoughtfully and stylishly decorated. It couldn't have been more comfortable!
I felt like I was in the country, tucked away in a beautiful garden, fall light streaming in through all the windows as I was working at the big dining room table. And yet, the S-Bahn is just 7 minutes away, a bus that runs every 10 minutes even closer. In just over half an hour you are in Mitte. Since I stayed through the pandemic, I didn't feel like going into the city every day. There was no need! Gorgeous walks along the shore of the Havel river and Tegeler See, through Tegeler Fließ and around the quaint village Alt Lübars didn't even make me want to. I just could not get enough of the beautiful fall light and foliage.
Espaço incrível, muito confortável e bem localizado. Adoramos!

Rainer was a fantastic host! He provided a very clean and tidy apartment with excellent amenities and a lovely atmosphere.

Rainer was very responsive and easy to works with. Very clear check in/out instructions were provided and Rainer made the process very easy.
This was a five star appartement in an excellent city. We recommend this place without hesitation!
정말 많은 도움을 주고 편안하게 해주었던 호스트였어요! 추천합니다 :)
Appartement spacieux , dans un immeuble calme .

Located at the center of the city, close to public transportation and at walkable distance from interesting landmarks of Berlin. Clean and comfortable rooms. A nice place to stay while on busyness or just visiting the city.
Patrick’s place was a great apartment for our family stay in Berlin. Walkable to lots of places. Plenty of space for our family of 5.

Beautiful flat in a great neighbourhood between Kreuzberg and Neukölln. The communication with Rio was smooth, the flat and my room were as agreed and it all felt like being part of Berlin. I will gladly come again.

We hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad. Alle voorzieningen die we nodig hadden, lieve attenties.

Die Wohnung von Christorph ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Wir haben uns sofort zuhause gefühlt. Es war alles vorhanden, was man benötigt, um dort einen schönen Kurzurlaub zu verbringen. Ottimo ostello, l'accesso all'area camere avviene previa visione della guest card quindi garantisce un controllo al check-in. nice calm place right at the deutsche oper!

This space was wonderful and so charming. Diarmaid truly knows how to make a new place welcoming and comfortable for travelers. I stayed in the apartment for 5 days and it was perfect. Un super accueil, une hôte extrêmement bienveillante, flexible et disponible pour rendre notre séjour agréable. L'appartement est lumineux et entièrement équipé, il ne manque rien. Tout est décoré avec délicatesse, nous nous sommes sentis comme à la maison. On est rapidement au centre de Berlin.

Alles wie beschrieben, sehr sauber und liebevoll eingerichtet. Tolles kleines Loft.

Flora é uma anfitriã muito gentil, estava sempre disposta a nos ajudar, respondia as mensagens com muita agilidade.
A acomodação era bem preparada, dá para ver que ela já tem experiência como anfitriã, pois tudo tinha as instruções bem claras, então era muito difícil restar alguma duvida. Vale comentar que ela preparou o berço e a cadeira de alimentação para o meu filho! A casa tinha um clima muito acolhedor, além de estar localizada em um bairro muito bom, com mercado e pontos de transporte público por perto.
No geral, ficamos muito satisfeitos! Recomendo e me hospedaria novamente

Schönes Appartement, stilvoll eingerichtet und toll ausgestattete Küche! Besonders die eigene Terrasse, wo wir jeden Tag gemütlich gefrühstückt haben, hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Das Appartement ist gut gelegen; Bus und Ubahn gut erreichbar.
Es war alles super - die Wohnung war sauber und ordentlich - wir hatten eine schöne Zeit - die Kommunikation lief auch reibungslos:)

Il miniappartamento di Alice è perfetto per una coppia per visitare Berlino per qualche giorno. È ben arredato e curato, silenzioso e vicino ai mezzi. Rivedrei solo la stabilità del tavolino da usare per colazioni/cene. Nel complesso un ottimo AirBnB a un buon prezzo!

Tolle, großzügige Wohnung mit stylischer Einrichtung in perfekter Lage. Einziger Nachteil- wer einen leichten Schlaf hat, den stört die S-Bahn und die Hellhörigkeit eines Altbaus. Sehr bemühte und hilfsbereite Gastgeber!
I would stay again, it’s a nice place and staff are super helpful

The flat was perfect for a small group of 8, we arrived and the directions given were clear and easy to follow. The flat has a great placement and it’s really easy to get around. We were in Berlin on one of the hottest days for the summer. We contacted Noam and asked if it was possible to have some fans delivered. The hosts were efficient, friendly, and accommodating. Overall, it was a great stay and I would highly recommend!

We were lucky that Ulli accommodated us at the last minute after our earlier reservation elsewhere did not work out.  The room is much much better than what you see in the photos. It is a large room with own ensuite!  Both Ulli and her husband Frank were very helpful and friendly and their 2 girls were so lovely. Not many places on Airbnb are child friendly and it was great at Ulli's as when we were back early, my son had the chance to play with their daughters.  The location is very convenient too.  Thank you Ulli & family!

Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und die Beschreibung hat auf die vorgefundenen Sachen absolut gepasst.
Die Lage direkt in Berlin Mitte ist sehr gut. Es wäre schön gewesen wenn zur Unterkunft auch noch eine kostenfreie Parkmöglichkeit vorhanden gewesen wäre. Aber man findet um die Unterkunft genügend Parkmöglichkeiten.

really nice apartment. very clean and warm. everything you could want ..the kitchen had lots of appliances,utensils and china. good rooftop views. comfortable beds also quiet. S bahn short walk as are 2 supermarkets at end of road opposite Planetarium. great place to stay. thanks Cornelius.

The listing cannot be faulted! Indeed, it is better than the host lets on! The location of the apartment cannot be beaten - Alexanderplatz is easily reached in 2-3 minutes (walking) and well, Hackesche Höfe is right there. The apartment is spacious, clean and modern. Even if you don't feel like going anywhere - open a window and just absorb Berlin Mitte's life! Would recommend without question!  I will just point out, this apartment is perfect for people with disabilities as it has a lift/elevator. One last note, we arrived quite late so please do let the host know if you will check-in outside of 2-6pm - Hae-Ok organised someone to meet us for a small fee - this took the stress away. Loved it!!

Lovely place in a great location! It was the perfect place for my stay in Berlin where I wanted to feel at home. It was the first time I booked through AirBnB and I had a great start. Karsten did everything possible for me to feel good in his apartment and to find my way around Berlin. Thanks, Karsten for a wonderful stay.

Your East German paradise awaits! Centrally located in mitte, this stunning apartment offers extraordinary views, an amazing location just 2 minutes from the U bahn and everything you need for your stay in the city.  If you want a real Berliner experience away from the hotels and tourists uptown look no further - I can’t wait to come back!

I liked that it was close to Alexander Platz where most transportation arrives and it's an easy place to get to, but aside from that they let me check in early, the room was very clean, the bed was comfortable. It had a few adapters for international travelers and it was overall a really nice stay
Perfect location only couple of minutes walking from metro. Very comfortable for a single trip. The bathroom is super clean. I will definitely come back.
Perfect setting for a short stay. Relatively late check-in and very inflexible with their early check-out hours.
Very cute hostel, like that it’s not just bunk beds but you have a lot of space, it was clean, only down side the people at my dorm were slamming the door very early, not the hostels fault

We stayed at Enrique's place for two nights. The place is very easy to find, the check-in went super well, as he welcomes you personally. Around the flat are several supermarkets, restaurants and cafes, whilst being very well connected with Tram/Bus and Subway. He has very thoughtful touches in the flat, including a dehumidifier and an "air-cleaner" for allergies. Furthermore, he has a bunch of information letters regarding sightseeing options and other things to do in Berlin as well as several pre-selected walking/biking routes. Regarding the current situation, the flat is equipped with all necessary sanitary articles.  We will certainly come back and can only recommend his place to everyone who wants to spend a good time in Berlin. Gracias Enrique! Vielen Dank!
Perfekte Unterkunft für einen Berlin Trip! Gerne wieder.
Nice place.
Super Unterkunft und nette Gastgeberin!
Alles super, kommen gerne wieder!
We had lovely staying and enjoyed our accommodations , best regards😊 recommending the room 😌
Top Lage und absolut ruhig, mit offenem Fenster schlafen gar kein Problem. Absolut zu empfehlen.
Great place to stay in the Middle of Berlin, great value for a small price, highly recommended.

Das Landgut liegt etwas abseits direkt an einem Fluss. Es wird eine ruhige Lage geboten. Wir wurden sehr freundlich Empfangen und es wurde immer großer Wert darauf gelegt, dass wir zufrieden sind. Die Möblierung ist ein Mix aus Designer und Selbstbau. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und am letzten Tag haben wir das überwältigende Frühstückangebot angenommen. Neben frisch gelegten Eiern, über Müsli, Kaffee und einer Wurst und Käseplatte gab's auch warme Brötchen.
Ich denke wir werden nächstes Jahr wieder kommen :D

Casa molto comoda, pulita con ampi spazi e ben arredata. Molto piacevole abitare da Moni e Chris. Nella mia posizione preferita di Berlino.  Metro super comoda e vicina. Moni e Chris molto gentili e disponibili. Consiglio di soggiornare .

Compact flat in a quiet location with nearby shops, restaurants and public transport. Comfortable bed and sofa. Marc communicated well and easy check in and out. Only downside for me is it has no WiFi.

Howy's flat was clean and exactly as pictured. It wasn't luxurious, but the listing was very accurate, and I didn't intend to stay inside all day anyway. The flat had everything I needed, and was well worth the affordable price. It was up one flight of stairs, so take note of this if you have any mobility problems. I had multiple last-minute changes to my travel plans and arrival time, but Howy was completely flexible and able to meet me for check-in quite late at night without any problem. He was very quick to respond to texts.
The immediate neighborhood is charming and safe, with both posh and cheap eating options and lots of shopping, and there is access to two different tube lines (about 5 minutes walking time in one direction, and 10 minutes in the other). If you're in Berlin, don't limit yourself to a hotel in the middle of the city! You'll have a much richer experience if you stay in one of the more fun neighborhoods and explore the shops, galleries, and street art, and for a cheap multi-day ticket, you will still be able to take public transit to see the Wall and all the other main attractions.
I would recommend this listing without hesitation to anyone who wants to find an affordable but nice base point for exploring this wonderful city.
Nice Place to stay a couple of days. Very nice and helpful host.

I have nothing but superlatives to describe the efficiency of the AirBNB process and in particular Roi and his deputy who made our visit to Berlin so easy. The apartment was great for a couple about town. I could easily get to my conference and my wife loved the shopping proximity ! I would definitely stay here again if ever fortunate to return to hipster Berlin.

Die Unterkunft war prinzipiell sehr schön (entspricht den Fotos). Leider nicht ganz fertig: Nur Duschwannen, ohne Wände/ Vorhang: es wird alles überflutet, kein normales duschen möglich. Nur ein sehr kleiner/ beschädigter Spiegel, kein normaler Badezimmer Spiegel.
Zudem war die Sauberkeit ausbaufähig.
Positiv ist, dass der Gastgeber uns aufgrund der Mängel preislich entgegenkommen ist. Auch die Kommunikation war sehr freundlich und zuverlässig. Auch die Lage ist super: ruhig aber mittendrin.
Wenn die Sauberkeit, fertige duschen und Spiegel da gewesene wären, wäre alles top gewesen.

This place really exceeded our expectations. It had everything you’d hope for when traveling. It was really clean and the space is very well designed. It’s one of the best Airbnb places we’ve ever stayed in!

Oliver was great at communication. I let him know when I would be arriving and he met me in person to walk me through the house.
The location is quiet and easy to get to other places via public transit. It’s also not as touristy which I prefer. We found some great restaurants in the area. Would recommend this space for a larger group of people.
a very friendly man. quick response. communicative.
Good location and communication, could have a been cleaned more thoroughly.

This was a great place to stay! My son and I arrived late at night after a train long delay and they were so sweet to pick us up at the station! We were very touched by this sweet gesture! - the apartment is at a great location, very easy access to transportation and market. We’d totally stay here again!
It’s a really nice place to stay. Everything you need is there. Location is great. Would recommend
The location is great. It’s cozy. Checkin was easy.
Hostess Ella and the accommodation itself was very pleasant. In a good location and for great money. Thank you very much and we recommend!
Ruim appartement op een 20-tal km van het centrum van Berlijn. Zeer goed te doen met de fiets.
Appartement idéal et très fonctionnel pour un bref séjour à Berlin. Hôte très réactif et chaleureux par message.
Great place, good location,comfortable bed, friendly host.  Had everything I neded.  Would like to visit again next year.
Spacious room and apartment. Very close to public transportation. Host was not there for check in, but had his friend meet us at a convenient time for the keys. Very helpful throughout messages.

Big thanks again to Helen for the amazing hospitality!
The whole experience from communication to check-in was absolutely on point.
The apartment itself was unlike anything I’ve ever seen: so unique, full of character, and prepared with so much love and attention to detail. The area was also fantastic.
Helen went above and beyond even after our stay. I accidentally left a necklace behind, and she immediately took care of it and sent it to me by mail. Truly one of the kindest and most helpful hosts I’ve ever had.
I can honestly recommend this place to anyone.
Welcoming for kids — we loved the outdoor area!
We spend good time at Me Hien's place. Comfortable and clean and quiet. If will come again in Berlin will stay again. :)

Firstly, Sam’s apartment is ideally situated just a short 5-minute walk from a U- and S-train station, which is a significant advantage. The apartment is comfortable and located on a tranquil street with little traffic. It features electric exterior shutters on the doors and windows for complete privacy. The accommodations provide ample amenities for your visit.  Overall, enjoyed my stay there.
Sayın Günther, güler yüzlü ve samimi birisi idi.

Fantastic stay in a nice quiet area of Berlin. Area felt very safe. Transport was a 5 minute walk away. Handy supermarket downstairs (1 minute walk). Instructions to get into the flat were very easy to follow. Highly recommended!
Stanza pulitissima e spaziosa. La zona bella e comoda

This was perfect for us as two young people looking for a place to stay in Berlin for a long weekend. The location is perfect for sightseeing, with a train station a minute away from the flat. A supermarket and a pharmacy were also right by the apartment. Naomi was really quick to reply and gave us lots of useful information about travel around Berlin. Three people may have been a bit of a squeeze but for two it was perfect. The apartment was fun and clean and suited all of our needs. The area was nice and we felt safe, with three lockable doors between us and the street! There are plenty of restaurants nearby and we really enjoyed our stay here.

Tolles Wohnung, tolles Viertel. Rühig und einfach zu finden und bis die Interessanten Orten von Berlin zu laufen. Es fehlt nur Fensterläden um langeren Nachten zu schlaffen ! Aber möchte ich gern wiederkommen !

Perfect location in a lovely neighbourhood with lots of shops and restaurants nearby. I stayed here for 4 nights and had a wonderful time in Berlin with my 18 year old daughter, my 3 year old daughter and my parents (who are both 80). The hosts are kind, helpful and respectful people. The appartment was spotless clean and well equiped. Britt kindly arranged a cute new cot with pillow and duvet for my 3-year old to sleep in and her husband immediately came to the rescue when we had locked ourselves out! We higly recommend this appartment. We only found 2 downsides: one was that the covers on the beds were synthetic and that gets a bit too warm for us. It would be great if they would change that to cotton. Other minus was that the window in the bedroom could not open so that felt a bit closed in and stuffy exspecially since you had to keep this door closed as it is also the door to the bathroom!
Thank you Britt and family, we have enjoyed our stay in your cosy appartment!
Marjet, Sascha, Claire, Frits and Mary
Everything was just as described and superb location if you wanna experience Berlin. Great communication and hosts!
Alles super und angenehm!
Alles schick! Tolle Lage und dennoch ruhig gelegen. Schöne hohe Decken und stylisch eingerichtet. Gerne wieder!
Great apartment!
Sehr nette Hosts, gerne wieder!
Great stay close to lots of cool bars and cafes. Transportation is super easy since there is a metro stop right out front. Highly recommend! The concierge Max was very helpful as well. Thanks again.

Thank you!
Spacious and stylish apartment. Clean, comfortable, has everything you need. Subway is 20 meters from the house, and the bus too.
Highly recommend!
Great hostess, fully recommend!

Our long stay was filled with varied weather which one can fully experience from this location. The sky, mountain and water were amazing and even in February we were able to walk out in it. The porch is bigger than it looks in the photos and very inviting. The house is very comfortable, very well equipped and well cared for. Many places were closed, but we enjoyed the small general store and meeting people at Eileen's, as well as regular trips to Bantry. Be prepared for narrow road driving.

Everything about our stay at Ursula's apartment was perfect. The apartment was spacious, clean and comfortable and in a very quiet area. The silence, comfy bed and blackout blinds meant that we had a perfect sleep every night.
The location was also brilliant for us. It was walking distance into the Kreuzberg area where we spent a lot of time, and the station was 5 minutes away for when we explored further.
Eine sehr schön renovierte Wohnung , in ruhiger Lage .super Anbindung in die Stadt . Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt .
The location is perfect and the space is really lovely.

Die Wohnung ist wunderschön gestimmt und toll eingerichtet. Dazu kommt das besondere Flair der vierten Etage mit freiem Blick nach oben und auf die Konturen der gegenüberliegenden Penthäuser. Ein spezielles Feature ist der untenliegende Bahnsteig. Von dort unten steigen die beruhigenden Durchsagen für die Pendler ins offene Fenster.
Die Wohnung bietet alles, was man braucht. Wir hatten es leicht und beschwingt, Schlüsselübergabe sehr unkompliziert und Stefanie gut ansprechbar.

Een comfortabel bed en kamer. De badkamer is een verdiep lager, met douche (die niet goed afloopt) en wc. Hartelijke ontvangst en handige tip voor een lekker restaurantje. Ideaal voor een kort verblijf!

Die Wohnung ist einer guten Lage, sehr ruhig und mit guter Verbindung zum öffentlichen Verkehr. Nafi ist ein sehr netter Mensch, der sofort zur Verfügung gestanden hat, um mir den Schlüssel zu geben und die Wohnung zu zeigen.
Great location, great apartment. Much bigger than I thought it would be

L'ambiente è carino. Ma avevamo prenotato per due e ci siamo trovati solo un cuscino e un asciugamano quindi abbiamo dovuto arrangiarci per procurarci e prepararci tutto. In più il letto è da una piazza e mezzo. Il bagno è in comune con le altre due stanze e perciò, se l'appartamento é  pieno, ci si può trovare ad avere un bagno anche per 6/8 persone. la pulizia                                  dell'ambiente è appena sufficiente.  Invece i piatti erano sporchi (siamo consapevoli che questo dipende anche dagli ospiti). l'aspetto positivo è che molto vicino a un biologico dove fare colazione e dove prendere qualcosa a mangiare. Non abbiamo mai visto Parwana. E in cucina non ci tovaglioli di carta, nè una bustina di te. Ok, non è obbligatorio ma fa parte dell'accoglienza.

Pokoj byl čistý, přesně jako na fotkách. Koupelna trochu páchla, což ale mohlo být kvůli tomu, že zde nebyla okna, kudy by se dalo větrat.
Pokyny k ubytování byly jasné a srozumitelné, pokoj se dal zamknout a klíč jsme si mohli vzít s sebou, když jsme šli mimo budovu, cítila jsem se bezpečně.
Poloha ubytování byla blízko zastávky autobusu a metra, všude v okolí lgbt friendly podniky, byt byl blízko zoo i nakupního centra.
Za tuto cenu byl pobyt naprosto bezchybný.
The apartment was really quiet and comfortable, and very convenient overall... Good working desk and convenient internet for those in Berlin for business.
とても広々とした空間が過ごしやすかった。

It’s my second time staying at Thor’s and it was great again just as I remembered. He’s such a warm and welcoming host (and the cats too!) and his place is amazing. Comfy beds, clean private bathrooms, cool and modern interior, everything you wish from your airbnb stay. Plus, the neighborhood is quite and safe, close to the u bahn, bus, and also the famous Bergmannkiez.
You just need to book early!! :)
Wir waren das zweite Mal in der Wohnung und es war wieder einmal eine große Freude! Alles wunderbar!!!

Funda’s place was located in a nice quiet area 12 minutes from a main station and there was a supermarket and bar right outside! Funda was really helpful and answered any questions I had and had some very good recommendations!
It was a lovely quiet street and we felt very comfortable being able to get groceries/food/travel/etc locally.
The only downside was that some parts of the apartment were a little dirty, and our bedsheets had hair throughout them when we arrived.
Despite this though, the apartment was lovely, we really appreciated the beer and sweets left for us arriving and we can’t wait to visit again!
Great place, great location

My stay here was absolutely fantastic. When I got there I had no problems getting inside and once I got in I was already pleased. The place was so clean and so cozy. There was also a little booklet on the dining table with all of the information I needed about the place as well as restaurants, bars, and shops near by! I had such a delightful stay and this is the only place I will be staying during my future trips to Berlin. If I could give it more stars I would! Thank you guys for making my stay so excellent :)
Gerne wieder
Super schön eingerichtetes Apartment, perfekt ausgestattet in einer tollen Lage.
Everything was Perfect! Also the host great in communication! Vote: 10.

Ubicación estupendo, a 5 min de la parada de metro que conecta con algunos de los sitios históricos de Berlín. Elisa muy amable, no hicieron ningún ruido ni causaron ninguna molestia a pesar de que vivian en la habitación de al lado. Todo limpio, el apartamento bastante original, aunque quizás lo esperabamos algo más grande, pero todo muy bien.

Michael was an excellent host: very helpful but he is respecting the guest's privacy. The room- and the other facilities - are very clean. The neighborhood and the house is quiet. Interesting part of the city with excellent traffic connections.
We stayed a whole month at Jan’s place while we were relocating to Berlin. The two big rooms are really comfy and the location is perfect, close to some of the nicest spots in Prenzlauer Berg.
Beautiful apartment, convenient for Alexanderplatz but not too central, and a very short walk to some great cafes and restaurants

Perfect stay for a group of friends, we enjoyed being all together in one room. Apartment also has an own entrance from the street, a huge bathroom and a comfortable kitchen. Easily accessible by bus and 10 minutes walk from Treptower Park station.
Fint sted at bo til en forlænget weekend. Nemt til offentlig transport. Rent og pænt. Køkkenet indeholder et minimum, ikke engang salt og peber.

Wir haben leider das falsche Zimmer bekommen, in dem nur ein Bett vorhanden war (wir brauchten zwei). Kommunikation mit den Mitarbeitern war aber trotzdem hilfreich. Zimmer waren sauber, Steckdosen funktionierten nur zu 50%. Ist OK gewesen.

We enjoyed our stay in this beautiful apartment in a centralized part of Berlin - Mitte. Close to all transportation and was a great base to explore Berlin. The apartment itself is clean and well-equipped with an incredibly comfortable bed. We were greeted warmly and would happily stay again if we return to Berlin.
Excelente lugar, con todo lo necesario para hospedarse

Kleines Apartment mit allem, was man für einen Kurzurlaub braucht. Spitzenmäßige Lage, ruhig zum Schlafen und trotzdem dicht gelegen an U- und S-Bahn sowie am Tempelhofer Feld. Wir waren zum zweiten Mal in diesem Haus und kommen gern wieder.

Sörens Unterkunft liegt in der Nähe der U Bahnstation Sophie-Charlotte Platz, mit der man schnell ins Zentrum von Berlin kommt. Die Wohnung ist sehr ruhig, sehr sauber und sehr gut ausgestattet. Ich kann sie uneingeschränkt weiter empfehlen.
Great location, very quiet away from the busy road. Nice and clean and big room.
Ein unkomplizierter Aufenthalt für uns

Words can't describe how absolutely amazing my stay was. Not only did I feel completely at home and welcome but the warmth provided was like being with family.

In addition, the location is ideal. I walk everywhere and in lengths that most would find insane but it wasn't even a problem here. They are directly next to the bus and train which is wonderful but within 15 walking minutes you are on a main strip of markets, shopping and restaurants.

Loved Berlin, loved my stay but mostly I loved my hosts!
Super cool place! Perfect for a weekend. Really nice design, comfortable bed and high standard. Loved it!

Nice located apartment in trendy Prenzlauer. Easy communication with Carolina, could even check in earlier.
Baby chair and bed made things easier for our daily life 🙂
Great place for your money and a great, responsive hosts. I really recommend it especially for long stays. The place has everything and feels really cozy.
Bonne adresse.
Perfect location, very central for excursions throughout the city by foot, scooter or e-bike. Lovely decorated and all essentials available in the apartment. Will come back for sure
Все было отличто, только интернет плохой(
We zouden hier volgende keer graag terug verblijven
Super Unterkunft. Unser Ziel erstes Mal Airbnb war es in tolles Erlebnis.
Notre Séjour s’est très bien passé. Le contact avec l’hôte était aussi très agréable. Merci Katrin. A bientôt
Had a great weekend in Berlin and was really happy to stay at Klaus' place. Everything is like described in the offer. Very clean and pretty centrally located. Also, there is a metro stop 50m away.

Pros: the location is great and the adjacent building is beautiful. We really recommend you to try the restaurant next door (Katz Orange) - amazing meat and great cocktails! Quiet neighborhood. Apartment is fully equipped.

Cons: The sofa bed is ok for a couple of nights only, looks a bit rusty though... Be aware that there's no possibility of leaving your suitcase after the checkout time (not so convenient if your flight is in the late PM).

PS. Be careful, there are a few places with the same street name and number - be sure to mention the right postal code or neighborhood when ordering a taxi or uber.

Wir waren über das letzte Oktoberwochenende in Berlin, und haben den Aufenthalt bei Frank Norbert sehr genoossen. Es mangelte an nichts im Appartment( z.B. WLAN) und der Bus hielt fast direkt vor der Tür, so dass man in 20 Minuten in der Innenstadt war.

Love this place. The old building is charming.
Convenience to park around.
quiet and peaceful.
It's quite safe neighbourhood, really recommend this place if you are in berlin.

Nice size studio apartment, stylishly decorated, with all the basic things you need. It’s in a great neighborhood with good restaurants nearby and easy access to public transportation. It’s a bit of a challenge to get into but once I figured it out, it was fine. It’s an interior apartment looking out on a driveway, so not picturesque surroundings, but that might be expected in a city apartment building. Owners are responsive.

If i could give a place a 6 star review, especially for communication, accuracy, cleanliness, hospitality, and especially location and value, i would give each of the aforementioned 6 stars. If youre a couple or solo travelled (like i was) this is THE BEST AIRBNB IN BERLIN

Frank's place is great for a visit to Berlin. Fun neighborhood, close to public transportation and well equipped with all the necessities of life! We would definitely stay there on a future visit. We were two couples, but it would be a great place for a family with small children. Communication with Ingrid was very efficient!

Das AirBnb von Antonio war perfekt für meinen Aufenthalt, gut angebunden und hatte alles was es benötigt hat um eine tolle Zeit zu haben.
Micia die Katze war super pflegeleicht und sehr zutraulich.
Auch die Kommunikaiton war perfekt, ich kann diesen Stay absolut empfehlen.

Werner ist super hilfsbereit und sehr gut erreichbar. Die Unterkunft ist gut gelegen, direkt in der Nähe einer Ubahn und sieht echt sehr schön aus. Alles war ordentlich und sauber. Die Küche ist gut ausgestattet. Absolut empfehlenswert

cet appartement est idéalement placé, et très bien desservi par les transports en commun. l'accueil est parfait. l'appartement est spacieux , lumineux et confortable.parfait pour les grandes familles et/ ou les groupes d'amis. très bon rapport qualité/prix. idéal pour découvrir ou "approfondir " Berlin.

Excellent appartment! With nice neighborhood.
Philippe

La vue est vraiment incroyable, le quartier est parfait pour sortir facilement le soir et rentrer tout aussi rapidement. Ivos est très sympathique. On a trouvé tout ce dont on avait besoin dans l’appartement. Le lit est confortable. Il y a un supermarché juste au pied de l’immeuble, très pratique.
Alan and Kasia were super hospitalble, accomodating and we had an amazing time in Berlin. Great location and super close to both the S Bahn and U Bahn to easily get everywhere around the city :)
Very friendly and helpful host. Provided me with a lot of useful information about touring around Berling city.
Wir haben ins sehr wohlgefühlt. Bett und Couch waren gut zum Schlafen. Tolle Lage und alles da, um selber zu kochen. Wir würden wieder kommen.

Beautiful space, neighborhood, lots of  restaurants and shops, also a little quieter than some other neighborhoods in Berlin. The room was spacious and the bed was very comfortable. Angelika was a great host and I had an awesome stay!
Recommended!

L'alloggio è perfetto per una coppia! Ben posizionato a lato della metro U8!
L'appartamento è pulito e dotato di tutto. Lo consiglio

The apartment is big and beautiful!
Great location and communications.
Stella’s flat was easy to find and check in, and was clean and comfortable. The location is well connected in a nice area, and would recommend to anyone wanting to explore Berlin

Raffaela ist eine unglaublich herzliche Person. Wir haben uns in Berlin sofort willkommen gefühlt. Außerdem hatte sie wirklich tolle Tipps für uns, vor allem, was die besten Lokale in der nächsten Umgebung anging. Ich würde mich mit meiner Familie jederzeit wieder bei ihr "einnisten"! ;)
Lena's place was perfect for our visit and the neighborhood had lots of opportunities for fun engagement with the local community.  We highly recommend!
Eine sehr schöne gemütliche Wohnung. Wir haben uns sofort zu Hause gefühlt. Die Lage ist Top, Fahrradverleih und U- Bahn ganz in der Nähe. Würde ich sofort wieder machen. Vielen Dank dafür
Great stay.  Just as advertised. Mia was responsive and nice.  Would stay again.
Super tasteful apartment in one of the best locations in Berlin. Will come back!

Es war ein sehr entspannter Check-in. Ingo war flexibel und hat mir sogar mit dem Koffer geholfen. Das Bett war groß (KingSize) und mega bequem. Eine sehr positive Lage. Dankeschön und sehr  empfehlenswert 😊
Described very well, had some problems with internet (very slow and limited devices) but with some communication found the solution. Very silent area, easy to move on.
Very ideal for my business trio
Comfortable room and very helpful host. I would be happy to stay here again.

Lieber Stephan,
wir waren unglaublich zufrieden und angetan von deinem Loft. Mit viel Liebe zum Detail hast du unseren Aufenthalt zu etwas ganz besonderem gemacht. Es war sehr sauber und gut durchdacht es hat uns an nichts gefehlt.

Vielen Dank für alles.
Really enjoyed staying here, great location and responsive host :) room was very clean as well, thank you for everything!

Es war ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt in Berlin. Das Zimmer ist sehr geräumig und sauber gehalten. Leider haben wir Matija selbst nicht kennen gelernt. Dafür aber seine herzliche Freundin Xenia, die sehr gast freundlich war und uns viele tolle Tipps gab. Sehr empfehlenswert!
Wer in einer Großstadt was sucht zum Runterkommen, ist hier an der richtigen Stelle.
Superfin lille lejlighed i et skønt kvarter. Tæt på U-bahn og masser af små og store spisteder i nærheden
Wir waren sehr positiv überrascht von dieser Unterkunft. Es war sehr sauber und Handtücher sowie Bettwäsche haben sehr angenehm und frisch gerochen! Viele kleine, liebevolle Details.

Netter Gastgeber und Wohnung in guter, zentraler Lage, bezüglich der Sauberkeit darf man jedoch nicht zu anspruchsvoll sein. Wir haben uns daher leider nicht sehr wohl gefühlt. Preis-Leistung war für uns daher verbesserungswürdig.

This apartment is close to two Ubahn lines (U7 and U9), extremely convenient for getting around the city. The apartment is comfortable; others have mentioned traffic noise but we did not find that to be a problem. Jörn and Zahid were extremely responsive and helpful.
Nina的房子面积真的很大，并且有几乎所有你需要的东西，一次很棒的住宿体验
Studio was as described, actually better than described. It was clean,  roomy and very quiet, although the place is very close to the night scene of F'hain. I would definitely stay there again.
Beautiful spacious apartment. Quite a climb to reach (6 flights of stairs). At U bahn station. Supermarkets, bakery and play area for kids nearby.
We had a lovely trip in Berlin! Thanks a lot! It was the perfect location to stay for our plans and needs. Highly recommended and will try to be there again for our next visit.
Das „Hotel Q!“ hat uns durch den super Service, die tolle Lage in der Nähe vom Kurfürstendamm, die freundlichen Mitarbeiter und das gute Preis-Leistungsverhältnis überzeugt.
Amazing appartment!

Irene is very nice host and staying at her place, even for only few days, was very pleasant. Room is nice and quiet, away from busy streets and has artistic vibe, which we loved. The traffic connections from here is also very convenient, we managed to access all major sightseeings under half an hour if not less.
For sure, we will recommend it to our friends visiting Berlin. :)

I'm so happy with this Berlin contact. We had an amazing stay here. Bee and Sam were very welcoming, available for questions, and gave us great recommendations. It's very close to public transportation so you can explore Berlin. The room is so cozy and bright! Thank you Bee, I wish you and your family all the best. Kate
Hier stimmt alles. 10/10. Danke!

Logement parfait à Berlin, accessible facile depuis le metro U5 et la gare.
Quartier agréable avec nombreux restaurants et appartement sur cour au calme.
The mattress is 5 cm thick! So take some painkillers with you!
Place was nice, clean and he area around is great!

Die Lage ist super. Einfach mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen (oder einfach auch mal laufen (bis zum Alex 30 Minuten)). Die Wohnung ist ruhig und sauber. In der Umgebung gibt es vielen Restaurants. Auf Fragen erhielten wir sofort eine Antwort. Parken ist ein Problem, da keine kostenlose Parkplätze vorhanden sind. Allerdings gibt es in der Kulturbrauerei das Parkhaus. Tagessatz Euro 15 Euro. Leichter ist es sich im Vorfeld eine Contipark-Karte zu besorgen. Dadurch sind nur noch max 7 Euro zu zahlen.

We had such a great time at Ben and Simons apartment. It was super clean and was very comfortable! Simon was so welcoming and gave us all the local tips. Great location and value for money. Would highly recommend this air bnb! Thanks again guys! 😊
The best location in Berlin and access to the courtyard in the back was an extra bonus.  Would definitely stay there again.
Excellent location being close to trams, and very spacious.  Also good value.  Highly recommend.
We really enjoyed our stay in the appartement of Simone. It's close to public transport. Simone is very helpful and welcomming!

You have to make sure whatever you want to know about the apartment and the rules. Ask everything when you check in to the owners because I found a bad experience with the neighbors especially the one in front of the door is a bit difficult to deal with. We have to be super quite. Nevertheless, the apartment was nice, clean, and comfortable.
a big and comfortable apartment at the heart of the Mitte neighborhood. Anna was friendly and helpful. Highly recommend.
Gerne wieder! der Standort ist super. Die Zimmer an sich sind wünderschön!

Die Wohnung liegt direkt in Neukölln und ist innerhalb weniger Minuten per S Bahn zu erreichen . Mehrere Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind in der Nähe vorhanden .  Der Zugang zur Wohnung wird über ein Code Schloss gesichert . Eine Taxi Haltestelle ist in der Nähe.

Une grande chambre dans un quartier très sympa, piéton et vivant ! Marielle m’a fait de très bonnes recommandations. L’appartement n’est pas loin du métro / tram et il est spacieux et calme. Petit bémol pour la propreté ; j’ai trouvé pas mal de cheveux et de poussière sur les meubles mais rien d’outrageant. Gros plus pour le prix : 90€ pour 3 nuits c’est vraiment bien pour les budgets serrés ! J’ai apprécié mon séjour.
Very nice and big apartments. Patrick left some wine and snacks for us on arrival. Would recommend it!
Very modern and clean studio apartment in a charming neighborhood.
Ingrid war sehr freundlich und unkompliziert. Die Wohnung ist sehr gut ausgestattet, sauber und sehr ruhig gelegen. Meine Familie hat sich sehr wohl gefühlt und würde gerne wieder kommen.

Très bon séjour dans la chambre privée du Minimal Hostel N°43. L’accueil est chaleureux, les hôtes sont respectueux les uns des autres, le lieu est parfaitement propre : bref, rien à redire .
Le seul petit inconvénient serait la mauvaise isolation sonore (les murs sont fins) mais cela ne nous a pas empêché de passer un excellent séjour.
Vous pouvez en plus laisser vos bagages sur place la journée de votre départ afin de ne pas être encombrés.
Je recommande !!
Amazing place, cool style, cosy, great outdoor terrace and has all the amenities you need. The location is perfect for exploring Berlin, also some great places to eat nearby.

What a great place for a hotel, luxurious looking very modern and convenient place in Berlin, 20min tram drive from Alexander platz.
If you have never been in Don Xuan Centre then That's even a bigger plus for you, it's a culture shock and you cannot choose what to buy in these Asia markets.
Free parking spot is also a big +

Appartement propre, chaleureux, fonctionnel et qui correspond parfaitement aux photos et à la description. Andrej et Vivien répondent rapidement, avec sympathie et professionnalisme aux questions posées. Un arrêt de bus au pied de l’appartement vous emmènera facilement où vous le souhaitez à Berlin.
Im großen und ganzen super !
Functional apartment. Great value. Would certainly recommend.

I can only recommend this place, it was clean, very calm and cozy. Also, nice and comfy bed and it is a big plus.
Perfect to reenergize after long days :) Thank you!
Sehr nette Begegnung

Great locality close to the undergound and the neighborhood is also really nice.
Communication with hosts was great and they were kind.
House was clean and well equipped and also has lovely book and vinyl collection.
Excellent location, comfortable home, friendly host.  We are a family of four.  Stayed there for a month.  Loved it.  Prasad was very responsive and supportive.  Highly recommended.

Tram-Verkehr hörte man sehr gut in der Wohnung.
Kein TV. Ansonsten ganz ok. Für die Lage, Preis ok.

The location of the accommodation was perfect for getting around, with easy access to public transportation nearby. The kitchen, bathroom, and bedroom were all clean and neatly arranged, and the stylish decor made my stay feel even more pleasant. The bed was spacious enough and the room was bright enough during the day without turning on the lights.
Sabastian was warm and friendly—despite there being no elevator in the building, she kindly helped me carry my very heavy suitcase upstairs. She also recommended some great places to visit, which really helped me make the most of my trip.
Thanks to the host, this has become an unforgettable trip to Berlin. 👍😉

Tolle Unterkunft, war bereits das zweite Mal hier und würde mich immer wieder für die Nena Appartements entscheiden. Die Lage direkt an der Spree ist wunderschön und das Bett ist einfach nur unglaublich! Selten so gut wie im eigenen Bett geschlafen. Der Check-In ist unkompliziert und einfach, eine Bushaltestelle direkt vor der Haustür und gegenüber ein Rewe und dm.

The check-in was super easy, location is excellent, host communicates...BUT.... the toilet seat was broken... while flushing, all shit and water came out and spread onto bathroom floor. On last day we cud not even enter bathroom... then someone for cleaning was sent to to our surprise he had just picked up the floor towel, drained it and left it to dry on heater without even washing it...
The floor was very dirty, my children had all dirty foot when they moved on the floor bare foot after the entire day's walk... It appeared the floor was not cleaned.
