I would never go back to the same accommodation ever as it is so dirty and host is saving all money which he charges in the name of cleaning.

Sehr schöne liebevoll eingerichtete Altbauwohnung in Berlin Friedrichshain. Tolle Lage mit vielen Cafés, Restaurants etc. Vom Ostkreuz gut zu erreichen. Fadeih war immer zu erreichen; sehr gute Kommunikation. Check-in durch Schlüsselbox flexibel. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und kommen bei Gelegenheit gerne mal wieder :-)

Allthough we haven't met Reinhard and his wife, they communicated with us from the beginning to the end. Really pleasant! The appartment is clean, beautifull and cosy. Excactly as the pictures show! We had an amazing stay and would definitely return.
Thanks for all! Thoughtful and punctual service, stylish and cozy flat.

Ich habe eine Unterkunft für meine Eltern gesucht, die zum Besuch gekommen sind und ich habe Alexanders Wohnung gefunden. Meine Eltern waren begeistert! Die Wohnung ist klein aber fein: elegant aber gleichzeitig easy eingerichtet mit sehr höhen Wände und viel Licht. Das location ist auch optimal: im Graefekiez Mitte Kreuzbergs und in der Nähe des Kanals. Sehr gute Erfahrung!
Great appartment with everything you need for a nice weekend in Berlin. Location is super and communication with Fadeih as well!

Excelente alojamiento, todo muy limpio y ordenado. Pequeño pero muy completo, no me faltó nada! Los anfitriones de lujo, cada pregunta que tuve me la respondieron lo más rápido posible. Claramente volvería a venir!

Der Aufenthalt war super. Der Check-In und Out liefen problemlos, die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet und die Kommunikation mit Fabian war immer super und sehr proaktiv. Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt, aber wenn man alle drei Schlafmöglichkeiten nutzen will ist es eventuell etwas eng aber vollkommen machbar!
Le logement était très confortable pour un prix abordable, je recommande
Sehr zentraler Ort für einen Berlin-Aufenthalt, gut mit dem öffentlichen Verkehr angebunden, man kann in der Wohnung gut für sich sein, die Katze bemerkt man kaum.

The flat is in a great location, just five minutes walk from the nearest U-Bahn station. The surrounding area has plenty of nice restaurants and bars, and there is a convenience store on the corner of the street. The flat itself is spacious and has great facilities. It was very clean and comfortable. Alex's instructions were clear and precise. Highly recommended.

At a quick glance to help those deciding:
Pros: excellent location, great transport links making it easy to get back to and find, great for 2 people at most, lovely host who was very easily contactable, comfy beds (1 single 1 double), nice shower, coffee machine, kitchen area small but has essentials to make meals, clean, lots of lovely cafes and restaurants down the road
cons / to be aware of: no separate shower room (shower in open space living room / kitchen on 'lower level' ) so not so much privacy if sharing place with a friend. It is about 3 floors up with no lift so just pre warning if bringing a lot of luggage.. , about 3 different locks to get through (very secure but just takes some time to get in..not a bad thing just to be aware), really steep staircase to get up and down to the double bed could use safety rail or bannister. Please stock more toilet paper :)
over all would stay again - thank you Naomi.
Sehr grosszügige Wohnung, tolle Ausstattung an guter Lage. Wir können diese Wohnung voll weiter empfehlen

Spent some nice days and enjoyed staying in Martin's flat.
Whenever we had a question Martin was super quick and helpful to respond.

I stayed for 5 days for a bit of fun summer travel and would love to stay again. The bed was super comfortable and clean, room itself was very spacious, sunny, and with all kinds of small things to make it more comfortable (hot water, places to hang clothes, etc). And of course, Alex and Daniela are incredibly kind and accommodating hosts. A great place for anyone who would like to feel more at home during their travels.
Till is a very discreet and respectful host. He also suggested a good place to eat in the area, and was available for a late checkin. kind person. Recommended.
Recomendable. Martín muy amable.
Optimale Lage und schöne Wohnung.
Very unique place, great location for access to all the bars and restaurants in the area.
Preis-Leistung etwas zu hoch angesetzt im Vergleich zu Hotels aber schickes Design.
It is a lovely space. Suitable for a family or group. Easy walk to a train station and lots of shops and restaurants.
Beau studio, propre, bien équipé, à la décoration sobre et élégante, dans un environnement calme et pourtant proche de l'île aux musées accessible à pied. Bon accueil de la part de Markus et Paula.
Zentrale und äußerst sympathische Unterkunft, jederzeit wieder!
Well Located. Nice accommodation in the heart Of Berlin Clubbing

El domicilio está en un sitio inmejorable, una zona tranquila, al lado de un supermercado y a 2 minutos de una boca de metro. Es tal y como se describe en el anuncio, quizás incluso un poco más amplio.
Amit fue un buen anfitrión.
La única contra es que el baño es un poco estrecho, que no tiene microondas y le faltan algunas cosas básicas como gel de ducha, algo para desayunar... aún así, sin duda, lo recomendaría para descubrir la maravillosa ciudad de Berlín.
Great room, apartment was very clean and comfortable, and the location is perfectly located in Kreuzberg. Highly recommended.
Lovely, quiet place, convenient to U-bahn, stores and restaurants,  I had a very enjoyable stay.
The flat is faithful to the pictures, great place and well located in Berlin
Super für späte Check-ins
Very nice host who was always available in case of a problem. I Warmly recommend him.

Super Wohnung, Super Host!
danke Frank !

Great apartment with a great location. It’s a ground floor but there’s no noice and has a lot of light. Great location to go everywhere.
I will come back.

Thank you Antje for a lovely stay. The apartment was perfect and indeed extremely sunny when we stayed in September. Location is ideal for the underground and easy to get to from the airport. Area is nice and peaceful given how close to city centre it was. Nice cafes and bars within a few minutes walk. Couldn't think of a better place to stay if visiting Berlin for a few days
Good place to stay!

먼저 위치를 말하자면 트램역과 지하철역이 근처에 있어서 꽤 갠찮은 위치입니다. 유명한 시나몬롤이 있는 zeit fur brot도 바로 근처에 있어어 좋았습니다.
체크인할때 의사소통도 안되고 답변이 늦어서 저녁에 도착한 저에게는 매우 불안감을 주었습니다. 기재되어 있는 주소도 다르니 체크인전 다시 주소 체크하세요.

먼지 가득한 그런 느낌입니다 :)
All amazing! 🖤
The apartment was spacious, comfortable and very well located. Oliver communicated promptly and made accessing the space very straightforward. Highly recommended.

tout près d'un arrêt de S-bahn (et d'un LIDL accessible par un portail privatif!), la maison sur une partie privée d'une rue calme dans un quartier très vert. maison habitée par les hôtes qui le louent le temps de leur absences/voyages donc tous les équipements (et les couteaux aiguisés!) sont bien présents. la maison très grande, spacieuse et accueillante, le jardin est une merveille. on s'est tout de suite sentis comme chez soi et on regrettait de partir.
Very open, free house. Feels very comfortable and and home. :)
Highly recommend! Great hosts, clean and comfortable apartment, such a great shower! Clear instructions on everything. We would be happy to stay again.

Notre week-end à Berlin Chez Leona a été parfait du début à la fin.
L'appartement est extrêmement bien décoré et lumineux.
Il y a de nombreux transports juste à côté. Le quartier regorge de chouettes restaurants et bars.
Leona a été une super hôte, flexible et très sympathique.
Nous espérons pouvoir y retourner très vite.
Tres belle adresse au calme et spacieux pour des adultes

Logement très bien situé, endroit très calme et proche d'une gare pour accéder au centre de Berlin. Malheureusement, nous n'avons jamais rencontré le propriétaire qui habite pourtant le même immeuble.

Die Wohnung ist prima, wenn man zentral in Kreuzberg wohnen will. Wohnung ist sehr gut in Schuss. Nette, unkomplizierte Vermieter. Die Straße ist belebt, auch nicht ganz leise, dafür hat man aber auch einen Haufen Restaurants vor der Tür. Wir mochten den Pakistaner sehr.
Jörn es muy amable y esta dispuesto a ayudarte. Su piso es comodo y suficiente. Está muy bien ubicado.
Best comfiest bed!

The appartment is on the ground floor, many strange people were passing by our windows and looking inside. The shower was broken, we couldn’t turn it off/on; the owner provided a handyman, but the shower wasn’t fixed at all, also shower gel wasn’t there as advertised. The appartment is different from photos, cheap blankets and pillows, mattresses are very used and not comfortable. Positive thing is that the appartment is good located in the city.

Great accommodation, it is in a good location in the city, very clean and looks like in the photos. Also heating was good in winter.
Loved the modern check-in & unlocking system via the phone in the web app.
Host was proactive and friendly in communication, including via phone.

Super comfy apartment really close to everything in Berlin, very good communicated with Hauptbahnhof station.
The apartment was so clean and cozy. The communication with the host was fast and kind.
I would like to repeat.

Tolle Wohnung mit allem eingerichtet was man zum täglichen Leben benötigt.
Kann ich nur weiterempfehlen.
We loved the vibe of the place and the neighborhood. Looked just like the pictures and there were even board games for us to enjoy, which was great because we forgot to bring any :)

Wir waren für eine Nacht dort. Jeder der eine Bleibe finden will für ein Konzert in der Columbiahalle, ist dort perfekt aufgehoben. Ein Weg von 15 min und schon ist man da. Die Kommunikation mit Louis klappt einwandfrei und es wird auf die Privatsphäre geachtet. Wir haben uns wohlgefühlt.

A bot of a mixed review. First of all the location is great - not far from vibrant Schönhauseralle but still in a reasonable peaceful side street. The apartment was very spacious and the beds were comfortable. It was clean and tidy. Access was easy based on the instructions. Things we didn't like were mainly the fact it was so stuffy and we stayed over a hot weekend. We could only open a couple of small windows and nothing at the back for airflow. We had trouble with the curtain rails falling down. We had to leave the front door open, but had a few curious strangers come up to the door... The shower is odd being in the kitchen, I guess it's a converted shop, and one part of it didn't work (the top shower head). So a bit of a mixture but overall I would still say very good value for money in this area.
Clean place that suited my needs in terms of location and amenities. Good value for money. Easy communication with host

If you want to enjoy one of Berlin’s hippest areas and have great access to the U Bahn, fun bars and restaurants you should consider this location. The flat is modern, spacious, clean and well furnished. The beds are comfortable and the rooms provide privacy and the kitchen was well equipped with everything you need.  The common courtyard in the back is very nice and  we felt very safe and secure.
Die Wohnung hat unser Berlin- Wochenende perfekt gemacht!

Ece's parents are very kind. The room was nice and clean and the apartment very close to the Jannowitzbrücke station, half way between Holzmarkt and Alexanderplatz. Highly recommended for solo travelers in Berlin!
We visited Berlin with 4 friends and we stayed at Sedats appartment. The appartment was very nice and clean and the beds were very comfortable. The location was perfect and very quiet. Thanks!

Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt!
Nice place, good location and comfortable room.

Konaklamamdan cok memnun kaldim. Ev merkezden biraz uzak ama yakininda cok fazla otobus duragi yer aliyor. Mutfak beni sasirtacak derecede donanimliydi. Esnek giris imkani sunuldu, üstelik ev tertemizdi. Seyahatimden cok memnun kaldim. Bir daha Berlin'e gelirsem kesinlikle ilk tercihim olacak.

Preis Leistung war super. Der Gemeinschaftsbereich hinter der Rezeption ist super geeignet um zu verweilen. Es gibt rund um die Uhr Kaffee, Tee, und verschiedene Cornflakes. Außerdem gibt es eine bunte Auswahl an Gesellschaftsspielen. In der Ecke liegen autoteppiche und Kisten mit Holzeisenbahn und Spielautos. super Kinderfreundlich. Morgens gab es zudem noch warme Schokocroissants und frisch aufgebackene Brezeln. Wir waren sehr positiv überrascht und werden definitiv wieder kommen.
Limehome had me comfortable while I was there. I had nothing to worry about as everything was clean, the instructions to get there were so clear and cut.
Ben's place was clean and bright. The new balcony is lovely and you don't feel overlooked. Ben had loads of tips for eating in Neukolln, so if you're a foodie your in for a treat.

I really enjoyed my stay at Sophie’s & Adam’s place in Kreutzberg. The apartment is bright & airy, comfortably furnished & everything is in good working order. The beds are really comfortable & the arty interior is very pretty. I particularly loved the big windows overlooking the leafy street.
There are parks & restaurants a few blocks away. Relatively close to public transport & a good supermarket about 2 kms away.
Overall, I had a wonderful stay & this lovely place made my trip to Berlin even more special. Highly recommended!
Aprtment is a very comfy and nice near S-bahn and tram station. Everything was great. Apartment is very clean and well equipped. I recommend it to everyone. :)
Had a very pleasant stay and  Ursula was a very helpful host!
Good location, the house has all the basic needs.

We zijn met een vriendenclub van vier personen naar Berlijn gegaan. We wilde graag ruimte hebben en het moest in de buurt zijn van openbaar vervoer. De loft was een perfecte uitvalsbasis. lekker groot en van alle gemakken voorzien. Naast de loft zit een prima café met lekkere cocktails.
Kortom, mocht je naar Berlijn willen gaan dan is dit zeker een aanrader.

Host are friendly and kind
Living area is big and comfortable, can sleep very well

Liebe und nette Frau. Hab mich sofort wie zuhause gefühlt. Die Ausstattung und Möglichkeiten die von der Gastgeberin geboten werden sind einfach klasse. Für Gespräche nach einem langen Arbeitstag immer zu haben.
Weiterhin alles gute !

- The apartment is in a lovely area (Charlottenburg); it's quiet and very well connected to the rest of Berlin . There are also shops nearby and many places to grab a bite for a cheap price.
- Zito and Zohra are very kind, they even gave us tips on what to do, where to go, which public transports to take.
- The apartment itself is very nice: comfy, warm and clean. The only thing is that there's no stove, so bear that in mind if you're planning to cook.
In conclusion, great apartment, great host, great area. Highly recommend.

Perfect for our requirement. Clean, easy to access, spacious, no unwanted surprises. The location off Karl-Marx-Straße is a little remote but only 5 mins from the underground. Good local café for breakfast.
Everithing was ok.

We stayed in Susanne’s place for 6 days and we have a marvelous experience. The house is beautiful and she and her family really welcoming and awesome persons. They let us felt like home. The private bathroom is definitely a plus. 100% recommended
Immer wieder gerne!

A true gem!  We were met on our arrival and given a full briefing on the place. The apartment is very well equipped and the location could not have been better.  The area is alive with activity and restaurants and things to do.  Stephanie ensured a perfect stay.
todo perfecto

Wir haben diese kleine super schöne Wohnung für einen Kurztrip in Berlin gebucht… angefangen von der tollen Kommunikation mit Wibke über den unkomplizierten Check in und dem Aufenthalt in dieser sauberen und komfortablen Wohnung , bleibt uns nur zu sagen… Danke !!!! Wir kommen wieder ;)
Super zentral gelegen , ÖPNV direkt vor der Haustür … kostenpflichtige Parkplätze direkt um die Ecke ;)
Alles wunderbar !

Die Apartments liegen zentral mit U-Bahn, Supermarkt und Essensmöglichkeiten in der direkten Umgebung.  Das Zimmer hat alles, was es braucht. Vor allem die kleine Küche mit Kühlschrank, Herd, Kaffeemaschine, Wasserkocher und kleiner Spülmaschine haben wir sehr genoßen. Zimmer und Badezimmer waren sehr sauber. Ein- und Auschecken war sehr unkompliziert.

Alojamiento muy agradable, apartamento amplio muy limpio y ordenado. Punto muy agradable el patio para desayunar o tomar algo. Camas muy cómodas. Es ideal para 4 personas aunque caben cómodamente hasta 6.
alles super
Really friendly host, good facilities, great location.

Die Location von Anas Wohnung ist nicht die allerbeste, bietet aber einige Möglichkeiten alternative Gegenden (eben insbesondere in Neukölln und Kreuzberg) zu erkunden. Ansonsten geht's auch mit der U-Bahn (Hermannstraße oder Rathaus Neukölln) halbwegs schnell zu den touristisch interessanteren Gegenden.
Die Wohnung war sauber, das Badezimmer etwas heruntergekommen (aber ok, wenn man nicht allzu hohe Ansprüche hat), die Küche schön und das Zimmer zu spartanisch eingerichtet. Das Bett ist eine relativ dünne Matratze auf Paletten. Das klingt zwar cool, für mehrere Nächte dann aber doch zu unbequem. Generell bräuchte das Zimmer einen größeren Schreibtisch zur Ablage.
Die Wohnung an sich war tagsüber relativ kalt.
Ansonsten hat das Haus und die Wohnung aber einen gewissen Charme. Für einen kürzeren Aufenthalt also ok, für einen längeren Aufenthalt ist es dann aber doch nicht komfortabel genug.
El Matalassos són molt dolents, no estan a l'altura del que es paga
ist ganz nett und bequem :)

Regina is an awesome host. The place felt like home and you have your own bathroom. The location is great with decent public transport nearby. Overall, I'd highly recommend this place if you're visiting Berlin.
Een eenvoudige, rustige kamer binnen het klooster. Mogelijkheid tot meditatie maar niets hoeft. Veilige sfeer. Prettige omgang met de mensen die er werken/wonen. Ik zal er zeker nog eens terugkomen

The only downside to this apartment is the 7 flights of stairs you have to climb up to get there, if you have lots of luggage or mobility issues it may be a challenge. Other than that, the apartment is spacious, the beds are very comfortable, the kitchen is stocked with the essentials and the rooms are bright with big windows. Right out the front door there are tons of beautiful shops, cafes and restaurants to choose from, and they are very good. The host was flexible as our expected check in time kept changing due to flight delays and was excellent and communicating with us before and during our stay. Steps to transit that connects you to the rest of the city easily.

Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit in Berlin und haben uns in der Wohnung wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist sehr zentral und vom Dach hat man eine schöne Aussicht auf die Spree und Berlin. Vielen Dank an Eileen und vielleicht gibt es noch ein weiteres Mal...
The apartments are a little bit not we expected because the Airbnb photos make different impression. However, the hotel is a great in terms of price/quality ratio. So it's for sure 5 stars.
Nice cottage Not a convenient location if you are elderly
We really enjoyed our stay, fell in Love with Berlin and Kitty’s place was the perfect Airbnb and she was such a lovely host!

I can't commend Bert enough - he was always responsive and went out of his way to ensure I could get my disabled son the most comfortable stay. He went out and bought a toilet fixture so that he could access the toilet with support handles. This saved the trip for me as my son can't sit unaided on the toilet.
The beds were very comfy ( better than mine at home !!) and I'm fussy.
Having a tv with Netflix was helpful for morning when I needed some time to get ready or evenings when we were shattered after a long day walking 20,000 steps pushing a wheelchair around Berlin.
I've come home broken and exhausted but my son loved his 21st bday present and Bert's support made it more than bearable . What a great guy. Thank you

Gabrieles Haus liegt in einer schönen und ruhigen Wohngegend, bis zur U-Bahn sind es nur ein paar Gehminuten. Mit der Linie 6 kommt man, ohne umzusteigen, z.B. zur Haltestelle Unter den Linden oder zur Friedrichstraße. Das Zimmer ist schön und gepflegt, auf der bequemen Matratze habe ich sehr gut schlafen können. In einem kleineren Nebenzimmer steht ein Fernseher, den man nutzen darf. Wie manche geschrieben haben, befindet sich das geräumige Bad zwei Etagen tiefer, was für mich aber kein Problem darstellte. Für mein Frühstück und Abendbrot durfte ich die Küche nutzen, für Gäste gibt es einen eigenen Kühlschrank und in der Vorratskammer wurde mir ein Stück des Regales freigeräumt, damit ich meine Lebensmittel dort lagern konnte. Was meinen Aufenthalt jedoch so besonders gemacht hat, war die außerordentliche Gastfreundschaft der Gastgeber - ich habe mich sehr willkommen gefühlt! Gabriele und ihr Mann sind sehr offen und hilfsbereit, dabei keineswegs aufdringlich, und wir haben uns sehr gut unterhalten. Herzlichen  Dank an die Gastgeber.

The accommodation is in a very good location, the room was tiny but very comfortable and clean. Any questions we had were quickly answered by the host. I would especially recommend it for those who prefer to stay in a central location.

The apartment is well situated with excellent cafes and restaurants spaced along tree lined streets, with a canal a block away, which makes for a pleasant Sunday stroll. It strikes the perfect balance of being in the heart of the city while still exuding a quiet relaxed neighborhood feel. The apartment itself was most comfortable and well appointed. The host helpful and quick to respond. Highly recommend.

Netter Aufenthalt bei Dor, angenehmes Viertel, gute Lage, ruhiges Zimmer zum Hinterhof raus.
Was in der Tat fehlt, ist ein kleiner Tisch und Stühle zum Essen. Wenn man nicht jedesmal auswärts essen will.

Thomas was great host.
He was very active before my arrival (messages, instructions how to get to his place) and even after that. He told me where i can find shops, restaurants, intresting things around his place. We have seenonly once (on my arrival) but it was enough - i knew everything that i needed.
Place is really nice. Big room, big bed, lovely terrace. Around apartment you have a lot of shops, bakeries, restaurants, park. Ten minutes walk and you have public transport and you can go to many places.
Really recomment this host and place.

We absolutely loved our stay. The location is perfectly situated to be able to easily travel around Berlin and is in walking distance to many highlights and great restaurants. The apartment is beautifully furnished, spotlessly clean, and has everything you need for a Bert comfortable stay.  And Wera is a great host! We hope to return.

Sehr zentral gelegen, saubere Unterkunft. Alles da, was man für einen längeren Aufenthalt braucht. Die Wohnung ist im Erdgeschoss- ein ehemaliges Gewerbe. Daher laut, wenn Leute an der Straße vorbei gehen.
Schwierig war Belüftung, weil es nur ein kleinen Spalt über der Haustür gibt.
Die Mülltonnen sind in der Nähe des Eingangs. Das ist in Berlin als Großstadt schon mal schwierig.
Vermieter hat sich erfolgreich um eine Entsorgung von Müll gekümmert.

Wunderschöne, helle und liebevoll eingerichtete Dachgeschosswohnung, in der wirklich alles vorhanden war, was man benötigt. Sehr ruhige Gegend in Zehlendorf, direkt am Wald, man hört die Vögel singen und schaut von den Fenstern aus direkt in die Bäume, wirklich traumhaft. Der nächste U-Bahnhof ist in wenigen Minuten Fußweg gut zu erreichen, aber auch mit dem Auto findet man problemlos vor dem Haus jederzeit einen Parkplatz, was in Berlin ja wirklich schon die absolute Ausnahme ist. Gundula und Jürgen sind sehr warmherzige und hilfsbereite Gastgeber, die bei Fragen jederzeit zur Verfügung standen.

The apartment is wonderful, very spacious and open. Being able to relax out front was also a wonderful option after a long day of walking around the city. We found everything the way it had been described and communication was always quick and easy. We were able to check in around 13:00 which was wonderful as we were all tired after a long trip.
The neighborhood was quiet and there was a supermarket and pharmacy close by. All in all a very good experience
Komplikationsloser und entspannter Umgang. Alles hat wunderbar geklappt und ich kann die Unterkunft von Jürgen nur empfehlen.
A great property with tons of room.  Close to a train station (so don't forget your ear plugs - haha).  Very clean and tremendous service.  Everything was first class!!

This is probably the nicest Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at and Katharina was really welcoming and hospitable! The U-Bahn station and tram are not so far away and the Airbnb is tucked in a neighborhood filled with many restaurants. I would definitely stay again here in the future!
sehr gut, würde wieder hier übernachten.
We had a lovely stay and would definitely come back some other time
Bright quite room in the heart of Friedrichshein ..

Nice and spacy apartment
We had no problems getting access to the place early or staying late on the day of departure.
Nice neighborhood with small shops restaurants etc.

Josty Brauerei's apartment 3 was great! It was very clean and cozy. We especially loved the equipment provided and the furniture. The location was AMAZING! It was really central in Mitte, accessible to all cool places in Berlin, and was close to all types of food and cafes. Metro and trams are all around. Klaus was communicative and helped us sort out some baggage delivery problems. Seriously love this place and recommend it to all.
A cozy and roomy apartment, good location, friendly neighbourhood. Sebastian was very welcoming, proactive and responsive.
It’s a modern and comfy apartment, and the location couldn’t been better, the perfect place to stay
Awesome social scene
Such a great stay, close to the Spree and near lots o& public transports: bus, and metro. Place is as pictured! Thanks Virginia!
It was a good location and host was nice too! Close to the center. Nice neigborhood with restaurants and super market. Thank you so much!✨
We had a very nice stay here! Lots of vintage shops and vegan restaurants  in the neighboorhood!
We hebben een heerlijke tijd gehad in Berlijn. Alles wat je nodig kunt hebben, is aanwezig in het appartement. Fijne communicatie en supersimpele check-out.
mi sono trovata molto bene

Excelente anfitrión, el departamento es muy lindo y todo está muy ordenado. Giancarlo habla varios idiomas, entre ellos Español, por lo que nuestra comunicación fue muy fluida. Sugiero planificar bien tus actividades dentro de la ciudad ya que, el departamento aunque tiene fácil acceso, está un poco retirado del centro y las atracciones principales de Berlín.
Cool place. Great area.
Gelfo一家的房子非常宽敞，2个卧室加一个客厅，可以三个私人空间，很适合出差和朋友一起出行，白天阳光充足，晚上安静宜人。位置靠近地铁，出行很方便，楼下有多个便利店，早餐店，甚至还有一家亚洲超市。 沟通方便很快捷方便且友好！非常推荐！
Nice appartement
alles perfekt! wie in der Beschreibung
Ein Stern Abzug weil sehr hellhörig. Aber im Grunde rundum gut 😊
Birgit is a lovely lady with a charming top floor apartment in trendy Kreuzberg. Would warmly recommend a stay there for business or tourism.
terrific stay and in a beautiful area full of nature

The room is very nice and comfortable. You can see the river Spree throw the window.  Christian is also very friendly. I enjoyed my time there with all facilities like Internet connection, kitchen using etc...
alles super. gute Verbindung in die Innenstadt und ruhige Lage

The apartment was clean and very nice. There’s a tram station very close by and it only takes about 20 minutes to get to the center of the city. There are also multiple grocery stores in walking distance.

Comfortable stay in a nice part of town. The cafe offers a nice assortment of breakfast options and a good price with very friendly staff. There are also a number of cafes around the location so you can mix it up. Overall the common areas, reception, and the room were all very clean and comfortable. Checking in and out is made extremely easy and the support chat is readily available any time and they answer quick.

We had a nice stay at Erna's apartment in Pankow. The apartment was really clean and modern. We particularly liked patio for dining al fresco! We really like the area; it's right across from the Buergerpark, close to great cafes (Stueck vom Glueck is our favorite) and convenient to the S1 and S2 lines to explore the rest of the city. Our kids would add that there are a number of great playgrounds in the neighborhood, too!
For those not familiar with Berlin, Pankow is on the flight path to Tegel airport, so there are planes overhead during the day. The windows on the apartment are very good; it wasn't a problem for us. We really like Pankow because it's just outside the tourist circuit (though close enough when you want to get to Mitte), so you feel a bit more a part of the real Berlin.
Elisa is a great host, the apartment is in a very nice area with lots of restaurants and grocery shops.
Alles bestens! Schöne Wohnung! Übergabe hat super geklappt. Sehr netter Kontakt. Jederzeit wieder! Sehr zu empfehlen!
Unkomplizierte schlüsselübergabe, Wohnung war sauber und ausreichend Platz, super u- Bahn- Anbindung. Alles super!

Katrins Wohnung war wunderschön, alles sah aus wie auf den Bildern, war sauber und gemütlich. Die Lage ist optimal, 5min von der Bahnstation, in der Nähe von Restaurants, Einkaufsläden und hat eine sehr empfehlenswerte Eisdiele direkt gegenüber.
Wir waren 4 Tage dort und haben uns direkt super wohl gefühlt.
Wir wurden von einer sehr gut riechenden, wunderschön eingerichteten und aufgeräumten Wohnung empfangen.
Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt und sollten wir wieder nach Berlin kommen, dann auf jeden Fall in Katrins Wohnung!!
Super! Weiter zu empfehlen

Habe Hans leider nur kurz kennengelernt, ist sehr sympathisch und freundlich. Die Wohnung entsprach genau der Beschreibung. Ich hatte mich darauf eingestellt, dass es nicht super sauber ist und so habe ich zu Beginn und zum Schluss nochmals das Badezimmer geputzt. Aber die Wohnung ist super günstig, die Lage ist prima und ich würde beim nächsten Mal auch wieder bei Hans buchen, falls möglich.
Very spacious, quitte and tidy appartment. Great stay!

Superbe séjour à Berlin ! L'emplacement de l'hôtel est vraiment proche des lieux à voir, et à 30m du tram. Personnel très serviable et sympathique.
L'hôtel est dans une petite cour au calme, donc une zone paisible la nuit.
Merci pour l'accueil !

Gute Lage, sowie alles (Supermärkte, Bars etc.)  in der Nähe. Check in ging sehr schnell und Check out genau so. Das Apartment hat fast alles was man braucht. Einziger Nachteil, die fehlende Klimaanlage. Zug direkt vor der Türe, mit denen man in 12 min am Alexanderplatz ist. Im ganzen ein schöner Aufenthalt.

Die Unterkunft war noch viel schöner als erwartet, sowohl von der Gegend als auch von dem Fotos her. Die Gastgeber Angela und Matthias waren immer freundlich zugewandt und haben das Beste getan, damit ich mich wohlfühlte. Das Zimmer ist wunderschön: Groß, ruhig, in einer außergewöhnlichen Gegend von Berlin, perfekt für den Sommer - mit Altstadt, Kanal zum Baden, vegetar. Kiez-Café uvm. und guter ÖPNV-Anbindung. Nix wie hin, wa!
Es war wunderschön
Really bad communications, as well as no internet connection provided by accommodation, while communicated and promised.

Nous avons passé un séjour superbe, logement très bien placé dans Berlin. Un bon rapport qualité prix, avec des instructions faciles et un logement qui correspond parfaitement aux attentes.
Je recommande

Already our second time in this great apartment :) all perfect! Thank you Maik
😊
Everything was good
Great place to stay in Berlin :) Quite good comunicated with city centre and the airport, and ms. Iljana is super friendly and welcome person. Thank You! :)
Sehr schickes Zimmer, flexibler Check-in - definitiv zu empfehlen!
The studio is small, but well organized. We had everything necessary for our stay. Kristina was very attentive to details that made our stay different than usual. Thank you for everything, Kristina.

Very clean and organised environment, especially for a hostel. The 4 person rooms had space beside the bed, so there was space for everything. Staff were nice and they had luggage storage. Well priced - highly recommend.

We enjoyed our stay with Henrik and would definitely recommend it! Great location & neighborhood. Quiet surroundings but close to bars restaurants and transit. The apartment was quaint and well equipped. A pleasant experience.
Host gentile e professionale.

Super schöne Unterkunft in absolut ruhiger Lage. Perfekt um nach langen, anstrengenden Tagen in der berliner Innenstadt zu entspannen.
Sehr einfacher und flexibler Check-in. Ausstattung top, uns hat es an nichts gemangelt.
Definitiv weiter zu empfehlen!

The apartment is in a great location for getting around the city. We thoroughly enjoyed the stay as the apartment was clean and very modern. The hosts were also very helpful with any questions we had to ask and were more than happy to help with suggestions for things to do in the city. Great time in Berlin.
Gute und zuverlässige Gastgeber mit schneller Hilfsbereitschaft
Der Aufenthalt bei Ambra war super. Ich habe mich von Anfang wohl und willkommen gefühlt. Die Lage ist für einen Kurztrip in Berlin einfach perfekt und ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen.

Logement parfait pour un week end à Berlin entre amis. 7 vrais couchages confortables et emplacement parfait avec pas mal de chose à disposition à pied de l'appartement.
Bon rapport qualité prix par rapport à d'autres logements dans le même quartier !
Very spacious and private room,  easy access to public transportation. Great place!
Apartment in ruhiger Lage Nähe Mauerpark. Wohnung war sehr sauber und alles wichtige war vorhanden. Abwicklung und Check -in völlig problemlos und einfach. Sehr zu empfehlen.

Marcus is an outstanding host; he is extremely nice and responsive. He often checked to make sure we were happy and all was well. His homes is so inviting and it brought us much peace and calm after a long day of travel. You can literally walk out and enjoy shopping and eating a variety of yummy food, coffee etc., as well as eclectic shops like a comic shop nearby. My kids also loved it.

This apartment is beautiful, full of character, with everything you need in the kitchen, and very quick to get to and from Berlin centre. The area itself has lots of interesting restaurants nearby with different cuisines, and feels very safe. Great place to stay when visiting Berlin, thank you for sharing it with us.
Perfect place to see Berlin not far from the train near some amazing places to eat and bars had a great time here very community feeling

Me la pasé muy bien durante los 3 meses que estuve ahí. No tuve ningún problema durante mi estancia.
Christina siempre estuvo al pendiente durante mi estancia, con mucha amabilidad.
El departamento está muy bien ubicado y es muy fácil el acceso, es una zona muy tranquila.
100% recomendado

This apartment was just great. Very good location and in the best part of Mitte for restaurants and cafes. Moritz was overseas while we stayed but he made extra efforts to stay in touch and make sure we had everything we needed to enjoy our stay in Berlin. Would definitely look to stay here again.
Tout s’est bien passé
Thank you 🙏🏼
Es war mega, danke für den schönen Aufenthalt.
Wir hatten einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt bei Kiki! Die Wohnung, das Zimmer und die ganze Atmosphäre waren super gemütlich! Wunschlos glücklich :)
Nette kleine Wohnung, ausreichend zum übernachten aber nichts zum verweilen gedacht. Im großen und ganzen war es eine angenehme Zeit dort.
War alles perfekt, sauber und alles vorhanden. Wir haben nur ein paar Tage hier verbracht und waren sehr zufrieden.

Super zufrieden!
Haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Vielen Dank für alles
Great location. We loved the flat and the beds.

Nice and cozy apartment for 2 persons on amazing location. Gili was amazing host! From the apartment everything is very close, various restaurants (try Hamy or Masaniello) to the music shops as Hardwax or Space Hall (only 15 minutes by walk). We enjoyed a lot ! Also U7&U8 are on 5 minutes walk! So you are connected with everything!
Apartment was clean and kitchen have everything you need for a few days stay.
Little tip: if you wanna watch TV bring something on USB with you cos all programs are on German language and bring your own slippers (if you have cold feet like me :P ). Thats all. We enjoyed soo much in this apartment and we will come back for sure!
Great location and great host

Die Wohnung entsprach voll und ganz der Beschreibung und liefert einen tollen Berliner Altbau-Flair. Es ist alles da was man braucht und die Lage ist einfach super! Der Kiez drumherum hat wirklich eine Menge zu bieten, von der tollen Eisdiele bis zur vielfältigen Auswahl an Restaurants und Bars.
Die Nähe zur Ringbahn macht die Erkundung Berlins zum Kinderspiel.
Darüber hinaus ist Pia eine tolle Gastgeberin.
Die Kommunikation mit ihr funktionierte prima und machte die Nutzung der Wohnung zu einer sehr positiven Erfahrung.

Wir fanden die Unterkunft für einen Urlaub mit Hund optimal. Das Anwesen ist ruhig gelegen und ein guter Ausgangspunkt für Spaziergänge. Die schnelle Anbindung nach Potsdam und Berlin hat uns aber auch gut gefallen. Das Haus ist sehr gemütlich und charmant eingerichtet.
Super lækkert

Een prima prive kamer bij Günter thuis. Een vriendelijk ontvangst en flexibele incheck (wij hadden 4 uur vertraging door de trein).
Je deelt de wc en de badkamer die op de gang zitten. Maar wij hebben in 5 dagen nog geen een keer gehad dat deze in gebruik was. Het voelde dus eigenlijk als een prive badkamer/douche. De badkamer is niet luxe maar gewoon normaal.
Günter geeft veel privacy wat wij konden waarderen.
De locatie is op een stukje lopen van Tempelhof en om de hoek bij heel veel leuke horeca!
Prijs kwaliteit is dit een top verblijf!
Sandra was very friendly and helpful, a great stay overall :)
Tolle Unterkunft im Hinterhaus! Super ruhig, schön eingerichtet absolute Toplage! Sehr zu empfehlen

Schöne helle Wohnung in ruhiger Strasse, Fahrstuhl im Haus. Viele Cafe's, Restaurants, auchTram-Haltestelle in unmittelbarer Nähe. Super Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber! Wir würden dort wieder wohnen wollen!
Very pleasant stay. It was 34 degrees outside, but in Alex’s place it was only 23. Alex gave very clear instructions with a lot of humor.
Logement spacieux, propre, joliment décoré. L’emplacement est idéal pour visiter et profiter de Berlin. Le logement est très bien desservi et facile d’accès en tram/metro.

For the price, this was a decent stay. I’m normally very sensitive to noise, so I was surprised how quiet this ground floor, street-facing unit was. I did sleep with earplugs just in case. Unfortunately, the heating wasn’t working; I notified the host right away, and it started working on the last day of my stay.
I really enjoyed staying at Mina’s place. It was clean and spacious and I loved the quiet courtyard! !

Nette Gastgeber, Tram Haltestelle vor der Tür, Bahnhof Gesundbrunnen in knapp zehn Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar mit Einkaufszentrum und Anbindung ans Berliner U-Bahn-Netz.
Wir hatten mit vier Personen mehr als genug Platz in der Wohnung. Der einzige kleine Schönheitsfehler sind die "dünnen Wände", so dass die Straße und die Nachbarwohnungen zu hören sind.
Aber Preis-Leistungsverhältnis für Berlin absolut in Ordnung.
Great location for a stay in Berlin; centrally located location, and a very helpful host which was responsive and flexible from beginning until end.
War sehr gemütlich. Hab mich wohlgefühlt :)
Nice hostel with quiet surrounding

hormis la situation bruyante et des vitres sans insonorisation, le logement est attractif pour le prix.
prévoir des bouchons d'oreilles !!

Leider ist die Unterkunft sehr hellhörig und die Nachtruhezeiten werden nicht eingehalten, im Gegenteil: die anderen Jugendlichen Bewohner waren rücksichtslos laut und wurden nicht durch das Management ermahnt

Die Wohnung bei Dirk hat uns super gefallen. Es war sehr sauber und die Wohnung hat einen schicken Stil.
Sie hat wirklich eine echt gute Lage zur Innenstadt, so dass wir eigentlich fast alles zu Fuß gelaufen sind. Ein super Bonus war auch der kostenlose Parkplatz auf dem Hof, da in der Gegend fast alle Parkplätze für Bewohner oder kostenpflichtig sind!
Beim Check in hat alles reibungslos funktioniert und Dirk hat uns noch super Tipps für unseren Aufenthalt in Berlin gegeben. Man hat gemerkt, dass Dirk sich viel Mühe gegeben hat, was nicht nur an einem Blumenstrauß und einer Aufmerksamkeit klar wurde.
Das einzige kleine Manko welches die Wohnung aufwies, lag darin, dass die Küchenaustattung etwas mager ausfiel. (Was aber schnell und leicht zu änder ist)
Alles in allem aber eine super Wohnung und in Berin werden wir diese auf jeden Fall wieder nehmen!

The apartment is very nice, comfortable and clean and Simon is a great host.
I do think it should be mentioned in the listing that although the building has an elevator, this specific apartment is located in the back courtyard and it has 1 floor of stairs and no elevator access. Also, for light sleepers I would also mention there is some noise sometimes from people using the bins in the courtyard, the sprinklers watering plants, and what seems to be a church bell which rang at 8:00 and 18:00 every day.
The apartment is as listed and better - great neighborhood, friendly and responsive host. Highly recommended.
A wonderful location and place to stay in Berlin!!
Todo muy bien

Das Apartment von Martin eignet sich super für einen Kurztrip nach Berlin! Betten und Sofa sind sehr bequem, Küche und Badezimmer sehr modern und gut ausgestattet. Die Wohnung ist zwar etwas hellhörig, Nachts war es bei uns aber ruhig und wir konnten gut schlafen. Die nächste Ubahn-Station ist gleich um die Ecke, ein bisschen weiter gibt es auch einen Rewe und einige Restaurants. Insgesamt eine schöne Unterkunft!

Great location in Friedrichshain that is very easily accessible by lots of different lines (S-Bahn, U-Bahn, tram). The room itself is very quiet as it looks over the inner courtyard. The room is perfect for a short trip to Berlin. Dor is very accommodating and helpful. Would definitely stay here again!

Appartement parfait pour 6 personnes, très bien équipé et décoré avec goût, une salle de bain et une salle d'eau. La literie est de qualité, la situation de l'appartement est parfaite. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour !

We had a great stay at Apostolos apartment. It is a very quiet place and very close to public transportation and all you need is just round the corner.
Apostolos is a very friendly host. He will do all he can to help you and communicating with him is very easy.
We simply must recommend his apartment. You wont regret.
Peter Langdal

Wir hatten einen kurzen aber schönen Aufenthalt und haben uns rundherum wohl gefühlt. Die Lage ist super um lecker Essen und Trinken zu gehen und durch die Lage im Hinterhaus auch sehr ruhig. Der Self check-in und check-out ist auch sehr einfach.
Wir würden immer wieder kommen !

Ein wunderschönes Airbnb, das "craft meets art" perfekt verkörpert. Jedes Zimmer ist ausgestattet mit sorgfältig ausgewählten Möbeln und Kunstwerken. Viele kleine Details machen den Aufenthalt besonders. Der Gastgeber ist sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend und sorgt dafür, dass man sich wie zu Hause fühlt. Die Lage ist sehr angenehm, mit der fußläufig erreichbaren S-Bahn kommt man wunderbar überall hin. Insgesamt eine äußerst inspirierende Unterkunft, die wir jedem wärmstens empfehlen können.

This is definitely an apartment you’d like to stay in while visiting Berlin. It’s close to the metro (‘ bout 200 meters ) which takes you anywhere and if you’re coming by car there’s free parking around the corner. The apartment is super nice and cozy and has everything you need to feel at home. We’ll definitely go back to this apartment next time visiting Berlin and can recommend this to everybody!
Все было супер. У Martin отличная квартира.
Hilda was very helpful and responsive, would recommend to everyone who wants  to enjoy a peaceful and relaxing days.

Notre séjour à Berlin, s'est très bien passé. Bee et son mari sont très gentils et très accueillants, toujours disponibles et à l'écoute. Le logement est très bien situé, pas loin de la U-Bahn et des lignes de bus. Très bon séjour à Berlin, nous reviendrons !

Un appartement extrêmement bien placé avec un rooftop très agréable. Toutes les commodités sont situées au pied de l'appartement. Idéal pour une famille.  S'il y avait un seul bémol à trouver pour ce bel emplacement en coeur de ville : les tramways qui nous emmènent si facilement dans Berlin résonnent aussi tardivement le soir dans la chambre donnant sur la rue... Une paire de boules quies et le tour est joué !

Hat alles gut geklappt. Sehr schnelle Antworten, saubere Wohnung und ruhige Gegend. Mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln ist man in einer halben Stunde am Potsdamer Platz, die Bushaltestelle ist gleich über die Strasse. Die Wohnung verfügt über alles was man braucht.

Extremely well placed. Close to easy transport on the U. Comfortable flat with great aesthetic. Hosts have fantastic communication—and thoughtful touches—oil, spices, shampoo selection—made the stay easy.

Incredible experience. Amazing, friendly and cool atmosphere. Perfect location with many accessible food options, thrift shops and a beautiful canal nearby. My friends and I felt immediately at home! Everything went super smoothly. Highly highly recommend!

Clean, comfortabel, stylish and quiet appartement at very nice location. US bahn just across the street. Schloss park Charlottenburg on the other side of the bridge. Bike rental at the econhotel nearby. Appt is highly recommanded.
Tolle, gut gelegene und sehr saubere Wohnung. Alles ist da, was man gebrauchen kann und der Host ist immer zu erreichen. Zu empfehlen!
Lekker dicht bij de U-bahn, ook veel bezienswaardigheden op loopafstand. Geen sjieke wijk, maar gelukkig geen (over)last.
Perfect and tastefully decorated apartment. Also the location was perfect. Strong recommendation!
Great place to get the most you can from central Berlin. Douglas was very responsive and helpful!

clean, comfortable, as described
Great place next to multiple restaurants and walking distance to museums.
Besten Dank an Ian für die tolle und flexible Aufnahme und Kommunikation.  Das ist nicht selbstverständlich und gerne wieder
Beautiful, modern and clean. And cheap for what we got. Everything worked fine. 👍🏼👍🏼

Super tolle Lage am Bergmannkiez und in einem Hinterhof, so dass es trotz der zentralen Lage sehr ruhig ist. Das ist für uns das große Plus dieser Unterkunft. Das Zimmer an sich war eigentlich auch sehr schön. Allerding sind die Betten sehr unbequem und das Zimmer ist durch das alte Gemäuer immer etwas klamm und es war sehr kalt - durch das Klamme mussten wir viel mehr als sonst lüften, und die Heizkörper wurden maximal lauwarm.
Am meisten hat uns dann geärgert, dass unsere Nachfragen nach extra Kissen und Handtüchern konsequent ignoriert wurden - aus unserer Sicht ein NoGo für solche Standardsachen und der Preisklasse. Insgesamt war der Aufenthalt dadurch für uns sehr ungemütlich und nicht zufriedenstellend.

Sehr stillvoll und gut ausgestattetes Apartment mit sehr zentraler Lage.
Ist perfekt für eine Kurztrip oder auch für einen längeren Aufenthalt geeignet.
Küche ist mit allem was man zum Kochen braucht ausgestattet, das Bad ist sauber, relativ groß (verglichen zu manch anderen Bädern in Hotels) und auch sonst biedet der Wohn-/Schalfbereich noch ausreichend Platz für Koffer und Co. Das Bett ist zudem bequem, nur könnte es sein, dass es etwas quietscht.
좋은 룸메이트들과 방을 함께 써서 불편한 점은 없었어요.  방 조명이 약간 어둡긴 했지만 전혀 문제되지 않았습니다. 내부 출입문과 가장 가까운 방을 받아서 좋았습니다. 욕실은 매번 깨끗하게 사용할 수 있었고 따뜻하게 지낼 수 있었어요. 6인실이라서 불편한 점이 있을 거라 생각했지만 문제는 전혀 없었습니다!
Super clean. There was playing cards and game boards. Everything we needed was there. The host was super helpful especially with the recommendations.
The apartment with modern, very clean and spacious. the reception guy was really helpful. I really enjoyed my stay there.
Es hat gepasst.
Valeska is a friendly and welcoming host. Her flat is comfortable and quiet, with a range of shops and restaurants nearby. I enjoyed my stay!
hostel dobrze skomunikowany ,czysty,bez zastrzeżeń

Ich habe für meine Eltern diese Buchung durchgeführt, somit hinterlasse ich ihren Kommentar:
"Wir waren eine Woche in Vincents Wohnung und
haben uns dort sehr wohl gefühlt. Wir können sie uneingeschränkt
empfehlen, unter der einzigen Bedingung, dass die Gäste so gut zu Fuss

eingerichtet und enthält absolut alles, was man braucht. Wir haben auch

Küche ist bis ins Kleinste (Geschirr, Küchenutensilien usw.) sehr gut
ausgestattet. Der Essplatz in der Küche ist besonders gemütlich.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist sehr günstig! Die nächste U-Bahn-Haltestelle

Das Loft ist wunderschön, die Lage großartig, blitzsauber und die Gastgeber sehr freundlich! Wir haben uns sehr Wohlgefühl, vielen lieben Dank!

Fue un muy lugar para pasar algunos días en Berlin, se encuentra cerca de muchos restaurantes y opciones para comer, caminar y beber, muy buena ubicación.
Laura estuvo bien como anfitriona y todo el tiempo fue una estancia tranquila :)

Die Unterkunft entspricht genau der Beschreibung und den Bildern. Durch die Erdgeschosslage kommt teilweise wenig Licht in die Räume, aber schließlich ist man in Berlin ja nicht, um drinnen zu bleiben. Der Kontakt zu Anna war wirklich mehr als perfekt. Siegward immer ansprechbar und hat schnell reagiert.
Für eine Übernachtunsmöglichkeit super

The entire team was extremely attentive from the moment we entered the apartment throughout our stay. They constantly checked in to see if we needed anything and did everything they could to ensure our comfort and an enjoyable vacation. They were incredibly polite. The apartment was stunning—very spacious, beautifully decorated, and extremely comfortable. It was in a highly central location, exactly where we wanted to be. I would love to stay here again on my next trip to Berlin.

This is quite possibly the best Airbnb I have ever stayed - and I travel often! The studio is much nicer than in the photos, everything is very functional and the sofa bed was surprisingly comfortable. Stefan and Betty were very prompt, accommodating and kind in all their communication. The outlook from the building is very green and it’s a quiet street even though it’s very near to a bustling neighbourhood.  The location is very convenient and you can get around by walking, u-Bahn (Südstern station 2 mins away) or bike. I would book this place again in a second- I highly recommend.

Наше перебування було чудовим. Спокійний район, зручне транспортне розміщення, квартира зручна, підходить для короткого комфортного перебування. Власник дуже уважний та завжди відповідав швидко. Дуже рекомендую цю квартиру!

L'appartamento di Sana si trova in una zona molto tranquilla e piena di verde. Molto vicino ci sono due fermate del tram e la metropolitana. A pochi passi troviamo anche uno dei parchi più grandi di Berlino. La camera è molto luminosa e spaziosa. Sana è una ottima host, vi sentirete come a casa.

Good located apartment (with metro) Okay apartment with lots of room. The condition is a bit ‘tired/used’ when you compare to the pictures. Some small things like shower and one of the beds needs to be fixed in this apartment before we would go back.

Our stay was fantastic! Communicating with the staff was super easy through WhatsApp, they were super responsive and attentive.
The place is modern and fresh, in the heart of quite an edgy part of Berlin.
Would 100% stay again!

Ein schönes Appartement gelegen mitten in Berlin und trotzdem sehr ruhig.
Es beinhaltet alles was man braucht, selbst für einen längeren Aufenthalt .

Une excellente adresse, avec un hôte attentif et disponible pour que le séjour se déroule à merveille.
L’appartement situé au dernier étage du bâtiment a beaucoup de charme. Avec sa vue sur la tour de télévision, il est spacieux, bien équipé, chaleureux et très bien situé dans un quartier vivant, proche de nombreux restaurants, boutiques et transports.
Nous recommandons sans hésitation l’appartement de Claus.

Francesco's apartment is in a great location, close to everything. I am originally from Berlin, now living overseas, and wanted my own place for a couple of days while visiting my family. I booked Francesco's place at the very last minute less than 24 hours before and he was really great about communication, check in and check out times. The entire process was smooth and easy although we never met. The flat itself was nice, clean, and as expected. The only issue was the construction work. The listing does mention this as a disclaimer but it was not clear to me just how loud the work would be in the morning. It did not affect me much as I was out most of the day but I would avoid staying during the week because of the noise.
Great stay at great place. Matthias proved to be very helpful and informative. His flat is close to vibrant and central Mitte so lots of things to explore within walking distance.
Great location. Nice shops and restaurants nearby. Nice view, easy access. Touch pad key is very convenient. Wish there were more lockers - there were less than 10 available for the whole building.

Gerhard was a fantastic host. He welcomed me at the station so I didn’t have to find the flat. The flat is very quiet with lots of character in a trendy district with nice eateries nearby. The wine bar on the corner is particularly lovely...  fantastic rieslings! The bed was very comfortable and I had a lovely time. Thank you!
Apartment liegt sehr zentral. Personal sehr hilfsbereit. Alles super sauber. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

This place is a great little spot in a fun and I think underrated area! It’s very accessible to the rest of the city by public transit— there is a tram across the street and a train station just a few blocks away. The place was very clean and no fuss. My private room was plenty spacious, and aside from the walls being a little thin, I was very comfortable. The staff on site and via messenger were super responsive and helpful as well— would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants a more low key Berlin experience.
Great apartment and an awesome neighbourhood! :D
I had a lovely weekend staying here. It was so warm inside and was a great place to stay to walk around the city centre and jump on public transport to see everything we wanted to.

I had an amazing time in Berlin and Ivos’s flat is cozy and clean. The position is more than great, few steps away from Alexanderplatz. Ivos is super quick to answer to any message and the check in/check out could have not been easier! Thank you 🙏🏻

What a great place! This area has is very quiet but very close to the hustle and bustle of Friedrichshain. Also free parking which was great. The apartment was spotless and so were bathroom and kitchen. Great value, very nice hosts that also very much give you your own space (they are at work most of the time :) if we come back to Berlin we will stay here again.

Axel’s place is a perfect option for anyone visiting Berlin! The location is lovely, private, and very secure. Axel is a great guy, he gave us all kinds of recommendations and directions around the city. I would definitely stay again!
Très bon séjour dans le logement et superbe ville :)

Robert's place is beautiful and he is a great host. He's really put a lot of work and love to build his home. We felt lucky to find his property on airbnb, a real gem. His place is only a short 20min walk to Berlin central station with plenty of local options for food and drink. I highly recommend staying here.
Great place. Provides exactly what it promises.
Ist gut plaziert, Parkmöglichkeit vorhanden, sehr sauber. Für übernachtungen ideal: simply the best.

Wir haben eine sehr schöne Woche in der Villa Nordlicht verbracht. Im Haus hat man viel Platz und alles, was man braucht. Es liegt absolut ruhig, trotzdem ist man mit der S-Bahn schnell im Zentrum. Fantastic place!
Sarah’s place was great. The location was perfect. I really enjoyed my stay.
Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour dans cet appartement très pratique. 1000 mercis, Anna !
Nice area, Nastacia was a perfect host and everything were clean! I recommend this flat!

Very good place to stay ! Stefan is really welcoming and nice !
the neighborhood is beautiful and it's easy near to the train station ou tram.
thanks to Stefan, we loved our week in this flat !

This was the perfect spot to stay for a week in Berlin. It’s very close to both the S-Bahn and U-Bahn making the city that much more accessible. It also felt like a safe and quiet neighborhood at any time of day. The space itself was clean and had everything I needed to be comfortable for my stay. Would definitely recommend!
Very clean, good beds, more than enough towels, perfectly situated!
Great and clean room with more room than you expect. nice bathrooms.

Stefanie is a dedicated and passionate host. She was very friendly, clear with instructions and was truly a pleasure to interact with.
Wir hatten eine schöne Zeit in Berlin und fühlten uns sehr wohl in der Wohnung.

Die Unterkunft ist gut gelegen und reicht völlig aus für einige Tage in Berlin.  Es war nicht speziell sauber aber auch nicht schmutzig. The room was exactly like the photos, and the bathroom (it's shared) was spacious and really clean. The situation is that there are 4 rooms inside a house and the 3 of them are up for renting. Birgit was really welcoming and hospitable towards us, and also respected our privacy.
Really good location, excellent hosts- they gave us tips on where to go and how to get to places! Lovely stay

Lots of good things about Numa in Mitte, but also a lot of things lacking as well.
The good first:
Location! Fantastic location!
Easy check in! Excellent water pressure. Heated water! You can do laundry but also sharing that with like 30 other people. They allowed later check out.
The bad:
The rooms have been run through. The sink was clogged, the shower was leaking. The bathroom wasn’t very ergonomic for the water, so water gets everywhere and you’re only given two towels.
We couldn’t store our luggage because in a building of 30 they only had 4 lockers for bigger suitcase so it filled up. Super inconvenient.
The bed was two beds that were combined and it kept coming apart - which was frustrating and the pillows were lacking.
We were on the third floor! The elevators are slow. You can hear everything from everyone, if someone slams their down it reverberates throughout the room. Imagine this at 2 am! Oh yeah fire alarm went off at 2 am because the stoves need to have a window open, people lack common sense. Smells like something is burning a lot.
All in all, it was a decent place although made me wish I was in a hotel for the amenities and for the price it wasn’t cheap. We paid on par or more for this Airbnb and lacked in service. Not sure if I’d come back!

Alan is the nicest person! He took his time to share the information about Berlin places of interest and how to get there from the apartment. About the place - very nice, cozy and clean.
3 minutes from the Metro. A lot of shops and fresh fruit selling spots are around. Very quite. And you can find everything you need in the apartment - starting from iron to umbrella. Great for a weekend in Berlin!

Die Wohnung war super, sehr sauber und man fühlt sich wie zu Hause an.
Yaz war sehr hilfreich und immer erreichbar.
Er hat für uns ein Babybett und einen Babystuhl besorgt.

Centralt läge med närheten till restauranger och affärer.

Location is good. If you want to be in walking distance of Mitte's bars and eating places then this is great. The flat itself is well appointed but it lacks a lot. The space is wonderful. It's bright and modern and everything you'd expect of a Berlin airbnb but there is much the owners could do to make it better.
The furniture does the space no justice. It's cheap and not even that practical. We had two friends over for a drink and had to sit round the dining table because the two-seat sofa was the only option.
It could be so much better with just a little bit more comfort. A bigger sofa for example or an armchair would make it more cosy.
The wifi is terrible. We called twice the number left on the notes, but no response.

The cafe suggestions left in the flat were great and we made use of those for a couple of days.
Nice time there

Karsten and his family was so welcoming and friendly, they took the time to tell us what was close by and all their recommendations were great. Especially the little German place around the corner. The location was perfect, close to the Wall Memorial and the Metro. We enjoyed the quite neighbourhood to come home to. The actual apartment is exactly like the photos, a hip place with so much character, it's worth it just to see this place. It was spotless and had everything you would need. We had an amazing stay and will definitely recommend this to our own friends and family. Look no further, book now!!

The room was clean, spacious, well equipped, and beautifully decorated.  Location of the apartment was fantastic - close to cafes, restaurants and a 15 min walk to the Sbarn so great for using the train.

This is a beautiful little Air BnB and the hosts were incredibly hospitable and friendly. The tiny house is located in their backyard surrounded by their gorgeous garden. They made us a delicious breakfast spread every morning and gave us great recommendations  on what local attractions/areas to visit as well as informed us on which touristy places to avoid. I would describe this almost as an experience rather than just an accommodation. Would definitely recommend staying here and would certainly come back again!
Ottima posizione per visita della città.

Right from the start, Simone showed us a very warm welcome and gave us useful instructions for the house (heating, recycling, nearby facilities and attractions). There are plenty of amenities: a set of towels for each guest, toiletries, kitchen utensils and cutlery. We also appreciate the DVDs and books available, they are great for a night in. The house is clean, well-maintained and everything works. It's in a quiet residential neighbourhood with a bakery (good for morning coffee) but it's only two U-Bahn stops away from Alexanderplatz and there are tram and bus stops within 5 minutes'  walk,  so it's super convenient for exploring Berlin. There was no issue contacting and communicating with Simone through our stay. Would love to stay here again!
Amazing host. Amazing place. Recommend 10/10.

Die Unterkunft und der Standort wirken einladend. Die Anbindungen mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln sind perfekt, nur 5 Minuten Fußweg bis zum S-/U-Bahnhof Warschauer Straße. Henrik's flat is the perfect urban retreat. Cozy, clean and quiet. An ideal place to relax after a long day exploring the city. Highly recommended!

Lana herself responded quickly and helped us with all our requests and needs.
The apartment is 3-4 stops away from most of the permitting sites and the city center. There is a nice park close by, neighborhood restaurants and pubs and several supermarkets within walking distance.
Highly recommend. The kitchen is small, but it allows you to prepare food when you need it.

Great location, easy access, the room and bathroom were much smaller than i was expecting.   1 or 2 nights max is ok but would not consider for longer stays.  Host was very accommodating and great communication.

A short walk to the tram stops that connects you to the city.
Highly recommended if you're looking for a peaceful stay in Berlin!!
Marius is a perfect host and his flat makes you feel like home or...even better :)

This apartment is spacious and filled with light, and its decor is exactly what’s pictured in the listing. We liked the neighborhood a lot, especially the nearby restaurants and utter apparent lack of tourists. It felt really great.

Danke, haben uns wohlgefühlt. Wohnung mit separatem Zugang und angenehmer Umgebung. Auto haben wir stehengelassen und ÖVNV genutzt. Der Wald ist auch gleich vor der Haustür.

The apartment is located in a historic building in walking distance to the main Berlin sights with many cafes and restaurants around the corner. Elliott made me feel right at home, the room is spacious and the bed super comfy. Thank for having me, Elliott!

Jens had a wonderful AirBnb. It was spacious and clean and he even left lovely little chocolates for us as an extra touch! The location of the flat is very central as well. Highly recommend staying here.

Great apartment - absolutely huge! Has everything you need, quiet street, well connected, would definitely recommend. Thomas was incredibly responsive and easy to communicate with. Alles gut!

Sehr gut ausgestattete und geräumige Wohnung in zentraler Lage! Netter Kontakt mit dem Vermieter Sven. Unbedingt weiterzuempfehlen für einen tollen Aufenthalt in Berlin.

Upon arrival at Jens’ place, we were immediately met with rudeness and made to feel very unwelcome. As three young girls in a new city this really didn’t help us to feel at ease. Firstly, after accidentally ringing the doorbell twice the host aggressively shouted down the phone to only ring it once ‘not fifty times’.
Next, we’re up in the apartment, after being let in by Jens’ partner. We get a very brief tour of the apartment with little instruction on key information needed for our stay. After being shown to our room, both Jens and his partner begin to walk off, presuming everything is done. We had to stop them and ask ‘sorry do we have a set of keys for the room’ they realise that this has been overlooked and show us where the set of keys are; notably there were about 5 keys on the keyring. They begin to retreat again before one of us saying again ‘sorry, which key does what and which do we need to use to unlock the apartment, which do we need to access the main building, which for the room etc’ they show us after again realising their oversight. Hence, there was little instruction from both Jens and partner, and if one of us hadn’t realised their oversights, we may not have been able to get back into the apartment later in the evening. Leaving us unsafe.
the room: There were four of us in total booked to stay at Jens and his Partner’s place with one person joining us a night later. The room was absolutely not fit for four people. Our first night was with just three of us and we struggled to fit three people and three small cabin suitcases into the room. Cleanliness was also not great and the whole apartment was a little smelly.
The bathroom: the bathroom again was not particularly clean or easy to use. The shower being fixed jetting out from the wall meant that it couldn’t be used without projecting water all over the floor or by holding it then having to switch it off to apply shower gel/shampoo etc. There was one small wall light making the room dark as well as there being no mirror. This wasn’t for vanity reasons but could be needed for brushing teeth / flossing / shaving. There was also no mirror in the bedroom.
It was clear from the offset that Jens did not like us and made this very apparent. His partner was friendly and most communication was had with her. Upon even saying hello to Jens on arrival he didn’t respond to us and simply ignored our greeting.
Later on in the evening of our first night 2 of us walked upstairs to get a glass of water. Some of the other guests were sat upstairs chatting and making a lot of noise. Jens came upstairs and engaged in conversation with the other guests asking them how their day was, and being fairly friendly. He simply glanced at my friend and I and said ‘shoes’ then left the room. We made an honest mistake by leaving our shoes on in the kitchen of the apartment and thus, apologised and said it wouldn’t happen again.
The following morning we received an aggressive message suggesting we were not welcome in the apartment instructing us that a hostel would be better suited to our needs. We responded by apologising again for leaving our shoes on the one time and asked specifically what we had done wrong so that we could rectify our actions to make the stay more comfortable for all of us. These messages were ignored. We sent an additional couple of messages telling Jens that if he would like us to vacate the apartment we would oblige and asked if he would be around for us to make a further apology in person for whatever undisclosed reason for our departure. These messages were again ignored. Hence, we gathered our things and left the room in the same state it was given to us and moved to a hostel - sunset hostel. The place was clean and in lovely condition and the room was actually hospitable for four people.
We are still unsure as to what we did for Jens to treat us so rudely, perhaps because we are three young British girls. But if you’re looking for a nice, clean, calm place to stay We suggest looking at hostels. Our hostel was about 500 metres from Jens place and cost the same amount of money.
