And last, but certainly not least, Julius’ recommendations for breakfast & dinner locations were absolutely spot-on! All-in-all, a place we felt immediately at home and that for sure we would return to.
Alles wie versprochen. Nette Unterkunft, kann ich weiter empfehlen.

Top Lage. Ruhige Ecke und trotzdem mittendrin.
Drei Spätis in alle Richtungen ca. 2 Minuten entfernt mit fairen Preisen und allem ausgestattet, was man so braucht. Mehrere Supermärkte um die Ecke. Haltestelle Tram 10 ist in ca. 5 Minuten zu erreichen (bei gemütlicher Geschwindigkeit) und bis FrankfurterTor sind es 2 Stationen.
Der TV ist ein bissel "alt" und hat einen sehr leisen Ton, aber gut, man fährt ja nicht nach Berlin um fernzusehen, ggf. nen Fire TV Stick und eine kleine Box o. ä. mitnehmen. TV selbst hat kein Internet, aber HDMI/ USB funktioniert.
Der Kühlschrank hat sogar ein Gefrierfach, sehr praktisch im Sommer. Das Zimmer zur Hofseite hin war sogar bei 35 Grad angenehm kühl.
Morgens/ mittags fix fertig machen und zum kurzen Ausklingen des Tages wieder zurückkehren, dafür ist die Unterkunft ideal.
Wer viele Klamotten mitbringt, die aufgehängt werden, packt vielleicht ein paar Bügel ein, aber da ist ja jeder unterschiedlich "gelagert".

Great apartment close to some really nice restaurants. It is a bit far from city center, but close to public transit so it’s an easy journey into the city center.
As others have mentioned, the neighbor is really sensitive to noise (although downstairs bar is quite noisy). My brother was in the bedroom about to fall asleep and from the balcony next door he said the neighbor was shining a flashlight. Not sure if he had his phone on loud or what provoked it, but just be aware you have to be super quiet after 10pm.
Other than that everything is as described and pictured!!! The apartment is super spacious and the bathroom is nice and big. Would definitely stay here again!!
I really enjoyed the recommendations from Kirsten before we arrived, she sent a long list of very nice recommendations with information about each one. Super super thoughtful!!!!

Sem was a perfect host and being one of her first guests she really made an effort to be one of the better hosts I have experienced.
They even did little things like drinks and fruit in the fridge.
The unit was actually improved from when it was listed with new beds, updated furnisings and decor.
Everything is well kept and in great order with a real genuine German homely appartment feel to it.
I have been told there are even more upgrades coming and they will make the home perfect in the future.
As no one was booked the next day a very generous check out time was gifted at no extra charge, a greatly appreciated touch.
I would not hesitate to recomend, and will stay again on my return.

Sehr tolle Wohnung und Verda ist perfekte Gastgeberin. Super einfache, schnelle und freundliche Kommunikation, wir haben last minute noch was gesucht und konnten am Samstagnachmittag für Sonntag buchen. Haben u.a. auch etwas arbeiten müssen, was sehr gut gegangen ist (Wifi für Videocalls tauglich, Ruhige Lage, Take Aways und Restaurant gleich ums Eck), aber auch das grün ist in der Nähe zu finden. Schöne, helle Wohnung im ruhigen Prenzlauerberg - einzig: wer nicht gut zu Fuss ist, die Wohnung ist im 4. Stock ohne Lift, war für uns aber kein Problem. Würde ich sofort wieder hin!

A stylish place for a few nights in Berlin, indeed! It had all the amenities we needed (karma points for a good hairdryer!), a very decent Kauffland nearby, and an easy access to get to anywhere we wanted, which was especially important since we had an early morning flight back home from Schönefeld Airport. Also we got all the privacy we needed, so thanks for hosting us, Andre.
Alles super

Het appartement was luxe en ruim in een goede veilige buurt. Tegen het centrum van Berlijn.
Een meerwaarde was het naastgelegen Maleisisch restaurant Prince waar we heerlijk hebben gegeten.

Sehr nette Gastgeber, schnelle Kommunikation und sehr unkompliziert! Allerdings kann ich die Wohnung nur empfehlen wenn man mit sehr guten Freunden unterwegs ist da man durch fehlende Wände nur wenig Privatsphäre hat. Zudem kann man viel Türen nicht schließen und es ist dadurch sehr laut wenn nicht alle Gäste zur gleichen Zeit schlafen gehen wollen. Für unser Mädels Wochenende war es ok!
Super hyggelig og skøn lille lejlighed tæt ved Mauer Park.

The apartment was very clean and has everything you need. It's on a good location with good public transport so it's easy to travel from to other parts of the city.
5/5 would stay again
Nice place to stay.

The location is great if you are looking for nice restaurants and bars. The apartment was nice and clean and there were couple sheets of tips left on the kitchen table. Overall its really great place and value, eventhough the strict silence policy after 10pm. We didn’t mind that, ’cause the location, it’s easy to hang outside to party and come home to sleep.
Everything was very nice and just as listed!

A fab base for us to explore Berlin. Quiet and diverse neighbourhood with lots of great food options and well connected with multiple public transport routes and bikes/scooters nearby. The apartment was very clean and really well designed offering great privacy and a quiet outlook. Highly recommend!
Had a lovely stay with Berta. The place is very homely and comfortable. Berta was very friendly and had great local guides 🥰
nice and spacious place
Very nice apartment in a convenient location.  Comfortable and clean.  Maddalena's description is very accurate and she communicates well.
Host gentile e disponibile, annuncio preciso e conforme alle aspettative, quartiere residenziale, tranquillo, ben servito dai mezzi pubblici ma non molto centrale.
For me and my daughter was the perfect place!!! We really enjoy to stay with Christina!!! Highly recommend!! Vielen Dank Christina!!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Simon qui nous a communiqué toutes les informations nécessaires. L'appartement/maison est situé dans un quartier très mignon et à part les deux petites couettes séparées (très bizarre pour les français ou ceux qui aiment dormir serrés haha, mais c'est un détail) tout était parfait en terme d'équipement :) Merci aussi pour les petites attentions dans la cuisine! Nous recommendons chaudement et reviendrons avec plaisir!
Thank you for a great time Julie
Great space. Very accessible and central. Everything you need. Would defs stay again
Lovely and clean, 20 min walk from main station. Great communication from hosts

Voor de weinige momenten dat we ‘thuis’ waren; dikke prima! Je bent in no time bij het OV, Tip: neem een Berlin welcome card! Ook de nodige winkels (bakker, drogist, apotheek en supermarkt) zitten op een steenworp afstand!
De keuken is voorzien van goede apparatuur. Grote koelkast met diepvries.
Enorme smart-tv in de woonkamer waar je heel makkelijk naar kunt streamen. Handig met pubers😅! De douche is heel netjes en over de plaatsing van de spiegels bij de wastafel is goed nagedacht! Ook een wasje is zo gedraaid. De trap moet je echt met aandacht betreden, de optreden zijn te hoog zodat je grote stappen moet maken. In de nacht is dat opletten! Lamp om de trap goed te verlichten is wel aanwezig👍
Goede bedden, maar helaas geen gordijnen op grote slaapkamer en alleen losse gordijnen op de andere slaapkamer die je over een kledingrek kan hangen. Met raam open slapen geeft op sommige dagen geluidsoverlast dan kun je beter airco aandoen. Gelukkig zijn dit details op verder een prima accom

Marcello is very nice and helpful host! He patiently waited while we were delayed in arrival due to heavy traffic. The apartment is very nice and sunny with lots of windows and lots of space. You can easily park your car in front of the house. There are several shops and restaurants just in front of the house. But what is the best thing: you're really right in the heart of Berlin!!! :-) I could fully recommend you this place.
Marion and her husband were great hosts! They were warm and welcoming! The place was cozy and perfect for our family of four and it was easily accessible by train and bus.
Super! Gute Lage, schöne, gut ausgestattete Wohnung und sehr hilfsbereite Gastgeber. Alles ist genaustens beschrieben und unkompliziert. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt!

Wir hatten ein tolles Wochenende in Timos Appartement. Es ist chic eingerichtet und es gibt alles, was man braucht. Betten super bequem. Im Hinterhof gibt es einen Platz, an dem wir in der Sonne frühstücken konnten. Für enge Freunde (weil ja nur ein großer Raum) perfekt. Wir kommen sicher wieder.
Schönes Zimmer, zentral gelegen, easy Check-In

Belle hospitalité de Werner qui vous accueille chaleureusement avec flexibilité et vous donne tous les renseignements nécessaires pour passer un bon séjour !
L'appart est très fonctionnel, bien agencé, propre et proche des transports en commun pour visiter Berlin !
Vous pouvez venir chez Werner sans hésiter !!!!👍

Patrick and Kate's place was very clean and very well equipped. The apartment is close to the train station and has some great restaurants and bakeries around. Just a little pricey compared to other airbnbs we saw in Berlin but I'd definitely recommend their place if you want a nice place in Berlin.
We like our stay very much. Quiet and peaceful. Big rooms. Enough shops and places ta eat around. Wel equipped kitchen.
it was the best place in Berlin , we group of 6 had such decent accomodations the place was subtle equipped with all the necessary appliances needed just perfect

Spending 5 days in Wera's appartement was nice but enough. It's was hard to move freely and relax because on every free inch there are "things". Everybody should be free in what to collect in his life, for us that is memorable moments instant of things, human before useless stuff. What sense does it have to have a fancy high class stereo set, on which the radio sounds like cheap transistor radio? Why a ridiculous priced TV with only free channels and none of the extra applications used... Why sit in shower because a shower curtain doesn't fit in the tidiness?  I hope that my day that I have to sit in the shower be very long away.
If your urge to pimp up you place with coral instead of leaving it where it's belong I think that shows that maybe when you visit your beloved Africa Wera maybe you could bring back a vulnerable souvenir and that is the Africans love of live instead of "things" or A brands. 
The communication with Wera was nice, she was leaving some drinks etc for us. The place was spotless clean and there is a lot of supplies to give a luxurious comfortable stay. she was helpful to pick our own check out time.
Ich bin glücklich, danke!
Fue un viaje familiar y lo pasamos excelente el alojamiento es muy cómodo y limpio.

Ivos is a fantastic host! He was super responsive and helpful in showing us the amenities. He even brought over coffee supplies and helped me work the washer/dryer at the unit. Highly recommend you book with him whenever you visit Berlin!

Wunderschönes Zimmer, fantastischer Ausblick & netter Gastgeber!
Für uns war dies der erste Airbnb Aufenthalt und wir sind wirklich begeistert. Das Zimmer ist sehr schön eingerichtet und hell. Man hat einen schönen Ausblick ins Grüne. Dafür haben wir auch das Treppensteigen gerne in Kauf genommen :)
Arne war ein sehr hilfsbereiter und unkomplizierter Gastgeber, der uns auch noch tolle Tipps für unseren Aufenthalt gegeben hat.
Gerne wieder :)

This is an amazing place. We stayed here a few years ago already and liked it so much that we wanted to stay here again.
The location is great and the apartment is amazing. The communication with the host was excellent. 5/5 stars. Thank you!
Quartier calme et reposant

Super semaine dans cet appartement, très propre, équipements de qualité ! Proche de tout les transports, je recommande !
Philipp est très réactif et clair

Very nice cozy place. Good location. Very thoughtful ambience.
Summer nights could be an issue since the room has no fans.
I would recommend it for short trip in Berlin.
Sehr gute Lage, einfacher Zugang zum Apartment sowie sehr wertige Ausstattung. Würde ich immer wieder buchen.

Toller Spielplatz direkt gegenüber der Wohnung, ideal für Kinder jeder Altersklasse.
Gut gelegen (Geschäfte für den täglichen Bedarf, Restaurants und Nahverkehr)
Im Esszimmer gibt es viele Touristen Broschüren falls man mal einen kleinen Tipp braucht ;)
Kommunikation mit Gastgeber immer super freundlich und schnell.
Kommen gerne wieder, haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!
Great place, it was my second stay, will definitely cone back!

Ubytování i hostitele mohu s radostí doporučit. Mám problém s matracemi v hotelech, které jsou moc tvrdé nebo moc měkké, ale tady to bylo jako to mám doma. Skvěle se mi spalo. Pokoj by čistý s vlastní koupelnou přes chodbu. Mohu doporučit. Tady chcete v Berlíně bydlet.
Hele leuke accommodatie in het centrum van Berlijn!
Great place, super host and easy to move around. Thanks Jeff!
Ohne zu übertreiben und andere Unterkünfte abzuwerten: Für uns war es die bislang am besten zu uns passende Wohnung
A good place to stay for a reasonable price. Most places are only reachable by public transport but stations are close.

Sehr schöne, großzügige Unterkunft. Die Wohnung hat einen großen Wohnbereich und zusätzlich zwei Schlafzimmer. Wir waren nur zu zweit dort, aber es ist auch ausreichend Platz für vier oder fünf Personen.
Wir hatten eine Unterkunft in der Nähe des FEZ Berlin gesucht und diese war optimal. Mit ÖPNV erreicht man auch schnell alles Andere in Berlin.
Wenn man Glück hat (und wenn man möchte), kommt ein cooler Kater zu Besuch. :-)

Marcus and Kathleen are phenomenally kind hosts. Their place is ideally located and everything is just pristine. The building is an architectural gem. The apartment has all you need. The high ceilings and windows overlook a courtyard with nice trees. It is absolutely quiet, which is great for a good night’s sleep after a busy day of work or exploration. I hands down recommend their place, whether you visit for work or leisure. There are plenty of cafes and restaurants in the area, art galleries and bookstores, and easy connections (though I mainly walked everywhere I needed to be). The bakery in the corner is a great place for a quick breakfast. I wish I’d had more time to discover more of Berlin. Even though it was a busy business trip, the fact the apartment and location were so perfect, made the experience feel real and enjoyable.
Huge thanks for your flexibility facilitating an early check in.

The location was great, and the hood also. But the apartment  is not sound proof the up stairs neighbor’s toddler starts tapping at 7 AM each day so it wasn’t easy to sleep in also very sensible to put music because the noise woke up the kiddo.
War super. Tolle Unterkunft, super Host! Gerne wieder!

Marie ist eine sehr angenehme Gastgeberin, völlig unkompliziert. Wir konnten auf Grund der früheren Abreise der vorherigen Gäste eher einchecken. Unsere Kinder liebten den Hund (temporär dort) sehr. In der näheren Umgebung gibt es viele Cafés und Restaurants, die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel sind sehr gut zu erreichen. Wir kommen gerne wieder!
I would highly recommend Martin's place, it was both beautiful and an adventure. Just hope I can return one day! AWARDED TOP RATING *****
Great host and in a great location.. easy walk to Alexanderplatz and nearby shops and transport. Catharina was very helpful during our stay and the apartment was great.
We had a great stay at Juns' apartment. It was spacious, clean and very close to the tram.!
Cozy and comfortable, easy to transportation, peaceful - very happy staying here!
Alles in allem ein super Aufenthalt
Alles hervorragend, gerne wieder!
It has a great location, it’s clean and the host is nice. It’s price it’s really good.
schön ruhig und sauber
Super Lage. Check-in unkompilziert. Schönes Zimmer. Wir würden wieder kommen.
Buen lugar,

The apartment is in a great location for exploring Berlin - away from the hustle and bustle but minutes from the SBahn station which takes you right to the centre and all connections for getting around the city.  The weather had just turned cold but the apartment was warm and cozy.  Very comfortable beds and plenty of space. The kitchen has everything you need for making breakfast and light meals, but maybe an extra pot or two needed if you wanted to cook something more substantial for a group of 6.  Having said that, there were welcome supplies of coffee, tea, sugar etc, cleaning products and tablets for the dishwasher. A lovely organic supermarket is just 2 minutes away with freshly baked bread as well as great café/restaurants very close by.  Urs was very responsive and helpful and I will definitely stay here again if back in Berlin.
Gorgeous walk up with period trim and modern conveniences. Convenient to transit, great restaurants, shopping, and cafes. Wonderful stylish neighborhood. I would definitely stay there again!

Awesome apartment, awesome host. Very kind and help us with everything we needed. Great communication, and great man.
Can't think of anything bad to write here. All was awesome

Vi mötte inte Anna själv. Och vi talade bara i telefon med Ralph som presenterades som oväxlande "vän" och "make", och som det var sagt skulle möta oss. Men vi fick ett fint mottagande av Susanne, som visade oss både lägenheten och området trots att klockan var 10 en lördagskväll.

Bilderna stämmer med verkligheten - men genom att de är tagna med vidvinkelkamera så ger de ett större intryck än vad som var fallet. Kök och badrum var enligt min mening underbara, liksom sovrummen. Lägenheten var dessutom lagom personlig, med många fina föremål och möbler.

Grannskapet fann vi mycket trevligt med mängder av olika restauranger för både frukost, lunch och middag. Där fanns både vietnamesiska restauranger, italienska, tyska m.fl. Men det var något längre till centrum än vad vi hade väntat oss.

The underground was only a 3-4 minute walk away, which made it so easy to access tourist attractions, museums, and art galleries. I would love to stay here again on my next visit to Berlin. Many thanks to Sabine for her warm welcome.

Ich hatte einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt. Die Unterkunft in einem Altbau hat das gewisse etwas und liegt in einer sehr schönen, authentischen und ruhigen Gegend, die trotzdem auch sehr lebendig ist. Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und Stephan war ein sehr freundlicher und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber. Die Lage war optimal und ich konnte zu Fuß und per Öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln sehr viel von Berlin erkunden. Ich kann Stephan und seine Unterkunft herzlichst weiterempfehlen.

Het verblijf van Gordon is prachtig. De gehele inrichting, de meubels, de voorzieningen en alle aanwezige spullen stralen smaak, klasse en kwaliteit uit. Dat geldt voor alle kamers van het appartement. Het gehele appartement is bijzonder smaakvol, compleet en doordacht ingericht en uitgerust. Er is duidelijk nagedacht om het gehele appartement 1en dezelfde uitstraling en inrichting te geven. Lampen, meubels, keuken en accessoires sluiten alle op elkaar aan.
De badkamer is luxe ingericht, smaakvolle tegels, luxe bad-, douche en wastafelkraan en bijbehorend passend wastafel en toilet. Handdoeken en badlaken zijn degelijk, schoon en passend bij het interieur.
De keuken is met een ingerichte keuken compleet met borden, bestek, pannen en glazen. Ook hier is gekozen voor degelijke en luxe materialen die passen bij de uitstraling. De bank is heerlijk!
De slaapkamers zijn voorzien van grote, goede bedden. De matrassen liggen heerlijk, kussens zijn geweldig en het beddengoed erg prettig.
I had a great stay. Hanna and Tara are excellent hosts ❤️
Es ist eine sehr charmante Altbauwohnung mit hohen Decken und Kohleofen. Es handelt sich um eine WG mit sehr netten Menschen. Der Empfang war herzlich und die Kommunikation gut.
David was very friendly and the airbnb was bigger than expected! The sofa bed was super comfortable and it was a really fun area :)

Nina's flat is lovely and very close to FU Berlin where I needed to be. Also good distance to public transportation, both S-bahn and U-bahn are just 10mins. away. She also responds quickly and overall process was smooth.
I enjoyed my stay at this flat! Perfect and convenient location to the nearest train station 😊 & the host was very friendly and helpful as well.

Thank you very much.
The owner of this excellent apartment was polite and punctual, answered always and on time, the apartment has all the conditions for living, the transport communication is excellent, both with Berlin and Brandenburg and all of Germany. Tram stop right outside the house entrance, metro, regional trains, 5 minutes walk to Friedrich Strasse station. 5 minutes walk to the Museum Island. Thank you Claus Peter !!!
Хозяин этой отличной кваритры был вежливым и пунктуальным, отвечал всегда и вовремя, в квартире есть все условия для проживания, транспортное сообщение великолепное, как с Берлином, так и с Бранденбургом и всей Германией. Трамвайная остановка прямо возле входа в дом, метро, региональные поезда в 5 минутах ходьбы до станции Фридрих-штрассе. 5 минут ходьбы до Музейного острова. Спасибо Клаус-Питер!!!

Tamara ist eine super Gastgeberin. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und die Location ist großartig. Ein früherer Check-In war möglich, Tamara hat uns einige gute Restaurants Tipps zugeschickt, war immer erreichbar. Die Wohnung hat alles was man braucht. Sie hat uns sogar zwei kalte Biere und Gummibärchen da gelassen. Super herzlich und zuvorkommend. Wir wünschen Tamara alles Gute!
Mükemmel bir konaklamaydı. Evde her ihtiyacınıza karşılık verecek eşya mevcuttu. Mutfak mümemmel. Konum süper. Her şey tertemizdi.

Ein sehr schöner Bungalow und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Sehr gepflegter Garten zum wohlfühlen. Sehr nette und warmherzige Gastgeber. Besser kann man es nicht treffen. Mußten leider den Urlaub wegen eines schweren Unfalls abbrechen. Auch hier haben wir viel Trost und Unterstützung erfahren (vom mehrmaligen Fahrdienst in Krankenhäuser, über die ganze Gepäckverladung bis zur Fahrzeugaussenreinigung durch Hans). Es ist wirklich schade dass wir den Urlaub nicht bis zum Ende genießen konnten. Denke auch gerne an die guten Gespräche zurück. Wir werden ein andermal wieder zu Erika und Hans fahren um diese tollen Gastgeber und ihr schönes Zuhause zu genießen. Auch an beide noch ein großes Dankeschön für die umfangreiche Hilfe. Da die beiden aktuell auch etwas angeschlagen sind auf diesem Weg noch großes Daumendrücken für eine baldige Genesung. So dass noch viele Airbnb Reisende dieses Idyll bei Erika und Hans genießen können. Alles gute für euch bis zum nächsten Mal. Liebe Grüße Uli und Gabi

This is the second time I stayed at Julius place, and the place was as good as the first time. It is less than a block from my son’s  apartment, great bakeries and the tram is right in front of us. It is a wonderful place to stay if you want to be in a beautiful, walkable neighborhood.

Wir haben uns sofort wohlgefühlt- die hohen Räume, der Parkettboden,der typische Berliner Hinterhof- und werden bestimmt wiederkommen . Die Lage direkt am U-/S-Bahnhof Jungfernheide und die Nähe zum Park des Charlottenburger Schlosses waren super !!
Das einchecken war total unproblematisch und persönlich , der Kontakt mit Anton schnell, freundlich und unproblematisch.
Vielen Dank noch dafür, dass wir die Koffer bis zu unserer Abfahrt in der Wohnung lassen konnten , das hat uns viel Stress erspart .
Danke für alles
Alles war super 👍🏽 würden jederzeit wieder  kommen ❤️

Absolutely perfect - the location, the apartment and the host (Sam) .
it was a pleasure to stay there, very safe, nice and Sam was always super helpful.
Cornelius was very easy to communicate with, he also allowed a later check out which was very helpful. Flat is spacious, comfortable and very close to tram with direct links to Alexanderplatz.
Super cozy, clean and sunny flat! Enjoyed great couple of days in there:)
It was a really nice and clean apartment, it is what you see in the pictures. Funda was always there to answer all of our questions.

The place is located in the heart of Friedrichshain. Really close to key places in Berlin. The living room and the bedroom are really large wide spaces, which makes it feel very special and comfortable. The kitchen has enough items to make you feel at home and the bathroom is very functional. Plus, the sofa is very comfortable. I would even recommend it for prolonged stays.

Claudius was very friendly, wrote an excellent description how to get to the flat. Room and bathroom was very clean.
The room was very hot and the location is a bit noisy. But from price point of view it was really good.

This was my first time staying in a lived in home. I loved it, but had I known, probably would not have booked with my husband as he is too introverted to enjoy this type of stay. Happy accident, as I feel I made a friend. Probably should be a bit more transparent in the description that this is the situation.

I had to quickly book this place because of issues with my initial apartment (it happens, we are all people). Picked this one because of the location, more or less comparable price and good reviews. And didn’t regret it at all!
Honestly - I loved the location even more. It’s super close to the metro line which is probably the best one for visitors, because it goes through Alexanderplatz and Friedrichstrasse straight to X-berg.
The area itself is also worth seeing, there are lots of great places right near you (Ben Rahim for coffee and breakfast, Cocolo Ramen - legend! Altes Europe - the cozy local place right nearby etc.) , and it’s so safe and peaceful, so many little beautiful streets around!
The place is just great and has everything needed (at least for me). It’s pretty minimalistic yet well organized. WiFi worked perfectly, no probs with hot water or heating, hairdryer available, pretty comfy bed and windows to the backyard.
Just the two watch-outs: the bed is low (I have problems with my back and still it was ok, but it depends) and no elevator. I didn’t see it a problem, but worth mentioning.
The host himself was brilliant - quick reaction, willing to help, very welcoming.
Super host and very charming house in the most enchanting area of Berlin! Quiet place, very confortable!

I loved this little house. It's a peaceful, comfortable spot with all the essentials. It's not in the middle of the action but it's a 20 minute walk (or 5 minute tram ride) from Ostkreutz where you'll find lots of good restaurants, and easy to catch a train to anywhere in the city. Carsten was a helpful and responsive host. I hope to stay again next time I'm in town!
Alles ganz entspannt und wie beschrieben. Schnelle, zuverlässige und freundliche Kommunikation
Miejsce dobre do zwiedzania całego Berlina
Super Lage!

Schönes Zimmer mit super Ausstattung,gute Kommunikation und beste Lage mitten drin - trotzdem ruhig.
Gerne wieder!

Die Unterkunft war grundsätzlich in Ordnung und bot genug Platz für uns (5 Personen). Der Preis war angemessen, allerdings merkt man der Wohnung und den Möbeln an, dass sie schon etwas in die Jahre gekommen sind. An manchen Stellen hätte es sauberer sein können. Wer keine hohen Ansprüche hat und eine preiswerte Unterkunft für mehrere Personen sucht, wird hier trotzdem fündig.
有特色的室内装饰，一楼也很方便搬行李，关键是位置很好，步行到博物馆岛、商业中心都很方便，距离地铁站就两分钟路程，不错的。

Schon zum zweiten Mal habe ich eine ganze Woche hier in Kreuzkölln verbracht. Es hat mir wieder ausgezeichnet gefallen: ruhige Lage, viel Platz, stilvolle Einrichtung, tolle Umgebung. Auch beim nächsten Mal werde gerne wieder hier einchecken. Vielen Dank an A&H.

Torsten was very helpful and friendly and the apartment was beautiful and clean. It was located very central, but on a quiet street. Most clubs were within walking distance, and there were plenty of restaurants and supermarkets nearby. We had a great time!

Ernst was a really good host, he and his girlfriend was really nice, the department is cosy and clean and in a really good location in the center of Berlin. We for sure recommend Ernst place to stay in Berlin.

Gastgeber antwortet sehr schnell. Die Wohnung ist an einer top Lage, wunderschön und sehr geräumig, perfekt für einen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Parkplätze waren allerdings etwas schwierig zu finden oder kostenspielig. Gerne wieder!

Great hotel, we stayed in the apartments. The hotel and the apartment where spotlessly clean, includes shower, shampoo and conditioner - the two bathrooms worked so well in our group of three. The pool is little but we still had a refreshing swim and a sauna, towels and slippers provided - a great end to the day sightseeing. The staff were all very helpful, and spoke excellent English for us.
I would totally recommend this hotel.
The hotel is between 5 and 10 mins walk to many restaurants, and just round the corner from the shops. Its about a 20 min taxi to the Tower.
Uber was so helpful for our journey, always easy to get and reasonably priced.
Tolle Location, der Flügel ist natürlich das Highlight. Für (angehende) Musiker, die ein paar Tage in der Stille arbeiten wollen perfekt

Lugnt område med nära till spårvagnsstation och mataffär.
Bra restauranger och barer ett par spårvagnsstationer bort. Även nära till S-tåg för längre utflykter.
Intressant byggnad med en del udda och väl fungerande lösningar. Compact living.
Trevlig och flexibel värd som var lätt att kommunicera med.

Julian's flat is just perfect for a weekend in Berlin! It's location is just a few stops away from Alexanderplatz - all the touristy stuff can be reached within 15 mins. It's really cozy, the bed is soo comfy, the shower is nice and overall it's really clean! Also the kitchen is well-equiped, so we were able to have breakfast and take away in the flat.
Julian always replied fast and could answer all our questions. Check-in and check-out went as smoothly as expected. Would totally come back!

Jana and Paul were great hosts—left us all the information we needed, including recommendations for eating, markets, bikes, etc. Very helpful, and Jana always got back to me immediately. The place is cozy, and perfectly situated for our week in Berlin.
I had a great time staying at Martin's place. Clean and comfortable.

This apartment was wonderful for our stay in Berlin! It's well connected to public transit and has great restaurants, bars, shopping, etc. within walking distance. It's bright and sunny and overlooks the park. I'd highly recommend for anyone looking for a neighborhood environment while visiting Berlin!
Sehr gute Lage und alles in der Nähe. Gute Anbindung zu den Öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Super Preis für alles.
i am sorry for throwing up in the bathroom at 2 am 😭😭
The apartment is very comfortable and cozy. The neighborhood is one of the best in Berlin and is very quiet, and family oriented.
A great place to spend a few days in Berlin. Its a very well located apartment and the neighbourhood is super well connected and yet peaceful.
Eine sehr angenehmes Ambiente und Emilia empfängt die liebevoll und es ist ein wunderschönes Zimmer in sehr schöner Lage.
Wir hatten einen scheinen Aufenthalt, ein nettes Apartment und eine schnelle Kommunikation mit Henning & Ariane. Gerne wieder
Great location and great value!

Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben, mit dem Nötigsten ausgestattet und in einer ruhigen Straße. Schön, neben dem ganzen Trubel der Stadt. Die Wohnung war sauber, die Betten bequem und der Check-In unkompliziert. Ist sehr zu empfehlen, wenn man eine ruhige Unterkunft sucht, die man hauptsächlich zum Schlafen nutzt.
habe mich wohl gefühlt und das Bett war bequem zum schlafen

Great location and nice spacious clean room. The only problem was someone had taken the room assigned to us since the key was in the room door waiting for us. Luckily the host responded quickly and got us another room in the same building.
Nice place in a very big city. Comfortable, clean, and everything as expected.

Uneingeschränkte Empfehlung für diese tolle Unterkunft! Sabine ist eine ungemein freundliche und herzliche Gastgeberin, das Zimmer sowie die ganze Unterkunft lässt keinerlei Wünsche offen - ich hatte ein großartiges Wochenende in Berlin.
Sehr schön eingerichtet und super schön auf der Insel gelegen

Wir hatten 3 wundervolle Tage in Berlin und Barbara ist die perfekte Gastgeberin. Ihre Unterkunft war traumhaft schön, wir fühlten uns rundum wohl. Ihr liebevoll arrangiertes Frühstück und ihr Gastfreundschaft hat uns den Start in den Tag leicht gemacht. Wir können Barbara als Gastgeberin Wärmsteins empfehlen. Ihre Wohnung ist traumhaft und unser Zimmer war liebevoll bis ins kleinste Detail eingerichtet. Wir danken Barbara von Herzen für ihre Gastfreundschaft und kommen gerne wieder, weil wir Berlin einfach lieben.

We had a nice stay here for a few days :) The room is very spacious, with a small but functional bathroom. Cleanliness was okay, but the cleaners had not cleaned the water kettle that we were expecting to use. The location was ideal for us, close to the train and bus stations, and also grocery stores and restaurants. You should know that the noise level is quite high, as the walls are thin and the room is on the ground floor. The bed we used was a bit small, but for two people it works just fine. Otherwise very cozy and appropriate for me and my friend!

Hardi es muy amable, atento y aunque no conocíamos muy bien el idioma, el se esforzó por explicarnos todo. La ubicación es muy buena. Nos rentó dos bicis con las cuales recorrimos más de 30 kms en Berlín y pudimos conocer más de lo que esperábamos. El desayuno que ofrece como extra es muy delicioso. El cuarto es impecable y silencioso para descansar. Totalmente recomendado.

About a 10 minute walk to the nearest U-station, peaceful and walking distance to a number of good restaurants (and fantastic thrift shopping. Plenty of space for the two of us. It was tidy and had plenty of amenities.

Nuestra estadía en el apartamento de Cristoph fue perfecta. Un apartamento fabuloso, espacioso, tranquilo, con una decoración con estilo y buen gusto con una vista maravillosa de Berlín. Sin duda el mejor apartamento que he alquilado por Airbnb. Cristoph siempre estuvo atento y receptivo a nuestras consultas, y atento a los detalles como el hermoso ramo de flores de bienvenida. Tan solo a dos cuadras del Kadewe y a pasos de una de las partes más céntricas de Berlín. Si estás buscando apartamentos en Berlín y tienes la suerte de que el apartamento de Cristoph esté libre, no dudes en reservarlo. Nos encantaría volver en otro momento

Great value in a solid location. ~20 min walk or 5 min tram ride to Alexanderplatz. Also many great dining options nearby. Only knock is that the bed and pillow weren't the comfiest and there was a slightly weird smell in the bathroom. Like mothballs or something. But I would definitely stay again at the price!

Absolutely fantastic place to stay. The location is fantastic - quiet and close to restaurants, bars, small grocery shops and public transport links.
The room is comfortable and amenities are provided to make the stay as enjoyable as possible.
I highly recommend - I will definitely be staying again.

We had an excellent 4-night-stay in S&M's apartment. The apartment is beautiful and very well equipped (I especially appreciated the great hair-dryer), and the area is great - just a few minutes to walk to tons of hip Kreuzberg bars and coffeeshops, nice restaurants... We'll come back next time we're in Berlin.

Hanyu and her place made my stay in Berlin super comfortable and a memorable. The space is very homely, with a well equipped kitchen and very spacious room. I was able to cook my breakfast and lunches with ease.
The real pleasure came from meeting Hanyu, who was kind enough to invite me to one of her yoga sessions, and then spend the weekend showing me around the Tempelhof park and other areas.
Definitely recommend Hanyu’a place to any traveler - not just to spend some time in Berlin, but to also share a space kind, open, and spiritual soul :)

Stefan hat uns super nett empfangen. Alles hat Komplikationslos geklappt und die Lage ist top!
Sehr gerne wieder. :)
Would recommend  this beautifull place!

located in near Alexander Platz (ca. 5 minutes by foot). The room was bigger than we thought and was well equipped with all necessary items.
Definitely recommend to stay :)

such a great location to the DB train, once you go through the system once, it's easy to navigate (thank you google maps)
the room was awesome had everything I needed and more than expected. would definitely come back to this place 🙌🤘
Everything was fine, Johannes is a great host.
Logement spacieux, confortable et agréable et à proximité des transports en public. Adapté pour les groupes voulant un logement à Kreuzberg.
Tutto come da descrizione, appartamento molto ordinato e pulito, ho apprezzato il silenzio della palazzina.
Nice stay and calm !
Thanks for making our stay comfortable and memorable. Kathleen was very cooperative and accomodating. The place is in close proximity to a number of landmarks in Berlin and feels very cozy.
Alles super, sehr sauber, hat Spaß gemacht

Amazing apartment, close to local amenities and very clean. Roi was very attentive and available at all times if we needed anything.
5*
Cheers Roi.

Die Wohnung liegt wunderschön im Gleimkiez etwas abseits vom Touristenstrom. Sie sieht wirklich so aus wie auf den Fotos. Hervorzuheben ist der tolle Kontakt mit Axel. Wir reisten mit einem Kleinkind an, weshalb wir keine genaue Ankunftszeit angeben konnten. Auch unsere Abreise haben wir spontan verschoben. Alles kein Problem. Axel antwortet sofort und regelt alles ganz entspannt. Nur zu empfehlen!

写真以上のクオリティです。勿体無いほど広い上にインテリアも素敵でした。
サンドラとサンドラの家族はとても素敵な人達でした。様々なサポートを快くしてくれました。
価格が少し高いように感じますが、払う価値があると思うので払える範囲であればおすすめです！
土曜日と日曜日は上の階の住人の生活音がよく聞こえます。気になる人は気になると思います。
日本人にとっては鍵の開け閉めが時々難しく感じることがあります。
シャンプーがあると良かったのですが、なかったのでスーパーで買いました。電子レンジがあればより良かったですが、調理は充分できたので問題ないです。
Logement très bien situé. Proche en métro du centre-ville. Aménagement correct pour 5 personnes.

This is a lovely space, well located, with fantastic access to public transport. the flat is just like in the description. It's a quiet neighbourhood but close to restaurants. our only problem was with the check in instructions. We got them very early, in fact, we were still in the UK. However, we found them unclear and they were in a photo format, but it was out of focus and we couldn't even read the key safe pin code. On the positive side, there was a phone number, which we called and they were very helpful and sorted everything out. So, all was well. Lovely flat.
Excellent place. 10/10

Modern eingerichteter Albau, zu Fuss ein Katzensprung zur Haltestelle Humboldthain, würde wieder buchen.
(Endlich mal ein Airbnb mit genug Kleiderbügel ;] beste!)
Très bon accueil et emplacement parfait. Ainsi que chambre agréable et propre.

Stefanie's apartment has the feel of a converted warehouse, it is large, stylish and very comfortable.  The location is perfect, close to transport, amenities such as supermarkets, and has cafes at the doorstep.  What we liked most was that whilst close to the action, it didnt feel like we were in a tourist area. Stefanie was a very considerate host.  We loved our stay and will definitely be back!

J'ai passé un excellent séjour chez Peggy. Elle s'est montrée arrangeante pour mon arrivée. Elle m'a toute de suite mise à l'aise , nous avons discuté très facilement. Elle a une grande confiance dans ses hôtes et on se sent aussi en confiance avec elle. L'appartement est comme décrit, propre, fonctionnel avec une jolie déco. Il est proche des commodités et du centre de Berlin. Je ne peux que conseiller cette adresse et si je reviens à Berlin j'espère pouvoir retourner chez Peggy.
Wunderbarer Aufenthalt in einer sehr schönen Wohnung!
Danke! Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in Berlin.

Very nice place, easy check in.
Was perfect for city trip!

Personal war sehr freundlich, Sauberkeit gut, nur konnte sich das Fenster im Bad nicht öffnen lassen, wodurch Schimmel am Fenster entstand. Lage sehr ruhig und öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind gut zu erreichen. Generell ist die Unterkunft ihren Preis auf jeden Fall wert und ist zu empfehlen
Lovely & homely studio with stylish interior. Linda is a great host. She was very helpful & friendly. She recommended a lot of nice places in the area. I'll happily recommend it.
Vielen Dank! Wir kommen gerne wieder...
I'll be very happy to stay with you again.  Great setup.
Localisation idéale, grand studio propre avec décoration très sympa. Recommandé à 100%!
Empfehlenswert!

Nice, clean, basic flat. Shower was super powerful, the local area had a lot going on. Thomas was great at making suggestions for pubs/restaurants and super accommodating to our late checkout request.
Bed wasn’t the comfiest and curtains didn’t block all the light so if you like a darker environment maybe bring an eye mask. But overall a decent stay.
Wie schon letztes Mal alles in Ordnung.
excelente atención

Dorothee's accomodation surpassed my expectations. She was very welcoming and helpful.  The accomodation was just what I wanted - so quiet that I could sleep with the window open, almost unthinkable in a city. Being so close to 2 U-Bahn stations is very convenient. I would recommend it to anyone.

Great little basement apartment, located in a great and safe area. Lovely ambiance around and would definitely recommend. My only complaint are the noisy neighbours who were playing music at 3am on our first night, and being very loud during the other nights, but Jonas was very helpful in sorting it out.
Great location. And easy checking in process. Host responds to our messages promptly! Highly recommend!

Die Bilder in der Anzeige haben nicht zu viel versprochen. Sie war geräumig, geschmackvoll eingerichtet und strahlte eine gemütliche Atmosphäre aus.
Der Zustand der Wohnung war hervorragend. Alles war sauber und in einwandfreiem Zustand. Es war offensichtlich, dass die Gastgeber viel Mühe in die Pflege und Wartung der Wohnung gesteckt hatten.
Trotz der zentralen Lage in Neu-Köln war die Wohnung überraschend ruhig. Sie befindet sich im Hinterhaus, was dazu führte, dass ich nachts gut schlafen konnte, ohne von Lärm oder Trubel gestört zu werden.

Muro a ridosso del letto macchiato, di chissà cosa.
Mi hanno fornito 2 tovaglie per 5 giorni.
Il tappetino del bagno è inutile perché l'ho bagnato martedì uscendo dalla doccia e non si è più asciugato (fino a domenica).
La coperta era troppo corta e non si poteva infilare sotto al letto.
Il cuscino era probabilmente da esterno per seduta, non per dormire.
Riscaldamento inesistente, ho dormito con la felpa per i primi due giorni.
Illuminazione insufficiente.
Rumori molesti ad ogni ora e pareti sottili, chiunque sente qualunque cosa.
Aesthetically pleasing, clean apt. Centrally located, hip neighbourhood. Verda was very responsive and available through text at all times. Would recommend.
Peaceful area yet close to every major attraction. Nice restaurants in the area.
Zona tranquila con muchas comodidades, el apartamento increíble y las camas muy cómodas

Der Aufenthalt bei Stefan hätte nicht besser sein können. Die Kommunikation verlief prima, die Wohnung ist geräumig und gepflegt. Sie befindet sich in einem schönen Haus in ruhiger Umgebung.
Innen war alles wie beschrieben, sehr sauber und so haben wir dort herrliche Tage verbracht.
Einfacher Check-in, sauberes Zimmer, Kaffemaschine im Zimmer, leider sehr laut.

I felt right at home. Good location near transport and a supermarket. Easy to access trendy neighborhoods. The room is very spacious and nicely decorated in Berlin style. Leo is a caring host. I will return with pleasure.
A nice clean flat near the city centre. We recieved a nice warm welcome. Would happily stay there again.
Great place to stay. Clean, spacious, great location. The host is very accessible and friendly.

This is one of the most memorable AirbnB experiences I've ever had. The flat is really gorgeous -- way beyond the usual IKEA centric decor. It's well acquitted with a washer, dishwasher, real stove and oven, heated bathroom floors... But it was the atmosphere that won me over. The location is perfect, right in the heart of the historic Scheunenviertel area of Mitte, surrounded by great restaurants and shops and historical sites. The S and U bahn are a block away. Berlin is at your feet. We were three friends, so we used the master bedroom and the pull out couch in the main room. Communication also gets an A plus. Palamena, the main contact, met us at the flat and was readily available throughout our stay to answer questions. She went above and beyond and delivered clean towels midway through our stay. It's one the ground floor, so there is a little street noise, but with the double windows it was never a problem. Highly recommended!

Tolle Lage, man geht einfach raus aus dem Haus und gleich um die Ecke gibt es viele ganz nette Lokale, Restaurant, Cafés....
Sehr gute Verbindung zur S-Bahn.
Conveniently located near restaurants and public transport. Spacious apartment with everything you needed for a weekend stay.

Sophia is a very friendly and welcoming host, which made me feel at home right away. Keep in mind that you are staying in her house and sharing the space, and there are no locks on the bedroom or bathroom doors. The bedroom itself is spacious and nicely decorated. The absolute highlight of this Airbnb is the neighborhood, truly a fantastic area to stay!

This is a very charming place in a quiet neighbourhood. Our room was spacious, equipped with everything we needed and the rooftop terrace was amazing. Everyone in Art Nouveau was very helpful and friendly. Would recommend if you want to do some Berlin sightseeing but at the same time looking for a bit more calm surrounding to wind down at the end of the day.
Coole Wohnung, super Gegend & herzlicher Gastgeber - jederzeit wieder!

Ideal for one person or a couple. Situated in a historic part of Berlin that is layered with moments of significance and change.
Many major attractions are easily walkable. Transit is around every corner including the trams. The flat offers a quiet, calm place to relax after your adventures. Groceries around the corner. Bakery nearly next door. Very nice cafés and restaurants. The neighbourhood is family friendly and playgrounds are numerous. This is probably the best location I have stayed in Berlin over the years. Now it’s your turn!

Ruhige, in einem Hinterhof gelegene Wohnung. Es war sauber und sehr geräumig. Die Wohnung wirkt in echt noch schöner als auf den Fotos. Die späte Ankunft (Nachts) stellte kein Problem dar und ich wurde freundlich empfangen. Gerne wieder.

Pavel's flat has a great location. All the photos are very accurate. All communication with Pavel&co was very efficient. Not the most homey like flat to rent, if that's what you are looking for, but gives good value for your money.
Amazing location and clean, stylish space
Amazing place, Wibke and Rudie are really great and friendly weman!

The place was very nice. Location was good too. However we stayed there for two weeks and Alex refused to change our sheets for free, and would only do it for 50 euros. We ended up washing them ourselves and only spent 6 euros.
Personne sympathique et accueillante. Sur le peu de temps que je suis resté et durant lequel nous avons échangé quelques mots, rien à signaler.

L'appartement de Fai était parfait pour mes 3 collègues car chacune avait une chambre à elle dans un endroit très propre et accueillant. La cuisine est équipée pour y cuisiner au quotidien (attention, pas de congélateur), le quartier est vert, calme et central à la fois. Elles seront ravies d'y retourner lors de leur prochain passage à Berlin.
Merci, Fai !

Da wir übers Wochenende in Berlin waren und mit dem Auto kamen, fiel die Wahl auf eine Unterkunft etwas außerhalb.
Die Lage der Unterkunft ist sehr praktisch. Man kann kostenlos in der Straße parken, eine recht leistbare Tankstelle und einen Rewe gibt's auch in der Nähe und die Straßenbahn Station ist nur 200m entfernt. Zudem liegt die Station noch in der Zone B des Öffi-Netzes.
Anita ist sehr nett und zuvorkommend. Sie hat uns alles wichtige in der Unterkunft gezeigt. Zudem gibt's eine kleine Mappe mit allen wichtigen Infos.
Das wirklich einzige "Problem" waren die Betten. Es gibt zwei Einzelbetten (die wirklich sehr sauber und gemütlich waren). Als Pärchen heißt das entweder sehr viel kuscheln oder getrennt schlafen. Aber das ist dann schon meckern auf hohem Niveau.
Wir würden beim nächsten Aufenthalt in Berlin definitiv wieder kommen.

Sorpreso positivamente.
Ambra bravissima ragazza che ti fa sentire a casa ed a tuo agio. Disponibile per eventuali necessità, amichevole e socievole. Mai invadente.
Appartamento veramente molto bello e soprattutto perfettamente pulito. Quartiere che ha diverse offerte di ristoranti e bar, vicino a fermate metro(Rosenthaler) e normalmente tranquillo.
Super consigliato.

This place was great! It felt more spacious than how it appeared in the photos. Perfect location to walk anywhere and hop on the train. Host was responsive even when I had a question late in the evening. My only critique would be that the cooling was mediocre - the place got a little stuffy and the shower gets water all over the floor, so extra towels would’ve been beneficial. Overall would stay here again!
All is as described. Katja made all she could to make my stay as promised. Thanks
Excellent location and everything you need is in the apt. Would recommend it to everybody.
You'd be luck to stay in this handsome home with such a gracious hostess.
Great place, beautifully designed, at a good location if you don't mind climbing a couple of stairs

Hemos estado muy a gusto, el anfitrión ha estado muy atento a cualquier cosa que podamos necesitar. La zona es ideal, está en el centro de Berlín y tiene muy buenas combinaciones para moverte por la ciudad.
Eine super schöne Wohnung, die sehr zentral gelegen und wirklich gut mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln angebunden ist.
Very good experience! We could check in early that made us really happy 😃 friendly staff and nice place. Easy to reach tram and U Bahn. There is a nice kebab around 🤤
Sehr schöne Wohnung. Sehr sauber. Der Aufenthalt hat sich auf jeden Fall gelohnt.

This apartment is in a great location. Once we knew about the shortcut it was a few minutes walk to the grocery store. The subway and bus lines were very close and it was a comfortable walk to the Museum Island. There is a cafe across the street and a restaurant just up the block.
The kitchen has a two burner cooktop and there is no oven or microwave. There also is no coffee maker but there is an electric kettle for making tea and instant coffee. The lack of comfortable seating for reading and watching television was the most serious issue. It needs a sofa and a chair.
The apartment was very clean, freshly painted and quite attractive .
We had SUCH a great stay at Philipp’s apartment - super clean, beautifully decorated and in a brilliant location (opposite a fantastic bar too…). Would highly recommend!

Host was very nice and friendly. We received welcoming surprise and special greeting since it was my Bday trip. Apartments was new, clean and stylish. Coffee and basing needs for cooking was in the kitchen.

Andrea is a hospitable and polite lady welcoming the guests to her place.
Although my room was smaller than I expected, it was comfortable and cosy. The bathroom and toilet are shared with the other rooms, but I had no problem at all - it was as if I was the only user! The other guest we almost "invisible". I had a great time there and would gladly return to explore more of the lovely western part of Berlin.
Finally, thank you Andrea for the nice breakfast provided. It is not a common practice.
Sehr zentral gelegene Wohnung, jedoch trotzdem ruhig. Die Wohnung ist hinreichend zum kochen ausgestattet, Lokale und Cafes befinden sich aber auch in fußnähe.

Very clean and tidy apartment. Great location. The owner always answered all our questions promptly. Everything was to our entire satisfaction. Parking was also available for a reasonable price. Thank you very much.

Kiki and Christian’s place is beautiful as well as incredibly well located. They both made us feel at home from min 1 and gave us recommendations of the neighborhood when needed. I cannot stress enough how beautiful the house is decorated and how comfortable we were during all our stay. 100/10 thank you so much Kiki!

This place is great for a solo traveler. It had everything I needed and was in a location that I really liked. Highly recommend for solo travelers and couples looking for a place to stay, it covers all the basic necessities.
Alles war sehr schön
good hostel!
Ein super ausgestattete und saubere Wohnung im Zentrum von Berlin.

Leider hatten wir ziemlich Pech mit dem Zimmer. Es war nicht sehr sauber und hat nicht so gut gerochen. Zudem hatten wir ein ständiges Geräusch das aus dem Bad kam und leider nicht behoben werden konnte. Somit konnten wir erst nach einer Nacht in ein anderes Zimmer, welches leider auch eine Dusche hatte wo das Wasser nicht richtig ablaufen konnte. Die Lage ist super und der Check-in und Check out Mega leicht, jedoch würden wir uns in Zukunft nicht mehr für diese Unterkunft entscheiden.

Unterkunft war wie beschreiben und ist Direct 5 Minuten von dem Bahnhof Charlottenburg entfernt . Im gesamten war es sehr schön und bereue es,dass ich nicht für einen längeren Aufenthalt gebucht habe .

What an amazing place. We have been traveling Europe for the last month and this place has been one of the best. The location is near public transportation, with restaurants and stores near by.
Verda gave us a couple of suggestions to attend (flea market on Sundays) and we really had a good time. Lots of local food and interesting things to buy.
The place was clean, and had all of the amenities needed. Ideal for a couple or a small family that want to explore Berlin.
What was really nice was the windows that provided natural light during the day. It also had nice shades that made the room dark at night (better sleep).
We fully enjoyed our stayed in Verda’s place. Would love to come back.
excepcional!!! la casa es maravillosa y el trato con nassa espectacular. situada en un barrio idoneo , la proxima vez que volvamos a berlin no dudaremos en volver a visitar a nassa.
Super hôte et appartement nickel, tout proche des transports en commun. Très bien équipé, très propre et très grand. Service impeccable, et réactivité sur les demandes. Je recommande !

We really enjoyed our stay in the apartement. Werner was a really friendly host and gave us a warm welcome!
The apartment was ideally situated for us- shops, restaurants and playgrounds where nearby. The rooms where really big and clean and the apartement was equiped with everthing- you could almost only bring our own clothes.
Beautiful apartment, lovely neighborhood, plenty of bars, restaurants, shops, and extremely easy access to get anywhere in Berlin. Ambra was a wonderful and helpful host. Highly recommend!
All good = 5 stars :)
Trevlig värd. Fin lägenhet. Nära till allt
Recomiendo el alojamiento porque es muy cómodo, limpio, hay silencio, las personas son muy amables y es muy cerca a todo !

Barbara's apartment was outstanding! Everything was beautifully styled and so clean.
Really good location few minute walk to the tram which brings you into the main area in minutes.You can even walk in if you feel like a stroll it's about 20 mins.
Fully supplied with tips from Barbara on transport to dining out we took restaurant recommendations and ate in some local spots the value and quality was amazing.
We also found a gem nearer to the main area ristorante a mano, one of the best restaurants we have ever been.Following Barbara's advice we used the hop on hop off tours well worth it too get all the sights in.I highly recommend this apartment if you want a comfortable enjoyable stay in Berlin with a fabulous host.
We would 100% return !! :) Eoin & Jasmin
Great please, great location.

While nothing they did was overtly unwelcoming, I couldn’t shake the feeling that I wasn’t exactly wanted there. I had to switch rooms after adding an extra night to my stay, and both the original and new rooms were located at the far back of the hotel. So, is it clean? Absolutely.
Hospitable? That’s up for debate.

First of all i wanna state this was my fist Airbnb experience and i got to say that mr Rochus did leave a high standard for me to compare, when i book accommodation my top 3 is the bedroom, the bathroom, and the location, all the rest are amenities to me, so I'm going to cover the basics first, the bedroom is really spacious and gets filled with light from a huge window that allows you to have a great view and also feel the breeze, the bed itself is really comforting with nice bed sheets, also in the room there is a nice couch, a full mirror, in a closet with plenty of space to fit your stuff. The bathroom should get a review on itself since it's really big and modern, it's so nice that you might consider sleeping one night in there just to enjoy it, it is kept really clean and tidy, the rain forest shower is mind healing and instantly makes you want to shower for ever, and the view of the forest from the window just tops it all. About the location i got to admit its a little bit far from the center, our route might not be the fastest but it worked for us and took us aprox an hour to get to Alexanderpltz station but we got the bus around the corner, then the Sbahn and then the Ubahn, as you get used to it i guess you can go around faster ways, but even though it might seem like a long ride i don't regret it for a second since you wouldn't be getting this kind of amenities in the center of Berlin for such a good price and being there i was able to experience and see the real life of the people in Berlin and it's not that the vibrant people isn't real but in the outskirts you get to feel the different transitions in the people from the raving and radish crowd to the working people and the families. The house itself is spotless clean, the pool is really nice hangout in the summer days after a night out in Berlin, the tv in the living room has Netflix for the calm nights, the kitchen has all the appliances needed, it was sad that nor me or my girlfriend know how to cook, and there is a Lidl supermarket and and a real Italian trattoria (if you go ask for mr Horacio) only at a 10 min walk. But all of that is topped only by mr Rochus hospitality and attention to detail, so i have nothing but gratitude for him, i hope to come back when all the garden remodelation is done, i don't want to extend too much, but i guess it's already late for that, hopefully my review helps decide to stay here and the people that already been here agrees with me.

The good: The location of Robin's place is absolutely perfect. We loved the neighbourhood, and the view over the church from the roof terrace is gorgeous. There are so many amazing bars and restaurants nearby, and it really feels like you're living in Berlin as a local, not just a tourist. Robin has great recommendations for things to see nearby. It was very quiet and the check in process was super easy. It was great to have a washing machine and an elevator as well! The place is well-laid out and a good size for a couple.
The less-good: Unfortunately, there were a few things that made this stay difficult for us. One was that the fridge wasn't working, meaning all the food we bought spoiled and we weren't able to keep anything cold. Robin was away and not quickly responsive to this. Apparently they had been having issues with it but we weren't informed of such. It was also extremely hot in the apartment, and there is no fan or AC (which is common throughout Germany, so we weren't surprised, but it would be nice to have a fan). There were major storms while we were there which meant we couldn't leave the windows open, so it was very difficult to sleep. Additionally, the blinds to the roof terrace (which is lovely) broke while we were there, so we couldn't access the terrace for two days. There was a lot of personal stuff around - clothing, stuffed animals, books, etc, with no place to store or hang clothes or put suitcases, so I wouldn't recommend it for a longer stay.
Overall, we loved the neighbourhood and the roof terrace (when we could access it), but the apartment could do with a bit of upkeep. Hopefully those issues will be fixed soon!

3. Self-check in: ideia excelente, mas bem complicado para quem chega à noite ou se estiver chovendo. A caixa não abre facilmente, precisei chamar pessoas e várias não conseguiram, até que após muita insistência ela se abriu. 4. Camas de solteiro: algumas madeiras de sustentação estavam quebradas e os colchões eram péssimos. Afundaram, porque são muito finos, mesmo para as pessoas magras que usaram.
São ajustes simples que tornarão a estadia perfeita.

Amazing place to stay in Berlin. I spent 3 days in the city and I really enjoyed it. Clean and comfortable.
One of my favourite AirBNB places I have stayed in.  Really comfortable beds, excellent facilities, Nespresso machine and a mini bar.....all packaged with very funky decor.

Schöne Unterkunft, entspannt geeignet für 2-3 Personen, in unmittelbarer Nähe des Müggelsees, mit hinreichend Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, zahlreiche Outdoor-Aktivitäten möglich, ruhige Lage, daher jedoch weitere Anreise bis ins Stadtzentrum. Wer gerne außerhalb Berlin genießt, der ist hier gut aufgehoben! Zur Erkundung der Seen per Boot optimal!

Bei Bianka war es wunderbar gemütlich und schick eingerichtet! Die Wohnung ist ruhig und zentral gelegen und es war genau die richtige Unterkunft für uns! Ich würde diese Unterkunft jederzeit wieder mieten.
Eigentlich ein schönes Zimmer. Ein paar Sachen sollten aber mal festgezogen werden.
We found this place to be perfect for exploring the city. A fascinating area to walk around and a cosy place to return to as the winter night closed in.
Very nice place, clean and cozy.
Everything good and matches the price.
Friendly and helpful hosts, at your service anytime. Safe, quiet and enjoyable neighborhood, full of small bistros and very close to a train station.

Really very nice lodging, set in a really peaceful garden. The interior is very neat and simple. we found all kinds of amenities. Ursula very helpful for any information about the house. There is also a window on the ceiling from which light comes in the morning, it is really hard to get out of bed so comfortable under the covers. Highly recommended
I had a great stay at Etienne's house. Flat was clean and cozy, room was very spacious with a beautiful balcony.  Etienne was very hospitable and kind. I can't wait to come back!

O anfitrião (Marco) foi extremamente solícito e o check in ocorreu sem problemas. O local é rodeado de verde, e muito tranquilo. O quarto tinha tudo que eu precisava, e estava limpíssimo. O bairro é extremamente charmoso (charme berlinense), repleto de opções gastronômicas e atrações culturais. O hotel fica bem próximo ao metrô e à outros meios de transporte. Super recomendo. Muito obrigada, amei a estadia :).
셀프체크인 건물 밖에 럭키박스 있어요. 처음에 럭키박스 찾느라 약간 고생한거 말고는 대부분 만족했습니다. 근처에 코인세탁소, 대형마트, 식당, 카페같은 곳이 가까이에 있어서 정말 좋았습니다.

El alojamiento de Marc fue perfecto para nuestra estancia en Berlín. Ubicado en un barrio muy tranquilo a la vez que repleto de tiendas, supermercados y locales donde poder disfrutar de la gastronomía y de una buena cerveza. Muy cerca de la estación, lo que facilitó enormemente nuestros desplazamientos por la ciudad.
El apartamento en sí es genial. Aunque sea un bajo y las ventanas estén a pie de calle, el ruido no nos supuso un problema en absoluto. En él se crea un ambiente que te hace estar totalmente cómodo, y la limpieza era impecable.
Nos trataron con muchísima amabilidad desde el principio, pendientes de cualquier necesidad y siendo muy flexibles siempre.
Es un alojamiento de 10!

Le logement de Kristian est très bien situé. Il y’a de nombreux restaurants et magasins aux alentours.
Nous avons pu nous rendre à pieds au centre de Berlin en 10 minutes.
L’appartement est charmant et bien entretenu. La chambre qui donne sur la cour intérieure est calme et le salon va aussi très bien pour deux enfants (le canapé est avec deux lits que l’on peut séparer) . Il y’a suffisamment de place pour une famille de 4 personnes.
Nous recommanderons facilement cet appartement pour nos amis.
Awesome central place! Highly recommend

Nous avons été ravis de notre séjour. L'appartement est grand et très cosy. Idéalement situé, proche des transports pour aller dans plusieurs directions et proche de supermarchés et de bars/ restaurants. L'appartement est calme et confortable. Nous remercions notre hôte pour son accueil et ses indications. Cela a facilité nos vacances.
Hat alles gepasst

We had an absolutely fantastic time here! We came with the whole family from California for a wedding and ended up spending a lot of time with relatives and friends in the apartment because the location is superb and there is sooo much space. My teenage daughter slept in the room with the red curtains and said that it was her "dream room". Communication and check-in was easy,  wifi fast, the neighborhood absolutely lovely,  and the hosts super nice. I will think back to our time there with very fond memories - I recommend.
My parents stayed here in October 2021 for the second time while they visited Berlin. The apartment and location is perfect and the hosts, Julia & Ian, were absolutely wonderful.
Loved it here! Fab location, so clean and had everything you need.
Great host and a nice stay in a very convenient location. Would definitely stay again!
Desde el primer momento la comunicación con Sabine fue muy fluida !! Sabine es súper hospitalaria!!
Haben uns sofort wohl gefühlt. Tolles Apartment in toller Lage. Wir haben ein Konzert im Velodrom besucht und waren in weniger als 5 Minuten zu Fuß dort. Sehr zu empfehlen!

Sehr empfehlenswert!! Alles top von Kommunikation beim Checkin bis Raum große und Sauberkeit. Sehr viel Asiatische Restaurants in der Nähe.
Werde ich nochmal machen!
Alles wie erwartet. Kommt für den nächsten Besuch definitiv nochmal in Frage.

Staying at Marie's beautiful apartment was a proper treat! The apartment is located ideally for exploring the city and it was equipped with everything (and more!) that we needed for a holiday of 8 nights. During our stay the house was very quiet and quite cool even during hot summer days which meant that we got a good sleep every single night.
The neighborhood is nice with shops to see and restaurants to eat in and public transportation is only a few minutes walk away, right around the corner.

Communication worked flawlessly and Marie was ready to help us with recommendations and making sure everything was ok.
I would definitely recommend staying at Marie's, she will make it easy for you :)

----
Kaunis, siisti ja hyvin varusteltu taitelijan asunto oikein hyvällä sijainnilla.
Metro ja ratikka (useita linjoja) parin minuutin kävelymatkan päässä. Kivoja kauppoja ja runsas valikoima ravintoloita lähikatujen varsilla.
Kommunikointi Marien kanssa oli todella helppoa, ja hän oli joustava, avulias ja käytettävissämme tarvittaessa. Suosittelen lämpimästi, sopii myös pitkäaikaisempaan majoitukseen hyvin!

Appartement très agréable et convivial, aux pièces indépendantes les unes des autres, très pratique avec son magasin d'alimentation juste en face et la station Fridenau à 5 minutes... Mais il faut savoir qu'il faut monter à pied 4 étages et demie...

호스트 Wibke가 친절해요.
호스트는 좋아요! 글언데 땰인지 뉴균지 모루갯는대 암튼 칭규들 대랴와서 노zH 엄청 크게 틀어놓고 엄청 쿵쾅거리고 걸어다니고 문 쾅!!!쾅 닫고 Lㅏ한테 호 ㅏ 났나 싶어서 있는 ㄴHㄴH 눈ㅊ1 엄청 봄. 인ㅅrㅎH도 씹어용~
그리구 온 ㅂ6 천지에 먼zl가 가~득!!!!!!
거ㅁ1줄도 마나용!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
버zㅕ진 ㅂ6인줄 알았어요.^^
화장실이 넓어서 좋았어요. 위치도 좋아요.

We hebben een fijn verblijf gehad in het appartement. Het komt overeen zoals beschreven. Rustig appartement in een levendige omgeving. Het heeft een fijn bed, fijne badkamer en douche, en prima uitgeruste keuken.

Alles hat prima geklappt. Die Wohnung ist zentral gelegen und ruhig.
Es können ohne weiteres 6 Personen dort schlafen. Wir waren zu zweit und hatten nur eine Nacht Zeit. Deshalb war der Preis etwas hoch

I had a wonderful stay! The place was spotless and well-maintained. Sarwah was incredibly friendly and welcoming. The view from the apartment was fantastic. Additionally, public transport and a supermarket were just a short walk away, making it very convenient. Highly recommend!
Parfait appartement pour un séjour à Berlin ! Proche des principaux transports en commun et appartement très propre.

Denny’s apartment was wonderful, sadly the bedroom I wanted didn’t have the bed made and was missing the fitted sheet which was disappointing as we were still paying for the entire apartment so I’m not sure why they chose which bedrooms to make available to us.
The pillows are also terrible! Luckily myself and my friend brought pilllows with us but even with down feather pillows, there’s zero head support.
On the plus side, the bathroom was very spacious and great for myself and my two friends. The water pressure in the bathroom is also excellent! The kitchen was very easy to use - it had some cool coffee machines (we wish we’d bought oat milk with us!) and after some experimenting the system for lighting and heating was clear and simple :)
My only note about the location is that we found it difficult to find a local grocery store but otherwise it was very close to the train station and easy to get around :)
Great location and our kids loved hanging out at the pool and sauna. Hosts were absolutely amazing!! Highly recommend!!

The place itself is very nice and near the Warschauerstraße S and U-Bahn station. The only thing we didn’t like were some other guest who were really noisy in some nights which prevented us to get a restful sleep. But overall a nice place to stay.
Great stay and great location

The apartment was lovely, well run, and the hosts were very friendly and helpful.
The only issue my group had was that we weren't informed of how to dispose of our rubbish, there is a bin shed next to the main entrance but we didn't have a key for it. As a result we had several bags of rubbish on the last day which we didn't know what to do with.
Other than that it's in a great central location for tourists, we had a fantastic time and were very comfortable.
Alles super, nur hätten wir gerne 5 einzelne Bettdecken gehabt. Diesem Wunsch wurde nicht nachgekommen. Dennoch absolut empfehlenswert

Excellent pre-arrival communication.
Super location of the flat -- very convenient to all major sites by either foot or by metro.
Check-in / out organization is flawless, especially with the locked cupboard system for storing luggage post check-out.
I will definitely keep this address handy for my next visit to Berlin -- thanks!

The location is brilliant and the apartment is even far nicer than the photos. Great if you have children as loads of toys and child safe too! You can feel its a home loved and lived in with a fully equipped kitchen- and nice details- great aesthetic.  Easy in and out, fast communication with hosts and well looked after. This is my goto Berlin spot!
Sehr schöner Aufenthalt in sehr zentraler Lage. Danke Lilly!

The apartment is in a lovely area with lots of great bars, restaurants and shops nearby plus very easy transport links to the centre. We picked up the key from the bar with no problem at all and were made to feel at home. The apartment is situated in a quiet building back from the main road, and, as many other reviewers have said, although the outsides of the buildings are run down, the apartment itself is new, spacious and spotless with everything you need. There were three of us and we used the sofa-bed which was large and comfortable. We easily found our way round the city, with trams and U-bahn nearby, it's also lovely to walk around the immediate area and it's walking distance to the Berlin Wall Memorial.

Die Ankunft bei Mi Kyung und Bert verlief freundlich und reibungslos. Tolle Empfehlungen zum essen, sowohl tagsüber, als auch Abends.
Ansonsten war die Unterkunft wie beschrieben, top ausgestattet und sauber.
Das Bad könnte wegen der Schrägen für Personen über ca. 1,85cm zum Problem werden.
Ich würde die Unterkunft jederzeit wieder für meinen Aufenthalt in Berlin buchen.
Bis zum nächsten mal.
Alles super
Located in a very nice and quiet area with good acces to public transportation, units are sizeable and comfortable

Die Unterkunft liegt direkt an der Rummelsburger Bucht. Sie ist extrem gemütlich und gut ausgestattet. Sie hat eine süße Terrasse und eine Bank vor dem Haus. Die Ausstattung ist sehr hochwertig und die Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin hervorragend! Uneingeschränkt empfehlenswert.

Wonderful place and host always ready to help! We spend a fabulous weekend feeling as if we were at home.
We absolutely recommend it for families with children or big group of friends. Apartment is enormous has a great big table that gathers all in one place to celebrate family breakfast.
And everything you need to prepare a dish is there!
Tram 5 min walk, nice park with very pleasant cafe just around the corner.
Best place to be in Berlin :) thank you Alke!
Tolle Unterkunft, wie beschrieben, Danke für den reibungslosen Ablauf.

Sehr gute Anbindung zu den Öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Bushaltestelle in unmittelbarer Nähe. Die Wohnung war praktisch Eingerichtet. Es war in der Küche alles vorhanden, was man so Tag täglich brauchte. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Kommen gerne wieder.

Naomi’s apartment is lovely, with nice furnishings, beautiful floors, & tall ceilings & windows. The kitchen has all essentials, bathroom is roomy & well stocked. We suggest that guests be aware that they must be able to climb 4 flights of stairs & the apartment door lock-a combination- can be a challenge & may need practice. We liked the location-close to U Bahn & tram & the main train station. Easy walks to major sights & museums. Some good restaurants close by. Enhanced our stay to Berlin.
Toller Aufenthalt. gerne wieder
Gute Lage, viel Platz, unkomplizierte Kommunikation, gerne wieder!
It was definately one of the best hestels ive ever been in. Beautiful place indeed, location is also perfect. 5 max 10 minute walk tu Alexanderplantz. I would recommand this to everybod.
Appartamento come da foto. Pulito e confortevole. Ottima posizione per visitare la citta'. Tanja e' molto gentile e disponibile. Consigliatissima :))
War alles gut und sowie beschrieben. Kommunikation auch gut

Nous nous sommes sentis très bien dans le bel et grand appartement de Michael où nous avons passé une semaine en famille. L'appartement n'est pas situé au coeur de Berlin, mais est très bien desservi par les transports en commun. L'accès est direct par la ligne S45 depuis l’aéroport de Schoenefeld. La possibilité de garer des vélos dans la cours de l'immeuble est un plus. Commerces et Biergarten disponibles à 5 minutes à pied.
L'appartement est grand et très bien équipé pour faire la cuisine. Il dispose également d'un équipement de premier plan au niveau audiovisuel (home cinéma, etc...) avec des documents clairs en expliquant le fonctionnement.
Nous gardons un très bon souvenir de notre séjour chez Michael.
Nádherný zrekonstruovaný byt se skvělou dopravní dostupností. S majitelem komunikace rychlá a bez problému. 100% doporučuji
The apartment is so wonderful! Very stylish and clean, and Fadeih was really easy to deal with. Loved our stay!

Stephanie's place was the perfect location. It is right by a lot of restaurants, coffee shops, and the mall. It is also by the Alexanderplatz. The room was super clean and it even smelled nice! Stephanie was fast with response and made our trip as smooth as possible. Definitely recommend anyone who's coming to Berlin!
Alles super, vielen Dank
Thank you, Nicola, for your hospitality.

Trovo la soluzione offerta molto positiva. Lo spazio è piccolo ma per una persona sola molto vivibile e accogliente. Bello e comodo il balcone, un terrazzino che in estate diventa un'estensione dello spazio abitabile, uno sfogo da godere e prezioso per la luminosità del minuscolo monolocale.
Unico appunto alla struttura, mancano indicazioni chiare in merito allo smaltimento dei pur minimi scarti quotidiani.
Il prezzo penso sia buono, certo per 11 gg incide abbastanza...
Nice place, as expected.

I absolutely loved my room, the building’s style, and the overall energy of this place. Surprisingly, I slept even better than in my own home—something that rarely happens when I travel!
This was my first time staying in an Airbnb with shared spaces, and I’ll admit, I was initially a bit concerned about how we’d coordinate using them. But everything was always tidy and well-organized. Tanja even let me know her shower schedule in the mornings, making it easy for us to adjust and avoid any inconvenience.
The location was fantastic—close to the S-Bahn and bus stop. I also loved that there were so many great restaurants and cafés nearby, from Italian and Greek to Vietnamese. Perfect for when you're too tired to venture far but still want a great meal!
Tanja is a kind, calm, and helpful host—and, I imagine, an amazing cook. I didn’t get to try her food, but the lasagna she was making smelled absolutely delicious!
If I ever return to Berlin, I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again!
Niovi fue increíble! El apartamento es ideal y en un barrio único de Berlín. Si volvemos a Berlín, volveremos a su apartamento sin ninguna duda
very cosy appartment. Easy communication. Great transport possibilities
Die Wohnung ist wunderschön und sauber, viel besser als erwartet. Die Lage ist sehr Zentral.
zeer fijn appartement! aanrader

Εξαιρετική τοποθεσία και άνετο σπίτι για έξι βράδια για τέσσερις ενήλικες
Μπορείς να πας παντού με τα πόδια
