Σχεδόν τέλεια διαμονή ευχαριστούμε θα σας συστήσουμε

The apartment is very clean and modern in a beautiful renovated old building right next door to a lovely old church. You can walk to the main attractions from there or use the U underground which is right outside the apartment.
Boian and Olga are lovely and very helpful. They provide you with milk, juice, bread, croissants, cheese and ham for your breakfast. Plus there is a coffee machine and plenty of tea choices.
It is easy to catch the train from the airport straight to Alexanderplatz and then walk or catch the tube for one stop.
We didn't find many restaurants nearby but there were plenty to choose from three stops north on the tube.
We had a great weekend in Berlin.

Good for the price we pay.  Though for noise-sensitive people like me to sleep at nights because of the pounding and mixing sounds from the bakery right below all night long. Andreas was quick and responsive

Nicolas place was lovely and we highly recommend it!
Me and my partner were looking for a cozy place to stay the weekend and we loved the rustic and homie vibes of the apartment. Besides that Nicolas was such a great host - he gave us recommendations for the days we were staying in the city and was so easy going from the moment we've booked with him.
We would definitely come back for our next travel in Berlin!

We found the apartment easily, it is well located close to the underground and within easy walk to local shops, restaurants and bars.  Lovely area and bright, clean apartment, outside roof terrace was fabulous for relaxing in the evening and for breakfast!  Gundula was a warm and welcoming host who went out of her way to help us make the best of our stay and time in Berlin. Would recommend this apartment to all and hope to return soon.
Alles wie beschrieben.

We stayed with 2 other friends at Aneres place for a 3-day trip in Berlin. it was a very cozy place and we felt like at home. Everything was as described and the communication was very good. The apartment is in a very good location, right next to a tram station, easy to explore Berlin from there. :)

Prachtige entree in het appartementen complex. Het is een heerlijk en ruim appartement om bij te komen van de stad. Fijne plek ook om zelf te koken en aan de ruime tafel te eten. Veel mooi design in het appartement en veel moderne kunst.
We stayed during a very cold week so Fritz managed to get us extra heating which was necessary, the apartment was great besides that and we enjoyed it.
Very nice apartment in the middle of Berlin. Clean, more than enough room and near the supermarket.

Very lovely spot in a quiet spot in a vibrant neighborhood! The hosts were very responsive and polite in their communications. good spot to catch local transport or walk around Berlin. Highly suggest!
Cozy and cute - and great location for exploring Berlin

Bettina und Thomas sind einfach die perfekten Gastgeber, sie und das ganze Haus verströmen eine sehr warme Atmosphäre. Das Zimmer ist ungemein gemütlich, mit Blick ins Grüne und mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht.
A nice apartment and nice host

Great location, well-served by public transport and easy to walk to places. Really helpful and friendly staff. The studio was really clean, good amenities and lovely and warm in a very cold city. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone.

Super gemütliches Appartment mit sehr guter Ausstattung und unschlagbarer Lage. Kommunikation und Check-In waren unkompliziert, der direkte Kontakt mit der Gastgeberin war immer sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Würden dieses Appartment wieder buchen.

Das Zimmer ist sehr gut eingerichtet. Die Ubahn ist direkt in der Nähe und man kommt von dort schnell überall hi. Einziges Makel ist, der Bürgersteig ist direkt hinter den Fenstern. Dadurch ist es laut und fühlt sich nicht sehr privat an.
Heerlijk terras, mooie locatie en de airco was super fijn met de hete dagen.
Gerne bald wieder!
Great hostel. Good location. Welcoming and helpful staff.
Ein ausreichendes Apartment, mit mühe eingerichtet. WC und Dusche sind getrennt, was nervig sein kann, aber auch irgendwo vertretbar ist. Alles in allem, eine kleine aber solide Wohnung.

Very well located apartment, minutes walk to Checkpoint Charlie. The apartment matches what it offers. Axel is very responsive and detailed in his descriptions. The house was very clean and had all the equipment we needed.

El lugar es una maravilla, esta en una zona bastante silenciosa y además bastante bonita. El apartamento contaba con todo lo necesario incluso para estancias largas. Lo recomiendo mil veces, gran lugar.
הדירה של ריהאנה יפהפיה ומטופחת, מאובזרת בכל מה שצריך. החדר עצמו גדול מאוד ומרווח עם הרבה אור. המיקום של הדירה מעולה, צמוד לתחנה של U עם גישה נוחה לכל חלקי העיר.

Pros:
- very clean and comfortable 
- nicely decorated
- cool old building with balcony
- well-outfitted and good internet
Cons: 
- Check-in: check-in was only possible 2.5 hrs after time indicated in the listing. Then I had to contact a third party outside of the AirBNB platform. Then this person was over an hour late on top.
-Don't stay here if sleeping in is part of your plans. I wear ear plugs regularly but the shrieking kids at the playground all morning were no match.
-Oven doesn’t work.

Die Apartments sind in einem sehr schönen Viertel und es gibt viel zu entdecken: Restaurants, Parks, Geschäfte etc. Trotzdem ist es sehr ruhig.
Hans-Jürgen ist ein sehr freundlicher und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber, der bei Fragen sofort reagiert.
In allem ein Ort von wo man Berlin prima erkunden kann.

We, 2 adults - 2 teenagers of 18 & 16 + baby of almost 1, visited Berlin for a week. This place was perfect for all: spacious and above all it was a real home. Welcome by Lajos was friendly and informative, and it was lovely to also meet Verena when we left. The location is convenient,and exactly as described by Verena: quiet, 2 minute walk to Sbahn and bus stop as well as a supermarket, small bakery and shop for veggies and fruit. A 4 minute walk to another supermarket and Florastrasse with nice places to drink coffee, a bookstore specialized in children's books (in fact there are a couple of shops specialized in kids items) and some breakfast/lunch/dinner locations. Bürgerpark is really nice with a location to drink and eat, it takes about 10 minute to walk. We were happy to park our car in the backyard and sit on the patio at the back of the house in the sun. At the moment I am home again and I feel lucky to experience Verena's house and it's location.

The Appartement is very nice and central as there are all important stations near and you can easily reach all parts of Berlin. It is small and minimalistic but totally comfortable and enough! It really felt like I was living there especially because Robert is/was such a friendly and  interesting host. He has a lot of stories to tell and can recommend amazing places to visit. Furthermore he cooks really good food and shares it with you!  I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely book it again! I had a great time!
房间在一个小院子里，从房间看向窗户外面很漂亮。厨房、卫生间、卧室都十分整洁。出门步行5分钟就是地铁站和电车站，出行很便利。重要的是，晚上这里很安静，我休息的很好。
Emplacement génial !

Overall, a comfortable stay in Moabit. I appreciate Ljuba's kindness and willingness to accomodate for me during my stay. I even ended up leaving a belonging and she was happy to mail it back to me. I do note that sometimes there were misunderstandings regarding house rules and order. I earnestly believe this was mostly due to a slight language barrier in communication. However, good effort was made on both sides to meet on common ground.

Hendrik’s studio is a great place to stay in Berlin. The kitchenette is very handy and the bathroom/laundry was very clean. It’s located just two stops from Berlins central station so can’t fault the location. Plenty of shops nearby too

Gehrads Gastfreundschaft und die tolle, sehr angenehme Wohnung sind genau richtig für ein paar Tage Aufenthalt in Berlin! Ich habe mich dort sehr wohl gefühlt!
Ich werde Gerhard auf alle Fälle weiterempfehlen!
Durch den herzlichen Empfang fühlte ich mich gleich wie zuhause. Würde sofort wieder hier buchen.
Eine wunderschöne Wohnung zum Wohlfühlen
Vielen Dank für die Flexibilität und freundliche Aufnahme!
beautiful apartments, and such friendly staff!
Great location in Kreuzberg near cafes

Schickes Zimmer in coolem Kietz
Wir haben ein verlängertes Wochenende bei Katja verbracht. Das Zimmer ist sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet und verfügt über ein separates Bad zur privaten Nutzung. Alles war sehr sauber und perfekt für uns vorbereitet. Die Kommunikation mit Katja war unkompliziert und immer sehr schnell. Wir haben uns super wohl gefühlt. In den Straßen ringsherum im Gräfe Kiez gibt es sehr gute internationale Restaurants, schöne Cafés und tolle kleine Läden.
Ein Tipp für Entdecker- abseits der Touristenpfade und doch mittendrin!
Eine sehr schöne Wohnung, sehr geräumig und hell, immer wieder gerne!

Kan varmt anbefale denne lejlighed. Super stille så pænt og rent. Ser ud som på billederne. Nød virkelig den lille altan ud til en stille gård. Meget imødekommende vært med sent udtjekning og hele tide sikrede sig vi havde det nemt og godt. Tak for din dejlige måde at være vært på.

Super sauberes und neuwertiges Appartement. Einziger Makel: Die Lage ist zwar etwas außerhalb aber es befindet sich direkt davor eine Straßenbahn Haltestelle.
Wir würden es immer wieder buchen!

"O apartamento do Frederic e muito agradável ,espaçoso ,e bem equipado, muito bem localizado .Frederic nos deixou todas informações praticas para puder aproveitar da melhor forme possível nossa estadia em Berlim.
Recomendo este lugar sem restrições .
This was a great place to stay - easy check in process

Die Tür machte jedoch einen soliden Eindruck und auch nachts war es insgesamt sehr ruhig, sodass wir sorgenfrei geschlafen haben.
Mindestens zwei Lichtschalter in der Wohnung hatten jedoch keine Abdeckung, die ohne Lampenschirm hängende Glühlampe im Schlafzimmer funktionierte nicht, die einzige Steckdose im Badezimmer funktionierte nicht, einige Armaturen im Badezimmer waren teilweise wackelig, die Fenster am Bett gehen leider Richtung Innenhof, in dem alle Mülltonnen standen (dementsprechend roch es, wenn das Fenster lange offen war) - ansonsten gab es bis auf das kleine Kippfenster über der Tür keine weiteren Fenster. Außerdem hatten wir keinen Mobilfunkempfang innerhalb der Wohnung.
Wer mit diesen Abstrichen leben kann, der wird in Julius Airbnb auf jeden Fall glücklich werden und dem kann ich dieses zentrale Airbnb weiterempfehlen.

I have traveled to smth like 30 countries, and this place may well be among very best stays I ever had. It is stylish, cozy, well-designed and equipped with truly necessary and well-fitting things that create special atmosphere - a log-burner, a radio with sound system mounted on the wall, some nice furniture, bookshelves. I mean, it is not luxury at all, but for me there is some magic in this place that makes you feel like home.
Also, I could hardly wish for a better location - it is not far from the city center, and at the same time you have a truly private space - 30 meters of water between you and people in the city. No neighbors behind the wall, no traffic noise, just the sound of waves and your own houseboat and pier. It is ideal for a couple's romantic weekend.
Finally, the host, Martin, is very quick-responding and helpful, I really appreciated that.
Strongly recommend to anyone going to Berlin as a tourist.
P.S.: I may only make a note that when booking this place, one should be realistic in his/her expectations from this place. I mean, do not expect it to have 5-star hotel amenities, and be mindful that getting to it and living in it demands some very basic skills - like handling a paddle-boat, binding it to the pier, making a fire in the log-burner, etc.
With realistic expectations, this place is truly unmatched in terms of value for money - and memorable experiences :)

Elisa is a responsive host with lots of information. My family and I enjoyed staying in her apartment and had everything we needed! This place is in an amazing location with U-Bahn very nearby and lots of shops and restaurants.

Paulo and Guido were the loveliest hosts! Their rooftop apartment was the most picturesque spot I've ever stayed in the city, so well located and easily accessible by public transport. The flat is exactly as described, located in a really great part of Berlin, with a lot of good restaurants very close to the apartment (we liked the mazel tov, where we could have a nice meal after 10 pm).
Britta is really reactive and very flexible for checkin and checkout, that made our organization very simple.
I recommend this flat for everyone (we were only two, but the flat is large enough for 4 people).

Eine super Wohnung, entspricht den Bildern. Sauber, tolle Ausstattung.
Netter Kontakt mit dem Vermieter.

All in all our experience was good. The place is comfortable and clean except for stains all over the rugs/carpeting. We felt comfortable and at home. The location is good and quiet. The closet is huge and the shower was nice.

Great big apartment in a hip neighborhood! Check out Simon-Dach-Straße. Apartment is at 150m of the tram stop and about 2 stops from the subway. Also there used to me a chimney so when the wind blows hard there is a bit of an old wood fire smell. Again nothing to be afraid of, just open the windows a bit. There are 2 mezzanines with beds, the kids found it fantastic!
Fint sted, men der manglede toiletpapir en aften og vi fik kun et sæt håndklæder udleveret og en dårlig hovedpude.

It was a nice stay. However it is bit far from the Centre. Although train station was nearby and connections were frequent. It is in the ground floor so not much sunlight. Overall good for the price. Recommended.

Wonderful apartment in a great neighborhood, walking distance to many restaurants, parks, and other attractions.  The apartment is very comfortable with great light.  Josephine is a very nice and responsive host.  We would love to stay there when we return!
Wirth the money

Wir haben uns bei Katarina sehr wohlgefühlt und kommen gerne wieder. Sehr nette Gastgeberin. Absolut empfehlenswert.

El dueño es muy atento y te contesta en muy breve tiempo a cualquier duda.

Ella and her home couldn’t be lovelier. Her apartment is so quiet, yet central location-wise and clean, beautiful and inviting, comfort-wise. My fiend and I had an ideal stay in a truly lovely home. We both felt completely at home and truly appreciate Ella for being so gracious. Thank you, Ella!

Staying at Barbara's apartment was perfect for our first trip to Berlin. She greeted us and gave us a tour of her place on our first day -- the apartment is even better than the pictures! It was our first time using Airbnb, and this experience exceeded my expectations. Everything we needed was there: shampoo, conditioner, soap, towels, bedding, etc etc, even a bottle of wine. The neighborhood is cute and quiet. We were able to get everywhere we wanted to in Berlin very easily as the public transportation is very close to the apartment. Definitely a wonderful stay!
Alles wie beschrieben, haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt in der Zeit.
Was lovely!

Logement confortable et bien équipé. Quartier calme. Petits commerces dans le hall de la gare sur ligne S dont le réseau permet d’explorer Berlin facilement. La proximité les lacs et forêts et un bonheur pour le sport ou la méditation.
Thiago was a great host - so kind and thoughtful. He and his place made my stay in Berlin special.

The Host took care of a very warm welcome. Quick and clean Communication.
Nice that you also took care of some details, like olive oil, salt and pepper, tea, coffee, soap and so on!
Everything was clean and we felt safe in this CoVid 19 time.

Wonderfully roomy place with lots of space, great utilities on site, fantastic central location near public transportation. Will look for this place first the next time we are in Berlin!

This is the 4th or 5th time I've stayed at one of Kathrin's places and it's always great.  Not only is everything as advertised, but she is very responsive if I need a little something or other (e.g. a desk lamp for working).  A super place to stay!

There are  a lot of stairs to climb to this room. The accommodation is light and modern. The location is great with Queensway only a few minutes walk away. There is only a few cooking utensils, if you plan to prepare food  to eating-in.
Extremely convenient place for those with tight budget. 🥳
Alles war gut. Sehr komfortabel.

I had a lovely stay at Jerome’s place.
The neighborhood felt safe and was convenient for both quickly grabbing takeout or for a sit down meal at one of the many restaurants in the area. I’d definitely recommend Cafe Backerei for a quick breakfast—the food was great and well priced and the staff was so friendly and helpful. There’s even the most adorable free book sharing station right on the corner.
The home was exactly as described & pictured. The room was comfortable and clean— as was the rest of the shared spaces (kitchen, bathroom).
I really appreciated the host’s ability to be flexible with the check-in time, as I was able to arrive right after my flight landed.
I would absolutely stay here again when I’m in the area. 10/10 would recommend. Thanks for the stay!
Ambra's place was amazing and would love to come back to stay there again. I highly recommend!

Large space, well laid out. Great place to stay for a few days.
Close to Tegel airport. While being north of central Berlin, easy to get there with plenty of public transport options nearby.
Alles gut, für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in einem einfachen, sauberen Hotel zu empfehlen.

Was really but really amazing place:) I love it a lot! Cosy, warm, clean and very good locaiton, walking distance to KaDeWe, just cross the street like 20m organic market, if you walk like 100m then huge market, with many items. Cool place, funky, warm, insteresting. Clean. Again, I love it.

Bad value for money. We felt uncomfortable because our bedroom was in the 3th floor and to acces to our bedroom we needed to across their study hall. There was no key for our bedroom. Also our bed and blankets were little and not comfortable. Concerning the location, it was far from the city center , so we needed to take 2 vehicles. But even so the bus and tram station were near to home. However owners were kind and helpful,for example they allowed us to check in earlier than the appointed time.
Angelika’s place was lovely and just what we needed. Would stay again. Good communication and friendly.

Very convenient location close to public transportation amazing food near by.

Sabine was an excellent host, so I recommend her and her accommodation.

Hardi is a nice person, very friendly, he give us ease in time to check in and a lot of help.

Great place to stay, worth the price, fit 6 of us very well and was comfy.

In the end we took the risk of an 80 euro fine and just parked outside.
Can’t wait to stay here again! It’ll remain on my saved search whenever I’m in Berlin. :)

4/5 stars. Great place, easy to check in/out. Very clean. However, communication was lacking, you are often speaking to a robot instead of a person which makes it difficult when you have issues you need to discuss, often times the issues won't be dealt with until the next morning. The wifi was HORRIBLE! If you stay here make sure you have a good service plan because the wifi could not be used for any phone calls/web searching.
Easy to transit around.

Location, location, location....Maria’s apartment is close to everything, train station, restaurants, bakeries, and the Friedrichstadt-Palast and the end of the street. We rebooked Maria’s apartment for our recent stay.
Host was really nice and everything went well. The place was bigger than expected!
Die Wohnung war sauber und geräumig, die Kommunikation sehr gut. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel war ebenfalls sehr gut.
Lovely apartment that made me feel like home. I wouldn't hesitate to stay there again!

Sven is great. Our flight home was delayed by a day, and he was able to get us into another property in the same building on very short notice, for that additional night's stay, including sending an associate to walk us over.
The property is just like in the pictures, and is very conveniently located.
Clean as a whistle.

War ein toller Aufenthalt bei Horst und Sabine.
Alles da was man braucht, die Gastgeber sind sehr zuvorkommend und hilfreich, die Lage ist gut :)

The stay in Diarmaids studio apartment was pure pleasure, the place was very well equipped at the back of the building - very quiet! You couldn't say you were in the city. It was very comfortable also - the best mattress I have slept in Airbnb equal to 5 star hotel mattress! I was working from the studio and it had an amazing atmosphere for me to concentrate and do my work - very good aura! The place was very warm despite -5 outside. The final bonus was Netflix, after hard day working I could watch my favourite series! Amazing! 5 stars without any doubt! Highly recommended!
Hat alles super gepasst, fein und gemütlich - empfehle es jeden :)

Einfach eine geile Unterkunft in super Lage, 20 min mit s Bahn zu eigentlich allen highlights die man sehen muss.
Kommunikation reibungslos und Sehr nett.
Würde ich immer wieder buchen
Great place - stylish and well appointed apartment. Great location, and very nice host!

Unser Aufenthalt war super, total unkompliziert. Wir hatten ein Baby und einen Hund dabei auch für die beiden war alles da.
Freue mich auf ein nächstes Mal :)

For a fairly expensive listing the lack of amenity that resulted from heavy immediate traffic noise almost around the clock was a real problem.
So too a failure to provide basic extras in kitchen and bathroom - of the kind that is standard in Air BNB - was surprising and regrettable.

Die Lage der Wohnung ist für einen Citytrip optimal. Alles alltägliche ist in kürzester Zeit zu Fuß erreichbar. Die Wohnung selbst ist großzügig geschnitten und gut ausgestattet. Vor allem die Spielzeug-Ausstattung ist besonders hervorzuheben! Wir waren mit 3 Kindern im Alter von 6 Monaten bis 1,5 Jahren da und alle waren begeistert. Die Kommunikation war einfach und immer freundlich. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen! Danke für ein tolles Wochenende :-)

Alloggio perfetto per una settimana a Berlino in cortile interno tranquillo e ben collegato con i mezzi. Ampia offerta di supermercati e ristoranti nel quartiere. Host disponibile ed informazioni chiare!

Werner a été très accueillant et actif dans les échanges. L’appartement était très propre et correspondait aux attentes ! Le check-in était très flexible ce qui a été grandement apprécié !! Je recommande cet appartement à 100% !

Michele is a fantastic host. A really nice person. Quick to answer any calls/texts. Apt is great. Beds are so comfy which is great after a lot of sight seeing around Berlin! Apt is close to all public transport. Very easy get taxis too. Plenty of room around the apt and lovely and warm. I highly recommend
Le séjour s'est bien passe chez Robert.

I am an Airbnb host myself, who rents my home in the old-fashioned way. Rafaella was the same kind of host, and quite honestly, in many ways, this was one of the best Airbnbs I have ever stayed in. It was a home, and every amenity was available.
The location was great for getting around, with incredibly accessible transit. But best of all was Rafaella herself: warm, kind, thoughtful, generous, patient and more. She stayed up very late to make sure we reached her home and could be properly oriented. And then, she let us checkout a bit later than the official time. Rafaella you are a star- thank you so much for your wonderful hosting.

tout était parfait. mise à part la douche qui ne s evacuait pas . nous avons démonté le bouton et là  un paquet de cheveux bouchait l évacuation..sinon décoré avec goût, stationnement facile et gratuit dans la rue . en cuisine tout ce que nous avions besoin et j ai rarement vu des poêles  et casseroles aussi bien entretenu es
Really great room and in a great location!
Great experience

Me and my parents loved the place.
We hope we can come back some day…
Sehr freundliche und herzliche Begrüßung durch den Gastgeber.
No problem, nice, clean and close to centrum.

Die Unterkunft war sehr leicht zu finden und einfach zu erreichen. Sie war sehr geräumig und sauber und hatte alles, was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt braucht. Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war ebenso gut und er hat schnell geantwortet.
Wonderful clean and beautiful place! I highly recommend it, everything corresponds to the high level of service and cleanliness! Convenient location and pleasant service! Thank you very much!

Lovely spacious apartment in a fantastic location, lots of great bars and restaurants in the area and very close to transport links. The check-in experience was quick and easy and everything was explained well, would highly recommend!

Good apartment and very localisation!
A lot of restaurants and cafés directly on the same street.
Sehr zentrales, wunderbar gelegenes Appartment!

geräumige Wohnung, zweckmäßig eingerichtet.
unschlagbare Lage
Great location, nice neighborhood and relatively close to the centre of Berlin. Tidy, comfortable and peaceful.

Die Wohnung hat eine sehr gute Lage zur Ubahn und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. Im Haus befindet sich ein Bäcker, sodass man nicht weit für sein Frühstück laufen muss. Bei der Wohnungsübergabe haben wir wertvolle Tipps von Jens bekommen. Auch die Restaurants im Viertel sind sehr zu empfehlen.
Die Wohnung war sauber und völlig ausreichend für uns 3 Personen.
Wir werden gern wiederkommen.

Great place to stay with family and friends, they offered more than we spected.
Great location
Host very accessible to are questions.
Sehr sauber, aufgrund von Corona leider kein Frühstück
Modern hotel-style room in modern building with hotel reception

L'appartement correspond précisément au descriptif et aux photos. L'immeuble est très bien tenu.
La terrasse donnant sur la Spree est un plus indéniable.
L'accès au centre de Berlin est simple même s'il faut compter environ 45 minutes. Bus au pied de l'immeuble, trains et trams à 10-15 mn.
Nous n'avons pas rencontré Bianca cependant elle a répondu rapidement à nos demandes et les instructions qu'elle avait laissées étaient claires.

Merci beaucoup à Douglas pour ce super séjour ! Il est très réactif et prêt à nous aider : le premier soir nous avons remarqué que le wifi ne marchait plus, et le lendemain il est venu nous aider et le problème a été directement réglé !
L’appartement était propre et ressemblait exactement aux photos. A 15 minutes à pied de alexanderplatz.
Gerne wieder !:)

Appartement impeccable. Simple et fonctionnel. Personne à l’arrivée ni au départ. Tout se fait par message et par codes (pour les portes). Efficace mais manque le contact humain. Excellent rapport qualité prix. Appartement calme dans un quartier vivant.
Lo que es destacable es que está muy cerca de la U-Bahn y también a unos pasos pasa un autobús que te lleva a la estación central de tren o al aeropuerto.
Very good location, with nice alternative bars (we visited two of them). The place has a separate entrance from the building. The decoration had a very stylish vintage taste!

The flat is wonderful!  Bright, clean and so well stocked – the neighborhood is easy to get around with lots of restaurants, shops, bars and even a few grocery stores.  Both bus and trains are so easy to get to.  Walking up the 4 flights is worth it because the roof deck is an amazing place to have coffee or a glass of wine – great views of the city and the TV Tower!     I highly recommend this for anyone staying in Berlin.
Es hat mir sehr gefallen bei Tatjana. Die Wohnung ist groß, hell und gemütlich. Die beiden Katzen sind auch süß 😊. Wenn es sich ergibt komme ich gerne wieder.

J'ai passé un excellent séjour chez Soha, elle a toujours été disponible si j'en avais besoin et l'appartement est super. A noter que l'appartement est au quatrième étage sans ascenseur donc attention si vous avez beaucoup d'affaires comme moi. Autrement, le quartier est également agréable avec beaucoup de cafés/restos à proximité et l'appartement est bien desservi par les transports. J'y retournerais avec plaisir!

We loved Roman's place, it was nice and tidy, and quite fit the description, the place even had a balcony, which was a nice addition. The location was awesome for discovering Berlin. Unfortunately we were unable to meet him, but he was still very helpful, and he still helped us with everything he could over the phone. He even had a little map showing places for everyday needs (ranging from pubs to even hairdressers).

I would definitely recommend his place.

Mike ist ein sehr freundlicher und zuvorkommender Gastgeber. Wir haben uns von Beginn an sehr willkommen gefühlt. Das Zimmer ist sehr sauber und mit bedacht gestaltet, es wurde an alles gedacht-selbst Schlafmasken lagen für uns bereit. Herzlichen Dank nochmal für die Überraschung am Morgen und das bereichernde Gespräch. Es war für uns ein Geschenk bei einem so aufgeschlossenen, interessierten und kommunikativen Menschen zu Gast gewesen zu sein.  Unsere Erwartungen an einen entspannten Aufenthalt in Berlin wurden dadurch voll erfüllt. Sehr gern wieder!!

Großes Appartement, ruhig.
Ganz nah zur Tram- und Bushaltestelle.
Super tolle große Wohnung, die in Echt so ist wie auf den Bildern. Busse direkt vor der Haustür
Der Aufenthalt war in Ordnung.
Great location near to city lakes for swimming, walking and running

The room was clean and tidy with no dust or anything else to be found. I checked and everything was thoroughly cleaned. I had a small issue with the check-in, but otherwise it went smoothly. It is definitely worth the price. The area was quiet and both the subway and bus stops were within walking distance. I would definitely book it again.
Mir war klar, dass die Wohnung in einem Sozialbau liegt. Entsprechend klein ist die Wohnung,. doch der Balkon ist super und trotz straßenseitiger Lage nicht zu laut.

Very lovely place in a great location. The sleeping couch was a bit uncomfortable but they provided an extra matress which was great. Dan and Robert are very friendly and easy to communicate with. The apartment is such a great place filled with beautiful art pieces. Love it! Would book again immediately whenever I'm back in Berlin.

Super Wohnung mit echt geilem Fernseher !!!!!
Einzige was mit gefehlt hat waren kaffekapseln für die Kaffeemaschine 😅😅😇
Aber wollte eh meine Koffeinsucht bekämpfen und ich werte das einfach als Versuch mich dabei aktiv zu unterstützen.
Man kann Sebastian als Gastgeber uneingeschränkt empfehlen!!!!
War schon in vielen Air BnB 's aber unkomplizierter als bei Sebastian habe ich selten erlebt ,wir kommen gerne wieder.

Very very nice, cosy and quiet apartment near the metro station, supermarkets, restaurants, Charlottenburg garden. Very clean and well supplied with everything what you might need. Perfect transport accessebility.
We were delighted to stay here for 3 months. The attitude of Julia is wonderful! She is very kind, helpful and friendly, all we need was provided immediately. She really cares of her guests. We feel at home in the apartment.
Highly recommended!

Julia and her space are elegant, design focused and calming. I highly recommend staying here as it is a peaceful space with a gorgeous room available. I genuinely don’t think I’ve slept better in any other bed. Thank you for your kindness and hospitality Julia! Would stay here again and 100% recommend.

Eine tolle, helle, saubere Wohnung, in der wir uns sehr wohlgefühlt haben. Es ist alles vorhanden, was man so braucht und das Bett ist wunderbar weich und bequem. Die Wohngegend ist ruhig, aber Geschäfte und Restaurants sind alle fußläufig in wenigen Minuten erreichbar. Zu Fuß 3 Min. bis zur U-Bahn (Kaiserin-Augusta-Str.) und mit der Linie 6 ist man in 13 Min. im Zentrum (Unter den Linden). Der Kontakt mit Biggi hat bestens funktioniert, wir hatten ein paar schöne Tage in Berlin und würden die Wohnung jederzeit wieder buchen.

Der Empfang war sehr freundlich und dennoch unverkrampft. Das Zimmer und allgemein die ganze Wohnung war sehr sauber und hygienisch 1A. Reinhards Burger-Tipp (Berlin Burger International) war super; die Burger waren klasse :) !
Bei uns bleibt ein sehr guter Eindruck hängen. Beide waren sehr freundlich und zu keinem Zeitpunkt haben wir uns unwohl gefühlt oder hat es uns an etwas gefehlt.
Cheap at a good location!
Perfect apartment, perfect host!

Beautiful and sunny room
It is well said on the description that it’s a smoking apartment. As a non smoker the smell was intense but the room was well aired.
Good location, fairly clean and pet friendly.

Ute was very friendly ! We forgot something inside the flat after the key was given back and right away we got a reply with a solution ! Communication and check in were easy and friendly
The apartment was very nice and was a perfect location near public transport , restaurant and supermarket.
Would gladly stay here again !

We hebben een hele goede week in Berlijn gehad. Het appartement voldeed aan onze verwachtingen. Je kan wel zeggen dat het appartement van alle gemakken is voorzien. Verder is de locatie perfect. Het licht een een rustige wijk vlakbij een parkje waar de kinderen zich goed kunnen vermaken. Met het Metrostation op loopafstand, ongeveer 10 min lopen. Wanneer je een vraag hebt reageert Marc meestal binnen een paar uur, dat vonden we ook heel fijn. Het appartement beschikt over drie ruime slaapkamers en een ruime badkamer. In het appartement is ook rekening gehouden voor mensen die invalide zijn. Kortom als je met 5 a 6 personen naar Berlijn wilt dan raad ik je zeker dit appartement aan.

The apartment is super well located, close to public transport, restaurants and shops. It is on the top floor of the building and has a nice terrace. The hosts, Mariusz and Nina are very friendly and helpful. Highly recommended.

The location is really good. The host are super nice, helpful and very respectful!
I had a nice stay :)

If you are lucky enough to be in town when Hisar and Anne open their apartment, don’t hesitate to book a stay! Beautifully decorated, sunny and spacious, perfectly located, plus they are super cool hosts who graciously left me with an apartment that actually felt like a home. Perfect experience!
It was great stay in this apartment, everything on high level. Thank you once again
Très bel appartement, très confortable, et au calme. Emplacement pratique, proche des transports et avec les monuments de l’ile aux musées à proximité.

Our stay with Philipp and Nabil was very nice overall and exactly what we were looking for in terms of accommodation. The apartment had good connections to most everywhere we wanted to go in Berlin and could reliably get anywhere within 30 min or less. The area around the apartment also had some very nice cafes and restaurants.
The apartment itself was very clean and had a great living room. The beds were very comfortable and could definitely accommodate two people per bed.
The bathroom is quite small unfortunately and gets easily backed up with multiple people visiting the airbnb. The lock on the door was a digital keypad which made it easy to not have to carry a key around, but did offer some slight resistance at times. The building does heat up quite a bit in summer and unfortunately the projector isn’t very bright during the day due to big windows in the entrance area.
Overall would definitely recommend if you are looking for a little place away from home to call your own :)
Die Wohnung ist für zwei Personen perfekt geeignet. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt. Direkt um die Ecke gibt es einen Supermarkt sowie schöne Restaurants und Cafés.
The apartment was really nice  and it was very comfortable to accommodate 3 people. Francesco and his wife were very helpful too.

It was a good place to stay for the weekend. The hotel had a little bit of trouble with the cleaning and we had to wait almost one hour. Nevertheless, the staff was friendly. The room was clean but some spot were a little bit dirty and we missed a sponge. The hotel is in the center and it’s super convenient.
Immer wieder empfehlenswert!

We hadden een tweepersoonskamer die erg netjes was en een eigen keukentje had. Een heerlijk bed en een ventilator aanwezig. Voor een leuk wijkje moest je alleen wel even lopen of het ov nemen. We hebben wat geluidsoverlast ervaren door schreeuwende en bonken gasten. Jammer dat we daardoor enkele keren wakker zijn gemaakt tussen 02.00 en 04.00
great location. It is an extremely clean flat with all the necessities. Ulf helped me a lot including the transport and the attractions around the city. wonderful stay
Super! Bis zum nächsten Mal! :)

I am from LA and it was my first time to travel in Berlin. And did not regret booking this property. It was conveniently located to public transportation, grocery and restaurants. One of the homiest place that i have ever been , cleand and quiet. I felt local for couple of days. Gabriel and Ilye were both very helpful and accommodating. They responded quickly .
Waren nur für eine Nacht da, aber es war alles da was wir für diese Nacht brauchten. Alles Sauber, Küche gut, sowie das Bad mit der Dusche. Kann ich nur weiterempfehlen
The Hostel was great. It was clean, near to tramstation and the bar in the hostel was very affordable. I would recommend it to all who want travel for a low price!

Brigitte was responsive and everything went great. The listing looks as described and was perfect for my short stay!
Would highly recommend.
Ein kleines schnuckeliges Appartment genau am richtigen Platz in Berlin-Kreuzberg.
Great place and great location! Everything was amazing and clean would 100% stay here again

We liked this beautiful flat a lot, it is very clean and furnished in an almost artistic vintage way. We slept nicely on the large bed in a sweet alcove beside the window. From outside we only heard the birds, no traffic, no noise. The bathroom is quite a luxury. Christiane's roommate is very calm, we didn't see each other a lot. By the way - the house itself is a historical beauty!  Shops and bars are nearby, the station too.

Sehr unkompliziert und persönlich und trotzdem genug Privatsphäre. Sehr speziell und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Freundlicher Umgang, einfach ein schönes WG-Feeling. Habe mich rasch zu Hause gefühlt. Wer Katzen liebt, wird seine Freude haben: liebenswerte Vierbeiner. Alle Vorgaben seitens Gastgeberinnen sind von Anfang an klar. Geschätzt habe ich auch die Gegend, es ist einfach alles in Gehdistanz, was man so braucht. Ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen — Danke für diesen entspannten Aufenthalt!

Good location near restaurants and bars. Spacious but could have been cleaner. Description did not say we had two stove top rings. Kettle malfunctioned on the final evening, tripping off all of the electricity in the flat, the only cure being to disconnect the kettle, at least we had the stove top.
Excellent hotel

Ulla’s garden is a magical spot for a restorative getaway. So easy to get to from the city and lots of nature to enjoy. the cabin is lovely place to spend time, clean, comfortable, and chic! Thanks for your hospitality, Ulla!
Lovely apartment in a convenient location!
Great room in a cool location
A fantastic place and better than the pictures on the website. A great area to explore.

Everything was good. Lots of space, clean, new.
For a brief moment during the night, neighbors were a bit noisy.

very good experience, Volker is fast respond  and preparing everything you need in the apartment. the apartment is located in a very convenience place to take s Bahn. Room is clean, well equipped with everything.
Elektra’s is a very nice host. Her place is clean, quiet and spacious.

The room was tidy and comfortable with all what I needed for a night sleep. Hamdan was communicative and answered all my questions. So, overall - thank you for having me in your room, I had a good airbnb experience. The neighborhood and its location were a bit tough for a foreigner for a single night - hard to arrive from the central train station (by S bahn and a bus), and even harder to leave to airport (3 buses then an S bahn).
Good location, easy to find, a simple solutions for any stay, only road is a little noisey but didn’t really bother us
Great studio! Great host!

Simons place was perfect for us during our time in Berlin. The apartment is a 3 minute walk to the underground making it easy to get anywhere in the city and a 5 minute walk to a large supermarket. Simon is also a great host, making himself available to answer any questions at any time. Would definitely recommend staying here.

It was my first experience in an Airbnb single room. The best one had in all my entire Airbnb rental experience as a guest! Loved everything. 100% safe and 100% recommended. Everything amazing. Top rated!!!
Wir haben uns wie Zuhause gefühlt! :)
Comfy space, all useful amenities. Easy location for the ubahn and 20 min walk to major tourist locations. Good communication from the host.
I'd stay there again

My husband and I stayed here for two months in June, and I can’t imagine a better home base from which to explore Berlin. Very close to both U and S Bahns, loads of grocery stores nearby, and delicious restaurants all within a 15 minute walk. The apartment itself is the definition of charm. Absolutely gorgeous old world Berlin and with all of the modern conveniences. Elle was a wonderful host, responsive, kind and gracious. All in all, we couldn’t have asked for a better apartment or better hosts.
Lovely place in close to the centre of Berlin! Public transport is close and easy to use. I would recommend this appartment when you wanna stay in Berlin!

The shared kitchen and badroom is something to considera when looking privacy.
Everything else was super. The rooms are big, clean and organized.
Me hien is a very friendly host and will make everything in order for you to have a good stay.
Nice clean studio on an quiet and central location. Communications are pro-active.

Alan & Kasia had a great place. They provided a lot of great recommendations of what to do and were very helpful when we needed to check in a bit earlier.
The apartment would be great for a couple and is in a great location. There's also a courtyard that was great for us to store the bikes we rented for a few days.
Definitely a great place to stay!
clean convenient Berlin hotel
Nice place.

Einfach perfekt.  Ein sehr schönes Apartment.  Gut erreichbar mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Ruhige Gegend. In der Wohnung alles vorhanden, was man braucht. Volker hat auf alle Fragen sofort reagiert. Es hätte nicht besser sein können. Danke!
Super schönes Appartment!

Sehr saubere Unterkunft, gut ansprechbares Personal, geräumige Zimmer,
schöne Architektur durch den überglasten Innenraum.
Place was great - Henrik and Sven were very helpful and friendly. Apartment has a great feel to it, high ceilings and nice light. Also the neighborhood is fantastic. Couldn't recommend it more.
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour, le logement est top, nous recommandons!

Reservei sem expectativa ,pois os comentários que li antes ,não eram nada bons . Surpresa, tive num quarto ótimo com frigorífico, excelente limpeza e até o papel higiénico era bom . O edifício é antigo e o elevador também o é, o que não é nada de anormal e tem toda a segurança que outros têm. Está localizado a 1 minuto a caminhar até a estação de metro e numa excelente zona ,tanto para descansar como para restaurantes próximos.  Recomendo a 100 % a estadia aqui no W22.

Geräumiges Zimmer in den sehr unerwartet ruhigen Sarottihöfen.
Toll, dass ein Hund sehr unkompliziert mitkommen darf.

Marcel's a great host. With lots of experience in the business. Answers questions and helps you out if and when needed. Perfect for young workers and always careful about who stays. Overall a great stay !
Very nice apartment situated in a very nice part of Berlin.

Es hat alles ganz hervorragend geklappt! Axel und Anne haben eine ganz wundervolle Wohnung in perfekter Lage! Sehr ruhig im Seitenflügel gelegen, toll eingerichtet, sehr sauber und mit allem ausgestattet! Ich kann das Airbnb nur wärmstens empfehlen!

Ich war mit meinen Freunden zu siebt über ein Wochenende in Berlin. Die Unterkunft ist sauber, sehr einladend und gemütlich. Melanie hat sich super um uns gekümmert. Es wurden kostenlose Lebensmittel bereitgestellt und auf Anfrage konnten wir auch einen kostenlosen späteren check out bekommen. Ich kann diese Unterkunft nur Empfehlen! 😃

The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. It felt safe and secure. The apartment was very hot on our first day - thank goodness for the fan that was provided. Regardless, the first few nights the apartment was very warm which probably speaks more to climate change than the apartment itself, but perhaps more light-blocking blinds would have helped control the temperature during the day. Overall a very nice stay.

Super dejligt sted!
Meget rent
Internettet virkede super dårligt, så skulle bruge egen GB…. Som løb ret meget op i løbet af de dage vi var der.
Kun 1 enkelt viskestykke, opvaske svamp og skraldepose… det kunne der godt være brug for mere af… hvis man ikke spiser ude
Men alt i alt virkelig skønt sted til prisen!
Kæmpe anbefaling 😊

dato per 3 posti ma solo un letto per due, appartamento vecchio in disordine. il letto per due ha materasso sfondato e lenzuola sporche. tazze spaiate e sbriccate sensazione di sporco ovunque.
prenotato per una settimana abbiamo lasciato la casa dopo due notti.
peggior esperienza su arb&b

This place was perfect for me as I was solo traveling through Europe. My favorite aspect of this place is your were close to everything without being in the middle of everything.
A very unique place that was a lot of fun. Frank met with me and gave me the rundown of how everything worked.
Frank was a great host! Would love to come back next time I’m in Berlin.

Marcus offers a very nice place. The location in Mitte was ideal for my purposes of attending several concert events which I reached by U-Baun and S-Baun stations close by.
Lots of choices of food and coffee in the neighborhood
Finally, the apartment is a very cool loft with a good vibe- quiet for sleeping too.
I’d would definitely book this on my next trip to Berlin
Virkelig god hotel/lejlighed. Helt nyt, fint og rent. Masser af plads. Meget tæt på alt.

Anna’s place is perfectly located and great value for money. It was quite cold when we visited so I was out in the day and then I made dinner in the flat in the evening and watched tv. Anna was really responsive. I loved my stay and would recommend.
Sebastian was very helpful and friendly!
Een mooi design appartement in een leuke buurt!
Great place/location/ landlords. Definitely recommend.

Fabulous flat in Prenzlauer Berg! Lots of shops and restaurants nearby, very walkable neighborhood, and close to S and U Bahn station. The flat is exactly as pictured, spacious, comfortable beds and pillows with all the amenities you need. Louis is a wonderful host who is very communicative and made us feel at home. Thank you for everything Louis, we would love to stay here again when visiting Berlin.

The apartment was great for our trip. It is a good location for the main sites and close to bars and restaurants. It was also spacious enough for four women. The balcony is lovely as well. Natalia was very accommodating with our arrival time and answering any questions during our trip.

Tanja's apartment was charming and clearly had a designer's touch. Nice color scheme, updated decor, modern appliances. It was extremely convenient to public transit and to Berlin's extensive network of trams, buses, and Metro. There are nearby markets: an organic market ais about an 8-minute walk, a Lidl is just a bit further, and a few corner stores are just blocks away.  Don't miss the terrific burger place, kepab joint, and bakery that are all within a 3-block radius. We enjoyed our stay.

Die Unterkunft ist super geeignet für einen Freundetrip in die Hauptstadt! Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind gut zu erreichen, Cello Coffee ist super zum Frühstücken (ca. 10min Fußweg) und der Döner gegenüber schmeckt auch lecker. 😉
Die Kommunikation mit Dusan war super schnell und unkompliziert. Die Wohnung war sauber und die Küche mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht.
The apartment is good and clean. Mr. Reiner and Mrs. Olga are nice.

I recently stayed at the NUMA Hotel on Tourstrasse in Berlin. While the location is quite central and convenient for exploring the city, several issues with the booking process and room functionality detracted from the experience.
Booking & Check-in: Unnecessarily Complicated
Despite booking through Airbnb, the confirmation process was confusing and difficult for an international traveler. I was required to:
Complete a separate check-in via What App
Verify my phone number (impossible with my Australian number while not yet in Germany)
Upload passport information (never required in my 100+ previous Airbnb stays)
Getting access details required extensive back-and-forth communication and significantly more effort than standard accommodations.
Room: Functional But Impractical
The room was clean and quiet (located at the back of the building), but had several functional issues:
No adequate space for a suitcase
Very narrow shelf
Door that didn't close properly
No bedside lamp

The location is great, and while the room is small, it’s adequate. The real issue is the host’s customer service—“horrible” is an understatement. I tried to extend my stay but got no response, so I booked a new reservation in the same building. The new room lacked amenities I needed for health reasons, so I reached out. It took nearly 6 hours to get help. I kept getting bot replies, and when I finally got a human, they gave vague answers and disappeared—forcing me to start over with someone new. At one point, after waiting 30 minutes, the bot asked if my issue was resolved and to rate the experience from 1–3. I said “0” and it basically glitched. In the end, they moved me back into the original room I had asked to extend, completely unaware it was my old room or that I had requested it. There’s a serious disconnect between this company and guest needs. They have lots of listings in Berlin, so just be warned before booking.
