Perfect for a nice stay in Berlin. In the heart of the city, good communication, very clean, simply perfect!
Das Zimmer war sauber und ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt.

Sehr schöne Unterkunft und kleiner Garten-Terasse, die am lauen Sommerabend unter Sternenbeleuchtung auf ein Glas Wein einlädt. Sehr ruhig und geschützt, tolles Zimmer mit Koch-Möglichkeit, komfortablen Bett und schönem Bad. Gastgeberin immer erreichbar, freundlich und hilfsbereit
Sehr zu empfehlen, wir kommen gerne wieder.

Ich war bereits das zweite Mal bei Helen, und ich habe mich auch dieses mal wieder sehr wohl gefühlt. Helen ist eine tolle Gastgeberin, die Zimmer sind sehr gemütlich und stilvoll eingerichtet und vor allem blitzblank sauber. Ich komme sehr gern wieder und werde Helen weiterempfehlen. Vielen Dank liebe Helen!
Hat alles super geklappt
Nice place at a very well connected location.
Great host.  Great location.
Alexander was really nice to me and helped with places to see in the city. And the flat itself was really good. Especially the bathroom haha!
Best choice for your money, thank you to the welcoming and friendly staff!

L'appartement était propre et très bien décoré. Nous sommes restés à 7 pendant 5 jours, tout s'est très bien passé, l'appartement est largement assez grand et bien équipé. L'arrivée est très pratique avec la boîte à clés.
Lana nous a en plus fourni quelques recommandations de visites, nous avons adoré !

Fantastic stay. Lovely place. Hans Jorg was very friendly, welcoming, and helpful. Great location. Holtzmart 25 across the river is lovely place to hang out and eat/drink on the water. His place is very clean and nicely designed. You can hear the trains very few mins so something to bear in mind if you are sensitive but we didn’t mind and weren’t disturbed by it. Would love to stay again.

Das war mein bisher schönster Aufenthalt in Berlin. Ich habe mich die fünf Tage bei Reinhard und Marie sehr wohlgefühlt. Die Wohnung ist sehr ruhig - man hört fast nichts von den Nachbarn und von der Straße -, es ist eine friedliche Oase. Vor allem toll, weil man dennoch in wenigen Minuten -zig Restaurants und Läden erreichen kann. Die Wohnung ist top renoviert und sehr ordentlich, WLAN läuft problemlos, den eigenen Wasserkocher im Zimmer finde ich super. Organisatorisches und Absprachen haben gut geklappt. Vom Hauptbahnhof kann man den M41 Bus nehmen und einmal umsteigen oder vom Hermannplatz zu Fuß gehen.
Die Gastgeber sind sehr unkompliziert; danke für die Gespräche.

All was in good conditions as described. The host was nice, and the kitchen is fitted with a lot more than just the basic stuff. The location is directly next to a larger pond suitable for a walk.
The surroundings are quite (for a city) and the next bus station is just 7 minutes away.

Das Zimmer entsprach der Beschreibung, schöne Altbauwohnung in guter Lage, Bad und Küche durften mitgenuzt werden und auch sonstige Haushaltsgeräte. Die Vermieterin hat sich bemüht, den Aufenthalt so angenehm wie möglich zu machen, und die Wohnung auch regelmäßig saubergemacht. Insgesamt war die Wohnung für meine Zwecke sehr gut geeignet und für alle empfehlenswert, die gerne Berlin kennenlernen möchten, ohne lange mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu fahren. Danke für alles, Ljuba.
We definately want to go back some day! Thanks for having us!
Sehr schönes und ruhiges Zimmer in idealer Lage, stilvoll eingerichtet und blitzsauber. Sehr schnelle und zuverlässige Kommunikation. Absolut top!

A great place to sleep on a short notice and on a budget but with a lot of perks such as kitchen and utensils to use and very comfy beds and 24/7 availability due to the front door being opened eith a code thats always functioning, hence perfect if you like late nights out and dont want to be locked out ;)
Frank is a great host and the cleaningstaff worked often during the days to keep it nice and tidy♡ HOWEVER the other guests treated the bathrooms like todlers :/
This IS NOT the hostel staffs fault,
its due to the GUESTS.
They left all trash and personal belongings in the showers and never once dried the floors when they were done showering (wich do get super wet and slippery) and left their soaked towels piled on the floor.
Again this is NOT frank or his staffs fault.
But rather a heads up to future guests to treat this space with a bit more respect:/
(Like comeon, they even provide scrapertool to wipe the floors. Its not that hard)

Well, at first I must say that this kind of stay is not for everyone. You have to be ready for that. The toilet is really small and not to comfortable. There is an outdoor shower which is quite cold, but you can ask the hostess and she will give you access to hot shower in their house. Apart from that everything was great. The hostess is the nicest person in the world. We came late at night and there were water and ice-cream in the fridge as well as 2 bottles of wine. The bed is really huge and comfortable. I slept like a child. And you have a cozy yard just for yourselves where you can a pleasant conversation with a glass of wine. The surroundings are really quiet and calm. There is a large grocery store in just 5 minutes walk.
We had a great time there
Ben was such a lovely host! Very attentive and super helpful in visiting Berlin. Very clean apartment with ample storage throughout. Would come back anytime!

Die Wohnung war perfekt – sauber, gut ausgestattet und sehr gemütlich. Die Lage war ideal, und die Gastgeber waren unglaublich freundlich und hilfsbereit. Ich habe mich rundum wohlgefühlt und komme gerne wieder. Vielen Dank!

Ich habe zwei Nächte bei Cinderella verbracht und mich rundum wohlgefühlt. Die Unterkunft ist nicht nur wunderschön, sondern auch perfekt zentral im Bergmannkiez gelegen – eine tolle Gegend mit vielen charmanten Cafés, Restaurants und kleinen Läden. Besonders begeistert hat mich die liebevolle Einrichtung und die angenehme Atmosphäre. Ein weiteres Highlight meines Aufenthalts war das Sushi im King King Restaurant – absolut empfehlenswert! Insgesamt eine großartige Erfahrung, die ich nur weiterempfehlen kann.
Foi tudo muito bom de verdade,  compensou muito a estadia, espero voltar mais vezes.

Casa comoda, perfetta per 4 persone, molto luminosa in un bellissimo condominio. Fantastica la metro a pochi passi dalla casa, così come il supermercato. C’è anche una discreta varietà di caffè e ristoranti sulla strada e questo è molto comodo se non si ha voglia di cucinare. In ogni caso, la casa ha tutte le dotazioni necessarie in cucina. Quando torneremo a Berlino, di sicuro soggiorneremo ancora qui.
Die mit Abstand am besten ausgestattete Loft, in der wir jemals waren

El apartamento es tal cual aparece en las fotos, muy espacioso y luminoso, con wifi, 2 baños completos, la entrada es por un patio un poco destartalado y al llegar al portal, con aspecto un poco abandonado y sin ascensor sorprende cuando entras en el piso lo bonito que es. Esta muy bien situado, boca de metro muy cercana, en 2 paradas estabas en el centro. El barrio tiene  muchos restaurantes cerca, pero la calle donde está la casa es muy tranquila. El anfitrión, bueno la persona que trataba con nosotros encantadora. Pendiente en todo momento de nosotros.
Sandra has been a nice host and she has a beautiful flat. She is really kind helpful and friendly. I had a wonderful stay in Berlin.
Nice place. Spacious for 4 people.

Superbe appartement, chaleureux , confortable et parfaitement équipé. Les procédures de check in et check out sont pratiques et simples. Situé à 200 mètres du Ubahn et du Sbahn donc parfait pour voyager dans Berlin et à 400 mètres de Tempelhof un des endroits magiques de la ville.
Merci encore Rainer

Lovely apartment in very nice, quiet neighborhood. Perfect for travelers with small children. The apartment was exactly like on the photos. We were welcomed by Carolina's neighbor, as she herself was away. Everything went really smooth, in terms of contact beforehand as well as check in and check out. We would not hesitate to recommend Carolina as a host to anyone who would like to visit Berlin and the neighborhood of Prenzlauer Berg.

Daniel's place was clean, well-decorated, and looked exactly like the photos. However, the listing itself is a bit misleading because while it says you have the entire apartment, it actually feels more like a private room.  The original apartment is sectioned off to make multiple airbnbs. This airbnb is like the living room with a kitchen. The bathroom is in the shared space with another airbnb and the host. There is a shared entrance, shared bathroom, shared corridor, shared laundry. One of our main issues was with the internet. We received 'vouchers' that only work for a certain amount of time and for a certain amount data and only for one device per voucher. If you choose to stay here request MANY vouchers in advance. We needed to do some work on our laptops and ran out of data twice which was extremely inconvenient. Another thing to note is that the laundry machine is shared and it also operates on a voucher system. The host needs to activate remotely and then only for 4 hours. In the end, we were not able to use the laundry because it was difficult to coordinate and either the host or another airbnb guest was using it.

Martin´s place is a beautifully designed tiny house with large windows and individual furniture.
The location is calm, clean and beautiful, perfect for a walk along the waterside. Supermarkets are in walking distance and there is free parking in front of the house.
Martin was very responsive and helped me out quickly with questions.
My dog was welcome and we had a great time here.

We loved Arne’s place - It’s a very “Berlin” feel but with his artistic, vintage and sustainable touch making it special! Perfect location for us, central but without a tourist feel, great to walk around or for public transportation. Arne is friendly, great communicator, and we loved his adorable cats. We would definitely stay again and recommend to others 🙂
Great value in a great location
Loved it. Will come back!

Het appartement van Izabella is top: fijne sfeer, de locatie is mooi gelegen in Prenzlauerberg vlakbij Kastanienallee, gezellige retro inrichting, heerlijke ruime douche en fijne bedden. Helemaal top!

Hilda was so easy to deal with, and it was a great stay with very accurate descriptions of everything. They had a lot of tea options in the kitchen, and coffee available. The building on the outside was kind of rough at first glance but nothing was broken and it felt safe the whole time. Parking was very easy, even with our big travel van. All the windows were functional and it was very comfortable. Comfortable beds and sheets. The shower was easy to use. Very responsive in the messages as well for any questions we had. Overall great stay!
Excellent communication, location and impeccably clean home. Thank you for hosting us Dietrich.

I can't even put into words how amazing this accommodation was. We were always so excited to Come back here from our trips around Berlin. The owner Uto was Very welcoming and friendly, we really felt like home :) What I can appreciate is that we could use the heating, so we made our room nice temperature after we came back all chilled from cold winter Berlin. The shower was excelent so was the whole bathroom. There was blowdrier, shampoo, conditioner and soap for us to use. In our room the bed was super comfy. Thanks to blinds we could also make our room Very dark and sleep well thanks to that. We Will definitelly recommend this accommodation  everywhere we can and definitelly Come back! 10/10

Die Lage ist Top, es ist auch alles dort was man braucht. Allerdings ist der Schimmel im Bad wirklich ziemlich unangenehm. Die ganze Wohnung riecht danach und länger als 10min will man sich nicht in dem Bad aufhalten.
Clean and comfortable!
Die Wohnung ist sehr hell, geräumig und gut erreichbar mit den Öffentlichen. Die Vermieterin war sehr nett und hilfbereit bei unseren Anliegen.
Super emplacement, hôte sympathique et serviable, logement propre. Je recommande!
Goede locatie  buiten centrum om de stad te bezoeken met openbaar vervoer, in de straat diverse leuke tentjes om wat te drinken.
Excelente hostal!
Alles super.

Sabine ist eine unglaublich herzliche Gastgeberin. Sehr gerührt hat mich ein kleines Nikolausgeschenk in meinen Stiefeln am Nikolaustag.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist super, das Zimmer sehr sauber und Sabine ist sehr bemüht um neue Bettwäsche, Handtücher etc. Insgesamt würde ich immer wieder bei Sabine wohnen, gerade auch für längere Aufenthalte!
Great place highly recommended. The room I had was spacious and well equipped. Location perfect also

Séjour parfait. Emilia est réactive et aux petits soins.Tout est pensé pour ne manquer de rien: équipements, vaisselle,linge,confort literie et tant. Bel environnement et maison et intimité appréciable pour la chambre et salle de bain. Accueillante, attentionnée.Nous reviendrons avec grand plaisir. Top,top,top. Cela mérite 5⭐ et plus. Au plaisir

Excelente ubicación. Cercano a la estación de Alexanderplatz. Adicional a ello, puedes ubicarte fácilmente con Fernsehturm de Berlín.
Hay varias alternativas a la redonda de transporte público.
Quedé enamorada de la ubicación.
Fácil acceso. Hay casilleros para guardar equipaje antes del check in y posterior al check out, sujeto a disponibilidad.
La habitación estuvo disponible antes de los previsto.
Mi experiencia ha sido muy grata. Me encantaría volver.

Süße kleine Wohnung in guter Lage zu öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln und in ruhiger Lage.
Leider ist die Ausstattung der Wohnung teilweise sehr veraltet. Die Heizung im Bad ist verrostet, sehr alte Küche, Oberfläche im Bad durch Wasser aufgeplatzt, Türgriff kaputt - eine kleine Modernisierung würde der Wohnung sehr gut tun.
Fantastic location, lovely and clean, and was a great apartment for a long weekend. There’s a Lidl up the road and the train station is a minutes walk away. Couldn’t have asked for a better stay!

Buena Calidad precio. está todo nuevo, la TV es enorme y la cocina está bien equipada. lo único que no tiene microondas, pero tiene Nespresso, cocina, frigorífico.... Algo importante y que nos sorprendió es que está a pie de calle. Para nosotros era positivo porque no echamos de menos las vistas, y entras y sales fácilmente, la puerta de la habitación da a la calle directamente, pero es una calle muy tranquila, ademas tiene unas persianas exteriores automáticas que dan seguridad y no dejan pasar la luz por la mañana, algo que a mi pareja y a mi nos parece fundamental. volvería, lo recomiendo.
Good location! It has all the equipment you can think of. It's convenient and clean as well! Highly recommended!

Fab location (2 minute walk to the U-Bahn which then takes 5 minutes to get to Alexanderplatz - or you can walk in about 15 minutes). Close proximity to everything you could need or want - including a Lidl less than 10 minutes walk away!
The hosts were easily contacted and very pleasant. The bottle of wine was a really nice touch (thanks!).
The space was also really cool - literally *in* an art gallery.
Alles super und unkompliziert
We had a great time in Berlin this 4 days

We have enjoyed our stay so so much. the apartment is very lovingly decorated. the inner courtyard enchants you immediately and the birds are singing lively. we would recommend everyone to visit carstens oasis of wellbeing.
personally i will miss being woken up by the birds in the morning very much.
Appartamento molto ampio, pulito e comodo per gli spostamenti. Consigliato!

We had a wonderful stay at Oliver’s place! We arrived at the airport super late, and Oliver gave us clear instructions on how to get the keys from the lockbox and which key opened which door :) Super comfortable and plenty of space to get work done and/or chill. Well-equipped kitchen, there’s even an air fryer! The grocery store is just around the corner, made it super easy to pick up anything last minute. Not sure if he does it for everyone, but we were happy to meet him personally and get to know him over drinks. I’ll definitely book his place again the next time I’m n Berlin!

Depto excelente!!! Todo impecable por parte de Roman
100% recomendado!!
Great area to stay in and Maja is a good host
La habitación está muy limpia y se ofrece un muy buen desayuno. El espacio es un poco reducido pero el suficiente para una estadía cómoda. Kristina es una gran anfitriona!
Vielen Dank für den netten Aufenthalt! Es war alles wie beschrieben und sehr zentral gelegen! :-)
Vielen Dank.  Haben  uns sehr wohl gefühlt

Wir hatten 2 schöne Tage hier und alles hat gepasst. Die Ausstattung was umfangreich. WM, Bügelstation und eine sehr gut ausgestattete Küche. Einzig die Lage im UG war gewöhnungsbedürftig. Wir hatten meistens die Rollos unten da man sonst in die Zimmer hineingesehen hätte. Gegenüber ein tolles italienisches Restaurant sehr empfehlenswert.
Wir würden gerne bei nächster Gelegenheit wiederkommen.

Barrio muy bueno.
Comunicación y transporte. Lo único que ha sido poco aceptable han sido las almohadas.
Perfect gelegen in een coole buurt, maar toch rustig en stil, Tempelhof vlakbij, leuke Thai tegenover de deur. Het appartement is ruimer dan de foto’s doen vermoeden!
Sehr schöne saubere Wohnung, tolle Lage, netter Kontakt.
Mehr Sauberkeit des Badezimmers
Great location; high ceilings and good lighting.
Schönes, sauberes und freundliches Hostel. Nachts teilweise sehr laut.

I have trouble thinking of any way Louis could have made things better.  There were a number of very nice touches which we used with pleasure - the restaurant recommendations, the host's iphone so that we did not incur data roaming charges on our phones.  All very thoughtful.  We will definitely be referring other friends to Louis and would plan on booking with him again. The neighborhood was great fun, and although we enjoyed the rest of Berlin, we could not wait to get back to his flat in "our" neighborhood.  If you go to Berlin, plan on staying in Prentzlauerberg.

Location, location, location! Matthias's beautiful, clean and very nicely stocked flat was so convenient to all the things a first-time visitor to Berlin wants to do and see. And, even better, a very nice market was just steps away and a Gelateria right across the street. An excellent selection of restaurants, cafes and bakeries are just a block or two away. The living room looks out over a nice courtyard. It was very quiet inside the flat, even though the bedroom faces a street with tram lines and a fair amount of traffic. As travelers who like to recycle, we appreciated the array of recycling bins available at the garage level. The nearby market also had recycling for plastic and paper available. Matthias and his sister Gabi were very helpful and accommodating. I honestly can't think of anyplace else I'd rather stay in Berlin and hope to visit again.
The place is very close to the U-Bahn station and many supermarkets and restaurants. Not suitable for someone with many luggages though since it's on the last floor and there isn't an elevator.

Maria was so kind and helpful. She had great answers to all of our questions, but also we just really enjoyed speaking with her.
The house was clean and lovely. It's also a great spot to get away from the hustle and bustle of Berlin proper.
Sehr schön und ruhig gelegene, saubere Wohnung. Sandra war immer super schnell erreichbar und es hat alles perfekt funktioniert.
Tout est conforme, juste à côté du parc et des transports en commun. Excellent!

Alles super! Die beiden Gastgeber waren sehr hilfsbereit, freundlich, zurückhaltend und hatten gute Tipps. Die Lage und die Anbindung an U-Bahn/S-Bahn ist super und trotzdem ist die Wohnung sehr ruhig. Alles ist sehr gemütlich eingerichtet und man kann sich ganz wie zuhause fühlen. Wer eine schicke Unterkunft sucht, ist hier nicht richtig, aber das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis ist top. Wir würden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen!

Etienne was very kind to share his apartment beyond the room. He offered use of the appliances and his wide selection of teas were great for breakfast. The room itself is large and bright, with a balcony looking down onto the Main Street. Great place to stay in Berlin

We absolutely loved this place! Quiet location in the middle of Berlin, close to the trains, next to a beautiful park. Great for a family get-together. Caspar and Louisa are so easy to get in touch with, and always responded right away; also let us stash our luggage early. Their apartment is beautiful! And, while this is maybe not on the top of everyone’s priority list, the light coming in through the windows is amazing. We definitely want to come back to Berlin and spend more time here.

MM NT Labs was a great way to do Berlin. Everything went very smoothly, from flexible self check in to check out. It is located very close to Alexanderplatz, and made seeing Berlins main attractions very easy. There were also heaps of good restaurants within walking distance. Although we didn't have time to use them, the communal areas looked great. I would recommend MM NT, and if we come to Berlin again, we will definitely consider this for accomodation.
Gemütliche Unterkunft in unmittelbarer Nähe zur Messe und S-Bahn. Absolut ruhig. Andrea ist eine sehr angenehme und aufmerksame Gastgeberin.
Sehr schöne & zentrale Wohnung. Hat alles bestens funktioniert, kann ich nur weiterempfehlen!

Die Wohnung ist schön hell und sauber. Das Schlafzimmer hat mir besonders gut gefallen, weil es so gemütlich war. Die Lage war für mich perfekt, weil ich um die Ecke ein Seminar hatte. Restaurants und Supermärkte gibt es gleich in der Nähe, sehr praktisch. Die Kommunikation mit Kevin war unkompliziert und die Antworten kamen sehr schnell. Ich komme gerne wieder.

Heide's place was great for my group that included 3 adults and a toddler. The location was very convenient to the Sbahn (train) and streetcar system as well as an Edeke grocery store just down the street. Heide was responsive to all my questions, providing recommendations for nearby playgrounds and prior to our arrival, setting up a pack and play crib and high chair for my son and set up couch for sleeping in the living room. She even left a few age appropriate toys for him, and we took advantage of the outdoor patio every day for play, appreciating the extra space. Overall the space was larger in the main room and bedroom than I expected from the photos and generally for being in Europe and our size group. I would highly recommend this location.
El lugar es como se ve en las fotos, es limpio y agradable. Muy sencillo de localizar , además muy cerca del metro para movilidad en todo Berlín. Lo recomiendo
Appartement et séjour parfaits

Wij hebben een geweldige week in dit prachtige huis gehad met twee van onze kinderen. Het was erg luxe en iedereen kon heerlijk zijn eigen gang gaan. Vanaf het huis een korte wandeling naar de metro en dan in een half uur in het centrum van Berlijn. De hosts zijn zeer vriendelijk en je kunt met vragen en opmerkingen bij hen terecht. Van ons geen negatieve opmerkingen, alleen maar positieve. Wij willen zeker nog eens terugkomen.

We had a good stay in a practical location, but after leaving the host rudely accused us of being three people instead of two with no justification (because there was an extra towel in the hamper which we did not remember using - we just used the towels laid out for us), and did not listen when we told her this was not true. An unfortunate ending to a nice stay.

Sehr gute Lage, es gibt gute lokale in der Nähe und man kommt relativ schnell zu guten Läden und trotzdem ist es relativ ruhig. Die Wohnung sieht genauso aus wie auf den Bildern. Josef hat uns gut geholfen sodass es ein toller Aufenthalt war. Danke.
Very comfortable place.
zona tranquila y bien comunicada
This is a lovely place, perfect for any length of stay. Listing as described, lots of space and easy access to public transport routes. Highly recommended
Gute Lage und gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis!
Alles bestens, nur die Ausziehcouch ist nicht mehr im besten Zustand.
Very spacious apartment, great balconies, good location!

Bert is a great host! Very quick to reply, very friendly and gave perfect instructions about everything I needed to know.
The apartment is perfectly and nicely tucked away on a quiet street located in Friedrichshain with walking distance to restaurants, caffès, shops and clubs. Perfect for my weekend trip!
This is a really nice apartment, I totally recommend and I will always come back!
Reine AirBnB-Wohnung in zentraler Lage. Wohnung ist ok, aber super basic und unpersönlich. Das Gemeindschaftsbadezimmer hätte öfter gereinigt werden können. Für einen Budgettrip aber ok.
Super Lage, unkomplizierter Check-in, so mag man das :)
Great experience— this is the first place I’ll be looking to stay at during my next trip to Berlin
A charming and comfortable place. We slept very well and enjoyed the proximity to many cool places around Neukeln. Definitely recommended.
Good value for money if you are looking to explore Berlin. Location feels very safe and the room matched the pictures exactly. I would recommend people to stay.
Alles sehr gut. Kann ich nur weiterempfehlen!!
Auch beim zweiten Mal habe ich mich sehr wohl gefühlt und werde sicher wieder kommen! Vielen Dank für alles!
Exactly as the place description! It was a really nice stay

Der Aufenthalt war kurz, unproblematisch und super angenehm! Der Schlüsselkasten ist eine prima Idee für Menschen die zeitlich flexibel anreisen möchten. Praktisch ist außerdem der Späti vor dem Haus. Die Einrichtung der Wohnung (insbesondere das Badezimmer) sind stilvoll und wohnlich.

Verda's apartment is tidy and extremely well located, with many great restaurants, bars and cafés only a short walk away.
Verda was so friendly and welcoming, and made sure that I was happy and comfortable in the apartment. She did that little bit extra - the sort of thing that always makes you feel special. I also met her gorgeous little boy, who had just started to walk.
A lovely stay in Prenzlauer Berg.

Great place to stay in a convenient location close to public transport and with plenty of restaurants and a grocery store in walking distance. Tori provided clear instructions which made the checkin process easy.
Robert ist freundlicher Gastgeber, welcher schnell zurück antwortet, Tipps für Berlin gibt und die Lage der Wohnung ist sehr gut.
Danke für die schöne Unterkunft in der wir uns mit 2 kleinen Familien sehr wohl gefühlt haben.
Alles super
All good, would recommend
Best Airbnb in all of Berlin!
This apartment was a great home base for our time in Berlin! Very clean, well appointed, and close to public transport. Would definitely recommend.

Die Unterkunft ist für einen Kurztrip nach Berlin sehr gut geeignet. Die Lage war super. Wir haben ein Konzert in der Mercedes Benz Arena besucht und konnten diese problemlos fußläufig erreichen.
Hatten zunächst Probleme mit dem Türschloss, diese konnten aber telefonisch direkt behoben werden. Wir waren zufrieden mit unserem Aufenthalt.

I love the place the minute I walked in. It felt hommy and comfy.
The place is quiet, near everything and the host are perfect.
I'll be back for sure.

This listing is great value for money - privacy of having the place all to yourself for a reasonable price in a very lively area. Ease of transportation and connectivity to the rest of the city. Although located next to a busy street and in between nightlife businesses, we weren't bothered by any sounds, though we did stay in the middle of the week.
Only thing I wouldn't suggest setting your hopes on is the "recent renovation" aspect mentioned in the description. Although in fairly good condition in general, there is much wear to the studio's floors, walls etc.
= ❤️🙏 top Lage, schnell am Alex und nah an der Ringbahn, schnelle und gute Kommunikation. Ich empfehle jedem die Wohnung!
Tolle Unterkunft

Stay was great. Place is at a convenient location with easy reach to Tram and buses. A great place closer to social amenities. I wont hesitate to recommend anyone to choose this place as accomodation.
I had a great stay at Densita‘s AirBnB! It’s nicely located in the center of Kreuzberg and yet quiet. The apartment was clean, check-in super easy and communication with the host was friendly.

Very comfortable Airbnb and strong wifi; alongside the super responsive host Julius! The place was very clean (had towels and a washing machine/dishwasher) & easy access with the M10 a short walk from the house. The TV was such a blessing with Netflix accessible.
Really enjoyed our stay & would stay again!
Next to airport don’t bother with a soulless hotel
Great location, spacious apartment with great facilities.
Great location. Really easy to get around Berlin from here

This place is really beautiful. Close to all amenities.
Doerthe gave fresh flowers, fruits and wine to welcome us to her house.
Thanks for that.
Definitely will come back when we are in Berlin.
Great deal, Luca was a great host.

Very good communication with Houssem and a very Nice place. Well placed, easy to find and very easy to check in and out.

If you are looking for a cozy space to stay in for more than a few nights, I would not recommend this space. While all the amenities are provided, a cozy stay they do not make. The airBNB is run like a business, because it is a business.
The living area has no comfortable seating. The couches might as well be a park bench and the cushions were falling apart. The kitchen doesn’t have lighting in the cooking area, there are no kitchen towels, and the appliances in the kitchen were dirty. The nonstick cookware was beyond safe use so we bought our own pan.
The apartment next door is also rented on AirBNB by the host and shares an entrance area with this one. We were startled in the early morning to hear people entering, and thought they were coming into our apartment.
The apartment next door also has a balcony that looks directly into the living area of this AirBNB. We didn’t expect to have use of the balcony but it was an uncomfortable setup.
The biggest issue for us was the WiFi. If having a secure, private WiFi is important for you, do not stay here. The WiFi is shared between this apartment, the apartment next door, and the bar downstairs - all of which are owned by the host’s company.

Also, there is long-term construction happening directly across the street which we weren’t aware of. It was loud occasionally, so just be aware of that.
These were all of the things that didn’t work for us. All of that said, the bar downstairs that is run by the host’s company is a great spot. It’s cozy, has great drinks, great service, and overall is a really nice vibe. I don’t recommend this Airbnb but I definitely recommend the bar (Patesô).

Questo fa si che la casa abbia poca luce, poca areazione e cattivo odore di chiuso. Durante il soggiorno è stato molto difficile arieggiare gli ambienti, anche se la cucina e il bagno affacciano in un cortile interno, ma anche lì non c'è alcuna privacy se si aprono le finestre. La cucina non ha la cappa sul fornello, quindi quando si prepara il cibo si crea ulteriore odore in casa. In compenso Daniel è estremamente gentile e reattivo e ha risolto velocemente un problema di pulizia che abbiamo riscontrato, la cucina è grande e ben equipaggiata, i letti comodi, bagno e doccia perfettamente funzionanti.

We loved this place. From the moment we entered, we knew we picked a great apartment. It was a lot bigger than we thought and also so charming. It’s in a large complex, but it feels so private with its own entrance and no other apartments nearby. There are also a couple outdoor private areas and picnic table in the garden.
One of the best features that is hard to understand in the listing is its location, especially if you want great food. It’s not in the center of things, but it’s only a mile away from most major spots. So you can walk or take a quick 10-15 minute U-Bahn ride to almost every attraction.
The apartment is in a major international section so you can get great authentic food from almost every country in the world. While we were there we had Indian, Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese, Italian, Turkish, and of course German food and beer. Two of Berlin’s iconic foodie spots were right around the corner. Mustafa’s Döner Kebab and Currywurst 36. Yum. It’s also conveniently located next to several grocery stores and mini-marts so you can always get anything you may need.
Another thing hard to appreciate in a listing is how important the hosts are to a good stay. From the moment I booked the place until I left, the communication was better than I could’ve expected. Felix answered every one of my questions, even silly ones, within minutes and even provided outside advice and help. A great example is when I asked where I could get our Covid test results printed, he replied that he could do it for us. I asked if I could meet him somewhere to pick them up and he said he’d drop them off. He had it to us within the hour and I didn’t have to worry about finding a place. Wow!
We loved Berlin and a lot had to do with our stay. We will definitely book with Felix again when we return next year to visit our son. I recommend Felix and this AirBnB with the highest possible ratings!

Tolle Lage und Ausgangslage für einen Berlin Aufenthalt. Sehr große Wohnung im Hinterhofgebaude, dadurch sehr ruhige Wohnlage, vorne in der Straße rockt aber das Leben, perfekt. Super Kommunikation, alles da in der Wohnung was man braucht. Wir waren zu viert und haben es sehr genossen.
This is a stylish, well equipped studio apartment, with very nice design details and an excellent location in Kollwitzkiez. Will definitely try to return here for future stays in Berlin!

Great apartment. Nice location near a subway stop, a great breakfast cafe, and within walking distance to a handful of fun neighborhoods. Easy to check-in and out with the staff. We'd stay here again next time we're in Berlin.
Like others said, internet wasn't amazing, but perfectly fine for casual browsing.
herzl. Dank für die gute Kommunikation
Appartement très bien situé et conforme à la description

Our stay was amazing!
The place is very clean and stylish. It was easy to check-in and check-out. The host are very friendly. A lot of public transport options are nearby.
We totally enjoyed the stay!

TempelCasa is the perfect apartment from which to explore Berlin. The apartment is huge, really clean, with everything you need. Comfy bed and living space, large kitchen to cook meals. My only regret is that we didn't stay longer! It is close to public transport, walking distance from many amazing restaurants and cafes. We were greeted by one of Alexanders friends who told us everything we needed to know about the area. Will be staying again.
Jenny was a great host. She maintained good communication and answered all of our questions before and during our stay. Her place is clean and comfortable. We really enjoyed our stay at her place!

Lovely, luminous apartment in the old style.  Nice furnishings and comfortable bed and bedding.  Great neighborhood—interesting but also low-key, and close to Bellevue S-Bahn. Vivienne is the perfect host, friendly and helpful in every way.
Merci pour votre accueil, c'était super !

It was UNFOGETTABLE stay!!! Everything was perfect - ultra comfortable, great location, warm welcome, gorgeous design apartments, very clean and have all nessecary equipment. My only wish is to come back!!! Highly recommended!!

Super Lage!
Der kleine Balkon ist sehr schön, mit freiem Blick über die Dächer.
Das Zimmer ist gemütlich ohne unnötigen Schnickschnack.
Ich hatte überlesen, dass man die Küche nicht nutzen kann.
Aber es gibt natürlich ein großes Angebot an allem vor der Türe.
Stella hat einen unglaublich schönen Ort in Berlin! Und eine super leichte Kommunikation! Danke
Die Wohnung von Miriam ist klein aber fein und hat alles was man für ein paar Tage in Berlin braucht. Obwohl die Unterkunft in einer belebten Umgebung liegt, ist es doch sehr ruhig. Sehr zu empfehlen

It was the first time I ever tried Numa's apartments, and I was positively surprised!
Numa Boxer is perfect if you're looking for a short stay in Berlin:
the self check-in was very simple, the only issue we had was that the room was not ready as we asked for an early check-in, but because you have free lockers for your suitcases was not a problem.
The room really surprised me as I was expecting something smaller, but the medium size is perfect for two! Very clean and brand new, pretty spacious, with everything we needed, from coffee, tea, towels, soap (basically what you need from a hotel room)
Also I found very helpful the laundry room and storage in case you need to change your towels you'll find them there!
Location is perfect as Friedrichshain is a very quiet neighborhood but full of local café and bars, well connected especially because you have Ostkreuz station near by, that connects you with airport.
Super recommended!!

Der Geruch im ganzen Gebäude ist schon sehr auffällig und vor allem im Zimmer war es schon fast unerträglich.
Die Lage ist super, direkt an der Haltestelle Turmstraße aber dadurch ist es bis in die Nacht sehr laut und durch den Gestank muss man das Fenster öffnen.
Für eine Nacht was es jetzt okay, ich würde aber nicht noch einmal hier übernachten.
Die Mitarbeitenden waren allerdings freundlich und ich konnte mein Gepäck noch tagsüber dalassen bis zur Abreise.

Helemaal top! We hadden echt geen betere plek kunnen hebben. Alles was brandschoon, Vivian was super behulpzaam, dichtbij de s-bahn, rustige buurt, gratis parkeermogelijkheid. Alles was super! We komen zeker nog eens terug.

Nicole, som inte var hemma vid min ankomst, var väldigt mån om att jag skulle hitta och komma in i lägenheten. När jag blev försenad ringde hon upp och frågade om jag behövde hjälp att hitta rätt. Hon är en mycket bra värd. Lägenheten är belägen i ett lugnt och trevligt område. Rummet som jag disponerade upptogs till största delen av en dubbel loftsäng. För den som endast kommer att använda rummet för att sova i är detta ett bra alternativ. Enda nackdelen med detta boende är att det inte finns någon hiss.
Danke für die Unterkunft, die ziemlich zentral liegt. Alles ist gut erreichbar, Netto gleich nebenan, Bäckerei, Döner auch. Schöner Blick vom Balkon.
This is a very cute hotel. Would stay again
Todo genial!

Absolute great location to discover Friedrichshain. Very close to RAW-gelände, shops, restaurants, U-bahn etc. Being at the inner part of the building, very very quiet during the night. Dor was really helpful, especially because we arrived 4 hours later than planned. Great host!
Is actually bigger than it looks in the photos. One of my favourite neighborhoods in Berlin. Price is really fair for what you get. Would definitely recommend!
This house is very cute and the terrace is fantastic. The neighborhood is very cool and you are very close to tons of restaurants. Would highly recommend this house.

Wir waren drei Wochen bei Angela. Für uns hat alles gut gepasst. Die Wohnung ist sauber.
Die Lage ist sehr ruhig, aber man hat alles was man braucht. Der See ist sehr schön!
Mr Klaus is very nice . the apartment is  also beautiful. it is very convenient and closed to subway and bus . it is good place for every visitors
Good room for 1-2 people, with a great family in the house. Would recommend!
Had a lovely time here. The apartment was clean, comfortable and very stylish. Erez was very welcoming and responsive. It was a great price for a lovely stay :)

The room was as advertised and as many other previous comments had reviewed. Decent, clean, spacious and a good separate bathroom / toilet. The check-in & out was really easy, BIG thanks for that, much appreciated!

The apartment check-in time is 16h, and the check-out is 10h. Highly unusual, and very inconvenient. When asked if we can check-out at the internationally normal time of 11h, we received a generic response and invitation to pay 40 EUR for this luxury. We also received instructions on checking out before we had even checked in. The whole experience made us feel unwanted, and our needs not really catered for. You will not get a personal touch staying here. The front door of the apartment itself open directly on to a noisy street. The finishes inside are sparse but acceptable. The whole place needs TLC, for example the shower door. The rooms are just for sleeping, and there are no real amenities inside the unit, other than a whole wall of rules to follow. If you're looking for a place to stay overnight, make sure you've first read all the fine print, otherwise choose a place with a more homey and cosy feel, and hosts who actually type their own responses to you instead of using templates.

Quiet and cosy place just around the corner of “Gleisdreieckpark”. Super friendly host. Perfect for a female solo traveler (like me) - very good with the baby as well. The place is small (especially the kitchencorner) - but very well kept and absolutely sufficient when you’re out and about most of the day anyways. We were very happy! :)

Andrea hat mich herzlich mit einer Tasse Tee empfangen. Das Haus ist gemütlich und liegt in einer ruhigen Wohngegend. Der Teufelsberg liegt nicht weit. Es gibt zwei S-Bahnen, die fußläufig zu erreichen sind. Beim S-Bahnhof Heerstraße gibt es eine gute Pizzeria und andere Lokale. Andrea bereitet auch ein leckeres Frühstück vor. Eine gute Gastgeberin!

Excellent séjour chez Axel qui a été d'une grande aide. Axel nous a recommandé plusieurs d'endroits à visiter et nous étions proches de tout à pied. Ce logement est idéal pour visiter Berlin.
L'appartement était très propre et bien agencé. Merci encore Axel !
Super séjour ! L'appartement était très propre, lumineux et spacieux.

Katja's flat was clean, confortable, cozy, and very well situated in a charming neighborhood with easy access to public transportation, nice cafes, restaurants and a wonderful Turkish Market within a walking distance. The host was friendly, responsive, provided plenty of water, clear information and good recommendations. Our stay in Berlin was beyond our expectations, we hope to return and stay at Katja's flat again!
Buen jugar para estar en Berlin, lo mejor es el bar
Wunderschöne Zimmer, sehr freundliches Personal, superleckeres Frühstück

Me and my family had a wonderful stay at Silas apartment. The place was tastefully decorated with a small peaceful garden to enjoy an evening drink.

We would definitely recommend a stay at Silas apartment and would absolutely come back.

Nice little place in an up-and-coming neighbourhood of Berlin. Less touristy than other areas, but also quite interesting and easy to get to many different public transports. Kitchen is VERY small, bedrooms cosy. Thanks Sebastian; recommended for a quiet, no-frills, hassle free stay!!

Perfect location, in a peaceful set up, walking distance from great places to eat, hang out, and enjoy the good vibes of Berlin! Great connections too with the train and local hubs. Will definitely stay again if in the area!
Great price for a nice little appartment, host was nice and proactive. The only downside was that the wifi was very inconsistent, but other than that it was perfect
Absolutely perfect, do not hesitate

Sehr schöne große Wohnung, nähe an Potsdamer Platz. Das Zimmer ist hell und sauber. Sehr zu empfehlen!
Nice place!

Johanne was the perfect host. The apartment was conveniently located near public transportation, and the bed was very comfortable. Everything was just perfect. I would definitely stay here again.
Cute and interestingly decorated flat in central but calm area. Responsive and friendly host. Thank you for having us!

Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön in einer Allee in ruhiger Atmosphäre gelegen. Restaurants, Bars sowie die Bahnhaltestellen und Läden für den täglichen Gebrauch sind fußläufig erreichbar.
In der Unterkunft sind einige Dinge eher provisorisch eingerichtet. Dennoch hatten wir alles was wir für unseren Aufenthalt brauchten.

Posto incantevole, circondato dal verde, ci siamo proprio sentite a casa!
Super consigliatissimo, host molto gentile!
Perfekte Apartments mit allem, was man benötigt, sehr gerne wieder. Vollste Empfehlung.
Das Zimmer ist wunderschön gestaltet und die Lage ist ebenfalls richtig gut. Es ist alles so wie beschrieben und die Kommunikation mit Kristin war sehr einfach und immer freundlich.
숙소 시설이 너무 좋고 집주인분도 너무 친절했습니다. 하나 아쉬운 점은 숙소의 위치가 짐을 끌고 이동할 때 거리가 좀 있었다는거 뿐입니다. 나머지는 완벽했습니다.
Todo perfecto, apartamento recomendable!

Appartement fidèle à la description, très bien situé (nombreux transports en commun à proximité), calme. Les rideaux ne couvrent pas entièrement la fenêtre. Peu d'équipements de cuisine (ustensiles).

Berlin is a great city for museums, history and architecture discoveries.

Great and peaceful accommodations in a vibrant and fun neighborhood. I will definitely try to book it again the next time I’m in Berlin. Mathias is a wonderful host.
Good value for money!

Amazingly stylish and clean apartment. The location is perfect with S-bahn situated within a few minute walk from the apartment. Easy check-in, beautiful modern interior and you have everything you need: soft towels, hairdryer, coffee kit and a super comfy bed. Thank you for having us!

Good location to get either tram or u bHan or as we did a ten minute walk to Alexander platz

Goed kunnen overnachten om dit weekend naar een festival gingen in Berlijn.

Unser Aufenthalt bei Michael war rundum perfekt. Wir hatten im Vorfeld eine gute Kommunikation und das Zimmer war für unsere Zwecke ideal.
Wir planen für kommendes Jahr wieder einen Aufenthalt bei ihm und hoffen wirklich sehr, dass es klappt!
Appt is as described

Bei Kerstin haben wir einen tollen Aufenthalt in Berlin genossen! Eine sehr nette Gastgeberin und eine super Remisewohnung mit süßem Gartenzugang, die auf jedenfall empfehlenswert ist!

Amazing staff, location was very peaceful and easy to find, room was great, comfy, spacious and with everything you need! Wish i stayed more yo truly enjoy the amenities, hope i can go back soon!

Beautiful, quiet apartment in a cosy neighbourhood. Great and attentive host. One if not the best airbnb:s I’ve stayed in.

Cons: The room was very small and while the owner made good use of the space - 3 large storage drawers under the bed, for example, it really isn’t suitable if you have suitcases - we had nowhere to put them and the two plus our carry-ons took up what little floor space we had. un super endroit à proximité du centre, une hôte très agréable et serviable. je recommande !

Ideal como punto de partida para descubrir la ciudad. Muy cerca de Alexander platz. Edificio antiguo sin ascensor pero piso cuidado y adecuado para estancias cortas.

Einfach ein geniales Erlebnis. Wird in ewiger Erinnerung bleiben
The apartment is in a great location if you have business meetings in the Station Berlin arena. Nice design and a great shower make you feel at home and much better than in a hotel!

Vielen Dank für den schönen Aufenthalt :)
heerlijk verblijf gehad in dit mooie appartement. van alle gemakken voorzien in een prachtige gezellige buurt.
Beautiful place to stay at Berlin and Mandy is a great host. Very recommended!
Lovely place, better than a hotel! The room was very spacious and faced a quiet street. The neighborhood was also great with many restaurants within walking distance.

I would absolutely stay again. Nastasya’s flat is lovely and the room was gorgeous. Large and the private balcony was a dream. I was delighted to stay, was very comfortable the whole time as a solo traveler, and very appreciative of Nastasya’s hospitality. Loved the neighborhood (one of my favorites in Berlin); this was a great value and usually booked for a reason!

Kelly´s apartment is nice and clean. It also has a very nice and potent little ironer. Other than the shower, which does not quite work as desired, and the shades that does not really block the light, the apartment is very confortable, clean and cozy.

Now the location of the apartment is not close to mitte. And because of that I´ve lowered the number of stars on my review. Yes there is the metro station, but that could be quite confusing for a short stay. And given that the place is far from downtown, I think the place is overpriced.

Kelly and her husband are great people and for a long stay and lower price the place would be great.
Schönes Zimmer, gute Design Auswahl. Check in war sehr einfach und Mike ist nett, entspannt und am Start. Gerne wieder!

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Stéphanie. Le logement est propre, et après plusieurs séjours en Airbnb, je n'en avais jamais vu un aussi bien équipé. nice place maintained very well

Great apartment in a superb location of Berlin plus the views!

Wunderschöne und stilvolle Wohnung in perfekter (zentraler) Lage.

Absolut empfehlenswert für einen Städtetrip!

Nice and clean apparment with Tram just outside the door. Nice cafés and restaurants around the corner. Try breakfast at Napoljanska f e. We've had a great stay and there was enough space for 1 adult and three kids 7 to 16 years old.

Great value. Quiet location so easy to get some rest for the next day's exploring. some good local amenities if you don't want to travel too far, but just 2 ubahn stops from central Alexanderplatz, so was great for getting into the city centre quickly

Madlen hat uns sehr freundlich empfangen. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und wie beschrieben ausgestattet. Die Lage war sehr ruhig und trotzdem alles schnell zu erreichen. Der Vietnamese ums Eck war einfach der Hammer 😋

Martin hat immer sehr schnell geantwortet. Seine Unterkunft war für unsere Zwecke genau richtig mit einer guten, zentralen Lage. one of the best room i stayed..owner is helpful and warmheart...highly recommended

wspaniały wypoczynek...

Alles wie beschrieben und ein reibungsloser unkomplizierter Ablauf. So muß das sein. Vielen Dank.

Wunderschöne Unterkunft am Waldrand und nicht weit weg vom kleinen Müggelsee , Maria ist eine sehr herzliche Gastgeberin.

Very good apartment, perfect for what we needed, in walking distance to train and bus stops to the centre and also in walking distance to all the sights!

We really enjoyed our stay at at Nena apartments, the location is perfect for walking to attractions, we arrived late around 11pm but check in was simple & smooth. We would highly recommend the apartments.

No frills comfortable place to stay on the ground floor. It was a bit hot the day I was there and no air conditioning so the room was a bit stuffy. There was a small fan that helped some. Bring your own shampoo and conditioner, only one liquid soap provided. Coffee maker with sugar and cream nice touch. Plenty of places to eat within walking distance.

Astrids apartment was a perfect place for our vacation in Berlin. Close to the Berlin ring motorway, good parking and easy transport to the center of Berlin. The apartment is very spacious and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. We really enjoyed coming back to the cool cellar apartment after many our in the city with over 30 degrees. Astrid made us feel welcome and is a super host. We can absolutely recommend the apartment for anyone who want a quiet place close to Berlin
A fabulous base for a week in Berlin. Really well-located apartment, with all the amenities we needed. Instructions from the hosts were clear and very helpful, especially with pictures.

Die Wohnung sah aus wie auf den Fotos und war wie beschrieben. Wir waren mit 5 Personen zu Gast und haben gut Platz gehabt. Die Wohnung ist recht einfach eingerichtet und wirkt etwas abgewohnt. Das Geschirr und insbesondere das Service sind zusammengewürfelt und nicht schön. Wir hatten auch Pech, dass die Spülmaschine nicht mehr funktionierte. Besonders nachteilig war die Lage von zwei der drei Schlafzimmer zur Strasse und zur Sonnenseite. Entweder war es laut oder warm. Für 70,- Euro Endreinigung sollte sie aufgeräumter und sauberer sein. Die Fenster sind wohl schon seit Jahren nicht mehr geputzt.
Die Lage war mit Nähe zu einer U-Bahnstation und der Bushaltestelle ziemlich gut. Restaurants sind einige in der Nähe. Empfehlung: Landhaus und Viet Rice.
Die beiden Gastgeber sind sehr nette Personen und sehr hilfsbereit und unterstützend.
Tolles Hostel, tolle Gastgeberin und ein guter Standort! Definitiv eine Empfehlung.
Very clean, modern and nice place, there is a train station and a market only 1 minute away!
Outstanding host, very clean and cozy place in a great location. Already miss it to stay for a longer period of time. Highly recommended!

Super Lage in nettem Viertel mit vielen Cafés und Restaurants, Supermarkt, Apotheke, Eisdiele usw., 5 Minuten zur U-Bahn . Das Apartment war perfekt als gemütliche Basis für 2 Mädels, die ihr Praktikum in Berlin absolviert haben. Für einige Wochen alles da, was man braucht. Ruhig, da die Fenster zum Innenhof zeigen und auch bei Sommerhitze angenehm kühl.  Phillipp  war jederzeit bei Fragen erreichbar, ein kleines technisches Problem  wurde sofort behoben. Alles in allem ein Apartment einfach zum Wohlfühlen und für einen Aufenthalt in Berlin nur zu empfehlen.
Lovely big apartment in a great location in Berlin, near to transport and a quiet area. Jonas had great communication throughout. Would recommend

I had a great experience during my short stay at Andreas's place in Berlin. Julian was there to greet me and show me the room which is very spacious. The flat is clean, offers a shared bathroom and kitchen and is very well located with multiple train stations as well as bus stops in walking distance. I would recommend other travelers to stay there when in Berlin. Thanks and all the best, Torsten

What a beautiful home! It’s in a great part of town with lots of food and coffee options! Walk 10 minutes or even less, in either direction and there’s something delicious. I enjoyed the natural supermarket that was near by (Alnatura Super Natur Markt) and also the bakery, Zeit für Brot.
I took Uber majority of the time with my parents, and they arrived within 2 minutes every time. I did see public transportation close by if that is ur main mode of transportation.
I’d definitely recommend Yoren’s place for 1-2 travelers. Sleeping on the pull out sofa was comfy but loud. If you are a deep sleeper, you may not notice.
The living room was arranged with live. The kitchen was fully stocked. The bathroom and shower room was Super clean. Great water pressure.
I communicated mainly with the manager via WhatsApp. Highly recommend people download this app when you travel to Europe. It’s commonly used. I’m not trying to advertise or promote the company, just stating that many airBnB owners/managers use this as a mode of communication.
Enjoy your stay at this beautiful home!
Very nice apartment and is in a very central location making it easy to travel throughout Berlin.

I would highly recommend staying with Anna - her place is beautiful, clean and equipped with anything you might need. The location is ideal, with lots of cafes, bars and restaurants, and very close to the canal, where you can enjoy a peaceful stroll.

Ein tolles kleines Apartment, mit vielen liebevollen Details und einer stimmigen Einrichtung. Gute Lage, ich konnte zu Fuss nach Mitte gelangen und war mit einem Sharing-Rad in wenigen Minuten in Prenzlauer Berg. Straßenbahn/Bus zudem fast vor der Tür.
Ich kann mir sehr gut vorstellen, nochmal zurückzukommen!
Marie is probably one of the best hosts. The accomodation is lovely and located in one of the best neighborhood in Berlin with a massive amount of restaurants and bars. We really enjoyed our stay.

We couldn't have gotten more lucky with Fadeih's place. We were with a group of 8, which was perfect. Lovely apartment and even more spacious than shown on the pics. Fadeih was very responsive and proactive with answering the questions that our group of eight had. Thanks a lot, we will certainly come again! !
Great stay. Nice location. Very convenient apartment
Great Accomodation. Bernd was a great host

Martin was a great host! He was very quick to answer any questions that I had. The flat is quite spacious and comfortable. You can't beat the location! It's near two U-bahn stops (Mendelssohn and Potsdamer Platz) and you are able to walk to many of Berlin's attractions within a few minutes.

Dörte und Oliver sind Gastgeber, wie man sie sich nur wünschen kann. Absolut zuverlässig, freundlich und hilfsbereit. Wir waren über ein verlängertes Wochenende in Berlin und haben uns sofort zu Hause gefühlt. Die Details machen den Unterschied. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Matthias & Diana
Sehr schöne Unterkunft die sehr gut zu erreichen ist (ca. 15 Minuten bis Alexanderplatz mit der Sbahn).
Sehr gute Lage, schöne und saubere Wohnung. Würde Georgy als Gastgeber auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen.
Katharina hosted my daughter Alana who absolutely loved her stay at Katharina’s.
Alles prima, habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt, komme gerne wieder
It was a pleasant stay
Einfaches aber sehr schönes Hotel in einer tollen Lage. Sehr zu empfehlen
Apartamento espacioso y la piscina y sauna muy recomendable.

The house is in a quiet neighbourhood, with plenty of places to eat nearby. Very close to the airport and great if you need to work at HZB/Bessy.  Günter's family has been great, very friendly and helpful. The room is big and the bed comfortable.
It was really a wonderful apartment for the trip to Berlin.

Vi havde nogle dejlige dage i Alexandras lejlighed. Der var rent og pænt, og vi havde alt, hvad vi skulle bruge til os to voksne og fem børn. Der var også god underholdning til børnene: spil, bordfodbold og masser af tegnefilm på tv’et. Køkkenet havde også alt, hvad man skal bruge til madlavning, og der lå et supermarked meget tæt på. Der var gode transportmuligheder tæt på lejligheden, og masser at se i nabolaget. Tæt på Mauerpark med en god legeplads og marked i weekenden! Alex svarede hurtig og var meget hjælpsom, hvis vi oplevede problemer eller havde spørgsmål. Vi anbefaler denne lejlighed!
Appartement agréable, bien équipé et idéalement situé.

Die Ausstattung des Apartments war spitze. An Küchenutensilien war alles vorhanden. Supermärkte und öffentlicher Nahverkehr sind in Laufweite. Auch die Kommunikation mit Stefan war unkompliziert. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder :)

It was very good indeed and the large apartment is exactly as described and as in the photographs.  We all loved it.  For a group of 8 friends or family it is very well set up and there were some very nice and convenient places for evening meals in the immediate area too.  All clean, well stocked with anything you need in the kitchen and with comfortable beds.  Super experience and highly recommended.
Everything was great. Public transportation conveniently placed. The streets were a little dirty and crowded but i did not mind that much.

Perfect airbnb that is very clean on arrival. Next door, communication with the owners was very good!
recommended!

Wir waren super zufrieden mit dem Zimmer und besonders mit dem Check-In es war sehr sauber und unkompliziert.
Auf jeden Fall für kurzen und langen Aufenthalt zu empfehlen!

The apartment was spacious and comfortable. The beds were comfortable and good for tall people. The directions to get there were clear. A bit of pressure to arrive at a stated time which did not go well with the hazards of travel. We had a small issue at the apartment with water but felt uncomfortable bothering the host since it might cause inconvenience.
There was a nice bottle of wine waiting for us and a helpful booklet of things to do and rules for the apartment. There were some strong limitations on using the washer/dryer which made it impossible for our stay. It would have been nice if there were things like shampoo and extra towels. Very close to a metro which made it easy to get around into and around Berlin. A comfortable place to explore the city from.

We had a wonderful stay! Its a really cute place which looks onto an internal courtyard. The flat was very clean, nicely decorated and felt secure. The location was great, and allowed us to easily get to other parts of the city. I would absolutely recommend staying here. Thanks !

We highly recommend staying at Sebastian’s centrally located yet quiet and peaceful apartment. Sebastian is very friendly and proactively reached out to see if we needed help with anything. Thank you for your hospitality!
Singer Hostel was amazing! The staff were super friendly, the rooms were clean and comfortable. The common areas had a great vibe. Would definitely stay here again. Great value for the price!

Wir, zwei Jugendliche und ich, als Mama, suchten nach geeigneten Adjektive zum alten Kiosk... skurril, berlintastisch, urig,...beschreiben diesen wohl am besten. Unterkunft samt Gastgeber, gerne wieder. 😁

Die Wohnung liegt in guter Lage in Berlin und es gibt Parkplätze direkt vor der Tür. Der Check-in verlief problemlos und die Kommunikation war schnell und unkompliziert. Die Wohnung war ausreichend für 5 Personen und wir haben uns dort wohlgefühlt. Gerne wieder!

The place is good. It's very tidy and very retro-sheek. It does sacrifice some usability for style unfortunately. I probably wouldn't recommend it to anyone privacy conscious. The main room looks onto the road, and the curtains are close to see through. The shower doesn't provide good privacy and could use a redesign of where the curtain goes. There is no curtain on the toilet and the curtain to the kitchen is similarly see through. The kitchen is one of the better equipped I've had at an AirBnB though, and make sure you pack your own soaps and shampoos because the host doesn't provide any. Overall a good experience though. It's a very clean place.

The apartment of Christina is really nice, the room was clean and the bathroom as well. The location of the apartment is not really close to the city center, but it is so close to the metro that is not really a problem. It is perfect if you need to stay in this area of the city. Christina was super helpful and I really appreciate her help with the taxi and also with my early check-in. Highly recommended. 😉
logement trés propre,  très facile d'accés.

Peaceful place, we felt right home. Heating system is very effective, makes the place warm in minutes. Water pressure in shower is satisfactory. Pillows are ok but some people -like me- may require two of them since they are pretty thin.
Location is great, walkable distance almost everywhere in Mitte (within 1,5km) Thorstrasse is stone throw away and you can find many restaurants nearby. I would strongly recommend this apt even for long stays in Berlin.

It was the perfect space to come back to after a day of sight seeing. We loved the quiet setting and location next to so many nice cafes and bars and would definitely stay again!
Fantastic place! Great shower, amazing bed, kitchen fully equipped, warm, charmy, ... just brilliant!

The apartment had a loud personality as it is a reflection of the host. Everything was functional and we received a welcome drink. We had some problems with the wifi connection and Katharina helped us with it but if we did not have data we wouldn’t be able to communicate and get that fixed. We missed the wifi manual sent to us prior as it was in German.
The place is near Maude park which is a really nice neighbourhood to be in. One downside of older buildings is that the insulation is not very good, we felt a constant cool air entering the bedroom even with the heater on. The kitchen, toilet and bathtub are clean.
There isn’t really any space for storage for our clothes or bags except for some coat hangers, so if you are staying for a longer time, it’s something for you to consider.

Dieser Hostel ist für junge Menschen und Leute die gerne Feiern sowie trinken sehr gut geeignet.

Hasan quickly became a great friend through our conversations on life and partying in Berlin. The house felt like home with beautiful views from both balconies. The bed was comfortable, and the check in and out process was smooth.
Location is a great starting point to walk to museums, monuments, parks, coffee, etc.
This was the start to my first trip in Germany, and it could not have been any better.
I hope to hang out with Hasan again one day!

considero que el espacio está muy bien y satisface las necesidades de los huéspedes. solo hay tres comentarios.

The location is awesome with lots of shops and restaurants around you to discover and the tram to downtown Berlin and all its sights is only a 3min walk around the corner. The garden is pretty. The house is old, and we heard people going on with their daily activity but it wasn’t anything too loud.
Ich hatte eine sehr gute Zeit. Sonja hat bei allen Fragen und Problemen sofort geholfen.

Amazing property run by such lovely, helpful hosts. We loved everything and would recommend to anyone looking for excellent value and amenities. Thanks so much Soren and Nina!

Alles war einfach super !! Die beiden Häuser waren unglaublich gut ausgestattet und auf Wünsche wurde eingegangen. Wir hatten einen wundervollen Aufenthalt und möchten von Herzen Danke sagen und auf Wiedersehen, wir kommen sicher wieder.
Die Unterkunft ist gut von der U-Bahnstation erreichbar. Zu Fuß war ich in 15 Minuten bei der FU. Die Unterkunft war  zweckmäßig eingerichtet und der Gastgeber sehr freundlich.

Daniel was super responsive to my questions, usually answering in less than a minute. His communication was very consistent, helpful & clear. I would definitely stay here again, and highly recommend this sweet space.
very nice, clean and functional apartment, a few meters from the tram / metro station (S).

Christoph is amazing,gentle,kind man. He explains everything and showing you through the balcony where to go..and drink coffee and more.. u bahnn( train) is really close by..also the ke de we( huge mall) the apartment is awsome,big,warm.. the fireplace works.. a big tab with hot water always!!

The appartement is brand new and looks great. The living room is a very comfortable place to just hang out, having lots of natural light and a nice and big couch. The s-bahn is right round the corner and brings you to the center of town quickly, but there are also two u-bahn lines closeby. Jörg provided up to date directions on getting to the appartement from the airport, making for a smooth arrival. Great place to stay!

Great please to stay for a 2-5 nights in Berlin. Has everything you need and great transport links. Dietrich was really responsive and helpful via the AirBnB chat too.

Thanks Ece for let me stay at your place. Very good location near to Alexanderplatz. The room can improve but was okay to sleep, good wifi.

I stayed 3 months in Michael's flat during an internship in Berlin.
+ sides: The flat is much better than on the picture!! The best thing about it is the light (there is a balcony, even though I did not use it) and the broad living room. The flat is equipped with all useful materials.
+ The flat is really close to line U2 underground named Kaiserdamm very useful to go to the city center.
Only two downsides: First I would only recommend to buy a Micro-wave it would have helped me a lot :)). The main downside anyway was Internet!! The box the host provided stopped working after a few days/hours of use. The host was kind enough to come to see and help but brought me a sheet with the data consulted which did not make me at ease and told me that I did use too much Internet and downloaded movies which was false plus he recognized he does not know anything about Internet. It was a bit akward as he also commented on the fact I was worried not to have Internet -- but perhaps it is a generation's gap (or not?) I had only watched news and a few website online as I worked but anyway this is the only downside and Michael tried his best afterwards to help me find Internet for 3 months, which was not easy as it is a short period, and I honestly thank him for this. At the end I was myself too busy to explore the other options he e-mailed me and I used my phone for Internet, which was really expensive: I paid about 80 euros the first month but this is partly my fault as I did not take the time to go to an Internet shop as he advised me to do!
So: great location, nice host and bright; well-equipped flat. It is perfect for a short stay, I just recommend buying a microwave and a better Internet device / connection (I think the comments below were already pointing at problems with Internet so it would be a good idea because many people do need Internet and the flat's description should not include it otherwise)

The house combines old-fashioned charm (think velvet curtains and thick carpets) with top-notch amenities: comfortable beds, excellent bathrooms, a huge living/dining area, great kitchen, flawless wi-fi. Everything works, everything is perfect. Gaby’s communication, attention to detail, thoughtfulness and hospitality are outstanding. She is a host who genuinely cares about her guests. Frohnau is in the north of Berlin but only 30 minutes or so from the centre by S-Bahn. The station is only 10-15 minutes’ walk from the house and the trains run often (every 10 minutes). Bus 125 (200 metres from the house) connects with bus 128 at Kurt-Schumacher-Platz for an easy, convenient way to reach Tegel airport (and vice-versa). Frohnau village is very attractive: three supermarkets, boutique shops, good cafes, big houses - and trees! Frohnau indeed is surrounded by forest. We took a fantastic walk through some beautiful forest and around a lake (Hubertussee), following the former course of the Berlin Wall. We passed a poignant memorial at one of the old watch-towers. We will never forget our Christmas at Gaby’s house.

What a wonderful place to stay. Fantastic location, very comfortable apartment, great host: couldn't ask for more.
