At the end of every well-walked day, we were very happy to get back there.

We had 3 people stay at the apartment and it was a great space for us! Comfortable beds and a functional kitchen space. The coffee was greatly appreciated! We appreciated the flexibility of check-in, and Simon communicated wonderfully to make the process smooth. Only downsides were a couple of stains, and the couch wasn't very comfortable to relax on, but nothing that detracted from the quality of our stay. The location was convenient, and it was extremely quiet at night. We would gladly return!
Anca was very hospitable. Would recommend stay.
The place is amazing, decoration/design quite nice, personal very kind. Thank you for a very pleasant stay!
We had a lovely stay! :)
This was the second time we booked Sandra's place. Everything is as described. She is a great host and we happily recommend her.
très bien et très propre !
Gute Wohnung, ruhige Lage, U-Bahn keine 3 Minuten entfernt, Bäckerei 100m entfernt, Supermarkt 300 Meter. Gerne wieder.

De kamer en badkamer was grondig schoongemaakt en gezellig ingericht. De voorziening is echter verouderd en zeker de badkamer kent vochtproblemen, waardoor er schimmel zichtbaar is en er een muffe geur hangt. Het contact met de host was erg beperkt en onpersoonlijk. De ligging is prima, vlakbij het centrum met de metro, op wandelafstand van het Tempelhof en 's nachts toch erg stil. Handig dat er een supermarkt bij de deur is en parkeergelegenheid in de straat.

100% would stay here again!
Philipp and Mara's apartment is surprisingly spacious and was perfect for our 6-day stay. The bed is super comfy, the shower is strong, with instant hot water, and there is all the cooking equipment you need.
The apartment is on the ground floor, with bicycle parking for the apartment outside the windows. It's nice and quiet even if someone comes to park their cycle.
We adored the location. The apartment is in a street which is lined with little gardens and seats/tables to park yourself and people watch/drink a beer. I am on crutches and felt safe walking on my own around the area at night. There are cafes, restaurants and little convenience shops up and down the street, and we ate our way round the world without having to walk more than a few hundred metres! We definitely recommend Mephisto which is the cafe right next door.
The apartment is a short walk from the U-bahn, and there were e-bikes and e-scooters to hire on the doorstep.
Das Zimmer ist super ausgestattet, sehr sauber und es wurde auf alles geachtet - wie im Hotel! Außerdem unkomplizierte Kommunikation und Check-in, sowie gute Lage. Absolute Empfehlung!
We loved our stay. Gregor was very attentive and quick to respond. His listing was just as described and I would recommend it.

Wir waren vom 13.4 bis 16.4 zu Gast in Jörg's Raumkapsel.Der Aufenthalt war Mega, genau wie auf den Bildern und in den Kommentaren beschrieben.Wir sind aus dem Grinsen gar nicht mehr rausgekommen.
Es war alles sehr unkompliziert und ein sehr freundlicher entspannter Vermieter.Also wer kein Hilton braucht und mal was außergewöhnliches machen will dann unbedingt den Banga mieten.Leider kann man nur fünf Sterne vergeben aber die sehr, sehr gerne.Dann bis bald mal wieder, Jörg in deiner Raumkapsel :-)

The apartment is clean and has everything you need for your stay. The only remark is that it´s a ground floor on street level. This means having no windows you can open except the door and the little one above the door. The flat is very bright because of the big windows on the walls. Overall is warm, well located, and clean.
Great apartment with easy access to metro and train. Center of Berlin with beautiful surrounding
It was really nice

The apartment was very clean and cozy – everything was just as described. Great communication with the host, who was very helpful and friendly ☺️ The location is excellent – close to the U-Bahn and S-Bahn, so it's very well connected to the rest of Berlin. There are also some nice restaurants nearby, which was a great bonus. It was a bit noisy at times due to passing trains, but it didn’t bother us much. Definitely recommend!
Audrey was fantastic is all ways possible and her space is nice and separated from the rest of the house. It's like having your own space in Berlin. 5 stars. I'll be back.
Great place for a stay with kids. Nice neighborhood with great access to public transport. Dörte was a helpful host and very quick to answer our questions. Would stay again!

Le centre de Berlin est accessible en métro ou à pied en longent la Spree.
La Karl Marx Allee est très proche et mène aux restes du mur de Berlin.
La réception a été très accueillante et arrangeante, le logement a parfaitement convenu à notre très court séjour dans la capitale allemande.

Great place to stay while we explored Berlin for several days.
It’s a one of a kind space that has everything you need.
Franz was an excellent host, very responsive and easy to coordinate with.
We’d gladly stay here again on our next trip to Berlin.

Sehr nette Gastgeber.
Tolle Wohnung.
Wir konnten abends im Garten sogar einen Fuchs beobachten.

Ich war für 6 Wochen in dem Airbnb und bin gänzlich zufrieden.  Mir hat es an nix gefehlt und trotz der Größe konnte man es super auch über einen längeren Zeitraum dort aushalten. Bei Fragen stand Andreas immer zur Verfügung und auch als es mir mal nicht so gut ging, haben sich Andreas und seine Partnerin sehr lieb um mich gekümmert und mir z.B. Tee und Medikamente oder ein Wärmekissen rausgelegt. Mein Freund war ebenfalls für einige Tage mit dort und wir haben festgestellt, dass es sich auch zu zweit gut dort lebt. Man verbringt ja tagsüber eh die meiste Zeit im schönen Berlin. Die kleine Wohnung war sehr sauber und liebevoll eingerichtet. Das herunterfahrbare Bett ist eine tolle, platzsparende Idee und was auch nicht zu unterschätzen ist, ist der separate Hauseingang, was einem viel Flexibilität gibt. Man ist schnell an der S-Bahn und erreicht von dort das Zentrum, sowie die umliegenden Bezirke wunderbar. Ich würde immer wieder herkommen!

Fantastic and beautiful airport in a beautiful and peaceful part of Berlin. My only note is that it was a little harder to get into the centre of Berlin than imagined by public transport it took us about 1hr20 to get there. The apartment itself was even bigger than it looks and was very comfortable with great bedding.
Great location, great flat and an accommodating host. Highly recommended

Wendy was a great host. She was very flexible with my late check in, which I appreciated very much. She also checked on me during my trip to make sure I was alright. I felt well taken care of. Highly recommended! Thanks!
Recomendable para unos dias!
Die Unterkunft war sehr gemütlich und die Gegend ist sehr schön. Sonntags der Flohmarkt im Mauerpark oder die ganzen Cafés und Restaurants in der Nähe waren unser Highlight.
Great place and close to everything!

Really enjoyed our stay here. Very quick response time whenever I had questions and the place is beautiful! Close to public transportation and has a 24/7 convenient store right next to it. Would recommend if you’re in Berlin!

Anton의 숙소는 기대했던점과 다른 사람들의 후기와는 다르게 저희에게는 만족스럽지않았습니다. 숙소가 4층인 부분은 알고있었지만, 생각보다 더 높은 계단이었기에 무거운 캐리어를 소지하셨다면 분명히 고려해보아야 하는 점인것 같습니다. 숙소를 찾는 과정에서 안내해 준 이름과 입구에 표시되어있던 이름이 달라 찾는 과정에서 많은 어려움을 겪었습니다. (숙소를 찾으실경우 이부분은 참고하시면 좋을꺼같네요)
또한 머물고 있던 Anna의 태도는 호의적이지 못한 느낌으로 다가왔으며 숙소는 매우 더웠고 문을 열면 아침마다 공사하는 소리가 시끄러워 잠을 설쳐야했습니다. 그리고 방에 놓여진 파란쇼파는 너무나도 더러웠습니다. 사진처럼 소품이나 가구들은 멋지고 아름다웠지만 긴여행을 하는 여행객들에게는 편안한 분위기의 숙소는 아니었던 것 같아 아쉬움이 많이 남습니다.

Veronika‘s Apartment is really pretty!
Very confortable and quiet.
With M10 only A few minutes away from the Tran Station.
Surrounded from nice Restaurants, Coffes, Shops and Markts.
I was never in this side from Berlin and I am sure I will return to this part of the city again.
Veronika thank you for the Restaurants and Coffes suggestions, they were amazing!
Ruhige und gute Wohnung mit sehr guter Anbindung Bus und Bahn

100% recomendable por instalaciones, ubicación, flexibilidad… pero por encima de todo por un servicio EXCELENTE. Nos atendieron a las mil maravillas y nos ayudaron con los problemas que nos surgieron. Difícil encontrar una atención mejor, repetiremos seguro. Gracias!

Loft de una sola habitación bien integrado. Limpio y práctico. Muy bien ubicado. La comunicación con Alex bien, sin embargo su actitud para resolver problemas es mala. La lavadora de ropa no funcionó y solo se limitó a decir "sorry. No puedo hacer nada por ti". Entiendo que eran fechas difíciles, antes de Navidad, pero su actitud para buscar una solución fue cero.
Wir haben diese Unterkunft schon das 2x in diesem Jahr gebucht. Die Betten sind super gemütlich & wir sind total zufrieden. Wir kommen gern wieder✨
De accomodatie was super. het klopte perfect met alle info op de fotos. het was redelijk rustig gelegen met winkeltjes in de buurt dus alles wat je nodig had.

This beautiful and spacious home is exactly as pictured on the listing, and contained beautiful touches that made our stay in Berlin outstanding! The location was amazing, with a Turkish market appearing on the street twice a week (the gozleme was amazing), an insane vegan donut shop metres away and close to the metro. It was close to the nightlife for us, but wasn’t noisy or feel unsafe. A huge bonus is it is on the ground floor, so no lugging suitcases up stairs!
Thanks again Frank, we can’t wait to come back!

We had an amazing stay at Magdas place, a beautiful and comfortable home to have as a base for our extended visit to Berlin. This listing will be a ‘superhost’ sooner than later.
The apartment is perfectly located for access to all that Bergmannkiez has to offer and is a short walk from multiple access points to Berlins public transport system making the whole city easily and quickly accessible. Within the immediate area are a seemingly endless amount of amazing restaurants (at all price points), markets,great shopping (new &vintage), bars, parks (Viktoria Park is right across the street, templehof feld is ~2km away) & more.
The apartment is stocked with everything you’ll need for your stay. If you want to cook your own meals the kitchen has all the equipment you need. The bedroom and mattress are comfortable and there are really effective blackout blinds if you wish to sleep in.
The bathroom is nice with heated floors and a standard shower/bath setup, there is also a clothes washer and drying line in the bathroom.
Magda is a great & prompt communicator, and was able to make adjustments on the fly for our check in process when we had a flight delay that caused us to miss a connection.
There was a small issue with the building heat during our stay and Magda was prompt with communication on this matter and co-ordinated for someone to come assess the issue in the unit.
Thanks Magda! We'd be thrilled to stay here again when we return to Berlin.
We had a very nice stay. Thanks for having us! We would like to stay with you next time in Berlin
Lage, Lage, Lage

Dit was onze eerste airbnb ervaring. Dit is ons supergoed bevallen. Het contact met Tom verliep meteen erg prettig. De woning was heel ruim, schoon en lekker zonnig! Wij voelden ons er thuis. De metro is om de hoek. Wij komen zeker nog een keer weer in Berlijn en indien mogelijk kiezen we weer deze woning.
Persönlich liebevoll eingerichtete Wohnung im schönsten Kiez.
Great place for a short stay in Berlin, has everything you need! Great location and very clean! No complaints
Great apartment.
Super Lage, sehr sauber und nur zu empfehlen!

Sehr individuelle und bunt zusammengestellte Wohnung, in der jeder Zentimeter gut genutzt wird. Tolle Erfahrung in einer Wohnung zu leben, die eigentlich ein Geschäftsraum/Laden war. Tolle Kommunikation mit Caroline.
Schönes, sauberes Apartment in ruhiger Lage! Schnelle und sehr nette Kommunikation mit Jan. Gerne jederzeit wieder!

A well situated location in a walking distance from a few public transportstion stations.
A couple of points:
at night with open windows it can be a bit noisy due to being situsted on an avenue but nothing much to spoil the stay overall.
Great place, clean and comfortable + Close to lots of great restaurants and shops. Quick and easy communication. Would love to stay here again!

Vi var meget glade for den private p-plads i gården og badekarret. Lejligheden ser ud som på billederne. Kvarteret er hyggeligt, særligt Goltzstr og Akazienstr. Værten var hurtig til at svare på spørgsmål. Vi havde nogle gode dage.

Gianni was a fantastic host and we loved staying in his apartment. The location is fantastic - Neukolln is a great area and Gianni was communicative, friendly and helpful. The apartment is lovely and very light. The kitchen is very small but you can cook in it. The apartment looks exactly like the pictures and the living room in particular feels like a home from home. I really recommend!

Lage perfekt und unkomplizierte Kommunikation.
Allerdings war das Zimmer nicht sauber. Im Bett waren Haare und große Flecken.
Auch das Badezimmer war nicht genügend geputzt.

Well located, about 5 mins away from 2 ubahn stations, lots of trams and buses. The flat was large and clean, just as described and spacious.  Checking in was challenging as the lockbox was not where it was supposed to be. I called a few times and messaged before finally getting through to someone. The guy wasn’t helpful, saying we had the wrong location, before he finally sent us instructions to a back up key. He also didn’t apologise for this and just seemed annoyed I’d called. But the flat was good once we were in, well equipped and a good location.

Lägenheten var mycket äldre än vad man såg i bilderna. Trapphuset var mörk och luktade rök i hela huset. Själva lägenhet var dock mycket ren och stor med fin inredning. Värden var hjälpsam då det gick fel med incheckning och hämtning av nycklar.

Nadine's place was gorgeous, artistic, cozy, and inspired. I was here for a writing retreat and felt at home at the apartment. Everything needed was available and the location was great -- coffee shop and spätie downstairs, post nearby, plenty walkable, lots of restaurants. I was traveling and less communicative with Nadine prior to my arrival but she still left clear instructions for me to check in and out. Everything was clean and lovely. Thanks Nadine!

Carolina's apartment is simply lovely. The place is well furnished and has everything you need for both short and long stays. The apartment has a very quiet neighbourhood and it is well connected through trams and S-Bahn. It is also well located in one of Berlin's warmest "Bezirke", close to nice cafes, shops, supermarkets and the weekly market. Communication with Carolina were always smooth and quick. I will definitely come back for my next stay in Berlin!

ז'אן היה מאד שירותי והנכס היה נוח ובגדול מאד ותאם לציפיות.
יש לקחת בחשבון שזה בית שגרים בו אנשים ולכן יש הרבה חפצים אישיים וזה נראה כאילו מתארחים אצל מישהו.
המענה היה זריז מאד גם עבור תקלות שונות שנפתרו מייד
Cool place in a cool neighborhood. Highly recommend!

This is a great place to explore Berlin from. Very spacious and all the necessities for a great stay. A lot like staying at a friend's house. :-) Communication was great and we felt very at home here!
Es war super, vielen Dank. Gerne wieder
A very spacious and stylish apartment. Great location.

Wir hatten einen super Aufenthalt. Wir wurden nett empfangen.
Die Wohnung war sauber und ruhig und ist ein paar Gehminuten von der U-Bahn weg. Wir können die Wohnung für einen Berlin Besuch nur empfehlen.
Great stay in Renes Apartment stylish and comfortable Rene very friendly and helpful Location great for restaurants and nightlife Great for transport links Fabulous!! Would come back in a flash

We really enjoyed our stay.  We arrived late in the evening and special arrangements had to be made to let us in that we greatly appreciated.  The apartment is well stocked with towels, soap, water etc.   And there is a grocery store and a delicious Thai restaurant a few steps away!  Cute and convenient!  We would definitely stay there again!
Charlotte and Jeremy were very friendly and warm, and the place was super clean and comfortable with everything we needed. Thank you very much!
Appartamento situato in una zona comodissima, a pochi passi dalla stazione della metro. Complesso molto grande di appartamenti e nuovi.

Die Unterkunft war eine der schönsten bisher, die Bilder treffen voll zu und wir haben uns direkt wohlfühlen können. Mann sieht wie viel liebe in die Wohnung geflossen ist. Auch die Lage war sehr gut, wir sind zu Fuß in die Stadt gelaufen und am Sonntag könnten wir direkt auf den Flohmarkt vor der Tür.
Kommunikation hat wunderbar funktioniert, sehr freundlich. Also wirklich eine der besten Unterkünfte überhaupt 😉
Fantastic place at a reasonable price. Easy to reach Adlershof.

Het verblijf was heel goed! Het enige nadeel was dat de keuken in de eerste twee dagen heel erg stonk. We hebben dit laten weten aan de eigenaar, en ze hebben er meteen iets aangedaan. Voor de rest een heel leuk verblijf.

Schöner Aufenthalt. Alles sauber, nur alles schon etwas in die Jahre gekommen. Ich weiß, bei hohen Decken schwierig, aber es wäre schön gewesen, wenn die vielen Spinnenweben und teilweise auch Spinnen (Weberknechte) nicht mit im Zimmer gewesen wären ;) auch die Schrank-/Schiebetür im Flur ist mit entgegengekommen, da nicht mehr befestigt.
Toll ist, es eine Kaffeemaschine gibt (Nespresso) und zwei Kapseln dort lagen, damit man sich einen frischen Kaffee machen konnte, bevor man das Haus (Appartement) verlässt.

Expérience incroyable dans un environnement propice aux rencontres dans un quartier très intéressant. On se sent bien ici et je n’aurais pas pu imaginer mieux comme hébergement. Ma meilleure expérience sur Airbnb !
They try to get money out of everything. charged for a late checkout, while was not told by anyone that if you checkout at midday you get charged.
Good place for the price recommended.
Sehr nette Gastgeber

Great location, responsive host, easy check in and check out.
Would recommend.
100% Wohlfühlunterkunft = 100% empfehlenswert, sehr gerne wieder, jederzeit!

We had a lovely stay in Kai & Oana's apartment in Berlin. It feels very homely - we regularly visit Berlin and this is easily the nicest place we've stayed at so far. The Friedrichshain area is fantastic with lots of bars, restaurants & cafes, but the apartment is outside the busy area so is away from all the noise. Highly recommended.

Fijn ruim appartement gelegen aan een mooie binnenplaats.
Keuken is goed uitgerust met genoeg servies. Attent dat er ook koffie, thee en kruiden zijn.
Dichtbij een bushalte en ook wat eettentjes en supermarkt in de buurt.
Goed contact met Stephan en zijn medewerkers.

Wunderschönes Appartement in perfekter, stiller Lage. Man hat einen sehr guten Anschluss zur Innenstadt und kommt mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln überall schnell hin. Ich und mein Freund wurden sehr lieb und herzlich aufgenommen und die gesamte Kommunikation lief gut, gerade dafür, dass wir dort die ersten Gäste jemals waren. Dieser Aspekt ist jedoch auch, wo der einzige Kritikpunkt herrührt, der mir einfällt. Dadurch das die Wohnung brandneu ist, entstanden ein paar technische Komplikationen, darunter vor allem, dass wir für einen gewissen Zeitraum nicht duschen konnten, bis ein bestimmtes Problem an der Duschkabine behoben war. Das war jedoch kein Problem für uns und kommt sicherlich auch nach uns nicht mehr vor. Dementsprechend kann ich das Appartement nur weiter empfehlen und würde auch selbst in Erwägung ziehen, es wieder zu buchen, wenn ich die Gelegenheit bekommen sollte.

El departamento es muy lindo y limpio, está perfectamente ubicado, cerca de medios de transporte y la zona es tranquila para recorrer caminando.
Diego es muy amable y siempre estuvo predispuesto a ayudarnos.
Si algún día volvería a Berlín está sería mi primer opción.

Wunderbare Unterkunft für entspannte Abende und auch als Co-working space super geeignet.
Martin hat uns zum check in mit allem vertraut gemacht und sehr dafür gesorgt dass wir bei ihm ein unvergessliches Wochenende verbringen durften.
Wir kommen wieder :)

Very nice, comfortable and clean apartment in a central location. Convenient for all sightseeing, restaurants, bars and shops. Bus stops directly outside to the Hauptbahnhof. Staff friendly and helpful.
Tolle Unterkunft in wirklich genialer Umgebung direkt in der Nähe des Hakischen Markts, des Monbijou-Parks. Alles war sauber, gut organisiert, gepflegt. Ich habe mich rundum wohl gefühlt

Lovely apartment, excellent location, well connected to all parts of the city with public transport. Noise travels around the building easily though which was a little disappointing and curtains should cover the entire window openings, not just the centre of the windows with the glass. Was woken both mornings early by the light.
Lovely spacious clean room, well connected to public transport.
Le logement est loin du centre ville, conforme aux photos

Sehr schön gelegen für meine Bedürfnisse. S-Bahn fußläufig gut erreichbar, ebenso wie Bus und Straßenbahn. Einkaufen um die Ecke problemlos, sehr gute Bäckerei.
Für mich war die Unterkunft optimal.
Alles durchschnittlich bis Schlecht
Great stay and location
Thanks for letting me leave my backpack at your place for a little longer after checkout. :)
Sehr angenehmer Ort in einer schönen Umgebung an der Peripherie von Berlin. Spannende Gespräche über Gegenwart und Vergangenheit. Mit PV Panels und Lademöglichkeit.

Tolle, saubere Unterkunft in sehr guter Lage :) Viele Restaurants und Cafés fußläufig in der Nähe. Die Wohnung entspricht der Beschreibung und den Fotos.
Vielen Dank und wir kommen gerne wieder!

Wir haben uns in Birtes wunderschöner Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt. Das Zimmer hatte alles was man sich wünschen konnte. Die Betten waren super bequem, die Aussicht auf den grünen Innenhof herrlich. Das Zimmer selber ist so gemütlich und gleichzeitig praktisch, dass es einfach ideal für kürzere oder auch längere Aufenthalte ist. Das Badezimmer ist schön, sauber und geräumig. Es zu teilen war völlig unproblematisch. Birte selber ist eine tolle Gastgeberin. Sie ist hilfsbereit, entgegenkommend, flexibel,  und inspirierend. Es ist leicht zu kommunizieren und auch leicht sich in Ruhe zu lassen. Und schließlich: die Lage der Wohnung ist fantastisch. Restaurants, Cafés, Geschäfte, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel-alles ist in der Nähe. Wir können nur empfehlen bei Birte zu wohnen. Wir hatten eine wirklich wunderschöne Zeit und kommen sehr gerne wieder.
great apartment, walkable to many metro stations and in a good neighborhood. Sahin was friendly and helpful as well.
If you ever been in Berlin,just go to this hostel. Everything’s was soooooo good

Amazing flat,very well located, quiet building with wonderful garden an river terrace view, all you need to find in a rented apartment and on top a perfect host as Ursula. What do you want more...highly recommended.

Andreas was a great host - very flexible over arrival time and even helped me up the stairs with my bags. He made it clear he was there to help with anything I needed but I also got all the privacy I needed. The room is very comfortable, the wifi is strong and I found Charlottenburg a good base for travelling around Berlin.
Great apartment, nothing was missing, an hour walk from city centre. All went great.
Wundervolle Lodge, naturnah mit super Anbindung. Die Wohnung bietet alles was man braucht, mit ein bisschen Glück entdeckt man sogar Waschbären und Füchse :)
really lovely, ideally located apartment. clean and had all the amenities we needed.

Supernette und hilfsbereite Vermieter.
Wohnung tiptop sauber und super ausgestattet.
Отдыхали 3 дня. Расположение хорошее, тихий район возле леса. Рядом супермаркет и два отличных ресторанчика с вкусным пивом и едой. До метро пешком 5 минут. Рекомендую.

Alles Bestens, die Wohnung ist sehr zentral gelegen und trotzdem ruhig. Mariano hat sich sehr wohl gefühlt und war sehr begeistert ein Fahrrad zur Verfügung zu haben. Vielen Dank dafür. Gerne kommen wir wieder.
Cozy, clean, and perfectly located apartment, and Anna was such a nice and gracious host.

Helena's home is warm and inviting, very practical space.  On sunny days the private porch is lovely and nice distance from the lakes and forrest of the Grünewald, which is an amazing green space for nature lovers.  The house is also a short walk to the Halensee and beyond the highway, you are close to key places in West Berlin (e.g. Ku'damm).  Helena is a wonderful host and was very kind to us.
Great location, clean place & close to supermarkets. Responsive host and perfect location for exploring Berlin!

The whole experience was excellent! Tobias was extremely helpful, responsive and he went above and beyond to accommodate to our needs and requests. The place is big, beautiful, clean, and it has everything you need and even more. I want to come back to Germany just because of this place.

We had a lovely stay at Mia's place, very near to train station and lots in walking distance. Nowhere was too far away, very well connected. The area was good with plenty of restaurants nearby. The apartment was great, nice and clean and cosy :)

A perfect stay chez Monica. She was very helpful with getting me oriented, and recommendations for restaurant areas. The room is exactly what is described - great view, clean and comfortable. A great place, a great host, a great city! Thanks Monica.
That’s a great place!
cozy house with private bathroom. There Is a Little kitchen for breakfast or chai break, very nice! Antonia is very kind.

Schöne Wohnung in Einfamilienhausquartir.
Sehr gut mit öffentlichem Verkehr errichbar.

Gill's place is just perfect for exploring Berlin for a solo traveller or a couple. The apartment is spotless, and Gili makes sure of this. He also goes out of his way to ensure that your stay is a comfortable one. As for the location, it is very close to the train station, and you'll have plenty of choices for food (the Vietnamese place is of note). Would highly recommend the place.

Heerlijk verblijf gehad in dit mooie appartement. Het is van alle gemakken voorzien en op loopafstand van Alexanderplatz en het leuke Prenzlauer berg. Lekker bijkomen na een dag in de drukke stad. Shared bathrooms and showers are on each floor, and they were fine. On my first day, there was no hot water, and the radiators weren’t working, so I had a cold shower, but after reporting it, everything was fixed and worked smoothly. Keep in mind, there’s no elevator, so you’ll need to carry your luggage up the stairs. The hotel staff is only around during office hours, which could be an issue if something like the hot water goes out after hours.
Overall, it was a hostel-like experience in terms of price but with private rooms, which was perfect for me!

Everything as described - and even though we were just two people using two of the four bedrooms it was among the best value we could find in Berlin when we were traveling. I was a little worried at first when the website for submitting my ID didn't work (possibly a UK problem?), but the support staff got my ID uploaded properly in the end and everything worked perfectly while we were there. I had seen some Google reviews complaining about burglaries recently, but the flat felt very safe when we were there and the safe in the room made me feel much more confident about that. My only complaint would be that there was nowhere to put recycling in the building.
Overall I would definitely recommend a stay at the Numa Nook in future. It's a brilliant location for exploring central Berlin, with very useful facilities inside.

Loved Sabine's apartment!  Perfect location near restaurants, clubs, transportation.   Easy communication since acceptance.  Apartment had everything we needed.  Would definitely recommend!

La habitación es totalmente confortable, me sentí muy cómoda, mi viaje era para un encuentro profesional y pude trabajar muy bien en la magnifica mesa.
El barrio es está muy bien comunicado en una de las nuevas áreas emergentes de Berlin, llena de bares, restaurantes y gente joven, es un poco alternativo, para mí ideal.
Peggy es una excelente anfitriona, me he sentido acogida, he compartido la cocina cuando la necesité y me ha ayudado con información que necesitaba sobre el transporte, volvería.

Kleine aber gut ausgestattete Wohnung mit gemütlichen Bett (sehr bequeme Kissen & Decken)! Die Lage könnte besser sein, da es wenige Restaurants und Cafés in direkter Umgebung gibt. Da man in Berlin aber ja sowieso häufig mit den Öffentlichen unterwegs ist, war das kein Problem. Die Wohnung war an sich sehr sauber, es gab nur einige Spinnweben, die hätten entfernt werden können. Insgesamt trotzdem eine sehr zu empfehlende Unterkunft.
Heiko ist sehr freundlich. Das Ferienhaus gefällt uns besonders, der Park 100 meters rechts vom Haus hat viel Spaß gemacht, mit wunderschönem Sicht auf den See. Herzlich danke.
Small apartment but well equipped close to public transport and with nice restaurants in the area.
Wie immer alles bestens! Ich bedanke mich!
Gastgeber war wirklich sehr freundlich und bemüht, immer erreichbar. Die Lodge ist in der Tat etwas ganz besonderes
Sehr nett, sehr empfehlenswert. Great apartement.
Very nice apartment!
Super Service und eine tolle Lage.

Dias inesquecíveis na belíssima capital da Alemanha.
Melhor hostel que já hospedei.

Wir sind mit der einwöchigen Reise in Berlin sehr zufrieden. Der Aufenthalt in der Enrico's Wohnung gehört sicherlich dazu. Die Wohnung ist am 4. Stockwerk in einem alten Gebäude. Sie befindet sich in der Nähe von dem Kurfürstendamm und die Superfreundlich Edeka und Lidl sind nur einige hundert Meter entfernt. Gute Parkmöglichkeit an der Straße. Enrico und seine Frau waren auch superfreundlich und reagieren schnell auf unsere Anfragen.
Weil wir aus einer ruhigen kleinen Stadt kommen, war es in der Wohnung ein bisschen zu laut, wegen des Verkehrs und der Kneipen in der Nähe. Aber das wäre den Anderen nicht unbedingt ein Nachteil.
Alice’s place is very transit accessible, in a great neighborhood, and quiet.

Great location perfect to walk into town, for
Main attractions good transport links. Apartment clean, Marko explained everything. Got fit climbing stairs though. Recommend nice neighbourhood.
very cute and spacious apartment. great location with parks and restaurants closeby. train station in walking distance. we can highly recommend a stay with Anna

Clean & convenient place to stay in a cool neighbourhood. Has almost everything you need for a short stay.
The only downside was the room doesn’t have air conditioning, and the windows face over a courtyard with office buildings. Room got a bit stuffy and hot during the night so we slept with the windows and blinds open.
Probably wouldn’t recommend staying here in the hottest month of the year - but otherwise pretty good!

What a great little apartment. Ideally situated for getting to and from Brandenburg Airport, with the city equally accessible. We had a minor problem with the TV which Laura sorted out very promptly, and the advice she gave regarding local restaurants was most helpful. We would have no hesitation in recommending this apartment to friends and would happily book again if we return to Berlin [when the weather is better!]
L’appartement est bien desservi, plusieurs ligne de bus et de metro ! C’est propre et sécuritaire. Parfait pour un voyages entre ami.e.s.
Aufenthalt war toll, sehr gerne wieder! :)
Great place to stay. We enjoyed everything about the place.

Ute's apartment is in a great location and has everything needed for a comfortable stay. The transport connections are brilliant for travelling around the city and to and from the airport. Ute was really flexible about our arrival, which was quite late and gave us lots of recommendations (Curry 36 is a good option late at night and a great introduction to Berlin cuisine!) and she made us feel at home. The flat was warm when we visited in winter and I'm sure the little garden would be great in the summer too. Highly recommended.

Très bon séjour chez Kristin et Christian, hôtes accueillants et sympathiques !
Appartement très propre et lumineux, chambre conforme à la description et propre.
Au top !

Uns und unseren beiden Hunden hat es hier sehr gut gefallen. In wenigen Gehminuten sind eine Pizzeria, Café, Bäckerei und auch die S-Bahn zu erreichen. Alles war zu unserer Zufriedenheit und wir würden wieder kommen.

We stayed al Olga’s place for a week and felt at home. Everything we need was there. The garden is beautiful and relaxing. The neighbors are nice. Olga was always responsive and very helpful. Thank you for the stay!

I stayed with four friends in the apartment and it really exceeded our expectations. Beautifully designed and spacious with huge windows and loads of natural light. Everything was spotless and they have thought of all you need for a comfortable stay. We also enjoyed the information booklet about the architecture of the building and local recommendations.
Location was also great, easy to walk to lots of things and good public transport links.
We had a couple of questions/requests throughout our stay and the responses on Airbnb messaging were super quick and helpful. Overall, we would definitely recommend!
Very convenient and comfortable. Easy access to public transport.
Saubere Wohnung, tolle Lage!

Eine verkehrstechnisch wirklich gut gelegene Wohnung.
Vom Nauener Platz fahren tagsüber alle 5 Minuten Bahnen (sonntags und in den späteren Abendstunden alle 10 Minuten.)
Für mich und meine zwei Kinder war die Raumaufteilung gut (ein Bett 140cm? im Wohnzimmer und ein Bett 160cm? im Schlafzimmer; die Matratzen waren bequem). So konnte man sich auch mal zurückziehen und aus dem Weg gehen.
An Stauraum für die eigene Kleidung hat es leider etwas gemangelt, wir haben dann improvisiert und die Schreibtische/unsere Taschen benutzt.
Die Küche ist, wenn man zu dritt darin ist, recht eng, aber da wir nicht aufwendig gekocht haben, war das für uns in Ordnung.
Die grundlegenden Utensilien an Geschirr, Töpfen, Besteck, Küchenhelfern und Geräten sind vorhanden (4 Plattenherd mit Backofen, Kühlschrank mit Eisfach, Wasserkocher, Doppelspülbecken (keine Spülmaschine), ein Espressokocher für den Herd und ein Filteraufsatz (da ich keinen Kaffee trinke für mich nicht relevant)).
Die Dusche befindet sich in der Badewanne (mit Vorhang).
Einkaufsmöglichkeiten (Netto, Bäcker, Gemüsehändler, Imbisse) waren in unmittelbarer Nähe und wir haben uns in dem Viertel sicher gefühlt (waren aber auch nie nach 23Uhr zurück).
4 Stockwerke im Altbau sind übrigens schon, je nach Tagewerk oder Einkaufsvolumen eine Herausvorderung ;-).
Wir haben uns jedenfalls wohl gefühlt und hatten eine gute Woche in Berlin.
Proche du centre, et conforme aux commentaires existants
Solid stay. Wasn't overpriced. Easily accessible.
Great place, nice and responsive host and very peaceful area.
Zu empfehlen
Great accomodation, very nice stylish flat, good location, close to the very centre.
Wonderful appartment in a nice and central area.

Exactly what we expected. Room is good value for money. Nice and clean with a nice bathroom and the U Bahn station is just across the road. It’s an ideal location if you’re doing a lot of travelling on public transport.
great place to stay!

Die Wohnung ist zwar sehr schön, ist aber eher für jungere Leute als wir gemeint. Im Zimmer war es etwas eng für 2 Personen aber das Bett war gemütlich und alles nötige war vorhanden. Es gab kein Kleiderschrank oder sonst was da drin, wo man die Klamotten aufheben konnte. Lucky ist ein sehr netter, lockere Gastgeber und stand bei Bedarf gut zur Verfügung. Das Badezimmer hatte ein Hauch Luxus sogar und das Internet hat bestens funktioniert!

The place is very nice, but really meant for younger travelers than us. The room was a little small for 2 people, but the bed was comfortable and everything necessary provided, except that there was no closet or cupboard to store clothes, so we had to live out of our suitcases the whole time. Lucky is a friendly, relaxed host who was easy to reach in case of need. The bathroom even had a touch of luxury and the Internet was good!
Tanja’s place is very clean and spacious. The location is just outside the of the city centers and a really short walking distance to the metro. She was a great host.
All perfect, very well located, clean, nice decorated, warm.. I can totally recommend it!

The location is perfect for anyone visiting Berlin who does not mind walking.  Go left out the door, left on Albrechtstrasse 5’ max to the Spree River for restaurants and a lovely river stroll.  Bakery just down the street. We were able to visit most historical points of interest by walking 30 mins.  German Technical Museum 45 mins but worth it.  Uber and Bolt for those less fond of walking.  The stairs/ladder to the loft is steep.  Anyone with fear of height may be intimidated.  Basic cooking gear only, coffee maker, Nespresso also.  Would be nice to have some laundry detergent for the washer.  Bed is in a tight space.  Windows open to courtyard.  No view.  Met our expectations (a couple).  Would rent again.  Thanks Mia.

Super süßes kleines Hotel in guter Lage. Die Kommunikation verlief reibungslos und der Check-in zu einer späteren Uhrzeit war auch kein Problem.
Die Zimmer sind sauber und liebevoll eingerichtet. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt :)

Perfekt, war super. 👍
Sehr nette Gastgeberin und unproblematischer Check-In/-Out.
Great location, smooth and nice communication with Pablo! The place is stylish and nice decorated, would love to stay here again!

Daniel & Darren waren super freundlich und hilfsbereit!
Die Wohnung ist ein kleiner Traum, super schön und hochwertig ausgestattet, man fühlt sich mit dem vielen Holz sofort wohl, es ist super gemütlich und sehr stylisch!
Es ist genug Platz und gut aufgeteilt und wir hatten eine wirklich schöne Zeit!
Super chambre et bien situé, très bon qualité prix, je recommande !!

David war sehr gastfreundlich und konnte mir auf viele Fragen über Berlin Antwort geben. Die Straßenbahn fährt direkt in der Nähe ab, man sollte sich aber bewusst sein, dass Schöneweide eher am Rande von Berlin liegt und entsprechend Zeit mitbringen, wenn man in die City möchte. Die WG ist größtenteils sauber und gemütlich eingerichtet.
Lovely place stay, easy access to city centre great location

Werner has been a great host. The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures, wide and clean, with all the comforts. The neighborood is quiet and the metro station to the centre is very close. We warmly recommend Werner apartment!
Great and clean apartment in a wonderful Berlin area. We really liked it and we would be happy to stay at Andea's place again 🤍
Beautiful place! Highly recommend!
Super efficient Management, clean, proper and spacious rooms. Typically, hotel rooms in this price range fit into the amazing bathroom alone;) Also liked the location!

Bra lägenhet till bra pris. Köket är väldigt litet men överlag en trevlig lägenhet. Värden var lätt att kommunicera med, in och utcheckningen okomplicerad. Lätt att nå stora delar av Berlin från lägenhetens plats med kollektivtrafik!
Thanks to Marc the appartement was great  !

Bernd met me in person, described everything clearly and make sure that we got everything we need.
The room is bigger and better than photos on Airbnb. Location is the best!
Will stay here again next time I come to Berlin!

Abbiamo soggiornato per tre giorni in questa splendida stanza e siamo rimasti molto soddisfatti. La pulizia e il comfort sono eccellenti, tutto era curato nei minimi dettagli per garantire un soggiorno piacevole. I proprietari sono stati gentilissimi e sempre disponibili per qualsiasi necessità. Inoltre, la posizione è perfetta: il quartiere è molto calmo, ideale per rilassarsi dopo una giornata in giro. Consigliamo vivamente questa sistemazione e sicuramente torneremo se ne avremo l’occasione!

A wonderful rooftop apartment in an excellent location with a great little terrace to drink the morning coffee. I used to live in the area so I knew that the location was top. Very quiet but only a 5 minute walk to the next Tram and 10 min walk to the subway. Elevator very convenient, kitchen offers everything you need. The internet at times was a bit spotty but all in all not an issue. Good mattress, washing machine everything was as described. Excellent communication with the host.
I will definitely come again if I am in the area ( which I will).

Ich habe 3 Tage bzw. 2 Nächte in Berlin verbracht. Es war bei Ulf sehr angenehm, der Aufenthalt hat sich wie eine angenehme WG angefühlt. Ich konnte mich mit ihm viel unterhalten, er hatte auch Empfehlungen bezüglich der Innenstadt. Ansonsten war er sehr entspannt und entgegenkommend. Das Zimmer war sehr angenehm, gute Aussicht, angenehme Atmosphäre.

L'appartement est joliment décoré et très agréable à vivre. Il est idéalement situé dans un environnement calme mais à proximité de nombreux restaurants et cafés. Il est à quelques stations de tram de l'Alexanderplatz et de toutes les grandes connexions.  La communication avec Katrin était facile et chaleureuse et elle a été très arrangeante pour me faciliter le départ. Je recommande vivement cet appartement!

Freddy is super nice and welcoming guest. We love our room in Berlin and it is also close to the central city. The room is amazing and it also offers amenities like milk and oats etc. love the coffee as well.

Thanks for hosting us,it was perfect, just as a recommendation change the knifes 🔪 😀 the once you got is just was terrible )))
all the restperfect!
Hope come back soon!

Wir mussten aufgrund eines Havarie Vorfalls in eine andere Unterkunft von Nena Apartments (Kreuzberg). Die Unterkunft war kleiner als die von uns gebuchte und es war kein Fön vorhanden. Letzteres ist nicht allzu schlimm, da ich immer meinen eigenen auf Reisen mitnehme. Wir hatten einen kleinen Balkon, der in den Innenhof gerichtet ist, was das Zimmer wieder aufgewertet hat. Ansonsten war alles sauber im Zimmer.
可爱又温馨的住所 还有两只可爱的小猫咪陪伴 实在是太幸福的一次旅行体验🥰🥰

Appartement sublime dans le meilleur quartier de Berlin (selon moi ;-)). Les alentours sont remplis de petits bars et restaurants tous très sympa ! Le canal à proximité est très agréable pour les balades et prendre le café.
Ella est très accueillante et le logement comme sur les photos ! Merci encore !
This is a little oasis. A wonderful and relaxing hideaway in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg. It was a lovely stay.

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt! Die Zimmer und die gemeinsam genutzten Dusch- und WC-Räume wurden täglich gereinigt und waren gut ausgestattet. Durch die Innenhoflage war es auch immer ruhig. Wir haben uns dort sehr wohlgefühlt! Die Zimmer haben nur leider ein bisschen chemisch gestunken, was aber nicht allzu sehr gestört hat.

Kirsten’s apartment is the ultimate OG Airbnb dream. It’s spacious, full of character, and clearly lived-in in the best way—everything has a personal touch and unique style that makes it feel warm and real. The view over the canals is absolutely stunning, and the whole experience was smooth, relaxed, and beautiful from start to finish. Honestly can’t imagine a better place to stay in Berlin. Would come back in a heartbeat!

It was an amazing experience especially as my first air bnb!! It was so nice having little toiletries which came in super handy and the sugar/ condiments in the cupboards too! Super comfy beds, lovely and warm apartment and lovely bed linen! Shower was fantastic, location was great, and your mum is so friendly and welcoming!! My only suggestion would be bring an eye mask as there isn’t a blackout blind. As the apartment got very light from 6am. Other than that- we loved it!!!

The apartment is in a great location with plenty of great restaurants nearby and super close to a station for the s-bahn. The apartment is basic but equipped with everything you need. Communication was pleasant. Only tip to improve, install a full length mirror to do outfit checks.

This AirBNB was fantastic.  As far as the room goes, it was probably the nicest and most well kept room we've stayed in so far.  The space was very large, very clean, and very comfortable.  The beds were great, the bathroom was perfect, and the kitchen was the perfect size.  The room is very "studio"-ish (meaning, one giant room), and was beautifully furnished.  The wi-fi was perfect, and having a TV was super nice!  The neighborhood is quiet but safe, and the place is a very very short walk from great shopping, and easy transport to the city center.  Also, the room felt very secure, as we were able to not only lock all the doors but roll down metal screens/gates from the inside that closed off the door, like a closed shop in a mall.  Martin was extremely friendly, funny, and kind, and he helped us find our way around the area and the city and answered all of our questions happily.  For those curious, he's a native English speaker, so you won't have to worry about a language barrier like you do in some other places.  I highly recommend this place - we had a wonderful experience!
L’appoggio risponde perfettamente all’annuncio
Nice place in the midle of the city

Es war ein absolut fantastischer Urlaub!
Das Haus ist wunderschön und mit viel Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet. Der Garten - ein echter Traum. Katrin hat sich liebevoll um uns gekümmert. Danke Katrin, auch für die vielen sehr guten Empfehlungen und Tips für Ausflüge und Restaurants.

Die Lage ist fantastisch. Es gibt unzähige schöne Badestellen, die man schnell und einfach erreicht. Die Anbindung an das Berliner Zentrum ist sehr gut. Bin immer noch fasziniert davon, dass es die ganze Nacht eine Anbindung an das Zentrum gibt ;)

Ein Rundum-Sorglos-Urlaub. Nochmals vielen Dank und wir werden sicher noch viele Male wiederkommen! Grüße an deine tolle Familie!
Melanie

The flat is cozy, big and well equipped. The location is perfect, 2 minutes from the ubahn lines 7 and 9. There is a supermarket next door. Everything was very clean and Hilda is welcoming and nice. Recommended!

Sirdin is really easy to communicate with and gave us clear instructions for check-ins and recommendations around the area. The kitchen is good and everything is here toilet paper, towel etc. The apartment is ready to use from the first time we arrived.
The most important thing is for us Asians this is a perfect place. I recommend this apartment because on the first floor they have a Turkish supermarket and on the left and right there are many options that really match our needs.
We stayed here for around two weeks and enjoy our stay. About the noise, i think this is more than okay for us, we don't have trouble sleeping because of the streets. Maybe it is because our tolerance toward noise is different.
overall this is a perfect place for us, I really recommend it if you travel from Asia like us for example.

Bequemes und hübsch eingerichtetes Appartment mit guter Verkehrsanbindung. Wir haben als Familie mit vier Personen einen sehr angenehmen Aufenthalt in der Wohnung gehabt. Unkomplizierter Check-in und Check out, sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung an die Innenstadt, nette Umgebung mit vielen Restaurants. Die Wohnung selbst entspricht genau den Angaben. Sie ist ruhig und hübsch eingerichtet. Die Küche ist zwar klein, enthält aber alle notwendigen Geräte und Utensilien. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Der Check in war super easy und man hatte durch das eigenständige einchecken keinen Umweg den man auf sich nehmen muss. Die Unterkunft war sauber und sehr schön groß. Die Gegend war ruhig, was mit Kind ein großer Vorteil ist in Berlin.Von der Unterkunft kann man über einfache Bahnwege alle größeren Orte ganz einfach erreichen. In der Unterkunft gab es sogar ein wenig Spielzeug, das hat meine Tochter total gefreut. Die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war ebenfalls sehr gut. Man bekommt sofort eine Antwort, mit wichtigen Informationen. Durch den Informationsfluss gibt es eigentlich keinen Nachfrage Bedarf mehr. Der Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm.
Geniale, ruhige Lage in einem Hinterhof! Kommen jederzeit gerne wieder
Sehr schöne Unterkunft für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in Berlin. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

Es war alles perfekt und so gut durchdacht, der Service sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Die Kitchenette ist der Hit!
Ich kann mir keine bessere Unterkunft in dieser Lage zu diesem Preis vorstellen. Ich komme gerne wieder!
All good, only we were not really aware that the entrance was through one of the rooms and the extra keys were missing. That didn‘t feel so good for the person in the room.

10/10 sehr charmant eingerichtet, das Bett war super erholsam und ich vermisse die Decken! Die Kissen waren mir persönlich etwas zu flach aber an sich kein Problem.
Die Wohnung ist klein reicht aber vollkommen aus für 2 Personen die nicht planen ein großes Festmahl zu kochen.
Es war wirklich entspannt und ich komme gerne wieder!
Close transport options. Friendly neighbourhood. Well operated.
Baassam is a real fine gentleman, good taste and intelligence.  Kreuzberg is a very nice neighborhood...

We loved the place, the location and Laura’s communication, instructions and tips. We had some little issues, but she answerd immediately and was helpful. I would definitelly reccomend for short, or longer stays.
Great place with great location. Will defo come back again

A lovely stay at the mini loft! The beds were set up for everyone when we got to the apartment, place was clean, tidy and quiet. Good brunch places nearby as well as the metro.
While the check in instructions were clear and easy, there was no mention of what floor the apartment was on and when we got into the elevator, we didn’t realise we had to hold the key against a scanner to be able to press the buttons so almost got stuck - we worked it out fairly quickly and from then it wasn’t a problem, but would be good to mention something for the avoidance of doubt! Apart from that, a great stay!
Great place with a nice aesthetic! Also rather spacious. Would book again if I get to Berlin!

Bettdecke viel zu dünn:
Mein Aufenthalt war im Dezember, draußen 8 Grad, die Wohnung & das Zimmer waren ausgekühlt, es gab nur eine sehr dünne Sommerdecke, keine zusätzliche Decke im Schrank. Ich musste daher in voller Kleidung & Mantel schlafen (da ich bei Eintreffen gegen 00 Uhr Fr. Neumann nicht anrufen wollte).
Die Option, die Heizung voll aufzudrehen, entfiel für mich, da dies ständiges Rauschen verursachte und die Erwärmung des Zimmers zu lange dauerte.
Weiter ist zu beachten: auschecken früh 09:00.
Wohnung ist sehr sauber, Frau Neumann freundlich.

We really enjoyed our stay at Sketch! The room was so cozy, clean and with everything you may need!
I very recommend staying at Sketch:)

Ein wunderschöner Ort in Berlin, zentral gelegen im zweiten und dadurch sehr ruhigen Hinterhof. Der Hauptbahnhof ist nicht weit und auch sonst gibt es viel zu tun in der Umgebung. Das Loft ist groß, sehr groß. Und mit viel Stil und Geschmack eingerichtet. Thomas und Alex sind hervorragende und sehr sympathische Gastgeber.
Der check in in die Wohnung war problem los, Olivier war immer gut zu erreichen und hat eine 1A Wohnung zur Verfügung gestellt. Optimale Lage, gerne wieder!!!
Einfach nur top! Immer wieder!

The 3rd floor loft is spacious and well equipped. We were two couples who were here to explore Berlin. Place was large and well organized - kitchen was extremely well equipped as we cooked a couple meals in and we weren't missing anything.
I could imagine in the summer on a hot day it might be warm, but it was October, so no issues.
Definitely would recommend it.

Great place to stay & very walkable. Only negative was I could not for the life of me get the bedroom patio door open even with the instructions. But the living patio was spacious enough and we spent each of our evenings out there.
Thank you again for hosting us!
Great apartment, great location.
Great, clean, spacious flat with a convinient access to the airport. A perfect haven for exploring a manic and absolutely crazy town. Wuhuu Berlin.
Sehr gastfreundlich

De communicatie verliep super! We hadden een kleine lekkage en ze stonden de volgende dag gelijk op de stoep om het asap te repareren. De locatie was top, de ruimte was ook zoals omschreven, kortom een hele fijne plek om te verblijven met een groep. 🙌🏼🔝
Sehr empfehlenswert!

Perfect flat for a couple.
10 min by foot from train station.
Restaurants near the flat.
Quiet place.
The Automated Receptionist 110% of the time killed the experience👎

The place was super nicely decorated with a small but cozy balcony. Nearby it is a canal where there was a nice atmosphere in warm summer nights.
The kitchen is small but equipped with all basic and necessary tools. We could use spices, coffee etc and Kim bought us some strawberries, which was really nice.
Transportation wise there is a bus going to the next S Bahn station (or 20 mins walk) or to the other direction 15 min walk to the u Bahn station.
Communication was quick and check in was easy.
We would stay here again!
Kjempefin leilighet! Alt er som beskrevet i annonse. Vi kommer gjerne tilbake :)
Alles in Ordnung👍

Very nice location: close to U1U3U7, nice neighborhood as well!
Beautiful interior, nice and cozy, has everything we needed!
Cozy and comfortable. Anneli was an amazing host whose home and hospitality was a warm welcome to a new city. Very clean, comfortable and you are surrounded by beautiful art work:)

We have enjoyed our stay in Celly’s apartment. The stylish looks of the apartment and other services brougt us much more than a hotel room ever could. Certainly compared to such prices. The price/value ratio was very good.
The contact with Celly was very easy. He was very flexible in his check-in time so that we could experience Berlin from the moment we got there.
Furthermore, the placement of the apartment was quite good. We’ve enjoyed the beautiful park in front of the apartment and the evenings were very quiet. We as a young couple rented a scooter so that we could go everywhere on our own. But the apartment is very good reachable by bus from everywhere around the city.
Overall, we loved our stay in Celly’s apartment from arrival to departure. I strongly recommend the apartment and Celly as your host.
호스트도 정말 친절하고, 집도 깨끗하고 예뻐요! 도심하고 멀지도 않고, 15분 내외로 시내에 도착할 수 있어요. 복잡스러운 도시 시내를 별로 선호하지 않는 분들에게 적극 추천해요! 그리고 안젤라 정말 최고예요:)
感谢Mr.Oliver，帮我打印古典音乐会门票，以及：虽然厨房不在airbnb服务范围内，但他依旧允许我储存了我的牛奶和水果，Thanks

We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment is compact but has everything you might need — a safe, a coffee machine, a kettle, and some nice welcome treats. The bathroom was surprisingly spacious and well-equipped, which was a great bonus.
The location is super central, with lots of places to eat and small shops just around the corner. At the same time, it was quiet at night — even with the window open, we slept really well.
Big thanks to the host — communication was easy, friendly, and helpful throughout. Instructions were clear, and it felt like we could always reach out if anything came up.

Wenn man etwas für eine Nacht braucht, super empfehlenswert. Die Wohnung ist allerdings sehr hellhörig und die Zimmer sehr klein. Es gibt auch weder im Bad noch im Zimmer Abfalleimer. In der Küche gibt es eine Herdplatte und sonst ist vorhanden, was man braucht. Das Check-in ist super leicht und dadurch flexibel, was mir sehr gut gefallen hat.
Buen alojamiento en barrio tranquilo y con servicios (restaurantes, autoservicios y buena comunicación).Martín es un encanto. Estuvo muy atento en todo momento.

Considering what you have to pay for a two bedroom apartment elsewhere in Berlin, this place is a treasure. It’s located in a green and quiet part of the city and is nicely decorated, with details like Berlin-mugs to drink your coffee out of. The dishwasher and the rainshower also are a big plus, as are the free bicycles that come with the appartment. You’ll need them, because it’s a 15 minute walk to the nearest S-Bahn station.
As is the case with everything that sounds too good to be true, this place comes with a price. Let’s just say owner Hans is quite a character. The retired engineer started to rent out the first floor of his house, because he likes the company. And once he starts talking, he simply doesn’t stop.
To make matters worse, Hans is highly opinionated. He has something to say about almost everything, including his guests (past and present). When we went to ask him for some extra towels, he wasn’t home so we sent him a textmessage through the Airbnb-app. He showed up at the door later that evening to tell us we weren’t getting those towels and took almost two hours (!) of our time to lecture us on the effect showering has on the environment and that we shouldn’t expect this kind of service for the money we were paying.
Needless to say, we repeatedly tried to get out of that conversation, which we experienced as very uncomfortable. But being polite got us nowhere so in the end, we had to shut the door on him. A door that cannot be locked; although the complete first floor is yours, you can only lock the two bedrooms (which wasn’t an option for us, while our 2 year old daughter was staying in the other room).
Although the owner is outspoken, his advert fails to mention that the house is still under construction. The back side was in scaffolding and it isn’t hard to see why: the plaster is crumbling and the windowframes are rotten. Hans tries to fix everything himself but doesn’t seem to have the time to do so. This also shows inside the apartment, which isn’t thoroughly cleaned. There’s dust in the corners, mold in the shower and crumbles in the cupboards.
At least the problems with the house can be fixed and if Hans adds some curtains to his pleated blinds (so you don’t wake up when the sun rises, as our daughter did), this appartment will truly be a gem. Hans will still be Hans though. If you’re looking for a nice place to stay and don’t mind spending a serious amount of time speaking with - or rather: listening to - the owner, look no further. If that’s not the case, please continue searching.

The only caution I would give to a prospective guest is that having such a beautiful space to yourself makes it difficult to want to get out and explore Berlin. That said, I think we were very lucky to have that problem.
I would highly recommend the stay if you’ve ever wanted a small gallery for yourself for a night or two.
Die beste Lage die man kriegen kann. Sehr zufrieden gewesen 👍🏽
Alles super, gerne wieder!

Wir hatten leider einen kalten Aufenthalt in der Unterkunft. Die Heizungen haben nicht richtig funktioniert, weshalb die Wohnung kalt war. Das Wasser zum duschen wurde ebenfalls nur Lauwarm. Unsere Zeit während unseres Aufenthaltes wurde dadurch auch gestört. Die Wohnung an sich war schön aber die Sauberkeit lässt ebenfalls zu wünschen übrig…

Berat is super helpful and his place is amazing! High ceilings, tastefully decorated, spacious and everything you could want.
Very close to the U bahn so excellently placed to get around Berlin.
I’d highly recommend Berat’s place.

voordelen: ruim appartement, voldoende informatie over Berlijn aanwezig, rustig gelegen aan een binnentuin achter een wooncomplex, goed aanbod van restaurants in de directe omgeving

nadelen: weinig glaswerk aanwezig, gescheiden badkamer en toilet zou prettig zijn (wij waren met 6 personen), geen buitenruimte (mochten geen gebruik maken van de binnentuin)

A really nice place! The apartment is big and spacous, clean and quite. The area contains some restaurants, food shops and a "spätkauf" (kiosk open late, for whine, beer etc). Only a few minutes walk to the subway with easy axcess to Zoologisher Garten and further communication. Helmut is easy to get in contact with, and 'help' is not far away.
The beds are a little bit to hard for my liking (and three of the other fellow guests), but not a big problem.

Tia’s place is absolutely amazing. Perfect location on the river. Close to wonderful restaurants and sights. Close to the Metro. Central to almost everything. The apartment is huge and VERY spacious. It is beautifully decorated and furnished. The amenities are fantastic, and we had absolutely everything we needed. Tia greeted us personally and provided us with reliable communication and neighborhood recommendations. Do not hesitate to book Tia’s apartment for your stay in Berlin!!

Just perfect. No fussing around for checking in, no keys to pick up in some shop, no keys to leave somewhere, no bizarre instructions, a super fast wifi, induction plates if you want to cook, enough utensils for some basic cooking, a microwave, a toaster - everything you need. Very comfortable bed, soft bedding, and extremely quiet - we slept like babies.
I’ll be back here for every one of my coming trips to Berlin.
Great location and very nice set up apartment.

The host was very friendly and helpful throughout our stay including providing additional pillows and allowing us to store luggage. The apartment itself is a perfect size. The bed is comfortable, the shower is very nice and powerful and the kitchen has everything you need to cook. The location is good, there are bus stops nearby and an S bahn station that you can get to the centre of Berlin. The area is quite quiet. There are a few takeaways and a few bars but it is not a lively area.
everything was perfect.

최고의 호스트 응대는 우리 가족을 즐겁게 하였다. 또한 음료, 주류 등을 제공해 주어 편리하고 즐겁게 지낼 수 있었다. 주변의 식당 등도 직접 소개해 주어 편했다. 숙소의 위치는 두개의 전철역에 5~6분 거리에 있어 이동이 편했으며, 주변에도 큰 마트와 식품점이 있어 숙박객에게 편리할 것이다.

I would absolutely 100% recommend this place to stay to anyone in the future.
We stayed at Audrey's for two nights. Audrey was extremely helpful and even messaged us a detailed plan for how to get to the flat from the airport. When we arrived Audrey made sure she was there to welcome us. She was very considerate and provided us with a useful guide to the local area.
The room was quite large and we never felt cramped in it. It was very warm and quiet at night and we had two very peaceful nights sleeps. We also had our own separate door in and out of the flat which was useful because it meant we didn't have to worry about waking anyone up.
To get to central Berlin (with all the museums) it was only about a 5 minute walk and a 15 minute train. It might sound far but it was really quick and easy.
We ate at two places that I would recommend to future visitors: BurgerMeister (close to East Side Gallery) and Nosh (close to the flat). Both were really nice and not too expensive.
In summary, Audrey's place is lovely and perfect for anyone to visit Berlin. She was a lovely host and we hope to visit her again in the future.

Die Wohnung entspricht genau ihrer Beschreibung. Für eine Städtetour super geeignet. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und es war alles vorhanden, was man benötigt.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!

Antje's apartment really does deserve all the praise and high ratings. It truly is a great airbnb but also a home!
I had my girlfriend visit Berlin every year. This time we decided to spent a month in Berlin so we could holiday and work remotely, end lockdown in our favourite city but also near the lakes and nature. Antje's apartment ticket every box.
We wanted to be close to Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. It's a 15min walk or 5 min cycle from the apartment. Very happy!
We needed high speed reliable internet for the week we would be remote working. It's over 80mg super fast. So more than enough for high end user for video calls, conference calls and HD streaming. Very Happy!

The apartment is a home and feels as much. The kitchen is particularly exceptional has everything you would need for a long stay.
We enjoyed our time immensely, so much I extended an extra week!
Good place to stay for a short term. Had everything you need, check in was extremely easy and quick, everything in the room was clean and fresh.

es halt alles perfekt gepasst - sehr sauberes bad/küche/zimmer, frische bettwäsche/ handtücher, gute kommunikation mit der vermieterin & immer eine schnelle antwort bekommen, einfacher check-in:out mit guter beschreibung & auch die lage war top:)

This place is absolutely amazing! I stayed for one month as a transitional space moving from LA to Berlin. I could also see this being a beautiful place to have for one or two days. Sehr sauber mit einem unkomplizierten Check In. Parken ist leider schwierig da es nur mit Parkschein geht (Tagespreis 18€).

The bathroom was always spotless and there were even (plenty of) extra towels for the guests if they need them. Overall 20/10 experience.

Very beautiful apartment! Was all extremely clean. Kitchen is well equipped with everything needed and more. Location is great. No complaints. Would highly recommend for everyone!

I very much enjoyed my stay at Simone's well-equipped and well-kept apartment in the suburban Berlin Tegel neighborhood, allowing me to work during the day, and get out into town in the evenings and on weekends: internet connectivity is flawless, there is a big desk, sufficient light, and it's quiet. A supermarket for all basic necessities is a 7 minutes walk away - and so is public transport. Frequently operating busses easily connect to major U-Bahn lines, making up for the fact that the nearest U-Bahn station (Holzhauer Str., U6) is currently not functional due to construction work.
Simone and Stefan are great hosts, always available for a friendly chat. A small lake, Flughafensee, is accessible from the end of the street; i found it quite crowded on hot WE days, though. The bigger Tegeler See, is also in walking distance, with a nice shore promenade, boating opportunities, and eateries close by (Alt-Tegel).
Alles ist auf einem hohen Niveau. Passt ideal für eine Familie.
Alles top! Tolle Gastgeber und ein absolut ruhiges Haus!

I loved staying at Albert's flat.  "Superb" is the only word to describe it.  It's bright and sunny and immaculately clean: there's not a speck of dust anywhere and you could safely perform open-heart surgery in the kitchen and bathroom.  The weather was very hot during my stay but the bedroom has an air-con unit which has  a low-setting which is absolutely silent and kept the room cool all night.  The flat is near a busy road but the double-glazing is sound-proof so there was no noise from the traffic inside the flat.  All the furniture and fittings are brand new and Albert obviously takes great pride in his flat and being a wonderful host.  I can recommend without qualification and I'd be happy to stay there again.  People with mobility problems should be aware that the flat is on the third floor and there's no lift but, if you don't have a problem with that, this is an excellent place to stay.

Direct op de hoek van de straat bevindt zich een bakker met dagelijks goed vers brood en de mogelijkheid om aan te schuiven voor een ontbijt. Prima! Er is een Rent a Bike Berlin op loopafstand (Anhalterstrasse).
